Author: Choi Yee C
Title: no table
Review: nice place to visit everytime go melaka, not so good is a lot family sit whole area occupy alot of seat

Author: Renganathan S
Title: Best food in town
Review: I tried linguine bolognaise sauce... It's very awesome!!! The wine by glass also very nice go with my meal... I really enjoyed my dinner!!! Well done!!!

Author: vidyamenonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Was in the area...
Review: Was around the area and stopped by to have a drink and to my surprise, the banana chocolate shake that i had was simply amazing and according tomy husband,the double espresso that he had was also very good...dont know bout the rest of the stuff they serve...xx

Author: lookbackwithjoeyUnited Kingdom
Title: WILL NOT RETURN. 'ENTIER'-LY WASTE OF MY TIME AND MONEY.
Review: I was so disappointed with this restaurant. I came here for my birthday last year but the lunch was the most disappointing one ever. We felt invisible to the staff and we did not get the service we paid for. I have sent a complaint email to them on the same day and received a reply stating that they will discuss with the restaurant and I will get a follow up email but 8 months later, still no update from them. Utterly disappointed. Entier is a French fine dining restaurant but provides service worse than night market. We wasted our time and calories dining at this restaurant. 3 hours lunch for ONLY TWO COURSES. TWO! (2 courses because I had to CANCEL the 3rd course) We waited 30 mins for our order to be taken, another 30mins for our amuse bouche which was quickly accompanied by our starter (weird timing but okay). Took ages for our empty plates to be collected away, another 30 mins for our main course and more than 35mins for our dessert that never came. It took so long I had to cancel it. I was very disappointed that I didn't get to try their burnt cheesecake and Madeleine but I've waited long enough for the entire lunch. They even took forever to get us our drinks. A table beside us who ordered later than us got their meals way quicker than us. We got no attention from the waiters and when we asked them about our dishes, we never see the waiters coming back to us again. What a service. Not to mention that we were placed right at the entrance, but the waiters didn't even care that we've waited hours for our meals.Poor customer service as the waiters were not attentive at all. One nearly spilled a cup of coffee on my mum when he placed it on the table.The only thing that came quick during the entire meal was THE BILL. surprise surprise.During this covid pandemic, good hygiene is expected. To my disgust, their toilet was DISGUSTING, IT WAS FILTHY! Even public toilets in malls / airports / marketplaces are cleaner than theirs.Anyway, 3 hours WASTED for only 2 COURSES. Terrible customer service, food was just average. Poor toilet hygiene.

Author: KiddySingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Some dishes too sweet, seafood overcooked
Review: My friend and I ordered 6 dishes here, which I dare say is a representation of how good the restaurant will be. I was disappointed with all but the char kway teow. The shellfish was tough and overcooked. The vegetable and no soup dish was very average. The chicken was way too sweet and non mushy. Most zi char stores in Malaysia or Singapore would do much better.

Author: cgw99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Casual Saturday Dinner
Review: Just got back from Strato, it's really difficult to either slag it off or rave about it? 4 of us ordered 1 pasta and 2 pizzas plus starters and 2bottles of red! A word to the wise watch the wine gist is as dear as the food is reasonable!Bottom line we had a fun night out but we could have got better value elsewhere!

Author: Duif_family
Title: Why not cleaning tables at night?
Review: This restaurant attracts rats, mice etc simply because they don’t clean tables at night, leaving glasses and left over food outside. This is bad for our neighbourhood and especially people living nearby. Hope restaurant can be more responsible.

Author: fongpen1
Title: Average food
Review:
Pub style cafe, serve beer and local food
Live band performance night time
Food quality - average
Just located at center of jonker street
Plenty of vegetarian food

Author: BKLauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less disappointed
Review: Less disappointed as before when it was at ground floor.Earlier experience was very rude captain, poor food quality including some ingredients gone bad, ...Now, just average food in shopping centre with high price. Service is below the intended class of restaurant, including Service Captain's response to a question borderline hamster style ...Guess Malaysians are tolerant and so used to the substandard delivery, this is quite acceptable.

Author: IanC770Cheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: After all our research to find a good Restuarant, what a disappointment!
Review: My son and we're really looking forward to a high quality meal.Restuarant was less than half full, staff seemed disinterested, service was slow, food was poor to mediocre. The chef must have spilt the salt into the main course which was delivered to the table Luke warm, perhaps they struggled to strain out the salt! The two main courses were delivered 10 minutes apart. The noodles were hopelessly undercooked. Drinking water had so much chlorine it is probably recycled from the swimming pool. The wine prices are astronomical, They charged approximately $14 for a small glass of red wine which would cost about $10 bottle in a supermarket. After a long wait a single desert menu arrived, in response to my request for a second menu I was told that there were no more menus. We could have had a better meal in the shopping mall at a fraction of the cost. The Restuarant is worth a visit to admire the very beautiful exotic fish tank, but avoid the food at all cost. Shame on you Hilton, I have had much better from you elsewhere in the world.

Author: Curiosity50589311193Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Service Great Food
Review: Great service by Ms Azura, Ms Aishah, Ms Samatha, Ms Lily & Mr Ben. Food are amazing, great atmosphere, excellent dining.

Author: Emma MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wouldn't Come Here Again
Review: Before coming to Malacca, I checked out online for places to eat and Malacca is quite well known for good food. Many websites recommended this place for me to go and I did but was utterly disappointed with my meal. And I was not the only one. Both my traveling companion were disappointed too. The meals were bland and the portion didn't seem to match the price. At least the staff were nice and the ambiance was lovely.

Author: IanWernHan_LIMKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best View of KL
Review: The main attraction is definitely the view, one of the very few places that gives you the full view of the 3 main towers of Kuala Lumpur -- the KLCC twin towers, KL tower and TRX tower. Unlike many other places, you get a full perfect view of the twin towers. Definitely go al fresco for the nice view despite the humidity of the KL.Had the grilled king prawns which was the highlight of the night for me, 3 big and succulent prawns. Having it as an appetizer do set the bar high. The Kyushou Wagyu beef after do follow it up nicely but I would suggest skipping the sauce for it. The Atlantic cod fish is nice but it lacks flavor, leaving it to the accompanying baby spinach which was really good. Finally, the lychee parfait was extremely unique. Had the food accompanied by a bottle of NZ Sauvignon Blanc which goes well. Overall, enjoyable food with some memorable dishes.Service is good as expected from such a venue. There's attention to detail for everything and the staffs do try to accommodate to the requests. Special shoutout to Firdaus who attended us when we were outside; he was attentive and did a wonderful job in showing us around including the Vertigo bar upstairs. He definitely sold us the idea of returning for the sunset.

Author: Cassie TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good seafood in Miri near Marriot Resort - sea clams, mussels, prawns & fish
Review: If you are at Miri Marriot like we were in August 2016 and did not want to pay Resort prices, this is a local seafood restaurant we ate at 3 times in our 1 week stay. As this area is not close to town, unless you have a car, this is a good food option (even for non seafood lovers - lots of choice non seafood) rather than pay resort prices. I love seafood and can definitely recommend it as clean (I am cautious of contracting Hep A overseas) and value for money. Yes, expensive if you are a local, but foreign currency exchange rates make everything is cheap in Malaysia especially their food. FYI re fruits- rambutans cost $21 Aussie dollars in Australia for 10 single rambutans so i went mad for tropical fruits here because rambutans cost $6 ringgit for a bunch (aka 20 rambutans minimum in a bunch)

Author: kwoongSingapore
Title: Most tender paper wrapped chicken
Review: Was brought to this restaurant in Johor Bahru and was told that it serves delicious paper wrapped chicken. Was not particularly excited about it, as I never really enjoy the dish. Most of the time, I find the chicken usually overcooked and too dry. The paper wrapped chicken @ Teck Sing is an exception, the chicken is tender and juicy. Really enjoyed it. Definitely the best I have tried. And, I went back several times again. Another favourite from the restaurant is the pork knuckle.

Author: 616jeetgill
Title: Stay away
Review: Stay away of this restaurant..horrible food and even worse customer service.. waiters talk as tho they are going to fight and don't even gv what u ask for..food is 2/10.. didn't enjoy anything served.

Author: lillianBirminghambirmingham
Title: Awful
Review: Booked a table here tonight for 9 people. After checking the website we were expecting a high class dining experience but were sadly disappointed the restaurant was very dark with no ambience and no lighting on the tables etc to make the dining experience good. The majority of the food was just okay (pizza) then againit would be hard to get pizza wrong. The curry and lamb were awful, we all ate at different times, nothing arrived together, the whole experience was awful, I can honestly say street food is better. When you go outside to see the roof top view, you are met by a full swimming pool, lots of noise and just really awful. I can honestly say they have missed the trick, either have a swimming pool and let people just yell away or try and create a decent restaurant.....they don’t woke together ....better places to go in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: Tina_2502Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing
Review: Went to this shop after reading some of the good reviews. Food was extremely disappointing. Tried the thosai (dosa) and a thinner version of a chapati (which the staff recommended). The tosai was extemely oily, gravy that accompanied was mediocre. And the bread that was similar to the chapati was dry, and extremely small. Felt like a complete rip-off. Can't fathom the delight of other patrons...

Author: mk25900Cleveland, Ohio
Title: Airport cafe with a proper British touch
Review: I enjoyed a warm scone (RM 9) and a nice hot pot of Earl Grey tea (RM 15) which was about 2-3 cups. Walked up to the counter, paid, and my order arrived at my table very quickly. A nice way to relax before my flight.

Author: S_BeatoongMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice meal in a beautiful setting
Review: The hotel (Seven Terraces) that the restaurant is located in is absolutely stunning and the dining room was tastefully decorated with beautiful crockery. The service was good and we were given some recommendations for their 4 course menu. The menu was supposedly nonya but there were a lot of options that reminded me of Vietnamese food. We got the spring rolls (yummy and crunchy), otak otak which was served in a pie form (tasty), tamarind beef (quite dry), pork belly (some pieces had great crunch but overall very tasty), super crunchy tempura veges, four bean salad, pandan creme brûlée (better dessert) and the mousse. Everything was generally well cooked and yummy but we didn't think it was anything super innovative. It is definitely pricier than most restaurants in Penang but you get to sit in beautiful chairs, and eat off gorgeous plates and bowls while a pianist plays in the background.

Author: agw350
Title: This must have gone down hill quickly
Review: Given positive reviews, we went out of our way to select this restaurant and its highly reviewed Peking Duck. What a disappointment. To begin with, no one serving or waiting could speak English -- surprising for a Marriott property. And then our meal. The beautiful duck was carved excellently -- and delivered COLD! Only one of two vegetable dishes arrived, and only after we had finished the warmed up duck and asked for them several times. At this point we did not bother to ask again for the one that they forgot. Often we waited long periods for someone to show up at our table. We travel a lot (Marriott Titanium) and this was a true disappointment. When the duck arrived cold, they should have just told us they weren't charging and sent us on our way to another restaurant!

Author: sharonjaneliauSelangor
Title: More ice than juice!
Review: I've been to Melaka so many times and I know that this place is always packed, so just recently I managed to sit down after walking around jongker street night market and ordered a simple 'Mix Juice' from their menu with my buddy to quench our thirsts. Once placing our orders I reminded the waiter for less ice in both our drinks.When the drinks served, I could only taste water and once we drank half, we noticed the ice covers 80% of the glass... Before we left we decided to address the matter to the staff and unfortunately the staff find it hard to understand and I feel doesn't give a damn about QC at all. We were given a complimentary juice to compensate for their mistake.However when we were leaving, a floor manager came and started to harass us by saying 'you're not allowed to complain after you finish the drinks... you need to complain before that' - (if we don't drink it, how can we know how it taste? how do we know how much ice they put in?). He added 'It's normal for us to put so much ice in our juice...' ' there's so many people to serve here...' (what the??) - I felt as we were accused for addressing the issue.Even though it's just a simple juice, they already failed in so many ways... can't imagine myself going back there again... such a pity.

Author: JBenProvence
Title: Inflexible staff
Review:
Customer always king, right? Not at Tujo.  Asked for a simple menu upgrade (at no cost to the restaurant) after visiting the restaurant several times with my family of 5. Denied. 

#BuyerBeware

Author: Scottygirl82Malaysia
Title: Delightful lunch
Review: The concept of a twin cuisine restaurant is a little strange, especially when Mexican and Dim Sum are the pairing, but it somehow works.We ate fish tacos, prawns and mango salad, and apart from the limited cheese on the salad it was fresh, tasty and served quickly. The service overall was good, and the entire restaurant seemed to be running well.

Author: Emily Y
Title: Always happy to be here
Review: This is my 4th time having their dinner buffet. Always wanted to compliment their staff but i always forgot. This time i promised the manager i would do it.Food - Cannot miss out the cold section! I always go for the Oysters, prawns and snow crab legs. What makes me keep coming back is the oysters. It is huge, creamy and as fresh as it can get. Prawns are sweet and firm. Basically i get full from eating these 2. The selection is quite ok (chinese, salad, a bit of japanese, indonesian, indian, pasta and dessert). You cannot miss out the most popular Durian cake. Whenever it is out, a quarter will be gone. It is like eating the real durian with coconut milk. Yum! The dessert section is quite big, it is about 30% of the whole buffet. Kids go crazy! The hot section has room to be improve though. I would even go once a month if the hot dishes are as good (and 2hrs of crossing the causeway wont sway my determination to eat there).Service crew - I don't know how the manager do such a good job training the staff. Everyone is very helpful and friendly. They are always smiling and they will ask you politely if they can clear your plates (and they do it diligently). They treat every diner as their friend. Price - I say it is very reasonable at RM128. For the quality of seafood and crew, you can't complain much. Good job Makan Kitchen!
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: MaytsoBradenton, Florida
Title: Extremely disappointed with the food and service
Review: We were very curious about this restaurant because of the nightly crowds visible from our appartment/hotel next door. Had to try it. Will not go there again!!Having read some of the on-line reviews,we expected the food to be somewhat decent.We were very disappointed. Being Chinese,we can usually tell if a dish is well prepared or taste right.We ordered several dishes. The stewed pork with preserved vegetables tasted like it had been prepared weeks ago.Came in a very small dish with meat that tasted dry and very little sauce...more like leftovers. The Herbal Chicken dish which some reviewers praised turned out to be disappointing. The meat was dry and swimming in a thick gooey sauce. Had a tough time trying to figure if it was meant to be a soup or sauce. The stewed stuffed tau foo though tasty was overcooked. The only decent dish was the cold salad of fern fronds!Had 2 other dishes thst were equally bad.AND the service....or the LACk of it!!!! The waitstaff was totally indiffrent and VERY surly. Had to call them several times to take our orders. They did not refill our teapot....which was a metal pot filled with some premade brown liquid (supposedly tea) for which we had to pay.I think a great number of Malaysian Chinese have lost their tastebuds for good quality Chinese food. Many of them are used to " Chinese " foods cooked by their foreign maids who probably have no idea what Chinese food ought to taste like!!We are amased that this restaurant is so busy. Could be due to the location and the ample parking.Also beware....if you are allergic to MSG..avoid this restaurant.The food is laden with it. Iwas dying with thirst until the next day.

Author: KY G
Title: Puff Galore all types of variety of filling to choose from
Review:
You can have your curry mee or mee suah for breakfast here. 
Next you get to savour the famous puff form the next stall. you have fillings which cater to adults and kids. It was heavenly.

Author: Vegetarian4everBristol, United Kingdom
Title: overcharging for tourists
Review: Be careful here as they are known for overcharging tourists.Any white Caucasian is overcharged.How do I know? I checked the price per portion with the local office staff at 1:30 pm lunch time and they told me my dish should cost half the price they paid. should be about 5 ringits .buffet style but avoid lunch times! office and locals mainly here

Author: fizajamal
Title: Cosy Place
Review: Love how it is in the city centre but feels like an escape from it. Great coffee & friendly staff! Worth a detour for a great coffee. Had their buttermilk fried chicken & it was juicy!! WIll try their pasta when I have the chance to come back

Author: CrystalPalaceFamily
Title: Great tasting traditional Pakistani food
Review: Loved the food, very simple cafe style restaurant.We ate keen roti and keema naan and very tasty karahi chicken dish, would recommend the tandoori roti

Author: Mukesh70
Title: One of the best Indian restaurant in KL
Review: The restaurant is situated in Brick field (little India) close to Central LRT. Food served here is very good and tasty. They have north Indian and south Indian both. Must eat when you stay in KL.

Author: VincentKKL
Title: Rude manner
Review: The boss very rude. Bad manner and attitude and will not go again. There's no point for us to be treat like this

Author: CurryPuff1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: AWFUL, AWFUL, AWFUL
Review: Went here yesterday with the family. We had intended to have the buffet in the larger restaurant but despite there being many vacant tables we were not allowed to have one with a bench seat for the girls. So to the Grill, pleasantly quiet, nice greeting and again problem with the seating, there were only three or four tables in use but it would not be possible for us to have a window seat. About to walk away again and suddenly, unfortunately, one was available, we ordered a rib-eye steak(RM198) a spring chicken (RM 158) and 1/2 doz oysters (RM128) and some fries fro the girls. Oysters were fine, plump and fresh tasting. Long wait and eventually the meat arrived, a grey and tired looking steak and a chicken that looked as if it had had attention from a MIchelin tyre rather that a Michelin star, flattened completely. Both were served on a bit of mudstone set in wood, most unattractive. The steak was supposed to be medium rare but there was no pink there, it was almost cold, tough and fibrous no juice flowing when cut, the animal it came from cannot have had a happy life. The chicken was much the same, near to cold when served and dry, most was left. The french fries were thin frozen things, again arriving near cold.The gratis chocolates at the end were good. With water and no wine the bill was well over RM 500 for two adults and two young children. For this price I expect much better quality. Oh just for the record there must have been a lot of cancellations as the supposedly reserved window tables remained free.This place is, on this experience, way over-rated.

Author: Honestyofcouse
Title: FIRST and DEFINITELY LAST TIME!!!!
Review: As a local Malaccan, I was curious to see a long queue everytime I passed by this restaurant for years. Due to the long queue, I thought someday, I could give it a try. Then came this time where we passed by and there was no queue. Out of curiosity, me and my family decided to give it a try.We came before 6pm and was told that we could only be sitted when the full amount of our guests arrived although there were vacant tables. Since this was during late evening, the sun was blazing at us while we as customers had to patiently line up at the corridor. While lining up, we were hurried several times by the waitress to place our orders. We ordered a few dishes that we were comfortable with and the waitress asked us "you're not going to order crab?" Since it was our first time, we thought no harm giving it a try and placed an order for one crab. The waitress then mentioned that minimum order was two crabs and the price range would be at RM100+. We proceeded to order.As we waited, priority was given to other customers lining up behind us simply because they had their full number of guests while the waitress apologetically assured us that once our guests arrived we will be sitted. We then told the waitress that our guests would arrive in 5 - 10 minutes of which the waitress brush it OFF.When our guests arrived, we immediately told the waitress that our guests have arrived. We were then shocked to get her response. She just told us COLDLY and TARTLY that all the tables are full and we had to WAIT INDEFINITELY. Part of our guests were senior citizens of which we requested that they be sitted first. The COLD HEARTLESS waitress just yelled for someone to bring a chair but IT NEVER CAME. After waiting for about 20 more minutes in addition to the first 30 minutes that we waited, we were finally sitted. Earlier while ordering, the waitress told us that once we are sitted our order will be prepared. We'll, IT WAS ONE BIG LIE. We were only served intermittently approximately 40 minutes after being sitted. While waiting, we observed that there were 2 main types of treatment given to the customers (we have tried to make reservations however we were told it is only walk-in). Some customers had to wait indefinitely like we did for our food while some customers had VIP treatment where they were ushered in and lead upstairs straight away and we observed that the food was served to them first while we waited waited indefinitely for our food. We highlighted to the owner about the long wait however he TURNED A DEAF EAR. After the long wait, the waitress had the audacity to inform nicely that "you're food is being prepared now".In terms of the DISHES, it is COMPLETELY OVERATED. There IS NOTHING SPECIAL about it.Upon paying the bill, we clarified with the owner on the minimum number of crab order as we observed that there is order for one crab and that we were told the minimum order was 2 crabs. The owner immediately replied that at the point that we ordered, the available crabs were medium size so the minimum order is 2 crabs while 30 minutes later the bigger crabs arrived and therefore the minimum order is 1 crab. Upon checking the bill, we were charged RM200+ for 2 crabs instead of the RM100+ as claimed by the waitress.Overall, this was a terrible and stressful dining esperience. I'm never stepping in ever again and will STRONGLY NOT RECOMMEND it to anyone.

Author: Flitz8
Title: Good restaurant..watch out for birds literally
Review: Had nasi lemak from here it was tasty but as started eating a bird decided to jump into my plate and take my chicken lol.Nice view overlooking bird gardens and hornbill also come there thus name of place

Author: wooster30
Title: Count as you eat
Review: Its not cheap considering its small portion. Environment like chinese coffee shop.  I waited for long time to have tomyam noodle.

Author: courtsbuyer
Title: Avoid at all costs
Review:
Used to be the best breakfast experience in KL.
Now just a sad dirty cafe.
Un-hygienic buffet.
Most hotel guests treat it like their living room.
A big 1* experience.
Cheap ingredients and poor service

Author: Evelyn LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced for subquality food
Review: One would expect some standard with a name like Kampachi. But my family of 6 were sorely disappointed. Stay away from their sashimi dishes. The Chirashi Don had 2 tamago, 2 toro, 2 salmon, 2 octopus n 2 swordfish/hamachi and one big piece of crabstick. Not enough rice for 75RM. The sashimi tempura set had miserable 3 types of fish and a small amount of tempura for 84RM. Presentation was excellent but not value. What was good was the maki rolls like shake aburi 83RM. Not exactly reasonable priced. The portions were mostly small for the rice set. Never going back again.

Author: 900cookEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Still a Good View Pity About The Food
Review: When we visited because of the lack of customers the regular buffet was not available. On arrival we were asked to choose from Western, Malaysian or Chinese food. I opted for the Malaysian. The main course was terrible. My partner went for the Western which was a little better than mine. The starters and fish courses were ok but not necessarily what we would have chosen. The best course was the asparagus soup but this could have done with being warmer. I think you should be told at the time of booking if there is no buffet. The views are still spectacular

Author: AaronO8885
Title: So old yet still that good
Review: hidden away from the busy streets, dont be taken aback from the old building, its food is mouth watering to the last bite. never try never know, once try every day also want... ^.^

Author: Akinotaiyo19Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a great birthday dinner
Review: My husband decided on this place after doing a lot of research but it was unfortunate that the service and food left much to be desired. A reservation was made but when we arrived there, not actual table had been reserved. We were given a table next to a very boisterous group of Japanese diners with the excuse that there were many big groups that night. So, basically a reservation doesn't mean anything then. This was already a bad start to the dinner but we decided to give the place a chance instead of leaving and trying out many of the other restaurants nearby. I ordered a Lychee Martini that took a good 20 minutes to arrive. And when it arrived, the cocktail stirrer had what looked like the leftover lychee from a can skewered onto it. It looked incredibly unappetizing and I decided to not have the fruit. The cocktail itself was not too bad though. Since it is supposed to be a wine loft, I was hoping to try a sparkling wine instead of a cocktail. But, they do not serve any bubbly by the glass. We had the bacon wrapped scallops for starters. It was good but it had a weird salad on the side and had a heaping of alfalfa sprouts all over the scallops. We didn't understand why that was necessary.I ordered the Chicken Roulade and it was disappointing. I'm grateful that the staff did inform us it would take 30 mins to be prepared but the dish left much to be desired. Firstly, they used the chicken thigh as the base and there were still bits of cartilage on it. The stuffing was spicy and since no description was provided for in the menu, I was not prepared for it. The potato mash was the only saving grace. To be honest, we were just waiting for the meal to be over and done with so we could leave. I felt really bad because my husband really wanted this dinner to be a special one. We will not be returning to this place anytime soon.

Author: Bob MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beyond awful food
Review: standard HR decor but terrible food.The meals are precooked and then reheated. the results are predictably dreadful. of our party 3 had their food served cold, which was a give away for a freshly cooked burger! the food is worse than a fast food joint. not cheap either.the staff were very apologetic and gave us a complimentary round of drinks. but if you want freshly cooked food go elsewhere.

Author: PLMLKuala Lumpur
Title: Absolutely delightful - every mouthful was fabulous
Review: We had the Siew Yoke Briyani, rice cooked to perfection, together with Pork 65 masala (spicy), eggplant masala (lightly flavored), butter chicken (stunning), bacon and cheese naan (buttery with a hint of cheese, couldn't really taste the bacon tho) and the star dish, malai tikka (chicken cooked to perfection, succulent and absolutely Delish).Gets very busy so suggest booking a table and making sure you are there on time. A little warm due to the open concept and noise levels get high (lack of buffer) - suggest if you don't want to rush through your meal being conscious of people queuing, go for an early or late meal. A great dining experience - I've already planned my meal for my next visit

Author: Steady
Title: Still Great
Review:
It is always a pleasure to visit this restaurant as the food is excellent and the staff are very friendly.
This restaurant is quite difficult to find and is at the end of quite a dark road but it is well worth a visit.

Author: Siang Teng LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor food. Disappointment.
Review: It is supposed to be one of the better Peranakan restaurants in town. However, I found them pale when compared to the other known restaurants in the same league. The cooking is poor. The reason could be that their kitchen could not turnaround fast enough to meet demand and at the end, they short changed their customers. For example, we asked for “sayur lodeh” and were told that it was still being cooked in the pot. We told them that we were willing to wait for it but at the end we got half cooked “sayur lodeh”. Their ngoh hiang and pie tee are hopeless. It was a big disappointment.

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice fresh sushi at Isetan
Review: This restaurant, apparently a branch from America, has been operating for a year and mend by Japanese chefs. Seafoods were fresh, with 3 deliveries per week directly from Japan. Simple, yet nice, sitting arrange with good ambiance. The long L-shape chef-bar can sit 12 people, with 2 sushi chefs mending both stations. The seafood cuts were pretty small and rather ordinary, unable to differentiate themselves from the well established top Japanese restaurants in town. Omakase at RM 490.00 is pretty stiff. There have a nice collection of premium sake though.

Author: Connector823667
Title: Overrated as the best in town
Review: Other than the reasonable alcohol price, food was poor...if not a drinker, then find other place for food.

Author: jacobs60nz
Title: Very Relaxing
Review: This bar, I’m like some others in Penang, did no smell like a bar. It was clean, funky, had great lazy music, and was a great place to relax. Extensive drink options. Loved it!!!!

Author: duttonstLondon, U.K.
Title: Every dish was delicious
Review: We were a family group of 7, including elderly grandparents, and were lucky to be seated at a large round table in the restaurant. The owner advised what dishes were available on the set menu that day, and suggested some additional dishes we may wish to add for the table - we went with his recommendations, and were not disappointed. Every single choice was delicious, and all members of our party really enjoyed the food. Service was great too, and we'll definitely come back here again when we are next in Penang. Highly recommended.

Author: Marianne188632Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Skip it...
Review: It's called 'Hard Rock cafe'. So why is the DJ playing all kind of top40 crap? He also thinks he's on some kind of fair; talking through the 'music' and some REALY bad scratching. We also saw a nice coverband. That was cool. So, 2 stars because of that. O, and it's really expensive. Not worth your money!

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Service was slow and a little inattentive
Review: After doing a lot of walking at the Jonker Street Market I decided to rest, and sit outside on a bar stool and a high table whilst my wife shopped nearby. I had a tiger beer and she joined me for a drink a little later and had a mocktail.Two musicians were playing. One was a male and one a female who alternated during the night.I found the service a little inattentive and despite the waiter and waitresses not being extremely busy they were not attentive and it was difficuilt at times to attract their attention.

Author: SkyegerlSingapore
Title: Arrogant Dining Place!!!
Review: Totally disappointed with the arrogant attitude!! Reached at 130pm hungry and refused our business when they stated 230pm as closing. Amy herself was so arrogant. Didn't even tell us nicely why they are closed and just signal and ask us to go. Will never come back ever again. Don't think I want to pay and see faces. Will spread this news around and make sure all my friends visit others than them.

Author: 828DavidJJSydney, Australia
Title: Did not try the food
Review: A friend told me it was worth a visit and it certainly looked promising from the street, with an intriguing eclectic decor. You walk to the rear of the restaurant, which is in a garden setting, using stepping stones across a little pond. Walking past the glassed-off kitchen, however, I noticed one of the kitchen staff smoking. He hid the cigarette when he saw me and looked sheepish. I did not bother to order and left. Elsewhere in Kuching a good level of hygiene is maintained and it is disappointing to have to report this incident.

Author: Enkidu-backpacker
Title: Nothing special
Review: We ordered one whole chicken. Packaging was more interesting that chicken itself. Chicken was quite small and herbs not really strong. Taste was nothing really special, from that price, I expected better quality and different taste.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Terrible foods & too expensive
Review: It used to have better food, but now it's just too pricy and ridiculously tasteless. Not recommended. Service was terrible too as the staff are ignorant

Author: TjahYOno
Title: Love this Malaysian delight
Review: Tried their char kuay teow and nasi lemak, I love them both. Perfectly cooked to suit my taste. The place is also nice and comfy to dine.

Author: Gabriel3939Lucerne, Switzerland
Title: Smoking in the restaurant?
Review: Was there last night with friends, the table beside started lighting up cigarettes. Not only did the waiters not stop them, they even provided them with ashtrays. Can't enjoy the drinks and food when there's smoke blown towards you.

Author: Mimsawadee
Title: Overated
Review: For me this is overated. Nothing special about it. Some waiters will ignore you and even look at you while chatting to each other. Cocktails are in small sizes. Some bars are better here in lovelane. Try Wheeler's and their food is delicious!!!

Author: Stephen WSydney, Australia
Title: Ivy's Nyona Cuisine
Review: I went with two friends to Ivy's on 28 November 2013. The host, Dragan, was charming and helpful, and advised us how to construct a set of courses, including an excellent beef rending. He arranged for a man to appear with a small range of wines, including French and Italian reds. I would definitely return.

Author: Thiben76
Title: Extremely overpriced for the most simple food.
Review:
52.50 for the simplest food for 2 & that too without drinks. Mini tiffin fit for a child & $7 for a thin piece of Naan is ridiculous. 
Greed is the word comes to mind.

Author: Menrva26Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant enough
Review: Got together with some gfs of mine and decided to give this place a try. Staff were friendly and helpful. My girls really liked their dish called Amazeballs. One of them had ordered a sparkly apple drink which I must say was really good. And I had ordered the Mantastic which came with beef bacon though they substituted it with turkey bacon for me. Thanks:) but the fried chicken was too thin and I think a different breading would be better for the chicken. I did like the chamomile tea courtesy of TWG. Overall, we had a pleasant experience. I might just come back.

Author: BunnyDahlGothenburg, Sweden
Title: The Best View in Kuala Lumpur
Review: We have been to the restaurant a couple of times and we made reservations for dinner all the times we went as it can get a little full on weekends. It's best to go to watch the sunset around 7pm to see the changing of the skyline.As we normally book for more than 6-10 pax we are normally abled to customized the menu according to our budget usually about USD100- USD150 per pax without drinks. Yes, it is not cheap but you get what you pay for. The atmosphere, excellent service and great view of KL City.The chocolate dessert is absolutely to die for if you ever get a chance to come here. If you are just there to have some drinks there is also a trendy bar next to the restaurant where the view os equally as gorgeous. But, I would highly recommend that you splurge on the fine dining experience next door for a romantic night out with your partner.Overall experience, above and beyond expectations everytime!

Author: Gerald KSingapore
Title: Quality of food has dropped
Review: The quality of food at Makko has dropped through the years. I would give the food here with just a pass, and there are way better nyonya food in Melaka. The food and drinks are also a bit pricey. My wife and I ordered the pongteh, rendang and hee paw soup, and the taste of the food was not as flavorful as nyonya food should be. Nyonya food is often rich, flavorful, and has many ingredients that contributes to the explosion with your tastes buds, but sadly, the food here did not do any. It tasted like something I can get at a normal coffee shop. I have eaten at Makko numerous times in the past, but this would likely be the last for me.

Author: Wunic
Title: Good food
Review: I like the Asian salad with grill chick and the BBQ 1/2 chick. The service is usually good and the place has many seats, so should not be a problem to get a table.

Author: Philippe DHuy, Belgium
Title: Disappointing
Review: It was a busy night at blablabla this Monday i guess a difficult one for its kitchen. We arrived around 8pm. We ordered the ostrich rolls, pandan chicken and Mango duck. It took almost ONE hour fr the rolls to be served and sadly the 4 pieces were barely cooked. The waitress had a look and guarantee it was always served medium rare. Regardless it was not great for a signature dish. Next came the mango duck after another 20 minutes. I have to admit it was tasty and well presented. To end up our bad blablabla experience, the pandan chicken came also raw. This time the waitress admitted it was poorly cooked and offered to replace. There was not sign of any management in the building. Some formal form of apologise would have been appreciated. We are looking forward for better meals tomorrow in Kuching and certainly would advise other customers to avoid all this blablabla on busy nights. 130 RM for three dishes two of which were not cooked...Hmmmmm

Author: Sakti V
Title: Nice food.
Review: The restaurant is based on indian recipes and cooking style. They offer variety of dishes chicken, fish, crab and lamb as well. Quite expensive for ordinary people but worth it.

Author: 77linrPerth, Australia
Title: Not up to standard
Review: I drink at a lot of coffee at Dome establishments being my preferred tipple and is the benchmark against which I tend to measure all others coffee churn mills including McCafe etc.. This was pretty ordinary and did not meet my or my partners expectations. Service was indifferent and we were only one of 2 couples in the whole place. This despite being located at one on the premier houte couture shopping precincts in Kuala Lumpa. Also particularly noticeable given the higher level of service one gets in Malaysia.The product was also poor and overpriced. This cannot be put down to the Asian Equation of not understanding of the western palate. The best coffee I have ever had was in Kuala Lumpa prepared by fellow compatriots. The price was equivalent to what you pay in Australia surprisingly so no value there.No, on this occasion it was just a overpriced coffee made with lack lustre effort by indifferent staff who need to either improve their game or look for a different vocation. I do not recommend this establishment and advise to look elsewhere for your barista needs.

Author: ryanbeo
Title: Tender Chicken Soup Noodle is a must-try
Review: In case you are wondering what to try at this place, give that one a shot and you won’t regret!  Food is superb and service is way too nice :D

Author: SamS6837
Title: Food taste so so, service poor
Review: We had dinner during weekend. We been waiting long time for dinner to be served. We ask for the tomato source for twice time, then only be served. The food portion is big, but taste so so.

Author: Robbreese
Title: Hair in food, incorrect order, did not get all items
Review: Venue is in a good location, that's the best that can be said for it. Food was average, hair in one of the mains, prawn crackers never arrived despite asking twice, staff were rude. So much better in KL an cheaper too. Avoid!

Author: paulynnb
Title: Close for Renovation
Review: I made a reservation 3 days ago before dinner date 13Feb2020 and I only got to know it was closed for renovation when I arrived. I believe restaurant should have informed me earlier since I had made my reservation. They then moved us to The Premier but appetiser n a few items like Ice Kacang on the menu were not available. Disappointed.

Author: Yen69
Title: Quick and good Udon
Review: Been here a few time. Udon is always good with their poach egg. Always able to get a table here. Fast and good place to go to.

Author: mufimurphy
Title: Wide variety of choices but not outstanding
Review:
You can find a wide variety of cendol here - with peanuts, corn, mango, even oreos! It's around 3-4 ringgit each. Unfortunately, there wasn't anything very outstanding though it's quite tasty. 

Wifi available. Password is cendol7776.

Author: iamjohnny
Title: Good Services, Nice Food, Good Location
Review: Had a nice dinner with a friend. Felt so good with friendly and accommodating staff. A nice diner with good ambience facing the fountain at the KL twin tower. It was a very pleasant dining experience. Much better services than the neighbouring diners. Thank you.

Author: turbofoodMelbourne, Australia
Title: Poor food quality and services
Review: Had a dinner at the Chynna Chinese Restaurant. Ordered 3 dishes - steamed free-ranch chicken, black charcoal tofu with salted egg yolk, stir-fry kailan vegetables. I was not prepared to come across these types of services in a 5-star hotel. (1) After sitting down for quite a while, no one came to take our order of tea; (2) there was no condiments such as soy sauce, chili sauce on my table (they were there on other tables); (3) A waiter was talking in his mobile phone right in the restaurant; (4) A male waiter rolled up his sleeves exposing his hairy forearms. (I must say that when he served us the dish I lose appetite to seeing his hairy arms.) Now, about the food. Disappointing. (1) steam rice is loosely scooped like, while I would expect a 5-star restaurant do know how to scoop the rice to make it a smooth round top in a bowl. (2) The steamed chicken, came after 30 minutes of wait and when we finished all the other dish, was the biggest disappointment of the night. It was bland, tough, tasteless, like a frozen chicken thawed in a microwave oven. The chicken is chopped into bite-size pieces, except the wings. So, you can imagine how awkward it is to use a pair of chopsticks to handle a whole piece of chicken wing; (3) the portion of stirfry kailan vegetables is as small as appetizer.Verdict, will not recommend anyone to waste their money in this restaurant.

Author: ShahriarB14
Title: Wost steak
Review: I heard so much about steaks here and since i was living in a condo next to here we gave it shot. We ordered tenderloin steak which was 40rm and considering you are eating at a mamak its totally expensive the vegetable they served with it was frozen and the meat even though we ordered medium was overcooked. Plz don't waste your money here , definitely other decent places you can eat with same price and better quality.

Author: lindypicotin01
Title: so...so..
Review:
Visited few times with friends and relatives as many wanted to have dim sum.
Personally I'd not choose to re visit as the foods are too salty! 
Not liking their char siew too.
I've informed the supervisor and hoping for improvement in future.

Author: TripTedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Horrible place- empty and bad service
Review: Came here for a quiet night for drinks but it was exceptionally quiet and they had none of the whiskey on their menu..... I ordered the 18-year-old Chivas regal they didn't have it... Then tried to order two different ones which they also didn't have and they tried to upsell me to buy a whole bottle. I just was not in the mood to drink a whole bottle of whiskey by myself. Stupid people know how to ruin the night ...

Author: claudesuppiah
Title: A lot of hype
Review: A restaurant that was extremely busy, the setting and the decor were extremely good.The food however was really mediocre.... You can can get 10 times the flavour eating at any other other restaurant.

Author: awanderingeyeMalaysia
Title: Consistent and quick
Review: Nyonya Colors serves nyonya food, which is easy and familiar to Malaysians. This outlet at Nu Sentral is located off the escalator and makes the dining experience bright and comfortable. Despite the fact that there is rarely an empty table during lunch, service is quick and waiters will assist customers to find spots once available. The food is good and consistent across all their outlets; something which customers will always appreciate. Pricing is also reasonable. This makes Nyonya Colors a preferred choice for a quick, good lunch. Recommend the Curry Chicken Mee Siam.

Author: deltahaterSan Antonio, Texas
Title: Outstanding-Just Go
Review: I could write a 5 page review discussing everything, but you simply just need to go and eat there. We called/emailed and made a reservation as we were 8 people. They also own the sushi place next door and you can order from that menu as well. Everything we had was outstanding. The service was great with a smile from all employees and it made for an incredible meal experience. Just go and do it!!!!

Author: Anneeq2310
Title: Amazing dinner
Review: I enjoyed my meal at toh yuen..the food is great..i will come again with my family..nice restaurant.

Author: 68Seng
Title: Father's Day Celebration
Review: Food served very slow. Serving came not in proper sequence. One of the main course left out and spoil our dinner mood when we have to wait till very late as the meal was for our father. Spoil our father day celebration. need to improve and pre inform customer if we have to wait.

Author: Patrick L
Title: Ice cafe?
Review:
This cafe has a lovely and delicious durian cendol. 
It's great for an afternoon and better after a meal and makes for a good break away from the Malaysian heat during the day.

Author: lucas12014Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Bad experience.
Review: Cannot believe this is so highly rated. Was rushed in to the place by over enthusiastic staff. Was then squeezed in between 2 other tables. Out order for 3 people was taken without a notebook and pen. Yes we had a naan bread missed off. Could not wait for another to be made as the food is barely warm when served. My chicken masala was was 80 percent bone, hardly worth the effort to eat it, the rice served cold. Plus side the naan we got was really good, the mango lassi also excellent and tandoori chicken ok too. This is very local food not much above street vendor quality, with a little help and improvements this could be ok. The bill was very cheap, so maybe as they say you do get what you pay for. Personally I would prefer to pay more and have a better food and dining experience. All in all this place should not have such a high ranking on trip advisor.

Author: NomadicBoys
Title: Great food and really sweet owner
Review:
Came here for a meal with a group of friends.

Everything was delicious especially the minced pork tofu- to die for!!

The owner is adorable with such a welcoming presence and warm smile.

Author: szotdogsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Confusing pricing system
Review: The food here seemed good enough to me, but it looks as if the pricing system is based on the pieces of meat/main item of the dish, rather than plate size. It kind of caught me out and probably made the meal more expensive than it should have been, but it was nice and spicy nonetheless, which is what I wanted.

Author: Adair_and_ThandoNew York City, New York
Title: Tasty budget eatery
Review: If you’re not familiar with Indian food you might feel intimidated by the extensive menu but we managed and enjoyed their special Indian spices chicken dish. It was delicious, spicy and paired well with our lassis. The food came fast, service was good and the prices were low. All in all, a good experience if you’re in the Brickfields / little India neighborhood and looking for some local Indian dishes.

Author: sam lKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good sate celup
Review: My first time trying sate celup here in malacca and it's surprisingly good. Staffs were friendly, the herbal tea was great! Will definitely return. Please beware of the shop with the same name next door. Don't go to the one with blue sign. Go to the one with orange shirt crews

Author: Oriol C
Title: Very Poor
Review: We came here for new years eve. The food wasnt as expected and the service very average. Totally overrated..

Author: Jennychong
Title: Bad service
Review: Visited here a few times. Service from stuff is getting from bad to worse. Food served was not up to the standard. This is the worst TGI restaurant that I have patronized

Author: JeffYeoh23Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Best Pai Kut in Klang!!!
Review: This place is very trendy. Not only they have the best Pai kut but they are also very up to date in terms of technology. They will take your orders from a smart tablet of some kind. Their Pai Kut is their signature dish!! The rest from the menu is equally good. Sardine fish to Bak kut teh to any other dishes from the menu will not disappoint any customers. Even their soya bean is very refreshing....

Author: vishnu350Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Soggy pizza, diluted coffee, rude chef.
Review: Used to come here often, however had a bad experience twice recently. The mushroom fettuccine and starters were ok. The ice cafe latte was watered down, and there was an ant in the sugar syrup bowl. The siciliana pizza was bad, the dough was soggy on the top. The cheese was like salty slice cheese, not mozzarella. We sent it back, but they just baked it an additional 10 mins and served it again, still soggy. No apology. We sent it back again, and the chef tried to rudely explain how to make pizza to us in a condescending manner because we were Asians. We paid and walked away. There are tons better places to eat in Penang.

Author: k7eats
Title: Arabian food
Review: Excellent service and reasonably priced. Very good ambience. Worth the efforts. Took just 10 mts from KL Sentral by Grab.

Author: Jo-AnnKYTan
Title: Crazy Crowded!
Review: It is crazy crowded. You have to be patient for the lady in charge to get you a table and to come around to take your order. Their chicken is really good. However their side dishes have been precooked and so, they are cold.

Author: MiminazilaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: For seafood lovers...
Review: if you love seafood..do come and eat dinner here...so many restaurants by the water to choose from... you choose your fresh seafood...ranged from Alaska Crab, Nipah crab, flower crab, all sorts of prawns with different sizes, fish, all sorts of shell thingy... choose what you want to eat, they will weigh them and tell you the price..if you're ok with it, then you choose how you them to be cooked...sweet sour, sambal, garlic lemon, etc...they have chicken and beef too for those who not in favor of seafood...and choices of vege to choose from...the price is very reasonable but the taste is just ok...not bad but not as tasty as I expected them to be...but I still enjoy the fresh seafood...and dining by the sea...i see water so I presumed it's the sea...if you're in JB, forget the seafood at Danga Bay..come to Senibong..you'll love it here..

Author: 552WendyH552
Title: Good music
Review: This is a nice place to chill after dinner and walking Jonker Walk. The two singers are great fun, will join you for a drink between sets. Happy hour finishes just before the music starts.

Author: HsienK7
Title: Very good and friendly service
Review: I came here for a family's member birthday celebration. It was a delightful gastronomic experience with exceptionally good service by the team!

Author: TravellingMalaysianMalaysia
Title: Great Indian food in Bangsar
Review: Devi's corner is located right in the heart of Bangsar commercial center and it is one of the few restaurants that serve great Indian food. The choices are great but be oreoared for spicy food not you average diluted spice stuff.They are open 24x7 .They are open for breakfast right up to after party .Breakfast favourites - thosai , nasi lemak Lunch - a great veriaty of choices including mutton varuval, chicken varuval, veg etc. If you want ala carte go downstairts but if you want the full spread of Indian banana leaf meal , head upstairts where the choices are equally fantastic.Tea- indian pastries Dinner - as per lunch Supper - nasi lemakPlease note that upstairs are usually very full during the peak lunch hours including weekends so go early.The pricing is reflective of KL pricing.

Author: HongYawJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Sumptuous French Cuisine in Johor Bahru
Review: The restaurant is good with a variety of famous French Cuisine. The notable escargots, chicken cordon blue, quiche and cheese platter.Service provided is good and friendly. I would recommend everyone to give the mushroom soup a try. It is very tasty, fresh and different. Escargot, chicken cordon bleu and quiche is a must.Do take note that the apple crumble is freshly baked. Hence, a waiting time of 20 minutes is needed. The restaurant do require their customers to be decently dressed.On the side note, I would recommend restaurant owner to add on the menu with more authentic french cuisine and pastry. The orange duck confit, etc. The waiter and waitress with basic knowledge of french language will be a plus point to instill the french vibe. Overall, it is indeed a must try restaurant in Johor Bahru.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: SatishC265Sydney, Australia
Title: Fresh Veg Pizzas / Pasta were great
Review: We were there for a dinner on Sunday the 5th May 19 We walked in and were asked if we had a reservation but we didn't have. We were asked our preference as to sit inside or outside and we chose to sit outside. We were there for about 45 mins or so and it was just two of us on the outside set up. There were few diners in the inside. We had a cocktail, red house wine and Veg options for dinner. We had only few items as we were not too hungry. Food was fresh and cocktail was good. Overall happy with the choice and no regrets. Definitely not a budget option and less options for vegetarians. Ambiance is good and visit is you are prepared to spend about 50 plus Malaysian Ringetts

Author: MR_BiRD1Singapore, Singapore
Title: Pleasantly surprised with the service
Review: I reached slightly to 2pm on a Friday and was half expecting to be turned away as the lunch hour is until 2.30pmA young lady who i think is the lady boss greeted us and say they are still opened and don't worry.Recommended us some dishes like their signature oyster noodle, ngoh hiang, prawn roll & orh nee. Food was legit and affordable. The prawn roll rocks and the orh nee is not overly sweet and you will not feel sick eating too much of it.This is the part where it will contradict some of the reviews here that have some complaints about their service.The same lady asked where we were going after our meal and we mentioned about walking to Jonker st. She told us that it is a very long walk (thats true) and suggested to use grab taxi instead, we tried getting a grab to no avail. She then offered to call a grab for us using her own mobile phone and when it was accepted we thank her and waited outside for the grab to arrive. She call us back in the restaurant to wait in the aircon for the grab, telling us its too hot out there, meanwhile her staff is cleaning up and closing the place.Hows that for service?

Author: Justin K
Title: Overpriced foods and bad service
Review: Went there for dinner with few friends, the food is overpriced for the given atmosphere. Not worth the trip. The staff service is poor and impolite. I SAW a notice board in front of the shop to no pokemon players which I found disturbing as I'm a player myself.

Author: MatildaTheTravellerTampere, Finland
Title: Recomending! Especially the Christmas day lunch
Review: We visit the restaurant two times. The first visit was before Christmas 2015 for a lovely dinner and the second one was for the Christmas day lunch. Both times were excellent. We tasted both French and Asian duck dishes and the food just melted in our mouths. The Christmas lunch special was 3 course meal (French: 1. Chowder 2. Duck confit and 3.home made ice cream with chocolate cake) and affordable so that even a backpackers like we can eat this delicious food. Staff was very friendly, atmosphere most welcoming and the graphic design of the restaurant cleaver. We liked that you can sit outside or inside and you can pay with a credit card as well. “What the duck” offers great value for money.

Author: MyBangladeshiCousin
Title: First lunch in a year at Tarma
Review: Our first lunch here in a whole year. As previously, fantastic food, lovely unintrusive staff, great decor, nice music in background and all at very reasonable pricing.

Author: RobertChew-MYShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Definitely worth A Star... Or two...
Review: Never thought that I will come across such a gem in Malaysia!We have dined in many Michelin Star restaurants and this definitely deserve A Star, or Two!Just came back from his 17 course dinner. Very pleasantly surprised with the chef's ingenuities. The Food---------------Brilliant execution with local ingredients that tantalise your taste buds with complex flavor and texture profile. Few of the ingredients may surprise you! Bravo Chef!The Service-------------------Attentive and well trained staff, with some minor mistakes by (I guess) new staff. Friendly and each course is well explained.The Ambience---------------------Simple yet comfortable. Tables are well spaced to provide dinners comfort and privacy. Open kitchen allows you to see Chef and his crew preparing your courses, professionally.We will definitely look forward to their each new menu, which unfortunately changed quite slowly (I can understand why as work of art cannot be hurried)P/SThe place is rather difficult to find as you can't see it while driving. Waze it.Option 11. When you reached KDU, enter into the college. You can park infront of the college lobby2. Go through the lobby and turn left3. Go down the stairs and you will see the restaurant on the leftOption 21. Enter KDU college2. Immediately go down to basement3. You can park there and see the restaurant

Author: Mobile41540728905
Title: Absolutely enjoyable!
Review: A really happening restaurant served great foods with great mojito. Friendly staff provided great service and their dance performance contributed to the great atmosphere. Suitable for friends and family gathering, highly recommended for celebration.Chilled drinks, good music, great food, nice people. I am not sure what else I can ask for.

Author: Strider O
Title: Good Ramen
Review:
The ramen is good. The soup is nice but a bit salty for the miso-based.
I found that the Bankara original is nice.
Would definitely come again for the braised pork belly....

Author: Gilbert Y
Title: Great food and value for money
Review: Good food and affordable price. Ambience were simple and spacious. Not over crowded. Will drop by again.

Author: travelingdimensionsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad but certainly nothing special.
Review: Admittedly our expectations were probably high due to reviews here and though we still try to go in with a neutral mind its hard not to be influenced. In any case, the food seemed fairly generic in taste, even though it was supposedly fusion. It was just hard to different tastes as the food was very sweet but none of that was a problem. Everyone has different tastes after all.The building and atmosphere was very nice though the hostess had a very hostile attitude to us for some reason that we couldn't discern especially since we always try our best to be polite and respectful (I was in hospitality for 20 years before so know what its like). She just seemed be trying to put extra effort into glaring at us as if it was a pre-Boxing match showdown. The hostess may have just been having a bad night but between her and the food we won't be coming back since there are just so many choices in the area where we can get better of both.

Author: Walesvisit0r
Title: Lovely family restaurant
Review: Simple unsmart restaurant run by very friendly  ladies. Good food freshly cooked. Prices slightly high for Malaysia but low for a tourist centre so fair enough. We ate there several times and really enjoyed it.

Author: LooiShynEn
Title: Bad service!!!!
Review: Waited 1.5 hour for food, no system and bad planning. I DO NOT recommend this place at all!!!! The table that arrived after us received the food first. Food was not worth my time and money.

Author: 524anniec
Title: Cancel the booking unplesant experience
Review: I am completely convinced that this restaurant has zero customer service and stuck up restaurant ! I did a booking on 17 July for dinner 10 ppl booking for next week. What have happened : - they confirmed & accepted the booking with a long table and the normal practice is to confirm the booking a day before it .. then they called me and given that they have new booking request : What goes wrong :1) they ask for $ DEPOSIT to secure the booking !! THIS is ridiculous . 2) they offered us the Lower deck with high chair and high tables for our group dinner instead of a long table . I ask why ? Because the priority is given to other customers to occupy the long table .They definitely do not value you as their valuable customers . Usually in this place you can spend between RM 3K to RM 4K ( when you get a few bottles of good wines) 3) They insisted that we confirmed the headcount for dinner as they DO Not have enough chair !! Finally cancelled the booking due to unpleasant experience !! Move on to other restaurant in Kl Chinese says 傲慢的态度 还没吃顿饭 已经

Author: Lynda F
Title: Bland food
Review: Very mediocher food.  Service was ok and location good.  My husband and I only ate here once so maybe it was an off night but with so many other choices close by I wasn't willing to give it a second try.

Author: ziont
Title: Food is not qualified with the price tag
Review: I know this restaurant is in KLCC, the price is just fine but the quality of food is way below average, I could have lot more better quality food in KLCC as well. 3 of us (my friends and I) ordered queen margherita pizza RM32Rainbow sushi roll RM38Chinoz burger RM39Jujube honey lemonade RM15Choco Coco RM15Hibiscus tea RM15Add 10% service charge + 6% service tax = 178.65I love sushi and I know how a good sushi with this price tag tastes like. But Chinoz Sushi is not up to standard especially the sushi rice. I do not want to order this sushi again even if it is at rm15The pizza does not deserve the price tag as the crust is really below average, little of vege, tomatoes and dried tomatoes. The taste of ingredients are okay but the whole pizza... I could get lot better pizza outthere in KLCC. And with that price tag, I got a bigger nicer proper italian pizza in Mont Kiara.Chinoz burger, ingredients just like mcd cheap range burger, quantity less than McD, fries below average, not delicious. Beef patty is not properly made. Bread is like those used in cheap street side burger, not properly grilled or treated.Jujube honey lemonade. No taste of honey and jujube. Only taste like strong lemon water. Putting only one small jujube to justify it as jujube drinks? Oh... Come on... Choco Coco which is not pure choco but MOCHA!! And you serve us and tell us this is choco coco?? What? Evrn worse, lot of creamer taste instead of choco taste... Hibiscus tea, if you could screw this up, I would ask for refund. Just a tea, nothing special. I guess is because just add hot water into tea leaves. Nothing could go wrong. Jujube honey lemonade is too hard for Chinoz to handle. 3. One of the service crews is impolite and impatient. Furthermore, he does not speak understandable english. The crew that come after him is considered much professional for a proper restaurant.Overall, I will never step into this restaurant again. Go for other similar restaurant in KLCC is much MUCH better.

Author: suggs1965
Title: Nice, nice, nice!!
Review: Food was awesome (probably one of the best meals from our two week Malaysia trip).  Staff were friendly.  Prices reasonable.  A definite must do meal option.

Author: kok fai t
Title: normal chicken rice
Review: to be honest, not fancy to me as it is just a ordinary chicken rice. the chicken was cut into small pieces which not nice to eat for me. bean sprout is the famous dish in Ipoh so you can find it everywhere.

Author: tree_haha
Title: Great Local Food!
Review: Stay 4 days in KL, and every day come here. Once for lunch, and other days for dinner. Love it. Definitely will come back here.

Author: MatthewR3428
Title: Mediocre food, poor service, over priced
Review: Myself and four friends were very excited to try out this fine dining restaurant in the heart of KL for sometime. The atmosphere is dark, leather seats - almost like a cigar smoking lounge. Great view of the Petronas Towers. We each ordered separate starters, I had the Bone Marrow, which I found under seasoned and bland. It didn't look fresh but I can't confirm. We asked to see the sommelier to select an appropriate wine for the much anticipated beef and unfortunately they didn't have anyone who could advise us. No Sommellier but a very egotistical wine list - we settled on a Chevrey Chambertin as you can't go to wrong with that - it was OK. With the bread came various dips but no butter - we requested truffle butter and had to repeat the request a few times until the waiter understood. For the main we ordered the T-bone to share - I would say the beef was just OK - no oh my god feeling - I could have done better. For dessert I had the Crepe Suizette which was enjoyable at least. At the end of the evening they managed to get very confused over the bill. We wanted to split the 4000 MYR bill between 2 but my friend had already paid 1000 deposit - they couldn't figure it out. In the end after some wrangling they got it right. However I was horrified to find out 3 days later they had double charged my debit card so I was over charged by 2000 MYR! They hadn't bothered to contact us about a very obvious mistake on their part. So save your money and go elsewhere for better food and better service. The view you can get by standing in the KLCC park.

Author: ElsieTravelsKuala Lumpur
Title: Bad servuce
Review: A couple of friends and me decided to have a cosy get together in this place,service was very poor. The restaurant was empty with the exception of 2 other tables when we entered,however the service staff was more interested in their mobile phone than attending to customers. Their food was decent but their service,obviously the lack of it just spoils the experience. We ordered coffee and gulab jamun for after dinner. Coffee was served,however after 20 minutes the gulab jamun hadn't arrived so we called a waiter and asked him and he nonchalantly told us that they had run out of gulab jamun. Why they didn't think to inform us about it before we asked is beyond my understanding. However it makes sense now why they were empty when we walked in. I wouldn't return or recommend this place to anyone,plenty of better options available at Brickfields area.

Author: chrissI6403OJPoole, United Kingdom
Title: Mixed experience
Review: Had two meals here, one was very good and another was awful and had to send main course back. Food is well presented, soft shell crab was good first time less good the second. The whole baby chicken was excellent. Would have rated this very good but could not due to the awful lentil dish which was so watery and almost lacking in lentils.

Author: AndyLauraW
Title: Hip, trendy and cool
Review: This bar is hip, trendy and cool and can easily see why it has the great reviews and ratings! The music was great, the staff brilliant and the vibe was amazing. Spent several hours there and it just flew by!

Author: elenatG5666SOSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hits and misses
Review: The achar was really good, a little on the sweet side. The rest are just alright...Disappointed with the kueh pieties - the cups were stale and the texture became tough and chewy rather than crispy.There’s no sambal belachan but the friendly staff gave us three types of chilli paste that we that we didn’t find exciting or inspiring.We had desserts - salted egg yolk cake gave a hint of the egg yolk. The sago gula melaka was a huge let down that we left it after a spoon - too much coconut milk and too little gula, the coconut milk taste strange as well plus the sago was overcooked, too soft and lumpy. We also had glutinous rice cooked in brown sugar and we kept biting into bits of uncooked rice. The only dessert that we smiled to was the kueh with green Pandan custard, fragrant but texture can be better too. Chendol was just alright The friendly staff saved the day...

Author: Joann LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: All that fuss over nothing
Review: Have you seen the weekend queues at this place? I didn't realise patrons had so much time to waste. For something mediocre. I can't comment on the coffee as I'm generally not partial to it so wouldn't be fair. We had the big breakfast and eggs benedict. Both friend and I agree, our dishes were uninspiring. It was perhaps slightly above average priced, which disappointed further. I'm a believer that you get what you pay for so I would moderate expectations if everything was cheaper. Saving grace? Pancakes, although I'm basing this on the only one I've tried so can't comment on consistency.Don't waste your time (waiting) and money.

Author: The_Miri_EpicureMiri, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed.
Review: It is over a year since we last ate here. This time I went with a large group and tried more things.Food OK, service was quick, decor comfortable & prices inexpensive.Filling to dough ratio in the Pau was wrong. A tiny scrap of filling and a whole lot of stodge.Batter on the deep fried prawns was far too thick. A great lump with a small prawn hiding inside.So, on the whole not as good as I remember.

Author: 962wilsont
Title: good experience
Review: it was a long wait.. but good experience nonetheless. would recommend people to come but not be late. food portion abit small though.

Author: Albert SMalaysia
Title: Became a family restaurant
Review: This was the 4th time we came to this restaurant but it has run down, I wanted to have nice fine dining with my wife, i made a reservation, As a Mandarin Grill they position them self as fine dining restaurant, but this glory has gone, when where seated, it was not that busy, they placed us next to table with a small kids who where running around, My wife and my self we where shocked, we thought we have nice peaceful dinner and we pay a lot of money as its expensive restaurant, and in the same time we have accept the noise and hassle of these kids who run around us, we complained to the waiter and requested a other table, what they finally did otherwise i would cancel my dinner, so i ask the waiter who you allowed childern in this restaurant, than he said normally we don't but we make exceptions, i told him what is you do or you don'tthan i told him when we know you accept childern we would not book, he said yes more people complain, than i said so you do accept then he said, yes ..... I said good we know ...service has also gone down waiters all from Philippines now only the prices has gone up special the wines is far overpriced,

Author: Ching Kuan Ymalaysia
Title: Good Shanghai dumpling and La Mien
Review: I like the La Mien in Dragon I One Utama branch, especially their seafood fried la Mien and black pepper fried la Mien, very tasty and the noodle also good. Their chicken rice in a wooden bin is a must try. The rice has the aroma of chicken and cooked perfectly that you could still see the grains, yum yum. Their Shanghai dumpling (siao long pao) is another popular signature dish, the skin is thin and the juice inside is really sweet and tasty.
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: Izar E
Title: Overrated
Review: Heard a lot about this place hence we made a trip. 5 of us. 1. Service was slow. And i meant... 1 hour wait.2. The dishes were cold. Cold kailan Cold kangkong Cold cockles. They were cooked a long while and left to be cold.3. really average and mediocre cooking.Coming from places like Newton / East Coast / Chai Chee Seafood.... these dishes at Senibong were complete crap. 4. Salted egg crab? Not salty No taste. Crap Crab.My advise to Singaporeans ... dont bother coming here for Seafood. Pay sgd dollars for good food.

Author: eoncoKuching, Malaysia
Title: Much overrated seafood eatery!
Review: Tucked away behind some old rundown shops in the middle of the city this eatery (I won't even bother calling it a restaurant) has re-located numerous times in the past but seem to have settled down here now.Its very basic, usually packed due to locals who have a high tolerance level for poor service, hot and noisy atmosphere (on the ground floor) and cold and stifled aircon (top floor) - the choice of seafood comes out of a pick-up truck semi-permanently parked by the kitchen. It's selection and freshness can be dubious at best. Lots of local vegetables,ferns and what-nots are stacked up on an tabletop.Pricing is based on whether you are a local,tourist or on an expense account. Usually preferential treatment is given to guests and patrons who happen to be either related or of the same dialectical background as the owner - whom I find to be bossy,obnoxious and loud. However the boss-lady (towkay-neo) is pretty nice and decent. Service levels are atrocious - most of the time you have to help yourself to extra utensils etc.The food and dishes served varies in quality (and quantity) depending on the mood of the cook(s). It can sometimes be excellent, other times nonsensical. Overall I would give it 2 stars (Poor), just short of Terrible.

Author: JLeong1965KL
Title: Seriously dissapointed after Dialogue in the dark.
Review: Commercialised. Food was really bland for the hefty price. Dining here is about waiting , waiting and more waiting. Different type of waiting. Waited 45 minutes for my table even though reservation were made. Waited another 30 minutes before food were served and another 15 minutes food is finished. Totally famished after all the waiting. And waited again to be brought out of the restaurant. Wouldn't do it again even if it is free. Boring with no entertainment. What a torture instead of experience. And poor staffs. The restaurant really overworked them. The guy who served us, Thong was obviously overworked with the big number of guest he needs to entertain and his fatigue was obviousP.s. Went to dialogue in the dark in HongKong. Thoroughly enjoyed the experience where we discovered the sense of sound, smell and feel without sight and met some very nice people with impaired vision and went with them on the journey

Author: terencemooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cheap but average
Review: Came here on a colleague’s recommendation. Easy Sunday morning drive across the causeway from Singapore, little traffic & easy to find (google map). Opens at 730am. We arrived about 8am. Lots of places in restaurant which was really two shop lots joined together with an airconditioned section. Crowd comes in around 830, a mixed of Singaporeans and locals. Parking was ample and on the streets, free on sundays. On sun, offices are closed so lots of parking lots. It will be more difficult on weekdays. Ordered a variety of usual dim sum dishes. We found in general, taste is quite average. Had better dim sum in KL at same prices. Even my fav Loh mai mai was just so so. It’s not that it’s not good. it’s just very average probably because there are so many others to compare with and we have this often. But it’s cheap, compared to singapore (of cuz) so for an morning outing it’s was fine. Everything else was ok too. Service was attentive and quick (maybe we were early), place reasonably clean (except for pesky flies they should do something about) and easy to order/pay. Not somewhere I would recommend if one looks for quality dim sum. But for an cheap easy outgoing close to causeway to Singapore and all so reasonably priced, decent, then why not.

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: A pleasant surprise
Review: Ask someone to name a typical Melaka food and even a Singaporean will likely suggest chicken ball rice. (otherwise also known as chicken rice ball): fragrant chicken rice you know and love shaped into cute little golf ball sizes.
