In the entire state of Melaka, only one is halal certified – Ee Ji Ban.Although I’m generally not a fan of halal Chinese food, I was pleasantly surpised and impressed with the excellent flavor and texture of the rice and dishes. It was busy and almost full when we arrived for dinner which we took to be a good sign. In addition to chicken rice balls, the menu offers nyonya delicacies. The sambal sotong (squid cooked in chili paste) is a crowd-pleaser if you fancy something with extra heat.It is official, and who knew it: halal chicken rice ball is a thing. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…

Author: 868rashidk
Title: I'm rather annoyed
Review: I've been to this place several times. And had some of my most memorable dinners here. Food is decent. Ambience is good, even on a Tuesday night as I type this. But tonight I'm annoyed. They have stopped serving table water, and are now forcing patrons to purchase over priced and wasteful bottled water. And for me, this is a failure on the most basic level. I am waiting for my food now disappointed, and no matter what magic the chef whips up, I know I'll leave disappointed.

Author: YNWASGMalaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Have heard about this outlet for years. Just another overrated restaurant. Very expensive also. Parking lots are short. Quite a wait for food though it was not crowded when we visited. I think mostly patron the restaurant due to publicity. Doubt customers will revisit the second time with the exorbitant charges and unremarkable food.

Author: Zac G
Title: Amazing
Review: Esther is the best host ever, fantastic service and great food, it is the gem of malaysia, nice area where bars are aswell

Author: thidamirod
Title: Extremely expensive.Not worth.Real waste of money.Normal tasty.
Review: EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE & NOT WORTH IT. visited again after 2 years. Queue still long which gives visitors great impression about the restaurant. Order for 3 person : 2 medium size black pepper crab- RM234.00 + sweetsour pork- RM12.00+ lemon fish - RM45.00 + Vege-RM10.00+ 3 Rice+ 3 skyjuice + 1 jelly lime juice and total RM312.73. Not sure how the charges for crab. Overly priced and overrated. Can get better n tastier food at normal restaurants with cheaper price.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Food, Poor Service
Review: Honestly, I have been always wondering what is the big fuss about this chain of outlet. The food is by no way on par with what true Malaysians would rate as good. Perhaps it is the expat community and patronage that has made this place popular and trendy.This outlet is even worse than their pioneer outlet in Hartamas; at least there is a properly air-conditioned section to keep the "easy-to-melt" guests cool.Service was slow (obviously poorly staffed) and the food took forever.

Author: fxm8London, United Kingdom
Title: Good Standard Hard Rock Cafe, service could be better
Review: Following the level of the Hard Rock Cafe, the KL setup keeps that standard going. Good large portions, a decent live band, they do play sports here which is good too. The let down was on the service part, could be improved, that would make the experience much better.

Author: Louischan928888
Title: Service
Review: Jaamuna, excellent service ! ! Keep the good works! Will visit again to this buffet next time……………….

Author: Nurain Syakirah M
Title: Average food.
Review:
It's overrated, there's nothing extraordinary about the taste or anything except the fact that it is rice ball instead of rice.
But still happy with the service! :)
And for its price, there is no harm trying

Author: ALAAYASMINMalaysia
Title: Friendly Owners, FOOD IS SPECTACULAR!!
Review: I’ve been living in Langkawi & this was my first visit to the restaurant & I wish I came here before, the owners are very friendly and welcoming, I felt like I was back home. Their salads were delicious and if you ever decide to come here do try their breakfast options & their crepes. One of the best French restaurants in langkawi

Author: MrsfraggleManchester UK
Title: Epic Disappointment!
Review: I seldom give poor reviews and then only with reluctance but I think I must have visited a different restaurant to some of the other reviewers. I had low expectations about the food and high expectations about the ambience. We were party of 20 and were seated in what I thought was a side room. The place was not very clean and the wiring looked downright dangerous. It was such that I didn't risk a visit to the bathroom for fear of what I might find! We had been asked to preorder our food from a list of three choices two days ahead of our visit. I chose the Hainanese Chicken Chop, a dish I had enjoyed elsewhere. It was beyond grim and served with frozen mixed vegetables and was smothered in what seemed like economy supermarket own brand sweet and sour sauce. All the food arrived on a trolley and the service was brusque and indelicate. We started with a nondescript mushroom soup and our drinks arrived as we were half way through our main course. the style of food was best described as school dinners meet hospital food although I have had much better meals in both types of institution. I just didn't get the concept. Fearing I was missing the point I ventured into the neighbouring room and bar but apart from the interesting memorabilia this also looked as though it had not been cleaned for a century. Local people were having meals on sizzling platters and enjoying their experience which left me bemused . It all reminded me of the sketch " Going for an English" from the programme Goodness Gracious Me and that's how I would describe my dinner experience farcical.

Author: amilism
Title: Very good enviroment.
Review: Good service.but not so many choices of food.but good for me.would be nice if have many choices.this cafe located at dynasty hotel.i would recommend stay at this hotel.very cheap price for gov staff.

Author: ALR0609
Title: Standard HRC
Review: Pretty standard HRC, meaning it's good but not great. Nice decorations, nice environment to just chill. Especially in the evening when it's not too hot to sit on the verandah overlooking the melaka river, and with a view of the stadhuys.

Author: danutaperth
Title: Good atmosphere
Review:
This my 3rd trip to Hard Rock Cafe.   Usually go to experience the atmosphere of the restaurant. Meals are fairly large portions.   Bit pricey for KL standards, but well worth the effort to get there.
Good music is played all night.

Author: endymionk
Title: TASTY VEGGIE DISHES IN A FRIENDLY NICE ATMOSPHERE
Review: The menu offers a variety of yummy dishes with a very competitive price. The owner of this restaurant is extremely friendly and willing to give you advice about what to order. Definitely recommend for vegetarians.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: NG Q
Title: Impeccable service and good food
Review: Impressed with service staff for their enthusiasm and warmth. Recommendation on wine selection is good. Food quality is also very good

Author: AmasLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyable lunch
Review: Before our trip to KL we made a conscious decision not to visit both the towers. The rationale to pick KL tower was the restaurant and for the price of a buffet lunch, we had access to the observation deck. From KL tower we could also view the Petronas and the rest.I booked the buffet lunch online and the confirmation was quick and the request of the window seat was accepted.Staying at the Shangrila-la was also a bonus as the tower was within walking distance. At the bottom of the hill there is a shuttle that takes guest to the base of the tower. At the entrance there is a reception desk for Atmoshpere 360. At the appointed time after checking in with the receptionist, guests are escorted to the restaurant by lift.We were seated by the window as requested and the view was amazing!We also knew the alcohol was pricey so we stuck to water. We were plied with ice cold water and that was sufficient.The buffet selection was varied, European, Japanese, Malaysian, Indian and Chinese.I was spoilt for choice. Unfortunately, the food was not that hot. I tried majority of Malaysian, Indian and Chinese fare. Loved the dessert selection too, the durian cold soup was delicious and so was the cendol.We stayed for the whole lunch service as we wanted to soak up the view and we were not rushed by the staff. The staff were all very helpful and pleasant. We were taken to the observation desk after our lunch, which is one floor below the restaurant. We didn't stay too long as the deck is not air conditioned and we had already seen most of the view.Overall, the food isn't fine dining but for the view and food it is good value in my opinion.

Author: elixirpuppyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It's good, not great...getting overpriced.
Review: They have increased the prices of the sushi and sashimi. I personally feel they are getting very orverpriced and nothing really extra ordinary about their sashimi, except when they feature their latest ingredient for the month. However, they have a wide range of ochas to choose from. I love their ochas, but not their food. The udon selection is very limited too, and the soup is inconsistent. At times the flavors are well balanced, at times, over salty. Sushi rice sometimes are so well made that you know the sushi chef is in a very good mood that day, and some other times the rice just fell apart when I was about to pick it up. I don't think such an expensive place will produce such inconsistent quality of udon. Overall, I used to love this place until I noticed the price is getting expensive but the quality is rather plain and inconsistent.

Author: dyanz765Kuala lumpur
Title: Splendid family gathering in vasco’s
Review: We had a family dinner at vasco’s last month, celebrating our nieces graduation. The place was so nice with kl view and the choices of food were uncountable. I give 5 star service by our waiter, jaiprakash, for his patience and hospitality. Looking forward for next dinner gathering.

Author: erfani83Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing view of KL
Review: Found this place on TripAdvisor and went there to check it out.The bar is located on the 59th floor and super friendly staff on the ground floor can help you to access the right lift.The music was good and DJ played a variety of songs. Unlike some bar the music was not too loud and suited the environment. I ordered some tapas food along with drink and everything was served timely and professionally.The view of KL and skyscrapers is outstanding particularly with the mist surrounding the buildings after a rainy afternoon.If you want to have a good time and get a good view of KL, you definitely need to come to this bar. The view is a lot better than KLCC twin towers.

Author: Kum C
Title: mediocre dining experience
Review: although atmosphere was great, food was average. spaghetti meatballs was full of tendons. the famous piglet had way too much fat till it was uneatable. however the desserts was a delight

Author: thevein_nambiarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Kerala Food
Review: If you want something different from the run of the mill Indian restaurants, this is the place to go. They serve Kerala cuisine, the only such restaurant in Kuala Lumpur to the best of my knowledge and possibly in the whole of Malaysia.Given the quality of food, its rarity, and the location it is value for your money.

Author: Brian CMichigan
Title: Stayed for lunch
Review: I came for the Coffee and stayed for lunch. After reading reviews online this place came up for its Coffee. The Coffee was just average with no single-origin options, not much of a coffee shop or environment. When I was there it was jam packed with office workers grabbing lunch. The food was good at medium prices. I had the superfood salad and it was def super and worth going back for.

Author: HongKongNoodlesBonn, Germany
Title: Nope.
Review: Yes, the view is good - and you're gonna pay for that. I get it. But for what we ordered, it was way too expensive!Stay away from the lamb!!! (Lamb Kuzi for 13RM) Why? Because there was not meat. It was rice, sauce and bones. Horrible. I ordered the Sate (which was pricey but good) but I got my order after my boyfriend was finished with his meal (He couldn't wait cos it took 20 minutes). So well, we wanted to eat together but that was not possible.When I complained about the bad service, the guy almost got ugly.You can go for the view, but choose your food wise. I won't ever go again.

Author: ShanmelbMelbourne, Australia
Title: Don't pay to eat here
Review: We had a dinner buffet (9-11pm) booking here. We came early to see the observation deck but there was no point, we saw it all from the restaurant.Although there was a large variety of food available it was all cold and fairly bland. Not worth the 195RM you pay to eat here. The staff were nice enough although there was a time we waited more than 20mins to order another drink and by 10:30 they definitely want to be getting out of there. The band was amazing. That's the only thing I liked. When we went down to go home there was no one at the taxi bay and no taxis for the 20 odd people waiting.If I could do it again I would just go up there during the day and have a look. Would definitely not eat there.

Author: shedeeBrisbane, Australia
Title: Would be better if service was faster
Review: Had lunch there on a Friday afternoon and the place was packed. Food was fresh and the Paku dish was pretty good. The fish was really good but the service was painfully slow. Orders were taken fairly quickly but the food delivery took almost 45 minutes to be sent out We had to keep asking the servers where our meal was. I saw a few people having the same issue whilst having our lunch there.

Author: binshahidan
Title: Buffet Ramadhan
Review: Nice place with great view with good vibes. 7/10 for foods and baverages, the briani and the lamb not meet my expectations. 10/10 for the services. Every waiters got a good knowledge for what they serve. Would like to give a credit to auri for serving the delicious seabass. Will visit next time! Cheers!

Author: Semih G
Title: A hidden treassure on Langkawi
Review: Great location and fantastic food. The restaurant is a very clean and tidy place. The owners and the staff are more than friendly. And the food...wow! Very good and reasonable prices. A must go!!

Author: Cheah D
Title: Disappointing
Review: If I could give zero star, I would. One of the worse. Ordered rojak mee sotong and cendol. The portions were large and fresh and came within minutes after the order. However it was very disappointing. It was dull, flavourless. The cendol was just plain cendol with no creamy corn nor red beans. And it was damn pricey. Maybe they should come over to Seapark Jalan 21/17 Petaling Jaya to learn what the real rojak mee sotong and cendol is all about.

Author: Carel K
Title: Good Food and good value!
Review:
The restaurant is clean, the food is well presented and the most important thing, it is tasty.
We have tried several restaurants and for Malaysian dishes, this was the best.

Author: NabilMuhaiminpairtra
Title: Servis lambat..food biasa2 je
Review: I went with my friends and brother for a drink after futsal. And the waiter kept us waiting for 10 minutes to take the order. Understaff. Very bad services

Author: KiarashATehran
Title: An eat; nothing more is expected
Review: Cheap beer price during happy hours and relatively cheap beer during non-happy hours. The dishes are very ordinary and there is nothing special about it. The music is hell. Once there was this chinese duo playing chinese karaoke songs to a chinese birthday party. It was hell. But since the beer price even beats the union jack it gains appointed to average class.

Author: Noimarley
Title: AWESOME SPREAD & EXCELLENCE SERVICE
Review: My bestfriend n i were very pleased & enjoyed our breakfast spread very much. We were spoilt with choices of food to choose n clean ambience. All staffs both from the kitchen & the servers were very helpful n friendly. They pay attention to our wants n always with great smiles. We would like to give a shoutout to SITI NUR AJWA for her excellence service & quick respond. Keep Smiling Thumps up Le Meridien! Overall, we enjoyed our 3 days here!!! N today is my bestfriend Birthday.. heheh

Author: carimakanman
Title: excellent chinese course dinner
Review: food is well cooked and reasonably priced. Special  for group event dinner. Environment is stylish and cozy. Air-conditioned.

Author: SorryIAmAM
Title: nice malaysian food
Review: i have to be honest the food here is actually good and the service is good as well. i like the ribs and the portion is so big. got many other pork dishes here. its situated in a mall attached to an apartment complex

Author: Eric O
Title: Food is Average, proportion small.
Review: I ordered grill barracuda fish set for the son. One of the most expensive item on the menu. I don't think the fish fresh.The price isn't cheap but I expect higher standards. The portion of pasta is tasty can't make me full even though I am a small eater.

Author: Fsahu
Title: Dinner is horrible...
Review: we order 12 dishe... The nicest item is the juice. It take very very high level of skills to cook beef this hard and rice that soggy! taste like crap

Author: KLG77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast
Review: I love the breakfast so much even it did not have much choice for you to select.Their international breakfast is great and it is serve on your table. You still can have your juice, bread, oat, fruits, cereal and Danish pastries from the buffet counter.The price is reasonable and tell you what, I love the latte so much. When I have time, I will go over for latte.As it is fine dining restaurant so lunch and dinner menu is quite upper range price but it is worth the price.

Author: TheYumL
Title: Chili's KLCC
Review: This spot is forever popular, but I'm not a huge fan. The portions are generally large and tasty, which I guess is satisfying for group dining. I understand its charm, but it's not for the true gourmand.

Author: rkmajumdarPittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: Avoid this place
Review: The food in other "hip" KL restaurants are much better. The price of food is too expensive especially the meat items. Plus, if I wanted to eat on plastic lawn chairs, then I would have eaten at the numerous hawker or food stalls scattered around the area. For the amount of money this place takes in, they could easily upgrade the sitting and eating arrangements.Overall, the experience was disappointing.

Author: epalash
Title: Excellent!
Review: This Syrian restaurant is excellent.  All the dishes are made in house including the pita which you do not see very often.  Would eat here on a regular basis.

Author: labripaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Major Disappoinment and Disgusted.Rename it to 7 sugar.
Review: My family & I visited this restaurant yesterday.7 spices. Being indians we were expected authentic Indian food. We were impressed by the ambience and the layout. Orders were taken fast by a friendly foreign worker. After that, everything was just negative.1) service was so slow. There were about 8 + staff. Some at the food counters. Some standing around and some at the cashier. None of them followed up after the orders were taken. We had to call them and request for the banana leaves and rice and vege to be served. Then too, the service was so slow that I think we could have drove into Spore and returned to Singapore! Most of the staff were idling and least enthusiastic about anything.2) horrible food - I do not get it. Is this really an Indian restaurant? Fish curry was sweet, side dishes were sweet, sambal fish was sweet and overloaded with belachan and smelly and worse was the so called signature grilled cheese giant prawns which tasted as tho it was cooker with just sugar and the disgusting sweet mutton in the dum mutton briyani. When we enquired the waiter just stared at us blankly n said she does not know. And we requested to speak to the manager , he never came. Sambar tasted horrible too.3) rice was practically half steamed.4) only edible food was the pepper crab. Fresh and spicy.rm120 for crab. Rm100 for the disgusting sweet cheese giant prawns (x5 pieces) +++ = rm380. Not worth a single cent dining in this restaurant. Highly NOT RECOMMENDED.

Author: shaktibhaktiLondon, United Kingdom
Title: bit pricey but organic & fresh
Review: Ive been here to eat 5times now. Unfortuntly this week theres a new chef who boils the lentil soup to heat it up and it has arrived bubbling. Took over 10mins to make it cool enough to eat...such a shame as two weeks ago the same soup was served hot but not that hot. The apple crumble with nut cream[cashew i suspect] is delicious. They also serve meat and fish, not vegan...had the olive and pesto pasta, bit oily for me but expected it to be so with pesto...very good however if you arent avoiding too much use of oil like macrobiotic me! fresh juices but all seem to have fruit, i managed to get them to mix a green one without apple..Can sit outside or in and its on one of the main streets down from the bangsar shopping village.. parking is a nightmare around this area...too many cars driving around for space and twice we had to go to the underground village shopping centre. It seems to be `very hip` but I`m not too impressed...theres an amazing stationary shop on the corner of this street...go visit, places like this shop have long gone in London....they sell EVERYTHING!

Author: ms2b5862Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great menu for an Italian restaurant
Review: Good serving of piña colada for RM30.Great outdoor seatingSpacious restaurant space indoorPolite staffBeside the pool at 13th floor so very relaxing with the view
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: TravellingAfrican
Title: Nothing special
Review: We weren't very impressed with the food here. Very greasy. There are much better options in the general area.

Author: Mimath
Title: Good for seafood but very basic for the equipment
Review:
This is a very very basic restaurant along the sea side. Food is good but also very basic. During the day the view is rather nice. At night it losses a bit its charm as the see can't be seen anymore.
A bit expensive.

Author: studiohausvincent
Title: Nothing special
Review: Its really nothing to shout about with the rice ball and chicken here. Its very commercialize and seems mostly tourist are going.

Author: KanjiKJS
Title: Awful chili fries
Review: The burger was ok but the chilli fries is really disappointing. It soaked up oil, it was like eating tiny little branches.

Author: KLTokyoKuala Lumpur
Title: It's a shame particularly when it is associated with Nadaman & Shangri-La and
Review: I have been to Zipangu over many years but the quality of the food has deteriorated gradually to the point that it is no longer acceptable. The atmosphere is good but, depending on the timing, there are way too many kids running around and destroying the environment. A simple grilled chicken, i.e. Yakitori, was served over-cooked and was not able to eat. Until such time they revamp the quality of the dishes, I recommend to avoid - it's not worth visiting here.

Author: bcampbell2015
Title: So-so
Review: The food was average with limited choices on the menu. Good vegetarian options but my meal lacked flavour. The tom yam soup was very disappointing. The live music was too loud to carry on a conversation at our table.

Author: Selva G
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: Ordered fish, tofu, sambal petai & vege curry. All the items were super oily. People with heart issues & high blood pressure should stay away!

Author: mengzaiSingapore
Title: Lousy service with oily and salty dish
Review: This is the 3rd times I had visited this eatery. Last 2 trips was still acceptable on the service and food. However it seem getting from bad to worst. Food served were salty and oily than before. Had informed the waiter to have the dish done with less oil and salt but it turn up worse. Ordered a plate of steam roll and it never being serve. When ask for it for twice, Was told it was on the way. After we had finished all dishes. The steam roll is yet to be serve. Asked for the steam roll order to be cancel. The supervisor give you the look as want to fight with you. Horrible!

Author: holybird_12London, United Kingdom
Title: terrible food
Review: We took some friends there for dinner, hoping to have a good meal. Unfortunately, this was not the case. The dishes that we ordered were all very salty. Service was mediocre. We ordered a dish of steamed fish. When it came, we cut it and was shocked to see that it was not cooked through - blood was oozing out of the flesh. The waitress apologised and quickly had it sent back to the kitchen. Waited for at least 20 minutes or so before we had the fish back. This time, it was so overcooked - well overkilled!! Tasted disgusting. By then, our appetites were also killed. And to top it off, the bill was so expensive. Well, we have learnt our lessons - we will never go back to Overseas restaurant again and have told all our friends about this bad experience to discourage them from going there too.

Author: Bronwyn WMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Simply superb
Review: We went to this restaurant with open minds and left with full stomachs. This place doesn't look much (by Australian standards) but inside it is full of beautiful wooden booths. The menu is extensive. Our family of 6 all ordered something different and none of us were disappointed. However, you must leave room for dessert. An absolute must.

Author: HazreeqKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unforgettable anniversary diner.
Review: The best steak in town. Very comfy environment.Me and my fiancée having anniversary dinner and the server that incharge for our table surprised us with awesome n delicious small cake,which is impressed me with a polite n good way of serving. It was a beautiful and memorable anniversary diner that night.❤️

Author: CkgC74
Title: fine place for dinner
Review: I love some of their pasta, poultry, and dessert. Main course just nice portion for a diet person. recommended place to go.

Author: elenita o
Title: Perfect dinner
Review: We had tried a portion of lobster paired with the bottle of wine. Is was so fantastic  and amazing dinner with my friends. Definitely will be back..

Author: Jon WBarton-upon-Humber, United Kingdom
Title: Great Night Out
Review: Was passing and decided to go in and glad we did. There was a great band playing rock covers, cant remember what they were called but had two female lead singers. Only strange thing as a Brit was that people were smoking inside, although they did have a good air conditioning system.

Author: StevenL1470
Title: Cosy place with carpark
Review: Nice restaurant for breakfast and good coffee. Sitting outside is nice with the road view. Coffee is not too expensive with available parking at rm 2 per hour. Super nice grocery store BIG Ben at the same area!

Author: WhatCanWe L
Title: Great cheesecake
Review: The cheesecake was similar to the one in the Tokyo Restaurant. The closest replica you will ever get

Author: Nick R
Title: Some beers at the Wheeler's Coffee
Review: Unfortunately we did not try the Coffee, just stopped over for some cold beer. Wheeler's Coffee is located on Love Lane in the city center of George Town. We had a basket of Tiger beer and got some fries for free, what was a welcomed suprise. Staff was very friendly and we did enjoy some nice hours in the evening at the Wheeler's Coffee. Full recommendation!

Author: GourmandVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent local food in beautiful setting
Review: Every dish that we had here for dinner were super delicious, especially the beef, lamb, 4 angle bean kerabu, prawns and all the desserts! The blend of spices in each dish were superb and top notch! The decor and ambience is beautiful and service was very attentive. Note: if you are hosting a dinner for private dining, there is a noise restriction, which was a little ridiculous ("guest upstairs complained" at 10pm). Highly recommended to dine here! Vegetarian options also available upon request.

Author: Natalie1918
Title: Ok, greasy
Review:
May just be preference, but the Turkish pizza and kebab mix was quite greasy.
Friendly staff and good service though.
Homemade lemonade was enjoyed by friends, as was the hummus

Author: murthiadvisor
Title: Why bother!!!
Review:
A waste of time with rude waiters, poor food and questionable hygiene all round.
The owners seem only interested in making money and not providing quality service.
definitely  not worth a second visit

Author: dsaa2016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: FABULOUS CHINESE FOOD IN KL
Review: service 5 star,food excellent. My family and i go to this restaurant very often. Always greeted with a smile and top notch service. The dim sum menu is good. also the sweet and sour chicken. Egg foo yong and of course you cannot leave without trying the durian pancake. To die for. Overall, one of the best chinese restraunts in KL

Author: munieeIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Buffet spread rather disappointing
Review: There are a lot more to improve as they claim themselves as 4-stars. I would say probably 3.5 stars in terms of restaurant presentation. The buffet spread was rather disappointing on my recent trip to Tiffin. Guess it was meat night on the buffet. Dishes was roast lamb, rendang tok, beef stroganoff, lamb in indian style and beef stew. I think the executive chef or rather the F&B manager need to improve on the menu selections. As for the buffet line, call me typical but I do not think that appetisers should be place together with desserts. Nice cheeses and greens for salad but guests only discover them when they hit the desserts at the corner.

Author: CheeY TSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice dim sum place, very reasonable prices
Review: A nice family restaurant frequented by locals and tourists.We arrived around 930am and a nice variety of usual dim sum was still available.The porridge is worth trying too.Place is clean. Service is good.Parking is an issued and enforcement is quite rigid.If you looking for some decent dim sum at very affordable pricing, this is the place.For those who complain about serving portions, I think they would be challenged to find it elsewhere at these kind of prices.

Author: Travel-Luxe1Sydney, Australia
Title: Not good. Not authentic. Not tasty.
Review: Erm, I am at a loss to explain why others are saying the food is good here. Really? Are you sure?Let's go through some points ...1. It's not authentic American food. Ok, I wouldn't mind that part, if it was tasty. But it's not. So that makes it unauthentic, as well as not tasty. 2. Tried the pulled pork sandwich. Nothing like what it should be. It was sloppy, did not have the rich bbq flavour it should, was soaked in runny gravy with no flavour, and sat in a cheap as heck white bun. 3. Tried the fried chicken. Wished I hadn't. Absolutely swimming in flour laden gunky sauce. A disaster.4. Tried the dog food fries. Appropriate name. No further comment required.5. Homemade lemonade. Was good. Hurrah, you got one thing right.6. Food arrived within 103 seconds of placing the order. I timed, so I know. Must have been precooked, and tasted like it. Not possible to cook fresh in that time.In summary, it's not tasty, it's not original, it's not particularly cheap, it's not inspiring. What is there to recommend?Worse still, I guess it is all cooked way before you get there.Avoid.

Author: Ragu88
Title: Delicious Steak
Review:
The steak is really juicy and tender and made with so much of love :)
Have really enjoyable brunch here and really pleasant environment.

Author: ViaCorinto90Rome, Italy
Title: Terrible!!! Stay well away!!!
Review: We were very excited to go dine at this restaurant and the expectations were according to the name of the hotel chain. Everything turned out to be a huge disappointment instead!!!No welcoming smiles or words at the entrance to the hotel where guests are dropped off by taxis. At least at the restaurant staff was kind. But that, the amazing view, the bread (only white. No wholegrain) and the champagne were the only good things in there. The rest was absolutely to forget about!!!There was no art, love, skill, taste, research or anything in any of the dishes we ordered!!! Everything was totally bland and any pre-packaged meal/salad wound have been better presented and tastier! Unbelievable! Especially considering the price tag!!!The absolute highlight was when the waiter politely asked us if the oysters were "fresh enough"!!! Seriously???One of my worst dinners out ever.

Author: Naim ANashua, New Hampshire
Title: Another HRC. Food was not good.
Review: The salads were not good. The choice of draft beer was very limited. There was a fun band singing as of 11pm which is ok and the ambiance was just OK. We ended up there for some personal reasons, I would not recommend it otherwise in a city with so many good restaurants.

Author: john5868
Title: good food at JB
Review: Ho min san got two outlet at Johor and it much try when u are in JB, Paradigm and southkey , dumpling and noodles. You may also order for "Pan-fried Pork Chop in Curry Sauce" as a side dish too! also can try their Tau Fu Fa, I been there 3 times.

Author: Eric TKuala Lumpur
Title: Average food with terrible service
Review: Let me say that I love the Din Tai Fung restaurants overseas - especially Singapore and Taiwan.So we tried the Malaysian restaurant, and found it severely lacking.The food was average - either is was bland, ill prepared or quite ordinary.The service was especially bad - with food being served slow, wrong orders being placed, and a lot of waiters rushing by our tables (with their heads down so they won't look at our raised hands trying to get their attention).I would not return, unless I was dragged here by my friends and they were paying the bill
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: mahes752Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Received poor service - 8pm - 21st may 2014
Review: i walked in , very few ppl so there shld not be a reason saying they are buzy!set at a table visible ,,raised my hand many times but they are not even bothered to attend to my call ! i wonder why! so i just set wonder when they will attend to me!came in few groubs of 4pax and 3 pax . waiter opened the door taking them to table to sit. if they are seeing ppl and servicing then should paste a notice at the door so we dont go there!more we are not paying any lesser then the others! food is expensive too! my experience!!!!!!!! ENDed this restaurant hear after.

Author: josslerUK
Title: Lovely environment that is sadly unmatched by the food
Review: We had high expectations. The restaurant is visually stunning. The head chef came & spoke to us about his philosophy on Indian cuisine - all of which primed us well.The dishes are inexpensive but all are small portions - starters & main courses alike really are tapas dishes. That is no bad thing. But expect to need to order a lot of dishes to sate your appetite - which will push up the cost of your bill.But value for money wasn’t our key observation. It was the quality & taste of the food itself. The dishes all taste similar to one another. And none were visually appealing. Considering the artistic surroundings it was disappointing to be served bland looking offerings. The dishes were nicely spiced; but some were too creamy & sickly. And some were foul (the escargot dish isn’t pleasant - and I love escargot). It felt as if the produce (meat, veg & seafood) being used was rather low end.On balance, despite the great ambience & good service, and arguably ok value for money, I wouldn’t return. The food just isn’t good enough.

Author: fir3bolt
Title: Love it!!
Review: This is the best sushi place for me and I really really enjoyed the food there. Do try Gyenuki Enoki Roll. Love the ambience too. I really hope they would open one franchise in Ipoh.

Author: ImmaY7
Title: Wedding Anniversary on board
Review: Celebreate our wedding anniversary at plane in the city , nice view nice feel and nice foods , Must Try !

Author: MTLtravelfunMontreal
Title: Pretty place, nice meal
Review: What I liked: 1. Right on the waterfront – great location, nice looking restaurant with lots of seating2. The fresh lime juice was extremely refreshing after a hot day3. Enjoyed the margarita chicken curry – very tasty and nicely seasoned4. Easy place to relax and talk 5. The service was fine. What could be improved:1. On the day I went the washroom was a disgrace. I mentioned this fact to our tour guide. It was dirty with water all over the floor and mud. The garbage can didn’t open. When, you left the wash room, the place to wash your hands seems to be right in front of where they leave dirty dishes. There was a small bottle of hand sanitizer, but no paper to dry your hands. This is surprising after a nice meal, nicely presented in what should be a good restaurant. My rating was reduced due to the washroom.

Author: Stevenng118
Title: Open air pub
Review: Live band 2 pc every thursdays.  The lead singer Patrick is good. Mostly oddies of the 70s, 80s and 90s.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Jan Willem tNijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: The fame is greater than reality
Review: We came for dinner at about 7 pm. We choose a table at the street terrace and the waiter came to take the order for a drink and gave us the very large menu book! We ordered Chinese ice tea and started studying the menu book. After a while we came to a choice and ordered. But the waitress told us tghat a number of dishes on the menu card were not anymore served, the ones we choosed too! Finally we ordered Kuh Lu Yuk, Kailan, Petai sambal shrimps and threelayer pork noodles. The dishes were served within 4 minutes after order but the taste was not more than average. We think this place is good for beer in combination with food, then the food becomes less important probably. Total price, Ringit 52,90 We will not come back here.

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive!
Review: Looking around for a place to have desserts and visited this one. The desserts was ok, even above average but I found the prices to be on the higher side which is why, though the desserts are good, I only gave it a 3 out of 5. At this prices, I don’t think I’ll be trying anytime soon.

Author: packedandready2goCalifornia
Title: Great breakfast buffet though regular dinners only average
Review: The breakfast buffet deserves 5 stars with a wide selection of western, Indian, and Chinese breakfast food along with lots of breads, cereals and fruits. The lunch and dinner menus are identical so the food can get repetitious if eating here on a daily basis. The dinner food is okay but nothing special. I understand the weekend barbecue buffets are good but I did not have an opportunity to try them.

Author: Jishnu575Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Best barbeque in town
Review: This place has awesome barbeques of all kinds. The choices are simply amazing. So is the value for money.I went during the lunch hours, and was lucky to find myself comfortably seated. Definitely the Sheekh Kabab, is too good.Surely visit this place, you will have a fun time.

Author: ajimenez001Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't like it at all
Review: The only one thing that it was good was the tiger beer served following the Chinese old style. Back fried rice was disappointing, black Angus burger was so Dry, untasty that the only remarkable thing was the fries. Never back. Checked and that's it

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Seriously overpriced
Review: There are tons of Thai restaurants about and while this is one of the better ones, that doesn't justify a price level around double of anywhere else. Seriously guys - RM 39 for a bloody green curry - that is a rip off - pure and simple. Even if they made it out of pure beef tenderloin (which they definitely did not) there's no way that price can be justified.

Author: Riz82_12Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing experience!
Review: I have had the privilege of eating at many excellent restaurants around the world and the food here is really among the best I have tasted. Just one odd pairing in the main course (tofu skin wrapped wagyu beef sausage) but that could be a matter of personal preference. Great service from team including Shaun and the chef/owner himself, Raymond. This is a Michelin starred restaurant in the waiting and nothing less than 2 stars will do it justice. I just hope they retain the setting and pricing when that happens. Do yourself a favour and try it out!

Author: ChristineCCMMalaysia
Title: Overpriced food and bad service
Review: We were there as a group for a dinner over the Bastille day celebration. And apparently the chef had concocted a special menu of 16 "tapas". We could either have everything or choose certain dishes from the list. The menu looks impressive however when the food arrived, it was so disappointing when it comes to the portion. It was hardly a tapas dish as each dish consist of a bite, more like an amuse bouche. On top of that service was horrible as each dish took at least half an hour to an hour of wait. The restaurant should have represented the menu correctly and inform the clientele that it was a biteful of each dish instead of calling it tapas.However, the food was pretty good, but i suppose it should be judging from the price they are charging for a bite of minuscule foie gras and half a raspberry.VERY dissapointing indeed.

Author: ObokeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good dim sum in the morning
Review: We have our breakfast in this cantonese restaurant in Ipoh. The place is very traditional, like Hong Kong in the fifties? They also offer extra washing bowls for washing your own cups, just like Hong Kong. You have to get the dishes yourself from the counter. The choices are limited depending on the timing.

Author: BLYCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sunday buffet
Review: One of the best buffet around. Food variety was good, staffs were pleasant and helpful. But I would expect that considering the price was on the high side. Lost count on the number of trips went back and forth the spread. The Tiger Prawn cooked in oyster/soy sauce was excellent. Pizza was good as it was fresh i.e hot from the oven and the portion was just nice. Somehow the sashimi doesn't taste as good as it looks. Deserts and fruits were pleasant and was refill rather swiftly. Can skip the ice kacang/abc/whatever you call it as the shaved ice tasted rough and the hygiene is questionable as the ice was shaved ready.Would i return? Probably yes...

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Great Food, Old Kopitiam!
Review: This oldie is a jewel when it comes to food. It is location within walking distance from Central Market and opposite to Petaling Street. This coffee shop actually operates in 2 shops, side by side. You may order from the corner shop if you sit next door. I am totally in love with the roast duck the most. Super duper yummy. Beef noodles are great too. Loh mee is tasty. Char kuey teow is also good.

Author: HeyManaLouKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fancily Disappointing
Review: Drove by IstanaSangkut when searching for places to have dinner. 1) Place looks kind of hipster-ly, with a barber next to it 2) Ordering system is a mess. Not sure how to order, menu is confusing, wait staff also not sure what to suggest to patrons 3) Payment, also confusing. Have to enter a boutique (street wear) to pay 4) Only Mee Rebus is ok. The Sangkut Fried Rice is horrible. 5) Beverage ordering process was seriously slow. Took some minutes for the wait staff to inform that no coffee available. Seriously?! 6) Not friendly for kids, as the whole place is smoking zone. Unless you want your kids to pick up smoking. 7) If the cafe is striking to be different, it scores in terms of weird arrangement of seating, tables, but failed in functionality 8) the owner needs to remember this is a food outlet, serve good food is also crucial, not just the style.

Author: EaterNGo
Title: worst
Review: worst indian restaurant. cant make basic chutney and idli. food is terrible and spoiled. mutton briyani worst briyani in my life. the chicken curries just watery n tasteless

Author: TravellerPoriruaGreater Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Terrible Place to dine
Review: We had a terrible experience at this place. As the walls are not plastered, we found a couple of lizards crawling on the ceiling and we were scared that they may defecate on the food. When pointed to the manager, he did not seem to take any note of it. While their biriyani tasted good, the food was generally pretty hot with chillies. So my wife couldn't try other dishes and when we finished eating, a guy came and collected our plates and to make things real worse, he just took my wife's plate, wiped it with an already dirty towel and put it along with other plates to serve the diners with. We walked out in disgust thinking, that we might have eaten from dirty plates used by others. Very horrible experience.

Author: Your_MelakaMalacca, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Dining Ambience
Review: Pleasant service and great cuisine. Attended from the door to the table, the waiter and the waitress are friendly and they warmly welcome you. Best attempt is extended to get available table of your choice. From the moment you're seated, warm tea is served and ice cubes make its way to the table for those who prefer drinking cold. Soothingly as you enjoy the warm fragant tea, the tender music pleases your mood and the refreshing cool air pamper you while warm and steamy foods are timely delivered to your table from the kitchen.The joy of dining is elevated with the quiet ambience, cosy lighting and creative wall design, excellent for anyone who would like to capture and mobile upload to Facebook for their close to like. There is a wide range of cooking styles one can order and do not hesistate to ask for recommendation. The waiter and the waitress are please to attend to your request promptly.The whole dining experience is complete with desserts and fruits. A restaurant to feast.

Author: RozitaHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tea for two rendezvous
Review: A tea visit during RMCO led us to order the Roast Beef French Onion melt sandwich which was so delicious. The combination of tender roast beef slices covered with onions put drenched in gravy and topped with mozzarella and parmesan cheese was very filling and comforting. Just what we needed on a cold rainy day. We also opted for the warm scones. I had an Earl Grey tea. I would surely like to order the roast beef sandwich here again. It has become my favourite sandwich at Ben's from now on.

Author: balihomestay
Title: Love the foods
Review: Some variatif foods that we like here including the Bak Kut Teh. They offer many kind of foods for you to choose and some time we are confuse which is the best one to have because all looks good and nice.

Author: JC CHong Kong, China
Title: A bit of Bali in KL
Review: Stumbled upon this - it had just opened a few weeks. The food was good - ribs were good, fast service and also a great food which kids love. It was rather noisey though - music coming from the restaurant next door, but didn't stop us from enjoying our ribs!! Not quite the same as Bali, but if anyone misses Bali Naughty Nuris this is certainly a good filler!

Author: r15xeb
Title: Great location, average food with exorbitant price tag
Review: Dinner was ok but priced at fine dining levels, so not appropriate for an average steak. Wine poor as well but perked up by friendly service. Unfortunately, representative of KLCC BAR/restaurants

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Great Peking duck, soup, and noodles, but considered expensive for KL prices
Review:
Great Peking duck. Also made into preserved vegetables duck soup, and stir fry duck noodles. Steamed fish was good. Old school dessert were nice.

Overall, great food. But considered expensive for KL prices.

Author: summerboi123
Title: Not even ready for service
Review: We walked in the restaurant. Took easily more than half an hour just to place our order. The restaurant doesn't seems to be ready for service. More than 50% of the items were not available. We are place our order, after 10 minutes, the server said few items not available. So, I asked what are the available items. The server couldn't answer me and said will call the manager. The manager came after 7 minutes. Again, I asked the same question. The manager look at the menu and told me the items which I were told not available as items available for me to order. I wonder if they ever know what the restaurant is serving. Disappointed and not professional.

Author: 岩田 諭
Title: Very good staffs
Review: Very delicious food and drinks......Waiter and waitress which serve me was really good which is Amira and also Sethu.....The music here also really....Definitely we will come back here for the good service ...

Author: karyee98Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive ! ;(
Review: At first, yes I thought it was a paradise for foodie or traveler ,backpackers, etc. but when I was here, the environment was so-so and the cleanliness um average but the main problem is the price! The price is quite high comparing with others eg: you can get a plate of delicious chicken rice at Jalan Ipoh (about RM5) but you need to paid more (about RM7) for it and the taste, ugh . So, for me, here is not a good choice to eat at for budget foodie why paid more when you can have the same food at somewhere else? ;(

Author: 330edwinalLos Angeles, California
Title: Slow and inconsiderate service
Review: Similar to another review below, the food came out slowly. Eventually everything came out except for my grandfathers meals and we ended up waiting over an hour. We asked the waitress 4 times and eventually asked the manager twice for the last order. No offer to comp the last order even when we asked. Bad service, will not recommend. There are other places to get similar food without the slow attitude.

Author: Travelled123
Title: Disappointing
Review: Over 50% of the beers were unavailable. We were talked into a beer that didn’t fit our preference. Most expensive round of the night and left it. Massively disappointed.

Author: 523jennys
Title: Does not deserve its rating
Review: This place does not deserve its number 1 rating. Food was pretty average and overpriced for what you got.

Author: Sir_Phillip_G
Title: Still the best.
Review: Great to be back at Healy Macs Publika. I had such a great time there last year and was delighted to see some familiar faces upon my return. Marion, Joanne, Annie, Lyn and Genevieve were so welcoming. As usual the conversation was entertaining, the beer cold and food delicious.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: 26ellies
Title: Just great!
Review: We came for dinner and it was just awesome, lovely table with a great view and the food was amazing but it was all the little extras that made the night great, little free waygu burger taster, chocolates and Madelines to finish. The staff were so attentive and what made it for us was we mentioned we might pop to the bar above after dinner, at the end of the night our waiter escorted us up and they had reserved us just the best table outside with a view of the petronis towers. Really just above and beyond service!!

Author: lookennethKuala Lumpur
Title: Decent, but over-rated
Review: Had a lunch buffet here as part of a company-organised function. I would say I sampled most of the cuisine the menu had to offer. The supervisor was attentive enough to make sure we found our designated seats and our drinks served. They were also able to communicate well enough to our international guests with their needs. The service met expectations. That said, I had a sense of suspicion why we were not being served by the regular waiters and waitresses on staff. The food would be nothing to shout about. The local cuisine offered were either over-seasoned i.e. too salty, too oily or under-cooked i.e. the steamed fish. The Italian offerings fared slightly better, but again one would expect better quality at such an establishment. The desserts were unfortunately a let-down as well. One good take-away would be the fruit platter. The local fruits were surprisingly sweet and fresh. In summary, I would say that they need a lot of improvement just to meet expectations in terms of food. For such a steep price, I would get better value elsewhere in the same area.

Author: debblee02Perth, Australia
Title: Nice views
Review: We booked a buffet lunch as a present for a friend. It was 439ringgit for 4 people (about $156 Aust) the views were very good, it was raining so we had some cloud cover. There was an assortment of food, the hot food wasn't very hot & some were cold. We didn't know we only had 1hr to finish our meal so it was rushed. Take a jacket/jumper, the air conditioning is very cold. Staff were very good. We don't think it was worth the money, the views were nice but it was very rushed & the food wasn't great.

Author: shikin28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cute Halal cafe in Jonkers Malacca
Review: Was looking for some Halal food in Jonkers Street when I spotted this cute little cafe. Serves good range of Halal local and western cuisine. The London famous Salt Beef Sandwich which was mouth-watering and tasty Beef Brisket Noodle was their speciality. A very cosy ambiance enhanced by nice selection of soothing music, makes us want to sit for long! Good service too.A must try Halal cafe for all, in the heart of Jonkers!

Author: Thipa R
Title: Fun!
Review: Bring your little ones here to explore how Mamee was made and learn a little bit of the history behind home grown Mamee brand! They even have noodles making workshop for your little ones!

Author: Julie C
Title: Not great
Review: The noodles and veggies were way over cooked. The shrimp dish only had 2 shrimp in it. And they had this horrible loop of muzak that made me nuts.

Author: synicalrulesPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Just come with an empty stomach
Review: Was here for an office luncheon. The spread was not bad, there's something for every one here. There's dishes here that me as a native Klang Valley-ite had never seen or experienced before, or dishes that you maybe haven't had in a long time. They also don't hold back on the spice, so it was supposed to be spicy, it will be spicy. Food is pretty good.Also, parking is RM3 per entry.

Author: JeshawnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprise Food Find
Review: Their Indian food is honestly very decent and tasty. Dunno if I was super hungry but I especially love their cheese garlic Naans.Their Butter Chicken, Aloo Gobi and Tandoori Lamb are good! Totally enjoyed lunch. Flies are a problem though, it can be very distracting to eat our meal in peace. One even 'dived' into my drink and ruined it. They do delivery so can consider doing that so as to avoid the flies.

Author: Tiara123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worse than Terrible!
Review: If possible, I would have given a worse than terrible rating for this restaurant. My dissatisfaction stems not from the quality of food or ambience here, but the appalling lack of responsiblity and integrity of the staff (especially the manager). Recently I called up the restaurant to book the venue for my daughter's bithday party and they gave me a positive response. Then I made a personal visit to evaluate the place and also to confirm the venue. I talked to the manager himself and told him we are going for it. The day before the event, I gave them a casual ring to make sure nothing goes wrong and to my utter disbelief, they let me know, I have no reservation for the next day. They then put the manager on the line and he said he vividly remembered my visit, but unfortunately nothing about making a reservation there! I wish I had more time to spare some to tell him off then and there! But the last minute panic took me over since I had to call each and every guest to apprise them of the changed venue. The manager proved to be so inefficient and irresponsible since he forgot(?) to jot down or lock our reservation! A huge thumbs down for this Restaurant!!!

Author: KlinsyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good for a drink but forget the food
Review: Nice atmosphere and it's a good place to stop a while and enjoy a beer. But the food is a big disappointment. We tried a number of the started and a range of the tacos and none of us were impressed. The "Baja" taco was the worst, a large lump of deep fried battered fish drowned in some sauce. I couldn't finish it.

Author: tzenkai l
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Used to be very good but now not as good as previously. Service has dropped. Staff used to be very friendly but now just feel uncomfortable.

Author: Chikwilliam
Title: Dun go to this restaurant....you get threaten and insulted
Review: I was a Chinese Canadian and I was given a rude shock how terribly Malaysian Chinese especially this restaurant service provider. They were extremely rude by throwing vulgar words to the customer. Chicken is tasteless.....nothing to shout about. I hope this little thugs doesn't represent the Chinese community in Malaysia. Nightmare..

Author: BselviKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed expectation
Review: I had dinner at The Bangsar outlet on19-6-13. My order was Pan Cobia Fish. It was glorious. I yearned for it and had it again 24-6-13 when I went shopping at 1Utama. At 5.45pm, I & my kids waited to be seated but no one attended to us. So after 5-7 mins we sat down on our own. the outlet wasn't busy. I ordered the Pan Cobia Fish and waited excitedly. The order took 30mins to arrive. To my utter dismay, my order was a big let down. It was nothing like the one I had at Bangsar outlet. The sauce was so miserly, it did not have the chickpeas, zuccinis and so little red peppers. The dish was not like how the menu described it to be. I was shortchanged. It was awful. Though Delicious charged the same for my order but quality and presentation of my order was not up to mark. Doesn't Delicious maintain its fine food standard at all its outlet?

Author: GJreview
Title: Dining experience review
Review: The food and atmosphere can be considered above average but the service provided by a tall male waiter whose name start with ‘A’ is the definition of lousy/low standard service indeed. He is responsible to take our beverage order and he shouts at us when we asked him something that is clearly not mentioned in the menu. YES, HE SHOUTED! So, I guess he is telling me to “research” about all the menus of each restaurants under Werner’s Group before stepping into any of it? Cielo is not an ideal venue to host any kind of exclusive event as claimed in your website, thanks to him. This is our first time and last time to visit there. We are genuinely unhappy with our dining experience. It’s pointless for paying so much to ruin our mood. Lastly, thank you so much Julie, you’re so professional and helpful.All the best in your future endeavours, Mr. Werner. P/s: el cerdo was good and better Regards,A dissatisfied and disappointed tiny customer.

Author: jasoncfc
Title: Disgusting
Review: The food is cold and nothing like what is says on the menu is had chicken tacos that where more like salad in a cold pitter bread! Couldn't find the chicken must of been still running around out back! My friend ordered steak which was so fatty and tough a dog would turn there nose up at it! I had a small bug running around my plate maybe he ate the chicken all in all disgusting place to eat

Author: kelapa44Louisville, USA
Title: Disappointed but maybe we came at the wrong time
Review: We have been here a few times before and was happy with the spread but the lunch spread on this Monday was terrible. There was barely anything to choose from. Even the noodles had only tom yum as the soup instead of usually a curry soup or a soto soup. And there was only 1 strainer for everyone. There was no Japanese station or roast beef / lamb stations / or seafood station. The indian selection had only jeera rice and 2 curries. The satay was nice though.We were told that the chef was away (this was 26 Dec) so maybe this was likely. When we asked the manager, we were told that lunch spread was "normally" like this and it was the high tea (12.30 noon - 5pm) on saturdays and sundays which had much more selection. So maybe we came at the wrong time.

Author: Vims84Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Crap! Don't waste your money
Review: One the most awful food we have ever had! Ordered Hakka noodles and Manchurian and literally didn't look any different from each other and the taste was of only OIL!! All we could taste in every single bite was OIL but nothin else! We only had couple of bites each and left three quarter, took it back to the restaurant and there was no apology but instead argument and arrogance!!

Author: HO D
Title: Normal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: The restaurant served chicken rice ball which is normal. There are better restaurants in Melaka. The chicken not so smooth and chili needs to improve. Just visited this restaurant once and would not returned for a second time. The price is also not attractive.

Author: emilymaye22
Title: Awful
Review: All the food is bland!!!!We had the red curry the money bags and the pad Thai. The curry was spicy with no flavour. The money bags had frozen mixed vegetables in them. The pad Thai was over cooked noodles covered in sweet chilli sauce. I'm from New Zealand and I've had 1000 better Thai dishes in NZ!

Author: ConundrumMiaoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Satays
Review: Pork satay - not as succulent and tender as per the review. not much taste in the meat itselfPork intenstine - slightly more fragrant than the pork satay and can tastes the charred flavourChicken satay - a lil dry for mePineapple satay sauce - sweet, slightly spicy satay sauce. prefer to have more nutty taste though

Author: sleepyd88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No respect for regulars
Review: Shame an evening with friends was ruined because they decided that all screens in the pub should be tuned to rugby rather than split between football and rugby. How to hack off a regular in one easy lesson. And we were not the only people to walk out and leave the pub
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: jianleey
Title: Poor service and food quality
Review: This is a restaurant that I (and my 10 guests) will certainly not visit again nor recommend to others.The service was bad, very bad. Service staff dont know what to do, have no idea of the menu, responded to queries with a blank look, at best, they will check with the kitchen or whoever they trotted off to check with. Not attentive, they prefer and more important is to chat amongst themselves.The Aperol Spritz were insipid, their "ungenerous" portions of alcohol was confirmed when the Bombe Alaska did not "bombed" - only did after added another dose of alcohol, even then, a weak flame.Quality of food? Our orders were wrongly noted, the sauce for the lobster (which was tough and chewy) came 5 mins after the dish was served, the breadsticks had seen better days. Other dishes were generally OKAY. However, will give thumbs-up for the focaccia and tapenade.

Author: zyxw1Melbourne, Australia
Title: Amazing!
Review: I dined regularly at Tg's during my time in KL. Amazing food at very decent prices. The roti canai, garlic naan and butter chicken are up there with some of the best I've ever had. They're open 24 hours and have a very large menu of Indian, Malay and Thai food. Would definitely recommend to anyone in KL!

Author: sabrinaliew_96
Title: Nope... Just nope...
Review: The ambiance and service was good but the food... Seasoning and flavouring aren't up to par so I don't think that it's worth paying the price stated.

Author: JS B
Title: Overated
Review: This Laksa shops used to serve very good laksa and has become very famous over time, thus the laksa fillings have reduced in proportion with the increased price. It now serves very average and very over priced laksa. This shop is very over-rated thanks to the flocking Singaporean mob that come across the border just to eat here.

Author: Karuna C
Title: Over Rated Tim Sum restaurant - Resting on Past Laurels
Review: People like to enjoy their yam cha and tim sum in leisurely manner. That is the general expectations of people patronising a tim sum restaurant. However that is not the case at this place. This place is extremely noisy compared to a wet market or a bazaar. While some customers are eating, other customers rudely hover around seated customers waiting to grab a seat no sooner than is vacated.The tim sum items served here are no tastier and higher quality than that you would in most other tim sum joints in Ipoh. The much talked about Char Siu pau (bun) is half the quality and taste it once was.Please stay away from this place if you are a true connoisseurs of tim sum.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: WanderlenMalaysia
Title: Generous portioned servings
Review: I came here for a business lunch appointment. There were only a handful of tables occupied so it was conducive for talking business. The menu was separated into a drinks and food menu. The food menu is a two page wooden board. There were western as well as local dishes. I tried asking the waiter for their signature dishes but unfortunately I couldn't understand what he was saying. In the end, I referred to the menu itself. My associates had Spanish burger, fish and chips while I had grilled Norwegian salmon with 3 choices from a selection of vegetables, potato and sauce. We also ordered a Caesar's salad with chicken slices. To my surprise, the chicken slices were very tasty. However, I was a bit disappointed with my salmon as it was pretty dry that I squeezed some lemon juice from the fish and chips to moisten it. Overall, the serving was big, ambience was good and service was attentive.

Author: SpicyOlio
Title: Notably slow service
Review: The quality of service was way better prior to SB revising its prices upwards. How is that possible? Waited half hour for tosai. The waiters almost always divert their attention away from you. What a disappointment.

Author: 763emmad
Title: Best place I’ve tried in Asia
Review: I’ve travelled a lot trough Asia and this is by far the best meal and dining experience I’ve ever had! Every single plate we ordered at the table was excellent quality and taste, the setting is local and the vibe is nice. Traditional live music (chill - not the loud nosy kind). Service was friendly especially Jonathan made our dinner excellent! I will come back for sure

Author: IreneNg12
Title: Great dinner
Review: Friendly staff and good food. Regina, Adli and chef Steven were very helpful. Super good environment. Thank you.

Author: lisajbickLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Food was really nice, but staff grumpy/ lacked atmosphere
Review: The food here was really tasty, lots of veggie options and the veg samosas were very good.However, the staff were probably the least friendly we have encountered during our whole Malaysia trip so far! We only arrived after 9 and it was clear they were trying to rush us out. I'd have preferred they said they were closing, rather than take us in and rush us!Having said that the food wash excellent. Especially liked the green dip which came with the free popadoms.Yellow lentils were nice and the beer came in cool metal tankards.Mojito making skills were questionable!

Author: Shubhaa N
Title: Daughter's 7th year birthday celebration at Hydeoout
Review: Thank you to Christina and team, Hydeout Grand Hyatt for successfully arranging a wonderful 7th birthday party for my daughter. Our whole family had an amazing time. Thank you so much for making it a memorable and enjoyable party.
Restaurant: HYdeout By Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur

Author: Mahima A
Title: Excellent
Review:
Great food... 
Great taste.......
Went for my husband's birthday party. 
Food was really awesome. 
Roti, swarma, specially the salads.

Author: Ros TDevizes, United Kingdom
Title: Midday Drinks at Bar
Review: Sat in the bar for a midday drink after walking around little India. The bar had a colonial feel with dark furniture and big ceiling fans and lots of detail about the history of the place in frames on the walls. We were the only ones in the bar but the cafe was getting busy when we left. Worth a visit.

Author: Liana L
Title: Durian puff
Review:
Already try their durian puff, its really really delicious.
Don't miss it !!  
One is never enough, must try it !!

Author: landseairmudWorld
Title: Fuss Free & Straightforward
Review: Service is not too intrusive, very serene ambience and good to have conversations. Menu quite extensive and had a good variety of options. Taste of food was basic(as the title suggests straightforward) flavour was not complicated. Had the beef brisket sandwich, tender beef but not as flavorful. Nasi Lemuni, well nothing to shout about, it is what it is. The laksa however was special and had a unique taste.

Author: FalsaqriMuscat, Oman
Title: Awesome view
Review: This Chilli's is on the third floor of KLCC Surria shopping center and facing the fountains. It has an awesome view if you are lucky to be seated near the windows. The service was great. We were told that the wait was 40 minutes but luckily we were called 20 minutes later. All the waiters were cheerful and helpful. The food was a normal Chilli's style but it was good and tasty. Pleasant place to hang out

Author: FreeNEasyTravellerKL
Title: Dim sum - disappointed
Review: Service was good but unfortunately was disappointed in the dim sum. Not only the taste is not up to standard, the quality is not value for money. Preferred Sheraton Imperial's halal dim sum. We tried seven different types of dim sum, only one was good.

Author: AlexKwan118
Title: Overpriced Food lol
Review: nowaday Kuala Lumpur or Malaysia as a whole is much spoiled by food choices, however some people still stick with old brand. good luck guys in the que.

Author: BalackudaSingapore, Singapore
Title: This review is for the outlet at AEON Bukit Indah
Review: Ordered the usual items that my family usually do at Nandos but this outlet was somehow and somewhat different.The staff was quite inattentive and I had to whistle out loud to get their attention. Other than the food which was good and my kids' favorite dining place, I felt that the service and attentiveness of the staff, should have been better attuned to the needs of their customers.

Author: Estees234
Title: Chef and some staff
Review: Chef and some staff not wear mask in this covid period, waitress not introduce any signature dishes even you ask, she answer me they not have any signature dishes.

Author: Beingyaya
Title: best japanese food in town
Review: Best place to eat Japanese food. Also good ambience. Special thanks to Ifzan and Rohana. Keep up the good work!

Author: Harriet CToronto, Canada
Title: Nice location but.......
Review: We stumbled on this restaurant while on a walk along the waterfront & decided to give it a try. The service was indifferent at best. Food, when it finally came, was ok but there are better places to go for local food. Prices were not outrageous given the waterfront location but, again, there are better places to go. The final disappointment came when the bill arrived. We had asked when we first sat down if they accepted Visa & were assured that they did. When I pulled out my Visa card, the server then said they only took cash. Do yourself a favor & just have a drink here to enjoy the river view but go elsewhere for food.

Author: cailindeas2013Hong Kong, China
Title: Good ambience
Review: This is a popular tourist attraction and the food is adjusted accordingly. I enjoyed my meal but the portions were a bit small. My friend (male) was still hungry after eating his! The service was excellent and the waiters very friendly and smiley. The restaurant does have a nice ambience and the décor is pleasing. However I did think the music was too loud ( we sat inside).It's a nice place to chill and enjoy a glass of wine or your beverage of choice. The prices are about mid range. If you want to try authentic Mayay/Nyonya food then this is not the place to go.

Author: tink58Roma
Title: Nice!
Review: We had lunch here a couple of times and really liked the food and the service. It's clean and modern and the staff were all friendly and efficient. Loved the salads and fresh fruit juices. It's pretty popular in the evenings too.

Author: Lim L
Title: DIsappointed!!
Review: Pricey, small portions, taste was so so which not worth it price and have to made reservation before visit (or else you have to queue for atleast 30mins). Luckily the service and speed of serving is average.

Author: EvonSpencer
Title: Unpleasant & disappointing dining experience in 5 star hotel restaurant
Review: We visited yesterday’s to The Lounge for my birthday celebration, therefore my friend made reservation earlier in order to have seats with better view. We have been arranged to be seated at middle seat. We been informed that the available window seat with KL view has been reserved by other guests after we requested to switch over. But question is, we were also guests who have made reservation earlier? The answer was "they have made special request on it". Further we asked to switch over whenever there are available window seat, but we been rejected with the reason of "The Lounge is busy at the moment". On the other hand, the birthday cake was served directly while we are still having our main-course. The server don't even bother to ask to serve now or later. Moreover, this is common sense in every restaurant, not to mention is a restaurant in 5 star hotel. In addition, I truly do not understand, why is other people with birthday songs surrounded by waiters but I’m the only one who’s not entitle with the song? I understand this is not granted but while the other people is having, why am I an exception for this? Last but not least, personally think that I’m just purely unlucky to serve by waiter that’s not really happy on that day.

Author: Annick J
Title: Not what I expected
Review: Since I’ve read all the reviews on tripadvisor, my expectations where pretty high. Service and atmophere are good. But the food was a big disappointment. A had the red curry prawn. There was more oil in it than anything else. The flavour was blend. And it had 4 shrimps that had to be peeled as well. Not to mention the size of the boil. Was still hungry, and there was nothing really small to pick from the menu besides bruschetta. So I went with the mushroom bruschetta. The bread was really soft. (I mean, bruschetta?!) the mushrooms where baked well, but the sour cream didn’t do it for me. The coffee is way to bitter and the milk far to hot. If you want to make a proper latte (wich you pay for as well) please know what youre doing. The wine is good, so was the watermelon salad.

Author: Adeline T
Title: It's ok
Review:
As said, it's ok. To find a porky place with rice, pasta, bun in one place, it's ok.

I think the pasta is good.

Author: EilGagsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pathetic Food & Terrible experience
Review: In these guys simply screwed up the Birthday party of a friend . Plan was to have dinner and it ended up in one of the worst experience in KL. The place is like a highway dhaba in north India where you see 5 buses halting same time and people riding on each other to get their food, quality of food was worse than you can think of .Not recommended for sure !!

Author: Mokkey8Hong Kong, China
Title: Decent chicken rice ball
Review: There are a number of chicken rice ball restaurants in Malacca, particularly on/off Jonker Street.Didn't have a queue (unlike Chung Hwa which consistently has a long queue) so we came in here.Chicken ball rice was good but the chicken itself was okay - not as good as other establishments For this visit to Malacca, not having to queue up in the heat was way I chose Hoe Kee

Author: leong34Pulau Ubin, Singapore
Title: Poor this trip around
Review: Its been a while since i ventured to Overseas. But we made sure we booked ahead. Table for 10, and they reserved a room for us. Service was good as always at this lunch. Soup, Vegetables all done well. Char Siew was also good. However, one major disappointment was the Roasted Belly Pork this time around. Standard for this dish certainly had dropped. Other than that, i reckon it may be still worth one more try- given that this may have been a one off given it was a Monday lunch (maybe Chef was having a day off after the weekend).

Author: PaulRHolland
Title: Nice for a group meal
Review:
Took a group of 10 to experience ‘traditional’ Malaysian food, in a mall..

Service very good, great food choice and very tasty.

Author: OnielD
Title: Very local unclean place
Review: We have been enjoying local food joints, but this place a very dirty and not recommended for foreigners / visitors looking for nice reasonably priced local food

Author: KelvinL1454
Title: Awesome experience
Review: If u love to experience new fusion food this is the place you will love.What we love about this place aside from the food is the ambience and the people here are really nice and helpful.The little extra they brought to the experience was it was our anniversary and we did not expect to receive a gift.The best thing is the gifts are good gifts that are practical and useful.Everything they did was well thought through.We recommend this place highly.

Author: 1_bullshead
Title: Nice lunch, great staff
Review: Lovely restaurant, nicely laid out, unusual serving dishes(leaves and fish shapes). Staff were fantastic - described unfamiliar dishes really well.  Not as cheap as other places in Central Market but worth the extra cost.  Try the starter selection to share.

Author: tomacat1
Title: Accidental drop in
Review: So while Jalan Alor we ended up here as we were quite hungry. The restaurant looked clean and quite busy so we decided to go for it and we enjoy middle easter food. We were seated quite quickly and ordered our food. We had a mixed grill and grilled prawns. The food was served in a decent amount of time however when we did get our food the grill wasn't really that warm and the prawns were practically like warm so probably not just off the grill. The garlic and chilli sauce were very nice as was the service.

Author: 188helenawBatu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: My Birthday dinner
Review: Dined here for few occasions. Both food and service was great. Tonight dinner ended with an unpleasant approached from one of the crew.We finished our meal and with some balanced of beverage when this crew came over with 2 of his questions to us:1: have you order?I replied him; we completed our dinner.The crew replied: oh2: have you pay?I replied, not yet.The crew walked away after hearing my answer. We were shock of his behavior. Is back to basic training is require?

Author: AlanGeaB
Title: Lovely clam soup
Review: I think this place is comfort choice. The food taste quite good. I like their service. And the price quite affordable. Definitely will be back the next time I visit Penang

Author: iamonpreeyaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great taste for dinner!!
Review: We had our dinner at this place.All the dishes that we ordered were super delicious. All the pork dishes were so tender and juicy. The soup of the day cannot be left out. These dishes are recommend to have together with rice.This place is a must when you visit Georgetown.
