Author: Father_5029Penang, Malaysia
Title: Food quality and services of the restaurant
Review: Usually, the local people don't go to this restaurant. The food quality and services is no longer good taste but "Poor" as compared to those day Foh San. We paid for premium rate of pricing but served with not so good quality and taste of Dim Sum. The serving also not presentable. Most of the customers now are tourists.

Author: DK_LeechPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Cold dishes is a big "turn off"
Review: The waiter brought us to a table, wonderful view indeed overlooking the swimming pool downstairs and its charming décor with its forestry surroundingI have read the tripadvisor and I did make a repeating mistake warned by other readers not to order the food from the smooth talking waiter as most of the recommended Indon-China food was pre plan and pre cooked…But this being a posh restaurant, I ignore the warning and took whatever recommended by the waiter which later turned out to be unpleasant…The fish, prawn and other dishes were surprisingly cold…Didn’t expect this coming from a highly rated expensive restaurant..Overall the taste of the food was authentic but wasn’t hot and fresh enough to turn it into a WoW factor and of course the damage was unreasonably high.

Author: sarrono
Title: best food
Review: attended a wedding there and enjoy the food very much. very crowded. also tempt by their ala carte food when passing their normal dining zone. food portion also very generous.

Author: Nahnee
Title: Booked a room and was cancelled last minute!
Review: My friends and I made a reservation here for a Bachelorette Party. But when we arrived our private room booking was cancelled! Should have told us earlier so that we can plan our event elsewhere. RUDE!

Author: courcouAthens, Greece
Title: A great place
Review: Believe it or not, we had some of the greatest pesto spaghetti! The used a very special type of basil that has a citrus aroma, and the effect on the pasta was spectacular. Also the mojito was very good. And a last remark: the man's public toilettes were the cleanest ones I have visited for years!

Author: PinheadplanetLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Freshly cooked and delicious
Review: Kept it simple here for lunch and just had a few roti with dhal tadka and the Mrs took a martaba. It was so nice that shortly after we were ordering more food, garlic naan and brinjal aloo curry. All food was lovely and freshly prepared.

Author: JamieTanBKKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Only ok...
Review: Went there recently for dinner. The overall decor around the place is good. Everything is beautiful and comfortable, the staffs are all friendly and attentive. However, I have had better North Indian cuisine elsewhere. The foods are not bad, but it doesn't really stand out to me. Oh, and it is a bit hard to find decent parking during dinner time, so you have to be early to park inside the restaurant's compound.

Author: peter cOttawa, Canada
Title: Best steak in town
Review: A very simple place that delivers outstanding steaks at a very reasonable price. The steak and other samplings are well worth a visit. Expats frequent this spot and it is very family friendly. You need to order some satay and oxtail soup as starters. Order the filet, the most commonly ordered, steak with pepper sauce. Ask for it medium. You will not be disappointed.

Author: HannaJ295London, United Kingdom
Title: Great views in an average buffet restaurant
Review: I booked this as a special treat as it is rather pricey. I think it's worth booking for a one off experience but I wouldn't do it again. The views from the revolving floor are great, but you only really need to go to the observation deck for that. There was a wide range of food and some of it was ok, but generally it was an average buffer dinner. The desserts all tasted the same to me. So I didn't push myself to eat more and left early so I didn't have a big queue for the lifts down. I would recommend organising a taxi for pick-up prior because I had to get a metered taxi home which was double the price from my taxi there.

Author: komburongo
Title: First time visit
Review: Well, the place is amazing because i was fascinated with the kl views. It was very relax and some kind of good feeling when you took a bite of your first food. And i enjoyed the food. I only had problem when i tried my debit card it was not went through and they having line problem and it was at night. Hustle needs to go down and escorted by staff. Service of staff was a bit slow...it was cost me about rm999.... And i got to served myself for this hustle......anyway i have another incoming celeb in there this coming dec 2016...let us see......how!!!

Author: xy_0811
Title: not same as reviewer said
Review:
-corkcoach available
-hard to find parking for big car 
-very expensive that NOT RECOMMENDED for budget trip tourists.
-every sushi had wasabi inside, which not my flavour. but, the rice set was nice!

Author: Mic W
Title: Not up to par
Review: Had high hopes for this place as we were walking by. Unfortunately disappointing. Perhaps it was over CNY, but our food came out one by one in 15 to 20 min intervals. Had the cheese prawn meehun, the black pepper crab and chicken stock frog legs. The overarching theme is overcooked. The prawns in the cheese sauce was dry. The sauce was ok. The crab was very disappointing. The black pepper flavour was not evident. The sauce was very sweet. And the crab was overcooked and dry, even though it was live. Wouldn't go again.

Author: jolyeneSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed with overdone steak
Review: I was recommended to Prime - said to have the best steak in KL. We ordered the prime ribs wagyu that was on the menu for RM630+ per kg. Ordered medium rare, when it came, only 2 slices were medium rare, and towards the middle, the slices were slightly at the rare side. We told the wait staff to refire it for a few seconds. What came back was a well done steak. Very disappointed as the slices are now tough, chewy and dry. Waitress offered free coffee or tea for the 'disappointment'. We asked for the manager and feedback. Manager gave us a 10% off. Will I go back again? Maybe not.

Author: Mandype30
Title: Dinner
Review: Excellent night. Lovely staff. Thanks Mandy and Fe....😊 Impromptu singing and dancing with lovely freshly cooked food!!

Author: hismenteaKuching
Title: I had high hopes because of it's reputation but...
Review: Well, I guess I now know why someone came up with the phrase 'Don't hold your breath'.The service was just okay. To say that it was super fantastic, then no, I'm sorry, but it wasn't.I liked the whole dark atmosphere, because it felt cosy. The only problem, for me, was that it was just way too crowded. No, not with people; it was crowded with, literally, junk. The place is already small enough; did they have to make it even worse by filling the place up with junk?I went with my family and friends, and our food took about forever and a day to arrive, and when it did, it was terribly disappointing. My lamb shank looked about the same size as my (then) skinny kitten's leg. I thought that maybe mine was the only small one, but it wasn't; my dad's and my friend's had skinny lamb shanks, too. I've had lamb elsewhere, and theirs were so much bigger, and so much more tender. The one in The Junk, though, was just so... blah. My mum's risotto looked so yummy, but tasted weird. My sister's dish, though, was humongous. What, fisherman's friend? Something like that. Anyway, I thought that it was worth the price, until I realised that it was only just topped with seafood, on top of a mountain of french fries, like sprinkles. When I realised that, I wanted to laugh, so loud, but I controlled myself. Needless to say, I don't think the food was worth it at all. Based on the prices, I expected it to, at least, taste good, but it didn't. If you're going to serve food like this, at least price it UNDER RM20, because that's all it's worth.And did I mention I hate the surroundings? The placement of JUNK throughout the place? Yeah, the place is called Junk, but you don't literally have to live up to the name and make it hard for everyone to find their footing when they walk around. Horrible!NOTE : One last thing; I know this only happened to me, but bear in mind that this could also happen to you.I had an iPod Touch, and I brought it with me to dinner here. After dinner, I accidentally left it at the table. I came back within five minute of leaving the place, when I realised that I'd misplaced my iPod. When I went back to my table, I talked to this one waiter, and asked him if he saw my iPod. He said that he didn't, and that he was the one who cleared the table. He looked extremely nervous, was fidgety, and was making a huge show that he didn't see it. He started pulling out chairs, looking under place mats, and almost got down to his knees to prove that it wasn't there. If the lighting had been better, I knew he'd have been sweating bullets. He even told me to search the trash can, because that's where HE threw whatever from the table when he cleaned up, and not long after he said that, he ran away from me as fast as he could. I can read people very well, and I tend to notice facial tics. The waiter? Guilty and nervous, he was trying to hide something. He tried to mislead me into thinking it was in one place, when, really, it was with him. I hate that, but I let him have my iPod. I can't do anything to him, so instead I'll just let the guilt literally kill him slowly, over time.Suffice to say, this place was terrible. I don't see why most everyone loves this place. It's overpriced, the food is disgusting and not even filling(even though we have to pay through our teeth for it), the employees are bloody dishonest and the place is way too littered with, I can't stress this enough, JUNK! You want a nice place to go for the evening? Don't consider going here. You're better off eating at Malay hawker stalls across river; at least their food is nice. Not to mention quite reasonably priced.

Author: KhorW43
Title: Spaghettis
Review: I with my friend candy,khai hen,khai wei,my family, ah Ken,kb , siew eng came here to order the best spaghetti in the world

Author: ambxdextrousSingapore, Singapore
Title: Getting worser
Review: I have always place Tony Roma's in high regard, be it the one in Pavillion KL or at KOMTAR JBCC. However, my latest visit was a major disappointment. My date ordered the Roma Platter, and the wings were too tangy, oily and salty for my liking. The potatoes were a bit bland. I ordered the carbonara- like pasta (forgot the original name) and I was greatly disappointed. Dripping in oil and too overwhelming. Hopefully, management look into it because you have one disappointed loyal customer right here. Luckily. my date didn't turn as salty as the dishes were!

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya food in a pub
Review: It’s a pub that serves Nyonya food. The decor is modern. There is a bar and place for live music. And the menu has all the Nyonya favourites. We had the chicken pongteh, fried snapper in sambal and kangjung belacan, finished with the cendol- which didn’t have the green bits as they had run out! They had also run out of the otak-otak, popiah and pai tee- disappointing. However, all the dishes we got were tasty enough, though portions were on the smaller side. They are very near Ramada Plaza hotel, worth a visit if you are in that part of town.

Author: caesar1956
Title: too expensive for tasteless food
Review:
we went there for lunch, ordered the supposedly special banana leaf set, the only thing we could taste in the curry was powder 
you are anytime better off eating at any other places available in bangsar
too expensive for tasteless food !!!

Author: HockLye
Title: Fun
Review: RM22 for 4 personalised cup noodles. It’s a unique gift and fun to personalise each cup with a message and ingredient. The staff are well trained, so there are full of rules and inflexible.

Author: 10dede
Title: Good chinese food
Review:
We had lunch here. We ordered vegetables, noodles, fried rice, and fish.
The vegetables and the fish were excellent.
Rice was ok, but was better in other restaurants.

Overall we enjoyed our lunch here.

Author: dbrown101272Echuca, Australia
Title: Fabulous Brunch!
Review: We went here for brunch with the kids last weekend.My wife has the huevos rancheros, which were delicious. A lovely bit of spiciness in the salsa, great guacamole, and tasty corn chips. Yummy dish.I had the Mexican inspired big breakfast, with a spicy chorizo sausage, lovely cheezy omelette, black beans and mushrooms. Really enjoyed it, and though the pricing was excellent.Coffee is really good too, it's a nicely laid out restaurant, good staff, and from the looks of the place and menu, I'll be back for dinner one of these days.

Author: Mandymaltese
Title: Uncle Don Publika
Review: This is the worst outlet that I have ever been. Meals arrived 20 minutes apart. Ordered black pepper sauce and received BBQ sauce instead with no explanation from server. With the current covid situation, the chef was not evrn wearing a mask when preparing the food.

Author: 123klnomadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing for Shangrila Standard
Review: Wanted to take my son to a nice buffet but was so dissapointing. I have had Shangrila buffet in many countries in Asia but this one was the worst. The selections were too local oriented and they did not even have Beef steak at the cutting board. Was a real pity and dissapointing. Also had stomachache in the evening and am assuming it was due to one of the oyster that went bad

Author: ralphlaurence
Title: Amazing Dinner
Review: Very good steak,Tender and juicy, i really love it!,,staff are really friendly, specially raj &Nellie,, highly recommended, we will come back

Author: SingaporeBobSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Location, Poor Service, Average Overpriced Food
Review: Visited for lunch on a hot day with 2 friends.When we arrived, no one bothered to attend to us. Had to go in and ask for a table. The waiter seemed disinterested. Tried their Jonker Fried Rice. Food was overpriced for Malacca but I guess you pay a premium for the location as it's smack in the middle of Jonker Street. Fried rice was disappointingly average and we've had better from hawker stalls. Satay was bland.The place seemed understaffed and it was rather difficult to get someone to attend to us even for the bill. Went to pay at the counter instead.We are Asians. Noticed that the unfriendly waiter seemed to be rather more enthusiastic attending to the Caucasian group beside our table. Angling for tips perhaps? I may be just being oversensitive but it would explain the different reviews on this page.It's a decently air-conditioned place in a good location for people watching (not much else really) and would be a wonderful respite if you happen to be Caucasian, accustomed to higher costs of living and want to sample possibly subpar local food in a safe and controlled sort of environment. Otherwise, my suggestion would be to go to one of the many other cafes around the area.

Author: RoadtrippersAsiaPenang, Malaysia
Title: Pretty nice Malay mixed rice and local kuih
Review: Drop by this kafe in Subang for a short meeting with my friend and to enjoy this quite popular Malay restaurant.I had my Malay mixed rice with rendang beef, potato and soya sauce egg (RM7) while we shared some local Malay kuih. My favorite are the Pulut Inti and Onde Onde and I would say the Mixed Rice is pretty tasty too.The restaurant gets good crowd but service is still good. Only issue here is parking.Overall price is ok, taste is excellent, service is fast.

Author: car0le3
Title: Brilliant food and really friendly place
Review: We visited this place three times whilst in Penang and every meal we had was excellent.  The Thai style fish was really good as was the chicken satay and the beef rendang.  The place was always busy with a great atmosphere.

Author: wiltoncardoso
Title: Not much to say
Review:
A lot of items from the menu are often not available, serving size is very small for the price.
Service is not the best: they gave our entrees before out appetizers arrived.

Author: syabilazman
Title: Great burger
Review: great place,friendly staff,best pace to have a burger..dont miss the live music show..Overall its a great experience for me

Author: liewz2021
Title: Family dinner (omakase)
Review: Excellent food and services provided. Definitely will recommend to my friends and would like come back again. Especially great staff from Mr. Fai that providing marvellous service, suggestion and sharing his precious guidance at eating omakase. Really appreciate it .

Author: Pereppo
Title: Nice historic stop
Review: A nice place to stop for a drink or some food in the middle of Jonker Street. Food is not the best in town but it is ok and price is fairly low. Free wi fi, although with slow connection.

Author: jermpins
Title: Nice terrace, food was average
Review: The restaurant has a very pretty terrace. Food was average. We were only allowed the breakfast menu as they were hosting a wedding luncheon. Coffee was not acceptable.

Author: PER468Perth, Australia
Title: Waste of space
Review: Perhaps old style restaurant (>30 years I think)Perhaps old style doesn't provide good service (I don't think so)Perhaps old style food are so oilyPerhaps old style you don't necessary get what you orderedPerhaps old style the waiter/ waitress are not willingly to serve customer (ignorance even they could walk pass you without even "entertain" customer when requestedPerhaps they are just way too old, although it's location (in KL golden triangle area), although they restaurant are quite spaciousI think this restaurant is totally waste of space, since the operator has no interest to provide good food and hospitality at allI suggest to close it down so let other utilize the space for better reason ... Sorry for the harsh comment, I made this comment after few visits, just to be sure ...

Author: evamandyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated and pricey
Review: I did not like the chicken and beans sprout served here. Chicken and sauce are oily. A plate of chicken for 2 cost you RM21. Bean sprout isn't that great. Not plump and juicy as claimed. I think Ipoh Chicken Rice restaurant serve far better bean sprout and chicken for half the price they charge here. Only the rice was good. Very soft and wet.Not recommended the hassle

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not the best nyonya food in Melaka
Review: This is a nyonya restaurant which we decided to visit out of convenience. We ordered food for our group of 7. Some of the food we ordered include otak-otak, chicken buah keluak, chap chai, fried fish with chili (Ikan goreng chili garam), asam prawns, cuttlefish in sambal petai, fishball soup & kacang botol stir fried with chili. Generally the food was only satisfactory. The best dish was the fried fish in chili & the otak-otak. Acceptable nyonya food but there are better ones out there.

Author: GoPlaces823482
Title: Warm Only
Review: Ordered their Tofu Bakar w/Dried Squid and their Mee Rebus. Very disappointed because the food come not hot but luke-warm. The Tofu is warm only as if it was fried long ago and put in the microwave to heat up when ordered. The Mee Rebus gravy is warm only, not even hot. The staff did bring it back to the kitchen and heat it up on our request. Otherwise it will not be palatable.

Author: Ericlai87
Title: Nice food
Review: The food here is nice and the portion are just right. The only things is parking here are limited. Better to grab here.

Author: nadeeyamnorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great experienced with The Grand Getaway ❤️
Review: The great opportunity won’t come many times. The decision to try out The Grand Getaway definitely worth it. Flying virtually to 5 cities while enjoying all the delicious meals just made our day. We wish to come again to enjoy the moment with our children .
Restaurant: The Grand Getaway by Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur

Author: FoodiefromKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: ARROGANT STAFF & POOR QUALITY SEAFOOD
Review: I went back there for a meal last night with family and friends after a few months. I had called four days earlier to book a table in the air-con room. When i reached there, there had mess up my reservation and I was asked to sit outside. I pointed out to the captain that there was still so many empty tables in the air-con and 2 tables remain empty through the night. I told the captain I had been a regular customer for years and if they messed up my reservation, they should rectify it.The captain was total unapologetic and she said if I don't like it, I can leave. Since I'm entertaining friends, I decided to stay. The quality of the food that night had gone down tremendously compare to the years I had dine there. Even the portion is smaller. However the costly price maintains.

Author: Aarchi
Title: 0 response
Review: Staff had not reaponse on any enquires. After waiting for 10 minutes had to leave the place... place is quite noisy

Author: Steve HUnited Kingdom
Title: Not a pleasant dining experience!!!
Review: Invited by a good friend to have dinner at Thirty8, an express lift rapidly takes you to the restaurant and you see an attractive circular bar overlooking the Twin towers that at night are magnificent. Sadly we did not have a table with a view of the Towers but sat next to a busy open kitchen. The restaurant occupies 75 % of the floor on 3 sides of which only one side has the Twin Tower view and it is brilliant. Anyway, we we're put on a table about 2 metres from A very noisy kitchen and handed menus which offered both Asian & Western options, we selected our food & wine then the live band started singing, they were located next to the bar so that only one section of the restaurant could see & hear them properly we had an annoying muffled sound plus the banging of the kitchen which ended up being a major distraction. Then the lights started dimming and then got brighter this carried on for most of the night as though they were trying to please 2 different tables why???. The starters arrived, our friend said that some special bread was missing, the waiter was not sure and after a few moments a senior waiter advised us that the starter was complete. No look at the menu!! After 10 mins, the guy who had taken our orders arrived with the bread, we were right but no apology. the food was ok, nothing special. The main course was served, all 3 of us had steaks of different types etc, I asked for a peppercorn source and had to question if this was the right source, they insisted it was but it was awful. The deserts were excellent , wine ok but although the restaurant was very busy there is no excuse for the poor service which continued, a lot of waiters rushing around but what appeared to be the senior staff in jackets disappeared for long periods and then suddenly 3 or 4 would turn up like London buses. At the end of our meal we were able to get a table with a twin Tower view and had after dinner drinks, again service was patchy at best. Overall a very poor experience from a top hotel, I have enjoyed much better in their Sinagpore & Dubai, for the price this is not a restaurant that I would recommend, it is like eating in a noisy cafeteria. On a good note the live band were actually very good once we were sitting in that area and of course the view was spectacular but I would suggest that the place be avoided until they have a rethink on the layout & offering, sadly not a great night but our friend says the Sunday brunch is well worth a visit, not sure I want to risk it!!!.

Author: RWWDevonDevon, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing
Review: We cancelled our booking at another restaurant as Marinis was so highly recommended. This was a very poor decision on our part. We are very accustomed to dining at top restaurants across the world and we enjoy Italian cuisine and therefore expected to greatly enjoy what we were led to believe was 'fine dining'. We wished to dine at 7pm and accepted without quibble the information that we would have to spend a minimum of R 600 ( about £124.00) .Let's start with the positive aspects: the welcome at the ground floor where our names were checked against the booking, was warm, the view was superb, the bread , the complimentary candy floss and the dessert of tiramisu were all delicious. However, once reaching the 57th floor we were taken straight to a very smoky bar, where we recoiled and asked if we could go straight to our table. At this point we were told quite abruptly that we needed to make a reservation if we wished to dine! Quite what happened between the ground floor and the 57th, we did not know - but they seemed to rediscover us and we were permitted to enter. Our table , as requested, was by the window and our waiter, Rosie, was delightful.we both ordered scallops, followed by main courses of pasta with butter sauce and black truffles and a risotto with a beef consommé base and decorated with gold leaf! We began with warm bread and butter plus olive oil and balsamic dip. The butter tasted rancid and this was removed and replaced with two small foil packets of fresh butter. The scallops arrived and it was explained that they had been cooked 'medium'. If this means transparent and raw, then I do not wish to repeat the experience. When asked by the waiter if I was enjoying the dish, I said that it was just not cooked to my taste but that I was looking forward to the risotto. Unfortunately the creamy, delicate flavours I would have expected from a good risotto, were totally overpowered by the strong taste of beef consommé and I am at a loss as to what was added to the dish by the gold leaf. I ate half of it, with difficulty. The pasta apparently tasted good but the large quantity of melted butter left in the bowl was quite alarming. Again, we quietly and courteously shared our reactions with our waiter. From him we discovered that the chef was a 'stand in', which probably explained a great deal and maybe why the restaurant was not full. We were able to enjoy our desserts , which was a great relief as we were celebrating a birthday and things had not gone quite how we had anticipated. When we asked for the bill we were a little surprised that, despite the disappointment we had expressed, the manager felt justified in charging us the full bill of R965. (£ 190 approx). We were even more surprised by his apparent total lack of interest in our experience. Wanting not to ruin our evening by becoming angry , we went on our way but salt was rubbed into our wounds by the next 'greeter', a young woman, who was very surprised at our answer to her 'have you had a good evening?' And laughed at the fact that we felt disappointed - which did nothing for our humour at this point. On reflection, it is very possible that this was an indication of her embarrassment, but at that moment it just did not feel like an appropriate response. On our way out on the ground floor, we met our first warm 'greeter' again and we explained to her why we were disappointed. She took us seriously! At her request we completed a written comments form, again noting what had gone well and what could be improved. We were so grateful to be listened to! We returned with relief to our delightful hotel next door, the Mandarin Oriental - where we had dined superbly yesterday evening for far less. PS As I was finishing this report, I received a telephone call from the Restaurant Operations Manager for Marinis on 57, closely followed by an email. He has made a full and handsome apology for our poor dining experience and has asked us to return tomorrow evening to allow them to 'put things right'. We really appreciate his response and offer, but , with regret, we feel unable to accept it, preferring to have our final meal in KL at somewhere in which we have total confidence. However, we are very grateful to him for caring about our feelings, especially as he was not on duty and had no responsibility for all that went wrong. Thank you ,Peter.

Author: lighthandSingapore
Title: Over-leveraged on their history
Review: Tried this restaurant after recommendation from local guilds. However was very disappointed. The food was over-priced, and the drinks even more so. I still could not get over the fact that they change you for the sambal chili (that's just rude for a Nyonya restaurant).We had the bua kuluak, kang kong, meat ball soup, fried chicken and sambal fish.The bua kuluak was average and the meat ball soup was fine.The star of the night was surprisingly the fried chicken, it was well marinated and fried just right that it's crispy yet retain the juiciness.Biggest flop was the sambal fish. The sambal was weak and the fish have the aftertaste of mud.Service was poor as well (though maybe it's cause it was full house). It took a more than 10mins to get initial service to take our order. Also you get the feeling that they want you to clear off as fast as possible.

Author: Shnarajad_95
Title: Make us come back all times!
Review: Food was great. Service fantastic ! We love it make us always to come back here have a good time with family and friends

Author: karenoS7951WAIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Tourist trap
Review: The place was awesome once upon a time, note the word 'was' and 'once upon a time' . Poor service, the quality of food had dropped significantly over the years. Locals who know their food won't bring their friends here other than it is convenient location near to local souvenir shop.

Author: arulagKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: high luxury eatery with low satisfying feel
Review: decided to go here for some chineese food with our japaneese client...1st hand being there was asked waiting for sometime although reservation already made...that itself a put off...went in and the tables are rather not occupied ...really have no idea for keeping us waiting...sitted and request few times for the waiter to take order ...it repeated the whole lunch session calling the waiter who looks busy in a empty restaurant...weird and lost at my idea of waiting...food only the dimsum and beijing duck was good but the rest is bad...the pricing is sky high...totally dissapointed...

Author: DerekH2189Singapore
Title: Terrible food, totally cheated
Review: Seemed a very promising place but Guess I was wrong, never judge a book by its cover and this case, the restaurant by the pictures of the food in the menu. Pasted around the restaurant is recommendation by Trip Advisor. Alas, surely, something went wrong somewhere.I came hungry and tired and just wanted to give this place a try because Thong Seng Restaurant was closed. Ordered the signature dishes, cheese bee hoon and fried pork belly. Terrible terrible mistake. The cheese bee hoon was so so. The pork belly was cold! Surely pre-fried and stored for a long time before being reheated and poured with the sauce before serving to us. The oil from the deep fried pork belly tasted horrible. The salted egg sotong was the ‘bomb’! We were like biting into rubber! Goodness. Never ever have I tasted such badly prepared sotong. The service was so so. When I asked the waitress why is the food so bad, she just ignored me and quickly and conveniently busied herself with other customers, totally ignoring me and avoiding coming too near to our table. Give this place a chance. No way. Please do not visit this place. The experience seriously affected my mood.

Author: LaiWFMoscow, Russia
Title: Decent but premium price
Review: Was here for a meeting, 3 person lunch buffet damage was around RM270++.The food variety was average and so is the selections.But in terms of ambiance and environment for a meeting , I would say it's good as it's not crowded and rather quiet.

Author: MJEffendi
Title: The Best Halal Italian Food in Town
Review: They substitute every non-halal ingredients with modification of halal ingredient without compromising the real italian taste. For Italian lover, this place should be in your "must-go" list.

Author: Eddie RDallas, Texas
Title: Don't waste your time and money
Review: What can you say about this place. I know this place is an icon with amazing views. However, the food, which is a buffet is subpar. For about $50 a person plus another $10 if you want to sit by the window this place should be avoided. Pay your fee to go to the observation deck but don't waste your money on this outdated restaurant. Along with the cheesy band playing, avoid his place like the plague. The two stars are for the views and the deserts.

Author: KA1961Calgary, Canada
Title: Good eats
Review: Ambience is great both inside and outside. Local choice are not enough. International selection is good. Prices are reasonable

Author: muppet911Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Lack of attention from staff lets this place down
Review: Went on a Sunday lunchtime for fathers day. First time at this outlet and wasn't expecting too much as this a 'generic' restaurant as far as I'm concerned. Food was surprisingly tasty, apart from chili fries - far far too salty. Only tried a selection of starters but all were good. The big thing that lets the place down is lack of attention from staff. We were led to a table and then abandoned and had to try too hard to get a waiter/waitress to attend. The waitress was also very very slow and didn't seem to know what was happening! In addition, I feel the beer is extremely overpriced - 50% more than say J&R Bottle and Boar in SS15, and that was Socials happy hour price. The wine (house wine) is acceptable at the happy hour price for a bottle (RM100). Although having said that I believe reading other reviews that prior to the GST elimination it was RM95! So if that is true then shame on Social for trying to con us. Overall I would say give it a try but like me, I'm sure you won't be in a hurry to rush back, which is a shame because that's why these places often end up closing after 12/15 months.

Author: XimeyJuanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very nice!!
Review: We went at lunch time, however I had heard they had very good breakfasts so I chose the benedict eggs and they were stunning.My husband decided to order the lamb hamburger, it was ok but nothing to rave about. So I recommend always choosing breakfast dishes, they are really forceful and do not leave without try any coffee!!The service was very nice and average prices.

Author: LL721
Title: Delicious lunch
Review: We were here for a weekday lunch. We managed to get a table without waiting long. The steak with pasta, breakfast and French toast were really nice. Service was fast too. Nice atmosphere.

Author: Worth W
Title: Name sums it up
Review: I had a very pleasant light evening meal here - pizza and a couple of Carlsberg draft beers, which is pretty much the standard weak lager for Malaysia. Pizza was nothing special and the service was slow, but it was still a great place to chill and hang out and enjoy the view without a lot of hustle and bustle.

Author: Lizkeith68
Title: Ok for a quick drink
Review: Stopped by on our way to Jonker street market, there was live music and a buzz to the place, prices about average for the area, didn't really give us a reason to return.

Author: Fiona091
Title: Great food, casual atmosphere
Review: Dined at Tek Sen, had a short wait. Service was quick and efficient. Never felt staff were rushing to turn over the table. Food was very tasty and reasonably priced. Pork dishes to be recommended. Hope to visit again soon.

Author: 445arih
Title: Very good food and feeling
Review: Good service as Bar side as grill side. Food portions area Very big and good. If you want to sit around other people do it in the, but if you want to eat in quite do it in the grill.  Good selection of whiskies

Author: Mary ZBerlin, Germany
Title: Amazing food for a great value!
Review: We ordered Banana Leaf.The food was amazing and a lot to close a hungry stomach. You get 3 veggies with it and 2 different curry-sauces. The price is really cheap and the restaurant seems to be very clean. Just for the food I would give 5 stars, but since the service is just average...Recommendation: Try Banana leaf and add mutton masala...

Author: Charlotte WBarcelona, Spain
Title: Bad food
Review: Staff were nice enough we ordered spaghetti Bolognese which was ok. Garlic bread and chicken pesto pasta food was quick heard the microwave a few times! Chicken was awful chewy and a grey colour ate it without the chicken as was very hungry and didn't want to make a fuss. Service charge was added to the bill of 10% which in England is optional, we did not want to pay as I was unhappy with my meal. Asked if we had to pay and was told yes you do and laughed! Would never visit here again.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: interesting pancakes...
Review: We ate at their sister restaurant located upstairs called Wicked Pancake Parlour. If not mistaken they share the menu. Simple open airy cafe with a small kids corner. Service is a hit & miss. Forgetting orders, slow at times & hard to get their attention. Expect to wait during peak hours as it does get crowded.They are famous for pancakes so that is what we had. Tried the apom terbalik, chikity chinese chicken & minimalist. Overall the pancake itself was good but the toppings could be better. Bit stingy considering the price point. Apom terbalik is rather dry so be careful. We washed it all down with some coffee which I have to admit was really good. Complimentary water is given.Overall a once visit kinda place. Just to see what the fuss is about. Bit overrated if you ask me.

Author: mimiyap
Title: Mrs
Review: Was there with friends for buffet dinner . My second visit for this month . Good spread of delicious food . Would like to compliment floor staff , Hafizi , for his friendly & attentive service .

Author: bluexippoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service at lowest level
Review: Went there with my wife and 1+ year old son. 1. Queue for nearly one hour during peak time (acceptable)2. Wait for dish to come for nearly another 40 minutes3. No staff including the manager has no intention to ask why my table still empty4. When i ask the status, they said system problem and my order did not get through5 But I think there is no problem with the system..it was actually human error (they lied to customer)6 And their biggest mistake was..i did not hear any 'Sorry' word from any of their stuff (including the manager)Maybe I was the only one who is unforunate today but I hope they can improve this.FromSushi Maniac

Author: jujuong07
Title: Perfect
Review:
Nice quiet ambience, great delicious food. A great place to enjoy the great company.
Can try and see
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: QueenB1011
Title: The worst bar/service at Nexus. Food, horrible.
Review: This is my second visit but I decided that write a review. Your bar, your service and your staff sucks BIG TIME. I was there yesterday at 7pm, you had your 5 glasses of rose wine promo with 8canape, we decided to go for that, only to be told by a stupid male server that the it is no longer available and it's only while stock last. I was there at 7pm sharp, like wtf ?! Did not make a fuss, we ordered whiskey and beer, and the same server, didn't bother telling us about the happy hour where your whiskeys were at 15 instead of 22. We also ordered your bbq pizza, you need a new damn chef. A child whose learning how to cook can do better. I am never stepping foot in this place. OMG. Horrible experience.

Author: dac546Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the price
Review: This restaurant is located opposite Tesco , in Wisma sp Setia . The food is mostly pre-cooked and served out fast. For 2 Pax, rice plus 3 dishes , plus 2 drinks, sets you back for RM 130-140 incl GST. Fine dining price with disappointingly tasting food . The name is spice - but you won't taste the authentic Indian spices . Even the chicken tikka / masala tasted like pre heated dish . Not worth the price - trust me , you will be disappointed - unless they change their food quality .Hard earned money conned. Enough said.

Author: Kapsicurean
Title: Local fare but very basic!
Review: Getting there taking the sampan ferry from across the Hilton was more interesting than the meal. No alcohol.

Author: Kenix LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service not up to standard
Review: This was my first fine dining experience. Came here after reading Nobu's write up in the newspaper. Food was not bad, we all quite like it but the whole experience was totally spoiled by the service of the floor staffs. I don't mind being served by foreign staffs but we didn't see attentiveness in their service. It was like they did not bother, or happy to work in this place. Can the management do something about this? My friend who is well travelled and dined felt ashamed having this kind of service standard in Malaysia..

Author: FibblesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Novelty experience for first-timers
Review: Experiential dining, service was attentive, food was OK, price was a bit on the high side. You can't choose the food as there is only one menu, everything is fixed and it's a surprise, hence "dining in the dark". You just have to inform the restaurant beforehand if you're allergic to any food. It was my grave mistake not telling them I do not eat raw meat. They served raw salmon that day.Interesting concept although not for Nyctophobia, the elderly or children.

Author: TrickyDickie72
Title: Very dissatisfying visit to this cafe
Review:
Very dissatisfying visit to this cafe, service was not very good, flavour was very bland, one dish was inedible. I’m sure that this is not the norm but there so many other places to eat in the mall. 
Would not return 😡

Author: ranjans586
Title: Awesome experience
Review: Wow what an experience from starting to the end, dim lights, good introduction, humble waits and first class service and awesome food.

Author: mai0remKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Brunch, Great Service
Review: I've been coming here for years, and each time the food is great with new additions, and the service is superb as always. Our server this time is Jayson, and he's quite informative about paella when my friends and I asked him about the mountain paella dish.

Author: CalvinChan1
Title: Oily Based Stock of Curry added to Claypot of Small Fish Head over Gas fire .
Review: Yes , just like everyone that read the past reviews would think that it is good value . Hold it there ! Visited this place recently around 11am and there was this Outlet steaming hot even with the overhead fans @ medium speed and wall hung fans which is circulating hot air trap inside this premise. We waited at the roadside pavement,queues already for 5 tables & joining me in the queue was a newly arrived pair of couple. Heard them muttered " Hmm , so long wait better go another place ". I turn around and said to them , its should not be long since you re here for the first time like myself since you are. When our turn came after 30 mins ,the young chef with bearded face look gestured to us and ask what we would like ... Fish Head or Fish Tail ?I ordered a large portion and he proceeded to prepare 2 half of the Fish head ..... added lady fingers ,tow kee with two scoops of prepared curry base stock and put it onto the fire .Some earlier diners finish and was paying up and the chef directed us to avaliable table.Minium apa ? As the lady assistant in hot pant leggings brought the cutlery and fresh cut chilli.We wait another 10 min before the Claypot Fish head was plonked onto the table .Another man with six plates of rice was going round the premise asking how many plates we wanted ....we politely requested 2 rice and and empty plate since there were 3 of us .Tried to skimmed off the red chilly oil floating in the claypot ...as we were digging into the fish , we realise that the fish head is generally much smaller than the standard one you will find in other places .Wow , now we know why some other diners is slurping off from individually prepared claypot .Being foodies ,our verdict after eating here will skip this place in search of Better Fish head outlet

Author: 1361977sk
Title:
Irish pub
Healy Macs
Review:
Best food, drinks and service.
Really good service from staff especially from PRITY.
Gonna come back again definitely and recommend this place to everyone else

Author: juihongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Old school nyonya
Review: The old world decor really wow me at this nyonya restaurant. It's incredibly old school and brings back memories of yesteryears. Nyonya food can be challenging to find in KL, as there is always better in Penang or Melaka but Limapulo (which stands for 50, as the address of the joint) delivers. A nice place to satiate your taste for sambal fish and cendol.

Author: dimsum088Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't border
Review: Don't bother going there. We were there for lunch and despite ordering the RM380 omakase menu, the food was lousy and the service was not up to par. The waiter got our special requests wrong as one of my guests had asked for no raw fish and 3 of them asked for no beef. The food came, and instead they served us 3 sets of special orders with no raw fish and no beef while only one guest asked for no raw fish. The signature cod fish was a big let down as it was dry and hard. It's nothing like the one in Nobu London or Silk Road on Crystal Cruise. The sizzling beef was way overcooked despite my request for medium rare. The wine was another big let down. We ordered a bottle of Cloudy Bay sauvignon blanc which is pretty standard and guess what? We had to send back the bottle and get our glasses changed because there were traces of 'oil' or 'grease' in our glasses. Worst still, we can see finger prints and dirt on the glasses! Though the lady 'manager' obliged and replaced a new bottle for us but my friend told me that she gave us a real funny look behind our back. It's really very unprofessional. This was my second visit to Nobu KL and I don't think I will ever go back there again.

Author: MohamednuhHalifax, United Kingdom
Title: Seriously just avoid!
Review: Ok so to summarise the experience, their English is so bad that simple questions about the menu become such huge tasks. They try to upsell at every instance and the food on the best of days is pretty average!Sorry but there are too many better places around!

Author: RutheranS1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor French pretenders
Review: I found this to be an arty joint probably patronised by people who felt an urge to be there to be seen as intelligent and insightful. It was humid and with 1 air conditioner running. A waitress who tried hard to maintain a French persona and a touch of French humour.Dishes that do not do justice to the depth of tradition in French cuisine. Desserts where that which was expected to be warm was served cold. It is not a place I would commend to anyone seeking fine cuisine.

Author: thecarryonlifeDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Don't waste your money on the restaurant
Review: The food is a disaster, the view is nice and the band was good. However, for the price you pay per person, absolutely not worth it. Get the top access if you insist, look at the view and go eat somewhere else. The buffet was too narrow you couldn't get by. The restaurant was more on the empty side yet we still struggled at the buffet. The food was really bad, it overshadowed the view and the band. Shame.

Author: Anders W
Title: Excellent service, good food!
Review: Quite enjoyed this little place along the mainroad. Very friendly attentive personnel and tasty food. Good prices.

Author: W3616OTchristianb
Title: Surprisingly Good!
Review: Surprising because this is not at all the first time I have eaten here. It's one of those places I go to often, but never thought was good enough to mention (or bad enough to warn people about) until their recent menu change. Tacos have become a very well balanced mix of rich, creamy and spicy pickle, the mains seem less starchy and altogether everything has a freshness it didn't have before. It still isn't haute cuisine, but then it doesn't pretend to be either. Definitely worth checking out.

Author: rachellwySeminyak, Indonesia
Title: The Poh Piah worth the visit
Review: As the name of the shop suggests, the signature dish of course is their Poh Piah. I don't usually eat Poh Piah in Singapore but the Poh Piah here is delicious!! Went back twice in two days for the Poh Piah. Tried other dishes tkk - rojak, nyonya laksa and bachormee too. Not bad but not the best I've eaten either.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Good duck...
Review: Always a good place to have lunch if you are in the mid valley mall area.Now they have a set lunch for rm18.90++...which includes soup, main course, dessert and a herbal tea...So not badThe roast duck is as juicy as when we last came ...So standard has maintained.Go give it a try...It's not just a duck restaurant, they have other dishes too....It serves pork...

Author: fongh881
Title: Only cendol
Review:
Practically everything else is bad, too salty . Wait time is horrendous, i dont know what is going on in the kitchen. Had to forego a dish due to the wait time. 

Only the cendol was slightly above average i give them that atleast.

Author: JeremyTan9Penang
Title: Good food, but let down by appalingly poor service
Review: Have been a regular visitor of their Penang outlet at G Hotel / Gurney Plaza, and overall, my experiences can be summed up by the title above.The food, for me, is great. No complaints so far. However, it's a totally different story when it comes to service, and my visits are often let down by poor service from waiters that could use a lot more training.It seems that this outlet in particular, has strict policies about seating at certain times of day. Simply put, you're not allowed to sit at certain sections at certain times. Now, as someone who pays good money to eat at a restaurant, shouldn't choice of seating be a basic privilege? Obviously not.In my latest visit, at 3pm in the afternoon, I was told that the entire air-conditioned section was closed. And that I had to make do with the outdoor area, which was baking hot with the afternoon sun and heat. If that wasn't bad enough, I spotted a Caucasian couple happily seating in the air-conditioned area, browsing the menu. The excuse given by a waiter, was that they arrived earlier so they were allowed to sit there.Common sense dictates that when people are still looking through a menu, they wouldn't have been there that much earlier. Seems more like a double standards policy that white-skinned tourists get special privileges.And to top it off, when paying my bill, I was told that the cash register was out of order, and they had to manually write the bill.Running through the prices, I noticed that one dish was overpriced by RM10. The waiter insisted it was the correct price, until I demanded to see the menu and indeed, that price was wrong. He sheepishly apologized, but I couldn't help but feel that the staff had tried to take advantage of the situation and make a quick buck for themselves.The only reason I would still consider going to this place is because I love Italian food, and at this mall, it's about the only decent option.

Author: clui888Hong Kong, China
Title: Very good meal, service and beautiful scenic view
Review: I and my husband tried their dinner meal 27 Feb 15, they delivered very good dishes especially the fresh shrimp, nice vegetable salad & lovely dessert. We enjoyed very much for the beautiful sunset with white wine. The most remarkable is the surprised birthday cake. Must come again for our next visit to Langkawi.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: teawithcay
Title: Great food great service
Review:
Awesome briyani rice we had with cheese naan but the butter masala chicken is sweet for our liking. 
The apam sri lanka set is awesome ans crunchy! 
Love overall food here and service is great

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Overpriced nasi lemak and poor service
Review: Overpriced nasi lemak and poor service. Nasi lemak quality worse than general eateries. Might be better to eat at the food courts or coffee shops.

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: HOMST did not deliver
Review: Homst Chinese Muslim restaurant boasts of chinese cooking but at our latest visit, we barely detected the chinese in the food we ordered.Malaysian yes but chinese?Let's start with radish cake. Traditionally fried like char kway teow, this one came in chilied cubes on a bed of beansprouts. Nothing like the one you get in a genuine chinese restaurant like Dodo for example.Next is the sizzling taufu: when served the sizzle had gone and we beheld a large pan of spicy sauce where egg and taufu were swimming in. The taufu was sparsely spread, giving the impression there was not enough to go around in a crowded restaurant.But it was the taste that made us conclude that this is more a Malaysian than chinese restaurant. Chinese cooking is distinguished by the freshness; food here looked lethargic as if the kitchen was not enthusiastic enough or perhaps the chinese chef is taking a break.And we passed up on dim sum deciding it would be better to wait for an occasion to celebrate at Chynna where one finds the best dim sum in town.One can get a decent Malaysian meal here but we wish the chinese style is not too compromised to cater to those who are not too particular. We left knowing why tourists bypass the local pizza chain as the italian pizza served is anything but.

Author: Shinzkylu
Title: Hate The Service
Review: The food is good but when it comes to the service is so slow !! The waiters service is rude and the food really take so long..

Author: THYeow
Title: Declining food quality & slow service
Review: Ben's was average to good when it first opened - it was popular, the menu had some hits; overall it was decent and a nice place on occasion.However, not so on our last visit there. Now, if you can imagine - after a hard days' work and a gym workout, just about any food would taste heavenly, right? Not so. Ben's has proven that you can be hungry enough to eat a horse (raw) and their so-called "Nachos Libre" can literally make you spit it out with a cry of "What the .... IS THIS?"Do you even know how nachos are supposed to taste like and don't give me the line of "Oh, that's our chef's interpretation of it." Please. Do not substitute your marinara sauce for salsa. It does not work at all.Easily one of the most unappetizing dishes I have had in a long time.And the food took about 30 minutes to arrive but the restaurant wasn't very full, when we arrived, most of the other diners were already partway through. We were one of the few new patrons. Had to ask twice where our order was.By the way, you should hire locals instead of foreigners who can barely speak English or Bahasa. You are in Suria KLCC for goodness sake, the flagship of Malaysian malls. Step up your game!

Author: Thomas C
Title: Fried pork (paikut) lovers will love it
Review: It is quite a long time restaurant since in the 80's. Famous with the fried pork (paikut), asam fish, chicken meat and other side dishes. Delicious!

Author: Mukesh70Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent authentic Indian food serving restaurant in Miri
Review: This restaurant is very close to Petronas office in Miri. They are serving authentic Indian food both vegetarian and non-vegetarian. You will love to eat Shahi paneer and Chana Masala in veg and Tandoori Chicken and Chicken Biryani in non-veg. Staff is very good and supportive. Even the owner is also excellent.

Author: yusufyaranIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Improved greatly !
Review: Dined on 26 Dec 2021 around 10:30 am about 10 people, sat outside . Ordered several dishes for breakfast alongside the drinks.All went well and we were positively surprised with the authenticity of these products compared the time when it was first opened on this location. Very nice.

Author: SharinaSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never again!
Review: We went as a group of colleagues for office lunch. The restaurant makes their profit from the drinks. They keep coming with drinks. The service was typical of restaurants at Suria ie bad and slow! They were quick in bringing additional drinks though. Food quality was okay. The bill turned out to be more expensive than dining at the coffee house in a five star hotel.I promised myself that I will not set food in the restaurant again. I will not spend neither my company's money nor my own money at their restaurant again.

Author: pickleinwimbledon
Title: Good vegan food
Review: Good, wholesome vegan Japanese food. Maki and hand rolls were very good. Noodle dish a little bland for my taste. Nice atmosphere and good service. Option of sitting on the floor or at tables. Freshly cooked/ prepared to order.

Author: wawaz2021
Title: ROOFTOP25
Review:
Great service, efficient communication and a really easy way to get a mortgage with lots of help and support to get the right deal.

Thank You Christina. I might spell your name wrong but I never forget your hospitality to us .

Author: glenhillsKuala Lumpur
Title: Soup in a mini "gyoza" & etc...
Review: In sixes or eights, that s how one can order the signature "siu loong pau" mini dragon bun is filled with hot delicious soup and delicate portion of lightly seasoned minced pork. Always so consistently good. The other light and easy dish that I like is the crunchy cucumber. On rare occassions we order the pumpkin in salted egg, gosh a plateful of chlosterol goodness, very tasty. My husband enjoy the noodles in clear soup. Overall ,we always come out happy after dining in Din TAi Fung.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: SantiSuliandjo
Title: Suckling Piglet
Review:
This restaurant’s food are all about pork.. their suckling piglet is very awesome.. 
The place is easy to find

Author: nami8319
Title: Just ok
Review: We came here on the weekend for dinner. Luckily we made reservation as it was extremely pack. Food is average not that great.

Author: Xorxorty
Title: Lunch
Review: Service is bad. Been seated for the last 30 mins and i do not get any service at all despite having floor staff standby at the corner.The gentleman who leads me to the table dont even greet or speak to me. It makes me wander if he could actually hear and speak.Not a place to recommend for dining.Extremely poor service!!!!

Author: mechatorakichiChicago
Title: I let my expectations get the better of me -- It was just a diner in Penang
Review: I wanted to give this place a single circle rating, but it wouldn't be fair. It wasn't bad at all. I just thought it would have excellent food. I am NOT a foodie and I wasn't expecting anything fancy, but just good quality food and it really wasn't. It is just like a greasy spoon, breakfast place or diner that you could find in any rural place in the United States or Canada. A place to get steak and eggs or a sandwich only it had Asian hawker styled food as well. It was fine, but due to it's number 1 spot on tripadvisor and all the rave reviews, I thought the food would be...better. We tried their house specialties -- some Asian, some Western. It was like food from a hawker stall in a cleaner environment. Don't get me wrong, I love hawker food. It's cheap and tasty, but it's not using high quality ingredients. Everything we had was like that. I had a rib eye...and it was the kind of rib eye you have to pour A1 sauce all over so that it has taste -- just like you'd get at a truck stop or a diner. Maybe this kind of food is a rarity in Penang, but there was nothing impressive about the food there at all. The atmosphere was pleasant. The staff were friendly and attentive (and knew most of the patrons there). I would say that the average age of the patrons on the night I went was about 68 years old. That takes into account the babies and children present to bring the average down. It was like a Denny's on a weekday -- most customers were pensioners who obviously frequented the Living Room often and loved everything about it. Living Room food was probably a nice break from the nursing home food. As I sat in the Living Room, I was wondering if the kind elderly folks there (who were obviously loving the place) could actually log on to tripadvisor to rate it themselves, or if they had their grandchildren do it for them... It would probably be a cool place to have breakfast and the food was not bad -- it could almost be described as home cooking, but I'm confident that most people are capable of making better food at home. They offered three types of beer in bottles or cans and some house wines. Needless to say, this is not the kind of place that accepts credit cards. Most dishes ranged from MYR6 to MYR30. It's a cozy place with lots of greenery and friendly staff, dedicated regular patrons (some mentioned they have been frequenting since the early 90s) and diner/hawker type food at reasonable prices. I'm not the type of person that regularly eats at fancy Michelin rated restaurants or spends any time contemplating what vintage might be good on the wine lists, but I can confidently say there is nothing gourmet about the food at Living Room and if you are looking for truly good , quality, delicious food you won't find it here.

Author: Alan HArmagh, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing meal
Review: I had a very bad experience at this restaurant. When my meal was brought to the table it was cold and had to be taken away to be reheated. We ordered soft drinks with our meal which we did not receive until we had finished our meal. Asked to speak to the manager who was not interested in my complaint and did not offer us anything in return. I will never go to this restaurant again.

Author: Imanina_31
Title: Delicious Nasi lemak
Review: Delicious nasi lemak &  spicy.Love to eat here but need to improve the cleanliness.Near to Ano Hotel and Kingwood Boutique hotel

Author: peterwu16
Title: So so only the food
Review: Not many variety of dim sum the plus point is not pricy the food I prefer fok sun . Service need to ask for Food but the foreign worker doesn't seen to care when ordered...
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Kuru276Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, awesome ambience
Review: This cafe is one cool place to hang out with friends and family. Very tastefully decorated with a variety of antiques (motorcycles, cars, paintings etc), creating the perfect ambience for a memorable and delicious gourmet adventure. The Nasi Ayam Penyet is of the best I have ever tasted. Priced at RM9.50, it's worth every ringgit spent. It comprises rice, a whole flavorful and well-marinated fried chicken leg piece complemented by a delicious sambal sauce and a generous helping of ulam. This place, I was told, is famous for its cheese banana fritters. Unfortunately, I was not lucky enough to savour it. Get there early if you would like to taste the cheese banana fritters. All other food items on the menu looked yummy too. Service is quick and the staff are very attentive too. All in all, a lovely place to hang out and enjoy a scrumptious meal.

Author: KaryllBrowneColchester, United Kingdom
Title: Strange Beer!
Review: I had bugged my partner about taking me to this venue - it looked the biscuit. Unfortunately, straight on arrival, it turned out to be disappointing. It took ages for us to get served and when the beer came, it was not Tiger draft as ordered (even though they insisted it was). They took it away and then brought back a can of Tiger! The food took a long time to come and the place was not busy. A very disappointing place to visit - my partner was not happy with the large bill either - for what was, on the whole, a poor experience. Looks nice from outside.

Author: CPM2288
Title: Good Food, Unsatisfactory Service!
Review: I had a birthday gathering over the weekend at Beta and while found the food was good and value for money we found the service to be well below standards for an establishment of this repute. Our main server (in white long sleeve shirt) throughout the meal along with the manager (assumed as she was wearing a coat) seemed to be having bad days and were more than happy to share their misery with us. The overwhelming feeling was that our requests were inconveniencing them. It seemed that even when we took pictures as we cut the cake they were in a rush to make us take them faster. Very strange. One of our fish dishes was undercooked and they were accommodating to waive the dish and offer us a free dessert of our choosing. At the end of the meal we were surprised to find that we were charged for the 'complimentary' dessert. The dessert turned out to be RM88.00 as well. If a complimentary dessert was offered, at least state any stipulations rather than deciding behind our back that we were going to be charged.Overall it was not a good experience.

Author: susie sLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Please do not pass this little gem by! Stop and have some food!
Review: My Fiance and i discovered Helana's cafe on our second day of a 10 day visit to Penang, and we went back everyday for either a drink (banana milkshake!), lunch (bacon sandwich!) or an evening meal! The food is fantastic. It is all freshly cooked and you are able to see the kitchen which is clean and well organised. On one occassion we were offered a Grouper for our evening meal and Helena took us into the kitched to show us the fish, which you could see was as fresh as she said it was.The service is second to none. Helena and her mum Theresa work so hard (as well as the man at the front of the cafe and the other lady in the kitchen). They always have time to talk to their customers no matter how busy they are, and are always so welcoming and polite.As i said at the top of this review, please do not pass Helena's by, it is a real gem, and deserves to do so well for itself. It is a fantastic cafe run by an even more fantastic family. The review is late going up as we have had no internet since December, but hopefully it proves how much we loved this place as we are taking the time to write this review a month after our holiday. Thank you Helena, Theresa and all at Helana's cafe Susie and Dave PS - mum's curry is amazing!

Author: claytonjayscott
Title: Palate cleanser - great selection
Review: I have been here twice now and happy to say that it is well worth the visit, the whisky is good and well priced, they serve it correctly (however you want it) and know what they are talking about.  I will be back

Author: Y4757ZEstever
Title: Awful
Review:
Dreadful and over priced. Happy hour  was not actually happy hour. 

Beer was watered down. No wonder no one else was there

Author: Elz_007Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A bit overpriced, but healthy food
Review: I went here for lunch and they offer a lot of vegetarian, raw and even vegan dishes. I found it a bit overpriced (we paid RM100 for 2 dishes and 2 drinks) and the taste was (especially in a country as MY that is known for its food!) a bit so so.

Author: aarontan320
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Great Service and experience. Our server Mirwan made us feel welcomed and was very attentive to what we needed. Would recommend this restaurant for celebrations and dates. Cozy ambiance. Will be back

Author: nadialum28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lost for words with the valet service
Review: The food here is good but please don't trust the 'free' valet parking. After dinner the valet just dump us the keys and expect us to find the car on our own. Walked around the entire hartamas parking lot for 45 mins to find my own car. Ended up can't find my car. What's the point of having valet service if the valet hide and seeks the car.

Author: ZashnainKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A mega disappointment
Review: 7 years ago, this restaurant served exceptional good food, be it the steak or ribs. Also flavorsome appetizers. Now it is merely a shadow of it former self. A mega disappointment. I am unhappy with the quality of beef served, the ambiance in a mess and outdated and the service not deserving the tip. But I did enjoy the warm and soft buns.

Author: vincent a
Title: So so
Review: It's alright nothing much to say.. entertainment is zero.. boring place if your solo.. cocktail mix is so so like for the price it's very little..
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: PQako
Title: Don't bother! Poor service, great at giving excuses.
Review: It took 45 minutes for my simple order of a side dish and salad appetizer to come out. The restaurant was half empty. Never again.

Author: drKingh
Title: Kolo mee .....
Review:
We read some good reviews about this place and walked a great distance to get to this place. Frankly speaking the mee was a disappointment. Their roast meats were hard to chew.

Lastly we saw flies settling on the cooked meats. Terrible!

Harjit.

Author: Lunaluniayakakak
Title: Dinner Gathering
Review: Had a great dining here. Attendant Ms Zuraini was very friendly. The price are on the high end but the dishes were great and delicious.

Author: joycenelwanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: New Menu
Review: Ante is one of our favourite restaurants in KL. Starting with Crispy Trotter and the many choice and tasty main dishes we always have a great dinner.My husband and I went back there yesterday coz we miss to eat at ANTE and we were surprised that they changed the menu. No more Crispy Trotter Salad and I told the Restaurant Manager that Salad is so far is the Best Salad in Town. I ordered fish but it was the worst ever fish that I have try. From it's presentation until the taste it was horrible!. Lots of rubbish and no taste at all so I have to clean all the fish before eating etc...Common ANTE what happened to you?.

Author: 889hasanrSingapore, Singapore
Title: Our Fav Bfast place in KL
Review: My family and i have been having our breakfast here each time we stay at JW Marriott. The range is great and provides enough to please all taste buds. At 9.30am, this place is very crowded on the weekends and so hard to find a table, hence have to wait a while. Saying that, the food is fresh and good. We enjoy it and looking forward to our next visit to KL!

Author: sansanvmHong Kong, China
Title: Bad experience in the restaurant
Review: I am first time visit Penang, we specially choose this restaurant as we found the internet comment, it is historic place. When we arrived the staff is very nice and we finally decided to dine in this restaurant, since the time still early, around 6 : 00 pm, the restaurant is only us and have told the waiter we can start dinner at around 6:30 and then snapping outside, however, when we walking around and shooting at the courtyard, suddenly a nervous GM stop us snapping, he said the other side is the hotel lobby , it is a really embarrassed us as they did not inform us in advance or no sign / notice, the hotel lobby is not allow to photo taking. In fact, all the camera are without flash on, we are traveller , snapping around is normal , how come suddenly have a guy come out and stop us ???For the food, this restaurant only serve set dinner and no a la carte menu, it is too full for us. For travellers from western country, I believe it is good but for Asian it is just so so fusion food... It is true that the environment is good and clean.

Author: ChanMLPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Multiple diarrhoea after buffet dinner on Friday
Review: Visited Lemon Garden with wife and daughter for buffet dinner 4 Oct. Both of us came down with bad diarrhoea after consuming oysters and sashimi from the buffet spread. I’m still not eating properly after two days. Disappointing that Shangrila F&B produces this unhygienic quality of food. Hope their overseas hotels do better....Bryan Chan(reservation made under my name)PS Daughter did not eat seafood, no diarrhoea.

Author: Linda T
Title: Don't Bother Eating There
Review: We stopped there for lunch. Ordered the Straits Malacca Salad (or similar in name) and chicken satay. The salad dressing and peanut satay sauce were the same. The sauces were bland and tasteless. The salad itself would have been good with a good salad dressing. The chicken satay was dry and also bland and tasteless. I cook better satay using packaged spices. There were many people in the restaurant and that's why we decided to eat there. In hindsight, if we had paid attention the people were all tourists, that should have been our clue. Do not waste your money!!! The Night Market (Friday - Sunday nights) was far superior and cheaper.

Author: Zackchia92-
Title: BJ’s birthday
Review: Sushi not very fresh at all, but overall is not but. Hopefully will getting improve after this, god bless

Author: Benjamin_AnnieKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Been Eating This for Past 20+ Years
Review: Grew up eating this.I have to be frank that this is not a comfy style eateries with good services.Go else where if you are looking for good services.The price might not be value for money but again it's not rocket high (RM10 per person is still better than McDonald or KFC).It's the most authentic wantan noodles in the Malaysia.Just try their char siew (honey roasted pork) and wantan.Going in odds hours (other than 12noon to 2pm) should be ok for a little better attention.

Author: adriankoh1981Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated and overcrowded
Review: We had dinner at Bei Zhan, having reserved a table at 7:30pm on Saturday. The restaurant was packed and service was in chaos. We joined several tables in long waits before we were attended to. Tired of waiting, we took our orders ourselves. Our food arrived 90mins after we walked in. The steam fish arrived in a tepid stock, and was not fresh. The signature fried rice was mushy and lacking flavour. Having seen the crowd, we didn’t expect much from the quality of food, and even then it fell short of expectations. The sweet and sour pork and spinach dish were mediocre offerings. Avoid this restaurant unless you want the novelty of Bei Zhan, which has quite a long history in Malacca. There are many other restaurants in the area that are far worth your time.

Author: questseekerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A restaurant with great ambiance but food that was so-so
Review: I love restaurants like this... ones that are truly unexpected, full of character, tucked into little corners. I was super excited when I arrived. It was exactly the type of restaurant I love. I have to say that the menu was rather tempting too as there was quite a wide choice and prices seemed reasonable. Unfortunately, the food did not meet expectations. We ordered two starters - the first was reasonable but the Hokkaido scallops were definitely not from Hokkaido. They were terribly small (different sized at that) and horribly rubbery! My main which was the duck confit was ok though I've had better. The dessert which was the vanilla creme brulee was also so-so. When I shared my disappointment at the food, it was apparent that the waiter couldn't do much. He shared that the scallops were frozen but I still wouldn't have expected a 'fine dining' experience to mess up something like that. Would I return? Maybe not. Despite it's charm, the food was underwhelming (as mentioned by another reviewer).

Author: irepatMadrid, Spain
Title: Decent food but quite pricey for Melaka.
Review: We had some beers and tapas, the food was good but not exceptional.Price is on the high side, probably due to the fact that many ingredients are imported.If you’re after a European meal in Melaka this is the place to be, however there is better value for the money available in Melaka.

Author: KK2104Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Street Food Tastier
Review: Everyone have different taste and needs. Tried 2 different outlet of Mdm Kwan, Subang and Pavilion, found the Chinese and local cuisine nothing special but pricey. Prefer to go for local food hangout on Jalan Alor. Mdm Kwan is a place if you wanted to have a business lunch meeting with Western or European taste friends or colleague. Not a place with young children or someone who enjoys good Malaysian Chinese cuisine.

Author: JoshShoeString
Title: Cheap Udon
Review: Basic no frills place serving no frills udon. Cheap and delicious. Nothing fancy. It is just a few doors away from Old Restaurant (Lau Jiu Loh) which serves Ramen at slightly higher prices. Both belong to the same owner.

Author: Maps825365Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed!!!
Review: despite reading all the negative reviews, I still choose to try it my self but was disappointed... the oyster was not fresh and tasted like a cheap oyster... the grilled lamb rack was very small for the priced charged but the sauce tasted good... the cocktail was terrible too... Definitely won't be eating here again that's for sure!

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Chinese cuisine
Review: Meisan restaurant's name started with Holiday Inns and Grand Margherita just carried on with it without changing. The food was favorable and taste excellent for a Chinese restaurant. I so believe the cooking was towards Cantonese style and it's a known fact the best food found in China is from Guangzhou....that's the original Cantonese cuisine started. The staff service is beyond expectation and the ambience is fine although it is not huge but presentable.

Author: joshuanaveenkrishnanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Brilliant place and Excellent service!
Review: Had an event for my company at the Velvet Lounge and there is nothing to complain about. The event went well and the food & service was fantastic. We had the whole place to ourselves and 1 staff (Simon) who accommodated to all our needs. Special Thanks to Chef Sharmini for designing a good menu with the perfect ptice and for Rakit and Simon for the excellent hospitality. Will definitely be heading there for the scrumptious food and any future events. Highly Recommended!

Author: saic629Bengaluru, India
Title: Was let down due to high expectations
Review: I have visited Singapore Anjappar and found the food really good and authentic, bit this one was not close to its Singapore Coubterpart. I ordered lime juice and I found it bitter. I ordered Rumali roti and found it hard like papad. Although, I was told that I could get it replaced, I expect it to be good very first time. Has a pot to learn and improve in terms of customer service and satisfaction.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Ridiculously expensive and unimpressive food
Review: I've never understood the hype over Shook.Upon arrival, you'll be presented with a menu that is thicker than a PhD thesis, and you get the sense that they're just trying a little too hard just so they'll be able to claim that they serve "everything under the sun". Local cuisine, Japanese, European, steaks, etc. You name it, they've probably got it. Yet, NOTHING looks interesting enough to eat!The food then arrives, after an eon, and you find it is just ordinary. The servers are dismissive; I've noticed that they are only really attentive if they think you might be a titled or royal personae. Very pretentious. Actually, that pretty much sums up Shook. Pretentious, without delivering on the illusion of chic, exclusive and up-scale they try so hard to create. Then the bill arrives and you're left wondering if they secretly snuck diamond and gold chips into your food when you weren't looking, to justify the price. Be prepared to pay, easily, RM200 per person for a 3-course meal at Shook.

Author: melinayoonglihSeville, Spain
Title: Rooftop Disappointment
