Review: After several attempts to get a table at the always fully booked Ceilo rooftop restaurant, I finally got the chance to eat there this Friday night.Let's start with looking at the question - "was it worth the wait?"The answer in short - a resounding "NO".On arrival you are politely asked to wait in the lobby, then served a welcome drink before taking the lift up to the rooftop - so far so good.Next when you get to the rooftop - the view is great - another tick in the box.From then on in the experience was almost a masterclass in what not to do if you are promoting yourself as top of the range eatery.So what went wrong? Let's try to boil it down.1) The waitress who took our order looked about as happy as if she was at a family member's funeral. When she spoke, it seemed she must have had something top secret to say, as her voice rarely raised above a whisper. When we asked questions about the menu we simply couldn't hear her responses, after several "Pardons" "Could you repeat thats" and "Whats" we gave up asking and tried to work things out for ourselves.2) She took our order, including drinks (two bloody Mary's), but as we would discover she took down our order incorrectly.3) After a fairly long wait - about 10 minutes - another waiter came and delivered something to our table. He placed it between me and Mel in the middle of the table - then whispered something inaudible (Yep he was our second whispering waiter of the evening). I called him back and asked, "What is this" not sure if it was a starter or an "extra" for us to share before the starters arrived. He informed me it was crab cakes. Great, that was the starter that I ordered. So I moved the plate from the middle of the table to my place setting.......then decided to wait until Mel's starter came.4) Then waited5) Then waited some more6) When no one brought a second starter after nearly another 10 minutes (or bothered to check why I wasn't eating my dish), I called another waiter over and asked when we could expect Mel's starter to arrive.7) He went to the till to check our order, clearly, Mel's starter was not in the system as I saw him checking through the written order chits. However he never came back to our table to tell us the mistake.8) By the way, the Bloody Mary's still hadn't been served (we had now been seated 25 minutes).9) I call the waiter to ask, any update on the missing starter, to which he tells us, it will be ready in a few minutes, so I ask "But you forgot to put it through on the original order - right?" he then confirms this "Ehhh yes, very sorry sir" 10) Mel mentions to him, "But the first starter has been here for over 10 minutes and is already cold as we expected to eat our starters together", to which he replies "Very Sorry Madam" To which Mel replies "Well do you think you might offer to heat it up again before by starter comes" - he goes way and checks and get the OK to do so.11) The bloody Mary's still haven't turned up.12) So now we are one dish down, no food on the table, but success, 30 minutes in and the bloody Mary's turn up - better news - they are pretty good Bloody Mary's - big relief.13) Both starters turn up, they are OK - but not to die for. A more senior waiter (possibly the manager - he did not introduce himself so we will never know) came over with two complimentary glasses of Cava to apologise for the earlier confusion. Nice Gesture, but perhaps it would have been better to talk to us first and subtly find out what our drink preferences are - neither of us like Cava!14) But at least the Bloody Mary's are good.15) On to main courses - This is what it all about, Medium well steak for me, Sea Bass for Mel. Can't wait. But........Mel's Fish is just a bit too fishy, nothing wrong with it, but doesn't have the clean fresh taste you expect when having great fish............. My steak seems a bit difficult to cut, turns out to harder to chew, lacks any moisture or taste and on balance is almost as well done as the sole of the shoe on my foot. 16) Not nice at all, but I decide not to complain any more.....but then when the "senior waiter" appears again and ask me if everything is OK with my food, I can't help but tell him how bad my steak is - but insist I do not want any replacement or second attempt.17) At this point, we just want to pay the bill and descend back to the ground floor, maybe hit a local Mamak and get something enjoyable to eat! But I do have one tiny gulp of Bloody Mary left in my glass and am looking forward to swigging that down to at least end this disappointing experience on a high.18) Arrggghh that same waitress that took the incorrect order at the start of the evening efficiently sweeps by the table, and without asking (or maybe she whispered!) "are you finished with your drink" assumes it is finished, picks up my glass and wanders off out of earshot before I can call her back.One last thing - despite always being told to book weeks in advance and whenever we had called to book, being told the place is fully booked, for the sitting we were in, over half of the reserved tables were still empty when we left,

Author: 322nataliiak
Title: So so
Review: Food was ok but not great, we expected more from authentic restaurant. Prawns were fine, tandoori selection was rather dry. Was our least favourite from all Datai restaurants. Thai and Beach Restaurant were better.

Author: Panheady
Title: Good but not outstanding
Review: Enjoyed the crispy lemon chicken and it is great you can get half serves. Spring rolls were so so, wouldn't order them again. Deep fried ice cream was very tasty.

Author: alexcafc
Title: Delicious meal - great value!
Review: We loved the food here and it is great value for money. The waiter was also super friendly and helpful with recommendations. A must visit for Indian food in Penang.

Author: 880jenniferj
Title: Halal Dim Sum in Ipoh
Review: Delicious halal dim sum located in Greentown Avenue, Ipoh. This is the must come place for breakfast every time we visit Ipoh. They serve a wide variety of dim sum. If you want to locate the place, just use google maps/waze search for "Greentown Dim Sum Cafe". When you arrived, the shop is just opposite Berlin's bier Houz.

Author: cheri yKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: VERY UNPLEASANT DINING EXPERIENCE DUE TO ITS VERY RUDE OWNER!
Review: The Owner gave us run for our money, we had a good show/demonstration on how one should "butcher" his/her piece of steak.1st piece of steak came well done instead of medium,the waiter took it back in, nicely and politely. Who would have ordered well done for a sirloin when its known to be quite tough on its own. So here came the 2nd piece and that;s where the drama started. It came medium-ish but for some reason it was still very tough. Maybe its the cut or the quality? We really had a hard time chewing it. After trying to "saw" our 3rd/4th piece we decided we should let the kitchen know, not thinking to return it as we didn't want to wait again but to at least inform the kitchen that they should look into the quality of its meat. Before we can catch a waiter attention, the owner who has been walking around greeting every other table but us (we were the only Asian table that Saturday night but I do hope its not the main reason why he didn't conveniently drop by our table) took a very offensive approach and came up to us with “What’s your problem”, and before we can explain much it just said “Oh well that’s what you get for a sirloin” (i.e. 2nd most expensive main, RM115 for a Foiegras Sirloin Steak), then went on with “You want me to cut it for you?" I said yes thinking he will be bringing it into the kitchen to get it slice up nicely for us, but NOPE to much of my HORROR he said "Nope! i will do it, I show you" and proceeded to snatch the cutlery from my partner and "butchered" the steak right there at our table, please take note of his butchering skills, it was that awesome till we had sauces lying off the plate in front of us. I think i had enough steaks to know that you do not require such force to "cut" a steak even if its a cheap piece of steak till i get sauces flying off everywhere. We were no doubt in shock and had no words to say beside telling him its ok we can do it ourself. Enough of his superb demonstration skills. The Owner gave us a very good big fat SMIRK before he left our table.I never one to put down any reviews, even much good ones or bad ones that i have experienced so far. But this is the cream of the crop so far that I had to do this review. It was such an experience coming from a semi-fine dine restaurant in my own country from a foreigner. I truly believe any ahne at any mamak stall would give me a much better manners/service for a fraction of what I was paying for that night.P/S: The 1st 2 dishes was actually good. I told my partner that I would like to come back again for the duck confit cause I have yet to find another place that serve a nice one since i got back from France. That night, we ordered 1L bottle of sparkling apple juice, 1 french onion soup to share, 1 duck confit de canard, 1 foiegras sirloin steak. We had plans to order drinks and desserts after, but thanks to the drama from the Owner, we just could not bear to stay there any longer!

Author: LolaLinaMaradona
Title: Good Restaurant for Colleague Gathering
Review: Warm greeting from the Restaurant Crew once i stepped in the restaurant. The foods are super-delicious especially the Tamarind Prawn. This customer-friendly restaurant will definitely make us repeat our visit some other day for the next gathering!

Author: hugislovePenang, Malaysia
Title: Awesome place for family dinner
Review: A great place for family dinner with excellent quality of steaks. First, we love the ambiance of the restaurant which is the kind of chill and relaxing place for us 10pax from seniors to juniors and we love the meal that the staffs recommended to us, as well as the types of salts which comes together to pair with the steaks. And lastly, we love the desserts especially when the staff cooking the crepes suzette in front of us. We will definitely come back again!

Author: Persian-Pardis
Title: awesome place
Review: loved loved loved my meal over there... their steaks tasted heavenly and the waiters and waitresses were polite,caring and nice xxx

Author: Ravindran M
Title: Not bad
Review: Good food and good place to hangaround with friends but abit pricey. I been there a few times and once had their veg briyani but I dont really like it as well as my wife. Rest of the food was nice. Thumbs up

Author: LilyNana89Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Miso Soup Taste Awful
Review: 1. Service very lousy, keep serving wring table.2. Food haven't arrive for my friend even after all of us had finish the food.3. The taste of miso soup is not like any other normal japanese restaurant taste. 4. Had sashimi don, the sashimi is not so fresh.

Author: angelng1231Bidor, Malaysia
Title: Yummyyyy Dim Sum in town!
Review: Yummy! But always lack of table, similar to HK style, so far it's my favourite Dim Sum restaurant to go. I am not a Dim Sum person, but Ming Court is really tasty. Value of Money: 4 out of 5Like others said, popularity of this place speaks for itself. Especially at public holiday or weekends, always be there before you are way too hungry since there must be a long queue for a table. Environment ok, it's a good place to go with friends and family.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: TravellerPorirua
Title: Air conditioned Indian restaurant
Review: Many nice South Indian dishes are available - Aviyal, nice fish curry and Banana wrap fish, Thali meals (not available during weekends) Dosai in the evenings only. Crab dishes are all great incl. crab soup.

Author: kopibusukPort Dickson, Malaysia
Title: poor experience with the gnocchi
Review: may be the chef think they can fool the customers with fake gnocchi unfortunately they fool the wrong person.i m a food critic who has been doing food tasting and know how to cook, and the chef is trying to fool me with an elastic rubber gnocchi which has no potatoes in it.the server was amazing-Anna, she is very helpful and make our evening delightful.

Author: Abana87Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Gobo No Go
Review: I would like to prefix this review by saying that the actual food we had during our visit was good (if not great value), but what has really brought this rating down was the terrible service we experienced.Never ones to normally eat at the hotel where we are staying, my partner and I chose to visit Gobo Upstairs whilst staying at the Traders hotel due to the appeal their Australian Week presented. When we arrived at the restaurant (on a Tuesday night) there was just us, another couple and then what looked to be a work meeting involving 10-15 business men and women. Basically, not a busy restaurant in the slightest. We ordered drinks (a gin and tonic for myself and a beer for my partner) , with the plan being to get one of the Australian wines featured once those were finished. A waiter came over shortly after to take our food order, and we sat back to wait for our drinks. And waited. And waited.After about 10-15 minutes we got the attention of one of the floor staff, and inquired politely as to if our drinks were being prepared. I would like to point out at this point that my partner works in the service industry, and as a result we would normally give the benefit of the doubt for any delays, mistakes etc. as he can empathize with the staff. The staff member apologised, and said our drinks would be over shortly. Roughly about 10 minutes later our starters were delivered, but we were yet to receive our drinks. When the starters arrived we once again inquired as to where our drinks were, and were told, again, that they would be over shortly. In the end, they were not delivered until our starters had been cleared away. In the meantime, another family had arrived in the restaurant, been seated and served their drinks and starters whilst we were still waiting for ours. Putting a damper on the evening, we enjoyed our main course and would have liked to have had dessert - unfortunately, no staff ever offered it or brought us a dessert menu. After about 10 minutes of waiting (yet again), we'd had enough and decided to just get the bill and go elsewhere. Despite numerous staff going past our table, not one stopped to see if there was anything else we needed, or even glanced in our direction (most likely due to occupational embarrassment or not wanting to acknowledge the state of our evening's experience).In the end, my partner had to do the thing he hates people doing the most - standing up and waving his arms until someone came over. The bill was then delivered, although we insisted that the service charge be removed, due to lack of service we received (although this required us to complain to a variety of waiters at excruciating length until we spoke to the maitre d'). Reading about other customers experience around the time we visited really seems to highlight that although in a prominent location, Gobo Upstairs really does need to work on its customer service. I would not recommend this restaurant unless you were staying at Traders and desperate not to go out elsewhere.

Author: PjbrackLancaster, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely views but terrible service
Review: Visited Marinis on 57 with partner and another couple. The views are stunning but the service is poor to say the least. We order four meals. One turned up then five minutes two more did and after asking the servers twice more we eventually got the final meal. As there were two pizza and a pasta dish which should cook quicker than the pizzas (I used to be a chef) then it was surprising that the pasta took so long to cook! They also messed up the drinks orders "forgetting" the vodka in a vodka and coke. The excuse was that they were busy but half the tables were empty. As for the dress code - don't worry about it as it doesn't seem to apply anymore. There's more trainers in her than on the stalls in chinatowns market. All in a nice venue but every other place I've visited in KL will give better service.

Author: Trinet1702
Title: God mad, fantastisk service
Review: We had read the reviews and wanted to try it out. I ordered some kind of pancake, which they told me were sour, but I didn't thought it Would be a problem. Unfortunately it didn't fall in ny taste, so they wanted to make another pancake for me without paying extra. It was a really good service. They were all very smiling and friendly, and We really felt like We were welcome. After dinner they served a scoop of icecream, which We very Nice as an ending to the dinner. They food were very Nice. I Will definitely recommend it if you Want to Try traditionel korean food to a good Price.

Author: Janis1805
Title: Wonderful service and food
Review: Highly recommended from friends who have visited and decided to give it a try. Absolutely wonderful experience. Kids loved the margherita pizza and the mushroom soup was absolutely if not the best we’ve had so far. Classic fish and chips had the right amount of texture and taste. Nice and crispy battered yet light and tasty to each bite. Service by both Mr Danes and the team was warm and hospitable.Thank you for making our evening . Will be back for sure.

Author: Traveller_J0Malaysia
Title: Forget Souled Out!!
Review: Food cold, service poor, over-priced.......Souled Out has really gone down hill in the last year, and despite handing them 3 customer reviews to alert them of the poor deal, it continues to worsen. I have spoken to several people I work with about their experiences, and think it's about time Souled Out was removed from any list that recommends them. If I was to find a positive point, the freshly made pizza's are the only food worth asking for there, as they are fresh and hot. Souled Out needs to offer some staff training in waiting, food hygiene training, and a cookery lesson to the chef on how to cook......anyone can heat up or microwave food. I'm just glad there sister bar/restaurant WIP in Bangsar is better!

Author: Usha SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food & service but flies mar every thing
Review: This is the second time we visited Birch with friends. Ambiance is good, food is good and it's a new experience - a blend of western, mid-eastern and local cuisine. Everything is delicious and fresh, but there are flies around that spoil the whole ambiance. It was our friend's anniversary and we wanted to end the meal with cake, but my friends said they will not eat it because the cake counter also had flies swarming inside!

Author: Jaymin B
Title: Fine, but not the same level as the US
Review: The menu is pretty typical of what you would expect of Chili's, but the quality isn't as good as it is in the US. The salads were especially poor.

Author: NazdaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: The employees were extremely nice and friendly. Food was ok. It was a bit warm inside so one of the employees lend me his portable fan! I forgot his name but he was attentive. The toilet was a bit messy, paper towels everywhere and there was no soap. I informed the staff and apparently they had this problem where non-patrons using their toilets. Overall was a good place to escape from the chaos and heat of the city.

Author: KLchronic
Title: Budget food
Review: It’s just a local type of non air conditioning restaurant. These are better known as Mamak restaurants. It’s like an Indian Muslim restaurant. Can get vegetable dishes.

Author: SundarappandianMJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Cheater! Boycott!
Review: Many choices of food; cheap happy hour beer.But This owner is a cheater of public people and government of Malaysia. During GST, they charge nett price include GST.Once GST abolished and SST introduced, they take advantage to continue same price without reducing GST amount; on top of it, they charge SST 6%. End up price is more than previously charged where it supposed to be lower.

Author: torejohnsen48Oslo, Norway
Title: Souled out has good food but never serve guests at the same time !!!
Review: Souled out has good food and we enjoy the atmosphere there, but one thing is ALWAYS failing - the food is served when ready guest by guest. Nice way to know for the chef you have made my dish, but for people who want to eat at the same time - will be disappointed We know the preparation of the different dishes takes different time, but why don’t do a small attempt to make one table’s order ready at the same time. Especially when there are few people in the restaurant - it should be possible

Author: Ruby R
Title: Icook Italian gastronomia is re-open
Review:
Icook Italian is already open since last week. Just change only name into Italia & Ribs Gastronomia. They added new special Ribs and it's really a best seller since they open the place. 
In any info or inquiries call this number 03-6211-4000

Author: SarapolskaSpain
Title: Great view of KL
Review: The best about the restaurant is the view of KL and turning 360 degrees! Amazing at night and during day. Big variety of food with a correct quality. Quite expensive - taking in consideration that drinks are not included (only water, tea &coffee) and there is nothing specially for children (like nuggets, chicken, French fries or simply not spicy bolognese). Nice music and helpful staff. About 20 min before the end they indirectly motivate you to rush, pay&go out. We were offered a complimentary cake for birthday if one of us- a nice gesture. The view of the city is exceptional!

Author: fizzysoupQueenstown, New Zealand
Title: Visit for nostalgia reasons only!
Review: My golfing group had their Christmas lunch here on the 6th December 2012 (as we have done for the past 3 years). However this time the oxtail soup was mediocre whilst the steak & kidney pie has no kidney & the crust was like leather and was simply inedible. The banana fritters were simply awful, and the batter just tasted oily.The whole place just looks dingy now, and has little appeal other than it used to be a happening place half a century ago! If you need to experience it, by all means pop in and have a beer or a glass of wine, but there are literally thousands of better places to eat in the city.

Author: Christopher WShanghai, China
Title: Great Steaks but no flexibility!
Review: This restaurant still serves great steaks and their ribeye is truly consistently wow......however they have no flexibility in sauces whatsoever. We have visited several times and I suppose we will continue to do so as there is great value for money.....but I wish the Chef would try to enhance the experience with some béarnaise or pepper sauce......sides that go with the steaks.......

Author: Julian LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must be a bad day for the restaurant!
Review: I read the reviews on this restaurant on Tripadvisor and decided I simply must give it a try - that was the worst decision we made in Melaka on restaurant choice. Food portions were meager, regular in taste, the appetizers forgettable, and to top it off, the rice we ordered never came, and they wanted to charge us for it! The bill was the highest we spent in all the different restaurants we went to in Melaka, and our regret having gone to Daorae was just as much, if not more. Either the restaurant was having a bad day that day, or the reviews of it are inaccurate. This is one restaurant you simply must not go. Go for the Peranakan food just down the road!

Author: tt6575Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Be careful of what beverages you order
Review: My friend and I went to dine in last night and we were seated right in front of the cashier counter next to the kitchen entrance. We were watching the staff who prepare drinks using tap water for the "Filtered Water", fruit juice and etc. There was a water filter just next to the tap but all the staff filling up using the tap water, this is not right......people could get sick with unfiltered water. We ordered mango salad but it was drench with water and the pad thai is way too sweet. It was my first time eating there (though I have stayed around the area for years), I doubt I would patronize the restaurant again.

Author: vshoghiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mind Blowing !!!
Review: My wife and me came were in Kerala for a short visit and we were not happy with the food over there ( maybe it was due to short visit and didnt know the correct place ) ... but sadly we were dissapointed that we couldnt taste a good kerala food. We landed in KL and just tried our luck to go for a kerala restaurant and we found Malabar Rest in Hartamas. The place were nice and food was super awesome ... best we had among all indian restaurant. Friendly staff and reasonable price. I will highly recommend this place to others. You must try this place !

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yuk
Review: We went here in 2017 on a previous visit to Melaka - and thought this place was excellent.We went back this past week and were dreadfully disappointed. Except for a very good prawn omelette, the rest of our food,especially the pork dish, was at best mediocre - if that.Plus the interior is scruffy and towards the back it is very untidy around the cash desk and towards the kitchen Thank you - but definitely a 'no thank you'.

Author: 250liniMalaysia
Title: Just okay
Review: Food was not great, drinks were good. Overrated basically. We went in as a couple next to us was a long table of oldies super noisy for an event, we couldn’t even talk. You should hold a private room for events. I will not come back to this place again. Not worth.

Author: Robert d
Title: Afternoon Tea no good
Review: I am a sucker for atmosphere and love the custom of English afternoon tea. Harrods was my choice in KL when I couldn't do the Ritz. No more. The toast was stale, the sandwiches thrown together with minute bits of cold cuts and a ladle of mustard; gone are the nice mini pies and the delectable baked bits. And the tea selection has shrunk to whatever Tesco has on special, it seems. The only redeeming feature were the excellent scones, everything - and I mean everything - else is far better at Dome and pretty much every other place across the planet I have been at. It was awful. And doodling boy band tunes over the stereo non-stop didn't help the atmosphere either. Harrods UK take note, they are ruining your brand.

Author: Umair S
Title: Excellent
Review: Excellent food and service. Freshly made eggs and soup. With a variety of cuisines to chose from. Highly recommend

Author: dominicf330Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worst beef patty
Review: The so called ‘grass-fed’ beef is no different from the ones in MC D in terms of taste and quality, and I have never in my life have to spit out burger patty because there’s just so much (at least 70%) of rubber texture ligament. The portion has been reduced, not to mention some key ingredients taken out from the dish itself , no guacamole salsa on the dish and didn’t bother to address or add in alternatives until it was pointed out by customer. For a cafe that promotes healthy choices and diet but serves such poor quality and contradicting food is utterly disappointing .

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Expected better
Review: I had not been to Zipangu in a while and decided to eat here with my husband. The lunch set menu is not bad and we chose the vegetarian set which was at RM79.00. Overall, the food quality is considered average as there are much better Japanese restaurants in KL. For a Shangri La hotel restaurant, we really expected better food quality and presentation. Service should also be improved as i was served food without cutleries. These are small bits that service staff should be efficiently trained.

Author: strawberrygirl26Singapore, Singapore
Title: Horrendous Service - Avoid at all cost!
Review: Very very bad service and attitude. We went there at 12.10pm, stood at the door while all the service staffs at the counter stared at us. It was our first time there. I walked to the counter and told them we wanted table of 3, and they told us to fill up the form with a blank face. I said, “Should’ve told us, we stood there at the door.” The old aged waitress with long straight black hair said “you didn’t ask!” Is that the protocol of a restaurant? To ask what is the procedure before we can actually be seated? Mind them; we are paying customers. What sort of attitude is this. Nonetheless, we walked out due to the horrible, terrible, horrendous attitudes of these waitresses. Cottage Spices located opposite is a much better choice with impeccable services and have a much better atmosphere and vibes.

Author: 593twtwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Come ploy with your taste buds
Review: It's a very cheeky place to eat with a really nice ambience. The tagline "Ploy with your food" really comes into play with a lot of their dishes. Their Korean Fried Chicken is super crispy, all you want to do is pick it up and hear the crunch as you bite in. Their steak is juicy, their lamb is hearty and all of their food have a Japanese-Thai twist. Worth the visit!

Author: vicbruinSan Jose, California
Title: Tourists watching tourists
Review: The Geographer's Cafe must be mentioned in just about every tourist's book and has become a tourist attraction itself. Quite a lot of tourists indeed, most, it seems, sitting in the outside area enjoying the sunny weather (or the rain!) and watching other tourists pass by. The ambiance was quite joyous, but the food experience not that much. Lots of choices, but not tasty at all. I had nonya curry chicken and it was so so. Very slow (and unenthusiastic) service. Live music in some evenings. If you must, sit outside, order a drink and some fried egg rolls, and enjoy the people watching.

Author: Hangkenhong
Title: Rooftop Bar
Review: Enjoyed our welcome drinks there. Overseeing the cat city in a quiet way. Not much people and is a good place if you wish to have a small talk.

Author: dnxhuong
Title: Great place
Review: I came for a late afternoon coffee and fell in love with the place so I came back again for dinner and drink. It’s a too relaxing place to leave early and I ended up with a few drinks, with very nice service from Pook, a cute handsome waiter. Riverside, cozy, free. I’ll definitely come back. Thanks Pook and hope to see you again.

Author: JayY1Gold Coast, Australia
Title: Best Whiskey / Steak in SE Asia! Don't miss this!
Review: OK... I'm from Alberta Canada... Which means I was born with a steak and whiskey in my hand... Whiskey Bar is the best, hands down in SE Asia. They know their steaks and they definitely know whiskey (over 300 selections). If your lucky enough to be here when then have a tasting don't miss it. The crew here are top notch... Absolutely top notch. Working for a global company we bring people from all over the world here and it's for three reasons :- The service - The choice of Whiskey- The steaks... and frankly there is something fantastic on the menu for everyone. Dont think, just go... It's that simple folks. Well done Whiskey Bar!

Author: Jules_durst
Title: Best Vietnamese food outside of Vietnam...
Review: ...and beats some we had in Vietnam. Fully authentic and completely delicious, we had the pho and a banh mi. Would definitely come back!

Author: BeccaS_TXTX
Title: Good food, ok service
Review: I went here with work colleagues on a Sunday night. It was fairly busy (not full) and the service was not great. There were lots of employees but so slow to get service. Food was pretty good - highly recommend the satay and their signature platters.

Author: Rashid AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very weak or it's reputation
Review: One of the most expensive places, mainly due to its view of the town, which is nice for visitors, but the restaurant is extremely poorly planned, not luxury clean at all, and no value for money.Smell of the kitchen is widely heard on the tables, and its not pleasant.the food quality is equal to a cheap or basic restaurant and for the money that you pay here, you don't get the quality you should receive. NOT EVEN CLOSE.Both I and my wife were very disappointed. for us, never will pay to go there again, but if someone wants to see KL from top, you can try it out. Don't expect much though... very basic for its price. even the service is basic...

Author: kefaloveJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Local foods to try
Review: I love the variation of the local food here, and the outdoor location make it a nice spot to watch peoples passing by. Althou I will suggest you make a brief review or at least ask your hotel staff which restaurant/stall is a better places to eat. Dragon View (at corner, there's 3-4 dragon view restaurant at Jalan Alor) is a quite safe choice althou it's higher prices than other hawker stall.

Author: Simon6511Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Latino ???? Think again
Review: for me this is just a name but the food is rather common and i dont see any Latino's taste into it. Steak .. the grill is rather standard. In Latin, the grill is straight and big big portion unlike the little piece .. the beer selection, the music and the ambient is just not LATINO.. some effort into it will make this great

Author: LittleGulliverEurope
Title: More hype than substance
Review: I went there hearing how great their BBQ/roasted meat are. I had their famed char siew, roasted pork, old cucumber soup and sauteed yam with pork slices. The char siew was a letdown, while the others were just average. I know of at least 2 other places in KL that have far superior char siew and roasted pork. In view of the slightly higher prices they charged, I have to rate this slightly below average.

Author: Sunil2108Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible Service
Review: I was super exited to visit this cafe based on Trip advisor reviews et al but when i visited there last week with my family i was terribly disappointed with the quality of service. We were 4 adults and a kid firstly I am not sure if the cafe was understaffed on that day when we entered i asked almost 5 people if they have a table for 4 and they kept sending me up, outside, inside and still i did not get a table until i got hold of one guy who got me a table for 3 and we manged for sometime and got a proper table but it was frustrating. Well even for a minute if i gave them the benefit of doubt on the table thingy for that day saying it was crowed et al, the service was absolutely crappy. We ordered for few drinks and food and it took eternity for them to serve and involved quite a few visits to the main counter to check if our order is taken or not and finally we got it but the food tasted awfully bad and they missed couple of our orders as well which we finally cancelled. The only good thing was the music band was decent and it was reasonably priced. However i am sure i will not visit this place again as you dont want cheap food/beer and cheap service....Not recommend for families for sure!!

Author: nicolah750Taif, Saudi Arabia
Title: Exquisite food , service could be better
Review: The food is amazing and the beach setting beautiful , but the staff need to be better and more attentive
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: rpcamar
Title: Very average food.
Review: All presentation little substance. In fact just bland tasteless courses. Only thing with taste was the goat cheese! But then its hard to mess up goat cheese.

Author: yugandhardiviKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food with great service by Raju
Review: Well, it's been more than a year in KL and the top most restaurant we visit quite frequent is none other than Damansara - Passage Thru India. Quality/Hygienic- tasty food, the best in KL that we tried so far, Raju- special mention on service by Raju as he is utmost dedicated, very professional, always big smile on his face and he is undoubtedly biggest asset to the restaurant in getting repetitive customers, my children love his presence during service. We used to go to main branch but move on to Damansara probably due to Raju and that's his power! My family and children love the food especially Prawn Biryani, chicken tikka, fried chicken, chicken curries & whatnot everything! Don't miss it!

Author: safiqliyana
Title: Amazing dining experience at khan’s indian cuisine
Review: the food here is amazing. the service sub par but my family and i are happy to come here again. thank you

Author: patriciarH8841JT
Title: Take away dinner
Review: We were looking for some local food but with tired kids walked in and asked if they would do a take out for us. We were greeted with hospitality and soon a very tasty fare was packed and ready for us to go away with.

Author: ChanMLPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Quality of food had deteriorated
Review: Went for lunch at Imbi branch with family members. Was disappointed with the service, both the supervisor and waitress had the same attitude of couldn’t care less. Food served was cold and unappetising. It used to be one of my favourite Chinese restaurants but sadly I can’t say it for now.

Author: JannChiaAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Good place for food.
Review: i like the food here. simple and nice. i went with my daughter as i wanted her to eat fish. we ordered 1steam cod fish (rm132), 1 fried rice (rm18), 1garlic stir fry kai lan(rm18), 1 coconut (rm8). chinese tea is only rm2.80.quite cheap i think. the peanuts they charged us rm3. also reasonable price. my daughter alone finished the cod fish and i finished the kai lan. the portion is quite big especially the fried rice. end up we had to pack the fried rice. environment wise, it reminded me of those typical hong kong restaurants. their services were excellent. the only thing that puts me off is the parking. i had to pay rm8 for the parking. so darn expensive. but at lease i managed to get a place to park. Otherwise parking at that place can be horrible.

Author: Boon Ken L
Title: Overrated for Nyonya food！
Review: There is no original taste of nyonya. The food was not okay at all. Overrated！No return in the future，we ordered Chap Chai，Rendang Ayam，Asam Fish and fried eggs and it was not a good choice to choose for Nyonya foods.

Author: ziKiQKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service, average food
Review: Finally decided to see what the hype was about Yellow Brick Road and Wicked Pancake Parlour.We went as a family of 3 (including our 11-month old) on a Saturday morning and by 10am there was a queue outside the restaurant. As it was quite hazy and I did not see a wait staff from the outside, I walked in to ask if we were going to have to wait long. A waitress came up to me and without even so much of a 'Hello', she ordered me to go back outside as there was quite a queue and promptly left. We walked around the block to see if there was another cafe we could go to but realised everything was shut. Since we were quite hungry, we went back to YBR again and this time were greeted by 2 other staff who promptly showed us upstairs (WPP) where we realised was only half full!We had sat for a full 5 minutes before we were given menus and we asked for a baby chair twice. On the second time a waiter told us that they would bring one to us as soon as they had one available. About 20 minutes later another waitress brought us our order and I asked for a baby chair again, to which she replied there weren't any. Husband walked downstairs and found 3 baby chairs available and brought one up himself. All this was done in the full view of the waiter and waitress who told us that there were none available and neither of them came up to apologise or explain why they couldn't bring one to us in the first place.Baby threw up mid-way of our meal and we decided to clean her up and leave. We explained and apologise to the wait staff about the mess on the floor (I tried to clean up as much puke off the baby chair as possible). Waiter nodded and gave us this grumpy and annoyed look. In fact, every staff we met seemed unhappy and grumpy.The food in itself is average. Poached eggs were overcooked (yolks were almost solid) and the toast was soggy. The coffees had a slightly burnt taste.Overall the experience was anything but frustrating; and we definitely will not be back.

Author: explrdvr37
Title: Average - and pretty hot in August
Review: Nice spot, but lots of mozzies in August in the open air area. Food was local and pricy by local standards and strangely sweet.

Author: RobynL256Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A very pleasant Dining Experience.
Review: The ease of walking to the Impiana Hotel via the pedestrian walkway already made a good start to dinner at Cedar on 15. The Cream of Topin Ambour, made from Jerusalem Artichokes was as delightful as it was unusual. The Porcini Mushroom soup was also lovely. The presentation of the soups was interesting as the empty soup bowls were placed on the table first and then only were the soups poured in. I had Wagyu Tenderloin which was also very good. We sat inside which had a calm and quiet feel although there was also seating outside with a view, a bar and more city presence. A very pleasant dining experience all in all.

Author: ongjanice1Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Too pricey for Ipoh standard
Review: I only visit this place once in a blue moon especially when I wanna meet up with friends. The food & drinks are pricey (not really value for what you are paying), I suppose you are also paying for the ambiance & the service. Service is not that consistent but acceptable. If the service staff sees a familiar face on your table, the table is usually being treated with more "care".

Author: ZikraOsman
Title: Ruined birthday moment
Review: As a fan of this restaurant ambience and decorations we decided to celebrate my hubby’s birthday there, the online reservation system was so efficient and I wrote a small note asking for a small birthday candle on the dessert (birthday you know ‍♀️)The day of reservation they called me to confirm, at the call I repeated my request, the employee assured me that they will put the candle and they will have a staff to sing him a happy birthday song, I got so excited! But unfortunately at the restaurant non of this happened! Not the candle nor the singing part NOTHING!This is my husband first birthday together so I felt really sad! I know this a long review but I really liked this place before and I’m so disappointed in the customer service.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Handmade Noodle
Review: Their noodles, beef ball, beef slide & pork ball are overrated & overpriced. Atmosphere & service are good

Author: BavaLeela
Title: Yellow leaves and sour bean curds
Review:
We went there on 8/1/19.
Ordered garlic garlic kailan and sizzling beancurd .
Both bad.
Kailan was more yellow than green.
Beancurd was sour.
Complained to the staffs there

No more Nyonya Suan.

Author: courteney0
Title: Nice ambience, food is okay for the price
Review: Stopped by for lunch and ordered from the set menu (19.90 RM). Food is average, but plated nicely and of decent portion. Tea soup is very good. Tea salad is nothing special. Fried bean curd is very tasty and good portion size! This restaurant also sells a large variety of tea and tea accessories. The food is a bit expensive for what you get, but not terrible. Would recommend if you want to splurge a little on the experience/ambience.

Author: shermainelahhKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: a great twist to food
Review: IN LOVE WITH THIS PLACE. DEFINITELY WILL BE BACK TO TRY MORE DISHES.all 6 dishes which i ordered tasted so good with such unique taste. most of the time i dont even realize whats inside cause the combination of taste is so unique it just taste so right on your taste buds.only one thing was a problem, place was too noisy. perhaps adding curtains and carpets will prevent the sounds from bouncing off the walls making the whole place noisy.and the lift. make sure you know how it functions or you'd get trapped!

Author: Cindy C
Title: Very nice casual deli vibe
Review: This is a great soup and sandwich kind of place  You can choose all of your ingredients and custom order, as well as take away with deli breads and cheeses. Price is fair. The service is very slow.

Author: Jon WBarton-upon-Humber, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to eat
Review: This is a great little restaurant good food at reasonable prices. We ate quite late so there were not many people in. This restaurant is in a row of other restaurants which I think are all owned by the same group? Our waiter was called Enam and he couldn't do enough for us. The scallops, prawns, lobster and steak were all wonderfull. The only slight downside was that they charged usctwice on our card, however this was quickly rectified. Hence only 4 stars. Would highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: paraplanner15
Title: Poor service with overrated food
Review: Service staffs arrogant and not bother to serve with smile.Food was expensive and overrated.Nothing above average and yet staffs behaved as if customers owe them a living. Maybe because they think business will continue to flourish due to these "good" reviews and start to act arrogantly.Nothing beats having good service.

Author: schinto
Title: Ingredient not fresh
Review: Only nice presentation on the video. I told them that their prawn wasn’t fresh but they replied that they get their ingredient daily. So?

Author: wombatxBeirut, Lebanon
Title: a mixed experience but overall nice, convenient to Ampang Park hotels
Review: Hip and pleasant steakhouse run by local restaurant magnates. For the record, I am not one who frequents the steakhouses listed in every airline magazine on business travel, so true red meat afficianados may have a different take on the place. I'd had my fill of a week of eating lovely Malaysian street food and was up for a nice glass of wine and air conditioning. Came here once for light meal and once for steak as it was in the same building as the Doubletree (the Intermark complex). A bit pricey for a meal in KL but not bad when compared to your average business traveler steakhouse. Steak itself was near perfect, medium-rare and delicious. Steak are sold by weight so one is at the whims of the "hand cutter". Chimchurri and marrow sauces quite good. Sides were nothing to write home about. I should have tried the brussel sprouts as others were sort of stock. Wine (by the glass) list was small but quality.The place itself is quite nice, dark, and cozy and, as is it open late, a covenient late night option for hotels near Ampang park. Service could use some work. There is a lot of front end doting with bread and drinks and bottled water but then one has to work a bit to flag someone down for a second glass of wine. When I asked (I think nicely) about what appeared to be some sort foreign matter in my drink, I was shunned for a half hour. There seemed to be a bit of social scene on the weekend with a squadron of well-dressed women at the bar and dudes from the Gulf chain smoking cigars in the front seating section. Overall, a nice alternative to hotel dining, a good place to have a business dinner or impromptu date. Probably more interesting places in KL further afield.

Author: Trail29451945156
Title: All great except the bathroom
Review: Great ambiance, great service and great food. It is a premium price location for Ipoh but the bathrooms were worse than anything else experienced in Malaysia

Author: JeanWNSingapore, Singapore
Title: The Medini Food Trail
Review: Gayatri@Medini is located in 1 Medini Hub not far from Puteri Harbour. It’s in new surroundings so there’s a dearth of competition. It serves a buffet lunch of Indian cuisine whose aromas draws one in. Costing about RM27 per pax, it’s positioned in the SG foodie stampede trail. Also serves an ala carte menu. Lunch buffet ends about 3pm and resturant stays open till 10pm. It’s adjoined to a bar which serves liquor n coffee too. Many office workers came to grab their Take-Away lunches in “plastic containers” (unwittingly adding to the world’s plastic nightmares). Some ppl are starting to bring their own containers for take-always Perhaps it would help if one got a discount for BYO containers. Small step for Humankind

Author: KJJ19Sydney, Australia
Title: Best Kept Secret
Review: We bumped into Gin Ger Restaurant while walking around Central Market. It's the best Thai food I had outside Thailand. It is as authentic as you can get. We found this place by chance and I did not expect the food to be so delicious. We had the Tom Yum Goong, Chinese Broccoli with Garlic, Mango Salad and a Fish. It was so, so, very delicious. Service was good as well. Totally recommend Gin Ger for your Thai food cravings.

Author: Caroline-vlt
Title: Romantique
Review:
Very good ! You have to go there ! A bit expensive for Malacca but it is totally worth it. The location was amazing on the river 
And the staff very good and nice

Author: 936danielaoHouston, Texas
Title: Delicious food and very good service
Review: The food and service always exceeds our expectations! During the lock down we were ordering take away and everything was perfect with very good standards. Now that it’s open, we came to have lunch and dinner and the protocols are very good, sanitizer temperature masks etc. we will recommend to come here every time you want to have a good Italian dinner or lunch

Author: AChee74
Title: A bit expensive
Review:
Roti canais are quite normally, nothing special. The naans are quite good. Overall, it seems to cater mainly to students at the nearby university.

The pricing is a but high and the staffs are not too friendly.

Author: mrbrentharris
Title: Not the same as America
Review:
It's not bad... it's just not the same... The food flavoring is different than America... Our waiter was very nice, despite the resturant being super busy...

Overall not a bad experince. Just not the same...

Author: paulchoo
Title: wonderful tasting soup
Review: the soup was rich in flavour and i was amazed at the tastes. the ingredients are real and seriously premium. i also give commendation to the mee sua, which caused an explosion in my mouth. the flavours was WOW! MUST TRY!

Author: london5453
Title: excellent.
Review: i came across to this place by a recomendation of frend of mine..this place is more lively at nite with music and also the concept of lighting source.over all had a best time during nite with a pine beer and also mocktail.good food ,chicken tikka masala was owesome and together with some type chicken grill.i forgot the name. The staff is really ambiouses..helpfull...well worth price and portion of food.will come again soon..

Author: Chin L
Title: Excellent burgers!
Review:
Great place for burgers. Good service.
Wide choices to suit all taste.
A bit pricey but quality is there.

Author: tsun006Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Very caring host
Review: The owner is a lovely chap although I must say our food didn’t quite live up to the massive reviews on TA - It was fine but not excellent. The restaurant lacked atmosphere, it needs a little music going and some art or photos etc. However a friendly owner who is trying his best and a nice clean and tidy place. Worth a visit, perhaps we didn’t order the right things so happy to give them the benefit of the doubt.

Author: TuangWXJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Over priced and over charged
Review: Used to went there few years ago for business lunch and it was good. Visited again yesterday and feel disappointed. Quality of food is deteriorating and became more pricey. Plain Basmathi rice costs RM 7.00 per plate. We ordered 10 initially but subsequently reduce to 7 since we ordered bread as well. The waiter has agreed with the change of order initially but soon we realize that was not true. We were still charged for 10 plates even only 7 was served. Tried to verify with the cashier and waiter but they denied instead. Please be honest, if the order cannot be changed, just serve the amount as paid.

Author: Andriod i
Title: Sorry, to those who nasi lemak, this is the WORST..
Review: Sorry guys, for me this is the worse nasi lemak EVER, I had this morning for my breakfast and it cost me RM 24 for 2 of us, we only took fried chicken, cockle, beef lung and normal Sambal. Sorry, for me the road side mak chik nasi lemak stall much much much nicer even cheap fron this Wanjo. My advise to Wanjo is ask your cook to go and get better simple decent nasi lemak recipe or go to Google recipe. Plssssss. One more thing they use chili boh for Sambal?? This is nonsence at least u mix chili boh and dried chili half/ half and your rendang taste is terrible. Unleast u tell me this is nasi lemak INDON style... Pls send your cook to learn a right way to cook nasi lemak and the other malay dishes to accompanied. I felt cheated and I don't understand way this shop in top 10.. Sorry bro, pls sell your product at good at..

Author: F820OAkareng
Title: Horrible customer service
Review: Tried making reservations but encountered poor customer service. Felt very disrespected and irrelevant ....it’s a strike off the list

Author: Katie C
Title: Nice atmosphere and drinks
Review: Nice chilled out spot for drinks, they have a happy hour everyday 10pm-12am with half price cocktails. Otherwise very expensive if you're a backpacker. I didn't try the food here so can't comment on that.

Author: AdammikaeelJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Lunch
Review: To start, the service was decent despite getting one drink wrong. When my fork fell on the floor, the waiter provided a new one without me asking.The location is great, as is the look of the restaurant.However, the food was really bad. Absolutely bland and somewhat unpleasant. It was difficult to eat such terrible food. We had the Nasi Impian, and a signature noodle soup/curry. Had to force them down so as not to waste.The drinks were expensive.Its sad because the place looks great, and it is popular.We will not return nor would we recommend eating here.

Author: TrinityDmelloKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch At Delhi Royale Restaurant
Review: I was at this restaurant for lunch this afternoon with a friend of mine... It was an "Average" experience at the restaurant. The Staff was not very courteous. Yes, I know every restaurant has their own rules and policies, but there's always a right way to put it to your guest which was missing... the staff made it very obvious about the assistance, like a big favour done.. The Staff needs to be more polite... On asking for spoon and fork, the staff just dumped it on the table. There was no water served or even asked. The quality of the food was ok... The Food was Cold... The menu was not the same which was mentioned on buying our food coupon online. The ambiance and the interiors are nice but nothing happens with it. The restaurant needs a right drive towards hospitality... “Good Food and Good Service” is what people want. There’s no way I will be visiting the restaurant again.. Good Luck Guys...

Author: shashinetto
Title: Halal DimSum
Review: My lovely friend Sharon took me for lunch here as we are both foodie adventurers and I must say the dimsum is good and ambience is great with smiling service. Would recommend my Muslim friends to try it out. Price is ok lah

Author: SarahClarke1702
Title: Nice!
Review: Wide selection of dishes! Everything great atmosphere, staff,food. We had a nice time there! The place is definitely a must!

Author: shobhaj112
Title: Not for vegetarians
Review: I was vegetarian for religious reasons once when I visited. Selections were so limited I ate Kailan in garlic sauce with plain rice. I didnt mind it but I know a lot of people who are full time vegetarians would have scoffed at this selection....or rather lack thereof.

Author: Alwin00325
Title: A taste of local!
Review:
This is a place where you should be! 
Try out the local native food! 
It will definitely satisfy your taste bud!  
Recommended to come with friends or family!

Author: LarrymanChelmsfordChelmsford
Title: Good but not great
Review: I'd had dinner the night before at Yasmine's and thought that was excellent. I then came to Fat Cupid with high expectations. It was good but Yasmine's is better. It just didn't work for me. The food here is well presented. Restaurant is open and can get hot. It's nice enough.

Author: Jonathan NNew York City, New York
Title: Rude waitstaff, bland food
Review: I had bought a ticket to see a film at 11:15, decided to have a little something to eat while I waited. The restaurant looked nice so I approached the host, asked about vegetarian options and wine. Choices seemed fine in both areas so I ask to be sat and I ordered. As soon as my food and wine hit the table, the manager and another service came to my table to tell me that the bar was about to close and ask if I wanted to order another glass of wine, I expressed a little annoyance over the fact that nobody had told me that the restaurant was about to close (as I would have justr gone to any number of the other places nearby that are open a bit later), but the manager assured me that I'd be fine sitting there until 11pm enjoying my meal. Initially, I declined, but it was 10:15 at this point so I reconsidered and went ahead and got the second glass of wine. Why not? I'd definitely be done by 11.Immediately after they brought the second glass a waiter came to the table and said that the restaurant had closed and that I had to leave. I told him that the manager had just told me that it was fine to sit until 11pm. He said no, that the restaurant was closed and that I'd have to drink my wine go. He was exactly that blunt. He came back to the table two more times after that bullying me into leaving until finally I just left having not finished my second glass.On top of poorly trained, rude waitstaff, the food was not inspired, they also only have two choices on their by the glass list. All considered therefore, this place is not worth your time, especially when there are so many other, better options nearby. it was unnecessary stress on an otherwise great evening. If they'd simply told me that they were closing in the first place I would have happily gone elsewhere. I really wish I had gone elsewhere, as Ben's policy seems to be to take your money and then make your meal so unpleasant that you want to leave!

Author: tudora380
Title: They had soup
Review: The eastern cuisine is pretty ok, although a bit expensive. Don't order anything European, as they have no idea how to cook it. Our schnitzel was undercooked, even the second time. The local cuisine menu items have quite small portions.

Author: alenaiziEsam89
Title: Very Good
Review:
Very good food especially if you are a big fan of dimsum/chinese & thai food. Prices were reasonable in my opinion. Service was decent. 

Nothing super exceptional but decent overall.

Author: ErictheViking1805Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely dismal
Review: What can I say. We order our food and the order was not keyed into the system. Needless to say everyone got food and we got nothing. All we got was a extremely bad attempt to apologise. They said ‘sorry’. That’s all. We ended up paying for our drinks and after 1 hour left the restaurant hungry. What a disgrace. No service recovery whatsoever. I hope the owner will read this. But I doubt it. Never coming back again. I doubt they care. To have this kind of service during these times where restaurants have struggled is totally unacceptable. Dammit I am so annoyed.

Author: yogesht49
Title: Slow service
Review: Waited quite long for 2 roti chanai and 2 teh tarik . Place is super crowdwd during public holidays .

Author: WotneyKl
Title: Not as expected .....
Review: We live close to The Olive Tree and having visited their website (accessible via TripAdvisor), went one Saturday for a late lunch @ 3PM. Their website (see image from their 'About Us' section) says they are open from 11AM until 11PM but they are not, as we discovered, they close after the lunch service (2:45). When I pointed-out the discrepancy to the unhelpful guy who was there, he behaved as if it was in my imagination. So .....We've, via Kuala Lumpur Room Service website, used the Olive Tree for home delivery (if you use the restaurant website 'Dial a curry', you need to go pick it up).In the main the food is good but have found the chicken tikka is predominantly leg meat (I like breast meat and the lamb biryani is fatty meat, not what we expected.

Author: veronika_yong2019
Title: Vey rude staff
Review: They write that the restaurant work until 11.30 pm. When we came at 10.50 pm waitress didn't allowed us come to the restaurant. But staff already took money for the car parking and told that that we can get our food. When i asked why they write wrong information waitress didn't give us an answer and go away. So terrible place.

Author: PSDev
Title: Bad service
Review: Waiters spoke broken English, buffet options were sparse. Only the view was good. Food is a shame to Malaysia.

Author: Suria BJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice place, but bad service and average food
Review: The location is indeed very nice, but the food is just average and the service was bad... Maybe if you just want to have a drink and chill out, it is okay, but I wouldn't recommend eating there since you will most probably spend a lot of time waiting...

Author: 548chaimaeeDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Nothing impressive
Review: Very small lounge with a heavy smoke smell ( cigarettes/ Shisha ) however it’s a good place for those who interested in smoking shisha. The vibe and the service are ok

Author: AnpijolaMale
Title: OK in taste & a bit pricey
Review: I entertained a few foreign guests in this restaurant. They are satisfied with the taste.The deep-fried grouper was good, so was stir-fried mixed vegetable. The prawn dish was OK but with very few prawns scattered on a big plate -- it looked awful, and pricey for such a few prawns. The portions for lemon chicken was acceptable, but overcooked.There are little choices for soups. My guests requested for several options, but they failed deliver. We ended up without ordering any soup.

Author: kesharooPJ
Title: Not worth the money...
Review: We booked for a dinner on a Saturday evening and were shown to our table promptly. The table was weirdly large for 2 persons, making it less intimate and the chairs were slight lower than usual and as such makes us feel as though we needed higher chairs. We ordered soup for our starters and steaks for our mains.I got the clam chowder which was really sorry when it arrived, firstly it was lukewarm, and there were only 2 clams in it. I could buy a nicer tin of clam chowder soup from the grocers. It tasted more of milk than anything else. My wife's lobster bisque was adequate, some lobster meat would have been nice, considering prices for starters.The meat was really what we came for and we were disappointed to note that the "doneness" was not quite what we wanted which was medium rare, what came was medium well, with just a shade of pink. As such the meat was drier and required quite a bit of sauce to moisten them. Needless to say we were not happy.Service was okay, the wine and complimentary bread were good, the evening's saving grace. All in all it was not a very good night out, we could have a better steak back home. We would not be back.

Author: a-goumetMelbourne, Australia
Title: Dinner visit on 4th May 2015
Review: The food quality was quite reasonable but the dinner was spoiled by rude waiter with obvious lack of training. I and wife went there for dinner on 4th.May 2015 trusting Hilton Hotel standards. Asked for a quiet corner away from busy family area and was granted a table behind which was great.A male waiter served us all we need but with indifferent attitude. Need to ask for water for example. When we asked him if the carpark ticket is endorable for discount, without a word he use his index finger to twitch a couple of bring it on motion, a gesture to get my wife to submit the ticket to him. Again without a word he went off with the ticket and then came back. I and my wife individually said thank you to him, and with expressionless face, he went off again quite rudely ignored our thanks to him. Shocking experience of hostile service by Vasco's at Hilton KL waiter.

Author: SparklerCLondon, United Kingdom
Title: I LOVE DIN TAI FUNG
Review: There really is nothing to fault, delicious dumplings, with tasty seasoned meat, veg and shrimp and a nice bit of soup too - careful with the chospticks so you don't pop your dumpling and lose the delicious soup. The green beans with pork are amazing and the peanut spicy noodles are one of my favorite noodles anywhere. I don't think the buns are amazing ... but there is so much else to change from it doesn't even matter.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: Hafli_ali
Title: Only for teh tarik...not for lunch dinner or so on
Review: everything is curry....they serve large portion on the plate....floor is filthy with cigs ashes...the only thing is u can chill for teh tarik here...

Author: AshokMelaChennai (Madras), India
Title: Vegetarian South Indian food !!!
Review: Hotel Saravana Bhavan (HSB) is a very popular South Indian hotel chain that serves delicious south indian dishes such as Idli, Dosas, Uthappams, Upma, Kitchadi and so on. I was surprised at the authenticity, quality and taste of the food which I would say even defeats their on food quality in Chennai.

Author: ikcsoo
Title: Nothing to shout about!
Review: Friend has been highly recommending this shop for several times, saying this is a must go place especially for 生鱼粥 (raw fish porridge). So, we drove all the way from Hulu Langat to catch the last order of the day. Ordered the so called yummy mee goreng Chinese style as well as the lobak.Unfortunately, it was a great disappoinment. Food is average and nothing to shout about at all. For raw fish porridge lover, I would definitely recommend Petaling Street's Hon Kee which is 10x better. The lobak seemed to be 'double fried' thus kinda hard / compact. Will I ever come back to this restaurant? Sorry to say, no. Friend,who is my all time makan kaki apologized and told me that the food quality was way better last time and didn't expect it to be so. Hmpp... unfortunately, I won't risk for the second time.

Title: Dinner super satistying
Review: This restaurant is really good, recommend for sure. It is also serves no pork. The family stayed at Dayang Bay and were looking for a cheap but good place to go for dinner. We found this gem. The ordering was really good and useful. He sized the meal well balancing, the best is we had fish, squid, prawns, clams up to 10 dishes for 9 people and it cost us RM250! That was like RM27 per person. To top it off the food was really tasty.

Author: stevekyneNew Taipei, Taiwan
Title: It’s official. It’s off.
Review: I think I’ve been visiting Old China Cafe for about 10 years now. I visit every time I’m in KL, and that is at least once a year. It has been my favourite restaurant in the world in years past.In recent years the service has been getting worse and worse, but the food had stayed consistently great. For that reason, I have continued to recommend it, with the caveat that you shouldn’t expect anything other than surliness and general unfriendliness. Last time I was here (in a flying 7 hour visit), the food wasn’t up to scratch, but it was the first time I’d ever thought this, and so assumed I’d hit an off day.But today... well what the actual...? First to the appetisers of which there were six on the menu. Three were “off”. This was at 1:30pm in the arvo... the restaurant had only been open two hours. Unacceptable.We ordered three mains... one was “off”, so I suppose it was a better strike rate than with the appetisers. The replacement dish suggested by the waiter was a chicken dish that had been overcooked - great sauce with dry chook. Actually sauces on all three dishes were good - so that’s in its favour. All dishes could be described as average at best.It was a telling sign that when we visited there were only three other tables of customers. In years past, the place would have been full at this time of day. You’ve got a myriad other options in this awesome city of food. Choose one of them.

Author: CafeHopper13Skudai, Malaysia
Title: JB sky view at Sky26
Review: A short gateway with my friend. The place had a great view of JB town. The food was nice, we ordered seafood aglio olio and chicken chop, but the beer drinks is just not that test good. The place had live band, but it is a bit low as mostly are sad song. Please be thoughtful of the song chosen.

Author: Serina GHong Kong, China
Title: Impressive Nyonya Foos Experience
Review: I have tried Nyonya SuPei was very impressed by her authentic cooking, ie preparing food from scratch using raw materials. Not only the favors were tasty, the cultural experience that came along each dish being presented deepened my cultural understanding. Definitely worth trying this place out whenever one is in Penang.

Author: desmondc308
Title: Always forgot something
Review: Make sure you check all your orders before you leave the drive through. They always forget the condiments but today was the worst. 3 orders of fries they didn't give and I had to drive back to get it. Thumbs down

Author: petalbearBallarat, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We were staying in the KLCC area so this was a convenient breakfast spot. My partner and I both decided to have the same thing and it was poached eggs on a potato hash thing. When the dish arrived, there was gravy all through the eggs and definitely what we thought it would be. The potato hash thing was not very nice and our poached eggs were a bit too runny. I think the idea of the dish is lovely and there is a lot of room the improve the dish. On the upside, the coffee was good.

Author: Bruce T
Title: Your Tastebuds Will Sing!
Review: One of THE GREAT meals of all time, outstanding ambience, service and food, words do not and cannot describe how happy your tastebuds will be nor the sheer all round excellence of this sublime experience.

Author: christy249
Title: 'Overrated' comes to mind
Review: Ate here today for lunch, because of the good reviews on Tripadvisor. I think this is the same reason that makes other people want to try this place.The food was good, yes it was cheap but you get exactly what you pay for. As for the taste, foreigners that never tasted Asian food may well be mindblown but as for me, the taste is pretty much similar to almost any other nasi shops. Nothing special. The teh tarik was too sweet and customer service is non existent. Not a single smile or greeting was given to me or any other guests. In fact the staff look almost annoyed at having to serve customers.For that reason alone I wouldn't visit again. As I said the food is perfectly adequate but nothing extraordinary or one of a kind. You can get the same in almost any decent nasi shops. Worth one visit though, if only to see what all the hype is about. Too bad because I really wanted to like this place, having walked almost 7 kms from my hotel just to get there.

Author: ImranMarjuki
Title: Superb service by Cafe BLD crew
Review:
Thank you to the following staff for the superb service when our family was having dinner in Cafe BLD. Here are their names:
Theresa, Hanis, Arif, Asyraf,  Vinnie, Harith, Jaj and Eza
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: mamabehartPerth, Australia
Title: Great service, fresh fish, delicious food
Review: Had dinner here on a Monday night. Wasn't very busy. Good variety of food. The food wasn't too salty. Fish was fresh and cooked nicely. Staff was friendly. If you sign up to their VIP, you can get 10% off your meals and more on your birthday.The place is quite clean too. They also have high chair for children.

Author: LxhallKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad lunch
Review: Walking past and seen sign The Magnificent Fish and Chips Bar.Sounds and looks good I thought !The whole menu looks great .I ordered a beer and fish and chips .. Baramundi .When it came it looked great but the fish was cooked with skin on which is a non starter for me .So I asked if I could have another fish without skin ?They were out of cod and offered me Dorado and I said great .I also said I would pay for the first one no problem .So the fish comes , no skin but it was average at best !Anyway I ask for the bill .Bill comes Has 22 for the first fish .. no problem ..But has 44 for the second fish !!So I said to them that they have ripped me off !I fully expected to pay for two fish but at same price .Absolutely disgusting and won’t be back .

Author: fiyond C
Title: Dinner
Review: Bad service attitude and not recommended.We waited for more than 1 hour and ordered 3 courses.But they just informed that no more after we wait 40 mins and we changed the course they left. But after we wait 15 mins more and still left 1 course not come ,we went counter to ask for cancellation and just be informed that actually the meal we changed no more.Really cannot make it and felt bad experience with this restaurant.

Author: urneighbor78
Title: A Lebanese Resto
Review:
....just to taste lebanese cuisine
....calamares and fries were good
....beef and chicken were just okay
....salad maybe too strong for the children
.....expensive mineral H2O
....if you're not into it...don't try
....fancy restaurant
....expensive + corkage fee
....once is enough

Author: krobbo1Penguin, Australia
Title: Great value, food and service.
Review: This is one of our favourite restaurants in Langkawi. It has a pleasant seaside outlook and friendly, relaxed atmosphere. The menu is small but all dishes are delicious and servings are generous. Check the specials for fish of the day - the barracuda is awesome and the steak is great. Good value meals and drinks.

Author: Raisyam M
Title: Good Food with Worst Service
Review: Known for good food. However the service  was bad. Few times request for plain plate. At the end have to take it myself. Plain water portion was really small.

Author: Anmol4uBhubaneswar, India
Title: Overrated Resturant
Review: Over rated Restaurant on trip advisor. Pathetic service, we searched for authentic Indian food but very much disappointed. Over priced and north Indian food was alos in menu but prepared in different style. Almost very dish whether a daal or Cheese item was in some red curry with horrible taste. Naans were not up to the mark. Ok for Dosa or idly only.They may remove the north Indian food from the menu. Not recommended if you are looking for North Indian food.

Author: jnabdullah
Title: Great Turkish lunch!
Review: It looks like a hole in the wall, but the Turkish cuisine is delicious! The bread is delicious out of the oven, and the owner is very friendly to his customers!

Author: driPJ
Title: Nice food with excellent service
Review: The food is fancy and interesting, we thoroughly enjoyed it. Best to make reservations as it can be quite full for dinner

Author: annacheng20
Title: Fruit juice
Review: Red dragon fruit with orange juice is nice! Reasonable price. A place where you can dine in during lunch hour with your family before heading back to KL or other states.

Author: Kirkp_11
Title: Top level service
Review: Very helpfully staff, that were focused on the whole experience, from the choice of wine, to the dessert to Finish a truly memorable dining adventure, and we will definately be going back for seconds on our next visit!

Author: mybig s
Title: good but limited
Review: the food is good but pretty limited due to the size of their operation i guess. not many seating and short operating hours is a drawback. better than fast food i guess.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Subpar frozen food, prepacked paste, small portion
Review: Is it me or I find the food pretty lousy. Most of the items are frozen... Curries are all so "lazy", practically felt I was having pre-packed paste food.. Just wasn't impressed at all.Service was okay - nothing went wrong during lunch but nothing worth mentioning either.Their desserts were alright, but then again, no reason to go back for subpar food..

Author: Gayu_kathyShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Taste -average
Review: We tried the village briyani - signature dish, chicken briyani, chicken soup and chicken kahti - wrap. The briyani portion is generous amount for one person however the taste was just average. If you are come with expectation, you might end up with dissapointment. But the chicken kahti wrap was good, worth to try. The soup was full of spices and corriander which was definately not my preference.

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Superb!
Review: I had a wonderful meal with my guest at this upmarket restaurant in the Shangri-la hotel, Kuala Lumpur.We had the degustation menu prepared by the resident chef, Chef Olivier, details of which can be found on the hotel’s website. The quality, temperature, and portion size was "spot-on" and all dishes were simply delicious.Service was exemplary. The Maitre-d was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The staff were polite and efficient.All in all a very enjoyable and memorable experience.

Author: jacq1111Charlotte, North Carolina
Title: Ugh...
Review: We were SO looking forward to this restaurant since we had been eating at outdoor markets for days. A cool day of AC, good food and Central market shopping. But it was so so disappointing. The calamansi juice was not fresh (tasted like syrup) and was too sweet my kids couldn't drink it. We asked them to change it and all they did was dilute it. The calamari was rubbery and the padthai was way to spicy for the kids (and we live in China and eat Sichuan cuisine weekly). To top it off, the waiter could careless. I wish we just ate at the food court next door.

Author: sambissettMelbourne, Australia
Title: Come here instead of Heli Lounge
Review: We were keen on going to Heli Lounge for a good sunset view, but I realised that Vertigo was a lot higher up, and not a popular. This was a great choice. The bar wasn't at all busy around sunset time, and we got a great view over the city. You can see the Heli Lounge much further down in the distance. The prices weren't actually too bad considering it's in the Banyan Tree.

Author: LiyanaF12
Title: What's wrong????
Review: Lately jemari's service turns from normal to worst! At night, only prawn dishes are available??? No goreng2??? Even eggs also dont have??? Employess did tell us before we order but this is the 3rd time i come and same issue is happening! Giant is only near across the street to buy groceries!!! Such a shame since the food is really2 good!!! Please improve for the sake of your customers, TQ.

Author: jasschen2015
Title: Not a good place for dimsum
Review: Poor quality dim sum...not a good option if looking for good dimsum...many items out of stock after putting in orders...never coming back

Author: SunildeepDNotting Hill, United Kingdom
Title: Shocking Service @ Westin
Review: Called the westing to book reservation for dinner at Prego,First time was transferred and line died called back and lady tells me that they are unable to book because everyone is at a meeting!! Is this a 5star hotel as claimed to be?With this kind of start i say no thank you!

Author: mel1216Noveleta, Philippines
Title: SO..SO..
Review: Its my first time in this restaurant/bar. We chose this place because it is very near to our place. I came with my manager and friends to celebrate my friends birthday. We arrived at about 11:15 something and it took us some time to order because we are waiting for my manager. When we are seating, the waiters gave us the menus.
