We are not informed right away that we need to order because their kitchen will be closed at 11:30. So we're thinking that its okay to wait a little more for my manager. Then, when we got a message from my manager saying that we ordered first I decided to order for him. Then the staff who just stood beside our table for a long time waiting for us to order since he gave us the menu, told us that their kitchen will be closed at 11:30 so we need to order fast! So we ordered some pasta, pizzas, fries, etc. Then he also told us that we need to order dessert as well, so we ordered. I was shock when they served the dessert right away. Take note, dessert was first served before the other dishes. We was so hungry that the first thing that is infront of us is the desserts. I was thinking that we need to order the dessert and they will serve after our dinner. Unfortunately, I was wrong. Food was very good actually. Just the pizza was so dry, nothing special. Then about 1:00 AM I think, we were not advised that they will about to close. Suddenly, they just turn off the music, lights and seat down like showing us that we need to go back.

Author: Jwpgoh
Title: Over-priced and not worth the wait
Review: The food is rather expensive and over-hyped. Rather average peranakan food. With so many competing options in the city area, there is nothing much to rave about.

Author: chetchew
Title: One of the best dim sum places in KL
Review: Great service, excellent food! The only grouse I have is the restaurant is so popular that you need to make reservations or be prepared for a long wait.

Author: Stuart294265Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over priced for the money
Review: This is a nice resturant with nice atmosphere. The food was a little disappointing as we ordered a prime rib which was very tough and not like you would get in an American steakhouse. If staying at the meridian I would suggest going to the new restart and bar by the exception which has great food at much more reasonable prices

Author: Abuu D
Title: Cleaner with Bad Attitude
Review: My wife & kids went here on friday. there is this aged waitress/cleaner supposed to be the owner's mom. My wife realized that the waitress giving a long sour faced stare and kept on shaking her head while looking at my 2 yrs old kid eating a bit messy on the table. What do you expect for 2 yrs old kid eating by himself? Imagine if my kid spill drinks and be much more messier? how will she treat us? She doesnt even try to give a smile. They have Good food but Service wise as i mentioned to u guys Its all Loooonggg Sourrr Faceeee Staring at my kid like having a grudge against a 2 yr old.

Author: saadiahaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dine at the Top of Melaka
Review: Nice ambience with good food. The 360deg skydeck is easily access from the restaurant. No entrance fee required to pay if you are hotel guest. French menu and simply delicious. The lamb steak is yummy. They served a surprise piece of cheese cake with nice decorations fr birthday person . Staffs served us diligently and very tactful with our needs.

Author: Darrel M
Title: Extremely Friendly Staff
Review: The food was superb, my chaps that were with me were impressed and despite having to fork out a bit more and having to wait quite a while to be seated, one is easily impressed by the quality of the dishes and the much-inviting staff.

Author: erico f
Title: Tasteless Meat
Review: RM 50 for half slab.  Meat is tasteless. Rather disappointed.  I would have expected more tasty from this well known restaurant chain.

Author: Traveller_J0Malaysia
Title: Definitely number one romantic KL experience!!
Review: It took us a few errors in finding this place, including taking the wrong information about it being at the hotel nearby, but if you drive past 7/11 you've missed it!! The food was outstanding but a little pricey, there are set menu's or a la carte, but if you have a la carte, don't expect the sorbet or petit fours during your meal. The venue itself is truly romantic, decorated with long theatrical drapes with hundreds of sparkling crystals suspended from the ceiling……if I could've, I would have reserved my valentines night table there and then. The staff are great, and try their utmost to give a good waiter service. It would be brilliant if Cafe Cafe could open another restaurant nearer to KLCC. Please don't count the crystals as I may have exaggerated on 'hundreds'……….ha!!ha!! A must for any true romantics. Top tip………Propose at KLCC whilst watching the fountains dance, make your way to Marini's on floor 47 for a glass of champers,then have a blue cab (or a limo) take you to Cafe Cafe for exquisite French cuisine.

Author: hinasoo88
Title: favorite restaurants
Review: I enjoyed my dating with my friend to have dinner there, the grilled chicken with a different spicy sauce

Author: ammadzMaldives
Title: Genuine Thai, Malai Thai!
Review: Staff at Malai Thai are dedicated, friendly, service-oriented and delivered to my expectations. I believe all the servers are Thai nationals - makes it a lot more genuine. Talking about genuine, food (omg! the food) is really gooooooooood! I would recommend to try a little bit of everything, you will be up for a treat - check it out. I am definitely coming back next time I am in KL. Good location and easy access too. If you are in the mood for a drink after dinner (or in my case pre-dinner), there's a pretty cool Tapas joint right outside on your left. PS: Thanks a lot for packing that Papaya salad for take-away. :-)

Author: pinkgiraffeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Most amazing putu piring in the world
Review: Soft, fluffy full of fragrant gula melaka goodness!! It's so yummy and worth the queue by the roadside. Book online via their Facebook page if you are ordering a lot. Must try if you are ever in Melaka. According to my knowledgeable Malaccan friend, the gula melaka (palm sugar) used is made the traditional way by a seller whose shop is opposite the putu piring place. Bought a packet of the gula to make my own ondeh-ondeh at home.

Author: Tenshi C
Title: Dissapointed visit.
Review: Racist host that doesn't serve the asian and feedback on food was not well received.Waited there for so long and was not served. A group of Caucasian came in and they were served before us. The 'menu board' was shifted to face the Caucasian and all we could do is wait. If it was not because of the rain, we would have left.

Author: VinodN30
Title: Expensive.
Review: It was just way too expensive. Walk a little ahead and you'll get a Beer for RM16 instead of the RM32, with a river view to go with it. Just too pricy.

Author: Mitchell_Lim
Title: The Lesser Outlet
Review: Cafe is located at very strategic location in the mall. Access is easy (centre court) but not convenient for those on wheels (raised platform seating area).Having dined at all their outlets, they have most areas to improve on despite being around for quite some time..both service speed, staff warmth & food quality (rather inconsistent). On a crowded day, it's naturally busy for them. Based on observations, if customers procrastinate on what to order, being grumpy & hasty are qualities they usually exhibit. Surely, there are better ways to manage the situation.Moreover, quality of coffee doesn't commensurates the price tag!

Author: efay
Title: Great ice-cream
Review: Great ice-cream in a cool comfortable location. Staff are friendly and it’s a great place to catch your breath after exploring Ipoh.

Author: NurA5599
Title: Bad service, disappointing food presentation
Review: It was only 11 am and not many people were around. But the service was verrrryyy slow. They prioritize take away orders that came much later than others who dine in. It's order over the counter concept but they tend to ignore when you have stood infront of the counter unless they think they are ready to take your orders. Which is okay but they couldve told to the customer nicely. Tables were not properly cleaned either. 2-3 tables were occupied with uncollected dishes. The food arrives so late and looks disappointing. The teh tarik was nice. They dont give tissues together when the food arrive unless u go to the counter.

Author: 32elvinat
Title: First timer
Review: Good ambience and comfortable place but don't expect us to memorise the pastries name and go to the counter to order. Do insert in to the menu. It'll be more helpful =)

Author: Basheersalem
Title: Worst experience
Review:
The food is really bad,grills all cold  shrimps also cold 
chops oily and not real chops  it's something else 
tappoula not fresh  
all in really bad experience and I won't repeat it even for free

Author: Wolv3rin3
Title: Granny's delight
Review:
One favourite lunching place. There you'll find your local favourite hawker's fare.
Today's choice for me is Cantonese style beef kuay tiao, a flat rice noodles. Friends ordered Hainanese chicken rice and mee bandung.

Author: doboyz_CAN
Title: Absolutely Aweful place
Review: Buffet was so limited and not even filled when it's empty.  Service was awful, need to keep asking staff for water refill and plate to be clear.  No wonder the restaurant was nearly empty during lunch time.  This was a sign I should have noticed.

Author: seehowSingapore
Title: Overpriced
Review: Totally overpriced. Was given wet towels (not those disposable) at first and thought was quite a good service only to realize that we were charged 1.80 each for that before service charge and gst. Porridge was bland. Curry fish head was lousy. Roasted chicken took so long till we finished all our food. First and last. Rm330 for 5 pax not even filling.

Author: keltzar
Title: A bit dated but comfortable
Review: A bit sterile. Not much to say... we hung out there, had drinks and a cigar. Comfortable if you're in the hotel... but hardly somewhere that's a destination in itself.
Restaurant: Lobby Lounge at Renaissance Kuala Lumpur Hotel

Author: Ellie B
Title: It's the view!
Review: I enjoyed the canapes and finger foods. A great place to go for a drink and the view! And I think it's one of those places where you can have a grown-up conversation over a good drink!

Author: sjman41Penang, Malaysia
Title: Warning-Think Twice
Review: My wife and I visited the restaurant on 26 Dec2021 for dinner around 6:30 pm. The person greeting me at the door inquired whether I had a reservation and I said "No, how could I?" and I showed him on my phone that I had dialed their number as listed on the web 6 times between 3:00-4:30 pm and always got a Call Back response. He then mentioned it was the owner's number who was now in Spain. Curious to use that as the only contact number in their Web listing. They were fully booked but we could sit at the bar which we accepted. The waiter plunked two dishes in front of us, but even after waiting did not bother to furnish place mats like I saw done for all other dishes already set. The personnel and atmosphere (we were the only ones in the restaurant at that time) just felt wrong and we decided to leave. But at the door another staff member inquired why. I told him this purportedly was a somewhat upscale restaurant, certainly not cheap, and that I felt slighted by not having place mats and just bad service. His excuse was they were fully booked, as if that is a reason. He never apologized for the inconvenience but his parting words when I left the restaurant were " We also don't want people like you here". That probably characterizes the level of this establishment. Nobody looked remotely Spanish rather I felt I was in a Pakistani/Bangladshi restaurant.I have no idea about their food and never will. For sure the staff I have seen has absolutely no class.

Author: Helen BDerbyshire, United Kingdom
Title: Not good experience
Review: We visited this restaurant on the 2nd night of there opening and they have a lot to do to bring up to standards of a 5 star hotel! So many things I could write about that were so wrong, no pizza available as ran out of dough!!! The atmosphere was not of an Italian feel. Very disappointed with food and experience
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Andrew CKuala Lumpur
Title: Celebrating Valentine
Review: The ambient is great with friendly & professional service... the foods here are great too especially the racks of lambs, a must to try!

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap and friendly
Review: Dined here for a quick late bite to eat - the food is relatively cheap and the staff are friendly. We had noodles, house special egg fried rice, crispy crab/fish cakes, squid and chicken claypot. The chicken in the claypot had a bit of a weird twang to it which put us off a little. Squid and other dishes were nice though.

Author: Samuel CIskandar Puteri, Malaysia
Title: Nice, but limited
Review: Coppola is a very pleasant bar/ restaurant with a genuine Italian pizza oven.Even though the restaurant is somewhat separated by a dividing wall, the relatively small size of the place means that the atmosphere can be dictated by just one or two groups of customers. I have been in here when it has been overcrowded by a few families, dominated by some sports loving men and almost dead quiet. This does not detract from the fact that not only is the food tasty (although on the expensive side for Malaysia), it is also a nice place to have a drink and watch some sports.The menu seemed a little limited, with no sides and the pizzas all of the same type (thin crust base). There are pasta and salad options.The drinks are no more expensive, in fact possibly cheaper than elsewhere in Malaysia.I also thought that there was not enough seating available, nor the screens quite big enough to call this a proper sports bar, or enjoy the sports that are clearly a feature of the place.Perhaps it suffers from a captive audience, with a huge condo block directly opposite, and it does a roaring trade in take away pizzas.

Author: JIMZA_LUK
Title: NICE AMBIENCE
Review: Try to dine at The Ship if you are looking for a good western steak or menu. The place is conveniently located in Bukit Bintang area. They also have branches in Damansara Utama and Penang.

Author: damiantehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Spacious with great staffs
Review: Went there on 4/4/13 after group meeting and was amazed of the ambience. The mixture of old building with new renovation just was the perfect blend. Staffs were friendly and courteous from the begining. Food portion was as usual large but still tasty. From the previous reviews, I believe they have improved. But what blew my mind was the band. Crazy good. Especially when they sang Bohemian Rhapsody. OMG! By that song alone, it is worth the trip again. Go check it out

Author: alice8829Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Don't come with high expectations
Review: We came here because a friend was gushing over the food and insisted that everything was delicious. For the price, the food had better be good (mains were in the RM30+ range). Maybe that was the issue for us, coming in with such high expectations. I had the spicy shasouka. It came with 2 eggs, and I may be wrong but I was expecting runny eggs (maybe I should have requested it to be done this way). The eggs were practically overcooked, with like a plasticky layer over it. The whole dish was a little on the salty side.Tried the lobster bisque, and the seafood bisque linguine. Both tasted the same - salty and had a very strong "seafoody" smell to it. I'm not a seafood expert, so maybe bisques were supposed to taste like that, but the overpowering salty seafood smell did put me off after the first spoonful.Service was a little on the slow side, we sometimes had to request for the same thing twice. But they were accommodating to our huge party, and didn't try to shoo us off even after we've finished our meals (there were guests waiting to be seated).I don't mind paying for expensive food if it is worth it, but based on my one experience here, I would not visit again.

Author: JamesKwok
Title: Nice and great atmosphere
Review: Great and authentic food at reasonable price. Staff were helpful and attentive. will come again if I am around the area.

Author: charhugkiss
Title: Average bowl of noodles
Review: Came to the store on a wednesday.  Shop was full house.  Managed to make a table shortly.  Waited for 20-30 mins for my bowl of noodles and find the noodles pretty average.  Not to my liking maybe.

Author: Thin Chay H
Title: Captain is rude and bad manners
Review: On 8 Oct, I went to buy pizza for take away on, so I waited at an empty table outside. The restaurant was quite empty at that time around 6.20pm. A couple came and the waiter tried to separate the next 4 seater table to create a 2 seater for the couple. However, Captain instead asked me to vacate the table so that the couple can take the table. I asked the couple whether this is their choice but was told it was the Captain's decision. This is rude and unacceptable behaviour of the Captain as there are many tables empty nearby! I hope the management will train the staff properly. We are all customers and deserve equal treatment!

Author: foom839Pantai Tengah, Malaysia
Title: Thanks Wan and the team for awesome 8th Anniversary dinner
Review: Made a reservation thru phone 2 days advance to reserve a nice spot with sunset view.Went there 6:30 PM and the view is just great and windy. Ordered their Signature Nasi Campur and one Fish & Chip. All foods are fresh and taste good! Especially their fish.Wan, the person in charge did an amazing job helping us to get a nice seat, bring us plain water and even gave us a surprise cake for our anniversary. Well done to Wan and the team! We had a great experience here & highly recommend whoever visit Langkawi to visit here.

Author: nickohlongKlang, Malaysia
Title: Fair taste BKK
Review: The BKK are served in Claypot & Dry style. They served some side dishes too.The taste is fairly good but not one of my favorite BKK hangouts. I only take my outstation friends here for their first time taste of BKK. This is due to its easy to find location and the ample parking around it.Service is so so and do expect to sweat it out like most BKK outlets. Price wise...you pay for what you eat

Author: noherrt
Title: Poor Customer Service
Review: We ordered breakfast, she had the acai berry smoothie bowl and I ordered a 'choose your own' salad with warm ingredients.My food was prepared and served within 15 mins. The smoothie bowl took a subsequent 30 mins to arrive (therefore 45 mins in total). I had not eaten yet as I was waiting for my partner's dish to arrive.By that time my warm dish was cold and dry, I asked the server for a new one. He returned with my 'new' dish. However it was merely reheated - I could clearly tell as I had broken the rice when it first arrived in a distinctive manner and the new dish was served in the same manner. When I told the server this he denied reheating my food and insisted it was a new dish. That got me angry - there are a variety of ways to deal with a customer's complaint - lying is definitely not acceptable. I paid for the acai smoothie, refused to pay for the salad and we left. On a side note the acai smoothie was apparently very good. But that cannot excuse such poor customer service.

Author: garyng6666
Title: Salty
Review:
Service was good. The place was clean. Order paella,  lasagne, calamari, aglio olio, lamb balls and escargot. The food is alright but they were salty. 

Maybe the cook was a bit heavy handed but it spoilt our first visit.

Author: Ady H
Title: Reasonable food, good shisha.
Review: We had the chicken sherwama platter and lamb kebab. They were both a little dry but well spiced. But they did have what is probably the best shisha in KL.

Author: cirqueJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Signature Mushroom Pao is Out of this World
Review: Menu is definitely creative, ambiance is very nice, but most people will grab the seat at the terrace as the city view is definitely stunning. We were seated outside overlooking Grand Hyatt. Amouche bouche is served in unique tiffin box and it was really creative. We then move to Heirloom Tomato Salad which was tasty and ordered a Mushroom Pao which the associate said it was the signature dish and we did not disappoint. The texture of Pao was so soft and the filling is mixed between minced mushroom and sauce which give creamy texture. We also ordered a duck and fig entree and it was delicious as well. I wish I would spare some space for dessert as the selection was tantalizing too!

Author: dharroshanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great ambience and selection, however....
Review: had frequented this restaurant several times before, however my dinner visit a moment ago was really horrible from service to food.no doubt it has a great selection of food and lovely ambience, however my visit this time was a regret. quality of food has dropped as well as it serviceonly two customer (which had their food served) and 5 employees at the restaurant and it took 19 minutes for the food to be served and definitely the quality of the food has dropped

Author: 987johnt
Title: Authentic Chinese breakfast
Review: Recommended if you want to experience some local Chinese breakfast ~~ nice hospitality from lady boss

Author: taoki207
Title: Good taste and it’s unique
Review: Good taste and it’s unique to see making porridge under the steaming plate. Staff are friendly and nicely served. Be careful when you order clams chosen from tank. Looks reasonably priced per kg but weight includes clam shells. Felt so pricy when I looked at edible portion.

Author: eagle-am05
Title: Bad service
Review: I had to get the attention of the waiter and waitress a couple of time. To take order, to refill my Ocha, and I had to walk over to get their attention. Most of the staffs are not paying attention. Another customer did the same by walking over to call the waiter to take order. I have been to this place several times but today’s service is very bad.

Author: SammyHizMelbourne
Title: Enjoying all until...
Review: We were loving everytjhing about Bla Bla Bla. The decor is great, the serving staff very efficient, the food we ordered very tasty. I was verging on giving it an Excellent rating, until we realized they sell shark fin. I am totally against killing an animal just for 1 small part of its body then chucking it back in the sea alive where it can no longer swim and will eventually drown.

Author: kimlkimfdPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best chicken chop in town ?
Review: Went there because they claimed to be the best chicken chop in town Well of course the statement is way over exaggerating the whole situation The grilled chicken (tried both mushroom and black peppers ) are just of ordinary quality With this price (RM16) and environment and service, I don’t think it’s worth it

Author: wanderlustbyjaneKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: It was okayyyy..
Review: Initially we wanted to go over to Pak Kong but they were closed so we decided to try the next best listed which was Lou Wong. The guy who took our order wasn't friendly at all. Instead of looking at you when you are placing an order, he looked up to the ceiling instead making us felt a little stupid for talking to someone who doesn't want to be talked to. We ordered white chicken, bean sprout and rice. Standard dishes. Chicken was quite tasty, nothing so spectacular about it but definitely a bit tastier than what we can normally find in Kuala Lumpur. No soup though. Two person's portion chicken, with 1 person portion bean sprout, two plates of rice and drinks costed RM39. Very expensive if you asked me. But if this is your first time visit, I would say give it a go.When we were leaving, a bunch of Caucasian tourist came in and you can see the 180 degree change in that one guy who served us. He smiled and said, "Welcome!!!" to them..

Author: DanarajaS19
Title: Awesomeness
Review: It was right from the start the ambiance, the people, and the setting which made the difference from others...simply awesome

Author: KTerence
Title: Good food, great service!
Review: Good quality food. Suggest to try the mouth-watering yet simple wagyu. Service: the staff was very attentive and quick to respond to my requests especially the trainee, Marcella.

Author: Clarissaanne
Title: Lunch
Review: Place with ver nice ambient and friendly service. Offered great varieties of food and drinks. Good place for hang out.

Author: HelleborinIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Reasonable Prices, High-quality Indian cuisine
Review: Yes, it's a cafeteria, but it's cafeteria food is On Point. I'm not kidding. I told a friend about this place and she was like "..You serious bro?" and I was like "Seriously try it" and she went and was like "Holy rice balls this is good." I personally prefer their lunch style over dinner, although both are good. (Naan only served at night). Lunch is a sort of buffet style pick-and-mix (almost no waiting time!), with rice on a banana leaf and a choice of dal or curries that the server gloops artfully over your rice. The aloo gobi is awesome. The curry fish and chicken dishes are all awesome. Everything's flavourful and really fragrant while not being so spicy that you drown yourself in lassi. (Their mango lassi is also good - a little too sweet, but okay once the ice melts)Quite good for value by the way. Because they're not a fancy restaurant, you avoid the fancy restaurant prices and still get good food that matches the quality of, say, Tandoor Grill. The service has never let me down so far, and the manager's a nice guy. The only con is that it's not air-conditioned. The place is well sheltered so it's never too hot, but keep that in mind anyway.

Author: Steve F
Title: Great Food and Service
Review: We loved the great service and food for our stay. The staff were very attentive and a credit to the hotel.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A watering hole just down the road from Ramada Plaza Melaka
Review: We found this place by chance (Googled nearby watering holes) as the lounge at our hotel was closed for the night. This place was not too bad – there was a live band playing that night. The ambiance was relaxing, however I found it a tad too cold. The place is fairly new, so they didn’t have any beer on taps at that point, only by the bottle.

Author: timd87260Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: very good...but maybe no longer the best?
Review: In past visits, for me, the buffet breakfast here at Latest Recipe was the best in KL. The variety and quality of food and service was always excellent. In this most recent visit, I noticed that the variety of food had been reduced somewhat, but the quality of food and service was still excellent (except for the coffee...I think they must have changed brands for the restaurant as the coffee upstairs in the club lounge was still as good as before). I suppose that's down to the times we're in (pandemic). I will return for the quality of food and service, but I hope to see the variety return to excellent as well.

Author: Mikapalloza
Title: Outstanding service, food and beer
Review:
You don't need to look any further....this is the bar for you. Very friendly staff who look after everyone even though the bar may be busy.
Food is really nice and atmosphere is friendly.
Check it out!
Thomas the waiter is a legend too.

Author: reins76
Title: Disappointing
Review:
Breakfast- inconsistent service and cooking
Dinner- very disappointing pizza, not like an Italian pizza, very American-cheesy with a bad base.  Very disappointing pasta dry stuck together pasta with dry ordinary sauce.  Expensive for poor quality food in a country/city full of cheap, delicious food

Author: Joeinshenzhen
Title: Fantastic
Review:
Wondeful experience here. Warm welcoming staff. Artistic cool vibe with paintings on the wall.

Extensive menu. 

I had to salmon.  Was excellent.  42RM. Lots of choices. Big portions. 

Seriously you have to go here

Author: Victor T
Title: Nice restaurant for meal
Review: Better come early for meal in this restaurant or else have to wait for table. Overall meal is nice and pricing is acceptable. Need to find parking at the back lane of the restaurant.

Author: Ann SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food, good staff!
Review: I loved eating in Quivo. One of the best to have food with friends. Great location. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. Food is very good. We ate pasta, chicken and beef burger, all delicious. Quite a big menu. Good range of drinks, but costly, an ice lemon tea for RM 16. And Chocolava with ice cream is RM 18 :D :D. Great ambiance, very good seating. I am surely visiting again, but no drinks.

Author: KhidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Never again
Review: We were full of expectancy before we came here for lunch after reading the reviews. We arrived about 20 mins earlier and discovered to our dismay that they only open at 12 pm sharp so we had to go another place to grab a drink and waited for the restaurant to open.Indeed, the decor is great but that is about all you get. The service from one of staff who seems to be the in-charge was severely lacking. He greeted us with a sour face and never acknowledged us each time we said thank you. When we asked to return or replace the sashimi ordered because the maguro looked very aged, he kept telling us this was how it was supposed to look. The meal all the way downhill after that. We just could not wait to finish our unpleasant meal and leave.For people like us who have travelled to Japan and had Otoro and Maguro at Tsukiji and Kuromon markets, the sashimi they served was a sad excuse. The slices were too thick and the maguro was almost brown in colour. I have never sashimi so lacking in lustre (see photographs). In the end, he reluctantly replaced the maguro with salmon although we requested for Hotate and were willing to top-up for the difference. His reason was that the Hotate were still frozen. Are you kidding me? How can a restaurant open for business at 12 pm and some of your ingredients are still frozen?If there is anything I can find to praise about this restaurant, it was the waitress who is working part-time there. She is a gem and I hope the restaurant recognises her value.

Author: Ongkarseng
Title: Bad service, average food quality
Review: Sitting more than 15 minutes and yet no one to clean the table. Worst service I ever experienced at dim sum place
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: nellielim
Title: Flame grilled chicken
Review: This outlet is located on the 4th Floor of NuSentral and serves the normal menu of flame grilled chicken. Food is ok here but service is terrible and has to be improved.

Author: irsyadistKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The worst ever
Review: I had my visit today at this horrible restaurant expecting a good meal with a fair service but none was received. It was during lunch hour and this place couldn't cater a huge crowd at one time. They were under staff, there was no one at the front. The food we ordered had mistakes. Your staffs are incompetent in terms of communication. Everything was slow. Th fact that I was rushing, i couldnt able to enjoy my food properly. Would I advise this to my friends? I'd say go elsewhere with better service. Definitely spreading out words that this place has one of the worst if not the worst place ever.

Author: 4896Jk
Title: Ridiculous
Review: What i had in this restaurant most nice are the dessert, kimchi soup too salty , sukiyaki salty , sashimi normal nothing special , udon over cooked , grilled salmon over cooked

Author: MalaysiaMelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Coliseum Cafe Sunway Pyramid branch
Review: This is a kind of strange review as I love the original restaurant as much as I dislike the branch at Sunway Pyramid, but the facts should be known.I have been eating in the Coliseum cafe for many years and have always enjoyed the food plus the history and ambience, all of which is hard to match. My memories are of smokey rooms with ancient Chinese waiters serving great steaks and heaps of fresh bread and butter and I have many times brought friends and associates there for dinner. Most of these friends loved it and returned often.Today I took my wife, my daughter and one of my daughters colleagues for lunch at the Sunway Branch, where I had never eaten before and was shocked. I ordered one of the priciest items on the menu, a tenderloin steak and asked for it to be cooked medium. What arrived on a smoking iron plate was a chunk of tough (but tasty) rare sirloin steak with no side dishes. Could it have been tenderloin? Only if they had somehow found a tough piece and filleted it the long way.I missed the never ending supply of Hinanese bread and butter but was blandly told by the waiter that they no longer served bread . So if you enjoy a good steak, plus the genuine atmosphere of a 1921 British planters rest house I can recommend the branch at Tunku Abdul Rahman, but would suggest that you stay away from the one at Sunway. This suggestion is somewhat supported by the number of diners in each branch - Sunway was about 15% occupied while I often have to wait for a table at the original cafe.

Author: Mike Kathryn RKhancoban, Australia
Title: Very disappointed
Review: We have been to the Apartment at KLCC several times and it has previously been quite nice and affordable. This time we were disappointed on several levels. The prices had risen quite markedly - no doubt the reason would be due to GST even though GST is only 6%. Our second gripe was that service was slow and on two occasions we had to re-order our drinks because the waiter had forgotten to put our order in! To add insult, our meals took a long time to arrive and when they did, one meal (chicken) was hot but the fish meal was cool and the potatoes were almost cold. It was inedible. We refused to pay for the meal and asked them to take it away, which was not a problem. While we were invited to order a new meal, we decided not to as we would be eating separately. A very dissatisfying evening which will influence where we eat next time.

Author: 646lingm
Title: Services
Review:
Very friendly staff , best food .. love Jonathan and Marvin .. service on time and helpful . 

I will be back everyday .

Author: ariane_hotzelFrankfurt, Germany
Title: ...not recommended/ possible for families
Review: We wanted to go there to celebrate my birthday. Luckily I went there to make a reservation (we wanted to go for an apperitif at the rooftop bar and for dinner in the restaurant) not possible with a child ...

Author: ushkavivek
Title: Food & Service Excellence
Review: I loved how cozy and comforting the place was and how well the staff treated us. Loved the food. We ordered the Chicken Nachos, Mutton Fried Rice. The Seafood Pasta was my favourite! I had the Lychee Martini and requested for more lychee in it. The manager Raman was sweet enough to add more lychee to my drink. Loved how they took good care of us. Also met their awesome chef, the lovely Sharmini. Ask for the both of them on your next visit to have a super excellent service!

Author: VivianLooPT
Title: Great services with warm hospitality
Review: Great service from Leng & June, good hospitality, really feel at home, We will come back again and again. Highly recommended.

Author: 658jannas
Title: nice jap shabu!
Review: worth the price!! the food was nice and fresh! recommend the milk spicy soup... very nice! order the beef to go with the soup! the chicken slices were normal only... try the cheese meatballs too!

Author: Audrey L
Title: Horizon Grill in Banyan Tree KL
Review: Fantastic meal amidst breathtaking scenery! A must for first time visitors to Kuala Lumpur or that special occasion!

Author: y_sharadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just Average... Don't waste your time!
Review: This place is in magnificent Suria KLCC 4th floor giving a feel of great dining but this is actually a mediocre restaurant. I ordered green prawn curry and got chicken curry and when I reverted back got prawn curry only after half an hour with multiple reminders. Bunch of stupid ppl take orders and it's pretty heavy on your wallet too.

Author: H7167ORtimf
Title: Fun!
Review: Holy guacamole was a fun experience at night!! Good love music and nice people made it a great vibe.  We also went during the day and it was delicious. Great food!!

Author: Michael L
Title: Drink and buy tea
Review: Visiting Purple Cane is an opportunity to savour various types of tea in a very nice ambience.  After you have decided which tea you like, you can place your order for a packet to take home.  Purple cane also serves some delicious local desserts.

Author: kr0elleAmman, Jordan
Title: Nothing special for hotel buffet
Review: Gobo Chit Chat is of the usual kind of hotel buffet restaurants. Nothing particularly exciting. Service is kind, but clientele really doubtable. The restaurant should enforce a dress code and create separate spaces for large parties and families with infants.

Author: AKnomad907
Title: Great for dinner
Review: Always seek these out when i'm staying down in CT. Good food at reasonable prices.  Tends to get pretty busy in the evenings but they can usually wrestle you up a seat if all are full at their stall.

Author: ngorkongleitengSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Total disappointment
Review: We made an online reservation via their website. Travelled 25km with family and arrived there exactly on time. The lady behind the counter told us we had no reservation. We showed her the Whatsapp confirmation and told her we even have an email confirmation. She continued the rhetoric and also said the online app does not work very well. Hey, it is the official website and the TableApp is the mode used by the website. But no, she kept up the rhetoric and offered no apology. Knowing the App does not work properly but did nothing to resolve it is bad attitude and poor management. The way she talked to us like we were so wrong was also infuriating. Will put this restaurant on blacklist.

Author: dasmayak
Title: The food was 'so so'
Review: I disliked it because it was not clean from the greasy tables and oily cutlery. Food was nothing that much to shout about but looking at the prices it was expected. Popular with the locals it seems.

Author: AliAzzamShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Crowded but damn good
Review: Last year visited this area but there are no credit card facilities. This time around they have it. The food is marvelous and is so damn good. The seafood is so fresh. Go ahead try the steam fish and their fresh water prawn steam with eggs. Oh my .my...still thinking about it today.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: katana4222Singapore, Singapore
Title: Over priced Nasi Lemak which is edible and poor quality of chendol..
Review: Had a try at their Nasi Lemak after hearing ppl ranting about it... Had a try, disappointed in e rice (not very fragrant) I had tried better ones, along a street stall along jln alhor. The chendol if anyone would try, I would advise they to pass it.. And doesn't help that the a/c.is not cooling.

Author: YeeY124
Title: Go for fried instead of grill
Review: Grill chicken chop with mushroom sauce taste average nothing much to shout about, fried rice a bit tasteless

Author: maryjane7212019
Title: Freaking Hot!!!
Review: The old Pelita Nasi Kandar have move to Zouk old building. It's spacious but they have a poor cooling systems! Imagine you're here in the middle of the afternoon??!! The spotlight making it more worst it is right above your head and you can feel the heat from it!!! The floor is dirty! The price is high but they can't even install a big fans for their customers!!!!!!!

Author: 49karenlSudbury, United Kingdom
Title: THE BEST MEAL IN MALACCA
Review: I found Nancy's Kitchen Restaurant on one of my research forays for our trip. I am so glad I did as it proved to be the best meal we had in Malacca.Nancy's is not located in the main town area but a traxi ride away at a site where there are multiple eating abodes.The food is all Nonya and excellent, the restaurant is quite basic and not at all grand the food is delicious and excellent value, I understand there are cookery classes available too, which I am sure would be worth attending.

Author: Noren17y
Title: It was ok. So so. Service poor
Review: It was ok. So so. Service was poor. They need to train their staff on how to take orders, deal with customers and to know their menu. It would be a good idea to inform the customer what is not available for the day before they start making their choices. Also, if the lobster is going to take 20 minutes or more, might be best to say so so the customer can decide if they have the time to wait. It wasn’t worth a 5 hour drive. The only kind available was the spiny lobster which was small and didn’t have much meat.

Author: 111Laura111London, United Kingdom
Title: Service with a smile
Review: We really enjoyed lunch here. The staff were incredibly friendly and we thought the local food on the menu was delicious and exquisitely presented (they also serve some western dishes). If you're looking for a beer/G&T with your meal, this was one of the few places in the locality where you could order alcohol. They also have wifi.Only thing to note if you're prone to mosquito bites is that a lovely little pond stretches along the back of the bathrooms. I'll spare you the details, but I wish I'd applied some deet beforehand!

Author: PerthVince_KPerth
Title: The Wanton Noodle is superb
Review: This is the equivalent of doing the "Char Chan Teng" of Hongkong without having to fly there and stay in expensive hotels. The HK Milk tea is up to par, the wanton noodles is what I considered as superb in the texture. Best to go with a group of friends to be able to share in a variety of great snacks.

Author: edwinchowywMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A low class joint - really not worth the visit
Review: We had dinner in this restaurant on the 25.8.19. My wife and me with my 3 lovely children.I think I should just go straight to the point 1. The bread took 30 minutes to arrive. And it was only after we had to request for some 2. They served my daughter ‘s carbonara after 45 minutes . Then it was another 30 minutes of wait for the other main course to arrive. 3. The carbonara was watery- never had a watery soup like carbonara in a 5 star hotel restaurant before.4. The service is ridiculous poor.And it is just a waste of my time writing more about the low quality food and service in Olio.Olio .. I will remember you for a very long time.Trust me.. the food at the nearby hawker centre would be more satisfying...Horrible experience

Author: LeandroP1711
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Very good food and service! Good choice of vegetarian dishes. Definitely coming back recommending to friends!

Author: ericchoe
Title: Terrible service but nice food*
Review: The two star review definitely only giving for the food, the food were perfect but service was terrible. From the moment one of the guy with suite taking order, the experience was bad not even "mamak" standard. Simple order of beverage also can forget to be serve after waiting more than 45min. Honestly speaking I was a hotelier before, the first impression I able to feel is unwelcome, this shouldn't happen in any of the hotel especially with the brand of Shangri La.-terrible manners on taking order-beverage was not sent until we almost finish the food-drink with other guests while on duty and keep us wait at aside-bill changes was not presented to me after paying the bill I think management need to take discipline action on the person who supervise the outlet on day of Thursday (12 sep 2019). Shangri-la is one of my favourite brand while travelling, I have no issue with the brand but I'm disappointed when this issue happened in shangri-la hotel.

Author: gosiak888Lodz, Poland
Title: Amazing vegetarian chicken rice balls
Review: Very nice and affordable vegetarian restaurant. I came both days of my stay I Melaka for lunch. I almost regretted I couldn’t stay longer in Melaka just to try more of their dishes. I was surprised that a simple dish like chicken rice balls can be that delicious. The owner speaks very good English, is very friendly and helpful. I absolutely recommend!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: bayubabe
Title: Beautiful Japanese French Cuisine
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed Sage's excellent set lunch today with a few girlfriends. The menu was varied and every dish was beautifully executed and cooked to perfection. It was obvious that the chef took great care selecting the freshest of ingredients.Coupled with warm, efficient but unobtrusive service, we had a very lovely time. And yes, it was great value too and we will return soon to savour their more complex set dinner!

Author: Athlet
Title: quite ok
Review: I had buffet one night, it's quite ok, Chinese, Indian & Malay food to chose, good quality and reasonable price

Author: Susan T
Title: Not impressed!
Review: Went to this restaurant on the recommendation of a friend. I am not an oyster eater and the menu is heavily oysters. I knew this so was not surprised and I knew there would be lots of seafood to choose from. Ordered the tomato and mozzarella salad with crispy basil to start. Pretty much without flavour and mozzarella was very ordinary. Best bit was crispy basil. My husband and I both ordered tiger prawns for our main. Both our prawns were overcooked. Mushy and without flavour. I sent mine back and got a second portion which was marginally better. On a good note, the staff were helpful and didn't question when I said prawns were overcooked. They were happy to replace the prawns. The bread that accompanies the prawns was very good. Wine was also good, if a little overpriced. Don't think I will make a return visit.

Author: raoflatiffSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place but Food is Just ok
Review: Great place to rest after a walk at Pahlawan walk and before starting Jonker Walk. It’s just across the little bridge. The location and setup inside is very nice. The food was very average. The chocolate brownie was too dry and served the wrong way which was difficult to consume.

Author: Razreena R
Title: BIT EXPENSIVE
Review: The aunthentic thai food. Too spicy and small portion. Delicious food but expensive. Service very slow and not friendly.

Author: josi8h
Title: 【山寨】鼎泰豐
Review: The food is 15-20% more expensive than 鼎泰豐, and the food served were cold and mediocre, probably due to inexperienced chef in newly-opened branch ...
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: CameraEyeCharlotte, North Carolina
Title: Casual, enjoyable experience
Review: First, must say the food is solid (in the figurative sense, using my daughter's vernacular). Very authentic, tasty, and the sauces are terrific. Prices are very reasonable, and the restaurant is located near a food court in upscale mall adjacent to Petronas Towers. Staff missed an itemwe ordered, but that was a rookie oversight. Overall, a great experience!!

Author: SlatedoggMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Avoid like the plague!
Review: Malaysia is a place just bursting with great food from every corner of the globe, so if you want something good to eat at a fair price it shouldn't be hard. I had read the reviews for geographer cafe prior to going there and dismissed the bad ones as people being a bit picky. I have worked in customer service for 8 years so I'm normally lenient when it comes to the staff in stores or restaurants, but my god. ONE AND A HALF Hours! after we initially ordered, my wife lost her rag and went to complain. The time was 1pm on a Saturday afternoon and the cafe was not even at half capacity. There seemed to be two people taking orders and one person standing behind the bar doing very little. Someone took our order after fifteen minutes (fine if you are busy) then it took a further twenty minutes for our two iced coffees to arrive. We then sat for fifty minutes or so while everyone around us was brought food (albeit very slowly) and we appeared to be invisible. The final straw was when someone on the table behind us who had only been there for about twenty minutes was served the exact thing my wife ordered. We decided to complain and ask if our food was even coming because at this point we would prefer to just leave. The waitress my wife spoke to said in quite an accusing tone "you haven't even ordered anything". Well why do we have knives and forks in front of us and why are there empty glasses on out table. She shrugged and we left having not paid for the drinks we didn't order or drink in the hour and a half we wasted in this average looking overpriced cafe. We then went to restauran saranavan for a South indian meal and we're served amazing food immediately which cost a quarter of the geographers cafe. Actual geographers should use a map and find somewhere decent to eat instead.

Author: yellowshaunSingapore, Singapore
Title: Slow service and food arrived cold
Review: Go noodle house is one of my favourite must-haves when I visit KL, and I promote it to my friends. However today’s experience was rather underwhelming...We came before the lunch crowd hit, with only a quarter of the tables filled. However the food took about 20mins to come and when they arrived cold, I was quite puzzled as to what is going on...Hope it’s a once off occasion and they will be soon again be providing the great, affordable food that I have come to love!

Author: SheCanTravel23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: PITCH-BLACK
Review: Superb Experience.! Impressive fine dine menu.Radha was very helpful throughout the dining. Definitely will come again.

Author: Crafty_B_1977Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Great Burger, Flat Beer
Review: Cheese burger was very impressive, albeit the cost of 10GBP++ was somewhat high. However, the beer was flat and this detracted from the experience.

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: Sleek and modern but disappointing pizza
Review: We always try and make Friday night pizza night, no matter where we are in the world.Somtimes it's easy to track down a good spot, sometimes not.Much of Asia is difficult, the toppings are off, the cheese is wrong or the dough hasn't proved.When we walked past The Loft in Love lane one mid-week evening we did a secret little happy dance, it looked the goods.Modern and thoughtful design and the promise of wood-fired pizza, we vowed to return for Friday night pizza night.The interior of this slick new build is great, they've spent a lot of time and money getting the look and feel of a contemporary modern trattoria and it mostly works.I say mostly because the one glaring fail on design is the huge and unwelcome television set screwed to the back wall, nobody, and I do mean nobody, paying any attention to it. Why they would ruin the feel with a dreary soccer match playing above everybodys head is a mystery.There's also the threat that later in the evenings a DJ will climb into a high perched booth and ruin the atmosphere even more with some overloud tunes.To the food and service.The staff are great, all friendly and knowledgeable, busy looking after the crowd but keeping an eye on the tables as well, good stuff.The food, well, the salad was nice, a green leaf salad with apple and parmesan cheese, nicely seasoned was a hit.The pizza. Not a hit.Sad and flat it resembled something you would order from Pizza Hut, it really wasn't good.The dough had no chew to it, burnt around the edges, but not in that good slighly charred classic Italian pizza way, this was just dry and burnt, but what was really unforgivable was the use of those horrible black seeded and sliced olives, the ones that look like small car tires, they should be banned from public, they're fake olives, they have not been cured properly, they are soaked in a chemical bath first to make them go black. Most canned black olives are soaked in lye first, have a read what lye chemical is and you will not want to eat those round black balls of hell again. Horrible.

Author: jpk186240Penzance, United Kingdom
Title: The worst meal
Review: We were on our first night in Melaka and wandered into Jonker Street only to find everything was closed, including restaurants - except for Geographer's Cafe, so ended up having to eat here. Didn't look promising since it tries to be a western type bar/cafe which is exactly not what we came to Malaysia to experience. However, ordered vegetarian mee hoon. The portion was pathetically small, very boring looking with a bit ot lettuce as garnish!!! very un- Malaysian, and half way through we realised there was some very gristly meat in the dish too. The whole thing was flavourless - even with meat in it! Grim. To top it all, the cost of that plate was more than double any other meal we had during the whole holiday, so felt decidedly ripped off. I showed the waiter the meat in the dish, and he didn't seem interested, nor did he offer to reduce the bill, and I was too tired to argue about it. Geographer Cafe experience was the only bad one we had throughout our holiday. Cannot understand why there are so many good reviews of this place.

Author: DianashhCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant in Langkawi
Review: Husband and I stayed at the Andaman hotel, so we booked a table for dinner at Jala restaurant. The view was beautiful as we got to sit by the beach, it was raining and thundering but still very very beautiful. We loved the idea of the restaurant as the floor is covered with sand and you can just walk/sit there with bare feet (for an amazing experience). You can choose from a good variety of fresh fish, however, the portions were not very generous especially for the appetisers. The atmosphere was very lovely, and we would definitely visit again next time we're in Langkawi.

Author: Jonathan CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good …. But Not As Outstanding As Before
Review: Family of 4 plus a toddler (our Grand Daughter). Have posted a couple of reviews of this Restaurant here before - on previous visits my family have come away feeling very well fed with delicious steaks.This time the steaks were nowhere near as good….lacking in flavour/taste. My son and his beloved had the Valentine Dinner Special. Starters and Desserts were lovely although my wife found her French Onion Soup a tad salty. But our Crepe S. desserts were disappointing ….. I think we had the Trainee doing it. Soggy, with little liquor taste - she clearly had some teething problems with the (beside table) preparation.Hoping this is just a one-off - the usual Chef had the night off maybe. And we missed Arif - our favourite server.

Author: AmberschaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good ambience
Review: We visited this restaurant in last year for my friends birthday celebration. The decoration and atmosphere itself very nice and it feels luxurious. But to be honest the seating arrangement us a bit pack and the restaurant were small not as I've imagined in the pictures I had googled before we going there. The food were good bit the price were a bit pricey. So far it's highly recommended for small event space and for food lovers.

Author: kpeople123
Title: Bak Kut Teh(BKT)
Review: If the boss managing the big container which has all the pork, does not know you. No extra BKT soup and extra fat pork portion for you. You go as a pork eating machine, crowded, crampy, hot and no eating pleasure to enjoy the food. However, it should be a place for you if are pork swallowing machine with brew tea.

Author: Pael GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing
Review: We have been regulars in Chilis Paradigm mall and Chilis Empire Subang for years now. However, after a long time we went to Chilis Midvalley. We found it really disappointing and were surprised as this is one of the oldest running outlets.We had ordered a plate of Calamari rings and wings with Feta cheese for appetizers.For main course we had ordered South Western grilled lamb and Country Fried Chicken. The calamari rings were rubbery and could hardly be swallowed. The Chicken was over fried while the south Western Grilled lamb was just filled with rubbery fat, and once it cooled down slightly, it was impossible to eat.Chilis has always been one of our favorite places, but the recent cost cutting measures have severely brought down the quality of food.I do hope the management would look into it and do something constructive about their food quality.

Author: SteveY8888
Title: Expensive Mediocre Food
Review: Overpriced for most of the dishes. To avoid their Western food items and go for the Asian food. I believe the chef(s) doesn’t really understand Western cuisine or having very little knowledge in preparing them. Latte art failed despite being Arts Cafe ... bring your money elsewhere.

Author: 12Travel_foreverKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sunday Buffet Rip Off
Review: I have been to Hanare previously and loved the good quality sashimi and ambience, it was never too packed and although the selection was limited, the food was great. Imagine my disappointment this round, that not only the price per person has increased from around RM150 per head (after tax) to RM180, they also had certain items which are limited.Upon arriving at 12pm (buffet was from 12-230), we were ushered into a crowded dining area and were told that the Chutoro (tuna belly) was limited to 3pc per person and oysters was limited to only 2pcs per person. On top of the fact that the premium items were already limited, the food was incredibly insufficient for the diners. By 12.30pm, the Unagi (I saw 20 thumb size pcs when I was seated at 12.05pm) were long gone and not replenished, so was the shishamo, the tempura prawns, the ameabi, and most of the small appetisers. The food display remained relatively empty throughout. By 1:30pm I actually asked one of the servers if they were ever going to replenish the unagi since I didn't get some, the staff went to the back and came back with 6 tiny thumb size portions.....and proceeded to put on the display counter and brought an additional 2 pcs for me. I mean....it was very crowded that day....i even saw people literally running to the counter to grab it....at RM180 per head, that's an insult.The service staff were efficient in serving the customers, but they had no control of the amount of food coming out of the kitchen. They were all nice except for the manager who, perhaps know he will have to listen to many customer complaints kept disappearing. The teppanyaki counter was also not able to handle the orders, we put in an order of seafood n wagyu beef at 12:30pm upon noticing the bare food display areas and only received our food almost an hour later. It also took the chawanmushi (individual orders) about 45 minutes to reach our table and to our dismay, it was only half a cup worth of steamed egg. I should have ordered at least 2-3 per person then!All in all, we left with empty stomachs and empty wallets and empty hearts. Photos submitted was taken around 12:30pm....all 4 taken at the same time. Can you imagine all the hungry faces?

Author: LukeH1533Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Just another made up Western pub with almost okay food and poor service
Review: I've always preferred this restaurant to its ilk along the strip in Bukit Bintang where most bars employ aggressive in-your-face touts who try to bully pedestrians into their make believe Western restaurants. But the food and service is not what it was and when I place an order I'd prefer to see it served, as opposed to being accused of never placing it in the first place. Left with a bad feeling. Go to Havana across the road next time.

Author: Rickigilangpermana
Title: BAD!!!
Review: Caterpilar on my food!!! Iam telling the staff but no sorry from him just SMILING with no regrets!! I was auditor for some hotel in indonesia, iam not expecting any free of charge food cause i pay first then telling them, i just want apologizing from the management but the staff just give me SMILE no WORDS!

Author: jstunnaAdelaide, Australia
Title: Horrible food
Review: I usually don’t write reviews, but I am doing it now not because my experience at Emily’s steakhouse was exceptionally great, but quite the contrary, exceptionally poor. The staff were fine, but the food was absolutely terrible!The medium rare steak I had was below the average of an English pub standard. The peas were microwaved (some were hot and some were still very cold) and the chips were just miserable as hell (how do you screw the chips up?!)I honestly don’t understand how this restaurant received such a high rating. If I was the owner I’d replace the entire kitchen crew immediately and make adjustments to the menu.I regret trusting the reviews for this place, and it’s a shame this happened to be the most expensive meal I’ve had in KL so far.

Author: HighadventurerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not impressed and here s why !
Review: Based on below reviews, I thought it s worth a try but upon trying it did not meet my standards benchmarked on Tim Ho Wan HK or the PJ Damansara Jaya dim sim which is packed, all weekend mornings with long queuse.Kai Suan's setting is 1st class being in the lower floor of Pan Pacific (parking is RM5 a hour, compared with RM1.50 next door where you walk across the sky bridge at level 1 adjoining the hotel).Read somewhere the chef is trained by a HK chef and the stuff we had did look the part but did not taste the part. Not sure if lack of pork made the dim sim less cohesive and the har gow or crystal shrimp dumpling did not stick to its skin. Other shortcomings were glutinious rice was too sticky (and did not taste loh mai kai without sausage, mushroom and chicken) > we had porridge which was too thin the chicken feet too tiny and the fish ball really meeny. Mini chicken char siw pau was good but cheong fun was so soOverall the dim sim here did not meet my expectations and likely yours unless you are halal dim sim foodie. No complaint about service but it does take a while for the food to be served. If ever you are to trust any review, first check out the crowd and the queue. Here there is none, big restaurant but only 4 tables were filled on a Saturday ( not sure if this was due to weekend being on Friday). Tea costs Rm2.50 a pax and service tax 10% and govt tax 5%.If you are a discerning dim sim die hard esp the non halal (pork based) this is not what you seek, you may want to go upstairs and have the RM50 per pax international buffet.For those whom don t know what real dim sim taste like,do enjoy your dim sim - you won t know what you are missing. Buffet dim sim (eat as much as you like is about RM40 a head)

Author: cheevun
Title: Steamboat hunters
Review:
I went to many steamboat restaurant 
This one is second one worse in kl/selangor area 

Service very bad 
Food not bad 
Grab not fresh smelly 
Vege not fresh 
The chili and sauce good tasted

Author: marksV6097UEKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nasty Nuris
Review: Having been a regular over the years at various Naughty Nuris, especially this branch, we enjoy a number of items on the menu. However, they have recently made changes to their menu removing a number of dishes and really slimming down the choices available.On this occasion, we opted for a drink and some nachos to start. However, when they arrived, it was clearly just a bag of cheap crisps from the shop. I even recognised the flavour and the brand...needless to say we didn’t order anything else and will not be rushing back!

Author: grpexpectationsProvidenciales
Title: Delicious and warmly received...
Review: Called at the last minute to make a reservations for dinner and was warmly received by Francois who welcomed us for an evening supper. Upon arrival we were offered a seat in the "back" of the house, but with tables available up front we requested seating closer to action and fun of someone else's birthday party. With well decorated contemporary and warmed toned interiors, pressed white linens and nicely appointed and on-point waiters, our anticipation of an exciting meal heightened. Pretty wine list with fined geographic reference to Italian wines along with other "international" wines. Relatively speaking the wines were well priced and well chosen. Rather than go with a wine familiar we chose one more highly recommended by Francois (Montepulciano) and with breathing it showed well. All tables started with the "bread" course and each person their own small dish of olive oil and balsamic. Yummy assortment for those very hungry! First courses of Foie Gras with Apple and a Cold fish salad (filet on bottom topped with thinly sliced veg) lightly dressed, second course a shared plate of Seafood pasta with squid, one shrimp, mussels, clams, third courses of Mediterranean lamb with Couscous and Veal Scaloppine with Mashed Potatoes with a final of Tiramisu. All well prepared, with meat execution, sauces flavorful (tad salty on the lamb) with the overall combinations well presented on the plate. We were not offered the option of Grated parmesan on top of pasta nor ground pepper on any of our dishes.....Overall, delightful ..... since this is mostly an Italian restaurant, I was really hoping for that delightful custom of a complimentary glass of Limoncello presented at the end of the meal. Not sure if the owner was to the present, but that would help establish a personality and anchor for the restaurant.

Author: TheProtagonist16Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious fresh food with an elegant ambience.
Review: Great food and impressive bar at a 5 star hotel. I ordered a number of dishes but the highlight was their fresh, juicy and succulent Grilled lobster. I used my Amex card that had a promotion so its more bang for the buck or else it can be very pricey. Chilled place for drinks and proper western food.

Author: aida1365Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: tasty foods but rude staff
Review: on my birthday cause of my friend suggestion we went to this restaurant to have memorable experience, my friend told me once you say its your birthday they gonna take photo and celebrate it, we went with friends the waitress came for take an order and we requested her to give us time to choose, her behavior was awful like that wanted punch our face for asking time. i do understand some times because of stress and hard working might be not in a mood but it dosent mean that they can act like this, after we took an order they served such a tasty bread ( really delicious ) and then our orders which was pizza and pasta.(both were Delicious too) but again the way that waitress served was so rude almost through the spoon and fork. you can imagine how angry i was i asked her name just to put in TripAdvisor,her name was fizza.At the end cause my friend saw i am so upset because of her attitude went and told the other waiter that is my birthday.which was surprise for me cause i didn't realize and they bring piece of ice cream cake and took photo, thanks at least for others, the only point that i can give this rate was food not environment at all.the other funny thing which i have never seen it before we requested to take a way bread cause it was so yummy but they asked me to fill up the form for take away. it was silly.any way thanks for chefs foods were nice :)

Author: Stuart294265
Title: Good breakfast spread
Review: Had breakfast here only....good choice of food both spicey and non spicy...better than average breakfast layout in Malaysia but of course no pork.....
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: MohdF786
Title: Palak paneer taste had changed
Review: Never missed to order this cheesy blended spinach gravy at every visit since over years. Today the taste had change become stale. Ask the manager to change but seem like the taste still the same. the worst if the cook disnt remake, just reheat. Manager refused to give discount. Paid for unsatisfactory food. You are losing your customer to come againJM 0122760694

Author: carynjen13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super Yummy!
Review: I love the food, the sauce they used to cook it's delicious. The starters (also nice) are refillable but self service.I like to add Udon to my Chicken set. One set is enough for two person actually.Only thing would like them to change is from giving Tentacles to Squid body part. I hate tentacles.

Author: kelvinleec
Title: Very very very sad
Review: Have been my favorite Roti place in the whole Malaysia ! But it have long gone ! Since have operate by other ppl !! Tonight I will have a try on this and Rated it just as same as normal Mamak roti ! This will be my last time here ... farewell

Author: Alain TBangkok, Thailand
Title: DO NOT GO TO ZIPPANGU
Review: After having posted a very negative review of the hotel's Japanese restaurant a few months ago, I decided to give it a new try on this visit. Nothing has changed : after being ushered to a table and given the menu, it was impossible to attract a staff member attention in a restaurant half-empty. I left after twenty minutes of waiting and waiving at waiters and complained to the restaurant manager who could obviously not care less but just gave a vague apology.

Author: CongTyeKuala Lumpur
Title: Delicious is no longer as delicious as before!
Review: Went at tea time. Sign says "please wait to be seated". Stood for a good 2 min or so, no waiter came to usher. Decided to show ourselves to the table. Food was ok, never like it used to be. Smaller portion. Drinks didn't arrive until near finishing eating. Reminded the indifferent waitress about our drinks. Waiter lacked proper waiting decorum - arms crossing over when serving, instead of to one's right! Ate finished. Waitress came to clear plates - no basic May I clear? but cleared right away! Looked around to see other patrons, not the same typical discerning worldly crowd like before. Bad indifferent service from the crew. Moreover, the crew looked downcast, no joy on their faces. The waiter or waitress who served us throughout our meals, not a word of thank you even when we left the restaurant. Today's visit is the 2nd time for Delicious Bangsar Village 2 after E & O took over. There won't be a 3rd, ever!

Author: Mademioisella_Ayeen
Title: mee Kolok yg superbbb
Review: mee kolok was superbb yummy! @rimba12, old saddad court , nice place to bring along family n friends!

Author: heleneri88
Title: Freezing-box!
Review: The food was nothing more than average, the presentation was stunning and service good. However, relax on your aircon, we were freezing so much we tried to eat our food fast so we could get out of there. Overall poor experience, not worth the money.

Author: dannyliu93Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: Long waiting time & questionable food?
Review: Too much sauce for carbonara & too dry for the sandwich. Along with long waiting time(1 hour). Overall will not come again.

Author: yeoing
Title: Don't serve previous day tandoori chicken
Review: To expensive with previous day tandoori chicken. It was so dry. Staff was friendly but food is really bad for fine dine standard. Lamb Rogan josh 24.90 it wasn't taste like Rogan josh.

Author: PenangBillAyr, United Kingdom
Title: A place to avoid
Review: My friend and I decided to have tea with scones but made the mistake of going to Dome. We were not brought milk with the tea so we asked for it - twice. Then gave up.The scones were dry, there was less than a teaspoonful of jam for two scones and the so-called cream was from an aerosol can and dissolved when spread. Poor service and dreadful food.

Author: MOUSE ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Affordable pricing if base on Singapore dollars but food so-so
Review: It was my first visit. On weekday, operating hours start from 12noon. But apparently the kitchen wasn't ready as waitress informed us that they are receiving stocks from suppliers, so need 45mins-1 hr. since we were not too hungry yet so we accepted the waiting. So if you are rushing for time, don't eat lunch time, maybe dinner time, food will be served faster after ordering.We ordered fresh beans with minced pork, a pork belly with stomach soup, A sesame ginger chicken, a braised minced pork Mee suan and a green honey tea (a jug-Cold).French bean -- still ok, we finish then our soup arrive.Soup - only taste peppery, not those boiled effect type, so I consider it failed to meet my minimum expectation. Probably too early, the soup not ready yet. Canfood button mushroom, some pork belly slice and some stomach slice.Ginger sesame chicken - very disappointed, it didn't look nice, and it's taste same as it's look. The only I like was the ginger like our usual chicken rice while my Sister like the garnish (cucumber slice w I think deep fried shrimp)Mee Suan - both of us like it as the gravy was plenty so enough to match w the Mee Suan. The bonus was it come w a free cabbage soup but that didn't have much taste like water w cabbage.Drink - sweet but still alright taste as it's name - green tea with honey.Like someone mentioned previously, a lot of items not available even through it on menu. When we order the soup, she actually need to check if they are serving that soup for the day anot.

Author: jessicajames35q
Title: Over-rated average food but exorbitant charges
Review: Average seafood but above average prices. Never told us the price of the fish but charged us RM 200 for a Grouper fish for 3 people. Daylight robbery! Will not return here again!

Author: prabhavmusaddi89
Title: Good quick food
Review: Although you have to get your food here, since it is the food court, but it was quick and some good thai curry.

Author: John S
Title: Great setting
Review: Quality restaurant in a beautiful setting overlooking Cenang Beach. Walkway on beach provides access to other choices too
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kevinchiew92
Title: Food quality fallen over the years
Review: We’re regular at this restaurant and we’re quite sad to say that the food quality has fallen over the years. They serve less premium food now and even the coffee quality is bad now. For the price that we’re paying is say it’s no longer good value for money.

Author: KARENT180New York City, New York
Title: One of the best meals we've ever had
Review: We travel a lot and dine well. We live in NYC and dine out every night. We did not expect to find a restaurant in KL that wowed us like Marini's on 57. Usually restaurants with these views are tourist traps with mediocre food and service....but NOT this one. We enjoyed cocktails and the spectacular views of the Petronas Towers in the bar before sunset. Escorted into the west facing dining room we were served by a gracious and professionally trained staff who did not miss a beat. Our vegetarian ordered the 15 vegetable salad with pipettes of different dressings and aromatic sprays to enhance the salad. Inventive and fun! The various entrees were all excellent and beautifully presented and served. The sun set over KL and we went on to enjoy the pre dessert surprise (I won't ruin if for future diners) and then beautiful, special desserts followed by a complimentary offering of house made chocolates. This was a spectacular experience with a sophisticated well dressed clientele. We highly recommend it!

Author: daydreamingdoryBiddulph, United Kingdom
Title: I would not recommend
Review: I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone after our visit. Good points are the view, live music and the wine wasn’t too bad. Bad points despite previous reviews stating the food was not hot there has been no improvement, I don’t like my food too hot but the food was not hot enough. Buffet area is to cramped. Had lamb off the grill but it was all bone and no meat, not much left in the way of desserts when we got to it. Service wasn’t brilliant and when table cleared when we went up for desserts came back to the used cutlery had been placed on the tablecloth causing a mess that we had to sort out. Was amusing though trying to locate your table after going up to the buffet. Funnily enough not 1 person asked us about our experience and if we enjoyed our meal which means they probably don’t want to hear. I hope management take on peoples reviews and actually act on them.

Author: Kim Kheong H
Title: Economical Muslim food galore
Review: Affordable Muslim food with a wide varieties of choices. Mostly packed during lunch and dinner time.

Author: megatshamsulnizamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit!
Review: Theirs is on par in term of quality with the one in Pantai Klebang but with lesser waiting time. Have varieties of coconut shake n water. And have been told that coconut water is free of charge n free refill if you dine in. And also pls try traditional kuih keria which is only located next stall. However, parking is limited.

Author: AndrewLim91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't waste your money here
Review: Total of 9 of us visit here for dinner. Good thing is, there are ample parking spaces opposite the shop. We are served with some light snacks while looking through menu and ordering. The snacks is pretty basic, but delicious enough to warm up your stomach. Other than the parking and the snacks, I couldn't think of any good point to visit here. We ordered 6 dishes, and dish came out extremely slow. The first dish came out is the vege, and then tofu. And after this, no more dish coming out. We waited for 5 minutes, and I almost finish my plate of rice with just 2 dish served. Ask the manager to check, and the dish just slowly coming out, and mostly all of those are not hot. 1 of our dish is roasted duck. We ordered a whole duck, and it was served cold to us. The duck itself is not warm, it's room temperature at the skin and outer layer, and when you eat more, it's cold inside. When we confronted the manager, he just heat it up using oven, and it looks dry when it served to us again. The few other dishes like vege, fish, and chicken, are not impressive as well. And like what I said just now, mostly are not hot. It feel like it was being put aside some time before serving us. I won't recommend this restaurant to anyone. It doesn't worth your money. Try other restaurant nearby, plenty of choices.

Author: SinagQuezon City, Philippines
Title: Eat here for a piece of KL history
Review: As frequent travelers who are curious about where locals eat, hang out and chill, we were recommended to try out the Coliseum Cafe along Jalan TAR to experience of history of Kuala Lumpur. Please do not come here if you are looking for the so-called Malaysian cuisine of nasi lemak, nasi goreng, etc. There are plenty of those restaurants around.Food was described as western and Hainanese. The atmosphere spoke of 'days gone by'. It was as if time stood still and we were served dishes that this almost 100 year old restaurant would have served in its heydey. The bar next door can easily be filled by the 'expats' of 1920s as their public house or 'local'... and there it is, still serving pints. Upon entering the establishment, we had a waft of the mouthwatering smell of smokey grilled steak. Ceiling fans reminded me of the decades when air conditioning was unheard of. There were no empty tables on a Saturday night but apart from us, only one other table was occupied by tourists (family with young kids). The waiting staff, albeit not serving upperclass, is very well-versed with proper service. Polite, welcoming and attentive but not to the point of hovering too much. Apart from the Carlsberg promo girl, the Coliseum Cafe falls under the category where I'd also place 'The Grand Budapest Hotel' - if at all it still exists.One has to appreciate what this restaurant means to the locals.
