We did not see it as a tourist trap but rather an experience that one might want to go for when in KL.The tables and chairs spoke of families and friends (mind you - regardless of race) who have frequented the place for good ole reliable comfort food. Specialties of the house are the sizzling steaks which explained the welcome to our olfactory devices. It reminded me of my childhood (back in the 1980s) in The Philippines when my grandparents would take me to our favourite steak place 'Sizzling Plate'. Nice piece of juicy steak swimming in brown sauce. This is what our dinner brought me, "a memory from my childhood."Table cloth was stained with the previous customer's sizzling steak order - we shrug that observation aside. Another piece of history we learned is that during the Japanese occupation in WWII, this and its adjacent cinema were the only establishments untouched by the Japanese. While the rest was destroyed during the war, the edifice where the Coliseum belongs to had witnessed it all.I debated whether I should go for the sizzling steak or a Hainanese dish. I went for the sizzling ribeye - managed my expectations and the dinner was how it was meant to be - walking back in time. It was humbling to imagine what the simple 'western'/Hainanese food meant to those who could afford it then and to those who come to the cafe for the memory it brought them.Found my review interesting? A review of MUD The Story of Kuala Lumpur the musical is to follow... pair the show with a meal at Coliseum just as we did. Take stock and experience the beaten but not-so-touristy track.

Author: Vajra Y
Title: Not as nice anymore!
Review: Mentioned Madam Kwan's previously and you'd get the thumbs up from anyone and everyone who has queued patiently and dined there. My last few visits have been disappointing though, and i no longer have a once-in-a-while craving for its nasi bojari. Nuff said!

Author: janesaini23
Title: Great unexpected
Review: The unexpected stay to find while traveling with a friend. The room was quiet, clean and very comfortable. Very close to area attractions and restaurants. Staff name Jeet is courteous and most helpful. Will definitely stay again

Author: mafi_slMalaysia
Title: High on Sugar……
Review: Visited the restaurant thrity8 for the afternoon tea. I felt it was an average experience. I have heard positive reviews of this restaurant but in my opinion the high tea is not that great.Arrived just after 3PM. And was whisked up to the Lobby level on a high speed lift. You need to then take another lift down to the 38th floor.The goodThe items were X’mas log cake, macaroons, tarts, cakes, all sweet items, there was chicken and Tuna sandwich (A couple of feet long sandwich, slices cut and served), additionally they provided Dim sum, curry puff and spring rolls, we also had an option of coffee ( a list of 6-8 varieties) or tea. The staffs were helpful and courteous.The views were amazing. KLCC, and the surrounding areas were superb. Areas to improve.The food was good, but nothing extraordinary. And it’s a bit overwhelming since it was a lot of sugar. Perhaps a bit more savoury items would help, I appreciate the theme being high on sugar, I won’t be going for the afternoon tea any day soon.Making the reservation a day earlier was an event on its own. The telephone operator put me on to the restaurant, and they were not sure which menu would be severed the day I planned to visit, a tray severed tea or the high on sugar buffet, took me several calls to get the details clarified.

Author: Emily OKajang, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the money
Review: Limited choice of food. Food is not as good as price paid.Service is terrible.Waited too long to take order altough not many people dinning in the restaurant. It takes 2 staff to clean a table hence leaving customer wait to be serve.Ambiance no good

Author: Bexat4
Title: Walk on by.....
Review: Thought we would finally give this place a go after several trips to BF but found the food very 'bland' and service bordering on incompetant and miserable. Give it a miss and try either side at Guan Guan or Living Room.

Author: Ingvar J
Title: Mexican Fiesta
Review: Brilliant experience, delicious food, and amazing drinks. Could not ask for a better beginning of my Langkawi stay, will be coming here every evening!!!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Alles_19
Title: Average Food
Review: Had Nasi Lemak for breakfast at Sambal Hijau but wasn't impressed. It was good but not spectacular so there isn't anything to shout about!

Author: AdrajsingaporeSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: For Evening Live Music over Dinner & Drinks
Review: Don't go during the day. Grab your seats around 7PM, grab dinner, wait until the live music starts at around 8.30PM and then drink on. The restaurant bang opposite it plays live music too that you can enjoy. The 2 retaurants are clever enough to alternate their live music sessions (every 30 min or so). If it's packed, expect the service to be slow. But then again, what's the rush! You're here to chill out in Melaka.

Author: Dalip CSingapore, Singapore
Title: 50% Off Between 3 to 5....
Review: We had just dropped the car at Hawk Tayar to get the tyres replaced; and walked around the corner to get a bite/drink killing time whilst waiting for the job to get done. "Woah... Naughty Nuris!" one in the 5-person gang exclaimed. We were ushered in by the friendly Filipina staff. The Rock-n-Roll music, the Long bar, a Pool table and a general fun, party-styled atmosphere hits you immediately. 2 menus placed before you : the extensive full menu, and a single paged 50% off between 3-5pm is the other. The ribs are succulent, the Gado-Gado yummy, esp the peanut sauce, chicken wings and the beers complementing each other, and the Nasi goreng very tasty. Pity, that we had lunch just a couple hours back; otherwise wed've greedily ordered more and wolfed the food down. Memories of Naughty Nuris in Bali 3 years ago were flooding back : a casual, chic, partyesque place, full of life. The type that grips you, and you leave very reluctantly. That's exactly the feeling we had, when it was time to head back and pick up the repaired car (sigh).

Author: LiveNLetLiveKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Good place to hangout with family or friends
Review: We recently went to this place for dinner. Ambience wise it's pretty cosy with Murals of legends adoring 2 of the main walls, hence the name. It's has the feel of a mid-range establishment.The menu is filled with many finger foods and main course. There are many pork based items on the menu as well. As there were only the 3 of us we ordered 2 dishes to share. One time we tried was the pork pizza which had a generous topping of thick sliced ham and cheese. However the dough was a tad too dry to my liking and the taste of the tomato based sauce was rather light. The other we sampled was the pork ribs (the true test of whether a pork establishment lives up to its name.....;). This dish was interesting as they had their own signature sauce which seemed to be a mix of soya sauce which reminds me of something one might find at a Chinese restaurant. Nonetheless it was a good choice with their own in house twist. We saw other interesting appetisers which we will be sure to try on our next visit to the place.The place can get pretty crowded on weekends so be sure to go early to get your choice of seats.

Author: alistair15
Title: TASTY SHABU SHABU
Review: Decent and nice japanese restaurant. Comfortable seats and decor. Fine place dining with family members. Good menu for whole family to choose from.  Hot pot and set meal is good selection. Overall tasty and good.

Author: ann cKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: All day Happy Hour Sunday
Review: Came here with some friends to chill & watch the World Cup match. Beers are Happy Hour rate whole day @ RM8 per mug, chill & fresh. Their north indian dishes are pretty good I guess because we've seen 2 foodpanda riders came to collect the packed food for delivery. We ordered 2 items, the fried chili pakora was decent while the lamb kebab is oily & laden with flour. We had it returned after some complications with the waiter as well as the manager, and had we not check our bill, we would've paid for crappy food that we returned. Apart from that, the place has a nice feel to it with a decent location. Will be back for the beers, perhaps not the food.

Author: september1stMelbourne, Australia
Title: Incredibly disappointing
Review: We booked Bijan well in advance of our trip to KL. We have visited this city a number of times and have enjoyed some terrific Malaysian cuisine whilst on our stays.On arrival by cab the restaurant presents very well to the street- elegant warm lighting and a buzz of patrons inside.On the evening we visited the restaurant had a number of very large parties that were being catered to... though the staff to patron ratio did not seem unreasonable. Service was fine overall but not remarkable.What was remarkably unacceptable was the food. We ordered three of the signature dishes believing we would not go wrong. How wrong we were. We ordered the duck rendang- the duck seemed old and not terribly flavoursome, the Australian beef spare ribs were tough and sinewy. We left part of this dish untouched. The papaya salad was incredibly disappointing- it seemed like day old salad- not fresh and crunchy but characteristic of salad sitting in liquid for too long- perhaps because the restaurant was focused on catering to the larger groups. Perhaps we ordered badly, maybe we caught them on a poor evening. But for each of the three signature dishes to be so very disappointing seems more the standard than a slip up.Our advice is to go elsewhere.

Author: WeylyPahang
Title: Too crowded and noisy
Review: We had our lunch at the main branch. It was super crowded with most of the tables occupied. Chicken, rice and the bean sprouts were okay. Maybe I should grade them 7/10. However, the 'kueh teow' soup and the mixed chicken gizzards and liver were just 2/10. The cold drinks in the plastic containers/cups brought by the woman staff using a tray to our table were not full. Some cups were only three quarter full. There was a very rude male staff who just took away one of our chairs without asking us for another customer who just came in two tables away. When we told him off he went away to bring more chairs and rudely put two more chairs at our table. The management have to look into the standard of cleanliness in their shop and their staff.

Author: ek8228Singapore
Title: Stunning location beats the food
Review: This is cave dining at its most impressive. The venue is hard to beat. The stalactites & stalagmites are huge and artfully lit. The water features are alas, an addition but nevertheless contribute to the atmosphere. The owner's personal cellar is an interesting addition. The fixed menus looked better than they tasted; possibly poor value even at half the price. I suggest you have pre- or post- drinks here and soak up the fantastic atmosphere and dine on local fare, either at the Pomelo restaurant or downtown.

Author: DanielPD1985
Title: Staff were highly attentive.
Review: The staff were so wonderful and kind. There was a lot of variety for breakfast. Food and service were both great.

Author: AmberschaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Vietnamese food
Review: One of the best Vietnamese food I've tried in KL. In terms of pricing, the price are still affordable. The food, pho is the best not to forget a compulsory Vietnam's spring roll is good too. It's rich with flavour. 5 stars for the Vietnam Coffee. The seating and table arrangement are well organized. The service was okay.

Author: aunt73
Title: Lovely ambiance
Review: Stopped here for a meal, greeted by lovely staff. Food and service great. Had a very nice ambiance to the place.

Author: 88gaian
Title: Good service but the food are below average
Review: The service was fast and prompt. Food also very Fast serving. The crab we ordered are deep fried until dried and tasteless. The steam prawn with eggs are good. Other food we ordered are so so only. Deep fried soft shell crab are good by the way. Recommended to go early as you will need to queue for a long line if late.

Author: Ian AIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Angus Steak was a Disaster
Review: We dined here on one Sunday in March this year, a group of eight friends who often go out together to try out the latest Ipoh fare. It is a nice place with a good atmosphere and music but very much at the expensive end. However, "in for a penny, in for a pound" as they say I chose the pretty expensive Angus Steak. What a disaster! Instead of a thick juicy steak that I expected I was served with two thin, overcooked steaks which were full of gristle and impossible to eat. Furthermore they were served cold. The owner/manager came when called and after explaining the problem to him he removed it. There was no suggestion of a replacement but to be fair he took it off the bill and provided a free bottle of wine for the table. I went hungry.From their comments the others did not feel that they had experienced value for money but I leave it up to them to comment on their meal.The most incredible thing was the statement from the owner/manager that if we came on a Tuesday the food would be better as they would not be so busy!

Author: sitwaiyin
Title: Local Malaysia Street Food
Review: This restaurant offered variety of Malaysian food which are tasty and delicious. Alas Prawn Mee Noodle and Char Keow Teow is a bit of overprice. I woud consider Nasi Lemak with chicken is good.

Author: steinland77
Title: Expensive
Review: Cool waiters, you know what you get when it comes to the food. Expensive, 50% more than the normal price range.

Author: Dkkeeling
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent service and good quality local foods. Freshly cooked and good attention from the staff and working owners.
Recommend to everyone.
We ate 2/3 times. 
Limit choice for real foodies but don't worry.
Quality dishes not quantity.
Great price.

Author: MarbellavacancesMarbella, Spain
Title: Amazing!
Review: The experience was really amazing, was our first time dining on the dark and we felt very confortable and our waitress Marcos was very helpful in all moment. They change the menu every three month and we hope to come back again! Thank you very much to all the team and good job!

Author: Buomar98
Title: Average restaurant
Review: It is average restaurant. The location is more like coffee shop in which they serve shiasha. The taste is fair Iraqi food .

Author: Andi D
Title: Great location
Review: the location is perfect. you could enjoy the clean river and people activities on the tourist spot. i ordered NY strip medium rare, and disappointed with the quality. When served, the beef has already cooled down and not juicy. so i used a lot of chili sauce to fix the taste. But the burger menu was so good.

Author: couscous74
Title: Good Malaysian food
Review: I had the Nasi Lemak, Otak-Otak, Char Kway Teow, Belacan Kankung, and Fried Rice with Salt Fish & Chicken. All very good. I would definitely eat here again.

Author: elisa gKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Arrived at 6pm for dinner before the crowd sets in but all tables were quick to fill up and queue started to build up outside the restaurant. If wish to try, best to prebook. Lobak was tasty, cendol was good, pai tee's filling was coarsely julienne while i prefer matchstick size but this is just my personal preference, some people might like the thicker cut, the taste was ok though. The biggest let down was the babi pongteh where the pig skin was rather hard and flesh dry, taste was fine. For any braised or stewed pork with skin, the skin texture should at lest be soft to the bite and a little sticky, although there are people who like them melt in the mouth but not many like dry hard skin. We also ordered vegetable curry and cincaluk omelette. Generally, this place is good enough for a decent dinner if you happen to be around the area and there is no queue. Otherwise, there are many similar restaurant that offer the typical nyonya cuisine. The total bill was around RM20-30 per head in average as we didn't order any seafood.Don't think I will go again.

Author: Lance-TravellotManchester, New Hampshire
Title: Rude service - did not stay to try food
Review: Sushi Tei (ST) targets the mid and mid-upper class segment. I am a frequent diner at the Sushi Tei(s) in Singapore. Good food, good service. And my wife eveb signed up for their in-house credit credit card.The ST at the basement of the Pavilion is a dissapointment. I was dining alone and requested for a better table since there were lots of empty table (post-peak dinner time). I was told rudely by the manager (male, chinese, early 40s) that the tables I wanted was meant for larger groups (even though I do not see reservations cards placed on them). And the manager smirked (spoke in broken english and mandarin) that if I wanted to eat I should just accept the little awkward seat for single diners. If he had offered me a counter seat, or be more polite, I would have dined there. Instead, I thank him and quickly left the place.I went back to peep at ST after I had dinner in another Japanese restaurant. The so called reserverved seats were still untaken, and the restaurant was still empty.Found out later that the STs in Malaysia were franchises. And there were quality and service issues. Guess I will skip ST in KUL until they fix this.

Author: Kenny W
Title: Good, reasonable local food
Review: Very friendly, accommodating owners.  Excellent curry noodle chicken dish, as well as laksa dish.  I would certainly recommend!

Author: Josh AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: HI TEA BUFFET lacking
Review: After my last review on its ala cartes items, did go back and tried its hi tea buffet finally, was quite disappointment by its varieties, the choices has been cut down compares to what we had experienced in the past, the curry puff that used to be quite good was lacking in its spiciness and too sweet, dimsum and fried items were not good too. Only the main dishes were quite okay, and that was about it. There hadn't been as many cakes as it used to , some were too sweet in fact. overall, a pretty disappointing choices of foods for a 5 stars hotel. They didn't have " good Hard artisan breads" and merely serves " normal buns breads, etc". Their Ala cartes sometimes wasn't up to the standard too at time after my last reviews, on some days they were good, others days not so.

Author: kongjing26
Title: Getting Worse
Review:
I used to came here since i was small till now, but the last time i went here with my mum, don't even have fish and the cangkung manis with eggs not so nice~ even my butter chicken rice~ 
Feel strange when i ate it~

Author: Andy LSingapore, Singapore
Title: will visit again
Review: All popular Peranakan restaurants in Melaka need reservation, otherwise be prepared to wait.Although Makko might not be the best Peranakan restaurant, but the food served is tasty and satisfying. Our kids always clean their plates!We recommend :- Chap Chye (vegetable)- Asam Prawn (not spicy for very fragrant)- Potato curry chicken- Ngong Hiang (meat roll)- the sambal fish are also popular but we have to skip (kids)We always end our meal with cendol dessert.

Author: simonc639Hong Kong, China
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Used to enjoy eating at Madam Kwan's restaurant, every time I pay my annual visit to KUL. Disappointing this time as dishes were not as good and consistent as before, including kuo dew, satay, and in particular it's latest hotpick shrimp noodle soup which doesn't come cheap. What I can gather is in absence of Madam's standard, the cooking has no more passion. The beef in satay was not properly cooked, the shrimp noodle soup looked simply watery.... I'm referring to my experience at both its Pavillion as well as KLCC shop.

Author: Annette BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Spanish????
Review: I really do not like to give bad reviews, I always try and find a positive in everything... But this time I really have no choice. This is the worst Spanish restaurant I have ever dined in. There is nothing, which remotely resembles Spanish cuisine. Plus, the staff are unfriendly and seem to have no knowledge of what they are serving.

Author: bentong66
Title: Get your tarts and traditional cookies here!
Review: Didn't stop for a meal this time around, but picked up all our traditional favourites here.  Pineapple tarts are highly recommended!

Author: mistygem2016
Title: great discovery in he Berkshires
Review: Stumbled upon this restaurant while trying to find a place that would accommodate 6 people for a leisurely dinner. It was beyond our expectations. Delicous food, lovely un pressured service and delightful clientele. So happy we found this spot. It made our weekend!

Author: NmrsylvGeneral Luna, Philippines
Title: Be wary
Review: Ordered drinks that came with a dirty straw (seriously wondering if they reuse the straws here as it's not the first time a straws come out looking worse for wear)Wasn't given my change and as I waited for it the guy walked away avoiding me, terrible service

Author: jameskwlSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Burp !
Review: The junk, what a fascinating little restaurant tucked in the middle of this city . This restaurant's best point has got to be its deco. Its filled with interesting antiques and many tribal paintings and crafts . The food is quite reasonable due to its large portion. 2 people can easily share one portion as its huge !

Author: Calmac84
Title: Small portions.
Review: Service was polite. Food was very good but you dont get a lot for your money!!nice atmosphere tho.worth a visit if your not starving and have a lil extra cash to burn.

Author: MNazriAdnan
Title: One of the best restaurant
Review: This is the 2nd time we came to this restaurant and we highly recommend the good quality in the food especially the steaks. Special appreciation to all the staffs there especially the manager Mr Farouk. All of them are always smiling and giving them good vibes. You guys are definitely doing a great job. Cheers.

Author: RatpackersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great cafe, a must visit when in Melaka
Review: This cafe specialise in burgers not just for meat eaters but they also offer 3 types of vegetarian burgers. This cafe was recommended by a friend and I highly recommend anyone not to miss Baboon Cafe when you are in Melaka. Four things I love about this cafe.1) No photos allowed inside ( selfie included) which means people are not looking down at their phone from photos taken inside and also of their food. it means people actually savour their food and have a conversation.2) The decor is amazing. An eclectic mix of traditional Straits Chinese furnitures , open courtyards, lots of indoor plants and modern art hung on the wall. We love, love the deco. It is also a shame that they do not allow photos because this place is a haven for photoshoot and Instagramers. However I did asked for permission and took two photos. :) 3) their residence cat Nana. Real chill. Scratch her jaw you get her attention, touch her belly, you get her claws. 4) Amazing food and service. A MUST VISIT when in Melaka.

Author: Nira08Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: 2nd visit - great food, horrible front house staff
Review: My first visit to Skillet was in Q4 of 2016. The food was great and I really enjoyed my overall experience there. This is my 2nd time here within the last 3 months, Jan 2, 2017. Once again, the food was great, however, had a horrible experience with the front of house staff, with one except of the Gentlemen (Asman). I had a 3 course meal starting with king crab that was paired with some sauces. I used my fork and knife and after finishing I placed them on the plate. The waitress came over and took only the plate away and threw my utensils back onto the table. I didn't think too much of it, however, I had steak for my second dish and needed a steak knife. When I asked for a steak knife, the same waitress came to change it (with attitude). I was sitting right next to their station. The front of house supervisor proceeded to ask her if I asked for my utensils to be changed. "Only change the utensils if you are asked to." I proceeded to think if the chef would really what that for their customers. To mix the flavors of the previous dish with another. At this price point I expect a new set of utensils with every dish. Again - the food is great. Two staff ruined the experience. I really would love to give 5 stars. But I really hope the owners or managers of the restaurant see this.

Author: ruthmgMumbai
Title: Disappointing
Review: We visited for lunch today, as we had heard some buzz about the place and wanted a special lunch with a great view. The view certainly is excellent, and the restaurant is very nicely styled and appointed. However, we were disappointed with the food. As a ‘Grill’ we expected the steak and accompaniments to be highlights, however many of the basics missed the mark. My husband ordered the Wagyu Ribeye (circa 450MYR++) and he found it very average. The Bearnaise sauce was bland. I had the Oyster Blade and, even taking into account it is a cheaper cut, it was fairly chewy and sinewy. It seems that a fair bit of focus has been put on adding brightly coloured gels/foams and some other attractive decorations to the presentation, but this seems to be at the expense of getting the main components of the dishes executed correctly. All the servers were very nice and polite, so despite an incorrect drinks order, I would not criticize the service. It is in a wonderful location and would be a real go-to restaurant to recommend to friends, however based on our experience today we would not do so because there is just no way to justify the quality of the food at this price point. I am giving 3 stars, which my husband has said he thinks is generous, but I feel this place could have potential and I hope our experience was the exception and not the rule.

Author: Redphoenix76
Title: We got sick
Review: We became sick after a meal and drink at the restaurant on 24th July. Had expensive medical bills since quite a lot of us got sick. Beware!

Author: LNZJKulim, Malaysia
Title: Fulamak Fu-Rin
Review: Was here for dinner as it was raining heavily and we didn’t want to get caught in the jam to get to dinner. The food is actually not bad, the Udon comes with a generous dose of vegetables and mushrooms but the pricing is off the charts. A Bento set with sashimi, tempura and a ridiculously small slice of cod cost RM140. I understand it is in a hotel but I have eaten better Japanese food for half the price. Nevertheless, as it is located within the hotel, I guess it was worth it but only because of the horrendous jam outside.Ambience was ok if not for the group of drunkards making a ruckus at the teppanyaki table.

Author: FanHupPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: No Chef, No Burgers.
Review: Arrived a little before 12 noon. At five to, saw the "Open" sign and attempted to walk in. Stopped and told the premises were not open yet. Umm, maybe flip your sign to "Closed" or amend your business hours. The rather surly youth then added that the chef was out and there were no burgers available. What time would he be back? In about half an hour.Plenty of "tak apa" in this shop.

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Restoran Soto Shah Alam
Review: sorry havent been to Soto 13 yet so will review Soto Shah Alam first. Located at s8, one can find it minutes from the main road where it nestles amidst green foliage in residential area, next to surau ar rahman s8. the place was crowded when we got there for breakfast, and we ordered soto ayam, a chicken soup with rice cubes, shredded chicken and the quintessential begedel or fried potato balls. the soto was ok, not as salty as in other joints and if you want it spicy, the black chili sauce is the answer. we also had lempeng pisang or banana pancake for dessert. there was a substantial spread of malay food including kueh or sweet delicacy. will return for more; just one tiny observation: the front of the restaurant with the sign Soto Shah Alam was marred by the sight of clothes being hanged out to dry just under the sign.

Author: hanraBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: Somewhere I always return to, when back in KL
Review: Siu Siu Restaurant is one of those rare places with consistently good food and service we always return to when back in Kuala Lumpur. Note that the restaurant is in a desolate and dark location, but does have its own parking facilities.Food is authentic and tasty within a very casual and cool (climate wise) setting, since it's located beside the forest. It's not the first time we've been here and we've always ordered the Char Siew (Roast Sweet Pork), Fried Fukkien Noodles (Dark Sauce Noodles) and Crab but generally speaking, ask the waiter for some recommendations - that's always worked for us. Give them a guide on what you would like to try - e.g.: What's good today?, fish, friend chicken etc..

Author: zaha_maySingapore, Singapore
Title: Average Food and Sevice.
Review: If you're looking for a great Nasi Kandar, try other restaurant. But if you must eat here, go with a local who have been here. The staff don't speak much english and their ordering system are quite confusing for first timer. The food are average, nothing special from other indian restaurant around KL.

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Flavorable Homecook Food
Review: We have a belated BD dinner for our good and close friend at Aunty Lee restaurant on 28 Oct 2017. We made reservation a week ahead. A small restaurant but well patronised due to the good food and reasonable price. The specially ordered fried noodle is nice (thanks to the owner). The stater pai ti, the deep fried fish with sambal, chicken curry, tau geh, prawns, sambal kangkong, fried grago eggs, salted vege chicken soup are well done and good to eat. The chengdor as dessert is nice. Cheers.

Author: k7cq
Title: Aloe Gogi
Review:
Asked the Senior waiter to have the Naan break done crispy, well done. 
It came back under cooked. He did not pass our request to the kitchen.  He could care less about the customers. This was our last visit here.

Author: Ongbb
Title: Nice food but a but noisy
Review: It was my first time been to this restaurant, I like the food its tasty and nice. The decor is unique and beautiful but the music is a bit noisy. Its more like a pub cafe where people drink and talk.

Author: Cadenza88
Title: Returned visit
Review: Went back again with family the second time. The first visit was couple of years back. Still tasted good and worth the time in the queue. The kids love it!

Author: vtinivlini
Title: Best pizza by slice
Review: By far the best pizza by the slice anywhere in KL! Toppings are generous and tasty. Family-friendly place.

Author: dingsls
Title: Overrated
Review: The satay sauce was bland and watery, I had tasted better than this. The pork meat is fine but the portion given was too little. Overall, this place doesn't deserve to be in the top list.

Author: martin w
Title: Good vibe on a hot evening
Review:
Just dropped in on a hot, steamy evening.  Drinks were good and reasonably priced.  Staff friendly and helpful. Well positioned at the end of Jonkers by the river.
Went back the next night for more again after mooching around the town

Author: 1953blokeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid unless you enjoy being conned
Review: I have been to this bar three times now and one thing I am now certain of is that the waiting staff are crooked. They will try everything to short change you, delay bringing your change, overcharge you. Please keep your wits about you and make sure you keep track of your orders and your bill. These guys are con-men, actually con-men is too flattering, they are basically rip off artists who are trying to steal your money. The management is blissfully unaware of their antics but I'll make this prediction now, left in place these guys will destroy your reputation,it's already destroyed for me and I wont be going back, and ultimately your business too.

Author: Lup13_13London, United Kingdom
Title: A great buffet but nothing more.
Review: The Lemon Garden cafe is part of the Shangri La therefore the quality and variety of food (from international to malaysian) meets the standards of a 5 stars hotel so, absolutely nothing to complaint.But if you are looking for romanticism, traditional Malaysian athmosphere or tranquillity, I suggest you pick a different place.The menu is served also at buffet so the atmosphere reminds a bit of an "all you can eat" sushi bar.Fair price even if not exactly cheap.

Author: AikhongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good lunch at LTP Teochew restaurant
Review: We went there for lunch last Saturday. The roast suckling pig (no need pre order because many were prepared for 4 banquets that same night) was very good, not fatty and no strong 'porky' smell. The steamed pomfret was good. Although the fish was not like super fresh but fresh enough, the condiments used like plum, salted vege & mushroom balanced very well to make the liquid base very tasty. Lastly, the signature fried tanghoon with dry cuttlefish strips was very tasty, although the cuttlefish was a challenge for my teeth.

Author: louisa_kochStuttgart, Germany
Title: Average meal for mid-high price
Review: The atmosphere is not really good, the staff is not very friendly.Also the meal was only average for 130 RM for 2 Person you can expect more.i have seen better hard rock cafes!

Author: salomek439
Title: Okey
Review: Okey food but not that tasty. Nice staff. Cheap and okey for the price. Could need little more spices or something that makes it little more nice.

Author: Geoffrey L
Title: yucks!
Review: not well ventilated, very dirty environment, laid back staff.. just the location is good.. nothing worth to go..

Author: echaj18
Title: Ayam Pansuh
Review: Came here for dinner to try ayam pansuh halal. For me, ayam pansuh is like ayam masak lemak without coconut and more on the ginger/turmeric taste. The veg inside give the flavor and taste delicious. Portion for small (2 person) quite big, 5 pieces of chicken. Tips: the food is generous on the use of salt, please advice if want less salty.

Author: AuJusCoTucson, Arizona
Title: Excellent Nyonya Food
Review: Melaka was dead on Wednesday night and very few restaurants were open. We were hungry so we walked in whatever was open. Boy, we were pleasantly surprised. The food was really flavorful, with a bit of a kick, but not too spicy. It's perfect to wash down with beer (which Tames also sold). We ordered Rendang chicken, Kangkung Belacan, and Otak. The owner lady recommended the Otak as it was homemade. We were glad we accepted her recommendation. It's the best Nyonya food we had in Melaka. The decor was basic, and there were 3 generations of family members hanging out in the dinning room. I felt like I'm back to 1970s again, but the old school feel is part of the charm. Everyone, especially the owner lady, was friendly. When you're in Melaka you should give Tames a try.

Author: Nina_Most
Title: Relaxing
Review: Very nice place to relax. We have done exactly that. In early evening is so nice. On this occasion we have had a drink only. Service was quick.

Author: Citygal12456
Title: Nice location
Review: It is a nice bar by the beach. Food is okay. Their drinks are good. Annoying that staff are constantly talking loud to each other.

Author: r15xeb
Title: Not recommended
Review: Poor service and less than average food catering for the "trendy" set. Plenty of better choices in KLCC

Author: DarthNathan
Title: Key landmark but could improve
Review: The taste has dropped somewhat since I was here last (abt 5 yrs ago). The place is crowded and the wait for food is long. Value isn't exactly there. What they have got going for them is their location - but not much else. Not a single item was outstanding. I think the Geographer needs to be more than just a name.

Author: experience_12
Title: Overpriced !!
Review: Overpriced, specially the non duty paid foreign beers! Food takes hours to be served! Nothing special!

Author: Ken C
Title: Poor Quality Food
Review: Don't ever eat out at Healy Macs in KL Jalan P Ramlee the service is great the staff great the food terrible, couldn't eat mine 2 others sent back hot meal served cold.

Author: Wpei L
Title: All time favorite
Review: When I think of big breakfast, this place is the first one that comes into my mind. Plus the coffee, it is just perfect. We spent a lots​ of good time in Antipodean.

Author: rey-mundo-khorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rendang like my Ah kak....be ready to be surprised pleasantly!
Review: It was a mad rush for breakfast buffet as I arrived there with my friend at 9.50am and it closes at 1030am. I was hoping to get a quick bite to fill our morning tummies before we head back into the city for out holiday.We were on a "tourist in your own city" excursion. I suggested Le Meridien's Latest Recipe not because of it's review. To be truthful, i hardly read any but my heart was rooting for Hilton. But we ended up at Latest Recipe. Upon arriving at the lobby, we look rather rushed but everyone who saw us took it upon them to greet us Good Morning! That itself is so welcoming and then we reached the Latest Recipe and the Manager told us we have less then 30 minutes to eat and well that's the objective. Fill our tummies only. But the moment we got to taste the food, although we know its been served since early morning, it caught us by a pleasant surprise.... its like just cooked. at 10am, Nasi Lemak is still steamy and pile up a hill, warm and soft rice, the Rendang Ayam was HEAVENLY and that is one reason I intend to visit again for lunch and from a tummy filling exercise, I savour every dish I took from the buffet line. The sausages were excellent and they serve frankfurters too..I mean...the effort to make frankfurters! There was a whole roasted chicken, yet to be carved. Sushi, Congee, Dim Sum, and a Health Section of fresh fruits, meuslies and the list goes on....I can rant on but please make it a MUST TRY and try me by this tip, be nice, very nice to the staff there and you shall too be pleasantly surprised and rewarded. They understand, they welcome and truly, a service..no not service...a gesture of true hospitality that warrants return upon return! Kudos to Andy, Dinesh and Salim! You made it all so special!

Author: GojavasBengaluru, India
Title: Nice crepes but need a more exhaustive ice cream menu
Review: We went here around 4 pm for a dessert and as the reviews mentioned before this is a highly rated place. Unfortunately for us, we wanted to have some ice creams and thought that the crepes would have some ice creams in it but there was only one scoop of chocolate ice cream(you have a choice between vanilla and chocolate).Dont get me wrong, the ice cream was delicious along with the banana,nutella crepe which was highly recommended but we would have liked if they expand their menu to include a separate ice cream section only for ice cream lovers. The lady owner was very friendly as she gave an extra spoon for my little kid to enjoy the crepes but we finished the ice creams and bananas first and the crepe became rather bland to eat all alone. Overall quite satisfied.Note that they are closed on Thursdays and Fridays as we realized that when we went on friday afternoon. They are located in very near the Cenang mall.

Author: TifKoh
Title: Terrible
Review: We liked to shop at Midvalley, it is the best shopping mall in KL. After our shopping spree, we went to 4Fingers at the basement level for supper. At first, my friends (foreigners), wanted to pack their burgers & drinks back to hotel (about 9.40pm on Wed night last week). Later, we only bought drinks.One Indian service staff, pretty tall, was at the cashier. My friends did not understand her so didn't get the right change. She was rude and abrupt. She repeated the amount loudly. Our evening was almost spoilt by her. We changed our minds and only ordered drinks and not the chicken for supper. This was my foreign friends' first experience of the 'bad attitude' of a Malaysian staff, sadly.The rest of the service staff in the mall and at the Info Counter were superb, except this staff. It was a shame. We could have been great customers of 4Fingers if not for her :((Their ice milo was very diluted.

Author: mamiface123
Title: the worst restaurant
Review: service is so so so bad. The manager there was so rude to customers and the foods were just average! Don't worth to wait that long. Management is very poor.

Author: CatherineLow
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: It's always pleasure to dine here irregardless for what purpose. The food, services are excellent! Just love to dine here for the yummy 😋 food!

Author: Simply1005
Title: Our family's favourite
Review:
Our family's favourite after testing out all the heong peahs along Jalan Gunung Rapat. They also sell 3-in-1 coffee satchets and other biscuits.

Do check out their cats which are tasked to keep the mice away.

Author: julian lKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Curious atmosphere
Review: It has taken me a while to write this review because I wanted to think carefully before posting.As much as I wanted to give Sham's Cooked With Love a good rating, on reflection it simply did not deserve one.While Sham is a decent home cook her food is not restaurant standard. And though she attempts to be a hospitable host, on the day she did not seem overly warm or welcoming.Further, I was hoping to be shown into the kitchen and expected a bit more insight into the various spices, however neither was forthcoming.What really let the meal down though was not the food (which was pleasant enough) but the curious atmosphere in the apartment. Dining at the chef's home could have been a magical experience but with the TV blaring and her children running about, any sense of calm quickly vanished. Moreover, being served a drink from a glass with a huge chip on the edge was a careless oversight. If you are a tourist who wishes to experience a meal at a stranger's house then this could be for you.But if you live in KL, this is a big, big letdown.

Author: Hoyctsp
Title: FOH SAN DIM SUM
Review: This Restaurant was very old Dim Sum Restaurant and compare when childhood taste is better than now. The service now is very poor and price expensive

Author: dennis8899sg
Title: Dim Sum Ipoh
Review: Huge like a mall,   food and price moderate.  A place more for tourist. Located a road behind Excelsior Hotel

Author: GlobalAdi
Title: Not worth it!
Review: Food was so so. Fish was smelling bad. Chicken was not fresh. Butter milk was also bad. Over all i did not enjoy the experience!!

Author: HannuK158
Title: Just fine
Review:
Without reservation no hope to get
a table inside.So we had our
meal on the porch. No broblem.
Western type of food was good.
Price level on the higher side.

Author: Christine LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: For the price per head, i would have liked to see my tempura being fried on order and not sitting in a buffet dish. By the time u eat, its gone cold and not crispy as tempura should be.Service is also fairly slow. have to keep asking for my tea to be refill.

Author: Linda CBeijing, China
Title: Definitely Worth Its Number 1 Rating
Review: The place is alright. Food is average and the service was passable. A bit expensive for what you get. We only came for an early dinner so can't comment on the bar scene. We ordered a fish and chips and a pizza with anchovies. The fish and chips was not memorable and the anchovies were hard and crunchy, don't like the dried kind. Wish we had known beforehand. Wouldn't come again.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: SHIRLEYB843Province of Rome, Italy
Title: Terrible overcharging for westerners -Frosty attitude!
Review: Watch out for either the elderly Chinese Family Owner 'Aunty' or 'Uncle' here watching the food on your dish either plate or take away packet!Problem here is that the price for meals is not consistent -you go one day and the charge is different but the owners deal with the money and not the migrant worker staff who don't speak English at all. Local white collar staff get their meals cheaper -we watched this happen . Lunch times could be packed with office staff so no tables. This is not a reflection of quality but price for them and not for us, How do we know? We asked the locals outside the cafe when leaving for clarification. Food is so so quality but acceptable and served from a few stainless steel troughs with mixed veg. Set behind a car park.

Author: 89shivbJaipur, India
Title: Nice ambiance and a nice corner to hang out ...
Review: This is the busiest place on the Jonker street , post 10 PM at night !! Lively music , food optins are limited but reasonably good , has a laid back and casual charm both during the day and at night...however , i wish , they maintain and clean their toilets a bit better. Coffee lovers can taste some good stuff during the day and the prices are over all quite reasonable ...I would recommend Geographer Cafe as a decent and a lively hang out place in the laid out town of Melaka ..

Author: Salina-Soon Lin... CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood dinner
Review: Good, fresh and affordable seafood dinner. Shop opens only at 6pm daily. Very friendly and attentive service. Great for a group dinner, as more dishes can be ordered. Nevertheless my husband and I did full justice to the 4 dishes we ordered- crispy fried soft shelled crabs, salted egg squids, grilled prawns and stir fried bean sprouts (taugeh)with salted fish and black mushrooms! Very good dinner!

Author: RobYoungerKilcock, Ireland
Title: Great selection of craft beers
Review: I'm a bit of a beer connoisseur. I like to try lots of different kinds of beer and I am continually changing what I drink. Imagine my delight when I found the Brussels Beer Cafe near my hotel in KL. After a day touring KL, I would make a point of stopping off at the Brussels Beer Cafe on my way home to enjoy a Leffe, A Hoegaarden and particularly the Kriek Lambic. It was nice to cool down near the outdoor air con whilst sipping a beer and watching the world go by.

Author: Tayfun U
Title: Awful, awful, awful - avoid at all cost
Review: Took my team in Malaysia and one of the colleagues wanted to take part of her desert to her son at home... the manager came and said that even though we paid 4000 plus ringgit, they were not willing to part with a silly tin can the dish was served in .... horrible end to an evening - would never bring anyone I like here again - ever

Author: Preetpannu
Title: Preet pannu Jb
Review:
I am very pleased with the service and the quality of food is very good.Very tasty food, reasonable prices. Atmosphere is special, but the food is great. 
I recommend this place to all my friends.
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food

Author: marypoppinss
Title: AVOID THE PLACE AT ALL COST!
Review: The place is so terrible!!!My family of four went there in Feb 2015. First of all the order took so long to come. Staff were inefficient and unprofessional.The muffins and drinks came first -they were okay. The food arrived an hour after placing the order. The portions of the set meals were so small and looked unappealing to say the least. The minestrone soup was cold with soggy crumbs of bread in it. It honestly looked like someone else's leftover. The rice looked and tasted old. The chicken tasted like it was going to get spoilt and really bland. Ended up just leaving the restaurant without eating. A total waste of money and time!

Author: amiraha247
Title: Dinner
Review: The dinner was super amazing. The place is very clean and sanitize. My food was suggested by Azzu, she is bery friendly and knowledgeable.

Author: e_SweeLing
Title: Good food good environment, but too noisy
Review:
Good food good coffee and good environment.
Because everything is good, therefore the crowd is crazy almost all the time. It's a bit too noisy if you are looking for a cozy quiet place to read book.
Restaurant: New Chapter by The Owls Cafe

Author: DalvinderS9
Title: Mediocre western food with poor service
Review: I had really poor service during my visit with my wife today. The food was subpar with our grilled lamb & grilled chicken served cold and not seasoned well. Although they have facilities for payment by credit card, but for some reasoned they refused to accept payment by card. If you enjoy eating blend and mediocre western food with poor service, then do visit Chef at home.

Author: jerrypeter11Toronto, Canada
Title: Amazing Gastronomic Journey .
Review: Nadodi gave me an amazing gastronomic dining experience . The food journey and wine pairing was amazing. The dishes were prepared with so much passion that is resonated in every dish i had. They journey was out of this world from start to end. We also tried some of their signature cocktails which was one of a kind by taste, presentation and quality. The nadodi team is really a passionate bunch and not only knowledgable, they take pride in everything they serve and each dish comes with a little story which mesmerise you even further. a must try and i will be back again too!

Author: jordananas668Johor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Marriage Proposal at TOSCA's private dining room; but FOOD is "kinda disappointed"
Review: It was a great and beautiful night, the Manager of TOSCA, Mr Jai called on the next day (23/11/2014), for seeking feedback on the overall dining experience at TOSCA, so after gathering some feedbacks from my invited guests, i decided to leave a review here. I booked the private dining room on 22/11/2014 and invited 12 guests (include my fiancée and myself, total 14 ppl) to celebrate my fiancée's 26th birthday, as well as to give her a surprise marriage proposal at TOSCA (13th floor of Double Tree JB) After surveying around, i found TOSCA have best in term of restaurant's ambience and environment. My pleasure to come across with the manager, Mr Jai. Then I was told that TOSCA will be busy on 22/11/2014, as it's public holiday, so Mr Jai prepared a set menu "Salads, Soup, Main Course(Cod Fish, Beef, Chicken) and desserts, one week before the actual day, for my 12 guests to make their prior selection. Mr Jai is really friendly and helpful, he really impressed me with his good services.Thanks to him and his crews who gave me their full cooperation and support on that night. However, the food is kinda disappointed, all my guests claimed that the mushroom soup turned out to be tasteless; the cod fish and beef as well, it's freshly cooked but tasteless. We all enjoyed the private dining room's ambience and environment, but hope TOSCA can improve the the taste of food.P/S: I posted this review once at Double Tree by Hilton Johor Bahru's trip advisor page, but was told by the GM Mr Simon McGrath, Tosca has its own trip advisor site, so i re-post the review here. Thanks.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Jaya Sangar J
Title: Worst food
Review:
I m in the restaurant now...worse ever restaurant that I have visited. The thosai is the worst. .my son ordered mee goreng mamak. .its horrible
.pls don't make a try. ...

Author: Julie G
Title: Small portions
Review: We went for dinner. Satays were the smallest I have ever experienced. Meals are also small even kebabs were small as a main. The rice was average like riceariso. Overpriced.

Author: dingsls
Title: Overrated n poor service
Review: Good ambience. However, foods were not as great as described. We ordered laksa (taste average), nyonya beehoon (big serving but bland), fried rice (big seevubg but served cold n tasteless) and cendol (taste bland with diluted gula Melaka). The workers were not attentive and ignorant but Alan was helpful enough to check our order.

Author: JLee1982
Title: Poor quality of food and overpriced
Review: Staff here are disinterested, food was substandard and overpriced. Wish they could be a lot more environmentally friendly and not use plastic for drinks. Only thing good about the place is it's convenient location

Author: Misz N
Title: Wonderful Service ... Great food at Infusion Cafè
Review: I have been here many times... and had organized 3 events for my company here...my reasons for coming back? Definitely the great service by the staff... especially by staff named Wati and Nizam.. they are so polite and will do their very best to fulfill guests' requests.. and the food is great.. kudos for a job well done..

Author: DrMikeDC
Title: My go to for lunch in a pinch
Review: Quality food. Good service. Good location. Solid menu. Always like coming back here. This is for the gardens branch. Better access IMO. Staff made effort to remember me. Try the chicken skin mushrooms.

Author: Coffeeaddicthereiam
Title: Nice place to hang. Great coffee and pastry ;)
Review: Regularly come here with my family. Love the ambiance, food and The owner is very friendly and generous;)

Author: wkwoon88
Title: Brand new experience
Review: The idea of having a nice dinner inside of an airplane while not having to fly anywhere is cool. The service crew is very polite.

Author: 71qamarw
Title: Variety of Terengganu dishes
Review: Mak Uda offers a wide variety of east coast dishes, specifically from terengganu. Their breakfast spread is great: nasi dagang, laksam, nasi kerabu, ikan goreng tepung, pulut ikan n many kueh. Their pulut ikan n laksam are good. But I could never eat the nasi kerabu because they use the bright blue artificial colouring. Actually Hartinie n Sri Merah offer more authentic kelantanese food. The pulut ikan is superb. Lunch - they have ikan Bakar too.

Author: BazNZ
Title: Very nice piggie food!
Review: I had Iberico ribs which were delicious. Service was outstanding, brought us free bread with pate and a cocktail to finish. Highly recommended.

Author: Mingsrealm
Title: The banana leaf kitchen
Review: Friendly service. Good and comfortable environment.  Food was good will definitely be visiting again to try the banana leaf rice.

Author: TPANGSingapore
Title: swatting flies as we eat
Review: This review is only for the Mt Austin branch. (I went to the Sutera branch and it was excellent)The side dishes were cold and unappetizing. With a party of 7, they only gave us a tiny amount enough for 1. Limited selections too and not well prepared. The meat we ordered came BBQ, even though they didn't ask if we wanted it. We had wanted the kids to enjoy bbq it by the table, the traditional way. . The most uncomfortable part was having to deal with the flies while eating. Its ridiculous tp have the staff standing next to your table with a bright pink fly swatter. There are plenty of other Korean restaurants at Mt Austin.

Author: KaylyWang
Title: One of the best Jap food in PJ area!
Review: My 2nd visit to Miyabi this time for dinner. Great variety of set dinners from the freshest sashimi,beef teppanyaki, assorted sushi,teapot soup etc. Trusted Chef Dino's recommendations definitely made it more worthwhile. Kids loved the udon and of course the Yuzu ice cream for dessert. Have recommended colleagues and friends and will definitely continue to do so...good job team at Miyabi.

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing service
Review: We were 10 minutes late for our reservation (and only because all the escalators were not working and we had to carefully walk up 4 flights of escalators with young children), were told as our table was not ready yet we had to wait - no issues with that. Fifteen minutes later, were told that the table that was meant for us, is now given to another group - Why?? "Because you were late!" So we had to wait for Another table. Told the bespectacled Italian man that we have been here all this while waiting for that table, but he then raised his voice and said we were late therefore No! Not negotiable. They gave some young expat couples our table instead. We should have just left, but the children were hungry.We were fans of Ra.Ft in KL and it's positive vibes from the other staff, but this seemingly racist episode has left a bitter taste and we will not be back.

Author: ACanadian2019
Title: Regular food and high price
Review: Westin the living room buffet suppose only open to public on weekends,weekdays only open to seminar groups but today the server he let us to joining it. Overall the food selection are not much just like a regular buffet restaurant. The worst part is Westin they charged us the weekend price which is $235 for 2 persons.Kind of disappointed and frustrated with such kind of price and food serving by a 5 star hotel

Author: StefHing
Title: Not bad
Review: As a Malaysian I do prefer to go and try all the food on the street than visit here, first it is cheaper sometimes the street food taste better,but to visit Madam Kwan u are ensured with the hygienic.

Author: mjyates
Title: Great Sunday evening
Review:
Went here, and was a bit apprehensive.
My worries were put at ease by the host and the waiter.
What a great meal, the darkness just made it all the more special.
Recommend this for a special meal.

Author: Andrew11211Singapore, Singapore
Title: An irish sports pub that plays music over the games
Review: I would have given 1 star except they have metal instead of plastic straws.Twice I have been to Macgreggors - both times to watch rugby and had identical problems.So I went to an Irish sports Bar to watch Ireland play in the Rugby World Cup. The game was advertised as being on but when I got there the video was on the screen, but the sound was off and they were playing music.Literally *every* person in the place was there to watch the rugby. 2 people were managing to stream it on their phones to get the sound, which could only just be heard over the music they insisted they played.Staff said they couldnt turn on the sound until after the manager got there which was after the game finished. Apparently they couldnt ring the manager either to change it. after the game finished they managed to turn the sound on one TV only which was outside where only 1 of the people were watching.If I go back to JB I will find another place that shows the rugby.

Author: boon T
Title: Chicken rice
Review:
Standard dropped. Not as good as the last time I was here
 Taugeh also seem to have lost its trademarks.

Author: Fionelee
Title: Nice ambience but mediocre food
Review: I'm going there with my sister and my daughter for high tea. We were given a seat right beside the window panel in the middle section where we can only view KL tower but not KLCC. As usual our warm climate hits the window panel and when the sun setting down around 330pm our table and seat were hit directly by the sun as if we were sun bathing so if you do not prefer this to happen do request for inner tables rather than window seat. The food wise were mediocre for the price of RM128. The sandwiches were above average, scones were quite hard though, all othe desserts were extremely sweet to our liking that we only tasted one bite for each and left it untouched for the remaining. The best serving was the fried cheese puff serve on a glass of uncooked rice. The hot chocolate did not come up to expectation as Starbucks hot chocolate were way better imho. I personally feel that we actually pay for the ambience rather than the food. The staffs were rather helpful as they are willing to take photos for us as memory. We were sitting in the section one table away with a bunch of age 40s ladies who non stop taking photos and selfie since we enter the restaurant until we left. Thats about 1.5hrs. That's our experience at Altitude. I would rate 5.5/10 for the overall experience, food and ambience.

Author: B1shonenSiem Reap, Cambodia
Title: Consistent service
Review: This was my 3rd time to HRC... this time to celebrate my little niece birthday whose live In KL, I wont bother to review of the food as we all know how generous it is. my highlight was the staff for its consistency service. the staff even willing to sort of white lies to give a birthday suprise to my little niece. at the end they were all singing birthday song... terima kaseh HRC... TOP NOTCH SERVICE

Author: Xenoraph
Title: Great food, Great Service
Review: Ordered the Salmon. It was really good. The manager/owner was here and chatted with us for a bit. He even treated us to free dessert. Will definitely come back this vacation.Cheers to this place!

Author: JeszwuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome experience
Review: Returning customer, Came back here for my husband's birthday, made a reservation thru phone call and specially requested for a surprise dessert at the end of the course. We ordered guiness ribs and angus sirloin, food was splendid as usual. Thanks irene for serving and attending to our needs. She did a very great job. Best part is they gave us complimentary vodka shots and also a little green pig figurine as a birthday gift, so thoughtful! We will come back again, definitely!

Author: Cheerysunshine2001Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lifeless 'Lazy' Service Staff !
Review: A local friend highly recommended Cozy Corner @ Ampang Park Mall. Finally, we went there shortly after Raya for dinner around 7'ish on a mid-week. There were less than 10 pax (incl. the 2 of us) occupied 3-4 tables. Waiters seemed lifeless & slow in attending to us. Explicitly demonstrated lack of interest in providing any services, needless to mention achieving customer service excellence (never expect a 5-star hotel service here, but NO service or whatever to begin with!) Food was nothing fantastic, I think road side Zi Char can be easily outdone & tastier. Furthermore, cheaper without tax & service charge. Ironically, we had to pay 10% service charge where there is NONE !!

Author: TKH1990
Title: Bad service
Review: Terrible service. Food didn't arrive twice. Ordered paella for 45 mins and it didn't arrive after which they said it was finished. If your order doesn't arrive remember to check!!

Author: victoriakH6049GG
Title: Rather dismal
Review: My family of 4 ordered from their menu shortly after they served a table of 8pax. Subsequently we waited 50mins for our order. The staff were apologetic, but could not make up for the kitchen’s tardiness. We ordered Pan eggs which were wayy overcooked, the mac & cheese which was not salted nor flavorful, pasta with scallops where the angel hair pasta was overcooked, and the big breakfast, at least the last item was acceptable. A very disappointing dining experience overall.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Gavontheweb
Title: Came back for more
Review: We had two fantastic meals here, fresh, nicely served meals right on the beach with great choice of cocktails and wines. Definitely recommend.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: simonwong88Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Kuchabe Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur
Review: A few buddies of mine decided to dine @ Kuchabe Taman Desa branch in Kuala Lumpur. We were trying some new menu to us ala vegetarian. Surprisingly, the food tasted delicious & the kopi got oomph (the real kick in coffee taste). Must try the kampung styled fried rice & the pumpkin barley drink. Well worth our time to visit this outlet. Thumbs up

Author: SungeiSarawakPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Ravioli Ripoff
Review: I have visited this restaurant on one occasion and left angry and still hungry. RM45 purchased 5/6 smoked salmon pieces in skinny ravioli envelopes with tomato sauce base (and water). To set this in context, at a restaurant just opposite similar expenditure obtains a substantial salmon 'slab' with veggies and tumeric sauce (and fruit drink).These are premium prices - one expects proud product.I've eaten at multiple Italian restaurants since learning (a little!) Italian many years ago and become accustomed to a certain display of talent - value and variety. Sad to say, despite its multiple photos of Italian scenes, I find myself forced to report here my negative experience.

Author: maartendg85
Title: Suprisingly good
Review: When you see the restaurant at first glance it doesn't seem like a place where would find this quality of food. We went there because of the previous reviews and we're not disappointed one bit. We had one of the best meals so far in Kuala Lumpur and for such a great price it's a must do.

Author: 246melindahMelbourne, Australia
Title: Don't bother
Review: My husband and I attempted to have a final drink in the bar before heading back home. We thought the view and the experience would be good way to top off our extended holiday. It wasn't to be, as we were denied entry due to their "dress code". My husband was wearing a collared shirt, tailored shorts and leather sandals. I had on a very nice silk dress and sandals. We weren't wearing thongs and singlets! When you're travelling around a (hot) country for 4 weeks, the last thing you're going to pack is long trousers, closed toed shoes, and heels. As has been our experience throughout Malaysia, there are many Malaysian businesses and tourist attractions that are not interested in tourists and tourism.

Author: 245daverDungog
Title: Rude Staff
Review: My wife and I were visiting Melaka for three days and we were advised that Makko was a good restaurant. When we arrived we were promptly seated and the menu looked nice and spicy. Shortly after we ordered I heard a waitress say "dumb westerners " in Mandarin. We were the only Caucasians in the room. A short time later another waitress delivered our drinks and she had a plate of prawn chips in her hand. She said in Mandarin "they not want these." She laughed to another staff member who also laughed and took the chips back into the kitchen. I speak enough Mandarin to understand what was being said and the context.Such a shame because the food was good.

Author: koksekMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas
Review: Its totally not asam pedas to my taste. I had in the past asam pedas which is totally different. Why can"t they serve asam pedas as in the good old days, where our grand mother used to prepare and the the aroma is really delicious where theirs a saying quote" orang lalu dibelakang rumah tidak sedar'" unquote. Translated means people passing behind our house did not notice. This is the original asam pedas!!

Author: cia w
Title: Nice food
Review: Food is nice but the pork knuckle is too dry and hard after frying. Fried chicken, mixed seafood hot plate,curry fish claypot and pork knuckle are the famous dishes. Hope the owner take note of the pork knuckle quality.

Author: Stoic1948Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Elegant nothing at a very high price
Review: The location on the 38th floor of the brand-new Hyatt is stunning with great views over Kuala Lumpur. View is important for a restaurant but good food, of course, is the most important. On that count Thirty8 sorely and expensively disappoints.We ordered the large seafood platter for two: not only was it quite small in comparison to similar ones in other restaurants anywhere in the world (e.g. a mere two each of oysters and clams) but the price was exorbitant. The taste was utterly bland, and if you'd been eating with your eyes closed you''d have been hard put to distinguish the various crustaceans and clams. My main course of roasted duck was undercooked and not at all crispy (as promised); my companion's steak was okay, but how much is there to spoil in a rare cut? Potato fries were too crisp and the asparagus listless. The dessert was ok if you allow for half-frozen strawberries.All in all a very disappointing experience given, too, the fact that there's lots of really good seafood in Malaysia, and delicious ducks galore! This was a 'nothing'. The Kuala Lumpur Hyatt should be ashamed of itself. It must be said that the staff was very friendly, but that they were clearly undertrained amateurs.The bill was shockingly whopping for what was offered.

Author: Teresa HManchester, United Kingdom
Title: waited & waited & waited a bit longer
Review: We had visited this restaurant on previous visits and had always enjoyed the food and service. What has happened ????? we sat down and our order was taken after about 15 minutes, our drinks arrived 20 minutes later and after the waiter spilled it waited again.After an hour still nor food no cutlery and no acknowledgement we were even there. Listening to other guests there were problems no service no food and wrong change.The attitude of the staff was appalling not one simled or even attempted to make contacts with guests. We left in the end as other guests seemed too. It is a lovely location but just can not get anything right. I certainly would not recomend this restaurant. When passing on other nights there was no body in so word must have got around kutching What a shame.

Author: naafarrrSingapore, Singapore
Title: Salvaging point: clear view of the Twin Towers.
Review: Considering the hype I read about this restaurant on Tripadvisor and on the web, this restaurant is quite a disappointment!Tried its afternoon tea. In December, the restaurant apparently only serves a 'High on Sugar' afternoon tea. Alright, given the name, I was expecting a lot of delectable sweet and savoury dessert choices. But what was laid out was only a table, comprising of cakes, macarons, scones, pralines etc. Taste was mediocre but really nothing fantastic.The table served two choices of sandwiches - tuna and chicken, of which was a thick stack of bread with very little tuna or chicken filling. And the restaurant also served complimentary dim sum, spring rolls, and epok-epok (seriously?). I mean, how do these fit into the 'High on Sugar' theme?Food aside, my biggest qualm about the restaurant is its service. We came slightly early and was asked to wait at the lounge while they prepared our table and the service in general. 5 minutes into 3 pm and we were only ushered in a while later. Never mind that, but our table were not set properly, and comparing with the other tables, some things were missing. Probably worst, the buffet table was not ready, and the servers were still bringing the food and the utensils out 15-20 minutes into the supposed start of the tea time. Remember the sandwich? It wasn't brought out until 20 minutes later.And oh. One of the managers/supervisor came to ask if everything was okay. He asked "Everything is alright, right?" I'm quite sure he meant "Is everything to your liking?" And later on, some of the supervisors were discussing about a colleague, and I could clearly hear dissing/vulgarities. (Obviously cos I understand the language...) Not very professional eh?A salvaging point is probably the view of the Twin Towers.

Author: GladysK908Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible sushi
Review: Chance upon this at KLCC. Ordered sushi and shabu shabu. Sushi is horrible. Doesn’t taste like Japanese sushi. The rice doesn’t seems like Japanese rice. Shabu shabu was really expensive. Got 4 thin slices of beef. The rest are all vegetables. In the end the shabu shabu is like vegetable soup. Overall disappointed with the quality of the food in this restaurant.

Author: Pat RDublin, Ireland
Title: Good beer!
Review: We stopped for a few drinks and stayed for more than a few ;) They had a good promo for craft beers so we ordered a bunch. The staff were very knowledgeable about their stuff! A bit pricey, one must admit, but it was worth it and we enjoyed our visit.

Author: Jaayy94
Title: Casual and fun
Review: Good music, but too hot though, friendly place, sohag is the best host, must must must visit while in malaysia

Author: oal151Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Total rip-off!
Review: Heard about this hip place from several sources so decided to check out for myself. On first impression, it looked like a biker's dream come true with an array of motorcycle memorabilia and collectibles. My companion and i settled to ordering our drinks and dinner- ABC ( shaven ice with red beans , and grassjelly) , and upon the waitress recommendation, a fried tomato kuey teow and their specialty, their ox-tail assam pedas ( oxtail in a sweet sour hot stew) . The latter sounded quite exciting and we were eager to try . The desert drink ABC came first - it wasn't too bad with a right level of sweetness but I would have preferred if the ice were more finely shaven.Next was the tomato kuey teow- the prawns and squid in it were fresh and firm but there were only 2 prawns - I would have expected more for the price of RM14! The kuey teow tasted a bit stale , evidencing that they were probably kept in the fridge for at least a day or 2. The success of every tomato kuey teow lies in its fragrant tomato ketchup gravy and I could actually say that this particular gravy here was quite pleasant with the right amount of "kick" of sourness and sweetness.......... but that is where my compliment ends. The oxtail assam pedas was a huge disappointment!!! Not only were there chunks of bones and little else save for 3 very stringy old and " unchewable" lady fingers and a few pieces of sliced tomatoes , but when I pointed it out to the waitress that I had nothing but bones in my dish she went to the kitchen and came out a few seconds later , shrugging her shoulders and said - " sorry but the oxtail is "memang" like this.".For a hefty price of RM28, I would have expected at least 50% meat and 50% oxtail bone, but what I got was probably 5% meat and 95% oxtail bone!!!I really felt cheated here! It was actually my intention to recce the place for an upcoming birthday party but after tonight's experience, I was appalled and disappointed to say the least and it is unlikely I would return.

Author: Chan C
Title: Afternoon snacks
Review: In Chinatown. A traditional Chinese herbal shop selling herbal teas and jelly. The herbal jelly tasted good with honey. The herbs are supposed to cool your body, especially from the heat in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: margheritapie
Title: Nice environment, bad coffee
Review: Ambience is excellent but food here is overpriced for the quality served. The coffee is bad and not worth paying for. Good place to hang out with ppl though
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: AcrylKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst service!
Review: There is plenty of choice for lunch or dinner at KLCC so do yourself a favor and avoid this place!The staff here are unfriendly, unsmiling and they are just hanging around doing nothing. While entering the restaurant You don't even get a "hi, welcome!" But rather an unfriendly frown as you are obviously disturbing them. Getting their attention to place your order is an almost impossible mission even when the restaurant is half empty and off peak hour .... Same problem to get the bill. The food is ok but nothing to rave about either. Frustrating experience and definitely not worth coming back.

Author: DavideA572
Title: Italian name
Review: The restaurant offers a menu with many italian dishes. The result is not that much italian indeed, and it can be improved. It is located inside the hotel and for late arrivals(like mine)  remains a decent choice

Author: boknaai69Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: All show but no go.
Review: Went on the Saturday before the F1 , watching qualifying. Ordered a new york cut steak medium rare. It came still mooing. I asked the waiter if this was what the classified as medium rare. He said it was rare and that he would fix it. Disappeared for approx 15 minutes and btough back the same steak now closer to well done than medium. The pepper sauce which came in a separate little cup now had a skin on it because it had cooled down. They had not seen fit to give me a new one and likewise with the fries. The steak itself was fat and gristle . Not a good cut of meat. At this point I was past arguing , drank my beer and left. The wait staff seem on the ball, but are let down by the kitchen. The owner also decided to have a staff meeting while their were 17 people in the restaurant. Not a good way to run a business. he place looks pleasant enough and the photos are awesome. But the reality is different.

Author: Skyline1919Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Oily Food
Review: I went to this restaurant in this week. I ordered three dishes.A staff served us oily pork chop and a burned beef wrapped with betel leafs. We use many pieces of tissue to wipe out the oil from the pork chop before we eat. We have ordered 3 dishes as the same time,but the staff forgot to take note our 3rd dish. Once we told him,he walked out and add on our order. The last dish was delayed and served with bad quality. I would suggest the chefs to concern about the oily food. Before you serve the customers,please make sure that there is not too much oil. The food is tasty but oily.

Author: Sch1381
Title: Overpriced
Review: Food quality ok but overpriced. Average service provided.There are better options nearby in Midvalley mall.

Author: TripntreatsukLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unique experience, poor food.
Review: Firstly it’s a unique experience to dine in a revolving restaurant with an incredible view. However if the food isn’t good then what’s the point. It’s a buffet system and not a good one. Too many people pushing around for food that isn’t even great. I suggest you dine elsewhere and just come here for the observation deck.

Author: GavinJ594Aboyne, United Kingdom
Title: Designed and Priced for tourists but ...... great food and drinks
Review: This place opens at 08:00 and closes at 17:00 and catered almost entirely for the foreign community with (excellent) Vega, Vegetarian and Meat based foods all priced accordingly - we had a coconut based muesli and a sweet-potato curry with Roti and a couple of juices which was RM$30 - so very good but expensive by local standards. The manager is very friendly and helpful and makes a fantastic Coconut Shake and / or a Banana Shake. They also have accommodation and also run cookery classes which we did not try.My verdict: great local food and a great selection of vege and vegan food in a lovely little side street in the centre of town with great staff ..... but relatively expensive.

Author: ChloeL1269
Title: Good ambience but staffs need training
Review: As intentional we visited this cafe due to many good reviews, I would say that it has good food. However, Staff customer service experience wasn’t up to standard. I sat at the corner of the sofa bench chairs and since the table and bench was narrow, there was an obstruction and sharp corner of the bench, I knock myself at the knee and it was so painful. The staff just look at me with the poker face, no asking of how am I, he simply stand there like a stone, (owner, you can see from the cctv on 2 July 3pm onwards), then I wanted to go up to view the layout of the cafe, the staff said we can go, after viewing we came down, was shock that another customer took our seats and table, wow! I was pretty shock the staff didn’t reserve the table for us, we simply went up for less than 5 mins and came down with our seats taken by another customer ?The staffs also didn’t greet us when we enter.

Author: JuJabar
Title: Yun House is phenomenal!
Review: I organized a birthday lunch get-together and I'd been liaising with Celine. She had been very kind & helpful. Celine had the ability to communicate information and answer questions extremely well. I'd received a personalised customer service on a consistent basis from Celine. Thank you so much Celine & Team Yun House for being wonderful! Keep shining bright!
