Author: thiathiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Late lunch on a sunday
Review: Food has gone pretty bad. We ordered 1 nasi lemak, 1 curry laksa an one soft shell crab rojak. The curry laksa is tasteless and very soft noodle. The nasi lemak is not as good as how it was. The rojak nothing to shout about. The service is really slow even at 2pm. The servers are not friendly. Our appetite had disappeared the moment we sat down. They never smile at all during the whole lunch time we were there. Will not go back again. There are better nasi lemak and curry laksa in KL

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very oily Sarawak Laksa
Review: Typical coffee shop in Miri... One of those shops which is still open after 2pm. Sarawak Laksa is not great. The broth is bland and it's filled with a layer of oil. Tomato noodles wasn't what we expected- it has great wok hei taste but not sure if this is Miri tomato noodle. Will not recommend this place for Sarawak Laksa.

Author: Vinasha AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Needs an 'overhaul' through and through
Review: I used to go here everytime i needed a 'beef rib' fix but have stopped in the last year. Portions have gotten smaller and everytime I pay a visit, i could have sworn the price was lower the last round I was there.Service is unpredictable, one day you get a smiley face, another day you get a blank face and slow service. But in Malaysia I find this more and more common, people in the service industry have absolutely no regard in doing their jobs; ie providing service!The lighting is dim and the decor is dark so you can't really see, but overall cleanliness seems to be detoriating

Author: manchesterianBangkokBangkok, Thailand
Title: Convenient if you are in the area
Review: This restaurant has changed hands many time and in its new guise seems to be doing quite well considering how busy it was for lunch during Ramadan . They offer a reasonably priced lunch menu which my friend had but I just opted for a club type sandwich which came with acceptable chunky French fries.

Author: 968cherylnManila, Philippines
Title: My fave in Penang
Review: I spent 5 days in Penang trying out the all supposedly best places to eat, fromThe hawkers to the posh places, I even joined the heritage on a plate food tour but I dare say the best meal I had was at the mews cafe. I had the fish seamed in banana leaf and beef rendang. The meats were tender and the balance of flavors were perfect.'just the right touch of sweet, salt, spicy and aromatic. It wasn't too spicy that it drowned out other flavors, the meal came with a cup of blue tinged rice which I'mTold was naturally colored with butterfly pea flower. The pretty server June gave me some buds on warm water. Which gradually turned it a light shade of blue. The cafe itself is a welcome respite. The lush row of birds of paradise gracefully beckons and sways with the wind a tropical paradise in the heart of Georgetown

Author: Loh S
Title: Disappointment with this high rated restaurant
Review: When I browse the internet, this restaurant won the highest rated among all dim sum restaurant, but it brings me disappointment. Bad smell in the air-conditioning restaurant, food no surprise. I must give low mark to pull down its rating

Author: Lee S
Title: Nice dinner
Review: This is my 2nd time visit, the food is nice and cheap. Unfortunately most of the dish is not available and sold out due to holiday period. Will come back again with my family if I visit Malacca.

Author: elbertlim
Title: Times Square branch
Review: Looking for lamian noodle. What we got is ramen noodle. Only lamian for the name.  Ordering both pork and beef lamian. Pork lamian taste bland. Beef noodle just average. Only xiao long pao is good

Author: monniemooBedford, Australia
Title: Great location, average food, rushed service
Review: Went here for a special occasion. After being told that the shuttle service was not available the night we booked (admittedly a drawcard given the distance from central KL), we decided to taxi there. On arrival, staff were quite intrusive with strong recommendations of the most pricey dishes on menu. We ordered and within 10 minutes, appetizers arrived. These were actually quite nice. Unfortunately, main course arrived within minutes of appertizer being cleared...and we felt very rushed. Mains were pretty average...nicely presented but flavors were not as refined as I would have expected. Following mains being cleared, bill was promptly presented. So unfortunate that in such a beautiful setting, we felt we were being pushed out. Asked waiter to call a taxi for us, which he did...but then didn't tell us when it arrived (despite telling us to sit in a spot where we couldn't see it arrive)Overall, sad to see a restaurant with so much potential, be so average. Don't think we will return!

Author: SingCKL
Title: Poor Attitude from the lady boss at the counter
Review: The first time I went there, I love the food. Been there a few times after that, just for take away. For take away, you need to pay at the counter to the lady boss. Now, I got the chances to experience the lady boss's sarcasm. When you try to talk to her about ordering your food , she didn't even wanted to reply you by pointing at card, which reads , "order with the captain". When you asked how much, she just pointed at the receipt as if talking with you will waste her breathe.When some other customer asked her where shall he waited for his take away, she gave the guy a fierce look, and replied " you stand where you like to stand ". Later, I heard her complaining to her captain, " This fella asked me where to wait for his take away. Just stand wherever he likes la. What a stupid question". Her attitude was just bad, as if the customers begging her for the food. From then on, I had decided to ban this restaurant. Yes, the food is good but the lady boss poor attitude is not worthy of the patronage. The food not worthy of a single cent.

Author: FBJ1805Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Averagely Opus
Review: Located in a quiet residential area of Jalan Bangkung, Bangsar, this Italian bistro can definitely do much better than what we experienced and tasted for dinner last week. The food we ordered lacked the flavor and service just lacked the attention. The wait staff was too busy waiting for diners to arrive at the restaurant's entrance door and they have neglected to pay attention to the diners that's already in the restaurant. This is not my first time in this restaurant however it feels like they have not evolved in terms of their menu offerings - which is too bad because they can do so much better. The restaurant is ideal for those looking for just a simple-fuss-free meal however the prices are beyond simple. If you're looking to impress, would definitely go elsewhere.

Author: Dawnrajaratnam
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: I went to the restaurant with two friends to celebrate one of their birthday. The service was good but the food was unpalatable and insipid. The birthday boy had a western meal, and that was ok but my friend and I tried the Asian meals; sambal fried rice and pineapple fried rice and it was unappetizing. I can usually finish my food and mind you, I was hungry. But I couldnt finish my plate. Then came the fried calamari. It tasted like old calamari refried and served. The breaded coating was crusty and hard. The calamari was chewy and tasteless. The only nice things was the ice cream with a candle for the birthday boy and the free flow of coffee.

Author: Rebecca GSingapore, Singapore
Title: Souper Tang at Aeon Bukit Indah
Review: Our first visit last Saturday and we ordered the Stone Pot rice, spicy lotus root with assorted mushroom, vegetable Chive and from the pictures you will know that the stone pot rice has the mushroom with minced meat, the Spicy lotus root has the same type of mushroom and the plate of vegetable Chive is so few pieces and the mushroom - same variety is more than the vegetables...... when the food was served I was shock so i ask the waitress why she has not highlighted to us that the 3 dishes we ordered must the same ingredients - she shrugged her shoulder and walked away. We too ordered 2 different type of soup which was good but i need to send them back to make it hot - who want to drink below lukewarm soup? Service of food is fast though the places was about 90% occupied. Rather disappointed.

Author: Traveltheworld99999
Title: Good vibes & cocktails
Review: Quite an unusual area for a nice cocktails bar. They are famous and attack crowd want to be there.  Nice cocktails bar with different rum selections. It famous for the “jungle bird” cocktail, taste great! Good ambience and great place to hang out with friends.

Author: SwirlingTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overhyped and overpriced
Review: This restaurant was supposed to help us start our Saturday morning with a hearty and tasty brunch. Unfortunately we came out from it feeling more depressed than before.We ordered a balsamic mushroom on multigrain bread, but instead we got balsamic mushroom on a bed of salad. The order taker actually repeated our order, and yet got the order wrong. The other 2 items we ordered were french soup and country pie. The soup was first to arrive, but the country pie got to us almost half an hour from the time we ordered. The pie didn't arrive until we reminded them. No apology was given. When it was time to pay up, I was charged for balsamic mushroom on bread, and mushroom on salad. If I was not careful, I would be charged for both items, when we only had one. Again there was no apology from the cashier/staff.Overall, there are better places to spend your hard earned cash than over at this over-hyped establishment. Not exactly delicious.

Author: Stephanie N
Title: Happy moments
Review:
Always a delight to be here as I always received recognition from the staff.
Todays no exception as we were here for a small celebration with family members.

Author: 萱 蔡
Title: BLD Cafe
Review: nice atmosphere,good food and the services crews are very friendly especially the crew by the name of Dinesh from BLD Cafe, had been attented to my family very friendly and provided excellent service..
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: kianglong81Malaysia
Title: Local good sushi place
Review: This place runs by local Malaysian, yet you able to enjoy fairly good sushi meal here. The price tag here is reasonable, and having many variety of sushi in their food menu. You can have a decent meal around RM20-30/pax. If you very particular about wasabi, this place use powdered wasabi, quite normal practice among mid-priced local sushi shop. This place is comfortable and clean. Air-conditioned. Recommended for those hunger for Japanese food at mid-priced range cost.

Author: PrairieSailor123
Title: Premium local dishes.o
Review: Our party of 7 ate very well. A small but comprehensive menu of local and regional dishes. Good service, good food, good prices. We enjoyed ourselves.

Author: juz_do_itKuala Lumpur
Title: The pork ribs were nice, lovely, thick bones
Review: For the world of me, I cannot understand why oh why so many restaurant operators place sooooo much priority on their restaurant ambience and decor instead of the food they serve. Walking in, the restaurant looked like a nice hang out place....it is - over a couple of glasses of beer. We specifically came for the pork ribs.....you know, pork ribs with succulent and tender rib meat which has the right meat to bone ratio. The first to be served were the German Pepper Sausage (RM19++). Instantly, we were dismayed at the portion size. As we weren't into sauerkraut, they asked could they just give us more mash potatoes to which we said yes please. Well, the sausages with the so called 'extra' serving of mash potatoes were a totally unimpressive.Next came the Half rack of Pork Ribs (RM38++). I do boil 'pai kut tng' (pork ribs soup) at home and all I can say is that if I was blur enough to pay for pork ribs with the meat cut so close to the bones, I definitely deserve to hear this comment, "You don't know how to choose more meaty ribs meh??"Of course my lunch partner and I were commenting, "OMG, so little meat." There was no salad or any sides that came with the pork ribs. Such a pity - taste wise, they got the sauce right. Well, the BBQ ribs came with nice, lovely, thick bones.This is yet another time where we were thankful we didn't order more dishes. Among the meats, pork is the cheapest in Malaysia. I buy only 1 kg of pork ribs at the market each time and I can get meaty cartilage ribs so I can't understand why chefs at restaurants supposedly specializing in BBQ pork ribs serve pork ribs with so little meat. Another thing, some of the reviewers have been too generous to this restaurant. No one commented about the portion size of their dishes or in this case, ribs being their specialty, the meat to bone ratio.With one pint of Tiger beer (RM19++) the damage for this lunch was RM87.45. Makes one wonder how so many Japanese buffet restaurants in Klang Valley make money when such a high proportion of their menu items are imported. For just another RM23.55, two people could have a very delightful and satisfying buffet lunch which includes dessert, fruits and free flow beer (RM110 nett).

Author: SinghWorldTravelerSydney, Australia
Title: No punjabi flavour
Review: Would be good if cooked punjabi style with real ghee instead of unhealthy oil. It could at least be an option to chose from. Tea taste like any coffee shop tea.. also would be nice to have an option to have tea made from fresh milk and jagry. Im sure it would attract alot more genuine punjabi crowd and good for business too.The rest is all up to the consumers choice.
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food

Author: WongHY17Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Assam style curry fish head
Review: An unassuming shop located along a relatively quiet road in SS15 Subang Jaya.Can choose between curry fish head or fish meat.I took the fish head as it offers more texture.The curry is cooked with assam and tangy in taste.Small curry fish head + additional vegetables costs RM46.

Author: Russell E
Title: No service
Review: Tried this place because of good reviews. Nobody around when I arrived. Looked for a menu?? Sat and waited - no one around. A table of people were leaving as I sat. Waited. Young guy came and cleared the table of those who just left, nodded at me. Waited.Still no service. So I left.

Author: win_ng8899
Title: i lost my money
Review: be careful Guys, bad experience and really disappointed i having a dinner and my bill was Rm53.65 and i gave Rm103.65. and i was waiting for the change and after i asked the staff and the cashier insist said that i gave Rm53.65 im not drunk and i really sure that i gave Rm103.63 and my friend also saw that i gave Rm103.63 instead of Rm53.63and because of i didn’t want to ruin my holiday so i didn’t argue much for get my money back.but it is very RUDE. Really Be Careful Guys. i don’t want you guys will have the same experience as mine

Author: Cyanne L
Title: Will be back
Review: Foods was tasted good! Service was superb! Price can be 'better'. Cosy ambience for couples, gathering.. need to be there earlier to grab a car park lot.

Author: HarlingsBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Overrated, Expensive and Bland..
Review: I can only assume that the people who rated this food so highly have only just arrived in Malaysia because although the restaurant is very nice the food was decidedly average, sadly lacking in taste, spice and heat plus extremely expensive for what you get. The owner is IT savvy yet only accepts cash, bearing in mind your minimum spend will be about RM 50 for a couple of drinks and some bland food. We can categorically state this was the worst food in our 4 weeks of travelling around Malaysia. Nana TomYan is just around the corner where you can get something far more authentic and far cheaper.

Author: Marina RSydney, Australia
Title: dinner on the beach
Review: We did this one night & it was a nice evening. Tables on the beach. Menu is varied & the our choices were good. Service is very efficient & friendly. Cheaper meals to be had outside the hotel but this is a nice quiet option.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FreeLyGoh
Title: Awesome dining place!!!!
Review: Actually I totally disagree wt White Stallion . It's a great place with great food n people. All my friends love it. Prices are reasonable. Been heading there since they open up well it's not true abt their closed days as they only change it once four months ago till now. Everyone knows that it's closed only on Thursday. The people there are so friendly . I'm someone who speak what I feel is right as I'm a regular there.

Author: Bernicetls
Title: CMCO lunch
Review: Food was splendid and the hostesses are really really friendly and helpful. When you're here please try the teriyaki cod with miso broth and sup ekor (oxtail soup).

Author: iverge
Title: Poor Quality and Dirty
Review: Went here for breakfast and the quality of the food was really awful and the cooking and serving stations were dirty.

Author: paradisicalmostlyKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Don't waste your time
Review: We got the 70 dollar mix grill which was two big plates of rice (nice tasting) and a small plate of meat which was tough and way over cooked. The humus was good but half way through it the waiter tried taking the plate away; not sure why.

Author: Peder TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pasta dinner
Review: Warning... The pasta wasn't fresh and very sweet. I returned it, and at the end, had to pay full price.Now, feeling ill and they for sure lost a customer.It is a petty as i kind of liked this place but will not return here again.

Author: KanchanaJGKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Buffet dinner at Bar BQTonight
Review: We went for a buffet dinner last Sunday. The spread was alright but the quality of the food was disappointing. They were serving Pakistani cuisine such as biryani, chicken karahi, mutton keema, lamb sheesh kebab, muttonpaya chicken tikka, fish tikka etc. The mutton keema and chicken karahi was bland and extremely oily. The fish did not taste fresh. They had suji halwa and fruit pudding for desert, which was extremely sweet. The biryani and lamb kebabs were nice on the other hand. All in all, I don’t think I would return.

Author: paulineb0905Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Indian Food
Review: We are regular at Rock Bottom.. we are going almost 2x a month and we LOVE it. We have never been disappointed and the food is delicious. We only tried the Indian food but the western food looks good too. We have recommended and will continue to recommend this place. Raj, one of the waiter is very helpful and will give us advises.. the other waiter is great too.

Author: lamyeeleng
Title: First and Last
Review: Tonight, my boyfriend and I went to rock bottom to enjoy the live music from Hydra, drinks and food. My boyfriend ordered for me the seafood marinara. He requested for the chili flake to be on the side. But after trying to explain that request to the waiter, he did not quite understand the request, maybe because the music was very loud, so we decided to just ask him to omit the chili flake to make it easier. When the food arrived, I requested for chili flake and Parmesan cheese. And this is were the night was ruined for me. I asked a different waiter if I could have some Parmesan cheese and because the music was very loud, he mistook my question for me asking if he was Bangladeshi in which he replied “yes I am Bangladeshi”. I tried to repeat my question and he still thought I asked the same thing in which I was trying to be nice and just said “really? Oh okay” to safe him from feeling embarrassed that he heard me wrongly twice. But to my surprised, he asked me “yes I’m from Bangladeshi. Why?” I told him nothing (cause I didn’t even ask him that question in the first place). He then proceeded to ask me why again. I said nothing. My boyfriend stepped in at that point and asked for the Parmesan cheese. He then went to the kitchen and came back with both Parmesan cheese and chili flake. We thought that was the end of it and we could eat. The same waiter placed the chili flake and Parmesan cheese on the table and had the audacity to ask me “I just want to ask, when you order, you ask to not put chili flake. Why you asking for chili flake now?” in a more aggressive manner. Both my boyfriend and I work in the food and service industry. Never have we ever come across a server questioning the customer about their food preference in such a way. My boyfriend explained that we can control how spicy the marinara will be. The waiter wasn’t happy and out of no where told me “the person who cook the food is also from Bangladeshi”. I was shocked. Then I tried to explain to him that I actually asked for Parmesan Cheese and not if he’s from Bangladeshi. Again he repeated “the person who cook is Bangladeshi. I’m also from Bangladeshi” and at this point he was just being completely rude with his tone. My boyfriend proceeded to calm the situation by telling the waiter that “it’s all good. It’s all good”. Without an apology, the waiter just walked off. That one waiter just spoiled the nice night we were having. The only reason why I won’t be coming back would be him. Unfortunately I didn’t get his name. Chubby fellow. The food, the music and the drinks were great.

Author: Eddie30Malaysia
Title: Oilly Food
Review: The name of the establishment was very impressive but the food quality was below par. We went there for dinner (4 pax) and we found that the food was really oilly and was nothing compared to its namesake. Seriously I would not go back there again. I can eat much better food in Kuching anytime & anywhere.Cheers

Author: jameslB3203PESingapore, Singapore
Title: Food are over cooked
Review: I went with expectation that I will get fresh seafood and a great meal. When the oyster omelette was served, the oyster was over cooked and hard. The steamed fish was over cooked as well and too salty. We also ordered oyster that is the size of a palm, this too is over cooked. Overall disappointed with quality of good.

Author: Dandellions
Title: The worst experience
Review: Thursday1st March 201821:00pmThe worst service i ever experience, dine-in as a single diner, i order something quick to prepare, Caesar salad as a main, cheese cake n americano to be serve later, the server (male server) serve me a cheese as my 1st meal? And again i said i want it after with my americano, i don't want to be fussy i told him, he can put it on my table, since he already serve it, i remind him serve americano later, i waited around 15 minute for my salad to come, and suprisingly table next to me who order later (a pasta) came 1st!!!, i was a bit cool down after my salad came 5 minute later, when i about to tuck in, i realised there no dressing tossed in my salad, plain!, how do you feel, you just want to eat something simple and easy, and they not even able to do so? i'm pissed, I want to inform a runner who sent my salad, she not even give attention and totally ignore me (a female runner),i able to inform (male server) there no dressing in my salad, he informed me in the kitchen is new staff, not really aware about menu or food prep, he said he will made some (dressing) for me???? Made????, i need to wait again for caesar dressing, omG!!! After all this mess situation after so many drama i managed to eat my supper!!!again another mess!!!!!after finished ate my supper, i tried to find any server for my coffee, none of them on the floor, all of them is inside kitchen ( so nobody will assist customer? It is a self service restaurant?) for a birthday table behind me, another loooong wait again, even i able to informed them i'm still have to waited and kept follow up and ask for my coffee(begging) and they not even serve freshly brew coffee, it came from instant dispenser coffee machine!!!! What made it soooo difficult? and instead of put a little bit care seem like staff rushing up to chasing out customer, pull up table and start doing closing. I was amazed when to come paycheck, i did'nt experience any difficulty to made payment, honestly this restaurant just focus how to make money compare than deliver not even basic customer service as a semi casual restaurant, there no integrity or customer service value, not even basic! i can get even better service from hawker centre, i did'nt put high expectation, with the price i paid and lousy food, service i got, it is worth it to dine in here? My answer No!!! i did'nt see any manager around, or probably a lady at cashier (anis) is in-charge.

Author: anthonywtlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Skip the salted egg yolk dishes
Review: As many reviews said it, it's hidden and car park is limited. Extremely limited during weekdays. Ambience is good but the food hardly have taste. Chef is a little stingy with their meat on all their pastas. Making them overpriced. Coffee their is their lifesaver. Other than that it's too troublesome just to eat average food in factory area.

Author: foodfelineKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food and drinks
Review: I come here very often due to the convenience and I can attest that most of the food are delicious (the local food, not so much the pasta, which leaves much to be desired). They also sometimes offer free bananas. The downside is that it is rather isolated and the area is dark during night time and for a frequent customer, I wish they had more items in their menu but I am glad that they do offer delicious food at affordable prices (the portion is good for the price). While I did not enjoy the coffee and pasta, I would highly recommend the butter chicken and mocha.

Author: Jessica_lucy977London, United Kingdom
Title: Bad management
Review: We had booked a table for drinks on new year's eve but unfortunately the waiter did not want seat us only for drinks despite the bar being half empty.As we were coming to have drinks for NYE we thought it would be possible to enjoy drinks at the bar but that turned out not to be the case.It's a shame as it seems like a nice place and the view is lovely. We won't be coming back to stay as the management were not very flexi ke and lost out to a paying customer.

Author: JaydeBh
Title: Terrible Service
Review: We made a reservation for dinner aand reached there 15minutes later because of heavy rain. 1. From the beginning at the reception desk the hostess couldn't find out reservation but when checked with our mobile number they realized they wrote wrong name.2. They started giving us time to leave and we said we will have dinner but they insisted that if we don't pay extra for the jazz they will move us out from the jazz room.3. Only offering in the menu is a 3 course menu and 4 course menu and tapas only. No other options of ala carte mains. Prices are not mentioned for any main course offering.4. We ordered 3 drinks and 3 tapas to start with but before even we finished that and thinking of ordering other stuffs the waitress came and informed us we have to leave as there is reservation waiting.5. We we're not all informed that they sold our reserved table to someone else. Very very disappointing and when we asked the waitress to call the manager no one came to see us. 6. Just the whole atmosphere with the staffs were absolutely rude, impoliye and unprofessional foreign workers.Really surprised how they are doing business. We went there by looking at other reviews but to our utter disappointment I will never ever recommend this place to anyone on this planet. Didn't get to see their jazz performance so can't comment on it but the food was average and portions are relatively small.Never go there again.

Author: Cursions01Melbourne
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: This restaurant is our favourite. We have been to Kuching twice for a few days each time and have eaten here numerous times. From out front it doesn't look like much, but step further in and you will be amazed with the intricate decor. Step over a pond of fish to get to the outside seating area. At night it has a lovely romantic atmosphere. The food here is delicious! Compared to the other local eateries, it's a tad more expensive, but they are decent serves. We shared 3 meals between 4 people. The staff here are also very nice and attentive.

Author: HappiMummiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Last stop in Malacca
Review: We were recommended to visit this place by a friend. There's a cafe, a shop that sells all the Mamee products and merchandise, they host workshop for kids (but it was fully booked when we were there.)We just got the biscuits and noodles and left.

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Good and creative nyonya food
Review: I have read many nice reviews on this place. My parents and brother had been here some time ago; they loved the food in the first visit. We all enjoyed the food this time too.Let me start with the ambience - very nice restored Georgetown pre-war houses. A nice air well separate the dining room from the hotel/ residences. Good place for photography.We tried 3 starters: pork mantou, Kebaya man xeo, and otak-otak. All were yummy finger food. For mains, we ordered selection of 10 dishes among them grilled chicken kapitan, hong bak lamb, organic roast pork, grilled snapper, prawn geng, loh ark, and another 4 greens to go with steamed rice. For desserts, we tried all 5 dishes - good but not out of this world.Service was attentive and prompt. Not sure how some of the other reviewers experienced such poor service here.

Author: fauzayBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Bland expensive food
Review: Strongly recommended to stay away from this restaurant (unless you're a millionaire). Visited here with friends, ordered the soup, steak and burger. For the ridiculously expensive price (more than KL/ Brunei), we were expecting a truly delicious meal. But the mushroom soup tasted weird, wagyu burger was bland (barely any meat), and the wagyu steak was OK but tiny portion for the price. Only good thing were the drinks (can't go wrong with water), and good service by the waitresses.

Author: 879sylvieu
Title: Cool place but no drinks
Review: We came for having a drink in the afternoon. The place is really nice and cool. We asked for their special juices but they had none. They offer me another drink but it was already booked by another customer. We asked for a simple orange juice but don’t have any ! So we decided to leave this nice place.Too bad !

Author: Xanchoong
Title: Food & Hygiene
Review: Food here is indeed disappointed and not worth the price. Will never come back again. The tea cup is not washed properly and oily smell.

Author: Kieran B
Title: Very tasty Laksa
Review: The Laksa here was very tasty and was pretty cheap. Its a small quaint café in the centre of Georgetown. It is walking distance to all of the famous street art

Author: hadi23381Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Had a birthday dinner. It was a seafood buffet. The choice of food was enormous. The staff were superb. Recommended.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: BluesphynxSingapore
Title: Favorite pork kwayteow
Review: Came here specially for the minced pork noodles relocated from Sam Kan Chong days in town centre famous for springy pork tablets and 'Siew cheong' (stuffed liver rolls), as good as ever with slippery kwayteow, $8RM per bowl. Ordered a large cockle fried kwayteow from another stall, too wet and with the tiniest cockles and little prawns, if they existed at all! Disappointing. The wontan mee stall was popular with very good-looking char siew but too full to try it. Boiled barley homemade taste, good.Parking is terrifying in the crowded lot across the street but the jaga kreta is helpful, the you make your way through the rubble of the Mrt digging under the baleful height of the IMDB building, good chance to experience the pulse of KL city in all its heat and colorful chaos.

Author: Bob W
Title: Basic, but fine
Review: The food is fine, but really basic. Service was fast. Setting is mundane. If you want some serviceable local food at a reasonable price, it’s OK.

Author: IM CKuala Lumpur
Title: Waffles galore
Review: If you like waffles, this is a place to check out. I ordered a salmon and waffle dish. But to be honest, 2 slices of waffles is too much as its really rich. Did not give me a sense of satisfaction having this for lunch. But there are items with one slice of waffle which is just nice. Not too bad as a novelty. Busy though, hard to get a table.

Author: Matt WLondon, United Kingdom
Title: disappointing
Review: We went to this restaurant tonight for my partners birthday dinner. We have been before and were pleased but tonight we were disappointed. We asked for our rice to be replaced because it was not hot enough. It came back and was no better so we had to ask for more again. We were then asked if we wanted to order anything else before our main course had arrived. We were then left without the hot plate to cook my beef on and had to ask again for that. We were not given the attention that a restaurant of this standard and price should be offering. We complained at the end and were told that it was because they were busy. The food itself is good although I felt the portions were too small for it's price, but the service let it down tonight. We were much happier on previous visits. We will not return again. There are far too many other places to go in KL now.

Author: D0minicNg
Title: Family Dinner on a cold rainy December Wednesday
Review: First time here. Got recommendations by friendly and great service staff. Food turned out to be excellent. Fresh and tasty. Worth another visit.

Author: Marika_Jose2015Kyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Disappointed!
Review: We went to this cafe for breakfast specifically following the TripAdvisor rates and were very disappointed. First, the black coffee was pretty weak. Second, we ordered banana pancakes with peanut butter, and when I started to eat, it turned to be apple pancakes with no peanut butter at all, but with Kaya sauce. We were not informed that they don’t have needed ingredients, just were served a dish, with half of the ingredients changed. When we asked why the dish is not what it should be, they called the cook, who apologized and said that they will not charged us for this dish. Overall it wasn’t a pleasant experience as reviews rated. Also I believe it’s overpriced for the value and quality.

Author: aastyre99
Title: Very Bad
Review:
I ordered pasta and chicken wings and pizza.

The chicken wings were bad with very bad taste.  The pizza size is so small and untasty. I will not visit this Restaurant again..food is not delicious at all.

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place...
Review: When we were in Melaka, suddenly we were starving for seafood. just type Melaka seafood in google, this restaurant's name appeared with ikan bakar (BBQ fish). With no time, we straight away headed to this place from Jonker Street, just one way straight... easy to find.We reached there at 5.45pm and we were the first customer of the day.Nice environment and ambient, surrounded by some sort of Cuban music. It was located by the seaside but, due to land reclamation, the view was hampered.We ordered butter prawn, grilled siakap fish, sausage with mashed potato and some local snack. Those food were nice, only the sausage was a bit hard. No complaints for the rest.The restaurant was filled with trees & plants... we saw a monitor lizard swimming in the seaside... just beside out sitting place.. my daughters just got frightened... hahaha...Price is average, just watch what you order.Recommended place... nice food.

Author: Ultra MPetaling Jaya
Title: Spicy but nice
Review: 8 of us had just completed a round of golf at Forest City Golf Resort in Gelang Patah. Ravenous and tired, we headed off to the Mall of Medini, upon the recommendation of one of us.Wednesday lunch, it was all quiet at the mall. The restaurant was not empty, so we took it as a good sign.The meal was ordered, typically, a huge order and everybody take a bite at it. The ubiquitous seafood tom yam, not hot, but a nice sharp kick as one slurps the soup. Pandan chicken, steamed fish, vegetables, were amongst the items ordered. Washed it down with lemongrass chilled drink. Fantastic meal.The service was most attentive and fast. The atmosphere was friendly. The pricing was decent, after all this is a proper sit down restaurant.Our only disappointment was the absence of sticky rice mango. Probably it was off season for mangoes.

Author: biofreshKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food had never be the same
Review: maybe I am too used with the food from JLN TAR which all the uncles are serving. The Old Coliseum. Food here are not up to the standard which I had been carving since I was 15 years old.Maybe this is due to commercialization which had lost the original touch!!

Author: MEAFaroAlgarve, Portugal
Title: Friendly and tasty
Review: Having messed up the day of our booking for another restaurant we did not feel like going too far and this one was right near our hotel. The day before, when we arrived, we had tried to eat there but it was late and they did not serve food. So here we come and enjoyed it. Nasi Goreng, a mango salad, satay, among other things. Without being excellent the food is tasty. Fast and friendly service.

Author: clkwin
Title: Bad experience- Food quality below expectation
Review:
Hair inside Dim Sum " Wu Kok ". No explaination received from staff when we informed them on the above.

Expecting better service and food quality and hygiene.

Author: ira2003Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad and tremendously SLOW service
Review: It's the second time we came as expected they had improved their service and train the waitresses after 3 years. Unfortunately, seems no improvements at all, the staff served very slow and bad attitude. We had order at the counter, 20 minutes later they came and said the dishes we order finished already. Don't come here while you are hungry, expected foods will be served on ur table 20-30 mins after your order. I don't recommend to KL people to drive all the way here to try Padang foods, they are many Padang restaurants which is way better in KL. I think I'd give up with this restaurants already, no chance to come here anymore. We even can't finished our foods, loose appetite with their bad attitude and slow services.

Author: SabriMarcCalgary, Canada
Title: Always busy, always good
Review: Good drinks, excellent location, good food, and very very nice service! It was the second time we stopped here to have drinks. Their drinks menu is huge and their food is eclectic. Like the Cafe' s name says, it is from all over the world. My mom ( we are Italians) ordered a pasta dish, and I was quite sceptical about it, but she said the pasta was cooked al dente and it was not bad at all. Thus, big thumbs up for this cafe'

Author: Zambia_StoneMoss Vale, Australia
Title: Worst experience in KL
Review: We booked this 'Theatre Restaurant' based on the reviews on Trip Advisor so I thought I better put this review up to warn against this place. Absolutely horrible! We arrived about 1hr before the show began for the buffet dinner. There are two lines of the same hot dishes maybe around 7 different selections. There was also a salad bar and a few other small tables with other selections. Now add about 4000 tourists all clambering and fighting for food. It was insane! I had two ladies hit me in the back with plates when the lined slowed. I gave up and grabbed the only thing that didn't have a couple of hundred people lining up, bread roll. My partner ran the gauntlet and I tried his food and it was pretty damn terrible. I got some fruit but as I waited the 'chef' shovelled watermelon into his mouth with his gloved hands and then touched all the fruit. There was a small child having a great time licking dessert serving spoons then returning them. And don't get me started on the cultural show whose self proclaimed highlight was watching about a hundred tourists try a few dance steps one at a time. Possible worst dinner experience ever.

Author: 993andrews
Title: Fantastic gem of a restaurant
Review: Fantastic gem of a restaurant well worth the effort of getting up the two flights of stairs to get to!The menu is simple but everything on it is delicious. Run by a lovely couple who work tirelessly to ensure you are being served quickly and efficiently. The wife’s laugh is infectious!

Author: Relax537746
Title: Dinner
Review:
Strong recommended to who come to kuching for lunch and dinner.
Lepau is pondok in kayan language.
This venue capable to cater up to 100pax at one time.
Thanks for delicious menu!!!!!!

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Nice chicken rice balls
Review:
Nice chicken rice balls and dishes. 

Both roasted and steamed chicken are very nice. Meat is tender and not too fat. 

Garlic Kang Kong is nice too.

Author: perkul
Title: Awful
Review: We love eating at the Pavilion and usually go to Sushi Tei, Ichibanboshi, Capriciosa, or the food hall for Chicken rice, Korean, etc. But we thought we'd try some place different for a change and went to Madam Kwan's. We were a group of 7, all ordered different things but nothing special. They tasted like already made food from a packet or a tin and just microwaved. Would never return again.

Author: goodies67Labuan Island, Malaysia
Title: Kuay Chap
Review: It was a short stay in Miri so we were looking high and low for an outlet serving kuay chap, a milder version of bah kut teh eaten as breakfast. There are quite a varieties of local food available at WZT such as laksa, kam pua, mee sua, fish noodle etc. All priced reasonably. The environment is clean and pleasant. Not too crowded during breakfast hours either.

Author: NCNGSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Slow service and feel like being treated like air
Review: It was my first time trying jap food in Ipoh. I ordered foie gras which is not bad as it is crisps outside. I also ordered garlic fried rice which I had waited 20mins, when I asked again to cancel it if they unable to get it done in 5 mins. They can finish it in 5 mins but I truly disappointed for the total time I spent. So I cancelled it because they forgot my order which is intolerable, hey, I am talking about restaurant not hawker stall who took too many orders and overlooked yours. Sorry for bad review because it was.

Author: Chin-PinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Definitely not worth the 2-hour wait
Review: Was on holiday with husband and two children aged 11&14. Read all the great reviews on tripadvisor and decided to check it out.We reached the restaurant on time for our reservation and were seated. The time was 6.40.The food came at 8.30! My children were starving and my husband and I were also very hungry. However, we decided that the long wait would be worth it if the food was good. There were other families that came after us. They were so desperate because of the wait that when a lady came into the restaurant with packets of guava, everyone jumped to buy it just to fill their stomachs.Unfortunately, the food was average. We ordered the cheesy beehoon, ginger chicken cubes, deep fried sweet and sour fish,fried garlic squid and braised tofu with minced pork. The food was not up to the expectations we had of the restaurant that had so many good reviews. The tofu was basically swimming in watery gravy and the presentation was awful. The ginger chicken was too hard and overcooked. The cheesy beehoon was good but nothing special. The fish was only ok. The only good dish was the garlic squid which took 2-hours and 20mins to come.Overall, at the end of the dinner, we all agreed that the food was only average and DEFINITELY not worth the 2-hour wait.

Author: JoshuaSLMcKinney, Texas
Title: Not ridiculously priced if you order the right thing
Review: For some reason there was a vast difference between white rice (3RN) and fried rice (16-25RN). Most dishes were absurdly overpriced.We really enjoyed the roast duck/chicken/pork platter (20RN). The sauce was great and there weren't too many bones in the meat. We also ordered a side of white rice and a side of noodles (sauce also incredible) and combined the three for the perfect amount of food for two.The delicious and free soaked peanuts were an added bonus. I had a Carlsberg Special Brew for 10RN and the service was polite, quick and clean.

Author: kinosraj15
Title: Average Indian Food
Review: Ordered Briyani here. The taste is normal or average and the price is ok.  The waiting time is acceptable.

Author: NeerChan
Title: Far fetch from the main branches
Review: When my husband and I heard about Pampas opening in Melaka, we were excited coz we love the pampas grill in bukit ceylon and never fail to stop by for a meal whenever we go up. Obviously we r not from KL and Melaka is much nearer to us.Unfortunately, when we arrived at the restaurant,we were at awe as although we were the first and only customers to step in, all of the staffs stared at us in shock - made us think whether we came too early (6.30pm on Thursday) or that we didn't look like humans? It took them about 2min before someone waited on us.Thereafter, they improved but slightly. Steak was acceptable but not up to par, we ordered medium but turned out mostly cooked. Our vege side dishes was raw and the waitress told us it's not supposed to be cooked completely? So...Quite disappointed.

Author: Wanderluster131Maidstone, United Kingdom
Title: A great little cafe with a wonderful cooking class - cannot recommend the class enough
Review: Cannot rafe this lovely cafe highly enough. We did the cooking class which was fabulous - Lucien took us around the markets and was both very relatable as well travelled and well spoken but local and very informative. The cooking class was great fun with lovely dishes: palm sugar chicken, a spicy laksa, a dutch style rice, a vegetarian pumpkin curry and a delicious local style salad. We then got to sit and eat the feast we had made and as it was just myself and my friend on the trip we had it to ourselves! Just do it - you wont regret it! We also ate here as well as customers and enjoyed the food and the style/ethos of the cafe/homestay. A wonderful place :)

Author: Wheng G
Title: VERY BAD SERVICE
Review: Went to Sungai Wang Nandos, & order take away, i asked help from the staff name "kika" ,but then again...shes very rude and i have to go to kitchen my self to check my order,,,found out my take-away order was just there on the table waiting for one of them to take & give to me...how long should i wait then?if i didnt check my own?...

Author: Lawrence YGreater Sydney, Australia
Title: Standard Hotel Buffet
Review: Hard to be enthusiastic about hotel buffet lunches and dinners. It is, after all, catering to the masses. A few patrons from other countries can sometimes behave like "pigs at a trough" but overall, the food is diverse, varied and lends itself to mass production, self service and, in the end, you always have the option of choosing from their a la carte menu. Service can sometimes suffer when things get busy but I only experienced this at breakfast.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: fsenadaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing Phad Thai...
Review: Went to this restaurant to try out their Thai food. as I was not too hungry. I ordered Phad Thai. It came out quite fast from the kitchen.. By the looks of it, I knew something was not right. So I summon for the chef, ask him is he from Thailand, cos the rice noodle he used was different from the authentic one and furthermore the lime used was different also. So he told me that, the ingredient was kind of hard to get local. I was poised initially that I am going to have a nice Thai food as the name is so Thai, only to my dismay the Phad Thai, tasted like a fried kway teow.

Author: firerooster2009
Title: Nothing out of the Ordinary
Review: I was hungry when I went there for lunch.Unfortunately, I didn't think the food was exceptionally yummy. I had expected more from the hype I received. It was just ok.

Author: justina601
Title: Disappointed with service
Review: Arrived here at 1.45pm and informed ya the restaurant is closed . Totally disappointed. Travelled by e hour to get here and asked us to leave.

Author: W8967VEsusanpHong Kong, China
Title: Under par
Review: We visited the Restaurant on the basis of the reviews we read on TripAdvisor, which was has a very high rating...All the tables were set on the beach, nice start..Umm, great if you are wanting to see four wheel drivers going up and down the beach in front of you collecting the watersports equipment etc, after the day's activities. Food was served by people that really don't have any time for you. Talking about the food, it is mediocre, I really don't understand why people rate it so highly, also whilst eating our food we had to listen to loud music from a place near by. If you are wanting a romantic evening I certainly wouldn't recommend this place.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Said0078
Title: Happy weekend with canopy
Review:
Good shisha, excellent service and good music ..
Drinks is nice too. . Love to come canopy every weekend

Author: ReubenC1606Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not too bad
Review: Nice place to unwind after a long day and have a couple of pints. For me, the staff were quite attentive and friendly.But with the music blasting, this isn't the right place for a quiet evening. Be prepared to raise your voice slightly higher than usual just to have a conversation with your buddies. Though I would definitely recommend this place.Get's quite busy some nights especially leading up to weekends. But a nice bar none the less.

Author: rloganathan
Title: Good place to chillout with family and friends
Review: Very good ambience...staff are friendly and focused. Quality beers and food. Typical neighbourhood pub. Very knowledgable and friendly owner. Price is reasonable for food and drinks.

Author: nlliewbangsar, KL
Title: Delicious with a bitter after taste
Review: Been there on several occasions and each was disappointing...appallingly slow service, uncooperative waiters (or rather language challenged waiters), totally unapologetic of their poor service and food a bit tad expensive for the adventure that they promised on their menu - go only if you don't consider money and time wasted a criteria for dinning out.

Author: ConstanceL279Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food not up to standard
Review: Went to this place as it was highly recommended. The price was relatively reasonable. It serves many side dishes, however when they serve the side dishes, many if not all were warm, meaning that they were left in the open for a long time. The staff will barbecue the meat for you. But, all the staff seems to be in a rush as the restaurant was quite packed. The barbecue meats were cut in a very haphazard manner aka anyhow cut. While I understand that they are very busy, I guess more care can be put into it for the sake of quality. This is the first Korean restaurant that we went to and we left a lot of food uneaten.

Author: hjc13malaysia
Title: Kampachi- dont waste your money here
Review: Food quality at its worst. The saba fish d8sh came cold and with bones (not suppose to have bones). Negitori maki looked and tasted like a rm3 sushi king plate. High price low in food quality.

Author: Ann SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good & way too over-hyped!
Review: I have visited Prego thrice, now & I might visit again as my friends love the place. The food is good. Great selection of pizza and wine ;), yes. But the staff needs to be a lil more attentive, helping, listening, considerate and smile more. For the price you're paying you would expect something additional. The bread they serve as complimentary, could just be cut out. You really need very strong jaws to actually eat it. The ambiance is really nice, service is too slow. In KL customer delight is a culture. The best diners are best because they make you feel welcomed, Prego doesn't!

Author: ExplorerFoodie93Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing experience
Review: The service was extremely slow, so that after some time we decided to order the drinks at the bar ourselves. Unfortunately the cocktails and long drink we had were actually very disappointing. We asked for the manager and explained to him that one of the drinks wasn't correct. He was defensive, impolite and didn't even mention a single word of being sorry whatsoever. We didn't feel welcomed at all. I definitely expect more from a bar at a five star hotel, especially from the manager who should act as a role model. Apart from this the music was definitely too loud, but others might like that.

Author: MeijunHamilton, New Zealand
Title: Cheapskate
Review: Had an awful experience at your restaurant, Souled Out @ Bangsar South (2 June 2015). Ordered fried chicken thigh burger, the patty was really dried to an extent we need can't even tear it apart with hands. Asked for a change, the chef did not apologise and on top of it the burger was represented in a cheapskate manner. I can try to understand when he/she reuse the burger bread, BUT HE/SHE REUSED THE CHEESE I BITE EARLIER!!! Who would have thought of that brilliant way to save cost for the restaurant, its very unacceptable. Service staff were good enough to apologise on behalf but not the chef or the floor manager did not. Please do something to the standard of your food, or sooner or later you will lose most of your customers. For your information, this is our second visit and will be our last.

Author: KimandkhorPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Poor Ambience, Overpriced, Lousy Service and Disappointing Food
Review: Noisier and more crowded than a fish market, made worse by the airplanes, the liberally scattered chain-smokers( how can people eat while smoking? or smoke while eating?) didn't help at all. After finishing a miserable plate of thinly sliced sashimi geoduck spaced out pathetically over a huge tray of ice costing us more than RM100 per head, we waited like an eternity for our teochew steamed sea grouper. We reminded them, only to be told that they have to wait till we finished our first course before they can serve the second. Hello, we ordered rice and we're Chinese! What's this first course and second course thingy? Then another eternity and the fish finally materialized with more rationalization of its late entrance. Also no sign of other dish but it came soon enough. The flesh of the fish is firm but tasteless - been languishing in the tank too long?. It wasn't teochew steamed. It was poached in hot water so that all its goodness and flavor is drained, than drenched with some kind of starchy teochew sauce impersonator. Enough said. We made our way back to the car in the bumpy carpark, grateful that no one's wearing heels.

Author: Dennis J
Title: Cheap and delicious!
Review: The food and drinks are cheap and affordable. The foods taste nice and usually is crowded with people during weekends and night times. People who wants to have a taste of local food should come here!

Author: nick jLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lukewarm steak, tepid sauce
Review: My sate appetiser was OK but the main course was poor. They managed to deliver a lukewarm steak with gelatinous cold sauce; it felt as if they'd cooked my appetiser and main course at the same time and left the steak hanging around until I finished the first course

Author: C3451ZUmichaelt
Title: Lunch at Nancy's
Review:
Was exited to come again to have a good meal. Today lunch was disappointing. Hee Piou Soup / Assam Nanas Prawn was too saltish. Prawns is not fresh. Sambal Belachan is so so. 
It seems Nancy's is over rated. Won't be back again.

Author: WilbertWPH
Title: Good Nyona food
Review: Ordered Asam fish and curry chicken with 'çhap chye' , Otah, and other typical nyona dishes. Delicious, Good nyona food and reasonably priced..

Author: AliceM8824
Title: Food inconsistent, drinks terrible, service friendly but disorganised
Review: We visited two nights in a row, first with two members of the group and the second night with a group of 6. Food was good (steak, chicken, pasta) on the whole but there were a couple of disappointing dishes (rubbery mussels). The service was friendly but very disorganised, drinks were terrible. Two flat tonic, gin and tonics arrived and were sent back, then still put on the bill. Same with a drink the night before, horrible taste but still charged.. couldn't be bothered to argue. Also, extra drinks from the table next door were put on our bill... took a long time to sort out and no apology. Nice setting and could be a great place for drinks/ dinner... what a shame.

Author: Dianne T
Title: Quality cheap eats
Review: Great little restaurant, tucked away with indoor and alfresco dinning, no ac but lots of fans, friendly service and great food, try this hidden gem.m

Author: kenf242
Title: Nice environment and cozy place for dating
Review: The decorations here is so nice, the environment is beautiful and cozy... a good place for dating and meeting up friends

Author: Charmaine888Hong Kong, China
Title: Scam by TableApp and KL Hilton
Review: I was planning to try this restaurant after reading rave review of Chynna and made a reservation with TableApp (official booking partner of Chynna and also advertised in Tripadvisor). The terms and condition clearly did not say I am not able to use any credit card discount or membership discount. When I booked it required me to pay a deposit which is refundable if I make changes or cancellation 7 days in advance.However, I have called KL Hilton dining to reconfirm the discount but was informed that it is a blackout date on 8 February 2020. No discount will be granted. I contacted TableApp for cancellation on 23 Jan 2020 and was informed they will charge me 5% as processing fee. This is ridiculous as it was clearly not in the T&C when I make the reservation. It was in the T&C now and I am sure they have just added it in. I did not expect KL Hilton and TableApp will scam customers and I did not take any screenshot when I made the booking. In all e-mail confirmations I receive there isn't such clause in it too.I trusted KL Hilton branding and didn't suspect anything when I book through TableApp. I think KL Hilton should really perform proper due diligence when choosing which partner to work with as it gives us a bad experience and KL Hilton is indirectly helping TableApp to scam your customers.I will not be refunded the 5% processing fee of RM200 which is really ridiculous when what I did was only to make a reservation and cancel much in advance, and being charged a "processing fee" which was not in the T&C when I made the booking.I hope KL Hilton can stop working with these unscrupulous partners and don't assist them to scam your customers in the future.

Author: 919crismMelbourne, Australia
Title: Perfect
Review: Great food great service perfect location. Assorted food and drink choices staff were friendly and very knowledgeable.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: kamloongcJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good tasting salted chicken
Review: It cost rm21 for 1 chicken. At today’s prices, I think it’s reasonably priced. Fast takeaway unlike way back then which we were required to book in advance. It was a different age then..hahahha. It is baked juicy, tender and salted just nice with herbs. I wouldn’t complaint on the taste, to me it’s great. A definite must try when in Ipoh.

Author: Nidal T
Title: Entertaining with a decent buffet
Review: Not a fancy place but definitely worth checking out to get a quick overview of Malaysian culture.  Dinner buffet is decent and the show was entertaining and interactive.

Author: DrRuben
Title: Vegetarian food galore in Bukit Beruang
Review:
A very good place for delicious vegetarian food.
Situated strategically for MMU students and residents around Ayer Keroh, Bukit Beruang and Batu Berendam.
Varieties offered here is good with superb pricing.
Value-for-money vegetarian eatery offering delicious dishes.

Dr.Ruben Kumar
Malaysia

Author: HakimuKandy, Sri Lanka
Title: One Ok and One Horrid
Review: We went there twice, just cause it was close by and also the Hotel suggested. The first visit was ok with the food tasting good, but the service was a bit of a roller coaster as they kept mixing up our orders. The second experience was pretty horrid, this time the service was ok but the food was really bland and not up to standard. The juices were nice and the prices were really cheap too. I'd avoid this place next time.

Author: NickHtunSingapore, Singapore
Title: Enemy of Children
Review: After seeing good rating in Tripadvisor, our family including my 4 years old daughter went to have a lunch at the restaurant. Security staffs at hotel gate are very polite and informed me that we need advance reservation so I try to call the restaurant but no one answer. After few try, security staff at gate even let us go in and told us to check with hotel reception for reservation at restaurant. When we are at reception, staffs are busy with few guests so we went to restaurant. There are no diners at restaurant so we seated where the staff at restaurant give us seat. Few minutes later before our order, a staff come and chased us away giving reason that hotel do now allow children in the premises. We were very shocked and speechless. We never come across such a hotel treated children like enemy and chase customers away.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: CanadaVoyage123Singapore
Title: Service and view good, food horrible
Review: Wanted a place to eat with some variety. Gravy Baby sounded like a tourist trap and should have known better but late and hungry, we said “what the heck”. Wrong move. View is nice, service friendly, good choice of food, but quality below mediocre. Sent my plate back (which pissed my wife off as she knew she was going to eat her cold burger alone and wait until I finish mine, which I gobbled up) as main course (chicken) and sides were cold. People sitting next to us (4 pax) left as they were waiting for close to an hour, sipping on their drinks, waiting for their food to arrive.Bottom line, if you like cold and over cooked food, not in a rush (need two hours to dine in), Gravy Baby is the place for you. Enjoy.

Author: Samira Y
Title: food is ok..but too oily
Review:
food is ok to try out here if you're looking for a change..however i found all the items very oily and the set up was not up to standard

Nothing special overall

Author: keith606
Title: Having my birthday dinner there.
Review: I was impressed that they took the effort to ask my wife what occasion it was and they prepared a table for us in a private corner. Food here is great, loved the succulent beef. Overall a nice place to chill and relax.

Author: nycgenius99New York City, New York
Title: Great view, terrible food
Review: Only come here for the view as the food is beyond terrible. I've had better food on economy flights than what is served here. The restaurant is extremely overpriced and not worth ever going back once you saw the view. The rotation is nice, just need to seriously work on improving their buffet.

Author: dtjt1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: OK Restaurant
Review: Was here during Christmas for a cuppa. Overall, setting was OK but what irks me was the open kitchen concept. Open kitchen is pretty cool but whats bad about this restaurant was that he smoke and smell from the kitchen spread very quickly into the dining area making the whole experience unpleasant.They have to work and improve their air ventilation otherwise most will avoid this place. Imagine your clothes smell upon leaving the place.

Author: DaveMawMilan, Italy
Title: Average Hard Rock Cafe, not as good as most others I've visited.
Review: Dropped in for an early dinner when we were out walking and got caught in a downpour. Although it's reasonable, it doesn't match most of the other Hard Rock Cafe's I've eaten in. The food was pretty good but the beer selection was poor. Service was also good but there are a lot of great local delicacies in KL that should be experienced.

Author: SharonOHBI
Title: A little too sweet
Review: Not a fan of donuts and was a little too sweet for me. But for those you like sweet donuts, you will be spoiled with flavour choices

Author: ChristerChin
Title: Fresh and delicious
Review:
Awesome ambience with great food
Loving the music
Staff are attentive 
Overall a great experience here

Author: TMY15Province of Rome, Italy
Title: Disappointed
Review: Hi, tried calling a few times to make dinner reservation for tonight. Impossible to get line through to restaurant as line is always busy. Guess u need tons of patience to get a seat here. Be prepared! Despite good review I did previously, am very disappointed this time. Thankfully there are still many good restaurants to visit in JB...
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Casandra MJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Stale food when I was the only one there?
Review: I had ordered nachos and a burger for take away. I waited about 35 minutes for the food. While walking back to my hotel, I tried some of the chips and they were very stale.. enough that I didn't eat them when I got back to my room. The burger itself was average, but again, the bun was stale and the tomato tasted like it was old and had been sitting out for a while.

Author: Paul_L_DonnoHaverhill, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyed this restaurant
Review: I have only reduced the rating due to the accessibility of the restaurant, it had no ramp for wheel chair users or offer of help when trying to get in.The location was excellent near our hotel (Hilton) and the price good especially when comparing to the Hilton!We popped in a few times during our stay and each time pleasantly surprised. I had the Sir James Fish curry which was spicy enough for me and my wife the Green Curry which she enjoyed as well.Our daughter enjoyed her noodlesThe beer was cold which in this heat was very welcome.The young lady serving us was really good and helpful. You had to call her over which when we understood that was not a problem and always came over with a smile Well worth a visit

Author: walkformilersWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Bla Bla Blurgh...
Review: We decided to visit Bla Bla Bla, after reading the reviews and wanting something a bit different. I can definitely say we got that!The chicken in pandan leaves which we ordered first were excellent so we were quite hopeful. My partner ordered the fish Thai style. When we asked we were told in came with Chilli. What they meant was smothered in sweet chilli sauce. Not good.The special noodles basically are crispy noodles in gloop, something we didn’t expect from the ‘gravy’ description...It took us a long time to find someone to complain to but when we did they did take these two dishes off the bill, (which is why I have given it 2 stars not 1).If you like massive portions of OKish food this place is for you, if you like good food go to Cha Bo next door... it’s much better

Author: NodnoltravelLondon
Title: Poor food. Tried to scam on the bill ! ! Worst in Kuala Lumpur
Review: We stopped here for lunch as it’s next to the KL tourism centre and were the only people there. The woman serving, (Ain) was slow in arriving. The order came in about 10 minutes. It was luke warm and the meat was very tough from where it was reheated.To add insult to injury when we asked for the bill, the server, (Ain), came over with just a calculator in hand. I have never seen this done anyway in the World ! ! She then said the total was 91.90 Ringett. When questioned, she sheepishly asked what we had to drink and I told her calmly. She went over and whispered to her colleague to explain, he then laughed. Clearly he realised she'd been rumbled in her tourist con. A bill, by “sheer miracle”, turned up for 71.90 Ringett, which was paid. She had obviously tried to cheat us with an extra 20 Ringett. She did not apologise or even act as though it was a mistake ! ! ! The bill included a service charge of 6.20 Ringett. We don’t question this at that can be theres for the global exposure I have now given them :-)Avoid this place unless you want meat that only a dog, shark or tiger could eat, get a bogus bill and mediocre service. Kuala Lumpur has fine dining so please dine elsewhere.

Author: kadekr2014
Title: Nice food but terible service
Review: Having my lunch with my family and been here for almost every weekend, the food is good but the service keeps going down, last time we do not need to ask for refills our drink or our tostada, the waiter automatically will come to the table and offer to refills. But now event we ask to refill our drink the server ( young indian gentleman ) said " wait is not my sections " . Is the customers now need to know if I not seat at your section im not gonna get help? Its truly disappointing as there's more "models" doing the catwalk here then actual waiters.I see the manager is busy working and some really proactive and efficient staffs.. But there's a few that did nothing to help their fellow waiters. They just walk around. I hope the manager will take time to stop and monitor her staffs.. See which one that needs to be more proactive and needs more training. I dont want to cause any trouble just want the service to improve. Overall it was still a good restaurant to bring my family to. Thanks to Tina and aminah for a job well done is very hardworking too.

Author: rlow168Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Pricey and so-so
Review: Was told this place is famous for it’s steam fish rather than it’s bakuteh. My take were:-1. A 2 person meal comprising a steam fish, 2 person bakuteh (soup), braised pig trotter, 2 bowls of yam rice and a pot of jasmine tea costs RM76.90. 2. Steam fish is overwhelmed with garlic n the fish is certainly not fresh.3. Bakuteh taste is average
Restaurant: Kedai Bak Kut Teh Hin Hock

Author: GohYC
Title: Lack of choice
Review: Most of the food listed are not available. So  ended up eating whatever is left. The taste is so and so.

Author: leglobetrotter7London, United Kingdom
Title: Ok
Review: Not that great. Not so many options for vegetarians. The meat dishes we had were ok. The Singapore noodles were good. Service was good. Expensive.

Author: Ramzidog777
Title: Dinner at Curate
Review: Would like to give a massive commendation for Jackson and Marvin for a wonderful dinner service. Speedy, personable and attentive, this is a true world class five star service. Keep up the top notch service and attitude. Regards, one ecstatic customer. Many Thanks,Rosli Family
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: geoffp475Cairns, Australia
Title: This Place was supposed to have a great reputation!
Review: We went to Healey Mac's with high expectations based on their reputation as best Irish Pub outside of Ireland ..... well this one ISN'T!We ordered Garlic Cheese Bread for starters..... to be told later that they didn't have any garlic butter .... so we had toast!!!!My wife ordered fettucine prawn marinara ... unbelievably it arrived without the prawns! Embarrassed waiter goes back to the kitchen and then comes back & advises that the chef said that the prawns were not fresh! My wife then ordered a chicken spaghetti which arrived after I had finished my main course.The spaghetti was dry and barely warm .... my wife added butter to try and get at least some moisture into it. The few bits of chicken were not great either - she didn't eat much of it as it was not palatable.My beef burger was a beef pattie, slice of cheese and half a slice of tomato..... seriously guys???? This chef is incompetent - get a decent one and get one quickly as your food is NOT ACCEPTABLE!!

Author: ChernLam
Title: Bad Service Food Served Cold
Review: We went with few friends, order their famous Dissapointing Cold Pork Knuckle. It was cold when it was served. Another Pork Ribs that we order was told it was finish after waiting for so long

Author: ILuuvKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Smoking is ALLOWED in this restaurant
Review: I visited Birch in DC Mall on 14 June 2019. I was very surprised the customers at next table were smoking. When I asked the staff, he gave me ‘grin’ and said they have ‘special permission’ which their customers can smoke in the restaurant. I wonder what kind of special privilege is given that outlaw the regulations ya. Smoking is not allowed in any eateries including open air eateries started 1 Jan 2019 in Malaysia Law. This kind of restaurant do not have basic etiquette about other ppl’s health. Non smokers are forced to take secondhand smoke. Please put a sign right in front of the restaurant ‘For Smokers Only’. I will not visit this restaurant again.

Author: aadroitSingapore, Singapore
Title: Juicy steak
Review: I found this restaurant on TripAdvisor when I was in Kuala Lumpur, which was within walking distance from my hotel. This place served one of the best steaks, and you can easily distinguish this place from the others, because of a large fried onion ring which was placed on the steak when served. The service was reasonable, and we saw the lady owner going around tables to chat up with the guests. The steak was nicely done, just right for my medium well preference. The ambience was great, certainly a place for a candle-light dinner. At the end of the meal, we were gestured to provide a review on TripAdvisor. I would return, but the price is on the high side by KL standard.

Author: TheYumL
Title: Rooftop bar
Review: If you're looking for a quieter bar experience Man Tao on the roof of Hotel Stripes offers nice views in a peaceful environment. Decent wine by the glass and the specialty is Chinese beer. It would also make a great event space.

Author: jmptrips
Title: disappointing breakfast buffet
Review: disappointing breakfast buffet, better to srcik with the a la cart. Just not enough offerings, variety, too many things cold, chewy

Author: joykoo
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: Typical cze char stall. Went there because of recommendation by local friends. Had the chicken soup in coconut, salt bake crab, steam partin fish, vegetable, tofu and lala. Bill came up to RM313.

Author: ReefBROOKLYN
Title: Excellent Service
Review: Rachael is the Hostess, and she knows how to service customers. The place is as good as it gets. Scotch,Wine,Cigars...under the great city, watching people go bye. Don't go to those places and get FAKE ALCOHOL..come here and experience the difference.

Author: penguinsuky
Title: Dinner at Spice Kitchen
Review: Nice environment and good food. Wide variety of food selection. Recommended for family or friends gathering

Author: DutchiesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good foor in nice surroundings
Review: On the terrace, with view over the river, we had a truly lovely meal. Steamboat was very good and so was the curry. Too bad the curry arrived when the steamboat was nearly finished, but that was the only flaw. Excellent, friendly service and very decent prices.

Author: Poje MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Margaritas!!!
Review: On a recent hot day in Bangsar, the idea of a nice tasty Margarita was inviting.But unfortunately, it was only in the idea. RM 30++ for a tasteless water-down full of ice lime drink. The worst i've had in KL so far. To bad, it did not made us want more, and ask for the bill; which took a very long time to get also. Desapointed.

Author: Jeffrey HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: OVER RATED NASI LEMAK TANGLIN
Review: The RiceLack of taste!! I dont taste the presence of coconut milk and the scent of pandan leaves. The Sambal SotongLack of imagination and the taste is rather flat with a twitch of the heat from the chili no presence of tamarind, the sweetness of the onions. The sotong has a funny after taste and its not soft and tender. The BergedilIts ok and sweet perfect for granny with sweet tooth that dont care about the taste. Taste sweet, flat and rather disappointing. The Fried ChickenHorrorable bin Horrible!! They just fried and season with salt. Another disappointing item that should br a star. Overall I should think the original recipe printed on the Board should be taken down.

Author: rosec302Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: I love this place and food was Delicious
Review: We were at the Dome Cafe at the trendy alley between the Pavilion Mall and Pavilion Residence. We had brunch. I so love this alley we sat outside the restaurant. We were able to enjoy our meal and still felt comfortable to watch people passing by. It was comfortable and relaxing. The staff and their service were good. The food were delicious and good portions. Free wifi. We sat for quite awhile and nobody or staff harassing us. Definitely go back again.

Author: vrhSingaporesingapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Lovely location and views, food very expensive and not of a good standard. One main meal came out 15 minutes before the others so it was cold when the others arrived. One other main course was just warm rather than hot. The lamb shank was overcooked and chewy.

Author: KHSim9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Staff not honest.check your bill.
Review: We had 6 oysters and 2 wine , as we have dinner later.Had a look at the ocean trout and didn't want to order since have to pay charges to slice it when I can buy shasimi next store.When we finished our wine and oysters and wanted to leave, the foreign worker bought the trout. Told him we never ordered that.He said it's free on the house.When I went to pay the bill , he refused to show me the bill and I smelt something not right.True enough he put the trout and cutting charges on the bill.When I complained he took put the charges only but I told him I never ordered the trout and he said it was free.He said no and only cutting charges are waived but then he did not take it out in the initial bill and tried to hide the bill.Told him he tried cheating me but he said he only said cutting charges is free.Contradicting statement from his action.Told him this is the last time I am visiting as he is dishonest.If the owner is reading this,you should sack him.

Author: Joep BAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Nice place to go for breakfast
Review: This typical backpackers hangout situated on love lane offers nice western style food for like wise prices. The place lacks a bit of ambiance due to the glass doors that split the restaurant in an airco and non-airco area. If you’re looking for a more quiet place to go for breakfast/lunch, I can recommend the pitstop cafe, just a block away

Author: AsoiI
Title: Full Course Fine Dinning
Review: Really Nice place to setup an Event.I'm doing my anniversary event at Miyabi. it was really superb and my wife really love it. Staff restaurant really friendly and helpful. Really recommended for those who want private dinner and delicious food.

Author: Robin JLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The view
Review: The view was amazing and you just could not get enough of it! The food I would say was a little bit disappointing! The first course was bland and the second had that much pepper it was just hot! The roast chicken was amazing except I found two bonds in it, which would not have been a problem if you could have seen what you were eating! The lighting was just so dim. The desert was 10/10 just wonderful. The drink was amazing and of good quality and I would be happy to try the experience again in the hope the food was better.

Author: ChelvakumariPetaling jaya
