Title: Ill trained staff and personnel
Review: Went for dinner last night to celebrate my daughter s birthday - a group of 5. We were given a table about half a foot away from a water feature that ran alongside the table. My husband assumed it was tiles as the water refraction made the tiles look closer to the surface than it actually was and due to very poor lighting and no notices or staff to warn us he promptly stepped into the water face down! What was worst is the way the staff responded to the situation! They just didn't bother! They turned away! We had to rescue him and gathered napkins to wipe him down. We had to call the staff to ask for a towel which arrived half an hour later. All my husband s belongings such as hand phone and wallet were drenched. We made a complaint to the duty manager of the hotel. I selected this place as it was rated in the list of 10 best restaurants in KL. What a major letdown it was in terms of hospitality , customer care and service! Oh yeah did I mention the food wasn't great either and was so long in coming?

Author: Lauren1ee
Title: Poor food and poor value
Review: This is a truly great hotel but having eaten here one evening because we were late and tired I can only say this is a truly poor buffet and truly poor value. Our worst food in 11 days in Malaysia. Sorry because we love the hotel

Author: Berrly1
Title: Nice people.
Review: It was 930pm with a very huge crowd, waited for nearly an hour but we were nicely warned beforehand. Staffs are nice and friendly. Foods are not bad, with fixed price on menu.

Author: ximosanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: A great place for friends gathering with good food and excellent service. The servers are always so caring and concerning to make sure we are well serve throughout our dinner.

Author: Thomasong1980
Title: Overrated
Review: If you have tasted good Peranakan food , forget about expecting much from here. We had the chilli pork which was quite oily . The chapcai was mediocre. The only good comfort was the sambal chilli which you must order from the side menu. Skip the chendol.

Author: xopixieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not as great as I expected
Review: Overall it was an enjoyable meal @ Stoked. However, the Blackmore wagyu was dissappointing as it is probably a low grade wagyu hence there was no 'melt-in-the-mouth' taste.Other than that, the lamb & starters as well as the sticky date pudding (TDF!) were great.

Author: MARKO663885Cheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Sorry not what we expected
Review: Went to Cocos as reviews were excellent. We were really disappointed both with the restaurant and the food.To be fair the food is very very average pub grub considering that you are in Langkawi and not the UK. The menu has no starters just mains which consist of as previously stated Fish and Chips, Irish stew etc. there is one mention of desserts but as to what it/they are is not disclosed on the menu.When the food came it was ok but nothing special but certainly not overpriced.The basement restaurant reeked of the deep fat fryer and the decor is post Berlin Wall basement German not easy on the eye. The tables were brown plastic and functional akin to any shopping mall food hall anywhere in the world. No table cloths(even paper ones) and just a cruet set and a candle in a red what looked like beer glass.Service was brisk and friendly enough.We sat down at 8.30 and were out by 9.05.Do go if you are desperate for a home from home basic tea your local could give you but if you want a special occasion with special food with special surroundings forget it.

Author: ardourboy
Title: Nice ambience but food need to improve.
Review: We were enlightened by the overall environment, service is good. Food so so only, soup is very salty. The pork bun is tasteless.

Author: IvoClaassen
Title: Perfect service, good prices.
Review: Perfect service, good prices. Child friendly, even got free playing cards!! Three places where you can sit.

Author: Ns0078
Title: Perfect social distance.
Review: I was amazed to see what happend n glad to the event.. We as forigners we are told malaysian police are xxx, but they were great as I presume the outlet documentation was all OK.. We were at canopy when local authorities came to check SOP suddenly.. We were all shocked, about 40 of them, but they were friendly and were checking social distancing etc, which Canopy always follows anyway.. However they checked what looked like documentation of staff etc, not sure but at the end, they said thank you and left.. My point is that they, canopy all doing their best yo keep us safe, so I totally agree we the guest also must support the govenment as its all done to keep us all safe..

Author: Wim SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great steak, service so so
Review: My coworker has been to this place before. Great recommendation. Prices are steep, I took the cheapest wagyu cut (I wasn't paying so did not want to overdo it). Was wondering since it was flat iron steak. The result was great, steak was awesome.Service was so so though but I guess for KL standards not the worst.They have credit card special discounts, I believe Citibank cards (only local cards). Up to 40% off food items so really worth it.SPG members get 20% on food items. Not sure whether it's for all levels of membership though.

Author: Syafnitasyah
Title: Business trip
Review: My favourite hotel so far. Their service and of course the buffet selection for breakfast is awesome!Thank you Suman, for your kind service!

Author: yokekancBangkok, Thailand
Title: disappointment with the service provided at Tamarind Springs.
Review: I am writing to express my utter disappointment with the service provided at Tamarind Springs. My company booked the venue for an international company dinner on the 18th of June 2019. We had guests flying in from many countries such as Denmark, Argentina, Brazil, Russia, Indonesia, Philippines, Germany, Greece, Korea, and many others. We had chosen Tamarind Springs, which prides itself in its exclusivity and top-notch dining, in hopes of giving our guests a glimpse of Malaysia’s wonderful hospitality and food. Unfortunately, the outcome was anything but a success. I acknowledge that we made a last minute change to the number of guests, but the staff were completely uncooperative and unaccommodating – they refused to make the slightest changes to the table arrangements. When I asked for a few sets of cutleries to be cleared to make more space for the guests who were still at the table, the assistant manager refused, claiming that they “would not do rearrangements and resetting of tables” because it was not what they were told to do. Even when we offered to pay extra for any additional costs incurred to accommodate our arrangements, he still rudely refused. This is completely unacceptable for a restaurant that welcomes group bookings/special events/private functions. It is customary for a restaurant to have a certain degree of flexibility and versatility to adapt to a change of circumstance. Moreover, when we requested the bottles of wine to be placed on the table so our guests would have easier access, the restaurant was adamant on refusing our request for no good reason (or at least even if they had a good reason, they chose to keep it from us). Nonetheless, the main emphasis of this complaint is the attitude of the staff, especially the assistant manager. For the most part they were nonchalant and almost hostile when serving us. It was very embarrassing give the impression to our international guests that this was what Malaysia had to offer. Additionally, I want to comment that quality of food served that night was subpar, nothing like what would be expected from the “never compromising on quality” image promoted on your website. This, aggravated by the immensely poor service, is why I would not be recommending Tamarind Springs to anyone, especially for the purpose of hosting group functions.

Author: petite_rainbowMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious Dinner
Review: One of the best chinese restaurant there is, located in Sentul, this place serves their signature dish, fried chicken wings. Each time I come here, it is the same I'd order and will never get tired of it. It will be fried chicken wings, 'seong tong' lala soup, stingray curry and sotong stew.Though this place is always congested, good to make reservations before you drop by.

Author: KitfoodieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Service, Ambiance and Food
Review: Visited Tosca in the beginning of this month, their service and food are good. Staff are very friendly and thanks Jai (the restaurant manager), who provided us a private room with sky view for special birthday surprise celebration. We had a wonderful and memorable time dining at the restaurant. If I have another opportunity, will definitely come back to try their famous pizza.Kit
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: lavendydream
Title: Excellent Dim Sum, worth the wait, worth the crowd
Review: Still the number one Dim Sum restaurant in Ipoh, Foh San is second to Ming Court. Simply wonderful and heavenly taste in all the dishes!
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Medicineonthedge
Title: Coffee break
Review: I would never attend this hotel for coffeeThe ambience in the morning coffee area on level 6 is dull and boring The price of coffee is rediculous 2 cups of coffee for MR 60 or $20 !!!!An absolute rip off Don’t waste your time and money You can get much better for one third of the price

Author: 802darrenl
Title: Superb seafood
Review: Super super long queue. Waited around one hour. The seafoods were so fresh. Cheesy prawn meehoon so yummy. Crab so big. A bit pricey. No choice tourist spot.

Author: Erico2709
Title: Nice desserts
Review: This shop is located right next to the MBO cinema. So wonderful to have a snack before the movie starts. Friendly and helpful staff.

Author: bwoodsy88
Title: Delicious relaxing lunch with cocktails
Review: Nice peaceful setting,  chilled music / decor.  Good choice of Malay / Thai food,  everything we ordered was delicious.  The cocktails were fairly unique and tastes great.  Fairly priced for what you are getting

Author: Ro_FishersFishers, Indiana
Title: Expensive, but excellent in all ways...
Review: Excellent service & excellent food. Make sure you have a reservation. We got in all the time we went but some days the place was extremely busy.Be sure to dress to match the restaurant's code.. They may not turn you away if you are wearing jeans but you will not fit in.

Author: 89stuarteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very, Very Dissapointed
Review: Arrived and when seated requested a bottle of sparkling water. Within seconds a different member of staff told me that I can't order a bottle of sparking water unless I order from the A La Carte menu.Placed our order from the a la carte menu and after about 20 minutes one of the meals arrived. 30 minutes later, after my guest had finished eating I enquired about my order only to be told "it's coming.....its a few minutes". Waited another 5 minutes and asked again about my order...."the kitchen is rushing it now, 5 more minutes". If there is significant preparation time it should be stated on the menu and basic hospitality decorum everybody knows...you serve the table at the same time.I cancelled my order, paid for what we ate and left without food nearly 1 hour later.Whilst waiting I notice that many tables arrived well after us and we're server very quickly because they were ordering from the brunch set menu.Having been forced into a la carte so I could drink water it's obvious that this operation I'd only interested in serving fast food for quick turn over.I would not venture back....plenty more to choose from in this area with much better service.

Author: Lisa Y
Title: Not worth
Review: Burger was drier than the Sahara dessert, crumbled apart. Pasta wasn't good as well. Drinks were okay. Definitely not worth the hype

Author: Edward C
Title: Did Not Reach Expectation
Review: Me and my friend were out on our usual food hunting weekend. I've read reviews about this place, some were good and some were very good.This place is situated in a housing area and the place is quite calm. We are delighted with the ambiance, which the Tea House is in a garden. Place rating 4/5.We were here for an afternoon tea, so we ordered, the Tea for 2.However, we were very disappointed with the food. Cakes were too dry, chocolate tasted bad. I guessed that the tuna that they served together with the salad, were canned tunas. The bread they used is straight out of the grocery store from what I can tell.I would say that non of the food from the menu we picked were self made, like the tuna, bread, etc. Food Rating 1/5.I would recommend this place only for the ambiance and not the food.

Author: NatnOllie
Title: Interesting lunch.
Review: Cane here with the family over lunch. I had the Katsu Chicken and if I'm really honest,  it was very bland. I had higher hopes.

Author: KLPowSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food
Review: Located just next to PDI and spacious.I tried the Nasi Lemak and love the chicken. So soft and tasty.My friends tried the fried kuay teow and another tried laksa. All commented nice though the kuay teow is a little pricy.No service tax and not GST. Worth to eat there is you are willing to fork out a little more.

Author: Johnson_charlesNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Not worth it
Review: Went here for my anniversary meal while in Kuala Lumpur. I was extremely disappointed. Everything was just average. The steak was extremely dry and the peppercorn sauce was tasteless.Would not recommend.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Very quick service
Review: Little Penang Kafe serves up pretty delicious Penang delights. Their char koay teow (CKT) still can't quite compare to the stuff you find from hawkers, of course, but is still pretty tasty (if expensive- RM18 for their seafood special CKT!) Their prawn noodles, asam laksa, lam mee, rojak, joo hu char and kari ikan hantu are also pretty good. Do also give their cendol and red ruby desserts a try.Service is quick but perfunctory. Wait time between ordering and getting your food is surprisingly minimal... but that is often assuming you manage to get the attention of a server in the first place as they're always zipping about looking extremely hurried, busy & stressed.Be prepared to queue during peak meal hours on weekends, public holidays and school holidays.

Author: Julie FLangkawi, Kedah, Malaysia
Title: The excellent food from an ever changing menu means you are never bored with the same old, same old
Review: The menu changes are lovely, just one or two dishes on an excellent menu just to make sure that you want to come back. It is extremely clean and tidy with a/c and wifi but it is the Chef that makes the highlight of this lovely place by coming out and greeting old and new friends. The services is above and beyond what you normally get here and definitely a favorite,

Author: Norlin ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Go for the Indian menu
Review: After a day spent at Legoland, my daughter and I decided to go out and find us some dinner. It was rather late so we didn’t want to venture too far from the hotel. Came across this restaurant which specialises in Indian food but has some Western menu options as well. I ordered the garlic and butter naan with the lamb spicy curd masala which was recommended by the staff who served us. My daughter had the Australian Wagyu tenderloin. The Indian option was really good. The lamb masala was so flavourful and tender but really spicy so just a warning to folks who can’t take spicy food. I loved it though. The naan were also good. My daughter thought the butter naan was better than the garlic naan. The steak was so-so to me. The meat was tender but they let it sit too long so it wasn’t as warm as it should be when it was served. The service was impeccable. Our server, Rohit, was excellent. Ever so friendly, polite and attentive and great with recommending options from the menu.

Author: jko1988Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent dishes with reasonable pricing
Review: First time eating here. Important to note this is a pork free restaurant. We had the spring onion sliced fish with ginger which go very well with the rice. The sambal belacan was spicy and flavourful (do request from the waitress). Also had the Chinese spinach soup and beancurd with minced chicken meat. Good service with attention to details (will check your teapot for refill if necessary).

Author: crinols
Title: Best Breakfast
Review: Simply the best breakfast option in town. We had daily buffet breakfast as part of our package but would be happy to pay for it if it wasnt included. good for family, friends, business colleagues.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Dkonn
Title: Drinks and service
Review: The drinks are getting worse by the day. Especially it's coffee as if you're drinking mineral water!! Besides, order was not taken correctly

Author: JustinlyhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beverage counter
Review: Price is high for such a small food court, food is just OK, but is funny setup whereby beverage section located at the other side. The food court operator is offering free drink for any food purchase during certain hour, however, the beverage counter staffs seems very rude and no manners, they attending customers with black face. Probably the staffs hate thier work.

Author: Nuttavut J
Title: Very basic place.
Review: I went there with my friend decision base on TripAdvisor reviews. The restaurant is very basic unless you need chisha. Not so variety of foods, it is a place for smoking chisha only not formal restaurant at all.

Author: tayhockseng
Title: Worst eatery in Melaka
Review: Don’t waste time. Rubbish food... worse than canteen food. Says has a wide variety of nyonya kueh but there was only spring roll and goreng pisang!! Nasilemak only packet ones. Worst coffee anywhere !

Author: escholte
Title: Delicious food
Review: Delicious pizza and burger in this mall restaurant.  Service was quick and food was lovely.  Looked and tasted good.  Nice place to watch people.

Author: Starry-niteKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Smells good, looks good and price's reasonable
Review: When I want authentic Malaysian dishes, with air-cond, comfortable, relaxed and clean atmosphere, I'll head to Madam Kwan's. Service is fast. Liked most of their dishes, especially the Nasi Lemak and Penang Laksa, yum-yum! Go early before the lunch crowd comes, or after 2pm - the queue could be very long.....

Author: balthasars_13Kornwestheim, Germany
Title: Great location, subpar food.
Review: We've been there on a Monday night, party of two. The service was absolutely spot on , as you'd expect in such a place. However, the food was a letdown, almost shockingly bad. We're no fuzzy eaters, we just love high quality food. But the Chicken Tikka was so burnt and dry, I had to cover it with my Girlfriend's Butter Chicken sauce. The chicken in the Butter Chicken also didn't seem to be of the highest quality. Maybe day just had a bad day but I can't recommend it, especially considering their slightly higher prices. It's a shame really, but our Indian dinner @Bombay Palace was significantly better. Please also keep in mind that going back to the city with Grab can be quite time-consuming. It took 20+ minutes until we would finally find a driver that didn't cancel the pickup.

Author: astridbaptist
Title: Our first time coming here
Review: Our first time coming here and I must say I love the warm ambience and the feel of the place. My husband and I ordered off the Ala- Carte menu. The ocean trout and the scallops were very nice. For mains we had the fish and the duck which was fantastic. And for dessert the famous durian ice cream. Last but not least the service was very good and attentive given that it was a busy night. But kudos to one of the staff named Maslan that served our table. He took the time to explain to us each and every dish. Overall, great experience and will definitely be back.
Restaurant: ATAS at The RuMa Hotel & Residences

Author: steennyAalborg, Denmark
Title: Dinner
Review: Very bad Lamb Meat, chiken wings and Tomyam Dont eat there .. take another restaurant .. There are a lot !The Service and The Staff was frindly and speak good English The kitchen done a Very bad job .. So they ruin My evning ☹️

Author: CheryllynThomas
Title: Awesome
Review:
Just so perfect... Good food, good wine, good ambiance..
Kids friendly, awesome service.. We love it there..
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: 673kenmSingapore River, Singapore
Title: The Steakhouse KL. Not worth the effort, price or the calories
Review: I ate at The Steakhouse KL on 15 Jan 2014. For starter Oyster Rockerfeller: The chef hasn't a clue. The oysters were cold and layered in cold spinach and bread crumbs and the plate was cold.There was no resemblance to Oyster Rockerfeller. For my main course I had Black Angus 300grms ordered medium rare. The chef hasn't a clue. The meat wasn't cooked, there was no flavour, the vegetables tasted of chemicals, the plate was cold. The bill: They haven't a clue. I was overcharged by MYR40 but got them to reduce it. This restaurant relies on its reviews but does not live up to them. The experience was terrible. Ken Montgomery Singapore.

Author: LamN_12
Title: JP Teres is the JP Morgan of Malaysian buffet
Review: Malaysian (mainly Malay) dishes, well cooked, but something pan-Malaysian like Straits Kitchen at the Singapore Hyatt would be better and more successful.

Author: Hawker78Burlington
Title: Review #2... WHAT HAPPENED??
Review: I came to Amy's in March of this year, and had the door's blown off my expectations of what Melakan Nyonya Restaurants could offer. Namely, the banana blossom salad, and the smoky, creamy chicken stew with buah keluak (black nut), blew my mind as very few dishes in my 6 or so years of visiting and eating around Malaysia have--such a richness and symphonic construction of flavors, it was everything I hoped Nyonya food would be like, but rarely lived up to. Fast forward to December. WHAT HAPPENED? Ikan Asam Pedas (sour/spicy fish)--a Malaysian staple, and a Melakan Nyonya specialty--was thin, watery, a little sour, and bland. Absolutely no depth, and we're pretty sure the fish was cooked seperately and chucked into the kuah at the last minute. I've had all kinds of asam pedas around the country. This was the worst. Another favorite, sambal petai udang (prawns with "stink beans"), was made with tiny, precooked shrimp, without shells and without flavor, another "worst" rendition, and I'm simply shocked how pedestrian this was, after offering two of the best Nyonya dishes I've ever eaten. I'll be back, for sure, but I'm calling ahead to see if the bunga pisang dish is available.

Author: SamiraIsBobbinKuala Lumpur
Title: The place to be is Quivo
Review: This trendy restaurant/ bar has definitely become my favourite place to grab a meal and hangout with friends at. The food is great, the ambiance is super chilled out and the service is definitely with a smile. Come evening, it turns into a pretty cool bar with very cool playlists (I'm big on music) and a nice crowd. Definitely worth a visit, you might end up making it your stomping ground.

Author: 251michellHong Kong, China
Title: Disapointed
Review: Our hotel was very close by , and rating was appealing. Finally we found a Chinese cantin, very noisy, even menu show starters, main...the main came first , then starters ..so what’s the need to mention it ? Also drinks came later ...very poor service, not concentrated, looks waiters don’t have their tables to manage. Typical Chinese restaurant where the boss is the cook , first cook , first served. Efficient by careless.Food mostly Chinese influence.We don’t recommend,

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Evening
Review: Coco's over the years has been established at various locations but has been in its present location I believe over 4 years. It is a good 3 years since my last visit and nothing has really changed. Still the same great food and ambience. It is run by Steve a large strapping Irishman who is the chef and his tiny Chinese wife Coco along with her front of house staff.Steaks are very popular and always praised for there tenderness. I had fish with some mashed potatoes and roasted vegetables. Again delicious. Another house favourite is Chicken Cordon bleu and the ubitious Irish Stew is very popular. I would recommend you give it a try. Just ask any taxi driver and they will take you there.

Author: joelchong13
Title: Marriage proposal
Review: Been here several times. Excellent service, highly attentive staff, chefs that care about feedback AND act on it. Mr Sumo was highly attentive and Mr Fabio the chef was accommodative and highly passionate about the quality of food that comes out of his kitchen. Food is on par with other fine dining restaurants but service is definitely above expectation. All of this added up to a smooth and successful proposal to my now fiancée. Thanks Mandarin Grill! I would so come back again!

Author: Varin B
Title: Surprise Party for Hubby's Big 40
Review:
Had a g8 time. Planned a surpise and worked out well. Food as usual as g8....Staff friendly and chef shamini, Raman and Rakitt was awesome.
Sure to be back for more great times...

Author: qureshbengaliMalaysia
Title: Best to Worst
Review: In 2018 I left a very good review for this restaurant however over the years it is become very bad. Must say the quality of the food has really deteriorated. They say the chef has changed but then the quantity and quality cannot become this bad. Over the years the pricing has increased which is no problem but portion size has become less than half. Taste and quality totally gone down. The chicken pieces of sheesh tawook have become half the size and that too is dry not moist n juicy. The Mullawah also half the original size and not even baked properly ... was half raw.When I told the cashier he said he is only a cashier need to talk to manager.The person cooking ... Is he really a chef or a beginner who is learning to cook the food.

Author: Rohit GSingapore, Singapore
Title: Restaurant timings are wrong.
Review: Pretty much on all websites they have advertised timings as 10.30 while they close kitchen at 10. I reached here at 10.05 and had to go to a different restaurant to find food. And the staff handling billing was rude enough for me to not visit them again.

Author: LaurenceMacraeDoha, Qatar
Title: Some good some bad dishes
Review: We took in the sunset here with another family. Positives lovely location on the beach to watch the sunset , very nice staff and some good dishes which tended to be seafood. I also had tomato soup as a starter which was excellent. Negatives my wife and her friend had chicken tikka which was really not very nice , they complained to the waitress who apologised and when we got the bill both dishes had been taken off. The manager also came up afterwards and apologised , they seemed to be genuinely distraught at everyone not enjoying the food. When we left we realised that my daughter had left her phone , she returned back and one of the waitresses had handed it into reception so you also can't fault the honesty of the staff. Not as good as we expected but if we came back I would go back , the tikka wasn't good but the prawn masala I had was very good so worth a visit.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rainne_TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Just average - but do drop by in the evening!
Review: On the first night in Malacca, we passed by Geographer cafe and was impressed by a lady singing with the live band there. The cafe looked packed, with a lot of onlookers standing around, enjoying the music. We figured this may be a good place to drop by the next day, as the cafe looked really too full for that night.Next day, we decided to have a late lunch at Geographer cafe, and I ordered their Jonker fried rice. The dish took about 20 to 30 minutes to arrive, and my partner had long since finished his watermelon juice. The food was average - not something that we expect after a long wait. The place was not exactly packed, just small groups of patrons sitting in the air-conditioned part of the cafe, wanting to escape from the heat. But the waiting staff looked harried, often as if they were way too busy for you. I won't say their service is bad or rude, just indifferent and.... busy. They just looked too busy to care about their patrons. At that point, I was a little regretful for not waiting till evening before trying out the cafe.Nevertheless, their sour plum juice is nice, as with their watermelon juice.Do try to drop by in the evening when the live music starts. I think that will jack up the ambience by notches. You'll probably be far too engrossed in the performance than to realise your dinner has taken 30 minutes or more to reach your table.

Author: YH C
Title: rather expensive...
Review:
the service is decent...  the food was bad... the setting was great....

so, is it worth it?   prolly not.  :D

Author: sacmajeekDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Need to do better...........
Review: Have been staying at the hotel for almost a week now and our experience of eating at Cba has been very average at best. Monday evening was a roast buffet. The meat was cold and I had to ask for it to be reheated in the microwave. Yesterday and today we have eaten lunch here and much of the small lunch menu was unavailable. The waitress did not know why. No salad option at all on both days! Service was very slow today and customers were complaining. We had long finished our drinks before the food arrived and we only ordered burgers. Some of the more experienced staff are very good and attentive but seem to be running at 150% to perhaps make up for the inexperienced staff who look lost at times. In full sun the available shaded space in the restaurant is limited. They could do with investing in more sun shades or a large awning to provide more shade and increase the number of available tables. Some seat cushions for the hot plastic chairs would also be appreciated.

Author: 247Carpe_Diem
Title: Open air restaurant
Review: Open air restaurant surrounded by tall buildings. It's a 2-3 star restaurant. Food was average. Free WiFi available. Not all staff can speak English

Author: 943sulaimanh
Title: Satisfying & Value For Money
Review:
There've a variety of foods, which also have a few of mix cuisine foods. Delicious, fresh & temptations. I've been there for many times and always meet my expectation.

Keep it up Melting Pot Concorde Hotel Shah Alam!

Author: Fearless734926
Title: Ok
Review:
We ordered thai foods was ok
But it was sooo spicy and i felt littlw bit indian taste mix. It was like a fusion cook?!

Author: BushymartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just ok
Review: I had dinner with some business partners tonight.They took us here.The food was just ok, nothing out of this world .I’m not How much it was as the business partners were paying The steamed grouper was ok but I found the rest of the food to be salty and bland Service was quick and attentive.Next door is a live seafood market (see my photos) which I think has very fresh seafood

Author: Shine C
Title: Not worth for the price at all
Review: Can't imagine their serving and food could get one of the best restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. We ordered seafood teppanyaki set & sashimi set, except the fruit decoration is nice, i can't found anything else...( even the rockmelon is tasteless) teppanyaki sauce is full of oil, seems like a butter dressing sauce more like a teppanyaki sauce. Sashimi (amaebi) is not fresh... really disappointed and hardly will visit here again...

Author: gladyschaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: we got over charge for the meal
Review: We ordered 7 dishes for 8 persons, all the food are tasted so-so only. one of the dish is fried fish with chili was charged at RM70+, which is too expensive!! We will come back here and go somewhere else as there are many good Nyonya food restaurant in the town.

Author: 793dindaa
Title: Happy hour
Review: My favorite go-to place to chill and mingle with friends! Amazing food accompanied with the luxurious  view of the KL city. The perfect place to lounge and to treat yourself with luxurious ambience

Author: Budi_KNKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Hardly to eat Schnitzel
Review: We have been visiting Morganfield's Publika since the opening in Publika and had always good experience and enjoying varieties of spare ribs and other dishes. This time, we noticed that they have a new menu whereby we also realized that you now can get only a full slab spare ribs while previous menu, you still can get a half slab!! .Unfortunately, during my last dining experience last Sunday Nov8th, I was very much disappointed.when ordering one of the new dishes called Pork Schnitzel / RM.38.90First off, the Schnitzel has been battered twice thus very very thick and on top another bread crust thus the meat is so dry that I couldn't cut easily and even not to think to take a bite. So I called one of the staff and they took the plate back to the kitchen and prepared a new one. Unfortunately totally the same but better than the first plate as it was slightly tender but still very very dry and had to eat by dipping mayonnaise sauce because the mushroom sauce is completely disappeared into the battered crust...for reference see picture. After our dinner, I called the Manager and showed my plate with remaining full of battered crust of 2 pieces meat and suggested him to check with the chef as what Morgenfields is offering a bad dish as it's a tiny shrunk meat with a thick battered crust skin and very very dry meat..and suggested him: a Schnitzel suppose to be prepared with a layer thin skin of battered bread crust stick to the meat (not like that I can easily pealed out from the meat) and fry it in PAN WITH BUTTER and NOT IN A DEEP FRIED like making French fries...Besides, the Mushroom sauce should be served separately where you can eat it as dip sauce too.Unfortunately, I had to pay for my meal even it is totally unsatisfactorily and sincerely hoping that Morgenfield's HQ will appreciate customer input.

Author: November R
Title: popular with indonesian cuisine... 'Kedondong Juice" is famous too.luv it
Review: popular with indonesian cuisine... 'Kedondong Juice" is famous too.luv it

Author: Naveen NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice, clean, decent and good service.
Review: I was actually surprised to see many bad reviews as my experience was quite good. I went to the one in Bangsar Village. Very good service indeed, all food was served well. Food also tasted delicious (all plates cleaned). We had french fries, soup, pork kebab and ice cream for decent. Just a simple dinner after our short vacation. They also have everything thought off for toddlers, drawings and etc to keep them busy. Overall, good experience. Nice relaxing atmosphere as well. Will come again.

Author: penyuMalaysian in Aussie
Title: Fresh and delicate
Review: The title says it all; among most commercial sushi places, Sushi Zanmai is ALWAYS full with long walk-in queues even during odd hours (3 - 5pm). Peak hours may take 1 hour to get a place to sit (that's how good it is). Prices are very reasonable, for this price range I'd say it's the best choice. Facial expressions of some waitresses in the store could be "improved", though. :)

Author: EddieZulSingapore, Singapore
Title: There is nothing fantastic to brag about this restaurant. I have eaten so much better at a less expensive restaurant.
Review: Maybe because im a frequent stayer at 5 star hotels that I have such a bad impresssion of this restaurant.. The buffet spread is nothing compare to other 4 or 5 star hotel restaurants. The choices are limited and there is not much changes daily or weekly. I have stayed in this hotel for 8 days continously and I can tell the difference. Frankly speaking after the fourth day, I started to look for outside eateries.

Author: ginger123Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: wonderful food and service
Review: can not say enough about how much we enjoyed the food here. Japanese or Korean bento boxes are very tasty, with generous servings, we were so full after. Hot tea comes and is topped up by the lovely staff when you are running low, they look after you very well here. A nice touch that they all say hello and goodbye when you enter or leave the restaurant. We enjoyed it so much that we went back a few nights later, such tasty sushi, nice and fresh and delicately put together. The price depends on what you have, bento boxes are excellent value for money. We were going to the cinema the first night we ate here, we said to the staff and they rushed our order through so we could leave in time, very helpful, thank you!

Author: Agatha_Ling1987Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not recommend
Review: I booked lounge in the sky, business class from klook around Rm500++. At the description stated that with exclusive 4 course of canepe platter. To my dissapointment it's just come with 1 course with 4 small finger food. Your advertising is very misleading too. I believe I am not the only unhappy customer and felt like being cheated. The price for this experience isn't worth and expensive. A slice of cake that I order for my partner birthday cost extra Rm68. And your staff even spoil the surprise by mention the cake arrangement and ask for payment infront of my partner during our check in. This place is not suitable for any celebration. Only for those who prefer to come for chill or get a unique experience. Overall dissapointed, would not recommend.*See the attached pictures

Author: 39steo
Title: Not value for money
Review: Had lunch at Nancy's kitchen on a weekday. Fish curry (ikan lemak nenas) was a rip-off. Fish was tiny, can only feed a cat i think, but cost RM30. Other dishes like chicken curry and soy sauce pork taste as if the meat was pre-cooked, and it was just different gravy poured on top of it. The only saving grace was the popiah which was tasty with an eggy skin. Will not go back there again.

Author: Harrods6
Title: Disappointed with the food and slow service
Review: I ordered ayam penyet today and the food did not come out as it is. The chicken portion is small and full of fried crumbs on the plate. I was disappointed and told the waiter this is not ayam penyet. In short the waiter replied how should it be? I am puzzled with the way it’s been asked and served. We ordered a pizza and burger. Pizza was overcook and burn on crust - hard to eat. Burger is small in size but the photo looks attractive. My friend ordered double shot coffee latte and the coffee is really diluted and no coffee smell. They refused to change the coffee- really disappointed. The service is really slow even thoughtless we are the only customer at the point of time. We waited 15 min for out beer and coffee was serve 20 minutes later - that is really slow and disappointed again. There are 5 workers behind the counter but not doing anything. We have to keep on asking for our drink and food. In short I do not enjoy the meal and surely will not go back again.

Author: umaramesh888Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Just OK to fill up in emergency
Review: It was situated closest to our hotel. Conceirge suggested this place for Indian food. Though the menu was quite big but the food tested more of south indian type. Even the north indian curries were more with south indian type gravy. May be that is the taste of local people. Moderate ambiance but service is fast.

Author: memories137Dunblane, United Kingdom
Title: New experience
Review: Visited this restaurant following a recommendation and this was our first experience of a Korean BBQ. The staff were very helpful explaining dishes and we opted for a set meal allowing us to sample a variety of dishes. This included 10 side dishes and a variety of pork mains. Some were delicious and others interesting but this was the best way to try something new. The seating was unusual with very low chairs, making it difficult for taller customers. It's worth a visit for a novel experience but on the night we visited there were too many children running about unsupervised which disturbed other diners.

Author: Karen T
Title: Eat, chat, relax
Review: Good western food and desserts with dog friendly environment. A place not only for the youngsters but also suitsble for family and kids to hang out. There is also live singing.

Author: 559tany
Title: Popiah and nyonya dumpling
Review: Rm5.50 each for nyonya dunpling. Popiah comes with pork lard but im not a fan so cant comment much. Sells noodles and other dishes too

Author: ruizgenTroyes
Title: My honest opinion
Review: I gave 2/5 because I can't really think of any reason to justify the price that this restaurant charges for what they serve. The steak, no matter which you would choose, was priced per 100 grams. (Do look properly at the menu & check pricing indicated & don't hesitate to ask the staff what you're actually getting & at what price).There's a minimum order of 1200 grams which would definitely set you back with a RM 800+ price tag ( in the case of striploin cut). That piece came with the bone which of course you couldn't consume. Sides and sauces were extra,the sides came in pathetically very small portion that sharing was impossible. The starters were overpriced too, the burrata cheese was just I presume only a quarter of a ball, was served melted so it was spread out & priced at RM45. To sum it up, there was no value for money here, in quantity, in quality, in dining experience itself. Service was just acceptable. The restaurant pretended to be fine dining which it wasn't. If you're coming to entertain clients & your meal is on company account, then go by all means. Otherwise, there are many other restaurants in the vicinity worth spending your money on, and for sure you won't go back home still hungry. Don't fall for the hype.

Author: Yogesh D
Title: Average Food and Super Expensive prices- Ambience is good
Review: Tamarind provides a good ambience and is in quiet location,  Tried few dishes, The food is average and nothing great however its super expensive.

Author: oal151Kuching, Malaysia
Title: For your Jap noodle fix.
Review: 2 of us ordered the premium combo set which consisted of 2 bowls of any noodle of your choice , a set of 3 appetisers,a plate of boiled spicy gyoza and 2 of their signature pork buns and daifuku as dessert ( a mochi stuffed with ice cream) - all for the price of Rm88. i ordered karaka-men ( a minced pork with a spicy miso paste broth with 2 slices of belly pork whilst my companion ordered a akamaru- shinaji ( the traditional broth with garlic,) I did not mind my noodles but it reminded me of the kolo noodles of kuching in a spicy soup base , as the noodles were the thin curly sort .and the broth reminded me of curry mee soup. So it did not strike a chord with me. i much preferred my companion's choice as it tasted more authentically japanese. And i liked the subtle flavourful soup of the pork and the crunch of the seaweed vegetable bits in the soup. I could think of 2 ways they could improve- (1) The green tea should have been included in the price (2) It could have come with a few more slices of the pork .Service generally was attentive but they seemed rather preoccupied in trying to clear the dishes as quickly as possible so you cant really relax and chat over your food. All in all, a good experience and I would return for my japanese noodle fix.

Author: AJandDJMelbourne, Australia
Title: Over priced for the quality we both thought
Review: We dined here only one night and came away thinking it was a bit over priced for the quality and quantity of food we had but just may have struck a wrong time or day. It may have been more enjoyable if we had chosen some different courses so willing to try it again next time we stay in KL.

Author: SathappanS
Title: Great vibe
Review: Amazing shisha and great vibe. Definitely worth a visit. Staff are very helpful also. Very affordable prices as well.

Author: caitlynkhailingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: Dishes are fine but not suitable for those that can't take spicy foods. Those that enjoy spicy foods will recommended. The dishes are well known of its spice and cendol is a must after meal. The services are fast but have to wait outside if there are too many peoples.

Author: RENERONO
Title: Ordinary
Review: Normal and ordinary western cuisine , nothing special but u can enjoy the food. Not too bad but nothing special

Author: LISELOTTE D
Title: be careful with your bill!
Review: I went to get some drinks with some friends and they usually offer to hold your credit card in order to give you the option to pay at the end....the problem started when they overcharge us...another problem are the waiters and waitress, that basically,,,,are very aggressive and they do something stinky in the cashier...without the control of the owner. The restaurant is fine and the food and ambiance are good but really, the last time was out of control the behavior of one of the waitress...i can understand that not all of them receive basic norms of education but at least the restaurant should invest on it, thinking that they are dealing with the costumes. On the other hand, the lack of organization, two of them were serving and we were like 7 people, we gave the card in order that he charge for both of us but the waiter i think...didn't understand or....the point is that both people that were serving us knew that we were correct....my suggestion is having more control to the cashier because they were the most distrustful workers.

Author: KKuaNew York City, New York
Title: Overstaffed and underserved. Eat fast so they can turn the table for next party.
Review: First of all, their website is never maintained. You cannot make a reservation online. The food here is awesome and authentic when flavors are concerned. Sadly, the execution of the food can sometimes be off. Textures and temperatures are never consistent. Sometimes the stir fry noodles are overcooked and swimming in oil. I have also experienced the unfortunate delivery of melted of the shaved ice dishes (chendol, air batu campur, etc). Nothing worse than cold rice with lukewarm rendang. The staff is overzealous on removing empty plates off the table, but never to be found when we need to ask for cutlery, sharing plates or additional beverages.I always feel rushed when eating here. So why so many waiters? The lousy service is contributing to poor dining experience. Here's a tip: lower your expectations and you'll be fine.

Author: BadServis123
Title: First & Last Time!
Review: Just to put on record our very disappointing first visit to Naughty Nuri's at ss15, subang jaya. We were there for lunch end feb 2020..There was a 50 % promotion during lunch. We ordered 1 ayam bertutu,1 mee goreng, 1 hot water.Ours grouses are:1. Ayam bertutu was not fresh-the chicken was obviously refried - hard, stringy,tasteless. The accompanying sauces smells & taste 'basi'( ie smells & taste like they're beginning to turn bad-never touch it.The only edible item was the rice.2. My companion's mee goreng was, to quote her: " tastes terrible,noodles taste like it was soaked in water!"3. the hot water which came in a kopitiam -size cup( minus the saucer) ,cost Rm2.00. Yes, I was told it will cost RM2 but I expected the quantity to justify the price!Of course we gave this feedback to the waiter who came to clear our table but when we paid the bill (3 items ) it amounted to RM33.05-imagine if there was no 50% discount the bill would have been a whopping Rm60 plus tax! for 2 persons. What galled us was there was no apology from anyone for the shoddy food! So, Be Warned! Definitely First & Last time to this place for us.We attach actual pics of two dishes we ordered, the bill .We forgot to take a pic of cup;sample pic found was too small to post here..but cup was definitely small!

Author: Sogen LJohor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
Title: We will never go again...
Review: Our first and last visit is around 10 persons family member. Though we relocated in different country, we use to have re-union dinner every year.For the service, we don't really care as we got things to catch up after a year. But it will be POOR if you ask me. Since there are many customer for them to take care...etcThe food is really bad, almost nothing is consider a "GOOD". For the quality I can only say is BAD.For the Value, I would say "Five star price with no star food".Though, the atmosphere is quite good when you feel lonely. Very crowded.I might not even care to review this restaurant if Tripadvisor not keep sending email to ask me for it.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: Taylor NHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Good food
Review: Prego stands out as the best food choice at the Westin Kuala Lumpur.The service is excellent and the waiter very attentive to your needs. The food is pretty good it remains however a typical Italian menu. Love the open kitchen concept and the decor is unique as well. The pizzas from their wood fired oven are excellent if you like the thin crust variety.Average prices. Highly recommended.

Author: monicaj995Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Amaaaaaaazing!!!!
Review: We ate here last Friday, our last night in Langkawi after a local western guy we'd been talking to the night before recommended it to us. We wanted western food as we actually live in Thailand and often crave real western grub!! And that's exactly what we got, the food was delicious and the portions were large! We got a side of potato salad to share which was a hue bowl! We had to take it home as our own dishes were enough, we didn't need it really but we had read about how good it was, and yes it was! We ended up having it the next day for breakfast with freshly cooked roti's, it was random, but delicious! The place is lovely, a little hard to find, but if you look it up/ring or ask around you will find it. It's a gem!! Ambience is lovely, it has a huuuuuuuge shelf full of books you can read ad the staff and owners are really friendly too!! No doubt if you are western or just anyone that loves western food, it is a MUST!! I wanted so much from the menu! Hats off to the staff there, they're all fab and the food speaks for itself :) I didn't take a picture of my fisherman a pie as I just wanted to dive in, but check out the Ozzie burger my boyfriend got! It was HUGE!

Author: Klaravantr
Title: Exelent food !
Review: We spend in Kuching 3nights and twice went to eat here. There is a Small kitchen for a big restaurant...so there's longer waiting time to be served. The food is absolutely amazing! Recommend!

Author: lewisreviews
Title: Nobu is great wherever you go!
Review: Great service, great food and attentive wait staff, you can't fault Nobu. The view from Tower 3 is also incredible, making the meal that bit more memorable than dining experiences in Nobu elsewhere. We went over sunset and it was beautiful.

Author: DRANDYSydney, Australia
Title: Below expectation
Review: Thought this might be one of the best bakeries in Malaysia, especially when it was advertised earlier that it was owned by one of the former Prime Ministers!But was utterly disappointed!Pricey! It certainly is.But the products is not as good as some of the similar bakeries in town, especially the one under some Swiss brand.Certainly someone rich like a former Prime Minister could afford this place on a regular basis!

Author: regis4187
Title: Cash only!!!! Unbelievable in 2020
Review:
Don’t go there if you want to use your credit card. One of the rare cash only place left in Asia. 
Food quality is the same as the neighboring restaurants.

Author: nikil67
Title: Mini size sashimi
Review: ..the kitchen staffs are up to no good. It's a total disgraced of japanese standards / hospitality...

Author: lizziem27
Title: Great Local Experience
Review: Busy atmosphere, friendly staff and awesome seafood. Cheap n cheerful place to eat and enjoy the best fresh seafood in Langkawi. It started raining halfway through dinner and they whisked us to another undercover table smoothly. Try the ABC sauce in your  fried rice!

Author: debgodsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very Busy and tables not cleared
Review: We stayed at Traders hotel in a club room over new years but decided to have breakfast at Gobo Chit Chat as more variety.The restaurant was really busy and difficult to find a seat, breakfast is buffet style and no table service, tables were rarely cleared of dishes until we left. Coffee machines did not seem to work. Good choice of food available.

Author: cc_KL
Title: Awful
Review: This place just does not do it for me -- the food is poor and the service is terrible. I refuse to give this place my custom any more.

Author: JamesC373Mount Claremont, Australia
Title: Dashed high expectations
Review: Quick lunch was about $70 for 2. The bill was not itemized so it's difficult to check whether it was correct. The roast duck was drenched in a sweet sauce which had the faint aroma of ginseng. The skin may have been crispy originally but by the time we ate it, the skin was soggy from the sauce. The sauce was very sweet.The char siew or barbecued pork was nice and charred at the edges but unfortunately was also drenched in a sticky sweet sauce so it was no longer crispy.However, the service was quick and efficient. And the air conditioning kept us cool in spite of the sweltering heat outdoors.

Author: Theakk
Title: Bad beer
Review: Ordered two carlsberg beers, they were most likely watered out. Tasted really bad. The music was too loud to have a conversation. The bathroom was really gross.

Author: NoReservations5
Title: OverPrice
Review: Waiter/waitress are very slow in allocating seats to the customers, not so friendly staff, pre cooked local food (cheap ingredient) but charging 5 stars (quality + quantity) price, I would say this place is not worth visiting. Food is not freshly prepared, mostly precooked food, the dishes are cold when served on the table, totally dissapointed !!!

Author: cestnataliaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork lover heaven
Review: Great food, huge portion and superb service. Everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly, very satisfyig meal.

Author: acline2771
Title: Wonderful meal with great hosts and staff
Review:
We were warmly welcomed into SALUD and it set the tone for a wonderful experience.  The service was the best we experienced in Melaka and the food was delicious.  Many of the tapas portions were larger than expected.  
Don't miss this gem of a restaurant.

Author: Peppau
Title: Good coffee
Review: In a corner of Jonker Wall.Cold bier and nyonya cuisine.Very good coffee.It is such a nice place on the terrace as in the interior.

Author: RoadRisesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High end venue with great views and food to match
Review: Been here for a couple of dinners having heard about the place at Opium (also part of the group).Staff are very attentive and service levels are far superior to what is available elsewhere in the same street - though, to be fair, this is by no means a typical Changkat establishment.Menu choice is limited and if you don't eat seafood, you probably shouldn't have come, but the food is superb if a bit on the higher end of the price scale and smaller end of the portion sizes as in many fine dining places.Good wine selection, again, not on the cheap end of the scaleWould recommend for a night with somebody special, or business meal

Author: Karti IGurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: Some of the best sea food that I have ever had.
Review: Loved this restaurant. Great decor and wonderful ambience despite its basement setting in the Starhill Mall. I had a roasted cod with vegetables - the cod was so fresh it melted in my mouth and the flavours were wonderful. My husband had stir fried prawns with asian condiments - also great.

Author: LovDac
Title: Drinks at the Danna
Review:
A lovely room to end a night with great music. Great singer Azlin just melts you as she sings your night away. 
Drink staff are friendly. Great place to relax

Author: Asian65Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Think again about this terrible shop
Review: Food was mediocre and most noticeable were the rude and unpleasant staff. Most of them have no customer service and did not even allow us to order our preference. Prices are crazy high and a total rip off to the customers. Prices for a simple meal came up to RM130 which is restaurant prices. Smoking staff unhegenic toilets added to the terrible experience in top of tourist rip off pricing. Totally avoid going here. And the uncle in a cap behaves like he is the only shop in town. Smokes and total disregard for hygiene.

Author: RenukaMalaysia
Title: Expensive Vegie
Review: Great food and atmosphere but be prepared to pay a lot! If feeling nostalgic of Indian food, here's the place to be.

Author: Adzmir AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not an ounce of value for money at all
Review: Who's the owner of this place??? Please make sure you serve your clients with food that is worth the money.This is one of the few restaurants in KL where I came back feeling so cheated. Malu!Went for dinner to celebrate a friends engagement. The description on the menu looked good. So we ordered mixed grill, grilled mushroom, pesto pasta and duck man tou.The mixed grill was pathetic. 2 small skewers, a prawn which looked sad and a huge portion of garlic rice lumped on one plate.The only saving grace was the duck. Tasty but tiny. Ehhh please serve your clients good food ok. If not just close your restaurant. Interior looks nice but defeat the purpose of going to eat.

Author: melyam525Malaysia
Title: So so food
Review: It’s my 4th visit already to this restaurant. I was very disappointed with the squid ink risottos that I had today. It used to be very rich in flavor and was also my favorite dish. However today when it came I already felt something was amiss when I saw that the gravy was a bit watery. The Baramudi fish that we had was also so so only.

Author: Steve HUnited Kingdom
Title: second visit not so good
Review: Visted this place 2 years ago with friends and had a brilliant night, sadly revisited for New Years Eve 2015 and although the bar still loooks good and has had some refurbishment to create a better outdoor seating area, the night was let down by the DJ playing what he likes and not looking at his audiance. Ok I am not a young guy but on our last visit the place was packed and the DJ at the time really played to his audiance and got customers up and dancing. Our latest visit was not good with a New Year buffet which was questionable at best and very few customers willing to dance to a DJ who should have been playing in a club not a New Year celebration. We danced but very few others braved the dance floor until midnight and then sat down quickly and efforts by the staff to get more up were not successful. Can only assume that the bar owner is trying to attract a younger crowd but we spend very good money on multiple bottles of champagne hoping that the DJ will change the music, sadly not and will not revisit, will try one of the other brances.

Author: dineshbabu25Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yen Restaurant
Review: The Dimsum did not live up my expectation . The flavours were bland , nothing to rave about and we were charged a premium price for a very poor quality food . I would have expected a better quality of of food and flavoursome meal for the premium price charged but we left the restaurant disappointed

Author: Melgary918Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food is here
Review: The food here is very recommendable. I loved their Mighty Piggy Burger and their new on the burger list, Emperor. Other main course is equally good too. The only menu that I don't really like is their Roast Pork. Definitely a no no for me. The service in this place was pretty bad but they seems to improve a lot now. Price : Expect to pay around RM50 per head, including drinks and dessert.

Author: 66giraffe72Melbourne, Australia
Title: Dim Sum ok, service poor
Review: We visited this restaurant for their dim sum buffet on a Sunday lunch before it got busy. There was good selection of fried and steamed dim sum, all quite tasty without being memorable. But what let the restaurant down was the lack of service. After the showy welcome tea from the long spouted can, our cups were no longer filled without prompting, plates and baskets weren't cleared, and orders took a long time to arrive. There was unfortunately none of the attentive service you'd expect from a pricey hotel restaurant, or at least the quick and efficient service of plainer dim sum restaurants. Can think of better ways to spend 800 ringgits for 8 pax. To top it off, the air conditioning was turned off at 2pm to hasten our departure. Give this place a miss.

Author: zzmelayuSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Surprisingly good
Review: First time at JBNC and it was surprisingly pleasant. 7 pax. 3 orders of their much-talked about soft-crab burger, big daddy pizza, summer salad, salmon, olio seafood, seafood soup. All except pizza tasted above average ... but the soft-shelled crab burger was exquisite. We are regulars at Serai (founder of jibby is exec chef at serai ... see my review on serai). All the negative things did not happened to us. Service was prompt, food tasted good. We will definitely come again. We went over to Tours le Jours for dessert same night

Author: WanderingGourmandHanoi, Vietnam
Title: excellent steaks spoiled by mediocre service and a hot & stuffy dining room
Review: Food: high quality beef, in particular the OP Rib and grass fed rib-eye..steaks were cooked perfectly with the exception of the burgers..absolutely no excuse for a steakhouse to cook frozen patties..every burger was cooked well-done, even when ordered medium rareService: the Middle Eastern waiter was courtesy personified and tried his best..the restaurant was woefully understaffed, with just the 2 waiters..the other waiter, who unfortunately was serving us, was appalling..he seemed totally disinterested in actually serving us..when asked why the burgers were so overcooked, he just looked at us and said "they're cooked from frozen"..he didn't seem at all inclined to offer a replacement until we asked..to no avail though, as the replacement burger was equally over cookedI have to make special mention of the roast garlic jus, which was really excellent.. flavour-packed..

Author: CKY281
Title: Over the hill
Review: My family have been regulars for many years and had celebrated many milestone events. However, consistency and quality has recently been a bit erratic with a downtrend pattern. This restaurant is still very popular given its long history of satisfied customers. The char siu (bbq pork ) and siew yoke(crispy roast pork ) are the two signature dishes but the quality do vary a lot. On our most recent visit we ordered a combination of both meats but were informed half an hour later than crispy roast pork had been sold out. However, we saw the lady manager taking all of the displayed crispy roast pork in a plastic bag from the meat counter towards the cashier and handing over. It is my firm belief that someone had been given unfair preference to have the crispy roast pork instead of my family. This is most unprofessional conduct for a restaurant with such a strong following. We accepted a recommendation from our server to order steamed free range chicken with black truffle which was good but not outstanding. The price for half chicken was RM 80,which is expensive. Another reviewer had posted that he was charged RM 148 for a whole chicken with wood ear fungus (same dish as we had ) which wasn't good. The bbq pork may be considered good but certainly no where near the best in KL. Steamed whole fish tends to be slightly overdone for the bigger fishes. Stir fried Chinese vegetables are generally good but too often customers are informed that the ordered veg has been sold out after a lapse of time which again raises suspicion of queue jumping. Service standard is considered satisfactory but generally indifferent. The interior design is aged and renovation is overdue. Prices are fairly reasonable unless special dishes (with truffle, exotic live fishes ) are ordered without careful enquiry of the price.

Author: RosiePerth123Dundee, United Kingdom
Title: Food excellent....service not so much......
Review: The food we were served was excellent but our enjoyment was spoiled by the manner in which it was served...half way through our Soups the main course was served....there wasnt enough room on the table for the dishes....we asked the waiter to take them away as we werent ready but this meant we had to rush our appetiser....when the main dishes were returned they were cold and one member of our party was still waiting on his appetiser....we asked for it 3 times and told it was coming....well it never did but it was on the bill.......once the main meal was served we were never offered more rice...never asked if everything was ok or did we need anything.....the price is above average so you would expect the service to be commensurate......dont think we will return for some time and hope service improves.....but sadly this seems to be the way of things in KL....poor service seems to be the norm and acceptable and they have the cheek to make a service charge......

Author: Capt_BolaKuala Lumpur
Title: Good Food But Gets Noisy
Review: Tried this place after reading the good reviews. Its a vegetarian restaurant with a wide selection. We tried the dhal, brinjal, paneer tikka and paratas. The food was good, especially the paratas, and value for money but it got very noisy with badly behaved kids. So if you want a quiet place for dinner, this is not it. It's a pretty basic place and service was good. The manager came around a few times to ask if everythign was ok. 99% of the customers were Indian expats. Parking is easy as it is not in the main Jalan Maarof area, rather the adjacent lane. We may do a take-away the next time.

Author: _ilafev
Title: Great Middle Eastern Restaurant in Shah Alam
Review: Food tastes good, great for family & friends gathering. A bit costly compared to other similar restaurants. In overall still great restaurant to visit once in a while.
Restaurant: Zam Zam Arabic Restaurant & Grand Ballroom

Author: cliffong
Title: Food and Drink are average
Review:
The environment quite nice, afternoon will feel quite hot. 
The only food in this Cafe is Laksa. The Laksa is too sweet. Feel dissappointed

Author: BrvergTaiping, Malaysia
Title: Poor Customer Service
Review: As we of walked in, hoping to try lunch here, the restaurant operator greeted us with a "sorry we are full", eventhough we noticed a large round table empty without the reservation signage on it. It looked like he prefers to accommodate the bigger crowd, for bigger profit. We left dissapounted. We will never reccomended this place to our family and friends.

Author: Bobby E
Title: All the local food.
Review: Visit the place twice weekly. Quite pack and many Singaporean as they stayed  nearby without breakfast. The price here is on the very high side as the rental is high too. So are the drinks.

Author: Philip WKoh Tao, Thailand
Title: Great bar & restaurant
Review: Im a German traveling for a year and it is really incredible to see a restaurant like this in the middle of Kuala Lumpur. On the wall there are paintings of the old german town Bamberg and the beer tastes like home (off course a little different). Amazing restaurant, we enjoyed the delicious sauerkraut and the Erdinger weißbier!

Author: 778ahmedb
Title: One of the best Indian Taste
Review: This is probably the fifth time I eat at this restaurant.  Food is the best in town.  Environment is nice and suitable for family.  Staff are friendly and helpful.

Author: ecossegeo
Title: Frecsa Avenue K.
Review:
Mediocre mediocre mediocre

Very slow and poor service.
Food was no big deal.
Portions were small.
Price was big for what we got.

Give this place a miss. Very mediocre.

Author: Reviewer6868
Title: Chat siew at its best
Review: Our usual weekend group of 6 people check out this joint , mixed reviews of course : what was ordered : char siew / siew Yok / chicken and vege (can't recall the name of the vege though, Char siew - 2 found a bit oily - the rest didn't agree but it's good n needs to be oily Siew Yok - good and skin is crispy Rice was just as good Overall a good meal- n fast service although the restaurant was nearly full . We will come back and try their steam soup and pork leg - Good overall

Author: ScorchedSun
Title: Overrated chicken chop
Review: Chicken chop not very tasty, nothing special, sauce no depth just a simple brown sauce. just a slightly bigger portion of chicken chop serve with extra garnish.

Author: hudsonw407
Title: Fantastic steak - Sub standard service but it is KL!!
Review: Came in a group of 4. They serve 1-1.5kg Tomahawks cooked with the bone. Served medium rare it is definitely one of the TOP 3 steak houses in Kuala Lumpur. You can't compared Ril's to Wolfgang Puck Nor Mortons but for the price, we feel it is not only better value but it s damm close. Service is disappointing but the staff aren't trained to a high class restaurant standard but we can't expect much for Malaysian standard given what's been going on !! I definitely come back again and again for the food! Expect to spend 150 Ringgit Malaysia per person/steak ( 35 USD ). We paid 500 for the 1.4kg tomahawk which was well worth it !!

Author: crazygweiloPetaling Jjaya
Title: Its now closed
Review: Well, Stephanie, Rico and the team did a great job for the past decade, but I got news, and its not good.Sic transit gloria mundiae. All good things must come to an end. And so, like many other venues in Kuala Lumpur, the Ceylon Bar calls last orders.BUT - to get the same 'sense', the same 'feel', a lot of the regulars that patronised the Ceylon Bar have moved to the Green Man. Which has a similar concept/psyche. Though there will never be another Ceylon.

Author: szesze2018
Title: Excellent suckling pig
Review: Go to El cerdo every time we visit Kuala Lumpur.  Love suckling pig and desserts so much. Very good service.  Particularly Jayson and Isza are very friendly.

Author: architectBCNBarcelona, Spain
Title: First meal in Asia!
Review: Our first day in Asia and our first meal there. We went there after leaving our things at the hotel and following some traveller suggestions, and it's a great place!Nice people serving good meals. I strongly suggest to try their asam laksa, it's the perfect place to start discovering the malaysian food.There are also a lot photos and information on the walls about the old chinese immigrants in Malaysia. Lovely place!

Author: karen pKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Loved this unique joint - Delicious Food and Affordable
Review: Everything about this place was interesting. From decor to menu and food....your mouth is watering just from looking at the menu. Greedy us ordered too much. Eyes were bigger than stomach. Inspite of ordering a lot of food - price did not break our wallets. Good experience and will certainly be back when I'm next in Malaysia.

Author: ChrisPiBaconAustralia
Title: Never go again!!!
Review: I reserved before Visit to restaurant. But staffs couldn't find my name on there reservation book... And they gave me a terrible seats... It was just in front of the toilet...and I ate a chicken rendang... It was terrible too....too much dried chicken and also was cold....(but the plate was not bad)Staffs doesn't care about me and my lady...I would never visit again!!!!

Author: ambiga tPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Alternative place to eat chicken rice balls
Review: We went there after tryin Chung Wa's chicken rice balls. The rice balls were bigger and taste ok. The chickens were tender and easy to chew. The rice balls only cost MYR0.20 per ball and its not too small. The cabbage is not highly recommended because there was nothing special about but do order if u want to add vegetables to your rice. However, during weekends they serve normal chicken rice with rice balls. Price was MYR16 including drinks. Try going after 4pm to avoid the queue.

Author: Christeene818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love Alexis'...not cheap but well worth the bit extra for great food
Review: I have dined at Alexis at Mid Valley a number of times and am always impressed with the food. Had their roasted chicken sandwich with sundried tomatoes & arugula which was so tasty and came with crispy twisted french fries. My husband's favourite is the chicken & prawn laksa and orders it each time we dine there. Serving sizes are quite generous and definitely in line with the prices. They also have yummy cakes and decafienated coffee. If you think ahead, try and book one of their booths as they have very comfy upholstered seating....most popular area. If you are feeling like a real drink, they have a bar area and a good selection of wines. Alexis has a great feel - light & contemporary. Service is very good and you don't have to wait long for your meal. Can't wait to go back.

Author: Yi C
Title: Courteous Waitresses
Review: I must say how friendly the waitresses were. They stood attentively and said good bye when we left. The food was good...

Author: kopibingyummy
Title: Rip-off
Review: Be careful to read each items in your receipt. Price in receipt is different from the price in the menu. Many people do not aware of what is being charged and just pay the total sum asked. Rip-off from the small details of the food ordered.I ordered broccoli with mushroom: price written on the menu is RM12, but was charged RM25! When I asked the cashier why I was charged RM25 instead of RM12 shown in menu, they just simply answer that the price has increased. Ridiculous! Increase from RM12 to RM25! Very stingy in putting ingredients. The sea cucumber, fish maw and mushroom in the soup are cut into very small piece.

Author: Arief F
Title: Good Food/ Ambience hampered by a very rude manager
Review: Was there for lunch earlier today as part of a business trip where we were provided with transport and refreshments. Most of us went in with a half opened mineral water bottle. All of us understood that there is a no outside food/ drinks policy (which is common with many eateries around town) but we brought in our stuffs (bag/ folders etc) as the transport dropped us off at the restaurant. None us drank from our water bottles and even we ordered loads of Acqua Panna as everyone was thirsty. The manager made a fuss with one of the waitresses (and this is after bottles of Acqua Panna were already ordered and served). On my way out to the main entrance for a cigarette, I told the manager that we understand of the policy and will not drink the bottled water we brought in and even suggested that they can even take them away or throw them away. I then continued to proceed to the main entrance with another friend. Upon lighting our cigarette, the obviously unhappy manager came out and confronted us wanting to explain their policy. I then told him that we already understand the policy and suggested they throw away the bottled water. He then proceeded to say that I was rude and even as a paying customer we don’t have to be rude. This got me really puzzled. I just told him that it was rude of him to interrupt my chit chat with my friend over our stick of cigarette without even saying “excuse me”. I politely requested that the two of us be left alone to enjoy our cigarette and to continue with our chat at which point the manager got agitated and raised his voice trying to explain the damn policy again. He denied he was rude and instead told me that I was the one who is rude even after I apologized to him. Its really weird. Don’t know where this manager is from (obviously not a local) but I suppose their definition of “being rude” and “rudeness” is very different where he came from.Very unfortunate. Good food, good ambience and even excellent service from the working staffs but the actions of the manager left a lot to be desired. There are loads of other Italian joints in Kuala Lumpur…

Author: Kelvin LMalaysia
Title: Poor poor service
Review: Went to Shang palace on a sunday afternoon for tim sum lunch. Arrived at 12pm, and place was half full with patrons. Waiters were either too inattentive or too busy, couldn't flag them down to get our orders. For the price you're paying for the food, you would expect service to be better.

Author: Shwu Ling L
Title: Overated food and bad experience
Review: We went there in a group of 4,since it's a must for everyone to have a four courses set, we managed to try most of the dishes.The atmosphere is classy and clean however, i think the food is overated.I had a very unpleasent experience that night and i think i would never go back or recommend this restaurant to any of my friend. We found the chicken was not fully cooked as the meat cannot be teared off and it looked a little reddish inner. My intention was just to let the chef know and not to change the dish or whatsoever but the white haired lady took the plate to kitchen and then came out again talked to me in a very bad tone to let us know that how much time they comsumed to prepare the food and how long they had cooked it and it's how impossible that the chicken is not fully cooked and etc, till a week later i can still remember her arrogant face. I was really offended by what she said,i doesn't mind to pay for a uncooked pricey meal but not talking to me in a way that she did. The staffs there are good and polite except the white haired lady.

Author: BackPacker747618
Title: A letdown - Not worth the price
Review: For the Kampachi brand name and the prices they charge- this one was a clear letdown. Ive been here several visits- all business lunches and not one visit was pleasant. They missed out my meal (twice)- I was served only after all the others on my table were finished. Also, the wait staff are unable to explain anything much on the menu. I asked what's the difference between ordering the Gindara set vs Gindara and they could not explain to me properly. Unfortunately, I ended up ordering the wrong thing - I wished it could have been explained and I ended up with a really small miserable piece of fish. The staff there look fed up and impatient- and its quite clear that they sorely lack training. When we asked for refills of green tea we often got long sour faces. The food itself was either average or below average- some dishes were cold and not at the usual standard Im used to at Kampachi. Avoid this outlet at all costs... its really not worth it

Author: IsaacGoh90Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Luscious Food in joyous dining environment
Review: We went to the newly open branch in Atria Mall because we had the RM 50 voucher which they distributed before its opening. It was Friday's night, the place was fully occupied. But they did a very good job, I was asked to leave my contacts in the waiting list and they called me when it was my turn to have the next available dining table, it was superb convenient since we could walk around the mall while waiting for the seats.We ordered the Signature Grill (the most recommended grilled ribs with their special sauce) Wah Tusuk Babi (char grilled pork belly), Nasi Goreng ( Indonesian styled fried rice) and BBQ Satay Lilit (pork kebab skewered using lemongrass).
