They served the food in real quick manner, although it was superb packed, but we could get all our orders served after 10min we had ordered them.The environment was joyous, but it might be little rackety for someone who prefers serene dining way. They had dancing, birthday cheer for the birthday boy or girl, loud music, well, sometime we couldn't even do chatting because the music was too loud, but we relished it.

Author: ErikW1787
Title: Antrian nya cukup melelahkan
Review: Cheese prawn beehoonNot too strong taste of cheese. Very big prawn.Cheese prawn beehoon is quite popular menu in malacca and this restaurant is quite popular. U can see from the queue to get the table. Waiting list is about 30min-1.5 hourScore 9/10Sweet vinegar gui hua fishVery crispy yet tender inside. The sauce is perfect, taste like sweet and sour dish but better. Very good dish and awsome display. The meat is cutted but still intact with the skin.Score 9/10Suggestion for the restaurant, please provide chair for the queue

Author: Jatinder KKurukshetra, India
Title: Delicious Asian food with views of Twin towers
Review: The curry house is situated very close to twin towers, just next to the public bank building. It provides a soul filling experience for dining with the enchanting views of Twin towers at night. A large number of food options at a very budget price. I opted for aloo Paratha with traditional dish of KL, Nasi Lemek (duck fried rice) and Teh tarik (tea) for a modest 10 MYR (200 INR). There is lot of space to sit in open and enjoy the view of Twin tower and the surrounding area. Service is fast.

Author: Soonkiat
Title: Delicous Banana leaf rice
Review: Vegetarian set is delicous, we also ordered masala lamb, sambal fish and fried sotong. Teh Tarik is very thick and nice too

Author: PGMetali
Title: Quality of food
Review: having dinner here with family dinner 8th Nov @2000hrs., this is my 4th times here, a good place to have seafood shell out. However this trip they are serving uncooked rice. The waiters and waitress making a lot of noise joking at the back loudly, playing music very loud in the kitchen, very annoying. They must keep the quality of food and all staffs must respect guests in the restaurant. I only give 3 star is only that I enjoy the shellout sambal. Very disappointed.

Author: pak_sowme
Title: Fresh dim sum
Review:
What's good:
- Yummy fresh dim sum
- 80s dim sim tea house atmosphere
- Reasonably priced

What can be better:
- The carrot cake dish
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Dyhshs
Title: Must come
Review: Lovely view and a great vibe. The service is very quick. Sohag was very lovely too. We order food, drinks & Shisha

Author: MissyJLQY
Title: Authentic Italian Food
Review: If you would like to taste some authentic Italian food, this is the place to be. Superb customer service!!! They split the soup for both of us. Even offer to put the leftover pizza in a container to bring home. Very comfortable place to dine in. The pizza is very crunchy. However would expect a stronger taste on the pizza. Will try a different type of pizza on our next visit! Overall, definitely a good experience dining in here

Author: Jumbo-KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but could do with a rotation of menu.
Review: The restaurant offers a wide variety of choices but we notice that the items for buffet dinner are always the same. Regulars like us may find this a bit boring after a few visits and would appreciate themed buffets every once in a while. Staples in the last few months are the Japanese section (my favourite with the lovely teppanyaki, sashimi and freshly made hand rolls), barbeque, Chinese, pasta and carving station, Indian, cold cuts & seafood, salads and desserts (the kids would love the variety of toppings on display for the ice cream). A wide selection of coffee and teas as well to finish off the meal (you need to ask or you will end up with regular coffee and tea). Pricing a bit on the high side but with Starwood Privilege card / vouchers, would be acceptable for the items offered.

Author: Bubblecat-USATarrytown, New York
Title: Sadly mediocre but with promise.
Review: The hotel is a little generic but clean and well situated for walking into the sights without being too close to the noisy night activities. Room was clean and modern but a little small and several things didn't work (tv, shower blind, safe). Dinner was excellent although the restaurant was close to entry but breakfast was appalling. Cold food limited choice and the bread and butter pudding sauce was off. I wish I could recommend but a good hotel is in the details and these need attention. Maybe our trip during CNY caught them at a bad time.

Author: BeamishGLuzon, Philippines
Title: All style and no substance
Review: Highly disappointing experience. The location and the view are stunning. The initial greeting was very friendly but the food......My starter was called Burrata Alla Moda. It was possibly the most unpleasant starter I have ever tried. Not only did it taste bad, it left an aftertaste for quite a few hours afterwards.The main course was Agnello Impanato. Essentially a breaded lamb cutlet with cheese, deep fried. A gimmick dish with a real hotchpotch of tastes which didn't work at all. The lamb was very much overcooked. The roasted beetroot was the only saving grace .Didn't bother with dessert although the free candy floss was amusing.....Service was pleasant generally

Author: 904RlaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to shout
Review: Have been to this place a couple of times. Off late prices have increased, you also need to BUY drinking water now. Despite charging 10% service charge, they don't even offer free water. Previously the fried banana fritters comes with quality mango ice cream; now you only get cheap quality vanilla ice cream. If you need to eat at KLCC, go to Chillis and you get better quality and prices.

Author: M_RashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great setting but food was ok!
Review: Wouldn't go to this restaurant unless visiting the birds in the park here. It is a good place to relax during a hot day of bird watching. The beer is cold and fries are hot. But the food was rather disappointing for the price of it. We ordered the Malaysian chicken curry, the two pieces of chicken in it were rather sad. Not too much meat in them and the gravy didn't taste well done. The other dish was rather ok, flat noodles with prawns.The ambiance is great, with the outside seating overlooking the park. But you can get better tasting food in this city. Most come here to eat when they're visiting the park

Author: ReginexyteoJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Service in slow motion
Review: Not much of staffs working during Raya, which we can fully understand. But we ordered egg tarts and wait for at least 45mins which is over our limit.So sad about that!

Author: Waddlerstrikesback
Title: Basic reasonable food
Review: Not haute cusine but good local food and good quick and pleasant service from a nice hostess. Reasonably priced.

Author: JoeeyingKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Good value for lunch :)
Review: Enjoyed the tempura soba noodles. With the current set lunch promotion (buy 2 free 1). The free Saba fish set lunch as well!

Author: saidatuljKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to hangout and
Review: Nice place to hangout and the food is nice . The place is just beside KLCC and people recommend to try the sisah. The manager also so friendly and give us a nice place to set

Author: Zara RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Family Dinner
Review: We really enjoyed our family time at this outlet. The foods are great and Mr. Dan entertained us with his very good manner. Will definitely visit here again!Xx

Author: mimamason
Title: Kuching waterfront eatery
Review: The fusion  menu with local flavour  that use the locally produce black pepper was my favourite. Try the fish fillet with their special  sauce. It is a relaxing place to chill out  and have a veiw the sarawak river.

Author: nellielim
Title: Corner coffee shop
Review: A nice place for breakfast Malaysian style, roti canai, tosai, teh tarik, etc. Nice location, clean and packed with patrons. The food is good and cheap and service fast and efficient.

Author: emahsieh
Title: A place just for having a look
Review: We came to here because of introduction on the travel book.  This building is famous for its history.  Unfortunately the service and beverage were not as good as its great history.  We were disappointed.

Author: chang s
Title: It can be better
Review: The quality of the food can be improve. Affordable price. Great view. Good place to hang out with friend.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: siralabuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not That Bad
Review: Having this for Mak's birthday. The seafood is fresh and the Ombak Cajun Signature sauce was so yummeh. We also tried the buttermilk sauce but it tasted just so-so.However, their #pakaitanganjer is so catchy and I kinda like it. Aha, another room for improvement, you may need to add more lightings. It is important in order to get a pretty photo while you are eating with a perfect lighting, lol. . .I can't comment much on the food since am not a seafood lover. I just ate corn, few prawns and sotong. No ketam, no lobsters and etc.In term of food selection : Pretty limited and most of it unavailable (side dish) and for the seafood, 4 combo set available with the price ranging from RM150++(2 pax) to RM439++(4-5 pax), before any add-on. You may opted for 4 type of sauces.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: can’t pass the mark pork free Chinese food
Review: has not changed since my last visit to Yen about a year ago? food is still subpar... for the price they charge they are not giving enough. charged lobster price but gave prawn. worst lomaikai might as well get it from family mart? really might as well just go to li yen where dimsum is way more authentic. plenty of other porkfree choices in town to go for as well.service was also subpar this time around, as compared to my previous visit for dinner.got a discount as a platinum elite member but even after the discount I couldn’t see the value in dining here...

Author: Michael CL Y
Title: Speechless
Review: This review is actually about the one in 1 Utama. We arrived there when there was no queue. Nobody set out to meet us. The staff were all chatting in the corner. When we were finally sat down, I found an opened wet tissue packet. The quality was horrific. The amaebi (sweet prawns) were dry and the colour was off. Same with the surf clams. We called one of the staff over and explained our problem. He didn't speak English so we called the manager. He said that he would replace the unfresh sushi. When he returned, the quality was still the same. So when we told the manager that it was the same, he argued. He said that it had always been that way.Such great customer service. We ended up paying USD$45++. It was one of my worst experiences.

Author: spark41
Title: What happened?
Review: We went on a quiet Tuesday evening. No steaks available. Much arabic food on offer. Apart from a very service-minded Philippino the rest of the staff were poor as was the food in general.

Author: Johnsonloh
Title: With family dinner
Review: Tonight I was been lai po heen dinner with my family , I was enjoy it for tonight dinner and service very good... especially restaurant manager Jane very kindly and professional serve to our family ... another side food was delicious I think I will come again to visit again

Author: icequeen732017Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Going downhill....
Review: Very disappointed! Been here a number of times and the service has slowly gotten worse. Non busy time so no excuse. Staff seemed annoyed that I wanted a booth and was dining alone meaning they had to clear the other places. Ordered a salad that was so drenched in dressing I might as well of had a greasy burger. Never once came by to ask how meal was and then I finally had to get up and go to find staff to pay the bill. What happened KL Hardrock?! Won't be going back.

Author: jah1993
Title: Dissapointing food
Review: Quite a nice atmosphere but food was really dull and lacked flavour. Dissapointing considering the price, you can get a much tastier meal for less around the city.

Author: DinasPutra
Title: The original Ayam Penyet place.
Review: Good Indonesian food specialty in Ayam Penyet or Smashed Fried Chicken. Tasted almost like the original one cooked in Indonesia.

Author: Edster88Melbourne, Australia
Title: Food street in the heart of the Golden Triangle of KL
Review: You get everything here.... satay, noodles, seafood, BBQ chicken wings.Open till wee hours of the morning.Don't bring your passport when you come here just to be on the safe side.Be prepared to be slightly harassed by dark skinned beggars holding their young child to illicit pity. Also many hawkers trying to sell stuff to you as you eat.Just ignore them and they will move away. Alternative is to drop them Riggit $1.00 (approx. US$0.30) but then you risk other beggars coming to you if they see this.

Author: drazzahy2312Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: THE WORST HOTEL AFTERNOON-TEA EXPERIENCE EVER!
Review: We are a group of coworkers who organised a farewell party for our boss on the 15th of January at 230 pm in the Mandarin Oriental's Lounge on the Park.My colleague had made the reservation months in advance, and I arrived at the venue at 2.21 p.m. today (refer MySejahtera check-in). At the entrance, we were greeted by a Chinese lady who was lovely and inviting. I was amazed by the interior design as well.My companion and I were placed at the table for 8 people (on the left side of the lounge) (we were a group of 25 people.)The nightmares began as soon as we sat down.1-The cushions were sinking and sagging. It was unbearably unpleasant. I switched seats with all of my friends, and the cushions were all the same. And after sitting for a while, one of my friends, who has a slipped disc, developed pain.2-The staff begin taking orders. We ask about the tea with the lady with short hair who attends to our table (She wears nametag: Halimaton) and is served in a cup or a pot. She said it would serve in a pot, and she REPEATEDLY said that the pot could not be shared. We were stunned by her answer because we didn't ask whether or not we may share it. She speaks in an unpleasant tone as if she was mocking us. We already know, and we don't need to be reminded REPEATEDLY as if we're idiots. It was frustrating. She should be aware of the situation. She was speaking to an audience of adults, not children.3-Please keep in mind that we came at 2:20 p.m. And we didn't get the food until 4 p.m.! All other tables, including those who came after us, were already served. We spoke with the staff a few times. The lady staff (Hana and Nguyen) responds with the standard "I'll check" response. They haven't provided any updates. We were left hanging and starving in the corner of the lounge. When my friend spoke with the manager, Firdaus, he informed him that the sandwich bread had run out. This is entirely unacceptable, considering we had previously made a reservation. The crew should plan ahead of time and serve promptly. We might as well walk in because the walk-ins are served first!The staff are unprofessional.At 421 pm, All seven of us left the Mandarin Oriental Lounge by the Park hungry, disappointed, and frustrated.This is the worst hotel dining experience I've ever had.

Author: nurhudaazizSingapore, Singapore
Title: Could have done better
Review: I went to Chilli's at Suria KLCC. Waited for 2 hours before getting the seats. Extremely poor in managing its seatings. It closed off a section of the restaurant which I wasn't particularly sure why? That section could easily accommodate another 30 guests. The steak was disappointing. Certainly ain't the standard that Chilli's used to serve previously. An overrated dining place. You may consider checking out this place only if you have plenty of time and patience to spare.

Author: Shaun1995Singapore, Singapore
Title: Honestly Expected better
Review: The place looks a little run down. Stairs to the 2nd floor were a little creaky and unstable, feels like the steps might give way any moment. More imptly, the food was quite bland and dry. Seafood was not as fresh when we dug down to the prawns and mussels. Drinks were fine and great.

Author: Nirmala BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely dinner experience
Review: Went with our parents and the service was fantastic. Mr Ravi was a fantastic host, and he made our parents feel special. Food selection is vast and really delicious too! A good place for a big dinner with the family.

Author: shamugam
Title: Gd diner with drinks
Review: Gd place to take frens for a good meal n  drinks . Good ambience especially at evening. Lighting is cosy enough. Weekends live music.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Marcus C
Title: A unique experience with Lavish
Review: The atmosphere in this cafe is really great and the food is too good looking. Excellent for instagram and hangouts.

Author: Yee1124
Title: Sunway velocity.
Review: I went to 4 finger sunway velocity and waste almost 1 hours at there ...food is ok but service very slow and bad. manager treat customer without manner...

Author: Salil_077
Title: Lovely canopy
Review: Lovely place to hang out with friends.. here everyone like friends.. I never saw that before anywhere.. Shias food drink very good .service amazing. Thanks shawn

Author: LimchTraveler333
Title: Xmas lunch on 25 Dec 2018
Review: I have always rated the The Four Season Hotel ,highly but what Curate restaurant Offered on Christmas Day is a rip-off.A hotel of your reputation had such ordinary offerings. . Please go and check out,the Mandarin Oriental, Hyatt, Shangri La, Banyan Tree,Mariott; Majestic, Millenium, Westin,Hilton Sentral , Le meridian. For a new Hotel.you should have gone all out to impress.The food counters, Japanese : hopeless...the worst offerings n mediocre selection.Despite having a good Chinese restaurant, the noodles counter was not up to it, and the dim sum was limited . The advertised Rumali roti was missingAll in all ,the spread was controlled and contained. .Looks like a cost cutting event.Really embarrassing to have friends invited to this outlet.It was simply,a lousy buffet lunch.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: HappyCouple1998
Title: Not the best steak in town
Review: Starters and desert were excellent but unfortunately the quality of the steak was not great. The meat was overcooked and tough.

Author: telur1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst food ever
Review: I come with the understanding that the food is not bad, but it turn to be a waste of time. The food sucks, i dont understand how they can screw up order. Beside that the wonton soup is dire and the skin comes so easily thatbi am eating it meat filling than the whole thing. Service is crap, or should i say basically is none. My advise AVOID! BY ALL MEANS !

Author: bsoetjiptoJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Below average
Review: I was invited to have dinner here. My first impression was they were unorganized. I knew that my business partner had made a reservation yet they were confused which table(s) were good for us. Since I was the first one to arrive, I decided which table for us. I did not want to wait too long just for choosing the table(s). This was an all you-can-eat and do-it-yourself restaurant, but the quality of the foods were below average. It was like you could choose yet had nothing to choose. The service was also slow. It looked to me that they were short of waiters. Hence, my suggestion is please consider other place for dinner. Sorry.

Author: TonyCherryClevedon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, service and atmosphere
Review: Looking down recent reviews, people may think this is some sort of Bristol conspiracy, but we, like Basemess used the Lonely Planet and ended up here. My wife worked In Malaysia slightly longer ago than it would be gallant to mention and frankly, finding anything in KL to live up to her memories was making me a bit anxious. No need to have worried. Decor as described by previous reviewers. Service polite, efficient and helpful. Food authentic and high quality. Beef Rendang and Fish Head stew can both be thoroughly recommended. Portions generous to a fault. Will go again when back in KL later this week.

Author: Tony RDublin
Title: Excellent Italian in KL
Review: Prego is an excellent Italian-themed restaurant located as part of the Westin Hotel in KL. The pizzas, which are cooked in a wood-fired oven, are particularly good with a range of interesting variations, including a good vegetarian pizza. The restaurant is aware of gluten-free issues as well as it offers coeliac-friendly dishes. The wine list is OK in terms of variety - we found a nice Montepulciano for RM130 that satisfied everyone at the table. Service is good - not too hovering. Atmosphere is OK - nothing special here.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Great and unique ambiance but the food didn't meet my expectation.
Review: The ambiance is unique and traditional. But the food didn't meet my expectation. The Mee kolok is too pricy and the portion is way too small for the given price, and the ayam penyet is not as tasty as the ones they serve in town.

Author: NeerChan
Title: Amazing Chiraishi!
Review: My husband do enjoy their set meals as they are not only delicious, their portions are adequately prepared even for lunch. My favourite is the Chiraishi set, where various sashimis layered on a bowl of rice with sweetened sauce in it. They have fresh oysters too with good package price. It's situated on Jalan P. Ramlee, just left side of the traffic light before arriving at KLCC.

Author: KualaLumpurTabbykuala lumpur
Title: Good food, terrible service
Review: Went to the Ming Room for their dim sum lunch for the first time today. We had a table reservation for 1.30 but weren't seated until 1.45 and then no sign of any dim sum trolleys until 2pm. The food we had was very good but they had already run out of most things by then. We ordered a bottle of wine and also 3 glasses of iced water and repeatedly asked for them again several times over the space of about half an hour before they eventually informed us they were out of the wine we had ordered and asked us to choose another one. We decided not to bother as at this point it was 45 minutes after we had ordered and staff had already informed us it was time for last orders so we just left and got a drink elsewhere. The baffling thing is that there are a ridiculous number of staff on the floor - it's just that most of them were wondering around not doing anything helpful and looking like they didn't have a clue what was going on. Seems like terrible business sense as we would easily have doubled our table bill had we been able to order a bottle of wine and more food (both of which we wanted!).

Author: Chika1748
Title: Salsa Latin Night
Review: The best place for salsa and Afro night. Superb ladies night drink and shihsha was the best. Amazing song selection from the DJ.

Author: BellaliciousShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Price Victim
Review: Half of you palm of rice and 2 pcs of mutton (half than matches stick box), ribena lychee drink = RM11++. Scary... as a conclusion, me and colleagues never went there again. Waiter never smile - feel so awkward. Double thumbs down for the price and services.

Author: w951fb4Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin
Title: Cheap place with below average food
Review: Found this place close to our hotel via TripAdvisor. It is definitely on the lower end of the spectrum when it comes to the look and feel. It does have a full Indian menu. The food is edible. I had vegetable fried rice. It was too salty. My wife had a dosa and the sambar was cold. The biggest problem was that people were smoking inside. Go to this place if you really want Indian food and don’t have another option!

Author: bluactc
Title: Nando's alamanda
Review: the Menu book look like very nice and more foods but the sald not nice they not provide source for salad.

Author: greeklover
Title: no flavours
Review:
What a disappointment!!! Food was completely tasteless - lacked all the wonderful  spices you normally find in indian food. Such a shame because the setting in an old colonial villa is really charming.
Don't understand how they could have acheived so many winning awards.

Author: Tigett77Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: the secret is it ain't authentic
Review: if i would have to rate the food based on the authenticity of cajun food, i would have given just 1 star. We ordered 4 most signature cajun dishes, namely gumbo, etouffee, dirty rice, dan jambalaya. As the alumni of a university in louisiana, we really looked forward to bring back some good memories from the food of this restaurant. The result was totally disappointed. Out of the 4, only dirty rice met our expectation, the rest are disaster. Never the less, if the food tasting is to taste based on the food itself, they are not too bad. Also, good ambience.oh, lastly, Bubba Gump serves very good jambalaya

Author: kalleraunKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Malay food and good service
Review: Was the first time since the MCO has started at the Bijan. Glad to see that they still have the same good Malay food. Foe me personally one of the best Malay restaurants in KL. Also their service staff is very friendly and attentive. Love their terrace and it’s currently anyhow great and safe if you can dine alfresco. Will soon come again..

Author: MasterspyWest Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: It’s only a cafe and not a restaurant.
Review: Our travel agent put this establishment on their list of recommendations but despite its location in the heart of the busy Jonker Street the food and service was very disappointing. I had a chicken and cashew nut dish which had bits of chicken floating in some sort of liquid. Service was slow and the waiter managed to get everything wrong with our order. For those that like a 2nd rate noisy band and cheap meal this is this place to go but overall I would avoid.

Author: Free_Soul_WOLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Worst Place To Dine
Review: Food was tasteless, staff was rude, dirty and very unpleasant environment. As a Malaccan, I felt so embarassed to have picked this restaurant for my family who came from the UK. This is not an authentic Nyonya restaurant. Food was badly cooked. More like a street cafeteria. Not cheap either. Cost over RM200 for 5 people. Was asked to pay before even finish eating. Staff attitude was disgusting. AVOID

Author: Mohd Azhan I
Title: Great food. Poor service.
Review: This restaurant serves great thai food. I've always loved the food here. The fish dishes are my favourite. The king prawn tom yam is excellent. You can choose between clear soup or red tom yam soup. The red soup is quite hot.The prices are on the high side but still reasonable.The service however is getting worse especially during lunch time on weekdays when the place is full. Once, I had to wait for more than 1 hour for my fish. The restaurant then gave me some discount on the final bill.On my recent visit here, I ordered a few dishes including a fish. Other dishes came first and we started eating. We ordered additional drinks but had to enquire about it several times before the drinks finally arrived. Similarly for our fish. After asking about it several times, we were told that the fish was not on our order list. It was very disappointing. As we're already at the end of our meal, we cancelled the fish.The dessert was good and delivered in record time. I loved the the red water chest nut and jack fruit served in coconut. The mango with sticky red was not bad either.Overall, a great place if you love thai food. But plan to arrive early so that you don't have to wait long for your food.

Author: Rby25PERTHPerth, Australia
Title: Dining on the Beach
Review: This was our second visit to Casa del Mar(4yrs previously). The previous visit just to dine was excellent, a great choice of menu, highly recommended and lived up to all the reviews we had read on Trip Advisor...a great place for a special occasion.It was my husbands birthday ,so our first choice this year was Casa del Mar ..it was disappointing, a vast change to our previous visit..Firstly, it really isn't the place to have a special dinner...the tables are no longer on the premises of the hotel but all on the beach, with a boardwalk behind the tables!!!!! A constant stream of people all evening...so much for the romantic dinner!!!!!! Added to that is the noise from 4wd vehicles...and I'm sure no one really knows how to drive on sand as nearly everyone became bogged which led to the revving of the engine, digging theirselves deeper into the sand, and even louder noise and fumes!!!! It was a constant flow of people , noise and vehicles.....we could have been in Bali!!!! As for the menu there was hardly any choice for vegetarian dishes , and the fish portion my husband had was quite small. This menu was so disappointing.The service was good. considering the ratio of tables to waiters...but sad to say this Hotel/restaurant is just a time of change now as is Langkawi.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: andcsyKuching, Malaysia
Title: Slow and bad service
Review: Had fairly ok experiences there previously but had a family event there for CNY and the service was quite bad. Admittedly they were under-staffed but the boss could have taken our requests in a better way. He did not seem to care at all, and the air-conditioning was spoilt too. The portions were quite small for the rather exorbitant prices paid. Will not be returning until I hear of some improvements.

Author: Derrick T
Title: Nice environment, terrible customer service
Review: Visited with friends for birthday celebration, but we were there quite early before dinner time and quite full, thus decide to order some food or snack/ dessert for sharing. Just because of that, the waiter asked us to sit at the bar area. But we said we prefer to dine in proper dining table and the waiter walk away. During taking order, the waiter somehow make us feel that we are not welcome because 7 of us just order 4 dishes with a bottle of wine. He even "accidentally" pour the wine on table Food serving is fast, we even wonder if they just reheat the food.Spent around RM500 for a normal taste indochina cuisine with bad service. Will never return, doesn't worth it. P/S if you are tourist, they might treat you better. And bring mosquito repellent.

Author: CodeRiderWylie, Texas
Title: Buffet was slack luster
Review: Staying at Traders Hotel for a week and a half. So, thought I would give Gobo Chit-Chat a go this first night.They had a buffet that included many varieties of food, sushi, western and local.Much of what I tried was in the warm to luke warm side. I would have expected better temperature control for foods on a buffet.The waiter, even though he didn't really have much to do, was no where to be found when it came time for my bill. Thankfully, another waitress took care of that for me.All in all was was not really impressed, for a 140MR (about $42 US) tab I would have expected better quite frankly.

Author: LPMTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Dim Sum terrible service.
Review: This is a regular and typical Chinese restaurant and you can find similar options all over Kuala Lumpur.It is without a doubt a popular restaurant and it can at times be difficult to get a table. Why it's a popular restaurant is for me difficult to understand as the personnel and service is one of the worst I ever experienced.

Author: Wolv3rin3Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Street Hawker favorites in the mall
Review: Always a long lunch line by 12:00 noon, and place is packed. Not only patrons but the seating. In efforts to maximize numbers, you're practically rubbing shoulders with the next table, and back to back.Service poor, slow though waiting on table. Perhaps lack of training, or poor pay.Food at least has consistency form previous visits, great tasting local favorites like char kueh tiau, curry mee, prawn mee, nasi lemak etc. I love curry mee. However the nasi lemak fish, fish was rather small.

Author: Z6771UA_Magong, Penghu
Title: The best modern Malaysian cuisine in George Town
Review: Every dish is awesome! We came here twice in two days. Tried many starters, rice cuisine and noodle cuisine. Every dish is giving us a feeling of "wow".In addition, the manager is good Chinese speaker說中文, you can ask for recommendation.If you come to George Town, don't miss it.

Author: dunmetielBandar Puchong Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great lamb rack!
Review: I was here on a company dinner. There were about 17 of us, and we were given one long table at a cordoned-off corner of the restaurant. The layout and everything was nice, but the seats were positioned too close together due to the limited space, resulting in a very cramped situation for dining. The quality of the food more than made up for it, though. For starters, they served us wild mushroom soup and tomato bruschetta. The bruschetta was only so-so, but the soup was lovely. For main course, I had the rack of lamb and it was delicious!! Very soft, tender, juicy lamb with a side of roasted potato and vegetables. Honestly, I had thought that the portions would be very small considering the type of restaurant this is, but I was surprised to find that the portions were quite good and managed to make me full! My friends who had the Organic Barramundi also had only great things to say about it.Ambience of the restaurant was romantic. Because we came on a Monday evening, there was no crowd except us. Not so sure about weekends. It would have been nicer if the restaurant had a nicer view (if you sit outside, all you can see is the busy clubhouse foyer and carpark - not very nice at all). Service was great. The waiters were very attentive and cutlery was cleared very promptly. Food and drinks also did not take long to be served, everything was very fast and efficient and most importantly, friendly. Very very pleased with the service aspect.I will definitely come back to try more of the food!

Author: Manonfire51Santa Fe, New Mexico
Title: Blane food
Review: Sorry to say but this isn't Italian food at its best, Service was poor beer was warm. The food was really nothing close to Italian. For the price of the food from 1thru 10 it's a 1. Would have been better of stoping at Pizza Hut . Cheers.

Author: jameso315Singapore, Singapore
Title: Below par food quality, better go for hawker
Review: Visited this Chinese restaurant with my family (4 adults + 1 child) based on reasonable review rating posted on TripAdvisor. However, this shall be my last visit as the food quality went horribly wrong. The salad prawn taste was horrendous. The fried prawn was stale and tasteless and routinely coated with some mayonnaise perhaps to enhance the taste but failed miserably. To my dismay, we did ask for recommendation from the waitress and were told that a few prawn dishes like butter/cereal prawns as well as salad prawns were equally good. We had good reason to suspect that the prawns were from frozen supply which could explain for their poor quality. The other dishes were equally mediocre. The yam ring was overly soaked with watery chicken sauce that was filled within and as a result, its crispness was lost and left with a soggy feel. Worst yam ring I ever had in my lifetime. The oyster omelette served on a hot plate surprisingly contained tiny oysters with hardly any taste. This was despite charging us a special rate by weight due to our request for bigger presumably more succulent oysters. Overall, food quality was disappointing without doubt below our expectation. I suppose any decent hawker is able to easily surpass this expectation.

Author: shanjunyeo
Title: Good dinsum
Review: Delicious dimsum served in the Hong Kong way with lots of locals in the morning. It may seem hectic to westerners though.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: AfthabASri Lanka
Title: Worst steaks I've ever had!
Review: The service to the food, it's absolutely appalling!!Went for a family lunch and firstly had wait 15 mins for a bottle of mineral water, then it was just downhill from them on..Ordered the beef ribs, the New York steak and the Tennessee burger all three being their recommended dishes none of the items had any flavor in them. We could barely finish our meals, and the burger which was mentioned juicy was just plain stale bun and meat.If your planning to have good decent meal then avoid TGIF!To top it off the service is ridicules!The waiters run around asking for change!

Author: Fiona S
Title: Small portion
Review:
Reviews are amazing for this place but it’s quite overpriced for malaysia and offers small portion sizes ? 
Food was ok

Author: Deanne L
Title: Never again
Review: We went to the new restaurant at the KL Life Centre. Poor service, very average food, way too noisy. Will not go back again. They get a rating of 1 as they bundled left over food so we could give it to our dog.

Author: b0bnw8London, United Kingdom
Title: DC should try harder
Review: In outstanding gastronomical landscape in KL, every now and then a new restaurant appears offering "international cuisine"Quite formal, but impeccably elegant, and reasonably elegant, DC restaurant is a nice place to have your dinner with service that is second to none in a very pleasant atmosphere.Alas, what is delivered from the kitchen does not match the expectations and certainly does not deserve the price tag.We have been invited for a four course tasting meal with several additional dishes and while none of it was bad, it certainly dish after dish appeared to be uninspiring, semi-finished and disappointing. I see no reason for asparagus from a jar to find its way to a plate in what aspires to be a high class restaurant, do not understand that dish after dish the food was under-seasoned and lacked flavour, that there was no respect for terroir and local ingredients and that great ideas failed to materialise and turn into edible and memorable dishes. I am not sure we are going to give this restaurant another try, we certainly did not dislike what we've had, but in a city where good food is a standard, not an exception, you have to try much harder to impress the audience, no matter how a thick layer of pretence can pull wool over their eyes. For if pulling wool is what you are into, not even pulling cashmere will be of much help. Fine dining is not something you aspire to, it is something you accomplish or not.

Author: Michael_Teoh
Title: HALAL Chinese Kopitiam
Review: The place is really crowded during weekend . All the food here are Halal. Popular Prawn cheong fan and must try Roti telur goyang.

Author: khalidm878Leicester, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch Time Buffet
Review: The Views are amazing. Restaruant itself looks very stylish and modern. FOOD however was a let down for us. For the price we paid (Around £35 per head) it was poor. Really not worth it. The selection was not huge. Food was not to out liking either. BUT i'm guessing people go here for the attraction!

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Overrated
Review:
Food taste really bad and service was poor! 
The cheese meehoon tasted so bad!
Besides, it is Overpriced and unreasonable. 
The seafood weren't fresh as well :/ 

We won't be back again!

Author: Kaley K
Title: Visa fraud at Chili's!!
Review: 15$ meal and sprite (ate solo) but my Visa was charged over $100 US dollars, my visa was red flagged and cancelled while on vacation due to this frauded transaction! Customers beware!!! Do not use card here, as only explanation could be waiter adding 600% tip!!

Author: mamunalsultanBangkok, Thailand
Title: Angry Attitude Manager
Review: The waiter made a mistake with the order, as one of the customer with us is a severe patient coming out of the hospital. When manager came, his attitude was very bad. Need to remind him that he is the manager and it’s his job to address these issues, but he is very upset. At 7:30 pm here in Bukit Bintang this restaurant is not even 30% full and they seem not to know how to handle the work. Not a single staff smiles or greets customers. As a customer service person myself and to write helpful reviews for other customers, I generally try to greet and be nice to see how they respond. But this place is just plain rude. On top of everything, a customer can pay the same price and get double the size of food at other places...we received very small surprising size of plates for a very expensive price and was quite shocking. Overall impression not really worth it. This stretch here has a lot more restaurants to provide better service and deals

Author: Paula M
Title: Breakfast not suitable for Gluten Intolerant
Review: I was lead to believe this restaurant could cater for Gluten free food. When I couldn't see anything on the menu I asked the staff. They suggested the sandwich and croissant. When I told them what gluten was they suggested the pancakes, which also contain wheat. I ended up having poached eggs, baked beans and a small serving of veges. I didn't enjoy my meal. The actual restaraunt itself looked very nice.

Author: insyirah a
Title: Terrible dining experience ever!!
Review: This is the second time im here. Last time was perfect. Unfortunately, for my second visit it's just terribly poor!!Please think twice before you want to eat here.or else, you will feel the same thing with what i have been go through..terrible service ever!!!I come here with my family(total 7 person), enter the restaurant and sit at the table,in front of the middle counter.There is one waiter stand there(his face looks like bangladesh/pakistan,i have attached his pic),but surprisingly he just ignore us,as we have not even exist at all!! Can u understand how my feeling was when someone purposely ignore u and your family?We have been waiting for more than 10minutes, and i can even count how many customer in the restaurant(i try to be positive,maybe all staff was too busy). There is only total of 9 customers (beside of my family) and all of them had been entertain, so i don't understand why that guy don't even come to our table. He just stand there and do nothing (he have a menu book with him). Frustated with his attitude, i try to give signal to other waiters,and luckily, she saw my signal and straight away come to our table.. thank goodness, she did apologise and politely handover the menu.I thought i just want to forget about the incident, but unfortunately 2nd dissapointment come over, it is the food!!The food that we get was totally different quality than before..the kebab lamb and chicken taste was bad (i think they change the recipe),mee tarik also taste different and was full with fat meat! Seriously??fat meat? What kind of restaurant, which previously can get 5 star, give fat meat to the customer?? Even streetfood was much better than this! Honestly, i think something wrong with this restaurant, either the staff or the chef..

Author: Ko948
Title: A good Vietnamese restaurant
Review: A good and wide selection of Vietnamese dishes at reasonable prices. A good ambience to have a quiet meal with friends.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: 01Mooro666
Title: Useful diversion from Damai Puri
Review: Reasonably priced menu, popular in the daytime and evening, great to sit on the comfy seats and watch the ocean

Author: Soofy2002Malaysia
Title: Such a huge WASTE !!!
Review: Expensive and bland food !! Such a waste of money and time !!!

Author: vina902011Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Great place for hangout with friends and for a beer lover!!
Review: I love to go 5 foot way with my friends when weekend because the beer at this place so cheap!!Beside that,its serve fast food also not only the beer!i reaaly love kue tiaw there.5 foot way have a great music excellent staff and the best part you can making new friends there. Very nice atmosphere!

Author: kimkP56DNSeoul, South Korea
Title: Good ambience, average food, bad portion
Review: I came here for breakfast, the service and the ambience were great but compared to the price that we paid for, the portion was too small. We ordered Nasi Lemak and Smoked Salmon Sandwich. The sandwich was good but it was the chicken in Nasi Lemak that was so bony with barely any meat. But really good ambience and service!

Author: dicke-nznew zealand
Title: "Worst restaurant in KL"
Review: On our recent visit to KL we went looking and found this restaurant. On the outside it looked ok and ordered a starter followed by a main. No problem so far, the starter arrived, a chicken satay. But 2 min later the main arrived. So at one point the waiter was trying to fit 6 to 7 plates onto a very small table. We said we were not ready so they then placed the mains onto a spare table while we finished our starter. We then sent it back to be re heated, with it being put into a microwave it, mmmmmmm real nice. To be honest the waiter (who was the so called manager) was left wanting. He had no idea and used a feeble excuse "we are busy" and started the main too early. There are better restaurants in KL and you do not have to be very good to be better than this one.

Author: chauthornAarhus, Denmark
Title: Ordered two paninis. Served more than 20 minutes apart
Review: Went with my gf to get paninis for lunch. I got mine after 5 minutes or so. 5-10 minutes later came our smoothies.Then another 10 minutes before the second panini came.The staff did apologize, but I noticed the same trend with the 3 tables around us (one person without food, the rest done with theirs).I give it two stars because the paninis were good.OH yeah - don't sit next to the speakers if possible. It's loud (above conversation-level).

Author: accessibledudeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Views! Good Food.
Review: Pros: Excellent location overlooking a nature in midst of the city. Good for romantic dinners. Food is good with reasonable pricing. Reservations recommended. Cons: Only staircase, difficult for old people to climb. Asked for change on upper floor for senior people, was refused. Reserved the terrace for steamboat feast. Was informed steamboat was not available only at the time of ordering the food. This could have been done earlier. Unprofessional.

Author: lindalF1078EPJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not a typical hotel F&B outlet
Review: This is supposedly the main coffee house for KSL Hotel and serves daily buffet lunch. The buffet spread is decent and service adequate. Predominantly local fare with a sprinkling of international selections. Unfortunately, the place is run like a family restaurant rather than a hotel food and beverage outlet. Lots of extended family groups with young children and they can get quite loud. Would not recommend it - pay a little more to enjoy better choices (and definately better ambience) at any of the other 3 or 4 star hotels in town.

Author: mohemmadfeisalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellenttttttt Indian Gastronomic
Review: I am not super duper craze about 'Indian food' but now I love Indian food because of 7 Spices! Thus I keep provoking 7 Spices to others because of the service staff, the choices of food & beverages, layout of the dining tables & environment of the restaurant just perfect for couples & family occasion! I will visit 7 Spices again!

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Delicious Chinese Food
Review: Pork Dumplings is the must try here! Eat your dumplings with vinegar is superb! Dumplings are juicy with full of meat. Besides, Pork Ribs Ramen is another must try dish. Prices are affordable and I would definitely come back again!

Author: thee_babzLusaka, Zambia
Title: Poor service
Review: Had lunch here after a round of shopping. Tried their New York Strip steak and nibbled on their bountiful ribs. The steak was average but the ribs are to kill for. The waiters however were rather slow and unwelcoming. Its like they dont have the zeal to work. Found our table dirty and had to ask them to clean up. Thereafter, service was still slow as we had to keep asking them to clear up the table. All in all, I'd rather order on 'food panda' for a delivery rather than sit in there and experience their 1 star service.

Author: Michael HBrisbane, Australia
Title: Not worth the taxi fare
Review: I love hawker stalls - Singapore has the best by far - and I had fond memories of Chinatown in KL from a visit a few years back. This time it was more of Little India than Chinatown with most stalls operated by Indians - the area was grubby and with a permeating smell of sewerage. I lasted one beer (yes, it was hot), went to buy some souvenirs but was frustrated by being grabbed by stall holders

Author: hilly-abboud
Title: Absolutely rubbish service
Review: Absolutely rubbish service here, I waited 30 minutes to get served and I still hadn’t been served or acknowledged. I waited at the front for somebody to atleast seat us and nothing. Many waiters and waitresses looked at me and walked right passed my wife and I and still nothing what a joke of a restaurant and service

Author: LGohMelaka
Title: Much Ado about  nOTHING
Review: Food not great. Too much hype about the ceesy prawn noodles. Better to go to the Fatty Lee Crab ...I think that is the name. It is a restaurant near to Renaissance Hotel.

Author: amirajuhan
Title: Nice Thai food!
Review: Extensive Thai menu. must try their Homok Seafood and Tomyam and their mango sticky rice! very nice. food never taste differently each time visit. Nice food.

Author: CoolverineLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Let down by service
Review: There's a pretty selection of beef, all done competently. The wind selection is good and the ambience is sophisticated. The service however is non-existent. No one to seat you, waiting over 20 mins to take orders, etc

Author: IngunnandEspen
Title: High expectations - disappointed
Review: We wanted to try due to good reviews onTA. Average food, main course(the recomended duck) was burned and destroyed. No reason to go back. For the price of 100 RM pr person it was a disaster.

Author: Mahavatar BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Stay away . Filthiest of all
Review: Against all good judgement and poor experience from past, we decided to gv this place another chance coz it was raining and was the closest and kids were hungry. Dinner 8pm last night. i told the family to go ahead n order while i dropped by next door to pick up some urgent stuff.Bad move on my part coz normally i will check all precooked dishes tt have sitting there whole day. Kids already into chicken n mutton dishes.Mutton curry gone bad, chicken suspicious. Wash area nigthmare. Black fungus and toilet smell .Generally had a grimy fungusy feel all over. I lost my appetite. Didnt even touch anything. Service was zero. You hv to demand for attention. No idea how this place lasted all this long. Probably customers end up not paying bcoz no proper bill writing either.

Author: wanlihc
Title: Not so authentic after all
Review:
Laksa. Nothing great. 
Fried chicken was hard, sticking to each other. Double fried. 
Service wasn't good either.
Overrated place.
Will charm tourists and first timers, but not repeats.

Author: streetwisegang
Title: Not tasty
Review: Went to eat dinner with family. Food was so so, fish was not tasty. Tauhu also not tasty. Vegetables also so so.

Author: azira1991Singapore, Singapore
Title: " Not at par Standards 5 star food, terrible plating & under cooked chicken,salty curry mee"
Review: Went to Curate, FS KL with my friend for lunch and we expect to have amazing and delicious meal unfortunately we received 1* food (really2 bad I can tell). My friend order their grill fish but when received, can see on photos (like kid platting, not from Professional TRAIN CHEF). Really sad to have food like this from 5***** restaurant. I order their Curry Mee, and when eaten, too salty for me (their Chef supposed to check first before food out). Chicken under cooked (very dangerous cause of salmonella), this is unacceptable from good reputation hotel like FS. I had experience also to stay and eat at FS Langkawi, FS Doha but never ever received this kind of food!!!. For sure I'll never come back to this hotel and wouldn't to recommend to anyone, fullstop!!!!
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: Calvin YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Preferential service only if you a Mat Salleh!
Review: Just average food and very lousy service..!! It starts from the moment we stepped foot into the restaurant. First, we were made to wait for 10-15 minutes to be seated and we thought that was because the restaurant was full, but when we finally entered the restaurant it was hardly 30% occupied.When we were finally seated, the so called fine dining service was certainly non existent. The last straw was when my friend ask for the dessert menu, no response. Then I ask for menu again and still no response but when Mat Salleh on the next table called, the waiter immediately attended to them and we were asked to wait..!! Just crap..!!Honestly, the price is way overpriced and this is the first and last time for me.

Author: FindpaulngJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good food nice ambience and really good service!
Review: The service stands out. You are told upfront that the little kids won't be charged even if they eat at the buffet. The waiters are quick to notice when you need help or the table needs some clearing. You ask for something to be made or refilled for you, nobody needs to be reminded. Of course the food is up to Hilton standards and the ambience is very pleasant. It could be a crowd - but you wouldn't notice given how the tables are laid out, and the lighting and the decor. The only caveat is that the price is on the high side but for a once-in-a-while celebration - value for money.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: travellinggirl1312
Title: Terrible
Review: Staying at JW Marriott from 30th March - 2nd April, just ate lunch here, really awful food, poor quality ingredients, had the scallops, they were tiny, smelly and not fresh, and the sushi was stale and falling apart.

Author: 80thangnHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Comfortable for couple
Review: Its located in central of KL, you can check on map and walk from KLCC to Acme Bar.There is a modern style design, whole space cover with dark colors. The lighting focus only the table with yellow color, it stimulate for delicious meals.You can seat inside and look the road through glass window, but you don't need because in front of is a small road and high building.Its extensive menu, Western Foods, Japan Foods, Malaysia Foods and so on. The chef decorates eating beautiful and herbs. The price of meal not expensive, around above 30RM.Otherwise, there is draught beer.However, the staffs here are not professional in service. They made wrong order twice with us. The main reason I think is a language. If the staffs and customers not clearly in communication, they need to patience for understanding.In general, there good diner place but suitable for couple or small group.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Goldiemaz
Title: Don't bother eating here
Review: This restaurant is part of the KL Bird Park.  I ordered butter prawns and the prawns were not fresh.  It's average, overpriced food.  You can enjoy better food at less the price that they charge here at other restaurants.

Author: ScoobeedowaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food but not too cheap LOL
Review: I just typed Nasi kandar on the Kuala Lumpur TA Forums search function & this place was the 1st selection that came up...So i thought why not since it's only at KLCC & convenient to squeeze amongst the New Year's Eve crowd at KLCC Park , after my meal ...However , the price of MYR33+ was not expected for 1 portion of potatoes , green veggies , curry mutton & 1 pc of udang goreng ... & 1 coke ...My heart very nearly stopped beating LOL...The food , ambience , staff service , toilets cleanliness were all good...Foreigners were helped along while placing orders either in the queues or while seated...After this sumptous meal & looking at the price menu , i realised the udang goreng costs MYR14!!Will definitely be back again for all the right reasons... without the expensive udang goreng!!

Author: Vipin VSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice North Indian Options & Affordable too
Review: Well this restaurant is near KL Sentral and offers North & South Indian Dishes. We had ordered mixed options and food was up to the mark. The food was fresh and tasty. The hight of our visit was "Jalebi". The Jalebi was awesome in taste and was made in front of us. It is a must try.

Author: KLHunterKlang Valley
Title: My pasta came with insects
Review: I should have wrote this earlier...I have been there at least 5 times and the food has been ok. But the last time I patroned was about a couple of years back. I ordered some pasta and we also had garlic bread served to us. In the dish itself was baby cochroach like insect, the restaurant manager acknowledge but didn't do anything about it that night. He called to apologize and offer to buy me (only) dinner within the next 2 days. I will not comment on the rest but judging from the way this was managed, I will never return to this restaurant again.

Author: Jannaenae
Title: Poor service
Review: On my 1st visit, the staff were rude in explaining the bill to us.During my 2nd visit, I have used the entertainer app during the visit but the staff gave a weird/look down look. The shop decided to join the discount app but look down on people who used it. Ironic.

Author: -blacktop_3-Toronto, Canada
Title: Awesome experience
Review: My girlfriend and I went here based on the reviews on TripAdvisor. TA did not disappoint as the experience was phenomenal and unique (although I do understand that the concept exists elsewhere). Ganesh, our server, was super helpful and great. The food was average, but the experience really made it worthwhile. One downside would be if you have a girlfriend that likes playing tricks on you, she might hide your food from you during dinner. Luckily, you can get her back!

Author: Milouhappy
Title: Nice Restaurant
Review: Nice vegetarian Indian Restaurant.  Dossa was excellent.  Nice, calm  and clean place to eat.  Staff are adorable.  Highly recommendable.

Author: Roger120361Dereham, United Kingdom
Title: Weak Management
Review: If you want a great view, don't pay for a premium window seat. All customers come & block your views, especially the Twin Towers, & the management do "nothing" ! They even offer to take their photos ... terrible customer service - demand a refund .

Author: Silver_MimiTawau, Malaysia
Title: Decent place for lobster and steak
Review: I read about the good comments on this restaurant while surfing online for a new place for dinner and decided to give it a go since it’s quite near to our house. We ordered a sirloin steak and ribeye steak with half a live Boston lobster . The portions were quite huge for us as we are not big eaters . The steaks were ok for the price we paid and they were served with adequate smokey flavour . However, we were a bit disappointed that the fries and the sauce for the steak was not piping hot when they were served . As for the lobster , it was fresh and we thought it’s better than the steaks . It went down very well with the sauce. We would focus more on the lobsters during our next visit . We were also surprised to be given a complimentary dessert which I thought it’s the star of the night ! The rich chocolate brownies , topped with vanilla ice cream, walnuts and liberal drizzle of chocolate syrup which was served on a sizzling hot plate really stole the limelight . I was very full by the time it was served but still I couldn’t resist but to gobble down every caramelised bits of the heavenly treasure on the plate. Last but not least, the service was good and I personally find the free valet parking is an extremely plus point to visit this place as finding a car park space around this area can be a nightmare .

Author: Gobeli
Title: Overrated and poor service
Review: Can't understand the good reviews, we had a sub standard experience. Poor food, odd service and a terrible table. Don't waste your time or money.

Author: Wei Siong G
Title: Excellent ribs!
Review:
Pros: very very delicious ribs. Friendly staff

Cons: salted egg squid was very bland  and not fresh.  Warm as no indoor segment as far i could see. 

Price: $$$

Author: Shaf_KhaleedMiri District, Malaysia
Title: Not Bad
Review: Good food but not the price. 24 hours restaurant in town. Most crowded restaurant at night. Near to hotel (imperial mall , permaisuri, meritz, & kingsleys ). Good service. If you want to try other kind of food, just go to the street food ( infont of the restaurant) night only.

Author: HensoppersMandurah, Australia
Title: Too noisy!!
Review: We waited very long for a table - we were not offered a seat or a drink, just had to stand in the entrance way. We sat down and basically decided to leave within a minute as the music was deafening and they did not look keen to turn it down when we asked. Can not comment on food.

Author: Jini045076Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: it was discouraged by pomelo staff, as we wanted to have a lunch with my office colleagues & mgrs
Review: i called up to check on menu and price as we have to report estimate the cost for the trip. (my colleagues has called earlier and given all the details but no reply til today)however, the staff name "Apple" as mentioned by herself, was not friendly and i was un-comfortable to hear even, as it was totally discouraged by her for us to have a lunch in there. and i even mentioned that "it's not a good place for us to have a lunch in there, althought we will order all main courses" and she can still replied me as "certainly mdm". either my ears are wrong, or i spoke to wrong person ? we stayed for 2 nights before, and it was so nice, so i have recommended to my colleagues to check it out for our menu but it turns out to be in this way, and no one feel likes to go. hope you can train your staff in manner, just a one small thing can ruin your beautiful hotel i ever experienced and been recommending friends.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: Permatasariaivy
Title: Poor and terrible buffet
Review:
Went to shook on CNY.. totally dissapointed with the buffet spread. Not even a buffer spread. Nothing fancy and everything is so poor. 

Please review ure buffet price as it does not reflect the actual buffet spread.

Author: elbegzayap
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: I had many unforgettable memories and delicious food. I would highly recommend this restaurant if you looking for classic and cozy environment.

Author: ncsm23
Title: Bad experience
Review: We have waited for more than 30 mins for the steaks. The staffs there were totally not helpful. In addition, what we ordered were medium cooked steaks. But they were cooked as welldone! What a mess.

Author: riaayni
Title: eat at this restaurant because it's near from my hotel
Review: i try chicken tandoori, Butter naan, and chicken martabak, the taste is okay, i cannot compare with other restaurant because its my frist time tried that food. You can eat here for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Author: AFrial13Clermont, Florida
Title: Fantastic food, great atmosphere, below par service.
Review: We were a disappointed about this place. It was recommended to us by a friend and we were very impressed at first when we arrived. The place was beautiful and had a very romantic feel to it (just what we were hoping for as it was our anniversary). We had booked several days before through their online booking system and received confirmation as well so we were shocked to find out that we weren't even on the list for the night unless you count my boyfriend's name scribbled on a random paper next to it, which we had to point out to them. The host looked unconvinced (and confused) we actually had a booking and showed us a table anyway--I guess lucky for us the place didn't look to busy otherwise we wouldn't have gotten in. The service was alright at first but somehow didn't feel like we were getting the service we want. Mind you, we're not expecting them to wait for us hand and foot, but we do like to order when we're ready, have the staff ask us how we're doing occasionally, and ask if we needed anything every now and then. It was hard to get their attention most of the time and we can't help feel we were being ignored because we didn't have a proper reservation (even though we did). I guess we could have let things slide except at the end of the dinner, my boyfriend revealed that he guessed that they forgot about the special surprise he had planned. Apparently he had emailed them asking if they could organise a complimentary dessert that says "Happy Anniversary" on it to mark the occasion. He even showed me the email where they stated they were going to inform the restaurant about the dessert. We waited for it for a long time but nothing came. We thought about saying something about it but the moment passed and the dinner felt ruined already. Didn't want to force them to make us something they should have done already. Made us a bit jealous because the couple next to us got a dessert that says "Happy Holidays" on it, which made us wonder if it was meant for us. Who knows...? Aside from that, the food was great and very delicious. Just wish they should have been more accommodating especially if they were told about it beforehand.

Author: 39trevorl
Title: Absolute favourite
Review: Undoubtedly one of my favourite places to dine,  service is always good and food is fantastic. Local dishes are excellent and western dishes just as good. I would highly suggest one visit in your time in Langkawi

Author: Shah FPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Nice food with excellent views
Review: Visited last week to celebrate my 10th Wedding Anniversary. Visited along my parents, wife and three kids. The biggest plus are the amazing city views. I had lunch there so that can see the views in day time and it paid well. I had bought online tickets and as the 1:30pm slot was easily available online even though i purchased just one day ago, I was of the view that there will be less people however to my surprise it was quite over crowded. though the kind of food served was not usual for us still we all liked the food. the staff gave us a complimentary anniversary cake slice which felt good.

Author: Damianmay33Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super Nice Noodle Stalls (Asam Laksa + Dessert ) & The Colourful of Jalan Alor Street Art
Review: Hey, cindy here..my friends and me decide went to bukit bintang K.L, The first place i went to Street Art. Its so colourful and i have been long times not visit there.Then we found there are Food Stalls in front of 168 Stores.I order the Homemade Asam Laksa,they use the(Ikan Kembong)for soup,i special request add pineapples ,onion and my friend Annie love peppermint much. Omg, the soup is so super nice ,is quite different that i try compare with orders place's asam laksa. The soup is full of taste,sweet, sour,spicy and slighly bitter taste. I also do order the 00daily dessert, ginger soup withsweet potato dessert（番薯姜糖水）,only RM 2.20. I cant even found at this prices. I also order their Special Veget dish for 1 plateRM 5(小白菜）.You can sellect what veget that you prefer. After finished our meal, i take away 1 bowl Asam Laksa and tong Sui for my mum dinner.My mum said is yummy..hahahha....This Food Stalls Uncle said have been there for 20 years more...Please come earlier ,as they start at 4pm until 9pm.They off on Thursday.Best recommend ,Must try when you at Jalan Alor!

Author: Charles L
Title: Will never eat here>>>>
Review: Not really a place to eat and not recommended!!! Foods are Horrible !!!!sorry to say it as it will be a place to chill off with some drinks

Author: YSW1971
Title: Great Dining Experience
Review: Great dinner experience with friends for birthday celebration.food are tasty, fast and attend service with 5 stars standrad from Captain Jojo.really enjoyed and will come back again surely.

Author: jennykain255108
Title: Gobo Upstairs Lounge and Grill.
Review: The service and the food were both excellent. Our waitress was special - she produced a shawl for my friend who was feeling a little cold in the air conditioning.

Author: yeoc468
Title: Average
Review:
The menu is limited... just like any cafe around.

Only thing which is god and reliable is their coffee.

The rest of the dishes are average.

Author: Sandeep_AujlaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Overrated tourist trap.
Review: As with most hyped establishments, over time, the qualities that got them the fame would slowly fade if not managed well. This is the case, I suspect with Nancy's. Service was good, waited in line for about half and hour due the popularity and was seated promptly once a table was vacated. Hungry and excited, we were let down by the food though. Of the 5 dishes we ordered, only the otak2 starter stood out. The dishes we ordered were mainstay Nyonya food, Like the chicken rendang and Assam pedas fish. It looked more like an oil slick off the Melaka straits! So oily! And the taste was nothing to shout about .. I've had better n that's a guarantee. The Kang Kung belacan was simple and for the price not worth it. Any regular Chinese corner shop could whip that up for half the price. For all the hype , it was an utter disappointment. I regard this establishment as a tourist trap. Never will I recommend this place to anyone heading to Melaka. There are better options out there...

Author: GAM1Brighton
Title: Going downhill
Review: Went with family. On entering the restaurant we noticed the carpet is filthy, it really needs replacing. We had the second sitting 8.30pm to 11pm. Food adequate. You really do not go there for the food but for the revolving restaurant and the view that comes with it. The restaurant itself was about 15% full, not many diners at all. However the buffet still managed to start running out of desserts by 10pm, still an hour of service to go. This was our third visit and will be our last. My opinion, not worth the money.

Author: yazid yKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: New Tim Sum Menu
Review: This review is specifically for the new timsum menu which was recently introduced. (Restaurant visit:November 2014) This restaurant had (since the days when it was operating under the Nikko hotel)been serving among the best timsum in Kuala Lumpur. The restaurant underwent a recent refurbishment and the decor and ambiance now is very nice and classy. I had timsum there soon after it reopened and was happy that the fare had greatly improved in terms of quality, taste and presentation. For several visits after that, the high standards were maintained. However, my last visit on the 9 th of November was extremely disappointing. The menu had been revised.In a nutshell, the dumplings which were supposed to be prawn based did not have the right amount of prawn. Too much chicken meat/fish was used as filler.This is not acceptable for an establishment such as the Intercon. The price too were lower than before. The "cheong fun" selection was also not good, utilising ingredients such as dried shrimp. One would expect prawns and scallops cheong fun from the Intercon. I think that the management has tried to re price the timsum to be more "affordable". This is a wrong strategy. I dont think that patrons to the Intercon are price sensitive if the quality and service is reflected in the pricing. The service is however still of a very high standard.(To the GM of Intercon KL : Please look into my comments. It may be shared by many other patrons. Thank you. )

Author: Kelly N
Title: Not as expected. A bit expensive
Review: Dim sum taste not as expected. A bit expensive. Should try the fish and chicken porridge, smooth and easy to digest.

Author: RonnieT96Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Read the excellent reviews and went for dinner last night at 8:30pm with great anticipation. You see, we love our seafood!.1) First disappointment - When we were ready to place our order, the waitress told us the mud crabs were sold out. Disappointed that there was no mud crab left at such an early hour of the night, we placed an order for black pepper steamed flower crabs instead.2) Second disappointment - Five minutes after the order was taken, the waitress came to inform us that the flower crabs have run out too. We were truly disappointed and thought of leaving, but since the rest of our orders had already gone in, we decided to stay on. We reluctantly changed our order to steamed king prawns. 3) Third disappointment -When our vegetables came, we realized they served us kang kong and not kailan. We did not make a fuss as the kang kong looked fresh and nicely cooked.4) Fourth disappointment - The garlic lime steamed fish was served next and unfortunately, it was not fully cooked. The parts near the bone were still red and raw. We had to send it back.Overall, the quality of the food was average, tending towards a sweeter taste (due to a generous use of tomato ketchup as a flavoring) which is not to our palette. Pricing was however reasonable. Would I recommend my friends to visit? Probably not as there are far better alternatives across the road.

Author: AChee74
Title: Use to be much better
Review:
Like I say, it used to be much better. The portion is getting lesser nowadays and the prices are slightly high for Kuching standard.

But it is nice. it is just good, not very good, nor average

Author: Redknaps
Title: Dinner
Review:
Excellent food and fantastic service. All staff friendly and welcoming. 
A great variety of food. Indian curries were outstanding and the raveoli as entree was superb.

Author: blackdqenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor execution
Review: Visited in early Feb 2017. Now this is not necessarily Skillet's fault, but the first thing that hits you when you enter the lobby where skillet is, is the smell of stale, deep fried fat. Nice to have an open concept kitchen where we can see the chefs at work, but not so good if your extractor fan isn't good enough. As I said may not be their fault strictly- there's a casual Japanese restaurant opposite that could be to blame. But it wasn't pleasant. Aside from the fact that you can't smell your own food (a vital preceptor for taste) all our hair and clothes smelled bad after the meal. Showers all round! Then: shock horror. They only offered imported water at exorbitant prices. I have a real problem about this. Never mind paying for good food, and I can understand (barely) that water isn't free, but I have never yet heard of a plausible explanation as to why either the cost of water isn't factored in to the price of food that we pay, service charges, or, cheaper alternatives can't be offered. Awful.When asked why, waiter got very defensive arguing that it was "management decision". When that didn't work he said okay you can have tap water but he really didn't recommend it. Untreated tap water in KL is just silly. Finally he agreed to have it boiled. Huh.Well Management, you heard it. Your waiter wants to blame you. What are you going to do about this? And this set the "professional" tone for the rest of the evening...Now I have to say food was not bad, but Definitely not worth it. If you want experimental, set menu prices are about the same at Canteloupe in Troika and far more refined. First of all, the menu options were so mind boggling it confused everyone for ages. When the waiter was asked to explain... oh forget it. He was not knowledgable about the menu, and that's if you managed to understand him...? Reading out a description in the menu is not an explanation dear. I decided to go for a three course menu on the dinner set. Should I mention that almost Everything on the dinner set menu had massive supplements to pay on them? And even so the starting prices were already not insubstantial.First course that I picked was the onion tart. There was no supplement on that but that was a rather sad, stale, and dry tart with cheese and onion filling. I was ravenous and finished it, but honestly Delifrance could've done better for RM40, which is what it would've cost on the a la carte menu. If I'd ordered it ALC, I think I would've had a fit. Well actually. It cost about the same under the set. I think I'll have my fit now then...Big redeemer of the night was the A5 wagyu. Top notch melt in your mouth little morsels. Accompanying vegetables were wonderfully done too. But mind you I believe the supplement on that was RM180? I tried my godfather's pasta. Nice experiment...but everyone agreed the taste came out funny. I thought it came out tasting like laksa. Well then. Textured chocolate was odd but a sight to behold in terms of presentation. Was it instagrammable? Yes, it should've been. Presentation of everything was good. Everything was beautifully placed and even the restaurant was pretty if you could get over the smell. But... it is Very dark. So that's a challenge for the Instagram account! Enjoy the atmosphere and talk to your family then. Unless you bring a long lens slow shutter camera of course, which the family on the next table did.

Author: MAD531
Title: Bad Service & Food Expensive
Review:
Terrible food
Bad service 
Expensive, overpriced !
No aircond, damn hot eating dimsum and yet they claimed as high class restaurant. 
Lousy.

Author: 2RightyPerth, Australia
Title: Must Visit - Excellent
Review: The decor of bold tiles, dark furniture, candles, and gold inlaid chinese timber work, along with Jackie the hostess really set the stage for a meal to remember, and it was. Service brilliant,and thanks to Denash for finding the lamb shank that was originally not available. The Snapper grilled in banana leaf moist and excellently spiced. The mini Bau with Pork Belly with pickled vegetable was so clever, could have eaten 3 serves. Finally the Lamb Shank was the best I have ever eaten, served in a grey coloured coconut flavoured gravy I initially thought "oh, oh", but how wrong I was. It is a must have. Do yourself a favour and put this restaurant on your must visit list.

Author: Chow Hock SSingapore
Title: Not as good as I thought it should.
Review: This is new site for the restaurant, The decoration is not upscale enough, and does not fit into a laid back type of Melaka restaurant. It is still a popular restaurant among the locals. Reservation is required. When you enter the restaurant, all the staff ( yes, it is all) will greet you loudly to make you feel welcome. But this will happen to all guests entering or leaving the restaurant. As such, you may not have peace of mind to dine. The dishes are not great or special. The waiter can't wait to clear the dishes whenever you are almost to consume each dish. Price is reasonable.

Author: amandar633
Title: Is it supposed to be served cold?
Review: I had the pork plate with rice and it was cheap so that was a plus. But the crispy pork is served cold. I'm not usually a picky eater but I just ate the crispy bits on the end and left the rest

Author: Anurag S
Title: Ordinary Food with less than ordinary service
Review: Following trip advisor's no.1 rating landed here but quite a disappointing experience. Ordinary food with rude staff. Not sure how its rated top of the charts on TA. Please avoid.
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food
