Author: BavarianBurgerKuching, Malaysia
Title: 90 minutes for a burger? Anyone?
Review: Something need to be done here. I even saw an old lady shouting at the kitchen, a customer i guess, saying that she waited for one and a half hours for her dish. But the food is nice though. Not recommended for those who are starving, unless you're planning to have your dinner at 7.00 p.m. and come here at 5.30 p.m.

Author: GazzajamLondon, UK
Title: Poor Service -Terrible Meals
Review: our expereince is- this place is only good for cafe and a drink- not meals. The meals were poorly cooked, served and the waiting service was appalling. The waiters were just like wild chickens- dis-organised chaos and poor hygiene when you see waiters using their hads to wipe their sweat and then serving meals at the same time!!! NASTY, NASTY, NASTY. Vistors, its your call. Your experience might be quite the opposite, but we would NEVER recommedn this place. Location is great, but that is where the positive qualities stop.

Author: AliciaY151Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Over Rated Chicken Rice
Review: Used to like Lou Wong but realised that the quality had deteriorated. The chicken meat arrived disintegrated, although I ordered half chicken. Portions were small.On the other hand, the rice was also low quality “broken rice grains”, it is definitely not worth the price paid. Immediately after having lou wong, we tried Onn Kee which is located opposite of lou wong. we found the chicken portions to be bigger and well plate.Will not go back to Lou Wong again.

Author: MBJ400
Title: What a shame
Review:
Want to go for a personal nice relaxing lunch, what a shame

Way way over priced, RM50 for a glass of wine and no choice at all, Mark the manager was the saving grace a top guy

Author: Andrew M
Title: Old school classic.
Review: Nice comfort food for Westerners ... it's from a different era and I enjoyed that. Retro without trying to be. Perfect for Westerners that want a break from all that great Asian food.

Author: VickyCarameloKuala Lumpur
Title: Poor service and food
Review: We went to Traders Hotel for the Seafood buffet on Valentine's Day, and I must say the service was very disappointing. Tables were set too close to one another, clearly to accommodate a large crowd for a quick profit, food finished quickly and took ages to be replenished, etc. We paid RM118 but only drinks inclusive were water, black coffee and tea. The ladies toilet sink was leaking and there was a pool of water under the sink causing a stench. What a terrible way to start your romantic evening!

Author: wintermelonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It would be better if the staff can be more friendly
Review: Tried the nasi lemak here. The overall taste was just average. The coconut rice was average, nothing special. The rendang sauce was too sweet while the chicken breast meat was dry and tasteless. The sambal ikan bilis was okay and very small portion, not enough to eat with the rice. The achar was good but very small portion given. The staff were not welcoming. It would be better if the staff can be more friendly.

Author: CurryPuff1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor quality food
Review: Had lunch here today as a break from the normal lunchtime diet of home-made sandwiches and to kill half an hour. Ordered cod and chips and a bottle of sparkling water. Water was from Wales so a plus point there but the cod was just awful, skin on, and flabby, wet, no texture, no taste, batter was really oily. Cheap industrial chips were cold, some crushed/mashed garden peas substituted for mushy peas. The lady sat next to me had tried the chicken pie and left most of it , she said it was pretty poor, it certainly did not look appetising, a pile of brown goo. Had a desert and cofee to makle up fro the, thankfully I suppose, small portion, these were both OK, in fact quite nice, much better coffee than the nearby Dome, The whole lot came to nearly 20 GBP so not at all cheap and really very poor value for money.

Author: dieana_myKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Steamboat and Grill
Review: We came here to celebrate birthday and was our first visit. The steamboat and grill was good, looks fresh and new but there were no crab and they didnt refill the prawn. Selection of items can be improved, not as much as Seoul Garden but this is the first steamboat/grill restaurant that have whole marinated fish normally other restaurant provide fish fillet. But the selection of fish i feel is not really suitable for grilling. The choice of sauce can also be improved as the available sauce is not so "kick". The soup is ok, just the tom yam taste a bit like asam rebus. Cold drinks choice is ok, but there is no hot drinks eg. coffee/tea. The Ice cream only 2-flavours, when 1-flavour finished, they didnt refill. Overall is ok la.

Author: Leonj59Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a veg fan...
Review: I came in here for their thosai and vadai and it is easily among the best around. The accompanying chutneys are extremely good and possibly among the best i have had. If I'm in the vicinity, in the morning theres no other place I'd rather be. (Hmmm theres a song in there somewhere!!)

Author: jess123011
Title: Average food
Review: Since it was our first time there, we decided to play it safe and order their house "specialties" - ie devil curry , prawn curry with pineapple and brinjal..The devil curry was ok - just alright..The prawn curry was a big let down - the prawns were tough (overcooked) and tasteless, the curry was too sour and it overwhelmed the dish, the deep fried brinjal was ok but not something that i would order again..so all in all, i would rate the whole experience 3/10 as nothing that we tried was good enough to be ordered again should we end up there again (though its unlikely).

Author: BelSheppardAustralia
Title: Worth the hard work in finding fatCUPID
Review: fatCUPID is hard to find. Taxi drivers do not know where it is. Take a look at an earlier review (about September/October) which will give you good directions. Now ... to the food, the food at fatCUPID is super yummy. We had Laksa which was devine. We had the special of the day which was a Crispy Skin salmon in a Malaysian sauce which my husband and I both devoured. We had our two boys 9 & 11 with us and they were treated so kindly by the owner. They were invited to swim in the pool while we dined and also were allowed to venture and play in the cubby house that had been built. The wine was icy cold and the restaurant is crispy clean. There are also some rooms that you can stay in and they are well worth a look. Great prices and very very clean. fatCUPID is in our "must do" list when we return. Oh and the dessert was "to die for".

Author: alan s
Title: Sun Cafe
Review:
If you only eat at one place on Langkawi you must visit Sun Café!
Great food and really great staff!

Author: Kuropon
Title: Bad buffet dinner
Review: The food taste pretty bad with low standard presentation. Beef and chicken are not up to standard with the price. The dessert zone looks like a disaster aftermath. The waffle is undercooked and soft cream tastes really cheap. Waiter and waitress are not professional enough. This restaurant aspects us to have dessert with the forks and spoons we used for savory main dishes. One of the worse hotel buffet I have ever been.

Author: TheRuddos
Title: Food excellant, well presented and extremely good value.  Helena and her mother were extremely pleasant and friendly
Review: Extremely good value food, lacked some atmosphere but more that made up for it in the cooking.

Author: callmesheepz90Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good! Will return.
Review: We thought that the food were generally quite good. We went with no expectations. We were a group of 4 and shared the breakfast platter, croque madame and soft shell crab bao! Plus an order of churros with salted egg yolk dip. We also had iced americano and the juice, yellow pages. The juice is refreshing and great!! I enjoyed it on a hot afternoon. Prices were reasonable as well if i would say. And with the exchange rate of 1:3, it made it even better. However, food service was a little slow. 1 dish at a time, when the first dish is almost done. Lucky we shared and not ate individually. Staffs were friendly and the cafe interiors looked good. Will return again! And oh, we parked at a nearby open space carpark as there were no roadside parking anymore and the area was under construction which made the roads more narrow.

Author: SingaporeRon
Title: Pork Satay
Review:
Another of our family's favourite haunts in Malacca.
Original shop was at Jonker over 15yrs ago. 
The satay is normally well grilled & served with generous helpings of the tasty sauce with belimbing.

Author: Sam SCanadian in Paradise
Title: LIFE SAVER
Review: If you happen to be staying in hotel in Kuala Lumpur, that does not have food, than this particular place is really a life-saver!Really good food, not too spicy, and very easily delivered to your room, by Uber-Eats.To top up the kudos, this place is really, really cheap!

Author: zacharyeffingtonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Abysmal service, disinterested staff.
Review: We arrived for a quick brunch. It took a while to get the waiter's attention to place an order. When she finally arrived, I decided to order the regular eggs with chorizo and some orange juice on the side. My guest ordered something similar. We were seated alongside a barrier in the upper deck section. Interestingly, the menus were placed in a holster along the barrier- located right next to our table. It was particularly disturbing because there were many flies buzzing around the menus (Im guessing the staff didnt clean the menus and thus the flies were attracted to weeks/decades worth of remains stuck on the pages)Food: Did not arrive. (We were waiting for >30 min for breakfast...a simple sausage and eggs)Service: when we called the waitress to ask about our dishes..she simply didn't bother checking. We then ask someone else to check on our dishes and found out that apparently it was ready ages ago. We refused to pay. Cancelled the service charge as well. I have heard that this place was infamous for its horrible service but I decided to give it a chance, to my detriment. Never again.

Author: 311drewf
Title: Weekend roast
Review: Weekend Roast was amazing for $58 MYR! Great food,great atmosphere and accommodating staff!  A must visit in KL! 15 minute walk from Pavilion.

Author: Mark L
Title: Bad customer service
Review: The food was good but I did not enjoy it the slightest bit.1. They took our order (did not write it down), forgot and asked again, got the order wrong and scolded us when we told them it wasn't what we ordered. He kept giving us nasty looks throughout our meal.2. While ordering, I had chosen 3 dishes and they all weren't available. So I ordered Nasi Ayam Penyet Special. I waited for about an hour and my friends had already finished eating. I asked them to check it and they said "oh ayam penyet is only ready starting afternoon" (I was there in the morning).Not coming back.

Author: wing_wingggg
Title: Nice bar but very average food
Review: Great looking bar with reasonable atmosphere and televisions to watch sport.  I went here for a quick meal and drink.  Unfortunately my laksa was lackluster and therefore I won't be racing back here for a meal next time I'm in town.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Dirty environment. Flies do land on the food
Review: Do not expect the foods to be clean. I usually see flies flying inside the foods that are near the cashier. But the foods are really cheap compare to any shops outside. The naan are nice however.

Author: gsatimessquare
Title: Nice
Review: This is Tourist place. All Foreigner  traveler can visit in this place, also they can take their foods and also alcohol. This is very sweet able place for all foreigner guests.

Author: Anna SWarsaw, Poland
Title: Decent Indian food
Review: We visited the restaurant as it was close to our hotel, had no major expectations. The food was very decent- chicken tikka masala and tandoori fish at a decent price. The place lacks the atmosphere though. The service was trying to be nice but the waiter kept chatting to us over our dinner so we didn't feel very comfortable eating. 10% service tax charge was a bit of a surprise on the bill. Disgusting and dirty toiletts unfortunately.

Author: Saturn
Title: Blood dripping from Chicken
Review: We went here yesterday as per recommendation from a friend. We ordered the Ipoh chicken rice but barely ate it since there are still fresh blood dripping from the chicken.

Author: Sharif P
Title: Wonderful service
Review: I find this restaurant by triladvisor. I had my Valentine's dinner with my lovely gf. The food and cockatils was awesome. Service was excellent. The bartender give us complementary shooter. Waiter too helpful. He book for us grab car to reach our hotel . I wish I will back here again

Author: 876barkat
Title: June 19
Review: Nice food place in the pavilion mall. Serving mainly continental food specialty in pizza and pastas. Good service and definitely would try again.

Author: dselvanWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: Rang and booked a hotel and it is walking distance from Shangri-La.We had a table overlooking the road but it was outside on the balcony area.The service was good and the food was good although prices were higher than in Georgetown.Had a starter to share and 2 main course and they were very good and I asked for spicy and it was hot and nice!!Had their famous dessert and it was massive and we shared it.We walked out with very full stomachs and happy!!!

Author: vtST13
Title: Poor food but restaurant set up was quite impressive
Review: Lalapan just ordinary, pomfret was a bit expensive for the size served, Nasi goreng Pattaya, wok is not hot enough, Nasi lemak just like street quality, for food..lots of room to improve to match that beautiful décor of the restaurant, location was very strategic.

Author: machapastaSingapore, Singapore
Title: It was everything I expected
Review: As a pretty mean reviewer, I have a very strict view on things, and this restaurant was everything that I expected it to be. I was even looking forward for the restaurant to prove me wrong and surprise me, but that didn't happen. It was very crowded. Since I was eating with a big group, we got the privacy of a big table behind a curtain away from everybody else, and it was nice since the restaurant was very crowded. The setting was not really the best, but I give it a 3.4/5. Sort of like those old hotel wedding thing that didn't fit their theme of being a restaurant that sold simple hawker food at a restaurant price. Yep, you read correctly, the prices weren't exactly so high, but it's more than what you get at a hawker center. But with rent and air conditioning and everything else, I can't blame them. Now on to the most important thing, the food. That was the only thing that surprised me, In a bad way. With so much talk about how great their food it, when I looked at it the decorating was exactly like the ones you'd see at a hawker center. I ate the most famous thing on their menu, the nasi lemak. The curry was spicy but manageable. The chicken was not as good. Dry and chewy, sort of like gum. The rice wasn't nice too, was quite moist and the grains were little. But the nasi lemak feel is there. Thank god. The dessert was their saving grace. It was quite delicious. Their bobo chacha was quite a delight.

Author: lovetotravel402West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: What is all the fuss about ?
Review: Having read all the reviews before we went we went out of our way to visit this place. We tied it in with a trip to Central Market which is just around the corner. The food was awful. The fried chicken was cold and was like rubber. The lamb curry was also cold and sooo salty !!!.If you like genuine Indian/Pakistani food then you will be very disappointed. I have tasted much better food back home in true UK.

Author: pdyananKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: As good as it gets
Review: We were looking for a late lunch option and this place closes at 4pm. The chicken rice and char siew are the main highlights. The portions were decent. Lacked a bit of their signature sauce but overall was ok. Petai not too spicy, taugeh was crunchy. Would recommend.

Author: vthuppilBangor, United Kingdom
Title: Fake tasting food, outrageous pricing
Review: I can't believe how this place has an average rating of 4.5 stars! The owner must have a large social network of relatives and friends. It's without a doubt one of the worst places that I have eaten at.First of all, the food doesn't taste fresh. It seems pre-prepared and heated at the restaurant. The fact that they couldn't modify our order to make it more spicy further indicated that the food was not freshly prepared.We ordered the falafel and spicy chicken adana wraps. And hot chocolate for drinks. I can't believe they have the gall to charge RM 9.50 for a cup of hot chocolate which is nothing but a packet of instant hot chocolate mixed with water. Speaking of water, they charge RM 1.50 if you want a glass of plain water.The food itself besides obviously not being fresh also feels artificial. Especially the bread. I really had to struggle to finish the my wrap. The last few bites were literally tough to swallow. And for hours after your meal, you're left with an uncomfortable feeling like you've just eaten plastic or something equally artificial. If there is an opposite of wholesome, the food here is that!And no, it's nowhere near authentic Mediterranean food in taste either. Sorely disappointed on so many levels. I almost never leave 1 star reviews on TripAdvisor, but this place thoroughly deserves it.

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: 10 Curry Friday - Noon 'til 2
Review: Every Friday they have their 'Lunchtime Special'. A banana leaf with rice and 10 small helpings of a variety of vegetarian curries. With plain rice its 7RM with Byriani rice its 8.50RM.All the food was delicious. Sure its not haute cuisine but it gives you the chance to taste a variety of different veggie style dishes. Also besides the 'Special' there are loads of other dishes you can choose - meat, egg etc and of course chapatis!The restaurant has recently had a 'refurb' so is in much better condition than just 9 months ago.For something a bit different try the Friday 10 Curry Special. It from noon until 2pm I believe.

Author: SabrinBediKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing banana leaf and more.
Review: The banana leaf is usually available upstairs daily from lunch time onwards.. The curries are absolutly amazing.. I highly recommend the crab and madras fish curry. Be warned that you may take sometime to get a seat and be served.. as the seats are limited and sharing tables sometimes is unavoidable, but you will be all contented after your big Indian meal. Give it a try when you are around Bangsar for lunch as it;s much fresher then. You can always grab their other bites from naan to noodles downstairs if you are not into rice.

Author: PaulQuinn51
Title: Paul Q
Review: Attended restaurant 02/01/2014 .The hosts are lovely an the food is excellent. Beef radang is a wonderful meal as is thai  style fish .A place definately not to miss on your journey.

Author: dianahamasubaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Had lunch at The Curve Branch
Review: Reached around 2pm and it was full house. Requested a nice roof shape table and we got the table when there were customers just finished eating.Ordered salted fish fried rice, Broccoli with prawn, Siew Mai prawn, Chicken Cheong Fun, Crewy Meat croquette and Szechuan dumpling. All are tasty, delicious and satisfied.The services was good, even during it was fullhouse. The ambience was nice since it has nice decoration.Of course will come again. Thank you

Author: Max1968ITRome, Italy
Title: ok
Review: the place offers both a buffet option at 110 RMY or à la carte. Being alone and quite tired I chose the latter. Nasi Goreng was good but not memorable, the tropical fruit platter big and fresh but I was expecting something more than a few bits of papaya, pineapple and the melon and watermelon that I can find also in Europe; price was 83 MYR which is very ok especially if you're used to Hilton buffets in Europe. Very friendly staff.

Author: montpax8
Title: I would...but,
Review: For all the speakeasies I have visited, this one is up to my par of interest. Services are really good, drinks are decent and the atmosphere is amazing. Plus the popcorn was amazing! One thing I do not like about this place is the bar manager named Alex. Seems like a good guy, but the way he speaks just bursts out egotistical. Not to mention, he was also quite rude to a lady friend of mine. As this seems like a wonderful place to hang out and have a good chilled out time, I would have given it 5 stars but not this time as my friends were not having a good time.

Author: AliaAMRKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing Spectacular
Review: Had a buffet dinner. Nothing spectacular being the latest hotel in the KLCC vicinity. Other 5 stars hotel around the area offers better spread at a lower price. Paying premium price for the buffet with coffee and tea not part of it, this resto is not on my return list.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: jaseet88
Title: Cozy Place with Vibe
Review: Old sewing machines are used as table legs/stand. All the furnishing in this place are made of recycled materials. Kodos to the owners. Think home-cooked food with live music & songs. Not bad.

Author: tisyahmalaikaJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Tested new Nasi Ayam Penyet
Review: Tested new Nasi Ayam Penyet express lunch at amaya food gallery superb.The taste of sambal delicious and comes with ice lemon tea & fruit platter.Worth for money

Author: SushantChandak
Title: Worst Food Qlty
Review:
Dosa/Tosai came with Liquid Potato Masala, Full of Black Pepper ...

Waiter doesn't understand anything...  too casuals

Author: Companion825981
Title: Dinner at Kota
Review: The food presentation are nice and taste delicious. Also, Mr Hassan that serve us is very friendly.😍

Author: BharathA35
Title: Indulgance
Review: Peated single malt + Cuban cigar. Arif,you can't go wrong on your suggestion.. thanks mate.we will be back again.

Author: PatienceginKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Can be better
Review: We dined there recently and we ordered quite a number of dishes. From porridge, to fried carrot cake, to Siu mai, har Kao and fried noodles. We were a little disappointed as it tasted average. The standard of food can better. Service made up to our dining experience.

Author: O2987RNjimpAmpthill, United Kingdom
Title: Hard Rock KL slipped ?
Review: This was a favourite haunt of mine . It's not cheap but always been a nice place to go . Staff are great , surroundings are great . No band on when I was there but normally a good quality band . Happy hour is no longer but one get one free but a discount rate . That does not bother me but the quality and portion size of food was not up to Hard Rock standard . Natchos with fajita steak was poor and the wings no longer legendary ? I was in Hard rock Singapore next week where standard was what you expect . I am in Gold Coast now and will try hard rock again tonight . Come on KL get your act. Ask together on food !

Author: Chan K
Title: Good menu for brunch
Review: Pullman Bangsar used to have brunch over the weekend and I notice that it is no longer available. It used to be good and a lot of people used to come by. I dont know why they no longer have it.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: AydenN2
Title: Great food, Great service and Great chefs
Review: Chef Lam really has done it again...food there is really awesome. Love their dim sum and especially their desserts. Lost of words. Keep it up Chynna!!!

Author: Sonia PSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tiny portions, mega prices
Review: We had my birthday dinner at Brasserie 25 and everything was mostly pleasant..untilthe food came. My dad and I ordered the roast lamb loin which was to be accompanied by herbed vegetables. We got three pieces of lamb, maybe 1*2 inches each, three thin strands of asparagus, three snow peas and two thin strands of carrots. The vegetables looked more like garnishings then part of the meal. For the price (RM120), we felt so ripped off. The food is supposed to French but I don't think even the French would accept something so small and be pleased to go to bed hungry after paying so much. It is ridiculous if they think that the smaller their portions, the more expensive it will look. Come on Brasserie 25, that was incredibly disappointing. And by the way, did you shrink all our portions just because we had a eatigo 30% voucher? I'll need to get myself some Milo and cream crackers now..

Author: coyokKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: good time with nice beverage and fantastic ambiance
Review: been here for the complimentary drinks upon check in at Weil Hotel. nice setting of sofa and tables for drinking whilst listening to piano though its playing is programmable

Author: Christeene818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great live music venue....
Review: Finally we have found some live music in KL. They Backyard have a real mix of musicians from local bands, Phillipino bands, jazz etc. We were lucky to have heard a local rock band who were having a come back performance after a10 year break. They were amazing. Unfortunately, for non-smokers it is very smokey. We would have stayed longer but the smoke was stinging our eyes and was quite uncomfortable. The pub was packed from 9.45pm. We thought the music was to start at 10.00pm but in reality they started,at 10.30pm. As we had eaten close by I am unable to comment on the food. The menu was extensive and what I saw being served looked good and very generous servings. Staff were very friendly and they serve all non alcoholic drinks, including juices and alcoholic drinks. If you can cope with the smoke then I highly recommend you check it out. The pub is called Backyard as it is frequented by a lot of locals - so a nice friendly crowd.

Author: jenlimmmmKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: pleasant
Review: Food and service was up to par, waiters recommendations were good. The atmosphere was nice, quiet and we opted for the 630 reservation and got to witness sunset which was quite nice. I've been there a few times and all my experiences have been fairly similar, and once to celebrate a birthday, and they were nice enough to prepare a personalized plate.

Author: BellaMaePopSouth Korea
Title: Yikes
Review: When we arrived it was full and we did not have a reservation, however the owner graciously got us a table in ten minutes. I regretted it immediately when I walked in . Very small space with minimal decor, seats about 30-35 people at 7-8 tables or so. Painted black with a few old pans hanging on the walls secured by white bathroom hooks. Music was playing but couldn’t hear it because it was so loud from people talking and from the extraction fan whirring from the kitchen. I had to essentially yell across the table to have a conversation. The menu is pretty basic- overpriced steaks with several generic sides to choose from. I had the sirloin with mashed potatoes and my wife had a ribeye with mash as well. The waiter tried to talk us into getting a 300 gram piece of meat instead of the 200 grams we wanted. Had trouble hearing him as well. Food comes out pretty quickly and our turnaround was about half an hour from seating. You get a basic salad with your steak and that’s it. Now for the steaks, quite deliciously prepared and cooked to perfection. We both thoroughly enjoyed them. The mash on the other hand tasted like it had been loaded up with butter, and I couldn’t shake the overwhelming taste of rosemary embedded in there. For a thirty minute, and near 100 USD meal, I don’t think it was worth it at all. Granted the steaks were tasty, but I felt stressed out amongst the noise. It was comparable to eating in a cheap school cafeteria, or IKEA on a Saturday afternoon. Bizarre experience indeed. In addition, no credits cards accepted, only cash. This is written on the door on a piece of paper, and again emphasized when you get the bill, also written in paper and taped on. Tacky to say the least. You’re better off spending your cash in one of the many other restaurants around this area.

Author: Shaukat A
Title: Great Nyonya Food in Melaka
Review: Extensive menu and amazing taste of some of the best Nyonya dishes. Enjoyed chicken curries, steamed vegetables and seafood dishes. Great flavours and highly recommended by myself.

Author: sbrady123London, United Kingdom
Title: Hard Rock without the ROCK
Review: My partner and I came here last night for the evening for a couple of bottles of wine, some nachos and to listen to the music. It started off well on arrival. Guitars from Kiss and Aerosmith on the wall, a jacket from The Beatles and a drum set from Van Halen. Rock and Roll!Sadly, this is where the rock ended. The reason people go to a Hard Rock Cafe, or the reason they do outside Malaysia perhaps, is for the Rock music. Both live and played by the DJ. In the four hours we spent there, I didn't hear anything that you'd expect in a Hard Rock. We really couldn't understand it. I started writing down some of the songs being played, as it was really puzzling me! So the DJ, amongst other stuff of the same variety, played Sean Paul, Mis-Teeq, Jennifer Lopez, Ja Rule, Fifth Harmony, Nelly and Beyonce. What?!Next came the band, T-Rex. Sadly, although they had an OK sound, they weren't a rock band like their namesakes. Don't get me wrong, they were lovely people and we spoke to them at the end and they were great. They weren't bad musicians. But they played Adele (twice), Taylor swift, Mark Ronson, Beyonce, Sam smith, Ellie Goulding, Carley Rae Jepson and Katy Perry!This is the Hard ROCK cafe. We had a lovely evening, but the place doesn't fit the brand. It was disappointing to hear this kind of music given the reason we went there in the first place. I checked to see if one of their memorabilia was Jennifer Lopez's hair brush on the way out!On a side note, the wine we had was nice (served at room temperature which was great), but the nachos were slightly disappointing. There were a lot of them, but need more dips and lots more cheese. GIVE ME SOME ROCK!

Author: Poje MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below average Pizza!
Review: Second time having pizza here, second time to much!As soon as you enter the place, the fake old dated green bush gives a really bad first feeling of the place. Ok, now strait to the point, the Pizzas: ordered the Meat ball pizza, and the Tony Sopranos pizza, both where just reheated, soft, not crusty, blend, and very chewy. So for the price asked, I don't think it's acceptable. My brother told me he still prefer the Pizza Hut (which i think is bad). Also the staff, being mostly foreigners, are not really welcoming. Not a nice place to have a good dinner.

Author: saffronsBournemouthBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Conveniently located
Review: Conveniently located in Brickfields, 5 minutes walk from Sentral Station. Looking at the decor, you could be in suburban England in an Indian restaurant - dark wood, light brown/white paintwork and table linen, pictures of dancers on walls, fusion music to be heard. The menu is basically North Indian, with a dozen South Indian items (perhaps a better choice, as this is apparently part of a South Indian chain). I chose Kadai mutton with nan: the meat was chewy, but the masala excellent. Bill: mutton, nan, 2 beers RM56.85.

Author: Grace EKL
Title: Pretentious and lack substance
Review: While we can forgive the waiter for prob not having the best day , the food was beyond disappointment.dont be mislead by the glamorous , 5 star looking interior because the food is all but that.they are priced slightly higher than the average restaurant here but dont expect the food to live up to its price. The beef shawarma sandwich was served in a tiny plate with a lone slice of tomato,that wasnt the problem cause it tasted so salty that you cant taste anything else but salt.the oriental rice with lamb is so amatuerish that we were in such disbelief it qualifies to be served in a restaurant.my lemon mint tea screamed powedered,instant, zero effort.wont be back for all the tea in the world.oh dont expect to be greeted upon arrival and leaving the restaurant. tarbush just down the street is a much better choice.

Author: Sally TAlbuquerque, New Mexico
Title: Nice beachside restaurant
Review: We were thrilled to find this place but that feeling was shortlived after an encounter of intentional overcharging. When we walked into the premises, a Chinese man stopped us in our tracks and requested us to place our food order and told us that they didn't have menus which appeared odd for such a nice big expensive restaurant. He was adamant that their small portion had to be 500gm even though we repeatedly told him that there was just two of us. Then my husband nicely told him that he'd settle for 400gm as we knew how much the prawns would cost. The fish was the next item and we chose a fish which weighed about 450gm and he offered to deep fried it and coated it with a spicy Thai sauce which sounded good to us. The last item was a small plate of Okra. The food was good except for the prawns which looked exceptionally huge when it arrived.... it was obvious that they stuck to their 500gm weight! We had a rude shock when we were presented with a bill of Rm178 for the small fish, prawns, okra, a bottle of beer, an orange juice and 2 glasses of warm water. My husband sought clarification form the lady who then had it amended to Rm129.95 which was a huge reduction indeed! It was obvious and intentional because the supportive orders tagged to the bill brought to us had figures written over them in several places! So check your bills before paying and seek clarification if you feel uneasy .... be in control when you dine here!

Author: Aachal CSydney, Australia
Title: Great views!
Review: Limited selection of cocktails which aren't anything to write home about. The food and dessert wasn't bad though. Really close up views of the Petronas Towers and KL city were worth the price. Caters for a well dressed crowd, so make sure you don't turn up in open toed shoes or a round neck shirt! Also, full of smokers and rather terrible music!

Author: Yogesh D
Title: Terrible food . Unhealthy Oil , Terrible food presentation
Review: Bad food, please avoid this place. Fries and burger is cooked in terrible unhealthy oil. I guess its low grade oil.  Second dish came with Uncooked grilled chicken

Author: mhhdgpj
Title: Dim Sums & Vegetarian
Review:
Services are good.
Location is good for business meeting. Environment is good for business lunch & dinner. 
Dim Sums are very niece. Vegetarian food is good. Try to cater more vegetarian food.

Author: MyLittleLife
Title: Authentic teo chew cuisine
Review: Went there recently for granny's bday celebration. A great place for family dining. Food was very nice.excellent customer service!staff are helpful and very responsive. Thumbs up!

Author: Julius F
Title: fantastic cuisine and service
Review: We had a nice evening with fantastic food and simply a perfect service. One of the most friendly waiters ever met. Thx for your great hospitality.

Author: foosunPetaling Jaya
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: Armed with no reviews or knowledge about this bar - we walked into this place attracted by the mosaics of colours mash up in the interior decor. That sets up the mood for the rest of the night.Service were decent and prompt. Although we only had the mixed beans salad and the Rellena Pizza - the food left a good impression especially the pizza which made somewhat alike to a calzone but not a calzone itself.The steam were rushing out the moment our fork and knifes dissected the pizza. We were amazed!

Author: shahsuffianKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Standards are falling - serving food late and not warm
Review: I had been disappointed with this specific establishment for a while, but given the new year was hoping that things would have changed after countless feedback. Sad to say that things haven’t changed. My son’s carbonara was not served hot and you wonder how long it was waiting to be served. Took 30 minutes for all the mains to be served, and that after asking several times what happened to the food. If there was a full house I can maybe be more understanding but when we came here tables were half empty. And only here is the practice of waving off customers an acceptable behaviour. Maybe KLCC should ask if the recently closed Cozy Corner in Ampang Park wants to take this place over...

Author: jgan2015Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: Besides the constant poor service, they didn't serve us fresh butter prawns. We had been regulars for 4 years solely for the food and it happened to us that one time. Spent a huge lump sum of medical fee rm380 after our meal there as my wife is due for work and we didn't expect this to happen.

Author: victory99
Title: Delicious food
Review: The foods r very delicious & cheaper . Every shops or streets have painting & plants . Love the town .

Author: malissam998
Title: Awesome Selections of Seafood in JB
Review:
Great options for fresh seafood. 

Tips: There is one chinese halal stall. Personally I think it's the best! And get the rojak kangkung aunty (end shop) to send you one plate. It's the bomb!

Author: realryanwatts
Title: Bad Review
Review:
We didnt have anything there because the place had only one baby seat in the restaurant . 
I do not recommend

Author: Cholla1
Title: Very disappointed
Review: I have lived in Spain and while some of the dishes are near to Spanish some are not very disappointed with the paella and size of the tapas. Staff should learn to smile the only one that did was the one breaking the plate. Think the food is more Spanish with a Malaysian twist. Would I go again, yes just to see if I went on a off night. Sorry was expecting more

Author: Suresh G
Title: AMAZING!
Review: Excellent place for original,unique, and scrumptious dishes. Throughly enjoyed ourselves, and their one of a kind cocktails is a must try!! We also went for 2nd round of oysters which had the BEST sauce served by the side I've ever had. Definitely a new and upcoming establishment, that's gonna make its mark on KL's culinary map.

Author: aydrianacSan Francisco, California
Title: Awesome vegan sushi with impeccable ethics!
Review: Come here if you love sushi but you don't love how fish are treated to get on our plates! :)Using fine ingredients that they list out, you know you're in good hands here. I recommend all of the sushi rolls but especially the 7 spice! The flavors are mouth watering! The Wakame salad was super fresh and spiced perfectly! I had to get it everytime! Do try the global warming rolls- they don't specify but they come out crispy and are so delicious!I also had the fried udon and I forget what it was called but something like red chilly udon -- that one was amazing! I'd come back again and again if in the area! 5 stars!

Author: anu26
Title: Royal n Delicious
Review: A very good place for indian delicacies..infact the best place i found for indian food and chaats in kuala lumpur..A must go for foodies..Ambience and taste goes hand in hand here..

Author: dianneg623
Title: Elegant dining with views of lush tropical gardens
Review: Excellent staff, attentive and intuitive!, food beautiful, included three dishes prepared and flambéd at the table! Could not fault this for fine dining.

Author: LL721
Title: Very good, reasonable price. Expect long queues.
Review: Be prepared for long queues as this is a really popular noodle house. We absolutely love the soup and sometimes the pork slices are sold out.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: decent variety & price...
Review: A typical mamak that is open 24 hours. A decent variety of dishes to choose from at an affordable price especially in Brickfields. Service is fast & attentive. Place could use a bit of cleaning up but it isn't dirty. Notable mentions would be the fried mee or rice, roti canai, tosai & freshly fried chicken. They also serve vegetarian dishes. Worth a visit when in the area.

Author: Teddy_May
Title: Great view and service
Review: Love the view and service of friendly staffs here. For the taste of food based on 2 menus I tried in the photo, I think it’s just ok.

Author: Climber489653
Title: Cozy
Review:
The environment is comfortable and awesome.
Staffs are well trained.
Good food with great smile.
Nice cafe.

Author: Matt E
Title: Have the waiters actually received training?
Review: We ordered takeaway. Out from the kitchen come three plates of food, no cutlery, no napkins, no tray. Another evening we ordered fries to the room. Arrives without napkins and cutlery, no salt or pepper, not even ketchup. Another night I ordered a Caesar salad. A plate of lettuce was handed to me. That's it. A lower standard from a 5 star restaurant we have yet to experience.

Author: TomVegas1Dover, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went the Hard Rock Cafe off the cuff as we walked past and it was so hot we needed a drink! When we got in we decided to eat aswell. It was not the best.Firstly, although a positive for us the air conditioning was set very very cold. I could see this being a bit off putting but in our condition we didnt care and were grateful! We were sat in a window seat and ordered garlic bread to share as a starter and a burger each for main. The burger arrived quickly... no garlic bread! Before we could mention this the waiter disappeared! By the time they came back we had nearly finished, I asked about the garlic bread and the waiter apologised, said they forgot and would get it for us!The burger was okay as was the garlic bread.After finishing the garlic bread this was taken away and then no one said a word to us for about 20 mins. Despite us wanting a desert. Eventually I just asked for the bill and we went elsewhere for desert!On a plus side I did get my Hard Rock KL pin for my gutair strap!

Author: Toni-as-criticRhineland-Palatinate, Germany
Title: A unique place with excellent food
Review: There is shame in wanting some familiar food, when travelling in Asia. So this is the place for all liking Swiss or German food. The restaurant has a unique interior with old clocks, gas lights (most of them now electric) and the menu is great in choice of drinks and food. The service was fast and very friendly.Unfortunately it closes on Sundays at 6pm and stays closed on Mondays, so we managed only one meal there.

Author: NikhilB_12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food not delicious
Review: We went there in a group of 12 people and that time a lot of people were in the restaurant. There service is fast and good and they did not take much time to bring our order. We also like restaurant ambiance.We felt the food is pricey (may be bcoz its inside KLCC). but taste also so so only, not delicious.For a thai restaurant like this we expect at least tom yum soup to be tasty but we were disappointed. Even red curry chicken & green curry chicken also okay only.

Author: kavipriyasellan2209
Title: BAD SERVICES!!!!!
Review: The service was too bad.  No respect at all.  Was very bad.  Dissapointed 😠 the waitress was so rude . The food received too late.

Author: Charlene722Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Captain's offer being rejected by boss because our spending is less than RM2000
Review: I was at yezi for dinner with my family I was a bit disappointed as the promotion of 15% off for Cimb card no longer available. The good captain who know that I was disappointed offered me 2 desserts. No doubt the food there is fabulous.The captain said that he will need to give the boss a call to get permission when I jokingly requested 3 desserts and so I thought why not. I wasn't that disappointed when he told me that he cannot give me the extra dessert that I requested but I was EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED when he tells me that even the 2 desserts he offered was being rejected by the boss. That was worst than I thought as I did not anticipated such outcome! I was really annoyed, it is not that I there to beg for a discount but as a regular customer for two years I was totally disappointed.Anyway, I apprediated what the captain had done for us. P/s :- Our spending that amount to rm1355 doesn't not contain any seafood, and we ordered 9 desserts which cost RM195 of the total bill.

Author: Prakash VChennai (Madras), India
Title: Vegetarians have limited options, but visit never the less for clean place & value for money
Review: Restoran Kirans Delights in Melaka, Malaysia boasts of South & North Indian Cuisine. When we went inside, we were slightly disappointed to learn that only vegetarian food available was Dosa and Rice.This is a spacious restaurant and is clean. The service is good, and our food was served quite fast, given the crowd in the hotel.The dosas were good, so was the sambar. Biryani (indian flavored pullao variety of Hyderabad) was ok, but lacked the flavor and taste of its Indian namesake.If you are visiting Melaka and want to have Indian food, you can visit here. There is not much variety, but that's alright when you are in such kind of a town.

Author: FamilyHobbsCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: After reading such good reviews on here, we tried this place ourselves opting for Special Laksa (the most expensive of all the dishes offered). There was a lot of it, but the prawns were overcooked, rubbery and flavourless. The service was poor with only 2 staff who were constantly staring at their phones.

Author: richo15cHong Kong Island, China
Title: Cracker find
Review: Walked around Georgetown spent days eating the local food( wonderful flavoursome and cheap)Turned corner into Lebuh Campbell and there is Il Bacaro .Great Italian diversity from Penang flavours and a small respite from the thunderstorms and humidity.recommend for its Genuine Italian feel . Speak with the waiters and you know they arent local and the good is fresh and clean Italian .Wonderful

Author: 927devashishsIndia
Title: Unexpected and disappointed
Review: Me and my friends were very hungry today, always ordered Dosa here but this time thought of trying something new. Everything else is meaningless especially the COMBOS. Prota is another dish which is like chapati and we call it 'Parantha' in north India. When served it looked like a pasta with no taste at all. I would recommend everyone to have only Dosa and Masala tea here.

Author: suhaidab2016
Title: Very rude and inconsiderate staff
Review: Staff is very rude, inconsiderate and idiot. Arrived early 5:50 thinking it open at 6pm and upon arriving no one greet us. There was one staff was walking here and there and clearly can see us. When we asked only he told us they open at 6:30pm. My kids was playing around in the courtyard and one of them went inside. I went in to get him and one staff wearing singlet pointing finger at me telling me to go out. He could have say it nicely instead just a gesture like that. So we waited until 6:30 then we are allowed to get in, and was offered a table with sofa chair, the problem with this type of chair is my wife was wearing something like kebaya and it was tight with high heels. The seat was so low almost like japanese setting it will definitely be uncomfortable for her and her sister to sit and we still need space for two baby chair. So i asked for another table which was available and there were no reservation sign on it but the staff insist for us to seat there in isolation from other patrons. I was like wtf. What really pisses me off is this is not my first time here. The thing is if im almost regular there can be treated like this imagine if it was my first. So yes i just walk out and will never ever come here again n i will make sure non of my family and friends will go as well. We still have bombay palace, sager in bangsar, alia, and etc in klang valley.

Author: 182cheelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast place during RMCO
Review: Very big portions. We have cut all the sides the next day breakfast. Its nice and service is excellence. The only breakfast place at le meridien during this period.

Title: Good food
Review: This is actually a Food Stall in the Food Court at NU Sentral Mall. Some dishes were very good, some so so, but overall a good experience.

Author: bertlee86Miri, Malaysia
Title: Not bad, not bad...
Review: Nice small like artsy cafe with a variety of dishes served. We had the pan fried salmon which was good. Love the wasabi mayonnaise dressing on the salad. Home made linguine pasta was pretty good as well and they were generous with the prawns. But the creamy mushroom soup was terrible, was more a starchy can mushroom soup rather than a creamy fresh made on. My opinion anyways...

Author: luisp709Parede, Portugal
Title: Suberb!
Review: Excellent at all levels! We went for dinner and we were a group of 12. We previous booked table and food and everything was delicious. The restaurant is away from KL, in the jungle, so you get the feeling and the sounds of being for real in the jungle. The decor is buda, minimalistic and very nice.

Author: faez18Singapore, Singapore
Title: High Tea Worst Service!
Review: Waited for more than an hour for our high tea set when we are clearly the first to arrive! The other 2 guests received theirs first and the lady staff was not attentive at all! She served my coffee first when no guests was there but did not bother when we received our Mango Tango HighTea set after the other 2 tables was served by her! Had to asked to changed my coffee twice because it was cold as i was waiting for my hightea set! Came up to the counter and ask for a guy manager who approached me first when we arrived. Waited 20mins. Did not turn up. Went to counter again and asked for him but another guy with blazer came and all he did was apologised,gave us a feedback form that requires us to write a good feedback because the card says something like Catch us at our best. And then pass us a box of sandwich and salad!!! When we did not want that! We just want to tell you that we came first n why are we not receiving our set first? We are not that cheap to want a sandwich from you!! And he said he is new! Great! Means you dont know things!! Why make your guest feel cheap by apologising then pass them a "feedback" form to say good stuffs then give them a sandwich!!! Are you seriously kidding me??! Do you even know which name n company are you working for? Disgusted. Drinks was messed up. Asked for a glass of red wine n they brought 2!! Asked for a Cosmopolitan and there wasnt any alcohol in it!! Until the ending when that manager who approached me at the start came and made another coffee for me which tasted way better than the one the lady made or brought from somewhere. Overall extremely poor quality of service from the lady n the new guy. Savoury sandwiches not that great but the sweets are nice!
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Zen BDalcahue, Chile
Title: One of the worst meals I've ever had
Review: It's bad manners to be on the phone at dinner but I can't believe how bad the food is. We ordered chicken, fried pork knuckle and broccoli with tofu. It was the toughest chicken I've ever had. Even the drumstick which is suppose to be tender is as tough as rubber. The pork knuckle is mediocre with minimal meat on it. To top it off, the broccoli and tofu only filled half the plate with a a few broccoli and tofu. There were more carrots than anything else. I would be able to overlook everything but the food didn't taste good and it was just bad.

Author: kakiayamEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Quick drink/food at this family run coffee shop
Review: Been a few times to eat Sarawak Laksa. The people who runs the place are quick to take your drinks order. Some of stalls serve food in the evening or early morning only. The laksa and chicken rice stalls seem to be opened all day until they ran out of stock. They also serve fried noodles (possibly all day). There's a beef noodle stall but I've never seen it open during the lunchtime. I heard that the noodle is good and it opens in the evening only.The prices are cheap for drinks and there's a price menu at the wall for the drinks. If there's no price for the beer, just ask.You can get a meal from MYR4 onwards.

Author: beatricel330
Title: Duck Lover Paradise
Review: Went to this restaurant with my friend. We order quite a lots and had a fully stuffed tummy back home. Soup was too oily but Char Siew, Siu Yok and Duck was so good! Is like literally sooooo good. Had a good time eating here....Not forget to mention, they have massive menu with tons of food varieties.More

Author: 709shawngPerth, Australia
Title: Lunch with a view
Review: Rode up to rimba for lunch, (for those walking up expect a bit of a hike up the driveway). Greeted with the customary friendly welcome and sat outside overlooking the treetops and water. A pleasant way to enjoy lunch. The food was good with a lot of flavour with my wife really enjoying her prawn dish. A enjoyable lunch indeed.

Author: job v
Title: Wrong time and place
Review: We visited the restaurant after visiting Sarawak cultural village at 1500 hours. Nice waitress but half of the menu was net available. When the western food came it was a pizza from the fridge and the burgers were half raw. Cheap food which was therefore overprized. It has potential because the place is great at the beach. For a drink I would visit it again.

Author: fovant
Title: Slugs in the lettuce
Review: Not hygienic enough, I expected better from a major tourist attraction,  especially the biggest of it's kind in the World

Author: 1972jazz
Title: Very good bar and restaurant
Review: Highly recommend visiting Healy Macs - great food and guiness served my Prity lovely Indian girl made us feel very welcome. Will come back again 👌thankyou

Author: BobBobGolden
Title: Excellent food but poor setting
Review:
Suggested by friends to visit. It is more like a canteen. May be we arrived at 6pm.
Decided not to stay and take away the food. It taste great even after 30 min.

Author: ganeshc170
Title: Great Place Excellent Food
Review: Really love the food . Great place to hangout for relax moment . Staff and management really helpful and accommodative .if you love  North Indian food , this will best choice

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great food and good service
Review: Came here by 10:30pm and the kitchen close by 10:30pm . Just in time for last ordering of food , had oxtail soup and spaghetti here . Nachos with tomato dip on the side . Relaxing place and nice ambience . Waiter was helpful and attentive .

Author: RAHUL S
Title: No Indian food. Just making stupid
Review:
Only tells that Indian food. But not test like Indian. You ordered any dish test is same.

It just hybrid restaurant of Chinese food mixed with Indian curry.

Very very bad test.

Author: Chia-i H
Title: City Trip in Johor Bahru
Review: We can only recommend as europeans having travelled a lot in Italy! The quality of the food is top! Most importantly, it is authentic! We love it and will definitely come back!!

Author: becksangel7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Get your pizza cravings satisfied here
Review: Really good pizza's. Starts from RM9 for the original and goes up to around RM14-15 per slice for those with toppings. The waffle fries are a good try though I couldn't finish the portion - found it too rich with the cheese but wouldn't be a problem for cheese lovers. Buffalo chicken was so-so, wouldn't have it again. Definitely worth a visit back for days you feel like having good pizza. One slice of pizza, buffalo chicken, waffle fries and a soft drink cost approx RM42.

Author: azrin73
Title: Mid east food galore
Review: Looking for an arab restaurant that is reasonably price with good environment and deco do come to Hadramawt. The food is good the restaurant is very comfortable and the serving is big.

Author: natedeljoseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Such a dissapointment
Review: The food is cold. The papadom are squishy which is supposed to be crunchy. The set we ordered supposed to comes with coffee unfortunately, the waiter never served it. Me and my partner couldn't finish the food. Such a waste of time and money. That would be the first and last time I visit that restaurant. I left the restaurant with huge disappointment. How could they serve cold food to their customer? Where are the supervisor? That is the most terrible restaurant I have ever visited.

Author: Lai Y
Title: FUN & PLEASANT EXPERIENCE
Review: It's a fun thing to do and the setting is beautiful. I enjoyed the wing walk but please make sure you won't wear skirt if you want to do this. Food was so so though. Wine and beer are reasonably priced.

Author: Kitty0811London, United Kingdom
Title: Weekday lunch
Review: The location is good ish, I guess. We ordered the set menu for lunch. The food was disappointed for a Hard Rock Cafe standard. The service is poor. The cafe is literally empty, the stuff at bar is fooling around and the waiters are mostly hiding in the kitchen. We were left alone for half an hour after we finished our food. We physically went to the front reception to get our own bill.

Author: Iwan34Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Bad Service ...
Review: Went on a Sunday with 2 friends , the restaurant was busy with few small groups. Already had a bad feeling on service when we were asked to wait for sometime for them to clear an empty table. Once seated made us wait for half hour just to order. Tehy keep ignoring the bell numbering system, actually should just dont have that. More interested to take care of bigger groups than individual tables with 2-3 persons. We walked out and they just see and ignore us. Too much business for them I thinkl...Will never go there again. Tried it before and was okay but this time really kill off the intention.

Author: JeanWNSingapore, Singapore
Title: First Visit, cautious review
Review: Was taken to this Resturant/Bar/Coffee House with Sports on TV. Tried the Smoked duck salad, nice wish there was a tad more duck slices. Nachos for starters. Chicken with basil pesto, a bit dry but tasty. Son liked it, had it 2 times (on diff occasions) Had the pizza but have had better. Ambience not bad, airy, not too noisy but don’t sit facing kitchen coz you’ll be treated to a view of wet floor. Perhaps something to block this would be just the trick. Had a good evening meal. Left happy, pleasant service.

Author: ZoeR1090Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overcooked
Review: We are big fans of Japanese cuisine and was feeling a bit dissapointed after eating here. The restaurant ambience was nice, friendly staff and services but the food was not my liking. My honey salmon was overcooked, and and overcooked salmon is not nice. The grilled saba was so salty, we have to chunk it down fast with rice to get rid of the saltiness. The tofu was okay. The drinks was okay. We didnt taste the sushi so i cant say much about it. No next time i guess.

Author: Julia E
Title: very very tasty  Sarawak  kind of dishes
Review: A 24hrs halal Malay stall infront  of Pullman hotel. Myb doesn't  suits our western friends unless u wanna giv it a try.

Author: Ivan B
Title: Worst place, poor dishes
Review: Do not go there. The photos are nice but the real inner atmosphere is  poor. The meat is poor, the salads are average, the AC is weak, no view, no air, wine is like poison. The staff is fine but not the high steakhouse quality.

Author: SamtaSharma1997
Title: Don't know the difference between veg and non-veg
Review: We are pure nvegetarians and as the name says, it serves vegetarian, we wen5t for lunch. We ordered onion uttapam (I said exactly onion uttapam in English, nothing else). First, it came very late. Second, when we started eating it, we found it too soft for uttapam. After we had two three bites, we realised IT HAD EGG in it. How can you do this to anyone who's hasn't eaten anything non-vegetarian in life? I complained and became very frustrated. The staff said, sorry it happened by mistake. But what my point was, it is not a small mistake. IT IS NOT JUST A MISTAKE. IT IS A VERY BIG DEAL. I talked to the person at the cash counter too and we left. I came back to have water because we were very disgusted by the whole thing. I asked them water and there was a man who rudely asked me to shut up and go. This was when my husband came and had a word with that man. He was not even from the shop, I guess. And guess what? The whole hotel staff didn't even uttered a single word to that man that it was their fault and he is nobody to come between the two parties involved. Please guide me if I can do something. This is a real big deal for me and my husband. Food is just not food. It is a very important aspect to which these people should stay honest.
Restaurant: Vinni Jeyaa Banana Leaf Curry House

Author: T4063UCandykEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing experience!!!
Review: Went out of our way to visit this restaurant on the basis of reviews. Acknowledging we ordered with little knowledge of the different dishes, we only got two of the five dishes we ordered. We were told that one of the dishes of fish head was too big. I said I would like to try it but it never arrived. Neither did the chicken curry and rice we ordered. A plastic tab arrived on the table with no explanation that this was our bill. So we sat with the bill on our table waiting for our food. After a while we tried to find out was happening and we were told that our food wasn't coming. Obviously, a popular local eatery but our experience wasn't very good. Of the two dishes we did get, the butter naan was excellent, the rojak not to my taste.

Author: TheBortz
Title: Delicious ramen.
Review: It was my night between my co-worker and myself to choose the place for dinner. I just pulled up TripAdvisor and selected the best rated, closest place to the hotel.My co-worker said he wasn't really a ramen person when I told him my choice, but said he'd try it anyway. He later left the restaurant raving about how delicious it was.I went with the signature dish—kakuni bankara. I also got some gyoza. The gyoza were cooked perfectly, but bland. The ramen was great—very flavorful broth—but they were awfully stingy on the pork, and the noodles weren't fresh. A pretty tasty meal, overall.

Author: JamesKMTan
Title: Authentic limited but cozy
Review: I went there for the buffet lunch with my friends. The choice of the buffet is very limited though they keep replenishing it. The place is cozy but slightly noisy. Their briyani and dishes are just average.

Author: NotAbby
Title: Fish but no Chips
Review: Thought we would try the restaurant having previously bought fresh fish from the adjoining shop. We were hopeful for some really good fish and chips yet to be had in KL but we're disappointed. One daughter had the breaded plaice which came with chips other daughter had mussels and requested some chips but was told no they could not do chips! She was offered some wedges but when they arrived they were truly horrible brown and over cooked not nice at all. My grilled barramundi was fine but expensive at more than 60 RM plus. The decor is nice and the service ok. Not sure the open kitchen adds to the ambience. Seemed to be plenty of fresh oysters available. Girls enjoyed the chocolate brownie for dessert. Sorry but will not rush back.

Author: Niamh C
Title: Awful service
Review: The staff are absolutely horrendous here. Firstly, we were ignored at the entrance while waiting to be seated while multiple staff members walked by us. None of the staff smile either which is never off putting. They just stand around on their phones.Our order took over 40 minutes to come, with our side order coming 15 mins before our wings. The people sitting beside us (who came in 15 mins after us) were served there food after 10 mins where as we waited 40 mins. We will definitely not be back!

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: could be great but ...
Review: Atmosphere wise this place is awesome. Their layout is great with multiple nooks and corners. Great for group outings or even a quiet romantic date. They play a good selection of music and knows how to keep the crowd entertained. However that is where the positives end.The overall service of this place is poor. Like the comments below they seem to favour foreigners more. Getting the attention of the waiter is difficult and at times they even forget. In terms of getting a table upstairs you have to open multiple bottles or they won' even entertain you. However if you are a foreigner you don't even have to agree to any arrangement just order what you want.Sad I know at this day and age but guess they just prefer foreigners over locals. Which is an awful policy if true. Wouldn't really recommend folks to this place. They are so many others along the street who treat everyone fairly.

Author: Onlyrealreview
Title: Bad experience
Review:
Order came wrong, need to wait for additional 10 mins.

Complementary chicken they served is cold.

Stall manager cannot handle crisis. 

Food is average. 
Expensive. 

Not worth it at all.

They got no facebook review page, hence I'm finding whichever place that can leave review.

Author: vijimelbs
Title: Dinner at Aliyaa
Review: Great ambience and good dinning spirit, staffs were very attentive n the best was the food, we all loved it so much that we planned another visit

Author: Nicholas G
Title: Old brand serving great food
Review: Make sure you make reservations instead of walk in. The crowd is still unbeliveable. From the time my parents married here till today, the food is still awesome. It is old school yum. Even some of the servers are still here.

Author: noisyminor
Title: Really good duck but other dishes are only average
Review: We were here for a family gathering. Service was prompt and courteous, though the waiter forgot our water and and had to remind him again. The best dish was definitely the roasted duck. Its skin was crispy and meat fleshy, moist and juicy. The sauce on the plate was awesome to compliment the duck and no wonders they don't offer the usual suspect, plum sauce. It was certainly unnecessary! could even debone for you and that was great as we have some kids with us. However, we don't find other dishes outstanding but merely average. The deep fried cod with fine ginger strips and steam cod with garlic were probably slightly better. The bbq pork was tasty but harder bite as it was really lean. The roasted pork was just ordinary. We reckon it is good for a place for a quite plate of dry plain noodles with duck while shopping. But not for a special occasion as it can be quite noisy too.

Author: dougg812
Title: Welcomed addition
Review: New and finding its feet, but a welcome addition. Great beers, enthusiastic service and tasty food. A really great addition to KLCC. It will be my new local!!

Author: Asteroid2015
Title: Greet food not expensive
Review: Had lobster and prawns for dinner and the bill came to less $70 with drinks as well. Beer is $1.50 a can. Food was great

Author: -aquamaryn-
Title: Like the food, hate the service..!
Review: Went there for a quiet dinner out with family to celebrate. In with high spirits, left on a low. Never got the menu until 10-15 minutes later, after many attempts to ask for one. Ordering was even worse- they never came to take the orders even after one of us asked for a waiter, one of whom was at a station writing something. All we got was a curt "Wait a minute", and needless to say, we waited ages before we ordered anything- worse still, that waiter never even came to serve us. With orders done, we thought that the dinner would proceed smoothly, but we ended up with a missing dish- only one of 2 identical fish dishes arrived, leaving one of us without dinner for nearly 45 minutes. Hungry and irritated, the night was basically ruined. On the upside, the steak was great, but the other meals were poorly done. Roasted chicken was too dry, albeit saved by the tasty sauce, and the lamb was a tad too salty. Still, I went there to enjoy the company, and the terrible service truly did no wonders to that cause.

Author: johnyboy010Rotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Not really
Review: The food was ok. The staff on the other hand, a disaster. Had to get up a few times to get my own wine. In the middle of our dinner I was asked if I could pay (whut?). Very strange. Worth the money on Christmas? Barely I have to say. I used to enjoy Tosca, no idea what’s going wrong there.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Kimberly LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but overpriced
Review: Overall, the food was pretty decent. You have the option of noodles or rice to go with the chicken, and both are tasty! I find the chicken meat too tough though. Four of us ordered a half chicken which wasn't enough meat for us. The meal (including two bowls of fishball soup and drinks) was pretty pricey, coming up to MYR76 for 4 people. Three different touts approached us during our meal, which didn't make for that pleasant a dining experience. Overall, the food was not bad, but I wouldn't call it a must-have for tourists in Ipoh.

Author: Vagabundus5891Miesbach, Germany
Title: Birthday Cancelled
Review: Headed here for a awesome birthday celebration! Arrived a little late but still caught the end of the band!very cool so got a round of drinks. Didn't know what would follow would be a blitz of techno. So disgusting I couldn't finish my pint (shed a tear, pints in KL are expensive). I expect this in any other bar than one named rock bottom. Spoke to the manager Azizie M.Y was less than sympathetic, heads up folks this place turns into a techno inferno in the early hours, no apologies. So just incase you wanted a rocknroll birthday look elsewhere.

Author: Emma_CubeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: If you like to sit in a restaurant environment go here
Review: The food was good, not great, but good enough and fairly well priced for a restaurant. If you like to sit in a restaurant environment then go here. There were lots of tourists in there and this was reflected in their menu with some mild curries and some English curries. Personally I prefer the cheaper Indian canteens with the locals, so if you're after that environment don't go here! :)

Author: GardenCafeInKemaman
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: This is another place to have the Malacca chicken rice ball. Surprisingly this place is huge with good and fast service.

Author: E1972LEkarenl
Title: Simple & tasty local chinese foods
Review: Air-conditioned & cooling, clean & simple furnishing. Very good fried carrot cake, and some other chinese dishes. Recommend their BBQ noodle & fried horfun.

Author: ExBankerIpswich, United Kingdom
Title: A busy cafe
Review: Clearly very popular, it is a bustling place with rapid service and a wide range of food choices, within the Malaysian theme. We were looking for a quick economic evening meal, not too big which introduced us to local fare and we felt we had got it. We did not really expect it to be so brash and noisy, with cafe-style tables and chairs. Service was quick and well-drilled.

Author: CalvinTKC
Title: Birthday Surprise for love one
Review: Amazing Authentic Japanese Food, great service.. Special thanks to the Service crew Sorfina, Celine, April, Shahad, Christine & chef Ben. Keep up the good work.

Author: paulyny2017Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Birthday gathering
Review: My husband had a birthday gathering with friends at Sanga. It is an awesome place to have gathering especially if you are a salmon lover. We had ordered a whole salmon and the chef had turn the fish into multiple delicious and wonderful dishes. The boss is so nice and even allowed us to use the side space and decoration into photo booth. We had a wonderful and fun brithday gathering dinner.

Author: BatmanSupermanHong Kong
Title: Average and commercialised tasting food
Review: We tried this restaurant as it is close to our hotel. It is staffed by non Peranakan and it does not seem authentic. Commercialised food. Not great but not too bad either. Service seems fast. Average menu. Nothing really worth calling out for. Just one of the many. Manis J is far better.

Author: fqtravellernd
Title: Away from heat and rain and all things crowded
Review:
Good location.. good place to hide away from the hide or rain or even the crowds. 
Food and drinks are ok.. the music and dancing makes it a fun place to be around in the evenings.

Author: EdAdni
Title: Good
Review:
Food was not the best ever but still OK. 
Staff was very nice and friendly
We were there on a monday night, where there is a live Jazz concert, which was very nice.

Author: Corrado_foodpashaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Italian for foreigners, poor
Review: Being Italian, lunch was a bad experience. when i see a carbonara with cream I know i am in the wrong place. and it went downhill from there. poor.

Author: tieneit
Title: Cheap and Good
Review: One stop center for hawker food for both locals and tourist. Variety of food at a very low price. Chicken, BBQ pork and roast pork rice a must for my family for every visit.

Author: Iqa I
Title: Concept was good
Review: Was here with friends and like how there's so many restaurants to choose from. Walked around for a while before deciding which one should we settle for. We all decided to try the Chinese restaurant, it was so so as the menu was not that much, was told by waiter when asked that it's more of dim sum restaurant. The dim sum there was ok, not bad but wish we were there for breakfast and not dinner. Maybe we will come back

Author: CF282
Title: Poor service, average food, nice location
Review: The location of this cafe is lovely - on the river, with pretty duo tables with candles on them etc. The food - I had pizza - was fine, small in size and average in terms of taste. The service was diabolical - we ordered a large bottle of water for two people and it came with one glass, I asked for a margherita pizza but a vegetarian was brought - and when I pointed out we had the wrong pizza brought, there was no apology. So many other nice places along the canal - do yourself a favour and avoid this one.

Author: yiningl2014Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Photo worthy only
Review: Place was very crowded and any photo taking spots. Dissapointed with the overpriced food. Portion was small and food tasted bland. There are plenty of better cafe with high qualoty food in kl. Doesnt worth to travel this far and find parking for a long period just for an awful beakfast

Author: MelbourneStickMelbourne
Title: Be prepared and you'll have an excellent meal.
Review: The first time we went it was about 12:30 and there was a significant queue forming. We were told there would be a 20 minute wait. My partner couldn't face standing around so we left and went somewhere else.Later that evening we got a good tip that the thing to do is to grab the menu and order while standing in the queue. The next day we went back determined to do exactly that. To our surprise we got seated immediately. The lunch rush slows significantly around 2pm.Amongst the dishes we ordered the House Made Tofu was a real standout, Everything else looked really good too. Sadly there were only two of us eating so I didn't get to try more dishes.

Author: poshpackertravellerTokyo Prefecture, Japan
Title: Ambience says it all!
Review: From the moment you stepped through the entrance and stroll along the beautiful path, decorated with a grand bhodisatva stone carving and dimly lit - the place evokes quiet, peaceful and relaxed surroundings.The bar service and their cocktails were excellent and so is their food menu. Ask for one of the senior waiters to help you choose - as one of them has been there the longest and always makes great choices for us.

Author: Newfie013
Title: Interesting experience
Review: Went at 8pm on a Thursday and it was very busy.  The atmosphere of the restaurant is interesting and the food is well prepared.  The service was friendly and efficient.  The most interesting part was people watching!!!

Author: PoleinaholeSwitzerland
Title: Decent Pakistani & North Indian Food
Review: In an area of town surrounded by Chinese eateries it was good to find this option.Like it’s Chinese cousins, It’s a simple road side restaurant with a tiny kitchen, a toilet, sink and inside and outside seating.They are open at 6 am for your roti fix—Milo rôtis anyone?I had dinner there. As others have noted, the Tandoori Chicken is excellent— moist and beautifully spiced.Raita was average. Didn’t seem the freshest.Tarka dal and plain daal average. They wrote out of saag paneer.They have fresh lime juice and lasdus.Service quick and kindly. It’s not a place yo write home about but I would happily eat here again.

Author: Pubalan
Title: Best Cheese Naan
Review: Honestly, I never taste cheese naan like the one at RSMY anywhere else. Highly recommend this place to anyone.

Author: SphingxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Went for tapas, got tidak-apas instead.
Review: When The Barn first opened in 1 Mont Kiara, the place was packed. You couldn't get a table because they were booked full night after night. Fast forward a few months later: now that the novelty has worn off, the place is not even half full on a Saturday evening. I should have taken that as a warning sign that something was not right.I suppose it's the decor that attracts people because it really is very impressive and well done. Tasteful wood and black iron textures on the wall, nice tables, pleasant lighting and of course the artsy array of wine bottles in the glass wine room. Unfortunately, you can't eat the decor, and that's where the problem with The Barn lies: because The Barn menu lies. The food is advertised as 'Firegrill', 'Small plates' and 'Tapas'. Well they got the 'Small Plates' part right, but if you've ever had real tapas of any kind you'd realise right away that calling what they serve you would be an insult to the Spanish. As it is, some of what they think they can get away with serving you really is an insult to the customer.Of the set of 3 normal tapas (Calamari rings, open face 'sandwich', luncheon fries) and 2 'heavenly plate' tapas (anchovy and spinach fritter, 'wild' mushroom and chorizo) and 1 salad (chorizo salad) that we ordered , only a few were edible or looked like what was advertised in the menu. I don't know if the cooks even taste their own cooking, but I suspect they don't.The salad arrived flooded with this horrible sugary vinegary dressing. I am not kidding when I say flooded... there was literally a pool of black dressing at least 1 cm deep pooling at the bottom of the bowl. The entire salad was stained black with with it and we couldn't taste anything but the dressing if we tried eating it. We pointed this out to the servers who promised to make us a new one. We asked fro the dressing on the side. They said sure. When they presented the new order, it was the same, drizzled with dressing on top again. Maybe they put a bit less this time but quite annoying when we specifically asked for the dressing on the side. Sent back again.
