Kitchen got the message this time but pretty sure the 3rd time was just the previous salad rinsed it off, there were oil traces and a pool of water on the bottom of the salad bowl which wouldn't have been the case if it was a fresh bowl. Rather not waste good veg so fine with that, but yeesh... at least dry the rinsed salad properly please?The open faced sandwich looks nothing like the menu picture. To be honest all it was was a piece of common white sandwich bread, cut in a circle, soggy and floppy, with a quail's egg on top. Serving it on a wooden board doesn't make this any more impressive.Calamari rings and luncheon fries were ok. Nothing special, batter is not the greatest in the world, but at least they look like what was ordered and tasted like food.The heavenly plate 'wild' mushroom and chorizo was ok, nothing astounding, but it's really hard to mess up cooking chorizo, which is already flavourful and mushroom anyway. I should mention that the 'wild' mushroom are basically just normal farmed chestnut criminy mushrooms though. I'm not sure why they call it 'wild'. Maybe to make it sound more impressive?And now we get to the worst offender: the so-called 'anchovy and spinach fritter'. When we asked before ordering, the server, who could barely speak English, tries to explain it as 'something like a cookie-size'. What it really is an insipid little disc of tasteless flour batter fried, not even properly cooked (the middle was raw) or seasoned, flecked with the occasional bit of chopped spinach, and no anchovy in sight. I ate one and a half of those horrible things without getting a bite of anchovy OR any kind of flavour just to make sure it wasn't some sort of fluke, but gave up at that point. Seriously, it should be illegal to serve 4 pieces of this for RM 12+ as a 'heavenly dish'. If it was being sold by a roadside stall for RM 1 a bag, no one would buy this. Props to the manager though, when I complained and asked them to try and actually eat this thing, they took it back and offered to change with something else on the menu instead. I took up the offer, ordered the dry roasted ribs instead. While nothing amazing, it actually tasted like ribs that it didn't feel like I was being ripped off, which the fritters really did.Service-wise, there seem to be way too many clueless workers standing around doing nothing, and when they do attend to you, they seem to have severe communication issues with the customer, the kitchen, and basically everyone. Other than the salad incident above, the kitchen also sent in yet another plate of those horrible fritters well after I changed my order. We explained and they took it away. To be honest, the floor supervisor seems to be the only one capable of doing anything right, alas she cannot be everywhere all the time.We ordered the Paulaner since the wine selection did not appeal to us, to give credit where it is due, this was served properly, with chilled glasses and no watered down or stale taste.I really wanted to like The Barn because the place does look nice and it's nice to see a place that appreciates wine (selection and price might not be the greatest, but hey at least they are trying) but the no-quality-control food thanks to the 'tidak apa' attitudes of the kitchen and the confused service really is problematic. I will not be coming back again.I think the next time I want a meal with wine, I'd rather head up to Publika and take my pick from the wine section at B.I.G. and eat at one of the restaurants there instead.

Author: C3451ZUmichaelt
Title: Dinner with friends
Review:
Have is reasonable and good. Dinner is overcrowded and share the Long table is crump. 
Good for big group to share food.

Author: azrulhanis
Title: "Secret Society Hong Hua Hui"
Review: They are not professional mixologist. SSHHH is the hobby house and they just love to share  their love toward drinking of underground secret society...

Author: John TPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Well looked after
Review: All of the guide books tell you how wonderful the street food is in George Town, but unless you are a local, or have acquired previous experience, it's not always easy to know what, or how, to order in an environment where neither the cuisine nor the language is familiar. (Our evening at the seafood food court on Lebuh Duke - VERY popular with the locals - was a case in point, we ended up eating a plate of chopped fish cakes, prawns, potatoes etc in a sweetish red sauce and not really enjoying the experience since we had no idea what to expect and very little opportunity to influence the food preparation}. This must account for much of the popularity of Ivy's Nyonya Cuisine, where the proprietor, who speaks fluent English, gives forthright advice and - to novices like ourselves - recommends the set menu and helps you to pick out the individual choices on it.... since the names generally mean very little to the uninitiated. As a result there was none of the "ordering anxiety" which can otherwise accompany meals in unfamiliar surroundings, and we felt well looked after from start to finish when our host ordered a taxi for us.It is difficult for us to judge the food itself without having much knowledge of local Chinese-Malay cuisine. It was all tasty, but nothing had us jumping up and down in excitement at a new discovery. To my mind the best and most surprising taste was the combination of spicy sambal with cooked vegetables and mushrooms which we were invited to wrap in the lettuce leaves provided! The fresh pineapple and ginger drink was also very good. Asian desserts are a bit of a no-go area for us (what is it with beans? we always find ourselves asking) but the sticky black rice in coconut milk was a pleasant end to the meal. It seems to be important to reserve in advance, since hopeful guests who walked in during our meal were mostly turned away. It is worth mentioning that the surroundings are simple and plain, and the bathroom facilities out at the back might not appeal to all (squat toilet). If your expectations are not over-sophisticated and you would welcome being gently guided through the meal, this could make a good evening out whilst in Georgetown. There is only a handful of tables, of which three are large round ones seating - I think - eight people, so it could b be a good place to go with a larger group. The price was more than reasonable.

Author: happydevo55Portland, Oregon
Title: Bad food and bad business practice ripping customers off
Review: Food was not too good and really do not like business tactics here. We ordered a squid dish, kang kong, a shrimp omelette, rice, a spring roll, a beer and an ice tea. When we sat down they brought some prawn chips to the table without asking and they also tried to give us wet towels toward the end which we told them we did not need. When we got out bill there were charges for the towels and the chips. I do not go back to restaurants like this where they try to rip off the patrons, even if the food was good, but in this case the food was very poor quality. The omelette was so greasy we did not even eat more than one bite. The spring roll was also greasy and mushy. The rice was not fresh. The squid was overcooked, and the kang kong was fishy tasting (and yes we like fish sauce). The total bill for a bad lunch was 86.50 MYR. I did not argue with them - I speak with reviews and return business. Bad business practices do not deserve business.

Author: xxxgvip
Title: Terrible
Review: Went there for dinner. The chicken is so raw and the meatballs with soup are so salty! It seems like they have become too famous and too much customers to attend until they forget about the quality of the food! Nevertheless about the price. Overall, very disappointing. They have only 3 choice of drinks (soya, barley and wintermelon)and all of the drinks look unpleasing, as the workers hold them everywhere on their handmade tray.

Author: puchkaBengaluru, India
Title: On Jalan Alor
Review: This restaurant on Jalan Alor was disappointing. Firstly we were seated next to the barbeque station, which made it very uncomfortable with the heat. Secondly there were no tissues to wipe fingers. We had asked for a bottle of water which arrived after the meal was over. This was the only restaurant where they took payment before serving the food. The grilled chilly prawns was well done but with the shells on. The staff too were not welcoming.

Author: Djlocdog
Title: Blah.
Review: Got there at 730 as they seemed to be closing. I was starving and still didn't enjoy it. Chicken tikka was edible but the rice was cold and tasted old. The "soup" was not good. I'd avoid.

Author: shlim1188Singapore
Title: Food, Drinks and services
Review: Visited on 1st May 2016, very disappointed.Food - so so, not that fantastic.Drinks & Juice - extremely lousy. some of us order Soursop Juice, Apple Carrot and orange Juice, all their juice are extremely diluted, does not taste like jucie but water.Service - even worst, very slow, un-friendly. Very rude.The put a jar of ice water on the table but did not provide cups, how to drink water without cups ?In conclusion, if they don't improve their service and food and drinks quality, will not go there is have other choice.

Author: ChanwengcheongCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely No Value for Money
Review: I believe this establishment was banking on its popularity worldwide but in terms of food, it was just average and the portions are small. Service was good and attentive although not many there spoke English well. I've been to it's branch in Taiwan and it was absolutely out of this world but this one at Mid Valley was a stark contrast to that. Never will I return to this place again. It's too hyped up and the food was simply way below its standard. To pay for a bowl of its noodles at MYR18 (on average), you'll be expecting something good, but it's otherwise. Big let down.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: matthopkins1991
Title: Lovely little cafe
Review: Really cool vibe, super clean, nice staff. The food and coffee was amazing. Large menu and a lot of options. Poached eggs, a bagel, bacon and a latte for 5 British Pounds. Unreal. Wish I discovered this place sooner than on my last day.

Author: Ellen WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: More costly food not replenished
Review: Went for the dinner buffet on a Saturday (19/5/2018) . My second time there. Arrived at 7pm. Unlike the first time, fresh oysters were rationed out. By around 8.30pm, they were all served and not replenished. Other more costly items like sushi with unagi and opera cake were also not replenished once they're all taken even though it was only 8.15pm and the buffet was supposed to end at 10.30pm. This is really disappointing. I don't know if it's because a lot of vouchers for the buffet at Latest Recipe were sold at 35% discount on Groupon and the hotel thus have to cut costs to make up for it. This is unfair for customers like me who paid full price. Parking was also super expensive. Despite having the parking ticket validated, I still needed to pay $17.

Author: alansP5377KN
Title: Excellent and a Must Visit Place
Review:
Awesome food - A few drinks and beer a great hit...
Must try the appended meals..
Beef sausages + mash
Mediterranean chicken + rice
Beef satay and rice. 
 Genuinely Friendly service too!!!
Family vote of 5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐s

Author: margaretleesyPenang, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing babi guling
Review: Was here celebrating a friend's birthday and they pre-ordered the babi guling. Well, we were disappointed. It was nothing like the babi guling we all had in Bali. Maybe they should name it something else because it was not what it was supposed to be. The rest of the dishes are ok but the place was just too noisy for a relaxing night out.

Author: Danglove
Title: getting over their heads
Review: Made a reservation for my family to have dinner here. My father couldn’t join us the last minute so only three of us went in the end. I was actually excited to introduce my parents to this place initially because I liked their food. But this time was a huge disappointment because of the way we were treated. When we arrived, we were told by the owner that he would have given our table to someone else if he knew we were showing up one person short, and even emphasised that we took a “good” table. Making it sound like such a huge loss for him. Which shows utter lack of professionalism and respect for their guests. Should have walked out the moment he said that. There are tons of restaurants out there and we’re not there begging you to let us eat there.

Author: Melt T
Title: Random friday night Dinner
Review: Its very cosy and the environment makes you feel like you are in Japan. Love the starters and the dessert. Maybe we ordered the wrong mains, wanted the tenderloin but they ran out.. had the sirloin and it was just alright.

Author: Johan AKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Rock Road Regrets
Review: Rock Road was recommended to us but regretfully, did not meet up to expectations. Private rooms are dated, entrance leading to the 1st floor is dominated by a large fruit storage display that made me think that I had walked into the fresh produce section of a supermarket. We had fish, crab and prawns. In addition to a soup dish and vegetables. I accept that any food is a matter of taste but one measure I use to gauge how good seafood is the blend between the produce (fish, crab or prawn) and the sauce. In our case, the sauces such as the tomato base and chili base used for our prawn and crab, tended to be overpowering and overwhlemed the taste of the meat itself.If you are looking for a pleasant seafood dining experience, stay on the road.

Author: Gigi_Gusteau
Title: Absolutely great
Review: Very pretty restaurant. Great service and excellent food. A bit pricey but as they say, you get for what you pay.

Author: firdousmajid
Title: Great!
Review: Great food and service by Nik, Teedy and Monibsha. Very friendly staff! Very helpful and accommodating too

Author: Erin M
Title: Highly recommend!!
Review: We decided to eat here the night of after seeing the great reviews. We had a wonderful dinner here and I would highly recommend! Marvin, our waiter, was absolutely fantastic and provided wonderful recommendations that were all so delicious. He timed the drinks/ food perfectly and provided wonderful service. The ambiance was great and you can't go wrong ordering anything on the menu!

Author: Jishnu575Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Ordinary half cooked Indian food
Review: This seemed like an interesting place, so ended up over here. Ordered for Paneer Tikka, Chicken Lollypop and some Biriyani. Half cooked and not at all appetizing. Complete disappointment.To top it, its also not very reasonable and will be considered expensive for the ordinary quality of food.Take a risk at your own expense.

Author: Sammie_90Sabah, Malaysia
Title: Rude staffs
Review: We went to the bar and order a few cocktails, and the staff are rude and not friendly. I don't think it's worth my money to pay expensive service charge with rude and not friendly service.

Author: jheianne20
Title: Great service
Review: By the way that was in season's cafe at plaza petangi... we will sure be coming back again.. thank you for the good service

Author: Tony L
Title: Slow service with mediocre food
Review: • Hostess took her time to seat us.• Took 30 minutes for food to be served. All other customers were waiting as well.• Waitress forgot the salad I ordered.• Salmon sashimi served was not fresh. Expected more of their service given their store location in Suria KLCC. Not coming back here EVER.

Author: petalbearBallarat, Australia
Title: So so
Review: We had lunch here last week for a family gathering and there was about 20 of us. The service was pretty good however there was nothing much about the food and buffet spread. I have been to quite a few buffet lunch, dinner and high teas in KL and this was just alright. This was an occasion so our meal was paid for hence I can't justify the cost. As for atmosphere, suitable for family with children and while we were there heaps of kids. The quite a small variety of food such as salads,greens, few different meats and veg, dim sum, soup, and cold seafood nothing extravagant, very simple and basic. The highlight was definitely the desserts. There was a huge variety of Malay kuih, cakes, mousses and a lovely waffle/pancake section. This was definitely the highlight.

Author: wongbengyawKlang, Malaysia
Title: Just too yummylicious!!!
Review: At first, me and my wife are having a big doubt in our mind whether to try this Japanese restaurant as some mention here is quite pricey. We decided to give it a try at last and this restaurant deserves the best restaurant award for the money that we're paying. The food is just too delicious and fresh. Even the ice-cream recommended by the staff really got both of us flattened as it is way too good. Recommended place for anyone who wanna visit Langkawi!

Author: Nurain N
Title: Buffet Dinner
Review: The food was ok. But they giving delicious meal limited. like grilled chicken, steamed fish, only a slide of it. It is good to serve more than a slide as if we eat, we enjoy the food fulliest. Only serve mineral water in glass. No more than other beverages. There some sushi, malay food - asam pedas, ayam goreng berempah , indian food, also chinese food, if you prefer to eat fresh food, there are also oyster, crab, prawn and other seafood.

Author: SandraBPVCStone, United Kingdom
Title: disturbing choice for a vegetarian
Review: If you don't mind your friends dining out on probably the best seafood in Kuching then join in and have the beancurd, speciality bread, noodles with egg vegetarian style and you wont be disappointed with what's on your plate but look away from the tanks as you enter the restaurant if you don't want to make eye contact with our fishy friends. I suggest a table upstairs rather than outside/in the car park.

Author: Kingstrom
Title: Overcharged
Review:
Food was very average, better choices nearby.

Got charged 5.80 MYR for a small piece if chicken... Feeling pretty ripped off. It was heated in the microwave.

Also had the Roti Canai and Teh Tarik, all average.

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great reputation, poor dining experience
Review: This Overseas Restaurant is one of the oldest and comes with great reputation for fine Chinese dining experience.Arrival was great. Ushered to 3rd floor and promptly shown to table booked.We pre-ordered steamed soon hook and char siu (med size). We ordered on arrival double-boiled pork rib soup with winter melon, chinese almonds and herbs, chicken braised in chinese cooking wine, claypot tang-hoon with veg and home-made with fresh mushrooms.The char siu was a disappointment to some in our group - burnt taste or over- caramelized. Many slices were even stuck to the serving plate! Char siu is supposed to be THE signature dish for Overseas Restaurant.Most in our group had looked forward to the steamed soon hock. Then the soon hock fish came out a bit bland in seasoning and the fish meat had some weird metallic after taste?! Really bizarre. Maybe the fish gall bladder burst its contents in the prep?The soup in the end was the star of the meal. All of us had multiple bowls and some of the us are soup-people.

Author: mega_byt3Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food!
Review: One of the best satays in town! Don't be afraid by the price of RM1 per chicken satay as the portion itself is the largest compared to most if not all other satay stalls around the neighbourhood. Other stalls would include the fats or skin in the satay but Warunghijau offers a fully meaty stick! Yum! Owner and staff were friendly and welcoming in engaging with other patrons. Great place to hang out for supper but they open until 11pm only. Do give them a call before heading out as they might be closed for functions and catering at other places.

Author: AI1980
Title: Average Japanese restaurant
Review: We love Japanese food and stopped her for a lunch. We ordered one Sushi and one Salmon set lunch, Vegetarian and Crispy rolls and Soba Tempura. The set had a good Miso soup, the salmon was ok so was the sushi. Pickles had been very disappointing just a few crabsticks and some bad tasting fried eggplant. Sobs was overcooked and too soft, the tempura to fatty and tasteless. The Vegetarian rolls had a strange consistency and the rice was too soft. The crispy rolls had been just ok Overall disappointing

Author: bobsN442JE
Title: Incredible experience
Review: Not only the building, or the interior, but also the food is extraordinary. You wander if you should be differently dressed instead of short trousers and t shirt. When you get the menu card the prices seem to be in $'s, but they are not. Taste the asparagus soup!
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: ami968
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Buffet spread was scrumptious, good variety and plentyGood and mix selection of food...like home cooked meal

Author: Michael H
Title: Something for everyone
Review:
Its a must to experience whilst in KL.

It's not cheap, but the variety is excellent even my 2 fussy kids like going there.  

Get in early to beat to rush or go a little later and have almost no cars.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: AminangieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Birthday lunch
Review: We celebrated my bff's 62nd birthda there for lunch. The food quality was good with generous portions for the items we ordered. This restaurant have been around for decades and so has some senior staffs. I feel they should review their service and be more current.

Author: Charles TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing open face pineapple tarts
Review: Sadly their tarts are over-rated. We were so disappointed that their open faced pineapple tarts did not even match up to some pineapple tarts we can get back in Singapore. They use margarine and so we lowered our expectations but even then they just did not come close to what we expect of good pineapple tarts.

Author: Melody RKuching, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: Came here with my family for mother's day. Order came extremely late! First dish the salmon and lambchop came..so we tot.."wow,fast service.." then left 2 more dish suppose to arrive but we waited half and hour and still didint arrive. We call up the waiter lady who took our order earlier, and was told one of the dish we ordered was not in the menu for the day! When ask "why we we told earlier..?" the waiter lady just smile and said " im sorry,its not in the menu." sooooo.. We waited 30 minutes for just about nothing. Definately last time coming here. Terrible service. Food, portion quite small for the salmon. Lambchop full of bones. Fruit juice very minimal. Yep,highly not recommended.

Author: KhaiPgPenang
Title: Little gem on the island
Review: Amazing find on this island. A must try for Japanese food lovers. We did not try the wagyu but the grain fed char grilled ribeye was tender and delicious. Unagi meshi was excellent and highly recommended. My children liked the cold cha soba too. The service was very good and friendly overall.

Author: vincemllimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dim sum where? Not here.
Review: Really horrendous and yet it's packed. Went on a Thursday as Ming Court was closed. Have around 8 types/basket, I can't sample any that's nice. Do not order the meat dumpling(kow chee), it's inedible. No wonder no taker. In fact, the lady insisted to reheat the dumplings. Can't say they do not have various offerings.

Author: amandaxcat
Title: Belated mother’s day
Review: Service is fast n they are all very polite n gentle . Food is very tasty especially the soup and lamb rack. It’s very soothing especially with the soft music.

Author: fizS7
Title: Where is My Coriander Leaves?
Review: Mom's Laksa at Jalan Haji Taha.I used to be a frequent flyer to the restaurant. Love the interior design. A fresh look. Clean and fast service. Of course the main reason why one would go there is in search for a tasty 'Laksa Sarawak'. Honestly, I agree one of the best 'Laksa Sarawak'. In town. Love the Laksa taste and the strong aroma of laksa paste. Well done. Downside,The price for Laksa Sarawak Special has shot up rather drastically. Last I paid was over RM7? I doubt that it is related to GST or the increment in the price of the raw materials. Or is because the demand is more? Secondly, the staffs are not that pleasant. What happened to my 'Coriander leaves'? Always missing when I am ordering a take away. Still rooms to improve.

Author: ElleSouthStaffsWest Midlands
Title: A Bit Disappointed
Review: It's perhaps a bit unfair to review this restaurant as the food just wasn't to my taste. Not really sure how it gets to be No. 1, the owner and staff are great but we had the kimchi to start which I thought was horrible and then I was given the wrong main course, I'd ordered something with beef and what I got had beef in it so I assumed it was the right thing as it was my first Korean meal and probably my last. It's a nice, air conditioned restaurant and as I said before the staff are really great compared to some of the other restaurants in the area but, sorry, I really couldn't recommend it.

Author: tpLong
Title: Indian Vege Restaurant
Review: Authentic Indian Food. We enjoyed the tasty & delicious lunch.   However, some food are consider costly.

Author: KennyKimNiigata, Japan
Title: First trial of local nonya food
Review: 페낭 카레 미와 이름이 기억안나는 볽음국수를 먹었고 먹을만했음로컬 음식을 처음 접하는 사람에게 권하고 싶고 가격 저렴함Ordered Penang Curry me and fried noodle(I cannot remember the name^^) and both were good. Recommandable to people who try Local food at the first time with moderate price

Author: LKaYit
Title: Worst dim sum in my life
Review:
Overpriced crap! Artificial meat mixed instead of genuine meat in the siumai, undercooked green bean in the dimsum. You need to queue to get dimsum that you want. 

The only pro: nice deco. Nothing else.

Author: Nur HMelbourne, Australia
Title: Worst staff service.. moderate taste!
Review: Staff was not happy when we asked about their varieties of food. As all the food looked similar, we asked the sorts of gravy the meat / fish was cooked in - sambal or masala or ???. Staff showed utmost irritation and asked rudely and loudly " what do u want?" The total food for 2 person was RM 42 containing fish, vegetable and some gravy. I personally feel this place is over rated for its taste.Went to another Nasi kandar restaurant the next day. We had 1 chicken, 2 vegetable and gravy x 2 packets and it was only RM 29. The staff was friendly and generous with food. We had a good laugh when I accidently paid with Aussie dollar instead of Ringgit Malaysia. This eatery is near to Corus Hotel off Jalan Tunku Abdul Rahman. An under rated restaurant with excellent service!

Author: Mikeandkaren1
Title: Wedding Anniversary
Review: Location: on the beach, great views and sunset!Food: we had crab and the prawn to start and both followed with the Angus beef. Starters were good but chilli vinaigrette overpowered the crab. Beef was good too but one piece a bit chewy due to a layer of sinew. Strange mash potato with pickled silver skin onions. A bit odd!Desert was the soft chocolate sponge. Came with chocolate mousse and ice cream. Sponge was excellent, mousse average and the ice cream full of ice crystals.Wine: glass of Chillian Sauvignon which was OK but this was the only white by the glass. A Muscadet or Chablis style would have been better with the seafood. With the main course we had a Coonawarra which again was OK but lacked the depth and complexity of those we have tried in Australia.Service: friendly and pleasant but we must have seen every waiter in the place. Nobody seems to be responsible for particular tables as in most good restaurants.Overall a nice meal in great surroundings BUT nothing special and expensive for what it was.We rate this as average not compared with other local restaurants but with quality places elsewhere.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: food_lover_jp_sg_usaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Service is beyond bad
Review: Don’t try to go to this restaurant if your solo. The staff who appear to be the manager when he asked how many literally said oh only one and then give a frown face and walked away. The guy collecting money started to eat his dinner. He told me 30 minute wait. Clearly he didn’t want to serve me. had a recommendation from a local guy to try it. No matter how good the taste may be, incredibly poor service ruins every restaurant. Very disappointed that I took the time to go there. Absolutely no manners at all. Zero points would be more fitting.

Author: mcnamee11
Title: Exquisite food
Review: Excellent food perfect eating area clean tidy on sea, staff excellent very friendly always smiling taking excellent care of guests!

Author: naim m
Title: Poor
Review: Went for family gathering hoping for nice indian/pakistani food. Was utterly disappointed with the food as it was not as expected.

Author: 59LizHHenley-on-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Great location and food to match
Review: This place feels like you are in the middle of a rain forest. The decor is in keeping with the setting and the food is a mix of Malaysian, Vietnamese and Cambodian. Everything we had was excellent and very authentic. The service was friendly and very attentive. One tip though is that whilst the Vietnamese beef salad starter is lovely it is also incredibly hot - we love spicy food but this was too hot for us! We would definitely go back and encourage others to do so.

Author: ariati_ds
Title: Nice place, nice food
Review: Lured by array of pastries, and end up having snacks and drink while enjoying the afternoon scene before strolling around.

Author: tisaf2014
Title: Nice Service
Review: The service is very good. For the food is usual. Nasi briyani in here a little bit spicy. Small cafe but so many people went here. Price a little bit expensive

Author: KhaidzirHJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Why the arrogance
Review: Wanted to have special meals with the family...six of us last night but the place was full. We went there without reservation because they never bothered to answer our calls. I patronised the place just before MCO and the food was out of this world. The problem is with the attitude of one of the lady staff member. We said we were disappointed of not getting a table after driving al the way from JB....in the nicest possible way. He respond was, "there are many from JB"!!!! Couple that with her tone, even my 15 year old daughter noticed....that was it, we will never set foot to that place again. Sorry! I will spend my money elsewhere.....

Author: Nurhayatie A
Title: Variety of food
Review: I'm been here last year and we order 3 main dish & beverages. Overall was average. The taste average. Got some menu quite salty. Hope can improved

Author: klipinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork place in KL
Review: I went to celebrate birthday with my friends two days back. We really enjoy their salad with wild rocket, hami melon and ham. And the pasta with blue cheese surprisingly good too. However I find their pork ribs is overpower by the spices and rather dry.

Author: Nalina N
Title: Delicious
Review: Great place for those wanting delicious north indian cuisine. The ambience was classy and each dish had generous helping if just a little bit on the pricey side. The waiter who served us was great as he had suggestions on dishes that were popular there. I recommend this place to anyone with a hankering for north indian food as this will fully satisfy your cravings.

Author: nsunil2015Pune, India
Title: Awful
Review: Had dinner here since I had to fall into tourist trap and visit Jalan Alor....order Chicken in Thai style sauce... Thai dish and it was sweet.....waiter told me that it is spicy etc...rice was dry and very unlike nice sticky rice you get at any south east Asian place..many dishes were being brought in from places near by, sounds like they share kitchen with other restaurants there...charged me 20 RM + 1.5 RM for the rice...I say it is the most awful Thai chicken I have ever had. Jalan Alor food street itself is overrated and dirty area....I only came here on the hype it gets on internet....AVOID!

Author: logolo123456789Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Am i gonna order from here again? Fuhgeddaboudit
Review: Well, i ordered 2 beef pep slices and a classic ny slice. The delivery guy came like 45 mins after my order. When i got the pizza, it was cold, so the crust was hard and the slices were slightly soggy (maybe use a proper bag to trap the heat?). The pepperoni was WAYYY too hard. Like i know pep is not the softest thing in the world but this was like hard AF. Even i found it tiring to chew it. The pizza is really lackluster, nothing to shout about. And wayyy too pricey. The flavour was just meh. Not great, just meh. I wud very much prefer to order Dominos. Considering that this is a "proper and authentic" pizzeria, i thuink that their pizza shd be wayy better than a fast food pizza place (Dominos). Yet, it isnt. their buffalo wings tasted awful, btw. It was an experience, but never ordering from here again.

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Restuarant "Impossible"
Review: I had a feel of deja vu after steppping into this place, if you have been following the astro programme Restaurant Impossible by Chef Robert Irvine, you will know what I meant. The deco , furnitures of the place are way past its time, just like stepping back to the 90s. Service could be faster and better. Tom nyum gong was average, prawns are not fresh. Sweet and sour chicken , sour taste too overpowering the dish, all you can taste is sour only. Deep fried fish was not fresh, dissapointed again. Fried kangkung was not good either, only tasted the flour. Tofu was the only dish that tasted good. Price was about rm102 for 2 pax. Definitely a let down experience. This place needs a total revamp of menu and refurbishment

Author: 239lenpBendigo, Australia
Title: Quirky, gimmicky, & wonderful...
Review: Sat at the rear in period seating amongst heaps of, well, junk!! As in antiques...It added to the atmos, & the beer & coffee was very nice...We went the chicken burger...it had garlic buns, with a side of fries & was very good in both value & taste. Been back a couple of times now.Jason & Shan will look after you :-)

Author: Topbabe
Title: Really Bad
Review: The presenter of the show has a very annoying voice. The first dance route was a laugh.... However they thought this was good. I have seen better school shows.

Author: kriszzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy local meal!
Review: Yummy local meal! The War Tan Hor Fun 滑蛋河粉 is delicious! I love the baby octopus! The hokkien mee hoon was springy but a bit too salty.Our dinner for 3 pax:• War Tan Hor Fun 滑蛋河粉 (S) MYR7• Yu Kong Hor 月光河(S) MYR8• Hokkien Fried Mee Hoon 福建炒me米粉(S) MYR7• Baby Octopus 八爪鱼 MYR18• Barley Drink MYR1.80• Coke 2 cans MYR4.60Total MYR46.40

Author: CharissaAreingtonSingapore
Title: Avarage and they Dress the sushi with horrible mayonnaise
Review: We decided to try Kampachi for sushi... Experience was okay, think we were expecting a bit more for the quality of sushi.When you tend to go for higher end sushi you expect a clean taste of all Flavours of the actual ingredients that make up sushi.From looking at the menu there was no mention of the word mayonnaise... Therefore I was really disappointed to find my sushi rolls on top of a thick layer of horrible cheap mayonnaise... Really... What happened to serving sushi on a clean plate...My husbands seared Salomon sushi was also drenched in some sort of mayonnaise slash spicy dressing.. Not worth going there unless you like mayonnaise...I did not complain and I really wish I'd rather returned the dishes, but lesson learned.Would I go back...no...Also we ordered a bottle of mineral water, it was a big sized supermarket bottle that you can buy at Cold Storage for RM2 - so we were served that and obviously did not pay RM2, the price was higher... Perhaps a good idea to serve Evian water in a nice looking bottle of you are planning on charging 3 times the price.

Author: carson lBayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: good services
Review: we were there sitting besides one of the staff(might be the Boss?)he was dining when we were seated,on the spot he left his food and clear off the table and serving us.the foods are NICE,DELICIOUS,the PRICE is reasonble.I was not sure what my friends order,something like "Yun Yong","Bee Hoon",and the blacky noodles ..if not mistaken..something named like "yi mian" totally about RM 35 only included drinks.

Author: ClausP
Title: Great food
Review: Had the chicken shawarma with fries and it tasted great. Quite a small serving though and very few fries. So if you are really hungry, then you will need to go with an additional dish.

Author: andysD5351AYBangkok, Thailand
Title: Most Disgusting Toilets
Review: The food was decent, but regretfully i had to use the toilet, and it was absolutely a disaster. I cannot believe a restaurant can operate under such a repulsive conditions. It stank from yards away, had flies everywhere inside, the walls were moldy and covered with what appeared to be faecal matter. What on earth is the management doing? How did they get the license approved? Has the city council inspected this repulsive restaurant? Absolutely disgusting.

Author: Joyce SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Had the Mee Jawa Malindo for lunch. It was not tasty at all... Gravy was thin and lacked flavour. Service was also quite slow, my colleague had her meal served when i was almost halfway through my meal. Asked for cili padi but it never came. Only got it when i walked up to the counter to ask for it again. A meal is about RM10 with drink.

Author: JacobO634Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average and slow
Review: Ordered Roti Canai, Chicken Murtabak, Sambal Prawn and Dosai in the morning. Murtabak is good but small in size compared to the ones from other places. Roti Canai average, the curry is spicy and flavorful enough but not warm enough at all! Service wise, everything is served painfully late and slow, despite it’s morning. Environment is hot with the aircon not exactly working.

Author: FozzieAD
Title: Worth to try
Review: Good food, excellent location. Friendly staff to entertain you. Price increased since new management took over but overall recommended to try.

Author: ng_reggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best mutton Briyani in JB!
Review: This restaurant located nearby Danga Bay has one of the best mutton Briyani I have ever tasted! It is just a bit spicy (well the name of the restaurant is 7 Spices!) but taste great all the same. And then serving is quite a generous portion. Ambience is good as it has a fine dining feel to it. Service is great as the waiters are very attentive. Prices are just a tad higher. But then again you get to enjoy the meal in a nice comfortable air conditioned restaurant with great service. Enjoy the Briyani!

Author: stargazer99tangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Japanese
Review: I seldom go for buffet dinner in a hotel because I'm not a big eater. However, by chance, I get to visit this place as it's a team dinner and I'm totally satisfied with the Japanese food selection here. The teppanyaki is the highlight of the night. If you must, you need to try the fish and prawn teppanyaki. The fish is very fresh and the prawns are succulent. The salmon is very fresh as well. Too bad the caesar salad was not replenished fast enough. It was a full house from what I can see...I'd say the dim sum is not bad for a halal place.

Author: Tarek1966
Title: Very nice all around
Review: Shisha is great. Food is great. We had a performer who was high spirited, although music was a bit loud. We had fun!!

Author: Eddy_1855
Title: Sucks Service!
Review: Having lunch at season's cafe aeon kulaijaya with family & kids ,not a busy day just a few table but they make us waiting the food almost 40mins,slow service.Really frustrated.

Author: tengkuroszaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, good service
Review: Kumar was a good waiter. Very attentive, very polite & has good hospitality. The food is amazing! Would come here again!

Author: 587markdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: Came for my daughters birthday emailed a booking unfortunately they did not reply rang to confirm they said they where fully booked. When we explained they fitted us in. When we got to the restaurant we got the table by the kitchen and different chairs very uncomfortable.We asked for the fan to be turned on as all others in the restaurant where. Then the table beside us asked for it off this is where it became unpleasant as there was no control.We asked to move so did the other party eventually they moved.The waiter did offer to make good for the disruption unfortunately it put a downer on the evening as the other party where very upset.The food was good and excellently presented a lot of food when you have all the courses.The building is exceptional and worth a look would have been nice to be at a better table. I agree with some other reviews that it is 3 courses including the sides with mains. Two would be enough for most people not an option.They did give some free drinks and the service was good but the other incidents caused me to mark it down.

Author: PhilsgonemissingBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Full of hidden extras, beware!!
Review: Came here for crepes with my partner and was really disappointed. The crepes were alright but nothing special but what upset us was everything was a paid for extra. Partner wanted a cup of English tea, but they want to charge you a extra 4 MR for milk!! We had french bread with jam but if you wanted butter it was a extra 1 RM. Sorry but English tea comes with milk and toast comes with butter. They also charge 10% service charge, for bringing out a couple of crepes!! No where else that i ate in Langkawi charged a service charge. Go here if you want but be prepared to pay extra for it

Author: ireneong1960
Title: Good vegetarian restaurant
Review: This restaurant was recommend  by my friend. We went to try it out, and the food was quite delicious.

Author: ZaidAlzubedi
Title: The best one
Review: Gin was the best also the atmosphere was amazing I suggest all people to visit this place It's a place you can sit inside and outside.DJ is very relaxing hopefully the price is normal

Author: mic981223
Title: Dinning
Review: Thankiu Alam for the service is really good and never peace me off on the service and specially the food as well I will be back soon to this outlet again

Author: ArosubSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated , not worth the Q time...
Review: This came highly recommended by friends and Hotel.Cheesy beehoon : nothing special. Beehoon was soft .Black pepper crab : crab was firm but this got to be the worst black pepper crab that I ever had!Milk crab: crab was firm again , not bad but so-so.Deep fried squid : only this was nice.Overall, not worth the Q .

Author: shenpl02Singapore
Title: Simple dinner
Review: we went early, around 5pm and already there is a Queue. we waited for about 20min, and managed to get a table then.had belacan stir-fried potato leaves, peranakan chicken curry, fried rice and kueh Pieti.by the time we finished our dinner around 6pm+, the Queue has grown much longer.I must say, I don't understand what the rave is about. the food is only average, not worth the time at all.

Author: julianycy
Title: Ocean Trout at Shucked!! 😋
Review:
Really fresh ocean trout!! 
Had the sashimi and grilled. Tender and juicy- Delicious. Staffs are accommodating and friendly. Love it!

Author: jgomezchia
Title: Best place in Kuching
Review:
Very good place for an early  or late meal as they are open 24hs... food is great Laksa  and roti my favorites.
Definitely a must in Kuching... do not expect a fancy place but expect a delicious food!

Author: Jacqueline FKuala Lumpur
Title: Not worth a try
Review: My family and I were there last week to celebrate my mom's birthday. It was a Wednesday night and the restaurant was half packed. We would expect good service if not excellent on a week night, especially when the place is not full, but for the entire night, it was mainly us waving at the waiters asking for the same thing over and over again. There were 6 of us and they only gave us 5 menus and we had to ask the waiters for an extra menu, after that while we were dining, we had to ask 3 times before they finally refill our water and then again twice for the bill. The food wasn't all that good and very pricey. We ended paying close to RM500 for ordering simple noodles, fried rice, poultries, 3 starters to share and we did not even order drinks. Don't think I will be visiting the restaurant again.

Author: BaaarmiinLipa City, Philippines
Title: My mouth is watering as i'm typing this...
Review: I really wasnt a fan of curry due to its tangy taste so i really wasnt expecting much when my wife booked us a trip to malaysia and had this as one of our activities.We had to wait in line for about 30mins under tje summer heat due to wifey's excellent planning skills... going to a famous curry house during the 12pm rush hour didnt seem like a bad idea to her, it seemed.We ordered a large serving, and two cups of rice. I immidiately smelled the aroma of the coconut milk and the curry spice, which is far from my previous experiences with curry. The creamy soup and the balance of spices makes you want to take a sip one after another. The bean curd topping does a good job of soaking the soup so you can pick it up with a chip stick. The fish head did also a great job of absorbing the flavor of the sauce and had just thr right amount of tenderness in it. The vegetables were also done just right.This one is definitely recommended and i would definitely want to go back here, though maybe not on the rush hour.

Author: tsehweiMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Homey ambiance, great for friends and chilling out
Review: Dim lighting and comfy chairs makes for a great place to hang out and chill with friends. The food is slightly on the pricey side, but is still great value for money because they use quality ingredients. Their mashed potatoes is to die for! The cooling effect of the cucumber and the savory taste of the potatoes really bring down the heat on a hot day. Highly recommended. The spaghetti bolognese was also very nicely done and very, very tasty. The place is run by only the owner and his wife, so do check their Facebook page for the day's menu, and call ahead of time to ensure that your food arrives in good time and in great form. There is also a hidden room behind the book shelf, available for group gatherings booked ahead of time. The owners are friendly and approachable, and more than willing to chat with customers about their recipes.

Author: GenP479London, United Kingdom
Title: Horrible Cantonese noodles
Review: We came here for dinner one evening, my friend ordered fried noodles and I asked for the Cantonese noodles, after asking the waitress what was in them and she told me noodles and vegetables. When it came out I had some suspicious looking bits of meat on the top, which after researching I think may have been tongue, which the waitress failed to mention. I have no idea what Cantonese style noodles are usually like but these were horrible and crunchy in a gravy that made the ones at the bottom of the bowl soggy. Really not what I was expecting and the taste really wasn't good. My friends fried noodles were okay but nothing great. Not good food at all. Wouldn't come back. It is cheap though!!

Author: NazariusKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasteless food
Review: I have been here twice in 1 year and each time it's the same. TASTELESS food. The description on the menu was great but when the food touches my tastebud, it feels as if there were no seasoning. I had the pasta and it felt like eating pasta alone without any sauce.

Author: SharonOHBIPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Never again!
Review: I read about this place and many reviews on how great the ribs were. Unfortunately, didn't order the infamous ribs. Instead we had the soft rib sandwich, soft ribs on pasta and 'Once you go black', a lean piece of meat on the pasta. Firstly, never ever order the pasta. It was TERRIBLE and tasted like it came out of a can. It was overdone and too soft. It didn't look appetizing as well. Out of our 3 orders, the soft rib sandwich was most edible but still nothing compared to some other places for the price you are paying. Never again!

Author: joycenelwanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad
Review: Been here many times. My last visit I ordered soup ekor and the carrot was not cookednow today Saturday, Jan.20th, I ordered Fried Rice Kampung and it took more than 20mnts still not coming, then waiter came asked wether I ordered food already or not. Gosh!. In the meantime my husband is eating his fish and chips. I asked again where is my food it took so long only for a kampung fried rice, waiter said because of too many outside order. Is that be my problem?. No!. So I said just cancel it coz I don't feel like eating anymore and was so hungrily upset with the service. Will not come here anymore!. Terrible!.

Author: Mathavi S
Title: Long wait
Review: I been here few times and the pizza is excellent. You can't compare with our Malaysian pizza. The thing I to want to highlight is, there is no proper system for people who is dining here. We were party of 3 and we had to wait outside for 30mins before got a table. After ordering was told had to wait another 40 minutes. But our pizza arrived 1 hour later. Yet there was only about 10 tables. Because they were preparing for all take away orders and we had to just wait. I think they really need to plan and organise their system.

Author: arunkmurthyMumbai, India
Title: Authentic Indian food in KL
Review: Had dinner there with Malaysian friends. Very well decorated with south indian art pieces and a nice centre peice idol, wooden carved pillars, golden door handles etc. Started with Potato Bajji - which was not great - a bit soggy on the inside. But the Masala Dosa and the Rava Dosa were good. The South Indian Thali was also good. North indian dishes were not something to write home about but were passable. Prices are very reasonable - meal for 3 was around 85 Ringitt. Situated at the Temple of Fine arts which also houses a store which has Indian ethnic art peices and furniture.

Author: Newfie013Vientiane, Laos
Title: I would not go back.
Review: Although nothing specific happened to make this a bad experience, my overall impression of this restaurant was ... Blah.The food was ok, but nothing special. The service was fine, but certainly no one went out of their way or was particularly friendly. The staff spent more time chatting to each other than to the guests. The atmosphere was ok, but again, nothing special.With so many other places to try, I would not go back.

Author: Just_my_viewsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worthwhile
Review: This restaurant probably became known after some review by some artistes from Singapoare's MediaCorp, and thereafter is frequented by tourists. During the peak times, ie weekends and/or public holidays, the place is crowded. Success thus beget arrogance and when I visited it, I found the service to be excruciatingly poor. Unfortunately, we had already driven round twice to find parking space near the restaurant, and it would be difficult to get the party of over 10, which included a few old folks, to drive around again to another restaurant. Thus, we stayed on, and, much to our chagrin, were served food which was not at all up to expectation.

Author: VincentC990Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful place but very pricey
Review: It is our second visit after 10 years. The food is still good. But the prices shocked us. An Asian dish is close to USD30. I understand opreating cost in a rain forest may be slightly higher. But it should not overcharge guests who have limited dining options at the Datai.

Author: Elin A
Title: Disapointment
Review: A big disapointment after the good review that we read. The restaurant it self is cozy but the food was not as expected based on the review they had. We took the recommanded dishes that the restaurant had but it was a huge disapointment. The lamb was tasteless and dry. On top of it they started to take a way tables and clear the area just after we ordered, during the maincourse they asked us if we wanted to order dessert because they wanted to close the kitchen. I would not recommend this place.

Author: Traveller_J0Malaysia
Title: Disaster!! Microwaved food
Review: This place at KLCC has really gone down hill!! Enchiladas were stone cold in middle, and mince grey! Manager said its heated up in microwave, but wasn't long enough!!! They replaced it with boiling hot enchiladas that were over microwaved. The food was exceptionally disappointing! Will not be returning!

Author: Gideon SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible not only for its breakfast...
Review: I'm currently staying at Somerset which serves its guests breakfast downstairs at Souled Out. Whilst this is a repeated disappointing experience (would rate it zero stars for the lack of variety, lack of quality and also lack of quantity...the limited spread is usually half gone by the time I make it to breakfast, which isn't late at all), I guess I can't judge the restaurant on the breakfast which it probably serves under tight budget control by the hotel. Unfortunately however the experience at night is also poor (I'm being generous by giving it 2 stars. The food on the menu is unimaginative and very middle of the road. Service is downright appaling with opinionated waiters (they wouldn't let my wife take a dessert including ice cream up to the room even though we acknowledged that it might melt on the way up...but they just wouldn't give it to us.....whatever happened to the customer always being right?). They also keep trying to peddle beer, even though it was obvious that my wife and I were drinking water/soda that day....asking open questions is fine, but asking me specifically if I want beer time after time is annoying.Anyway, my wife went for a steak which was average for the price tag (much better steaks to be had in places like Ben's or Chinoz on the Park at nearby Suria KLCC). I probably had the first ever horrible tasting Indian dish of my life (and I have eaten ready made microwave 'Indian' grub before...). I went for the chicken vindaloo and what I got was basically chicken with a sickly sweet sauce, as if someone had dropped a kilo of sugar in it. It had none of the heat and complexity of spices that Indian food should have.I would advise you to avoid, however for some reason it always seems to be quite busy...

Author: NoelnGeraldineLeitrim, Ireland
Title: Didnt even stay to eat!
Review: Always eat here when in kl and was so looking forward to returning.Went earlier in the week at about 9pm. It was very quiet so there was a choice of tables. We sat at a table for 6 ...only 2of us... because it was in a cooler area. Immediately the waiter came over to say we couldn't sit there as we were only 2 people. Reluctantly we moved to a table of 4 asking him if he was expecting a crowd at this time of evening!! He immediately asked what we wanted, I said it would help if he gave us menu's! Gave us menus and stood there looking at us! I asked if he wanted something or perhaps we should leave if he was in such a hurry. We got up and left immediately. Complained to manager on way out! Such bad customer service....rude and abrupt! Won't be back no matter how good the food is.

Author: DrClementLee
Title: Saturday night BBQ buffet
Review: Have recently ate at Pullman's F&B, Kitchen twice within a month. Both occasions food was a disappointment despite varieties. Wasn't yummy at all, especially BBQ meats overdone, dry and tough, and not tasty. Service was above average though. Overall not value for money.

Author: ng_reggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sumptuous buffet spread!
Review: This is my wife and I favourite restaurant for buffet. Their spread is super generous and all the dishes taste really good. Need to book ahead as this restaurant is very popular despite its fairly steep price! But I personally think its worth it because their spread is just so good.Their main offering is the seafood. Really fresh sushi and sashimi and lobsters (on weekends only). But they also have chinese, indian, western, cold cuts and loads and loads of dessert - from fresh fruits to ice cream to pastries, etc - the whole lot!When dining here - don't rush. And don't just savour one type of food. Be patient and try the whole lot.

Author: BHAVAV1
Title: Smelly restaurant & worst food
Review: cold biriyani, chilly chicken and chicken 65 almost same. the cups not wash properly..really waste of money

Author: turning-into-motherKent
Title: Location great, but that was it!
Review: Went for dinner as recommended, but disappointed at limited fare on offer (set dinners) despite this, the service still managed to be dreadful - 3 dinners arrived within 20 minutes, then one more 15 minutes after that, whilst the other 2 (same as previous orders) had their rice brought after an hour, then the curries when the microwave had heated them at 10 minute intervals. No apology, and accused of having more desserts than entitled to. I'm live in Malaysia, and am used to food arriving when ready, but this was just clearly forgotten orders and dreadful service.

Author: Kentan0722
Title: Visit to Tosca Double Tree Johor
Review: The food overall is good, but the waiting time is quite long for fine dining; Overall everything is fine and above expectations
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: mike c
Title: a little bit average
Review: my wife & I ,only visited once, the service good, menu fine, prices average, but food quality, so so, small servings , not great. maybe we went on an off night, the staff were very kind.

Author: Nic_99ST
Title: Pork chop is good
Review: I like only the pork chop cos the rest dishes are very sweet and price is not cheap too. Owner are very friendly and serving are very fast.

Author: cyp5613
Title: Our late lunch at STG
Review: It was after a tiring drive from Penang that we went for lunch at STG, the staff were friendly and welcoming and answer most of our questions. It is mainly western food with Asian options. My wife like the tea sauce chicken

Author: patber66Malaysia
Title: Boxing Day Lunch
Review: Food were good as per recommended by the owner the only problem I think would need the owner to take his step towards training his worker, a lady waiters who accuse of us not wanting one of the dishes that we ordered and told her boss that we are the one that canceled while she did a mixed up in placing dishes that we did not order on our table and later we found out from the boss that dish she mentioned was actually on her hand that we did not know at all. After many arguments the owner came and made his stand and apologized for his worker attitude. Beware for this lady with single pony hair which is extremely rude. Overall good are delicious if you don’t mind the attitude. Have a try.

Author: Chong E
Title: Nice service, nice drinks!
Review: Awesome service by Farid, probably the friendliess server we've met. Nice drinks,  friendly people,  relaxing environment. Definitely worth every penny you spent!

Author: Susana CSydney, Australia
Title: Great lunch deal
Review: We went once for lunch and the food was really great. Plus they had the 2 Carlsberg for the prize of 1. The pasta, the redang and the chicken sandwich were all great. So was the dessert - not a big range but the available dishes were great.The service was a bit confused but within the normal KL range.

Author: GourmandVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Truly disappointing
Review: I often go to Wild Honey when I am in Singapore, which is always an amazing experience. Never mind that this restaurant here in KL is halal (prefer real bacon) but the food was so disappointing - really bland overall and just not tasty at all. Had the American and the only good thing was the bagel and cream cheese. The pastrami was diced up and tasted...weird. The sausages was dry, overcooked and truly awful - tasted like sawdust (was told it was lamb and beef mixed and made in-house). Will never return here again. Service was relatively good, nice ambience.

Author: faiqahchipKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Definitely an experience to remember
Review: The whole experience from start till end is memorable. The food served are very creative and because of the whole experience I learn to appreciate more things in life that I might have taken for granted. The menu changes every 3 months if I'm not mistaken, so the food I ate might not be similar to you. A good way to engage in conversation as well as no mobile phones are allowed at all. Not even watch!

Author: carsam c
Title: Strictly Non Halal
Review:
Just a few doors from a bank, this newly ticklish restaurant caught my attention.
Well, it is stated  Stictly Non Halal but check out their ignature Pork Ribs.

Author: I2662XKsusanwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome buffet spread
Review: Went for Sunday buffet lunch at Lemon garden and was greeted with a wide variety of buffet choices. My favourite corner was the sashimi and seafood, the oysters were so fresh and juicy. We had double boiled soup (herbal chicken and winter melon) that made us feel like home... The dessert spread will be dessert lovers fairyland, eg creme brulee and raspberry jelly were just right for me.

Author: Khy N
Title: Eat here if you plan to be dissapointed.
Review: It's from really bad to worst. The customer service makes you feels like your really a burden. When they gave you incomplete food and maybe just a spoon with a fork and knives . . You will think twice about asking them anything.. they gave you that look. "What you want now."Finally the food.. the last I ate.. it's was bad enough for me to vow to never come back. Chicken tasted like it's cooked the day before..

Author: Susan T
Title: Novelty experience
Review: Darkness is exciting. Everything is a surprise. Hands n fingers for me, I might have made a mess. My friends and I had a wonderful experience. Darius was very engaging and witty and has a voice that is so calming and made the dark atmosphere cheery. We had fun guessing the food we ate. How about dancing in the dark next?

Author: VincentL2738
Title: Japanese Restaurant Dinner
Review: Nice ambience , friendly staffs and quality food, brought my wife for a dinner and she wanted to go back again .

Author: Rob MTwickenham, United Kingdom
Title: A great few drinks on a night out
Review: My partner and I called in here after a dinner and had an enjoyable few beers and tequila shots. The waiting staff who encourages to enter looked after us well and we had a nice view of the street for some people watching. Would happily visit again!

Author: BonnieChuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overprice and Overated
Review: We were so looking forward to dine in Greyhound cafe. Was there for birthday celebration cum christmas gathering. Personally I think it is overpricing and for the food it is overating. We were quite dissapointed with the food taste. Ordered 8 dishes and all tasted like going nowhere. Staffs were friendly and helpful. Thank u. Atmosphere is good.

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A touch of class everyone can afford!
Review: Children are welcomed! When I made the reservation, I thought we would have to change our plans due to our 5 year old. But I was very pleasantly surprised. Unlike other "classy" diners, they do not restrict children. Two thumbs up to that!Expecting the menu to be highly priced, again we were wrong. Very reasonably priced food. I had the Seafood combo (i think that's what it's called) and it was divine! My personal request for omitting dairy in any of my food was noted by our server, Indra (thank you!)The husband ordered a steak. Our order taker missed asking for the weight and done-ness which she then apologized for, but luckily he enjoyed ever bit of it!We took a quick walk outside and noticed the amazing view of our beautiful Melaka...it was breath taking. The ambiance outside was slightly lighter feel compared to the stylish settings inside. Was a little chilly but I liked it anyway.Parking=====Our only issue was the car park. Since the restaurant is within a mall/hotel there was a bit of confusion when we left the restaurant after the mall operation hours. I strongly suggest asking for parking instructions before.Overall=====I had a wonderful time and will surely be back. Soon.

Author: beyondseh_Singapore
Title: attentive staff and awesome coffee
Review: my friends and i came here for just a short while, to take a break from the scorching hot weather and to wait for other friends who were having lunch.we only came here to order coffee but damn, it was good. we had hot white flat coffee, iced cuppucino and ice cafe latte. even though we only ordered drinks, the staff still treats us pleasantly equal as others who ordered more. orders were taken swiftly and served promptly. most importantly, the coffee weren't too expensive and was made well.

Author: Keat_Siang73Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great value for money!
Review: Not far from Petaling Street, this gem is tucked away at the basement level of an inconspicuous 3-4 storey arcade. Go in a group of 3 or 4 so that you can share a few dishes. I don't think there are any weak items on the menu, so you can order one tofu/vegetarian dish, one seafood and chicken or pork (I would recommend the pork dishes here)

Author: OliviaodeleSingapore, Singapore
Title: very good nonya food
Review: fine dine setting that doesnt look very child friendly, the food serving were little but its very high quality, and expensive but we felt its worth it, difficult to find by taxi as there are no sign, look for the hotel instead, nonya food dont have much selection for kids so better bring your own, must order the beef and roasted pork, i hope to be back soon for the best nonya food i ever had

Author: Tunching218Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overated and not worth wait
Review: After hearing all the hue and cry over this restaurant, I decided to give it a try. I had to wait for almost 45 mins to get a seat. As there were 5 of us, we decided to try all the dishes they were famous for ... the loh mee, pork chop, chicken chop, fried rice and the grilled pork. Frankly, I really don't see anything special. It is definately overated and not worth the waiting time,

Author: fernandezg2018Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Its a mistake, i spoil my date by Going to Dawakan Restaurant
Review: They only have 2 sets of meal and both have beef as one of the dish and we can't share the food.When call the shop, they show me the direction to Dawakan but when i reach there, they asked me weather i have reservation or not. After that they asked me to sit a side because no reservation and us see the menu.They dont let customer to choose Alacart menu instate only have 2 sets and both sets have beef included as dish. Since i am a HINDU, i cannot eat BEEF. I asked the waiter to change the beef to chicken and he replied the chef wont allow.I understand that they dont want HINDU as a customer at the same time they dont value HINDU customer as we dont eat beef.We call Malaysia as Truly Asia because we live in multi racial country. Finally i never eat and walk away because its must to eat beef in that shop. I am true HINDU FOLLOWER and i cant eat there.

Author: Antonia GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: shockingly rude manager and bad food
Review: Hugely disappointing food and unbelievably rude and incapable manager, who definitely does not know the meaning of the customer is always right. On Thursday the 12th March we ordered takeaway from La Risata, a restaurant we used to enjoy and considered a treat. Grab delivered the food and have been extremely professional. The pasta and soup arrived hot, but definitely lack lustre and not as expected. But the worst was the pizza which was wrong, burnt and completely stone cold, literally as if it had been made the day before. We called the restaurant to request a replacement and encountered the rudest women manager I think I have ever come across, she actually swore at my daughter and hung up the phone when she requested her name in order to make a formal complaint!! My daughter actually then went down to the restaurant, only to be told the manager had gone home!!! If you're looking for value for money and good service, do NOT go to La Risata.

Author: Sheikhkobob
Title: One word .. WOW
Review: My first night in Langkawi and after 3 flights consisting around 16 hours. I can say there is no way better to start off the holiday. Have had syrican cuisine all around the world but to date this is the best I have tasted. Amazing food, lovely owner, you will have to wait a little long usual for your food but it is worth every minute. The honours/ falafel and chicken shawarma have to be tried to experience the culinary brilliance. A must visit in Langkawi !! Will be coming here again before I leave.

Author: sarahrzk81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: disappointed service
Review: My friend and I went to chinoz yesterday and I requested to change our table as the table next to us is talking loudly & I prefer to sit at a bigger table. the waiter refused and told us that the bigger table is for 4 guests. but, when I looked around there were few couples sat at bigger tables. I'm so disappointed with the unfair treatment. When we ask for bills, the waiter didn't give us our small change ( as if the small change is considered their tip). tell me why I should give them a tip when they give a disappointed service?

Author: openlancelot
Title: great food, good prices
Review: Tried this cafe after reading good review on Trip Advisor. Ordered the Squid Thai Style, Kang Kong, Satay, and Banana and Ice Cream. Great tasting food, I should say. Plus the owner, Amy, was very friendly and accommodating. Would visit again!

Author: Michael CL Y
Title: Errrrrr........
Review: Delicious. Yummy yummy in my tummy. The MSG tasted very nice. Very generous. The food was very cheap (not). Very friendly staff (not) . Must try to keep the food down.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: MeahsunshineKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It's a Must Go Italian Restaurant in JB
Review: It's a must go Italian Restaurant in JB if you are in town. I've been there twice and the food was good and consistent. The 3-course lunch menu with drink was RM32++ per person. There were only 2 selections to go with which I think it's reasonable. The ambiance resembles the cuisine they were offering. Service was great. Smoking is allowed inside the restaurant. When they are cleaning the restaurant, everything was moved out from the premise. This was a very rare situation which I like (this means they are giving priority to their hygiene especially the sofas which could get dirty and smelly easily).

Author: mrsdeepak
Title: Vegetarian Restaurant
Review: Tasty South Indian Food. We order Meal and it was very tasty. The place is very tidy and well arranged.

Author: Lugano22Lausanne, Switzerland
Title: average food for this restaurant in Traders Hotel KL
Review: Gobo Chit Chat is one of the 2 restaurant of the Traders Hotel and it's located on the 5 floor. Cuisine is opened non stop from morning breakfast to diner in the evening. Two choices the evening or at lunch, a la carte menu or Buffet.The food is international with some malaysian specialities food.The decor is nice and modern. But service to be improved and time to be served quiet long.I choose when I went, The tandoori chicken with naan bread, mango chutney and mint sauce, The chicken was good, but the naan bread horrible, a sort of arabic naan bread grilled. And the mint sauce was very small portion.....................At the end a bit disappointed. Prices are ok, but bad for this occasion.

Author: Jip79
Title: Wide selection
Review: We went to Sushi Zanmai in a mall in Cyberjaya for dinner, and it was crowded. Their menu had a wide selection to choose from and the food came quite promptly. Not bad on taste too, and service was excellent.

Author: LisaG6101
Title: Best coffee and service :)
Review: The service is so good and the staff is very friendly and helpful. We absolutely loved the coffee here - it is sooooo good. Thank you.

Author: Eva_ChongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrate & Poor service
Review: I dine in solo this morning with reservation on 27th march, ordered a Cuppucino, and it takes 30mins to serve. Ordered a Smoked Salmon Wheatberry Salad and Scallop Oglio Olio, it takes 40mins to serve!! the salad taste so bad, but well, the pasta is so so. bill was RM110.20 for 3 items, when I leave, there is no greeting from the staff at all. with the price I pay, I would rather go to Red Bean Bag in Publika which serve better food and coffee. I will not come back second time even for their fine dining.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: sstai
Title: Good portion but bad surrounding
Review: This is the best restaurant in Santubong area. And the most expensive one. The food is ok, very big portion. However, the environment of the restaurant is disappointing. Not cold enough, a bit filthy with flies everywhere.

Author: FlyAaron
Title: Quick service
Review: All your typical Thai dishes you would expect, most includes seafood.  There are also beef and chicken as well.  Only a few vegaterian dishes.  I had vegetable Pad Thai.  Tofu and broccoli were included.  Very friendly and quick service.

Author: LoveTravel709013
Title: Nice Dim Sum Place but ..
Review: Nice Dim Sum location but choices not much available. Taste consider one of the best in iPod aRea. Will still come again.

Author: dclooLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious street food
Review: Ordered the chicken tight and sliced fish porridge. The chicken thigh was absolutely delicious and I’ll highly recommend it. It’s tender, juicy and extremely flavourful. The sauce - some mix of fried scallions, sesame oil and light soy sauce - goes very well with the chicken thigh and was the star for me. Porridge was tasty but nothing really special. Sliced fish was also okay only.

Author: mikelim8116
Title: good variety of dim sum
Review: More than 12 vatieties of dim sum to choose from. I find the ingredients used were freshly made. Price is reasonable.

Author: constableworldPerth, Australia
Title: Very disappointed
Review: We went to Lepau Restaurant because of all the good reviews. Maybe it was just a bad night for the restaurant but we were very disappointed. Our chicken dishes had more bones than meat and the beef tasted "off" and was very fatty. It seemed that only very cheap cuts had been used for the meals. Half of our soft drinks were served warm. The service was good and the restaurant looked really nice with traditional music playing. When passing the kitchen on the way to the bathroom, it looked very dirty. We had better and cheaper food at the Water Front in Kuching.

Author: Anto876Madrid, Spain
Title: Bad service, low quality
Review: The waitresses are untrained, the sashimi was still frozen when served. The picture on the menu and what you get is TOTALLY different. Food arrives randomly you may get the desert first and the appetizer at the end... I came here twice and both times they have served me different sashimi instead of what I've ordered (saying that the one in the menu, more expensive, was out of stock)

Author: EshwariVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Place to Be
Review: I have been coming to Vin's since it opened 4 years ago. Every single visit has been a memorable and cherished experience. The food is delicious, the ambiance is inviting, the service is efficient; you never want to leave. At Vin's you're not just another face in the crowd and they are not just another place to eat. One visit and the place instantly becomes 'yours'! I have had business discussions, celebration dinners or even friendly catch-ups with friends. Something about this place just makes it perfect for each occasion. In the 4 years that I've been coming here, I have seen the menu change, go from strength to strength, but there is one item on this menu that I simply cannot get enough of. It is their Elusive Chocolate Truffle. It is the one thing on the menu that I will always get. It is excellent. So excellent I never even bother having fondant cake anywhere else!

Author: Selvi K
Title: Worth the money
Review: Nice ambiance. I loved the variety of food they offer. Pastas were good and come in decent portion. Overall was good service but sometimes it was difficult to get the waiters attention. Price is reasonable.

Author: ghostriverKlang, Malaysia
Title: Disappointment visit to HRC
Review: I and my wife decided to spend our night live at Melaka by enjoying live band at Hard Rock Café. I’ve already been to few of HRC, so when they open their outlet in Melaka, I don’t want to miss the opportunity to visit the new HRCPARKINGIt’s quite difficult to find parking in Melaka. If you want to go to HRC Melaka, you can park under the HRC. Secure parking. I reached here around 9.30 pm and left at 1 am. My parking fee is RM25 – after get HRC stamp on the parking coupon. FOODBig portion and deliciousSTAFFFriendly and helpfulENVIRONMENTLike normal Hard Rock Café and it is free smoking zonePRICEStandard price for foods. Restaurant price. Drinking Water (not mineral water) for RM15. Please judge it by yourself if this is reasonable or not. LIVE BANDLive band start at 10pm. When I and my wife came here, they just have new band from Indonesia performed here. For music selection, I only can give 2 star. Only few rock song were performed by them. Most of it pop song with rock music. Totally disappointed on their live band performance. This time I feel like I was sitting in “Pop Rock Café”, not Hard Rock Café. Sound of the music instrument are too laud until overwhelm the singer voice especially the drum sound.

Author: PierceWongKuching, Malaysia
Title: The local pasta and desserts place that you cannot missed
Review: This place cries out to be the place for your local food; namely local pasta and desserts. Local pasta consist of mee (noodle), Kuehtiaw and Beehoon as the three major ones. You could also find "rat dung" as they called it (Though it has got nothing to do with rat, but rather this white pasta is squeezed into shape that looks like rat dung).For each of the three major pasta, here are the ways that they can be prep here by various stall.1. Pouched - Kolo Mee (egg noodle variety #1, kuehtiaw, beehoon and rat dung)2. fried with bean sprouts and eggs (yellowish mee, kuehtiaw, beehoon and egg noodles )3. fried with bean sprouts, eggs and cockles. (yellowish mee, kuehtiaw, beehoon and egg noodles )4. fried with Tomato sauce (egg noodle, kuehtiaw, beehoon and yellowish noodle)5. fried hokkien style (same as #3 above)6. fried foochow style (same as #3 above)7. fried cantonese style (same as #3 above)8. fried dry style (same as #3 above)Other than that you can also find pasta in Kuehchap which consist of pork, various parts of the pig that does not limit to it's meat. Laksa is another must try. DessertsWhen this place started back in the 80's it was quite controversial.
