Most of the stall owner was forced to move to this area as their previous area of operation right outside of the Police quarters was demolished. It made headlines on the day that they were supposed to move. The stall at palm roads is famous for their exotic drinks. There were many claims as to be the first to make such drinks but as far as the old timer goes, those drinks started in the early 60's due to customer request to skip milk from the icey desserts.1. Matterhorn2. white lady3. red dot (was initially called conjunctivitis)...

Author: Saravana K
Title: Bad....
Review: food is nothing to shout about and service is bad ... the waiter literally ignored me twice when i called him . They dont seem interested serve people .

Author: Gabe08
Title: Poor food quality that is so not worth the price
Review: Had dinner with friends and at the start already encountered challenges. Waiter was totally not knowledgeable about the menu and could not answer questions. Tom yum lacked flavour, chicken dish was too salty, fish cake too soggy. Could have been more satisfied for less elsewhere.

Author: karengZ9134ADAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Charming, friendly cafe in a great setting.
Review: We stumbled upon this place quite by chance and enjoyed a peaceful, relaxing lunch overlooking the river. The food was very good, chicken curry, rendang curry and mushroom soup, and we were very tempted by the desserts and the drinks. May have to come again to try some of them. Friendly and efficient staff and a location away from the bustle of the busier streets of Melaka ensured we had a very enjoyable meal.

Author: JeffC4362
Title: Nothing so special leh.
Review: Nothing so special but good enough la. Paid Rm57 for a bowl for 2 Bak Kut teh mix and 2 steam rice and 2 barley drinks. Will still look for better. Hehehhe.

Author: KoolBlueSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average at best
Review: After reading some rave reviews about this place, our family decided to give this place a try. Having tried great Teochew cuisine over the years, the food here is average at best. Plus given the prices they charge, the quality of food certainly disappoints. For the amount we spent here, we could get much better quality food elsewhere. The other thing that puzzled us is that we were not allowed to add on to our orders once we have placed our orders at the beginning. Overall a very average experience in a highly rated place.

Author: glutenfree4lifeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fine dining atmosphere, average food
Review: The seven terraces hotel in which this restaurant is located is a nice quaint hotel and the restaurant is very nicely decorated. The service is also good. If you have not tried many Asian foods before then it's definitely worth it. However if you live in Asia and know Asian food well (Malaysian, Thai, Singaporean) then the food itself is nothing great. They only have set menu and 2 seatings to chose from: 6 to 8pm and 8pm to 10pm. We took the early seating. The starters were just average. The desserts were the best part of the meal we felt. We also visited 'my own cafe' (didn't care much for the Asam laksa, loved the coconut ice cream served in the coconut shell); 'jawi house' ( loved the biryani, lamb-okra dish was just ok, desserts were good).

Author: Jose Michael HSingapore, Singapore
Title: AN AMAZING RIP-OFF EXPERIENCE!
Review: It is our first time in Ipoh and having travelled for 14 days in Malaysia, driving starting from Port Dickson to Langkawi, we decided to head to Ipoh on our way back to Singapore. Since it is our first time to visit this restaurant as well, it was obvious we were struggling to order what we wanted to eat so the wait staff started recommending foods to us. We were first recommended the smoked duck. I quickly browsed through the menu to see how much it is and saw it was 44rm. Then the wait staff recommended a fish and some other dishes which we just agreed blindly. We were surprised to find out that we were recommended a very expensive dish let alone that we were not even informed on how heavy the fish dish is. Considering that there is only two of us, a 1.5kg of fish is a blatant rip off to be served for us. Just imagine, when we had a 4 course dinner for 5 person in Five Sen5es in WESTIN KUALA LUMPUR which only cost us around 600rm and then receiving a bill that is 590rm in IPOH! There are alot of way that this kind of rip-off can be avoided. When customers work on good faith, businesses like this abuse it!

Author: snakes116Frankfurt, Germany
Title: Not so impressed
Review: We popped in on a saturday evening after seeing the recommendations on Trip Advisor. Our starter the potato wedges, picture included was in the small side for a starter.The food was not as we expected and more fusion than authentic. Which is fair enough, neither of the dishes were to our taste. It could appeal to more adventurous diners. The atmosphere was non existent. It was too empty, the music was nice. Not too bold or over bearing. The decor etc was nice. A lot of time and effort I guess into putting it together. Maybe for a coffee or lunch but not dinner.

Author: Millennium_Falcon888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Underrated restaurant with great Chinese food
Review: I seriously wonder why a restaurant serving excellent Chinese cuisine is so grossly underrated here in TripAdvisor... Anyway, during my October trip to Johor Bahru with colleagues for a training session with our business partner, they took us to Hook Sang (located a short walk from the AEON Mall in Bukit Indah) for dinner - the place came highly recommended by them.And the food was indeed excellent, one of the best we have had in JB. Special mention must be made to some of Hook Sang's specialties, including Fried Enoki Mushrooms, BBQ Squid, Beggar's Chicken, and Steamed Fish Head - better than what was served at some of the restaurants I have eaten before, in both JB and Singapore!For those of you heading into JB, do check out Hook Sang and hopefully produce more positive ratings to build awareness of this place in TripAdvisor!

Author: Vinasha AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No Soul At All !!!
Review: This is my second visit, the first wasnt impressive either but we went there but it will be the final visit. Now i know why people cuss this place on FB. The staff really are terrible. I can't imagine them being in the service industry and not providing any service at all. They sulk while taking your order, you can't ask them to elaborate the menu as they will give you a 'you are so stupid look', when your raise your hand for attention, they pretend they don't see you.The drinks are horrendous. Why bother having happy hours when you water the drink down so badly, the alcoholic beverages tastes like a glass filled with water and sugar. When you charge your customers money, you have a duty to provide what you state on the menu. Your prices may not be fine dining range, but they are not cheap either!The food, we order nachos, calamari and 'wan ton' chinese dumplings.The calamari was LIMP and COLD and quite tastless.The nachos and wan ton were normal tasting.We closed off our bill, didn't finish our drinks or our food and headed to Healy's Mac down the road which will be my our new favourite as they excelled in every aspect you didnt!

Author: Olex_KL
Title: Overrated
Review: This is probably the worst food I’ve ever had in Penang. I don’t understand how this place get so high rating . Absolutely not worth it.

Author: OleenHKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Celestial Court, Chinese Restaurant
Review: The Dim Sum was good, unfortunately the service at the retaurant was very disappointing. The service staff actually forgot two of our orders which we ended up canceling as we had already finished our meal! On top of that, there was a miscommunication with the bill.. For a 5 Star Hotel, not quite up to the mark.

Author: TheItalianTravelistBarcelona, Spain
Title: unjustified high prices for average to mediocre products
Review: Mikey's Pizza is like Bangsar Telawi itself - pretentious, pricey and with no quality. I had a whole pizza half buffalo half meatballs (90RM) and cheese waffle fries Brooklyn (13RM), plus a couple of drinks, a coke (4MR) and an iced lemon tea (8RM). The food is absolutely no worthy the money. First you've to go order and pay the pizza at the counter (making it feel more New York?) and then they will bring it to your table when ready. The cheese used was not of the best quality, the buffalo chicken side of the pizza was leaking oil and it's probably the heaviest meal I had in my life. The waffle fries are tasteless, but so greasy you want to throw up pretty much. The service is kinda ok, but for a place where you live 120RM in Malaysia which is a kind of fast food at the end of the day you would expect at least a better service than that. The deco is miserable - fake green bushes on the outdoor which they look so cheap and plastic that not even a blind dog would dare to pee on them. I was surprised to see quite a few people eating dinner, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone (actually I will recommend to anyone I know to stay way far from here) - there're many better places in KL to eat pizza at half price than this, with a better ambience and a better service. I didn't give 1 star only because the dough was well done. Ah, the waffle fries comes with a "rich beef gravy" which tastes rich only in the use of MSG. To avoid.

Author: Vinosingh
Title: Lunchtime...
Review: Went for a corporate set lunch... For RM69++ you will get a selection of unlimited salads, cheeses and desserts, as well as a limited mains menu... The salads were great and the desserts were decadent.... The mains were a bit of a let down... The fillet mignion was not bad but the chicken dish was nothing special... Overall a good lunch

Author: Nacho F
Title: Excellent
Review: It was excellent and cheap. Waitress were helpful and kind. A must in Kuala Lumpur, even if the area isn't attractive for tourists.

Author: Asqalani
Title: Love the place!
Review: Friendly services with great environment, the food is amazing as well. Definitely a good moment to relax with the combination of awesome musics. 5 star for you Rachel!

Author: RaymondK393
Title: Great Nyonya experience
Review: Enjoy the Nyonya delights very much. The Nyonya fish, Chincaluk omelette, Sambal Sotong Petai were delicious ! Ayam Buah keluak was quite a disappointment, hope they will improve their chicken dishes.

Author: KuwombiaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Food is bland and definitely not worth it
Review: People go to Marinis for the view and not the food so why spend over $120 per person when all you want is a view. You're better off going to the bar and having a few drinks with a view instead. The food had little taste even though the presentation looked good. The only thing I tasted with some flavor was the risotto, which was too salty. Honestly, the food at a hawker station on the street tastes better. Save your money for drinks at the bar. Oh, service was excellent.

Author: Ben LLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Avoid. Just avoid
Review: Went in for a quick lunch. Menu looked good and interesting. We went for seaweed fried rice and a kimchi fried rice. Easy right? My partners rice came out and although it took some time it was nice enough. We had to wait another 35 minutes and ask 3 times until my seaweed rice came out. When it did it was cold. A table of 4 had come in after us and all been served before my meal came out and most of their food also came out before my partners. We expressed our disappointment but no apology. No explanation. Ordered another round of drinks while we were waiting and ridiculously that only came after my rice. Joke of a place. Either 1)tourists aren’t welcome 2)they are just constantly dreadful or 3)they were having an off day. I hope it was the latter.

Author: Passenger03114099292
Title: Excellent food
Review: The restaurant serves excellent food. The sashimi is thick and fresh. We ordered the set meal and the portion was huge. And I got my birthday surprises. We really enjoyed our food, and surely would like to visit again during other occasion. Keep up the good food!

Author: TanCKMalaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I went for a buffet lunch. The price stated at the website is RM140 nett per pax. But was charged there at RM168 nett per pax. I really cannot accept with such a rate, i did not have any other choices of drink except plain water, there is no coffee, tea, fruit juices, soft drinks, etc. Another thing is, saw a cheese cake at the refrigerator, but was not allowed to taste, as it was for refilling, can only be tasted only the other types of displayed cakes finished. I would hope if the cake was not allowed to be tasted, did not show it in the first place.

Author: Michael LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nyonya food was not as good as we had expected
Review: We were expecting very good nyonya food since Nancy's Kitchen featured prominently and ranks near the top of our search for nyonya food in Malacca, the home of nyonya cuisine.We found the food rather average. We had the candlenut chicken which was one of their signature dishes. It was served lukewarm and the chicken was rather tough and too chunky. Service was ok. The place was rather busy on a Friday evening. We think there are better nyonya food options in Malacca.

Author: Chay N
Title: If you are looking for vegetarian food don't eat here
Review: The tofu had no flavour it was disgusting. Everyone else in the restaurant was enjoying their food mainly because they were all eating meat dishes. Honestly so disappointing. The tofu was bland, no spicing or seasoning, no sauce, nothing.

Author: AusKIWIPerth
Title: Was very good super clean
Review:
We had two meals a late lunch which was perfect Then an evening meal again very nice.
Not a lot of local food however a nice change. Drinks good

Author: natiey
Title: Cheating in your bill.
Review: The cashier will try to cheat you, i have spend just for 60++ but he charge me almost 100 and he only use calculator to count our meal and without receipt. The reason given the cashier machine got problem, but when i enquiry again about the charges then only he count back in front of me and the actual is different. almost 26 ringgit i will lost if im not asking for the receipt. Please be carefull when dine in at this restaurant. Food just ok only.Nothing special,

Author: Matthew H
Title: So so! Nothing special
Review: A Halal Thai Restaurant - not great! Food was ok but not anywhere near traditional Thai food! Owner was friendly and staff were helpful, could be a lot better! Restaurant was not expensive and quite busy!

Author: jamierippingtonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Big disappointment
Review: Me and my girlfriend decided to come here for our final meal in Kuching after seeing how good the reviews were. However, our dining experience was pretty bad. I asked the waiter for his reccommendation and he told me to get the butter chicken and cheesy garlic naan. My girlfriend got the veggie curry and garlic naan. The cheesy garlic naan was more like a chewy pizza with not much flavour and not very naan like. The garlic naan was quite bland but much nicer than the cheesy one. The chicken in my curry was pretty good to be fair but the sauce was pretty gross. It was incredibly oily with pools of oil sitting on top of the sauce where it had separated after it had cooled. It was also very very sweet and left a bad taste in my mouth. The veggie curry was better, made with aubergine, but the sauce reminded us of curry sauce you get in a chip shop back in UK. All in all this meal didn't live up to the reviews, leaving us both with indigestion and irratablly full! Sorry guys!!

Author: Loke SIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: For what it boasts for, disappoints in many accounts. Overpriced for the Christmas menu. Only the wag yu 5 and dessert were good. The rest, average. Far from classy. Much to learn from places like Entier or Marini's or even Gooddam @ ss2 Hub- in terms of food and service. Sky dining? So many other places in KL for a good view of KL. Never again will I go, will not recommend.

Author: Julia W
Title: On everyone’s to do list
Review: Basic setting, plastic chairs and cutlery but food and staff fabulous at silly prices. Make sure you visit. If you stay in Shanghai La make sure you visit. Don’t be put off by the location.

Author: andri2805
Title: Decent effort
Review: ...these "decent" eateries however won't stand a chance if looked at on an international scale. OK coffee, OK food, good atmosphere. Singapore, Jakarta and Bali have many world-class restaurants and Malaysia probably has around 10. Serious change in standards needed.

Author: yenyun77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy salted chicken
Review: The chicken is juicy with salt and herbs. Best eaten hot (heat up before consuming it). The shop provides fresh salted chickens and frozen salted chickens as well (ideal for those who intend to bring the frozen salted chicken back to hometown and dine with family, friends etc). Mind you, the chicken is really salty! (that's what made it delicious)

Author: Koayteowlover123
Title: Oily n salty koayteow
Review: I had a business dinner last Friday Oct 30, unfortunately i chose koayteow. It came as insipid oily noodles, with hardly any taugeh and six strands of kuchai (I counted). It was salty too, and I sensed strong msg taste (or similar) that I developed palpitations and high blood pressure soon after dinner. It could be due to other reasons, though I was perfectly fine prior. I am disappointed with the food quality and taste. Perhaps the chef had a bad day. I wrote so that you can improve.

Author: CnD0523London
Title: Delicious, though a bit pricey for hawker food
Review: My wife and I went to the Mid Valley branch. It was very busy and we waited 10 minutes for a table. It was worth the wait. We had the Nasi Lemak and Prawn Noodles which were very good. With such delicious food, it is not a surprise the restaurant is packed. It is a bit pricey but if you do not like sitting out in the hawker stalls and paying a bit more, then Madam Kwan is for you.

Author: PhilGordon74Sydney, Australia
Title: Nice but too expensive
Review: restaurant is nice. Service attentive and quick. Wine list outrageously over priced but high tax on wine in Malaysia so not unexpected. Steaks were good but not amazing and ridiculously over priced for what they are. A $15 red was RM 250 which is over $80! The bar attached to the restaurant was awesome. One of my new favourites in KL. Outdoor leather couches are nice with lovely views of the Petronas towers. Avoid the restaurant and have drinks in the bar instead.

Author: arin9955
Title: Not bad neither impressive
Review: A revolving restaurant serving buffet dinner. Only 2 dinner sessions available for a night. Light music with a night view of Kuala Lumpur. Buffet food is fair. Seats by window at an extra though...,,

Author: ymungkuraadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Purrrfect
Review: The decorations was one in a millionAll the motorcycles,Formula 3 car and Ferrari as decorations was simply put of this world The collections was just too amazing The food was lovely and the coffees was excellentWe had a quiet discussion and because of the ambience,it was almost perfectA must visit when you are in Kuching

Author: cnaren1980Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Filthy eatery, and expensive
Review: Don't go to this restaurant, it is so dirty. Try going to the hand wash area or toilet. And take a look at their kitchen. Totally dirty and filthy. And the food is also so expensive.Once again, don't go. Restaurants such as these should be closed down.

Author: jenniem71Perth, Australia
Title: Popular with locals
Review: We were taken to Hakka by a local friend and had a great meal. The menu choices are many and varied and portion sizes generous. Our friend explained that the portions are more for sharing so we chose two starters and 3 small dishes for main with rice between 3 of us. We left feeling stuffed! Prices are reasonable and the quality of food and service is very good.

Author: JosephinetoadFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Why is there a line?
Review: When you calculate the time it takes to get the food on the table and the price paid for the mediocre food, it's best to just drive, yes drive, up to Penang for lunch. When you arrive in Penang, you can grab a char kueh Tiaw to go and bring it back to this cafe to let them savor how their signature dish should taste. Why are customers lining up to this place?

Author: NewbieGastronomistBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice Chinese restaurant
Review: Been there right after the heavy rain so the weather is very nice for sitting outside.Tried several dishes but some of them had to wait for so long that I forgot Their signature crab is just so so.Yong tofu is nice to try here.Salt and pepper shrimp is really good. Recommend to order

Author: shazamiera77Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: SAY SORRY IF YOU'RE WRONG TO THE CUSTOMER
Review: NZ Garden Cafe - 2nd April 2011 : around 11:45pm : first time here but I will NEVER repeat my mistake coming to a terrible place where your people can't say sorry to the customer even when they are wrong! How come you let a metal bar with sharp edges at the edge of your table, where your customer are sitting? Imagine if I am a customer with kids running around it will surely wound their head because it was a very sharp metal edge.I called their staff but nobody say sorry, even when I showed them my ruined and scratched leather handbag and I said, "Imagine this happened if I were to bring my kids along and something bad happen to them?" My colleagues was suggesting them to at least say sorry for the inconvenience but they just shook their stupid little heads like it was none of their fault.Guys! Where is your hospitality???? Not to mention that your food even your drinks taste horrible!

Author: sina1981Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: they can cheat people easily
Review: first of all food is so simple and the price is so high for this type of food, they just bring lots of kimchi that is taste less with very small amount and simple type of steak. another thing that happened to me there, i asked for bill and gave them my debit card they charged me two times and came back to me and told me my card has problem then i gave cash to them, this way they charged me 3 times. when i got to home i noticed it and called them but they refused to accept even after i send them photo of my bank statement. and still after 4 days they did not send money back to me and took lots of energy and time from me. they are really cheaters and having food there was wrost experience of having food in a restaurant in my life.

Author: jamesbV4437WFNew York City, New York
Title: Favorite Place in Kuching
Review: I stayed in Kuching for 10 days, and this became one of my favorite places. Other reviewers have commented favorably on the mango duck, and I would echo those judgements. There’s a lot of good local choices. The mindin (jungle fern) with shrimp paste was a favorite as well.

Author: Escape17407264347
Title: Hidden
Review: We had difficulties finding the location with a scooter. Dinner was nice, location also. Bit pricy. Do not forget to take „NoBite“ with you. They also give you a candle.

Author: Mandy_MWYipHong Kong, China
Title: Sold out before 2pm
Review: I reached this restaurant before 1pm, target to have lunch. But 1st, staff was not helpful, I was not sure of the queue of for take away or eat in. We keep seeing other tables have food bought by the waitress not getter Ng from the counter people were queuing. Again, we asked the staff there (they don't know English), they point to the queue. Ok, then we queue. But when I almost get to the counter. The guy in front of me said the meat sold out.Such a bad experience to visit this place and have no food.Not recommended to go if you do not speak Malaysian language.
Restaurant: Wong Kee Hai Lam Chicken Rice & Roast Pork

Author: Jellylim
Title: Do not miss !
Review: the environment is top notch, food are good and very authentic. The highlight of this restaurant is definitely the sunset that we all enjoy. simply magnificent.

Author: hedger9ukKota Kinabalu
Title: Great variety of Authentic Northern Indian Food
Review: My son said this was the best he has eaten but unfortunately he hasn't been to many, i enjoyed the variety of different flavours and spices to each curry. The Nann breads and Biriani's was good too. The condiments they serve with the poppadoms had no taste though and needs to be improved. I would return if i went to Miri.

Author: HaishanaBatu Caves, Malaysia
Title: Great variety of food with affordable price
Review: Love the ambiance, love the food, love the price! We had a very big group for lunch the other day, and they actually opened up the first floor just for us. The food presentation was catchy, it came in a box! I would love to go there again.

Author: 869jaztSingapore, Singapore
Title: So so ONLY
Review: Just had lunch at this place. The overall is only “so so” or ok only. The Chili is so diluted and when we ordered chicken breast, given mostly bone till we have to order 2nd service and emphasised that we want “breast meat”. Rice is very yellowish and typical Hainanese rice is not that yellow. Hainanese chicken rice without parsley and good Chili = not so complete

Author: V1465PYkimlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: After office dinner and drinks 🍺
Review: My colleagues and I frequent this restaurant as it is very near our office. Just the perfect spot to unwind for the day, have a drink and a laugh. The restaurant is situated in a row of shops , quite obscure from the main road and you have to drive slowly to look for the main entrance or risk having to do a u-turn on a very busy Jalan Raja Chulan. Valet parking is available as the nearest public car park is a 5 mins walk away.We usually sit outdoors, despite the noise from the road. The restaurant serves western dishes and has a wide selection of beer, wine and liquor. The standard of food is consistently good and staff are friendly and obliging.At our last dinner, a group of mat sallehs came and literally took over the place with loud obnoxious behaviour whilst everyone else tried our best to eat in some comfort and had to speak louder to hear ourselves! Maybe the management could have done something to stop the rowdy crowd but it was not to be. Alas! Business as usual...

Author: alisonzk_1
Title: Great flavours and attention
Review: First I have to recognize the attention. The staff is really kind and caring.Food is great too. Most of the options showed in the menu are available.It’s important to highlight that the restaurant follows the SOP, making mandatory wearing masks (and gloves for breakfast) I really appreciatted it.A very nice experience

Author: NaniSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Loved their baked egg pan
Review: Decor and ambience was instagram-worthy, the place had lots of natural light coming in. I really loved their baked egg pan with shredded duck in a tomato-spiced broth. The breakfast club platter despite their own-made bread was nothing special, unfortunately. A short 5-minute walk from Ampang Park LRT, worth paying a visit for brunch with friends/family.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Auldprop
Title: Best Laksa in town
Review:
Each to his own but for me this is the best laksa I ever had and suits my taste.The lady gives me more beansprouts and less Mee. Get there early or you will be disappointed.
Other stalls look good too.

Author: Kamarularif1989
Title: Breakfast with family
Review: Nice treatment during breakfast by paya serai. Special thanks to kalpana, linda, rizal, irma, rohini, teja, fariz and chef bobby

Author: pingping246
Title: Poor service
Review: Food is good but service is poor.  Took them a long time to serve, waited for a very long time even though all the dishes were ordered in advance.
Restaurant: Hoi Tin Lau Restaurant Sdn Bhd

Author: nazzerooney
Title: Great Service !
Review:
Service was wonderful.
Food was okay, maybe i have higher expectations after seeing some good reviews.
Ambience was fine but can be very noisy when it is crowded.

Overall - Satisfying.

Author: jasonk254
Title: Wrong info about dishes provided by waitress, and wrong order served to us
Review: Rather disappointing visit to Gourmet Sausage. Staff were inattentive as we had to call staff several times to catch their attention. We were served with wrong orders and waitresses doesn't seem to know their dishes.

Author: Karyn LMalaysia
Title: Good food
Review: Just went to fill out stomach. 1st time there. Food are good. Clean place, neat n tidy restaurant. We ordered curry fish head and a potatoes leave veg. But because curry fish head smells so good it attracts flies to our table. That made my husband agitated. Got to keep chasing those flies away while eating. One of the staffs notice his reaction he quickly took his initiative to bring us a candle in the glass so to keep those flies away.

Author: JVDZ7
Title: Mediocre food in beautiful jungle like setting
Review:
It’s a beautiful green oasis in the middle of urban metropolis. Pond with turtles and koi fish. Peaceful and romantic. 
However I was disappointed with the food. To me it was a food court quality which did not match the surrounding.

Author: SPPatelIndia
Title: Decent and clean
Review:
This is situated right at door step of Batu caves.
I had amazing coconut water. they have really huge coconut.
the food served is good.

Author: Amyang08
Title: Nice food..great service
Review: The food is above our expectations for the price we paid. Great place with great service. Absolutely loved it.

Author: Katie MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing location.
Review: Geographer cafe an amazing spot to watch the world go by on Jonkers street. A place we always stop to eat when we are in Malaka, unfortunately I think it will be our last. The quality of the service was unfortunately well below par. Serving staff inattentive and unknowledgeable about the food and when it came the food was nowhere near the standard it used to be. Still a nice place to sit but far nicer places to eat.

Author: Samantha8989kkw
Title: Nice environment but..
Review: Been there for birthday dinner. Foods were okay but small portion. A bit too salty. Service is fine. But what is disappointing is they charged us for one big bottle of stillwater 500ml for rm20? If they ask u, reject it and order alcoholic drink which cost rm20++ better. Ordered tiger prawn but turned out to be just normal prawn? Just nice environment and nothing else.

Author: teok870Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Lunch
Review: Thought we were going to be eating good peranakan food judging from queue. Very disappointed by cooking standards. Maybe expectations a bit too high. Bakwan kepiting and fish maw soup from similar stock. Avoid. Chap Chye too sweet and Assam pork dish too dry when using pork loinOverall will not recommend

Author: SAZZADhbdbx
Title: Hangout
Review: My first time.Awesome shisha and drink place in KL for best place ‘all staff are very friendly the help is for everything Mihad very nice and funny guy we are like him awesome personanlty make sure we will come back soon

Author: waterchlo
Title: Bad service
Review:
Food : Delicious especially omelette & vegetable 

Service : Horrible, we asked if they can recommend a few dish, the staff reply, “ how I know what you like to eat?!?!” 

What is this? Gosh

Author: ume1
Title: excellent fine dining restaurant
Review: delicouse food. very high end level. with asians and local ingredients. fantastic taste. very fine to the perfection presentated plates. thank you to chef and directors.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: Barrie MKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Deliberate overcharging
Review: Stopped by with a couple of friends for a few plates and couple of beersWhen i asked for bill was just told a price. When queried against what we'd ordered the waiter had just whacked on 40% for himselfAverage food for gap yah backpacker types who want an Asia-lite "real" experience.

Author: DeeDub002Dublin, Ireland
Title: Good tasty food
Review: We were staying in the Berjaya resort nearby where the food was mediocre and expensive, so having read reviews of GFC we tried it out and weren't disappointed. Basic good food done well and very tasty and great value.It was so yum we went back for more before we left. Its part of a food court and seating is basic, but service and value are excellent. Far better than Berjaya resort at a third of the cost. If you're in the area go!

Author: Freedom19135917277
Title: Penang cafe
Review: Must visit and try out this cafe while in Penang. Good food and lovely environment. Lunch or afternoon tea or just chill.

Author: 99rameez
Title: Not much halal options
Review: Its a good happening street to walk by. However, there are few Halal options there. And its street food but its not cheap.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: tikloonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Italian Dining Experience
Review: This is truly a place that we frequently return for the excellent authentic Italian food and great service! Food is always amazingly delicious and wine selection is extensive. You are welcomed by a cosy and relaxing ambience. Classy but not pretentious. Service is courteous and attentive. Truly a place that we will be assured to have a wonderful evening together with great ambience

Author: Kiki S
Title: Visiting 360 atmospher
Review: I had the chance to had buffet lunch at this atmosphere 360. The food is a below average and service is ok.i won't recommend it .its a shame for restaurant that they start to close the buffet 40 mins before and most of the dishes are not filled again.I missed having soups, fried fish , rice , spring rolls and on top of that when I went to have dessert only few pieces of desserts were left, once ice cream flavour was completely finished.Upon asking the Management to kindly refil the food and desserts they apologized and said it's all finished. :( .I did told the receptionist that it's your daily work your chefs should know how much quantity of food can cater to the Coustomer.The receptionist simply smiled and said yes yes. That's it. It's a waste of money to visit this restaurant.

Author: CSHew23
Title: Serve great food. Excellent quality.
Review: SHANG Palace has been giving excellent service. Food is up to five star grade. Good ambient and environment. If you like some quiet place with good food, here is your best choice. Highly recommended!

Author: EuninoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: top-notch
Review: Went with my mum to MO grill and had the lunch set. Loved the service - very personalized with good recommendations.. Mum loved the duck confit - crispy on the outside and breaks apart on the inside, coated with a lovely caramelized sauce. Waiters and waitresses were attentive. Did not mind us sharing and automatically took 2 plates out for us to share dessert - an after eight chocolate mousse which sweetness was perfectly balanced with a berry jus.Even got a surprise candy/chocolate box after to top it.

Author: tehjulie107
Title: food is not good
Review: ambience is nice.staff is good ... but the food is not good. very disappointing quality is not the standard of such a beautiful hotel...

Author: lsg181
Title: Real taste, good customer service!
Review: The location maybe a little hidden, but the good food will find its way into your gastro! Authentic Burt’s cuisine, especially the beef dishes. Look for ala carts and set menus.

Author: LarryKLBangkok, Thailand
Title: Good food at erasable prices
Review: A Parisian style restaurant in the middle of KL; a little dramatic in its interior, but fun at the same time.The food is good in flavour, and sometimes a little large in quantity. But generally no complaints.Service is good too; its not a very large restaurant, so there are always staff around.For French food in a Asian capital the prices are reasonable. Somewhere to go as a couple or with some friends.

Author: Joseph NBezeq
Title: Group package, but quality maintained
Review: The freshness test for Chinese food is, invariably, steamed fish, for which this place did not disappoint. It was firm yet still moist, and the seafood sauce was yummy. Polished it off with white rice.Vegetables were crunchy, too.Ambiance was slightly above average as Chinese restos go, and service was attentive--not bad for dealing with the two and a half busloads of us. So they get my four stars.

Author: SamuelSweeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pricey but good beansprouts
Review: I visited this restaurant on a recommendation from the friend. The beansprouts here have a good crunch and do not have a raw veggies taste as you might usually find in other southeast Asian countries. The chicken was also quite tender. You can see the steamed chicken in ice buckets. However the sauce was a little too salty and oily for me. The price of RM27.50 for two people, without rice or Kway teow is a little pricey.

Author: Sandie728Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super salads for whole food plant-based eaters!
Review: I have visited Simply Green Salad at the Gardens/Megamall twice in the past month and I have been super happy with my food experiences! The selection of vegetables and beans makes it super fantastic and satisfying for someone who eats a whole food plant-based diet. I hope you continue to maintain your super standards!

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food standards have deteriorated badly
Review: Visited again after a while and was very disappointed. Apparently they have a new cook. So, with the new cook, we had overcooked ribs. The meat was dry and hard, it was just about edible with the sauce. The Caesar salad was so-so, with very few bacon bits. The pork burger was small in size and “ok” tasting only. Overall, would not be returning unless they change the cook.

Author: s00pingl
Title: Won’t stop by in the near future.
Review: Seriously, tourists flock here? It’s giving Ipoh’s most popular food a bad name.I’m IPOH born and bred, been eating beansprouts chicken all my life. Lou Wong used to be good but it’s going to be a no-go for me from now. The chicken is tough, the beansprouts taste just salty, minus the sweetness. They’re not the “fattest” I’ve eaten either. Mind you, Ipoh boasts of growing the fattest and crunchiest beansprouts in this country and I can vouch for that. The kueytiao noodle broth is simply bland. The only plus point...prompt service. And Martin Yan was featured visiting this restaurant in its promotional video, haha.

Author: mohammedaJ5287URJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Bad service and attitude, food is average
Review: The variety of the menu is good. We didnt really like any of the 3 dishes or the three drinks we had but they were not bad. The fries were very good.The server we had was terribly bad with very unacceptable attitude that we are not willing to come again.

Author: yuenwahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Plenty of variety
Review: After reading the many reviews of this food court, decided to try out during our recent visit to Penang. Arrived around lunch time on a weekday. Waited a few minutes for a parking space. Place is packed, notice with more locals than tourists. Plenty of variety to choose, would say reasonable in taste only for the food that we ordered. But price is cheap.

Author: balibariElancourt, France
Title: Good tandori chicken and drink for 3 Euros !
Review: If you do not mind the lack of real air cond, basic tables and chairs, poor decoration, etc. yet if you wish to have a real tandori chicken for a rather cheap price, and really mixing with the local population if you "like other cultures", then I do recommend you the place indeed !

Author: mj18_12Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Good nyonya food
Review: Reasonably priced good nyonya food was what we got here. Amazingly we managed to get our seats pretty fast compared to the long list of people who came after us. It's better to book this place if you wish to dine here. Pongteh pork and nyonya fish were very sumptuous. I did not like the popiah here, could get better ones back in my hometown of seremban. Fried egg with cincalok was a below average dish. However I would really recommend this place to newcomers!

Author: G783ZSmichellel
Title: Cleanliness is pretty bad
Review: Used to come here often for dinner. However, there was once where I spotted cockroaches on the floor and near the washroom area and I dare not ever visit again!

Author: eileenh81
Title: Worst service I have ever seen
Review: Brought guests from overseas to have lunch there (total 20 pax in 2 tables). A few dishes were wrongly served (seafood and meat were used for vegetarian dishes) and a few were not served despite multiple reminders. 1st follow-up: the waiter said he was very sure that the kitchen was preparing the dishes but did not went into the kitchen to check. 2nd follow-up: all the waiters were trying to avoid eye contact with us when we raised our hands; when I walked to a group of them who were gathered at a corner, they quickly dispersed; another try got myself a waitress who was not sure of our order, she promised to check but never came back to us. 3rd follow-up: the manager told us that he has ensured that the kitchen got the order but he could not guarantee what happened in the kitchen because it was not under his control. We had to leave when it's time for us to continue our meeting after spending 1 1/2 hours waiting at the restaurant. Our guests from overseas did not get a proper lunch because among the 3 dishes that they had ordered, only 1 dish was served, which was very embarrassing for the host. During payment, dishes not served were included in the bill. After communicating to the manager of our frustration, he removed these dishes from the bill as a service recovery act. We told him this is not enough, he stared at us, shaked his head and walked away without any apology. He then sent a waiter to send the receipt to us to avoid the need to perform service recovery. Very disappointing!

Author: zulurologyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: average italian food
Review: was there for dinner. good location. tried the grill calamari, spaghetti aglio olio, and squid ink spaghetti. my personal opinion: ok but not fantastic.Still cant beat Ciao's. the squid ink spaghetti was very bland. The grill calamari is also not up to the expectation. The owner, Mr imran came to every table to meet up with the customer. waiting staff is ok but some are not allowed to take order. I love the tiramisu. The choc lava is also a miss. Too sweet with oreo in the middle. i will come back to try their lobster fettucine

Author: Jacki_ice
Title: Bad service and cold food
Review: Went over to celebrate Christmas dinner with my boyfriend, already had reservations however our drinks only came an hour later. We checked with one of the waiter and he said wait. When one of our orders came we asked again what was this, clearly the waiter doesn’t know what’s on the menu. He started saying it’s chicken. Knowingly there’s 4 other chickens on the menu. My food came back cold, and was unbearable to eat. Not only we waved to called for waiters but was left unattended. I couldn’t believe what an experience not only the food was bad, short staffed and bad service when waiter doesn’t even know what’s on the menu that they are serving. Clearly a bad Christmas dinner to go.

Author: Kiarash-R
Title: Delicious Steaks
Review: In this restaurant you can have very nice steaks but a bit expensive. They offer different drinks also and cooking level of your steak is exactly as you wish.

Author: samanthas792Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice setting to chill out!
Review: A nice greenery set up to enjoy quietness. Had a homemade lemongrass honey lemon drink which is very refreshing. Didn't manage to try the food as i was very full after breakfast. This cafe has a no photography rule. However i don't understand what a big fuss of patrons taking photos in the cafe. This is just so common nowadays where people & friends meet and would like to keep a memory the places visited. The set up of the cafe is just normal nothing phenomenon. Anyone would & could duplicate the concept of the cafe without referring to any pictures.

Author: fakhriAhmad
Title: Good chicken shwarma sandwich
Review: Just a quick take away shwarma sandwivh. Tastes authentic like the ones I used to get in the ME! Kind of pricey but within the range of pavillion mall price. Could be bigger-sized portion :(

Author: cjsbeautyandnailsBrisbane, Australia
Title: Not fine dining but more like a Mc Donald's Resturant
Review: Food is realitively good but the so called resident buffet for Christmas was appalling!Children were running riot and definetly in charge of the restaurant.
Restaurant: New Zealand Unlimited Restaurant at Puteri Harbour

Author: Shinny95
Title: Wait so long to order order
Review: First I come, I got one hours to wait my dishes. My friends already finished their dishes but I still waiting... Unfriendly staff... Need more improvement.

Author: MAXKLDEC
Title: Worst Buffet Ever-Latest Recipe Le Meridien Buffet Dinner 6:30pm Dec 12 2018 Wednesday
Review: From the service level to quality of food and rudeness of staff this is easily one of the worst ever buffets in KL.Unfriendly staff and service level:Arrived at 6:30pm was told by Front Desk at Latest Recipe that I would have to wait 5 minutes before I can be seated as there is "lack of staff" while plenty of Service staff were standing around with nothing to do. Was finally hushed to my seat by the rude unsmiling Manager None of the catering staff who were manning the counters were offering to serve customers at all, from the hot grill people to the dim sum person - they were just standing around waiting for customers to ask to be served. If customers were already at counter should you not ask customer if they would like a serving? They were just standing around talking to themselves? Only the pancake / yoghurt person was friendly and openly helped to serve customers and deserve special mention amongst all these other incompetent staffOne VERY PROMINENT example of poor service was Dim Sum guy who served around 7pm to 8pm - this guy was preventing customers from opening the bamboo steam baskets to see what was on offer and also did not offer anything to customers despite the very long queue at the dim sum counter...not helpful at all. Do your job and serve instead of pouting around and offending customers! Had the cheek to tell customers not to open the steam baskets but did not offer at all anything to customers standing in the long queue - really embarrassingManager was also not helpful, sulky face throughout the night as though it was the worst most stressful time of his day!Bottom line - this restaurant badly needs complete overhaul of service staff to improve level of service from front desk, management all the way through servers and counter staff. Zero level of commitment for a good customer experience.Food QualityOn menu were many items completely unavailable on the night I was there. Notable absences were smoked salmon replaced by some very inferior smoked duckCheeses were completely unfresh and stale tastingThere were a total of 3 roasted chickens and 1 baked rainbow fish throughout the entire buffet and these were gone in the first 30 minutes with NO refill! No wonder the counter staff did not offer willingly any food to customers - they have NO food to serve!!! Embarrassing1 plate of egg tarts were gone in 30 minutes as well and the refill were leftover uncrispy oil-laden cucur udang which tasted more inferior than the roadside stalls selling these! Maybe these were brought unsold from the roadside stalls after they were closed for the day! Horrible tasting!Dessert section was even more pathetic! Passion-fruit ice cream tasted sour and stale, had stomach ache after eating and headed to toilet right away!Lack of variety and all desserts snapped up in first 30 minutes only to be rfilled by what looked like lunchtime buffet leftoversMango pudding was not even a pudding but canned mango juice which was not set as a pudding. Macaroons on the menu were only 2 pathetic macaroons set atop some poor quality cakes as garnish - no other macaroons in sightNo crabs even though it was on the menu - just some sad looking unfresh prawns with really bad overnight mussels which tasted like rubberSeafood stew - every bite of this were mouthfuls of cracked mussel and other shellfish shells - it is a hazard to eat this and could be fatal if not careful!Sushi plates were gone in 30 minutes - none left at all for anyone who might come in lateWait - poor quality cheese were served with crackers which were the packaged "Luxury" branded crackers often found in low level supermarkets and convenient stores.Overall, to call this a five star hotel restaurant is a MAJOR overstatement as service level and food quality is worse than many 3 star hotels. Had a buffet at VE Hotels just last week at 1/3 of the price of this and much much better experience from both service level and food quality standpoint.At this price - advised that you spend your MYR or dollars somewhere else - once tried NEVER again will return. Acidic service laced with arcenic food!

Author: BigTone72Melbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful & tasty meal, excellent service
Review: 4 of us thought we should try Kabaya for dinner. Whilst pricey for Penang it was well worth it. We did the RM128 4 course dinner. Excellent starters for all to try & share. Duck, beef, prawn & lamb for mains which were succulent & tasty. Various Asian infused veges and beautiful range of dessert. The chocolate fondue was to die for. Excellent service in an old grand dinning room. Very classy and well worth it. Highly recommended.

Author: David MWoodbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great choice, well presented.
Review: We ate at the restaurant on several occasions and enjoyed the varied menu. Sit inside if you want airconditioned luxury or outside if you want to see the wildlife gliding over your head (yes, honestly, it's amazing). Food was always fresh and very well presented by the exceptionally courteous staff.

Author: JoachimG3
Title: Excellent burgers, but unsatisfactory experience
Review: Was a loyal customer until they scammed me. Maybe a sign of corruption. Second time that happens for me in KL in a few weeks. Disappointed and won't go there again. Be careful with your hard earned money.

Author: uptown121
Title: A French cafe
Review:
Settling along Jalan Telawi, Bangsar. 
This place was recommended to me by a French friend. 
Awesome pastries. Yummy estagos. A bit pricey but worth every penny

Author: ferrymulSingapore
Title: Average Chinese Seafood
Review: I was there after recommendation from a salon trip. The food is average. The place is not clean. The price though is quite easy on the pocket. But nevertheless, i will not return back due to hygiene reason, and there are many other options in melaka.

Author: cory1950Dallas, Texas
Title: Dining
Review: Had dinner at the Sentral outback. Service was terrible. We ordered burger and and the fried onions. The waiter dropped the food in front of us and left. We tried to attract attention as we needed ketchup for our fries. We were ignored. The burger was almost cold. We ran out of dipping sauce but no one came to check and no one to attract. When we finally want to pay our waiter asked a female waiter to go but my friend said no YOU. We told him of our dissatisfaction and he went to talk to the manager and we finally went to the counter where they were talking. Paid our bills and left. Never again to this location. We ate about a third of what we ordered. I could have gone to Burger King for 1/3 of the price and probably a better burger.

Author: menghampakan
Title: Rude workers.
Review: Rude workers. Seems the owners have no control on educating their workers. Food are thrown when serving. They talk aloud in front of you sitting on your table as if you are not in existence. Terrible experience during the recent visits. The restaurant is decreasing in its quality compared to a few years ago. Very dissapointed. If you want to be treated like a slave instead of paying money for their food, go there.

Author: NoFussDiner
Title: Cravings satisfied
Review: I'm going to make this simple.Quality: above averageTaste: above averageService: tailored for social distancing but still efficient. My thanks to Jenny for serving us and being so pleasant. Conclusion: if the craving for Japanese buffet hits you, definitely give this place a chance.**ice cream was dope**

Author: stefaniecstPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Love the simple homecook sarawak
Review: Just finished my brunch here at 11.30am. Love love and love the kacangma @ rm15 no rice and sarawak laksa normal @ rm9. Kacangma is so addictive and the pounded ginger yummy! Laksa fragrant without the oilyness like other laksa. Wish to try their hakka abacus seed only available on weekends

Author: jaswantb2015
Title: Great little Indian restaurant...
Review: We had aloo parathas and saag, along with masala chai. Everything was fresh and tasty. The service was good. Around the restaurant is "little India", with a Sikh Gurdwara, Hindu Temple,  shops, and an air conditioned mall!
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food

Author: KennethC1348
Title: Horrible Experience
Review: I have never tasted so awful food in my life! Do you guys know the meaning of fusion? Trying to fuse 2 different culture into a single inspiration but you have not done it. Simple mixing is an insult to both culture and worst yet trying to market it to simple lemmings who knows next to nothing but trying to impress their other half because "less says its good"Let me share my experience:1) pasta was served cold2) rice in their so called crab in roll was nothing but local rice.3) tuna salad was served soooo salty... try not to drizzle to much fish sauce!4) beef pasta smells poultry. We left the whole bowl after few scoops of taste.5) worst is their fish... cold fish!!! How dare you!I would not recommend any of my friends to this place...Kenneth Cheah

Author: HildybluesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bar with fun atmosphere
Review: From the time we walked in to when we left, we had good attentive service. From the suggestions to the choice of wines and beers and how our drinks were served chilled - all this made our visit feel a fun and relaxing place to be. We popped in after dinner so we weren't able to try out their menu.

Author: 481catherynlBrisbane, Australia
Title: Great shisha n ambiance
Review: The ambiance is great. If you sit outside on the terrace, you can watch the people and traffic below. If you sit inside you get air conditioning. You can smoke shisha inside and outside. The shisha quality is good for rm42. Service is good and attentive. Traditional hummus is good value for money as it comes with bread and olives for only rm16. Dessert is not very good and way pricey. I would visit again for the ambiance and service.

Author: KamranShaukatAliKhanLahore, Pakistan
Title: Really bad steak :( So disappointed
Review: At my first wedding anniversary, me n my wife in Malaysia for first time. I had no idea where to go so we both picked up TGI Friday for it is known for steaks. Damn, my bad. I don't remember exact price now but I remember that, for an economical steak at Fridaay's, I paid 3 times more than what I pay for best steak in Pakistan. And it was not even close to a real steak. I welcome anyone to come Pakistan and try Copper n Kettle (3 course meal) - best steak with soup and dessert (for about $12) In Malaysia, look for a Brazilian restaurant near SS22. I can't recall the name so check my reviews (as I will sure put a review later)

Author: RMZK11Seria, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Frequent visited restaurant
Review: I frequently visited this restaurant everytime i am in KL. Food's always great.However, this time it pisses me off for one reason. Opening time. It says open at 11am in google n it was written clearly at the shop. When i went there, it was closed. Fine. Then i asked what time they are open, two staffs gave me different timing. One says 11 one says 12. Since im having a quick trip to KL, knowing that I am not sure what time my favourite shop open sucks. Please improve your staff ability to answer questions especially the old lady.

Author: DovanLoh
Title: Probably the steak are frozen
Review: Went there for lunch on a good day. Spent 15 minutes looking for a parking. Got in, ordered a soup and a sirloin steak Medium Rare. Soup was pretty fine. The steak is No-No (and I was told this is the BEST-est steak house in town)! How is it possible for a good piece of sirloin steak to be dry and hard when it is cooked medium rare (the piece I had is indeed cooked to medium rare), but it taste like it was cooked to well-done level. Well, if it has been frozen for a long time... Probably that is the only answer.And the sauce that comes with it, taste weird, a little sour-ish. When asked the waitress 'what is this sauce? I find it a bit sour-ish, is it normal' and she told me that it is mushroom sauce and it tastes like that. OMG, RM100 lunch... Btw, also heard that their dessert is GREAT, but decided not to try it.

Author: msetoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beef Rendang is over-rated and overpriced, plain and simple.
Review: Firstly, heard so much about everyone raving about the beef rendang, so decided to try it. Dish comes with yellow rice, three other goodies, the rendang itself, veg side dish and achar of some sort. Rendang is soft, lean no visible fat (a good sign) however, the saltiness of the rendang eats away the delicate spices, the veg makes it even more salty...very unbalanced. Pickled item is okay, refreshes the palate a little, but too little given. On the whole, I don't get why people would pay 31RM for this. Over-rated and nothing like how a home cooked rendang should ideally taste.

Author: mikyarozHarrow, United Kingdom
Title: Bad service and very oily food
Review: Got to our hotel pretty late and this place came up as open until 11 pm with great great reviews. Clear to say it was a total disappointment. The person serving acted like we were an inconvenience and the food was reallly oily. I've had my portion of oily food in Asia but this was the worst. Left with a tummy pain and big disappointment.

Author: Rainne_TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pavlova is a must-try; staff attitude needs to be improved
Review: We went to Alexis on a KL friend's recommendation, and we were glad to have made the trip down to the shop. We ordered Pavlova and Tiramisu, as these two seemed to be the hot favourites among their regular customers. Their tiramisu was definitely special, with caramelized nuts on top. But I still prefer their Pavlova - creamy and sinful to the very end, with the sweetest strawberries, ever.The staff's attitude left much to be desired though. We were just gestured into the restaurant and obviously there's just one vacant table to the direction which the waiter gestured. No menu was given to us - I had to go to their counter to grab two menu. When we called and settled the bill, the waiter literally just threw the bill with our loose change back on our table. How rude! And just to make things clear, we had not made a single complaint or were being obnoxious while we were there. My partner and I were of smiles when ordering, and we said "thank you" each time our food and drinks were served to us. The staff's attitude were downright disappointing, to say the least.I'd go back to Alexis for their cakes the next time I'm in KL, but definitely not this outlet at The Gardens anymore. Their service is horrible.

Author: nooralysa
Title: Rindu nak makan lagi! Will come again!
Review: Me and my friend both ordered Mee Sapi..we can choose the mee *either use kolok mee or sanggul mee* and we can also choose either we only want beef strips in our broth or cow intestines/liver etc. I chose beef strips only and add generous amount of sambal *chili type of condiment* and it eat while its still warm. My friend even add another bowl lol. Delicious..flaming hot kind of breakfast and im loving it. Btw, the restaurant is rather old fashioned packed with local kuchingnites. I guess its their fav place for breakfast and im not surprise.

Author: C5968RA
Title: Great Malay food with a nice view.
Review: A great place to grab some cheap food and drinks. We had a starter and main each and a jug of beer for £15. Amazing. Really nice view of the river and a place we returned to a few times.

Author: benwolf223
Title: Food was cold
Review: They served us cold food! Ridiculous! It was not good at all! Wasted time and money! first time we went there was the very last.

Author: Mohd Hafiz A
Title: Good
Review: Nice place to having food for your tummy. Delicious food and nice environment. Must try if you come to JB

Author: DeborahT1840
Title: Eye Opening Japanese Delicacies
Review: Worth the time, worth the value! As this place brings you to an authentic Japanese Sushi experience that you thought it can only be found in Japan. I reco this place!

Author: Winnie_L_123
Title: Must book before go
Review: I did not able to try. Since been told by owner that we must make booking before go. But this is something should not happen ! How can a restaurant fully booked with empty tables. Only do one round of business???

Author: Stuart294265Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 18 Months on - not very good now
Review: I wrote a review 18 months ago here and went back to see how things are for my wife's birthday. Not good I am sorry to report and no longer worth the money. The steak is still great but the rest of the set meal was rubbish. Last time we had soup, roast port and pasta with a chocolate bomb and some quality wine. Now its soup, some tuna salad and a poor desert with a plastic bottle of cooking wine... may try again in another year but will ask whats on the menu before I go. See picture of cooking wine !

Author: harishbalaMuscat, Oman
Title: Disaster. No power. Ruined our anniversary dinner
Review: Visiting this restaurant after 6 years. Completely lost its charm from the place it was before. There was no power and they were clueless on when it would come back. They dont even have backup power. Ruined our 15th wedding anniversary dinner. Will never forget this.

Author: LucasKingKL
Title: Unreal
Review: Hi, I Went with friends had some beers, beers were warm ordered some food the steak was tough could not chew it and my friends chicken was not fully cooked we told the staff but they did not care.Asked for discount for the bill but we were refused.

Author: hannajomeansMalaysia
Title: Great service and food
Review: Andrew and his staff make you feel incredibly welcome and took the time to discuss dishes with us, explaining things we had questions about. The food was good. I give a 4 instead of 5, as I'd prefer the cashew chicken to have more than 5cashews thrown on as garnish. With that said, I will definitely go back. It's going to be a local favorite for sure.

Author: Dominic_HoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good stuff but can get better
Review: We tried the roast platter and it came with 3 types of roast. roast pork, char siew and roast duck. The char siew was good but slightly too sweet, roast meat skin not crispy enough and the roast duck is the best among the 3 items. It is not fantastic but it is what I consider above average. We also ordered the dou miao, prawn omelette, plain noodle and a fragrance rice. Dou miao was good, prawn omelette fantastic, noodle was soggy and texture not Q and fragrance rice good.In all, taking into consideration all dishes, the food is not bad but can be better.

Author: alistair200Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid - terrible service and rip-off prices
Review: Really slow service - 30 minutes after ordering I asked a waiter when my food would arrive. He said it was coming! About 5 mins later, he brought my main course and said my appetiser would be there soon. Seeing I didn't look very happy about this, he took away my rice and brought it back a few minutes later with my chicken pagoda appetiser. No, doesn't make sense to me either. The food was OK, but much less good than other Brickfields restaurants like ABC One Bistro and MTR or even PappaRich at NuSentral, and over double the price. The final straw was that they added a 10% service charge and GST to the menu prices, unlike all the other places. When I said I would give a poor review, both the waiter and the man behind the desk just shrugged, as if to say "we don't care, we'll have other customers".

Author: C8875BOjasonrEchuca, Australia
Title: Basic food done well
Review: Let me start by saying that I would rate this as good (3.5) if I could but these ratings go from average to very good. The food is basic but well done, we had a bit of a wait but the service was good. I had the chicken snitzel with pineapple and cheese which was large and very tasty, sadly the melted cheese slice detracted from it. The fajitas were ok but only provided with a piece of flat bread and not a wrap which would make it easier and more authentic.

Author: AdventureoverseasBrisbane
Title: Just average
Review: Admittedly we were there on an extremely busy night for the staff but the food service was slow and one of our meals came out a long time after the rest of our family had finished eating theirs.The place had a really nice atmosphere but the food itself was just of an average quality.

Author: LittleElephantsSydney
Title: Great curries
Review: Food was very good. Lovely service by staff, but the kitchen was very slow. The food took ages to come out, even though the place was less than half full. The kids food from kids menu was not great. The beef in the burger was so tough that my son didn't eat it. The wonton noodle soup was very average.Also very expensive, the price guide should be $$$$, but consistent with all the other hotel restaurants.Overall experience was a good one and we enjoyed the experience.

Author: WesmineKang
Title: Fantastic Wednesday Breakfast
Review: Fantastic Breakfast to kickstart my Wednesday | Hearty | Scrumptious | Lovely | Attentive Staff | Top Notch Customer Service

Author: Jorge DMadrid, Spain
Title: Totally disappointed
Review: Nice pictures on the Web. But when you arrive you feel like you arrive to a 90s restaurant old furniture, dirty menu list.... Nice view to petronas towers, that's all. Food is probably the worst in town for the price. Just the steak tartare and a crab ball were ok. The seabass a la meunière was horrible (farm fish). What to say about the wok rice with scallop and prawns.... unfrozen....unflavoured and cold . For the 500 MYR 2 pax you can go to a much nicer restaurant in town. I was expecting to pay 500-600 but for a nice lunch not for a food court quality food. It doesn't worth it. I was expecting a nicer food at the Grand Hyatt.... I have tried all the top restaurant in town paying the same and this one is the worst ever. I have been told that Sunday brunch is nice.... I will never try.....

Author: Jasontjx14
Title: Good service and good food
Review:
The unagyu and salmon sashimi were good! 
Many sake options too. 
Service was even better 😁 
Highly recommended!

Author: Hing Z
Title: 5star service
Review: i came with gf to celebrate our anniversary at lai po heen.Nice view ，good service and staff was so friendly . Especially clayton ，boon and jarren . They make me feel warm like family. Pecking duck very juicy and siew mai i like it.The restaurant manager kc and jane recommend us dessert as 「Durian pancake 」. My lovely dessert . goodRecommendation！I will come again .

Author: SarahChermaine03Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience is not up to expectation
Review: Staff are talking & chatting very loudly. Chicken salad - meat is tough. Passion fruit smoothie tastes like soursop somehow. Apart from the strong aircon, nothing I would recommend. Dining experience is not up to standard - cos there are more noise from the staff than I could hear my hubby. Not worth the money. There are cooler; more sincere cafes in Penang.

Author: Raja ASubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Terrible on my recent visit
Review: Ordered their fish and chips, but everything was overly cooked. it was not the same when I went there for the first time. Not sure this will be my fav fish n chips joint in the near future. Hopefully they will look back into their quality.

Author: Adly MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing 360 KL view from above while dining
Review: Went here for a hi-tea with families to celebrate mom's birthday. They even surprise her with a cake and played the birthday song. Adequeate choice of buffet food for an evening meal. If the weather is good, one can see a breathtaking view of KL. It's best to make a reservation to avoid dissapointment.

Author: Patrick CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive Food target tourist
Review: Went to have some chicken rice on Oct 2019 and noticed the food is expensive. The chicken given was all bones portion and it tasted very salty. Portion is small and expensive. The only plus point is service is fast. Many tourist eat there due to social media saying go to Ipoh must eat Chicken Bean sprout rice. Think there are more better food to eat then this chicken rice.

Author: Chews97Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: Food preparation was terrible, I've ordered a creamy pesto pasta and my wife ordered an aglio olio.The wife aglio olio was bad, pasta over cooked, garlic still whitish and raw, seem to be blanched in oil and boiled pasta water, tasteless and disappointing for such price. There were even parmesan cheese powder given for the dish, which is ....My pesto(which should be hard to fail) turns out bad as well, not much taste of pine nuts more of a sauce just created to suit the color.The prawns were rather fresh though.

Author: teja_anoushka
Title: Over-rated, can't understand
Review: The cooking is just bad.  The dishes are always overpowered by either herbs or sugar.  No delicate balance.

Author: usuariotripadvDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Bland cocktails, disappointing
Review: The place looks nice and the staff is friendly, but unfortunately the cocktails we tasted were awfully bland. Little flavour and barely a hint of alcohol. So much so that we wondered if there was actually any alcohol in them. Disappointing.

Author: StephenR81611Cuenca, Ecuador
Title: Ignore the others, seek this one out
Review: Surprisingly good fish and chips, with several choices of fresh fish to choose from. The chips and curry sauce is also really good. This place stands out from the huge selections of other bars on the Bukit Bintang for the food and the service.

Author: Naveen Raaj S
Title: Spicy Sensation
Review: Excellent food prepared by the most dedicated chefs that makes you want to come again and again. Get those spices work your appetite up.

Author: fernkg
Title: Awdul
Review:
Awful service, food was ok - spoke to the ‘assistant manager’ about the service charge, they refused to remove the charge.
Rude, staff all sat down behind the corner

Author: Kevin_TannKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Most Horrible Female Captain whom is a liar!
Review: Read the other reviews. This woman blasted us with a 1800 bill with multiple items we did not order. This was the 3rd time we've experienced this and we are 100% convinced that she is doing this to many customers. Last time she charged us 200 for mangoes and it wants even in the bill after we paid CASH. When we asked her whether is the mango, she conveniently said OH it's in a separate bill. Never go to this restaurant no matter what! We asked for 2 medium sashimi from the menu and was billed almost 800 for a bunch of stuffs which was not on the menu.Why would the owner tolerate this? Unless she is some share holder or something. We were in a party of 7 adults and 3 kids. No more Kuriya!!!

Author: CarnivoremermaidKuala Lumpur
Title: Forget the buffet
Review: So I had been lusting after the Hanare buffet for awhile. I will NEVER trust food reviewers' feedback 100% after this because they are obviously given preferential treatment. Long story short, I will never go back to Hanare. First off, the weekend buffet comes with a hefty pricetag: It was about RM180 including tax, PER PERSON. The spread was very close to being miserable. Granted, they served tuna belly but as someone who does not appreciate tuna, what was it worth to me? I made a beeline for the salmon which turned out to be less than fresh, so I tried to seek solace in a comforting dose of selenium that the promise of fresh oysters offered. However, in that quest too I was to be thwarted. For once my party and I sat down, we were handed little magnets that represented the rations you were allowed to have. One colored magnet for a pair of TINY oysters, and one clear magnet for a serving of badly-cut tuna belly. It was an insult, paying so much and having to be rationed. As if the patrons were uncivilized enough to clear the freezer of oysters and tuna within seconds. Zipangu at Shangri-La and Minori at the Royale Chulan never had such issues. If they ran out, they simply issued a polite statement to the diners. I was rather affronted by this system.Plus points: The oden was very good, but it is oden, hard to get it wrong. The fresh prawns were very sweet and delicious though.The pancakes they served were quite tasty, but those didn't last long. The teppanyaki took a long time to reach the table so by the time we had finished our mains, most of the desserts had been eaten and the waiters made very little to no attempts to replenish them. Overall: I felt very bad that I had dragged 5 of my friends there to celebrate a birthday and they left feeling extremely ripped-off and unsatisfied. I will not be returning to Hanare ever again, it is simply not worth the premium price for such a lackluster spread, when many other places offer the same or more items for a price that is gentler on the diner's wallet.

Author: IzzatyMeow
Title: Out-Concept ! Served Korean Food & Korean Music
Review: The cheese baked rice was not good. Love the concept but Korean musics & food is a big NO! Frustrated :(

Author: 478sallybBrussels, Belgium
Title: HORRIBLE
Review: I ordered the “house specialty” lamb shoulder with French fries and peas. While the sides and sauce were fine, the “lamb” was inedible. Fatty, chewy, disgusting. I am taking it home for my dog. Moreover, this place is way overpriced. I will never eat at Acme again. Keep away.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Lennon N
Title: Not open on time
Review: Went there on a Thursday 5:30pm. Sign board clearly stated they are open today and shop not open, phone nobody answer. Totally waste of time.

Author: Ankor94
Title: Wonderful Tea and drinks
Review: Charming place in the older part of Ipoh near the night market. Great tea to drink and to buy as presents. Also tasty snacks. Friendly and helpful staff. Great setting in a historic building. Would love to go back.

Author: Addy_L_22
Title: Food taste not up to par
Review: The buffet lunch has a wide selection of cuisines, however the taste is not palatable. The otak-otak that we had was extremely hard that I could knock it on the table and the otak-otak didn't even break. Spoke to the staff about the food quality but they didn't give any response. For an international hotel, the food doesn't match up to international standards.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: AI1980
Title: Very disappointing
Review: I can nr believe the rating of 4 here! This was the most disappointing Italian food I had in the last 8 years. Minestrone was with fresh vegetables but the broth tasteless and out of the pack. Onion soup tasted ok but the cheese melt was in a bread so tiny and hard that I almost lost my teeth. My sole was overcooked, dry and the lemon/caper sauce congealed. My wife's seafood pasta a signature dish was ok but way too peppery. All in all very disappointing and one if those places where I regret to spend my money

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Modern Amongst Old
Review: Located at the junction of Jonker Walk and the bridge to the Red Square is the modern cafe amongst the old heritage buildings. Overlooking Melaka River a great combination of historic views and modern lifestyle. Great place.

Author: willseeyouthereperth
Title: Rather normal food
Review: We come to this restaurant for family lunch but found the food only got the name. Food is normal and nothing special. Not only the appearance is standard but also the test is light. Plus it is a bit pricy so I think go to other food court can get better food and cost less

Author: Christopher MBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Family Reunion
Review: We chose the Bombay Palace as it was both highly rated and close to our hotel, plus my daughter who had been traveling for 4 months in Australia and Asia was craving a decent India meal. They greeted us by name and the restaurant was beautifully furnished.The food was as hoped excellent and service very courteous and attentive even though the restaurant was quickly filling up, however the restaurant lacked atmosphere and wasn't somewhere you felt you wanted to stay and chat there was simply something missing - perhaps a little music would help but honestly I think the problem goes deeper.

Author: MartinF3969
Title: No beer!!!! Unbelievable!!!
Review: Can you imagine a bar without beer. Well, comme to Healy Mac's Jalan Ampang. After getting one draft, we're told there's nothing left. Not just draugh, but also no bottles left. Unbelievable!!!

Author: pipped_upKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Crap crap crap
Review: The worst service I've ever experienced in Malaysia (and that's saying something). Basically, had to stand up and walk around to find a waiter whenever we wanted something. Expensive also, when you consider the quality is average. Order a kebab and you even have to pay for rice. Total rip. Avoid!

Author: Loopy230612Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Delicious dinner and great service
Review: I have been living in KL for over a year, but this was my first time going to Michelangelo's...I have been missing out!! The menu presentation was very nice, with some great photos of some of the main dishes. I liked the fact that they had separated out some of the Chef's Specialties as well. We ordered some appetizers (Mozarella di Buffala e Pomodora, and Insalata di Mare) which were absolutely "spot on" in terms of flavor and freshness. We also ordered a veal dish (name escapes me) off of the Chef's Specialties, with a mushroom sauce that was absolutely amazing. The veal was so tender, and the sauce had a very balanced flavor. Throughout the night, we had Arris and the rest of the staff helping us at every turn...the service was fantastic!!I have found a new great spot to go to for dinner, and since it's located at the Pavilion shopping mall, it's oh so convenient!!

Author: Chia S
Title: Worst Nyonya Food Ever
Review: We have wait hours for the food to be serve but the food was cold. This is my worst nyonya food experience ever. Don't know why people giving high rating... totally misleading and disappointed.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Alfanso1959Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Salted Chicken in Ipoh
