Review: Taste of the chicken is not too salty. The location is in the centre of Ipoh. For people who want to take away can just stop in front of the shop. The worker will come and ask the order and hand the chicken to you in a minute.

Author: ChristianTVCSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: From 5 star to 1 star
Review: When they first opened their doors in Publika few years back, I was one of their pioneer patron, they serve really thick, succulent and juicy pork steak. I became a fan of Ante.HOWEVER, it all went down today with a chain a bad encounters, not only their food quality, the dining experience as well.First for the drinks, ordered RED APPLE JUICE, it came GREEN APPLE JUICE. Was not told any of the time that they have no RED APPLES until they serve it, and they just serve as if RED is the SAME as GREEN APPLES. Secondly on starters, ordered their MISO PORK BELLY (slowed cooked belly, miso glazed and herb crusted). The dish came without the herb crusted, asked the waiter, he claimed their menu changed, the dish was from the new menu and MISO PORK BELLY is not available. Short say they served what was NOT on the menu and NOT we have ordered and NOT told any of the time that they have a NEW MENU. At this point, we were utterly disrespected and disappointed.Thirdly on the entree, ordered their signature PORK RIB EYE. Upon serving, I immediately sliced the pork steak and came to find that a few parts of the steak are slighty undercooked, of course I send it back to the kitchen. Not long after, they re-present our dish with the same pork steak that I sliced, not a brand new PORK RIB EYE dish. I would call this dish, 'sliced and diced pork steak'. By this, they have deviated and destroy the presentation, originality, taste and most important the texture of PORK RIB EYE. Now our dish was overcooked, heavily underwhelming. On this particular day, the restaurant manager was not in, and their staff have to endured our complaints and dished out tons of apologies especially Zeeya and Wa-wa. From their tagline, "KL'S PREMIER PORK STEAK RESTAURANT", today is an ultimate LET DOWN for me and my family, a bad dining experience.

Author: elveee
Title: Good food marred by horrible service
Review:
Came for lunch with my dad and it was almost full. We headed upstairs and the only vacant table was a large round one. Stood around for a while to see if there were smaller tables available or if the staff would come to assist....Nope, nothing, so we sat at the large table.

Walked to the staff at the counter to place my order because no one came and was told to sit down and wait. After my order was finally taken, a more senior staff came and asked how many of us were dining. "Two" i replied, and she let out a very loud sigh in front of me. She then went over to another colleague to loudly complain that we were just two people occupying the table.

The food came and my roast duck and roast pork noodles were cold. The noodles had already stuck together in an oily clump. Asked for chili sauce and was again told to wait - it never came.

The food was really good a few years back. It would have been good as well today, if it was served warm and with chili sauce by hospitable staff.More

Author: Wolv3rin3Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Banana Leaf Veggies Meal
Review: This review is for the Brickfields 196, Jalan Tun Sambathan, Kuala Lumpur branch. One of the more authentic banana leaf restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. A small quaint shop, basic decor and seating.Tried out their Saravanaa Vegetarian Banana Meal at MYR 11.40, not bad. Though I'm missing my local style banana leaf with heaps of fish and mutton curry.

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: There's better brunch restaurant out there.
Review: Went here for Brunch at Bangsar.They have the buy 1 free 1 coffee, which was an excellent choice.Ordered Benedict's Egg and the I'm So Hungry I Could Eat a Wolf.The meal was alright, but the only problem i had with the meal was the eggs. I ordered Sunny Side Up at first, but then i change my mind like a minute later and request for Poached Egg, but at the end i received my Sunny Side Up instead. So I no complain about that, but the problem with one of my egg that one of the egg they serve is horrible. The Benedict's Egg one is that they put too much leaves on the plate rather than meat. I prefer more meat than greens. Other than that i'm no problems with their food. Should maybe try their dinner menu. Went there for the Brunch and because of their promotion for the drinks, it's still acceptable.

Author: Nitegal80Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice sauce, bad satay
Review: After hearing good feedback on this satay stall, I decided to go down to try it. When the satays arrive, it tasted too dry & saltish. Really not to my taste. But the satay sauce is really nice .. Can taste the sourish pineapple taste inside. I don't think I will go back for satay again cause I think the Malay stalls satay tasted better.

Author: Kay6388Malaysia
Title: The worst nyonya food that I have taste
Review: Went there after seeing some highly recommended food reviews n proclaim by some saying that It offers one of the best nyonya food. Extremely dissapointed with their food. Ordered 8 dishes namely devil's chicken curry, cencalok egg, rendang beef, chicken pong teh, deep fried fish tengirri with chilli, belacan kangkung, mixed veggies n asam pedas prawn. All d food tat we ordered was tasteless, precooked n reheated with microwave when arrive. The chicken pong teh tastes sweet and were cold. While d devil's curry taste sour which i think they afd 2 much of vinegar. We couldn't even taste d cencalok even though it was called cencalok egg. Mixed vege was boiled n taste bland. Fish was boiled n covered with some chilli paste n all we could taste was d paste.The only dishes tat was edible was d belacan kangkung. Total price is Rm 150 for 7 pax which i feel was expensive given d food tat we consumed. This is d worse nyonya food that I have taste n they even proclaim to have 27 years of experience cooking nyonya food.

Author: pedromrmaMaputo, Mozambique
Title: To avoid
Review: Some how the employees must think they are Rock Stars and we, costumers should serve them because not only they take FOREVER to knowledge you, they come as if the world owes them something and for last they don't know nothing about nothing.So, unless you are a shareholder of the HardRock Cafe and know all there it is to know about it, I would recommend: Enter, buy the t-shirt, leave asa fast as you possible can.

Author: Weill2128
Title: Dirty Chinese restaurant
Review: Very dirty Chinese restaurant !I have visited this restaurant many times but the table cloth, spoon & chopsticks most of them are not clean & still have the dirts or the those foods that left behind. The attitude of the staff not so good cos all of them seem tired & don even want to served u when u requests them to order the foods. I hope this 5 star shopping mall can have a 5 star Chinese restaurant.

Author: TonyP992Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Really poor food
Review: Went last night for Dinner with my wife and a close friend. We skipped the appetizers and my wife ordered the barramundi sea bass, we both ordered the Kansas style ribs.My wife's fish was so bad, and salty, she couldn't eat it. The Kansas ribs were supposed to be marinated and spicy. Was neither. Seemed to be broiled. The guys were both hungry so we ate it, but it just showed really bad cooking skills in the kitchen. When they asked how was our meal, we said really terrible. Just got blank looks.

Author: schnecki95Goettingen, Germany
Title: Simple but delicious
Review: It‘s a simple restaurant but the food was very delicious and the staff very friendly. We had to wait quite some time until the food arrived but since the juices were tasty as well it didn‘t bother us. The food is cheap. You can only sit inside. We would recommend going there! :)

Author: 231visitorPenang, Malaysia
Title: Great meal in lovely setting
Review: My wife and I went last night to Kebaya with another couple. The restaurant itself is beautiful, the service was excellent, the food in terms of quantity and quality was superb. We followed the suggestions from the waiter and shared our choices. We could not finish all the main and veg. If you want a treat, go there !

Author: EmDani
Title: Banquet
Review:
Excellent food really really delicious but no roti!!!! We enjoyed the Malay banquet and found it absolutely delicious- excellent honey chicken and rendang 
Very enjoyable

Author: LeonCheah
Title: Good coffee/food and nice environment.
Review: Ordered big breakfast and the chicken waffles, enjoyed it, will definitely come back again. Kind staff too!

Author: bobyohKlang, Malaysia
Title: Malaysian style western cuisine
Review: This restaurant chain have moved away from Western concept menu to a more Malaysian context. 5 years ago the red table cloth were checkered and menu items are mostly meat grills, steaks, chips and chops. Nowadays, a peek at the menu and today specials revealed Nasi Tomata, Ayam Percik and the sorts. Perhaps it is due to marketing reason. I prefer the old style Western concept though I think by going to Malaysian concept bistro, this place will lose its uniqueness. The food now is run of the mill Malaysia staples such as satay, nasi lemak and the likes. For the price, I would go "kopi tiam" style bistro anytime

Author: Graham0709Newcastle, Australia
Title: Beware MSG in all food
Review: This is a good open air restaurant with a retractable roof should the weather turn nasty.Unfortunately all food items are treated with MSG & there are NO signs to mention or caution about this.When I complained to the management about this, they did re wash my meat and vegetables prior to cooking.Being open air, it can become a bit humid at times even though they have fans placed near the tables.Staff are very efficient

Author: Swee Hiang PPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Ayam Bakar
Review: This restaurant is famous for its Indonesian menu. I have visited the Bandar Baru Bangi branch almost two years ago. Today I made it to the branch in Bandar Seri Permaisuri, Cheras.It is famous for its ayam bakar (fried chicken) and ayam penyet (spicy fried chicken). However, I tried the Pecel Lele which is a deep fried ikan keli (catfish). The red and black chilly sauces add the spicy taste to the crunchy fish.

Author: harrynsamVancouver, Canada
Title: Disappointing meal
Review: The restaurant was in a beautifully and sympathetically restored period building and the maitre d' kindly escorted us to see the common areas of the Seven Terraces Hotel when we expressed an interest in the building. The dining room was lovely.Having read previous Tripadvisor reviews, we were prepared for the 4 course menu. For appetizers, we had the pai tee (the deep fried prawn was shrivelled and tough) and the maung kham (delicious), each of which were 3 mouthfuls of food.For mains, we had the roast pork and the special of the day, a scallop sashimi salad. The roast pork was delicious except there were only 5 small slices. The salad was interestingly delicious with at least 10 ingredients that I could identify.The tempura vegetables came in a thick, crisp, hard batter with no resemblance to Japanese tempura. The sprinkled belachan powder was a non event.The cher char was just a small heap of stir fried mixed local greens with nothing to distinguish it.The pandan creme brûlée although too sweet was deliciously smooth for the 5 teaspoons that we got out of the teacup it was served in.The cheesecake of the day was 2 spoonfuls of fluff with 1 spoon of ice-cream.We felt that the 4 courses were at best appetizer sized.Perhaps Kebaya is trying to emulate some Michelin starred restaurants who serve precious little tastings.With so many excellent reviews, our expectations might have been too high. However, the food served did not include expensive or exotic ingredients or require elaborate cooking techniques and there was no reason for the food quantities to be so small.

Author: Jean-Luc KHong Kong, China
Title: Good international seafood and good service
Review: Within a group of several restaurants at the basement of a high market shopping gallery. Nice atmosphere, very good service.The food is international seafood dishes. Prices are varying a lot depending on the dish, probably based on the provenance of the fish.A bit pricey but proportions are generous and everything we had was very good.Good wine list.

Author: R_P_MittalToronto, Canada
Title: Amazing place with some great dishes.
Review: Ambiance is just exceptional, so very British looking. Restaurant itself is quite nice with option to sit in sunlight (covered with glass roof and air con). Staff is helpful and caters to your requirements. Queen of puddings remains my favorite with no other place serving such an awesome delicacy.

Author: BendyBonesManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Worth seeking out
Review: Lovely restaurant attached to La Pari-Pari accommodation. Not the easiest place to find, down a side lane filled with pot-holes, but worth the effort. The staff are friendly. The decor is minimalistic, giving off a relaxing vibe. The background (French themed?) music added to the ambience. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our 3 course evening meal with a few drinks. Definitely value for money and would recommend a visit.

Author: vivienateng
Title: attend a 4 year old birthday party
Review:
was there on feb 10 for a 4 year old birthday party.  ample space for parking.
saturday night mid week of the month. lots of families there. food was lovely but short of service crew.

Author: Ruth L
Title: Chicken satay is mostyl gristle
Review: We had the satay chicken and the sauce was nice but the actual chicken skewers were tiny and all gristle (disguised with the spices they had been cooked in). We didn't eat them.

Author: Monika NAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great place!
Review: We have visited Thirstday 4 times in a week which is the best review on itself. All my friends fell in love with their pizzas, they have a great flavours like duck and mango or satay chicken, you can get traditional ones as well. Presentations of other dishes are beautiful, great selection of alcoholic beverages. Very nice live music band in the evening, cool decorations, really good vibe.Can get a little bit busy with slower service but all of the staff are super nice so they always try their best to give you the best service.Definitely must visit in when in Langkawi!

Author: Henry LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive for ‘only average’ food
Review: Food is pricey. A plate of salted egg crab (yes, only one crab) costs RM91. This is by far the most expensive crab dish I have had in local Chinese restaurant in Malaysia - it’s definitely much more expensive than those in KL, Penang and Kuantan. Not worth the price! Service is good, food is average. Even the signature crab - Salted egg crab is near to tasteless. Can give it a pass. Crispy roasted chicken is good though. There are other good restaurants around.

Author: SurreyRoamerSurrey
Title: overrated
Review: Service on the evening we went was shockingly bad. There seemed to be nobody in charge; despite repeated requests to find out what had happened to our food, our starters arrived after 45 minutes and had to be sent back as they were cold. As the courses started to arrive, it was clear that there was more confusion about the cooking than fusion. The limited wine list was curious in its choices and outrageous in its prices. There are lots of good places to eat in George Town; don’t waste your time and money here because they don’t know what they are doing.

Author: Kun M
Title: Ramadan dinner with lebenon and local cuisine
Review: Went to dine with business partner for buka puasa dinner.it was amazing.many choices of food especially lebenon cuisine.guest chef hallal was there interact with dinner. a lot of choicesandbplebty of food.lily is amazing i see her for breakfast and dinner.Always quick service

Author: tricam
Title: Not bad. Staff poor
Review:
We ordered the:
 Pie Tee - excellent.
 Omelettes - also excellent.
 Traditional house rendang special - tasted ok but they got the order totally wrong and forgot the rendang.
Staff were inattentive and communication was poor.

Author: 461clarejFarnham, United Kingdom
Title: A little disappointed
Review: Night 2 of 4 in KL with the Steakhouse following Tamarind Hill as our choice of dinner venue (well researched and booked months in advance). We expected quality dining, great steak and ambience but were left ranking it as number 4 out of 4, i.e. our least favourite. Why?Pro's - nice service (although front of house lady seemed cheesed off and struggled to engage - but clientele we saw perhaps caused this - it's NOT a classy location)- my steak (tenderloin) delicious although on the rare side of medium rare CONS- husband's bone in sirloin poor quality, tough and tasteless. We should have sent it back but had given up a bit by that point- street restaurant is located on. Some kind of Blackpool, Benidorm impersonating tacky street full of bars and eating places that was great if that's what you wanted but not great if you were thinking nice romantic meal with good quality food (El Cerdo the exception - see later review).- wine list. Very very overpriced. We felt they did loss leader on steak (to compete with the street?) and tried to make up profit margins by charging excessive margins on cheap poor quality wine - scallops for start. Great quantity but over cooked, chewy and a bit gritty dare I say. At 49 ringits I expected much more - pepper sauce with my steak. Unpleasant and inedible. Very salty and unlike any pepper sauce I've ever had ( I asked them if this was really it and they said yes - seeing my dismay offering an alternative would have been nice)We really cannot believe the TA rating. We think those who reviewed must have eaten in pretty poor places to be so wowed. It's pretty average. Don't go expecting anything other than average food overpriced.

Author: anunknownsiteManila, Philippines
Title: cheap and tasty roti canai and mee goreng seafood
Review: It’s always a good sign when you see locals eating in a place too. This nasi kandar definitely satisfied my roti canai craving! I was here four times in a week (always passing by Jalan Alor food stalls without regret). lol Food was consistently served hot and freshly prepared. Prices were reasonable and cheap. MYR1.20 for one roti kosong (plain). No worries if you’re going solo. The servers were approachable and polite (esp. the tall lanky one). Nice of them to ask if I wanted the fried noodles to be spicy or not too spicy.Love Tg’s nasi kandar!

Author: Wei Wen CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great ambiance, mediocre flavor.
Review: The vintage jazz music and friendly service staffs are definitely plus points for this newly established restaurant. The idea of self-customized meals is creative and together with the quirky and creative interior, this place serves as a great attraction to the younger generation.However, it isn't outstanding when it comes to the flavors. I had the grilled pork fillet sandwich at the price of MYR 15. The portion is relatively small as compared to other major sandwich chains such as Subway and Quiznos for a similar price. The grilled pork fillets taste bland and the sweet and sour sauce just could not make the cut. I'm looking forward to a better improvement as the restaurant has a great potential to be successful.

Author: DastageerMuscat, Oman
Title: Lower quality than expected
Review: First time went to this restaurant,, there was long qui we have to 45 minutes, we imagine food will be delicious, but when they served the food, karahi half cooked with hard chicken, the DAAL was OK. The tikka also was taste less, price also higher as compare to other Indian restuarant , I never will go again there.

Author: Surendaran CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very Rustic place
Review: This is such a cool place. The rustic feel and look of the place with all the junks around makes it looks really amazing. Went to have a chill out with my fiancee and tried your tiramisu cake. It was amazing. The food portions that i see on the other tables was huge and I was glad that I didn't plan to order any food else I would be rolling home.I will definitely come to try the food the next time I come to Kuching. Do come early or make reservation as this place is always full.

Author: PknowlesiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Quantity, Average Quality
Review: To start off lunch with a cold Chawanmushi is so dreadful. The menu is extensive. Fresh oysters didn’t really look and taste fresh. Sashimi and sushi roll was good. Fried squid and chicken was tasty and not overly salty. The baked scallops and shrimps were good but just a tad small. The service was very good. Very friendly and attentive staff within the restaurant. The ordering system using slips of paper was rather messy and could be better. I may or may not return.

Author: Sharifah SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Heavenly Thai maybe but Tom Yum Mee Hoon far from heavenly
Review: Our family was looking for some simple Thai cooking so we were thinking that we can't go wrong with Phad Thai and Tom Yum with meehoon. I think we were being a bit too simplistic in our expectations. The Phad Thai was tasty enough, the quantity was insufficient for a 25-year-old, as he says he would gladly pay for a larger portion. But the restaurant must surely win the honours for making one of the worst tasting Tom Yum ever. It was extremely watery, with two tiny pieces of prawns, one tiny slice of squid and one miserable morsel of stale fish. They were indeed generous with the meehoon - albeit being the cheapest ingredient. To be fair I was told Amarin is the place to have rice and other dishes. Complaining to the waiter would be a waste of time as my husband tried to explain how disappointing the dish was. The waiter just looked blankly at him before handing over the check!

Author: Sillymommy2003
Title: Yummy Pizza!
Review: We love the NY style pizza. Giant pies that feed our large family and leave plenty of leftovers for breakfast the next morning!

Author: SuYuenC1
Title: Best Italian place in KL!
Review:
Definitely order the following items:
- toast focacia with foie gras
- burrata with tomato. The burrata is really authentic! Almost like the ones in Italy!
- angel hair pasta is their best pasta of the list

Author: carolinafzsdKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Okish and expensive
Review: It is a okish restaurant. The decoration took me to my grandparents house style. We sat close to the cellar door, each time it was opened a mold smell was coming to us. It is a steakhouse full of seafood in its menu. The meat was tasty. Our dinner was RM470 with 2 main dishes and 1 bottle of house wine. No starters, no desserts. I wouldn't return, I think KL has better restaurant options.

Author: Henrik Bæk JOdder, Denmark
Title: Not worth it - overprized
Review: Well, they have fantastic views, but that is it. We ordered the 6 course degustation menu and 4 glass of wine. First course was one (1) olive, fried and funny served, but anyhow. The wine menu was very disapointing. To start a "glass" of procecco, which is fine for an Italian restaurant, but the quantity was ridicilous - maybe 4 cl. That was the only Italian wine served at an Italian restaurant. I guess the total quantity we got was half a bottle in total and that for a price of 75 EUR.Twice as expensive and half as good as "Cedar on 15" that we visited the night before.

Author: mosab a
Title: The best food ever
Review:
This is most best food i had ever in Malaysia.
The Syrian staff very smiley, the food fantastic, the portion more than my expectation.
Clean and cozy restaurant with the best price you can get.
This Syrian food is the best
Haighly recommended

Author: shirlizaannKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst than previous visit. Disrespectful waitress.
Review: I went to this restaurant few months before and I did aware that the price is quite expensive. Yesterday I went there again but was disappointed by the service. I went in and was seated at the 2 seat table as I was waiting for my husband to join me a bit later. After ordering my lunch set, and seeing that the seat in front of me was empty, a waitress (the one in the photo wearing yellow uniform) simply dumped all the menu books at the seat in front of me.. i mean, come on! this is not cheap mamak restaurant, or a chinese coffee shop at ground floor normal commercial centre. There should be a specially designated place for you to keep the menus, right? And to dump it in front of the guest is absolutely not right. I took that as a sign of insult, and offended by what she did. She just pretended like it wasnt there, with no sense of remorse. I had to call another waitress to clear the menus away before my husband came.And I overheard that the waitresses are not happy with one another.. I came there for lunch, not to watch a drama. Seriously, the management has got to do something about the way they work.. or else, more negative comments shall appear from other guests as well.

Author: IndranNayerBangkok, Thailand
Title: Terrible Service and Experience
Review: I and my family had visited your restaurant on 8th September to celebrate my daughters birthday..(Not decided to ask for any arrangement at my side of the staff approach at front desk) Unfortunately, the sub-standard food served in yourrestaurant really dampened our spirits.The dinner started off in a very disappointing way when we were arrive. I have 6 vouchers in FAVE and your cashier (Stagghorn) If I remember his name correctly, swipe all my 6 vouchers for 4 adults. When I approached him, “Why did you swipe 6 vouchers for 4 adults? He replied “I will leave remarks in my system and you can walk in anytime” Is this a hotel standard? Don’t even feel sorry for what he has done? No greeting, no welcoming and poor service at reception.. (RM99) buffet come with KopiTiam service? Most of the hot food was cold, The Main Course tasted equally pathetic. They all seemed to taste the same. Curry was good, Sea-bass with lemon was terrible, soup was totally outrage. Regret and totally not recommended compared with other places. I hope hotel management could look into it and improve your service standard. Your staff are totally not friendly and not suitable to be work under hotel environment. My first experience become worst experience. Regards,Indran Nair
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Allan LMiri, Malaysia
Title: Very nice Butter Chicken Masala
Review: I fully recommend the garlic naan with the butter chicken masala. The tandoori chicken is very small and will not be enough to feed one person. The place is clean and the staff are friendly, attentive and helpful. I had a good lunch experience at this place and will be visiting more frequently.

Author: PyanS
Title: Lots of choices of food
Review: Lots of choices of Malaysian foods from the traditional menu to the current. Mix of Indian foods like roti canai and chicken tandoori.There is even lopeh and lempeng pisang But quite pricey

Author: JeffYeoh23Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Smokin' Breakfast!!!
Review: Breakfast was included with my room. Had the Nasi Lemak, fried eggs, porridge, coffee and tea. My wife complained the coffee is the worst she have had. The breakfast was just average. Suddenly I smelt cigarette smoke. Then I saw some patrons smoking in the cafe. I questioned the manager. Apparently they still have smoking section. The section is only separated by carpet and tiles. I thought Malaysia has banned smoking in all air conditioned places!! Now looks like I will ban this cafe!! Not recommended for anyone who is particular about smoking especially for family with kids.

Author: Stephentee
Title: LOUSY WAITER, LOUSY SERVICE..
Review: A lousy service restaurant. Me and my girlfriend went to this restaurant at KLCC for our dinner. We seated at a table of 4 with our shopping goods. Soon after we ordered our food and request the waitress to clean the table. A waiter came and told us that we cannot occupy a table of 4 because we are just 2 persons. We mentioned that we got things with us and there are other empty tables for other customers. He insisted we can't. Then we said want to cancel order, he said cancel as you like. Is this the manner waiter to serve customer??

Author: KinkinMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Slow food, small portions
Review: We came to the restaurant because we are craving for the pecking duck and hope that will be great because of the restaurant located in Sheraton hotel.Unfortunately, the peking duck has only whole size (no half size option)so it's too big for us 2 people.... no worries... we change to banquet business menu 138 RM per person. (Was wondering why it's so cheap) The food came so small portions. The taste was alright for the starter then comes to chicken soup with one piece super dry chicken....feel like they cook it for 3 days. Then the main course is roasted duck 4 small pieces per person.....then for sure we will never be full with this so we order beef stirfry which is nicely cooked. Asking for the fried rice to come with the main, we need to wait for 15 to 20 mins for the rice??? All the food is gone cold and I don't feel like eating anymore.Asked the waitress why the food so slow and she told me they have only 2 chefs in the kitchen.... 2 chefs????? For the hotel restaurant......maybe you should get more staff....or better management??Disappointed

Author: JosephineJj
Title: Nice deco
Review: Food just ok, nothing to shout about. Service is quite slow. Overall if you are looking for a spot to have some food then you can go there. Decoration is quite pleasing though.

Author: kawanutKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 1st outing kinda disappointing
Review: We have a chance to sample Shang Palace Chinese Restaurant last weekend. We ordered the famed Peking duck. The duck's crisp skin was sliced in front of the us by one of the restaurant's captain (as he wasn't in any chef's garb). He was kinda of in a hurry to slice the meat/skin. He dropped some skins (twice actually) on the tray's (unclean) top and to my little horrors, he actually used his tongs to pick them up and put them into the preparation plate ! I find it a little unacceptable in a 5-stars Chinese Restaurant. He didn't expect anyone to spot that and he went on to business as usual to do the 'spring-roll wrap of the duck's skins' . The spring roll with skin and cucumber slices were reasonably delicious saved for the slight un-hygenic act earlier. I rate the other servings as slightly above reasonable, nothing spectacular as expected. My high : Good environment Friendly staff My low : Not so spectacular food Service could be better (we have to serve/pour our own tea) They do kinda of make you unwanted after 2pm (cue to finish food and go off)

Author: aizam05
Title: Amazing Italian food & Best Crew Service
Review: Outstanding food and service. Our server, Zulkarnain was especially friendly and helpful. Definitely will come again and i highly recommend it

Author: DicksonO29
Title: Not recommended for food
Review: I came to this place about 2 weeks ago for dinner. The pork meat are tough and dry, kind of tasteless and some other food i tried as well are almost tasteless. Only thing which I actually kept eating are the french fries provided as a side dish and luncheon fries (side order). Though I'm sure you can get luncheon fries at a cheaper price and better quality somewhere else. Beside's food, the atmosphere is alright and I do see a lot of people there having wines. Maybe it's a wine place~~

Author: stennuzzAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Amazing pancakes
Review: The real French galettes and crepes! Amazing. Juices and coffee also really good. We will come back again.

Author: DAF10000007
Title: Afternoon Tea
Review:
This is the most excruciating experience in trying to have high tea, the staff don't know how to call back and its just always full. 

The high tea itself is nothing spectacular. that's the verdict!!

Author: lindasllimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the Best Salted Chicken in Ipoh
Review: Whenever we are in Ipoh, this is one of our favourite shop to buy salted chicken for take-away. We always re-steam the chicken before eating and the taste will still be good. On that day when we were here, there was no crowd so service was fast. The only complain was the price has increased to RM19.00 per chicken and the chicken has also shrunk in size.

Author: Kallee  O
Title: Fresh!
Review: Ordered sashimi and it's very fresh! Good service and friendly staffs. Free jockey parkings and good environment.  Suitable for couples and families to dine in. Definitely worth another visit soon!

Author: 869jazt
Title: Disappointed
Review:
Indeed disappointed with inconsistency of the food. For eg: nasi lemak which is the local delicacies and the rice was like sticky rice.

Also most of the food are oily
Restaurant: Kites Restaurant at Holiday Inn Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie

Author: HappyCamper77777Reading, United Kingdom
Title: Chicken makanwala was delish!
Review: Definitely recommend the chicken makanwala and spinach dip!My friend had the vindaloo but there was no spice to it at all, just tasted of tomato purée! Would suggest asking the waiter to ask the chef to make it spicy and more flavoursome!! Come during happy hour to make the most of the 18rm pints of beer.

Author: SStefan12
Title: birthday
Review: delicious food and nice night viewNice atmosphere,good service from jackieThe location also very good

Author: theva19Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average in taste, but pricey
Review: Came across this place by chance, decided to give it a go with one other friend.Very grand looking deco, but a bit tacky for my liking.Good friendly service.Ordered chicken rahra, mutton rogan josh, 2 plain naan, 1 plain rice, orange juice and a bottle of water.Was served a complimentary appetizer as well as some papadam, nothing exciting.Naan was soft and tasty. Chicken dish was average, small chunks of leg meat mixed in some mild curry gravy. Mutton meat was tough, in a thick slightly spicy gravy.Overall food tasted ok, portions not too big. Total bill came up to rm170; definitely overpriced for the taste and quality of food served.Wouldn't come again, given that the are other options with better value for north indian food around KL.

Author: melaniecT2011XH
Title: Good Food
Review:
Enjoyed the butter chicken.  
Home cooked food kind of feel.  
Ambience is nice. Great sunset view surrounded by padi fields.

Author: AndrewaididPoland
Title: Malacca eating
Review: Malacca revisited after 30 years was a disappointment. What I had told my wife sounded so promising, yet reality had a very sobering effect on both of us. Beside the town being far more dirty and full of concrete constructions, there were huge CROWDS! The bicycle taxis with their absurdly loud onboard music were a pain in the butt and additionally spoiled the atmosphere. But let me get to the point: food. Finding a place to eat on the famous (?) Jonker Street at lunch time was virtually impossible (am not talking of top-notch venues withtop-notch prices), they were available. having walked the street up and down three times, we decided to inspect a side road - Jalan Tokong, as it says on my restaurant bill. And we came across Tames Cafe. From the outside it isn't obvious you will find food there. You have to stop and eyeball the place carefully. Only then will you realize it's a restaurant. It turns out to be a family-run nyonya place. Food was great, particularly chicken rendang. At a cost of MR22, we had a two-person portion. Fried rice and fried noodles cost MR 5 each. Excellent value. Greens (morning glory, I presume) were not that good, but what the hell! Had a nice chat with the mom of the house, got the rendang recipe. Bought some spices and wonderful tea to utilise at home. The location is 50, Jalan Tokong, a street diagonally parallel to Jonker Street.

Author: josi8h
Title: Disappointing
Review: The ramen is mediocre and not cheap. The noodle is ok, the soup is sub-par, and the beef ramen used oil-fried beef.

Author: SamsonLiew
Title: Nice food
Review:
很棒👍🏻第一次尝试法国人做的法国餐。室内没有华丽的装修，但是食物味道很好，老板也很友善亲切。
这间Coffee Shop 值得一试😋位置位于在一家便利商店7-eleven楼上。
Thank you for you to make delicious food🙏🏻
Next time will come again.

Author: Marc F
Title: Steak was not good
Review:
I had high expectations of this place. The last time I came a few years ago, the Lamb cutlets were awesome.

This time around, it was a disappointment.  The prime rib was almost tasteless. Service was slow.

Author: Divyaa R
Title: Amazing place!!!
Review: Food is excellent!!! The service is really good and the people working are really nice. Want some amazing food? Go to Vin's

Author: donliewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over Rated, give it a miss.
Review: We went there because of all the reviews but boy, were we disappointed. Great that they are innovative by using pork with Indian Cuisine but first you must at least get the Indian Cuisine part right. Compared with plentiful of Indian restaurants in Kuala Lumpur, there ranked easily the bottom half. Kudos for their innovation but once they have a good decent Chef, they will definitely do well but for now, go elsewhere.

Author: graceyenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rude hostess
Review: The hostess was exceptionally rude today. We wanted to check how many people left on the waiting list before we could be seated. The waitress gave us a piss face like we owe her money and said "you want to sit at the bar? No right? "Like seriously ? Someone need to teach her some manners and maybe teach her how to smile. we din even make a fuss about waiting.Other than that the food was great. Pancakes were good.

Author: boglaBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Decent bar, nothing out of the ordinary.
Review: Tried the Green Man and a couple of other bars in the strip.All provided good service and the drinks were OK.The bars in this area all charge 6% vat + 10% service charge. I object to the service tax. RM 37.10 for a small glass of wine and half a pint, I think is expensive in a country where the average daily wage is around £10/ day.

Author: docfeedbackAdelaide, Australia
Title: disappointing and were is authenticity?
Review: We wandered over to the Gardens shopping centre as we had been told by many locals that we would find better prices on the watch brands we were looking at. They were correct.To celebrate our purchase we went to this restaurant for lunch.Very disappointing from entry to departure.Our meals were bland and overcooked and service was just ok. A few smiles would help

Author: VLR_2019Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: German food in KL
Review: My husband was craving a pork knuckle so we found this place on trip advisor. The pork knuckle was good but my burger was only okay. As other reviews mentioned, I think it was microwaved... not the best but not horrible. They have erdinger if you’re craving German beer. The pavilion was packed the day we visited. Overall a decent experience but I wouldn’t go out of my way to visit this restaurant.

Author: stevekyneNew Taipei, Taiwan
Title: Service great; food a dud
Review: I’ve have eaten and had drinks at the Shangri La numerous times including a truly exceptional meal at the hotel’s Shang Palace, which I have reviewed previously here on TripAdvisor. But Arthur’s did not, unfortunately, live up to expectations.Having started off with our overall negative reaction, we must state that the service was excellent. Our principal waitress was Hani, and she was gold.Our gripe was with the food. Now admittedly we’d just flown in and were late ordering. Three blokes - three different dishes. One was inedible (steak) and two (nachos and burger) were ordinary. I am happy to cop criticism for ordering these dishes in Malaysia, a country that is truly a food paradise. But it was an “english pub” and this was the fare on offer. I think, after going back and reading other reviews and talking to my mate who is a regular at Shangri La, that the Arthur’s Bar experience is a much better one than the Arthur’s Grill experience. I for one wouldn’t risk eating here again. There are just too many other great options in this city, including at least two in this hotel.

Author: IsabelPerez999
Title: Great variety and value
Review: Very impressed with the quality of the food, the extensive variety, and the quick service. The sausages are highly recommended.

Author: elyzakay
Title: Great Weekend Brunch
Review: Excellent food and excellent service. Love coming here for their special weekend brunch with the family!

Author: Adli GPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Uninterested service
Review: Horrible experience. Waiters were uninterested to serve us. Begrudgingly shown us to the table. And just left us there for 15 minutes. Even after calling and waving at them to take our orders they made themselves look busy. We took our bags and left. Horrible horrible place

Author: Ksksksksks
Title: Great place for dinner and some drinks
Review: On a lively street with other bars, though not too noisy, can watch the action. Terrace is quite spacious. Raw fish is good, friendly staff. Recommended.

Author: 211lew
Title: Absolute Thai!
Review: Very cosy atmosphere and delicious dishes! You have to wait for long but it's not a matter when you have good food.

Author: debs_ngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gorgeous Cafe
Review: A very nice and comfy cafe. Drinks were good and worth the price.A bit of caution though...there are rooms upstairs and the movements made by the guests nay cause debris and dust to fall into your food and drinks.They were proactive in making sure that we got replacements for our polluted drinks.Kudos!

Author: MicLarsen
Title: Dirty nastyness
Review:
In spite of good reviews, the place is really dirty and nasty. There was hair in both our dishes, and it tasted bad. 
Food had been on display for at least a couple of hours and was not fresh. Do not waste your money here!

Author: Lee-Kee TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Indian restaurant
Review: This is an Indian restaurant disguised as a Spanish tapas place. Don't be fooled.Red sangria was awfully diluted, seafood tapas were all smothered in Indian spices or sauces until you can't even taste the seafood itself, which is quintessially important in Spanish food.The prawns in Mariscos paella were still bloody, jeez!!

Author: TuneK
Title: Bad service
Review: Went in for lunch. The place was nearly empty. We were seated very quickly by the entrance. Then the staff seemed to magically disappeared. After this we were ignored repeatedly and decided to leave.

Author: gsbonesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing food at Bangsar branch
Review: I WANTED to like this place. The website tells a story of authentic Mexican cuisine by a couple. We went there on a Friday night and we're seated immediately in front of the "pass" between the waiters and kitchen. No atmosphere at all and noisy, but we were reseated after we asked.Waiters were not well trained, and the ladies were handed menus after the man. We picked some small bites and an order of Fajitas. The cactus leaf topped with cheese was interesting, but the presentation was clunky (and not like the photo on the website). The fajitas were not at all up to the mark, the meat being greasy and served simply with a very small serving of salsa. No greens, no guacamole, no sour cream, no cheese? Ok, maybe authentic for one version of the dish... but not enjoyable at all. Tacos with pork cracking were only ok. The jalopenos stuffed with cheese were a very poor version of a common dish. And to add insult to injury, the jug of promised "fantastic" classic margaritas was a dilute mess of a jug, three quarters filled with ice cubes. Overall very high prices for poor quality food. Owners, your staff is slacking, at least in Bangsar. There was no discernable popping flavour or pride in the fare served.Unless it improves a lot, I won't be back. Avoid.

Author: eldhooo
Title: Nice hotel
Review: Good hotel with good ambience. Rates are little on higher side but the food quality and taste is awsome. I enjoyed the food there and the reception by people ther is great. They even interact with us and ask our experience.

Author: Extra_Terrestrial-ET
Title: Refillable BananaBro!
Review: Food is great! The taste is yummy~~ one of the best Indian food I've tasted so far. Fried bitter-gourd is my favourite! Comes with 2 choices of rice, 4 types of curry sauce, 3 types of vegetables, few pieces of papadom, a rassam soup, and a yogurt milk dessert. There are also other side dishes available for order with additional charges. Had mango lassi and it's nice! Service is good, quite fast actually. Atmosphere is okay, nothing great, but nothing bad either. Restaurant is clean.

Author: Kalaiarasu K
Title: Awesome food
Review: Excellent food. Spent more than 4 hours in this place. Very flexible waiters who were willing to accommodate to our request. Best Indian food so far. Waiter raman and Simon provided us with excellent service. Will definitely come back again.

Author: KwanT_Ng
Title: Traditional Food
Review: They offered variety of Malay food with good cooking. The restaurant wasn't that big but nice environment. However, it has limited space from one table to another table. Not convenient if the restaurant is full. Hard to walk around.

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Avoid the cendol
Review: I walked in to try the cendol without checking the reviews and I wished that I had. It was over priced at RM15.90 and it wasn't good. The cendol was full of sago that was clumped together, and clearly lacking in red beans. When we checked with the staff, he replied that this is the way that their cendol is done. I should have spent my calories somewhere else.

Author: 628eugenekPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice overall
Review: The babi guling which was one of their premier items was disappointing but the ribs were good. The other menu items were average to good. Service was quite fast even though it was crowded. Some items were quick but some additional re-orders took time. We had a birthday celebration there and the staff accommodated our cake and other requests happily. There is limited parking and they do provide complimentary valet service but the guy was rude and while I don't mind tipping, they could have asked nicely instead of growling and demanding a tip.

Author: poppy313
Title: Excellent food at affordable price
Review: We ordered peranakan laksa and ayam rempah with pandan rice. Excellent taste. We particularly love the fried rempah chicken. So crispy but tender on the inside! However the desserts (bubur cha cha and pulut hitam) are way too sweet!!

Author: IpohMike
Title: Horrible food
Review: Stay away unless you Want a fancy very Malaysian ambience..... Horrible food.... Makes Ipoh look horrible as a foodie destination if this was set as a go to place for food in my beloved little town.... And it's not cheap.... End of the Day you get crappy overpriced food.....

Author: JonathanOys
Title: Nice Birthday Dinner
Review: We have visited Zest for a wonderful birthday dinner.The atmosphere was elegant and serene.The staffs were really courteous and helpful,especially Lily, Rita and Edwin. The best part was birthday cake they provided as a surprise to my wife. Whereby the the staff sing birthday song and wishes on our table. We really enjoyed tge evening.Keep up the excellant service.Regards John

Author: EnricogiFormigine, Italy
Title: Bad service and quality normal...
Review: Bad service and quality normal...for the money we spent the quality of the food was not so convenient, too much expensive and the service was so so ... really didnt like there too much. what else I could say? not suggest this restaurant to a friend, only the atmosphere was not so bad.stay away and choose something else

Author: The80sTravellersKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good view of the towers
Review: We went to Marini's on 57 for some pre dinner drinks and had great service from the staff and a good table for the number we had. It was mid week so wasn't too busy and had a good view of the towers- it is slightly close so you will struggle to get a picture of the top of the towers with a person in it.Given the location the drinks are expensive but we were surprised how much it was to eat there- having looked at the cost we felt it was just too much to eat there as a family.

Author: Norlia a
Title: Lunch
Review: The first thing that greeted us upon alighting the car was the the horrendous stench of I guess the waste ... it was really foul... be that as it may, as ISS were invited by family friends, we proceeded to the restaurant. This is not our first visit. The quality of the food has deteriorated.

Author: popeye7814Sibu, Malaysia
Title: Food not up to my expectation...
Review: I have dinner with my colleagues here, the food served here does not match my appetite, the green curry is too sweet for me, the cuttle fish in tom Yam Soup is overcooked, the fried eggs are too oily.they served a lemongrass drink which i think is quite special.

Author: Duff99Bangkok
Title: Really horrible service
Review: The restaurant is above average price for Georgetown, and there are many vegan and vegetarian choices, even within a few blocks of this place. And although the food was mostly good (2 of the 3 dishes were tasty), the service was SO BAD that we tried to cancel our order and go elsewhere. Even though the restaurant was mostly empty, other tables were also complaining about dishes not arriving and drinks showing up at the end of the meal. Servers seemed entirely clueless, wandering around the tables not noticing/caring that one of us finished our food before the other one had received anything to eat. No one bothered to ask why one dish was completely untouched, and we watched waitstaff huddle behind the counter or stand at the counter eating their dinner in sight of paying customers who had no food.

Author: CWaresLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Really odd place!!
Review: I came here on a Sunday lunch time with my husband. The food came out cold and was more like a microwave meal. Random little bugs all over the place. Not good considering the prices are the same you would expect to pay in an outstanding Italian restaurant in London. The staff were all very dull and didn't seem to care that we weren't having a very nice experience despite both my husband and I being very polite to them. All very odd!!

Author: KlCarmenKL
Title: Go if only food is not a main priority
Review: Located in a stand alone bungalow lot, ample parking and beautiful decor. No one can fault the setting of the restaurant. Ambiance wise it is cozy and gives off the colonial English feel. Vast array of Sabah tea collection as befitting to the name Sabah Tea Garden. Be adventurous and order quirky sounding name. Go ahead, I encourage you to. Food wise, bland to tasteless. Food is cooked with care done to plating. Either they are extremely health conscious to refrain from seasoning of any kind or the palate is just plain bland.Good surrounding for conversation and high tea but as to the tummy, it feels not too satisfied,

Author: cyrildasonKuching, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambiance, food was ordinary
Review: Came here after hearing rave reviews and ordered Chicken tempoyak soup, umai ikan, petai belacan and fried cuttlefish.Well, the decor of the whole restaurant is really lovely. The setting is nice, and it gives you that tribal Dayak feel.However, I personally didn't favour the dishes, but this is likely my personal taste buds. I felt the umai had too much onions, and I didn't like the cold rice, although I think this might be the authentic way it is served.The deep fried cuttlefish however was really good, and the service by the staff are excellent!

Author: Ng_Wesley
Title: Not very clean.
Review: Many house flies flying around during my last visit. A notch below other pizza hut  outlets. Really ruins the appetite. Menu is standard and same as other outlets.

Author: swaldmey
Title: Midweek dinner for one
Review: Good food but terrible service. I came early on a quiet evening. I ordered three dishes and they all came together so I had no opportunity to enjoy the appetizers without the main course being stone cold. And I had two or three of the serving staff hovering at the table waiting to snatch the plates away. It was a lovely room - I wish I’d been given some time to appreciate it!

Author: lonelyasian
Title: Good local Chinese cuisine.
Review: This restaurant provides good local Chinese food. I will call it home cook style. Be prepared to wait for a while. The restaurant is small and crowded. This is very common in Penang.

Author: Kevin TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Economy Rice
Review: I chose to patronize Rama V because it was categorized as “Fine Thai Cuisine”. I wanted to treat my family for belated Parents’ Day. I got them to dress up for the occasion; however, the nightmare started when the waiter told us there was no Thai beer. I was gravely surprised when a Fine Thai restaurant do not have Thai beer! It was beyond comprehension. Food was a let-down and crazily over-priced. Don’t get me wrong. I am the type who is willing to pay for good food. I was so willing to pay. The portion was obviously on the small side. When the dishes came, I was embarrassed by the portion because everyone was staring at the little plate/bowl. I wanted to walk away because I do not know where to place my face. For example, the duck curry was probably good for 3-4 people? The pineapple fried rice had hardly any pineapple with its obvious 4 prawns displayed on top of it. The red ruby dessert was way below par. I have tasted this before. The rubies were more like pebbles instead of rubies. The flour was more than the chestnuts! Shame on you Rama V. This is not how you cut corners.Food aside, the ambiance was nothing to shout about too. There was hardly any resemblance of Thai. I could at least pay if not for the good food but at least good deco but that was also a let down. The table we had was a HUGE rectangular one. We were seated so far apart and that made the dishes very hard to reach. We had senior citizens. We had to serve our parents. At the end, we scooped all the dishes on the plate and that looked very much like the everyday ECONOMY RICE, honestly. The highlight of the night was a section closed for a birthday celebration. It was like a night market! I was wondering which part was the FINE DINE??? It was totally inappropriate. I am not stopping the celebration but get-a-room. I am not too sure why this restaurant is so highly acclaimed. I was seriously disappointed. To me, this Thai restaurant is overrated. I believe it was good before as strings of accolades claiming Rama V KL’s best restaurant were displayed but it was until 2017. Many young couples dined in as well as Mat Sallehs. If you do not belong to any of these categories, I won’t recommend you Rama V.

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: German Bistro and Bar
Review: I dropped in for drinks one evening after dinner. It’s a place I’ve walked past many times over several years and always wanted to have a meal and drink. Unfortunately I didn’t get a chance to dine here as we were staying at the executive floor in the nearby JW Marriott where canapes and drinks were provided.I love this strip of restaurants and bars on level 3 at the Pavillion Mall. It’s a very vibrant and busy location with various food options.

Author: radicalrhodium
Title: Great ambience with not so interesting food
Review: Situated in the middle of jonker walk you could chillout at this nice restaurant yet you have a chance to enjoy the happening of jonker walk. Ambience was good but overall food quality is below average.

Author: shirrrrly
Title: Unique
Review: Their spaghetti taste unique as I never tried something like that before. Friendly and helpful waiters, they are quite efficient. The price range is also not bad as it is affordable. Really suitable for pork meat lovers.

Author: maeltoshioPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dirty restaurant
Review: Super crowded,food wise ok..the tandori chicken tender and juicy.Nan bread very soft .The only problem the restaurant very dirty ,i just wonder the business definetely make a lot money why cant they hire people to clean it up.How the Health enforcement can let they run the business with that cleanliness.

Author: chansaikeongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ordinary
Review: I am sure that most of the people went to its opposite dim sum restaurant which is looks bigger and nicer. But we decided to have a try at this restaurant this time.Reached the restaurant at 6.50am. Still able to get a table easily. The staff there were friendly and worked fast. Quality of the dim sum were ordinary. The sizes/portions are smaller if compare with other dim sum restaurant but the prices are not much different. Personally, I think that is not worthy.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Albert SMalaysia
Title: Worse from all NOBU restaurants
Review: We are Nobu Lovers, but we went to NOBU in KL before it was a disaster, just after the opening, we had over seas guest as Malaysia does not have really good restaurants so we thought we try again, but is was a mistake as its still the same a big empty place and very low standard of service, and everything is messed up, staff is more busy playing hand phone than looking after the guest, For us sure the last visit in NOBU in KL we better wait for our trip to London or Dubai, NOBU in Malaysia is extreme expensive the cheapest bottle of wine is around RM 270 outside you can get maybe less RM 70 we are wine people but wine quality is very bad but price very high i think the wine have to cover the rental... For us sure its it...... our friends even highlighted and they where Japanese and say the standard is very poor, sure NO NOBU standard and they where surprised that NOBU management till now does not look in to this as its bad for there reputation as well, maybe they don't care. And now i was be told sunday becomes a children playground as sundays they allow children, so Sundays you better stay also as there goes your sunday lunch, you can see how low NOBU goes its now going to be a children play ground now, so couple stay away.

Author: jtennylauMelbourne, Australia
Title: Breakfast
Review: Ordered stewed beef noodles, young chow fried rice, crispy pork rice. Beef noodles was bland, but the beef was tender. Crispy pork was nowhere near nice, was really expecting “Hong Kong” version. Lean part of the crispy pork was hard and dry, and the fat does not melt in your mouth. The rice for crispy pork was dry and slightly hard, like overnight rice, not fluffy (doesn’t taste like freshly cooked rice). My mom who’s a thrifty person, could not even force herself to finish her fried rice. Didn’t taste like anything “Hong Kong” to us.

Author: Katherine0928
Title: Dinner
Review: A very nice environment restaurant,  the staffs here are very kind and friendly. Good foods with good service, it is a good place to have dinner and celebrate birthday with friends, family or couple.

Author: anshuman m
Title: Best Cafe in George Town
Review:
This cafe is situated at Love Lane. They offer a variety of western food and drinks.
Staff is friendly, ambiance is good, food is awesome and overall experience is fantastic.
A must try when you are at George town.

Author: Kylie W
Title: Wouldn’t recommend or come again
Review: Came for lunch. No mention of fish & chips being unavailable even though on the menu. No mention of having to pay cash upon payment & was asked to go & get cash out... very inconvenient. Average food options.

Author: ritzr2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average
Review: It was a family get togather and we had the private room at no extra cost for a 14 person seating. Food is expensive and flavors are average. Fish is good but avoid the huge chunk of pandan vhicken at sll cost. Part of it was not cooked enough. Salad was good and platter to share was ok. Service was ok and they showed no fuss to replace a veg that was prepared in error. Overall a pleasant meal and good ambience.

Author: Clive ESalisbury, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Dinner
Review: I picked this restaurant at random as there are many along this street and fundamentally they all tend to offer the same, i.e. food and drink, with the emphasis on drink!. I chose this one as I fancied a steak. The steak (T-bone) was good, and I like mine medium rare to rare and it was, so full marks to the chef. Whilst it was rated as being aged, I suspect it was not as aged as some, but what to you expect for this price range. Good service. This part of town can become quite lively / noisy late at night.

Author: MayMalIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit but a tad pricey
Review: We decided to pay a visit to this restaurant after reading good reviews about its pasta. We ordered salad, potato gnochhi, crab meat pasta, tiramisu and chocolate lava cake. The pasta was slightly below my expectation after reading the reviews. The salad was a let down and on the pricey side. The dessert, however, more than made up for the pasta and salad. They have affordable set meals for lunch.

Author: Hilda V
Title: Fancy Italian dinner experience
Review: We really enjoyed our dinner at Zenzero, near the KL tower. Very nice street with multiple restaurants, chose Zenzero based on good reviews and were definitely not dissappointed!

Author: Ashwinie
Title: awesome!
Review: awesome food and service. big serving and priced reasonably with a wide selection from the menu. ambience was fun and nice.

Author: omogea
Title: Dinner Date
Review: They the best beer ever. Try and check it out, nice place to hang out and chill while waiting for ur fun nite around changkat!

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Chinese food, with Fujian influences
Review: This branch in SS15 was not very full for a mid-week lunch (during the RMCO). Tried their bamboo herbal prawn soup, sweet and sour pork with lychee, yam with duck and their chili clams. All good, perhaps the chili clams were not very spicy, but otherwise all yummy. Worth a visit.

Author: F4358CSalessiac
Title: Great potential but meh
Review: Very nice café and atmosphere. Too bad they are offering pasta for breakfast and pancakes for lunch (only after 12.00 - they didn’t make any exceptions at 11,15). The pastries are quite good, the smoothies are slushies with frozen berries and the coffee is watery. Service is a great area of improvement.

Author: Kevin BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Whats the hype?
Review: Just an ordinary road side shophouse restaurant with no air conditioning and hoards of people.Could not bring myself to eat a second mouthful of their fried beehoon (fried vermicelli) xin zhou chao mi fen. Doesn't taste like it.Their signature cheesy prawn beehoon is slightly better but still average.

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Location PJ Hilton - Expensive Drinks!
Review: Some confusion with other reviews posted for this restaurant in wrong location!Attended seminar at PJ Hilton and decided to stay for dinner.Decided on A La Carte menu as they were prepping the buffet...dined here many times in the past but first visit for several years.Ordered the steak sandwich which when it arrived was very good as were the wedges and slaw that went with it.My rating reflects the price I was charged for drinks where the coffee at 23RM before any tax, service charge was nearly the same as the steak at 30RM which is quite ridiculous! I was also charged 16RM for a small glass of coke poured from the tap...40 RM for two drinks which is flagrant overcharging at best. I know that this is a hotel but one that sits in PJ ....?

Author: madonnajonesSydney, Australia
Title: Went for dinner didn't stay
Review: The beers may be cold and not expensive but there is nothing authentic about this place. Sitting on the smelly waterway eating spring rolls filled with cabbage doesn't rate number 5 in Malaka for me. The fact that the young men asked that we do a review speaks volumes. All home made I'm told but really people I expect better when I come to experience a culture and its cuisine.

Author: mysfums
Title: Smokers Inside Air-Cond Room
Review: The food is a little salty, average portion, nicely presented, overall I like the crinkle fries best! I don't like the environment though, mostly outdoor with a lot of smokers, plus they allow smoke inside the air-cond area, which is also rather small in size.

Author: keila m
Title: grate experience
Review:
Dining in the Dark is a fantastic experience .
The food was well thought out and the paring wines excellent.

Author: harishbalaMuscat, Oman
Title: Slow service, waiters need training, average food
Review: Regret eating here, the place looks dead. The waiters are least bit interested and really not clean. One of them was eating food inside and then without washing his hands came to serve us after putting his hand in his trousers to scratch, really ridiculous. Average food, nothing special about the overpriced paneer butter masala special. Will not eat here again.

Author: KevWooCheras, Malaysia
Title: Not sure why the hype...?
Review: Definitely overrated for the quality of the chicken rice. I think the chicken rice ball in Melaka has dropped over the years due to all these hype & the superfluous demand. The folks had to cope with the high demand especially during the peak season, which is a known fact, coz you can't possibly measure up whilst maintaining a high quality of the chicken rice. Was in Ipoh for the chicken rice (Lou Wong) & it miles better, period.

Author: JenniferL4753
Title: Not impressed
Review: Had a surprised anniversary dinner there, was arranged by husband. However, to my horror, the furniture at the second floor is in bad shape. Some chairs are in wobbly condition and a broken sofa is there for guests to sit. I would not come back again even the food is so-so with the above average price tag. Little cockroaches are running around in the restaurant. Cafe Cafe, you guys need a serious refurbishment work.

Author: TiongWhoL
Title: Artistic Pizza Place by Malacca River
Review: They serve delicious pizza, great coffee, fresh juice of your choice. No alcohol. The environment is windy, chilled, on the romantically lighted riverside. The interior design is fantastic. The owner is an artist, he crafted the table surface into different motives using colourful chipped tiles. Same to the restaurant interior. LOVE IT !!

Author: Mirage O
Title: Excellent restaurant for halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Great dining experience. Well-worth the taxi-ride from our hotel. Good food, clean and fast service.

Author: Sg_Gal83
Title: Special for rice bal but not that great
Review: This chicken rice is special for the rice ball but the chicken is not that great. Price is a bit expensive.

Author: taroduck_qingMalaysia
Title: Expensive but taste horrible
Review: We had our lunch here. Everything looks good at first until we get in. It's so hot even when the aircond is on, so we requested to on the fan but they said it's not working or something I'm not sure but that's not a big problem.The thing is that their food tasted horrible but super expensive. The chicken chop was very dry, ice lemon tea was tasteless, apple juice was just some packaged coloring + favoring water with weird sour taste, the potato wedges tasted weird as well (funny how an easy dish like this can be ruined). Everything was overpriced and all we get is table full of low quality food. I ordered Cheese Grilled Burger, the burger was okay, at least its edible but doesn't worth RM24! I can get a RM5 burger at this foodstall next to the souvenir shop nearby (I don't know how does it taste but definitely worth it if compared to this)They have flies everywhere, it's a little filthy, and the menu smells very bad.Would be better if you try the food court or some other restaurant.I don't know about the beers or alcohol drinks they have, but NEVER ORDER FOOD FROM THIS PLACE! Yuck!

Author: Chris B B
Title: Never open
Review: Went here Sunday and again Monday closed both days so gave up and went to Pizza Hut just down the road, good pizzas there.

Author: michaeldX635BAGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Ok but doesn’t deserve to be in Top 5 in KL
Review: We had dinner in the upstairs “restaurant” area (it’s really just another part of the bar).The food was OK / average but nothing that would, in my opinion, remotely deserve such a high rating on Trip Advisor.The staff were OK but again, not remotely near excellent. They were however, really keen to give us their cards and ask us to put a positive review on Trip Advisor or Facebook.....I had a ribeye steak which was “passable”. It was a bit tough and quite bland. I’ve had better steaks in many, many other restaurants and gastro pubs. My wife had a chicken dish which she said was nice.The toilets were basic with no locks on the doors and not especially clean.Overall, this was OK but nothing like as good as some reviews claim.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: elisewong0Kuala Selangor, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Meh
Review: After reading the good reviews on trip advisor, we thought to give this place a try. The place is cozy and inviting with pleasant music playing in the background. There were many old school items displayed on the shelves and the design of the place gives it a nice atmosphere.We ordered the nasi lemak with pansuh chicken and ginger chicken with rice. Sorry to say we found these dishes super bland. The chicken pansuh dish had a lot of things in it which made it look all the more appetising. The chicken was poached nicely but it felt there wasn't any flavour in it at all, very bland. The rice didn't have that lemak flavour to it. As for the ginger chicken, despite it looking black, there wasn't much taste going for it. It was not salty enough and did not packed enough punch.All in all, it was a disappointing experience.

Author: CorriebegHong Kong, China
Title: Good food-- awful service--- Kampachi Catering
Review: I am reposting this as I mistakenly posted it on the Kampachi Equatorial site. That restaurant has, apparently , closedWe decided to use the catering arm of this restaurant for a dinner party at my house in KL.The " delivery " service wrecked our whole evening. We met with the Business Dev Manager a few days before the event and agreed the menu. On the day of the event, the restaurant called and said that the food would be delivered no later than 6.45 pm. We planned accordingly. By 7.55 pm the food had still arrived. No one called to explain why. I chased the Business Dev Manager who was on a break in Singapore. Rather than owning the issue, he just asked the junior and untrained delivery staff to call me. They explained that they had got lost. I asked why they had not called and the response was " I was driving " ! I am not sure what the other one was doing ! I am still chasing for an explanation as to why this happened. I am keen to understand where management was in all of this or do they think it is completely normal for a 45 min delivery to take more than 3 hours ? Clearly, no oversight and no customer care. My advice is do NOT use the catering service under any circumstances. Given the lack of tourists, the awful lack of confidence in the Malaysian economy, I would have thought that businesses like this would have gone the extra mile to take care of existing customers. Clearly not. Kampachi, you are an absolute disgrace

Author: SENTHAONew Delhi, India
Title: So so
Review: Celebrated my wife's birthday in this restaurant. The food was delicious especially the Andhra fish curry was so nice then we placed 2nd time. The portions were too small not at all proportanate for the price. The service staff was good and prompt. The ceiling was too low and the decor was not appealing to me. Overall it was but I cannot give high score due to small portions not reflecting to price

Author: JulianF584
Title: Went to the outlet at klcc food court
Review: Had the lamb burger....the queue was endless and had to queue about 15mins to get the foodAt one time the queue was two persons deep.....The patties were juicy and fresh and very well grilled.They have restaurants as well but this stall at the food court is just as good

Author: Grantie0702
Title: good service good food
Review: was able to be fed and watered in very quick time. Service was excellent and the price very reasonable

Author: ernichanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The famous ribs...not so much in my book
Review: Ate the ribs which were rm39...disappointed after all the hype...was stringy and tough...needs more cooking time before being BBQ-Ed.....ordered the mash potatoes which never came, asked why only to be told much later that they were not available that day...certainly off considering, mashed potatoes should'nt be that hard to prepare...wait staff need more training-hap hazard manner is a turn off to me..a couple in sitting in the adjacent table left after being asked to moved several times as tables that were unmarked as reserved were apparently reserved...no comparison to the naughty nuri in Bali...go original or go home

Author: Stephanne S
Title: What a shame!
Review: What a shame - our friends and I finally discovered a decent Italian restaurant close to our home in Permas Jaya. The food had been lovely and while one of the waitresses always looked to be in a bad mood, the service was generally good. That is until tonight. Three of us were dining in with pizza, two fruit juices and a glass of house red. The wine glass accidentally got knocked over during dinner and broke and - get this.... they charged us 25RM to replace it!!! For a restaurant with a menu as expensive as it is - I have NEVER been charged to replace a broken glass - EVER. The waitress was extremely rude - making us clean up the glass and offering us nothing to clean the table cloth. Only coming over to tell us we owed her for the glass. When we got the bill - there was the added cost of the wine glass, with government and service tax added on top!!! What a disappointment and rest assured - our friends and I won't be back. Gianni's does make nice food; however, you'd better ask that all your food to be served in plastic bowls and glasses, for fear of having a very expensive bill at the end of the night!!!

Author: ShaliniGanendra
Title: Very poor service
Review: Had to ask 3x for a slice of Burnt Cheesecake despite there being more staff than clients.  No decaf gourmet coffee!   No loo roll in WC.  Disgraceful and during pandemic time as well.

Author: chi-natsu_ngJakarta, Indonesia
Title: visit once and definitely not worth for re-visit
Review: booked table for families gathering of 8 pax adult with 1 children and 1 infants. the hall was so empty, when scouting around the buffet spread you will certainly shocked and disappointed. Seafood bar : only fresh cold prawn, limited mussels, tasteless crab is serving, not even see fresh oyster, worst seafood bar in 5 star hotel.sushi bar: low grade salmon slice,butterfish & maguro and some condiments for sushi roll-not even touch it.salad bar: wide selection of salad condiments and local delights rojakcooked food : satay, prawn, curry, beef ,lamb, chicken - very average food none of it worth for recommended you can find all this in local food court.noodle station: curry broth not bad, can try but you will never want to go hotel buffet for a try of curry noodledessert station : bread pudding is good, others cant even recalled, coffee is good.In summary, with the amount they charged you definitely not worth for a try, unless you are ready to spend and experience worst buffet spread in town.however, credit to the female floor manager aka barista who can makes best cappucino & friendly too.

Author: KunalG121
Title: Worst hospitality....
Review: We went for a simple lunch to the restaurant and ordered some dishes... The manager taking order acted as if he is doing me a favour when taking the order and serving food... The food was Jst OK to have and service and hospitality was this bad that I have never experienced in past....Not recommendable at all...

Author: adjromulosKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Banned this place. Will not come back.
Review: Asked for extra lettuce (vegetables) for the mixed grill dish upon ordering which the waiter agreed. The serving came with a paltry amount of lettuce which can be described as "a tablespoon's worth". Also no onions. When I asked the waiter about this issue, he replied that they would charge RM 2.00 for the extra vegetables. Note: they used to serve this dish with ample lettuce AND onions.

Author: bernardf0033Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Serving staff unable to help
Review: Serving staff was not able made small changes when ask. Eg, fresh lime with soda. Although this is not in the menu, the charges can be lime juices. But somehow the head captain would not entertain and insisted the menu only. Why are we asking because one of us only drink lime soda without sugar. There is no proper approach when we ask to settle the bill when the cashier close the account. What lack of is manners, approachable, flexible and how to serve customers. Hope this will help to improve.

Author: Epifida
Title: taste ok.but very poor service
Review: wait almost an hour for my food to be ready full serves and ready to eat.over priced.but food tasted ok

Author: Joanne CKuching, Malaysia
Title: Loved the food
Review: Really enjoyed the food, I had the salmon which was served with a small pecan Waldorf type salad, very impressed! Had the juice, if anything, our orders took quite some time to come out, but it seemed like they were busy that night. Only point to note, they are a halal restaurant, which means no alcohol or pork.

Author: 848lucypBrighton and Hove, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food, great atomosphere
Review: After seeing the reviews, we wanted to see if they were deserved and I'm pleased to say that they are! We enjoyed sampling the gorgeous homemade cocktails and impressive whiskey collection. We couldn't resist the mini-sliders which were sooooo tasty, as was the tuna sashimi / tartare - my partner is a true convert to tuna after this. Some really interesting and surprising taste combinations that were always lovely. The hospitality was also great, really friendly staff and a special shout to the manager who was charming and helpful - she really helped make our final evening in Malaysia very special.

Author: Raymond1989LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Worst ever Thai Food
Review: 1. Rice not well cooked, ask the waitress, she mentioned is original…2. Staffs mostly is Indonesian female which not willing to serve you3. Tom yam serve not hot, but with overcooked squid same as chewing gum.4. The pot didn’t serve with fire which keep to soup hot.Well… worst ever Thai food that I had in Johor Bahru.Previously was nice which located at beside New York hotel.

Author: 881gillIpoh, Malaysia
Title: GREAT PLACE GOOD MUSIC
Review: Well done Mr Anderson. Keep up the good work. I was in HRC on 19th feb '16 nite and heard the Indonesian band. Its these kind of bands that keep the crowd wanting for more. Incidentally, Mr Anderson were you formerly managing A & W and Popeye's in Ipoh during the 1980s ? If its true then I had worked with you for a short period.Please let me know..cheers !!

Author: Rick L
Title: Large food variety
