Review: We staid there for new year's eve 2017 and all has been prefcet, service, fine food, restaurant stayle, waiters, waitress...

Author: Muthu MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced Blackpepper crabs
Review: Went there with my family of 4 and ordered 1 black pepper crab. But the waiter told us it's a must to order 2 crabs and cant order 1. So we ordered 2. While waiting, the waitress did not understand English nor Malay. we had a hard time ordering our drinks. Place was nice and quiet. We lost our mood when the crabs were served. it was dry black pepper crab and has a lot of crab's eggs. the taste was not that good and must say the most horrible tasting crabs that we have ever had. and the price for 2 miserable crabs coat us rm 320!! will never come here agaim...

Author: CharlieNorthWales
Title: Avoid
Review: We learnt that it was not possible to amend a dish slightly for dietary purposes, and when it arrived the few pieces of chicken were were rubbery and the food was left uneaten. Try the Melting Pot nearby, much better

Author: Passenger566905
Title: Terrible service attendant!
Review: This review is solely based on the attitude of their service staff and only one in particular if it matters.Went for lunch with my girlfriend at the prestigious Madam Kwan's last month thinking we'll get a warm welcome but instead we were treated like we were not supposed to be there and like they would much prefer serving someone else just because we didn't make a reservation beforehand when clearly there was a lot of empty tables that could've accommodated us.anyways she (with a very surly tone) said she would try to find us a table which she did thank god.She proceeded to take our orders without repeating them which I might add and left us.The food came really fast to my surprise but she never stopped staring at us as if we committed a crime.We finished our food as soon as possible and left the place.All I'm asking is a little bit of the hospitality element in their approach to service.I'm not a fin dining expert but even I know that that lady who ushered us to our table could've done better in terms of her service .

Author: Solobackpacker25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely food, Terrible service
Review: The food is really good - we tried a variety of dishes from here over the course of our stay in KL. Unfortunately the place gets quite packed during dinner and you can notice how disoriented the service staff are. They were all over the place and it took 15-20 minutes even to come to us and get our order. I suggest if you find the place packed, go somewhere else. Other than that, no complaints - really nice, tasty vegetarian Indian food at a reasonable price near KL sentral - can't ask for more.

Author: divamiezaMiri, Sarawak, Malaysia
Title: Same breakfast for 4 days stay at J.W Marriot KL
Review: Stayed at J.W Marriot for 4 nights and the breakfast buffet was same for 5 days in a row. Staff were not so friendly and assisting but there's one chef, Chef Yussuf who was super friendly and helpful. He even offered to fry beehoon for my children and it was delicious! As for the rest of the food, it was ok but doesnt meet up the 5 star standard of the hotel.

Author: Arunachalam10Palm Springs, California
Title: Food not special at all, tiny and terrible portions for delivery
Review: Ordered food through a take out service and will not do so again, may never visit the restaurant after my first exposure to it in this way. Portions were extremely small, even for a green mango salad that cost more than 20 RM for one portion. I find it hard to believe these are the same portions they serve to customers in the restaurant. The Pineapple Fried Rice had literally not one chunk of pineapple in it, just peas, carrots a few cashews, certainly not authentic Thai. Chicken in the soup was not nice pieces, some were chewy with tough bits (fat and tendons). Even the white rice portion was very small. A big disappointment.

Author: kimikajai
Title: If you got tastebuds, you’d like this place
Review: I like their pasta very much i can’t get enough of it. I tried their aussie wagyu sirloin steak and it is among the cheapest in melaka. The steak was as exactly as i want it. And their dessert could get you off your feet. Excellent services. Excellent food.

Author: Bhaskar1965Mumbai, India
Title: Bombay Palace @KL
Review: 1. They changed their location and did not update it in the web-site. I had to be in traffic jam for 2 hours and spent almost USD 30 dollars followed by a KM walk to find the restaurant. It was a dinner with customer - what a shame.2. The ambiance is very good. And, the food is just opposite - tasteless. The cook does not know how to prepare a basic kebab.I would not recommend any one.

Author: edwinn896Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Xmas Eve Dinner
Review: Food was sumptuous with wonderful ambience with the tatami style seating. Served by the very helpful Zuraini!

Author: 753lydiajKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Better ..Not so..
Review: Saw many people eating this stuff and decided to give it a try... the have put a note at the shop that it can last for 5 hours with refrigerator. .. but when we bring back home (banting) its kind of sour... its a durian puff but too sour... mayb it became like tat due to heat or something else... but really disappointed for not getting to taste it at its best...Maybe staff can remind customers to finis it asap if they planning to bring back home. .

Author: meriemr43
Title: Bad service
Review: Staff and chef on station were extremely rude, very poor service. I do not recommend to people looking for a 5 Star dining experience.

Author: Harry S
Title: Fantastic Service
Review: Service is top class, especially a staff named Vennmathy. This is why Le Meridien KL is always on top of my list.

Author: maryamabelKlang, Malaysia
Title: Great food with stunning view
Review: We went to the restaurant for a lunch buffet. The food tasted really nice and delicious, comforting as well. We particularly loved their bbq wings, breaded shrimp, braised chicken and their pizza is to die for. They served a wide range of food to choose from leaving you with so many choices to start from. Desserts were nice as well especially the chocolate pudding. They also have fries and fish nugget for kid's menu. In my opinion, the cleanliness at the plates area should be improved as the area does not seem pleasing to the eyes. Other than that, I think this restaurant is a very good restaurant to dine in as not only you can savour delicious food but you can feast your eyes as well with the lush greenery of the golf course.The wait staff were courteous, helpful and friendly too.
Restaurant: Kites Restaurant at Holiday Inn Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie

Author: Benn2120Malaysia
Title: My experience
Review: In short, the place is nice and cozy. The food and drinks were great; presentation, arrangement, the selection of the main and sides and, the quality and quantity as well. The desserts however weren't up to expectations. I've been there during the lunch time, the only thing is, the place was crowded and we had to queue a bit.Staff were so friendly and helpful, over all it was great.

Author: laizhejun
Title: Special Count Down Event 3d2n dinner staycation
Review: Very Special Dining expeirience, 5 stars for it. However the room soundproof is bad, 3 stars for it.
Restaurant: The Grand Getaway by Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur

Author: Utd_till_I_die
Title: Good place to chill after dinner; good selection of pastries and cakes
Review:
Good ambience - bright and cheerful to hang out after dinner. Tables are well spaced so the place is busy without feeling crowded.  

Good selection of crepe cakes and cronuts with ice cream.

Author: OhhailainBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Don't judge a curry house by its cover!! Wow
Review: Went here tonight for tea.. Got there just before 7pm which seemed like the perfect time.My boyfriend and I both had the tandori chicken tikka, vegetable fry Dahl.The Chicken was absolutely mind blowing! Great food, the staff were very quiet yet attentive enough to make the visit a good one! Good value for money.. All with drinks came to 60RMWe'll be going back tomorrow for lunch.

Author: annensteveHerefordshire, United Kingdom
Title: Happy hour rip off
Review: We were 'invited' into this bar (along with many others on the street) for happy hour, with the price of pints of Tiger being given. Once we had ordered 3 pints we became aware that a jug of 3 pints was half the price and asked if we could have that price. This request was denied and we had to pay over 60 Ringgits for the beer instead of 38 for a jug. This lost them not only our good will but we moved elsewhere for dinner and other drinks. Never again

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for a relaxing meal
Review: Located within the Portugese settlement, this is one of the better restaurants here. The seafood here is fresh, the food tasty and service friendly and efficient. A must order is the baked fish and devil curry. A nice place for a relaxing meal while enjoying the sea breeze.

Author: Y6193EEkevins
Title: Not worth the price
Review: Overpriced without any wow factor. I'm a fan of Japanese food and really there are much better Japanese food KL that serves equal standard of foot at 30-40% off the price. Not going there again.

Author: r-taratiaLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: the best in langkawi
Review: i had checked trip advisor on this place and wanted to give it a try. booked the place earlier and was lucky to get it for the evening. lovely dining on the beach. the drinks are must try. the food just great. must try to find out. price is high but must try to find out at least once. only tried main course as we are all samll eaters. will go again to try the dessert. book ahead.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: leongs969
Title: Good service better food
Review: Had always been a fan of ippudo ever since my girlfriend brought me to the first ippudo in Malaysia in pavillion. Ever since then I have always visited ippudo for lunch whenever I can.  Best ramen I ever had and a lot of sides that cannot be found anywhere else. Gst cost reduction for ramen and Plus now u get free drinks on ur birthday month. What more could u ask for!

Author: theblackbackpackerVerona, Italy
Title: Pizza is not genuinely Italian
Review: I ordered a Margherita and as an Italian I can say the pizza is definetely not cooked based on Italian standards. The crust is incredibly thin and tasteless. Instead of mozzarella the place uses something more similar to cheese. On the plus side, the pizza tastes better than other self-proclaimed Italian restaurants. Wouldn't recommend ordering a pizza here

Author: Suria_Nataadmadja
Title: Salty spaghetti!!!
Review: We missed to eat at Dome. I had a good Reuben sandwich, delicious, but, the aglio olio spaghetti was too salty. It’s terrible. Well, we’re heading to have something else later so I think this was only appetizers 😀😀

Author: Patrick CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: For RM80 the worst buffet dinner in a hotel
Review: Went to have buffet dinner there and for RM80 ringgit the offering is the most limited and with all the cheap food provided. Can even count how many main dishes been offered. This is really one of the worst buffet I have eaten and is not worth the amount been paid. If given half price discount also not worth it. I really do not know how come this establishment offer such a ridiculous food for their dinner buffet. This is my opinion the buffet is the worst and food also not tasty. Hope they will not short change customer.

Author: vuikit_official
Title: Good restaurant to visit
Review:
First time here and I love it. 
Not only the foods with variety choices, the waiters that serve also looks professional..
Price is also reasonable and affordable. 
Guess what, price tag is available on the food tray and you roughly can estimate the cost.

Author: the_spinsterella_SG
Title: Bad Service, Nice food
Review: The service could have  been much better. No smiles, no warm greetings. They got our steak wrong  and  didn't apologize.

Author: Jeyjey05
Title: Average chicken rice
Review:
Went for quick dinner. Overcrowded street with limited parking space. 
The chicken rice was average in taste.ordered meatball which tasted better. The price was expensive. Maybe can visit just for the hype created in the Internet.besides that nothing else to look forward.

Author: PYLiewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Can Be Better
Review: Atmosphere was nice, warm and had a good buzz. Service was pleasant. Steaks were good! No complaints. The lobster however leaves a lot to be desired. We ordered the lobster on promotion i.e. the 1.5kg. The flesh was soft and I think it is frozen lobster hence it was a let down. The sides that came with it, the avocado potato salad had no taste of avocado and the coleslaw dressing tasted like it had come from a bottle. We didnt realise that sides were unlimited, they only came to us after we finished the meal. Plus point is that no corkage is charged for BYO wines.

Author: iknowmacha a
Title: Breakfast
Review:
They were good when i last visited them. Service has taken a dip! Arrived at 10.20am and tried to order for dosa and was told that they do it because of they are busy!!

What a joke!

Author: Marcus1710
Title: A small gathering
Review: Is my first time visit laipohen after long time. The hostess was friendly but the server there was not so alert when we ask for even the others table. That we can see mostly the server was standing there. by the way, the durian pancake still is a must to try!

Author: MOYYIO
Title: Don’t go there, go Morganfield’s!
Review: Ribs menu reduced compared to many ribs options in the past. No longer a ribs specialist although the single ribs dish is still good. Thick dark sauce chilly is good. Manager seems lackadaisical when asked about plastic gloves for eating ribs, “No, no gloves”, after persistent request, offered lemon water to wash hands! Service poor, lack of manpower so not attentive. Will not come back.

Author: banu r
Title: Excellent Briyani House
Review: Great Pakistani briyani...Flavours talk for itself and wide selection.The ambiance is good and service staffs are friendly.

Author: paulyny2017Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Mother's Day Celebration
Review: First time trying this Chinese Restaurant located on 1St floor in Grand Magheritha Hotel. Must try the butter prawn. It one of the speciality. Generally the dish is OK. It will be great if they are using the fresh duck instead of frozen duck. Worth of dining if you have the Prestige Card.

Author: jo_chaMalaysia
Title: Not worth for money
Review: I went to the JPO outlet and I was completely dissapointed. I paid RM 18 for a fried rice where I think mamak stall can do better than them. My husband ordered beef noodle soup was too sweet n not up to our expectation. Conclusion : u feel like eating local Malaysian food n paying $$$

Author: Chlli-NomadBarcelona, Spain
Title: Great up-market Indian, but not a rip off (like some)
Review: Food here is not cheap, but it's not as expensive as the Bombay Palace just down the road. But the food is usually extremely good (and better than most), served on a banana leaf (and now with an added banana leaf shaped dish underneath). The place also has rather eclectic Indian decoration reflecting the various regions of food it serves - very interesting and pleasant. If you eat meat, the lamb ribs are very good, but there's lots of very good veggie dishes too. We took a friend here who normally does not eat much, and he couldn't get enough. It's now a regular haunt for our family and friends. If you need a good Indian dish when in KL, this upper-end restaurant is certainly worth it. There are lots of very good and more basic/cheaper Indian restaurants around also, but PTI is a really nice blend of comfort, food, atmosphere and service.

Author: Dacrimsonmariposa
Title: Disappointed with the crema catalana
Review: I wanted to eat creme brulee and came here because this place was suggested as one of the best places to eat creme brulee. I ordered crema catalana which I guess is the Spanish version of creme brulee. I chose to take away the crema. After I ordered and paid for the crema, I noticed that the worker was scooping out the custard from a container and filling it in an aluminium container!!! If the restaurant did not prepare crema in suitable container to be taken away, they could have just informed me...Overall, I'm very unhappy with the crema catalana. It felt like I was drinking custard as the custard had melted because it's form was ruined and the caramalised sugar literally disappeared into the custard. Really really disappointed

Author: Gmakk N
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Service very fast. Food recommended from friendly Sean is nice and fresh !! Nice ambient and good place to chillax with friends  😋😋👍👍

Author: RiChiB
Title: Drinks with a view
Review: Great place to take a group of biz partners or friends to. Lovely garden like rooftop. Good drinks, nice snacks (pizza is great) and friendly owners!

Author: BeeT772Malaysia
Title: Rude
Review: Have not been here for a while and the place is half empty. They now have stroppy rules that you can't change the bun on your burger which makes no sense since they allow you to build your own burger. The service was rude as well. They can do without my future custom

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Sumptious BBQ Platter
Review: We have been to this restaurant a few times as the standard of BBQ Platter is always yummy, alas on our last trip. it was not as good as previous -could it be the change of Chef? Hope the Mangemetn can take action to maintain the quality.The Steamed Chicken was also a disappointment as the chicken was not the "kampung" breed compared to last time. Is it change of supplier?Service has always been good despite the some staff does not speak any local dialects. Tea service never stopped and always hot which is a bonus nowadays.The complimentary soup and dessert are well served.Will try again and hope we will not be disappointed.

Author: stefgaughranLondon, United Kingdom
Title: holiday
Review: Bella and Wan were both very helpful and friendly . They made us very welcome each night and took the trouble to get to know us well.

Author: mwk2015
Title: Lunch & dinner
Review: Good taste on each meal I order frm the set meal & ala carte menu.  Standard maintain. Friendly staff.  Worth to return for more food monthly.

Author: ChangS176
Title: Nice view
Review: Great night view place, if 2ppl go make sure bring tripod because the worker there was too busy..i feel the food was not really worth with the price..

Author: damiar2022
Title: TO IMPROVE MENU
Review: I am sad because i am regular customer and i am shocked because there is no teppanyaki at live station & no more kids friendly food at dessert session .Last time there was a chocolate fountain that most hotel in KL have and now in Renaissance JB. After that there just a bowl with chocolate with fruits. But now no more and my kids keep asking. And new year eve there is no salmon? Can upper management work with chef on this? Thank You.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: L1234ng
Title: DC
Review: Good service and good food for the families members and will come back again! Good location easy for travellers from Singapore.

Author: 534StuartD
Title: Been twice
Review: Great beer, very surprised about the quality of the food. Thought it might just be pub grub, but The food was great. Just don't bother with the cheesy videos being played. Either I'm in a time warp, or this is the 90's😳😂😂

Author: Azkaban10000Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful view, overrated food
Review: We had dinner last week and the restaurant was awesome. It's set in a live cave that's still forming. Very romantically set up. I fell in love with the place. We could choose from 2 sets and we had the lamb, steak and salmon. The salmon was not that good but the lamb was amazing. The steak too was cooked very well but the sauce was too bitter. Everything else was pretty ok. I guess you pay for the ambiance. The staff though friendly were not very experienced.

Author: CityFolks777
Title: A great place to unwind after a hard day's work
Review: The service staff are friendly and efficient. The grilled salmon do was surprisingly well prepared and freshly served. A good place for a cool draft beer to accompany your meal. Price are reasonable for KL central area.

Author: Eric TKuala Lumpur
Title: Weekend DimSum Buffet - Good food but let down by bad service
Review: Came with a groupd of friends for the weekend dimsum buffet (starting from RM 55 per person).We loved some of the dimsum selection especially the egg tarts.However the service was especially bad and slow. Waiters kept forgetting our orders for food and rink refills. Many items that we ordered took 30-45min for them to serve, because the (different) waiters that took our orders went behind the kitchen (supposedly to place our orders or to get our food), but nothing came out even though up to 30-45 min had passed.We repeatedly reminded the waiters, but (as mentioned above) nothing came out of the kitchen for 30-45 min. Keep in mind this is a dimsum buffet, where you order food off the menu and wait for the kitchen to send it to your table. If you have to wait 30-45 min between placing your orders, the food fills you up and you cannot eat as much. Maybe this is Hilton's tactic so that we can order less ??A very disappointing meal, due to the exceptionally bad service.And the restaurant was maybe 60-70% occupied, and there were plenty of staff walking around (at least 5-10?)

Author: ace_krusherKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Impeccable dinner service!
Review: Had iftar at Atas for a friend’s birthday and the experience was made all the more special by the impeccable service by the attentive staff (shoutout to Bell)!Food was delicious - while they do not have that many options of multiple types mains, the main of rice and lauk that were served was delicious, and they made up for it with the extensive dishes to complement the main meal. Desserts were also extensive - and so good!Loved the fact that it still felt intimate and distanced while being able to enjoy a night out with friends.
Restaurant: ATAS at The RuMa Hotel & Residences

Author: Gtaroncher
Title: Nice place
Review: Liked the pain au chocolat! Great coffee place in Penang!! Make it a stop during your heritage visit to the city.

Author: Elie EKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Comment
Review: I went to al Amar on Saturday night and found out that this is a political restaurant singing for some political leader (Bashar el Assad) and I thought I am in the Syrian parliament which is not suitable for a restaurant which is supposed to be for fun and for spending some good time.. I hope this will be resolved although I won't repeat it going there :(

Author: 361zacharyc
Title: Awesome food, AmaZINC staff and service
Review: Hard to find quality food like zinc's in Kuching, unique restaurant, awesome atmosphere and amaZINC staff. A definite must go if you're in Kuching.

Author: Fizzy543
Title: Left alot to be desired
Review: While it was in the heart of the town and the outside was lovely the choice and mixture of food was not amazing. One thing that needs improving soso it is better for western tourists is to install a toilet /abday. Apart from that the atmosphere seemed good enough and with improvements will be fantastic.

Author: Vajra YKlang, Malaysia
Title: Quality and sincerity in doubt.
Review: 9 of us did a birthday dinner celebration on Saturday, 23rd April with reservations made. Service was good until I complained about the prawns in the char kuey teow noodles having gone bad to which ruined our appetites. The waiter in attendance did a good job to immediately summon the manager but what transpired thereafter left me disgusted. The manager only came, apologized and told us he would notify the kitchen. And THAT WAS ALL THAT HAPPENED! i would have expected them to immediately removed the plate of noodles, asked us whether they could offer a fresh dish on the menu or give us the option of not having to pay for that foul serving. After all we paid premium price for that plate which is 6-7 times what we would pay outside at a normal eatery.Hard Rock Cafe , you have let us down miserably!

Author: ZetyNina
Title: Yummy!
Review: It is a chosen place everytime we wanna enjoy the fresh seafood. It is quite pricy but the great taste of each cookings will not stop you from visiting this restaurant again.

Author: NelsonFei
Title: Elegance chinese dim sum
Review: It is well known as it's serving and food quality, not big range of choices but you can try as their food is really nice, recommended !

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Diarrhea after eating, NOT authentic Hakka food, cheap but quality is rubbish. AVOID
Review: Price - The food is SO cheap. I was very amazed with the price.Food - Quality of the food is SO bad I can't brain it. First of all it's NOT even Hakka food. I've grew up eating Hakka food this is no where near Hakka. Vinegar > Pork Knuckles - TOO MUCH BROWN SUGAR! So sweet I almost died. > Fish balls - bought in bulk from the market, not even home made. Might as well I cook at home. > Hakka Zha yuk - it is NOT even Hakka Zha Yuk to begin with. You need that preserved beancurd (nam yue) to cook this dish and there's NO taste of it at all. It's just some rubbish fried pork braised with kicap. Also they added SO MUCH corn flour the whole broth is THICK! EW. > Hakka fried pork balls - what the heck is this?! it's fried pork balls not ROCK balls. so hard my goodness!> Tofu with minced meat - Just some white tofu off the market rack, some minced pork and the broth again, too much CORN FLOUR and it's tasteless> Asam fish - another rubbish dish. CORN FLOUR gravy so thick you can use it to mask your face or something. Not even a single piece of Okra or anything that comes with the fish. The fish came just like that. Given the price of it, fine. Instant asam broth that can be gotten from the market.> Pork ribs- the only edible item. very flavourful and lightly crisp bitsThe whole restaurant's so-called Hakka is NOT very Hakka!It felt as it I came for economical rice.... Even economical rice is way better. This is absolute horrid and I just can't digest it at all. RM100+ for economical rice for 5 pax is so so so overpriced. After the entire meal, we decided it was not worth it afterall. Also, 3 of us got food poisoning after eating in this place. The rest of the meals we had we at separate places and this was the only one on that day we had that had caused all of us diarrhea. Food were managed by foreigners and they heck care about cleanliness. Not only the taste of the food is rubbish, it even caused us diarrhea. I will definitely find my way to report this place to the local council. I asked for the receipt to check our items the guy at the cashier refused to give it to me and forced me to see from his screen. What the hell?????? Isn't it mandatory to give receipts when we request for it???AVOID DINING AT THIS DIRTY PLACE.

Author: Sarah CSeria, Brunei Darussalam
Title: What a disappointing meal! Grumpy waitress and under average food
Review: Good layout, great decor, shame about the food and the grumpy waitress, who incidentally hadn’t even finished her mouthful before she came to take our order, begrudgingly. The chicken was slimy and the salad unappealing. The fish and chips was ok. We asked for bottled water and were told ‘no have’ and when I then asked if the water was ok to drink, I was told no Perhaps lost in translation. She was much nicer than our waitress though ! Would not go out of my way to find this place or recommend it. Perhaps the waitress should read the sign on the way in !

Author: loneranger2204Miri District, Malaysia
Title: Housing of local and western food in famous Satok's area
Review: Went here for lunch and its jammed pack. There were few food station selling local Sarawakian's food: laksa, mi jawa, terubok masin..as for chickens lovers..there's plenty good menu to choose. Serving was bit slow and maybe due to less staff and you got to call them to get your order. Flavour wise was not so " wow" as it seems.Overall, most of the food's taste are edible.

Author: ChillFabKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing experience
Review: The air-condition was down but yet we were told that it was working. And the problem apparently has been going on for perhaps a month or even more. And if that was a problem, it would have been better if the restaurant managers can highlight in advance of the issue for client consideration.

Author: MasrinaJ
Title: so dissappointed
Review: Saba service was very poor. with just a reminder message "arrive before 7 o'clock to avoid cancelation." and no call or without double confirm from saba. they just cancel my reservation. then when arguing happen... they give me a table.. feels a bit happy because i really want to taste food at saba. then when time to eat, all the food finished very early and we need to wait for few minutes until they top up certain menu. its not just end like that, i also need to waits about 20 minutes after to get a baby chair. when time to pay.. the cashier was so unfriendly. his face telling that you are not allowed again to saba after this and plz dont bother me. im so dissapointed. we pay and go back.food at saba was good but saba must budget properly esp on arabic menu. its because all the customer go to saba to taste the arabic food esp in ramadhan.

Author: Aida CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Stupid rule ,Did not allow customer to take a photo by camera
Review: I was there for lunch with a group of friends , and while we were taking a photo, staff told us that " Camera not allowed here, you can take a photo by your phone only, not camera !! I asked him why , he said that this is the management rule ??? what kind of stupid rule is it ? You suppose to be happy while the customer taking a beautiful photo of your restaurant and it's really benefit to your business right ? I did't blame the staff as he is polite and just follow what the management said but this rule is way too weird...What a disappointment!
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: JoshuaPLCKKuching, Malaysia
Title: A Mediterranean Delight (Italian/Greek/Spanish/etc. dishes)
Review: James, Emi and the crew took really good care of us for the evening. The food was splendid, service was great, and venue was lovely. Couldn't have had it any other way. We had 32 guest over for the private room and the long table had everyone fit in nicely.Venue: 5/5Good central location right in the heart of Kuching, only thing to watch out for is parking if you're having a large guest list.Food: 5/5If you're looking for a taste of the maditerranean in Kuching, look no further. I'd highly recommend them. Service: 4.5/5Our fronthouse representative for the night, Emi did a great job accommodating us. Food and orders arrived right on time as requested. They even threw in a few candles and made up the long table pretty and nice for us for the evening. Only constructive feedback I'd have is for our waiters to give us the option of introducing the different dishes when serving the platters out for guests who are trying the dishes for the first time. It was a missed opportunity to highlight the great effort the kitchen puts into their cooking. Their house red was great and went well with the dishes we had.Atmosphere: 5/5We booked the private room so we had access to our own audio system, so we were able to playour own choice of music. The sound system was great and the privacy of the room was perfect for our little gathering.Price: $$$$/$$$$$It's great fine dining, and the price is appropriate for what you get. They're on the pricier side for Kuching restaurants, but they're also on the top end in terms of quality.Keep up the good work guys, will continue to check back in when I'm back in town!

Author: BKLau
Title: Declined service quality
Review:
Another depressing meal at Kuriya due to bad service. Namely 1 female captain. Food was OK, though the fish head wasn't good.

All in all, was good. Now is like lottery. Try your luck.

Author: TimothySohSingapore, Singapore
Title: You either like it or hate it!
Review: I felt the Poh Piah was good but my parents thought they were too dry and tasted weird. All I can say is the filling is darker than the ones we normally eat and instead of strong shrimp based taste, the filling tasted overwhelmingly pork lard and more like Teochew duck sauce. Did not taste much prawn.

Author: littlemylizzyxJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: It wasn't my first time visit Gran Fiesta, in facts it is always in my recommendation list. No one actually welcome and lead us to a seat. After we took our order, no one even care to serve us our drinks even after we told them that we were still waiting for our drinks. Staff is not familiar about what the restaurant is selling.

Author: StellaOPYKuala Lumpur
Title: Only the Looks
Review: Ordered Nasi Lemak and Chicken Ramen, NL came 1st. Waited for a good 15mins before I asked about the ramen. Server said, it was sold out and asked to reorder. I was utterly dissapointed as there were only 2 of us there. How can a server forget to inform ??? She uttered a mere 'sorry' unapologetically. Ordered something else and during meal, one had to just shoo flies away. This should not happen in such an establishment. Food is really mediocre. It couldn't even save the whole mess.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Derrick1230Hong Kong, China
Title: Maybe better for lunch
Review: I was looking forward to eating here with all the great reviews! I was a little disappointed to be honest.So I started off with the deep fried pork dumplings and they were excellent. Big portion and piping hot. Loved them!So they don’t have udon noodles, so I ordered grilled beef. It was not bad but it was not great either. The other party did not like it because it did seem greasy. The rice that comes in a bowl and you mix it up, this was my least favourite dish. I just did not like the flavours in this dish.I can’t say I’d return for dinner but the dumplings are enough for lunch so I’d definitely return for this dish at lunch time!

Author: GadiShaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Would be nice to taste food if only....
Review: I have written a number of reviews on various websites for both accommodation and food, but never negative reviews as I am generally averse to the idea. However on this trip to Penang in which I have found the people and establishments to be accommodating and genuinely warm in general, Jawi House Cafe has become a ambassador of the other end of the spectrum. Rude service from wait staff the second you enter the door. Our group, 4 grandparents, 2 parents and 2 well mannered young girls arrived to enjoy a pleasant meal out and instead were rejected service. Why you may ask? Not enough tables? Improperly dressed? Neither of the above. Instead, the staff simply decided that short of saying that they would not accept children they concocted a story that the table they had already offered us to sit at was suddenly spontaneously booked by another customer on the phone while we were waiting to be seated at said table. This is clearly not a family friendly establishment and instead thinks too highly of itself. I will certainly be recommending Jawi House Cafe and Gallery to my friends, relatives and students as somewhere to avoid should they wish to maintain the impression that Penang is a welcoming place.

Author: experience_12
Title: Food quality
Review: I recognized a bis change of the quality, specially the sausages and ham, Sausages are very low quality and ham hard find. Seem to be the sausages without meat or less meat make more profit. Less reason to eat at Porkies.

Author: CatjlynBradley Stoke, United Kingdom
Title: Overpriced ok service
Review: Right on Jonker street this place is definitely hiking up the prices due to its locationIt isn't the most comfortable in Melaka and certainly not the cheapest but due to its location it is always going to get good tradeThe service was slow and staff were a bit surly and kept bumping into our table without ever apologisingBasically it is a bar on jonker street that has managed to get itself a name and charges a lot for that reason

Author: christycy
Title: Overall the vibe and environment
Review: Overall the vibe and environment is alright, but can work better on the cocktail. The presentation of the cocktail is good but the taste doesn’t reflect or rather it’s not as expected as shown in the photos compare when it’s imagined.

Author: Siew560Norfolk, United Kingdom
Title: Touristy
Review: Been to Malaysia many times and was looking for some street food near our hotel. Found this street from TripAdvisor. I can understand the mixed reviews. Walked the whole street and decided on Dragon View but was totally disappointed. The satay was the best dish. Noodles were average and tasteless, sweet and sour chicken probably the worse I've tasted in all my trips here. The service was appalling and probably because this place is not run by indigenous Malaysians. Don't expect anything cooked to special order, if it wasn't on her iPad it was a 'no can do'. Expensive too, don't avoid Alor Street but walk pass by Dragon View and choose a different place to eat. Didn't see many local people eating here and I can understand why.

Author: stlayching
Title: Local Malaysian Variety Food
Review: This restaurant offers a great variety of malaysian food I would recommend Nasi Lemak and Nasi Bojari. Great taste and has great ambience.

Author: Chandra SNew Delhi, India
Title: Good Indian Restaurant
Review: We were on a trip to Kuala Lumpur and staying at Double Tree Hilton. An Indian friend who lives in KL recommended us this restaurant. It also had good reviews on TripAdvisor so we decided to give it a try since my seven year son wanted to have rajma rice or kadhi rice. We went to this restaurant it was about ten minutes walk from our hotel. We ordered kadi and rice, thankfully it was in their menu and my son wanted it . I also had a beer and Alu Parantha, they offered us Pakodas which were complimentary. For dessert we had moong daal halwaa, the portion was small but tasty. The food was good. If you are in KL and craving for Indian food, you can go to Delhi Royals.

Author: shakyldanialKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent lobster pasta!
Review: Just the best italian food in the country! Had pasta with fresh Italian lobster! Server was Anwar, he was great!

Author: jessye3000Sioux Falls, South Dakota
Title: Delicious !
Review: This restaurant was well worth the evening, the Jawi Peranakan food was really delicious. We loved the nutmeg juice here, and the desserts were also great. We went here once for dinner and once for an afternoon snack. Totally recommend it. I regret not buying one of the cool cookbooks they sold in the back !

Author: Beatrice_Ayeong
Title: Nice place
Review: We choose this place because we can sit outside overlooking the fountain. It has good varieties of food & beverage menu to choose. Nice ambiance, nice meals. The staffs were attentive and of course nice.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Way overpriced Japanese food
Review: Bearing the price that the restaurant charge in mind, the food is not up to par, and the service lousy (probably because of the unexpected Chinese New Year crowd).The food also took very long to be served, between the first dish on the table and the last.For the price that we were paying, we expected a lot more.

Author: chandrika bKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very average - nothing special, food should be better
Review: seating is very close- squeezed, i would say. i think they are trying to maximize the space...i was practically rubbing shoulders with the guy on the other table beside me.we tried 3 dishes, the popcorn chicken salted egg is delicious! recommended if you don't mind the price as you can easily get this better at any Chinese restaurant. never order the Big Daddy pizza and the chicken schnitzel. The pizza tasted only of barbeque sauce and tomato sauce (not even tomato puree!)...come on now. the chicken schnitzel was over done- dry and hard. it was not pleasant at all.

Author: ranjini2014
Title: Decent Pasta and sandwiches :)
Review: They have tasty food but the menu can get selective on certain days. Prices are Rm12-25 but its hearty food run by a lovely couple!

Author: Alyssa_1890Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just average
Review: As we went there around 10 am on a weekday, the place was not packed as expected. We managed to get a place without queuing up. Had the normal dimsum dishes, steamed pork ribs and "liu sa pao"- the taste was just nothing to shout about- you can find the same quality in KL. The price is not too cheap either. Would have to say it is an overrated place.

Author: a22Zak
Title: Very pricey for mediocre food
Review: The food portion was small, usually chinese muslims restaurants have big portions. Considering the mediocre taste and small potions, I think its very pricey.
Restaurant: Restoran Hj Sharin Low (Seksyen 7 Shah Alam)

Author: ElleMansorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: RUDE INCOMPETENT SERVICE
Review: The service here is NOTHING LIKE HARRODS CAFE LONDON. Firstly they LOST OUR RESERVATION. They then give us a bad table though the cafe was practically empty.We were there to celebrate a friend's birthday and a waiter RUDELY Told me no outside food allowed when I brought out the cake and told me a corkage fee of RM100 is applicable for birthday cakes. Why didn't they told this during reservation?? Not only they mistakenly put the wrong name down during reservation they reserved a wrong day. When I brought this up to the waiter the manager rudely jumped in and replied WITHOUT AN APOLOGY.The level of incompetency is incomprehensible. Please hire competent staff and don't bring shame to Harrod's good name.

Author: JenneelimKLSungai Buloh, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Lousy steak
Review: Visited Prime Le Meridien in June 2013. We informed the waiter who served us that we will like to try the wagyu steak that melts in our mouth. The waiter then recommended Prime Signature 1kg wagyu ribs. We ordered and it cooked as medium. The doneness was too advised by the waiter.The Prime Signature wagyu ribs meat was fibrous. The steak was not tender and doesn’t have the melt in the mouth effect at all. We are all disappointed.The steak isn’t worthy of the price RM480 at all.

Author: RezaA1648
Title: Lovely Food and nice Atmosphere
Review:
All the BBQs were fantastic and the buffet food were also great with variety of food, salads and deserts. The atmosphere was nice and all the staffs were friendly and attentive.Highly recommended to all love meat, BBQ and buffet. 
Looking forward to go there again

Author: Highadventurer
Title: Overpriced and tourist trap
Review:
Due to hype, this seems to be the go to place eat chicken.

It is over priced and the toilet cleanliness conditions need improvement.

Try the other stalk diagonally opposite or Chan s Chicken across the street.

Author: KaruTAJurong, Singapore
Title: Interesting Interior
Review: Was there for lunch when we visited the area. Found a table upstairs amongst many knick knacks & antiqueish artifacts. The clutter around appeared to intentional...The food is nothing to be excited about. Average at best. But we did enjoy the drinks. Interesting blends & good coffee.This is one of those insta-worthy place with average food. Maybe a good place for a cups.

Author: Minz Z
Title: We had a warmest welcome from staffs.
Review: Good food good service. Good for hanging out! We got no plans of celebrating a birthday but but staffs help us to at least make a simple surprise to our friend. Giving a two thumbs up for the service. Surely we will come back here!

Author: josslerUK
Title: Expensive, soulless, poor food
Review: Dined as a large group. Ambience was non existent. Service was very slow and erratic. The food arrived inconsistently and was awful: I ordered calamari which was clearly from a packet, and a lamb shank - which arrived cold, tough and without vegetables.The wines was ok but both wine and beer prices were too high. The meal for me & my wife cost 880 Ringgit, and we left hungry, underwhelmed by the lack of South American experience and disappointed by what is the worst restaurant on the great Old Malaya strip.

Author: sxnflxwer_Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't understand what the queue is all about
Review: Waited for 40 mins for a shared table to try their famous chicken chop and roti babi but we were very disappointed with the food and the customer service. The gravy served with the chicken chop was extremely watery and diluted, all we could taste was salt water. The roti babi was also quite soggy when it was served. It feels like the food quality has gone downhill because it was too crowded. Also, the staff are rude when it comes to taking the orders and serving. Just a negative experience overall.

Author: karmilla kKuching, Malaysia
Title: service needs improvement
Review: First time i tried mom's laksa, my sister bought it home. The taste, quite nice. So i went here with my husband and kids. We sat for 30 minutes and no one attended to us for the orders. We even call the waitress for order to be taken, but left unattended. We went out disappointed with the service. I guess no matter how good the food is, the service that makes the customers come back.

Author: PAULINE712Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: Arrive on 17june with family. We ordered different food from the menu. Cheese pizza, garlic bread, Nasi Lemak and lasagne I tried. Nasi lemak did not have coconut taste however the overall Chili and rice is very nice. The rest are as good. Nice cosy place. Met celebrity artiste Jessica Liu. A sweet and pretty lady.

Author: markaR2101QP
Title: The definition of mediocrity ....
Review: Our experience today was disappointing given the ratings. The food was very average, the service was minimal and the whole experience forgettable. There are so many great places in KL that deliver a much better experience.

Author: mohzan hSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Good Malay food in Penang Island
Review: Penang is famous of its Mamak (Indian food ) n other delicacies. There is not many traditional Malay crusine restaurants .Accidently found this place while walking around the famous "Armenian Street area " - National Heritage area under UNESCO. Unfortunately I did not try any of the dishes, as i just had lunch,but the menu 'looks' good ( agree with the other reviewers ) Price is ofcourse slightly on the higher side with each dish averages rm15.00 ( usd5) n coffee n other drinks around rm10.00 (usd3) What is great is the ambiance / set up of the place , the owner ( a former university proffessor) wishes to keep alive the Jawi Peranakan tradition ( i don't quite understand this) but there are write ups n articles in the restaurants to 'explain' all these. Nice art gallery n photos , very clean place n you must go to the 1 st floor which the owner arrange some nice furnitures to make it look like a living room and very clean toilet too. Cook is the owner's son , a yound friendly guy. I had coffee and the lemon flavour custard was excellent, just could't resist the creamy look.

Author: libertyandbeyondPerth, Australia
Title: Beautiful steak
Review: We believe that these guys were top notch. The food was lovely, there was inside and outside seating but considering that you are probably going to get a lovely black Angus scotch fillet steak with delicious accompaniments, you don't want to be dining alfresco and sucking exhaust fumes.

Author: derekg392Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
Review: Such a horrible experience that I don’t know where to start Arrival - during covid you would expect that the tables are cleaned well and sanitised. When I was seated, I had to call the wait staff to wipe the table again as it was still dirty with food debris. To my shock, the staff just came with a dirty cloth and wiped it without even sanitising the table. The menu - try and look for some beverages ( I wish you luck ). They don’t even have bottled water on the beverage list. - I wanted to buy a wine from the retail but was told there is a RM70 corkage. I’m fine with the corkage if the establishment sells wine. But they only have 1 label ( tempus two ) - as previous comments also mentioned, THE RIBS. Probably the worst ribs I’ve ever had. The Ending - we could not finish the ribs so I asked to to have it packed to go. To my shock, the first thing they said was “ no problem but we charge for the packaging “ !!!!!!! SERIOUSLY??? After spending a few hundred in a horrible restaurant they want to charge you for the packaging To me this completely reflects bad management and even worse training. You can’t blame the wait staff if they were not trained and from the look of it, they were surely not trained. My suggestion - There are so many other proper restaurants out that at a fraction of the price. Why pay for horrible food, service, hygiene and PACKAGING. I paid the same amount in Bref and bistrot David for better food, service and was not charged for packaging

Author: Jannim1966
Title: Central though isolated
Review: Nice bar but just a bit too far from promenade. Unfriendly and uninteressed staff did not pay attention to a single customer

Author: molly_cher62
Title: Pretty good selection
Review: I have been to Care Rosita a couple of times in conjunction with courses given by our department and I have always found the food to be pretty decent in comparison to monetary value and selection. The cafe itself is clean and the staff polite and helpful but then again there's nothing to shout about because if you want star treatment then you need to go to somewhere 5 star too. We need to be fair in our criticism and comments. All in all Cafe Rosita would fall in the fair category.

Author: MizzKlang
Title: Happening place
Review: Enjoy your food to the sounds of a live band...only for those who don't mind the noise! Good food...especially the satay!

Author: locomotoreNasushiobara, Japan
Title: the name is italian, and that's it
Review: The venue is posh, the service is excellent but...the food is NOT italian.My expectations for a fine italian dinner were crushed when the first course arrived: the "spaghetti aglio, olio e peperoncino" looked - and tasted - like singapore noodles.Also the second course was a disappointment.Moral: there can't be a real italian restaurant without an italian chef.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: GardensValleyRome, Italy
Title: Old and empty on a lunch time
Review: The area looked like decorated 30 or 40 years ago, and we found it with not many persons we would expect to see for lunch. Anyway I enjoyed the stall 9 where the chef was making in front of us the extension of the noodles and cooking and frying under our eyes.

Author: AnitaM1497
Title: Delicious food
Review: We have been in BF for a week and have eaten here nearly every single day! Delicious Indian and Arabic food, very generous serving sizes and fresh produce. The staff are really kind and friendly and have been happy to adapt meals to suit our family. Big hit with the kids.

Author: ssU4711OQ
Title: Overpriced
Review: For local restaurants in KL, this is over priced and over rated for the quality it serves. Went twice and felt it was a rip off both times

Author: BabsioSydney, Australia
Title: Ok food, great service
Review: Went to this place based on trip advisor reviews. The food was ok/good. Nothing special and certainly not bad. I just would favour other places. The service was efficient and friendly.The ambiance of the location is lost with the loudspeaker from the Mosc (at the Golden Sands) across the road, but don't let that deter you from having meal here. Accomodating for young children.

Author: A20142015Dublin, Ireland
Title: Delicious food, great service and unbelievably low prices
Review: We have been to this restaurant about 10 times so far as we have used Kuala Lumpur as a base for our last three holidays.This is a simple restaurant mostly serving locals but luckily they have an English menu and a very helpful young waiter who always smileys and ready to help.We have mostly had our breakfast here and I can assure you, all of their Indian breads are amazing!There is one thing that has to be said about the place though: do not go near the bathroom if you can help it! It is an absolute disgrace which is very surprising as the restaurant is always spotlessly clean.Do eat here if you have a chance!

Author: AmmyY14
Title: Delicious Pork Satay
Review: This is a quite famous Satay Restaurant in Melaka. The satay is very nice especially pork intestine. Beside the sauce are quite sweet which we don prefer sweet things (which this is very personal). Overall very good.

Author: aussiedevilleMelbourne, Australia
Title: A Bit of A Let Down
Review: The restaurant must have had an ‘off’ night as everything served was mediocre at best. Well the cocktails were good but the food was a huge let down. We’ve read all the awesome reviews here so we decided to give this place a go. We are lifetime platinum members with Bonvoy, so they recognise the membership tier here and offer a 30% discount. Even if you are not staying at the hotel the membership discount applies. I would like to note that alcohol doesn’t qualify for the discount. We ordered the burger, fish and chips and the rough cut pasta ragu. The fish and chips was ok, pasta was acceptable (a bit garlicky for our taste but then this is subjective, but the biggest let down was the burger. It was way to salty, and the patty wasn’t mixed properly as certain parts of the patty was saltier than others. The wait staff changed the burger to fish and chips as well as my wife wanted to order something safe as a replacement since that was what I ordered. The cocktails were value for money we thought. Essentially it’s one for one during happy hour. On a personal note we would return for lunch, we thought the lighting at night was a little too dark, then again one would argue it’s a personal taste thing. Hopefully the second time things would be different.

Author: Jeffrey HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over Rated and Food Taste Below Expectation
Review: Food:Food taste and choice below expectations. Requested for a new fried chicken end up with a cold piece despite spoken directly to person frying the chicken and the waiter. Cleanliness:Teribble not hygienic. Person wiping the banana leaf was using a scruffy dark cloth that looks disgustingly hideous. Every single waiter touch their pants, crouch, adjusting their hair and face. Absolutely no hygiene at all. They hardly wash their hands.Service:Very slow and no attention to details. Not friendly it's only business .. You eat you pay and get out. Waited uniform is white which is good but 80% of them are wearing dirty uniforms. No attention for details. Oh just saw another Thambi holding a banana leaf while scratching his eye brow and left eyes... Still not washing his hands. Disgusting. Conclusion; Avoid at all cost if you can as there are other better banana leaf operator like Raju next to LaSalle Primary School. Value for money; Only if you take their beverage not the food. Staff no very attentive!!!

Author: gina c
Title: Average
Review: The view is of hotel pool...wel it looks like a motel but anyway, the beef rendang was good but very spicy! The wonton was amazing and the steak sandwich was worse than pickle barrel. Lemongrass mojito was very strong but hey whose complaining. All westerners. No locals. Very hard to find place, our grab driver got lost for 10min and was so cranky he finally got us lol.Would not come again but got to say we tried!Service was amazing

Author: weiyangleeKuala Lumpur
Title: Would have waited if they had better service attitude rather than the "I don't really care for your business" attitude.
Review: Wanted to eat here initially. After a brief interaction with the restaurant staff and their "I don't really care for your business" attitude turned me away from this restaurant no matter how good the food may be. Decided to eat elsewhere instead (Cottage Spices, opposite side of the road) which turned out to be a more enjoyable dining experience with more courteous and helpful waiters and waitresses along with the good food.

Author: JeanctcMauritius
Title: Unique and surreal experience
Review: Loved the whole concept. Right from the start, we are encouraged to use all of our senses. The meal was very good...loved the salmon tartare, cauliflower soup, duck with mashed potatoes and the Panna cotta. Yuz was an excellent guide! Really recommend!

Author: aikichin
Title: Awesome variety
Review: We had an all you could eat coupon and our expectations were low. We were delighted that the food that was served was extremely tasty, and came in good sized portions. Ambience and service is better than average, with floor manager going the extra mile. I thoroughly enjoyed my meal.

Author: Godzilla5
Title: Fabulous Ipoh Chinese Fusion Restautant
Review: Yearning for the best char siew?Great crab porridge full of roe?Best dry curry mee with giant cockles?Home made dumpling?A taste of the best of Ipoh local Chinese food fused with wonderful Chinese seafood dishes.What more I can say.Caution, please call ahead
Restaurant: The Museum New Concept In Tow

Author: nezar kBaghdad, Iraq
Title: Excellent iraqi food restaurant
Review: It is a very good iraqi and middle east food in kuala lampur in jalan impi in front of momorail station of jalan impi.the breakfast is so good especially the scrambled eggs.also there are so many meals for lunch and dinner which are very delicious like kebob and chicken biryani rice.also the bread is highly delicious iraqi broad bread which is called naan.the okra stew and beans stew are also very tasty.the prices are somehow high even for malaysia prices standards.highly recommended especially if you are staying at berjaya times square hotel which is very near to the restaurant.

Author: Annabel TNew Haven, Connecticut
Title: Didn't even get to eat
Review: I went to Hanare with my parents on a Saturday night. My father was pretty excited about having fine Japanese food for dinner. The ambience was pleasant as one would expect of a top tier restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. It wasn't too crowded. After leafing through the menu, my mother and I decided to order the set dinners (I wanted the reunion dinner special they were having for Chinese New Year that came with complimentary sake), and my father wanted the famed 'omakase' dining experience that Hanare is famous for. Much to our dismay, the waitress came back and told us that none of these sets - including the promotional CNY dinner - was available. Only the teppanyaki was available. Now, if a customer is going to pay good money, he or she is going to eat the best the restaurant has to offer. We weren't going to pay exorbitant prices for fried beef and a handful of bean sprouts. The least the chef could have done was apologise to his customers for the nonavailability of his items, but there was none to be had. Not even going to try again.

Author: 192alvinnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Colonial charm with great scones
Review: We came here as a couple to celebrate my birthday and had the afternoon tea. The food was good and the ambience was very pleasant although fairly noisy because it is a popular place to have afternoon tea on the weekend. Service was a tad slow, perhaps due to the crowd, but staff were very courteous and friendly. A good place to splurge on afternoon tea in a charming environment, with live piano music.

Author: elzyech
Title: This was my second visit there.
Review: This was my second visit there. The first one was okay. We ordered pho yesterday the soup was hardly warm, its supposed to be hot. The cutleries was dirtyyyyy. Not washed properly. Gosh, especially during this covid time i was hoping the cleanliness is better.

Author: Pavlianito
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: Absolutely delicious dinner, ordered a few smaller plates to share, all were very good.  Cheap as well.

Author: Richard T
Title: Far from expectation
Review: Hyped in social media but taste bad, the mango creep tasted weird,the most ridiculous is mango in the mango pie is already overripe, the pie is soft.

Author: BricodustSouth West France
Title: Cannot understand the hype about this place
Review: Arrived at 6:10 pm to find the place pretty full but we obtained a table outside on the pavement but this was a mistake as we were next to the entrance, within minutes we were surrounded by people queuing, bumping in our backs and nearly on the table.The food was of a good standard but not exceptional, twice cooked belly pork was very small pieces that seemed to have been dipped in a caramel sauce, the portion was very small, The chicken with ginger and garlic was a better size but the chicken was tasteless, just a few small pieces of ginger. The green veg with prawns was OK but just 4 small prawns in total. The bill, including a large Tiger beer was 69 RM, not bad price but still enough for average food.Staff and service OK but not particularly friendly.This place is living on its laurels (and Tripadvisor reports giving it 5s).There are far better Chinese restaurants in Penang, search them out.

Author: MJvixenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: Had business lunch for 4 pax. Set menu and food served were average, not much of a "wow". Variety of breads served were nice and much more unusual than other hotels dining.

Author: 949uuuuum
Title: Super expensive for what? Horrible!
Review: Super expensive for what? Cold hot fish? They say not spicy but they distroye your stomach? Their horrible salad? For double the price of everywhere else? What a scam.

Author: alistair15Singapore
Title: Satay Yakitori
Review: Be prepare this restaurant is really crowded with people from all walks of life. It show how good is their satay. Charcoal grilled to perfection. The aroma of the charcoal is lightly grilled onto the surface of the meat. Imagine the style of the japanese yakitori grill and that what you get from this succulent satay.

Author: Roderick d
Title: Eat here. You'll love it (and go to their sister restaurant SUGAR too)
Review: This is an excellent place to eat, great food, friendly staff, great snacks, nice hip furnishings and an extremely cool sundown cafe (Sugar) where you should definitely go too to watch the parachuting tourists narrowly miss the church tower above you :)

Author: Florance T
Title: Served water with unwashed tumbler
Review: After drinking three quarter of the water in tumbler i noticied rice sediments at  the bottom of tumbler.   Wanted puke. As the tumbler was not washed.   Showed it to the waiter.  He did not have the courtesy to apologise.

Author: tonnyt136
Title: Recommendation of good service
Review: Aidah from Chyna provides good service. She serves andvrecommends the food to us with warmth and smiles. Very hospitable. I will give her a 10.

Author: CarolChinYY
Title: Indian food with a twist
Review: Yummy food but way too spicy. Tiny pieces of siew yoke in the biryani though. The ribs were good. Good for groups.

Author: lilblackdogSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Yummy but on the pricey side
Review: Had wonderful tacos here, but was surprised by the extra charge as one of the staff recommended having the pulled beef flavour. It came as an additional add on which I only noticed when I paid the bill. Wanted to try some cocktails but it seemed the menu had no alcoholic drinks offered. The place is quite hard to find and you have to walk a few flights of stairs from the ground floor up to the very roof top.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: joy777777Indonesia
Title: the most expensive restaurant i ever been
Review: The most expensive restaurant in melaka. Better dont try even the food not bad. I suggest u to eat around melaka raya, such as: zongthai restaurant, station one cafe, hailam kopitiam n there's still a lot of good n cheap restaurant to grab. Remember...nvr try city famous.... the waitre or waitress come near with a knife on their hand...

Author: 363aisyahrShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Average experience- more soup than the beef
Review: If you love spicy noodle soup, go for mee soup with braised beef. Ziran mutton or toothpick lamb is also another speciality over the place. However, from my observation at Shah Alam branch the waiters were not too alert with incoming customers. In addition, the mee soup with braised beef that I ordered was a bit dissappointing as there were too little thin slices of beef provided
Restaurant: Mee Tarik Warisan Asli Shah Alam

Author: lostpatrolasiaGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Not So Hot
Review: Very expensive.I had the large burger tasted of old grease.And the fries were soggy.Outrageous prices for beer.Stick to the Chinese Coffee Shops in future

Author: WyntnKL
Title: There was a CATERPILLAR in my curry laksa
Review: I ordered the curry laksa (not the seafood version), but it came with cockles and 2 prawns, which was fine as long as there wasn't any squid. I hate halfway and found that there was a CATERPILLAR, hard, so it must have been fried, I'm guessing.... It was just in the midst of all the noodles in the soup. I could have easily have missed it. Anyway, the manager was kind to change the bowl, though it was mentally difficult to eat again after that. Also noticed that the bean sprouts were not cleaned properly. It still had the brown husks on it. Other than all that, the soup was tasty.

Author: ryanjogorman
Title: Best Dining Experience in Langkawi
Review: Our introduction to Korean food here at Haroon Haroo was unforgettable. The service was excellent and entertaining, we were walked through some top recommendations and they delivered. The food was tasty and reasonably priced. Would definately visit again.

Author: andrewmY8759PF
Title: A big for something different
Review: Yes unique scenery of bikes but gret coffee and cake .. so yes afternoon is a must here . The service excellent. I was offered a great choice of coffee and i had plain iced coffee on this occasion

Author: SarawakJingleSarawak, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as before
Review: This place used to be my favourite café for Sarawak Laksa as it was excellent, a 10! But sadly it was not as good when I last visit. It was a shock to me! The gravy was with a sweet after taste. Sarawak laksa do not have sweet taste, it is always savoury. Very disappointed and would not go again unless they can assure they will bring back the good old laksa paste.Place is not as crowded as it used to be. Maybe the idea of charging customers for every little things like extra sambal belacan, lime, gravy is a turn off. Sometime it is pleasing and winning the hearts of customers which are the most important. Once you lose a customer, it is very hard to win them back so Madam Tang, try to please your customer more, win them back and most of all bring back the superb Sarawak laksa that I used to love and I promised you, I will be back (literally fly back to Kuching) and it is not only me, but all your previous faithful customers. So go for it Madam Tang!

Author: TerjeHoegberg
Title: Pubfood the british way
Review: Good location in Changkat Bukit Bintang it's a good choice for those to craving for british pubfood. Big portions, cold beers, inside and outside tables but rather expensive compared to malaysian standards. Good service.

Author: steve_vensJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great food great beer
Review: We were searching for a seafood restaurant alongside Alor street and happened to passby this restaurant. It was paradise for Sofi since she loves seafood as much as I love chicken lol. Anyway it's quite a good deal in this restaurant, but beer quite pricey and well you need to share a table with others sometimes when it's very crowded. P.s: butter fried shrimp is my favorite, I had some people looked at me with a disgust face when I fight with shrimps.

Author: 158trevora
Title: Peking Duck excellent
Review: large relatively empty restaurant on a Saturday night - but I'm glad we weren't put off as the Peking Duck was excellent and every bit of the duck was used to good effect. Wine relatively cheap.

Author: StartrekersNewton Abbot, United Kingdom
Title: No wine with dinner
Review: Thought the food was average, service below average and if as it claims to be an international restaurant then it needs international standards and serve wine not just a can of tiger beer.Having said that the price was very good at under £10 a head

Author: TheProtagonist16
Title: Unreliable service and food isn't that great
Review: Yes it's cheap but food isn't Thai at all. Staff are clueless about the food and way better restaurants around the mall. Nevertheless it's cheap.

Author: shafinasb
Title: Awesome tepanyaki dinner
Review: Had an awesome dinner at this restaurant with my husband. We ordered beef tepanyaki and salmon tepanyaki.. both are extremely delicious. But as a beef lover, the sirloin tepanyaki was a star. Met Saiful which was the supervisor of the restaurant, and he guided us what to order as it was our first time there. He’s a very nice man and very attentive. So as our cook, Jimmy who is very nice and friendly. Good job to the whole team of the restaurant. Will definitely come again. Check out our dishes from the photos

Author: Sherene1308Malaysia
Title: Above expectations!
Review: I brought my family there after reading some good recommendation from Trip Advisor. The family run restaurant serves authentic Korean home cook meal, which taste very homely and unlike the normal commercial Korean food I have in big cities. The Bibimbap is the best I have tasted so far. With most of the foods here in Langkawi are over priced due to its tourism status, Haroo provides great dining experience at a decent price. I will definitely visit them again!

Author: paulsQ3216KX
Title: Terrible restaurant. Stay away
Review: Average food, bad service and over priced. Price and food quality does not seem to match. Carry a lot hand sanitizers as even the menu is dirty and seems to be falling apart. I was overcharged for the drinks I had. So please be careful and check your bill properly. Staffs seems confused with everything they do. I think there are a lot of better Thai food joints in town. Don’t be deceived by their slow loading website and photos. I will surely not be returning to Baan 26.

Author: Leithiga
Title: Food was not good
Review: We went as a family and tried steaks, the buffet as well as the buffet with meats. The steaks are the worst I've had in KL. Dry, tasteless and definitely overdone (I asked for medium well but it looked like it was well done).The food at the buffet was below average and the meats were not properly marinated. As such, there was a distinct lack of flavour and some were too salty. The only thing that was nice was the grilled squid and the duck breast was .. not too bad compared to the rest.Will not go back again, for sure.

Author: Cheryl-TMF
Title: Service so so
Review: Unfriendly staffs, slow in order. Cold chicken was served. Fish and pork balls nice. Noodles was tasted good.

Author: jellyjanejane
Title: They don't serve warm water BUT you can pay RM20 for them to boil Acqua Panna mineral water for you
Review: This rating is based on their lack of common sense, poor hospitality and unwillingness to accommodate patrons who are unwell. 2 of my party is down with a fever and bad cough so we wanted some warm water. The waitress insisted that they do not have warm water BUT suggested to boil the Acqua Panna mineral water for us. Any establishment that is unable to accommodate to a request for filtered warm water for a sick guest is inhumane. I don't mind being charged for the warm water, but just don't give a stupid suggestion to boil a RM20 bottle of water. No one does that. Utterly disappointed and has diminished any of my desire to return here.

Author: Idah H
Title: Service Good but Food Just Okay
Review:
Been here a few times. Service was fast and staff quite friendly however food tastes just mediocre - have tasted better elsewhere
Tried their lempeng, asam pedas ayam and daging lemak cili padi
Frankly the price was a bit over-rated. Should improve the taste

Author: JGBMF
Title: Discriminatory restaurant
Review: Went in this place for dinner. It was not busy at all. They have barrel type seats, which is where they wanted me to sit, but after a long day at work my lower back was tired so I asked to be seated against the wall where there was a seat back. The host advised that was a place where they usually seat larger parties if necessary. I explained my back situation and he allowed me to take a seat where I requested. I waited a while to place my order. After ordering, the waitress who took my order asked to to move seats! I asked why, she said this area was for larger parties. There was a total of 7 people in the restaurant, no large party waiting to seated. This was extremely discriminatory! A big two thumbs down for this establishment. I travel 80% of the time internationally for my work and I have never experienced this type of discrimination or poor treatment. I wonder how the staff would feel if they or one of their family members were treated this way at a restaurant. I’m not a believer in the customer is ALWAYS right but this treatment was way out of line. I cancelled my order and departed for a more service oriented place to eat. Zero rating is the true rating this place deserves. Diners beware!

Author: NatashaRenn92
Title: Impressive hospitality
Review: Went there for a dinner with my family and Yun House team offered the best class service. Love the offerings and Jia Ying and Elin was very attentive and friendly. Pauline was also top and not forgetting to check on us. Highly recommended!

Author: madollah
Title: Terrible Ipoh Foh San Dimsum
Review:
Tasteless dimsum, over priced. 
Eating dimsum but no aircond, hot.. bad environment ! Don’t go there, Ipoh is heaven for chinese food, still many other places with delicious high quality dimsum and Chinese cuisine.

Author: Chic_observerSydney, Australia
Title: Great dining experience
Review: This was our highlight in KL! Worthwhile experience, good food - each course has a few small plates to try. It is completely in the dark, no candles, or small lighting to guide you to your table. Our vision impaired host had a great sense of humor, who led us in the dark and served all our meals. It is different to be relying on smell & taste to guess what is on the menu.Coming from Australia, 98 Ringgits is more than reasonable for 4 course meal including a drink on arrival, tea and coffee at the end. You do need to book in at least one day in advance online from their website.

Author: ShirleypageYorkshire England
Title: Lost some of that old world charm
Review: This was our third visit to KL and our third visit to this restaurant and I'm afraid it will be our last. Starters arrived cold, the chicken dish for our main had three inedible pieces of chicken in it. The whole meal was rushed, we felt like they wanted us out. Interestingly we say them turn two sets of Asian couples away only then to allow westerners in - didn't seem right to me. This used to be a great little gem, but as it is mentioned in the tourist guides maybe that is who it caters for - this was the worst meal so far if our visit !

Author: miikkkeee
Title: Tasteless on jonker
Review: The place has lots of good reviews not sure why from my experience. Maybe I ordered wrong but food was tasteless and overpriced for what it was.

Author: dc_rock85Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Steaks
Review: Not many places in KL where you can have good steaks in a tavern! Great venue for gathering with friends.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Inconsistent, terrible hygiene & racist staff members
Review: The foods are inconsistent. Staff members are not friendly to Chinese customers. And they never renew the soy sauce, caused my friends and I to have terrible diarrhea experience after dining there with the soy sauce served on the table

Author: sallygK2969YO
Title: Good experience
Review: Very handy for the Aloft hotel. We were quickly seated. Salmon appetizer very good, also the dynamic rolls..

Author: 847danialt
Title: I hope this reaches the management
Review: I hope this reaches the management and owners of La Risata. I have been a loyal customer to the Ampang branch for over a decade. I have spent thousands of ringgit supporting this restaurant. Today I was excited to know that La Risata can deliver to my house via Grab. But, turned out to be a nightmare. So I made an order at 11am for 3 pizzas. At 11.45 I received a lasagna and carbonara. So I looked for a phone number to call for grab. But to my dismay, their procedure was to email them a complaint. Which takes 24 hours for a reply. So I call La Risata, they just told me it was a mistake from grab and I should call them instead. I mentioned that I can’t call them because Grab doesn’t have a phone number I can call about this. They said they will try for me. So I waited, but no response. So I call again. This time i was passed around to 3 different people and I had to explain again to all 3 my situation. In between the exchange I can hear them talking to each other about what to do, it sounded like I heard someone say it’s grabs problem. Long story short, I am the customer and I am not the one to be punished, pushed around and be caught up with the Grab vs La Risata battle. So I asked if I am going to get my pizza and that they are making a new one. They said no, and that you are going to send a pizza that has been bouncing back and fourth for what is coming up to 2 hours. La Risata, I am not happy with your customer service. I expect the grab quality pizza I paid for with my hard earned money. What are you in the business for if not to take care of your customers. What ever issue you have with your delivery partner in the future should be dealt between yourselves and not the customers expense. Send your customers their food with quality in mind. Just FYI, still no news that I will be eating lunch today.

Author: ClubGGGToorak, Australia
Title: Hotel food...
Review: A shame as the buffet looked nice, and it was a Thai cuisine festival.There were also Chinese and Indian sections, but overall it was average.We sampled and shared several small dishes of various cuisines, and maybe the best was the Indian, with a good curry and a lamb roshgan.Good fruits for dessert as we were not tempted by the sweets.Good service from the ladies in the restaurant.

Author: LE MEUR D
Title: A good French taste in Asia
Review: The young owners have a liking for the food they serve in their peaceful restaurant.No too much dishes to choose but all are perfects.A quiet atmosphere, an interior decoration and a very good music.So, have a seat and enjoy !

Author: mk t
Title: Not in expectation & doesn't feel the concept
Review: A little disappointed. Chocolate drinks taste like milo and only the design of cup is special. Waffle also taste below expectation.

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Very good chinese restaurant
