Review: This upmarket Chinese restaurant serves well prepared dishes. Their signature dish is the lychee wood roasted duck, but other items are also done to a high standard. For vegetarians they also have a moderately good range of dishes.I've not had the dim sum here though.

Author: midzurllMalaysia
Title: Its nice but not the best
Review: Since we came by walking, we had to climb up so many stairs to reach the top. The lady who served us was very patient with us and explained everything one by one, they also had a menu on what they could do which was helpful. Price was okay too and you could ask for how many grams of fish you (depending on the no of pax, there were only the two of us so we asked the lady to find us the smallest fish). All the dishes were cooked deliciously but it tasted just like how you could find it in the other states in Malaysia, so nothing special. P/s Sabah has the best seafood that I ever tasted. Oops.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: 567IanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive Fast Food
Review: First thing, do not expect any privacy if you are a couple due to the sharing of tables with others. Food were not up to expectation and not worth the price that they charged. I find it hard to comprehend when they used a serving tray for the Arabian meal that was total impractical to dine with. Time provided was inadequate and felt like they were rushing you to finish up each serving in a hurry so that they to move on to the next dish. However the best part was the amazing light show during the entire meal which was a good experience to have. At the end of the dinner, the server would trick you into paying extra by ordering after meal refreshments which was totally unnecessary because there just wasn't enough time provided to let you indulge yourselves with those drinks. I suggest you have your favorite beverage elsewhere that allows you to relax and chill. Overall this entire episode felt like a 5 course fast food experience.

Author: Thomas T
Title: Fried Oyster
Review: One of the better ones that we have had. Enjoyed this better than the one at a nearby stall. Oysters were fresh and chilli sauce was piquant.

Author: Winnifred63Sydney, Australia
Title: Never again - avoid!
Review: We were very disappointed with our visit after reading the review in TimeOutKL. The service was terrible - we waited 30 minutes for our order to be taken after many attempts at attracting attention. Our table of 5 waited another 50 minutes without any food appearing despite 3 tables around us (who ordered after us) being served and finishing. Our multiple questions about the lack of food were not followed up and we felt invisible and ignored. After waiting 70 minutes since ordering and still nothing, we left. We have an apartment nearby, but will never go again as there are plenty of excellent options in this neighbourhood.

Author: Michael B
Title: Grubby and not good
Review: I had to borrow a wipe from my wife after looking through the very grubby, tattered menu - the whole place was unloved and uncared for.  Staff were like the place - no service, no care - had a drink & fled.

Author: slowlyandloudlyPerth, Australia
Title: A good little spot to escape Petaling
Review: I popped in here for some airconditioning and caffeine, and got quite a surprise from the interesting menu.Went for a sakura green black sesame bubble wrap, kind of an anti-waffle due to the bubbles. And it was good, great flavour, though a little hard to eat as it came in a cardboard cone that had to be held, accompanied by a little wrapped plastic utensil - so the first problem was how to get the tool out of the bag one handed.That's basically what keeps this place from being 5 stars, the food is great, the toilet clean, good air con, but too much wasted disposable plastic with the straws and utensils and packaging.

Author: TyngPCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over Rated, Over Priced For The Quality Of Food
Review: Called to make reservation, was really anticipated to try the food by the chef who used to worked in Michelin star restaurant, after all there aren't many in Malaysia. Had Beef Consome with Foie Gras & truffle. It was ok, no "wow" factor, nothing special. Also had Roasted Chicken. The side dish potato, diced duck in the cream sauce was lovely, the chicken was roasted perfectly, except that the meat wasn't fresh. The side dish was much tastier than the chicken. Feedback to the management but he didn't seem to care much. The wine by glass, an Italian red, was good for the price compared to other establishments in KL. Our waitress was friendly & eager to serve. Overall I am disappointed as I was really looking for good food. To be fair, I have to say that it was real food, meaning not artificial flavouring or ingredients, no MSG, but from a chef with working experience in Michelin star restaurant, I expected more.

Author: westkayu
Title: Horrible experience
Review: Dishes were badly cooked, overpromise and underdelivered.  General cleanliness of the place - unkempt, slippery floors.

Author: londonerabroad79
Title: 5-star prices, minus 1 star food
Review: This place has a big reputation, but I suspect it was earned man years before I ate here and they've been phoning it in ever since.Poor selection of food - I eat almost anything, and even I struggled to find something that appeared appetizing.For a high-end upmarket restaurant, charging at least MYR150 per head, the food quality was abysmal. You can have a better meal in a food court.I don't blame the staff too much - they appear to have limited training and not much to work with.But at least the band was ok.

Author: GraceC855
Title: Family visit
Review: Not saying that their food not good . Compared before they move to this new building . The food taste drop a lot . Not that special .

Author: Lowchuanhwee
Title: Chicken rice shop
Review: Very good food especially their cha xiu! Must try, and the chicken rice also delicious. Place are clean and cool.
Restaurant: Kitchen Iron Rice Bowl Sdn Bhd

Author: shougie123
Title: Super good food and service!
Review: I really recommend this restaurant. The waiters are really kind to the customers, give relevant information about the dishes and guide you through the menu, and make sure that you have a good evening. And the food is excellent! The chef also pays visit to the customers to chat and inquire whether we like to food or not, and also to show us how to eat it. We had a really good experience. Thank you Haroo!

Author: wessyuk
Title: differant
Review: I reviewed the ceylon bar in january 2014. We visited again on our 2015 visit to k.l. the bar is still the same welcoming place, great for a quiet drink and food. There is now a restaurant "upstairs". It was so pleasing on my earlier visit that after walking up Changkat and being "invited" in to all the bars we past...we arrived at the oasis of the Ceylon......no invites to come in....however this does not happen anymore and on our last visit this year we were indeed "invited" to come in, although maybe it was for the restaurant upstairs......They share the same steps from the road.....making our visit to the Ceylon......not the same.

Author: kenluvs
Title: Unhygienic area
Review: The chairs, the tables and importantly the floor is so dirty. The floor is so sticky and it's disgusting. This branch has to dramatically improve their cleanliness! The hand sink is terrible.

Author: AlfredKhoo
Title: Valuable price & normal food
Review: That was valueable , when we go there need to wait around 30 minutes but the food disappointed just normal . 2 person cost around RM 30+ , food so so

Author: T SJupiter, Florida
Title: Breakfast Buffet is Not Very Good
Review: Hotel told us that breakfast was 5MYR if we ate at the Carvery. Upon entering the restaurant, we confirmed with Remy the price for breakfast and he told us 5MYR each.Buffet breakfast items were not replenished. Eggs had been heating too long. Char Kway Teow was dried out. Fruit juice containers were almost empty. Tea pot was empty.After a very tasteless breakfast, the bill was presented stating that we owed 70MYR. It was subsequently reduced to 10MYR. Watch out for inflated bill.

Author: joeyfun81Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fair
Review: We had been always wanted to visit this interesting restaurant as they have sizzling stone grill for your meat/seafood. Special ostrich meat to try. We tried the ostrich kebabs and it was ok. It's easy to be burnt on the stone though. And the stone was cooled after 10-15mins. Tom yam seafood soup with noodle was horrible. So damn spicy and waiter was not bothered even after we told them. It's not normal spicy. It's worse than Chinese Ma la soup. Inedible! Total bill ended up RM55.50.

Author: Weng LSydney, Australia
Title: Dinner food
Review: Recommended by tour guide at the Hilton and local food and taste like the local vegetable that is only available in Sarawak and chicken/pork etc.Taste wise very average compared to what I am used to elsewhere and same can be said in general of the Kuching restaurant food.

Author: Ashok PMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Used to be good
Review: Once upon a time, the food here was fairly authentic Thai cuisine. I went again a couple of weeks ago, only to be sorely disappointed. Whether to suit foreign palates or for some other reason, the spiciness of many dishes has been almost entirely eliminated. For instance, the tomyam soup was sour, instead of fiery hot and sour. The green curry tasted overwhelmingly of fennel. Somehow they had run out of the ingredients for a mango salad, and prawn fritters we ordered did not come. To make things worse, both the salad and the fritters were on the bill, until I pointed out that we had not received them.

Author: Eddie LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expect 1 - 2 hours before dinner served..
Review: It could easily been years since the first time I notice this restaurant..especially the crowds that would stand there and waited to be the next customer. I guess it must really serve extremely good food and out of curiosity, I took my parents to join...Well... It turn out to be well... Normal seafood restaurant with the extremely long waiting hours and long queue. No more second time... Geez.. Sorry to disappoint but it's purely my own opinion though..

Author: Djmegena
Title: Very bad experience
Review: I've been on a tuesday evening with my girlfriend. Looking for something to eat but unfortunatelly at 23 the kitchen was closed (on internet website opening hour for restaurant it's till 1am daily...), we decide to take some snacks but also those were not available (finished french fries ???). Ok after a annoing strong push of the waiter to buy more drinks, we ask for the payment, and without notice they didn't give back the change (aprox 20% of the total) and we had to search the waiter to get our change.... I've been in many many Hard Rock around the world, and this is definitely the worst experience i had in Hard Rock.

Author: VenuRamadass
Title: Birthday Lunch
Review: We were a party of 6 on Christmas eve. Had roast chicken, pastas and pizzas. The family surprised me with the help of the lovely staff of Positano with a molten lava cake for my birthday. Topped it up with steaming espresso. Thanks Jeeva, Athierra, Malik and the rest for making our afternoon a delightful one!

Author: Nurinhamzah
Title: Annual dinner
Review: Food is very good and delicious ...Staffs also very friendly..... good services.... Very recommended....

Author: K3iGo
Title: Great food with stunning view
Review: Food here - few words to discribe, great, delicious & varieties. With the stunning view of Kuala Lumpur, this makes it to another level of dining experience.

Author: jiajing1993
Title: Great Coffee surround by the water
Review: I enjoy the feel working here with their coffee. They have really good coffee and the atmosphere here is calm and relaxing. Beside, Mr Rafat also served us very well, He is always there when we need something.

Author: Trip804857LA California
Title: Last night in KL
Review: WOW! We found Quivo and decided we wanted to have casual meal of a mixture of food. They did not disappoint. We sat at the bar. It was very busy around 7 pm. We could not have been happier with our choice. Service was great. We had Garlic Balls, the Pepperoni pizza and the Brisket Risotto. ALL GREAT. We got to meet the chef by accident and he was more than excited we were eating in his restaurant. If you are in KL please visit Quivo, you will not be disappointed.

Author: emeliera
Title: Nice staff
Review: Not so cozy place but the staff was very nice. The food was ok but not a wow moment. A little western influenced place.

Author: JoeCool_KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fabulous food and Great ambiance!
Review: This restaurant opened up in 2019 by a famous celebrity chef in Malaysia. We came here for the special Raya buka puasa and the food here is fabulous ! So many choices of Malay cuisine and all cooked to perfection. The chef is really insistent on using quality raw materials and this can be tasted in all the rich sauces and curries.Will definitely come back again for meals.

Author: LouHaa
Title: Need more variety...
Review: We liked the setting and service, yet we thought it lacks variety and more reasonable prices...
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: travelling_sisterCairns, Australia
Title: Delicious - Dim Sum
Review: I have reviewed this place several times and the thing always letting it down was the service but it's turned around. The service was attentive and friendly. The tea smoked spare ribs are awesome, a suggestion from one of the wait staff. The pork buns and avocado rolls are a favourite. Oh, and the sticky rice with Chinese sausage. Will return.

Author: shehwazGandhidham, India
Title: Will never visit again even if i'm starving
Review: One of the worst places where i had "indian" food while in KL. Place was overcrowded and the staff was unable to handle the rush of visitors. Apparently this place is very popular with the tour operators from India, so you will see huge bunches of tour groups during lunch and dinner rush hours.Food was very bad. Just the sight of the food made me loose my appetite. Did not try anything there inspite of having paid for the lunch buffet.Everyone was shouting at the top of their voice and dining experience was ruined completely.Presentation was pathetic. Tables not cleaned properly and staff seemed dis-interested in serving us.Do not visit.

Author: aivlysmil3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced Food and Measly Portion
Review: Our family of 6 visited Oribe due to the reviews we read on TripAdvisor. We weren't expecting much but our disappointing experience left us with worse regard of this overrated restaurant. Needless to say we bear zero intent on ever returning to this place. The only food that was good was the single serving of one fresh oyster per person, other than that the few stingy slices of sashimi (ootoro, yellow tail etc), appetiser, 5 measly anorexic pieces of sushi, and bland chawanmushi were unbearably embarrassing to warrant for an Omakase standard and quality. We have had omakase in Singapore and Tokyo and they far surpassed what we were served for a total bill of RM3700+. We do not mind paying for quality food and this weak offering for an Omakase is inexcusable. We were even served miso soup! Seriously?? We have never been served miso soup in any of our omakase experiences. Those who are thinking of trying this place out should think of spending their money elsewhere. There are much better places in for Japanese cuisine in KL.

Author: summersbeaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh prata (roti canai)
Review: Hailing from Singapore, Indian food is not unfamiliar to me. I couldn't fathom how one Indian breakfast place could differ from another but onward we tried Restoran Nagasari given the great reviews. It didn't hurt that it was also 5 mins away from our hotel.We had prata on our first breakfast, complete with chicken curry. The curry seemed to be prepared beforehand and heated again in the microwave as it had a dried film of oil when served. However, the roti canai/bomb/bawang which we ordered were all crisp and very fresh.On our second day we had brunch at the restaurant and ordered a butter chicken with murtabak. Again, the butter chicken seemed to have been prepared beforehand and heated, served with a dried film of oil. However, the murtabak was great.Given the two experiences, I would recommend taking the fresh "pastries" instead of whatever soup (or soupy-like dish) was available.

Author: sherredenkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Everytime
Review: Ah El Meson! The family and I have been regulars here ever since we moved into the area, because it is always, always the ducks nuts (the best in Aussie speak). The food is always divine, from the perfect paellas to the lucious lamb and the delicious duck dishes. The prices are on the more expensive side but on par with other places in the same area. I'm happy to pay though when the food is that good and you can see the cleanliness of the kitchen from the restaurant area. Having worked in hospitality myself, I'm always happy to see a kitchen that's open and has nothing to hide. The front of house is also clean and well loomed after. Tables are cleared and reset quickly. Staff are attentive and kind.There is an extensive drinks menu as well with wines, cocktails, mocktails, coffees and shooters.The atmosphere is relaxed and open. Music is not too loud and there are sports playing on a couple of televisions so you cam keep an eye on the soccer scores while you are munching. It is suitable for small and large groups. I would say family friendly but not for large groups of children at once. It is a bar as well as restaraunt with many adults on dates or catch up with friends so we keep our own children as quiet as possible out of respect to other customers. Other then that the staff are always accommodating and friendly towards us our children and I've observed the same treatment towards others so there's no bias towards regulars like us.We are regulars because of the consistency of quality for both food and service. So if you are in the area and want a tapas snack or filling main meal try El Meson.

Author: Dean L
Title: Slow and average
Review: Waited over an hour for a few pieces of sushi, and they even forgot a few pieces from our order. Food was ok but the service was unexisting.

Author: Winnie Lbatu caves
Title: Special pineapple sauce but..
Review: Few years ago, I went and tried out the satay. It was really GOOD and DELICOUS!!It make me felt it is the best satay I had ever tried. Because the sauce is special. The satay is juicy. The sauce has pineapple in it and this match perfectly with the satay,That makes me miss it a lot whenever I think of Melaka food.Yesterday, 12 Sep 2016, I went again.The shop had expanded to two shops. They make satay in the kitchen not outside anymore. And I get a 2nd chance to eat the satay again.But I am disappointed this time. The taste had changed. Satay become small and dry. Pineapple sauce is a bit different. Not as good as previously.Is it now they are popular and famous so they produce satay with strong fire without quality control?

Author: Darcy AHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Nice for a crepe and some people-watching
Review: Came here for dessert and had a berry crepe and some green tea. Both were quite good and you feel almost like you're at a cafe in France sitting there watching the people walk through the Pavilion. Didn't try the dinner food, but will definitely go back next time I'm there.

Author: Excursion379280
Title: Casual dining
Review:
If you would like a perfect view of Kuala lumpur, this would be the place at 400 plus meters .

However selection of food for the buffet lunch is really nothing to shout about.

Author: Ayla_KosmonovaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Restaurant with a view, good quality meals but service has a lot to be desired.
Review: Had a little birthday dinner with my sister & cousin over the weekend. The starter bread & dip was pretty meh, it was hard. We ordered the sushi/sashimi platter (RM200), szechuan chicken, mushroom soup, caesar salad and fried rice to be shared among 3 of us. The salad was prepared live on the table. Ingredients are of high quality, the sushi/sashimi cuts are big & fish are fresh & no funny smell! The fried rice has lots of seafood in it, even caviar! We can't barely finished the fried rice since we also ordered mojitos that comes in a very big glass. Total damage for food & beverages around RM630++ (the champagne was the most expensive thing) and for special occasion we dont mind binge eating :pSince the restaurant was dark it's hard to get waiter's attention. We waited for a long while for the plates to be cleared & dessert (complimentary cake from the grand club staffs) to be delivered. Its almost 11pm & we're getting impatient. Finally a wait staff noticed us & start clearing our table & presented us the cake. They sang happy birthday & left as swiftly as they they arrived. Very insincere...lol. but it's ok since the meals are good. The restaurant could make use of some live music for entertainment/distraction while waiting for the food to arrive. It was pretty boring & sleepy after a few shots, the only amusement is by watching the glimmering lights of the twin towers & the strobe lights from Marini @57 bar.

Author: sweet_cindy1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Felt humiliated
Review: We were disappointed with the way we were treated. There is this chicken wing dish on their menu and we politely asked whether we could change the wing to breast meat for my daughters. We were straight away tell off by the chef, he says that “He has never come across people that doesn't eat his chicken wing!” in a very rude way! My daughter felt very sad after being told off my the chef. We did not eat and we left the place as we felt humiliated by the way we were treated.

Author: pattngSingapore
Title: 😖 MSG laden
Review: All 7 of us were thirsty like crazy after leaving the restaurants. Desperately kept looking to buy water throughout the day. Had lunch there and afterwards could no longer eat anything the rest of the day as some of us were sooo bloated. Couldn't even eat dinner. Will never go back. Waiters were also unfriendly.

Author: MinTze
Title: Avoid if you can
Review: Lousy service, unfriendly staffs, super duper long preparation time, expensive, I asked for a set of children set and they claim they don't have it, absurd!! Avoid at all cost please.

Author: Joe C
Title: Disappointing to the max
Review: We visited this restaurant in KLCC to search for the good taste it used to have 3 years ago. I still remember how great the beef sukiyaki in its damansara uptown HQ tasted last time. To our dismay, the food's standard was totally unrecognizable. The soup is bland, the food portion is tiny and the revised price is unacceptable. Won't recommend anyone to step in.

Author: DrKok Chiang NChili, New York
Title: Ok for this small town
Review: The waiter is terrible and the owner is arrogant. Service is bad. The food is alright, not fantastic and they overcharge for lobsters and wagyu beef, so never order those. Unfortunately, there aren't many fine dining restaurants in Ipoh, so this restaurant is likely to survive. Macaroon's only ok, can't even compare with Levain in KL.

Author: welshboyed
Title: Tasty cheap food
Review: Enjoyed a delicious lunch of tandoori chicken, naan and dahl here for just 9r. Other food looked good too and good value at around 5r per dish, easy to find outside central market.

Author: Travelller78
Title: Was great!
Review: Enjoyed the fries, the fajitas and the lemon tea! Recommended!  Only criticism is, in my opinion,  the fajitas should come as standard with cheese but they brought it over after I asked for it!

Author: Munjusri
Title: Get lost on the Tea Menu
Review: It was my first time there and was dazzled by the choices of tea. The waiter recommended us some flower tea without caffeine and it came in a pot with amazing aroma. Unfortunately, the tea can't be refill and the pricing can be quite expensive.

Author: Tee A
Title: Less than ideal nonya food
Review: Went there with a group of 8. Were disappointed with most of the dishes. This is definitely not an authentic nonya food place and it contradicts with most of the reviews I read here.I would say this restaurant offers dishes of what a typical nonya restaurant served, that's all.

Author: nigelskelchyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gruff Beginning but a Sweet Ending
Review: Uncle Lim who takes the reservations and orders is particular about doing things in a particular order. He's also gruff over the phone. No brownie points for phone manner but in person he's lovely, helpful and very friendly. Every inch the proud Maitre D'! Lovely to watch someone who's proud of what he's putting in front of his guests.From his assertions that Amy's does everything in-house from the spice pastes to his instructions about ordering and eating dessert at the end "Cendol nanti, Makan Dulu" he's large and in charge! Just in case you're reading this Uncle Lim, it's all good! ;-)Unfortunately, the bad part of our experience was that there were only 2 of us, which for Nyonya food is not always the best thing as what you can order is very limited. We had the Udang Goreng Assam or Tamarind Prawns, Sayur Masak Lemak (Water Spinach and Cabbage lightly braised in Coconut Milk), and the Ayam Pong Teh (a Chicken Stew braised in a sweet broth with fermented bean). All were delicious. As my friend said about the Sayur Masak Lemak, "it was a 'lemak' orgasm!" Recommendations for the best experience;1. ALWAYS reserve a table for your party. Never show up without one or you could be turned away. Yes, this happened while we were there. And show up on time or risk having your table given away.2. Waze doesn't always get you there. It got us near but it was about 200m further up than where Waze said it would be.3. Pre-order. They do have a menu to take away at the restaurant. They run out of dishes quite early on as they make a limited amount to keep things fresh.Other than that, prepare for a great, authentic, delicious experience.

Author: HMPyROSE
Title: Disappointing
Review: Despite its promise of being an international buffet, it sadly disappoints on both quality and variety of food.  I had some serious issues with luke warm food, and unavailability of staff to advise ingredients in dishes.

Author: tonyma3008Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Piece of metal was found in food
Review: Piece of metal was found in the food. We had a baby too. We asked for a manager they say there is no manager here now. Also there is no owner. After long arguments they gave me a phone number which turned out to be unreachable. I strongly advise not to go there.

Author: farahhanisrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staffs, great service
Review: Friendly staffs, great service by Miss Azura, Miss Arlyn, Kok Seng & Miss Zuraini. Great food and great ambiance.

Author: alexsacePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Unreasonable charges
Review: I was having dinner at the restaurant more than 30 times because their foods are amazing till the very last time, as usual orders and I ordered additional JUST sweet & sour sauce, they gave us in medium bowl and charged us RM8, and I looked up the menu, the sweet & sour pork dish cost RM16. (How is it possible the sauce price as same as the MEAT!?) it's so ridiculous.. I asked the owner how can it be so expensive and it doesn't make sense at all, and he said, we specially make the sauce for u. I don't mind to pay RM4 but RM8 is toooooo much!!! Well, it will be my last visit after >30 times!!!! p/s: By the way, they don't even give a ISHHH about it because business is too GOOD!

Author: Dee-Taylor-AndersonBurlington, Canada
Title: Best Whiskey Bar Ever
Review: Best collection of whiskys I have ever seen. Spent a great evening sampling and talking whiskys, then enjoyed a great meal. The service was well above average and we had one of our best evenings in Asia there. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys a sophisticated evening sipping and sampling.

Author: CourtneyCheongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sweet is better than savory to my liking
Review: The sweet crepe is fantastic.. not so much to the savory. It has some kind of sour cream taste on the crepe that I don't really enjoy.. Staff was friendly.. Gave me a mini Eiffel towel to take picture with my crepe. Lol. Definitely worth trying!

Author: bluemant2015Gelugor, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed!!!!
Review: We are in a group of ppl.. 6 adults and children.. we are been told they are not prepare to serve us! And rejected us to seat in even we are prepare to wait! Funny thing is they still accept small group of ppl to dine in when I leaving...

Author: StephenB5288
Title: Not a kids friendly place
Review: 1 1/2 weeks ago, i had a dinner in souledout sri hartamas together with my family friends from Ukraine, i felt very disappointed because i told to my friends that this particular restaurant is a family friendly restaurant until the incident happened, i was seated in the table just in front of the bar with my kids and friends and we heard the guy(bar staff) screaming to the other staff like treating them as a moron, the guy wearing same shirt as the other but with different badge(metallic in color) he is very arrogant and disrespectful. I guess this may be the last time i will comment about your restaurant because i dont want to come back there again.its not a friendly place anymore.

Author: WallyHollandVoorburg, The Netherlands
Title: What to say? Not a great place to hang out
Review: Came here on Saturday evening around 11 pm. Approx 20 people in / outside the bar looking at their phones. One group of youngsters were having a drinking game. The band had a break after a few songs, the DJ took over. Basically no atmosphere in the bar since almost everybody was outside. After ordering a beer I watched the scenery and decided I would leave straight after the beer. Suddenly a lady turned up and started talking to me and asking questions like”where r you from.” I knew enough; time to go. Not recommended. Also the surroundings are poor. Three quarters of the development is empty.

Author: Tornbakkevej6Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very pleasant
Review: We went back for a 2nd visit to see if the quality still holds and it certainly does.Good service, wonderful sourdough pizzas served piping hot and a good, reasonable selection of wines served at the right temperature. Our red wine selection was out of stock, but we found another one which was also good.

Author: josefs486
Title: Don't do it
Review: I recommend you to eat here if you like bad service and very long waiting times for food, desserts and shisha that doesn't even taste good. you can make all the food much better by yourself on a street kitchen. This is not even worth a penny. Even the juices is like a 80% water taste...

Author: Carolcchiah
Title: one of the better ones
Review:
as a local, i find this chicken pretty good, although it has gotten smaller in size.
sometimes can be too salty. but generally still good.

Author: eohh
Title: Place to hang out with friends
Review: Its walking distance from my hotel and they have friendly staff. Too bad they close 9.30pm which is abit too early probably because of weekdays.

Author: bibibiboo
Title: Terrible Food! Terrible Service! We got food poisoning after the meal!
Review: All of the diners got vomit / diarrhea / Tummy upset after the dinner @ Yum Yum Restaurant. Food taste was NOT up to the mark and the service was horrible from both of the boss and staff.

Author: suba2350
Title: Nice, classy, reasonable price
Review: The food was nice, reasonable price, but a bit small shop where feel crowded. Overall price and service is good

Author: GregdundeeMudeford, United Kingdom
Title: Great Restaurant & Awesome Bar
Review: We first visited the junk when we originally came to Kuching for a holiday in 2011. We were very impressed - the décor is amazing, easily the most unique restaurant of this type I have ever been in. The walls are lined with various trinkets, pieces of art, antiques and much more (even a real antique dentist chair!). We now live in Kuching and go there regularly.The restaurant is a bit of a maze, but I actually mean that as a compliment, as navigating through the various rooms is interesting thanks to all the 'junk' you encounter. The entire premises seems to occupy at least two or maybe three shophouses, although its hard to figure it out exactly. There are several dining areas, a front café/bar area and a really cool bar/club in the back called Backstage. The Backstage bar features my favourite of the decorations from the entire place (red Chinese lanterns hanging from the ceiling along with a chandelier). There is a pool table, although this is often moved or covered for functions or when its time to party. There is a DJ in on Friday and Saturday nights and the place really gets busy as the evening gets later.The food at the junk is the real star - all of the massive portions are worth a go - the best of the bunch for me being the cod fish in crab meat sauce and the red wine duck. There are two vegetarian options (for main course) which are vege lasagne and vege pizza. My girlfriend almost always gets the vege lasagne and loves it!The Junk also does the best bruschetta in the world, with fresh sweet cherry tomatoes.The service can sometimes be a bit slow on nights when the restaurant or bar are busy, but I would recommend you just relax and enjoy the wait because the food is worth it. Plus there is plenty to look at whilst you are waiting.

Author: fsriana
Title: Delicious food, nice decoration
Review: Having lunch at DC comics restaurant right before entering HK town, the food is extremely delicious, specializes on western food their burger , macNcheese, pizza and spaghetti are yummy. 👍recommended when you are on the neighborhood. And the staffs are nice and friendly..

Author: Hiroshi_Kazuhiro
Title: Taste Good But Pricy
Review: Serves local cuisine such as nasi lemak, fried noodle, curry mee, asam laksa and etc. A bit pricy compared with the street hawker stalls but the environment is clean and cosy.

Author: Shaa_0211
Title: Staff attitude
Review: Hi, I have visit this restaurant few times... But the staff attitude make me feel disappoint... Really irresponsible and didn't take the order properly...that thing happen all the time when I visit to this restaurant.. But the food is very delicious.. Please take necessary action.. Thank you.
Restaurant: Vinni Jeyaa Banana Leaf Curry House

Author: KNSYC1Luang Prabang Province, Laos
Title: Quick and good response to mistake but......
Review: There was a group of 20 or so people at the restaurant when we were there. Staff seemed to pay extra attention to the group, and perhaps that's the reason for our lack-than-satisfying experience. We ordered an Angus sirloin, and two side dishes - roasted vegetables with spinach and soy-glazed Portobello. The cauliflower croquettes that came with the Angus sirloin were cold. Restaurant manager responded promptly by offering us a new plate. Unfortunately, the second plate, too, was cold. This time, the server responded quickly by bringing us a warm dish, followed by a complimentary cheesecake. The roasted vegetable and spinach didn't have spinach in it. We mentioned this to one of the staff. The server was going to do something about it but we told him it's ok. Foods were really mediocre - including breakfast - but we really appreciated the staff's effort at keeping us satisfied. Sadly, we were let down once again when we found out we were overcharged by USD$13. We don't know what went wrong with the bill as it was not explained to us. It probably has to do with the 30% discount for in-house guests that doesn't include beverages.

Author: stewartindiaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: New found respect for Japanese cuisine
Review: I've been a little wary of exploring much more than sushi to be honest apart from Nobu in London a decade ago. So this was a real eye opener. The menu is not too bewildering and we were guided through it by the staff .The most delicious sushi role followed and then an amazing foie gras and duck dish ... Which I had to ask for a knife and fork to eat and made my apologies ....It's a grand setting and quite pricey but in terms of coming to grips with a cuisine that has enormous depth and flavour this is a great place to take the plunge .

Author: sylviaw817Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and low quality of food
Review: Went abt 6.50pm for dinner by myself first as I am pregnant and was hungry. Ordered mushroom chicken rice with the waitress who repeated my order, but 15 mins later the order that arrived was chicken noodles. Not only did no one apologise for the mistake, the first waitress had the nerve to insist that I ordered the noodles. After another 20minutes the correct order arrived but it was pretty much hawker stall quality chicken rice with 3 pieces of mushrooms and the whole order (especially the soup) was cold. Appalling service and quality of food for the price paid, esp since the whole restaurant wasn't even half full.

Author: mariamam2014Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Indian, Chinese, Western and Malay Food
Review: It's one of my favourite place where can get fresh food all the time.You can get all variety foods anytime throughout the day, from South India to western foods.Prices are a bit cheaper than 7 spices and it's a good choice for those who wanted to take light meals.Few of my favourites are seafood Nasi Lemak, mamak Mee goreng, mini idli soak with your favourite curry, cow milk tea, chocolate shake and more. Price is affordable and the location of seating is quite nice n breeze especially in the evening....The only con is food served abit late.Overall I enjoy going there. If they can add north India dishes, then it would be the best place to go.

Author: monethetripper
Title: Avoid
Review: My dinner was rather unenjoyable. I chose the Nasi Lemak but it was dry and not as nice as other establishments. Plenty of other places to try instead.

Author: ArohaCMWellington
Title: Won't be returning
Review: The Apartment is part of a complex of restaurants beside the KL fountain. You can eat inside - non smoking and air conditioned, or outside - with smokers and open air. Over a week we tried four of the restaurants along the fountain side and this was the least nice and most expensive. We found the waiting staff a bit too aggressive, they hung around the table waiting for us to order and kept pushing us to order more. It wasn't nice. We were there during happy hour which featured a special on 3 beers for a special price. We ordered 2 and said we were waiting for our colleague to join us for the 3rd beer. When our friend arrived and ordered his beer they wouldn't include it in the special. We were a table of 8 people and really thought they could have added the 3rd beer (there was only a difference of 10 ringgit) When the food arrived it was okay - nothing great but not bad either. Servings were on the smallish side. We weren't impressed and will not return.

Author: Mary KShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Great ambience for dining
Review: After hearing raving review from a friend, we decided to try out the restaurant. Place was crowded on Sat night but we were quickly shown to our table despite not making any reservation. Ordered the steak, lamb chop and pasta. Didn't quite like the steak as recommended by my friend as it was well done instead of medium. Food was okay, service was prompt and friendly. Great place for celebration.

Author: LeonardoD1876
Title: Great location!
Review: The service is stellar! The staff is uniquely friendly and they even have a business van that they offer as a courtesy. The managers are wonderful and pay a lot of attention. They hire live musicians that play new and old classics on Fridays and Saturdays!
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Aidid F
Title: Nice Cheese Nan
Review: This place has the best cheese nan i ve ever tasted. Parking is a hassle but complimented by the delicious cheese nan.

Author: Robbie JJohnstone, United Kingdom
Title: Shocking
Review: This place in Citta Mall is absolutely terrible. We went in and were seated, that was as good as it got. The waiter took ages to take our orders. After a while they came back and said they had no roasted vegetables when I substituted some thing for them I was hopeful. The meal came and the order was wrong, the meat was overcooked and tough. Parts of the meal was not only wrong but some of it was missing. When I complained the waiting staff said thank you, when I tried to explain further they said thank you very much.Avoid at all costs

Author: SharmilaG8
Title: Terrible service
Review: Seemed more interested in serving foreign tourists than locals.I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. They got my order wrong after I waited an hour for my food.I was deeply disappointed after reading positive reviews.

Author: ScorchedSun
Title: No good buffet in JB
Review: Despite some review stated that this is one of the best hotel buffet, the variety of food is bad, Low quality buffet food with high price tag, BBQ item is sub par, cheap ingredients, repetitive dishes.Good for hotel guest that attend seminar or workshop kinda quality.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Soloista-SoulMale
Title: Not that exciting
Review: Good vibesThe restaurant can be quite full ... busy... food looks really good...but as wow as expected after read a lot of review...I expect a bit more...May be because my fish dish smell a bit. When they serve it ...I can smell fish right away...which Put me off a bit.

Author: Koh Z
Title: Dinner with family
Review: The food here is really delicious and the fishes is really taste good and fresh. I had a great dinner here and the service is good.

Author: meit2015Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great French Japanese restaurant in Mid Valley
Review: If I traveling to Kuala Lumpur, I usually will stay at the Mid Valley Garden Hotel. The restaurant I must visit is Sage. I order a angel hair pasta with trio seafood for my entree. My main was panfried Atlantic Seabass and my dessert was Apple filo parcel with caramel ice-cream. Truly, I enjoyed so much with all the dishes. Finally finishing up with a cup of tea and some complimentary chocolate.

Author: Rainer A
Title: A good idea to enjoy the Thai way
Review: The restaurant is open for appr one year and has not lost the quality from the beginning. Some dishes are not always available. Last time I enjoyed a Baramundi fish. Just excellent. As a starter a vegi-roll which was also very good.

Author: mfar11
Title: Old style
Review: A classic and almost a Malaysian or KL icon by right. The steaks are uniquely Coliseum and the waiters/servers are as "grumpy" as ever. Brilliant.

Author: 414tashat
Title: The worst dim sum ever
Review: I am wondering why the ratings are at the best. This is the worst place to eat for dim sum.. Dry and tasteless.. Definitely not coming back. Waste of time

Author: mfar11Malaysia
Title: Good fun, good eats, good music
Review: Its a cliche but yes, its actually a fun place to hang out. The joint in KL is livelier than most as its right in the city and its business district. So there are more "regulars" and on the weekends it, rocks. No apologies for the pun, its good fun.

Author: lechmanrTurin, Italy
Title: 1000 year old frozen cendol
Review: First of all...its nothing close to authentic Cendol (local dessert made of palm sugar n coconut milk). The cendol looked as though it was frozen for 1000 year! Secondly i find the cardboard decoration to hold the bowl is not environmentally friendly at all.Lastly...(I keep the good thing as last) the iced cold white coffee ( they called it so) is really refreshing with good coffee aroma.Thanks for the dessert though but seems to be too commercialised...

Author: Sincy TKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Impromptu Dinner visit
Review: This play caught my attention as there serve fusion food besides typical cafe menu. I came to try their signature Bistro Tang Laksa. Overall taste is good and is different from Penang Asam laksa. It taste like nyonya laksa. But the soup or gravy was too little and I have to request for additional soup which have additional charges.. cost around Rm5 (as mention by the waitress) Anyway, quite a cool place to chill during chilling weather as open concept with hanging ceiling fan (no air-con).Cool decoration with antique and recycle furnitures...

Author: Mushi88
Title: First time here! Had the famous
Review: First time here! Had the famous Penang prawn mee noodle.  Soup base and noodle  was tasty 😋 staff were very good and friendly! Recommended!

Author: Tiwari2509Singapore, Singapore
Title: Extremely Overrated
Review: We ate here for the first time after coming across food vlogs and videos of this place. However, to our extreme disappointment, this place is extremely overrated, as the title suggests.The so called “power” sotong sambal, had a large sweet taste to it. Mind you, all the recommendations mentioned that the sotong sambal was what that gives the Nasi Lemak the “kick”. Any Singaporean/Malaysian would agree that the quality of the sambal is critical to the outcome of a Nasi Lemak.Furthermore, the other side dishes such as the Ayam Merah were all very sweet too.We just couldn’t understand why the hype exists for this place. We have had much better Nasi Lemak elsewhere across Malaysia and Singapore at much better prices.Probably, the only compliment we have about the place is the variety of side dishes to choose from to complement your Nasi Lemak. Besides that, probably the friendliness and the prompt service of the staff.

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service
Review: Excellent service and food at this Japanese restaurant located in Hilton KL Sentral. Good menu and also set menus.

Author: Ingri-ingriVancouver, Canada
Title: Phenomenal
Review: This is hands down the best restaurant in Langkawi! Amazing fine dining experience with beautiful views and exquisite food. Service was impeccable and we loved the decor of the restaurant. One of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to anywhere. My favorite was the seafood paella - simply out of this world! Highly recommended!

Author: lucia19821
Title: Bad mussels that led to food poisoning
Review: We had our xmas dinner celebration at this restaurant because we were excited to try the fish/seafood. We ordered two pots of mussels as appetiser and each one of us had a fish entree as our main.When the mussels arrived, we saw that something was off and the mussels look stale. We've made a complaint to the staff but they said that is how the mussels normally look. The day after we had dinner at this restaurant, the whole family felt sick and doctor diagnosed that it is due to contamination of food/ food poisoning. We wished that the staff and chef were more honest and direct about the food served to their customers. And be more diligent about their food prep. Sadly, they are not. This restaurant is officially blacklisted and we will not go back there anymore.

Author: Ahmad A
Title: Amazing Arabian authentic food
Review: Food, staff, service, cleanliness, WiFi connection, location, decoration and atmosphere and everything was amazing and perfect there.

Author: Su76KualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Do not be fooled by the authentic ambience
Review: Though initially the place looked authentic Old traditional Malaysia coffee shop ambience but soon the cracks are seen by first getting our orders wrong, orders doesn’t arrive and all these while served by non verbal terrible zombiefied faces that look like they are not interested to serve the customers. Food is only so so compared to the other more up market authentic Malaysian coffee shop places. Beware of this overhyped place. We are local Malaysia patronising this place and there are better service places than this one.

Author: catrenacjySubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: BAD SERVICE. Will not return again
Review: 4 problems I encountered while visiting QUIVO on New Year's Eve for my boyfriend's early birthday dinner:#1: They got our order wrong but luckily they replaced it with no extra charges#2: As I made reservations a week early, they called to confirm and I asked them if I could get a complimentary birthday cake and they said "Yes we'll be happy to". Went to the restaurant and asked the waiter, he said normally they don't give but he will check. In the end, he never got back to us.#3: I was asked to make a RM50 deposit/pax for reservation since it was NYE. So I made payment immediately. However, they did not give me back my deposit on the day I went to the restaurant and I also forgot to ask them about it (but if their service was good, they would've given it back to me) #4: Called the next day to tell them about my deposit and they said usually they will deduct the amount from my total bill. But they did not. The guy said he will get back to me. It has been a day and nobody called me back.Verdict: Food was NOT BAD only. Service? Even worse. I hope QUIVO's management reads this and improve on their service.

Author: knighsSouthampton
Title: Nothing special
Review: We were very disappointed with our food. The spare ribs were not ribs at all, but over cooked pieces of fat with hidden morsels of meat.most of the food was very greasy. Check your bill as we were overcharged and also charged for things that we didn't order. They cunningly charge you for the nuts they put on the table when you order your drinks and also for the wet wipes that are on the table. I really wouldn't recommend this place.

Author: lee20122015Selangor, Malaysia
Title: It's not for everybody
Review: I dislike this place very much, but my friends' and colleagues' like it and it seems to be their default place whenever they visit Changkat. That is why I'm giving it 2 stars rather than 1. My experiences there are on after-dinner get togethers on Saturday nights and so I will comment on them. On the plus side, I think that it can suit a variety of people's tastes because it has a food and drink section downstairs and a clubbing area upstairs. You don't have to be stuck in the clubbing area if clubbing is not your thing, unless you get dragged into it by your tipsy friends! The ambience downstairs is relatively nicer than upstairs. Don't mistake the downstairs area will be a relaxing place for a catch up because the music from upstairs will get blasted at some point in the night, so you'd have to shout to the person you're talking to. I think those who are ok with Havana are:- Tolerant with inefficient and inconsistent service. The staff range from awesome to need improvement, for example in terms of the amount of times a customer must repeat their order.- Ok with drinking diluted drinks. The only undiluted things are the shots and the wine.- Ok with / a love for dancing to 80s music in the upstairs dance area that could be more crowded than the KTM and Monorail during rush hour. At one point at the dance floor, we had to make a detour because of the sheer amount of people.- Are confident with handling creepy people on a regular basis, especially on the dance floor. One of the worst I know of is when a female friend got bitten and touched inappropriately at multiple areas of her body. Overall I think it is a successful club because the place is always full on Saturday nights. The music must be good to many because the clubbing area could become very packed. But it's not for everyone. Been there about three times already, with no plans to return.

Author: PirkkoH50Helsinki, Finland
Title: Nice atmosphere and friendly
Review: Nice atmosphere and friendly staff. Our starters were outstanding but unfortunately main dishes were not at the same level.

Author: BackpackWarriorSingapore
Title: Improve on the food and drinks and it will be perfect
Review: (1)Location: Right smack in the middle of Jonker, cannot be that bad for a tourist, I guess...(2)Ambience: Cosy place to hang out with friends for a beer. Second level is air-conditioned with a view to Jonker street.(3)Crowd: Well, mostly tourist, of course...I don't see why locals would hang out at a over-croweded pasar malam over a weekend...(4)F&B: We ordered draft beers and it was good (how bad can a beer be??). Some of my friends ordered fresh coconuts and the found the coconut juice bland and very sour. The satay was an epic failure. Not that the taste was bad, but to call this satay in Malaysia is kinda weird...maybe feels more like a shashlik?(5)Service: Quite ok. They did not charge us for the coconuts that were not satisfactory. For some reason, they did not open up the air-conditioned 2nd level during the hot Saturday afternoon when I would not mind hopping in for a beer.(6)Would I go back?: Yes, but just for a beer to chill out with friends and rest my legs.

Author: Mitch131213
Title: Overpriced, long wait for steak. Better spend your money on steak elsewhere
Review: It USED to be nice. Till recently, over-priced, over cooked (owner blames it on the hot plate), and slow service. Go to the Steakhouse in Changkat Bukit Bintang if one wants to taste the best steak in KL- It is truly well worth the price.

Author: RichardLee93
Title: Next to Brannigans club
Review: Used to hang here after dance at the Brannigans just next to the restaurant. Good food good location.

Author: Shabaka13
Title: Very strong spices
Review: Nice homy place. Food was just right for us. Way too strong that we could not go beyond a first taste. If you are sure you love the type of food they offer, go for it. Otherwise i would say skip.

Author: ElaineT1935
Title: Take Away & Reservation
Review: Messaged and called to reserve food to be collected on Christmas eve by 6pm 1 week earlier and was told no deposit needed. On 24/12 at 550pm they called for collection. Reached by 6pm sharp and they haven't send the order to the kitchen. Our dinner started 1 hour later as everything delayed and the other food was left cooling with over decanting wine. No matter how awesome is their food, when the service is bad, what left is the bad memory for their customers. During the movement restrictions period, a restaurant can't survive if it cannot adapt to changes such as how to handle take away food and be punctual with timing.Their crew always say dry-aged steak available when we check with but out of stock when we were there for twice. Maybe they need a better floor manager for better arrangement.

Author: Senbagavalli MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Very Disappointed"
Review: My husband and I were totally disappointed with the quality of the food that was served. I ordered Plantain/Cooking Banana Bajji. We had to wait almost 40 mins for the 2 Bajjis in one plate with one white coconut chutney that was tasteless and a sambar.I had to HUNT for the plantain in the plantain bajji.(It was so so tiny and thin & with the skin! )The weight of the plantain was not even 5% of the weight of the plantain bajji !

Author: ykloke1Norwich
Title: Poor experience
Review: We had recently eaten at another branch (located at Pavilion) of this chain, and found that to be pretty good.Unfortunately, the food in this KLCC outlet was much poorer, both in quantity and quality. The service was also inaccurate.Examples include a red curry (duck) where we could hardly find any pieces of meat; a bland tasteless tofu dish; a clumpy uneven Pad Thai.Our (refillable) Chinese tea was never refilled contrary to what was stated in the menu.I wouldn't have felt so negative about this, except that we then received a bill that was equivalent to what we would have paid for a 5 star luxury hotel meal in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: ddfoodlover
Title: Authentic Japanese Food
Review: Wow. We were very impressed by the apparent authenticity and taste of the food at Unkaizan.

Author: WadatShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Food quality for weekend hi-tea degrades a lot
Review: Tonka Bean has been my favorite place for weekend hi-tea-hunting. Been to the place for several times, with the last visit being at the end of 2016. Went there again last weekend, and I have to say that it is a big disappointment to the food choice. Several foods have been nominated out from the buffet line. They serve no more types of fried noodles, fritters (banana, ubi, etc). I did not find any lamb but only beef. They put roasted turkey as a replace but it just taste like an ordinary chicken. Taste wise, has also degraded though not for all foods. The Malays dishes still taste good but the desserts were kinda nightmare. The cheese cake taste like you are eating the butter. Red velvet thin cake is combined with pudding to become some kind of layer cakes. Pasta and shepherd pie taste real strange (like they have accidentally put some perfume into it). And the sushi were not fresh. Hot drinks were only served in a hot flask, and not being topped up. The best highlight of the buffet is only the range of free flow Baskin Robbin ice -creams (but they have taken out the cone). With the price getting increased, and the quality degrades, no wonder there were less visitors Not even quarterly full. It used to be almost full house at one time. Tonka Bean Weekend Hi-Tea is no longer in my list. And this review is solely meant for the weekend hi-tea, as I have no idea about the other buffet offer.

Author: r0ns0nAngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Week day Dinner and breakfast
Review: I gave 3 1/2 for the dinner and 4 1/2 for the breakfast as such average is 4.Let me start with the dinner which have a decent spread but only the satay is nice. The rest are average. The noodle soup and the dessert is a great disappointment. The noodleThat cook by the chef is terrible and the ingredients use is not fresh. As a buffet dinner they serve Nescafé machine tea and coffee. Their club lounge serve better tea. As for the breakfast the spread is bigger than the dinner. Sure you will find something you like. Do check out the fresh fruit juice and other station that are outside.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: BoinkValKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Would have been better but for the staff...
Review: We loved the food - from the ability to have dim sum paired with roast duck with truffle, lion fish and HK Choy Sum was a joy. The scallop from the appetiser menu is a must; same could also be said about the porcupine bun and taro!We however found the ambiance disappointing as the wait staff decided to watch news or listen to music on their mobile device on speaker phone!

Author: Kass M
Title: One of the most terrible hotel buffets I have tried
Review: I don’t usually write reviews unless I strongly feel about the place or service. The Mill Cafe at Grand Millennium invoked such an emotion from me. It is terrible. From the lobby staff to the restaurant, people were unfriendly and didn’t seem to be liking their jobs. At least smile! You’re in the hospitality business, for crying out loud! The buffet spread does not look appetizing at all and the food looked like it was prepared from weeks back and the taste was compensated by adding more salt - that burned our tongues. I had to stop eating the maki midway through because the rice was HARD giving it a chewy texture. The steak was overcooked and adding gravy to the beef made it taste like stew. I expected more from this place since it’s located in the central shopping area of KL but boy is it disappointing! Never coming back here again. If you love your body and are conscious of your sodium intake, please do not come here.

Author: JackieS_12Lutterworth, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: Sorry - went here after reading reviews but there are better places to go. I ordered the grilled salmon fillet that arrived with a very strange taste and covered in a thick BBQ sauce with mushrooms and onions. Couldn't eat it.Great fit out and a quirky little place but large portions don't make up for poor food in my book.Maybe I just got them on a bad night.Won't be back

Author: Eddy Y
Title: Rodent and Cockroaches
Review:
Food are good but not hygienic place. You can see rats and cockroches everywher
e. Sugar cane are placed directly on floor where washing area, rats and cats are there.

Author: manis c
Title: delicious vegetarian meals
Review: this is the place to go whenever i want to have reasonably price vegetarian meals. plenty of dishes to choose from

Author: nafi2018
Title: Rude waiters and bad food
Review: We went to the outlet in ampang point. We ordered sweet and sour fish and mixed vegetables. The waiter got our order wrong and there was a mix up. When the food finally arrived again there was a mistake. We were tired and was getting late we just ate what was served because the kitchen had closed. Overall the food was over priced and service really bad. The food wasn't that good not up to the Cozy Corner former standard. The waiter was cocky and rude. I would avoid this place. My strong advise do confirm size of the fish because you may end up with an small fish which is what happened to us.

Author: Norma HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre
Review: I had heard so much about this restaurant and after several visits to Penang finally had the time to dine there. It was mediocre, and wasn't the special Italian experience I was expecting. I wonder if the chef has changed because the reviews from several of my friends were quite positive? I hope others have a better experience than mine.

Author: GuliWherePenang, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia
Title: Almost ethereal
Review: Was here for the buffets ... breakfast as well as dinner . Thus I noticed the quick changes in decor and set up . It may be minute but it was really impactful . Table setting leaves much to be desired . Staff not really engaging. Pricing wise , it is not cheap but then you get qood quality items in return .I'll begin with the Buffet breakfast -plenty of delicious , healthy , wholesome Continental, European choices -you can request for specific juices from the chefs stationed behind the juice dispenser .- there's German yogurt and flavoured water , salads , passionfruit ....for those who want to start the day completely nourished , this is a Dream buffet !- I did not like the rendang. It was too sweet for me .- there are Japanese , Chinese , Indian and Middle Eastern options Buffet dinner- please arrive early if you want raw oysters as they get snapped up SUPER FAST- again , a lot of wholesome healthy choices with good oils used- there's more meats compared to breakfast - there's a pasta station - the dessert section since it is close to Christmas now , features delightful German pastries and cakes , so that was wonderful !Never try to walk in . It was fully booked even for lunch.Best advice I can give you is to book weeks ahead .

Author: AsianFiendKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Quality Sunday Brunch
Review: The Sunday brunch in the beautifully refurbished masterpiece is heavily touted but was disappointing. There is absolutely nothing to distinguish it. Generally poor quality(less expensive dishes) are offered. The Asian section is a por reflection of the great tastes of Malaysian and Asian food -extremely disappointing. Equally bad is the behaviour of some of the guests who are determined to get their value for money (tough task). Some of the expats or foreigners may have more luck with the free flow of wine and beer @RM45 per person.

Author: Tunching218Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overated
Review: This place is always so crowded and I decided to try to see whether it lived up to my expectations. It did not ! I tried the lobak and penang laksa. The gravy was watery and there was too little gravy. The lobak was dry and not succulent enough.

Author: 13makmalaysia
Title: A place for tourists but locals shy away
Review: The variety is there but locals prefer to go elsewhere due to the lack of parking, proper service and taste. Too commercialized and the reputation is only based on historical basis, not really on the taste and prices. The building looks grand but nothing special actually. Service is also rendered by foreign employees - to be served dim sum by a Nepalese or someone from Myanmar?

Author: jonwix
Title: Tables reserved but always empty
Review: I usually come to ss15 courtyard to do my grocery shopping at village grocer. Occasionally I will drop by naj and belle for a coffee but I noticed they always reserve tables and it's always kept empty. Staffs turn down customers who would want to sit at those tables. Even after spending quite some time at the café I don't see anyone dining at those reserved tables. Makes me wonder why would keep the tables reserved if no customers have actually reserved it. Staffs don't serve with enthusiasm and no friendly vibes.

Author: aleksamiro
Title: Authentic
Review: Visited the place in desire of Korean yums. Ordered ramen and topoki and also another portion of noodles. Could be better for the price. Would recommend for one time visit. Noodles were delish

Author: Travelingankara
Title: Yum
Review: Nice breakfast buffet. A wide array of Asian inspired foods. Can get very crowded in the late morning and drinks at the smoothie bar run out towards the end of breakfast.

Author: norulhuda
Title: Nice superheroes restaurant
Review: Nice dining restaurant with superheroes characters..the beef pepperoni also delicious..will come back again 😃

Author: Menenz
Title: Nice restaurant in KLCC - next to Petronas towers
Review: Popular place on the 4th floor. had to wait for 15 minutes to be seated as place was packed. Try the fish wrapped in banana leaf which is excellent. Desserts are good. Overall good food, and worth the wait

Author: sandschd
Title: Okay food, overpriced
Review: The restaurant staff are polite and pleasant to deal with. The food itself is nice enough but nothing great. For the amount and quality of food though, it does seem overpriced. The decor is nice.

Author: SeviOtt
Title: delicious Steaks
Review: Thank you johnny, it was Great! Warmly atmosphere and friendly staff. Price is ok. Neatly from chinatown.

Author: rcarnizzah86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just Simply WELL DONE!
Review: Well, their signature dish DAGING MAUT! adoohaiii. too good lah.I was there for Buka Puasa twice in a week!Worthy and Food was great!If you in Publika and you want to have Malay cuisine, think no further! head to their's and you wont be disappointing!The owner, very friendly couple... make all worthy!

Author: cnkpCanberra
Title: Best Authentic Indian Food in KL - a "must do" experience for visitors to KL
Review: I was taken to this unassuming Indian restaurant located in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur for a business lunch. It was the best meal I experienced during my visit. The restaurant I learnt is family owned and uses fresh ingredients to create mouth watering authentic cuisine. The menu caters for both non-vegetarian and vegetarian diets with the menu including both South and North Indian styles. There is a particularly large range of delicious naan breads on the menu. The palak paneer was particularly memorable. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner it is an ideal location for a family gathering, special celebration or working lunch with colleagues.

Author: George ALondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely restaurant but ambience missing + food very hit and miss
Review: This restaurant looks everything you'd expect an upmarket Chinese Restaurant to look, a copy and paste from a style guide. Drawn in my this we were expecting more. Firstly place was empty bar a couple of other tables. Food very hit and miss, one of our starters a crispy chicken roll was amazing, but a Prawn main was round prawns the size of Golf Balls and very tough. No refinement at all. Rice that we thought we with ordering to share ( single portion), turned out to be nearly a bucket of rice, enough to feed 6 people.After mains, scraps of food were left on the table still from the Main course while the desserts were served. Very odd.Drinks ordered turned up after our started had been delivered, very slow. Strange.

Author: waytogomateSydney, Australia
Title: Overcooked food
Review: While the service was good the meat dishes were overcooked and very dry, one a chicken dish the other a prawn dish. Prawn overcooked and dry is a dish that is not enjoyable and should not happen.The cold drinks were served at room temperature - the room was warm.On a plus side, the hummus was very good, the only aspect of the meal that was enjoyable.The restaurant was busy, hopefully other diners were having a more pleasant experience.

Author: LovetotravelpjPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very poor quality food
Review: I never expect restaurant in a Hilton hotel serve such poor quality food. The crab and prawn are all not fresh. The slices of sirloin steak looked dry and unappetising. Even the pineapple at the fruit tray appeared with black spots. The only thing that is edible is the satay. The drink is also very expensive.

Author: ErickySPHong Kong, China
Title: Great lounge deck but restaurant lacks quality and service
Review: The lounge bar is great with live music, it is very small with beautiful materials which gives it an exclusive atmosphere. However the service was not great, it took a long time for drinks to arrive and our peanuts never arrived. The restaurant’s interior is very stylish, looks really good. But the food has not enough quality to justify these prices. We chose the discovery menu with 7 courses or so including wine pairing. The foi gras on one of the courses did not look and taste like it. The duck was not well cooked. Every course we had a new waiter of which some were difficult to understand their English. The wine was good, but the food is not worth while. I understand people go there to have a drink but not stay for dinner (as our neighbors did). Disappointing despite the beautiful building and location.

Author: pengchiew
Title: to avoid
Review: Service beyond terrible. also found flies buzzing all over the bread. the staff were indifferent to my complaint

Author: Balitime2020
Title: Beautiful location
Review: Recently had lunch at Aqua Restaurant, and did enjoy the food, The location is lovely, but the service was a little slow, though friendly, and admittedly they were quite busy. It is a little pricey, compared to other places in Kuala Lumpur, but probably what you would expect at such an iconic 5 star hotel.I would recommend, but definitely book ahead.

Author: KL_SueLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Underwhelming in many ways
Review: The positives - the food was very tasty, nicely presented and reasonably priced. The negatives - many! We had a reservation and yet we were initially seating along a bench facing the window (a little like a bar seat). The window was filthy and the seating arrangement made it impossible to have a conversation with my partner as we were seated side by side (rather than opposite each other). There was a couple next to us with about a 20 cm gap which was crazy as it was impossible to have a private conversation. The view from the window was over a building site. To get the view that is in all the photos on the website you need to go to their sister restaurant Fuego. The layout of the restaurant was severely compromised - it didn't matter which table you were seated at you always had a waiter tying to squeeze past as the space is very narrow.

Author: JaySeeva
Title: Expensive and Coercive Selling
Review: We were there with family of 8 on X'mas eve and the waitress was forcing us to take the full meal course when we were there to enjoy lights meals and drinks only. The price was exhorbitant for a not so posh eatery. Live 2 piece band was not entertaining and truly disappointed with the environment.Will never go back neither will recommend to others.

Author: Ulun64
Title: Can't find the Assam and Pedas.
Review: I ordered the Assam Pedas fish and it's was a total disappointment. The hot and sour fish is savory at all. It's totally bland. Maybe next trip I will try the restaurant opposite of them.

Author: Joel0l0l0l0l0l0lPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Customer Service at Salsas Gurney Paragon. Total contrast from Salsas Hotel Continental
Review: We had a good impression of the food & customer service at Salsas Hotel Continental which we had visited a couple of times. It was unfortunately a very unpleasant first time visit to Salsas Paragon Penang. The attitude of the supervisor & the staff at Salsas Gurney Paragon was one of the worst we encountered thus far. They were very impolite & were very reluctant to seat us though there were empty tables with the excuse that they were too busy to clear the tables. We were indirectly shooed away from the restaurant.

Author: yuva906
Title: Cozy Place
Review: Went for a lunch as a couple. We tried their petai burger, nasi Jersey and red velvet cake. Tasted good.Price of the food is a bit expensive. All the staff were welcoming and friendly.Definitely worth a visit.

Author: Eddie900310
Title: Kuching Food Hunt
Review: Porridge and Kuey Chap at Lau Ya Keng Carpenter Street Kuching is very delicious. Love it so much. Yum！Yum！

Author: Sarah D
Title: AMAZING!!!!!
Review: I don't know where to start, this place blew my mind! The staff and service was exceptional , very attentive. Opened every door for me, including the bathroom then raced me back to the table to pull out my seat! My partner and I chose the 5 course degustation and we weren't disappointed, all dishes where delicious and we didn't have to wait very long, not to mention the never ending supply of bread selections. Although pricey, the experience is well worth it. We were lucky enough to have a window seat, the view is amazing! Great photo opportunity of the twin towers. When we thought the meal was complete and were about to leave, thenstaff brought out a complimentary dessert, followed by a big bowl of cotton candy.. then to top it off we got to pick some chocolates to accompany the plate we received with a personal chocolate message. We couldn't believe it, it was above and beyond our expectations. Will definitely be back!!!!!

Author: Y3661HXvictorv
Title: Unbelievably slow
Review: If you can't wait 45 minutes for a simple kolok mi, don't go. Came 3 persons, we ordered kolok mi, and have to wait 45 minutes for the order to come. Picture below is the kolok mi.

Author: Wong2080Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Low food quality, poor hygiene.
Review: This is an Open Terrace Restaurant without Aircond.Hence the tables are dusty and the wind is strong.The place is full of Flies hovering over your food and drinks. They should instal Insect Killing Lights and Waiters should wipe the dusty Tables + Chairs. The Sizzling Lamb is burnt black at all corners and the Naan is cold and not crispy. The worst is the Ice Kacang which have very few Red Beans, any Street Stall Ice Kacang taste better than them.This place is more for Beers + Liquors, need to improve on their Food Quality.

Author: kai-elsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rustic, Nice Atmosphere, Friendly Staff
Review: A slice of history comes alive when you visit this cafe located at Jalan Tukang Besi. This street is named thanks to former metal traders who ply their trade at the particular place. The moment you walk into the cafe, you can see reclaimed wooden tables adorned with antiquated metalwork and also antique dining tables and chairs. At first sight, it may look like a typical hipster cafe, but once you have settled in, it offers nothing but comfort to you. I liked their staff, and they were very friendly. One of the must-try when you visit this cafe is their lemongrass and pandan (screwpine leaves) drink. Of course, without a doubt coffee was aromatic and has a pleasant aftertaste. The food items that we tried were the Malacca Elvis pancakes and Kaya and Cheese Toast. Although there was nothing to shout about for the pancakes, I felt that the cafe was brave enough to take a plunge for the toast - adding a slice of cheese on toast and drizzled it with fragrant kaya. A very courageous move, I'd say.Another interesting fact about this cafe is their artwork that adorned one of the walls in the courtyard. There is a two-storey wall mural which tells the story of how the cafe got its name. In Zulu, “kaya” means “home”, while in Turkish, it means “stone”, which is appropriate for this cafe as it has a lot of exposed brick walls. I would say that this is a pleasant cafe to visit and do drop by if you get the chance. You will not be disappointed for sure.

Author: RichardU71
Title: Great service and good vibe
Review: A very happy and cool place. Good vibe and rhythm, very good service. Good wine list and the food is absolutely fine.

Author: alfredfangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dim sum breakfast
Review: We went quite early at 9am on a Monday, and it was already quite full. The dim sum items are not bad for the affordable price range. There's no menu here, and the wait staff will carry trays of food items for you to choose from. Tea is self-refillable too. It's a no-frill place for good dim sum if you're in the mood.

Author: KKlowPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Tasteless food !
Review: I am writing this review in Bedouin because I just had the worst most expensive turkish dinner at Turkish Cafe Istanbul behind. It is fine if the food serving is small and expensive if it taste great. But its the opposite, the food here does not taste near to any middle eastern food of the same kind i have had fromLebanon. The funniest thing is my wife and myself bumped into the same couple we saw at Turkish Cafe Istanbul earlier when we werenin Bedouin. Go to Bedouin which is only a stone throw away if you ate in for middle Eastern cuisine, by far the best around aside if you are not planning to travel downtown.

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good but not Great
Review: We went for breakfast and got there just before the queue started and shared a large table with two other groups (3 girls and a family of 4).Food was fine but not outstandingly so - - I had poached eggs on toast and the Mrs the special muesli. We'd rate it as a reasonable western style cafe.Nice coffee but I'd prefer mine to be on the hot rather than tepid side.

Author: HaddyTaY
Title: Will not back again
Review: The staffs are rude and very impatient.  The nyoya foods taste average.  The food served quite fast, and seem it pre-prepared.  Food came in small portion, but enough for us (2 adults and 2 children).

Author: Tini201405
Title: Good taste at affordable price :)
Review: It's a located in a food court. You have to order drinks from different booth & the cleanliness around the eating area can be improved.

Author: shirleys595
Title: Family Dinner-Disapointed
Review: Buffet style @ RM49.90 per person. The meat were all razor thin slices & not marinated. You have to grill all these on your own within a 100min time limit at the table to cook and eat. If you can't finished your food by 100 mins, You can buy time as they call it at the cost of $9.90 per min. Water is not free, Rm3 per a small jar. Total bills add 10% Service Charge & 6% GST For such food & pricing I think there are other better option out there.

Author: Crisper1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Shame about a few things...
