Review: Atmosphere was great! It was busy and lively with a good crowd. Menu was good. Food prices are acceptable, because the quality is good. Wine prices are unreasonable. Service was not good enough for a restaurant of this standard (blonde headed waiter with glasses). We ordered wine which was too expensive and then had to refill our own glasses. Waiter never asked how the food was and he left us with the same cutlery from starter to dessert. He never offered cracked pepper, but other tables were offered. We had two white pepper shakers on our table...no salt! All food was awesome, except the sea bass pasta special...was very bland and both tables either side of us said the same...but the waiter never asked! Waiter brought the bill without even asking if we wanted anything else or how was our meal. It was a bit disappointing considering we have been wanting to visit this restaurant for the last 6 months.

Author: sunnykaren78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Top Notch food, service and ambience
Review: Yun House is definitely one of the most notable Chinese restaurant you can find in Kuala Lumpur. You will be surprised with the vast selection of dim sum and Chinese menu selection. Pricing is definitely reasonable for the quality and service. Highly mentioned on their server who is meticulous on details and gives good recommendation, Tan and Darren. In fact all staffs shown their passion greatly. Looking forward for next visit!

Author: DrDavid2012Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Junk...not really!
Review: The Junk is in an old part of Kuching, lse to the riverfront. The food is very good and varied, and there is a dim musty ambience with art and bric a brac around which makes it a bit mystical. Beer and wine selection is good, but the dining areas are cramped, the stairs upstairs are steep and narrow, and the furniture in the back by the bar is just too low and uncomfortable. Good food, ambiant, but a bit of a pain somehow. Service is average. sometimes you have to hunt for waitstaff. Other times it's ok.

Author: sitihajarmadinaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I love it
Review: The one I went to was the one in citta mall. Been there five times and there was no problem on getting tables. The food is great, and the boss always provide us with free side dish like new menus for testing. I'm not familiar with Korean food but if the food at this restaurant is anywhere near the authentic dakgalbi in Korea than I'd say Korean food is super good!

Author: CenturyCorp
Title: Not impressed
Review: Went to try due to the very high rating but came out disappointed with a dry and tasteless pizza. Service is ok and place is clean.

Author: ecossegeoJakarta
Title: Read the menu, twice
Review: Popped in for happy hour.Don't get conned.Read the menu, then read it again.End of the day so many other places nearbye.Don't get stung.Staff have a complacent attitude, however the Manager was more responsive to my query.Either way, lots to choose from in the area.Read the menu!!

Author: Zain P
Title: Capati Lunch
Review: A capati Lunch with some office mates .As usual the restaurant is always brimming with customers from 12 noon to 2 pm.The freshest and wholesome capatis you can get in KL , if you're ok with a bit of curry odour on your shirt !Great variety of side dishes...from vegetables , beans , legumes to muttin kimma ,curries and dhall. There's also the afternoon tea snacks of curry puffs , samosa and the likes ..It was a vegetarian day for me with the capati finishing the meal with a Tea with fresh cow's milk...Wow ! Enjoy

Author: Mona DPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unique experience
Review: Suprised my husband on valentines day- it was a really fun experience especially as it was our first time here. The waiters were very friendly and explained the itenary for the night, giving instructions every step of the way. Special thanks to mr radha who served us- excellent job! We had a suprise menu and it was fun to try and guess what we were eating for each course. For me the desert was the best tasting, the other courses was okay. U can just eat with your eyes closed since its totally pitch black in the restaurant! I recommend every one to try it out at least once, provided you are sporting enough and not claustrophobic

Author: dexter1881Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre menu and something has gone wrong?
Review: Fancy dining setting and nice open kitchen concept. No Italian music, no Neapolitan songs, exchanged with groovy upbeat lounge music. Stone oven baked bread + pesto were the nicest touch, but all other subsequent dishes were rather medicore. Could you imagine a simple antipasti platter was priced at RM150++ a pop? Much better offerings are out there in the vicinity of Bukit Bintang, and for me, Prego has seen better days.

Author: MichelleABWBern, Switzerland
Title: Waited for hours!!!!!
Review: The menue looks delicious but you will wait hours just to even get the menue card. Then you wait hours that a waiter will come that you can order & than you wait again hours untill the food is coming. I won‘t come again here!!It was also a pitty that you can‘t eat Acai Bowl on weekends. But this was nowhere written on the menue. So when you choose Acai Bowl on weekends the waiter will say you that you have to choose something else.So when you‘re hungry don‘t go here - you will wait at least an hour untill the food is coming.But the food is good.

Author: rainybaxx36
Title: In love!!!
Review: Ohhh. This is love at first bite! I really highly recommend their espresso chicken chop and matcha creme brulee! Located right at Love Lane, Wheeler's Coffee 😍😍😍

Author: kkview
Title: Affordable
Review: About 10 minutes walk from Suria KLCC, this place is huge. It is a kind of Indian/Muslim food which have many choices. Roti canai, thosai, biryani, nasi kandar…..It is a 24-hour open air establishment with many tables. Ideal for a quick meal. Imagine a kopitiam in a very big scale. It is always packed. Do not expect service. Server will come to take your order. Just order – eat – pay. Simple as that.We had roti canai. Not the best but acceptable. Washed down with a hot cup of teh-o - that was our breakfast. Simple and affordable.

Author: Sammyboy95
Title: Good burger and fish
Review: we went here for lunch today and ordered a pork burger and kapitan fish. The burger was juicy and patty was thick. Kapitan fish was excellent! it was really fresh one plate of rice wasn't enough. And the portion was very generous enough for 2

Author: Jwtm25Cheras, Malaysia
Title: Never again on a long public holiday!
Review: Went there today on the 5th day of Chinese New Year. Parking was a hassle. Cars flocked roads around the restaurant causing massive jams and many frustrated drivers.Then when I managed to get one which was around 400m away, went to the restaurant which was jam packed with people. It was like 10 tourist buses just arrived! Every table had people crowding round waiting for the seated to finish (if you're eating, you'd be pressured unless you can clear your freaking mind as to no one was around!) and get the hell out of there. Worst still, no proper system leaving many frustrated customers.Yeah, I know it's cny but could these freaking restaurants at least have a proper system for the people waiting? Imagine standing in the middle of a war zone with staff and customers carrying hot tea, food and beverages zooming here and there. Worst still, you're standing around with your 6 yr old kid! In the end, I left as I'm not in the liberty to wait as my 6 yr old was darn hungry and seeing every table had at least 2-3 people standing and breathing down on those eating. Such a famous place but arrogant enough to not put any proper system for people to wait in order (don't need a genius to teach how to do it!). I'd never recommend this place to anyone due to their sheer arrogance.FYI, this is not my first time there but the first time I didn't get to eat! But a gentle reminder that one can get better dim sum anywhere according to most locals! I was only thinking of my 4 mth old as it was a better environment dim sum restaurant that I know of in Ipoh but boy was I wrong!

Author: 873jonask
Title: Great food and service
Review: A colleague and I visited the Horizon Grill, and found the level of service and the quality of the food very high. A special thanks to our waitress Niza for the high service level making the evening even more memorable.

Author: Anthony1031
Title: Guinness
Review: Were two Irish lads looking for their fill of Guinness, here we found Guinness on tap, Guinness was delicious. Guinness
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: versaseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ruined my wife's birthday dinner!
Review: Rude service. Lazy service. Name all the bad you got it here. I called to make reservations. The lady was seriously rude on phone. Thought it was just on the phone. When we arrived there it was even worst. It was my wife's birthday dinner. Biggest mistake. Food is also rubish! Sushi king has better service and food!

Author: kajambeCanberra, Australia
Title: Great service, food so-so
Review: Unlike others we had no complaints on the service here, we arrived around 9pm on a Sunday night, our waiter was friendly and smiled, our orders were taken promptly and the meals appeared all together (sometimes a challenge in Malaysia!) quite quickly. Unfortunately the food wasn't great for us - not inedible, but the curries and laksa were all quite sweet, which overwhelmed the other flavours. But they get points for service and the ambience which was lovely.

Author: bdsmythSingapore, Singapore
Title: Looks arent everything
Review: We went to TWG to take a break and have some tea and cake. The service was exceptional slow, the tea as always was fantastic. However the cakes were a complete and utter disappointment, nothing more than flavored gelatine. While they may look tempting, looks arent everything. Terrible cakes, really terrible, just stop serving them please. Never again!!

Author: capsicum0620Thailand
Title: Location...
Review: ..is all that matters. Well, at Sid's, the service is also excellent: courteous and swift.As in any Malaysian bar geared at tourists and expats, the beer is outrageously expensive, and the selection offered quite depressing. Malaysia is NOT a place for beer lovers.This being an English pub, we did not order any food. What was served at the table next to ours comforted us in our opinion.

Author: JaspreetBhatiaRaipur, India
Title: FOODY'S PARADISE
Review: This is the place to be in KL if you are a foody and you love to explore cuisines. A street in bukit bintang which comes alive in the night with scores of food stalls serving a variety of Chinese, Thai and Malay dishes on the road side. You can also find some live music performances on the street which makes this even more delightful. Adorned with red chinese lights in a criss cross manner over the road and multicolored chairs and food stall lined on both sides of a sloping road, its a picture perfect place for street food lovers. Its not a place if you are very fussy about cleanliness , but it is generally very clean.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: Gmailangie
Title: Food
Review: We went with a group of seven.We ordered a rare medium mixed grill, a sizzling beef steak. The meat were all overdone n the beef was so chewy. Service was good though but the disappointment with the overdone meat was very difficult to take. The rest of the good was mediocre. Not worth the money nor the time to have a gathering there.

Author: PeterHoo54West Midlands, United Kingdom
Title: One of our favourite places to eat
Review: We have eaten here many times, so we know the staff well, and they are always friendly and attentive. The food is always very good, and if you are here after 9pm on some nights the staff perform a dance routine which is worth waiting for.

Author: Stef W
Title: Great sandwich
Review: Very chilled out cafe not close to Love Lane.. best sandwiches in the area and fresh juices.  Highly recommend..........

Author: r15xeb
Title: Poor quality food, hugely overpriced.
Review: Average food quite often poorly implemented (very oily). Staff are friendly but the prices are unrealsitic for what is a cafe - try Little Penang Cafe just below for a much better experience.

Author: LynKinnVientiane, Laos
Title: Don’t believe the hype!
Review: Came here last night for dinner. This is cheap food for backpackers. Ordered Lamb & Chicken Biryani along with Garlic Roti. Both of the Biryani’s were from the hot table but were only lukewarm. Same with the vegetables that came with the meal. The curry was barely spicy. Only the Roti was made to order and the sides with it were good. If your looking for good Indian food try somewhere else..

Author: Syahid S
Title: Dinner with my love
Review: This is my second time having a dinner here. We had a mushroom soup for our starter,lamb rack and sirloin steak for the main course and cramebrulee as our desert, i highly recommend this restoran for those who want a quality food with reasonable price. The service also very good with friendly manager..

Author: Steffaniwardana14
Title: Great view with great hospitality
Review: Such had a great Christmas gathering with Vertigo Banyan tree, nice view and affordable place. I like the hospitality especially Mr Janeer the one who was treating us well, helpful and friendly.

Author: millieWa
Title: Breakfast
Review: Had a good breakfast with the highlight the juices. The owner has a good selection of smoothies also including non dairy options! I enjoyed eggs benedict also. Clean, western style cafe. Has wifi.

Author: 133Dave
Title: Pretty Average Food
Review: Not great dim Sum by any standard. Pretty average quality but catering for low budget customers. I went there because it was near my hotel but once is enough. I will try elsewhere for better quality chinese food.

Author: Snoopy S
Title: Dec 2017 Family Trip to Malacca
Review: The restaurant served good food but the service is not to standard. Waiting time for lunch is about 1.5-2hr. Very slow in service.Very unfriendly staff at the front counter (waiting to get seat). I could say the price is not cheap. Went once and will not patronize again. Anyway, good to try for the first time.

Author: tpeipingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just ok...
Review: We had our wedding anniversary dinner here. Service is so-so, and food is ok, not bad, not great either. I would prefer Sassorosso or Cilantro which has much better food and more attentive and pleasant service.

Author: AnnieO844
Title: Awful service
Review: The food was good but this place is severely let down by its service. Two people on our table had ordered the same main and the waiter had assumed that they wanted to order one meal and split it between themselves, which was a strange assumption to make. When the waiter only produced one main, he said he would bring another, which was served at a reasonable time but the meal was already ruined as two of us were eating off of bread plates which the waiter separated the meal between! The salt shaker on our table was loosely screwed and opened on one of our meals, leaving it covered in salt. Numerous waiters saw this but did not want to come over as it seems they could not be bothered; when a waiter finally came over, he asked whether we wanted a replacement meal - did he expect the diner to eat a meal covered entirely in salt? We waited ages for a replacement. When we got the bill, I didn't think they would charge for the main they had messed up, but they did anyhow. The service here was absolutely atrocious and should not be associated with the Mandarin Oriental at all.

Author: kisstherainSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience, average food.
Review: The decor theme is retro photography with some photo worthy corners. We had toufu burger, deep fried oyster mushrooms and Hawaiian pizza. The burger is not bad. Nice flavour. The fries that came with the burger were tasty because you can taste real potatoes in the middle. The oyster mushrooms were a disappointment to us because the batter had cumin seeds. We didn't like that. If you are fine with the smell of cumin seeds, this will probably like this dish as the oysters were fried till very crispy. This pizza was thin crust. Could do with more pineapple.

Author: YoniG_12Singapore, Singapore
Title: OK place close to Legoland
Review: It's not the best value in JB, but compared to the gouging at the Legoland resort area, this restaurant delivers relatively good food ~10 mins drive from the hotel.I felt some of the flavors were muted - some dishes didn't taste like in a proper wok stir fry/sze char kitchen - but the salted egg yolk crab was real nice, our fresh sea bass was cooked well, and the hot plate tofu had surprisingly complex flavors and textures. We also really liked the sugarcane with water chestnut drink. Service was great, but there were flies all over the table despite the staff's best efforts.

Author: anshuman mKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the Best Place to Hangout at KL
Review: If you are looking for a good crowd with awesome music, Havana is the place to be. It has two sections, the ground floor is the sitting area which gives you a relaxed and chill out atmosphere. Once you go to the first floor, its a pub with a full fleshed Dance floor. The service is fast and drink options are also good.

Author: haveaplanCasino, Australia
Title: Poor service
Review: Stayed at the hotel and decided to have an early dinner, the service was terrible, we were the only people there and no one seemed interested in serving us at all, I only got half of what I ordered and my friends meal was bland.

Author: PravinKumarKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: Waited for quite some time as the place was crowded (which was not a problem at all). Nice environment and with friendly staffs. Drinks were good. Food on the other hand is overrated, it was rather taste less. Wouldn't recommend to have your dinner over here, as it would be nice to hang out.

Title: Ala Carte Japanese Buffet
Review: Had their lunch buffet, the food is good and worth the price. Loved the sashimi slices (Tuna, Salmon, Butterfish) and the teppayaki items. The menu is quite extensive, didn't manage to try everyone of it. Staffs are quite attentive and friendly, although the place was quite pack when we visited. To avoid disappointment, book early (especially if you are visiting during weekend). Not far from the MRT Bukit Bintang station.

Author: TheangMingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad Service Bad Attitude
Review: Xin Cuisine at Concorde Hotel KL used to be a dining place that I highly recommended to anyone looking for nice food with nice environment. But after our dining experience on last night, I am not really sure about it anymore.We were having steamboat in the Cuisine tonight as the restaurant is having ‘Chiak Beh Liao’ offer starting January 2018 with the good price of RM60 nett per person.The booking was made two weeks ago,talked to one of the staffs in the restaurant and the staff that attended to us that night was polite, explained to us about the offer and told us the offer of RM60 nett is definitely value for money and the set will sure be a satisfying one for everyone.There we were, whole family ,in the Cuisine looking forward to enjoy this good offer. To our disappointment,the service was so lousy last night .The staff were rude and the attitude was terrible. The soup took a long time to come and when soup was ready, the staffs poured most of the dishes into the soup without asking us and when we asked them to stop so that we can at least start eating some first, they were unhappy. We tried to ignore their bad attitude and told them we would do the rest ourselves. Unhappily they walked away.To our further disappointment, when we asked for the bill,we were charged RM80 nett per person. When we asked why were we being charged more, the captain just answered RM80 nett is the price with a very rude expression. One of my nephews settled the bill. But we felt cheated. The other nephew checked the website and the price clearly stated RM60 nett with no hidden charges. (The price stated on the website is still RM60 nett at time of this writing).We went back to the restaurant, shown them the website, they avoided us!However, after we insisted to talk to the manager only they started to realize their mistakes and tried explaining and apologizing. Finally, they admitted it was their mistake and agreed to refund the RM20 and charged us the correct price of RM60 nett.With this review, I hope the unpleasant experience that we had last night will not happen to other guests. With this, I also surely hope , the management will do something to make things better , at least trained the staff to be more polite and friendly. We have no complaint on the food but the service was just unacceptable.

Author: firey2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service from the waitress
Review: This is the 3rd time I've visited the place and so far its all good. However, on the fourth visit which is on 24th December around 2-3pm, there is this specific young Chinese lady waitress that was serving my table, after the food were arrived, she kept asking us whether she can keep our plates even before we finished the food. This is not acceptable for such a reputable table. She asked and asked again until she have successfully ruined my mood and I left the restaurant left the food unfinished. I will never come back to this restaurant if this kind of services still persist and I will never recommend anyone coming here.

Author: GourmandVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent Italian fare
Review: Sitting near the noisy indoor water fountain was a bit strange, so ambience was not ideal. The fritto misto was a bit oily, small portion and the 4 cheeses pizza was standard. The orecchiette was tasty. A bit pricey. Slow but friendly customer service.

Author: shaun517Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Diluted Sarawak Laksa
Review: Attracted by some of the good reviews in TripAdvisor. I thought I should give this restaurant a try since it is close to my hotel. However the dinning experience there was bad. I went to the restaurant about 9:15pm after a long hour flight to Kuching. I ordered a legacy Sarawak laksa, and guest what? I have to wait almost 30 minutes to be served. The supposed thick flavored Sarawak laksa was tasteless. The gravy seems being diluted. Most probably it is close to the end of the day and they ran out of gravy to serve? Very disappointed.

Author: AnnetteIncePlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: During our stay at Casa del Mar we ate in the La Sal restaurant for five dinners and two lunches. Four of the dinners were part of our package and each one was a wonderful occasion. There was an excellent choice on the menu offering local and international dishes. The food was well prepared and cooked to perfection. The portions were very generous, especially the Beef Rendang.A special mention must be made to the the waiting staff who were always very attentive and provided and excellent level of service.Finally, a mention for the bar staff at the poolside cocktail bar. These guys worked their socks of to provide excellent refreshments and an amazing range of cocktails. Thank you to Bobby, Sparky, Kree, Mood, Anzian and the others we have forgot to mention. You all made it a wonderful holiday for us both.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: CarmenJJMalaysia
Title: Disappointment
Review: Terrible is the only word i can use to describe my feeling towards foh shan. I used to visit this shop before it was even moved here. But nowadays i can only say there no longer are any standards for this shop. Poor choices of food, horribke taste, terrible service. Many in KL probably serves better dim sun than them..

Author: Ronan Ray FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Condescending and Rude Management
Review: While the service staff were helpful and nice, the owner/manager is rude and condescending. She probably shouts or embarrass her staff all the time that she forgets and extends this attitude to a paying customer. Next time a customer has difficulty opening the toilet door, there is no need to shout and be condescending. The food wasn't too great as well. It is overpriced for a kiddie-sized meal.

Author: Jaxx86Gillingham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely place for food and drinks
Review: We had dinner here- the Mango Thai Chicken and the Jonkers Fried Rice, with a jug of beer for 110MYR (about £20), which was really good value. The food was delicious and there was a large selection of dishes and drinks on the menu. We returned the following day for a mid-afternoon snack of some satay, which was also great. I would recommend the Geographer's Cafe as a really nice, lively place to eat or just for drinks.

Author: Sproble
Title: Don't be fooled by the reviews
Review: If you review this place you get a free desert, and that's the only reason for the good reviews. The food is not great, and neither is the service.

Author: Hasel M
Title: nice bread
Review: the loaf pastries are delicious especially their tarts .. they do sell evening tea with scones and cakes.

Author: LSD213
Title: Tranquil Chulia Corner
Review: A great Western-style cafe, even if just to escape the humidity or wanting to get your online activities done. Small but scrumptious menu (the chicken-avo wrap was killer!) with great coffee. Kudos to Daniel, the owner.

Author: Rasyeqa H
Title: Parents 43rd Anniversary Lunch
Review: Elite ambiance. Loving great team (ieka,Saifullah,Marvin, Dhanen, Senthil, zainab, jacinta, ashveen, sufi, wani)
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: PatrickngiapSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner with my Penang relatives
Review: On 3rd January 2020, I invited my Penang relatives to dinner at Cheang Kee in Chulia St, Georgetown. It’s a 7 months old small cafe restaurant located in an old shop house, minimally but nicely done up with its original brickworks deliberately exposed. The food was reasonably good especially the lobster hotpot which is good for 3 pax with accompanying meatballs, fish and pork slices and vegetables. Soup stock was rich and flavorful. We were given a choice of having the lobster flesh fried with butter and the lobster head and shell used for the hotpot stock. We also had their Penang prawn noodles which was good. Overall we had a satisfying meal

Author: hsalem2019
Title: Still the same as the first branch
Review: after testing the first branch we found out they have another branch so we tried the food , its as the chef is one , really consistent and the food amazing

Author: Awesometrave12
Title: Food
Review: Too much of praises on the food. Went with certain expectation however, was greatly disappointed. Prices are higher than other restaurant. Possibly due to the signature name.

Author: YangyennnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Misrepresentation
Review: Ordered oyster omelette, baby KAI lan, sotong with ginger and red snapper. The food was tasty and cheap, but they served a sea bass instead. Didn’t want to change the fish so we continue to eat. They insisted it was a snapper when billing but u can still see the sea bass head on the plate!

Author: aralin
Title: Very salty dim sum
Review: The Dim sum used to be excellent but recently the dishes come out  way too salty. Such a disappointment. Food that is undersalted can be improved but oversalted food is hard to enjoy.

Author: LukeCao
Title: Bad service, average taste
Review: No smile at all, seems cant wait to leave work. The food is just ok,  nothing special. Durian ice cream is too greasy and 24 RM for each prawn is not worth at all.

Author: romzi2015
Title: great foodchoices but could improve on food safety
Review: Foodchoices is excellent but average taste, and food safety should be given more priority. Food sometimes are not covered and  attract flies.

Author: WilliamW2183
Title: Nostalgic
Review: This restaurant give me an impression of a old school type of restaurant but after this visit, I'm so awe and impressed that the building has gone through some renovation works....Upper floor was the Marco Polo Chinese Restaurant that offer some really superb good food.

Author: KylieACSydney, Australia
Title: Very disappointing Valentine’s
Review: Very disappointing Valentine’s Day dinner. We were not told at time of booking but arrived to find a set menu. Disappointed to find none of the specialty dishes we had lived in prior visits. We ordered an entree and main each and (seeing others patrons being rushed) asked 3 times for a break of 30 mins between courses only to have the main come while we were still eating entree! The main was NZ lamb cutlets and definitely the cheapest most gristly we’ve had in any restaurant. Following quick delivery of both mains no wait staff couple be found to order dessert or drinks. Other patrons near us were also getting very frustrated. We walked downstairs to pay and found all the wait staff chatting in a corner downstairs. To top it off they lost our umbrellas and we waited over 20 minutes outside the restaurant while they casually looked for them. Disappointing food and service and sad to see Manja clearly being greedy for margins on Valentine’s Day. Used to be one of our favourites but we won’t be back.

Author: Qirooma
Title: Birthday celebration with unique experience
Review: Unique experience. Dining in complete darkness. Food was so delicious. Yus who guided us inside the dining area, gave us the confidence that we are doing fine.

Author: Endlesssummer73Livorno, Italy
Title: Good burgers but staff needs to improve
Review: To be fair, we had very good recommendations on this outlet and we were not disappointed. The burger menu is quite wide and the ones we had were very tasty, bit unhealthy probably, but who cares when you go for burgers.The only aspect to work on is the service, I don't like to be proposed several times to clear my plate when my partner is still half way on his burger. Anyway, burgers are great

Author: seanpg1234
Title: Dark cherry pie
Review: Looks nice. Tastes average. Below expectations. Outlet is comfortable, just nice. Limited choices of main entrees. Impressive display of pastries and desserts.

Author: angweina
Title: Very expensive! Ripped off !
Review: A place where we used to frequent. Today was a shock to us. 6 of us for a total of Rm306 at a place 20km from KL......3 supposedly big crabs cost RM126, 5 supposedly big prawns at RM50, vegetables ( plain garlic potato leaves) at RM16 ; oyster omelette at RM26; 3 grilled at squids Rm24....it lost its sanity on father's day today to rip us and lost us for sure.

Author: Seth BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Over-rated
Review: The location on the beach is excellent, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The food, though, is something of disappointment. It's reputation, and the price, suggested that we would have our best meal on the island there but the food did not compare with other restaurants in terms of quality of flavour. My tuna tartare was very tasty indeed but the other dishes felt 'safe' and didn't have strong flavours. If you want a beautiful location for dinner then this is the place to go but there are better places to eat on the island.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Wong2080Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: " Proceed with Caution ... "
Review: Proceed only if you can Accept these :1. Ordered Grill Lamb slice but it was served Cold ... how could hot Grilled Lamb become cold ?? Answer is becos the plate was chilling cold, all experienced Chef in upmarket restaurants + 5 star hotels will know that the cold plate must be heated up to receive the hot Lamb ... that's QUALITY SERVICE2. Ordered Hot Apple Pie but was served Cold Apple Pie despite several Reminders to the Waiter that it must be served Hot, have to send back for reheating.3. Given a small round Table that flips over when you rest your hands on it !!! This is Incredible !!!4. There are 5 Waiters running around but none bother to check on Guests service, you have to chase after them for service as waving both hands plus a napkin may not work.5. Hate going to restaurants where there are no Supervisors, Managers or Owner managing the outlet as all Complaints / Requests/ Suggestions will fall on Deaf Ears as the place runs on Auto Pilot and nobody cares as nobody is in Charge.6. There is no Wifi in such a classy place inside a 5 star Hotel ... stingy on wrong things7. Its a pity a nice and cosy restaurant like this is run like a Canteen.

Author: Prasad P
Title: Disappointment
Review: Had takeaway from Sagar last night via Grab. The food was less than expected. The mutton was stringy and tasteless (tasted like pre-cooked meat with gravy added) The Chicken order was wrong and equally sub-standard. The breads were chewy.

Author: Crystal CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor services
Review: The food and environment definitely are attractive. But the services are poor. The design of the restaurant is very nice and this makes us wanted to take picture of the place, but the staffs will keep looking at us and give us a signal that we were not allowed to take picture. The did not allow us to move a chair when we wanted to take a picture. P/s: the rose room was not occupied, we only took pictures in the rose room without disturbing other customers. The treatments with the foreigners and the local were very different. They should have improved their service, perhaps standardize the service to everyone.

Author: AnnisaTong
Title: colorful xiaolongbao
Review: First time experience with different favors of xiaolongbao, like cheese, truffle, ginseng …. and of course original favor too!

Author: t0mmyhs
Title: Best nasi lemak so far
Review: This one is certainly the best nasi lemak that i have ever eat so far (subjectively). Laksa is not bad although it looks very appealing. Cendol is not bad either. Price is quite expensive compare to other nasi lemak restaurant.

Author: azzraklKuala Terengganu, Malaysia
Title: good staff but overpriced
Review: good staff but felt like the darren chin show. staff in the restaurant seem to be directed a lot by the chef which makes one wonder who is directing the kitchen.price is equivalent to other find dining restaurants, I didnt enjoy it felt bad for my friend who was paying the bill. Ive been to cilantro and Maison Francaise and enjoyed both restaurants more. they felt like better value

Author: DoreneSH
Title: Smoky environment & average food
Review: Came here for dinner as it was located just a stone throw away from behind my hotel, Harbour View. The place was quite crowded with a mixed of locals and tourists. It had a nice cozy ambience but, sadly...the place was enveloped with cigarette smoke. The shop owner tried to improve the condition by using big fans to blow away the smoke from each corner...but it was not very effective. I had John's Special Fried MeeHoon (rice noodles) and garlic stir-fried "midin" fern (local fern). The rice noodles were smooth and thicker than standard ones. But, the overall flavour was bland. On the other hand, the garlic stir-fried "midin" fern was very salty. Overall, if there is no other place for dinner, you can try this place as it is very near the waterfront and it opens till 11.30pm.

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Other better ones available
Review: Went to this Asam Pedas shop as the one we wanted to go to was close. This shop also sells roti canai besides asam pedas. We can choose the type of fish you want, either pari, tenggiri or kembong. I also chose not to have rice but roti canai. I felt that there were many much better asam pedas shops around Melaka. The asam pedas gravy was too sour for my liking and the roti canai was just average. Choose another asam pedas shop for better options.

Author: martantongLegian, Indonesia
Title: Dinner with family ruined
Review: First come first serve, does not apply in this resto. Our group 16 persons, arrive early, however other groups got their food first. And our food came one by one, so inconvinient. At first we passed this resto, the indoor room looks new and comfort, thats why our family choose it. However, their reason for busy is not acceptable for us, since others who came later than us, got their foods earlier than us. So first time and last time for us.

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Quality goes down, prices go up
Review: Price for a cheese burger + soft drink up 40 % over the past 3 month and now they charge tons of extras. Quality have not improved. They have gone from being a good deal to way below average value.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Nyonya food around Jonker area
Review: Overall I'm pretty satisfied with their food. Some dishes are slightly too salty but goes OK to have with rice. Dishes like sambal prawns, prawn is so small and they did not even bother to de-shell. Petai is sliced into so tiny portions, like quarter the size. Just not quite happy with the way they ration things for a dish. Sometimes, setting the price a little bit more and use better ingredients will not harm. Rationing here and there is like might as well I just cook at home then. If you're already charging not really cheap prices, give it the best to your customers. You have really good sambal, don't waste them on lousy portions/ingredients. If I remember correctly they do sell their sambal separately for an extra fee. Then again, Nyonya cravings satisfied!

Author: zhenweik2015
Title: Great food and service
Review: Had their Texas burger and durian ice cream. Both are absolutely delicious and really worth the visit. To top it off their staff Pradeep gave excellent service to make the visit even more memorable.

Author: vion86
Title: A good place for dining
Review: I been at shook to celebrate my fiancee birthday,food was delicious,service was excellent,they have live music too and make us enjoy with good ambience.for sure will recommended to our friends

Author: SPPatelIndia
Title: Overcrowded but good food
Review:
Had been to this restaurant for dinner with our tour group.

The food is good. 
Deserts were strictly okay
Staff is friendly.
It's was very crowded and took sometime to sit

Author: dreamiegurlMalaysia
Title: never again.
Review: I went there on 8th March 2015. I ordered for grilled chicken set but was served with roast chicken. I requested for a change, the server ignored and scold me instead saying i ordered it wrong. Guess customer right is not in their motto. The food is below average for middle easter cuisines.
Restaurant: Zam Zam Arabic Restaurant & Grand Ballroom

Author: TifKoh
Title: Average Food
Review: Have heard good reviews on the food offerred. We were at One Utama last weekend. May be we went to a different branch. Most of the reviews centred around Mid Valley.Service was so-so. Staff were pretty inexperienced. For 8 pax, the bill was about RM356. Curry Laksa & Assam Laksa were not as good as PappaRich's. Fried Kuay Teow was piping hot. Taste - average. Chendol was not great either. Ingredients in there were too negligible.Loved the Assam Prawns but wished it could be more spicy instead of sweet. Liked its Fried Tou Fu but not its Rojak. Plain Fried Rice was pretty good. Ambience was not too bad. Though they had 2 tables right inside a corner, good for small private events, we thought it was much hotter there than than the exterior. We couldn't feel it's aircon. We were sitting right inside the corner and were perspiring ceaselessly, esp after taking the chilli.Overall, food quality was average. Prices were on the high side. Preferred Papparich at Nexus Mall instead.

Author: 1948dmcPenn
Title: Overpriced for mediocre food
Review: Tried this restaurant whist staying at The Andaman. Whilst the setting is ok the food is at best mediocre and vastly overpriced. We have better food at our local town at home at a third of the price.We tried to book a table for 8.00pm only to be told they could only do 7.30pm, when we got there only one table was occupied and by the time we left no more than six tables were in use.

Author: Jennifer R
Title: Appalling service
Review: Awful experience. We were a party of 7, ordered from the a la carte menu. It took over an hour for the first person to get half of their meal (steak without the accompaniment), and the last person got their meal after waiting nearly 2 hours. The meals were wrong and the staff were unapologetic stating that we should expect to wait as this is fine dining and food takes time to prepare. There was nothing fine dining about our experience. They were uncompromising with regards to settling the bill- despite serving 4 out of 7 people incorrect meals, then had the ordacity to charge a compulsory 10% service charge. Appalling service, food was average but overpriced for what it was. It doesn’t even deserve the 1 star rating. Would not go back on the basis they handled a poor customer experience so badly.

Author: AdrianY222
Title: Superb choices of steak
Review: Love the Oyster Blade Steak (medium rare) which was creamy, and flavorful. The Roasted Bone Marrow was a bit tad too salty and rich but maybe it was supposed to be that way.

Author: NPasricha
Title: lousy for vegetarians
Review:
Food is average at best and they are either not accomodating for veg or they will add some meat into your food and do the, "Sorry, lah". 

Desserts are nice but it doesnt constitute a meal.

Author: LipSengYap
Title: The one and only Japanese Restaurant worth it in Langkawi
Review: Highly rated as the best (and only) proper Japanese Restaurant in Langkawi, service is always good, food fresh and authentic. Price is a little on high side, but worth it.

Author: Coastal58484684690Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food with awesome staff
Review: Best meal we had during lunch time. We ordered few sets lunch along with some maki, better to order 1 tepanyaki wagyu just to try it out. We also served by few best staff in this restaurant which are Ms Azura (lead), Mr Alam, Ms Aishah and Ms Jamuna.Overall the food experience is very good and I will join again for family reunion.

Author: HappycookiesKl
Title: Lousy lousy lousy service! Don’t expect dog yee sang
Review: 1) We were lost upon arrival with nobody to serve us. (It’s a huge space and it’s dark FYI) I had to hunt for a crew to ask about our booking.2. We did the rm138& menu, first and second dish arrived cold so we complained and 3rd dish onwards was piping hot3. If you been to oriental, you do expect a certain standard. This is he worst ever experience. From food taste, to service (keep pouring us cold tea); no local to serve us, ALL foreign workers who are so blur! (I mean this Is an expensive restaurant, a certain level of service is expected!) North Star fish was lousy. Tasted frozen! 4. The dog yee sang you see them advertising comes with a cost. If not it’ll look like any other yee sang :)

Author: Green_kermitTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Amazing
Review: What’s not to like about this place? You wonder along a little jetty (walk or buggy). You wonder into a white building which has a kind of Moroccan opulent beach house type of feel. You can watch a beautiful sunset whilst sipping a cocktail with actually pretty good band playing quietly in the background.Then you wonder inside for some great, friendly and informed service. They have a great wine list and some really good options. One word of advice - fish. It’s so fresh and good, you should make sure one of your courses have it. I had scallops and beef (technically neither is fish) and both were amazing. My wife had fish, and it was jealous. Puddings - they are ok but the mains and starters are where you should use your calories. Great with kids too, they asked him what he wanted - they made it just for him. So it isn’t cheap (similar to a good meal in Hk or Sing), but this was the highlight of our holiday and I was left wondering when we can next come back. We had a great time.

Author: maninasuitcase1905
Title: Friendly and relaxed
Review: A nice place to have a few drinks and relax away from the hassle on the street. We only had drinks but the food also looked good we will try next time in KL.

Author: vasavaprLappeenranta, Finland
Title: An average Restaurant
Review: I am not a fan of south-east type of food. Also I hate sugar in my meals. It was my first time and it was not good. I hated what I ordered and did not eat it at all. My wife ordered crab curry which was surprisingly good.

Author: prettyposhpenguinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantabulous!!
Review: They have some of the best cocktails i have had in KL - try the chilli peppers (if you are adventurous) or the mangosteen if you are looking for something more subtle and refreshing. Their falafel bites & popcorn shrimp are fabulous and do not leave without having desserts - they are all homemade!! Its a perfect weekend dining experience :)

Author: parandcoBrisbane, Australia
Title: Nice Cozy Cafe ; It's a must visit for the curious tourist
Review: It's such a nice place fore those who seek antique locations. In the heart of that central area of KL (The old town and the China Town and Petaling Street) this is a spot where you will not forget compared to the rest of what you see there. I liked the style and its design more than anything. The Asian style Coffee that we had was also very good and a real delicacy.

Author: name-annie-81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad services👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎
Review: Terrible n bad servicehighly recommend to walk in customers, dun go in. Wil hv an aunty (if not mistaken, she is d Bos)come out to scold d staff n reject us Insisted d staff allow us to sit!!!! So rude n no respect at all! If earli b4 v waiting, jus dun accept us. But wen v oledi sit down n ready to order.. then been reject n asked to leave! Wat d hell!!!!! Reali annoying!!!! Bad services . 1st time ever In my life been like tat treat by restaurant. Pls share d bad manner of d aunty...

Author: Harujung
Title: Great place with great meet
Review: What a positive surprise. Great food and superb service from Kaiyum and his team. We enjoyed a lot! Buffet and lots of yummy meat!

Author: LynD827Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Would return for the food
Review: Won't say a much about the coffee since it was so-so. Food was good tho. Was not planning on eating since we were there after dinner. However we ordered some snacks to share and that went pretty quickly. My husband ordered spaghetti olio and he was pretty pleased with the outcome.I'd go again to give the coffee a second chance. Apparently they are known for their breakfasts. Will give that a try too.

Author: yeo s
Title: Happy Breakfast Happy Tummy
Review: Wide varieties of choices from Chinese food such as Dim Sum,Yong Tau Fu to Malaysia favourite dishes Nasi Lemak to Japanese Food such as Udon with Miso soup even Lebanese food also provided here. There also provide different kind of pastries like Danish and hot pancake with peanut butter, kaya, blueberries jam etc. Remember to try their hot soya milk and also muesli. Best ever. Hearty breakfast. Wide selection of eggs, if you don't like egg yolk you can choose egg white omellete. Egg Benedict is a must also! And never forget their western food, buttered fried vegetables and scrabbled eggs so nice!A big shootout to Soffian (or Soffial if I no mistaken his name). For specially made roti canai with double eggs and cheese for me. So delicious and fluffy. He even served to my table with dhall. He also kept on checking with us whether the roti canai nice or not and constantly check whether all the food here okay or not. And also a big shootout to Hasmah introducing us different kind of teas and serve two kinds of tea in teapots to us. Good hospitality and good services.Thank you Soffial or Soffian (I forgot the name whether Soffial or Soffian, but is a very nice and friendly chef) and Hasmah for making my Saturday's breakfast time a happy.Happy breakfast!

Author: protiendat
Title: Oily food
Review:
My friend and me ate here for several times during couple days visited Miri. The food was quite oily. Waiting time around 15-30 mins to get the food. 
Many drinks or food in the Menu but not available. They did not remove it.

Author: goodgoodfood2017
Title: Tea and dessert
Review:
We only popped in for some baklava, tea and shisha. 

Service was great.

We paid rm120 for the above which was reasonable.

Author: Waileng L
Title: Good food and cozy place
Review: We both quite enjoyed the food, all the taste is just nice, balance and not over., nice atmosphere, price is reasonable. However, there are still rooms for improvement. The place we sat near the window display (a table for books deco ) are dusty. The cakes are not covered and attract few flies sitting on it. Know Malaysia is tropical country, hot humid, flies are not easy to avoid. Last comment, is wish the waiters waitress can give warm smiling and passion to introduce the food.

Author: mickn695
Title: Don't go to watch sports. They don't care.
Review: Do not go here if you want to watch a sporting event. Just finished here 5 minutes ago. Specifically came here for the Singapore F1. Booked a table here and got one in front of the big scene for this event. So far so good. Had a great meal and things going well until 21:50hrs, 5 laps to go....big scene goes up and no F1. Ask waitress and manager what's going on. The band is coming on. Last lap, half way into it band starts. Every single smaller TV has F1 on. Can't watch because stupid lights from band going off and blinding us. Lost all our future business. Spent 1000 MYR for a really disappointing end to the night. Would have stayed and kicked on but you didn't deserve one more dollar.

Author: dimsum088Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great view but mediocre food
Review: I had a business lunch there recently and I must say the food quality was way below my expectations. We ordered the Matsuhisa set, beef set & sushi sashimi set and none of us was happy with the meal. The Matsuhisa set was very ordinary and the black Cod in there tastes nothing like their signature dish. The saving grace was the choc fondant in the desert bento. The mochi ice cream (RM50) was another let down.

Author: desilvagsingapore
Title: Just ok.
Review: Went for their set lunch.Priced at Malaysian Ringgit 38 nett.Ordered Fish&Chips which turned out to be 2 pieces of oily battered fish, French fries Salad dish and a Dessert. Very small portion of Fish. Set came with Brocolli soup which was a slightly salted to my taste. The only saving grace was the Dessert which was the Brownie with Vanilla Ice cream. That was so rich and very tasty. As well as the free flowing Soft Drinks which included Sprite,Coke,Ice Lemon Tea.For the price i paid it was ok but not worth it at all going by the taste. I have got better Fish and Chips at Hard Rock Cafe other outlets around the World which i have tried and can vouch for the portion,taste and quality of it.

Author: PaulC44_ReviewsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Honestly a bit of a disappointment
Review: We had dinner here last weekend for my friend's birthday on a recommendation. Honestly I have to say we were disappointed. We arrived on time for our reservation and the table was occupied - no problem, they moved the people quickly and we were seated within a few minutes. Then the disappointment began. It took 15 minutes after sitting down for anybody to ask us if we wanted a drink. Then our food arrived before our drinks and I had to ask on three more occasions for the drinks before they came. One of the drinks was just a bottle of water so hardly difficult to prepare. When the food arrived, the vegetables were cold and the pepper sauce tasteless and cold. That said, the steak itself was tasty - credit where it's due.On our bill, complimentary soup and bread and butter were both listed and we received neither. Why put them on the bill just to rub salt into the wound. The whole time we were there, we were effectively ignored. It seemed as though the staff couldn't really care less. We were very disappointed, as was the friend that recommended them to us.

Author: Timothy_George1Braunton, United Kingdom
Title: Family
Review: We had a table on the beach booked for 7pm but arrived at 6 for cocktails. I had a Pina Colada and my wife and daughter had Singapore Slings and our friend a glass of wine. There is a tradition at the Casa del Mar called "Spin the Wheel". The bar counter is made up of square coloured tiles. You place whatever drink you have on a coloured tile and then spin the wheel attached to the bar upright roof support. If the colour on the wheel matches yours it's a free drink and you have three goes at it. We were lucky and won a Pina Colada and two Singapore Slings. After this we took our table for dinner. They have a very extensive menu. My friend and I started with Chicken Caesar Salad. It was delicious. My wife had the Asian Seafood Salad which consisted of Poach Prawn, Torch Scallop, Mango Jelly, Slipper Lobster and Orange Thai- Dressing. My daughter had Pan Seared Hokkaido Scallop & King Prawn with Salsa Verde, Cherry Capers & Crustacean Glaze.For main course my daughter and I had Crustacean Farce. Slow cooked Risotto Rice in Seafood Bisque, Grilled Scallop & King Prawn, Asparagus and Mushroom Caramelized Grapefruit Rind. Our friend had Skewered Boneless Chicken Tikka, Saffron Rice, Naan Bread, Cucumber Carrot Raita and Makhani Sauce.My wife indulged in a Fabulous Authentic Malaysian Pallet. This consisted of 9 pure Malaysian dishes which she said was delicious. We washed all this down with a couple of bottles of NZSB. My daughter decided on a sweet with two spoons. A trio of Chocolate. It took 30 mins to arrive and when it came it was with 4 spoons and was delightful. This restaurant is not cheap but the food, atmosphere, ambience and service are excellent. Well recommended.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Rob MDordrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Nothing special
Review: Went here because of the ranking on this site but were disappointed. Food was just ok and relatively pricey. Certainly not much better than what you will get in a hawker place but much more expensive. People are queuing to get in though so you will get the eye to move on when you're finished eating. Compared to the many good restaurants in Chinatown, Singapore this is substandard.

Author: peternC8393KV
Title: Heaven on a Plate
Review: All I can say is do yourself a favour and try the food. Anything said here is pointless. Go there and let the food do the talking.

Author: 328rachelh
Title: Wouldn’t recommend
Review:
We love Indian food and were excited to visit. 

The food was poor. Bland curries with low quality meat. The breads were quite good. 

The service was also poor.

Author: rantyrantsSingapore
Title: Overly exaggerated food with brainless service staff
Review: Seems that this is the one of the few places in JB that serves better quality beef. WRONG!!! they are one of the few that rip you off blind, with these prices its better to have quality food in a more hygienic set-up across the Causeway. At least if you were to get hit by food poisoning in Singapore for sure the authorities will do something about it. I was there last year and the occasion was on the contrary memorable. I was working out of JB and a consultant partner of mine was looking to have a good steak dinner so i thought of treating her to a better restaurant and boy was i wrong. First up cockroaches running everywhere, once we sat down and water was not even served there was this little critter crawling up the side of our table. The girl that was passing the menus came we pointed at the critter she smiled used her hand to sweep it to the floor and swiftly placed a foot to it and picked it up and left. Next up more cockroaches, there was one hiding in my cutlery set, which I had to make not once but 2 requests to have my knife and fork changed after the ordeal. The service crew are more interested to ask you stupid questions at the wrong time. Clearly i was unhappy for the cockroach incident so please change my table to your best roach free one and not come almost every eight mins or so asking me on how are things and inquiring on the taste of my food. How many times must a customer indicate that they are not happy with his dinner to get some attention? The servers seem to be all former Makati, Jollibee recruits. They are trained like robots selling fried chicken with one style and one sauce only, even if there was a fire or earthquake during service that night their modus operandi would remain the same, even if the Pope himself would have arrived that night for dinner it would have been the same or even if the Pope would have died whilst mid eating there that night it would be even more the same. The place is dimly lit that gives that horror feeling even more, not knowing if that piece of what looks like black olive you are placing in your mouth is food at all. I had an even funnier incident with this restaurant during Christmas eve dinner where I was unsuspecting lead to believe when i was told by a close friend that we were going to one of the best steak house across the Tebrau Straits for dinner. Just shows why i say fast food service or call centre staff should never be asked to take care of finer food serving establishments. The bosses don't seem to give a damn it's one of those very important nights where your restaurant is fully packed and yet you allow none of your best local staff to man the show, or do you have any better staff at all???

Author: bernicesim_29Singapore
Title: Yummy Indian Food
Review: We had this for lunch on a Monday afternoon, and there were four of us. The food was excellent, flavourful and super worth every penny. Not that it was overly expensive. It was reasonably priced and portion were huge as well. Friendly staff and owner. We'll definitely go back again!

Author: ShirindpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly Neighborhood Restaurant
Review: In the quieter region of TTDI, Vin's has a great variety of food and drinks to choose from. Having tried almost every dish on the menu, I am yet to be disappointed. Other than the food, what makes Vin's ... Vin's are the staff - friendly, attentive and eager to please. It's always a pleasure coming back and knowing i'll walk out stuffed and satisfied :)

Author: sojourn7Canada
Title: Not authentic; not very good
Review: I've been twice. The first time I thought, "It's ok for a change." The second time I thought, "Never again." Let's start with the good: the service is friendly. That's where the good part ends. First of all, this is not authentic Mexican cuisine. Not even close. Anyone that says it is does not actually know what authentic Mexican food is.Secondly, how does an informal restaurant like this think that it's ok to raise the price of a canned soft drink by more than 500%?! Seriously, a warm soft drink in a can for RM 8.50! Ridiculous. Finally, authentic Mexican food has a large choice of meatless dishes because the Mexican diet relies very much on rice, beans, and tortillas. Yet, somehow, Las Carretas has hardly any meatless dishes and the ones they have are not good and very over-priced. Never again.

Author: shaifulr328
Title: Horrible tea time experience
Review: The standard of ritzy tea time is going down the drain. The scones came together with all the mini bites. It’s wasn’t fresh bake anymore. It’s cold scones. They only serve strawberry jam instead of few selections of jams before. And when i made the reservation, i did mention it was for a birthday celebration and they said we are entitled for a slice of cake with candle etc. But nah , it’s just a bluff i guess. We were waiting till we get tired, so we just asked for the bill and i asked about the complimentary birthday cake. None of them know. Funny. I mean we aren’t desperate or hungry for your cake but we were expecting a nice birthday celebration there.

Author: BT993TTIpoh, Malaysia
Title: It is "so so" .....
Review: We tried a number of items here for dinner and it is so so only. We ordered wat tan hor fun, hokkien fried dai loke mian, bean sprout, braised chicken feet and baby octopus. The place was quite busy at 9+PM on a week day and the service was prompt. Not sure if I would visit again to try their other dishes.

Author: Simon8989
Title: Super Expensive.
Review:
Super Expensive restaurant in housing area, like a 5 star hotel rate, a la cart main course rm62-rm100++, xmas dinner set rm198 per person, with very small size. 
After ordered have to wait very long time to be served. 
Don't have kids set menu.

Author: Johanrsk
Title: Great experience end to end
Review:
Amazing food from starter to dessert.
Very good service as well.
Highly recommended.
Coming from 2 frenchies.

Author: levictoria_msia
Title: Friendly owner and good food
Review: The food tastes good and large portion. the owner is friendly and tried to explain how to eat bibimbap. My friend and I had nice brunch at here. However, the drink is expensive.

Author: Neil0akesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good but some issues
Review: It's always a shame when you enjoy a meal but one of your fellow dinners has a disaster. We had great appetisers and personally I really enjoyed my main course but one of the mains was not ordered properly by the waiter. A replacement was offered and when this arrived it also had issues down to service. It is a shame that such good food is let down by inexperienced staff. Hopefully they can get this fixed soon we will go back again for the pasta dishes which were very good.

Author: lisamaria0424
Title: Amazing food, customer service and more
Review: Amazing food, customer service, environment and views...! Would gladly come back again another time :)

Author: hml1010
Title: Not for local
Review: I went there with family for vacation as we seen tons of good comment about this place. However, the good is below average only, great disappointments. Maybe this is not for local :(

Author: Departure679831
Title: Delicious Waffles
Review: I was passing this shop time and it wasn't a mistake to swing by. The waffle is superb i just can describe how enjoyable the taste was. Yums!

Author: IsRazakBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Preferred Japanese Restaurant
Review: Sushi Zanmai is the preferred Japanese sushi restaurant when I'm in Kuala Lumpur. The service can at times be a let down but what makes the rating higher are the quality of food and the price are reasonable.Last visit was a good one. Service was average. We ordered sushi sets and was good, that we had to order seconds. Kids love them.A recommended sushi restaurant. But I must admit few times there service and friendliness of staffs should improve. Stating the obvious but... Nothing shouts good restaurants like good foods and good services.

Author: MelisaHa93
Title: Very overpriced and cheating on drinks
Review: We went here because of the reviews. We honestly don’t understand why this restaurant got this high in the ranks. The food is very overpriced, 22RM for an “okay” cheeseburger. Besides that we ordered 2 cola’s and they use 1 can for the both of us by putting it in glasses filled with a lot of ice. So you end up paying 12RM in total for 1 can of Coke. I asked two staff members about the cola, the first one said the can is finished and later showed me from the bar 1 finished can of Coke. We were like okay you used 1 can for two glasses, that’s exactly what we were saying. That’s why I asked again to another staff member who was serving the food why we won’t get 2 cans instead of two small glasses filled with ice. (After some time you’ll notice half of your drink is water as on the pictures.) The staff member said that a lot of restaurants do so and that I needed to ask for a can. The staff members didn’t even try to fulfill our needs. When guests try to give you feedback face to face to work it out and to make your restaurant better, I don’t think you should ignore that.

Author: SamanthaChik
Title: Is nightmare to my children ..
Review: Worse service ever!! Attack the customer with rude words by the staff and owner. The impression is run by thugs. Never ever go to this restaurant.

Author: muraly86
Title: service teribble worst experince
Review: service terrible at valentine restaurant honest opinion please boikot this stupid restaurant cause how they do the food is honesty very dirty and also they actually talk at the back about u - not very pleasant thing since i am chindian look like malay so i understand when they talk back at me.. basicly the food is ok but the service is teribble and believe me their hygiene is questionable since they use the same hand to deal all the cooking and also handling the money ect .... bacillary wost experince in ths resturant

Author: RebeccaL4090
Title: Essence restaurant
Review: The food was terrible, the buffet was less choices and even the choices I ate tasted terrible. I had the rosemary lamb it was so dry and tasteless. I was totally disappointed a 5 star hotel has such a bad food like this. The ambience was great but honestly the food is just terrible. The only thing I could eat was the desserts. Their desserts was fairly okay.They had many choices. They didn't serve any drinks like orange juice those cordinal drinks it will be extra charged, they just served normal plain water.The worst hotel food I had wish they really improve.

Author: lop8308Houston, Texas
Title: Intersting and Different
Review: The resurant has an upstairs dining area that could easily be missed. Go to the side and the back of the ground floor to the stairs. The walk up will be surprising. If you have ever been to a 70's era disco, it might bring back a few memories. The menu is extensive. Eveything is an asian fusion. We tried the pulled duck tacos which were surprisingly good. In keeping with the the resturants name, the floral (iced) tea is also a surprise. Not to spoil it, I won't add any more other than to say it was delightful.

Author: agusnapoli
Title: Tough BAK KUT
Review:
Taste is average,flavour of herb in the sup is not strong enough,the meat is tough,tourist price.
I wonder why it is crowed.

Author: Evin D
Title: Nice Food
Review: Really nice food, great spot for a bite to eat. Great service too. Ordering food was very efficient and the food was prepared very quickly.

Author: MikoraudHangzhou, China
Title: Good but pricey
Review: Went there for an early dinner. Ordered Pesto Cream spaghetti (26.90) and Chicken Leg with butter cream and potatoes (29.90). The spaghetti was wonderful, the chicken was way too salty for my taste, although the potatoes were nice. The service was good, relatively prompt and friendly. I didn't appreciate being asked to queue up in a place where just one table was occupied. Also, the internet was pretty spotty, The interior is special, it seems to have it's own style (though I wouldn't blame one for calling it run down).It seems all very Singaporean - the queuing, the prices, the place. My wife said this is mostly for the S'pore clientele, and all things considered it sounds reasonable. It's definitely too pricey (and not that special) for JB - we ended up paying MYR65.90 after taxes for too dishes. All in all, not a bad place to get a bite, but I wouldn't go out of my way to go there.

Author: karenwpcKota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia
Title: They served Delicious Dim Sum and Fried Rice...
Review: We were late for lunch as our arrival flight were delayed. Some friends booked our lunch at 2.30 pm and we arrived almost 2.45pm. The restaurant still managed to serve us willingly and we ended our lunch one hour later.The staff are very helpful in their serving and also helping us to pack our leftovers.

Author: adela986
Title: Bad service
Review: Good coffee at pavilion walking street but there is only 2waiters while the shop is full always unfortunately more than 25 min and no one attended our table like others around , when you ask for the check it will take longer time .

Author: Nightowl037Singapore, Singapore
Title: Poor service and terrible food
Review: This place has gone downhill since my last visit a year ago. The waitresses though polite was totally incompetent . Could be their first day of work . Stony face , they went about their job as though they work in the mortuary . The drinks like most places in Asia is overprice . You really have to be desperate to pay for it . Ordered prime ribs and it came tough and without jus. The waitress actually agreed with me that the prime rib is tough and dry . I was like aghast that others may have feedback to her the same thing. Cesar salad is inedible . These dishes are suppose to be their signature dishes . I think the chef has left since the menu was printed . Saving grace was the fish and chips was good . So all five of us shared one dish . This restaurant has potential , it is a shame that shangri la management did not focus the right attention to it . Go there for drinks and order fish and chips only . Watch the review on trip advisor for improvement before you go for a meal . There are a lot of good western restaurant in the vicinity , so you do have choices .

Author: IzzahA84
Title: Lunch Buffet
Review:
The food spread was delicious and ambiance was nice..

Staff Azlina, Shaz, Rizal, Irma & Darshini was friendly and helpful. Thank you for your excellent service 😊

Author: cheah99Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Bad Brunch!
Review: The Brunch dimsum here(on weekends and public holidays) serves mediocre food, not unlike many of the 'economy' dimsum joints that is found all over KL.The dimsum lacks not only quality but flavour(most tastes like variations of minced meat fried or steamed).Having eaten here many times in the past, the food here is now quite mediocre.One should eat in the economy dimsum places found all over KL at a tiny fraction of the price Celestial Court charges. I will avoid their "Per Person Brunch set"

Author: EikeWiebkeFrankfurt, Germany
Title: interesting experience
Review: We were extremeley looking forward to this dinner because we read so many excellent reports of this special restaurant in KL that we couldn't wait to do it. Because there is a large variety of choosing the hour to come we went for the last one, a mistake I would say now. Because we arrived only at 8.30h p.m. we where chased through our dishes and didn't had time to enjoy all the flavors as we wanted to. The day was not so warm but the aircon was still on, sometimes it was freezing. Not to mention the loud music. I do not need to listen to music all the time, for me it was much too loud and not necessary for a high standard restaurant.The staff was friendly but I expected more from a restaurant with such high prices. We started and had two choices: 13 and 15 courses: the difference in price was not to mention and the waiter explained to us that it would be better to take the long journey because it's better (!) and the chicken would really be worth it... ok then, we took the 15 courses. I chose the journey with cocktails and it was really great. The bartender came often to our table to explain what we drank and how it was arranged. The drinks where very good, extremely interesting to look at and worth the experience. Bravo!As for the food I was disappointed. First of all I was under the impression that it was a run and not a restful journey. If I spend a lot of money for going out, I will decide how long it takes. The staff came often much too early with either a new drink or a new course when I did not had finished the one before. I found this very disturbing. If 8.30 p.m. is too late why offering this time to arrive? With the food came always an explanation. Because of the music I could not understand everything and because of the explanation the food was not very hot in the end. I went to the toilet between two courses. I came back and the new course was allready served (it was the soup), the explanations given to my company and I did not had the explanantion neither the experience of seeing how it was done. Sad!To make it short. I ate better for much less money. The chicken served was chicken briyani which you can eat everywhere in Malaysia and I have to say much better. For this chicken I had to take the 15 miles walk (or rather run)? Very disappointing. The lobster was good but not too good flavoured, the lamb had a good texture but was too cold. In the end we where among the last guests. The butterflies where not so nicely decorated than we saw them at the tables before: sign to hurry!??All in all we were not sad to have seen this place, there are a lot of interesting ways of decoration and presentation but I would like to have a god culinaric experience for such a lot of money too! Perhaps the chef was ill or had already gone home and now there where the apprentices to continue? We will not come back, we saw and tasted enough.

Author: CityFolks777
Title: Not much improvement over the years!
Review: Had not progress in term of cooking skills and menu selection. Still having the same old menu. With the current new facility, the ambience had improved. But foods pricing had gone up quite a fair bit.

Author: zcemp13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Can I get your attention please, Ms. Holier-than-Thou??!!
Review: [Without Prejudice]Generally, I would like to look at things sometimes half full glass AND half empty glass. I will start with a half full glass. 1) We got to celebrate my daughter's birthday - and she specifically wanted Thirty8, because she had numerous fun times there. 2) The cheesecake with blue berry insides was nice to eat.3) Great to know that the hotel celebrated earth hour this year. 'nuf of the good stuff. Now to the glass half empty. 1) Though I understand that the "sofa" area is not bookable for dessert and drinks, I called twice to ensure that I get a place big enough for 13pax for our last stop of the night. And although I have spoken to the hostess twice prior to 30.03.19 night, I was flabbergasted to have found that we were given an area where traffic flow of people were high, and small and felt like we were squeezed to that area, for us to share just one small rectangular coffee table. The term we used was "tauhu sumbat" for those understand Malay language. I was okay if we just did a walk in, but if I had to put in effort prior to that to get a generous space for the 13 of us, I expect efforts being put by the hosting team to get us a better space. 2) Now the next point is purely unacceptable a service. So because we had orders taken for the 13 of us by a nice polite Chinese man, I had to check and follow up with our drinks. Trust me, we had nothing complicated, because we were just merely waiting for the cafe latte and iced chocolate to be served. I followed up with the Chinese guy's lady colleague who went and check, but after a short while, we still didn't get our orders. 1/2 of us were already done drinking water, I finished my ice cream already and the coffee/chocolate drinks are still not served. Then I followed up with a Caucasian lady (probably a team lead/captain). Whilst explaining to her my becoming-issue, she managed to cut short my inquiry a couple of times, and came across as rude. The word I would like to use was "patronized". Though, we ended our uber short conversation with thank you - both of ours were far from being sincere and genuine about it. I would not take such treatment, so I reported to another captain (Malay guy) who eventually tried to save the situation. However, my problem was still about this Caucasian hostess. I checked with my family members on my impression of her and if my feelings were out of line. I needed to calibrate, and my Sister-In-Law who was in the mass communication industry assured that she had stepped out beyond an acceptable line. We just left dinner at a nearby 5 star hotel as well and their service was probably 2 times better than what we got at Grand Hyatt. So, THIRTY8 management, if you have just 1 person who is rude like that, and especially in this hospitality industry, your Grand Hyatt image is tarnished. Rather infuriated with this encounter. The nerve she had to be this condescendingly. In my opinion, she does not represent the brand well enough, and I have been around enough to know this. At Grand Hyatt Singapore, even the hostess at the Straits could remember my name, have a jolly good morning conversation whilst sending me to my table, and made me feel so comfortable there. So I know what Grand Hyatt can do.  She is definitely a candidate for performance improvement We are at an age whereby hoteliers are always looking at ways to improve themselves and are always seeking for feedback. Therefore, this needs to get enough of attention to re-calibrate the level of service at Grand Hyatt KL. Team leads need more training to be able to handle all sorts of clients/patrons, but this is really basic requirement - regardless what it is, everyone there needs to go to the basic hospitality 101 i.e. THOU SHALL NOT PATRONIZE YOUR PATRONS! If she plans to work in KL any longer, best is to be humble, embrace and adopt the true Malaysian hospitality. Otherwise, please take a quick exit out. To end the night, the rest of the team sent in complimentary cakes (and sang a rearrange birthday song for my daughter), treated us with dignity, respect and speed (even at payment) and that was truly an appreciated drastic step-up. So to the rest, KUDOS to you.

Author: ttp1111Toulouse, France
Title: Better of in Bayonya Restaurant down the road
Review: We arrived, and was placed on the waiting list, while waiting outside, I served myself to the unused menus, was told that i could not have the 3 menus to look at, just the one. There wasn't anyone ELSE using it. Since we couldn't look at their menu, we went over to Bayonya Restaurant checked out the menu there and lo and behold same items on the menu, no waiting list and such a friendly lady! food went down a treat in Bayonya Restaurant just down the road, wouldn't waste my time here, plus Bayonya Restaurant pricing was so cheap!!!!!
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Passport778639Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Superb slow service
Review: Finished order at 12.55pm waited 30mins js served wf peanut n tea, ordered set lunch thought cn hv it faster, but nex table ordered 10mins later than me Ady having their meal! I decide to cancel order and once I arrived d counter d food ready but I rush for meeting so request take away, aft I arrived my office no spoon/chopstick no tissue provided n found they charged me in receipt though I din use d wet tissue at all! dishonest! Insincere! Disappointed!

Author: Frank0870
Title: Avoid this restaurant
Review: It used to be such a nice restaurant, but nowadays it has changed dramatically...dirty floors and tables, cold and tasteless food, lazy and unfriendly service, overpriced etc. Won’t go there again - it’s just terrible...

Author: AUG2016familytrip
Title: Bak Kut Teh - local favour
Review: Open in the morning till noon only and very traditional and local favour and try both dry and wet Bak Kit Teh

Author: Debora H
Title: Terrible
Review:
My bill remember to live in USA no in Malaysia. 
Food orrible and service staff bad no answer me with education. 
I really disappointed for this.

Author: tamali71Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Just a in-mall restaurant
Review: Don't get me wrong, the food was fine not even the sauce was tasty but the service was not that good. I had to wait almost 30mins for my food and drink.
