You can serve me my drink first, just so you know. Mr recommendation would be you should come by when the restaurant is not full. It was crowded by the time i was there so it might be the reason i had to wait such a time.

Author: Joyce SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must try the Nasi Kukus Ayam Goreng
Review: An impressive serving of Nasi Kukus ayam goreng. The spiced fried chicken is really delicious. Good flavours of the spice marinate. Personally the rice portion is too much for me but it's served that way (tried asking for half rice but in vain). The sambal is not too spicy (for me).

Author: jamjam12345
Title: One of the best street foods we have had!
Review: The bbq ribs were absolutely amazing!!! You can’t miss out on these. Highly recommend the spicy ribs (not really that spicy but yummy) We also had the signature pandan leaf cendol for dessert and it almost topped the ribs. One of the best street foods we have had!!!

Author: GraceTBSingapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible experience
Review: It was the 1st time for all 10 of us from the office for an early lunch on a weekday. We made reservations a week ago but when we got there before 12pm, the table wasn't set. The excuse given was that the person in charge was not working. After we ordered, the main dishes came out before the appetiser. Food quality is average. The waiter served our tom yam soup in individual bowls, filled to the brim till the broth spilled on my skirt, without even an apology. Then, we waited for around 20 minutes for our dessert after the plates were cleared, not without us asking for the it at least 2 times. When our tam tim krob came, it was warm with whatever balance of ice shavings completed melted. Bill time, we asked for it 3x. That's not all, after giving our amex, we waited for 10 minutes before going straight to the cashier to sign and to collect back the credit card. What an unforgetable experience!

Author: cittabellaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: An overseas friend stayed over at Shangri-la for business and we had dinner at this renowned Japanese restaurant. Out of the dishes we ordered: tofu, salmon skin roll, chicken katsu, the foie gras cawanmushi reigned supreme. The texture of the cawanmushi was very smooth and it melted in the mouth. Needless to say, the foie gras tasted yummy and it compliments the cawanmushi very well. We enjoyed the food and will definitely return again.

Author: DaveThompson16Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Warmed up pre-prepared food
Review: My wife and I were apprehensive when we looked at the online menu, which is enormous. Far too many options. How could the chefs possibly freshly prepare such a wide variety of dishes? Well, the answer is, they don't.We booked a table in advance, but when we got there they had no record of our booking. Anyway, the place was empty so no problem. While we were looking at our menus, a waitress came over and asked if we were ready. We said yes, and she picked up the menus and walked away without taking our order! Eventually I got to order the lamb shepherd's pie with chips and peas. The pie was what you would expect to find in a downmarket supermarket's frozen section. The peas were mushy (by design) but not as they should have been. Best part of the meal was the gravy. My wife ordered the cod and chips and a side order of onion rings. Not sure what the fish was, but it wasn't cod. Telapia maybe. Cream coloured mushy flesh, not white and flaky. Yeugh!Service was below average. I asked for a fork and was presented with a pint of Tiger. They even tried to charge us for that later on!Valuewise, the food is not cheap, and poorly prepared. We both felt a bit ill later on. The location is good though, and the ambience is ok.Sometimes I feel like I'm reviewing a different restaurant to everyone else. Definitely not recommended. We won't be going back.

Author: ForevermuiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointed with the food and service
Review: Was here on a Friday lunch, the first wow impression at the reception quickly went down to drain, thanks to the slow food serving and the sub standard food quality (comparing to Din Tai Fung Pavilion and Din Tai Fung @The Gardens). Aside from the long waiting time (understandable for Friday lunch), the bigger problem was most of the time the serving staff can't even identify the table to deliver the correct order. We have to request for 3 times just for the ginger that supposed to serves together with the xiao long pao. 3 dishes cost us RM80, rather expensive for the kind of service and food quality.
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Suria KLCC (NO PORK)

Author: jasonbreckKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good, Authentic Food and Great Owner
Review: The owner/host was very welcoming and helpful with ordering and recommending dishes from the buffet. He made sure that we enjoyed the food and were attended to by the staff. Providing water, napkins, and boxing up our leftovers for take-away. Good food and good service combined can be hard to find in some parts of Asia, but this owner shows he cares. All at reasonable prices. I'll be back next time in KL.

Author: VickyCarameloKuala Lumpur
Title: Corporate event
Review: I took some office staff and several friends in hopes of some good buffet. Unfortunately the service was disappointing which puzzled me as there were so many waiters around. The food was reasonable but there were many dishes with beef which were not displayed/ disclosed. The place comes with a hefty price tag too so I will not recommend going there

Author: 201bethanyc
Title: Best food we've had so far in KL
Review: It's not fancy but this is a clean cute place that offered excellent food at a good price. When ordering they didn't have descriptions on the menu but rather the name of dishes under categories (chicken, fish, vegetable, etc.) and a book of pictures. The waiter was helpful in guiding us by identifying spicy dishes, etc. We loved the Satay (the sauce was excellent) and had a nice mixed vegetable dish as well.

Author: Edward I
Title: Slow Service and No Potatos
Review: I have eaten at Nando's restaurants in many countries and usually I am very pleased with the service. This was not the case on my most recent visit. During ordering each of our party of 8 ordered either sweet potato chips or potato salad with their meal. Only after serving 4 of the orders did the waitress tell us they were out of potatoes. The last of the 8 orders was served 20 minutes after the first. The food once served was tasty but because of the extremely slow service I will not choose this particular Nando's for a business lunch again.

Author: leaht2014Sydney, Australia
Title: service is great but don't go there hungry
Review: The food is really bad - we had a burger with a side of fries and the salmon. The side of fries was so small that we ordered an extra bowl of fries which was way too big, tasted terrible and was stone cold. The salmon wasn't cooked properly with the skin being very soft and almost like jelly. The side of veggies that came with the salmon were also very bad, they were very watery - obviously from the thawing process! However the service was great, our waitress was lovely and tried her best to fix any problems for us, but sadly these issues were obviously beyond her control. I wouldn't eat there, especially when theres much better and cheaper next door or close by.

Author: MPCURLYSingapore, Singapore
Title: A highly recommended local delight
Review: My last visit was exactly a year ago, and what I liked about this local restaurant, which is also a popular spot for the local is the consistency in their food quality. The speed of serving the dishes despite a packed restaurant is also a plus point for this efficiently managed restaurant. My pick of "a must try" is : the spicy fried roast pork, the steam 3 eggs which is very smooth and their assam prawns. I am not a prawn lover, but this assam prawn dish really leaves an impression. I ordered a green lime drink, and I really like the refreshing lime aroma, the citric and yet not too acidic drink really freshened me up for a hot afternoon. 6 dishes with drinks for 4 of us , cost us about RM$105, very reasonably priced. If you have a craving for a home cook meal after tasting all the great Penang hawker foods, this is really a highly recommended choice.

Author: Luluuu
Title: The most non-halal restaurant in KL (that is a good thing)
Review: Have to try the suckling pig, and the iberico ribs are amazing! The jamon iberico and the milk fed lamb is good too. Desserts are good, and I love the complimentary shot of lemony stuff at the end is great!

Author: DENIS CFontenay-sous-Bois, France
Title: Decent Japanese restaurant
Review: Surely none of the staff are Japanese but the food is ok , nothing to kill for but the ratio price quality is good , the service and the atmosphere is good private small cubicle Japanese style available for lunch good bento selection at more or less 12€

Author: CarmeneeteIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Food not hot
Review: Dinner with friends, I ordered steak set.Salad was ok, nothing special. Soup, really creamy, would have been real tasty if served hot instead of tepid, almost room temperature. Pity, pity.Next came the steak, lots of black pepper sauce, so much so I was unable to taste the meat. Ah, the pat of butter on top of steak had stayed solid until the last bite. Yes, the butter was left atop the steak on purpose, just to prove how not hot the steak was.Service, not bad, not out-standing.To pay RM94 for this set dinner, will I come back? Not unless someone else is picking up the tab, and will not be ordering steak nor lamb (I tried my friend's order too).

Author: FjcrmRawang, Malaysia
Title: Great Service at the Rooftop Lounge of Limelight
Review: Jessie and I enjoyed our drinks thoroughly. The place was quiet being a Monday night. That worked very well for us. The "tusk"-locally fermented rice wine alcohol was super!. The food was so-so. Adding a fine touch, the manager and steward provided exceptional service by adding to our "tusk" drinks with another shot a piece because we loved it so much. The lounge is a nice place to unwind and sit back whilst enjoying your drink! Recommended

Author: Agnes KJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special from this shop
Review: Aside from the varieties of the side dishes, nothing is special about this korea restaurant compared to other korea restaurant. The floor and the tables were oily from all the smokes. Service wasnt excellent. Food was just so so. The most i dislikes was the smoky surrounding in the shop like you gone in an oven. Oh yeah, lots of flies as well...*shake head*

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced and poor service
Review: It was amazing to see a restaurant of such repute having waiting staff that would take selfie and wefie in full view of the customers. Yes, there were only 2 tables, but that does not mean that you should.The food is just average, while the ambiance and decor is fantastic, but it is no where near any decent value for the price that they charge. Oh, if you are interested, they have a fantastic inhouse toilet that gives your own personal wash basin inside every cubicle. There is still the common shared one outside.

Author: ibangirl
Title: Yummy beef noodles
Review: My favourite food there is the beef noodles. Its just the right taste. And the price is very cheap considering that it is situated in the touristy area. Its a cheap coffeeshop so dont expect anything fancy.

Author: Lee Y
Title: Fancy and friendly
Review: Well-served! Well instructed for the suckling piglet cutting ceremony. Wish was made! Hope whatever wished will come true.

Author: Amanda WUnited Kingdom
Title: Wonderful Japanese meal!
Review: We stayed at the excellent Ambong Ambong just up the hill from Unkaizan so it was our nearest restaurant. We really enjoyed the authentic Japanese food, the excellent service and the view from the terrace. We found it good value for money in comparison with Singapore where we are based - about SGD 120 for 3 set meals and a good bottle of wine. We'd definitely visit again if in Langkawi.

Author: Joel MKunming, China
Title: Overpriced & low quality
Review: We had two soups and a spring roll for 30 ringgits, which was too much for soup that was similar to what can be found in the noodles area of a grocery store. There are too many more better and cheaper places on the same road.

Author: BlackstarkarenIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Bad Experience
Review: I was there to request a seat from the staff, but they just shout at me in front of other customers. The staff is being so rude. I understand there are many customers during Sunday. But I didn’t expect getting this kind of service as a customer. Really bad experience.

Author: TanJ1037
Title: Worst Kenny Roger Meal
Review: Greatly dissapointed by the quality of food. Ordered muffins and one came out 2 times smaller than the rest. Gardan salad came out with 4 pieces of cabbage with sauce. All the "Hot" sides were cold. Ordered Mac & Cheese and I counted 15 pieces given and can't taste the cheese.Seats were dirty. Service was slow even though there were only 2 tables of customer. Had lots of kenny rogers in my life and this is the worst so far.

Author: c4joelitoBrussels, Belgium
Title: OK, Sometimes great, Sometimes horrible
Review: You can get a lot of fun in Havana club, but you can also get physically threats from the "security" hooligans they have there if you happen to have a problem.on fridays and saturdays house is full but you either must go there early or risk the door roulette where you can get in wearing shorts and snickers if you know the guys on the door or you can be barred even well dressed with the classic "did you make a reserve?". Other days is mostly empty and it's not worth the visit.The music is old, they have the same playlist from 2012 when i was there with a couple of more songs more.

Author: pei2jeffKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Judge yourself
Review: It started with the waiter (A) asking us few times to take wine & we said we r good with plain water... & he started to show faces and walk off.We asked another waiter(B)"which is the best selling pizza" (the menu comes with like 20 choices)The (A) waiter appeared & replied = the best pizza is with all the add ons...After awhile; the (A) waiter came again and ask how's d pizza, so we said okay not bad. For that, the waiter said the pizza will be better if you order wine ‍♂️.The food is okay. Well they have buy 1 pizza free 1. But with such service hmmm.... Well maybe not all waiter d same, but 1 rotten apple is enough to spoil the whole barrel. I'm pretty sure others have experience it too...

Author: cittabellaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent pizza and beer
Review: One of my favourite restaurants which I go to regularly.There are many delicious dishes but the thin-crust quattro formaggi pizza is too die for, so is the smoked wagyu beef carpaccio pizza. The squid ink risotto with grilled baby octopus is also an excellent choice. The restaurant also serves the renowned German Weihenstephaner beer which goes really well with the meal.I would recommend this restaurant for all occasions. It is always packed on weekends. Parking may be an issue in the evening as there are rows of pubs and restaurants in the vicinity.

Author: BatoolW
Title: Very bad service
Review: Very  bad service  that we had to leave  before  having our order sine it tool more than 20 minutes  without having our order even it was not crowded , they wasted my time . Please do waste yours

Author: WM_2UMalaysia
Title: Go for the drinks
Review: Don't go for the food.The saving graces are - nice selection of cocktails & liqueurs.- parking space with security.

Author: nanaarsad
Title: The best nasi kukus
Review: The nasi best nasi kukus I ever have. Their sambal tempe so crunchy, the ayam percik damn tasty. Please come early to avoid long queue.

Author: sswong17Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Limited varieties and quality of food not there for High-Tea Buffet
Review: Having my high tea buffet there:1. The varieties of food are limited compare to my last visit a year ago.2. Pasta station - pasta served is not as good as last time3. Grill station - quality inconsistent 4. Other pre-cooked area - Beef are over cooked, gravy of prawn tasted good however the prawns are not fresh.5. Curry noodle stations - this station served good curry noodle6. Dessert - limited choices of fruits Not worth the money

Author: Dannytravels73Sydney, Australia
Title: Bland, and no servicde
Review: Not a great opinion of their food. Came highly recommended for local Malaysian food.Disappointed with what was delivered. Even the waiter was surprised by the plate - sparse - and dry. 3 meat dish.Chicken was just full of bones, minimal meat. Not worth the time to dissect...Beef was as dry as the rice.To the credit of the team - they agreed it was bad form - and refunded all - and offered free "buffet" food- but i moved on.

Author: Shahrun Adam A
Title: Not open
Review: Went there on a Sunday afternoon and was closed. Location was off road and was very disappointed. Wish owner and other visitors will update operating hours and closed days.

Author: matty1965Sunderland, United Kingdom
Title: Great bar
Review: What can I say,, called in for a drink and served by a very nice person called Prity, ended off staying for a few more drinks than planned and having food,,,,,,food was really good and very reasonably priced, I would highly recommend a visit to this bar and you will not be disappointed, we will be back before we leave.

Author: Cheryl T
Title: Wagyu tomahawk
Review:
Lovely the ambience ,cozy place.
Good wine selection served here. 
Love their Wagyu tomahawk.
Derive is good.

Author: ParisbreakfastGaithersburg, Maryland
Title: If You Like Street Eating, This One Is For You!
Review: My nephew Nap, his wife Stella, and daughter Bea took us to Alors, Bintang and chose Restoran Dragon View when they couldn't find the restaurant they went to before. They said they all look the same and we weren't sorry we went here.This is more for those who loves street food eating and adventurous in spirit. If you're looking for clean, spic and span restaurants, this will not be your cup of tea. They ordered the following: salted red egg sauce with chili crabs, cereal prawns, Bak Ku Teh, Grilled Sting Ray.I've had the salted red egg sauce with chili crabs and cereal prawns in Singapore in a very pricey restaurant there. Singapore is the most expensive city in the world. Expect to pay $500 for four at No Signboard restaurant for lunch. If that isn't expensive, I don't know what is. We had the salted crabs in a Chinese restaurant near Sentosa. The taste is exactly the same and just the way we like it! The cereal prawns met our expectations. We've eaten this in another country and it was just breaded prawns and I had to take out the breading first and it just wasn't the same. They said Singapore used to be a part of Malaysia and so they have the same food. No wonder I love Malaysian food. We don't have many Malaysian food in Maryland except one in Bethesda. My new favorite is the grilled sting ray. It had some kind of sauce which wasn't salty. There's something about sauces and gravies in Malaysian food that's just so tasty. They must have a lot of spices because it's always just so flavorful.We took a picture of the name of the restaurant so that when we come back here, we know where to go. But exploring other restaurants in the area would be nice to do too. When we came out of the restaurant, the outside dining was really full of clienteles. I was surprised! By the time we came out, it was night time and the street was lighted with Chinese lanterns. It was a pretty beautiful sight! It wasn't even Chinese New Year but it felt like it was.The price for 5 dishes turned out to be $50. That's cheap! Imagine if you were in Singapore and ate the same thing.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Sri Lankan in the city centre
Review: I can’t express how happy I am to know that there’s good Sri Lankan food within the city centre. If you all are familiar, there’s a popular one called Aliya but it’s a bit distance from town.The food choices are very authentic, they even source their produces from Sri Lanka and head chef is Sri Lankan, can’t get anymore authentic than that. Some of my favourite includes the crab curry, eggplant, samba selection and the appam is a must!!! Of all curries, it was the crab curry I could not stop eating - it goes so well with rice / appam!! I visited the place with a friend who has relatives in Sri Lanka and often frequent the place. She also approves and love their food! It’s a lot more crowded during lunch so if you want to take your time to enjoy properly do consider dinner instead. Alternatively, there are also per portion’s food for lunch which I have yet to try but saw a number of solo customers having them.

Author: 195anamh
Title: Best place at kl
Review: The  crab is really awesome.  Nice place  for  dinner and drink.  Happy our mojito , blue margarita and vodka berry is really fantastic  1ly Rm.10 . Highly  recommend the place for dinner and drink

Author: traveller24by7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unhygienic eatery crawling with cockroaches
Review: First things first - this place does not seem to observe basic hygiene. The sink had nasty cockroaches around and it is quite shocking to see pests crawl freely in an eatery. We even got a dead snail in one of the dishes - the Chilly Idli to our utter disgust. Don't know what we can expect next -- a dead rat or two maybe. We went there in search of some good Indian food at a decent enough place, would never go there again. Go at your own risk as would not recommend this place to anyone.

Author: TdyeqhaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Dinner at Yue
Review: I came with my friend and ordered a few item from the menu and surprising the food is so delicious, the fried egg noodles with seafood ' Singapore' style, Yue fried rice, homemade beancurd with pumpkin sauce and the venison is superb ! Thumbs up to Chef Ben Lim and his team. Also thanks to Rini who recommended and provide attentive service. I would like to recommend this restaurant to others. Thanks to friendly team of Yue.

Author: MayLamKL
Title: Underwhelmed
Review: Many of my expat friends love this place...but to be honest, I can't see the attraction. Maybe i picked the wrong dish -  Hawaiian Pizza. Tasted like a microwaved heated frozen pizza. Won't be back in a hurry...

Author: Daan P
Title: Very messy
Review: We ate here for Valentines day and overall it was v. disappointing. The male waiter was totally not interested and looked around when he took the orders, resulting in us repeating it multiple times. When he brought the food he just put it down without saying a word... the kebabs come without any sauce, so are dry. The roasted bell pepper was cold (came from fridge) but ok, mushrooms were ok, the filled pork was mwah and the churros were okay. Overall experience was messy (it was busy) and we will not come back again. Total was 128rm for 2pax

Author: phuongn573
Title: Morning talk
Review:
Peaceful, nice and cozy place with good view in garden morning.
It's hard to find this restaurant, not suggest for local enjoyment

Author: BernardLiowMalaysia
Title: Very tasty Nyonya laksa. Relaxing environment.
Review: Location wise, not easy to locate, need to look out carefully for their signboard on the main road as you need to access through some small road to reach this place, at La-Pari Pari Hotel. Environment of restaurant is quiet beside the hotel pool with some French music in the background. Overall food prices are too steep.We’ve tried breakfast and lunch on 2 different occasions. We had Nyonya Laksa and Beef Rendang dish for lunch, both were superb. The portion was big, especially the laksa. This could be one of the top nyonya laksa I’ve had for a long time.Breakfast was disappointing. We had The Works and Nasi Lemak. These dishes were more than Rm20+ each, but the quality & quantity definitely did not match the pricing.

Author: BabysBreath_EventsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Five Star Service & Excellent Venue For Various Events
Review: We are an event planning company(BabysBreath) that recently recommended two of our events (wedding & private dinner) in Tamarind Hill & Mandi-Mandi. We are writing this to commend the wonderful attitude , helpful approach and attentiveness to service which provided by your coordinator Ms Friae Ong. For the past few months since our first meeting with Ms Friae,from the suggestions to menu, attention to details and the arrangement for the event, her service was far beyond our expectations. She was definitely reaching outward and extends her help to us with full sincerity. This has made our client's event so successful and the guests were so impressed on that evening. Not to forget our compliment to the Mandi-Mandi & Tamarind's team as well . The food was so excellent as my guest keep on feed back to me they are very pleased with the foods.We had a great meeting with Mr Henry during the food tasting and he never failed to ensure our request of the foods are taken care. And the team was able to accommodate our requests during event set up which allowed us to manage the event perfectly according to our schedule.Thank you so much Tamarind for having a great team,we would never hesitate to recommend our clients to this place for next event again!

Author: basti2018Steinau an der Strasse, Germany
Title: Food like home made by my mom
Review: I have been twice at the german food corner, once to see the cable car and couple days later to see the waterfall which is close to the german food corner. Me as a german I can say the food is absolutely authentic and tast astonishing home made like my mom would do it. I can really recommend especially for those who don´t endure the asian food that much good to eat there, and in the end I have to admit that the owners are really kind.

Author: 71emmaKuching, Malaysia
Title: great food
Review: We enjoyed a good dinner here. Amazing, all the dishes were delicious. Price is affordable.However, it's very packed during weekends. Remember to call and book in advance. It's two shoplots combined into one restaurant. There're outside sitting as well, if one prefers that.Highly recommended to come here for meals.(Serving staff not very friendly)

Author: DGlobTrot
Title: Sucks!
Review:
The quality of the food can't justify the bad service we encountered. 

We asked for extra chilli sauce and we were given sour faces. We are a huge group and they are actually rationing our chili sauce! Unacceptable service!

Author: nickmah76
Title: birthday dinner
Review: came here for birthday dinner. The tomahawk steak was superb. service was top notch. shout out to adli, azu edward and david for making a wondering evening

Author: Hisham HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible shame ... sadly, never again
Review: I still remember my first visit to the restaurant when it was first opened a few years back. Sadly, in terms of food quality, it has gone downhill ever since. I went there again for dinner tonight after several years, only to be reminded why I stopped going.Our dinner is hugely overpriced, and the quality was pretty atrocious. The foie gras mantou came looking rather puny and sad, essentially two small dollops, nothing bigger than a 50 cent coin but knocked us back RM55 for a starter! I’ve had it before and was pretty sure that it was not so ridiculously small! The RM28 chicken chop was dripping in oil, and looked as if it’s been deep fried twice if not three times in dirty oil. Same with the so-called garnish, all soaked in oil. The Sarawak (Marron) laksa came adorned with a large prawn carcass but with almost next to nothing meat, and again for the RM44 price tag, minute serving. All in all, for a total bill of RM170 with just mineral water, I would say terribly disappointing and enough for us to swear never to bother returning.

Author: Estefany V
Title: Good, could be better
Review: The food was very good. Almost all waiters were nice except for one that was very rude. Service gets kind of messy cuz several waiters go to your table and they get confused more than one time. Staff takes a lot of time to get your plates off the table onces you are done, so you keep eating other plates with the old ones still on the table. The place is nice but some chairs are worn out.

Author: Hirmee
Title: Normal Mamak Place
Review: Open 24hrs. Variety of mamak and malay food. Cheap and fast service. Just a typical mamak restaurant.

Author: chinchai2016Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Rubber band cooked together with pandan chicken
Review: Food takes long time to serve. Food is not up to par. Prices are at the high side. Only 1 waiter is working. Found out rubber band after opened the pandan leave of the Pandan Chicken. Asked the waiter for restaurant manager, he said no boss. Huge disappointment. Definitely will not return.

Author: The_Zawati
Title: Dirty
Review: Dirty street full of hookers ,Zero Hyginec ,People likes it after 4 am but me i would recoomend for a quick look only

Author: CK2012_12Singapore, Singapore
Title: little Cafe with great Food and Service
Review: You will need to have an open eye when locating this cafe along Muntri Street, it serve Nonya food, prices are very reasonable with huge portion and tasty. It have an indoor and outdoor sitting area, very peaceful place to dine in. I have a party of three, the server recommended the sampler, very good recommendation with the "blue" rice which gets it color from flower know as Butterfly Pea flower. Must visit and dine in when u are along the Muntri Street.

Author: castiel21Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Highly Not Recommended
Review: On our first day in Ipoh, we went there for a dinner with high expectations. But it was really a huge disappointment. The worst place to have a family dinner.Reason:1. Bad customer service. The waiter was really slow.2. Nasi padang dishes was not fresh.they just recycled it from the lunch time.3. We ordered simple thai dishes like kailan ikan masin, ayam masak telu asin, daging masak kunyit but after 20 minutes waiting,one of the waiters informed the food were no longer available..we ordered some western food...again in 10 minutes the waiter informed us the food was not available. A bit piss off but still we ordered a Bakso. And again the bakso was really terrible. I tried the meatball and it was not fully cooked...yucks..taste really funny.4. My kids ordered a sizzling steak and club sandwich which is a bit ok.5. The price of the food were exorbitant compare to their bad service and low food quality.6. Please be careful because beside the GST, the customer also required to pay 5% service charge.Really bad experience.

Author: Eddie30
Title: A good pick up place
Review: Crowded with many young people eating & drinking and also some "hunting" for companion. A great place to spend your time in the later hours of the night.

Author: tasya14
Title: waffle was rock hard.
Review: so we ordered a caramelized banana and cream waffle and to my surprise i got a cardboard flavored ‘waffle’ instead. cutting it to pieces was equivalent to the scene in The Incredibles when Mr Incredible was cutting his son’s steak and the plate broke. the only thing i somewhat enjoyed was the banana. staff told me that the ac made it hard which makes no sense at all (insidescoop pun ada ac but sedap je waffle dia) they wouldn’t even give me a new one. paid 16 bucks to eat cardboard y’all. the ‘waffle’ was a 0.4/5 for me.

Author: keett712Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: WIZARDS AND MAGIC
Review: From the Red Bean Bag and Yellow Brick Road - what can go wrong!This time what is magical is the next concept in the menu with new dishes that really tantalise the taste buds Great snacking list with truffle fries and butter chicken pops.The eastern fusion dishes are also very good.As usual weekend crowds and regulars throng the place so be prepared to wait.The ambience is good and well thought so great jus to hang out.Already made 4 trips within 2 weeks Kudos and coffee is really good

Author: hellshound
Title: bad service
Review: food price is very unacceptable considering with the food quality. frozen food? direct cooked? what happen to thawing? holding time? recycled?

Author: Yosua K
Title: Good service good food
Review: My experienced eating at graze was wonderfull. The food was nice (especially the mushroom soup and risotto), the restaurant atmosphere is cozy and the servers are very polite and warm. Thanks to bobby and aisya who made my dining experience at Graze become memorable. Will definitely recommend Graze to my friends.

Author: lovemykidsallthetimeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Something “very dodgy” in these reviews!
Review: I was going to eat here today, but when I looked down the TripAdvisor reviews, I noticed there were many reviewers with only 2 reviews. When I tapped on their profiles, they all only reviewed Tigerlily and another restaurant, Baba Nyonya, each time on the same day, & each time giving both 5-stars! There are at least 10 of them here, so I wouldn’t trust the reviews. So I searched up and found Erawan upstairs. Much more expensive for sure, but at least all the reviewers there had posted more than 10+ reviews each. Much more credible. Such a shame that the Tigerlily restaurant has to resort to “gaming the system” to try to get noticed.

Author: eliya s
Title: Eliya/ inditra
Review: It is worth the experience I have tasted this restaurant   a no of times. Good but not a standard  maintained  variable service .anyway worth visiting

Author: Danielle FSydney, Australia
Title: Disappointing after all the great reviews
Review: We wanted some awesome local food for our last night in Malaysia so we came here. Boy, were we disappointed!The tandoori chicken was so bland that I actually didn't eat most of it. I noticed a girl at a nearby table left hers behind too. The fried rice was ok. The fried chicken was really good. The mango lassi wasn't fresh but still tasted pretty good. The staff were quite nice though. I don't know if we just ordered the wrong things but it was such a disappointment. There are so many tastier places to eat!

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: We’re told it’s the best dim sum place in Ipoh
Review: We came here after reading good reviews on food blogs and also being recommended the place by our hotel. We tried to come at 9am on a Saturday morning and both levels of the restaurant were fully occupied. Rather than wait around we decided to come back earlier the next day.We arrived back at 7am the following day and quite a few customers had already arrived but there were still plenty of tables to be had. We were shown to a table and given plates, chilli sauce and an order card. You take the order card to the food counter where you select your dishes and they write on your card to keep track of your bill. They load up a tray of food that you have selected and bring it to your table for you. You can go back for more and when you are done you take your order card to the cashier to pay. We had six dishes which came to a total of 24RM. Dishes range in price from about 2RM to 15RM. The dishes are your standard dim sum fare and were very nice. The restaurant itself was relatively upmarket looking. Be prepared for a wait if you come at a busy time.

Author: AybarsYagizAnkara, Turkey
Title: Ordinary place but nice sushi
Review: Maybe shoping mall restaurants cannot get any better than average, but still the shabu shabu, which was supposed to be the king of the table, had only four pieces of meat for 11 people. The only satisfaction was the sushi.Looking at the other reviews, we didn't get any compliments at the end as well.Maybe next time Yuzu.

Author: Mrsjb2010Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Views amazing, food average
Review: We visited here for lunch after I had purchased a groupon voucher. Booking was very easy. We paid extra to have a window table which was about 50 ringgit. The food was ok, we all found something to eat but there was a lot of seafood or dishes that didn't appeal to us. The desserts were lovely though. Drinks were very expensive too. But the view was awesome and the continuing changing view over KL was really nice. We were there on a lovely clear day which was even better.

Author: Peggy L
Title: average
Review: average rated. quite pricey but the dishes is ok. portion not big, however is enough for 3 persons with 4 dishes.

Author: prettygorgeousalley
Title: Great!
Review: The most awesome thing about this place is the live band. Good singers great voices awesome music! The crowd is good too.

Author: Santhidreamer
Title: Terrible food and terrible service!!!
Review: We ordered 4 briyani food via grabfood.2 vege, 1 chicken tikka, and 1 tandoori. Unfortunately, what we received was 3 vegetarian, and 1 tandoori. The food was very plain and the taste was horrible !!!We paid RM98 for the terrible food. When we called in to feedback, the manager Nasheek was very rude and claimed us to be lying. He also did not provide any good response or even ask for sorry.The food and the service we received was totally horrendous. Never going to order from here again !!!

Author: OzziePGAdelaide, Australia
Title: Just Yummy
Review: We wandered down Concubine Lane and saw people in this small restaurant tucking in to what looked totally inviting. On asking, the four diners just put their thumbs up for deep fried chicken and one of the signature Ipoh dishes, watercress with barbecued pork. So that's what we had, too. I can't tell you how moist and succulent that chicken was and how full of deep flavour. And the stir fried watercress was still crispy but tender and laden with strips of soft but crispy skinned pork. Served with rice and chinese tea, it all came to RM 30. We left replete and satisfied!

Author: John F
Title: Nice food
Review: Good food, quick and friendly service. Try the Ikan Bakar. Along the roadside, which adds to the ambiance and very popular with the locals.

Author: reallyhungryhippoPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Pizza time
Review: Headed down to larisatta as i fancied a good wood fired pizza. How did it fare...The pizza is cooked in a HUGE brick oven. This thing can easily fit 10 to 15 pizzas without breaking a sweat, maybe more! Just laying eyes on this thing got me excited for some sliced goodness. Ive seen a few brick ovens in my time and handled properly i know this beast can churn out some legit stuff .I ordered a half and half seafood and smoked duck pizza. I felt like tasting some fresh seafood, something juicy, something with a little salt from the deep blue sea. And the combo of smoked duck, caramelised onions and anchovies was getting my juices going. Done right this thing was set to hit the table and make us all stand to attention.But that didnt happen. What i got instead was a total dissappointment. Lets check the crust and see what we're dealing with... something rather anaemic looking, so either undercooked or a cooked with a low oven temp. Flat so either inadequate oven spring because the oven was not hot enough or insufficient gluten development. Eitherway it was a flatbread biscuit pizza, aka characterless cardboard. Toppings were rather meh, adorned with a smattering of poverty seafood like watery, tasteless dory and rubbery prawns. Caramelised onions were not caramelised, the rocket was nice and fresh however and the duck breast whilst pre cooked frozen fare was still tasty and topped with a little smear of anchovies, which was nice. The oven is gas powered although they simultaneously burn a bit of wood in the corner of the oven so they can claim to be wood fired i guess? The chef assured me it gives their pizza a lovely smokey taste. This is a fallacy, but wasn't going to explain basic oven thermo dynamics to him. Good pizza is hard to find.

Author: Bala S
Title: One of the oldest restaurants..
Review: Best restaurants since old times,I use   to come here wen I was young with family, today after long time went there to eat palak paneer and butter nan..it is the best as last and same now..superb..☺☺

Author: Philb_201Sanderstead, United Kingdom
Title: Bland food and bad service
Review: Not a huge amount more to say unfortunately. We had to eat here as the night we arrived At the Renaissance hotel, the 2 other dinner restaurants were closed, I believe due to the refurbishment going on. The place was very empty at around 8. The buffet is around 140 MYR with hotel guests getting 30% discount - the one positive! We were seated, given a glass of water and left to our own devices, no intro to the restaurant/food/concept etc offer of drinks other than water, or told to go and help yourself. It wasn't bad service, as such, I.e the wait staff weren't rude, but it certainly wasn't good service. Luckily we just wanted water after a long flight, so the lack of offer of another drink wasn't terrible.The food itself had a fairly good selection, Malaysian, Indian, western - but all of it was very bland. My guess is they have toned it down for international visitors, but for me I want authentic when I travel, punchy flavours, the food in that night just didn't deliver it for me. I was disappointed.Good selection of desserts, tasty, but to be honest anything was tasty in comparison to the bland main courses. In summary, if that night was representative of the quality of food and service on other nights, I sadly wouldn't recommend, even with the 30% off - yes it was relatively cheap, but it was bad food and service. There are other much much nicer, slightly more expensive buffets around - such as Mosaic at the Mandarin Oriental - at around 160 MYR each. Sorry but this one definitely isn't for me, such a shame when it is the only restaurant available to guests in the hotel for a proper dinner!

Author: Ivan CMelbourne, Australia
Title: Don't have breakfast here
Review: I had breakfast here when staying at Le Apple the staff joke around and don't do much work, they seem too busy with each other to attend to customers properly. The plates, cups and glasses are the smallest I have ever seen not even as big as my hand, the hot food was cold and on the stale side, chicken nuggets for breakfast, amazing, the restaurant was small and crowded, don't eat here.

Author: vmco_mnlphManila, Philippines
Title: Not to my liking
Review: Reviews said their burgers are a must try, so I did. Was sorely disappointed. In fact, I enjoyed the side of fries and potato salad morethan the burger itself. The burger had an aftertaste that wasn't to my liking. Still, I appreciated their "no pictures" policy because guests can appreciate the quirky/hipster set up of the place. The decor, however, isn't unique in Melaka (saw lots of places with the similar style) so no regrets if one didn't get to go inside.

Author: CindyY193
Title: Aircord not functioning
Review: We had a very bad experience when we dine in here at sushi zanmai at the gardens as the air conditioning was not working today 28th May 2017. Business too good till no time for maintenance and customer had to go through this situation. We requeated to move to another seat but they say we are not able to do so...

Author: mwan_69Singapore, Singapore
Title: A Meal To Remember!
Review: We were celebrating a special occasion last weekend and visited this restaurant based on reviews on this site, it was definitely the right choice as we had an awesome time there.The ambience was pleasant and we were led to a very nice booth seat immediately, the servers were friendly and knowledgeable...who came to check up on us throughout the meal but were not intrusive. They were patient in explaining the very extensive menu with many options of different cuts/grades of steaks.What I found to be very helpful was an explanation page at the back of the menu which described what each cut meant as well as a detailed description of the doneness of the steak.We started the meal with Irish oysters which were very fresh and came with six different sauces....the seared scallops were delicious as well!Then we had the lobster bisque which was presented in a unique manner but was very tasty indeed.Ahhh...then the star of the meal arrived, premium Australian cut steak which had the perfect doneness that was requested for. The meat was tender and succulent and you had a choice of sauces...we choose the mushroom and special Béarnaise sauce. We also order sides, the creamed spinach and truffle mash potatoes....both were very good but the mash was especially divine, smooth and tasty with just the right touch of truffle infusion.We really wanted to end the meal on a sweet note, but were so very stuff that it was impossible to order dessert...no worries as it will be a great excuse to go back to this fantastic restaurant again.We thought that the prices were reasonable and will definitely visit this restaurant again during our next trip to KL.

Author: Terry_Kweh
Title: Tasty Babe!!
Review: The ribs, chewybakkwa, hoilam ting n you braise me up is very very tasty n r very generous on their lard. 🐷🐖🐖🐷

Author: ViaBenGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: It's the location more than the food
Review: This is a nice restaurant in a great location by the river - the outdoor tables are great to enjoy the view and the evening breeze just a short walk from the happy chaos of Jonker Street. Service is friendly but a bit amateurish, food is fine, the decor is Tourist artsy.Come here to enjoy the view - but Malaka has plenty of better places when it comes to food.

Author: V2090WWdanielpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No service mind at all
Review: On the way back to our resort from Cenang beach, my wife was quite in a rush, so couldn’t help but entered Casa del mar for restroom. When she went in to the rest room, one staff approached me and asked me whether I stay in the hotel. I said no. And the staff started scold me. He told me that using he toilet you are not stay with is like break into the house and use the toilet there. So sorry for the using the toilet even Im not stay there. Thanks to the staff, we cancelled the booking for the dinner there for the day after the event. They need to learn about what is the hospitality is.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: zalbetrippin
Title: Alif is the best
Review:
Thanks Alif for being a darling and making us feel like home 😊❤️

Deserves a promotion this boy 🐆

Food is good, love the ambience

Author: Ngan H
Title: Just ordinary
Review: This spacious restaurant serves typical Indian Muslim food. The food & drinks are so so. The service is lacking and slow in attending customers. Even have to wait to pay the bill. Never go again.

Author: sunnykhandelwal5Nagpur, India
Title: Fast moving, value for money, not the best ambience. Overall 7/10
Review: This is a fast moving, busy restaurant in Kuah. The ambience is not great, from outside it looks like a shady place. But the food is great. Its very cheap, very good in terms of value for money. Make sure you go here early. They dont take any reservations I believe. Its first come first serve. The sea food variety and taste are both top notch. Its an open kitchen. If you're a vegetarian or hindu by religion and are not used to the smell of the seafood, avoid going here, coz you can see the kitchen, and you can also see lobsters on other people's tables which are quite close by haha! Anyways, if you're a sea food lover, you will really relish this place! Enjoy

Author: navynectarine
Title: Awful Services
Review: + the food was better than ok but not amazing or great. + the tea selection was great! You will never run out of options. Hundreds of teas to choose from, you name it and highly likely it’ll be there. Unless you created your own name % the setting wasn’t too bad, at a quieter corner of the shopping mall, surrounded by high-end boutiques. This would create split, some people love the alfresco type of dining in a mall, some just don’t. - no one welcomed us at the entrance. Unacceptable for this sort of place. - our table wasn’t in right shape and form with some dirt on it. Only two tables occupied at that time. We looked for another table, not much difference. - the waiter was way too friendly, asking some inappropriate questions. It made me uncomfortable. I normally don’t mind if waiters are like that if they are talking about their food, giving suggestions etc. - and shockingly was when the waiter wanted to use my phone lying on the table as his support while writing our orders. First time ever in my life and it reached my limit until i had to tell him off. Give me a break, this is a proper place. - the food was ready and we found some cutleries were dirty. I politely asked to change the whole cutleries and another surprising move from the same waiter, arguing that the knife was clean. Again, just change the whole set. No need to argue with your customers. It was a simple request. Initially i rated 3 stars only because of its food. But after writing this review, it became unbearable to me with its bad services hence 2 stars. To the management, please send your staff for training courses. I could see potential in your waiter. With proper guidance, I believe he will improve and go even further.

Author: kingcjchrisBerkhamsted, United Kingdom
Title: Avoid
Review: Terrible service - 50 minute wait for a simple pasta dish, with others waiting over an hour for a pizza at a quiet lunchtime. Over priced with an unadvertised 10% service charge added to your total bill. Pleasant surroundings but certainly don't make up for the dire service.

Author: IanpatrickclarkeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: wonderfully athmospheric and the food is excellent too
Review: tucked in at the edge of the old town in an area that will hopefully be sensitively developed in future, this place is a wonderful step back into an older style of establishment, reminiscent of the Peranakan establishments of Georgetown and Malacca. Best of its kind we've come across in KL.Quite touristy, but wouldn't regard that as a negative in this context.

Author: cproffitt
Title: Hardly any food choices left
Review: We had the chicken curry and a salad, but only because our first two choices weren't available (and they didn't tell us about the second one until ten minutes after we ordered). Inexpensive, though and staff were friendly.

Author: jofrost678Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic choice of freshly caught fish at reasonable prices
Review: Dinner at the Jala is quirkily different. Sand replaces the usual floor with staff and guests in bare feet or flip flops and a chance to clean your feet with a high powered air gun when you leave which the children in particular will just love. The choice of fish is diverse and diners can choose from a set menu or select a fish from those on display and personalise the way it is cooked, along with the sauces and vegetables, etc. Great for sharing. There is also a limited choice of non fish dishes for the non fish lovers. Everything is beautifully cooked and excellent quality and I would highly recommend a visit.

Author: ShrutiN79
Title: Best in cenang
Review: Live band,beer,cocktails and food.Band could take fewer breaks.Table seating and barstools. No band on sundays.

Author: allanonthego
Title: HERD MENTALITY
Review: Went on a monday morning, having search tripadvisor it was good dim sum.Hold & Bewarned, they dun make the dim sum themselves. They probablygot it from a mass dim sum manufacturer or wholeseller. They re-steam it and serve..All dim sum dishes were cold and salty. Quality? None - when u have no control over the manufacturing process.The skin of har gau was too thick & filling salty.Siew Mai was bland/ tastelessChar Siew Pow flour was rough and filling was a llittle fat pork slice and salty.Nothing was good.You could eat better at any chinese roadside coffeshop selling din sum.Why queue for something that you can have very much faster & better at anysmall chinese coffee shop offering the same .Herd Mentality is so TRUE here.

Author: Jessica BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly service
Review: Stopped here for a quick lunch as we'd read on TA that it was THE place to eat Penang laksa. The laksa is very good, but it's basically the only thing on the menu and the kids didn't want to eat it... Not a problem for the helpful, friendly staff, who simply offered to get some fried rice for the kids instead (from one of the neighbouring cafés or hawker stalls I think - I don't know because the nice young man went and ordered it and it was brought to our table!) Try the durian coffee, even if you don't normally like durian - I don't, but the coffee was very nice!

Author: Borislikesbanofeepie
Title: Nothing to recommend
Review:
I can only form an opinion of a restaurant based on its food, ambience, service or value

On every score it's nul points from me on this one.

Author: Sashirekha
Title: Food to feed
Review: The restaurant is located near to the sea which you able to enjoy your food with the sea breeze. The food are kind of expensive like vegetable can cost RM30 for small plate. The service kind of bad as the waiters walking around pretending not looking or hearing to take orders. We was waiting for 1/2 hours till the supervisor came down to take order even though there was less people that time. There is service charges included plus the food are so so..
Restaurant: Tai Son Seafood Restaurant - The Zon

Author: FattyFoodieLovesFood
Title: Tasty food but quite pricy
Review: Some of the portion is too small with little ingredients (like their salad) but in general tasty thai fusion food.  Again, i do like their food but they can work on the portion a little as their price is really on the high side.

Author: Neish21
Title: Great service and delicious food
Review: the food service was great and the dimsum brunch was great. The climate of the restaurant is great with slow music. The design of the restaurant is something special and unique

Author: JanePhillipsEl Segundo, California
Title: Disgusting Food...How can you screw up a spring roll?
Review: The View is simply incredible...do to the floor below to see view. This place has some of the worst food I've ever had. I ended up eating just the cheese. Service was good but for the money (which was a lot) the food was an inch away from unedible

Author: 335anned
Title: Reasonable meal
Review: Went there following a recommendation from the Lonely Planet guide. Easy to find, good air con, friendly staff. Arrived around 8pm on a Monday evening, no queue and several tables to choose from. Good range of dishes, inc veggie, and catered to allergies well (nuts). Very reasonable prices, most dishes RM10-16, quick service. Food was tasty (we had one chicken dish, one veggie paneer dish, veg fried rice and a garlic naan. Only issue was a small cockroach that appeared on our table - the waiter saw this but as the cockroach disappeared off the table we stayed there. After it appeared 2 more times on the edge of the table, we asked to move tables, which they sorted quickly. Standard 10% service charge and 6% tax added to bill. Overall, a nice enough meal that was tasty and on par with any decent UK curry house with reasonable service.

Author: chyimingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Impressive selection of whisky...
Review: 1. Wide varieties of whisky2. Other drinks are available of course. It's call whisky bar for a reason tho....3. Had a chance to watch how the round ice cubes were made.4. Warm hospitality5. Knowledgable staff6. Drop by if you like whisky

Author: JH992Petaling Jaya
Title: Average buffet meal
Review: My family decided to eat here, having not been here for many years. Food, in general was average-to-good and service was attentive. We were not happy with the display of bottles of mineral water on the table. So low class. Not what we expected from the Hilton. Plus, they expect us to drink out of plastic??? We were told that the water is only available from the bottles and they are chargeable. They used provide water for free and tea and coffee were not part of the buffet. Now, tea and coffee is a part of the buffet but water is chargeable. Very petty of them. Sadly, not only were there no selections of different teas/coffee, what was served was not good. With so many hotels offering great buffets, there is no reason for us to come back.

Author: SarahG534
Title: Amazing Chinese food
Review:
Price of the food here is great and the service is the best. 

All of the dishes we had were beautiful and we left nothing on our plates.

Author: TravelAdvisorMunichMunich
Title: arrogant
Review: I went to that place because it was rated so high. But was dissapointed. Prices are almost as high as in the restaurant of the Holiday Inn Hotel. Owner was unfriendly. Did not make the impression that she cared about us being there. We talked about the preparation of food. When I told her that the dish called "Thai Style" was not the way Thais would do it, she replied, this would be her restaurant and she would define what Thai Style was.We ent to the the Gan Gan restaurant next to it. Owner was very nice and friendly. But prices again were quite expensive and dishes small. We found best value for price at Bora Bora restaurant right on the beach.

Author: myopinion112China
Title: Lovely spot although difficult to find within the resort.
Review: Great location on the beach with amazing views although we would not have found it if we hadn't gone walking around the resort. Staff at the reception just pointed us in a direction and left us to our devices. Loved the "loungy" feel of the décor. Drinks were okay and same prices are most other places. Had some scallops and pulled lamb sandwich which were really good but a pity we couldn't try the Tuna tataki that was finished. Our waitress was incredibly friendly and polite. The guy who we assumed was the manager was a touch overbearing but I am sure he was just trying to make sure we enjoyed our time there but the waitress was doing a perfectly good job of keeping us happy. We were there during the day but I would imagine that the sunsets would be amazing. Totally recommend.

Author: DR HARIHARAN SPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Getting good to bad
Review: Honestly the food quality has dropped. I used to come here very often for the cocktails and lamb. But now I am so very disappointed for the quality vs price I am getting. To keep up the competition change ur cheff and bartender. Today's food is completely hopeless... U guys use to do better than this

Author: YHY85Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Guttered by the dishes.
Review: The food quality and presentation of this restaurant was below standard. The prices of the dishes weren't on par with the food quality served, is doesn't worth that value at all.We ordered a Tom Yum Seafood Soup, I don't expect something fancy or elegant or super delicious but when the tom yum soup was delivered to our table, the bowl was dirty on the side (please refer to the photo attached) and immediately I loss my appetite of having this meal. The presentation of the tom yum soup just look like those you can have on the Thai street food, just unbelievable.Service was ok but food quality and presentation is just not up to the standard for the price you paid.

Author: yiningl2014Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced.
Review: Good atmosphere with lots of photo worth spots. Foods are all below my expectation. Cappucino had no rich flavor of coffee. The breakfast chain is definitely not worth the price and tasted bland. My french lady tasted like normal toast with a little sweetness. My friends ordered terry benedict and tinker bell and according to him the food tasted bland too. There are many more cafe that offer better food in kl. This place is only worth a visit if you need a decent post on your instagram but not when you needed a decent brunch.

Author: Nemesls03
Title: Awesome food and service
Review: My wife and I had dinner here and really enjoyed our meal :) The staff were friendly, attentive and open to feedback. We had the mala red snapper with added vegetables, mushrooms and bamboo clams. The batter of the fried squid side dish was pretty tasty too. Will definitely be back for more! :) Hope to bring our family here the next round.

Author: justme439Singapore, Singapore
Title: expensive and disappointment
Review: last week, 2 of us brought our relatives to visit Malaca and went to this place, had the following :-- popiah ( so so ) -- egg cincalok ( above average)-- ayam buah keluak (4 pieces of keluak) (so so)-- prawn petai ( where were the prawn ?? just tiny shrimp and a few pieces of petai)-- chendol ( smaller portion and less flavorful compared to what one could get in Jonker street)we were the only local eating there while the rest were europeans. the way of preparing the kuih pie tee was not hygienic. the lady worker used bare hand to pick up the ingredients. i suspect that our popiah was similarly prepared !! agree with some reviewers that cheaper and better food could be had at some other places.

Author: 836lottac
Title: Nice bananapancakes
Review: I took bananapancakes for breakfast and they were really good ones. A little bit too sweet for me so if you do not like sweet things so maybe you can say that they won't put any syryp..

Author: paulprit7
Title: Fabulous As Always
Review: A real favourite of ours. Food is out of this world, cocktails even better and so nicely presented. See my photos. All in all top class. For special service at the cocktail bar.....ask for George!!

Author: Sneaky_NutsSydney, Australia
Title: Interesting to visit and good noodle
Review: Found this place online so went to give it a try. Had 2 serves of noodles for 12RM total. Very yummy but don't expect menus and/or fluent English. We have passed this place by while trying to find it, it's tucked in behind the stalls and there is a guy in front of it frying banana fritters or something...lol... Nice experience and noodles great tasting.

Author: Happyholidayer7Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Love it here
Review: This time we were determined to stop here. We were on a cruise and only had a short time but this was a must. This time we had something to eat, even though we had had lunch on board. It was quiet when we arrived around 2.30 but soon got busier. The food was tasty and the Long Island as good as last time. The cocktail list was extensive. When I ordered the Long Island she asked if I realised this was in the section marked killer cocktails! We were last here 7 years ago and spent longer in Malacca so we're able to visit in the evening. The atmosphere was fantastic, with a live singer. I still remember the lovely evening, hence our determination to revisit. I highly recommend this place.

Author: VivianeTongMuar, Malaysia
Title: Overprice with So So Dining Experience
Review: Food is just ok. Not too impressive and not really matched with the ranking #8.Overprice oyster @68/pcs which i could have gotten half dozen @ plenty of fine dining restaurant at Bangsar and really fresh too. Salmon belly sashimi is quite tasteless.Overall got quite disappointed when we went all the way to try it out.

Author: manhattan64Hong Kong, China
Title: Absolutely the kind of places you won’t go back
Review: Heard some friends recommended this place for the Shark Fin Soup with Crab Roe although they said all other dishes are not too good. For a start, the soup is not real shark fin at all. It is some sort of glass noodles they used that is similar to the HK shark fin soup street food except the noodle is a little finer. As you let the soup sit for 8 minutes or so, the so called shark fin become real soft.The chicken satay is shockingly bad beside no taste of any charcoal, every skewers attached with a couple chunk of chicken skin. I don’t think I needed to go any further and waste my time to comment!

Author: pipped_upKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Well worth a visit!
Review: Thought that the reviews on here about this place were fake as I had walked past this place 1000 times and never thought about visiting. However, now after dining here I can see what the fuss was about. Great steak, fantastic service. Lovely evening for my wife and I. Many thanks!

Author: kitrasb7
Title: To improve
Review: Lamb shank biryani is very good...also, masala tea was more like a normal tea - so I won't order again. The portions are sufficient to fill the tummy though. Note .. if u don't rate then 5* u don't get 5% discount

Author: EllysulianaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Bad service, rude manager, mediocre food. Not a Nobu standard at all. The waiters were not properly trained. They didn't know the menus and certainly had no idea how Japanese food should be served. My miso soup only arrived last, after everything was finished. Will never go back.

Author: Genevieve E
Title: Yummy
Review: Great food nice staff pleasant ambience and clean for an middle to high end pricing cafe. Good for couples family and hangout.

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Close for afternoon prayers.
Review: Wanted to try this and because it's on Monday afternoon and it's our last few hours in Langkawi, we decided to drop by for some dessert after our lunch.Too bad it was close for afternoon prayers. But from what I know, afternoon prayers won't take half and hour or more. And most customers are willing to wait. So it was a bit disappointing that the ladies just ask us to get out. It's a Monday afternoon not a Friday afternoon prayers.So it's abit sad that I cant try this. And wish that the ladies could accommodate us. Because in my company too, the Muslim ladies took turn praying. And there were two ladies working.

Author: zai71
Title: Food for Thoughts
Review: I had been to this place a couple of times with friends and family. And I enjoyed every single visit to this place. The food is appetizing, a handful of choices and the service is fast. Do try their famous lemongrass special drink.

Author: EthanLee2903
Title: Good experience in The Round Tower!
Review: I came here the other day with my family and we really enjoyed our time there. Food was good, the ambience was lovely and the service crews was very friendly and helpful. Definitely would go again! Please do give their rose latte a try, something new and yummy to drink!

Author: Rustygirl888Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique but extremely very slow service
Review: We waited over 50-60 minutes for our family to receive our order. 2 of our party received their order but the rest waited and waited. Pretty typical in Malaysia but this was the worst I have experienced. After observing for a while it seems that that only 2 staff are doing all the work while the remaining staff including bosses stand around. Still didn’t get our order ! Won’t be visiting again any time soon. Terribly slow service.

Author: juliuso818
Title: Overprice
Review: Best of the food is plant rice  surf.Me.wrong food and.don't want me.to reject food is garbage too sweet no.tom yam.test

Author: SebastianAnuarSingapore
Title: Bad services
Review: I visited on August 2014 with my business partner. I need to bring out some suggestion which they need to improve. 1st, they missed out my booking and placed me to table near toilet area. 2nd, they served low quality ingredients with high prices, no worth for this kind of meal. 3rd, all service staffs are foreigner without proper services. 4th, noisy and a lot mosquitoes. End up we spend almost rm370 for the bill with only one red wine. We not satisfied what we had at this restaurant. Sorry no next visit.

Author: cathhhhhhSydney, Australia
Title: so cheap and tasty
Review: This place was about 3 min walk from hilton and pullman . We nearly didnt try it as at 6pm it was empty, but after passing it full at 9pm we went back the next night.We had calamari, chicken and seafood rice bake, plus big cheap beer. Came to $15 for 2....would def go back . many locals and fast service..top spot!

Author: kevinr499Chatham, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place, nice food
Review: A nice place to eat with good food. Prices are ok but it's a safe option. I would advise eating here and it is good but the food in the surrounding streets is a lot cheaper and just as nice. Plus you get to see how the locals do it rather than just a restaurant.

Author: nokbier
Title: Simple
Review:
Quite a regular here for their Nice place for breakfast, lunch and tea.

Nice dry mutton curry! Their veggies are delicious!

Author: 27paulsTonbridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great location. That's all.
Review: I expect to pay for a great location but the fancy burger was ordinary, salads good and the drinks very overpriced. Does a place like this really run out of chilled filtered water or various cocktails or is it just a scam to sell you a bottle of imported Italian water for an outrageous price? If it wasn't the location this place would not deserve to survive.

Author: nathesh
Title: Amazing restaurant
Review: Good day with great environment,, cool staff especially the manager NESH. I really enjoyed the day ... The pork chop is really great,tender and juicy.love it..💕

Author: desmondl138
Title: Fresh
Review: Very fresh sashimis and the bento is worth the price as it is very filling, nice place to have a fancy japanese meal. service is good as well, but it's pretty hard to get a parking here.

Author: sinead2358
Title: A must visit!
Review: Good food and drink flowing. Thanks for the great evening Paddy, Stev & Gene. Set the tone for our first night in Kuala Lumpur and nice to meet Irish on our one way trip.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Fpchong
Title: One good tourist attraction in Jonker Street
Review: Good place to hang out (better than HRC@Melaka) if you are going to Melaka.  But will be over crowded with tourist during the weekend.

Author: shiroatkl
Title: Good Choice
Review: Good choice of  chicken rice despite the long Q of 30min and another 15min for food to arrive. Chicken meat is soft despite being serve on the breast part.

Author: Nikmansolas13Dublin, Ireland
Title: Nice place let down by service
Review: Beautiful place and environment with good selectionOnce got busy service became horrible . Forgot my order , told one of the waiters and got ignored again no interest people avoiding contact it’s beyond any acceptable level. Compared to alilla branch day and night . Bad management .

Author: ASHAANANDANKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disgusted!!!
Review: The people running the Nu Sentral Nando's branch need to seriously look into the way the treat their customers. I was there with a friend for dinner on 10.11.2016. After dinner, i ordered a hot cup of tea. Whilst chating with my friend, the waitress comes with the bill - without me even asking for it. We were surprised by that but thought it was an honest mistake. I paid on the understanding that we could continue to sit there. 5 mins later- the manager, a Malay girl comes and tells me that we have to leave cos the table has to be given to some other customer as it was reserved earlier. What utter crap!!! she said she had no choice. In the first place, there was no reserved sign on the table when we sat there. And after 1 hr of sitting there, surely there was another table that can be given to the customer who just arrived. It is disgusting how you treat your customers. I am never going to your outlet ever again you

Author: josephlM3402PJ
Title: What a let down
Review: The food used to be good and delicious when Plan B first opened in Ipoh. After a number of years, we found the quality and taste of food to have deteriorated. The management has tweaked with the menu too much that it is no longer representative of the quality cuisine that Plan B in KL is known for. Yucks!

Author: SleekVoyageur
Title: Mediocre Italian Food
Review: Went there for a quick dinner during shopping break at Pavilion.An Italian restaurant which serves quite expensive range of food on the menu. They don't serve table water but imported mineral water which cost Rm15 per bottle!We ordered some starters, and pasta for main course.. Food tasted quite plain... With similar price range.. We would recommend ones to eat at restaurants upstairs from them.. such as Morganfields and The Barn, which we had gone back to eat everytime we visited Bukit Bintang..

Author: Heather0664Perth, Australia
Title: A Penang fine dining experience
Review: Visited here on recommendation from a friend in KL, as well as the Trip Advisor reviews. Lovely decor and ambience, with attentive service from staff. Really happy with our menu choices, especially the beef main course. The pandan brulee dessert was also special. I would like to give 4.5 stars, as it was one of our better meals whilst staying in Penang.

Author: Coastal758516
Title: Bad service, poor food quality
Review:
Had dinner today with family and the restaurant service is really bad. No spoons and when we asked for it, the waiter clears the dirty table before we have to request again for the spoon from the manager. 
Food quality is very average and not...worth the price we pay at all. 
Will not patronise the restaurant again.More

Author: Aishah BJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Big disappointment!
Review: Ordered Mexican Nachos, Chilli Crab Dip with Mantou, Lamb Steak & Crème Brulèè....Mexican Nachos....Nachos dip was good but too little cheese on nachos. Chilli Crab Dip with Mantou....total disaster! For the price of RM 35, not worth it!...very watery, minimum the crabmeat...they even pinched on the eggs! Colour not appetising at all....as per the photo....very deceiving. Lamb Steak....two slices of lamb was served....only one slice is edible, the second slice was tough..felt cheated!Crème brulèè.....custard was too sweet. The waitress brought the dessert without the caramelised sugar on top of the custard...but, when she saw my face expression, she got the cheeck to ask me whether I want the caramelised sugar!

Author: luaaysIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Bad service
Review: Unfortunately this nice place and good location under controlling of like these staff. They through the things we ordered and nobody show up later. Our table without ashtray and all our glasses is empty waiting to see any staff to finish our request. So, we decided to leave and finish our night with other place.

Author: jennylee3456Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing food.
Review: I visited this place last weekend and was disappointed with the food. Having frequented this restaurant for the last 28 years, I knew it wasn't the same. Looked around for the owner and was told he sold away his business. Well, definitely, way below the standard. Shall not be visiting it again. I guess tourists go there because of the reviews. A local portuguese friend told me to try Stall no. 4 or 5. If I do go, shall write a review on it. Good luck.

Author: beatricel330
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Food was great but what makes the restaurant amazing is their friendly service. Environment can be better, a bit warm.

Author: roryjdoyle
Title: Good range of buffet
Review: Good range of lunchtime buffet in this restaurant located in Hilton Petaling Jaya. Discounts for kids but drinks are not part of the buffet package.

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Rude staff and bad service
Review:
Food was just average and overpriced. 
Service was slow and bad. 
Staff was rude and unfriendly. 
This is definitely overrated!

Author: YusveenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good briyani, terrible service.
Review: With a few friends for lunch here as we heard here is the famous nasi beriyani in Kuala Lumpur. Waited about 10mins to be seated, 10mins for the waiter to take our order, and another 45mins for the food to be served! Waiter service is horrible. We ordered masala crab, and after waiting for 45mins we decided to ask the waiter to check our order. And they told us that it is unavailable. What? After waiting 45 minutes only the staff told us! Should have told us when we're taking our orders. And yeahh, i ordered an ice coffee. Ordered from 2 waiters and their manager. And it didnt came as well. End up, i have to self served myself. Went to the fridge and took the minutes maid orange juice by myself. (Which eventually i told the cashier about it, and he still show his arrogant look) ohh well, what can i say. Really terrible service..

Author: Tim M
Title: What a poor customer service
Review: Came here based on the ratings. Ordered some exciting options and a beer.Full of tourist families but I'm a tourist too.Asked after 30 minutes where my spring rolls were. Panic. 10 minutes later they came to see me and told me my crab main was off.Fawlty towers anyone.I asked them why it took 30 minutes to tell me my choices were off. Waitress ran away. Grabbed large Chinese waiter and asked for bill He brought bill for all food I ordered but hadn't received. Questioned this and he ran away with no comment. Then got bill for 30 MYR for one bottle of heinekinPaid guy and asked if he knew real restaurant where they actually served food. He recommended place across the street which they also own.Most people like this place so they are either luckier than me or have no sense.Don't ever come here is my opinion for what it's worth.Bummed out on Bukit Butang

Author: hellshoundKuching, Malaysia
Title: Just a grind😀
Review: Like sakae sushi, Im not complaining about ur bad service, terrible understaffed, utterly smucked crowd control ninieys....u wanna know what bothers me most? I can't afford to spend a million dollars to eat sushi to Japan, so I came to you hoping to see a glimpse of Japan, but all you guys offered were only a nutsack full of the japs od yakuza sense. Darn. Wont name the other smaller japs franchise around cause they made sense, they r lack of Japan too of course, but unlike u n sakae, u guys r big. Its nonsense and I mean ur a joke seriously, I didn't get it when I dine in ur cribs. Seriously lame.

Author: Pixel8Malaysia
Title: Horrible first time for 4
Review: Decided to try out the degustation sets here for anniversary dinner on a 11.11 weeknight. Our first time here turned to be a mistake overall. Food taste was amateurish, couldnt get the mix of ingredients here there. My deluxe set's only saving grace was the grilled langoustines but that was it. Sea urchin was bad, had to reject it and got replaced with a good one. The supposedly signature lamb for mains was just rubbery and old with tendons; the mushroom sides had sand/dirt which i was crunching into, urgh. Other 3 sets were just as bad, seabass mains were bland and mushy (not fresh). Duck was bland. Fortunately the chosen Rongopai house white was good to wash it all down. Turned out the usual chef was on long break,leaving the assistants to hold the fort. Not a good risk, this is what can hurt reputations, bad timing really. Hope the other 3 tables of customers had better luck that night.

Author: nyavtechKuching, Malaysia
Title: Jury is out
Review: To be fair, the Hilton had just reopened after being a quarantine hotel. Toh Yuen was serving a limited menu. Dim sum at lunch was not available which was a shame as I had been looking forward to that.I ordered the braised fish lip and crabmeat soup, expresso glazed shrimp, and fried eggplant with salted fish. The soup arrived nice and hot with contrasting textures. Not sure I got my coffee rush from the shrimp, they were large and crunchy reflecting their freshness. Need to try them again when they resume full operations. In the meantime the jury is out.

Author: ogajimDubai, United Arab Emirates
