Title: Pleasant but not exceptional
Review: This place stands out on the strip of restaurants & cafes which it occupies because of it's good decor and welcoming frontage but there are other places which offer better reasonably priced food and which give a better feel of the 'local' Batu Ferringhi & Penang. For those who like Stongbow and Guiness (bottled) it is available here although expensive. This is a comfortable place with excellent service from the proprietors offering a good selection of local and western dishes (including breakfast with 'real' bacon) but none more than many other more 'authentic' Penang establishments nearby. Prices are reasonable but better food at better prices is available elsewhere locally. This is a place which appears to cater for western & Australian/NZ tourists who are not at ease outside of the general environment which they are probably used to back home.

Author: juliet lBuckinghamshire, UK
Title: Top class
Review: We are staying at a different hotel but decided to book a table going by a friends recommendation. We had a drink in the bar at the Datai first which has beautiful views through the forest to the sea.We were taken by electric buggy to the restaurant which was great fun and went right into the forest which is where the restaurant is situated. Service impeccable and so courteous and the food was outstanding. Slightly more expensive than other restaurants we have eaten in but still extremely good value compared to U.K. prices. If you are staying at another hotel best value is to get a taxi and they wait for you for a nominal charge the only other way back is to get the datai to use their car to take you back take you back but that was still reasonable 80R for a 25 minute journey (about £13) the taxi is 50R Lovely evening - highly recommended - menu is Malaysian and some beautiful fresh fish and seafood you can select yourself.

Author: PradnyaRaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lebanese food for the first time
Review: Hopped in to experience Lebanese cuisine and I must tell you it was quite interestingly. We tried the Mazze, which comes with Bread and variety of salads and dips (hummus) was one of them. One portion of this is good for a group of 3-4 people. We also got Arayez, a mince meat preparation stuffed inside bread, which was well prepared as well.

Author: leonintoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ok, nothing special
Review: Gf and I were going to watch a movie after dinner in KLCC so walked around a bit looking for a restaurant. The Korean restaurant that used to be really good here went downhill a bit in quality, so we looked for something new and ended up here. Had a beef dish, papaya salad, and a tom yum soup. The decor and atmosphere feels more high end, but the food is just average. Nothing wrong with it and portions were acceptable for the venue, but won't be coming back.

Author: edenmelody
Title: Terrible experience and will not return
Review:
First table to reach but not first to serve and after 30 mins our food is not prepare still! 

Not gonna visit anymore for sure.

Author: jongs705Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: My all time favorite
Review: I won't say it's really nice, but it is definitely addictive. Look at the long queue under the hot sun everyday. You will not only find the tourists but also many local will go for it. Those regular will just bring their own container to pack the curry fish head home.

Author: bountyaway
Title: Time Out
Review: Were told about this place by a hotel guest we met.Had a lovely meal,well cooked and service was great.

Author: RutheranS1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The descent contines
Review: This was one of our most memorable places. We remember it when it started. Open , multi cuisine and great ingredients. It then got better and better and then worse and worse. Service suffered and then the cuisine suffered. From valet to waiter it was service for the whose who. Yesterday I approached with a request for a place for 3. The answer - what do you mean by place. Appreciating English standards today I rephrased - table for 3. Then came the retort - you mean you want to eat here. Wait ahhh wait ahhh. One staff talks to another and another to another. Then against the backdrop of an empty restaurant - sorry we are full. That’s after the round robin of stupidity. YTL is a great owner and their boldness of concept and leadership sets them apart. They need to look at this property seriously. Even in the main lobby of the Marriott an expat manager manning a best next to the main entrance leans over his work station with him foot placed on his seat and his chest leaning into his knee.... but all said the Chiu chow was wonderful as always and truly welcoming as they have over these many years.

Author: ZYXWVUTSBristol, England
Title: Could do better
Review: This restaurant lets the whole hotel down. There's nothing actually wrong with it - and the food is pretty good (though the fresh fruit service at breakfast is inadequate and runs out much too early), but the service is inadequate (managers - go down the road to the Shangri La and pick up some tips). Tables are left uncleared, mess created around the servery is not cleaned up fast enough (or at all). The staff are all caring and smiling but seem to lack proper supervision.

Author: ParisAnonymePARIS
Title: An overate place that offers a poor cuisine
Review: The service is attentive and pleasant, as well as the building itself. However, the interior decoration is really outdated. The cuisine is very poor: everything is fat or too sweet or tasteless. Even the salad lacked freshness. All this at prices higher than those observed in equivalent establishments.

Author: Peter C
Title: Very enjoyable meal and experience
Review: The meal was good and plentiful.Interesting decor and nice atmosphere.Staff very friendly and obliging.Drink prices - 28MYR for tiger beer and 25MYR for glass of white wine.

Author: Rhiannonj86
Title: Tasty
Review: Very tasty food for a cheap price. Good banana leaf food and some traditional food on the menu. Good service, they were helpful explaining what stuff was to us.

Author: 266gmail
Title: Two Frenchie Restaurant In Penang, Malaysia
Review: Our travel group of 6 had s delicious dinner st Two Frenchies.  Highly recommend you make reservations   Place is small but very  accommodating  and intimate  Great service Ownerd are perdonslly involved with their clientele Very good food , delious desserts and wine  A culinary  exoerience

Author: DonPauleone
Title: Decent food, decent value, poor service
Review: Food was fairly tasty, if a bit bland. Service was not great though. Price was reasonable, nothing really memorable.

Author: You S
Title: The food is nothing compared to the ones in KL/Selangor
Review: The only thing I'd credit this restaurant for is probably the service. But trust me, if you're from Selangor or KL you would've been to better seafood restaurant that serve much more delicious seafood. Idk why it's called the 'best seafood in town'. I don't think it can even survive a year in KL or USJ or even Kota Kemuning.

Author: abrogers2001
Title: Disappointing - owner absent
Review: We went here but could not get served because the owner was absent.  Nice outdoor eating area by the river.

Author: lchiu28
Title: Excellent
Review: They are very efficient. The price is reasonable. Not long queue. Great choice for getting Ipoh specialties. The chicken taste good.

Author: H4487QWmuhammadaBatu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: Poor quality food, accused by management for no show
Review: This is the 3rd time visit to Contango for buffer dinner night.1st visit was excellent, widespread choice, decent food quality, Widespread choices of sashimis, oyster, seafood, red meat.2nd visit was around a month ago, food quality worse. No more tuna or salmon sashimi, no oysters, turkey was bland and rubbery3rd visit is the worst experience. Food quality was poor and not being refilled.The worst part that triggered me to write this review was the restaurant management reported to the 3rd party reservation company for no show, which reflected bad profile for our account. Come on, we have receipt , credit card transaction to proof that we fulfilled our reservations.Please investigate this matter and i expect apology for both side.

Author: avinashchandraaBengaluru, India
Title: Poor food and very poor service
Review: We were extremely disappointed with both food and quality of service. They charge for everything like wet towel, glass of water, nuts etc. Ordered spring rolls and diced chicken with walnut in soya sauce and paid RM 51. There is a 10 percent service charge. It took more than 40 mi T to bring food.

Author: Normski3232Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Huge portions
Review: Great restaurant, albeit hidden, don't let it out you off. Tables at he far end of the room are great for enjoying dinner with a view. Portions are generous and tasty. Great place for drinks too, a night cap venue for sure.

Author: themushroomsociety
Title: A memorable first time to eat rice balls!
Review: Great food, great host, and a lot of potential to be the best place to eat chicken rice balls in the town center! The lady host wasnt able to give us roasted chicken rice on time as it was still being prepared and we were delighted to get a complimentary small serving of it. Awesome! Worth the trip.

Author: BallyD7
Title: Exciting journey of delicious foods
Review: I was introduced to this place by couple of friends, and I brought a special person in my life for the first time here. So my wife who is a pasta fan, she was blown by the way it was prepared hence it became our favourite place to go. During diwali last year, they had the specials "THE BRIYANI" my GOD! I almost died out of happiness! Vins! A definite place to go and have their amazing food!

Author: fresky_xu
Title: Food is very good
Review: The food is very good, and the price is lower than Cenang area. You have to wait in rush hours. Opening from 5pm to midnight.

Author: 12Kathleen89
Title: Really nice Japanese food
Review: We went here a couple of times for dinner. The sushi is freshly made and very tasteful. We also tied some of the Bentley boxes which were also really good. We can also recommend the dombury. Nom nom nom

Author: Danny KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Interesting food court in the market
Review: This central market is not a fish market as there is another fish market nearby. At the rear section of this market are some food stalls, less than ten in all serving popular local dishes like kolo mee, curry laksa, fried noodles and the soupy versions. The food on offer here are decent at best but cheap. They are sold out quite early as soon as market ends, I guess.

Author: Nroviano
Title: Rude waitress
Review: I was there with my family, everything was fine until 1 waitress shouting at us she’s so rude just because THEY accidentally doubled our order, we were so confused because it wasn’t our mistake but why that waitress shouted at us.

Author: Woktraveller
Title: Excellent food
Review:
We ate here quite often as the food was excellent and very reasonably priced
Highly recommend.

Author: sambZ7801IB
Title: 3,5 I guess
Review:
Almost 4 in rating 
Service was good even if the place was quite full. Appetisers came quick, so did the drinks. 
Food was ok
Not great and not poor= 3,5
Will be back to try again

Author: How-ShoongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor customer service and follow up
Review: We had our 10th wedding anniversary celebration at Lafite fifteen years ago. Service was excellent, food was great.We decided to go back for our 25th wedding anniversary. Had a poor experience. The night before I called up to make a reservation. It was 9.50 pm and I was told by the operator there is no one to entertain my booking. Then she said someone will call me back tomorrow, so I left my number. No follow up call, so I decided to celebrate at another fine dining restaurant.

Author: 813krish
Title: Tastefull and good looking
Review: Great looking place to sit down, relax and cool down during a break of wandering through Georgetown. The drinks are looking great on pictures. But more important, it tastes really good.

Author: drzulkarnain1969
Title: Fantastic View
Review: The revolving restaurant is unique..one can see KL's beautiful skyline from the tower..food was ok as there were a variety of foodstuff..taste was good..

Author: JRF892Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Indian meal we have ever been served
Review: We chose the Palace Feast and expected a variety of aromatic and subtle flavours ranging from mild to hot. What we got was a bland, insipid, stodgy mixture which had less flavour than a frozen instant dinner. Meats were overlooked to the point that it was difficult to discern what meat we had been served. Main course plates were cold and the dishes appeared to have been heated in a microwave. Breads were shiny with grease. The only truly edible element was a grilled prawn. By the time the home made dessert arrived we could only laugh as it was served with silver foil which might have been an attempt at garnish.....or the wrapper.A truly awful meal.

Author: PaperStoneScissors
Title: Not very Italian
Review: We visited this restaurant and wouldn't call it particularly Italian.  It was as if the restaurant has given up on being Italian and has gone for the local clientele instead.  Ever heard of Duck Pizza with Bechamel sauce before?

Author: Ken J
Title: Nice food
Review: Great cheap eat close to Waterford . Nice food freshly squeezed juices good service. Second trip to kuching always manage to drop-in there for a meal

Author: MOHDAZLANA2
Title: Great place for quality time with friends and family.
Review: Had a great time at the restaurant, everyone at the dinner was really happy with the food - delicious & authentic. The deserts(rasmalai and carrot halwa) are to die for. Service was excellent and professional as well. Cool ambience, beautiful paintings and decorations. There's a live traditional music performance too while having quality time with friends and family.Highly recommended for those who would like to have authentic North Indian cuisine.

Author: comfy2Hampshire, United Kingdom
Title: Colonial charm retained in this institution
Review: Durbar has the chef and staff led by Kelvin from Ipoh Swimming Club. It retains all those favourites I remember from my childhood like the steaks and rather delicious banana fritters. This was the bar in the colonial days for expats and still retains the charm and history.

Author: 926jonhNottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Head for hights it's a long way up and very polished
Review: Great experience food and service were excellent... the best bit was sitting on the open air looking up at the Petronas towers with some nice wine ... and great people

Author: HouW12
Title: Overrated, bad service and food so so
Review: No one leads you to the table booked. You have to call the staff few times to order dishes and serve/refill tea. Food so so only. Waited for half an hour for the dessert after meal. Better check the bill properly before pay cause there are additional few titbits charged for our case. Saw this in other comments not sure is this their tactic to extra? Not worth it especially paying to their lousy service fee. Overrated and definitely will not visit again.

Author: peol75Krasnoyarsk, Russia
Title: 2D кафе
Review: Пишу отзыв на Трипадвизоре по этому кафе первым. Местечко впечатлило своей оригинальностью. Получаются интересные и необычные фотографии. Что касается меню - в основном напитки, десертов нет. Отдельно отмечу, что мы были первыми посетителями, но в кафе было грязно. Столики в пятнах каких то напитков, пол грязный. В один из двух туалетов просто противно входить. Далековато добираться. Из центра мы ехали на такси почти сорок минут. Кафе рекомендую только для фотосессий. Покушать - не сюда. Если мой отзыв был полезен - ставьте пальчик вверх

Author: matthewchanalang
Title: Overpriced Bad Pasta!!
Review: Excellent service with great prompt efficiency. Sadly that was overshadowed by the LOW quality of their food. We ordered the seafood spaghetti marinara which costs over RM50 (when taxes and service charges were included). I’ve tried A LOT of seafood spaghetti marinara over the world: from London to Italy to Hong Kong. This was by far the worst version as it:1) only included 2 FROZEN non fresh “tiger prawns”, around 5 clams and 2 squid rings (I know they are trying to keep the cost low but come on!).....2) had an excessive amount of pepper and salt....3) the spaghetti were too thick....Their pizza was great though! We ordered one drink, one pizza, one mushroom soup and one very unsatisfying seafood spaghetti. It all came to around RM150.Go to the BASIL PASTA HOUSE in KUCHAI. It’s by far the best pasta I’ve had in Malaysia. They make fusion Italian dishes that can compete with the best I’ve had in Europe!

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Interesting German Food...
Review: We were passing the stall to get to the other end of the small food court when I noticed the Tripadvisor sticker. So I looked up the entry in Tripadvisor and saw many favourable reviews for this establishment.Initially we ordered only the cakes - banana chocolate and vanilla almond (if I recall correctly) but as we were finishing the cakes I thought why not have a light lunch as well and proceeded to order the currywurst with potato salad and another with fries.The cakes were homemade and I can vouch that they don't have the 'perfection' associated with mass-produced cakes sold franchises. They tasted mild and not cloyingly sweet, the same way mum would have baked hers.The currywurst was nice. I don't have any experience eating original currywurst elsewhere so I can't really compare it against any set benchmark. The curry sauce was reminiscent of Japanese curry, with hints of spices, sweetish and thick. The potato salad had some grated cucumber in it giving it a slight crunch.Overall a good meal at affordable prices.

Author: De87De87Sydney, Australia
Title: Disappointing yet again !
Review: When we first ate here, this place was packed and I understood why ! Food was amazing ! But not anymore ! My BF and I ordered steaks and I ordered the surf and turf , food was lukewarm, seasonal veg was a pile of sprouts , scallop was raw ,lobster was more like a small yabbie , only plus was the steak was nice . My BF enjoyed his steak , staff are lovely ! Coupled with the fact we had to put up with some very loud dinners made for a very unpleasant evening ! Definitely not worth the $$$ paid

Author: sveltedinerBucks
Title: Just the sort of place you always hope to find for local food
Review: Cosy feeling to place, quirky chill decor, warm welcome - host will sit and chat with you, great food, couple of reasonably good random singer/guitarists on Saturday night. Go early in your visit - you will probably want to eat there more than once as confirmed by the steady stream of regulars and repeaters on our two visits.Onto the food.Everything really good, work your way through the favourites on the board.Beef rendang, their signature dish, is awesomeSatay one of the better ones, especially the peanut saucePenang fish curry - excellent - real taste of Malaysia with nice sweetness and balanced heatChill squid - best food so far according to familyStir fried green stuff (can't remember name) - outstandingCold beer at reasonable prices, also do G&T which is not the case with all of these smaller places.Also went to Andrew’s which I would recommend for a visit, but this was the winner for a second evening out.

Author: WSLEE74
Title: Disappointed !
Review: Brought my family to chew jetty around 7pm. Thought of taking dinner nearby before going into the jetty. CF was the nearest food court around. Ordered few dishes there and all the food was not up to the standard. Will not visit again

Author: YP_SiowJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Bad, Bad Service Attitude
Review: From outside it looks interesting because of the high facade. The neon decor inside depicts several kungfu figures (beware of copyright infringement... a restaurant chain in China is recently being sued by Bruce Lee's family for using his image as logo without consent). "Kungfu" obviously refers to the effort the kitchen put on the dishes, but the Chinese signboard suggests only Wengchun as the Kungfu they are using, conveniently borrowed from the popular Hongkong movies.Might not be that bad right I guess? Wrong.The menu is so disoriented and unorganized. One has to mix and match his choices of noodle, side dishes and soup. I know this maximize profit but it's just confusing. You have no idea how much are you paying for the meal until you solve the math puzzle. And that's not the worst.The waitress did not know the ordering sequence too when asked. She got the captain, an arrogant chap. The show begun.He told me at a fast pace flipping the menu impatiently how to get my order done. And on the font page you need to decide what type of noodle ingredient, namely xxx and potato. Excuse me, potato noodle? The Chinese writing was "土豆 ground nut", which in local Hokkien dialect it is nothing but peanut. Mandarin for potato is 馬鈴薯. I told the chap how it should have been perceived. Moreover not all parts of mainland China term potato as "ground nut", it is more colloquial than professional. He obviously got pissed and started to argue to make his points heard. He said all of their ingredients came from China as such the terms in the menu follow. Well either he was naive, oblivious or ignorant, or just trying to cover the typo mistake. Guess what, he walked off.I walked off too, of course.There is not a single reason for me to dine at Kungfu Noodle while there are many just across the aisle. Your meals are not cheap too.

Author: 279ericaiVancouver, Washington
Title: Would never recommend.
Review: I would not recommend this place to others. This was my experience: We first sat inside, but the air conditioning was so cold that we ended up moving outside. A nice Indian man was serving us. We ordered a chicken pancake appetizer, which was like chicken friend in a delicious breading, which was quite good. I then ordered the seafood pasta, and my friend ordered the chicken pasta, neither which were supposed to be spicy. After we ordered a table of girls sat down at a table nearby and ordered, and we were a bit put off when they got their meals much quicker than we did. One of the women had ordered the seafood pasta like I did, and complained about how spicy it was, which made me nervous. My friend and I spoke of maybe her idea of spicy is very mild, and agreed that if I couldn’t handle the spice in my pasta, we would switch plates. We began to get slightly annoyed with the wait, but then they brought our entrees out and apologized for the wait. My friend began to eat his dish and commented that it was spicy. Literally as soon as I put mine in my mouth I knew there was no way I could eat it. It was literally probably the hottest thing I’ve ever put in my mouth. My friend saw my face and immediately took the plate and took a bite, and within seconds he agreed that it was insanely spicy, much spicier than the mild Thai food that we had, and we put it to the side to send it back. I’ve never sent back a meal before, but I cannot even explain the level of spice in this dish, almost like someone put harbenaro sauce all over it. The waiter came back and we explained, and he said that he would bring back one without spice. A manager went to the table of the girls next to us and they complained to him, and even pointed at my friend and said, “look at how hot it was, he was even sweating!.” It turned out that they had borrowed a cook from another restaurant who did not cook it correctly. By this point my friend had even decided the chicken pasta was too spicy, and set it to the side. When they finally brought the seafood pasta out we were starving and very quickly shared it and left. The seafood pasta that was brought out without spice and very little flavor. For the wait time and time and the inconvenience of everything we wish some food would have been taken off of our bill. Overall we really had a terrible dinner here and would not return nor recommend it to others.

Author: YaseLisa
Title: Very delicious and authentic malaysian food!
Review:
We don't eat meat or fish and found here tatsy delicous vegetarian dishes wich we ate with rice!
We had mixed veggies and the eggplants!
With a water and a little dessert we payed only 30myr at all!

Author: Gabe6134 PMiri, Malaysia
Title: Suggary Curry! Totally Not For Indians
Review: Very nice place, scenery is exquisite but as a foody you must say the quality one of the biggest building blocks of food is definitely not on the table and as I may state I am a foody this is no place for anyone to eat a nice Indian meal. I must absolutely say this restaurant is in no way expectable to nice food I'll tell you now if you want good food you need to eat at the one and only Miri Marriott.

Author: karynthong
Title: Best spot for dinner ever!
Review: Went here for dinner with my little sister. A waitress who named Fatin are very nice and good service! Vote 5 stars a part because of her. We do really enjoy our dining time at here. Foods, drinks and those stunning view, love it! Definitely will pay a visit again!

Author: 5bhavin
Title: Best Italian in Asia
Review: The pizza and pasta at this restaurant were AMAZING. The standard of food was great and also one of the best tasting Italian food in Asia. The choice of drinks are also great.Staff is very friendly and located in a very convenient place. Safe to go even later on in the evenings.Definitely would recommend this restaurant if in KL.

Author: A_Julieana
Title: Homemaker
Review: Truly a personalised service-oriented stay. Staff made the added effort to pander to my every request and made by birthday a special day indeed.

Author: NadeemN
Title: Words cannot describe...
Review: I believe that until I eat there again, I will wake up in the middle of every night craving the Nasi Lemak from Madam Kwon's...

Author: Sharon V
Title: Best fine dining experience
Review: Been here a number of times and was never disappointed. The food served is excellent and the ambience is just great. Their staff are friendly too and offer good service to us.  By far had the best fine dining experience here.I'll definitely return!

Author: AsiaMorganSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Chinese food, stylish environment
Review: I first ate at Dragon-i in Hong Kong years ago where it's a stylish restaurant with nightclub. Now they seemed to have blossomed into a multi-branch restaurant chain in key Asian cities. I enjoyed a lovely dinner at the Dragon-i in the Pavillion in KL. The food is fairly Shanghai-focused (I think) with a key focus on Peking Duck. I'm thrilled to report the food is truly outstanding in every possible way. We enjoyed the duck, noodles, veggies, appetizers, etc. All fresh, well cooked and fresh - as authentic as any Chinese restaurant in my opinion. Oh, the decor is very stylish and nice - fairly traditional Chinese formal approach. Service is quite good, very helpful to Westerners. Highly recommended.

Author: priyakasinathanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Buffet Lunch for Mother's Day 09/05/2016. Session 1.30pm-3.00pm
Review: Generally the restaurant ambiance is well managed. We have paid RM450 including additional RM25 for window table.Unfortunately, we did not get adequate food. We started off on a regular buffet serving with the Starters. When we went to the spread for the Main course, there was nothing much left, the dessert had finished too.When the Chef was asked if there's going to be any replenishment, the reply was "No", the time was only 2.15pm then, whereas, the buffet is from 1.30pn - 3.00pm. It is truly unfair on us for what we have paid. If the lunch is till 3.00pm, the Crew should ensure food is available till then. Very disappointing.Priya. K

Author: Orhan A
Title: One of the worst experience I ever had.
Review: Two friends an me were there to enjoy some drinks and dinner. icecoffee tasteless. Cocktails also bad. we ordered 2 meelsSpaghetti with dryed beef: spaghetti was swimming in oil but still hard to eat. my dish was with some seefood , the housing of Shellfish was broken and inside my meal. At least they tried to change it: the other one still had some brocken housing pieces, so I couldnt eat it at all . One star for the service guy, very friendly !

Author: Cassandra Y
Title: Awesome Pawsome!!
Review: Last night my friend and I decided to eat sushi, so we eat here. "Shake Sashimi" (Salmon) was really fresh, which you should try it! At last, we eat dessert, Vanilla Monaka Ice-cream. Ohh, it's super duper yummeh! But I would like to apologize for you guys got to work a little longer as we're the last customers to come out..Didn't know it close at 10pm as we were first time here. However, your service are really great! Definitely will come back again and recommend this to my friends & family.

Author: brommie-diverPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lunch only set menu, dinner ala carte
Review: Nice setting, food was okay and the waiters were quite pleasant and helpful. Had cream beef and butter rice, served with a plate of salad. Cream beef was good and tender but butter rice was dry, not buttery... tasted more like nasi goreng cina. That made the meal a little overpriced.

Author: Asia-aficionado
Title: Tasty fare, fresh. Pricey.
Review: Filling, fresh and served piping hot. The fish balls here are nice - that's what they're famous for - however, the price is a bit on the high side. But a great place to go for a simple, fast and filling lunch.

Author: Yen900Toronto, Canada
Title: Disappointing
Review: I would say it was rather a disappointing revisit to Senya. Was a regular customer last year and would come here once a week. Recently, made another visit down here after being away for a few months and the quality of the food has gone down leaving me rather disappointed. The service was a lot worse than before with a lot of waiting and wrong orders. It goes to say that Senya has not managed to maintain its quality over time. Would not be returning anymore.

Author: Lucy CCairns, Australia
Title: Great location, poor food!
Review: My husband and I attended this restaurant based on Reviews and must say we were disappointed with our food choices which were extremely oily/greasy and covered or should I say swimming in rich over powering sauces. The location was quirky and enjoyable. Also they do not sell bottles of normal wine!

Author: ShameemaCape Town
Title: Horrible
Review: Possibly one of the worst places i've ever eaten at. Poor service and extremely poor quality food. There were at least 5 types of drinks we tried to order and the waiter kept coming back saying they had no stock. The waiter then hovered and kept asking with 15 second intervals for a drinks order. Same with the food. The menu is not very descriptive other than the pictures. When you ask what's in the dish, you get a "yes" Ordered 6 different dishes which we all shared and each one of them was terrible. 3 of the chicken dishes had chicken along with various bits of seafood. Not a place I would ever visit again or recommend.

Author: Grace EKL
Title: Bias Waitresses
Review: Came here for lunch since there is no other nearby eatery in sight. We have had great experience with Souled Out Sri Hartamas anyways. So we thought we should give it a try.The usherer told us there is no place to sit inside as they were all booked or reserved. It was a hot day and I do not feel like sitting outside so we insisted to sit inside and they somehow managed to find a place for us. We were seated right under an ac blower so the moment the food arrived it got cold right away. Food was just so so for us. Most disappointing was the waitresses whom we could not help but noticed were overly attentive only to Caucasians patrons; the majority of them in the restaurant and bar. Took us longer to be served and whenever we ask for something we had to ask for is twice or thrice. Bad experience. My husband is an ardent tipper and he did not this time. Will not come back.

Author: chocolates30
Title: Lunch
Review: Delicious food. Portions are big. Service is great. Love their complimentary lemon drink.They also serve fruits for combo meals.

Author: Gaelssl
Title: Bad service
Review: We were singled out. No chili sauce and plastic gloves given to us. Very bad service here. Will not recommend this place to anyone. It's not even crowded. Only 2 tables out of 5 taken including us.

Author: Frans dSan Antonio, Texas
Title: Great ambiance and excellent food
Review: We came to visit the Hindu temple next door, but they were cleaning and closing up.Sitting down for dinner in Sri Ganesa Restaurant seemed like a good idea.And it certainly was.Some of the waiting staff speaks limited English (and how good is your Hindi?), so it is possible to get a bit of confusion. But that is all part of the joy of traveling.The food was excellent, the service was quick and the staff helpful. Try the different roti's! Be aware of the basins to wash your hands.Certainly a place we will return too. It was a great experience!

Author: Vishnu407Seremban District, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated and over priced
Review: This restaurant has all the elements to succeed except good food. I've never paid so much for a meal that tasted this terrible. It's advertised as authentic malay cuisine but In reality it's simply terrible versions of authentic dishes which would cost an arm and a leg. The service was fair, ambiance nice (even though it felt like a furnace), but the food was way below palatable levels. The best part is , this restaurant is trying to portray fine dining with Michelin star prices but is miles away from that mark. So.. If you are interested in trying authentic malay food but not really particular about how it taste and what it cost then perhaps this would tick most boxes..

Author: Lina E
Title: Delicious salad!
Review:
We ordered the Parlls r  Mariscos which was ok but nothing special. The
 Ensalada de espinacas was very good. The ambience is cosy and the service is great. Prices are reasonable.

Author: AI1980
Title: Great Indian Food
Review: Since we live in JB we had 2 been 2 times here and where always very very satisfied. We tried several dishes all good and they come with the spice level you like. Prices are also very reasonable

Author: AnkitBaid
Title: Average Service and Food
Review: Mostly south Indian food. IF you like south Indian food, it would be a good place to visit. If you prefer north Indian cuisine, better off looking for other places as you will not have too many options here

Author: dreamiconKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: I expected to try here cuz this place shows high rate among sea food restaurant in Langkawi. However, I couldn't find any special in this restaurant. A lot people que up to get a table & service time is too slow. I waited the food more than 40mins. Lobster was really good but other than lobster everything was an average. (Do not try their seafood fried rice) Over rated

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Char Siew Rice & fried osyter
Review: The most popular char siew rice at noon & fried osyter at evenning. Always required a wait to get your order

Author: Kannan PPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unhappy experince at the FLOUR
Review: At the recommendation of friends we went to the FLOUR Bukit Damansara last night for dinner. Reviews were very good and so were our expectations - we were very let down and disappointed. My friend ordered Chicken Briyani and my choice was Mutton Briyani. The rice was well prepared but the spices were average ; we were very unhappy with the very frugal servings of the meat ; my friend found a few small pieces of chicken and I was shocked by my serving of mutton - 2 small ribs with hardly any meat, a joint with only tendons and no meat and only 1 small piece of mutton about the size of a 10 cent coin !!. We have eaten briyani in many places in the world including of course in our homes but the experience in the FLOUR was terrible. All restaurants have a moral obligation to be fair to their patrons. I will not quibble about taste as it is an individual expectation but quantity and quality of food should not be compromised upon especially in an upmarket establishment like the flour - essentially we felt ripped off and remain very surprised by the many positive experiences that other diners have written about. We will certainly NOT be recommending this restaurant to our friends.Kannan Pasamanickam

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Great Food..
Review: I could not find any fault in the food, all great and 2 thumbs up. Try the Philipinnes Egg plant, that looked like french fries..crispy and tasty. Service is prompt eventhough the restaurant was full. Well done, and thank you for 1 of the best food that I ever had in restaurants.

Author: C3451ZUmichaeltVoesendorf, Austria
Title: Dinner @ Bert's
Review: Staffs are Friendly. Nice ambience overlooking at sea. Food are not bad, except the butter prawns & anchovies are oily. Maybe should consider cereal prawns. The grill fish is fresh but should have more sambal to spicy it up. The chill sauce should be sweet then fish sauce. Sorry Bert is my honest comments. Prices are reasonable.

Author: John_Teh_TBPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Tourist trap!
Review: Very poor quality food, the prawns we ordered were not fresh at all and possibly not safe for consumption. The steamed fish was the worst I've ever had, flaky and tasted stale. Poor staff attitude, mostly migrant workers who don't care about the place, what it represents and serving customers. They blamed their suppliers but why should customers have to suffer. They also said they cater mostly to tourists, who I imagined might find the ingredients interesting enough, but it's grave injustice for them to experience such poor service and food which can be much much better if prepared with care.

Author: docr99Delhi
Title: Nice cozy place
Review: New place with good ambiance, bar is well stocked, service is efficient & friendly & food is good. However the prices are little steep & portions are really small. There is a live band, however on the day I visited it was not playing. Overall a nice place to be with friends or loved ones when you want to have fun.

Author: Karin H
Title: Lovely local restaurant
Review: Brought our 4 adult kids visiting from overseas there and everyone loved it. The food is very tasty and fresh and the service is very good too. We will certainly go back.

Author: trinamoore74Ashburton, New Zealand
Title: Cool set up, but that's all
Review: I found this place on trip advsior and thought the set up and decor looked really cool, so we decided to go here for dinner, On arrival about 5:30pm we sat down and were looking through the menu and ordered 2 tiger beers and we told they had run out, so we then ordered 2 Carlsberg and they had run out of that too. I then said ok what beer do you have and was told the only thing we have left today is Guinness. Guinness is certainly not a beer my husband and I can drink and therefore we said we were sorry but we couldn't drink that and wouldn't be staying for dinner, what bar runs out of beer.The memorabilia and decor was pretty cool and we did take some photos.

Author: AlphaMinahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly service
Review: After a day of visiting historical sites, jostling with crowds and dealing with the scorching heat of Melaka, a tipple at Sid's offers a great respite. The wait staff here are very friendly, prompt and energetic. Overall, there's a great energy to the place. A nice pit stop for cold beer.

Author: Shyan C
Title: Very Poor Service and No Electricity at Night
Review: The James Brooke Bistro from afar looks like a really great place to have dinner by the river, but it is certainly a dissapointment when you arrive there to have a nice good dinner you were expecting. When we went there, there was NO ELECTRICITY and we were told that it is a common problem at night after 6pm (which we were very surprised to hear). The food served there are nothing to shout about. There was nothing special about the food and the ambience was just dissapointing. The staffs did their best to try to accommodate but they weren't very fluent in english and therefore was not able to assist much. I think I may have bumped into the owner or the supervisor in charge when i was there (they were doing a photo/video shoot) and I had not gotten any smile nor assistance from the person in charge. Service is poor and the food and ambience is dissapointing. I would recommend that travellers try some place else first if you are looking for a enjoyable dinner or authentic Sarawak Food rather than going to this place. For the food and service, the price you pay for it would certainly let you down in my personal opinion.I hope the management would buck up or perhaps a new owner or management should come in to run the place as it is situated at a very lovely at strategic location.

Author: Roam767452
Title: Gourmet Vouchers
Review: I had lunch here with family last Saturday-20/12/19. I was not satisfied with the manner Kaits restaurant handled my situation. I had vouchers of RM300 and other voucher to collect a bottle of wine and cake. The restaurant had some restriction on the manner to redeem voucher which they claim to be cash voucher. The voucher clearly spelled out that at any point of time there can only be 2 vouchers use for the same reservation. So I suggested to the manager to split the bills where I will pay by my self using 1 voucher and the other 2 vouchers will be use for another bill of 2person. This was decline by the manager. Then I suggested that I will use 2 of the vouchers and collect the wine & cake but the manager decline and said that 'CASH' voucher cannot be use to claim the wine. This was not spelt out at the back of the voucher at all. I visited the same place last year and had lunch with my family and collected the wine without any problems. The manager claimed that the rules have changed since Sept19 but these changes was not informed to members like me. My wife called Gourmet Collection and demanded for an explaination. The spokesperson said that only Holiday Inn Glenmarie are being difficult to their members. I wonder how Holiday Inn Glenmarie will treet me for hotel reservation when I have been treated unfairly at Kaits restaurant. Never want to come here again.
Restaurant: Kites Restaurant at Holiday Inn Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie

Author: Theexecchef
Title: Decent enough
Review: Went their for a quick bite, food ok and the restaurant is very clean..don't cater to vegetarians much....

Author: 155thihasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place for western food in jonker street
Review: One of the good places to offer western menus for food. We had a dinner and lunch there on our second visit to Melaka. The atmosphere of the restaurant is nice. They have both outdoor and indoor air con seating. The menu is not extensive but they cover from western to Asian and local food and beverages. The taste is good with reasonable prices. We watched a live performance during the dinner and it was enjoyable. Staff are friendly and always moving around fast. Some food may have to wait long due to the crowd but it’s not that long wait. Would definitely visit again next time.

Author: badger w
Title: Lovely place with good food!
Review: TopShelf delivers the classic French favourites and the Duck Confit with potato fondant & French beans is simply delicious! Love the decor, simple and minimalistic. Would go back and try other dishes next time!

Author: FranNod
Title: Music’s GREAT, but ...
Review: The Latin music attracted our attention and made us walk in. No doubt we’ll feel our feet/legs moving as the Cuban started singing. The real Caribbean voice and songs. To continue with the Latino flavor I asked for a MICHELADA; and that is the reason of my 3-star review. The menu says something, and the waiter brought something else. Not being enough, what I drank is not a MICHELADA. I lived in TEX-MEX counties for many years and a I know what a MICHELADA is. Saying your recipe is diferente is ok, but didn’t bring me something different and, on top of that, no red color anywhere. Suggestion to owner, if any reads this. Customer satisfaction or X-User philosophy.

Author: 634rexc
Title: How can give such poor service without a word of sorry
Review: Very very poor service. Couldn't care less attitude of most of staff. Serve the wrong order although clearly written. Also repeated many times to different staff but can still get things wrong. In the end not even a word of apology.

Author: lll1958
Title: Afternoon tea
Review:
Pleasant place for having a relaxing afternoon. If u r looking for a place to chill out after all yr shopping.
Service by Yana is good.

Author: ALR0609Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Nice!
Review: I went to Indulgence for tea.This restaurant is on jalan raja dihilir, near ipoh specialist hospital. It's an old, huge bungalow, in a huge compound with lots of parking. The easy parking on its own, already won me over.The ambience was great. The restaurant was made up of several interconnecting rooms, all decorated differently, and decorated well.The waiters were good. Attentive, efficient, polite and they could even suggest/recommend what to order! Rare indeed!I had their Chai Tea & fudgy browny which were both good. I left wondering what the rest of their menu tasted like. It looks like i'll need to make another trip to ipoh soon.

Author: laura773Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing from start to finish
Review: My friend and I had just arrived in KL and spotted this place which looks really nice from outside. We headed straight in and got totally ignored, walked all the way to the counter to ask for a table and were told to sit anywhere. A waiter brought over some menus and then didn't come back until we called them to take our order. We ordered our food and 2 bottles of water and a bottle of wine... We got one bottle of water and a glass of wine, we corrected them and 5 minutes later back came the same glass of wine! By this point we were considering leaving as we'd been there 15-20 mins and still didn't have drinks! Our food arrived and looked disappointing, but still no bottle of wine! We asked one more time for it and finally it arrived. After about 15 more minutes the waiters started stacking up chairs around us and brought over our bill before we asked for it. They were then all sat on tables waiting for us to leave, when we stood up one of them made a cheering noise, they all got up to clear our table and walked right passed us - not one of them said thank you or goodbye!Food was below average and service is shockingly poor. Such a disappointing place, with potential if they had better staff.

Author: lchiu28
Title: Super slow. Service bad
Review: Took too long to serve the food even not that many customer. Food taste average. Din not have the perception people have as it should be under the Starhil feast village

Author: Steph K
Title: Everything is great!
Review: The waiters are friendly and accommodating and food always taste great .. I always my visits to chilis

Author: Afif B
Title: Service was terrible
Review: My friends and I came here during fasting month and the waitress was very unfriendly and rude. Instead of answering our simple questions on their foods, she seems to raise her voice a lot of time saying "I don't know what to suggest, just pick any lah". Hardly to suggest this place again to family members or friends. i think senibong gave better service and better food portion than this place.

Author: iant743England, United Kingdom
Title: Good authentic Sarawak food
Review: I loved the Sarawak laksa and kolo mie when I visited Kuching a few years ago. So I was happy when a friend recommended this place in PJ. It's a simple, clean, no-frills restaurant with a menu limited to just a few Sarawak classics. The laksa was particularly good. If you're lucky, you'll also get to meet Aunty Christina herself.

Author: hammo25
Title: Not much good to say really
Review: Food took forever and was average at best.  Place wasn't busy but the kitchen struggled to keep up.  Tablecloths and furniture was all filthy.  At least we didn't get sick.

Author: jeremy48
Title: Busy, but Worth the Wait
Review: The food was excellent with large portions and good value. Definitely worth trying but very busy with queues waiting all day long.

Author: MahAshraf
Title: Good International Cuisine in KL
Review: Located in the KL Pavilion, TGI Friday is one of the best american restaurants in KL. The food quality is good and the service is fast. The menu is quite expensive when compared to other options around.

Author: Sue808Yokohama, Japan
Title: Delicious
Review: Was here for lunch and dinner. Truffle pizza was delicious. Both the topping and the dough itself was tasty. Our second visit was right after our gym session and we wanted to seat outside thinking we were not appropriately attired but was surprise when the waiter gave us a table inside and assured us that this is a casual restaurant. All in all good food and good service!

Author: fox7179
Title: went back again
Review: our 2 trip to langkawi we went back to this favorite spot - what a great scene with mangroves and sea and mostly Michele! Must go!

Author: 963sunnyk
Title: Overpriced...
Review: This is a nice-appearing establishment in the Hilton Hotel in KL Central. The furnishings and ambiance are pleasant. The menu is not your typical Chinese menu. There is a "modern" spin on what might have been "the expected". What is totally unexpected is the OUTRAGEOUS cost of drinks. Compared to other places to eat in KL expect to pay 12-15x the typical cost for bottled water, soda and beer. It's my mistake for not insisting (after asking once) to look at a drink menu before ordering (I had no reason to expect price gouging), but I was shocked to see the bill for 2 beers = 96 Ringget. 2 Sprites = 48 Ringget. 1 330ml bottle water = 28 Ringget. As a reference, divide by 3.8 to get US Dollar equivalent. The food is prepared nicely and presented/served very professionally...and is not over-priced as the drinks are. I just wish I had the aftertaste of scotch or wine or champagne (not 2 beers), considering what we ultimately paid for with this experience. Consider yourself warned.

Author: David B
Title: In the shadow of its next door neighbours
Review: The food was very tasty and more authentic than it's neighbour but it lacks the overall ambience of the larger place.

Author: NSFamily2016
Title: Reasonable food, poor service
Review: The food was lovely.However, the seating service was lacking. We were one of four reservations for the restaurant for the whole night. When we were shown to our table, we were shown to a small cramped table, next to another diner, and adjacent to the crockery / service station - in an otherwise completely empty restaurant.We asked to be moved to another table and were shown the one next to it….. So my friend pointed out a nicer table for two and we moved there, but the mood was already spoilt. We had a nice meal, but did not feel the need nor enjoyment to have a longer more relaxed meal.Disappointed if we had been walk-ins, doubly disappointed as Plat SPG member with reservation. No desire to return as the food was not *that* good.

Author: AamirM91
Title: Its Average
Review: So I went to this restaurant after seeing a lot of reviews online with great views of the skyline and comfortable environment. While the view is nice, it is not the best in town. The pictures on the website are from all different restaurants under the Troika banner. While I did get a view of KL Tower from the table, the construction right near the building ruined it. The environment is nice however, it is somewhat fancy but it is way overpriced for the quality of the food served. I had the wagyu beef cheek ravioli and it can be best described as average. My girlfriend had the rib-eye steak which was decent but she commented that chilis has better steak. What did stand out was the service. The staff is excellent and very attentive.

Author: henrysusanti
Title: My Fave Mexican cafe In town
Review: Located at the hustle bustle of Georgetown, Penang. Busy cafe, always full but there is always seat outside. Staff is efficient and helpful. Good food and drinks. Love the cafe mural inside. Soup, Burrito, nachos etc, all good. Love the margarita there too

Author: RaviPaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst experience and cheating at Hyderabad Recipes
Review: We had purchased 4 course meal as advertised on GROUPON for 4 people as fine dining. Cost of this coupon was RM 48 actual cost advertised as RM 172. We selected the Bukit Bintang outlet.By no means was the actual cost of the meal RM 172 since the restaurant wifully doctored the meal quality and quantity both so that actual cost must not have been more than RM 40.Points to be noted 1) Airconditioning not functioning 2) Cannot be defined as fine dining since there was no table cloth, napkins 3)Poor service 4) Portion of the food very small 5) Quality very bad 6) advertised dessert not available (had to make do with raspberry flavoured ice cream).Clear case of cheating when such a big discount RM 172 - RM 48 advertised on GROUPON.Poor business ethics. Definitely would not recommend this restaurant.

Author: jpcoballesManila, Philippines
Title: Wau Dining is Great!
Review: We tried the Wau Dining by Rabbit Hole and we loved it. Wau Dining offers malaysian cuisine. The restaurant is very cozy and nicely designed. The food was great and the staff were very friendly and accommodating. Special shout out to Naomi and to all Filipino staff, they are the best!

Author: bestari3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The worst Ho Fun Mee I ever tasted!!!
Review: The ho fun mee is the worst I ever tasted. It shouldn't be even in the menu if they can even cook it properly. Not a saleable food at all. Mention it to the staffand they just laugh and did not even take it seriously because they dont even think that is any of their business

Author: Rafic H
Title: Work drinks
Review: Got orders wrong 3 times then tried to slide it through by changing things around on the sly..not cool people :(

Author: fitzeraldb
Title: worse service
Review: First n last..got scolded when we order the food...we order food from one of the staff n he answered please order from that guy...the guy that he mention was just ignoring us..strange!.

Author: kittycatperth
Title: OK
Review: We thought was nice but nothing special. When you went near the back to the kitchen smelt like dead rat which put us off our food.

Author: AndriEnrico
Title: Amazing food amazing service!!
Review: This is one of the best restaurants I’ve been to! The service is great and the tenderloin steak amazing! Big shoutout to Aizaar who showed me all their 800 brands of wiskey and the wine cellar I loved it!

Author: Elna Q
Title: Good food in a lovely atmosphere
Review: If you are tired of nudles and rice this restaurant gives you good value for money and western traditionel food besides the experience to be in a historic place.

Author: arwen_tripMiri, Malaysia
Title: Good try n experience
Review: My first time eating at Hoe Kee. Long Q but not as long as Chung hwa which is few doors down. Selected them because review said the chicken is nicer then Chung hwa. Service is fast n friendly. They come with some default set menu and recommendation of serving. I have 4 adults with 2 little toddlers. Ordered 4 person portion the rice is not enuff. So we top up further. Taste wise I think it's ok. Not particular very very nice. So better set ur expectation right. :) however at least after eat not very thirsty. it's good experience to eat the famous famous chicken rice. :) the rice ball is a bit cold. My family doesnt quite like it ( tradition old pple lol). Price is reasonable. Very nice setting. The antique architecture.

Author: ohmygoodness_11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty but expensive
Review: I went with my 82-year old Dad because he wanted to try out the North Indian dishes and I wanted aloo paratha which is not readily available in most Indian restaurants.The food was tasty but portions were small. The service was poor and I was annoyed when we were asked to move just because a Chinese family of four turned up. We were not asked if we wanted to move and the waiter brought a tiny table for two just in front of the door and made us sit there. For a small bowl of pilau, one aloo paratha and raita, the bill came to more than RM30. We're not going thre again!

Author: Aidadaud
Title: Chambers grill
Review: We truly enjoyed our dinner tonight. Steaks were done to perfection & staff attentive & accomodating. Many thanks to the team tonight...Adli, Azu, Steaphnnie & chef nathan & team!

Author: tenglenglim
Title: Very value for $$!
Review:
Had roast suckling pig, 6 dishes and yam paste. Coated around 600+ RM. For the group of 12 persons, it worked out to be $10+ per person. It was definitely worth the money.

The promfret is a must! It was very fresh!

Author: 118princess
Title: Normal taste
Review: Sorry to say taste not like my expected. Just normal taste. Hope they can raise the quality and taste

Author: JohnmagfamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Die die must try!
Review: Did ate many varieties in Malacca, so it is a must try to eat Malacca chicken rice if you are here.In conclusion, most outlets selling chicken rice are about the same, so unless you are a food writer or critique, to me most stalls here are very good!

Author: Leslie D
Title: Sugar rush
Review: The ribs are good but the sauce is way too sweet-- not like the sauce in ubud. If you go , suggest sauce on the side and ( ask the manager to please add a basic fresh salad to the menu -- )The cumi cumi was also sweet and very dry-- small portion -- I was expecting something like salt and pepper sotong but it was like hard candied fish.At the real NN in ubud they have an excellent grilled chicken burger--this was not on the menuThe truffle fries were tasty but served in a huge basket , one is good for three people!The restaurant was loud -- very loud wouldn't it be nicer with some relaxing Balinese bamboo music instead of all that shouting?Service was excellent and staff very friendly.

Author: UlysseKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just order duck :)
Review: We made a mistake by ordering anything other then duck.Had wonton noodles - which was totally blend :( Pineapple rice was also a disappointment, small portion and taste just like fried rice.Also please check your bills. We were charged higher then what was stated in the menu for the chinese tea and pineapple rice.

Author: FRMason
Title: Terrible
Review:
Went on recommendation of a friend who lives in KL. 

Unfortunately it was crap. Cheese nan had almost no cheese. 

Chicken curry had a bone shard. 

Paid almost 30 ringit for butter prawns but it was more like deep fried nothing 

Would not go back

Author: Gachoi
Title: Excellent food and great value for money
Review: The food is imaginative, tasty and very good value for money. This, combined with an excellent range of wines makes J&Rs a regular favourite for me and my family.

Author: 600rahulKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: i was there(centre court,pavilin) @night 9.30.
Review: i was there(centre court,pavilin) @night 9.30 12/12/2015. then i asked for drinks they said closed already but still they can provided me take away after all i take my drinks when i asked for bill there manager we closed already our system so we cant give you bills. its make me disappointment.

Author: Colin CSydney, Australia
Title: Not a recommended restaurant for Peking duck or dinner
Review: Always heard so many good things about this place but really didn't live up to basic standards. The duck was cold and the duck skin for pancake was cut too thick. Service was poor and we waited 50 minutes for food (asking twice for update) and the management didn't seem to have it together. Don't order their red bean pancake dessert, you will regret it and destroy your good memories of childhood (it sure did for me).On a good note, their mooncakes from the hotel lobby are phenomenal!!! Durian snow skin mooncake was truly amazing. We bought a few boxes, however a bit pricey (but so worth it!). Even the people I was with who don't eat durian loved it.

Author: 221jannep
Title: Ok but...
Review: A bit over rated. The food was ok but really nothing special. Only tourists were present. Live music was entertaining and the service friendly. But still...

Author: JewelTanBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Best sizzling brownie in town and good food
Review: I love lobster fettuccine, spiced saffron creamy sauce. Awesome! If u r never creamy sauce fan, u have to try this pasta. You might change ur perspective. The scallop truffle aglio olio was tasty. Angel hair pasta coated with truffle oiled, full of favour every bite and they are quite generous with the scallop. The best is the sizzling brownie served with ice-cream of ur choice. The hot tasty brownie and cold ice-cream blend in well and delighted my tastebud! Indescribable sensation!Went there for the second time but lobster fettuccine is no longer in the menu, they substitute it to crawfish fettuccine. The sauce was the same but I was quite disappointed with the crawfish. I think it was not fresh, mild fishy taste.. Don't like it! I ordered a chicken breast dish. It was too dry, maybe overcooked.The brownie is still the highlight of the meal
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Beadsbb
Title: Cheap Specials
Review:
The food was ok, moderately priced, cheap specials. We asked for no ice, never got it... ever! 
The food options are quite vast, so there is a lot of choice. Western and Malay options alike.

Author: hongsengng
Title: Anniversary dinner with great experience
Review:
Good table arrangement with privacy for us to celebrate our anniversary dinner. 

Staffs are friendly,  food is fresh and cozy environment.

Will definitely come back again. 

Well done Ishin!

Author: ChingPengT
Title: Cheated by the comments
Review: I don't understand why so many commented the food at Tuck Kee are good or excellent? It's terrible ... maybe all them having try a better one in Klang. The tai chow in any where in KL can taste better ... I only taste the soy sauce taste ...

Author: DaBugsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic food and awesome service!
Review: I've had the opportunity to stay at The Danna previously but due to such a short trip, we didn't get to experience dinner at The Planter's. Judging from their fabulous breakfast spread, made it a point to ensure we had our seat at the dinner table during this visit! The moment we stepped into The Planter's, we were treated to an enormously warm welcome. Everywhere you looked, you were greeted with a wonderful smile and Fuad, Qistina, Najwa and Paulo, who attended to us, gave such exquisite attention... we wanted to stay forever! We ordered the Chateaubriand and boy, was it marvellous. The meat was so tender, brimming with flavour and the sides were so nicely apportioned that it supported the mains so well without stealing the thunder. What a wonderful experience and definitely a night to remember!Thank you to all at The Planter's for making us feel like royalty! You guys are the best! We'll be back.

Author: JandNMcHong Kong, China
Title: Decent Buffet
Review: Hanging out for Malay food I succumbed to the temptation of Vascos. Its a good buffet but nothing sensational. Just glad to have spucy Malay food. Service was ok considering the staff were over run

Author: Caroline Alexan... J
Title: Valentine's Dinner
Review: The setting was just minimal. Presentation was ok but the wait for the food is just plain horrible. It was a set dinner with 2 main meals to choose which I find hard to understand why they need to be so sloooowwww in serving their food. Our dinner took us about 3 hours to finish...and stomach not even filled. Please buckle up.

Author: WinterfloodBath, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Cafe
Review: If you go here expecting a restaurant you'll be disappointed however, if good food is what you're after you won't be. If this place was in the UK we'd have walked straight past, but based on the TA reviews we have it a try. We had a great, relaxed meal and would highly recommend for a casual, no frills, tasty meal... provided you like duck (as it features in almost every dish).We particularly then Hainanese Duck (sorry for spelling error), and both soups we had were great. We visited end of season and had no problem getting a table for two but by many accounts it's busy in the peaker times.V good value for money - wine a bit dodgy but good for a cold Tiger beer. Would definitely recommend.

Author: JakeV238
Title: Perfect for whiskey lovers
Review: Best whiskey bar I have ever been to. Crazy good selection. Good service. Cheap prices. You get a class of water, glass with iceball in it for the water. Pipet for water, and the perfect aromatic glass for whiskey.(plus nuts but who cares, they have whiskey). 5 out of 5. Caught me out of surprise.

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Was The best around 15 yrs back...
Review: It was one the best place in Melaka to hang out 15 yrs back. At that time service was excellent, food was great, the service was superb. And price was reasonable. But lately it become opposite of above and there are much better places. The price now become extremely high

Author: Thiben76
Title: Never go near this restaurant.
Review:
Ordered Red Snapper & kitchen delivered Talapia. Checked with supervisor & he insisted Talapia is reds napper.. To my utter shock. 
NO apologies, no change. 
Just amazed, that they are still in business. 
Good quality is poor & service is bad.

Author: SyedZubairHa5anKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service and lousy food.
Review: We went there with another family and we are a total of 4 people 2 ladies and 2 gents we order 1KG of Lamb Madgoot which was recommended for 3 to 4 people after long wait when the food arrived we knew that it will not suffice so we plan to order Mandi Lamb However they were out of stock at 8 PM only and was given an option for Lamb Hanith so we plan to go with it and this time again when the food arrives it is with same meat only rice difference we love Arabic food and ate so many other places so we tell them this is not Lamb Hanith and they insist that this is what they called lamb hanith.It was not enough even adding another KG of food which suppose to serve 6 to 8 people and we are still hungry so we order Ratub bread which supposes to be served with Honey as other restaurants serve in Malaysia and they bring the just bread upon asking for honey they give the respond the same way that we serve like that only.overall horrible experience ending up paying RM151 for the food which don't even like.

Author: BJPatt
Title: Great food
Review: Have visited this restaurant several times and have never been disappointed, the food is good and varied the staff are very friendly and attentive. Well worth a visit.

Author: BobBobGolden
Title: Poorly ventilated
Review:
Food is very fresh but a bit expensive for the same quality in Bangkok or Hong Kong.

Prefer take away as the oily fumes from the deep flyer is too strong.

Author: StephenR81611
Title: Good beer
Review: Flavorless, but not bad food. Good service, comfortable chairs. Great people watching. A few beers on tap you don't often see.

Author: SkyGrrriffinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a good experience
Review: I have been hesitant to try this place as the atmosphere didn't seem the greater but one day decided to try. We wanted to sit inside as the mall was hot and there were available tables inside in the Aircon but for some reason we were told to sit at the outside tables to wait, which was fine at the time as we weren't in a huge hurry. It took 15 minutes to get drinks for no reason other than the staff were spinning around in circled not sure what to do. The one drink we wanted they were out of stock on, which was disappointing. Then they moved us inside and we ordered and after another 15 minutes were told they didn't have what we wanted and then the second thing we tried to order they didn't have. It turned into a comedy as each time they would take the order and then wait an extended amount of time to tell us we couldn't have it. So we tried to get the bill for our 2 drinks and when it came it was 300RM and we only had 2 ciders. They sorted us but after 40 minutes and the bizarre moving tables and not having anything in stock, we certainly won't be going back. Maybe it was a bad day.

Author: Hotmomm_666
Title: Korean food fan
Review: Been longing to come and dine here everytime we went jb but this time round we finally made it.We loved d ambience and their service was good.Thanks to Adira(I can't recall her name)& also to the rest of the staffs that has served us.Food & Drinks was great.We enjoyed it & definitely come back.Well reccomended.
Restaurant: K Fry Urban Korean Holiday Villa Johor Bahru

Author: scubadude9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average buffet lunch
Review: Went with my family in a group of 11pax on a Sunday afternoon. Price was pretty expensive and the selection was on an average side of less expensive food. I reckon food was pretty much the same as any 4 Star hotel in KL. We only like the dessert section, that is the only food that we enjoyed most and is seems packed with people all the time and with just 1 person manning the counter. We were quite annoyed with the character of one of the Indian chef helper, who speaks very loudly and being ignorant at the peaceful surroundings. Parking has a flooding problem. Please remember to pay your parking fees of RM10 at the hotel concierge before going off.

Author: DewiRatnaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not As Good As Before
Review: I was there last night for dinner. Very disappointed with the meat combo platter and the chicken chop. The chicken chrispy but on the dry side, the lamb was under cooked, the beef a bit smelly, the only thing good about it, is the dessert, we ordered chocolate caramel banana, it taste as good as the first time we had it
Restaurant: Laman Grill steak n Bar B Que,

Author: harpluck
Title: Paid 50bucks (USD) for low quality salmon sushi
Review: Ordered 8 piece chef selection sushi. There were a good piece of sea urchin, a hotate and a kampachi but the rest were pure disappointment. The cooked prawn were tasteless and the salmon and tuna looks so "old', it taste like sushi to go you get in tesco.

Author: Sam M
Title: Great whisky
Review: Went there with my wife because place looked ok to have a drink, we went there about 5pm so there was no one else, however we had the chance to try 8 different whiskeys from 8 different countries, bad news is you only get 1oz per brand.Great place to go to try whiskeys you have never seen!

Author: dnahsamKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good food, good location fusion cafe
Review: This cafe is halal and it's located across from Imperial Hotel Miri and Permaisuri Mall Miri. They serve a variety of local and western cuisine. Ordered 'wet seafood fried kuetiaw' as it's called here or 'Cantonese kuetiaw' if in Kuching (flat noodle in egg sauce). Portion is enough, sauce is just right. My friend ordered the Ayam Lalapan, and the portion is big and the sambal was awesome but spicy. Service is fast and good. Food is overall no complain. Location is just perfect.

Author: 2015Kay
Title: Local eatery with reasonable seafood
Review:
Service & environment slightly better than Top Spot but parking can be a challenge if you drive.
Overall food is reasonably price, seafood is fresh & offers more menu variety.

Author: selinacheanWanhua, Taipei
Title: Didn’t even stay to try the food.. rude staff
Review: Had bought a gift of chocolates for my friend who opened d box & ate a piece. Waiter came & curtly told us no outside food allowed. It wasn’t like we packed a pizza! But he was also just inexcusably high handed & rude, or we’d be ok & wouldn’t have left to spend money next door ..

Author: Seika61Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Thai Food
Review: If appearance is anything to go by, this restaurant with fairly extensive decor and ambience showed great promise. But the chefs at the Busaba at the Bangsar Shopping Centre must lack confidence in their cooking. That can be the only reason why MSG is used in most of their dishes. According to the waiter who took our order, most sauces are preprepared with this condiment, and given that among our party was one extremely susceptible to monosodium glutamate due to being on an extended medication regime, we basically had to settle for fried sea bass (siakap) with sauce on the side and other dishes that did not have the stuff added beforehand. It's said that MSG imparts a taste of Umami to the food but I'm also aware that this can be achieved through the use of the right ingredients and proper cooking.Overall the foods not too bad but unexceptional. We had the deep fried sea bass with lime chilli sauce on the side, king prawns with tamarind sauce, water convolvulus with shrimp paste, and a combination deep fried and fresh blanched vegetables, and ended with the sweet banana with warm coconut sauce.It's extremely hard to find super fresh seafood in Kuala Lumpur unless you get to one of the Chinese mega restaurants serving up live creatures and this meal seemed much like most other usually thawed out seafood meals. Acceptable but not especially overwhelming. But if you're into quick business lunches with some ambience, this might just be the place. Our meal for three (no alcoholic drinks) came up to around USD$80, about average for Bangsar prices.

Author: Sunshine ZPetaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: HORRIBLE !! found HAIR in food and there was not even an APOLOGY
Review: horrible service. Horrible and disgusting. we are regulars and we love the food there, and we had our naan served with hair on it, i had poked, prodded and checked and i know what is it, with the texture. we returned the naan, and ten minutes later we were told, that is it charcoal, and it has turned into ashes, and the staff had PEELED OFF THE HAIR off the naan and GAVE IT BACK TO US, and told us to eat that. disgusting. and we were shocked.DISGUSTING and dirty and lying to us, and telling us, that we should eat it, and that we dunt know the difference between charcoal and making us feel like idiots. Disgusting. DIRTY and no manners. HORRIBLE

Author: BenTravel174Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: The restaurant is incredibly dark inside, to the point that it makes you feel uncomfortable. There is no natural light at all given that all windows are blacked out. When we arrived we were directed to a table where we waited. 10 minutes later despite several staff walking pass us no one even bothered giving us a menu. Left after some 15 minutes without even being able to order.

Author: LisDobb
Title: Cheaper, better food just around the corner.
Review: The cakes are not bad, but VERY pricey, and better and much cheaper are available just around the corner in the food hall of Merdekah Plaza. I really don't like being gulled by "tourist" prices.

Author: Michael B
Title: Food was awful
Review: The food was awful, We went during the day. The buffet food was cold and it just had no flavour. There was also very few options. The view is great but that is about it

Author: Jiewei C
Title: Not worth it
Review: Booked for almost 60-70 pax, service was good but the food is so so, no communication between hotel and restaurant management, they don't allow coach to stop by and pick up, keep on chasing the coach away, Hotel Person in charge's attitude is very bad, keep on yelling in front of us.

Author: 92wongk
Title: Yummy food
Review: My girls like it, the ambience is nice. Surprisingly the food is yummy with reasonable price in Genting Highland.

Author: OldjackGreater Melbourne, Australia
Title: Asian With A Modern Twist
Review: This is a well set up restaurant for those that do not want some of the local fare. The menu is a mix of Western and Asian with a little twist. The food was OK and well presented but not special and prices were higher than elsewhere. Service was slow.

Author: yjt2014
Title: Excellent Porky Delight
Review:
Celebrated my wife's birthday there, we had the Grilled Pork Shoulder Steak (Really awesome and tender pork) and Guinness Ribs
Make sure you get a reservation~!
In the weekends (Fri-Sun), they have 2 sessions in the evenings; 6.30pm - 8pm, and 8.30pm onwards.

Author: aggressor93
Title: I wouldn’t go there again
Review:
Honestly they should change there menu or chef that’s all I could say and definitely I won’t be visiting again. 

If you go there do not order FATOUSH because it’s not fattoush more like garden salad.

Author: thefamilycatBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Chicken Rice with Generous portions
Review: Arrived around 1.30pm and was fortunate enough to be seated immediately. Lady who took our order was knowledgeable and recommended a few variations of dishes. She also spoke mandarin and hokkien which made it easy for us to converse as we are from Kuching :) We chose a mixture of chicken rice and chicken rice balls. The dish arrived with half a chicken on one plate and two plates of rice (one normal plate and one ball plate) The place was cool even though the temperature was blazing at 35°C which made the meal relaxing. The chilli and dark soy sauce compliments the chicken rice very well. Will definitely return in the near future.

Author: RutheranS1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: For Tourists Without Taste
Review: I would commend the outlet for its interior decor, wall frescos and brass ware. They fail when the food arrives. A thali meal is served without a choice of gravy. Only item which resembles gravy is a stale serving of dhal.The waiters find it difficult to focus between tables of choice and chatting with one another. It is not uncommon for a waiter to attend to a table with no focus at all, regularly looking away or starting a personal conversation with another waiter. One is expected to pause, wait repeat and hope that the message got through.It was a poor dining experience and in no way matched Matcha in The Curve or Banana Leaf. It’s a good premise entrusted with bad staff, untasteful cuisine.

Author: Tanjumjahan
Title: Amazing food
Review: The food was really good. A must visit place. You can enjoy with friends and family. Also the atmosphere is really nice

Author: ZBROSECosta Mesa, California
Title: Amazing food, but don't try to work from here!
Review: We visited YamYam today for breakfast after reading numerous rave reviews of the food- it is a little off the main stretch of Pantai Cenang so we rented a motorbike for the day just to get to this place. We haven't been very impressed with fresh food options around Pantai Cenang so far and YamYam was such a breath of fresh air! We ordered a flat white and a long black, as well as a Summer Scent Juice (watermelon and pineapple) - all were wonderfully delicious and well done (so nice to find great coffee finally!!). The food was also worth the visit- we ordered the butterscotch apple pancakes and the tropical fruit bowl with yogurt and granola and a side of eggs. All were fantastic and we LOVED our dining experience.
