We are full time travel bloggers and work from our laptops, so the quiet, relaxing atmosphere and fast wifi were a dream- but when we had finished our meal and asked if it was possible to move inside for a power outlet, the owners let us know that they "were running a restaurant, not an Internet cafe", and said that use of power outlets wasn't allowed. After our so-far lovely experience it was quite the way to leave Yam Yam! We understand when restaurants have this policy while busy or for people who do not order food, but we ate a full meal with 3 drinks and planned to order food for lunch as well (Since we loved the food so much), and there was only 1 or 2 other tables occupied and a nearly empty cafe. If you're a digital nomad like us, be warned that this is not a work-friendly cafe. We didn't see any no-laptop signs or anything like that, so perhaps they could benefit from that, but for the food alone this place is worth the visit.

Author: Sujoret
Title: Time to Relax
Review: The place is just walking distance from the hotel we live. Booked table in advance since we are group of 15 pax. Burgers are big portion :-) Live music just started around 09PM and we can sing along together with the singers. Good to have this kind entertainment to release stress

Author: Veren RIpoh, Malaysia
Title: A Big No
Review: Where do I start, all of us were excited to try out Cuisines as its rated no.1 on tripadvisor with amazing comments. Firstly, the ambience of the restaurant is basic to an extend of dullness. The aircond was leaking water onto our chair and table, the management might want to check on the cleanliness of the airconds which might be causing the leaking. The staff were pleasant and attentive, the only positive about this place. We ordered Tabbouleh Salad where no couscous was added in. Crab meat pasta had no salt in it, I guess the Chef did not season it. The NZ lamb rack was average in taste and chicken dishes, the meat was dry and hard. Only edible dish was the Singapore Laksa. I don’t think we will be returning or recommending this place anytime soon.

Author: jmptripsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: a forgettable experience never again to be repeated.
Review: Three adults…three teens…first visit as a group….Call to make a reservation….Gal answering the phone can barely understand English…name, phone, time and number of people, took a total of three calls, finally resolved with the Manager.The things we wanted are offered only on their M-F menu…so we opt for the RM72 ($16) Burger and the ONE request for onion rings to substitute for fries met with a $5 additional charge…how much are fries…RM14…and onion rings? RM20…so give me onion rings at an extra RM6…NO! OK…RM8! Hassles and three trips to the chef???Despite nearly empty, the food and drinks took way too long to arrive. They bring it all at one time which was good and our server was definitely there to please us. The burger simply isn’t that good and the SouledOut Burger for RM28 is better. The onion rings are the best but not worth the reservation/ordering and cost hassles.All dishes were good sized but no one loved their food…the bill for three adults and 3 kids was over RM600 or $142!! Seriously!Add to that, a family of wild infants and a 4 years old running all around unsupervised and stomping his feet as loudly as possible near us…a forgettable experience never again to be repeated.

Author: amyleeskKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: NOT WORTH IT
Review: Went here for birthday dinner and we order the wagyu prime steak that cost us almost RM700. The steak came out cold and I told the waitress. She took our steak back and the chef grill it and send back to us and it was so tough. This is totally unacceptable and I rejected the dish. They replace it with another steak which is the worst steak that I had in my life as is full of tendon The worst part of the experience is , the manager in charge did not even borther to come and resolve this problem. We waited for more than 15 minutes then we decided to leave the establishment. I am truly dissapointed with the kind of attitute of the staff from a supposed high end restaurant.

Title: So so only
Review: Very normal food but I prefer the Cowan St. better. Commercialised not the boss or his side kicked cooking anymore

Author: jasonsK5356ISSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but no so good
Review: Had a high expectation but the food is so-so. Although I was impressed with the waiter who can churn up the receipt immediate after the food is served. But still it is Old Wong so everyone who is here needs to try and give a comment like what I did.

Author: Mhiroshan
Title: Poor Service...Unprofessional Customer Service...Wasting Time..
Review: Was looking for a nice dine on Saturday evening, saw fume on entertainer seemed to occupy where on olive the bay.. was decided to give it a try.. Reached the restaurant around 8.20pm..we order Lamb Briyani,chicken Tikka,Chetinad Prawn, Mango Lassi & warm water...By 9.30pm nothing had come. end the end I serve warm water by my ownself. waited untill 10.15pm nothing has come except Mango Lassi & Chicken Tikka..We keep on asking the waiter & waitress there answer please wait! Customer's keeping coming to remind them to bring the food..decided settle my bills with anger & the waiter not even wants to apologise to us...Service was bad, overall experience was disaster, totally spoiled my Valentines Date, WARNING! Stay clear of restaurant. Waited 2 hours just to lamb Briyani to come!? Not sure why people are saying this is a great value restaurant. The food is over priced & the quality is very poor. I will not come back to this restaurant ever again & I will not recommend to anyone..Totally Blacklist it..Thanks..

Author: Chong J
Title: under our expectation alot
Review: We had our dinner here, due to rainny night and we lazy to go out and eat. the portion of the food is very small and not worth the price, we are not full at all, and the taste is average.

Author: Murphy1967Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A better bread shop than restaurant
Review: Great bread and pastries etc for sale to take away BUT the table served food was very average. Undercooked eggs in one dish and cold eggs on the other.For such a limited menu and large kitchen and staff I expected much betterAlso RM 8 for a glass of Sunkist orange juice is, quite frankly, ridiculous. The couple at the next table also seemed to have some serious service issues as well as they appeared to wait for 20 minutes just to get their drinks.(I hope that the Sunkist was worth the wait)Anyway, as local residents we gave it a try but won't be back in a hurry.

Author: Xin10000Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mixed feeling, for a MYR128 meal in Penang, one would like to expect more.
Review: We read reviews and wanted to try this peranakan fine dining restaurant. A lot of other reviews talked about the food, so I wanted to say something else. After all everyone has their own preference of taste.However the service could have been improved.1. We came with a small suitcase, 25 minutes before our 6pm reservation. We were told by the waiter that we could wait at the bar area with the suitcase. Nobody showed us to the seats or told us where exactly we could leave the suitcase. So we found seats ourselves, but there was a lady (maybe in charge?) came and told us we SHOULD leave the suitcase at the reception... conflict of opinions from staff and confused guest. It was not a big issue at all so no problem. We followed her instruction and waited at the bar.2. The same lady apparently was not good with names? Only 4 parties arrived at that time. We were checked for reservation name, 4 times within 15 minutes.3. Menu, just two pages, could have been seriously improved. Would the restaurant like to consider the idea of making it a nicely printed booklet, including picture of the dish, more info/story behind each of them if any, or stories for the historical building, the hotel, georgetown or even peranankan cuisine/culture? We were the second table placing order therefore our food came quite fast, but we noticed some other guests who came later indeed waited for LONG time. Maybe it is a good idea to provide some reading? 4. Related to #3. Maybe some snacks (peanuts, crackers, etc) while waiting? Of course if those seems too much, the restaurant could charge a bit more, to cover the printing of (take-home) booklet/menu/story, some welcome tea and snacks. Btw we didn't get the drink menu so I thought the drink menu previously we saw at the bar were only for the bar...5. You might also consider the idea of having a postcard as souvenir. It could be the hotel building, the interior of the restaurant, or the dishes.6. Some waiters/waitress seemed quite new. They walked around the tables in a very causal way (not like the waiters in E&O for example). They talked among themselves while pouring water to you glass. When you said thank you no (or inaudible?) response from them...some plus points:- we liked the kebaya and sarong that lady(in #1, #2) wore, but she was the only one wearing those.- we liked the pianist, but for the 6pm seating, he came only around 7pm? Food is OK for us, not really fancy or very impressive but quite OK, as I mentioned taste is a very individual thing. However "fine dinning" is never only about the food itself. For this price (seriously with MYR10 you could easily get a serve of fancy noodle) and what we got, I'd rather patron some peranakan restaurants back in Singapore more, like national kitchen, true blue, house of peranakan, blue ginger etc. None of them advertise themselves explicitly as fine dining anyway, nor anyone is really more expensive than this restaurant.

Author: EricO1973
Title: Good vibes
Review: Good for family outing. Quite and nice atmosphere. The foods here overall were well presented and delicious

Author: mustaffaniezamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lost its Sparkle.
Review: Me and wife frequent this outlet every fortnight, like it very much, we feel appreciate when the staffs remember us and we feel at home. But lately everything have change, new staffs and new faces. And even no one show us our table, just point from far,

Author: GodsgloriousworldLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great view but very average food
Review: We dined here for lunch approx. 6 hrs after arriving in KL. We had a 13.30 reservation but was about 20 mins late and had to wait for a table. Please note that it takes a while to walk up to the tower (you can wait for shuttle bus) and you have to queue for the lifts which is a long queue as everyone’s trying to get to the observation tower. So allow ample time, I thought we had and was still 20 mins late. We were given the window seat we reserved though. The view was great. I’m not a lover of heights but always find myself up these buildings (I’ve done the ones in Seoul and Toronto). It also rotates very slowly so no fear of motion sickness and you get to see the entire 360 degrees. You may have difficulty finding your table when you return from buffet though as it won’t be where you left it :) The food was just okay. They won’t win any awards for their culinary selections but there is a fair choice. I did feel a little rushed though. They started clearing tables before we even got to dessert and then brought our bill for us to pay while we were still working our way through the scrumptious selection of mini cakes. But I guess high tea started at 15.30 so they had to be prepared for that and it was our fault for arriving late. As far as value for money goes, there are places to eat that are cheaper and better but when you consider it’s about RM38 for entry to the tower alone, I guess you may as well pay the extra RM50 and dine while you’re up there – just for the experience. I’m not sure what the diner selection nor night view is like but I got the feeling I would have been disappointed if I had paid RM198 for the dinner slot.

Author: 790angelinaaSingapore, Singapore
Title: lunch with friend
Review: Visited on 7/1/2017 Saturday with Friend at the Komtar JBCC 2nd floor. Even though,just half restaurant occupied but our food serving time took 30-40mins then being served. But saw others' table whom came later then us being served first. Think was the girl never keyed in our order in their system so they don't know our order is what. That's why make our dining almost 2.5hrs. Tried the FC Bang Bang(from receipt),RM20.90 forget what it's called. Is chicken fillet with breaded coated with fries n sunny side egg in bird nest shape basket-noodle deep fried. My friend ordered Spicy baked fish fillet with rice RM19.50,her milkshake vanilla,RM10.90 she said like drinking milk. My drink,Happiness fusion is strawberry with earl grey tea RM9.90,find it like syrup. Tried Brownie with vanilla ice cream w caramel topping in sizzling hot plate RM12.90. Vanilla ice cream with nut powder sprinkle on top is yum. But the brownie was burnt,taste n smell burnt. Another dessert Sizzling banana w chocolate ice cream RM12.90,the banana is fried without flour coated.Overall spend,RM114.15. Service wise need improvement as food serving time too long As for food,while handling brownie must be careful not to burn it,which ruin our appetite and wasted the brownie,luckily bottom part still can eat.

Author: boocik04Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced food
Review: The price does not justify the taste. The food is expensive but the taste is just mediocre. Nothing great. The waiter/waitress who waited on us seems uninterested to take orders and was very slow to come when we called. Sorry, I would not come here again.

Author: Shenyang1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place to eat smoked
Review: Great place to eat smoked meat definitely one of the best spot in Kuala Lumpur . Authentic smoke Texan bbq in atmosphere will bring you in US mood .. price very affordable for this level of quality. Definitely recommend for family or party . Big group can fi as this place is very large

Author: kllove26Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: disappointed
Review: I visited for lunch and invited my important people. A waitress told me it would take only 10 minutes to get Peking Duck ready and I ordered it. But we had to wait for it for 50 minutes though I asked them(including the manager of restaurant) to serve it as soon as possible many times. At the end of lunch, we ordered desserts directly to the manager. However not come for ages...Finally we canceled the desserts. I was dissapointed at this restaurant and will never come back.

Author: HarryHank
Title: Closed for renovations
Review:
NOW CLOSED

New owners. Why do they buy a profitable, established business, and renovate it?
Good luck as you have lost all you previous customers, now you must start from square one.

Author: Alaa A
Title: Good but been in better hardrock in other coutries
Review: Ok for lunch/dinnerWhat was strange , when i arrived i asked for place two persons, they said sorry u have wait ...frankly speaking place wasnt crowd that much ....then suddenly i show them my reward 'priority seating' , less than 5min i was on my table......food ok as other HR

Author: yeoc468
Title: Average
Review:
Meat here are a little tough.

Service is average.

Ambience .... nothing to write about.

Can skip if you want.

Author: NchuatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food in a great place!
Review: If you are working or residing in the Kuala Lumpur City Centre, here's a great place to dine. The restaurant is situated in an old bungalow, probably built in the 1960s. What attracts me to this place is the ambience, but not discounting the great food they served. I have been to this restaurant several times, 7 to be precise and I truly enjoyed each visit. The interior of the restaurant has a retro look to it plus it is cozy. Limited parking is available.

Author: _Valene93
Title: Authentic Indian Food
Review: Loved the briyani here, very authentic and close to home. Service was abit slow and the place mats were a little dirty however the value for money cannot be beat.

Author: Alex LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Very bad service and follow up
Review: Call the SkyBar this morning planning do make a reservation for the day, unfortunately I've been calling few times the restaurant was busy the person will get back to me. Yet my question was not solved in an appropriate manner. The operator told me to leave the phone number and name which I did, Several hours later finally got a call from a gentlemen. As a first timers, I would like to know more information about the hotel and also the menu and the cuisine that serves. I would say information from the internet is TOO LIMITED. Non of the information is useful for me. Try searching for other people blogs and review, feeling to give a try with the high rating of TRIP ADVISOR. Unfortunately I was disappoint with the follow up and the service. The gentleman the return my call couldn't answer my question at all. Is if so difficult to send me a sample of menu for reference? What so secret about the menu can let everyone knows? It is too ridiculous for me waiting and waiting and is just like 1 hour from now to my reservation timing. Very disappointed, with Traders JB. The same experience in Traders KL is far much more better. He claimed that he have to seek got his manager approval before sending me the menu. Keep waiting for the menu, but still nothing been send through.VERY UPSET with the service provided.

Author: Lasrin
Title: OK beer and average food
Review: Happy hour prices for Guinness which was a good thing. Food menu is quite limited, I had a hamburger which was rather average.

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Good but no variety
Review: A group of us met for high tea. All they served was mantou (chinese pau/bun) with various fillings. They also served soup desserts like bubur chacha, red bean and cendol. The mantou was nice but you cannot eat many as they are very filling. Wish this high tea has some other variety other than the mantou. Nevertheless, service was good. There is only valet parking available for this hotel.

Author: Brenda0913
Title: lovely nature scenic...but food juz so so
Review: lovely nature scenic...but food juz taste average to me... surrounded by lush of trees... reaaly love the place... but i do love their signature drinks... tamarind juice and the lemon grass tea....

Author: NK10
Title: Nadodi - hidden gem
Review: What an amazing experience. Food was artistically done and put me in a confusion weather to admire the plating or have it. Service staff were extremely knowledgeable and attentive. Thank you for an amazing journey will surely visit again.

Author: MyspaghettimonsterSubang
Title: Gave me food eaten by others
Review: Went there for late lunch with wife today. Simple order of fried rice and sambal vegetables. After 10 minutes a waiter brought sambal vegetables to a table next to us. A guy at the table ate some of the sambal vegetables and then stopped eating it altogether. We didn't think anything unusual about it. Anther 10 minutes passed and out came another plate of stir fried vegetables for the table next to us. Then this 2 idiots from the next table told the waiter the sambal vegetables is not theirs. This chief waiter (Chinese man) realised the mistake and took the sambal vegetables and gave it to us, saying it's our dish.I asked if someone had eaten it. This Chinese man said no one touched it and said the sambal vegetables is ours. WTF.... this plate of sambal vegetables was on another table with bits of it eaten by others and this Chinese man chief waiter had the audacity to expect me and wife to eat this dish. He then walked way mumbling something.5 minutes later our fried rice came. We ate our fried rice (so so only) quickly and just want to leave as soon as possible. Lady boss saw we did not touch the sambal vegetables and did not charged us for it.Wifey swore never to return to this restaurant. Terrible people.

Author: marianof709Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food and wine selection.
Review: They have a very broad wine selection. Service and food quality was excellent. We shared the cold cuts plater, then had the baked goat cheese with honey and finally the Cesar Salad with Salmon. All dishes were scrumptious and time for very delivery was decent even though the place was full.It's a pity they allow smoking at the bar. Split between non smoking and smoking areas does not make sense.

Author: Chuan Wey LSydney, New South Wales, Australia
Title: Average
Review: Dined with friends here for lunch and found the food pretty average. We sat outdoors and the decor was kind of cool looking. The wine list isn't too bad as they have quite a variety on hand. The decor is interesting looking, kind of a hip warehouse feel.We had scallops, pizza, some pasta and they're okay - but not exceptional enough to call for a return visit.

Author: XuJR88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Long waiting. Slow in serving. Medicore food
Review: Waited 1 hour STANDING in line. When finally seated waited another hour for the food to be serve, really a test of patience. After 2 hour waiting the crab finally arrive. Instead of serving man tou, they serve toasted bread to dip into the sauce. And if you order crab. A minimum of 2 crabs must be ordered. Was too pissed on the waiting to enjoy the food. Just want to get out there ASAP! Be warn! There's of mosquito too!

Author: acantopsis02Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Filipino food
Review: Crispy Pata (deep fried pork leg) is a must try! Go with an empty stomach or bring a few friends, goes down so well with ice cold beers!Egg plant omelette, stuffed Milkfish, chicken adobo, pork satay, pumpkin surprise are other must tries. Ingredients are always fresh and comes in decent quantity with reasonable price. If you find any dish insufficient, just order an extra portion!To end the sumptuous meal, halo halo (shaved ice dessert mixed with fruits, jellies and ice cream) is well deserved ending.

Author: cdwood77Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Very Elegant
Review: So many eloquent reviews... All I can add is Bravo!We have dined in many fine restaurants in many countries and. Cannot remember a more gracious presentation nor a more elegant setting, yes, it is a bit pricy...and well worth it considering the ambience. Sooo delicious, I did wish the portions were not so small, especially the bouillabaisse which differs from any I can remember as they use a cream base, mild herbs, subtle flavor to enhance the seafood rather than overpower.Do not miss Jeffs Cave the fabulous wine cellar with wine bar built into a natural cavern complete with stalagmites and a fantastic collection of fine(and ancient ) wines from the worlds best vineyards. Best to choose from their bottle selection rather than the limited by the glass offering. So bring some friends and share an incredible setting with a fine wine
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: liiwaShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Truly disappointed!
Review: Perhaps I should try the Ala carte. We paid RM150+ / head just to eat those low grade sushi buffet dinner, not many choices at sushi bar, they don't have even free flow shrimp tempura (we only allowed to order two shrimps tempura per person). Truly disappointed as they don't have soft shell crab tempura/roll too, how about dragon roll? Besides, I don't think their sushi rolls were freshly made, not many choices for sashimi sections.They do have the BBQ section, only have few choices to pick, for instant vegetable/mushroom, chicken, beef and Salmon. Just wondering why they don't serve prawns or squids?Anyway, the dessert bar average ok - but the green tea ice cream definitely not up to my expectation.

Author: ev2993
Title: Excellent choice in cat Town
Review: The ambient is pleasant and the waitress are attentive. The food is excellent and the place is really clean.Food serving is decent and fast. The taste is delicious without heavily seasoned.Get a real European authentic kitchen here in cat town. With a fusion of local tuak and laksa flavour choices in the menu.Consider you to do a full course of meal..from antipasti all the way to a limoncello shot.Price will not a concern after finished the plates on your table.Well done.

Author: Carousel7
Title: Decent food
Review:
We had Chinese food for dinner, at affordable prices. Andrew was very friendly. I could see why the British expatriates or tourists enjoyed his hospitality.

Food was decent.

Author: Roving739490
Title: Satay crab
Review: Always one of my favourite restaurant, the satay crabs is one of my love although the price is high and can’t get the fresh crab every time, but I will still come back

Author: pongo56Blackwood, United Kingdom
Title: disappointed
Review: Sadly we did not have such a great meal as previous reviewer. .. food very average and certainly did NOT come out at same time ... 30 minutes between first and last person served. .. and they had the same fried rice so that was bizarre ... I had been there on a previous visit for afternoon coffee and cake and loved the place as the decor is so lovely.

Author: COW6Y10
Title: Bargain priced local food
Review: A restaurant that had lots of locals going to it is a good sign for me. A wide selections, that was very reasonable in price. Clean and quick service, with very nice waiting staff. I would recommend this place, if visiting Little India.

Author: 3vilfr3akybabi3
Title: Expensive but Tasty French Crepe
Review: Friendly Lady-Boss, Great Crepe but it is on the sweet side. Fixed my craving for dessert at night. yummy!

Author: jtsl9Sydney, Australia
Title: Nice Atmosphere, Better Company
Review: Decided to have xmas dinner with some ex colleague here as the xmas menu looks good. We had the seafood paella, lobster rigatoni, lamb shoulder, baby octopus, soft shell crab corn chowder and of course the sizzling brownie. The seafood paella and lobster rigatoni were a let down as the rice was underdone and hard, the lobster was a tad overcooked which made it rubberly. Besides that, the other dishes were pretty good especially the baby octopus and corn chowder. The restaurant was deck out with Xmas decoration and the ambience was really nice.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Nina CRichmond, Canada
Title: Pricy food but good atmosphere
Review: We decided to switch back to western food after a few meals of curry laksa and etc. This place is perfect for that if you miss your typical western food. Steak was reasonable and the burger was very good. Price was about 70 USD for two people which is quite expensive considering Melaka. However the seats on the balcony by the river side was worthwhile but make sure you go early to grab a seat!

Author: yinsterLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unexpected
Review: You don't go to Lang Kawi and come out having experienced really tasty korean food. Well worth the find. If you go on the same day as the Night Market, it is a treat to eat. It was so good, we went twice out of the three days we stayed in LK. Portions are big and the restaurant is clean. Owners are so friendly, make you feel like good friends.

Author: DevversNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Tourist trap, avoid
Review: Id expected this to be a classy restaurant serving top quality food with a stunning view. Sadly it only fulfils the latter. The novelty of this restaurant and millions of passing tourists must help its continued existence, because I'm not sure who would go back a second time for a £45-a-head very basic buffet.The lukewarm food is basic and boring, and we wished we'd tried any number of places but this. The entertainment of a singer and pianist wa unwittingly hilarious because it was so bad.Had same experience as other reviewer... 15 Rm taxi to restaurant but 35 Rm from info desk when we left, but there's no other way of getting away.And by that point we really wanted to leave. Total rip off.

Author: B7920ZRmichaelv
Title: Good chance to try malay food
Review:
After asking so many times for malay food (not indian or chinese), in the hostel they recomend us this place.
The food was nice specially the blue pea rice and the laksa. Great price too

Author: Justreviewit
Title: Poor service experience
Review: Our water wasn’t being refilled so I had to put my hand up for 15 minutes to get the attention of a server. I got one woman with short hair and asked her to fill our waters. She filled up only 1 glass and immedidiately left without filling the others and set the pitcher down with attitude.

Author: Kev_hi
Title: Vasco @ KL hilton - Overated
Review: 1. Service: except for the warm welcome at the entrance, the service is basically non-existence.2. Food: salty noodle chicken soup, iced cold but not fresh seafood, tasteless lamb, pepper mill with no pepper, my latte in teh tarik glass... Totally not worth for RM200 (during 2020 Cny) per person.

Author: GABBYUSABABYPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Omakase in KL
Review: Loved the simple tasting menu at this hidden location. Traditional Sushi counter style. Chef Sam creates for us a special, unique tailored menu full of mellow, subtle flavors. Small and intimate restaurant with very few guests. Being a local Malaysian I thought I knew all the good Sushi / Japanese in town. Location is not the best not very central.

Author: Keiran J
Title: Amazing food
Review: Went here on many occasions and everything we tried was absolutly beautiful. Hats off to them. Vegetable curry was especially good

Author: yvonne t
Title: Family lunch
Review: Visited this restaurant for family Sunday lunch. Super long queue before we can get a table cause they are very famous. Food served very fast & clean restaurant.

Author: SD2606Christchurch, New Zealand
Title: Fast, friendly and delicious option on Jalan Alor
Review: Picked to eat here on Jalan Alor (night street market food) and really enjoyed it. Was expensive for night street market food (still cheap though for us Kiwis) but the service was fast and friendly, the food was delicious and good portions. My husband had frog which was a bit of a novelty for us.

Author: Marie O
Title: Good Italian restaurant
Review: This restaurant has a good ambience, the interior design is simple but nice, the staff is also efficient and friendly. The salad, too, is fresh! I would definitely visit again whenever I crave Italian food.

Author: etwy
Title: Pricey
Review: Tried few of their food like Nasi Briyani Kambing (lamb), pasta, pizza, hor fun soup and steak. Pricey but taste soso. Cakes are too sweet. Tasted their wine too - okay.

Author: Stanislaw1972Krakow, Poland
Title: Worthy experience, don't complain about food!
Review: A very nice and totally worthy experience - a combination of dining with enjoying Kuala Lumpur views. A rotating restaurant, full turn takes approx. 90 min, that's the length of a dinning session there. Some people complained to us about food - actually it wasn't bad.

Author: Fiona H
Title: Best in Ipoh
Review: Best tauge chicken in Ipoh. They have really delicious chicken feet too. Opens at 6pm and make sure you're there before 6! Or else you'd have to queue up for it
Restaurant: Restoran Cowan Street Ayam Tauge & Koitiau

Author: penangowlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh seafood in a unique setting
Review: We dined in Jala during our stay at The Andaman recently. The restaurant is by the seaside with a very unique setting. Instead of concrete flooring, the restaurant's flooring is actually sand from the beach. Guests are invited to go barefoot.Instead of choosing from a standard menu, guests are invited to select their fresh seafood at the main counter. The friendly and helpful staff showed us what seafood were available that night and made some really good recommendations. We had a grilled whole-fish and some prawns. We like the simple cooking style as brought out the fresh taste of the seafood. The selection of sauces and sides provided with each order were great too. Highly recommended.

Author: florab495
Title: Bit disappointing
Review: Lonely planet overly bigged up this restaurant. Lovely staff, and veggie dishes were unusual and full of flavour. However we also had two different pork dishes in which the meat was dry and of poor quality. An interesting insight into Iban cooking, but nothing more.

Author: peepeepoopooPew
Title: Slow
Review: Food very slow The food very slow The food so slow ultra slow very slow too slow very very slow slow slow

Author: TASunde
Title: Was nice
Review: It was a nice business dinner. We had a private room and staff who were helpful and attentive. They allowed wine to be brought in as well.

Author: CuriousjennySingapore
Title: Most un accomadating & rude staff
Review: Our whole dinning experience was spoilt by the rude and rigid attitude of the staff on our two visits on 19 and 22 Dec'2013.All of our minor requests were turned down like ...request to be seated inside was flatly refused inspite of being completely empty.(We were 3 families total twelve ) Yes ,every organization has rules that they follow but a helpful gesture can either build or break it's goodwill.Inspite of the good food and lovely location.My family will never be eating at this unfriendly place nor will I recommend it to any of my friends.

Author: 821biancaf
Title: Nice place
Review:
Best shisha place in Malaysia love their 80 varieties of shisha. The place is very nice 
 I love the environment.  Thanks for your service. Surely coming back here when come back to malaysia

Author: jimhS7817OQJersey, United Kingdom
Title: Crowded with poor service
Review: Visited with friends for a meal and drink. Although the food was ok the service due to the pressure the staff were under was slow and erratic although the staff were friendly enough. Was also a bit on the noisy side with background music and lots of shouting..

Author: YenTi H
Title: Awesome food with best service
Review: We ordered 4 dishes which are frutti di mare in guazzetto (seafood soup), salsiccia (lamb sausage pizza), seafood aglio olio spaghetti (chef recommend pasta for us) and bistecca alla fiorentina (angus t-bone steak)...overall evrything is so yummy, nice and full...very recommended the seafood soup and seafood pasta...they’re very generous with the seafood and also fresh...the lamb sausage pizza is their homemade sausage lamb which is so delicious and lastly their t-bone steak which is cooked perfectly...just a perfect dinner with best service..why i called it best service, coz this is our first time to come so we got help from the chef, Chef Jeffery, to let us know what is their recommendation and after we finished our dinner..he came to us and ask about the food...overall is really good, from the food to the service including the kitchen and service team, enjoyable atmosphere with friendly staff...will comeback for sure...

Author: SCYX
Title: Meat Lovers
Review: The meat are superb. So delicious. I don't really like some of the dessert. Environment is good and the house wine is ok too.

Author: Sandesh B
Title: Really Really Bad Service!
Review: Staff very rude! Food quality is just average. Non-smoking so not very convenient. Will definitely not come back.

Author: puvan1978
Title: Best Indian Cuisine
Review: Visited TasteBud last Sunday for lunch. Super helpful staffs and cosy set up. We were helped with suggestion of food items. The Crispy Baby Corns as Starter vanished within minutes as our children really loved it. It was crispy on the outside and juicy inside.Next came our main course : Bread Basket consisting of various Naans & Kulcha, Butter Chicken, Mixed Vege with Paneer, Mutton Keema and Prawn Briyani.The boneless butter chicken was so juicy, the mix vege with paneer was flavourful and i can't find the words for the mutton keema...it was simply yummilicious. Generous serving of prawn briyani had our bellies full yet the mouth was asking for more. We ordered Chocolate Milkshakes, Soda Lime, Badam Milk and Falooda. Everything tasted good & refreshing.Generous serving of food portion at a reasonable price.Overall...5⭐ and

Title: Always a great choice!
Review: This place never disappoints. There's a wide variety of dependable Asian and Western favourites. Drinks are good and everybody is there to have fun... so the buzz is fantastic.

Author: 707siobhanm
Title: Best pork ribs in Kuala Lumpur!
Review: Best pork ribs in Kuala Lumpur! Worth a try, open feel, free flowing beer, central location. Yummy food despite the stoic service.

Author: ronyc277
Title: Good pork... Nicely done
Review: Had a wonderful lunch exceeding expectations. Pork taste really good. Must go with rice and all the add ons. Sloppy fries to complete the meal.

Author: Baby SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service, fantastic food
Review: Earlier this month, we visited Nizza with our kids. They had just rolled out a new menu, and Chef Kim was kind enough to offer us some of his recommendations. The burrata was simple yet so good, and I loved the fact that they source a lot of their vegetable locally (ie Cameron Highlands). My son loved the steamed mussels with white wine; he polished off about 80% of the plate by himself! Don't forget to try the steaks too, which are cooked in the Mibrasa oven so it comes with that lovely smoky aftertaste. Overall, a fantastic meal and service was very friendly throughout the meal.

Author: sambashNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Nice atmosphere and food
Review: We have eaten at BBQ Nights twice now during our holiday in KL.The food is cooked in Indian / pakistani style - BBQ. The lamb chops were great. Boneless grilled tikka & Fish also good. Sitting outside watching everyone go by creates a nice atmosphere. staff are friendly and helpful. We thought this was not bad value for money £8 per head compared to some of the other resturants we have eaten at eg. ~ £8 per head - for main meal , 1 soft drink , icecream and a coffee. Would recommend it.

Author: travelholic17
Title: What Happened?
Review: I love Kenny Rogers Roasters but this one's just unacceptable. The floor is smelly, mashed potatoes look and taste like a porridge, and the chicken still has blood oozing.

Author: Alpehornisten
Title: Disappointing
Review: This restaurant does not deserve being in Top 10 of Kuching restaurants. Although very friendly staff the food was really nothing special. Actually I already forgot what I had.

Author: Kaladin T
Title: Delicious Indian food
Review: Lovely food. It was a bit confusing in terms of going up ourselves and picking what we want as we werent sure how it all worked and how much each was, or even what it was. Overall we paid 13MYR each which included the soft drink we bought.
Restaurant: Vinni Jeyaa Banana Leaf Curry House

Author: Edith CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good big bao
Review: We queue for nearly 45 mins to get a seat. By then most of the items were already sold out.I will definitely not go for the siew Mai or Har kow. Anything that has similar skin as Har kow is terrible. It is soft and mushy. This place definitely not serving authentic dim sum if that is what you are looking for.But I will highly recommended the big bao. The filling tasted like beef but we were told that it is pork. It is very juicy and flavourful. Beware when eating as the juice will squirt out if you pinch from the bottom.

Author: SuneetKSra
Title: Le Petit Chef GHKL
Review: I was absolutely looking forward for this experience. Service was impeccable and the food delicious. However, after viewing the videos, i was honestly expecting a little chef to ‘actually’ cook the meals for us. The visuals were not sharp enough and it felt like just moving from one country to another with some lighting effect. So that was a disappointment. A more personalized meal would have been much nicer.

Author: Tri-shahRKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not Worthy of a 5 star Hotel Buffet
Review: You see, this 5 star restaurant has been entertaining Groupon customers, so they think all customers are the grub n go type! The sashimi buffet was very poor quality and not good at all. When I asked for the roast beef, two small measly pieces was given with a sour face. Staff seems on the lookout for greedy customers.After frequenting this place for years, I am dropping it like a bombshell.

Author: KennyKueh
Title: Unfriendly staff
Review: Visited the "famous" cafe in Melaka at night, the food was nice, Environment is good but the hospitality is very poor.I do remember the time was around 10pm. When we walk in, no staff entertaining us, I'm very sure that night wasn't that busy, we wait for about 10 minutes, a male staff bring us to the table that haven't been "clean" I suppose, after we sit for around 15 minutes then we get the Menu and the waiter just inform us that kitchen close, why can't the waiter tell us at first? We wasted our time just to know that your kitchen is closed? We have no choice so we just order some simple snack and drink, when the food is serve, the waiter not serving us the plates and some tableware, as a customer we still need to ask from the waiter, why a simple steps can't be done as a "famous" cafe? Worst part is when the food are serve, the waiter ask for the payment before we start our meal, does he look down on us as we dress very casual? Why can't he wait until we finish our meal? While we are eating, the waiters stand beside us to watch the television show. Er... please la, show some respect to the customer.Anyway, recommended for the food and environment but seriously do something to improve your hospitality.Thank you.

Author: Clem_SydneySydney, Australia
Title: Monday Breakfast at Temptations
Review: Went to Temptations breakfast buffet which has a wide spread of western, spicy Malaysian focus with minimum Chinese and no Japanese food items which was a little surprise for those who dont have a preference for inclination for spicy taste. Also less selection of fruits or local fruits.

Author: KiatYeenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quality of service needs to be improved
Review: Went for lunch for colleagues farewell. The waiter is clearing our table and collecting 2 bowls with soup inside from my desk. The bowls on his arm are already wobbling and I asked whether he could handle or not but he did not answer my question. When he extended his arm to collect the saucer from my desk, what I hope not going to happen it really happened. All the bowls were fall from his arm and the fish head noodle soup also pouring to my back. No apology were given until my colleague asked and no discount nor any deduction given to our bill. I know it is not compulsory to give discount to us but behavior of the waiters were like, this is something happening everyday. By the way, the last time when we visited the restaurant someone broke some dishes as well.We love the food in the restaurant but will be hesitate to visit again if the quality of the service is still the same....

Author: pakabayAdelaide, Australia
Title: Fantastic Food & Service
Review: We visited Teksen for dinner last night and yes, there was a queue but, perhaps because it was Sunday night, it wasn’t too bad. We arrived around 7:00 pm and wouldn’t have waited any more than 15 minutes.But even the waiting is entertaining. Yes, you are handed a playing card, in sequence, and a menu and when your number/table comes up, you place your order, then get taken to your table.Because a large table became empty, we were asked to join 3 other couples at the large table, which wasn’t a problem for us.The couple that we were next to were young locals who said that they come to Teksen at least once a month.The food was served quickly, hot and full of flavour. Our 3 courses (plus steamed rice) were just fantastic, some of the best food we have had on this holiday.Watching this well oiled machine work was amazing, the logistics and time management to get so many people through, seated, served was impressive.Well worth a visit.

Author: Linda345679
Title: Celebrate my birthday
Review: Nice place..  Food so delicious and the service so great thank David and Jane for making my birthday special we recommend this restaurant and we will comeback here

Author: tgwwgtTravelHermanus, South Africa
Title: Good Mexican food, disappointing service
Review: We went to this restaurant with friends on a Saturday night, you certainly have to book as the place was pumping. Excellent Margheritas, so nice that you need to buy a jug- much easier than ordering by the glass.The Mexican fare, enchiladas, burritos, tacos etc was excellent, What could have been better was the service, which was slow. It was also a bit noisy, but after a few margheritas....Clientele seemed to be predominantly in the 25 -45 age bracket, some big tables with families celebrating an occasion.

Author: pedrosz1
Title: Nice place
Review:
The service is very good.
The food is very good I liked the wraps, the wrap lettuce and rhe prawns noodle.
The prices were ver good.

Author: SilverKit
Title: Very poor service
Review: The music there was really enjoyable, and the atmosphere was quite good. But the waitress's service was really bad! While some of my friends did not order the drinks, her face expression just like looking down upon my friends. This made people really uncomfortable.

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Nice Restaurant
Review: Was here recently for a lunch. Ordered Buritto with beef, I must say it was good. The bread before starter that came with garlic butter was excellent, which we had asked for extra several times and they accommodated without hassle. Overall, I enjoyed it, will surely come back.

Author: David HSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Disgusting
Review: This would be the worst tasting burger I have ever had in my entire life, McDonalds tastes better for a fraction of the cost.When I paid my bill with a 100 MYR note the server wandered off got ten minutes, I eventually found her outside on the phone with no regard for her waiting customer.

Author: mountain333
Title: Dinner - Enthic Local Food
Review: It's worth try it. The Midin belacan is not spicy, the soup terjun fit well with the big portion brown rice. The calamari is not bad. Definitely will recommend this restaurant to others..

Author: maxpang
Title: Smoky!
Review: This place is famous for their chicken chops! This place is kind of ancient! The place has a smoky kinda smell in it!

Author: monniemoo
Title: Okay...nothing great!
Review:
Enjoyed the beef rendang...but the rest was fairly average. Not bad...just not great!

Service was okay but not particularly attentive. 

Overall, probably won't return as would prefer to try other options that KL offers!

Author: Sweden_svedenSigtuna, Sweden
Title: Average or below
Review: Not the standard of a five star hotel. You can eat better in the nearby malls for a much lower price. Breakfast is a little better than dinner/lunch, but not much. The sushi is one of the poorest I've experienced, the rice is like porridge. Children mat find the food ok. Staff is sometimes really good and sometimes not doung their duties 100%.

Author: VintageClaret
Title: Ok..3 stars at best.
Review: More of a cafe restaurant really....nothing to shout about at all food or service wise. Needs to step up a bit in terms of decor certainly.

Author: Richard WWorcester, United Kingdom
Title: Evening buffet was extensive
Review: I had breakfast here. The choice was excellent, and the staff very helpful. A great location, although busy. I also ate in the evening, there was a buffet duing Ramadan. The choice was fantastic and a wide range of foods. An expensive treat - but it was a special treat if you were ending the day's fast.

Author: feliciadionMelaka, Malaysia
Title: My fiancé choose here to celebrate
Review: My fiancé choose here to celebrate Valentine’s Day ! End up waiting for the food almost freaking 2 hours !!!!! I’ve asked twice to different waiters but not even one freaking person come and answer me how long do I have to wait more !!!!! Seriously , you guys made my day !!!! 1st and last time here !!! Nice place but super slow !!!!!!!

Author: MF15
Title: WIll not go again
Review: Went during breakfast around 10 am on a Sunday. Food was OK (however, quite expensive for street setup) but tables were not cleaned on timely manner. Possibly due to understaffed. Dirty floor.

Author: Piotr K
Title: Taps is good
Review:
Starters are really good, main course and churros, just average.
Owners are trying hard to brig the service level up, hope they will make it soon.

Author: imrickyisaac
Title: Execellent Sushi
Review: We stumble this while riding a bicycle..We thought we just going to have a light meal..but.since the food.is so.good we keep on ordering the food..Must TRy..especially if you are the vegetarian person

Author: JeffT_JUmPerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average high end Japanese Restaurant
Review: Overall the food is ok and average for this considering “high end” restaurant.Expensive but the food is not match with the price tag.Lucky staff are attentive , good service given.Restaurant owner need to upgrade food taste to draws the crowd

Author: RoamingjiverOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Really excellent Malaysian food
Review: We stayed in the Traders hotel, where the concierge recommended this place when we asked for authentic Malaysian cuisine with a good ambience. This is what Bijan delivered. Wonderfully tasty dishes at reasonable prices with great service. You can choose to be inside or outside on a terrace with fans. Definitely worth trying if you are staying in KL for a few nights as we were.

Author: melvantan88
Title: Over rated over price
Review: Food sub standard, portion average, not worth the price at all , go to any local coffee shop you get the same taste but pay a friction of the cost.

Author: KateMcKaySeaford, United Kingdom
Title: Superb Sunday Brunch.
Review: We enjoyed ourselves from the moment we stepped in the front door of the hotel. The "Bubbelicious" theme was strong with a girl in a bubble in the foyer through to colour themed balloons on the table and soup served in bubble bowls. The food was tasty and varied and available in good quantity as was the Mumm champagne. Our glasses were never empty in the time we were there. A good selection of salads, seafood, roast meats and sweets. Although we did not have children with us the supervised children's play area looked excellent and must be fabulous for parents and children alike. Loved the little touches like the champagne prize draw and take home photograph. We will return for more.

Author: TonyInKL
Title: Great service with wine buffet
Review: Good evening dinner buffet and currently offering 50% discount for two dining.  Nice to have the additional wine buffet for only RM50++.

Author: Arlingtonian2011Arlington, Virginia
Title: Dinner buffet at the Link
Review: Although the food selection at the buffet is not much different from that of other hotels in KL,the staff are knowledgeable about dietary issues and very helpfulI wish to stress this as in Malaysian cuisine MSG is heavily and extensively used and most often you are not informed that it is even when you use the local phrase "ajimoto" to describe it. Servers often have no clue!This was the first hotel buffet in KL where knowledge of the ingredients was part of the staff training and that made all the difference for our group.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: Jannooi
Title: Nice decor but food is below average
Review: This area is famous for unique cafe....near to sekeping kong heng that worth a visit. Just right behind is the hawker street which is super crowded on weekend breakfast.Food at burp & giggles are below average.. pastry doesn't worth a try...burger only start serving at 11am. Pasta are ready made and the girls just heat it up for you. Coffee are nothing to mentioned. But still worth to visit to reminisce memory lane.

Author: mohdoqbaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food with wonderful view
Review: Literally in the Pedi field, Off the main road narrow access road between the fields took us to this cozy place. It was good idea that we went there for lunch or else would have missed the wonderful view. Local and asian influenced Yummy tasty food. One of the best beef rendang I ever had. While visiting Langkawi this is one of the must eat places.

Author: Jeremy5858London, United Kingdom
Title: Gone diwnhill
Review: We went last Monday evening having reserved a table at 8pm. Although we had been warned that this restaurant was not as good as it used be, we wanted to try for ourselves. The last time we came here was six months ago and now, in summary, we are disappointed with the haphazard service and mediocre food. Also the starters (satay and soup) more or less arrived half way through our main course. Moreover, the chicken was not even cooked properly. When we complained, the satay was taken away and simply reheated! Not the Madame Kwan of old.

Author: Laura TMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: sampled many tasty local dishes
Review: We were being treated by another company so didn't pay so I can't comment on the prices or value. But I can say that all of the food we were served was very tasty! There were soooo many dishes brought to our table and we enjoyed them all! I loved the "Lazy Susan" in the centre of our table so we could easily turn the middle and rotate all the food to easily access any dish. I can't eat nuts, sesame or seafood which is challenging in Asia but was able to try lots of yummy dishes here thanks to the helpful staff. Note vegetables are often cooked in sesame oil for fellow allergy suffers! My favourite dishes were the satay sticks (which I could enjoy as satay/peanut is always on the side) and a beef dish. We also ordered traditional desserts afterwards, which were very unusual - to us westerners! Worth the experience to try and my husband enjoyed the coconut ice shavings with the weird jelly toppings! I enjoyed the hot milky dessert with sweet potato and tapioca! and the fried banana desserts were considered excellent by everyone.

Author: gmenOn2014Wayne, New Jersey
Title: NOSH: NO Service Here
Review: We were 2 couples visiting Kuching fo a week in 2013 December, and NOSh was recommended by the owner of Batik Boutique ( a wonderful place where we stayed) for New year Eve dinner. So we havd high expectations. We had reservations, but when we arrived, they seated us smack in the entrance ( close to the kitchen counter where waiters took the food trays rom). So we requested to be moved- they moved us to the ' extension" which was outside- where we were promptly attacked by mosquitoes. So we moved back to the same table inside. Ordered drinks, and we could have sworn there was no alcohol in their bloody Mary. There wa sno difference between my drink and which my wife ordered ( she sked for non-alcoholic one, and I found it tasted exactly as mine, which was supposed to be a regular one). The service simply sucks .When we checked about their " Special menu for the evening", the waitress ( who was the perfect non-friendly, sour faced , disillusioned employee of the year) said she did not know if the items came with anything else such as rice or salad. Finally we ordered, and requested that my wife who is a vegetarian, be served a garlic bread or at least two slices of bread- and she refused saying there is no bread ( There is no Bread in a restaurant !!!) . We were about the first to arrive there ( 7: 10 PM), so there were not more than 3 patrons there, but the way the waiters ran around, talking loudly, made it look like the place was crouded and they were over stressed ! When the food came, it came in intervals of 15 minutes- so the first to get served had almost finished when I got my order ( the last). By then the restaurant was half full, so we waited another 15 minutes before we got the attention of the waitress, and asked for the bill and reuested for a taxi- she said there is no way she can call a cab, as they dont have any phone numbers for that ( even tiniest restaurants we dined in Kuching had no such problems). While waiting for the Check, another lady ( who looked and acted like the owner) asked us if evrything is OK. We all shrugged, and showed our disappointment, but she never asked any more questions and walked past. When we paid the check, the change came as a big bundle of singles ( about 25 of them, along with bigger bills), and with the waitress and another person (Owner??) hovering around, watching us count it all out, and checking out how much we would tip for their wonderful attitude and adding insult to injury ( pricy dinner for a lousy year end evening). For the first time in our life, we decided they deserved NO tip - for NOSH ( No Service Here restaurant). As I need to say something positive here, my food ( shank of lamb) was good, but my friends did not enjoy what they ordered.My recommendation- Avoid this place like plague, if you want to feel good about a meal !

Author: wajihbBerlin, Germany
Title: Delicious food, cheap drinks!!!
Review: Love the food at 21 changkat, lower level is a nice romantic restaurant and upstairs is a good club with good music with good reasonably priced drinks. Only recommendation is that it's best to go there on Wednesdays, ladies night, free drinks for the ladies and better crowd than during weekends.

Author: bbtehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great location, good food
Review: If one wants to avoid the mad traffic in the heart of KL, this place is perfect. Located in Bangsar, parking is fairly convenient. The menu is an interesting mix of pork dishes with local favourites thrown in - yes, Hokkien mee and BKT included! Have dined here for many years and despite changes in the kitchen and service crews, one can have a lovely evening here and leave quite filled with good food. Pre-dinner drinks in the loft is always nice, and usually you would bump into people you know there. Recommended for a cosy but sometimes noisy meal.

Author: Yushikin
Title: Worst Service!!!!
Review: We still not finished our dinner but the staff ask us to leave from the table!!!! Reason because the need to combine the table for their 7 pax customer. What the hell!!! I was not there because I'm going to the cashier after the bloody stupid staff (big size, fairer and wearing spec) inform me that our take way is ready and need to collect at counter! Immediately i walked to the cashier, not even 5min my family already stand and left the table and our drinks not even finished!!! We do pay for the service tax but what kind of service we get??? Your staff i totally ZERO knowledge and manners!!!

Author: daveNewportNewport, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic
Review: We walked in and we immediately felt welcomed. The atmosphere and the ambiance were great. Everyone was super friendly we ordered our meal and the service was amazingly speedy, the food was brilliant. Tasty fresh and great value. A pint of ASAHI was 20 myr. The owner came over after we had eaten he ordered a plate of squid and we drank and ate together. It was a totally brilliant experience. They have a band playing who are great. IF YOU ARE IN KUCHING THIS IS A MUST VISIT BAR.Thank you very much.Croeso (welsh for thank you).

Author: 645charlesh
Title: Great service, food solid
Review: Handy and tasty Japanese restaurant in the Intercontinental KL. Good service and tasty tempura. Wine list range could be improved.

Author: NomadicFootprints
Title: Good food, though a little on the pricey side
Review: I came here for a friends birthday party and they handled a group of what must have been 20 people well. The food was tasty, though as other reviewers have commented the portions could be bigger for the price (relative to KL). The ambience/decor is good and the cocktails were delicious. The guacamole was amazing - recommend.

Author: rabaah_rosziniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Family lunch.
Review: We always eat here every fortnightly.We always go to the one at Bangsar Shopping Centre as it's a walking distance from our home.Especially loved the Crispy Chicken Chipotle and my hubby always have his Fav Swiss Mushroom Lamb Burger(Huge Portion)...and the Lava Chocolate Cake is a Must for dessert!

Author: lbthomsen
Title: From excellent to poor
Review: Used to be great and the onmy place to catch a ciggie before going to the movies, now turned their bar non smoking, which I am sure some people appreciate, but I do not.

Author: Johnnyboi9966
Title: Excellent Place
Review: Canopy staff was very professional and polite. They have excellent Shisha and cocktails I would highly recommend!

Author: NomadicBoys
Title: Good safe food (v yummy dessert)
Review:
We came here on a Friday after Eid- all the other eateries were shut except this gem which meant it was very busy!

Despite this, we had a nice omelette and chicken giro kebab. The real highlight is their dessert!

Author: 27Vivien77Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food at reasonable prices
Review: We chanced upon Manhattan Fish Market in our shopping. Fish and chips with salad (dory or salmon belly, grilled or fried) on offer at RM8.50! Mocktails were on 50% discount. Good idea to have the drinks that go with the fried fish. We tried both the dory and fried salmon belly - delicious!

Author: chan93012014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Too Commercialised. Arrogant and cookings compromised for fast services. Expensive.
Review: Two person bill came to Rm37. Two noodles.5 meat n fish balls. 1 plate chicken and taugeh. Noodles were precooked and just served with hot soup over them (soup also NOT steaming hot). Chicken are not probably cleaned and has small feathers on them. Rude service by throwing the PAID signage on our table. In short, no big fuss on the foods and they are more happier competitors around. Suggest to stay away from that road frequent by tourists. Expensive and unsatisfying.

Author: pradeepkodanya
Title: Excellent food and location
Review: Nice open restaurant on the corner of jalan Parek and jalan P Ramlee. Right in heart of the city, very close to KLCC Twin towers and major hotels. Serves excellent pakistani punjabi food. Being a vegetarian, this restaurant has provided me many choices. Always filled with people but doesn't feel crowded. Cheese naan is a must try. Very friendly staff and service is pretty fast.

Author: greenestbubbles
Title: Family friendly, big portions, yummy food!
Review: Staff are friendly. Food is as authentic as nyonya food gets. The portions are big and reasonably prized which makes it great for sharing. Family friendly environment. Would definitely recommend and visit again!

Author: zgianoTulsa, Oklahoma
Title: Overrated. Overpriced. Small Plates.
Review: I’m very confused by this place. Meals say “serves 2-3 people.” Meals were verrrryyy small. As in, 2 of us got 2 plates that each serve “2-3 people.” We both left hungry. My ravioli had 3 raviolis and 2 scallops. Besides the portions, the food wasn’t that great. My friend got the cod, and he’s telling me to write “not great.”We both came here because of some good reviews. Did this place change? We both don’t understand. Since you’ll spend about 200 ringgit, take your money somewhere else that’s worth it.

Author: saad k
Title: Great bbq flavour and reasonably priced.
Review: Food was really good and authentic flavours . Enjoyed the chicken jalfrezi and garlic nan definitely worth trying. Great waiter called nauman if me and my wife was ok quite a few times which was really nice. Best service i have had in KL.

Author: U556DLjessicabLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great satay but no chicken!
Review: This place is a great find. Luckly when we arrived it wasn't extremely busy and got seated straight away. The prices are great- 1 ringget per skewer. They range from tofu to crab sticks to wontons but no chicken!! The coke is 2 ringgets and it makes for an enjoyable experience. I would recommend just for the novelty and you are not having to part with a lot of money.

Author: Veronica CKL
Title: Unprofessional & rude Acme Manager
Review: Please do avoid this restaurant. I had a nasty experience of being verbally abused by the Operations Manager of Acme. I voiced my concern of the toliet door not being covered properly (there was a hole in the door). While I was using the toilet cubicle, I heard a male voice and saw hands & a measuring tape through the glass door. Instead of being professional and mature, he invalidated my concern and hurled profanities at me as I caught him in the restroom holding a measuring tape & talking on his phone. When a customer is being offended, it is not suprising to lose customers.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Kathryn DEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Good food and cold beer
Review: We ate here on a couple of occasions. Firstly we tasted their cakes - a fruit berry strudel and a banana crumble cake with vanilla icecream - absolutely delicious at RM 12.50. Our second meal wasn't quite as good - a very strange mixed meat platter for RM 36. The other food we saw looked great, though.Still, the beer was always cold at RM 7, with happy hour 5-7 with buy 1 take 1, and the restaurant itself is very attractive with plenty of modern art on the walls, which is also for sale. Small outside seating area. Seems very popular with locals and touristst alike.

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Standards have dropped
Review: There was a 2 for 1 deal on the Nasi Lemak when we went, which may explain why we were told that there was no more sambal left. We were promised more egg in return which meant a whole hard boiled egg instead of half! So the Nasi Lemak without any sambal (chilli spice with anchovies) was very disappointing. The acar also seemed watered down. Basically, if you can’t serve the complete dish, it should not have been offered. Another in the party had the Cantonese noodles. It was a small amount of noodles with 2 small prawns, several bits of chicken and several bits of cuttlefish. It was not adequate for a price of over RM20. So, again, disappointing. I have previously found Madam Kwan’s food to be good, enough to justify the higher prices, but definitely not this time. Overall a disappointing meal.

Author: Carole H
Title: Beer by the River, What could be better?
Review: Sid's is a great spot to end the with a glass of beer on the patio. Let the fans cool you, let the river boat tours entertain you, let the beer revive you.

Author: uniqueliciosfood
Title: Bad experience
Review: The price of the buffet per person is not worth as much as the food. The food was spicy and not salty enough. The other food was just okay. The food experience was bad.

Author: ElizabethKualaLumpur
Title: Average Only
Review: Loud and crowded.  The food is okay but the atmosphere is too hectic like a McDonald's.

Author: CFSMCHERYLSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Poor Food Presentation & Poor Food Quality
Review: The food were not cheap as it was a restaurant. The food presentation was poor & the taste was not up to restaurant standard. The service was also not very good. We ordered Tum Yum Soup which claimed by the restaurant an award-winning dish but it was not spicy at all & the ingredients were not fantastically good. The pineapple rice was soggy, the pandan leaf chicken was not fresh & we suspected it was frozen chicken meat. The worst dish was the asparagus with scallops where the presentation was very badly done & the taste was saltish. We will not recommend anyone to patronise this Thai restaurant. Any hawker stalls or coffeeshops offer better & cheaper food than this restaurant.

Author: HKinsey
Title: Good vegetarian food
Review: A reasonable choice of meals for vegetarians. Good ambience, pleasant service, definitely recommended

Author: T SJupiter, Florida
Title: Not Enjoyable
Review: Decided to go at 9am since there is always a long queue at this restaurant. After eating there, I have no idea why there is a queue. The chicken is tough and flavourless. The rice balls were dry. The only saving grace was the homemade garlic chili sauce. Would definitely not go back.For what it is worth, I have never given a restaurant in Malaysia a "poor" rating. The food is usually outstanding.

Author: Ivan HToronto, Canada
Title: Food poisoning. Extremely disappointed.
Review: Was here on a 3 day trip and stayed at Meritus right beside. I decided to treat my family to a nice dinner here on the last night when I found this place as one of the top restaurants on TripAdvisor. Well the food was great, probably as good as it gets on the island. I had the duo of lamb which was the most expensive item on the menu and my brother had the special of the day - red chicken curry. My mother had the cod. We all shared each other's food BUT my mother didn't have the red curry. And middle of the night both my brother and I woke up puking for a good hour everything we had inside. We went back first thing the next morning to talk to staff so they could do something about it hopefully no one else gets sick but they didn't respond very well claiming we are not guests so it must not be their food - that was not cool. No apology. Nothing. We just wanted them to heck with their chefs and kitchen to make sure no one else will get sick. Very disappointed and would recommend anyone to skip here and try the other top restaurants.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: justineesun
Title: Terrible Food & Service!
Review: Terrible! Ordered Braised Tofu in "hot pot"and is cold! Set Dinner Soup is cold! even the fish! When feedback to the lady Captain? she seemed just not to care attitude.

Author: juneitajohariKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Easily all Malaysian delights in one place
Review: If you ever needed to have something authentically Malaysian, this would be the place where locals get their favourite fix like Nasi Lemak, Char Koey teow, Chicken Chop, Asam Laksa, Curry Laksa, Ice Kacang and Cendol. Madam Kwan's speciality is also the Nasi Bojari, which is delicious too. There are several other dishes that some people just come back for more like their sambal tumis udang with petai. Simply wonderful and the quality is always consistent.

Author: muhaimin a
Title: Delicious but expensive
Review: The food are delicious but the price a little expensive.most of the food are chinese food.there also nice desert to choose at this restaurant.the only thing is no halal certified from local goverment.

Author: FBFranz71
Title: Mmmmm
Review: IMHO, service staff is great but steaks are probably not up to mark. Too pricey for a very thin piece of meat. Cross the causeway and find yourself an Aston for better value me thinks.

Author: dandddurangoDenver, Colorado
Title: Such a Disappointment!
Review: We ate at this restaurant last week. We have known about it for awhile and were anxious to try it, but what a disappointment.Although the menu does have typical Mexican items, that was about all that was typically Mexican. First we ordered chips and salsa. The chips were actually pretty good, but the salsa had a strange taste—like there was some kind of Indian or Middle East spice in it. I ordered a beef taco. It arrived on a crisp, flat tortilla—this was a tostada, not a taco. A taco is folded in half and the contents placed inside. But I would have been okay with that except that the beef was cooked and/or marinated again in Indian or Middle East spices. These kind of spices NEVER belong in Mexican food. Having come from an area where Mexican food is very abundant, I have never in my life tasted Mexican food that tasted like that beef did. There was also some cheese on the taco/tostada; I don’t remember if there was lettuce and tomato—if there was, it was a small amount.I realize this is Penang and not Arizona or New Mexico, but with regard to the reviewers indicating that this place served decent Mexican food, apparently they have not eatten truly good Mexican food. At least use Mexican spices and not Indian or Middle Eastern spices in the preparation of the food! We thought the prices were quite high given the size and quality of the food portion. So beware—do not go here expecting traditional Mexican food—expect food with an Indian or Middle Eastern flavor. We will not be back.

Author: 451nicka
Title: Delicious
Review: Not my first time sampling the delights of sausage kl and definitely wont be my last. Always great quality, great value and great service.. Thank you Matt and your team!

Author: Mel22MelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: best margarita
Review: Nice place to chill and have dinner without being too noisy as the other bars on this street. They play good music to chill but not too loud that you cant chat with friends. There are more than 10 flavours of margarita to choose from, never seen this anywhere else before. Try the sizzling hot plate tapas, nachos and churros. Really good

Author: Frank1910Nijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: Authentic Thai Food
Review: A hidden pearl in Kuching. Authentic Thai food. We travel much, looking everywhere in the world for Thai food and this is one of the few places where the taste is really Thai!The staff is also really friendly!Must do if you love Thai food!

Author: 391genevievec
Title: Rude waitress
Review: Great building. A little noisy but that’s as expected. Terrible female wait staff who had such a bad attitude. Looked like we were wasting her time and just so rude when we asked if we could replace meat with smoked salmon. Said,” sorry nothing can be changed here.” There was no need for such an attitude.

Author: FRE4KIN
Title: Service bad.not proactive
Review: The waiter dont bother the local people,but they only treat the foreigner well.oh ya maybe bcz of tips.

Author: Adrian SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Day Ever
Review: This place has the worst service ever. Food took more than an hour of wait and never arrived. Their waitresses also have sour faces, zero customer service.When I asked them where is my food, they just assume that it was coming. Finally, I went back and asked them and they told me it hasn’t been cooked yet. one hour later, despite me reminding them at least 3 times.Worst restaurant in Brickfields. Please don’t ruin your day by going here.

Author: Loredana P
Title: Parvez for ever
Review: Amazing venue,amazing menu, amazing staff and also amazing our waiter PARVEZ. Thank u so so much for having us and amazing dinner on our last day in KL. We want to go back and again and again. Super lovely experience ♥️ XXXXXX Loredana Paciolla🇪🇸

Author: WayneTFY93
Title: Nice American Pizza
Review: Nice American pizza at queensbay area, near bayan lepas and airport. Good for visit with family and friends. Nice try on their new Chili Crab and Salted Egg Pizza

Author: Nishant2029Gurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: Meal was OK only
Review: I have been to this Jai Hind couple of times. The food is OK. The only concern is pricing. Once. you get the food from buffet a person will come to you and he will do some calculation in his mind (Only God knows how does he do :)). First time, the bill was reasonable but second time, that fellow charged us too much. Its better to go to Restaurant Sangeetha.

Author: michaelniwotBC
Title: Ok, but a bit rough and ready.
Review: First of all, the address is 46 Bukit Bintang. Not 55 which found me in the middle of nowhere. I guess it is ok but certainly not a gastronomic example of Indian fare. The food was only warm, the nan like rubber and the meat full of gristle. The mango lassi was good. In my opinion, don't bother. I went at lunch time.

Author: randyh406Vancouver, Canada
Title: Interesting
Review: I like the concept that each dish is made with tea. I ordered a combo that included one main entree, pudding and tea soup. The pudding tasted refreshing and delicious, the tea soup was flavourful. My only issue was with my main entree, which was some fried chicken with orange sauce and rice. The portion felt small, and the sauce tasted strongly bitter. I would recommend others to try this place, but maybe just another entree

Author: gekteng28
Title: One of the best dinner spots in the island
Review: I was raised in this small island, always like exploring new restaurants with my family. I’d highly recommend this restaurant for dinner! My seabass fillet was well cooked and juicy, though I thought it’ll be better to have more greens for the side. The ambience is great for a cosy dinner with family or friends. There are also a few vegetarian options. The price is reasonable considering the portion of the food!

Author: demalayboiPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Somehow Underrated, But Highly Recommended
Review: Never heard of this restaurant before, and I was recommended to this place by a friend.I went there for dinner, getting there for the first time was a bit tricky as the place was located at the very back corner from Persiaran Sukan & Hotel Laman Seri.I ordered the Aus Lamb Rack for main course, Chocolate Caramel Banana for dessert or hot Darjeeling tea for drinks. The lamb rack was delicious, and I'm a bit surprised as the lamb portions served was quite a lot compared to amount served by other restaurants that I've dine before. Very satisfied. The services were good; foods was served in considerable amount of time, the waiters were always alerted when you require their assistance.Overall, I was satisfied with my meal. Somehow there werent a lot of people dine at that place when I was there (maybe because the location was a bit deserted or maybe because I went there on weekday)The space & seatings are quite limited; so you have to consider first if you want to held a big function or event at the placeRatings; ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Restaurant: Laman Grill steak n Bar B Que,

Author: SetroE1
Title: Expensive
Review: It's expensive with normal food the place is good but the food same any Arabian food and mor expensive  the bread hot and fresh meat is good

Author: 879bobj
Title: An awesome Indian restaurant
Review: Fabulous food in a really lovely setting.  Amazing food - the tandori tiger prawns are out of this world.

Author: DrewG475Hong Kong, China
Title: Great view in a douchy bar
Review: Okay, so the happy hour prices and the view really are excellent, especially in a city where booze is a premium purchase, but you have to put up with terribly music, flashing disco lights (even before dark) and a generally uptight vibe. Three elevator rides from the ground floor, one of which goes up one story, add to the sense of exclusivity, which carries through to the staff. Worth putting up with for a sundowner, but then head out for the rest of your drinks to anywhere else.

Author: chengann
Title: Standards dropping?
Review: Second visit here. The food was still good but not remarkable. Something seemed amiss. Service and attention was still good despite the crowd.

Author: whc001Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not so Live Seafood Restaurant
Review: I was always very impressed by the Kota Kinabalu style live seafood restaurants. I really love those. Road Road image is good, name is good too. Pricing is top of the range, but the range and choices of live seafood is very, very few.Some small prawns, a few local fish, and crabs. Service is quite good though.But as a review of what the restaurant has been projected as a live seafood restaurant, then I believe the gap is too far off, and plenty of hard work is needed.

Author: Crunchy_Fr0gWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: What a disappointment.
