Review: Visited 19/11/2018.We were advised that it was most important we make a reservation, however during the time we were there were only 9 tables in use.Stupid prices on red wine, an €8.00 botle of Spanish red cost £85.00.We were presented with the bottle of sparkling water, for us to inspect the label-thats a first for us!We had 1 tomato soup, 1 prawn salad & 2 rib-eye various veg and potato gratin. (no wine) total cost £131.00Now dont get me wrong, if this had been an exceptional meal i would have been happy, but our veg was all stone cold (very obviously prepared well in advance, swimming in oil), the bernaise sauce (from a jar) was gone in two mouthfulls. During our meal no-one asked whether we were enjoying the food, in fact, when the waitress cleared the table i asked her to tell the chef the veg was all cold -no response -no apology.I strongly advise anyone not to visit here (the worst meal we've had all week) especlally when there are so many other great restaurants within short walking distance.

Author: shazzerwilltravel
Title: Casual fun night - great cocktails!
Review: Great night as we sat outside & soaked up the atmosphere of Love Lane. Food tasty & plentiful. Staff attentive & fun.  Loved the hats!

Author: lunchai
Title: So so
Review: Nothing fancy about the food though regardless of the price point.. Ambience wise nothing great either.. No wow factor.. Food quality average. Freshness I'm not sure, cause if it's fresh seafood and not only that you can't bring out the freshness out of it but trying to hide the freshness of it, then it's just as good as your everyday frozen seafood. Overall a typical Japanese restaurant. That's all. Not fancy enough for a table for 2. My wife weren't happy about it.

Author: Chan K
Title: Food seen over price
Review: chicken is ok. other is so so, especially drinks bad, and price is quite high. after 0% gst, receipt is not provided.

Author: avinashchandraaBengaluru, India
Title: Everything was below average
Review: To begin with we were given a table by the side of BBQ oven, extremely hot and the cook standing just behind me. We ordered Grilled prawns, tasteless and caused bad stomach. The guy took payment even before bringing food. Asked for a bottle of mineral water that came when we were leaving. No tissues for hand cleaning. Strongly recommend not to go.

Author: Kelly L
Title: Really disappointed!!
Review: We are here for lunch during our trip to Melaka. We expected more due to the good reviews and we're happy to get vegetarian food but we were disappointed. The rice was cooked horrible and was stodgy and the tempeh was awful. We have just spent a month in Indonesia and loved tempeh so we were excited to have it but it was rock hard and tasteless. I had to force myself to finish the dish. My partner had a veggie curry that he said was okay. The service was really good and the staff are friendly so maybe it is better for a drink in the evening rather than food?!

Author: ChernLamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Quick Friendly Place to eat
Review: Place is airconditioned went with a family of 10 people 7 adults and 3 child. Order 6 items which turn out less than RM 160.00.Portion might be a smaller than usual but to think about it even order another dish wont cause too much either.

Author: Luuk1055
Title: Great place! Cheap beer and good food!
Review:
Great place and personel at John's place. 
Low prices for beer and a lot of choice. 
Highly recommend as a place to have a drink and relax.

Author: benjaminwong93Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Think twice before you come in
Review: My friends and I came for a birthday dinner. It was a good and clean environment but the service and foods totally upset me. The fish and chips & pork is not bad but for beef lover, please don’t take here. Have you try deep fried Wagyu beef with bread crumbs? It was totally a messed and terrible experience! The wagyu is totally spoilt and think like the bread crumbs! When the crumbs is thicker than the beef itself. For the tuna, please don’t try as well. It was so fishy taste>> not fresh! For the tamarins tiger prawns, one is fresh but another one wasn’t!! For service! OMG... terrible! To ask a person serve a new bottle of wine, you will need to shout in the restaurant!! So what do you think how well is the service provided. Further, once you made an order, they will come to confirm with you at least 4 times!

Author: mudcowGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful views but utterly horrible food and service
Review: The views are incredible. The food and service are an abolsute dichotomy with the views.I made a few enquiries beforehand as one of my children has complex allergy issues. The few responses that I got were encouraging. Unfortunately more general questions such as regarding whether we needed to pay extra to get into the tower were ignored.The arrival process was reasonably slick. We were shown to our table and informed that anything other than tea, coffee or water would cost extra. Not a problem. However when we walked out an hour later we still hadn't seen a wine list or been asked for a drinks order,The food was, at best, what you could get from your local Tesco/Lotus. Actually that might be unfair on Tesco/Lotus; I supect that they might have actually bothered to heat the food.We paid over 500rm for a family of four. We were finished eating within 20 minutes. We had been informed previously that there would be a special interaction for our son's birthday. We had exhausted the sad cold buffet after 20 minutes. We waited another 40 minutes and nothing happened. When we left we were sent down in what must have either been a cargo lift or something under renovation.We paid over 500rm for a few bread rolls, some MSG laden soup and the toughest beef in Malaysia. The restaurant is falling to pieces, the service is beyond lacksadaisical. Once we paid we were sent down in either the cargo lift or something under renovation. Not even a 1* exit....Quite the worst dining experience that we've had in Malaysia since moving here over 2 years ago.

Author: Essexman08Essex, UK
Title: Excellent little cafe
Review: The Living Room is a wonderful little bistro restuarant. Amy and Ben always find the time to check on how you are enjoying the food and welcome any comments. The place is usually busy which adds to the feel of a cosy little meeting place. The signature dishes of pancake rolls and salt and pepper squid are superb, as is the rest of the menu. You should also note that they pay the same level of detail to those guests who are a little shy of ordering something local and prefer to keep to burger and chips. The prices are very reasonable, infact one of the best value for money places you'll find on the whole strip.

Author: Aswad M
Title: The best Western Restaurant in MELAKA
Review:
Visited here with my beautiful girlfriend❤️ We enjoyed the food very much. We ordered smoked ribs and chicken garlic cream. The environment is pleasant and their staffs were friendly.

p/s : Worth waiting😍

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Happy TGIF peeps, 🥰🥰🥰
Review: Happy TGIF peeps, Always awesome to be back here again chilling white wine on a Friday evening, over our favorite tiger prawns tapas with olive oil and garlic, and signature fried squids with flavorings and their all time famous salmon pan fried steak with avocados and onions blend with fresh tomatoes, an indulgence with seafood refreshing big tiger prawns pasta and a dip of multigrain breads

Author: TVillanueva
Title: An option among others
Review: Nothing special, the food is acceptable but No memorable. In our opinion is not a very good place, we would prefer having lunch or dinner at TGF.

Author: 870jamiec
Title: Food not fresh. Especially
Review: Food not fresh. Especially fish ball & dumpling . Soup base tasteless. Sunday nite only 3 table. Might b the reason not fresh food

Author: AiniyapPasir Ris, Singapore
Title: It so-so
Review: The price- reasonable Fresh-not so Speed-fast Taste -eeehh Basically its okey, but its not what you expected from all the review you read. The thing is the food taste is not that good. The taste is actually quite bland. What you pay is what you get. I do not recommend the chilli crab. I do recommend the honey chicken. This is my opinion.

Author: sathvinderKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: interesting but expensive
Review: nicely secluded near klcc it has a nice setting but temperature is rather cold.. we took the 12 course.. the cocktails were good.. the waiters are very courteous and friendly.. now the most important thing is the food.. food was good and interesting but it wasn't great and not worth the money.. the portions are small and after 12 dishes you will still be hungry.. some dishes are rather dull.. the price was a roughly rm500 per head.. you can get much better Indian or sri Lankan for half the price in KL..

Author: Zen BDalcahue, Chile
Title: Disappointing luncc
Review: I'm visiting KL on a business trip from singapore and stumbled upon this beautifully decorated restaurant. I love Japanese food more than anyone I know and is literally almost my daily diet. I ordered the first set lunch on the menu with the biggest picture of it and realized how little food I actually got for the ridiculous price they charge. What I received was 3 little slices of salmon, and a big bowl of rice with a tiny slice of eel, 2 tiny sides dishes and a bowl of fruits. The salmon was alright, not the freshest but it's edible. The eel over rice was minuscule compared to the giant bowl of rice. The side dishes were clearly a joke and not even worth mentioning. I felt like I just paid for a bowl of rice. If compared to prices around the world, this mediocre Japanese restaurant without any real Japanese chefs would be totally over priced. At least they smiled while ripping off customers.

Author: Elaine KHamilton, New Zealand
Title: Best place in town to get cheap authentic Kuching hawker food
Review: We come here every time we are visiting Kuching. The local hawker food are varied, yummy and value for money. Love the authentic pork satay, tomato noodles, kolo see, kueh cap, fried rice noodles, dumplings etc.Parking can be difficult during peak dinner time so go early or be prepared to park further away. Highly recommended.

Author: jasephine
Title: Service can be improved
Review: Overall breakfast experience was average. Dim Sum was good and a lot of choice however the staff are not so friendly and attentive.

Author: awanderingeyeMalaysia
Title: Cosy environment, comfort food
Review: Betty's is comfortable - in both environment and food. Go early to avoid the dinner crowd. The service is better earlier too. The food is good and portions are generous. Definitely a winner with kids! However, it is not a place where you can relax and dawdle over your meal. The wild wild west waits for no man, I guess.

Author: 227adamnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dim Sum Buffet
Review: Was here for the dim sum buffet. The varieties of the dim sum are quite good. But the quality and taste of the dim sum still have rooms to be improved. Understand that there has been some crowd, but the speed and service level are not something that I'd expect in a five star hotel environment.

Author: gosiaw838
Title: Very touristy, but good coffee
Review: As in the title :) just tourists sitting there, but the coffee was lovely, and the menu extensive. A bit pricey, but it's in the main street (Yonker Walk). My tip for the people running this place: change the music! People don't want to listen to Elvis when they visit Melaka, really!

Author: osaree
Title: Reasonable price
Review: My parents had a century egg congee. There're so little eggs inside the congee. The taste was ok and had reasonable price.

Author: LondonerAbroad29
Title: Overhyped
Review: Had the signature chicken chow. Was good but nothing spectacular given the hype and the other local food we had here. Worth a trip if in the area.

Author: bongiek
Title: Great food
Review: Got some takeout from the place, it was quite efficient. We ordered the mixed grill which was really nice, gone within seconds we also enjoyed the sauce that comes with it. It's a nice mixed grill to share

Author: estherjohansson
Title: fancy location but lousy food
Review:
perfect for beer only. If you want decent food or a decent coffee, this is not the place. 
horrible food actually.

Author: Joop000Singapore, Singapore
Title: Skip it!
Review: Went there this morning for bfast because it was listed as one of THE places to eat. Q wasn't that long BUT food was cold! How could dim sum be cold when it just comes out of the kitchen. Have had better. Would skip it and go elsewhere.

Author: Gene1133
Title: Great food, great feel
Review: Like similar areas throughout Asia, this has lots of great foods from a variety of Chinese cuisines. Don't miss it.

Author: Celine C
Title: Poor service !!!
Review: I was ordered soft shell crab salad, I even pointed the menu when ordered! After that he repeated our orders with the English accent that we not understand so we assumed he had took the correct order but i was wrong about it! When he gave me the Caesar salad instead of soft shell crab salad, I requested to change to the correct one but he refused due to the food had already made! I checked back the menu and realized they put beef becon for Ceaser salad so i told the second waiter to change due to i cannot eat beef! At first the second waiter was told me can change it, but that stupid foreign waiter came to me again and said cannot changed and he had confirmed that was turkey Bacon! I really doubt about it due to the colour of the becon! I felt that u guys just don't want to help me change back to the correct order so lie to me ! How come u guys can forced customer to accept the wrong order!! Very disappointed and will never come back to this restaurant again!

Author: gwany03Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Best Ribs in Johor
Review: My husband, 2 friends, our 2 young daughters and I went last night and had a great experience. The pork ribs were amazing. The service was great. They did a little song and dance when I received my margarita. They turns cartoons on one of the TV's for the children. The security guard helped us park. The place has a great atmosphere but it is loud with the music and the staff singing and dancing but we loved it. We would go again. Things to point out: There is very limited parking. Make a reservation as it gets very busy especially on the weekends. It is loud so not a place for quiet dinner.

Author: l_seraphine
Title: Average
Review: It was with high expectation when i entered the restaurant. As the information counter mentioned it was on a high reviewed. The service was quite okay, but the food was average. The choices aren't as many, and no recommendation for the signature food.

Author: Jumbo-KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A disappointment
Review: My husband and I dined in Vasco for dinner on the 30th December 2013. We had previously dined at this restaurant many times for buffet dinner and were looking forward to a good spread and good coffee. This time round, we were sorely disappointed. As it was year end and during the festive season, the restaurant was packed with people on office and family outings. The food was not replenished fast enough and the menu was changed from the normal high quality offerings they usually set out for their buffets. The cold seafood platter was dismal with only small crabs and small oysters; there were no prawns, nor mussels and scallops as per their normal spread. There wasn't even any lemon but they offered some tiny lime wedges for the oysters! The poached salmon and smoked salmon were missing. Given the price they charge for buffet dinners, we felt sorely short-changed when they took away the premium items and replaced them with cheaper stuff just because the restaurant was running full. Dinner that day felt like a cheap canteen, even the coffee was compromised. Planning to dine at Vasco? Do so only on a quiet day when there are less patrons around and they don't decide to stinge on the menu despite charging the same price.

Author: jlt129Chicago, Illinois
Title: Great Experience!
Review: We ate here based on an online foodie blog's recommendation. We went on a weekend night and it was jam packed with families. We were skeptical about getting a table, but they are extremely efficient at turning tables and we (two people) were seated within five minutes. We ordered the Beef Rendeng and Nyonya Laksa. Both were delicious but I especially loved the Rendeng. Service was as expected considering how busy they were. We had to flag a server if we needed anything but they were quick to come over and happy to accommodate. Would definitely eat here again if we had more time in KL. Side tip: there's a small cafe at the top of the escalators called Miss Kwan's- don't be fooled by this imposter! Look for the restaurant that will likely be completely full.

Author: 522daniel
Title: Excellent concept and delicious food..
Review: A perfect place to try delicious food served in traditional style..nice interiors, very rare to see such locations.. Pleae try

Author: CFEIII
Title: Nice bar, fair music, good food
Review: This bar is right downstairs from the hostel I am staying at, We have drank there and eaten there a couple of times.  The food is good, and the people are attentive.

Author: Donovan C
Title: Bag of salt in a soup
Review: Well there aren't many Bak Kut Teh around Petaling Jaya but this apparent one is way too salty! One should try the one nearby (Xhin Fhong BKT).

Author: 490SSS
Title: Horrible food
Review: Why is this place crowded? Because it's a long weekend? We ordered the sattisoru and veg rice bowl and both were horrible. We left most of it. Such a disappointment. Neither of the dishes tasted Keralan. It was just a pile of junk.

Author: ThevaRamButterworth, Malaysia
Title: Cheap patty for a premium price
Review: This guys’ chicken burger costs more than McD’s spicy chicken burger (cost me around RM14) but the patty and the mayo used are cheap ones used by roadside burger stalls. What irks me even more is the condescending albeit cheap and unauthenticated testimonials on their homepage.

Author: cosmo_artemisMiri, Malaysia
Title: Old ingredient, I think?
Review: I came to this restaurant on 28/9 during afternoon at Lutong. They take at least 30 minutes to send my food. My order was nasi lalapan, satay, nasi impit, mee jawa and banana split. The taste is just ok. But the ingredient is more to bad? What i mean by bad is the satay is fried not grill. But ok for that. However, the nasi lalapan...the fried chicken - you really can tell the different between the fresh chicken or the one which you re-fried / old stuff from fridge where the flesh is easily crumble from the bone? And with the nasi impit, until i want to go back and asked the staff where is order and they still even dare to ask me back, "have we send to you the food"? I told the guy, "look, can you see any plate for nasi impit on the table?"

Author: southlondonsno1
Title: Great local pit stop.
Review: This place quickly became my favourite watering hole in Kuching. Right in the centre of town, but curiously peaceful in its own garden. Great for some good quality lunch, all helped along by friendly, smiling service,

Author: Richard TBeijing, China
Title: Noise, expensive noise and more noise
Review: Ridiculous. I have no idea why people go here. I went because I was following friends. They hated it too. Tables full of families eating over priced food against the wall of noise that was the house band. When the band were not playing the DJ was playing inane dance music at very, very high volume. I was a UK punk in the 70's, I am not afraid of noise. Hard Rock cafe simply gets everything wrong, but still some people like it. I only wrote this review for myself; if you still go after reading this then you and I would most likely not share much in common :)

Author: DrMSKamarudinBatu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: Late Lunch
Review: Planned to have a Japanese lunch with my family. However, Razuken had already closed for lunch. Decided to check out Madam Kwan's.Ordered fish head curry and few other dishes. All were good. Desserts were bad. Even my sago pudding, which is SO EASY to make, turned out as a bubur sago. Very disappointing as we paid so much on it.

Author: Ngan H
Title: Best satay celup in Melaka
Review: Truly recommended! You must try all the food-in-stick that are prepared for you. Nice to super nice. I especially like the "mengkuang" and "balled water spinach". Dipping them in satay sauce makes the taste even tastier! The quail eggs are also not to be missed. The restaurant can get crowded especially on weekends & public holidays. Try to eat in one of the weekday and you will see more locals eating there.

Author: roseline m
Title: Now also at Intermark
Review:
The mains come in big portion, would be too just nice if to be shared. Plus some other snacks. 
Do not expect a real izakaya as it is more like a bright restaurant

Author: SumiologyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Poor
Review: Average taste. I think the tourist who give good reviews are not familiar with authentic Peranakan food. Having grown up in Melaka i can attest that good here is mediocre. Nancy's kitchen definitely has better variety and taste. Food portions are small especially for the fish - huge hike up from market price.

Author: AnneGoh
Title: service is lousy, waited for our foods nearly 1 hour
Review: i wouldnt recommend this restaurant for my friends or family members.

Author: stormlccIpoh
Title: Expensive but mediocre = POOR
Review: Seriously, this is Ipoh, you have so many other choices if you aren't a Muslim if you want to enjoy good assam food (ahem...Up & Up Restaurant). Even IF you won't touch anything that doesn't have a halal sticker on it, this is NOT the place to go to because there are dozens of good spicy and sour food with a halal badge in this state and doesn't break your bank account.Now back to the food itself. Nothing stands out from this place, the taste is mediocre, the way they cook it is mediocre and worst of all, although it's name "Assam" suggest spicy and sour is it's center stage but it really doesn't. The curry fish head taste like......curry, quite spicy but there is NOT even a hint of "assam" in it. The sweet and sour chicken that we ordered were mushy and some of them quite hard because they were battered in super thick powder, fried then covered in sauce for too long before they were served. The herbal tea and the dessert were too sweet it's like they forgot they already put sugar in them and then they put MORE.I haven't even come to the worst part, the price. It's just not worth it. We ordered a set menu: 1 curry fish head, 1 plate of vege, 1 plate of chicken, 1 plate of prawns (1 prawn for 1 person), 1 plate of "buka puasa" yee sang (that consist of all vege) and 1 plate of sizzling tofu (that was NOT sizzling and almost COLD when it reaches the table) and the total cost per person is RM50! I can cook a piece of 300g grade 5 wagyu beef with this price...

Author: keii
Title: Expensive but somehow edible
Review:
Would suggest to give this place a skip.
The top floor food concept is a total failure. Ordered mee goreng mamak and receive a red,soggy fried me with nothing inside, except some beansprouts.
Waitress have language barrier.

Did not tried the ground floor indian food.

Author: Oratory1Singapore, Singapore
Title: best nonya food in town
Review: excellent food with a vast menu to choose from. Reasonable prices and authentic setting. A short walk to jonker street. Be patient as it is a very busy restaurtant and the staff have lots of orders to take. Arrive before 830 as the kitchen normally closes by 9pm. There is always a queue of customers wanting tables which is a good sign.

Author: 800joewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place
Review: This is the second time I have visited the cafe over the last few months and again, it did not fail. Great friendly staff witha fantastic drinks menu and snacks. Really recommend going here if you want to take the weight off your feet and get a good drink

Author: elizabeth s
Title: good food and cold beer
Review: when stayed at batu ferringi we ate at the boatmen,several times and didnt have onebad meal.the staff vey friendly,and their was a great choice on the menu,and the prices were good to.

Author: debyong
Title: Wedding Dinner
Review: Although the restaurant looks nice from their decor, food was nothing special & can be disappointing as some of the dishes were bland.

Author: keatleongjcMiri, Malaysia
Title: Inedible food
Review: We ordered the seafood combo and grilled beef set. The food was not fresh, not properly marinated and inedible.This is the worst sushi restaurant that I've eaten in my entire life. Totally not worth the price that you are paying for. It would be best if the management can remove these two sets from the menu.

Author: Francine-AlanVictoria, Australia
Title: Cheap and delicious
Review: A big welcome from staff. Beer was cold and the food was delicious. The menu is extensive if not a little confusing but it's all part of the fun. We had the most amazing naan breads cooked in the tandoor and the 3 main courses, chicken, veggie and mutton were really tasty. If you want to eat where the locals go, then this is the place for you! Sometimes a bit of a language barrier with the waiter but nothing we and he couldn't laugh about. Dinner and drinks for 4 - just over $50 AU

Author: ScorchedSun
Title: Standard Bryani
Review:
Standard bryani, nothing special, price on the high side.
A few special dish like goats brains etc. Can give a try.

Author: glorias445Secret Harbour, Australia
Title: Quick service less than average food
Review: We are visiting KL from Australia and love Thai food so thought we would try this restaurant which is within the KLCC shopping complex. The food would have to be one of the worst Thai foods I have had. We ordered the share plate for appetisers, nearly everything was deep fried and extremely greasy. Very unpleasant. Then chicken with cashews in sweet and sour, a vegetable dish and rice. I had to ask the waiter if the meat was chicken or fish because the consistency was not like any chicken I have ever tasted, I’m guessing it was reconstituted. The vegetables were ok but not much flavour just a plate of vegetables. I wouldn’t recommend and it wasn’t that cheap.

Author: Olivier-78100Paris, France
Title: One word: Disappointing !
Review: When you will come for a diner at Gobo Upstairs on the basis of all the excellent reviews in the previous posts of TA, you may well be disappointed:1/ the quality of the meat is not assured. My T-bone steak was one of the worse ever experienced, nervous and too fatty. 2/ the quality of service is not assured. Several mistakes like bringing drinks we never ordered, forgetting to bring the sauce with the meat, confusing “decaf” and “standard expresso”...3/ the view on the PETRONAS Towers is not assured: if you are in the part of the room which looks at the Exxon building, you will not have a single glimpse of the Towers.

Author: sck_11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What a dump
Review: Used to be great, but going downhill. Crappy service not at all professional. Smelly member of staff & stank of sweat. The only thing that came quick was the bill.... Every thing else was super slow.. And have to keep chasing the staff why my food & drink was taking so long. And just to get told lies that its on its way! There are far better to be had in Pavilion KL Dont be a mug and go here!

Author: geeshariffPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for a taste of Vietnam
Review: Went here with a friend. Found it by chance. Ordered from the large but tattered menu (might be a good idea to replace them). Enjoyed the pho, a soupy noodle dish and a few other dishes. Also liked the lemon grass drink. Service was relatively fast given the smallish crowd that was there. Nice place for a quite chat with friends. Would go here again to try the many other dishes.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: PaulineWMWKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ice-cold beers and decent food
Review: The beer was ice cold, and the food was decent enough. Unfortunately, my pork roulade main was dry as a bone, luckily I could wash it down with an ice-cold pint of beer. Price-wise, expect the prices to be equivalent to Kuala Lumpur prices (that is, expensive!) but if you're gasping for a pint and are staying nearby, this is the place to go.

Author: Jegan P
Title: Disappointed
Review: Worse ever customer service experience...Just because they close at 3pm. They tried to chase me and my wife to the outer part of the restaurant just becoz they were closing...worse part they turned off air conditioning while we were still dining...The Bangladeshi waiter didn't even know what mojito was. No manager around when asked to be spokeb to. will never in my life recommend this restaurant to my corporate contacts and friends...ohh btw the food isn't as great as some reviews given....I will 4 out of 10.

Author: leechuehjulKuching, Malaysia
Title: I will never set a foot in this place again
Review: I was celebrating my friend's birthday there 2 weeks ago. We do not feel like eating anything so we decided to have a drink there.The staff kept coming up to us and asked us to order food. After we had ordered a few drinks and appetizers, I went to the WC, during that moment, I saw one of the staff whispered to another staff WHILE their eyes were looking at our table. The next thing the staff did was really SPEECHLESS, he came to our table, sat on our chair and told us: This is a restaurant!" I do not even get this kind of treat when I have my meal at the kopitiam! I have never been treated like this before, and I will never set a foot in this place again. Well, the only thing that I like about is the design of the space. That's all.

Author: Ruth CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: RIP off price for fish
Review: Went to this restaurant where we have eaten a few times before. However we asked about any sour gravy and the waitress who took our orders recommended a fillet fish in sour gravy. What we got was something that was not a fillet but a thin single piece of jenahak fish in some light thin gravy. Not a single piece of tomato or onion. The other dishes were ok and what we expected. However was shocked when the price for that fish was RM22. Total RIP off. Will not be recommending this place to anyone else. Guess the management offer a set menu and then charge horrendous prices for the other items. Very sad when restaurants do this to their loyal customers. When asked they said the price of jenahak is very high. But RM22 for a single piece of fish. If they had told us the price we certainly would not have ordered that dish. It was not even the best assam gravy.

Author: herveklKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not to recommend
Review: Very salty pizza, cold gnocchi probably not prepared before serving , pasta di mare simply ok , extremely surprised to see so good reviews. Good service . We accepted not to pay .

Author: Sunshine ZPetaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: too many people were around
Review: food was excellent but it was a bit chaotic for me, as there were just too many people around and rushing. not my sort of dine in

Author: HarujungZurich, Switzerland
Title: Would be nice place but terrible service
Review: Drinks and prices are ok, nice atmosphere inside. Unfortunately service is very very slow and ignorant. 6 guests only and waiting time for fruit punch and lemonade was more than 45 minutes... Beer was quick. Some service staff should go for education or should not be employed there...

Author: saltedcarameow
Title: Best place . Find milon
Review: Everything good , Milon is the best , good service , kind polite best service !! Good beer best iris bar !! Always ur best choice if u want drink !!

Author: elenita o
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Had a good and memorable birthday celebration in this place.. truly appreciated  all the staff who gave a surprised birthday platter for my friend. Had a wonderful meal that was perfectly served by the staff..

Author: Ilker K
Title: Wrong title
Review: Under info you see that is turkish, which is not Turkish, it's arabic , please correct it immediately ,

Author: Nomad763143
Title: Amazing Italian cuisine and service
Review: The food was amazing, bursting with flavour and the service was good. Mr Jeeva served us well and ensured all of us were well taken care of from the minute we walked in to the end of the meal. Highly recommended fine dining Italian cuisine.

Author: Josavage
Title: Breakfast was amazing
Review: We had breakfast here and it was so yummy we had 3 rounds! They had a great selection of Western and Asian food with a great bread and cake section. The selection of juice was great too - really fresh!

Author: jmptripsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great 12th floor space!
Review: Great 12th floor space, outdoor pool and a nice covered bar and DJ plays tunes at 4pm. Nice space, well designed with e

Author: SavvySaffer
Title: Awful, Overpriced Cr*p
Review: RM80 for 2 people with standard banana leaf rice (no refills even), 1 dish of lamb curry/varuval, and 2 ice lemon teas. ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS! Maybe they charged us white people prices or something, which would have still been acceptable of the food had been good. Unfortunately it wasn't. It's a place for the Bangsar crowd and the poser pub crowd to go and pretend like they're in a genuine banana leaf place. The food and service to not justify their markup.

Author: oneooneeast
Title: Terrible Place to Be
Review: I am totally disappointed with Qba, The place is so different then what it use to be many years ago. The service and entertainment quality is out. The hotel need to re look at the club and get a passionate manager t mange it.

Author: HannuVantaaltaHelsinki, Finland
Title: Average Breakfast
Review: The breakfast is rather limited and does not offer much. Had a couple of times some coffee there, as well, and the service was a bit flat.

Author: T1240KRkatielLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The worst outback business in the world
Review: Me and my business partner came here to talk business. The restaurant was empty but they insisted it was business as usual so we came in.We were seated and minding our own business when the waiter came and took our drink order. Service was friendly, although asking where we are staying is quite frankly none of his business. Our drink order was bang on (2 cokes) these drinks were, and I rarely use this compliment, the business. Would highly recommend the bloomin' "typhoon" onion, known worldwide for being delicious - and if the rest of the meal is anything to go by, the only dish keeping this place in business. When the burgers came out it was clear the joker on the grill had his mind on other business, as he was clearly not concentrating on our burgers. The meat was cold and tasted like stale blood, this is no way to serve meat in a food business. Neither of us could finish our burgers.Having visited outback businesses across the world, these burgers really let my favourite restaurant business down. Being a business owner myself I hope this was just a one off as these burger standards are simply bad for business.

Author: Nada R
Title: Value for money
Review: Good Indian food and its cheap. clean area and good for family dining. The parata was nice and the appam was wonderful

Author: TimskuUtrecht, The Netherlands
Title: Good food!
Review: I really recommend this place. The establishment looked very nice and clean from the inside. The staff was also really friendly. Most importantly the food tasted good and was beautifully prepared. The only downside was that it took really long to prepare our food. But overall a really nice experience!Also, dont order the gado gado as a side dish for two persons, it is way to big for that haha.

Author: rogerstephensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Bistro food, erratic service, overpriced and erratic service.
Review: Three of us went for Sunday lunch today. We went about six months ago for dinner and I had the interesting experience of pulling a roll of cling film from my mouth that was wrapped around a slice of foie gras. That aside, it was a small mistake so we were hoping for much better. I'm doing this in bullet point so I'm crystal clear about what we liked and didn't. Issues:1. Seated in a vast restaurant with only two other people at 12.30 and six waiting staff that I could see. We ordered still and sparkling water. It took 10 minutes to arrive after we had to ask again. Mostly we have to refill our own glasses, and after finishing the first bottle gave up hoping they'd notice they could sell more, and had to ask for another bottle. One of us opted for the wine inclusive which consisted of a very sharp and cheap Shiraz. Don't, just don't.2. The starter of smoked salmon, scrambled eggs and and salad was very nice. Well prepared, well presented.3. The main course was fairly over cooked salmon filled with a sesame crust. Poor average bistro level and dry. The beef cheeks were reasonable and the chef kindly accommodated one of our party's allergy to onions. The vegetables were plonked on the table with no description and we had to ask what we were being served. The initial answer was "vegetables" Good guess there. They were in general tasteless, coated in a gelatinous stock and looked old.4. Cheese arrived. Slivers of something - again, "what is this" as in "what cheeses?" although it was pretty clear there was about 25g of two types of cheese with a sprinkle of sultanas and walnuts, the waiters educated response was "cheese sir".5. Desert arrived. Looked pleasant until we found a long black hair on one of the deserts. The waiter took it away but interestingly handed it to another member of staff over the other side of the restaurant who pulled the hair off and sent the dish back to the kitchen. Clearly, the chef is not shown what comes back? 10 minutes later a replacement dish arrived looking exactly like the first - I wish I had taken a photograph but I am sure the restaurant changed the offending portion at the very least. By that stage, two of us didn't really fancy the desert. I see from an earlier review that hair in the food has happened to others at the restaurant.6. When the replacement dish arrive, no apology, no expression of concern. Just plonked on the table and left. 7. We weren't offered coffee so we asked for the bill. 8. The bill arrived, we were overcharged, pointed it out and they corrected it.9. On leaving, a very smartly dressed you lady asked us if we had enjoyed our meal and hoped to see us again soon. I quietly said that no, it's unlikely we'd come back as this was one of the worst meals I'd had in KL in 4 years. Her response? "Thank you Sir"KL deserves better than this. If Maison Francais was in Singapore, it would last a month if it was lucky. But this is KL and somehow it keeps going. I am sure they feel the three of us are of no loss to them and they won't care about either the review or our departure. However at least one if not two of our group they absolutely should not have lost - if I were them and I knew who it was, I would be banging my head against the wall.

Author: RatmanKLNyon, Switzerland
Title: Used to be wonderful but not anymore
Review: A sad story. This used to be my favourite Japanese restaurant in KL - design and food made the place stand out. However, it has all changed. Service has become sloppy, unresponsive, uninterested, uninformed - summarise... incompetent and unprofessional. The quality of food has also deteriorated - what a pitty as the place is still beautiful and has all the potential. I guess management needs to change - time for a Japanese to take over.

Author: sundancekid73London, United Kingdom
Title: Rip off
Review: Went there on third day of Chinese New Year and had a dry wonton mee, Kuey Teow goreng and Kopi O ais and bill came to RM25.90!! The waiter told me CNY prices. He showed me the menu with a new price sticker over the old price. How can a restaurant do that? Food court in shopping mall don’t increase their prices!! Will never go back to these places
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: Meander31319508788
Title: Worst experience
Review: We paid for the glass and found out later that none of the drinks are available so I have to go out and buy mineral water from other place. When complained to the staff they did not gave any good response. This Ikea is the worst!!

Author: Ayimbun
Title: Good Choices of Kampung Food !
Review:
Excellent variety of choices for Kampung food. Tasty & fast service.
Will definately go there again..

Author: 985chanc
Title: Overrated Cafe
Review: Nice decor aside, staff were unattentive and they serve beer that were either not fresh or watered down. enough said.

Author: Mamun KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sweet place
Review: Wife was driving me nuts to go to this place so we obviously did, the place is small but it’s worth it. We got the waffle desert each with chocolate sauce and cream, it was really nice and a generous portion too. The chef is actually French and he knows his stuff. I saw a few people getting their omelettes so those must be nice too.

Author: SHARISHA I
Title: Food taste just average
Review: I've been visiting this place twice during lunch hour. First time visit, I ordered the salmon teppayanki set. This time, I ordered the lunch beef set. The set came with a little portion of a side dish menu, mixed salad & jelly as a dessert. The beef set that i received is undercooked and more towards the fatty side. I can't even force myself to gobble up & finish it. So dissapointed. Overall, the food is just so so

Author: LionrocksSingapore, Singapore
Title: So so Dim Sum
Review: I'm not sure what's the hype all about this restaurant. The quality and varieties of the Dim Sum is not what I expected it to be. The Bao is quite nice. The rest of the items I find is only so so or below average. But there is one item which I find Very nice is the tofu. Very smooth and the taste fantastic.

Author: chuckwowengland
Title: Good location, beer n pizzas n asian foods
Review: A busy popular corner sited bar with food good selection of foods .asian fusion eiropean, and satay pizzas a bit different, upstairs is best but thats only open at weekends as i tried several times and was told no not open , beers standard islam country price i.e. Expensive beers from£3 small bottle

Author: AAGuide
Title: Fun times on busy bar street
Review:
Changkat is a busy tourist bar street - more subtle than Bangkok but full of sweaty bars with cocktails, happy hours and happy backpackers. 

Rabbit hole is better than the rest. 

Jumping after 10.... Enjoy the hangover tomorrow.

Author: chris2pherwongCanton of Zug, Switzerland
Title: Okay dim sum
Review: Came here for dim sum after someone mentioned it was better than Yun House at the Four Seasons. I am inclined to disagree. The food, although good, lacked the something extra that justified the higher prices (similar to Yun House but we got that extra pizzaz). Good to try once but would go back to Yun House definitely.

Author: peter cOttawa, Canada
Title: Service and food that will keep you coming back!
Review: The staff are amazing here! My wife and I patronize this location every time we are in KL and we love it. They have great food and always deliver a quality dining experience.The selection of tequila's is second to none. The staff always helps us with our choices and when we bring the kids the go out of their way to accommodate us.

Author: ChloeLauBandar Puchong Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good
Review: Went with my children. Good ambience, good service. It's a good place for special occasion, not too noisy that you could still have a good chat. Overall, the food was good, although on the more pricey side. Mainly pork dishes. The signature suckling pig was served in an interesting way, where the kids had fun watching and tried cutting it too. However, we in fact had tasted better ones elsewhere. For the price, we wouldn't try this dish here again.

Author: 72fengmingl
Title: nice place with local food
Review:
been there at 9:00pm for dinner. nice place in western enviornment. live music singers.
food arrived in 30min due to many guests. mis send the food for my wife and we accepted. local food tastes ok. expensive

Author: jennytgoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Nonya Food
Review: Recommended by a friend. It is not in town so you need to book a transport to bring you there. Do make a reservation as there are not many seats. Food is great and tasty. But personally prefer not so salty food. Only the chapchoy i find it salty. Price is reasonable. Service prompt.

Author: PrasadN175
Title: Authentic Chinese...
Review: I used to work in Pavilion which is just next to rhis restaurant.. place to get some good Chinese food n beer at great price...

Author: sifa287
Title: Great taste Kacang Pool
Review: If you ever want to taste the authentic-recipe of Kacang Pool, don't forget to drop by this place.. There's few other branches in JB, such as at Angsana and Plaza Larkin..

Author: Helenz MIncheon, South Korea
Title: Cafe Restaurant still going strong, like old faithful
Review: Cafe Rosita restaurant is located within Dynasty Hotel Miri and caters to hotel and walk-in guests. The restaurant is simply decorated, with comfortable chairs, and it was carpet. It is also fully air-conditioned. The restaurant interiour is fairly large. It has a kinda cozy and homely feel to it where you can stay there for hours while having nice long chat with friends or even meeting over lunchs/high-tea time/dinners. The service was quite good; staffs were attentive and friendly. The food (Chinese, Malay, and Western cuisines, all Halal or Kosher) was always good and they have quite a large selection. I would recommend eating the local food (especially the Sarawak dishes) instead of the western food, because I don't think they can cook western food quite well. In any case, I visited Miri regular, and I want eat the local food, not western food. I always enjoyed my lunch/dinner at this restaurant with my family and friends.

Author: PappanMajumdarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A RM 560 lunch which did not deliver...
Review: Overall it didn't deliver for us family of 4 - 2 adults and 2 children (15 and 8). We went to celebrate my elder daughter's high score in an exam. We went for lunch on a Sunday afternoon. Location - situated in a remote area of Ampang. We traveled 17 kms from Mont Kiara. We checked out the overall review on TA and this place was highly recommended. My first complaint is that there is no signage at the entrance of the restaurant. You end up at a place where the road is a dead end and without a signage you wonder whether you have landed at the right place because there is nobody to ask there as it is quite isolated. Decor - Very nicely done. A lovely pathway leading to the restaurant area with a lovely pond with many tortoises outside (a good hit with children for sure). It is mainly wooden construction and is open from all sides, overlooking lush green forest and green area. You could have a nice walk about near the restaurant. Interiors are pretty straightforward. What did not deliver for us is the heat and humidity of a KL sunny afternoon. It gets a bit uncomfortable. And the restaurant should have air con to manage this I feel. If your day is bad and it is hot and sunny in KL, trust me you will not enjoy the temperature at the restaurant. They have kept it natural which is a problem as per me. On the other hand, if it is raining and a little cooler then it could be a nice experience. But a restaurant needs to deliver either ways, isn't it? And not leave it to chance.Service. Many issues. The staff just seems to be doing their job because they have to do it. They are really not happy doing it. Nor are they really keen to give service with a smile and pay that extra attention. Also, they keep making a disappearing act from the deck area and many a times you are just waiting for one of them to grace the occasion. Service matters later on because of the value for money equation. I will come to that later. Food. They have a fixed Sunday lunch menu. Firstly, there is a timing for that. The last order is taken at 2.30 pm. So, please watch out for that. Because we landed at 1.30 pm and by the time you settle down and try to order it is already 2 pm and then you have to start getting worried about putting in every order by 2.30 pm. Also, one of the staff an old gentleman kind of came and gave a look of "yeh better order food fast or else you get nothing" which did not help at all. SO, PLEASE ENSURE YOU GET THE TIMING RIGHT. For a 2.30 pm last order, you need to be there latest by 1 pm. Better would be 12.30 pm because they do take their time to serve the food.So, it is fixed menu. RM 180 for adults with free flowing wine. RM 120 for children above 12, 50% for below 12 years. You can order all you want. The choice is extensive between seafood, poultry, beef, duck, starters, desserts. No problem with that. But the staff here reluctantly or hesitatingly explain to you that you can order as much as possible. So, you have to kind of discover what exactly is the system here. Well, that is still acceptable. But, what they don't explain or recommend is the portion which are abysmally small. Really, the starters are literally 1 piece offering. So, the least the staff could do is to recommend that this much is good enough to order. And in a situation where you are racing against time and that elderly gentleman sneering about the time, all this doesn't help. Even the "free flowing" wine is served slowly reluctantly. Every time you have to call the waiter to refill the wine. Why, if you are saying free flowing, then why can't you make it so? The restaurant should train the staff to keep an eye when the wine is getting over and refill generously. Food quality and taste is average. What is amusing is that the food served is mostly cold!! How can that be? Firstly you have a deadline on ordering which you are racing to fulfill and when you do that well within time, you are still served cold food??!! Really??!!Finally the bill. RM 561. Definitely on the higher side. That is fine. But what it delivers is quite poor. First, the location...everybody goes gaga with the forest kind of feel. Which is agreed. But for us Indians who have traveled extensively in remote areas in India, this kind of place is nothing extra ordinary. Secondly, the service is quite poor. Thirdly, the food portion and the fact that it is served cold. There is no excuse for this. Finally, the nail in the coffin is the value for money delivery is poor - nothing more. So, my advise is that KL which is the land of food and with over 4000 restaurants on TA available, do you want to go spend more than RM 500 on this kind of an experience? I leave the decision to you.Some other points to make. We made a reservation through Table App which holds good. But on reaching most of the restaurant was empty anyways. Sunday afternoon, we thought it should have been a bit better. Some of the seating overlooking the forest has a problem - there are big black ants which keep visiting the bench seating. For children, it can be an issue.

Author: UKMsianLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A disappointing experience
Review: Two visits to TGI today, one for drinks and another for dinner. The first visit was because everywhere else was busy. Three drinks and the staff forgot my young nephew's. We had to remind them and they still took ages. And they took ages to get our bill too. We then returned (I know what were we thinking) as my sister wanted to have steak for dinner. The steak and burger were fine but they forgot the third order AGAIN! We were told we had to wait for it to be cooked. The waiter apologised but the whole thing was a joke as the service was poor and two mistakes to the same customers is quite frankly a poor show. TGI should take more care in training their staff. Never go there again the food court is more value for money and YOU won't forget your order.

Author: Chiara BMoscow, Russia
Title: Lovely place for a pleasant dinner
Review: Just outside the most touristic part of the island, fatCUPID is definitely a place that is worth a visit.It's a minimal decorated restaurant, mostly on the white tones, with a pleasant background music. Menu is wide and everything is delicious, including the desserts.Food is well presented and portions are big enough.Price is a little bit on the high side for Malaysia, but in line with quality and standard.

Author: bma_1981Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed on my last visit
Review: Well, for honesty purposes, I visited this restaurant twice before, once I was alone, and the next one was with friends. Both times I was fully satisfied and happy.But, on my last visit a couple of days ago, I invited someone so dear to me after I told them how I love this restaurant. Well, what happened was, we took the buffet option (as I always choose), they kept bringing us medium-rare (all red from inside) meats. When I inquired about it, they said "this is what customers usually ask for, (medium-well), sir". I felt insulted, cuz I know very well how to differentiate between medium-well and medium-rare. Anyway, we weren't satisfied and had what the buffet offered (i.e. fish, pastas, cheese, cold meat...). Before I ask for the check out, the waiter approached me and asked if I wanted one made for me! I was surprised and felt happy with that nice gesture. I left feeling better. I just guess will go next time either on early-lunch, or during non-peak hours. Maybe the service could be at its best.

Author: Nadosht-RScranton, Pennsylvania
Title: Bad food
Review: We went their for our 5th wedding anniversary. My husband contacted with them over a month before the occasion to do a small celebration for us, he asked for a cake and flower bouquet. We had menara deck pass so we can go to it before the restaurant. 1- When we arrived they let us waiting down for long time knowing that we had a pass for the menara deck, then they let us go to the deck for less than 10 mins.2- the restaurant had a buffet and we were excited about it. But the food taste horrible, and no seasoning at all.3-We paid 50 MYR extra for a window table.4- Restroom were very dirty, disgusting and unusable.5- They brought the cake we asked for which was dry and taste horrible.6- They roses my husband asked them to bring for me where ugly and not worth the money he paid for.The only thing I liked was 1 the view 2 the piano which started at the minute we left our table to leave the place

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre price-efficiency
Review: From my attached picture, you can roughly know what I had ordered in Mangoes. Well, none of those dishes meet my expectation, and usual eateries can beat Mangoes in both the tastes and price-efficiency. Lack of cheese in Chicken cordon blue, normal seasoning in their grilled fish, normal potato soup and mango crepe. My partner could not finish the plate of grilled fish despite she likes to eat fish.The only thing that shined in Mangoes was their service and passion. With a meal costing around RM 100, I didn't see anything to substantiate the price, or value, of their offerings. Although others seemed to be satisfied, there will be no second visit for me.

Author: nellielim
Title: Place for a nice meal
Review: We have always enjoyed our meals at this restaurant. The salads and tom yam are always good. The menu is quite extensive and prices reasonable. A nice lunch or dinner spot.

Author: swissguest
Title: Great location...almost a museum
Review: The place is actually huge with multiple rooms each with various styles, so worth having a visit before eating. Portions are rather large, we found our bruscettas and pizzas excellent.

Author: janiceteohxxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Getting more and more expensive!
Review: Been to this restaurant for 3 times within a year.No doubt that the services provided were tip top, however the portion of the food served is getting smaller, and taste wise was decent only.During my first visit, overall experience was amazing, especially Nicole's piano performance in the dark. Food portion was good, the taste and the quality was extraordinary (they did served cod fish before). Then, I told myself that I have come back every now and then, and I even recommended this place to many of my friends.However during my 2nd and 3rd visit, I was quite disappointed as the food served was normal (probably just chicken and prawns), the desserts served was both the same (I visited in Oct13 and May14), the portion of the food has been reduced (yes we went home with a grueling stomach!).Also, I was so looking forward for Nicole's performance, apparently she did not perform. Yet, they increased their menu price.Honestly, I felt a little ripped off.With that amount of money paid, just top up a little bit, you can dine in in any rooftop bar/sky dining restaurants in KL.Will not return in near future, or perhaps not anymore.

Author: tche tKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: lunch
Review: went to the go noodle outlet in Sunway Velocity and order the fish ball noodles.. no only was the taste of it so bland like as if no wine was added to the soup, the prices have raised at least 25 % up .. definitely no value for money and looks more like day light robbery to all patron and customers.. definitely can give the outlet and the restaurant go noodle in sunway velocity a miss and should not go there anymore

Author: Sree KShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Food is good but lousy service
Review: came here for a supper around 11pm. the guy(possible co owner) refused to let us seat inside and instead asking us to seat outside. his face when taking order was like a piece of garbage as if we owe him something. no smile and no expression... as if dont like us to be there.it happened to another customer who came after us. asked him why his face like a scum but did not bother to answer. WILL NEVER COME AGAIN. better to go other places behind the road.

Author: MBJ400
Title: Consistent with all Nobus
Review: The expected dishes are there, the food is good, service not as smart as most nobu but OK, prices good

Author: georgiaa451Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service
Review: We visited Haroo after seeing how highly reviewed it is and we weren’t disappointed! It was the first time any of us have had Korean food and we had the menu explained to us which was fantastic. The vegetarian options were fantastic! We enjoyed our visit so much that we ended up going back a second time. Haroo also caters to children and the staff were so good with them.

Author: CyndyJoanPenang, Malaysia
Title: Happy Birthday
Review: I held my birthday party at Two Frenchies on 15 Feb and had the best birthday party. Annette took great care of everything and Ikram was amazing with the techie things. The food was wonderful and just what I asked for. I received lots of feedback from guest who had not been to Two Frenchies before saying they would be going to return for dinner or lunch. A huge thank you to the staff at Two Frenchies for making this birthday so special. I love you all and will return again and again. Big Hugs

Author: monk3yseendoMalaysia
Title: Very Cute and Pretty Satisfying Meal
Review: First off this is a review of their food delivery and not dine in. Dim Sum has always been a crowd pleaser but this restaurant has taken it to a whole new level with cute Dim Sum! So how does it taste?Steamed Piggy Bun with Lotus seed - RM 9.33Taste: Firstly, they look adorable as ever set to melt the hardest of hearts. Then skin of the bun was firm and yet soft within and the lotus seed paste not overly sweet. Absolutely delicious!Malaysian style steamed sponge cake - RM 10.39Taste: This dish was absolutely flavourful and a little overwhelming as it was really filling. Arrived slightly soggy at the base due to condensation in the container but absolutely delicious!BBQ pork pau - RM 8.80Taste: The Pau was flavourful but a little stingy on the fillings. Skin was nice and firm too! But all in all pretty delicious!All in all, a very cute and pretty satisfying meal. Our full review is on Instagram (@monk3yseendo) .

Author: tulipanmorado
Title: Nice view but mediocre food quality
Review:
The view are spectacular and unbeatable. Food are nothing special yet pricey.
We had a group dinner recently, it was poor presentation and taste. Will not go there for the food.

Author: ktshuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good place to chill
Review: My first visit to a Hard Rock Cafe and love how friendly the staff were. We were there for a drink mid day before dinner. The menu looks good for dinner there. Would love to head back someday to try their food.Great place to hangout to avoid the heat or rain. They have free wifi as well. Nice of them to provide kids with stuff to Color while their parents enjoy a drink there.

Author: Amirul-UK
Title: bad service
Review: the staff do not clean your plates after you have finished. or maybe it was just me. food is only average so for the price and the food quality it isn't really worth it.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: natedeljoseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible Restaurant on Earth!
Review: Definitely a no! Would never ever I step my foot into this restaurant anymore in my life ever. This is not the first time I've been to this restaurant. Been here few times and my last visit was approximately a year ago.Unfortunately this time, I guess this is the most horrible restaurant I have ever been to in my life.Last Monday, I invited my close friend to have brunch here. I suggest her to try their banana leaf while I gonna have their tosai.While seating, a waiter approached us after we called him to take our order. So, my friend start to order their banana leaf rice then he said that we should go to the 1st floor as there is where they serve the banana leaf. Then I asked him whether they allowed us to order tosai upstairs as I dont want to have banana leaf. And he said yes you can. Me and my friend agreed and went upstairs.So as we choose our seat, this one old indian man approach us and start laying the banana leaf to us and I told him that I wanted to order tosai. And he responded to me angrily said this level is just for banana leaf. And I told him that I've asked your staff downstairs and he said we can order tosai here. He become more pissed then start yelling, 'If I allowed you to have tosai here then other people saw and start ordering like you too." I was surprise the way he spoke to me then I said, ok fine. I really wanted to get out from that shop at that moment but my friend was starving so I let her to eat.Later on, when my friend finishes her meals, she asked the same man if she should pay to him or at the counter downstairs, he just showed his grumpy face, no words just pointed downstairs. We went downstairs and saw it was raining. So I said lets just chill downstairs and planned to order hot drinks. We were waving to the staff for 20mins, none of the waiter come and approach us. There is one man, I think he is just in charge of cleaning the table, I asked him to call the person who can get our order to come to our table but he didn't even bother what I was saying. I even asked him twice as he keep on walking around our table cleaning the rest of the table. The second time I asked him, he shake his said telling us no. I am truly surprised how can a famous restaurant like this treat their customer terribly. I am truly pissed off with that restaurant, I leave the place in the middle of heavy rain to another restaurant.Just because your restaurant is well known and got famous by bloggers does not mean you can treat your customer badly. Your food does not even taste that good compared few years back when social media not yet exist. Sometimes most restaurant were just overrated. Services, food and hygiene are the main point to rate whether the restaurant is a good place or else.Devi's Corner Bangsar is horrible service with arrogant staff, you can even smell their nasty smell near the kitchen, cockroaches and rats everywhere and food aren't even that good. Its a NO place to visit.

Author: smooches lKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Interesting place but bad ending
Review: Be prepared to walk up 2 flights of spiral stairs and 1 flight of normal stairs. Very nice ambient and deco. It had a great variety of cocktails, but only one red wine and white wine option. We were suddenly told that there were cops raiding bars nearby and that we had to leave, at 11pm. Such a shame that the communication was poorly managed. The lights came on, and we were told by the manager that we could stay if others left. So it was a bit weird, and we decided to leave rather than to be fined $1K by the cops.Other bars we had been to before adhered to the SOP and therefore did not face any issues with the cops.

Author: 8484amierKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love this place 💙
Review: Beautiful ambiance. The food very good. Staff Amaluddin really helpful.. Also mr Reuben, you so kind Really recommended this place ‍♂️ will visit you again

Author: Rayyap
Title: Gorgeous Laksa, amazing view!
Review: If this is not voted one of the top restaurant in Kuching, then I am not sure where that could be. The laksa really needs to be commended and the view and atmosphere is second to none.

Author: 587osmanaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner at Ivy’s
Review: This is a must visit to see Dragon and his wife, Ivy in the kitchen. The husband and wife duo makes the place come alive. The food is fabulous- rendang; kapitan chicken; otak and prawns... couldn’t fault it. Only wish they served some kueh kueh. We ended up buying back their Hei Bee Hiam to put on bread at home ...service is impeccable and super friendly ...you want great food and homely feel, this is THE place..

Author: peterkO9573HQShibuya, Japan
Title: Nice Japanese
Review: Nice Japanese food from a very broad menu. Certainly one of the better ones in KL. Will come back soon again. Must try the teppanyaki.

Author: 123ffsPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not up to expectation
Review: First time visiting after hearing so much about it. Arrived at 7.30am so there wasn't much of a crowd yet.Ordered 5 bowls of mixed meat, and 1 bowl each of taufu, taugua, chicken feet, and eggs.Soup didn't have much of a herbal taste, and was a bit to the salty side.The weird thing was that the bowls of meat consisted mostly of pork trotters. The pork trotters were not tender and were hard to chew. This was definitely NOT one of the places where it was cooked right.The chicken feet was also bland, tough, and didn't have much of a taste.Price wasn't too expensive and came up to about 100 for 5 adults and 2 kids. However, the food was a big disappointment.My friend summed it up best when he said it was the first and the last time here.
Restaurant: Restoran Seng Huat Bak Kut Teh

Author: rhiannon83
Title: Gorgeous, classy, delicious!
Review: Amazing, fresh, beautiful food, for a very reasonable cost considering the quality. Definitely a must-dine in Georgetown!

Author: Din34engBangkok, Thailand
Title: Tasty food, Hainanese Restaurant
Review: This is old Hainanese restaurant that is still survived in KL. Food is great, tasty, delicious and cheap. This place is always crowded at lunch so we plan to arrive late at 2:00 pm. However, service is fast.Just few minutes walking from Sentral LRT station. Always stop here for late lunch on the way to Sentral station.Highly recommend.

Author: skksure
Title: Oily food poor quality in 5 star environment
Review: The food is very oily. I ordered hosht punjabi and bendi masala with garlic naan, but the gravy was full of oil and had very little mutton for the price. Bendi masala is average. Masala tea is good. The garlic naan is just ordinary.Will say unhealthy meal for the amount of oil used to prepare the food. When complained, the reply was it is normal preparation. Served by Vignesh on 22-dec-2012 at 9:12pm.

Author: Alexey K
Title: Great! Great Again!
Review: We've had a long stay at Kuah. For a month. Family with two children (5 and 9). And when kids were asking for some grill (shawarma or chicken). I knew, the place which has the proper one!We’ve been at Alhamdulillah for several times. And always satisfied with atmosphere, taste of dishes and quality at all!!! You shouldn't wait some decor, luxury or special treatment! It is just about the food! Tasty food! Every time! Thanks a lot to the host! Best wishes!

Author: robjar
Title: Good local food
Review: Helpful service explaining all the dishes on the menu. Went for the egg on top and hadn’t realised it would be raw. Still all tasted good and I survived to tell the tale. Cheap and local!

Author: shenolam
Title: One word....AWESOME!
Review: We went to Zen Zero for my very special birthday and it was a memorable experience from the moment we walked in to the moment we left.I had the ravioli to start with and the spaghetti with pesto for my main course. Both were cooked to perfection. The Prosecco and glass of red wine which came recommended by the very attentive and knowledgeable staff was a perfect accompaniment to our meal. To finish off, the lovely home made tiramisu. Yum.The ambiance of this restaurant is just right. Not too stuffy, not too casual. For me, the ambiance and food were the perfect match.All in all an excellent evening out and I would recommend Zenzero to anyone. Go now!! You will love it!

Author: moeyh007Auburn, Australia
Title: Finally some great arabic food in Langkawi
Review: It was great to finally have some Arabic food that actually taste like Lebanese, especially after 3 weeks of traveling around Malaysia and Bali. My wife is loving life after this meal. She finally got her falafel hit. The food and service was excellent.It was worth the 35 minute ride here on the scooter.The owner Rami and his wife are doing a great job here in Langkawi

Author: Wendy VSydney, Australia
Title: Extensive Variety of Food, Attentive Service
Review: We had dinner here on Valentine's Day. We were greeted warmly by the staff. The food range was extensive with the deserts having a real Valentine's day theme. We really enjoyed the seafood and deserts. The oysters and prawns were huge and tasty. The menu caters for western and eastern preferences. There certainly were a lot of people but staff were very attentive and we weren't kept waiting for anything, neither were we rushed to finish. We left with full bellies. Will definitely go again.

Author: PineappleViking
Title: Amazing atmosphere
Review: A real gem in George Town,  the decor is unique and amazing and the service is top notch. Kitty is a very hospitable host, definitely recommend it.

Author: umarmukhtar23
Title: Good place...
Review: The environment was nice. This is my second time here. The food is always available. If you get the table at the open ceiling area, you can have a sky view and see aeroplanes passing by.

Author: drdvgBengaluru, India
Title: Good south indian fare
Review: Saravana Bhavan, true to its name, stands for authentic south indian food. The thali meal we had was very tasty but the portions were small. For the number of accompaniments, the parota served was only one and the rice was limited. The mango lassi was quite good indeed. The service was businesslike. Parking is a big issue here, and we had to walk almost half a kilometre!

Author: davidcY3374CJSingapore, Singapore
Title: An underrated gem in the KL food scene.
Review: I have now visited multiple times and have been meaning to write a review for some time.The food is excellent. Last night I enjoyed the best wagu steak I have had in KL. It literally melted in the mouth. Cooked to perfection. The goat is to die for. Not a meat I normally eat but it is just superb. Every dish we have had has been excellent. They are often unique, with an incredible balance of flavour. A true foodies delight. The location is great too, situated in an old restored historic building with beautiful views of the KL Tower. I look forward to my next visit.Highly recommended.

Author: kco897
Title: Return again and again
Review: Uncle John is getting old. But The food is continue to amaze me and my guest.  Price remain competitive especially at the location they are in. Where can u get Set Lunch at below 10RM in such location with such ambient ??

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great quality meats though pricey by local standards
Review: Brought my good friends for dinner at this restaurant and they were impressed and satisfied. They serve good quality meats and BBQ the items for u on the hotplate right on front of our table. Their service is prompt and friendly. It's very near to hatten hotel and equatorial hotel. It's expensive by local standards by their quality of meats are well worth it.

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Consistently Good Fare
Review: Visited this restaurant at lunchtime recently.Decided to go for some different dishes from our usual pick.My wife and I chose the following dishes: Pomelo Salad ( new offering ), Hokkien Mee ( thick yellow noodles with black sauce ) a KL favourite and Yam Cake.The pomelo salad, however, did not live up to our expectations. It was quite bland. The hokkien mee was very good with a generous amount of goodies and the yam cake was excellent especially when eaten with a dash of hot prawn infused sambal.They also have some unique Malaysian drinks here: we ordered Assam Boi Lychee ( sweetish sour ) and Selasih Longan. Both were excellent and refreshing.

Author: Decz05Perth, Australia
Title: UNBELIEVABLE!!
Review: From the moment we walked in we knew this was a special place. The menu is not huge so selection is quite small but they more than make up for it with exceptional quality produce, amazing presentation and terrific flavours! The wait between courses wasnt long and the service from the staff were friendly and attentive. All round an amazing restaraunt that has 5 star quality thats not at an extreme price compared to the 5 star hotels near by. Its difficult to find, on the tripadvisor map it shows on the same side of street as weld shopping centre but infact its on the other side of road on a terrace with a few other dining places.

Author: CoL748015
Title: Good outdoor bar. Nice view of the harbour
Review: Food is decent. New Zealand fare. Enjoyed the fish and chips and the pasta. Nice place if you live in the area but wouldn’t travel here for the food and restaurants
Restaurant: New Zealand Unlimited Restaurant at Puteri Harbour

Author: vickiwells63Hamilton, New Zealand
Title: A yummy and unique experience.
Review: We loved this experience. The food was great. Our waiter Yous (probably not how it's spelt) was amazing. We had booked and prepaid for 6 people but one of them was not able to come as a storm had blocked her access. They refunded her money without a problem ...this was appreciated. It is so different and done so well. We are definitely going back again with the friend that missed out. They change the menu every 4 months so that is good too.I highly recommend this restaurant. Go for it.

Author: samnatkarenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good decent Nyonya cuisine in a accessible location
Review: The restaurant is near towards the end/start of Jonker street and is one of many nyonya restaurants in the area. The place was recommended to us by the hotel staff. The chap chay, fried chicken wings and fried omelette are really good and taste better than alot of places. However the chilli fish dish was horrible which was really a disappointment. The uncle servicing us is really friendly and service is prompt and polite. Overall, if you are looking for a meal in jonker, i will say this is a decent place to try

Author: nohp13Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth a visit for the Mamee Museum
Review: Visited the Mamee Museum at Jonker street and it was a disappointment that it was that small and nothing much to see...visit only if you have spare time and willing to pay the RM5 for one pax. If you want to get your own cup noodles done, you would have to pay RM22 for 4 cups, yes, that's the min.qty one has to buy.

Author: Tay TMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Bad experience and not friendly
Review: I booked on Wednesday for Sunday lunch 1.30. They have taken down my name and phone number by repeating to me and make doubly sure . When reached there at 1.30 Sunday , was told not in their booking system and very unfriendly . Their food not the best in town ,but the attitude will chase customer away .

Author: edouardreizianSurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Very nice place to chill.
Review: Accessible location, friendly staff and very delicious food. Love the bacon and the fries, even the classic one is so yummi. I guess there is a life band in some days, which are ok. the welcome and service is very much appreciated and really you can enjoy your drink, meal or even watching sports.

Author: James-H1984Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Absolute shambles of a place, didn't even get as far as eating!
Review: I had prebooked for my girlfriend and I for the dinner sitting at Atmosphere 360 in KL. Having read reviews on here I was expecting poor to average food at an expensive price but was willing to overlook that for the views. Dinner is from 6.30pm - 9pm, 6.30-8.30pm when you eat and then half an hour to take pics from the observation deck. We arrived at the KL tower at around 6.10 to absolute chaos.. 100's of people everywhere all queuing for the various different attractions on offer. It took us 5 minutes and having to ask around to even find where the Atmosphere 360 place was (a small desk hidden away from the entrance with no clear signage) We then had to wait 10 minutes or so to get our tickets and told to join the queue for the elevator to the restaurant (We weren't told which out of the 3 was the queue for the restaurant). It was really confusing and it wasn't just us as you could tell by everyone's faces they didn't have much of an idea what was going on. Well turned 6.30pm when we had paid to start eating did the long queue actually start to move a bit, but not much. At this point people were not even joining the back of the queue and just pushing in and branching onto the front of the main queue, forming another queue. It was clear that people were trying to push in and not joining the main queue, I even told a few people to be met with only shrugs. Unbelievably at about 7pm the staff proceeded to move the new queue of people who had pushed in and not decided to join the main queue to a new elevator around the corner which had magically appeared, actually moving them ahead of the people who had been stood there patiently for an hour in the hot humid weather. That was the final straw for me and I decided to leave, an hour of waiting and 30 minutes into our allotted table time and still no closer to the food. I've never witnessed such bad organisation, I can only begin to imagine what it must be like when you actually get upstairs to the dining area, combine that with the reported expensive, poor food and it's an absolute no go for me. Add to this the rude staff and you've got an absolutely nightmare waiting to happen.
