Not to mention they had another elevator they weren't using with 100's of paying customers no closer to actually getting what they had come for.The night actually turned out ok, we managed to get a table at another restaurant with a view, fantastic food and around half the price. If this review puts only 1 person off visiting this place I will be happy. AVOID!

Author: Kongka O
Title: What a Disappointment!
Review: Me and my partner we were wondering around town looking for a place to chill out and some afternoon drinks. Finally we decided to come here as the meridian brand shouldn't be that bad. When we arrived there was no staff to welcome or to escorted us or anything we had to find our own seats and then we waited and waited for awhile there were not many people there only few tables. So its not busy why no one even looking after the guests? My partner went to find the staff so we can take some orders. The staffs were not as friendly almost like they don't want you there or they don't want any customers. It was a big surprise for us the way they acted to the customers just like their friends. No thank you or anything after we ordered she was just like looking at the other side and sake her head like ok.After the drink arrives the smoothie was no flavor but I'm happy with my iced lemon tea.The lemon tea served with no straw. 4 or 5 staffs was doing their own thing and no one look or asking you anything why you there. So I asked one of the girls there. Excuse me, may I have a straw for my drink? She answered with her unfriendly face we no longer use straw here. I replied, my partner has a straw for his drink and can I just have one also? She was like whatever and went behind the bar counter handed me a straw. I was like wtf. From the beginning to the end we have never experienced anything like this. Then again you have to yell out for the bill. And the other tables next to us was doing the same. So never again coming to this place and be treated like an uninvited guests.

Author: fudailrosli
Title: ONLY for the nice ambient
Review: If you want to chill and get hot drinks with great ambient, this is the place.For their food. It tastes "ok" For their dessert, mostly all of it are not worth it and taste cheap. If you want cendol and abc go for stalls around ipoh which is wayyy betterLastly, their mocktail is just SADBut....if you want a place to just chill and relax with some simple drinks or coffee then yes, do try come and visit

Author: SER508
Title: Great place to watch the sunset
Review: Really lovely beach setting, wine was great and snacks we had were good. Did go for dinner but was very westernised bland menu so ended up going elsewhere. would recommend adding 1 or two more local dishes on top of what they already have

Author: Hema KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still one of the best for north indian cuisine in KL
Review: Coming back to this place after a few years. It is still one of the best places in KL for authentic north indian dishes. Besides the buttery moist stuffed parathas, the kebabs were tender and had just the right amount of spice and flavour. Their mango lassi was particularly yummy too. Good ambience and very reasonably priced.Will definitely be going back again soon.

Author: HuangJooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Be prepared to wait
Review: We arrived 5 mins before 6pm. However it was already crowded and we had to wait 20mins to get our seats. Waited for another 20-30 mins for our food. Food comes in different portions. We ordered small portions dishes and they are really small hence it is not so value for money - eg we got two pcs toufu for the seafood toufu dish. Food is so so hence am not sure what is the hype for.

Author: Stephen o
Title: Kid's Meal : Junk food at its best
Review: We were looking for an alternative to our 2 year old boy's dinner of roast duck @Village Roast Duck and were half hour too early for the Han Room. We noticed the Ippudo nearby which always looked popular @BSC. Our preference was a steak meal like @TGI or seafood teppanyaki. Their seafood promotion was over and as a consolation the oyster bar Shucked was just in front for our side order. We ordered the kid's meal of a bowl of Shinomaru Tamago with fried chicken pieces. The KFC style nuggets were disappointing with some meatless fried dough balls! Anyway there are still off limits to our boy. What he normally enjoys is noodles. On this occasion he ate ramen without a fuss with a few pieces of steak, onsen egg and oysters(from Shucked). The medium done ribeye steak on a hot plate was rather measly, half the serving size(100g?) with burnt undersides. Nevertheless the tonkatsu broth was tasty without the saltiness that you find @Menya Musashi. The whole onsen egg was commendable compared to @Senya and @Gantetsu. The pork loin charsiu was like boiled ham, nothing like really good charsiu @Yook Woo Hin. Like most fastfood joints, they served a cup of orange coloured chemical drink to avoid. Our additional fresh orange juice drink was sour, so it was not palatable for our little boy. Service was sporadic but loud - copying the Tokyo ramen shop shouting without paying attention to customers - really meaningless service levels. If not for the oysters from Shucked, our son would have ended up with a meal without nutrition! Yet, we noticed many kids at the outlet having this meal, perhaps they are on multivitamin supplements.

Author: hytz
Title: Great quality, so worth it!
Review: Wide food spread, not just the grilled meats. They also had fresh oysters, sashimi, lasagna and beef stroganoff, desserts and lots more. The meat spread were amazing. They had wagyu beef, lamb, sirloin, duck etc The beef was juicy, tender and well marinated! Forgot to take the pictures but trust me it was so good and worth every penny. The staff are friendly and attentive!

Author: janesoniakuching
Title: Chinese cuisine at it's best!
Review: My favourite Chinese restaurant in Kuching. Been going here since it's inception or even from the time when it's staff were at the former Tsui Hua Lau restaurant. Every dish that you order is good. Never a let down moment! Missing the food already ;)Need to make reservations in advance. Normally a full house almost every nite.

Author: RobinSkye74Shenzhen, China
Title: Well deserving of its high ratings
Review: High quality curries, very nice presentation, service was excellent. Thai iced tea was lovely and tall glasses, and the curries were nicely balanced and satisfying. Would recommend to anyone.

Author: AnnaPratiwi
Title: Open until midnight!
Review:
I had my late dinner here while I was waiting for my train to HatYai.
Yes! It opens until midnight and close to Ipoh Rail Station.
It was my only choice because other restaurants/cafes were close earlier.

Author: Sasori YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Joke
Review: I have no idea how this cafe can get a tripadvisor award. I visited this place with my friend and ordered a coffee, banana pancakes and matcha lava cake. There was no ambience at all. The atmosphere was merely customers talking and staff also chatting. The coffee was extremely normal and there is nothing special about it. The banana pancakes was probably the best thing I had which might be the only thing worth ordering.The worst thing of all is probably the matcha lava cake. When I ordered the matcha lave cake, I was told that I had to wait 20 mins for it. I happily agreed. After 30 minutes, a staff came and told me that I had to wait another 10 mins. I was a bit grumpy at this point in time but I nodded in acknowledgement. After 15 mins, there was still no cake. Another staff came over and said that the kitchen accidentally broke the cake so they will make a new one for me. I politely asked if I could cancel the order since it has already been 45 mins. The staff says she will check. After another 5 mins, she came and informed me that the kitchen was already making a new one and they wanted me to wait another 10 mins for the cake. If the cake wasn't out in 10 mins, then I could cancel the order. Trying not to make things difficult for the staff, I agreed to this. Eventually, after waiting another 15 mins, the cake finally arrived. I waited more than an hour for the matcha lava cake. To make things worse, the cake was not even that good. It was too heavy and feels like they just tried to cramp as much bad matcha powder as possible into the cake. It was a disappointment and I will never be back and I discourage anyone from going.

Author: ramini_9london
Title: Celebrating daughter 21st
Review: We ate here many times during our 10 day stay - the staff are friendly and Qayyum always went above and beyond to serve us and cleaned our sunglasses. The food is excellent and he helped with taking memorable photos always ready with advice to any of our questions. We highly recommend CBA the service is excellent I know we will be back as can not fault anything about this hotel Thank you for making our holiday a relaxed and caring experience The Bird family

Author: aurfeiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful little hideout
Review: Converted from almost deserted shop houses in Ipoh old town, this little hideout really showcases the creativity and entrepreneurship of the owners. Everything in the cafe screams of nostalgia, the furniture, the decorations, the lights, the dangerous-looking stairwells, the walls with peeled off paint jobs, the rough concrete floor... to such an extent that it might actually irk somebody. But that's the brilliance in using innovative ideas that generated such a buzz of a place... and to top it off, the food is actually very good!! A must visit for sure, and their burgers are probably the hottest selling commodity.

Author: AdamWaStockholm, Sweden
Title: An average place, with regards to place - no fine dining
Review: I do highly appreciate the 529 reviews being posted before mine.I had to wait 5-10 minutes after getting seated before anyone asked me for something to drink or gave me the menu.The toilets actually turned out to be located outside the restaurant.300 MYR (60 USD) for the tasting menu and 150 MYR for the wine pairing is affordable, but you understand why when you find yourself with an empty glass with the second course and realise that it doesn't come with a wine pairing - nor refill from the first course. The wine glasses coming on also turn out to be very small...The restaurant is rather noisy, from the music and from other guests.In addition I got a table next to the bar with people running back and forth from the kitchen.And there were no separated tables and people are seated in a long sofa along a wall covering ~8 tables.This might be a nice place to visit with friends before partying if you are around, but definitely no fine dining (visited 30+ Guide Michelin restaurants).What still gives this place a rating of 3/average, with regards to price, is its exquisite tastes, the morel mushroom and the dessert with cocoa and coffee ice cream being two of them (the wagyu cheek I've had more tender in their places).If this place is 3rd of 3 462 restaurants in Kuala Lumpur I do understand why Guide Michelin is not rating this city.

Author: Amygien
Title: Valentine's 2020
Review: Love the ambience.. Food is good as well as service. Well done! Will definitely return when I come to Ipoh.

Author: Greg YMelbourne, Australia
Title: Best buffet in KL
Review: This place has an amazing seafood dinner buffet. Choose from a huge variety of cuisines, including Japanese, Chinese, Indian, Western, short order cooking, chocolate fountain, dessert bar and a huge array of fresh seafood (prawns, lobster, scallops, oysters etc). When we went it was 125 ringgit ++ per person.

Author: NatassiaDShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Great meal, average service
Review: The meal was huge & delicious. No complaints about that. The service was just average, there were 1/2 staffs was a bit in a cranky mood... I don't know, I'm just guessing.

Author: mapmanish
Title: Allows smoking
Review: 21st January 2020 and they allow smoking. They provide ashtrays to people wanting to smoke. This is illegal, hopefully they get fined

Author: RajahPutihKuching, Malaysia
Title: Terrible experience
Review: I came with a friend to try the place out only to be more than disappointed. The food is substandard, tasteless, comes in small portions, poorly presented, and takes a long time to come even though the shop was half empty. The drinks were what my friend and I agreed and described as stale or bland. The price was average but for the quality of food, it was absolutely not worth it. The place had a terrible smell to it. I ended up sitting outside in the haze (API is above 100). Tells a lot, we'd rather sit in the haze than in air conditioned stink.The quality of service was also really poor.I can only rate this 1/5 but if I could, it'd really be a 0/5.

Author: CoolkoalaBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Cold food and terrible service - not sure about cleanliness either
Review: We went to eat here after reading all the reviews and I cannot believe people are talking about the same restaurant. Everything started well and the ambience is quite good, though it is very dark so you cannot see how clean things are. We ordered starters which came very promptly, almost too quickly as we had only just got our drinks. Then the main courses arrived whilst we were still eating our starters. We kept them there as I didn't fancy them going away and being brought back again after being reheated and kept hanging around. We tucked in straight away and realised that the food was quite cold, my lamb was very cold in the middle. The food arrived so fast it cannot have been freshly prepared or heated properly. The portions were enormous, too big, almost off putting. I tried to attract the attention of a member of staff but she was too busy standing at the top of the stairs texting someone, completely indifferent. We ate what we could and then left. Not a good experience for us I am afraid.

Author: Jude BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth every penny for everything!
Review: Opus has been around for more than a decade so there's no qualms about food quality and service. For dining, you have the option for a pretty bare area upstairs but otherwise you can have the main dining. Menu choice between pasta and meat are awesome. But if you would like to mix your option for Spanish cuisine you can request for the menu from Cava; just next door (owned by the same group). Must try are cod fish and the seafood pasta. And if you would like to start with a gist of alcohol, order the sangria special from Cava! Definetly coming back again. Ideal for celebratory occasion.

Author: adecheong
Title: Fine dinning service with friendly staff
Review: staff were friendly and cheerful,especially thier captain bobby choo who was very accommodating to our special requests.the food that we selected (whice were out from the menu)was very much enjoyable . topped up with the warm smiles of the staff that served us that night.we will definitely come back again very soon ! good job!

Author: DoreenC292
Title: Authentic Nyonya food
Review: The nyonya food served here are good and authentic. Love the Lemak udang nenas, ayam pongteh, buah keluak and pai tee. It is advisable that you make reservation well ahead. This restaurant if popular and they seldom take walk ins. Because they are popular, the person taking reservation may sound a little unfriendly. Overall good nyonya food served here and at a reasonable price too.

Author: occasionaltravele939
Title: Varied cuisine at great prices with friendly service
Review: We ate twice at Enca, across the street from Bayview Resort.  The menu is quite wide, the prices very good, and the taste delicious. Best of all, the wait staff are very friendly and helpful, and speak English

Author: SphingxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A lot of style, but very little substance. Left the place hungry.
Review: Several people raved about this place. After going there, I do not understand why.The pros:The service from the waiter is some of the best I've ever encountered in a KL restaurant, even in some of the top hotels. It's friendly, attentive, non-snobbish. Downright fantastic.The cons:The food. Don't get me wrong. The food is not bad. It's not fantastic either, it's just kind of slightly above average with a lot of frills to shill it as something extraordinary. They have a very fancy menu with reams of superlative information describing the food. Did you know that you can make any food sound fancy by adding the place of origin before the item itself? For example (this is not the exact item on the menu, just a demonstration of the style): Pan-seared Hokkaido scallops in Irish cream sauce, or Australian fillet mignion, served with Chilean asparagus or Tuscan rabbit or something (yes that was sarcasm). All these only serve to make the food sound more impressive than it is. There is even this really expensive dessert called 'And Ode to Newton' which has its own special card describing how it's anti-gravity and avant garde and all that, but basically is a scoop of ice cream on a wafer of flavoured ice on a glass of ginger beer. All for the bargain price of RM 25+This would not be such a bad thing if the portions were so minuscule for how much they charge you (RM 50-80 for a main). You order saddle of rabbit and you get one tiny little piece barely bigger a 50 sen coin. The duck breast was supposedly served with mash but what you actually get is a little dollop that looks like it had been served with a teaspoon.I don't mind paying for quality, but when a place is hyped but turns out to be so much style, and so little substance, it's really underwhelming. And honestly, if you paid 1k for one meal for a party of 5, I would have expected everyone NOT to leave the place hungry. The only way I'd ever recommend this restaurant to anyone if they and their wallet want a bit of weight loss, and if you enjoy the ambience and the prestige of having that kind of money to burn, I suppose.

Author: AHC_1990
Title: Just don't go here for the food
Review: Great atmosphere, view and location. Ideal for a relaxing drink. But don't bother with the food, it's expensive, the portions are small and it's not very tasty (lack of taste and burned vegetables). Staff/ service is nothing special.

Author: SophiaKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Service!
Review: I and my family went there last week. We ordered Kabsa chicken, Mandi chicken and Chicken Spaghetti. Chicken was smelly, but I finished it anyway. I also bought Baklava for taking home. Its RM20 per box, its made in Malaysia, not imported. The taste was not so good like authentic baklava from Middle East. Pistachio looks not real pistachio, nuts are colored green by food coloring (correct me if I am wrong). They are also oily.In my oppinion, this restaurant can not beat Dima restaurant at Oasis Ara Damansara or Saba Restaurant at Cyberjaya at all.If I have to visit this place again, it might because of the service of waiter was so good!

Author: kevinwchan2018Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Nyonya Cuisines!
Review: How could you not love Baba Nyonya Food? It is unique, it is delicious!Oh Heavenly!Do not miss their nyonya curry fish, pie Tee (as appertiser), the Lobak (spring roll), the perut ikan dish, and the list goes on....... get the Nyonya to recommend it for you and your parties!

Author: Helmshore_Traveller
Title: Amazed to see this in the top lists
Review: We ate here after reading the reviews on tripadvisor and cannot see what the fuss is about. Food is of below average quality, over-priced and service random. Added to the uncomfortable 'quirky' seating and it all makes for a rather poor experience.

Author: denieseg2015
Title: Annoyed by staff
Review: I heard about this restaurant and decided to have my dinner there... We enjoyed the food and the environment..but the service staffs doesn't show their profession to the guests. Service staff talking to each other using their language too loud...It's make us annoyed because we were sited in the middle of the restaurant, And the management doesn't seem to do anything about it. Overall, the next time if I were to dine In your restaurant again I would prefer to be sited in a quieter corner... Just for small comment..

Author: 342cindyqBlair Athol, Australia
Title: Romantic dinner in langkawi
Review: The restaurant was quaint and had a lot of candles which added to the atmosphere. The staff were very helpful and even lit a citronella candle for us to avoid getting eaten by mosquitoes. As the restaurant is outside there as also harmless small geckos that crawl all over the ceiling. Which doesn't diminish from the food. The food was great with excellent flavour. However the wine by glass menu isn't extensive, but I find that is the case here with many restaurants. The wontons and fish curry had a lot of flavour but they were slightly overcooked. The satay skewers and lychee & lime freezer is a must have.

Author: RichardJM2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome breakfast in KL
Review: My day started at the Cafe De Paris in Pavilion with a wonderful breakfast. The food was super fresh, made in house and really tasty. The juice was freshly squeezed and the coffee super. If you're in KL and want a great breakfast at a very reasonable price come give these guys a go. I did drop back later in the day for a happy hour pint to take the edge of frantic day of shopping

Author: NudeFoodDudeYarra Valley, Victoria, Australia
Title: Reheated Pre-prepared Food
Review: We tried Madam Kwan's in KL recently on a family holiday. It was located in the food basement at Pavillion Shopping Mall. What we encountered was mostly stodgy food with adequate service. Considering Malaysians love their food I'm surprised that this restaurant is actually a chain. And it ain't cheap! Try this if you will but there is a plethora of adjoining eateries to choose from that make this establishment cower in comparison.

Author: JoannaF1178
Title: Disappointment
Review: This is the restaurant so call seafood platter that cost me RM118. First time visit and won’t come back anymore. Not worth the price at all!

Author: LinnaTeng
Title: Having bad service on my 2nd time visit
Review:
Been here for 2nd time… the staff serving r not polite and also unfriendly. Will not be here again.

The food are just nice. 

The overall review are under my expectations.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: eat_drink_love_prayKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Way below acceptable standards
Review: Celebrated V day there. Food was so so. Nothing to shout about. Premise was cramped with tables next to each other, of course to gain max returns. Staffs were under trained, probably hired from kopitiam next door. Cutleries should be changed after each servings. Very minimal understanding etiquette. Staffs were just rushing around to get things done. Not a place for special occasion anymore. Very unpleasant experience. Eat and go is ok but still I will think twice since I am paying good money.

Author: timothyw501
Title: Inappropriate 10% service charge
Review: They ask you to go pay by yourself at the cashier but they charge 10% service charge. So what am I paying the 10% for Anyway? Doesn't feel ethically right to me.

Author: Bustania
Title: Best restaurant in Kuching
Review: Perfect place for a good/romantic dinner in Kuching! The atmosphere is very pleasant, nice decoration. I've been there twice and the service is always excellent, so as the food and the drinks ! It's a little bit expensive, but it worth it.

Author: HZ PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Average food, terrible service, not worth the price
Review: Came here for dinner at 8.40pm on a Monday evening, so peak hour has long passed. There was a couple in front of me, so the first waitress signaled for me to wait, which is fine by me. What was NOT fine, was being ignored by a second waitress who came to the entrance but completely ignored my existence. Pity I didn't remember her name to name her here. First waitress eventually came back shortly after and seated me, with a smile.Same second waitress took my order, unwillingly and only reluctantly took out pen and paper to write down after I ordered my third item. With a sulk.I ordered a unagi chawanmushi which was drowned in unagi sauce, but egg itself had good texture and flavor. The oyako maki was much smaller than other places and not tightly packed. Some roe juice was left on the plate after I ate the maki. Overall I felt the price does not justify the quality and service.By the time I called for the bill, the restaurant was considerably even emptier, I called for the bill and unortunately it had to be the same sulker.Nothing came despite seeing a few waitresses walking about randomly so I had to call for the manager for the bill.Will not return.

Author: Jack F
Title: Malaysian food
Review: Like most restaurants in Melaka, this restaurant serves a variety of dishes, especially Malaysian food. You can enjoy eating their typical fat rice here, the prices they offer are quite friendly and fit in the pocket.

Author: munir n
Title: Lunch with family
Review: A good place to have lunch with family and friends. The place is quiet small but the foods there are delicious, mouth watering and the waiters are friendly.

Author: Boojie
Title: nice views, but go elsewhere for good food
Review: overpriced and not so flavorful. the atmosphere was fabulous though. wish we had stayed at this hotel.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KRafteryLimerick, Ireland
Title: Lovely Restaurant off the beaten track
Review: Had a lovely meal here. The place itself is down a roadway off the Main Street in Tengah. It's closed on Mondays which we found out when we tried there first. Setting is really nice-outdoor feel to it. Food was delicious. Lovely Asian dishes and western option available also. Service was excellent-the manager was very friendly and quick to make recommendations. Would highly recommend.

Author: Fakrul J
Title: Extremely disappointed.
Review: I booked this place 5 days in advance to celebrate my 1st anniversary with my wife. I've requested to add floral setup to my table, however upon arriving, there was nothing. No setup whatsoever. I was told by one of the staff there, that the florist could not make it due to the pouring rain. I was gutted and extremely disappointed because I have not been informed earlier.

Author: FfejcGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Beautiful Restaurant in 5 star hotel, excellent staff, huge menu.
Review: We came across this by chance after walking around Telaga Harbour and not finding any restaurants that looked good. We saw the Hotel and decided to have a drink there and pass some time as we were early.Inside we found a few nice bars, music and the Planters Restaurant.Very friendly and helpful hostess outside showed us the menu and outlined all the different types of food, European, Indian, Malay, Chinese etc, massive choice, and then showed us around inside and the outside tables with a wonderful view.We had a drink and then decided to stay for dinner and we were glad we did,As mentioned exceptional choice, we had a large grilled sea bass and some side meat dishes and veggies / rice. Great drinks / wine lists, just a very good restaurant and excellent service throughout the meal.The downside was that it was quiet and lacked atmosphere, but the service, the views and the quality of the food made up for that. Give it a try.

Author: El3an00r
Title: Packaged well
Review: The restaurant food is Eastern flavour and spices with Western influence. The food was really lovely and packaged well. Cooking and portion of rice was perfect. Only thing, they could charge more for food!

Author: aphsanayasmin
Title: Arabian Grill and the best desserts!
Review: Beautiful food! Staff were amazing and so friendly. I cannot fault any of the restaurants at the Danna

Author: Ezyan N
Title: Very private & cozy
Review: I had lunch there with my friend. I ordered their lunch set which cost less than RM15. Worth every money! The taste not bad. They need to improve cooking skill as the fish they served were too oily for me. They have ample car park space so u don't have to worry bout parking side of the road.

Author: MagAcdc
Title: Nice food, good service
Review: In went there with family of 4. We had banana rice thali and it was delicious. The staff there are very efficient even though the restaurant was pack with patrons. We enjoy the food there and I would love to go back there again.

Author: Traveleratheart2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Embarrassing
Review: How awkward and embarrassing should be for a restaurant when a customer sends back the plate to the kitchen asking for the main ingredient to be in his/her plate as mentioned in the menu, minutes later the waiter comes saying: we're sorry we don't have it. They tried to cheat on me giving me Philadelphia spread instead of feta cheese!! I rejected it of course, worse part: it was charged in the bill. It's irrational and ridiculous!

Author: Yuen K
Title: Wanted to compare taste to bamboo restaurants
Review: Ordered the paper wrap chicken. Disappointing. Chicken no taste or herb aroma. Meat is not tender. And costly. Orders also kang Kong tough to chew. We call it old in Chinese. Service is terrible. Like we owe them a living. After dinner can feel very thirsty and dry mouth. Must be too much ajinomoto.Will never go there again. We all agree.

Author: LoV55
Title: Tasteful dim sum
Review: Only place available for our early breakfast at 7am. Their most popular is the big pao but we get shocked when they sent us the pao. I thought it's bbq pao coz the size is small as it but the lady boss told us they served small size of big pao. Anyway those doesn't matter because the "big" pao really taste good n delicious!! The rest of the dim sum just so so but not bad. Highly recommended for those like to have very early breakfast n dim sum fans.

Author: Indra KMelbourne, Australia
Title: A must try in Langkawi!
Review: We ate at fatCUPID today for lunch and we are so glad we did! We stayed at the Westin so finding this restaurant was a little off the beaten track.. it was difficult to find but once found it was like an oasis. Incredible food, cocktails and service! I particularly enjoyed the Laksa and Sago pudding! Will definitely recommend to anyone who wants a decent meal in a gorgeous setting while in Langkawi. I wish I had found it earlier in my stay!

Author: johnwU4958QJ
Title: A Great Example of Japanese Fine Dining.
Review: 11 of our family members attended Yuzu and were given a private room. Excellent food and service. Great ambience. Highly recommended

Author: Anne B
Title: Great restaurant
Review: We were in a group of 10. Everybody ordered something different from the local noodle dish to fish and chips and all the dishes were excellent. Compliments to the chef for preparing such a varied menu and doing them all well.

Author: dannyy647Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food, Personalised service, Great Value
Review: Very satisfying experience is how I'll describe my visit with my wife last night to Positano. They may have just opened just a few days ago but I couldn't tell all went smoothly. For a casual restaurant, the service staff were attentive and professional, the owners were around to host us too. I also found this is great value - I suspect they'll be very successful if they keep this up! Well done Positano!

Author: daezjnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: I was looking for a quaint Chinese restaurant with a nice, unique, 'designer' like decor, good food and pleasant ambiance for my father's intimate 74th birthday with just my mum and I. I was not disappointed. I love the interior with it's modern Chinoise style of red lanterns, printed emperor images on soft fabrics hanging from the ceiling, walls covered with wooden drawers (reminded me of a Chinese medicine influence), pretty table setting of colourful porcelain plates and steaming bamboo trays in view at the end of the small restaurant as part of the aesthetic/ mood. Great place to take nice photos! We were immediately served with a fancy tea that was poured from a very long spout with much fanfare and flourish. It was also a special delicious tea that was slightly sweet and apparently contained wolf berry, ginger, dates, etc. The staff were attentive and hospitable- we were served by a lovely elderly lady and a Chinese gentleman. We ordered the Peking duck and a stir fry vegetable. The duck was first served Chynna style with it's sliced crispy skin dished out to everyone equally, then the remainder was hand rolled and neatly presented on a large plate after. We opted for the stir fry noodles for the remaining duck meat and it was very delicious! Chynna has it's own unique seaweed sauce for the duck (I found it tasteless though) but I was happy with the traditional plum sauce. I had secretly ordered a slice of chocolate cake with the words 'Happy Birthday' at the end of the night. The lady waitress lit a candle and sang a song for us. The cake was delicious, not too sweet and moist. We were very happy and stuffed!!!

Author: Ha WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is bad
Review: Went for a birthday lunch with colleagues and chose this outlet in Sunway pyramid. Food arrive reasonably late although restaurant is quite empty.Mac & cheese is terribly dry, cream sauce almost non existent. Chicken breast portion is so small and disappointing.No more free dessert cake for birthday boy as well.

Author: humi s
Title: ... Be patient, you have to wait 30-45min.
Review: ... I can not believe that to serve a bottle of water, a shawarma, and fries, people, listen: 45 minutes! Hahaha... Maybe the restaurant was full, full? 3 tables! Haha... Then we order another bottle of water and after 7-8min. We have to cancel it... A bottle of water, eh? Not a paella for 3 or a Sirloin steak... Haha...avoid this place, please!

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Understaffed restaurant
Review: It has been a long time since I last had Pizza Hut and this visit reminded me why. We ordered the set for 4 that includes soup, spaghetti, 1 large pizza, ice cream and drinks. We also ordered additional regular pizza. Service initially was fast. We got our soup, spaghetti, the pizza and drinks from the set quite fast but the second pizza did not arrive. And the ice cream. I had to get up to get a staff attention that I was still waiting for my second pizza. By the time the pizza arrived we have waited enough and needed to leave. So we had it packed for takeaway. Then the ice cream came! Oh, what a facepalm moment.I put the issue on the lack of manpower. I pity the staff. There were only 3 wait staff including the manager and God knows how many in the kitchen. They have to wait tables and entertain online orders.While the pizzas still have the magical stringy melting cheese, reminiscent of my childhood, maybe I should just stick to takeaway.

Author: Hp C
Title: Average food, rather steep even for this part of town
Review: Thought I would try a new restaurant and decided on ra.ft. For the princely sum of RM 40 for a beef burger with bacon and cheese, the beef was overcooked, and smelt like it had been around a little too long. The bacon in the carbonara was hard. Will go back to try their coffee but will steer clear of these 2 dishes for now.

Author: amiraazhar94Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: We ordered a few items on the menu. Half of them came on time, the other half was supposed to be the appetisers and a main dish came extremely late. We cncelled our orders as they made us waited so long, regardless following up w the waiters fr approximately 5 times to check on our orders. Very upsetting as my mom was frm the clinic n it was supposed to b her first meal after a long fast.

Author: rayt66Singapore, Singapore
Title: Enjoyable
Review: Had dinner with a fried we shared the duck, scallops and cod. My friend had a soup and I had the breseola salad to start. Food was very good though portions were a little small for the price we paid. Service was pleasant and fairly prompt though our water glasses did take a while to get refilled. Overall an enjoyable meal.

Author: Prem J
Title: Subtlety but Obvoiusly Racist attitude of staff
Review: Visited the place on 15th July 2018 for lunch. At first I thought the place was just bad service due to attitude of the staff. No one was bothered to take my order or even acknowledge that I was sitting there. Didn’t take long to realise that this attitude was only towards me, and when I looked around Imwas the only Asian customer in the place. New customers ( Aussie , European etc) arriving were greeted with a friendly hello, the waitress was coming up to get their orders find out how their food was etc. Never once was I approached not even to check if my pint order needed to be refilled. It was more like ignore him and he will leave sooner than later. I’ve been the hospitality industry for the last 20 years working working with luxury brands and this attitude is very sad and deplorable. Just moved to KL a few weeks ago a live 100 mtrs away from this joint. Needless to say won’t be visiting them ever again.PS : nothing wrong with the food per se but nothing to rave about either; a folded newspaper is kept under the butter paper to give the impression of an over full plate. Hilarious.

Author: marcellor613
Title: Chicken Rice
Review: If you are deary to chicken rice of malaysia cuisine, halal and tasty you gotta try this one. One of the branches located in central touristic area of bukit bintang near federal hotel. Good price and quick service.

Author: valmeow
Title: Dinner is better
Review: Been there many times, good service only a reminder of refill water touchdown. Going again in November.  I think mainly local food, would like to see better salad variety. Mash potato, pies, fried chicken, wedges...

Author: k7cqPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Almost Perfect
Review: The service, atmosphere, and quality of food were all top notch. Better give that Myanmar chef a raise because you don't want to loose him. My wife and I wanted a romantic dinner but were unable to get it here. The music was way to loud and I don't appreciate listening to "johnny be good" type of music for dinner. They turned the music down, but the owner/manager obviously has poor taste when it comes to fine dining music. We don't get that kind of crap music in the U.S., maybe they do in Germany.

Author: Boon Ming N
Title: "Food Court" in shopping mall
Review:
If you are tired of all the fast food and shopping mall food chains outlets... this "food court" concept restaurant that serves basically from breakfast (nasi lemak/roti bakar) to proper dinner (cooked dishes/meals)..

the price is acceptable.. air-cond environment..

Author: johnm53376Hobart, Australia
Title: Not as good as it looks
Review: This place is strategically located on Jonkers Street and automatically attracts the expat crowd because of its décor. It is OK for a beer and a stare but there are plenty of better places to go for food nearby such as the malay portugese food at Eleven Bistro just down the side street and Baboon House for the best burgers around. The music is often unnecessarily loud and makes a conversation a real chore. So all in all not really the go but as stated fair enough for a coldie!

Author: John DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: I don't see what all the fuss is about
Review: I think Kebaya is a confused concept. It tries to be fine dining but I think could be considerably improved if a more flexible approach were adopted. I was not keen on having to order a set menu and would have much preferred an a la carte approach, particularly because the portion sizes were enormous and simply not appropriate for a restaurant operating a "fine dining" concept. On the other hand, the food I tried was reasonable, but certainly not spectacular given the price point.Perhaps rethink the menu and offer an a la carte option?

Author: Gary-L8Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good
Review: This restaurant has been here for a while and has developed a crowd of followers, along with a live band, which makes it a fun place. There is an interesting choice of foods, perhaps beststated as a diverse choice of foods, that could ensure an option to satisfy almost any picky eater. I had a chicken teriyaki bun and a shrimp mango salad, both starters, along with a watermelon mojito. I was with a friend who is a regular, and the staff were very attentive. We were at an outdoor table, and the atmosphere was ideal to allow us to have a conversation, while eating the interesting dishes. I have previously eaten here and at their original restaurant on the other side of kl, and what really works for this restaurant, is the variety of choices, and those choices are genuinely interesting.

Author: Wolv3rin3
Title: Basic business lunch buffet
Review:
Reasonable spread of international and local cuisine. Quite like the variety of local curries esp. the fish head curry very well spiced and painted well with the nasi briyani long grained rice.
Desserts liked the black glutinous rice in coconut milk.

Author: SurferAlly
Title: Happy Tummy
Review: Ordered the Mexican Dawg meal and the cheeseburger meal. Good meal. Nice ambience. Free Wifi usage. Good food = Happy tummy

Author: AuliaP107
Title: Shopping Centre
Review: you can search what you need. sometimes they had a lot of discounts kkk. it's located in front of the station (bukit bintang).

Author: Bacio73
Title: Bad food &very sad!
Review: I took my niece & nephew for lunch today and it has been 2 years they never come to KL. Such a disappointing lunch we had. We were served with cold  & thick beef noodles and watery sauce of black pepper & mushroom for our...chicken chop . It was really really disappointed . We complaint to the manager and he was very apologetic. I feel the money I paid more than 100 ringgit should be given to those who needed instead of paid for my awful lunch . My advise instead of just want to make money the restaurant should focus on quality and service .  My advise to everyone if you want to have delicious madam kwan food you should go to BSC not KLCC.More

Author: 39felwBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Dissapointed
Review: I am amazed by the ambience but the food is not delicious especially the noodles. We ordered foo chow noodle and asam pedas noodle, as a local chinese, the noodles should be cooked using the right noodle and not using spaghetti noodle which is rather very dissapointing. The portion is huge but size of the portion is meaningless if the food is not delicious. This place is not recommendes if you are looking for a good cafe to have your brunch. There are much nicer cafes in Kuching.

Author: ILoveMakanTokyo, Japan
Title: Quality deteriorating.
Review: It is still one of the favorites amongst locals and people visiting KL. However, over the last 5 years I could see the quality of food deteriorating consistently. I am sad to see this as it has a great menu. However, if they can not up keep the quality and service then I will have to tell my friends to avoid this restaurant. I am also hearing from many of my friends reporting the same concern. I would hope the owner of the restaurant will take it seriously to these voices and improve the quality of dishes.

Author: ESTan888
Title: Anything chicken
Review: The sauce is great. Most dishes taste great. Especially the marinated honey chicken. Could try their lunch set. If you are coming here for lunch during work week or weekends please come early as there is usually a long wait.

Author: aaroncoloradoLos Angeles, California
Title: Wonderfully decorated, solid location, cafe/lodging combination
Review: The good things:The family that runs this hostel and cafe are helpful and nice. The decor is wonderful. The dorm room is spacious and beds are comfortable with nice bedding. AC works well. Nice sitting area. Easy access to downstairs cafe. Great location and near to many attractions. Lockers for valuables. Water container. Place to prepare simple meals.Needs improvement: Noisy from street traffic in bedroom at night. Only one shower/toilet combo for the entire hostel floor upstairs. Additional shower/toilet downstairs in cafe area.

Author: urvashi595
Title: very relaxing and lot of afcilities
Review: everything was good, you can have  ashower and relax till your room is ready or before leaving after check out if you have  alate flight

Author: MatthiasG1292
Title: Food ok, but...
Review: For the food i give a three- it's OK, nothing special. Price is a bit higher, but location is very central. I rate it down to two, as the atmosphere is nicer in other places ( more personal and more authentic, i felt the "tourism thing" very strong), but mostly because of this: we were there with our baby boy (1y), and they brought some prawn crackers (we did not order) for him after we finished eating, most likely to keep him entertained. And then we found 3myr on the bill for "tibits"! It's not because of the money... It's because being so cheeky/ insulting!

Author: slowneasy2083
Title: Drop in for Dinner
Review: Firstly the service sucks and the food is very oily and they do not really care, if you like it or not.

Author: KLworker
Title: Quite noisy and food not too good
Review: The place is very busy and noisy at weekends, cannot hold a conversation in this place.  Basically a drinking bar.  Food is not very good at all, probably want to avoid it.  Ok place for young groups.

Author: Vektor_HugoOsaka, Japan
Title: Cedar service in Western Breakfast.
Review: Staff provided great service and even the on duty manager are keep asking us how's the food, and he also collect used plate from table but the food there not much choose as maybe they just provided Western Breakfast.

Author: 859babum
Title: Service was suck
Review: Good food.but service was very poor. The myanmar waiter so stupid.don't know how talk english.if i ask for something, he said so what?

Author: Ruby T
Title: Delicious !!
Review:
Good Punjabi's food.
We love to come again. Best Indian food. 
The Chicken Tikka Masala and the tandoori chicken was very delicious. The best Indian food.

Author: MikloZenHelsinki, Finland
Title: Ok food, but overall experience not up to expected levels or price
Review: Went to Nobu on a Saturday evening for dinner. Restaurant was semi full, so a bit busy but there were plenty of empty tables. We received a table by the window as was requested, and he views were great!On arrival we we asked if we would like some drinks to start the evening with and we did order some. And that's when the waiting started. And that pretty much dominated the whole evening. I took more that 30 mins to get the first dish after we had ordered the 7 course menu. Wines would be delivered only 15 mins after we had received the dish. We were served the same dish twice, or tried to but we sent them back.Several table around us were served much faster even though they arrived later than us. At one point, after a couple of apologies, the waiter asked if we would like to speed up the serving of the courses. Naturally we said 'Yes, please'. That had no real impact on the speed. Eventually restaurant was almost as empty as our table and wine&water glasses but still we had to signal several times for the bill.For food we had the Nobu Omakase Menu, which had some really good highlights like the tuna sashimi salad and white fish. But mostly it was average good, nothing special with some disappointments even like miso soup without any taste or the very basic nigiri set.Most disappointing was the lack of attention and respect towards the client. Even the little mistakes with the service would not matter if you were treated with attention and professionalism that can be expected of such a venue.It's very evident that Nobu KL is fully relying on their name and views rather than trying to impress with food or service. I would give average rating instead of poor if prices were lower.

Author: NLSTLS
Title: Nice spot, awful food
Review: The spot is amazing and the location perfect, the choice of beers is very good. But don’t go there for food it’s not good at all except fries !

Author: TallyHo_8
Title: Romantic sunset cocktails
Review:
Romantic sunset cocktails in an unparalleled location. Private with very attentive service.
#amazing

Author: NickyTeh2004
Title: Overrated and overpriced
Review: Seriously, don't waste your time unless you are not there for food or drinks. The ambience and landscape is good. That's about it.

Author: YauKuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Drinks
Review: Perfect location and suitably eclectic for a great drink very well served by helpful staff, There was Cooper's beer, the best Stout / Porter I have ever had; the colour of Guinness but smoother and with a great taste more like a mild bitterThere is food but we did not try it.

Author: ellanec2013Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Affordable average japanese buffet
Review: Celebrate Father's day with my family members there. Remember to book advance if you intend to go there. You can't just walk in as the place always full.Overall rate average. The sashimi and oyster not so fresh. Other cold dish not bad. Fish is good. Tempura also nice. Grilled lamb and beef are ok. Love the green tea ice cream the most!

Author: Choonyiap2238Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: super Beautiful and Very Nice
Review: this place will get popular so come before they get popular Expect to wait for a while because the “smoothie art” take time to make n only fresh pre order For me n my friends we happy with it n worth to wait Really thx for the experience !

Author: jokl78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: We decided to celebrate our daughter's birthday here after we tried it back in Oct 2021 cos the food was good. But we were very disappointed this time around. We ordered few dishes for sharing.Lamb - tasted good but a lot of fats (50% fats). Only ate half (lean meat)Lobster roll - goodSmoked duck breast - yucks. It's so salty like eating salt. We ask the waiter is it normal to be this salty. He called the Manager and he said yes. We don't believe a single word he said. How can be a smoked duck breast so salty like pouring salt into your mouth? Pure nonsense. We don't want to argue but just let it be.Bad experience this time. Will we be back? Most likely not unless they change out the manager or the manager change his attitude and admit his chef made a mistake!

Author: chc888
Title: Good ambient but below average food quality
Review: The building was cool and very enjoyable ambient for dim sum. However, the dim sum quality was way below the average.. not recommended if you are looking for good dim sum.

Author: derickyu
Title: Terrible
Review: Bad service. Average food. Expensive. Very slow. Complained to the manager who said they would remove the room charge but nothing was done. We walked away in disgust. Never go there.

Author: Leilani DMorton Grove, Illinois
Title: Ugh!
Review: I'm not sure about authentic Malay food that we were looking for, but we felt it was more Indian (unless Malay food is primarily of Indian descent contrary to what I searched online). The place was dirty, there was no organization in placing of orders and paying. The food all looked and tasted the same. Only one (amongst 20+) servers can understand English. Even though we paid pretty cheap for everything, we preferred to have paid more for better!

Author: emz_ingNewark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic pizza!
Review: After eating Asian food for each and every meal for more than a week pizza was a welcome change and it was fantastic! Look for Big Bottle bar and it is just to the left hand side, we almost missed it. Prices very reasonable (approx 20RM for the smaller size). The place to go for authentic pizza in Kuching.

Author: Robert FSydney, Australia
Title: Delicious Dim Sum
Review: Clean and spacious restaurant with a great selection of dim sum. The restaurant is self-serve, so you go up to the counter and order what you want instead of selecting items from trollies pushed by waiting staff around the restaurant. There doesn't seem to be a menu so you need to be with someone who knows the names of the dishes. Alternatively, you can just pick the items you like from the steamers. The price is very reasonable and food is really good, so overall great value for money.

Author: mdzamriKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious curry restaurant in middle of city
Review: 1) Variety of curry dishes, fried (chicken, fish & cuttlefish), selection of vegetable and crunchy papadom.2) You can try mix a few dishes and “kuah taru atas” it means pouring curry sauce on top.3) Be careful if you choose fried cuttlefish, probably you may check the price before you take.4) This restaurant open 24 hours daily. And will be crowded during lunch and dinner time.5) Parking in front of restaurant not enough space and most of visitors “double park” their vehicles.

Author: foodtravellermalaysi
Title: Overrated Steak House
Review: Not a good experience as the staffs were very cocky and not attentive. Pricewise is ok, food is ok. View is good. just the staff attitude spoiled the experience.

Author: JDi1
Title: Slowwwwwwwww
Review:
Make sure you're not THAT hungry when you come over.. It takes years for your food to come, especially when it's full.

Great choice of breakfast though

Author: jamesl617Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food Sucks!
Review: • Smoked salmon is not fresh• Chicken is over-cooked & become elastic• No bread served for starter• No iced water provided• Risotto is not worth or the valueFrankly this is the WORST Italian restaurant I've ever had in Malaysia!

Author: Stingrui11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Decent korean bbq but slow service
Review: Tried gogirou for the first time and the food was generally decent and the sets were also quite affordable. However, due to the lack of staff, it can be quite difficult to get service even though it is quite a small shop. I personally also preferred the ban chan at Bornga which is just opposite at City Square.

Author: Alsek810Chapel Hill, North Carolina
Title: I wouldn't know how the food was, it never arrived.
Review: We went to this restaurant after reading positive reviews on Tripadvisor and some restaurant blogs. We were seated upstairs and our orders for drinks and dinner chaoices were taken promptly, About 10-15 minutes later one drink arrived, followed 5 minutes later by the other drink and my dinner companions entree. We then sat at least 20 minutes , with me telling her to go ahead and start eating, while waiting for my entree which was a grilled fish dish. The waiter who took our order was no where to be seen so I flagged a waitress and explained I was still waiting for my entree, no results. After 40 minutes or so after ordering I finally walked downstairs to the kitchen and found our waiter and canceled my order. Sort of unbelievable especially when people all around us were ordering and being served. Made for a very dismal dining experience. When I asked for the bill for the drinks and one entree that was delivered we were told we did not owe anything. I appreciate they did the right thing. However the service was unexcusable for a dining establishment with this reputation.

Author: luckyonelolCranleigh, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty and elegant
Review: We ate in this restaurant a few times alone and with friends for tea and drinks and for dinner and were always pleased with the experience. The staff was friendly and helpful , the setting and decor beautiful and interesting . Good ventilation and tasty and well presented food . Advice: book ahead .

Author: Mervyn H
Title: let down by tripadvisor reviews
Review: It was not the first time I was misled by tripadvisor western reviewers with minimal knowledge about Malaysian food, but Old China Cafe beats all my other bad experiences by being both truly atrocious and expensive. Old china cafe was very dimly lit and the interior looked dark even with a hot blazing afternoon daylight outside. The service was nonchalant and the waiters avoided looking at the dining tables in case a diner needed service. The diners were all foreign except for a group of men looking like owners or shareholders. The fried chicken pieces in lemon sauce were small, over fried, tasteless, and the lemon sauce was watery and tasted diluted straight from a supermarket bottled sauce. The beef rendang was anything but. Tiny slivers of tasteless fatty beef served in Chinese stir-fried style, it was very dim but we could tell that the dish was off-coloured, and of course, tasteless. The coconut rice was served in Maleka-style bluish colour and it was ... you might have guessed ... tasteless.The menu is very expensive for a run-down setting in a tourist-trap area of KL, the lack of local diners was already a worrying sign at the outset. I'm not here to do anybody any favours, thus, its your money if you want to squander it here. I've done it so you don't have to.

Author: JoLynnL14
Title: Poor of service.
Review: Nice decoration but the spaghetti is abit expensive. The restaurant opens at 10am but the kitchen actually starts at 11pm. I visited at 10am n started to wait for around an hour. I would like to order a cappuccino but the cashier said drinks only available on 10:45am onwards. The most disappointing part is the service. When you talk to the cashier they kept pressing their phone and give you 0 eyes-contact.

Author: Isaac L
Title: Lunch
Review: Heard of this shop review. Order their nyona rice dumpling, fruits rojak and poh piah. Rice Dumpling with lots of meat fillings , Rojak was a little wet but overall taste is ok. And the poh piah is unique as they add in crispy pork lard. Overall, nothing special just the local taste. No aircon limited siting space. Need to park a distance and walk as there is limited car park lots. Price is a bit $$$

Author: roseline m
Title: High rise high price
Review:
A relatively good choice if to have a night KL view from top.
Food in small portion and big money. Service on average. Always too crowded especially weekends.

Author: CV KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice comfortable cafe for local street (hawker-fare) food
Review: We come to this outlet occasionally for a nice place for hawker-fare. This time we hosted a visitor who wanted to try local comfort food. This cafe offers a wide selection to try-out a bit of variety. We ordered the fried noodles, curry mee, prawn mee, banana fritters and ice kacang (shaved ice in syrup and sweet-bits). The meal is very satisfying with lots of good conversation. Its above average for street food but not overly pricey for this location. Staff was very helpful and attentive. It is helpful to reserve a table ahead or come early for the meal. There is a queue at the door during the peak dinner hour. Great place.

Author: 845shee
Title: Cosy place from the outside
Review: Cosy place from the outside.Food is a pricey for Ipoh standard and taste is so so only.Ample parking and nice ambience

Author: melvyn b
Title: Great Steak
Review: Looking at the steaks available the waiter recommended the porterhouse. It turned out to have a great flavour and was thoroughly enjoyed. Possibly the tastes' steak I have ever eaten.

Author: cofycofySubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Don’t go for the food , extremely slow service
Review: It was the last day in Langkawi for me and family , the experience here pretty much ruined half of it. Do go for the drinks and view, but as for the food, We waited for 1 and a half hours , our food wasn’t even served completely, we then decided to just cancel it and leave the restaurant. We ordered the food around 750pm, by 930pm we left with an empty stomach.

Author: Sean T
Title: Favorable.
Review: It's okay. But a big let down for spicy fans. The food is a little too sweet, just a little above the human tongue could handle. But, I can say that the service and ambience is very very good. The uncle will not rest until the customers are satisfied, which, to me, is quite good of him to do so. Food specific, the Pie Tee was extraordinary, as well as the sambal prawns with petai. The asam fish was favorable, but it doesn't quite fit the picture of asam fish. In a nutshell, it's an okay experience at Amy's.

Author: NishaKl
Title: Good food
Review: Overall food good. Like the nasi bukhara but hate the qeue....

Author: lolarahmanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Everything was perfect!
Review: The food is amazingly delicious, the staff were very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. We felt as if we were given a customized treatment from the moment we enter the restaurant until we leave. The view at the back of the restaurant is amazing too. Love it. Come with someone special and you'll feel the magic of the restaurant even more.

Author: Savanna454Melbourne, Australia
Title: BEST AVOIDED
Review: The cuisine is apparently "Tex-Mex" but to call it that would do a great injustice to the genuine article. My partner's fish and chips had overcooked batter but the fish within was oozing liquid which indicated to me that it was likely still partially frozen when deep fried. It fell apart into a soggy mess. My prawn tacos were marginally better. The salad filling was reasonable and actually contained miniature tomatoes and avocado. However the prawns had also suffered the same fate as the fish being inadequately thawed and oozing liquid which made the tacos soggy. Needless to say we both decided to leave the food unfinished. Service was little better with most customers struggling to get attention from the few waiters circulating. Most of the waiters appeared to be itinerant labour rather than locals and spoke little English or Malay. To cap it all I was asked to leave a tip for service which was additional to the already included service charge and a first for me in Malaysia. I also noticed that the bill of RM135 had been converted to $AUD at a terrible rate AFTER I entered my pin which contravenes Visa/MasterCard rules. Best avoided, there are much better choices to be had in KLCC.

Author: Toms11212
Title: Good sushi
Review:
You've got bad sushi and good sushi. This is good sushi. Not excellent but price versus quality: good.
Try the soup with clamps, and the sashimi also taste good.

Author: Adrian M
Title: Dreadful management
Review: Dreadful attitude of the Ante management tonight. The restaurant was enveloped in noise from construction next door. The so called 'management' sat outside smoking and playing on their computers and refused to do anything whilst their customers suffered inside. Extremely poor attitude to paying customers.

Author: SamS551
Title: Authentic Malaysia Food
Review: This is  a very busy restaurant and can get really hot during lunch time. Food is decent and the price is reasonable. You will see that people here use their hands to eat!

Author: JennyY856
Title: Food so-so
Review: my family and I went on last Saturday. the food was far different from original peranakan taste. We ordered belacan kangkung, pongteh pork, cincalok egg and some other dishes. all tasted totally out, and was not cook by locals but foreigners. Foreigners doesn't know our nyonya food taste. my whole family is really disappointed with the food. we will never go again to this shop.

Author: peejay_dkDenmark
Title: Very overrated
Review: We had breakfast at La Bodega Pavillion one day, based upon the Tripadvisor reviews. What a disappointment.The food was OK. Just. The orange juice apparently freshly squeezed, but not very tastful. The beef bacon very fat. The sausages undercooked. Bread was randomly wheat and rye, randomly toasted/untoasted. Like they just didn't care.Lack of care could also be said for the service. They were hardly interested in taking our orders after the first two persons had ordered, leaving 4 of us waiting for the attention of the waiter. They offer a juice AND coffee add-on to the meal, however when ordering both we have to ask repeatedly for the one (juice or coffee) they choose not to serve without being reminded.And to top it off, they had the bill wrong, having breakfast, jiuce and coffee as seperate - and thus more expensive items - than the meal. "Oh - you wanted their meal" was their comment, when questioned.Never again.

Author: Foreign_tour_somedayRewari, India
Title: Very nice food for peanuts price
Review: we visited this restaurant for more than 10 times in a span of 7 days...mostly for lunch and dinner and sometimes for evening tea.the food was really good in taste except the lunch on our last day of departure and the bill on average was 30-35 ringgits for a family of 2 adults and 2 kids who are 9 yrs old twins. our minimum bill was 16 ringgits on one day n maximum was 47 ringgits on another day. I would like to make a suggestion regarding adding more options for vegetarian food lovers as my wife is a strict vegetarian and prefers Indian food only. Though kids and myself were never short of options. A special thanks to the owner couple and chefs Kamal and Akka....who always received us with a smile on their faces. Vikas. P.S I am sure they will recognise us immediately after reading this review.

Author: RoadtrippersAsiaPenang, Malaysia
Title: Nice Kambucha Tea
Review: Had a little time around the area so decided to check out this cafe for some drinks and found this Kambucha Honey Tea on their menu.Kambucha is some fermented tea ~ giving you that vinegarish taste with some hint of alcohol. I had it with honey so it gives the drink a little sweetness.Nice cafe to hangout I would say and the do have some pretty delicious looking food items on their menu.

Author: StrayCat5Penang, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as it used to be!
Review: Dragon View is a regular food stop when I visit KL - & that's a few times a year since 2006. This visit was poor. Prices increased, service decreased, quantity good, quality so-so. Seated at table where pedestrians walk (aka push) through, so meal was constantly being interrupted. Downwind of durian stall. Will have to seriously consider if I return next visit in December.

Author: 344lukas
Title: Awesome dinner experience.
Review:
Last day in Langakawi, we wanted to treat ourselves to a nice dinner, eating out mostly at food trucks etc... The staff was very friendly and and and catered to our every need
The

Author: autumnleaf09
Title: Nice Vegetarian Food
Review: Varieties of local delicacies to choose, fried flat white noodles taste especially good, a must try.

Author: 65djv
Title: You just have to go here!
Review:
The food is great. It's very busy, but that's good, it enhances the atmosphere. This is what you want from authentic Malaysian street food. Good taste, cheap, busy, chaotic. We love it!
Did I already mention how awesome the food tastes? It's the best!

Author: K1151LMjohnw
Title: Awesome fish, Ok Sushi
Review: Our second visit to Langkawi and we finally located Unkaizen. Having heard much about it from our base at the Andaman, where the chef and owner originally worked at their Japanese restaurant, we had very high expectations.The place itself is just so so, decor could do with an update but the staff were very friendly perhaps even a little too helpful in explaining the menu to seasoned Nipponfiles. The had fresh belly tuna the day we went, the only place on the island to have it and it was good.. Black cod served on hot coals exquisite! In fact all of the hot fish dishes were very good indeed. Sushi was just OK though and we had better several times the hotel.But if your after choice and exotic Japanese style hot fish and seafood dishes this is the place to go.Make sure you book, it's very small and fills up quickly.

Author: rwlidPerth
Title: Food Good in Parts - Fantastic Location
Review: We were actually invited by friends who were staying at Casa del Mar and we had a table right on the beach with a specular view of the beach, the Andaman Sea and the outlying islands. My starter of Tempura Prawns with Wasabi Mayonnaise was wonderful, but the Ayam Bakar Chicken which followed was a little disappointing. Desserts were good though and considering we had a good time with our friends and the unique location, it was a great evening all round and if in Langkawi we would surely go back.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: amarije
Title: Delicious and tasteful!
Review: Good food, fresh, very tasteful and nicely decorated on your plate. It's more expensive than streetfood, we paid 51 RM for traditional Laksa, spaghetti bolognaise and 2 lemon iced tea. More than worth it because if the exquisite taste and large portions.

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ...great heavenly...food slightly pricey but worth it....
Review: ...i have visited this place more than 10 times,mostly cos we shop at jalan masjid india and its the most convienient location to eat without much hassle.......luv the masala tea,its done just rite everytime a sure winner...the baturas or puri is so fluffy and tasty accompanied by the potato chutney,mum always has the rawa kichadi which is yummy as well...the set with idlis and vadai is the best of all.....this place is a sure treat and at each visit the food and chutneys are constantly the same....worth piggin it out here...dishes can cost between RM8-RM12 per meal....a full meal with drinks can fetch up to RM25 per person or more...so don't be shocked!

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing (In my opinion)
Review: Bak Kut Teh is a very personal thing. There are so many variations out there, from thick dark soup, to clear soup to the dry ones.Klang is known for its thick dark soup variety, and despite the fame of this outlet, I was disappointed from the presentation to the taste and the environment.The taste is a little bland compared to other offerings in Klang. And the place is in bad need to upgrade, too dirty, poor ventilation and bad service.
Restaurant: Restoran Seng Huat Bak Kut Teh

Author: YUMMYZNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and excellent attentive service
Review: We enjoyed 2 very nice buffet meals at this restaurant including a special seafood dinner . The service was excellent with very polite and attentive staff who were always very eager to please .The selection of food at the buffet was a of a very high quality and the choices were vast from Indian , Chinese , Malay , Japanese and some European ( pasta and pizzas ) , The dishes were regularly refreshed , of high quality and plentiful !!

Author: Getin M
Title: Nothing to write home about...
Review: 1. The menu is not "authentically NORTH INDIAN" as it flaunts itself. In taste, it may pass off as a close relative. FYI- North Indian states are - Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh and Jammu & Kashmir. ‘Hyderabadi’ cuisine is southeastern just like Hyderabad :) Present-day Indian cuisine that is served in restaurants is a mix of spices and ingredients that traversed borders long ago so 'authentic' is in the eye of the beholder, with all respect :) Even the humble Butter Chicken which is famously connected to Punjab is made differently across the state without claiming authenticity. So please just truthfully call it Indian cuisine. Price is fine for quality and portions served.2. The biriyani (which isn’t actually Indian, historically) tasted more like street-side Mumbai biriyani [read chicken-masala rice] , a far cry from biriyanis famously known in North of India, namely, Mughlai & Awadhi biriyanis which all include layering the rice and meat while cooking with the grains of rice not sticking to each other, like how we experienced at Flour.3. Seeing the name Flour, one assumes that their USP lies in the breads. Texture and taste was good and enjoyable. They seem to have overlooked the basics of serving Indian breads.. Anybody who has eaten at Indian restaurants would have noticed that breads are served in baskets with a bread cloth to cover them. This gives you time to relish your food without having to worry about your kulcha/naan/chapathi going cold, like we did when we were served our hot naans on a wood block at Flour which had well working A/Cs. Service was appalling!! It felt like the waiters were waiting (all pun intended) for us to leave quickly after having brought our food late. So much for "Athithi Devo Bhava" - Indian proverb meaning "Guest is next to God". The only other way to beat this is to serve the breads one-by-one hot from the tawa/tandoor to the guest I understand this is not possible by an under-staffed restaurant (as explained, albeit confusingly, by the owner herself - something about visa issues for Indians, when asked about the longer than promised delay in getting our order that came in bits and pieces. This was not expected from a restaurant that boasts a strong 50 year old restaurateur lineage. Here’s a bright idea - you could use your current chef to teach & train Malays to make bread (not actually prepare the dough in case you want to safeguard any secrets) & other basic dishes that do not require the experience of an Indian national. While on that topic-there are Chinese immigrants in Bangalore making wonderful South Indian dosas & chutneys. The magic is in the taste not in the nationality of the person making it.4.Flour seems to be doing what ‘new-age’ Indian restaurants in India are doing - to look stylishly hip & chic while still serving the same Indian cuisine to hipster crowds who want ‘western bohemian’ ambience served with their makkai roti & sarson da saag (naan style bread made from corn & mustard leaf curry). So zero points for authentic décor. If I were Flour, an Indian restaurant in a foreign country, I would have opted for an Indian setting to transport my guests to the sights, smells and tastes of India.

Author: Pongolau
Title: Best Restaurant in Johor bahru
Review:
Although the area looks packed with cars. Please call the restaurant and they will have reserve lots for you. 

Their dishes are very good and peking Duck is crispy.

Author: eelino0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mmm Mmm Mmm ... Laksalicious!
Review: We were looking for lunch at an odd hour in the day and found Laksalicious. OMG, what a find. It was (add your own expletive) amazing.And on top of that, in a very comfortable air-conditioned restaurant that provided our tired feet a much needed rest. Must-go!

Author: razleens
Title: Westin Hotel Review
Review: I visited this place last week, the staff were very welcoming and attentive especially Chef Hamid. All food are very delicious and never regret having dinner here. I would say 5 star for the food. Simply put : very highly recommended hotel. BOOK YOUR SEATS NOWWW!

Author: travelpr0123Saarbrucken, Germany
Title: Overrated and overpriced
Review: Just like in many cases on TA, unfortunately, the numerous 'one-review'-reviews (maybe by employees or the management) distort the true standing of an establishment. Don't believe the hype: The pizza served here is on the low end of mediocre, compared to a supermarket pizza from the freezer section it is acceptable, maybe. Service is slow, you will encounter different faces, none of which really is 'your personal server'. Disappointing and hugely overpriced.

Author: JasonKYB1919Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious & Fresh Oysters
Review: I have lunch date with my wife at Shucked Oyster and Seafood Bar. We ordered 3 different type of oysters which recommended by the server. The oysters were fresh and delicious. We will definitely go back again for oysters.The drawback is the fried calamari was not fresh and difficult to chew.

Author: darius73
Title: Good udon
Review: Went to the outlet in MyTown shopping mall. Delicious udon at reasonable prices. On par with the ones I tasted in Tokyo on a recent trip. Will definitely go for repeat visits.

Author: Berberal18Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rude & Poor attitude
Review: We have a terrible experience there. Here is the story.Me n my frens were having late dinner and I came in late. So my friend helped me to order aglio olio during the last order (about 9:30pm). I managed to sit down at the table before the food was served. This is my first time taking aglio olio with Chinese parsley which I hated it so much. Nvm. Our fault. We ordered wrong thing. So I tried to pick out the Chinese parsley as I really can’t take the smell. But I still tried my best to finish the food asap because I knew that they r closing at 10pm. I keep checking my watch times to times. At about 9:50, while I m still eating the food (just a little bit left), the boss came to stop us and said “we r closing now”! How can u said that while ur customer is still having their food? I know everyone wants to finish work by time but it is not yet 10. Eventually I need to put away my pasta n GET OUT from their shop. They r really rude n poor in attitude!

Author: kimjB7537GWPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lost Their Lust
Review: When you talk about Bah Ku Tek (BKT for short) what come to most peoples mind is this place. However, fame has gotten to their heads their prices are higher, quality has dropped and really some cost-cutting to increase profit. If you want to try real BKT this is no longer the place for it. Really sad..

Author: s12796Alice Springs, Australia
Title: Love the place
Review: For some reason, I happened to dine here for several time this year. Like any HRC around the world the setting and services are almost similar. Here in KL, the service can be consider as good. Some of the staff like Baby and Mama etc, even recognized me when walked in. Few times they messed up with the meal and they manage to recover the situation. The food somehow are consistent and within expectation. I would like to come back again in the future.

Author: Eddie T
Title: Nice Buffet Lunch
Review: Having buffet lunch with business friends prior puasa month 2016. Decent choices if foods and the India and Malayu recipes were nice and I liked it very much. The satay was good and taste originally like the satay from typical kampung melayu. Waiter is friendly but less attentive due to peak hour or shortage of workers. Environment of restaurant is good and cosy to have meal. I will bring my family to try their buffet again for the next visit yo this Hilton PJ Hotel.

Author: MarcusGB9London
Title: Superb Afternoon tea, refined, elegant and great for a special time.
Review: The best venue in KL for Afternoon tea, where you are treated with great courtesy, good manners and enjoy this special venue. A meeting with friends or business will leave a great impression, and if you treat it as such, you also will be well welcomed here.

Author: Dinieramli
Review: The food was great, ordered buttermilk chicken with rice that was tasty, and had one drink, mushroom soup and ice cream all for only rm16. Very reasonable price. And also very nice food presentation. The staff were very friendly. Keep up the good work.

Author: sauditravellerCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Worst service in my whole 23 years on this earth
Review: If you enjoy waiting long for your waiter to serve you come here. Basically came here with my friend for a quick sandwich. We already knew what we wanted as the menu is outside. We came in and were given the same menu I indicated that we were already ready and hungry. He left us and didn't come back after 10 mins the man at the door came and asked if we were ready to which I responded with yes and he simply left us again.
