I was very upset and very pissed off at this point. I waited for another minute only to find the man at the door talking to someone and laughing with him. And it was a waiter who could have taken our order. At this point I lost it and left the restaurant. I felt this was very insulting by the restaurant. This is probably the worst service I have seen till today.

Author: 428PaulHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 1st time, last time!
Review: Food was served intermittently and ended up cold. Steaks are cut too thin to cook medium or medium rare, baked potatoes are over cooked and then re-heated. Very average food that prices itself on 5 star quality - I can assure you this is not even 3 star. We will not be returning.

Author: 873simony
Title: Teddy Bear Haven
Review: Everything around here is themed with teddy bear. Lots of opportunities to snap photos. Spaghetti, toasts, burgers and chicken/lamb chops are available. Coffee, tea and fruit juices as well.

Author: sky369369
Title: Stupid and rude action boss
Review: This dim sum restaurant i visited last my vacation on 2015. Since is so early at 6am. Im hungry so i visit again this dim sum. The older boss is ok. I think the boss i mentioned is thier son is so rude and no manner. Talking so rude and attitude also. Service so lousy.scold customer. Mind problem ya.. their foreigner worker is more better attitude than this stupid boss..

Author: William J
Title: Tigers or the Food?
Review: Do people really go here for the food or is it the attraction of star  spotting? Seems fairly ordinary to me.

Author: Riitta_A_E
Title: Hyvää korealaista ruokaa
Review:
Hyvää korealaista ruokaa ystävällisesti tarjoiltuna. Annokset riittäisivät hyvin jaettaviksi. 
Very good real Korean food and a friendly staff. After dining for sure you aint hungry anymore.

Author: Y6193EEkevins
Title: Standard has dropped
Review: Since moving to the new shop lot, felt that their standard of hainanese chicken chop has dropped a little. Chicken was pre-fried and prepared, some came out not as warm. Coffee is still good.

Author: imsharad012
Title: Nothing to brag about
Review: The food is mediocre. Nothing to brag about but because the place is within KLCC, it is frequented mostly by expatriates. There are better (and less expensive) places for Indian food in KL.

Author: Jolie142014
Title: Excellent serviceScrumptious food
Review:
Celebrated my dad's birthday and was on seventh  heaven. Service was great. My opinion on best waitress is Miss Lina :)
Ambience is peaceful and nice. The  lamb was the best. 
- Jolie
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: pnairPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Yumms meal
Review: Tried the Degustation menu so I could try everything. I was not disappointed. The quantity and quality was worth my money. The server was a bit intrusive but overall service was good. They have private rooms as well for small gatherings. Toilet was clean but a bit dark. Overall a good experience. Would go again.

Author: Darron1970Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: We were looking for somewhere to eat on our first night in KL. Luckily, this excellent restaurant accepted an e-mail booking from the UK prior to our departure. They also very helpfully put our booking back an hour because of a delay. (thank you Nanthini) On top of this excellent service, the food was lovely. Very happy indeed.

Author: NLKBKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent food, terrible service
Review: Ribs are decent, tasty and well portioned but meat doesn't fall off the bone. Fried rice and noodles are large portioned but at RM18, they should be. Service was terrible though, we were told to leave after 105 mins, apparently because reservations are only valid for 90 mins. They wouldn't even allow us to order dessert.

Author: Cyberacodeca
Title: Double Standard
Review: I came here few times before. But this last visit back in November '19 was a bit disappointing. I was sat at the sushi bar with another white man at the other corner. There were few other tables occupied. Even I was seated at the sushi bar, my sushi was the last to arrive. The chef in charged,Yau was too occupied with the white man, making small talk. I figured it out that he was fishing for good review here. Conversation was only focus with the white man.Regardless with the good review, a chef should focus on all food to prepare, then fish out the reputation what so ever. I have to ask the waiter about my sushi from the server, then he start preparing when informed. I do appreciate the complimentary starter how ever that doesn't compensate the delay and double standard.

Author: fsenadaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Favorite Nasi Kandar...
Review: I can eat here like twice a week. Don't seem to get bored. Always on my list is Nasi Briyani with lamb, Fried large squid mix masala sauce. Crab is another that I would order. Simply like the spices and spiciness. Food is good and the price is reasonable. ample space for sitting and the place is always kept clean.

Author: Cheryljxx
Title: Just go there
Review:
Basic tables and brilliant food. We eat here every time we are in KL. 
There is a varied menu with lots of vegetarian options and you can get beer which isn't always an option in KL.
You won't be disappointed

Author: Halcyon_FlowersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good service, mediocre food
Review: Driving past while looking for Thistle Hotel, we were attracted by Big Food's friendly facade and ample parking.My hubby ordered beef fried rice while I had the Honey lamb chops. We also had 2 sticks each of chicken and lamb satay and a mint tea.Fried rice was ok with lots of salami and ham slices but the 4 pieces of lamb were tough as leather. If they were not so overcooked, they would have been tasty. Pity.Mint tea was super sweet tea without a hint of mint. Very surprising since there were quite a lot of mint leaves and the tea was supposed to be hot.However, the meal was slightly redeemed by the satay which was flavorful and juicy. Satay sauce was a bit too watery though. I dipped my tough lamb in to make it more palatable. Didnt want to be hungry after dinner. RM28- not worth it.Good for kids as there was a little wooden playhouse to entertain them.

Author: Skylark995Singapore, Singapore
Title: Worst Nobu outlet brings same to the name!
Review: I am a big fan of chef Matsuhisa and have visited a few of his restaurants worldwide. My recent visit to Nobu in KL has tainted my perception of the brand Nobu. The purpose of my recent visit was to celebrate a friend’s birthday and introduced Nobu to him. I have previously raved about how much I enjoyed my various visits in NYC, Dubai etc. I had only hoped I didn’t oversell Nobu to him as it’s was such a let down. For a start, it was not easy locating the restaurant that is nestled in an office town and had to transfer lifts. After tell as few security officers when asked where you are heading to, we arrived at the door of the restaurant where we had to wait to be seated by clueless staff. We sat by the windows which was too glaring and hot despite the evening sun. We also noticed many guests requested to move shortly being seated near us also by the windows. We didn’t mind it and persevered as the sun will eventually set. Some staff were not clear to what was served. I bet they know the food but couldn’t pronounce or articulate clearly. I cringed whenever the staff tries to greet a guest that walks in. The Japanese pronunciation was just wrong. I was told staff were not taught how to pronounce correctly. They merely learn from one another and could be the blind leading the blind in this case. Food was just so so. I told the manager that the garnishes for some of the hot dishes were cold. He was surprised to hear my less than average appraisal when asked by default how things were going for us. Bet he was expecting the usual good response from the non discerning. My fav black cod miso was not impressive at all. Some burnt fish skins that we had to peel and discard. The biggest bummer came from the dessert! The lava had some burnt metal shavings. We reported to the manager and he was indignant about it. Though he apologized about it, he insisted that it was not their fault. I wonder then where the metal came from? In any case, there was no attempt of business recovery. We were just given a name card of the manager as he suggested that we call him for the next visit. The question is will we be back? NO! Absolutely not after paying about 400rm for each pax and to be fed some metal shavings from God knows who other than the restaurant that served them. Nobu should just close that outlet in KL for it brought shame to a good name.

Author: Charles2794
Title: just dinner for 2
Review: would never go back steak not cooked to liking service poor and irregular served out of sequence a great dissapointment

Author: eloise883
Title: Bailey's cendol - a bomb !
Review: The bailey's cendol there are so good, although i feel that it's slightly overpriced but still worth a try. Limau perut is great, nice ambience, good service. Somewhere to go for when you're in urge of Nyonya food but don't have a huge group to share with.

Author: Jwlip026Malaysia
Title: nice place for having a party or gathering!!
Review: fantastic. no matter.food, environment or service in tip top.My most favorite food Premium English breakfast , Croissants with strawberry jam & butter that's a perfect match.Besides,Buffet menu food very special and delicious too!! i will have my meal with my family or friend again! good job!

Author: YudiS397Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: So far this is the worst I have rated
Review: Disappointment from the word go. Service was slow and staff rude. Food was just as bad with the Pho consisting of more soup than anything else. When staff was asked because one of the party didn't get their mint leaves and bean sprouts, the response was a very rude 'wait!'. In Malaysia that manners would be described as 'kurang ajar', bad manners. Would I go there again. Not even if they were the last Vietnamese restaurant before the end of the world.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Liew VKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Holy Grail Of Char Siew In KL!
Review: Being a KL boy, eating here since the 1980s where they were still based at the coffee shop together with the brothers of fish ball noodles of tong shin road.The char siew is heaven as usual. Make sure you tried it once in your lifetime.Can be pricy for KL price now but still wht is not pricy nowadays i KL?And

Author: Rae LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average experience
Review: We had to wait about an hour for a table. They don't accept bookings. Make sure you bring mosquito repellent as there are a lot of mosquitoes coming out to play as it gets dark. Food was not bad. Menu was not extensive, but adequate. Waiters were attentive, but since the space is small and tables were limited, we didn't feel nice lingering over our meal while so many others were waiting for a table. For a quick, expensive meal, this is a good option. But if you'd like to take your time, better to look elsewhere.

Author: STTan1221
Title: Splendid sunset views
Review: Our second time dine in at the Beach Grill.It is located by the seashore and surrounded by the green. While drinking and eating at the golden hour,I witnessed splendid sunset views. The fine dining food served were so delicious, compliment to the chef. The restaurant do provide vegan delights, make the choice more varieties.The staffs here are so friendly, from we stepped in the main entrance, were being served warmth and generous reception.Especially Ms Sharifah, she served us twice on our visits. She's knowledgeable and helpful ,we are so pleased with her service.

Author: Eddie L
Title: great place for Chinese and seafood specialties
Review:
fast and friendly service. food is great. value-for-money.
we left behind a parcel and pick it up the next day without and issues.
good parking spaces available. the temperature is suitable for dining without air-conditioning.

Author: meaningremission
Title: Wasn't as before
Review: This used to be a favorite meeting place, however, the quality and selection of food has dropped, hence major improvement is needed.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: THE BEST homemade salted butter caramel sauce in Langkawi!
Review: My favourite dessert place in Langkawi! The crepes here are superb, and the sauces are delicious. So delicious, in fact, that my friend couldn't bear to leave the melted puddle of ice-cream and sauce on her plate, and slurped it all up with a straw! My favourites here are the {mushroom, sour cream, cheese + extra onions} galette (or as they call them, salty pancakes) and the salted butter caramel crepe with a scoop (or two) of coconut ice-cream. Sometimes, with extra caramel. Divine! And the {caramel, nutella, ice-cream & strawberries} combo is positively sinful, but so good you really don't care!Also, above and beyond the crepes and galettes, the awesome service we receive from Soumia & Vincent (and their staff!) is always par excellence, no matter how busy their creperie is, or the time of the day. We once made a stop at MY French Factory for a last hurrah before getting on our evening flights, only to find out the caramel sauce had been sold out for the day. Instead of disappointing us, Soumia asked if we could wait 15 minutes, made more caramel sauce on the spot, and made VERY happy customers of all of us. THAT's what I call service, and business owners who really care about their customers! I'm a fan for life. :)As mentioned by a few reviewers, the creperie is indeed small. However, I'd recommend that you visit just as they open at noon, or between 3pm-6pm, when the crowds aren't at their peak, to avoid the seating issues. Also, if you happen to be driving, I recommend that you park at the Cenang Mall next door, or at the Baron Hotel's parking lot. Also as mentioned by a few others, the place isn't exactly somewhere you go for cheap eats. Depending on your "base" and add-ons, it can come up to about RM25 for crepe + a drink, but I've always felt the price was more than justified, in terms of food quality and absolute satisfaction. :D

Author: Jean KGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Not like it used to be
Review: We were very disappointed. The waiter was over attentive and wouldn't leave us alone. We were charged £8 a glass of wine when it was pointed out that it was two for the price of one, but not warned that they had to be the same colour. The food was average but expensive. The videos were mostly of modern pop, not what we expected, and far too explicit and violent for our taste. Not the place to take children, though there were some. Shan't be going again.

Author: Jp D
Title: wide international food varieties
Review: as mentioned in my general review, food varied and flavorful but could clearly do with a few degrees warmer

Author: OurPerspectiveNewbury, United Kingdom
Title: KL has much better to offer
Review: Do the trip up the tower, just don't visit for dinner. KL has 000's of amazing places to have dinner, but this isn't one of them. We don't regret visiting A360, as its OK, but we do regret not visiting somewhere else that night given how good the rest of our KL trip had been.

Author: elmiza
Title: Not for second time
Review: Bad food and bad service. I would not come for the second time. One is enough. Not recommended. Brought my family who came from KL to have our dinner here  but unfortunately the food was terrible.

Author: thedonbk
Title: Good presentation
Review: Good food. However there’s too much of beef based food compared to anything else. This left least options for the non beef eaters.

Author: peishuanjacqJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Very Disappointed with Everything
Review: Please take some time to read what I posted in their FB account. The ehole ordeal was really upsetting and what really puts us off as consumers are the lack of interest the owner himself puts in his business. People need to understand what really means to run a food and service base industry and not just sit on the issue and let things go worse

Author: milespierceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: A recommended restaurant. Great location and very busy and atmospheric. We ordered food and bottle of wine ( not available by the glass ). 4 dishes ordered but only 2 arrived after an hour. Complained to 3 separate members of staff and eventually the manageress. They accepted that it was a mix up but no sense of an apology for messing up our evening. We eventually paid most of the bill, reluctantly. The food we got was good. Our complaint was the total lack of remorse for their very poor service and the attitude of the manageress.

Author: QuatoKuatoSingapore
Title: #1 restarant in Melaka, but.....
Review: Easily the best meal i had in Melaka! Pricing was affordable. Food was nice. Portion were really big! The only downside is that, we ordered their signature crab dish for just the 2 of us. They prepared 2 large crabs! It was totally unnecessary as they should know the 2 of us definitely wont be able to finish sure a large serving. The crabs are 2 times the price of all other dishes i ordered, combined.if there is only 2 diners, please just cook 1 crab.

Author: kirsi_nessu
Title: Stunning food.
Review: Stunning food. I am happy for recommended dishes and awesome service. Spices were adjusted based on our liking and it was a spot on!

Author: jayden1988Singapore, Singapore
Title: Satisfactory
Review: Had a dinner with my gf for her birthday celebration, food was good and satisfying. Waiter and waitress (Martin and cho) were so friendly, good atmosphere, nothing more can I ask.

Author: rebeccakX3650KESydney, Australia
Title: Spectacular service and delicious food!
Review: Delicious bibambap, I’ve never had it before so it was a great first experience for me. The service was impeccable, it started with a yummy refreshing shot of some kind of fruit that takes over a year to grow before harvest! The waiter gave us an overview of all the dishes that are native to Korea and recommended. Just as we were finishing up about to pay our bill our waiter emerged with a delicious scoop of ice cream on the house. Such a delightful experience, we’re going back tonight to try another dish.

Author: Nie Ching T
Title: Their burnt cheese cake is not the best in town
Review: Very crowded. So should make reservations before going esp if you go in big group. I tried their burnt cheese, but I would not say it is one of the best in town.

Author: Sammy_2812
Title: Latest Recipe
Review: They have the best teh tarik, great and friendly staffs with wide selection of foods. In my favourite list definitely!

Author: miche71
Title: I find Delicious terribly overrated. I...
Review: I find Delicious terribly overrated. I have never had a meal that I've enjoyed there. I truly don't get it.

Author: youke_worldwideSingapore
Title: Good service. Competent food
Review: So we got a nice place and service was good - even though it was a room we always had the service desired. Food was expensive but okay. Didn't like the way they had done the escargot. Stuffed pigeon was competent but not memorable。

Author: simonj555
Title: Best Shawarmas in Malaysia
Review: Found them on Uber eats. Hands down one of the best hummus & Shawarma I have ever hand in malaysia. Their garlic sauce is to die for!!

Author: georgiovalentinoHyderabad, India
Title: Awesome Pork Xiao Long Bao
Review: This Taiwanese restaurant is located on the Ground floor of the Gardens Mall in the Mid Valley city area. I visited it to try their most famous dish "Pork Xiao Long Bao" and I had a great experience. Normally there is a huge queue outside it but luckily for me I did not have to wait much as I went in the evening time.I ordered a Pork Xiao Long Bao and Steamed Pork & Shrimp Shaomai and both the dishes were really good. It cost me around 35 Ringgit for both the dishes so it was not that expensive either. The Service was quick and the decor of the place was very nice.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: KHSim9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First visit
Review: Didn't know about this place,recommended by my son.Price is ok,service is good .More of fusion Japanese.We choose abalone set and 2 Japanese sets.Choose a Dassai50 sake on promotion at RM280, about twice retail price, still ok to us.Not expensive but if you prefer Japanese omakase,then it is not for you.

Author: KokomuKuching, Malaysia
Title: A place to drink rather than eat
Review: Food quality is definitely terrible, small portion and not cheap. Service is very bad. Had to stand and wave to get the attention of waiters. Definitely not enough waiters. Not a good place to bring families to. The only thing good are the alcoholic drinks. Would say well stock bar.

Author: shima2227Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: delivery food👍🏻👍🏻
Review: tq to mr tejah,chef sam and mr tilek for helping me to order delivery food from makan kitchen.the food was very good taste and the price also not so expensive.i order prawn massala butter milk,rendang ayam sulawesi and pecal jawa simpang empat.and tq to danial for cod our food infront door.your guys service was excellent good job.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: biscottisueKuala Lumpur
Title: It wasn't great when I went to the one at Mont Kiara. It is still isn't great now. What a shame. The stars are to be...
Review: It wasn't great when I went to the one at Mont Kiara. It is still isn't great now. What a shame. The stars are to be shared for friendly service, its papaya salad and beef green curry. The royal tom yam goong was so appallingly bad. Even the level 2 and 4 food courts at Suria KLCC can make better tom yam!

Author: dino1963Singapore
Title: Yummy yummy
Review: Went to Melaka last week with my sis & family. She found this place from friends and must say its is very crowded. We had to wait 15 mins for a table and 45 mins for the food to arrive. We wanted to order the cheese steamboat but had run out, but we tried the milk crab and was super, as well as the salted egg clay fish. There were 7 of us and cost about $190.

Author: 634denzelcJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced and stingy !!!
Review: I have to this restaurant several time and this time round really make me to comment on TripAdvisor about their service. The food I took was only 1 vege + 1 chicken + fried egg , my friend took 1 vege + 1 fish with sambal + fried egg. Both off us took warm water since we eating rice, at the shock of my life when the counter guy told me is RM32!!!!! The stingy part is the people who is serving customer as they only putting little bit of vege and that when you ask for more they charge twice. I receive feedback from my family and friends that this is what happening in this restaurant. It proved when happen to me too.The waiter at the restaurant do not know how to smile, the way they serve customer like we owe them money. The service really worst than mamak shop. Hope there will be another competitor will take over this shop. I will never return to this shop again!

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Waited 20 minutes for table while first seating guests chatted idly
Review: I dread eating standard Chinese New Year reunion food so we ended up with Peranakan for reunion where it was less crowded and food was not production line.It would have been perfect if I did not have to wait 20 minutes for my table while the guests from the first seating sat around chatting and the restaurant staff did not encourage them politely to leave, until I broached it.

Author: Thomas FCopenhagen
Title: Great sushi, terrible service
Review: We ordered a Omakase (Chefs selection) for 4, consisting of a sashimi course and a sushi courseWe got a great sashimi course for 4, but when it was time for the sushi they only delivered sushi for 2. We asked if this was a mistake, but they told us they only wanted to give sushi for 2, so we could try more things? (There were a total of 5 pieces 2 each)We told them that was not acceptable, we ordered and paid for 4, and this was clearly meant for 2. They then offered to take the sushi back, pick off 5 pieces and replace them so there were 12 pieces, 3 types with 4We found this extremely disgusting, as we had already eaten from the plate, and they wanted to take back sushi to serve to other Terrible service, felt cheated. By far the most surreal experience I've ever had in a restaurant. We ended up refusing to pay.The sushi was OK, but I same price and not as good as Nobu

Author: leonsrao
Title: Busy restaurant
Review: Very crowded all day and many food u can choose like chicken. Located at mytown shopping centre is very recommended.

Author: TheTrueOriginal
Title: Disappointed
Review: Quick meal in between rounds around legoland!! This place has little to do with thai food! Seriously over-priced - prepared with no heart' first truly bad meal on this trip!!

Author: niikiiiicnn
Title: Need improvement
Review: Basically most of the food i saw on the menu was duck!I love duck meat !I had their duck salad it was nice but come on such a small portion and with such little meat! For that price!Lucky I had a late lunch My friends enjoyed their food so that was ok!But the food tasted good overall

Author: Gun55Martham, United Kingdom
Title: Noisy
Review: Been traveling around for 6 wks fancied a change from noodles curry rice etcBurger & frys sounded good excellent awe bit noisy but well worth a visit good for families made very welcome

Author: EvenJoHelsinki, Finland
Title: The arrogant saleswoman ruined it
Review: We were about to do some shopping at the small, inconspicuously situated Harrod's shop adjacent to the cafe, and then sit down for a coffee, but the complete arrogance and impoliteness of the saleswoman at the shop side convinced us otherwise. We were dressed in clean, smart, culture sensitive clothes for the type of weather that prevails in Malaysia in June. The saleswoman look a long look at us from head to toe and the first thing she said "you must be looking for the discount shelf, it's over there". People, remember go in wearing only your Prada, Louis Vuitton and Hermés, because anything less than that just isn't good enough!

Author: 25markd
Title: Poor service and average food
Review:
The level of service here was poor. The staff had attitude and appeared uninterested in what we wanted.

The food was very average, and was not fresh.

A nice location for an 'after work' drink, but nothing more.  Disappointing.

Author: MsL431971
Title: Change the menu
Review: I've never particularly liked the menu but my son insisted we come in for a bite. Service still lacking charm. Some waiters looked scruffy. And please! Benjamin Yong if you are reading this, have you tried sitting on the banquette seats?? It has sunken so badly. Please replace.

Author: tpLong
Title: Service
Review: We chosen this restaurant due to the food remain good standard and it serves vegetarian food as well.  However, the services need to be improved.  The staff who answered our reservation and the taking our order were not showing his/her hospitality and friendliness.

Author: kmquekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Peranakan food!
Review: Fantastic Peranakan food! Really delicious and has a distinct class to the way it is prepared. Servings are tapas like in smaller portions but the quality is good and a little like fine dining. We throughly enjoyed eating here and will come back again. Tal and her team have good service.

Author: NeeShenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great service, pretty busy at night.
Review: This outlet is pretty packed when I was there. Surveyed TGIF just across and it is pretty empty, which means this place has to be good. Service was fast once we got a seat. If you go in small parties, you should not have any problems getting seats. Food was up to standard of what I expect from Chili's. The staff does not rush us out once we are done and kept refilling our drinks although we had stayed there for a while.

Author: kefaloveJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice restaurant, ok food.
Review: The restaurant style like the one that you saw at Kungfu film. Very nice & cozy. We love to see it, meanwhile the food is kinda funny to see the riceball. I found out singapore chicken rice is still more delicious, KL Bukit bintang chicken is better also. But come to eat here, you won't dissppoint anyway. 2 ppl (1 plates of chicken, 1 plates of rice ball & a vegetables) costs RM 16.

Author: Lobsterlyy
Title: Great Atmosphere & Drinks
Review: Ordered the Big Moano & Perhentian Swing - drinks came perfect! Cozy place, good music . A hidden gem within the busy streets

Author: ramses2ndKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Astonishing variety of food and endless champagne
Review: Sunday lunch buffet.At over RM500 each, it’s not cheap, but the variety of food is amazing. You can’t get close to sampling everything, so some planning is needed when you first survey the vast array of dishes. The calamari weren’t great, but everything else we tried was delicious, from sushi, fresh crab and oysters through salads, casseroles and chicken kebabs. The desert counter is pretty spectacular too. It’s a lot cheaper if you forego the champagne but that would be a shame as it really is free flow. Before your glass is even empty a waitress is on hand to top you up.A great treat for special occasions.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: Bala KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service and hygiene
Review: We have been to Aliyaa twice prior to this uneventful day. After reading the various reviews, we a family of 8 wanted to enjoy the various Sri Lankan dishes that has been widely promoted via various online sites.However, after ordering our food, we were shocked beyond belief that the "papadam" that was served was mixed with left over papadam from what was served to other customers. It was stale and tasted bad. We highlighted this to the staff and management who admitted this as an oversight. So, imagine how many other customers were served a mixture of fresh and left over papadams. We were appalled that we had to eat left over papadams.In addition to the "chicken varuval" served was not freshly cooked as it was served lukewarm. When the staff was questioned, the waiter admitted that the dish was cooked for lunch and it was merely warmed to be served during dinner.Based on the above two, this is unbecoming of a well known restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. It is unacceptable for the staff to give excuses that they were busy and this was an oversight.If this is the standard Aliyaa maintains, this should be rated as the most disgusting restaurant in Kuala Lumpur under the guise of good food and service.I sincerely hope that the owners takes note of this and rectify this very uneventful dining experience.

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Sorry it is not the same anymore
Review: I had not been back to Oribe since Chef Ori left. After a long sojourn, I decided to go back for some good sushi memories and booked a seat at the counter. We ordered the Iga set at RM228 for 8 sushi. In short, overall it was not the same as i remembered and the fish portion for each sushi was cut rather small. Therefore the price is really not worth it for the meal as there are really better sushi counters in KL that serves better cut and quality. Unfortunately i have to bid Bye Bye to Sushi Oribe.

Author: Richard_Heng
Title: Surprise find!
Review:
Near to our Senai factory, a nice place for happy hours, gatherings.

You can get proper meals, fingers food, beers, fun, darts in one location

Personally I like the BBQ pork. 

Staffs are very friendly, good service and always attentive

Author: 548SamKPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Unexpected Good Foods
Review: This is restaurant was converted from a bungalow so there are plenty space for parking. The interior is cosy & comfortable. We ordered some pasta, fish & chips & grilled chicken and Sirloin Steak. All are really delicious & tasty. I can't imagine in Ipoh can find such fine dining restaurant. And their dessert are really good too, especially the Tiramisu very moist & tasty. And next time I will come for their Hi-Tea as well.

Author: Norli85Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quite tasty and reasonable priced
Review: Ate here several times with my in laws. The food here was quite tasty. My favorite was the rich and succulent Mandi lamb. Also, service was good and fast despite the weekend crowds. Only setback is that there are very limited parking spaces and heavy traffic main road. The place can get extremely crowded during dinner so I suggest coming earlier.

Author: noahl401
Title: Cozy dining place
Review: Cozy dining place but a pricey. Would be a great place if the prices are 30% lower. However ambience and service is good...

Author: Selina7155Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very poor service
Review: We came here in a group of four and order our food and drinks. We have to wait so long and our order were not done properly, we were served what we did not order, when we complained, the order just keep hanging and finally we get out of the place with our stomach full of grumble. We have wasted so much time here but in the end need to to look for another restaurant.

Author: aarbainMalaysia
Title: Good live seafood
Review: I was told by friends that the place is expensive by Miri standards. Indeed there were a few business dinners going on (at a more relaxed atmosphere vs fine dining)Dinner comprised of live seafood. We had:Crabs (2 pcs) with salted egg (a little bit dry to my taste)Boiled prawns (1/2 kilo for the 2 of us)Tilapia fish, steamed nyonya styleMidin for vegetables (cooked with a hint of kerabu style I think)Including drinks (3 rasa/taste), the bill came up to RM150 which is reasonable considering the live items we ate.In terms of location, it is a bit out of the way. Taxi from Marriott costs RM30 (1 way). That might put off casula tourist who do not have their own transport.

Author: askov614
Title: Really bad service
Review: Ordered Araina Chicken, got lamb and the waiter was arguing with us that we ordered lamb, sure 3 of us were wrong.  Olives were good and the mix grill was ok, expensive for sure and will not come again, good luck what you get.

Author: VananKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: food okay, bad service
Review: i visited hyderabad restaurant in bangi for dinner with family. our main aim is taste pure briyani from india. briyani is one of my favourite food so we went there to try the best from hyderabad. The environment of the restaurant is very cool but the food and services does not meet my expectation. the food served cold, nan bread is hard, one of the order was not served at all. The services are terribly slow and it took more than 30 minutes for them to serve the drinks and food. the briyani is just ok, their drinks are good, other than that i don't really feel the taste of indian cuisine in this restaurant. there are much more better briyani restaurant than hyderabad recipe's.

Author: Hannah C
Title: Incredibly rude
Review: I came here to have a coffee, when I advised what I assume was the owner I would not be buying food and would finish my coffee and go he snatched the menus off our table and asked me to leave as it was for customers only then turned his back on me straight away ignoring my questions about finishing my coffee. I am guessing he did not even bother to look at the table or listen to what I had said to notice that I had already purchased something. I had to ask the waitress who was lovely to please allow me to stay till I had finished my latte. When he was told I had a coffee he just said oh sorry and walked off again. Incredibly rude service.

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Upset stomach
Review: We had a meeting package at Westin and our 3 course sit-down lunch was arranged at the Prego. Not certain whether it was at this place or the breakfast buffer at Living Room but 5 out of 18 people had a bad stomach 4 hours post-lunch. Mine was bad and the affect was carried forward till today, 24 hours later and had to made frequent visits to the toilet too.

Author: Anbalagan MMalaysia
Title: Tasteless Biryani
Review: We took our guests to Sagar Restaurant for the first time after seeing this restaurant every time we pass through by the look and of course from the all the review from Tripadvisory that their food and service is excellent. We have ordered 2 different Biryani and both tasteless. Its more like you pour some gravy into Biryani rice instead. Y However, no doubt that their "Naan" selection is good and tasty and the workers are very friendly.

Author: Chris_OrleansKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disgusting and quite expensive
Review: The products at IKEA become more and more expensive while quality is dramatically dropping. Such disappointments always either food or stuffs. I was a regular customer from the 90s in France now in Asia. It s too bad. I even bought glasses pack of 4 at 1.5 euro / unit not that cheap but can't have cheaper in shop. After one 1 week two broken, after 3 weeks three broken. when will I say goodbye to the last one ?

Author: Paul B
Title: A lovely restaurant
Review: We visited Penang for the first time spending 8 days there. We read about Andrew’s Kampung and wanted to try it. It’s not the easiest place to find but what a lovely place. Andrew welcomes you and you choose where to sit. The menu is not huge but that’s a good thing. The food was excellent in particular my green curry the second time we went there. As we left Andrew took a photo for his photo board.

Author: mozilla_monsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Go for the views ...
Review: This place is great for its views, being right next to the Twin Towers you will find the view to be one of the best in KL.Service is competent, not great, while food is average - won't disappoint, but doesn't wow as well.If you're up for a party or a good time, and really just want one of the best rooftop views of KL, this is the place to be. Don't go if you're after great food.

Author: mrvarSouth Australia, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Decided to go here for lunch due to the recommendations and proximity to my hotel. There's were about 6 to 8 staff, one table occupied outside. I was not greeted by any staff, when I paid and left I was not thanked. The only time I received any interaction was when I ordered (which took some time to be noticed), to which a stoic young man nodded and walked off. Took about 25mins to receive the blue cheese burger, at which stage the only partially warm part of the burger was the meat. I like blue cheese, but this was overkill - couldn't taste the burger over it. The mustard bottle (yellow) had tomato sauce in it, the tomato sauce gone (red) contained sweet chilli sauce. No mustard in sight. Fries were only just warm. Swing and a miss...

Author: pipped_upKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: How is this “the best”
Review: 1125 and I am a vegan. My friend is starving so wants the full breakfast and I can’t order off the pm menu that starts in 35 minutes as it’s “a very strict policy”. Sorry, but in this day in age you will lose customers very quickly if you can’t be adaptable. My friend didn’t like her plastic food and I just had a coffee and juice. When asked at 12 if I’d like something now I said “no thanks” and got a sarcastic smile. Good luck with your business plan. Avoid! Go to common man roasters instead!

Author: KirRoyaleSoo
Title: Cheap and fresh seafood
Review: Very good price. We had prawns, fish, squids, chicken and fried rice.  Price Less than RM100. Saw a lot of regular customers. Service is quick but have to wait a bit longer for food because the restaurant always full.  Must try, strongly recommend.

Author: 482ashisha
Title: Worst Customer Service-Arrogant-Never Go Place
Review: This is a worst place . They are only interested to serve bulk orders. If you walkin they will treat you arrogantly. This happens 2nd time. First time we reached before their group arrived so they took order but we struggled like any thing Food was average .

Author: happy_tarazSingapore, Singapore
Title: Restaurant Needs A Service Overhaul!
Review: Dim sum is not up to par! Change of cook change of taste I guess! Herbal jelly served with Honey not on the side. Check with the in charge and he said this is how they serve it. Which is definitely not the case since this is my favourite everytime i come here i will order this dessert.I have been to this place so many times till today the service level dropped to non existence! Worst in charge called Jonathan! When i queried him why the service is so poor! He was quiet did not apologise.I requested for dried prawn chilli before the meal was even serve, those chilli showed uo 1/2 way through the meal.I thought this Restaurant used to be good till it became a joke!Waiters are all Malays who don’t understand Chinese. Not only that when i ask how is the is the fried rice their answer is I don’t know never tried!They are not even familiar with the selection on the menu ordered.The food took such a long time to serve despite the fact the restaurant isn’t full! In essence as Marriott Platinum member who turn up here at the hotel on monthly basis this is worst meal!

Author: EdCoClareWestern Ireland, Ireland
Title: Super food
Review: Had the pleasure of eating here twice during our stay. It has an amazing variety of Aisan, Malaysian and Western dishes with wonderful desserts to follow. Staff are extremely attentive and could not be faulted. This restaurant is a must - but make sure your hungry so you cannot all courses!!

Author: Nicole T
Title: Sarawak local delicacy.
Review: Quite fascinated with the interior design. The foods here are quite nice however the portions of food are rather small.

Author: TheMohawkSingapore
Title: Outstanding vegetarian dinner in beautiful Peranakan house
Review:
One of the best vegetarian meals that I have had. Stunning texture and tastes.

Lovely range of wines too, unusual for Malaysia.

Great service too with a smile.

Beautiful peranakan house/hotel.

Faultless.

Author: redbagjourney
Title: Nice Place, Food just OK
Review: The place is just nice for dinner after work with your colleagues. The food for me just OK, it wasn't that great. It can be very crowded, so better if you reserve it first.

Author: Nishan SSydney, Australia
Title: I pity the fool!
Review: I use Mr T's catch phrase very loosely here, in that my blind waiter felt sorry for me because I was dining alone. At one point towards the end he said "you're having a lonely dinner". Had he not been blind and so pleasant to deal with, I may have taken offence. I think it is better to dine alone, you not only rest your eyes but also your mouth - in terms of speaking that is. Just listen to what is going on around you from other people's conversations (and many nationalities were represented tonight from Americans to Europeans).I found that I recognised most of the tastes in the food I had but for the life of me could not connect the dots to most dishes and thus got most of my guesses wrong!It made me realise how visual food was for me and when sight was removed I struggled to identify the food even though my tastebuds were familiar to it.What an amazing experience! Once you lock your smartphone away outside, you really are on your own! So if you can't handle that then bring a friend.

Author: tyliew333
Title: Over priced for average food
Review: The food here is way too much overpriced. I order a root beer for like RM 7.99 but only to receive a sugary drink with no CO2 already. Obviously you have open the roof beer and put looong enough in fridge. Come on, you could just buy a can of root beer from hypermarket for RM 2 and serve for customer, still you could make 300% profit from drink. Next is the portion of food that cost RM25++ but only serve for kid. Each piece of chicken cutlet cost me RM 4. This is one-time-visit restaurant which I could never come back.

Author: Rui S
Title: Very good chinese food in a excellent surrounding
Review:
We had several courses including a New Year salad with very long red chopsticks, the food was very good and the presentation impecable, I never thought I would find tofu so delicious!
Service was excellent, recommended for a top end chinese experience.

Author: churrinetKuching, Malaysia
Title: Spciy Thai Cuisine
Review: This restaurant which is located on the 2nd Floor of Komtar JBCC in Johor Baru offers a varierty of Thai cuisine, both spicy and normal. Ample space for big groups. Took Chicken Tom Yum Noodle, which is spicy, bit of sweetness and also sour. Recommed for dinner looking for spicy Thai Cuisine in Johor Bahru

Author: Jackylam
Title: Salted Chicken in Ipoh
Review: One of the popular and famous local food in Ipoh, delicious but the price are reasonable. it is something special souvenir for your friend.

Author: SeanHongYewZinTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Not worth the trip
Review: Give it a miss, there are lots of dim sum restaurant in Ipoh. This one is not worth the visit, should have known from the half empty dining hall, not a good sign for a Sunday morning.

Author: singlish_sgSingapore, Singapore
Title: ENCHANTING CHINESE FOOD!
Review: Excellent staff who recommended me exactly what my family wanted to try! I'm not a fan of the Chinese food served here, but my family members were blown away by the unique presentations of each dish, I will define Chynna like having a meal at a Five-Star-Michelin-eatery, minus the expensive price tag!

Author: Rebecca072013
Title: More mayonaise than fish
Review: Not a lot of upside to this place, aside from cheap prices. Portions are small, and rolls are drenched in maryonaise. I hade to use my chopstick to scrape off a few tablespoons before it was even edible, and still all I tasted was maryonaise.

Author: debbielee73Singapore
Title: Super long wait!
Review: I went in to carambao today after walking past the place. The ambience was rather uncommon so felt like in a resort place with some tatami style seating. omg.... the waiter rushed us to make our order looking seriously impatient! After ordering we waited 50 mins.. our food never came only our fresh coconut came. My partner went into the kitchen n found they hvnt even started on our 3 dishes. We walked out exactly 1 hr later n still had to pay for the coconut ++ 6% service!!! will never return to this place. The least they could do was to ask us if we mind waiting for our meal and we would decide to stay or not!! Terrible!!

Author: NeeShen
Title: Hidden gem in kuching
Review: The platter has a good variety of food for everyone, young and old. The shank is fork tender but remember to order in advance. Great place for family celebration.

Author: Maklong_marhazlinda
Title: Breakfast at paya serai
Review: Excellent! We're very happy with the service! Thank you very much, keep it up! To Kalpana, Linda, Irma, Rizal, Teja, Jega, Rohini, Mus, INA, Shamsul, thank you for the good service! <3

Author: Leonard S
Title: Location, that's it.
Review: One thing great about this cafe is the location. It's right at the edge of Malacca River. It's nice to hang out, and sit chillin' at this cafe. But the foods are not that great, even drinks are quite pricy.

Author: Wstxxx
Title: Be Cautious
Review: Overall experience was very poor.Upon arrival the waitress was trying to push us to buy drinks (I.e coconut water, beer, etc.). She shamelessly stood there until we finally ordered coconut water. Next she pushed us to order more than we could eat (seafood) even though we checked multiple times if it was too much for a party of 3X. At the end of the day the price we paid that night was about the same we would have paid in a nice fancy restaurant (rather than a restaurant next to an airport).If you were to go there please be present when they choose your seafood and check when they weigh it. On a positive note the seafood was fresh. No different from any restaurant that have life seafood.

Author: 309pesadillaa
Title: Pesadilla Argentina
Review: Very good japanese Restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. The Shashimi excellent. The Sushi not as much. The service very good. Salad I think it was complementary very good.  The wine list poor. Excellent the Whisky selection. Its worth a visit for the Shashimi and Whisky.

Author: sunilp70Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Don’t order food to pickup by cash
Review: I ordered food to pickup on the way to airport by calling them directly , gave them a time after half hour to keep ready. But looks like they started to prepare only after I got there, was delayed by 25 mins waiting for them to get the order ready, the person who took the didn’t seem to care... shrugged away my complaint, should have been apologetic as I was quite tensed up due to the delay. The food is ok., tastes like the Punjabi food available in Mumbai.

Author: LizashahrulJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Food!!! From a chef point of view
Review: Taste: 5 starsLots of varieties. Tasted most of it and I have to say, its worth every single cents you pay. They have a Chef from China to make fresh noodle at the counter. The noodle is super super silky and the broth is so tasty!!!Service: 5 starsWas greeted by the Manager Mr Samsyeir when we came at 5.30pm. He wrote our name and hp nimber in the guests list as the restaurant will only start serving dinner at 6.30pm. At 6.25 he personally walk to us (we were at the lobby lounge having tea) and lead us to the restaurant. He was smiley and his words was soft and courteous. He showed us around the restaurant and recommended some of his favorite food. We were also attended by other staff like Stephen who had continuously fill up our water. We were so happy with their tiptop service. Congratulation Hilton! Ambiance : 5 starsMusic was not too loud. They play soothing top 40s music. Seats were comfortable and diatance between each table is not crampy.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Zillione
Title: Worst customer service ever! Business owner extremely inconsiderate.
Review: They let people queue for hours and after have a seat, have to wait for another hour! Our whole night plan ruin for wasting time stand and wait for the normal food!ITS SO HOT AND NEED TO STAND FOR QUEUE FOR 3 HOURS! They said no matter u are pregnant or old folks also have to wait! They should let customer know the actual waiting time and care for customers. Not feeling proud for let their customers stand and wait!

Author: Swee Hiang PPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Vegetarian Chee Cheong Fun without Fun
Review: Delighted to see vegetarian chee cheong fun, Hong Kong style, on the menu? Wait, there is no fun at all. What you get is chee cheong fun "kosong", literary means empty. It is plain rice fluor rolls without any filling. One would have expected some filling of mushroom at the very least. However, the number of rolls is double what you get if you order pork, shrimp, or mixed chee cheong fun. So you would walk away feeling full, though no fun!
Restaurant: Restoran Jin Xuan Hong Kong "Kuchai Lama"

Author: KayneLeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A quick lunch
Review: Having a quick lunch here with my friends. She ordered the nasi goreng set while I choose my own dishes near the counter. For my food, I've chosen a gulai and two kinds of vegetables. The gulai was too sweet to my likings but the vegetables were okay, not very tasty but okay. My friend liked her nasi goreng set which served with the salted terubok fish. The set was quite big for the price paid. However, she was saying that her teh c special is not sweet at all, but to me, it's totally fine as I normally request for less sweet beverages. So, if one prefer beverages more "kaw" or thicker, you may need to ask for it. The price is quite reasonable. So, worth a try if one wants a normal halal local meal.

Author: elsiekLondon
Title: Nothing special
Review: This is more restaurant than cafe and is perfectly placed in Armenien Street when out on your tour of China Town. Western food at Western prices. Very expensive given that normally Penang food costs very little. The food was OK but nothing really to get excited about. The crispy pork baguette was soggy and smoked with no crispy at all. The pitta bread around the tuna mix was stale & very hard. The beef stroganoff with mashed potato was about the best. All variety of Western beers, wines & cocktails are available but again at a price. Service was very slow. Our quick lunch dragged on for ever. Look out for local food halls for an authentic reasonably priced alternative

Author: Anonymous855Trabuco Canyon, California
Title: Dullest Hard Rock I've been to in the world
Review: Easy to find, small, and has the menu but outside of that.... It has some requisite memorabilia and small screens of videos in a small square room. No unique elements, no enthusiasm. Stay away from the chocolate milkshake, more chocolate is not always the best way to make one. We had to pick up a shirt for a collector or we wouldn't have come. Skip it unless you can't live without a decent hamburger.

Author: charlesf16
Title: A nice place in Batu Ferringi
Review: A nice place to have a coffee , lightmeal or more..A plesant ambiance..Ben and Ami are great hosts...Well worth a visit.

Author: GanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasteful interior
Review: Located at the Kwai Chai Hong of Kuala Lumpur Chinatown. The interior decoration is tasteful with red lanterns and striking murals on the wall. Beautiful portraits of sophisticated ladies. The place looks flirtatious and funky. We tried the charred lettuce and the keropok nachos. Our drink was Yuzu spritz

Author: johnlB6486YD
Title: Closed for business
Review:
The place been closed for a good 3 Years... Moved to nearby Jalan Alor but unfortunately wasn't successful. 

If u miss their char Siew, the son opened an outlet in Shah Alam

Author: SunL348
Title: Service with an attitude
Review: We have frequented this restaurant many times especially taking our overseas friends to try their famous char siew and crab dishes. Last night, we were served by an arrogant man, supposedly the front of house who acted like we were begging to try their food. Speaking to us as if we were first time diners, not knowing what sizes of dishes were right for our table, and was impatient to take our orders, basically made you feel like we owe him to be there. Food was not as nice last night and we feel the standard is dropping after every visit. Just want to remind the restaurant owner, with a manager/front of house taking orders with such attitude and staff telling you you they don’t refill hot water for our tea and just ignore you when they walk past - you have lost 7 customers who will not return nor recommend anymore new customers. We are sure we are not the only ones leaving with that feeling.

Author: irissnauwaertDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Delicious Japanese food: fresh, fast and very tasty
Review: While being on a business trip in Malaysia, I almost dined every evening at Sakura Fuji. My favourite is their sashimi and tempura dinner set. The fish is fresh and the side dishes are great.Very friendly staff.Would recommend to anyone enjoying some good Japanese food.

Author: Ashley O
Title: Worst Food and Service Ever !
Review: Horrible food, extremely slow service, totally not up to Hilton's standard. WILL NEVER RETURN OR RECOMMEND TO ANYONE !

Author: terencel988
Title: Left with empty stomachs and empty wallets
Review: In short, our experience was a disappointment. Food was average (yet the website 'boasts' otherwise), service was appalling and the price was extremely steep. Unfortunately, it fell incredibly short of our expectations to such an extent that our party had to dine elsewhere after.Two stars for attempting to innovate.

Author: christinecY5166CAKamakura, Japan
Title: Disappointed
Review: The new concept is very nice and exciting. However, the price is pretty high with a very common little portion seafood. The seafood were not really extremely fresh or nice, No surprise at all. The same value can spent at a very nice and high end seafood restaurant, I.e. Not worth to pay a visit.

Author: Tan M
Title: Good Teochew Food
Review: Have visited this restaurant three times and have never been disappointed. Must try the steam promfret fish and the Ngoh-Hiang. The place is always packed so advance reservation is highly recommended.

Author: TravelerDZ TOran, Algeria
Title: What is Mexican about their food!?
Review: Ive been to fresca with my husband who is Texan and has traveled a lot and have experienced the authentic Mexican food. We decided to try Mexican food in KL and have found fresca as a potential good place for that.Over priced Tacos Dorados, very small pieces, wheat flout tortillas which is not what we ordered as my husband has a gluten allergy and the topping was so disappointing. we also ordered Pico de Gallo and corn chips. Those who have experience with Mexican food who expect pico de gallo to be freshly made, which was not the case of our dish. The service is good.Overall, pricey, small portions and does not taste Mexican, in my view.

Author: simtiamhock
Title: Terrible service
Review: Terrible service and overpriced, not worth it. Highly not recommend to visit. Will never come again.

Author: fitfunfPerth, Australia
Title: Welcome to conference reception
Review: We had a conference welcome drinks here. We had the red wine and satay. And kebabs, yakitori and sliders. Good service. Very attentive manager. Lots of yummy local desserts. Nice set up with lots of little nooks & crannies for chit chats. Would come back for more drinks & dinner.

Author: Concerned-Malaysian
Title: Not itemised bill and dishes are not reflected as per order.
Review: See the bill don’t reflect actual dishes and it’s against the law , Refer to KPDN . We ordered cheese & aloo pratha respectively.Mutton masala & palak paneer & coffee and tea respectively.*No Nasi Campur as stated in the bill.Food was generally ok but the mutton masala was spoilt even after pointing out to the proprietor .As he assured us that it was freshly made .And as a result both of us had stomach upset.Just hope they’re ensure good food safety standards in the kitchen.

Author: Discover64941
Title: Bland and expensive- could be better
Review: After reading raving reviews about this place, my family and I decided to have our dinner here one evening. We tried the cheemeen prawn curry, the grilled fish and the prawn briyani for mains, and the sweet appam and watalappam for desserts. The prawn curry was really bland, with tiny pieces of mango. So was the briyani. The grilled fish however was pretty tasty. I was really disappointed with the sweet appam which was a real letdown. I was expecting moist appams with caramelised jaggery, but what I got was an appam that wasn't very tasty with a weird looking sauce. The waiters were quite attentive but the owner was also around and didn't bother even greeting us although there was only one other customer in the shop. However, when a more posh looking couple entered the restaurant the owner appeared so friendly and welcoming to them. We were quite put off by such an attitude. The food was also really expensive. Definitely not coming here again, such a rip off.

Author: NovitecRosso
Title: Horrible nightmares
Review: On November 19 we called to make a reservation for Christmas night, and we double call to make sure our time and date and the lady who picked up the phone said ok confirmed. Then we arrived on Christmas Eve night just to found out that they are closed on Christmas night. Well thought to myself ok maybe she moves my reservation. I called to check my reservation and she told me my name isn’t in the system, and they are fully booked on the whole weekend. Such a disappointment with her service kept saying impossible I said ok to ur reservation on Christmas night. make sure you guys call least 10times to confirm your reservation.So sad that she doesn’t want to admit her error and call herself the general manager of the restaurant.

Author: Uma S
Title: Malaysian food at an exorbitant price
Review: Food was average but price was expensive.You can get better food at the local food stalls for half the price

Author: Burkett66
Title: Below Par After MCO
Review:
After waiting over 2 months for Hardrock KL to reopen the food I received via a popular delivery company was well below par......

Come on Hardrock sort your act out very dissapointed.

Author: wenddyq
Title: Good
Review:
Best place when u are hungry. The food is good but some are very spicy for me. 
Some of the workers not really welcoming you but its okay. They maybe to tired working for the whole day.

Author: PatrickF581Haarzuilens, The Netherlands
Title: Good food, great place!
Review: Went here for dinner. Served by Jeet, who has be mentioned in earlier reviews. Really nice guy, and really on top of business as well. Food was great and not that expensive. Price-quality awesome!

Author: Janet I
Title: Fantastic food
Review: This is a hidden little gem which offers delicious local dishes. The service is excellent, and the food is fantastic, the quality is similar to the one offered at Kebaya.

Author: Alice YKuala Lumpur
Title: Dinner
Review: The food and service does not deserve the rating given by TripAdvisor.Been there three previous occasions and was very happy with all previous visits. Have not been for a while and now, was very disappointing. The food was below average and the service was not at all pleasant.

Author: Tricia E
Title: No thanks
Review: We tried 4 pizza’s and 2 pastas. Bar the carbonara which eas excellent, ever other dish had one too many ingredients. Though the wine list was extensive but they didn’t have one of the two bottles we ordered. Stands true to these chain of restaurants. Would be much better to have a list with wines that are in stock. The one good point was that staff were great and it made the dining experience. We won’t be rushing back.

Author: kylee2004
Title: Poor service
Review:
Staff provided poor service.The music didn’t match the theme.
But on the bright side, nice and interesting decor. Food was so-so

Author: ngyk22Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Food But Not Outstanding
Review: We have visited this restaurant a number of times, mainly for lunch. However, we opted for dinner this time as we were doing some shopping in Bangsar Village. We arrived at about 6.30pm and the place was fairly crowded. Service was prompt and we ordered a number of dishes amongst the 4 of us. The pineapple rice (which used to be very tasty) was disappointing and the portion was small. The Mango Salad was a bit too spicy. The Green Curry Beef and Pandan Chicken was ok. The kailan with salted fish was ok but very pricey. Overall, it was an expensive dinner (about MYR120) for the four of us.

Author: sinyee87
Title: First try but it’s a good try
Review: Nice food, good ambient and good service! Just the parking a bit pricy, and difficult to find especially after working hour. The business at Bangsar Village is good, we will need to drop our name come back in a while...

Author: Fred ACambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Poor quality
Review: Not recommended. No atmosphere due to no diners, lacking in choice and expensive for what is was. Eat out!

Author: Judith MBolton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: We were newly in Georgetown, tired and looking for an evening meal. We were about to give up looking for somewhere that looked appealing when we found Lagenda. We were warmly welcomed, made comfortable and beautifully served with super food. We returned 2 nights later and it was just as good. We highly recommend you try it. And tty the nutmeg juice too. Delicious!

Author: ongjanice1Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Looks like the price has gone up by 15-20%
Review: Since my last review, I've returned to dine in Chinoz but didn't pay attention to the price as it was picked up by my friends/my company. Just 2 days ago, I returned with my family and I've discovered that the prices have gone up; not surprising. Anyway, this time round, I was there for dinner and we ordered the following items: the "Oz" meat pie, mushroom soup, fried squid, prawn laksa, dragon maki & creme brulee. Overall, the food is to our liking especially the meat pie & fried squid but the prawn laksa is quite a disappointment. I must say that the service was rather slow and the crew wasn't that attentive; maybe becoz they were all on the Hari Raya holiday mood. In any case, it was still a good meal for my family & I.

Author: MimiTHengKlang
Title: PITIFULLY POOR service in addition to BAD FOOD
Review: Went there today for lunch with colleagues to the Bangsar South outlet. I ordered Curry Laksa but the taste was bad and I was given a half-cooked chicken drumstick! When I alerted the workers about it, THREE of them came over to look at the chicken and one of them finally said "I will inform the kitchen".. And then guess what, not a single apology, no replacement and worst of all I still had to pay for the 10% service charge although I would rate the service as PITIFULLY POOR in addition to BAD FOOD. I had an utterly bad experience dining in your premise.PITIFULLY POOR in addition to BAD FOOD.. booohh...

Author: peattielis21
Title: Good food and service
Review: Have been there twice now and have been happy with both meals, they offer a great cross between western and malayan food. Friendly and attentive service. Would go back.

Author: SueLynnTiongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique dining experience!
Review: Jala at The Andaman boasts an exciting menu of Malay and Western flavours, with a fresh seafood display for you to choose from. The restaurant offers the best of both worlds, nestled between the tropical rainforest and the Andaman Sea.Dress code is resort casual so skip the stilettos and go with flip flops, unless you want your heels to sink into the soft sand. One of Jala’s unique selling points is its sand floor that allows guests to feel as though they are dining on the beach. Jala is headed by Chef de Cuisine, Rene Knudsen, whose has a passion for nature and great respect for the local community.The herb collection was most interesting; everything was edible. Except the pot. Try the Jalaksa, the chef's take on local laksa. This composition of king prawn and seabass fried in Japanese breadcrumb batter, quail egg, cucumber and consommé was as tasty as it looked.On the whole, my dining experience at Jala was very enjoyable. The ambiance was lovely and the seafood was fresh – brought in by the fishermen that evening itself. Flavours were kept simple, and dishes were hearty and unpretentious.For more pictures and a full review, visit: http://www.bangsarbabe.com/2013/04/jala-restaurant-the-andaman-langkawi.html

Author: unclelumpyHingham, United Kingdom
Title: Bad service, they broke the 15 minute rule.
Review: We chose this restaurant based upon the TripAdvisor reviews. It looks lovely and there was a nice ambience with a pianist plinking away in the background.However, fifteen minutes after being shown to our seats we had still not been asked what we wanted to drink, let alone had anyone talk to us about the menu. The last straw was when they started to clear and set tables rather than take out order. So we walked out.When the manager realised he apologised and tried to get us to stay but I’m sorry, if your staff don’t prioritise a customer whose actually there then they don’t deserve their custom.It’s a real shame as the food looked really good but life’s too short to put up with badly trained staff.

Author: Wang B
Title: Come here with little to no expectation,I guess I was right
Review: One of the most expensive burger 'franchise' I have ever ate....and the portion is incredibly small and yet the taste is just McDonald like.Not to mention their service is incredible slow,with just 3 customer yet it took almost 15 minutes!I am not even procrastinating...it took 15 minutes just for 1 burger and I believe other reviews that I read have the same issues.But however they manage to redeem it with friendly customer service and yes.....80% of the workers are from napal but they managed to speak fluent english and provide a satisfaction service,for this I will give this restaurant franchise 2 star.In conclusion,unless they improvise I won't even consider eating in fuel shack

Author: dicko1307Swindon, United Kingdom
Title: Poor food, poor service, bad atmosphere ... good view
Review: The food was rubbish. For the price and taste of food in malaysia don't bother eating here. Food was cold and just simply not nice. Service was vacant and there were children running around everywhere.The view is amazing however can be seem from the observation deck. If you do go a dress code is enforced and you must wear trousers

Author: neiplerakHoofddorp, The Netherlands
Title: Friendly staff, food not outstanding, nice ambiance
Review: Had CNY dinner at Chynna. There was a choice of 4 menu's. I must say, the loa sang was good and so were the noodles and desert, but the fish was tateless, seafood was though, the duck had little taste (very tender though). The wine service was exellent. The food was plenty, but every course came very fast. The staff was friendly and observant.

Author: zak222016
Title: Not so great
Review: Have been before service was much better food more tastier.this time around no so great.will not go thee again.

Author: Vortex888300
Title: Still worthwhile thought a bit pricey
Review: Have been a clientele of this restaurant for years now. Always have enjoyed the wide array of fresh seafood here. Taste wise, cant be faulted. Pricing on the other hand, has steadily increased. I would still return though!

Author: Gals_Adventure85
Title: Friendly atmosphere
Review: Love a good pub where you can enjoy beer or sip of wine with your working mates. Food is not bad too. Irish pubs always my choice,

Author: Daniel HZurich, Switzerland
Title: Closed much earlier than indicated on web-page, not professional
Review: Arriving late on KL I was looking for a decent dinner.I checked Tripadvisor & the web-page, both indicate:Open Mon - Sun 6.00pm - 11.00pm.I arrived 10:10 pm - from a restaurant intending to play in the top league on would expect to be served, probably not the big "degustation menu" any more, but still some a la care bites.Not here: "kitchen closed" was the answer an I had to leave hungry. Really bad service and not up to professional standards.

Author: MaxStaysPhilippines
Title: The food is below average
Review: I was surprised the food they serve is without sense of freshness. The beef green curry was not using the fresh coconut milk and make the dish lousy. The sweet and sour grouper the gravy is like tasteless. Seem like the chef was not there... Some other helper to cook....Think twice before visiting this restaurant. The service was poor and slow. They don't seem understand English or Malay. They staff seem not local, the communication skills was affected. Advice to have some one to speak fluent and understand English for ordering the food. Is pricy with the low standard of food....

Author: DetroitGKTKSingapore, Singapore
Title: Late lunch
Review: Very poor service by staff. A pile of plates and utensils were put in the table. Customers are expected to arrange the plates ourselves. ? What wonderful service ? Are we in a food court ? The gentleman in black suit who took our order is not much better. Luckily, the quality of food passed the test and make up for the poor quality of service. Food ordered: chicken soup, salted egg prawn, lava bun, Xiao long bao
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: Danny LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tried the new outlet in Nu Sentral
Review: Went to the new location on the lower concourse / ground level at the Nu Sentral mall just next to the Coffeebean, located right next to the main entrance from Brickfields side. Items are mainly RM9-12 per dish of 3 pieces. The food is all halal and the siew mai is nothing special. The harkow is not bad but the best item was their Prawn mozza roll which was crispy and yummy. The teas are from 3.70 to 8.50 but each person gets their own pot so you can order different types of hot tea and they will refill the pot as well. Their decoration is also quite unique with the 1950s style and large lanterns.

Author: Louisooil
Title: A fine Dining
Review: 31st Aug 2018 1st trial at Farquhar Mansion Fine Dining.Good Service,explain all the food after serving to us.A good experience our fine dining here.

Author: VijayaratinamRamahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth for money
Review: Poor service. We had ordered few items and requested for toothpick at the end, all were only served/delivered after a minimal of 3 reminder to them. Food is horrible in taste. No value for vegetarians. The sambar was too watery and the rasam has almost no taste.

Author: theWorldofJose
Title: Good fish ravioli, nice ambiance for a dinner with friends.
Review: La Raviata provides you with good Italian food. I was with a group and the fish ravioli and salads were quite good. The service is very good and the place with good for big groups meals.

Author: TravelWithBender
Title: Lucious, Lovely - Must eat here!
Review: On the beach watching the sunset... Where else would be better for our anniversary dinner and what a treat? The staff were friendly and attentive. They remembered our names and were prompt. The food was amazing. Its been a long time since I had such a special meal and all under $80 - entree, mains and dessert. For that quality you would usually pay plenty more, let alone the view and service. They surprised us with dessert bringing out chocolate sauce writing happy anniversary and a free ice-cream for me. If you are in Langkawi - GO! You will not regret it one bit! I know you think its alot of money, and we know. We spent $5 across the road on lunch for 2 people, but this is special and I will be going back for sure!Visit my blog http://erineatsthat.wordpress.com for more info!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Calmac84
Title: Give it a miss.
Review: Small portions, mediocre food, very expensive for what you get. Much better places at much cheaper prices!! Just give it a miss!

Author: jennytgoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Famous restaurant
Review: Went twice with diff group of friends from Malaysia. The restaurant always pack. Go earlier than peak hour to avoid waiting for your table. Food pesentation good, some dishes tasty but some is quite salty like the fish noodle soup. The platter otah was cold when served. However we ordered a separate serving of otah it was quite good with pieces of fish meat visible.

Author: TSLow
Title: Expensive
Review: This is a very popular halal seafood restaurant. It is very expensive yet still very popular. The food is reasonably good but not excellent.

Author: YCT50
Title: What? It's my fault to order the lamp rump ?
Review: Expected a 5 star service especially during low peak season with only about only 6 tables being served but service was bad, all the way with the regular waitress, supervisor and even the manager.It all started with the lamp rump when the waitress wrongly took my order as lamb rack. As a English graduate myself, the local waitress wrongly took my order. When she questioned me (before the order arrived) if I ordered the rack I said no, it's rump. She got nervous and asked supervisor to come and question me. Supervisor questioned if waitress repeated my order I said no. She didn't believe and insisted waitress did and I said second time no. After that she got no choice but to change the order.At end of meal manager came to talk and insisted it was a misunderstanding.That's when I felt all staff are so much of a one team thing and nobody realise it's their own error, that I have to take this to public channel. I will return if they keep the chef but the service team is gone! U know what I me an !

Author: PhilR1486
Title: Best Bar and Restaurants in KL
Review: Everything about Sabayon and Blue Bar is fantastic. The food, cocktails, views and staff is 5 star. Highly recommend you visit The EQ and experience this fantastic place

Author: DaimarrrLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good music, but lacks atmosphere.
Review: We were staying in the Le Meridien hotel next door and fancied a change of scene so visited Chambers for a drink one evening, having enjoyed drinks here over the years. This year it was a little bit lacking. The music from the band was good, however the service was very slow and there was nobody around to serve much. The lack of atmosphere from other guests only compounded the feeling that it was lacking. We enjoyed one drink which was reasonably priced and returned to the Le Meridien bar, which to be fair didn't make a good cocktail either!

Author: Its_CastiSingapore, Singapore
Title: A blot on the Shangri-La brand
Review: I was here with a colleague on a Friday evening at 11.30pm and there was no one manning the entrance to usher us - what followed was a reluctant welcome. None the less we settled in with a beer and at about 12.45 am we were told that they’re shutting down and if we wished we could order our second drink. Once the drinks were served we were told we had fifteen minutes to wrap up and could carry our drinks to the hotel lobby. That being the case I am not sure why were they so desperate to serve us the second round of drinks. Deplorable behaviour to say the least - not expected from the Shangri-La brand. As for the food menu, this was hidden somewhere beneath the table and no one bothered to even check if we needed anything. It is hence no wonder that the bar was empty on a Friday evening when we arrived. This was my second visit here and the last.

Author: nickkimchung
Title: So Expansive
Review:
rice with 1 chicken wing masak merah cost me Rm 7.00 WTH
i not recommend you guys to come here .. SRS boulevard new

Author: Leonj59
Title: Could be better
Review: I would describe it as largely average although the pancakes itself was rather thick. It was served with toppings of nuts, coconut shavings, ice cream, syrup and so on. What's to dislike? But it could be better. The 'dark' hot chocolate was very nice.

Author: djulecabahug4Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner Review
Review: All of the foods we’ve ordered were delicious and even excceded my expectations. The quality of the foods are worth their price. The appetizers before the main dish, which are the salmon rolls and the bread, were a great start and tasted delicious. The service made me feel welcome and brought more warmth to the experience, and the waiters were very hospitable and helpful throughout the dinner. We would like to come back to eat here and enjoy with my family or even friends again. The atmosphere and environment was mesmerizing and sticks true to the name of the hotel and its class. Thank you for helping me create another wonderful memory that I would cherish and look back into for the rest of my life.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: Khayz H
Title: Shell out Desa Pandan
Review: Over price. Portion is small. street food taste better that their food. service also slow. have to ask for the extra rice even though we had order earlier

Author: StephanieYanYu
Title: Great foods with good environment
Review: Have a wonderful night here. Foods are superb especially hokaiddo scallop and duo wagyu. Services are excellent. Will come back again in the future 👍

Author: Herman3684
