Title: Seafood birthday dinner
Review: Went on a seafood dinner at New Lucky Seafood on 17th Nov 2019 after some recommendation online. On reaching the restaurant, there was no menu and we had no idea how much we were paying for our food. Henceforth, to play safe, we ordered bee hoon crabs, pig stomach soup and a prawn paste dish. I asked for a small bowl of soup and the server said they only have 1 size at 10 ringit. Thinking that just 3 simple dishes won't burn our pocket, we proceeded to wait for our food.20mins later, our food came along. The bee hoon was very salty, crabs were normal with no wow factor.However, we didn ask for 2 crabs as it was just the 2 of us yet 2 crabs came along and I wonder if the server considered that it was too much for us. Next came the prawn paste which was cold and not crispy at all. Lastly came the soup, also normal and no wow factor except for the price that really "wowed" me. From a mere 10 ringit as mentioned as by server, it snowballed to 70 ringit for a ingredientless white pepper soup with just some mushrooms and pig stomach. It really made me wonder if this restaurant is a black shop without giving a clear pricelist and based the price based on instruction from their kitchen upon my enquiry.Look at the receipt attached and you will know what I mean. And point to note, we just had peanuts and no crackers issued to us as they claimed that there was only 2 of us instead of 4. However, we paid for cost of peanuts cum crackers yet they took the crackers out based on their own business aspect.I strongly discourage going to New lucky restaurant. Food is not worth the cost and the taste does not append to its reputation.

Author: DonC181Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: We came here after a disappointed madam kwan dinner at Pavilion, on a rainy night. Reached here about 9pm plus. Totally double disappointed with the "dry" n "wet" bak ku teh n "tou kee".. So ex somemore.... Seems like in this KL trip, the best food I taste is the Overseas Restaurant kampong chicken. Lol.

Author: Midnite_sushiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great service, great view
Review: We came on a Saturday night for Happy Hour and sunset. Although we arrived a little early, we were given a table right away. My husband and I both ordered margaritas (great happy hour deal!!). The staff was attentive but not intrusive, friendly, and accommodating. They offered to take pictures of us in front of the towers, made sure our drinks were constantly topped up, and that our snacks were filled. Aliff was our server and was especially good, remembering my husband's name and joking with him. Great view of the skyline despite the haze.

Author: VivaHawaiiHonolulu, Hawaii
Title: Good Food
Review: I visit Kuala Lumpur at least once every year and I always make a point of having one dinner at The Outback! Most people know this restaurant chain so you know what to expect there. The staff are very nice and friendly. One comment - if you are a non-smoker like me, don't sit outside as they always seat a chain smoker at the next table.

Author: chefrevival04
Title: Japanese food after lockdown
Review: Visited with family. Order my usually soba noodle. The taste not the same like before. Overall so so only

Author: PeachytravellersGold Coast, Australia
Title: Expensive, Very Average Food & the chef didn’t wash his hands after going to the toilet.... 😳
Review: We visited this restaurant with family with young kids.It was Expensive with Very Average Food.The food came out separately with a massive wait between dishes which made it very awkward with different family members eating at different times....The pizza was very average at best...The chicken meal was very small and I was left hungry...The meal cost over 450RM (approx $160AUD), which is very expensive compared to other restaurants in the same area which we have had better food at.The service and sangria was great though.BUT DESPITE THE OVER PRICED AVERAGE FOOD, I SAW THE CHEF WALK STRAIGHT FROM THE TOILET (WHERE HE WAS FOR A LONG TIME), BACK INTO THE KITCHEN WITHOUT WASHING HIS HANDS.....DISGUSTING & DISGRACEFUL...This place boasts to have a 4 Star Trip Advisor rating, but I can’t see how...?I would not recommend this place at all....

Author: the_hair_thiefEdinburgh
Title: Rude waiter
Review: After reading about this restaurant in the Rough Guide, my wife and 4 year old walked there, avoiding a passing downpour on the way. On entering, we were shown to a table by a waiter. We were about to sit down when another male waiter (I'm guessing the manager) appeared and asked if we had a reservation. When we said no, he told us there was no tables, took the menus and walked off. As our son needed the toilet, I asked if I could use them. Again I was curtly told they were upstairs. Whilst using the facilities, the first waiter came across to apologise to my wife. Given there were other tourists in the restraurant, I can only guess that our young son was potentially the reason why we were turned away. It's the first time I've encountered anybody in Kuala Lumpur (or Malaysia) who has been anything less than very friendly, especially towards younger children. Disappointed and would not recommend.

Author: _judithellidgePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Very good
Review: Food was very nice if bland, but: hot sauces available. Staff lovely. I am the pickiest person in the world and will go back.I did not like the music but it was very low.Buzzing wth local Chinese and backpackers. And me! The long time resident Uk granny! I did not feel uncomfortable at all.

Author: Wheng1229
Title: Philippines food  and product
Review:
Food excellent
Come and try guy's
Filipino dish and product 
Open 10 am to 10 pm 
Call or WhatsApp
0104260317

Author: 984elsak
Title: Come here for live music only
Review: Went here for a lunch meeting, at the same time there was this artiste launching his album here and we got the chance to listen to the live band. Ordered, grilled salmon, new york strip and char koay tiau while enjoying the band. For rm117 new york strip, the taste was okay, nothing spectacular about it. The salmon was abit too dry. Overall, , the food is not that great but the arrangement of the live band is amazing.

Author: George JNew York City, New York
Title: "Way Too Expensive"
Review: Was in Ipoh for a business meeting and friends recommended me to this particular restaurant. Well, i just have to say, ambience wise, it is nice and but the prices are WAY TOO EXPENSIVE !!! Taste wise, just alright. Its more like a place to impress client/dates.

Author: ERedqueenLuxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Traditional dim sum
Review: Not sure whether it was a public holiday, the crowd started at 7am. We waited at least 30minutes to get a seat.It is advisable to go by grab as parking is limited. The price is reasonable but please note that they charged by headcount for the Chinese tea.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Anysia S
Title: Disappointed
Review:
the menu is poor in choices.
I take one malaysian speciality.it was almost with no species.......I dit not like it at all.
The worst resto i try in KL.

Author: BodilY2
Title: En nydelig kulinarisk opplevelse
Review: We have been traveling a good deal in Sti Lanka, but the best Sri Lankian food we ate at Ali Yaa in Kuala lumpur. Absolutly recomand

Author: BluesphynxSingapore
Title: Everything delicious
Review: Five of us ordered 30 sticks of chicken satay, grilled over an open flame, beautifully charred, plump, juicy and tender meat, nice saffron color with ketupat, fresh cucumber and onion and thick peanut sauce. Only $31RM! Beats Kajang satay any time. The thosai came with different types of sauces, all delectable, fragrant and spicy while the chapati was a good texture, not hard, served with a portion of vegetables as well as curry sauce. A portion of chicken curry, 4 pieces, was also tender and the curry sauce good with the ketupat as well. A vegetable dish of radish and carrot was also seasoned just right as everything else, not salty or overly sweet or too spicy. Teh halia was also not too sweet, and lime juice freshly squeezed from small limes came in cheerful pink and blue glasses, nicely curved. Devi's has such a wide menu I'm determined to try the crab curry and fish head curry next time. Also saw huge plates of mee goreng at other tables. Service is prompt and efficient, someone comes to the table with pencil and paper, you pay at the counter later. The hardworking staff all wear shower caps, the restaurant is clean and unpretentious, cooled with fans, and there's a multi-racial clientele of locals and tourists happily eating together, convival atmosphere.

Author: Royce88Kuching
Title: Salty as hell
Review: Been there with my cuz, I ordered fried rice n the food quality is not as it's décor.it's like I'm eating a fried rice with a handful of salt added. And another thing, the staff there are not so friendly. Let me get this straight fellas, we came to dine and not all consumers are trying to hit on you.

Author: chao99Miri, Malaysia
Title: Nothing but hype
Review: Heard this restaurant from locals that it serves dim sum so great that even famous chefs from Singapore came to try it out. It was nothing but hype. Tried it out for the first time, the food was very moderate, you can get this dimsum in normal Chinese restaurants without having to pay the high price tag. The environment was extremely unhygienic when it gets windy, our plates were covered in dust and sand while sitting on the inside when huge wind blew upon us. The waiter kept asking us if we need more food even though we rejected (asking is good, but it gets annoying after constant questioning every few mins). The worse part is they only accept cash payments even though they have the card machine. As an avid card user, I brought barely enough cash that morning, which was really annoying.Never again.

Author: K0stasZLimassol City, Cyprus
Title: Pleasant Malaysian night
Review: Beautifull Malaysian night out...1 hour show with national dances, each dance dancers where differently dressed with traditional costumes. They called us also on scene to participate and was a nice experience. Great buffet with plenty of traditional dishes, from starters to desserts.100RM nett/person the cost including buffet and 1 hour show.A must do when you visit KL

Author: Olitrav
Title: Faux Malaysian cuisine for the tourists served with an awful house band on the side
Review: We are here last night and it was most disappointing. The food is definitely aimed solely at the crowd of tourists ambling down Jonker St. We ordered chicken satay, a cashew curry and a dish that described itself as mango chicken. The chicken in the satay was fine but the sauce was awful. The cashew curry was bland and the mango chicken was essentially sweet chilli sauce with a few pieces of mango thrown in for good measure. I do believe that the ingredients here are good but the execution is poor.Their draft beer is quite good but the house keyboard and singer duo were terrible, we contemplated hanging around for drinks afterwards but left to go and see a guy put his finger through a coconut which was far more entertaining.

Author: major_riotBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Little Gem of Penang
Review: Warm and Friendly staff who go out of there way to ensure you are looked after. Penang is all about the food and Andrew's Kampung is one of its best ambassadors . My wife loves spicy food and went for the Devilled King Prawns and she was not disappointed. I had the Malaysian curry and was awesome. We also had the special fried rice which had some chillies in it and fried anchovies; which I was a bit dubious about but it really worked. All washed down with some King Tiger beers excellent. We will definitely be back.

Author: Gill0uGAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Real Vietnamese food
Review: As the name hints, this is a Vietnamese restaurant. We fell in love with Hanoi Pho while in Vietnam and we never really manage to get a good Pho outside Vietnam. But in Du Viet their Pho is authentic. No surprise the staff come from Vietnam. The portion are huge and the price really reasonable. The best Pho outside Vietnam!
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Brisbane963Brisbane, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: We arrived for lunch at Il Bacaro with high hopes of a delicious Italian meal. Sadly it just didn’t live up to our expectations. My husband had a pizza, which he said was nice, but nothing special. I chose something from the daily specials board, which while tasty didn’t justify the price. We finished with two doppio espresso which we couldn’t finish as they were too watery. We won’t be back as it was expensive for what we had.

Author: IvorynGold
Title: Good Dim Sum
Review: A must visit whenever I am in KL.  Good dim sum, good service.  The price is reasonable and it is a good meeting place for business associates or friends.

Author: KerryM749
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Excellent food and excellent service, like everything in the Hilton KL. Great choice of lunch and dinner menus, and a fantastic view.

Author: rainboy
Title: Went here last year on several occasions not anymore
Review: So last year we loved to go here, but this year the menu changed and all i ordered was not available and what was ordered was different from the menu. Food otherwise looked good but service and stock is terrible. Not recommended

Author: viviantan930Klang, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated
Review: This place was ranked the top dim sum place along with Ming Kok in Ipoh, I never have chance to dine at Ming Kok, but yes for Foh San because there are more tables here. The food was not that great as what they had been rated, price was not cheap either. There are many variety for sure, but the taste was just alright. The service was not good, some waitress even show us smelly face when we refused to take what they recommended.

Author: TinjaP
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: A cozy little place. Tasty food and drinks. I really liked the salads there and the serving size was big enough. Service there was also good.

Author: PravinKaneshPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Awful Service
Review: Food is way below average and the staffs are terribly rude with absurt attitude . Will never ever return. Totally not worth your penny. Maharaj restaurant is definitely a better option.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for certified Halal dimsum
Review: one of the good halal dimsum restaurant in town. it's under oriental group so the quality won't be anywhere near bad. they use a lot of seafood to replace actual pork dishes so it's actually pretty neat. sorry to say some pork dishes cannot be replaced at all, eg siumai, pork ribs, charsiew, no Chinese pork sausages in fried radish cake, basically missing something. nevertheless, they did a great job for dishes that do not require pork (eg. lau sha bao/ molten egg yolk bun, prawn dumplings, prawn cheong fun, chives dumpling, pan fried radish cake and the list goes on). it's a great place to introduce dimsum to Muslim colleagues who wishes to try Chinese dimsum. they have promotions only during weekends - it's usually much busier on a weekday so you may want to make a reservation earlier.

Author: chung986Hong Kong, China
Title: Expensive
Review: This is a great restaurant but very expensive not only for KUL standard, but evening compare to similar restaurant in HK. We went there on Saturday for lunch, and we had two problems - 1. When we called to book for a table at 1315, we were told the last order was at 1330, but when we arrived at the restaurants clearly stated the last order was at 1400, which a few more customers did just that! 2. We we order a la carte sushi and a grill fish dish, we were told (very politely) that the minimum order per person must be RM200, even during lunch?! Why wasn’t we told during reservation and no where on their website ever stated this requirement. We ended up had a nice meal and we spent way over the minimum. I think the restaurant management needs to resolve the above issues in order for them to be one of the best in KUL.

Author: Travelerbrat_inPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Wooohooo Briyani!!!
Review: If you like Pakistani Briyani this is close to perfect!! Not too spicy and very flavorful..... this place does server other dishes like Breads and Gravies.The Mango Lassi/Plum is the BEST IN KL.I can vouch for that :) The Gralic Cheese naan is also nice its like a pizza!

Author: alricy
Title: Not worth the visit
Review:
Service is nonchalant, especially the lady at the counter. 
Food is disappointing, bread and potato was overcooked with charred portion. 
Aircon is non-existant, especially glaring on a hot day like this. Defintely not worth the visit.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: BarryPAleoAtlanta, Georgia
Title: Famous Food Just "Alright"!
Review: This food was good but was by no means "amazing"! We enjoyed everything and were happy but again, not overly impressed. The service was very slow considering the restaurant was only 50% full.We read may amazi g 5 Star Reviews on this restaurant and maybe were expecting far more.Wouldn't go back again!

Author: Scott W
Title: Rundown
Review: Too many staff working at once - although service still lacked as only one of the staff actually served. For example 7 soft drinks with around 7 members of staff would take maximum of 5 minutes, yet took around 10-15The restaurant was very smelly, was warm and uncomfortable to sit and eat. The food was decent despite everything else so props to the chef!

Author: Rob BVancouver, Canada
Title: No service, no table, no view
Review: We had out friend make a reservation for New Year's for us for a table at the window, and we showed up at 6:00pm to check it out and confirm and they said they saved us a non window table, which was unacceptable. They offered us an outdoor seat if the weather was good and we accepted. We offered to pay for a bottle to hold our table but the host (Elle? a man) Said it was unnecessary and said we had his word he'd hold it until we arrived. We were about 20 minutes late due to new year's traffic, but showed up and they had given away all tables. They brought us in to what was the worst table in the bar, peopl e shoving by us constantly and no space and absolutely no view. We had reserved bottle service, and no on ever brought a bottle or served us at all, even though we spoke to a waiter who took our order and never came back.We had no drinks, saw no fireworks, and frankly wasted an hour getting there in a cab.I would guess on another day the view is good, but I'd avoid it as the service is some of the worst I've experienced, and I'm not one to complain.One floor down is Nobu, they're great! Go there.

Author: JPizz_86
Title: Terrible Breakfast
Review: Randomly tried this place for breakfast and it was horrible! The pictures they display looked amazing but the quality is shockingly bad, service was also terrible

Author: 973simon
Title: Delicious
Review: You have to learn to eat with your fingers at this place on a banana leaf , no plates! traditional indian food  a few minutes walk from the hotel ,recommended by the tour desk.

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner: Japanese Fine Dine 😋😋😋
Review: Dinner: Japanese Fine Dine Dinner on the 53rd floor Authentic Japanese Cuisine that served fine Japanese foodies. Had the Omakase Course & Seafood Course. Starters with steam monk fish lover and spinach. And came the double boiled soup fish with seafood. Simple and had varieties of food especially their Taro, Salmon; scallop and tuna are awesome and refreshing that melts into your mouth with fresh sushi, Salmon grilled with simple authentic fried rice served with matcha green tea ice cream and double boiled Red bean with peach freshly peal and peach.

Author: webbsmAnkara, Turkey
Title: No brunch menu
Review: So this cafe was on a blog post recommending new cafes in Penang for brunch. As mentioned you need to pay RM20 to get into Fort Cornwallis (which isn't worth a visit). You can claim half of this back off your meal. Firstly there is no brunch so since I had paid to get in there I ended up with dessert instead. Which granted was good - the coffee wasn't though. He most disappointing thing was the service. As we were the only two people there I had to find someone to take our order. The menus were just thrown down in front of us. Very disappointing. Not to mention the stale smell of cigarettes. As a Penang resident I can say there are plenty of better places within walking distance. Dear tourists, keep on walking!

Author: sifa287
Title: Not my f
Review: I went to this restaurant few times, and during those visit they have consistently deliver below my expactation. Overall food taste and service is average

Author: kzamhari
Title: Awesome food & great ambience
Review: Authentic crepes both savoury and sweet. Great place for breakfast and/or lunch with attentive and personalised service. Looking forward to trying out the items on the menu! Will be back soon.

Author: MelissasawGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: DISAPPOINTED- NO RETURN
Review: Disappointed dim sum . Ordered cha sao and custard pao . Waiting quite sometime but Came Out with not even well steam, Not hot at all . Asked the waitress send back to steam it again . And heard the loud scream from kitchen area . Not happy with our request . To reheat the “pao”. Steam milk last time is one of my favourite there . Facing the same issue . Not hot enough . The overall for the dim sum can said that .. the standard and the taste are in going down standard, really no good and not worth of money at all . The waitress all almost old age and long time working workers . Their attitude are terrible . Slow and almost all in black face . This will be my last visit ..Bye

Author: eblissSingapore
Title: Class restaurant in Melaka, worth a visit or two
Review: Parking space is a bit limited if you drive there, go early. The restaurant gets pretty busy fast.Maybe it is during Christmas time when we were there. The blaring Christmas carols spoils the atmosphere. The waiters are attentive.We were discouraged from ordering most of the Chef recommended dishes because there were only two of us and the portions are pretty big.The Pu-Er tea is pretty tasteless. Quite disappointed with it.Assam Fish Head (RM48) - Big portion, some scales left on the fish, slight fishy smell.Braised Pork with Yam (RM20) - smells heavenly. The pork is slightly tough, yam is soft and melts in your mouth.Mixed fruits desert (RM10) - fresh and sweet.We were given papaya, honeydew and watermelon. Will I be back? Yes, to try other dishes.

Author: CaesarPJ
Title: Love the ambience, food was delish and a very welcoming service from the staff!
Review: Perfect for girls night out or date nights! (check out the design of the entire place). As well as business meetings (cosy, quaint and inspiring!) Also come alone and make new friends! I always do. So much warmth. Everyone is very welcoming and genuine in their recommendations of food and drinks. Food are delish and looking so pretty too. The serving portion is suitable for these type of dining, small tapas-like flavourful bombs. Fave? Cheeseburger gyoza, tuna tataki and the chicken wings! So much love. Keep it up!

Author: FattyFoodieLovesFoodPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Huge pizza but so so quality
Review: We actually tried Mikey's pizza at a few outlets before. I cant recall once we really enjoyed our meal there. The pizza sure is big, but the quality of the ingredients is so-so to our liking. Its also quite pricey and have to order over the counter and pay first.

Author: Ann S SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fun for a visit
Review: This is fun and a bit retro. There's much better food elsewhere in KL, but it's fun to see the city moving round. Great views, ok service and ok food. Can't really recommend the cocktails, but I'd take visitors there for a bit of gentle tourism.

Author: KrystelVerkerkRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Best Lemon Chicken EVER!!!
Review: For a few years we have been having lunch in the little street besides the Golden Sands when we heard the owner has a restaurant close by during the evening. And so we went tot have dinner. It was such a cozy little restaurant with a nice atmosphere. And... last but not least, she and her husband serve superb food! The Lemon Chicken is not on the menu but if you ask, she will make it for you. The absolute best!!

Author: LimGM
Title: overrated & overpriced
Review:
One of a waitress quite rude, she act like a boss, her high heel footstep sound very NOISY.
Other Waiters & Waitresses are nice..
 Foods is ok, but overrated & overpriced. Definitely will not come come.

Author: Jacqueline  C
Title: Bali memories
Review: Food was nothing to shout about, but appreciate the ambiance and the service makes up for it, especially when dining with guests.

Author: TerminatorT2Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Old Porky Lunch
Review: Heard so much about it finally, went down to try with my brother. There was a queue since the shop opened in the morning. But the shop kind enough to have chairs outside so that u can wait comfortably, and the turned around was fast too, we waited about 5 minutes, got a 2 seats(sharing table with another 2 ladies).Food : the roti babi (pork bun) was something special, but the pork chop nothing really outstanding but it was good enough. The beef noodle was okay, but I think if they cooked the soup another hour longer, it would be perfect. I saw the ladies in front of us, ordered roasted pork, looked damn good, but we seriously can't take in another dish, alas. I must comment on the foreign staffs, they were all very smart and hardworking. The one fellow saw me and brother were sharing a bowl of beef noodle, he gave us two small bowls, two sets of utensils, 2 plates of chilies without us having to ask. Very street smart fellow or very well trained.

Author: keyrthan
Title: Extremely Poor Service, Hygiene and Rude Staffs
Review: Poor coordination among staffs and its rude managers. Sometimes cant enjoy the food due to long awaiting for dishes upon order. Very poor floor, toilet and food serving area hygiene. Only good thing is THEY CHARGE THE CUSTOMERS AS IF THEY PROVIDE THE BEST. Strongly encourage the Health Authority to inspect this place.

Author: Choo N
Title: quite good
Review: a restaurant which located behind aeon kinta city (nearby ELKEN stockist).we ordered a small claypot chicken rice,soup and plain vegetables,it only cost RM20 include tea and GST.

Author: RezaA1648
Title: Fantastic Birthday Celebration on the Sky
Review: I have been invited by my wife for my birthday celebration to this wonderful BBQ buffet. we faced to some very negative reviews for Trace restaurant before going there which were made us a bit worry about the quality and services. However, we went there and had one of our fantastic buffet experiences in Kuala Lumpur. It wouldn't be my first choice as the best buffet but it is one of the best BBQ buffet in KL. It should be considered that the reputation of this buffet is because of its BBQ buffet so you have not to be expected to receive the variety as much as international buffets. However, we really enjoyed and loved the variety, quality and taste of the food. Now, I would like to give you some real facts about this buffet restaurant;1. It is located at the 40th level of Element Hotel in KL. The view is very nice but if you wanna take a window-sit table then you need to book it a week earlier before going there. The location has nice and relaxing environments to have a relaxing times through dining. 2. The BBQ part is included rib-eye, sirloin, lamb, beef, fish, shrimps, Calamari and chicken and beef sausages. You need the take the pieces and put it in the plate and pass it to the chief to cook for you. You can also consider about the degree of doneness to the staff. After a period of 10-15 minutes they will bring the cooked plate on your table. You can also take different provided sauces for your BBQ pieces.3. Apart from the BBQ part, you can find some salads, cheese, Pasta, Lasagna, soup, fried rice, roasted duck and chicken and ... in addition to deserts, ice cream and fresh fruits through the buffet area but the variety is not as much as International buffets.4. The restaurant is also provided Some Detox water and hot drinks like as cappuccino, Tea, Espresso on your buffet.5. The chiefs and staff are really friendly, warm and kind and they provided a very good services during the dining time. They also brought a cake and candles and singed Happy Birthday songs as it was arranged with them through my wfe.6. I think It is really worth the money for the Buffet and services.It would be highly recommended to all BBQ lovers to have a Wonderful dining on the sky.

Author: jaaaaa156
Title: Won't come again
Review: I had dinner here. and I won't come again. The location wise, best view. Service wise, ok but slow. Food wise, below par. When my food came to the table, it was already cold. If it's night market food stall, I wouldn't mind.

Author: pascaljeanclaudesBangkok, Thailand
Title: Very good diner in exquisite location
Review: The Lounge at Four season hotel is opened until 11.0pm, offering a very beautiful scenery just near the Petronas Twin Towers. La carte offer a good choice between local and foreigner food. The personnel is young and very helpful. The restaurant decoration provide a private diner in a very beautiful and sweet atmosphere. The restaurant give also access to a night bar with exclusively young fréquentation.

Author: treavelmadoxfordshire
Title: Great European food
Review: Treated to a meal here by a staff member from The Danna Hotel just 10 mins drive away. Excellent choice of European Food, even Pork on the menu ! Lovely rustic setting, wonderful hospitality, delicious well cooked food. Had a very enjoyable evening , look forward to our next visit .

Author: Gilbert B
Title: Excellent.
Review: We really enjoyed the food at this place especially the baked fish. Super nice !! Not to forget the people served us. It's a windy area.

Author: tanhooiying
Title: Superb
Review: The portion is very big. The best part is we can order 2 different flavours in one pizza. The stuffing and topping is superb. It is a must try at Ipoh.

Author: ningmin
Title: Celebrating my aunty birthday
Review: We are here to celebrate my aunty birthday! Their service is really good, all the staff are so friendly. My aunty was so surprise and happy while they serve the cake dancing and singing birthday song together. Definitely will come again and recommend to my friends!

Author: Robin_Kok
Title: Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Love the prawn with masak lemak gravy the most whereas the asam fish and kangkong belacan were just so so. The cendol dessert is nice if you are a Malacca's sugar lover.

Author: Alex_e_SabrinaRivignano, Italy
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: Delicious food, typically Italian (original products!), authentic hospitality, kindness like a few!As frequent traveler for business reasons, I attend this place every time I am in Penang, I think it is one of the best Italian restaurants in the world.For the most demanding gourmets, chef Mario is always available for specialties on demand.Very good bar tender with his excellent drinks!

Author: Gareth_kwhongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Old Chinese Restaurant in KL - Retro and nostalgic, best ever
Review: Must try their pei pa roast duck. Crunchy roast duck skin and tasty duck meat. To me, it is one of the best in town. A little oily, but after some gym session should be alright. The second must-try dish is their gui fa shark-fin. It is basically scrambled-egg with shark-fin, wrap it with lettuce and add a little vinegar. If you don't eat shark-fin. Sorry for sharing this.

Author: rkigervaronHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Awesome
Review: Great food, great atmosphere/ ambiance and excellent service-- pricey and smallish dishes but a great experience nonetheless

Author: Philipgsearle
Title: Good tapas & cocktails with great service
Review: enjoyed lunch with family - we had sharing platters and cocktails (and mocktails for kids). Staff were great - couldnt be more friendly. Food was typical tapas but decent quality

Author: Ronnie C
Title: Hard rock cafe.
Review: Beautifully lighted in the nite. Is located along the river. There is a Wind Mill opposite this Hard Rock Cafe. Tbe Wind Mill is beautifully decorated lightings and beautiful flowers all round. Take a picture of this WindMill with The Rock Cafe as back drop. Simply beautiful

Author: E1000DUericv
Title: Dismal service
Review: This used to be a very nice place to come for lunch or dinner. However, today while I am still sitting in the restaurant, I see that the service has dropped to the bottom of the ocean. The food is dismal to say the least. Where this beautifully located gem was once one of our favourites it had now become one of the worst. What a pity.

Author: FriendsOfPeasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Previously I reviewed Makko. This trip we went to try out Cottage Spices. It's packed during the weekends but no queue outside. Service was slow but that's not really something I would grumble about if the food is worth the wait. We ordered prawn paste chicken wings, sambal kangkong, cinjalok (pardon the spelling error) omelette and otah.Small portion, poor presentation and average taste. We (4 of us) finished our meal in silence and left without trying the cendol. One thing I like about this place compared to Makko - the lighting. Makko is a little too dark for my liking. Cottage Spices is kind of like a zichar place in Singapore but the food we had 'cmi'.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: glaziermediaCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Loyalty counts for Nothing
Review: I've probably eaten here more than any other regular, 4 or 5 times a week. And yet today when they were busy, although there was one small table available, the only place they would seat me was a bar seat. These bar seats are situated in the main public route outside the mall and the table is about 9 inches wide. I love the staff and the food. But if the always grumpily manageress values one extra cover over her loyal and regular customers, then this regular customer is loyal no more.

Author: moveawayMalaysia
Title: Expensive, good service but poor knowledge of dishes by serving staff
Review: Dined with a party of 6 people whom were Spanish hence there was some difficulty understanding the menu. When we asked the waiters for explanations about the marbling grades of the beef (rated 6 to 9), the difference between wagyu, grain fed or organic and was met with little understanding of their products. Had to ask for the manager who gave us a good rundown on the types of meat. Service was unobtrusive and efficient but the food took an hour to arrive so we were given a complimentary Caesar's salad and 2 crab cakes to be shared by 7 people! Nice touch but they could have been more generous with the crab cakes! The meat was cooked to perfection and they did a good job or remembering how we wanted our steaks cooked and who ordered what. The side dishes were ok, creamed spinach was tasty but lumpy, the truffle mashed potatoes was cold but the sauces were very good. Very expensive restaurant but filling portions and nice ambience. Getting to Le Meridien is a real pain, the hotel parking is dingy and snug. Unfortunately there was a family with 2 noisy children whose parents did not control them and the staff did nothing to ask the kids to quieten down.

Author: sherrytam78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant experience with family outing
Review: We have a pleasant experience in this restaurant with our family in this restaurant. It’s a ala carte buffet style. You choose from menu and they will send over the food. Mitasu have 2 branches. 1 located in Central Plaza and another 1 in Old Klang Road. We visited both places before. Food wise KL one will be more fresh and tasty. Old Klang Road one interior decoration is more attractive but food so so.. KL price is RM 10 cheaper than OKR outlet

Author: 986BillN
Title: skip it
Review: poor service and food - you can do much better in the area.  The service is poor and the value for the money is not good.

Author: leonsrao
Title: Average
Review: Good matcha but the food is average and location at pavillion mall so u can drink there after shopping.

Author: AishahMoorsKuching, Malaysia
Title: Honestly!!!
Review: 1. Bad slow service: we waited for a good 45mins for our 1st dish to be served.2. Found not one long hair in our veg but 2 .. after we almost ate all the midin... yucks. 3. Whilst waiting for our food, I saw the waitress dropped a piece of chicken n hmm thought I saw them put it back on the plate n serve! 4. The soup taste of pepper and corn flour .. not nice at all.

Author: AdiFarhann
Title: Spicy Food Lover
Review: People would come here for their Nasi Ayam Penyet. It is a Indonesian Cuisine: white rice, tempe, fried chicken and spicy sambal gravy. The highlight of their dish is their sambal.

Author: RTWvisitsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tourist trap
Review: We found the food and service to be poor. The Beef Rendang was very tough and the Chicken Rendang had virtually no meat on the bone. Worst of all, they have they have the unacceptable and unhygienic habit of reusing disposable plastic drinking straws from other customers.

Author: 454lindylouCentral Portugal, Portugal
Title: Ignorant staff
Review: As we were staying in the Shangri-La we went to this bar twice. The first time we spoke to the young manageress who was friendly and helpful. On our next visit we didn't see the manageress and the staff were rude serving other people after we had been waiting for some time. It's time they were taught customer skills!

Author: E_najzy
Title: Service  was  good
Review: The workers were very Nice and friendly, price was reasonable, food was Ok too, specially loved their mayonnaise as well. The Place is quite big and suitable for events and meet ups, would recommend to friend

Author: Travelandtravel1962Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: BALA'S BANANA LEAF, BANGSAR: NEVER TO GO THERE AGAIN!
Review: We decided to try out this relatively new restaurant, the opening of which, we heard was much delayed. Probably to meet some requirements by the authorities. We arrived at the location about 2 pm on a Saturday afternoon.Location: Good location in Bangsar. Corner lot. As such additional seating by the side.Parking: As usual it is difficult to get parking in that area. We circled the block 3 times (no exaggeration). We would have left if we didn't get a parking place the ill-fated 3rd time around. Unfortunately we got a place to park.Look and Feel: Restaurant was well presented. They have spent to make it look reasonably good.Lighting: Bright. Open concept.Food: There wasn't much of a choice. A few vegetable dishes and two preparations of chicken. That's all we could see. (Could it be that we went there at the wrong time?) Even then it should not be that disappointing.Service: We were asked - Banana leaf or plate? My wife chose plate, I wanted the banana leaf meal. She was served rice on a plate and she went on taking some dishes as I looked around. We sat down and all she had taken was some vegetable dishes (probably spinach and potato and one more). I asked why nothing else and she said 'nothing else looks good' (with disappointment on her face).I continued to wait for my banana leaf rice serving. 10 minutes later, I got up, went in and informed them again that I want banana leaf lunch. In another 10 minutes, I helped my wife who wasn't very interested to complete her meal, to finish it. I was quite happy that my meal had still not come, for I found the food tasteless. Even the potato was bland.We finished the 'meal' and went to pay at the counter. We didn't have to wait to pay, unlike some other places. I saw this at the payment counter "The Taste says it All", and I totally agree. The taste said this place is tasteless! So, I had my lunch next door.It's not the location or decor. It's the service and the taste of food. I know of people who travel for miles, just to get a good meal. That is Malaysians!

Author: Bukusiki
Title: Birthday dinner
Review:
Came here to celebrate my husband’s birthday with the whole family and everything was just perfect! From the food, wine, service and ambiance, everything is exceptional! 
Highly recommended to those looking for an excellent dining experience!

Author: Jackie A
Title: A taste of home with a Malaysian flare
Review: I always enjoy visiting a new Hard Rock where ever I go... Just like many others filled with rock & roll stuff, food is good, drinks are pricy however environment very cool especially if you are looking hang out with Americans.

Author: Robert d
Title: French bistro food
Review: We have now been there a few times when in KL because the CdP serves good and authentic food at very reasonable prices in a typical French cafe atmosphere (prepared in actual copper pans!). And the location is great for people watching just like a French cafe should be.

Author: VKExplorerAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Dinner
Review: Cheap deals and good food. Despite the fact they ran out of the meal I wanted the alternative option was as good as.Very busy place and you get what you pay for. So if want waiters to be very responsive then this is not that kind of place. Overall good tasty meal with decent portion size meals.

Author: Sailormoon12Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Please do not clean the table by spraying the chemical while there are people eating beside the table
Review: I have been to Yellow Brick Road for brunch for numerous times. It has never failed me how delicious the mains and desserts are. However, during my recent visit, I was quite disappointed with the table cleaning service. I was eating with my peer beside a vacant table. The waiter came to take the plates. Before they wiped the table, they sprayed the 'detergent' on the table. Instantly, my friend and I could smell how strong the detergent was. Imagine my food was right beside the table and I was eating. I have lost my appetite right after that. I hope the waiters could be considerate next time when spraying the chemicals when patrons are eating nearby.

Author: Jimmy YPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Another long wait One Utama branch
Review: Bad experience at Kyochon One Utama branch. What supposed to be a 20 minutes wait for honey chicken ended up 55 minutes late. 4 tables at the same time has finished the food and left. But my table??!! uurgh. Asked the first waitress to check but didnt bother to come back. After 50 minutes, went to the cashier counter and ask for explanation. Say another 4 minutes. I was pissed off and asked them to take away for me. Then the manager went to the kitchen and dunno what she checked, then bring the plate of chicken and wanted to put on my table!!! Duh!!! No one bother to sincerely explain to me what happened. One of the cashier at least has the courtesy to waive the service charges. but overall i dont recommend that branch. Others maybe but i havent try yet. Good food is not defined by just the quality of the food, but also the quality of the service and overall experience.

Author: kmquek
Title: Nice Nonya food
Review: The food here is good. I especially like the freshly steamed otah and the chicken kapitan. The lor bak is also nice. The rest of the food was ok.

Author: LindySHY
Title: There's a time limit to eat at this restaurant apparently.
Review: The evening started well, food was good and everything. Was having a conversation after meal but was asked to leave after 1 and half hour , reason being that there is no place for other customer to sit ( no customer queueing at all when we were asked to leave ). This left a bad taste for the whole experience that was good to begin with. If wanted customer to leave after meal - put up a sign that says so then.

Author: Melli_Mello_75
Title: Amazing place
Review: Very friendly staff. Nice place to have a drink. Very good location. Very close to the twin towers. Good food. Ask for Rajib who is a very nice guy

Author: hilarydayCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: A good welcome and spectacular dishes
Review: This is a great place to go for a meal out with friends - low-key and friendly, with knowledgeable waiters to help you choose from the menu. Each dish we tried was a delight - the chicken roasted outside on the spit was juicy and flavoursome, the nan were freshly made, warm and soft, the various dishes which arrived at the table each had their own spices and flavours. I would definitely recommend coming away from the Golden Triangle to explore another area of the city and to taste the authentic Indian spices and cooking of this lovely restaurant.

Author: andrewmY8759PF
Title: A fresh approach to chicken
Review: Yes it certainly lived up to its name "fresh chicken" the breast  meat was great and the salad was fresh and had a good selection of ingredients. We would go back again

Author: geoff hBromyard, United Kingdom
Title: A great meal
Review: We were looking for somewhere to eat in Little India, and of course there are hundreds of places, so it was just by chance that we found the Bite n Eat on Penang St.We were warmly welcomed, but despite being really busy we were still served pretty quickly. A good selection and very tasty.Would love to have the opportunity to return, but unfortunately we are moving on.I had Buna Gosht and garlic Lappa.

Author: AhamadEmran
Title: Good food!
Review: Middle eastern food at medium price range. Nice friendly environment and very neighbourhood-ly.  One of the best kebab I've tasted.

Author: dostrovsNew York City, New York
Title: Would like to give it zero stars
Review: It is ungodly bad food. Only foreign tourists. The prices are very expensive for Malaysia. It is served "all together" within 10 minutes after ordering. Bland. Mushy. No taste or flavor. I suspect many dishes are defrosted. Service is dismal. I was shocked, because of good write-ups they get. Please avoid!

Author: Kapsicurean
Title: Place to go to late night if everything else is closed
Review: Local fare like Murtabak's, Nasi Goreng etc if you are really hungry. Staff are helpful but communicating in english was a challenge.

Author: FabioZanandrea
Title: Delicious
Review: Inside the Mandarin Oriental Hotel, the Mandarin Grill is simply extraordinary for beef!! Ribeye Black Angus is very recommendable!!

Author: Jayce-96
Title: Review on my visit
Review: This is a great place for a good time. Staff are so friendly. Drinks are just in taste. Will definitely come back here. Keep it up !!!

Author: 416atulr
Title: Hearty Punjabi meal in unpretentious setting
Review: Delicious Punjabi vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, in an unpretentious setting, at a very reasonable price. Walking distance to KL Sentral monorail. Will surely visit again.

Author: Maria KStockholm, Sweden
Title: Top notch
Review: Well, what more can I say about this place than "perfect"? Dining here is a truly memorable experience - you get to choose your own knife that feels right in your hand, and the cork from the wine is brought to your table on a platter. Moreover, the meet was perfectly cooked and tender, the wine delicious, the sauces so tasty we almost licked the dishes etc, etc. I celebrated an important birthday here and it made my day complete! Do not miss this place - and do dress up a bit, or you'll feel out of place.

Author: Flitterbick1
Title: Delicious rendang and helpful staff
Review: A great experience. Beef rendang was a real highlight. We also loved the softshell crab salad. Jonathan was our waiter and the service was excellent. He looked after us and our baby really well, getting us some noodles for the baby to eat. We would highly recommended

Author: DarienRobboNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious? We'll never know
Review: Looked really nice from the street, but stood around waiting to be seated; waited 10 minutes for menus, another 10 for our order. Drinks weren't chilled when they did turn up but may well have been warming nicely on the bench waiting to be served. Food didn't turn up - after 45 minutes of waiting we discovered they'd not actually handed our order in to the kitchen. Such a shame as we were hungry and looking forward to it. Grrr...

Author: YiM117
Title: Highly recommended
Review:
Recommended for gathering and couples ❤~ 
They provide a nice environment with variety choice of food 😊

Author: Shani APuchong, Malaysia
Title: I Had Too High An Expectation
Review: Traveled up to Ipoh last weekend for an eating trip and this restaurant was one of the top 10 restaurants to dine at with their "Wat Tan Hor" being highly recommended.Ordered "Wat Tan Hor", "Hokkien Mee" and "Yuet Kong Hor". The Wat Tan Hor was cooked differently from Kuala Lumpur where they are served in a bowl rather than plate with plenty of soup. It was definitely one of the best Wat Tan Hor I have eaten, the noodles were smooth and accompanied with a fragrant egg based gravy. Both combination made a great pair. Feels like drinking a hearty scrumptious soup rather than eating noodles but I am not complaining.The Hokkien Mee on the other hand was average and maybe due to demographics, I prefer the ones served in Kuala Lumpur.The Yuet Kong Hor tasted like a combination of both the Wat Tan Hor and Hokkien Mee. Wouldn't recommend ordering this if you have already ordered Wat Tan Hor and Hokkien Mee.Should also order their braised egg/tofu and meatballs. Not forgetting the ever so famous, Ipoh Ngah Choy.Be wary though by not ordering from the wrong restaurant as located just next to it is a restaurant called "Sin Tuck Kee".It isn't difficult to find a parking if you are willing to walk far but if you are lucky enough to find a parking nearby, you will be pestered by "unofficial parking attendees" directing you to a vacant parking space and they will require payment.Business on the weekend is bustling so unless you are prepared to wait, avoid this place =)

Author: Wendy K
Title: Great place!
Review: We escaped here to avoid the grim hotel we were staying in. Lovely rooftop bar with fantastic views and good cocktails. The restaurant served great food in large portions - so large we were surprised and didn't order a main. Excelent value.

Author: NSafinarGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic kopitiam in Kuching town .
Review: The best kopi o , kopi o peng ✌. Their roti kahwin with homemade kaya a must try. Their Sarawak laksa us superb. Popia too. The coffee shop is established way back in the 70's . Always jam packed with people. So be prepared to wait. Shop are clean. Cheap

Author: cjay98Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
Title: Worst staff ever
Review: *** Terrible Service and Terrible staff in summary a Terrible experience ***Worst restaurant I have been to in my travels around the world.Let me explain why... I am of south east asian origin and of brown skin colour. I was wearing khaki pants, a polo shirt and shoes, basically well dressed.. Some of the guests were in shorts and flip flops. I went there by myself to try the all you can eat yum cha. This is how it went...1) I was not greeted well and as they cant refuse me I was seated facing the Toilet doors in a corner where you can actually smell the urine and chemical odour.. the restaurant had more than adequate seating for me and when I asked to be seated elsewhere they ignored my request. I spoke in perfect English.2) I was served my dessert in the middle of my meal and one of the staff was snickering behind my back. I asked why is this served now and she said this the Chinese way in a matter of fact tone.3)After eating an average yum cha I paid for my meal and as I was leaving a heavy set woman with glasses in a suit who is a staff member hurriedly approached me and investigated me whether I have paid for my meal. I did not start a scene and was polite through the whole situation there as to respect the other patrons who were paying just like myself to enjoy a so called quality meal. I sincerely hope this message is seen and action taken to rectify this problem. The staff that discriminates all I can say is Shame on you..I will never site this place for the way I was treated and the food was mediocre too. I have had much more tastier meals at the food court across the street from here.

Author: Thomas HWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Check the Meat
Review: First visit two weeks ago. We had a voucher which was two main courses for the price of one. We ordered pork ribs and a farmhouse sausage which although took an hour to cook was very nice albeit absolutely huge. The menu said a pound of sausage meat but I think the chef works in kilo's because it was so big. When we tried to pay our bill the waiter said we could not use the voucher because his supervisor was not there, supervisor miraculously appeared and claimed that the farmhouse sausage is not a main course because it comes under burgers on the menu. We argued that due to the size it cannot be classed as anything but a main course, they relented and we got our 2 for 1 deal. Not too bad all in all and the food was actually pretty good. I think the problem was they did not know how to put the voucher through the till. Everyone deserves a second chance so final visit was an hour ago. Ordered lamb racks. The first attempt was red raw in the middle so sent it back. The second attempt was still raw but this time some of the meat was a very dark red and the it did not look fit for consumption so we had to send that back too. Finally changed my order to pasta as was starving. Some of the food is actually quite nice but I think the chef needs to understand more about cooking meat. Either that or they didn't like us from the first visit.

Author: Samanthazhang
Title: Scam Resturant
Review: The menu and name of resultant said hand-pulled noodles in chinese, the noodles came out mass produced and machine made. Manager still lied to our faces that the noodles are hand pulled.

Author: Waddywoody21Lincolnshire, United Kingdom
Title: Unattentive Staff.... Flat beer... Consistently poor experience...
Review: Been here a few times and although the food is good and reasonably priced, the staff are very unattentive and when it comes to serving you a draught beer, they don't have a clue.Twice we have been and ordered a starter and specifically asked both times for it to come first and then the main course to follow and both times..... you've guessed it, all the food comes together... When challenge the staff about it they just shrug their shoulders as if they don't care!!! The staff can regulary be seen standing around chatting whilst customers are waiting to be served ad that's not even when it's busy!!!!On to the beer.... Why oh why do they insist on serving flat pints of Tiger in Guiness glasses??? Tiger provide the glasses to all bars and these have the gadget in the bottom to keep the beer "live" and to keep a good head on the beer... At this place they serve you Tiger pints in warm Guiness glasses which makes the beer flat even before it gets to you!!! I have mentioned this to the staff numerous times and again always just get the shrug of the shoulders as they don't care.There are numerous good establishments in Bangsar and this could be a good place if they trained their staff in customer service and understood how to serve beer as it is intended to be served, but alas they just don't seem to care!!! They really do need to up their game!!!

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service has to improve
Review: It was a quiet night with less than 5 tables occupied throughout the night, and yet the service was very poor, staff with surly faces. Our teas were never refilled (despite requesting many times), dirty dishes were never cleared and the food either came all in one go, or took ages to arrive. Very disjointed dinner. Not reflective of a 5-star hotel restaurant for sure.

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Niche store, museum and cafe
Review: The Mamee brand with its cute blue monster mascot is a popular and well loved brand, but I had no idea until I came to Melaka that there was a store dedicated to it. You can buy their chips and noodles there (although not individually but only in specific sets) as well as other merchandise. There is a mamee monster statue you can get your photo with and if you pay extra there's a museum, workshops and a cafe.

Author: JPizz_86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Catch up with friends
Review: This street (Jalan Alor) is always busy with shops and restaurants, I’ve been coming to this restaurant for some years now and food is always good, moderate price, but it’s a tourist attraction and therefor heavy foot traffic! Good if there is a large group of people

Author: Byronrecruitment
Title: Fantastic Food, Cocktails and Service
Review: An amazing night out. We loved the food, the staff was engaging and informative. The cocktails were original and delicious. Great value for such elevated food. You would pay much more for a similar experience in North America or Europe. Highly recommend this to any food lovers looking for a special night out.

Author: jourykimKuala Lumpur
Title: Super crowded and very annoying patrons
Review: We have always wanted to try this place but were unable to get a table. Finally one day we managed to get a table near the door. Overall nice food and not too expensive. But the annoying thing is others who are there waiting for table will stare at you eating and I even saw one family sat on an occupied table and wait for that family to finish their dim sum. How rude ! Our table was not spared too. We finished off our dim sum and swear never to return . It may sound petty to some but this not the way to 'yum cha' and more so not the way to enjoy this delicate little hearts . Try others like Foh San or Yoke Fook Moon ( both opposite ).
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Liza-K-pieRichmond, United Kingdom
Title: Much better than I expected
Review: This Italian restaurant is in the Intermark Mall. The menu is plentiful with lots of choices (too many choices, with a specials menu and a long menu) however when the food arrived it was really tasty plus a very good glass of red wine. It was quite a busy place so we're reassured by this but my advice to the restaurant is to simplify your menu and specials and continue to serve up good food.

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: British style cafe serving Malaysian food
Review: If one longs for an English-like cafe experience, do visit this place. The atmosphere is like a British cafe but they serve Malaysian food, with breakfast lunch and tea menus; all ala carte. Parking is municipals roadside (do use the parking app as Shah Alams traffic warden is super efficient). Service is reasonably good but as in all eateries, you have to be vigilant for late serving of orders. Hygiene is observed. Price a tad higher than your average pick-pay-and-sit eateries but well compensated for the ambience and limited patrons at a time. Recommended

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad Ben's
Review: We went here yesterday about 6.00pm - given it was a holiday in KL we were surprised it wasn't full. It's a great location and the decor provides a great atmosphere. Otherwise we did NOT enjoy our eating experience here at all. Slow service, inconsistent food delivery - french fries arrived about 10 minutes before anything else, drinks service was slow and wrong, and we had one dish which seemed to have had no applicable sauce added to it. Three food dishes were not available so one of us had to order twice over - and just for fun we were charged for one that was not available and we didn't have.The explanation of all this comes from one of the staff there, who, on being asked a question on the food, replied that he didn't know "because we are all temporary staff". So poort staff = poor customer experience.

Author: MikeCMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simple place for a Malaysian meal
Review: Unlike food places in the city, this place is less congested and more comfortable.Food wise, it is OK. Very average by Malaysian standard. I tried the cendol and the curry laksa. Certainly had better ones elsewhere in Malaysia..but they are not bad. The price is not exorbitant, so at least you are not paying through your nose for average food.

Author: aotearoasTrier, Germany
Title: Hair...
Review: I read some reviews before I went here, one also saying that there was a hair in their food. I had the same experience at this place. Hygiene doesn't seem to exist here. Not to mention that you would have to eat two portions if you're hungry.

Author: 228alvinc
Title: Mediocre Mee Hunker
Review: Managed to beat the lunch crowd here to give this mee hoon kueh a try. Waited around 15-20 minutes to be served. I feel it's only mediocre at best. The "peeled" pieces of flour didn't have the silky smooth feeling as much as I would like. The pieces were kinda sticky to one another. Soup was also a tad too salty for my liking.

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No frills joint but enjoyable Japanese meal
Review: We walked into the simply decorated, no frills outlet to a strong whiff of fishy smell - I was worried my husband may be put off by it. But we got used to it soon enough.We ordered a sashimi platter to share, as well as the mentai rice - which was so addictive that we ordered another portion of mentai.The prices were not cheap (not reflective of the simple outlet!), but I guess reasonable for what we had. Usually crowded but the turnover of customers is fairly fast.

Author: Emma_N68Market Bosworth, United Kingdom
Title: Good location and nice food
Review: We were staying at the Pullman and this was just at the bottom of the hill opposite the Tua Pek Kong Temple so a great location for us.Really lucky to get a table right at the front overlooking the gardens and the river for dinner. Service was good and the house white wine was perfectly drinkable (always a bonus). The food was good and the service was great. Much to our amusement they had what sounded like karaoke at the temple across the road but think they were actual 'singers'. Very good meal with a beautiful view and a funny sound track!

Author: 468mihaicBucharest, Romania
Title: Let your senses guide your way
Review: It's the place to be! It really deserves it's place in tripadvisor's top - From the warm welcoming to the manager's feedback at the end! Our senses were tested from the beginning when we had the opportunity to see how can we handle the dark.. I lost miserably in front of my wife :))Getting in is smth else, extraordinary experience, very good food yet it's so hard to recognize common tastes.You must try it and give a huge respect to the waiters!!

Author: NZanUSAKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disapointing Customer Service
Review: Customer service terrible. Venue and concept great.Five Things to consider:1. After the steak and Lamb was brought out, we asked if there were vegetables to go with it. Was told no and the kitchen was closed and cleaned up now (only 8pm). Owner came out and said same thing. Not impressed. Therefore, were meat only meals except Steak had apple/potato salad side. Not a good fit beside Steak and Gravy...2. A hair found in the crème brulee.3. After showing hair to staff they offered replacement (but we had no confidence left now). Owner/Chef did not front…4. Multiple ants crawling across the table raised to waiter was ignored…5. Bill arrived and no deduction for “hairy Crème Brulee”. After expressing request for deduction, corkage was taken off the bill. Owner/Chef still did not front or apologise. Would we go back? Not even if you paid me.

Author: Cor LNew York City, New York
Title: DISAPPOINTING INDIAN FOOD
Review: Food was disappointing, small portions , and expensive! The curry was watery , the chicken Kadai tasted off and the vegetable biryani was over cooked & too mushy. The place itself was nice however and had really good air conditioning, plus it had live Indian musicians performing. Still not enough to make me Go back though!

Author: Hell2PleaseEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Non! Non! Non!
Review: I have eaten dinner here once and was disappointed by the lack of finesse, service and ability to provide an exceptional dining experience. In my lack of judgement, I thought, perhaps they do Afternoon High Tea really well - Wrong!I wish I had read May081's review, but I didn't. I completely echo her sentiments, but I am going to add some sarcastic embellish. High Tea 2pm to 5 pm Saturday and Sunday. Saturday, 8 ladies went to celebrate a forthcoming baby arrival. We too were greeted by last kitchen orders at 3 pm - really?! We would like some Sparkling please - oh finish already! Ok we will take a 400 buck bottle of Tattinger, it is afterall a celebration. It's not chilled, infact it's warm which we find after the cork has been popped and they begin to serve. Tea (no English Breakfast/Afternoon) is not included in your High Tea. So that would just make it just High then? But in their case it's not so High either. Apparently, it's acceptable in this French restaurant to serve sweet and savoury plonked on the same plate. Not terribly chic! The humble Pain Chocolat has graduated petit déjeuner to make it's way to the heady heights of the tiered cake stand and replaces the traditional scone, cream and jam. The rest of the offerings were nice enough but certainly nothing special, definitely more Delifrance than French patisserie.By 4pm we were being hustled to get on our way, so we headed to 38 at the Hyatt where patrons can rely upon friendly and competent service, not to mention exceptional food. To my girlfriends - I am sorry!

Author: JehanJasminNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Superb service and ambiance
Review: Just had a brilliantly relaxing Afternoon Tea time with my girlfriends. Their tea selection is quite extensive and we had a hard time making up our minds. Since the service staffs are very attentive, you will not find your cup empty for long since they will check on you to fill your tea. The food is well made and tasty, although i have to recommend the warm buttery scones they served with the selection of cream, strawberry and marmalade. Coupled with a plush interior and live music, you will be in for a treat!

Author: Stephanielenalee
Title: It was an 'okay' pub...
Review:
Read some good reviews about it and decided to give it a try...got there around Nine'ish was expecting huge crowd but nope...only a couple of tables are occupied. Band was ok...musics are fine...
Service is ok. Nothing to shout about actually ☺

Author: shaun517Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: 1st class location with 3rd class staff
Review: I just had my dinner with an old friend at the restaurant, no doubted it has a nice view of the Malacca town, but the staff that served us was rude. This supposed to be a so called 'fine dinning' restaurant, but the staff never smile. The front desk receptionist not even greet us when we arrived, and when I ask too much about the menu, he just pointed to the menu and ask me to read it myself. It's either he's can speak proper English or he just don't know how to explain. We sat at a table near the kitchen and you can hear the chef talking and cooking and walking around in and out of the kitchen like a 'mamak' shop. Very disappointed with the service and it really spoiled my night.

Author: Asian65Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Poor Service and Terrible Food
Review: Been here for several years now. Initially food quality was pretty good, but this last visit confirms that this restaurant is sliding backwards. Service staff are not attentive ordering and also getting their attention is such an effort... To make things worst, food quality great degraded with time, and this time nothing from the buffet line taste good. Need drastic improvements and a new menu. Disappointing visit and will not recommend to friends.

Author: JoAnnelovetravelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food n reasonable price
Review: The restaurant is near to pelangi mall. The restaurant is quite small. Have quite nice ambience. The price is reasonable n taste of food is nice. Just that we have to wait for awhile for our set meal which they served separately. We on weekday don't have to q too long for seat. Waitress all are very friendly.

Author: jasreeBatu Caves, Malaysia
Title: Good
Review: We had our berbuka puasa here, by paying for almost rm180 per person. Lamb and nasi beriyani taste good, i did try the asam pedas ikan kembung and have to wait about 15 minutes for them to cook, taste just ok but still smell fishy, some of the foods was not replenished, we was sitting next to japanese stall and someone is just grab a food and sit at our table, and we have to wait him to finish his meal, we reserved and paid for the seat but wondering how someone can eat at our table? did the management just simply accept the booking without calculating the total pax in the room? the foods is ok but hope in the next event they will replenished some of the foods because the buffet is not cheap

Author: clareguCullercoats, United Kingdom
Title: Worst som tam I've had - mostly sugary syrup
Review: It's a nice looking restaurant and the staff were friendly. However I had been really looking forward to this given the reviews. I was very disappointed with the som tam. It came drowned in about 1cm of a thick sugary syrup and was not spicy (at all - I think if they are not going to make it Thai style i.e. spicy they should tell you and ask you how you would like it), sour or salty (the other 3 main flavours you're supposed to taste). The overwhelming flavour was sweetness. You could have wrung the salad out. As it was I let each fork full drip for a little while to try to get rid of the syrup before I ate it (I was hungry). I told the waitress it was not good and too sweet, but she said oh, and did nothing. The mango sticky rice was fine, though the rice was sweeter than the mango - which overall worked out.

Author: E4441KDandrewf
Title: 20th anniversary trip
Review: Beautiful surroundings and excellent staff attitude. Excellent food and wine selection. This is how holiday dining should be.

Author: jeancV5381BO
Title: Variety Buffet
Review: I was celebrate my husband birthday here. All the foods are fresh and good in taste. We also had a piece of cakes for the compliment. Some characteristic desserts available here.

Author: Dantes GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lousy foods
Review: Here is a list of why u should go to Dutch harbor cafe: ambience and nothing else. I went there for dinner and since it is a cafe by the river, so expect cool breeze while u are having your meal. It is a good place to sit down and chill. However the menu at night is of limited options and all of them are set meals. No alcohol is served in this place. So if you are looking for someplace to sit down and have a drink, head to other place instead. I would rate the foods 2/5. I would strongly advised against this place.

Author: 447daphnetSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ok food
Review: if you havent tried peranakan food, you maybe wowed or impressed. But for the finer tastebuds... You will be disappointed. The belachan is blended not pounded. The flesh of the buah keluak is not removed and checked and mixed with mince pork and stuffed back in. As a result, you are eating it as it is... hard. The rempah was not mixed with sufficient ingredients. .. it tastes neither rich nor aromatic... simply riddled w salt in an attempt to make up for the taste. In short, I felt that took much hype for this place and to cope with the amount of ppl patronising this place., lots of short cuts are taken in their prep.

Author: Arvin10
Title: Dining experience at vin's
Review:
Food is 9/10 

Service is 10/10 (Waiter who served us was Snigdha she is very helpful)

Ambience is 10/10

Would recommend people to come here 

Arvin

Author: LukeysarbearBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious and different
Review: This restaurant offers a good range of vegetarian, fish and meat options. Including delicious starters and a complimentary scoop of ice cream to finish. We both really enjoyed out meal. It was an especially hot evening and so we were greatful of the friendly staff misting us with cold water!!Not the cheapest but far from expensive and worth it. Not quite 5 stars as restaurant's location next to road is not ideal..

Author: Jemmy T
Title: Average breakfast with a little high on price
Review: We ordered Char Kwee Teow, Fried Mee, Toast with Egg. The taste is average. Service is good. But the price is a little bit on high end i think.

Author: linzfj
Title: Not friendly
Review: The food is ok but the staff is totally not friendly. Wonder why they can’t train them to be more polite & courteous.

Author: BefascinatedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Extremely Disappointed This Time
Review: Ordered the Roasted Lamb Shoulder Set Lunch. This is 90% what was served as Roasted Lamb Shoulder. 10% edible was tough and felt like i went to gym for jaws.

Author: Ian KNew York, United States
Title: Disappointing
Review: I visited the restaurant for the first time last night with a group of friends for a birthday. We should have gone for the signature ribs which did look good. Instead we took the tapas suggestions of the waitress and ended up with 4 bowls of heavily fried food that all tasted like deep fried bacon. That on top of the staff dancing and singing to a jingle every 5 minutes when serving a shaken drink made for a disappointing experience.

Author: Tourist711938
Title: Yummy
Review:
I would visit this restaurant 
When i come Langkawi again ~~~
Food was good taste and good service!!!

Author: Helengray17Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: For tasty Malaysian delights!
Review: We ate dinner here twice, selecting from the Malaysian options. They were all very tasty and clearly the sauces were not straight out of a packet. The service was a bit erratic, but this is typical for Malaysia so nothing extraordinary. Great location and open-sided building lends charm to the place.

Author: YG60
Title: lousy sevices..
Review: lousy services... sashimi portion are small and most menu item not available.. one curry rice take 20min to prepare.. best to avoid this restaurant...

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb Halal Dim Sum
Review: 1st time visit to this place. Its situated above the Maju Junction Mall, can be accessed directly from level 5 parking. They serve pork-free dim sum and other chinese cuisine. Prompt service, clean place and the menu is extensive. Excellent food quality and execution. Great place to have group lunch or banquet events.

Author: Anil S
Title: good customer service
Review: Good service and nice environment, very nice place to chill and hangout with friends.the food are delicious

Author: catherinecssKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Moderate
Review: Easy to locate using Waze GPS. Went arnd 1pm. Lots of people. Very popular. Had to wait for a table. Service was good & fast. However, not sure what the fuss was all abt. BKT was so so. Either not enough herbs or soup too diluted. Ordered both soupy & dry types. First time trying the dry version which was quite good. No fun coz there'd be other people waiting for u to finish so they could take your table. Perhaps should go in the morning. Anyway, if you've never been there, no harm giving it a try.

Author: Kayli1223
Title: Total new experience of dining
Review: A session with food without sight, yet an opportunity to enhance taste palate. They have landed us into a comfortable and organized session. Preferable to choose 6pm slot to enjoy quiet ambience before the dinner crowd come in. Vegetarians are welcomed, worthy 4 course meal. Menu will be updated once in a 3 months and I might be doing the second visit.

Author: Zed Z
Title: Staff are great but Poor quality meats
Review: We decided to have chinese as the kids love their duck. The duck was well cooked but did not taste right.. the dim sums tasted all the same. Nothing bad .. until we got the chicken stir fry.. it was grissly and tasted of pure chlorine.. we both tried it at the same time and found ourself instantly spitting out what we put in our mouths. Will not visit again.

Author: iammichhhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I Will Not Come Back Again!
Review: First and foremost, we took about 15 minutes to secure ourselves a table. After submitting our orders, they took another 45 minutes to serve the food. People who came in later than us had their food served way before us.None of the noodles were delicious. They tasted the same, except they looked a bit different on the outside.

Author: Dolny5Phoenix, Arizona
Title: Late afternoon snack
Review: We visited around 3pm after a 4 hour car ride from Singapore. It was a nice spot to get a drink, cool off, and try some satay. My sister ordered the curry noodles and couldn't decide if she loved them or hated them. My brother-in-law finished them off with no problem. FREE wifi to enjoy (just ask the server for the password).

Author: ChrisAndrewRao
Title: Awesome deals and great food
Review: Great atmosphere and wonderful staff.  Did not wait long for my food and the buy 1 free 1 for beers is eye-catching. :)

Author: KimLengWPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Service without a smile and some bad food
Review: Nobody smiles in this restaurant and the chucked we ordered was really bad. It was already spilt. Good thing they could cancel the order but they should lyn have served it in the 1st place. For a high end place like this, you would expect some smiles. It's just sad. Really ruined our evening and family dinner

Author: Explore39610407819
Title: Tourist Restaurant
Review: The combination menues are quite attraktive. However, the spring rolls have not been made fresh ; the same for the desserts. Most of the main dishes have been good, the mixed Satai i would recommend

Author: kogn1Singapore, Singapore
Title: One of the most least value seafood restaurant I ever had
Review: This is super no value restaurant.A fruit juice for rm8 ? Plate of small boiled prawns for rm 42? Scallop with broccoli for rm38 this is a rip off restrauant regret choosing this over zinc before we depart for singapore .If the food is exceptional good I don't mind but it is so so only blahhhh!A complete rip off

Author: eileen1223
Title: Not worth
Review: I came here for dinner and surprised that the 'seafood' and the vegetables really not nice. I wonder why people recommend this restaurant, while the price not worth with the food came to us.

Author: hatimrazakMiri, Malaysia
Title: Room for improvement
Review: Went to try their Sunday lunch, the food served were ok. Some were delicious- ie their steamed chicken, steamed duck and the condiments accompanying it. Some were so-so ie the lamb vandaloo and the rest.In terms of selection nothing to shout about, pretty basic. However if you are looking for a good weekend lunch buffet i would prefer the one in Grand Palace hotel- cheaper price (RM52) but comes with unlimited amount of salmon and tuna sashimi. While their buffet spread wasnt that extensive; they served the more 'expensive' food; turkey, prawn,steamed garoupa, squids etc.Hope Pullman F&B staff can visit Grand Palace and see how it's done, so that the customers get more value for their money.

Author: TheArcticStarSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, service and ambience
