Review: I have visited the Singapore Hard Rock cafe before, of course, since it is where I reside.I wasnt prepared for the lovely , quiet ambience of the Hard Rock Cafe in Kuala Lumpur itself. It was the very first stop I went to during my first visit there, to see a friend. For lack of a better meeting point from her school (she was learning pastries making), I chilled out in the cafe having some wine and food to kill time.The waiters were all very jovial and friendly, and chatted with me. They also shared information about Kuala Lumpur along with some recommendations. One could really see their passion about service.The potato skins I had were crispy and tasty too - with generous servings of spring onions, cream and bacon bits on the deliciously soft potato skins. It was truly a delight. The interior was rustic, retro and nicely furnished, with lots of rock stars' posters. Great music was playing too. It was truly a great experience to visit.For more detailed information and photos, do viist:http://thearcticstar.blogspot.sg/2014/01/maneuvering-malaysia-kuala-lumpur.html

Author: stonewithnomossDuhok, Iraq
Title: Flat out bad service
Review: The food actually is not bad, but this review will be about the zombie like service. Never a smile, hard to get anyone's attention (and it was not that busy), and mistakes. What is the point of going out to eat if you are not going to have decent service. Again, the food was all fairly good -- standard for Chili's -- but the service was so bad, I wouldn't return.

Author: bobN6078XOSan Diego, California
Title: The illusion!
Review: I have been to a number of hard rock cafe locations. Never had this experience.Walk in and the A C is blowing. Love that part.... it's about 25% full, so expecting great service.Get to the table, and we are brushing food off the booth. Wait almost 20 minutes to give out order.35 minutes later the food arrives. Both burgers were undercooked to just over raw.Waited almost 10 minutes for silverware after the plates hit the table. They forgot my cheese and guacamole.The kicker. ... he wrote down our order.The manager (I assume) offered to refill the kids drinks. Tack on another site 10 minutes and when he approached our table with the check for the other table... yeah.... then realized he got that wrong and got the drinks to the kids.The fries were decent, the burger is good once it is actually cooked.Just the worst experience I have ever had at a Hard Rock Cafe. The price for food here is easily quadruple most all other restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. I will never return here.

Author: crabbyfishy
Title: Nice Cafe...
Review: Great environment for frenz gathering with nice bakery selection. They have updated the menu with more choices for those on healthy diet...

Author: kenishereKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overated! Poor food quality!
Review: As a local KL resident, Jalan Alor used to be popular with local street food with very affordable prices. However, since the 1990s when this place started to get popular with foreign tourists, the prices hiked and quality of food became very poor. For tourists from western countries, many would think it is a unique place to find local street food. Boy...they are so WRONG! Many popular street food hawkers has moved to Petaling Jaya or they died off. Touyrists should try going to suburbs like SS2 food court in Petaling Jaya where they can find more authentic street food with local price tags.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: Eva19920402Innsbruck, Austria
Title: Avoid this restaurant
Review: My boyfriend received a frozen pizza for the equivalent of 6euros, we could'nt eat a piece. And me...received a piece of frozen chicken and a kind of gluant rice, so disgusting. Waiting for the bill, the boss was just looking at us and waiting without a word and really didnt care about this situation. Don't waste your time and money, AVOID IT.

Title: Excellent service and bar
Review: Excellent service, helpful and hospitality from Aristotle and Faris H. Recommended on ground staffs!

Author: mei17
Title: Dinner
Review: This is a small restaurant which serves western and peranakan food. Food is ok but the serving size was small for the price.

Author: suetopia
Title: Exceptional!
Review:
Fantastic restaurant!  Lovely staff, absolutely stunning food and a super wine list.  We treated ourselves to the Chateaubriand and loved it!
Note- this restaurant is western prices!

Author: Tvignes
Title: Good food
Review: Small yet delicious food served in quite a funny way as I tried hot tiffin that comes with small cute masala tosai, uthapam, vadai n etc

Author: Dhanush V
Title: Bad restaurant
Review: I strongly recommend to go better restaurant as it is a worst service restaurant.  Please don't use ur precious time wastely in this  restaurant. Save ur time by avoiding this restaurant. Even delivery will be late. So order from other best restaurants

Author: Kin Mun C
Title: Awesome food !!
Review: You have total control over how the fantastic chop being served: as sandwiches, with pork lard rice or pasta! You can also find side dishes here which you could never think of to add on to your main !

Author: Darknight1522Orchard Road, Singapore
Title: Great service-Awkward Ambience-Mundane food
Review: Dear Folks,Probably you would know from my other F&B reviews that I love food and works in same industry. Hence my reviews tend me detailed. Following are my touch points:Service Mix of local and foreign service staff who are all equally trained and performed well. Smile on their face, welcoming and prompt. LocationWithin 2km from heart of Jb city but this place this enjoy its tranquility as its located near residential area. Parking can be scarce and easily you would miss out the exit road leading up to this place if you are not powered by GPS systems. AmbienceThis is the pulling down factor of my overall rating of this place. This is my first time and I went here on Saturday at 2.45pm. Considered post lunch timing which I always try to avoid as this can be in between hours where senior chef will excuse themselves from kitchen. Still I went there as my wife was adamant in trying this restaurant due to her colleagues's trumpet session. But to my horror they allocated few families that dining in at this hours to a small private dining room which expands lesser than 16sqm. There were solid 16 seats in this room. This is the first kind of experience for me. If you are a single male and happens to have a Neighbour table seated by bunch of gals then I'm sure you would enjoy but that's stop there. No other group age or group categories would prefer that kind of seating that require you to literally whisper. At least the management should invest in a nice sound system so a melodic music or song can be played in such private dining area. So you can imagine pin drop silence in 16sqm space that filled with strangers. Haha quite funny but I don't enjoy that as me myself have quite a considerable loud voice. Business folks should ask where they will be seated when they place reservation. Nothing great about the decor of the restaurant as well. Considering the owner make shift a large bungalow into restaurant, I will expect for more of distinct decor character from such restaurant.FoodWe offered bru coffee, tea, paneer pakora, Village goat Dum Briyani, Garlic naan, chettinad chiken. Personally I feel the Briyani was good but not definitely nowhere near to the taste will leave impression. The rest was bland and my wife feels the chicken was filled with overpowering of cumin seeds and it tastes like rasam instead. After tasting those I couldn't agree more either. The horrible size of beverage was laughable. For beverage price 25% lesser than Jb Hilton, the amount of tea and coffee is quite on thrifty I would say. CostFew ringgit lesser than RM100 for the amount of food we ordered. Easily this is the most expensive Indian restaurant in Jb. For this price I would expect state of art food from all angle. RM6.50+ for coffee and tea is really exorbitant as well.That's all about this restaurant. Thank you guys. Kind regards,Guha Shan

Author: Graeme LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Being older ordering by a mobile app is a real pain.
Review: Three of us had to sit at adjacent tables when in other places we could sit together. The menu is very limited for breakfast when one wants only a simple continental breakfast and not wraps or complicated sandwiches. Service was satisfactory but we had to ask for basics such as cutlery and sugar.

Author: suomi_soongSeoul, South Korea
Title: Mandarin Grill Steak to perfection
Review: Our experience at the upmarket steakhouse was up to perfection! three kind of Bread rolls with french butter, followed by delicious Foie Gras and perfectly executed Angus sirloin steaks and quality side dishes. The creamed spinach was fresh and delicious. The service was professional and unobtrusive. Lovely surroundings and we enjoyed wandering through the renovated Mandarin foyer afterwards.

Author: EvaT1482
Title: Dinner at Kota Dine
Review: I would like to recommend Kota Dine because the appetizer is delicious, chilli crab taste good and the desert is extremely delicious. Good environment and good service.

Author: ZylangKlang, Malaysia
Title: staff service can be better
Review: this is the unpleasant visit for us among the rest of visit in here. we noticed that the crew team was changed compared to the previous visit. we so upset with the service. service was slow and the crew totally need some training. we been waiting for table and it take time to take order as well. what make we angry is the crew didn't tell us that our order is out of order. they can inform us or make a recommendation instead of keep quite. management should aware about this as the price of your food should be equivalent with your service provided.

Author: Gennadybox
Title: Overhyped
Review: The pancakes here are bang average and the service is terrible. There is always a line outside this place for god knows what reason. We waited 30 minutes to be seated and when we were finally seated upstairs half the room was empty. It also stayed half empty for the duration of our meal meaning that staff were purposely not seating tables. We reckon its so that they can keep a line of people waiting outside to create buzz for the place. The food was also very poor and the coffee average.

Author: SwirlingTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bitter sweet.
Review: My wife and I had our dinner at the Mont Kiara branch. In order to secure a corner table, which we always preferred, I went to the restaurant one day earlier to make my reservation and specified which table we wanted. The waiter wrote down our preferred table and confirmed it. A staff called me in the afternoon the next day to reconfirm my reservation. I confirmed it, and again stressed that we wanted the table which I specified earlier.When we arrived, much to our disappointment, the table we booked for was occupied! I don't understand how, after going through such length to reserve the table we wanted, it was given away freely! It was Valentine's Day (and this was not an excuse really), so we didn't start off the evening very well . Thanks to these forgetful and 'don't-care' attitude of those individuals, we had to make do with a table next to the kitchen, which was warm and I was perspiring throughout. Didn't have a choice as that was the only corner table left. And there wasn't a single apology from the staff.To quench our thirst, we wanted 2 glasses of warm water, to which the staff explained that 'the pipe was faulty', thus we have to purchase imported bottled water that were placed on our table. What coincidence and how convenient.Food and beverage was generally good and service was fast. My wife ordered the Angelo Special mocktail, which was 'so-so' and I had Chianti. The beverages arrived within 3 mins. The starters we ordered, a bowl of mushroom soup and antipasto, arrived within 6 mins. Mushroom soup was a slightly bland, however the antipasto was very tasty. We loved the fact that it has so many choices on our plate.For main course, my wife ordered gnocchi and I had the hotplate Seafood Marinara. The Seafood Marinara was tasty. That was pretty much a highlight for me. Generous in portion, the dish came with mussels, clams, squid and prawns. Pasta was al dente, while the sauce tasted good and lightly spiced. Recommended. The gnocchi on the other hand was hard to eat. The pasta wasn't well-textured, which was a pity as the sauce was rather tasty. Our total damage was just below RM200.Overall, we liked the operational and kitchen's ability to provide fast service. General ambience of the restaurant was good enough for a date. However they need to listen with a heart when taking bookings and managing customer's preferences, especially during such an important occasion. We will be giving this restaurant another go, with lower expectations this time.

Author: Amani10Peterborough
Title: Eat Before You Pay
Review: We ate once at Cu Cha Restaurant on Jalan Alor after trying Dragon View the night before (see separate review). Unfortunately, the food here wasn’t nearly as good and the service was abysmal with diners being presented with the bill and being expected to pay at the same time their food and drinks arrived. Perhaps they’ve had problems with people leaving without paying (which isn’t surprising given the standard of the food!) but we found it pretty insulting.

Author: Noryn161Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not for catering
Review: This is my favourite Briyani place in JB. However, do not ask them to do catering. I recently ordered for 30 pax. The rice taste different and of different colour than their everyday rice. The dalca is too watery and not much gravy. Come here for the simple pack for one but don't ask them to do catering. It's sad, they should have applied the same standards over their signature dish.

Author: 246izar
Title: Average & Overpriced Food
Review: I've been to Madam Kwan's twice, once in KLCC and once in Pavillion. I loved Nasi Bujari (it's a flavored rice served with Quarter fried chicken, Beef Rendang & Prawn Sambal) I love everything about this food except the Prawn Sambal as it taste like the sambal has been overly poured with tamarind juice while cooking. The sambal is bitter.The price wise, some are worth the food taste & quality, some are overpriced.

Author: rafidahali
Title: A splendid Malaysian cuisine
Review: I went for a lunch buffet at this restaurant and found myself in the mid of splendid Malaysian cuisine.The buffet spread offered a lot of varieties and choices from rice, noodles and also a dessert. Please try "Masak lemak cili padi daging salai" as it if the killer menu here.Recommended to do rsvp for table as you don't want to be frustrated when you reach the premise.Carpark is RM3 per entry

Author: JasonTheAdvisorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food just so so
Review: Since I travel alone, hence the number of food is very limited. Ordered balacan fried bidin (Sarawak local vege) and a steamed assam fish. Taste not as expected. Balacan not tasty enough to match with the bidin. Fish is a little bit fishlike smell and assam is not tasty enough.The main sauces (balacan and assam) is very important in making the dishes taste good. But it disappointed me.

Author: 61_Connie
Title: Very poor
Review: we were there with friends for lunch. There was only limited selection of food and drinks disappointing. The quality was very poor.

Author: DMS17869
Title: Great Food Great Value
Review:
The fresh fish and food here is amazing.

The quality far outweighs the very cheap cost of the food, we had fish, prawns, local vegetables and rice along with a few very cold and refreshing beers.

Author: kraziteAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Best Chinese halal food in kl
Review: As a Muslim we don't have much choice of Chinese halal restaurant .The peking duck wrap is out of the world and the second dish the meat it's recommended sauté with asparagus and garlic.the stim fish is recommended basically all the ala carte menu is nice.we have tried the dim sum it's not so great.its better at China treasure at simedarby convention centre .

Author: kvxdan7501
Title: Parents’ birthday celebration
Review: Had a relaxing and wonderful time at Cielo. Jayson, Ivy and Liang were cheerful and attentive servers, they made the experience much more comforting! Will come again next time!

Author: AdeleneT
Title: Nothing great
Review: Had lunch here having read some good reviews. Ordered a curry chicken, prawns with petai, spring rolls and ngoh hiang. The curry chicken was just passable. The sambal prawns with petai were slightly better but the prawns were tiny and the petai sliced too thinly.

Author: erashmahmudKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent place to its great food and service
Review: We went there today for a random celebration dinner and the find was worth it. We enjoyed the food, ambience, energetic attention from the people working there. We were attended by one server call Kabil and he was friendly, attentive and informative. Their Pasta was really awesome, most probably the best, in KL I would say. Planning to go again soon to enjoy some nice dinner.

Author: DazzaRBKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Way below the benchmark
Review: We had very high expectations and had been eagerly anticipating the opening of perhaps the first real celebrity chef restaurant in KL. So you can imagine how disappointed we were when we were presented with what was pretty good food - but quite ordinary. If the same dishes were served to us in say Rakuzen then we would have no complaints. But when you pay 10 times the amount for those dishes then that's akin to sticking an Armani logo on a white Pagoda T-shirt and charging RM500 for it!Our group of 6 pax all ordered the omakase as we wanted the maximum experience. They did not accord us the normal Nobu service of having one of the chefs explain to us what dishes to expect. This I believe is a very important part of the dining process for omakase as it is the teaser or trailer to whet our appetites. The waitress said the chefs were too busy.They really should rename the omakase to just "Set meal" since that was what it really was. We compared in real time with a friend of ours who had just been to Nobu the same week and sure enough, they served out exactly the same dishes. I can't imagine what creative chef would have a "whim" that lasts over a week! We had specifically requested to NOT have chicken but sure enough, they went on autopilot and served it to us in the nth course (we lost count, and interest after the 2nd). For the price we paid, we would expect fine ingredients such as uni (sea urchin) and other exotic creatures but no, they served us chicken.There was absolutely no Wow factor that we were expecting - certainly no creative dishes fused with Latin American flavours and really nothing special at all on presentation.I really hope Nobu-san himself comes to visit and rectifies this anomaly to his famous name - or else Bobby deNiro is going to come round with a baseball bat to sort things out!

Author: Romain1136493New York City, New York
Title: Overpriced and terrible service
Review: Place to avoid. Food is average, overpriced and the service is terrible.We went there yesterday. First, the price is easily two times higher than other comparable places in K. For that price we were expecting a good service and nice food.Truth of the matter is we ordered chicken and a pizza. After 10 minutes my chicken comes but not the pizza of my wife. 15 min later the waitress said we would have to wait a lot for the pizza as there was a group who ordered many. Question: why with such high prices order does not come at once? My wife order the chicken and waitress said she is sorry. Meanwhile is chicken is getting cold. We saw many chicken dishes served in front of us (priority you know what it means?), ordered french fries to wait, insisting it was because of her mistake. Her chicken comes finaly, almost one hour after mine. It was very very average.They made us pay for the french fries and gave us nothing for ruining our dinner ! Incredible ! Most expensive place we have been in borneo and yet the poorest service! Next time we will consider a food court. No glamour name or waitress but no lies in service quality. Dont good there they are much better places in K.

Author: MM693Sydney, Australia
Title: Great view of the bird park while eating
Review: Good food and fast service while looking over the bird park. There was a mixed menu which suited both adults and fussy kids. The juices were awesome and refreshing and the nasi lemak was tourist aimed, but still nice. The pricing was a little more than usual, but that's due to the location.

Author: Wander158453
Title: Excellent lunch buffet
Review: We had excellent lunch buffet + yee sang. The food selection was amazing, Asian and Westerns . The food generally good quality. Ate the best and fresh sweet and sour mussels dish and must have yogurt mango ice cream. Yummy...But i think due to not enough staff, we always have to wait for a while for a staff to come to our table. But overall, they're very helpful.

Author: jervenus0932
Title: Ordinary home-styled cooking with 5 star hotel pricing!!
Review: Wasn't my initial choice but visited this restaurant due to huge crowds in other nyonya restaurants in my list, got to know Aunty Lee through random browse in some food blog with high recommendation. Decided to give it a try n make a call to shop, to our surprise, there was still table available for our big group. The shop is located rather far from city center n difficult to locate if you driving in late evening. Small shop with only 6-7 tables, 2 tables were occupied when we enter, too bad I shd had pre warned of that on a Saturday dinner time when all other nyonya restaurant are fully occupied with huge crowds. Environment wise nothing to comment abt, not much deco. After food order, we waited not too long for the food served. However, we got shocked with the food portion served, it is small to the price stated, our food bill was RM465 for 12 adults n 4 kids. Overall the food tastes very normal, portions are pathetically small, and overpriced! For that price, we feel we could get a better quality food, more satisfying food portion, n nicer environment in city center! Would definitely not going back n not recommended anyone..

Author: erdtirfanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A really nice cafe to hang out
Review: The place is so nice, plus it's near to street arts nearby. It's quite less busy in the morning, therefore I'd recommend you to go here with your friends and family. The decoration of this cafe is also really nice which gives you a very warm feeling as a customer. Would come here again soon!

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Too sweet...
Review: Having lunch for the first time here. The place set up was really impressive and grand looking.However the food were rather too sweet for the BBQ lamb and chicken, as well as the unagi on rice set.The consolation is the waiters keep asking us whether we want refills on the appetisers, the kimchis.

Author: Mr_HafLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Japan in Langkawi
Review: If you ever been to Japan, when you walk through this place you will feel that japanese vibe flowing through this place. The place was very Kyoto-ish. Inside a cute japanese waiter that is very good in english is so friendly taking order and serving. The food is very authentic and yes SAKE! <3

Author: BeckysOwner
Title: Kenneth Wong
Review: Buffet dinner(birthday) at Vasco's for three on 16th March. Dining was not the issue;it was the 40 minutes circling the very limited parking on 2 levels to find a parking slot. Let alone having to navigate haphazard and double parking intruding onto the pathway. (There was also not one relevant person in charge of the car park offering any assistance;privatising or outsourcing such services to those who do not subscribe to the high standards expected of the Hilton brand can be very detrimental) Maybe opening up tenant parking after office hours for hotel guests can be considered.On another note, credit should be given to Cik Noor from Vasco's for her attentiveness and efficiency in attending to us and also to the Concierge staff for their assistance in my wife's "mishap" with her shoe. Thank you all again.

Author: louisa_koch
Title: Nice atmosphere but bad surprise
Review: Was eating here and found a caterpillar in my veggie curry. That happens. I got part of my dish newly served but there was nothing else. No refund no real sorry. Still staff is nice and the location is great.

Author: KT785KL
Title: Average, expensive.
Review: Went here twice in a week for two parties, The view is good but there are several other places with as good or better views. The food was good and service at the venue itself was okay but I wouldn't say superb. Prices, especially for bottles of whisky were over the top. A mark up of up to 100% of retail price is okay but 250% on a 18 year bottle? It is all about the "image" and "exclusivity" but the cracks do show. If you are going there but don't mention that at the ground floor reception, and just ask directions to get your bearings, the answers are very cold and they even frown. The moment they realise you are a customer, they become overly smooth, with lots of smiling and grinning.

Author: Ngan H
Title: More expensive
Review: This corner restaurant offers Chinese food, with various stalls residing inside. There are varieties of food to choose. The food generally is good. The downside is the price here is more expensive than similar restaurants nearby. Maybe the stall rental is high. Then there is the issue with drinks. The drink is not good and expensive. Don't know why the drinks here is charged higher - either the rental is pricey or the business owner likes money such. Regrettable.

Author: kenkeh
Title: Had the not so fresh seafood
Review: My experience with this restaurant was not good , I'm not happy with the prawns which was not fresh though it was huge . So I don't frequent this restaurant anymore after the incident !

Author: MukulJain_2014
Title: Bad Food!!
Review: Very bad food. The taste was not at all good. There are definitely much better places in the area. Would not recommend this place at all.

Author: molly_cher62
Title: Great Seafood and fast service
Review: Had dinner here at L and L Seafood restaurant at Pending. Staff would readily invite and usher you to a table to secure business. Ordered fresh coconuts which was really sweet and delicious. Had prawn fritters, steamed fish, cockles, water spinash with shrimp and cangkuk manis. For a four person meal with 5 dishes including drinks, we only paid RM128.00 which is quite reasonable. Good place for having seafood and fresh local vegetables.

Author: Chin Leong SLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great dinner and great atmosphere
Review: It was my company year end dinner and we had a very good italian dinner at this place! There are many italian restaurant in langkawi but the food here is something very italian make you remember for its cruisine! Even our kids were dancing on the floor after the dinner! Highly recommendation for all to try it! Thank you mr. Lorenzo for the wonderful setting and arrangement!

Author: J9279JTnataliepBucharest, Romania
Title: Pricey
Review: Really lovely setting and atmosphere in this restaurant. Waiters are attentive. Food was delicious. We had the sushi selection and a few other side bits, such as, the miso soup, tempura eggplant (I found this slightly tasteless) and some chicken skewers (get the spicy sauce. My partner commented these were the best chicken skewers he ever had). Washed this down with some delicious cocktails and a couple of deserts. Food was delicious. However, personally thought it was all over priced.

Author: shylocktubal
Title: Good but not special
Review: This is an expensive restaurant by Penang standards. It's very pleased with itself and a bit stuffy. The food is okay but on an island where you can eat better at a tenth of the price I wouldn't go back

Author: AstralexPhu Quoc Island, Vietnam
Title: Horrible
Review: Based on all great reviews we have decided to head to this night market on our arrival to KL on a Saturday night. Well it might be your place if you are into grilled pieces of cheapest hotdog, crabsticks, "shrimps" made of same crabsticks, half-dried "fresh" squids or fish-heads in plenty of curry. Otherwise spare your time and stomach. Somebody used words fresh and higienic about this place. In my expirience it was the opposite.

Author: 33anujgMumbai, India
Title: Miles away from thai food
Review: I have eaten thai food not only in Thailand but in other countries too and by far, this was the worst thai food I have eaten. The green thai curry tasted of raw turmericThe stir fried chicken with cashew was stinking of bad fish sauceThe chicken in all the dishes was over cooked and chewy The thai tea tasted more like coffeeTheir lemongrass juice was water flavoured with lemongrassBean curd was the only decent thingEverything was super salty. Had to leave most of the dishes & sauces. Ate only the proteins from it - was so salty.Wasn't worth the price at all. Burger King / KFC would've been better I think.

Author: jamjarMaltaPhuket, Thailand
Title: Christmas bUffet
Review: We went as a family of 4 - 2 adults & 2 kids. Super buffet with tverything you could wish for..fresh seafood..lobster, crab, salads, fresh pasta, steak, satay...and the desserts oh my! Great atmosphere, good service even though the restaurant was full our glasses were kept topped up ( with the free flow wine package) Lovely way to spend Christmas Eve.

Author: TravelChargerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Malacca Nyonya Food
Review: This restaurant has many awards and appear to serve authentic Malacca Nyonya Food, however we are slightly disappointed with the taste, not too authentic in our opinion...there are other better choices within Malacca, can do more research. However this is not crowded on weekday evenings when we visited.

Author: viag8
Title: So disappointing
Review: Website says open at 10am. They accept dine in only after 7pm, is that a joke? They force you to fast even if you do not want. Ridiculous

Author: Changjo88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Dancing with a Smile
Review: Recommended by a business colleague, we tried out Dancing Fish for lunch. I must admit I was not one bit disappointed. The restaurant is tucked in a quiet corner on the 3rd floor of Bangsar Shopping Center. We sat at the patio area which was designed with privacy for a business discussion. We were recommended some lovely dishes including the famed dancing fish, roasted chicken in special Sudanese herb and the fried duck reminiscent of my meals in Chinatown London. The chef was kind enough to prepare a special rendition dessert of light and fresh lemongrass jelly, coconut ice cream and refreshing mango on shave ice. We did well finishing up a big meal. Would definitely make my return trip next time I am in KL.

Author: Toje7162Brisbane, Australia
Title: Did Not Enjoy This Dance
Review: Had dinner here with friends on a Friday night. Opted for the set meals. The service was ok - nothing outstanding and what you would expect from a place like this. Unfortunately, the food failed to impress. There was nothing to rave about. Everything was overly fried, dry and lacked any defining flavor. Even the barley water lacked flavor and if possible for a drink, very stodgy and tacky.The mango dessert looked great but was just sliced mango with a scoop of vanilla ice cream in a glass of crushed ice. Personally, we would have preferred to have hit our local mamak stand and had an outstanding meal for 10% of the price we paid. After the build up of expectations, this was a mega let down.

Author: Hemant_Ggn
Title: Beautiful setting for a meal
Review: Went there but found it very expensive. So did not try the food. However looks really nice. Maybe will try once?

Author: Nikoleta G
Title: Worst food in Malaysia
Review: We thought to stop by for lunch while in Melaka and regreted it. I had one of the wok meals and my sister had the lunch special. That was the worst food we had in Malaysia and maybe even ever. The vegetables were spongy and tasteless, the chicken wasn’t cooked properly and was raw. Not to mention it was way overpriced even for a good and tasty meal. So disappointing. Never again

Author: HHinKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Huge disappointment
Review: Went there on Sunday evening, as soon as walking in one could feel something is not right, only 2 tables, 4 people in the restaurant. The old sommelier has left, all new waiters, I keep this short, just returned form Gaya Island Resort, where we had fabulous service and great food every day, Gaya Island Resort is also a YTL place. I was told the the Feast Village will be renovated soon, but this is not a reason the let your flagship restaurant in KL go downhill. The service was lousy, the food was lousy, but the price was very high !!!I leave it at that, nor sure if i even want to return once the refurbishment is finished.

Author: alfredphuakimchaiKuching, Malaysia
Title: Not as reviewed
Review: We reached there for an early dinner ard 6pm. I guess the pictures taken in the dark looks different when compared to the real place in daylight. The inside of the cafe is a little dirty to our liking so we moved to the bck (along the river) with the hope of a better seating with better view. There's only a two or three small tables with two chairs each to a table. It's definitely not as romantic as I thought it would. Probably they have yet to laid out the tables. We ended up didnt dine there and walked to another place to eat.

Author: Lynne WAbu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Disappointing in many ways.
Review: Sadly, this meal was very disappointing because of a number of factors. The food choice was limited, especially if you required vegetarian options. The area where the buffet is served is far too small. It was very crowded and the restaurant didn't even seem full. This isn't helped by greedy people who insist on piling food on their plates as if they haven't eaten for a week.We opted to pay for a seat with a window view. Don't bother. all the people who haven't paid for this just come and stand by your table to take photographs anyway, spoiling both the view and the atmosphere.Waiting staff tried to remove our plates before we had finished throughout the meal and at the end of service proceeded to take unfinished plates away, telling us that time was up. The price tag on the meal doesn't match the quality of the food or service and we certainly won't recommend this dining experience.

Author: rodrieva
Title: Fill both - tummy and heart
Review: I will start with atmosphere - very nice and relaxingService - on time and staff is friendlyFood - I have visited this place a number of times for the Indian sweets. I now love the sweets specially the rasmalayi and gulab jamun. The pricing is budget friendly and they serve food in good portion.

Author: JimDKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Beef Rendang ever!
Review: I had been so looking forward to trying the much heralded local cuisine at this restaurant,but so disappointed by the poor quality ingredients used in some of the dishes. In particular, the beef was inedible and thankfully the restaurant manager agreed. He did offer to change but by the stage of the meal we were at and with so many errors being made by our rather disinterested waiter, we just wanted to get out. Get the basics right.....I have been living in KL for 10 years and this was the worst beef rendang ever! The staff were not up to 5 star standard and the one we had should not be allowed contact with general public. I had to almost beg for more water during our meal. Interestingly a few tables away were a group of Hyatt Managers dining and they were getting first class service!

Author: PinkAddictKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Didn't Meet Expectations. Sad to be the one to give this review but want to share my experience
Review: Having trusted TripAdvisor for a while now when planning my trips, I made sure I dropped by this restaurant bec of the rave reviews. I even booked the boutique hotel beside it thinking that we could at least get a decent meal while our short stay in Johor (since I was bringing my daughter to see Legoland). Also, let me note that I live in KL and spend summers in France for the past 9 years, hubby is French -- so I had high hopes for this French restaurant when we went there.I booked dinner for my family, True enough the waiters were friendly and smiling when we entered. I do not doubt that they are eager to serve. However, all things got dampened when I ordered the FOIE GRAS. It came with some salad and after I ate the first bite of the foie gras and a piece of the cherry tomato, I noticed something moving -- and i mean MOVING and WRIGGLING -- on my plate! It was a little worm! The waitress quickly came after I called her and I asked her if she can see the wiggly thing. She muttered "sorry" then took the plate away. When she came back, she said it must be from the salad. I would expect at this point that the chef would come to apologize -- no I didn't get that. She just said here this one no more moving stuff inside. Hmm... seemed very unapologetic to me. I would think they should give it for free after that horrible experience ... i wanted to throw up after that but held it together because I did not want to ruin the evening (which started badly). The mushroom soup was good -- that I can vouch for it. The rest of the food was okay. Nothing fantastic. I had the steak, which was okay and a bit dry for my taste. Hubby took some chicken with mushroom and he liked it. While my mother (whom I was entertaining as well bec she came to visit me in Malaysia as my guest) had the grilled lamb which I found a bit hard but didn't want to complain. In the end, I was disappointed that I did not have a formal apology... nor an offer to discount that silly item with wriggly worm. They took the plate away too fast for me to take a pic! When the dinner was done, my mom kept wondering if they will give the foie gras for free since they didn't come to formally apologize... and she couldn't hold her tongue and told the waiter "No free dessert?" when I asked for the bill. I guess they felt guilty about what happened and did come with some free dessert (after being prompted). I did come back the second evening -- simply because of convenience. My daughter and mother were tired after Legoland so they stayed at the hotel while hubby and I went back to Chez Papa to get some soup and a quiche for a light dinner. We tried the different wing of the restaurant (the bar part) which I find was better atmosphere albeit some mosquitoes flying around. We had a forgetful waiter who did not come with our bread -- and had to remind him 4 x before we got it... then the waitress from the other evening came to serve our soup jokingly told me "Dont worry there is nothing moving in there" -- not sure what to make of that... funny? or not? We ordered some cheese which hubby found very reasonably priced (that is one good thing about them).. however we felt overlooked bec the owner and chef were bust with their "regulars" and seem to have forgotten us ... and our need for bread to eat with the cheese. I even finished my soup sans the bread -- which our forgetful waiter said was coming... sigh. I guess we were the lucky ones who encountered some kind of incident at the restaurant. I just think they need to improve their customer relations when it comes to incidents like this.For me, not sure if I would bother to go back there the next time I am in Johor to bring my daughter to Legoland. Will probably try other places. If not for the convenience beside the boutique hotel, I would give this place a miss and try to find other gems in Johor.Oh... and my honest opinion on their atmosphere -- i guess some people find the place charming which I do not contest bec those are personal tastes. As for me, I found the place very old, in need of upgrading. If you look up the ceiling you can see they didn't bother fixing it properly and tried to cover with some cloth... the interior could benefit from some fresh paint and some upgrading.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: mrymalisa
Title: Family / Birthday Dinner
Review: Miss Azura&jdaver were very welcoming and provided great service for us. Miss Azura made us feel very comfortable and assisted us throughout the night. Service was excellent! Will definitely be back.

Author: PJK7777London, United Kingdom
Title: Poor service, average food
Review: Arrived as a group of 6 highly excited for our meal here having read the raving reviews. Our experience started off with a cold reception; whereby we told to sit and wait, and were then ignored by staff for over 30 mins before we had to ask how much longer the wait would be for a table of 6. Another 10 mins or so passed with no reply/action being taken. Had to ask again, and immediately a table was prepared for us. The food ordered was tasty albeit more bone than meat which was problematic for the meat eaters of the party, and a vegetarian dish tasted distinctly of fish. Would recommend booking in advance if you wish to receive a friendly and timely service.

Author: Regzana
Title: Very over rated. Don't waste your time.
Review: After reading all about this place on trip advisor and being recommended it by our friends I'd have to say it was very disappointing. We had 3 entre's and only 1 was good, the fried anchovies. The laksa was tasteless, if the other man on trip advisor thinks that is the best curry laksa he has ever had then clearly he hasn't tried a decent one! I personally wouldn't bother, unless you want very average food.

Author: William C
Title: Horrible Service
Review: Came here during lunch hour on Sunday. Very bad service. Waiters were rude to customers, shouting for them to wait.

Author: GraySurferKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 2 hours waiting for meal
Review: Previous experience was great dining experience. There's even manager who does magic show. Worse experience last year, a day after Christmas. Waited for 2 hours for steaks. The waiters services are horrible. Not clue about their own special Christmas menu. Never bother to follow up with kitchen. Just gave the same reply "It'c coming soon" without even moving to kitchen to ask. The waiters spend more time grouping around in drinks bar giggling and chatting instead. On the steak, overcooking (we ordered raw & mid) is probably poor cook performance, but overcook with charcoal burn is bad. C'mon it used to be much better. Environment is still great thou. Nicely done seasonal deco and cozy place.

Author: JohnI273Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: " Poor excuse for casual dinning "
Review: I proceeded reluctantly with my friends to eat at Souled Out I've been there before was never impressed. Well this time I was for sure unimpressed and here is the reason why. I ordered a cheese burger can't mess that up correct will wrong. The server asked how I would like it done. I said Medium! When I got my cheese burger number one I could tell the cheese WAS NOT melted that in its self is a mortal sin! Next I took a bite into the burger and it was RAW inside, therefore I cut the burger in half to make sure and lord and behold it was raw. It was confirmed by my friend whom I was having lunch with. I called the server and I said this is raw, she said its medium! I don't think so I made it a point that its raw. She called the manager and he agreed it was raw, to my horror he want ed to recook the same burger!!! What I said you give me a new one!!! how tacky is that taking a bite out of a burger and cut in half and recooked! Then he proceed to tell me that it would take a long time for a new one, wanting me to back down for my recooked version of the cheese burger. I told him I got all day so get me a new ONE! about 20 mins later the new one came and it was only ok, but the Cheese was STILL NOT MELTED! take a pass on this place.

Author: Hou_dxbShanghai, China
Title: Worst dinner experience in Malaysia
Review: Based on the high rating here we went to try this restaurant we paid 746MR for 3 persons buffet dinner and food quality was really bad below any quality we try during our stay in Malaysia. The restaurant decorations is old fashion and outdated Avoid this place by any means it’s not worth any penny

Author: danielk10629
Title: Very good service and food
Review: service was amazing and food was even better. Was a very good experience and will definitely come here again. Thank you Farquhar Mansion

Author: 915madss
Title: Really good food and service! The owner puts all of his passion in his restaurant
Review:
Top top service. The owner was very sweet from we arrived, and talked with us alot. The food was excellent, took a little bit of time, but it was well worth it. The dishes tasted so good and was really fresh.

- mr. Mahdi

Author: Elizabeth-Thereselondon
Title: Nice ambience with Chinese music instrument playing in the stage, reasonable dim sum
Review: Upon arrival, the ambience and the look of this place is no much different to the other dim sum place that we have been before. What's more was the live Chinese instrument playing at the stage, it was a nice thing to have but the music was way too soft and the loud noises of human chattering have completely drowned the music.The selection of dim sum when we were there was not as interesting or vast as most of the other places that I've been. The food however, was quite fresh and not bad taste.The cup and the bowl were dirty that I had to ask for new set when we first sit down. The toilet was clean. The service was only ok especially slow when come to ask for the bill - we had to walked over to the other side of the room to speed up the process as there are staffs walking around but none of them taken our bills with them after we had asked them for it more than three times. I don't think the price was cheap in this place as it costs about MYR about 100 for less than 6 dishes. The deep fried food was not very good as it was pretty dry and not tasty.

Author: AnBu67Hua Hin, Thailand
Title: Where are the managers?
Review: We had a short break and decided to stay for a few days in Miri at the Pullman. We arrived after 6pm and were quite tired so we decided to go for dinner into at cafe. There was only one other table of 4 there which seemed to be done with their dinner. So, we were the only table left in this big restaurant. One young sever, quite friendly but not that experienced, was helping us with our order. She said the the glass of red wine had to be collected from the bar. She didn’t write down our orders of two main courses and the two side dishes. First came the fries, half way through my rib eye arrived. Have way through my that they wanted to serve us a pumpkin soup which we declined since we ordered the roasted pumpkin as a side dish with our steaks. My wife’s short ribs came long after I had finished my steak. By that time she wasn’t really hungry anymore because she ate all the fries. When leaving the restaurant we saw a manager/supervisor which was nowhere to be seen during the service where she, at least, could have asked us if all was ok or if there was a problem with our order. No wonder the restaurant is empty. Food was actually not bad at all...only that there is no concern for the customer which, in a 4 or a 5 star establishment, you would think they would care!

Author: vincemllim
Title: Moderately better
Review: Though the other two in the neighbourhood r established, the quality has deteriorated through the years. Choice given, this outlet would be much preferred.

Author: MFadilKMauritius
Title: Minimalistic Lunch Buffer
Review: I lunched at Atmosphere 360 on the 27th November 2016 ; the place was not too crowded. ticket to Atmosphere 360 give you access to the Observation deck also.The Pro : Scenic View. You can see up to Batu Caves. the rotating platform on which you are dining gives you different perspective of Kuala Lumpur.The Cons : Poor choice of buffet, extremely minimalist and average quality. Old Cutlery.

Author: Roving395750Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very poor food quality
Review: What a big disappointment! We were expecting great Cantonese cuisine, but what did we get? First, steamed scallop ON a shell, literally! because the scallop was already detached and just placed onto the shell with a big dollop of chopped garlic on top and hardened glass noodle underneath. Garlic tasted raw and the scallop rubbery! RM23 per rubbery scallop mind you.Second dish is grilled spare ribs "supposedly" marinated in red wine. No taste of wine, just plain sweet and nothing else. The little meat there was, was stuck stubbornly to the bone.. it was not a melt in the mouth moment! Each portion is just one bite size and one of my friend's "bite" was just bone! Each bite size is RM10.Ok, admittedly the stir fried vege (RM48) and eggplant in hotpot (RM28) were acceptable but nothing to shout about.Next, the steamed free ranged chicken c/w steamed rice. hmm.. why is it not steaming hot? and where is the aroma of steamed chicken?? The meat was soft and flaky (like ordinary chicken), tasted flat and like its been frozen for ages. The condiments of ginger and chilli blend did not help at all. Sorry to say, the chicken rice sold in my neighborhood tasted way better than this. Half free ranged chicken cost RM108.Our above concerns were conveyed to the head waitress. She put on a blank face while listening and mumbled she will inform the chef of our comments and walked away.I used to love eating at Ming, not anymore!

Author: Legal_itinerant
Title: Average Harrods
Review: Just another KLCC cafe without any real distinction other that carrying the Harrods name. Staff are OK and so is the food but that's about it. Convenient because it is situation on the edge of the mall and by the Mandarin Oriental hotel.

Author: HemaVikPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Relaxation with good food..
Review: This was my first visit to this cafe. The pasta carbonara is highly recommended! Kaya big breakfast was not up to our expectation. Hot chocolate & latte was awesome! The environment is a plus point too.. Relaxing... Customer service was good. Surely will come back here again for the carbonara & hot chocolate...

Author: huanyinchanMalaysia
Title: Simply terrific
Review: Yeng Keng Cafe is no doubt one of my favorite restaurant whenever I am looking for authentic hainanese cuisine in Georgetown. The restaurant is relatively small in size with very limited seating capacity, thus I would highly recommend reserving for your table as well as some of the famous pre-order item like chicken rice (24 hours in advance) and pie (3 hours in advance). I particularly love their Hainanese style chicken chop and Hor Fun paired with a glass of passion fruit juice. There is one small car park at the back of Yeng Keng Hotel- complimentary for the café guest. This is always a great option not only for a authentic Hainanese lunch but also a great place for a cup of coffee in late afternoon.

Author: Mark_Bay_64
Title: Quality middle east food
Review: We love this place, the food is authentic Middle Eastern and A delight to eat. We keep going back for more

Author: iamjohnny
Title: Very Local, Friendly & Good Food
Review: Very local place with good food and drink selections. Friendly staff. Not so expensive. Servings quite generous, too.

Author: Kamy115
Title: Area manager...best ever
Review: we recently visited KLCC and Rathna the Area Manager assisted us.she did everything to make us 13 people feel welcome and comfortable. thank you Rathna for such an experience. you live up to great service.Pizza hut brand must be proud to have you.

Author: Jason005
Title: In house restaurant at Sheraton Imperial
Review: Choices, choices and more choices 4 buffet bars  plus desserts of every type on the 5th. I cant remember the price but remember it was very reasonable. (It cost less than the single malt scotch I had with dinner)

Author: amyrr26Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad experience. bad customer service. wont be coming here again
Review: Grade Z service! Let me elaborate;We booked in advance under the name farah (but mistakenly spelled sarah). We made the reservation ONE week in advance for our friend's bridal shower surprise. But thanks to Birch, you managed to ruin it.1) There was a system down, hence we could not order. We get that bad things happen sometimes. There is this pathetic excuse for a restaurant called birch.So bad things does happens. But what i dont understand is WHY is there no initiative from you guys to call us and let us know we could not order ANY food due to this. We could have found another alternative without even judging you guys and we would happily come back to try the restaurant. 2) Since when we ARRIVED only did we found out we cannot order, we decided to just continue there as the bride was about to arrive and there was no time to make other arrangement. As with all other events, balloons are now a must & especially for a bridal shower. Bt one of ur waiter did not let one of my friend to enter because there was a policy of no balloons or min 3 balloons policy? Seriously? first off, ive seen loads of pictures of people at birch with balloons. bt why were we not allowed? ridiculous. even so, you could have kept the balloon for us, let us in and serve us like normal. bt u would not let my friend in. So we ended up just leaving. Thanks for ruining the event.All in all, I wont recommend coming here in groups. I sure wont be coming back due to the pathetic service. n judging by the other reviews, you have some serious customer service issues. If i could rate this ZERO i would bt that is not an option. such a shame.

Author: dbrown101272
Title: Fun & Fabulous Breakfast!
Review: With a really funky design, and a large variety of top-notch eats, this is a great place for breakfast. It is pricey, but well worth it for when you really want that buffet start to the day...

Author: mer4876
Title: Poor Service from the Staff and Food Quality Was Not Up to Expectation
Review:
I was referring to the Madam Tang outlet in Brighton Square @ Titanium whereby I was not satisfied with:
1.  Staff service was very bad.  Service without smile and ignorance attitude.
2.  Food served was not hot though I ordered Cantonese fried kueh tiaw.

Author: JoelynnchinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best oysters since I returned from Tasmania
Review: The birthday girl picked this place. It has the vibe between a seaside shack and urban joint, and the place is tucked in the working class part of Bangsar. The placement is slightly odd but much welcomed as it's away from the glamour crowd and just a short walk from the Bangsar LRT station.I arrived slightly tipsy from two glasses of wine at a previous engagement, so left the ordering to the birthday girl while we waited for a friend who was running late. The three of us shared a lemon sole (RM66), grilled seabass (RM68), angel hair curry butter prawn (RM40) and Irish Premium oysters (RM132 for a dozen). The fish dishes were okay, with a nice crisp on the skin. The pasta, not bad, with a generous serving of whole prawns. The best of the lot was of course the oysters. I had just returned from Tasmania where fresh oysters was the highlight, so the bar had been set high. Having oysters from a hotel buffet at an office party was a major disappointment, so I was delighted to relive the Tasmanian experience. The oysters were fresh, plump and juicy - skip the dressing - all you really need is a squeeze of lemon to enjoy it. Even the birthday girl was converted - she has never had oysters before except in the form of or chien (oyster omelette - a local hawker dish). There's quite a selection of oysters to choose from, and they come from Australia and Ireland. Prices are on the high side, so watch your wallet and be considerate if you're splitting the bill equally with a party of people from different levels of income (the bill can quickly add up). The gelato, I feel, is overpriced at RM32 for two dainty (i.e. tiny) scoops. Three dishes, three glasses of wine (RM38 per glass), a platter of oysters, one gelato and one coffee came up to RM460. Service was attentive. We were one of two tables seated outside and although we had to catch the attention of the waiters once in awhile when we wanted to add our orders, our plates were cleared promptly and water bottle filled up when it ran low. The toilets were clean too.

Author: carsam c
Title: Fish Balls & Fish Noodle
Review: I ordered Fish Balls Noodle & taste was good . The fish balls were very springy & good texture. You can check it our here

Author: AnneLize020
Title: Good vibe!
Review:
I loved the furniture; no plastic chairs no table cloths just original wooden tables.
Loved the very helpfull and friendly staff. 
Felt comfortable, good no-nonsence food.

Author: Beverly JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing plus!
Review: We had heard such good reviews we couldn't wait to get there, however we were very disappointed mainly with incredibly bad service. Food was mediocre and staff were nothing short of miserable. Everything seemed too much trouble and if we rejected any of the dim sum dishes we were met with unpleasant looks. I have had much better meals at Concorde. Sadly something is not right in this restaurant right now - a pep talk to staff is certainly needed.

Author: phfoong
Title: Good food
Review: Pumpkin soup was very good and creamy. Had the pesto pasta was excellent too. Clean and simple place. However, the prices are slightly higher than expected.

Author: waifunKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average taste Vietnamese restaurant
Review: They have choice of main dish, side dish and drinks. The three of us ordered main dish only, lemongrass chicken, BBQ pork and beef with vermicelli, but we found all the dish taste average. Can choose the amount of rice or noodle so that no wastage of food.

Author: James C
Title: Excellent Food
Review: The food was excellent and the service good. However, there wasn't sufficient staff. They seemed to be running around catering to the guess.

Author: wana2013Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food is good but the place is loud
Review: We were a party of 5 adults and 2 kids. Reservation is highly recommended unless you want to have a really late dinner or don't mind waiting for a table. Tried a few of the breads such as the poori and kulcha. All were good with lamb dish and also the paneer dish (sorry forgot the names). The mutton biryani was superb though, not a big portion but super tasty. If you come in a big group, try and order multiple dishes to share. Service was fairly good even though the restaurant was full on a Sunday night. The only thing that we didn't like was the noise, with the restaurant full, the noise level from everyone and anything in the restaurant was super high. Very hard to have a conversation. Maybe the owners can do something about dampening the sound. Other than that, overall the experience was quite good.

Author: eagle_3567
Title: Not a comfortable dine in
Review: Pain for ears. workers blowing ballon using machine in a indoor environments. we moved out to open area but other decorating activities is going on, they don't care customer present and respect the right of customer to dine in a conducive environment. The lamb steak with raw smell.Is this how Irish restaurants serve their customers? We are not eating for free.No worth rating

Author: lamiananda
Title: Curry mee!!!!
Review: Good food... nice ambience.... very lovely aunties .... wanted to try their chee cheong fun but they were out of it... next time !!!!

Author: RichardTanChaiBoonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing special
Review: As tourists we were told that we must try the bean sprouts chicken rice. Upon reaching the street, there were a few bean sprouts checked rice restaurants. We chose Lou Wong for its huge yellow sign board. Service was fast and efficient. Food was ok. Nothing special. But the bean sprouts were fat and juicy.

Author: EdwardLiew128
Title: Strategic Location at CBD
Review: Crowded with people at 10am.  We love the food.  Nasi lemak is delicious with crispy fried chicken, sambal, ikan bilis and peanut.  The best i had ever tried so far. Cham panas is nice but not as hot as expected. Overall is thumb up.

Author: adrian0714Singapore, Singapore
Title: Total disappointment
Review: With many raving on here about 63, we made reservations at 1315 on July 18 with high expectations. On the contrary, the food was mediocre at best. Two of its popular dishes, pie tee and chicken buar keluak was unavailable. It was lunch and the Peranakan restaurant did not have enough of these common Peranakan dishes to go around. What does it tell you about the establishment? For those wanting to patronise, the acar isn’t worth the tag of RM1. We were so disappointed we didn’t even wanted the cendol at the end of our meal. Not going back ever.

Author: loong007Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Hygiene is worse than mamak stalls on the street
Review: Pricy as expected but still consider cheaper than other restaurants at KLIA 2. Typical mamak food but the dishes are rather cold. The worst thing about this restaurant is HYGIENE. Used plates and utensils not collected and cleaned by workers. Table is oily. Worst still, you can see flies literally everywhere. On the floor, tables, chairs, glass windows or even on your food. You are lucky if you can find a place with only 3 or 4 flies bugging you. Bottom line, if you wanna save some money on food or try mamak food, you are welcome to patronize this restaurant. Otherwise, DON'T. P.s. been to other branches of NZ Curry House and it was pretty good. Too bad this one at KLIA 2 really sucks.The meal caused me RM7.50 plain rice with 3 vegetables as I'm a vegetarian.

Author: JoyceLYPTaiping, Malaysia
Title: Too pricey
Review: 1st time trying Nyonya food after searching for one online - reviews were goodIt is a Halal restaurantOrdered :1. Sambal bendi Sambal not spicy enough and it is sweet and watery. Rate it 3/0 But maybe that's how sambal in Nyonya style should be? But it just ain't my cup of tea. 2. Tauhu NyonyaTexture of tauhu is good - smooth. Sauce was a bit sweet, but was quite tasty. Rate it 7/10 3. Ikan goreng asam The gravy was excellent - spicy and sour enough. Only down point is it is pricey for quite a small piece of fish. They serve the keropok as tidbits - but we are charged for it. RM 2.50And a bowl of rice is RM 2.50So 3 dishes for 2 person with drinks ordered (causing RM 3 per person) came up to RM 90 - pricey Overall, I would rate it ⭐⭐⭐ only

Author: jaymalaysiamalaysia
Title: Disappointing service and food
Review: Went for seafood dinner promotion. Food are not nice, limited choice , food are dry and hard! Some serving counter are empty and food runs out fast even with only a handful of patron!! Didn’t see many replenishment, you can see one piece of meat on tray for the whole evening, no refill!! At least the desert and cheese counter are acceptable. Coffee vending machine served good coffee. Not typical buffet, don’t expect to see much food here. Maybe better ask for a la carte.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: mrlabelman
Title: Wonderful gem of a restaurant
Review: Finding good Italian food in Asia isn't always easy but this little place in a heritage building is wonderful.  I enjoyed the baked linguini with seafood and it was really tasty.  We also enjoyed the six tapas appetizer and were not disappointed.  I'll be back

Author: martinhornfeldtStockholm, Sweden
Title: Poor service
Review: We went there 6 people for High Tea. The place was not busy and still it took 45 minutes until we got the first servings. And the first person in our company was served about 20 minutes before the last person.For a place like this, that kind of service is not ok.High Tea was innovative but if you were looking for scones, cluttered cream and cucumber sandwiches you will be disappointed. Even if it was innovative, some of the dishes were really not very well composed.

Author: Anon YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible food
Review: We waited in line for an hour with a promise of amazing noodles and crabs.After an hour and a half our food finally arrives. And to our dismay, the prawns in our so called "must have" cheesy prawn noodle was not fresh and then sauce was diluted to the point that we could barely taste a thing.Then once we almost finish our meal, the piece de resistance arrive, our fresh milk crabs. The taste itself was neither here nor there and they couldnt even give us proper Man Tau. They freaking served us toast bread to dip into the sauce. You would expect in an establishment such as this that it would have properly cooked food along with its respective condements but Nooooo!!!Lastly, the price of the food. For 3 mud crabs we payed a total of rm190++ for 3 crabs... that is price we would pay back in kl...but atleast in kl it would have been tasty and we would have been served Man Tau. All in all a meal for the 3 of us cost us a total of RM450++ which by the cost more that my suite room for the night.

Author: BiingWY
Title: Poorest Service ever!
Review: I have been to this chain of restaurants for many years and the most consistent factor here is the SERVICE!APPALLING!!1) they wont allow you to enter until your party has fully arrived. Means no reservations - the most consistent inconvenience you have had herein. Across all your outlets, BU, KLCC, BSC2) Staffs - you must have had learned from your seniors whom were arrogant bunch of personnels. why argue with clients when they dont understand your restrictive booking conditions. Let alone most are just hanging around chit chatting instead of attending to clients.3) Foodwise still ok. but with such service forget it.

Author: MelindaJ259
Title: People make the place....
Review: The staff are patient, polite and attentive, owner\s are friendly and ever ready to help, food is great and so is the chef. The chef has actually when kitchen is not too busy brought out the food and served it himself, I find that to be a very personal "touch" which is a small gesture but not many take the time to do it. My friends and I have been there a couple of times and last night we had our first function - a small birthday party there, to make a long story short, it won't be the last.

Author: Charissa PMalaysia
Title: Lousy afternoon tea with lousy service!
Review: Seriously?? I was cheated by the faked reviews on Tripadvisor. Everyone here raved about their food nad services. I should have googled to read the reviews there before coming to this "so called" 5 star! (I made a grave mistake) What a shame MO. You had lousy rude reluctant looking face staffs which can't even perform a proper standard service which all service lines are required too! Our afternoon tea on the 26th Dec was a disaster. The waiter were very very unhappy. They could not serve with a smile! Took 30 mins for a carrot juice to come. When we waved at them, they turned a blind eye at us. No please, no thank you, no warmth at all! Did not even take the effort to refill water to the teapot.. everything need to be requested! Woah... 5 star my goodness.. This is not a hotel. Even a lousy inn has better attitude.Scones were crispy..? guess the chef doesn't know how to make a proper scone. I ended up eating a crispy scone cookie.. have you tried one before? Desserts were sweet like hell like I was eating a bag of sugar! Sandwiches were dry and unacceptable. Oh dear.. RM 158 nett per pax wasn't worth the price. I couldn't bring myself to speak good about this hotel. Everything was so off. MO standard has fallen to beyond repair. I have tasted many good and bad afternoon teas but MO is by far the WORSE AMONG THE REST! Trust me. You will regret when you step your foot into this place unless they start to make HUGE improvements. Till then, not coming back.ps: I wouldn't even want to give you a single freaking star in the first place.

Author: Jill C
Title: Poor
Review: Long wait for food. Curries thin, watery and powdery. Not very exciting. Staff very pleasant but the restaurants either side are better.

Author: SudhirB187
Title: Worst food
Review: Please no especially nasi lemak with frozen egg instead of fried egg 🥚 my rest of the journey became hell

Author: 478sallybBrussels, Belgium
Title: Unique food in KL
Review: So nice to find this place- offers a completely different style of food than other places in KL. Just for that they should get a shout out. Service was very nice and professional - explained the menu well (all dishes for sharing) and even came back during the meal to ask if everything was ok. That never happens in Malaysia! We had moutabal (baba ganoush) with harissa to start, roasted cauliflower with tahini, pork ribs and octopus and seafood chowder. Pork ribs were cooked to perfection - rather spicy so beware if you don’t like spice. Octopus was over cooked but the mussels, clams, squid and all else was yummy. The tomato broth was very flavorful. Cauliflower was good, but needed a bit more salt. Also had the sweet corn coleslaw - kind of bland. Probably least favorite dish of the evening. It is a bit on the expensive side - 42RM for a glass of wine seems excessive. 3 people with 2 wine and 1 beer was +400RM. But I would go back to try other dishes.

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good to try, but not authentic!
Review: Its a place you could come to try, but to say its authentic it's over exaggerated. The crispy baguette is seriously not tasty. I asked for crispy, but it does not taste good. I ordered that we some beef soup which the taste is not to my liking. It's difficult to eat. I won't order this dish anymore. The Vietnamese coffee also not as tasty as i tried in Vietnam. I just recently came back from a vacation in Vietnam, so the taste is totally different. Again not authentic. The condensed milk problem or the way they make it? I'm not sure.Overall the food is pretty average and expensive with the small quantity served. 10% service charges to give, if you have to pay at the counter is a little bit too much.Overall I still give it a 3. Because it is worth a try but not to come again. It makes you realise the food you are in Vietnam is really that good! Compare here.

Author: JivaniKuala Lumpur
Title: Mezze Bistro
Review: Mezze Bistro is a pork/meat lovers paradise! The food is delicious, the pricing is just right for the portions and i especially love the Spicy Asian Buffalo-style Chicken Wings, served with a coating of honey and sesame. The location is also idyllic if you don't want to tackle traffic to get to a good restaurant. I read a really good review by a writer a couple of weeks ago which i think deserves a mention. http://www.expatgomalaysia.com/article/561/mezze-bistro-represents-the-finer-things#.UA4UXoGoXl8Those living around Damansara and Bangsar will find it very convenient.

Author: 514bernardh
Title: Disappointing experience
Review: Went for buffet dinner which was served at table. The menu was impressive, however the food served was below expectations. Except for the pizza, steamed fish and ais kacang which were prepared fresh, most of the food tasted and looked like canteen / economy rice food. Sushi rice was hard, most of food was cold. The aircond also seemed not to be working when we were there. It was warm, stuffy and not pleasant dining in at all. Saving grace was that staff were friendly enough.

Author: motiver2018Singapore, Singapore
Title: Below my expectation
Review: First dinner in Melaka after driving for three hours. Saw the reviews was good so drove there to try. We called Beef Rendang, Kueh Pie Tee, Chicken with Buah Kalak, Otah, egg omelette, and another soup dish with Chendol as dessert. The beef Rendang is good, the wetter curry version.The Curry chicken is palatable but only three pieces of buah kalak which is miserable. Otah is ok but cannot beats the Muar type. Chendol is below expectations although the gula melaka syrup is thick and sweet. Cost us almost RM$200 which is above average, cannot considered cheap.

Author: jorc23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst experience ever
Review: Dear friends, Please DO NOT VISIT THIS restaurant!!!It’s operated by Vietnamese but the food that they cook is nothing similar to what is cooked in Vietnam. Please share and viral it!!The incident starts like this, I looked for Vietnam food in Johor and found this on trip advisor, when I arrived there was no customer in the restaurant, I thought maybe it’s a bit late as I arrived around 9pm.When I was ordering my food, there’s a lot of choice not available so I assume that they’re about to close therefore not much choice, so I ordered 1x Kangkung, 1x fish, 1x pho noodle, 1x chicken rice, 1x prawn, 1x soup and drinks. So the staff told me that the fish will need 30minute to cook. I said fine. Here the problem comes, 30minutes, not even a single item was presented to our table, so I wave at the staff, he saw and ignored me and continue talking with another tables guest. The first thing to come is the chicken rice. You can refer to photo. For those who eat Vietnam food, know that this is not how it supposed to be. I have no issues with their pho noodle and prawn, but came the vegetable, and soup which was very disappointing. Look in the photo, does it look appetitive to you? Is this how Kangkung is cooked? I ignored it and thought just eat and leave. But there’s more. The soup is worst, I’ve eaten fish since I was young, how can I not tell if the fish is edible or not. The soup does not taste anything near to what there is in Vietnam. So I asked the staff to take the soup and return it to the kitchen, and told him there mud smell with the fish and it spoils the soups which makes it taste aweful. He brought it back to the kitchen and then bring back the exact bowl of soup to me again. I told him I don’t want it, he just ignored me.Lastly the steam fish arrived, I just took 1 bite and obviously know that the fish was not clean properly, you can see a lot scales on the fish and taste has an odour. I told him I don’t want this fish, he act as if he didn’t understand me. After that, I told my girlfriend to speak to him in Vietnamese, which is his mother tongue language, he heard everything and DID NOTHING. So I wrote a review on their page, and message their page about the food, the message was read but there’s no courtesy to reply. You can refer to the photo. Then we found out the girl who is the manager of the restaurant, she came in right after I complain on Facebook but did not even came to us to find out the issue. We know she is the one who manages the Facebook and replies. I was so mad and frustrated with someone with this type of attitude opening restaurant who doesn’t know how to manage. So I went in and wanted to pay, when she show me the bill, I told the manager I didn’t eat the soup and fish, because it’s inedible, she refuse to take out the fish from my bill, so I demand her to try the dishes herself, the food is as per in the photo and we didn’t touch further. I personally went to my table and took the dishes to the counter and ask her to try. To my surprise, she said “NOTHING WRONG WITH IT” Me and my girlfriend argued with the manager, as I was speaking English to her, she seems not understand enough, so I ask my girlfriend talk to her instead but she just keep giving reasons, and say I cannot eat and don’t pay, at that moment, I already put cash on the counter. The bill is RM111.20 and I put RM112 at the counter. It got me so furious I really wish the authorities would do something about this place. Please stop people who have no desire to make good food for people to eat. What if we got sick eating their food.

Author: Chris RCamberley, United Kingdom
Title: Great view, shame about the food.
Review: Attended here for afternoon tea. The view from the balcony outside was fantastic even to the point of stepping out onto a glass bottomed platform. Had to come inside early as a huge storm started with lashing rain. Not a problem as was impressive to watch the storm from the inside.Had afternoon tea in the revolving restaurant which was a buffet style and not very impressive. Cups and saucers were very small and we were only allowed 2 cups of tea during our 60 minute visit.When we came out the taxi rank was locked up so we had to wait 45 minutes for a taxi to turn up.

Author: TrushnaP7
Title: Beautiful views ruined by cats everywhere
Review: This restaurant really HAD potential. Good location by the Kuching Waterfront and nice place to cool off and have a drink as you watch the sunset. Unfortunately, these simple pleasures were ruined during my last trip to the restaurant. Felt unwelcomed from the get go by a waitress who told us to go sit 'anywhere'. She pranced off uninterested and we were then attended to by male waiters (hats off to them for their kind service and deepest condolences for having a brat as a colleague). Wish I had good things to say from this point forward but nothing got better. There was a litter of kittens in the restaurant, jumping on tables and rubbing on customer's legs. The wait staff would shoo the kittens off when we complained but the waiters were also playing with the kittens. How unsanitary! Kuching might be called the city of cats but a dining space is definitely not the place to have cats around!

Author: stylesetter17United Kingdom
Title: Not for the money you pay
Review: Heard good things about this restaurant--with hindsight, mainly about how good the view is--so decided to try it out for a friend's farewell do. After making my reservation, the restaurant called me twice on the following two days to confirm my booking, remind me not to be late, and insist I do not bring more people to the restaurant than I had booked for, which in my humble opinion, is a little too much.Ambience was good, view was very good, possibly one of the best in Kuala Lumpur (rivalling the nearby Sky Bar of Traders Hotel)--still, not up there with Robuchon Au Dome of Macau, or Red Sky of Centara Bangkok. The set menu for 3 courses is RM 230 per person; if you order from the a la carte menu, it's approximately RM 80-100 for an entree, and RM 100-150 for a main, another RM 30-50 for dessert. Menu was not the most exciting--too many pastas and not enough of anything else. The most basic bottle of wine on the wine list will set you back RM 300. Tables were set rather close to each other, making diners having to shift around as waiters squeezed past them.The service was good in that the staff were attentive and friendly, but important details were missed such as not filling up the bread basket, clearing the side plates, and bringing the right cutlery. The starters were fair in terms of taste and portions, but there was a 25 minute wait in between the starters and the mains. The kitchen did not manage to bring out our main courses together, and on top of that, two out of the four courses were cold when they were served to us. The best thing about the meal was the chocolate dessert, which would be recommended if you do order dessert. Give the cheese platter a miss, unless you never expect crackers with your cheese.The bottom line is that this restaurant's food was not worth the money they charge for it.
