The stunning views and good ambience do not make up for the less than satisfactory food. If you must go for the scenery, then perhaps have a drink at their bar before moving on to a restaurant that serves better food.

Author: rdreamer
Title: Average... nothing fantastic
Review: Just your average chicken rice/horfun, nothing fantastic. Only good thing is they have a upstairs dining hall which is air-conditioned, and the location is next to lots of other food choices.

Author: lmlucas
Title: Not that fantastic anymore.
Review: In compare with 13 years ago this restaurant is not that special anymore. Now you can eat the kind of food served in an average restaurant anywhere, the terrace is beautiful, especially at night.

Author: SuzanneTi
Title: Average service
Review: one of the place for have the lunch or dinner fro western food. Is just that i prefer a more brigthen lighting area of the resataurant

Author: AnthonyS978Arles, France
Title: Didn’t try the food, waiter didn’t want to work
Review: This is the first time I write a bad review for a restaurant. We went there because of the nice things people said about it, and we really wanted to try the ‘Indian fusion’ but we were unlucky and it wasn’t obviously the right day to go.The waiter was on his phone on the terrace, he looked at us like he had hope we were going anywhere else, and asked us to go inside, which we did.I gave us the menu, not a lot of choices, with some ‘coming soon’ and others erased, so I asked him the difference between the 5 sets proposed. He answered that only 2 (!) were available, so we ordered one of each and two drinks. My girlfriend gave him the menu and he rolled his eyes like he was SO, SO BORED!It was too much for us, and we left right after. Honestly we’ve never felt so bad in a restaurant, and it’s a shame because it is really beautifully decorated, and we read nice reviews so the food must be good too.

Author: rakeshvora04
Title: very less options
Review: the place has very less options for vegetarian food, also the lcation of the place is far from the city centre

Author: Jacob M
Title: Horrible managers and unsafe servers
Review: I went to this bar on two back-to-back nights. The first night, my friend and I were talked into trying the Chili margarita, which was served with a flaming tequila shot. The waitress told my Friend that you’re supposed to drink the shot while it’s on fire, which of course makes no sense, but she was adamant about that so my Friend tried. Lucky, he freaked out before doing so and blew it out. Immediately, he took a sip and burned his lip on the scorching hot glass. A manager came over and said, “was your shot on fire? You’re suppose to pour it into your drink.” When I explained that the waitress told him to drink the shot that was on fire, and about how he burned his lips, the manager laughed and said, “today’s her first day. I’ll tell her the correct way so it doesn’t happen again.” She then walked away laughing, while my friend’s lip was still burning. Queue to last night when I try the bar out with another few friends. The server from the night before sees me and apologizes, while laughing about the incident, so I briefly lectured her on safety and she took off. Once we order our drinks and began talking, the chair that my Friend was sitting in broke. The front two legs completely detached from the chair causing her to fall to the ground. Luckily she wasn’t hurt, but I wanted a manager to finally come and apologize. Upon the manager (different from the previous night) coming over, she blamed my Friend for breaking the chair. So instead of apologizing, they now are blaming people for things and I had had enough, so I had a few choice words with this new manager about her incompetent managerial skills, and she said that I was attacking her. This caused the general manager (the only reasonably helpful person in the entire establishment) to come over and try to resolve the situation. I explained what had happened the previous night with the shot and he informed me that he was aware of that. I then informed him on what happened with the chair and the manager blaming my Friend. All the while, the manager is now verbally attacking me while I’m talking to the GM. He asks her to leave which she refuses, and when I told her to leave as her boss had requested, she again refuses and starts getting more irritated. Eventually, she leaves and the GM blames her words on a lack on English vocabulary. The only thing I wanted was a sincere apology from someone in the first place, and the GM was the only person who sort of did that. Terrible service. 10 out of 10 would not recommend.

Author: kimeatthisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: lovely food and good staff :)
Review: At the moment, Knowhere Bangsar is only doing takeaway and delivery because of the whole virus situation, but before this I would come here every now and then, because who else serves bottomless tuak on ladies' night??People come here for dates and cocktails, maybe some drinks, but the food is underrated!! so good. Not the biggest fan of fusion food but Knowhere does it perfectly and subtly. Personal favourites: Ulam Pesto, their margherita pizza (tomato gala?) and their al-funghi pizza too. Also had their steak for one of my date nights - it was amazingggFor their tapas, their nachos and grilled calamari are bomb. Not a big drinker but their cocktails are instagrammable and according to my friends, taste good too! haha

Author: Carla L
Title: I love the shisha in a pineapple
Review: We went here for their Shisha and didn't expect it would really be nice. I ordered a cappuccino and I warned you guys, it tasted so weird coz' they put some spices on it and I think they put ginger. uuhh.

Author: LIM C
Title: That's I call Melaka !
Review:
Just groove with the music and the atmosphere once you are there!
The singer from the pub opposite is better and you have both by just pay for one! Must visit Jonker Street and stop by either these 2 friendly pubs in Melaka!

Author: Afsar_11Vancouver, Canada
Title: Attached to Concord hotel
Review: Good atmosphere , good service, familiar food, can meet like minded people coming around the world. Good drinks

Author: mithamaticsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fumble n Gobble
Review: A great experience. Small portions but lotsa variety. Guessing your food, the contents, and finding out if you're right once you finish the meal. Got 90% correct. Good food by the way!

Author: traveggieBreda, The Netherlands
Title: Good vegetarian curry
Review: We noticed this place many times before over the years, but never tried it before, probably because of the name.We are vegetarians and somehow didn't expect to get anything vegetarian in a place called Edelweis.This time we did try it and were proved wrong.The vegetarian curry was very nice indeed.The restaurant is in a interesting old building andThe owner is friendly and sociable.Recomended.

Author: janarthan2018
Title: Pricey but good food.
Review: Good varieties and tasty preparations. Although communication would be a bit difficult if don't a chinese speaking friend with you.

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Enjoyable meal but nothing exceptional
Review: The food was good and well cooked. Not cheap, but you are paying for the chef (who was wondering round the restaurant while our orders were being cooked, so he obviously doesn't cook every dish!) and location in Solaris. Having said all that, it was an enjoyable meal. The cod, spaghetti with chicken, steak and pasta were all good. Usual selection of starters which was OK. Too full to try to desert menu, but the chef said they had a dedicated dessert chef, so will have to try for the next visit.

Author: Sonata SVilnius, Vilniaus Apskritis, Lithuania
Title: Very unprofessional waitress
Review: We had a nice dinner in Opium couple days ago. It was really delicious and enjoyed the food so much that decided to have a 4 course menu dinner. We booked a table and left our business card to the waitress whose name is Joanie Opi. We impatiently waited the dinner and pleasant evening for 2 days :) Unfortunately when we came, our table was occupied. And Joanie Opi first said that she forgot to tell the chef. Later she started to explain that she'd tried to call us, but the number was international..... Unbelievable bad experience and spoiled evening.

Author: jermpinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambiance, good service, but souffle doesn't make the cut
Review: I liked the ambiance of the cafe, white walls and brightly lit room from natural lighting. The service was really good too. The owner (I assumed) kindly informed us on the short waiting time, and seated us on the window counter top as soon as it was vacated. She later offered to re-seat us considering the strong sun ray and heat from the window. The vanilla souffle was overrated, definitely overdone. The souffle is complemented with a very nice and refreshing grapefruit sorbet. We also tried the chocolate lava cake - it was decent! For drinks, we tried the fruit tea and it was really good!

Author: ChrisLeicester
Title: Great service and atmosphere
Review: Have visited many times over the last 5 years and it never disappoints on food and service as far a value for money is concerned.

Author: Rebecca MBanbury, United Kingdom
Title: Nice family very friendly , food good , can however eat more luxuriously for exactly the same price.
Review: We were recommended this by a couple staying at our hotel, beware....what someone else calls great food is not always your version of good food.We'd booked ahead and the taxi brought us to a normal looking house with parking at the front off the main road. Inside the decorations are sparce, a couple of tables on the porch and room for about 18 patrons within. We sat indoors. The owner brought menus, his son played inside the restaurant, the cooking is performed inside by foreign workers, clean and presentable. Western piped music eg Everley brothers, toilets at the back, everything kept very clean.The spring and meat rolls were delicious, fruit juices well blended, the portions were more than ample, it just seemed odd that everything was served all at once, ie the starters and the main so that the main wasn't as piping hot as preferred.The acar fish steaks were good with a great deal of ginger, a vinegary taste.The chicken Kapitan was good , we only got three assam prawns , should have been four, they were well grilled, the veg was a bit bland and the black rice and coconut milk adequate.The food was good don't get me wrong and the service very good, but for exactly the same price we ate in more luxurious surroundings and very delicious foods in another Nyonya restaurant the following evening.I don't wish to run this place down, it is nice food and I'm glad we went however we ate more lavishly the following night for the exact same price.

Author: 0505KateKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful food, rubbish customer service
Review: Limited menu, half cooked salmon serve with a smear of holland are, no carbohydrate with the main meal. Tiny portions of cold chips with lamb shank. When asked for hot ones, still tiny portion came after a long wait. Asked for vegetarian gluten free and go a 'Caesar salad' this was NOT a caesar salad- no Parmesan as described in the menu gulp for dressing!Pizza was ok but came ages after other meals. Complaint was listened to but no effective solution. Left very disappointed.

Author: Mathsman_perth
Title: Best meal we had in Penang
Review: We stayed at the Park Royal and had dinner there several times. Saw The Living Room on trip advisor and decided to give it a go. The whole family were super impressed with the food even Miss Fussy who is not a fan of spice. Everyone enjoyed the meal and I enjoyed the bill. Not much more expensive than the Long beach Cafe (Hawker's Market) but in a completely different category in quality. Ben made mention of Little Mister (12) who not only ate his meal but also helped every one with theirs. Kids enjojed a HUGE milkshake one night and both loved the fried ice cream the other night. This will be a regular stop on future visits.

Author: mckenly123
Title: i felt so bad
Review: last saturday 13 of june i was at souledout,..sri hartamas ..i had my dinnner at the private room upstairs...the tall guy with pimples and has a dirty shoes..if im not mistaken he is renz ,..he did nothing!!! i didnt get a service!!he just holding a walky talkie and talk like boss...please be more attentive with the customers..didn't follow up our foods..totally horrible i will never go back to souled because of one bad waiter..

Author: LovelySR
Title: Awesome service!
Review: My parents and their friends went in for a rest while I do my tour along Jonker street. The food was great! Service was wonderful while we did a surprise birthday celebration for one of our members. Thank you for the cooperation and help!

Author: erichP8473DLPhuket, Thailand
Title: Not what it used to be...
Review: Eating in the revolving restaurant gives you an amazing view of KL by night... but having lived in KL for the last 10 years the place isn't anymore what it used to be. Ten years ago it offered 2 huge buffets and a wide range of choice between Western and Asian food... now there is only one buffet left, average food, not many people (for a Saturday night) !!! The times when this place was the place to be to impress your guests are over... the price tag way too high for what you get... the place has the location though so why the quality fading took place over the years is unclear to me... I doubt I will go here again...

Author: Grace WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Most disappointing
Review: The last time I visited Nancy's Kitchen was when they were in their old premises. They always had long lines outside their restaurant then. Now, they have moved to a spanking new place. The hotel staff advised us to make a reservation a day in advance, and we did. It was a Saturday and we were there for dinner expecting a long line. Strangely, not only was there no queue but they had tables for walk ins as well. We ordered Pie Tee, Ngoh Hiang, Chilli Prawns, Tamarind Prawns and plain rice. The Pie Tee was all right but not terribly delicious. The filling was too wet and Pie Tee shells not exactly fresh and crispy. The Ngoh Hiang was soggy and simply unappealing. The Chilli Prawns were flavourful enough but there were only about 6 or 7 small prawns on the plate. The Tamarind Prawns tasted just like the name, prawns fried in tamarind sauce. Nothing spectacular. All the food especially the Ngoh Hiang tasted like they had been heated in the microwave. Even the sambal belachan which should accompany the food had to be paid for at RM3. The chillies were very coarsely pounded and the dish was more seeds than sambal. Perhaps it's because we didn't order the recommended dishes but I was really disappointed with this restaurant because it's supposedly one of the most famous in Malacca.

Author: ash_egyEgypt
Title: Disappointing
Review: This is the only western resturant in Suria mall, KLCC. You have to wait 20 to 30 minutes to get a table. Whenyou finally in, you discobered many free tables available and peopleare waiting outside. I guess the problem is short of staffto cover all the tables. Then the food doesnot have same taste and qualiyof chili, worldwide. Even the Fahitas is different.

Author: PocketBon
Title: Birthday dinner!
Review: Fast service and it wasn't long for food to arrive. Good food with good people and good service, nuff said. We got free shots too for celebrating a birthday here!

Author: clemencenils
Title: Good but lot of dishes not available
Review: It is our second time . The environment is very good , food as well. Unfortunately for the second several dishes were not available.

Author: Fmnz
Title: Ridiculous concept, ridiculous prices
Review: Completely average experience at Dining in the Dark, this concept of dining in complete darkness would be fine, except for the fact that the food which is served tastes so exceptionally average.Complete rip off. will not return

Author: JohnWatson260Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful views of KL FROM Marini's on 57
Review: My wife and I spent a couple of evenings taking in the atmosphere and views at Marini's on 57. Thanks to the staff who are very attentive and professional. Only fault would be is that on two visits it was extremely cold due to the air-conditioning which could not be adjusted to suit the conditions due to this we left earlier than we would have liked to :(

Author: castiel21
Title: worst customer service
Review:
not like before..ordered chicken bleu..had to wait long before my food ready and even a group of customer arrived after me recieved their food earlier than me..n after my food arrived, they sent wrong food..had to wait another 10 minutes.omg.

highly not recommended

Author: im_long_john_silverPerth, Australia
Title: Very intresting experience
Review: My experience was mixed. We were greeted warmly by the hostess and given a welcome drink - nice touch. There was a bit of a mix up when we were told to come through. Just as we were about to be seated we were told to wait at the bar. Unfortunately we had to wait at the bar for 20+ minutes. The staff were apologetic but was slightly embarrassing. we were not even offered a complimentary drink while we waited. I expect a full paying customer NOT to be seated after a 'Livingsocial' customer has has paid 50% less than what i have to pay (yes normal customers like me do realize that other are paying much more for their experience than others).The service in the restaurant was good. apparently all the staff in the dark room are blind and you get an amazing glimpse into how difficult it might be for them to simply try new foods.The experience was good, the food was very average if even bordering on the poor. It's worth doing once but i woudnt go back again unless the food dramatically improved.

Author: maymaymieMalacca
Title: Poor Service, Mediocre Food, and Expensive Parking at Paya Serai High Tea Buffet
Review: Bad experience at Paya Serai High Tea Buffet today. The service is appaling. We arrived 15 minutes early for their weekend high tea buffet which starts at 12.30pm. There was no one manning the entrance, so I walked in to find someone. There were plenty of waitress and kitchen staff walking around but no one bothered to greet and ask for your reservation or seat you down. Few other guests were also walking around waiting to catch the attention of someone to direct them to their tables. Finally I approched a waitress who lead me to my reserved table. Once seated, you are left alone, they don't ask if you'd like iced water, nor automatically bring you iced water (unlike other hotels). 30 minutes into our meal we were still not served any water, and my husband had to flag a waiter down to ask for water for the table. Tables were slow to be cleared, even when there were at least 3 servers at our section. So we just stacked our dirty plates on top of each other. The buffet spread was mediocre. Not much choices and mediocre in quality. There was no seafood section at all, no oysters, prawns, crabs, scallops, mussels on ice etc....there was no japanese or italian section either. The chinese food was very disappointing, the Malay section was the best among all. Dessert ice cream was terrible. They only served those cheap local ice cream in chocolate, strawberry and yam flavour. Do not expect premium gelato quality ice cream here. Surprised a 5 star Hilton hotel serves this kind of ice cream... Shangrila and Mandarin Oriental all serve premium gelato quality ice creams at their buffets.Lastly, parking is super expensive here. We parked for less than 2 hours, and it was RM15. When settling the bill, we gave our parking tickets for validation, but the waiter said it's a flat rate today (Saturday), so no validation is necessary. I think RM15 flat rate for 1 hour plus of parking is ridiculous. We had 2 cars at our table so the parking fee was RM30, which in my opinion is very expensive. Even parking in hotels in the middle of KL city is much cheaper, normally around RM8 for 2 hours of parking, their restaurant dining flat rates are also around RM8, certainly not RM15.Conclusion, poor service, mediocre food, and expensive parking... do not waste your time here.

Author: Jaszy_77
Title: Good food
Review: Great Northern indian food and comes with a good fine dining ambience.. Customer service needs to improvised and needs to reconsider the price.. Overall it's good

Author: Lindsay SLondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: In Johor Bahru? Don't miss Flowers in the Window
Review: A highlight of a brilliant visit to JB. Owner Mr Sea is 'attracted to simple things that most people overlook' so we saw beauty in unexpected things too in this delightful cafe. The others there were JB's young creatives but they welcomed us warmly. Delicious home made food and fruit juices. We loved it.

Author: kevinbN3814XCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not even top 50 in KL
Review: We went because it was ranked top 50, but it was hugely disappointing. The service was bad, to the point the waitress removed a plate while my wife was still eating and was discourteous enough to not even take note when she was told. As far as food, at this level of restaurant one should expect a multicourse meal to have a throughline which connects the meal from one dish to another. Instead, this was more of a sloppy concoction of flavors without sense or continuity. The drinks pairing was also not properly thought through in regards to the flavor combination between food and drink.

Author: bernie_simcs73Miri, Malaysia
Title: Meisan Restaurant --- Not recommended
Review: I have attended training for 5 days organized by GLC. On day 2 of training, lunch meal was served with overnight chicken, we have complained with the FB manager and it was agreed by chef that the chicken was not fresh. On day 5, Surprisingly it did happen again with overnight chicken and salad..Woo.. no standard lar...

Author: Jake25379
Title: Outstanding, lovely people.
Review: Excellent Indian food. We had Nosi Goreng India, Channa Masala and Chicken Tandoori. It was outstanding.

Author: cheatdayfactoryOslo, Norway
Title: Scam!! This is NOT fresh food- STAY AWAY.
Review: I have traveled in favor of food for several years now and this was a real disappointment.Before we walked in we asked if it really was authentic food from the Middle East and they confirmed that it was fresh food.- I have roots from Syria and there is no way you can serve Frenchfries to the dishes we ordered! It was supposed to get our food right from the grill and it did not take a very long time before we had served the food where the chicken was cold!It was possibly grilled in pre-production, the hummus was tasteless, possibly hermetic and they served us fries from the freezer. Mc'donalds style. Even the bread was hard and bought at the grocery store.Expensive and unprofessional!Take my good advice and stay away

Author: goodsvejkGlatton, United Kingdom
Title: Charming restaurant with great food
Review: We were very excited to hear about the Edelweiss Cafe, a Swiss German restaurant--bratwurst, fondue, imported German beer! We were even more excited once we arrived and were greeted by a wonderful atmosphere, a charming host, and outstanding food. All for a reasonable price. We got a starter of pommes frites and salad, followed by the fondue for two and were not disappointed. The beer selection was great. And everything was very authentic. Highly recommended if you're in the mood for something other than Malaysian or simply want a relaxing and fun evening in the Georgetown.

Author: EmbracetheUnknownLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Not exactly very wallet friendly!
Review: Came in here on a hot afternoon to have some beers, chill & get away from the balmy heat!Nostalgic old world feel, the bar stands out with its really old teak wood structure and design against the wall. Not exactly wallet friendly, the beers cost like more than double what one will pay in Chulia Street!Overall, if you are in this part of town and really need to chill out, it's still a great place to unwind. Owner & staff are a happy bunch of people.

Author: thilaks
Title: Nice ambience but crowded.
Review:
Food is good but bit pricey for the fried rice.
Fruit juice are fresh without added sugar.

Need to improve on service as need to wait long to be served,

Overall is ok.

Author: Newgracie
Title: Food quality and service deteriorated
Review: Visited this restaurant a couple of years ago and was there for dinner last night. I must say that the quality of food was below par (paella was tasteless), service could have been much better. If you really want Spanish food, spend your money elsewhere

Author: Vivian K
Title: Great place
Review:
Second time came here since I had a good experience with it from last trip to KL with my friend .Good location great food and service.
The staff names Sam is very nice guy and serious with his work

Author: boskiIsland of Malta, Malta
Title: No way this is the best Thai in KL
Review: We went here because the staff at our usual Thai were rude so we thought time for a change, and a change we got but not a good one. No atmosphere, lethargic staff, one of the male staff was picking up cutlery and giving it to customers from the eating end- yuk – dirty. The food was below average, eatable only because we were starving . they asked how the meal was and we told them how plain and average it was so they handed us a feedback card. Meals were not fresh pre prepared and seemed microwaved – never again

Author: Rhett_NgSeoul, South Korea
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: I went to this restaurant twice for my company dinner. The food is great but the service is just so so. This place is located at the same floor as the check-in counter of Hilton hotel. Due to the price of the food here is not price friendly, you will hardly find it full. However, if you want a private room, kindly reserve it as sometimes the rooms will be taken. Food is delicious but I will not recommend here due to the price here. In Kuching, you can find many places with good food with reasonable price. If you do park your car here, you need to validate your parking coupon to pay for the flat rate carpark fee. If I not remember wrongly, it costs about 4 to 5 ringgit per entry. Overall, I am satisfied with the restaurant and if I have the money, I will definitely try it out here again.

Author: orchids30
Title: A "just ok" experience
Review: The food is like any other ayam penyet/pecel lele. it is not bad, but nothing great either. The cashier is efficient.

Author: girliepuppy
Title: The best Pizza in Town
Review: Tried this yummy pizza and I keep on coming back for it. Balkanico and Pepperoni are my fav on the list.  You can't find other place that offer first class pizza at kopitiam price. Highly recommendable for pizza maniac. Affordable and tasty!!

Author: smurphetteeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not Worth The Price
Review: The photos on their menu do not do justice to the actual meal. The quality of meat they use for a stone grill restaurant is cheap, it gets very tough once you start cooking it. They only have black pepper sauce as a flavour in which was a bit of a disappointment for a restaurant that serves different types of meat. I ordered their sirloin and it was very very dry, even when it was cooked to medium rare. There was an odd layer of rosemary season on the meat which should not be paired with beef. Rosemary is often for Lamb, not beef!My friends ordered the marinated meat skewers and they were equally as dry. Service was neither slow or fast, but rather you could see the waiters just 'lepak' (laze around) when there was nothing to do. I don't think this would be my first or second or third choice if I happen to be back in Johor again.

Author: ngsiewchengKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: staff problem !
Review: we overall enjoyed the ambience and the food there, and we were the only local during the dinner time. and the only Chinese male waiter, really unfriendly and no patience in explaining the menu and service too, but the other are fine.. if you are only giving good service for tourists or foreigner, sorry no next time !

Author: P4545IFdennisl
Title: Quiet place, good food
Review:
This was the best place I had dinner while I was on Langkawi.

Had both appetizer and main dish and both was good. Had some cocktails as well and they where tasty.

Nice service, would definitely come again.

Author: Diana A
Title: Food was not good
Review: We ate lunch there and the food was not good. My boyfriend regularly eats Philippino food where we live and he really enjoys it which is why we tried the place. We found the food to be under whelming and lacking we almost felt we had to go somewhere else to get full. The food wasn't that great of a price either.

Author: SusanW2008Sri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special compared to the original
Review: Having been in Vietnam in Feb this year. I must say the place is good with service but food quality is average. Three of us ordered 2 Vietnamese Pho with beef balls while 1 chicken chop rice set.The drinks are also so so, I ordered lemongrass hot tea while my friend ordered ice coffee. Bill came at rm 76.00. Not cheap as well.

Author: D6337GPpaulcBangkok, Thailand
Title: Sunday brunch - a little different . . ..
Review: Sunday brunch is, typically, considered “value for money” if there is too much of everything - and the belt around your waist is considerably tighter by the time you leave!Flock is different - yes there is a lot of choice - but, reassuringly, it’s a quality choice with a significant emphasis of very fresh dishes.“Spectacular”? Probably not.But different, delicious and value - I would say yes.My only “gripe” - the DJ and live Saxophonist were simply too loud.Would I visit again? Definitely.

Author: AnnaR8287
Title: Visit this restaurant!
Review: This is the best restaurant we have been to in Langkawi! Except for the great food, the service is no doubt perfect. Fantastic!!

Author: drsashi74Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: THE place to hang out in Miri
Review: Ming Cafe is located near the Pullman Hotel in downtown Miri. Popular with expatriates, locals and tourists alike, it s buzzing with activity after dark. The atmosphere is spiced up with great music and a menu which caters to both western and asian tastes. A decent variety of beers and liquor is available too... I d avoid the salmon steak or grilled fish...we found the fish a bit stale. One has the option of

Author: Rose R
Title: Porky Ribs!
Review: I always love pork ribs and of course BBQ ribs but that was in a traditional way of local Borneo people made it with my mum special recipe (Mum's always the best). But Mike's Smokehouse brings back my childhood memories of this taste, a bit dry and crunchy but still juicy inside, its just sooo yummy! It was for my belated birthday dinner with a few friends, thanks for friendly waiter that serve us that night.

Author: Simon CSydney
Title: Decent food, great ambience
Review: Dined at Gobo in February. Thoughts are below:1. Service - Excellent service. The manager Wan Fazrul was very friendly and welcoming. I had planned a surprise for my wife and he went out of his way to help me plan it, despite the fact he was not working on the night of the event. The waiters at the restaurant are very friendly as well.2. Ambience - The restaurant is clean, the tables are spotless and the inside of the restaurant is great.3. Location - Location is near the twin towers and inside the Traders Hotel. Easy to get to and near transport.4. Price - Typical Malaysia, it is cheap despite being an upmarket restaurant. We got out of there for $35USD/head.Negatives:1. View - Being so close to the twin towers, there is no view of the twin towers from the dining area. If you want a view of the twin towers then try the lounge.General comments:1. Food - The food here is average. If you wan't steak then this is worth a visit. It is not the best food Ive had in the world but its also not the worst. I left satisfied but not amazed.If I was in the area, I would visit again, but don't go out of your way.

Author: Anne W
Title: On top of the world with Oetronas Towers in view
Review: Great view, great music, great beer. Great night ! We were staying in the hotel, wentI up to the roof bar, the Petronas Towers lit up as a backdrop, thumping beats from the DJ...excellent !

Author: mario5400Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Very good Indian food
Review: We came here twice for dinner during our 3 day stay and really liked the fresh food that was well presented and not too pricy. The orange juice was great, the dosas really good and the fresh spring rolls also. I especially enjoyed the Dahl makani. We will be back when in town again

Author: MontanaCyclist
Title: Bad food wrapped up in a fancy bow for tourists.
Review: This place is simply not good. It's not really Nyonya either. Try Kota Laksamana area for much better food.

Author: Maat75
Title: Langkawi’s best grill
Review:
As my kids said: ‘Can we also eat here tomorrow...!!’
Friendly staff and quick service. Just good food freshly grilled in front of you. Personal touch by the Syrian staff. Tip: nice triple dip as a starter.

Author: Russell BCanterbury, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely breakfast
Review: We only had brunch here but the service was excellent and the food good. After wandering on foot through China Town it was nice to relax here. We were somewhat confused with our tourist map but the very helpful hotel receptionist gave us her map and directed us to where we were intending to go. The hotel reception area and dining room were spotless and should imagine the bedrooms are too. It was a haven of peace and tranquillity after wandering through the narrow alleys of the Chinese food market with all its smells, scooters and people.

Author: WhyoneMui Ne, Vietnam
Title: Great atmosphere, wonderful steak!
Review: This has become a favourite and regular fixture for myself and my work colleagues whilst working in KL. Its an unprepossessing 'hawker' style set up (i.e. several different businesses serving food to a common area of tables) - hence you get several menu's brought to you as you sit down. The seating is under a corrugated iron roof, open to all sides. The atmosphere on a busy night (Friday/Saturday) is great - especially if it is raining hard! Satay is a popular starter, and the steak is of very high quality (NZ or Aussie sourced) well cooked and extremely reasonably priced. Service is extraordinary - after 6 weeks away, 4 of us returned. Our regular friendly and bubbly waitress greeted us warmly and proceeded to tell us with 100% accuracy what type of steak each of us would like, how it should be cooked, what sauce we would like....oh, and some English mustard as well. Remarkable! A 'Witches Hat' for desert rounds a meal at Suzi's off very nicely indeed.PS - don't be put off by the sign on the loo doors!!!!

Author: JoL855
Title: Tasty meal
Review: Bright clean place. Friendly staff. Food freshly prepared, tasty and good value. Easy walking distance from Sentral station,shops and hotels. Good place to get a good tasty Indian meal.

Author: orionstar85
Title: Service and foods so so
Review: Service very slow and bad. Food not teasty at fall. I won't come back again. Staff also not friendly.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: keeleyellisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointing experience.
Review: Very disappointing experience. The service was extremely slow took nearly 1 hour for our main course to arrive .. the menu says fresh pasta and we actually saw them take a bag of dried shop bought Penne pasta into the kitchen to cook for us ... the food was extremely average, the wine we ordered in fairness was nice but over priced . The lamb shank was served cold and had no flavor and was tough .. you don’t serve cold food it’s not acceptable. I wouldn’t recommend this place. We even travelled 30 min in a taxi as was expecting an amazing Italian meal .. sadly wasn’t the case.

Author: MaisieLow
Title: Good food horrible service cold food
Review: I went there with a group of girls. On the side note, we each arrive separately over a course of 1 hour.. Bijan’s food is good! Top quality food. I had the beef ribs, curry prawn, whole fried fish, black squid and lamb shoulder. The beef ribs were tender, succulent, sweet and tasty, rm88 with 3 short ribs. Curry prawn was rm60, 6 pieces of prawn in thick coconut curry sauce. Whole fried talipia fish with tamarind peanut sauce was rm78. Lamb shoulder’s potato was under done. Overall the food itself was great! But all were served on a cold plate with running ceiling fan than made the food stone cold in a matter of seconds. The wait staff were all rather dumb. I asked for recommendations on their signature dish and they practically just named everything on the menu. They kept pushing for drinks and appetizers.. I asked for menu, they only brought the food menu without the drinks and for a fine restaurant like this, they do not serve table water. That’s a huge disappointment.. also, when we asked for the bill and was ready to pay, no one was going to take out bill. We were ready to just walk out. I would say that no matter how good the food is, I am not willing to pay such high price for cold food and bad service.

Author: wesleyh532
Title: 2 thumbs up!
Review: Must try spot in Melaka, excellent food and reasonable price. The ambience is just perfect for the historical city.

Author: 66mikepRas Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
Title: First night disappointment
Review: Was our first night in KL and Souled Out was recommended by a colleague who had visited earlier from Europe. Oh dear what a complete disappointment. We had fish and chips and steak and chips. I guess the only edible part, just, for both of us was the chips! The fish was brown and looked totally inedible, the steak was ok if you liked chewing gristle. The food was not very hot either. Maybe it was a bad night, but after discussing with other work colleagues here in KL it seems this is more the norm. Not a place I will be returning to or recommending.

Author: Chin-FahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: I dropped in for a late dinner. With some rave reviews on FB about its curry mee, it turned out to be disappointed The roasted pork (char siew) was sold old and replaced by some tiny, limp wantan. The curry soup was very bland and I added a lot of soy sauce to give it more taste. There were a few stalks of vegetables (not generous).The medium size was quite small, and all in all, it costs RM9.00. I didn't think it was value for money. The experience wasn't quite what I was expecting.

Author: 885shankars
Title: Jazz show and dinner
Review: Attended the show of Rachel Guerzo and friends for dinner. The show was enjoyable but the seats uncomfortable. Got a high chair despite a reservation online. Food was half decent. The music was the redemption.

Author: invisible999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing...
Review: So this is 'the' fancy place - on 41st floor of the hotel. It comes with three attributes 'view/atmosphere', 'food' and 'value for money'. The catch is - you have to select ONLY one from above three and letter two are not really available for selection.If you come here to have a tasty meal - you will regret it and to add insult to injury - you'll feel cheated of you money. Money you spent on a single meal is enough to feed a family at excellent local restaurant. Especially try to avoid meals with shrimp in them - I had a feeling that they died due to natural causes and then been served at this restaurant - after that meal had to spend reminder of my evening at bathroom.Nothing bad can be said about service, but again - if you want to be on a safe side just order glass of wine, sit inside and enjoy the view.

Author: LilkevsSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Horrible.
Review: Please. Save your time and go to Morganfields. The ribs were so bad here. I don't see what the hype is about. They only have 1 type of spare ribs flavour. And I thought that is what naughty nuri is famous for. We also order fried pork snack which was so chewy. Don't waste your time coming to this or any other outlet for that matter.

Author: Guzheng_KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Recommend you window side seats for view
Review: Every time I go to KLCC Chili, we need to wait for seats at least 20 minutes, mostly more than half an hour. But it is nice to sit at window side and look down KLCC park fountain. I recommend you to visit here after dark.

Author: PipPaul W
Title: Expensive
Review:
Had a beer here whilst watching the world go by on Jonker Street.
Was our most expensive whilst in Melacca

Author: wanyueg
Title: Nasi bojari, dish that I must have
Review: Dining atmosphere is good, advisable to call for reservation otherwise get there before lunch time you'll be fine.

Author: Teyf2014
Title: Service needs improvement
Review: First visit with relatives. Wanted to eat dim sum but missed the timing as dim sum is only served till 5pm.1. Food salty. Nothing to rave about.2. Aircon was dripping. When water dripped on one of us, we told them and they simply switched off the airconditioner. But it continued to drip water. At the end of the meal, one of the service staff said they are aware. But obviously no apologies offered.3. One of us asked for wifi password, but was given a password that did not work.4. Service staff basically rude and just ignored our query when we told them there were hardly any meat in the braised fishhead.

Author: Mustang645
Title: Not a good experience
Review: Service was fair as the food the coffee could have been stronger and hotter. The staff just did not seem to be interested in serving customers on the day we were there.

Author: Richard PSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Find at JPO
Review: We go across to JB quite often and thanks to my lovely wife, we always end up at JPO. This place is probably the best thing about it! Food is always good, the service friendly and efficient and it's an excellent place to relax from the horrors of shopping. I am seriously going to sort out a boys' tour to JB and spend the weekend here.
Restaurant: George & Dragon Cafe at Taman Tasek

Author: Tsai C
Title: Peaceful environment - good place to dine in
Review: Was there for lunch with family. Light music as background music. Ordered salmon burger. Food taste is good. Portion abit small for us. Overall good service. Suitable to hang out for coffee and desert as well.

Author: SusanWellingtonWellington, New Zealand
Title: Did not live up to expectations
Review: Appetisers and desert were great. Mains get mixed reviews. Sous vide barramundi was dry, wagyu beef cheeks were tough and needed more time at a slow cook. Duck breast exceptional. Between main and desert they forgot about us and once reminded that we were still there desert was quick. Did not refill water. Overall a disappointment given TA reviews

Author: 207maggiec
Title: Over rated Mee Hun Kueh
Review: Not worth the wait for the not so tasty noodles in clear soup. The shop is always crowded, humid and uncomfortable to dine in.

Author: RONALDODIMATTEO
Title: Very good food - Cheap set lunch
Review:
Nice place, well decorated.
Very good food (especially the pasta)
Cheap set lunch
Very friendly staff

Author: Saim7Preston, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food
Review: Good food and Quick service which is exactly what we wanted for lunch. Could use a bit of renovating though as its quite old plastic. Price was a slightly higher than we expected for a cafe. Andrew was not present when we went so missed his service as mentioned in the other reviews.

Author: Stayoshi
Title: Mediocre
Review: Food variety was rather limited.  Western food quality, especially the cold dishes is subpar. Local food fared slightly better.  There is a band that goes around playing.  It was quite nice and created a good atmosphere. The customer service was ok.

Author: chubbykittytravels
Title: Bak kut teh
Review: Soup is more herbal and not the peppery type. Can add mushrooms for rm5. Quite generous portions and can request for soup refill. Do go early as it tends to get crowded during peak lunch hour.

Author: michellemarionKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used to be a fan, not anymore.
Review: I went for the Sunday Buffet Lunch with my husband yesterday. It all started from the reservation, I made the reservation on Friday for the sunday lunch, but was informed by the staff that they only serve ala-carte menu on Sunday. Confused, I checked the website, it clearly mentioned that buffet lunch is available on sundays. I made another call to check again and insisting that buffet is available on sunday. To cut the story short, I managed to book a table for two for sunday finally.We arrived at the restaurant at 1215pm, there were barely 10 customers. We were led to our table by the staff, then a waiter came to our table asking if we would like to order some drinks, and he raised his index finger at my husband. Raising an index finger directly pointing at a customer, that was rude! The waiters hardly smile too!Food wise, I think they must have cut down the food variety by 50% since our last visit in Nov 2011. And I remember the food quality and variety they used to offer back in 2008 - 2010, what we saw yesterday was just plain disappointment.

Author: noisyminor
Title: Great food but the worst service ever!
Review: I made a reservation few days ago and requested for the vip room but was told it was first come, first serve system. When I went there on Friday night, 2 vip rooms were taken by "reservations"! I asked why was the difference treatment but no one at the counter bothered to fix the issue. Thumbs down big time!Then we had the dinner. 2 orders were wrong and I has to send them back. Thumbs down again. Food was great as always, especially the lamb fallen off the bones. My guests were very satisfied with the dishes I ordered. I will go for the food again but never for the fine dining experience as advertised. The staff are in need of urgent training. Many of them were busying using their smart phones while working!?

Author: championstuartLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing. Super salty
Review: Was excited about this and the menu looked very appealing, in that it had a relatively limited but specialised repertoire. However, the bamboo chicken tasted as if the top had come off the salt shaker. It was almost inedible it was so salty. The spicy fish was only acceptable, and the veg dishes were nice to try but nothing special. This meal left us gasping for water and we left very disappointed. On the plus side, the staff were very friendly, and it was cheap. Sorry, but I can't recommend it and I'm surprised to see so many positive reviews - gutted that our experience wasn't better

Author: JulesP205
Title: Fantastic
Review: If ever you go to Ipoh, this is a must in dining.  Great menu, fantastic surrounds,  did lunch then dinner on the same day last year, then dinner again this year.  It is a must do in Ipoh

Author: Manky11Eltham, Australia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Had dinner here which was a very pleasant experience. Nice courtyard location with a pleasant ambience. Staff very polite and good service. I had the Nasi Goreng which was absolutely fantastic - loved it. Very reasonably priced for the quality of the food. Not to be missed if you want a restaurant that caters for both local and western food tastes.

Author: kentwongbugKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Middle Eastern Feeling
Review: Fantastic shisha lounge. The decoration was impressive and totally brought out the middle eastern feeling. Service was great and no problem at all. However, the downside probably the choice of drinks a little lack of options. The place wasn't that spacious so you could experience crowded during peak time. Overall it was fantastic.

Author: ritajegaJohor
Title: Expensive place
Review: This restaurant is located at Kg Sungei Danga Johor Bahru.Its not cheap like those days.The location is great and its at the sea of danga. can feel the glipse of water and enjoy meal with the wind from the sea.. You be facing the sea can see singapore and danga bay. We ate Black pepper crab, Prawn, Baby kailan with mushroom, Sotong and fish. Which cause six of us RM 402.00. We use to eat at this place few years back and its not so expensive like now. Got shock with the bill.

Author: Gerard R
Title: The perfect place for an ice cold beer on a hot day!
Review: The reason we visited this place was for its famous Snow Beer: - where semi-frozen beer is poured from the bottle into frozen beer glass; where the beer foam becomes crystallized and the beer itself remain super cold but in liquid form! We also had the Ikan Bilis; which was a little bit spicy to my liking!The staffs were very friendly, the service was fast and prices were reasonably cheap, definitely a perfect place for a cold beer on a hot day!

Author: Justinlyh
Title: Arrogant
Review: Visited this restaurant for lunch, even you go early to the restaurant, the were always crowded with customers, you need to queue up at outside waiting for call. The service was bad and arrogant. Price rather expensive and the food quality had dropped.

Author: DrShawnPaul
Title: Average claypot chicken rice
Review:
No idea what the hype is about, found the rice to be too salty and no burnt crispy rice at the bottom of the claypot(come on, that is the best part).

Average at most.

Author: CKY281
Title: Short of ambitious goals
Review: I have patronised this place on 6 occasions over the past few months given proximity to my office. The decor is enticing but food quality is consistently average. The serving staff generally lack communication skills. Have tried many dishes and small plates but none was outstanding.

Author: johnkim9889Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just slightly above average
Review: In fact I have visited this restaurant numerous times since they left the old place to the present one which is just at the back of the old place,well in fact I have tried their chicken chop,pork chop,mee hailam,French toast,roti babi and so on but I find that most of the item is just so so only nothing very special maybe it's up to individual but one for sure is that they still maintain the olden days classic taste

Author: rajj21300
Title: "NICE"
Review: Food was normal. We ordered and the food came fast and the service was good. Price wasnt reasonable since the food wasnt rich. Place was cosy and warm. Tipped the staff  because they were nice n greeted with a smile once we entered in.

Author: amkh782001Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never a disappointment
Review: I think Baan 26, located at the bustling Changkat Bukit Bintang has stood the test of time.It's been around for years as I keep on coming back and seeing it around unperturbed by all the changes around the area.The bars and restaurants around Changkat often change, only a handful have been around for a long time. Baan 26 being onr of them.It is a restobar with very basic arrangement. If you see it among theother bars along this road you may not be enticed.Among locals and those who frequent this area, know that Baan 26 is the real deal.Really good food. (Kudos to the chef). Authentic Thai as authentic could be. The dishes are better than the ones I've had in Thailand.The waiters are alert and nice. The music which starts getting louder after 9.30/10pm is sometimes retro hiphop is easy to start your night of partying with.All I can say is, if you're unsure, head on to Baan 26. It will not disappoint.

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Original Chicken Rice ball
Review: Hoe Kee restaurant goes back to many years, just only rented a stall at the coffee shop near the bridge before they set up their own restaurant nearby. Their chicken rice balls with steam chicken is the original & the most famous in Malacca. Later, they added assam fish, soup & vegetables. The service is ok but during weekends & festive seasons it is packed with lots of people and the queue is rather very long wait for a table. The prices are reasonable and its great to have your meals here.

Author: ZoeR1090Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing all day breakfast!
Review: Great food selections. You can have breakfast and dessert all day here. Coffee was okay, food was amazing, and their desserts are a complete finish. I love the ambience here, it's private and cosy. But i do feel the staff is less friendly than other places I went. Will come again for pancakes. :)

Author: Hidayah Z
Title: Bad Service
Review:
Worst when we only get main menu.
Have to wait our side menu for so long end up, they didnt prepare it for us.
This is not first time but SO MANY TIME.

Author: Lance-Travellot
Title: Cheap aged cigars
Review: One of the largest and well stock cigar shop. Prices are below what you pay in nearby hotels.  Food is so-so.

Author: Mfamilysgp
Title: Overrated
Review: Tried for lunch. Service was very slow even though restaurant was not crowded. The food was just solo and service is small for the price I paid.

Author: TRIPSPJLEE
Title: dinner disaster
Review: went for Mexican buffet , food was cold and old , then order beef burger which was more bread than beef , chips were dangerously salty , order bottle of wine was too warm needed to be chilled.

Author: WishdocbrianKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid this place unless you are a sucker for poor service and rudeness
Review: I have been there a few times .. food is average at best. However there are few restaurants in Bangsar which serve pork. However my last experience there helped me decide I would never patronise this joint again.It was a Sunday brunch and my nieces wanted a fry up with sausages and REAL bacon. There were only about 4 tables which were occupied. I asked for a glass of wine and when it did not arrive, I inquired and was told that they do not do house pours for lunch. I am fine with that but at least they should inform me. However when the bill arrived, i was CHARGED for the wine. I complained to the manager ( presumably he was) and the charges were reversed. Instead of an apology, I was reprimanded for not understanding that they were busy and short staffed. Is that an excuse for poor service. BTW there were only 4 tables occupied. Can you imagine the service if it was full.....???

Author: Cikgu
Title: Consistently good
Review: This is the third time I've been to Cottage Spices. The first visit was an alternative to Nonya Makko because Makko was closed. We did not regret that visit. This time I visited Cottage Spices for lunch. Quite easily accessible, within walking distance from Hatten Hotel, next to Fenix Hotel. Roadside parking is available. Restaurant opens at 12 for lunch. We were there early but invited to sit inside while they got ready. When we got into the restaurant, others started streaming in as well. However, they did not flip their 'CLOSED' sign until their kitchen was ready!!We ordered sambal prawn petai, chincalok omelette, kangkong belachan, sambal ladies' fingers, ayam buah keluak and itek tim for our group of 6. Unfortunately, ayam buah keluak was not ready and the itek tim was not available for the day. We ordered Ayam Kapitan as an alternative.The prawn petai was good, large prawns fried with sambal petai. The chincalok omelette was done like a typical western 3 egg omelette - very fluffy and full bodied omelette. it had onions, some chilli and a subtle taste of chincalok.The kangkong belachan was good as it was not overly spicy and salty. It tasted just right to the point that you could eat it on its own without too much rice.The ladies' fingers were freshly steamed and the young pods were crunchy and not too slimy. This was served with fresh chilli and onions and a splash of lime. Very refreshing and appetising.I expected the ayam kapitan to be dry fried like the Penang variety. However, it was similar to a non-spicy rendang, rich and tasty.We also ordered two servings of chendol to share and the server gladly provided us small bowls and 6 spoons. Thoughtful service that was friendly and efficient.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: SyazwanMalik
Title: A unique experience
Review: I make a reservation for my anniversary. The reason why i choose Dining In The Dark in the first place is because I want tp do something different for my anniversary. Reservation is done through tableapp. When we arrive there, parking was an issue but according to FAQ in their website, they suggest few places to park your car but in the end I just use vallet parking around bukit bintang area (RM15).Upon arriving, there are two to three games to prepare you. First is juice tasting where you have to guess what is in the juice mix. Next is searching paper clip in a cup. You'll be blindfolded and must use your touch to find three to four paper clips. Final game is block arrangement where you'll be blindfolded and they'll ask you to rearrange blocks. After that you'll keep your phone, watches in their safe box and wait for you waiter to take you to the darkness. Upon entering the door via human train, you'll not be blindfolded but believe me you can't see anything. Its pure darkness. You'll have to rely on your sense of touch to grab spoon, drinks. Its a 4 course meal and each course comes with two to five dishes.Considering everything, its quite a unique experience as you guess the dish and have conversation with your partner.I would suggest this place to anyone who wanted to do something different. Its a must have experience at least once in a lifetime.

Author: WindLynnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is average but slightly overpriced
Review: Referrred by aunt to this nyonya restaurant but ended up very disappointing ! We were there on Feb 20 after a long night looking for this restaurant. As we entered, there was nobody in the restaurant. Aircond all off & many mosquitoes !!! Then a foreign staff came from the kitchen behind & have us. The ambience is very poor that we hesitated to leave or order. I just can't stand the mosquitoes ! So worried for my 18mo son ! Since it was late, we decided to order. When cendol was served, there's no red beans & whatsoever. When asked the staff, he told us cendol does not has red beans ! Also we ordered 3 cendols and 1 turned out to be half of the other 2. Food presentation is poorly done ! Won't refer anyone there ! Food is just so so and yet they are slightly overpriced ! Like KL city price ???

Author: G783ZSmichellel
Title: The whole place is just crazy
Review: Crazy crowd and the queue is just so long. Hardly can find a place to sit, esp if you come in a small group, chances are people will just book the whole table for themselves. If you're lucky you might be able to find people who are willing to share the table with you.

Author: jokl78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very pricey
Review: Came here for a few drinks. Not much choice on food. Beer selection plenty till you don't know what to order. 12 types of beer on tap. I must warn that it's very very pricey. RM37 for a glass of beer. A glass not a pint. And it's not a high end restaurant. It's super duper expensive for a beer near this area. The most expensive i would say. Lousy happy hour promotion. Definitely will not be back because of the price.

Author: BorneoJessieKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Delicious home cooked Nonya food
Review: Took a taxi out to Amy's as it was located in Melaka Jaya, far from our hotel in Jonker Street. We arrived around 6pm without a reservation as it was mid week. We were VERY LUCKY to get a table as the places was very popular with both the locals and the tourists. We saw people who have booked being turned away through out the evening.The layout was simple and the service was polite and good.We have the Sambal Jangtung Pisang ( Bud of the banana flower in a tangy salad dressing) to start. I finally get a chance to try the Ayam Buah Keluak which was very tasty - the chicken is tender and the gravy is tasty and thick. Then we ordered the Fish in Chilli and Garlic topping with the Prawn and Pineapple Curry. I also ordered a portion of the Mee Siam to try. I have not have Mee Siam for a very long time. It was not bad. I finished with the Cendol.. which was not as good as others in Melaka. Overall, the food was well prepared and quite huge in portions for the 2 of us. It was tasty and we would recommend them to others. We will tell them to book in advance to be on the safe side.

Author: Tarn TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Ads lied about its menu price
Review: I tried to go there for the Malaysia International Gourmet Festival 2015 as seen in the booklet that they have been giving out everywhere. I wanted to to try the 4-course fine dining menu during the MIGF October month because of the attractive pricing. However, when I was at the restaurant, the price DOUBLED the one shown in the ads! Truly disappointed with a 5-star hotel to be either making an obvious and crucial typo or blatantly cheating people to go to the restaurant.

Author: ShirleylslSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience but not so nice food
Review: Read about the reviews and decided to give it a try. Even has to ask around to get to the right place as the address stated in tripadvisor which is lead by google map not accurate. A dining place with good ambience with good and polite service staffs. However, the taste of food were so disappointing. I order aglio olio prawn and it was totally tasteless. The Lynette's wanton were average but the chili sauce was good. Not a suitable place for young kids. We also find the food were a little pricy.

Author: BramDoc
Title: Lunch at the Apartment
Review: Visited The Apartment prior to visiting the Twin Towers. It was relatively quiet for a Saturday but the service was good. We mostly had starters band drinks. Would have visited again if I had time

Author: but-first-we-eat
Title: Amazing find and local experience
Review: Discovered this gem and so happy we visited, the food was amazing accompanied by the friendly helpful staff and setting. All the dishes are authentic and hearty, the owners are a delight explaining to us all the dishes. Pia also offered cooking classes, which I wish we knew prior to the trip as I would have loved to do one. She offered us to take photos of the recipes and talked us through how to make them - most of which we ate for dinner. A must to try when visiting!

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Not quite what we were expecting!
Review: We decided to try the set dinner, which was reasonably priced and had sufficient variety, and would give us a cross-section of what the restaurant had to offer. We also added 2 glasses of red wine, at RM15 a piece, which was cheap and cheerful, but of questionable quality.The salads, one was Siamese, the other had smoked duck, were very enjoyable and a pleasant starter. The carrot soup, with a large crouton, was also pleasant enough.The disappointment came with the mains. The steak was tough, tasteless, and the sauce was bland. The confit of duck was also disappointing, and had been over-cooked by deep frying before it was served.Dessert was a scoop of chocolate ice cream with chocolate sauce and small pieces of sponge cake. It was tasty!It wasn’t clear how long the restaurant had been open with the current format; however, the washroom area, adjacent to the food preparation area I might add, was extremely dirty and was in need of a deep steam clean or hosing down with disinfectant. It also looked to me as if food was being left in the open for long periods which would explain the bland taste of the mains. The waitress was clueless about handling cutlery, touching the bowl of the spoon with her fingers.Food quality ***Hygiene **

Author: SherLynNg85Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing lunch
Review: It has been awhile since we last visited Zipangu and was actually anticipating a good lunch taking advantage of a long weekend. When we first arrived, we clarified a credit card promotion which was then confirmed that we will receive a 50% on all items in the menu every Monday. After placing our order, we were then told that this it is a blackout day today and we will not be able to enjoy the said promotion. Due to the error, we were then offered a free dessert as compensation. Although we understand that this is a small overlook, we would have much appreciated a gesture of allowing us to reconsider our order or a dessert of our choice. Don’t mean to sound petty but isn’t that what service is about especially in a renowned brand like Shangri-La. Our order of wagyu hot pot and grilled salmon were both over cooked. Our server tried to take away our plate of salmon in a much dissatisfactory manner with no explanation. Due to the profound disappointment, we left without even enjoying the offered free dessert of ice cream flavour of our choice. Perhaps it is our expectations that Shangri-La would offer a much pleasant experience to their guest which unfortunately we did not experience the slightest much spoken of hospitality. We hope to have a better experience the next time we do return.

Author: S_A_Wills09London, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible service
Review: Sometimes the food is not worth it... 3 of us ordered at the same time yet it was well over an hour before the last dish (a pizza!) came to the table, with the other two coming at a time difference too. The most expensive dish on the menu, fish with crab sauce, came covered in grated parmesan- for someone with a lactose intolerance this was unacceptable especially as there was no mention on the menu of any cheese involved. We put it to one side and it was over 45 minutes before a server asked what was wrong with it- and then left it there until the end of the meal, not even attempting to fix it in any way... A very disappointing, expensive meal. Customers around us were either complaining that their stakes were not done as ordered or their food was nowhere to be seen and staff was shouting around- 'Food for table 12!!!' and so on. Chaos!Very high prices for a very poor service and food ruined by cheese grated over everything and not in the dish description.

Author: Sagar P
Title: Antiauthentico Italian food.
Review: When you come to an Italian restaurant and read a menu that's in Italian, you expect the flavours that you enjoyed when you ate it in Italy. Yes, the expectations are high, but then so are the prices.But let's not talk about the prices. Its what you'd expect to pay in an Italian restaurant in an upmarket locality in Kuala Lumpur. It's a fairly large restaurant on an expensive piece of land. So first, I'll start with the ambience itself... Brick interior with mirrors, old air-conditioning units and old plates and frames on walls. Some places badly lit and other places too bright. Pretty authentic.The expectations therefore was for the food to be equally authentic. So we look at the house wine... And end up drinking one Australian and another Chillean wine. And this is where the authenticity went out of the old ceiling height window. The least they could do was at least serve an Italian red.We asked for the bread that is usually served before the meal but they said that they ran out of bread... By 7.30 pm on new year's eve?! We ordered insalata d'antara arancia (duck salad with orange). The vinegar was unevenly spread which made it very sour in one place and the sour orange made is very sour in the other place. Everything overpowering the taste of the duck itself. The other starter was a Gnocchi with prawns which was fried, crispy and tasteless. (As you can see, I'm giving up on the Italian names already) Disappointed, we decided to give the place one last chance. If this worked out, we'd order the dessert. I'll spare you the suspense, we didn't order the dessert in the end. Back to the mains, we ordered the risotto primavera that had hard rice, scallops wrapped in beef bacon and overall had as much flavour as a cardboard box. The second dish was a Wood Fried Lamb Shank that had no smokey flavours. The meat fell off the bone, which was really good and the mashed chickpea and vege with olives was good to taste.We really wanted the panacotta but really didn't want to get disappointed anymore. Hence I decided to write this review as the memory, unlike the food, is very fresh and am now calling for the bill.

Author: BunnyC_NatNYSingapore
Title: Speechless
Review: The price is sort of VERY EXPANSSIVE compare to other similar restaurant in JB area.As for service, it very much depends on your luck, some of the waiters are very nice and helpful but most of them are .... sigh.... I can't give a rate that are not successfully satisfied my expectation.. regarding our foods it really salty.. Need to improve your service and the foods

Author: IanHutton1066Valletta, Malta
Title: Great View
Review: Worth a visit for the view at sunset. Take photos no better place in KL. However, the food is not as good as the view. Great selection but most of it was cold or at best luke warm. Shame realty as view sells it, but please sort out the temperature of the food out. Great night but spoiled yo the food.

Author: cherylwA1293IQKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic unpretentious French food at value prices in a relaxed environment
Review: Hubby and I visited this restaurant with some trepidation, as the write-up in the newspaper mentioned that this was by the former owner(s) of Rendes-vouz in Bangsar. We didn't have a pleasant experience at Rendez-vous both times before, but decided to keep an open mind to visit Chez Gaston - and thankfully we did, as we walked away satisfied with a plan to return! This time, we found the place warm and welcoming, and had a good chat with the chef owner Florian who was affable and genuine in speaking with all his customers -so nice!The food was honest, unpretentious fare cooked like it came from a family friend's kitchen. We had the small sharing platter for 2 and it was great! The chicken liver pate was probably the best I've had (aside from my mum's) and it was served with caramelised onions that were sweet to offset the rich pate. For mains we shared an off-menu item - wild boar stew - while it didn't sound too exciting, it was really very hearty and tasty, without the usual weird wild boar odour. We later found out that it was imported boar meat. The french loaf went well to dip into the rich gravy. For dessert we had the classic creme brulee which didn't disappoint either. They have a decent selection of wines both from France and other old world and new world countries. Portion sizes are very generous and they don't seem to mind sharing, which is great.The place is non-airconditioned but sufficiently ventilated with large open areas and fans. Accessibility might be a challenge for those who need to walk with assistance or for the wheelchair-bound.All in all a good experience!

Author: travelbunny0306Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Attentive service by the manager :)
Review: I was staying in the Sheraton Imperial during my recent stay and I loved staying in the hotels during weekends just to pamper myself ! I had a try at the Chinese restaurant, Celestial Court after a great night sleep in the spacious rooms and and the experience turn out to be not too bad.I was dining alone at the restaurant and the manager, Ray was the one who really taught me on impeccable service. Alerting his team members that I was dining alone, they were so attentive to me and made sure i was really taken care of and the service staff offered me newspapers and magazines just to keep me accompanied. I felt as if i was not dining alone at all and even the manager made effort to make sure that i was comfortable.Although they do not have the best Chinese food, but the service was truly respectable. There were many choices of dim sum and a la carte menu, but i liked the dessert best, there is this herbal jelly with lychee granite that made my day! Talk about the sweet tooth :)I will be back to this restaurant as i believe the food can be improved. Kudos to Ray and his team!

Author: kevinkeen
Title: Late lunch again
Review: Nice food with a cup of latte surrounded in a relax environment and it makes my day. Especially friendly waitresses ;)

Author: marilyne2375
Title: Quaint premises
Review: Friendly and helpful staff. Overlooking the river which has its good and bad points. Nice quaint setup and homely premises.

Author: Stephen BOxford, England, United Kingdom
Title: Great quality beverages!
Review: Almost in the wrong direction from the main stretch of bars and restaurants along Pentai Cenang, but worth a detour if you have time. A nice atmosphere and a more sophisticated feel if you fancy a relaxing coffee or two somewhere quiter. Friendly staff lovely decor

Author: UnderpaidSamuraiSingapore, Singapore
Title: The Chef(s) Need A Performance Review, Right Away
Review: I really liked this place. It's by the river, at the foot of the entrance to Jonker Street. After a busy morning of river cruises and lots of walking, I decided to take my family in so we could cool down with a beer.Although there were no tables indoors, the service staff managed to get us a table in 10 mins which I really appreciate. The deco inside is great and there's lots of memoribilia and walking space.However, the food was poor. And that's an understatement.I had the New York Sirloin Steak which was tasteless and I had to get tobasco sauce so it could be palatable. And my wife had the nasi goreng, which again was tasteless. I find this quite incredible.

Author: Angelin C
Title: First visit was good, second was disappointing
Review: First visit ordered the fried chicken chop, fried rice. The food was abit pricey but not bad. The second visit was disappointing. Service was unfriendly. The chicken chop sauce was bland and watery. Portion looks smaller compare to the first time. The drink served with stains on all 4 sides of the cup. With that price rate, would expect a better service and food quality.

Author: Navigate41393097508
Title: Taste generally ok but a bit salty
Review: Location is nearby canning garden market. varieties of mostly Chinese hawker style food available. Parking space is ok except during lunch time and breakfast time. Pricing is reasonable. services are quite good. Choices of fresh fruit drinks , variety of local drinks including tea and coffee. There is also convenient stores nearby. Atmosphere is good and kept clean. Food is served promptly . Varieties of chinese breakfast dishes

Author: 351rhysd
Title: Quality and good value
Review:
Eaten here several times. The service and food are great and good value at the moment

Views are brilliant over the Puteri Harbour

Author: 100melvint
Title: Awful Customer Service (Worst ever!)
Review: We went to Urban Daybreak around 2pm on 3/11 to get lunch. When we went in, the staffs stopped us and told us that the restaurant was full so we have to wait, around 30 minutes. ( His attitude wasn’t very nice ). We are willing to wait as we understand that it’s weekend, it’s normal that restaurant get crowded. Therefore we ask them that if it’s okay to sit at the empty tables (Yes! We spotted 2 empty tables despite the staff told us that the restaurant is full, and there were no reserve sign put on top of the table also) near the entrance point while waiting as we have 2 kids under 6 years old and staff also busy walking at the hallway serving customers, we wouldn’t want to block their way. But what we got in return is silence treatment. The waiters just staring blankly at us, not offering any form of assistance. In the end, we were standing outside of the restaurant waiting for our turn. No, we didn’t get upset nor giving the waiters bad treatment, instead it was the opposite. While waiting, one of my family member wanted to use the washroom located at the end of the hallway inside the restaurant, and found out that there were actually plenty of empty seats inside. Afterwards, we questioned them (politely, not raising voice) about why they told us that it was full house with no empty seats available. This time the reply we got is, in their own words: “ We don’t have enough staff, so we cannot serve you.... “. No apologies were given and they replied in a rude manner. That’s the last straw! We decided to leave the place. If you have a pleasant experience dining at the restaurant, I’m happy for you. Maybe it’s just our bad luck having to encounter these staffs on our first visit at 3/11/19 Sunday 2pm (in case the owner read this comment, he/she can find the culprit and solve this issue so that it will not happen to anyone else). Haven’t try the food yet, will I ever return to that place again? Hell no!

Author: RickKRTKratie, Cambodia
Title: Good for people watching
Review: Located in a nest of fun international restaurants and bars with outdoor seating, this was a nice spot to enjoy a few drinks and eat dinner. Most of the wait staff on the night were chatty funny guys from India. They were very accommodating and if they thought we were struggling to find something we wanted to eat on the menu, they just kept bringing other menus. Apparently the adjacent restaurants pool their kitchens to provide a wider variety of food. Most of the items on the menus were western, but they also had an Indian menu. My companion had a huge grilled chicken burger on sesame bun that he liked and I had a couple of Indian dishes. The lamb boti kebab dish was a bit on the dry side but the roasted eggplant was nice, although generic baingan bharta.

Author: WelletjesTerheijden, The Netherlands
Title: Local food fish restaurant
Review: Our tour guide recommended this restaurant to us so we gave it a try. It is located on the top of a parking garage, not the place where we would have looked. We took the elevator and arrived at a huge open space with many tables and at two sites all food stalls showing there food. All food if required is cooled with ice. You can choose from all they offer and tell how you want it prepared, we order a red snapper, two different clamps, some vegetables and steamed rice. All was very well prepared and we very tasty.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is average albeit a little bit pricey
Review: Went there for dinner few days back and was slightly disappointed with the food. I have read reviews that the food was good and was hoping to get some nice Thai food here. The service was ok, but very enthusiastic, they smile and welcome you, and that is the extend of their service. Food was average. It was ok, but nothing to boast about and not very authentic Thai food (perhaps we do not know which ones to order). We had green curry, sweet and sour prawns and their signature crispy chicken with mango dressing. It was ok, but I would probably not visit here again.

Author: JozcatPerth, Australia
Title: Great break from the office for lunch
Review: Very comprehensive menu and fresh food. They even split our bill for us as we were all on business and wanting to pay separately. Would like to come back for dinner and try a banquet or share dishes. A calm and relaxing haven in busy KL.

Author: AizaJohari
Title: Nasi beriyani lovers' haven
Review: If you are a fan of nasi beriyani,this is a plave you should be.The rice is soft and well flavoured with splendid honeyed chicken dish.The price is slightly costly than the other shops but it is worth it.Only that the rice given is small portion
