Author: 932michelleeFasoula, Cyprus
Title: Snobbish owner, sluggish food & unpleasant
Review: We were only here because Ming Court was full of customers. An instant regret when we sat down on the table. They set up a strict system to order your dim sum only after you order your drink. We were greeted by snobbish rude attitude cashier and waitress overall, a really funny stare when my husband just wanted ice water... like she's never heard that before. If you don't want to start off your day with a rude service, okay or subpar food. Avoid this place. This place may look majestic from the outside, stone cold rubbish from the inside. No wonder Ming Court is constantly a full house !

Author: IvanTheBossTsim Sha Tsui, China
Title: Bad staff
Review: Very cool place,but here working some dangerous staff,they bring alkohol after 20 minutes and became angry.And they want to fight with you,be careful,manager is crazy.

Author: BKLau
Title: Slow service for average food
Review: Slow service for average food. Not worth the heat, wait and price. Looks better in photos than reality. Suggest trying other outlets.

Author: bubblesKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: people there are class concious
Review: i went there with my family, i noticed that they treat you better if you are well dressed and look like you come from a well do to back ground. they say it is pay much as you are willing but they expect you to put a big amount or else they'l give a stare as if u ate for free! i saw it happen to those people who place rm10 at the counter for each person. which i personally feel it is alright for vegetarian food and its pay as u feel. doesnt give a warm and welcoming feel unless you come wit a credit card

Author: Affan R
Title: Delicious authentic Pakistani cuisine
Review:
Was staying in KL for a few days and we went here everyday for lunch. We tried the chicken biryani, chicken tikka, butter chicken, cheese and garlic naans. All were superb! Also try there mango lassi which is awesome.

Highly recommended!

Author: NaturalPestControlBangkok, Thailand
Title: Seafood Buffet Saturday, not worth the money
Review: Expensive and not worth money.There was not much seafood, the seafood available smelled strange especially the crab. The meat the fry so long you can't eat because it's to sticky. There was no lamb shank as advertisement and for the rest only Malaysian food that you can buy everywhere.The staff was not friendly and didn't clean the table.We came here for some 5 star experience but this was very disappointing. We complaint to Selva but he didn't seems to take our complain seriously.

Author: Fion515Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mini dim sum
Review: This dim sum restaurant is getting famous with tourist crowd. Was been told to be there as early as possible to escape long waiting time. We arrived there before 8am and really escaped long waiting time. However, we are shocked to see their dim sum size. Their dim sum are in mini sized served. The taste of dim sum is quite good, just only we don’t like the dim sum are so small pieces. Besides, when we just get the table and going to sit down, their waitresses brought their dim sum and acted rushing to put down their dim sum as much and as soon as possible. I understood their customers are many, but I don’t like they served like chasing the customers to get and eat dim sum ASAP. The waitresses will straightaway put down 2 or 3 baskets for same dim sum when we are still looking and choosing their variety of dim sum. If we didn’t act fast to reject, then we might get many same baskets of dim sum. We won’t return here for dim sum. We still prefer Foh San at the opposite for better atmosphere, taste and presentation of food.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good, tasty south Indian food
Review: Visited Krishna with partners. 7 of us had banana leaf lunch meal with accompanying meats & seafood. The set meal was fresh and comes with good 3 types of vegetables, chutney & papads. We also ordered the fried chicken (good), fried fish (good), fried squid (good), crab cutlet (average), claypot mutton (very good). The meal comes with rasam (soup). Total bill was Rm110, which is quite reasonable. Place is clean, managed by staff who're quick. Good place for good food.

Author: EKCL
Title: Rude customer service at Counter
Review: The counter girl, MIA was pretty rude if you asked to clarify the bill. However , please insist and she will take the difference from the till , unwillingly but without hesitation. Won’t be back.

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No much hype...
Review: Although along the Jonker Street, this is the one cafe serving alcohol drinks stands out among other since it is located in a very spot on premise, which tourists will just hop in very easily. We were there when the sky was very windy indicating the rain was coming. Ordered beers and desert.. but they forgot the beer order... need to constantly remind them.. this was not a good sign... they have live band with some good music.. quite crowded but it was just a normal cafe cum bar.... no big deal.. as I said, their location is good, so lots of tourist having a break there.When a heavy rain came, all patrons at the verandah just ran into the cafe.. even we sat inside, we felt rain just splashing in.... wow!!!Just a place to sit and rest...

Author: MglapKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Waste of time
Review: Visited the place to check it out as but were disappointed. We had 3 main, 1 side dish, a salad and a Thai tea. The problems that need to be further looked into are:(1) We have asked for the food to come all together and they've came one by one. Having the side dish without the main, it really makes no sense at all...you do not push things out the kitchen just because they were cooked earlier - you organise the food to come out at the right time..(2) Mushrooms were not edible. It was like chewing plastic...(3) Steaks were horrible and chewy - like eating someone's rubber shoe sole (4) Service - the person attending our table did not know that side dishes come with the main and the difference between well done, and medium-well. (5) Thai milk tea - more milk than actual Thai flavored teaThe Spanish and the salad were OK.

Author: FerdyMADJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Lots of delicious and halal foods
Review: This is heaven for budget travellers looking for various, tasty, and halal foods...I like the grilled pari fish a lot..., they were freshly grilled, hence were still hot when served.Eat it with rice, sambal, raw vegetables..., yum yum.... You might want to add salted egg too..And of course, with teh tarik, hot or cold, for the drink...Or just ask for a plate of rice, and then choose the food that you like by yourself, ranging from chicken, fish, beef meat, vegetables, sambal, etc...Around the hawker centre, you might also find Indian restaurants serving delicious briyanni rice and chicken...

Author: Melanie_Yeoh
Title: Not recommended
Review:
Pro: live music, people watching, loads to choose from the thick menu
Con: below average food and drink quality, small portion and it was overpriced

Verdict: Will go for a drink but not having a meal there... not worth...

Author: FrequentFlier660825
Title: Worth it
Review: Its a good cafe for some very nice beverages. The location is good too. Parking is not a problem too.

Author: Cikgu
Title: Crispy duck
Review: Restaurant serves roasted meats. Duck was tasty and moist. Skin was crispy! Char siew also well charred and tasty without being overly sweet. Portions were good for the both of us who went for dinner. Good to go earlier as last order for food is at 7pm. By the time we went, they had run out of roast belly pork and most veges. We had a stir fried iceberg lettuce which was nicely done and not salty at all.

Author: SanHec
Title: Simple & Friendly Cafe
Review:
Was there for brunch with family. Place were nicely decorated. Clean and comfortable. Service was fast, and staff were very friendly.

Food were average and slightly pricey. Coffee was so so. 

Generally not really bad, good place to meet up with friends

Author: DennisK1710
Title: bad food, bad service, good location to lure you in
Review: told them fish ball and plain rice smell and taste strange, waitress just hand over me bill and ask me to pay for everything include garbage dishes

Author: TheBusboyEureka, California
Title: Great food, GREAT people!
Review: My wife and I stay at the Renaissance hotel, so enjoy this fantastic buffet breakfast every day. As good as the food is, it is the staff that make it so special! From the personal greeting by Eza at the front, to the assistant manager Partheeban and his supervisor Patricia sharing their time and knowledge with us at the table, it feels like home away from home. We just feel that welcome. Head chef Chris, and Indian chef Joseph are equally as friendly, and go out of their way to ensure that your meal really satisfies. I would give six stars if I could!
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Wendychua1312
Title: Best japanese dining ever
Review:
Food is nice, Service is nice, worth to try
Better reserve Table before u come. Other than the Main Course, the dessert also nice to try

Author: GrazingAsianCape Town Central, South Africa
Title: Expensive for what you get. Low tide on every drink we received.
Review: We came here for a pre-dinner drink(s) and nibblies before dinner-proper. Disappointed as every drink we ordered (spirits with mixers, glasses of wine, pints of beer) came out under-poured and left us examining our glasses with raised eyebrows as we received them. Considering the prices they charge here (more than other establishments along the same street) - pretty poor. Also, 9RM for a side of guacamole? Really? Servings of snacks were small and a couple of the salsas tasted really odd (strangely bitter) so we did not eat them.There are more satisfying places to spend your money along Changkat. We won't be returning.

Author: thandsmut
Title: Blue rice
Review: Friendly restaurant with some interesting local foods. The blue butterfly flower rice is a definite novelty. No aircon but airy with the fans and high ceilings.

Author: TousTnTPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Busy Foodcourt with wide selection of food
Review: This is my nearest foodcourt & luckily for me one of my favourites. It is always busy with a good atmosphere. There is a wide selection of predominantly local foods but some international as well including Italian & burgers (no beef though). I find all the stall holders friendly, helpful & sympathetic towards non-locals & explain their food & offer variations if you prefer. The service is great with a large selection of drinks including beers & washrooms & toilets. Judging by the popularity with the locals the food is good & I certainly enjoy all that I have eaten with a special mention for the Char Kway Teow, claypot chicken & both the steamed & grilled fish stalls. The prices are very reasonable.

Author: vtST13Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Ok only
Review: Rated as one of the Miri popular breakfast spot, coffee are very subjective topic here if you claim to be one of the best, my personal preference is Nice café more than WZT. Kuey Chap taste more like soya broth than the herbal taste. Only the kolo noodle and Char kway teow store worth the penny to try. All others is just average, is basically people attract people outlet, parking is a challenge in the morning. Toast bread was not up to the expectation, just ordinary...look like Hainanese toast, but the taste not there yet...not a must or top choice in my personal opinion.

Author: Rachel T
Title: Delicious food and Good Service
Review:
The food here is delicious and has a good service by Ms Joanne.
This is the best waiter I have ever met.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: sathvinderKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for drinks..
Review: One of the better pubs in kl.. it's a cricket pub and those who want to catch the matches can go inside and enjoy a quiet atmosphere and watch the match.. on the outside however it can get rather noisy but great place to catch up with friends.. the beers are good and so are their bar bites.. a favourite of mine is their whisky sour which was awesome and the best that i have tried.. we also had the house white wine which was good as well..

Author: Susan TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hidden surprise!
Review: We were taken to Mangoes by the owner of where we were staying and it was in walking distance. We would never have found it otherwise as it is well tucked away. What a lovely surprise! It is in a lovely jungle garden setting with views of the sea. The owners are Lutz the German chef and Michele your typical friendly, welcoming Australian. The service was great and the beer was very cold. We had the impressive bratwurst with saukerkrat which was delicious and a very large serve. We actually went again the next night and had beef goulash, blue cheese salad and meatloaf. All delicious and hearty portions. Unfortunately too full to have dessert. Great german food and happy friendly atmosphere. Prices are very reasonable for beer and food.

Author: 639abbieCanberra, Australia
Title: Delicious Wonder
Review: Tips - the place does not take booking so be early, it accepts BYO drinks, best dishes are prawns, steam fish and noodles and salted eggs calamari. They open at six anytime after 7 you will be in a queue and hard to find park. Service is great and so is value for money. Enjoy!

Author: Sthewlis
Title: Enjoyed the food and drinks
Review: Enjoyed the food and drinks here. Staff were friendly. Loved the five layered dip. Was a nice spot for a cocktail and a small bite to eat

Author: Kat_KaaatTallinn, Estonia
Title: A huge dissapointment
Review: We chose for visit this restaurant because of good rating on Tripadvisor. However, it didn't meet our expectations at all. Firstly, the selected two different wines by glass from drink list were unavailable. So we decided to take cocktails. I took salad with shrimps and my boyfriend chose marinara pasta. I was totally dissapointed with salad, because it consisted of a few small shrimps and al the rest was lettuce, nothing more. Pasta was ok, but nothing special. Moreover, cocktails were not good too and I even couldn't drink it. The prices are not suitable for that kind of dishes and beverages. The only thing, which we liked, is quite nice location with a view on KL Tower. All in all, I do not recommend this restaurant!

Author: Chris FNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Good but not brilliant.
Review: Had lunch here with 2 pints of Tiger beer. Service was ok and very friendly. 3 different waiters tried to take our order! Was told my husbands meal would take 25mins and mine 5 so I asked that mine could come at same time as I was prepared to wait so we could eat together. Yes it took 25 plus mins for my husband's roast chicken sandwich to arrive but then my duck & Mango salad did not arrive. Hardly rocket science. But both meals were very tasty and satisfying. Not cheap but not over the top.

Author: Melvinles
Title: Family dining area
Review:
It’s a very simple food court with multiple stall selling the same thing.
Most of the food not to my liking, Guess it suits the local.

Author: maksudula2018Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: After a little Break
Review: After a year I came back this place Vins .Recently they change their menu .So server recommend me to try Calamari and egg while we are drinking .Combination of egg and calamari omg .my friend order a signature Seafood past wow its light in flavor fresh seafood and the note of basil .than we order a duck pizza probably it was best pizza we had in a year .Good service too but food was excellent .

Author: DrofpotsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: This is a superb restaurant, yes the decor is not high class, but cruelly did to the charm. The food and service is brilliant. Now there is. Sign on the main road it is easier to find. It is great value for money. I would highly recommend this place

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Special Malacca Chicken Rice
Review: Chicken rice ball is only available in Malacca. Famous & well known to tourists. The outlet in jonker street is always crowded

Author: Peelid
Title: decent music - average service - dry food
Review: music was great - the service was ordinary - the food was .. not

Author: Farhana_ary
Title: Awful food & service!
Review: The food doesn’t taste at all as Japanese! Lousy & tasteless food! Chilli paste source was old & Teppanyaki will never serve like this!

Author: syumokhtarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: lunch with family on birthday
Review: we had a lunch here with the whole family on our loved ones birthday. the choice of food quite interesting and the variety is also good. but however, i wish to see other choices of food like sushi, dumpling, or juice as an extra mark. the appetizer variety can be add more and one thing i want to highlight that is, if i am not mistaken, juices make us to pay separate bills, this is ridiculous. how come drinks not calculated in the same buffet package prices?? with that prices, i think you should consider for your customer to have a good food with good drinks.anyway, dining in while having a turn of kuala lumpur city was a very great experience. the staff are very friendly and good too. its worth to try and spent a very good food, good time, and good scenery with your loved ones.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Very good soup
Review:
Recommended to me by local...the dry bak kut teh (spare ribs) is very nice....something not every restaurant does.

The soup bak kut teh also very tasty

Recommended

Author: CorylusxSydney, Australia
Title: Beautiful view, good ambience but average food.
Review: We were a group of ladies celebrating, and had the table at the balcony which was nice. It's quite a small balcony with just 2-3 tables so you do get quite a bit of privacy. It's a good view overlooking KL with the KL tower in the background but that was pretty much it. Food was decent & some good, but not amazing. Pretty average food for the high prices, so the price premium is 70% for the ambience. The minimum charge per person doesn't help. Drinks were limited because the bar menu was separate & we could not order from the wider range of cocktails they had. They did offer us a few extra options later but I question the need to separate them unless the bar was full & busy, but it was not. Tip to management: cocktails are revenue generating so you really should make the most out of it.

Author: wizman007
Title: THEY SERVE OLD FOOD EVEN WITHOUT HEATING IT
Review: terrible terrible, its a disgrace to thai food. they served us old food even without heating it. awful service was bad and the quality of food was so poor you cannot eat at this awful restaurant. malaysian health authorities must shut this place down

Author: Pass me tDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: A really good hotel breakfast
Review: This is where I broke my vow to not have breakfast in any hotel on this trip. I wanted to save my appetite for as much street food as I could, but the variety here was just too tempting to pass on, as they had something for everyone. Whether you wanted a continental breakfast or an oriental one, these folks had it all. I'm so glad we ventured here, because it was here that I had the most unique boiled egg with Bubur Ayam. I have been trying so hard to understand how they stained the whites to black, and I really hope the hotel can solve the mystery for me once they read this post. I wish I had the desire to have the delicious noodle soups that were being prepared fresh and customized to everyone's preferences, or some Nasi Lemak; but I was really just in the mood for something sweet and conventional so I had a waffle with peanut butter and berry compote, and soul-soothing TWG Japanese Sencha tea, and some fresh juice to kick start the day!

Author: Arthur X
Title: Smuggled booze and rusty bottles
Review: Great atmosphere and entertainment. Food stalls by the side of the venue has decent food. Whole experience completely ruined by stale thinner infused booze and old beer.

Author: LondonBurlUnited Kingdom
Title: This place is OK
Review: Although in the Shnagri-La, its tucked away from the main lobby. Food is OK and so is service but really this place is nothing special. Nothing really wrong with it but, sadly, rather average.

Author: Kenny K
Title: Over rated in the web
Review: OK food, reasonable price, better food can be found in Melaka

Author: LucyCarvalhoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unworthy of a spot in a 5-star hotel
Review: Had dinner here with friends on New Year's eve. We arrived during the last hour of service, some of the food stations were unmanned and there weren't enough waiters. The quality of the food was poor, we had to wait 20 minutes for the most expensive bottle of prosecco (£53) and still paid full price for the special countdown dinner. Stay away.

Author: Ser1980
Title: Not bad
Review: The lasi lemak is nice. slight change of menu for the 2 breakfast that I have. which is nice.  However, maybe it's the crowd the service is quite slow.

Author: ABChappytraveller123
Title: Breakfast at Vasco's
Review: Good spread. Attentive, engaging, thoughtful and helpful staff all round. Special mention to Kumar who made us feel relaxed and comfortable despite it being a busy morning. Mum really enjoyed her breakfast (-:

Author: kongkkPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Restaurant do business with no integrity
Review: Becareful of the dimsum bill during weekends. Price are not shown in the weekend menu template. When the bill comes, price does not tally with the menu items price during weekdays. It should be the same price.Do note down what have eaten, request for weekdays menu with price and calculate. It happened to me on my both visits. First round we dint check, when back home only notice. Second time we check on the spot and same wrong pricing happen again. Come on..such big group of restaurant, why cheat on small money. It won't be coincidence for wrong pricing twice?

Author: AliM1879
Title: Foodies must visit
Review: A must do for those who crave excellent food above all else. Fresh, delightful, fantastic value, fabulous service. A place you would not mind repeating during the visit. Its really that good.

Author: Bealom
Title: Best burgers in town
Review:
Craving for a nice burger? Fatboy is your place. Located in the Publika square, you can choose among many options, all very tasty. 
The menu does not match your needs? You can create your own. 
Fair prices. Great service. Cons?
Do not choose onion rings.

Author: chrisr785
Title: Not veggie friendly
Review: Nice looking chicken curry but avoid if u don’t eat meat. We were offered plain biryani with no meat but only chicken curry sauce available. Oh well, live and learn. It’s a high throughout place so don’t expect any customized dishes. No alcohol either.

Author: paragkaraniaFlowood, Mississippi
Title: Average
Review: Place is average at best. Food is not fresh as the sushi was not good. Bento box was good. being in the basement of the mall and food court there are so many options to choose from and the variety is huge. Service is fast though

Author: Mohd HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is expensive and caused me and my whole family to have diarrhoea
Review: My honest advice. Don’t visit this branch. I spend over 650 ringgit last night only to cone back and suffer from acute stomach complications. I thought it was only me but when i asked my kids today, the too suffered acute stomach discomfort. What a waste of good money on such lousy food.

Author: NeilwmckaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Good dining experience
Review: Very good overall experience but I would sound a few notes of caution that meant the rating fell short of a 5.My wife & I ate dinner here while staying at the Le Meridien and also grabbed a snack (rather than a full meal) before getting our onward transport back to Singapore.The western dishes were all very well done but I found the Asian pan seared mullet the weakest dish and would recommend looking outside the comforts of a big hotel for a more authentic local experience. Otherwise there were interesting twists on established dishes, such as the best chicken burger I have had for a very long time. Freshly baked bread was very light and tasty (actually baked goods are a strong point in all the venues at Le Meridien in KL)Be warned the desserts are huge, ours defeated us at the end of a large meal. My Eton Mess could have comfortably been shared two or three ways.

Author: Pioneer46185375892Malaysia
Title: Favorite vegan cafe
Review: Been there 3 times and never disappointed. The food is all delicious with own characters - esp the mac & cheese and crispy roti canai. The house baked vegan choc cake is an additional sweet treat. It’s always very packed and busy so best to reserve the table online in advance. Try to go for very early lunch to avoid the crowd.

Author: CynfulwordsKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good Food, Wide Choice of Alcohol
Review: Very nice eatery/pub with a good selection of alcohol, including imported beer on draft, single malt whiskeys and other hard liquor. The food is very very good. The chef was from a previous (very respectable) Western restaurant in town. I had the grilled fish, grilled squid and prawns with angel hair pasta and the local fried bee hoon; all of which were superbly prepared. Tip: Ask for what fish they have and ask the chef (Alex) for recommendations. At the point of writing, they do not serve lunch yet, but plan to. They also have a 2nd floor, yet to be opened.

Author: Silvita_jib
Title: Amazing Staff
Review:
So happy I wentp there. The staff was amazing. Paddy, Rajib and Mamun treated me like a queen! They were super helpful and kind. 
The service was amazing and the guinesses too :) 
Looking forward to go there again! Cheers guys!

Author: Wyntn
Title: Would definitely go again!!! And again!!!
Review: Service was alright, not wonderful though. Noticed that the staff pays special attention to foreigners compared to locals. That's a set back. Atmostphere outside was cozy. Food is very good! Desserts were the best!

Author: DucatiMartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good, but ...
Review: Place is very nice and the menu is great and mostly with a Thai influence. Mango Duck was a very nice dish and highly recommended. Portions are large so be careful not to order too much.One of my favourite dishes and one that the restaurant claims to be one of their specialities was a big disappointment though. Pandan Chicken. It was so over cooked that the Pandan leaves could not be unwrapped, they just crumbled into a mass of charred pieces on your plate and the chicken was stuck to them, making it very hard to eat. Also the chicken had bone and gristle in it - very poor for a recommended dish.

Author: RashidAlsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is good but service was poor
Review: The food was good but dishes came out too slowly.As it is the fasting month, we pre-ordered our food much earlier in the day but food only arrived 40 mins to 1 hr after we arrived. We only got our food 30 minutes after it was time to break fast. After 1 hr, there were still dishes that have not arrived. Very very poor service. Ruined our dinner. Buck up Majapahit!

Author: 294ciaradDublin, Ireland
Title: Not great
Review: Visited Nov 2013.Our overall experience is this restaurant was fairly average. After spending a day out and about we were late going for dinner so it was 9pm when we arrived. The restaurant is located just outside the mall entrance and we were staying in Traders hotel so we chose it more for location than anything else. We were the only diners there when we arrived and felt very much like we inconveniencing the staff. I ordered fish for my main which was ok but the lemon sauce that came poured all over it was aweful. My boyfriend had the lamb though and he really enjoyed it. If you do decide to go for dinner here maybe go earlier in the evening when the shops around it are still open as I'd imagine that's when they are at their busiest.

Author: jessicachong06Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unsual
Review: Walked in yesterday evening at Great Eastern Mall after work around 5.30pm. Ordered a cup of latte and a slice of tiramisu while waiting for my friend to arrive. I was sitting indoor by the glass window closer to the plant outside. There’s a superior wearing black shirt (not sure if it’s the manager or a supervisor) were playing around with a lady staff. Touching and tickling among themselves by the counter which makes me feel disrespectful and unprofessional.(they were both malay). They could be couple but as a superior in the restaurant, it does not look good infront of all the staff and customers. Overall, I love the cakes and services in Alexis but the superior really need to behave while there’s customers in the restaurant.

Author: auntybibHunter Valley
Title: Bizarre menu - no options and guaranteed indigestion!
Review: I am not sure who the menu planner is... but whoever thinks a set menu of pumpkin soup and chocolate pudding with ice cream (no options) can sit well with...sate, or portugese chicken curry has shares in indigestion remedies. Maybe the western options for a main course were a better fit.. I passed on the pumpkin soup ( it was a hot and humid night!!)Regardless of three option of passwords. no joy on the wi fi, and no help from staff pleasant to be sitting near the river but left as soon s possible... and never to return!

Author: munisxc
Title: NICE FOOD
Review: I juz try their nasi lemak,its awesome and very delicious.Environment juz ok but their menu got alot choices choose for.Food taste guaranted juz give a try.I bit pricey!!

Author: Ric333888
Title: Never Ever Visit !!!
Review: Never ever go for this restaurant!!! Was there on the 2nd day of CNY. Reached at 6.30pm and Food Ordered by 7pm. No communication on food delayed during food ordering when restaurant not full. Waited for an hour food still not served. Check with their counter, being informed its coming!! Waited for another 20mins, still being informed in sarcastic manner that the food is coming! By the way, table that came later food served and left. End of the day just walk off. A big No to this restaurant.

Author: SushilMohtaKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: A VEGETARIAN'S DELIGHT
Review: We were staying at Citin Hotel Masjid Jamek and this Restaurant was very near to our hotel opposite Masjid India Police Station which made us try the food here as we are pure vegetarians. The Restaurant is a delight for vegetarians. The variety of North Indian and South Indian food is really great, specially the chat counter (offering a variety of Indian Savouries) which operates from 4 pm to 11pm. The prices are quite reasonable and we paid between RM 30 and 45 for a fulfilling lunch or dinner. Apart from having a disappointing experience at Spice of India (Indian Restaurant at KLCC Suria where we paid RM 100 for a dinner) on the very first day of our five days stay in Kualalumpur, we could not resist ourselves from eating at Sangeetha daily and never though of trying another place as this was very near to our hotel and remained open from early morning till 11 pm.The staff is good but the only problem is that all the waiters have a habit of huddling at the service counter most of the time even without any work and they don't try to look at the customers' table for any further requirement unless they are called for. The steward Mr. Kolanchintan is a nice person who at our request suggested some special dishes which we really enjoyed.A very good restaurant for Indian Travellers particularly those who are vegetarians.

Author: S77w
Title: Average.
Review: Nothing special, restaurant is noisy and has very busy atmosphere. Had to ask for things too many times, cutlery, drinks that never came. Bill of course came promptly, but took too long to be returned with Credit Card. Disappointing.

Author: Richard J
Title: Poor
Review: We were looking forward to dining here but were so disappointed. The ambience is awful as the room is just so stark, far to bright and generally dated. The food was no better than your average chinese but significantly more expensive!

Author: gallgbaronFeodosia Municipality
Title: Very Disappointing
Review: Food wise started well with starters and attentive staff. Main course so disappointing - a spicy fish dish with little spice and obviously dry fish that had not been marinated or hydrated but just thrown in the lot. Ordered a Musselman ( southern Thailand ) beef curry, greasy, (asked for it without potatoes but it arrived with potatoes) the meet old and each piece like rubber that I just gave up. Staff predominantly Indian rather than Thai and a walk in the courtyard at the back showed they and their families living at the side of the restaurant. At the back some private dining areas done as Thai houses ( these are what you see on their website not the drab interior of the main dining room) but not in good repair electrical wiring a hatchet job and weather has taken it s toll and little or no sign of repairs. Definitely not worth the 295MYR ( €70+) we paid had better food at a street stall. The diners mostly Chinese were paying top dollar but obviously the owner is milking the place and not investing anything back into it Sad , disappointing as we were told it was an excellent Thai restaurant. Will not be going back. Term daylight robbery comes to mind.

Author: Rikhard M
Title: Simply amazing
Review: I visited this place with my family as I had heard it’s a good place. I was not dissapointed as the lamb was the best lamb I have ever had. It was so juicy and tender. The delicious food was accompanied by excellent service and atmosphere. I highly recommend ordering off the menu and asking for lamb skewers, as you won’t be dissapointed!

Author: Pekka MJoensuu, Finland
Title: Good food - great service.
Review: Nice restaurant where dishes are meant to be shared. We ordered two small plates, one medium plate and one dessert to share for two. Food was very good but not mind blowing except cuacamole which was out of this world. Cheesecake was also excellent. What makes this restaurant so good is service. Bob the waiter was welcomming and had time to tell about each of their dishes and recommended few options for us. Cocktails are also very tasty and good-looking. Bob also tried to order a ride for us back to our hotel although ride never came but we appreciated the effort.

Author: silviacsb
Title: Crappy and expensive
Review: Despite Google's and TripAdvisor's good reviews, we found the food bland. The curry lacked flavour and the spices tasted raw. The satay was dry and too sweet. It was expensive for the quality.

Author: CynthiaLobAmstelveen, The Netherlands
Title: food poisoning and no service
Review: We went last week Thursday to have lunch there and my husband ordered a burger and I peperoni pizza before 12 o'clock. My husbands burger came after half an hour and I kept waiting for my pizza and after more than an hour I thought it was crazy . Then I saw a women going away with 2 pizza boxes and she was not there when I ordered and got so crossed when they had the courage to tell me to wait 10 more min since it was in the oven. More than an hour to bake a thin pizza. I told them to cancel and I don't want it anymore and they had the guts to tell me to take away the pizza what I refused and we left. Next day my husband had a bad foodpoisoning from the burger and was really sick. We will don't recomment this place since its slow and you never get your food. Remembered also that last year when I went with a friend to have lunch she found a hair in the burgers sauce too.

Author: LooiJoliatDoha, Qatar
Title: Almost Cheated by Waiter
Review: The waiter tried to short change us. The bill was RM41.55 and we paid with RM100 note. The waiter returned with a change with the bill. To our surprise when we opened the restaurant receipt folder, there were only RM8.45. The waiter were just one meter away from our table wanting to leave. When we waved our hand to call him back, he immediately too a RM50 note from his pocket and returned back to us. It was weird and it was clear he was trying to keep the RM50 if we weren't paying attention. I confronted the waiter. He claimed that he was doing other stuff and forgot to put the change in the folder. He apologized. Still I didn't believe him. How can he forget the RM50 but remembered to return RM8.45 change?So, just be aware when you settle the bill.

Author: ZoakiesMalaysia
Title: Nice home-made food
Review: Going there after reading some review in TripAdvisor.... Didnt hold up high expectation in such a highly recommended nyonya restaurant in Melaka coz i been to few but its just over-rated in my honest opinion.This is something different!!The taste of their Nyonya food is kindda homely made type... Not too commercial and their taste suit to my taste bud.Love their fried chicken wings and Pai-Tee... The taste is just awesome... the brinjal taste good too but too bad the fish sambal is not too into my style. If you into dessert, the Nyonya cendul is a must try... They put in sago into their cendul is something different.. Well, after i have tried few nyonya restaurant in Melaka, i would recommend give this Amy Heritage Nyonya Cuisine Restaurant a try. It's not hard to find...it's located in Melaka Raya, right opposite road of the Allianz Insurance office... Tables are limited, so making a reservation is preferably. Parking shouldn't be a problem as right outside the restaurant got plentiful of it. Be there early...as their last call is 9pm...

Author: 912pawe_z
Title: Just average
Review: Really average experience. Similar dish has polish and serbian culture and they are way better. The idea is well know and they were prepared and served well. The staff was helpfull. But the taste was poor, i think only with shrimps were just like ok... Worth maybe half a price. Or less. Will not come back. Too much hype maybe those in pavillon are better
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Suria KLCC (NO PORK)

Author: Marama SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great atmosphere great service and delicious Sarawak food
Review: Definitely worth a dinner. Midin salad a must. Fried basil leaves. Crispy sotong and best fresh garoupa done in soy, ginger and spring onions. And Cloudy Bay savignon blanc available to accompany it all. Our waitress was so helpful and recommended half portions would be more than enough. Super relaxing atmosphere as well.

Author: NIR006
Title: Hopeless food
Review: The food is hopeless, tasteless...they are supposed to be an authentic South Indian restaurant, but even their chatni and smabhar (the bare essentials withany South Indian snack) are tasteless...not even worth a try...skip it...

Author: stefaniecstPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best Fei fan outlet of all
Review: After visiting 5 outlets of Fei fan hotpot, no doubt this is still my top 1 outlet to visit. Soup are tasty here compared to other outlet plus service here are prompt and friendly unlike other outletMost visit here for hotpot lover and price are reasonable and good selection of fresh food with yummy dumplings and homemade balls Keep up the good job Fei Fan 163

Author: camuche123Brussels, Belgium
Title: Not my thing
Review: We have booked a table of 3 and it was set up along the bar counter near the sink and entrance. We asked to change and not possible. No common sense for guest experience. Outside seating is ok but u need to be patient for service as staff forget tables outside. Food is ok but portion far too small for price paid. Beef at RM78 was tasteless

Author: blokototerminous
Title: Food is OK, while the new rooms upstairs are very good
Review: A Malaysian businesswoman in Miri recommended this inn to me, and it turned out to be good advice. The rooms on the two floors above the restaurant are new and nicely furnished and priced right. They have all the amenities I look for -- wi fi, TV, air con, hot shower, and cleanliness. Good location a block from the riverfront in one direction and a few blocks from the Top Spot seafood center in the other direction. The staff are friendly and well-trained. I would gladly stay there again.The noodle dishes in the restaurant are good value, and the restaurant is lively most nights with both Malaysians and tourists -- a good sign.

Author: FelixKaLeungHong Kong, China
Title: More than a casual restaurant
Review: I was staying in le meridien for three nights which I have all my dinner here.The price is fair n there is a live brand which give a perfect atmosphere for meeting with friends, dating or a after work drink.The menus is western with some Gd steaks. You can have a relaxing till midnight if you wanted!

Author: KS-LIM5555Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb fresh and delicious sausage in KL
Review: I ordered a home delivery from KL Sausage and the saugsages were fresh and delicious. The sausages were made upon your order, therefore they are all freshly made. The payment gateway is convenient to the customers where there are options of Grabpay / cash on collection / duitnow.

Author: RaeshylKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Dinner!
Review: It was truly a lovely dining experience :) My boyfriend brought me here in conjunction to my birthday celebration in December 2014. The service was so good and staffs were very friendly and helpful! We enjoyed our food like a king :) Will definitely be back!

Author: Hongmei26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Overrated...
Review: We went with a family of 13 on our first day of arrival at Langkawi as a results of great reviews. The place was packed and we have to queue for at least 30-45 mins for the table.The food is just so-so. We had many better food in our next few days in Kuah. Quite disappointed with the food.

Author: kaleon
Title: Very disappointing visit
Review: Came here as it is always busy and were extremly disappointed by food, drinks and also service. I can not understand why this place is so popular. Everything was below average and overprized.

Author: OY_890
Title: Very bad.
Review: Had very high expectations of this place. View is fantastic. Absolutely stunning. But the food is awful. No proper theme, no proper arrangement, all food tastes bland. It was a very sad experience all in all.

Author: etwy
Title: Heaven for Pork Lovers
Review:
If you like pork, this is the place. Spanish Iberico pork all the way.  Nice food. Big portion. Good ambience. and service.
Do make reservation before going, especially on Friday and Saturday night.

Author: Ayla_KosmonovaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Unforgettable meals
Review: Saved the best for our last night at the Andaman. Truly unforgettable taste & experience. We were hard to choose either ala carte or the fresh catch of the day...the waiter was helpful in describing each of the menu on board & provide suggestions. We ordered grilled white pomfret, accompanied with rice, kailan & water spinach. The way they cook the water spinach was soo unique & memorable, what kind of belacan they use? the green chilli dip was nice, tangy & spicy. Everything we had was so nice & we raved about it whenever we dined out in a comparable posh restaurant...there's nothing like Jala, period!

Author: foodloverseden
Title: topspot ling loong
Review:
not recommended to visit or revisit
butter prawn ok
3 rasa grouper very bad, taste tomato sauce only
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: adriaantl
Title: Scam
Review: My first and last visit to this place.Staff mostly pushy and not friendly.We informed about dishes and just got it without ordering it.We ordered later 3 dishes. All small, but got big fish without consulting us.I complained with manager: only apologizing about everything and offering no solution.Staff was laughing. Total unprofessional attitude.Manager tried to buy me with free dinner after my friends revealed my professional background (Hotel & Restaurant Management, Tour Operator, Diplom Hygiene in Food Industry and HACPP).Toilets not cleaned properly since opening. Urine acid into toilets. Excuse of manager: we have a function tonite.Unprofessional attitude of staff and management.Unhygienic toilets. Wonder about the rest.No place in the last months dissapointed me that much. Not worth anymore visits.Adriaan

Author: chengkeonglSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice view, lousy seafood buffet
Review: Went on a Saturday night when the only dining option was a seafood buffet. The view is nice as the restaurant is on the rooftop facing Johor Straits and next to an infinity pool.The food is nothing fantastic. More importantly, it's not fresh and some of the food that is grilled on the spot is not even cooked properly. Not worth the effort and I definitely will not go ahead.

Author: sourodweepmSharjah, United Arab Emirates
Title: Good Authentic Chinese Food
Review: Hi , Wnet to this place for our office dinner buffet party. The Restaurant painstakingly took care of all our culinary needs . The most stand out was the Foie Gras which was served on the crisp bread. The meat just melted in my mouth .

Author: eboman77Tiel, The Netherlands
Title: Hard Rock same as others, but bad service
Review: Although an empty restaurant, after the order not much attention from staff, pretty expensive even with happy hour, which they try to sell as much as possible. Wanted 2 beers, staff brings 4 beers.

Author: teep0h
Title: Chicken Ball rice
Review: Came to Ho Kee after seeing crazy queue outside Chung Wah just across the street.It's was just 10am in the morning. We were quickly seated at Ho Kee which didn't have a queue yet but I did notice the railings near doorway which indicates the place will have queue as well.Ordered the chicken ball rice and the lady offered package with cabbage, Assam fish etc which I turned down. Was there to eat chicken ball rice. Drinks were usual herbal tea, soft drinks and Chinese tea. No coffee etc or even barley.Strange thing was that when I wanted to order more chicken balls they're said it wasn't possible due to limited balls and could only order the standard rice....slightly disappointed with that since it's supposed to be a chicken ball rice shop.Anyway the chicken was quite good and rice was decent.....I think the many reviews here are exaggerating that it's terribly bad but that's their opinion. I'd say it's a decent eatery and saves you the hassle of queuing at the Chung Wah but the fact they can't serve more balls is definitely silly on their part.

Author: live_until_you_dieLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place, shame about the food
Review: From the outside, this restaurant looks empty and unwelcoming, but don’t be taken in by first impressions. Once through the doorway and past the front reception, you cross a charming little stream on stepping stones, and find a busy environment full of young locals enjoying themselves.We were lucky to find a table as it was very busy, but once seated, quickly shown the menu and offered drinks.We asked advice on the menu, and settled for crispy noodles with prawns and crispy noodles with vegetables. For a starter we had seaweed with chicken “floss”. Overall, we weren't terribly excited about the food, the vegetarian noodle dish was slimy and uninspiring, We were however pleasantly surprised about the bill. The noodles were 10 MR each. The service was quick and very helpful. Overall feeling was that we made a bad choice of food, and would love to give it another go. I hope you found this review helpful happy to answer questions.

Author: Grace EKL
Title: Customise Your Roll
Review: Visited this place during lunch. One of the few out of over 100s outlet in Publika that is rather busy during lunch. We did not order the usual roll since we prefer warm food. Ordered Salmon & rice set and tofu salad. Fish is totally fresh, service was prompt and tofu was crunch, well dressed ( gladly not drenched) give it a try! overall we have had good experience here.

Author: junchuent
Title: My family and I have been
Review: My family and I have been here since it first opened, I must say the quality had dropped especially on large ticket items. The seabass was poor and the condiments of sliced zuchini and roast potatoes were a bad joke. For RM55, I felt conned. The meatballs for the pasta was terrible as well, with large portions of the meatball coming from too much random fillings which I think might have been breadcrumbs and lamb mince. I remember when it used to be real beef mince. Alas it feels like such a long time ago. Positano has lost its substance and a loyal customer in my family and I.

Author: Afflick67
Title: Expensive and a rat!
Review: We had one Havana club rum and coke each and the bill came to RM60!  On top of that there was a large rat that scuttled by our feet which made up our minds to drink up and leave very quickly.  Not good!

Author: annaFIN112233Tampere, Finland
Title: Not Thai food
Review: Quite big disappointment. Read the reviews and were expecting actual Thai food. Starters crabcakes must of been out of freezer since it took like 5 minutes from the order to get in the table and it tasted like chicken nuggets.. Main course, chicken and cashew nuts, did not taste like anything, not spicy or nothing and vegetables were too raw. In the beginning when we asked for water for the drink with out beers the waitress first forgot then and then when I asked again he brought us tap water in a glass. We had to ask if it was tap water and he said yes and asked then if we wanted bottled water. Overall big disappointment since we were expecting a good Thai food (we been to Thailand and this was not near close to their foor). The most expensive bill in Kuala Lumpur so far and the biggest disappointment. Been here already for 7 days.

Author: Khalid J
Title: Chicken was undercooked and Naan was burnt
Review: I went for dinner with my wife after reading the reviews here. We ordered chicken qorma and garlic naan. The chicken was still pink when served and undercooked and raw. We could not eat it. Stomach started swirling inside. Garlic naan was burnt. We decided to go eat somewhere else. We reported this to the waitress and the manager. The waitress took some pieces of chicken to show the chef. The manager told us that maybe some of the pieces we ate were not well cooked. I asked how much we have to pay. He replied the bill totals RM 59 but he will give us a discount because of the food. He charged us RM 56 for undercooked chicken and burnt naan. Totally spoiled our evening. No wonder we were the only customers there. No more spice garden for us.

Author: pohmun1129
Title: TERRIBLE FOODS
Review: We had our birthday dinner and the foods make me truly disappointed. We ordered a mushroom soup and the soup is cold and tasted really bad. Otherwise, the others foods did not taste good but quite expensive. We are really disappointed.

Author: petesJ9598HY
Title: Show Us Ya Single Malt
Review: Ariff was the man. 10/10 service and even a cheeky free sample for the boys. This place is heaven. Whisky. Cigars. TVs everywhere playing sport. Absolutely living.

Author: Juunass
Title: Overpriced and tasteless
Review:
Ordered Spaghetti napolitana and salad. In spaghetti you couldn't taste anything else than parmesan cheese. Salad was oily and tasteless. 
BUT staff was friendly and garlic bread was ok.

Author: Bernd EParkhurst, South Africa
Title: Dinner next the "Twins"
Review: Level 57!! of course an excellent view over the roofs of KL and the Petronas Towers next.Professional, warm welcome, express lift up to 57. Cozy seatings with a different variation of view, either to the towers or KL city. Nice bar in front of the restaurant for aperitif or snacks. Good menu with different food style, western, asian and indian. Excellent quality but you have to pay for the view as well what is visible in the price.

Author: Sangaran
Title: Anniversary
Review: Very nice foods and all the staff is friendly. Really had a great time with husband to celebrate anniversary
Restaurant: The Grand Getaway by Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur

Author: 629azmij
Title: The best sambal nasi lemak in KL
Review:
Now available at RASTA TTDI..Nasi Lemak with special steam technique
-fresh seafood
-basmathi rice
-craving sambal
-cozy place

Author: Bartje1965Etten-Leur, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious ribs in a basic setting.
Review: Great basic restaurant. Do not a expect fancy entourage. Long tables with stools. The BBq ribs are delicious. Nasi goreng could have been a bit more spicy. Krupuk was not very crispy, but it was a damp evening. Would like to go here again.

Author: sexybuttmanila
Title: I love this restauant!
Review: My mom and I had lunch in this restaurant with some of our friends after spending time shopping. We wanted to rest our tired feet and indulge our growling stomachs.We ordered some buttered shrimps, baked crab (not sure what it is called) and orange chicken...and some rice. We were amazed by the size of serving. Enormous. Awesome. Everything was delicious. Needless to say we had a great time. We will definitely come back.

Author: Lizkeith68Southend-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food, friendly staff and prices excellent.
Review: Have been for dinner the last two nights, it is set menu at weekends but great value for money, they serve beers but not wine, as me and my husband are used to having wine with our evening meal we asked if we could boy wine, it wasn't a problem, they even provided glasses and ice, for my white wine.Alvin at front of house is very efficient and friendly.They are situated on the riverbank, so very busy river traffic with tour boats, good location.My one criticism, which stopped me from giving 5 stars was no toilet paper or hand wipes in the toilets, both nights.We are here for a few days still so will definitely visit again to try their a large carte menu.

Author: kanabagaiTemerloh, Malaysia
Title: Nice place
Review: Super delicious, fresh sushi and japanese food for actually very good prices. So so tasty and cheap! It’s a quick place so the staff are very chop chop and keen to serve you and get you out... so good for sit down meal but not for long catch up session etc... overall one of the amazing places in Pavilion to eat

Author: YLMcMullingar, Ireland
Title: The worst food ever tasted in Malaysia at extortionate price
Review: Got take-away at lunch time, restaurant was packed and still long queues for table, presumed it should be good. Couldn't be more wrong. Service was efficient for the huge crowd. This is about the only positive thing I can say about this restaurant.Take-away menu was very limited, so ordered a pack of 6 pork and prawn dim sum and a bowl of dry wonton noodles. Both came up to MR 39.30, which I thought was extortionate. Waited ages for the food, too but again thought should be a good sign.To my disgust and annoyance, the serving of noodle was tiny, hardly adequate for a child. Not much taste either. The dim sum was even worse, the filling completely tasteless and the wrapping thick and hard. This is without doubt the worse chinese food I've ever had in Malaysia. And at this price, I'm really amazed there's anybody eating there at all especially with the huge selection of eatery at the mall. Avoid at all cost.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: cittabellaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Iketeru used to be one of my favourite Japanese restaurants in KL. It's located on the 8th floor at Hilton Hotel. My friend and I decided to dine at the restaurant on Saturday evening. We ordered edamame, assorted seafood sashimi, beef tenderloin teppanyaki, tofu steak, garlic fried rice, 3 types of vegetable teppanyaki, i.e. enoki mushroom, bean sprout & spinach, and matcha ice cream with azuki red bean.The sashimi was very fresh and tenderloin teppanyaki tasty. The vegetable teppanyaki was mediocre and the matcha ice cream was way too milky. The service was attentive. However, the quality of food has been compromised. It used to be much better in the past.

Author: Kalaivanan P
Title: Not bad..
Review: If you have no alternative to go and eat if you happen to be in Jalan Nagasari, then you can go here. Not really the best but ok..

Author: Miserableoldman
Title: Rip-off Nobu
Review: This restraurnt clearly relies on its name because it cannot expect return business based on what is delivered to the table.Everywhere else in the World when you order sashimi you can expect to get at least 3 pieces per portion. Not Nobu. You get one small piece.I ordered 2 portions of salmon 2 portions of scallops and 1 portion of eel. Plate arrives with 5 items on it. Cost over 100Myr.If it had been out of this World then maybe but it was not, in fact, worse than any other sashimi i have had in KL.PLEASE DO NOT PANDER TO THEIR SUPERIOR ATTITUDE.Don't go it is the only way they will understand they are screwing the public.

Author: bnghanemKuwait City, Kuwait
Title: Nice place to light lunch
Review: during travels i used to have lunch and dinner in one mealthere last time i ordered Bamiya Curry with rice only with soft drinki like there food also no thing distribute my meal the place nice , the food good and cleanalmost it is good and does differ from the others in ( Arab st)

Author: KLOysterManMalaysia
Title: Great atmosphere with authentic food
Review: Hakka is a must visit in KL. A huge bustling restaurant with good service, ideal for taking big groups of people from 10-20. Very nice dishes, though the menu is a little more complicated now, and plenty of Carlseberg beer girls on the prowl to fill up your glasses. BYO wine is available, and would suggest it as the wine list is shallow and drastically over priced.The homemade Hakka noodles, sweet potato leaves, sichzuan prawns, vinegar ribs are all winners.

Author: nomadsk
Title: Heavenly!!!
Review: Scumptous delicious n satisfying meal as always at this vegetarian restaurant..Service is volunteered and always with a smile...Food wastage is discouraged..We are in love with this restaurant n it's a must visit on every visit to Kuala Lumpur...

Author: mansooreeKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Not for the vegetarians
Review: Made it a point to visit this place as it was very highly rated on TripAdvisor. Thankfully there was no queue to be seated as I arrived well after the lunch hour. Servers are helpful, but don't have great english. Due to dietary restrictions, I could not order anything containing pork. When I explained this to my server, she told me that there were a grand total of four items on the menu that I could eat. That restriction was a pity as the two items I ordered were both very good. i am sure people without similar dietary constraints will find it a much more appealing option.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: Tpg88
Title: Dinner
Review: Unfortunately food not authentic for Penang. Overrated and overpriced. Definitely nowhere near what Penang nyonya food should be like.

Author: XUANLINSingapore, Singapore
Title: Getting the prices right
Review: We stopped by for tea time. Do take note that if you choose a cake and twg tea pot for afternoon tea set, there is no savings at all. Unless you choose the scones then there will be some savings.What spoilt our experience was that their staff recommended to try their red velvet cake which is baked by their chefs whole the ny cheesecake is bought from external sources. She mentioned that both are of the same price (rm14) but when the bill came it was rm18. I believe its only basic for your staff knowing their stuff clear enough. No refill for tea as stated in menu. As for the limited time only red velvet cake, will be good if they had more layers of cream cheese ibstead of just one. Pretty dry to be honest. NY cheese cake was amazing but might be overwhelming if you cant take strong cheese taste.

Author: FlightproAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Go for Beer not for food!
Review: Perfect place to sit with great view of the white beach and stunning sunset.However, the Quality of our food was just terrible. If you like deep frozen pizza’s then this is your place to be. If not, then just stick with the Carlsberg beer from the draft. For RM 6 per 1/2 pint it’s a good deal.

Author: juihong
Title: Service can be slow here
Review:
This outlet can be a tad slower compared to their other chains. Getting to your seat can be a wait, and the service can be slow. Food is as per their usual quality.

I like the tomato soup.

Author: Ian_CHEONG
Title: Western fast food for High Income Society
Review: Because the yuppies are lazy to make their own sandwich, they will fork out 3x the price of 3 large loaves of bread in return for a few slices of cold cuts and western vegetables wrapped in a couple slices of franchised breads.

Author: GazzaGlenIris_VicWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Good but a little expensive
Review: Recently seven of us visited Chez Papa restaurant for a relaxing evening. Overall the night was good however in my opinion the food and drinks were a little over priced. The total bill came to RM1,000, which when compared to other quality Asian restaurants, this, in my opinion, was a tad too expensive for what you got and to warrant a second visit.The décor presented a very casual ‘cafe’ style look rather than a luxury up-market look. While the food and wine were expensive, it was still quite nice though as it did provide a relaxed atmosphere to eat and socialise with friends.The staff were very friendly, although it did take an extraordinarily long period of time to serve up our main meals. When the mains finally arrived they were very nice, albeit my steak was a little under-cooked. I ordered my steak medium-rare, however it came out rare. I could have sent it back, but thought I may end up eating alone when the others had finished their meals. In fairness to the restaurant, they did offer a liquor and coffee as compensation for the long delay in serving the meals.Overall it was a pleasant night, reasonably good food, but a tad expensive for the style of restaurant when compared to other up-market restaurants in the JB area.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: FoodFun775George Town, Malaysia
Title: All Hype and for Tourists only
Review: I had lunch at Kota recently and it was an experience that would never be repeated. First of all, you have to go through Fort Cornwallis where the entry charge is RM10 per person for locals, foreigners pay more. The charges can be off set against the food bill. First of all, only 1 table was occupied by a family of foreigners. Service was prompt as the restaurant was almost empty but it was without a smile and when asked for more information regrading the food, the server was not sure. The menu was also very limited. We knew it was fusion food so it will be somewhat different but the food was more of a confusion. The Cendol, which came blended in a bottle tasted kilometres away from its name sake, and the coconut milk/santan used came from either a can or packet, with a few hard pieces of red beans and it was thick and gritty. We couldn't finish it even though it cost RM16. It had an unpleasant taste with a strong hint of rancidity.The Hokkien Mee, RM 25, was actually Italian pasta with a stingy serving of gravy that was not enough to mix the "noodles" in. It had a couple of prawns which was fresh but that was its only saving grace. It tasted faintly like hokkien mee, just only a hint of it. The laksa was an interesting dish with a small bowl of normal laksa sauce (but with no ingredients) served at the side and a few pieces of cucumber, lettuce leaves, onion slices, a tiny amount of prawn paste and 2 small rolls of what looked like sticky rice "noodles," more like rolled pancakes on a bigger plate. I wouldn't eat that again. The Poh Piah Acar Awak, RM 15, was overwhelmingly sour and spicy and you can stand to eat only a couple of rolls. No water was served but you can buy some from their exorbitantly priced mineral water. The total bill came to RM89.10 but was deducted RM20 (the entry price). The ambience was sterile and it was like eating in a canteen. Prices must match quality, fusion must be clever and creative but sadly these two factors are not present at all. Not recommended for locals, it's food for tourists.

Author: nork210Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: foodPon
Review: viral food and i try it. the mark i can give only so-so. price quit expensive. i love to try nasi ayam and if i compare nasi ayam all the malaysia. i love nasi ayam at teluk intan. just small gerai but server the best nasi ayam.

Author: edang_80Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful service and ambience. Food hit and miss.
Review: I doubt they are truly no.1 in Tripadvisor due to the deliciousness of the food, probably more for the excellent service and the ambience. Sitting comfortably welcomed in this restaurant you will forget for a while that you are dining in a shop that is in the city streets of Johor Bahru, Malaysia. The chocolate mousse and the baked potatoes with raclette cheese were really nice, whilst the other items that we tried were somewhat average. Nevertheless we will surely be back again to try the other items on the menu that people are raving about.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: Kaylene D
Title: Christmas eve dinner and Christmas day lunch buffett
Review: Had Christmas eve dinner and Christmas day lunch buffet in the restaurant and food glorious food in all areas ... desert bar was wonderful. Bonus was the Carol singers .. performed a melody of Christmas carols.

Author: SyazanaK
Title: Authentic!
Review: I just went to Kuching in September so I dare say that the Sarawak Laksa here tastes exactly like the authentic ones I had in Kuching!

Author: Nicholas GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unmatching in Reputation - Price - Service
Review: Was looking forward to a good meal backed up by good service. Left greatly disappointed. Do not mind paying for a good meal and service.Waiter taking our order was clearly displaying his irritation and impatience when asked questions about the menu. His communication was not very pleasant too - reminded me of a street stall hawker food, which sometimes is better.Then when searching the bathroom, asked a passing by waitress who, without acknowledging or looking at us just pointed in a direction with her finger. Rude!Food wise, with the exception of 1-2 dishes, the rest was a big letdown. We felt so letdown that we even asked if food was prepared by a qualified chef or trained kitchen crew.

Author: JarodYJKSarawak
Title: Not As Good As It Was
Review: When I first had Nirwana Banana Leaf Rice 5 years ago, it was heavenly. The bitter gourd fritters were a delicacy that got me & my friends coming back for me.After coming back from our studies, the food was different. It was not as fresh & the price has increased. However, the demand was still there if not greater. It's now very hard to get a seat at the shop.Today, the shop is as popular as ever & the price is higher but the quality of the food has dropped significantly. I will not be coming back because I have found other restaurants which serve better banana leaf rice at a lower price with little or no queue.

Author: MinhajMJKitchener, Canada
Title: Lebanese Cuisine Lover
Review: I am a Lebanese Cuisine Lover and Al Amar Express in Fahrenheit 88 Mall didn't disappoint me a bit. There is another branch in pavilion mall near by.We sit inside which is fully air conditioned and family area as well. But you have to bear the smell of sheesha/hookah. We ordered Seesh towk, half chicken, shawarma beef and chicken, arabic rice, and many other dishes i forgot the names of them. All of them were above the mark. This food makes my love for Lebanese cuisine more. For sheesha lovers, this place is too good. you can sit indoor or outdoor upto you.After meal, the best thing of this place is Ice Cream and the way they served you, too good.

Author: WonglcMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Delicious home cook style Nyonya foods
Review: Have lunch with family & friends, ordered 8 dishes, all very delicious.Location is just 5 to 10 min drive from town centre.Parking spaces available at front & side open parking space.

Author: johnwD7902QWBurwood, Australia
Title: Changed for the worse
Review: This has always been a favourite restaurant for when we are in Kuching. Unfortunately, when we went a few nights ago we found it was no longer focussing of Kelabit food. It appears to have changed owners and now focusses on Iban cuisine.Changing cuisines is no great problem. So we stayed to eat. And it was disappointing. The balance of flavours was off in many dishes, and the Umai was almost inedible. Sadly, I don't see this restaurant lasting if they can not improve their food.An old favourite, sadly a favourite no longer.

Author: Arnon PPhuket, Phuket, Thailand
Title: Averagely taste and feel not really welcome
Review: I read a review of where should we have our Dim Sum in Malacca and decided to go there. We had tried somewhere else much better & fresher. When we first entered, the ladies owner asked us in chinese but we don't understand so she speak in English asking "you speak Chinese or not?" I said no" Then she started talked Chinese to her friend the next table which sound like gossiping and say something about us and laugh. Which I found very rude and not friendly to tourist. Putting that matter aside, the food really not up to standard & lack of taste.

Author: Gracephung13
Title: Dinner
Review: Taste and service, everything on point. Staff are polite, friendly and attentive. Safura, assigned person to attend to us, was very friendly and nice. Price wise is good for value and fair. Sashimi is fresh and delicious

Author: YoshiYashKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointed customer
Review: This restaurant offers quite a variety of indian cuisine. But some of them are not really authentic. Some of their dishes are just a mix of malaysian recipe. Which didnt really turn out well. We tried garlic cheese chicken and the taste was not good. My expectation was indianized style of cooking but it was a total opposite. All my fav south indian dishes were not available. We went there 8.30pm on a monday night and the waiter told us to wait 10min and went missing. We decided to take the staircase and go to another restaurant just to find out their staffs were also there. The guy who told us to wait 10min couldnt recognize us. Nevermind on that. But the food was not as promising as the restaurant crowd. I think we could find better indian food in KL with that price tag. And not to forget, the washroom was not clean. So, those who are into expensive food but doesnt mind on how the food taste can try here at least once....good luck.

Author: MartinJMichaelSurfside Beach, South Carolina
Title: Very Disappointed
Review: As an American that has eaten at American Outback restaurants many times, this was a big disappointment. We arrived mid afternoon and it was a bit late for lunch specials and roo early for dinner specials; however, upon speaking with rhe manager, he offered a 10% discount, although it was still over priced for Kuala Lumpur. I ordered the sirloin steak tips and my partner ordered fish. My steak was tough and full of gristle and my partner's fish was not anything special. It was only our second day in Kuala Lumpur and I was a bit shy about complaining, but I regret that I didn't. Needless to say, we walked out hungry and disappointed. Will not return although we will be in Kuala Lumpur for another month. If you plan to eat here, Don't expect the quality of food you get at Outback in USA.

Author: BernieandMandyC
Title: Delicious
Review: So glad we found this hidden treasure ! Delicious food and wonderful service- not expensive and well worth a visit - thanks Liane 👍

Author: Joe MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic food and faultless service.
Review: A number of friends had recommended this restaurant to me and so I was compelled to try it for myself. As soon as we arrived Benjamin and the other staff were attentive and helpful. Benjamin went through the menu and helped us decide on our choices and everything we had was delicious. A very memorable meal in a beautiful setting. I would highly recommend.

Author: FrancisN176
Title: Lunchtime Meal
Review: Very disappointed with the service today 24/6/18. We were ushered to our table at about 1.20pm & given the menu. After waiting for more than 10 minutes, no one came to take our order.We just got up & left. Nobody ask us anything. Approached the outlet Manager & complaint about the service.Very disappointed as we have had meals at Madam Kwan’s other location with excellent service.

Author: EnochmingoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Putu Piring in the town
Review: I only ate putu piring in pasar malam before. But once I tried this, no more putu piring can amaze me. They serve the fresh and tasty, not too sweet putu piring made by gula melaka. Eventhough you have to queue up for maybe around 15 mins to buy it but it totally worth.

Author: teejayem
Title: Great Bruschetta
Review:
A wonderful Italian restaurant in the heart of the old district of Georgetown. Are there twice in a week and thoroughly enjoyed the food.
Highly recommend you give it a try.

Author: Daenvgiell
Title: Poor service
Review: Food is nice, especially the nyonya fish. But service is horrible. Ignorant waiters and waitresses. Waiting time is horrendously long.

Author: Kamal4
Title: Waitress took my drink without asking
Review: I asked for the bill but the waitress just took my drink even it’s just a bit left without asking.. not very good service for that..

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food Court within the mall
Review: Japan Street serving food slightly pricy as it is within the mall as rental could be quite expensive. The food taste ok and presentation normal. The service is good and can be crowded during festive and holiday seasons. The only problem is the lift have to wait quite a while as too many shoppers could poised a long waiting time

Author: Mark LSingapore, Singapore
Title: poor service
Review: i must admit we were at the 'makan street' of ipoh, very crowded during dinner time especially weekends. first we had to wait, standing outside the shop for a table, at least 20 mins gone. They do not take orders when you dont have a seating table, next i asked how long will be the wait before we ordered, 'about 30 to 45 mins' was the reply, fair enough, as crowded it was. God it took us almost 1.5 hrs for our hor fan to come.....it killed the appetite.When i 'confronted' why it took so long instead, the reply was 'well, you can cancel your order after 45 mins of waiting, if you cannot wait anymore'do i need to say more? thank you.

Author: Cool_DiscovererKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Dining High Up!
Review: A great venue for some wonderful dining. With wonderful views of the city plus an indoor and outdoor option, this place has managed to bring a whole new perspective to the KL dining scene. Service was amazing, unobtrusive and seamless. Even though the venue was packed to the brim on a busy Saturday night, the service couldn't be faulted. Kudos to Cheong and his crew.Food was exceptionally good....as with the portions. Though a scaled down menu is offered currently, the options are quite balanced. An enhanced and larger menu I was told will be available soon. Chef Daniel and his kitchen brigade have done wonders with their creativity and delectable cuisine.If ever you would want a nice and exciting dining venue to go to, this would be it. Plus point is that you have the Vertigo rooftop bar just a floor above to indulge in as well....

Author: TravellerfromSINSingapore
Title: Enjoyable nonya food
Review: We ordered a variety of dishes and most were quite good especially the sotong nanas (pineapple), chap chye and the ayam (chicken) buah keluak. They were not very generous with the sambal balachan and gave us 3 portions to share amongst 12. As the restaurant does not take reservations, we had to go early to ensure we got a table as we were a big group. We all agreed that it served the best Chendol of the 4 restaurants that we tried, without it being over sweet.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: KcY44Senai, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Nice ambiance by the pool overlooking the harbour, although the sea was in total darkness from my direction, haha. The 'baby chicken' was in big portion. Could only finish half of it and took away the other half. The staff there were attentive. As for the price, understood LAH. hehe

Author: Putri_wong
Title: Damn Expensive
Review:
Pay $600 just for few simple dishes like noodles and rice.... Please becareful....

During cny they simply marked the price. Please see the photo as the receipt prove it...thanks

Author: drkewscIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Dim Sum is ok but Worse Service
Review: Been here many times and each time the service is really bad. There is no waiting system. So many empty tables with so few patrons and yet the service is so slow by the manager and the service staffs. Rude staffs especially the manager. Sad to say their sense of service is appalling to say the least. The manager will show his disgruntled mood to his customers. Service you would expect much better with the 4 star hotel. Truly disappointing. Not worth the wait and the trip. This will be my last trip here.

Author: hweeyingJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Smoke inside the restaurant!!!
Review: We had been here many times for the past 15 years. We are very satisfied with the food, service and atmosphere of this restaurant. The last time we came was last year,intend to have dinner together with my parents. However when we entered the hall, the air conditioning hall very bad smell, it's smoking smell everywhere. Terrible!!! I can't believe they just ignore the customer smoking inside the restaurant. We decided not to have our dinner here. Terrible environment and terrible management system!!!

Author: MellowtraxCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Best restaurant in Pantai Cenang
Review: This is without comparison the best restaurant in Pantai Cenang. The location (the tables are directly on the beach), the service (very friendly) and the food (amazing) makes this restaurant to a must try if you are in the area. The restaurant is a part of Casa Del Mar hotel. We went without booking, and they didn't have any free tables, so we made a booking for the following evening. It's an amazing feeling to sit directly on the beach, enjoying a fantastic cocktail, waiting for your food. And the food is absolutely amazing here. Although it's not cheap, it's affordable and worth the money. The service was fantastic, friendly and very attentive. The only regret I have is that we only had dinner here one time. Definitely recommendable.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Capta1n57Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Something Lacking
Review: Maybe it was a bad night,or what we chose to eat and drink,but this visit bared no resemblance to our previous time here.Cocktails were good,and reasonably priced,but the atmosphere and left us less than happy. We thought the food was bland and also the Ambience. Have the prices gone up? Seemed a lot better value before too

Author: MegahYangSingapore, Singapore
Title: service was quick and good, food was average
