Review: me and my friend were looking for malaysian bak kut teh. we wanted to go to the other store which has better reviews but it was closed, so we tried this one. i find it weird to find spring onion at the top of the soup which probably used more for decoration than actual taste. the soup was too clear for what i would expect, and the amount of garlic is not enough, although i can add it myself later. The spices put in the soup is also not cooked long enough. for a bak kut teh lover like me, this is not a place that i would recommend or would come back again.

Author: Catherine LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sake San Pizza & Lava Cake, worth trying!
Review: I had my birthday dinner with friends not long ago and generally it was good. They have happy hour with cheap cocktail, beer, and wine up to 6pm if I remember correctly. 2 of the dishes which I would particularly recommend are:1) Sake SanA light pizza with thin crispy crust topped with salmon slices, salmon roe, cherry tomatoes, lollo rosso, Japanese mayo, and some wasabi. A surprising and healthy kind of pizza I would say, not those heavy ones! We had an 8 inch pizza which is priced at RM25. 2) Lava CakeSuper moist lava cake I have ever tasted. Piping hot cake with praline sauce and cashew nuts which will melt in your mouth. The cake is topped with Haagen Dazs vanilla ice cream so it's hot and cold at the same time! Heavenly good!

Author: 198jasontGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Good local food !
Review: When you are here, please do order their MALAK CHICKEN (sweet and sour) and get their Michael Jackson drink ! I promise that they will not disappoint you! Although, this place may be quite busy and you might have to wait awhile before getting a seat.

Author: PrincessCK2015
Title: Good place to unwind :)
Review:
Drinks / cocktails was great, I tried long island ice tea and mojito other days.

Food very yummy, we tried chicken and mutton satay, and Nachos with beef.

Music is OK, friendly staff.

Author: KGB777Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible service
Review: Arrived late on a Friday night in Kuching and was wandering around the waterfront trying to find somewhere suitable to eat. This place seemed like it was open and the waitress confirmed that yes, it was open until 11am. Looked through the menu and ordered. Then around 10 minutes later she decides that it isn't open after all! Pretty appalling stuff. Ended up eating at the cafe inside the Hilton Hotel, which was nothing special but at least the service was better.

Author: carolinf846
Title: Delicious dinner with friendly service
Review: BBQ grill restaurant with middle east touch combined with Malaysian food. We had a plate with hummus and baba ganoush and marinated chicken. Afterwards we had a hot brownie with vanilla ice cream, which was very delicious too. The staff was friendly and created an welcoming atmosphere.

Author: Jeep6530Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Nostalgic
Review: Just had to try 28 years after my father brought me there. Did no disappoint as the sizzling rib eye, hainanese chicken chop and prawn salad was very nice or it was just that we were very hungry. Whichever it is we enjoyed our meal very much. Enjoyed the ambience, nothing classy but it just made you feel relaxed.

Author: kons168Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food, good price, but limited seats
Review: We heard about this restaurant for a long time now but we didn't have time to visit this place until last weekend. There are ample parkings around that place, either park along side the road, or park in the open bay opposite the restaurant, which is chargeable.There are limited seats as it is just a small restaurant and reservations is allowed for group. We have to wait like 30 minutes for a seat during peak dining hours. They could have put some chairs outside for waiting people to sit, which will be nice to have.During our visit, they have around 3 staff working and clearly they are a bit overloaded. Once we were seated, we had to ask for menu but still no menu is given, all the waiters are busy with other tables, so we proceed to get the menu ourselves. The menu consist a mix of chinese, nyonya style cookings. I guess we were expecting too much from them but some of their dish are actually not as good as those restaurants outside. I guess this is a more towards 'tourist' resturant. Some of the dish like pineapple curry squid which is real good. The portion is just nice for 2 person. The price is not really that expensive, 3 different dishes with a pot of tea cost around MYR 60 to MYR 70. During peak hours, the environment will be real noisy, need to raise our voice in order to speak to each other.

Author: rosamundwo
Title: Only tiramisu cake taste good
Review: Don't like  Angel Hair Oglio Olio. Environment is great for friends chatting. Food don't really like. Staff is good.

Author: Mark Y
Title: Good steak but bad customer service
Review: On the Saturday 27th April 2019 @ 7pm to 8pm dinner the taste of Steak here is not bad (a stiff price) but the indian waiter trying to remove us off during our payment by cash RM360 for 5 pax saying this table is already reserve by their other customer. (meaning we have only 1 hour on this table to eat otherwise not welcome). Overall - Staff ethics no good towards customer.

Author: erion980Tirana, Albania
Title: Very good crepes
Review: Very good and quality food. The crepes were very big, at least for breakfast. The staff is also very nice and smiley. Is not the cheapest solution, but you pay what you get. Langkawi is very far from France, but the crepes are the same like in Paris.Keep up the good work!

Author: aaronv372
Title: Too bland food
Review: It may be a good vegetarian and healthy food. But too blend. Place is ok. Sitting is normal like cafe/ fast food. But not that fast food. Service is just ok.

Author: sheronlee
Title: Not too bad
Review: The durian puff is quite good. It's fresh and delicious. It's best to eat it immediately upon purchase. If you are in Jonker Street, you have to drop by this shop to buy the puff.

Author: miraclenTorremolinos, Spain
Title: Excellent service but horrible food
Review: The service is attentive and excellent. The food is nothing but horrible. We have tried:Beef brisket - beef is dry and overcookedButter chicken - averageLamb curry - averageCrab broccoli - below average Sweet and sour fish - poor and fishyNaan - worst i hv tasted in my lifeSushi - does the head chef even know what sashimi and sushi should look like?Chocolate cake - acceptableFruits - ok - not good but ok. Overall, as a frequent traveler to many parts of the world each year, I can say this is not a buffet dinner that is acceptable in any 5-star hotel in the world. Wine (at extra 170myr) tastes good. My advice is do not bother.

Author: Phil TNewport, Wales
Title: A very enjoyable lunch
Review: We didn't go to the bird park, but called in for lunch at the Hornbill when we were wandering round the Lakeside Gardens and had a very enjoyable meal. Having just read some of the more negative reviews of the restaurant, I can only express surprise. The staff couldn't have been more helpful and pleasant. They brought us extra plates, without us having to ask, when they realised we were sharing dishes. And the owner called us over to the balcony so we did not miss seeing the hornbill strutting his stuff. We had a couple of curries, one was fine and one was exceptionally nice. The owner also explained to us what the calamansi and sour plum juice was and we both gave it a go, and would thoroughly recommend it as a very refreshing drink. Another reviewer rightly said the restaurant was more expensive than street food. But given that this restaurant is in a very nice building with air conditioning, it is hardly surprising and we found the bill to be incredibly reasonable. Yet another reviewer suggested it is a bit of a tourist trap but, when we there, there was clearly a number of groups of local people. Enough said, we liked the place!

Author: jaxxesplin
Title: Tropical garden hideaway
Review: Excellent foods and ambience. One of the few places you can enjoy pork in Langkawi. I would recommend the ribs. Attentive smiling front of house. Thanks Shaun. Oh and cocktails a must try.

Author: Muzza265
Title: Great after dinner spot
Review: Called in after dinner in KL, great hideway in KL @ the Sharngri La for a drink and a feed, Good atmosphere and great Staff.

Author: sky12qtSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy food!
Review: The place was packed on a Saturday night. Must pre-book. It is about 20 minutes from Ipoh city centre. We ordered dishes recommended in earlier travel reviews and they indeed lived up to mark. The bean curd (dofu) dish was yummy and was presented in a unique way,looking like "bowl with lid" . The steamed fish done Thai style with lots of garnishes and a sweet sour soupy gravy is very appetising. There is the honey chicken and sweet and sour pork chop - all awesome.

Author: ghostriverKlang, Malaysia
Title: Price vs Taste = Totally Unacceptable
Review: I came here with my wife for dinner. We know this restaurant from instagram. Based on the positive comments that we read, then we choose to come here. Be honest, I have high expectation before I come here based on all the comments.We reached here around 8pm. Then we just realized that actually it was located inside food court. Our hope still high. Then we made our order. Appetizer: Bolognese Nanchos (was advise by the waitress..she said this is very special)Myself: I ordered their Best Seller dish, which is 7 spices rib eye combo spicy olioMy wife: She also order Best Seller dish but take sirloin steakDrinks: Drinks are free here but they only provide syrup.Total Price: RM65.70** you have to pay 1stAnd then..Judgement Time. Served time:We were served our main dish first. The Best Sellers were served faster. Only after 10 minutes after that they served our appetizer.Taste of foods:Nanchos: Are you serious sell this to your customers? Have you ever taste it before you served it? Its tasteless and you call it special?? I don't know how it taste if I order appetizer that not special.Best Seller: Really? This is your best seller? With that price, around RM25-RM30 per plate, I expect to be serve something better. The black paper sauce totally dissapointed. The spaghetti..mmmm..what the best word to describe it..hmmm..miserable? Yea..that's my choice.Totally dissapointed..totally unacceptable. Not something that i would recommend to others.

Author: AliciaN374Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best food in KL
Review: This place is as good as the reviews say. Photos are also correct. Sit down and order the double cheese naan, it’s worth the holiday calories and the contemplation of moving to KL for. It’s honestly so delicious. We ordered two curries, naan and a juice which came to under $40 ringgit. It’s too cheap for the excellent quality. My only regret is eating there once. This place is the hidden gem on the city.

Author: Dreampeace
Title: Kaiyum is the best!
Review: Had a pleasant and enjoyable experience at the restaurant. Kaiyum, took care of us really well. He explained the dishes, recommended Anna’s eggplant salad (genius dish, love it so much) and very attentive thruout our time there. Food was gloriously flavored with perfect blend of spices.

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not bad
Review: Located in front of the Pavillion Food Court at LG. We had an early kind of dinner here at 5pm, so it was not crowded. The food here is not bad, but the food arrived very sparsely timed from each other. One member of our group waited quite long for his set. The salmon sashimi was nice and fresh. The Gyu Don was also nice. Food price is not too expensive.

Author: nusabahorSingapore, Singapore
Title: If you want good food, go elsewhere
Review: Dozens of time visiting Melaka but have yet to try their famous Nonya food. Do some research from the internet, and coincidently my GPS bring me to this "famous" Nonya restaurant in Melaka. The ambiance is not too bad, but the food quality is bad. I've had much better food than this. Food were serve in a swift manner, but all the food were very hot , I suspect all are pre cooked and microwaved and served it to customers .  Nothing to shout for and the price is expensive. I will not recommend this restaurant if you were to try genuine Nonya food.

Author: MefuzzySelangor
Title: Experience was exhilarating, food was good, service is decent..
Review: Having no idea what to expect, we certainly underestimated the experience one would have dining in the dark. As the name said, the place was in total darkness and they did a great job to ensure the place remained in total darkness. You are given a locker to place all your shiny stuff (yes, includes your phone, no exceptions!) so it was a rare experience that saw no one fiddling with their phone, oblivious to the surrounding. This is perhaps the most talkative this group have been in all our long years of our dinner sessions!We had a lot of fun guessing the mysterious food served in front of us, however we're slightly disappointed that the meals were slightly cold, perhaps to prevent the 'blind' patrons from burning their tongue or fingers. While the menu was chosen with items that can be served as such, it was an underwhelming meal overall. The one aspect I felt let down was the service experience. Food was served too long between the interval which meant we got agitated and fidgety. Because it was dark, we also did not know how to call for service and could only order our drinks when the waiter came with the next round of food,which mentioned earlier, was too far in between. However, the waiter and hostess was ever friendly and cheerful as well as did a great job in ensuring the atmosphere remained vibrant but not noisy.The after dinner coffee session were great for us to just sit back over a fantastic cup of coffee and reflect on the dinner and experience. Upon such discussion, you would surely realized that this is a very unique experience that should be tried once!

Author: renee6764Singapore, Singapore
Title: quaint
Review: we stayed at the ren i tang and dropped by bistro tang for an afternoon coffee before heading upstairs to our room. we had a lovely latte and honey lemon tea, sat on the comfy cushions at the back of the room and chilled. lovely staff and music played in the background.

Author: Sheena J
Title: Cheated
Review: I choose the set for 6-8 pax that was RM280+. Had to make a reservation in advance and even confirmed on the set via WhatsApp. Based on SOP they informed me they need to divide the tables into 4 eqch and the tables can't be combined. Suggested to me that they would need to divide the chicken dish and prawn dish to two portions. I agreed and re-confjrmed that the portions in halved. No specific reply was received except that yes and the set of RM280 I'd a rough estimate. I was shocked to receive the final bill of RM475.20. I asked the cashier how come there were double charges for chicken and prawn? She informed me they had to give me 2 as the portions would not have been enough. After coming back to the hotel, I realised that all the food items were charged individually and not based on the set as well. I seriously felt cheated. Why do you give a set for 6-8 people then if you know your portions are not adequate? I paid RM54 for 5 pieces of prawn that was meant for 6-8 people in your set? How do you expect a group of 6-8 people to share 5 prawns? I went with 7 adults and 1 child and the food came in small portions. Very disappointing. Never again. I visited the place based on the number 1 recommendation from tripadvisor. How reviews can be deceiving.

Author: bikerjoe15Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced for mediocre food☹️☹️
Review: Other than the nice surroundings...food and drinks were definitely overpriced. The lamb ordered was not as fresh as expected and salad was so small for the price. The view overlooks the berthing area and sight of sea cannot be seen. Quite a dull place during lunch. Don't expect a wow factor. Disappointing.
Restaurant: New Zealand Unlimited Restaurant at Puteri Harbour

Author: SydneyTourist1Double Bay, Australia
Title: Ripped Off! Avoid this tourist haunt
Review: This restaurant is absolutely horrible. The service was very poor and the food mediocre at best. Lebanese hospitality is all about generosity, however at Al Amar the serving sizes are minuscule. We ordered some lebanese sausages that cost around $15 Australian as one of the mains, we got 4 sausages. Each sausage was about half the size of my pinky finger. Overall the restaurant was extremely expensive given the tiny serving sizes. The service was not very good and we found it difficult to get the attention of our waiter. This restaurant was voted best middle eastern food in Kuala Lumpur... I would certainly hate to see the worst! Avoid this restaurant, unless you like being treated like a mug.

Author: 2geraldSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor service and average food
Review: This establishment does not befit the Nobu name. It should not even be called Nobu, because others may not even consider eating at its other restaurants.I called to reserve a table for two for lunch, reservation was taken by a courteous man. When we arrived, we were greeted at the lift before going up to the Sky Lobby. So far so good.Then, we changed lift and headed up to the 56th floor. That was when things started to go downhill. First bad sign, nobody working there has a smile.So we proceeded to order, and the food came. I was quite happy with Nobu Hong Kong and expected at least something similar, alas, the quality of the food is far from Nobu Hong Kong, and average when compared to run of the shopping mall Japanese restaurants at best.My guest was not happy with her beef and complained to a staff that looked as if he was at a funeral. The staff looked at the beef and said "ok" and went to work at the bar. We did not know what to do with her food. Then, we asked a waitress for help and she said "he works at the bar only." She then brought the beef to the kitchen and came out to tell us "the beef is good."Great! At this point my guest said forget it and let her just eat and leave because she was starving. So I started to work on my lunch box which was bland. The miso cod was the only ok food I had.Nobu staff there were indifferent to patrons, they all had that "pissed off" look. Coupled that with the average food, please, save your money and eat elsewhere to avoid the agony.

Author: bnghanem
Title: Expensive with less quality
Review:
Expensive with less quality
the food not like last  year 
service is slow
staff doing  fine
my friend did not like it same as for me

Author: SweeHeng C
Title: Not Food!
Review: I cannot imagine people would call what they serve as food. Taste and presentation are totally fail. The only good thing about this establishment is the environment, 1-star for that.

Author: Sgp_traveller74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good for big groups but always book in advance
Review: Generally the food is above average and the prices are reflective of its quality. Located right in the heart of "downtown", it is well-positioned to attract the hungry who is staying in one of the 5star hotels in the vicinity.Do reserve well in advance as the owner has the habit of turning people away.

Author: aliceawesomeandrewsGöteborg
Title: Nice location but pretty poor food
Review: I ate lunch here, I spotted it from Jonker Street so the location is really good and you can sit and watch people on the street which is nice. The food is pretty poor for the price you pay though, I ordered a vegetable curry with naan but it wasn't much and the naan was not the real deal like in Indian restaurants. So I say, if you go here, don't eat but have a beer or a fresh juice and enjoy the streetlife from a bar chair :)

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good ambiance but poor food.
Review: Went to Malones Irish Pub in the Pavilion, Bukit Bintang, for lunch with two business friends. As with all Irish Pubs the ambiance was good and the service excellent. However, the food was terrible (maybe we caught the chef on an off day !!). I ordered the sausages and mash, not only was the portion small but the sausages had large lumps of, I assume, grisele so hard that it was more like a stone. Another friend had the pork chops that he had to send back as they were under cooked whilst my other friend had the salmon that was seriously over cooked.Bearing in mind this is not a cheap restaurant, actually rather expensive, the experience was very disappointing. Next time I go it will be in the evening for drinks only.

Author: RuffRussBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: lovely night view of KL
Review: We decided to go here for an evening drink instead of a meal. The buffet spread looked quite average didn't WOW me. But lovely view when you sit by the window and just experience the rotating restaurant rotate changing your view of KL every few seconds. There was also a 2pc band performing on the night we were there. Which was a lovely touch.

Author: SueJennings
Title: Good old fashioned service
Review: You are made to feel very welcomed here and staff go to a lot of trouble to get exactly what you want!  Traditional ambience, very clean and tidy!  Food freshly cooked and served with ample portions.  Mashed potato at last!

Author: fell3ong
Title: Lousy dinner.
Review: Captain oversell their dishes. Keep telling these dishes are the best & client raging how good it is. Frankly it's really normal.Orange salad once of the ingredient is Avacado. When arrive, the waiter said it was Avacado sauce, we further asked & they say it Guacamole. But can't see at all....they say it's very Fine Guacamole.Seriously nothing impressive.

Author: purple_dotsKuala Lumpur
Title: Quaint. Good Food. Young Team.
Review: I was lucky to get a reservation at the last minute. Love the ambiance (both at the restaurant and at the bar upstairs). They have a good selection of Nikka whiskeys and a very pleasant bartender.Dinner is a little pricey but it was good, size wise and quality, with nice food presentation. I think this place is worth visiting again. Wished they had better house pouring wines though. After the whiskeys, a bottle would have been too much.

Author: angelineo99
Title: Love their Asian food and cocktails
Review: The Nexus is the latest hotspot to grace the cityscape of Kuala Lumpur. Set in the enclave of Bangsar South, visitors are in for a great time as they indulge in a myriad of lifestyle and F&B options both illustrious and distinctive. And if you are looking to celebrate a party or just hang out and chill with a bunch of family and friends, why not join the soulsociety and stopover SOULed OUT?Established in May 2014, the SOULed OUT at Nexus is large and spacious, with two sections for seating guests; an air-conditioned area and a commodious alfresco styled-area. The place was lively and relaxed, and many patrons were there as friends having dinner together or celebrating a birthday, co-workers chilling out or as a family having the evening meal together. Everyone was just having a good time.They have so much going for this outlet, with regular parties to commemorate Christmas, New Year's Eve, Oktoberfest, St. Patrick's Day and a slew of others. They also have live music on Wednesdays for the urbanite seeking the mid-week break from the grind, and they sport large TV screens for you to catch your favourite football matches. They even have a schedule for football match screenings at their website, go check it out.And with decades of experience in the F&B industry, SOULed OUT kitchens and bars offers some of the best signature foods and drinks in the Klang Valley, with dedicated menus for both items. Their kitchens for example, specializes in four different kinds of foods, catered around Asian food, Western food, Northern Indian food and pizzas. As an added value for families, their menu also caters to children and they even have a section for light eaters with a local flavour.Caribbean Jerk ChickenNo, when the chicken arrived it was quite amiable. Jerk is actually a style of cooking from Jamaica, where meats are marinated using a spicy mixture called Jamaican Jerk spice which consists principally Pimento and Scotch Bonnet peppers, but may also include other ingredients such as cloves, cinnamon, scallions, nutmeg, thyme, garlic, brown sugar, ginger and salt. In this case, the chicken thigh was marinated in Jerk spices, then grilled to the point where it is nicely seared on the outside but tender and moist on the inside. It is accompanied with vegetables and sautéed fragrant rice which quickly became a favourite.Tandoori Chicken SpecialThere are so many ways to prepare poultry, but nothing can quite match this North Indian dish in terms of its savoury taste and the uniqueness of its preparation which requires the meat to be marinated with yogurt and subsequent seasoned with Indian spices. It is then cooked in a charcoal-fired clay oven called a Tandoor which imparts its name to the dish. This is served with raitha, papadam and your choice of pulao rice or plain naan.Sang Har MeinThis classic Chinese dish is simply delicious! It is crispy noodles, crowned with a trio of large deep fired fresh water prawns which are then doused with an egg-based gravy.Sambal Prawn & SquidThis spicy dish is cooked with SOULed OUT's secret sambal paste, the taste of which tantalises the taste buds. Consisting of juicy prawns and squids, it is stir-fried together with the sambal paste, onions and long beans. This dish is accompanied by sesame fried rice.Camembert Beef PastramiThis Beef Pastrami soon became another favourite and it goes well with any drink you order. Beef, Camembert cheese, Monterey Jack cheese, tomatoes and Balsamic cream is sandwiched between Five Seed bread and then toasted. And if you are with friends, cutting it into neat equal sized triangles makes it excellent finger food for sharing.Mama MiaSOULed OUT pizzas come in two sizes, a modest 8 incher or the larger 11 incher. This excellent pizza is topped with Salted Anchovies, Beef Bacon, Black Olives, Garlic, Chopped Tomatoes, Mozzarella and Tomato sauce.DragonflyThis zesty drink is SOULed OUT’s signature juice. It is a combo of Red dragon fruit, Watermelon, Strawberry puree and Fresh Lemon juices. Ice KacangThis ultimate local dessert will definitely satisfy anyone who has a sweet tooth craving! Finely-shaven Ice is crowned with Sweet Corns, Cendol, Red Beans and Black Jelly. It is accompanied by a small pitcher of Brown Sugar Syrup which you can, at your discretion, drizzle over the dessert to taste. Pour it all over, you know you want to! And additional option would be to top this with a scoop of Häagen-Dazs ice cream. SOULed OUT is currently having a BMW promotion; Beer, Mojito, Wine. During the promotion time, they will be offering drinks at a flat rate of RM10 per glass from 12 noon to 7pm. These drinks include Tiger draughts, Classic Mojitos, and Vineyard house pour for red and white wines. And it will never get boring because the Vineyard house pour changes once every 3 months. But if you are keen on drinking something else, have no fear! Their house pours during Happy Hour are at flat rates starting from RM10 for Gin, vodka, Rum and Tequila, RM12 for whiskies and RM15 for Single-Malt from 12 noon to 9pm daily.

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: The steak is good
Review: This is an open air restaurant . 1st time I came here after clubbing at 3 am we had roti canai, Nasi Briyani mutton , Nasi Lemak .The food was delicious . 2nd time we came around 8 pm and we had mix grilled and French onion soup . Apparently the steak here is famous . Thumbs up

Author: Swifted04Hong Kong, China
Title: Waited 30 min for my drink
Review: Hassle to get a table as apparently they are fully booked when half of the place in empty. Ordered a drink which never came asking 3 times for it, ended up getting my drink by myself st the bar. Never heard an apology. Nice place but terrible service

Author: R3dhi11Malaysia
Title: Poor knowledge food.
Review: The bread is of no the right texture, not to mention that variety of cheese is limited to 3 only.The lemon provided for oyster and salmon are pathetically remove most of the pulps, what is serve mainly lemon skin and literary dry lemon in raw salmon(which is dryish).The Chinese herb soup is so plain and it seems that the chef is unaware that the red dates should be pitted before boil. And quality is worst than 8rm common stall quality. The Dimsum is tasteless and one can't taste fish ball as smell and texture of fish ball. The chicken noodle section wasn't like last time where one can delicious smell. Pasta and pizza are like bread. How can they use tasteless and smelles herbs for Italian pasta and pizza. Is outrageous to have a 5 star hotel serving this kind of food. It use to be nice herbs smell and not just tasty but hot too. Nowadays just cold pizza that is artificially heated by lamp. Fruits is like heap of mountain the way they displays is more like night market. Constantly full and dryish. Can see is not freshly prepared. Very disappointed with the management who handle it by degraded standard as previous.

Author: Nicole TLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Not recommended
Review: Bad trip adviser reviews normally amuse me. I am capable of topping up my own wine and don't need silver service.But I do expect a certain level of service and dinner tonight was not great for a restaurant which was recommended to us.We were placed in the far corner next to the kitchen. Tables which arrived after us received food before we received menus. We tried unsuccessfully to catch the eye of one of the plentiful staff members but they were busy setting tables which weren't filled.We were probably branded as troublemakers when I got up to ask for menus and service. But I thought we were back on track when our order was taken, drinks arrived and, shortly thereafter, our starter. It was hot and delicious.Then two minutes later our mains arrived too. Whilst not unusual in Asia, it was unusual in this restaurant as all the tables around us had had a pause between courses. The beef short rib was tasty but it was cold. Unpleasantly so. The prawns were also cold but also overcooked.We were probably unlucky given the seemingly better service given to the tables around us. You may wish to chance it and may get better service and food but our verdict was that it wasn't worth trying again in case the bad service and food was not a one off.

Author: Tonyduck
Title: Good ambiance and service
Review: Have lunch in yun house with my family today and was amaze with the atmosphere and the service. The food are to die for. The cereal eggplant and the salted egg fish skin are the best.

Author: Sze K
Title: Best Seafood Buffet but screwed up front line services
Review: Have been here and very satisfied with the seafood quality here and also the service level but not until today where they messed up the reservation preference table by a guy named Steve Ho as claimed by the frontline staff who served me. My whole family was made to stand outside the entrance. This is way out of Shang standard. Way frustrated of the service experience.

Author: csfKuching_SarawakKuching, Sarawak
Title: Poor
Review: Johore is a place which I travel for work regularly. This restaurant is the latest which I explore on one lunch date with my clients. We ordered the Beijing Duck as the card on table stated that there is a promotion, offering RM 48.00 per duck, (whole). The rest, we opted for some tim sum. When the duck was served, the waiters serve the skin on a pancake fully wrap with other ingredients and there was in the plate, about 10pcs. Then we were asked how we like the duck meat served, we opted for ginger and spring onion fried duck meat. The waiter took away the whole bird then later came back with a plate of fried duck meat, which portion is equivalent to a quarter of the duck and two duck drumstick place on the side of the dish. We asked the waiter where is the rest of the duck meat, she answered that there's all to it. We were quite surprised as its very clear, the portion is way too small for a whole duck. Next, came the bill. We were charge another Rm12.00 to have the duck meat fried. We felt cheated, for on a normal day, a whole duck is served at Rm 68.00, now the so called promotion period, we paid Rm48 then another Rm12 for the duck, that adds up to Rm70 for a quarter of a duck, well, that will be our last visit there. Disappointed!

Author: RyanL4387
Title: Ambient environment
Review: Great service team once you arrival towards boarding. Comfortable seat and ambient environment that worth to drop by for a visit.

Author: CAlove75Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special
Review: Not that we were expecting much but the service was terribly slow and the food was just alright. My husband ordered a dish and they brought him out the wrong one. We were eating with our children so we didn't have time to wait for the correct order to be made (especially after waiting forever to place our order and then have it brought out). Won't be eating here again

Author: Mndym67Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Steak
Review: Great quality steak and cooked exactly to order. We were there early and it was quiet, but had walked by later on other nights and they were quite popular. Very kindly changed the television so we could watch the NRL State of Origin :-) Food and drinks were great (some different cocktails to the norm), setting great. Good value for money. Prompt friendly service.

Author: DoraQiyi
Title: Too pricy
Review: The environment is good but the food is just below everage .  Nothing special on drink . Also food abit salty

Author: AylwinOPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Horrible Ribs
Review: After reading so many good reviews about this place, we just have to try. BIG mistake. We ordered the signature and curry ribs. They were so dry. The sauce were tasteless. Everything were just wrong. I will not recommend this place to any of my friends.

Author: jetsetqueen54321Sydney
Title: good atmosphere
Review: went there mainly becoz nothing else is open at night on the entire jonker Street!!! starving and had to go to this place. it was ok. service attentive. price a bit expensive. food tasted so so. if i manage to find something else I probably wouldn't have eaten at this geographer cafe. but its not bad. just not extremely fantastic.

Author: euphorialicexzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Uninteresting, not fresh, very limited
Review: The grill buffet we had on Saturday was limited. They only have prawn,2 types of fish, mussel, squid, chicken, lamb and beef, and also satay skewers. The prawn was not fresh, the fish was not well-seasoned and the squid was not even seasoned. There was very limited sushi spread with no raw fish served. The cold prawns at the salad section were not fresh. There is smoked salmon in the salad section but no fresh raw salmon. The chicken tikka was too dry and not well-seasoned. The dessert spread was laughable. Everything was too sweet and the cakes taste below average. I could have gotten better cakes at any normal bakery outside. There was no ice cream served or local desserts served. Just tiny pieces of sugary flour they call cakes. Not even cheesecakes!The only thing I liked was the Spinach Ravioli but some parts were very floury. The mosquito repellant provided did not work so we were still bitten by the mosquitoes as we were dining. The live band was not-up-to-par. It's mostly just noisy. But we did pass by the lounge at the hotel reception and that singer was much better. I will not return.

Author: Shahul Hameed SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Probably not the best pasta
Review: I went to The Apartment few times, mainly because of some events. Their main dish is just average, nothing to die for, but I do like their Red Velvet & rainbow cake. I would probably not go to this restaurant if I would need to pay on my own.

Author: Damian_76
Title: Definitely an experience worth trying
Review: Whilst I don't think was food and matched wine was anything particularly memorable or justifiable for the price, we had a great evening nevertheless. Even entering the dark dining room with your waiter was quite overwhelming. The overall experience is somewhat hard to explain but really something I would recommend.

Author: ISZISMAEL
Title: Chilly and
Review:
A good place to hang out with friends and having a scrumptious dinner.

Choices of meal is variety compared to other hotel at similar area.

Author: Esther G
Title: Love the cronut!
Review: The cronut is good. Even though it may be a little pricey but guess it's worth it! The environment is nice as well ;)

Author: WakoPattoBangkok, Thailand
Title: Disinterested & Unhelpfull Staff, Tastless food. Sombre Atmosphere
Review: Went for lunch, All the waitresses sitting around talking disinterested in showcasing there restaurant, food, culture, heritage, traditions ect.Food was fast, But flavourless asked for salt and sweet chilli to add flavour, Salt arrived, Still waiting for sweet chilli... The orange juice was fanta..I will not eat here again.Tip, Wander up a little further to porrige house, Food amazing, People friendly and interesting. There menu is not in english how ever speak with the pleastly plump lady she will suggest menu choices in english.. (dinner only til 2am) Try the Mongolian Pepper Chicken!!

Author: Jc221111
Title: Bad service
Review: Outstanding restaurant for restrict customer order their food, not a cup of water consume in their shop but one set meal for 2 people is not fulfill their standard. Not everyone with big portion stomach!!!!! Lousy service

Author: WilliamTan168
Title: Average food only
Review: It is really mind-boggling as to why so many people would queue up and wait for a long time just for a bowl of mediocre noodle / mee hoon kuih soup. Definitely not value for money.

Author: KerryR290Indented Head, Australia
Title: Terribly let down
Review: Well I have to start by saying I totally agree and support Eric from California comments.This is not true fine dining, yes it’s a very nice setting but far from fine dining.Our experience was as follow.Table service was efficient and polite although one waitress was unable to answer my questions regarding how the dish was made and contents.Varied choice of wines and sparklings by the glass .Entre of scallops, I would have to say they would be the best I ever had. Just beautiful and attention to detail with presentation.Risotto main was undercooked and a little crunchy. Sent three quarters of the fish back.Linguine was bland and floating in oil, not pleasant.Cauliflower soup whilst was tasty it was so salty beyond belief.Overall: A very overpriced restaurant that does not match quality or true fine dining experience.

Author: yc GKlang, Malaysia
Title: Taste & Service Downgraded
Review: Taste of the Cendol, Curry Mee and Asam Laksa not as expected compared to last visit about a couple of months ago. We feel that the taste this time is below average compare to those from others.Service was quite bad. I was reprimanded to the cashier buy the cashier through a waiter (foreigner) to pay my bill first even the foods not ready yet just because we changed table from outside into air-conditioning section. I was OK with that, but the way she talked was quite rude and worse without eye-contact.This will be the last time there. If the quality & taste is kept as good as before when they first started, I might go back though service not as good. But not this time..

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Good chicken rice, convenient location
Review: This restaurant was just a row away from Straits Hotels & Suites where I was putting up a couple of nights. From the facade, one can really tell how commercialised it is, with the extra large lighted signage, but then again, is there anything left in Malacca that isn't already commercialised?The wait staff was very light on their feet and, attentive and friendly. The owner was equally attentive and chipped in whenever his staff was occupied. We ordered a serving of chicken rice balls with steamed chicken drumstick and a serving of loose chicken rice with steamed chicken thigh.The steamed chicken was moist and succulent. However the rice balls were dry and a tad hard which could only mean that the rice balls were made a lot earlier than it was served whereas the loose chicken rice was a lot fresher. I would recommend to forgo the rice balls and go for the loose rice instead, as it is just a gimmick and nothing else.Overall, the chicken rice was tasty and definitely worth a repeated visit. Price wise, typical of Malacca's over inflated standards so nothing unusual.

Author: eddymayaYork, United Kingdom
Title: Rough, ready and overpriced for what it is
Review: After a long flight from the UK I was looking for somewhere near my hotel for a quick and easy lunch. This place seemed to fit the bill based on the reviews but I found it a bit disappointing given it's high rating. My curry was tasty enough but the whole experience was rough, ready and charmless. Maybe that's what some people like about it. I also ended up spending around RM40 which seems pretty steep for a place like this. Apparently the large prawns are a whopping RM12 each. Either that or they saw me coming & ripped me off. Wouldn't return and wouldn't recommend.

Author: iwantgoodfoodnow
Title: Nice kueh pie tee and cincaluk omelette
Review: Friendly staff and boss. Tried the lady's finger and chicken with tamarind too which was average. Chicken didn't feel very cooked and willing recooked it. Many cookies and chilli for sale

Author: DianeF24
Title: Great Hotel
Review: Good location, basic hotel but clean, staff are very friendly. The Lime Light Rooftop Lounge is great to sit back and relax and the complimentary Lime drink is great.

Author: scubafun1234
Title: Great atmosphere, ok dinner
Review: Had business dinner here with some colleagues, atmosphere is really nice, the attached hotel is beautiful, the food choices were plentiful, and the food in general was good, it just was not outstanding, nothing that would make me come back

Author: ClivehmToronto, Canada
Title: WHAT A JOKE
Review: we went to this restaurant expecting something special..another reason was it had good ratings. They must be by people who are impressed by the high price and think therefore it must be good.It was all sizzle and no substance. Every course looked good but the taste was mediocre at best. We went for the view as well so at least we enjoyed that. My advise is to have a drink there, enjoy the view and go to a real restaurant to eat..

Author: rudicheu
Title: So so
Review: Fish was average. Prices were on the high side. Parking cost rm15. Staff service was good but overbearing.

Author: toedeloetjesBrno, Tsjechië
Title: Food poisoning
Review: We stayed at the attached hotel during Ramadan. The Ramadan buffet was extensive and gave us both food poisoning - after eating street food for a month in Vietnam and Thailand without a problem. Best avoided. Very expensive for what you get as well, even if you do not count the food poisoning.

Author: MarkTluszczLuxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Lamest of all Nobu restaurants....
Review: How can a franchise like Nobu allow this to happen? Uncool and lame are the two words that come to mind.While it has great views, everything else about the experience is a disappointment. It simply does not stand up to the Nobu standard.Avoid this place. Many better choices in KL.

Author: FionPjohor bahru
Title: Weekend Buffet
Review: Less crowded, but limited food choice. Indian food, satay and salads bar above average but western food is limited. Choices of drinks also limited.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: OSWALDHII
Title: Dragon Seafood Restaurant
Review: The restaurant is located at Baram Road next to seaside beach.They are preparing fresh and quality food especially seafood; for instance classic lobster noodles and fried deep water crab.

Author: Christeene818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing non authentic Thai Food
Review: I dined at this restaurant on Thursday night with my husband. Having lived in Bangkok and missing the beautiful favors of Thai food we felt we would be guaranteed tasty Thai food given the Chef is promoted as being Thai. The entre set the scene with Thai Fish Cakes (unedible); deep fried prawns (tough); chicken & cashew nuts (again tough & definitely had been reheated), and spring rolls (which I did not try). This was garnished with canned pineapple which I think speaks for itself. For our main meal we had ordered seafood salad with vermicelli which was just as disappointing. Large junks of raw white onion and tasteless tomato with a dressing that didn't add any flavor to the dish other than chilli and, in fact, was quite bitter. All in all very disappointing. If this restaurant didn't advertise a Thai Chef I would have rated it as 'Poor' but you would assume that a Thai Chef would be able to get those amazing flavors which Thai food is renowned for in the dishes. I really hope that the Chef sits down and actually tastes what is coming out of the kitchen because it is not good and definitely not authentic Thai.

Author: 991JamesM
Title: No shorts Please
Review: Good club but no entry without long trousers! Venue bouncing in terms of music and people who want to be seen! Visit we'll worth the view of the Sky Walk!

Author: Sarnia31Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but witnessed animal cruelty
Review: I've been to this restaurant twice. The food is good and the place is clean (even the toilets).But I will never go again after I saw this: a very young, small street cat, not much more than a kitten, wandered into the restaurant. It wasn't causing any fuss, just curiously investigating. But one of the waiters viciously kicked it into the air and out of the door, whilst laughing. I wouldn't be surprised if the cat sustained broken ribs - it was a very hard kick. There was no attempt to gently guide the cat out onto the street, just a heartless kick and a guffaw.This spoiled an otherwise pleasant evening for me.

Author: vinayraichur
Title: Average Indian FOod
Review:
Not authentic indian food.
Veg/Non veg Thali is available , Value for money
Service is slow. Location is good.

Author: andrewleesg
Title: Service SUCKS!
Review: Unbelievable! Even by local standards. Waited 10 min for a cup of coffee... Guy said he forgot. No big deal... Then we ordered food... 15 min later, wifes food arrives - cold! Asked about my food. Guy says `yea yea, on the way`15 min later, I ask the waiter again... He said. 'oh I forgot... You wait another 10 min' I said forget it, let me see the manager. Manager takes his time then finally comes over. Tells me its my fault cause the order wasnot clear! So I paid for the coffee and wife's food and left.Place is a joke. Dont give a damn cause another tourist will take your place.No reason to spend your hard earned money in a ---- hole like this.

Author: JamesKMTan
Title: Average pub like restaurant
Review: Was there recently for a function organised by the lproperty group.  The atmosphere was rather dark and noisy. The food was average and service was so so only.

Author: cdrsree
Title: Disappointing evening
Review: Very friendly staff, but the ribeye steak of not really good. The drinks, Sangrilla n Mojita just so so. The tenderloin, lamb cutlet was souled out too. The atmosphere was very warm.

Author: 1rowang
Title: Dinner
Review: All of us had dinner set. It was really good! The double boiled soup and cod fish were especially nice. They provide good and friendly services.Happy to visit again in the future.

Author: GeraldineH
Title: Great Casual Local Dining Experience
Review: It is was recommended we try Teksen, really enjoyed this bustling restaurant, quick service, recommend crispy pork and delicious tofu. Very well priced

Author: farsyaahmad
Title: Chill place for a beer. Not great for anything else.
Review: First day, went for beers (good) and food (I'm sure the photo of the cottage pie received speaks for itself). Then in the evening, went for cocktails; had a clueless waiter and an awfully rude bartender that did not want to accept that I had severe allergies, which I specifically mentioned before ordering. My boyfriend went over to confirm that they'd written down my allergies, only to have the bartender scream at us, saying he already started mixing the the drink and therefore we needed to drink it, or just leave it but still pay for it. His exact words were, 'Don't drink la, but you will lose your money'. He even asked me WHY I had allergies. Will never go again.

Author: dexter1881Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, lame service
Review: Creative menu remains, and interesting degustation menu for those who couldn't be bothered to read through the a la carte menu. Entrée | Mains | Desserts are RM68+ | RM88+ | RM28+ upwards.The truffle butter is a proven crowd pleaser, but one could get better breads elsewhere. Went through 2 bottles of Gigondas 2007 (very good!) with our meal, but the sommelier did not offer cork inspection (as what AndyChanKL mentioned in the earlier post), and did not apologise when he missed a drop on the table cloth while pouring the wine. He seemed be on the rush without trying to find out what our preferences on food-wine pairing were.It is worth a visit for good food seeks, but wouldn't it be nicer if Cilantro could brush up their services as well?

Author: Lim B
Title: Best Beef noodles & Perfect Porridge
Review: After Some Shopping in chinatown, petaling Street do Stroll to jalan tun h S lee & you'll Stumbled into Soong Kee, houSed in a Simple Shoplot where for at leaSt 40 yearS, they have Serve the beSt beef noodleS, .... flavorSome minced pork toppingS on d Soft noodleS, generouS Slices of beef (optional & with variable choiceS), Springly beef ballS & clear yummy deliciouS Soup! It's a Small portion, So another Star choice here is Loa Yau Kee porridge, a equally infamouS Stall they took over lot Stock & barrel from the original owner to compliment; Smart Strategy! It's porridge, whether fiSh or pork is Smooth, Sweet & muSt add its Stir fried pork inteStine ... Sensational & Superb!

Author: Demonone
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: One of the best top of the range restaurants on the strip. Well worth a meal there. Good service and great food.

Author: JojiJacobSingapore
Title: Very good food and service
Review: My 10-year old and I had some time to kill before heading out to the airport. My kid had fish and chips (excellent) and i had a couple of Long Island Ice Teas (again, excellent). The views out of the windows are great. and the staff is very friendly and attentive!

Author: Wolv3rin3Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Diminished Portions N' Service at High Price
Review: When arrive, we're directed to Tatsu Japanese restaurant for they have closed off Tao Chinese restaurant. Should have raised a red flag. Tatsu was less than half full, probably due to CMCO. Service was not fluid, eventually get to place our order. Starters portions were small, were it's single portions now. Scallops were sliced thinly, like one into 3 slices. When the main courses arrived, to say evidently portions were small is an understatement. We had to double and triple order the mains. Not like last year's visit. The wasabi mango prawns, french beans belacan stirred fried with white fish and seafood tofu in claypot is notably good. A couple of deserts were a saving grace, like the soya pudding with a gold leaf on mint garnish and mango puree in passion fruit. Bill was RM 705, with pot of Chinese Puer tea, no liquor.

Author: tareqsafar
Title: Bad service and the Indian manger doesn't care
Review:
I stayed 20 minutes!!!!! 
i ask for my  order . After that the waiter say  said there was a problem with the system
And I speak with Indian manager 
He doesn't respect me and he tell me don't noise in the restaurant

Author: jeiwongKajang, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for family or friend gathering
Review: This restaurant did very well in their decoration, it give us a thought that we have reach the land of China.Their waiter and waitress all wearing the traditional costumes whereby excellently fit the atmosphere of the restaurant.We had steamboat here, and we chose one pork-bone soup and another is fish soup.There is plenty of sauces and dip for you to taste, I like that part most, you can prepare your own unique sauce, or following the recipe of the restaurant.Everything is good, except for the price, consider a bit higher than mid-range.
Restaurant: 龍門客棧 Dragon Door Inn Steamboat Restaurant

Author: geoftheref
Title: Great Food!
Review: Great spot and great food. Fast and friendly staff. Had the Chicken Curry + Fish with Mushroom Sauce with a side of Chicken Dumplings.

Author: zhihongtohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food
Review: Decided to try the weekend seafood buffet with my Girlfriend and we regretted not trying it for the past few times while we stayed in doubletree.Everything was on point, sashimi and oysters were fresh, stations available for you to stir fry/boil your Favourite seafood! Delicious local delicacies prepared on the spot by the chefs and also a wide variety of desserts from pastries to cakes to ice cream! Will definitely try it again the next time we stay in doubletree!
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: WarmlyAndCoPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Is ok but over price
Review: We would like to experience the live band, unfortunately we chose a wrong night as they did not have any live music on due is the day of remembrance of MH17. The restaurant was quite quiet, consider was 11pm on Friday. The waiter was very friendly and chatting with us with attention. He even bring some Hard Rock Café badge and cocktail sticks when we said our children that at home (our rarely night out) would like the cocktail sticks that come with the cocktail. It was a nice though and surprise for the children.The prices of the drinks were slightly more expensive than a few pub/Bristol along Melaka River and Jonker Street. It was a treat for us but not a frequent visit place.

Author: OwenLiu
Title: Lunch time Meal
Review: What a rush.  The ambience of cafe is new Tradition.  The food is good.  But the lunch time crowd overwhelming.   Waiting time around 30mins during lunch.

Author: JimmyKimmelKobe, Japan
Title: Small portion too expensive for what you get
Review: I just ordered a Lamb Kebab. Being from Europe I was expecting a proper Turkish style kebab cut and wrapped nicely thick almost a footlong size like a sandwhich. All I got was some french fries and 2 sausages and they charged me 32 RM for this. I ordered through FoodPanda and they were not helpful. If this is the amount I get for ordering food I cannot recommend it. It's too expensive.

Author: ilovehomekong
Title: We were there for a family Sunday
Review: We were there for a family Sunday lunch! Very nice environment! And family friendly ☺️ we ordered a pizza, lamb shoulder and a whole chicken! You should really share the food the portion. Is big! The 2feet long pizza was more than enough to share with 7 people, the Lamb and chicken also! Plus dessert we had ☕️ affogato, tiramisu and budino - the salted caramel pudding ! we had a blast super good services and the price is super reasonable! It’s better than I expected :)(Too busy eating, didn’t really take pictures)

Author: Lostsoulpe
Title: Very slow service
Review: Bad service.We had to wait for one whole hour to get our food.very disappointed, otherwise food was okay.
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Umaruban
Title: Average food
Review: Had lunch here with my son. Had tried the Western and Eastern  choices, including a vegetarian meal which was quite unpalatable. The seafood pie was better though. Service was good.

Author: choonhueil
Title: Wonderful Experience
Review: Warm welcome from the staffs Maizan and Avai.Azlan makes really good drinks.Best rooftop bar in KL,the view itself says it all..Cocktails were excellent but little pricey.Overall everything was on point.Definitely will recommend this place

Author: meiajc
Title: totally different
Review: 1. The food was different from the menu, but the portion is super small for the price you paid. 2. Don't get cheated by the other Google photos, it's just mini size burger and there is only ONE small corn.3. No lotus chips, it's burdock root strips.4, the teriyaki sauce is watery.5. slow service, unprofessional.

Author: MJvixenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Desa Sri Hartamas branch - not bad
Review: Pop in for a quick lunch as we were lucky to get a parking spot just right next to the restaurant.It was our first visit and was glad that they make rotis during lunch hours which many of the mamak/banana leaf restaurants don't do so to force/insist their customers to have just their rice or noodles only.We ordered roti telur, tosai, roti tissue and roti boom which all of them were acceptably tasty but gets cold quite quickly. Four pieces of rotis, a teh tarik and a coke was about RM15.

Author: Benedikt SIpoh
Title: What a let down!
Review: Used to go there often. Came back tonight and was shocked. Prices are high, service is average and one has to eat from plastic plates. Not what you expect though standard in Malaysia it seems! Portions are small compared to before. Not worth going there again!

Author: CaraCaraTravelBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Servers hello? *over here*
Review: I am super disappointed . We ordered 3 dishes and the first dish arrived after 15 mins, the second one after 20 mins which is fine .. however the third dish arrived after 45 mins. When asked , they gave an excuse that it is grilled ,hence, it would take longer.However, how is it that two tables who ordered grilled food after me got their dishes first .If you are going to serve my food late , at least do not patronize me by giving an obviously weak answer. Own up to the mistake and apologize.Plus the servers aren’t very attentive although it is in a very enclosed place . Several attempts with flailing arms and waves .

Author: consumption888London, United Kingdom
Title: Unauthentic food
Review: Ambience was nice, and service was okay. Would come here for a drink, but definitely not the food. The food makes the place a bit of a tourist trap, is unauthentic (coming from a Malaysian), and expensive. Also why is the ladies toilets locked with a PIN code and the men's isn't, bit sexist? Could also do with toilet paper (had to use my own pocket tissue).

Author: annierodSydneySydney
Title: Good value for money
Review: You really need to go with a crowd as even the small serves are large. We had the scallops with broccoli, the special mee hoon and the soft shelled crab. All delicious!We were welcomed by Irene and our table server was Anna who was delightful. The ambience which is old style Chinese where we dined on the balcony overlooking the water towards Singapore was extremely mellow.Certainly would return.
Restaurant: Tai Son Seafood Restaurant - The Zon

Author: jacfaadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The food is not worth the queue or waiting list, disappointing.
Review: We were Google'ing for good food to eat in Malacca. And we came across the blog - Top 17 food in Melaka so we decided on Nancy's Kitchen. Judging by the queue and the waiting list of the restaurant, we were excited for the food ^^ plus we were hungry!We ordered what most people have on their table. Ayam Rendang (was just normal), Popiah (is bad, skin is dry and the content inside is just blah), Pork Bean Paste (nothing to shout about), Omelette, Mix Vegetable (looks like from yesterday's dish, not fresh at all) & Ondeh-Ondeh. Presentation is bad. Taste is not up to a "queue up" restaurant standard. Verdict walking out the restaurant: It is a very disappointing experience.

Author: Natp39Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, slow service
Review: The food here is reasonable, but the service is very slow and every bodies dinners came out at different times. The cocktails are good,and ok prices during happy hour. The atmosphere is very city chic, can be a little pretentious. On the whole a good little spot.

Author: ZongHao
Title: Boss's appalling attitude
Review: Requested to change table due to horrid smell and got a "you're dumb" in response, absolutely horrible. No more explanations needed.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Beautiful restaurant. Terrible employees with horrible attitude.
Review: The ambience, the design and the restaurant itself is gorgeous. But the foods are definitely not worth for paying it. And if you're a local, the waitress will not be kind or respectful to you. Lack of service policy. It ruined my anniversary dinner night.

Author: david0ng
Title: Dinner at Hakka Restaurant
Review: They do not provide parking for tour buses and the food there is quite pricey.  You have a chance to enjoy a good steamboat meal but add on's are also pricey.

Author: drrrb420
Title: Bad & Expensive
Review: food is ok, service was bad, even the serving plate was broken. Menu pics are completely different than what they serve👎👎😑

Author: MS1890Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch- Stale and old Curry
Review: Had bought Daal Tadka, Shahi Paneer, Mixed Vegetable: trust me Daal was good. But Both the curry was old and stale. We called them saying you have given stale food. He said, pls bring it back and we will see if it's spoil. Sorry to Say Singh Chapati: this is the first and last time I have bought food from you.

Author: YingyingH41
Title: Don't go there if you do not have enough cash on you
Review: I went there with my husband for our anniversary. At the beginning everything was fine. We were quite happy with the service and the food. When we finished dinner and tried to pay the bill with our credit card, the waiters told us that there was something wrong with the machine. Then we tried four other cards (which have enough credit), and somehow they didn't work (they worked perfectly when we did our shopping in some malls before going to the restaurant). And we didn't have enough cash (we never thought that we would need to carry 700RM with us when we ate out). It was so embarrassing. The waiter told us to get some cash out of an ATM, which is 50 meters away from the restaurant. I did so but I was not happy -- my bank charges a high fee for withdrawing cash in a foreign country. When I got the cash and went back to the restaurant, I was told that actually the machine worked. I was not happy and told the waiter about it, but he didn't do anything to make it up for me. I don't think I will ever go to that restaurant again. The waiters there don't seem to know what is "good service" and how to make customers happy.

Author: USCHRU_13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Better than average and not expensive Japanese food
Review: We went there a couple of times during the past month. There are many mid-range Japanese places to choose from in KL, this one is better than average in my opinion. The food here seemed to taste fresher than similar restaurants. Also, its service is also slightly better. As for the price, a dinner for two runs up to 100 RM with tax and service charge included.

Author: Rob7711Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: You Are On A Timer
Review: Firstly this is a review of Rocku Yakiniku at 1U Shopping Mall. I believe this is a chain restaurant and as such the review should be applicable. My family had lunch here on 29/08/2016 at noon and we all ordered the lunch set consisting of raw sliced meats and veg. You also have access to the small buffet spread as part of the meal.Halfway through our meal (remember you have to bbq your meats and veg) the waiter drops by our table and informs us that we have remaining 15 minutes to finish our meal! The waiter then proceeded to inform the elderly couple seated at our adjacent table similarly. We were all taken by surprise as were the elderly couple (both tables were sat about the same time).Perhaps there were fine print notices or in the menu somewhere that we failed to take notice of but be warned ... You Are On A Timer! Now go ahead and burn your meats and vegs coz that's the only way you get to finish your meal.

Author: prashantini S
Title: Worst ever food
Review:
No proper service. Indian vegetarian food was so bad. Never give this restaurant a try for vegetarian options. Too many good places are there near melaka riverside.  Waste of money and choice.
Regret choosing over this place for lunch.

Author: olicgnCologne, Germany
Title: Unhygenic and very bad service.
Review: I am one of these "expats" and brought to this place as of the courtesy of my local friends to treat me with western food. Saw other expats but I dont think that they are regulars as they all studied the menu closely. We were all shocked by the run down appearence and really bad were the bar where they presented the meet. Very dirty! We ordered english breakfast and we had to attract the attention of the staff several times before. Not helpful at all. Forgot cutleries, brought cream for the coffee in a cup that was not supposed to be used to pour any liquids. Food was dry and flat. Malaysians, please dont assume that European food is like that! This was certainly below my lowest expectations.If you want to waste time and money you have a place to go.

Author: amiesu27Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Halal dimsum, authentic taste!! But bad customer service
Review: Brought my Chinese friends here before and they all said its worth it! So if you’re a non muslim asian, then halal dimsum is never nice but this shop managed to get the taste right. It’s a bit in the pricey side but the portion pretty much make it worth the money. I called for reservations and Rizal was kind enough to make sure we got the best seat in the house and make sure we are taken care off. Me and my cuzs went crazy n ordered a lot of food thus we took quite some time to finish it. Rizal was kind enough offering to reheat the custard bun as its not hot anymore. Had a bad experience today where most of the staff (esp the girls) there look tired and make angry faces every time we asked for either a refill of tea (3x refill) or ginger (once), the food taste make up for it. I mean we do have to pay for service charge and sst though so if u cant handle people then get a desk job. Overall total bill for the 3 of us came up to rm302.40. My advice, just eat their signature dimsum and leave cause service is really bad. Or look for Rizal, he’s really nice n considerate.

Author: nephronkingLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Pretty woman
Review: Sherina from our Grand Hyatt hotel concierge recommended and helped us booked this lovely fine dining experience. We initially chose the Stratto the Italian cuisine and true to many of the disappointed comments here the view was not great. The restaurant made the change to the Cantaloupe, the french cuisine section and we had the balcony to ourselves. The view of the Petronas Twin Towers and KL skyline was fabulous. The ambience of eating out in the large balcony all to ourselves was akin to the Pretty Woman movie. The menu was fine dining at it's best designed by Chef Christian Bauer  the celebrity chef from Luxembourg. The hospitality staff and special mention of thanks to our waiter Hafiz for making it a special night. We would personally recommend this dining experience when you are in KL.

Author: midmagColwyn Bay, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: You cannot go wrong with this restaurant as proved by being constantly full with people queuing to get in. The Steamed bass is great and the prawns they serve are the tastiest and juiciest I’ve ever had. Despite being busy service is fast friendly and efficient. Price wise we’ve always come away amazed at how low the bill is.

Author: thedevourer
Title: Not worth the hype
Review: The pork knuckle was not good but the upside to ordering the pork knuckle is the potato you get as a side dish which is the best thing I experienced in this restaurant aside from the excellent service.

Author: Just_me_lahSingapore
Title: Not as expected
Review: Read up that this place is good and the pics looks appetizing. However, the food was sorely disappointing as it was starch overload on their hor-fun. What we did enjoy was the braised chicken feet which was flavorful and the squid which we ordered seconds. Other than that, not impressed

Author: Choo N
Title: it doesn't worth
Review: Meat balls and fish balls are kinda normal, nothing special. I don't think it is nice and it is really overpriced !!!
Restaurant: Hakka Mee Restaurant Paris (Yin Yau Kui)

Author: tradeformChateaurenard, France
Title: Pleasant, but pricey
Review: It is pleasant to sit on or next to the beach on a balmy evening. Service is second to none, The food is good, but for the price paid one would expect that. More local dishes on the menu would have been appreciated. A bottle of mineral water tasted disticly "off" so we drank the local water in preference. Overall a pleasant experience, but we enjoyed other restaurants more which charged 1/3 of this one.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ajcJohannesburgGreater Johannesburg, South Africa
Title: Stop and eat
Review: Problem on this street was were to eat. A bit much with every person shoving menu in your face. There is a bit of a smell in the street in certain areas. Found a restaurant were we had fish. It was well cooked and enjoyable and was cheap based on other touristy places we had been to.

Author: 981betya
Title: Nice staff members
Review:
Date: 17/12/2018
Location: Ferringhi Beach area

Type: Local chinese food
Clean: Yes
Service: Yes
Friendly Staff: Yes
Food Quality: Average
Value for money: No
Scale of 0-10: 5.5/10

Total spent: MYR$62.70 (2pax)

Really average food. Seriously overhyped.

Author: Richards1250Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Sour experience
Review: The food here is very tasty especially if you like Mexican food, the atmosphere is also very good. It’s just such a shame the staff let it down. The first night we came it was quite full and the gentlemen running the place said he would get us a table then disappeared for a while so we gave up. Came back for a second time and sadly the experience wasn’t the best. Food came separately which is fine and then I asked for sour cream, waited a while as my food went cold grabbed a second person and asked him, still waited. It got up to ten minutes and I was quite frustrated so I got up and asked the bar they said they would bring it. A while later i finally received the sour cream, the man rather aggressively said I had to pay for it. That’s fine, just let me have some!!! No apologises just wants money, I don’t mind paying at all it’s just the wait and the attitude. For someone who is passionate about sour cream I would avoid in the future.

Author: wanch2019
Title: Sakae Sushi at JB City Square
Review: The sushi on the conveyor belt has been going around many times, thus don’t taste nice. Some of the ala carte food items are not hot, probably left in the kitchen for quite a while. Quite disappointing!

Author: Laura TMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food and soooo cheap!
Review: We visited little India Brickfields and were surprised at the lack of restaurants to choose from. Wandering by the coloured archways we walked past Chat Masala and saw that it was very busy with locals. We checked tripadvisor and reviews seemed to be good so we gave it a try - and we weren't disappointed!Service was a little slow, but we weren't in a rush. Our food was very tasty and prices are excellent value! 25.50MYR for both our meals and a few soft drinks/teas (under £5!!) Mine was a little cheaper than most as didn't contain meat, but just look at the size in the photo! served on giant banana leaf.We ordered completely unfamiliar dishes (as very different to a local Indian restaurant back home in the UK!) but everything was very tasty. I can't remember the names of our dishes, but I'll upload copies of the menu once downloaded photos from the menu.

Author: PaulM941
Title: Not bad
Review: Decent food, but they use turkey bacon on their burgers sadly.  I understand why, I just wish they'd offer both pork and turkey bacon as options on their "world famous" burgers.

Author: ABossMTanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Not Bad"
Review: First visit to this restaurant and booked one table for 10. This restaurant is clean and service is pretty good. For starter, we ordered the "Bidin Salad" and we were not disappointed as it was good. Second dish was the "Seafood Green Noodle" and again we were not disappointed... green noodle texture was good and seafood was fresh. However... the"Beijing Duck" was a disappointment as it just does not taste right & the layer of fat under the skin cannot be tolerated. However the duck meat fried, with ginger & served with mantou, was commendable. The steamed "Soon Hock", about 1.5kg, was simply awesome! Another good dish was stirred fried "Sayur Manis"... it was finished in a jiffy. Must try the"Fish Lips Soup"... we enjoyed it. The salad prawns and fried sotong are just so so. "Pork Throttle" was good but we cannot finish it as we were full. Overall the food quality and serving portion is good and the price... reasonable.
Restaurant: Hoi Tin Lau Restaurant Sdn Bhd

Author: farisahmedmv
Title: Worst food
Review: I will never eat from chilis ever. The food tasted horrible was nothing like shown on the menu. Tasteless..

Author: Alex5590
Title: Middle Eastern Cuisine
Review:
My wife & I have lunch here. The place was not crowd.
Taste ok not bad. I will come back to try the middle eastern rice.
Look very yummy.

Author: VivianeTongMuar, Malaysia
Title: Overprice with So So Dining Experience
Review: Food is just ok. Not too impressive and not really matched with the ranking #8.Overprice oyster @68/pcs which i could have gotten half dozen @ plenty of fine dining restaurant at Bangsar and really fresh too. Salmon belly sashimi is quite tasteless.Overall got quite disappointed when we went all the way to try it out.

Author: LLing_L
Title: Desserts
Review: The watermelon cake taste ok, not the best. The tiramisu taste great. Price was slightly expensive but worth a try.

Author: zayazeha
Title: Okay
Review: Well, the food here is okay. However, the miso soup doesnt taste as good as before. Just wondering since when the miso soup has cabbage inside? Other than that, i love the salmon sushi, especially nishoku. It was fantastic.

Author: Choonfong
Title: Excellent cuisine
Review: Great culinary delights prepared in your own vicinity. Chef's recommendations never disappoint and barbecue sauce ribs are tasty and delicious.

Author: AaronO8885
Title: great ribs
Review: expensive but worth the price, the pocket of ribs are to die for and the onion rings with its starter garlic bread are just to warm up your mouth for the main course.

Author: HennyL122
Title: Average
Review: The food was average, so-so. The place is very comfortable and cooling. Furthermore, the toilet is the cleanest toilet I've ever been for restaurants. It has air cond in the toilet and it looks posh, similarly to hotel toilets.

Author: KateJSAsia
Title: A proper Indian
Review: It's not memorable or outstanding, but it is a good solid Indian restaurant with reasonable prices, at least for veggie stuff. Although raita was overpriced, and we didn't even bother with beer, which is always expensive in mainland Malaysia. Certainly a notch up from the greasy fast food/stuff kept at bacteria breeding temperatures places in Jl Thambypillai. I thought the service was perfectly OK, but then I don't like hovering waiters - if I need them I'm perfectly capable of summoning them.

Author: 17jacquieSydney, Australia
Title: Andrews is a must!
Review: If you are staying anywhere near Batu Ferringhi you must go to Andrews Kampung. Don’t be put off by the location in a poor looking building or the 3 flights of stairs to get there...it is all worth it.From the moment you enter you are greeted by Andrew and his staff. Their warmth and hospitality are charming. The menu is tricky as it is difficult to decide what you won’t eat! There is a mix of Malaysian and Asian food on the menu and I think I spotted some western dishes too. I would suggest that would be to accommodate the many tourists staying at the resorts in the area.Musts to try are: Kapitan prawns (Nyonya), Devil Chicken Curry (Portuguese influence), Kampung Fried rice and the Malaysian Fish - superb! I nearly forgot the Char Koay Toaw - not greasy at all and the best I have tried in Malaysia. The satay however was not the best I have had, but there are so many dishes to try, so why bother with one you can get elsewhere. Most dishes come in half sizes so you can try more! In our six day stay in Batu Ferringhi we dined twice and would happily have gone back again. Another recommendation is the fried ice cream - different to what I have had before as the coating was not a batter but a sweet bread. A delicious reminder of childhood dining experiences at the local Chinese restaurant.The service is great and chef Andrew floats around making sure all are happy with their meals. Very fast service too. A Blaine’s table is good to view the bust streets below.Highly recommended.

Author: SylvienD10Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Did not enjoy the food
Review: Pai Tee - The best dish that I ordered. Crispy skin and fillings was good.Pork buah keluak with curry base sauce - slightly salty and curry sauce was watery and lack of the oomph flavour.Assam Nenas Prawn - Not the freshest prawns. The sauce is the letdown. It tasted sour only. No hint of saltiness nor sweetness.Fried Egg Cincalok - Tasted like ordinary fried egg without cincalok.Chap chai - AverageOverall - I will not return. I can find better elsewhere.

Author: boeis
Title: char kuey teow
Review: The kuey teow is one of the worst I tried ,considering its high price,the Penang coffee also tasteless.

Author: Azxel
Title: Nice spot for drinks while watching the game
Review: Hidden in Damansara Heights, this joint is great to catch Cricket, Drinks, Food with Friends. Ambiance is good, service is good, Gin is a must.

Author: Itazzi
Title: Affordable and worth the visit
Review: If you want to see a different perspective of malaysian hip signature dish, u can try the local coconut shake and also the kuih keria.It’s gonna quench ur thirst especially during hot season. U can also try out air kelapa lemon if u are a lactose intolerant, as the coconut shake has milk as one of the base ingredient in it. Quick service though the queue is long, but it might not take hours for u to stand in line. There are of course plenty of other kuih, Parking is limited, u have to play smart and create ur own parking space.

Author: bertrand c
Title: Poor service and crowded place
Review: The concept, the menu and the place look appealing but at the end the service is not at the level and the constant noise is just an experience killer

Author: metal_mad_travellerPerth
Title: Great food and ambience, staff too eager to help.
Review: We were going to go to another restaurant, however, they were in the process of closing, so we went for a walk and found this restaurant instead. The ambient lighting was we wanted, the waiter came by and handed our menus after looking at them for what seemed like forever we asked which meals was the best seller. We had a combo meal.
