One thing that bothered me was the wait staff seemed a little too eager to help or clear our table, I was still eating when they took my plate away. The portions were the right size, due to having had stomach surgery a few weeks ago. About 11pm the power went out, we couldn't get our receipt for the meal which I am told is quite common in Malaysia.

Author: eezee1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: AVOID THIS PLACE!
Review: It was a decent experience... until we got the bill and realized our orders were the wrong size.There was 3 ladies in our group. We ordered 3 pastas and requested for the small as we have small appetites and weren't feeling too hungry. Server asked if we were sharing, we said yes because we wanted to try each others' food.When the food came, we were surprised that it was such a big portion for the small. It was our first time here so we didn't know what to expect. We had trouble finishing the portions. The good Asian kid in us forced ourselves to eat and when we just couldn't anymore, we finished all the seafood / meat and left the pasta to avoid wasting food.When the bill came, we asked why we were charged for the larger size and found out that the order was wrong. People (including ourselves) make mistakes and misunderstandings happen- we completely understand. We eventually got our bill rectified (so kudos on that).What made our blood boil was that the server was mumbling loudly at the other side of the restaurant about how we wouldn't have ordered small to share. Worse still, he was mumbling (in Cantonese) "IF YOU DON'T HAVE MONEY THEN DON'T EAT HERE".Are you serious??? We do NOT appreciate being INSULTED. Food is mediocre and with servers like that? There's really NO reason why you should visit this restaurant. Opus, I really wanted to like you but no, never again.

Author: David W
Title: Impressive!
Review: We ate here for as a fmaily of and enjoyed our meal. We had wide variety of food and shared everything. I've read that there is problems with service here but we had very good service although it wasnt that busy. They have a huge choice of beers which is unusual for Borneo. We had the 1kg Burger, Sausage Platter, Pasta and the Meat Platter all of which i'd reccommend. The Nacho's however were awful and i'd be embarressed to serve them. They were also served with our deserts.Overall this is a great western bar that has good food and a huge choice of beers. They also show live sporting events on their large screen outside.

Author: liyana1987
Title: Delicious local food
Review: Tried their fried mee hoon. It was delicious. I always order their lemongrass tea which is good also. They used to have ikan bakar but now their menu is rather limited. Staff and boss were very nice.

Author: FlyDineWineSydney, Australia
Title: Not fine dining
Review: Overall: this was a disappointing and pretty dismal dining experience and feel the restaurant is quite deceitful in its overall web presence. Would advise any future guests and travellers to avoid!What we ordered: 358 RM 9 course 'surprise' chefs tasting menu + non alcoholic drinks pairingService: Overall the servers were nice, but not very professional. They understood very little about the food they were serving. The server we had, omitted certain items on our plate and when probed further about them would only be able to tell whether they are edible or not (not whether they were part of the taste of the dish). So overall, very rehearsed and robotic service... didn't feel natural, was definitely not happy about the automatic 10% service charge on the meal!Food: Overall the food quality was poor and not worth the money. The flavours were boring and we had some flavours repeat over a few courses, which u don't expect when offered a chefs supposed 'surprise' tasting menu. The food was hardly fit for fine dining with very rudimentary presentation, on one course we had to half deshell a prawn, which is not expected when fine dining.Drink: the drinks which were paired with didn't really match the flavours in our food. They all tasted the same with a lot of them tasting of varied fruits mixed through sprite. They were also not introduced in detail by our server..Portion size: The portions were also very tight...my girlfriend wasn't even full after 9 courses. Some courses were embarrassingly small.Ambience & setting: The view off the external balcony is a slight redeeming feature of this venue. But there is overall a lack of attention to detail by the staff in the dining atmosphere. We heard utensils being washed behind the open bar, the reception mobile going off often & loudly. The bathroom was also unfit for a fine dining venue in terms of decor and the soap dispenser hadn't even been filled. The background music in the dining room was a loop of Christmas carols quite noisy, noticeable and maddening.

Author: Charmaine W
Title: Nothing Special
Review: For me it's nothing special. The place is crowded with tourists and be prepared to queue up for the table during peak time like lunch hour.

Author: Garfield60Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: It is very disappointing for so long have been to the establishment and the staff is the major problem with their attitude and expect customer to make complaints on the management but rather it’s the staff that has an issue. The management and food has always been top class it’s the staff that has the attitude issue. Food quality is always good but this time around staff attitude needs to change.

Author: vman63Mumbai, India
Title: 4.5 stars actually. Worth a visit. Great value.
Review: Wanted an authentic (reasonable) Malay meal on the last day of my trip and had read about this place so found it at Suria KLCC. I sat in the cafe section outside the main restaurant so I am guessing the menu was a lot smaller and limited since all of the dishes were prepared in that small space. So prob all pre-ready food that just had to be heated if at all.I ordered a beef rendang that I was craving and for 19MR you got a healthy portion with a soup and a drink. Well worth it. One of the best I have had. Highly recommend Madam Kwan's for a quick intro to Malay food. If you have time for a leisurely meal then head into the main restaurant which is next door.

Author: Alvin NKuching, Malaysia
Title: Mediterranean delight in the heart of Kuching
Review: Tucked away in a corner pre-war shophouse and easily missed if one is not observant is this Spanish inspired Mediterranean restaurant bar. But step onto the wooden patio and you are welcomed by friendly attendants one of whom might well be James, the owner himself. Service is friendly and personal. Menu is refreshing by Kuching's standards given the lack of Spanish tapas restaurants in town (the other outlet is Pincho Loco by the same owners/management.)Had the seafood soup, foie gras, mussel and bacon stew and topped off with a sampler cheese board with a flat white. 'A' ratings for all of them. A great cozy place to hang out at the end of the day with friends.

Author: SatishD236
Title: Rude owner
Review: I'm a regular customer for the shop. Recently the customer service is very bad. I have requested the owner to calculate all my family meals at table because a few of them was still queing. The owner have raised the voice to me and said 'PAY NOW'. This is very rude behaviour to a customer. I have not got back my balance untill i have to go back to the counter to ask again.i will not go back to the shop anymore!!!!

Author: Rosie6529Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Prime Indeed
Review: It is located in the Le Meridien Hotel KL. Service was good and the meat dishes were cooked to perfection. The choice of dessert was great too. A good place for romantics and candle light dinner. For business people on the run, they have a good choice of lunch specials

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: New menu is underwhelming
Review: I have been to Ante many times before and have always been impressed with the food. However, on this visit, they had a new menu. So I tried the ribs. It was coated with a new spicy sauce. The sauce was so-so. Unfortunately, the meat itself was not tender and very difficult to get off the bone. The previous ribs with the BBQ sauce was cooked until the sauce soaked into the meat and fell off the bone. This was definitely not as good. The others had the pork burger - ok albeit a smaller size, and pork ribeye- quite tender meat, but very slightly undercooked. The pork belly starter was still ok. Overall, a disappointing meal, compared to previously. If it doesn’t improve, not sure will be back.

Author: yemz M
Title: Among the best
Review: Lamb Maghdut very good..the rice itself very tasty u can eat it owns it own..Only service need to improve..

Author: Moon_hmz
Title: Alright
Review: Had a satay nasi goreng and also asam pedas. The food tasted salty to me, but my husband said it was ok. He liked the asam pedas, said it had a nice texture.

Author: Jolyn84
Title: Never again!
Review: Bad service and food is so so only. Dirty cutleries, wet glasses, stained glasses with lipstick. Service was really bad. We need to call a few times before somebody actually serves us. The server gives no interaction, basically like a robot. Multiple server came to us with the wrong order, they are unaware of which table order which food. Very very bad service quality. Cannot believe this in such a beautiful place. We came in happily and left with frustration. Pastas is too watery, taste bad. The mushroom soup is worst, it is too watery and never had I tasted such a bad mushroom soup. Do not order this! After food is served, the cutleries were not given until we keep requesting for it. I will never ever come here again!

Author: Hemant M
Title: decent
Review: it has nice ambience and good view. close to bird park. food is good and prices are also reasonable and place is cozy.

Author: Edward D
Title: Poor food quality & cooking
Review: It is an expensive restaurant with beautiful view. But the food quality do not tally with the prices charged. It is a total disappointment for me and my foreign guest and wife. What a turn down and feeling waste of money spent.

Author: Romuluz75Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Birthday Buffet dinner at the Grand Millennium
Review: We celebrated my birthday at The Mill Cafe at the Grand Millennium Hotel in the Bukit Bintang area in central KL city, and is strategically located just a stone’s throw from the Pavilion KL luxury mall, and across the road from the Fahrenheit shopping mall and 5 mins walk from Lot 10 mall. Booked the slots at a discount from an online reservation portal which makes it a very good deal. Rack rates are RM168++.There is a good spread of western, asian, japanese cuisine. The course starts at 7.00pm sharp and you are not allowed to enter the restaurant until then.Highlights are the roast beef and roast lamb.The only drinks served are tea & coffee with heated fresh milk (a nice touch), and cold water. No juices are served as part of the buffet.Desert consists of various cakes, pastries, Malaysian kuih and ice cream.Service was generally okay however the clearing of used plates took much longer than expected.The hotel and restaurant is well maintained however the interior shows sign of aging and in need of an upgrade.

Author: Tom WKuala Lumpur
Title: Decent food, poor service
Review: Decent food at the Bistro but very poor service. We were a party of 11 and 6 of us were told our selected meal was not available that day. The waiters should advise patrons in advance if dishes are unavailable rather than wait for them to consider, choose and order. Worse still 5 were not advised until about 10 minutes after ordering so that meant some were finishing their meal before others had even been served. One was served something he hadn't ordered but ate it anyway as he was so hungry and everyone else was finishing. Our complaint did not receive an apology so I won't be returning. Also they are misrepresenting the size of their drinks. The advertised "pint" is only 400 ml whereas as a true pint is 568 ml (UK) or 473 ml (US).

Author: paulandc0Sintra, Portugal
Title: Great place for dinner.
Review: I had been afraid to go there after poor experiences in similar places in KL. But it turned out service was good, food exquisite and the atmosphere was nice. The restaurant was full from start to finish but it never got noisy. A bit on the expensive side, but then no more than some of its competitors.

Author: Cromps_from_PerthPerth Hills, Australia
Title: Great Place to Watch the Sunset !
Review: This is a great place to watch the Sunset with a beer or cocktail. If you get a pint of beer they will put it in a ice jug for you to keep it cool which was a great idea! There is plenty to choose from on the menu and the prices aren't too bad. Once again the staff are great & service is quick and friendly.A must on the beach!

Author: boskiIsland of Malta, Malta
Title: LOTS OF CHANGES HAPPENING HERE
Review: On previous visits we have enjoyed many nights eating and drinking here however there have been some changes.Prices have gone up and some items have been removed from the menu which is a shame- the place is always very busy and the staff do a terrific job running all night to try to get a good standard of service to everyone. There has been a lot of staff changes which is obvious as well and there are always several people standing around “managing” as opposed to getting in thereWe did eat here a few times more for old times sake than not- one dinner was very good one was not – perhaps consistency has been lost with all the changes

Author: HibiscusRedWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Sushi Zanmai One Utama
Review: Food was good but service absolutely one of the worst I've experienced. The staff didn't seemed too concerned with getting our orders when we sat down. We had to ask if we could order after waiting for more than 20 mins. The dishes came to our table one dish at a time. It took over half an hour for my chicken teriyaki to arrive after my garlic rice and by then my rice was cold! The whole event was just frustrating. The manager didn't seem to careless about my complaint. Well! You can rest assure that it would be the first and last time I ever go there again!!!Please do not eat there if you want a pleasant meal that arrive promptly and at mostly the same time!

Author: JessieS1365
Title: Great experience!
Review: Fantastic food. I’m extremely pleased with the excellent services. Great environment for a quiet yet warmth date with the loved one.

Author: Armin P
Title: Very nice
Review:
Definitely one of the nicer restaurants in Georgetown, in Little India in particular. 

Good service 
Good food
Reasonable prices 
Good (modern, tasteful) atmosphere 

I can truly recommend it.

Author: CK G
Title: Crappy food!
Review: Ordered shrimp scampi pasta and never tasted anything worse than this. Ribs are overcooked and portion of side dishes shrink significantly. No reason to comebhere really

Author: EnjoystravellingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High prices did not correlate to tasty food
Review: I went in expecting to get a tasty dinner time. Shake Sashimi was good though only 3 pieces (though big). Chicken Teppan (my must have and I ordered 2 portions) was small and relatively not tasty. Wagyu beef should have been seasoned better. Had Gintara Teriyaki and Unagi which turned out just ok. Though I did not try Chawan Mushi but those who ate them had no complaints. Several other dishes that we had was nothing to shout about.Service - good. However, to me Sashimi and Temakis should come out first, not my main dishes which included rice.2nd time there. 1st time felt better.Overall - pricey and left feeling not satisfied. Sorry guys.

Author: SanfordCheeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Deliciously herbal salted chicken better than Nga Choy Gai
Review: I prefer Aun Kheng Lim's salt baked chicken to the plainer steamed chicken that is more famous in Ipoh. This is definitely tastier than the slapdash ayam tauge one gets at Lou Wang (a once famous institution now sadly past its prime after the original owners sold out).What's great about it is the tastier chicken, slightly salty but with wonderful herbal notes. It's deliciously flavourful. They only do takeaways and it costs RM21 per whole chicken which can be finished off easily by 2 pax. One of my best discoveries in Ipoh this trip.

Author: BenPua
Title: Excelent place for 'Mee Kolok'
Review: Mostly a breakfast coffee shop, Kim Joo is famous for its 'Kolok Mee' you can have it 'dry'or 'wet' try the wanton too  their great .

Author: gayathreei
Title: Finger licking Japanese fusion
Review: We absolutely enjoyed everything we were offered. Definitely a worthy visit when in Mytown Mall. But be prepared for slightly slow service. Food is definitely worth it. No milk  alternative on offer.

Author: SiuLiu
Title: Too touristic nowadays
Review: Not what used to be. The street is becoming very touristic but I guess it worth the visit if you ant to try local food in the city centre

Author: iloveperthMalaysia
Title: Not so great!
Review: Heard quite a bit about this cafe so decided to have dinner there a couple of weeks ago. However, was greatly disappointed with the food and attitude of the owner. He was seated in front of us, was fully aware about our displeasure but, was too arrogant to acknowledge our unhappiness. We have ordered steak, the steak was over done and dry, the cut was too thin. Soup was cold and garlic bread was horrible. Definitely not going back, couldn't feel the warmth and comfort of this cafe. Thumbs down!!!

Author: SWShanC
Title: Overrated
Review: Overrated. I enjoyed the cincalok omelette, kids liked the fish ball soup. But the rice balls are too soggy and the sotong petai is disappointing...

Author: cryptofreakSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and place to chill
Review: My friend and I managed to get a table at level 2 which was more quaint and relaxing. Kudos to the effort put into decoration and unique dishes. Brunch options were more of an australian fare, which were both hearty and healthy. The coffee was great too. Would definitely visit again when I am in JB.

Author: clairek0k
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: Highly recommended. Very good soup base for steamboat. Love the ambience and the classic Chinese songs. Reasonable priced.

Author: tnchingColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Great views, food choices were limited
Review: The views were spectacular. The revolving floor was amazing and we enjoyed the view the entire 1.5 hours we spend here. However in terms of food, the spread was limited and would have been better if there was a bit more to choose from. The taste was good. However the rip off is the photography where they charge an exorbitant amount which i felt is ridiculous after paying a hefty amount for the food.

Author: 77nathanr
Title: Underwhelming
Review: The oysters didn’t taste fresh, and I tried 4 different types. The avocados were not ripe in the baked avocado dish. We had planned to go for dinner but stopped after those two dishes and went elsewhere.

Author: OSWALDHII
Title: Excapade Sushi
Review: For those Japanese food lover,you may visit this restaurant at Tanjong Lobang,Miri. The word "Excapade"from term Escapade,definitely described the best sushi and Nimono menu ie.simmered dish in Japanese cuisine.All fresh and tasty.

Author: peggy_teo
Title: Nothing too special
Review: I've been to this restaurant a few times previously and I felt that the taste seems getting not as good as compared to the previous times I had. And we have to queue for it.

Author: Rona NLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Won't ever comeback
Review: It was actually last year but I think it a must to share my experience . We thought it's authentic Korean food but I saw there is Thai food and Malay food . A little bit confused because all the dishes we ordered slightly same taste and all ingredients slightly same , we didn't know actually what we ate . Pricey compared to what they served .Won't ever come back again .

Author: Shirley F
Title: A cafe to try out!!
Review: Great ambience with amazing food :) Shout out to the staff members that are friendly and helpful! Try it out yourself!

Author: idahoangoneglobalSandpoint, Idaho
Title: Awesome experience!
Review: The service was great, they even put a citronella candle under the table to keep away mosquitos! The food was really good and beautifully presented. Considering the quality of the service, food, and setting, I thought it was really affordable. Great for couples on vacation, and still awesome for backpackers like me!

Author: Poje MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: from just OK to terrible...
Review: Been a few times over the last couple of years, and it was ok, nothing so special but ok.Now we returned to be shocked by the horrible quality of the food.I love lasagna, and here now, it is probably the worst i have had anywhere.at first it looked terrible, Zero on presentation, dry like a shoe, no cream, no sauce, tasted bad, not fresh. nothing about it was nice, zero zero. Worthless. It is very clear that standards are dropping fast......we will not return. Very expensive for what you'll get. In fact i found the photo of the Lasagna in had in 2016, and now in 2017. Spot the Difference?I will not return in 2018, too afraid of what we'll get...If the owners do not care, that's what happens. Here it's clear.

Author: selvarajuanandChennai (Madras), India
Title: Amazing Ambience - Horrible food and Service
Review: This Restaurant has some excellent interiors showing are culture, Heritage and arts.Looks like they have lots of branches across the world and restaurant is located in a Good building with ample parking and near public commute easily accessible.Now let me share my experience in his dinning.When I entered the restaurant there was no in the entrance to welcome so I walked in straight and then waiter jumped in front of me and said you cannot step in to our restaurant like this and brought me back to the main entrance and asked me to be seated.First of all if you are so particular about discipline you should be there in the entrance waiting and welcome the guest and let them know your embassy protocol.After few minutes of deliberation with the managers he requested me to take the table.After that I ordered the food. The rest of the waiters and the managers were hospitable.In mean time I was waiting for the food.....I observed that the same welcome experience happened to other guests who arrived later as well.Food came and I was not able to finish any of the items which I ordered.This a north India restaurant I pretty much ordered most familiar north Indian food kebab, roti and chicken gravy. All the food didn't have any taste in it and the bill was super expensive.I was little disappointed.If any of the managers walked around and tried the food in the neighboring restaurantsthey will work on improving the quality of food.For this place is waste of time and money.

Author: GreenCollectionIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good quality of food
Review: We went for early lunch , the environment was so calm and peace. They maintain high level of hygiene. Keep it up. The only dissapointing news is the lady who serve the food is not polite either welcoming. Body language of her was not nice. Improve your customer service. Overall it was just pleasant. The price is a little expensive as for normal chicken rice set with a cup of coffee cost you RM14.....!

Author: Peter MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Second time still no happy
Review: New to KL my wife and I have visited this restaurant twice. First time, the service... the waiter struggled to pronounce English. Ok, he’s not English but I’d have chosen better communication skills if I was the owner. Oh and no smile at all. From beginning to end. The Lamb shank.... over cooked and the mash potato was so incredibly lumpy to a point where it reminded me of school dinner mash. Service wasn’t slow and nor was the food arrival. Then again it was empty. What the service did do however was leave you feel like you didn’t matter. Second visit...by accident when the other Italian above which is far superior in every way didn’t do pizza. We ventured to Porto Romano. Service was still cold and unhappy looking. We saw ourselves to the table after we were noticed only after walking in then half way to the table the waiter was distracted by a bar conversation with colleagues. Once again, no smile. Gosh how hard is it to train staff to make you feel welcome????The pizza...Peperoni. Bland and disappointing. The coffe is good but not in time with modern health conscious people like us. No Low fat milk. So I’m summary. I certainly won’t be frequenting this establishment again.

Author: GourmandBC
Title: Mediocrity confirmed!
Review: The nasi lemak was okay, but when you cannot execute a decent teh tarik for which you charge a hefty premium for, then you loose my loyalty. Haven't been back here for ages, but I had better memories the last visit.

Author: Shirliebaby
Title: Review
Review: Medium rare Japanese Wagyu is nice and tender, service is fine, it just the vanilla ice cream is a bit too sweet

Author: Feipat
Title: Classic yet simple dishes executed perfectly
Review: I ordered the tomahawk medium and it was cooked perfectly. Nice juicy well cooked to the done-ness I asked for. Some restaurants tend to over complicate the dishes where they completely forget about the main ingredient of the dish but not for this place. Classic combinations of proteins to condiments to sauces. I worked in fine dining restaurants to know this. All in all service was very good as well and the ambience of the place. Good way to end the night in KL.

Author: Vanisvivienna23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprise Meal
Review: I had my dinner regularly here ,and it happen we found out that Eatigo is offering 50% discount due to Malaysia Day so we decide to enjoy this special discount with my family end up really disappointed me as it seems like not as usual what have been serve previously almost half of the menu been remove example there use to serve lobster hand palm size but now is finger size,alot of dishes not available even dessert , although is 50%but is still not worthy ,I feel like the privilege is not given genuinely as the meal we had is so terrible as in the freshness and taste ,oh ya and I had try their bobo cha cha surprising it tasteless and so watery and it shouldn't happen in 5⭐hotel.Definitely this would be my last visit

Author: jornp2014Ao Nang, Thailand
Title: Not worth it
Review: Just finished dinner at Thirty8 at the Hyatt hotel in KL. Firstly we must understand that this is one of the most expensive restaurants in Malaysia. Placed the food order. The waiter came back after a few minutes and informed that the starter I picked was not available. It is expected that a waiter in a 5 star establishment knows this up front. Not many customers, so service should be extra top notch. Worst one: The main course was served before I finished the appetizer. This happens frequently in Malaysia, but usually at places with 20% of the cost of this one. The sauce for my steak was wrong in spite of me repeating my order twice. I complained and the correct sauce arrived around 1 minute later. Lukewarm. This suggests it was precooked. When I order a rm180 steak I think I am right to expect the ingredients are freshly cooked. Avoid this place. They don't have their act together. I recommend the hotel management to actually have dinner there and check what is happening.

Author: nurtira
Title: Pricey for the quality
Review:
Not sure why people love this restaurant. The only pros is the services and comfy

the food is average. i will not come here again (unless if it is someone's treat)

Author: giiii1
Title: Good Schawarma for good prove
Review: Had the sharwarma falafel Sandwich Menü regular for 10rm (around 2.20€). Could be a Little Bit more, but it was hot and tasty for a good Price.

Author: Gail BMonmouth Beach, New Jersey
Title: Average food
Review: Disappointing pork dishes, dried out and tasteless. Service is poor too, they just throw the food at you, no style or care.

Author: Sushsi
Title: Love the duck dishes
Review: One of my favorite places if I fancy eating duck. The Tim sum is not bad either.

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Exquisite, expensive experience.
Review: Exquisite, expensive experience. Worth trying at least once when in KL. They serve fine dining menu at a higher level.

Author: pokorino
Title: One of the best Japanese Restaurants
Review:
Superb food, variety of choice, great service and nice Japanese ambiance.
Meals are served relatively quickly.

Author: FlslingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It was ok..
Review: Went there on a weekday lunch to celebrate my husband birthday. Place was crowded and was made to wait for a few moment before being ushered to a table. Food took some time to arrive and I feel the kitchen could have done a better job at it. Nevertheless Saiful was very helpful and attentive.

Author: Shane118118
Title: Very Very Very Poor - Avoid If Possible
Review: We went here on our last night of our honeymoon thinking that this experience would be amazing. Sadly we regret even going to this place. The ONLY good thing about this place is the view and the revolving restaurant concept itself. As a tourist your inclined to go and check it out for yourself despite what others may say. However I write this review with honesty and warn any future tourists to re-think their plans if they are thinking of checking this place out and dining in it as the service and food is of very poor standard and the prices are ridiculous. It doesn't matter if you complain at the time the manager will still insist you pay the full price and wont let you leave until you have done. BE WARNED THIS IS NOT A PLACE OF LUXURY OR SOMEWHERE YOU WILL GET ANY DECENT FOOD. If you do decide to go then GOOD LUCK!!We went to this place and right from the start we had hints that this was going to be rubbish but because we was tourists we thought we would carry on and make the most of it. How wrong we were to do so. We arrived in a taxi to the place and there was no one to meet us at the door. We initially thought we was in the wrong place as the environment of the entrance was like an entrance to a 2* hotel. We made our way up the escalators and eventually found the direction to the atmosphere 360 desk. After confirming our table booking we were guided to the security clearance and sent up the lifts to the wrong floor. After realising for ourselves that we was on the wrong floor we made our own way back down the lifts to the right floor. As we entered the restaurant the atmosphere was very gloomy and there did not appear to be any spark of luxury or ambiance. The staff showed us to our seats and told us that the food was buffet style and pointed to the area where we could help ourselves. The views were stunning and the platform itself revolves so you get to see the whole city. This part is good but the rest of it spoils the mood. If its the views you want then I suggest you go to the Traders Hotel pool bar on top floor or the Petronas Towers...its a lot cheaper and nicer. The waiter came to our table with an Ipad and did not even bother explaining what drinks were available. He handed us an Ipad and we had to click each tab and enlarge the screen with our own fingers to actually see the drinks menu. I am very capable of using technical gadgets but this experience was time consuming and somewhat annoying to use. Again there was so many reasons to leave at this point but the tourist inside us thought forget it carry on....We went up to get our food and ALL the dishes were cold and half the dishes were empty. Kitchen staff were seen to be standing around watching us move from dish to dish and they did not even attempt to re-stock the plates that were empty. In frustration we had to tell kitchen staff to get certain dishes. Reluctantly they did and when they did come back with the food almost 2-3 mins later, the food was still cold on border of warm. The food was badly labelled and you had to guess what some of the items were. Shockingly not even some of the chefs knew what some of the dishes were and their excuse was because they never worked on that part of the kitchen. What a joke! Again this should of been the point at which we should of left but we thought no forget it carry on...After attempting to eat the cold food I can honestly say that there was not much flavour. There are lots of restaurants in KL and even the low budget ones taste far more better than this place. After all this we still continued and by this point our mood had been shattered and all we wanted to do was finish our drinks and get out of the restaurant. After leaving most of our mains we went over to the desert counter and asked the chef what some of the items were made out of and again shockingly they didnt have a clue. They couldnt tell me an honest answer if they had nuts, eggs or any beef extracts in it...they just guessed what we wanted to hear. Complete waste of time. This was the breaking point for me and after that I had to call to see the manager.The manager Kamal introduced himself to us and I explained the situation to him. All he could say was that he apologised but very insistent that we paid the full price. In his opinion one customers view is not as important as that of a collective group of 10 different people for example. After completing the feedback form and eventually having to pay an extortionate amount of money we left. Even the taxi services at the front try to rip you off...I suggest you walk to the main road and flag a taxi down and pay by the meter. Overall the experience was very frustrating and the management of the restaurant do nothing to help you. All they are interested in is your money as soon as you step into the place. I would strongly urge you to stay away from this place and try the other places out for the views. I am now waiting for the apology letter from the restaurant and an explanation from the senior management team. This is by no means a luxury restaurant I would rate this place 2* and thats only because of the view. Anyway the choice is yours if you go or not but please be careful if you have food allergies or are particular about what you eat. Also if you are happy to pay high price for 2* service then go for it...if not then think again.

Author: Evelyn K
Title: Great Ambience
Review: Mews is a great place to refresh and rejunavate quiet and cozy ambience. Staff friendly and accommodating.  On Sat evening listen to live music. Menu is something with modern twist creation.

Author: EliiiADBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Super Delicious food, but lack of customer service
Review: The food was super delicious without any doubt and I love to try it again once I go back to Melaka! The owner was very welcoming person.But we have been waiting for one hour in a queue to enter the restaurant. After one hour we entered the restaurant and ordered our food, but we had to re-order after 30 minutes, because the waiter forgot what we ordered. Customer service needs to be improved there not food for sure.

Author: Honigtau
Title: Really amazing matcha lava cake
Review: I had amazing food and I can really recommend this place even it is really expensive. But also to say it is really loud, because most of the people don’t use headphones and the cafe is super open space. But really good food.

Author: KiwiJonnyHaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Started brilliantly, with a disappointed end
Review: Ordered: 1) Truffle Fries; 2) The Linguist; 3) Magical Shrooms; and 4) Forest Mushroom Soup.Everything was good. Loved the service, the ambience, the food. Quick to come to the table, tasted great.We were talking about how we'll help by writing reviews because it's a new place.Then halfway through the meal... Something crawled to my seat. A cockroach (see pic). A supposedly 5 star rating just dropped drastically.We'd definitely need to think twice about the place now, because no matter how it looks, how brilliant the services are, or how good the food tasted... Presence of a roach only means that the kitchen is filthy.I don't know... Really having mixed feelings about this.

Author: Eleonory
Title: Nice but not asian
Review:
We had the expectation to go eating in a fusion restaurant, but here food is not fusion: you can eat a good burger or fish and chips, but you'll not find Adriatic food.
The atmosphere is nice and the staff is particularly kind.

Author: azrilein
Title: Will come back..definitely
Review: We visited this small cafe based on the review on Tripadvisor and it did not dissapoint us. Fantastic food and great service. I really enjoy the good coffee and cakes were fresh and tasty. We would definitely recommend and will come back.

Author: BrouBrouette
Title: Excellent dinner
Review:
Atik was great with the kids.  
Good food, especially the calzone. We had a very nice and warm service, very kind, patient and attentionate with kids.

Author: mrbbangMalaysia
Title: No food after 11pm
Review: Arrived at 11pm were told no food to serve as the kitchen is closed. What HRC is this? Is this even legit HRC or just some franchise using the name only? 11pm on Friday night no food? No wonder it isn't crowded in a HARD ROCK Cafe!

Author: MaureenO608
Title: Someone recommended this
Review: Someone recommended this place, I had a few hours to kill in the island, look on tripadvisor and the opening hours and it was stated 10am on a Saturday morning. 7 of us arrived at 1037am after a long walk with 4 children, we were told they open at 11am. I asked if we could sit down and wait for 30 mins inside since tripadvisor lead us there with the faulty opening time and the children were tired from walking. A lady at the door reluctantly agreed, 15 mins later a guy in glasses arrived, walked straight to out table trying to wipe it rudely, I felt I been asked to go.I asked him do you want us to leave? He said is up to you go if you want to because you forced yourself in! I explain that the tripadvisor bit he said well they can published what they like is not within our control they open at 11am.With an attitude larger than life, he chased four 7 years old children out along with 3 adult and showcase to the young children there’s no compassion and courtesy in this world. I think this is ‘preposterous. My 7 years old walked out and asked and I think she send the ship back to shore ‘ are Penang people all this rude!’

Author: carine3366Singapore, Singapore
Title: Durian lover Must try it
Review: The weather was very hot, this is the best time to had this durian puff. 1 pcs is RM$2.20, 6pcs will be cheaper.You really need to eat the whole thing at one go else the durian cream will flow out. Recommend durian lover to try it.

Author: Surayarabs
Title: Lunch buffet
Review: Service was a bit slow but food was excellent. Can improve on the service and communication between workers. Overall satisfied

Author: Anthony P
Title: Poor value and service
Review: We had been looking forward to our last night in KL by celebrating with a visit to this Thai restaurant in KLCC on a Saturday. We ordered the sweet and sour grouper and Tom yam soup recommended by the waiter together with vegetables and rice.There were no Thai waiters unlike that you invariably always get served in a UK restaurant. We expected the courses to be served separately but all the dishes arrived at the same time. There was no heater or burner as you get in most restaurants which meant by the time we got to the fish main course, the food was disappointingly Luke warm. The texture of the fish was not crisp, and was not fresh. The soup was no different in that the sea food including the prawns were soft and inedible. Considering the whole bill with bottle of beer and one soft drink came to RM250, this meal was way overpriced for KL standards. (Having eaten at 'Fatty Crabs' in SS17 for roughly the same price with a group of six). Our waiter abandoned us after taking our order and we did not see him again. The only service visit was by another waiter to inform us mid-way through the meal the kitchen was closing @ 9.30pm which made us rush our meal. In summary, having visited other reasonably priced restaurants in KL, for example Rama V, we will not be returning to this overpriced, and poorly run restaurant ever again.

Author: flyng84Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Unsatisfied!
Review: Disappointed because of the food, it is way too bad.1. For coffee lover, maybe coffee selection is not really a good choice at Chili's so maybe something else is more safer.2. Soup of the day - Chicken & Mushroom soup: It is way too thick, which doesn't look like a soup and it is very salty!3. BBQ Beef Ribs - Partially too dry and harden to chew.4. Southwestern Quesadillas - Still eatable.5. Grilled Chicken, Grilled Beef & Grilled Lamb - Still eatable, and the onion is really good. It is really unsatisfied spent this much of money but had a below average meals, we definitely won't go back again!

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Rice dumbling for lunch
Review: I came here twice for a small midday snack. The rice rumblings are their speciality and taste quite original. If you're passing by and would like to have a quick snack this will be your place

Author: Lim W
Title: Sucks food
Review: The taste of the famous steam octopus is so so. We ordered a small hokkien mee and the portion is relatively small compare to the standard portion. The taste is sucks coz smell like burnt and found many little tiny black dust (from the wok) in the noodles. We told the person in charge but he wasn't apologize, only offered us a new plate of noodles.

Author: Ben LKuching, Malaysia
Title: best sandwiches in kuching
Review: This cafe serves the best bread in kuching, real bagettes, ciabatta, bagels, english scones and muffins. Proper bread, not sweet! My personal favourite is the smoked salmon & cream cheese bagette.They also serve a range of delicious local food, with the emphasis on being healthy.I recomend this place to anybody for breakfast or lunchGive it a try

Author: Josham93
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: The food was really delicious.. Their mushroom soup is a must to try. Their staff Ms Christy and Ain were very polite and full of smiles. The restaurant manager Mr Reuban was polite and very friendly. The did simple decoration for our table but ni charges apllied for it. This is a good place to celebrate. Thank you.

Author: 529evecKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love the curry and nan
Review: Actually I don’t know about indian food.. but I love this restaurant food.. especially shrimp curry nice with the nan.. only thing I am not used to eat the white rice with my kids.. if got other type of white(normal) rice then will be perfect! But overall good, service Good.

Author: kittenzero
Title: Nothing special
Review: The food was very disappointing. Bland flavours. I was expecting more because of the other reviews. .

Author: Thaniawidy
Title: Good Service
Review: Im glad to spend my nights in this hotel. Everything so far so good. Maybe give more variant for breakfast. I will stay here again if i come back again to malaysia. Good job.

Author: KarenS3604
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Authentic French cuisine. Food taste delicious with normal portion. However price is on the high side.

Author: KanjiKJS
Title: Very average tomyam
Review: Claims the tomyam to be really spicy but it was not. I've had better tomyam at roadside stall, with cheaper price. If you want tasty tomyam, try the one at level 4 food court. Nothing special, just pricey. Won't bother to come here again.

Author: Melvin S
Title: Fries or mashed potatoes
Review: I was here on 3.12.14@9.15pm with my family.I ordered a pork meal which came with French fries.I asked for the fries to be substituted with mashed potatoes but the staff said it is company policy that you can't change the fries.I said that was utter nonsense.Asked to speak to manager but staff said manager said can't change.Then a few minutes later,staff said manager not around!I guess a restaurant like this just lacks that basic customer service!Just spoilt my dinner!Did not order.

Author: wiriany w
Title: Super disappointed with the service
Review: its always my must visit restaurant whenever I go to jb. Last week when there to take away the chicken and was told to come back in 1 hr. After 1 hr, the lady boss said the same thing to us. When we informed her that the staff said the same thing to us an hour before, she just said that they ran out of chicken and need to make reservation next time. I hope they will improve their service despite their good business

Author: smurfgal02Melbourne, Australia
Title: Rude staff at dining area
Review: I wanted to dIne there and was greeted with a rude staff at the dining area. He was discriminating me as a solo female traveller .I blatantly told him that I just wanted to dIne there and I liked the place . He told me the place was full despite many empty tables.I was turned away without any apology and I felt discriminated as a local malaysian.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: gunaselanv
Title: An ok place only...
Review: Its an ok place but no real variety or real dim sum flavours to the food . The price is average not to cheap or expensive. Custard bun was nice but the rest of the 5 dishes below an average dim sum place . But i guess in the middle of the city its hard to get that sort of dim sum tasting place . Service was not the best and we had to walk and look for a waiter to pass our orders . The gents were better and more attentive to our requeat than the ladies.

Author: sybariteAylmerGatineau, Canada
Title: The waffle ice cream crowns the meal
Review: This restaurant took over the Rakuzen location but kept their quality and variety of Japanese food. Any combination of sushi, sashimi, soup, salad, cooked or raw food is always a palate celebration. On of the raw fish was a little bit chewy but besides that point everything was excellent.

Author: MaxTNPKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gone Backwards
Review: Came with a table of 10 and had dinner here over the weekend.Ordered approximately 8 dishes and sad to say, the taste of food have gone bad. I personally have been a regular over the 4-5 years and another on the table have been a regular customer for close to 30 years. Claypot chicken and sour soup was particularly disappointing as they just taste totally different. Tasted totally watered down.Everyone on the table including grand pa and grand ma who have eaten here even longer than all of us, were all disappointed by the food served. The floor manager and waiters and waitresses have all changed as well. Perhaps the owners have sold off the business? To pay 40-50 per person on average for all past visits over the years, we are greatly disappointed that the restaurant have chose to go down the road of average food. One thing for sure, we will not return to this Fong Lye branch.

Author: dom2409Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Replacement Lodge that needs to Replace its staff.
Review: I like to consider myself a pretty easy going, amiable fella but this morning's experience at this seemingly cute little café in Johor Bahru's Heritage Walk area just pushed me over the brink. I arrived at about 9.55 am to be greeted by 3 staff members who told me that the café was not officially open until 10am but I could take a seat and wait. So I thanked them and wandered into the second seating area with the intention of setting up by the window close to a power source. I took up a 4-seater table by the window, powered up my Mac and logged into the free wifi. About 10 minutes later a young girl took my order of a cafe mocha and I started working. It has to be said that this 'hip n' trendy' cafe also has hip and trendy prices. (aka as expensive for Malaysia) My 11 ringitt mocha arrived in a small cup with the usual 'hipster barista swirly milk decoration.' After a further 15 minutes another young girl asked me if I wouldn't mind moving to a 2-seater table as there were apparently a lot of people wanting to sit down. She said there's a 2-seater table on the other side. So I politely agreed and packed up my stuff and was beginning to move when the waitress told me to stay put until they'd prepared the table. After 10 minutes of further waiting I went through to the other side and asked the girl what had happened to the table? She said someone had taken it and there was no further space. I decided rather than hunt around for another space next to a power socket I'd just leave. The ineptitude of the staff and their inability to source another table or have the decency to tell me just totally blew my mind. I can accept everyone makes mistakes but for god's sake just 'communicate' clearly to your clients what you want them to do. I'm sorry to say but so many of these places are run by young, inexperienced kids who haven't got a clue what to do when there's the need for a 'think out of the box solution'. I've got no problem with trendy, cool cafés but please just use some initiative and sort out simple seating logistics - is it really that difficult? I hasten to say I won't be going back to this silly little place. It had so much promise but alas it's fallen well short of the mark.

Author: Mafia010
Title: Excellent service
Review: It's been a excellent service and beautiful place I ever seen and with helpful staff's and peaceful place. The restaurant food was delicious and the staff's very kind and friendly especially supervisor Michael. Will visit again this wonderful place for a peace of mind.

Author: inlovewithfood2016
Title: Service sucks!
Review: Service sucks and the staff ignored me when I asked for a fork! Rude! Cashier even stared back at me when we went to the counter to get spoon and fork(plastic somemore!) Not just once the staff ignored me but twice!

Author: markrabjohnsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food and Great Music
Review: We booked Bobo for my wifes birthday party. The food was good - I recommend tha Arancini Balls and the Salmon, and the staff were very helpful in taking careof our needs with a brought in brthday cake and wine. After dinner we went updtairs for the show, and the entertainment was wonderful - great band, great atmosphere and really good selection of songs to sing along with.I can recommend Bobo for a great night out.

Author: StefanB01Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Great location, and even better food!
Review: Another great 4 course meal. I have been many times and always look forward to coming back. Executive Chef Alan Wong and his team put on a fantastic meal, whether set menu (I like the surprise of not knowing what I am going to get and trying new things) or al la carte.The seafood is fresh and beef tender and cooked to perfection. The value for money for the food is exceptional. My clients and friends always leave very content after an evening at SkybarWine list is Ok/good, but as always in Malaysia a bit pricey and always tips the bill a bit over at the end. The Service is good and best in Johor.One of the best places to eat in Johor! You won't be disappointed. I'll be back again and again....

Author: skylee91
Title: First time here
Review: The food is special. We ordered the egg, chicken, belacan vege. All are delicious. You may refer the others' review. We just based on the review to order the dishes. The lime juice is very refreshing. Mamamiya~ ^^

Author: DavidF9994Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overly expensive hyped Indian fine dining in the heart of KL
Review: The new location of Flour is easy to get to and easy to park. The menu is beautifully presented as food intolerance's are well labelled, which is a plus. The ambiance within the restaurant is unusual for an Indian restaurant with a mixture of marble walls, gold toilets, a gold-plated unicorn in reception and pseudo French chic ornaments and the clientele is nearly exclusively Chinese. (no Indians).The food is disappointing to say the least. The chicken with mango starters were cold and the spices lacked sophistication. The mushrooms were not that great. The main courses of paneer curry tasted out of place and poorly constructed while the goat curry was fatty and could not be eaten. Alcohol is limited and very expensive with house wine starting at MYR190 (about 100% above supermarket price) and topping out at an eye watering MYR3,300 per bottle! We left very disappointed after spending MYR500 and unfortunately it was a "never again" moment. We discarded our take-away food (the vegetable dish arrived after we had finished) and put this one down to experience. You can't win them all, buyer beware.

Author: Meander09847351888
Title: Super
Review: Magnificent place to visit for dinner,shisha and having some fun time especially with that amazing stuff they have in th

Author: pamela cTaranaki Region, New Zealand
Title: First time ever
Review: We had visited the Geographers in Kuala Lumpa and enjoyed it and mistakenly thought we would have a similar experience in Malaca but sadly this was not so. The meal took ages to arrive despite the quiet period, the meals were served separately and I had finished mine ages before my husbands arrived and this was the very first time in my life that I refused to pay for a drink I was served. The supposedly fresh coconut water was served in the nut but it was very very watery and sour, when told this the chef simply shrugged and dismissed us. Will not be returning and sadly this experience deterred us from visiting other Geographer establishments on our travels

Author: Z5109TWcarolinacLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: The best Bruschetta is found in Penang
Review: My family and I have been staying at the Bayview Beach Resort when travelling to Penang for over 19 years now and Enca Cafe just across the road is one of our favourite spots!We love coming to Enca for both lunch and dinner and never realised that is a restaurant in Penang that actually makes the best Bruschetta in the world!The food is great and the variety of the menu will cater to everyone.The team working there are always wonderful and friendly and it’s great that they remember us each time even with 2 or 3 years between trips.If you’re in Penang you must make your way to Enca Cafe.

Author: orangegenie
Title: good drink spot
Review: Easy to stumble on this place if you're around Joker area.  Worth stopping for an evening drink and the foods pretty good too.

Author: themoses2
Title: Don't eat here
Review:
Terrible service!
Terrible food!
We ordered 3 meat large combo, duck,pork, chicken plus rice and veg not one dish was good. 
Do not eat here

Author: Global631723
Title: Horrible Dinner
Review: Ordered "fresh" carrot juice - given a stale carrot juiceOrdered boneless chicken - One chicken strip had a piece of hair on itOffered to order replacement and ordered lamb kebab - this was absolutely disgusting, cheap processed meat which must have been made up of mainly fat and very little clean meatDespite all of this I was given a bill with a gratuity added to itI would strongly warn people to not consider eating here. Restaurant was almost empty even though it was very busy outside on the street.

Author: King3030
Title: Clean and tasty lunch plus services
Review: Food is good. Great staff Mustafa,  Linda,  Azlina, teja, Mel, Kalpana, rohini and shahrol. We appreciate their service and friendliness.

Author: qsiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor service, poor food, too expensive
Review: We were looking for a nice dinner as we didn't want to do room service and saw Michelangelo's. It looked nice enough and the menu looked enticing. Unfortunately, the whole experience was terrible.First of all, service was terribly slow. Even just getting two glasses of wine and some mineral water took half an hour. On top of that the service was pretty bad as they managed to screw up every part of our order. For appetizers we ordered calamari and carpaccio; for the carpaccio we requested no balsamic but only olive oil. When the food finally came there was of course balsamic on the carpaccio and the calamari were completely overcooked having the consistency of chewing gum.For mains we had the spaghetti al oglio with prawns and the tenderloin steak. When the order came we had the slapstick experience of the waiter standing there with the two plates and nowhere to put them as they hadn't cleared our appetizer plates. When that was finally figured out (took a while too), we noticed that the spaghetti was missing the prawns we ordered and the steak was cooked well done instead of medium rare. A second glass of wine took forever to arrive. There were no napkins, no parmesan cheese for the spaghetti. A total screw-up in every sense.To top it all it was all horribly overpriced as well. Stay away from this horrible, horrible place. Absolutely not worth it.

Author: 137melaniey
Title: One of the great Jap dinner !
Review: The waiting time is longer than expected but we are satisfied with the foods and drinks esp the sashimi, sukiyaki, yuzu. Teppanyaki can be better though.

Author: UmarS28
Title: Horrible mexican
Review: The place was gorgeous but the food was bland and salty . And servers were foreigners philliphinos who were rude and have poor service . Price very expensive portion very small . Utter disappointment

Author: anu26india
Title: Can opt for a better place
Review: Recently visited Kuala lumpur.. Our local friends took us to one of the finest Indian restaurants where all Bollywood stars dine..but we were not satisfied with the quality of food.. Apart from the breads served which was excellent, the curries and biryani could not tantalise our taste buds..The environment is good but taste wise:(

Author: Choi Y
Title: Overated
Review: I was visiting this restaurant with high expectation. However was very much disappointed with the food quality based on the price and reviews given.Food tasted moderate. Service was moderate too as most staff are immigrants from neighboring countries hence communication is moderated but communicable. But given the recommendations as Japanese fine dining, i guess I m expecting more. I ordered a sukiyaki. The beef served was fresh but not top quality as claimed. Half way through the meal, to my horror I found myself chewing through a cooked plastic piece hiding in between the vegetable fished out from the sukiyaki.As I was highlighting the issue to the staff who as confused as I am, resulting a feeling of "should i complete my meal to satisfy my craving" or "should i pay and leave"After 10 mins,the staff told me that chef explanation is the plastic is from the beef wrapper and that I don't have to pay for my meal. I thank him for the explanation but end of the day is not that we don't have to pay. Is that you acknowledge the mistake made. Feeling confused I just left abruptly. No one bother to apologies. I guess Sakae sushi or Sukiya would have given better service.

Author: SCOK74Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Let down in terms of quality & service
Review: I hosted a lunch there for my client today. Ordered 3 set lunches and stated our various preference. After waiting for 20 mins, the food was served, they got 2 out of 3 of our orders wrong. We send back 1 and the waitress took it back reluctantly without any apology. When I highlighted the mistake on my meal to her, she replied in a way that it was my fault and my explanation wasn't clear to the waitress, I was rather surprised since she wasn't the person who took our order. My teppanyaki seafood was another let down, both Salmon & Scallops were over cooked and rather hard. After our meal, I highlighted my unpleasant experience to the supervisor and she politely apologise on behalf of her staff without even asking me which staff was rude or even offer a recovery. Very disappointing with a 5 star hotel service especially dining with my client.

Author: Ellllllllllllllllllp
Title: First visit to canopy
Review: I ordered the blue lagoon and the drink was fantastic!! Hope to visit soon. My friends also liked their drinks.

Author: LhilljonesAberdeenshire, United Kingdom
Title: As far as hard rock cafes go, this one is a bit dull
Review: Having visited many hard rock cafes, I was a bit disappointed here. Just felt in need of refurbishment. Food was good with huge portions and drinks well mixed.

Author: Mastura MMalaysia
Title: insensitive restaurant ignoring muslims breaking fast at its outlet
Review: My family of 4 arrived at the restaurant 1 hour earlier. we ordered items for breaking fast as well as cakes n ice chocolates to be served to my 2 non fasting small kids.First the cakes n ice chocolates didnt arrive until i asked after waiting for half n hour. Second the patrons had to ask many times if it was breaking fast time already n third, our dishes for breaking fast arrived 10 mins late

Author: mcsc-squaredNew York City, New York
Title: Great views, mediocre service (for the prices)
Review: Fantastic views of Petronas tower. Good food, however they delayed the main courses for 2 of my colleagues - we had to remind them about their orders and then they rushed to get their food. Overall a nice experience but it seemed like we weren't the only table that had issues.

Author: ntan88Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Rude owner and staff!
Review: The staff taking our order was rude and impatient. When a group of people sat on a table, they were publicly told off by the owner, "Don't sit there. Can't you see it is reserved?!" Well no we can't, the table was set but there was no reserved sign so how was anyone suppose to know if it was reserved. Totally overpriced food and an unpleasant experience.

Author: fatimahk2014
Title: Good mix of Indian and Malay food
Review: Here you'll find both Indian and Malay dishes. The rojak pasembur is my favourite. It can be very crowded during lunch time 12-1pm and 8-9pm. Good food at reasonable price.

Author: Playfunkymusic
Title: The sushi was really good, I should have...
Review: The sushi was really good, I should have had more of it and stayed away from the rest of the menu. The food is expensive and bland, bland, bland. The quality of the meat in low, the tempura soggy, the sauces tasteless. The space is beautiful with an open kitchen and understated wood and stone decor. Come for the atmosphere and the sushi, if you must, stay away from the rest.

Author: ataullahk2019Malaysia
Title: Really disappointed
Review: So i was in town with my friends to get some Chinese food a friend recommended this place so we went there really disappointed to say that there were mosquitos biting us and our order took like forever like the coustomers that came before us got there food early and we had to wait for so long really disappointed.

Author: Tammy B
Title: Lovely lemon cake!
Review: We only tried the tea time special, which was a slice of cake and a cup of coffee/tea for rm15, but both were excellent, as was the friendly service. The cake choice of lemon cake came highly recommended, and we couldn’t agree more!

Author: ALICE NBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Sitting at an outside table, looking over the waterfront, enjoying a large Tiger beer, time slips by unnoticed
Review: Further to this enjoyment, the food is excellent. I had twice a late lunch there, both fish dishes. The fish with the sharp sweet and sour sauce and rice was to die for, so delicious. Furthermore, the service was polite and impeccable. Next time to Kuching, my first visit will be to James Brooke Cafe & Bistro for the sweet & sour fish!

Author: Eierbaeren
Title: Wedding Anniversary very successful
Review: Went here tonight for the first time with my family to celebrate our wedding anniversary. Very professional and friendly staff. Fantastic food (taste & quality) - will come any time again. The food is worth the prices. Recommended if you want to taste authentic Italian taste.

Author: zy_eggKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: DISAPPOINTED
Review: brought my bf for birthday celebration last night. the reservation service and waiter service were good. food quality were disappointing and the presentation were terrible. will not recommend.

Author: MikeCMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Overated, pricey, annoying waiters
Review: This place had some good reviews previously and I went to check this place out.It is not possible to comment on everything on the menu but the mains we ordered were nothing extraordinary and does not commensurate with the price. A RM41 fish dish that fills 1/4 of your hunger. The sizzling brownie was good though.Tables are packed close together so it is a noisy dining experience. Some people may find the waiters helpful but we found them annoying, bothering you when you don't need them, and not attentive when you actually need them. It is supposed to be a pretty high end establishment but the waiters were mostly not-so-well trained foreign workers. They will bring you 2 forks but one plate. The lounge upstairs is much quieter and seems more comfortable.Will I come here again? Most likely not, unless I someone else is paying!KL is not short of great food. I felt very foolish having to pay several times more and leave the place still feeling hungry and there was not even good ambience and service.Not recommended.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: ShawnWooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the better places in Ipoh for a Celebration!
Review: To Litha the Chef of Possibilities, thank you We hosted CNY Day 1 in Healy Mac for 40 pax. Everyone came in doubt with the choice of venue, its ambience and setup for a Chinese New Year celebration in an Irish Bar. But they left with a smile on their faces for its food, proper celebration setup of clean utensils, dining furnitures and air cond as CNY Day 1 is proven to be a hot and crowded affair in little Ipoh. We had our own private room all to ourself, a proper clean functioning toilet and a pool table. Of everything that I'd take for granted as a dining out Malaysian of good security, plenty of car park and English speaking serving crew, I must say the food left us all dining in happiness. The Pork Knuckle, the Pizzas, The Cesar Salad, the Fried Noodles, Ice Lemon Tea, And Cut Fruits are worth every penny of the its delivery and par excellence. Pork is stripped off its porky smell. Crackles on first knife and the juicy tender pork meat, OH SO GOOD! Litha, you have magic with them food. Good stuffs! I have said all the good stuffs but to be worthy of a 5 star, I wish for their staff to be more attentive as at most times I as a host have to rush out to issue instructions of new food order or for the matter, new plates and utensils for my guests... But this is Ipoh. I have high hopes for it as a pure bred former resident. My deepest gratitude for the professionalism and good food experience - especially 6 pork knuckles that was stripped clean! Well done guys! I had the leftovers of Cesar Salad and the yellow noodles and boy it's good for Day 2! Dear Litha, don't be discouraged of a 4 star ratings. This is the most for a worthy Ipoh celebration as the world watches. 5 star are for WOW factors. Bring it in. I will be back again in 2019. Perhaps then, a 5 star? =^_^=
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: PremN67
Title: never went back again
Review: one of the worst experience i ever had, went to this restaurant on Sunday evening , i got table on first floor the place is so hot and and get so much noise from other table , i couldn't even hear anything from my colleague , after waiting so long we got the food , the food is horrible , i order Karikudi mutton curry & fish fry & chicken curry , they people use same readymade masala for all the items , come back with so much disappointed

Author: JalanjLNCARIMAKAN
Title: Holiday
Review: It was our second visits in the restaurant. Unfortunately the experiences that me & friends had were really bad. Jeremy who happens is the manager was very rude. Disrespect customer by showing attitude towards us. However, staff , Manju was very friendly and apologies on behalf of his mama her despite she was part-timer there. The manager did not apologise and continued to show his attitude towards others and his staff too. It shown how unprofessional he was.

Author: eoncoKuching, Malaysia
Title: A snapshot of Kuching's harmonious races - laksa,kolomee,Mee Jawa,satay!
Review: Where else in Kuching can you find some of it's best local hawker dishes together in one spot? Choon Hui!One of the top laksa joints, although truth be told the mother had it better but she retired a couple of years ago, but the children still produce one of the town's most delicious laksa!Next to it you get excellent Mee Jawa, Satay and Nyonya kuih sold by a Muslim local Malay ...who also fries mee goreng and other stuff.Opposite to them is a kolo mee stall, again very good.The coffee is hot, strong and excellent - only problem? Finding a place to sit during it's rush hours between 7:30-9:30am. But don't be too late as most stalls sell out by 10am!

Author: elainettkIpoh, Malaysia
Title: My favorite nasi kandar
Review: I had been visiting this stall since at least 3 to 4 years, on a weekly basis. I enjoyed their sambal prawns, fried chicken, mutton, chicken kurma, homemade fish patties and also the varieties of vegetables available, including fried cabbage, bitter gourd, French beans, potatoes, crunchy gourd (another type of gourd that I don't know what it is called), and lastly, the salted egg and papadam.I must say that this stall made me put on a lot of weight!

Author: Shani APuchong, Malaysia
Title: Salted Chicken?
Review: Wasn't aware that Ipoh is famous for their Salted Chicken until I did a search online.This shop is apparently the longest standing shop in Ipoh that sells the best salted chicken in town and is a must buy for every person who visited Ipoh.It's as traditional as you can get. Basically, it's whole chicken baked in rock salt for hours so you get that salty taste on the meat without losing the essence. On top of that, you get the benefit of the smoked scent.You have the option of either getting a fresh packed, ready to be eaten in 2 days or a frozen one, for you to keep for no more than 6 months.To say the least, the salted chickens were decent.It's definitely a great item to buy as souvenir for relatives.

Author: faustinekaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Not as tasty as expected
Review: Stumbled upon this coffeeshop to realize it was a popular recommendation for wanton mee. Place was packed and generally smaller dining parties had to share a table. The service was of slower pace, it took about half an hour for us to receive our orders, perhaps due to the peak long weekend crowd.Taste wise, we felt it was much more bland than what we are used to in Singapore.

Author: paula2095
Title: Worst Waiter  I ever Met...
Review: Unkind, disinterested and Really Bad mood Person. The Food was Good but if you Feel Not welcome the best food  wouldn't taste Good...

Author: rink521Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Huge Disappointment!
Review: After reading rave reviews on trip advisor, we were excited to try this restaurant as Japanese cuisine is the family's favorite. What a disappointment! Overpriced, unremarkable cuisine with lackluster service. There is nothing redeeming about this restaurant - feel free to skip as there are much more authentic, interesting and enjoyable restaurants on the island!

Author: annekoh888
Title: Nice cafe with interesting variety of coffee
Review: Nice deco with interesting variety of coffee. Cosy and wifi speed is fast. Good for a chill out afternoon

Author: Dan333_Malaysia
Title: Quite dissapointed..
Review: The food was just ok. Way way below par compared to the flagship restaurant in Taipei 101. Will not go again unless you have a craving for Chinese food and no other choices.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: Yazid S
Title: not up to my expectation
Review: Me and my family just had our dinner at the restaurant and were disappointed. This so call famous restaurant by one of the Malaysian masterchef’s judge was obviously not in the kitchen to cook. This restaurant merely using his name just to keep people coming. The price shows that this place is a fine dining restaurant, but they didn’t even provide napkin. Let alone the cutleries. We were served steak with a bread knife! When I asked for steak knife, the waiter brought me another bread knife, only to explain that that’s the ‘knife’ we serve for steak. Nothing special about the taste and the presentation were so-so. The steak was tough and using the bread knife only made it worse. Some other RM15 steak restaurant can easily done better. We ordered lasagna as well. I can assure you that even the pizza hut’s lasagna taste better! Its soggy, small portion for the price, and the mozzarella topping had ‘hardened’ when it served on our table. I had even though that they might have precook/frozen and only heat it when ordered? The list goes on and on. Some of the downside are acceptable if only they are a mediocre restaurant. The price is not justified with the experience here, but thats me.
Restaurant: Laman Grill steak n Bar B Que,

Author: BGRigby
Title: Good food with good variety
Review: Spice Grill is a good restaurant serving both Western & Indian fare.  The quality of both is quite good and the atmosphere is nice.

Author: whiterabbitjb
Title: Great value for money
Review: We had a perfect lunch at the Little Penang Cafe: a short queue to get in, and then efficient service and honest dishes, true to flavour and very modestly priced despite the expensive Suria KLCC setting. A strong recommendation if you are in the area.

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Too spicy too eat
Review: Most of the dishes is spicy. For me is too spicy. All dishes served in very small portion. The small size is like good for one person. The nyoya fish we order is so small n cost RM35. Kueh pie ti is not so crunchy. Very expensive. Not my liking

Author: TravelrushKuala Lumpur
Title: Great Sunday Buffet
Review: Am regularly patronizing the restaurant with friends and it's always worth the money. They have a great buffet on Sundays for 68++ only, which I highly recommend. Working in the hospitality myself, the word quickly got around that this restaurant did well in the MIGF (Malaysian Intl Gourmet Festival) and won several awards.. Well deserved in my view. During the buffet hours you find many chefs around touching up on the buffet and socializing with customers. Great impression. The buffet itself has a very creative set-up and keeps you getting up for more. I would like to compliment on one of the Shisha staff (my apologies for forgetting his name) who is looking after us every time we come. Keep up the good work!

Author: 123klnomadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive and Not up to standard of hotel restaurant
Review: Went there with friends to experience nice French cuisine. But to my surprise, it was also very Italian. The price was very expensive for food that was casual French, not fine dining. I will most likely not go back and go to other independent stand alone restaurants in KL

Author: MazlindaM11
Title: excellent
Review: came there just for the oysters as me and my husband are crazy bout it. everything was superb and  we'll definately come again next time for sure.

Author: Maya762015
Title: Only for cocktail
Review: CBA has a great view on Cenang beach and offer some comfortable sofa in front of the sea. Service is nice and drink a cocktail there is very pleasant. However food menu is very limited and even pasta or burger are neither good neither tasty.

Author: 862rumab
Title: Good Food at affordable price!
Review: It is certainly one of the best places to have Indian Vegetarian Food in the heart of the city. Not a fine dining, but yes, good variety and good food - North Indian style! (Which is rare to have in Little India) :)

Author: menadivaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quality drop
Review: Used to frequent this restaurant for their South Indian food. It used to be good, however we notice the food quality dropped tremendously during our last visit. The chicken rasam was flat, the fish was not fresh, pepper onion mutton was totally not worth it, it hardly had any mutton flesh in it, just the mutton fats mixed with heavy flour batter. We shared the feedback with the staffs but there was no response,explanation or even an apology. Would not be returning again.

Author: ashishbakre67Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not so happy visit.
Review: This is not our first visit but this time the food so just not up to the mark. The sheer kabab was raw and uncooked ( very chewy). The fitters very limp and the beer a bit flat. Souled Hartamas out needs to up their game as competition is intense. Read “The Social” @ 163 MK. Apart from Naughty Nuri and if rumours are right B&B is coming back in another avatar.

Author: watsonworld
Title: Great Light Lunch
Review: Staying in a villa next door, we tried Sun Cafe one afternoon after a massive hangover. Great burger & chips plus a life saving orange & pineapple juice !

Author: Connor S
Title: Amazing
Review: Service was incredible, always making sure we were comfortable. Our favorite place in KL. Reasonably priced food and drinks. Great place to chill with friends and enjoy the KL nightlife.

Author: DaveThompson16Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Very nice Lebanese food. Bit pricey
Review: Al Halabi is quite a large restaurant in the Loft area of Pavilion. Not that easy to find so they probably don’t get many walk-by customers, but the quality of the food will bring foodies back. My wife and I had dinner. 3 starter plates (hummus, baba ganoush and falafel) and a mixed grill. All very good quality - much better than Al Amar. Unfortunately they don’t offer a mezze sharing platter. They should. To drink I had a lemon and mint, and my wife just had water. All told it came to RM158. Maybe about 20% overpriced, but great food so I’m not complaining too much. Hadramawt is better value though. That notwithstanding, I would recommend Al Halabi if you’re in Pavilion and craving good middle eastern food.

Author: GerardLawJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Service could be improved
Review: We did a farewell dinner for one of our senior staff, booked 1 week in advance. It rained on the night and so we were 15mins late on arrival. They gave away our reservation without prior contacting us. Then they began shoving chairs and tables to put us in a group and literally threw the menus onto our tables. Food was up to expectation but the service staff could do with some better training to improve on their attitude. Would think twice about going despite the good food. Service sucks.

Author: girigoku
Title: Marketing Hype
Review: Basically, a local business run by phillipino immigrant staffs serving cafeteria quality food at premium prices.

Author: Rajasingam BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: JP Teres
Review: Was there over this weekend. The set up is impressive with an open concept and clean. Has an outdoor extension for those of us who prefer the Malaysian way of dining outside. Serves Malay, Chinese and Indian Cuisine. Generally the dishes are good bit not exceptional. Definitely not the best but those who prefer a clean environment I would suggest eating here. Prices are acceptable as those under a 5 star hotel. Would suggest to add nyonya cuisine.

Author: 89stuarteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Italian Food
