Review: This is a great restaurant for traditional Italian food although some items are a bit pricey for what they are....The quality of the food is excellent and the menu has a good variety.....If you go during happy hour (s) the saving on alcohol offsets some of the expensive items...

Author: Eric Y
Title: Travelling lunch with family
Review: Good food.... Nice ambience... Good service... Recommendation food from Yeoh the manager... Will recomend for others  travellers

Author: ChristiaanJBKralendijk, Bonaire
Title: Sneaky!
Review: Last night we had a late dinner overthere. We had a jug of sangria, truffle croquettes, cheese platter and the lamb sliders. Got served by Chris and he was fast and professional at first. Turns out that the first 4 pages of the drinks menu are all happy our prices. The only line on top of those pages is “happy hour from 4pm till 8pm.We think that this is a sneaky way to make a couple of extra $$. Hope that they will change their menu soon.But I’m not coming back.

Author: G THong Kong, China
Title: Avoid - Mediocre Food, Bad Service
Review: Touted as a one of the better middle eastern restaurant in KL, this place was a major disappointment.We went for the buffet style Sunday brunch. We were put at a table next to smokers - something you would expect at a hawker stall, not a supposed upscale restaurant.Despite lots of staff, the service was very poor. The ala cart selection made - rice with mutton - was unappestisingly presented and contained very little meat. The taste was OK. The buffet was medium in size (can be viewed from outside the retaurant) and has a selection of meze and some main course dishes.Most of the dishes were over-salted to the extreme. The cooks clearly do not taste the food. The meat - mutton and beef - was very overcooked and dry to start with, and being left under a warming lamp for hours didn't help much. The roasted lamb chops were dumped in the same bain marie as the vine wrapped items (didn't try them), which meant they were soggy. Most of the main courses were inedible - either poorly cooked or tasteless.Some of the salads and meze were reasonable, but were accompanied by a squadron of flies. The staff didn't seem to care.The desserts were minimal and very non-Lebanese. We ordered baclava from the menu - what arrived was not baclava at all.The lime and mint drinks were very good.Pricing was at the level of a restaurant. MYR78 for the buffet and about MYR20 for a small main course. The quality of the food and the service made this very bad value for money.Avoid this place. There are more authentic, better quality restaurants all over KL.

Author: RavikantKuala Lumpur
Title: Decent North Indian type food at reasonable prices
Review: I had recently an opportunity to take some friends out for lunch to the 7 Spice restaurant. This was my first visit to the restaurant as I was visting Johor Bahru on some business. The place is situated in the Danga Bay area with lots of shop lots around. There is no exclusive or separate parking space for those visiting the restaurant; we however did not find any difficulty in finding a place to park in the common parking lots a short distance away from the restaurant. The space inside the restaurant is large - having no particular or distinctive ambiance inside. Interestingly, the menu does not serve Naan or any Indian bread during lunch times. These are only available during the evenings. However, one could order the tandoori/ meat/ vegetable dishes. My friends ordered Chicken Biriyani, the portions of which were adequate. Biriyani was served with Raita (small sized onion slices soaked in curd). The dishes were served almost immediately, without any waiting. A rectangular banana leaf is placed in front of you to place your food items on to it instead of ceramic plates.The quality of the Basmati rice used and the taste of the biriyani could have been little better - my friends however liked it. Few aspects about the Biriyani. In the Indian traditional cooking, chicken or vegetable biriyani is prepared by cooking the rice and meat pieces together with the aromatic Indian spices. That way the flavor is blended into both the rice and the meat pieces. I suspect that here it is done otherwise. I saw the waiter taking chicken pieces separately and then add the cooked biriyani rice on top of the pieces. Also the biriyani is served here in open containers. Traditionally, it is supposed to be served in small containers which are sealed/ covered at the top. One has to just remove the cover before having the biriyani. That way the flavor is retained in a fresh state until the food is consumed. Also, another important ingredient is the selection of the right type of Basmati rice. Usually, one selects the long grained Basmati rice. This basmati rice is so aromatic that the aroma would fill the whole house even when it is being cooked. This feeling or flavor was absent here. Our bill was also not too large an amount as the rates too are pretty reasonable here. Interestingly, no service charge or taxes are levied on the food items. They are all nett priced. Finally, the restaurant is ok, if one is in a bit of hurry and is hard pressed for time specially during the afternoons.

Author: SLee16Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing amazing despite rave reviews
Review: I went with friends to this restaurant after hearing and reading rave reviews about the good Northern Indian food served here. It is not possible to have a meal here without reservations for dinner so we booked in advance (so please call them). Once seated, we were given the menu (in a form of a coffee table book, nice touch but too bulky). A few items we selected, were not available and was only informed by the waitress when we picked them. Room for improvement : Would be great if they can brief us in advance to avoid disappointment. Hygiene - One of the glasses on the table had a strand of hair in it. We ordered masala tea and served in a clay mug that had a chip and not easy to hold for a hot drink. There seems to be lack of storage space for this restaurant so you will see things being placed around at one corner of the restaurant as though they are still doing housekeeping before opening.Environment & Noise - I am torn whether this should be a modern concept restaurant or a traditional. Noise level is high for those who enjoy a meal in such an environment.Food - Jeera rice was really dry. Overall food was not served piping hot. Again depending on your preference. The mutton kurma was like a form of 'carbonara' dish. Yeap, didn't taste anything like mutton kurma. We ordered a few types of curries and overall it was just poor and sweet in nature. Chicken beriyani was probably the only item we enjoyed. We didn't get to try the bbq menu as we were told we were not seated at the 'right' area to order BBQ set. Room for improvement : Ask the customers if they will be ordering BBQ meals before allocating the seats. A lot of room for improvement for this restaurant at this point.

Author: jonathany689Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Buffet Lunch
Review: I got a great offer from Groupon for this restaurant. This restaurant is located in the grand floor of Grand Blue Wave Hotel. The food taste is great, although there is a very little choice of food serve to be chosen. The restaurant service is great. The restaurant staff is very courteous. The environment of the restaurant is cosy and good.

Author: Fadhli91
Title: Bad customer service
Review: I was a fan of NZ GaRden. Sometimes I bring my own food but I will order some drinks or other side dish. But I ate there every Friday not to mention take aways on evening. In addition, I was a regular customer of NZ convenience store. Today, the cashier suddenly prohibited me from bringing my own food, notwithstanding my loyalty to the restaurant before. I will never go there again, as well as buy things from NZ chain.

Author: goodwork123
Title: Overated restaurant
Review: very bad service, noisy, expensive and lastly the taste of the food is very normal like any other restaurant (choo char)

Author: yunzsy
Title: Good Crowd?
Review: Just dropped by for a quick lunch, for I kept on seeing friends posted on the web about Antipodean Cafe and how the atmosphere and food were good. So we gave it a try. Little did we know their menu was all written on the huge blackboard that was located outdoors! A little neckache to be frank, to stand there and look up and down to decide what to have for a first timer. Wished they had a separate menu for those sitting indoors. Their huge blackboard menu is cool, but I preferred if they have an alternative for other customers. Another thing I think Antipodean at MidValley should take note of is their customer service with the new customers that comes in. That day I went I witness that the customers had to wait for the on-floor manager to attend to them on whether could they take the seat indoors or outdoors. The waiters had to ask the customers to wait and pass them over to the manager. I wonder why though.Overall, the food was good, ambiance is good. My food was a little too creamy and cheesy. Didn't expected that much creamy sauce for the Mushroom Spinach Cabonara that I ordered. Would go back to try other items on their menu since I have a knack for food.

Author: DoLLieBarbieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: I have eaten here quite a few times already. This time i feel the manager or staff? In white long sleeves shirt, the guy was quite unwilling to attend to our table whenever we need service. I hate to dine in restaurants where you have staffs or even worst if he was a manager who showed attitude towards customers when serving them which clearly showed in his expressions. I saw clearly when I raised my hand for service assistance, he was commenting about my table. Service staffs have to be more professional, and you need manpower since your restaurant is busy. I bought the nasi lemak, sambal was very little, standard was so off. When I walked pass Madam Kwan again just last wee travelling to KL, i was taken aback to dine in there again. Maybe another time.

Author: sheislisa22Canberra, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: Nice environment but the foods is not that good taste when I’m visit on July 2017 for Birthday celebrations dinner. Their spaghetti so far is still taste better than grilled lamb. The restaurant is located in Emart Batu Kawa, place is good for drinking and chatting with friends or family. Their ground floor have the bowling games in the mall.

Author: JeeneS99Singapore
Title: Good Indian food at Menara KL
Review: I have been visiting this place every time during my trip to KL, for the last 9 years.Good place to have Indian food, they have a singer singing live songs and the staff is courteous.One of the best food options in KL for Indian Vegetarians.Don't forget to try the chaat, paani puri etc. options.Conveniently located as well.

Author: Tom P
Title: Great setting
Review: Had dinner here for a special occasion, and it was very special. We had a table right on the beach watching the beautiful sunset. We both ordered the sea bass which was superb. The chef had deboned and reconstructed the fish, which was a lovely touch. Recommended for a special occasion.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: R_VikKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible service. Food not worth the wait.
Review: Been here for dinner and breakfast with families. Food is average to good on some dishes. It's by no means cheap and yet the service is atrocious! We ended up waiting 45 mins for food! Both times! If you have time to chill while waiting for for food come here, otherwise an absolutely dreadful experience.

Author: SeaininBrennanBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: Over rated and over priced
Review: Don't be fooled by celebrity culture - Nobu is not a great restaurant. The food is average and the cocktails are average but the price is not average. However, if you must go...don't say I didn't warn you! BTW: I've eaten in Nobu in London, NY, Cape Town and now KL...seems no matter what I say everyone still wants to eat there!

Author: Lukim_58
Title: Great Italian - huge portions
Review:
Il Bacaro has a very friendly atmosphere.

The food was authenticate and the portions were huge (particularly the anti pasto which contained a large variety).

I definitely recommend Il Bacaro to anyone who wants real Italian food in Georgetown.

Author: 488kasthurisKajang, Malaysia
Title: The Hostess - Inadequate or racist?
Review: Delicious loh mai gai, siew mai, custard buns and a pretty ambiance. But the hostess' attitude makes me rethink if I should dine here again. I had to ask her twice before I was given the menu and order chit while waiting for a table. I asked her a question and there was no answer the first time. We were give number 17 but only managed to get in after number 21. The hostess actually took time to usher in those who were sitting on the stools, but somehow managed to miss my mum and me, the only two people with different skin tone. Now I would have dismissed it as inadequacy, but this was my second visit to the restaurant. When I visited sometime in October, the similar thing happened. It could be my imagination but twice?

Author: Ying Hoong T
Title: Fine Dining Really?
Review: Decided to buy a special VIP a nice dinner and selected DC Restaurant located at Persiaraan Zaaba, TTDI. On the ground floor where my guest was waiting for me (as usual i was a bit lost getting to the exact location) good thing my co-host was there to accompany our guest having pre-dinner drinks at the irregular shaped long bar table located at the ground floor. Dinner is served on the 1st floor at La Salle room, but i was disappointed with the lack of decor on the corridor & stairs leading up to the dining room. La Salle room was simple in its decor, with green heavy curtains being the main thing that caught my attention - overall the ambience failed to meet my expectations of "fine dining". Overall the food was good, but not memorable - service levels were above average, with the waiters being attentive and even addresses you by name. For the price paid i would have expected more of this fine dining restaurant. We selected the 3 course menu (priced at RM 298 per head) & with add on foie grass and corkage charges the price per head approximated to RM 470 per hear

Author: wessyuk
Title: Relaxing drinks
Review: Sid's Pub, we have visited in K.L. After walking and enjoying this beautiful place we enjoyed a relaxing drink, no food, lucky to get a table by the river, great views down the river I could have sat there for hours. Great atmosphere, we visited in the afternoon. Good watering hole.

Author: KimPangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good value, but average pizza
Review: Been meaning to try out Mikey's pizza for a while now. I just had to satisfy my curiosity if the claims of original pizza New York style and the specially installed oven would match up to the delicious pizzas I used to chow down during my days in New York. Size wise, it certainly didn't disappoint. At least in this regard, the pizzas are keeping up with their original size back in NY. However, that's where the similarities end. Taste wise it was just average, dough was limp. Maybe it's just personal, but it was disappointing. Even my wife and mom didn't enjoy it, and they didn't have basis to compare against old memories of pizzas in NY. Would not recommend this place to my friends for sure.

Author: Sabrina W
Title: A JEWEL !!
Review: While back in Penang for a visit, my Cousins took me to The Blue Mansion, and we had lunch there. The Restoration of this Old Home was very Impressive. We then had lunch at Indigo Restaurant. Food was Excellent; Service was Impeccable; Setting was Very Pleasant. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this restaurant for a Very Pleasant, Unhurried Meal. 2 days later, on my last day, I took my Uncle and Aunt back there, and we had a really good visit and meal again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND this JEWEL RESTAURANT !!
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: JeremyHKS
Title: Thai Food
Review: Will not come again. Worse thai food that i ever try, especially fried fish spicy thai style, taste terrible!!

Author: Ritzy12London, United Kingdom
Title: Mexican food does not get better than this.
Review: Just go there and find out for yourself. I can't recommend it highly enough. Great service, great atmosphere, and food cooked as fresh as you like. Glad I found it soon into my attachment here. Will be a regular visitor.

Author: pippyboomboom
Title: Just ok
Review:
We had dinner here on a very busy night.
Had a pasta dish and a burger combo...not outstanding by any means, cold fries.
Service was also okay, but seemed to  have a great energy as far as ambiance.
Cute place though, inviting from exterior.

Author: Angel L
Title: Good ambience
Review:
Good ambience, with spectacular twin tower views. 
one of my favorite place to hang out and have shisha with friends. Just 1km away from KLCC. comes with a valet parking as well, no hassle in looking for parking :)

Author: George JNew York City, New York
Title: "Dissapointed"
Review: Well, the name of the restaurant still remain the same but the service, quality and food were unfortunately not. Something obviously went wrong with the snobbish and ï know it all"attitude of the waiting staff. What is the point of telling us there are 2 seatings (during dinner) and rushing us to finish up our food when the restaurant is half empty (despite it already being a small restaurant) ! we ordered pasta and was over cooked and TOO SALTY. Price wise, has been creeping up a lot !!!! BAD!

Author: kirstenmdkuala lumpur
Title: Go for a drink in this pub but not to eat
Review: Although the bar staff were very friendly and the wine was really nice, unfortunately, the food quality was very poor. Sausages had been microwaved, chicken wings were not spicy and very small portion. Nachos had barely any covering and sour cream had to be requested (when it came it was not sour cream) Calamari was rubbery. Go for a drink but not to eat!

Author: dineshbabu25Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Food , Horrible Service
Review: Service is so poor ! You can wait a minimum 20min to get them to refill your tea ! We kept going back for the food , but it takes forever for the food to come out of the kitchen . Staffs are not friendly or helpful at all.

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cheap Yet Good And Tasty
Review: Ban Lee Siang at Ong Kim Wee is the original branch for satay celup. Compare to Capitol satay celup, it's satay sauce is little watery. However with the price at 1 ringgit per stick, it's so much more affordable and you need not queue like crazy with its ample table. Parking is easier than Capitol as it is just in front of the establishment. When in melaka, try different places for their famous satay to suit your taste buds as everyone have its favourites. Overall rating is very fresh and good.

Author: michaelpF8291EXWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Gone downhill
Review: This was a staple for me when I moved here 3 years ago, but had a porterhouse tonight that was wretched and staff seemed nonplussed. I ordered medium rare as usual and after first cut it was obvious that the steak was not thawed before the cook. The fillet part fared better than the short loin portion, but in the latter there were several parts that were easily 30 degrees or more cooler than the rest. Typical issues with an uneven cut going in the oven, but nevertheless a rookie mistake that I feel any proper steakhouse figures out within the first 2 hours of being open. Staff was completely unapologetic or concerned and therefore got to downgrade this joint. It was a good value but have to say it is now best avoided.

Author: Stephen-Peter J
Title: Tandoori Naan
Review: I have eaten here several times, and I always order tandoori chicken and naan even though there are several other options to choose from. The food is average, but so are the prices. Service is fine and there is plenty of parking for customers.

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Another feather in Ben's cap
Review: This is a casual cafe style restaurant done tastefully and creatively in the inimitable style of Benjamin Yong, the founder of the Delicious chain of restaurants; and a dozen more new places all with a distinct style and ambience. As its name suggest, the food is definitely not kosher but thank goodness for that! It is set in the middle of a large gourmet supermarket (which is in itself unique, interesting and colourful) and serves a diverse selection of pork dishes from Eggs Benedict (not very good) to Chinese roast pork curries. The Asian selection seemed better but there is plenty to choose from. They also have a small wine selection which I am sure can be augmented with a bottle purchased from the wine store in the supermarket outside - all under same management. The decor, as you would expect from Ben Yong, is creative and light hearted (love the row of pink piggy banks by the entrance) and the pork inspired messages scattered around the restaurant.

Author: tgwwgtTravelHermanus, South Africa
Title: A unique dining experience.
Review: Have been going to Suzy's for about three years on a regular basis. The steak is great, strictly no frills, In the beginning the cats and rats were a free cabaret but now its cleaned up good. Plastic tables and DVD sellers add to the ambience. We have a stunning waitress who, of course knows our order off by heart.You are never disappointed by the quality of meat served. There is an alternative menu if you are not a tenacious meat eater which includes some great naan breads. Beer is served and recently wine has been introduced. Clientele is a real mixed bunch, locals and ex pats. Staff are happy to put tables together if you have a big group. Service is usually quick , there are separate waiters for drinks and food. Its pretty much an open air restaurant with a basic roof, situated almost under a flyover next to a busy road possibly not for the fainthearted. A recent innovation on the same site is a carwash , so you can eat while you get the car shampooed. Altogether a very different experience.

Author: Pei Q
Title: Slowest restaurant!!
Review: The food served is toooooo slow! I have waited for 50min and i am still waiting ! And spaghetti here is quite ok, the rest i cannot say more about it!

Author: arban
Title: too expensive and target for tourist only
Review: Too pricey unless you can use with euro and Singapore dollar. Not worth at all. soon will replaced another BAR owner. hehehe This Restoration previously was labodega somehow the price still good by the time.

Author: MagicStique
Title: waited 90 minutes for something that is finished in 9 minutes
Review:
If you want dinner, better go there and wait after you have finished your lunch.
Oily food, certainly not going there anymore. 
Price is too high for a restaurant that is cramp and noisy, and no parking.

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Good to try once
Review: Penang has so many restaurants you'd probably not visit the same place twice. A cozy place to dine and have fun with friends. Welcoming service crew, okay food and a good place to hang out if you only want some cakes and drinks or even a proper dinner.Parking could be the main problem because this is a heritage area.. all the best :D

Author: haziqh95
Title: First and last visit to "Absolute Thai"
Review: Went for Absolute thai at IOI Mall after hearing some good reviews. I ate pineapple fried rice which does not have pineapples in it, the taste was blend and has no seasoning what so ever, my fiancée ate tomyam fried rice which tasted like cat food. For a meal that cost me rm17.90 i would expect the food to be great and satisfying but instead i got a pile of crap that made Mamak fried rice taste 10x better. True story. Craving for thai food? Go somewhere else.

Author: putridz7
Title: Dinner
Review: Have a delicious night time spent at Jalan Alor where much foods. Though make me more confuse to choose. But for muslim, beware cause there're also many non halal foods. I love milo in kedai mamak along jalan alor, deliciousoo!

Author: nazrulzulkefli
Title: Best view and food in Malaysia
Review: Brought my family to eat here. We enjoyed it so much. Only set meal for weekends but still quite a choice of 16 items western and local.. The lamb rib are to die for and satay presentation a ...wow. Service a little slow because the café was pack but acceptable. Really friendly waiters. I would highly recommend this place to my friends.

Author: penshawpaulMactan Island, Philippines
Title: Not up to the Hype
Review: Was really looking forward to this - booked for friends birthday - waiter was friendly but staff generally not interested - took ages to be served, for drinks to arrive and for food to arrive. We ordered appetisers and mains. came in no order after reminding waiter that we were waiting. Pizza first (main) then some starters then more mains - once all finished the final main came out and my friend ate alone. Staff not even concerned - views were great outside but as good from the traders bar across the park. Smokers everywhere - surrounded at some points - but didn't matter as no-one was concerned about the haze in the restaurant. Only plus was the toilet attendant - at least he was happy to see us

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Long Q
Review: One of the famous & popular nyonya food in jonker streey. Most of the time are crowded & need to Q. Foods are taste ordinary & service can be improved

Author: Satthiam
Title: Great Location with Great Food!
Review: This place is always crowded especially in the evening but it makes sense because their dish is different from other restaurants. Service is quite fast, friendly waiters but slightly expensive food. Must try food: prawn Thosai, carrot Thosai and of course their beetroot thosai

Author: Carol L
Title: Staff need to be spoken to about making customers write reviews
Review: Went here last night. Had shisha, cocktails and food. Nice bar, we were enjoying ourselves until Mihad (staff member) asked us to review on trip advisor. I told him of course we would. But I was shocked when he held out his hand for my phone. I told him I'd do it and he walked around the table and literally stood over my shoulder as I typed. He also asked to be specifically mentioned. 'Unfortunately' my review didn't submit! I would have happily reviewed this place after being here but that really put us off the place and made our night much much less enjoyable. The food is fine, average or slightly above average, cocktails were very strong (too strong) and the shisha was very good. Before we left we saw another staff member approach another couple to leave a review... slightly less invasively.

Author: Nahal056Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Tasteless!
Review: I am wrting this review while i am in their branch near Sogo. And it is also based on my experiance with two of their otger branches.Their cheese naan is the best I have ever had in my life. However, everything else is cold and tasteless. Their beryani is dry and cold, their Keema tastes ok but also cold as ice, their Tandoori is really tasteless and served cold!Their Teh Tarik is dilated that it became flavored water!Done bother with their garlic cheese naan and "Yaummy" or "Extra Cheese". The Yummy naan they add chicken ham, which has no flavor. As for extra cheese, no need for that as the standard one is already loaded with ALOT of cheese! Just make sure you bring your cholestrol pills :D

Author: sasykantha
Title: Worst experience ever!
Review: My wife and I had a terrible experience. We bought the first class tickets and were not informed or explained about the hotel details. The food was really bad and we saw the attended pouring sunquick juice out of bottle as so called cocktail. It was not made in-house. My wife had the "turkey dish" which was so bad. We were told that it was turkey but it was really just chicken. I believe we know the difference of turkey and chicken. The wing walk experience was even worse as we were given a really old ladder to climb. It was shaky and unstable, I almost fell. Overall, we are so disappointed with the service. There so many other romantic getaways to choose from. It was really a big waste of money for a really bad experience.

Author: cecilyab
Title: Tastes soo bad - terrible
Review: I've visited Vivo with my husband. We ordered 6 and 8 pieces Pizza. But the size of the pizzas were too small and we're not saturate. And it tastes not like a pizza.

Author: ctcheah23
Title: Rude waiter
Review: Rude waiter with unpleasant voice, felt discriminated when waiter suggested for us to go to 5th floor - Gobo Chit Chat. Wrong soup was served but Manager insisted tomatoes soup and lobster bisque taste similar, nothing wrong! Very disappointed!

Author: Yong9974
Title: Overhyped and over rated. Misleading menu on website.
Review: Went there on a friday nite with my girlfriend. There were only three tables occupied out of maybe twenty. Thr place was quiet. We tried to order from the menu but many items were not available. Its ridiculous..they told us they had squid only from the kitchen and not the grill, and it costs twice as much. No flower crab, and the crabs they had were small and overpriced...ten ringgit per 100g. Many options on the menu were not avail as well. In the end, we settled for buttered squid, salted egg crab, and fried long beans with belachan sambal. Buttered squid was rubbery. Probably the worst i have tasted... I could have cooked them better myself. Salted egg crab...sauce was nice but the crab was too small and the meat stuck to the shell. Long beans were overdone despite me telling the waiter to fry them lightly. Damage? 100rm for these three dishes plus two juices. They even have a 10 percent surcharge. Avoid this place or regret.Teddy from Singapore

Author: poopshooter
Title: remember it better...
Review: Love their new place. Bright with elegant decor. Much more spacious. Parking is a pain though. Still bit pricey. Friendly staff. Tandoori ribs are still awesome. Tender & flavorful. Everything else just average. Felt it was better when at Publika.

Author: ashahnadia
Title: good music, good crowd too
Review: went over the weekend, so all was good. Mixed of local and your usual angmohs there. Music was great. Chillvibes :)

Author: beforeJune
Title: Nice Environment
Review:
Price are averagely for a French Fine Dine restaurant.
Foods are decent, just some description are too professional need staffs to explain.
Service is pretty friendly and helpful. Comfy place, especially the lighting is warm and not glare.

Author: anttit2016
Title: Nice atmosphere, very friendly service.
Review: We had a Sunday brunch here around midday. Brunch was excellent, and so was service also! Very relaxing and quiet atmospehere, I recommend this place!

Author: EskandarShah
Title: Saturday buffet bbq grill
Review: Totally disappointed with the buffet spread which is very limited in terms of choice n of poor quality. Totally does not correspond with it status as a 5 star establishment. Staff was not proactive in clearing away the plates until being told. Buffet spread in Casuarina is much superior.

Author: Matthias K
Title: a lot of upside potential in Monnalisa
Review: The first time I had published this review it got deleted. Don't know why but here it is again :)We went to the Monnalisa in Hartamas Shopping Centre after we had found out about it on Facebook.The opening night was on October 1st but interestingly on 1st of September somebody already posted “The best Italian food in town! Really authentic” on their facebook page. Interesting But still we wanted to give it a try so we went to the grand opening, which did not turn out so grand after all.When we arrived at ~19:45 the restaurant was still rather empty, with a couple of tables occupied. We wanted to pick a nice and small one inside (for 2 people) but were told that this was already reserved. The only table that was left was one outside and a bit out of the view from the bar and counter. Personally I don’t care but in the end sitting there makes you feel a bit disconnected and “out of focus and attention”. There is no proper light at this table either (yet?).To begin with we ordered a glass of apple juice (without sugar), a glass of house wine (Cesari Adesso Nero d’Avola) and a bottle of water. The waitress could not answer my questions concerning the wine and had to go and ask someone else twice. She also did not really understand my wife’s wish for ‘no sugar’ in the apple juice and repeated ‘more sugar’. Luckily she did repeat it so we could correct this.We went for the following dishes:Starters:Bruschetta al PomodoroCroccheMains:Costoletto di AgnelloSpicy vegetablesRigatoni MonnalisaDesert: PastieraVerdict:Bruschetta al Pomodoro: three bland pieces of bread with a slice of tomato on each, almost no oil, no pepper/salt, garlic?? Very little basil, overall a tasteless and bland experience. Probably the worst bruschetta we have ever seen and tastedCrocche: potato croquette stuffed with smoked buffalo mozzarella. The only ingredient with a hint of taste was the mozarella, since it was smoked. The potato itself tasted bland and boring. Not recommended.Costoletto di Agnello: 4 little lamb chops with rosemary, nothing to complain about but nothing spectacular about it eitherSpicy vegetables: spicy? Maybe. But cold as well when served. Another let downRigatoni Monnalisa: thankfully a ragout without tomatoes – positive surprise and rather rare. Did not last long. Overall the taste is very sweet and the whole dish was extremely oily. I have made many ragouts myself and although there is a lot of meat (hence fat) in there, and Italian sausage, it does not have to be that oily. Was hard to finish because it was swimming in oil.There is absolutely no salt/pepper, vinegar or olive oil on the tables.Also no fresh ground pepper is offered with the meal. Low attendance of waiters, might be due to first operating evening and due to the very unfortunate location of this table (almost does not feel like it belongs to the restaurant). We were even told by one of the owners that we were the first people to be served who were not his friends. Maybe a wise idea to give some ‘real customers’ some good treatment. But then friends are important too, I understand that.House Red wine (by the glass, 20MYR): taste wise not too bad at all but the first glass came half empty, second one almost correct. In a big redwine glass I would expect to get 200ml of wine, otherwise it looks like something is missing and that is exactly what the first one looked like, which was closer to 100ml. I would suggest to put the ml on the menu to avoid frustrating surprises like that. If the small amount is intentional having the actual volume on the menu would make any debate unnecessary.Pastiera: a rather dry and again bland desert. According to the menu the only one in KL and if this is how it should taste that I can see why.Fresh juice: prefect and to the point ;)Water: pretty much like water should tasteOverall: very poor food experience, waiters rather untrained and don’t understand questions (or answers) very well but this can be due to the first night.If the food quality and taste stays like this I can’t see this Monnalisa hanging around in KL very long.

Author: Brutally_honest08Dublin
Title: 5 star customer service
Review: This restaurant had the best food in Kuching! Fabulous staff who are so friendly and helpful. They accept credit card and although they do not serve alcohol as they have a predominantly Muslim customer, they allowed us to purchase a beer across the street and enjoy it with our meal while sitting outside. The dumplings were amazing and great value.

Author: MarsG28
Title: Good environment and good service
Review: Awesome environment and good service . Good place for gathering with friends and colleagues ...recommended

Author: ErIcT4080
Title: Chicken chop and fried rice
Review: The chicken chop is nice but side potato wedges aren't fresh. I think they've been cooked it all at once so it is ready to serve.

Author: trvkakiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Busy place but understaffed
Review: This restaurant has great business even after 2pm on a Friday afternoon, however, the entire restaurant is only staffed by a manager and two waiters where it is very much evident that they could not cope with the volume of the business. They did tried their best though.Their food was average but they have long vegetarian menu which suits well for my inlaws.

Author: Wong6690
Title: Terrible Sushi
Review: One of the worst sushi I ever tasted. The sushi rice is just like a regular home cook rice (definitely not Japanese rice), it really destroys the texture of the sushi.

Author: Alex H
Title: A tender evening
Review: A second try (the day before they were closed) we don't regret. A delicious meal nicely served sitting on the terrace alongside the river. Looks like the staff loves their job serving with a smile. This all for a very reasonable price

Author: yennyng
Title: Yummy & Cosy Place
Review: Saw previous reviews and was hesitated to come in. But it turns out so good! My aunt was happy with the overall food quality. Things to order are their platters and perut ikan. Their desserts such as gandum & pulut hitam is great too! Definitely be back again!

Author: YhteohMalaysia
Title: Not much choices
Review: Overall is good for the services, fine for environment dining area, but lack of choice in the food menu, only few types of sushi are available in menu and it doesn't look suitable for children.Order few set for the meal and the seafood for all the meals have lack of freshness issue on it, even the seafood spaghetti have a very strong fishy smell for their sauces & scallops.

Author: GeertVanWolvelaerUrgup, Turkey
Title: cheap and good
Review: We had a pizza at this location, which was not the best I had in my life, but that's hard to expect. You are not in Italy after all. It was fresh made though, and service was good for a local resto. Prices for other items seem very reasonable compared to its quality.

Author: kimjB7537GWPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: One Hit Wonder
Review: It is the 5th day of CNY so not surprisingly not many Chinese eateries are opened yet. Since it was the only Chinese shop opened in the area hence why not check this place out since there has been some word of the food here is a must try.And yes it was a must try once only! We as a family of 3 order 2 big char siew wan tan mee and a small bowl together with 2 kopi ”0” ice and hot Chinese tea, overall food was at best 6/10 would have given more if not for the following1. The wantan was so small with only a spec of meat inside.2. Soup is heavily peppered up which can be to hide its lack of taste and a possible additional additive ”MSG”3. The char siew was awesome however seems to be slightly undercooked by the taste of the fats but it was again heavily masked by the thick char siew sauce.Despite it, all, why this restaurant to me carries a 1 rating is because of the price. In all my total bill was RM35! This kind of price is only acceptable if it was in at least an air-conditioned restaurant but it wasn't and the cleanliness is so so only.I technically feel being cheated eating here the price i paid was not justified base on the food and ambience. Anyways i leave it to you to decide if you are willing to pay so much for so less.

Author: ColinS2639Japan
Title: Don't get it.
Review: I know the bar is set very low, but if you're recommending Hungarian goulash, pad Thai and cocktails in an Irish bar you really need to get out more.140 ringgit for a ok steak, cooked incorrectly and half a gin and tonic, ain't really a bargain, but if it's impressing everyone , please stay in KL and enjoy yourselves.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: arthurthetravellerIncheon, South Korea
Title: They do sing happy birthday to you!
Review: So, I'm a vegetarian so it's not much choices for me - I ordered salad which was ok (others finished the pulled pork for me) and I ordered fried noodle which was really really good! However my friends had tried other branches and they commented it's not quite standardised..

Author: Sierra1IrelandIreland
Title: Disappointing
Review: we were disappointed by our meal here. it is out of town so you are required to take a taxi there and back but we assumed it would be worth it given the reviews. the waitress was very helpful and talked us through the menu, giving recommendations. the food was very disappointing. I ordered a chicken dish and most of the chicken consisted of bone with no edible meat. my husband ordered the pork, 99% of which was fat. I appreciate that this may be a traditional way of eating pork however it was not to our taste at all. we left hungry and went to another restaurant for dessert. The setting itself is nice and lots of interesting artefacts on the wall. I also agree with another reviewer who noted the modern pop music was not in keeping with the traditional restaurant and it would have been nice to hear some authentic music. they ask for tips and have a large tipping basket for you to leave money in. they also suggest that you can tip your own waiter separately. I felt this was a bit pushy. we will not be returning.

Author: wanjiingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good experience
Review: Visited the restaurant after all the good reviews that I have seen. Their herbal duck was really tasty and their char siew was really good. We ordered additional kang kong to our lunch, which was not bad however it was alittle oily. But overall, the food was pretty good!

Author: 683JudyG
Title: lunch
Review:
Everything is no good. Soup is free for all diners.
Yong Tau Foo filling was hard. Must be overcooked. Noodle was too dry. Service so so

Author: CLLohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Doesn't live up to hype
Review: Went with colleagues for dinner this week. Location is central. Environment very rustic looking. Looks enticing indeed.However we feel the food doesn't live up to the atmosphere. The steak was too tough and rare. The pasta was almost flooding in oil. I applaud the creative fusion ideas that went to the dishes but somehow the delivery didn't quite went as well as the ideas.

Author: AnnaK16984
Title: Overrated
Review: Visited the food stall today but it’s really more for tourist. The seafood was just average and disappointing.

Author: alistair15
Title: Refreshing drinking time
Review: Enjoy the view and ambient of the cafe. Drinking is a must after a hot day around Melaka. Food is always good. Crowded yet with enough room to feel comfortable.

Author: danial8704Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: normal seafood restaurant with nice view
Review: this is the second time i be here and the service still the same(feb and may 2013 dinner peak hour weekend). take a average 10 minute for the waiter to give the menu and 40minute to 1 hour for the food be deliver. the seafood is fresh however overcooked the prawn and cuttlefish. The taste is just average so do the price but the service is not acceptance. The restaurant should invest more on labour during peak hour and improve the food quality. To come here must pay parking RM2 per entry. Maybe it better to go during non peak hour. The view is very beautiful and good for taking photo

Author: vsmitra
Title: Not at par with other hotels of the chain
Review: I have tried saravana bhavan's food in other countries as well, but this outlet doesn't stand up to thier brand. Had ordered Naan and some curries which disappointed us thoroughly. There are many other indian hotels near by that serve better food.

Author: L54Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super duper expensive
Review: I just wanNa know why a nachos should cost me 90 RM They didn’t have any happy hour , just offer one type of beer and the food was so expensive for the place and quality.There is awesome restaurant in Melaka so try to go there . For normal meal for of us spend 600 RM there .

Author: Michelle CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: They serve tasty chicken rice.
Review: I took fried chicken rice and also the boneless fried chicken skewers. Both were nice and tasty. The owner of the restaurant was not very friendly and no smile. No menu not food price been displayed so you will have some hard time in deciding what to order.

Author: ipsitag2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 'Unpleasantly' surprised
Review: After reading rave reviews we decided to try out this cafe for breakfast. The menu is quite innovative and the food looks as delicious as the pictures. However for some strange reason it tastes quite bad. I ordered the rosti - 1. Yes, it did look as delightful as the picture on the menu/ fb post 2. The food was room temperature, not even warm 3. The mushrooms and spinach were soggy and a goopy mess 4. The rosti was more like a small thick potato cake...slightly burnt, witha grainy sawdust kinda texture 5. Everything was underseasoned 6. The turkey slice which my husband was having in his cavemans breakfast wss stiff and smell indicating it frozen and stale 7. The juices were average 8. To add to our woes, the cafe is situated at a corner plot in Publika and occasionally there was a waft of smell from a sewage drain which really killed it.8. The best bit about my food were the few crispy mushrooms added to the dish

Author: kennethkongkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Severely understaffed
Review: Visited with a group of 12, where there was visibly only two service staff. We ordered a variety of dishes, most were alright except for the fish which was salted too heavily, beef steak which was rather dry, avoid the mixed grill as well - lamb chop was alright.The potato wedges which we ordered for starters came after everyone finished their mains, is it a dessert?The coffee drinks also took ages, more than half an hour, served only after the mains were out - ???Environment was good though, just watch out for the army of mosquitoes in the evening as it’s surrounded by greenery - in hindsight we should’ve went to an air conditioned place. Seems like a good place for a lunch or coffee by the waterfront, expected better food and service, but perhaps they were understaffed that night.

Author: nathassja w
Title: Eating ikan pari and delicious chicken wings 👍🏻
Review: A few of friends refer me to visit this restaurant in Jalan Alor. Tried it, it is very delicious worth to try. Their chicken wings is the best. Ikan pari is a must, the rest of the food is a choice of what you like (preference). The price is so so. But you need to ask for the invoice to see whether they charge you the wet tissue (0,60RM per pcs) eventhough you are not using themFYI, they always gave wet tissue in the beginning (it is NOT FREE), better to not using them. They provide wash basin anyway.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: Soo Kok C
Title: The food was only average
Review: Tried their breakfast set. At RM4.50, it was value for money but the food was only average. Nothing to shout about,

Author: Samuel KBratislava, Slovakia
Title: Very good weatern dishes
Review: I have been here couple of times, asian food was decent. But the last visit I opted for western meal and was taken by surprise. Greates pork chops I have had out in asia. Also very helpful and nice staff. If you are on a longer trip and get in mood for some familiar taste, go for it. Pricing is also very reasonable. Nice place.

Author: cttclaire
Title: Over rated
Review:
Business minded. Commercialized. 
Food: Costly but so so. Not worth the price. Too much of Ajinomoto. 
Nothing worth to mention. Over advertised by online bloggers.

Author: manasicajeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed and left wondering why HRC has invaded Melaka
Review: Disappointed with this HRC outlet… I always order the Nachos at HRC and the version served in Melaka was drowning in fake, liquid, fluorescent cheese.On the brightside, the staff here are some of the friendliest you’ll ever meet, and the location is inspired… right at the start of Jonker market and on the river facing the iconic Dutch Square and Christ Church. And our kids loved everything they ate.I’m a fan of HRC and make a point to visit when staying in a new city. But there is something unsettling about the appearance of HRC in Melaka. Melaka has managed to retain a certain “heritage village on the river” vibe, and I’m seriously afraid for the town now that American megachains have arrived. Don’t get me wrong… I do enjoy a good American megachain. But I just feel like this isn’t the place.

Author: peng_yew
Title: cheap cheap good good
Review: mouth watering choices of food, reasonable pricing. Only in Miri that one can find this sort of serving local Indonesian food. Must try food in Miri

Author: Albert SMalaysia
Title: A far way to go
Review: We are Nobu fans, but Malaysia Nobu i the lowest from all Nobu we have been, service is not there, staff not trained quality is not there as other Nobu's.But the most irritating is when you do a booking they pretent they are full and high standard, As they ask please note we have a dress code casual no slippers and shorts allowed, but when you arrive there is other way round , people where sport shoes and shorts and cheap or give away advertising T shirts, No standard at all. This is sure not Nobu. and the restaurant is mostly half empty.I think its time for the management to look in to the details and quality when they really would like to sustain here.

Author: Jeroven MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good atmosphere and service
Review: Very good service, relaxing atmosphere. Staff (Kyle and Emy) are very attentive. Delicious local twist to the creme brulee, and cendol

Author: E5711HHandytSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the price.
Review: I placed a reservation 2 weeks before arrival and ordered a suckling pig. Upon arrival, there was a promotion menu of RM850 which included the suckling pig and a few items which I wanted to order originally. So I took the promotion package which is nett price and included the tea and service charge. Firstly, the suckling pig texture was jus not right. The skin was crispy, but when you take a bite of it, the fats and meat could not be detached from the skin. They whole piece remain chewy in your mouth. The steam pomfret is over cooked. And it is lukewarm when served. And some of the shell of the prawns stuck to the meat when shelling. The recommended oyster noodle was blend. I asked to replace one dish with the duck which taste ok, no wow factor. The rest of the dishes taste just ordinary. For this price, I seriously would not recommend.

Author: calvinl1078
Title: overrated
Review: This restaurant prices is overrated and most of the cooks is foreign workers.Food is spicy and salty. not recommended.

Author: EnigmaticvampirePort Louis
Title: Buffet and seafood
Review: If you are a big fan of seafood and you like to eat eat eat then its the place to go! I am not a big fan of buffet and specially asian or chinese cuisine... So i wont say i didnt like it or either enjoyed it! But i had a large variety of food...On that day we went for dinner there, we were a group of 10 persons so we set the atmosphere hehe! There was japanese sushi, teriaki, chinese food with fried noodles and many more, malay cuisine and indian cuisine... So there was a large variety of food and i can say i really like the dim sum as it was pork free ( the only place i an sure i can eat dim sum without pork) However it is with an elevated price and for the same sum you can eat muh better or i should say non buffet

Author: syabilazman
Title: great place but the food just ok
Review: the place its self really stunning..its a very small cafe..but the food below par for my personal opinion.A bit pricey for the food but ok with ambience.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A restaurant model that everyone else should follow
Review: What I mean by the title? Instead of being fancy, such as fine dine, good solid restaurant business should simply offer great value to customers in terms of food, quality, ambience, service etc. In return, the customers will recognize the value and return to the restaurant again and again.There is little wonder why this restaurant keeps climbing the charts on Tripadvisor year after year. It has great ambience (old time Penang), great lighting, decor and ambience, friendly and knowledgeable staff, excellent food and unbeatable pricing for what a customer is getting. Just hope that everything stays the same.Although tucked in a small alley that is a little challenging to find even to the locals, but it is definitely worth the "treasure seeking" journey to get to it.Please note, this is a small restaurant with limited seatings, do call and book in advance (they still take bookings at the time of this article)

Author: Celestar989Singapore, Singapore
Title: Bad Ribs
Review: Dined here on a weekday evening. It was surprisingly bad at the Pavilion branch as I had no issues with their Genting SkyAvenue branch or their Singapore branches. I was the first customer for dinner service with no other customers around. Ordered their signature full slab pork ribs with Hickery BBQ sauce. Dish took 30mins to be served despite being the 1st customer, only to realize the wrong sauce was used. Was served the Garlicky sauce instead. Complained to the waiter who brought it back to the kitchen. 5mins later, the correct dish was served. With just 5mins needed to replace the dish, I was 100% sure the chef just scrapped off the garlicky sauce and poured lots of Hickery sauce over the ribs in the hope of masking the garlic taste. I never had pork ribs submerged in so much BBQ sauce before which you can see from my photo. Took a bite and yes I could taste both the BBQ and garlic sauce which spoilt the overall taste. The pork ribs was also overcooked as the meat was hard. Very disappointed with the food. The chef at Pavilion outlet ought to be retrained or let go.

Author: YH CKuala Lumpur
Title: :D this was a terrible experience...
Review: I read somewhere that said they served good food. So I ignored the rude staff that answered the phone to take my reservation...I turned up at the restaurant and was impressed with the decor and ambiance... frontline staff seemed friendly enough... and the non-smoking section was actually in one corner of the restaurant (Not a choice corner...)... so if you can bear the smoke - pick to sit at the smoking section.The food... it was poor... it was amateurish like it was prepared at a pasar malammm on nice plates and fancy cutleries.... the prawn was overcooked and the squid was rubberish and the fish was not fresh..... :/We dont like to make a fuss, so we finished our food and left for another place for dessert - not about to waste our stomach space for badly prepared food. :D It was a costly dinner too.... not that worth it, i feel. :)

Author: LivLuvKL
Title: Try the Mixed Platter but the portion is not for sharing!
Review: The menu here is not very extensive with a selection of sandwiches, limited main course and dessert. We had the  Mixed Platter, a delicious combination of grilled sausages, ribs and chicken served with a side salad. The portion is just nice for one person but...More

Author: broke05Hong Kong
Title: only to fool those who don't know Hakka food
Review: a typical tourist book syndrome. The menu does not represent authentic Hakka food. It is a place for the Chinese-Malaysian to collect their nostalgia memories and to heal their lost appetite. Poor service, rude response. Remind me of the cooked food stalls in HK. The servers are only making orders and collecting dishes.

Author: ppylee
Title: Tangy ramen!
Review: Got hooked on this ramen after my friend told me about it. One of the better ramen shops in town. The lunch set is good value for money. So I normally go for that. Service is good too.

Author: icebaby0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food isn't as fantastic and yes, the elder owner is abit rude
Review: The food isn't fantastic. The food we ate at another place was better. I think my late grandmother-in-law make better Nyonya food. What I dislike was the elder owner who is abit "proud" and told us we had to "reserve" cos they are very booked. But the best joke is, when we went at night, there wasn't any other table except us thru the night! And it is a weekend by the way.

Author: ladysnapeacklesWilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Modestly Ordinary
Review: Came here with my family due to television recommendation.Restaurant Ambience: Simply decorated, extremely clean, spacious & comfortable feeling. Location: Easily located inside a shopping mall. Food: Serving Chinese cuisine. Food are presented well but the taste are quite flat or salty. The lamb skewers are extremely good but they use the same flavourings for squid & chicken so I would not recommend ordering the variety. Services: Staff are friendly with a smile on their faces & professionally uniformed. Price: Considering other high-end Chinese restaurant, the price is cheap comparatively. Conclusion: Worth a try if you wanted to taste halal Chinese cuisine that does not bore a hole in your wallet.

Author: sodesa
Title: Disappointing
Review: Was recommended by friends to visit Tuck Kee restaurant. Aside from the signature smoked duck which my wife liked, the other squid & bean curd dishes were very ordinary. Perhaps we ordered the wrong dishes. Service was slow. Disappointing

Author: myewee_Singapore
Title: Great dim sum here.
Review: We had a fairly great dim sum here at Dolly. We ordered not very much items for 6 person. The service here was good.

Author: MWeePhotographySingapore, Singapore
Title: Definitely NOT classic nonya food...
Review: We've tried getting a table at Nancy's a couple of times but were unsuccessful as they were always packed. We managed to get a seat this time round though because we waited for them to commence their operations outside the restaurant (which in itself was weird, their facebook profile and a few other reviews listed wrong operational hours?!)So, after reading through numerous positive reviews about this restaurant, and us having tried pretty hard to get a seat the last few times, we were pretty excited. Unfortunately for us though, we did not hold back on the ordering. We had the popiah and the kueh pai tee as starters, with the sambal prawns, chicken "buah kuluak", mixed vegetables, banana flower curry and the nonya "sio bak" (it was a table of 2 to put things into perspective). Firstly, the popiah was probably the worst popiah I have had. The skin was too thick, the bamboo shoot was too soggy and the entire dish was too sweet. To be fair, the kueh pai tee's were not that bad, and the only grievance I had with this starter was that they served it with the wrong chili. The sambal prawns and the buah kuluak was not that bad either (although the chicken was tasteless). The biggest disappointment on the table was the sio bak. I've had the privilage to have tasted some really good sio bak, and this version was no where near the level of anything I have tasted before.Visit this restaurant if you do not mind below mediocre food set in a rustic environment. Any thing else and you would be disappointed.

Author: mariamzaidi8
Title: Nice
Review: It’s a great place to hangout with a nice view and atmosphere. Good music as well and friendly waiters.

Author: IsRazakBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Dinner with a friend.
Review: I have been to this branch few times before. Experiences before was good. But the rating is based on the visit date. And it is terrible when I asked for corn on cob and it is still freezer cold inside! Outside was like it wasn't cook well. Quite warm to touch but after biting into it, inside was just like it came out of the fridge! Food cold is a no no for me. As an establishment this sizs they should know it well.The starter bread used to come warm. Not so this time around. It was the start of the meal.The rib was reasonable but somehow you got the feeling the cooks were not too keen with the presentation. But regardless, it was reasonably good with one of the three being quite tough.Sorry . I do expect much more from a chain establishment this size. It is one of the restaurants I like to go to if I'm in the area. This was one of the dissapointing visit due especially because of the corn.

Author: ron255100
Title: Good place for Jazz
Review:
Did not here.
The Jazz show was good (cover charge applies)
Small venue so might need to book 
Like most places in KL alcohol is expensive for mediocre wines.
Ratings based on show and service.

Author: Hafli_aliBrunei Darussalam
Title: Craving for desserts
Review: I came here llooking and craving for its desserts Panna Cotta....it was delicious and price is reasonable. I never get the chance to taste the other menu. will come back here once i go to kl again. staff was attentive ,place are clean suitable for business meeting and celebrate wedding anniversary so on.

Author: AnneTseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: Just popped in for a quick lunch, was disappointed with the level of service, one staff pulled the chair from my table to another table harshly, the female staffs standing around didn't bother to pass me the bill until i requested for the second time, not even a courteous smile and thank you was expressed. I have experienced the same terrible service the first time i came here last year, if it wasn't on a sunday afternoon with all other restaurants packed, i wouldn't have stepped in here the second time.Totally appalled!

Author: Elysium_elyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Feel Cheated!
Review: i dine in last sunday for the buffet due to friends recommendations and advertise snow crab and slipper lobster. upon sited and order our drinks we found out the snow crabs and slipper lobster is not available. we feel completely rip off and cheated. they downgrade the food but still paying the same price. the staff told they replace this with small crab and prawns. which is not fresh! as of today the website advertisement of the snow crab and lobster is still there and this is a complete scam i shall say! now they are telling me these is seasonal items. well season items should not mislead in the adver. kindly replace this with your garlic fried rice and basic vegetables as this you can provide to your customer ever day! i do not recommend this place for the buffet and the price is not up to par of the quality of the food and the price you pay!

Author: anne_milley
Title: Good
Review: Pleasant dining place, breakfast is fantastic,food were nice, we enjoyed our meal so huge portion nothing else all great

Author: pj30298570Leuven, Belgium
Title: Worst dining experience of my life at ikano chillis
Review: We made a reservation. Since it was a group they asked for our picks on beforehand. When we arrived they were already putting the food on the table and judging the temperature of the food it was already standing there for quite some time. We had to sitdown and eat, not even got the chance to order drinks or so.When we complained they were very very rude so i also became quite rude and very unhappy!Apart from that i judge the food not really good there are better places to eat in the area for cheaper price.Never again!!!

Author: aaong86
Title: Disappointing
Review: Their xiao long bao's skin was a bit too thick. The la mian was average. The pork which came with the la mian was tough. There is lots of room for improvement.

Author: Tautvydas MRamuciai, Lithuania
Title: Nice view over the windows,but...
Review: Spending time in one city we always change restaurants for dinner and compare them.This restaurant is located at 38th floor Grand Hyatt hotel so all the city is below our legs, just Petronas towers are above. Anyway we were not delighted by our meals. We are fish and seafood fans.Traveling around Malaysia we found everywhere that restaurants giving Continental menu think that for Europeans salmon {*we do not think it is fish...) and cod fish( it is more a stake) must fit. Where are- sea bass, sea bream, john dory,red snapper, barramundi etc ? So we took Chines way sweet/sour grouper ,two different ways of cooking, but both were very similar...Restaurant was almost empty ,so personnel for nothing to do all the time tried to steel our bread( we keep bread till the end of dinner as long as we have wine). Positive thing is extensive wine list and I counted 5 sorts of Pinot Noire which we like most. So traveling in Malaysia we prefer to visit buffet dinners as there we can find something to eat...

Author: premgoody
Title: Quite expensive
Review: We went with kids to buy tee shirts but unfortunately the prices are quite expensive so we came out with just small purchases - I thought the prices were cheaper than USA etc.

Author: Lauren S
Title: Average food, great interior
Review: My boyfriend and I both have spent a good amount of time in Asia, but we still found the interior of the place interesting and somewhat exotic without being tacky. Unfortunately the food wasn't as great as our initial impressions about the interior. Satay was fine (if somewhat overpriced), the dumplings were nothing special and our soft shell crab salad was not bad, but definitely lacked the crisp that I'd want from a fried soft shell crab.

Author: Fuwa C
Title: Average
Review: Price is affordable. Limited seats inside. Go after 330pm less people and can eat comfortably. During lunch time it's full and had to Q up. Go during weekdays is advisable

Author: HochopepaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Food drenched in oil, tried to charge me for a tissue
Review: Ate here a few nights ago and was very unimpressed. The food was so deeply drenched in oil that I had heartburn for quite a few hours afterwards. The staff make no attempt to send the street hawkers away, so they come to your table and try to sell you things while you eat. At one point, this involved having a laser shone directly into my eye. The staff also tried to charge me for a tissue. The only redeeming feature of this restaurant is that their fresh cold coconuts taste incredible and are reasonably priced at 5 ringgit. Many better and cheaper street food stalls elsewhere.

Author: abghoudini
Title: Large Portion of Food!
Review: Wonderful food + Great atmosphere. But remember the portions are large so choose wisely...my favourite dish has to be the Nestum Prawns!

Author: JacobA1577
Title: Awesome Japanese dinner
Review: Personally served by the manager, Yeoh.Great food and excellent environment.Highly recommended for business gathering.

Author: pteo66
Title: Unimpressive thai food
Review: Tomyum soup was not impressive. Phad thai was just average. Overall food is abit sweet. Halal place suitable for muslim

Author: highfever88
Title: Average Cendol
Review: We only had the cendol shaved ice. It was average tasting. We had wanted to taste the Nyonya food, eg noodles but was sold out when we went at 9pm on Sunday. So, go earlier if you want to try the food.

Author: Seatroutfisher-1Hexham, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful atmosphere!
Review: Kyushigai is a yakitori restaurant in Chinatown - and if you sit outside you can actually watch the chef at work...and he is sooo precise! Wonderful to watch. The staff's English is not great, which could account for some of the reviews mentioning service. We found them very efficient and just fine! Excellent spot for an evening drink too.

Author: Marky226
Title: Worst coffee ever beware
Review: Had the M boutique hotel breakfast here & experience the worst coffee ever...black water with a tint taste of coffee

Author: PatrickMcAllisterChristchurch
Title: Friendly atmosphere but average food
Review: we tried this place with high expectations due to good reviews on Tripadvisor but were very disappointed with the quality of the food. My steak sandwich was average, with overcooked steak (no option to have it rare or medium) on a good crisp Panini and a tasty sauce, with well made French fries. However my partner's prawns were very soft and tasteless, not firm at all as prawns should be, and the spicy sauce they were in was TOO spicy (and she is a person who loves spicy, chilli-hot food). The supposedly stir fried chicken that accompanied it was strange - white squares of rather tasteless meat. To be fair, the owners deducted the price of this dish from the bill, acknowledging that it was not up to standard. The passion fruit cocktail was good.

Author: MizSally24Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cold horrible stiff Beef Steak
Review: The name of the restaurant says it all.. Serving western food, steak, chicken chop, etc. I was there for dinner. First, the service was lousy. We had to signal a few times to get their attention. The waiters and waitress were not attentive. They seemed to be looking at other places and chatted a lot.. a waiter came and gave the menu.The menu was really in a horrible state, they should change itThe table setting was not done properly. I wasn't given cutleries to eat my food. The food and drinks were served fast but it was cold, and not fresh. The fries had hardened and I had to ask for them to fry another fresh batch. This was greeted with a sour face from the waitress. Probably she was tired but that was not the way to treat paying cuatomers.Not a good place for steak.

Author: princess1224Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: average only
Review: try this asam pedas clay pot after knew it by website that one of the famous place for eating in melaka.we go for dinner.the shops were combine by two shops.crowded by mostly malay,then chinese tourist (maybe like us too). 1 claypot fish serve with a plate of white rice,half piece of salt egg and few of fried cabbage,cost around RM8-9.honestly to be said,the taste vary from the name,yes...perhaps every place taste &cooking style will different...but,we are not so satisfy as the taste was vary from what we imagine...yes...asam pedas,suppose to be sour & spicy,but,we only can taste it spicy,nothing was sour(asam).feel very dissapointed...anyway,since we reach,just try it...perhaps we are really misunderstanding on each place got their own taste....

Author: AndyGers766Culcheth, United Kingdom
Title: Good, slightly odd vibe
Review: Another Nobu outpost. This time headed I believe by the chef who got them a Michelin star in London at Berkeley St (no longer).Great location in the twin towers, (well, technically next door) with views to match. Dress code felt odd. I go to London branches in jeans or shorts but I put up with it. Boss lady was a bit overbearing I felt but i suppose she was keeping the staff in check!Food good, drinks good. Pricey of course. Assume cool spot at night.

Author: WongHY17Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Large buffet, average taste
Review: Department dinner in Contango on a weekday.The cooking stations were divided into several islands - Japanese, seafood, Indian etc...You can pay extra charge for free flow beer.Contango undoubtedly provide a large buffet variety, but I don't feel there was any memorable dish.The only thing I remember is the fine cheese selections.  Perhaps my expectations were too high, but I can't help feeling a little underwhelmed.

Author: Truls NMadrid, Spain
Title: Different and probably tribal food and cheap prices, but...
Review: We arrived at the same time as a big pre-order party, so this must maybe excuse some of the lacking focus on us. And the atmosphere is "local" and prices very low, so one must maybe adjust expectancies thereafter. If you do, the place is friendly and cozy, the many of the drinks and food are interestingly different from what you're used to, the lamb and chicken we tried were OK, the ice cream desserts nice, and the Tuak rice wine a nice new somewhat nutty experience to go with the desert. But the dishes for the four of us were served at very different times, cutlery came a long time after the warm dish was served, and the pineapple veggie curry hardly worth being called a main dish (or curry). The glasses of house wine were as poor (or perhaps oxidized) as they were cheap, and the coffee watery. So all in all - different, interesting, and very cheap - but hardly worth its certificate of excellence.

Author: akmalh90
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Been there to celebrate anniversary. Really don't know what to order really. But the waiter was so amazing, explaining what's the best for the special event. Love the food (especially dessert with fireworks) and the place. Recommended.

Author: deen_nonisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So so
Review: I came in for dinner and ordered the Tomyam Meehoon Soup @ RM12.90 and also the Thai Tea. I understand that the Tomyam Meehoon Soup was supposed to come together with a drink but the drink was not served.Our bill came to a total of RM17.90;Tomyam Meehoon @ RM12.90Thai Tea @ RM5.00I managed to ask why is my Thai Tea RM5.00 instead of just a top-up of RM2.00, the lady at the counter said that the promo is only for LUNCH HOUR.Paid, took the balance and left the place without realizing that they did not serve the plain Iced Tea together with the meal.Only realized that after arriving at my next food destination.P/S: I jump restaurants to review the food in my blog, the reason I was being really in a hurry.By the way, the Tomyam Meehoon Soup tasted a little too spicy and very sour. Other than that it was OK. The Thai Tea was also OK.

Author: TravelwithGarIreland
Title: Came to Cba bar for the cocktails - terrible let down
Review: Wow, had been looking forward to sundown cocktails at Cba bar, based on an old recommendation - but what a disappointment. Clear sense that the cocktail crew think they are better than they are.The location is pretty excellent, right beside the beach & perfect for sunset. However, the Margarita barely tasted of any alcohol, completely diluted and tasteless - hard to know how they got it so wrong. I had the Horizon (?) Punch which had most of the ingredients of a Mai Tai, which I fancied, but with the added addition of grenadine syrup. I had specifically asked up front to just add a drop of the syrup, but of course no one listened and I was presented with a strawberry coloured concoction which went straight back.If you are putting yourself out there as a cocktail spot you have to deliver the goods and most especially if you are charging the higher end pricing!We didn't try the restaurant and based on our albeit limited experience it did not endear itself to us. Very easily rectified if there is a will to get it right!

Author: stayz17Kuala Lumpur
Title: Standard has dropped!
Review: Dined at the midvalley outlet twice this month to entertain some foreign business associates who wanted to try 'malaysian' food. The overall food quality and taste has definately dropped compared to the earlier days when the restaurant started. The dishes did not have an authentic taste anymore. Maybe the chefs have tweeked the taste to suit visitors?

Author: LoveTravel275559
Title: Mr
Review: They made my day with all the songs and friendly entertainment. Simply that. Be there be happy and be with the host and new friends

Author: Veronica-food-lover
Title: Dinner with friends
Review: If you know about Italian food, this is the place to eat it, if you don't know it, this is the right place for a memorable experience. We had dinner with friends, their set dinner is value for money and the portions are just nice. The waiting time between the courses is quite short and the environment is very welcoming. What has left us most amazed about this restaurant is the attention to detail, the kindness of the Restaurant Manager and the friendliness of the Chef who visited us at the end of the dinner. The hand-made pastas, the leg of lamb and their mascarpone and vanilla ice cream are excellent. We will be back!

Author: NanYang HSingapore, Singapore
Title: What it has reduced to....
Review: Went to Kenny Roger's Roaster Bukit Indah AEON Mall outlet yesterday, it was a total disappointment !Ordered Country Chic Steak, chicken breast steak was very dry and hard, probably it was baked for too long, and placed in the keep-warm chamber for too long, it was salty despite it claimed as low salt healthy dish.The muffin has no standard, even the lowest quality bread was used for the Cheese hot dog we ordered.Very sad for such a reputable restaurant has became to.

Author: fawzy65
Title: The Village Biryani Cafe is a great Indian restaurant in downtown Johor Bahru. It is 3 blocks north of Danga City Mall.
Review: The vegetarian selection is great, as usual for Indian restaurants. The service is prompt and pleasant. The inside of the restaurant is very nice and gives you a view into the kitchen. It is air conditioned and very pleasant.

Author: 361anaisb
Title: Poor services, average food but great view
Review:
We didn't have a great experience. 
Minimun service and very slow.
Sandwich are full of mayo.
Wrong plate served. 
I don't recommend this place

Author: LounissartHKHong Kong, China
Title: Yummy Dim sum
Review: This is a fine Chinese restaurant for any occasion. The service was attentive and prompt. The dim sum was served piping hot along with all the XO sauce that I possibly want as a condiment. The waiter kindly informed me when i had ordered enough dishes for 2 as so not over order as I normally do when I travel :). The most memorable dish (surprisingly) was the steamed egg custard buns. One of the best I'd ever had and I've had a lot!

Author: wong l
Title: go for lunch
Review: the food there serve many types of food n drink more on chinese style many food they have i like alot mostly i order coffee ice n horfan n fishcake
Restaurant: Permas Jaya One Two Eat Cafe

Author: CrookedviewGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Delicious local fare
Review: Nice local Malaysian food at a good price. The service was friendly service but not so accurate on orders, had to repeat ourselves a few times. However the waitress was friendly and willing to help where she can. The food all tasted good and was presented well.

Author: tareqmadanatAmman, Jordan
Title: Terrible service and impolite staff
Review: We sat outside overlooking the fountain and ordered starters and main courses and a dessert for the kid.They took too long to serve the appetizers (45 minutes) despite the reminders and 2 of us received their main course and one of us didn't. He reminded the staff and waited for another 15 minutes and didn't get his order. Then he requested them to cancel the order and decided to go to somewhere else.The problem is that none did say sorry for the delay or apologized for causing this which left us feel mad.We informed them that we will review that on Tripadvisor but they didn't care.To be honest, the food was delicious but the service is the worst ever.

Author: bebechan541
Title: saltiest ramen ever!
Review: we ordered signature bankara ramen and konuni bankaran ramen..both ramen is very oily and this is the saltiest ramen i ever ate in my entire life！！！i drank 3 cup of green tea to refresh my throat！ can you imagine how salty is it？wont visit again.

Author: Little BKL
Title: Bad service!!!!
Review: Waiter attitude sucks. Practically ignored us as we are transparent when we asked for seating direction. DO NOT COME DURING PEAK HOURS. You'll be ignored as well like me and some other clients. Food is just so-so, but not worth the bad experience dining here. Waiter/Boss (unsure the guy who served us) is a Chinese guy. One of those restaurant who gotten proud after business gotten good.

Author: Kimirosh
