Title: Hell Disappointed
Review: Very poor service. The Food took a very long time to be serve and yet it was bland. Not recommeded to dine at Madam Kwan's KLCC.

Author: Venture744273
Title: Too good to be true...racist and rude
Review: Racist, and rude...food sucks not as being heard..prices so expensive for simple nasi lemak and the menu nothin special compare to other places... more gimic in sales instead of taste...not recommended to all. Recently owner show disrespect toward one of local vege seller..whole Mirian burst in anger... Place to avoid..

Author: mrctlimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Let down by one arrogant staff
Review: A heavily decorated house with ethnic artifacts all around. Ambiance was great. Menu was extensive. Food came quickly once an order was placed (suggests pre-prepared dishes, but that's ok). Fair prices. Food quality was fair to good.Only irritant was an arrogant order taker who would not listen to what I had wanted, but that's ok too now because once we got that out of the way, the rest was fine.Would I return? Maybe not. There are other good options around the area and I don't want to get upset again by an arrogant waiter. (He was probably the supervisor there as well!)

Author: T7311IXlisamAdelaide, Australia
Title: We must have been unlucky!!!
Review: After reading reviews on here this was on our list of must visit places. On our third night in Batu Ferringhi we grabbed a table here for dinner for 3. We could not be seated outside as we hadn't booked but we were just happy to get a table and were looking forward to some amazing food!Andrew came in and we said hi and tried to chat a little, we knew it was a busy night but were not expecting to be fobbed off and ignored. He was trying to sort something with the aircon and thought he would answer our hello and general greeting when he was done....no, he just walked off.We gave our drinks order which came quickly and ordered our food. We sat and watched other six tables in the room fill up while we ate our first course. The spring rolls were ok as was the satay. We then sat and watched everyone else get their food orders in, their food arrive, some even got to eat their food and leave while we sat there waiting.It seems we were not alone as the table next to us managed to eat their entire meal before their drink order arrived even though they repeatedly asked for it.Our main food eventually turned up just as we were about to leave, with no apologies for it taking so long. One meal was wrong so we called back the lady who had taken our ordered and explained it wasn't what we had ordered - she took away the food with no apology and we were left waiting again for food to arrive. We had ordered a couple of different dishes to try so we ate what we had, while waiting for the correct food to arrive and then realised we still had another dish missing.Eventually the corrected meal arrived and was put down on the table and she just walked away without a word. The sizzling chicken I ordered was still nowhere to be seen so we pretty much gave up on even getting it, the fried rice we had been served was completely inedible and gluggy. Just as we were finishing up the food we had (and could eat) my sizzling chicken arrived which just tasted like chicken in bad gravy. Hardly any flavour at all and most also got left.We were extremely disappointed with our food, the night before in long beach had been much tastier and a fraction of the cost! It had taken nearly an hour for any food to arrive and the whole time we just got to listen to people screaming out to each other from the front and the kitchen which isn't the lively ambiance we had read about.It was complete chaos trying to find out how we could pay as all we wanted to do by now was leave. This took over 20 minutes just to pay!All I can think is we must have headed to Andrews on an off night but one thing is for sure - when we return to penang in December we won't be heading back here. A few people at the hotel we stayed at commented that he had expanded since their last visit and they thought it had gone down a little - maybe a victim of their own success and should have kept that smaller, more personal space with good customer service? Felt more like a loud, brash fast food joint than somewhere you could relax and enjoy your food.Would not recommend, sorry

Author: HertsOldieStevenage, United Kingdom
Title: Ok food in great setting
Review: Visited CBA for the island barbeque buffet on Saturday. Lovely location on the beach with great sunset views. Salads were very good especially the fetta cheese one. The barbeque items were OK but were cooked away from the restaurant.Wine offer was good, 1st glass only 10 MYR with the meal.

Author: Bushra J
Title: Not great
Review: Rice was somewhat uncooked, flavors of the food were off,meat was somewhat rubbery. Seating is outside so rather hot.

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Good overprice coffee and terrible food
Review:
We been there a few weeks ago...the deco is simple but nice. The coffee was ok but overpriced for a local coffee.

The most worst is the food. Sour pasta,tastyless and bad presentation.

We will never come back.

Author: Zsófia SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wide selection, but the set menu is a bit disappointng
Review: There are hundreds of dishes available at a price range of 12-25 mry each. It's delightful, after the painful hunts for veggie food at the hawker stalls.They also have a set menu every day with 3 small dishes for only 14 mry, but that was a bit disappointing.

Author: peilingf2020
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Fantastic service, no doubt of the good and delicious food..friendly environment definitely nice place to bring your friends and family members here.

Author: sarel206
Title: Food not well cooked
Review: Food was not well cooked(raw), staff never say sorry for that. Other food also not good. Expensive just for the brand DC, not for the food. Never come back again.

Author: TerenceTay89
Title: Lunch in Yue@Sheraton
Review: Great food presentation. Excellent service. Good environment and ambience. Therefore, I can dine in this restaurant safe & comfortably

Author: Winnie S
Title: Horrible!! Do NOT go here
Review: Really seems like they don't like white people at all! Service is terrible and it seems like you are more of a problem than a guest!

Author: Chelljay
Title: Wow - Massive dissappointment!!
Review: This restaurant is beyond disappointing! For such a fantastic view the food, atmosphere and service were terrible. If you like cheap and nasty buffet then this is your place. What we were expecting was something similar to 360 Bar and Dinning in Sydney. This restaurant however did not even know how to make a lemon lime and bitters (basic bar staple) then charge $10AUD for a vodka lemonade. To top off the night, the only place to get a cab if you are there at nighttime is from a taxi desk which charges double what it would normally cost to hire a cab. Save your money and go to the observation deck only and skip the restaurant. Very sad as it has potential to be an unforgettable dinning experience.

Author: RENERONOJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: buka puasa at Marriot
Review: Was there with few of friend for buka puasa buffet, the buffet was too much of curry and local food also with curry based. not so interested and not much chooses. little dessert but the worse part is not many international appetizer. Location is quite bad with teribble traffic and the main enterence was blocked for renovation so we felt struggling to enter the hotel. sorry, not worth it.

Author: Jeffrey HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas Claypot Kota Laksmana
Review: Cleanliness ; 1/10Tables are scattered on a parking zone. My table was near the drain go figure. Dirt and paper trash everywhere. Waiter & Order; 2/10Waiter hardly spoke and we are guessing what to order coz no menu. You have to look at the big board signage to order. Waiter did not oso explained the serving amount for 1 or 2. One pot can feed 2 person if you order for kids it oso comes with Rice, Salted egg, sambal belacan and boiled cabbage. Taste/Flavour; 1/10I myself cook Asam Pedas and there was so many ingredients is missing such as; Bunga KantanDaun Kesum/Adam Jawa/TamerindBelacan/Prawn PasteVery 2 FlatWe hate not finish our food so it was quite dreadful. Avoid at all cost if you have the choice go to Asam Pedas pokok besar better deal. It cost RM94 for 2 piece of Jenahak and 2 Fish Roe, 5 drinks Teh 0'Ice and 10 stick of satayThe taste of the food is tasteless and not recommended. Over sell by the Singaporean crowd. Sigh... Take it from me ..avoid avoid avoid.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: We were here to do food tasting for a company event. Everything we had was freshly prepared, so it took a while for us to get our food. Most of what we had were really good. However, the standard wasn't as good during the event - some of the food were not as tasteful (probably because they were prepared in big batches), plus the food was not being kept warm enough. All in all, I would say the standard was just average. They are however well known for their lunch promo, which is another reason why our food took a long time to arrive during the tasting. The place was packed and apparently, they cook the spaghetti in fresh batches (not pre-cooked, buffet style). The promo is called "Eat All You Can Spaghetti" which includes unlimited portions of 9 different types of spaghetti, soup, salad and soft drink, plus ice cream.

Author: Journey642369
Title: Decent environment and friendly staff
Review:
Nice environment and friendly staff☺
Exactly look like what show in the photo(menu) and taste nice.Love it!

Author: jinnjinnip
Title: Hmmm. To be honest below average.
Review:
Hmmm. To be honest below average. 
Doesn’t tastes good and it pricey. 
Not worth it all. Not recommended to dine here. I’m very disappointed.

Author: ingrid040Eindhoven, The Netherlands
Title: Good food, nice presentation, bare food in the sand
Review: The jala is the best restaurant @ the Andaman. Pricy but the food is very good. The setting is informal: bare feet in the sand.

Author: lisamerelyn
Title: nice food with great value!
Review: try its penang laksa. you won't regret. I will always come back here whenever i miss the real penang laksa.

Author: Daniel MZurich, Switzerland
Title: Tasty food, small portions and expensive. Free dessert for review.
Review: We had lunch here today. My spaghetti carbonara was at most an appetizer, a lot smaller than in the menu picture: -1 point. The food quality however was very good.And: this restaurant gives away free desserts in exchange for reviews (see picture). Therefore another point less.

Author: EmbracetheUnknownLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sky Dining at Strato, KLCC area
Review: Surprisingly quiet on a Friday lunch rendezvous, Strato is located at the top floor of this Troika building. Decor is very village rustic - simple & practical. As the place was practically empty, i sat by the window... while u may have a good panoramic view, most of KL is under construction so all you see is construction works going on below. I had the carbonara pasta wif duck york which was al-dente. Sprinkle wif toasted bacon, it was a simple village dishBraised beef cheek was melt-in-your-mouth & right amount of herbs & spices, with a nice touch of savouriness Steamed mussels were done just right, sprinkled with tomato puree & white wineWait staff was prompt, attentive but clinical. Well, if you feel generous & wanna blow a good chunk of your wallet, this is pretty good place to do it. Not cheap considering the “rustic village settings”, you are paying fine dining prices.Wll be back when I hit jackpot in Sports ToTo

Author: ivyhwiJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Average Chinese cuisine
Review: Something missing in the Tim Sum's taste...tried a couple of the ala carte dishes.. Food average....

Author: Laura N
Title: Really good laksa
Review: This place was a little out of the way for me and it wasn’t the easiest to figure out where to order but it’s probably the best laksa I’ve ever eaten. Really good flavours. Think it cost 7myr for a standard laksa.

Author: Joeyiwen
Title: Memorable Lunch at a Cozy Place
Review: It's always a place that comes to mind whenever friends return to town or for a casual gathering....good food, my favourite place to come for Honey Sabah Tea, very friendly staff and great service, especially Ms. Amber Loke! Had a lunch earlier today to celebrate one of my friend's birthday, turns out to have a surprise cake decoration for my friend, hence make it a memorable lunch for us, thank you Amber!

Author: HelenappleColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Great food, friendly owner
Review: We came across this place whilst looking for a late lunch place. The decor is fabulously quirky, with numerous antique and retro objects on display, which kept one of us occupied for a long time. Food was delicious - made by the owner's wife and spot on. And very cheap. Well worth searching this place out - it's a couple of minutes off the main tourist drag so quieter and more relaxed.

Author: MovaripPiravom, India
Title: Yummi, tasty and cheap food
Review: We had dinner from this restaurant last month. I like their buffet and pricing system; whatever you want take in a plate from the buffet arrangement and they will price it accordingly to the quantity and items you have taken. In this way, there is no food wastage and you can have many items in small portions as you like. The restaurant is busy most of the time, they open only at 7 pm onward.

Author: TKC192Wakefield, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly Staff and Great Food
Review: We visited Bulldog this evening, with our 8 year old daughter, for our first meal in Malacca. The restaurant is really easy to find (on a main road and with good signage). It’s modern in an industrial way. The staff were very pleasant and smiley and spoke excellent English. There was also a menu in English. We opted for two chicken dishes - the Nyonya Chicken Curry and the Lime Leaf Chicken dish as well as a lightly fried fish dish and some water spinach with garlic, along with rice. All of the food was absolutely delicious; it was spicy but not ridiculously so. We didn’t manage to eat everything but only because we were full. In total, the bill came to around RM140 but this included two rounds of drinks as well as the food which we felt was good value. I am sure there are cheaper restaurants but the food, staff and ambience were all excellent so we felt it was well worth it. In all, a lovely meal.

Author: hawktengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Feels like Thailand
Review: The place is nicely decorated to make you feel like you're in Thailand. Great location next to Publika shopping so you can have a break for food between your shopping. The Jumbo tomyam was the kind with more body and not the clear soul kind served with a generous portion. The green curry laksa was unique, possibly a fusion of Thai green curry and laksa. It is gently spicy.Overall a positive experience but not exceptional.

Author: Angel S
Title: Awful and dishonest cafe
Review: Went there during brunch time because I came across buy 1 free 1 offer through The Entertainer app. Before I ordered and I reconfirmed with the staff again on this offer and they told me it was valid and even introduced to me which main course could be ordered. When the bill came then only they told me the offer not valid on puclib holidays. Well, they could have told me in the first place but they didn't! Please train your staff and I really felt cheated. Plus, the food was really average and there are other places with better prices and services. Parking is expensive too. Think twice before you visit and I will never visit this kinda dishonest Cafe!

Author: jm0rrSydney, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: For a fine dining restaurant, this institution is left begging. The service was average,taking 30 min to bring 2 (very average) cocktails (Mojitos). The food was certainly below par. I had beef fillet for main which was tough and chewy and very modest in terms of portion size, which for 120RM. Dessert was berries with sabayon and ice-cream, the top of which had been blow torched to "caramelise" it....it looked horrible and tasted worse..burnt and bitter. It was inedible and was sent back. My uncle and aunt's meals were good...but 5 star, no.I would NOT recommend this place. There are much nicer (and cheaper) places to eat in KL which will not leave you with a bitter taste (literally).

Author: Wally SGalle, Sri Lanka
Title: G & T anyone?
Review: This is where the tourists hang out; an afternoon - evening bar that is better known for it's alcoholic beverages than anything else on the menu. As there are so few places to get a wide range of drinks, this is a 'must have place in the Old Town

Author: wisejwwErie, Colorado
Title: The food is horrible! How are there good reviews?
Review: The food is very very bad. I ordered 5 dishes, and all the same horrible quality. How? The reviews suggest a wonderful kitchen.. maybe it just went under new management? Must be. Paella came out in 3 minutes and is NOT paella... it’s like a McDonald’s version. Lamb came out dry and quite tasteless. I can go on and on. Wow I feel like I went to ‘that place’ where everyone knows not to go but me, yet TripAdvisor said it’s a go. Folks maybe something changed, but there is NO WAY those positive reviews are for this place. That’s just the food.. the drinks? Bottom shelf like you see at a sports bar in a tourist trap.

Author: CkgC74
Title: Average
Review: Had the Dim Sum with my friend, some of the Dim Sum too salty, some are hard especially the carrot cake, the prawn paste skin is not up to my expectation. Overall not worth the the price to pay, even it's a four star hotel.

Author: whiterose39Sri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: NOTHING TO SHOUT ABOUT
Review: I told my family about the dinner area in the Portuguese Settlement and we decided to visit there for our Christmas Dinner. We had wait for a bit for them to prepare the table for us. We than orderd Fried rice, Baked fish, Squid Fritters, Kangkung belacan, Kailan, Chicken Debal Curry and drinks. We had to wait a bit, we asked them how long would it take to get our food. The lady said "if we are patient, we would get nice food" now i dont think its a proper way to answer your customer. the Baked fish was not very fresh, tasted like mud. Squid Fritters was okay and that was the only thing on the menu for kids, as we had 2 children with us.Kangkung belacan was normal too. Debal Curry chicken also was not that great, they gave us more potatoes and gravy and not much chicken. We wanted some hot drinks and they said it was not available at all which was quite disappointing. Now when we finished, we realized that our Kailan never arrived. We called for the bill and the boss came and to collect our money, as we went through the bill with him, we told him we never got the Kailan, at that moment he asked us "Do you want the Kailan now" ??? We had finished our Dinner what are we going to do with the Kailan, utter nonsense la. As we were walking away, new customers came in and were seated, the lady boss was asking away to one of the waiters for hot drinks to be served, how come they could get hot drinks and we couldnt get it. Quite unfair service. While eating the baked fish, i got a bone that got stuck in my throat and started coughing, my brother in law immediately ran to the lady boss to ask for some rice, knowing quite well my situation, she took her own sweet time to get the rice for me.....haizzzz dont want to say about your service la. You are busy trying to serve Portuguese food, but have lost quality of real portuguese food.

Author: ihsanadh
Title: The best bacon in the city
Review: Visited this place in my visit to Kuala Lumpur last year, though didn't eat the bacon, just accompanied my friend who loves it so much.

Author: neary0105Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful experience and long waiting
Review: I came with my 2 kids. We are Asian French and were looking for the local/ fusion gastronomy. I was appealed by the good reviews I've read and when I saw the crowd when we arrived, I thought it would be a good experience. However, as we arrived, we were told to seat outside and never asked us if we wanted to go inside, but that was fine. We could not get the feel of the environment and decor that looked nice from the outside. 2 other tables arrived after us and were served before us. We have waited for 1h15 before getting the juice for my son. I had to get back to the waitress as I got frustrated to wait so long when the table next to us almost finished their dishes. I had to stay at the counter as nobody got back to me. When I took the order I specifically requested to have the sauce separated from my dish, but it came with it. It has been changed quickly though. The western dishes were not as fine as I thought, we probably should have chosen the local dishes. Might be due to the crowd of Saturday night but did not appreciated to be served after the 2 near tables who arrived after us, when I got 2 kids with me. I wouldn't recommend the deep fried mozzarella as very fat and oily. Not a good food experience overall, sorry.

Author: Henry LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is bad, and terribly overpriced !
Review: Restaurant ambiance may look good, but food is awful and overpriced.I tried it once on last Saturday, and will definitely not step into this restaurant anymore. You can much better food in Suria KLCC, otherwise walk for 10 mins to Pavilion for some good food. Avoid this restaurant if you don't want your good dinner moment spoiled !

Author: myrfnd
Title: Awesome food
Review:
Dishes cooked to perfection
Crowded n if large group advisable to book.
Try their beriani n Tandoori plus lamb dishes with naan.
Comfortable n clean n hospitable.
Better food with variety of dishes..
No regret

Author: Masta S
Title: Awesome Gateway
Review: They serve variety of western dishes such as burger, fish&chip,grill salmon, pasta and finger licking local food as well.. that goes well with cold tiger drought.. Farah & Betty is the staff you should look forward as they really make you feel comfortable being someone new to their place.

Author: lyndaholgatePerth, Australia
Title: Not open till 7pm!
Review: We saw this as No1 on Trip advisor & where very keen to try it! However, we had to go a bit earlier as we where staying at Reback Island & our last boat was at 7.45..... So when we arrived at the La Sal@ Casa del Mar hotel at 6pm, we asked where the restaurant was and was "Pointed" in the direction of "Outside the back". So off we went to end up standing on the beach wondering where it was for 10 minutes!! Eventually we where approached by the barman who must have seen our confusion only to be told the restaurant didn't open till 7pm!!! Think it would have been nice to have been informed this when we first entered. I think the times should def be advertised. :-(
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 645pamlWarlingham, United Kingdom
Title: Don’t come if you’re vegan or vegetarian!
Review: 1st night despite being told beforehand, there was very little to eat. I was served with curried noodles ....noodles with curry powder.... it was inedible so I went hungry! And it left a horrible taste in my mouth. No imagination whatsoever, & very disappointing.Surely it’s not too difficult to make laksa ?? Great pity. I am not a fussy eater at all but I am dreading breakfast
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Nuria POlot, Spain
Title: Disapointing
Review: Tasteless food. Eventhough the place is nice and the staff is friendly (they have made 2 mistakes inour order though) it doesn't woth it, the food is simply insipid. There are thousands of options to eat in Kuala Lumpur, and in the same Avenue K with much better value for money.

Author: TomRockyHeilbronn, Germany
Title: Beautiful beach restaurant
Review: Very nice setting and kids friendly. We had chicken and fish, the kids enjoyed burger. Chicken was a little try but overall nobody should expect Michelin star kitchen. Only problem was that we had to use our flashlight apps after sunset in order to find the food on the table.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Foodie111126
Title: One of the place for Coffee
Review: Coffee were strong, Chips and it condiment were delicious, really crispy outside and soft inside; baked egg no recommended

Author: RuchikaSrivastavaMumbai, India
Title: Boring!
Review: No music until 10pm. They have a live band after. Not so impressive. Prices are okay. Cocktails are average. Surprising!

Author: philomenah512
Title: It's ok
Review:
It's ok
Not worth going out if your way 
Nothing to shout about really 
China house in the old court rooms is way better

Author: michaelgR4637DA
Title: Nice Food in a Fun Area
Review: Located right in the heart of Changkat. This place has nice food for reasonable prices. Very nice atmosphere with traditional Chinese style music played live.

Author: Zidan82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic place
Review: A great little restaurant/ bar right in the middle of the main entertainment street in Kuala Lumpur. Big range of live sports available and they’ll cater for any requests (UK football, US sports etc). Can’t be more helpful.Drinks are fairly priced for the area, with all day happy hours on beers and cocktails.Good food also available, with a range of local and uk dishes.Definitely stop in for a drink, a bite to eat or to watch some live sports!

Author: izzabizzLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Squirty cheese from a tin :(
Review: We ordered the nachos here as well as the cheesy chips and gravy. They were terrible and so overpriced. They obviously used squirty cheese which tasted sour and gross and the chilli con carne meat in the nachos tasted like it was from a tin. The soured cream also tasted off. Having tasted just a couple nachos we asked to return it but the waiter said he couldn’t do anything which I guess is fair but to then have to pay 10% service on pretty bad food that tasted like it was from a tin in a cellar was pretty sad. Squirty cheese from a tin shouldn’t be in the same category as nachos which cost over £6....it is literally cheaper in a Mexican restaurant in soho, central London and at least then I’m getting guacamole and salsa. :( a sad trip tbh

Author: MrandMrsNomadUnited Kingdom
Title: Not as great as I remembered ....
Review: Last visited two years ago when stayed longer than planned as enjoyed Ipoh food so much. Came back for a long weekend just for the food. The portion size of the chicken is good, but it was less tasty and not as silky textured as it should be. The beansprouts were delicious. One of us has noodles the other rice as part of the meal deal. The noodles were over cooked. We came expecting to eat here every night for three nights as we enjoyed it so much previously. We will now not be going back again. Shame, but there it is. Will try elsewhere instead. It's not that it was bad, just not as fabulous as it used to be. This place is still busy, mostly with visitors not locals. The prices have increased. It's now RM30 for two chicken and beansprout meals and one soft drink - more expensive than elsewhere by a considerable amount.

Author: 584banks
Title: Terrible attitude and unfriendly staff
Review: This was my first Harrod experience in KL. I was surprised by how rude the staff name Hardi can be when taking the order. Hope the management team can learn the sample from other branch like the one in Bangkok.

Author: dvnielyapKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible service
Review: Waited 15 mins for a seat that i can understand. 30 minutes for sate, fine. 45 minutes later come and tell me I have to wait for awhile for my chicken to be fried. Coke Light tastes weird and I checked the expiry date it wasn't expired but it tastes weird, fake coke i suppose? Will not recommend tourists or locals to try this branch because their service is horrendous. Go to the one in Pavilion or KLCC instead, efficient service and accurate orders. Oh i almost forgot to mention that the waiter does not understand what is fried rice with egg. They brought us a fried egg and i had to mention to other staff that make sure it comes with a fried rice. Ridiculous restaurant, make sure your staffs understand basic english like fried rice with egg if you're in gastronomic industry.

Author: 846saeedjRiyadh, Saudi Arabia
Title: The best Pizza I've tasted in Malaysia and the waiters were really friendly
Review: Recommend this for big groups to eat big tasty pizza's. The service was really fast and the waiters were really friendly. the sauce of the pizza is their main advantage, it is extremely delicious. The pizza dough and crust were delicious and well baked, definitely gonna make another visit soon and show my friends the best pizza I've tasted in Malaysia. The restaurant in Bangsar is well organised and looks clean

Author: ScrumBumJakartaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very Underwhelming
Review: After having a fabulous lunch here a few months ago I tried their breakfast. Not such a good move.. coffee was great but I suppose u can kid the crowd into thinking that the offering was traditionally French. Yes the names are but the results are v poor. A filled croissant that is so dry that when u cut it is turns into crumbs and baked eggs with duck bits and gruyere cheese (the tiny amount that was not lost in undercooked egg) along with a bowl of oily salad ( why are u serving salad with a breakfast.. my grandmother from Brittany would be laughing).. does not constitute a great breakfast.. will be back for lunch and dinner but better to sleep in in this case.

Author: Cherv75
Title: Decent place with nice music
Review: We came here in the morning. We ordered Let’s Rock Sandwiches and Espresso Chicken. Yes, Espresso chicken in the morning . Let’s Rock Sandwiches is decent. Like normal sandwich. If we were to choose again, perhaps We will order something more special. Espresso chicken is covered with cream sauce and a small cup of espresso. The cream sauce comes with a tinge of espresso taste with some espresso powder on top of the chicken. Something different and quite special. See photos attached.We sat outside the cafe as we felt the ambience is more relaxing. We enjoyed our morning here. We felt like we are in Thailand. Relaxing day.

Author: Travelseverywhere16Senggigi, Indonesia
Title: Soooo Expensive
Review: Dont bother. Is a blot on the landscape. Way way expensive. So not needed in Malacca Old Town. Just dont do it.

Author: kllar1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disastrous
Review: There were 9 of us for dinner, 2 took the buffet BBQ and 7 of us ordered a la carte. We had chicken wings, garlic prawns and onion rings for starters. For a la carte, we ordered 3 recommended ribs and 1 t-bone. 1 of the ribs and t-bone steak was dry and over done when we asked for medium. The other 2 were rare when we asked for medium.The food is generally salty. The steak and ribs were tough and rubbery.Despite complaining, the Manager only said sorry and he would tell the chef. Our waitress came back and told us that we could go for the buffet. By that time, we were done and only 1 of us took the offer.When the bill finally came, we were charged for all the horrible ribs and steaks. The Manager was no where in sight and we were exasperated and just wanted to get out of there, so we paid.3 of us were judges for the recent KL Mayor's Tourism awards Best restaurant category. We were appalled with the quality of service which was apathetic, and steaks. Never have we come across an a la carte menu that is worse than the buffet. They staff and Manager are clearly not prepared to deal with complaints on the spot and just wanted to make a sale for the night. Nothing will get us and the other diners to come back again, let alone recommend it. The restaurant might have made >RM800 from us on that night but never again. How foolish and short sighted.

Author: Fy1988
Title: Sambal charges
Review: After renovation, Cawanmas increase all the food and drink price (that understandable because of the renovation and taxes, all kind of expenses) but some food price increase Rm2 and the food is lesser than before... Furthermore,sambal need to be charged for Rm1?hello,we are not asking for a bowl of sambal, only just enough to dip with our food... That really ridiculous.If anyone want to go there, ask carefully especially the sauce u want.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: just average...
Review: A hip cafe in APW Bangsar which is a repurposed commercial printing factory. Interesting concept which is great for instagrammers. Bright & airy due to the all glass surroundings. Tables are quite close together so not very intimate. Gets really crowded so a wait is expected at most times. Friendly & accommodating staff. Prices are pretty steep.We were lucky to get a table when we got there just before 12 noon. We had the beef cheeks eggs benedict & toast with jam. They were average at best. Portions were okay. One thing that I like is their coffee. Strong, not too bitter, done just right. Complimentary water is available.I don't think I would return. Bit too pricey for what it is.

Author: Borisbear
Title: A smashing time
Review: The food is great. The service is good. And the general ambience and atmosphere makes for a fun night out. Always packed so make reservations. And don't get upset when they smash the plates! Its all part of the 'culture'!!!

Author: khed4Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food vegetarian friendly
Review: Went for an evening meal as we had passed a couple of times and it had been relatively busy when other places were empty. Definitely some of the most delicious food we had in Kuching. The man working there happily pointed out a number of dishes that they could make vegetarian for us and this was no bother. The noodle dish he recommended was so good, we finished our plates then ordered another dish!Washed down with a large bottle of beer between the two of us. it's a great, chilled-out eatery with very reasonable prices (we paid 34 ringgit in total for 3 dishes, a large bottle of beer and a large bottle of water!)

Author: PCChan91
Title: Needs to improve..
Review: Some points below for the restaurant to further improve:1. Cutleries were not complete. 2. We ordered risotto, ravioli and 2 pizzas. All 4 dishes were being served in one-go instead of one by one. There was insufficient space to put all these dishes on the table and we had to eat some of the remaining dishes lukewarm. 3. All 4 dishes were a little bit salty to our liking. 4. One of the pizzas was too watery and toppings were loosely put on top. On the bright side, staff were friendly and attentive to our needs.

Author: princessstf
Title: Good
Review: Staff was attentive, friendly, food was good BUT the size portion was big!Near hotels & convenient. It was about 7 mins walk away from hotel I stayed.

Author: 265ianpSydney, Australia
Title: Tasty but mild.
Review: This restaurant would seat 150 plus people. We were there 8pm on a Thursday and the place was packed. Most tables had 10 plus patrons each (seemed to be groups of businessmen). There we're only 2 of us and we were seated quickly but for larger groups I would definitely book ahead or go after 9. The restaurant is divided into and inside an outside covered terrace area. I would definitely sit on the terrace. There is a good wine selection at typical restaurant prices. Our order was taken quickly but took awhile, but not too long, to arrive. Meals were good quality and tasty but mild and not the spicy style I was looking for (hence the OK rating). I would stay away from the beef which is expensive, chewy and tends to be tougher than we are use too. We had soft drinks, 2 starters and a main and found that more than sufficient (AUD46).

Author: KhushbooM87
Title: Piece of Hand Gloves found in our Falafel Sandwich (Take-away)
Review: Horrific Experience and a bad case of food poisoning after consuming the rolls. The kitchen staff needs to be extremely careful while working along with hand gloves.

Author: Jon_SuzyParkside, Australia
Title: Overrated Dining
Review: Last week I was in Penang and some of the guests had mentioned that this was a good venue for an evening meal, having been to Penang many times I thought I would give it a try as my favourite restaurant Andrews Kampung is closed on a Tuesday evening.The venue is just Norrh of the Park Royal Hotel at Batu Ferrungi.On arrival it was moderately busy all diners appear to be tourists.We sat down and it was quite some time before we received the menu.We ordered Steamed Fish and Steamed Vegetables.The meal arrived some 30 minutes later and the server was not the order taker, and had little knowledge of English.The Fish fillets were very smell and presentation was unattractive. The Vegetables were bland basically all cabbage only 3 slices of mushrooms and 4 pieces of broccoli.We had 2 sparkling water and the price was MR 83 which is $27 Australian $.Having read the reviews here this restaurant is way over rated and clearly is not even close the the venue I mentioned above.Jon & Suzy

Author: Chanybl
Title: Insect in food
Review: Visited on 9 August. Flattened housefly found in food. Staff was unapologetic about it and pretended nothing happened. Food is overpriced.

Author: HKPANGIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Touristy food
Review: Had breakfast twice. 2nd visit to sum up my final review. Overcrowded & wait staff services were sub standard. My guess is tourists take up 40% capacity here. 1st tourist stop Dim Sum in Ipoh is Foh San located directly opposite this restaurant. Most customers come when Foh San is full. Dim Sum quality & pricing is 3/10. Nothing to shout about. Never return.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: fsenada
Title: My place for Japanese food...
Review: Been here countless of times, yet I still feel it serve the best Japanese food around Kuching. I normally order Unagi, Sushi and Tempura.Food quality and taste is always great here. Service is very good. A recommended place for Japanese food.

Author: DRANDYSydney, Australia
Title: Poor service, hygienic concerns, food just average,
Review: Went for lunch at the Dragon i restaurant in Sunway Pyramid.This place used to serve one of the better Shanghainese steamed dumplings in Malaysia, but during this visit, we found the quality has deteriorated. (we believe the best Shanghainese dumplings are currently served at the Shanghai Restaurant, JW Marriott Hotel, Jln Bukit Bintang in KL.)The head waiter was rather rude and service had deteriorated, what was of greater concern was we saw them re-using the cover for the dumpling baskets without washing them, the waiters just stacked up used covers near the kitchen's pigeon hole, and the cooks just used the used cover to cover the steamed dumplings before the waiters brought them to the tables. Made us wonder if they are also doing the same thing with the dumpling baskets ? reusing them without washing?

Author: Hiroshi_KazuhiroKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Service and Horrible Food Quality
Review: I went to Mitasu with a friend and we sat at the bar counter. We asked one of the waitress to exchange seating if there's any empty table but the girl replied rudely to us. We don't mind if they can't change our table but at least be courteous and polite when replying. When we were making order, the guy took our order was very rude also and unwillingly to answer questions that I thrown to him regarding the food in the menu. It shown poor customer service of the staff and even many people gave good rating but I think it is overrated. Unfortunately, our food was not clean and I found hair on the sushi. The manager just ignore it and none of the staff apologize to me for the mishap. This is my first time and definitely my last.

Author: Evelyn T
Title: Good place for both locals and tourists
Review: If you're looking for a place with quality and quantity, Arthur's Bar and Grill at Shangri-La Hotel is the place. It may seem a little expensive at first (if you are a local) but you get really good discounts if you are an AMEX card holder which makes the meal so incredibly worth it. They do great burgers, and steaks. They have an additional dinner menu which is only available during dinner. The atmosphere is great and it gets quite lively on a Friday night. A recommended place to dine.

Author: SEE KIONG TKuching
Title: Leisure Time
Review: Teh C special was far below par @ RM3.50 but still affordable however they operator should improve the quality or standard as it was named "Teh C Special". I would have not order it if it was not named "Special". I love the garlic rice which smelled nice and tasted good. The Deep Fried Steam Philipine Pork Leg taste was average. Infact I had ever found out from my Philipino friend that he had never seen such type of Philipino Pork Leg in Philiphine. A cup of Teh C Special, a some bottle of beck beer, a bowl of garlic rice and a Philipino Steam Pork Leg costed us about RM53.00 , fair price. I loved the waitresses there because they were very polite and served us well.

Author: James201410
Title: One of the most price-worthy Japanese Restaurant I have ever visited!
Review:
Pros:
Affordable Sushi
Delicious food
Great Atmosphere
Friendly Waiters

Cons:
Aircon was a little bit too cold

Author: choongyow cKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local Coffee
Review: Am surprised that the place is empty, over the last few years this will be my 4th visit, I must say that the quality of coffee and bubur cha-cha have deteriorated a lot. Love how the owners have decorated the place. Feels like coming back to the pre-war coffee place. Place is alittle dark for my taste. If you are the owner reading this pls try your own speciality and check for its quality. Noticed the 2 neighbourhood cafes are packed as i excited your shop. Your reviews at other foodie sites are consistent with mine. cheers

Author: Mohamed S
Title: I like this place
Review: I must say its a special place with nice environment overall. Food was good not perfect and a little overpriced but service was the best part it was perfect.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Vinosingh
Title: Very disappointing...
Review: I came looking forward to a nice dinner with my family.... Ordered a nice bottle of red and a nice steak done medium... The bottle of wine never appeared despite waiting half and hour... The steak came first... To compound matters, the steak was inconsistent with most parts well done... To the credit of the restaurant, they did re-do the steak without prompting... Unfortunately the second round wasn't much better... Disappointed....the service left a lot to be desired

Author: AnsonLee0524
Title: The rudeness of the Indian old man.
Review: Unbelievable rudeness of the Indian manager....We went to the bar to spend our weekend evening, there were only few tables occupied.We saw there were two birdcage designed tables were empty, so my friend requested to sit one of the empty birdcage seat there, but the Indian old man showed sour face and said to my friend: How much are you going to spend ? My kind hearted friend replied: we are going to order wine.So finally he agreed to let us take it ....I was about to confront with this rudeness Indian old man, but because I was the guest of my friend, so I decided to calm down for my friend.How rude and the way he looks down on people, if there is a minimum charge for taking a special table or a private room , he should explain nicely , not just throw the rude question with a sour face : How much are you going to spend ?? If you seriously want all the guests come to spend certain amount of bill before entering your bar, please put a BIG note at the entrance, I suggest the old Indian guy should go for a service training before working in F&B .

Author: III76
Title: overpriced, overrated, over it...
Review: i dont understand the long queue for this restaurant. known for their breakfast pancakes, they're just pancakes. nothing special. dont believe the hype.

Author: erin2503Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Spectacular view
Review: If you’re looking for something special, there are a couple of establishments that do a first-class job of elevating the dining experience to elegantly delicious heights. Feringgi Grill at Rasa Sayang is one such example and one of the most esteemed and long-lasting institutions of its kind. Feringgi Grill offers a fine choice of wines by the glass. They serves 10 different types of home made ice cream, and I must say that the peanut butter ice cream is to die for! Luxuriously smooth and nutty!

Author: Samboth
Title: Good Meal Great Service
Review: A nice seafood feast, delicious chili crab and great service. Our waiter Enem provided fantastic service with a smile!

Author: AChee74Kuching, Malaysia
Title: NICE.....
Review: Love the duck, the chicken and the bbq pork. The portion of the 3 is around RM45 and goes wonderful with the rice and the gravy. Portion is huge too.There were many other types of food available as well. Cannot wait to try the next one

Author: bhatku101Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great location, ok food and service
Review: We spotted the café after we had finished walking the Main Bazaar . We visited the Chinese temple near by and went to the café to take refuge from the sun and to eat something. The place had a nice ambience. It had an elegant, ethnic feel to it and the view of the river was really pleasant. We ordered just potato wedges and garlic bread which were ok and some iced coffee which was refreshing. It was a relief to order some familiar vegetarian snacks in pleasant surroundings.

Author: phebeh94Boston, Massachusetts
Title: Hard to understand how to order
Review: A bit hard to navigate for foreigners as the place is more for locals. We had trouble communicating what to order and were led to the buffet bar, which unbeknownst to us was a flat rate of 20RM. The food consisted a bunch of different curries, but without labels we didn’t know what dish was what and which foods were spicy. If you’re comfortable with navigating local menus, then feel free to enjoy the relatively cheap food here, otherwise I recommend going around the corner and trying Betle Leaf instead!

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Progressive cuisine
Review: A restaurant located in the Fort Cornwallis. This restaurant themed themselves as progressive cuisine whereby they try to present local delights in a different way. At times it is very confusing, in a positive way. Nice presentation however taste is rather bland, comparing to their original version. There is a entrance fee charged for entry to the Fort Cornwallis but the fee will be reimbursed if you dine in the restaurant.

Author: KeslyneSingapore, Singapore
Title: A must try restaurant even if you are not staying at the hotel
Review: We had 2 nights of dinner at the beach and all the food from appetizers to mains to desserts were delicious. Beautiful ambience and attentive staff. I would definitely come back for dinner on my next visit.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Barnaby NHong Kong, China
Title: Back again - great pub, great welcome
Review: There’s something different about Sid’s in that it is a fun place. The welcome is always warm and sincerely friendly and the staff are cheerful. Plus the setting is bright, colourful and calming - being part-open air and part inside.We were there just for a drink (before heading down for an amazing Indian nearby) but we stayed long enough to sample the amazing nachos! Really great and fantastic.I highly recommend this as a place to head for a quiet drink or an evening out of the city’s centre.

Author: MlleMonster
Title: Only so-so
Review: Ambiance is great but average fare and their rudeness is as iconic as the place.

Author: AnnieTanMalmo, Sweden
Title: A little disappointing
Review: I made a reservation and received a reply within 24 hrs. My reservation was 6p.m., which i guess should be the first batch. We finally find the place after while as we attempted to walk over from Pavilion. We reached the same time as the other group of 4-6 pax. The sign downstairs was 'Closed' and there was no one downstairs also to guide the guests. The other group just went upstairs and we followed. There wasn't really anyone there to welcome the guests. We felt abit lost, Anyway, after venturing around, we found someone who greeted us and seat us on the sofa, From the other reviews here, I thought there will be complimentary drinks served and some games played before entering, but nothing else was done after we were seated and shortly after, we were brought in by our guide. Food wise, nothing exciting. Our guide is soft spoken, the other table was too loud and we could hardly hear, though its no fault of the guide. Our guide was very nice and friendly. The room is actually not completely dark and I could see afew red lights and white lights. After we completed the meal and was brought out, we were seated outside and told to write our fav food. I thought we would have to guess the food ingredient, but it was not. Then we were showed the menu and everything ended. I should say perhaps I have been to one before, thus there's no element of surprise anymore and higher expectation sets in.

Author: Nicholas Y
Title: Dinner-ing
Review:
I like the environment here and food was very delicious. Highly recommended!!!

The location was strategic and services eas excellence.

Author: dharmavilasanRawang, Malaysia
Title: Good environment but food was spoilt
Review: Made a visit with family, it was cheap and affordable. Nice environment but no fan so will sweat alot. Not much variety, no mushroom or vege. The most dissapointing part was some of the dish spoilt. Mee Hoon Goreng was spoilt, some of the meat spoilt. Will never visit again for sure.

Author: D N
Title: Best laksa, very clean, good price
Review: One of our famous Malaise restaurant in Penang, Malaysia, well known for the laksa. The lady owner is very fluent in English, and very kind. She greeted us, explained the menu , recommended the dishes that we should try in order to compare with other places. The price was very reasonable compare to the quality and quantity of the food. There is AC, the restaurant is very clean.I had laksa at few other restaurants, but I had to admit that her laksa was super, the soup was thick, the noodle was chewy, the flavor and taste were just right.We were curious about the blue rice. She went out of her way describing how it was prepared, from the extraction of the color from the flower to cooking the rice. She even demonstrated to us how to extract the blue color from the flower. My wife shared with her another plant, the magenta leave, which also gives a similar color as the flower that she used but requires much less labor and can be preserved in the freezer for a longer period.Her desserts were also excellent. It may not fit for Americans, since they were not sweet enough.Her restaurant closed at 8 pm , but we were there until 8:30 pm, she treated us like family even we just met for the first time. She picked the flower seeds for my to try plant it at home.Highly recommended this restaurant if you are in Penang.

Author: reviewedbyherKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great drinks, but terrible service and a dead atmosphere!
Review: Really looked forward to revisiting this bar, however my most recent experience will unfortunately be my last. The drinks as per usual were really good, however the service and atmosphere was hugely disappointing. Staff were unwelcoming and unfriendly. The atmosphere was cold and dead, verging onto awkward.

Author: Ashmac87
Title: Overpriced average food
Review: Was really unimpressed with the food at this place, my wife ordered chicken and it was dry and bland, I ordered the lamp ribs and they really weren’t that great. Was pretty average food considering the price. We’ve had much better meals at surrounding restaurants.

Author: Jade19190Kuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: HORRIBLE SERVICE.
Review: The worst Persian Restaurant that I have ever been to. The waiter is horrible and how rudely he treated us. He scolded members of my party saying that there's no places to sit and somehow there's sits which is reserved to nobody. In fact of saying there's no place to sit the waiter even try shoo us away. I will NEVER come to this cheap and lousy restaurant again.

Author: Poje MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst ever.
Review: Sadly this restaurant is going down. Been few times, but this is the last time.Waited over 45 minutes for our meal to arrive, not at the same time. In an almost empty restaurant. Bad service. When the meal arrived: the pizza was badly cooked, tasted off, one of the worst pizza i've had. The fish pasta in the foil, was just bad.When we told the waitress the food was bad, no reply.Badly managed, will not return after this awful experience.

Author: shainizKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Service
Review: Malaysia has thousands of indian eateries and most of them understand the simple concept of “telur goyang”, which roughly means runny egg yolk. I specifically requested for that, and yet had the dryest overcooked fried egg I have ever encountered in my 3 decades of existence.Upon requesting them to remake it, the servers came in a group and gang up on me insisting it cannot be done, as though they’ve never seen a runny yolk before. Avoid at all cost, there are plenty of cheaper, tastier, and friendlier indian eateries within a few steps.

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Best Indian Food in town
Review: Love to come here eat tosai and capati. Their service quite fast, nice food with reasonable price. Here will be quite hot if you dine in in afternoon time.

Author: Coley1973Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food
Review: Went to this great place last night for a party that was outdoors. Food was good, staff was attentive, and great music. Will definitely go back!

Author: steven h
Title: cozy place
Review:
good place to spend time with friends, nice food, easy parking. i  feel relax at this place.
cake and pastries is an must try item

Author: tinhead69Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: What Happened?!
Review: My recent visit to Magnificent last weekend for breakfast was rather blah! The service is good as usual, the staff are very attentive and all but what's up with the quality of the food here? My big breakfast was bland and scrambled eggs were mushy. The freshly squeezed orange juice was watered down, last time I was there, this wasn't the case. I know they have their regular sets of customers hanging out here partly due to the attentive, friendly staff and beers but c'mon let's get your act together with the food, please have some quality measure from time-to-time.Sorry, I won't be going there anytime soon nor will recommend my friends too for now... I do hope the owner can improve on their quality of food.

Author: EnglishmanAbroad63Bluffy, France
Title: Terrible service
Review: This restaurant is in a great location on the river. My wife and I decided to have lunch, and, apart from one other person we were the only people there. We ordered a drink and starter which came up reasonably quickly. Then we were totally ignored. Despite attracting the attention of some kitchen staff we just couldn't find anyone to serve us. The waiting staff seemed to have just disappeared. Eventually we gave up and went to pay for what we'd had. We complained to a slovenly youth who eventually appeared to take our money but he was totally disinterested. We asked for the manager, but we were told he or she wasn't there.What a disaster. Clearly the staff had no training and just couldn't care less. This place needs to be taken over by someone who cares and who can realize the potential of its great location.

Author: KR_EDINBURGHEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: No longer such a favourite
Review: Had the kolo mee. It was ok but have had better. What was definitely was not ok was the fly in my accompanying bowl with chillies. Seriously, it was as large as some of the chopped up chilli, really disgusting. Also, for the second time i saw a cockroach on the floor of the premises. Beginning to question the cleanliness of this place.. which is a shame because I've always particularly enjoyed the laksa here.

Author: Janneke v
Title: Best coffee in weeks
Review: Haven't had a decent coffee in weeks. The Baboon House made up voor a lot a cups of Nescafé. Great coffee, nice ambiance and a fine european breakfast. Brown Bread, at last!!

Author: Pommard88
Title: Mediocre
Review: Overhyped for food that isn't especially good. Service was equally poor. No idea why the restaurant is so well-liked in reviews

Author: mhd2011Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not worth it & NEVER coming back
Review: wanted to give it a try since ive read comments on it being authentically thai with an amazing view. since the sentul area is like a heritage site, it did give that old ambience which is nice. the restaurant was small, entrance to it is like a puzzle, and u will b stepping on rocks, so ladiess if ur wearing heels, pls dont come here. we went there for lunch, parking was full because klpac was hvg some launch. the restaurant didnt have aircond. menu wise expensive and not worth it. we wanted to order only 2 rice because we wanted to share, but the waiter and manager said even if its sharing, they will charge us for 3 rice and its bloody rm4 each!! so not worth it. if ur local dont come here! place is aged and not well maintained, not forgetting pricey for a small portion. never ever coming back here.staff was not friendly.

Author: 189vincek
Title: The worse and most regretful decision for breakfast.
Review: My worst experience in jonker street.Price is an extreme rip-off. Selling an omelette with 2 peice of bread at RM12 and a Chicken sandwich at RM16 (and it's literally just the bread with no sides). Thier aloe vera drinks is literally water and ice and some aloe vera. It's selling at RM17 but the menu price is actually only showing RM13. Still deserve 1 star as they didn't poison us. Sorry. Please improve your menu choice and price. It's really a horrible experience.

Author: Zoodit
Title: Looking forward to coming back for more
Review: I have had several meals here, all delicious. I just wish I could try everything on the menu. Staff are courteous and helpful. Dosa and vadai just great. Lassi also very good

Author: 1STEP4WARDJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Greasy
Review: This restaurant is not so appealing when you get there. Nothing on the bbq section of the menu for vegetarians . Ordered some curry which was so greasy , the oil was actually layered and floating on the top of the curry. Was just put off . Couldn’t eat the food. Waiters were also very cold and grumpy. They don’t serve alcohol but allow you to buy from the bar opposite and bring it in.

Author: 817rhysm
Title: Ok but not amazing.
Review: Was expecting big things as I'm a burger fiend and had been waiting to try fuel shack. Burger was OK but not a burger I would rave about.

Author: PatienceginKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Joe
Review: The new kid in town Nobu Kuala Lumpur has yet to make its mark as the food was just ok and service needs to buck up. I have visited twice, to Nobu once for lunch and once for dinner! First impression as you walked into level 6, the hostess in black dress just stands at the counter and chit chatting away. Not forgetting playing with their phones. They are indeed good at staring at you from top to bottom. As for food I expected more on the Sashimi. All Japanese food are practically the same but how does one differentiate? The thickness and the freshness of the way a shashimi is being handled? Is it cut and serve on the spot or is it a defrosted shashimi?The signature black cod was yummy and I love the miso soup. The signature Bento was again a let down because it was just normal. It still tasted good but for RM180++ for lunch you will expect more! Overall food is way better off than service and if you visit Nobu, don't have any high expectation that's when you will not walk out disappointed! I believe Nobu, an international brand should sort their hostessing staff as they are the first impression a customer see and talk to!

Author: markrankin82Ilkley, United Kingdom
Title: Would go here all the time if I could!
Review: This restaurant is set back slightly from the main road opposite Underwater World. We've not seen it busy in the 5 days we've been here, but don't let that put you off; we were very glad that we gave it a try. Spring rolls were addictively good, whilst the kimchii and mains we ordered were really tasty. The portions are a good size and the owner brought out some samples to try of a couple of the dishes we hadn't ordered. That meant that even though we were hungry, we couldn't finish everything. The service was very friendly and hospitable.If we had longer here, we would definitely go back to try some of the other dishes on the menu which looked tasty. Wish this place was local to us back home!

Author: dbrown101272Echuca, Australia
Title: Not a bad pub, but used to be better...
Review: This pub has a nice atmosphere, it's small, the staff have all been there for years, and run a pretty good bar. I used to love coming here for brunch and to watch test cricket a couple of years ago, but they have since stopped purchasing the packages. Yes you can watch footy and rugby here, but I miss the cricket. As it's not a rowdy pub, it's a great spot to do that on a lazy Saturday morning. The menu is generally pretty good, but a little tired to be honest - the steak sandwich used to be awesome, and is still pretty good, but as I said, a little tired...Some rave about this pub, but I guess it has just lost me a bit.

Author: SamuelAlexandreSao Paulo, SP
Title: Frustrating
Review: By the reviews I had read it seemed to be a good place, but the food is not much, the loud sound becomes stressful and the staff kept making jokes about customers behind their backs what I thought is really disrespectful. I will never go back there.

Author: Sarahwright84Leeds, England, United Kingdom
Title: A wonderful experience with the most amazing staff :)
Review: My friend and I came to dining in the dark to have an exciting and new experience and it didn't disappoint. The food was amazing, but more importantly the staff and service was possibly the best I have ever had. Darius our guide was so lovely and charismatic, he really made our experience extra special. Not to be missed! Thanks again for your amazing hospitality :)

Author: Allykay88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great!
Review: Celebrated my birthday here. Service was quick and the waiter was attentive and present throughout the night. We brought our 18 month old and they were very welcoming to her as well. Thank you for making our dining experience so lovely and warm. The food was good. The star of course has to be the gorgeous view of the twin towers. Go around evening and catch the sunset and watch the twin towers get brighter as the night progresses. It's magical. Am definitely going to make this a yearly birthday affair. Thanks Thirty8, Grand Hyatt!

Author: IreenBeh
Title: Fried Kuey Teow, Assam laksa, ice kacang
Review:
If you are missing Penang food, here is the alternative. 
Varieties of food to choose from:- Assam laksa, Penang Fried Kuey Teow, ice kacang, etc. 
Air cond environment.

Author: georgeDHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Crazy prices
Review: Visited Friday night,could not talk,the music was so loud,food was so so,the drinks was crazy price,over rm50 for a pint of carlsberg,could not smoke inside or outside,I can see why they only had 20 or 30 customer max.definitely won’t be coming back.

Author: Sheron911
Title: Sheron
Review: Healy Macs is one of the happiest places I been.  The staff are so friendly  Prity one of the staff is so beautiful helpful I just love her

Author: StbackBondi, Australia
Title: Slow Service, Great Meat
Review: Beautiful meal, but really slow service, weird vibe, ridiculous high backed chairs that made conversation difficult. The best onion rings i have ever had and a really good steak.

Author: Ruchi B
Title: Spectacular food, service and view
Review: Please do not miss this one while at Langkawi. This was our best evening on the Island. Get there before sunset.

Author: Travelling_gerbil
Title: Must go!
Review: The food at this restaurant is amazing - make sure you try the specials.  Service is so friendly.  We love it here!

Author: SNC8810
Title: Delicious Food!
Review:
The soup and the services was excellent! 
I recommend this restaurant everyone who wants trying the Malaysian kitchen.

Author: blackberrymastermalaysia
Title: Casual Fine Dining with Excellent Surrounding
Review: My last visit was probably last year with my wife to celebrate our anniversary. I decided to choose this place due to it's secluded location from the central city and offering sumptuous foods.Driving there could be a little hectic if you are not familar with the area as you require to drive through Ampang and TAR housing area surrounded by bungalows lots until you reach. Sitting at verandah is the most ideal and preferred choice for all but we decided to sit indoor near to the bar. The whole restaurant concept comes with different cuisine from Thai, french and fusion style. so you need to decide which food you are going for before the usher leads you to the table. Food wise and selection - good.price for food - $$$ambience - ****service - ****will revisit again

Author: LL721Kuala Lumpur
Title: The lady in lime green who ushered us to our table was cold, ill mannered and mean!
Review: We arrived for lunch at 12.15pm. The lady in lime green attire who ushered us to our table was unfriendly and cold. And, she informed us that the buffet was not ready and she walked off.Then, we ventured inside (she had given us a table outside the main dining area) and the guy in chef attire was really friendly and said: 'welcome!' and he said we could start eating. So we went for a look around. And, we took our food. Then, while walking around, we saw the mean lady in lime green who looked angrily at us and reprimanded us: 'I told you the buffet was not ready!!!'Did she think she was the headmistress reprimanding students?So I laughingly informed her that the chef said we could start eating and she just walked off angrily, ignoring us.At the end of our lunch, we had to encounter the mean lime green lady again at the cashier counter and she gave our table number to one nice lady in black and just pointed us to 'go there'.She is really the rudest person I have ever met in PJ Hilton. Is this really the way to treat customers?Other than this rude person, we did enjoy the spread of Malaysian Hawker food. The fried chempedak was the best we have ever eaten. The crabs, mussels, satay, noodles, rojak and salad were good too.

Author: Kk L
Title: Nice place. Great food.
Review: Hubba has excellent ambience. Light and easy music. Baked Chicken is yummy. Finely seasoned with herbs and perfectly baked. Must try.

Author: SweetyL
Title: Great show and average food
Review:
The show was nice and interested but the food is so so not too good. 
The buffet had many choice of dish include Indian, Malaysian, ... 
Especially lamb here wasn't good at all.

Author: alex kKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The worst value food in the whole of KL
Review: Last weekend I really craved for a good steak and decided to splash out and go to TGI at Pavillion. I was relieved of 200 ringitt for a shared starter, two steaks, a beer and a cocktail. We all know 200myr buys a lot of great food in KL, so expectations are high!!The only good dish was the beer - served cold in a chilled glass. Everything else was awful.The cocktail had virtually no spirits in, so stingy! So my partner had to watch me get slightly merry drinking beer while she felt short changed. Not a good start!The tangy chicken starter was so tangy it was practically inedible. My partner was so disappointed as she loves chicken. This made me really nervous - don't they occasionally taste the food to check it's okay? I guess not.When the steaks came, I realise I'd made a big mistake. Bugger. I'll never see that 200myr again... The texture was kind of like a soggy bread. The only explanation is that the steaks were cooked from frozen. Totally unforgivable at this price bracket. There was no flavour at all. For this price, steaks should be fresh, hung for 15-30 days for flavour, from a traceable source of good beef cows. This was nothing of the sort. To make matters worse, the steaks were covered in the sauce, which was not nice anyway. Sauce should always be on the side!! I don't know what they were thinking!!These guys seriously don't have the faintest idea about quality food. I would say the correct price for all this would be about 30 myr in kampong baru (minus alcohol of course), then it would be acceptable. And even then I wouldn't recommend it.Save your money and go to Chilli's which is a similar price but worth every penny. They are world's apart!!

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: just average...
Review: Located near Jonker. Popular with tourist & groups. Simple layout, air conditioned. Service is a hit & miss. Rather pricey.We tried their otak otak, friend chicken, spicy fried rice, kangkung belacan, cincalok omelette, prawn sambal, asam pedas fish, pie tee & chicken lobak. All were average at best. Asam pedas was rather weak, no kick to the gravy. Only highlight would be the lentil crackers as appetizers.Wouldn't recommend unless you are nearby & looking for a meal.

Author: 313AmyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a great experience at their sister outlet, Snitch By The Thieves
Review: I ordered Flat White and Huevos Racherous. Coffee was good but the baked eggs and beef chorizo dish was rather spicy. Instead of chorizo, they served beef balls. Dish comes with a bread roll instead of toast. I had to ask twice if there’s a mistake to the order and was finally told that the beef balls are chorizo. That’s interesting.

Author: vdkondrashov
Title: Bad bad bad
Review: It was awful experience. The price for dinner for a couple was 500 RM. For additional 50 RM they suggested to seat next to the window, of course we agreed: what's the matter to visit restaurant on the top of the TV station and not to see the window.1) Above mentioned 500 RM were as a deposit for food. You should go to the special place by yourself and take a plate of food. Just like dinners in hotels. It is not comfortable because the restaurant is moving and you always become far from the food. Thus, you have to go through all restaurant with a plate full of food.2) No one describes you which cuisine is presented, no one helps you to combine dish with a perspective sauce. The waters will not even present at their place to provide you assistance. We had to go to waters by ourselves and ask them to do something. We need to wait for waters' attention for 30 min3) THE FOOD WAS AWFUL. No interesting dishes: just simple prawns, salmon etc without any sauces or topping. I can prepare it at home in a 15 min. All these seafood is available at other restaurants with much less cost.4) After paying 50 RM you get an air conditioner every 10 meters that are blowing in your face.

Author: dekiaiparadoxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A taste of Penang delights
Review: One of my few favourite places to dine at. I personally prefer their branch at The Curve as there's outdoor seating. Portion served were decent and the food is really good. Had almost everything on the menu, my favourite is always the prawn mee and the char keow teow - never fail to amaze me and the taste been pretty consistent. The fried rice is a win too, taken together with the cili padi. There are also many side dishes on their menu for munch while waiting for the food. It's a must try places for anyone who visits KL. Note: Their service could be quite bad sometimes especially on peak hours.

Author: MyriamM421Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: First time
Review: So disappointed : expensive prices, taste and portion of the food, attitude of the waiter (pushing you to take more). I will not come back.

Author: wongrachelPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: There's still room for improvements.....
Review: Quality and taste of the food can be improvise..... Variety of the foodis still acceptable but quality not up to par.

Author: vanessavN7929PPKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not to expectation
Review: My mom wanted to eat crabs and we were going through reviews about crabs around Sri Hartamas area. Delay no more was highly recommended. So we decided to go and try out the place. But to our disappointment, it wasn’t as good as we thought it will be. The sweet and sour crabs was below average and the kam heong crabs was just slightly above average

Author: Sherpa61808526165Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Never deal with unfriendly staff.
Review: Superb view. U won't regret to get up here to enjoy the sunset and night view. 5 star environment serve by unfriendly staff. Female attendance absolutely great job. Male staff maybe bias, racist, different treatment on whether u are walk-in guest or in-house. I was suprise by his decision to ask me to wait for 30mins while there were 2 empty prime view tables nobody sitting . The reason given is they migh be more people to come and I not qualify to sit there unless I wait until they almost close. Is a Sunday night, the crowd is getting lesser, by 11pm+-, you still want your guest to wait for 30mins? Lol.. What a surprise!!

Author: kirstenw1003Dusseldorf, Germany
Title: Wonderful place , excellent food and perfect service
Review: I dropped in to celebrate my birthday ! Beside the execellent food and surrounding, the waiter IMRAN made it to a perfect birthday. When he notices that it was my birhtday he didn't get tired to made it better and better.Last bus not least he offered me a very sepecial desert f free of charge, with choclate birthday wishes and my name.Gorgeously !!!! Thank you IMRAN

Author: TudwotsEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Weekend Brunch
Review: We sat upstairs which is more secluded and the cuisine was well presented and delicious. Drink service was a little slow although the restaurant was not busy at the time. The building Arcoris is just completed and the signage for parking is very poor. We gave up and parked in the building next door. Still lots of construction going on nearby unsafe for small children.

Author: Robin R
Title: Breakfast yuck!
Review:
Breakfast was awful, instant coffee with fake creamer and sugar
Without even asking if I take sugar.  And remember "sausage" 
Is hot dog in these parts.  Hash browns were greasy and out of a box.
Expensive too, what a disappointment.

Author: Robert F
Title: Bad experience
Review: When I first frequented this restaurant in 2012 was delicious food service wasn't so great but ok overall ....been back few times and food quality and service declined drasticly ...good luck in the near future ...

Author: MichaelHuxleyLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place, but average food, high prices and poor staff attitudes.
Review: This should be one of the really nice spots along the waterfront for a relaxed lunch or a bit of a dinner treat, but it falls short on a lot of areas.The place itself, the building, the gardens and the view of the river are undeniably great. The ambience is very nice indeed.However, the staff attitudes are shockingly poor. They look miserable when they serve you (the emphasis on WHEN), and look as if they couldn't care less. They even messed up our orders! These attitudes are in stark contrast to when the Prime Minister visited there a couple of days previously (we weren't allowed in then), but we saw them pulling out all the stops, the decorations were up, everyone was at their best, etc. Not good.The food itself isn't bad per se, but it is just average when compared to the other places in the area, and it is really expensive in comparison too. Better to go to other places, there are plenty to choose from.

Title: tasteless food but good service
Review: Visited here as thought it would be nice to eat looking over the KLCC fountains which are lit in rainbow colours at night. The service was very good, the waiter had impeccable manners and provided everything very quickly. However, the food was very disappointing - tasteless, lukewarm and seemed like a microwave meal. The 3 prawns in my curry which were mostly legs and shell. In the end we didn't stay long, too disappointed with the food (& bill!)Nice atmosphere for a drink, but if you're eating, try elsewhere.

Author: CZ-PZDurham, North Carolina
Title: After an hour, not even served my soda
Review: I’m staying nearby and decided to stop here for lunch. Simple order of a soda and pizza. Good thing I brought work with me to do because after an hour I hadn’t even been served my soda. I decided to leave and no one from the restaurant even acknowledged me walking out. Can’t speak to the food but service is awful.

Author: Tomaldinho93
Title: Best laksa I've ever had!
Review: If you're looking for the perfect laksa this is the place, very cool and clean with friendly staff and good sides to go with the main event. We both had the vegetarian laksa and the flavours were excellent. Highly recommend!

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mostly empty and average food
Review: This place occupies most of level 1 of Starhill. It must have seen its better days as on a Saturday night there were only three tables.The menu is international and Asian including Japanese, but not fusion.Prices on the high side without the ambience, service and quality of fine dining.Eg chicken fettuccine at 98 ringgit, French onion soup at 48 and 4 lobster tortellini at 158.If you plan to eat here, download Eatigo App and get 20% off, since it is not fine dining. Despite my Eatigo booking and discount, they forgot to give me the 20% off and I nearly forgot.The food looked ok but tasted average.Not recommended for a visit even with discount.

Author: maria m
Title: Malaysian Street food
Review: Street food everywhere... a lot of variety especially with seafoods. We enjoyed our food though it’s really crowded and a bit pricey compared to all the places we’ve eaten in KL.

Author: shahirahhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Another Hipster Cafe?~
Review: My first visit to the place was with my bff and we had to queued for about half and hour before can get the chance to have a seat in this cafe. We were seated upstairs. The deco and the environment had made a pretty good impression to me. Rustic vintage style that I adore. The architecture of the cafe had shouted out the laid back aura despite the noise made by the full house customers.I catches a glimpse of the cake display racks before heading to our seats upstairs.Looks promising. Checking out the menu, I definitely have to agree with the previous reviews on regards of the pricing for the foods. We just ordered their hotpot of seafood and salmon. The food arrived around 15 min after we ordered. The food turn out fine. Definitely a little more than average but not quite hit the wonderful button. We wanted to try out the cakes and had called up the service to check out the menu for their cakes but sadly they don't have one.
