Given that our seats is upstairs and i wore heel that time, we both just decided on our selection based on our glimpse earlier.The cake was a Ok but still not quite hitting the great level. Overall, I'll say the food is pricier compare to other hipster cafe. The taste was OK but I'm not that keen or excited to come back. Perhaps if I'm in the area or my friend ask for my company, I would come again to try out other menu.

Author: Suelowst
Title: Cheesy Prawn Noodles
Review: There was so much hype about their cheesy prawn noodles so had to go and try it out. very dissapointing. You can hardly taste the cheese. The seating in the restaurant is also very messy. However, the owner's wife, a lady from Bentong, was very friendly.

Author: everydayfood
Title: Humble Facade, outstanding food and excellent ambiance
Review: Top notch service, fresh food ingredients, very warm and friendly customer experience overall. I am definitely going to be a repeat customer

Author: Vince WPorthtowan, United Kingdom
Title: Great food but very pricey
Review: The food I had on my one visit was excellent, could not fault it for taste and flavor. Service was also excellent but I just found it very pricey

Author: monica a
Title: Tasty food and wonderful service
Review: We just rolled into Melaka with 3 tired kids after a drive up from Singapore. We were just looking to get the kids fed before bed, but we found a great little restaurant. The staff was wonderful and they worked hard to meet our needs. The whole family left well fed and content. We will absolutely come back the next time we are in Melaka.

Author: lhspenang
Title: Good Chinese Food
Review: Delicious Chinese food, price become more pricey lately, service average, their signature 'char siew' sell out early, best pre order.

Author: lavuarnePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great services
Review: Very good services by Miss Azura, Avlyn & Zuraini. However, with the price charged, I think the food still need some improvement. Overall, if the rating for services, then I will give them 5 star.

Author: StefanogiaconWarsaw, Poland
Title: Poor service and nothing more
Review: We have been eating and drinking at Canopy during our staying in Kuala Lumpur. We came here because of the good reviews on trip advisor and with high expectations. However, we felt disappointed due to the service ( they asked us to pay before we asked about the bill ). When we decided to pay with card they didn’t accept American Express neither ( which is a must for a popular destination in a capital city ). Food and drinks ok

Author: Neela RKota Bharu, Malaysia
Title: Racist
Review: Went to the restaurant for the 2nd time to have something different, steam fish, fishball soup, vege..waiting for so long for food. Chinese couples who came after us was served the dishes. Fishball soup never came, the white rice was the from the bottom of rice cooker, steam fish for 2 ordinary, but cost RM40!! Never going to this place again.

Author: ChaitanyaRungtaKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Cold food, rude staff
Review: The only reason the place even gets 2 stars at all is because the food tastes nice and the drinks are good, or else it shouldn't even get 2 stars. When we asked for a sweet cocktail, our server told us that "only mocktails can be sweet". The food served was cold, as the kitchen was about to shut, nonetheless it was tasty. But the staff itself behaved in a manner that suggested that they do not care about serving us food.

Author: Georgia D
Title: MAJOR language barrier.
Review: You'd think for an Australian style restaurant, attracting people mainly speaking English, that the staff would be able to communicate with some sort of acceptable English. Not the case here. Order was messed up at least 4 times due to the waiters lack of understanding. For a steak house, the steak itself was not anything special. Wouldn't recommend, especially for the price.

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lacking in ambiance
Review: An unexpectedly busy cafe in Desa Sri Hartamas. It was unexpected because this place is relatively new and it didn't have very inviting decor or lighting; but it got quite busy after a spell. They had some good Spanish wines but the tapas was a little bland and more Mediterranean punch.

Author: davidlJ2079GW
Title: Hakka cuisine
Review: Food not bad. Father in law like especially the hakka pork. Price reasonable but portion 'small' is quite small. We went dinner on Saturday. Full house but good thing is they accept table bookings. So before decides to dine here, call them for a reservation. Waiting time 45.minutes after ordering which is way out of reasonable.
Restaurant: Kaki Lang Homes Kitchen 自家人私家菜

Author: CeaserBoyBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nasi Lemak Banana Leaf
Review: Go for thier nasi lemak which is wrapped in a banana leaf and newspaper. Cheap and good at RM 1.50 per packet but be warned, its pretty spicy. The stall is located right at the entrance can get very busy during lunch.There are a few stalls inside this food court selling various local delights. One stall worth mentioning here is a stall at the end of the food court selling Beef Koay Teow Soup. Closed in the evening.

Author: subhoshreerMumbai, India
Title: Fantastic ambiance with delicious Indian foods
Review: The restaurant reminded us , we were not away from home. The interior is filled with exotic Indian culture, aroma of Indian spices and of course music. The Maharashtrian thali was better than we get in Mumbai. I highly recommend Passage Thru India for delicious Indian food.

Author: Karen NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pavillon
Review: Wouldn't give us a table in the empty restaurant, reserving the entire restaurant for Mulsim diners expected to arrive in the next hour and sent our family of 6 away. Hugely insulted and offended. Aghast at their service and rudeness. When at Sunway the meal and food and service was of a very good standard. Shocked to be turned away.

Author: AllyC09Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very bad service and quality of food
Review: It was unpleasant experience we gotten here with this restaurant (which is so much different from others branches at KL).Is intriguing learning the order and delivery system. As we observed, aside of our table? There are 2 more tables having the same issue. Next table who came in later and there food arrived before our brilliant eyes. Staffs works like lost birds. Our Yin Yong and hot tea took 20mins to be prepared and upon serving? It does looks like it sat there for 20! Our food were cold and pfff..you can imagineNever will we return to this outlet! I think the local food court have better food with great price.

Author: Wee WKlang, Malaysia
Title: Hope they can improve their cleanliness!
Review: It was my family favorite restaurant for Sunday lunch 20 years ago when they still operate in old shop with customers,ers sitting under parachute. New shop was initially nice but cleanliness is a big issue. We still go there sometimes but pork chop getting smaller and smaller.

Author: mohamednazimb
Title: Excellent food.
Review: I was hungry after a whole day’s seminar. I ate there on Sunday night and had breakfast there on Monday morning. Very nice

Author: boonyewGeorge Town, Penang
Title: A short, wavy, brown hair in my curry!
Review: I found a stand of hair in my green curry! Wavy, short, brown!We had a choice, Indian or Thai, but decided for chakri palace coz there're more customers. I chose a table next to the wide window to look at the towering KL Tower. Then the hairy experience began...Firstly, the diners at table left and a few waiters came to clear it. The last one came with a piece of cloth to wipe it. There's pieces of food on the table and to my aghast, he conveniently swept them onto the floor! But he swept them away after leaving them there for some minutes. There were other waiters who could have come with him with a brim and a dustpan, which didn't.Secondly, there was oily stains on my table near to where rested my arms. I complained and they wanted to move us to another table but I refused because of the gorgeous scenery I was enjoying.Thirdly, the menu came. I couldn't continue reading it because my copy was full of oily stains with thumbprints at the page edges. I felt disgusted but kept cool.Fourthly, we ordered Kailan with salted fish but when the dish came, the leaves were not kailan at all! They served us lettuce! I complained but was given the excuse that they only served that because other customers complained that their kailan was too hard! Can the chef really cook? Is he a chef at all? I ate it though.The last straw that broke the camel's back was there was a strand of hair that came in the green curry that we ordered! This is most disgusting with the kind of advertisement that they portrayed, top up with the posh venue that they occupy!I'll say no more now, I'll go no more.You may want to try but beware.For food quality, not at all that great. There're many more places better.

Author: JoannaF826Northampton England, United Kingdom
Title: Worst meal in a long time
Review: Throughout our amazing time in Kuala Lumpur/Borneo we experienced some fantastic food in a range of settings varying from 5 star hotels to street food. We opted for this restaurant with some apathy as were were tired with searching for somewhere to eat. The staff were ineffectual showing little enthusiasm and not typical of the malaysian hospitality we had enjoyed up to that time. A number of our first choice dishes were unavailable even though it was only 7pm which was not a good start. The first meat dish arrived quite some time before subsequent dishes and had only a very small amount of meat, the rest of the dish was made up solely of plain rice. Subsequent dishes were tasteless and/or greasy, spring rolls were unrecognizeable as such being flat in appearance, limp and very greasy plus little filling, the curry was just hot no flavour and a pork dish was swimming in grease with unappetising pieces of fat. In comparison to other places we had eaten this was the very worst place, the standard was not reflected in the price being more pricey than many we had previously & subsequently enjoyed. A very dissapointing end to our short stay in Kuching.

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Lou Wong built its reputation many years ago. Then it became too touristy and commercialised. It still attracts many tourist customers (especially due to tie ups with tour operators), but the Ipoh locals hardly go there. The chicken rice here is just ok, but there are better ones in Ipoh.If you're in the Lou Wong neighbourhood and looking for chicken rice, I prefer to head across the road to Ong Kee or walk to the next street to Pak Kong.

Author: Leonj59Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quality drop
Review: My first review of this place appears to have disappeared somehow. I thought it deserved 4 stars and a return visit. But it appears to have lost a star in-between visits. We ordered the tom yum chicken, basil minced meat chicken, red curry prawns and the 4-angle beans with peanuts. The tom yum soup was above average. Slightly pale red but perhaps could do with a bit more bite. The basil chicken was interesting but basil does that to people!!! The curry prawn was a disappointment. The taste was very bland but I'm glad the prawns were fresh. The 4-angle beans n peanuts was good - peanuts does that to people!!! And the mango sticky rice was just not there at all. Pity. It had potential. As an aside the restaurant was empty cept for us so service was fast.

Author: JustJessPerthPerth
Title: Nice food and atmosphere
Review: So we had the house specialties of Lepau Fried Rice, Fiona's Chicken and Tapioca Leaf with a bottle of the Apple Tuok. All of the dishes were nice, but for us lacked the usual zing of Malaysian food. Without making a negative comment about the food being bad, we have come to the conclusion that the local Ipan style of dishes are more bland than we are accustomed to, or the dishes were dumbed down because we were westerners. I would happily eat everything again and the atmosphere was really good, but I would not be rushing back as there are so many other options in Kuching.

Author: sunseanfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food with great service
Review: Visited a friend staying in La Paripari and we had a nice quiet dinner here. I like the quirky name of the restaurant as it certainly raises my curiosity to come try out the food. It was quite the hunt to find the location of the restaurant at first as it is located further down from the main road. However, this makes it nicer as the place is far away from the noisy crowds and we get to enjoy our evening with chit chats in peace. The portion is not huge as mentioned (I guess the portion is tailored more for asian tummies), but it is just nice. Leaving your tummy with a little bit of space for their desserts. We ordered their recommended starters, lamb, pasta and chicken. It tasted good. I admit it is not over the top good but it was okay. The service was over the top excellent, not in the professional way excellent (not that I'm complaining), but in a very friendly, welcoming and warm way that makes you feel as if they are your friends that you can hang out with, which is much better. We enjoyed our evening here and would definitely come back again.

Author: Willinko
Title: Best Ramen in town
Review:
Simply the best Ramen in Kuala Lumpur so far .
Menu is simple and clear .
Staff is professional. Ingredients are good quality.

Author: adele21212121Port Macquarie, Australia
Title: The food was amazing - the service very disappointing
Review: Busy bustling place - invited to sit down and we received menus. The waitress when she arrived was so rude. So unnecessarily rude to the three of us. Before she left we asked for a drinks menu. Waited and waited until we asked another waiter who fetched her. She grudgingly bought us a drinks menu but didn't come back to take our order. Our vegetables arrived (we were sharing four dishes) this was completely finished long before any other food arrived. the rest was really amazing - highly recommend the pork belly - we didn't ever manage to get anyone to take our drink order so we had nothing to drink. We will never go back

Author: 742sunilkBarcelona, Spain
Title: Tasty Food, Great Value for Money
Review: If you are keen to try out, cheap asian food, this is the place. Its crowded and service takes a while (thanks to the sheer number of orders processed by a limited number of chefs) but the food was quite tasty and authentic. Tip - Remember to have cash with you and try to be there by 6.30 p.m. as it gets really crowded after that.

Author: Babyface421JohnC
Title: Very expensive!!!
Review: Called in for a pint,took ages to be served.nice pint thou.staff crap,could not believe the price,just over £10 for 2 pints perhaps that’s what you pay in London?
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: loobyBucksbucks
Title: Chaos
Review: We ordered a starter of soup to be followed by 2 mains all three dishes came at the same time, they clearly don't understand the concept of a starter! Watching other tables one meal would arrive but the other meal turned up more or less at the time the first person had finished there's. One lady got her meal then another of the same arrived that was turned away only to be delivered again five minutes later while the poor man sat their with no food....get your act together! Maybe some staff training would be a good idea.

Author: ddiamentBuenos Aires
Title: Be careful with the taxi stand
Review: I tried to take a Taxi after dinner. Wanted to go to a rooftop for drinks so I told the clerk I wanted to go to the Reagent Hotel. He asked me 20 MYR (I had payed 5 MYR from my hotel 10 minutes away). Luckily I had my phone with offline map that showed me that the hotel was right on the footsteps of the Menara Kuala (300 meters away).

Author: sarahshg
Title: Deteriorating Quality..Overpriced & Disappointing
Review: I’ve been to the outlets at Pavilion (which was so-so, last visited in early 2017) and KLCC. This review is for the one at KLCC.Husband and I met up with a couple of friends for dinner. Luckily our friends (from Indonesia) had already eaten dinner at Little Penang Cafe so they did not have to experience what we did. Food:I had the spaghetti carbonara and husband ordered the Hainanese chicken rice.The carbonara was so-so..but I think it was not hot enough for the poached egg to really melt into it and stick to the pasta well. I ended up with a stomachache last night but to be fair, it could hv just been because I was fasting and had gluten (the pasta) for dinner.DO NOT ORDER THE CHICKEN RICE. Husband thought it was like hospital food or worse...I had some but despite craving for chicken rice, I could only take a tiny bit - chicken was tasteless like boiled chicken breast with no salt, rice was nowhere near savoury, soy sauce pun did not taste anything like chicken rice sauce..To make things worse..the chicken rice costs RM30! I don’t usually give bad reviews but this was just too bad.We also ordered Banoffee cake but the bottom half of it was dry..struggled a bit for 2 of us to finish it up..SERVICEWaitress was attentive but she needs to know her products a bit better - she informed my husband that chicken was pan-fried and it turned out to be boiled.Overall, service was so-so.AMBIENCEApart from the carbonara, prob the only reason why I’m not giving this establishment a 1-star (terrible) rating. Ambience is nice if you’re looking to hang out with friends and be able to have a conversation in a mall. This outlet used to be pretty decent even though slightly pricey (pretty standard by KLCC standards) but it clearly has deteriorated from the last time I visited if last year.

Author: presidenzPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent food pairing
Review: we have been there for dining and skybar,we are so happy with the meal we are dine,,tenderloin & blue cheese cream pairing with Peter Lehman Shiraz thats the recomened from the service staff very good pairing food with the wine,,good job to all staff and not forgot to the chef as well..we will be back to there,,:):)

Author: oneooneeast
Title: In consistant Service & Food
Review: The service are not consistent from the staff, no happy faces and the food delivery and quality are not consistant

Author: jartedmontonEdmonton, Canada
Title: Above average but tainted by bad service/policy
Review: Don't get me wrong this is probably one of the better places to get your char siew hit, I get mine every time I come back. However the service seemed to have slip on my last visit, we clearly placed an order with a specific amount of char siew and they (the boss who set this policy) decided to give a smaller amount, we questioned this quantity an the male server replied "this is the typical amount we serve to your size group" we kindly requested him to top it up to our original order and he said he will have to charge us 5 bucks extra (even when we already order half a chicken). A side note if you don't order a combination of meats you get charged 5 bucks !?!? This is the so called policy that the boss set !?!? Any way we eventually got the fee wavered after a lengthy discussion. Somehow the char siew didn't taste as great after that.

Author: jonathany689Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Bread 🍞
Review: This moonlight is located infront of Hong Leong Bank. This moonlight place offers a big variety of breads and cakes. I really like their breads alot. I do often buy them. I only visited the restaurant upstairs once to eat. At that time the service was super bad.

Author: andulucia86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Skybar were okay - there are better ones
Review: I only been on Thirty8 Bar and not the restaurant so the review is purely for that.The service is attentive but the pricing for their cocktails is on a higher side. Understand that might be contributed from the 5 star hotel and KLCC view.Speaking of the view - as it is all glass so night view was obstructed/not clear as they reflection glare from the light inside the building. There are more better places to go to if you're looking for rooftop bar view to KLCCWould not recommend

Author: Max WAntwerp, Belgium
Title: One of the better ones
Review: Hard rock was full but because of our all access we got the first table already after 2 minutes. The lady came to the shop and showed us our table.Service is good ant atmosphere too, unfortunately not yet a live band.Food was good however my meat on my nachos was not very tasty.

Author: Will B
Title: All about the view
Review: It's all about the view here, amazing view. The drinks and food were not crazily priced considering. There is a good outdoor area if you don't want to brave the cold (air-con) inside.

Author: Khai K
Title: Not brazilian style
Review: New updates, no more free mocktail for Ramadhan Buffet 2018. Paid for 15 meats, but they just served 9 meats. Even my table is green, but they are not coming to serve me. So free advice is, you have to request and called them for your meats. Its not really brazilian style as expected. Overall, I am disappointed. Not recommend this place for buffet.

Author: AllenY215
Title: My second visit to Ishin
Review: Food is still great. Only grilled fish head is a little overcooked. Waitress Sophia is friendly and made good recommendations. Definitely will visit again in future

Author: DL1688
Title: Great Venue, Excellent Service
Review: Back in Ipoh for CNY, heard so much great things about the restaurant so decided to give it a try. Three words sum it up for me. Great great great. Great Venue: a historical building beautifully preserved in the vicinity of Ipoh city center. Parking was easy with security guard on duty.Great Service: when we arrived for lunch, the place was jam packed, however, the service level delivered was excellent.Great Food: good mix of western and eastern cuisine that happily satisfy my entire family with diverse taste bud. Love the duck egg fried kuey teow and lava cake.A must visit for my family and I in Ipoh.Keep up the great work!!!

Author: Jagdave SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Latest Recipe @ Le Meridian
Review: Breakfast and Dinner here was awesome sep the efficient and helpful waiters. Would like to especially commend Sharvin. He recognised me as his sports teachers years ago. Will definitely come back here again.

Author: ruslananwar
Title: Expensive meal
Review: We have meal here, and the price is expensive.The only thing make us happy be there is lovely night life around us

Author: GuitarStrings01
Title: Lovely experience
Review: It was a fun atmosphere to celebrate my girlfriend's 24th birthday! She had a great time seeing the host cosplaying different varieties of clothing that represents the culture of the dishes. Needless to say, it was a Fun Dining.

Author: AymanA795
Title: Never again!
Review: I ordered a well done steak which arrived like 35 minutes later swimming in its blood!! I sent the steak back 3 times before it was actually well done. The waiter was most unprofessional and the quality of the food didn't meet the price.

Author: placingcomment
Title: Terrible
Review: The food quality is very low and doesn't even worth for the price. Never ever go to this restaurant. Every single thing there taste so terrible.

Author: HeatherMegaMauriFanLondon
Title: Good Menu - Poor Service
Review: We had a very poor experience here on a Saturday evening, having just arrived in KL.We waited 15 mins to give our order to the waiterWe then waited 45 mins for the food to come, which arrived in dribs and drabs so one person had finished eating by the time the other person's arrived. The waiter was so overworked/alone, he couldn't cope so you will enjoy the setting to view the fountain symphony, but you will be thirsty and hungry - go somewhere else !We were charged for service on the bill, we had a good laugh and just left.We also went to the Dome at KL Airport (ever hopeful) and the service was exactly the same .... They have a variety of good food/drinks but the service is really bad !

Author: JohndeSilvaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: absolutely brilliant!
Review: Dining at Qureshi is quite an experience. From the view of the Green to the splendour of the restaurant's interior and from the impecable service to the food, Qureshi sets the standard for Indian Fine Dining.Service:Attentive, prompt, friendly, and well-versed with their offerings. Gracious and not at all pompous.Food:Amazing! Everything that was recommended was absolutley gorgeous!Personal favourites: Dum Lucknawi Biryani (lamb), Jhinga Dum Masala (prawn), the masala tea, and the Qureshi Dessert Platter.Will most certainly be visiting again!

Author: Tengku A
Title: Rude Staff
Review: I called to ask where can I refer to the food menu online? He said he doesnt have the soft copy and I have to drop by myself to check on the menu. He didnt even give an alternative. Staff who answered my call was Kerith.

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: only great thing is its location
Review: FS Nasi Kandar Corner enjoys a great location, right in front of the iconic Bank Muamalat, near to Masjid Jamek LRT station and all it has to do is serve good indian muslim food as patronage is guaranteed. yet this is wanting as we found out over breakfast during the weekend. roti telur (egg prata) came looking tired and withered, the egg appearing in patches. surprisingly, roti banjir (prata with gravy on top) took a long time coming as it is the easiest to prepare: just dunk the curry and dhall on top of the prata. tehtarik was pedestrian, and the only saving grace was vadai though the nutty version was burnt. to top it all, the toilet was unserviceable, forcing me to go to the LRT station after ordering while wife earlier borrowed McD's washroom 100m away. dont think it is worth patronising again.

Author: tunatoniteKuching
Title: Second visit, still not much improvement
Review: This was my second visit, after more than 3 years. First impression was not good (they charged for extra plates back in the day) and upon suggestion of the owner, I decided to revisit this establishment for reevaluation. And I brought my wife for independent opinion. This was an unplanned trip as I want to see if the owners means what they say in response to my first review, which they reported to Tripadvisor as inaccurate.Went there after work on a weekday and the place was pretty dark and warm from the afternoon sun. Read about the day's special and tried to order some umai, but was told they ran out of umai after lunch hour, so we were left with no choice but to order some of the other fares on the menu. Seeing that the menu portions are for 2pax, we ordered 2 veg and 1 grilled meat (refer pic).I have taken Dayak dishes quite often and I find that the fare here is nothing to talk about, as well as miserable amounts for the price they charge.Environment? When they finally turned on the lights and the air-conditioning, then you will feel a bit more comfortable and start to check out the various exhibits. The laminated brochure about these exhibits was a nice touch. Playing of Christian songs in the restaurant is not really a good idea, and traditional instruments may be preferred for the mood. How about some sape music, eh?They don't charge service charge, but encourage you to tip. But you hardly see waiters except the moments when they come to deliver something to your table. And the price of dining is already 2-3x more than what I think it's worth. And just a handwritten receipt without pricing/GST information.Personally, I don't think this place warrants another visit. Due to my health, I skipped their desserts, so if you think it's worth a try, go ahead.

Author: amin434
Title: The place is not suitable
Review: This place in a food court. If not in school holiday, the will be croded with students. The food is ok.

Author: dogtrekKuala Lumpur
Title: this is restaurant food??
Review: This is the second time I tried satay celup.. and I was reminded why I didn't like it the first time 10 years ago (at Capitol then).. The ingredients are mainly processed meat/fish pieces skewered.. the taste of blended peanuts and pineapple is overpowering, the place is hot and sticky.. Just not to my taste..

Author: SPavDevPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The taste is getting stolen by
Review: Used to be my best ever place to eat mutton briyani and mint drink.. but now the curry is not too good, not spicy..and the rice is just... Normal... I come here regularly.. but now when I think briyani.. I wanna go somewhere else. They should bring back the old taste. Please help to maintain the food preparation.

Author: JohnFoster68
Title: Bad food, too expensive
Review: Ok it's right facing the river, which is favored by foreigners. The food was horrible and the prices 4 times what you pay at a local joint. Just go there for a drink and the views. The service was also lousy

Author: Azwan S
Title: Rude Staff
Review: I have no problem with other staff there.Except one of the malay girl so called Manager was very rude no customer service at all.

Author: Greg D
Title: A weekly rendez vous point
Review: Nice people, service is great. Food is amazing, sweet and sour pork, ginger pork, fried rice and so on...

Author: johnm136Perth, Australia
Title: Lives up to its reputation
Review: Visited this restaurant twice in our short trip to Melaka and found the food consistently excellent. The restaurant was located close to our hotel and backs on to the river. The decor is great and the staff friendly and professional, with the cost being affordable. Would recommend to everyone.

Author: rzinger
Title: Kyle tested Kyle approved
Review: Expert food critic Kyle MITCHELL tested yeast and what a success the brioche French toast with bananas and a chocolate orange sauce was exquisite!

Author: Adam1630Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, but looks like a transport cade
Review: The food is cheap and flavourful, the staff are helpful and friendly, however it’s not the sort of place you would visit unless you had the assurances of a good trip adviser rating. The restaurant is on the top floor of a concrete block and nothing has been spent on decor.I enjoyed the food, but wouldn’t go back as I think they need to improve the setting.

Author: DOHKL
Title: Like it
Review: Everything seemed good, menu is concise but the quality of every dish is there, the daily special spring roles were particularly memorable
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: Foodieonthehunt
Title: Chemical
Review: The food was so laden with flavouring and preservatives, it was almost impossible to tell what you were eating. I was particularly unimpressed considering the price they were charging for the food.

Author: Jwck1909
Title: No worth at all now
Review: We’re regular at this restaurant and we’re quite dissapointed to say that the food quantity has fallen over the years. They serve less premium food now and Prawn finish also wont refill again..when i ask about the prawn..the staff told me finish at 7.20pm..For the price that we’re paying is say it’s no longer good value for money.This price i can eat how many seafood at restoranVery dissapointed

Author: Sheena BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Great Culinary Concept
Review: It is genius, really. It is a tried and tested concept i.e. when one sense is removed, the others are heightened. In this case, the sense of sight took a back seat when we arrived for dinner. It was a fun experience, almost felt like one of those thrill rides at a theme park albeit slower paced and involves food. I felt giddy in anticipation. Our waiter was kind and entertaining; he guided us through each course. It is true that even when you are aware that you are not the only ones there, it feels intimate because of the pitch black setting. Still, I wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for a romantic dinner, though. There is a high chance that a group of extra giggly patrons would be seating next to you. Guilty as charged.

Author: divapdxPortland, Oregon
Title: Nothing to Hype About
Review: I wanted "local" cuisine and my friends brought me here. The dishes were just okay; nothing spectacular. We ordered curry chicken, otak-otak, fried chicken, fruit rojak and kangkung belachan. The only dish, IMO, that was good was the kangkung belachan. I was a rather disappointed with the other dishes. I was really looking forward to having some tasty local food after being away for sometime but didn't get what I was looking for.

Author: ARahimBSSIngapore
Title: Feedback that was not entertain
Review: Had a plate of rojak yesterday at about 9 pm. The first poke at the char quay with a fork, it was hard as stone while most parts of the pineapple, the core was mostly served in the plate Inform 2 waitress, they gave the feedback to a guy wearing a cap at the counter, kinda buat bodoh attitude. I heard he said, just inform him, minta maaf ajer. One of the waitress came back to me and inform that manager minta maaf and said," Char Quay dari ais box mmg keras cam tu,".What rubbish !!!

Author: Powerdoll
Title: Worst experience ever
Review: I choose to celebrate father's day at this well known restaurant but the 2 hours dining session was absolutely worst!!!All the waiter's attention and attitude are really horrible. The waiter attitude started being horrible when we start to order the food. They are extremely busy of the Father's Day celebration but all the waiters are never once smile. When they serve the rice, one of the waiter just stand beside me and shout, "pass to the other!". Then my mum asked for chili padi but they are just ignore.Come to the food, when the food been serve, we found that the meat is still cold which just toke from freezer and heat not enough. Then we request to help to reheat the meat and one of the waiter answer in rude which they won't heat for customer instead will serve a new dish. But when the meat re-serve again, it's actually the one as before and the chef mess up the meat like rubbish to serve us. The price is average as the rating for this restaurant but the foods are not nice as what my brother mentioned "mixed rice even nicer!". Really disappointed with the restaurant service and foods.

Author: Alamin H
Title: Irritating place
Review: The food is something OK but the service is so poor. I see some stuff taking so loudly and also have some problems of talking in a gentle way. I feel so bad in this place.

Author: GillMargoCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Not the best by far
Review: We ate there at lunch time and was surprised to see it so empty, other ones we've been to have always involved queuing and lots of waiting at that time of day! Food wasn't spectacular we both ordered the bar b q chicken which was tough and undercooked around the bone. On a good note it was very reasonably priced in comparison to others we've visited. We wouldn't go out of our way to eat there again as it was totally lacking atmosphere and musical artefacts were limited.

Author: SK.A A
Title: Terrible Service
Review: Been sitting here for about 6 minutes now and no one came to take my order or even gave me the menu. I'd previously ate here when it had just opened and the food was quite alright. Location is superb, just right next to my office. It's just their service that needs a tremendous makeover.

Author: yich99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Good tripe and fagioli for starters. Pastas average - certainly not fresh nor al dente. Service good at first but let down by slow service for mains. Pork ribs undercooked, sent back and took forever to come back, and when it did everyone else had already finished their food. Chef apologetic and gave a discount, but sorry, not worth a revisit, and especially to avoid subjecting yourself to the chef's insistence that you smile to show that you're enjoying yourself at his restaurant, when you're clearly displeased.Perhaps would benefit from a shorter menu concentrating on his forte, and not having his effort diluted by such a wide choice of mains, the quality of which he ultimately cannot control. Could also benefit from more generous portions.

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Staff like loud music
Review: As fast food goes the food is not too bad. They get points for quoting net prices which is unusual in KL. Unfortunately the staff seems to like loud music. Every time I go, guests complain about the level, which is so that it's impossible to have a normal conversation. Techno at discotheque levels just ruins the overall experience completely.

Author: kareem_ss
Title: Excellent!
Review:
This is an excellent choice for Arabic food. The kebab and shawarma are amazing and the service was extremely professional and friendly especially Abdullah.

They also have delivery for nearby hotels.

Author: chansaikeongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Only
Review: I have been to Batu Ferringhi many times but yet to have a chance to try this restaurant. Due to many recommendations from Tripadvisor, I am eagerly to dine here. Finally, I made it on 20 October 2017 for having our dinner here. Below are my comments/experiences that divided into three themes namely restaurant location and environment, staff service and food quality and price. The restaurant is located in the 2nd floor of Eden Parade. If you still having no idea where is it, basically it is just opposite of Golden Sands Resort. It is a small eatery shop with unique decoration. Restaurant environment is cozy and clean. Staff services were good and fast. The owner, Andrew, was nice and friendly. Food serving time also fast which we waited for about 10 minutes only. Before discussing the food quality and price, let me list down what I had order for our dinner (for 2 adults and 3 children): char kuey teow, Chinese style fried rice, chicken satay, spring rolls, crispy squid and 3 drinks. All dishes except squid were a bit salty. As a Malaysian, I would rate the food quality as ordinary. We paid about RM75 for this dinner which I am considering a bit pricey.

Author: ParaffleGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Walk on by.
Review: We had arrived in Kuching an hour earlier on an early morning flight from Penang. Having checked into our hotel we set off in search of breakfast. This bistro is in pole position on the waterfront, consequently would be chosen by many like us with little or no knowledge of Kuching eateries.My advice would be to walk past this place and find another. People generally in Malaysia are charming and here they were pleasant, but were not very accommodating, eggs on the menu were only available as fried despite them being offered in various styles. One of us ordered boiled eggs these when they arrived had barely been warmed, with little or no white, a health hazard potentially, speaking of which, whilst we were waiting for our food we were watching a rather weird looking cat who then proceeded to catch a rat and was running around showing everyone his trophy and finally running into the kitchen to show the chef. The staff were most amused, the girls letting out little screams.. On the plus side the one type of coffee offered was pleasant. Everything was priced in line with its significant location but without the quality to back it up. Malaysia is great at street food at budget prices, this place doesn't deserve to be in business.

Author: LianaR2727
Title: Beautiful set up and delicious
Review: Beautiful set up and delicious food. The teppanyaki are too die for! Miss Azura and her teams were helpful and service was good. Oh yes not forgetting our surprise anniversary cake complimentary by them. Thank you!

Author: NineEleven74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Steamed sea bass, the fish was not fresh. The stir fried vegetable was so salty as if the cook dumped half a bottle of salt in it & dessert bobo chacha was too sweet, we added half a glass of water but didn't help. I won't be coming back for sure. Oh & the toilet was filthy!

Author: kmaria83
Title: Take away ... bad food and pricey
Review: We got two dishes and sides to take with us. The sandwich was fine but the rest was not good and not with the money.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: diebutter
Title: Very friendly
Review: The food is very cheap and ok. It's not too loud (compared to the rest of this erea). The staff is very very friendly and the athmosphere is quite nice.

Author: UncleFas
Title: Fusion tapas
Review: Interesting fusion tapas that hits the spot. Has junior servers that needs refining. May get a bit loud and smoky inside especially when cigars are lit. The food is interesting when one is adventurous.

Author: AshwinT95
Title: Fantastic food and excellent service!
Review: A great place for a fulfilling culinary experience. Dishes represent the amazing flavors of Malaysian cuisine put together in mind blowing new ways. Not to be missed

Author: shizz2527
Title: Zende
Review: Great restaurant. Breakfast very nice, Buffet Dinner also very nice. Conveniently located in the hotel with a variety of western and Asian food.

Author: Diving O
Title: Sarawak River view
Review: Beautiful bistro just in front of the River quiet and nice design! Not expensive and good food ! Have to try ...

Author: KevP10
Title: Good Middle Eastern food
Review: Great food. Lamb kebab, falafel wrap and tabbouleh standout. Nice setting for lunch and very reasonable

Author: gav cBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Very mediocre
Review: I can't understand the hype about this restaurant maybe thats just because Im not malay/chinese. to be fair. However I found the staff to be somewhat disorganised. We were seated quickly however non of the dishes were really explained and when they started to appear it was in a totally strange order i.e. main dishes before starters. My partners food arrived and we had to ask when mine was coming . Then they forgot half of what we had ordered.The food really wasn't that good either, tasted very cheap quality produce so far as to say ive had better quality chicken in a mcdonalds. I think their main aim is to pack the place with as many people as possible to make money quickly but the quality and service let's them down.

Author: CTSULAIMAN
Title: Arab Rice The Spring
Review: Suitable for all races. Just drop by and have a try. The price is reasonable. Location at The Spring Mall at Jalan Simpang Tiga Kuching Sarawak

Author: dyganon
Title: Playing Chinese Songs
Review:
The food- good
The drink- good
They play Chinese songs and hokkien songs all night long
Pretty pointless

Author: D3sm0nd_L0wYuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia
Title: A little disappointed
Review: Tried the restaurant after some recommendation.The food is average Spanish food. Maybe I was expecting more. We tried Escargo, Fried Cauliflower and Paella Chicken set.I had high expectation on Escargo from this restaurant but it was not to my liking. Fried Cauliflower was quite special.Tried two drinks: Spanish Breeze and Lemon Ginger Soda. They are not bad. Didn't try the wines.Staff is friendly with good service. The dim ambience helps create soothing and romantic environment.

Author: ChrisHemaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Comfort Food Joint
Review: I love the concept where you can basically create your own burger. There is a huge board hanging across the wall that gives you the 4 simple steps from choice of buns, patty, add ons and sauces. I ordered the Mahalo which is stuffed pork patty with caramelised onions, grilled pineapple, melted monterey jack cheese and creamy mayonnaise. The patty was juicy and succulent. My friend had the Fish N Chips. It was dissapointing. The batter was blend and soggy. The staff were friendly and helpful. I would recommend this place and will return to try the "building your own burger".

Author: bbgg12345Sydney, Australia
Title: Delicious!!
Review: My friend and I shared the prawn fritters for starter, the sea bass and a noodle soup dish for main. It was so tasty and the setting is beautiful. Honestly, the food is outstanding!!! The staff are also really friendly and offered us some great travel tips. Our waiter Ryan was really helpful when we were asking questions about the menu. It’s probably a bit pricier than standard food but it’s so worth it.

Author: Fakhri L
Title: Link restraunt
Review: Good food and quality of food.Service staff frm the welcomer untill farewell is nice.food is no problem and want recommend to give ur staff name Rafizi and also camee (chinese) such a good give service to us and also make our day special that night.thanks for pullman team
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: hanKer H
Title: Worst Clam Linguine with lousiest customer service (Midvalley outlet)
Review: We (8 of us) visited Yeast Mid Valley today for dinner. I have the worst every dining experience in this branch. We complained to the manager on the main course (Clam Linguine and burger) is undercooked for the linguine and overly salty for clam as well as the burger patty. We provided the feedback to the branch manager. He did provide the feedback to the chef immediately. The unbearable response from the chef is that he claimed they only serve the linguine "undercook", this is the way how they serve it! Come on, im a foodie, I can differentiate what is undercook and serve perfectly. We giving this feedback is purely hope that this restaurant can improve further, but what you gotten back is excuse from the chef. I'm truly disappointed of this dining experience in Mid Valley outlet.

Author: highburychampionMelbourne, Australia
Title: I think I missed it, unsure....
Review: I caught the LRT to Kampung Baru and there was food and other things for sale on a road basically right outside the station. It was along a road which had the freeway on the other side.I was there on a Sat night and I honestly didn't know if this was something else or if it was the actual Kampung Baru Hawker Stalls. There didn't seem to be enough stalls to speak of.I did venture further back away from the small strip of stalls but it was dark and I was on my own so I chickened out a bit as it didn't feel that safe.I did sample some nice delicacies and drinks here. Like I said, not sure whether I actually experienced the right place but it wasn't worth a special trip out from what I saw.If you come out in the day time, you can scope it out more.

Author: GanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheese prawn meehun
Review: We phoned earlier to reserve a place and the moment we reach the restaurant we were led to our table. The food came 10 minutes after we have ordered. The signature dish of cheese prawn meehun was delicious. We kept on drinking the irresistible soup. The steamed otak otak and eggs was well done. We were very impressed with the signboard of the shop, so colourful and attractive

Author: yusufyaran
Title: Ok lah
Review:
Dined on 18 May late evening solo.
Ordered lamb kebab and ice tea.
It was ok lah, nothing to shout out and nothing to complain

Author: WinstonthedogPorto, Portugal
Title: Poor Service and Mediocre Food
Review: I wanted to really like this place since their glossy menu looked impressive. Their luncheon specials also looked great "on paper". Unfortunately, the service was pretty lousy and the food was very mediocre. The place looks nice, but there are other Middle Eastern restaurants that have better service and tastier food.

Author: gimry10
Title: Good restaurant with large breakfast buffet with variety of vegetarian dish for breakfast
Review: The Zest Restaurant have indoor and outdoor dining. It overlooking large swimming pool. The staffs were very helpful in arranging a vegetarian meal during our stay since we are here for two week borneo break from India. The tall guy we met in the restaurant converse well and know our requested cuisine well.

Author: chanlkwin
Title: Delicious food selection
Review: I have dinner here using the YTL complimentary dinner voucher. There are also various other ala carte food selection which are delicious & value for money.However, you really need a lot of patience to wait for the arrival of the food servings as they seem to be shorthanded with only 3 waiter/waitress around to manage the restaurant. Ideal place to dine if you have ample time to spare for the night.

Author: muppet911Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Don't understand the reviews
Review: I always try to search out good Italian restaurants and it is a little difficult in kl as many are not run by Italians. Opus has always had great reviews and so I thought I would try. I tried several times to just rock up without a reservation and never succeeded ( weekdays - not weekends) so I assumed it must be really good! How wrong. I went with a female friend and we again tried with no reservation and luckily they had a small table for 2 outside, which is no issue. What was an issue is the risotto I ordered, risotto is a basic Italian dish, albeit it does take a little care and attention but this was simply terrible. It was more like Nasi goreng (local fried rice). When I complained the waitress was completely indifferent and didn't show any concern whatsoever.they obviously asked if I wanted to change etc etc but that's not the point. My dining companions food was also very mediocre. And as in usual kl style the dishes arrived 10 or 15 mins apart! This really really annoys me, when you go to dinner WITH someone you want dinner WITH them, not to watch one another eat!! It appears a lot of wealthy locals eat there and I can only guess they don't know any better!

Author: neupaneajBangkok, Thailand
Title: Amazing Joint Even for a Late Night Food
Review: On our recent trip to Kuala Lumpur, feeling hungry late one night we stumbled upon this joint by chance. This is a Pakistani BBQ joint we were told by the attendant there. Right in the heart of the city not far from KLCC we found this place with decent food, friendly service and at a very reasonable price. Server named Islam was very courteous and friendly. We had beef bbq with Chicken Biryani (sort of like one pot dish like Paella but from India/Pakistan). Food portion was generous. Next time when we go to KL this place will be on our agenda. Highly recommended.

Author: olicgn
Title: Fancy crap
Review: Noisy environment, don’t know how to do basics. Serve you old toast and give you blurred faces when you complain. I actually gave it a second chance today but this was definitely the last one.

Author: Patrickamonaco
Title: Good!
Review:
Breakfast was included with the room. Large selection of Western, Malaysian and Asian food. Nice fresh juices!
Friendly staff, well done.

Author: Aneeta S
Title: Terrible customer service
Review: I am disappointed to say that although the food here is average the place has terrible customer service. The waiter dropped all the dirty dishes he was carrying all over my baby stroller and there was no apology or any remorse for the accident he had causes. To my luck, my son was not in the stroller. I was disgusted at the way the staff responded and they made a very poor attempt to clean the mess. Regardless of that, the food was average compared to the other saravana restaurants around the world and there are many other better non veg eateries. Never going back.

Author: 305lamj
Title: Great food and environment
Review: Had a big group of 25, gave us a banquet table without booking. Entrance and settings are fancy. Food was delicious and service was excellent. Pricier than other places in the region but still really good for the price. Would definitely recommend!!!

Author: Wolv3rin3
Title: Of Roti N' Briyani
Review: Get together place for teh tarik and Roti canai. Favorite comfort food for me, esp. for breakfast. Or chow down Mutton Briyani.

Author: 446philipf
Title: Amazing!!!!
Review: We love the layout of the place and the upgrades the mangement has done .Mr. Kartik, Fahrid and Kallay are to highlight. Watch those lovely sunsets with a great view – stunning place. They also serve a good Shisha that comes very quickly. All in all – highly recommended. All of the restaurant outlets from Ritz Carlton are great and offer an impeccable service at a very decent price. Dont forget to sign up to be a Marriot Member as well.

Author: Calvin L
Title: A typical family restaurant
Review: Decided to check out this 4 star Google rated restaurant. Firstly when you get there, parking will be a problem, as it's Subang! The service was prompt as there was someone that greeted us a the door and quickly got us a seat. The crowd was a mix of family and young working adults.We ordered the chawanmushi and the the one with crab meat and sharks fin as well. The regular chawanmushi was really bad as the eggs felt overcooked and hard. The crab meat one tastes much better with more well cooked eggs but it costs RM10 more. The Unagi that we ordered was rubbery and not well grilled. Slightly below average as I was expecting more , as it costs RM50. Rakuzen definitely wins in the area. The rice was hard and unappetising, topped with not so savoury gravy as well.The fish skin was nice on the first bite and not after, maybe it's the oil that feels that it has been reused and not fresh. Thee tempuras here are slightly flacid and the yasai tempura is over cooked and slightly charred but it's a full Nepalese team that's cooking it, not Japanese or locals so you can expect much for quality. The salmon sashimi I would say is good value for money as you get 7 slices for RM25, which is very decent however, 3 belly slices and 4 slices of God knows which part of the fish. At least they provide freshly grated wasabi so that was good. The overall experience was ok, as service was prompt and would definitely be good as a family type of Restaurant. Do not expect a great deal on the food quality or taste, it's very mediocre.

Author: Emventure1414Lampang, Thailand
Title: Amazing vegetarian dinner
Review: Went here with a friend for dinner after exploring the mall. We tried the hummus, veggie samosa, falafel, and garlic naan. Everything was incredible! The food came out very quickly and was all amazing. The hard part was choosing what to order. Even as a vegetarian, there were plenty of great options that all sounded delicious (both meat-eaters and vegetarians could be very happy here).The atmosphere in the restaurant itself was great too. Beautifully decorated and a great place to sit and enjoy dinner. Will definitely be going back on our next trip to Kuala Lumpur!

Author: Rudi P
Title: Good but expensive
Review:
The chicken rice was OK but can find similar in Melaka with less price. Probably because of the location nearby Hatten, Straits Hotel and Novotel. 
The good thing is that it serve halal food

Author: Nicevedham
Title: Homely food
Review: I had a nice experience like my home.. You might any part of world, will love food here, nice food and hospitality.

Author: 23mrr
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Excellent food and services. Staff provide excellent services and food is really authentic Korean food. Love the mural on the wall.  Felt the warmth of Korean food culture.

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: RE: A real let down meal of Portugese cuisine
Review: We had looked forward to having an authentic Portugese meal on our visit to the Settlement.Restoran De Lisbon was named as one of the most popular, according to Trip Advisor.We ordered three dishes, and, disappointingly, not one of them turned out satisfactory.I think the chef needs to pay closer attention to using quality seafood They need to serve customer fresh seafood and ensure that customers are not short-changed in value for money.For example, the crispy battered squid we ordered tasted terrible. All we got was a lot of batter wrapped around tiny little squid tails and tentacles. What happen to big round juicy squid rings? We get better quality, quantity and tastier squid/sotong from some seafood restaurant for less than the prices charged here.The butter garlic clam was swimming in a pool of melted butter in a cream sauce. It was simply too rich and milky. Any Chinese or Malay seafood restaurant could have done a better job.The Devilled Chicken curry we ordered was very ordinary in taste as well. The chicken pieces were very roughly chopped up, with bones sticking out, and the meat tasted like frozen chicken, rather than farm fresh chicken.Given the higher prices charged here compared to other ordinary roadside seafood restaurants found everywhere in Malacca, Restoran De Lisbon needs to pay closer attention to the quality, taste and presentation of its food to retain customers and attract new ones.

Author: Sushi118Melbourne, Australia
Title: Not recommended.
Review: Me and my wife had the course dinner a Kebaya restaurant. We were looking forward to the experience because of high reviews. The restaurant and hotel were indeed beautiful to look at. However when the appetizers arrived all illusions were shuttered. The presentation was poor, taste blunt and boring. This continued for rest of the dinner. However the worst part is proteins and greens came cold. They couldn’t even get the basics right. I don’t know what kind of deprived people could recommend this poorly managed food joint.

Author: Patrick L
Title: Jalan Alor Night Market
Review:
This is almost the centre of Kuala Lumpur and in the side street of Jalan Alor almost every night there's a food night market. 

It's very touristy though and the prices reflect it. 

Food is only average but the ambiance is pretty unique.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: thef00dcritic1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointing! Was served uncooked rice and horrible service
Review: The food is cheap but horrible. Their eggs that come with their rice dishes are soaked in oil and i almost threw up squeezing out the oil on my plate before eating it. The rice that was served not just on my plate but on all my friends plates were not fully cooked. The rice was hard and was uncooked. The staff looked clueless when we informed them and did not bother to change our meals or do anything about it. The staff have no idea about their so called "discount" on meals. One time I went there they gave me a discount, the next time my friends and I went there, they told us we don't give discounts for the same exact thing previously ordered. Strange! The tom yum soup is very disappointing. There was only 1 prawn in my seafood tom yum soup with the rest just being vegetables. My friends and I never went back to this horrible place.

Author: Chetty747Tirupati, India
Title: Best Fish Curry!!
Review: My 3rd time at this place. The food is good ( southern style), a little different from Bombay Palace( northern style) with more yogurt taste. As a starter try the chicken pagoda. For the main dish try the masala fish , tandoori chicken as we as the naans of you are not into rice. There is also briyani rice that you can choose. Masala Tea is good for the end. Per person will be rm70-90 depending on the fish. Place is a little bit dark but for some this is nice ambience . Friendly staff and accommodates for birthday but you will have to bring your cake. They will bring it out and serve. Walking distance back to bukit bintang.

Author: mapmanishKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing food and service
Review: I have eaten at Ginger several times since first visiting in 2006 but don't think I will return. The food on my last visit was mediocre, with everything being notably tasteless, something one wouldn't normally associate with This food. Unfortunately service wasn't much better, with no welcome from the staff we had to seat ourselves. The staff just seemed to exude a total lack of enthusiasm and care when serving us.  There are far better, and cheaper, alternatives all around KL so I would struggle to recommend Ginger.

Author: NeerajJk
Title: Much to be desired!
Review: Service - Excellent , friendly manager and waiters.Great ambience and interior decor, very comfortable poolside seats.BBQ buffet dinner on Friday nights - absolute rubbish! Marinades were mediocre. Seafood grilled was overcooked. Beef was tough and chewy. There was no lamb cuts at a BBQ buffet!Free flow wine was ok but not palatable after 2nd glass. Had to order ala Carte pasta and a separate bottle of wine. The squid ink marinara seafood pasta was nothing to shout about too.Didn't try the pizzas, maybe would have better luck with that.Give the bbq a miss.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: sashi201
Title: Best pork free italian place ever!
Review: The pizza base is very crunchy and the desserts are certainly out of this world! Our waiters were very attentive and I think the items are reasonably priced here. I would say that this is the best pork free Italian place I've ever been to!!

Author: YSY41
Title: Lunch with Mocha
Review: There are plenty of western foods, like burgers and pasta for you to choose. I have choose the aglio olio with mushroom and iced mocha for my first visit today. The price is reasonable and taste ok. It is overrated perhaps. The pasta is a bit too oily, but the coffee is just nice.

Author: Ian MBath, UK
Title: Great place to eat
Review: The decor of this restaurant is fairly basic, more like a cafe. However the extensive menu is great value. Service was also good, which deserves mention because every table was full with a queue of at least 10 people waiting for a table whilst we had our meal. Highly recommended

Author: Kritz_YPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Not a fan of the food
Review: This is a little hard for me to write because the people there were friendly and helpful. But alas, I cannot gloss over the fact that I wasn't quite impressed with the food. The canapes were a little bland. The Chicken Liver Truffle Pate didn't really taste like pate. Maybe there was some fusion thing going on but the description made no mention of that. Wasn't a fan of the bread either. I didn't really get to taste the Angus Slider properly so I can't comment on that.The Taiping Duck & Garlic Fried Rice was a little ... common? Mediocre?The Tuna Villa Gajah (Asian-flavoured spaghetti with tuna sashimi) felt a little too oily for my liking, which overpowered the tuna.The Negombo Stir Fried Crab with Mantau tasted pretty much like any other stir fried crab that I've had at typical Chinese restaurants, save for the fact that it was deshelled and easier to eat.Wasn't a fan of the Saffron Snapper & Scallop Ravioli either. The cream sauce was a little too dense.

Author: kathirasu2529Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My horrible experience
Review: On 9 April 2016 I was at this horribly serviced restaurant with my family. We were very irritated with the chappathis arriving at the time of paying the bill! I then requested that they be packed but was told that it is not possibe for buffet. Fine but I told the waiter its not my fault that it arrived late as it shud have been served b4 my lunch. That idiot was so rude that he told me that I need not pay if I wish n thats wat I did to teach that sarcastic waiter. Don go there,they only flecee you with the rotten service.lI REPEAT DON GO THERE IF YOU LOOK FOR SERVICE FOR VALUE? THEY ARE BLOODY CHEATS?

Author: BadriKumar
Title: expensive and lazy waiters
Review: location is nice.food also delicious but expensive.waiters are so lazy.difficult to order food and same problem to pay bill. The waiters dont pay attention to costumer. Need to train more.

Author: Mikkie LCosta Mesa, California
Title: Great decor, bad service
Review: This place was just across my hotel and I decided to walk-in for an afternoon meal on Christmas Day. I had a bad experience with their service. Walking in, the place looked really great, the design and the majority of the chairs looked amazing. I was immediately seated and given a menu. I ordered a kebab and a sprite. When my server took my menu, his exact words were, "soup or salad?" as if it were included in my meal. I was a little surprised by this question because I didn't think anything was included, I thought they were doing a Christmas Day special of sorts. My drink came out promptly, the soup was brought 8 minutes after ordering. The actual entree took more than 25 minutes! During this time there were 4-5 other groups eating. I was looking around for someone's attention because I wanted another drink. There were at least 5 servers working but they were gathered around each other and just talking. After I finished my meal I waited around to see how long it would take someone to notice and give me my check. Took 10 minutes before I had to get up and ask someone for my bill. I expected to pay RM 25 for my drink and kebab entree, I was pleasantly surprised with the extra RM 10 that was in the check for that goddamn mushroom soup I didn't even want. I told the server, that he didn't tell me that the soup was an extra charge. I guess that's just one of the ways they scam you here.The service was terribly ridiculous as there was no one else at the restaurant by the time I was finished eating. Not to mention, a lady was mopping the floor of the entire restaurant while I was eating, went around me too. I don't want to seem rude, but when you're having a meal on Christmas Day, a dirty mop is not something you'd like to look at while you put food in your mouth. All in all, I was hoping this was a wrong place, wrong time scenario and their service isn't like this normally.

Author: fizah4848
Title: great choices & attentive staff
Review: delicious sarawak laksa & have a variety of food to choose from. friendly staff & will try to fullfill your request even if it is not on the main menu.

Author: Tasha3469
Title: Mrs
Review: Very bad service with spicy food!!! Server is rude. Didnt expect this. Went there after read review from trip adviser but all upside down!

Author: Tiffany_travellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great crab adventure
Review: We had 4 crabs among 4 people. Yes, that's how much we love crabs. We ordered them made in two styles - one in the signature milk crab and the other steamed crab - cos we figured that if you can't get steamed crabs right, it means your ingredients aren't fresh. And I'm happy to report that it exceeded our expectations. Prices aren't cheap but if you go hungry, you'll be rewarded.

Author: JenA1071
Title: This mall could use a facelift
Review: To be fair Nando's itself wasn't too bad but the whole area looked like it could do with a facelift. Visit if you're feeling touristy else there are outlets elsewhere for you Peri-fix.

Author: Alexandra SCanada
Title: Average food... overpriced and overrated
Review: The food wasn’t the great. We had the lemon fish and the sweet and sour fish, both with rice. There was barely any fish in one of the portions. The lemon fish was over cooked and the sauce was horrible... it didn’t really taste like anything. So overpriced for what you’re getting.

Author: Babak MToronto, Canada
Title: Worse Arabic restaurant
Review: I have tried many middle eastern restaurants. It was the worst one.I tried grilled lamb cube and lamb liver. The quality of both foods was bad.

Author: MajournieMontreal, Canada
Title: Amazing vibe, okay food.
Review: We read about this place online and we thought we'd give it a try as our first Malaysian food experience. The vibe was amazing, they had a musician playing Malaysian beats, the staff was nice and well informed. The order came fairly fast, our apple juice was tasty and fresh, the food presentation was really nice and appealing but the taste didn't match the looks, sadly they weren't too fresh! Fried food felt a bit soggy and the satay had a bitter aftertaste. You'll enjoy the place if you're not hungry and just want to grab a drink.

Author: Traveler568679
Title: Good honest grilled food
Review: This place is very busy and has a selection of grills and curries. We went for the mixed grill and it was spot on!! Service was good. Will definitely go there again.

Author: Ljsums
Title: Great food, great atmosphere
Review: Loved the food, really tasty and a large portion. The atmosphere was nice, and with live music later on, really made it even better. All the staff were lovely, Lan was a great hostess and took care of me for my visit.

Author: Littledotman
Title: Peking Duck
Review: I feel like being cheated when order the Peking roasted duck. Cut only a few slices. There rest of duck meat said make fry noodle. It was disappointed that only so little noodle and meat. Where were the rest of more than half duck gone? Gone to other table serving? Only one I can describe this shop. 黑店！I rated you negative star. Not zero star but negative

Author: Capta1n57
Title: Still as good
Review: Haven't been here for a while,but always good. Their specials menu is always fun,as they place a large blackboard on a chair at your table,displaying the days offerings. Always plenty to choose from. Good staff and plenty of customers for a Thursday night

Author: AdventuresWithNessStratford-upon-Avon, United Kingdom
Title: Very bla bla blaaaa!
Review: After reading numerous positive reviews on here about this restaurant, my boyfriend and I decided to take the plunge! We had been living off street food and enjoyed the variety, but thought this would be a nice change.On arrival the restaurant is beautiful. It has stepping stones over water and heads out into an open eating area with a range of table sizes. We were suitably impressed. We arrived at 7pm and there was only one other couple who were finishing their meal. We ordered at 7.15pm and then the place started to fill quickly!At 7.30pm we hadn’t had any drinks, but we presumed that due to the busy period and influx of people that there was a slight delay so were happy to wait. However, by 8pm we were getting frustrated but there was only one waiter who was rushing around in a state and 15 tables of people who also had no food. Then, we noticed a few tables who had come in much later than us, had been fed or at least had drinks. At this point we were getting very cross and my boyfriend was ready to complain. It got to 8.30pm and we finally asked the waiter what was going on and he was flustered, panicked and rushed to make us some drinks. When he came back he said “I’m sorry, your order got lost!” And we had to reorder. We were very confused by this... how could our order disappear when we were the first there? It didn’t make sense. But, we reordered and at 9.15pm we finally got some food.I had the mango duck - which was very wet and clearly rushed through. Not a good meal. My partner had the crispy duck which was on the bone and chunks of pure gristle.Not very impressed!Be warned ;( we were so disappointed.

Author: SabrinBedi
Title: Decent place for cocktails with family and friends alike
Review: Ambiance is nice. The cocktails were a little weak .  The chicken varuval is amazing. The asam boi martini is a must try. Suitable for cocktails over the weekend ( cocktails are availble from lunch time ) ..while dining with kids.

Author: zzoggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expected more...
Review: Stoked has been a regular hapyy hour place with my group of friends and thought it was due for a dinner visit when they had a Noma alum on board. here is my review of the dishes we ordered:warm with truffle butterbread was a little dense however butter was excellentamuse bouchechips with parnship powder: a little oily, stale and tastelessstarterheirloom tomato saladsimple dish, no complains. mainsiberico collar the pork was tender and juicy however the dish was spoilt with a side garnish of canned peach. Would've expected a homemade relish from a proper chef let alone a Noma alum rib eye > ordered medium rare with a side of mushrromsThis dish came rare, on hind sight we shoud've sent it back but i was with a date and didnt want to make a fuss out of it. Wouldn't preferred the steak to be more charred with proper doneness esp with their special RM50k charcoal oven. Dissapointing dish, the au jus that came with it was underwhelming and tasteless. The mushrooms came cold and had a wierd rub on it.ServiceOverall decent for Malaysian standards but head waitress never bothered to check on us... WinesGood selection with decent pricesOverall Just your average western restaurant, underwhelming considering they have a so called No ma alum. I have yet to find a steak restaurant (jakes, prime, ril's, la fite, zipangu, las vacas, etc) in KL who can cook a steak with proper doneness, seasoning and char.

Author: Chaslyn
Title: Sunset dinner
Review: Service was fantastic, Food the best and view to die for.There is something very special dining on the sand with a cool breeze and great food.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: paulchoo
Title: chicken rice is wonderful
Review: Waiting time for food is a little long. however, the chicken rice is quite amazing. i will visit the place a second or third time each time i have a chicken rice craving.

Author: mmj17Bridgend, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, great atmoshere
Review: Menu a little tired but good food quality ,helpful bar staff , great rock music , but not the same as the old HRC since new management took over a few years ago

Author: elisa_kkMumbai, India
Title: Not much of a china town.
Review: We've seen Chinatowns in Thailand and Singapore so I must say this was a disappointment. Lots of clothes and bag shops, There is so much on display that you feel overwhelmed and put off.I did not find a single "bargain" item to feel thrilled about. No quaint genuine Chinese antiques or clothes. This was our experience. I would love to hear how others feel about it.

Author: Roving823994
Title: So expensive
Review: The food here is getting worst by the taste, and yet the price is so expensive..we rather eat at 7spices with good food and value for money...

Author: elanfoo
Title: Rest place for the old town visit
Review: There are many stalls to see and place to visit around these areas. We found this cafe through the tripadvisor. It is genuinely a cafe with some artistic deco. Feel cosy and enjoy the nasi lemak. Coconut drink is a plus

Author: Stephen o
Title: "Sorry" seems to be the hardest word
Review: "Sorry ah, foool (full)" repeated in a Malaysian-Chinglish accent by the elderly uniformed woman at the entrance greeting you best describes this outlet. Everytime, we thought of dropping by for an early dinner, my wife recounts this perenial utterance that will greet us. So we were told by her to avoid weekends all together and weekday lunches - "No chance lah" and most weekday dinner times. Well that leaves us with each entry subject to the roll of a dice! Hopefully its one of those API@400 hazy days or its torrential monsoon rainy days, that gets us in. On a few occasions, depending on her mood, we have managed to wiggle in for a half hour dinner slot. Other than this "Sorry" greeting at the door, none of the captains are sorry for anything that goes wrong. Once we caught out three times a female captain for lying to us about the closing time (20 minutes before time), no prepared table was available (plenty were found in a room) and no more dimsum only porridge (but there was none too).I threatened to report her to her boss Philip, for such poor customer service, though I did not. Until today, she avoids serving us. When our boy spat out some stinky stale fish from their Cantonese seafood noodles and I complained, the male senior captain just shrugged it off in silence as he processed my payment."Sorry" seems to be the hardest word here except at the door. We are not too sorry as we head over to their better half, the Han Room @Midvalley where their captains take our feedback seriously so far (but not the chef).

Author: Wolv3rin3
Title: Noodles and Latte
Review:
This review is for InterMark branch.
Having a late lunch, grabbed a Curry Mee (RM 20.00) and Latte (RM 8.00) to wash down. The Curry noodles was average, curry broth was thin, had better at coffeeshop. Latte okie.

Author: AussieGaijinKyoto, Japan
Title: The best in KL
Review: I have tried all of the highest level Japanese restaurants in KL and I have to say Tatsu at a Intercontinental hotel is by far the best. From the freshest sashimi to crisp tempura, this really has great cuisine. A definite must for lovers of Japanese food.

Author: TheWoody
Title: very good Japanese fine dining.
Review: this is my first dining here. the food is very good and the food is fantastic. the deco and ambience is very nice. will definitely come back again.

Author: sophymuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst experience ever
Review: Avoid this place during Ramadhan buffet at all cost. This is the result when the management chose quantity over quality. Overbooked, incompetent staff, rude and ignorance, i saw a case tonight when the customers shown up but his name was not in the book (imagine few minutes before iftar), crowded for sure, and the list goes on.It used to be good, not anymore. So please, avoid. Go elsewhere.

Author: starvingcritique
Title: Very slow service
Review: This restaurant is a quintessential type of a failed fine dining concept restaurant. You can see how unsystematic their ordering system is. People would sit for so long to have their order taken before waiting for another longer time to wait for their food to be served. All the staff seems busy to the extent that they forget to give a good and friendly customer service. You don’t feel the warmth welcome from any of the staff instead you feel their cold and hay wire working etiquette.

Author: Richard_Heng
Title: Will be back!
Review:
Had a quick lunch at this restaurant, we only ordered 3 dishes. All are pretty tasty.
Services from the staffs is very good, no complain. Tidy, clean restaurant.

Will be back next time to taste the Peking Duck, looks good (other tables).

Author: mark c
Title: Family Friendly Food
Review: service slowish or "Malaysian" as it's also known. Also typical of Malaysia, very family friendly, great food and despite the most torrential rain I've ever seen outside, a nice dining experience. Good varied menu makes it ideal for large groups with different tastes.

Author: mewmew3008
Title: Very good BKT and great price!!
Review: After reading reviews online, went there on Sunday with my BF. After driving through some houses, we finally found the restaurant and it was so crowded! We got a mixed BKT, 3 rice and 2 tea and the price came to around rm38-40 for both of us. Reasonable and there was plenty of meat. Will return next weekend!!

Author: priorityfoodKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food
Review: I was recently brought to this restaurant by some friends. I have never heard of it even though I frequent Publika. The restaurant is located on the first floor of Block A4 and is not so easily spotted unless you are exploring the area.The ambience is a fairly relaxing and casual setting. It does not exude the fine dining atmosphere and when we dined there, there was a child there too (there was a kids menu admittedly).The menu is quite limited in choices although nice exotic French names to it. The prices on the menu are of fine dining level. The wine list is quite extensive. The food overall is nice although I didn't think it matched the price that was charged. I have had much nicer French food. The service is very attentive and is efficient.So overall, it can be nice place to have dinner but just a bit pricey.

Author: christine389Miri, Malaysia
Title: Standard Has Suffered Terrible Decline
