Review: It used to be a good place to enjoy Chinese cuisine, like BBQ pork ribs and peking duck. We went there last Sunday, and was very disappointed. Service was bad as per their already existing reputation, but what upset me the most was the equally bad taste of their food. We tolerated the bad service and waited >45 minutes to be served lousy tasting ribs. Very disappointed indeed.

Author: wen jie m
Title: Love the corn soup!
Review: Came here for a dinner with my family - the soup is sweet and the fish is fresh! Will recommend for others?

Author: MLips1
Title: Good food👌🏻
Review: Nice location, and good food. Price/quality is perfect. I had a laksa and it was really tasty. We recommend this place.

Author: stuffmattersLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cold beer, relaxed
Review: Goo9 was a welcome stop on our Ipoh walking tour for a cold beer, air conditioning and a light lunch . It has a fun ambiance and a menu of interesting small bites. The beer was ice cold and just what was required whilst the waitress was helpful & friendly.

Author: AvidTraveller007IpIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Dim Sum affair so so...
Review: This restaurant [located in Weil Hotel, Ipoh] serving fine Chinese [Cantonese] cuisine was opened in December 2014. A carpeted restaurant with modern setting coupled with soft warm lighting. Had morning breakfast at this restaurant which advertised its all you can eat dim sum affair at RM28 per person. There are only 24 selected items which you can eat as much as you like together with a pot of Chinese tea [puer tea]. However, you are reminded by a friendly notice on the table that any unconsumed food will be charged at RM30 per 100gm. If you order any dish not in these 24 items, you will have to pay extra depending what you order. The dim sum served tend to be on the oily side and is of an average fare – of course there are better dim sum in Ipoh City! Restaurant also serves lunch and dinner.

Author: cwkchee
Title: Good food but pretty crowded
Review: We always love the food at Overseas except for the loud chatters and often difficult to have a conversation.  Despite that we still rate this restaurant 4 stars ...

Author: santhanamnskBengaluru, India
Title: Good South Indian food at low price.
Review: This restaurant is a 5 minute walk from Berjaya Times square. I stayed at Metro Hotel and visited this one for dinner. I had an onion utthappam and a juice for just 9 MYR. They had two chutneys and delicious sambar for the Utthappam. Ambience is pleasant though not fine-dine level.

Author: Prinzess_BeeKL
Title: Superb view of the twin tower!
Review: Marini's is divided into 3 parts- the bar, lounge and restaurant. As we only checked out the bar, I have to say that the views are amazing! There's an indoor area and an outdoor part too if you want something quieter. They do serve some tapas, so it's a great place to go to after work for a drink or two.

Author: Amanda TDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Interestingly Yummy
Review: Funky bistro with interesting seating options. Menu has lots of options. I had the mango calamari salad and the 4 cheese pizza. Very large portions and all tasty. The house red wine was a great way to wash it all down. Staff are attentive and help make great food recommendations.

Author: rzsandoval
Title: Great place for breakfast!
Review: Located in KL's little India.  Wonderful Indian food.  I don't know what I had since my friend who is a local ordered, but it was great!

Author: popcin22
Title: Just OK
Review: As much as I wanted to like the food based on the reviews, unfortunately it was just average. The staff was lovely however      as was the setting. The chicken curry was better than the lamb dish, which was essentially boiled lamb in a broth.

Author: stormlccIpoh
Title: Overhyped and overpriced
Review: This restaurant gets top marks because there aren't really any competition in Ipoh for a western restaurant. It's previous contender (that not many people know about because we locals tend to keep to ourselves) is gone (because the chef passed away recently).Another problem with this restaurant's review is that most people in Ipoh don't know anything about western food at all. I am not trying to offend anybody, just telling the truth. People tend to give high ratings because it is the ONLY thing they tried, they don't have other choices and they don't travel outside of their comfort zone most of the time.Although this restaurant has the ambiance and some fairly decent western food, it does not warrant such high marks because it's prices are ridiculous. The food quality and taste is not superb (just mediocre), and the quantity is...pathetic, yet they charge prices that are comparable to a 3 course fine dining for 1 dish!If the food is excellent, then yes I would gladly pay it, but it's just not worth it. The only salvageable thing in it's menu are the desserts. What I suggest to the people who are really obsessed about food is to go outside and explore, don't hole up in this place.

Author: Dantay80Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Not for locals
Review: We picked this place for dinner as we thought of a nice dinner with paddy field sunset view. Sadly there's none as there's a wall separating the restaurant, blocking the view. I think this place are more for tourist and overpriced. Nothing much to comment about the food, not to our liking and no intention in reputation damaging.

Author: simply-blissfulLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Never Disappoints
Review: As a long time resident of Langkawi, if there was ever a place that I want to go and have good food and good service, this would be one on my top 10.Of course, it helps that they know what my friends and I want...so personal recommendation is the Spicy California Rolls, the Yasai Salad as appetisers. Main course - you can never go wrong with the Sushi Gozen but if you are not into sushi for some reason, go ahead and get any of the grilled fish options or the Gyu Katsu Ni and for dessert, try the green tea ice cream with red beans.I would also recommend an advance reservation as even long time customers would have trouble just walking in to get a seat as there are nearly always full.

Author: Crisper1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice little cafe
Review: Cosy and relaxed little cafe in the lane way. Good menu with a mixture of Asian and western. Breakfast options were good - not many places offering healthy breakfast options in Kuching. We came a couple of times and enjoyed it. Staff are very friendly as well.

Author: Ipchloe
Title: Out of expectation
Review: Queing to eat their food but found out that their dim sum is not so nice and food are very small portion. Not recommended. Surprising that there are alot of tourist queing outside the shop when we dine. Not recomended.

Author: chanlim89
Title: Great Place, Food &Service
Review: This place has a good ambient. The food are great! The dessert creme brulee is a most try! The service provided by the waiter Vince is excellent as well!

Author: Ragini4
Title: Delicious north indian cuisine
Review: Had a great experience dining with family here. Nice and cozy ambient. Loved the Briyani and Parathas. Enjoyed yummilicious north indian food while listening to favorite hindi songs.

Author: Tan L
Title: Breakfast is good at Foh San
Review: Good atmosphere here if you come early don't need to wait. Each dish is well prepared. Service is good too, before you finish your dish, the waitress will take away the plate. Overall good, will come back for more if back in Ipoh.

Author: SurfingWildBandung, Indonesia
Title: Always excellent and fresh food
Review: This is one of my favourite places to eat fast Japanese food. The food is always fresh and tasty and the price affordable. I always come here early so as to avoid the queues at lunchtime and evening time. My favourites are the salmon mentai, salmon sashimi, spicy ramen, and ebi tempura temaki. However, this time the temaki was cold and perhaps not fresh which was disappointing but hope they will not serve it again like this as it tasted bad and like eating cardboard. Make it fresh and hot next time guys.

Author: Wonderer1961Orange County, California
Title: Good food;poor service
Review: Service was poor. The relatively tall lanky waitress (head waitress?) in Japanese garb (pink and white colors) asked us to wait for a table, but then seated a local couple who arrived a few minutes after us with no apparent reservation. She finally seated us at a small two-seater table next to a loud party in a semi-private room. When we were ready to order, I signaled her and made eye contact, but then she just continued chatting with a yellow garbed waitress for several minutes, before finally sending the other waitress over to our table. We ordered. My order, the Gindara Bento, arrived about 10 minutes before my partner's order, the Yuzu Gozen Bento, finally arrived. My partner had ordered her grilled beef well done, but it arrived rare, even though 10 minutes late. The food was generally good, although my saikoro wagyu steak was not as tender as I had expected - all three tiny pieces. In short, the kitchen is generally good, but the service falls surprisingly short for a Japanese restaurant and left us feeling disappointed. The bill for our two bento meals with tea came out to a bit more than MYR 150.

Author: chp021108
Title: Ming Court Dim Sum is value for money.
Review:
This traditional dim sum shop has been in existence for many years already. The food taste good and the price is relatively cheap. 
Nothing exceptional or nothing to complain about. 
A good filling breakfast before doing anything else with cheap but good food.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Naresh-Emani
Title: Good vegetarian food
Review: Restaurant is little hard to find without gps. The jain thali was sumptuous and good option. The service and price were okay.

Author: S CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good porterhouse steaks served
Review: We checked out the steakhouse during a weekend visit. They lived up to their reputation of being one of the best steakhouses in KL . We had both the t-bone and the porterhouse steaks. Excellent quality and presentation. It's close to our memories of this eaten when we were in NYC. What a great find!

Author: F1287PPandrews
Title: Wonderful little eatery with energetic staff
Review: Great spot.. it's low key and cosy which adds to the charm. The vegetarian rice special is a must which comes with kimchi and mini pancake ... the spring rolls were average tbh... best bit though are the staff for sure who get 15/10 for enthusiasm!

Author: syabilng
Title: Everything was good
Review: Food was great. Coffee was superb! Ambiance was nice. Especially if you get near the window. Service was fantastic too.

Author: AlbertoN78
Title: Fresh and tasty
Review:
Good atmosphere. Unfortunatelly very crowdy.

They re using a lot coconut in their dishes. But everything we tried was nice.
Waiters were  very kind!

Title: Over rated
Review: It's not bad but it's not super good either. The boiling sauce was alright, but the seafood was not all fresh. The processed meats like fishballs and all are ok but fresh seafood could be better.At least we didn't have to queue miles long like at Capitol.

Author: loneranger2204Miri District, Malaysia
Title: One of the best eateries that serve local traditional dishes
Review: Famous for local and visitors. Well known spot for "kampung" dishes. Especially for the(Orang Ulu, Bidayuh, Iban and to any non Muslim), it's a heaven on earth. The dishes surely reminding you of your grandma and mom's cooking ( kampung/long house). Spoiled yourself for varieties of dishes with black /white rice wrapped in leaves. Or snacking the yummy kuih pulut.Go try it yourself.

Author: tanyastewart21Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Must visit
Review: If you are in Subang Jaya and do not want to overspend on the food then this is the place. Laksa and char kuay tiau (don't know how to pronounce this till date) was amazing. Very reasonable price. As Malaysia trip was going out of our budget so me and my BF decided to cut down expense and visit some place affordable. Fully satisfied and highly recommend this one.

Author: AHK2960
Title: Long Queue
Review: It's considered quite popular with long queue, after we parked our car at the back lane, we saw 2 indian men were cooking & stirring a big pot of curry on the back lane outside the restaurant, so we left without trying.

Author: LWilsonnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced and nothing to rave about!
Review: Walking into this restaurant with some expectation especially the owner/chef is someone reputable and by judging at the price of their menu, the price is certainly comparable to some fine dining restaurants in KL, and I thought, I must be in for a great treat here! To start it off, my appetiser which is the mushroom soup is tasteless, and very starchy, the warm soft shell crab salad suppose to be served warmed but it comes out chilled! And for second, I thought I've ordered a cold platter salad! My main course is trio crab ravioli which is way overly salt! Not to make it sound awful but I taste nothing but SALT! The dessert I ordered is some sort of chocolate lava cake or molten chocolate cake but when I cut the cake open, expecting chocolate oozing out from the centre of the cake, it turned out over baked, the texture is dry and there ain't any chocolate oozing out from the cake... And not, I'm not trying to be a harsh critic here and definitely hesitate to range any restaurant as 1 given any opportunity. The food here is literally not up to their name, nothing on my plate is "Indulging" and the only food which is good is my glass of Merlot for the evening, and that's explaining the 1 star I'm giving here, only if my Merlot is considered food! Definitely overpriced. IMHO, spent your money elsewhere and save yourself!

Author: AbdelrahmanKhammash
Title: Requires Improvement
Review: Soup and quesadilla were very good, but main course of steak was disaster! We ordered well done and it came half well, also a lot of fat was attached making experience worse.

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Always loved this Bar / Restaurant, but getting pricy !!
Review: I have been visiting this bar / restaurant regularly whilst in Malaka for the last 15 years or so. Have always loved its ambience, live music and interesting décor. But most of all loved its location on Jonker Walk making it a prime spot for having a drink whilst "people watching", this is especially true on Friday and Saturday nights when Jonker Walk is turned into a night market and the street is heaving with people, the Geographer Café is located right in the thick of the action and thus very popular.Although the service has remained good,the choice of drinks good, the building well maintained and the music still excellent it has become somewhat pricy. Indeed probably one of the priciest places in this part of Melaka, sadly this means that the days spending hours and hours at this bar watching the world go by are over, still however the perfect place for a late afternoon or evening drink or three.

Author: Chow ESingapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible Tasting Thai Food
Review: I ordered the Green curry fried rice, expecting the green curry to be in a separate soup and rice set. Alas, the green curry was fried into the rice itself, and it tasted horrible. The service was really good, and the ambiance of the restaurant though.

Author: eritayunan
Title: Great service
Review: 5 stars for Sarmila! And the food is great too!  Will definitely come back again. Very good music and atmosphere

Author: MrsMomTravels
Title: Good buffet spread
Review: Too good of international breakfast buffet spread. Spoilt for choice. The prata is soft and yummeh to be eaten with its curry/ dhal.

Author: rajni r
Title: Tasteless food and watered down coffee.
Review: Food was not tasty or fresh. Coffee had no flavour. Overpriced and not worth it. Too many flies everywhere. Staff and service took ages.

Author: reddragon5860
Title: Delicious Seafood
Review: We went there 3 times out of 5 nights' stay in Kuah Town. Tiger Prawn was the best in Langkawi. Staff were friendly and gave us good recommendations on how to cook seafoods to our taste.

Author: Lawrence YGreater Sydney, Australia
Title: Casual Dining
Review: Prices are reasonable and quality is quite typical of most other hotel chains. Occasionally the service can be a tad slow or "missing in action" even though patronage appeared to be relatively thin.

Author: RobertP7785
Title: A magnet for young tourists
Review: Crowded with tourists drinking overpriced beer.  Food looked ordinary, but having sampled the beer I didn't eat there.

Author: ericdamiansean
Title: Great Mee hoon kueh!
Review: This place is perpetually full 24/7,and hence they sell some prawn crackers or you can walk about 10m to your left and buy some fried prawn fritters during lunch time. Hand torn Mee hoon kueh with a nice,chewy texture.

Author: Larissa O
Title: Horrible
Review: The Nyonya food was terrible, the ayam buah keluak was hard and expensive. The udang masak lemak was too milky, no sour Rastenburg just plain santan. The ikan cili garam was soooo sweet and not pleasant The other dishes were very sweet. The cendol is horrible, the ice were in chunks, had to bite my ice. One of the worst nyonya food I had.

Author: childishbambinoBrisbane, Australia
Title: Let down
Review: I visited this restaurant about a year and a half ago and I was really excited to go back even though it is a little expensive. I was very disappointed as I ordered the same things (loaded potato skins and cajun chicken salad) both were nothing like I remember and much smaller portions, however the price remained the same. Won't be going back.

Author: ram r
Title: Worst experience!
Review: “3 adult + 1 kid. Is there any minimum order? Visited SS2 branch today and ordered 2 portions of BBQ to try out. Was told we had to order 2 more dishes cuz there are 4 of us. Staff keep telling me is poliCy. Pls enlightened me.”

Author: Jasper T
Title: Rotten salmon served. Beware! Avoid! Avoid! Avoid!
Review: Visited this branch previously for dinner, ordered a few varieties of fishes mainly salmon. Firstly, the Salmon Maki tasted weird but too much vinegar was in the rice. I think they are trying to cover the rotten fish. Then came the Salmon Sashimi, took a bite and almost puked. The fish was rotten and how dare they serve these to the customer. Luckily I escaped without food poisoning the next day. Anyway I assumed the staff did not know of this issue. While making my payment at the counter, I kindly informed the staff "I think the Salmon has gone bad, someone might get sick from eating it. You might want to inform your kitchen about this". You will be shocked with his reply. He said "Oh, I knew something was wrong with the fish. Customers had complained this morning and I'm aware of it".I gave him the W-T-F look and left speechless. People, beware of this chain! Avoid at all cost or you may end up in a hospital with severe food poisoning! AVOID!

Author: DunreyLiLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to watch the world go by
Review: Situated on a street corner in the busy Jonkers Street area of town this is a great place to grab a drink or a bite to eat and to watch the world go by. The Geographers Cafe has a good range of drinks and an interesting menu with plenty of veggie options. It is reasonably priced and has friendly attentive staff who see to your every need.

Author: Tiwari2509Singapore, Singapore
Title: Seafood with scenic views of the straits
Review: We chose to dine at this particular establishment, based on one of our colleague’s recommendation.This is a place to dine if you’re looking for reasonable seafood with some sea breeze and scenic views of Singapore, right across the Johor straits. Prices here are a little bit above average for Malaysian standards but given the ambience, it’s well worth it.All the seafood that we had here were extremely fresh, along with the vegetables. However, the 3 Rasa fish dish wasn’t exactly having 3 different tastes (rasa) as the name of the dish suggested. Furthermore, the sambal seemed more towards the sweeter side, something which we are definitely not a fan of. Rest of the dishes were alright.In a nutshell, dine here if you’re looking for a seaside dinner with your family, with reasonable food at reasonable prices. Otherwise, it isn’t a loss if you give this place a miss.

Author: zoeb813
Title: DISGUSTING
Review: Flies absolutely everywhere (very uncomfortable and irritating constantly swatting them away whilst trying to eat), dodgy smelling eggs, watery baked beans, undercooked chicken sausages and a rude waitress that tried to overcharge us and then round up the bill...unprofessional, SO overpriced...simply AVOID.

Author: Kam1186London, United Kingdom
Title: bad customer service
Review: my wife and i decided to go here for my birthday meal while we were on holiday.we arrived for a 7pm reservation and were shown to our table. there was roughly 4/5 tables during our time there that had guests. i think there was like 2 waiters and some other staff floating about.the service was poor. we were not recommended anything special or whats on the chef menu today or given an amazing experience. we order drinks at the same time as our food, yet the drinks came half way through our food after my wife and i had to keep asking.at the end i asked the waiter to remove the service fee as i do not wish to pay for bad service. he refused to do so. i was shocked and spoke to the manager who stated that they were understaffed. at the end of the day thats not our fault and it was not like the restaurant was major busy.after arguing he stated he cant refund me the service fee but paid for the taxi back to KL.Completely disappointed i would not recommend this place at all.

Author: 241nurun
Title: Sofia Di stefano
Review: Sofia is one of  best knowledgeable  service in JB and very good whisky selection .They have many  great cocktails in JB .

Author: NABAJIT280
Title: Wow great taste
Review: Best Italian Restaurant in Kuching - Sarawak, I visited several times to eat their special Pizzas, Great taste, i just loving it

Author: Kee F
Title: highly recommend
Review:
nice enviroment and nice serving ~ 
highly recommend the dessert , will visit again for their dessert and food !!

Author: malimucanada
Title: Over blown simple
Review: The restaurant claims necessary to wait for food to arrive at table. True. The lamb shank biriyani came. The shank was room temperature tasteless. B rice arrived separately was so so. Butter chicken so bragged about here was on sweet side. Luke warm basic so was another chicken tika masala i think. Nothing close to tika masala. i guess ok for local or those who have no clue what it sd taste like. Not piping hot as it took some time to arrive and on sweet wide i guess locals like sweet. The hot chai tea came after lot of pomp and show of the maker barely warm to not worth a sip.only worth the dish was cheese naan. Rest for a very savy foodie this was a so so place. good for locals as kuching does not have much of indian cuisine as we know. No offence. Not coming back for sweet curry n barely warm food.

Author: O L
Title: Elegant and delicious food, good atmosphere
Review: I just had my launch there, order grilled fish(mashed potato and fried vegetable as side and garnish ) 25 RM no service charge no tax, it was simply delicious. Silky mashed potato , tasty side and not to mention very affordable The only problem was that my fish was a little bit under-season , and the parking was closed , I could not find it easily, but they said it is temporary...

Author: AgaTheBlueTiger
Title: Great plate-forme evening drinks
Review: It's a very nice chill out place. The list of drinks, moktails and beers is decent. Food is also available. Its such a nice corner shop where you sit and observe the town life. Like a cat.

Author: WongHY17Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: CNY Eve dinner 2019
Review: My family had our CNY dinner at Putien.Selected their new year menu for RM 288++:- Prosperity Yu Sheng- Seafood Thick Soup- Deep Fried Squirrel Fish- Deep Fried Chicken with Garlic- Spinach with Century Egg- Mazu Mee SuaUsually Putien dishes out good stuff, but not on this occasion.The squirrel fish doesn't taste fresh.Only the mee sua and garlic chicken was decent enough.Perhaps the dip in quality was due to the large reunion dinner crowd.But we are willing to give Putien another try.

Author: Yomera2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Main courses... yes
Review: I am biased, yes, I am from Mexico, so my mom will always be the best. But since my mom is not cooking for any of you go and try Fresca in Midvalley if you want to try some Mexican food. Next time I will jump straight to the main dishes; less calories and more taste

Author: TheThoughtShifter
Title: My favourite branch
Review: Although sitting in the basement of a giant luxury shopping mall is not my idea of a nice ambiance, this branch of the Simple Life vegetarian chain is definitely the best one I’ve come across. The staff are very friendly and the food is delicious... the chef here is really good, because the signature dish here tastes better than when I’ve had it at other branches. If you’re at The Pavilion, it’s basically the only healthy food option.

Author: tompowell16Redditch, United Kingdom
Title: Poor quality of food
Review: We ate her one night and it was truly awful. If I had to compare this to restaurants in Vietnam, this would truly be the worst. (And we ate at some awful restaurants in our 4 weeks in Vietnam!The beef was unbelievablely chewy, I couldn’t finish it and that’s rare for me. I wouldn’t even give it to my dog. Egg seriously over cooked.

Author: Arthur M
Title: Mediocre food and services
Review: Arrived at 950pm, desperate to eat after a long bus journey back to kl, was hoped to eat some quality food with reasonable price. Gave us the food menu in iPad, and when we decided to order the dinner set before 10pm, they told us the dinner set is gone after 10pm because there is only one chef left. Which is 40% extra cost on the a-la-carte. Had to pay more for the same food we ordered, because the only have one chef. Their service is mediocre at best. Do not recommend to come after 930pm since you never know when will they only have one chef again.

Author: V1465PYkimlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What a Sad Birthday Lunch ☹️
Review: We had a birthday lunch for our colleague at Ben's today. Sadly, the birthday lunch wasn't a happy event at all. We ordered the mushroom spaghetti, warm salmon salad and the aglio olio. The mushroom spaghetti was tasteless and the aglio olio never made it to our table. Well...I lie...it did but took almost ONE HOUR!! Gasp! Horror! Btw, that dish was also tasteless. The place was packed and the service obviously stretched and waiters/waitresses looked frazzled. I wouldn't recommend this place for lunch unless you have lots of time to spare and don't mind consuming tasteless food. Prices are to be expected as this is after all, a restaurant in KLCC. Sorry Ben's...I wished I could give you a better review but I just cannot.

Author: B5942BYjanb
Title: Lol
Review: You will walk in and feel excited, but when it comes to actually enjoying, be prepared for serious disappointment. The wine was corked, the degustation menu is a joke, I cancelled it 2/3 of the way through. Very good for Instagram, very bad if you're serious about food.

Author: Hypr FWaikoloa, Hawaii
Title: AMAZING VIEW - Beautiful Pool
Review: Even for a Fiday night it was pretty subdued - so you might think it's good for a quiet romantic place or a group of friends having a chat having a drink ... BUT they have this idiotic DJ playing really LOUDLY to the point where no one can have a conversation UNLESS you go OUTSIDE to the Infinity pool area where the best view of the city is. Potential of this spot is incredible - but they have to decide if it's going to be a high energy club or a premium Sky bar restaurant. ...and yes, the SERVICE SUCKED !!

Author: hariharankumarasamyKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Good place, comfy food
Review: We found this place for dinner from tripadvisor recommendation.Nice place with good decoration.Not a northern indian food expert, but definitely had better food elsewhere compared to what was offered.Nevertheless we had a good dinner with prompt service.They have potential to be a great restaurant with minimal improvements. Thank you.

Author: Wolv3rin3Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Average Buffet
Review: Buffet Lunch after meeting, whilst service was relatively good. The food had certainly food to improve in terms of spread and presentation, few that looked appetizing, and the taste matched too unfortunately. Saved for the Assam Fish which was the only good dish for the lunch, perhaps an off day.

Author: PerthVince_KPerth
Title: I reckon it's time to refresh the deco and the Kitchen
Review: I was anticipating a nice japanese lunch ala the expected Ozeki standard, but alas was seriously let down. The service staff seemed to be new and inattentive, in spite of only a few tables occupied. Had to attract their attention to get a refill of Ocha.I ordered the Unagi lucnh set. The unagi is only just passable, the sauce is too sweet without any fragrance. The wait staff omitted giving the japanese pepper pot for this set and I had to request. The 6 slices of sashimi were not arranged nicely, kind of flopping on the side.Looking around the restaurant it has not have a renovation since it opened its doors in late 1990's, really due for a reno and a sprucing up the kitchen quality. I did not see any senior head chefs in the kitchen.

Author: EgilJessheimJessheim, Norway
Title: As good as its gets!
Review: Breakfast or dinner at this restaurant is an experience in its own right! Food and service is exigent and if you get a table by the windows, you will have a great view as well! If there is something special you want for breakfast, just let the staff know. They will get you just about anything your heart may desire.

Author: Kim TPhiladelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Hmmm. Sai woohhh
Review: We stumbled upon this restaurant and thought we give it a try. The crispy pork and fried salted soft shell crabs were not not. The pork was dry and very small. The soft shell crabs were fried w alot of flour and soaked in oil. Do not get them. Their fried rice and soy bean sprouts were good.

Author: baoshunSingapore, Singapore
Title: High expectation - Bad experience
Review: Made a reservation for 8pm dinner. Arrived at the restaurant and there were only hungry diners with no restaurant staff in sight. Waited for 5min and finally saw somebody. Informed of my reservation and only to be told that we had to wait outside until a table is available. Obviously, the earlier reservation was not recorded. We waited. After about 20minutes, still not one in sight to usher us to our seats. We gave up. Wanted to inform the restaurant but the guy was too busy taking orders from other diners. We figured, the wait is not worth it especially if the wait time for the food is expected to be more than 45min (based on TripAdvisor forum).Bad experience. We had high expectations. Just too bad. Left disappointed.

Author: DanialZ57
Title: Don't even think of going
Review: This has got to be the worst fine dining experience a person can go through. Horrible, and I mean horrendous service with mediocre food at best.

Author: notgoodenough2London, United Kingdom
Title: Small portions
Review: Beware small portions. Mixed starter would be better described as a selection of dips. Seafood tagine would be better described as a starter. The bread was good but I could have stayed at home eating bread rolls, would have been much cheaper. Toilets are not great. Few of the reviews here have same photos and very staged close up photos making the meals look much larger than they are, I am suspicious about the authenticity of some of these based on my experience of visitng.

Author: princessshazakuching, sarawak
Title: i dislike it
Review: i try tinot laksa last time. my aunty want me to have a taste of tinot's laksa because my aunty knows that im a laksa lover. i dislike tinot's laksa because the taste of prawn overcome the taste of laksa and the gravy is not thick at all..the best laksa ever is my mom's and both of my aunty (wa and usu)..

Author: Sarah_AyuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Restaurant
Review: I don't really get the hype about this restaurant. I have such high expectation with the food but its just normal restaurant with nice deco. The food taste is average, normal portion. I order the seafood olio. I already ordered plain water as I don't take sugary drink with my meals. My partner did order the drink. When the drink arrived, the plain water not being given. Seriously? Then have to ask the waiter for that damn plain water. Such a terrible customer service, Not worth the money. We will never go back. please spend your money on somewhere else.

Author: jamester74
Title: Good cocktails
Review: Sat here for a few hours sipping cocktails and listening to the sax/piano. Relaxed atmosphere and really professional and polite staff

Author: chris2pherwongCanton of Zug, Switzerland
Title: Excellent Modern Malay Cuisine at European Prices
Review: Came here for dinner after reading the reviews and was not disappointed. The place is elegantly decorated and the service was superb, especially by our waiter Shabir who was so knowledgeable about the food on offer and gave excellent recommendations. The cuisine is essentially Malay with a modern twist and food was beautifully plated and tasty. The barramundi in coconut sauce was delicious. My friends enjoyed particularly the 8 different types of sambal that were served. All in all a very lovely experience and my friend said she will be back with her girlfriends.

Author: flhl82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: just a PASS .......
Review: I came to this restaurant with a group of friend on Sunday afternoon , as expected there are other patrons queueing up for seats.....It took approximately 15 minutes for the queueing !!! Overall the quality of the food is so so as i have try some other places " otak " particularly from Muar which is far better than this restaurant. On that particular day the waitress has actually messed up our order BUT fortunately we are already full so might as well cancel off the order. The food is slightly expensive because of the fame of this restaurant at Melaka. However, this is not the truth........in fact i am very disappointed with their cendol. Their cendol are very poor even some roadside stalls outside of Melaka can beat this restaurant , the portion is little and tasteless !!! Overall the atmosphere & cleanliness is up to standard and it is suitable for a group / family to try out some of the Melaka local delicacy.

Author: SN S
Title: Christmas lunch
Review: Although I didnt celebrate christmas, we decided to try the christmas lunch. The view was fine. But, the buffet was dissapointing.. the turkey pastry was hard, the only thing tht tasted good was the fish turmeric. The dessert was a let down. This will be our last meal here unfortunately.

Author: linggeeerococo
Title: Reaonsable priced and old school dim sum
Review: Just came back from the dim sum. My friend and I woke up at 6am to avoid the weekend queue. The eatery was quite empty when we reached at 6.15am. Thirty porridge is really good. A must try. As the crowd came at around 7.30am, we were already full from our food. Portions are small which is good as we can try more variety. It is right opposite the mosque so you won't missed it.

Author: 36elainhNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Not worth the money!
Review: We had a very disappointing meal here. We booked for the 7:30pm sitting and our tour operator never said it was only from 6:30 to 8:30! Had this been the only issue the review would be much higher. Upon arrival we were shown to our seat quite quickly and as we had opted to pay extra for a window seat we were happy with the seat given. That was until we realised the child from the next table decided to keep running round our table and then sitting under it. That was after he had stood between our table and the window a few times! Only once did a member of staff ask him to move. Added to this the food was not particularly good, it seemed like lukewarm left overs in the main. We did complain but still got charged full price including the window view supplement. They did say we could go to the viewing deck via a shortcut down the stairs, which we did, only to find there was about a 45 minute wait to get the lift down! It seems they treat you well on the way up with the fast track lift to the restaurant but after you've paid you no longer have the fast track ticket out!! We definitely will not go back as we last went several years ago and recall having a great meal then - times have definitely changed as we had a far better meal this time at the China Town market for a fraction of the cost!

Author: nikt w
Title: Excellent Dining
Review: The food here is no doubt a class above. (Although you pay for this) Service from waiting staff is professional, friendly and conversational. If you want a little treat and privacy with an ocean view this is the place.

Author: perdana89
Title: Yummy kebabs and hummus with quick service
Review: We had the falafel (after so many reviews here) and chicken shish taouk, alongside other dishes. They were all tasty, and service was prompt, though their drinks (we had Turkish coffee and mint tea) were average.

Author: Wong2080Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Low Quality .. High Prices
Review: 1. The grilled lamb was tough, 50% fat, 30% bones, 20% meat2. There should be Table Menu to order at our convenience without straining our neck to read the Blackboard Menu which is difficult to read , with all the items crammed into one small board.3. Limited menu choices4. Should seal off the passage to the Toilet which is beside the Kitchen as the Toilet smell flows into the Kitchen.

Author: AndyHengSingapore, Singapore
Title: More like Crap House
Review: Was recommended by friend to try out the various crab set here at Crab House yesterday but to realize that Crab house no longer sell any crab at all! (It's like Chicken store without having any chicken!) because they just "upgraded" their menu. For the price of RM198, portion is small & limited without any hotdogs, corns or rice served as what my friend had before. Lobster is small & meatless & taste is so so only! Service is slow & lousy as was serve soup without spoon, request for chilli but was given small qty. This is my first & last time to visit here. Should be called Crap House instead. Good luck to your business.

Author: captainbarryt
Title: Happy hour
Review: Great place to hangout. It's located in the old neighbourhood of Sri Hartamas KL, walking distance from the Petronas service station. Live bands perform nightly from 10pm. Crowd is a good mix of locals and expats, mainly matured age group. There is a good choice of drinks and food is good too. A little smoky but tolerable. But if you have a table at the lower tier near the stage, forget about having any conversation as you'll be right where the speakers are. Just enjoy the music.

Author: stephietanMelbourne, Australia
Title: definitely does not live up to its reputation of being the best.. very disappointing!
Review: despite being ranked as one of the best jap restaurant in town, i must say i was very very disappointed with the quality of the food.. there are better japanese places in town and less expensive... 3 of my family members had diarrhoea after dining at iketeru, and the management wasn't apologetic at all... i later found out a friend who dined there recently discovered a rubber band in her dish, and management did not take any action...very bad response for such an expensive and supposedly exclusive restaurant.. definitely not returning and not recommending to anyone unless you are my enemy ....

Author: Lynn LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unpleasant experience
Review: My parents were not treated with respect. The staff should be understand more about the restaurant's promotion instead of making guest to show " the prove " in a rude way. Staff were obviously not well trained to handle the situation well. Imagine a supposedly high end dining making their guest look for a promotion prove because it was their own ignorant. Sadly this happened during my mom's birthday and the experience was rather unpleasant.

Author: groovy77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible experience
Review: Went with my family of 9 for the International buffet and were seriously disappointed with the food quality. Firstly, the portion for each dish is only served in a small bowl (this is really a surprise for buffet), secondly some of the food tasted stale, and when we complained to the chef he said nothing wrong with the food, it's the ingredients they used that caused the taste. What else can we say as diners when the chef refused to admit the ingredients used already turned bad but still insist it is fine
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: 417uman
Title: Fantastic & Consistently Great!
Review: We've been going to The Spice Kitchen since 2014. They do excellent North Indian dishes, and fusion of Indian-Chinese-Thai dishes. Very creative, superbly cooked and always fresh. They make the best palak paneer we've ever had and we've tried it all over the world. We also tried Thai-style roast lamb and Sri Lankan sizzling tiger prawns. The prawns were a disappointing portion size even though the taste was great. I would also recommend purchasing their 3-year DCG membership which provides great value for money.

Author: JobvHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High hopes. May be still too new
Review: I love Mexican food. But I was a bit disappointed with the quality.Although the Guacamole starter is excellent. But the Burrito's and Taco's were a bit dull in taste. My Corona should be really cold. The Guacamole was colder than the beer. Good quantity of wine by the glass.

Author: Ashirley2
Title: Completely unwilling to accommodate allergies
Review: Visited this cute cafe and at was very interested in a few items on their breakfast menu, that looked really easy to make gluten free- simply don’t serve with bread! The chef was completely unwilling to do this. When a modification is so, so easy to make, it’s very disappointing to encounter such a rigid attitude. Oh, and for the celiacs out there - the initial excuse is they “couldn’t remove rice” - so clearly understanding is also a problem, despite various clear explanations.

Author: Kristinah87Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: The worst Indian restaurant that I have ever visited
Review: This incident happened in December last year. The reason I have decided to share this incident now is to spread the awareness to the customers. Before this incident happened, I do visit this restaurant quite often with my friends during lunch hour and after work. I won't check my bills at all and will just pay the amout that is stated. Till the day of the incident.On the day of the incident, me and my friends went there for dinner after work. We ordered 3 tea, 1 ginger tea, 1 tosai and 1 chicken kotthu parotha. When we wanted to pay, we asked for the bil and the waiter brought the bill to us. They billed us with 4 tea and a different amount of the kotthu parotha. In the menu, it was stated that the chicken kotthu parotha is RM7.00 but they charged us RM8.00. We told the waiter about the differences, so he took the bill back and minus off the price for 1 tea which we didnt ordered. Then he gave the bill back to us. We asked him about the differences in the kotthu parotha price, he said we have to pay the amount that is stated in the bill because thats the correct amount in the system. When we mention that the menu stated a different price, they argue and said no, its RM8.00 so we requested them to bring the menu to us again to double confirm. In the end, the price that was stated on the menu is RM7.00. When we asked about it again, the waiter called the manager in charge instead. The manager in charge was quite rude to us. He said that we have to pay for the price that is stated in the system and the menu is an old menu plus he said that the price for chicken and mutton item in their shop is the same. I am a frequent customer there and I know that the menu is quite new as they just changed it recently. At that point, we know that there is no point arguing with them, so, we paid for the amount and left the restaurant and never went back there again. The issue here is not because of the few ringgits, its the trust that customer had towards the restaurant. We ordered the food believing that the price that we will be paying later is as stated in the menu but their system will print out a different amount and us being people who are generous will just pay the amount without even checking the bill. Imagine how many "error" amount or the number of your ordered item can be add on to the bill? The way the manager in charge handled the situation was quite bad as well. They don't care whether you are a frequent customer or no, they just don't respect you. Their concept is, you have to pay the amout that is stated in the receipt, doesnt matter if its not the same as you see in the menu.I will never go back to this restaurant again. Visitors, please be careful when you want to eat here. Check your bills before you pay.

Author: W3616OTchristianb
Title: Lovely breakfast, except for the screaming kids.
Review: So here I am for a relaxing breakfast on a Saturday morning, my coffee is ordered and the menu in front of me is looking interesting and behind me three children seem to think this is a playground. The parents are not bothered and the management seem to think this is not their problem and so, what should really have been a very positive review doesn't turn out quite so good. (we're not talking healthily rambunctious kids, but chair bumping, across room screeching monsters)On to the food - it's a little more interesting than your average western breakfast in Malaysia, but the execution is a little slapdash. The eggs (see picture) are fried in too much oil that is too hot, making it bubble through the yolks, which then, of course, are not lusciously runny. The other thing I found a little surprising is the quality of the bread. It's not the great quality, crusty or dense stuff a proper bakery produces, but the soft squishy stuff some locals seem to prefer. It is a good breakfast nevertheless, helped by the fact that the old pig has a heavy presence. But please, guys, tether the kids and buy some real bread.

Author: 563imret
Title: Very good
Review:
Excellent food and very friendly staff. Best spot to sit is the small outdoor terrace at the back on the river side .
Can recommend the ‘share’ dining option. Large enough portions. Most important everything tasts delicious!

Author: 470lindsayKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: 30 min wait for a terrible Pad Thai, is say the worst pad Thai I’ve ever hadFirst and last time I come for lunchGood option for dinner and food normally tends to be ok and service decentIf you’re busy and expect customers to wait 30min, you should inform beforehand. It’s the costumers decision, not yours

Author: clyntjaf
Title: The best of Opium
Review: We tried the best of Opium and that gave us a taste of lots of the menu, well worth the experience great food.

Author: k7cqPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Werners Points
Review: Each time you visit and buy drinks, you get points that can add up to free drinks.We came in last night and decided to use our 32 points, which is almost good for 1 glass of wine. So we ordered 2 wines. Later, we asked for our bill and that we would pay with our points. The bill was for RM80, so using our points, should have left a difference of about RM40. That is how many points we should have received for our visit. But their policy is when using points, you get no additional points for that transaction. So if my wife and I had bought 6 wines and I used my 32 points, I get no points for about 5 wines. That is total BS. What I should have done is either not use my points that time or just order 1 drink and pay for it with my points. Then proceed to order more drinks that evening. Why do they have to make things so unfair and complicated.

Author: eliyaroam
Title: Indian restaurant Johore bharu Malaysia
Review:
Review Done already                       it is an Indian restaurant
visited by all Malaysians &singaporeans also visitors from other countries  seen
Try egg poratta coin poratta meal -lunch or dinner try the fish sambal

Author: Amiershad
Title: Farewell lunch
Review: Great ambiance and food!perfect place for farewell to our colleague, hafiz. All the best! A lot of reason to come again.

Author: TheYumL
Title: Mojo Restaurant and Bar
Review: This corner pub is very popular in the evenings. The setting is friendly and they have some good prices on drinks. Food is locally inspired with some powerful dishes that go well with well-chilled beer.

Author: travelerKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: Service at this restaurant used to be very good unitl recently. 1 month ago, my husband and I went for an early dinner and despite the restaurant being near empty, we were seated right next to this couple who were coughing away. We had to ask 3 times to change table and each time we were told to wait for I don't know what. My husband lost his temper before we were finally shown to another table.We thought we'd give the restaurant another try and had our family Chinese New Year lunch there. Unfortunately, service did not improve. The orders for my invalid father-in-law and my young niece arrived only after 45 minutes despite repeated reminders. By then, most of our party had already finished our meal. I felt especially bad for my father-in-law as he was not in good health and needed the food to take his medicine. Despite this, not a word of apology was given. We had planned to bring my father-in-law for coffee and cakes before sending him home, but the lunch dragged on for 2 hours because of the delay and he was too tired by then. It was very disappointing as it was a rare opportunity to bring my father-in-law out due to his health, but our plans for the outing was ruined because of the poor service. We certainly expected more from this restaurant, given their price point and history.

Author: yoongie21Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Too bland
Review: This hakka mee is definitely not for you if you prefer food with more taste. It was very bland... Maybe this is catered for the locals taste. The meatball soup is nice however the noodles is not really worth trying. They also serve a side dish of fried snack apart from the hakka mee, none of us know what it is, and it doesn't taste good either.
Restaurant: Hakka Mee Restaurant Paris (Yin Yau Kui)

Author: darius73
Title: Typical mamak
Review: Nice hang out facing the Twin Towers. Reasonably priced lunch, good choice of rice dishes. Service prompt. Need to improve cleanliness though. Flies (and mosquitoes) also a problem sometimes.

Author: manja2015a
Title: Bland food
Review: I have visited this restaurant a number of times for business lunches. It always fails to impress me especially when it's supposed to be the coffee house for a 5 star facility. I would seriously advise the hotel to go find new chefs

Author: Jamesloong
Title: Too much hype not enough flavour to come back
Review: The ambience and service was lovely.Average food Lack of flavour and taste. As Italian cuisine is best used with the freshest of ingredients, it is very hard to make it well using regular ingredients.The place has not much soul in the food. Needs a lot of care and attention. Ps I had the one In Damansara heights ( plaza damansara) average for the price

Author: lui_py86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointment
Review: My husband and I was looking forward to have the satay celup of Malacca prior to our arrival in Malacca. But what a disappointment. The satay gravy is not the same anymore. It is terribly lacking in flavour and grounded peanuts. Service however was fast and efficient.

Author: 93rick77Perth, Australia
Title: Okey....
Review: Located in middle of city place call as cankat full of street bars and restaurant...the food was average nothing to shout about it.They have good coktails choices.The service was fast but not really friendly.

Author: Sayidah A
Title: Unforgettable night!
Review: Love love loveeee everything about this plane in the city KL! The plane, the food, friendly crews n atmosphere was superb! Highly recommended to all :)) kuddos to all!

Author: Leonathan2013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Oldest Steakhouse In Town
Review: We were in the neighborhood of Jalan TAR and headed to Coliseum Cafe for lunch . It had been more than 15 years since my wife & me were here .The antique furniture & old memorabilia creates a nostalgic feeling of years gone by as you step inside but the service staff are new with a mix of local & foreign workers. Prices are a little steep for a restaurant which still is devoid of capital investment for renovations as nothing much has changed from the old days. They charge 90 sen for a plain glass of water. My wife ordered a prawn cocktail costing RM 15.90 & grilled perch which cost RM 27.90 .The prawn cocktail was a total rip-off with 5 small measly prawns and plenty of salad . They should call this a salad cocktail instead . The grilled perch was so so. I ordered a grilled Australian Rib Eye steak costing RM 53.90 and a slice of garlic toast . The steak was nothing great to shout about . The service was good but the food was not up to my expectations . Total bill came to RM 123.10 including 10% service charge for the two of us. I have patronized their Plaza 33 branch and enjoyed the ambiance and service there & will probably go there when I crave for my favorite rib eye steak in future.

Author: nuratiqahk
Title: Dissapointing
Review: Food was nice and service by most of the waiters were good. But we were extremely put off by the staff in charge of seating, I believe her name is Aida. Upon arrival when we asked for table, she didnt even bother to turn to check whether there were available seats and immediately dismissed us saying there are no seats available, when clearly we saw several empty tables. Only when we told her that we see there are a few tables empty that she turned to glance to see the vacant tables and obliged us with a table. Dont know whether its plain laziness or just biasness but whatever the reason, it is an appalling behaviour for a person who is supposed to be the welcoming face of the restaurant. Very dissapointing experience.

Author: Lovechiang
Title: Very Famous but WORSE Dian Sum restaurant in Ipoh.
Review: When I said "worse", it's truly is. Not just by me but by all the Locals who live here in Ipoh. We can't denied, they have strong image and great social reach to deceive foreigners but the truth is out there. :) I am not any competitor stall owner and truly I have tasted and given them twice chances but now am standing here for the sake of protecting this Ipoh food culture. (^.^)1. Food are cold prepared and machine made. Microwaved. If you like hot food cold. Here's the place.2. Done my personal video biography, went at 7am on a normal day to see only 2 tables filled but the other top 3 restaurants are at least half filled. Not to name names here. :)3. Self service.4. Expensive.5. 95% of local never go there. So if you see anyone there it's definitely not the picky pamper citizens of Ipoh. + points1. Great looking building!

Author: VirginiaRoss
Title: Closed for renovation
Review: Said reopening June but not open yet. Shame we missed it as friends say this is where to organise the best heritage walk guide

Author: Bryan Redstone ... C
Title: Not to my taste.
Review: Not to my taste.  Thin, greasy & tasteless. Supposed to have soy sauce but, if there was any, you couldn't taste it.

Author: angelineo99
Title: Ramadan Buffet
Review: With a long history of multiple awards, Sheraton Imperial Kuala Lumpur Hotel offers patrons a luxurious visit. And with over 300 rooms, one of the Best Spa Experience in Malaysia and 4 restaurants set amidst glamorous Moorish architecture and grand fittings, clienteles will be guaranteed of a memorable stay. This month, in conjunction with the Muslim fasting month, Sheraton Imperial KL offer a stimulating Ramadan-styled Kenduri at the Essense Restaurant. Starting on the 8th of June until the 4th of July, guests will be able to sample a broad range of saporous delights at their collection stalls and live cooking stations, each lavishly prepared and presented for your dining pleasure. The buffet experience starts at 6.30 pm to 10.00 pm daily at RM160 nett per person.

Author: aliffthegreat
Title: First and Last!! Disappointed
Review: From outside, the restaurant looks good. But the food tastes the worst. Ordered tomyam, and it tastes like a plain water. Such a disappointing experience

Author: koonl2014Klang, Malaysia
Title: One of the best kolo mee in kuching
Review: This place deserves more hype although theres already a min 15 minutes wait to be served during peak time. There are hardly any reviews on this place however was introduced here by a local. Really nice kolo mee with pork oil. Cant compare with those generic ones outside. Their sauces goes very well with the noodle. Definitely one of the best kolo mee i had in Kuching and amongst the top of the list too.

Author: pegasus78Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fishy squid!
Review: I'd heard good things about this place and being a big Thai food fan, decided to pop by despite being cautioned about the place being overpriced and overated. I don't mind the price, quite honestly - if you deliver. Ambiance was very nice, that much I'll say but the food left so much to be desired. Personally, I found the two dishes rather salty but then, that's a matter of preferance. One thing however that i find unacceptable is that the seafood in the tom yam- specifically the squid - was smelly and clearly not fresh. I'm not even talking about spices. The very basics of a good hearty tom yum is freshness. I tried three pieces of squid just to be sure- and all three were bad. What a pity. I so wanted to like this place.

Author: Farris R
Title: Good place to unwind, any day
Review: Been here for family feasts and romantic dinners alike, with its charming alfresco vibe removing the often too-formal feel that comes with hotel dining. The restaurant serves up applaudable versions of local fare (their Poached Chicken Rice is a family favourite). I asked the manager if he could switch up a menu offering to suit my cravings on one night, and he gladly accommodated the request to my delight. I would definitely come here again, for the ambience at least.

Author: rachellin8Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wow, it was not 'jelak'!
Review: We were surprised that the restaurant does not have any queue when we arrived before 6pm on a Thursday evening. But the host took quite a while to take our order. We ordered the signature cheesy prawn bee hoon and wow, it was not 'jelak' as I imagined. We love it. Some other dishes we tried include the stir fry Xiao Bai cai and bitter gourd fried egg. Both were equally good.

Author: onghm6950
Title: Mouth-watering cuisine
Review: I had tried a few Nyonya cuisine restaurants and I think this is the best. The food is not too oily and not too salty. Eating the food reminds me of my mom’s cooking.

Author: BSManiam
Title: Very Saltish Food
Review:
The food was very saltish and tasteless.

Ordered fish curry, garlic prawns and lamb shorba...all very saltish.

Would not recommend if you are looking for good quality tasty indian food.

Author: garyb310
Title: Great Bistro Style Bar in "Beautiful Malaka"
Review:
Great Bar/ Restaurant in Jonker Street Malaka.
Great choice of reasonable priced food and beer.
Worth a visit

Author: 210oliviahGreenwich, United Kingdom
Title: Poor quality food
Review: Trying to be western. Food not very good. Lots of chemical coleslaw. You are better off eating on the street.

Author: aimanreezam
Title: OVER-RATED!
Review: I couldn't event begin how disappointed I was. Went there to celebrate my birthday w my loved one, paid quite a handsome price per pax (Not that it mattered), but the food was EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTING! If you're trying to tell us the price mainly is for the experience, then I can say that the experience also was just so-so, and I could easily recommend to you any other places that can offer a much better experience and food with much lower price!

Author: RJEreviewsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below expectations!
Review: The place it self is very nice, wonderful ambience and designs. Food is MEH, not very good compared to other breakfast places in town and not worth the amount spent. portion is very little, pricy, and water glasses smells bad and stinky. However, staff are very attentive and has genuine service.

Author: WengWong62Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Worst Satay Ever
Review: Nasi Bojari - goodNasi Lemak - goodSatay - worst ever satayMadam Kwan’s should be honest to its customers and not serve food meant for the rubbish bin to the customers. Our satay order came very late after we had finished our nasi bojari and nasi lemak. The satay was burnt beyond recognition. I am sure the layer of burnt carbon was carcinogenic.Madam Kwan’s customers deserve better treatment.

Author: Difficult_t0_pleaseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Overseas Restaurant on Jalan Imbi is one of the older Chinese Restaurants in KL and I have been frequenting this restaurant since I was a child (I am now what many would term 'middle aged'!). I have not been there for some time as it is a difficult part of town to park and get to. However, last night, I decided to go for dinner and it was a great disappointment. The food was average at best and the service was dreadful, really dreadful.We sat down and despite many requests to place a food order, we had to wait for a good 30 minutes before the 'captain' (who was busy pouring drinks and entertaining another table of 5) decided to come over to take our order. (The table next to us left without ordering). We had ordered tea, but this too did not come as the waiter later told us that he was sorry but he had forgotten about our tea.When we did order, many items were not available (sold out and it was 8 pm). We ordered 4 dishes of which, 3 arrived and we waited for the braised pork leg patiently. When all 3 dishes were finished, the 4th dish still had not arrived despite us chasing the waiting staff who assured us that it was coming (in the meantime, the 'captain' was still entertaining at the next table and as is usual practice in many restaurants, did not check if all our dishes had arrived). We managed to catch the attention of another 'captain' (not an easy feat!) who checked in the kitchen and emerged to tell us that they had run out of braised pork leg, our 4th dish.So after waiting for a good 30 minutes for service, 30 minutes for the last dish, we left the restaurant hungry (we contemplated eating in some of the noodle establishments next door) and upset. The captain was 'sorry'! :)The food we did eat was average at best, if I was being generous and being surrounded by guffawing diners did not help, so maybe other diners were getting better service! The restaurant is seriously short staffed. It is unlikely that I will be going back to Overseas Restaurant unless I hear that it has improved, which is a shame as it is, like I said earlier in my review a restaurant from my childhood.

Author: michikazun2016
Title: Quite good night KL view.
Review: Quite good night KL view. But variety of menu was not there especially no much drink option. Hope they will get more alcohol drinks choice.

Author: bengyeaml
Title: Not fantastic
Review: Food so so .. poridge over rated .. long waiting time even not many customers .. personally I think it's only a marketing way of making ppl q outside the restaurant

Author: sathvinderKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: from good to bad..
Review: was one of our favourite restaurants before the mco and before they moved to the new place.. started off pretty good with nice settings and a delightful mango lassi.. but that was all that good and it descended into a rather poor gastronomy experience hence.. maybe it was the choice of the food but than again we have ordered the similar dishes before.. the fish was horrible the chicken was tasteless.. maybe it was a night off for the chef or was it our taste buds had differed after the mco.. what ever the reason we sincerely hope they can regain their old cooking excellence..

Author: DanielJLaiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unimpressive Restaurant.
Review: So. I decided to try out this "so called #1 restaurant in Petaling Jaya" since i was around the block. So we ordered a Lazy Bones with Pasta and a Lazy Bones with Charcoal Bun. "LAZY BONES" is apparently pork ribs with their bones taken out. So when we got our meals, it looks quite appetising, i must add, but when we were eating, we discovered 1 PIECE OF HARD BONE (attached with the pics), and 4 soft bones. So much for being de-boned,huh.. We also order roast pork (siew yuk in Cantonese). It was not bad, however it was a bit overdone and in some part of it burnt. We also had bottomless drinks included, and sadly, we found ants in our Sprite. Now, that was a bad way to end this meal... And all this cost a total of RM78 for two people. Which is very expensive for the food we have gotten. Sadly, i wouldnt recommended this place to anyone at all at the current moment. Lets just hope this was one of their off-days...

Author: James S
Title: Great view, go to the restuarant...
Review: We went to the bar and it was quite busy and noisy. The food was great (get the pizzas). I think it would be better in the restuarant if you have the money.

Author: juanh187
Title: Good food, friendly service
Review: First time here and won't be the last. Everything we had was good. I especially liked the short ribs (wish it was with chilli). The dessert chimichanga was delicious. To top it up, service is excellent

Author: FazidahtulAkmalPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Makan kitchen
Review: Superb varieties of food. You will never get enough of it. Friendly and helpful staffs. International menus.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: paramess2017
Title: Overated
Review: Food is so-so only . Not so authentically nyonya .. price ok, service kind of slow , clean and nice place .

Author: JamesT3541
Title: Overly rated..... Can Miss
Review: We were there in April with the family. Their most famous dish the Nasi Bojari was a wash out. Coupled with the high price, really not worth it. Their chendol was also not like the standard of a truly Malaysian chendol from Malacca or Penang. Truly disappointing.

Author: rwibisonoCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Lousy service
Review: I asked for a desert after main meal. Waiting for 15 minutes and ask again, and another wait for 15 mins, ask again, and eventually it never came. Thus I cancel the order and ask the bill, it come out with the desert charge (which never come). When I asked them to change, took another 10 minutes to change the bill which still come wrong. No apologies given, and no word of showing remorse. There are other restaurant in KLCC that offer better value for money and far better service compare to this mediocre restaurant. If you want to waste your time, this is the restaurant to be.

Author: PedritocalheirosPorto, Portugal
Title: The most expensive meal I had in malasya and by far the worst
Review: We love lebanese food and once in Kl we anted to try this place.Although the staff is nice and the place has a decent atmosphere the food is bad and overpriced.I had lamb that was cold and my wife had some prawns that we very soft... at the end the meal is quiete expensive even for International standards

Author: MirTraynorBedford, England
Title: Avoid!
Review: This place is not great... we walked from our hotel (the Quality City Centre) and were looking forward to a cold beer and to watch the rugby. It was packed in there, staff were not great, and the drinks were the most expensive we'd had since we'd arrived! About £12 for a small bottle of Carlsberg and small bottle of Gaymers. Yikes! We didn't stay long... or return!

Author: BahuleyanLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Visit 14th Sep
Review: Visited this restaurant on the 14 Sep in a group of roughly 50 people through Sunset Vacation from Sri Lanka. We were rushed by the waiters, couldn’t enjoy the meal. Waiters were poking their nose with finger in front of us. It’s is revolting and unhygienic. Waiters were rude. Never recommend this place. We were going to go there again but cancelled after seeing that staff’s pathetic behaviour.

Author: SPY945Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went for the long lunch on a Saturday. We were a bit early and had to wait around with insufficient seating. There was a reasonable selection of dishes but for the money, nowhere near the likes of Shangrila or even Eastin. We were all quite disappointed. I tried the roast lamb which I thought was a bit tough. The crayfish was over-cooked and tasteless. The local dishes were fine, e.g. the red curry. Overall, presentation was uninviting and food quality was just OK. We went there for a change but will give it a wide berth.

Author: Ravi DFresno, California
Title: Expensive, but worth it !!!
Review: This was expensive (though, conversion from USD to MYR makes it only moderately so). In most of KL, cocktails are watered down, but not here. Probably the best bar we went to in KL (of a total of 4). The food was good, tasty, but portions are small. The view (dominated by the Petronas towers) is spectacular. They even have an open balcony type place where you can smoke (!), and experience the 'outside' weather. Friendly staff. There is also a pretty good view of the rest of the city - though there was a lot of smog. Overall, a good experience. There were 3 of us and we spent 500MYR on - 7 drinks, 4 appetizers and one dinner entree that we all shared.

Author: Mynameisrick
Title: Dissapointed
Review: 3 dishes i order they dont have that day..1 st of all.why can u tell.me wht are the dishws that u dont serve that day..Lousy service.Arrogant waiter...

Author: JosephineS209
Title: I miss Black Canyon!
Review: It has been quite sometime since I had black canyon. In fact, I first had it in Singapore when they had a branch around East Coast Road area, and that's many years ago. Since then, I will visit Black Canyon for a meal whenever I'm in BKK. I tried the one in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, but it's too far stretched compared to BKK. And recently I tried it at AEON Mall, Tebrau City. Oh my goodness!! Every dish we ordered tasted so goood! Especially the Pad Thai! Not soo sweet (disclaimer: according to my taste), the Tom Yam soup tastes exactly like the one I had in BKK. If you're heading there for shopping, why not give it a try? I will definitely visit again, specially to try the Ice Thai Tea which I missed it the last time

Author: Toto79beirut
Title: do u really want to pay 280 MYR for a photo ?
Review: The View and the Experience was amazing however the food was less than average... and many plates were empty and they didn't refill on time !!!

Author: mikeyytokyoShanghai, China
Title: Great breakfast selection
Review: Huge selection for breakfast - fruit, cereals, coffee, french toast, cooked breakfast etc etc. Lots of tables - I went early and there was almost nobody else there which is great as you can relax and take your time.

Author: dianesimeon
Title: Breakfast and lunch buffet
Review: Very good food and lots to choose from. Maybe add more tables as theres quite a lot of people atbreakfast.

Author: MikmilKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Meats not up to expectation
Review: Was a bit disappointed with the steaks as I am a steak lover. Ordered a medium rare wagyu ribeye which came a bit medium and a bit tough which is surprising for such a meat and cut. Mentioned it to the waitress and was given a mumble of an explanation.

Author: ChamcolA1
Title: good place to meetup for large group and good meal
Review:
good the place are large group more than 100 person can seat in same time during peak hour and you still can have good meal.
the testes is average but depend the menu you order.

but i like Arabic mint tea so refreshing.

Author: Grace CMalaysia
Title: Be prepared to wait
Review: Reading the reviews on TripAdvisor, we make a trip to this place when we were in Langkawi for holiday. However very disappointed. We had to wait for 11/2 hours for food, there's no lighting bright enough to see your food, plenty of mosquito, food under seasoning. The only perks is price is reasonable

Author: Susan188
Title: A "hidden" gem in petaling street ..
Review: Good local nadi lemak roti bakar cheecheongfun & more .. we ate & we tapau (takeaway) .. i like the simple ambience reminiscent of an old kopitiam .. service was quick .. and service crew friendly & attentive

Author: Sandeep_AujlaIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Poor portions. Not worth the $
Review: Decent ambience but overpriced with poor portions ... Was informed by the head waitress portions 3-4 people but the food was fit for 2 people. Which another waiter confirmed afterwards.. Disappointing experience overall. Won't be back... If ure planning a function n want a decent bang for ur buck, this is not the place. Best for couples ..

Author: Crisper1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Shocking on last visit
Review: Sometimes it’s great and sometimes not! Been here many times now and on occasion everything is great....but other times the drink service is very slow and the food not so great. Generally when it is quiet = bad service. Staff gather together talking and don’t pay attention to customers. We sat outside on Oct 10 and the girl looking after that section was terrible!! We had to wave and call her every time - she was only interested in talking to the other staff. Worse night we have had at this place.

Author: Sunshine ZPetaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: check your bill
Review: do check the bills, because you would always ask for some other priced crabs, like rm 88 and when the bill comes, they would charge extra like rm 128 and say, oo sorry we forgot to mention to you, theres no 88 crabs. always check the bills here, happened 3 times now

Author: OngahRojo
Title: Good place to hang out
Review:
Awesome food...Fresh beer 🍺....superb service..
Intan and amra very2 friendly to they customers...😉😊
And don’t forget to try they new menu “ cheesy lobster spinach “ recommend.::

Author: ispfarahmandParis, France
Title: Avoid this place
Review: We should have left this place when the owner came by to chat and ask us to write good comments on his restaurant on TripAdvisor! We didn't mind to do so if only we had our order satisfied after having waited for two hours. As it wasn't (and there was only one other table occupied!) we paid for what we consumed ... no excuse or regret from the owner... oh yes, he offered to give us some vanilla ice cream but it seemed odd to everyone to have our dessert before the meal we never had. It sounds funny like that but not really when you are still hungry almost at 11 PM!

Author: B0b1314Adelaide, Australia
Title: Lovely food great service
Review: My husband and I visited on a Wednesday evening and had a nice meal here. The menu is very large with a selection of western and Asian cuisine. We paid 90 ringgits for 2 x waters, 2 x tiger beers, sweet & sour pork (yummy), beef rendang (delicious), fried mixed veg and fried rice.The service was very good they were lovely and very attentive. Well worth a visit.

Author: Maximillian U
Title: in comparison to TC Thailand very disappointing
Review: The quality and portion sizes are very disappointing in comparison to Texas Chicken in Thailand. smaller portions, less choices and the quality of the food is not up to par of their Thailand outlets either

Author: Fishkiller0215
Title: Environment & Services is good  but the food is suck~!
Review: services & environment is very good but the freshness for the food is really bad , yesterday the salad served was brown in color and the teriyaki chicken tasteless and salmon fish is smelly ....

Author: MDGNorth Shields, United Kingdom
Title: Not the best
Review: Visited this restaurant as it is close to our hotel and we enjoy Indian cuisine. Most the outdoor tables were taken but we were able to get a seat next to the tandoori oven. The menus were in a poor condition which usually isn't a good sign. The food was not particularly good with both gravies being pieces of paneer in a thin sauce which both had a thin skin on the surface upon arrival. The naan bread was tasty.The occasional whiff of the local drainage system (open gratings at edge of road) wasn't very pleasant. Will not be visiting again.

Author: Cam S
Title: Warm, friendly atmosphere.
Review: We made Coco's our local when on the island. The food is excellent and very reasonably priced, service attentive and the setting magical. The oldie style music lends to the atmosphere. Steve and Coco make you feel so welcome. This place will not disappoint.

Author: ESTan888
Title: Slow........
Review:
Food is still ok but food came staggered and is slow.... I have ordered the food and the order of Ipoh kuey teow didn't materalised have to ask again. Dessert also was slow the pancake took forever.
May not come again.

Author: gsa76
Title: not worth for 2nd visit
Review: it seems that their specialty is roast duck but we were quite late to dine in the afternoon. so the roast duck sold out and the chef who is in charge of the roasting was off for the afternoon. but it's ok for us.we had their wanton noodles, the honey crispy eel, a seafood handmade noodles with sauce and a fried rice (I don't remember the exact name)well, we had better ones elsewhere, so nothing to comment.the only word that describe the service staffs who usher us and taking the order is "lousy". I really think they hate their job. I really hope they'll enjoy working there soon. but we are glad that there are 2 staffs that ease the unhappiness that's boiling within me. without them, I guess the dining experiences will totally ruined.will I go back or introduce people there? a definite "no" and I'll tell them to avoid to dine there if possible, there are better quality of food and services with the same price.
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: jasoncK1620MEChandler, Arizona
Title: Great view, good service, not good food
Review: Came here for the view. It is awesome! Great view of Ipoh and the surrounding hills. The drinks are fine with a decent set deal on beer for happy hour. The service was pretty good. The food was not good. We had a starter of the crab stuffed mushrooms and that was pretty good. The salmon filet was not fresh and quite fishy tasting. The lamb rack was 50% fat. The meat tasted ok but it was not a good cut. The portion sizes are ok but quality is lacking. Enjoy the view and the drinks. Try the starters but be careful with the mains.

Author: sbkhanRiyadh, Saudi Arabia
Title: Disappointed
