Review: We walked into this restaurant for a late dinner, the ambiance was very good but then when our food arrived there was nothing authentic Arab about it. Eating Arab food all my life, it was over-priced for the quality of food they serve. The grilled meat smelled bad and we had to leave our plated full. Not recommended if you are Arabic food aficionado.

Author: 45SatisfiedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mexican food and magarita
Review: My third and definitely not my last visit to this restaurant. One is able to dine either out or indoors. Having experienced both, I will opt for the former, especially if the restaurant is busy and the weather not so humid. The acoustics indoors, is not the greatest, especially if you have animated revellers. You would be advised to book in advance if you intend dining over the weekend. The restaurant provides a varied, reasonably priced menu. If a margarita is not your 'cup of tea,' a range of wines and beers are available.

Author: pianocello
Title: Vietnamese restaurant
Review: While I have had better Vietnamese food in many places, the food is tasty for what it is and prices are reasonable. There's also sufficient seating usually. The main problem coming here is the fact that parking is a nightmare.

Author: amymK306XB
Title: Good location and tasty food
Review: Slightly more upmarket venue and a little pricier for food to reflect that Compared to nearby restaurants, but small portions. We had beef ragu pasta and a chicken with lemon sauce and spaghetti which were both delicious. Tiger beer was cheap. Lovely view of the sunset at beachfront location. Service was very slow and also lots of cats lingering around. We saw one eat food three times from plates that had been cleared from tables but left outside.

Author: desmond169Sibu, Malaysia
Title: Flavour of Sarawak and it has one of the best Laksa in Malaysia
Review: Even Anthony Bourdain liked the laksa here, so I need not comment more. Do try the popiah as well. These two tend to sell out fast, so be there early (especially on weekend), you need to queue up and share table with others.Walkable from Kuching Waterfront to this cafe.

Author: 207yurik
Title: Not an authentic Korean restaurant
Review: If you are familiar with Korean cuisine, this is not a place to go. Food tasted like cheap Malaysian local cuisine. Disappointed!

Author: Robin JLondon, United Kingdom
Title: If it was not for the view!
Review: I will start with saying the view was amazing and the atmosphere was eclectic, but sadly all down hill from there!No bottle waterNo decencies bottled bearThe rib eyed steak was the worst peace of beef I have ever tasted!The toilets were a disgrace!

Author: Astilda A
Title: Crazy Price cause dont have system how they charge
Review: i wrote this at 2020. Now the price of food in this restaurant is crazy up. They charge the food double almost 100% up. Naan,fried rice and chicken used to around 22 rm now is 34 ringgit. They charge u based on what they see on plate and give the price.so there is no system on this thats why the price is subjective given.and u cant complain cause u already eat it ( its kind of tricky) .my advice if u dont want to have bankcrupt dont go here ,there are many pakistan restaurants worth it, but if u think its ok to give 34 ringgit for one plate even if its not full they charge u full for it. go ahead.

Author: Julian WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good place to try Malacca chicken rice ball
Review: This is a friendly restaurant to try the famous Malacca chicken rice ball. There is always a queue at anytime of the day, worst especially during meal time. So just proceed to get a queue position and wait. The rice ball is much better than those that I had tried, it is fragrance and soft. the condiments is perfect. The dishes that you can order along with the rice balls are equally delicious. The balls are rather small so a plate of 20 for 3 adults is a good start. The two hosts speak good English so language is not a problem.

Author: tranzactnowPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent: A Most Fascinating Experience
Review: Ever wondered what it would be like to be totally blind and have to rely on your other senses to walk, drink and eat. This restaurant in my view is absolutely amazing and is a unique experience which is well worth doing. As other reviewers have said, prebook in advance and get yourself ready for a truly amazing night. It would be cheating if I was to give anything away about the food that is served, except to stay don't be concerned that you will be eating any real weird things - you don't. As well, the restaurant makes a point of identifying with customers any potential allergies etc. The service and friendliness of the staff was first class. The dining room itself I can say nothing about. I could see nothing, not even my finger if I placed it directly in front of my eyes. I do not know if I dined with another 100 people or whether there were only a few tables full. The food was delicious. Dining in the Dark was an experience that the four in our party 2AD 2CH thoroughly enjoyed and I highly recommend it.

Author: zh0ngyic
Title: Great taste of food
Review: They serve one of the best Lalapan in Miri, my favourite as of now. Crispy fried chicken with its spicy sambal is the best combination.

Author: ashtonalex123
Title: Good food
Review: Chilli's is overall good, near the cinema in Suria, the food is good service good but price is expensive.. not like 10-15, but like 30 if i'm not mistaken..

Author: HussamKayaliDoha, Qatar
Title: Malaysian traditional food
Review: Well , after my visit to KL i have to say that i am not big fan of the food there.My and wife visit the place , we have to wait for 10 min as it was crowded. The staff were not interested in explaining their food or give a recommendation . As a tourist to KL , i dint like the food here !

Author: maryyeoHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Bad service and average food
Review: We had a shuttle bus to get on at 10am and thought we would have breakfast at 8.30am when the kids are up. Sad to announce that upon arriving, we realized that Old Town coffee only opens at 9am. Fine, we'll wait till then. An hour is still ample time for a good breakfast.We walked around at was literally waiting at the counter at 9am, and the Malay cashier just told us to wait, they're not ready, before strolling over to their side door to get a line for queuing. At 9.05am, we asked if we could at least have a paper menu to look at (as the cashier has yet to turn on their electronic menu). She finally passed one to us and we tried to make our orders at 9.10am. The same cashier told us to wait again, as the cash register system was not ready. At 9.15am we couldn't wait any longer and asked if we could just order and pay in advance and get our order items within the next 10 minutes. The cashier told me that all menu items were ready to be served immediately since it's already 9.15am. When I finally ordered the items on a piece of paper (cash register STILL WASN'T UP), the kitchen staff said the item I ordered needed at least 15 minutes of cooking. I walked away, having waited 40 minutes for nothing.Thank God we already ordered some delicious noodles and drinks from the eager and hardworking Indian store right next to Old Town Cafe. Their food was served to us in less than 5 minutes.We were also extremely thankful to have found another cafe restaurant on the other end of the harbor called Mana cafe. Such a great variety of dishes and their drinks were all yummylicious, especially their Horlicks drink! At much better prices too.

Author: PerthtravelleramandaPerth
Title: Great food
Review: We are twice at the NZ curry house - food is great - mainly Indian options - open area dining - a little better than cafeteria but if you sit outside at the front great view of the petronas towers - very cheap but good food

Author: BalandKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hands down the best seafood I've hand in Malaysia.
Review: One of the very few places you'd use the term OH MY GOD to describe. Amazing seafood. I ate till my stomach literally almost blew up! The service was awesome, the food is beyond your imagination. The portions are well worth the price and yes it can be a bit pricey for some, but it's definitely worth every penny and I just can't wait to go back there again. If you're in Malacca, make sure you pay this place a visit. The best bar is, you can order your food at the bar (area). Really great.

Author: SimonSu86Kuching, Malaysia
Title: A picture speaks a thousand words😖
Review: Read alot of good reviews about this place so decided to give this place a try. Arrived there near closing time of their kitchen around few minutes past 10pm. The staff recommended their lamb shank curry so we ordered that and some plain naan to go along with it. Sadly the curry tasted diluted, like mixed with daal, the meat tasted not fresh at all. Plus point the naan was good. It felt like i went too late and was served with leftovers on the menu. 1 star solely for the naan and nothing more.Definitely will not come back again. Best part when i gave my feedback to the manager, he said that was impossible.-here is a picture of your "impossible"

Author: Ultra MPetaling Jaya
Title: Discrete location, decent food
Review: It was a wet weekday evening. All roads leading home were clogged up, so we decided to have a curry, what else. Choices abound, nearest common location was Bangsar Shopping Centre, and Thai curry it is. Tucked in a corner on the first floor, is the Busaba Heavenly Thai.Its amazing that they're still around amidst all the stiff competition. I guess delivering consistently good food deserves a loyal clientele, plus its conveniently discrete location helps.This time around, Heavenly Thai didn't disappoint...on both counts.They have erected a private room within the restaurant. Though it is still visibly present to others and audibly boisterous celebrations failed not to be noticed, it was all joyfully accepted by other diners as there was also a loud birthday celebration in the centre of the restaurant.The corporates, in line with current general economic malaise I suppose, were a lot subdued. They were still there, murmuring instead of chattering. And we decided not to have green curry.Four of us held back on the choices. Coming more for a change to our tastebuds, we had pandan chicken, kangkong belacan, steamed fish and topped it off with water chestnut and mango sticky rice combo for sweets. Run of the mill Thai fare.The place was packed. The furnishings and ambience of the place was most pleasant. The staff were most helpful and polite, befitting the Thai personna. All in all, it was an enjoyable dinner, we were able to catch up with each other. A recommendation is in order to pleasantly savor a Thai dinner.

Author: claudiarV9116PSTijeras, New Mexico
Title: Just not quite right
Review: The food is good, the mixed drinks are weak, the service staff is nice, but the process just doesn't work well together and the prices are rather high. We ordered water, drinks, appetizers, and meals. The appetizers and meals started randomly coming out to our table of 8 before any drinks, then a single glass of water, then more food, then wine glasses, more food, finally a bottle of wine, then mixed drinks and the beer came last. Just too strange to believe. It was not a busy night the bartender was standing there looking out at the guests with no apparent thought of providing drinks. Anyway, won't bother going back. This was our third visit, being ever hopeful that there would be a learning curve, but, alas, not so.

Author: trustmygoodtasteKuala Lumpur
Title: Don't even bother...
Review: Food served was good. Up to a hotel standards. However, don't try any alcoholic drinks there. It's a rip off. Atrocious service. Waited half an hour before somebody came and took our order and they didn't even asks us if we want anything to drink. Bread - which should have been at our table when we sat down, came with our mains. Difficult to get waiters attention as they were not attentive. Restaurant was not even full. Went down to check out the live band - apparently from Columbia. They were really bad. Worst still, a lot of 'working girls' lurking around.

Author: felixl947
Title: Be careful of your credit card charge
Review: I saw some of the earlier comments about waiter facing customers to pay in USD instead of local currency when paying by foreign credit card. So when I paid the bill I particularly requested to pay by local currency. However the lady still intentionally charged my bill in USD. when I questioned it then she reversed the bill. It is a very serious integrity issue. The food is also so so. Highly recommend others not to visit this restaurant.

Author: lichiangPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service, long waiting time, food not served after an hour
Review: Visited during lunch hour. After waited for almost an hour and follow up for 4 times our food was not served. First time they said misplaced our order, but yet our order remains unseen while they continued serving to other customers who came/ordered after us. Some even had finished their food. Hence we decided to leave as the service is disappointing.

Author: SmyoongMalaysia
Title: Marvelous food
Review: This is one restaurant which has been under the radar but must surely be one of the best restaurants in town. We celebrated a special occasion on a weekday night and had no problems making a reservation. The restaurant emailed me within a day to see if we could confirm the type of meal we preferred. We opted for the MIGF Festival 5 course menu, with differing options selected by each of us.The dinner was not cheap but it was well-worth it. The service was excellent (great staff) and each course of food served was top notch. I can honestly say, DC is comparable to some of the fine dining highly rated restaurants in the West. Highly recommended.

Author: Ling M
Title: Chicken rice and roast pork
Review:
The food is above average but the price really too high. Not that i wanna pay for this food.
I would rather pay less for other stall which the food is also as good as this
Restaurant: Wong Kee Hai Lam Chicken Rice & Roast Pork

Author: MandyOng2013Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Affordable Japanese Buffet
Review: I love japanese food. Somehow was always looking for Japanese buffet that also serve fresh oyster. I compared most Japanese restaurants in Kuala Lumpur, and finally found this with very good comments. Mitasu really gave me satisfactory! I booked a table earlier and went with my family. There were 11 of us with kids. Mitasu reserved us with a cozy and private corner, so the kids could enjoy themselves(very noisy...) without disturbing other customers. Very good arrangement.Price is reasonable for adult. For children, they charge according to heights, which I found not so reasonable. For example, my 2 kids aged 5 and 6 need to pay 1/2 price, and the other 2 kids aged 7 and 8 need to pay adult price! kids at this ages does not enjoy japanese food, furthermore they eat very little, probably some chicken dishes with rice will filled them up! Its ala-carte buffet menu have a lot of choices. I like the most is sashimi, prawn, and oyster, fresh! Their udon noodle taste very good too. Not to forget to mention the grill fish(Saba and Sanma), had a few round, yummy!

Author: dearris
Title: Feeling sick after buffet lunch
Review: Went for buffet lunch today 29dec at KL Lemon garden. After lunch, both of us start to feel not too well. My husband feel nausea and vomits. While i have stomachache and diarrhoea a few times. I believe should be something from the buffet that cause us feeling sick. What a disappointment to feel unwell and have food posioning from having meal from Shangri-la hotel restaurant which at 180rm per person.

Author: Randy E
Title: Deep fried diner-styled food
Review: Not great food.   Not recommended, but if you're desiring deep fried Americanized food, not well made, you'll find it here.

Author: tiggerone
Title: Little gem
Review: We found this little gem while on holiday. The staff are very helpful and friendly.  The owner was lovely  always had time for a chat. The food and presentation was excellent and the beer chilled to perfection.  Certainly highly recommend this cafe. First class.

Author: JessieL1487
Title: Goos Italian but very poor service.
Review: I've been to La Risata 3 times this year. Overall I'm ok with the food and I personally really like their pizza but only deserves 2 stars or less for their poor customer service. Kitchen speed is good. Food is always out on time but I'm talking about their "floor staff".1. Customers had to ask where to be seated and when asked for changing the table because it was too cold right under the Aircon. He asked us to wait for I don't know long. So had to just ask another staff. 2. Rushes customer when ordering and paying. These kind of things I understand as myself worked in F&B for quite long as well but your staff has no grace but make it very obvious.3. When we ask for recommendation, they pretty much just read the description from menu. Thanks I can read.4. I asked for 2 plates. Again, long wait. had to ask another staff.5. I asked for pepper to Staff 1. wait for 5 minutes. Asked Staff 2. wait another 10 minutes. When we asked staff 3, he finally got it for us. (Restaurant was only half full so it was not busy)6. I put up my hand to call staff. Two staff purposely didn't look and continued on what they were doing. Happy with food but you really need to train your staff to provide better service to same level as your food quality.

Author: Sivagurupatham V
Title: A view
Review: A stone's throw from China House. Decent staff. No vegetarian so could only have dessert. Cool and bright ambience. Young crowd.

Author: clairesiah
Title: Disappointed
Review: Terrible environment, food taste also fine and poor service if gimme another chance I will not visit again.

Author: jywee
Title: Good food
Review: A bit pricey but they used better ingredients. The environment is good as they played good soothing music. Would recommend travellers

Author: Lisa_BirchKent, UK
Title: Don't Bother!
Review: This is basically the worst TGI Friday's Restaurant that we have been to throughout the World, and we have been to quite a few as we usually like it a lot.Unfortunately the Malay's didn't have a clue about how to serve and prepare Westernised food. The restaurant was empty (which should have told us something to start with) with only half a dozen tables being used. The menu was the same as every TGI's throughout the World but the cocktails a lot less that we are used to, with only a handful available. The starter platter came up fine until we had only eaten a few mouthfuls, and then the main meal arrived! Mine luckily was a salad but my husband's was a fajita sizzler. They basically told him, "it is ready now eat it". They would not take it away until we had finished our starter.The staff were very scarce to if we had a problem, we couldn't do anything about it. The next door table to us were a German couple who, upon requesting a glass of water, had delivered to them a glass of hot water! They also took away their other drinks before they had finished them!The prices were about normal for TGI's but please don't bother visiting this restaurant, go somewhere else!

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food, average service
Review: I was disappointed with the food here. The restaurant surroundings were plush, suggesting a high end experience. But it was not the case. We were seated quickly and the drink and food order was taken quickly. Food arrived in good time. However, it was nothing special. They had run out of pandan chicken by 6pm. The recommended roast duck with a coffee sauce seemed overcooked and not much flavour without lots of sauce. The sizzling beef seemed more like a Chinese rather than Thai dish. The rice was lukewarm. The sticky rice mango dessert had a reasonable amount of mango and sticky rice. Once the food had been served, getting the attention of a waiter was difficult. We asked for extra water at the end of the meal but it never came despite 2 requests. Overall, pricey food that did not live up to expectations.

Author: muhammedm996
Title: Over price for mediocre food
Review: It's over priced for the mediocre food they served. Service was slow. Not going back there again. Neither should you.

Author: tjb38London, United Kingdom
Title: Over priced for sure but fresh food
Review: A kebab house really. The food was nice and fresh but I was expecting it to be a bit more flavoursome with it being a Persian restaurant, my friend added quite a lot of salt and pepper to get more flavour from his meal.Overall, the environment was nice and the staff were efficient but certainly not very welcoming or friendly. Food was simple and fresh. It is expensive though for what you get and I'd certainly suggest looking elsewhere if you want more bang for your buck as they say. I didn't feel like it was good value for the money paid but it was a very convenient location outside my hotel when I didn't want to travel far for food.

Author: MayLamKLLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Wouldn't rush back in a hurry...
Review: This restaurant was recommended to me by a Foodie. It apparently serves the best Taiwanese Food in KL and though I found the meal pleasant, there was nothing outstanding in my view. But that is probabaly as I do not really understand Taiwanese food and can't help comparing to Cantonese cuisine, where I am naturally biased.

Author: Christopher T
Title: Terrible MSG type effects
Review: I came here to eat on a Saturday night as part of a large company group that had obviously made a booking. Half of our group could not find seating for 10 minutes till they opened a new section. Badly managed.I only ate lightly - Cheese, small crab and crawfish (not worth the effort), cooked prawns, mussels, slices of pizza, slices of steamed fish, salmon sashimi. I left this restaurant with my tongue tasting like I'd a dose of MSG. That night I had the typical symptoms of having had a high dose of MSG.When comparing notes with other diners from the same event the next week, they all complained of having MSG symptoms!

Author: root171
Title: verry afraid
Review: when careful of damage from employ,the storekeeper summoned and surrounded ,roared out.Service is the worst and very dangerous.I was very afraid! I will never go!

Author: Koo YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Christmas Buffet
Review: The Christmas spirit is back in town again; and what are better ways to celebrate this season with the ever popular festive with your year-end festival gatherings at Berjaya Times Square Hotel, Kuala Lumpur.Lot of sumptuous food to choose and great selection of main course. Not to forget the desserts corner that can surely satisfy your sweet tooth

Author: teongcheeaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Service
Review: Everytime when I stay Hilton will never miss to come to this Iketeru Restaurant. The foods serve with very fresh n delicious. And the service of the staffs are so kind and friendly especially Ms Azure.

Author: alis418
Title: good food
Review: the food is good and the place has an indoor and outdoor seating with good dessert and shisha for people who love to smoke.

Author: Flixxe
Title: Is this pathetic looking thing fried wantan?
Review: The fried wantan only has a tiny bit of filling while the rest is just fried skin. The pic will show you that.

Author: skogs1Wellington, New Zealand
Title: good riverside cafe
Review: Nice place to take a break from strolling around the historic centre of Melaka, and recover from the heat. Great (and strong) brewed coffee plus a good and interesting range of cakes, such as apple pie and ice cream, and bread and butter pudding (I kid you not!). As well as watching the river boats, you might also see monitor lizards swimming up and down too.

Author: lyndy23
Title: Ate at KLIA2 new Air Asia terminal, Kuala Lumpur
Review: Overpriced food, small servings, tasty and well cooked but not heated enough. Don't bother expecting great food at Air Asia's new airport. None exists! Very disappointing terminal amenities although better than LCCT. Grab snacks on the street in KL and bring them with you!

Author: Rad_CyrusDallas, Texas
Title: Everyone must try it once
Review: It is a very interesting and different experience and it certainly worth trying it once but once would be enough for me.The food is tasty and service is excellent. The price is MR118++ per person ( about $36++ pp) drink not included. I had a small Carlsberg beer for MR14++To cabies the street address is well known but the restaurant is not and the sign is a bit obscure among many other restaurants on the same street so we had to look for it.Reservation is required and if it is done on their website then it must be done at least 24 hrs before or it will not be accepted. That was my case and I called and they were kind enough to get me in since my flight was next morning.

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Cold service
Review: Wanted to try the food so much here. Looked like a cool place when I was searching for a nice place to have lunch. Faber Towers too! Looked posh. Alas, the service was cold. We waited for awhile before someone came to take our order. The food was lazily served as well. And in the middle of eating, no waiters even looked up at us so I had to walk up to them to get more hot water for my tea. Of course I received room temperature water. Waiters were not local and had nice time chatting together. Lunch was not pleasant for us. When we paid, the cashier just pointed to the ipad, signalling us to punch in our phone numbers for points. Told him, we are not interested!

Author: Muhammad Umar bShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Xmas lunch buffett
Review: We had our lunch buffet at Paya Serai on 28th December 2019 in conjunction with Xmas. The spread of food was delicious especially the tasty sate with its rich and generous gravy. The beriani was the highlight of the menu which i liked the most. The F&B Liaison Officer, Ms Mei Yi was really helpful to arrange me the reservation + generous discount as a returning customer. Well done PJ Hilton. Your service was wonderful.

Author: 441yzxJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I was very disappointed with my recent visit to this resto for dimsum. This used to be one of my favorite place for high class dimsum. But probably not after my recent visit. The porridge serves was cold and obviously the leftover from the day before. The dimsum were not fresh too. One of the signature fried noodle no longer a signature dish to me and my family. The serving of food was very slow albeit that there were merely two tables of customers (including my table). My family and I were rather disappointed with the overall experiences at the Resto. We probably won't patronize the Resto anymore. It is sad that a reputable Resto has ended like this.

Author: roniciagan63
Title: Takeaway meal
Review: Second time ordering from them by Grab and their thai green curry with satays still taste as good as usual. Keep up the good work!

Author: SimonW4283
Title: Authentic Italian, Clean & Modern
Review: Clean, modern and fresh. Best Italian, great service and excellent value with the lunch time set menu. Highly recommended. You won't find better in Langkawi.

Author: kencmcneill
Title: Healy Mac, Ipoh - Air or Fair
Review: This restaurant has really good food, but it is not air-conditioned. Maybe it is that way because it encourages one to drink more.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: TristanEFCanberra, Australia
Title: Heaven on earth
Review: Really difficult to know where to start...everything is soooo good! The highlights were the tongue and the steak sandwich but everything else was mouth watering good as well. We went on a second night and had more sashimi with out beef and apparently it had all been flown in from Japan that morning. Really one of the highlights of the KL dining scene.

Author: ZhanaraKKostanay, Kazakhstan
Title: Unforgettable experience with Syrian cuisine
Review: Found this restaurant in TripAdvisor and do not feel sorry about the time spent there and food eaten. Very tasty!!!!! I have never tried Syrian cuisine before, but the dish I ordered was just exquisite. I was about to swallow my tongue The place is very clean and cozy. Waited a bit long for my shish tawuk to arrive, but sure delicious food needs some time to be prepared, one of the sign it is fresh not heated in microwave.Definitely will recommend this restaurant to be visited and trust me you will never forget this amazing experience. Thanx for the owner Rami and his wife Maya for their hospitality and great job! Keep it up until our next year vacation in Langkawi

Author: sabahrefugiselangor
Title: So-so only
Review: Well, first off, the lady serving us was not polite (not rude, but not polite).It's not hard to find. You may key in the coordinates:2.204694, 102.231669 and pls only visit if you have a car, it's not worth it to walk or travel by cab there.they serve peranakan or "Baba Nyoya" food namely Mee Siam, Pai Tee, Popiah, Nyonya Laksa, and they also serve Nasi Lemak. If you're bringing children, they may have the popiah and pai tee as the rest are all spicy. They also serve cendol there.The food was so-so only. I liked the Pai Tee but there were mixed review on the overall taste of the food there. There are plenty of seats there (I got there around 12pm). It was cheap too, we ordered- Mee Siam- Nyonya Laksa- 2 Popiah- 2 Pai Tee- 2 Cendols- 2 Milo IceAll adding up to less than RM35. They say the kaya spread is good too, but I have not tried/ bought it.

Author: SusanP429Brisbane, Australia
Title: Good food
Review: This cafe is very close to the waterfront, it's very nicely set out but have to admit that the atmosphere during our visit was saturated by the karaoke at the Chinese Community Centre adjacent, so ram antic and peaceful it was not. That said the food was extremely tasty and service was great. It did seem a bit pricey but you know you are going to pay more when you see the set up, so that is by no means a complaint, beer still cheaper than our hostel. I can recommend the vegetable curry, nice and spicy!

Author: catherinelee800Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Terrible food, even worse service
Review: My family and I visited Melaka many times and have seen this place very crowded. However, we never it before. This time we decided to try. It was awful. We ordered a pesto pasta, naan bread, pi neapple fried rice and chicken satay. The rice was tasteless, the naan bread was too dry, the satay peanut sauce was diluted and pasta was so plain. What a dissapointment!!!!! The service was bad too. When we asked for extra culinary because we were sharing , they took so long. They don't serve water and bottled water is RM3.80. What a rip off!

Author: Jameshan73
Title: Pricey
Review: The price of their food is not fixed. It could get very expensive sometimes. Been there few times but at different location. Almost every one of them have their own pricing. Sometimes it could be expensive. I wonder why their price are not fixed and uniform. We are very much at the mercy of the PIC's mood that day.

Author: MariaMerceraMalaysia
Title: Is just ok....not that great
Review: I order chicken chop I got KFC the black pepper sause was disgusting my friend order pizza and it was under yes was undercook! the pizza was raw!...we was sitting still finish or dinner and they start cleaning the tables and removing the little candles from the tables....I ask them to place back the candles...place ok no fan very humid sitting outside all and all 2 stars....but staff really really friendly...they just need to improve the Quality of there food...western food is not that difficult to prepare...check your food and the Quality before you sending out to the custumer...in the end I'm paying for my food.

Author: SuSankar1999Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Christmas eve buffet dinner- a letdown
Review: Recently, a friend and i went for the much hyped Christmas Eve buffet dinner at Paya Serai in PJ Hilton. I used to come here a lot a few years ago due to the selection and great tasting food. Unfortunately, the reputation has taken a severe beating in my opinion. The food selection was poor and limited. While they had the usual turkey and the trimmings (which to be fair, was nicely done) the rest of fare was quite disappointing. The taste of some of the dishes was surprisingly bad with some par ingredients. When some of the dishes ran out, it was not replenished. For a buffet service, it doesn't make sense to not replenish an item that was finished an hour and a half before the buffet closes. The dessert counter was quite pathetic and those that were served could have been given more attention during preparation. All in all, the whole thing was a waste of money. Would not recommend it again. On the plus side, The few staffs that were around, were very friendly and kind. But having said that, they were too few people working the tables. We even talked to other patrons who were trying to get someone to clear the plates and replenish water and there was only 1-2 staffs doing that. Perhaps, the mgmt should really look at restoring paya serai and other parts of of the hotel (service wise) to its glory days.

Author: 841vidae
Title: Cheat and rude
Review: Went there for the lack of other Banana leaf nearby.The normal practice of banana leaf rice you can ask for second serving of the basic rice and side dishes.Today they served some long beans, potato/ bitter gourd and cabbage. When we asked for second serve of the potato , the waiter rudely told us they can't give second , only rice. The banana leaf was one of the most expensive in town at rm8.50. Mooru and rasam was served together with the curry serving pails. How are you to serve yourself this?Restaurant is dirty. Won't go there ever.
Restaurant: Vinni Jeyaa Banana Leaf Curry House

Author: Kat537Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Poor food, not too clean
Review: We ended up eating here as there were very few restaurants open on Jonker Street on a week night.I was decidedly underwhelmed with the dish I had, which was gloopy and tasteless, though my friend enjoyed her satay.The place wasn't too clean, with dirty menus, dripping air con and toilets I decided to give a miss.

Author: Speak1ng0ftruthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not as good as it seems!
Review: Everything seems good and promising. However most dishes were disappointment and the toast and scrambled eggs were the only ok food. Nothing authentic abt Asian dishes. Only house pour white available despite long list of choices on the black board menu. Will I be back or recommend friends? NO.

Author: Duif_familySingapore
Title: Not hygenic
Review: We are regularly passing this restaurant in the morning and very often we see dirty glasses and plates from the night before. Probably rats and cats are feasting at night. I hope they don’t leave the kitchen like this at night. We only had a drink here and don’t dare to have dinner, because of poor standard of hygiene

Author: jermpins
Title: Overly salty food, but poor service
Review: Food was average, if not overly salty. Service was below average. We ordered a bottle of white wine, and the waiter gave us wet glasses. Price was reasonable though.

Author: MglapKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very poor choice and overpriced
Review: Visited the place during CNY weekend. We would not go there again for the following reasons:(1) They ask you to pay for tab water and they do not even refill your glass - you can buy next door mineral water for 1RM a bottle(2) Burger is so small but seems big as they put so much salad in it that takes the space(3) Burger ban, was not fresh, and warmed up making it crumbly - could not cut it with the knife(4) Burger comes on its own so we ordered some fries, that arrived 20 minutes before the burger...you can imagine that we did not have any fries left when the burger arrived....There are no toilets on premises, and you have to use public toilets that are smelly and have no toilet paper (male and female in same room) nor soap to wash your hand afterwards. Staff are friendly but that's about it.

Author: zzoggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: average....
Review: this was my 1st visit to naj& belle and parking is an issue as they only have a few spots in front of the restaurant. we were lucky in getting one when we visited on a sat night. street parking would be the next best option however due to its location, with some streets being 1 way, you may have to do a u-turn to look for carpark elsewhere. heard the food was good here so i went local and ordered the nasi goreng ulam and tried my friend's pumpkin salad and pesto pasta so this review is purely based on these 3 dishes only. i was dissapointed with the ulam, as the dish came cold and rice was soggy and lacked any seasoning or taste. the sambal was good, side dish of pineable onion dish wasnt very fresh and the chicken seemed frozen as the dish came cold and considering its dark meat, the meat was dry. the pumpkin salad was decent and pesto could do with a little more seasoning otherwise it was a generous portion. will come back for another try.

Author: rcaustin9161Clawson, Michigan
Title: Amazing Food, High Cost Upselling & Terrible Service
Review: Have been to Miyabi twice this year and similar experiences both times.Start with the food - amazing! Tried different things from Sashimi to grilled beef, grilled salmon to tepanyaki - all delicious and fresh. Highly recommend the food.Now the upselling - first time the waiter recommended a mix of Sashimi, a steak and a bit more - the bill was nearly 500 MYR in food alone for one person. Buyer be ware - he sells nicely but never mentions the cost. This time in June was there for a work event post workshop with 10 people. Had a budget so we fixed a menu in advance. First waiter comes in, knows we have the set menu, asks if we would like drinks. All is good. The second waiter comes in (same guy from first visit) and starts trying to upsell sashimi appetizers, offering specials for meals and getting my guests excited. Needless to say I am furious as I have to be the bad guy and turn all this down, losing face to some of the colleagues as "why is the company being cheap". Then after I stated that we had the set menu, he asks "are you sure you don't want to add to it?". Unacceptable.Service - 4 of us ordered beers. 2 came. 1 came 10 minutes later. Had to ask for the 4th beer after 15 more minutes. No apology. Ordered a second round. Same thing - delivered the beers one by one and took over 30 minutes to get 5 beer. I had to go and find the upselling waiter to demand to know what is going on - received a quick sorry sorry - and again said this is unacceptable - why can't you deliver draft beers together - to which no answer was given. Final round and for the final time, they could not manage to deliver all at once. No process improvement, no care, no concern. No round of drinks for free, no acknowledgement there was a problem from them.They did manage to constantly refill the green tea, but as soon as the meal was done, no more green tea while we continued talking (and waiting on the beers). Will be back at the Sheraton PJ at least 6x over the next 2 years - will never deal with Miyabi again.

Author: 777li
Title: Great place for celebrate birthday with Japanese food
Review:
Celebrate mum birthday there, nice environment, nice food but expensive.
Free birthday song from waiters and waitress there

Author: CityFolks777Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Getting pricy on the selection food on offer...
Review: Over the years the quality of food and service are just not impressive. But the cooking skills are edging the others on the same category. The 'nasi beranyi' with the house fried chicken are quite good. The Indian rozak are pretty good too. Overall it is a place that you will not frequent.

Author: martintaarnhojBarcelona, Spain
Title: Great Food - Great Atmosphere
Review: We found this place when we were super hungry and in need of some good food for everyone in the family - and oh, it was. We had some local food and some western food. It was sooo good, as was the freshly squeezed apple juice. And to top off, there was a guy playing guitar and singing - making in a top atmosphere to enjoy the good food in. We'd be back some day!

Author: brigfieldEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Overlooking water front
Review: Good meal at a reasonable price. Friendly staff but the place itself is in a bit of a time warp although it blends in well. Lots of artefacts to peruse whilst waiting for food to arrive so plenty to keep you amused. Well worth a visit.

Author: ojjun
Title: yeahhh
Review: this is not the foodilicious i was looking for. its just a store with the same name as foodilicious..

Author: Caitlin W
Title: Nice setting, not great food
Review: The meals are plain, not hugely tasty, the drinks are small, and the only vegetarian main on the menu was fried rice.

Author: FleesixtyR
Title: Love ur ribs
Review: No doubt this could be the best ribs in Malaysia! Hope you will have outlet soon in Penang, We had to travel all the way to seapark PJ after seeing a review and we think the 4 hours joirney is definitely worth it. Had the ribs, the meatball sandwich and love the jokes on walls! Keep it up

Author: KraZkatladyThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Average food, bad attitude
Review: Got our hotel to book us a table for 7pm. When we arrived at 645pm, saw a table for 2 with a 'reserved' sign , told one of the servers that our hotel had booked the table for us 3 times and she just refused to listen. We wanted to sit down at that table and was shooed away to go sit on a ridiculously big table next to it instead. This table was big enough to accommodate 8 pax. She even shouted across to the cashier guy to verify if indeed some hotel called to book ahead and the guy acknowledged by shouting back 'E&O' and still she refused to let us sit there. Only after 15 mins and halfway through our beer did she realise she could use this big table for the large crowd of people gathering outside the eatery. We were then promptly shooed to the table we wanted to sit at in the first place!!! We ordered the double fried pork (that everyone was raving about), assam prawns and sauteed winged beans with shrimp and were wowed by none of them. If you love eating very ordinary food in a chaotic, grubby environment, this would be your place.

Author: Meng Lee L
Title: Disappointment
Review: I usually don’t complain about service unless it is abominable. And this was. There was a happy hour promotion on the alcoholic beverages and we wanted to order Tiger as that was our favorite. Sadly, it was out of stock said by the waiter. We went for Heineken then. After placing our orders, there was another group of customers in and we saw the other waiter was serving them a bucket of Tiger! On the other hand, the attitude of the waiter was very bad and we were upset about that. He was not friendly and impatient when taking orders. The food is so so and costly. We will not recommend this restaurant if they still maintain this kind of serving attitude.

Author: iprasetyawanSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Family Lunch
Review: The chicken Parmigiana is excellent, combined with Laici Asam Boi. This retaurant uses supposedly saving cost concept where they use paper-box as compared to plate but the price is not any cheaper. Atmosphere is good and the crew are polite. Not bad for Sunday afternoon outing with Family or Friends.

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Our all time favourite
Review: Bert's has always been our favourite stopover for dinner whenever we are in Melaka. It has been trully consistent with their cooking and the taste quality has been well maintained for more than a decade since we first found this hidden gem. It is a beautiful open air garden brilliantly decorated and offers diners a very laid back & romantic atmosphere. Despite losing some of its ocean view to land reclamation works by the local council, it is still a remarkable place to dine or just to catch up over a pint.Our favourite has to be the nasi lemak which is a deligthful plate of fragrant rice cooked with coconut milk and accompanied by sambal, anchovies, boiled egg & boiled water spinach. The otak otak is another one of our favourite. Its freshly transported from Muar and one of the best around.The crowd favourite would be the BBQ seafood. They have a variety of fresh fish, prawns, squids, crabs & frozen lobsters. You pick the seafood and they BBQ or grill it for you. Highly recommended for couples & families seeking something different from the typical restaurants. Prices are a mildly higher than average but a good trade off for the lovely ambience.

Author: cyongyongBayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Lousy Service and Less food variety
Review: Paid RM94/pax( with 50% off group dining voucher from hilton dining pacific membership) and i still feel that the variety of foods really bad . Imagine those who paid full price of rm188. Service was also bad that night.We have to request the waiter/waitress to refill our water and remove used plates from our table. Aren't that suppose to be automatic.

Author: nutzbeauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: absolutely fantastic dinner experience
Review: My wife and I had the grilled snapper on mash potato with herb and dill/ capers sauce, absolutely divine, the mushroom soup was awesome and the selection of wine great, the staff were friendly and helpful and the ambience of the restaurant lovely for my wife's birthday. Thank you.....recommend

Author: DarhicrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over rating of yr outlet
Review: Our family group was there last month with high expectation to saviour authentic Nyonya food. Regretfully, most of the food we ordered, tasted average only. We believe your outlet was over rated. The most memorable incident was when our cendol was served straight from the fridge. (cendol was frozen and the grated ice was coarse).

Author: jeezjazzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pretty decent, but temper expectations
Review: I guess a meal with bean sprout chicken and horfun is probably high on every Ipoh visitor’s checklist. And while it’s hard for tourists to decide which of the two big names to visit if they have limited time and stomach space, it seems locals are divided too. One said that Lou Wong is for the younger crowd and the older folks prefer Onn Kee. And we found out why. The horfun broth here at Lou Wong was saltier while Onn Kee’s was lighter. The chicken here was more tender than its neighbour. The bean sprouts were the highlight for both. The meal was somewhat satisfying, but just don’t come with sky-high expectations.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Cendol
Review: Their foods are a bit overrated. However, the cendol is really good & priced very reasonable. Home style business & limited parking in front of the restaurant

Author: FriendPapitoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best Indian food in KL!
Review: The food here is of high standards compared to restaurants even in New Delhi, India! The dishes are flavorful, they taste exactly how an indian dish is supposed to taste instead of like it's malaysian cousin. I've been here a few times for birthdays or anniversaries and would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to have a good indian meal. the staff here is really helpful with always a smile on their face.Recommended dishes - ALL but here's what I tried and loved: butter chicken, paneer lababdar, Brinjal masala or something like that, their naans and chapatis are the best, should top it all off with damn good MASALA CHAI !!

Author: Kate LLondon
Title: Amazing dinner with a view
Review: My husband and I visited Horizon Grill for our anniversary dinner. We were seated outside with the most amazing views of Kuala Lumpur city. The food was absolutely amazing with beautiful flavours and the service was fantastic. A special thank you to Niza and Munir for making our evening even more memorable. To top off the evening we were given a free dessert to celebrate our anniversary.Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anybody visiting Kuala Lumpur.

Author: MeyHoMalaysia
Title: Cozy place for breakfast
Review: I went there few times, they serve quite a good coffee and nice breakfast. Their bread also a must try.

Author: RchewieLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Outstanding meal. A definite MUST if you are in Penang
Review: My family of six adults had dinner here at 8pm on a Saturday and were completely blown away by Kebaya. The service was wonderful and attentive, the setting was impeccable and the live piano music was the cherry on top. The food. Oh my word the food. When you make the reservation you are told that it is a four course meal at RM120 per head, which is just such incredible value for money for the quality of food served. That meal includes a starter, main, side dish and dessert. You have various options for each course but because there were six of us, we were lucky enough to sample pretty much the whole menu by ordering one of everything. (We are so grateful to the waiter for recommending that we do this!). Absolutely everything was just exquisite. It was one of those meals where everyone was silent and the only words spoken for a while was 'this is so good', 'this is even better', 'you have to try that' and everyone passing dishes up and down the table. I'm obsessed with pandan and my favourite dessert is creme brûlée and they served a pandan creme brûlée which was just heaven on a plate. The Maitre D was also lovely- she patiently answered all our questions about Baba Nyonya culture!Just wonderful- if you're in Penang you must visit for incredible Nyonya cuisine.

Author: SingLaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed after braving the terrible traffic
Review: Had good expectations of the food quality for this restaurant but was terribly disappointed after eating the food.Fish was okay.We ordered a tofu which is fried with some sauce. The oil used for frying the tofu seems to have a stale smell. Should have change the oil more often.The chicken is okay, could be more tender.The chendol was total disappointment. Full of coconut milk that is not fragrant at all but left us feeling bloated. Then again, we just went to Penang to have the most wonderful chendol at kimberly street.Will definitely not be back to this restaurant.

Author: Mesut O
Title: A night spoilt by rude service
Review: This was our 1st visit, and we were excited after being recommended by a friend. What was supposedly a celebration night, ended shortly as the waiter was absent minded from the beginning. He got our drinks and main dish wrong. To top it off he had the audacity to deny that i was wrong and claims he had repeated the order. The waiter is a Bangladeshi or Nepalese young man with highlighted hair. Pampas management should focus more on the politeness and attentiveness of their staff since customers are expected to pay for service. The manager did try to rectify the situation, however we were simply too livid with the waiters horrendous attitute. Needless to say, what was supposedly a celebratory night became a living nightmare.

Author: JoeMelaka
Title: Rude Service. Extremely unpleasant visit
Review: We basically reserved a table, well ahead of opening time. When we reached the place, the staffs saw us but ignored us and left us to write down our details and take our own temperature. When asked to come to at least acknowledge us, one of the waiter just shrugged it off, shouted, “Write down your details first!” and walked away. The other just stood there as though we were invisible. First impression bad enough to discourage a sit down. The owner wasn’t any much better too. No apology was offered and was trying to say that it was our fault to expect better service. Wouldn’t want to try their food no matter how good it will taste, with this kind of service rendered.
Restaurant: Big Ben's Restaurant Cafe & Cottage Industry

Author: Kamesam SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gone downhill...not worth the premium
Review: We had a RM100 voucher to burn so thought we would go back to Beast for dinner. We have been before, and enjoyed it. On the whole, the whole experience seemed not quite as good as before. Server was hardly articulate in English, could not explain any details of what was on the menu, other than reading the words back to us, poured still water into our sparkling, didn't seem to be on the ball. We ordered angus ribeye...nothing special, not bad, not good and mussels, which were good, but cost as much as the steak. The redeeming factor oddly enough was the sides (brussel sprouts, asparagus). Drinks - a rather sweet house Riesling, a Martini, and a Tequila cocktail. Damage, even with the voucher was more than RM 700. Personally I think if you walk away from a meal at that price, and the best thing you can say is that "The brussel sprouts were good" it's time to find another restaurant. And we will.

Author: emkay17Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: good service but crap food
Review: The clear tomyam soup, otak-otak and kangkung belacan were average. The signature spicy fried fish was really below average. The pandan chicken was very fatty and tasted like they have been prepared for a long time. But the service was so swift, it jeopardizes the quality of the food.

Author: TjantekMulusSpaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice art's deco
Review: One of famous cafe in Kuah Town. Decoration inside nice. Art lover will definitely love this cafe. Food average. I tried nasi kerabu taste so so, very dry. Pricing quite expensive

Author: Erica_NiddrieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service
Review: Came specially for the Peking duck. Was advised 30 moon wait when we ordered, which was fine I was happy to wait.The problem arose when another table arrived 30 minutes later, sat down beside us, ordered Peking duck and got served first - despite the fact we'd already been waiting an hour by that stage.The final straw was being presented with a book for a duck we didn't receive and little extras never used like hand towels.Not coming back. Can recommend Watami (japenese restaurant near theatres) as a superior alternative. Great service, delicious food, well priced and complimentary hand towels!

Author: adelka5Prague, Czech Republic
Title: Great food
Review: Can be more difficult to find, as the restaurant is not right on the main street. It is opposite UnderWater and just in the back street. Very friendly staff, very good food, definitely worth the money. For us the best place to go for a lunch while staying at Pantai Cenang beach. We were there twice and we always got something extra for free, for example more kimchi or egg omelette and icecream at the end! You can pay by card or cash. All meals we tried were realy tasty and delicious.

Author: alamakgirlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor Service
Review: First it is too crowded. Waited at least 30 minutes for table. For a group of 10, we are split into 2 booth tables. Difficult to get the attention of the staffs. Most seem to be waiting for instructions from the senior. Food serving is huge.

Author: yuanlingtan
Title: Amazing truffle pizza!!!
Review:
1. Truffle pizzas were so good that I can easily have a 12 inches one to myself 😊
2. Ambiance is great too! 
3. Wine selection is good too. 

Seriously the kind of place I will keep revisiting :)

Author: Ista D
Title: Missing strawberries in Ice cream
Review: I came in for dessert, a Pink Panther ice cream, which promised me real strawberries in menu but I didn't get any in the serving. Taste of ice cream nothing special- seems like out of Nestle tub and the strawberry sauce was quite too skimpy for my liking. This for RM14++ felt like a ripoff. The place was cosy tho, powerpoint plugs available on sofa indoors which were working and so I was happy. Service by staff were also great. They did note my written feedback- hopefully they will improve.

Author: Kiarash-R
Title: Expensive for nothing
Review: at this shop you pay high for low quality steaks which are never cooked as you want. cold and so small.

Author: edang_80
Title: Delicious Big Breakfast
Review: We absolutely love the big breakfast set. Although a bit pricey, it is still value for money for us, given the expertly cooked items and delicious coffee here. Queues here can get a bit long sometimes.

Author: NJLJONESKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Small portions but authentic
Review: Interior : 4/5Service: 2/5Cleanliness: 3/5 Portion of the food is slightly small but still remains authentic ( my 7th visits) .The soups are good as compared to other restaurants. Their fish is well seasoned, definitely will be back .

Author: suitecasediaryAustralia
Title: Food poisoning
Review: I try to be somewhat careful about what I eat when I travel. I try to avoid MSG where possible and eat very little meat. I went to Ming Cafe in April 2018 and ordered vegetarian - I had a mix of stir fry Bean sprouts, Cangkok Manis, and eggplant. Within 10 minutes I started to feel sick. I broke out into a pool of sweat and started lightly hallucinating. The entire cafe felt as if it was rocking back and forth, as though I was on a ship. I stumbled to the bathroom and threw up for 20 minutes. To make matters worse, the bathroom was filthy, the water in the toilet was broken and there were green vegetables drying in the bathroom. I was sick the entire night but felt ok the next morning. I appreciate the great reviews but I wont be back.

Author: castiel21
Title: worst n not punctual
Review:
worst customer service. the foreign staff has no attitude speak rudely. 
its already 10.25am but yet to open instead they have so many waiter who pretend to be busy..when asked what time is the operating hours, he.just glared at me.

highly not recommended.

Author: Annabel M
Title: Wonderful place for a large group.
Review: This restaurant is a super place for a large gathering. The staff are very helpful & efficient. The food is plentiful and fantastic. Would highly recommend eating here.

Author: Jdread2000adPetaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Good Seafood Pizza
Review: That's one of the good ones. The Steak Sandwich was not bad either and the Fish and Chips came in a good portion size. The ambient was excellent. Only gripe was that it seems like the staff are not able to cope if the room is full. Maybe the management need to look at this.

Author: kartono_huang
Title: good price
Review: reasonable price it is. good food and tasty also. so, what to ask more. its the favorite dining place of the family

Author: JuldiPerth, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: Went for dinner based on TA reviews and particularly for the rendang.Food was average. For a slow cooked dish, the Rendang tasted like it had undercooked spices.

Author: Arunachalam10Palm Springs, California
Title: Management needs to give itself a long hard review...
Review: Arrived at 11:20 a.m. and was given a full menu to peruse, but then informed that we could only order breakfast at this time, unless we waited half an hour to order. There was absolutely no flexibility with that. The staff seemed spacey, perhaps their language skills were not that great. Ordered Eggs Benedict and they were able to cook my eggs on the firmer side, however the dish was not even warm and everything, including the sauce, a bit tasteless. I also ordered a French pastry was which ok, nothing special. It would have tasted better if it has not been served cold out of the refrigerated case, just offering it at room temperature would have helped. Service was attentive, but not what I would call good. I highly doubt I will be back just because the food was so poor and the service so clueless. At the end of the meal they insisted on giving me and my companion comment cards which they certainly did not want me to fill out because it would have been quite negative!

Author: badrulhishammahariKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A very terrible experience
Review: I am a resident nearby. As with many others, this has become my regular joints since its opening. I watch this place grew in popularity and happy to see their business prosper, especially during the evening time when the place becomes almost full.On the eve of 29.4.16, I had an experience that is worst than I can ever imagine. Me and my friend had dinner. I wanted to order another teh tarik. After 30 minutes and 2 times order, I went to a waiter, Noyon, and complained about my order.He scolded me because I shouldn't order while standing, away from the table. I went back to my table and Noyon followed me. I sat down and make my order again. However Noyon continued berating me, said they were not asleep, if its late they must be busy with some other work. I was astonished. Speechless.I search and found the person in-charge of the restaurant, named Mobin. As i was talking to Mobin, Noyon arrived with the Teh Tarik and continued to berated me, in front of his supervisor, who told me he will talk to Noyon but no apology were offered. The supervisor further added that should I should come the next morning to forward the complain to his Manager.I looked at their website but there is no channel provided to deliver complaints.From now on, I will go to the next door Mamak Restaurant. I advice other customers to do the same, if they continue to be arrogant because they have too much business.

Author: Mithi_MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hipster cafe with lots of creative art from old things
Review: Love the different art pieces that they have on display, especially the art pieces made out of old things. It has a very homely feel, especially since this cafe is in a very old shop house made out of bricks. It has a very cooling atmosphere. Perfect for a Sunday afternoon, especially if you just want to chill with some coffee and a nice book.

Author: juraimainordin
Title: Poor service not worth it
Review: Having a family gathering at this restaurant is totally a HUGE MISTAKE!!!! their service is suck even the lady manager only chatting with kitchen staff!! The staff playing phone near the pillar! Never look at the service! Never refill water! my mom requested warm water but never give!! My food took 40min!! Wrong order!! Taste like rubbish!! Not worth for the price!

Author: shirley19572015Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Good cha siew.
Review: My clients loved the cha siew so much, there are 4 of them and they ordered 3 rounds. The meat is tender, juicy and not the red coloured type. Honestly, one should try it during lunch hour. It finishes fast not like the duck.

Author: KieranWeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Totally over rated!!!
Review: Read on trip adviser this comes highly recommended. 3 of us, we ordered the hot and sour soup, Peking duck, braised beancurd with fresh scallop and green leafland with bean sprout. For the Peking duck we requested the meat to be cooked with ginger and spring onion.Hot and sour soup - unrated.. It totally doesn't taste of hot and sour, texture of soup was so diluted!! "Voted the worst I have ever tasted!!" (--/10) - RM$22Peking duck - skin was presented with the usual condiments and sauce to wrap. Can't comment to much about it. Taste was usual , wasn't that WOW and wasn't that eeks.. Normal stuff which can be found anywhere (5/10) RM$98Meat of Peking Duck - cook with ginger and spring onion, the dish was overly salty and presentation of it was very bad. Really nothing much to comment about it (3/10)Braised beancurd with fresh scallop - they claim that the beancurd is self made. Well it tasted like the ones I can get of the supermarket from the refrigerated section. Was no smooth texture to it. Taste which just ok. (4/10) RM$20Greenleaf land with bean sprout- probably the most ok dish as it was cooked plainly and should not really go wrong. (5/10)Taking into consideration the difficulty of finding a parking space , I highly WON'T recommend to anyone. Total damage : RM$185.10

Author: RichardChiaBSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Poor Food and Service
Review: Saw review rated very high. Came into the pub there is no one serving us. But you have look for your own sit. All the waiters all ignored you when asked for order. After a few try. Then they came to take order. Poor service. Food is cold. Very disappointing.

Author: Tina L
Title: Nice food at affordable price
Review: They have several outlets in Malaysia. The two places we frequently visit Is in Kuala Lumpur and In Malacca. Must try is their fish noodle, their fried rice and chicken wings is yummy too. We usually order ala carte instead of the set meal.

Author: yenlungPontian Kecil, Johor, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I am so excited about the opening of Naughty Nuris.I missed their Pork Rib so much from my last Bali Trip in 2012.But, this kl branch's pork rib is under the expectation. It is not as good as the Bali 1.Hope they can improve their quality of food.

Author: 33carlos33
Title: Opening hours wrong
Review: Claim that they are open untill 11 pm but we got ther just over 10 pm and were told kitchen closes at 10 pm so no food for us.

Author: adrianfrancisdMelbourne, Australia
Title: Wring pick
Review: We were looking for Indian food around Bukit Bintang, after reading the reviews decided on Spice Garden. Unfortunately we were disappointed as the quality was quite poor, even the Roti & Nan was hard and chewy. Chicken korma did not have the traditional flavour.Biryani was dry also.The only positive was that we were able to drink our own wine without paying corkage.

Author: moonlight82
Title: Bad service
Review: The food is like any other Nando's but the service is just terrible. The servers are busy chatting away or checking their phones. It takes time to catch their attention to place an order and bring the cheque. Awful, unprofessional people.

Author: Mariza A
Title: A Gem! What A Treasure!
Review: This place has better food and service than many fine dining places in KL-PJ. This is no mean feat considering that there are many really excellent French restaurants around. The ambience is very relaxed and casual. And I had a fabulous meal and a fantastic time without being surrounded by pretentious, self-conscious diners! It was such a treat to be able to enjoy a beautifully crafted meal in such a relaxed atmosphere!And the food really is divine!The food and the service are well worth the visit! Highly highly recommended!

Author: IdrisA788Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very good food and excellent service
Review: Dropped by for lunch with ftiends. Not familiar with Kerala food though it tastes similar to Sri Lankan food i think. Service is excellent and the ambience is good. The waiter assisted with the ordering but the rasam left a great impression. The Briani is good enough to go for second rounds. Price is on the high side but worth it.
Restaurant: Kayra Authentic Kerala Cuisine, Bangsar Village

Author: Kajsa B
Title: Nice place
Review: Great place to grab a beer with friends! I really liked the atmosphere and the interior was cool.The price for a beer is ok, 11 RM. Make sure that you check your bill before paying though, at first we were charged for 3 extra beers.

Author: Ramsay MFortrose, United Kingdom
Title: Old Town White Coffee at Airport
Review: Very disappointed in this place at KL airport - staff were disinterested, did not communicate well and the coffee when eventually served was not the warmest I have ever tasted. Poor selection of food to accompany a cup of coffee. On the way to the boarding hall it looked as if Harrod's would have been a better choice

Author: AAAzlan
Title: It's pretty but not much else
Review: Was here with a group of friends. We were told we couldn't make a reservation and just had to show up to see if a table was open. The host/ person who greets and seats you was not friendly and wasn't even at the post while we waited to be seated. The people who served our food were much better though! The ambience inside looked awesome. But we were seated outside. We had asked if we could move indoors when a table became available but that never happened. Staff never got back to us. Chairs were uncomfortable to sit on, it was hot & humid outdoors.We had pizzas which were pretty good - I recommend the greek lamb. That being said, the superfood salad was relatively tasteless. Food is on the pricey side, not the best value for your money. That, plus subpar service = not sure I would come back.

Author: SeanA0202Klang, Malaysia
Title: horrible service
Review: service was horrible, we waited for an hour for our noodles to arrive. even when we tried to check up on our order, the staff basically just ignored us!! the food was nothing to hype about. definitely overrated. wouldnt be recommending this place to anyone ever

Author: Mr_HafLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem of Langkawi Island.
Review: The map was correct but it was hidden in the yard. Almost miss it :DThe food is total blast. You like pork and bacon? This is the place in Langkawi! The owner is friendly and amazing <3 ALSO MUST TRY THEIR PAVLOVA even though you don't like sweet <3

Author: julizanordin1212
Title: Very Nice Chicken Porridge and Fried Chickens
Review: LOcated at The Carpenter Street, they have the yummiest local style Fried Chicken, I love their porridge and also chicken rice. Go early if not you have to wait for an hour....

Author: Saanthi P
Title: Come for the ambiance but not the food
Review:
Disappointing for a top rated restaurant at Jonker Walk. Disinterested waiters and very plain tasted food. 
However if you are into ambiance and live music then this is the place.

Author: MalikM786Chicago, Illinois
Title: Not that great
Review: I went there for lunch because the night before their staff was all dressed up with skull caps with Hyderabadi dress etc. I thought the food will be great. But was disappointed. I ordered a nan with a chicken dish and lassi. The red chicken was for sure red, spices were ok. However, it was not cooked well. This and nan both were sort of an exercise on my chewing ability. Lassi was ok. Bathrooms were dirty and the place did not look a part of the clean KL as I expected rather a part of dirty Indian restaurants.

Author: jiazheng96
Title: Dim sum
Review: Now dim sum taste have not so nice service is nice price normal dim sum taste can improve then will be better
Restaurant: Restoran Jin Xuan Hong Kong "Kuchai Lama"

Author: Johari E
Title: Dinner
Review: Worst service and poor foods qualityServer did not know who have ordered what?When recall for the food - again the server said "your food ordered is not in the system....."Caesar salad full of mayo and was served using butter head lettuce instead of baby romaine heart.Three layer lasagna was disaster...iced cold in the middle. Mentioned to the server...she just "ignore"....( who are you to comment)Will never come back again.

Author: Choong L
Title: Dinner
Review: The wingwalk was fun and interesting! We have quite good time on the plane. Food was good, and I particularly like the beef dish, soft and tender

Author: 42ChrissyPerth, Australia
Title: Busy
Review: Had to try Hard Rock Cafe, this was in walking distance from our hotel. The meal was nice and the staff very friendly, a busy place so if you want privacy I would not suggest here. Great for young people as the band started up after dinner which rocked the house literally.

Author: Rajendra RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Above Average Expereince
Review: Celebrated my 50th birthday here with 2 very close friends. The food was good but the service sure put a damper on the experience. The waitress brings a hot dish and instead of telling us politely that it is hot, she barked at us "Don't touch! Hot!" Bread crumbs on the table weren't cleaned promptly. Food wasn't being served out promptly, forcing the head chef to come out of the kitchen and serve the food. The worst was when they brought a birthday cake and insisted I wear a mask to blow the candle -- with no mouth hole! And the same mask was forced onto 3 other customers celebrating their birthdays there. Not really fine dining but I didn't expect to see a waiter in shorts serving the guests either.

Author: valerie L
Title: bad, not worth to queue.
Review: Chicken was not so tender . Rice balls were cold. There were no soups on sunday and public holiday. Other then that, they can just hang a sign said no soup for today on any weekdays . We end up with not much choice after a long queue. They only sell white chicken, which not so fantastic, cabbage and Assam fish. As we were 5 persons in an group, we end up eating a small plate of rice balls and a plate of normal rice , all in cold. (They never asked us but just give us a plate of normal rice.) A plate of normal chicken ,and Assam fish. No soup, we don't like cabbage. End up no vegetables. Service was bad, they don't have time to communicate with you. No time to bring their chilli to you. Chilli is not fantastic too..queue for dishes like that. We will not step in in future.

Author: James M
Title: Great view, over-complicated food and service
Review: They really want to make you feel welcome, but it comes across as pushy and fussy. We we're met by maybe a dozen staff on the complex route from the door to the 57th floor, and the table (for 8 of us) was served by...More

Author: Tazel
Title: Average
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by several people and thought we would give it a try.    The service was very good but it was an average meal.

Author: YTSJbJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: B.E.S.T
Review: I would say it is the best Japanese restaurant in JB. There are two branches in Johor Bahru, but I used to go to the main branch in Permas Jaya.I know there are many other good and top Japanese restaurants in Johor Bahru, but this is the one you will be surprised while the food served on your table. You can never get such big and full of ingredients ramen anywhere with RM14+++ of course,it is very delicious.All their foods are served in high standard with middle range price. The ambience is nice, the service is good. In fact, my hubby proposed to me there;-)It is better to make reservation to avoid disappointment, or else just tell the waiter that you do not mind to have bar top seat. It will help you to get the seat sooner.

Author: RLP17Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible food and awfully expensive!!
Review: We made a trip to MyBurgerLab, however it was closed. Therefore, we walked around and stumbled across this place. The decoration, the flashy lights, everything seemed to look good. So we decided to try it, it's pork after all.Everything about the food and drink turned out to be TERRIBLE. The passionfruit juice was literally just syrup (so sweet, and I have a sweet tooth), the pulled pork sandwich was absolutely full of bones I struggled to eat it due to having to rummage around my mouth for bones - taste was not good either. I passED the other half of the sandwich to my friend and a big piece of sharp bone fell on the plate, it sounded like a stone dropping on it. We were done by this point. Then the total came to 68rm - for a sandwich, some chips and essentially a syrup drink.The service was good and the staff were friendly, but I will not be returning here. It's a shame as I have been living in KL for 3 years and have a lot of friends who eat out regularly that I could have brought here - but I definitely won't. Lets hope MyBurgerLab is open soon, that is a MUCH better place (with queues out the door) and much cheaper than here - GO THERE INSTEAD.

Author: arinaazmi
Title: Good food but slightly pricey
Review:
I've tried their chicken cashew and sushi roll. Both taste great. The portion for chicken cashew dish is quite huge, suitable for 2-3 pax. 

Overall, it's a good restaurant with a slightly pricey menu.

Author: charlottel537Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, thats all...
Review: Had a 'fresh' pineapple juice which I asked with NO sugar. Saw the waiter put some sirup from a bottle in it and mixing it in. This was certainly not fresh juice. When I asked him again if there was only fruit juice and no sugar in it he said yes which I know is wrong. Also, there was so much ice cubes in the glass that after five tiny sips of the juice that was it.

Author: shontsSingapore, Singapore
Title: hipster lunches!
Review: Shucked oyster bar is a little oasis of hip sitting inside the bustle of Ben's supermarket. I love that there is a great place to get seafood without the pretentiousness many seafood restaurants feel necessary. The grilled fish lunch specials are my favorite attraction specials change daily and are created by in house chef, I often take my kids for lunch before we do our groceries I can't think of a healthier, tastier, better value lunch in KL.Due to location inside the supermarket it is cold so bring a wrap!!

Author: XyanaWong
Title: Under cooked Chicken
Review: Previously submitted a complaint about under cooked chicken when I went there for my Birthday Dinner. Seems like no actions has been done neither my complaint has been noticed. This was disappointing as the food and everything else was great but the under cooked chicken gave my partner a really bad time afterwards.

Author: dk0922
Title: 1st and last time visiting this place
Review: BKT was not flavorful and rather bland. Not worth the price we paid. Parking is a hassle. Would not come again

Author: VincentHoKuchingKuching
Title: Name rich in history, regretably food does not live up to it.
Review: This is a small eatery. Food choices are very limited - mostly snacks. The view is great - overlooking the lazy Sarawak River with the iconic DUN building in site. But if you are there for the food itself, there are better places to go to.Sorry, but I have to advise to give this a miss unless you just want to plonk yourself down and get a cool drink and take in the sights .

Author: StvNil
Title: Sundate
Review:
Lighting and atmosphere is great, nice place to chill...............
Uji matcha and matcha rose cronut are strongly recommended

Author: 650jimmySingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Ambiance next to the river
Review: My mother-in-law, my wife and I visited Melaka on 23rd and 24th Dec 17 to celebrate Christmas and visit historic places like Church of Saint Peter (since 1710) and Majestic Hotel.We had our dinner at the Hard Rock Cafe, Melaka which was next to the river and Jonker Walk (weekend night market). We enjoyed seating outside because we like to wave to the tourists on the boat. You could also hear the evening birds singing (6pm to 7.30pm). The crowd gathering, the bright lights trishaw, the bright lights along Jonker Walk (lots of roadside stalls and people bargaining over the prices).We ordered chicken satay (one dozen) served with peanut sauce, nasi goreng, fried potato, house burger, had cocktail drinks, beers and hot beverages. We enjoyed the LIVE band and LIVE broadcast of Premier league matches.When you are next in Melaka, make it a point to go to Hard Rock Cafe to enjoy food and/or cold beer or enjoy LIVE music or simply buy a Hard Rock glass or TV shirt as a gift.There was a car park below the building for the convenient of patrons.

Author: nkpesq
Title: Not the best one...
Review: We have probably been to 30 or more hard rock cafes around the world and this one ranked lowest. The service was ok, the food was less than mediocre and the whole place just looks run down. What a disappointment....

Author: 月婷 李
Title: Place to hang out
