Review: Food n drinks are good. Need to improve with the service. Car park is limited. BBQ smoked duck danish is my fav so far.

Author: kylehorSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awful food
Review: I went there with my wife about 2~3 years ago and we absolutely enjoyed the nonya food. However this time, it was so awful that I suspect that they had changed establishment or their key chef is no longer there. Their house special nonya fish and its sauce tastes funny. In addition the fish was expensive and not fresh at all. Even with all the (so called) nonya spices trying to cover it's lack of freshness, I could tell from the powdery flesh that the fish is on it's way to the trash bin. When I told the desk manager, all he could utter was "OH". And that was that.

Author: michrods
Title: Not nice
Review: I’m really really sorry but the food is not nice. Not Thai food just the idea of Thai. Very Malay style. :(

Author: Barreiro-London
Title: Very good option to eat in KL's heart
Review: taste of Asia is a restaurant in the shopping centre's ground floor with lots of options inside with very affordable prices (with £1.50 you can buy a nice meal). Try and you wont regret.

Author: JOHL218Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never EVER going to go there again. EVER.
Review: There were having their set meal promotions and I decided to choose something else ala carte while the rest ordered the set. Their food came, they ate all done. And my food didn't arrive. The rest of the tables (some that are not set) also get served first. Unhappy, I decide to cancel my order for them to tell me its on the way (5 more minutes) and the waiter tells me that it has only been 15 minutes (according to their systems). I mean, HELLO... everyone else is done with their meal, do i expect them to watch me eat? How awkward was that? The waiter also wasn't too friendly and looked annoyed. Sigh.. Never ever going there. EVER.

Author: fernandosT6407ES
Title: Nice for a tranquil meal
Review: Staff provides good service.The food is good, not at lot of variety but diverse indian, western and Chinese.You can customize your salads having many choices.There are always tables free so no need to wait.Good place for a snack or a causal meal

Author: ViajeraMc
Title: Horrible food
Review: I ordered chicken curry and it was awful. Honestly this place is not worth the money you pay. I left everything on the plate

Author: SandyGrain
Title: Nice staff
Review:
Food was only OK but it was a nice evening. We sat outside and the staff were very friendly.

Worth a try.

Author: LarryLAPGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Very mediocre Italianrestaurant at pretentious prices
Review: Very mediocre Italian restaurant at pretentious prices. Not worth it, unless you're unaware of what true nice Italian food is about and want a change from the local food.

Author: Wendy KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I wish I'd paid attention the the other reviews!
Review: I had decided that I really wanted to eat steak and that I also wanted to look round Nu Sentral Mall, so spotting an Outback Steakhouse, I thought I had it sorted. Nu Sentral is lovely - the Chinese New Year decorations are probably the best in KL this year. Outback Steakhouse? Worst decision I have made in a long time!The menu goes on about rib eye being the steak lover's steak - well marbled and juicy. Available in 8oz or 10 oz. The menu describes what the steak should look like - I chose medium rare which should have a warm, red inner and a seared outside. What did I get? A small, thin (probably the thickness of three of their beer mats) and brown all the way through. If that was 8 ounces then I'd be very surprisedI called the waiter and pointed this out - to his credit, he immediately whisked it away and brought me some mushroom soup (lumpy, cool and almost solid, mind you) to keep me going while I waited.Eventually another steak arrived, a lot thicker so that was good.... but almost raw. Chewy, gristly, unseasoned... the accompanying chips were sparse (there was so much plate on view! Several of the chips were almost raw. I'd ordered a loaded jacket so my husband could eat that... again, verging on raw and if that was loaded, I'd hate to see an ordinary one.One of our friends had the fillet - again, supposedly medium rare... but it was dry and solid brown all the way through, but she didn't want to make a fuss. The chef needs sacking! This is not a cheap option and the standards were abysmal. I only wish I had done that food photography and taken pictures to show you all.Oh... and you want a drink? Despite the menu offering cocktails, you can whistle for that. Non alcoholic drinks or beer only... and that was only one brand, despite the menu offering a couple at least. My advice? READ THIS AND PAY ATTENTION! I wish I'd paid attention to other reviews. I'd have gone elsewhere, saved a fortune and eaten decent steak. This is a rip off. Outback Steakhouse Management? Get in there and check out this horrible shambles.

Author: danuw
Title: Ordered a paella and pardon
Review: Ordered a paella and pardon peppers, pardon not available, so just took the paella - way below average,  very mushy rice, seems to be precooked hours before - really not good

Author: elanfooHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Lively places and reasonably priced seafood stall
Review: Add recommended by local friend, we bumped into this eatery joint. There are many stall to choose from and we stick to the stall recommended. Many varieties of seafood dishes and culinary is excellent. Try to let the stall owner recommend you the dishes and the cooking method, it may be turned out very well for you. Do ask for price of each dish based on the weight of the seafood type selected, and relax and enjoy it with a beer
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: pericop138Bern, Switzerland
Title: Worst food ever
Review: The experience was ok but when it comes to the food quality...it was like microwave food warmed up and after checking the menu we still think that some food wasn't really what they assure it was. if I go to a blind tasting experience were you are supposed to figure out what you are eating I expect more than (spoiler alert) a fruit compote and a lamb tika masala with overcooked pasta. Totally OVERPRICED and SCAM.

Author: Rachel_PRLSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lots of Vegan & Vegetarian selection
Review: We walked past this place while walking along Jonker Street. The cafe is full with many foreign tourists, and we were about to look for another option but we saw there is another shop lot opposite which is almost empty and cooler and yet still belongs to Geographer. So we decidedly to give it a try.Surprisingly there are 2 full pages of choices for vegan & vegetarian. We ordered a mozzarella pizza, vegies satay & veg bitter gourd soup bee hoon along with some drinks. The pizza is freshly make in the open kitchen next to us, and it is reasonably good. Veggie satay is made from monkey head mushroom and very tasty. The bee hoon soup is average.Overall we like the ambience & wide selection for vegetarian.

Author: KimberlyLaw
Title: I wouldn't come back
Review: I ordered a medium rare rib eye. The part was pretty raw. I didn't send it back because I was almost done eating. It's was pretty tasty. My boyfriend ordered a surf and turf and it's a pretty small lobster. Look more like "sang har" (don't know what's in English) Good service here though. I didn't really like the smell of the restaurant. Smells weird like old wet wood.

Author: MissyMacyKuching
Title: A place that makes you keep talking into the night
Review: This has been in existence for quite a while; neighbouring The Junk, Havana, and now the new Barber. Their kitchens are related, meaning you can order food from The Junk's kitchen, while relax and chill in Bla Bla Bla. I used to go there because they have really comfy seats. Nowadays, the setting has changed but the ambience remains.

Author: Andrew MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Won't cook scrambled eggs?!?!
Review: I ate at Yeast in Midvalley several times a week before it closed. Now I have been going to Yeast in Bangsar. I’m a regular, good customer who spends nearly RM 50 each time. I am now told, today, by your lady Chinese manager (who’s a bit of a dope, honestly) that you can no longer make me scrambled eggs because “it’s not allowed.” What the hell is WRONG with you people? The chefs have eggs, pans, a stove--everything they need. Why risk losing a valued customer over something like this? Really? This is utterly ridiculous!

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Slightly overwhelmed
Review: This is a favourite restaurant, which I frequented regularly. Attended their wine matching dinner event recently, whereby chef Shiomi-san, matches the food with the wines pretty harmoniously. However, was a little disappointed this time because the wagyu A3 was over-cooked thus became really tough - didn't finish the wagyu dine. Shiomi-San is a talented cook and believe this minor slip-up was because of the group dining with 22 pax. As he is the only cook and he single-handedly cooked the whole dinner, hence overwhelmed with the task, which resulted in the mistake. The management has to take note and rectify the situation by hiring a sous-chef to support him. Overall, it was a poor experience, however wouldn't be disturb by this experience and will continue to frequent this place. Only thing will try to avoid organising a big group (above 20 pax) dinner function.

Author: Saket G
Title: great sandwich too icy coffee
Review: This is about harrods cafe located at KLIA. The veg sandwich they provide is small in size, but very tasty. The cold coffee is too icy with lots of ice cubes than coffee itself. Better to buy coffee can which has been refrigerated.

Author: Shin495
Title: Expensive food with low quality of services!
Review: Strongly recommend you to bring your friend there if you want to enjoy the moment how their staff tackle your friend, just in front of your naked eyes, wasting your time to watch how professional their staff flirt on your friend. Well, this is the right place if you wish to spoil your mood to having meal with the one you like.Never go there again! Inviting all my friends to ban this restaurant!Expensive food with low quality of services!

Author: JetKho
Title: Seafood platter was excellent
Review: My dad had the seafood platter and I choose to had beef steak. When the food comes out and we were shock that it was big portions and taste is fantastic. It is worth paying for it.

Author: bnghanemKuwait City, Kuwait
Title: Good but they charge double for strong tea
Review: Good but they charge double for strong teaNice location over looking the park and the lake with fountain We order 2 teas with chocolate puddingIt is comes for 61 RMNot so expensive but one tea doubled the price Service good staff very nice

Author: Nepali_Kancha
Title: Very expat friendly bar
Review: This is a very expat friendly bar where you can cool down after eating at the hawkers stalls before you end you day. Well prices drinks and food were plus.

Author: Suliyae1
Title: Having dinner
Review: I prefer to come to lavish fusion bakery because the place very clean and relax for having food & drink

Author: thru_my_sensesMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great environment but not great food.
Review: It's located at level 42 of The Shore tower in Melaka. Supposed to be the highest restaurant in Melaka, well it has a great environment with a spectacular view of the entire Melaka but the food is way below par. The price is on the high side and the food tastes like those found in usual food courts or normal cafes (some food courts' food taste even better). The menu is limited as well. Hopefully this will improve soon otherwise, it will be a waste of such a great environment.

Author: FelixH374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Different tasting Bak Kut Teh
Review: The soup was delicious with a distinct herbal flavor . The pork was tender and falling off the bone . The inoki mushrooms in the soup was a nice touch. We ordered a plate of bean sprouts with salted fish and a Claypot of pigs trotters -both were excellent . The yam rice was a good compliment .

Author: ickoo88
Title: Friends outing
Review: Good service and dining experience at Healy Mac. Warmth welcome by Mr Milon. Large portion of pork knuckle, cold beers and fantastic live band

Author: Naveen Raaj S
Title: Something Unique!
Review: Feels like you're dining in the air (Minus the fear of somebody hijacking your plane of course). A must try for all age groups.

Author: jolinc2016
Title: Wild Ling Cod
Review: The coconut cream sauce based a bit oily for me. The cod & sautéed vege taste good!overall still not bad though~

Author: siawui
Title: Kuching's high quality Japanese restaurant.
Review: Restaurant is easy to find at I Com Square. Real easy parking. Great ambience. Different sittings provided, I chose Japanese sitting.The menu was particularly interesting in displaying the dishes. A wide varieties of food to choose from, including grilled dishes and Wagyu beef !. Presentations were good especially on very artistic platings. Food itself was tasty and palatable. Good quality rice was used. I liked the way nice dressing sauce on the dishes. Service was a breeze. A bit costly for Kuching's standard but, my overall experience at iZakaya was enjoyable. Will come back again.

Author: 279benitarBurradoo
Title: Casual dinner
Review: Great local restaurant in heart of Kuah. Very busy with locals and visitors but tables turn over quickly so never really have to wait for table. Lots of variety, everything very fresh and cost minimal. Note only beer served - no wine or spirits. Loved it so much went back twice.

Author: Erry_susiloJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Unbelieveable food, top notch service
Review: Must try the suckling pig and the ribs. The service alse very good. We had the plate breaking expererience to have a good luck

Author: Matthew L
Title: Good & quick
Review: Good place for a quick lunch.  quality of food and service good a well as portion size. Parking normally not a problem

Author: 689jwk
Title: When in Malaysia.
Review: Best lunch experience ever .... food and service far exceed expectation. Kudos to the Chef , waiter’s Tess and Nick .

Author: Brian BAdelaide
Title: A Point of Difference
Review: Atmosphere 360 for us was the perfect finish to a great holiday (Thailand and Malaysia) and we weren't let down. Great view over K.L.City, great food, variety was amazing ....2nd best prawns on the planet only next to South Australia. Value for money and top quality service. I will defiantly visit again when next in K.L.

Author: Charline C
Title: Lovely restaurant for a relaxing break
Review: My friend and I decided to give Helena's Cafe a try and we were not disappointed at all! Food is tasty and service is quick. The setting offers a cosy environment to enjoy your meal. I would like to give my special thanks to the staff which is absolutely lovely, smiling and friendly. Everybody is very attentive towards their guests and we were deeply touched with some of their little attentions. As a result we ate at Helena's Cafe every night during our stay in Penang. I would totally recommend this restaurant! They really deserve it!

Author: jenniferhpkangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must go.....again and again
Review: We ventured to Chocha Foodstore today and were delighted with the quaint retro rustic interior. Fusion menu with everything sounding like we had to eat it. We settled for the Cured Fish Rice (Super yummy and fresh tasting especially with the herb butter mixed in and the scallion ginger sauce), Aglio Olio Duck (handmade noodles too ), Zucchini and Kyuri salad, CFC (cincalok marinated chicken ) and Crispy Chili Squid. Service was good and friendly. Wine is available too- happy campers and will definitely return (like tomorrow!!)

Author: blinkyeyedDublin, Ireland
Title: Very disappointing
Review: Service was very poor. They tried to sit us in the metal chairs at the entrance, I asked for a table further in and as we went I saw the restaurant was very big and loads of nice tables available, so I don't know why they wanted me at a rubbish table.I'm trying hard to remember what we had to eat, the same happened after I had ordered as it took so long to arrive ;) I had a poor burger and I think my girlfriend had the same. The meat was a poor.Great location and atmosphere but poor service and food.

Author: baldwincKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not the kind of high tea, service or sea view you are expecting!
Review: Took the chance to try out this place though there are reviews that their service is bad. True enough, it is BAD! Booked our high tea for 3pm. Got our high tea set only at around 4pm, and they expect us to leave the place by 5pm. Nothing fancy, food and drinks is just average. Only view is the reclaimed land and building construction next door. Staff tries to please everyone but the fundamentals of how high tea sessions should be is just off. Not worth the $$ paid for what they serve here. Tip: Just give this place a pass and go for more established hotels for high tea instead

Author: HappyTimes2011Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A gem in KL
Review: For me a trip to KL is never complete without a stop at the Hard Rock Cafe. What can I say? The food is really tasty and for the size of the portions, quality of ingredients and the ambiance, the price is a steal. Add up the happy hour savings and the neat items at the store and it is a win-win-win (yeap three times) case every time. Whenever in KL, I will always stop at the Hard Rock because I have fun and never been disappointed.

Author: akshaysaraf
Title: Worst buffet ever! Pathetic Staff attitude as well, especially if you go for a buffet!!
Review: People please do not visit this place if you really want to taste real Indian food. Their quality of food is substandard and the service is pathetic.There are much better places to visit for Indian food in KL like Sagar, Spice of India, Bombay Palace etc.

Author: 914shawPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A hidden flavour extravaganza,
Review: A hidden flavour extravaganza, on the second floor above KFC. We were craving some good quality Penang food, and Andrew did not disappoint! Tasty kangkung blachan, rich spicy chicken curry, spring rolls that mum used to make, all washed down with some refreshing iced lime tea. Were definitely coming back!!!

Author: T_Terrence
Title: Below Expectation Meal Experiences
Review: I thought that the food selections were not as great as it used to be as compared to my previous visit, which was about 2 years ago. I could be wrong. But with that price, I thought i could have a better meal.....

Author: Luis SBarcelona, Spain
Title: Didnt even stay
Review: I was eager to try the hard rock cafe in KL, when i get there and ask for a table for one, having empty tables and not saying reserved anywhere they tell me i have to seat outside or on the bar because (some unintelligible english).. so for some reason, they even ask if it was ok for me, of course not, its not ok, inside is air condition and eating on the bar is really uncomfortable, they seemed amazed by my answer that it was not ok, so i better left, Will avoid in the future

Author: Hannie999
Title: Awful food
Review: We had the signature duck confit and way beef for dinner but the taste was awful. Food was too salty and while the beef that was supposed to be medium rare came overcooked. Then came the bill which was shockingly expensive. First and last time visiting this place!

Author: Hannah B
Title: Mediocre
Review: Found the food to lack flavour and the juices too watery. There is an extensive menu which is good in terms of catering to various tastes, but it definitely lacked quality.

Author: jennifergR9664FILondon, United Kingdom
Title: Awful Meal
Review: Went to this Brussels Bar as the one in Ampang is very good, but this place is awful. Ordered our meal and after a long wait it arrived at our table stone cold. Sent it back, after another long wait it reappeared and this time luke warm. Only ate the vegetables as the meat was awful. They didnt charge us for it but would not venture back. We thought at the time that alot of people where only having a drink!!!! Would not recommend to anyone.

Author: vivnairMacau, China
Title: Nothing to write home about
Review: Went here for dinner tonight, nothing out of the ordinary. We didn’t leave with a sense that this was either authentic or a creative take on Malaysian cuisine. In fact it made the cuisine look like a poor copy of Indian and middle eastern foods. The Baba Ganoush was bitter, the biriyani’s only made you long for the real thing. Malaysia has a vibrant food culture. Jawi House is a poor ambassador for it.

Author: Nancy C
Title: Yummy😋
Review: Excellent food and service!  Roasted Pork was simply delicious and the other two dishes were tasty as well.  Portion was good for a family of three.  Will be back😊

Author: Dr_Nikk1Perth, Western Australia, Australia
Title: Tasty Indian food
Review: Friendly. Quick to serve. Ample Indian curry variety (and a few Western options: French fries, chicken nuggets, fish and chips). Clean venue. Very good value for money; cheap. Delicious. Even take-aways the next day are scrumptious. Close to the Pavilion shopping mall. Take the time to find it and it will become your local Indian go-to.

Author: Tien_111991Klang, Malaysia
Title: Boston
Review: When the word "Boston " I will think about their steam lala, 虾姑。。。very delicious...but the important thing is you must early 6pm go, if not will wait at least 1-2hrs for sitting place and food is be served!Be careful when going there eating, due to bad policing, a lot of cracksman...

Author: DDR1234
Title: Amazing view
Review: Wonderful  view with good photo opportunities, great food, good spread and good music to make a romantic dinner..

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique Japanese Restaurant in Hartamas
Review: Cannot begin to write about this quaint little restaurant which is neither an izakaya nor a full Japanese restaurant.The food serve is in small portions. Some are of better value, but some are super expensiveThe good thing about this restaurant is that everything they served seems to go well down the hatch.Definitely worth a try, at least to gain an experience of how a restaurant has different offering from the run of the mill types.

Author: golfer8899Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just average stuff..
Review: We pack 2 salted chicken home for dinner for $19 each..by the time we got home it's all dried up and need heating/steaming,..the meat is hard and one bird is hardly enough for 2pax...Next time, would need to pack 3 birds for a family of 5!

Author: monisa93Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, reasonable price and not pushy.
Review: When you first reached the food court area, the workers from every stalls will try to persuade you to choose their stall. But don't worry, they're not pushy at all and won't curse at you if you don't pick their stall. Just tell them 'no' nicely and they'll move on with their life. Stall no. 2 has friendly workers and even shared with us the history of this Portuguese settlement. Service was fast. They'll serve you peanuts while waiting for your order to come but remember, they'll include the peanuts in your bills. Since we don't want to have heavy dinner, we only ordered Portuguese baked squids, brinjal, one white rice and one large beer. Total bill (including the peanuts LOL) was less than RM60.

Author: Thomas NMiri
Title: nice big building, but service and quality still need room to improve
Review: The building is boxy type, spacious, feels rather empty inside.its will like a cool room, with no much of human touch to it.the food variety is below expectation at the moment and way pricey, hope it can be improved.

Author: Traveltheworld99999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Poor experience
Review: check in for a night and have late lunch at Wxyz bar at the lobby. Quite a bad one. Wrong food order even I repeated 2 times to the server. We order seafood noddles but got it vegetarian. I did mentioned to the Indian server but he couldn’t be bother. He just give me a blank look. Staff seem don’t care and No one actually acknowledge the error or offer to change order even the fault is from the staff.“Food took ages to served”I usually don’t comment bad, but this wasn’t a pleasant one. Training needed for the new staff. Repeat order to avoid wrong order.

Author: BilalMasood
Title: My introduction to Nasi Lemak
Review: I tried Nasi Lemak for the first time. Didn't think much of it. It was not bad at all, but nothing that great either. The anchovies take getting used to and are definitely an acquired taste.

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Good Meal
Review: We have been to this restaurant a few times in the past. This was a first visit after a long spell.The place was three quarters full when we entered at about 1.20 pm. It had a good buzz of excitement and the patrons seemed to be having a good time.We were quickly shown to our table and attended to promptly. We placed our orders and they arrived pretty soon. This was simply great because the place was crowded.The food was up to standard and the service was attentive and friendly.Overall, it was a good experience.

Author: ChoonFui
Title: Superb Claypot Bak Kut Teh
Review: It’s a must try. The Claypot Bak Kut Teh (pork rib “tea” literally, which is actually soup) is superb. Different from Singapore style which is peppery. This is more like herbal.

Author: Jesslia
Title: Disappointed and angry
Review: waited for full 2 whole hours for our main course. Racist behavior and terrible food. very overrated.

Author: Amyq166
Title: good food
Review: the service is very nice especially the staff attitude are very friendly. the price of the food is reasonable and afforable. i will come again. thz for provide a good environment n service .

Author: Swift Y
Title: Great Service and Whisky
Review: We ordered The Glenmorangie Nectar d’Or, the presentation is wonderful. Feels like chemistry lab, enjoyed it greatly. The waiter Arif is very helpful.

Author: Catherine M
Title: Top organic and vegan food in KL
Review: I love this restaurant and have gone regularly since discovering it. As someone who is gluten and dairy free and prefers to eat organic this is a real gem in KL. they have a full raw menu for vegans, which is of course gluten and dairy free. They have beautiful breakfast food, can serve coffee with almond milk and do a great range of lunch and dinner food too. I love the truffle omelette. My husband the red bun lamb burger. I have also enjoyed the beef noodle soup and tried the raw enchiladas and of course my favourite the very strong flourless chocolate cake.

Author: Fanny LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Tandoori Chicken In Town
Review: We walked into this coffee-shop type Indian restaurant accidentally, and ordered the tandoori chicken, beef, garlic naan and a plate of mix vegetable as suggested. The place was popular with the locals and lots of Indian diners, which is a good sign. To our surprise, the tandoori chicken was one of the best we have had - the cut of thick breast meat is large and juicy, we can tasted the tender meat was well marinated in yogurt, masala, turmeric, paprika and other spice, and it came with a light dipping sauce - the dish was really tasty and aromatic. The garlic naan, was large (8"), with crispy edge and soft center, and it also accompanied by delicious curry gravy - authentic and traditional. Even the mix vegetables were fresh, crisp and flavorful. Service was attentive , price was more than reasonable and the eatery was clean and cheerful. Highly recommended for anyone who like no-frill great Indian food. Great dinner for two cost less than USD 14 for both! . It is a Halal Restaurant, so no pork and no alcohol. (I thought a beer would make it 100% perfect)

Author: KillertanPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice Place If Like Green
Review: FoodLets face it, we went to a restaurant to eat. The food here to is good but not that great. Its doesnt much match with its ambient. The pizza is good but not great. The club sandwich was average. The laksa (didnt ate it), my friend said was great 3.5/5 Ambient Ambient is awesome. Lots of green. Fits its name botanical n co. I love how they use like this cheap flower but making it look expensive. 5/5Service Service was SLOW!. They take so much time to entertain us. The send fries and then i have to ask n wait for chili sauce n ketchup. Even for bill it was looong.. 1/5 Price If u're last name is trump, u might able to come here like everyday. But as an average person, its quite pricey. While Some food does fit with its portion, but some is just expensive. Drink also, the price n the size of the glass, it just ridiculousOverall The place is just ok for me. Maybe if u come when theres less people than maybe it would have been a different experience. But please buck up. The place got so much potential.

Author: limcl33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: We have visited this famous “authentic Nyonya” cuisine on Monday. Haiz~ this worst ever Nyonya food! Buah keluak chicken is dry and tasteless :( Chap Choy was overcooked and it taste weird.. this is the first time we visit this restaurant and probably the last time.

Author: SCFCJayStone, United Kingdom
Title: Chickenfish lah!
Review: Without a shadow of a doubt, this is my favourite place to eat on Jalan Alor and have eaten here well over 40 times in the last year. I always recommend it to friends and family and other expats and have even brought a few people here on a date! Not the most romantic of places admittedly but the food more than makes up for that. I have tried just about everything that the menu has to offer from the Salt and pepper squid to the sizzling beef and it has always been fantastic.Lillian the owner is one real character on the street and more interactive and friendly than any other owner I have ever met. I have been there at 8pm for dinner and 2am in the morning and she has given me the same service every single time and recognizes both me and some of my family who visit me every few months. I've read a review giving 1star on here... frankly I would urge that person to give it another shot because IF that is a genuine review it was certainly a 1 off. The other review about her temper, well I agree, I have also seen her become a little upset after someone walked out (perhaps the same night?) but I really felt bad for her because it was in the middle of a rush hour and there is only so fast they can cook food. Even top restaurants can take a while to serve food, it's just part and parcel so don't just go if it takes 30mins for food, enjoy a beer and take in the atmosphere and believe me the food will be worth the wait! Even after she was upset though she composed herself and was still pleasant to me and other customers.Price is average for the street, the tables are clean and nice fresh utensils, service is friendly and food is good. It is located 2/3 of the way down the street to the left side.I highly recommend the chickenfish!!

Author: misokimchiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very bad service
Review: The food was below average but the portion was surprisingly big. Good for those who eats a lot. Don't expect to get any service here, staff here doesn't care whether you exist or not. Lack of common sense and just downright ignorant. They can be seen talking loudly among themselves across the restaurant with customers around. Definitely would not revisit.

Author: Paik Ling HPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated!
Review: Not sure many have sworn by their pancakes. Seriously, I make similar ones using a box mix at home. Food overall is not GREAT (as per my rating, it's really average). We were there as a party of 7 on a Friday night and service was TERRIBLE. Waiters ran around like headless chickens and when they were not, they avoided eye contact and stood around.

Author: Garry700Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Local Food
Review: Parked in the middle of KL near The Pullman and the Royale Chulan hotels ,this is a great casual food experience . Very busy so get in early! fantastic selection of food and plenty of beer!! Many locals dine there and that is a good sign, BUT if you are a non smoker like me take a table down the back, and take in the view, enjoy.

Author: damlouiseAarhus, Denmark
Title: Nice food buuuut
Review: Food is simple, cheap and very good. Served in a banana leaf. However.. the guy serving it, had the worst attitude ever. He was almost throwing the food on the banana leaf, and he didn't want to reply or communicate in any way. Maybe he should consider finding another job. Plus for the food, but service and staff was horrible.

Author: janejale123Vancouver, Canada
Title: it was ok
Review: The service was not terrible but the food had hair in it. Not my style, they would not take the meal back and claimed that it was lemon grass.

Author: Peter KAustralia
Title: All talk , no action
Review: We dropped by the night before we actually decided to eat here and there was a very smooth talking guy who was intent on telling us everything we should know but wasn't too keen on listening to what we wanted. When we did arrive the following night he presented us two menus and I explained that I would have liked the on table BBQ but as he explained it was only for two people both eating the meat BBQ, I explained that my wife does not eat red meat and he then suggested a dish for me that was BBQ prepared in the kitchen and a dish that came in a choice of chicken , beef or seafood for my wife, she chose chicken. Well a delicious beef dish arrived in front of me and I started to eat and a few minutes later a beef dish arrived placed in front of my wife. When we explained that she had ordered chicken all hell broke loose , my dish was taken away from under my eyes and I was given what they had for my wife , ten minutes later a chicken dish arrived for my wife after mister smooth insisted she had ordered beef, not! When the bill arrived I noticed we were charged for two beef dishes but they had tried to placate us prior to this with a small scoop of "complimentary" ice cream. I couldn't be bothered arguing by this time , we paid the bill and left , never to return.

Author: Winnie LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Eve of CNY Dinner with family depressing
Review: Normal items that are not included today are:1. Oysters2. Satay3. Slipper lobster4. Lamb shan5. Bigger prawns6. Soft shell crab7. MacaroonsOverall food quality is well below standard despite no increase of price.Dessert quality also it’s a downward trend This is the last time I would come.

Author: RaffiRuff
Title: Short time to have a good lunch.
Review: While busy doing your shopping why not to have a break to dine in for lunch or dinner.All food served fresh and hot from the oven to your table..!

Author: Shahul Hameed SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the best Middle Eastern Food
Review: We went there for break fast during Ramadhan, unfortunately there was no buffet. But we still enjoy the food though. The portion is really big too, 1 briyani can be shared by 3 adults. My favorite dis was the "Iranian Briyani". It was really nice. The price is although is a little on the expensive side, It is worth going once in a blue moon.

Author: 910marielleh
Title: Good location, mediocre food
Review: To sit right at the beach, enjoy a beautiful sunset with a drink of choice in your hand, what could be better?This is what you'll find at this place. Excellent service and very helpful staff adds to the experience. But the food. Quite expensive and nothing special very plain. Not particularly bad but I was expecting more for the price.So all in all, I would recommend a drink or two here, but go somewhere else to eat!

Author: CashifS
Title: Not worth it!
Review: We ordered 3 chicken shawarmas and a box of mandi rice. Shawarmas didn’t cut it and mandi rice box was half empty. It wasn’t worth it! Better try other places, goodbye.

Author: ungkuraadKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: worst service,bad experience
Review: went to this place last week at noon.went with 16 of my family members..i guess ''US" being local have 2nd hand treatment....staffs didn't help us to seat us down....angrily pushed us away on the table issue( best part?they are not even busy!".Didn't want to take order...the best part again?the one that is rude is the foreign staff...what a joke!what we did after 20 minutes when didn't get attention...funny because we are 16 people(hard to be missed)...we LEFT!u don't want our money,we don't want your arrogance service...there's plenty of cafes around...posted in their fb and get no reply....

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Overrated
Review: Their curry laksa serve in small portion & taste ordinary. Price is at high edge. No parking & hygiene can be improved

Author: Arthur H
Title: More like Vietnamese fusion
Review: Place is cozy and comfortable. Music is relaxing. Place is nicely air conditioned. All elements combine to provide a pleasing dining experience.I tried to order the three staple Vietnamese dishes namely beef pho, rice paper spring roll and banh xeo. I'm surprised that I'm unable to find the last item in the menu, a first ever in my Vietnamese restaurant visits.I probably pointed at the wrong picture as I was served pork knuckle noodle instead. But nvm, my own fault.For the noodle, the soup is hot in temperature you might think it's a given, but not all restaurants I've visited is able to serve me noodle soup in the right delicious temperature. Anyway, back to the subject, the noodle tastes great.The rice paper spring roll tastes like the combination of sushi and rojak, probably due to the sweet sauce they used. But don't get me wrong, it is well made, very light, flavorful and easy to eat.The staffs are friendly and cared very much about my enquiry, which in my book is great service.I wouldn't say the food tastes like authentic Vietnamese, it is adjusted to suit the taste of Malaysian people. It's more like Vietnamese fusion. But the food is well made and tastes great so who cares.Would recommend.

Author: jourykim
Title: Spacious restaurant and airy
Review: Inexpensive food and good quality. The only downside is . we have to queue to collect our dim sum ( self-serve ) for most items. But the staffs are very attentive and helpful . Will come again.

Author: anotsoyoung1
Title: Great food and wonderful cocktails
Review: Enjoyed a quite meal and a lovely cocktail at the Geographer Café. Great atmosphere in this renovated old building in the heart of the Jonker walk in Melaka.

Author: nellielim
Title: Hawker centre
Review: This is a popular hawker centre frequented by locals. Lots of choices and very crowded. Nice to walk around and savour the food and atmosphere along Carpenter Street.

Author: MD Rakibul S
Title: Amazing
Review: Such a lovely atmosphere. i had the best shisha and bar experience in kl. I would love to visit this place again and again.

Author: Karin C
Title: Average only
Review: Chicken, bean sprouts & kway tiao soup all have the same soy sauce. Crunchy bean sprouts & a bit raw, nothing to die for.

Author: Doaa NKafrat Nassar, Egypt
Title: Great view but very expensive.
Review: We had our dinner tonight, we enjoyed the view and the service very much but the food wasn't good enough. I would recommend the bar not the restaurant for reasonable prices.

Author: malomaxBrisbane, Australia
Title: Just what I needed after 20 hours of travelling!
Review: Visiting friends in KL meant leaving home at midnight and arriving in KL late in the afternoon. For dinner our local hosts took us here for a light dinner. They eat here a lot as they know exactly what they can eat as they are strict vegans. My husband and I however, are not!So we just had a light meal - some roti and thosai....yum, yum, yum.The lime cordial was beautifully thirst quenching as well.A light dinner for 4 - around 15RM, so $5 Australian!

Author: ipsitag2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never ever
Review: This is perhaps the worst Middle Eastern food we have eaten in KL and trust me we have eaten some very bad ones. We had guests over so we thought we would just pack some food and bring back home. And what a bad decision. The Chicken Shwarma is so dry that it feels like someone has stuffed it with hay...yes there was super dry chicken and cold limp french fries (2 , yes thats right 2 french fries) in the Shwarma and thats that...no sauce, no pickled vegetables nothing! And we ordered biryani rice which was filled with chopped vegetables...maybe wjat they forgot to put in the Shwarma :) . The juices we had at the restaurant were pretty good and were served in these nice looking beaker kinda jars - these werent very clean though. On the whole would not recommend to anyone

Author: Sarah C
Title: Lovely riverside setting, very sweet food
Review: Lovely setting, busy staff and not bad food if you have a sweet tooth! Was looking forward to some spice but the Borneo Laksa, green curry and sweet and sour chicken were all on the sweet side. Perhaps should have asked for more spice!

Author: edang_80Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent view, delicious food
Review: We were here for a non buffet lunch on a weekday and were very pleased with the quality of food provided. I had a Black Cod dish and my partner had Grilled Scallops and Tiger Prawns. All items in both dishes were perfectly cooked. The very nice view and attentive service helped too.

Author: Alex9MaputoHong Kong, China
Title: Big Variety - lacking in flavour
Review: I was a guest at the managed residence next door and ordered room service twice as there was no table available. There was a good selection of food and reasonably priced. I ordered pizza and a curry. Both were a bit bland, and also the curry (chicken vindaloo) was not spicy at all and had a strange taste. THis amy have been from the plastic delivery container used. I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again, but wouldn't discount either, although there are plenty of other options a 15 - 20 minute walk away.

Author: FrequentFlier809388Odawara, Japan
Title: Good only to foreigners
Review: Food was mediocre at best. For price and claims as a good Spanish restaurant, we are disappointed. Only the grilled Squid with mashed potatoes had fantastic taste. Sadly waiters were not friendly as reviews mentioned. Very robotic and not helpful at all. They look friendly only to westerners. The manager seems to visit only tables with Western guest. Felt discriminated.

Author: Vic2riaVVSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely setting and good food
Review: Went there for dinner, good food and great location. Tried their local laksas and currys which were great value and superb. Ice cream wasn't very nice but we couldn't find a good ice cream parlour anywhere else in kuching. The crowd is mostly tourists, service is friendly but slow. The place has ample outdoor space with a boat in the front garden, which is very popular with children. Bring mozzy spray and enjoy the views!

Author: ganadelineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simply forgettable
Review: I do not like the pineapple tarts at all. The pineapple jam is rather sweet and not tangy. It did not taste like it is hand made by grating the pineapple manually. They use commercially-made jam. I know because it sticks to your teeth and lacks the fibrery look which will actually give the jam some form of crunch when eating it. The crust is strangely salty. It does not really melt in your mouth and dry. Butter used is not of quality too.Tried other shops selling these tarts but none of them can deliver. In fact some are even worse. Gave up trying the tarts. Prefer the tambun biscuits instead and one shop does make very good ones on Jonker street.Still prefer home-baked tarts.

Author: racwan78Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bad service & food varieties not worth the $$
Review: Last sat 2nd Dec me and family were at West In Hotel, The living Room for buffet lunch. First of all when we arrived, the captain of the restaurant did not greet us, some of the staff there were nice but the captain service was really bad! Food varieties at the restaurant was very bad n it's definitely not worth the money. Food was cold and tasted salty on sind of the dishes. I have very high expectations for a 5 star hotel buffet lunch but unfortunately me and my family was very disappointed. I will never go there again and I will never recommend it to any of my friends. Thank you

Author: Wongeileen
Title: RUDE TO HELL
Review: Those who rated above really really really have never tried dimsum before. Plus, service and attitudes is rude to hell.

Author: PLMLKuala Lumpur
Title: Interesting menu and decor, travelling up the yellow brick road
Review: Coffee is consistently good, anytime of the day - food menu has some interesting twists to local fare and the pancake menu is definitely a must try for the adventurous. Staff are friendly and helpful. Recommend making a booking especially for lunch any day of the week, or be prepared to wait (can take a while, depending time of day). Remember that no food is served between 3-6pm, just drinks and maybe some cakes.

Author: TravelDreamsPortland, OR
Title: I had one amazing meal there, and one so-so
Review: My first night at Jawi I had a great lamb dish with okra served with Benggalli toast. So tasty. Then the Red Velvet galette blew my mind. The second day I had some shrimp/ veggie fritters which I think were boring, the tofu and cucumber served with it were too bland to go with them, and a Arabic pink drink was also lacking flavor. So, go! It has great potential, but research what to order.

Author: Raymond H
Title: Delicious duck
Review:
Yummy! done and dusted. Came with few overseas friends. Nice menu. Very appetising. Its signature roast duck did not dissapoint. 
However, if the prices are more on the affordable side, i am sure Village Duck will blossoms in years to come and rivals the creme-de-la-creme's

Author: sarahauliaa1402
Title: friends gathering
Review: Good place, very delicioud food, good owner n staff..the service was so fast 👍🏻 i was always missed the food from that restaurant,cozy,quite..

Author: 412philippehHong Kong, China
Title: Great laksa
Review: Best laksa we had so far. The soup itself was excellent, a great balance between the fish taste, the sourness of the tamarind and the coconut milk.Great service and the owner explained carefully all the menu items. Highly recommended and by the way do not skip the deserts.

Author: Fearless43476
Title: Vasco's - a Hilton disaster.
Review: As a regular Hilton diner, I thought I had walked into the wrong restaurant when I saw the dinner buffet spread!We had spent over RM300 (USD70+) for two at Vasco's to experience the exquisite dining experience typical of all the other Hilton buffets outside Malaysia, but ended up feeling utterly disappointed and disgusted at the quality and selection of dishes.None of the meats or seafood were fresh. They were prepared like the cheap local coffee shop mixed rice standards.The selection of dishes was even more shocking...or the lack of selection.I cannot comprehend how the Hilton management can allow their world class standards to drop to this level and still charge guests an insane price...I had to kick myself to check if this was really a living nightmare.This review is to help the restaurant realize what needs to be improved...not to write a bad review without a purpose, as I am a loyal Hilton buffet patron who takes pleasure in your sumptuous grilled meats, fresh seafood and mouth watering desserts.If you cannot understand the intent of this review, then it's time to stop and think about another line of work.Please bring back the true Hilton dining experience I am so accustomed to.

Author: Barrie MKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Painful Service
Review: Superficially attractive cafe in great location outside Pavilion. Totally hapless, untrained staff who really have no idea whatsoever.I waited 15 minutes and have given up. I did manage a cup of tea. It arrived as a cup of water. Apparently you have to make it yourself. No milk. Eventually hot milk arrives. I ask for cold milk. It too eventually arrives but by this time the tea is going cold.Noone to take order for food. I gave up.

Author: CCallanMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Under serviced, poor quality, overpriced
Review: I'm weirdly amazed by their service. After waiting for 5-7 minutes at the outdoor seating area somebody finally came over to us. And instead of greeting us, the waiters stared at us. You could probably imagine the service for the rest of the night. The restaurant is not busy at all but we waited for another 30 minutes for our food to come, and the worst part is that they even delivered our dishes to the wrong table!While the food is slightly better than the service, but certainly not the best we had. We had steak burger with wedges. The burger was crunchy. The steak was just better than those you get from hawker stalls and not even restaurant level. The wedges tasted like those frozen wedges you can get from any local stores. And this is the first time in my life, a restaurant actually served their customers with cold and soggy wedges.We had chicken, which was terribly overcooked and dry inside. We'd tried the pork as well, not perfectly cooked nor marinated. I would rather get an angry whooper from Hungry Jack's than coming back again.

Author: schreibySingapore, Singapore
Title: Totally disappointing experience!
Review: It has been about 3 years since I last came to Shook and so to book and attend what I can only describe as a shallow representation of what Shook Champagne brunch used to be, is very sad. There is no atmosphere anymore, although a jazz band still plays. The food quality is poor, salmon sashimi that looked pale and not worth eating. The crab was mushy and watery - must have been overcooked. It can no longer be called a Champagne brunch as they only serve Prosecco now and amazing that they moved from French champagne to Prosecco and kept the same price - astounding! The cheese board has moved from what used to be a wonderful selection of French cheeses to 4 chunks of very ordinary swiss, edam and 2 others that were un noteworthy. It is all the little things that make or break a buffet - no bowls to put the wasabi and soy sauce in - I had to ask for them. Servers, reading things and not paying attention to customers who are there waiting to be served. The Chinese dim sum was ok but you can just see where corners have been cut in the presentation of the food. This will be the last time I will be attending Shook. How and why did it decline so badly?

Author: Anne-Sophie T
Title: A dissappointing experience.....
Review: We went for brunch at Acme after seeing it recommended on a few list of brunch places in KL. It was nevertheless dissappointing. After having visited VCR cafe they day before our expectations were high, but unfortunately not fulfilled. I had the avocado smash with eggs and ordered salmon on the side. The salmon looked unappetizing, and the bread was so dry that it must have been something from the beginning of the week. The avocado did not look like it was freshly smashed and the salad used for decoration looked so tired that it had been better not to put it there. My BF had the breakfast club, the scrambled eggs were dry and seperated, not how you wanted, the bread equally dry and the bacon very chewy. On top of that we paid 200 ringit for something that could not even compete with what we had the day before at VCR cafe for just 130 ringit. This cafe really needs to step up its game to compete with all the other hidden gems in KL. Will not recommend this place.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Frank A
Title: Wonderful everything...
Review: Beautiful food, wine, atmosphere and even family friendly! Delicious and memorable. Excellent, excellent service. Thank you for such a fine evening. The taste of that delicious foie gras still lingers in my mind!!!
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: vwongwtKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service and Food has deteriorated
Review: Used to frequent Siu Siu quite a lot as it is near my children's school. Recently after an event went to Siu Siu for dinner (Sunday around 7pm). As expected the restaurant was very busy but we managed to get a table. Order taker was not really friendly and I suppose because we were there having a normal dinner (Not ordering the 'expensive' dishes). Ordered Tofu with mincemeat, their signature Char Siew and prawn paste eggplant, Marmite pork ribs and Kailan (Kale) in 2 styles. 1. The Beancurd arrived cold (like it was pre-deep fried and they only cook the sauce and poured over it)2. Char Siew.. one of their signature... very tasty though a bit too fat for my liking.3. Prawn Paste Eggplant - our favourite everytime we are here but this time it was lukewarm and bland... a big disappointment4. Marmite pork ribs - Came out hot with good flavours but ribs were a bit tough and fatty. Seems nonchalant about trimming excess fat.5. Kailan in 2 styles - Not much to say about this.Dishes were served yet the rice only came 10 minutes later after constant reminders.Undoubtedly Siu Siu's reputation is built on it Char Siew, Claypot Crab Rice, Crab Dishes, Fresh Fishes which all cost a bomb. Other than the Char Siew, did not order any of the others this trip. Overall if you are looking for a simple family dinner and service with a smile, I would consider somewhere else.

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Tourist trap
Review: This place is s tourist trap. Walk down Jalan Alor a bit and you will find much better local Chinese or Thai food.

Author: Vicki C
Title: Sensational place
Review: What a find.... This place is sensational. The hospitality is exceptional. All staff, especially our waiter PADDY looked after us with attention and friendliness. The Tiger beers are the coldest we have had anywhere. Guiness pie is to die for.We make a point of going each day to have time there. WELL WORTH A VISIT.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: SleepsInCatPajamas
Title: Your average restaurant with good pork satay
Review:
went to the one located opposite OneTJ for dinner.

Normal restaurant with the normal standard food. but the killer point here is their pork satay, which is exceptionally good. 

other dishes was acceptable, nothing much to shout about.

Author: 12345AnitaAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Nice atmosphere, bad service
Review: There were a lot of photo opportunities in this restaurant but the food and service was a disappointment. My friends who ordered western food found their food alright but i specifically ordered a non-spicy Sarawak laksa and was treated to a spicy one. Didn't eat much of my food.

Author: kiwigazzaWellington, New Zealand
Title: Ok but nothing special
Review: Gotta agree with previous poster, not sure what the fuss is about. Pretty average curry really and same with naan, nothing wrong with it but nothing great either. wouldn't go out of your way to go here as surely there is much better around. Wouldn't say its a nice place to eat really just the run of the mill resturaunt i suppose if you want to have a few beers aswell could be an advantage.

Author: Sirinnapa S
Title: Super yummy
Review: Super atmosphere, super food, super dessert (we love Andreas special) and so much thx to Jayson, u r wonderful

Author: Kamesam SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High prices, small quantities, limited menu, slow service
Review: Went for dinner recently. Arrived at 8pm. For those who remember (and liked) the "old" Chocha menu, prepare to be disappointed. The menu has been changed (OK, no problem with a refresh now and then) but the choices of food have been drastically reduced, and even then, some of the items on this limited menu were unavailable.The portions are pretty tiny. (How did you find the snail dear? I looked under the vegetable and found a sliver of one hiding there). Prices are too high - RM200 per head including wine, no dessert. Service of the duck was inordinately slow...we waited more than 1 1/2 hours! The only saving grace, and why they get 2 stars, not one, is that the food quality is actually good. Just not enough of it, at the wrong price point, and too sloooow.I used to like this place. No more. Will avoid.

Author: joe992014
Title: Slightly pricey for a Coffeeshop experience
Review: Nice briyani rice .had the mixed grill plater that was good for 2 .Naan bread  a little too thick for us

Author: ppyleeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The chef should be fired!
Review: This was certainly the worst dining-out I've had in years. I went there today and ordered the unagi omelette rice set that came with matcha ice-cream. In the menu, the picture showed a reasonable portion of unagi. But when the real dish appeared, there were 2 small slices of unagi, thinly cut 1x1 inch square. I paid RM22 for that? It is absolutely absurd. I did not want to make a scene and ate my meal grudgingly. The ice cream tasted like stale ice. No creamy texture and reminds me of dry ice! Certainly do not recommend this outlet to anyone unless you want to be cheated of your money.

Author: Roby LJakarta, Indonesia
Title: A malay authentic food in mall
Review: It been like 3 years ago since i tried this restaurant for the first time, but until last month i had a lunch here, i still like it. I can find an authentic originally malaysian food inside mall, the taste is great, i really enjoy it here.I would really recommend all to come here and find out about authentic malaysian food. Hope you all like it.

Author: HongYawJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not up to its name
Review: Geographer cafe is no where close to what the reviews says. The food are nothing special (not even great), not even authetic, servings are small, pricing are expensive even for a cafe standard.Despite its strategic location, do visit other eateries or cafe for a better value for money.The staffs maybe friendly, but service are just not there. Just spend the money at any other local eateries.

Author: Highadventurer
Title: Local perspective
Review:
surprised at many rave reviews below likely written by foreigners who think local food served here are best. i beg to defer,

we ordered  mamak mee goreng and it was so less than tasty /unSatisfactory. soggy mee 

will not recommend to my frens.

Author: Striderspike
Title: Dining Experienced
Review: Poor service...  I ordered lamb chop,  i was the first one to place order then my wife and kids after....  Sadly my order was not taken/written by the service crew...  I kept on making followup... 😂😢

Author: yeoc468Singapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner
Review: Nice ambience, very good service, very average food. Peking duck is below average, nothing so good about the Durian dessert.

Author: zhimingandchunjiaoChina
Title: Terrible service bad bad bad
Review: Came here on 1st May around 14:00.The restaurant was not even fullService is terribleService staff had that kind of "unhappy face"When I raised up my hand to get the bill ,the Chinese lady ignore me once, I had to waive my hand in front of her to get it doneWhen she get the bill to me, she threw it on the tableWe ordered Veggie rollWaited for damn long, until main course is finished, the veggie roll is yet to arrivedAsked for a few times but NO BODY CARES!Will never come again and will never recommend this restaurant to others

Author: MaxMeijAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Diner in museum style!
Review: Interesting place. Mix of interconnected historical buildings with great ambience. It is packed with museum style collections, heritage, junk, paintings, artefacts. They serve good food as well and it is served in huge portions. Great place to have a meal and a chat in a quet and unique restaurant.

Author: Umair STysons Corner, Virginia
Title: Just ok
Review: Just an ok breakfast. I was not amazed about the quality. I have stayed at many other nice hotels around the world. Breakfast good have been better and better service.

Author: Manja Liza A
Title: Thumbs up.
Review: Hello Rozie if you read this. The most lasting bakery in this area. As one of the earliest tenant .. brings back memories.. their scones and cookies is WOW! Try it ...

Author: jwtraveller4
Title: Disappointed
Review: Got here just after 4pm it wasn't overly busy. I waited 45 minitues in 33 degree heat for my char koay teow should of just walked out others would have. Everyone around me was served. It wasn't until I gave the waiter a death stare that he went to chef! It was then cooked and brought to me at 5pm they shut at 5. I felt rushed to eat. Food itself was OK very oily I've had better at Gurney Drive. There are much better places in Penang, I won't be returning.

Author: n8210Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I still don't get it
Review: The first time I tried this shop's chicken rice, I was not surprised. Nothing special. Luckily back in 6-7 years ago, one working afternoon, there was hardly much crowd. Just a 5 min wait and we can get a seat. That was my first experience. This time round in 2011, long queues and still the same quality. I just don't get it. Why the long queues? I love chicken rice. I used to eat chicken rice for the whole 2 years as lunch when I was in high school. Parents had to work and I couldn't cook. Now, I live across the street to 2 chicken rice shops, and they both beat the Melaka chicken rice any time of the day!! I give it a "No go".

Author: sharadbhatt99
Title: Extraordinary veg food
Review: For Gujarati people this place to one of the best place for veg food lovers fills like in Gujarati food test.

Author: above_beyond
Title: BAD FOOD & BAD SERVICE.
Review: The quality and service has decrease badly. We ordered hummus and the hummus came late after we about to finish our meal. Plus the hummus was spoiled but they still served us and to other people. And the masoob dessert was different quality, different preparation and taste awful. The meat doesn't taste fresh as well.They never checked the food quality before serving and the restaurant full with non Arabs. As far as I know, Arabs only eat quality meat because they are meat lovers. I won't recommend this restaurant.

Author: asiabrandsJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Angry Diner
Review: Went for dinner. Call up restaurant thru search on web. Was there and found out if book by tableapp get 25% discount. No wonder price higher 25%.Talk to service staff wearing black uniform and ask for 25% discount. Answer was book thru table app. Said then I book now thru app answer no. Well still spend there but sad is why they do this to offend customers.So book thru tableapp as not to feel bad.

Author: Darknight1522Orchard Road, Singapore
Title: Extremely inflated pricing for Indian Cuisine
Review: Service Staffs are generally well trained and they do extend their service attentivelyAmbienceThe have a semi outdoor and great full indoor restaurant sitting areas. Decor is modern and music is soothing to hear. Fragrance inside the restaurant is quite pleasant and easy. Price pointThis is the part made my whole rate given as 2 star. I feel this restaurant’s entrepreneur have cascaded too much of their operating cost on the food itself. Which supposed to be, however certain food pricing is exorbitant. We are 5 kids and 4 adults and we spent a total of RM900+ which is a pricing bracket for upper scale restaurant in JB - KL areas. What disappoint the most is basic element of Indian food is rice and they charge $8.00- $9.00++ per small bowl of of plain Basmati Rice. As it is, each of their main dishes costs around 200++ each. Taste wise, if you love South Indian palate, these food are a complete letdown. However if you are a North Indian-fusion lover then maybe this restaurant is a good fit. I personally thinks the taste and food serves the best for Non Indian foreigners and tourists in JB/SPORE. The only credit I can really give to the kitchen team is the way they mix and match few sub-district food in India and present them excellently. To locals who are in love of authentic Indian food, do not be fooled with ranking on Trip Advisor. Thank you folks.

Author: AndrewD_SGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very disappointing
Review: I decided to try again after a disappointing meal at Prime Steakhouse next door. There was only a single grass fed steak on the menu, a rib eye. So I went out on a limb and tried the skirt steak. They warned, through the menu, to expect a tougher but more flavoursome cut. It was both. Unfortunately the toughness beat out the flavour and I left half the steak. Chambers have a lot of work to live up to their price. As a big Hilton fan it does hurt a little.

Author: Windsong233Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Soooo good
Review: The food here is so good. But compare to ten years ago it had dropped. I think it is due to the bad economy. Order the Assam prawn, the fresh prawn done in butter milk ,the cllaypot pork or chicken. The sun hock fish is very good....I could go on and on....

Author: kennethkongk
Title: Good food, great service!
Review: Dishes may not be to everyone’s liking but this is it - traditional Orang Ulu & Dayak food. Halal place.

Author: WoonWoonT
Title: Dimsum quality has dropped
Review: Quality of dumsum has dropped.Skin of siew mai is thick and prawn in dimsum doesnt taste fresh. Don't have as many varieties as before.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: ann cKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice decent place for food & coffee
Review: Had lunch this afternoon with a friend & her 8 yo girl. The place was 60% full which was perfect for the SOP distancing, we took a table at the far end but was not neglected by the service staffs, they were attentive & alert. We ordered 3 mains & 1 snack to share - Greek salad, Nasi Goreng, Pizza & french fries. OMGoodness .. the french fries is arguably the best in town - equally seized thin strips of potatoes deep fried to perfection with a standardised color & just right saltiness. Nasi Goreng was good too with it's very fragrant fried rice & a variety of other sides & condiments. The after meal flat white was perfect to end a good meal, we had no more allowance for dessert, perhaps next time.

Author: PGRBrusselsBrussels
Title: Great restaurant in Ipoh
Review: Wow.. what a great authentic Malaysian restaurant...plenty of locals dining, a good value dish of the day .. unfortunately Nasi Lemak wasnt on the menu the day when I called in and I took tofu..! .but great service, freshly cooked and well presented food. great value..classic Chendol! Highly recommended.. sadly like most businesses in Ipoh old town closes early during the week (5PM) and 9PM weekends - it has to be a lunchtime/afternoon visit.

Author: y1oshHarrow, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed with the food especially for the price!
Review: After reading the reviews on TA and some consideration we switched our dinner reservation to a lunch one...good job we did so. The food was very disappointing especially when you pay so much compared to better street food at a fraction of the price. It was only worth while as we got a good view from the revolving restaurant, which is better than that from the walkway on Petronas from my understanding (which we didn't do). Only do it for the view!

Author: doc8regCebu City, Philippines
Title: Great food, fast and friendly service
Review: First meal on arriving in KL on this visit was this unassuming restaurant nestled in the center of the city. The place is not very impressive, there were a few flies even in the air-conditioned dining area.. But the food is so good. Vegetables were cooked to crisp perfection, steamed fish, crabs and noodles were good too... But the fried shrimp with egg was to die for. At the end of the meal, try the Durian puff ( fried pastry balls with durian inside), you will not regret it. Definitely worth the walk....

Author: lostboyhappyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lightless yet brilliant!
Review: I've ever always been a skeptic of this sort of concept. After all, could I not replicate this by simply blindfolding myself at any meal? Simply put, no. There is a distinct difference to be actually immersed in total pitch darkness. It's not just a matter of not knowing what's on your plate, but experiencing what we take for granted - i.e. eating - without seeing... anything! No matter how hard you try, how wide you open your eyes, you cannot see your companions, other guests, the decor (if any!), and the other thousand things we notice visually, consciously or subconsciously. The feeling of being "disempowered" is at first a little disconcerting, alarming and frightening. But all that gives way to a sense of heady excitement. That in itself, is an experience to remember. To this diner anyway.The food. Just about all of it was very well cooked. Taste is, of course, subjective, however the skill of the chefs cannot be denied. The diversity of ingredients used was extensive and really keeps you guessing (extreme fun warning!). Food temperature could use more improvement, though. Main courses needed to be a little warmer in my opinion. The wine-paired menu option is a recommended choice. The wines I had were delicious and didn't 'distract' from the unseen meal.The service. This is what really shines here. Our waiter was courteous and very hospitable. His calm demeanor and polite, clear instructions were vital to making us feel relaxed and therefore better able to really enjoy ourselves, which we certainly did.Don't go expecting to have the best meal of your life or that it's a 'gimmick' - you won't feel cheated even though it's not exactly cheap. What it's really about, though, is the experience and execution, both of which are excellently done here.

Author: JeanSydney_AustraliaSydney, Australia
Title: Nice food, nice owner
Review: This is a quaint little place with good local food and friendly staff. The only thing that spoils it is the terrible noise and pollution from the gangs of motor bikes that rage up and down the street . Shame the police don't take action as it's a big deterrent for all the eating places along the Batu Ferringhi strip

Author: alexchew92
Title: Bad Service
Review: The service wasn't unfriendly and also we keep on getting the wrong order, some more there was a dish they send to the wrong table (supposed is our dish), one of the waiter she just bring the food back to kitchen and come out with the same dish. (I don't I think they charge for us), over roll the experience wasn't good enough.
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Mid Valley SouthKey Mall (NO PORK)

Author: Geneveive
Title: Average Peranakan Food
Review: The food was average compared to the last time we dined here. Service could have been faster as we waited quite a while for our food.

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Not a good experience...
Review: Koh Samui is one of the few Thai restaurants in Ipoh and they have been in business for many years, though it was only this year that I first went there.We have heard generally positive things about Koh Samui, but our experience there was not good. The flavours of the dishes that came out were nothing like what we expected and a far cry to Thailand or other Thai restaurants in Malaysia. The tom yam was just sourish and not aromatic or tasty. The green curry was far too sweet and lacked flavor, etc. In general it was one of the worst Thai meals I've had.We were wondering how the restaurant could have survived all these years with such bad taste. Perhaps that was just a very-off day for the chef. In any case, after that first experience we're hesitant to go back there.

Author: YannickStOberentfelden, Switzerland
Title: Very nice and helpful staff
Review: We were there for food and drinking. Very nice place with good dishes and the best is the very helpful staff around Rajib. If you want to inform you about your travel plans and Malaysia and have some good food and drinks - you're at the right place. We recommend it.

Author: shahrilr2019
Title: Amazing night.
Review:
Amazing experience. The only place in publika you will enjoy the night, the best service staff so attentive. Yummy food and the best maitai.
Will comeback soon.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: lucysilvers
Title: Attentive staff, great ambience
Review: This cafe was a welcome oasis from the heat as we meandered around Penang. The staff were helpful, food satisfying and the Creative drinks an added bonus.

Author: ashishbakre67Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Extremely Over priced
Review: It’s the only way I can describe the place , quality of food and ambiance very average. In the price for 4 we paid , you can get a gourmet meal in any of the 5 stars in KL. May appeal to Western tourist who are looking for familiarity, locals have much much better options. Not sure but the HRC in Penang and Melaka are much better in terms of location, ambience and food. Not sure why?

Author: Bess GNewellton, Louisiana
Title: Best salad ever
Review: I was in KL and went to Chilis for an American meal. We had the unlimited chips and salsa and a chicken salad. It was so good. We were just craving a salad and this one sure met our taste Bud desires. Very good and will return again.

Author: csds2019Klang, Malaysia
Title: Feeling sad
Review: Food was so good. My wife love the mutton Briyani and Paneer noodle But dispointed with service.... Hope this time be better and good service

Author: jainneha
Title: Ashoka curry house
Review: It is a Punjabi restaurant so can get good parathas and samosas. The food is good . In JB there are not much choice for North Indian food . So this is the best escape .

Author: 478sallybBrussels, Belgium
Title: Ok food but pricey
Review: Came here for dinner on a Sunday night and were the only people in the restaurant. Had butter chicken, tandoori broccoli and a sweet and sour eggplant dish. I thought food was fine but did not blow me over. Bill was quite high though (ok - we also had 2 glasses of wine). I guess you have to pay for Indian fine dining.

Author: David SBudapest
Title: VERY LOUSY
Review: Read about this place and expected a lot. But it was rubbish. An open kitchen merant you could see all the young chefs, leaning on one leg, not caring about what they were doing and it showed in the food.Poor rice, not fragrant enough.Watered down chill/ginger sauce.Sprouts not cooked well.Chicken was good but nothing special.Mushroom dish that was not well cooked.Over hyped and over rated.Clearly the boss is just capitalizing on his success and could only care about this profit and not his quality. Definately worth avoiding!

Author: YeeSeng
Title: Good food with reasonable price
Review: We had our dinner here on a normal weekday, hence the restaurant is not so crowded. Very relax environment and the staff is attentive. The price of food is very very reasonable although they are situated at the tourist spot!

Author: 947AnnTPattaya, Thailand
Title: Great steaks
Review: Suzis is a very ordinary outdoor restaurant, nothing posh about the plastic chairs and decor. It is a favorite with foreigners and locals alike. The food is good and fresh and the prices are reasonable. It is popular, so quite noisy and bustling. The steak is very good and cheap, by other fancy restaurant standards. If you just want a casual meal out with good food, this is the place for you.

Author: metrobird
Title: Very nice
Review: The food and drinks were great. Delicious Creme Brûlée dessert. Good service, relaxed atmosphere. Inside is quite brightly lit at night, so we sat outside. Maybe a little bit pricey for a cafe, but it was very nice all the same.

Author: SeanBPuiLos Angeles, California
Title: Best Wine selection in Kuching
Review: Yes!Finally a good bistro in little quaint Kuching.Their concept may be a little alarming at first but what i'm hearing is a revamp of this 5 year old restaurant. They have an impressive Wine list for Kuching standards and freshly made sausages. Must try's are their Wagyu Beef Steak, Curry Laksa, Bak Kut teh, Pork Knuckle, Crispy Roast Pork and Pesto Pasta.During seasonal periods they even have turkey and christmas pudding to be ordered.Not too expensive considering the ambiance and food quality :)Servers could be more attentive though.

Author: Sanjeev M
Title: Good value
Review: Have had buffet breakfast and seafood dinner buffet here. Very good value even though the exuberations of the Chinese New Year mean that some patrons (dinner) piled their plates sky high with the crab claws and mini lobsters and oysters. But there was more than enough to go around. Cost is £50/ head for the seafood buffet.

Author: Shanen617
Title: Ribs in Malaysia
Review:
Not the best ribs place I have been
Service was poor, the rack of ribs were dry and not as tender as you would expect

Author: jessa08Cavite City, Philippines
Title: Nice ambience, bad food
Review: Went to the Burps & Giggles seeing some good feedback from the internet. The interior of thecafe is awesome, nice ambience to chill out with friends.But thats about it, i don't recommend anyone to try their food. I had a bam bam, theingredients is fresh, but the taste is not up to the standard of what you paid. And they are verysalty!A place to chill out for a nice cup of coffee, forget about the food.

Author: TheAnotherTraveller
Title: Good concept on choice of noodle hardness
Review: Good tonkotsu ramen, this restaurant offers you the choice on your noodle hardness (soft, normal, hard, very hard). Great concept. If you have some soup left after finishing the ramen, you can ask for extra serving of noodles for a nominal price. Good service.

Author: FlinderscoupleAdelaide, Australia
Title: a very mixed experience
Review: Tribal Stove might have been having a really bad night the evening we had dinner there. Fortunately a few dishes, notably the vegetable of the day, was tasty, but overall it was a very haphazard and amateurish dining experience. Some key items on the menu were not available. The staff's attention was hard to get at any stage, despite only 2 other diners being there, who clearly experienced the same erratic lack of attention from wait staff and haphazard delivery of food and drink. Our main dishes were cooling on the table as we waited and waited for the rice to arrive. The owner made an appearance and was very confident about his place, but we think it needs a lot more work in every aspect to be worth a recommendation.

Author: Smita SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A place that doesn't try
Review: I've been here now and then since it opened, and the service and food have really gone downhill. At my last visit (and that will truly be the last one!), food was served on dirty plates. Cutlery had little crusty bits on them. Food was meh, but then again no one (I hope) goes there for that, just a relaxed time, some music, some beer. Anyway, we went pretty late (close to 10 pm), and I asked if they were still serving. Server said "oh yes" seated us took our order, and then before we even got our food everyone started leaving, the musician packed up, and by the time our mains came, the whole place was being swept, chairs stacked, the place all but closed. And when I complained about this, all I got was a half-hearted "sorry" from the manager. My advice: skip this place and head to Steak Frites for food or Mish Mash for a drink. Mews Cafe is not worth your time or money.

Author: sukiesk971102Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect choice for breakfast
