Review: They serve hot steaming dim sum, and the taste is yummy and tasty. Waiter and waitress are always friendly and helpful. If you can't decide what to order, you may always ask their waiter for the suggestion.It is always the choice for my family to have breakfast.

Author: ItsjamesnickJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Best noodles in town - spicy food lover, don't miss it
Review: You can't really differentiate good restaurant from the others in Penang, as they share same characteristics being not fancy, looks old, old (or even senile) cook/owner, and a little bit dusty. But this Yeap's Noodle is really something, I can say the best noodle house in town compared to others restaurant. Tried the spicy noodle with minced pork and meatballs, this is really a hawker style fried noodles with extravagant level of spiciness. If you a spicy food lover, don't miss this spicy noodles. I also ordered the non-spicy noodles for my daughter, the soup based is really delicious and tasty. Family are happy with the noodles.

Author: Hao E
Title: Unpleasant Dining experience
Review: Pretty disappointed with the food at George & dragon...premium price for the steak but tasted worst than hawker level. Unable provide right steak for the first time, steak was overcooked, the second served steak tasted like the meat freshly out from fridge. Tasted like frozen meat indeed. The salmon dishes were bland . Feeling yucks and unable to finish it. The portion also been cut down for others dishes with price increase. Overall the dining experience was not pleasant, hardly to come back again.
Restaurant: George & Dragon Cafe at Taman Tasek

Author: munirah a
Title: best for local dishes
Review: if u guys wanna try nasi lemak. and coffe. go to this place.. the taste are awesome.the nasi lemak sambal are spicy and nice.. the coffee are perfect...

Author: archmage
Title: Another Boring Chinese Restaurant
Review: Please add this to your list of yet another Chinese Restaurant. I attended a function last month and in due course ended up here for dinner. Dishes were run of the mill. Wouldn't recommend it. There are much more inspiring restaurants in Melaka.

Author: pooisze93
Title: Random dinner
Review:
Ordered and Waited the food for half hour .How come so Long ? 
Unfortunately realise that the waiter forget to order 🤦‍♀️ What the~
Some more the food there just soso ~ and the prize of the food is not worthy at all .

Author: Tini201405
Title: Too sweet.... More chilli please....
Review: Everything is sweet.... Do they put sugar in Tom Yum too? Thai food suppose to be balance with sourness, spicy, sweet & salty. But, these more like a Kelantanese Thai fusion.....;)

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Great Place
Review: Panaromic view of KL and Twin Towers as backdrop a great place to have our drinks before dinner at the Yen. A nice pool with dry ice and colourful neon lights great ambience for the birthday drink. Great  place.

Author: Manoj1973
Title: Great food, prepared with lot of care and love
Review: The food was mindblowing.  It was simple and we loved all the four dishes we ordered.  Have to visit again.  Slightly more expensive than usual restaurants in Melaka.  But then, the presentation is great and the preparation quite unique.

Author: Vincent GZürich, Zürich, Switzerland
Title: Nothing special
Review: As it was stated, this is like a French bistronomy, however, from what i have tried, you do not really experience an authentic french gourmet, it is more like a mix of american-french food, there is no wow factor with the food served, and the price is very pricey for such a "normal" food. quite a disappointment indeed.

Author: Rozelle_23
Title: Overhyped
Review: Wanted to check this place out as it was quite hyped about.. to be honest, i was alil disappointed.. the food was not up to expectation.. the extra star was for the courteous staff.. and a different music would enhance the ambience as well.. this is just room for more improvement.. please dont take me wrong.. all the best

Author: Ken C
Title: Nice location, nice food, slow service but what's the rush
Review: Really nice to be sitting by the river enjoying the ambience. Food was nice but a bit slow to arrive and the table took a while to be cleared. But there was no rush and it was just nice to sit and chill.

Author: Vanessa EKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Weekend high-tea buffet (extensive review): Good service but food was below average by any standard
Review: To note: The Living Room has a Citibank and Groupon offer for 45% off the high-tea buffet (for RM69). I did not go with a Groupon pre-purchase but used my Citi card on the bill; I did however peruse three of the menus on rotation on the Groupon site. I had reservations but figured I could trust the establishment with it being a Starwood hotel. Boy was I wrong. The duration of the buffet is stated to be from 12:30pm to 3pm on the hotel website (we found that diners were already there well before at 12pm). 2.5 hours is rather short for a high-tea lunch but we found it adequate as the buffet lacked variety. On the food, there were so many items missing from the buffet that were stated on the three menus. Satay, a staple at any Malaysian high-tea buffet (and mentioned in all menus) was nowhere to be found. Each menu also highlighted the fact that the sandwich bar will have smoked salmon and cold cuts but they did not. What little smoked salmon appetisers at the salad bar were snapped up and not replenished. I kindly asked one of the kitchen staff out on the floor if there would be more as I hadn't sampled any and he said "I will ask the kitchen for you but if it's finished, then it's finished." Certainly not a response I would expect. Seeing as they know how many diners will be there, certainly they could've prepared an adequate amount of food. Diners were polite and I did not witness anyone taking more than their reasonable share so the buffet simply lacked quantity and variety. Pasta station only had two pre-cooked options sitting on a bain marie warmer. Overcooked and bland. The staff manning the carvery station did not know how to properly cook meat as everything was overcooked (beef and lamb); we were not asked how we wanted the meats cooked either; nor was it an option as meats were pre-cooked then heated in a skillet. Diners also had no access to help themselves to the carvery. Mains mostly consisted of Asian fare. The Chinese Nai Pak vegetables were cooked well while the butter prawns were of questionable freshness as some were mushy. Pasembor (Indian rojak) was by far the most insulting dish at the appetiser bar. Theirs consisted of deep-fried simulated crabstick pieces topped with an inedible peanut sauce and shredded cucumber (pre-served in a martini glass). I've had the satay on the a la carte menu (very good peanut sauce) so it isn't even a case of them not knowing how to make the Pasembor dish. Appetiser bar lacked almost every seafood appetiser mentioned in the menus. There was only a beef dish and a Thai cold chicken feet salad. The octopus and crab salad had virtually no seafood. Desserts were not as advertised either. No Bubur Kacang Merah (also stated in each of the three menus) but instead a sickly-sweet corn soup. All menus also stated there will be Cendol for dessert but there was none. If it weren't for the service we would've wanted our money back there and then. Needless to say, I won't recommend the high-tea buffet at all due to the cost-cutting, skimping on quality, and misadvertising of the menu. This seems to be plaguing all the hotel buffets in the Klang Valley.

Author: geezerbelle
Title: Trying too hard
Review: Yet again another restaurant that caters more for 'see and to be seen'. Average food/service/everything

Author: lkloh69
Title: Good food
Review: Great food, excellent service!  It's a good place for those who are looking for 'fine-dining' food & ambiance.

Author: Onmytwofeet
Title: Used to be excellent
Review: Oh Foo San , u used to be great 20 years ago . In your old premise , where there were push carts serving patrons as tim sum experience should be. Your food was the best . What happened ? The food is now lousy (except for char Siew pau perhaps), and you make people queue at self service counters ?? Hey , u r a Tim sum not fast food restaurant! Your traditional Tim sum image is totally gone . So sad for you...

Author: The_Miri_EpicureMiri, Malaysia
Title: On the slippery slope?
Review: We have not dined here for a year or more but it was good last time.We had just sat down when a large man rushed up and removed us from the booth. The place we had sat was reserved apparently. So we sat elsewhere.Then the menus arrived promptly and then nothing for 20 minutes. The place was busy, about 12 tables occupied, and only 2 hardworking waitresses were there, but we could not "catch" them as they went by despite are best efforts.Finally we cornered a waitress, and went through the familar game in Miri. The game is called "Guess what we actually have" . The game goes like this.You ask for something off the menu, and the waitress replies "No have". We got 5 "No haves" (at midday!) , and I lost patience and asked her to tell us what she did have.I wanted Chicken chop in garlic sauce. " No have" but they did have chicken chop oriental and chicken chop blah-blah but cannot knock up a garlic sauce to go with a plain chop? Go figure.So we ordered Beef in ginger & Chicken rice. It arrived reasonably quickly & my wife liked her chicken rice, but my beef had a chewy soft taste ( maybe the old baking soda trick with a cheap cut of beef?) with no real beef or ginger taste.The prices are a little above average, but this is reflected in the nice deco, air con, and clean surroundings. The menu has a wide choice on it, but I wonder how many "no haves' are on it.In summary, this place has changed for the worse, and it may be on the slippery slope to ruin.

Author: jokl78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the worst!!!
Review: One of the worst nasi kandar i have ever tried. The mutton is super tough, chicken is hard, squid is tough, fish is also hard, beef also tough. Papadam is soggy. Curry tasted ok. Very thirsty after eating here. One of the worst nasi kandar I have tasted in my life. Don't even think of coming here to eat. Simply go to any mamak taste much better than this lousy place.

Author: maanojnPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: The finest venue for a family gathering
Review: Recently went with my family for dinner to celebrate my mom bday. The outlet is strategically located with ample parking. The venue ambience is relaxing and family friendly. The food quality is good with the right choices of spices.. will surely return on the future.

Author: WhatdoyouwanPlentong, Malaysia
Title: A wide variety of seafood
Review: 9 adults and 3 kids went on Thursday dinner. We ordered quite a lot(see attached bill). The dishes are good, we love especially the cockles fried kuey teow and the sambal shell(大头). The fried kuey teow was good that we order a big one soon after we finished the smaller plate. However, the smaller plate tasted better than the bigger one. The cod fish was not up to par and have a weird chemical taste.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful Happy Hour cocktails
Review: Whilst they have many choices of cocktails listed under the Happy Hour rates, they are not good at all. They do not know how to make basic cocktails, plus the Happy Hour rates are not really that great. If you're charging RM20+ for cocktails during Happy Hours, I expect them to be good, if not great. The wait staff are also extremely clueless about any of the drinks on their menu. From the taste of the cocktails, I would say the same about the bartender too. Best to have draught beer or bottled drinks. The food on the other hand is decent.

Author: jan1222Melaka, Malaysia
Title: hmmmmmm
Review: I decided to go cafe hunting with my friend on my off day, and we stumbled upon this lovely cafe.. although the place delivers an environment that a cafe should, it doesnt really have any distinguishing features, interior is so-so, nothing special... maybe the food will be nice!! but still, disappointed of getting a bitter aglio olio.... and overpriced drinks .... well, maybe its just a bad day .....

Author: pakdollahSingapore, Singapore
Title: very nice steak
Review: tenderloin steak was done in a tasty. i had one. it was done with sumptuous taste and i really enjoyed it very much. i can see other customers are enjoying evry bite they have. hope those who haven't, take a bite at this outlet. prices are reasonable and there are other options like satay

Author: Eleen00Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible service and so-so food
Review: I hardly write restaurant reviews unless they are exceptional. In the case of Gastro..it's been consistently exceptional bad the few times we have been here in the last year.Today will be the last time we come back to this place. Food is overpriced- quality of ingredients and food is generally subpar for the price we pay. We ordered 2 pasta for kids today, the pomodoro (which we requested changed from cabonaro) came sour. I don't understand how anyone could get a basic pasta wrong. We asked for a change, and was informed they will have to charge for the change in kids meal. For a rm30 kids meal, I expected better ingredients...but no...kids food was of lousy quality. Chef didn't even come out to verify the issue.Service was also slow. We have to ask for everything, including cutleries. Our order was only taken 15 mnts in after we called multiple times for someone. Adult food came 45 mnts after we sat down. Up till the 45 mnts mark, no cutleries was given to kids. No water pour despite ordering and asking twice. Horrible horrible service and food.

Author: SimpleSimX
Title: Sigh...I’m not going back
Review: My third visit to Anzu. Tonkatsu is authentic and delicious and fairly priced. I enjoyed the food and service on both my previous visits. But service was surly this time, and they brought out my main course 15 minutes after my companions’, without an apology I couldn’t be bothered to ask for the sesame seeds they’d forgotten to bring, because I was just tired out by then. My miso soup had a 3cm length of thin wire in it, possibly from some packaging. I showed it to the server and she made no comment. One young bloke, maybe a trainee, was friendly though. I like the cooking, but I’m not going back.

Author: SeeTasteWrite
Title: Mitasu Japanese Restaurant Wilma Chuang KL
Review: Value for $$. Regular price MYR 67.50++ Senior 55 years @MYR 50.90++ Ala Carte buffet inc. dessert and hot/cold beverage. Acceptable food quality considering price point so it’s 3.5/5 for us.

Author: AyeshaSCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Arrogant and rude service.
Review: We visited Bobo KL after reading a review on Yumlist. Unfortunately this was one of the worst experiences in terms of service. For one hour that we spent there with wine and a shared platter of cold cuts the waiters kept coming and interrupting conversation every 5 mins. The food menu is really quite limited so we didn’t want to order dinner. It was quite obvious that they didn’t want us there anymore if we didn’t order dinner, even if we were still not done with the wine and the cold cuts. They kept coming over to the table and pulling away the cutlery and crockery one at a time. After being requested and reminded twice that we didn’t want to be disturbed so often the Manager tells us “If they’re not being used they should be removed. That’s service!” Immediately afterwards another waiter comes up and asks us for the second time if we wanted dessert. The service in this place is arrogant and haughty. Nothing much to write home about except a bill of RM 178 for a precious evening with friends spoilt by Bobo KL. Upon being provided feedback on facebook their only response was "We are sorry that you did not have a good experience at bobo." It is very clear that they couldn't care less about the concerns of customers.

Author: vulynMaldives
Title: Gigantic, delicious portions of food
Review: What an experience!! We ordered food not knowing the portions and wow we were in for a shock. The portions were massive!!! Be careful that dont order too much. The taste is really good and authentic. Price is a little on the higher side but well worth it!

Author: fitfunf
Title: Lunch crowd Nu Sentral
Review: Very popular. Lunch crowd so busy. Had noodles. Dessert and hot drinks. Small tables. A little noisy but good for quick bite.

Author: Hikka123
Title: Best shawarma I’ve ever had
Review: Found the restaurant as it was number 1 on trip advisor and it definitely did not disappoint. Great end to the holiday enjoying some delicious chicken shawarma as well as other home cooked dishes. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting or even locals!

Author: jcjy77
Title: Not the ordinary Indian food
Review: I have tried Indian food in the past, but the food here was very different... more "modern" I felt. I didn't imagine foie gras cooked Indian style... this was definitely a star dish! We were initially unsure how to start ordering as the menu was very comprehensive, very interesting to read. The staff guided us and actually stopped us from over-ordering too. The food was very very delicious!! Price is a bit on the high side, but you can taste the quality there. Reservations are required, they can be quite packed at meal times.

Author: CFEIIIAustin, Texas
Title: Great smorgasbord Lunch
Review: We stopped in for lunch here and had a pretty good meal for a great value. Fish, chicken, veal, pork, half a dozen vegetable offerings, plenty of rice and noodles. The crowd had pretty much filtered out when we got there, but you could easily see that this place is popular with both locals and tourists.

Author: HJeneGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Late tea with dimsum
Review: Had a busy afternoon and wanted something simple, stumbled onto this wee restaurant at the lower ground and what a gem it was. I was quite keen for porridge but ended up with a few mouth watering dimsum. The food was fresh and the hargao (prawn dimsum) was juicy. Pricing was reasonable too! Will come back again.

Author: WS28Penang_Malaysiq
Title: Good range of hawker fare!
Review: Come here if you are looking for a wide range of hawker food ! They serve cool beer as well. Taste is comparable to all the good ones out there in Penang, A one-stop Penang local food !

Author: judescottphotoKuching, Malaysia
Title: Slow and food average
Review: Was eager to come due to the review given. I don't mind the queue but after order is taken, it took more than one hour for the food come. Food on the other hands, were not worth waiting for. Tasted average. For me this place is over rated.

Author: elenasP6097VL
Title: No tuna no cheese
Review: Great disappointment. The tuna is out of stock and cheese too... how can this be happening to one of the most popular healthy eating franchise?

Author: Fasya83
Title: Family Staycation & Good Service!
Review: This hotel impressed me with the attention from the staff towards me and my family..special thanks to vasco's team exspecially Azu,Fauzi,fatihah & Awie for the greet service during breakfast and dinner time..thanks!

Author: Joel WKuala Lumpur
Title: Quality has drastically dropped. Terrible.
Review: i have been a member of the Hilton Premium club for 3 years now. i continued on for 2 years after my first year due to the quality of the food in Vasco. This year has been terrible. i have eaten in this restaurant 3 times this year (to utilize my free buffet dinner/lunch etc) , and the quality and quantity of the food/variety has dropped from a 5 star restaurant to a 3 star restaurant!!This "new executive chef" that was hired by Vasco? worst decision ever made - in his attempt to impress his bosses with 'cost cutting'.no more fresh oysters during dinner? sashimi options are very limited now other options are cheap dishes (stir fried vegetables etc). what happeend to the chocolate fondue? steamed fishes?

Author: EdwinC79Singapore
Title: Cost Friendly Restaurant
Review: we went to cottage spices when we could not get a table at Makko. So the next day, we went at 11am in anticipating for an early lunch. there restaurant opens at 11.30am and a queue already forms up! see picture. when the door opens, everyone tried to rush in forgoing the line that was in place, so whoever is more kaisu, will get a seat. we ordered:Ayam Buah Keluak Salty Duck SoupOtakPetai another green veg. cannot spell it in English. Ayam Buah Keluak not to our liking. the gravy is rather diluted but the part that failed u us its the Buah Keluak. The Kernel is not grind so it taste really bitter. what really good about Makko is the price. we paid RM 75 for 5 dishes! we paid more at Cottage spices for 3 dishes. Overheard walk in customers at 12 noon that the wait for a table is at least an hour. So go early.

Author: Andrew KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Home Cooked Peranakan Meals
Review: This Peranakan restaurant is popular, judging from the crowded diners when we visited it during lunch hours. Taste wise, the Nonya cuisine served is average with their typical Peranakan dishes. Meals are served hot straight from the kitchen, but I think most of it are already pre-cooked, such as the Beef Rendang, Ngoh Hiang, Sambal Lady's Fingers, Sambal Sweet Potato Leaves, Sambal Petai and spicy fried chicken. The Assam fish was freshly cooked but did not have that Nonya SEDAP and SHIOK taste. Missing from their menu is the must have Peranakan dish - the Bakwang Kepiting (pork/crabmeat/bamboo shoot) soup. You would expect Malacca which is home and origin of the famous Peranakan cuisine to serve only the best Nonya home cooked meals here...maybe most of them have migrated to Singapore already!

Author: NOR AISAH AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the money
Review: I went to their 'halal' outlet near Melaka Raya. We just wanted to try the authentic chiken rice ball but we found out that it didn't justify the hype. For RM7.00 I got 10 fish ball size rice balls (quite ok with this), a small portion of chicken (this is a ripp off) without a bowl of soup which is a normal accompaniment of chicken rice and no limit to condiments-chillies and soya sauce. I think they expect us to order other side dishes which we didn't do. I'm just curious, it is just that when I eat at any Chinese restaurant, the owner is always concern if not so much of the taste (different people have different tastebuds-can't satisfy everybody) but the portion is always enough. This one is a let down.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Usual selection of breakfast
Review:
It's not easy to be creative when you serving breakfast for the masses I suppose...

They have the usual selection of breakfast norms but this place seems to cater for the Indian food with half their selections around curries.  Curries for breakfast?

Author: Kajsa B
Title: There is a reason for the cheap price
Review: Went here with a group of friends and noon of us were happy with their food. Bur their juices are great!

Author: thackeray19
Title: visiting
Review: surprise have a restaurant in the superheros shop. interested in product and fantastic designs.try snack in restaurant

Author: 2greeneyesuk
Title: I wish I could say I liked it......
Review: Well, we went there looking forward to good food and a good night and were really disappointed with the food and I really wish we hadn't been, but it wasn't particularly great. The presentation reminds me of an American Drive through, plastic baskets and grease proof paper, which would not bother me so much if the contents had been great. The pakora was, to put it bluntly bad, shredded veg deep fried and chucked in a basket. The spicy whitebait over cooked. The lamb to share, well for two grown adults it really wasn't to share, especially if one of them was a man, it was tiny. The Seabass was probably the best of the lot and even then I was disappointed with the presentation, altogether sloppy. Best yet when we asked for beer we were told there were only two white lagers as there had been a function a day ago and they had drank everything, so obviously stock control is an issue. Then to be told that certain cocktails were off the menu due to no tequila it all starts to look a little amateurish I am afraid. We were not looking for fine dining just good food and some cold beers and it just didn't reach the mark.

Author: David GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good old Rock and Roll
Review: Prime location on Changkat Bukit Bintang. Good music, drinks and atmosphere. Sit at the front to people-watch, or head inside for more privacy.

Author: Cl T
Title: NICE PANCAKES.
Review: Quaint restaurant. Efficient staff. Fluffy and unique pancakes. Prices are quite steep though. But what bugs me though is they add ice in their root beer float which rendered the root beer tasteless.

Author: R H
Title: Beautiful food, beautiful location
Review: We were lucky enough to get a table outside by the river and could enjoy the lovely atmosphere. The menu covers all bases, and the food we ordered came promptly. Delicious and interesting menu, with great staff.

Author: Linh G
Title: Do NOT go!
Review: If I could give it zero star, I would. I have been living in Kuching for 7 months now and have tried many restaurants. Porkies is probably one of the worst in terms of food and service. We went there at a non busy time where there were only a couple tables. We waited 45 minutes for my dish to come, another 15 minutes for our appetizer, and then another 10 for my husband's. The staff members were clueless and uninterested. The food was WAY below average. I will not go there again and strongly suggest that you don't.

Author: Silent88Seremban, Malaysia
Title: My Dining Experience in The Palazzo Cafe & Restaurant
Review: New western cafe & restaurant located in between Ayer Keroh & Malacca city. Served westerner food, from salad,mushroom soup, main course, desserts and coffee. Portion of the food are small, tasted from average to good. Provide free car park. Bad experience will dining, seated next to a smoker. Air-con dining area are fully reserve. No so friendly and don't provide good professional customer service. Poor timing for starter, main course and dessert. Price from medium to upper. Overall rating 2.5/5 star!

Author: si510178
Title: Bad system and against govt rules
Review: Packed on a Sat afternoon.Do not give numbers and sit people according to who came first.Got told off :whats the hurry" when someone after me got there and was seated and I complained.Seats and tables are not kept to a distance and no checking to only allow fully vaccinated customers. Children allowed to run around unmasked.Western food wasnt great at all!

Author: YusufK363
Title: No service
Review: No staff member approached us to offer any sort of service. We stood, looked around and left!! Beacuse it is a store and cafe, the set=up seems a little disjointed.

Author: TartahoySydney, Australia
Title: Get in the queue!
Review: Joined the line and we were not disappointed. Shared a table as this place is busy. Got excited and ordered way too much food. Even though the place is busy, the service is fast and the hostess was very friendly. The fried rice is good, the plum chicken was tasty, (i had hoped to order the double roasted pork but they had run out) the mapo tofu hmmm different but I had no idea what we were ordering anyway and the star of the show was the steamed fillet fish in ginger.This place is worth a look when your in Georgetown.

Author: JOH99Melbourne, Australia
Title: Absolutely beautiful
Review: I have just returned from a 2 week holiday in Langkawi with my mother and sister. During our stay, we dined at La Sal 3 times and each time was absolutely delicious. The service was fantastic, the wait staff are so friendly and always up for a chat. We had quite a few things on the menu and were never disappointed. The steak was incredible - a highlight during our time in Langkawi! Also the ayam bakar and beef rendang are delicious. The restaurant/bar itself is beautiful, very well designed and you can't beat having your feet in the sand over dinner watching the sunset. On our last night in Langkawi we decided to eat here and the waiters were kind enough to give us a couple of free drinks and make our night fabulous. It is slightly more expensive than other eateries in Langkawi but it's worth it and La Sal is considerably better than many places we've been to in Melbourne. Anyone staying in Langkawi must eat here, highly recommend it! We couldn't fault it. If any of the La Sal staff are reading this, thank you so much and keep up the great work :)
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: johnnienutPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Time wasted, money wasted
Review: People who run this restaurant has no idea what they are doing, forgot to read the review before we visit and fooled by the 5stars sign at their entrance. Bad service and bad food is fine, happens a lot, but trying to fool their customer? Not recommend for anyone especially tourists, this place ruin Penang's reputation!

Author: paulchoo
Title: okay and so-so
Review: food took a while. i think they're undermanned. small shop, so seating is an issue. Food is alright, not super amazing. i will question the authenticity of the korean food. Nonetheless, you can give it a try to judge yourself.

Author: seannhs1024
Title: Terrible Quality Food
Review: I was having really high hopes for this restaurant after reading all the good reviews. Brought my family there for dinner, apart from the friendly service, the food was absolutely horrible. We order the 2-3 person platter with different types of meats and also 1 side of beef short rib. All of the meats were dry and tasteless!! Food were neither served hot nor warm. Tasted like few days leftover old meats. Brisket and rib were not juicy at all, chicken and lamb were dry like grass. Will not recommend this restaurant or go back again! My family was really disappointed with this meal! Not worth the huge bill we paid at all.

Author: GlobetouristHarrow, United Kingdom
Title: A Stalwart for Dim Sum in Ipoh
Review: As a Ipoh born Chinese, my tastebuds should be fairly accurate. This restaurant had been in Ipoh for ages but survived much competition, recessions etc. Generally speaking, it offers average/above average Cantonese dim sum. There is much variety, has many tables, which are often occupied in the peak times. Dim sum is OK, good sized portions. The taste is ok but not refined. Pricewise it's reasonable but cost more than traditional hawker food. For e.g. a large bowl of congee costs M$9.50.

Author: Fel1011
Title: Will not come again
Review:
Ordered 6 dishes bill add up to RM 125. 
the dishes are jus so so and very oily. 
Will not come again. 

If you are finding authentic Dim sum this is not the place for you.

Author: mejarbmx
Title: They're closed on Mondays
Review: I came to give it a try but they're closed on Mondays. Not sure if I will come back again because the place doesn't seem to be in proper hygiene. I wouldn't recommend this place for family with kids.

Author: JanVanMuldersGhent, Belgium
Title: Nice Nice nice
Review: Tried the IBA-menu (8 pieces of different sushi) and a separate order of 1 piece of seared red snapper sushi (as not included in the 8-piece menu). Although have never been to high-end sushi place, the overall experience was good and think,the price was fair for the quality offered. The menu contained some sushi,I did not try before and was pleasantly surprised...Sit at the counter and watch the chef prepare the sushi....

Author: Bacon1234Deal, United Kingdom
Title: Miss this one
Review: Just come back from here. Restaurant was dirty as was the menu. After selecting what we wanted it was rather irritating to find out all was not available. In fact on one page only one item was available. Most of what we chose was re heated in a microwave and left to form a skin. My chicken masala was mostly bone. I would advise you to move on. Plenty more tasty restaurants around even for those on a budget.

Author: lpandsmScoresby, Australia
Title: Not bad
Review: We ate here as it is across from where we were staying. Personally I would say the food is okay but not the best place around. We had curry, rice and char koay teow (excuse my spelling). While it was very cheap, the curry wasn't anything fabulous, the koay teow was average. The nicest part was the naan - which was awesome. We returned twice just to get naan. As I said above the food was okay and it's in a good location, with good prices. However when comparing to everyone's reviews - I expected more.

Author: KitTan1110
Title: Quality is dropping
Review: Recommended a friend visit kl for first time to try Mdm Kwan. But regret not going to Hutong @ Lot 10. Quality dropped, just a typical franchise restaurant. Won't recommend anymore.

Author: rowduhPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: best place to chill
Review: We went there Friday night so the place was a bit packed. Nice place to hang out and chill, they have a wide selection of drinks plus there's a duo playing showband music until 12. Good thing is you can also enjoy the music played by the resident singer on the bar across, Ringo's Antique Shop.

Author: KyleM3253Seattle, Washington
Title: Amazing view, Great service!
Review: I went with two of my best friends after a big dinner so we were only there for drinks and the view. The View was absolutely wonderful, even though the weather wasn't great, a constant light drizzle didn't keep us from staying outside for the entire time. If your a smoker, cigars or cigarettes this spot is for you, that being said if you don't the large outdoor area makes it enjoyable for all. I am a paraplegic that uses a wheelchair and thanks to the attentive and extremely helpful staff it was very accessible. The bathroom isn't HC accessible however once again the staff made it work just fine. After enjoying a couple bottles of Rose the bill was a little easier to justify ( it's not cheap) but I say worth it, especially if you have never been. I want to thank the staff again for making this a truly enjoyable experience. I would definitely come back.

Author: cl_odhnab
Title: Skip restaurant, go to observatory
Review: The most upsetting bit about this visit is that I asked 2 different members of staff if the water they gave us was bottled water, both said it was. Still skeptical I asked a 3rd member who told us that it was tap water. As a westerner I am trying to drink only bottled water and am annoys that two people wrongly told me that I was drinking bottled water. Poor service, could have been more serious if question had been about an allergen.Food is average to poor, warm rather than hot. Selection of local cuisine is ok although no description of any of the foods so it was guess work. Staff are plentiful but have bad English. Overpriced- 35 RM for one large bottle of water.We were told a time we had to get out by which was fine as we were leaving anyway but would have left without being told to.If you want a table seat it costs extra but have to book a few days in advance.Would not recommend and would not return. Instead, buy a ticket for the observatory deck and go for lunch somewhere else.

Author: ShawnWong
Title: Wedding Dinner
Review: Really disappointed with the level of service offer from this establishment. Incompetent waiter, not well train. Waiter facial expression is so gloomy....wander what is wrong with their facial expression. I believe the banquet manager should look into this.Drinks was not refill after 2-3dish is serve. Oh my god, are the manager in charge blind?

Author: PinheadplanetLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Didn't do it for me
Review: Fish fish i had wasn't very nice at all. Maybe i chose the wrong dish bit i can only review what i had. It was a fish chettinad style curry. Not good. Hate to be the first to give this place a 2 star but so be it.

Author: ivyhwiJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice variety of breakfast menu..
Review: A friend bought some voucher from groupon, so was there for a late lunch plus some drinks, can't remember the actual name of the dish, 1 of it was chicken the other 1 is seafood and couple of beers. Presentation of the food is nice but taste so so.. Wanted to try the lamb but was not available.. :(There's a nice private room if you have a big group.

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: The food is just so-so
Review: The place has a nice and happening location at a corner of Jonker Street. Looks quite cosy and inviting, especially with the Christmas trees up and music playing. Been there several times; it's OK for drinks and as a meeting place but the food is pretty average.

Author: Barun CStamford, Connecticut
Title: Excellent crepes
Review: This place is run by a very nice young French couple, and you can see them making the crepes from scratch after you order them. It is pretty small: a couple of indoor tables and about 3-4 tables outside. The savory crepes were wonderful, as were the dessert crepes and the ice cream was also nice. The cost was very reasonable. Highly recommended.

Author: stephanie9292Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice place but food so so
Review: Disappointed with food supplies and limited choice Price expensive but service is good cos the staff will show their concern and take medicine when I fall down
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: jokl78
Title: Fast and efficient
Review: Came here for lunch with family members on Sunday at 11am. Ordered plenty of food for 2 tables. Portions are reasonable and flavourful. Famous for their char siu. Give it a try.

Author: anon9116Spain
Title: Special occasion
Review: Went for a special occAsion - we were the only 2 people at the Sunday Brunch !! Not at all atmospheric Staff very good, food average I have spent many Sunday’s (10 years ago) st Prego Sunday brunch - where it was busy, fun, atmospheric, bbq, cocktails, loads of tasters - pasta, pizza, beef, chicken, fish .........and it used to have amazing desserts, choc fountain. ...... Today I was very very disappointed and to be honest - Why ? Have a Sunday brunch with no people ??? Felt it was such a waste of food (buffet) And we felt uncomfortable Can not fault the staff The ambience was ‘0’. The air con was freezing v

Author: teatime361Epsom, United Kingdom
Title: rubbish ribs!!!!
Review: Just back from meal and must say the worst one we have ever had! Have been to numerous hard rock cafes and always enjoyed but this was not good, my partner had lamb ribs and they were nearly all fat and my pulled lamb was not very warm. We did complain and after speaking to manager were not charged for the ribs but it spoilt our evening and would not return!

Author: Kelvin T
Title: Great Food with PATHETIC SERVICE
Review: TAMARA's is not my first visit. I cannot agree more on the food taste and quality which has always welcome it's guest. But I strongly feel TAMARA's should work on their level of service.1. Today during lunch I and my pregnant wife were sitting almost 20mins having our food w/o any drinks. I then finally had to walk to the drinks section to ask and grab my own drink.2. They dont allow you to pick your desired portion. Hello come on, charge me extra for the food I dont mind but restricting me from having my desired portion is RUDE!3. The aunty that serve you the food has got NO sense of hospitality at ALL! It's that 1 aunty that always serves you food in TAMARA's and her face always makes you feel uncomfortable as though she is paying for your food. This point is something I strongly feel TAMARA's mgmt should work onto to get it fixed. A little smile on face while serving your customer do brings joy and prosperity. PS: The aunty picture as attached.I hope the concern can be addressed. Thanks

Author: ZivasbinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Watch your belongings
Review: On a Sunday noon we went there for lunch. We were early so there was no other customers at the restaurant. My sister left her bag next to the wall on the ground just under her chair. When we finished our lunch she took her camera from her bag and put it back on the ground. At the same time three of the staff came to take order for tea! Once they left, the bag was gone! They simply took the bag. We spent the rest of the day at the police station and with KLCC security but the management of the restaurant refused to cooperate and show the CCTV records! If you go there CHAIN YOUR BELONGINGS TO YOU! such a terrible place!

Author: 253hussamt
Title: Great experience
Review: Went there with my wife while on our honeymoon vacation due to the good reviews I've been seeing trip advisor. The experience is one that everyone in Kuala Lumpur should try. You get to taste a wide variety of food and try to guess what it is while being seating in pitch darkness. Your waiter is a visually impaired local who guides you to your seat and serves you your food and drinks. This place is highly recommended and costs around $ 60 per couple.

Author: Geoff Ythailand
Title: Food Great, Music Overpowering
Review: Food was up to expectation from a Nobu restaurant. The view across to the Petronas Towers was spectacular at night.All ruined by music that was totally out of sync and destroyed the ambience. It was far too loud and even when I finally managed to turn it down they turned it up again a few minutes later, Who wants to eat great food with a bass cutting through you.Shame Nobu

Author: HannahLouis95
Title: Excellent food, Excellent service!
Review:
Excellent food, excellent coffee!!
SOP rules are being met constantly and staff are very vigilant. Standard is not compromised here! Julia is a bubbly, courteous and attentive staff member who made sure our food and order was correct and of good quality!

Author: noorathirahb
Title: The best pizza👍
Review: It is the best pizza ever. It also halal for muslim to eat. You'll never regret after tasted it. It really delicious and I'm sure you will repeat it.

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Overrated
Review:
The satay was average. Meat really dry! 
The sauce was just ordinary!

Not worth the time to queue up!

Author: 623wilhelmeLudwigsburg, Germany
Title: awesome experience
Review: We were there on a Saturday evening and the reservation was mad a few hours earlier only.It was a really great evening and an awesome experience.The first half an hour I always tried to see something but it's really that dark that you can hear and feel only. ;-)Our host/waiter was great and good guide through the whole event.Starter, soup, main course and dessert were the dishes - all of them were really tasty.But, i've you are (really) hungry - you won't get full there.Anyway, once menu is changed we'll come back and will try again :-)

Author: SohyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard dropped drastically
Review: Came here because it was near to Encore Melaka and also because of previous good experience at their old premise. However we were quite disappointed with the quality of food. We went to different restaurants and always order a Melaka laksa to try. Nancy’s laksa has to be the worse, rather tasteless and not rich like others. The other dishes were also not impressive. It is definitely not worth the wait if we didn’t pre book a table. Service wise, they were not very good either. Partly because of crowd and not enough staff. So I won’t be going to Nancy’s Kitchen. Just go to nearby Donald and Lily.

Author: Bryan1994Melbourne, Australia
Title: great place for a first date and even the 100th
Review: it is very easy to get lost in the idea of the restaurant and though for many the idea of the restaurant is interesting but it is the friendliness of the staff and the flavours of the restaurant that make help make this restaurant exceptional as they are able to mix gourmet and fun together. However ,that being said they still aim to be gourmet and thus you cant expect huge portions of food and wont leave stuffed but do not worry you shall not leave hungry. Overall it's a great place to go with friends or a special day with a love one :)

Author: Mukhlis S
Title: Quite good
Review: Good:asam pedas good, ayam bakar superb, ikan bakar very good, lots of choices for ulam, friendly staffBad:Kari so-soSambal belacan, air asam n all sorts of sambal need to be improve.Overall: Good. If the owner make the sambals properly, I will rate it as superb.

Author: Victor DNorthants
Title: Mediocre in a country of great food
Review: I ordered their spicy chicken curry, no spice, bland and tough compounded by being served look warm. The mutton biryani was ok ish but the meat and rice had not been clocked together, also not hot.The roti was nice and the veg curry was ok. I doubt we will give it a second chance.

Author: kloon8
Title: Cendol
Review: Tasteless. The sugar syrup inside the cendol has no gula Melaka flavor. The cendol is pale green which is different from normal green color. No taste of normal cendol. I would not recommend it.

Author: TesvanweelieVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ate there a few times, and every time it was delicious. Not cheap but a good value, tasty and a wide range of dishes. You can sit in or outside. Inside is non smoking. You can also take a way. Close to te LRT station, opposite of KFC. Can recommend!

Author: sgstarkShetland
Title: Food OK but the bottled water poor
Review: Looked for a quick meal after checking in to our hotel and selected Kwan's as it was really busy and had a good buzz about it. We had to wait a few minutes as we did not have a reservation which was fine. Ordered our food and drinks, however the bottled mineral water which has Madam Kwan's picture on the bottle was so heavily chlorinated it was undrinkable. I ended up wondering if they had simply filled the bottles from the tap as the level of chlorine was similar. The saving grace was the food good value and tasty, service was also fine.

Author: Abu Bakar MShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: I guess being a Malaccan, this restaurant doesnt really interest me at all and this review would probably be a little biased. Truth be told, there are far better places to eat than this place, just that it operates till the wee hours of the night. I have yet to recommend any of my friends or family to have a meal here.

Author: firahjayySingapore
Title: Poor Choice of Restaurant
Review: We went last weekend on a Saturday, around 7pm. We came earlier so as to avoid the crowd. We just wanted to have a nice, quiet dinner with a lovely view. Unfortunately, one of our main dish did not turn out right. It is probably the worst Steak I've ever tried. It's tough and chewy that we had to send it back to the kitchen and ask the chef to rectify it. The chef just had to cook it again and guess what, it's worst than before. FYI, the steak costs us 48RM. Yes, 48RM gone down the drain. The other dish we ordered was an Arabic Rice with Chicken. This dish turned out just fine. No complaints at all! This dish comes in a set. So technically, we would be served with ice-cream but we were too mad, so we just left without having our desserts.While making payment, the staff informed us that their full time Chef is on leave, hence they get another person to do it, which explains why the Steak turns out tough and chewy. Honestly, if they had told us earlier, I would not have ordered the Steak and would not be disappointed at all. The least they could do is to offer us another dish when we returned the Steak back to the kitchen. I guess they don't practice any form of service recovery here. If you prefer a nice view with poor dishes, then this would be the place for you. And no, I am not returning here again. The money spent here could have been spent elsewhere that serve better food. Do not waste your time, really.

Author: KLOysterManMalaysia
Title: Gone down hill
Review: After 2 suoerb previous visits, I thought I was onto a winner. Entree's started off ok and the wheels fell off from there. Grilled salmon was woeful, beef ribs averageand lamb chops decent but hardly presented well with the weak side dish salad. Creme brule was a comical effort of slush which was sent back.Our waitress, an Indian girl, was very good and attentive however, so well played to her.Unfortunately, unlikely to return.

Author: BenT988
Title: great nynoya food
Review: extremely good nyonya food in this place - deep fried eggplant, curry fish fillet, cencaluk seafood, salted egg chicken are just among their top signature dishes. very friendly customer service and reasonable price as well. highly recommended

Author: n70khalid
Title: Dont miss Roti Canai here
Review: Street foods always good... we never miss our breakfast and supper here for Roti Canai. If you miss Penang's food, here is one of the best in Borneo

Author: KhairosShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Food was cheap and delicious
Review: Had a great time at the restaurant. Staff were very friendly and helpful in helping us to decide what to eat. We came 5 in a family but since some of us had a light snack before dinner, they suggested that we take a menu for two. They suggested just to add some drinks. Very happy as the food was just enough.

Author: leelarv95Selangor, Malaysia
Title: WORST SERIVICE
Review: Went here twice with my friends 1 year ago, but we went for lunch and the service was excellent eventhough peak hours BUT TODAY came here for evening tea, worst service ever experienced in restaurant. Be it the waiter , or the server didn't bothered us at all. Waiting there like 5 to 10 mins just for someone to come and ask us what we would like to have .. That's even fine BUT ME AND MY AUNT pissed off when people after us got served . Omg . And we just walked out of restaurant.

Author: Hammie2015
Title: Good and cheap
Review: This place was recommended by a friend.   Had dinner there after spending an afternoon walking around Armenian Street. Delicious Chinese zhi char place with fresh seafood . Expect to wait if you do not make prior reservations.

Author: Najatusyima S
Title: Dissapointed with Stiff and salty pasta
Review: -Nice and friendly staff.-Drinks was superb. Asam boi soda with serai ★★★★-My fiancee cant swallow thier salted egg pasta.-It is too salty! Its like someone pour a bottle of salt in it.(alert that the ingredients is salted egg.but please taste the food first before launching your new menu to a cust)-they used angel hair pasta for thier menu,and the pasta was extremly hard to bite and once i cant swallow it too.maybe they want to be fast,and not boiled the pasta properly. So we only have a drink there and left our plate as same as they serve it to us. Sorry but wont coming there again for foods.

Author: Jeremy5858London, United Kingdom
Title: Extremely disappointing and unbelievably expensive for very bland food
Review: Having visited Malaysia twice yearly for more than 25 years, I believe that I know something about Malaysian food. The food here is so BLAND! The Popiah (i.e. spring rolls) were wet and not crispy at all. The Pedigels were too big and had far too much flour and almost tasteless. For the main course, we had Rendang Tok and Ayam masak merah with a vegetable dish (consisting of runner beans and five or six prawns) plus two large bowls of steamed rice. The much-too-dark Rendang Tok (basically caramelised beef) was quite sweet, but we could not taste the beef which contained lots of fat. The Ayam (chicken) dish was very boring. We asked for some sambal as an extra to "spice" up our food. The non-spicy sambal might have come straight from a tomato ketchup bottle! We did not bother having desserts. I would have rated this restaurant three stars, but when the bill arrived, I was shocked! Two hundred ringgits for dinner (and no alcohol)?!?! This place just about merits two stars as the restaurant had a charming decor. One more thing, some of the waiters do not even speak Malay! Really embarrassing coming here and I will not recommend this to anyone. It was a huge disappointment for me and my Malaysian wife. In fact, I would recommend people to stay away from here and eat Madame Kwan if they want authentic Malaysian food.

Author: paulynyyy
Title: Breakfast spread was good but put off by the service
Review: We had breakfast buffet here as part of our package stay. The crowd wasn't too big around 7am and it was easy for us to walk around. Lots of choices from local delicacies such as noodle soup, nasi lemak, congee to international including sausage, eggs,...More

Author: NantucketJoeNantucket, Massachusetts
Title: Food good. Service pitiful
Review: Sometimes it’s tough traveling alone and getting good service. Bijan is a case in point. I was dining alone - sent here by my hotel’s concierge. The Malaysian cuisine was wonderful. The restaurant is casually beautiful. The service, however, especially for a single traveler, left much to be desired. I waited quite a while to receive a menu. And then - nothing for 20 minutes. I finally flagged down a waiter and figured I better submit my entire order since I didn’t know when I’d see him again. And then, nothing. I finally flagged down another waiter and asked when I could expect my cocktail. And so the evening continued. I didn’t receive anything - drinks or food - without getting a waiters attention and begging for it. The waitstaff was much more concerned about serving the groups in the restaurant. I finally just got up, paid at the counter, and left. Wouldn’t go back.

Author: Monica GDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Poor service
Review: I think what makes a nice dining experience in a restaurant relies heavily on the service, and that was lacking at the Zipangu. Our order for beverages was completely ignored, there never seemed to be a waiter when we needed one, and the waitress was less than helpful with the menu. It almost felt like she didn't want us to order whatever it was that we pointed to her.The food was not bad. My husband was disappointed that there were no bento boxes on the menu.But the poor service made it a less than enjoyable experience.

Author: LarryKLBangkok, Thailand
Title: Lost it
Review: We have been coming here with our close friends for years. Actually have reviewed them twice before. Always reasonably consistent food and well taken care of by their team who all know us. But last weekend there was a definite change to the food. First of all the traditional roast garlic with home made bread which you receive upon ordering food had been changed to a tomato dip. Shameless. The oversized meat platter we asked for (5 of us) was an insult to any table more than 2 guests. Each cold cut slice was stretched to the max on the platter trying to make it look full. Massive failure. Normally these platters are plentiful and we move on to mains. This time it was so skimpy we ordered 2 portions of calamari to keep us going. They arrived burnt and dry. Not worth eating as hungry as we were.Not sure what's happening in the kitchen or with the management but I hope bells are ringing cause we like this place. Still the service is friendly and good so get back on track is what I say....

Author: Emily C
Title: Very average
Review:
Sashimi selection was  disappointing, but decent quality. Service was good since we were one out of the 2 tables there for dinner. 
Dessert was sub standard - there was nothing edible except for fruits

Author: Nadin Y
Title: Dinner
Review:
Food such as friend rice, friend noodles were not freshly cooked as they were merely reheated. Very oily noodles and no-one  bothered to ask why we didn't finish all the food we ordered. 
I don't recommend this place

Author: papo22Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Below par Malaysian classic food
Review: I have been to this restaurant a couple of times, whenever I'm back from aboard. My friends tends treat me as foreigner and invite me to this place. Seriously, the quality has gone from get-by-with-foreigner to below-par-foreigner. If I wanted such things I should not travel 9430 KM.

Author: Steven M
Title: Poor Supervision
Review: Went for dinner with my family at 8 PM on Thursday 28 September 17. Waiters passing up and down but we had to call to order food. People around us started receiving food except us. We asked for our drinks only to find out our orders were not keyed into the system. Supervisor Ariff did not even bother to apologize. Sad :( Waiters were friendly and food good though but poor supervision ruin it . No more visits from us and friends

Author: Tanya1184Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but they charge for water!
Review: I had dinner at La Risata on Saturday night with my husband and 2 friends. I had the squid ink pasta which was very nice. The steak and the seafood platter was also good and big enough to share. The air conditioning was not working on that day so it was quite warm inside. My only other problem with this place is that they charge for water. Tap water is not available. If you want water, you have to buy bottled water (in a plastic bottle). Not only is it bad for the environment, I am also against paying for water in an establishment like this where filtered water should be readily available. If it isn’t readily available, I wonder what the restaurant’s hygiene conditions are like. For this reason, I would ask you to think twice before visiting.

Author: jenbatesPerth, Australia
Title: Went here by default
Review: I hadn't intended to visit this restaurant but was in a taxi and didn't want to stop at an eatery that had been recommended but just looked like another food hall to me. So off to James Brooke. I had the fish curry which was delicious and a very generous portion. Ambience was lovely- view, nice music but service non- existent.

Author: Joanna_CFKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food with bad service
Review: Food was very Malaysian and since it’s a chain of restaurant, all food are ok in terms of taste. Service wise is bad, don’t expect anything good as even there are tables, it will take you ages to be seated. On the contrary, other branches are way better

Author: BoonchuanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good seafood but costly
Review: The restaurant environment is huge and full of glass aquariums containing all the life creatures which will be served as seafood. The food portion served is small but the taste is great. The service is good and they have both open air and air-conditioned room. Their recommended dish are their salted egg mantis prawn with shell. Their prawn and steamed fish dishes were great as the prawn and fish is fresh. Would recommend if you have deep pocket.

Author: Jay552013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible
Review: Saravanbhavan WAS a place to go for a reasonably priced South Indian vegetarian meal. Unfortunately, not anymore. I was there this morning and ordered a few simple items from the menu to take-away. While I waited, my son ordered a lime juice. After two reminders, it took them 15 minutes to serve the lime juice, and 45 minutes for the take-away! The lime juice was terrible and the service was appalling! The Manager was indifferent, the cashier blamed the waiter for the delay and the waiter had a verbal slanging match with the cashier when confronted! This outlet is doing serious damage to the Saravabhavan brand, renowned for good service and quality food.Unless you're a glutton for punishment and indulge poor service, don't patronise this joint!

Author: Linda DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good, BUT...
Review: This is a bit hidden from the main road, and to look at it from the outside, it doesn't look like much. BUT, when you enter, the ambiance is really nice/ BUT, that's where it ends!The menu is divided into 3 plate sizes, ( a 1st for me), BUT the portions are NOT very generous at all!And, although the food is tasty (with the EXCEPTION of their foccacia bread) it is in MY opinion OVER PRICED for what you get.Their drink menu is very large, and HOUSE SPECIALTY DRINK is INCREDIBLY delicious! Drink prices are about the same as any other restaurant around.

Author: WotneyKl
Title: Parisian Prices ....
Review: Great location and, as our guest noted, better than the usual villa-conversion vibe.Three of us dined here, for dinner, to bid one of our three fond farewell.Expensive, especially the wine list (French wines only), here's the bill:1 x Beef Tenderloin RM 1181 x G&T (Bombay Sapphire) RM 2412 x Fin du Claire Oysters RM 2061 x Seared Seabass RM 881 x Seared Veal Tenderloin RM 1192 x Glasses Taittinger Brut Reserve RM 166 (a third which hadn't been ordered/served was removed from the bill)1 x Bottle Chateau Combel Le Serre (Cahors, France, Malbec) RM 2252 x glasses of house-white served with the oysters not charged (see below)Sub-total RM 946 + 16% Service Charge & Tax = RM 1097.36Bargain of the evening was the G&T.Amuse Bouche of Asparagus & Caviar - excellentOysters - excellent (some extras added by the chef as they were on the small-side)Meat - good albeit rather small portions and the ordered mashed potatoes didn't eventuateFish - wife says wasn't fresh and didn't arrive with the other meat mainsWine - excellent (the selected red wine was chosen from the lower-end of the extensive/expensive offerings)Champagne (assuming 5 glasses to the bottle) - expensive (bottle of Bollinger at Hyatt 38 = RM 285)As our guest diner said, "there's a fine-line between attentive and pushy waiting staff", staff here were pushy - no tip as the service charge was considered more than enough.

Author: NafLiverpool
Title: Breakfast
Review: Lovely small authentic  nyonya food. I love the cendol,very generous and the laksa was also very good. Mind you this place is just a warong or hawker style eatery but worth visiting if you are in the area.They are close every Tuesday & Wednesday.

Author: WinnieL1387
Title: Just for tea time
Review:
Not very advise to come on weekend or public holiday
wait for two hours, order 40 pcs satay come 30 pcs, ask for the Balance 10 pcs then ask me wait until serve other customer.
Manpower no enough...

Author: tche t
Title: Lunch
Review: decor is okay but the service personnel are not so attentive !. Battered Sea Bass fish dish is rather dry...and the chips served is rather small and over fried.. Not so tasty..rather over fried and hard too much corn floor overcooked

Author: esther tammy DSingapore, Singapore
Title: No meaning behind its luxury Name
Review: Its my first visit, after the opening of Pampas. Live in Melaka, but due to work constraints I never had the opportunity to visit the talk of the town! Anyway, on the 26th of April I decided to give a shot calling the steakhouse for general enquiries. Its Wednesday, it Ladies night, so hey! lets get more information about that. A guy picked up my call (number reflected on Facebook page) to my surprise It was the beginning of my terrible experience. I asked how do we go about ladies night, Eg: Any rules? Any cover charge? The response I got did not give me a fine dining feel kinda service. The guy gave me a very brief detail "you can only have 1 choice of cocktail the whole night" thats fine. So I asked if we can order food? To my surprise the answer I got "Oh sorry ma'am for food there is no free flow of food" Hmmm so did this guy actually listen or ask me about what I meant? Anyway, I wont explain further. Me and my friends arrived at the lift lobby, there were only 1 fire lift to the 41st floor & it took us about 30mins waiting time (FYI) Upon arrival, we were guided to the indoor and outdoor seating. The place was literally empty probably 2-3 guest chillin around with the music sounded as if there were a large crowd! So we were seated, waiter presented the menus and nothing mentioned about ladies night. But I thought that's fine. So I asked: is there ladies night? Waiter: ermm after 9pm ma'am.Me: its 9:15pm now? Waiter: oh! Yes it just started. Me: how do I go about? Waiter: you can go to the bar. Me: what can I order? Waiter: you can check with them ma'am.Now the frustration comes in.I walked to the bar, asked for the cocktail they serving, and it was (Juliet). So I said can I have 3? (Obviously its for me, and my 2 other girl friends) Bartenders nodded and I walked back. Suddenly the waiter approached me saying:"Ma'am for ladies night you need to collect yourself and it will not be served to you" Me: oh well, What's next? I walked to the bar and a supervisor comes up to ask "whats the actual problem ma'am? You can tell me so I can see how to improve the service" Gosh! Is this how a supervisor speaks? After much hoo- haa, I took my 3x cocktails for the ladies night and I gave up asking anything. We ended up ordering hot lattes for the night.Our steaks were okay, not the best as it seems.Lamb: too much fat. It came with no mint sauce. Chicken: meat too tough. Overall we enjoyed the ambiance with the view, chats and laughter since our last reunion. Didn't refill the "ladies night cocktail" too much hassle. I wish the management take this feedback seriously otherwise it brings no meaning behind the purpose of its name & sky dining. Don't forget there were no napkins too! 1 glass of iced water is RM5? This is hilarious when I come from a Luxury property our guest gets complimentary bottled water as many as they want! Pampas / The Shore management its time to relook?

Author: pozygKl
Title: Best xiao long thong pau
Review: Really the best xiao long thong pau (shanghainese steamed bun with soup inside it) you can find in kl. Much much better than others. Super soft n thin skin and succulent fillings. Sometimes they do it with truffles or hairy crab if its in season. Also one of the best places to go for hairy crab during its season. Other really good dishes: dry spring onion noodles (we normally order more so we can takeaway and eat the next day as well), drunken chicken, deepfried eel, cold dish with eggplants, if you're willing to splurge: deep fried fish. Forgot the name but its erm a huge thin fish. Other dumpling soup there are really good as well. Very friendly waitresses. Our go-to restaurant for the past 8-10yrs. During chinese bew year they have shanghainese nian gao dessert and chrysanthemum pudding. The nian gao soup is really good. I think they have something special during full moon season (around sept-october normally). Prices though are... Quite.pricey. But what you get is really high quality food.

Author: Za Z
Title: nope
Review: I understand that we have our own preferences and all this while I congratulate myself for not being too fussy over foods, but this one...haaiiizz..For sure this is not the best chicken chop in town.And all the other menu is not worth the money.

Author: Kawaii1804
Title: Out of expectation
Review: Honestly speaking the concept is something new but it somehow not very interesting. The food itself doesn't taste what was expected, overall its just an over rated event.

Title: Best vodka, lime & sodas
Review: Nice and strong is how they are served up.....making one drink plenty! Also enjoyed two meals here. Prefect spot to cool down and watch the waterfront and learn about the history of James Brooke

Author: Jervenne
Title: No more next time ! Disappointed
Review: I came to this Lavish bakery & cafe with my NZ friend and a pregnant lady . We asked for tissue but the staff ( name in the receipt) replied “the tissue is at the counter”. We kinda shocked and after that she went to take some for us. Then when she came back to us with the tissue, she said if not enough , you may get it from the counter. We were very disappointed with the answer given by the staff. In F&B line this shouldn’t happen. Service are important!

Author: travelhoneybeeKL
Title: Malaysian Chinese food in town
Review: Malaysian Chinese food restaurant nearby KLCC. Outside parking available, FOC. Nice place for gathering. Used to have KLCC view but recent years, due to many high rise buildings constructed, KLCC can only be seen partly. Recommend outdoor seating. Well known in charcoal-fire-steamboat but other dishes are also delicious.

Author: Sausalito O
Title: Wonderful Hi-Tea
Review:
Nice place for gathering with friends and pamper ourself with Hi-tea set in this cozy environment...
Highly recommend the salmon potato pancakes.
The staff service is good!

Author: linamn1579Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious halal Dim Sum lunch
Review: Maju palace offers a wide spread of delicious halal dim sum. Their service are good and the portion of their food are quite I have to say, generous. Also, their price are reasonable. Please make reservation before you come. They do have regular lunch crowd. Especially on Fridays.

Author: 356sergejs
Title: Disappointment
Review: I had great expectation of this place. Food was ok, but nothimg special. Staff was making an impression that they would be very happy if we would leave asap. Location is nothing to speak about.

Author: bluecurrantsingapore
Title: Mixed feelings about this. I had high hopes.
Review: After years of hearing raving reviews about the Malacca branch, it looked like a birthday celebration at HR was in order. Made reservations ahead of the day for my dad's birthday.Our hostess showed us to our table swiftly. We were given menus but were left alone for the next 15 minutes. We had to flag down a bustling waiter but was told he wasn't our server and that he'd get him for us. 5 minutes later, the same waiter came back saying our server was busy so he'd just take the orders from us. How are servers assigned tables when they can't manage the crowd size? Anyway, we placed our orders, most of us had burgers. SOOOOO excited!Artichoke dip was pleasant, don't remember what else we ordered but since we all got burgers, I'll talk about the burgers. So, on the menu, and based on the price, they marketed it as great quality meat right? But when I ordered a medium rare, they advised against it. Whatever, medium well it is. The burger was not real meat, i don't know what it was but its texture was off. Tender, sure but it did not bite off or chew like quality ground meat. Perhaps there was filler in the meat and lots of it. 3 of us couldn't finish our burgers, not that they were big, but they just didn't seem right. For the love of god, stay away from the burgers. Get something else... like the fajitas that every table seemed to be getting! It's a guarantee you'd walk out of the place smelling like food with all that good ol fajita scent wafting from every table. The ambience was almost there. Great lighting and deco. They need to turn up the AC though. And the music, I think it was 90's boybands night. No where close to any rock music. So weird, I laughed at every song selection. Will I go again? Maybe. But only if I really, really have to. Think this branch can really step it up.

Author: renemure
Title: Classy Ambience with Average Food.
Review: Top notch decor and classy ambience with warm caring service.  A great place for a romantic hangout. We had soup of the day, softshell crab pasta, mee hoon rendang chicken and seafood pizza. Soup of the day taste like can soup. The curry paste sauce at the pasta, slightly unmatched and too salty. Pizza dough was a bit too hard and dry.The food was just average and overrated. Price slightly on the high side.

Author: neiltnguyenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing experience
Review: The restaurant is modern and interior design tasteful. However we were given a table for four people when we booked only for 2. Given this was our anniversary celebration, we were expecting something more intimate so being placed on such a large joint table was very awkward. We requested to change to seating near the windows however were told it was all booked (even though there were empty tables). At no point in the night did the manager come to check if everything was to our satisfaction. The festive seasonal menu was average with many dishes being prepared using expensive ingredients thrown together in the hope that it would work (Caviar, lobster jelly, crab meat???). Overall, a disappointing experience given the hype.

Author: rodnd
Title: Charge is over and not that standard .
Review:
After research of the market, this restaurant is charge customer at least 15-25% higher.

The food is not that great ,I still recommend the Unique Seafood.

Author: 826JohnJ826
Title: Good restaurant and bar - good atmosphere
Review: Visited this place in January 2019, a very nice place, good food and drinks at reasonable prices, good service and a relaxed atmosphere

Author: Raymond K
Title: Caution here
Review: Booked, selected and ordered crabs and specials at this restaurant early. Thot that was the proper thing to do. Arrived 10 minutes before booking time. First the fried rice tasted funny, found out they used vegetarian char siew. Then the salted egg crab arrived. Waited and waited for my other baked crabs. Finally after getting annoyed, and asked them, was told my selected earlier crabs went to another table. Can anyone believe that story? They subsituted with two more crabs. By the way they also forgot about my cheese prawn noodles. Goodbye to that.First and last visit.Just be careful if you visit.

Author: jda100160Kongens Lyngby, Denmark
Title: Work on the basics
Review: In a nice hotel like the Danna, you expect a very good breakfast. This is not the case. Table serving needs improvement: forget orders, deliver when reminded (but even if it meanwhile got cold), mix up tables. Also the buffet itself is a disappointment ... bread selection and cold cuts ... fruit is OK (but not more)As the Danna and the team in general is very good, please attend to this - the guests and Danna deserves this.

Author: SunSunSunshine
Title: Excellent restaurant
Review: Really excellent place. It has rather large portions! The prices are quite reasonable and it serves alcohol.

Author: 9Davo9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced
Review: I would first like to point out the friendliness of the staff who tried to make our evening as pleasant as possible. The surroundings of this restaurant are also very beautiful and calmBut...The food was a major let down, living and travelling in Asia for so long you get to know what the differences in food taste like. Here the mains were very bland in terms of flavor and spice, very disappointing When coupled with the high price the bland food made it extraordinary bad. General service from the staff was sub standard, I put this down to a lack of training.

Author: SuzanneTi
Title: Bad services
Review: Every time went for this Nando's the services still same - "slow". I'm just wondering whether the management review their service to the customer? Every time went for the lunch still have to wait for the food up to 30 minits after ordering the food.

Author: Raiinlolling
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Brought my girlfriends here for birthday celebration. Awesome food and excellent service! Highly recommended!!

Author: dandav1956
Title: A nice quiet bar
Review:
Can hear each other without  shouting and some good snacks with ok drink prices 

Not quite a Mexican canteena ...

Author: Neel G
Title: yummy
Review: great food, not tooo expensive, and good veggie options, i suggest going here first before looking around, great staff too :)

Author: MealTimeAt
Title: Another wonderful visit!
Review: Thank you Christina, my amazing waitress, for the excellent service today and making up for another waiter’s rather lousy table service. My family and I look forward to the fresh and yummy food at Kampachi as much as we do the excellent service from most of its staff including Jenny Ong. I look forward to my next visit and will make a point to ask to be seated in Christina’s section.

Author: Bernicepang99
Title: Great Experience
Review: The service was very nice, our server April was extremely welcoming and attentive. The food was quite okay, albeit oily.

Author: AnnAnn428Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: No chance to taste the food...
Review: It was a public holiday, and I expected the cafe to be full. This is totally understandable, but the waiting time was rather enraging. First, there was a 10 minute wait for a table--which was quite tight for my family and I (there was 3 of us). After placing our order, the drinks took approximately 30 minutes to arrive and the food never came. We asked the waitress for the time we placed our order, it was 47 minutes ago. So, we waited a total of 57 minutes. We decided to leave, and the cafe was nice enough to tell us the coffee was on the house.

Author: CanduPopKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Service and Not Flexible
Review: Poor service received from their Director of ABC. We are enquiry for a group of set lunch package with drinks. But, they quoted us coffee & tea on separate charges and they can't even extend coffee & tea on complimentary basis for a social event. It's not flexible price range for commercial business, maybe this Cafe is more suitable for individual dinning base on fixed ala carte menu price.Besides, they lack of follow-up where client/guest have to chased them on the update. Deposit was paid in 3 days advance before the event day as requested by them to pre-purchase the ingredients. Sadly, they called on the event day morning itself to informed that the dessert ingredients was not able to purchase, due to sold out in market. Was wondering what's the purpose to paid deposit in advance?! During dinning at Cafe, kitchen preparation was slow, it took 30 mins to prepare main course dishes. Personally, not recommended this Cafe for group social gathering more than 5 persons. However, the waitress service are average. (Not sure is it because we had did few complaints during the pre-arrangement.)
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: baldeva531Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mouth watering coconut candy........... simply delicious
Review: During my daughter 's wedding her in-laws gave me a box of coconut candy. I must say I was very impressed with the packaging and when I opened the box I saw pretty pink cubes of coconut candies beautifully packed. I took a bit and I was blown off . It tasted soooo good. The sugar content was just right and coconut was light and fluffy and it simply melted in my mouth. My outmost compliments to the chef .Kudos for producing such a wonderful tasty coconut candy.

Author: darren_tancsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food and good wine
Review: Having stayed in Doubletree for a few nights almost on a monthly basis, i always try to have at least dinner here at least once every trip as food and wine are both good. Not many good western restaurants around, and some does not serve wine (e.g. Kenny Rogers in City Square). Wine list does not need to be long as long as wine is good. If not in a hurry, there AU Short rib or lamb is a must try, paired with Banfi (Brunello). Service is excellent, and they are not stingy on bread, great alfresco sitting area beside pool and great view, or in doors with big TV screen to watch soccer!
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Hotelieronbreak
Title: Art of hospitality
Review: Thank you Paya Serai team (Andy, Linda, shaz, Irma, mel, ayu, Kalapana,mus, maylan, tze and asmah. for kind hospitality. Me and family really enjoy the food and the efficient service. My feedback about the nasi lemak handled by chef Rahmat personally make me feel special. The night manager marvin go beyond his way to ensure I can drive out from parking smoothly.

Author: BlazerTravelsSalt Lake City, Utah
Title: They need to step it up...
