Review: This place surprised me... located on the top level of the famous KLCC mall (at the base of the world famous Petronas twin towers) this restaurant is in a terrific location. I thought I was in for a scrumptious Vietnamese meal after an evening walking the busy streets of KL. In the end I was disappointed.This place needs to step it up and invest... the seats and even the menu's were run down and torn. It felt like this place should be in a suburban strip mall instead of (what is) one of the shinier malls in all of SE Asia. OK... all is forgiven if the food is good... right? Unfortunately my Pho was really bland... the noodles had a cheap texture and the broth really wasn't that tasty.I was also disappointed that they have a minumum purchase amount if you intend to pay by credit card.One note on the positive side... the service was pretty good and the staff was friendly. This place just needs some investment... it should be a nicer place.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Sayeedac1Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Quite an average restaurant
Review: It had veg and non-veg fare on the menu. Three of us went there for lunch & had a mix of both. The food was okay & we relished having them. I had chicken paneer which was quite good. Service was so-so, could be better. Reasonable price. Not much of an ambience.

Author: MohdIdzwanZ
Title: Over priced and poor service
Review: Knowing that it was located at a touristy area in Bukit Bintang probably resulted in the price hike. We arrived at 2.30pm and the staff were already in slow mo. Half a chicken cost about RM35 and the chicken was rather dry. The unexpected price was the bean sprout fried with salted fish, RM20. I think it was rather too exuberant for a mere chicken rice restaurant. I hope they will consider to revise their price.

Author: Snugbugs
Title: Aglios
Review:
I can only comment on the aglio Olio I had which was quite dry. 
Lil garlic, too lil oil and almost no chilli flakes..theres room for improvement here

Author: Steph-189Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy BKT; and here's the reason why...
Review: MSG!!!!! Having said that, one of the better BKT in Petaling Jaya.The three of us ordered a mixed claypot, and the soup was refilled a couple of times generously. The soup was hearty, but I would hv prefered it to be more herby; just sayin'.We enjoyed the tender cuts of meat, properly cooked innards and soft tau foo pok. Mushrooms were also a good addition, but I would ask them to exclude the choy sum during my next visit. If you're likely to have a guilt trip from all that melt-in-your-mouth fatti(er) cuts, you can order some poh li sang choy (that's iceberg lettuce for the not-so-familiar) topped with fried shallots and oyster sauce. We didn't.If you go for breakfast/brunch/early lunch, you might get to order yao char kwai to dip into the rich soup. We didnt.Service is fast and courteous - it's always nice to see people working hard to ensure great customer service.Worth going for if you are hankering for good BKT and could not be bothered to drive all the way to BKT HQ in Klang.

Author: thortillachipsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not bad, but not amazing; just OK.
Review: Been wanting to try this place since I was told about it. While the beef pho stock was tasty, it was also flat at the same time. It seemed to be missing a 'kick'. Don't really know how to describe this missing 'kick', but the best way to put it is that basically, I've had much better pho elsewhere.Friend spring rolls were good though.

Author: Dandansam
Title: Please take note on your ways in handling customers.
Review: Been there a few times during weekday. It’s crowded during lunchtime, food are just ordinary, not as extraordinary as mentioned in some of the reviews. Price are fairly reasonable. Though they are busy and have good business, they should also think twice if they should still be operating, if they felt so much annoyed with big crowds attending to the restaurant. I have this thought of bringing my family to dine in one of the weekend. Was unsure if it’s open on Sunday, so I gave them a call just to reconfirm as I was travelling from another state. The person who received the call just mentioned, “why not open, can’t you see so many customers in here?”Well, I was on the line and stunned by this type of response and tone. And she continued to say, “hey, is that all? I will hang up.”I actually didn’t have space to even speak on the phone after my question.My question was,” excuse me, is your restaurant operating today?”Maybe the attitude could be improved as to give your customers a better dining experience.

Author: By5484
Title: Best seafood
Review: My family & I always dine here as we love the food here. Try their satay prawn with bun, squid with salted egg, midin belacan, steamed fish and you will always want to come back.

Author: HizamalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tonka bean or 'Tongkang Pecah'(wrecked ship)???
Review: Worst cantonese fried noodles ever at tonka bean. And i have to wait so long for it. And there were a couple just walked out from tonka bean bcoz they hv been waiting for more than 1 hour to get their food. Wooww! Impressive timing. Bravo to the restaurant management.

Author: MyriamCostaSaint-Germain-en-Laye, France
Title: Fine dinning
Review: Its the most fine dinning we find in this area. We was living 5 years in Kl and after that we are in Johor and i assure you its not so easy to find a very good restaurant. This one its the best for me in terme of Italian food.Very cost place and safe. They got a excellent chef and a Master Sommelier Noriko Yonezawa.Really we recommend you to go and taste........

Author: Blue_Man_AlejandroSingapore, Singapore
Title: First and last time
Review: A hotel staff recommended this place saying that this place serves the best steaks in KL so we decided to try it out. Ordered a few things to share including a large piece of steak, a lamb dish as well as a chicken. I was really looking forward to the food given it was so highly regarded by the hotel concierge and the prices on the menu were exorbitant (thinking that people would pay more for great food). However, when the food finally arrived, I actually felt disappointed. Firstly the presentation was nothing to shout about and secondly, the meat was not well cooked nor seasoned. Even the additional sauces we got were rather bland. The bread served at the start of meal was cold and wasn't fresh. The only thing I enjoyed was the wine and the complimentary mini wagyu burger at the start of our meal. I honestly don't know why people would choose to dine here. I wasn't happy with the food and we didn't even finish what we ordered. My friend had chicken and the dish came with 3 minuscule pieces of chicken. I bet he went back home for some roti bread after. LolIn short, there is a reason why this place isn't highly regarded on TripAdvisor and I found out first hand the reason why. I feel bad having to make this last remark. While I could tell that the staff were trying real hard, I felt that service came across as pretentious. I have been to many fine dining places where service is professional and that for me is great service. At this place, they tried to be overly friendly to the point where I didn't feel it was genuine. For me...I went, I tried and I'm never going back.

Author: MizSally24Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unhygienic restaurant
Review: I was at this particular outlet in Setia City Mall on a Sunday. Seated near the kitchen and beside a counter, I could see clearly what the staffs were doing. After ordering our food, I asked for an extra plate, the waitress took a plate nearby, wiped it with a brown towel from the counter and gave to me. While eating, I saw another waiter using the same brown towel to wipe a baby chair. At that moment of time, I just couldn't swallow my food. They used the same dirty brown towel to wipe my plate and the chair. It was gruesome and sickening. I would never ever eat at a place like this.

Author: AK_aroundtheglobeMoscow, Russia
Title: Perfect dinner
Review: We spent quite some time surfing the net in order to find some nice dining with seafood (strangely seafood is not very popular in KL). At the end we were very happy with our choice and I should say this was the best meal of the trip. Everything was perfect from the start, the staff was very attentive, the wine choice was good (even when we found out that our first choice was not available, it was not limited), the food was to die for (!) we took scallops, fois gras, tiger prawns and surf&turf and never regretted it. The only downside is the price, so be prepared. Perfect location for a special dinner!

Author: Bee_1309Mumbai, India
Title: Not environment friendly
Review: Just had a poor experience at the rest. The drinks were great and we left an appropriate tip. While leaving I asked for my plastic bottle to be filled with water as I hate keep buying plastic mineral water bottles and polluting the environment. But they said they can only fill it up with another mineral water bottle and they have no filtered water at the rest. This was strange and not environment friendly. Think institutions need to start thinking abut plastic and support stopping wastage!

Author: PER468Perth, Australia
Title: Good is degrading
Review: I have been visited the restaurant before they moved to this location, years ago (can't remember)The food was excellent, but in my opinion, it has been degrading (but still OK at best) ... Perhaps the business has been expanding so the mass production has caused the food degrading? I like the place and has recommended many friends to dine there so far, but probably won't do that anymore, unless they do something to improve the food quality ...Food is a bit pricey, but I had no problem to pay for that previously; as long they maintain (improve) the food qualityI will still go back to check it out & hoping it has improved; probably for one last try ...I like the atmosphere, the good service, collection of wine (especially Spain), but if the food quality is not to the par, it's time to look for another restaurant ...

Author: MosterMaja
Title: Great food, exellent service
Review: Our second visit to this restaurant, the food was great both times. Service was excellent. Can highly recommend this restaurant.

Author: Дмитрий М
Title: Enju
Review: This restourant is a bit expencive, but worth it 150%My wife liked sushi very much, and my grilled fish was also exellent. Service was very attentive but the same time not annoying - you just need to look at the waiter if you need and he will be right there.Very nice place for the diiner, especialy if you stay at Prince hotel.

Author: jreuringsGroningen, The Netherlands
Title: Nice terrace, pricey average food
Review: Geographers is right in the tourist centre and a nice spot on the corner to sit and relaxThe drinks and food are expensive but not better than averageThe wifi was not working but thats only a minor detailThe live music sounded more like an audition of Malaysia got TalentBut I am afraid she is not going to the 2nd roundSo nice to relax and have drinkFor good food go somewhere elseNBWhy focus on smoking free Chinatown, make it carfree first!!

Author: GourmandV
Title: Chole Bhature
Review: We tried the outlet in Bangsar, which was simple and had air conditioning. The chole bhature was very delicious. Good service overall.

Author: Pjsect14
Title: Red meat fix😂
Review: Warmly entertained by the owner Anita. Started with Mushroom soup and garlic bread and Caesar salad.then came the highlight!! Succulent Tomahawk steak with their delicious home made sauce, yummy sweet corn, mash potatoes and braised brocolli. The came mussels and mushroom carbonara, which I've never had before. Delicious!! And we were made to try the fried rice with tomahawk pieces in it. Awesome.

Author: Leonj59Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good malay food
Review: The negatives are the very limited parking and the cramped seating. Once you're past that you can begin to enjoy good malay food. The rendang daging, ayam masak merah, dalca daging - on Fridays only, asam pari are pretty good. Also the lontong. Svce is quick so that's good.

Author: Hai65Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Very discriminative!
Review: As one of the locals in Kuching, we thought we will check out the place so that we can recommend this place to friends from outside of Sarawak when they come to visit. We stood outside the restaurant waiting to be seated together with some other Western tourists. However, the waiter kept inviting the Western tourists to their seats and ignored us. After being ignored more than 3 times, we decided the place was not worth going into.

Author: nevaehnadiaJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Awesome ambience & food
Review: Visited with family. Initially we were planning for buffet dinner but in the end decided to order ala carte. I must say food was awesome. We had their signatures which is the non vege platter (comes in a sizzling plate), prawn briyani and chicken briyani.  We also ordered some cocktails & beers since it was the happy hour. The draught beer is definitely better than anywhere else in JB. I wouldn't say its expensive either.Overall everyone enjoyed from the young to old. I wil definitely go back again

Author: NIR006
Title: Good quality Indian food
Review:
- They offer a wide range of Indian food
- None of it is really special, but its all available and of decent quality
- Good place for vegeterians
- They serve jalebis on Sundays

Author: GlobeTrekker89
Title: Order only the pork ribs and maybe sausages
Review: Place is crowded and smoky at 7pm on a Thursday. Pork ribs is fantastic! Sausages are above average. The rest are just average. The onion rings are terrible.

Author: 721tonywHolsbeek, Belgium
Title: Price is worth the view not the food ..
Review: If you keep in mind your paying for the view the price makes sense, the cuisine isn't exceptionaly great to reach this sort of amounts..

Author: arek j
Title: Okay food but we were ripped off big time! !!
Review: Me and my girlfriend were looking forward to eat here, all the good reviews"wow". The staff was friendly, helpful and the food was okay. But we were ripped off big time. We didn't see the menu at the restaurant, we just ordered by the curry counter. ordered 2 plain rice 4 ringgit, 1 fried fish 4 ringgit, 1 lamb masala 5 ringgit, 1 chicken masala 4 ringgit, 1 garlic naan 3,5 ringgit, 1 orange juice 6 ringgit, 1 watermelon juice 6 ringgit and 1 fried squid which there were no price for. We paid 79,5 ringgit for the meal, which I think are way to expensive for the meal we got. After coming home I checked the menu online and found out that it should have been 32,5 ringgit. Of course the fried squid are not included in the price, but I don't think that it's 47 ringgit! That's not good enough.

Author: JosephN1937Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Crappy Service
Review: Food is surprisingly good but the service is horrendous. Me and my daughter waited to be seated and was in fact led to a table by one of their waiters and was seated whilst the waiter went off to get a tray to clear the table. The same waiter came back a minute later and told me that the table has already been taken and that I should vacate it. I told him that it was he himself who seated us but he replied that "technically" the table wasn't mine until he has cleaned it. What a joke. Complained to the shopping centre (Pavilion) and of course their standard reply is that they are sorry for the incident and that they will investigate the matter. Three weeks later still no response. So, for anyone who wants to pay premium prices for food but readily accepting crappy service, do try Quivo @Pavilion.

Author: Marcus S
Title: 15 minutes late
Review: Made a booking but came 15 minutes late and the owner says sorry. Will never ever return here. Absolutely no needs for customers maybe?
Restaurant: The Secret Sanctuary Restaurant and Lounge

Author: christinechin25kuala lumpur
Title: Lovely ambience but expensive
Review: We were here for dinner recently and I must say that it was a little more expensive than I had expected, especially the wines. But still I guess you pay also for the ambience and the service, which was topnotch.We had the tuna nicoise salad and fish soup for starters and both were delicious. However, my husband's main, chicken kiev, was a huge disappoitment. The meat was dry, the batter coating was falling off, I think it was because the skin was removed.For a price of almost RM100 for the chicken, we expected it to be perfect! My snapper fillet was very tasty though, I especially liked the trufle mash potatoes. When we informed the server of the chicken, he was very apologetic and offered to change it for us, or alternatively we could order another main, which we didn't as by this time, the chicken was already half eaten as we were hungry. After dinner we ordered a cheese platter and they gave this to us for free, which we thought was a very nice gesture. They have an extensive wine selection but they were all terribly expensive.Service was really good, the staff were friendly, attentive and very efficient.

Author: kevgill55Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: A let down
Review: rice came way before one of the meals and hence was cold by the time one of the main dishes came. second main dish came 50 minutes later! Poor service. Food average. A lot of food not available that was on menu! Wont be visiting here again.

Author: ShaneLiuw
Title: Can be better.
Review: Restaurant staff were attentive, polite and provided great service. Atmosphere was good but with many insects. Food can be better.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: Lanalolita
Title: Dayak
Review: The foods here are nice and the place was comfy. Looking for dayak restaurant? Well, you found one. Best in town!!⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Author: SamEng527
Title: Over rated
Review: This was my 3rd time visit. Feel so disappointed. Service was good but the burger is over rated. Sorry to say, I won't be coming back again.

Author: meyxtineSingapore
Title: Great location; Need better customer service
Review: We stopped by to have some snacks & drinks but were told that food will take at least 30 min so we did not order any food. Fair enough since it was a public holiday & the cafe was packed. Customer service was not good - the waiters saw us waving at them but we were ignored until finally one came to take our orders. We ordered a cold beer & a glass of watermelon juice. The juice cost RM10 but was very much diluted. With so many cafes around this area, we might not be trying this one out again any sooner.

Author: yamashitareina
Title: Not bad
Review: Much healthier option compared to the usual BBQ grill due to grilling on crystal slates. There are other food options in the buffet such as sushi and noodles which you can take while waiting for the grill/steamboat to be done!

Author: DarrenW867Gladstone, Australia
Title: Poor service , average food
Review: Seriously, when you walk into a restaurant and the staff (ie tattooed girl) can't be bothered to be welcoming from the outset it really does set the tone for the meal. As westerners we didn't really feel welcome which is a shame as Kuching had been kind to us. Anyway, some of the food was pretty good. The tilapia whole fish was really good but the rest of the meal was average. Only selling heinikin beers at high prices was also a put off. Went to pay with card but lady couldn't operate machine. Not a good experience.

Author: mandv888Milton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Nothing special
Review: We were greeted by the rudest waitress we have met in a long time. Luckily she was replaced by a much more friendly waiter. The food was average. The set fish dinner was reasonable but the fish slightly overcooked.The setting is pretty good but not enough to make us come back. The conclusion is that there are many other Japanese restaurants in KL so try one of those.

Author: Ukulere
Title: Service poor
Review: Food is 9.5/10. Service is 1/10. Asking me sitting outside even when there are available empty seat inside.

Author: lchiu28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service. Price too high. Not worth paying
Review: We went during CNY for dinner. The waiting time is too long. We waited more than 1.5 hours to get our food served. The quality was bad despite they made huge advertising thru social media and newspaper. The price is way too high and the food is not as good as promoted. Was really a BIG disappointment! Not Recommended!

Author: rajatkant
Title: average selection
Review: although the website of the hotel talks extensively about the food, it is nothing to write home about.the menu is not very extensive.mostly packaged stuff reheated umpteen number of times.

Author: chanss2017
Title: poor selection
Review: replenishment of food is slow, staff is also not responsive. utensils/cups are not replenished. food selection also very limited. almost the same selection everyday

Author: heatherrussellalaskaAnchorage, Alaska
Title: Great value for money!
Review: We ate here instead of the Bricks restaurant - very much enjoyed the food and the value of the food for the money. My only complaint is that no one checked on us after the food. We were the first ones in the restaurant for dinner and there were several people working and helping other tables. Once we received our food we never had anyone ask us if we needed anything, how it was, if we wanted dessert or refills. After making eye contact with at least 4 different people for about 15 minutes, I finally asked for my check. I really don't know how long they would have let us sit there without coming to talk to us haha. The food was a great value though and my son liked it - I ate the entire pizza so it was definitely delicious!!! I would eat there again given the value for the money and the quality of the food. I just wish the staff had been more attentive.

Author: joykooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: When we arrived at about 1pm, there was only 1 table. Service is prompt and attentive. Ambience was nice and comfortable.The food is a bit of a disappointment. The babi pongteh had a very strong pork smell and the meat is tough. Chincalok omelette was very oily. Otak otak tastes flat.

Author: RobertlongLos Angeles, California
Title: Direct from LA
Review: I can't wait to try El Cerdo after settling in my hotel but it was too late, so next morning that was my first itinerary, asking how to get there, got there at noon time  Since I am a solo traveler I can only taste one dish and I chose the half sucking pig. I only waited for 15 mins for the pig to come out! Took some picture, skip the plate cutting ceremony and have the kitchen cut it for me...  Half pig is RM188, quite pricy, but the first bite into it's fragile crispy skin tell me it's all worth it. Dip it into their signature liver with red wine gravy and you are in heaven, I tried to eat it slowly to make the experience last but it went quickly, there's thin layers of fat on the meat underneath, the meat is so tender and fragrant, no piggy smell, just scrape off the excess fats and dip into the gravy.  They must have marinade the whole pig into milk or coconut juice. Will surely be back it's time I am in KL.

Author: 455aslank
Title: Worst food ever
Review: Worst food ever. Got poisoned yesterday and was vomiting today and feel totally broken. Stomach is destroyed. Never again!!

Author: jianingl2022
Title: Nice Ambiance, Delicious Food & Very Good Service.
Review: We booked this place for a 7 pax farewell party. The ambiance is superb, the food was amazing and the service was fantastic. The staff is professional, friendly and very attentive. We love all the food recommended by the staffs. Their lobster risotto is superb. Special thanks to Mehedi for his kind arrangement and set up a cool seating for us.

Author: 478rudyp
Title: 40 sen for cut chilli
Review: Highly recommended by a friend.But......Disappointing.....Yes. Clean. Not very clean.Varieties. Yes. But nothing special compared to other mamak restaurants.Staff. A lot. And busy chatting rather than attending to customers who just walked in.Rather rude infact, mopping the floor when one is eating. Roughly moved chairs and tables when doing so.And..........Cut chilli, cost you 40 sen.When most restaurants give for free.Not happy.Regret and will not go there again. Ever.

Author: menu85
Title: So fresh and tasty
Review:
Found this place on trip advisor.
If you are in the neighbourhood make sure u drop by to try this amazing chinese seafood.
We had the salted mud crabs and the lemon steam fish.
Price was affordable.
Friendly and accomodating staff.
Would definately come back.

Author: ManFriday777Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lousy food, very expensive and filthy as hell.
Review: I live in Bangsar and I know Mahbob is all a lot of hype. I speak from the occasions friends from another part of town wanted to try their food and I obliged. And on every occasion, the verdict is always the same - what is the fuss about the food? And OMG why is so darn expensive? Over RM30 just for a nasi lemak with chicken and briyani was the last time a friend and his wife got hit. As for hygiene, it is just another filthy mamak stall. For heaven's sake, just clean the bloody place up guys.

Author: MallieXHouston, Texas
Title: I think it depends what you order
Review: I wanted to love this place because the staff was very friendly and accommodated my take away order. Also the food was really affordable - about US$4 for 3 dishes, but we didn’t eat 2 of the 3 dishes as the flavors were not very good. The eggplant with spices we ordered was amazing and I would go back and eat that again! The laksa Sarawak had a strong flavor (nutmeg maybe??) that I didn’t like. It was overpowering. We also got the stir fried jungle ferns and they had a bit of a flavor like they were going bad that I think might have been a strong fish sauce. We had had the ferns elsewhere at lunch and they were fantastic so we were so excited to have them again but we really didn’t like this version and didn’t eat them. I would be willing to give it another try and just order different items. For the price, you can afford to select a few dishes!

Author: Mea123Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: It was ok but nothing really special rather than hangup place with buddies.
Review: The food is just nice. But the service poor... As you have to wave your hand so many time to get waiter attention. and some of them not really understand what we are ordering ( they should study about their menu's) as we have to repeat so many times but end of the day we didn't get our order.. or probably their to busy to pay attention to the other patrons

Author: GKWRSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the money
Review: During our stay at KL, we had our dinner at the above restaurant on the last night before returning back home. The service was so so and the food serve was not worth the money. Very salty and the french fries was hard as rock. We also experience a power failure during our dinner and they do not have any back up. The staff just can't be bother, maybe it is a norm for them. Guests was not assure and they just proceed as normal. It was pitch darkness and no ventatlation during the power failure.

Author: yusufyaranIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Very nice view
Review: Tried this place on 28 December. Arrived at 21:54 pm , placed at the outdoor area, right under the photo taking extension area in front of the main bar where the cashier was located.Very nice view , nicely accessible from the city center.The bar manager has a super unique talent if opening beer bottles , you should ask him to open at the table , it’s amazing Food took a while to come Cocktail was good

Author: Cowsie
Title: Killing time in Miri
Review:
Great we bar ,are here nearly every day .Great selection of food and staff very nice.
Mary served us most days and is lovely.
This place is guaranteed good food and cold beer.
I will be back 😎🙏

Author: JaqenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food ..
Review: Don’t really know the big fuss is about this place. The food was borderline mediocre and I know a dozen of hawker stalls that can offer waaaaayyyyy better food than this place.However, what this establishment can offer is exuberant prices for their average food.A fan on Thai cuisines but not a fan of this place.

Author: Gureym
Title: great Italian food with a bit of spice
Review: always enjoy eating in Michelangelo's, been there many times its nice to have a chat with the Chef end the of the evening and get to take pictures with him.

Author: Aiko IKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch for 30 pax...truly disappointing
Review: Me & my husband hosted lunch for our friends & family during our ROM last June at Chynna for 30 pax. We opted for the RM88 per pax package & we had an open bar policy for our friends & family. We sometimes dine in Chynna weekends & the dimsum has always been exquisitely pretty to look at & delicious thus we opted for Chynna to host our friends & family for lunch. However come the day of our ROM, we were served substandard dimsum, presentation was depressing & service was poor. Imagine how badly cheated we felt when a bunch of tired & hungry group was being served a plain bowl of tasteless porridge sprinkled with spring onions when it states on the menu "Pumpkin porridge with seaweed". The stand in manager -Simone did try his best to improve the situation for us by expediting the floor service & we truly appreciate that, he handled our feedback & complains efficiently & proffesionally. The whole experience hosting our ROM lunch there was a horrifying nightmare, my husband could not enjoy himself on this special occasion as he was busy running back & forth apologizing to the guest. We were initially plannning to host our wedding reception with Hilton next year but this experience has detered our choice. A truly, truly disappointing experience for a restaurant in the acclaimed Hilton Kuala Lumpur...

Author: KCL KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No. 2 in Town

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Sumptuous and Quick
Review: Servings were generous, customer service was good, food delivery was swift and payment was hassle free. I was in and out of the place for dinner in less than 30 minutes all-told. And that was during peak hours on a Friday night when they were packed to the brim. Loved the food, even though it's like any other Japanese food. The ambiance couldn't very well be commented on as the place was crowded.

Author: Julie CTaunton, United Kingdom
Title: An unforgettable experience
Review: We went with friends to Dining in the Dark. Booking was very smooth and Jack texted me on the day with address and instructions on how to get there. The service was very good and we were given welcome drinks and a game as a warm up activity. We were introduced to our waiter who then led us into the restaurant - it was pitch black - I don't think I have ever experienced a complete blackout and we kept waiting for our eyes to adjust - they never did! We were guided through the table layout and the food came in small dishes, which again we were instructed which to eat first. You need to know your left from your right and which way is clockwise / anticlockwise! The food was varied and very tasty. It is amazing how much we rely on our sight to tell us what we were eating. At the end we were taken outside and shown the menu - there were a few surprises!It is expensive - we went for the flight of wine with the meal (1 glass of white, 1 of red). I was disappointed when I looked at the bill once I got home, to see that we were charged 11RM for 'local mineral water', given the bill I think water should be complimentary as it is in many restaurants.

Author: OnnWaiMiri, Malaysia
Title: Food is great but too far distance
Review: Even from a local resident's point of view, the Seafood Restaurant is too far distance. It takes more than 30 minutes drive. There are no other mean of transportation as well. If you have too much spare time to waste, then yes, this is definitely a great place of seafood for you. There are no other attractions or shopping centre around except to enjoy the beach area.Note 1: The waitress hardly notice you.Note 2: Local residents hardly visit the restaurant as it is expensive.Note 3: Too far from the local centre area.

Author: BashirahK
Title: Ramadhan Buffet Lacked Authenticity in Flavour
Review: I heard great things about this place from the reviews below. Unfortunately I was incredibly disappointed.I'm a Malaysian and I've eaten lots of authentic 'masak lemak' hence I was looking forward to an awesome Malay/Indo meal to break my fast. For the price per pax, the taste of the food served didn't meet my expectations at all. Masak lemak in general should have a balance of spiciness and creaminess but it didn't meet both. The seafood was not fresh (both the prawns and crab). I really think those who would want to experience authentic Malay dishes should really think twice before coming here. Another concern I had was the fact that the waiters/waitresses had no idea what dishes were served. When I asked what was inside an appetizer wrapped in banana leaf the answer I got was "I have no idea what's inside". The same answer was given when I asked about the desserts served. There were 3 different types of 'bubur' (dessert porridge) but they had no idea what each was (+ there were no labels). I sincerely hope that the cook will improve the taste of the dishes as it's a shame to have such a lovely environment to dine in without the authenticity of taste in dishes. Please also describe to the waiters/waitresses clearly on what is served to ensure that guests know what they're eating.All the best!

Author: ReiRamirez

Author: antliewtyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive, not worth it! Hot & Humid.
Review: Was sitting at the couch area situated outside. A place to chill (soft sofa, humid) but not a good place to have a meal which is very difficult to eat as the table is low and small and can't accommodate many people. I'm a simple guy with not a high taste of stuff, and this place is just a place to suck your money from your wallet. There's much better place out there with better environment and cheaper food and drinks to have a night.Maybe for the 2 ratings. I can recommend their expensive food. Which is quite tasty. But still not worth it. It's delicious but not unique, so still not worth it.

Author: dexter1881Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Popular bistro but lacklustre service
Review: We (with 2 toddlers) walked in at around 6:45PM on a rainy Sunday evening for dinner, at that time there were no patrons except us. The restaurant manager, who hid himself behind the bar counter, was rather laid back even when I jokingly asked for a bath towel/apron to get ourselves dried up from the rain. Other waitresses were a touch friendlier, offering white napkins that unfortunately didn’t help much due to their highly slippery polyester texture.The complimentary breads came in a few variety, all were freshly and beautifully delivered. The butter set in porcelain dish was too cold/solid coming straight from the fridge. It could be served with a bit of pre-warming up. Our appetiser, escargot/mushroom on brioche, was nicely and tastefully prepared. Even the kids loved this dish. The main courses were not so remarkable. Whilst the chef recommended duck confit with “so-so” foie gras tasted fine, the chicken roulade was downright forgettable. Serving portions were on the generous side, so there is a good sense of value for money here.Several wines were made available by the glass. The Côtes du Rhône that I picked not only held up very well as a standalone wine, but it also matched very well with the duck confit dishes.When our dinner was over at around 8PM, all the restaurant tables were fully packed. After paying the bill at the cashier counter near the entrance/exit, none of the staffs bothered to open the folding door for us even when we were having difficulty to exit the stepped door with toddlers in strollers. Instead, a gracious patron (Westerner) seated near the folding door got up from his seat and helped us with the exit.YEAST seems to have all the right elements to differentiate itself from the rest of the eateries around Bangsar area, but its service department clearly needs to be revamped to be sustainable for long term business. I would have rated YEAST higher than 3/5, but could not due to the lacklustre services.

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Above average, slightly below very good - still worth a try
Review: I'm a fan of their dessert, but since we are already in KLCC my wife suggested having dinner. The place is usually packed with people, so some waiting may be required. On that day, we didn't have to wait as only 3 of us. The rest of the group who are in large group even had to wait for 30 minutes for seat. The service can be prompt or slow, depending on the crowd. Ours was prompt. Their menu features good selection of nyonya cuisine, which is a hybrid of malay & chinese cuisines. Our starter was 6 sticks of satay, which was one of the best satay we had recently. Big pieces with no fat/skin, succulent spices and thick peanut sauce. Mains were their signature Nasi (rice Bojari, which comes with fried chicken, beef rendang / chicken in curry, sambal prawns and 3 coloured rice, all were good. Their dark soy sauce hokkien fried noodles were just normal, but the squids were fresh and soft. After dinner, we couldn't have the dessert as we're too full. Good place to visit, mind the price because of their location.

Title: This restaurant is a cheat!
Review: We had our dinner there tonight. We ordered the $17/kg crab, but they gave the $11/kg crab (the smaller size ones). It was so so obvious from the size. The male ordering person even tell us the crab is Sri Lankan crab, it for sure is not Sri Lankan crab because it is written clearly at their price list that it is local Malaysian crab. What a cheat.... felt totally cheated by this guy....

Author: Raja_Harris
Title: Disappointing Dinner
Review: Last night, I had a family dinner at this restaurant. It wasn't my first visit. I ordered a set meal for 6 pax. The rice mendy was edible, but I was extremely disappointed with the mixed grill. The meat was dry and tasteless. The dessert was also bland. I asked a waiter what it was and he said milk with rice. Strangely, I didn't taste any rice in it. I happened to sit near the overhead TV and the volume was so loud I could hardly hear myself speak. I wanted to speak with the manager to voice my concern, but he was nowhere to be seen. Overall, my visit this time was an absolute disappointment.
Restaurant: Zam Zam Arabic Restaurant & Grand Ballroom

Author: aminac540Lahore, Pakistan
Title: Beware of the person sitting at the cash counter
Review: Today we went to the old town white coffee shop at central market, KL. It's a small cosy welcoming place with courteous staff. We ordered two regular white coffees with some snacks. The food was great and the coffee was the best; strong and hot.Everything was good till we went to the cash counter for payment. The person sitting at the cash counter charged us RM 5 more than the actual bill and he was doing it with real confidence. If you don't ask for a receipt you will never know if you are being charged correctly. Our bill was RM 21.55 and we were charged RM 26.40.Those going there are requested to be careful when paying bills. Always ask for the receipt before paying the bill. Do not rely on the staff at the cash counter. Check your bill receipt first and then pay.

If the buffet is a failure and they keep running as such, it will never get better. Either shut the buffet down or refresh the whole thing.

Author: JenaliScotlandScotland
Title: Not what I expected
Review: We visited the branch at the Pavillion. The decor looked quite modern and thought the food might follow fashion. We were both very disappointed. The chicken was quite gristly and fatty. Noodle dish was greasy and the prawns were over cooked.Not somewhere I would visit again.

Author: Blossom021Kuala Lumpur
Title: Generous portions, and tasty dishes
Review: We have been to Langkawi numerous times, and the one thing we have never raved about has been the food - which can be described as blah at best.This food we have at this trip was a very welcome change from at previous visits. Since we were staying at La Pari Pari, fatCUPID is the where we had most of our meals. Service was prompt and efficient, food portions were generous, and most importantly, each dish that we ordered was excellent. Breakfast : we highly recommend the sausages (chicken or beef). Pure meat, deliciously flavoured. We were told that these are made by a South African lady, and can also be found in the frozen section of higher end supermarkets in KL. The three egg omelette was oozing with cheese and yumminess. Salmon croissants - i had to share this as the three croissants were just too much for one person to finish. Even the simple fresh fruit was served nice and cold, and always just right - not over-ripe nor under-ripe. Lunch - Since breakfast was such a large meal, we didnt really have the need for lunch most days. On the one day we did, i had the nyonya laksa which was another huge portion - but was so good, i finished up every last drop of the curry. We saw a number of non staying guests come in for all the various meals. And a number of them were repeat customers, ie we saw them more than once. A true testimony to how good the food was, that people who didn't stay a the resort were willing to come and try out the food, and not just once, but a number of times. Pricing - comparable to KL prices. But i'd say, very good value as the portions were large.

Author: bubuchahchahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I hate TWG
Review: The service is a farking fail. Please do not ever go to TWG for tea time. Buy their tea if you must, but never their dine-in. The waiters and waitresses are a bunch of arrogant farkheads. My friend asked for two chairs and they said they couldn't do that, when there were a couple of empty chairs available. In the end, my friends had to sit at another table.TWG is an overrated bullsheet restaurant. If you are craving for a high tea experience, head over to Grand Hyatt, The Majestic Hotel or Mandarin Oriental. Never go to farking TWG, where you pay farking overpriced tea for farking low quality service.Worst place ever.

Author: alexdC8933RHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with friends outrageous price beware
Review: Last week took another couple with my wife and I to Shook in KL for dinner, the chef came to the table and explained what the specials were for the day and also mentioned there was some very fresh spider crab on the menu and offered to cook the crab in a couple of different ways. We have eaten at the Shook many times over the last 3 years we have lived in KL I told the chef the crab sounded good and we ordered 4 starters, one crab and one salmon for a main course. The chef nor any of the staff ever did come and offer to tell me how much the crab cost or the weight of the crab. Finally arrived on the table and to be honest it tasted mediocre. upon receipt of the bill I was extremely surprised and angry to find the I had been charged 2668 Malaysian Ringit for the one crab alone this equates to approximately 835 US$ dollars for one crab the overall bill came to 5346.45 Malaysian Ringit. I have eaten in many high end restaurants all over the world and have never been charged like this without pre warning of the costs of the food especially when the costs are as high as this. this has really put me off visiting the Shook restaurant again and I would like to warn any potential diners to the restaurant ( ask the price) I called back to the Shook the following day to be told that was the market price I had been charged as afore mentioned I would have thought as a common courtesy to customers when prices are at that level the staff would have mentioned the costs and the weight.I am now totally dissapointed in the management, Chef and the waiting staff of the Shook Restaurant.

Author: Chiara_sgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Service and spicy food
Review: I had a quick lunch there before departure Malacca, I ordered the Lunch Set with only RM12.90 with Pineapple Fried and ice green tea and mini Tom Yum Soup and a scoop of ice cream, good price for a restaurant in Malacca. Their service is good, the staff is very attentive. I will come again my next visit to Malacca.

Author: Mick22
Title: Out of a tin curries
Review: Disappointing curries. Fish curry overcooked, Dahl undercooked, and had obviously been sitting around. Quite an achievement! Mango juice out of a tin. A crime in the tropics. Service fine, but lazy food. Nice place, but must be better fresher food in Kl

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: gravy in a box
Review: dropped by Hubz at Vista Alam for lunch. the decor was more cafe-like than like a restaurant but the menu indicated it is a restaurant serving set dishes for lunch apart from teatime treats. ordered nasi kambing set, and assam pedas ikan kembung for wife. not too happy with service; second in queue but a family that came after us got their orders first....ah well, maybe they are family with the owners. ours arrived later: the kaming stew and assam pedas gravy in black plastic boxes, with accompanying rice, fresh cabbage and long beans and some red chili. the food was tasty and i will certainly return to check out the rest of the items on the menu (there's lempeng leha served with either sambal or condensed milk during teatime; also the menu for breakfast). hope customers are served according to priority of Q.

Author: Trek322622
Title: Lunch meeting
Review: Good service by staff navine and amir.Set meal lunch are value for money and nice. Suitable for lunch meetings.

Author: chrischoong007Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Halal Dim Sum
Review: Its rare that I have halal dim sum. This was the branch at Avenue K, KLCC. Food was barely above decent for the price. The prices are comparable to hotel dim sum, and compared to similar priced pork free dim sum in restaurant. Dolly was below par. Ordered a few to try out. We had the prawn chee cheong fun, prawns are found in the folds of the chee cheong fun but are really small and I don't think they were fresh. Next was the prawn dumplings, again the prawns were small to taste it and the wrappings of the dumplings were a bit thick to my liking. Also had the stewed chicken feet, for me it should disintegrate in the mouth but it was not so. But good effort to introduce it to the Muslims who rarely have the opportunity to savour such delicacies. Servive was good and fast!! Thumbs up there. Have tried it and time to move on.

Author: OkIcanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: Went to Mr.Dakgalbi Citta Mall Subang few weeks ago. Hm... the Dakgalbi taste is just different from what I have been tasted in Korea. Personally, I love Dakgalbi, but I would not recommend this Mr.Dakgalbi. The service was bad, only few customer in the restaurant, but it is hard for us to call the waiters... They will just ignore or ask you to wait. Too bad! Regret to bring my friends who never try Dakgalbi before to this restaurant, as their first experience towards one of the best dishes in Korea - Dakgalbi was totally damaged.

Author: 10152366732633259Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Most authentic and best sausages in KL!
Review: Trust me, if you are looking for the juiciest, most flavorful and most authentic homemade gourmet sausages, this is definitely the place to go to. They serve a great variety of fresh and high quality sausages, burger patties and ham and even have pastries too. Have tried their Lincolnshire, Simply, Chicken & Basil and few others. Jalapeño & Cheese is my family’s biggest hit. Highly recommended. Once you tried theirs, the danger is you probably won’t go for others anymore.

Author: Sukan28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food with poor service
Review: My wife and I have been to this place a couple of time already with our baby who was less than one year old at the time. One of the reason we stopped going their because they often seated us outside in the balcony area. Regardless of the time we arrived, it was always full inside. I guess it was the fact that we had a baby. So we needed to sit outside among others who smoked with our baby. Please do not take my words for it, you should experience yourself while in KL. By the way, I just realised that there are no restaurants from Malaysia made to the top 50 Asia's Best restaurants. Is it the food or the Service. I will let you be the one to decide..........

Author: Vandieman111
Title: OK but not spectacular
Review: A chain serving Malaysian food - the Assam prawns had an overly sweet sauce although the beef rending was good. They did try to give us the wrong order.

Author: HossiShaf
Title: Average franchise with poor service quality
Review: It's just an average franchise, not really outstanding in a country like Malaysia which is a food destination! Service is bad. Dining halls are too cold!

Author: JollivetKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Afternoon tea shrouded in thick clouds of cigarette smoke
Review: I chose the Ritz-Carlton KL to have afternoon tea based on favorable reviews from past customers. Sadly, first impressions count, and mine of the Ritz Carlton has been nothing short of disappointing. From the old, poorly constructed and extremely discreet carpark, to the non availability of non-smoking dining area/rooms, we had a generally uncomfortable first time experience at the RC, which was rather surprising given its reputation as a 5 star hotel. Nevertheless, I commend the staff for their impeccable service. Food was above average and their vast tea selection was impressive. However, we would have enjoyed our afternoon tea better if we weren't choking from the smoke that wafted across to our table. I don't foresee myself going back until and unless hotel management decides to impose a strict no-smoking policy indoors, or establish a separate area for non-smokers to enjoy the best of their afternoon tea offerings in an unpolluted environment.

Author: Tagreed_A
Title: Barely edible
Review: We ordered a variety of items and must say that no one finished their meal. The staff was friendly but the food was barely edible. Will not go again.

Author: colin1201
Title: Dont let the lack of menu deter you
Review:
Good place to go if you want to get seafood.
There's no menu, so do ask the service staff for recommendations and price beforehand so you know what you are ordering.

Author: YredzyGauteng, South Africa
Title: Worst Service and Missing Chicken
Review: This is the worst service I ever experienced. The waiters took 15 minutes to take our order. Once we ordered they only brought half the order and the rest was forgotten. After 30 mins of waiting, we attempted to hunt down the missing chicken - I asked around 5 waiters about my order and I was told very rudely "wait wait wait..." or "they check they check...". After an additional 15 mins, I decided enough was enough, and tracked down one waiter and asked for the bill. Even getting the bill was a struggle - It seems once you entered its very difficult to leave - what a chicken hell! Finally someone came over and admitted that they forgotten the chicken. The food then arrived some time later. Do not waste your time here! I would never go back to this Nandos again.

Author: jjbaliBali, Indonesia
Title: expensive, gimmicky food... not worth the visit exception of the view!
Review: It is a beautifully designed restaurant and that's about it. Starting with the bar experience, their martini cocktails are hopelessly weak in alcohol ...a rip off at 45 Rm a glass....Snacks selections consist of various "tacos" at RM 18 a piece or shall I say a very tiny piece, you really start getting upset why you even want to continue eating there...Overall the food is fairly average, great presentation yet NO flavor at all ...fairly blend...It typically reminds me of the kind of food you would get at a very large 1000 pax banquet wedding at any decent hotels here inKl.....I patronized other Nobu outlets in different cities, food wise this is the worst of all and does not deserve a visit.

Author: 754kanehLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Worst meal of my whole life
Review: I’m not a fussy eater but this was honestly the *worst* meal of my whole life, coupled with terrible service.The food was so bad I couldn’t even finish. The chicken dumplings literally smelt like they had gone off weeks ago, worse than old socks. The roast chicken and rice was mostly bones with barely any meat, and the meat that was on there was very tough and dry. The spring rolls were too oily with barely any vegetables inside. I normally am not at all fussy with food and will eat anywhere but the dumplings and roast chicken were literally inedible. On top of this our waiter kept on catcalling single women that were walking past, and also kicked a cat really hard. Not a fan of that. Overall would recommend steering well clear of this restaurant, you can get much better quality food and service for the same price elsewhere.

Author: imasahmSingapore
Title: Go somewhere else
Review: We went for the lunch buffet (RM99 nett per person) since we were at the vicinity and I was famished. I would have left the restaurant hungry if not for the salmon sashimi, ice cream, some fruits and a cup of cappuccino. The food was not well presented and didn't taste good either. I was upset as to why they can't cut the cakes into bite-sized pieces like most 4-5 stars hotels do. The way the cakes were cut by the patrons made them unpalatable to me. Staff I came across were friendly but not enough to command my next visit.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: Travellog0001Matera, Italy
Title: Falls short
Review: Having tried and loved some local restaurants decided to visit El Cerdo (a Spanish establishment)) last night as it was highly recommended by Trip Advisor). My husband and I opted for the Paella for two people - it was so disappointing, the dish was dry, the prawns and squid overcooked and not in plentiful supply - the 4 scallops were the only good part of the dish.

Author: thaongochdHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Somehow overrated (!?)
Review: As a Vietnamese and especially a Hanoian, I will try not to critic the food here much, since I know it's really hard to expect a real authentic Vietnamese food in other countries. However, I felt quite offended when one of the waiters guided me how to eat 'bun cha' in a wrong way as he mistook me as a Chinese Malaysian. Well, of course we can eat in anyway we see fit, but once you are confident enough to guide customers without being asked, you should guide it right. Other than that, he was really polite.Another complain was about the price. They advertised a lunch set of RM19.9 with one main dish and three side dishes, which sounded really good. However, it turned out that you could only choose the main dish, all side dishes were fixed. They were also very small in quantity. Moreover, prices were not included 6% tax (okay I can understand) AND 10% service charge (okay I can also understand) BUT please tell so in the advertisement!

Author: Tamatomo G
Title: Not enjoyable after renovation
Review: Me and my family went here to eat and as it was hot outside, we changed seats.They let us change seats, but the staff communication was not good so they took more than an hour to serve us our food because of the confusion. Our last dish took the longest because it wasn't even being prepared until the last moment. And when we DID get out last dish, it was incorrect but we were busy so we just ate it without fuss. The first two dishes were great but the last dish, which was an egg and tomato one, was a bit too salty.

Author: dannychew73Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used to be better
Review: I frequent this restaurant quite a fair bit. So when we had the chance to rekindle the experience, we did. I ordered the unagi set, whilst my better half had the saba fish meal. Both fell way below our expectations based on previous visits. The portion sizes were significantly tinier. The saba fish lacked the all important 'salt kick' the second you sink your teeth in. The unagi was acceptable, but it didn't 'wow' me.Good restaurant that has had better days in my humble opinion.

Author: LittleLatteKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Hainanese food
Review: I went during brunch on a Sat and not surprise of the long queue but do ask the owner what is the waiting duration. Not too bad I only waited less than 30mins for a 3pax table despite the large crowd waiting outside. Service is good. No hiccups on orders. I had roast pork, chicken chop, hainanese cham ice (tea+coffee) & toast bread. All served in 5mins. I even take away roast pork & Swiss roll for family try. They wrapped the pork like hamper, so cute! To be honest, my family and I not so fancy on the roast pork sauce (yellow white sauce)..doesn't had much special taste or kick adding it to the pork so we prefer without it. I like the pork skin..haha crispy! A little disappointed on the Swiss roll. I took straight home from the restaurant but the texture are dry and firm (like something sat on the cake and became tight and firmed). Not a soft Swiss roll I would say, if it's meant to be like this. Overall, I like the chicken chop and the drink.

Author: Joe MManchester, New Hampshire
Title: TWICE FRIED PORK - GET IT
Review: This place was fantastically close to our hotel and was recommended by our staff upon checking in. It's open air and sit down, like most of the restaurants in the area. I simply looked around once we sat down and noticed most people were munching on the twice fried pork, so naturally i ordered it. FANTASTICI've never had anything like it! We ordered other items as well and they were prepared perfectly. If you're in Georgetown for a day you would be doing yourself a disservice by not coming here.

Author: CP GReading, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to hang out!
Review: Great atmosphere especially during evening. It is right at the middle of jonker street, and very famous in this area. If you are looking for good food, this is not the place. you can easily find an authentic local food around this area. But if you are looking for have a couple pint of beers, this is the place! I would say the price is above average from local tourist point of view.

Author: Green GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average steaks, below par service, arrogant owners.
Review: We were recommended here by 'friends' who obviously haven't been too well-exposed at what constitutes a good steak. The cuts offered included Gemas Gold, from that local livestock agency. We ordered medium-rare but what arrived was nowhere close. After much persuasion (and no apology), the meat was taken back to be reconstituted. We then had to face an irate arrogant owner at the end of the meal,who,without introducing himself,berated us for wasting his time, and after ensuring we had paid the bill, invited us to leave his restaurant!Needless to say, we will not be returning. Final word to the owner: if you can't take fair criticism, don't waste your time running a restaurant.

Author: PR_S18Barchi, Italy
Title: Not a Malayan dining experience
Review: returned after 5 years and found that thelocation was better than previous one but service and food worse. First of all the service is really slow. We made a reservation at 7:30 but received our drink at 7:50 , with only 4-5 other tables being occupied. Food used to be tipical Malayan, and is also still advertised, but with dal,nan and curries I found it more Indian than anything else. Although the quality is reasonable, it was not an experience we had hoped for. If service and cuisine stay like this, I will not come back.

Author: Flesh81Coffs Harbour, Australia
Title: The usual "Hard Rock" fare
Review: If your a fan of the food/drink chain then this is for you. The prices are the same here as you will get in L.A , Sydney , Bangkok or anywhere else. So bring you money with you, there are no cheap eats here.

Author: AnneFlowers
Title: Havana is a great watering hole
Review: If you are at the Changkat vacinity, Havana is a really nice bar to have a drink at with friends or even if you are alone.  Love the vibe at Changkat.  Yup, I'll definitely will come up to Changkat when I visit KL next.

Author: xcinderelliexSydney, Australia
Title: Not as good as it looks on the menu
Review: We were so excited to find a Chilis, with my partner and I both having eaten there before but neither of us having one in our resident Australia. As we looked at the menu our mouths were watering with all the pictures of the food making us order way too much! Unfortunately when the food arrived it was nothing like the pictures. It was so bland and tastless. we had the Texas Cheese fries (the cheese quickly became hard and very unappealing, and didnt taste of anything), the new Avocado burger (the bread fell apart in our hands leaving us with a massive slab of bad meat that again didn't taste of anything) and the tasting platter of desserts with dips. All three dips tasted the exact same (bland) despite being different colours and the appetisers themselves seemed to have been cooked from frozen. All beige and tasteless. We were massively disappointed.

Author: Ruth HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best meals we had during our Malaysian holiday
Review: We stayed for 2 nights in Ipoh on our recent trip to Malaysia. We had no idea where to eat but walked past this restaurant which was packed. We managed to get a table half an hour later and took waitress Michelle's recommendations as to which dishes to try. Spectacularly good! So we went again the next evening and enjoyed another wonderful meal - and company. It was a lot of fun! A friendly restaurant serving great food.
Restaurant: The Museum New Concept In Tow

Author: JD_JT12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service has improved
Review: This was our 3rd visit here. Had the steak and chicken chop, which was as usual good. Price was reasonable. Upon ordering, the lady who took our order said that it would be a 45 minute wait for our food. We didn't mind. What I like is that she told us openly how long it would take, so we were prepared. The soup,bun and salad were served a little earlier. It was worth waiting for the food. We noticed that the drinks service has improved. On the first visit here, it took a reaaaally long time for our drinks to be served. On the 2nd visit, we even had finished our meal, but the drinks weren't served! This time though, we didn't have to wait long. The drinks here costs a bit more than in a usual 'mamak' shop.The waiters also cleaned up the table promptly when customers left.

Author: Gabriel R
Title: Holiday
Review:
Very nice atmosphere and friendly stuff.
The food was lovely and arrived very quick.
Best pub in Kuala Lumpur for eat&drink.
Cold beer and chip.
Free desert before bill.
Thank you NAIM for your hospitality.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: KY G
Title: Great sausage and pork rib place for the family
Review:
Very well trained staff who was polite and recommends the food to order.
The Sausage platter and Specialty Ribs we ordered was great and everyone loved it. They also offer a wide range of cocktail drinks with their own special concoction which you can try.

Author: grevich
Title: skip it!
Review: tiny portions, big price, food not that good and service clueless. go somewhere else! this place is lame.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Omescape
Title: Fair price, average food, no service
Review: Came to Madam based on good review and recommendation from our friends. The place is supper crowed and noisy. All staff is running around. Food is good, but not as good as we expected.

Author: Ragini4
Title: Authentic Penang food
Review: I love Penang food and so happy to find this awesome place nearby where i stay. Price is reasonable too. Char Kuey Teow and Assam Laksa was really delicious. Looking forward to go again!

Author: CareTaker77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for Breakfast
Review: This is one of the spot that you should not miss when you are at Ipoh Perak, but you have to wake up early for breakfast :). The ambiance is like a food court with multiple selection of foods, from Chinese, Malay and Indian. Recommended for you to try not to miss, a must go place for breakfast in Ipoh.

Author: Aisyah S
Title: Delicious, dine in comfort
Review: A wide variety of choices. I have been here a few times and the food has never failed to disappoint. The staff are friendly, too. Nice ambience.

Author: GrahamStephensPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Heavy and oily
Review: Maybe I ordered the wrong dishes, but the mushroom soup was swimming in truffle oil and the beef stroganoff "special" was tasteless and served with spaghetti which is really not acceptable. Ingredient quality was OK but cooking was poor. I visited on a Sunday lunchtime and was only one of two diners so maybe the usual chef was not available. I will give this place another try - in the evening - and order a steak next time.

Author: williamcT7376MY
Title: ROM Dinner
Review: Had our mini wedding reception here and was served with excellence by Jacquelyn, Eugene and team! Highly recommend this place!

Author: GanYY2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't bother coming here for the Ramadhan buffet
Review: Priced at RM 184 nett, the Ramadhan buffet at Vascos is a waste of time and money. Buka puasa with my usual bunch of friends is a yearly affair, and we've sampled the offerings at other hotels namely PJ Hilton, One World, Majestic, Sunway Resort, Saujana in previous years and this has got to be the worst experience. The whole venue was overbooked, some company was allowed to hold some function with loudspeaker and projector in the main area spoiling the whole experience with the noise. Perhaps they should be given a function room close to the restaurant instead? We were placed far away at the lounge and had to walk far to get the food. There was barely any space left to navigate around people's chairs to reach the food area. The food selection was poor. Otak otak was undercooked, leaving the inside mushy instead of chewy and charred. Sashimi station was slow in refilling. The seafood station did not have the lobsters as was shown in the pictures by some food blogs. The lamb in the briyani was hard, not tender. The dessert selection was also poor, no sight of proper cakes, only those mushy mousse types. The only ice cream available was ice cream potong, not even those which you can scoop. If I wanted ice cream potong only, I'll get it at Giant. The fresh apam balik had very little filling. The choc fountain only had marshmallow to dip, no sight of fresh fruits on stick. It's a shame that we all agreed that PJ Hilton has one of the best Ramadhan buffet, and KL Hilton is far from there.

Author: Navigator668840
Title: Food is yummy.
Review: Food is yummy.  Loh mai kai is awesome.  Seating is a challenge if come before 10.30am.  Plenty of space after 11am but food like porridge or chee cheong fun are gone by that time.

Author: calvinogood
Title: It's totally out!
Review: Yes, you can say it's the most happening place in 60s but not now. The building & interior looks disorganized & dirty, it's doesn't fit the right standard that a steak house should having nowadays.

Author: SwisskidsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Embarrassing Host
Review: I took 5 Singaporean friends for tea and was greeted by the most unfriendly and rude hostess. I presumed she is a hostess because she was stationed at the the entrance. She is a rather heavy size Malay lady. She led us to the open area which we find a bit hot and humid. Immediately we told her to give us a table in the air condition area. She made a face and just left us standing there unassisted. Just a note to the owner, no matter how trendy your restaurant or how good your food is you should also look into the service and the attitude of your staff. FYI we are all hotelier before. Thank you.

Author: SueJenningsGlastonbury, United Kingdom
Title: OK if you like it hot!
Review: My heart slowly sank as it turned out there was virtually nothing I could eat! No knowledge of GF eating. I ended up with a bowl of clear soup, but SO hot it burnt the back of my throat. I am used to curries but this was inedible!

Author: azizyarisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just not as same as before
Review: I've been here as long as I can remember. Maybe more than 20 years. I still remember the owner serving us, chopping the chicken. However now it is only workers with no personal touch. Taste also has become worst. Please give us back the old taste.

Author: Franklyn EMiramar, Florida
Title: Give this restaurant a miss
Review: Had dinner in the restaurant on the 9th June. We were warmly welcomed in and ordered dinner. No one had mentioned that they were closing so starters and main course was dumped on the table all at once and it was then I was told that the kitchen was closing!!!We were served rubbery crab cakes that would have had no difficulties bouncing around KL!!! I complained and thought they would be taken it off the bill but instead got a questionnaire to fill out!!!!Very poor service and food......would not recommend at all.

Author: Eastham99
Title: Tasty treats at Whiskey Bar - Thanks Arif!
Review: We frequent Whiskey Bar (& its Steakhouse sister) and it never disappoints. Whiskies are of course what draws you in, but the food and service is something that makes the experience even more enjoyable. Our waiter, Arif, was super friendly, helpful with advice to elevate our meals, and was super knowledgeable about all the whiskies and food (we watched him walk thru some picky clients with their choices with professionalism and a smile). Don't miss this little gem on Changkat.

Author: yanyany2012
Title: Everage food, commercial restaurant
Review:
I would address this restaurant as commercial restaurant.
The food was "only " acceptable as there are plently small Korean restaurant serve better Korean dishes.

The side dishes choices a lot, bbq meat was very fresh.

Author: BellaNic
Title: disappointed
Review: disappointed with the food that i had ordered. misleading menu. forgotten to take pic to prove.  will not return again.

Author: Gamini R
Title: Upset
Review: went there for lunch yesterday, i was there at 2pm only then realised lunch to be served till 3pm, i did ask the waiter if its too late for us to have lunch, he said not a problem, while we were in the midst of having lunch, the waiter informed us that we have to be seated outside as they are closing and switched off the aircond while we were still eating. Waiter was very rude and absoloutely no respect for customers. I would never ever recommend this place to any of my corporate friends.

Author: Paulus_WBLeusden, The Netherlands
Title: why do people go here?
Review: You get what you expect: interior like Bangkok, Delhi, Jakarta, etc. Good but overpriced cold beer. Nice staff, even singing and swinging, but the place lacks atmosphere. If you dont like surprises, go here. If you like a nice place, go somewhere else. There are plenty at walking distance!

Author: rachelcB5086VA
Title: Satisfying!
Review: Had a very satisfying dim sum meal here. The food are served in small or medium plates in great variety. My favourites are the fried salad prawn dumplings, salted egg custard buns and the fish balls.

Author: Jenny O
Title: It was alright. Over-rated I think.
Review: Went over during lunch time, & there were not many choices. They didn't have any fried chicken, & only 1 type of fried fish. I ended up just taking the curry with ladies finfers & another fried vege.

Author: JosephN1937Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork Noodles Stall
Review: The food is good but the serving is pitifully small. I know because the current operator is the 4th one since it first started. I eat there a lot but you start wondering whether it is worth it since it hardly fills you up. The price is RM10.50 per serving and frankly speaking, one can get better food with a way larger serving for that amount. It’s not surprising that they have to resort to free drinks now to get more people eating there.Noodles are cheap but the operator thinks otherwise. The bowl is already tiny and yet they can’t fill it up with cheap noodles. This same stall used to use larger bowls but now it has resorted to using a smaller bowl but what gets to me is that they can’t even fill it up. How much did he save on that tiny serving? 10 sen? So, if you are a moderate eater (let alone a glutton) don’t even consider thinking about eating there cos you’ll probably need 2 servings before the food gets to your stomach. For big eaters, try 3 servings, which will be equivalent to RM31.50. It took me all of 2 minutes to finish it...and I am eating slowly. Perhaps this stall is adopting the “boat noodle” concept. The picture that I attached was served on a shallow bowl with a 5 inch diameter. That, my friend, is one small bowl and I am certain that if they can find yet another smaller bowl to serve it in, they will.

Author: DaFi11Launceston, Australia
Title: Good Thai
Review: We visited this restaurant on Changkat Bukit Bintang for dinner after running the gauntlet of the opposition and we're not disappointed with our choice. Thai fish cakes to start, followed by Stir fried squid and Paneang chicken were delicious. Staff were very attentive with being in our face and meal was well priced.

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dull Define
Review: Despite some reviews I was still hoping for a decent meal here yet in the end it was dull fare on offer. And not inexpensive. The Wagu cheeseburger (RM42) was unimpressive. The burger itself was fine but the lump of breaded mozzarella was inedible and the fried crisps a waste of time. The salmon was fine but salmon is salmon. The chicken was tough and the salted duck egg pasta was rather overpowering but one of our party liked it. With a couple of beers the bill for six was RM 341.

Author: pioneertraveller
Title: Nothing To Shout About
Review: Ambience is very good, nice and quite, parking is right in front of the restaurant where you can watch your car.  Food and service is average, but prices are very reasonable.

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Chendol
Review: Finally i have the opportunity to visit this restaurant after trying many times while i was in melaka. The atmosphere inside is really warm and perenakan with all the items displayed around the dining hall. As for the food, its hits and misses as some were really good while others were average. And i need to highlight that the chendol here was the best i ever had in Melaka. The rendang beef outperformed as well in my opinion. The seafood dishes that we had were fresh and commendable. Apparently this is one of the restaurant that is run by the family.

Author: Alias AKedah, Malaysia
Title: Best place for a special dinner
Review: Amazing Service, excellence food. Restaurant very organised by their Restaurant Manager-Rini.Always nice to be back to Lemon Garden Restaurant.. Buffet was amazing with great selections of type of foods. Will always come back for my special meals.Thanks for your kind attention to all of us. Amazing experience!!

Author: jvhKuching_MalaysiaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Hardly appetising
Review: As expats living in Kuching for over 5 years, we have eaten at James Brooke many times. It used to be a favourite when we first arrived and when friends come to visit. Admittedly, we hadn't been for a while before last weekend, but also doubt we will be going back in a hurry. It is true that the location on Kuching's waterfront is good. If all you are after is a cold beer, then perhaps that is OK, but we found that the quality of the food has gone downhill - majorly. As with many times previously, I had Mee Mamak (local noodle dish). At first, I was surprised that they had managed to bring it out so quickly, but I soon realised that it must have been because it was not fresh. Tasted dry and not at all like what the dish should be like - paying 3-4 times what a good local cafe may charge, I was feeling slightly disappointed. However, it was my daughter's meal that was truly shocking. Whilst we know that Malaysian attempts at Western cuisine can sometimes be a bit questionable (no disrespect), we were surprised to find that her order of butter chicken was, in fact, a serve of their special 'Brooke' (or Rajah?) family recipe chicken (specially coated like KFC), a totalky separate dish on their menu, with MELTED BUTTER on top! OK, so butter chicken may not have western origins, but this was by no means what we had expected for one of the most expensive meals on their menu. Drinks served up in cracked and dirty glasses only topped off our memorable experience! Replacement glass was also filthy. I know I sound harsh, but this used to be quite a good establishment and without the feedback they won't improve. On the positive side, my wife reports that the laksa was OK (still 3-4 times local cafe prices) and the staff were polite. If you don't mind forgoing the view, I recommend walking along the waterfront another 150 metres, cross the road, and treat yourself to a meal at the China House instead (located in the old Kuching court house).

Author: IannARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: TERRIBLE DINING EXPERIENCE!!!
Review: Visited this restaurant after getting recommendation from a friend of mine. Went there for a dinner with my parents. First impression, NOT good at all. Once reached the entrance, some of the waiters busy chit chatting at the front table whereby there were few tables need to be attended. Next nightmare, when I want to place my order. I believe the waiter should write the order instead of the customers. Plus there was an additional side menu which doesn't have any code to be listed on the food or drinks captain order. I've been working in the f&b industry before, so I do know what do's and dont's too. I asked the waitress to assist me but she seems too lazy. She said I can just write whatever I want and just leave our table blindly.I called another waiter and thank god, he is able to serve our table with friendliness and professionally. He took our orders and much to my surprise, he was able to answer some of my inquiries correctly.Food was just ok, nothing much to shout out because I had been to their other outlet in Spore too. Price was also average, almost similar to other restaurants nearby. But the dining experience was totally HORRIBLE!!! In the middle of my dinner, some of the staffs can be singing from the kitchen area and you can hear their SULTRY voices all over the restaurant. OMG!!!! I really feel embarrassed with this kind of attitude. What the hell on earth were this people are thinking? I hope the management will look into this matter. It's such a BIG SHAME because I saw the manager was on floor, but seems he was enjoying the show too. I will never come back to this place again. PERIOD!!!

Author: CFEIII
Title: Classic Cafe
Review: It was closed when I came by, but the half doors allowed me a glimpse inside.  Really pretty cool, I would love to sip a tea here!  (Come after 11:00)

Author: lhspenang
Title: Food Average, Friendly staff
