Review: Nice Deco, Friendly n smiling staff, buffet choice average+, Food average. No Decaffeinated for 5 star hotel ??
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: Nathan GSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: we had Dinner at this restaurant
Review: We were entertaining my cousin who had come from India for our niece's wedding. We took her to this Thai restaurant on the 2nd Level. My family and my cousin all enjoyed the food there. The waiters kept coming to us asking whether we need more rice and they told they do not charge for the rice. We gave the staff there a good tip at the end of the meal.

Author: Hambeary
Title: 5 star service!
Review:
Loved the deco so popped by for a drink when passing by.
Service was soooooo good I felt compelled to let everybody know!

Author: joanadventure
Title: Manja
Review: Wanna a place to dine and be pamper (manja), come and dine with friends with variety to choose from. A good place with group.

Author: SUJOY1974
Title: Gr8 Indian Food away from home
Review: Gr8 Indian Food away from home specially North Indian buffet - On Friday Lunch - Prized around 30 RM but u can get discounted rate as well through vouchers available on Internet - but its busy with locals also dropping in .....

Author: Wong77777
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: Very good food with friendly service. Although they did forget our dessert but after reminding them, it was promptly served.

Author: Jennifer CKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Dinnertime at Flock is NOT good.
Review: We went as a couple for dinner at Flock and was NOT impressed by the food and the service standards.1) Ordered half dozen oysters but it was not fresh and there were some sand in the shell.2) After our oysters, I noticed the waiter brought a 3 layered tiffin box to every table but ours. Thinking perhaps it was some signature dish, I asked the waiter what's in the box. He said it was bread, paused and stared at me and then said he will bring us one. The waiters forgot to bring us any bread in the first place.3) Food portions were quite small and pretty expensive.4) On their website they mentioned Flock is a modern Australian restaurant but in the menu they had tomyam soup, claypot briyani rice and chawan mushi. Nothing remotely Australian. This feels like poor menu planning. There were no burgers, pastas or pizzas either.Safe to say, we will not be going back to this place again. There was nothing special or memorable about the restaurant and the menu.

Author: kianglong81Malaysia
Title: Perfect place for breakfast and fresh bakery
Review: I would recommend their breakfast set. The breakfast set consists of two fresh toasts that filled with half-cooked egg and ham, a scoop of coleslaw, and a sausage topped with their in-house sauce. The breakfast set also comes with a drink. There are a few options for drinks. They have coffee too. However, these coffee are those 3-in-1 instant coffee pack. It was a no-go for a serious coffee drinker (like me). so I ordered a cold iced lemon tea. The breakfast set cost me about RM12, the food portion was just nice and served by dedicated kitchen staffs. Their overall service was good, most of the waiters were young. I like the place because it was clean. It is a place suitable for family with kids too. They are also an established bakery. And for the parking space, you should able to find one within a walking distance. Free parking, unless you choose to drive into a ticket-parking area(with ticket machine at entry).

Author: MalathiShriya
Title: unfriendly staff
Review: we were a group of 7.  understand cmco restrictions.   what we cannot understand is the staff trying her best to discourage us from waiting for a table

Author: jenyxzzjennc
Title: Taste was moderate, bad service
Review: Taste is just ok, limited choices in the menu. Attitude of the waiter needs improvement.. They were very impatient

Author: Jon LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Exorbitant prices, slow service,
Review: Overpriced, slow service. Imagine charging 26 bucks for rice with a few miserable slices of long beans wrapped in seaweed. The fried ramen was terrible. Quality has worsen over the years. Very disappointed as the price was raised to an unreasonable level. Service is so slow. Will not recommend this place at all.

Author: niroshan2018
Title: Great place
Review: Great location.  Awesome food.  Nouman served us brilliantly.   Total value for money.   I will certainly recommended the restaurant

Author: Jennybelle4Oakleigh, Australia
Title: Do not go
Review: The food was terrible. I was up sick vomiting all night. It was really overpriced and not worth it at all. We were happy to pay for the view and meal if they were good but they were worse that ordinary. Even before I was sick we still though the food was boring. Much rather have a cheap meal in jalan alor

Author: Erico2709Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good place for corporate event
Review: As the restaurant was tucked away nicely at the corner, you can have all the privacy and nice view to go with it. Slightly quirky way to the restaurant as one have to walk through the health club to reach it.

Author: KLRocketManAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: Just Average
Review: Parking was horrible. Quite easy to get a table for 3 as the shops are quite big. The food is just average and really nothing different compares to others (even in KL). Had half chicken, fried pork, bean sprouts and hor fun. It was too expensive for this quality. Will not return as there are many other options.

Author: pateliusVantaa, Finland
Title: A perfect way to end a perfect day
Review: During our recent stay at hotel Casa Del Mar I and my wife had two dinners at La Sal included in our Getaway Package. In addition we had once room service dinner from the same menu. La Sal restaurant seemed to be in harmony with the hotel in terms of ambience and service. We were gladly surprised by the informal atmosphere which doesn’t mean that the level of service or food was somehow mediocre, on the contrary. I would like to mention some of our favorite portions: Pumpkin and Sweet Potato Soup (starter), Baked Marinated Premium Australian Rack of Lamb with Sweet Potato & Feta Cheese Bergedil (main) and Australian Beef Fillet with Chive Mash (main). It is nice to start your dinner at dusk, enjoy the sunset and linger in the darkness.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JohnmwolfsMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Location is deceiving, food mediocre
Review: Dinner set menu, 32 RM good choices including one drink, appetizer and simple dessert. They advertise with burgers. Do not even think of trying; meat was undercooked, bun dry/old. Satah meat very dry. Laksha and nasi lembak simple but ok. Location perfect, but consider taking mosquito repellant.

Author: SG-lmh
Title: Hanging out with a pint of beers
Review: Just sitting by window and enjoying the wind from Malacca river and living music. You can leave the annoying crowd behind. Good beers and ciders.

Author: Shin85Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food but kinda pricey
Review: Celebrated mom's birthday here. Service was great but food was taking quite some time to be served. Finished 2 bottles of red wine before the main courses are served? Anyhow, da bill kinda caught me off guard as I didn't expect it to be so expensive.

Author: Saraswathi AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Home-cooked meals & charity
Review: This place runs entirely on volunteers. From the cook to the waiters! There's a buffet line that has ard 10-15 varieties & also some ala-carte. It's an unique experience to dine here as you can pay as much as you like. All proceeds go to charity.

Author: Reyna02Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Hidden Fresh Seafood at the Backlane
Review: Coincidently found very fresh seafood at the backstreet! The owner said that their prawns are from their own fisherman’s village somewhere name Endau Rompin Malaysia, that’s why they can offer very fresh prawns with cheap price. Serve mainly prawns.Tiger prawns - Very Fresh and Tasty (the owner recommend to try the deep fry one or the rapid boil one instead of the salted egg because their prawns are fresh, salted egg has strong taste might cover the freshness of the prawns, so deep fry and rapid boil is the best to taste the freshness of the prawns. Tomyum soup noodle - The soup was fantastic, the soup has prawns’ tomalley(prawns’ fat) that makes the soup taste very good. The noodle type in the soup is kind of instant noodle. The soup base was cooked with prawns’ tomalley. After dinner, I went to the Alor night market, very happening but food price overpriced. Had one cendol (local dessert) tasted really good, very refreshing.

Author: viviyeo
Title: Average food, overpriced, great service
Review: Overrated, food was just okay, nothing special and overpriced, MYR 20 and above for per serving, food was not hot enough, friendly staff and nice environment

Author: HSFOOSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely cafe
Review: Have been several times to both branches and I prefer the one at Pavilion as the seats do not require you to recline while eating. The service here is great and it's amazing how quickly they turned out the meals. Their wine selection is limited though and no bubbles which I always crave for. Eats wise i would recommend their pastas and burger.There is also a huge selection of desserts which I have never been able to find space for. The coffees could be a little better though.All in I would say 7/10.

Author: EPDJ
Title: Delightful Dinner
Review: Location is perfect. Its just right in front of sentral station. Easy to go anywhere. Had a delightful dinner at the italian restaurant. Food was so amazing especially the lamp pasta( i dont remember the name). Chef and Staff were sooooooo friendly. Everything was literally excellent. And Mr. Reuben,one of managers, he was really ready to help. Apprericate it! Cheers!

Author: Liew Y
Title: limited....
Review:
heard a lot of good reviews abt this place, went n tried it

limited choices compare to the other famous shop.

prices are cheap, BUT other than that, the lack of choices is really a letdown

Author: fionyeo78
Title: Very nice restaurant with good food and services
Review: The sashimi is fresh and generally their sets are quite good, been here a few times and always feel delighted with their food and services especially the manager Mr Yeoh. Will be back again.

Author: FwhebyChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: EAT. DRINK. TALK. WATCH
Review: To be certain: This restaurant is located on the ground floor of Petronas Twin Towers, overlooking (not IN) the park. It lived up to its byline, as stated in the title of this review. We shared 3 appetizers (hummus, tuna cerviche, and chicken liver pâté); lamb spare ribs; juice; water; and coffee. At almost 200 rm, it was not exactly a cheap lunch. But . . . for a rare and memorable vacation event, in one of the most prominent venues of the modern world . . . not a bad value.

Author: KevinG5315
Title: Unimpressed and very disappointed
Review: This is what happens when Chef's love themselves more than the customers. It felt like a group of new culinary school graduates overly impressed with themselves and out of touch with the balance of good/great food and value. Anyone that gives this restaurant a great review is either friends of the people working there or people that work there. This place/food would be best described as the most expensive Tapas in the world and poorly executed at that. Food arrived cold and underwhelming. The description given to us by the staff each time food was delivered was much more enticing than the final result. Beware is all I can say if you go to this place. Have a drink and look around first before you decide to order. Peoples expressions will be enough to convince you to move on to another venue. It felt like we were on hidden camera. $225.00 USD for 3 persons and leaving annoyed and hungry (everyone) is a bit ridiculous even at International standards. It would have been much cheaper to better to eat at the best hotel in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: Zinx1998
Title: Great lunch!
Review: Perfect for any occasion! Great price for the outstanding service and homemade food. Bread was exceptional (chef’s personal recipe) and olive oil used is specially flown in from Italy.

Author: Vauny1980Brisbane, Australia
Title: Great little restaurant - Awesome Laksa
Review: A little bit random, off the beaten track. It overlooks the hotel pool, which is a little strange - watching the vacationers frolicking in the pool while you eat lunch! But, in saying that, the staff were lovely, and the food was fantastic. The laksa was definitely the better end of the scale, and it can be hard to find a traditional laksa on the island. The chilli beef special was also delicious. Cold beers went down well with the spicy food. It isnt the cheapest on the Island, although the portions were massive, and the staff friendly.

Author: yss97
Title: Average Japanese food
Review: Had a set meal with salmon teriyaki, sashimi and tempura. The set was well presented. The sashimi was fresh. The salmon teriyaki average, the teriyaki flavour not pronounced, and tempura not very crispy. So overall average.

Author: Preet KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: service and portion need reviewing
Review: Four of us had dinner and we ordered four dishes with punjabi chapathi and rice.the lentils (black dhall), and eggplant were very good in deed. We had ordered a plate of chicken raad for 2 people. The helping was very disappointing, why in a restaurant of this standing do you serve more bony portions than meat. I waded through mostly back bones with a little meat.we had almost finished our meal and the jeera rice and saag (green vegetables) had yet to arrive. We had to ask for these two items. service and delivery has to be improved. and please take a look at what kind of portions of meat you serve. there should be a better balance rather than dishing up a plate of bony chicken bones.we ordered hot drinks and requested the waiter to bring the drinks altogether and he very kindly obliged. I wish I had taken his name.

Author: rebeccaballantyneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious... but NO BREAD until after 4:30pm
Review: Scrummy food and the Mint Julip is a must! excellent value for money. The service is great and the use of an ipad to view the meals beforehand is a lovely touch. The only downside is that they don't serve bread until the evening rush. I am a massive bread fan so would have loved something to mop up the yummy sauces. Not a real concern but something to be aware of if you too are a bread lover.

Author: alpha21mikeKL
Title: Real let down
Review: When we arrived the table was being set and thy didnt replace the tablecloth but just wiped down the bamboo placemats and left them damp on the table. Steamed fish was emaciated and unimpressive. Tom Yam wasn't fresh. Chicken curry was overcooked and tasted like ut came from a packet. We asked for water for 3 and only 2 turned up as staff were poorly prepared. I get better food ad experience in kampungs than this. A real let down and not a great example of thai cuisine.

Author: Msiatraveller
Title: VERY RUDE MANAGER FROM BANGLADESHCALLED MEHDI
Review: Talk rudely like we dnt have money to pay.Helloo?? Few nights before we spent almost RM1500.Today he approached our table saying that hey u have to spend more than 600 for this table.As if like we dnt know..excuse me????? F*** H*LL..talk to people nicely..if we dnt hv cash we wont be here a**hle!!He should be sent back to Bangladesh to milk the cows there.Fking MF.!!

Author: Companion729605
Title: Bad & worst experience
Review: Bought voucher from FAVE to celebrate my mum birthday(dinner buffet)The food sucks,very little variety of food,most of food were cold,not presentable and bad.In the menu stated have japanese delights but none of japanese food was served,feels being cheated.I paid RM90++ per pax,i would rather pay this amount to normal restaurant which is cheaper and food is nicer.Original price is RM145++per pax,i'm wondering who will go for second time if they pay original price for the world's worst buffet.

Author: rudilaxmi
Title: family trip
Review: Spent a great family evening here while visiting Melaka. There was something for everyone on the menu from children to Grandparents. A lovely atmosphere sitting by the river and good service.

Author: NorthStar742949Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Yummy Pizza....
Review: This is the only Pizza in town which allows a combi of different types of pizza on one pizza....great isn't it. You get to taste 2 different pizzas instead of ordering 2 pizzas. wonderful ambience and the staff are very friendly. For Pizza lovers....a must visit place .

Author: JWong75
Title: Skip this place...
Review:
Other than the Char Siew... Nothing to shout about.  
You can skip this place... Really. 
It is really kind of dirty...

Author: Vicknoben V
Title: Its ok
Review: Food was ok and not really that great. Seafood wasnt fresh and a few of us had diarrhoea later that day. Spoilt our Christmas but would go again to see if there is any improvement

Author: jas0nike
Title: Quality drop
Review:
Used to have asparagus and soup but these has been taken out from the menu. I don't like their restaurant manager because he is not friendly and refused my request to split bill.

Won't go anymore.

Author: Ivyteh84
Title: Poor Service! Overrated hainanese food
Review: We ordered Hainanese chicken chop based on good review from blog. It was disappointing! Poor service, food was not good! Not worth to try with such price...

Author: Amrit_PreetAl Wakra, Qatar
Title: Nice surprise in the end..!
Review: Writing this review a bit late. We were there on Feb 10 celebrating my wife's birthday. I would suggest going to Thirty8 if you are looking for spectacular views of the twin towers and KL's skyline..! Drinks and food are as expected from a high end restaurant.What pleased me the most was that I don't know how the waiter serving us got an idea about the event and all of a sudden a bunch of staff came singing 'Happy Birthday' to my wife. This was awesome.. haha.. Thanks guys for that.Oh and I must mention that we forgot our toddlers toy phone there. Even verified with your reception. Sad part is that I never got time to come over and collect it..! Would really appreciate if you can courier it to me.!Best of luck and keep doing the good job..! (Y)

Author: Ray AGosford, Australia
Title: Like a Movie Set
Review: This cafe is a bit like an old movie set. You can just imagine an old drunk in a sweaty white suit sitting in a back room swilling gin and being approached by Indiana Jones asking him to fly a plane.The food was ok..drinks a bit pricey..recommend The sour plum juice...very refreshing...an interesting place to visit

Author: WongHY17Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: One stop for Malaysian food
Review: Grandmama makes an effort to cover as many Malaysian comfort food as possible - nasi lemak, laksa, chicken rice, fried kuey teow etc...Although the food may be simple, but the prices are on the high side.  We ordered the Sang Har noodles, priced at RM40++.Was a little disappointed as there was only 1 prawn.

Author: adidayangamriKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: YOu need to give this one a miss
Review: We have had no choice as my mother was hospitalised there for 3 weeks. The food and beverage offered was tasteless and the prices are high for the quality. Staff are oblivious to the menu although some are polite. Ordering the food can be a chore as many dont understand what you are saying. The food will depress you.

Author: SalsaAramSan Francisco, California
Title: Excellent atmosphere, yummy food, and wonderful staff!
Review: After walking around for a while, we decided to grab a bite to eat.We love Malaysian food and we decided, on New Year's Day, to start being vegetarian.This is somewhat difficult in China because we can't speak Mandarin and there is so much meat in the food in most restaurants.However, in Malaysia, where English is a primary language, it is quite simple.We walked into the Geographer Cafe and thought it looked like a good place to have a nosh.So, we ordered up some vegetarian spring rolls and some other Malaysian food that was delicious.As we looked around the place, we noticed how it was a "world traveler" kind of cafe and we asked to go upstairs and into the closed areas of the restaurant.The staff smiled and agreed.We really enjoyed checking out this place and definitely recommend stopping by if you ever get a chance.Heck, they even had an tango floor upstairs!

Author: Callum M
Title: Rude to put it simply
Review: Went to Yeng Keng because of the good reviews but didn't get an opportunity to eat their food. Rocked up and we were told it was too busy inside to sit despite more then half the room being empty and with very few reserved tables. They made a table for us outside with another family also being set up. 5 minutes later they conveniently let the family in and left us outside with no communication of the situation. Just really rude and felt extremely unwelcome, I never like to negatively attack people or a place but they were pretty shocking. So we get up and walked out and went to far better places!

Author: Arryana_nst
Title: Something different but..
Review: The whole experience was amazing, you can capture your moments on the plane, on the wing and the cockpit. However, when it come to the food, some are tasty and some are just did not reach expectations.

Author: KazzaBubbaByron Bay, Australia
Title: Food okay, service shocking
Review: Must preface with it being our 1st night & tired kids, who I didn't want to challenge about food choices. 7 yr olds meal came, when he had almost finished the 10 yr olds arrived. When 10 yrbold had finished eating the next meal arrived, despite both of us ordering the same thing (lasagna). Husband ate while I entertained youngest. He finished his meal then took them for a stroll to keep youngest awake. They returned and I was still waiting for mine. Eventually it arrived after another five mins of them being back from stroll. They can obviously only heat up one serve of lasagna at a time. I think it's fine if you want to grab a Danish in the day time that area ready baked but to the place to eat with family or group particularly if u want to eat at same time. Food was okay. Not bad, not great

Author: cw78832
Title: Miyabi japanese restaurant
Review:
Thanks chef YAU for giving us a good omasake experience 👍

The fat fish fin is 👍

Is good to celebrate birthday dinner here 😋

Author: Jlee993
Title: Burnt
Review: Used to be one of the best places to get pineapple tarts, however, got 2 boxes of quite badly burnt pastries.

Author: jackyyongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yet another overated Ipoh food
Review: There are many things not to like about this. For one, the dimsum is crap! The skin tastes weird, as if they put too many chemicals there. Then there is the insane crowd. No longer had you sat for 5 minutes on your table, people start crowding around you, literally breathing down your neck waiting for you to finish eating and vacate your seat! What a complete violation of personal space! To make matters worse, the price is too expensive, on par with what you pay in a 5-star hotel in KL! Simple outrageous! Please do yourself a favour and skip this!

Author: Foonglin
Title: Authentic Taste of Chinese Meal
Review: Located along Jalan Pudu, right next to LRT Pudu Station.There is their original restaurant unit without aircond, only fan & an aircond unit right across an aisle. Aircond side must make reservations, and ut is often fully booked. Lang poon, their cold gelly dish & their famous braised trotter (pat poh ju keok) tasted so original as of old. There are shark fin eggs, self wrap with salad, kao choi fa with har kow(prawn) , liver & pork & finally Hong Siew Yu Dao (Stuffed Deep fried fishhead) . It's so good! A bit pricy in my opinion. But, i heard their simple dishes are very tasty too. Bitter gourd chicken, kao gey soup etc.. Will be back...

Author: DaveLim6363
Title: Food Tasteless
Review: Bad experience on the dish that I had ordered. Tasteless Chicken with canned Pomelo on the Top and tasteless plum sauce that cost RM60++. Upset that the Chef used canned instead of fresh pomelo. XO Sauce Fried Rice was too oily. Out of expectation as compare to my previous experience. Commented to the Server but no response was given. Totally against the previous experience that I had.

Author: Glen WHervey Bay, Australia
Title: Dinner Delight
Review: If you are staying at the St Regis resort or nearby i suggest you try out Kayu Puti restaurant. The name means white wood and it truely is a fine dining experience. This fairly new restaurant has a great chef Gaetan Biesuz who is very friendly and professional with the dining experience and you can see he is passionate about his food when he greets you. The menu is quite extensive and the dishes are beautifully presented with the taste and flavours of a 5 Star restaurant. Both with Malaysian & western flavours this restaurant is a fantastic night out and you will not be disappointed with any part of the experience. The restaurant is set on a wharf over the water out front of St Regis and has a fantastic pre dinner bar with sunset views second to none. Not only is the food and service exceptional you will also enjoy the extensive wine list St Regis has through there decanter bar, with over 1000 international labels to choose from.

Author: azrin73
Title: Wonderful chinese cuisine
Review: Nice place to bring your family friends or having a business lunch.. wide varieties on the menu.. good service..

Author: msjahkiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not too impressed
Review: I have visited this place three times in the hope that it would improve. One wait staff was quite pushy about having a BBQ cooked at your table, despite we I form that we are vegetarians. The food was (bibimbop) was rather pale, not a lot of colorful vegetables. Once the pajeon was ordered as an appetizer but was forgotten. When we asked to cancel it the same waiter rolled his eyes and said it will be on the table soon. It was soggy and not so appetizing. Disappointed to have dined in there 3 times, hoping for a better result but not.

Author: Heng G
Title: not the old SHIP i know of
Review: food quality not really good for the price we are paying, service poor, place use to be very good and value for money

Author: LimFYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience, food is ok
Review: The overall ambience is great. Nice deco.Good for couple and small gathering. It's located in the city center, but not a very crowded place. Parking is easy provided you arrived early.The service is good. The food however is only so so compared to the price of the food. I'm expecting better food with the price paid.

Author: rganti9Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Chettinad cusine
Review: Great place, quite fast service and quite decent taste. was there last week during lunch it was quite packed. Lot of locals in the restaurant implies they are quite famous. Dont order gobi manchurian its colored pieces of cauliflower. Try authentic chettinad dishes. Will i go there probably yes. Make sure you go there early for lunch or dinner or try making a reservation as it gets crowded fast

Author: rad2010Bentonville, Arkansas
Title: Overrated
Review: We decided to dine at this restaurant after witnessing a huge line of customers waiting to be seated. We went at around 7:30PM when the crowd significantly reduced and there were just 3-4 parties ahead of us. We ordered the lemongrass mojito, and the lemon lychee cooler. For the appetizer we ordered the fruit rojak with softshell crab. Our server did not speak good English so she was not able to describe the dish to us, but said it was good. After we placed our drink and appetizer order, no one came to our table for the main food order for more than 15 minutes. Finally a server (different from the original one) came to take our order. I ordered the Nasi Lemak knowing that it was a specialty. However, after about 10 minutes we were informed that they didnt have any more of it that evening. I asked the server for the menu to select something else, and after I had the menu for almost 15 minutes and kept looking around for someone to take my order, a different server (different from the first 2) stopped by. I ordered the chicken curry and asked if they had it. The server said they did.After about 5 minutes, what seemed to be the manager of the restaurant stopped by telling me they didnt have the curry and asked what else I wanted to order. There was no apology whatsoever. I told the manager both dishes I ordered weren't available so it would be better for him to tell me what they did have available. He then made a recommendation of Nasi Bojari which I reluctantly ordered as I wasn't very keen on trying it. The mojito was like drinking water which had partially crushed lemongrass and mint in it. The lychee lemon cooler was like drinking canned lychee sugar syrup that was flavored with lemon. It was way too sweet.With the appetizer unfortunately we took one bite of it each and could not stomach the taste. The soft shell crab that was added on top was the only thing we could eat.The 2 prawns was the only good thing about the Nasi Bojari. The fried chicken was plain without any seasoning, and the "beef rendang" was more of a beef paste.Overall the service was simply terrible and unfortunately I would absolutely not recommend this restaurant.

Author: jialoong
Title: Dissapointing
Review:
Note : Not refering to the Imbi Branch, I visted the PJ branch (Armada).

Service :  Staff's attitude was bad. Slow, lazy, needs to be told what to do. Shows No initiative.
Food : Standard dropped a lot.

Not recommended.

Author: AJZ94Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not the best seafood
Review: Their roast duck was so amazing that it melt in your mouth. Vegetables is fresh and sweet that you can't stop resisting it.Other than that, nothing is special to be mentioned, prawn is nice in texture but flavourless, i assume it's frozen to begin with. Not really recommended.

Author: Tee_MalaccaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The boss has WORST manner
Review: My family and I arrive here around 7:30pm at night. All the tables are occupied. But the workers are cleaning two combined tables, which another one family is waiting for the tables.The boss said there is no empty table, and ask us to leave. Okay, I can leave, no problem. Then, the family who is waiting said that they only need one table. So the two combined tables can be separated and we can use another table.Buy the boss just looks at us in very angry and impatient mood, tells us that even the family is okay to only use one table, but is not okay for him. He just uses the rude body language and the words "no no no" to chase us out.I got shocked on the spot, what is this kind of manner in the world? We ask him politely but the respond he gives us is so bad and rude! If he wants to close the shop early today, he can just tell us, instead of making excuses with such bad manner.My family used to visit this restaurant always few years back, but now I will definitely not come again!

Author: billyw784Bramcote, United Kingdom
Title: Average.
Review: While the food is ascetically pleasing it wasn't actually very good.The chicken reading as part of the lager dish of different rice, well it was all bone and no more than a spoon full of chicken in total, the prawn/pineapple curry had a good amount of prawns but they were whole in their shells and hadn't been cleaned so they were still full of poo.Saying all of that the garlic and oyster green beans and the mango/banana smoothly was very nice

Author: Climber823987
Title: Lips-Smacking Laksa
Review: This laksa is super delicious and a little bit savoury. The aroma of the laksa gravy smear your mouth. And i order 2 bowl of it. Worth it duh!

Author: kienhoetan
Title: Good quality Japanese food
Review: Came here for the Saturday a la carte brunch and must say the quality of sashimi and most dishes are good. Service was also to a high standard..

Author: Bobby BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wow, delicious!
Review: We stopped by Langkawi for a day on the way to Phuket on a cruise and we wanted to grab some food before hitting Cenang beach for the day. We found this place on trip advisor and wanted to give it a try. As soon as we sat down the smell was amazing and made me so hungry. I ordered chicken, cheese, mushroom and onion (G8) and it was amazing, so savory and delicious. My wife order crepe with salted caramel butter with bananas, wow the caramel was insane, so so good! I was tempted to order another round it was that good. I also had iced cappuccino which was great as well.Highly recommend trying this place if you are in Langkawi!

Author: shiroatkl
Title: Average
Review: Went for lunch (packed with people), waited about 20minutes for table. Menu is attractive with lots of choices. We had the 4 angle beans with sambal (just average taste but with fresh prawns), pai tee is flavourful, assam prawn and ayam pongteh taste.

Author: caesar1956
Title: Raj Banana shut down by authorities
Review: Raj Banana Leaf has been shut down, (could be permanent) as a video went viral when couple of their staff were seen washing the stainless steel thali dishes in rain water collected in potholes behind the restaurant

Author: banjapatBangkok, Thailand
Title: a very busy bistro
Review: a lot of people seems to always go here for some reasons. it's always quite busy. i found the food to be quite average, but of reasonable quality. it's inexpensive, which is perhaps why locals also flock here. worth a try, but prepare to wait a long time for food.

Author: EandOfamilyNew Plymouth, New Zealand
Title: Waste of money and time
Review: They claim it's Thai food. Well I guess it could pass of as Thai food of the worst quality. Any seasoned traveler will know the difference between real and fake Thai.So that was as far as the food quality goes.As for service let me start by saying that this place is located IN KLCC, a place visited by tourists and travelers, an icon for Malaysia. I think they should re staff their RUDE and insincere staff with people who really want to work. Really, blaming the staff alone will not do as it Must be a reflection of poor management whose only interest is probably PROFIT. Maybe if you were of the right colour, you'll get some respect at Chakri Palace. If you order water or hot water be prepared for condescending statements from the staff saying they only have 'Mineral Water bottles' that you have to pay for and hot water would mean Boiling that same mineral water for your consumption. I wonder which side the word cheapskates would then apply.As for proportions of food, it's standard.Price, we'll they certainly Have to live up to the KLCC standard here so come stocked up on that front.We went there as a family to celebrate a family event but thanks to the 'wonderful' service we got it didn't turn out as we'd hope.I would really HOPE that the management personnel who reads this review would look into improving the quality of food, their waiters, waiting time and for the price paid special requests Must be accommodated.As far as Thai food goes, and our family being fans of Thai food, let me suggest you go to other decent, cheaper and more delicious places. The two i'd suggest is Basil Thai Nudle Bar at Bangsar Village and Sri Ayutthaya chain.

Author: t_chan123UK
Title: Service was shocking, food still fine
Review: I've been to this restaurant a few before and it had been a good experience everytime. But in this occasion, the service was ridiculously poor - it's almost as if they are now run by a different management. They are well staffed but none of them are attentive, almost as if they have no clue what the role of a waiter should be. What's more, we were over charged twice for food which was ordered but never arrived despite asking on 3 separate occasions.

Author: Jennifer V
Title: Brunch
Review: Decided to try their 'lui cha' and was not disappointed. Noodles with bitter gourd tasted good with an assortment of vegetables. If you want authentic cendol its a bit of a let down. Sad because fresh coconut milk is easily available.

Author: Paddy1971Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First and lasts time!
Review: Good ambience , food was reasonable but unfortunately was led down by the grilled prawns. Normally I would not complain if the food is half cooked if they replace it with something cooked. The prawns came back not only cooked but almost burnt thoroughly. If this is customer service then I feel sorry for a restaurant of this calibre. Not an apology was given which means I understand how this restaurant works- take it or leave it!

Author: ameyakamatSingapore, Singapore
Title: wants be many things but is confused
Review: Is it a cafe? dinning/lunch place? beer place? not sure .... very limited menu means you are stuck. Is very inconveniently located for an exclusive trip. In case you are in the area can give it a try. Old workshop converted to eatery. cannot rave about the food but certainly needs improvement.

Author: sunbeamrnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Value for money eating place
Review: When to Pekin for Lunch on a Sunday afternoon.At 2pm , the place was not pack, so we do have lots of seat available.We ordered food and it was served quickly.In general the food quality was good.The cost is not expensive .. 6 pax about 120 SGD.I would skip the roast meal and pekin duck, it just ok .. we had better else where.However, the Char Siew was good. well roasted and very tasty.The soup is also very good. My advice is to order the medium size pot, it must more value for money then the small pot.The Roast Duck is really good, it meal is moist but the skin is crispy, making this a most eat item.The Garlic Oyster, mm.. so so, the Garlic is flavorful, but I dont taste much of the oysters. So , i have to say that i would give this a miss.Braised Pig Trotters is superb, specially with rice.The size is big, its can easily shared with 5 pax. As a whole, value for money and some good food. I would return again for more food.

Author: SandraC207Jersey, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing and very expensive!
Review: Money bags came frozen in the middle. Pandan chicken was burnt and dry, but at least it was cooked! Basic dishes like green curry were not available. Food is mediocre and nothing special. It appeals to the Western palate. The ambience is lovely and entices customers. Staff said sorry when we complained but didn’t offer to compensate us. Overall a bad and very expensive experience!

Author: Katherine T
Title: Not as expected
Review: Sprouts is sweet and crunchy, pork balls were tasty, 老鼠粉和福建面（大碌面）tastless. Price is not cheap as it is in Ipoh. not really recommend

Author: tomrush07
Title: Don't be fooled by the deals
Review: Nice place but don't look at the deals, I bought 3 beers under a deal but when I asked for the bill I was told it didn't count as I hadn't ordered them in one go.

Author: janny_yap
Title: Not nice chicken rice ball & dishes
Review:
The service is fast. 

Chicken ball rice not really tasty. Not much flavour. The chicken tasteless as well as the vegetables.

Only the environment is unique. Apart of that nothing special.

Author: Rina600Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Disappointing
Review: Staff members are friendly and polite, and the meal started in a very promising way, but.. while the starters were very good, the main courses did not live up to expectations! It is almost as if they changed chefs halfway through. We ordered the Degustation menu with three starters, two main courses and dessert. They were very accommodating in substituting one of the starters and the dessert to better suit our taste. The starters were very nice, but when it came to the main course the cod was hard to the point inedible and the steak was very chewy and rubbery, In general the food was very quick, except when it came to dessert. We had agreed to substitute the dessert with the vanilla souffle at the beginning when we were ordering. However, the waiter informed us that the souffle needed 40 minutes to be prepared after we were done with the main course, as if we had ordered it right then! It gave us the impression that either our order was miscommunicated or forgotten by kitchen staff. Also, we had indicated in the reservation that my daughter was allergic to nuts and have told the waiters numerous times. She was still served with dishes containing nuts twice (the waiter didn't even know that macaroons by definition contain nuts). We had to ask about every single dish and they changed two of her dishes after being served. This in my opinion is dangerous. In general I found this restaurant overrated and overpriced. Not an experience I care to repeat!

Author: linaimac
Title: Nothing like other Tony Roma's
Review:
Cannot recommend this establishment at all.  Front counter service was BAD, the menu was average and the food was worst of all.

We have eaten in TR's in many other places but this is definitely the worst ever.

Author: SharonOHBI
Title: Nice to hv drinks and people watch
Review: Location is good for drinks. Nothing so special about the food. Can be slightly pricey but then again considering the prime location. Service is quite bad and slow. Not worth the price if you are dining there.

Author: chengyeekinIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Getting poor
Review: Most of the people will know what happened to this chains. Food are getting poor because the hands that prepare them mostly foreign workers.Food chain are by suppliers, and quality definitely drop when they can't cope up.I don't recommend anyone to go anymore. I myself had stopped since 2011, I was once a daily supporter.

Author: CalynwlcKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Visited with an expat friend
Review: We think is great to finally have a place that serve alcohol, near the neighborhood but once we enter a bunch of kids sitting and coloring in the restaurant kind of spoilt the mood. It seems like attracting family crowd but looks like there an open bar concept? Is fine but atmosphere doesn't look like a bar or not even close to a proper dining which serves alcohol.The concept is neither here nor there. The alcohol is expensive so you can't really hang out there and drink a lot, food not so nice not value for the money pay. A bit disappointed because was thinking this should be a potential great place. Provided they have a proper music, better bar ambience, cheaper alcohol at least for beers and better snacks and food.

Author: TeamJoAdamAdelaide, Australia
Title: Buffet Breakfast Brilliance
Review: We stayed at the Renaissance Hotel and as part of its service we had a buffet breakfast daily complimentary. We ate here all 4 mornings that we stayed and it had a large selection of international and local foods. We mostly had eggs (scrambled/omlette/benedict), oats with yoghurt and fruit, beef bacon, hash browns, chicken sausages and roast tomatoes. And of course their pastries for a little breakfast dessert. They even had nutella available. Could not go past their Pandan Pancakes though. For the buffet for anyone staying outside of Renaissance, its RM120.00 for two persons. Their only downside is their coffee (although being from Australia, its hard to beat one of our coffees). If you dont like a lot of sweetener, ask for your coffee without sugar/less sugar- they tend to add in a lot.

Author: Bryan CDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Overpriced, But I Guess to be Expected
Review: I stopped in here on my way across the bridge from the Square to Jonker. Heard a band going on, which turned out to be average at best. Drinks expensive (of course). Nothing to write home about.

Author: minghuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: good light lunch, cocktails.
Review: went there at about 5pm on a saturday evening, hoping to catch the sunset. however, was told that sunset was between 7pm to 7.15pm. staff was very friendly and quickly showed us to a table. the tables by the beach were fully booked for the evening. ordered a grilled white snapper (MYR$42) from the LUNCH menu. i must say it had the best potatoes ever! and the snapper was good as well. food was slightly oily though, hopefully it's olive oil. the prawn salad (MYR$40) that my partner ordered was not fantastic though. we didn't like the fruit in it. we also had cocktails. the restaurant has a large variety of cocktails to choose from, and they are rather unique as well, which i really love. i ordered a mixed berry caprihina (MYR$25). i really loved it. alcohol content was slightly high, but there were real fruits in it, extremely value for money. staff at the bar were also very welcoming and friendly, engaging the guests constantly.i'll hope to visit this place again, for drinks and dessert next time!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Decent
Review: Location is quite central so they get a constant flow of tourists therefore no dearth of business and that could be a reason that they are a bit higher priced than the competition.

Author: Kaycci S
Title: Needs a Wake Up Call and NOW
Review: The idea of a rotating restaurant is exciting but this execution was poor. We (a group of 4) went for afternoon tea as we had just missed the lunch buffet session. The lady doing the reservations at the bottom though, couldn't stress the fact that it was a very light meal more (almost like a warning). From the observation deck, we needed to walk up a set of stairs to reach the restaurant. The doors for the stairs though were the fire safety doors, the ones that are designed to be heavy and should be closed after you walk through them - but it was held open by a chair and hence defeats the safety purpose of it. The thing that really annoyed me about the stairs was the fact that it felt like walking at the back alley dodgy part of town - there wasn't a clear indication that the door we walked to was the one to the restaurant. And when we did open the door, we were greeted with cleaning supplies right in front of us. The decor is beyond old. It needs a facelift, new wallpaper. The colours make the dining room seem unclean (browns, dirty looking oranges and greys). The carpet seemed as if it hadn't been cleaned in over 20 years - very dirty coloured. It was also a tripping hazard as I found myself tripping a few times and even saw some of the workers stumbling as well. Don't believe in all the pictures of it looking nice and pretty, in the day it was extremely dull and lifeless. The worst part of the restaurant is the restroom. I needed to go use the restroom and found it extremely uncomfortable that one of the employees literally just stands in that room. I opened the door and she was standing right at the door (so close that I almost pushed the door right into her). There was no music or anything in the restroom, and it was extremely uncomfortable as she was basically listening to me use the toilet. There is a range of cakes, some samosas (and various other things along the lines of it) and noodle soups. Our table sampled most of the cakes that were available and I was heavily disappointed in them. Out of all the cakes we had, only a couple were nice. The others were uninspiring and dull. The sandwiches were pathetic - afternoon tea sandwiches are not just a kraft single slices in slices of bread. I understand that food in novelty things such as this are usually not breath-taking, but reading other reviews I thought there was hope. To future visitors, be warned - it is not great food.Also, ignore the so called dress code. If you read online they want you to dress appropriately for the 'beautiful environment' they have created, but you don't need to follow it. Just dress however you want because they don't enforce it. Also, if I dressed to match their 'beautiful environment' I would have worn my sweat pants.The one real positive thing I can say though is that the waiters are attentive. They will refill you water regularly and clear you plates as well.The rating of 2 is only due to the price. Had it been more expensive, it would be a 1 rating. I suggest that just going to the observation deck alone (rather than the restaurant) would be a better activity.

Author: AmosKumar1011
Title: Not your money's worth
Review: They have a pretty good selection on the menu but being Indian myself, I do not see why does the food need to be so expensive when the basis of Indian food is using the different masalas which are fairly cheap.

Author: Jishnu575Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Average Thai Meal - very pricy
Review: This is a flagship restaurant, located in KLCC Suria Mall. It has great decor, and ambience besides the central location. The menu has limited choices and is not conclusive. Besides, the prices are too high. Even at the most poshest Thai restaurants in Bangkok, the prices are probably cheaper! Also the service was slow, despite having a relatively private dining room to ourselves. Besides the taste is not as good, as it should be to deserve such expensive pricing. Would not be tempted to burn my pocket again.

Author: ulagamsutrumtamizhanMalaysia
Title: Fish curry or veg curry- waiter got confused
Review: In Malaysia the trend of employing foreigners who can neither speak the local language nor familiar with the cultural nuances made me to face this interesting episode. Went to Devi's corner for banana leaf lunch. Asked for sambar( Dhall curry). The waiter poured a curry looked like Dhall curry, but on tasting found it was actually Kerala fish curry. When pointed out they removed my leaf and the waiter said sorry. As it was a serious faux pas, expected the manager to come and apologize and offer a token repentance of offering to waive the charges for atleast one person, as we went as a group. But nothing of the sort.On the food, nothing extraordinary or different from an average banana leaf restaurant. On a busy day lunch, searching for parking in that location and walking in hot and humid weather to the restaurant, realized later that the food was not that great to go for that much of trouble.

Author: colink987Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice seafood but long wait
Review: Be prepared to queue for your table. This is my only advice to all who intend to try this seafood restaurant. Forget about service when they can't even cope with the orders. The food is nice, fortunately. This will probably be my one-time-is-enough restaurant. There are simply too many food choices in Maleka to pick and the long queue just doesn't seems worth it.

Author: jinlim007
Title: Worst service ever
Review: Came here for dinner with my family. Food was good. However, service was terrible. The staff did not serve us water, tea, soy sauce or towel and did not intend to do so at all, until we had to specifically asked for the same. Even then they took ages to serve. Preferential treatment was also practised here as another customer whom was a "Tan Sri" was served everything mentioned above promptly without being asked to. This is totally unacceptable, it is as if we are less worthy of being served properly than the others, who appear to be so called 'higher ranked' or regulars. There was also a point in time when there was no waiter or waitress around, and we couldn't get anyone to get the bill or refill our teapot for at least a good 5-10 minutes. We had to walk to the kitchen area to get someone to attend to us. And when we asked the team leader why was there no one around, she refused to even acknowledge us, which I found really rude and unprofessional of her, as a team leader. All in all, this is definitely not what I expect from a 5 star hotel restaurant. I have been to other 5 star hotel restaurants and all I can say is Chynna's service is not only the worst among 5 star hotel restaurants, but far worse than many other chinese restaurants out there. We will not patronize Chynna, and will tell others to think twice before coming if they expect a proper 5 star service.

Author: hafezmagdi
Title: Can be better
Review: I like Chilli's but did not enjoy my meal at KLCC Chilli's & Bar. The service and the quality of food ware not what we are used to

Author: ashtonalex123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dining at Langkawi
Review: Writing this as I have just left the restaurant after two consecutive lunches.The best restaurant that we had food in Langkawi and much better than other Italian places we have tried in the Klang valley.Visited: mid October 2021. Closed on: Mondays and Tuesdays. Location: Near the airport. Time taken for a meal: 1.5 hours or 2.

Author: jcktsaoe
Title: Very tourism place
Review: I will say this is the place for tourists, locals won’t recommend this place. Had bean sprouts, chicken and rice noodle soup. chicken is the best.

Author: bowin93Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great foods.
Review: I went there with my course-mates on the previous boxing day gathering, we went to the Senya located next to the Hong Leong Bank Building, but i have no idea whether this outlet is still available. Their foods were great with reasonable price, the pork taste superb, and the staffs provide helpful and friendly service =)

Author: Rachael YIpoh, Malaysia
Title: not my favour
Review: Honestly, I love eating Steamboats,BBQs & Buffets. It seems like providing so much food, fishes, chicken, beef, seafood like scallop, crabs, prawns and others like fish balls, chicken ball, lobster balls.. etcThey have cooked food like spaghetti, some veges, chilli crab, milk and creamy prawn(which I didnt manage to get since no refill has been done).We only manage to fill our bellies with dory fish, crabs, prawns, scallops, some chicken meat, seafood and japanese beancurd, thats all.Others like fish ball, lobster ball, not really my favour. Their BBQ selection is limited to lamb, beef and chicken satay only... grill food also limited to few fishes, and sotong(if not mistaken.) One thing not bad is about their desert, they have various kind of cakes, puddings, mash potatoes, ais kacang... Overall, not really as what others said, a lot of food, delicious... etc... NO.... just normal la and with original price, I deemed not worth.

Author: NanthiniBalakumaranIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Very unsatisfactory
Review: Tried it for the first time as the deco and menu loooked interesting. However problem started when we wanted to order , as we ordered the staff said some of the things on the menu they didn't have. So had to cancel and reorder a few dishes. When the dishes came , another disappointment. The eel sushi had a pathetic piece of eel on top with the egg and rice in generous portions. Salmon was not fresh. Overall a regrettable experience , overpriced and poor quality. Only good thing is Deco is a plus point.

Author: Tommy88ml
Title: Enjoyable India Banana Leaf
Review: This is one of the best banana leaf in Kuala Lumpur. the curry was good and tasteful. The fly bitter gourd was among the best served vegetable. This is must try for people who love banana leaf rice

Author: HotelCritic17
Title: Quiet and Relaxing Place for Dinner
Review: I visited Brazzo by the Bay after a day at City Square in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. My friend recommended me there for dinner and i was not disappointed. The food is decent, the ambience is great and the staff are very friendly.

Author: rkmguddikuala lumpur
Title: atrocious, poor service and dont expect a smile
Review: Went for a family dinner and what a disappointment. The food is average nothing to shout about but it takes such a long time before the food is served even though there are few customers in the restaurant. The look on the faces of the service staff says why the hell you guys are here go somewhere else. Having such a glomorous name "Passage to India" but what a shame such poor service. If you like a restaurant where you wish not to be disturbed this is the one because all staff are running around like a chicken without a head every where except your table and when you call for service they will say "WAIT" . I will never never recommend this restaurant to anyone and definitely i will never return. To top up it takes ages to get your bill. In fact before leaving i told them that i will put my experience in trip advisor for the benefit of all.DONT BE DECEIVED BY THE GLAMOUR OF THE NAME "PASSAGE TO INDIA"

Author: klawspawsManila, Philippines
Title: No wonder this place has amazing food
Review: AMAZING Chinese food! We had a beef dish, a tofu dish and fried rice, and each of them were equally AMAZING. Great bang for your buck. Quick service. No-frills restaurant but the flavors more than made up for it.Last order is at 9PM so don't go later than that!

Author: AcdcSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch at Pavillion El Iberico
Review: I had lunch with my family at this restaurant, Pavillion El Iberico. We ordered the iberio pork and calamari. The pork is not as tasty as I thought it would be. The ribs are not so well seasoned and the calamari is not at all crispy. Quite disappointed with the food especially the quantity is so little and the price expensive.

Author: Jarl_FroylandPantai Cenang, Malaysia
Title: Great food and great service
Review: Best meal we have had so far in LangkawiBeen a bit dissapointed about hotel restaurants on the island so far, and used Tripadvisor to find this gem.Middle-east / Syrian food. Great kebab-both lamb and chicken, lovely hummus and a very good falafel. Fruit cocktails (non-alcoholic) are great as well. Got some fries with the food, only thing on the plate that was not needed. Plenty of food. Service outstanding.

Author: sleepyphoebe
Title: Bad crew service
Review: The food and drinks here meet expectations but service crew is terrible. The waitress Elsa is rude and condescending. Will not be back.

Author: DenniswonSingapore, Singapore
Title: 11am visit on 10/sep/2016 Not Worth It
Review: 11am visit on 10/sep/2016 Not Worth ItNothing special and I think it is over price.Person cooking like foreign workers who act like robots. Ordered red snapper congee but no red snapper. Soybean drink got taste of gelatin. So,as to cut cost in order to make soybean drink thicker.The true tast and spirit of dim sum cannot be felt and taste at all. Maybe just see decortration dim sum shop.Don't waste your money there. Please see attached photo.

Author: macfodDunedin, New Zealand
Title: Pretty average food and poor service
Review: We found service very poor and 50 minutes for food from ordering pushing it.Funny thing is then bring heated plates out after five minutes which are cold by the time food arrives.Naan bread was burnt and Jalfrezi just warmTasty tho but not worth a revisit.

Author: snoopyjazzKuala Lumpur
Title: one of the best Indian food restaurants in KL
Review: I first went to Tasty Chapathi in June this year and have been a regular visitor since then. In my opinion, it is one of the best Indian food restaurants in KL.It is situated in a mall and parking is easy as there are ample carparks on the road in front of the restaurant. If full, there is parking in the mall itself where free parking is available.The restaurant is a bit dark and music is a bit loud though all that is forgotten when the food comes. Especially good is the mutton rogan josh, palak paneer and aloo gobi. Chapatti are small but delicious as they are fluffy and warm. There is also briyani and sets are available during lunch at affordable prices.Service can be a bit slow at peak hours and at times the waiters do get our orders wrong but make sure they read it back to you so that you can pick out the mistakes.All in all, this restaurant is highly recommended.

Author: InterstellarTravelRedditch, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, fantastic service
Review: The food is what you would expect from a Hard Rock Cafe. However the service is fantastic and the staff are really helpful.

Author: Eraj W
Title: Good Sri Lankan food
Review: A delightful restaurant having a Sri Lankan ambience and a very courteous and helpful staff. But nothing to beat the traditional Jaffna style Sri Lankan crab. It was goood ! A taste of Kiribath-the traditional rice-cake, Ceylon devilled prawns and a Rasam of peppery lamb bone was part of the menu. The sweet Appam as desert required a repeat. A well stocked bar was also available. Worth a visit.

Author: Sherpa750694
Title: Amazing whiskey collection
Review: We came in whisky bar and it we try something especiall whisky. Ariff given service was very good service. We will be back again

Author: Barry S
Title: TOTAL DISASTER
Review: Arrived here with empty stomach and left here with empty stomach. Food arrived 50mins after ordering and fish and chips were cold...asked to change..came back later..same cold temperature. Orange chicken dish was very small and also cold. Service very poor.Avoid if you want good food and fast service.

Author: margaretleesyPenang, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Definitely interesting to see it from the visually impaired person's perspective. The waiters serving as well as the manager was visually impaired as well. The toughest part for me was to figure if I had finished all my food on the plate but we thoroughly enjoyed the dinner with the help from the excellent team! Good job well done!

Author: KiliGranPaphos, Cyprus
Title: Awful evening
Review: On entering Ben's I was pleasantly surprised how cosy it was compared to the other restaurants we'd been in in the Mall. We ordered a bottle of red. Buffalo Wings to share as a starter, Mac and cheese and Chicken & prawn laksa as mains. Now read carefully .... Waitress comes over .." Sorry no buffalo wings left " ok ordered nacho's instead. Wine came after 3 rd time of asking. Then they came over and said "sorry no Mac & Cheese " okay now we were starting to get a little annoyed .... We ordered fish & Chips instead. Had a sip of wine and over came a waiter with ...... Mac & cheese! We said " you just told us you had sold it all and we haven't had starters yet!" Getting very annoyed now. Nachos arrived ... Less than average. Fish & chips arrived, looked quite good ...... Then we waited and waited. My husband won't eat until I have my meal ..... Eventually my laksa arrived. Fish & chips were good so my husband said. Laksa was less than average. Red wine was good! We asked one of the waiters to ask the manager to come over. He went and asked but the manager ignored our request. By now it was probably as well he didn't come over ...... I was not happy. The staff were lovely but so badly trained, they hadn't a clue. As for the manager ..... I'd sack him. Will not be back ...ever.

Author: cynthiakusnadi
Title: Nice and cheap Chinese dinner
Review:
Big and nice steam soon hock fish! Very reasonably priced too!

Second visit; recommend to try!

Place is simple and may not be convenient during rainy days though.

Author: TimTamAbroadMelbourne, Australia
Title: Very nice steak!
Review: I came to this restaurant expecting good steak and friendly service, and that's exactly what I got. Steak was a 300g Charcoal grilled Ribeye and cooked to perfection (Medium Rare) and service was excellent, always being addressed as "Sir" was one of the highlights. Overall, a nice place that meets international standards and I will definitely return the next time that I'm in KL.

Author: hopleys
Title: Good as ever.
Review: We  have been coming here for years, this time we had the mutton curry, steamboat and nasi goreng Helena special. All of it delicious. Well worth the walk from the Lone Pine.

Author: onghm6950
Title: Delicious
Review: The shop has just moved to a new building. It is just beside the Cairhill Hotel. The grand opening was on 3/6/2019. The food is delicious but the price is average (my personal opinion)
Restaurant: Ipoh Road Yong Tow Foo, Cairnhill Hotel

Author: M9177KYsoniasSydney, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: Hubby was very keen to have some great mexican food last night, and after reading the reviews and comments, we decided on Las Carretas in Ampang.We went with the recommended Fajitas and Lamb Shank, and the classic margaritas.Fajitas were alright taste wise, but the sides were so small that you couldn't really make a nice wrap. Given 4 tortillas, you could only actually make two proper fajitas.The lamb shank was hard and pretty much chewy and the pasta that came with it was overcooked. Did not enjoy this dish at all! was gutted as i had really looked forward to it.Overall on our way back we concluded that it would not be a restaurant that we would return to.

Author: dusunlassSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chinese New Year Premium Set Lunch Menu
Review: My Husband and I went to Chynna, the Chinese restaurant at Hilton Hotel, Kuala Lumpur on 4 February 2017 for lunch. We had the Chinese New Year Premium Set Lunch at RM168++ per pax.We were totally disappointed with what Chynna served - the regular few pieces of dim sum which they tried to pass off as "premium". There was nothing in the ingredients used that could be considered as "premium". The dessert item was a jackfruit purée with what looked like a fried dumpling. It was the most horrific thing I've ever had. We barely touched it. We are outraged that we paid so much for a meal that is just dim sum for half the price on a regular day. Shame on you, Chynna and Hilton Hotel, for ripping us off. We will never patronise you again. You can continue your unethical practices and we will see when you go bust.

Author: azizyarisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Put your money elsewhere
Review: All the review is suggesting their dancing fish menu, personally I think you can skip it. Recommended however is their bbq chicken. I came with 3 other friends with high expectation, food was just ok, which i feel you can get better with at a lower price. Ambience was good and service was great.

Author: Steffen KStuttgart, Germany
Title: A bit hard to find
Review: We've read some reviews about the living room and wanted to give it a try. Another source told us, that this would be a wine bar also, but it is definitively not.First of all finding it is somewhat tricky. It is located between the entrance of the "Bla Bla Bla" and "The Junk". But this seems to be the back entrance as we nealy walked through the kitchen to get to the tables.The other entrance passing the fountaine does noz have a sign unfortunately.When we saw the card, we werr wondering why it said "Bla bla bla" restaurant. We asked the waiter and he said that they share the menu. Also payments afterwards was done at the Bla Bla Bla.The service was not the fastest but the food was good and also the wine. Although we imagined a bigger choice.

Author: V1881VXjohnj
Title: How to mess up a good restaurant (lateeee order)
Review: 1. Serving time took more than 1 hour after asking for it twice.Understand that it was during peak hour, but managed to serve other dishes within tolerable time. Why after asking for the only dish left unserved twice it still doesnt come. Note ticket was printed @ 12.34 pm and at the point of im writing this is already more than 1 hour. End up leaving without the chance to enjoy the meal. Worst was no apologies offered. 2. Good point to note, the captain took notice on out presence the minute he realised that we havent been asked to order and he came to take the order hinself.

Author: MancJRGWarrington, United Kingdom
Title: Steaks cooked to perfection!
Review: We booked our first meal in Nook, but it will definitely not be our last. We ordered off the a la carte menu rather than try the buffet and were thrilled with the meals. Beef tenderloin, choice of sauce and two side dishes for RM82 for two people. The restaurant has amazing views next to poolside, and you can enjoy the dramatic sunsets behind the islands. All the staff greet you with a friendly smile, top class service, and nothing is too much trouble. All the staff are a credit to this restaurant but I think Chef (Ms Auri) deserves a special mention for her first class food with excellent presentation. If you are in Pantai Tengah, I highly recommend you visit.

Author: Weng LSydney, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: As usual highly recommended by everyone and open air and busy and crowded and hot.You select your fresh food and ask them to cook the way you want it. Price wise -relatively cheap but if you want to enjoy wine/spirits with your meal then this is not the place as there is no comfort and peace and quiet!Overall average taste!
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: Naz971303
Title: Happy Place
Review: Good vibes, pizza is amazing, great service, even better cocktails. The staff are super nice, always keen for a good chat. Highly recommend for anyone to visit. Rajib and Paddy were our waiter and they wrre really accomodating and made sure we had a good time.

Author: tutuk23
Title: Disappointed
Review: Went for afternoon tea with husband, kid and a friend.We were taken to our table through a dirty corridor.  After being seated, we were told that the restaurant won't revolve . reason given that there was a meeting going on. But they should have told about this while booking coz no one goes there for the food.Not professional at all. As for the views better go to the Petronas towers,

Author: Lyy1103
Title: Food was good, service can be improved further.
Review: We walked in without a reservation and the hostess who greeted us noted our names and contact number, promising to call after 30 mins. We were waiting outside and when time came, we didn't receive the call. When we walked in again to ask for our table, presumably an intern took us and seated us immediately - tho in a more secluded area. We didnt mind that but had to wave hard to get attention.We were, however, happy to be served by Enrico - a server who was eager to please and to attend to our requests promptly. Overall food was good just the small hiccups had hindered us from having a much better experience.

Author: pacero599London, United Kingdom
Title: The Breakfast Cafe in Georgetown!!!!
Review: Probably one of the best breakfast cafes in Georgetown and yes it opens at 07:30, thank god!!I was there twice last week for breakfast and for the first time!! Having read all the reviews on Tripadvisor, I was very impressed by the quality and presentation of the breakfast, coffee and the cosy environment.What makes it so special is the friendly and smiling staff looking up and greeting you as you walk pass by the kitchen and when you leave too!!A rare find in this UNESCO heritage city!!

Author: glenys590Geelong, Australia
Title: Just ok......
Review: I'm not sure about the hype for this restaurant. Hubby and I came for dinner after reading all the reviews on Trip Advisor and were sadly disappointed. Hubby ordered BBQ ribs after seeing the photo on the front board. His dish looked nothing like that. I think his ribs were ox or something. 4 very large fatty ribs that were tough and had no sauce! I ordered Salt & Pepper Calamari expecting to get some lovely fresh squid. What I got was packet frozen crumbed squid served on lettuce in a cocktail glass with some sort of gravy on top! Very disappointing! Cold beer and nice watermelon juice though!

Author: Hussam A
Title: TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE
Review: First of all, the food is good but not great. Secondly, on the first day of Ramadhan I came to the restaurant, in response to their advertised 25 discount offer from 5pm to 9pm BUT I was told the discount is no more available, although I came in within the time frame of the offer. I had to go to the cashier and fight for it. Even though I got it at the end of the day but it was a very bad experience, cause they lied to me and I had to fight for it. Thirdly, No credit/debit card facility Fourthly, people smoke shisha in a the restaurant premise. You trapped in a closed space filled with smoke. They should not provide shisha cause it is not an open area.

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Lesung Batu
Review: Lesung Batu was one of the earlier restaurants established in the Denai Alam neighbourhood. It has seen better days and competition is tight from new restaurants in Boulevard.Despite that Lesung Batu still has a loyal clientele as it offers ease of access to good local food to nearby residents. The restaurant has a hodge podge of stalls selling local delicacies among others satay, otak-otak and fried noodles/rice.It is Ramadan now and the usual rice and noodle stations are closed (maybe for good) but satay and the otak-otak/kerepok lekor stalls are doing quite well.

Author: gypsybutterfliesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: good food but overpriced
Review: Food here is of commendable quality. However, in comparison to other Indian restaurants in the vicinity of Bangsar, this place charges much more. The bill for 4 people came to over rm100, and this shocked us. Upon closer inspection, we found that their standard banana leaf fare is generally more expensive, and so is the fried fish and drinks. The only saving grace was that the food was good, otherwise it would have totally spoilt the dinner experience for my brother who was visiting from overseas. In any case, I would say there is cheaper indian fare nearby.

Author: Libby CHua Hin, Thailand
Title: Wonderland is Wonderful, Wonderous and Wonderamazing!
Review: We were recommended to Wonderland by every taxi driver, shop owner, massage centre and hotel concierge we came across!!! We've never had such an emphatic recommendation for somewhere to eat and we weren't disappointed. Whilst the "ambience" isn't 5-star the service and the food certainly are and it's no wonder it's always well attended by both tourists and locals. The owner "Toon" is just the perfect maitre'd and he was so helpful with our choices. In fact it was so fantastic we took our friends back there and they've said they'll return before they leave Langkawi. And we couldn't believe how cheap it was considering how great the food was!

Author: melb0urnef00die
Title: Food was ok.
Review: Went for a function. Great integrated venue for a party. Not sure if the event was organised by them or an event manager.

Author: LailaErlandsenSydney, Australia
Title: Dinner
Review: We had a beer and a glass of white wine .The white wine was very small. Not only small but very small. Saw glasses later for others that was better portioned.Ordered Fish platter.The fish was in so much batter and over cooked so tasteless.Squid in smaller pieces but otherwise the same as the fish.Scallops: they had cut one scallop op in three pieces so they were thin, then put one piece in a huge shell and filled it with mash potato. Then baked or grilled. That way the scallop piece was completely over cooked and totally tasteless.The only thing that was almost nice to eat was the prawns on stick. Only head and tale shell on, rest was of and they were all most cooked nicely.There was still texture and taste left.

Author: K0nerIstanbul
Title: Shocking Shook Restaurant
Review: We had dinner at Shook restaurant in the basement of the prestigious StarHill Galery in KL.The atmosphere is okey but the quality of the food is absulately shocking and terrible ,besides the price is a rip off,you can have two dinners in KL's other quality restaurants with the same price price paid in this shocking restaurant.So be aware and not to get foolish with its atmosphere only.

Author: YinP6
Title: Tea infused Chinese food
Review: Interesting, with just a hint of tea in the dishes.  The curry was the best dish, then the chicken with noodles - tasty.

Author: nadsg2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious lunch 👍🏽👍🏽
Review: Excellent and authentic curry! ❤️Variety of dishes that goes with plain rice / nasi lemak rice that you will need to self-serve and they will calculate the price for you, call the waiter after you have selected all your dishes. They even have roti canai, which we saw other tables eating.Location is convenient - right beside Plaza Pelangi.

Author: 936sophiapDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Lovely food service little slow
Review: This restaurant is on the ground floor of the Grand Hyatt the hotel we were staying in. There is indoor seating as well as terrace. Server very friendly but very slow in bringing our wine the food on the other hand was so quick. Lovely Malaysian and Asian food. All delicous the rendang the roti and the roasted chicken and noodles. Very bright inside and a little canteen style but clean and food was quick to come out freshly made and tasty and big portions. We sat outside for our desert which was disappointing but nice terrace to enjoy smoking. Overall lovely meal and not so expensive.

Author: LightPacker237833
Title: Quick fun super man theme
Review: They served food faster than I expected. The burger set and drink set come with super hero theme. Kids love them and food is okay.

Author: Phil GNapier, New Zealand
Title: Beware of manager serving you
Review: The manager being very helpful filled my plate lastly putting on one small piece of squid without asking me. Then he charged me 20rm for one small dried out tandoori chicken leg and the squid ring. I questioned him about it the next morning. He gave me a free breakfast .. less than 10rm. For 45rm the meal was not even close to the quality of restarin rebung dato chef ismail. All you can eat for buffet for 50rm

Author: wolfraidersBoston, Massachusetts
Title: amazing food, albeit a little pricy
Review: food was fantastic. Slight twist to your typical Peranakan food. quality was exceptional. some of the dishes were average but on the whole it was excellent. service was also very pleasant and attentive. Would definitely come back again. price wise it is one of the more expensive places in malaysia but it was definitely worth while.

Author: edwinchowywMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Avoid this place at all cost !
Review: Never in my life have I been so disappointed with a Chinese meal. It use to be a favourite among locals. They have been in business for decades but today's dining experience was a real let down.The food was really bad. My children love WanTon noodles and we ordered 4 servings.For the first time, both may kids couldn't finish their portion. We (My wife and me) would usually gobble up the remains- but this time, no one touched the noodles. The noodles were soggy. There was only 2 slices of barbecue pork which was tasteless. The soup tasted as though it was laden with some chemical concoction.The fried Wanton had barely any filling. The meal costs RM52, which is does not commensurate with the quality of the food.This is the breakdown:1 bowl of Wanton noodle- RM 6 each bowl1 cup of Barley- RM 2Fried Wanton- 10 pics X RM 1.40 = RM 14A plate of Vegetable with Oyster Sauce- RM12I voted 1 out of 5 but but to be objective about my assessment I have not tried their Congee and other dishes on their menu.Verdict: Poor food quality. Not worth the visit. Try at your own risk....

Author: donutstravelsDoha, Qatar
Title: Overhyped
Review: This place is overhyped. The cafe is situated in an industrial area. When we got there, there was already a stretch of queue. After leaving our names, we were told that it would take approximately 45mins. We had no choice but to wait as there’s nowhere else to go since the cafe is in some “birds don’t lay eggs place”.The cafe is co-shared with a furniture showroom. Took them an hour to get us seated. While the ambience and food are instagrammable, I wouldn’t say so for the food, beverage and atmosphere.We ordered a latte, sencha green tea, Englishman’s breakfast and a roasted chicken leg with pita bread.
