The latte came lukewarm; it was nothing like what the others rave about their coffee. The food were average. Not sure if it’s due to the crowd?The service was horrendous. One of the service crew couldn’t understand simple English. I had asked her for some ketchup and she nodded her head but never get back to me and went on chatting with her colleagues and doing other stuff. I found out later from another waitress that they didn’t have ketchup but had chilli sauce instead.Although the cafe looks hipster, with the young service crew and ambience, it felt like a market place instead. The crew were just shouting orders and payments across to each other. If you’re looking for a place to chill, this is not the place for you. There is also a dining time limit. Overall, it was a total disappointment.

Author: Mike Khamilton
Title: God value, good food, nice old cafe
Review: We went here with our guide, Jeremy Mak, who is a definite foodie while visiting KL.The Cafe is pretty unassuming in character and quite clearly showing its physical age. The decor is a serious scene settler with images of old Chinatown. Similarly with fixtures and decorations.So one cafe, with older decorations, looks like it has paid it's dues.The service was good, not too much, not ignored, interesting place for dinner, with very good food. my table mates are not adventuresome eaters, so we ordered some fairly traditional Chinese plates of chicken, pork, morning glory vegetables, fried rice and so on, with Jeremy and I reserving on spicy dish for the foodies. The meal, all of it was very good, everything had its own unique flavour and could stand alone as a nice dish. Sometimes this is hard to do as the food all tastes the same due to short cuts taken in the kitchenThe 5 of us well, had a few beers and total meal which left us stuffed was under 50 each.well done Jeremy.

Author: Meg DSydney, Australia
Title: Great view, lacklustre service
Review: Great Sarawak Laksa but otherwise a bit disappointing compared to other Kuching restaurants. Cats everywhere, including jumping onto the tables. The restaurant only took cash, which was a bit surprising on the waterfront. A good option to see the light show on the waterfront but otherwise pretty missable (especially the cats).

Author: aadrianabdullahKajang, Malaysia
Title: Ordered delivery
Review: I ordered delivery from home, the manager who contacted me was nice and the food was really good and it arrived right on time! Will definitely order it again. However, there were a few things that could be improved which was, not all the food was up to quality (although it was still good) but one dish in particular was not up to standard and the online delivery through whatsapp were less systematic which I hope can be improve in the future.

Author: anggingyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Be ready for a long wait if you reach after opening hours, arrived 5 mins before 6pm (opening time) and the restaurant was already full. Waited 20 minutes to be sitted (longer if you are in a big group) and another 30 minutes for the food to be served. Ordered sambal Kangkong, homemade tofu, fried chicken w plum sauce and a single portion of soup of the day. The food is nice, a little on the salty side but certainly not fantastic and not worth the hype. Tek Sen is really popular among tourists. The bill came up to be 25 ringgit per person, pricey given the tiny portion. Overall, it's good to try once but certainly not worth queuing up for.

Author: samomidi
Title: Long time to say we don't serve breakfast
Review:
We asked if they serve breakfast before entering the restaurant. They gave us breakfast menu, but it took them 20 minutes to tell us they don't have breakfast! 
Very frustrating!
So we left...

Author: Shun Z
Title: Like the two different taste in one Pizza
Review:
Good Service and the food is nice.
The only bad is not much parking slot available.
But overall I will rate 5stars.

Author: tamialvarez
Title: Delicious hummus
Review: Fantastic place, food and owner. If you try once, you will come back for sure during your holiday! Falafel and hummus totally recommended. All the best for Ramy and his family!

Author: Cp T
Title: Great Foods & Great Service
Review: Great Service. The restaurant always busy but the foods always on time, all staffs friendly with smile. Love this El Cerdo Changkat restaurant. Oink Oink...

Author: Nicole M
Title: Great view
Review: The view is great, the food is ok...it's a buffet. it was pretty crowded and lots of kids running around this particular night.

Author: mohd n
Title: Horrizon Grill is superb!
Review: Fantastic place, magnificient view, superb dishes with great taste. Not to forget, excellent service! Munir & niza was helpful & professional!

Author: Dulcedeleche1985
Title: Bland food
Review: Food was utterly bland, tasteless and far from being authentic. Prices are average. Nothing memorable about this restaurant.

Author: MactreewalkerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing food
Review: We booked at Marini's on 57 because we had heard it was the best Italian food in Kuala Lumpur. Boy, were we disappointed. The view was spectacular and we were lucky to have a window seat at sunset. We order the tasting menu which sounded interesting. We were quite let down by the food, which was served in a variety of creative and beautiful ways, but which just did not impress taste- and preparation-wise. The courses also took absolute ages to come. We often order tasting menus at first-class restaurants and this sadly did not measure up at all in terms of technique, taste or timing. To add insult to injury it was also rather expensive and not value for money at all. If you're interested in first class food, try somewhere else.

Author: MeinBritischLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lemon drizzle
Review: All of our dishes had far too much lemon in them - totally overpowering whatever other flavours may have been on offer. Also, our vine leaves were made miles in advance and refrigerated - they were ice cold as was the sliced tomato that dressed the plate. Pretty poor show all round.

Author: Hedstrand
Title: Not to be missed!!!
Review: This was a GREAT experience!  Enjoy the Dyak food - you will enjoy many endemic plants and experience a cuisine you may not find anywhere in the world!  Order a smattering of side dishes to try!

Author: peterpatterpotGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Over rated, normal but overpriced
Review: It started as a simple local food place with reasonable priced dishes and friendly service ... BUT with its popularity and crowded tourists the restaurant food and service has deteorated in its quality. And price has increased esp if you order fish , please ask for the price first! We ordered a steam fish for 4 adults and ended up paying rm105 for that one fish alone ! Service is very abrupt and unfriendly n impatient waitress. Now we do not go there to have meals anymore.

Author: Jinyu2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awful lunch-won't be back
Review: We were here on a company trip and Nancy's kitchen came highly recommended.There are 2 areas that made the lunch rather unbearable- and all 9 of us agree!Firstly the service : the waiter taking the order was really condescending. He also did not warn us that the portion for small serving was actually miniscule. We told him that we would be ordering many dishes so portions should be good. We didn't expect everything to come in tiny plates- the type Chinese restaurants use to serve peanuts. We intended to order more if the food was not enough anyway. But we didn't for the following reasons.Quality of food- at best, some of the dishes were mediocre, at worst really not palatable.The Babi buah keluak was the best of the lot- gravy was tasty but the pork was Super tough. It was served without the small spoons for the nuts, and we had to go to the counter to ask- then it took a Long while before the waiter brought the spoons by which time lunch for us was more than half way through. The sambal was watery and with hardly any taste of belacan - by the way the restaurant charge for a tiny saucer. Rather unusual given that sambal belacan is a staple in Peranakan dining.We also ordered a jug of lime juice @ 22 rm. other than the colour, it was so diluted there was hardly any taste of lime. I asked the waiter to taste the juice. After tasting it, he said it was diluted but it was not prepared by him.Maybe tourists not familiar with Peranakan food would not be able to tell the quality of cooking, but for us the lunch was such a let down.

Author: rob_farisLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Service was slow and food too salty
Review: It's a nice set up with a diverse buffet line. Unfortunately, the frequency of the meat coming out from the kitchen was slow. Most of the meat were overcooked, dry and salty. Even the green salad was salty! I may have to revert back to the one in Damansara Jaya. I suggest the restaurant to experience Fogo de Chao and Bem Brasil in terms of service.

Author: tonygP3105ZNKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food very average service.
Review: The great thing about this place is the food. We have been 4 times in the last 6 months and the food is always fantastic. Whether it’s the fresh oysters, the seafood aglio olio or the fish and chips it is always delicious. I’ve rated it three stars because of the poor service. Unfortunately the last two visits have been disappointing due to the following issues:Mains coming out before entree’s and then being asked if we could just eat them firstMains coming out half an hour apartMussels and clams coming out without the musselsFries coming out long before the rest of the same mealSadly the staff are short of kitchen staff, training, supervision and leadership. We will be back because we enjoy the food and live in hope that the issues will be addressed

Author: waterlegJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Bad experiance on reservation
Review: I had made a reservation for valentine dinner a month ago, but your female receptionist didn't mention correctly only the valentine set available on valentine's day and deposit is needed in advance. Then, I called again on 14Feb2014, another unfriendly female receptionist told me I did not reserve any table as I did not pay for deposit. I was very upset because I has been waiting for a month and none of your staff inform me on valentines package, yet my reservation was cancelled! Beside this, your receptionist attitude need to be improved.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: winedude8888Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not sure how they great these reviews
Review: Firstly very expensive for what it is. Two people with one appetizer 5 shrimps large ones and fish for two over 600 rings. They try hard but service very poor and slow but there very nice just not organized. Our fish was great the first two shrimps were great the three sides were horrible full of butter and oil and just terrible. Than we ordered three more large shrimp they were terrible and sent them back chef came out said sorry and made three more. They were no better the second time really bad. So far in the property The Resturant is the best as all restaurant have there own kitchen.

Author: Zahra12121212
Title: Complaints
Review: Unorganized place with unorganized management! Waiters very slow! Security very rude! Please fix your steps, cuz 1 elevator not enough! And starting being responsible for everything what happening inside!

Author: Travelicious_K
Title: Limited menu
Review: Came here based on the positive reviews read online, but was truly disappointed. Very limited food menu, cocktails were different, yes, but expensive and pretty diluted. Don't see what the fuss is about this place. Safe to say I won't be going back.

Author: Bruce FNortham, Australia
Title: every enjoyable
Review: I visited Malaysia with my Thai friend, he was feeling a bit home sick for Thai food and we found Chakri Palace. The staff were very helpful and friendly and the service was really good. The food was top rated and my friend totally enjoyed it, he said that it was traditional. I highly recommend Chakri Palace if you want a good meal with good service

Author: Chris_Parker1337Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: 5* Food With 1* Service
Review: My fiancee had the green Beef and I had the red Beef and the food was, without question, fantastic, some of the tastiest Thai food I've had! But it took a long time to come and it took even longer to get our plates cleared. Genuinely felt discriminated by the staff who waited hand-and-foot over the Thai family on the next table.

Author: Michael RGrand Rapids, Michigan, United States
Title: Right in the Hotel
Review: Typically I prefer to avoid the restaurants located in my hotel. I am often spending several days in the hotel and it is nice to get out an experience another location. However, I had the chance to eat twice at JP Teres and the food was excellent. One night we ate out on the patio and it was very relaxing and enjoyable. If you are staying at the Grand Hyatt don't pass this up just because it's right in the Hotel.

Author: Catherine DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Buffet dinner
Review: The spread of food is very well displayed.The selection of food was good. A good variety of food also.A good way yo enjoy our dinner with family n friends was the ambience n decor.Then the buffet spread was a splendid cuisine.The food was well prepared by the chefs.And the desserts was a super treat for me.Did enjoy the coffee machine though.Good latte n all.Even got to see the chef prepare the shushi.My family had a great time here.

Author: JonBesarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hipster old kopitiaM
Review: the place’s looks and feel is reminiscent of an age old hipster kopitiam. I’ve only had the salted egg croissant (which was okay) but the star was its simple salted egg chicken chop served with a side of sweet potato fries. Unfortunately, the latte was a bit of a letdown as it was a bit too bitter, probably the beans that they used was over roasted.

Author: stsk60
Title: Just terrible
Review: Bad service, cold food with too much sugar. Only one cart serving all the tables and it was a very long wait.

Author: Krasen18Sydney, Australia
Title: Great place for drinks - worse place for food
Review: This is my second time to visit this café. The environment is good and they serve great drinks. If you want to have a jolly time just for drinks, then one can't miss this place. However, the food served in this place is extremely bad. Avoid ordering any food. We went there as a family and we ordered few dishes - tom yam, satay, fried rice, black pepper chicken and all the dishes were really bad and tasteless. Its very interesting given that within the vicinity there are many great hawker stalls and if proper food can't be served they might as well outsource the food division to the hawkers nearby. Very disappointing and won't recommend this place!

Author: Yukihana0
Title: Poor attitude by service staff
Review: Duck is delicious but had terrible experience a few times . Returned the wet tissue to the service staff aunty both after dishes were served and at the cashier counter but ignored me and simply added in the cost of the wet tissue into the bill . Until she was confronted , then she reluctantly returned the money . Not the first time that I had such an unpleasant experience . Also the portion has shrunk significantly . I do not expect top notch service but this kind of service attitude is not acceptable . Will not come again

Author: 603ronniet
Title: Disappointing chef's tasting menu
Review: Entier is french for whole/full, but the meal experience was far from that. We went there with a group of friends for dinner and decided to go for the chef's tasting menu to try the best that the restaurant could offer. However, half the dishes were disappointing to say the least.The starters were alright but nothing remarkable. It was after the carabinero that things started to go downhill. The prawn was not cleaned out at all and still had the strip of gut and faecal material running down the top which destroyed the experience for me. If a local hawker could clean and gut a prawn properly, I don't see why this can happen in an establishment like this. It is simply unacceptable.The chicken wing was dry and lacks flavour. Why chicken wing in a fine dining restaurant anyway? Then came the turbot which had a strong fishy odor that threw off the balance of the dish with an aftertaste which I would describe as unpleasant.We were hoping for the mains to redeem the night, but it ended up as a disappointment as well. Both the lamb and beef were tough and inedible. Worse still was the foie gras which had a strange odour which reminded me of stale fruits.Service was terrible as well. Gave feedback to the waiter regarding the uncleaned prawns but nothing was done, and they simply ignored the matter. Food was slow and it seemed like they are understaffed.Would we go again? It's a resounding NO from all of us. Never again. I hardly write any reviews, but this experience was so unpleasant I had to make an exception.

Author: AnjaliM293
Title: The Experience
Review: It was an experience that surely will not be missed.The food is exquisitely prepared and the flavors are mind blowing,excellent take on south indian cuisine.

Author: NoodynamicCase
Title: Mediocre Lebanese
Review: I am an American who lived in the Middle East for a year.  Love their food, but didn't enjoy Restoran Suria.  Food was in bottom 20% of all Lebanese food I've had and the service as inattentive.  Low recommendation.

Author: Carol CSchiedam, The Netherlands
Title: Dinner
Review: My husband and I were visiting Penang for10 days and needed to change to some Western food, we found The Loft for for pizzas& pasta. We did not have a reservation but were welcomed in. Our waitress Shanta was very friendly and efficient. We both ordered pizzas, the seafood & chicken pasta, which were both amazing. Probably the tastiest pizzas I have ever eaten. Highly recommended.

Author: Marysh Q
Title: Family dinner
Review: Excellent food and spices. Good food variety and dessert. Good seafood stew. Definitely will go again and again! Good service and ambient. Reasonable price.

Author: SylvienD10Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Afternoon tea in Orchid Conservatory at The Majestic Hotel KL
Review: Paying premium for a poor quality of afternoon tea (RM110/pax). None of us (5 pax) will ever come back for 2nd time. Environment is good but afternoon tea is not just about beautiful setting, food and tea are important. Unfortunately, the hotel fail in this. Fyi, there is a 50% upfront charges depending on the number of pax reserved. It was 5 of us and the food is being served 2 pax for a 3-tier stand. General perception would be each of us would be getting a set of identical food, for example, I would be expecting 2 salmon sandwiches in a 3-tier stand since it was being served for 2 pax. Unfortunately, as you can see from the photo, there was only 1 for each type of sandwiches, cake, etc for 2 pax. So, we will have to cut everything in half in order to taste each type.I am being charged for full price but I am getting half of what I have paid for. I don't know if afternoon tea is supposed to be like this but hey, I paid full for my portion. I have not been to many afternoon tea, but I get what I paid for on my previous experience. I have no idea why they served fried mini chicken drumstick and fried sesame glutinous ball (contains either red bean or black sesame -can't remember because I didn't bother eating it) for afternoon tea that supposed to be English style. When you thougt about afternoon tea, you would think of scones. How can you not have scones. Well the scones were below average. They were doughy. Not flaky nor buttery.Apart from the food, I am surprise that my pot of tea is non refillable. The hotel probably brew separately and therefore my pot got no tea bags nor tea leaves. But seriously a pot of tea is not enough for an afternoon tea. I find it ridiculous and unacceptable. Another pot of tea would costs me another RM30 and it's just Twinning brand, nothing extremely posh nor exciting about the tea that I would want to waste my RM30.Overall, it was a disappointed afternoon tea. Over rated!

Author: purebrigade
Title: slow service, so-so yet overpriced food
Review: We ordered the spring rolls combo (fresh and fried), bun ga nuong, and the house specialty dessert. We spent over an hour here because our orders came in trickles and we paid RM 65!
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Suria_NataadmadjaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Delicious pasta and fish dishes
Review: We like to have lunch here for a change when we’re tired of Malay or Chinese foods. We had a spaghetti ala vongole and a fish dishes. Very good and delicious as expected. Good friendly service too.

Author: HockLye
Title: Barely
Review: Edible. While the price is good, the quality of the ingredient and cooking is below average. Service is efficient. With so many options around, it’s a wonder that they survive.

Author: ai09112019
Title: Excellent Food & Ambience
Review: I made a reservation to celebrate my wife's birthday. Mr Michael Anthony and Ms Yee Lai Kuan from the Cuisines Restaurant at The Haven assisted me. They made a simple and beautiful table arrangement for the occasion. Upon arrival, we were greeted by Mr Jeet Singh. He was very friendly and lively. The food was delicious. We had prawn cocktail, crab pasta, pan seared sea-beam, cheesecake, chocolate lava cake. Haven Natural Drink and fresh orange juice. The food was cooked-to-order and the ingredients used was fresh based on the taste and texture of the prawn, crab and sea-beam. The birthday cake was prepared as per my request with candle and birthday greetings. The ambience of the restaurant was very pleasant and the scenery was breathtaking although the lighting was dim towards the mountain. Perhaps a bit more additional lighting could be added. There were no mosquitoes although we were surrounded by nature and that adds another speciality to the restaurant. The pricing was very reasonable compared to other high end eateries in Ipoh. One improvement they could do is to brighten the pathway from the main entrance (guard house) to the lobby / parking area and the guard could guide us to the parking area or maybe a better signage to visitors. Nevertheless, this is one of the hidden gems in Ipoh. I would certainly dine in here again.

Author: minavianna
Title: Good
Review: Their foods is not that bad at all!, It taste so good and authentic!, If you love spiciness in your meal, try their tom yum!

Author: DickZe
Title: Good food and bad service
Review: A beautifully decorated restaurant offering buffet meals and à la carte. The food was nothing really special and the timing of service was very bad. A disappointment.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: percyvakilMumbai, India
Title: Burgers looked better than they tasted
Review: I tried a burger called Original Shack. It was just about ok. The fries were cold, the fixings in the burger were so dominated by pickles that it overpowered the other tastes. The beef patty itself was decent, the burger on the whole a let down.I liked the fact that they don't put sesame seeds on their burger bun.Service was slow.

Author: Jeff_KostyBangkok, Thailand
Title: OK for backpackers and fratboys
Review: Love Lane is backpacker party central. If you like backpacker party drinking/eating establishments, then you'll probably love it. If not, not. The service was prompt and friendly. Drinks were relatively cheap. Those were the best things about this place for me. I was in the mood for Mexican food. Not a lot of options that I know of in Penang. So, in spite of not being the sort of person looking for backpacker party joints, I gave it a try.The food was OK but not very Mexican. I had tacos. The fillings were good, but the tortillas weren't. What do I mean by "fratboy"? The signature cocktail is a margarita-ish vat with an upside down beer attached. as you drink the margarita the beer empties into the glass, turning it into a beer cocktail, then a beer. If the most important thing about a cocktail is volume, this is the one for you.

Author: elenasP6097VL
Title: Limited choice
Review: The restaurant used to served ready made pizzas with assorted choices. But for the passed one month, the shelf with pizzas is usually empty or with one or two choices of pizzas. The restaurant used to be better whereby customers could just drop by, order and leave with the tasty pizzas within 5 minutes. Now its a long wait because the pizzas are only baked after orders are placed. Disappointing....

Author: AbraCaBlingKuala Lumpur
Title: While it's still the "in" thing to do...
Review: Loads of stylista cafes mushrooming in KL and to us, this is just another one of those to cater for the increasing number of KL hipsters or hipster wannabes. Food is decent but nothing to shout about. Ambience is not too bad and it does provide a nice place for friends to get-together. We may visit again... but after we complete our "hipster" rounds at all the other available stylish cafes. Haha.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: S6957DGbrianr
Title: Poor poor service
Review: Poor poor service staff and cook chatting away it took almost an hour to get the kids food.The restaurant was not full to only 4 tables.

Author: MaiDivineLifeSan Francisco, California
Title: Over rated
Review: Came here tonight for dinner with my family. Atmosphere was nice & loved the Dan Tranh (Vietnamese 16string instrument) the woman was playing tonight. Presentation was really nice but Food was mediocre and unfulfilling. Flavored were quite off and not balanced. Wish it was better. Management tried to make it better, so for that they get two stars. I wouldn't recommend this place though.

Author: JamesMalaysia2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible atmosphere. Rude waiters.
Review: Awful ambiance - the staff was not welcoming, the place was completely empty and the decor was distasteful. It was freezing cold with too much air con, and there were still mosquitoes biting us on the face and hands at the table. Certainly not a nice place to go for a birthday celebration, so we decided to leave before even ordering. When we got up to leave, the waiter insulted us by implying the menu must be too expensive for us.

Author: docmarloweSingapore
Title: If you want some adventure, you have to try this
Review: I am not an adventurous type of person when it comes to dining. But this is something that those who look for an adventure must try in KL. The servers are visually challenged and you get to experience how they feel when they eat. It’s around 2 hours of eating blindly and you dont know what you are eating. Well, they wouldnt serve something that you are allergic to or if you state to them what are the things you cannot eat. As it is very dark inside, I wouldn’t advise you to wear a white shirt or pants as you can spill your food in your clothes. All the food taste good by the way but to me, having experienced it once is already fine with me.

Author: ernestoarvMiami, Florida
Title: Excellent Food. 100% recommended
Review: We visited Kuala Lumpur on2016 and one day walking close to the Hotel discovered this restaurant. We didn’t know the Pakistan food and after that date we fall in love with that food. We came back now and booked a hotel close to this restaurant. They keep the height quality of the food and the service is excellent. Definitively everything that I’ll visit KL for sure I’ll come back again.

Author: ConundrumMiaoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad bad service for the price
Review: Very bad service for the price. Staff isn't that polite in terms of placing the spoon and serving the dishes.La mian with sliced pork: average, noodle is chewy but soup has not much tasteLa mian with pork dumpling: average taste and very very spicyShanghai fried rice: nothing special, rice are too brokened downXiao long bao: not badhomemade herbal tea: watered down, barely have loh hon guo taste, not icy coldOverall: I'd rather go to Din Tai Fung. We totally don't enjoy the service here.

Author: Tsiaw Ying B
Title: Everything in mid-range except price~
Review: Food so-so, environment superb, staffs friendly but did not recommend or explain to us the special dayak food so we just order randomly. Quite pricey as the portion is small..

Author: ericdream91
Title: Bad and slow service!!!
Review: Slow and bad service. Waited for an hour and no immediate response. The waitresses just ignored the request. Will definitely think twice if need to go next time.
Restaurant: City Square Hong Kong Kim Gary Restaurant

Author: tam431
Title: Great service
Review: This restaurant offers good value. The menu is small but good. The service is excellent. Overall a very good experience.

Author: 386williamjSingapore, Singapore
Title: Taste of Malaysia
Review: I visited the chain store at City Square JB instead of the original store in the suburbs. The taste compares well to the famous 328 Laksa Katong back in Singapore. Recommended for those tourist keen on tasting what Malaysia and Singapore has to offer, unique to the rest of the world.

Author: alistairw2015
Title: There are better Indian places
Review: On the recommendation of s friend we tried this place last night, very average Indian food. Also it's purely vegetarian but we knew that before going. Average, wouldn't return.

Author: Azlinza H
Title: Lunch
Review: If you drive there just try to get parking under the bridge. Lots are limited and kinda tight. Restaurant was clean. Staffs are friendly and helpful. Food was tasty but a little bit too *salty.

Author: JanderraAustralia
Title: Do not eat here you will be ill
Review: I do normally review a restaurant the moment I leave but want to warn peopleThis is italian restaurant owned by Executive Chef Paola Pala. I asked if he was chef and was told yes. Asked again if he was there cooking and told no.Asked many questions about menu including if calamari was fresh. Of course it was.Had soup for entree and that was ok.Had 2 fried calamari with french fries for mains. Didnt like the smell, was the oil old, was it not fresh. Ate 4 pieces and sent it back, tough, cold and tasted wrong maybe it was from a frozen packet. French fries were definately McCain or something similar from a frozen packet Did not eat. After asking 4 times for manager and telling him problems he was apologetic and wanted to cook something else which we refused.He insisted on giving us free gelati.However 2 bites and I rushed from the restaurant voliently ill outside the restaurant. Calamari, calamari, calamari.As I only had light breakfast at the hotel knew it was the seafood.Deducted main course from bill but we should not have been charged anything.Restaurant needs to be careful to serve fresh seafood as someone could die.

Author: Dauz A
Title: Simply the best
Review: I was at the bar having the wine with touch of beautiful view and atmosphere. The service was superb I enjoyed and friendly . This place was good place for chill with friend and enjoy the drink and bar snacks. I will come back and want to try the food from the restaurant were I look at the menu was interesting.

Author: Damomelbourne1Melbourne, Australia
Title: Worst $500 meal I have ever had
Review: It's such a shame and sad to write this review. I will say the staff were great and the location and ambiance promised so much but the food just was uneatable.The best thing about the night was the drinks and the view.The offer of a complementary Olive parmesan and pesto starter was just awful even though free.Then to the meal. I took pictures thAt I will attach that looked fantastic but didn't taste the same.I had the Baratha and it was bland with no flavour. But I should not of spoken too soon for flavour - as my main of lobster angle hair pasta was a kick in the head. Presented fantastic but The lobster wasn't fresh and smelt off. The pasta was under cooked and the sauce was so rich with beef stock I couldn't eat it.Finally we tried the so called picnic. Looked like one but tasted like a sweet nightmare.Go for drinks and the view, not the food.

Author: Elaine KPerth, Australia
Title: Christmas Eve Dinner
Review: Booked in for the Christmas Eve dinner and clearly this is a restaurant popular with the local western community in Langkawi as it was fully subscribed. We had a nice traditional Christmas dinner with turkey, glazed ham, plenty of types of salad and side dishes and dessert. Clearly Michelle is an accomplished cook. Although we had a good time and food was good home cooking, in retrospect, we should have booked someplace else for Christmas as it would have been nice to have something other than what we could have gotten back home. The cost was RM 100 per person inclusive of free flow drinks, inclusive of beer and wines. We felt it was a tad pricey by Langkawi standards.

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Need Better Service
Review: Food : If you tried actual Japanese food before the , the rating wil be 2/5. Food arrive coldAmbient : Lighting good, hygiene good. Noise : acceptable levelService : Poor. Very slow. But if you are the type busy with the phone at all the times, then is acceptable, cause you never time flies.It take abt 15mins to get one beer.

Author: ysl_juniorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork satay with pineapple based peanut sauce
Review: We went around 3+ in the afternoon and they have run out of chicken satay. Hence, we ordered pork and liver satay. The satay is a bit small size. Taste ok. The sauce is slightly sourish as it is pineapple based. We still prefer the regular peanut sauce.The shop is quite near to Casa del Rio Hotel, and facing the river.We searched for the location in Waze and it shows that the shop is closed (on a Monday). But we decided to call the shop and found out that they are open every day. So, do give them a call if you are unsure.

Author: NishchalSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Big name with worst service
Review: Location is real good, by the river, on one end of Jonker street... and live music adds to the ambience.Went in a hope to experience the same.Ordered couple of dishes... and relaxed for a while...Relaxing times stretched... but no serving yet.After a while, reminded a staff about the order, and continued waiting....Kept waiting in a hope order will be quickly served... as already reminded.After really Long wait and losing patience, again enquired about the order, .... after a while... staff came apologising for missing order and started asking again about the order....was the last straw to break...Cancelled the order and walked off from really a Hard Rock... a real shame on the staff and the managing team.

Author: Travelator72Kuala Lumpur, Msia
Title: Last time for a long time
Review: My friends and I come here around 3-4 times a year. We've found the food to be tasty most times but yes, it is definitely pricey. Tonight though we had problems with two dishes, the fish and the RM220 Australian crab. When we spoke to the male manager, he didn't seem apathetic. When we spoke to him again for a second time and asked if we could maybe get a small discount for the rubbery crab and fish, he did not offer a single sen. Wrong move.. he could have offered even a plate of complimentary fruits and we would have been appeased. So, no more Mei Keng Fatt for a long time. Or recommending it to any of our visiting friends from abroad. To be honest, May Mei just next door had several tables taken up. It seems like a good alternative, so we will take our business there next time. This isn't the way to treat your customers, especially repeat customers.

Author: Thomas NMiri
Title: Disappointed service from floor service
Review: The food although is good, but the service sometimes can be bad due to long queue and confusion in kitchen, e.g. fish ordered were half cooked, when asked why, waiter offered to recook, but I said it's not tasty anymore, they still recook the same fish. Waited for 30mins + then still they confused and let it waites at the serving counter and not served. At the end, rejected the order as we finished eating evrything and were full.On another incident, preordered an expensive pumpkin seafood pot, when arrived to pick-up the dish, a hair was found in it, the head waiteress said I cannot see it, let me put on glasses, still she said it's nothing nig deal. I ask her what she will do, her replies were it is nothing can be done, maybe just a fan blew the hair into it.At the end after some arguement, she offered either recook or replacement. I said I just want to know what can she do? The whole convesation ended without apology from her. I being generous, paid the dish.Utterly, disappointed as I never thought it should ended like this as a loyal customer to this restaurant.

Author: Lesley WSwindon, United Kingdom
Title: Very average!
Review: We went to this Chinese eatery after being advised that it was one of the best around Kuala Lumpur! This was so not true!Our server couldn’t have been and more miserable had she of tried! We ordered 3 dishes of food but only got two! When we asked about the other dish the server tried to make out we had received it and eaten it, she even looked under our table! She then took the food list out of the little holder and scribbled something in Chinese on it!The lady who came to take our money was nearly as fed up as the other! When we questioned about the missing food she said that they had ran out of the meal we wanted, no one thought to tell us! On the table next to us we’re a delightful mother & son from Perth who had also had the same experience!If I ever come back here this is one place I would never eat in again!

Author: Sush1206Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Buffet worth the Price
Review: Good Food gives Good Mood :)Delhi Royale is one such place with wide spread of Delicacies! For me the buffet was indo-chinese combo!For Non-Veg lovers its a treat you have chicken, mutton and fish fry. Though the buffet menu keeps changing.Veg was good too with 1 starter and paneer dish and bhendi masala.Fried rice, mushroom chilly in Chinese section.The Chicken Biryani was yum yum.Drink is also included in the PAC. However it's limited :( 2 Desserts to end with :)Groupon provides discount coupons at times do check before you go....

Author: HemahM2
Title: The Best
Review: I went once but trust me this is one of the best restaurant i have been. I wish to visit here once again and with my family of course :)

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: Nice try
Review: Visited this place because many of my friends did. Name of restaurant was catchy. Food was ok, worth a try. Majority of the menu consists of duck, even the cheese cake =) We ordered Duck Love Platter, Duck Confit, Salted Egg Cheese Cake. All good.Be sure to make reservation. This place is always full. :DAddress: 40, Nagore Road, 10050, Georgetown, Penang.Business Hours: 11: 30 am to 2: 30 pm; 5: 30 pm to 10: 30 pm. Closed on Wednesdays.Contact Number: 604- 227 8840

Author: ParvezSinghSidhuPerth, Australia
Title: Can Be Better
Review: Great place however need proper staffing during evening hours. I saw service coming to almost standstill during evening cocktail hours on all the 3 nights, I was there despite only few guests there. Need to raise the bar for drinks being served. Jemimah is the best among the crew there.

Author: NanpacificSpringfield, Missouri
Title: Nice Atmosphere but Average Food
Review: We selected this place as it was rated number 2 in Batu Ferringhi. I thought the food was really pretty average, and much pricier than other places I felt were better. This restaurant has a nice atmosphere and is located on the main street of Batu Ferringhi. It serves Chinese, Malaysian and Indian food. My husband had fish and chips which he said was greasy and tasteless. I had Thai and was also disappointed. I would not return here again.

Author: TKThunder
Title: Horrible Waiter
Review: The waiter with glasses was very very rude and unwelcoming both times I went. The food is great but the place is let down by terrible service.

Author: qimorabellucci
Title: Bad attitude staff,houseplaying
Review:
Im very dissapointed about the food ( fried rice ), poor food.
Drink to sweet...staff always playing infront custemor,im not finish my fried rice because the food very OMG....better im having plain congge than fried rice....i cant except this moment..
Tqvm...S.C.R the spring...

Author: shokadooKL
Title: Daughter's Birthday
Review: Food was not up to expectation. Staffs were too playful and manager was horrible in handling complains. Never order the pork loin...the presentation an taste were horrid. Please do not serve food when you have a lousy chef and staffs that are just there to flirt and entertain themselves. There were also unexpected visitor, the fly!
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Title: relax dining place for Friday night
Review: the surrounding was cool, dim light with excellent choice of music. After a great meal, some of us ordered the dessert while the waiter kept asking if we want others, whom was super friendly. The food was above average, but I really love the music there. We were a large group, and unfortunately was being placed near the entrance. Nonetheless, come here if you want to relax with a couple of alcohol drinks.

Author: 886kennylKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Where’s the Sabayon dessert?
Review: I remembered Chalet in Equatorial Hotel for their Dancing Sabayon Dessert presentation. However not only did they not have this, Sabayon wasn’t even on their menu. Very odd indeed. But none the less the ambiance was great.

Author: anki28Chennai (Madras), India
Title: Brilliant view but not great food
Review: The view to this restaurant is breath taking but the food is just fancy by appearance ! The options are very minimal n portions are small.

Author: iamthesaSarawak, Malaysia
Title: Where's my mi jawa
Review: Mom's laksa in haji taha The laksa was definitely yummy but the mi jawa I waited for the mi jawa for a good 30 minutes so decided to asked them again just in case they forgot about it yup obviously they don't remember and their response was definitely so disappointing when your costumers talk to you at least respond. So guess what? My mi jawa never came! What a great way to start my Sunday morning!!

Author: Amjad_Gafar
Title: Bad place, bad food, they
Review: Bad place, bad food, they will waste your time, took them 20 minutes after ordering to inform me that they don’t have my order item, and cancels my order without informing me. Will never order again, and I advice you to save your money and try much better places that respect its customer. Seriously, this is the worst restaurant in town. Run, and keep running away from this restaurant as far away as you could.

Author: NouranYaAbuja, Nigeria
Title: perfect taste
Review: I was staying in Casa del Mar, and every morning I was enjoying a very nice breakfast in La SalI tried around 6 plates from their breakfast menu, and each one was better than the otherI had a chance to try the dinner one night, and as expected, it was with the same quality like the breakfast, specially the shrimp started (the one in the attraction picture) unbelievable taste and textureI loved the restaurant, and dinner their is so romantic, and they have an extra romantic atmosphere if required ;D
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive and saltish
Review: We drop by this restaurant for lunch enroute from Singapore to port Dickson and regretted our decision. Should have just drove all the way to port Dickson and have our lunch there.The food was expensive and honestly, seems like the standard has dropped a fair bit. The last time we visited, it was already not very good. We told the servers to use less salt and the fried eggs were so saltish that I thought it was horrible. The beef Rendang was so chewy that I find it hard to swallow. The chili sauce was the only saving grace. There are many options around melaka.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: iloveswkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Thailand, almost Thailand.
Review: I love the Tom Yam Soup. It is delicious and savoury. Price mid range and affordable. If I crave for Thai food. I will eat here. The petai is delicious too. Unfortunately, the mango sticky rice is dry and lack of flavour. I've tasted better I suppose. Overall, satisfactory.

Author: ccfchew_23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good pizza , even better pasta!
Review: Stopped by their midvalley branch to try out the pizza. Slice of meatball pizza was good, love the base. While their selling point is their pizza, their pasta I thought was even better. The bolognese was really good. Good kick in the sauce. Good service overall.

Title: Amazing Restaurant
Review: One of the finest Restaurant l have had the pleasure to dine. Over 3 days, we had several Breakfasts, Lunches and Dinners. Every meal was awesome. Good choices, plentiful quantity and superb service.Most enjoyable meal was the Fishboat, that you cook about 18 items on your table in Chicken Soup or Tom Yum Soup. Then fine with 5 delicious sauces.

Author: willkuciaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good value sunday brunch
Review: Good value brunch. Very good staff and good value for money. Food is nice and vibe is relaxed. Would recommend to go.

Author: New2Langkawi2Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Penang food!
Review: We've been to Little Penang Kafe at Mid Valley Megamall a couple of times, and both times we enjoyed the food tremendously. We've tried their "char kueh teow" (normal one) and it was really good. Despite the fact it was advertised that there is a wait time of 20 minutes for the char kueh teow, ours was delivered reasonably quickly, in around 10 minutes. We've also tried their "assam laksa" which was also good. It had that authentic Penang herbs and spices flavour. Their "Penang Mee Jawa" (also known as mee rebus) was also very tasty. I enjoyed it very much. We also ordered their "Homestyle Fried Rice" which had a smoky flavour, very good. And finally, their "Penang Rojak" was simply sensational. We love the food there.

Author: TmenziesJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Don't Walk Past!
Review: This is a great concept with a wonderful take on an 'industrial' architecture. The front is a little plain and hard to spot in the day time - so don't miss it by mistake!There is a small coffee/cake shop as you enter, and then the main event - a completely empty space created by gutting two shophouses. Housed in this 'warehouse' is a semi open kitchen, very spacious seating, and trees!The menu is short, but includes a number of interesting options - including paleo... We went for the 'awesome salmon' and the (non paleo) blue cheese burger, both of which were cooked perfectly and very tasty.Definitely one to visit, even if just to experience the space...

Author: Ice_Berg111Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What happened to the prices?
Review: This is my second review for the place - but had to review it again as the prices seem to have increased quite dramatically (almost 60 RM for a old fashioned? No thanks) to almost double that of any premier KL establishment. I know the view should command a higher price but seems too much.

Author: Bikbergen
Title: Great experience
Review: You get excellent service here but then you pay for the privilege of having dinner here. Bring a lot of money to pay the bill.

Author: pillay15Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Unpleasant experience
Review: The food spread was very poor for buffet dining.Most items were cold as ice Most were clearly the left overs from the buffet lunch. For example I opened the roasted chicken tray and saw about 8 pieces of chicken. Then I opened the stir fried vegetable tray, I just saw very small quantities. I informed one staff and he just smiled and went off. There were less than 20 people during that time. One staff told me the crowd is there only on Friday and Saturdays with a better spread with BBQ. I was there on a Wednesday but I am still paying the full price! If what is told is true, then avoid the buffet dining here on weekdays.Service by the waiters was acceptable as dined plates were removed within a reasonable time.

Author: bbteh
Title: Food based on family recipes
Review: This casual, airy, neat and clean establishment is primarily operated by 2 sisters. Their signature offerings are based on family recipes, especially the asam laksa. Some ingredients are particularly unique- do try! They provide delivery services too, subject to a minimum order.

Author: ShahrulnidzaD
Title: Arrogant staffs
Review: Don’t bother visiting here anymore. The food is just okay. But the service is getting worse each time. This time, I had to call 5 times for a waiter to take our order. Most of the time they’d say “wait” when they’re not that busy. They all look dead. Food is overrated and overpriced. It’s meant for tourists.

Author: lillyjo6363Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner cum supper
Review: Menu of food was quite limited with most being vegetarian dishes. We ordered satay, which tasted rather different from the conventional ones as the sauce had a sour-ish taste to it. The rice dishes was served with brown rice. Service was average and food took a bit of time to arrive. The deco in this cafe had a rustic look to it decorated with old memorabilia.

Author: pokemon_sSingapore
Title: Seafood is not fresh, had food poisoning thereafter
Review: We read the positive comments and decided to give this restaurant a try. Great disappointment! We ordered a lobster, is not expensive but not fresh. We ended up with mild food poisoning that evening. Over-rated eatery. This restaurant is next to a dirty and smelly channel.

Author: Lovefood786Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: NOT VERY ENJOYABLE
Review: The nicely decorated lounge and bow ties were not enough to make this dining experience pleasurable. Having visited this restaurant after reading online reviews we were very disappointed. We wanted a lamb seekh kebab starter but it wasn't available, then decided to order chapal kebab, that wasn't available either so in the end we had chicken and fish tikkas, lamb karahi, channa masala and naan bread. The starters were not very well flavoured, the lamb karahi consisted of long thin pieces of fatty meat and was ok tasting but no where near as good as authentic karahis. The chana masala was bland and we were struggling to eat it. The naans are small to begin with and are then quartered before serving! No sauces are served with the starters, the first Pakistani/Indian restaurant we have ever been to where this has been the case.We visited as a family and none of us enjoyed the food, this is not Pakistani food and definitely not good quality food however is charged at a premium price tag.

Author: DenisetkjKuala Lumpur
Title: I'm spoiled!
Review: I'm a regular at Iketeru and because of the incredible quality of the food and the excellent chefs, I can no longer enjoy Japanese food as much in other Japanese restaurants in Malaysia.The sashimis are amazing and very fresh, complimented with the good cuts and techniques by Chef Johnny and Fai. I highly recommend this restaurant. Try to get a spot at the sashimi counter if you want to enjoy great sashimis and look for Chef Johnny!

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Heavenly sambal
Review: Still good as ever. The sambal was really heavenly and a perfect accompaniment to the rice steamed with coconut milk. The rice is cooked in a steamer unlike other establishments that take the shortcut of cooking the rice in a large electric rice cooker.The restaurant had a recent makeover and looked more enticing than before.

Author: Getaway824299
Title: Food sucks
Review: Don't waste time here. Food was lousy and price was expensive. We ordered petai prawn and the prawns were FROZEN little shrimp. Told the restaurant owner and all he did was just give us a grin and said 'yes ah' in Cantonese.

Author: apragu2022
Title: Cheers🍻
Review: Came in the afternoon and had a great day here. Great spot, nice view and most of all, excellent service from Milon and the team. Keep it up. Cheers 🍻

Author: tfcheang
Title: Would be better if have more curry variety.
Review: Had the garlic cheese naan. Naan was soft and filled with loads of cheese. The amount of garlic was just right for me but garlic lovers would prefer it more. It would be even better if thick, Northern Indian curries are offered.

Author: bma_1981Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I love their food, but...
Review: I went there for dinner. As usual, there was no place for me to sit (regular table), so they suggested I sit on the bar. Since I was starving, I went to the bar and ordered my food.First issue: the waiter kept bringing me stuff I did not order and ask me if they were mine.Second issue: I got my food warm, not hot. Especially my Classic Natchos were somehow, COLD!Last issue, which is the worst: I saw a mouse (or a small rat) running on the floor below the bar shelves...I guess I'm not going to visit it anymore...

Author: LobsterlyySubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Servers missed our order
Review: My bf and I were already very hungry when we came in, and managed to get last order (9pm). However, they forgot to key in one of our mains and when we complained, they merely apologised meekly and said nothing can be done. I understand that human mistakes can happen, but now we will have to set off to find another place to satisfy our hunger pangs. Maybe the place should’ve offered some free snacks/drink as a compensation? The best they did was to recommend us to order dessert, but who would even eat dessert before their mains ??Was not satisfied .

Author: Gil G
Title: Shared table.
Review:
Friendly-ish waitresses. 
Have to share table with another 5 people. So there's an awkward moment of ordering the food. 
Full of signs warning you not to do anything. Spill water. Open window. Closure dates. Mind your head. Etc. 
price wasn't so bad.

Author: Ryan E
Title: Amazing experience and service
Review: We've wanted to do this in London so finding this on our holiday in KL for a fraction of the price was a must do night out. Arriving at the restaurant you are can't help notice the sweet smell. Once checking in, you are immediately quizzed on what it was. This is the start of the journey where your eyes are taken out of the equation. Once completed you are then given a second task. They blind folded you and ask you to find 4 paperclips in a bucket of rice. Easy you may think but the task was quite difficult. Once ready you are given your waiter, who is blind or partially sighted, Holding their shoulders you are escorted to your table. Knowing that this is in the dark, I don't think anything prepares you for just how dark it actually is. Our waiter, Cornelius was amazing. Very attentive, calming and thorough. He provided us with each course , each time advising on ways to eat and checking all is well. The food itself was amazing and having no sight just added to the excitement. Me and my partner found that we made up with lack of sight by being more descriptive in our conversation but also having quite a laugh. As much as I am quite a foodie, we managed to guess only a small portion of what we was eating. This made us quite surprised at just how much we rely on our sight when they reveal the menu at the end. Having enjoyed the epic experience, we left astounded at the service and just how good the blind waiters are but also humbled and the feeling of just how lucky I am to have all my sense. This is a must do for KL....well done the staff.

Author: 2020Amia
Title: Great Taste
Review: Its a non halal chinese food which serve pork and alcohol. I tried a few dishes with family and friends (refer picture).I really like the tofu and mango drinks. The pork with chilli is a bit spicy for my taste bud but it also delicious. Overall would recomend and will come back to try the other dishes.

Author: TyngPCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Afternoon Tea By The KLCC Park
Review: Some of the cakes here, especially the ones with Valrhona cacao were of excellent quality. The otherwise lovely afternoon had some hiccups as the staff member who served us when we were selecting cakes at the counter weren't professional & not friendly. Asked what's the ingredients other than cacao, answered chocolate. Same answer from the annoyed girl for all the 3 cakes I asked about, despite the cakes were of different layers & brownish tones. Asked if the different layers contain fruits or nuts, answered they all have nuts. Eventually asked if she could please find out from the chef, she finally took out a sheet of laminated paper with some info about the cakes! For a cafe in 5 stars hotel, the level of service was very poor, as this place should be one of those which set benchmark for the F&B & hospitality industry. The visit was saved by the lovely garden view, & more importantly by other staff members that were attentive & friendly. They even kindly reminded me to mind the steps when going down the stairs. The Biscotti that came with our coffee & tea weren't fresh. It's a pity because they used to be very good to the level that we always bought some (by weight) to take away.

Author: MissRanieBandung, Indonesia
Title: Bukit Bintang rude waitress, average taste
Review: Me and friends visited this place because it's on the must try restaurant list in KL based on several websites.The food was okay, it is not as good as I thought it would. And the staff who serve us is not friendly and not helpful. We're tourist and we took sometimes to decide what to eat, and we asked a lot about the food to the waitress but she was not seems happy and acting quite rude. And it wasn't even a peak hour! I will not visit the restaurant again.

Author: Shamie S
Review: The ambiance is relaxing plus they have a good tasting beverages. I can say that this place are best for people who likes a quiet place to chill.👌

Author: Zura A
Title: Expensive!
Review: The price is quite rip off! 10 of us eating, we ordered 2 fishes, 1kg of prawn, squid and mussels, the bill came for RM700+. For me its ridiculously expensive

Author: Trvlbug1974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food not bad, let down by poor service
Review: Cititel Branch : Came here for dinner, table of 4. Food not too bad but for what it is, the price is on the high side, bill came up to RM230++ . We had something like a peking duck dish where we wrap our own pancakes, asked to refill our plate of cucumber & spring onions and the reply was quite a rude, we have to charge you for that, I said yeah no problem, when they brought a new plate, there was only cucumber no spring onion but I didn't want to make a big fuss as we were with guests.Setia City Mall Branch: Dinner, table for 2. We arrived about 8.30pm with at least 10 empty tables but we were left waiting in a queue to get in. They were quite understaffed. When finally seated, it took quite awhile to get our orders taken. We ordered 2 drinks, 1 crispy eel, 1 fried rice, 2 varieties of dumplings and red bean pancake for dessert. First to arrive was the pancake whch is dessert, when we asked why are we getting the dessert first, the answer was we didn't tell them we wanted it last as dessert and our reply was the waiter did not ask and it is understood desserts come last? He then went on to give us a lot of feeble excuses when a simple sorry I'll bring that out later for you would have been appropriate. After awhile our dimsum came followed by fried rice. No crispy eel when we finished what was served and we had a hard time catching any server's attention and finally the eel appeared and then had to ask for our pancake which took a long time to arrive and it wasn't fresh. Bill came to over 80 Ringgit. No complaints about the price if we get proper service but after this experience, I am definitely not coming back.Dragon-i has better decor but Din Tai Fung will give you a much better experience with friendly taiwanese style service and better food.

Author: 335jefflTaipei
Title: Average ambience, disappointing taste
Review: The restaurant has name quaint Chinese motif posters and calligraphy that didn't really go together but it's retro quitche so doesn't really matter. However, the food isn't really tasty, everything is bland and pretty much tasteless. It's not right that you can drink the sambal like a soup, where is the spice?! Rendang beef also was not very tasty either. The coconut milk was just about the strongest flavouring that they put... Boring!. With all the hyped reviews we were expected to be wow-ed, but instead we were meh-ed.

Author: Sukan28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for Tea
Review: My wife and I love this place and we often go there on the weekend for afternoon tea. Great variety of tea and les pastisseries. The service is good or shall I say used to be. We became good friends with some of the waiters there. Now they were both gone. We are now served by overseas students who clearly have no interest in serving you. But put that aside, great place to be for tea....

Author: 191carolefSwitzerland
Title: Back in time food and ambiance
Review: We really enjoyed their freshly made popiah - they catered to all the different requests regarding spiciness and vegan options. The laksa was simple but delicious and the rojak was also freshly made and tasty. The highlight is definitely the popiah - haven’t had such good ones for years.

Author: Frank D
Title: Nice and quiet
Review: This is a tastefully decorated restaurant, cool and quiet yet just off the main road. The fish dishes, especially, were excellent. Staff were fine, though perhaps they could have been a bit more on the ball. Would happily return.

Author: Norberto_indonesiaDenpasar, Indonesia
Title: A bit slow serving food if compare to other of the same style
Review: We had dinner tonight, we had pause waiting for meet to come sometimes 5 minutes between a piece of meet and other. Price is 119MYR ( saturday and dinner price per person)Buffet is really good, a lot of different meals, salad was good, food was tasty and good meet... no much of tenderloin...overall was good, will repeat again.

Author: Karis SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice concept and tasty food
Review: Atmosphere is very hip with loud music, jovial and friendly staffs, good crowd and definitely a good drinking place to go with the tasty food. Security officer that jaga the vehicles and parking is also very friendly. Pork rib is super tender and tasty to cover the porky smell. Mee goreng is just instant noodle so nothing special. Price is on the high side especially for beverage but overall still value for money in terms of ambience and service.

Author: Woon29Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not as great as what everyone says.
Review: The food is just average but we love the kangkong best. The food were served very fast. Hence I do agree that the dishes were all precooked. However I am glad that it is extremely cheap to eat here. Most of the staff are very rude. I also spotted them sweeping all the rubbish from the table to the floor while they clear the table for the next person. Hope that they can improve their service and ambience.

Author: DanielasQ598OKP
Title: Really wow, don’t waste your time or money
Review:
The title says it all.
An unpleasant touristic attraction: from an unhealthy menu ( immediately after with food poisoning) to an uninteresting program with a few singers and dancers.
Do your self a favor and spare your time, money and health for better.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Probably past its prime
Review: Awarded best Chinese restaurant by KL Time Out 2010 and 2012, and best restaurant by Tatler 2013 and 2014.Decent food but not fine dining level. The Chinese style cooking was well executed. Everything tasted fine. But nothing amazed.The marble goby was fresh and steamed Cantonese style, just right. The tofu with diced scallop and crabmeat, the spinach in superior soup with wolfenberries, and the fried noodle with shredded duck meat were fine but did not astound the taste buds.While the durian butter cake with coconut ice cream was delicious, there really was not much to call it durian.Service wise, perhaps our mistake to be in a private room. Plates were not changed. Tea was not topped up.The restaurant was quite empty. Perhaps I came three years late. Given the above average food and the below average service, I had to rate it a 3/5.

Author: MJvixenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: An absolute turn off
Review: Back in 2013, we had been dining regularly at the outlet located at Menara Tan and Tan. The breakfast was consistently cooked to perfection, hot and delicious.Since we are back in country, we thought of visiting the outlet at Mid Valley. It was our first time visiting the outlet and we were shocked how poorly the quality and taste of the food we ordered were served. We ordered an Egg Benedict and a Berry French Toast. At once glance when the Egg Benedict was served, it would have been seating at the kitchen counter for some time as a layer of skin was already formed at the top of the Hollandaise Sauce. The piece of bacon was full of fat and the piece of toast was soggy. As for the Berry French Toast, it was dry and undercooked. Absolutely horrible.The only consolation was the piccolo latte. That’s about it. For a bill of RM99.75, it was absolutely not worth revisiting.

Author: JanineF74Toronto, Canada
Title: Charged us for Wifi but didn't tell us
Review: So we went to Sun Cafe again....and I didn't realize it until later when I looked at the bill, but they charged us for Wifi! We always ask for the wifi password when visiting a restaurant/cafe etc....and I've never seen them charge for Wifi. Even if they were charging for Wifi, it's not okay to just add it to a customer's bill without letting them know beforehand.

Author: LouisexinKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Lovin' it
Review: One of the best places to hang out afterwork or dining spot with excellent services and Lebanese food at reasonable price in Kuala Lumpur.Especially lovin' their pizza and Lebanese sandwiches! Extra point for visitors would be we can drop by any time after an eventful night outing for supper on Friday and Saturday cuz its open till 5 in the morning. Yummz.

Author: SanJK89
Title: Amazing spot
Review: Great place, affordable drinks and decent crowd. Service is fairly good and the manager is friendly. Good place to watch football game too. Don't miss out their Friday happy hour beer promo!

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Waze my way here to find the location
Review: Thank god there's waze now days , just key in 486 Baba Low and it will bring you there . I came here alone after my breakfast at my hotel and I was greedy and I want to try a few of the dishes as it was my first time to this place and I really love mee Siam . At the end I have to take away some of the dishes as I can't finish the food .The ambience was a shack surrounded with big trees so it was kind of shady . My mee Siam taste ok , poh piah ,cendol and pai tee taste so so . Am I coming back here in future ? Why not .

Author: mohamadsaufib
Title:
Food was great,....
Ambience
Review:
Food was great,....
Ambience good,....
My ribs was awesome,.....
Great food great family,....
What more can you ask for,....

Author: jmptripsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: sadly dissapointing...
Review: As someone who used to live in Manhattan, my craving for a New York cheesy and saucy pizza went terribly unanswered. The pizzas 18", very large, crusts are doughy, unflavorful, and eveb with some toppings, very dry and disappointing. At $20-27 per 18" pizza, this is by far the most expensive pizza I have had in KL and by far the driest and least satisfying.The pepperoni is the only one I would try again.

Author: Faradila Z
Title: Very bad experience
Review: For the firsttimer like me, i feel very bad experience. I came with my husband n little son. Nobody welcoming us n i understand when read "self service" here. Menu were so plain and didnt have any pic on it. Look at the price, my expection was very high. I ordered pasta, ice latte, ice mocha caramel, caesar salad with chicken, nuttella pancake for dessert. Nothing special with the food taste. Ice latte n mocha caramel was so not as what i expected. Pasta ok laa.. but the caesar salad n chicken its really not reasonable with the price. And i didnt get my dessert. Service? Hmm. I dun like it. They even wrongly charged me the menu that i had cancel. My investment for having birthday celebrating here RM 50 was really not satify me. I would never come here again and i'm not suggesting this cafe to any friends.

Author: AngelUnicorn11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed!
Review: It's been a while since we dine at Du Viet. Decided we had dinner here. Very disappointed . The standard has come down tremendously compare to when they started. We had Vietnamese Crepe, Spring & Summer roll delight, steamed wrap rolls and Traditional mixed beef noodles. The Vietnamese crepe was really soggy when it should have been crispy. Spring rolls was also a disappointment in terms of freshness. Steam wrap rolls was ok but I remember the filling were more and tasty. The tendons in the beef noodles was not tender. Sorry to say we were pretty disappointed :(
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: CamXanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Hard Rock Cafe In The World
Review: Returned to Hard Rock Cafe in Kuala Lumpur after 1 year and WOW it’s totally rubbish now and by my extensive travels and collecting my tracking points I can now comfortably say it’s the worst one in the world.1. Ordered two steaks that had to be sent back as they were raw in the middle.2. The vegetables were almost uncooked, hard and barely warm3. My child’s meal was forgotten4. The bill came with 2 errors: a)Adult milkshake charged instead of child’s milkshake, b) Beet salad was wrong price from menu5. When I complained the steak they took back and returned totally overdone6. The cashier said thanks for pointing out wrong pricing so they can change the computer price accordingly (I guess the manager there don’t have any brain or just lazy??)There was no apology no compensation nothing, I also did not ask and can only share my feedback to others and also I will never go back there.Shame on you Hard Rock Cafe Kuala Lumpur for being the worst Hard Rock Cafe in the world with the worst management. Totally pathetic.Pity there’s not a zero rating.

Author: martyna_polskaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good spot for a sweet brekkie
Review: We had crepes with banana, jam and mango accompanied by fresh orange juice and very very good coffee (nespresso) . The staff was nice and in general it was a good brekkie!

Author: LelabongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: suckling pig's taste has drop...
Review: I was fans of El Cerdo for few years, fans of their special ceremony before eat the famous suckling pork, fans of their enviroment, fans of suckling pork's taste. And was celebrated birthday, friends' birthday, gathering etc several times at there.However, since last year, around end of year 2012, went with another fans, found the taste of suckling pig was have slight odor. Then, thought maybe that batch supply maybe just not that good. And, we went again not more than 1 month, found same.From that time.. we just never go again.And, another point to highlight: was treated by one rude waitress as well.....quite pretty but just rude.

Author: miss_maddymelbourne
Title: A healthy feast and friendly service.
Review: This was our first and only dining experience in Bangsar Village and it was top-notch! I am a bit of a healthy food nut and it's tough to find unique vegan food here. I had some crazy quinoa dish - it was different, but it worked!Service was wonderful. Great vibe, cool atmosphere.My only 'complaint'... no white wine in stock! (A catastrophe in my books)

Author: Tom SGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: still the best place to drink in Penang!!
Review: Every year I post a few comments about HEaley Macs just to let anyone who is interested to see if things have changed. Glad to report that it is still the best boozer on the Island!! Although Benji has left and we have lost that cetain "Irishness" our new manager has fitted in well and the excellent assistant mananger, Kamel, still keeps the place lively and interesting. great pub quiz on a monday run by the efficient, if somewhat moody, Dave. keep up the good work!!

Author: Yologer
Title: First ever restaurant that 'forgets' a pre-booked Birthday celebration!
Review: This was my first visit to Langkawi and pre-planned for my birthday. The reservation was made a week or more in advance and the restaurant was informed that it was a birthday celebration. However, it was disappointing that they omitted the celebratory cake and singing but did it for another party celebrating at the same time. Not sure how its possible to 'forget' someone's reservation and notification in advance but some processes need to be improved. Thanks for making it not memorable for me.If you are willing to pay for a pricey dinner with views at sunset (randomly cloudy then) and experience lying on hammocks overhanging the sea, the food was so-so. The server we had was quite indifferent and lacked a sincere warmth; very cursory and curt.

Author: violet818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chaine des Rotisseurs AGM Dinner
Review: Lovely ambience with a grand panoramic view. Food was excellent and well presented and service good.

Author: LeeN1105
Title: Antipondean Cafe
Review:
Very delicious, service good service, very nice environment, a very good place for chill out with friends and also family. Definitely will come again for the next round
Highly recommended for gathering and also chill out.

Author: ZyenPetaling Jaya, Selangor
Title: Two star service in a six star hotel
Review: My friend and I happened to be in Royale Chulan for an event, and we decided to have an early dinner at Warisan Cafe which is in the hotel.When we arrived, we wanted to sit at a table which had a couch instead of at the table with chairs; however the two tables that were still available hadn’t even been cleaned up yet. So we had to take a table which had chairs instead.We had to wait for a while before my friend finally flagged someone for the menu. Mind you, it’s not that they were unaware that we were there; a waitress had tried to direct us to the standalone table before we attempted to take the table with the couch.And even so, we found that the staff were more focused on cleaning up the two tables that we initially took a look at, instead of handing us the menu.We placed our order, and then waited for our early dinner to arrive. It took a really long time. I didn’t actually check the time because for once I wasn’t wearing my watch, but think it was more than 20 minutes before our food arrived.My friend had ordered tenderloin steak, whereas I ordered the rack of lamb. And as we picked up our fork, we suddenly realised that it was only accompanied with a spoon and a butter knife.My friend hailed the head waiter and all she did was hold up the butter knife and gave him a look. Fortunately he did know what she was referring to, because he promptly called a waitress to get steak knives. I couldn’t really hear what he said, but there was something about “if they are not at the back, get them from…” and I couldn’t make out where.And it was another five minutes before the waitress appeared through the front door (she had gone out through a side door) with two steak knives. By then I had eaten all my accompanying vegetables and mashed potatoes as I had been pretty hungry.The food was not excellent. I would say that the quality is acceptable, but not excellent. It is typical of restaurants within hotels to charge high prices, but normally the food quality would also match the price. I have honestly had much better food at five-star restaurants at a fraction of the price.My friend’s steak was still very raw although she asked for medium. Halfway through, she sent the steak back for further cooking, and when it came back, it was not much better. My friend told me, “Six star hotels would usually rearrange the vegetables on the plate to make it look nice.” That’s based on her experiences of six star hotels. Her plate came back looking the same way she sent it back. Personally though, I’d probably prefer it that way because it means no one (theoretically) touched my food.After we ate, my friend called for the bill, and we waited for five minutes in vain, so we flagged another waiter for the bill, who said that the bill was on the way. We again had to wait for another five minutes for our change. The waiter who returned the change explained that their “system was down”.That hardly explains why the service was so shoddy. This is not to say that the service staff were not polite. They are polite as most staff are in the service industry. It was just not six star service. The price and star rating hardly justified the service we got.I think the only people who would eat there are hotel guests, or like in our case, are already there and just need something to eat. I would certainly not bother to go out of my way to this restaurant in this hotel for a meal. I have been to much better places closer to home with far better food and better service, at a signficantly lower cost.

Author: enjoyoverseastrip
Title: Tong Sheng Restaurant
Review: Restoran Tong Sheng MalaccaWe heard of this need to queue early restaurant that all talk about. It was a normal non aircon type of coffeeshop. After grabbing there we manage to be in the queue for about 15 persons ahead of us. It was a friday night and the order taker was rather impatient whilst taking our orders but we managed to be seated 15 minutes later.We ordered the famous cheese beehoon big head prawns and the taste is pretty normal. Prices are a bit above average.

Author: Michael Y
Title: Extremely Bad Service
Review: Waiters are basically more important than customers. Don't have a place to sit and waiters are sitting on a table enjoying the view of me looking for a table. The bald Manager is also not bothered. Finally when there is a table vacant, bald manager says it is reserved. Might as well just close the place to inform walk in customer that your place is already fully booked!! Will not come here again!!

Author: LeonKSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bad service. Ok food.
Review: Went for a birthday party. Had their private area with buffet set up. Lunch was from 12 onwards but food was onlu ready after 1pm. Once the drinks came, it was warm liquid that was dispensed. Had to get them to bring it to the back to get it mixed again. Slow with food top up too. And I was just invited to the party not the organizer . Imagine calling ur guest at 12pm and food to be served an hour later. Thank god i wasnt the organizer.

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Peranakan Food
Review: True to taste Peranakan food although there is no pork. Must try is the Chendol, not to creamy and sweet. The taste is just right. The ambience is nice as the restaurant is housed in an old Peranakan house. The kitchen is clean and the restaurant is general is clean.

Author: GohSzeszeJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Lovely cats cafe
