Review: Chance upon this cafe after reading reviews online. It is located at a housing area. Easy to find using waze directions. Ordered grilled salmon, taste great. The cats are truly adorable and lovely. The place is clean. The kitchen is open concept where you get to view the chef cooking.
Restaurant: CATS Cafe JB - Cats At Their Sanctuary

Author: EviaChiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: First and last to visit this restaurant
Review: In fact, my friend wanna try this restaurant and myself has no confident of this restaurant. At the end we tried, has a terrible experienced. We ordered Toufu soup, pancake and fried squid. Only fried squid we felt not bad, the rest of food not authentic, not nice and the worst is we saw the baby cockroach climbing to us while we eating our dinner

Author: Anything416
Title: Dinner for my husband's birthday dinner
Review: Loved the masak lemak prawns  beef  and the durian dessert. There were other food but can't remember their names. Nice ambiance , cosy.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food, terrible manager, other staffs are ok
Review: Came in early evening. They were still cleaning the aircond and the whole place smells of disinfectant chemicals at 6.30pm.Asked what is the house wine and which bottle is still new (not opened yet). He said all are not open. Forced him to show me all bottles actually only one bottle is not opened and the rest are opened. Had to follow to the bar to force them to show me. I was planning to have a few and I didn’t want to have the last glass from the bottle. Browsed online to see what I could order. Showed it to the staff he said it’s too long ago (pic taken in April). He basically didn’t know what it was so he cook up some rubbish to make it look as if he knew. Basically telling me oh that’s the veal wrapped with bacon. I can read it from the menu- I don’t need you to repeat the menu??? Ordered al dente pasta but it was under. I’ve eaten many aldente pasta before and obviously this isn’t aldente. Extra 30 seconds would make a difference.All in all, the manager’s is extremely incompetent and his attitude to fake things makes him look terrible - don’t try to cheat your way through because we are consumers who have eaten many things before. When you can’t answer, don’t answer. Admit that you don’t know instead of telling me some silly answer. I’m surprised they hired such an incompetent manager who has zero knowledge on food. By the way, the whole place is managed and run by not Italians. Luckily the meat turned it to be okay but not the pasta. Certainly not authentically Italian and expect no service at all.

Author: LelabongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: .....baked fish in rare?
Review: Ordered one roma salad , one 4 cheeses pizza and baked snapper ... salad and pizza were Ok.... but the baked snapper , we found was serve in rare... so I asked waiter to check with kitchen.. and the waiter replied: so, you want your fish in well done?.....I was speechless... they never let us choose during we order.. and.. of course I want my fish in well done....

Author: jesamineandreanasKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unpleasant visit
Review: I have been to this restaurant a few times. Food was ok. Nothing fantastic. However, every time I go, the service I encountered was not pleasant. My most recent visit, I ordered the rib eye steak and aglio olio. The steak was not cooked to what we specify and everything on my pasta was over cooked. The squid was over cooked to the point of being so rubbery, I had to spit it out. The mussels were grossly over cooked and the pasta was not al dente. On the service side, when I told the waiters about my disappointment in my food, all they did was say sorry. No damage control whatsoever. Normally, when in a restaurant, when food is not satisfactory, they will offer a compensation or refund. But none was offered. Which made me think they don't really care. None of the waiters had a smile which made me decide, this will be the last time I am going to visit this restaurant. And that is why I decided to write this review. Hopefully they will improve their service and food. But I wouldn't know because I wouldn't take the chance of going back to a gloomy ambience and bad food.

Author: BackPacker93015Shanghai, China
Title: Terrible
Review: Checked on TripAdvisor for brunch place and came out this one, got there at 3pm and no more brunch items, only lunch/dinner food... we take a burger and peri chicken. What they call juicy patty is a precooked patty (Mc Donald’s burger is juicier) the French fries are thinnier than toothpicks, the chicken was so dry couldn’t eat half of it. The nice place and the inviting pictures on menu are totally misleading. Don’t go there

Author: LOVE2LIFEKuala Lumpur
Title: Horrible food & service
Review: I ordered a steak, rare, it was cold, badly cooked and tasted bad, in the mix vegetable they put bell peppers and everything included the beef tasted bell peppers.The potatoes were soggy like have been cooked for few days and just warmed up.The service was very inattentive, even if i didn't finish my meal and i had clearly stop eating they collect my plate after 20 minutes and only after i asked them and nobody bother to ask me how was my food or why i didn't eat it.Never again!!!

Author: InventNext
Title: Not that great
Review: When I saw the name, I was quite excited to try the authentic Hyderabadi food however they failed to meet the expectations. Food was just okay and highly priced.

Author: WilsonLimPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre overpriced food
Review: I wouldn't say the food is terrible/inedible but for the price they are charging (and the portion they are serving), I'd expect much better food. This is the first time I've been here (did not visit previously as I heard they were always full/owners with terrible attitude) and it will be my last.Country Fried Chicken at RM21 - 2 small pieces of chicken, a small helping of mashed potatoes and green peas. Portion-wise was already a let-down and to add to that, the chicken meat was dry (parts given were the drumstick and thigh so for it to be dry is an 'achievement') and it felt extremely sub-par in quality. To think that the owners have the audacity to be rude to customers with food of this quality. Baffling. Thankfully I did not experience this as the owners did not appear to be there.

Author: Calvin YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but way way overpriced
Review: Overall, the place ambiance is very nice and service is good. The food is also good but in my opinion just way way overpriced. We ordered Bitter-gourd with Salted Vegetable and it costs a whopping RM29.20 while a plate of normal toufu and mushroom costs RM32.70..!!I would however recommend their pork spare ribs, it's tender, juicy and real good and it will set you back RM23 a piece.

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Detailed care
Review: It is clear that detailed care goes into every minute detail- from serving the guests to the preparation of each dish. Enjoyed the experience so much, we returned!I was doing the ketogenic diet & made major modifications to most dishes. Yet despite the substituted ingredients, each dish whipped up tasted marvellous!

Author: meaningremission
Title: Decent Hakata ramen in Malaysia
Review: Your choice of noodle done-ness ans soup base. Lovely fine ramen in a nice environment. There also have very nice and tasty pork bun.

Author: Cecilie S
Title: Great view!
Review:
Lovely hotel and restaurant with an amazing view. 
Very friendly and helpful staff (Fakhrul in particular). You have a clear view at the sunset too and a large variety of different foods :)

Author: DRaxel88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive
Review: Extremely expensive we ordered ginger onion fish paste just fish paste it cost us Rm35 and just with another egg then I'll came up to Rm60. If you're looking for an ok and cheap food this is definitely not the place to go. Food taste ok just okey

Author: anaso601
Title: The environment is so dirty and the waiters are rude
Review: The tables stinks, you put your hand on the table it stinks, i asked the waitress to clean it she cleaned it and still the same. I ordered 2 dishes they gave me three dishes and they made me pay for the one I didn’t order and the reason was I am deaf. I came to Kuala Lumpur for three days and trust me friends this was the only and the worst experience I had ever have!

Author: Alexus C
Title: Food was fast but not great
Review: The only good food here is the Yuet Kong Hor.. Wat tan hor taste like hor fun cooked in glue and MSG.. the WORST i ever had...

Author: JoanneHuiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a pleasant first time visit,definitely would not return
Review: Today 8 June 2019,a chill Saturday and we (myself and another two of my friend)walk in into this vintage style cafe just to try out.- Perhaps we just ordered drinks and chit around,one of the staff show me some annoying face when I asked to refill hot water into my black Guan Yin tea pot. When this staff knew I do not look pleased with his service, another lady came and return my teapot after refill. I do not think we deserved this kind of service.- Another plot,one of the staff came to our table and said “sorry to inform this table will be reserve for next customer”.Meanwhile there was ample of empty space for next customer.Felt like being chase out.Maybe we just ordered a drink which is also not cheap (RM 20 per pot)Note:There are ample of cafe around the corner,perhaps with better customer service.will definitely not return back here.very disappointed.

Author: Mahbub KToronto, Canada
Title: Excellent breakfast buffet, not happy with dinner
Review: We were staying in Traders Hotel and breakfast was included in our room rate. Breakfast buffet was outstanding. We went for light dinner too, We are allergic to seafood and shellfish, my wife is allergic to nuts too. I don't like Malay cuisine as it is close to South Indian cuisine which I simply hate. So we ordered Hainanese Chicken Rice which I love. They said it is available but then after a trip from the kitchen they said it is finished. So we ordered Nasi Goreng which included both shrimp, prawn (and fried egg). It felt so-so (may be because I don't like Malay cuisine). We ended up in the same situation the next night too (no Hainanese Chicken rice).

Author: WilliamTan168Klang, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food but "Black Face" Waitresses
Review: Personally, their food is almost flawless. Generally all well-cooked and yummy. Even a fastidious Japanese food lover would inevitably find their food quality acceptable. Early booking is always a must especially during the weekends.It would have been better if they did not hire those foreign workers as waitresses who could not communicate well at all, and at the same time pulling a long face all the times. The service attitudes were utterly unacceptable.

Author: AndyLHLimSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Affordable buffet at JB but limited food choice
Review: Affordable buffet at JB which is about 600m walk from City Square. Lunch is RM48 but to be honest limited food choices. Meat choice is only chicken cooked in chinese, malay and Indian section. Food is not refill promptly. Cater to tour groups.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Bally DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of my favourite hangouts in Bangsar because they have a secret (Read below)
Review: Every single Rock Bottom you go to, be it in Johor, Melaka, Kuala Lumpur or Genting you are going to sum up in one word "Brilliant" why? because of consistency! Each place has all the listed below with the secret I mentioned on the subject:Great drinks (Beers, cocktails, whiskey you name it)Friendly staffGreat food (The secret recipe to the most tastiest Briyani served in a bar)Great ambienceGreat musicI love food, and the briyani in Rock Bottom is by far the best briyani I have tasted in any restobars I have been. And the funny thing is, It taste the same!If you want to catch a game, or early mid day drinks with your friends, choose any one of the Rock Bottoms. Super Thumbs Up!

Author: edzmiraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Italian Restaurant
Review: One of the best italian restaurant and it is halal. The staff Palani is very helpful and friendly. Tried their Lobster Thermidors and Calazone pizza and the taste is superb. Surely will come back again.

Author: yeoc468Singapore, Singapore
Title: Breakfast
Review: A very good selection of food for breakfast.Can be crowded and noisy at times.Service varies from time to time.

Author: C H
Title: Fantastic Chinese food
Review: Everytime I am in KL I will try to make my way to Dragon-i. The has a great atmosphere and the food is to die for. I love it.

Author: havebagwilltravel49London, United Kingdom
Title: Rip Off
Review: We were here for a birthday party. When discussing the menu, prior to the actual function, a request was made to feed the band.Only two guests were champagne drinkers, the others liked wine/cocktails.When the bill came we were charged for 6 bottles of champagne, which made the bill very expensive. This was queried, but the manager said 6 bottles had been opened!The next day my daughter went to the restaurant for a supposed "Refund". Only RM80 was offered! When questioned, the manager said that the high bill was because the band members were given lobster as part of their meal!!This is totally ludicrous. The restaurant was instructed to feed the band, but obviously within moderation.That, & the supposed excessive champagne (which was not consumed by the party) means that this restaurant will not attract future customers if they are ripped off like this. The manager has a lot of explaining to do.As a footnote, the food was very mediocre & certainly not FINE DINING!My advice is avoid this place.

Author: ChalkybIver, United Kingdom
Title: Western food
Review: If you're looking for something from home give this place a try, the food is very good and all cooked fresh. We had the fish and chips with mushy peas and tartar sauce the fish was excellent very moist and the batter was nice and crisp. Will we go again? Of course we will!!

Author: carmoooooonSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Food: Food is good but nothing special, maybe it depends on what you order. We had the abacus beads (a bit oily for me), the stir-fried cockle with salty vege, the braised pork with pickled vege & a tofu soup. The cockle was cooked the way I like coz it's not rubbery but the pickled vege tasted like it's not washed. The food got cold quickly coz all the fans were turned on even it's late night.Service: The waitress was prompt enough to bring us to table as soon as we got there but didn't remind us the dish we ordered might be too much for just 2 of us since we had with white rice.Environment: If you are a tourist looking for some authentic Hakka food & price is not an issue, here is a place for you coz it has outdoor seating with girls selling beers. A typical scene for Chinese eateries.Value: With its location in KLCC, be prepared to pay more even the place does not look like a high end restaurant. Btw, the parking is not free, I had to pay RM4 even I dined there. Not recommended if you do cook Chinese food at home or you are a local coz there are many other restaurants with better price outside of the city center.

Author: IrishRachSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great savory crepe
Review: Dropped into French Factory since we wanted something light pre dinner and wanted to see what all the fuss is about.Ordered savory crepes egg chicken cheese, really good quality, staff were lovely and very attentive. Great crepe, nice ppl , wish them all the best.

Author: Sanjeev K
Title: Very average and slow service
Review: Firstly, the wines are way way over priced. Much cheaper and better wines at the western restaurant in Le Meridien next door. Secondly, service was slow and inattentive for a restaurant of this kind. We had to ask for the food menu and the wine list. We had to also ask for refill of water throughout lunch. There were only 3 tables of guests but the service was very slow. The food was so average. The only thing I enjoyed was the asparagus starters. Rest was so average considering the pricing. My friend ordered the lamb shank but it was not available. Why have it on the menu if it was not available. All 3 of us felt the same about the food. Won't be visiting this restaurant again. Really below average for a "high end" restaurant. Disappointing experience

Author: yashatai
Title: Lovely environment, superb service.
Review:
A charming place, throwback feel. Enjoy my short afternoon visit there. Owner is welcoming and friendly. Just love it. 
Food is made with love and good quality ingredients.

Author: Lamlim13
Title: Great food
Review: Love the open kitchen style of cooking where you can see what they are doing.  Food is excellent - my mushroom risotto was excellent.

Author: Nileshkumar MLeicester, United Kingdom
Title: Most Horrible Food
Review: Waited over 30 mins which we did not mind as it was a sat night, we waited to order mains until we had a taste of our starters to see what the food was like. the Platter we got was cold and tasted rubbish - no taste to it. Asked for lemon to have with our starters to flavour the food which never came, had to add salt and the yogurt chat was off. We left very quickly and had excellent street food and it cost less then 13 MR and we were stuffed.

Author: Mouse-PrincessSingapore
Title: Not worth the visit if u are foodie n tourist
Review: Was in Meleka for wedding dinner. Host booked this restaurant and said the best Chengdol.Total disappointment on the Chengdol. Host has preordered the food so we were supposed to have all their specialty but all the dishes were just very average in taste. I am ok to eat there if I live around there and out of convenience. Definitely not worth the visit as a tourist ...

Author: armanddebrignac
Title: Disaster.
Review:
This is no more French feast.
No more french working there.
Food become very different.
No passion in the blood of the Chef.
Sorry will not go again.

Author: DRFONCOLOGY
Title: Pleasant experience dining at Vasco's
Review: I went first time for dinner buffet after MCO. The food selection is lesser compared to pre lockdown.However I would say that all the food served are quite tasty.Credit to the restaurant staff Mr Dinesh who provided excellence services attending to us.

Author: Samia I
Title: Best pizza in town
Review: unique way of making pizza, increases the taste... you can have western & local foods with a pint of cold beer.

Author: Lihkien T
Title: poor maintenance
Review: i dont understand why they are so run down....aircon always not functioning.. they put big industrial fans which are so irritating blowing my faceunderstaff.... we have to go pick cutleries and plates by ourselvesfood are more and more msg....sad to see this as last time this restaurant is so popular

Author: luckynme
Title: Good quality and tasty japanese food for reasoanble price
Review: Reasonable price at strategic city centre (Pavilion Mall) with very fresh quality and sumptuos food. Value for bento sets and well prepared skewers and salads

Author: alvthm
Title: Food is not fresh
Review: Nothing is fresh. They recycle wasabi. The wasabi you're eating might be the residue from few months ago.

Author: FullTime_traveller9Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Good views - but meal disappointing.
Review: Having pre -booked the table for 1:30pm, we arrived early as suggested only to find out we had to wait until 125pm to get ticket, then joined the queues to take the lift up. Lack of restaurant staff, meant it then took over 15 mins to get to seat, then we were quick to get food, but queues for food got very long very quickly. In less than an hour they announced that lunch was over at 3pm. The food itself was ok. But the whole event was disappointing. Like others stated, we had paid extra for a window seat, only to find other people standing by the windows taking photos. The views were rather good.

Author: tenuk
Title: Good for your beef needs
Review: I had their mushroom burger which is awesome but if I had to have meat I'd have the stew like meal my friend had that day and I forgot to make picture of it.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent and satisfying Italian complimented with Excellent Service
Review: The wait staff was impressive in their knowledge of the cuisine and the menu. Their service was attentive and came with smiles. Just felt that they were a little pushy in the beginning on getting us to order a bottle of water.

Author: Julia HPerth, Australia
Title: Find insight in the pitch black darkness
Review: This is the most fantastic dining experience both my partner and I have ever had!In a nutshell, you sit down for a three course meal in a room that is pitch black. You have a pre dinner drink and a coffee afterwards in the bar outside, but the experience in the dark room is something that you just have to experience if you can.I had a lot of anxiety in the beginning and it took me a little while to relax. The complete darkness made me feel vulnerable, but my waiter Thoun was very reassuring and it gave me a small insight into the experience that all of the vision impaired waiters have on a daily basis. The fun part is having a plate set down in front of you and having to try the different things to find out what you're eating. Don't worry, they ask you first if you have any allergies or intolerances and the dishes are all suited to a western palate so you're likely to recognise the foods. However, with that said, my partner and I were absolutely astounded that we had been so wrong in our guesses. Another funny thing is that I happily ate mushrooms, even though I don't normally like them.It's like a degustation menu. There were 3 appetisers, 3 mains and 5 desserts. The food was delicious!At 88MYR per person, you're not just buying a meal, you're buying an experience.

Author: ohmy123Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing valued set lunch
Review: A staple for lunch when my family comes to JB. RM45++ for appetiser, main course and dessert with ice lemon tea that is even applicable on weekends! End it off with a coffee or tea.Staff is welcoming and attentive. Plus what is there not to love about the complimentary freshly toasted bread that comes along at the start.If you are looking to indulge, splurge on their wagyu + foie gras with red wine sauce. This is slightly more expensive but a fraction of price that you would pay in Singapore. And it is not on the menu so call beforehand to preorder.Definitely a must visit - for a happy tummy and happy wallet!

Author: Michaela RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Reliably good food every time
Review: We come to Nirwana every time we are in KL to get banana leaf rice and it's always really good - the chicken curry is particularly nice and they have a wide spread of all the side dishes. The fried karela is especially nice and crispy, and the vegetables dishes are nicely cooked and taste fresh. Would definitely recommend Nirwana over other banana leaf options in the area as it is consistently good - however, be sure to come outside peak meal times unless you are prepared to queue for quite a long time, particularly in a bigger group.

Author: alexo273
Title: Very unique!
Review:
The food is indeed very unique and different! 
Be prepare to line in queue for at least half and hour if you are lucky.
The food is good and nice, recommended and go for it.
Price is reasonable with 5 pax. Below 500 RM.

Author: Estherck
Title: Kenny Rogers
Review: Once in a blue moon, thought of having Kenny Rogers since I haven't been there for long...Waited long for the food and finally is out! Taste not as good as last time and the restaurant with lots of flies. Not going to visit in the near future.

Author: Maya762015Le Havre, France
Title: Not fine and good Japanese dishes
Review: Restaurant is based in the garden mall which is very busy and the atmosphere of restaurant is far away from Japanese standard. Staff service is good but food is without taste. We took sashimi set and there are only 3 small pieces of fish which are not well cut with no taste. Also there is some Malaysian taste in some Japanese dishes as for example egg are with cheese which actually is not at all Japanese. We were very disappointed. Dishes are not that cheap and quality does not worth it to come

Author: Amal246
Title: HAPPY
Review:
Staff are friendly & helpful, the dj is also amazing. Highly recommend 
Drinks are good shesha is very good

Author: shawnl136
Title: Blah
Review: Food wasnt tasty at all. We ordered a fried asam pedas fish. taste was no were close to any asam pedas i have ever tasted. Also ordered chili Crab, sad to say it was all sweet and not spicy at all. was a total let down as i heard the seafood in sarawak was nice.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: Clairer23Perth, Australia
Title: Pretty Good for a Quick Bite
Review: I think this is a good mid range restaurant with some good staple choices in western food. You will find a lot of tourists or expats eating here. We ordered the chicken pie which was very good although could have been better, pastry was a bit soft. Was also more of a lunch portion. We also ordered the burger which wasn't the best. Service for the most part is quite good however some of the floor staff could learn how to smile and be a little more accommodating.

Author: Kookaaq
Title: Great Environment
Review: You feel like you are vacationing on an island once you entered this place. Nice place. nice food (especially their thai selections). I hate the mosquito though.

Author: julian lKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Poor
Review: The menu is quite misleading so beware: the bacon cheeseburger is laden with spice but there is no mention on the menu that it is a spicy dish whatsoever. So when my young daughters ordered one each, none of the staff deemed to warn them that it might be too spicy for them. When we told the manager our concerns when we paid the bill he did little more than say that there is a paprika chilli marinade. But of course it was too late by then. Very disappointing.

Author: Hafadzzafarol M
Title: Great place to have Japanese food
Review: The food was excellent. The ambience was very good for a restaurant. Different seating arrangements to suit your requirements ie private dining or regular seating. Overall a very pleasant experience. Recommended.

Author: KiddySingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Below average Nonya food
Review: In a city with many Nonya restaurants, this unfortunately does not make the cut. The chendol was thin and lacking in flavour. The laksa was also watered down. In the words of my friend, the pie tee was soggy. The popiah too was plain. Portions were small.

Author: leokl74
Title: Good food; friendly staff
Review: A warm friendly French restaurant that you could go with the kids. Lentrcote de Boeuf was good. Chicken Fricassee was a surprise..tasty..kids love it.

Author: Stixios
Title: Best cocktails
Review: The shisha and cocktails are best. Love the friendly environment.view is good .the maintain social distance perfectly.

Author: John SUlverston
Title: An ethnic experience
Review: As the restaurant's name implies, Tribal Stove serves traditional Borneo fare - some very tasty dishes at very reasonable prices. It is a shame that the restaurant often seemed to be quiet, as it was on the evening that we ate there. We were able to sit outside in a courtyard next to the restaurant proper, which was quite pleasant on a warm evening. Some of the dishes were "off" but the food that was available was very tasty. My veggie daughter had no difficulty in finding something. The service was OK, although we were rather strangely abandoned after we had eaten the main course.

Author: LovelySR
Title: Gathering
Review: The cafe serves healthy meals but they are very expensive. Drinks are not worth it for the size served. Ordered the Paleo fish. Tasted quite nice just the sauce is not enough.

Author: dunno51Singapore, Singapore
Title: Everything is made with artificial flavouring
Review: We ordered Miang Kham, Tom Yam soup, pineapple rice, and lemon grass drink. Miang Kham was ok but everything else had very strong taste of artificial flavoring. Tom yam soup was unnaturally sour, pineapple rice was soggy and pineapple was not fresh, lemon grass drink was clearly made from syrup! The restaurant provides good service but food quality is very poor for the price. It seems that the restaurant is trying to squeeze every single cent by using cheap artificial/low-quality ingredient to spend on decoration instead. Doesn't make sense for me to pay such price for food made with 90% artificial flavoring...won't consider to visit again.

Author: x96lee26
Title: Chilling lunch 🥰🥰🥰
Review:
#Throwback

Lunch at this cafe serving fresh salmon an fleas with scramble eggs with bacon wraps in asparagus and American Big Breakfast 😋😋😋

Author: Anna PBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: We left still hungry
Review: It's great to have so many vegetarian choices in a non-veg restaurant, but we were so disappointed by the mediocre noodle dish and very small portions for the price. The poached dumplings, though, were delicious. We were shocked and dismayed that the iced green jasmine tea was served in a sealed plastic cup with a plastic straw - this is a tea shop with beautiful little teapots in a display cabinet. Why is the tea served pre-packaged, with so much unnecessary plastic? Although the Chinese lanterns and brush paintings etc are lovely, the lighting is harsh and the air-con is loud, both spoiling what should be a nice intimate atmosphere.

Author: EveSarahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lousy food with high price
Review: I wanted to celebrate my husband birthday and since we are in JB, I thought we could go to a nice Mediterranean or Italian restaurant and we found this Sweetwater Restaurant. So I booked and we went. The ambiance is nice and soothing and parking is easy. The only positive feedback is the servers are attentive. What is not good is the food and the misinformation presented by the staffs. I ordered Calamari as starter, mushroom and onion soups, squid ink pasta and cabonara as main courses. The Calamari is almost tasteless except for a little after bitter taste which may have come from the generous herbs thrown in. The mushroom soup was ok but my onion soup is a disaster. I have never had such sweet onion soup before and when I asked the staff, he is very honest and told me that they put sugar... Why do you need so much sugar when the soup will be sweetened by the caramelized onion and beef stock/broth. It is the worse onion soup I have tasted. Then comes my squid ink seafood pasta and it cost RM$79 is I am not wrong. I looked at the pasta and realised that there is no squid ink and just dark grey colored pasta with seafood. I tried the pasta and seafood. The pasta is not cooked properly so it is hard and the seafood is tasteless and I guess they boiled the seafood. I called the server again and he told me that they ran out of squid ink and that is Aglio Olio but how come no one tell me...I was apparently very upset and I told the server to bring it back to cook longer for the pasta to be cooked and add cream sauce as it was tasteless. I didnt want to change the whole main course as I do not believe in wasting food. After a while, my pasta came back. All seafood now de-shelled and the pasta is with cream sauce. After one bite, I asked for salt as it is tasteless still. when the whole dining episode is over, we called for the bill. We were charged for Squid ink pasta instead of Aglio Olio. My husband then told the server and they amended the bill. This whole dining experience is bad. I will never go back there again.

Author: cheesemeltAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Great Service!
Review: Came by Vasco's for their Thai promotion. The food is good (try the Pad Thai and Somtam!), the service however- is exceptional. Special thanks to Azzu and Muizz for ensuring that we had a great time in Vasco's. Will return again soon!

Author: OriginalNutbagSabah, Malaysia
Title: Good food, flat beer, slow service
Review: Second time I've been to this place by the river. It's a great location with a lovely set-up. A very nice place to spend an hour or so people watching. However, The beer was flat. We ordered a jug of Tiger. The waiter said it was poured from cans into the jug then into our glasses. We asked him to just bring the cans. He brought another jug of flat beer. Yuk. Asked another waiter. He said it was poured from the tap. I don't know. It was flat & unpleasant. Very disappointing.The food however was quite good. I had a rump steak. The steak itself was average but the gravy was delicious and the wedges very good. My friends both had laksa. They were very different but both very yummy. All meals were reasonably priced.The service was poor. For such a nice looking place at mid-range prices you would expect better. Please, Malaysia, bring everyone's main meals together. I don't know why this is such a thing but it is. Also we had to chase down our change. I think I remember having to do this last time I came also. If you take my money, bring back my change, please.

Author: yling69
Title: Best vietnamese food in town!
Review: This is my first visit with my family. They served great food. The staff were honest and their service attitude were impressive. Like! Like! Like!

Author: tanseaway
Title: Tex-Mex chain restaurant...
Review: Tex-Mex chain restaurant that still manages to pull in a crowd for some unfathomable reason. Food is average, prices are not low, crowd sure ain't trendy... but they have been thriving for years. Beer is good.

Author: max13maxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique jewel in the sky... excellent Value for Money!
Review: Classy, elegantly furbished restaurant in the heart of Malacca, next to the river. Sited on top of probably one of the highest points in the city (41st floor), with an absolutely breath-taking and commanding view of the entire city, literally at your feet. Watch the sun sets over the Straits of Malacca, enjoy a glass of fine wine and savor a delectable selection of western cuisine. Best of all, was surprisingly affordable for such a classy joint, certainly excellent value for money! ... Will come back whenever in town! Thanks Mr Ariva and team for a wonderful time!

Author: caseylim1990
Title: Perfect place for skewers!
Review: Skewers were juicy and not too dry. Prices are reasonable. Must must must order the drink in the kettle (some alcoholic drink) that goes so well with the asam boi!

Author: V1465PYkimlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Iffy ... a bad case of food poisoning
Review: We have been here several times and always enjoyed the fish and chips and other varieties of western comfort food here. The restaurant has a wide selection of wine, beers and liquor. There is outside and indoor seating and huge television screens in selected spots...generally aired for football and sport fans. A pleasant happy ambience overall.However i was a little disappointed with last Sunday’s lunch as my young son came home with food poisoning. He had the fish and chips and the only one in our group to have had fish, i may be wrong but what else can it be? The rest of us were ok...we had the toad in the hole and corn beef mash and a round of beer.My son says now...no more fish and chips mom! So i guess we will not be going around to this restaurant anytime soon... a short leave of 6 months perhaps!

Author: schnark
Title: Good food at a good price and a playful side
Review:
Was meandering along the street looking for lunch and kept finding expensive options then stumbled here.

Cheap but great food with a sense of humour ("lunch set menu, drinky poos included) and good environment.

Author: philiplkLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Average
Review: We ordered a laksa, ipoh kuay teow as mains and the satay for starter. The curry laksa arrived lukewarm and we had to sent it back. The satay arrived quite a bit later after the main dishes. The main dishes were alright. Satay was tasty. I just expected better timing in the arrival of dishes and the laksa shouldn't have been lukewarm.

Author: JasonP3374
Title: Over-rated restaurant
Review: Staff were impolite and rude.  Not willing to offer table to single person at 14:00.  Food and taste were average with limited variety.  The brand was over-rated and won't visit again.

Author: docfeedbackAdelaide, Australia
Title: unpleasant environment and just average food
Review: This is one of the restaurants that are located at the basement level of the Starhill Gallery but tucked in under the shopping centre and not out in the atrium.The atmosphere was not pleasant as the restaurant is basically open to everything around including a very, very loud cocktail bar right next door. The raucous behaviour of drunks wandering past and in the bar certainly turned us off. It was a Friday evening and it was obvious the office crowds were out for a big time. The service here varied between pushy and non-existent .The menu and wine list were not very exciting. We both choose the blacken fish for main course which was ok.I strongly recommend that you build up some muscle before dining here as the furniture and in particular the chairs are SO HEAVY

Author: cl41r3Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Good view, ok food, poor service
Review: My last day in KLCC and where better to have lunch than taking in the views of Klcc Park. However I chose poorly and soon realised my mistake. The service was poor and food was average and very pricey for the quality. The positive was definitely the view and the coffee was ok I wouldn’t return.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: LennyNJSAustralia
Title: Something is wrong
Review: We booked a room with 16 adults and kids for Dad’s Birthday. We choose the menu and everything was discussed before the day, long before the day for the dinner. We arrived and was led to our room where table was set and seems like it’s good to go, I went to told the captain they could start serve our dinner. Went back to the room and wanna pour myself some tea, found my glass was fill with finger print and water mark, went ahead and check all the glass and table ware, plate is chipped, glass is dirty, bowl is stained. Not Impressed, Not at all.Next was even bizarre, they served all our 8 course dinner within 20 mins!! I booked a room and get menu sort out so I could get a banquet experience where dishes by dishes will be serve accordingly, not rush out in 1 lum sum!! As you could imagine, everything was right in the middle of the table and everyone is rushing to eat everything instead of sitting down and relax, Undisturbed in our room. Went and talked to the captain or manager when asking for bill, she act blur and said “ you should had told us in that way “, seriously? 8 course in 25 mins? Turn out they have a wedding reception going on so they try to rush out order out before they proceed to serve theirs! What a joke. Guess what, I always told everyone I knew or come in town in regards how reputable Lok Tien is for traditional banquet dinner, wedding reception, guess I won’t anymore, even I had my wedding reception banquet here 10 years ago. Guess 10 years is a very long time and thing changed. Won’t be back for sure, with that amount of money I’m paying, I didn’t get the equivalent food or service I deserve.

Author: Chen F
Title: Nice food nice service
Review: Is the best hotpot I ever tried before, highly recommend, the location is just at LOT 10, infront of mrt station, must try

Author: Thinesh18
Title: Poor service
Review: Went there with my wife and waited 20 minutes for them to clear the table. Leaves was served for the table beside and was not served or order taken for us. This had happened few times before and this time it was really fustrating. Good services always given to those who ear with fork n spoon on the banana leave.

Author: funkykiddoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great Food But Appalling Service..
Review: I brought a friend here for the first time for lunch as I've heard good things about the restaurant. The waiters were very nice. Took us to the table and recommended some of the signature dish and we decided to try the Japanese Bento. It was really nice and we truly enjoyed it. Unfortunately, towards the end, there were workmen who came in to the restaurant to do some interior works. I was shocked! Naturally, you wouldn't expect workmen in a fine restaurant whilst people were eating!! We asked for the manager. He came and said sorry but he didn't do anything. We were really disappointed and immediately left. Won't come back again.

Author: TheUltimoTraveller
Title: A refreshing addition to KL
Review: This place is great addition in part of KL that could benefit from a few more decent F&B outlets. Visited this place with some colleagues. The venue is split into 2 distinct parts: the bar / lounge area and the restaurant. Although the restaurant appears to portray aspects of being a fine dining setup, I think its anything but. Make no mistake, there is nothing wrong with the restaurant or the service. Just that it isn’t fine dining. It’s a good restaurant, serves tasty food of decent portions, has a convivial atmosphere and great skyline view of KL and friendly service staff. Not cramped and ample space to move about. The menu is decent, slanting towards a diner profile with pizzas and meats and salads. An enjoyable place; might consider going back again when in this part of KL’s neighbourhood next.

Author: MstrViolinist
Title: Great Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Went just after 5pm when they opened and were able to get a table right away.  There was a long line after us though.  Prawns were very good.

Author: AdlynAzizi
Title: Awesome but
Review: Remember to reserve a place beforehand because the tables are quite limited! Other than that, the food is AMAZING. Im a Malaysian, living in Selangor and their malaysian food is one of the best Ive tasted. Fun to see that the place is packed with tourists The ambience is perfect for dates and also families. 10/10 would recommend the Red Velvet Galette.

Author: PyaeSoneOo
Title: Atmosphere was great as much as the food was appalling
Review: Variety of the food was good but the quality and taste of the food was abysmal. All in all, the view made the experience all worth it. Not ideal if you're looking for amazing food.

Author: 68MAREEIpswich, Queensland, Australia
Title: Lovely Meal
Review: Really enjoyed our meal, a bit expensive but the meals were huge and was delicious. Allowed me to have a doggy bag also. The staff was wonderful, it was very clean.

Author: monk3yseendoMalaysia
Title: A Glimpse of Brussels and Its Gastronomical Delights
Review: First off, this is a review of their food delivery and not dine-in.Armed with a fleet of 7 outlets, across Malaysia with a determination to serve “popular Belgian scrumptious dishes”, how well does their food age in a take away box?Service: We placed the order via a third party app which was pretty straight forward.Packaging: Ordinary take away boxes.Golden Chicken Thigh (RM 29.68)The secret to a delightful fried chicken meal lies in the juiciness and tenderness of the meat, topped with a nice crispy chicken skin to the delight of the diner as they sink their teeth into the chicken.The chicken arrived sliced in equal portions making snacking in front of the Telly very convenient. It was extremely tender and juicy within spilling its flavourful juice as we sank out teeth into it, topped with crispy and addictive skin. It was accompanied by a serving of broccoli which was crunchy and garnished with a touch of butter. Completing the meal was a generous portion of chips. Although it was the slightest bit soggy due to condensation (which is understandable for a take away), it still made a well balanced meal.Recommended? Although the chips were a bit of a let down given that Belgium is renown for Chocolates and Chips, it was still a scrumptious meal Our full review with more photos can be found on Instagram and YouTube (@monk3yseendo)

Author: Rororo97
Title: Cheese prawn bee hoon
Review: wanted to have dinner there but the q was too long hence we ate at another place for dinner . at 1045 pm went to take away cheese prawn bee  hoon for supper RM70 for medium size plus gst 6% about RM 74

Author: flip-flop88-66Gibraltar
Title: money, money, money !!!!
Review: I've been there a few times !!!each time I ended up arguing about the price.But the straw on camel's back was when they charged us for our 2 yr-old kid, whereas I gave some food from my share.Unbelievable !!!For sure the food is good, but the taste I kept in my mouth was the frustration rather than their food.

Author: davidxavier71Bali, Indonesia
Title: Horrible is Right
Review: Seriously ? Call this a restaurant ? The place is dirty, tables sticky and the place really needs a clean up and some staff changed. What an embarrassment to the original set up in Bali. The food is over rated and really nothing great. Better places in the SS15 area for ribs. 6/456 restaurants Really TripAdvisor? Pls visit ! Absolute needs to be done up and cleaned up. Serious change in attitude required.

Author: Ks-jsparrow
Title: Over-hyped
Review: Good views of the city, and nothing else unfortunately. If its hazy, there goes the only thing going for this place. Food and service is garbage.

Author: ZARJMiri, Malaysia
Title: A fine lunch and dine
Review: Be aware that the restaurant is always full at peak hours. The food is cheap and nice. A typical Malay food combine with a touch of Indian cuisine. Sometimes you have to wait for quite a while for them to serve you.If you come here and don't know what to order try "Nasi Goreng Special Daging" where the rise is fried with "Petai" and serve with tender fried spiced beef along with "Sambal".Bon Appétit!

Author: NickOng
Title: The place to go for Japanese food!
Review: The food was fresh, expertly prepared by a Japanese master chef and served in a beautiful garden dining setting!

Author: Tasmania27
Title: Nothing special, bit old fashioned
Review: We had dinner here last October and there is honestly nothing special to say about the restaurant. The food is super old fashioned. Doesn't really taste good and is completely overpriced. Absolutely not worth a visit.

Author: Dicko88Kuala Lumpur
Title: Stolen iPad!!!
Review: We have been to Langkawi for a girls weekend for the past 2 years and we love the food at Sun Café.On this trip one of my friends accedently left her iPad on the chair at Sun Café, we went back no longer than 20 minuts later but it had gone. The member of staff that cleared the table had gone for her dinner, when she returned she said that she did not see the iPad. They also said no other people had been near the area where we sat, so it must have vanished into thin air!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! They also dont have air-con and it can get very hot.This has now tarnished our thoughts of the Sun Café and will NEVER return again.

Author: sarahhopkins18
Title: Best Coffee Shop in Penang
Review: This is the best coffee shop I have visited in Penang! Has great WiFi and good music selection. As well as good coffee and food.

Author: asyaari_74Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must try Halal Italian food
Review: My family and I loved Imran's story about how he decided to open up an Italian restaurant without the wines. Alhamdulillah, he succeed and we hope more great stories to come. We enjoyed the food, the margherita pizza was delicious, the pasta was good, and the service was excellent. We will definitely be coming again to try the rest of the menu.

Author: SeacroftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Attractive An
Review: This is a very popular lunchtime café style restaurant which has been attractively designed. Highly efficient staff whisk the set traditional Vietnamese bowls of noodles to your table. We especially enjoyed the chicken and beef noodle sets. And top marks for offering and serving a fine cup of Vietnamese egg coffee.

Author: kohchialiciousSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth a visit
Review: First time in Ipoh, "Burps&Giggles" is one of the recommended places by reviews online and by my day tour guide.I love the set up of the cafe itself. As for the price, I think it's kind of resonable compared to the country I came from.

Author: c_nadjaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Food poisoning!!!
Review: We ate at Mews Cafe last Saturday, we enjoyed the atmosphere there and just ignored the high prices. It looked nice and clean. Two of us ordered the Smoked Salmon Salad, which was very tasty when eating it. The day later, we both got terrible stomach issues with fever and black-outs, why we ended up in hospital. With stomach problems of course you can never be sure which was the cause. But considering the usual time and the fact that this was the only thing we both ate and the others did not feel bad at all, we are sure that this is where we got it. It might be that we were just unlucky, since none of the other reviews tells something about sicknesses. However, it's my third month in Penang where I ate in all different kinds of restaurants and food stalls and this never happenend to me before. Will not go there again!

Author: Jason LVancouver, Canada
Title: Light, thin, and delicious
Review: We came here with a local who was skeptical. But after devouring our rotis within minutes, we ordered another round to take away. The roti was very thin and light, while the curry was extremely tasty. The service was average, but that's not what we came here for. Will definitely come back to KL just for this Roti.

Author: whiterabbitjbLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Go for the setting and service..food ok
Review: We had lunch at Indigo as we waited for our hotel room to be ready. The dining room is on the top floor of the beautiful Blue Mansion: an imposing high ceiling room that is worth seeing. Service was immaculate and friendly throughout. And food was ok, although very western and very forgettable, a real shame in one of the best food cities of Asia.
Restaurant: Indigo Restaurant at The Blue Mansion

Author: Dex T
Title: A Lavish Evening
Review: This will be my 5th visit with various group of friends. Today Lavish has introduce their latest menu with great coffee and meals. Great environment and will definitely come back with more friends.

Author: Araz-ali
Title: best and tastiest Middle eastern food restaurant in kuala lumpur
Review: best and tastiest Middle eastern food restaurant in kuala lumpur, fresh, Tasty with good seating, cost around 25 USD per person.

Author: dyganon
Title: Very good pork noodles
Review: The pork noodles here is not big portion. But very nice instead. Liver, intestine, kidney....all of my favourite.

Author: Jill LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rock Road horror
Review: Fish was tasteless.Weighed right in front of us and yet billed later at a higher weightage.Fried vegetables had hair in it.Service was not great.When we politely asked for our crab dish to be put back on our table (they took it to be transferred to smaller plate), and despite the dish just sitting on the service table, the waiter can brush us off with a nasty,' sabar ', which means 'be patient' in english.Will never go back there. Plenty of other seafood restaurants in kuching!

Author: SSChua28George Town, Malaysia
Title: Went to Ben's at KLCC
Review: I was there with my friends for dinner. I decided that I wanted to try something different and opted for their Peking Duck spaghetti. It was pretty ok, rather too salty for my taste and also quite oily. I then decided to try their desert - recommended by their staff, Macademia cheese-cake sundae. Big mistake! First of all the portions was huge. The cheesecake was delicious but the macademia was really sweet. That coupled with a very sweet sundae. I finished less than half the portion. The place was also very noisy, perhaps because it was a Saturday with a very young crowd. Not recommended if you want some peace and quiet and a place to relax and chat. Food-wise, it could have been better.

Author: Peter MHenty, Australia
Title: View great Service awful
Review: The restaurant is in a beautiful position by the river and is a good place just to have a drink but the food and service needs improving we ordered two meals at one visit and didn't even get the meals at all. Just go there for a drink.

Author: J SBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Nothing to write home about
Review: Had the spring rolls and beef rendang with rice. I ordered the spring rolls because the lor bak was unavailable. The spring rolls were so terrible I actually contemplated not finishing the other 3 pieces. I make it a point to finish the food I order so it's highly unusual that the thought of just leaving the spring rolls behind actually came to my mind. The beef rendang was tough and chewy. The dish costs almost 23 MYR. Although the portion wasn't small, it required a lot of chewing of cold meat. I didn't find it enjoyable. Great decor, but the food I ordered was just very disappointing.

Author: EdisonLeeSingapore
Title: I'll be back...
Review: I have read quite a bit about the.Dyak since 2014 and finally brought my friends there while on a fishing trip one year later. Being aware of the cultural influence behind this eatery, I had specially made plans in the itinerary so my friends could try something different other than the usual Kuching trip.The first thing that took my breath away was the pictures on the wall. I had stayed at a Longhouse when I was still a student on a geography trip so not only were they a familiar sight, it brought back fond memories of my school trip more than 20 years ago. The atmosphere - while not out in the forest - was sufficient to remind us, we are really here for Iban food.I have to admit, I can't remember all the names of the dishes because I was so busy trying each of them. My favourite gotta be the roast pork and not always we get served with such tender roast pork. The rice wine sure came in handy for a wonderful dinner with friends, especially on a cold and wet night.The exception was a reservation "glitch", thankfully, the restaurant wasn't full. I had 7 pax with me so if it was full, it will be a very embarrassing delay. Auntie Mary made it up with exceptional service. She is such a friendly host and owing to a rather empty night (because there was a super heavy downpour), she took time to go through the menu with us.I will certainly be back (with all my fishing friends) everytime I am in Kuching. If you haven't ate at the.Dyak, you haven't been to Kuching. Period!

Author: CKY281
Title: Doesn't Taste Fantastic
Review: This restaurant is grossly overrated. The flavours do not stand out.We had the truffle xiao long bao without any trace of truffle. The dumpling skin thickness is just above average. Our 2 orders of noodles were served ahead of the dim sum appetisers. There's nothing awesome with the soup.We had 8 orders for dim sum and were not impressed with any.We noticed that the peak time.lunch hour crowd is much smaller than before and this is a sign that patrons are drifting away.The outlets in Singapore and Hong Kong serve much better food.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre oyster omelette
Review: I tried the oyster omelette for supper. It was RM8 for a 'small' portion. It was average, i wouldn't buy it again. The oyster was so small and minuscule, i think it would have been better if they added cockles instead. On a more positive note, the omelette is well-textured, with the right amount of starch added in it. The chilli complements the omelette very well. I just won't have it again because i've had better ones back home, but everything is worth a try and this one is not too bad to start off! :)

Author: Shanegyj
Title: Steak you would not want to miss!
Review: My wife and I had one of the best steaks in our lives! We had their Signature T-Bone steak with portobello mushrooms, mac & cheese, brocolli florets with fried garlic chips, and grilled prawns. The prawns were properly cleaned which was great! Do try out their condiments to accompany your steak; there are 4 options, our fav was smoky salt. Mr Adli served us with great hospitality and he was knowledgeable about the menu. Do seek for advise if you need help deciding. Ms Regina, Chef Nathan, and Chef Haziq were all at the top of their game tonight. Great team. Their dessert menu features items like brownies, and poached grilled pineapple but we ended up with the Pavlova. It was a sweet ending and definitely a necessary one to make this meal perfect. We strongly recommend this steakhouse to all foodies out there. Or if you want to celebrate a romantic night with your partner, this works too. Enjoy their wine pairings, we had Shiraz and it went perfectly. Btw, their cheese and onion bread for starters were amazing. Don't forget to spread a generous amount of butter on it!#butterislifeWe thoroughly enjoyed our night here.

Author: KFXRJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Just careless service
Review: I went with my key personnel, ordered a bottle of whisky, was served a bucket of ice with a buffet ladel/spoon for Ice. The Management staff sat with me and I told her, then she informed the staff to bring a ice tong, they changed it to a buffet tong, imagine how huge that tong was. Its about service training and service standards that werent there. Lately I attended New Years Eve dinner, was not ushered, no greetings and was not given any party packs etc when it was almost midnight, other guest had them while entering the poutlet or was given when sitted, seems like the service standards does have an issue. The band was horrible, would expect a good grade band for a 5 star hotel as the band is a facility of the outlet even if the outlet is struggling to make profits, but the Pub is a supporting facility of the hotel. They could just get a good quality 3 piece band and that would have helped this outlet, having a 5 piece cheap performance will not bring back regulars.

Author: 159kannyc
Title: Old school hand pulled mee hun kuey
Review: Finally find some old sch mee hun kuey, have to wait half hr for it. They have few kind of food over there. Friendly services.

Author: MarkReynolds
Title: Unexpectedly enjoyable
Review: Great lunch spot connected to the KL bird park. Good food and juices, and you get to dine among surroundings that make you feel miles away from KL.

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Coffee Corner
Review: Nice banana cake with hot Americano at My Own Bake...a relaxing time after dinner. A good coffee corner in Subang Parade to rest your tired legs whilst catching up with WA messages.

Author: wans627Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best services
Review: Friendly staff. Great hospitality here. Fulfilling breakfast and great night view.We would like to thank our friendly waitress Ms Sadrina for assisting us at Latest Recipe for being helpful & Loewe too for helping us. Thank You

Author: Irwyn N
Title: Too Commercialized
Review: Dim Sum sizes are too large and ain't that good. Ming Court dim sum opposite the road has better dim sum and in Hong Kong style sizes. The place is also packed and congested.

Author: Pgirl1771Kastrup, Denmark
Title: Fine food great drinks
Review: Sea bass was quite recommendable. Tasted good for the value! One of our group members had the steak, ordered medium but had to send it back twice because it was first overdone and then under. But third time was a charm and had a delicious taste. The main waiter (supervisor we think since he had red color clothes and the rest black) was very annoyed that we complained at the first place and didn't want to serve us from then on - but the new waiter was very kind and made sure we were fully satisfied.The drinks are really good !

Author: maliks455
Title: Good food, very nice staff
Review:
This cafe has great ambiance with good food also they serve delicious cakes. when we went there they were selling fresh Durian outside and it was yummy.

Staff is very nice and attentive.

Recommended for friendly gatherings.

Author: annie_ladybird
Title: ok burger, weird staff
Review: the burger i had here was ok, wasn't expecting much and it delivered. there was a woman who appeared to be staff mucking around a lot, doing shots and talking about drugs loudly, whilst smoking at the bar. wasn't my cup of tea.

Author: 138NickC138Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent service
Review: Excellent service and food was good. Fish was especially succulent and moist. Servers took time out to entertain our kid despite restaurant being full.

Author: AndyjParkerPerth, Australia
Title: Good ingredients ruined!
Review: Stopped in the new Coliseum Cafe in the Gardens Mall for an evening meal whilst away on business with colleagues. The choice of food was very good and prices were low! We all ordered steaks (2xChateubriand, 1 Fillet), however all the food was served up cold, veggies very crisp and the only thing hot was the side jug of sauce.It was a pity, as the meat cut was lovely, fortunately I am happy to eat blue or even raw, but just prefer it usually to be at least warm!Also note: No alcohol available to drown your disappointment!Will not be returning.

Author: Daniel EZurich, Switzerland
Title: got cheated!
Review: we heard some nice music and thought to stay for a while. We became the menu card and didn't know what to choose. They offered us a "house wine". We thought why not. I heard them wispering something about the price. "Red wine is twelve but I charged them 20 MYR". When we received the bill we had to pay 50 MYR for two glasses of wine!! when I insisted to see the price on the menu card, they told us, that this wine is not on the menu card! What a ridiculous and infamous service! Never ever again!

Author: Tazy_y786
Title: Best falafel ever!
Review: Was definitely worth the wait. One dish I'd highly recommend is the falafel, nice crispy and light. Fattoush was very tasty. Great customer service. Nice fresh healthy clean food. Restaurant is clean and has a homely feel. Well decorated and one of the best spots in langkawi!!!

Author: kerrien19
Title: Asian Fusion, Great service and Tranquil
Review: We ate once whilst in city here, great service and great food, very tranquil surrounds, The menu uses both traditional and exotic meats and dishes, eat or get there a bit early as gets full quick

Author: EuniceLiuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worse ever mother’s celebration
Review: We walk in around 9pm, not crowded at all.Most the food in the menu were run out ? What ?! Are you kidding me is Sunday and mother’s day, you don’t stock enough food ? Even the chicken wings also don’t have ? Then ordered 1 red wine by glass, every one drink already served but not mine ? Then I asked, few mins later came back no more red wine ? This restaurant has no red wine by glass, most of food we want to order also don’t have ? Do you want to do business or not ?? Worse ever Mother’s Day celebration I ever had ! Disappointed

Author: firashamzah93
Title: Mr
Review: The waiters (Sanjai, Fauzi & Ahnbu) are very friendly, helpful and well manner. Keep up the good work.

Author: Keng LHomer Glen, Illinois
Title: Roast pork
Review: Our go-to place for roast pork. About the best in town. Nice crispy skin and not too lean. Also chicken rice and barbecue pork. Beer, coconuts and soft drinks available. No air conditioning, just fans; so can be very warm on a hot day. Lunch only and the roast pork sells out quickly. Come at noon to secure a table as it is very popular.
Restaurant: Wong Kee Hai Lam Chicken Rice & Roast Pork

Author: JamesNjim
Title: Delicious Beriyani
Review: We visited the shopping mall for brunch. Out of curiosity, I ordered the Lamb Beriyani at the Arab Rice stall and I was not disappointed. There are several similar spicy dishes too.

Author: CJW2JTShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: The real PRIME!!!
Review: I must admit, this is probably the only option for a good steak in KL, and I am sure there are people who may disagree. I have been to the Prime a few times, and the steak and restaurant ambience have not let me down thus far. BUT...I need to make a quick comment, in regards to hygiene and cleanliness of the chef preparing the food. we were seated very near the food station, where we can view through the glass panel to see what the chefs are doing, this is what the establishment wanted us to do, to view with comfort and eat in peace. I was kinda disgusted that the chef at the front was picking something to eat with his bare hand, while preparing the food to be served by the waiters. He did not stop eating, even when he saw me starring. the next horror that I saw, was he used the same bare hands to pick up fresh vegetable apparently to be served as salad greens, and that was without even washing his hands. how can this be in a 5 star Le Meridien and the Prime! I think this has to be stopped and discouraged. if he really wants to munch something, he should just go to be back kitchen where no one could see and not doing that so openly. that just lead to another imagination, what else is the unhygienic stuff he as been doing if he was so brave to disregard to feeling of the paying customers. that really put us off. by the way, my wife's fillet mignon which was ordered as medium rare came as well done. we had to send it back. however, I must say that my Augusta Rib Eye was perfect. someone reading this should take some actions. I will not be back until I get some satisfying answers.

Author: Alfie A
Title: Amazing
Review: Excellent food and service. Exquisite furnishing which contributes to the overall elegant ambience that Qureshi exudes. Food is top-notch

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious anniversary dinner
Review: Chose this restaurant for our anniversary dinner and we were not disappointed. We were in two minds about going for the 3 course or 5 course menu but opted for the 3 course and were glad we did as the portions were a good size. Dined on a Sunday evening and it was very quiet. The restaurant itself is located in an apartment building and is somewhat open to the entrance/corridor area. The tom yam prawns I had for starters were absolutely delicious and flavoursome with terrific presentation. In fact, all courses were packed full of flavour. My husband had the duck for mains and it was superb, cooked to perfection. I had the fish for mains and it was a very good portion size, however I discovered a few bones. The restaurant was happy to replace the dish. Service was attentive and friendly. The cocktails were delicious too! This is fine dining without the stuffy formal atmosphere. I would happily return!

Author: Ikram KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the price anymore
Review: Had been a patron ever since it first opened. But now the staff are a rowdy bunch of school kids or delinquents on their first jobs making all sorts of noise but don't know much about service. Not worth the price as it was before. And I hate it when I order tea, it comes as hot water and a teabag.

Author: Jasmin A
Title: Worse experience
Review:
When wt family ordered couple of Nan tandoori chicken, they served us cold Nan and tandoori chicken. When ask they said can heat it up that's all, we told them forget abt it. But still charge for that.
what kind of mentality....terrible experience. .👎👎👎

Author: SingleSoul7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Service - Trying to fool customers
Review: I have never been to a restaurant where the buffet does not include plain water. The manager was poor at answering when I asked why there is no water. All they wanted, customers to pay for the water. Overall, only one waiter is good there, rest of them are not very responsive to the customers. The restaurant used to have lamb ribs in the buffet, but recently they don't put ribs in the buffet menu. They ask people to buy separately. Fooling customers with lousy answers is not a good idea. If people are paying for the buffet, give them what they are paying for. Food taste is fine but restaurant has poor policy and service which needs to be improved.

Author: LL721Kuala Lumpur
Title: Expensive! Not worth the price for the food and bad service!
Review: Had the tempura lunch set... 3 miserable pieces of salmon sashimi, 5 pieces of tempura, 1 miserable sad looking piece of mackerel, chawan mushi, miso soup, fruit, salad, pickles and rice. It was normal and the price was RM37+. The only think I liked was the chawan mushi, which was nicely done, hot and nice.Then, had to remind them to bring my hot green tea because the service was so slow. Was a bit surprised that they gave me a pot with one cup. At the end, I saw the bill which was RM5+ for the tea! Isn't that too much for hot green tea?Total bill was RM42.40 because I had to pay RM4.20 for service which was non existent.

Author: Catríona D
Title: Dated and overpriced
Review: My husband treated me to dinner in the KL Tower for my birthday during or honeymoon. On arrival we were told we couldn’t go to our table because it was 6.14pm and our table was booked for 6.30pm. Not being able to even go up and wait at the bar for a drink before our meal was disappointing and having to just wait around.On entering the restaurant both my husband and I were let down by the restaurant appearance wise. Old, very dirty carpet with patches out of it, massive wear and tear on the skirting board and around windows etc. Table clothes were so old and ‘bally’ and cutlery worn, heavy and not gleaming at all.We were not even offered water when we got to our table, I had to go find someone and request a drinks menu. My husbands whisky was serviced in an older than old promotion glass for water. We were also charged an additional 50MRY to sit by the window even though when we got there we realised all Two seater tables were by the window anyway and it’s really didn’t make any difference as the windows even seemed musty so pictures weren’t good. The food was nice, not amazing but we did enjoy that aspect thankfully as it was so expensive.It dulled the excitement of our celebration and had no real atmosphere there at all, we intended to eat as quick as possible and leave to go elsewhere for drinks. Just as well, as we were told during our dessert at 8.05pm, can you pay your bill and leave before 8.30pm for their next sitting. We knew this but didn’t like it forced down our throats as we paid a lot of money for this disappointing experience with poor customer service. Maintenance and renovation is highly needed as it is not worth the money. Much better restaurants to go to in the city.

Author: Rana U
Title: Poor service, equally bad food
Review: Horrendous service and equally bad food. I asked the waiter who was attending me what the soup of the day was & his reply was "how do I explain it; it's very difficult", to which I said.."just name the soup, what is the name of soup?" He then went in to check and returned and said erm it's tomato soup and I just shook my head in disbelief. The food was not only bad but was also not fresh. Highly recommend people to stay away!

Author: marcwatton1London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food but weird atmosphere due to acoustics of place and looped music
Review: We chose this restaurant as a result of its rankings on TA. We were not disappointed with the food which was delicious and fairly priced. However the atmosphere is odd. Partly I think because it is a relatively small room and the acoustics are bad and we could hear every uninteresting word of the German woman on the next table. Furthermore the music was on a loop of one song which frankly was annoying after the second time. The waiters were ok but not over friendly either.

Author: DJPaciSydney, Australia
Title: Shark fin soup!!!!
Review: These guys are openly selling shark fin soup & porridge on their menu. Apparently it's 'traditional' according to the manageress. Anyone who cares about the ocean and wants to play a part in avoiding the extinction of one of the most beautiful marine creatures on our planet, should stay well clear of this restaurant.

Author: powerranger123
Title: Nothing Special
Review: Chicken was just plain chicken with a slight peppery taste. Beansprouts also nothing special. Chicken rice also quite mediocre. Not sure why these are the signature items. The other side dishes were much better. Chicken innards were prepared decently well. Oyster mushroom was nice too.

Author: winifredwohc
Title: A bit cosy with the portion served
Review: We had our lunch there and tried the signature pork ribs. Taste is ok, but not worth the price charged. The rice is good instead of spaghetti. Overall, worth to have a try if you are pork lover. For me, I probably won't go again at least in these short period.

Author: YannKualaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The great Sunday brunch experience.
Review: The brand new W offered one a lavish brunch in a nice trendy clean decor.The staff greeted us with a smile and the service the entire brunch was really seamless and fantastic. Several different counters like seafood, sushi, meat, cold cut, cheese, deserts were displayed. You can also choose a la carte options like poached eggs with lobster, scrambled eggs with cured salmon.The seafood counter offers oysters, amazing scallops in their shell or some crab. Everything was very fresh and tasty. The sushi counter is interesting as well. I tried the delicious maki with fois gras, the lobster one and the yummy salmon sashimi. The chef has prepared some Chinese, Indians and Malaysian classical dishes allowing you to get various tastes of what this country can offer. I tried also a slice of a juicy big piece of beef along with roasted vegetables and melted cheese, it was excellent.I am less enthousiastic with the cheese selection that was not very interesting either tasty.Regarding the desert, there is a small selection but it is very good one . For the drinks, we took the flow less package. They serve lovely cocktails like rum sour, shots and good white and red wines. If you prefer champagne, you will have to pay by the bottle. They poure your glass regularly without that you need to ask for it. The value for money is really good. Definitely, I will be back soon to enjoy this Sunday brunch again.

Author: LqsoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: It was me and my family first time visiting this place, Call in to book a table and arrive on time, place is very squeezing into a small box, tables are small and the glasses for drink are dirty, Could not expect this from a 5 star hotel property. Poor was very disappointing, i can see that they use plenty of ready-made food, just heat up and serve. Nothing much to say about the food, choices are very little as well.

Author: assamklCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Stick to the beer unless you like sweet pizza!
Review: The beer selection is quite wide here - 10 beers from 5 countries ranging from RM15 for Asahi beer (Japanese) to RM36 for Hoegaarden (Belgium). A friend told me they had Sarawak Laksa here, but they didn't have it. So I got a pepperoni pizza instead. It was sweet! Service was rather slow, so by the time I got my pizza, my beer was warm. Warm beer with sweet pizza. What a terrible combination!Looking around and on the way out, saw other diners eating what looked like T-bone steak - so maybe that was the better tasting option. Lots of other tables had ordered buckets of beer bottles, and as the staff shirts claimed, people visited Sarawak, but they pissed at Ming Cafe. Their customers are locals, budget travellers, and tourists. Prices are slightly higher, because like most things, they are higher in East Malaysia compared to West Malaysia.

Author: Montano V
Title: Love the Nasi Bojari
Review: The nasi bojari ,  rice served with a quarter chicken nicely done Indonesian or nyonya style.  Loved the ais kacang, a very filling dessert indeed.

Author: Tommyea3
Title: Appetizers and cocktails
Review: Great dynamic cocktail selection.  Very helpful staff and servers.  Cocktail creativity abounds.  Don't miss this place.

Author: Jami W
Title: Food and drinks
Review: Best place for shisha and drinks one of my favourite place in Kl , the staffs have the best behaviour must visit for all the tourist and locals

Author: nimsterfish
Title: Great food
Review:
This is a great restaurant , wonderfully themed with various food wares , a central deli creating a wonderful immersive experience. 
The food was delicious and the menu quite extensive. 
No alcohol available but not a major issue

Author: myra214
Title: One of good place to eat
Review: One of best place to eat with more than 2 people . But they do not take reservations even if its for dinner :( ..

Author: RajanBaliah
Title: The steak will wanna make you want to go back for more!
Review:
Awesome steak served my senior waiters who have probably been here forever!

The ambience is resembles the 1960s or 70s!

They serve good beer and wine to complement the excellent food.

Author: sayanbhattacharya
Title: Tasty Food
Review: Tarbush serves great Lebanese cuisine. Must try ! It is easily accesible near Bukit Bintang. You also dont need any prior reservations. Good ambience, nice service and above all tasty food.

Author: Claire KTokyo, Japan
Title: Not gonna visit again
Review: I booked the restaurant to celebrate my dad's 60th birthday but really, cant say i am satisfied. Food average, staff not very friendly, not worth paying 500 for. 1. Arrived, and nobody at the door, so i had to call 4-5 times to get staff's attention. 2. Seated, and waitresses were a bit scary. No smile and we had communication issues... Didnt feel comfortable at all. 3. Food served. Starters were good, beef tataki and lobster soup were nice. And one of their their signature dish, cod with risotto was good too. Not really remarkable tho. And the steak .... Well i know better places to eat. 4. I pre-ordered special dessert for my father but apparently my order didnt get through... I had only one cake served with no message i asked on it. And the icecream toppings on chocolate lava cake fell down as soon as its served. And the cake tasted ok but cant really say good.I asked what happened to other dessert because we got new forks and spoons so naturally i thought they were coming. But untill all the icecream melt, nope. Nothing happened. I had to ask and my surprise was ruined. We had dessert served for free afterwards but i was pretty upset. The lady in suit(manager perhaps) was nice and friendly but it was really not the kind of place i would visit again.

Author: Compass443686
Title: Not a safe environment
Review: Had a good night, nice food and environment. Unfortunately I find the place is not really safe. Too many scumbag Indian's , and we got disturbed by them, luckily I was able manage the situation . I'm an Indian too ,but we can expect everyone to be the same. If you guys going for date, I would recommend leave early or find a different place ,this is for your safety!

Author: lewiszx
Title: Better !
Review:
Nice ! limited menu make the dinner treats within budget ! Their staffs, especially owner welcome guest with smiley faces and friendly approaches. 

Recommendation from them was sincere and up to expectation.  

Good try !

Author: joanadventure
Title: Old Town White Coffee
