Review: Old Town White Coffee is a place to get variety of food from local - curry mee to western fish & chips. It's a place to get authentic White coffee and also got place to charge h/p with free WIFI.

Author: JamesKMTan
Title: Average
Review: They have a branch located along Jalan SS2/4 opposite the Lorenzo furniture shop occupying a corner lot. Ordered a few varieties of Yong tow foo. The taste is average and service a bit slow. They also have steamed kailan and lettuce.
Restaurant: Ipoh Road Yong Tow Foo, Cairnhill Hotel

Author: moveawayMalaysia
Title: Good food, poor service
Review: Lovely restaurant with great ambiance. Where it fails is the service. I know that some of the staff are volunteers but they are clueless about the menu and some are not able to converse well in English. We ordered the vadai as a started which was freshly prepared and hot but the drawback was that it was very oily and inadequately drained after frying. The thosai was good and crispy and I would highly recommend it. The chutneys were ok but the sambar was very good Overall, average when all is taken into consideration.

Author: Amrazor
Title: Not as amazing as I thought it was going to be
Review: We had a full range of good from pizza through Malay and steak burgers with salads and fruit juices. The fresh orange juice was nice. Presentation was also good with a nicely knitted out seating place. Now the food, The steak was not cooked properly, the beef in the salad was raw and chewy the teriyaki steak was smothered in too much soy sauce, the Malay dish was nice everything else below average. There are much better places to eat within walking distance.

Author: queen_touristKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Christmas Eve Service
Review: VERY POORLY TRAINED STAFF - We waited 40 MINUTES for dessert. We followed up at least 4 times and were advised that it was on the way. We eventually asked to cancel but the female Indian server insisted we wait another 10 minutes because the dishes were already being made. Emphasis on INSISTED as she was very RUDE and expected us to follow her even though we were already unhappy with the late service. When I asked to cancel, she then said to wait another 5 minutes to see if it was possible. UNBELIEVABLE! I don't believe there was even a manager on site on Christmas Eve to settle such matters. Absolutely terrible.Pros:1. Good ambiance2. Some good pasta dishesCons:1. Digital menu is not easy to navigate2. Portions are quite small for the price you are paying for; if the goal is for fine dining, it still isn't justified3. When we asked for water for a table of 4, they only served 24. Quite rude waiting service, always on the bar area and not proactively checking on tables

Author: DanielcyChuahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The food was way over price
Review: We went there with my office colleague and was offer with a set menu which cost us about RM115 to RM129.00 for a 3 course dish and an additional RM25.00 for free flow of orange juice, coffee or tea. The food served does really taste good, i'm having a steak which the steak was thin and tasteless... some of my colleague order chestnut chicken where the chicken is dry and again tasteless. SOme of my colleague order sambal spaghetti whereby it taste so spicy that non of the them can finish it. Overall not satisfy with my experience there.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: LaryyyT
Title: Same idea, the 1836 or whatever is a scam.
Review: And the teas gone from SGD35 a pop to SGD60 now for a tiny canister which I bought. I don't feel the price justifies the teas which becomes increasingly expensive. Greed at best

Author: lucyang99Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Dayak or D'yak food?
Review: For non-durian fans, avoid any dish that's cooked with tempoyak, the preserved durian. I differentiate tempoyak as pickled or fermented. Most people just refer to tempoyak as "fermented durian". I maintain that if the preserved durian tastes sourish, it is fermented, if sweetish, pickled. For durian fans, tempoyak sauteed with anchovy or pork belly is an appetizer and goes perfectly with plain steamed or boiled rice. Dayak, phonetically pronounced d'yak because the first letter "a" is not pronounced as strongly as the second letter "a", is a general term now used to refer to any of the indigenous, ethnic groups of Sarawak. But the term most popularly refers to either the Iban or the Bidayuh groups. Anyway, to experience D'yak Restaurant food, chicken, pork, or fish cooked in the bamboo tube is a must try. This style of cooking is distinctively Dayak.

Author: heywen98
Title: Great location for dinner
Review: The restaurant ambience is good and comfortable.great place for an evening dinner with delicious food especially the unagi roll with chilli inside 😍and the service crew greeted us warmly. They were attentive and helpful.

Author: SARALAE
Title: Bad food
Review: Food was very bad. Ingredients are not fresh. Waste of time and money. Will not visit again. My third try and they failed again. Never Gona step in this place again.

Author: PikTzeHong
Title: Not a place to have good conversation over dinner
Review: This place prides itself for loud music. The music is so ridiculously loud that is deafening. I can't even speak to my siblings who are just sitting opposite me. Fyi they don't serve plain water. A bottle water costs rm3 that's same as a theme park price. I order beer thinking it is draught cause of the price but it was in a can. Are u kidding me? This is a 5 star pub or bar? Last time here. Btw they don't have Wi-Fi too.

Author: EatnEatnEat
Title: Horrible service & food! A slaughtering house for tourists
Review: I went with a group of friends on 1st june during school holidays and made reservation vis what’s app in advance. The food was way below expectations. Those good reviews I believe are orchestrated to boost sales and they are not genuine. This restaurant used to be good when they were at the old small stall. The lady who took our order is also owner as this is a family business. We ordered a suckling pig in advance and she kept insisting we order fish, sea cucumber, sharks fin etc. we also made a mistake and didn’t ask prices for those under market price category. The food came and much to our disappointment. They were either very oily, bland and flat. Some were just normal. Not a single dish wowed us. Food so lousy that we didn’t bother to take photos and Bill was $2549 ringgit! Will never ever ever ever come back again! Rubbish place

Author: Travelmadboy
Title: Incredible food
Review: Really nice food in a quirky restaurant- recommend garlic prawns and mango duck, and the portion sizes were humongous (I wouldn't bother with a rice dish too) Sadly the prices were a bit steep, but I would recommend at least once during a trip to Kuching

Author: Travel_Buff_AsiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reached high expectations
Review: Foodie friends of ours had highly recommended this place and our hotel concierge warned of long queues to enter... So we entered this restaurant before 8pm on a Friday. Its just over 5 min walk from the Hard Rock and on the second left down Jonker.We got seating at once and a very patient server who explained each specialty. We chose 4 dishes, the chicken, prawn and okra were superb - delicious blend of spices but not too hot. The atmosphere is simple but service was swift and attentive also with the family photos on the walls it felt like we were in a Peranakan relative's dining room.Planning to try another meal before returning home. The variety of items on the menu and the experience of the first visit requires that!

Author: WongK1312
Title: Excellent service
Review: overall a very good dining experience. Service staffs are friendly and helpful. Highly recommended for family dining and special day celebration
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: samantha086086
Title: Very average grills, shawarmas,
Review: Very average grills, shawarmas, and rice!good service though, really good shisha and hummus.! I’d say go for shisha and enjoy the belly dancer.

Author: Khylune TUnited Kingdom
Title: Impeccable Service & Great Dishes
Review: Shang Palace in my opinion is arguable one of the finest Chinese dining establishment in a 5 star hotel in Kuala Lumpur. The dish variety is extremely eclectic and one is spoilt for choice. The ambiance is beautiful with lovely touches.However the staff is truly the pride of this fine establishment. Being a regular guest they always remember my food preference and would bend backwards to provide the best dining experience for me and my dining companion. I’d like to make mention of Lai Ying and Sim on this occasion who’ve provided a very personalized and incredible service this evening.

Author: carynjen13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced and Lousy Food
Review: Came here for CNY reunion dinner (2 tables about 14 of us).Waited extremely long for the food to be served. Food finally came but in separate bowls for individual serving (SO LITTLE). Was not even full with that tiny portion and they only serve each of us one plate.Not one dish is nice except for the soup. Most are so so and for a restaurant of that standard i would have expected way more. I can get better tasting food for much better price elsewhere. I didn't bother with taking much pictures. Only thing worth talking about is the sufi that did sort off like a kungfu style move of pouring tea. That was amazing because I could see the tea swirling in the cup but it did not spill one drop.Total cost was almost 5k (including 1 bottle of Hennessy & 1 bottle of wine).

Author: yisiewtSingapore, Singapore
Title: Short trip
Review: One of my favorite Korean BBQ restaurant . Always visit the one in Jb Bukit Indah so wanted to try this stall . Customer service very good . Food wise not as good as the one in Indah . Free seafood pancake and steam eggs for the kids .

Author: ChowF36
Title: Overrated, Unfriendly Tourist Trap
Review: Lots of chicken breast for half chicken!  Owner very rude when being questioned.  Would not recommend!

Author: Vguudeal
Title: Unpretentious, good and cheap!
Review: A well located restaurant in the he heart of town, serving authentic Hakka cuisine. Seafood was fresh and reasonable price. Staff were friendly and ambience fair for a family restaurant. Good value. Will come again!

Author: 478sallybBrussels, Belgium
Title: Creative breakfast offerings
Review: Came here for Father’s Day brunch. Really interesting dishes - not your standard fare. I had The Legend - beef and chorizo meatballs served with poached eggs in a spicy tomato sauce. Very delicious and packed a punch. My only complaint is that the meat was ground too finely for the meatballs making them a bit mushy. Husband had Terry Benedict - braised beef cheeks served eggs Benedict style. He enjoyed. Daughter had udon noodles laksa style with a side of chicken karaage. She wasn’t such a fan. Coffee was good. The place was packed and quite loud making conversation a bit difficult. I’d come again.

Author: Aiman_Azami
Title: Delicious Food
Review: Very nice Fried Rice, Sure will come again, only the waiter made a bit spoil, i ask for ABC without bean but they still put it. Overall nice food

Author: Alexey Y
Title: Biggest scam and tourist trap in KL
Review: You will pay 200RM+ per person for a bland buffet, deal with totally clueless staff, tacky in-your-face shops, and pay taxi-mafia prices on exit. This place is the tackiest and biggest tourist trap in the entire city. I took some visiting family here for a treat and felt ashamed about the impression they have of Kuala Lumpur. This place is a disgrace and should be shut down. Lesson learned. I hope you learn from my mistake and never visit this place.

Author: huiyeeg2015
Title: Must eat in Melaka
Review:
I always come to this shop for chicken rice ball in Melaka, at least I don't have to line up under the sun for a long time. 

Love their fast and good service, and most important tasty steam chicken.

Author: Jenny J
Title: Great food
Review: Great food, with lots of variety. An easy walk from the Riverside Majestic hotel. Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant. The staff are friendly. We went twice during our stay amazing place

Author: laachmanl
Title: Tasty food & very pleasant environment
Review: All the dishes were simply superb. And surrounding of the restaurant was so clean and beautiful. Highly recommended place to have good and satisfying meal.

Author: leong34Pulau Ubin, Singapore
Title: Super Roast Duck
Review: Visited this place for lunch in June for a group of 15 Pax. We had the Roast Duck. Crispy Duck. Char Siew. "House" soup which was complimentary and a Vegetable. i still rate the Roast Duck here to be one of the best in KL! The Char Siew was also superb! Service was great and definitely a good choice to have come here for lunch. i visited the Bangsar Village outlet!

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Chinese Food Court
Review: The food court provides good selection of local food. It's less crowded, as compared to the restaurant next door. Food are taste good & priced reasonable

Author: junecasaKuala Lipis, Malaysia
Title: Good location but poor service
Review: We had our lunch here and there were 10 of us. Each of us ordered different food and drinks. But only mine was watermelon juice. The watermelon that I ordered was not fresh and taste wired. I let my husband tried a bit, was same. Hence, I brought the drinks to a waitress and she brought me to show to a barista/ manager at the drinks counter. The superior at the counter say nothing and just pour the juice to another small cup and try, then he answered me: ok ah, nothing wrong with this. I irks him is not fresh the fruit and really weird the taste and can I change another glass same juice? I didn't ask for others, just the same. If the taste is still the same, then I accept it. And the juice I only drinks a bit. But the guy pour again my juice and try and told me with an unsatisfied face and voice: this is our local watermelon, the taste is like that and gave me back the juice which left half glass after he pour out twice. I was angry but say nothing. And just took back my half glass juice and left it on my table. But me and my friends all decided won't come back again to this cafe.

Author: Lisa D
Title: Food Poisoning
Review: While I have historically really enjoyed this place, and have been here many times, my 4 friends and I (all expats living in Asia for 2+ years) got food poisoning when we ordered the appetizer platter and the mixed grilled platter. I am not impressed. There are other places nearby I will go and not get sick.

Author: M.Khalid I
Title: The sensual of Beach n Reggae Cafe in Shah Alam
Review: Chill atmosphere with the island vibe cafe. Great place to hangout especially when u missed to be on the tropical island.

Author: tatsuok780
Title: Amazing service and food
Review: Amira and Sethu  is a good and very kind person ....Service was really good.....Food was really amazing which is the spinach pizza and Caesar salad That I had

Author: kyokhutori
Title: can't have enough
Review: everything's good quality, great variety, good deals, always looking forward to new highlights every month

Author: Devilynn_SP
Title: Take away
Review: So I ordered Fried Rice. It was THE most horrible fried rice I've ever eaten. The chef literally just dump the rice, some anchovies, some carrot strips and probably a handful of salt into the wok and fried them. A very disappointing lunch...

Author: SerHweeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch on eve of Deepavali
Review: We were recommended on sweet & sour grouper their crown dish and we ordered.It was a disappointment. Fish not fresh and not crispy. We also ordered the red bean paste wrap in the skin. The skin was thick and not crispy but bean paste taste ok. The Peking duck cook in 3 styles but no soup as the waiter informed. So we have Peking duck, mee and fried Peking duck bones. The Peking duck was not as fragrant as before but the mee was just as good as before. However as for the Peking duck bones was horrible like a beggar food. We ate here before it was good and we came back. This round the service was not good and the food not that tasty. .

Author: mclalor
Title: Ok for a quick drink
Review: Well situated abd good for a quick beer. Didn't eat there so can't comment on food but it seemed very noisy and washroom facilities very poor standard.

Author: Margarithe
Title: Awful
Review: The food is awful and before you are finished, the bill is presented. There is no atmosphere and the staff are not great. Not worth the visit.

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great north Indian food expresso
Review: The restaurant reminded me of Tally Joe in London with a simple contemporary bistro style. It is very popular and busy in the evenings and not surprisingly because it serves up small but extremely tasty north Indian dishes that come with a selection of naan and roti. Limited selection of wine and they do run out of their own dishes quite often but with the high turnover they done seem to care too much.

Author: 191wilsont
Title: Good variety of choices
Review:
1. Savoury Egg Plant 特殊茄子

3. Butter Chicken 奶油鸡丁

4. Pumpkin Tau Foo 金瓜豆腐

Nice and economical food.

Service is good.

Waiting time is fast.

Fully recommended.

Author: Mimosa017
Title: Unique food
Review: Unique food which not available in east Malaysia, like the bamboo chicken, tempoyak fish, fermented durian, fish is very unique and interesting, doesn't taste like durian but quite strong taste, worth to try.

Author: YLShia
Title: poor tasting food
Review: I visited the restaurant yesterday. The place is very clean and nice.  But the food is a total disappointment. The servers are friendly but the person taking the order was so arrogant that it made the whole experience very unpleasant.

Author: GBHKWORLD
Title: Just ok
Review:
Food is ok, just ok.

Not a great sign when a place serving local food has no locals going to it.

Better and cheaper local food at the hawkers markets.

Author: MVW2013
Title: Steak heaven
Review: If you are longing for a good steak then this is the place. Absolutely divine. Best steak ever, not to mention the fabulous wine we had to go with it it. Memorable night.

Author: PravdaForever
Title: This place is a restaurant gone wrong.
Review: A long time ago, I remember this restaurant being nice, clean and quick. Now it’s a dump. The staff is nice, but general service is slow. The dishes are nice, too. But the waiting time is long.

Author: francis654
Title: Street food.
Review:
20th Oct. 1930hrs. Bought grilled chicken wings (supposed famous outlet). Over-rated.  Tasteless even though well grilled.  
Bought fried durian.  Not too bad. 3 pieces for $10 RM.  
My opinion. Too commercialised and to many touting.  Making it very hard sell and not worth the visit.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: Kenn LKuala Lumpur
Title: Comfortable family style Japanese restaurant chain
Review: Dropped by on a Sunday afternoon. There wasn't a queue and the polite and friendly wait staff seated us immediately. We chose to seat at the counter and the seats were comfortable. They had a kids menu that had crossword puzzles and simple Japanese phrases for them to learn. Very few Japanese restaurants have kids menu and we were glad Ippudo did have them. They served three types of broth; tonkotsu, miso and spicy miso. I had the spicy miso while wife tried their tonkotsu. The spicy miso was good. It has just the right kinda heat that won't kill you. Wife's tonkotsu ramen was typical of Hakata style. Ippudo allowed patrons to choose the level of softness/hardness of their ramen noodles. Their dining ambiance is very good vs the competition and we'll be back for more. Their ajitama was better than Menya Musashi's.

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Agree - Twas Underwhelming
Review: We wanted something, ummm, “trendier” than the street food we indulged in for our last nite in Penang. Actually, we set our sight (and palette) on a real decent nyonya place. Regretfully, it was a Monday and almost Our shortlisted nyonya restaurants were closed for the day. That pushed us to readjust our plans.Relying on the ever trusted TripAdvisor, we settled on Lagenda.Nice enough setting. Love the decor.Sad to say though that the food was pretty forgettable. In fact, I can’t remember for the like of me what we ordered. Ahhhhhh .... Wait .... Found the receipt ! Ikan bakar and ayam penyet. If this is your maiden trip to Penang and you’re on your first day, Lagenda is a good intro to the delights in Penang. Truth is there is better food to be had elsewhere.

Author: Robin P
Title: Great Plaza to Visit!
Review: Special place to visit. Worth of time to know the process of Mamee Monster! You can design your own Mamee noodle and make it the unique Mamee for memory. Definitely will come and visit again.

Author: JanP3745
Title: Obvious decline in quality
Review: I visited the Sarang Cookery twice. The first time was beginning of the year (2016), the second time just recently. Something must have happened in between, because the quality dropped significantly. The first time was an extraordinarily positive experience that would have deserved 5 stars (that's why I decided to go again). The food and drinks were awesome, the service good, and the atmosphere very relaxed and comfortable. The second time was a complete disappointment, which is certainly not due to my high expectations. The ice lemon tea was definitely different and dropped massively in taste and quality. The food was plain and soulless. But also the service and atmosphere changed. After years of experience as gastronomy parttimer, I could sense the tension between boss (the lady that fakes a friendly face and yells behind the scenes in the kitchen) and staff. No wonder they appeared nervous and "unconcerned" during customer service, and maybe that trouble they obviously had "backstage" also caused the 20 minutes waiting time even though there were not many other customers. That looks pretty unprofessional to me. Sorry to say that, but I guess I will look for another dining place when I have another business trip to KL.Additional remark: I posted this review before. How is it possible that it is removed without notification?

Author: MichaelinaChuaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Coming Home
Review: This is THE place for Sarawak laksa when I come back to my home town. Sarawakians have their favourite laksa haunts and this is mine because of my childhood memories of coming here on Sundays after mass at the nearby church.The place is always packed with locals and tourists because it's not just the food but the ambience of kopitiam; the Malaysian coffee shop with roti kahwin (kaya toast), kolo Mee, popiah and the iconic Sarawak laksa.The bustle of table service has the efficiency of tried and true systems. But nothing beats a battered old clothespin to let the teller (who walks around the tables) know you have paid.Park across the street if you come by car. Locals tend to park as they wish, on top of pavements, triple parked etc. That is probably what has changed from my experience of eating here!

Author: herricterMalaysia
Title: Suck Latte with Rude Manager
Review: 15th August 2015, roughly 5pm++, I'm with my friend went to your good restaurant at The Gardens Mall to have a cup of drink, but we're felt disappointed. We was ordered a pot of Peach sencha, hot cuppucinno,Ice Latte, Apple soda and 2 slices of cake. The worst and terrible thing is happened, the Ice latte is black coffee with milk and it's not espresso with milk, the taste is suck, and I'm was requested to a staff for change, after 5 minutes, a black shirt chinese guy was came to my table with show us face and asked:" Ah, who ordered Ice Latte just now" and I answered is me and explained the taste to him, but he seems no happy and said:" Our Latte is like that, is different with STARBUCKS." to avoid arguing, I just said:" Sent me back the drink." and he left, might be I'm was no spend good money at your good restaurant, at the end i just left my drink and pay for it. It is this is how the manager treat to customer? And also, why need to compared your good drink with STARBUCKS? I had alot of Latte at any coffee house but the worst I had is at your good restaurant. Please kindly train your restaurant manager how to handle customer complaint and learn more how to provide a good customer service. If no welcomed me for have drink at kindly restaurant I can just left. It was make my "wondeful"day with friends. This my 1st and last visit Alexis.

Author: Pvcras
Title: Grilled fish at sunset
Review: Fresh grilled fish and huge tiger prawns with sides and veg. Wonderful. Fantastic food and lovely attentive staff. All at a beachfront table and a sunset. How can you better that? Fabulous. Highly recommended.

Author: Jishnu575
Title: Good Food, Bad Service
Review:
The Curry Puff is the best I find anywhere. The service in some of its outlets desires a lot more.
For early morning breakfasts,I regularly frequented Old Town, and the coffee is legendary. About time they take the service complaints seriously.

Author: sirpao2016Espoo, Finland
Title: Wery nice cafe
Review: Good coffee and breakfast. There are also lunch and dinner portions available.Atmosphere is nice and you can enjoy piece of art during your stay.Service is friendly and nice.Menu is a bit limited but is compensated with quality.This cafe has found the way to differentiate from other cafes.Warmly recommended.

Author: shrzkml
Title: Bad coffee but awesome mille crepe cake.
Review: The first time I came I ordered latte and it was terrible. It wasn't hot at all, and it taste like normal latte. Nothing extra ordinary but had to come again for its delicious mille crepe cake.

Author: John_USA12Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Terrible Management/Service
Review: Walked into this place at 230PM on a Sunday to get a coffee and pastry. We were told by the manager/owner that there was not enough staff help to serve anyone! Are you kidding me?Food is fine, but what a joke - any place but KL (where service is poor across the board) this place would be out of business. Go to Antipodean, next door, great food and actual service.

Author: boborygmi
Title: Should be called tasteless!
Review: Forget about trying the durian chendol. Mediocre chendol topped with insipid watery duriany liquid. Much better off saving the calories for the durian chendol at the tried and tested san su gong a few shophouses down the street.

Author: jojopancakesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing and sloppy
Review: There was a long row of nonya restaurants along jonker street. We thought this looked the most promising and we soon learnt our lesson that appearance and accreditations certs may not always be the best gauge for good food. The dishes served was bland. The salted vegetable duck soup (itek tim) was a far cry from the picture on their menu. See the pics and you will know what I'm talking about. It tasted like plain water with a hint of duck essence. This is the nicest description I could give. Go at your own risk!

Author: U058542New York City, New York
Title: Complaint
Review: Food very tasty, but it was my last day in Malaysia and I was living on my Mastercard, very low on cash. Sign on the front door and next to cash register said clearly that Mastercard/Visa were accepted. Only when I came to pay the bill was I told “there is a 50 Ringgit” minimum, and I was a “solo” diner. Lagenda Cafe should know that setting a minimum transaction amount on a Visa or Mastercard is strictly ILLEGAL outside the US, where a $10 minimum transaction has been legal, but only since 2010. It’s a reportable offense. I JUST barely had enough cash to pay my bill but I left very unhappily. If you want to continue this illegal practice, post a sign, ok?

Author: Linh G
Title: A smokehouse out of pork...
Review: My husband and I went there for lunch in hopes to try their ribs. To our disappointment, they did not have any ribs, pulled pork or anything with pork in it. The servers were clueless and kept having to run back and forth between us and the kitchen to ask if they had this or that. Out of the entire menu, only the pasta and cheese burger were available. So we just ordered a pasta to share, an iced lemon tea and a glass of water (not bottled water). When the bill came I was very surprised that they charged 50sens for the glass of water. I don't really care about the 50 sens as it's not a question of money. It just made my entire experience from bad to worse.

Author: John L
Title: 15 people dining today
Review: Food serve very slow. And some didn't come out after we finish . They didn't allow us to cancel the order when settling the bills.. Price: rm35 per person

Author: Stig-asaurus
Title: Bleh..
Review: Was having craving for Korean food (after having visually assaulted by those Korean reality shows for the past daya!), and decided to try this eatery - we went to the Citta Mall outlet. We were greeted politely by the waitress, and upon being seated, she proposed to us the food to order.But that was about the good thing about this place. The rest are just bleh!Food were overpriced! And the food were not good at all. It tasted like the usual fried nice one could get elsewhere (and far less cheaper).Place is noisy too - blaring outdated K-Pop music; such a turn-off for those who wish to have conversations with others.Take it from me - Malaysia is a food haven, and I assure you that there are other Korean restaurants, better and cheaper.

Author: mathelaci
Title: Our favourite banana leaf restaurant!
Review: We come here every week with the kids and we were never disappointed! We have tried all the banana leaf places in bangsar and we always gravitated back to Raj's. The veg are nice, popodoms crispy, the rotis amazing. Service is good, food arrives quickly.

Author: Paragpuria
Title: Good dining place
Review: Ambience is attractive. Food quality is good but service is average. Not very popular with visitors for dinner time.

Author: ciktravelista
Title: churros!
Review: this is my second time here. this restaurant serves malaysian and western food. the price is reasonable. i like their churros. other than that, just okay. i think this is a good place to dine in with your family and friends.

Author: Shanna MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Go for the view....not the food or service
Review: We were very disappointed with this restaurant! We had to wait in a line for more than 30 minutes to get up to the restaurant. Keep in mind, it is hot and humid in KL and the dress code for this restaurant is “fancy” (but not enforced). Not the best conditions to be waiting in the heat. And there is no priority given to restaurant diners for the lift. Hence the long wait and we were in line with/behind those going to the observation deck also. The food was very disappointing. We opted for the buffet to try a few of their speciality dishes. The food was ok at best. The Indian food was not very spicy and the sushi was not very fresh. The buffet area is small and there is barely enough room to move. Poorly planned from start to finish.The service was what you would expect at a 2-Star restaurant.....definitely not fine dining. We will not go back here, even for the view. There are easier, better and less expensive ways for that!

Author: Kapsicurean
Title: Nice friendly bar frequented by locals
Review: Enjoyed the all strings band comprising of local Sarawakians in their 50's (my guess) for an unplugged expereince!

Author: VivienS30
Title: Excellent service with good food
Review: Had the sumptuous lunch with my friend which recommended by Jacquelyn. The food  portion is just nice and taste good. Enjoying the cozy ambience and definately will come back again..

Author: rogerstephensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Really disappointed, not what it was and it's shame..
Review: Used to be may favourite Sunday lunch time haunt. Some blips recently, they changed the chef and the food was dreadful for a while but got better again, still not to the old glory days sadly.After main course, today we ordered two desserts. Waited half an hour. No dessert so we asked for the bill which included two desserts. Waitress says it's normal for a 20 minute wait for a dessert, we are told when we order. I wasn't. Was it written on the menu? No. OK revised bill came. Just as we were about to pay the waitress said the desserts had arrived. I relented and said OK pack them, I can give to the kids. 10 minutes later nothing. Now beyond angry, I left. Just as I left the waitress came out with my change, no dessert and the bill again included the desserts. What complete and utter rubbish. I chose to drive off rather than shout. KL is full of much better places than this.

Author: Pankit S
Title: Ordinary food and service
Review: We went for lunch there, food and service was ordinary. Very busy restaurant during the lunch time. Curry laksa and mango salad didn't meet my expectations.

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: They don't serve warm/hot water!
Review: Came to this restaurant at Sunway Pyramid branch. Service was good, less people as Ramadhan month currently. We ordered Fish & Chips, Nasi Bojari, Chicken Satay and Honey Lemon drink. The Fish & Chips taste so-so, nothing to shout about. The Nasi Bojari is still good but the rice portion is getting smaller. Satay was ok, but the meat is not 100% cooked! Since both my husband n I was having cough, we only ordered hot drink, Honey Lemon. Half way through, I ordered a cup of hot water (to take my medicine) but was told that they don't serve hot water - the only hot water available was, buy a bottle of mineral water from them and they will pour it into a mug and put it in a microwave to heat up! Amazing, Madam Kwan! This is stupid and ridiculous! Highest degree of stupidity! Madam Kwan's have that!

Author: LotusmemoryKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A long wait - a very long wait it was
Review: It was my second time today coming to this place. My first time was nice, I would say, also during lunch hour. Today however was an extremely bad experience as I had to wait for my food for over an hour. There were only 3 of us and we ordered 3 main dishes and one small one to share, which we had to cancel as it was taking forever. Although I do understand sometimes this area gets crowded during lunch hour, I find it unacceptable to charge for service charge at 10% when the service was so bad and no apologies were also given for the longest wait I've had in a restaurant in a very long time. I have cooked for big crowds before and I know how tough it is to be organised and meticulous when it comes to food quality and presentation - but honestly, waiting for an hour to get 1 dish out (which was, moreover, a laksa with soup, and I assume the soup is already made in a big pot?) is just not my cup of tea. I will not come back - because of the service, and also because the pricing is too far off for me.Other than that, the food is rather nice and tasty, but paying for a Sarawak Laksa at MYR 29 is just not worth waiting for an hour, in my opinion.

Author: drlocbiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hopeless
Review: We have eaten in these restaurants in Bangkok, Melbourne and elsewhere in Malaysia, sadly this was a low point. We asked for a variation to an order namely substituting ginger for garlic in a vegetable dish, which was done with alacrity only two days before at another outlet of the same name. NOT here. The very brusque, quite near to rude table attendant refused even to discuss the point. Orders here are written by you, the diner, checked by a table attendant and the food then delivered. Our surprise was quite extreme when the truffle chicken soup was delivered as ginseng chicken soup. Even more surprising was the argument that followed where we were told that we had ordered the ginseng soup refuted by the written order on the table but then were told that the ginseng soup was in fact the truffle soup. An unpleasant exchange followed when eventually the ginseng soup was removed and replaced with the truffle. This product is excellent but not so good that staff think themselves so far above customers that a lecture and stern put down seems the way to resolve mistakes made by these staff that are so far up themselves they have lost sight of their ‘mission’ - a bad experience all round.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: KualaLumpurTravellerKuala Lumpur
Title: Where is the meat?
Review: Have been there twice now. The food is not easy to share with a group and it is annoying that the rice or bread comes on the side of each dish and not as a side. Tables too small. The food seems to have the same sauces and the big pot just has no meat/fish/veg in it and many dishes taste the same. It is also annoying re corkage... call them say 60RM, argue on the night you get 30, go back you get 35. At 10.30pm the shutters start to come down so leave!!

Author: willwin9391
Title: not recomended
Review: since i come to KL often this restaurant is not recomend from me, the price for food is to high and for me the taste is worst, but they are the largest restaurant in alor, but i prefer to try their neigbour

Author: Theakk
Title: Disappointed
Review: Ordered chicken satay, the meat had a really weird texture; chewy and fatty. Sent it back, and had spring rolls instead. Average and overpriced food!

Author: CCALLO88
Title: Bit expensive but tasty
Review: Yes it was a hit expensive compared to other places but rendang was really tasty. One thing to note, if you're a solo traveller, it's down an unlit path so you might not want to go there at night.

Author: Foodslut2013Sydney, Australia
Title: Terrible food - cheap beer
Review: Disappointed with this place, it looks nice, offers 2 menu's, quite central. My own food was awful. 2 of us ordered sweet and sour chicken and neither of us could finish it. Our friends seem to do better with the more western dishes (burgers). RM4 for a beer saved the day.

Author: MoonByrne
Title: Mediocre food and high prices!
Review: We came here as we were told it was the best Mexican in KL. I find this really hard to believe as the food was really mediocre. We had nachos and veggie tacos. The nachos had the most pathetic amount of salsa on them and...More

Author: jonckher
Title: Great vibes, great food
Review: I have been coming to Melaka off and on over the last 20 years and watched it change into a great tourist destination. This cafe and its super friendly staff shows how service with a smile can make such a difference.

Author: amkh782001Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: An experience that opened our minds
Review: I have been wanting to try Dining in the Dark since last year. Tried to book but was full. Tried again this year for a surprise birthday dinner and it was available. I was stoked. We've never tried this before and were excited. Firstly, the staff are first class. They are trained well we felt so comfortable. We had Marcus, saw his name mentioned by one commenter and I must agree, he's awesome!Then the food..it was delicious. The different taste for each meal really worked. It was an absolute experience.It's not necessarily tasty but it's how your palate is invoked by the taste and the smell. I strongly suggest those who are not adventurous and fussy about food to eat at normal restaurants because this is not just about the food and mingling, it's the whole experience.Before leaving, we spoke to Swami, one of the supervisors and the conversation revolved around looking at the world differently. It truly is, for that brief moment of complete darkness we realise the significance of sight which we may have taken for granted.

Author: 671wanyiy
Title: Nice dim sum
Review: The ming room is a popular place for dim sum. Staff are friendly. A  good place to have business lunch.

Author: RhilyzoroBandung, Indonesia
Title: various type of chilli sauce
Review: Me and my friends came here at lunch hour.. the seat was already full. we wait about 10 minutes, however, they served us so fast. Our food came quickly and we didn't have to wait for so long. The food was good and there's some various type of chili sauce too.. a perfect combination for this.. is Cold Milk Tea.. nyummm.. i would definitely come back again

Author: jeffreyboseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excelent authentic Nonya food in Malacca!
Review: We've tried many classic Nonya restaurants in Malacca and Makko is one of the best. The decor and furniture is traditional Peranakan and the menu features all the classic Nonya dishes we know. We tried the cincalok omelette, nonya chap chye, angle bean sambal, ngoh hiang, udang nanas and ended the meal with traditional cendol. Every dish was delicious and authentic. Portions were quite generous and prices were reasonable. The staff were knowledgeable and helpful. Our food was served within ten minutes from order placement. It was a truly enjoyable experience and we look forward to our next visit when in Malacca.

Author: finesses f
Title: Late lunch
Review: Don't know whether it's the cook's skill problem or the crabs are not fresh... ordered 2 crab dish. Disappointment. Others like prawns and sotong, both ok.Cost us RM342 for a family of 5.One thing to add on.: Taxi from JB Centre should cost RM20 only (by metre).

Author: 189JoeYip
Title: Nice place to visit
Review:
Good ambience, food is good. Worth the price paid. Sashimi is fresh and not skimpy on the cuts.  

Did i mention free jockey parking too..

Author: wildbee001San Francisco
Title: Good food but untidy place
Review: Went there with a group of ten people... everyone refused to eat because the place not that clean...i was the only who ate because of the reviews of trip advisor.. hygiene is of utmost importance in daily life and of course concerning food it is more essential...am not asking a five star hotel service or watesoever but still basic hygiene is the norm...ordered a chicken murtabak which was nice...a gud renovation of the restaurant is a must...

Author: MalTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Greatly Disappointed
Review: I've always liked the quality and variety of food here but tonight has been a great disappointment. I ordered a medium rare Sirloin Steak but it came Medium - IMO it's a waste to eat steak Medium. The server didn't hear me clearly due to the din but didn't repeat to reconfirm the order. The greatest disappointment is the supposedly Häagen-Dazs ice-cream on the Lava Cake. It definitely wasn't Häagen-Dazs at all with its non-smooth texture and ice crystals at the bottom. Or it could be but it was refrozen after melting. Absolutely disappointing!

Author: jenninJB
Title: Bad Experience for my birthday at the BLD Renaissance
Review: First time to BLD in Renaissance, Overall experience was so so. Beef Brisket was dry and no brown sauce at all. that is the only thing at the carving station.The only thing i enjoyed was the Mongolian Lamb.... good meet and tasty sauceThe Indian mutton curry was salty to me so i didnt enjoy it as much.Very limited selection of cheese which were small portion of brie, cheddar and edam and once the brie is finished it wasnt topped up at all. Bad ....Minestrone soup was very watery and will almost no ingredients .... BadBread / rolls ..... only soft buns ..... BadDesserts has a lot of variety but not what i would like.... and NO ICE CREAM which is the norm of any dinner.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: adry2704
Title: AWESOME DINING SERVICE
Review: All I can say is that the food is super good and the service here is top notch The best part is the staffs here are very nice and friendly especially these two particular chef (Chef Hamid and Chef Hafizi). They and the other members act very professionally yet still manage to make the visitors here feel welcome.

Author: 456ampangboy
Title: Food and service good. No smoking and social distancing not observed or controlled.
Review: Food and service good for the price.Nice place and clean unfortunately smokers walking around even when have their own area. Social distancing not really being observered.

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Overrated
Review:
Food was average and service was really poor!
Staff are rude and unfriendly! 

Food prices are overpriced! 
Not worth the visit at all!

Author: Mong2902Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing meal
Review: We always visit Nancy's kitchen whenever we are in Malacca. However this trip to Nancy's proved to be the worst ever. The sek bak that we ordered was cooked so tough I could not even chew it apart. The sambal belachan cost RM3 and it was dry, salty and blah. My MIL could do better. There was no oomph to the chicken curry and the cincalok omelette was not nice.Noticed filipinos cooking in the kitchen.. perhaps tastebuds are different. We used to be able to call to make a reservation but no this trip. Was told to come and queue. We queued for 45 min and there were 16 of us. Surely this is our last visit to Nancy's. What a shame.

Author: 1708shazsueKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful taste of local Sarawak cuisine
Review: My friends and i had dinner at Lepau and i can say that the service and food was very good. The ambience was also comfortable and soothing. The food was delicious and as everyone knows, the Brown Rice @ Bario Rice was very good. The fried Bawal fish was also good. The Bidin vegetable cooked with belacan was really good. Highly recommend this restaurant for those who want to taste the local Sarawak cuisine.

Author: teedot00Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth visiting at least once
Review: Went with a group of work mates for dinner. The view was excellent as you can see all of KL from your seat. I ordered the risotto and while it was good, I don't think it was worth the hefty price tag. What was good though was the wine selection. Would I go again? Possibly not, even if someone else was paying.

Author: Ashleylow89
Title: Very good service and amazing birthday song by the waiter IZHAR.
Review: Celebrated my birthday here, during afternoon tea and I must say the service is very good. Izhar has amazing voice which takes the birthday song to another level thank you so much for the fun memories!

Author: LY3233Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
Title: VERY BAD
Review: Was there with family member ,while on holiday,order wagyu ,was told no wagyu so we order other steak, and told them we want it well done and it came out rare, have to sent it back and waited about 25 minute,before it came back out and was told they dont have potato mash , (what the hell?) steak restaurant with no potato mash , nothing was nice ,the steak was tough,service was bad , so call steak house ? its a shame to the culinary world,

Author: Chlli-NomadBarcelona, Spain
Title: Simply not that good at much, but nice house
Review: Having seen some decent reviews, and looking at the nicely presented building from the outside, I decided to take my wife to Maison Francaise for her birthday. It was a Saturday evening and the restaurant was strangely rather empty - 2-3 tables occupied only. We sat outside on the balcony which was reasonably nice. Service was not easy; certainly considering the prices you'd expect significantly better. The team did not appear cohesive nor very well trained. But the food was the greatest disappointment. 'Fine dining' is not a label you can really apply here. Clearly that's the intention, but honestly it is nowhere near that standard. More of a pretentious attempt. Quality of raw materials is questionable - the steak, despite the price, was below average even for KL (and even for non-fine-dining places). And the asparagus appetiser was rather comically presented as though my 6 year old had tried to plate a dish. If fine-dining is what you want, there are plenty of other really good restaurants in KL with consistently good quality food and service. This place is best avoided unless you want to pay an arm and a leg for disappointing food and average (at best) service.

Author: John M
Title: Ok lah
Review: Although it is a well publicised bar-restaurant, didn't find it had any special features above similar outlets. May be was an off night.

Author: Julina K
Title: Good indian food
Review: A nice clean indian restaurant with a live band at night! The food is great and reasonably priced. You'll be spoiled for choice looking at the extensive menu.Definitely warrants a breakfast visit.Service : excellent!

Author: Kathyamber
Title: Worst
Review:
Not recommended
Food not delicious and expensive, satay is not juicy & tender. Signature dish is fried bean curd but worst. When payment please check your bills.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Average food - not worth the hype or the queue
Review: After months and months of always seeing a looooooong crowd queueing outside Sushi Zanmai, waiting to get in, I finally decided to see what the fuss was about.I waited in queue for 20mins with a friend (we were lucky! The queue we left was twice as long from when we joined it!) and we managed to get a seat along the sushi bar. We ordered some sake sashimi, hotate mentaiyaki, a curry udon and a beef sukiyaki. Then we sampled some of the items off the kaiten belt.All in all, it was pretty run of the mill. Definitely better than Sushi King, and slightly more expensive than Sakae Sushi.. but seeing as how the quality and flavour of the food wasn't noticeably better than Sakae, I can't say it was worth paying that little extra. The sake sushi was rather awesomely marbled, for what is essentially a fast food joint. Everything else was rather standard fare. The curry came from a box, and so did the udon broth - very likely the same boxes every other kaiten restaurant in KL uses. All in all, decent, belly-filling food. But it certainly wasn't worth the hype or standing in queue for 20mins. I still walked away paying RM60 for my dinner (incl. tax) and for that price, if I were to add just RM10 more, I could enjoy a delicious dinner at Yuzu, a PROPER sit-down Japanese restaurant, where I won't have to wait 20mins (or more!) just to get a table.

Author: SyameerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A hidden gem of JB!
Review: Located deep in a small neighbourhood amidst towering condos, this lovely restaurant-cum-bar is a great meetup place for a chat over a reasonably good meal. The food is about average and the pricing is quite premium. The service is excellent with the owner is very helpful at helping to choose the right meal. Not to mention, there are often freebies, e.g. experimental desserts etc which the owner will ask you to try-out for feedbacks! Overall, this eatery is worth a visit :)

Author: rarcharlieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Really not worth the price
Review: Came here with my mom, she got the saba shioyaki (mackerel grilled with salt) set and I got the sashimi one. Ordered octopus with cucumber in rice vinegar, beef tataki (not wagyu) and a seafood salad on the side. Almost all of it was mediocre except for my mom's mackerel. Octopus dish was almost tasteless, beef tataki was so tough it felt like I was chewing pure fiber. Not worth the hefty price tag. Good service though.

Author: Clb1403
Title: old favourite breakfast cafe
Review: One of the older places in Ipoh, it's been around since the 1960s and still going strong. Pork is not served by any of the food stalls and despite this the char kway teow is one of the best in ipoh.

Author: bblim123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Anniversary Dinner
Review: Celebrated our wedding anniversary here. Nice food & very good service from Jayson. Surprise drinks with 2 lil love pigs thank you El Cerdo

Author: birgitreist
Title: Excellent dinner
Review:
Kebaya was one of the best dining experiences we have in a long time! The food was excellent and really special! 72 hours slow cooked beef - SO good! 
Not to mention: fantastic value for money!

Author: SoonEnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fusion of Mexican and Chinese Dim sum
Review: The dining atmosphere was good, nice ambiance and great service, but when comes to the food, the Honey barbecued chicken bun was just okay, cold rice noodle roll (chee cheong fun), tasteless beef tacos, burnt beef bacon in the Caesar Salad and bad Caesar dressing which taste more like mayonnaise instead of a Caesar dressing.

Author: Kuan Y
Title: Shanghai restaurant.
Review: Made a reservation thru tableapps. Called to confirm seats one day before and staff confirm ok. When i went there on next day for lunch. I told the counter staff i have a reservation at 1pm. He told me its full now. And i ask him back i have a reservation and u r telling me its full now? Only he went to arrange my table. I was carrying a baby and it took him so long to come back n let me in to my table. Some dimsum that we ordered took more than 30 mins to be serve. Quite disappointed with the service. Despite its in a 5 star hotel. Nvr encounter this with any other restaurants in hotels.

Author: streetwisegangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: V friendly waitresses, fast front station cooks but pricey
Review: Went there to eat breakfast, and lunch. The tumeric rice w beef rendang (a bit salty) was ok, can choose few choices to add on like sardine, cuttlefish, boiled or fried plain or w sambal eggs, kuih like currypuffs, etc, beehoon (so so), fried rice (not tasty- it was dry), fried kuey teow (ok), murtabak & roti.The food was so so, lunch price is a bit high. Plain rice w mutton, fried catfish and fried cabbage was RM 16.To cope w huge orders daily esp lunch hour, the workers are super fast, esp the woman frying beehoon or fried rice at the front station.

Author: nesadiana82Melaka, Malaysia
Title: IM VERY FUSSY ABOUT FOOD TASTE
Review: Here the food such as mix rice , poori , tosai...and etc very nice but goreng 2 normal...however im fussy bout food im satisfied with their food..so if u come down to melaka pls visit this shop..im in melaka if i hungry i ll go there and eat mostly

Author: NudibrancherFort Collins, Colorado
Title: Very mediocre food! :(
Review: The restaurant looked pleasant and welcoming and the staff did a reasonable job with service. I ordered the beef pho and fried springrolls. The restaurant advocates no wastage but I couldn't possibly finish the pho - the noodles were rough and chewy, the soup was luke warm and tasteless, devoid of any beef flavour. The slices of beef in the pho were way overcooked and chewy! The only saving grace was the springrolls which were quite meaty and tasty... however, the sauce that came with it was rather bland and did nothing to enhance its flavour. Didn't bother with the sauce at all after initial bite.Not coming back.

Author: Hsien_TehSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not good
Review: I don’t know if they were having an “off” day but the food was a disaster when my friends and I dined there. The fish in the otah was mushy and tasted far from fresh. The beef rendang was tough and sinewy. The sambal of the sambal kang kong tasted chalky and the hee peow soup had a strong fishy taste. I am sorry to say but as a person of Peranakan heritage, I was totally disappointed.

Author: Tony GLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lonely Lunchtime
Review: We had the six course express gourmet meal which was outstanding and about the optimum size portions.The view from the 23rd floor was or course wonderful.However the ambience was indifferent my partner and another couple being the only folk in the restaurant.A downer however was that the restaurant do not have the wine that we requested, something we found in a number of restaurants in Malaysia

Author: Daniel Y
Title: Romantic dinner
Review: although the place is hard to find but the food there is Excellent, combination with red wine recommended. just nice!! will be back again ...

Author: jakeflo
Title: Nice surrounding
Review: Just go to Bulldog in the evening with the kids when the band is playing. Joy and her bad are fantastic . They sing all the oldies. The drummer is awesome especially with the music of Santana "Black Magic Woman". Drinks are reasonable and the kids will love their hot chocolate. The place is "NO SMOKING" which are good for non smokers and the kids.

Author: SJWJRLeicestershire UK
Title: Good food
Review: We ate here just once during our short trip and we were not disappointed. We ordered three dishes, two beers, one cider and a sprite and the it came to 103RM. The salt and pepper squid was so good. The owners are very helpful and took the time to explain the dishes on the menu.

Author: BDTNaiduShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Food & Service was Disappointing!
Review: Firstly the food quality was very poor. For the price that i have paid i think the food quality is very disappointing. Secondly for the service, i waited almost 30 minutes for the coffee and waited additional 15 minutes for hot water. I had to ask to 3 people regards to my coffee and hot water and their answer was "Please wait". Met the restaurant manager and he kept apologizing for it. It looks like they are more eager to service big groups compare to smaller scale. A bad choice to go!

Author: salad1982
Title: Not that impressive
Review: We were told there were 4 different kitchens to choose from, including Korean, but there were no Korean options on the menu. The food we had wasn't that great.

Author: Andy-Karen85Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Unbelievable pricing! Double Standard!
Review: Went here last week and was shocked with the bill!6 dishes and the amount come around RM17+It will be acceptable if the serving is large but is not!The serving volume is unacceptable (the dishes is more like for 2 people) and we got 6 peoples for this ridiculous pricingWorst, the bill didn't listed the price for each dish and only when i demanded it they wrote down the cost and they took around 15 minutes to wrote it!For your info, actually this is 3rd time i had my dinner here and the pricing was very reasonable!My girlfriend in fact had a dinner there 2 weeks ago and ordered 4 dishes and the pricing was around RM8+ with a large servingHonestly, the food there is quite nice but still i don't understand why they got double standard for the pricingWon't be 4th time coming and won't recommend this restaurant

Author: joanadventure
Title: Pamper yourself @ Temtations
Review: Even though the buffet style, there are cooks around to cook the selection of what we like. Get yourself a hot plate of food with Personalised Service too. Enjoy with a glass of wine will be great.

Author: xiaoxuanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Arrogant boss
Review: I am giving 1* without even tasting the food. We tried numerous times to make reservations but no one answer the phone. After a long walk and found the place. We were told place was fully booked. They told us they were short of staff to answer calls ( Then why bother to put up a phone) we saw 1 or 2 tables were finishing and are willing to wait but was told not to wait around as they "do not like to rush their guest". Arrogantly we were told if we needed to eat Nonya food, we can try another restaurant next door. There are so many NonYa restaurant in Melaka. We can give this place a miss and won't be back.

Author: L54Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It will make you disappointed
Review: I was there once with my friend as a meet up and once when my daughter wants to have brunch, both time we got disappointed first because of the quality of food which is under average and second because they just served breakfast on Saturday and Sunday.....it's hilarious... You will not find anything good there just go a little forward and try Harrods in Klcc.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: skchuehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: terrible attitude from the male captain
Review: We came in and want to order food, but no menu was given. Have to call the waitress, then only menu is provided. But we got six person of us, the menu only given one then again have to call again. Can't order thru waitress, have to wait for captain. When the captain pass by we call right in front of his face. He just ignore and walk away. Then we have to call again waitress. Then the waitress again have to inform the captain. Finally he came with dead father face. It already took more than 30mins just to call a captain to come for food ordering. Imagine that how are we going to eat as we only have 1 hour lunch break and we still have to wait for them to cook and serve. Some more with his dead father's face, the happiness of our gathering already gone!!! We want to tell the captain "If you are not happy with your job, then don't do. For the management of Marco Polo "Please always ensure your staff is professional enough to serve customer as it is your responsibility in this food and servicing industry!!!"

Author: EpoC9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dim sum under expectation
Review: Was there to celebrate my hubby's birthday with high expectation. Service was prompt and allowed to accommodate just 4 of us in a sizeable VIP room. All the dim sum tasted very average falling off the expectation of a prestigious restaurant as claimed online. Even the chef's specialty was nothing to shout about. Would highly recommend Li Yen Restaurant at Ritz Carlton KL for its constant high quality of dim sum. Never get disappointed so far...

Author: InirapRome, Italy
Title: Perfect experience
Review: I went to Tamarind twice and it never let me down.The environment is absolutely flawless, really cozy and sophisticated at the same time, you absolutely forget you are in downtown KL. Food is delicious, great selection of wines and quite friendly staff. This is, without any doubt, one of the places to go in KL after you had the chance to try malaysian food

Author: fawlyfauz
Title: Awesome Service!
Review: Loved loved loved the service they give here! Food was alright and a bit pricey, but the service really made up for it!

Author: Adam B
Title: Fantastic meal, great service
Review: This place was amazing. It had the ambience and feel of an upscale restaurant with white table cloths and fancy music. All the food was outstanding, but I can't stop raving about the Opor Rusuk, which was one of the best meals I've ever had. The service was great too.

Author: DoadodoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simply Overrated
Review: We dined at fatCUPID because it was high on the TA list. However we left the place really disappointed because the food were pricey and the menu was limited. Food was mediocre, with similar restaurants serving the same thing for a much lower price.On the upside, I think the place is nice and quiet, but a little too quiet. Service was top notch of course, but I can't help but wonder if its because we were the only table on a Saturday night! All in all I think there is plenty of room for improvement. I'm sorry to say but I think many will be left disappointed after reading all the reviews in TA and expect it to be a top notch restaurant- it simply isn't. I think if I were to stumble upon this place, without any prior knowledge about the ratings/reviews of this place, perhaps then I will be impressed.

Author: VFoodie-KL
Title: TERRIBLY TERRIBLE FOOD. STAY AWAY!!
Review: I usually don’t do reviews but this one screams for it.The ambiance is poor and the menu is quite confusing .. while the management may have tried to give it a fusionesque twist it definitely doesn’t cut it for fine dining with limited options, poor menu planning and horrible quality of food.So we went in one evening for dinner & ordered: 1. Methi Chicken - It was supposed to look like chicken malai tikka on sticks however, it was actually frozen chicken chunks with some flavouring microwaved to be defrosted and was undercooked in most places - disaster in any form of culinary experience. Negative points here.2. Mums Dal - It was bearable but not fresh one again. Seems like the restaurant specialises in freezing food and then just heating & serving it. No points here.3. Paratha - They literally served Kavan frozen parathas .. can you believe it? In a fine dining Indian restaurant they don’t have any bread making skills? Double negative points.4. Pineapple Fried Rice - We asked for a vegetarian version (no egg) and they twice served us with the same Fried Rice with egg in it. How difficult is it to decipher “NO EFFING EGG” ... There are not enough negative points to give here. The staff was all over the place trying to eat dinner and attend to us (it was only 10pm and they are supposed to be serving till 11pm) so couldn’t the staff have planned their own dinner better? It seems like the management has no clue of how to run a restaurant or train their staff. Terribly terrible food and not worth a trip at all. Stay away!

Author: JambianiNeilAfrica
Title: Overall... Pretty impressive
Review: Went with a group of 9 friends. WIP was by far the visst upmarket and busiest restaurant in the BSc and the vibe was good. DJ was doing the business at a decent volume, decor and ambiance was very upmarket and the pace was buzzing whilst every other establishment around it was dead by comparison. Started off with happy hour cocktails which were actually very good and somewhat potent and, thankfully, using quality top shelf alcohol. Food delivered dish by dish over a period of 25 minutes, which is quite common in SE Asia, but can be annoying for polite European diners waiting 25 min for everyone to get their food before they can get stuck into their now room temperature steak. Prices are low by global standards but high for KL at almost RM30 a beer and roughly RM30 a main meal, but my dish, the vegetarian tiffin was one of the best meals I had in 2018 period. It was perfect and well worth the money. The only items that weren't up to par or expectation were the pizza (but that's a common problem in KL) and the morrocan meatballs which were not substantial enough to qualify as a main. Overall though I personally will make it a regular pit stop when I'm In KL, because it's classy and cool and that vegetarian tiffin... was just to die for. Well done WIP, I'll see you again.

Author: JustinlyhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointed
Review: We went to restaurant for dinner, we tried the bangsar outlet before and it was ok. However, the mid valley outlet was a dissapointment, there was no air con, the weather was hot, seats were limited, busy crowd walking pass by, the menu was painted on a wall whereby you need to walk over in order to be able to read it. The food was ok however, this outlet situated at this location was not our choice.

Author: Kevin CPenang, Malaysia
Title: Lobster Roll finally...
Review: I was craving for lobster rolls and finally was introduced to this place. It is a small cafe with little seating. So you might want to book the place if you are coming with a big crowd.Two orders. Lobster sandwich and soft shell crab burger.Lobster sandwich was great for me and it came with fries and salad. I felt the salad was a little overdressed but it taste quite nice. The sandwich had a nice bread and the cashew nuts added the crunchy flavor.Soft shell crab burger. Asian burger. And came with fries and salad too. It had the crab flavor even though it is fried. The burger had an egg and cheese. Cheese I understand but egg was a little out of place, it made the burger tasted weird.

Author: donbero
Title: Neither a HALAL nor NO PORK Restaurant
Review: Surprisingly there were menus with pork! OMG this is very misleading! Hoping this issue to be cleared out. Thanks
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Suria KLCC (NO PORK)

Author: Compass538381Richmond, Canada
Title: Authentic peranakan experience
Review: My sisters and I had a wonderful dining experience at Nonya63. Everything was authentic, the food, the ambience , the service were excellent. Prices were reasonable. Especially recommend the assam fish , chap chai and otak., among others. Definitely "a must-go " for anyone who wants to enjoy quality food and have a nonya experience. Recommend to all.

Author: cressa_10
Title: Looks good but food expensive and not much of it.
Review: This is a lovely venue at KLCC looking out over the fountains. Food is beautifully served but I felt it was expensive and not very filling. A once only experience.

Author: nigel g
Title: Another fantastic evening with great food, drink and above all the atmosphere
Review:
One of the best venues in town for excellent food, drink and atmosphere with its own in house owner and renowned chef David.
A must to visit when you are in town.

Author: lingy314
Title: terrible service
Review: slow, rude. does not know how to use the UOB promotion accept the supervisor, but the supervisor did not teach others.

Author: Elaine C
Title: Disappointing
Review: 2 person seated but only served 1 menu!When i asked what type of tea they have, the waitress told me only pu er, jasmine and chysanthemum. So i asked for the menu since she only handed one menu to my friend. Then she passed me the drink list instead!. In the drink list, there were so many types of tea!!! When i asked, she said all tea sold out.Then we ordered asparagus, she said sold out. Only left kailan and brocolli! I was like, what??? Ordered stir fried beef tenderloin and lamb cumin. Both are too salty. The only dish nice is braise charcoal beancurd.Poor service. They dont even refill hot water for our tea. I had to keep calling the waitress. Only 3 person working here and only 2 tables with customers.Rating 1 out of 5

Author: Mel22MelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service but unfortunate incident
Review: Went with a group of friends to celebrate a friend's birthday at Chilli's Midvalley. As the birthday girl's drink arrived, she noticed a lipstick stain on her glass. Luckily she did not take a sip yet. We were appalled that a big chain of restaurants can make such a mistake. Makes me wonder, if there was no lipstick stain, how would we have knows the glass was not properly washed. Also makes me wonder how many times such a thing has gone unnoticed if the glass was previously used by a male (no lipstick). This is very unhygienic & we felt disgusted.However the manager handled it very well. He apologized on behalf of his staff who may have not done the washing of the glass properly. My friend had lost her mood to eat. But he promised her a chocolate molten cake as it was her birthday after all. She refused at first but thanks to the manager's good approach, she was able to let go of the incident & accept his apology. We understand that mistakes do happen, but when it comes to the F&B industry, a small mistake like this can cause uneasiness for the customer.Nevertheless, I truly hope such a thing will not happen to anyone. It is a sure way to spoil your night especially on your birthday. Thank you though to the manager who took care of the incident in a professional manner.

Author: NewbieInAMSAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Deplorable service ever!
Review: I had been told that this is one of the highly recommended restaurants in Mid Valley Megamall, and perhaps even in KL. Guess what I got to have there after waiting for 35 minutes? A teh tarik! I placed my order with a manager, a rather simple order actually - Teh Tarik, Stir fried kangkong, Kung pao chicken and rice, at about 8:40 PM and my teh tarik arrived in 5 minutes. From then on, everyone around me got their food, and in fact 2 families had even finished their dinner and left. I kept asking every waiter who passed by when my food would be served, and I was reassured that it's being prepared. After 30 minutes, at 9:10 PM I called another manager and asked him about my order. He said that I would have to wait for another 10 minutes as the order was lost somewhere in the chain and never reached the chef. I asked him to cut the check for the tea and with no apologies or insistence to stay, he just turned around and walked towards the billing counter to bring my bill. I was given my bill for a Teh tarik, which I paid and left. Thank you Madam Kwan for the gourmet Teh Tarik which I could have had at the food court for less than 1/3rd the cost. Ridiculous.

Author: ChewJ79
Title: It’s was so amazing
Review: I’m a Italian cuisine lover Prego always is my favourite restaurant but recently have some changed especially ceases salat taste weird before that its was my favourite dish. Even though the food is not same like before but the service is so amazing and surprise me Mr Edween and Mr Leon is so helpful and professional. They fully us how a hotelier be like.

Author: Leonathan2013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food But Service Really Sucks
Review: It was Fathers Day on 21st June 2015 and my extended family of 12 comprising of mum, brothers and inlaws decided to meet for lunch at Hakka Restaurant at 12 noon.This restaurant was selected due to its good food & ample parking spaces.My brother ordered from the menu in advance knowing well that the restaurant will be fully booked especially the air cond area .We were chit chatting among ourselves and were in a happy & joyful mood and here comes a sour faced waitress who literally threw a few sets of menu on our table like a croupier dealing a deck of cards..As i was sitting next to where she was standing I lost my temper and shouted rather loudly " If you have any personal problems , leave it behind.Don't take it out on your paying customers." I again repeated this in Bahasa Malaysia in case she did not understand English. I then got up and called for the lady captain & informed her what happened.and told her that I will write some negative comments of my experience there in Tripadvisor.She gave a blurred look and made no attempt to apologise.I noticed that we were not the only one in this predictment but there were other unhappy customers because of the " LACK OF SERVICE STAFF " We decided to order some chilled Carlsberg beers to accompany our 6 course meal which cost a total of RM 700Although the food was good ,we decided not to come again to witness that the standard of Customer Service really sucks .

Author: easyval
Title: Bad sashimi...
Review: Pictures looked great! But we paid a premium price for presentable looking yet awful tasting sashimi.... even the oysters werent up to standard, unfortunately.

Author: Lim20192020
Title: Poor service
Review: The lovely ambience of this restaurant was regrettably tarnished by the chef, a rather overbearing character who seemed to think it was necessary to dictate the food choices of his patrons. We were unable to glance through the menu in peace as he kept hovering over us, insisting that we read the menu from front to back, in a certain way. When one of our party tried to order his choice of dishes, he rudely interrupted and asked to speak only to the head of the party, “so I won’t be confused and have to deal with everyone.” When another tried to order again, he began speaking in Mandarin to us- despite the fact that we could only understand English, and had informed him so from the start. All in all, we felt is was rather strange way of treating customers - one would have expected, at the very least, a level of basic courtesy from someone of his rank and position in the establishment, if nothing else. Despite the tasty food, we came away disappointed with the service, and will not be returning soon.

Author: Troy BPerth, Australia
Title: Amazing food. Ambiance not quite there
Review: Went here for our final evening meal in Penang as it was highly recommended.We arrived and was seated smack bang in the middle of a samsung group that were from a convention. Very very noisy and we asked to be moved.However an hour later they were finished and gone.That when the restaurant really lived up to the hype. The food was absolutely faultless. Very fusion type cuisine with a twist. The otak otak was one of the best starters i have ever tasted. The onde onde rice balls amazing finish to the night.Well Done.

Author: BigtoadYork, United Kingdom
Title: Food looks great but no ambience
Review: Visited with two children. Choice a bit limited but had set menu. Food very well presented and generally tasted okay. The place was soulless. We were the last in and the were closing blinds and mopping the floor. Both children ended up with severe food poisoning. It had to be from here as they had the same and we didn't touch it. Everything else we shared. It could be much better. Drinks not inspiring. Food presentation lovely otherwise a 1 star

Author: RabbitcuteJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Poor Service, MUGI !
Review: This is my first time visit and the service was terrible. Table was full, so we were agreed to enjoy the bar while waiting the reservation, we ordered some drinks and finally we got our table. We ordered some food and dessert also another drinks to a waiter called "MUGI". To be honest, their service are bad, everything took long time, min 20 min for a beer. FTI, the live band play at 11.00 pm.While we enjoying our time there, 20 min before 11pm, Mugi came and asked us to move coz the table is reserved. The person which booked the table will open 2 bottles. That time we're still ordering some drinks... we told him that nobody tells us this table is reserved and our bill is more than 2 bottles cost. Our neighbours only have 1 beer in their table, some only dessert, why dont he ask them to move while we spent more than RM 300. He was quiet atm, didnt disturb us anymore till before 12 he came again and told me that the person is there already. I was so upset and cannot even enjoy my last beer and the music. In deepest heart, i could tolerate coz he just do his job but he should know also that be professional is a must. I will never ever back there again. Food, music and live band just average. Nothing special except the service. Was really good experienced for us recall we always had nice time in other Hard Rock Cafe.

Author: bob-i-jas
Title: Greetings Maharaja
Review: The food is exactly as I like Indian fair. The staff is attentive and reasonably swift for such a place. I like to go there once in a while. SInce it is situated at the rim of the city centre getting there and back is not too bad considdering the traffic.

Author: MaithengKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointing
Review: When we arrived at the cafe, it looked small from the outside. There were still empty tables but people were smoking so we went in. The cafe is all in length so as we walked in, it looked bigger and bigger! Quite surprising. There was a band so we thought: how nice...unfortunately the nicest area was a smoking area and we had to be closer to the entrance and far from the action to enjoy a smoking free area. There was a huge board at the entrance with the special food written on but non visible from anywhere in the restaurant unless you walked to the entrance to view it. None of the described food appear on any menu so we did not know and did not order what we would have otherwise. I ordered a moussaka and my husband Pad Thai. My moussaka was made of potatoes and eggplant covered with a thick layer of cheese and a nice creamy sauce BUT it was served with French fries and a salad. Why serve a dish that already contains potatoes with additional potatoes??? Moreover you could taste they were made from frozen potatoes and were dry and overcooked. The salad was made of mainly greens with very little dressing on it. When we tried to get the attention of the waiter he seemed uninterested and just wanted to walk away! The Pad Thai came black!!!
