Taste was so-so...Since we don't eat meat we asked the waiter to remove the chicken and he suggested to replace the chicken with either salmon or prawns and we agreed. It came with nothing. He had to ask for extra bean sprouts or else the dish was almost with nothing in it for RM29!!! All in all a very disappointing evening. Couldn't really hear the band, smell of cigarettes smoke permeated the entire place, special food not visible from anywhere. We each had a beer - Guinness for my husband and Hoogarden for me. The bill came to RM125. Not worth it. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Pity 'cos we live nearby!

Author: lavanian2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: The banana leaf was pre- served in a plate, they did not ask what we want and how much we want. So stingy wit the portion. The number of ppl serving was one two many and they hv no proper communication. Food : bland and tasteless, even the sambal was flat. Service: they all look annoyed everytime we ask for drink, sambal or even top of for curryVariety: only two curry options which was so boringMy last visit for sure

Author: hizeldaSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Basic
Review: My sister brought me here to celebrate my birthday with my mother and my brother in law. My sister really love the place and so I agreed to check it out. It's difficult to find halal dim sum around KL, as we all know it's in the category of Chinese food. Dolly Dim Sum is very well known amongst muslims in Malaysia. The quality of the food is good but not great as I've tried better dim sum elsewhere. However, the plating is exquisite. The service was poor as the staff did not really entertain us. I'm not asking for much but a smile when you greet a customer was enough for me but it didn't happen. I also want to bring up that one of their staff pushed my hand on the table when he was serving us. I would understand if there were many customers that they're too busy to noticed but the place was so empty that there were at least 5 other empty tables surrounding us. He could've said something because it was so rude. Most of the staff that was working there are not friendly, I did not encounter one that had a smile on their face. I believe that people who often go to this place is either for the ambiance or for their Instagram feed. The place looks amazing tho, but don't expect good service. I really hope they train their staff to be more professional when dealing with customers, as I think it's one of the most important factors that contributes to the restaurant's reputation.

Author: Adrian-StoS
Title: should do better
Review: good food, guest reception very average, overcrowded

Author: devonc918Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and small portion
Review: The ambiance and creativity of the restaurant is awesome but the only setback is that the price of the food is way too expensive for its portion. Food took some time to reach us and they forgot our food. Not our best experience especially during my brothers birthday. Could do better.

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: Not quite there
Review: This rooftop bar is described in the hotel blurb as having breathtaking views.Now, the Taj Mahal, sure, The Great Pyramid of Giza, no problem with that, The statue of David, you bet, all those things are breathtaking, however a view across an empty lot and a few old buildings to the muddy churn of the Sarawak river, no, sorry, that's not breathtaking.The bar staff are fine and seem keen, although how they would cope with more than 4 drinkers is anyone's guess, it takes a looog time to get a beer and a cocktail delivered the night we are (the only) guests.Still, if you are staying in the hotel and it's raining, this would be the place to watch the rain.

Author: 828muhammadrizalfJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good place for dinner
Review: The palace is located on melaka river bank,Try to have dinner dinner there, the atmosphere and scenery is great with the melaka river full of light at nightime.The food itselft is tasty, there are two set western and local (malaysia). The chicken chop set is great taste, and my wife also enjoy the asam laksa set.Price is a little bit expensive 72 RM for 2 adult and 1 babies. ( most expensive spending for food during in melaka) but it is worth it with great atmosphere and scenery you can enjoy during dinning.

Author: ngyk22Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sunday Lunch
Review: This was our 1st visit for lunch in this restaurant on Sunday. We arrived at about noon and there were a number of empty tables, but the lunch crowd started to arrive at about 12.30 pm onwards.We ordered their famous Xiao Long Bao (original) which was tasty. We noted that the latest flavor was Mao Sang Wang (durian) but we skipped it as we are not a fan of this king of fruit. The Szechuan hot and sour soup was a bit disappointing as it was too sourish. The La Mian with black fungus and shredded meat was delicious but could have been better with a bit more meat. The spring roll was tasty but the pan-fired pork dumpling was just ok.The restaurant ambience is cosy and the atmosphere was not noisy.

Author: nickpash
Title: Poor !!
Review:
If the management have any pride they should read their reviews.
The service was poor and slow( one and a half hours to get a club sandwich and a beer).
The food was just about edible.
If only we had read Tripadvisor first.

Author: Justine R
Title: Disappointment
Review: Been to Healy Macs Puublika for a meeting end in non sense talk. Train your manager to respect other people privacy. We don't go out to entertain her. As I remember the manager name is Caroline.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Yoonyin95
Title: Lovely dinnner
Review: The portion is huge, the lamb and rib eye is good. Thanks for Adli, Azli, Fajar, chef brett and Chef nathan.

Author: yumfixKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid, avoid, avoid!
Review: The other guys that gave this restaurant a terrible rating were not kidding. Nero Nero really is terrible. It's so bad I am impressed as to how it was ever opened and amazed it continues to exist. What were they thinking!? The food is bad, well other than a pretty decent pizza, everything else - including the coffee - is terrible, they didn't do any justice to their beautiful coffee machine. The pasta was soggy and food was not properly seasoned. The seafood items we were served were not fresh. For the prices that this restaurant charges, it is not acceptable. I really have no idea how anyone can say that the food is good, maybe they only had pizzas and salad? No fault of the service crew though because they were good and the dining ambiance is also very pleasant but for a rather awkward water fountain in the middle of the room waiting for a tipsy patron to fall into.Do yourself a favour and avoid this place. There are much better choices for Italian food, e.g. Neroteca at Plaza Damansara. Incidentally, Nero Nero should not be confused as a restaurant of the Nerovivo, Neroteca group although we have been made to understand there may be a couple of common shareholders.Avoid, avoid, avoid! ...There, now you can't say you weren't warned.

Author: Colin ABrisbane, Queensland, Australia
Title: Expensive for what it is
Review: This is a cafe with table service selling drinks and average food at above average prices. Same set up as the Perth WA based chain. You could walk out of here with a MR 50 bill just for a couple of slightly altered iced coffees. As with many places in Malaysia you get hit with an additional service charge and then GST so the price you see on the menu ends up further loaded. We made the incorrect assumption that a chain cafe charging as much as they did for very ordinary food and drinks would have included these charges. We won’t be back.

Author: JanineKGWinchester, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food, fabulous atmosphere, friendly service
Review: What a lovely find (thanks to Trip Advisor) for dinner on our first night in KL with the kids. We opted for an inside table (to escape the heat) and the A/C was brilliant despite not being an enclosed space. We were given the first table which made it feel like we were on the terrace anyway. This allowed us to enjoy the atmosphere of the busy city centre location and enjoy the live local music, played on the terrace. The service was friendly & helpful. The menus in English. The food itself was to die for. Many of the dishes sounded familiar, especially the dim sum but the flavours were just fantastic. The drink selection was also great. It was a total novelty for us to drink our beer from a ceramic bowel, poured from a ceramic bottle but we really enjoyed it. Our kids enjoyed freshly pressed fruit juices. It was a meal thoroughly enjoyed by us all (our kids range from 7 to 17). I would be very confident recommending it to other visitors with western size wallets.

Author: abeadera
Title: Good taste great
Review: Near danga bay this is indian international chain, a place that served indian food in modern way and just a stone throw from tune danga bay

Author: SURIE_S
Title: Good place take food by with birds
Review: This place is in front of bird park. Food is costly but you can take it with the birds. Really enjoyed the atmosphere with a nice view and plenty of birds. There is a toilet also here in the restaurant.

Author: Chengcg
Title: Overrated
Review: Crowded no doubt but chicken was so-so . Much better chicken and rice found in Melaka. Expensive too. Bean sprouts tasted ok. Hor Fun in Thean Chun was better.

Author: Candysaccharine
Title: Very value food
Review: Try out the chicken rice there, reasonable price and tasty... Only available morning session, various choices of food stall with very value price too.

Author: streetwisegangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bento boxes need changing as paint is wearing off from inside the boxes!
Review: We always go there for dinner as the place is quite comfortable and the staff are very helpful, friendly and attentive.I love the teriyaki beef w garlic, but once got tough slices where the tendons were. Disappointed with the sushi on the moving belt as not many choices and no colour to the dishes, mostly brown and dull. Once got some salmon head with no meat on them.the pickled ginger is tasty and free flow of fragrant green tea is great. Ice-cream is tasty too. Once got chilled noodles, also quite disappointed as wanted to eat hot, warm food that day.The bento boxes need immediate changing to new ones, Help! the paint is wearing off from inside the boxes! Black patches are visible when the red paint wears out!Pls do something.

Author: RockstonesAsia
Title: Better choice out there
Review: There are better choices of western food in Malacca that you may consider. I will not consider going back there again

Author: Eraz7
Title: Bad Chicken Rice
Review:
Nothing like S'pore's version.

Don't try the roasted chicken - the steamed is much better.

The rice is pathetic and chilli only made the rice better.

Author: Markk9999
Title: Worse ever dinner!
Review: Wait 1 hour for our meal. Had to get our own chopsticks and plate even. Blame us for the long wait when actually they are the ones who that a mistake on our orders. Very poor service.

Author: Ngan H
Title: Not tasty
Review: The food at this corner mamak shop is lacking of fine taste. The drinks also in need of more ingredients to be delicious. The ambience is like a poor man's house, rather sparse and desolate. Other shop next time!

Author: BryanN218
Title: entertainment
Review: The hive surroundings are good and the furniture relaxing the only downfall are the artists, they were very unprofessional

Author: Shikisan
Title: Good burgers enjoy the torn and old days
Review: Seats and tables are too close as there is less space. Burgers are like Burger King but they taste better. It seems like you are at the hiding place of torn and racks, is fine for chatting for young people..to hang out...

Author: Nency n
Title: HORRIBLE PRICING
Review: Their prices change every now and then. Too costly. Too many complaints on their price which is very expensive

Author: Matthew LShanghai, China
Title: Should have ordered rare
Review: Service was good and all the meals came together, order a steak Medium-rare unfortunately it was more medium-well, which isn't unusual in KL so my mistake. Unfortunate the restaurant view is not tower side.

Author: nouruldKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unreliable services
Review: Very bad welcome very cold peopleThe staff really sucksI will never go there again neither recommand this place We went one night earlier to do the rsvp for the next day. They say okay and took our number. The next day when we were there, they said no rsvp and we were late. We were There actually at 6:30pm as we do the rsvp for 6:45 to 7pm to be there for our day dinner. The worst we have guests from France and actually we are not first time there! We don’t recommend at all to come here as they don’t have reliable services. Especially when you have guests form far. Such an embarrassment

Author: HuatSiangSri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: Bad service, no repeat order.
Review: Maybe we have a unlucky day on that day. Let me tell my story. We having family dinner at here, 1st, we sit down that place is not really many customer, but 3-4 table are not clean. We waited for 5 min for the waitress to clean up the table. After that we make a order, but we not confirmed the order that we want. So we ask the waiter to came later. But SHE ALREADY take our 1st order without confirmation. later while, the order is all duplicated, 2 meal we not order came! OMG, what a terrible experience. This is first mistake make by waitress, then when we have the food, the 4 meal that we order is two meal it came all! We feeling like "what the f..." why the waitress did not repeat the whole set order? Lastly we finish our meal and payment part. AGAIN! wrong billing, the 2 set that we order it counted in! luck we check the bill before we paid, and! 1st time we told the waitress, 2nd time when the bill come, STILL WRONG! I very sorry to rate this restaurant with 2 star!

Author: LilyNana89
Title: Pricey but Worth To Try!~
Review:
- all the food served here is good just the price is pricey pricey
- good environment for gathering with friends
- TIPS - you may order one tom yum goong (serve size; small) but can share for 2 or 3 peoples..

Author: CJW2JTShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Total disappointment! !!
Review: I will never step into that restaurant again, ever! I don't know what happened to those superb Japanese hospitality, the people there don't seem to bother and care. We have a complain of not one but TWO cockroaches running around on our dining table, that's a no no for any si called fine dining restaurant! ! All the manager could say was "we will give complimentary dessert "come on. ..do we look cheap? ?? We don't need your dessert, we can afford to pay if we can afford any Japanese food. It is an insult! The least she could and should have done is to replace our food on the table, but no. How can you have cockroaches running on the table, can you imagine how many more underneath the table? ?? Then we have the recommended boiled soup which cost us quite a fair bit, and the fish was un scaled, when we told to the manager, she said she will inform the chef and for the last 30 minutes she was no where to be found! Neither the manager not the chef came out to apologize. I don't think anyone of us deserves an unclean fish. I don't know how this business can keep running that way. Authority needs to be informed on the hygiene of this restaurant clearly there is something lacking there. If you want some Japanese food, please think twice in going there. I know I won't, again! That was my first and definitely my last! !!

Author: JamieTanBKKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Food poisoning
Review: Went to Xenri last Saturday for their buffet dinner. I suspected that the oysters are not fresh as my family members who ate it (including me) suffered from food poisoning the very next day while those who didn't eat are perfectly alright. The atmosphere may be nice and all but I will never go back there again.

Author: Tom1873Scotland
Title: Very nice
Review: After reading some of the reviews we were not sure what to expect ?? Once we found Andrews which is just across the road from the Shangri-la Golden Sands we thought well this is different for us !!! We went for the spring rolls followed by the sweet and sour chicken which was a treat !!! Andrew himself is a colourful character who doesn't stop. We actually went back again as we really enjoyed it !!

Author: FrancisCheongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprisingly Disappointing!
Review: Recommended a friend & decided to go back to this restaurant for a quick birthday day and boy was I disappointed: 1. Malaysia is still in partial lockdown (Covid19) but dining in small numbers are allowed. When we walked in there was this 1 other guest besides us at 7pm on a Thursday evening. 2. By the time we ordered, the only guest in the restaurant was already eating his meal and it is obvious that chefs in the Kitchen would have only our meal to cook. Our pizza was good but our pasta for our Carbonara were not fully cooked. We realised thatAfter we both took 2 spoonfull from the original plate - we were sharing the Carbonara dish) and when we told the waiter, he politely took whatever that was left on the original plate back to the kitchen and re-cooked whatever that was left on the plate. Now, for such a high quality restaurant, I am really surprised that that was the practice. Just so that we are aligned, my not-so-cooked pasta were left on my personal plate untouched and that's to tell the restaurant that we are not trying to pull a fast one on them. 2. I told the waiter about my friend's birthday & it is a very common in this part of the world that restaurants would kindly offer a complimentary cake or even a birthday song by the waiters - but guess what? None of that happened despite asking the waiter at the very beginning b4 we were seated and a 2nd time after our meal. On the contrary, the waiter shoved us their dessert menu asked us to pay/choose the mcake. 3. There were only 2 tables on a Thursday evening at 7pm during CMCO (Conditional Movement Control Order), and the Caucasian owner/chef was onsite. We chose your restaurant to dine in (which is a rear occasion during such times), the least he could have done is to connect with his guests check if were doing ok. Of course non of that happened and when were given the dessert menu, I decided to walk 200m to Huckleberry and ordered cakes and coffee. I too am a business owner and I am in the travel and events industry. My industry is absolutely dead with zero business since February but when I have a paying client still choosing to support us in such hard times, my company and my team of 36 people treat our client like rare diamond - all that done in a virtual world of webinars. Back to the restaurant, I fully understand that we are now living in unusual times when business is bad, monthly rent deadline is upcoming, employees need to be continuously fed & paid, rising food cost etc but shouldn't this be a time when business owners truly connect with his guests who have chose your restaurant amongst so many in the area? Don't you think a gesture of a cake for a man celebrating his birthday could have made the restaurant another 2 cups of coffee revenue? Don't you think that if the restaurant is well managed and our comments being taken seriously, we would have brought more biz back, afterall it's my 2nd visit to the restaurant? I almost wanted to let the Caucasian chef know on my way out, but I reckoned he would have approached the 2 tables that evening if he wanted to. So... I told myself, never again to Enoteca. I'd go to Huckleberry for their Duck Confite, superb long black and the selection of cakes & pastries.

Author: jerrysT8159VR
Title: Sushi Unfresh
Review: Maybe this is a one off thing but I had severe diarrhea after having raw sushi from this restaurant. Be extra careful if you intend to consume raw fish from them. My gut is still aching as I write this.

Author: alisag09
Title: Good Thai Food
Review: Real nice Thai food Place.Good ambience. Only Parking is a problem. Overall its a place to eat food at least one time during your trip to JB>

Author: h_michikoDublin, Ireland
Title: Nothing special
Review: I came here with my family last August. The food variety is very poor. Also, they are not tasty at all. The mix vegetable that was served on that night was already out of date. I have to mention it to one of the staff and later the staff came and confirmed it with me. The dish was replaced with wedges. My husband didnt like the staff. They are not friendly.However, we enjoyed the show. It shows a nice way to show Malaysian culture. The price of MYR85 is a bit pricey for a poor selection of food. I hope the management will take note and take the necessary step.

Author: PutneySWLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Average
Review: Since my last visit the restaurant has undertaken a facelift and it looks good although the food doesn’t really do it justice.It was acFriday evening and the place was packed with even seating in the corridor.There’s a reasonable selection of food but it was all rather average and mostly unexciting.However, Senior Citizens get a discount!

Author: UlliRahn
Title: Not special but ok
Review: Food was ok, nothing special. The veg curry was nice but quite expensive, as well the mixed veg. The staff is very friendly and it's nice to sit there in this relaxed restaurant but don't expect much just a normal meal out ...

Author: DudaBarth
Title: MISLEADING MENU
Review: To get you inside the bar they will show you a menu at the entrance that is VERY MISLEADING. BEWARE!!!!! It said the pint of Guinness was 26,50 and the Bill came to 36,50! We paid 10 bucks more than we should have. Don’t go to this place this is a TOURIST TRAP. Now because of this take this review and deal with it. See you absolutely never again.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: skting
Title: From western food to asian delights
Review: Steak is the main attraction, reasonably priced. Good Asian food, but pricy. You cant call this a restaurant - cement floor, zinc roof, tube lighting, fans. Also provides Astro where you can view live football.

Author: nguynavBrussels, Belgium
Title: Worst cafe experience for me!!
Review: I came to this cafe with a lot of expectations looking at the picturesque images shown. It was fairly ok. But to my utter disappointment, the food in the cafe was extremely limited and very expensive, For someone who have travelled to Europe and US, i find the portions extremely small and inadequate, Talk about cutthroat experience! For e.g., it would cost RM 32.00 for small plate of croissant sandwich plus tea plus a small glass of orange juice!! For 10 euros i could probably get huge plate of sandwich in Belgium! In addition to that the taste was extremely bland and i had to repetitively ask for chilli sauce. It was indeed a very bad experience for me!!

Author: anliza
Title: Worst food ever
Review: The churros, cake, and pizza oh gosh.  The bad ever. Not recommended. Haih.. I just wasted my money here

Author: 478sallyb
Title: Mixed success
Review: Had an early dinner here. Service very efficient - order on tablet and food appears quickly. Some dishes quite good - agedashi tofu, onigiri, yakitori.  Sushi was just ok. Spicy fried chicken was REALLY spicy!

Author: Hyden F
Title: Badman and beyond rating.
Review: This is beyond rating. Service barely exist as you'll be whisked away by the arrogant server when you just step in. Not a word of sorry and they just give a hand gesture of shooing u away. Kindly revoke their award until they up their service. This is criminal!

Author: thisisnotmysandwichSingapore, Singapore
Title: I went today to La Sal because I was...
Review: I went today to La Sal because I was curios since it was number one in Langkawi's restaurant recommendations. However, the dissapointment was absolut.We ordered two Malaysian dishes and they were completely tasteless. While food presentation is nice, the food itself was bland.One thing you have to give the restaurant is that the setting is beautiful.We have dined twice at The Andaman and the local dishes are incredibly tasty. Pity I decided to trade such a good restaurant for something as bad as La Sal. Do yourself a favour, don't go there
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: shabanao2019
Title: Simple and Authentic
Review: This place looked to be a very popular choice amongst local Malays. It's a very simple set-up, with plastic tables and chairs, only Nasi Lemak on the menu, with a choice of 4-5 toppings/curries to go with it (in addition to the standard sambal, fried/boiled egg, cucumber and small fried fish that comes with the rice). The mango milkshake is highly recommended, which has fresh mango chunks inside to scoop up as a dessert

Author: streetwisegangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: long queue not because food is tasty but slow solo worker
Review: I thought the food was fantastic seeing the long queue so went to try the food. It was nothing good, the queue was long because it is not moving! the solo worker does everything from taking order to wrapping the take away to serving the queue!
Restaurant: Restoran Kudu Bin Abdul Nasi Kandar Penang

Author: Kate L
Title: Yuck
Review: The steak here is awful. Poor cuts and undercooked. I like my steak rare but this cow was brought out still mooing. My partner had the burger which was "ok" but originally wanted the ribs until he found out there was only 4 ribs in the meal despite the picture looking like at least 8. He was quickly told the picture was "just for show". The 7 chips we got each were delicious but too bad there were so few. Definitely won't be returning when there is so much better food close by.

Author: yatieyusri
Title: dinner at Vasco
Review: Good service and friendly..nice place.. good for family time.. the food was awesome and wide variety..staff very helpful especially Azu,Adani & Mazlan. definitely will come here again soon..tqvm ..

Author: Hip2012Melbourne, Australia
Title: Not fancy but awesome cheap eats
Review: This looks like all the other street food restaurant but what a find. Friends living in Penang eat here at least twice a week. The food is excellent offering a large varied menu. Their specialty is Indian food. The friendly staff are warm and accommodating, nothing is a problem. They even do a great pizza. Exceptional value! If you go tell them Jesse (a four year old) says they're the best!

Author: pteo66
Title: Generous portion and nice Assam laksa
Review:
Assam laksa has lotsa fish unlike some stalls with not much ingredients. Would be better with some lime.

On weekend they sell Siamese laksa which has coconut milk. Taste like Thai laksa.

Author: Mobile709315
Title: Rip off
Review: I stopped here for a beer after being collared by one of the bar girls whilst walking around the area, was not allowed to have a seat at the front in the street, presumably because I was on my own, which was annoying but understandable, ordered a pint of Tiger which was 22RM on the menu which is expensive enough, the waitress tried to move me to a table down the side street (!) whilst I was drinking, then charged me 30RM for my drink when I left - I wouldn't pay that in London. I won't be back, but I'm sure they don't care, the place was packed

Author: FoudinguetteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Indian & sri Lankan creations with an average service
Review: We were extremely excited to try this new culinary adventure in KL, and were not disappointed by the creativity in the presentation and flavors. This is certainly South indian and sri lankan food at its best, across the 13 dishes served that evening. It was the only option available (no 7 or 10 courses), with some small bites to start followed by quite a large one. If we loved the food and creativity displayed, we were extremely disappointed by the service. There were several gross mistakes: next course brought to us before we were finished with the current ones, another one served to different guests first. Not to mention the ultra quick service as if we were in a rush, which is very out of place in a fine dining setting. It is not up to fine dining standards on that aspect, whereas the price certainly is.

Author: claudiarV9116PSTijeras, New Mexico
Title: Great Margaritas, average food, always jammed with lots of kids
Review: I've gone to Chili's about 5 times and think they have one of the best margaritas in Kuala Lumpur. Service is good, although as is typical in KL the meals never come out together so one meals sits cooling while the other guest waits. The location is good if you're going to the movies or shopping in KLCC. However the food is not as good as I have had in the US. I had the Santa Fe salad which had a lot more lettuce and a lot less zing than the US version. Also, with their kids eat free policy the restaurant is best suited for families with lots of children. The kids are jumping on the seats, looking over the booth seats to the next table, yelling, dropping food, fighting with each other and making it an unpleasant experience for any diners not looking for a family atmosphere.

Author: LordchiaSri Lanka
Title: Million dollar view
Review: It was a great expirience we had reserved a table for a small birthday celebration. Everything went well and the waiters were kind and extremely well mannered.

Author: gowthamr302
Title: The bitter thing
Review: Basically this hotel is fully concerned on money taste is ok but service is completely waste  try the hotel near by which is banana leaf

Author: 88buba
Title: Foodie
Review: The food was good. They have variety of selection of Malaysian food. The murtabak was nice . However , I had to wait for like 40 mins for my Roti Kapas and it was not fun.

Author: sam170309Adelaide Hills, Australia
Title: Good food but BAD SERVICE
Review: This is my first visit.overall food and environment are good.service wise fair,I saw one of the Chinese chubby lady shout and keep scold those waiter in very rude.I’m so disappointed with this lady.with the same person who took my orders kept asked us quickly make our decision due to she was in busy.i totally can’t accept with her attitude.I hopefully the manager or person in charge will take action for the restaurant reputation in future.

Author: LSCAust
Title: Great restaurant
Review: This was one of the yummiest meals we had in KL. Authentic and delicious Indian food near Little India.

Author: Carolina5000Miami, Florida
Title: Dinner
Review: We were really disappointed, not what you expect from.The service was so slow that other tables also complaint. The server took so long, that by the time that we ordered the chef menu, the chef did not want to do it. Definitely not a great experience.

Author: MayswchenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food served & music found here!
Review: 21 Bistro found near the start of Chinatown has array of local Chinese & Western food.I generally love their array of local & seafood! There was a local band singing Oldies but goodies of the past...ambience was just great as we were carried with the flow of music...and happy feet tapping away.Basically the Boss of the place is here every night to mingle with the crowd and it seems very homey where almost everyone knows one another.If you are in Kuching do drop by...it's a happy place for a drink or bite.

Title: Sri Lankan food
Review: I never had Sri Lankan food before. It is quite different from Indian types. The food we ordered was extremely hot for me. The plate presentation was average. I thought the taste of our 4 dishes was ok but nothing special. I would not return to this restaurant.

Author: HoneyBBoy
Title: Street Food
Review:
my first time in KL and everything is was perfect,
I really like KL , People was nice ,Food very cheap.
I'll go to KL again.it's a nice place.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: yiningl2014
Title: Not recommended
Review: Not nice at all. Super spicy steamboat pasta which waitress quited a bit spicy. Small portion and tasted worse than my home cooked maggie

Author: Alexander G
Title: Nice place to visit
Review: It is a really nice place for gathering with friends. Nice environment, nice food and drinks. Strongly recommend this place

Author: travelling_sisterCairns, Australia
Title: Great concept
Review: Second time I have visited and I took another friend as the experience was fabulous last time. The service was still excellent but the food was not so great, this time around. Some of the food was a bit bland. The hot food came out luke warm. I know for safety reasons they can't serve piping but food but a little bit warmer would have made some of the dishes more palatable. But of course, it's not all about the food. It's a wonderful experience to gain (a teeny tiny amount of) insight into the life of a visually impaired person. Our waiter AK was fabulous. It's fun guessing the food and afterwards seeing what you really ate. Great concept.

Author: Tydus_cKuching, Malaysia
Title: Pretty place that falls short
Review: This place has been re-branded as B Greenhouse.The decor is nice, and there is ample parking.This is an establishment that appeals to a certain type of customer who likes 'safe' western food even though it is highly overpriced. Very much caters to local taste.We had a few dishes. The pizza had a home-made thin crust and was quite nice. I found the beer can chicken gimmicky. The chicken itself was tender and tasty. You are supposed to eat it with the beer as a 'sauce' which I forego because it just tasted like beer. The potatoes that came with it were rubbery and salty, but the veg was ok. What I really took offence with is that they expect you to eat with rubber gloves, which I don't find acceptable at a nice restaurant.We had a bottle of their entry level wine (around Rm130) which i would consider a table wine that retails for RM40 at a supermarket. They do have other nicer options, all of which have been marked up too much (hence my choice of the 'cheapest' wine)The staff are well-meaning but not well trained. e.g. they don't keep track of who orders what, and serve from the left or right as they wish.Don't get me wrong, I may have griped about the price but I`m not a cheapskate. I am willing to pay if I feel that its worth it. I will patronize places like Tom's or Hilton Steakhouse because you get the ambiance, service and food quality.Overall, I'm afraid B Greenhouse falls short of the 'restaurant quality' I expect.

Author: itsmypointKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food vs worst service
Review: Can't deny the food tasty. But you will just add up stress by seing how rude and arraogant their staffs are. It almost like you eat their foods for free and their doing a charity. Such a sad that they don't do anything about as other premise dying to cook food as good as them.

Author: ChanwengcheongCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Fake Thai
Review: When you see other branches of Tiger Lily creating a fusion or including other genres into their menu, you know it’s time to forget it. As what other reviews have said, the food is bland, expensive, and even the pineapple fried rice, one of the famous ones, should be rebranded as bland fried rice+pineapple slices on a half cut pineapple. It is as bad as it gets. Even Kampung Fried Rice tastes way way better. The red curry was ok but that’s abt it. This is a case of a franchise gone bad and the cooks are amateurs at best. Why expensive? An additional rice costs I believe RM3. Yes. I’d say, one to forget. Go somewhere else. Even the vegan version of Thai food in PJ tastes miles and miles better.

Author: BryanYeow13
Title: Poor Service from the Manager
Review: Went with a bunch of friends and one of us ordered Carprinha, unfortunately the drink was watered down and did not have much taste. When confronted, the manager was very defensive and only agreed not to bill us after some discussion. Was surprised with his service when we had 9 of us dining there. But overall, the food was good.

Author: Mistomare
Title: Not welcome
Review: Was there with my girlfriend (after few friends told us how good their food are) and waited at entrance for like 5 minutes but nobody bother to welcome us and get a table . Restaurant was almost empty (4-5 guest ) 9pm plus so I guess busy is not an excuse . Will never go again.

Author: amshramaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst restaurant.. I've ever seen..
Review: We recently been to this restaurant.. and as what we seen reviews on trip advisor.. we are welcomed by highly attitude staff..who seems don't know how to treat customer...secondly they purposefully put less capicity water bottle and expect us to hv water what they serve..we bring our own water bottle..then.. restaurant manager said..you can't have water from outside..and if you wish then can leave.. even though we had given order..we left with such a bad experience with restaurant staff and manager.. I never recommend this to anyone..

Author: drizz12
Title: Just great flavors
Review:
Exceptional flavors. We were trying chicken shawarma, chicken shish tawok and hummus. 
The owner and his wife were very welcoming and gave us a lot of advices about Langkawi nice places

Author: JosephchiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food presentation can be better
Review: Near four points Sheraton. Walk over for a hearty Italian meal. The taste is different from the usual palette that Singaporeans are used to but good. Cesar salad was ok. Veggies could be fresher. Pasta good size. Pasatamania prices but taste better better. Generally a nice experience save the bug in the lasagna- a blip to a perfect ending in Kuching. Will most probably be back and friends will still get my recommendation to make a visit.

Author: PLMLKuala Lumpur
Title: Pretty French house - gd for pics only
Review: Amazing venue for pic taking only - such a terrible shame! High tea for three ppl, were plated for each and served on tiers not sure why that would be the manner in which you present, should just serve each plate then!Coffee was served together with our sparkling water - so by the time we got round to drinking the coffee it was cold and our water had gone flat, we even had to remind them for lemon. Out of the 8-10items served, only 2 hits, the rest were misses. Really appalled at how inexperienced and clueless the floor staff were coupled with the mediocre food served = terrible dining experience!Wouldn't waste time with this one - on top of that, pls note it's valet only and its rm10/ car. Even though this their premise and there is also insufficient parking (up to 10), your car may be parked on the road side. Very strange to charge for parking when you are already patronizing their establishment. Good luck for those who intend to check this place out / be prepared to educate their floor team.

Author: asiarevivalPenang, Malaysia
Title: Not Lamb
Review: We ordered 2 lamb dish and we were served a meat that I am sure wasn’t lamb. i told the waiter the meat wasn’t lamb but I couldn’t be sure what it was? these popular restaurants served the customers different meat because most people don’t know the difference in taste.

Author: Whereismyumbrella
Title: Nice ambiance, incompetent staff
Review: I liked the plain decor and ambiance of the place where locals and tourists mix.They served my meal stone cold and refused to heat it up.The sweet roti with butter and sugar was to die for though and the dinner all in all was dirt cheap.

Author: Rommel919
Title: With customers
Review: Food was great ! Drinks choices are sufficient happy hours promo are good for the budget .. a lot of Filipino staff working very friendly

Author: 160markf
Title: Great whisky and Great ambiance
Review: Came here with family and enjoyed the ambiance, chilled attitude Nd Arif the server was knowledgable in.what went into each whisky. Made the experience that much better

Author: roshanm188Hong Kong, China
Title: Street food
Review: Really nice staff. And very reasonable prices. But this is just a street side dump. I don't mean to insult it but it is. The food is good. Being indian we can cook it at home but so can anyone watching Jamie Oliver. This is a great place for an ethnic insight. But India is an affluent dynamic modern and vast country with storied historical culture. So this restaurant can't be defined as indian. But it's worth a visit

Author: SecoyaGBLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Service and food need to be drastically imporoved
Review: At the beginning the service was exceptionally good. We had a lovely waiter who explained everything to us. My husband ordered a steak to be cooked medium rare as the waiter explained it was the best thing on the menu. I ordered the cod fish. The steak arrived well done and very dry which was much to my husband's disappointment and tasted like rubber when you chewed on it. My cod fish was the worst cod fish I have had anywhere. It was tasteless, lacked salt and pepper and very bland and watery. The captain came around and we told him what we thought about the food. He did offer to replace the steak or offer us a dessert on the house. We opted for the dessert. At the end of the evening, the captain did not come back to see whether everything was in order and we were charged for the dessert. In all fairness the only thing lovely about the evening was the bottle of over priced wine we had ordered. For supposedly the "best grill" in KL, the chef needs to drastically improve his skills especially when you expect nothing but the best after paying an enormous bill.

Author: chequer25Hong Kong, China
Title: My credit card got hacked!
Review: We dined at Koryo-Won @ Suria KLCC on the day I arrived in KL and I used my credit card to pay for dinner. Two days later someone made an online purchase with Air Asia worth US$1,600 using my credit card! I used that credit card only at Koryo-Won from my KL arrival date to the online purchase date. Staff there should be investigated.A bit pricey for the food quality and so-so service.

Author: zzoggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super msg!
Review: This restaurant is a favorite amongst office workers, prices are reasonable with generous servings. I found the food below average, meats that are frozen or pre cooked hours before and dishes loaded with too much cornstarch in their sauces and cheap quality msg where you lose hair and have sleepless nights if u had this for dinner. Will not return unless you need to thin your hair out!

Author: JonathanDBryantSydney, Australia
Title: Stunning
Review: We recently enjoyed dinner at Kerbaya. Housed in a superbly refurbished series of shop houses, this restaurant should absolutely not be missed if you are in Georgetown and enjoy good food. The décor is absolutely stunning. The service was exceptional and the food completely delicious. Highly recommended Peranakan cuisine in an uber glamorous environment!

Author: seaparkMalaysia
Title: Dissapointed Lunch Buffet
Review: Heard about positive comment from friends who went two years ago, and we decided to have family gathering over lunch buffet as well. Very dissapointed with the food spread, not worth the price. Food choices are very limited, only few of Japanese cuisine, Italian (basically only pizza and pasta), Indian corner is slightly ok with more choices, nothing at all on Malay or Chinese cuisine. Fruits are also very limited - considering Malaysia is a fruit heaven. Desserts are very sweet, and again, not much choices. Overall, nothing to shout about. Dissapointed lunch.

Author: SheenaStReichertshofen, Germany
Title: Bananaleaf for Brunch
Review: Came here for brunch, and was served quickly on banana leaf. In comparison to Johor Bahru, the Service is colder and less friendly. There are constantly People pushin around and asking you to move aside as they serve. Tight space.Food was good. Always ask for it hot, otherwise you might have already cold crab or prawns served. Most of the Curries are kept hot.Ask also for Bru coffee with cow milk. Extremely tasty!Though it is a Restaurant, Germans should not confuse this with homestyle Restaurants. The atmosphere is for locals, and the cleanliness Level is not to be expected to on par with german Restaurants.Nevertheless, the Food was excellent, Drinks good, and I had no Problems with tummy aches thereafter! Safe!

Author: Mimi-ozCanterbury, Australia
Title: Slushy rasberry margarita - YUMO
Review: When I was living in KL and working in Mid Valley this was a regular spot for an afterwork drink. The staff are exceptionally friendly and make you feel so welcome.For food, I love the fish Tacos, the nachos and even just the plain chips with dipping sauce.Don't forget to ask if its HAPPY HOUR

Author: yomamemoSingapore
Title: Overprice, mediocre food
Review: Ambience is ok...in fact if you walk around melaka, you'll find similar cafes...so nothing to shout about.Now, let's talk about the food.Ordered the CAT, grilled chicken chop, mushroom soup and Kaya breakfast. The CAT is a disappointment, just a cheese and tomato dip with slices of white toast.Kaya breakfast's scrambled eggs is just omelette broken into many small pieces. The mushroom sauce for the chicken chop is actually mushroom soup. the black local coffee is weak. All in all we spent RM100 for 3 main courses, 1 side dish and 4 drinks.If you want to benchmark against starbucks breakfast, please at least make sure the quality of the food is the same too.I think the tripadvisor flag that is hung outside the cafe, gives it a "licence" to charge exorbitant prices with mediocre food.

Author: deedee88
Title: Buffet and A La Carte
Review: We ate in this restaurant for buffet breakfast and also once for the Buffet Ramadan dinner.  We also had one A La Carte meal there.  We enjoyed them all.

Author: ysnizaysop
Title: D Positano
Review: Great ink squid pasta ! I like it. The spicy the better Great atmosphere. Enjoy it with my friends !!

Author: Stuart Liddle L
Title: The best breakfast going - steamed dim sum
Review: It was a great experience, the restaurant was clean and cool, the toilets were clean and the staff were very helpful. Haven't had dim sum for breakfast for a long time and these were very good, even had some fired carrot cake, which was also delicious. In addition, there was a handy car park just over the road and it wasn't crowded when we went- about 08:30 in the morning.

Author: BrianLFY
Title: It is about the details that set best apart from the normal.
Review: Overall the breakfast buffet, in terms of variety and taste are worth 4 stars of 5 for an international brand. So it is expected at least the coffee is drinkable and we can see details and effort put into the food preparation and presentation. But the coffee at this 4 star? hotel is horrible (the staff should really taste it before serving it, I will applause if the manager can finish one full cup) and the fruit presentation is emm... Can refer the photo attached and judge yourself..Time to get the basic right.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: roele414
Title: Overpriced tourist place
Review: Pushy staff, average food and inflated tourist prices. 30RM for long beans with pork and rice?Location is good, but down the street are a lot of better alternatives.

Author: AussiboyCalgary, Canada
Title: Expensive and Horrible Service!
Review: Not really worth the effort. Food was cold by the time it got to my table - Chicken rice. Service was horrible, infact very hard to find someone to take the order. Very expensive for what it is.Very stuffy and not worth the time.

Author: Petro CGauteng
Title: Bad service
Review: Restaurant was very busy they put us on a waiting list no problem. After an hour we got a table we are 3 couples sitting shoulder to shoulder, table to small for six people. We have ask waiter for a bigger table but no response after 10 minutes of asking for bigger table we finally go a bigger table. First we order our drinks one of the male ask for extra soft drink because his spirits and soft drink is half in a whiskey glass. The waiter say to him no he can't have more so he ask if he can have a can so she said no they don't have. After we received our food we ask for more chilli's, the waiter said to us they don't have chilli's really no chilli's in a Mexican restaurant. We ask for plain butter for our corn and they didn't have any plain butter except for garlic butter. One of the men ask three times for a knife and fork then decided he will eat his food by hand as he is fed up with them. The Manager was watching soccer he didn't worry about anybody. After the soccer match he only go and ask if everything was ok. Food not too bad, but service terrible.

Author: travelskSingapore
Title: Food is OK and Service is Poor
Review: I was there for lunch today after hearing so much about this restaurant in town. I honestly do not know what is fuss about this place - maybe it is the lack of good french food in KL that even an average restaurant stands out. Once we were served by the staff, it went downhill from there. The service is really terrible, where the waiters do not seem to understand simple english, and do not know how to recommend anything, no initiative at all. I tried the poulet sandwich, boeuf bourgiognon tart, and eggs benedict after looking around, and I must say that the food is just OK - Average. Maybe I went during lunchtime and the menu is limited, but even then, I have had much tastier french food. I was considering to try the dinner menu one day, but after this experience today, I think I may just give it a pass.

Author: dobin_8St. Helier, United Kingdom
Title: long wait for rubbish food.
Review: Visited here with four friends mid afternoon after giving the nearby food hall a miss on account of the flies .After two months of traveling was by far the worst meal and my friends who had been traveling for six months agreed .The chunky chips onion rings and burger weren't fully cooked the chicken curry and potatoes dish was full of just pieces chicken bits and skin could have eaten in kuchin for a third of the price the only thing going for it is the location if it had serious competition I doubt it would survive.

Author: DeepakSelvan
Title: Not bad!
Review: The thali meals provided in the hotel are not worth the money but other items are worth a try, especially those like dosa and naan.

Author: Nomadic_Wanderer12
Title: I love pan shisha
Review: This place i like coz of friendly staff and manager. I back here always for shisha only. Mocktails also my fav

Author: limelemonb
Title: Brunch
Review: Great lunch. Many choices menus. Will come again with family and friends !!! Great food and service, would highly recommend...Went there for lunch.. Everything perfect. Such friendly staff

Author: PiphoopPalm Cove, Australia
Title: Very pleasant
Review: My husband and I ate at the James Brooke Bistro on our last night in Kuching. We were both very tired and had overindulged in interesting food during our stay - we forced ourselves to leave the hotel. We were very pleased we did - a lovely, peaceful location overlooking the river, nice decor, good (fusion) food and service. I had the fish curry and my husband had the beef salad. Wine was available although not on the drinks menu - but expensive as everwhere in Kuching. We will definitely return during our next visit.

Author: ThanalechumiR
Title: Unhappy
Review: Previously service + food was superb, but today I’m very very disappointed with1)service-filling drinking water into tumblers(many), spilled, never bother to wipe table. 2)food -horrible, vegetarian platter, dry and tasteless, panner squishy, pineapple bitter & sour, Vege Briyani over cooked & it taste more like fried rice. When feedback to manager, the answer I got was, why other no complain only you saying not nice. He also sarcastically said its same cook, same service people,same SOP. Though he apologises but I could accept it because it wasn’t sincere.Please take note this is not my first time to here, been many times that’s why I can know the differences.I recommended this place to my friend for he moms birthday celebration but I really regret. I really felt shame of what happened. Will never ever Reccomend to anyone.......☹️☹️

Author: Kevin TBandar Puchong Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cold breakfast with rushing atmosphere!
Review: I have heard so much about Antipodean and finally got a chance to try the Mid V outlet. I have to say that I don't enjoy it at all for my Sunday brunch with my bestie. It suppose to be a birthday treat but I am so embarrass that the food being served are COLD! We already prepared that we might need to wait for a table since it is not a big place and it is crowded on Sunday. But we didn't know that we were rush to order and the only menu they had is the one written on the wall. We can't see it from far and the font and spaces being used is not "visual friendly". Eventually, the waitress is kind enough to recommend us the big breakfast. We were amazed that our food was served in less than 10 minutes but only to found out that it was COLD instead! We didn't even have the mood to order coffee and cake and leave the place as soon as we can.

Author: stefffanielinn
Title: Ridiculous pricing!
Review: Food was amazing. Pricing was ridiculous for a regular shop like that. 5 regular dishes + normal non alcoholic drinks cost us RM247/-.I remembered looking at the receipt having to pay RM40 for a dish. Never coming back. Sorry.

Author: IdrisA788Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food good service
Review: Situate along a row of shops along jalan kasah in a quiet corner of town where there are a row of pretty good restaurants this restaurant serves good food especially the foie gras and lamb rack. The steaks are also pretty good and there is a decent wine cellar. Service is fast and good though prices are a bit steep. Will recommend.

Author: Tim NDubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Terrible service
Review: An interesting menu massively let down by staff unhappy to be there, and unhappy to serve. Nearly ever table has to wave their arms to gain the attention of the staff, who seem to shuffle over and have neither any menu knowledge nor any idea what drinks are available...seemingly the absolute basics. But 6-7 staff happy to gather together and chat at reception, oblivious to the patrons. Once they understand what it is you want through pointing and then reading the menu option over you shoulder, seemingly never to have heard of your selection before, they then return a few minutes later confused by your request and check a second time by asking you to read their own writing...
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: AthieDev
Title: Nice place
Review: The theme of the cafe and its interior ws something different. Food was ok. Presentation of food was different. Service was just ok.

Author: TheAlchemistt
Title: Very bad rude owner
Review: Never go to this shop the the appam isn’t so great and the prices for one is RM4 , one appam rm4 is insane. Furthermore the service is rubbish and the ugly owner is downright rude and arrogant. Never go to this shop if you want a proper meal with GOOD SERVICE.

Author: TCLKLKL
Title: Nice restaurant environment
Review: Very nice place to eat. Pleasant environment with exception that the lighting is too dim to see what you are eating. Even with candles on the table, the lighting in the main hall is way too dim. Food is so so not expected for the price range. Pricey, yes, quality of local food, not fantastic. Western food can cost up to half your room cost or full room cost if you eat as a couple. Pricing don't make sense.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: tcling77
Title: Sushi, sushi, sushi...
Review: This month, they are having the Norwegian Salmon promotion. New menu with offer price. They provide good quality salmon and sushi, at affordable price. I think they are the cheapest sushi in town. They have a few brand in kuching, mostly in shopping mall.

Author: 880lindsaygWoodley, United Kingdom
Title: Stylish Japanese restaurant tucked away
Review: I visited here for a quick dinner with a work colleague - the menu was very extensive but we chose the prawn tempura, the soft shell crab, and a bento box to share. The amount of food is very generous - the bento box alone was enough for two. The food was delicious - delicate flavours, beautiful presentation. The whole experience felt very special indeed.

Author: vijaysap1986 k
Title: The staff is not understanding and rude.
Review: Though the taste is good in sangeetha but the staff is very rude adamant and never understand the customer. The air condition is unbearable cold and it was right above us. The staff is not ready to switch it off, they say only one air condition is operating in the entire ground floor. It's not my problem they have to get it fixed. You guys have to be customer friendly

Author: Lee L
Title: Good soup food
Review:
Waited 40 mins for the bah kut teh and I say it's worth the wait. 
Had good yam rice n braised pork belly. 
Soup is very good and warm. 
Service is good.

Author: Uni L
Title: My Favourite!
Review: Stayed here for a few nights and found that the morning buffet was the best. Good spread: salad (baby spinach,rocket, asparagus etc and good selection of dressing), noodle station, porridge station, egg station (poached egg, omelette, sunny side up etc), English breakfast counter, Malaysian counter (Indian cooked food, roti canai to order, nasi lemak, spring role etc), bread counter, freshly squeeze on-demand fruit juice counter, milk and soy milk counter, cereals etc. Plus very good service from station chef and staffs. And most importantly, they have a very professional staff Mr. Thiru who worked at auto-pilot fast speed and highly efficient and friendly, always cheer up everyone in the morning with his perfect service.

Author: bie90
Title: service and food very bad. .not tasty
Review: i had early dinner with my husband.not busy and only 1table with 3pax. .but first step already failed. .means no greeting when i enter to your restaurant. .then when i order some dessert. .i ask the waitress if i want change ice cream to another flavour but i got the bad answers from serve. .just simple things u cant handle, how attract cust to come to your restaurant??actually many times already i and husband want come to your restaurants but if like this service. .first and last i go to your place. .when food coming. .its should be started first. .but my dessert come first, after that main course and last is a appertizer. its annoying! all food taste very bad. .only my husband eat bcause the price is expensive. .im also work at restaurant and i AGM at one restaurants. .so please improve your service staff.. if u wanted your longer bisnes..

Author: noneoyourbusiness
Title: Really awesome food
Review: Really great Chinese food, and super friendly and helpful staff. I don’t know if I’ve ever had my cup of tea refilled so quickly and so many times. The prices are quite good as well. Would wholeheartedly recommend.

Author: Em MOman
Title: Good lamb mandi & great adani tea
Review: We went to Saba restaurant in February 2018 and ordered the popular lamb mandi. It has big serving. Therefore if you are a small eater, 1 regular plate is enough for 2 pax. The lamb is quite tender but beware of the green chillies and it can be quite hot; not for the faint heart!What we love the most is adani tea in a teapot. The pot can be shared among 3 people and comes in a small cup. We love the spicey taste of the tea which blends well with the lamb mandi which comes with the rice.They serve warm water but ice water can only be ordered via mineral water.Our total invoice sums up to RM82 for 4 adults and 1 child. Quite reasonable given that it is a restaurant.All and all, Saba is a nice place for family dining and they are quite prompt to attend to you when you press the bell/button.

Author: jokl78
Title: Good food
Review: Ordered salted egg prawn, pork ribs and tofu. Food is good. Price is reasonable too. Very quiet. Only 3 tables including us for dinner

Author: milokittsSingapore, Singapore
Title: bad service and food
Review: Went to this outlet in Nu-Sentral for a dinner. some comments:1. I felt the captain and waiters were impatient and almost rude.2. The sashimi were not fresh and tasted very stale.3, The beef with garlic ordered were not only tough - but they were sliced into strangely thin portion - probably a technique to make it easier to chew stale meat.4. The eel was ok, but the sauce was too thick and sweet.Its probably one of the worst Japanese restaurant I've gone to.

Author: lahejh
Title: Not as before
Review: I came here in 2014, food was much better. This time the food looked as if it was coming out of a micro wave.

Author: iamonpreeyaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Don't order any traditional foods here
Review: I have ordered satay, spaghetti and watermelon juice. The only dish that I can eat was spaghetti. The cumin in satay sauce is too strong. The watermelon juice taste just like water. The waiters and waitresses are slow response maybe there were a lot of people at the time that I been there.

Author: Dnyan_DSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded
Review: Good place.. Great food. However it's always crowded. Staff is also good, however they got the order wrong. In all fairness, we ordered multiple times. Getting a table was a pain. They also have seating on the first floor, however they didn't open that even though the ground floor was full.

Author: BangkokFanSingapore
Title: Avoid!
Review: The food here is definitely overrated & overpriced! I had one of the worst Seafood Aglio Olio I’ve ever eaten in my life! It costs me RM55! I didn’t even finish the prawns, let alone the pasta! This is the first time I did not finish my food in my life! The worst part is when I told the waiter that I wanted to cancel my dessert, I was told that it was not possible! What nonsense is this?
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: esh0307kl
Title: Decent food , incompetent service
Review: The food is decent , however it's the lack of little things 1- letting us wait for the menu while the waitress fiddled with her own stuff2- no asking if we wanted sugar in our fresh juice3- dishes being served separately - with the excuse of only one cook Having said that the beef sambal - although tad oily has a good kick Fried rice - first dish was awesome and the second had huge grains of salt

Author: S AToulouse, France
Title: Very average Chinese restaurant
Review: I was told that this restaurant is 'local Malay'. It isn't! It's a Chinese seafood restaurant. I didn't see any Malay dishes on the menu.There's a big queue which starts around 6.15pm and my two dishes took an age to arrive. Nevertheless, the kitchen is extremely well managed. Unfortunately, the food was nothing special. My bill came to 12 euros for one person including hot tea. I wouldn't go back. There are tons of similar restaurants like this in Penang.

Author: alexs426Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service!
Review: I've been to many Persian restaurants in KL and hands down, Shisha lounge is the worst Persian restaurant i've ever been to. The food quality is below average. Their staff are rude and under trained. Some don't even speak English and don't know how to communicate with customers. It's a shame as it is located in a very good location and could be a lot better.

Author: jacobsfoodieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible service
Review: Worst service in Kuala Lumpur. Waited close to an hour to realize our food hadn't even been cooked. Along with that, it look 20 minutes for an Oreo milkshake and water to arrive at our table. Staff were useless and many people were complaining. Don't go to eat here, it's a complete waste of your time. Absolutely ridiculous.

Author: wyana
Title: Pricey but not that great
Review: The price is on the high side. Probably because of the location. Food taste was mediocre - didn't justify the price I'm paying.

Author: saintqpid
Title: Over rated food
Review: Food is over rated. Although in comparison with the other stalls selling similar food they are good but I’ve eaten better chicken rice elsewhere.

Author: MALA S
Title: Best choice for Vegetarians
Review: Friendly staff and very accommodating for customising vegetarian requests. Safe choice after a tiring day in Legoland. Decent food and pricing.

Author: jtsh12Malaysia
Title: Amazing find in Publika
Review: Stumble upon this place when looking for a new cafe to hang out. Friendly staff, cosy environment and amazing food. Personally had the Buttermilk Brine Chicken Burger. Chicken is tasty n cooked nicely, has an amazing crunchiness to it. Top it up with a sunny side up egg and you have the perfect meal of the dayDo mind that it can get really crowded over the weekends but it's still worth the wait for amazing food

Author: puchka
Title: Indian cuisine
Review:
On Jalan Roberston, this restaurant serves
Indian cuisine.  The fish curry and rice was delicious and serving size decent.  The staff are welcoming and prices are moderate.

Author: Cuppuccino99Singapore
Title: I was disappointed.
Review: I was thrilled by the reviews most guests posted. My husband and I decided to dine there yesterday. We easily got a small table as we avoided busy hour. We ordered the most popular dish, herbal chicken and other dishes. To my disappointment, the chicken appeared so tiny to me, as small as a pigeon. To my horror, the dish cost itself almost RM$30 after all taxes. We were utterly disgusted by the service provided by the waitress. None of the staff had put on any smile to welcome their guests, even the cashier herself.I may not return until things changed to be better.

Author: SuppaSue
Title: Great Food & Service
Review: Overall good vibe and delicious food! Service is one of the best I've had, our server April was super friendly and very accommodating. Very much recommended place for celebration or dinner with friends and family because of the portion.

Author: Ravee312Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: Been here 3 times and each time we're here the guy behind the food counter is always shouting at all the waiters..he's like the gangster in the restaurant..and today when i was there, i ordered chicken briyani but he was in the midst of drinking coffee and just ignored me..when i repeated my order he just nodded..but carried on drinking his coffee..so i didnt wait there to pick up my food..i assume he will get the waiter to send it to me once he decides to start his work...but no..he only served people who stood there and waited...such arrogance..he behave like he's paying people to eat there...and i notice all the waiters are scared of him...i approached him and said i want to eat now..there was no customer waiting.. and only then he grudgingly served me....I will never come here again...

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice lunch
Review: Had lunch here with a friend. The two of us ordered the sashimi platter which consisted on uni, fresh prawns, salmon belly, tuna, scallop. I love sashimi but was horrified to bite into a small portion of unfresh uni! This really needs improvement as freshness is absolutely the testament of a good Japanese restaurant.Also ordered my favorite tempura sweet potato. Love it as I love sweet potato. The baked oyster which we had was a disappointment though. Finale is the raindrop cake which is my first try and we both love that.

Author: Aaron M
Title: Special drinks
Review: Food is good. Service is awesome as Raman is top notch. The special vodka coconut drink was out of this world which I think should be called "The Vodka Nut"

Author: Meander817893
Title: Bad attitude staffs
Review: We were there for a jug of draught beer, we already had a couple of snack which is dry squid. We wanted to have a little chili sauce to eat with our snack and the staff said NO, because we didn't order any food to have chili sauce to eat with. One of their staff even asked me "CHILI SAUCE FOR WHAT". The weather was so hot that we suddenly crosses over this and what they gave me was very disappointed. I gave them one 1 star for the bad attitude of their staff. I couldnt have any complain if they answered me in another way.

Author: marco365509
Title: Very nice
Review: Prob the best place on the river for couples, table next to the water, nice wood, good service, Carson is the guy you want to be served by, he is real good. Cold beers and nice dessert.

Author: Mike M
Title: No no no and no is a word to describe
Review: I was sitting the chair for 10 minutes without any one approaching our table A guy finally showed up and the moment I spoke English he tone changed. He left our table and started serving other table which we definitely came before. He came back and said what you will order we told him what we wanted. He showed up with the wrong order and we told him this is not our order. He said he can't return and said no, no and no. We walked out at this point and the manager said nothing after we told him what had happened. Stay clear of this place if you want service at least. Don't speak English. I saw him talking to natives very friendly and happy just to annoy us more. Stay clear.

Author: LKT2171
Title: Mamee Jonker House
Review: Paid RM5 to enter and but need to improve on the overall feel. The tour is short and I think the managements need to give some Mamee snacks for those paid the tour.... Overall, average only for me.

Author: Ahmad R
Title: I cant find this place.
Review:
Even local nearby is not sure abt this cafe whereabout. 

Probably has closed. Or maybe relocated to other location.

Author: Jasminetck
Title: Nice food and reasonable priced
Review:
Restaurant has a cozy ambience. Food was great and not too expensive. 

We ordered the  recommended curry fish head which came in a big portion. Roast duck and claypot pork dish was awesome too!

Defiantly worth a try.

Author: sean51712018Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Relish the moment with soulmate and great food
Review: What’s the best way to kick off a Saturday’s morning? Of course a good cup of coffee with someone matters to you. I’ve heard of some good reviews from friends about this cafe. Am very lucky to have an opportunity to drop by and tried their sunny side up toast! This is incredible guys!! M a bread lover, and I absolutely recommend this dish. Thought a very simple piece of thing, but the layers of flavours would make you crave for more bites. Their tantalising otak toast is worth trying too. Thank you!

Author: Elaine GGlasgow, Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Great little restaurant
Review: We discovered Opium when we were looking for a restaurant soon after we arrived in KL. It ended up being a great find and we are here several times throughout our holiday. The restaurant serves Asian fusion food which is very good quality. Also some nice looking cocktails available. I thought the Tiger beer served the traditional Chinese way in a jug and bowl was particularly charming. The staff are also very friendly and welcoming. Also worth noting - the all you can eat dumpling and noodle buffet is particularly good value.Well worth a visit.

Author: 736irakliaTbilisi, Georgia
Title: Good place
Review: Tried Vegetarian burger, comes with chips , small salad and little dipping (salty) I also had extra "mashed avocado"Pros:Burger and little salad was very tasty.Friendly and polite staffLive one man band, he was singing very well actually.Price is ok. Cons:Mashed avocado is actually a paste it's not fresh avocado so it's bit misleading, I wouldn't order if I knew. Chips were ok not really crispy.Overall happy with the place would come here again.

Author: Reji77Chatswood, Australia
Title: Madam Kwan’s staff trained to be madams
Review: We were set for local delights at this restaurant but turns out to be local delayeds.1/3 of the meal didn’t arrive after 45 mins wait so we decided to leave. There were most staff standing around than taking orders. And seriously there’s this culture of no “eye contact”. Just in case the customer might have a request. Not planning to return anytime soon. And they wanted to charge us for drinks that never arrived or consumed.

Author: ekta pMalaysia
Title: Excellent food but confused staff
Review: We ordered a few gravies and breads. It was a simple order but don't know what was the confusion to the staff for repeat bread orders, that almost 5 different people from staff had to be explained that we haven't got the full order. It was funny and frustrating at the same time, but the food was amazingly delish, so no complains. Paneer was made in authentic north indian style. Really good food.

Author: 53pluscountriesWest coast, USA
Title: Clean but average
Review: They had a fairly limited vegetarian menu. The restaurant was very clean, but the food and service was average. Not great, not bad, just average. I definitely had more flavorful and satisfying Indian food in KL, and this is probably the best Indian in the touristy section of Bukit Bintang. You have to go more towards the Indian part of downtown (adjacent to Chinatown) for better Indian.

Author: WateryWinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over overpriced food
Review: This restaurant serves variety of food, customers choose their own food and put in a plate and pay at the counter. They do not have a system/ guideline how they calculate the food, the prices to the customers are merely based on the cashier's judgement or maybe by their mood. I took some plain white rice, a chicken leg, some meat stir fried with vege & a fried egg, 3 dishes in total. The price that I need to pay for is RM21.50. Incredibly high price. I asked the cashier (looks like the lady boss there) why is so expensive, she told me that the chicken leg is RM8, and I took the meat and fried egg as well. If the chicken leg is RM8, then the rice with some meat that stir fry with vege & a fried egg shall not cost RM13.50 right?? She insisted that the price is RM21.50, and I couldn't and wouldn't want to argue with her. So I paid.Frankly, the taste of the food is not bad, but the way they do business and price fixing are terribly out and not sincere.

Author: Mike T
Title: Great place
Review:
Lovely food. Good prices . Nice music .
We had a lovely evening. 
Especially enjoyed the sizzling prawns.

Author: PearlPureheart
Title: Just chill out here!
Review: This is a very pleasant place to sit and watch the world go by.  Right in the middle of the old part of Georgetown.  Food and drinks good, service pleasant.

Author: GregariousWLifePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Spring Time Experience in the middle of Kuala Lumpur
Review: I brought an overseas friend here and we were a little regretful that we had to come so early for dinner. 6pm! But it turned out to be WONDERFUL! For the first hour, we had the affable and gracious Chef Ori to ourselves. Oribe did not disappoint. The entire meal was like a buildup of symphony of harmonious flavours, a true delight and entertainment of our visual and taste. We were treated to a collection of special ingredients only available during this spring season. Food is excellent, service is superb and Chef Ori was at his usual best. Oh, and I should want to have a heart attack, THAT is what I want to eat to induce it. ;) a concoction of Uni, salmon roe, fatty tuna, tiny shrimps AND alien looking sake marinated Firefly Squid.

Author: jecissa_wHamilton, Canada
Title: Major let down!
Review: I went to this restaurant t several times about 5 years ago and loved it then.i was anxious to go back on my last visit to KL and what a huge disappointment! Even though we had made a reservation the staff rarely noticed or acknowledged us when we came in and then tried to seat us right by the door. Anyway that wasn't a huge deal but it was work flagging down staff throughout the meal. I also found the food to be rather tasteless, bland and not impressive at all. The desserts were worth avoiding.While I know people do rave about this place and I was once one of those people ... Don't waste your time... There is far better food and atmosphere in KL.

Author: JChinPY
Title: Ms.Chin
Review: The first place that I’ve been missing the most is to dine in Chambers Grill the moment the lifting of MCO! I’ve lost count how many times I’ve repeatedly ordered their famous Tomahawk steak as it’s not just leaving everyone in my family unforgettable moments of their Top notch services by Mr. Adli & ambience but also dishes that will make you crave for more everyday! I’m so pleased & happy that Chef Steven, Nathan, Haziq & Edward from Chambers Grill came out with their latest menu 21-days aged Whiskey Tomahawk steak! After tasted their new menu today, I’ve already made another booking on the same night with Mr.Adli on my next following weekend with my family. Definitely have to return for my next feast before this menu ends on 30th of September 2021! The steak was not only perfectly cooked & flavourful but also uniquely infused with succulent Whiskey on every bite! The food was highly satisfying & the ambience was first class. Well done Chef! Best steak house in Malaysia that deserve a Michelin Star! Time and again each dine in experience will not be perfect if Mr.Adli is not around. We will always make sure he’s not on his day-off whenever we dine in with Chambers. His service was way beyond excellent & Top class service! Mr. Adli is always attentive, genuinely friendly, heart warming & polite to all diners. This F&B service industry is not easy to come across such excellent services people like Mr.Adli that had portrayed to customers especially in Malaysia, with long hours & physical demanding work. We really appreciate your outstanding & top class services each time we dine with you! Thank you & looking forward to dine in with you & Chef next week! Best Regards,Ms.Chin

Author: GDG1989
Title: Disappointing
Review: After an initially fantastic bruschetta, I guess my expectations were too high. My arabita pasta was boring, and tasted like an entire bulb of raw garlic was added to the sauce after it was cooked. One of my friend's meals came cold in the centre, and the staff initially tried to argue that it was normal. We had to keep asking for our table to be cleared. Prices for both alcohol and food are absolutely outrageous when weighed with the quality. Very nice ice cream birthday cake for my friend, however.

Author: Foxy-BelgiumGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Fine dining that comes with a nice view, a very expensive bill, small portions and arrogant pretentious attitude
Review: we have been here several times before and had each time a nice experience, however the last time it seemed that prices have gone up even more, portions smaller and pretentious attitude really worse. Do as a lot of peoples suggest; go to the bar for a nice view and leave to eat somewhere else.
