We have done a lot of fine dining in KL, and this restaurant is now the most expensive but not the best..pro's:-nice view, -very good food & servicecon's: -booking will only be confirmed the next day;-they keep the table for max 20 min, but 5 min after booking time you are already called where you are; - decent lady sandals without any distinct high heels need to be switched for glitter shoes or closed shoes, no matter how pretty, evening dress or appropriate clothing-tables at the window appears only for those spending 300 ++ per person (and no drinks at the bar before dinner are NOT included), -a three course dinner will get your bill easily above 1000 - 1500 RM for 2 persons, (so be sure to take the window table!)Fine dining is about excellent food for decent pricing in a relaxed atmosphere, this is not the place.We will not come back and choose a better option around.

Author: howeclanAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Great food, drinks selection and ambience not so great
Review: We live nearby and encouraged our friends to try Trace specifically after reading great reviews about the hotel and the new dining experience ... the food was fantastic, unfortunately, we didn't have a great experience overall due to a few things. First, we ordered cocktails but were told NO VODKA. However, we could SEE vodka in the bar, but that is not the vodka they use to serve us cocktails. Not my problem. As a customer, i kind of expected the establishment to take a hit on cost to keep us happy... no. Second, we tried to order a bottle of wine ... there were no red wines available. At all. In the whole hotel. This was surprising. Finally, we sat in a nice area with good views most of our dinner with very bright fluorescent lights in the restaurant. I understand this is a hotel restaurant, but as we were leaving at 9.30pm ( a lot earlier than we had anticipated ) they dimmed the lights to provide a very nice, intimate, dining ambience. We suggested they do this at 7.30pm instead - encourage people to get comfortable and stay. Unfortunately, it appeared the majority of staff we spoke to in the restaurant were leaving. Its a huge shame as the hotel looks amazing, its great what they are doing with their innovative offering - BUT to F&B .... please dont'take your eye off the local market who want to support new business.

Author: mustafa_t_amin
Title: Go for the view, not the food
Review: It's a typical place for either tourists coming for the experience or locals coming for a celebration or a romantic dinner date. They charge you extra if you want a table by the window but might as well pay for it as all there is to this place is the view. It's fantastic at night and am sure it's pretty amazing in the day too.They give you a 2 hour slot and you get about a round and a half in that time. The highlight obviously is as you pass the petronas towers. Food is a buffet but was a bit of a let down not on variety but on quality. But you're not going there for the food. We had a vegetarian in our group and they were accommodating enough to make him something extra which was nice. They even do a birthday song if informed in advance. It's expensive but an experience for sure!

Author: Paik Ling HPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food very average with the lousiest service in town
Review: You would expect great service in this award winning restaurant but no..........1) Took 10mins to serve a cup of warn water2) Looked at us in disbelief when we said the cup smelled of *horrors* cockroaches until i made him smell it for himself3) Started clearing our plates in such hurry when the restaurant was one-quarter full4) Took another 10mins to get the bill5) I had to say "excuse me" 3 times to get the attention of the waitress who stood by my side but looking somewhere else, to take my credit card for payment.For the price, the food is very average and very forgettable. I'm better off dining somewhere else.

Author: Matt T
Title: Closed earlier than staff advised.
Review: I rang before going here with my wife to make sure we could get some famous laksa at 10pm. I was told they close at 11pm. We arrived to find them closing at 10:15 and were told that the kitchen was closed. Disappointing.

Author: eliasonly
Title: Best italian foods /pizzas in KL!
Review: During mco tried their mco package ,arrived fast,superb delicious italian foods defenitely will try others after this.thanks!

Author: Khalil600Doha, Qatar
Title: Good
Review: After my bad experience with Spicy of India, I decided to try Bombay Palace. I ordered the food by phone. The test was good, the order came on time. However, the price is slightly, but not too much, comparing to Indian restaurant from same class in AD, DXB, and Doha. The over all experience was above good.

Author: JW T
Title: Not interesting
Review:
Their menu seems offering lots of choices, but its just combination of the same few things like bread, sausages, bacon, eggs, hash... Over priced and not interesting. Coffee was way overpriced for that kind of "quality".  
Their kitchen ventilator seems not working well either.

Author: CanisHanSeoul, South Korea
Title: Service need to improve.
Review: C1 ( 2013.10.03 )There was located near at monorail station. I visited there alone for dinner, and ordered curry rice. The food was so-so, I think, but service neet to improve much. They was not smile from incomming to out. The atmosphere was not bad, and clean.

Author: 372nirajbDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Don't go on other reviews - not worth it
Review: We r in KL now and decided to eat dinner at Passage to India after reading reviews. Service was worst. FOOD WAS NOT coOKED PROPERLY. Don't think this is real Indian food.

Author: LongWayBackHomeCalifornia
Title: Just Awful!
Review: We went over for a roast dinner during our visit to Kuala Lumpur and, as one can imagine, we were rather excited to be dining at Harrods albeit at the cafe.The staff were not quite top notch, however, the trainee we had tending to us was very good. The food - well, that's another story!We ordered roast beef diners all around which looked fine, though not very special. Upon the very first bite, we all noticed that the gravy which was all over the dish was abnormally peppery. We were told that it's pepper gravy, yet, the amount of pepper used was clearly a mistake. I'm English - I have roast dinners every weekend!Might want to avoid this place!

Author: Ali I
Title: Unique experience
Review: If you haven't tried it, you need to. Do I want to go back again? Not sure. The wife definitely does. Food is a mixed plate. Remember to eat from dishes in the opposite direction the waiter advises you to.

Author: Grace2310
Title: Expensive! The foods taste average
Review: We ordered the nyonya asam fish which i feel is average only and it costs rm100...expensive! This place is overrated. Will never visit again.

Author: Travelerbrat_inPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A pretty nice kerala joint
Review: I was there for lunch with a group of friends. Some dishes were really good and some items were a little disappointing But overall it was a good a really nice meal and anyone craving for kerala food should certainly give this place a shot and let the others know how authentic it is :)Please don't order the soup it was such a disappointment & the prawn briyani too :(

Author: blackdog1963Ko Lipe, Thailand
Title: WHAT HAPPENED?!
Review: This is a great little cafe that used to serve a great breakfast. However, when we turned up hungry for breakfast this morning we were greeted with a new menu and nothing more than an average 'roadside cafe' breakfast at Swine price. For the eggs Benedict...gone in the good slice of ham in favour of a cheap cut from a Tesco packet, gone the muffin for a tired piece of toast. On the big breakfast....gone the good pork beans for generic Heinz , just a couple of basic fried eggs, cheap overcooked streaky bacon....so sad, this used to be a great breakfast.

Author: ch00sen1
Title: Nice ambience
Review: The food is normal but drinks a recommendable. The ambience is nice inside outside could be noisy coz its in tigjt smack of jonker street. Their beers are the best.

Author: GracabuDelta, Canada
Title: Finger lickin' chicken!
Review: What food do you crave for on your last day while in Kuala Lumpur? ...4 Fingers Crispy Chicken, of course! That's because they ran out the night before so we made a plan to order early around 6 PM, for our last meal while staying at ALoft at KL Sentral, conveniently located at NU Sentral mall. We ordered for take out and asked the hotel for plates and silverware so we can eat in private and comfortably lick our fingers in our room! The menu for the evening was soy garlic chicken, seaweed fries, kimchee slaw and Japanese rice. We were in heaven! ...oh and make sure to order extra chicken.

Author: bettyk915Geelong, Australia
Title: Yummy laksa
Review: We went to FatCUPID for dinner. The restaurant is down a dirt road off from the main road. The menu has a mixture of western and local dishes. The laksa is amazing! The staff were extremely accommodating and made changes that we requested for our drinks (eg. adding vodka or gin to a slushy drink). A most enjoyable night out!

Author: BrunchBNNovi Sad, Serbia
Title: OK food, terrible service
Review: The food was OK, and the prices were fine, but the service was terrible.We were seated right away, and the waiter came in a minute, but when we ordered our drinks it took them a quarter of an hour to get us our beer, and then another half an hour to get 3 simple dishes which came in 10 minute intervals. Very poor service.

Author: Greg DDallas, Texas
Title: Nice food, nice ambience
Review: We have eaten at Bombay Palace many times - it is a short walk from our condo, and the food is very tasty. Our first experience was actually delivery through Room Service Deliveries (an EXCELLENT service for KL residents). I ordered lamb vindaloo, but it wasn't on the menu. "No problem, we make it for you sir." It was the best vindaloo I have had. Since then, we have always had good, sometimes great food - highly recommended.

Author: PradnyaRaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, crowded most of the times
Review: I have seen Chillies being crowded most of the times. However while i visited, the staff helped us to fetch a table within 5 minutes. We ordered Tacos, south western egg rolls and the tangy buffalo wings. The service was good and the staff was friendly as well.

Author: 483naina
Title: Top class food & service
Review: Amazing creative flavours with south indian inspiration at its best.went for the signature 11 course menu and it was seriously an amazing journey of flavours inspired from india & sri Lanka.service is amazing too with each team member putting their best in order to elevate the dining experience.Will be back soon.

Author: Raymond C
Title: Poor value, dodgy lamp chop?
Review: I had dinner on a weekday. Place wasn't crowded but the only diners seemed to be tourists. I ordered the lamp chops. Just 3 pieces mostly bone with little meat. It was way too spicy and one chop tasted funny. I think the meat was off. Overpriced even if the lamp chops came with a naan and a tiny salad. But the serving staff were very polite. I paid RM35 inclusive a Coke. But I was still hungry.Better value for dinner can be had at the food court at Pavillion Mall -most mains @ RM15-20. And its just 5 min walk away using the elevated walkway.

Author: RENERONO
Title: EXPENSIVE  AND NOTHING TO SHOUT, I DONT LIKE IT
Review: indian restaurant , food so so only, cleanliness below, cashier counter dirty staff not friendly, expensive and i dont understand why people like to go there.

Author: Lee L
Title: Very dirty!
Review: The spoon and chopsticks are not washed properly, can see stains clearly. Very doubtful on the food hygiene.

Author: ShirleyLXY
Title: First time and last time
Review: Disappointed!!!!!! This is the first time ever I gave such bad review. We reserved 3pm for hightea, arrived exactly 3pm but they were not even ready to open for business. After 5 or 10mins, they only open. Ok nvm. We waited for 30mins for our hightea that have yet serve and asked the waiter, and the waiter reply "sorry, kitchen is busy". Wait what?!?!?? This is the most stupid reason I had ever heard. Service is bad too. So, while waiting for our hightea, we go around snapping pic, selfie, wefie, blablabla. 4.15pm our hightea still not ready. So, mood spoil and angry, we demand to cancel. BUT YOU KNOW WHAT, IMMEDIATELY THEY SERVE THE HIGHTEA!!!!!!!! Reserved 3pm but 430pm only serve hightea. HAIIIYAAA What is the PURPOSE of having reservation then???? I don't know how they got so many good reviews on FB, google and even here. Thought of giving second chance for the food but again disappointed. Taste so-so only some of them are tasteless. WELL, I rather have hightea at some simple cafe than having it here. Why pay so much for bad service,bad food, and bad mood?!? "Grand HighTea" some more. Yea, first time and last time. :)

Author: markachariamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive Fish
Review: Went there with my wife for dinner tonight. We ordered prawns and fish as our main dish. As it was only my wife and I, we asked the lady for the small fish so we won't waste. The lady there suggested Soon Hock fish and not knowing much bout it, we went with her suggestion knowing that usually a fish for 2 pax cost between RM 60- RM 80. At the end of our meal, when the bill came I was SHOCKED to be asked to pay RM250 just for the fish. The lady who took our order didnt even mention that the price of fish was so expensive. She just kept mentioning the fish type so that we will order. The pricing of the fish for 2 pax is exorbitant. Its unfair to charge a customer that pricing just for a fish or she should have at least mentioned the pricing when we were ordering the fish. I wouldn't have ordered the fish if i knew how expensive it was. #nevergoingbackthereagain

Author: reshvenir
Title: Exquisite fine dining
Review: Went there for my ROM Anniversary with my husband. Honestly, the best fine dining I've had so far. The food was so good. I still can taste my lamb. It was so soft and yummy. The waiters were also super efficient and nice. Made us feel so comfortable. Hope to come back here again to try a different menu.

Author: samantha086086Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very dirty and smelly restaurant!
Review: Very dirty and smelly restaurant! Even the staff don’t look neat and clean , the guy who were taking us to our table had a huge tomato stain on his shirt like he’s a chef and a waiter??? You need to hire more staff and clean your restaurant! Not sanitary ! I don’t know about the food here I don’t imagine myself eating somewhere that stinks!

Author: 795ahmadlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Birthday Celebration
Review: Both of us came here, me & my wife.Celebrate my wife’s birthday here today at Positano Risto Publika. We love this place. The food is good, the ambiance are very welcoming & we had a very good time. Their staff’s are extremely knowledgeable and make great recommendations. We also received a complimentary cheese cake for the birthday girl & thanks to Malik, one of their staffs. I definitely recomend Positano Risto as one of the best restaurants that serves Italian food in Kuala Lumpur. Thumbs up.

Author: mburgin83
Title: Melt in the mouth steak
Review: As the title says, steak melts in the mouth. Have the rib eye and the free soup before hand is a good starter

Author: ch00sen1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super rude
Review: The staff is rude and provided wrong info We waited outside restaurant 15min before entertain. The place were full with non Malaysian so we were ignored .

Author: Matthewpsant567
Title: Good music, very expensive drinks
Review: It's a nice venue with good jazz music, though cover charge of rm53, and 3 other drink charges, which doubled the price of 4 beers to what i was originally expecting, is excessive.

Author: Pammy T
Title: Johor Bahru (JBCC) Komtar branch standard has dropped!
Review: Johor Bahru's branch has hired too many foreigners, from the cook to the waiters & waitresses. Their work attitude are poorly executed, looks dirty and lazy. When JBCC branch started their operation, food presentation and service providers were really good. As months go by, their standard of everything has dropped. Food portion got lesser and did not taste good. At one point the rice I had was not fresh and smells bad too. The supervisor did change to a new bowl of rice, but the impression I have for this restaurant will never be the same. I will never recommend anyone to visit this restaurant again.

Author: MagandranKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Ambiance (back to memory lane).
Review: We came here with a group of 40 friends and it was a buffet lunch spread. My wife I were a vegetarians and my friends were not. My friends said the food was (okay or so so only) nothing to shout about.Our vegetarian food was blend and nothing that caught our attention. But the restaurant ambiance was very good. It was like going into a museum. They had good collection of old stuffs on display and wood works dating many many moons back. However, from a restaurant point of view, this is secondary, where else the food has to the prime concern. Which none of us were impressed. I wouldn’t visit this place again. Vegetarians, this place is not for you (based on my experience). But certainly a good visit with friends from overseas, they’ll appreciate the decor and artefacts.

Author: TiniRahimSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Too Average for a Fancy Name
Review: My husband and I had the much recommended house specials; the salmon ravioli and spaghetti ala risatta, and both were SO average, I could quickly compare them to 5 other pasta places in KL with much more reasonable prices. No disrespect, but satisfaction wise, I'd rather have Milano pasta which is located in a food court. The whole experience was laughable, literally, because we really laughed at how we built up our expectation all these while, and when we finally experience it, we had that blank look on our faces. We basically telepathically said "i dont get this... do u...?" to each other

Author: smali2016Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Sunday lunch with friends
Review: The King's College London alumni association (Malaysia Chapter), in cahoots with a number of epicurean friends, organised a lunch at this restaurant, tucked away along a quiet stretch of Jalan Pudu. The ambience and decor are traditional Chinese, and the staff, friendly. The popularity of this long-established eatery was evident in the size of the crowd (apart from my fellow-alumni) filling up the restaurant by 1.PM. It doesn't have a bar, but allows guests to bring in their own drinks, and demands no corkage! As for the food, it's a smorgasbord of colours, smells, tastes and flavours. I did have a couple of regrets - if only the establishment was big enough for its clientele! And the washrooms proved to be a throwback to the 1970s, but given the quality of the fare and service, pardonable. In sum, a splendid dining experience for those willing to be squeezed in among friends and family.

Author: आनंद स
Title: Madam Kwan in Genting
Review: Came back to Malaysia for a trip to Genting and really craving for the best childhood food Nasi lemak and people recommended Madam Kwan. Worst experience ever. they served a Nasi Lemak without peanuts, fried anchovies and no “Sambal”. enough said the 3 main ingredients of nasi lemak not there. not recommended to eat nasi lemak for sure.

Author: tehaisliiiimau
Title: Hardened waffle
Review: First of all, I would say the ambience is peaceful but the food doesn't match with it especially this waffle. I may have forgotten its name but I never forget how hard it is to cut into. I was struggling with my knife to cut this piece of rock. And as we called the waiter, he simply explained that the air conditioner is the cause of the hardened waffle. Definitely would buy the ones that is selling melaka mall which cost about RM3 but still worth it

Author: basilda
Title: Lovely ambience, Food was marvelous, especially the foie gras and beef cheeks, worthy of the price paid
Review: Lovely ambience, Food was marvelous, especially the foie gras and beef cheeks, worthy of the price paid

Author: jayveller
Title: Horrendously miserable
Review: If you are up for waiting over 30 mins with food for everyone arrived at different time, this is the place for you. The staffs looked miserable. This will be the last time I visit this branch.

Author: stavrosting
Title: Not worth it...
Review: Been here at least 30 times and I had no problem at all, till my last visit.Had a short flight transit time, came here all the way by KLIA Express just wanted to have a Chinese New Year lunch before my next flight. At the entrance, I had to wait for some time before someone came out to serve me. Reserved a table in the morning & I was given a little table at the dark corner of the restaurant with the staff workstation just behind my seat with minimal space. Another guest ahead of me without reservation could get much better window seat. No one bothered preparing the table accordingly, no napkins till I realized I needed it? Other tables had them, why not this little table? With my little corner table, I hardly even get noticed by staff when I needed assistance. Gee, what's the point of paying the service charges? Probably won't be back again... I suggest you improve the customer service, especially the new (slow and a little sarcastic) restaurant manager.One exception: The friendly tea master is the only efficient staff as he's a veteran of this restaurant.

Author: billpar2015
Title: Just ok
Review:
Not bad but really nothing special despite the reviews.
Had to ask for the table to be cleaned twice. 
Had to ask twice for our drinks.
Food was okay but certainly had better

Author: nancy hKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Aus Lamb Loin Chops
Review: Problem with finding a parking space at USJ. The place was dark at 1pm in the afternoon. Empty even on a Saturday afternoon. Ordered the lamb chop which was a set lunch menu : pricy at RM33.50. The dish came with a side of wilted salad with small tomatoes. The sauce was not inspiring ( a black sourish and salty sauce served with the very thin lamb slices with bone attached on a grill. The lamb was not aromatic as no seasoning or marinade was put on it before grilling and so it did not live up to its mexican roots. I was expecting that at least they would marinade the meat before putting on the grill but i suppose that would messs up the grill. i asked for mint sauce and they gave me a teaspoon of it.. That saved the dish. In fact i would recommend that they swerve the lamb with mint sauce in future. The fresh salad was not fresh and i found foreign substance in the lettuce.

Author: Heros35Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service. Portion size satisfactory.
Review: Their service is the worst service I have ever experiences. Rude waiter/ order taker. We were served water is FILTHY glasses (and dusty too!).However food was satisfactory, although they seriously need to improve their service. If you're not concerned about service or having to drink water from filthy glasses, then by all means this is a place for you.

Author: Hua Lun L
Title: Quality not been consistent amongst all the outlet
Review:
I have dine in before at Ippudo Namba (Osaka) and Pavillion branch. 

However, the taste has not been consistent from outlet to outlet. 

The Pavillion branch taste better than this.

Author: elvtha0614Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Fine Dine Overrated!
Review: Dined in this restaurant few days ago. Firstly, the space is almost cramped. Very small restaurant. Secondly, Ordered our food. Chicken cordon bleu was ok. It was served only wit vege. No mashed potato or fries as the side dish. Spagethi scallopine was oily n the chicken thigh in it didnt taste fresh. This was our first visit to this place. Thirdly, the hotel cleaners were in the midst of vaccuming their carpets at abt 9pm. The sound pollution was bad. As the restaurant is located right next to the hotel lobby. Quite pricey for the quality of food served and the noisy environment. We asked 1 of the waitress to clean our table as some sauce dripped from the appetizer. But no effort was taken. We spent less than an hour here.

Author: tahrad2014
Title: Not impressed
Review: We had chicken curry, peppered beef and beef randang. None of them were great to be honest. I'd go elsewhere.

Author: Petar PDubrovnik, Croatia
Title: Tasteful food, great service
Review: Mews cafe is definitely best place to eat in George Town. I ate breakfast once and two times lunch in this restaurant because I was so happy with the food and service. The terrace is very nice with the surrounding trees, on each table there are roses, very relaxing atmosphere and great place to escape from sun as George Town is very hot and humid. I ate here best breakfast in whole South East Asia, croissant with eggs, ham and cheese with English Breakfast tea served in very expensive Chinese porcelain. They offer also some interesting magazines to read. For the lunch I ate some very tasty Indian meals. Each meal they served in different plate (depends how "complicated" is meal) what I found very interesting and unusual. The waiters were very friendly and professional. It is little expensive for Malaysia, but service, quality and presentation of meals were 5 star so I was happy to pay little extra.

Author: Chong1996
Title: Worst buffet I ever had in my life
Review: Rm 128 for a person but without serving juice , ice cream , sea food only serve prawn and “lala” want order a Tom yam gong and its even have to charge by menu price , what is this kind of “5 star” buffet Serve only local food exp : fried mee, veggies, mee rebus, some sashimi, sweet potato with masmello , satay , otak that’s almost all the main food they serving , I’m not joking Oh ya forgot to add , and there is nugget serving too Only two section of food station is serving, ice kacang cendol not available Trust me , if there is any negative star available, I will rate -100 star. Think twist before u wish to come here , I never leave any review online , and this really worth my time to rate “well done” Below is the photo prove that no juice serving, and the photo of the dessert part , one picture say it all

Author: Foodieshoodies
Title: Al halabi tak beli lagi
Review: Eat instant maggi kari mee 100 times better laaa. Never in my life taste nasi briyani as bad as yours. Disgusting.

Author: chriswithac17Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place to have a cold one when in jonker
Review: Beers were good, service was okay. Nice friendly crowd. It has a very cool ambiance. No complaints. Do note, if you're coming to jonker just to have a few cold ones, the traffic and parking and walking from the parking to the bar might be a hassle though. If you're already in jonker and want to have a few cold ones, this is the place.

Author: veratheexplorerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good view with ok-ok food
Review: Came here twice for their high tea and also the dinner. The place has really good view however taste of the food is ok-ok only. need to improve on the quality of food. Good place for high tea as the view is good. however the quality is ok only. love the artistic side of the high tea set. For their buffet dinner, we enjoyed the BBQ session where you can choose barbeque tenderloin, sausages on the spot. other than that, the food is meh

Author: Yuki Y
Title: good food , good ambiance for Chinese fine dining
Review: They use only premium ingredients ,adapting traditional Cantonese cooking methods. I especially recommend their Fresh Water Prawn with Noodles and Home-made Pork Ribs which are cooked to perfection and really nice! Really a great place for business meeting because they have VIP rooms.

Author: Mandeep68
Title: Delicious ribs
Review:
Delicious ribs. Hearty serving size. Decor is basic functional.
Nice place for a cozy family dinner.
Value for money.
Mushroom and tomato soup were also good. Toasted bread can be improved.

Author: efim2018Montreal, Canada
Title: Not so tasty food
Review: The service was great! However the portions are kind of weird and they use to much oil. I wouldn't recommend you to go there , 5' and there is the walking street where you can eat nice street food. Unless you wanna pay with card.

Author: Graham BEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Belgian name, certainly not belgian poured
Review: I stopped by for a drink having craved some good beers whilst on holiday. Went for a pint of leffe only to be graced with a beer that failed to be poured to the line by a good centimetre. Having told the waitress this, I was told the head is also beer. Well! She then took the pint and waited, presumably to prove that once the head is gone the beer will be level.... it was still below the line and now lacking a head.I continued to stare in astonishment whilst she kept me waiting further.She then poured me some more, still not to the line just to spite me, and also without any head whatsoever.I drank my 'spite' pint and left. An insignificant request overblown.

Author: AmirahAiniM
Title: An "okay" dinner
Review: Salted egg butter prawn and creamy basil chicken taste good. Golden pomfret taste so so only. Fast service by the crew. Price is reasonable.

Author: GGlen78Viborg, Denmark
Title: Good food - shame about the lack of pork
Review: We ordered pizza with salami and bucatini amitriciana. The salami used was beef and the bacon used in the pasta was duck. I was not impressed by the explanation- that it was difficult to obtain a license to serve non-halal food. I don'tbeleive that this is true. If you want to serve Italian- you need to be able to serve pork. It's like trying to seve Moroccan food without being able to seve lamb or mutton.

Author: Keano4896
Title: Good quality of food
Review: Well known restaurant with few outlets in KL and one in SG. Even with the expansion quality of food are well maintained. Good customer service  even though visited in peak hour and month. Must try the teh tarik and nasi lemak. Will definitely visit again!

Author: Blee79singapore
Title: Good after office hours drinks & dinner
Review: Nice place,great ambience and atmosphere.good range of alcohol and variety of food.food quality is good and consistent (mutton varuval thumbs up).great for Friday happy hours and simple dinner.can get noisy at times bcos of the good crowd so might not be suitable for business meetings.popular with working professionals in the evenings.good place overall but much improvement needed with staff-possibly understaffed but takes along time to get your orders

Author: LEE_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Above Average Dim Sum with some tasty items
Review: While this cannot match the higher end dim sums in major restaurants, I think the quality is excellent for a neighborhood joint. For those in need of a dim sum fix, this place will satisfy. Some dishes are better than others. I liked the char siew pow (pork bun) because of the soft bun. The sweet items like the sesame ball and egg tarts are also excellent. The glutinous rice chicken is good with one exception - they put a big piece of chicken with bone that crowds out the rice (too big a piece)! Service is ok but parking is hell - most will double park and sit outside to keep an eye on their car!
Restaurant: Restoran Jin Xuan Hong Kong "Kuchai Lama"

Author: chris a
Title: AQUA Pool Side Restaurant Great Food Best Service in KL
Review: I spent most of the four days that I stayed at the Mandarin Oriental at the pool side and dinned on several occasions at the AQUA restaurant. The service and staff in my experience was nothing less than exceptional; outstanding, friendly unassuming efficient and delightful. The service was unrelenting, staff were constantly changing ice water and cleaning empty tables and always anticipating what you were about to ask for. Great food, great service and great team work. Highly recommended!

Author: adelineysi
Title: Good Food but BAD service - Tropiciana City Mall Branch
Review: Food is good, but it's been offset by the poor service!!Read the comments posted previously. It's very true and I've been through it.Went with one of my cousin, we happily ordered quite a few food and drinks. When all the food served, we realised that the table for 2 pax doesnt fit, and become too small. Therefore, we requested to have a 4 pax table. Considering that the crowd in the restaurant is not big, we guess it should be alright, and we make a request to through the waitress. However, the waitress came back and said, "management doesnt allowed 2 pax to take table of 4!"It really disappointed! We have to squeeze all our food within the small table. Really can't understand why their management have such thinking? Does the owner of the restaurant really read the reviews?

Author: FaizulRuslanSegamat, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: I'm very pleased with my stay at the hotel..good receptionist (Sharon) where she offer me room upgrade and treat me warmly at the check in counter. Very honest staff when my daughter lost her bag and when i realised after that, quickly i went to the lobby asked whether they found any bag left at the sofa, the staff in charge told me they have kept it. Thank God. Definitely i will come back again and comparing to my previous stay at Mandarin Oriental there's a lot difference here especially variety of buffet breakfast, room, good customer service and it feels really like home . I will strongly promote and recommend Impiana KLCC to all my friends, family and colleagues if they're planning to stay in KL.

Title: No vegan options
Review: I tried to eat at this restaurant because trip advisor said there were vegan options. There was nothing that could be veganized except toast. I had to leave and go elsewhere.

Author: Peterjames0Stockport, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location but a rip off
Review: Thought the set up was pretty good but £6 for a pint of beer is taking the p***. I can understand that it is a prime location but let's be honest we are not talking Kings Road, Chelsea rates.Wouldn't go back

Author: EK T
Title: What's to complain about..
Review:
Butterfish F&C : Good - although the batter and the chips can be a bit crispier.
Sunday Roast : Good 

Amazing note : Happy Hour 10pm-3am. Only at Chippy.

Author: EvenJoHelsinki, Finland
Title: Couldn't take more than a few bites
Review: I'm afraid there is nothing positive to say about the dish I got at this restaurant. I ordered pesto pasta, and received something that looked like dog vomit and had absolutely no taste. My friend had the same experience with the ravioli. Hopefully they'll improve, because the interior was nice.

Author: tracyh3003
Title: Enjoyable visit
Review: The food is very nice, the staff very welcoming and the views if you're lucky enough to get a window seat, as I did, are just wonderful.

Author: tanpeipei
Title: Cosy view and great place!
Review: A cosy and relaxing place filled with lush greenery set against the backdrop of quaint houses dated back to the 17th century.  Great food served here.

Author: CalcifierMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cool Indoor Space Too~
Review: I went for breakfast with a few of my friends. Didn't get to sit by the riverside though, however the indoor space is also a great place for friends gathering since its quiet and have a typical Melaka rustic design.The weekday English breakfast sets are simple, affordable and gives a home-made feel.

Author: sakthin
Title: A special occasion
Review: I was there for my husband's birthday. It was the weekend brunch.The staffs in Prego made sure there was plenty of food and drinks around.

Author: sunlover2705Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Satisfying dinner!
Review: I knew about this place when I was back in Ipoh for a good friends wedding reception last year. So this time, I took a business associate there for a casual dinner. It didn't disappoint! He had the prime steak while I opted for the salmon with linguine. As I didn't want the salmon too well done as is the case here often in Asia, I told them I wanted it medium. Well I had to send it back as it was raw in the middle but alls good after that. The prime rib was good too. Finished our mains with no other complaints and ended the dinner with a fab bombe Alaska which we shared. Good food, great ambiance, nice Malbec red... Definitely be back here again for the food mostly!

Author: LorenzoC3090
Title: Serious no
Review: The service is horrible with overpriced food. The taste isn’t that good either. A serious no to this place.

Author: 909shaimaah
Title: worst service ever
Review: we ordered the stake as medium done and they made it medium rare when we asked to change they brought the stake totally burnt and we waited for nearly an hour ending up cancelling the order

Author: Kayhoinc
Title: spanish pork tapas
Review: For friday and sat night its better to call and make a reservation as its always packed. We love the cold cuts here.

Author: Safieyra S
Title: Wonderful service
Review: This is wonderful when I eat lunch few days before..Fauzi and ashlaily good suggestions food and perfection service also nice drink shahrizal make it..thank you everyone

Author: Khairun N
Title: High tea
Review:
The food selection was ok and the price was reasonable. Crowd is better during weekdays.
Staffs were ok.

Author: BustaniaParis, France
Title: Enjoy the bar more than the restaurant..
Review: The Junk is a beautiful place, decoration and vibes are great. However compare to the price you'll pay: the service is not especially friendly or helpful and I came here twice, I've been disappointed by the food twice ... They should precise a little bit the recipe so we don't have surprise when we receive our meals.(For example I took a roasted chicken I asked for the recipe they just told me "it's serve with mashed potatoes", first they give me chicken wings whereas I didn't order that and when they finally give me the right meal it was all covered with sweet tomato sauce.. If I knew I wouldn't have take this..!)And sorry but the cake dessert are not good... Go there for the drinks!!

Author: William M
Title: Closed on Saturday 26th Jan 2019
Review: Went there 7pm as advertised opening hours, waited till 7:30pm and still closed. Tried to ring no answer.. so have they closed shop for good or temporary?

Author: Robert TAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Not As expected
Review: There are very very few bars that class themselves as high end as this one that allow smoking. If you want clean air then any of the bars in the neighboring KLCC malls are better. The web site contains severe strictures with regard to dress code - fear not we were smart casual and felt overdressed next to the t-shirted clientele. Many better in KL.
Restaurant: MO Bar at Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur

Author: jasree
Title: Good
Review: we had our lunch here, variety of local foods and taste good, located behind petron station, reasonable price and pack during lunch time.

Author: Raymond DSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Yummy Ipoh Dim Sum
Review: Ipoh City, known for its Dim Sum so we decided to give it a try as we were down for a food road trip to Ipoh. Arrived early around 6am and it was already crowded! Manage to get a table but we had to share with another group as we were 4 of us only and the table was quite big thou . Good variety of Dim sum and the taste was delicious too. Service is slow and i suggest you grab as much you can once you get hold of the waitress as she will take some time to make a round back or to get their attention. Worth the visit and will definitely return.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Stein_TrondheimTrondheim, Norway
Title: Overestimated and overrated
Review: We, a family of 4, had high expectations when we decided to visit a presumably good restaurant. The staff was friendly. But how we were disappointed about the food. A greasy, oily serving of two beef steaks (lamb tenderloin) and rather tasteless pasta, the whole presentation looked uninviting. Also the vegetables were a big disappointment. The red house wine was ok, though.Dissatisfied, leaving most of the food we went to eat at an Indian restaurant nearby.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: BigTravellerAJC66
Title: Service was great, food just ok
Review: We came here to La Bodega as a business group after work for drinks and some foods. The service staff were great but the quality of the food was not what we’d have expected. Trying to get adequately chilled beers was a problem too

Author: Llleen
Title: Absolutely horrible service and food!
Review: I've never been to a restaurant where the service was so horribly inefficient. None in my group got our drinks or food without having to ask for it several times from the waiters/waitresses. And they weren't even apologetic about it! We had to wait for almost an hour for our food and see other customers who came AFTER us finish their meals. And everytime we asked a waiter for our food, it seemed like they didn't even know what was going on. The food, when it came, was not good. My friend's pad thai was tasteless whilst the sauce for my nasi kerabu was so salty, I had to settle for just eating my rice plain. The portions are also minuscule, although given the taste, that might be a blessing in disguise. Overall, one of my worst experiences. No more. Never recommending.

Author: AnnMarieS117
Title: Great service
Review: Came alone for an indulgent lunch - Gastro is reasonably priced with promotions on Eatigo. Staff is friendly and attentive, food was good. Ambience was peaceful and chill.

Author: drKinghKlang, Malaysia
Title: Dinner for two
Review: My wife and wife went to zinc for dinner. Initial impression was good. The restaurant serves western food.For main meal we ordered squid black ink paella. What to say, the dish was so salty, the paella dish looked more like a dish of risotto. The two prawns placed on top of the rice were not fresh at all.Not going there again.

Author: 579caroloSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth it
Review: We came here on the 1st day of the new year. It was meant for a celebration but it turned out to be a disappointment. The price does not justify the quality of food. It’s a 4 course meal that consist of soup, salad, main course and dessert with a complimentary plastic cup of house wine. The potion of the meal is normal. But the taste of the food is way below average. Furthermore, the so called house wine is terrible. We informed the waitress that the wine has a weird taste but the Chef mentioned that it’s meant to be like that. I’m sure that wine is expired or something.. the wine totally ruin the steak. The steak is just average. Not worth it. Highly not recommended.

Author: jzzy649
Title: Tasty and delicious
Review:
Our family enjoyed a special lunch at this restaurant. The food was delicious and well executed. 
My kids enjoyed the meal too.

Author: WhitebonitaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Location is beautiful
Review: It was special location where cannot find any other place like here.However service is not really up to level yet.Regarding customer service need to improve a lot.Especially staff need to train more ....a bit disappointed for it.

Author: worldtravellerLDN
Title: live ants in our soup
Review:
Nice view, well located. We had crawling ants in one of our dishes. They swiftly replaced it. 
The other dishes were average.

Author: 203pawelbBraintree, United Kingdom
Title: Great selection
Review: Located on the ground floor of Suria KLCC mall, right next to the escalator near the main entry.Great selection of freshly made juices offered in many tasty (interestingly named) variations. Perfect spot to grab a juice on the go. Quick, friendly service and lots of fresh fruits it's all you need. Average prices like for KL.

Author: arksgfoodie
Title: Restaurant appears to be closed
Review: Visited on Thursday 8 Jan. The restaurant name was there but the restaurant was chained up. The Bangla guard said the restaurant was closed and appeared to mean permanently. It's a pity as we have been there before and the food wad excellent

Author: maxwong89Miri, Malaysia
Title: Bad service and lousy food
Review: Waited for an hour for food , only one food arrived and it’s cold , canceled the rest of the orders , no apologise , everything is so slow even for payments , don’t come to this place unless u just want to have a drink

Author: Mukesh70
Title: Variety of Indian food
Review:
You can enjoy Indian vegetarian and non-vegetarian food here. For vegetarian, Choley masala or Bhindi is very good option. For non-veg, chicken biryani is excellent.
Situated in the heart of the city. It can be tried while in Miri.

Author: 438jessl
Title: Great Enjoy with Dearest Frns
Review: Having our good time here with buddies.  Do experience our first time fine dinning dinner gathering here with great environment.

Author: 1Javi1987Valencia, Spain
Title: Good food, terrible service
Review: We've been here a couple of times because we loves the burguers. In our last visit,it was a friday night, we ask for the pint beer combo, the waiter tell us that they dont have Carslbeer beer...really?Friday night and you dont have beer???I really dont know if they dont have beer or they just want to sell us the expensive one, anyway, i tried to talk with the manager but he didnt make nothing for try to solve the problem, instead of this, he sent another waiter to our table. NIce staff, nice burger, terrible manager!!

Author: PatrickSebIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Nice simple place
Review: On a trip to attend a conference and took a break to walk around Kuching town. On a hot day this place is a welcome place to stop for a nice cool drink in the afternoon. Had the three layer tea which was super nice. For those wanting noodles or other types of food available but I cannot comment on that as was not my type food that late in the day. Bought some fried bananas from across the street which was super nice and went well with the three layered tea...

Author: petite_rainbowMelbourne, Australia
Title: Too busy perhaps?
Review: Came to this restaurant for late lunch as it was already 2.30pm. I was glad the queue is no longer there but I can see the restaurant is still full of customer though not packed. One of the service staff saw me at the entrance and she waved at me to a table inside. Once seated, was given menu. After scrutinizing the menu for my choice of food, I tried to get the attention of the service staff. Alas, they ignored me. One or two walked by carrying dishes, saw me and walked on. I saw one standing near the counter, but looking elsewhere. After feeling neglected for 15 minutes, I stood up and left. They didn't even know I existed.

Author: alisonparkes
Title: Lovely atmosphere, good food, reasonably priced
Review: A must while in penang. Good food great atmosphere and well priced. A must visit when in Penang.  Try the Spring rolls and satay

Author: wirewalking
Title: Beuaty doesn't tell the taste
Review: So i went to this place a beautiful location very well kept and a proper interior. I was very excited for the food, like what could go wrong? So we ordered a biryani, and a side dish. Now the thing is, it didn't taste like a biryani. It felt like the things very just put together and served. As biryani is supposed to be cooked a curry separate and rice separate then mixed. I felt here the rice was made and then chicken was put later.Therefore the curry doesn't have the water and fat of the chicken. It was just okay like biryani everywhere in JB. The price was high for no particular purpose i would say. It was just okay. Not recommended for people who actually know how indian biryani is tasted like.

Author: shirshirrKuching, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Restaurant!! Ohhhh hhhhaaaa!!!
Review: I love this Restaurant. They serving local food, dayak cuisine. Even it little bit expensive, but awesome. They keep the dayak cuisine alive. Relaxing Sape music make it beautiful. AWESOME!!!!!! Once you test the borneo cuisine, you never forget it.. Honestly, the spirit of Orang Ulu will bring you here again.

Author: KesterO
Title: Always great
Review:
During our visit to K L we visited Prego twice with friends they loved it also .
It is consistently good .
Terrific pizza , truffle mushroom soup , scallops , rissoto .
Plenty of wines to choose from including some New Zealand .

Author: sasa_frewellim
Title: WE GOT KICKED OUT OF OUR TABLE!!
Review: We were kicked out of our table. The reason given was the table was reserved after 11pm. But, we were not informed that the table was reserved when we sat. They offered us another table without seats (we had to stand), outside without air conditioning. The are few issues here:(1) If the reservation had been made, they should inform us that after 11pm the table that we sat will no longer be available.(2) Reservations were not managed properly. Pisco accepted the reservation regardless whether there was any available table.(3) Pisco prioritized customer who made reservation than walk-in customer, which did not make any sense. Since Pisco prioritized other customers and kicked us out like we were not worthy customers, then we shall treat Pisco the same way. We are NOT going back to Pisco.

Author: gloandbobLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Can 50 TA reviewers be so wrong, or were we incredibly unlucky
Review: We tried this restaurant in anticipation following the reviews in TA but were bitterly disappointed.Perhaps our Aussie friends fit the bill here better, because everyone else (it has about 10 tables) seemed to be from the other side of the world to us, and all seemed to be enjoying themsleves.Starters - calamari/spring rolls. Former rubbery, latter pretty good - mind you I can make decent spring rolls!Main course - before we got it the waitress brought it out and tried to give it to about half the tables, before realising it was ours. My wife's chicken dish was ok, other than the overpowering sauce. I had beef with black pepper sauce. There was so much sauce, it was dripping over the dish, and I thought I was home having my Sunday lunch as there seemed to be a strong taste of Bisto gravy! I left most of it.There was no "did you not like your meal"? Our plates were taken away, we would not have had sweet, more drinks or coffee, but we were not given the chance as the bill arrived. Fortunately it came to a nice round sum, which I deposited on the table and we left. No "goodnight" from the staff.There are much better options in Batu Ferringhi

Author: gracep1572
Title: Late night supper
Review:
Overall good experience 
Order 1 ikan pari set, 1 ikan kembong set and one telur ikan plus 3 drinks less than RM50..
Nice asam pedas

Author: YouliHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very rich food and average service
Review: I visited Mdm Kwan’s at Mid-valley mall in Jan 2018 on a Sat evening together with my Sister. We ordered the Nasi Lemak, the Curry noodles and 2 Hot Lemon Honey drinks. We stayed in the restaurant for around an hour. Food: Food was good - very rich in flavours. However, the food was not as hot as I would like it to be. The hot drink was surprisingly good with a generous amount of honey and lemon. Service: Service is ok but not great. Table was dripping wet when we sat down and eventually some water droplets dropped off the table on our clothes. Cutlery were not clean and we had to request for a new set. -_-‘’’ Staff could be more attentive. Price: We paid around 60 RM for our meal for 2 people (2 mains, 2 drinks). Quite reasonable for the food. Overall: the food is good for a regular Malaysian meal but not outstanding. Prob a good place to go to try some local fare.

Author: drimmieusSingapore, Singapore
Title: Total dissapointment
Review: Came here alone and ask for their recommendation as I just wanted to have 1 dish. They were happy to recommend their signature Char Siew. Was served the char siew and I couldn't finish the whole dish as i had a tough time chewing it...sigh! Highlighted to them that their signature Char Siew is too tough to be chewed and all they did was apologize...that's all.

Author: Myca SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service, good food
Review: My friend was visiting KL and I thought it would be a great chance to revisit Quivo since the last time I was here, it was a couple of years ago. I was happy to see that the quality of the food was still pretty consistent. I ordered the Philly cheesesteak sandwich and my friend ordered the mushroom risotto, both of which were very tasty. I also had the Gin Swizzler, which was not bad, but the highlight was definitely the food. The service is also exceptional. I would definitely come here again!

Author: AnBu67Hua Hin, Thailand
Title: billing is questionable
Review: I have to say, after reading all the comments here I thought lets just try out the place and see whats happen. Food was good but not outstanding. A menu surely would be of advantage since not all guests are knowledgable on how and what to do with the seafood and the staff was also not really helpful since they also didn't,t really know what the cooks can do in the kitchen nor didn't they know what ingredients are available in the kitchen. Food was served very quickly and service was friendly and attentive.Now, the billing. I find it almost rude that the braised peanuts and the pickled papaya were on my bill since it was just put on the table without any explanation. The red snapper that we ordered, only half came (the underlining fillet was removed). It was impossible for me to verify what was billed since the attached bills where written in Chinese. The bill was 281.45 for 2 people only, which seems quite high and I know the explanation will be again the high cost of maintaining live seafood. I guess it just explains why many of your guests question your prizing and your billing. I have tried your food and even if the billing wouldn't be so questionable I would go back a second time. There are other places to discover that are for sure way more reasonable and also closer to town

Author: 765firasa
Title: OMG
Review: Something outstanding , really one of the best things u have to visit , warm place with nice atmosphere .

Author: scotskinnerAdelaide, Australia
Title: Pretty Good - One Glitch.
Review: OK - so here's the deal - this is top shelf stuff. Great view if you get the right side. The food is very good - esp. the seafood. The deserts are very good also and the Bombe Alaska, flambe at table is good stuff. Downside - ordered a single malt - 45mins before it arrived " ... out of stocks had to go and get it." Would have been prudent to ask me to select another - easy chose as the menu is vastNo cheap but then again the food is very good. Service is overall - pretty good.

Author: JuneChewww
Title: Excellent !
Review: Great environment, food is good and the service is excellent ! The staffs here are very friendly and helpful, will definitely visit again ! :)

Author: emilioeats
Title: Great food & ambience, despite unhelpful and disingenuous server.
Review: We arrived promptly for our 8pm dinner reservation at Kebaya Dining Room, located within Seven Terraces Hotel--the courtyard of this hotel (adjacent to the dining room) occupies the terraces of seven colonial-style shophouses. Upon entering, we noticed the heritage-forward interior and ambience, which we thoroughly enjoyed throughout our whole evening there. Whilst searching around for the maître d', another party of guests entered and also waited to be seated. A middle-aged lady with short hair finally appeared to greet the guests that came after us and we notified her that we also had a reservation for the 8pm seating. Her attitude towards our letting her know we were also ready to be seated was cold and dismissive. She eventually ushered our party and the next to our respective tables and handed us the menus. When we asked her on the menu items and prix fixe structure, she was ill-tempered when we asked for further clarification and recommendations on how the 6 of us could best order the dishes for each course. Due to her obvious irritated state, we asked her to help us choose our courses so that we could try the greatest variety in each category, noting that we were interested in the pork dishes.To our surprise, when the dishes came, no pork dishes appeared, and for the 6 main courses (for each person) we were obliged to order (out of 5 main courses available), she omitted the pork dish, and without consulting us beforehand, doubled the portions for the vegetable tempura and prawn curry (that was combined into one small pot with just an additional helping of prawns). The other four dishes (which she could just as much have doubled) seemed more worth our while and preferable as the options included a leg of lamb, beef steak, chicken curry and (the missing) pork. As the menu is prix fixe for each diner, we didn't feel like having two portions of vegetable tempura gave us our money's worth.The Nyonya cuisine we experienced at Kebaya tasted good, but was overshadowed by the waitress's poor service and misleading suggestions. We felt that she could have been more hospitable and less sly in helping us order our meal.

Author: Fiona M
Title: Chinese Food Heaven
Review: High end Chinese style food with various dishes that you don't find everywhere.  Lovely ambiance in the restaurant, good service.

Author: Travel555962Sydney, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: The cafe/restaurant attached to Muntri Mews does really good food and its courtyard setting slightly off Muntri Street means you can watch the world walk by. Staff are friendly and helpful, making solo dinners feel comfortable, not giving you the hustle to move on for bigger groups. Menu doesn’t look vegetarian friendly but ask the staff - the cook is happy to adapt much of what is there. Delicious vegetarian Helen’s Curry Mee one night and vegetarian laksa on a return visit.

Author: josslerUK
Title: We returned 3 out of 4 dishes,
Review: We returned 3 out of 4 dishes, because there was a long black hair in the risotto & pieces of pan scouring brush in the carbonara.We had a shocking experience here last year, but returned at the invitation of the manager & had a v good experience.But this last (and it will be the last time) visit was quite disgusting. The kitchen is clearly a dirty & poorly controlled environment.

Author: angelinesaw
Title: Over rated restaurant and not worth the second visit
Review: The soup is almost dry . The other country le petit serve lobster and our menu said is big prawn but what we are getting is only small prawn and it is over cook .

Author: raidzwanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: BAD QUALITY OF COFFEE!!! NO Star Deserves!!!
Review: Dear Sky Deli/The Shore Melaka,I like to comment on your so called 'fresh Brew' coffee cappuccino.The chronology:-At 9.25pm, me with 4 of my friends enter our restaurant and greet nicely by our staff.-On that time, I ask if the restaurant is available for eating and was replied that the food order already close and only available for drinks only.-We agreed and was invited to have a drink, so we order the 5 drinks and 2 cakes for this time.-Wait patients about a 20minute which is we still ok and no complaint due to this is the normal waiting time.-Once the all order reach, we were served by below 50°C of HOT cappuccino.-For your information, the standard milk temperature to froth is 55°-65° C and Max of 70°C.-And for your information there is no any coffee powder should be on your coffee since its a fresh brew with the coffee machine. Either your coffee machine is broken or your barista is not a trained person to make a coffee.-I was served by waiter name Mr.Ariffin from beginning till the bill is settled.And I would like to inform this type of service and quality of food/drink totally ruin your restaurant standard.After this, I will not hesitate to review in others platform or social media. Attached here all photo and video for your review.From The coffee lover and your disappointed customer.holiday and you ruin my relaxing weekend.Already 5days email sent to your team privately,but no response,its example of bad customers relationship.

Author: nObOdY007
Title: Great Coffee; Great Place
Review: I Love This Place Because Of The Lavazza Coffee. Staffs Are Attentive And Foods Are Yummy. Location is Great. Easy To Go and Have Many Selective Menus

Author: P1103OngKuala Lumpur
Title: Experienced Good & Bad Service in 1 time
Review: Me and my friends did a little gathering at this restaurant before this new year. Is great of the environment, food and service but there is some bad too.Pros:- Food is nice with the nice cooked & delicious porkkk (O.o Pork Lover) - Should try with the burger- Service of Staffs are great when I request for a cake for celebrate my friend's birthday. (But it is just the start, there is a very big shock with the different of service just right below)- Just as others (Ben's/Plan B etc), is a very nice location for hang out.Bads:- Can't make any reservation if you have more than 10 pax and they are not allowed to go in the restaurant even. Limited place for reunion/gathering- If you are with a group, they will mostly put you at the tables outside, it is great when it is windy but totally not fun when it's rain. If you don't want to get wet, ask for seats inside.- When we have just ask for the bill, it came with a sudden rain (very heavy rain) and we decided to stay for more little while. However, when we ask for changing seat inside restaurant the staffs changed their friendly face to a "shu-shu go away" face immediately which really make me SHOCK!!!

Author: Manonfire51Santa Fe, New Mexico
Title: Disappointing
Review: This had to be the worst mexican food I have eaten overseas. Your dishes were greasy, tasteless sauces, pico was the color green only. (Bad)I have to say your corn toritilas were great but you don't use them wisely.You need to send the Manager and so called cook to train in New Mexico USA in order to call your restaurant Mexican. To say the least don't waste you time and money on thus establishment. Man On Fire USA

Author: Christina HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing authentic French food!
Review: We ordered delivery during lockdown of moules frites, vegetarian platter, apple pie and Leffes Blonde beers - it was like I had stumbled into a memory of a French holiday! Amazing service, incredible food and range, authentic European cuisine. Thank you! We will definitely order again.

Author: lucyleekBangkok, Thailand
Title: Great Valentine's Day brunch
Review: We went for the Moët option and had a great brunch. We always worry that being vegetarian might spoil our experience of buffets but the staff were great and we were offered plenty of tasty pizza, pasta, risotto to try. The ice cream was delicious - possibly the highlight. Very expensive for us compared to other similar options around, (I imagine looking at what was on offer excellent value if you had less specific dietary requirements) but we had a great time.

Author: VinodhsomBengaluru, India
Title: Good Food... but limited choices
Review: Been to Olive tree - probably the choice for most travel agents to take the guests... we reached early and escaped the crowd... Food spread was quite limited but overall had a good dinner. Ambience is quite good. Service Staff on that day was fairly good - but one could see many staff with that easy-going attitude and busy chit-chatting on the floor...

Author: eskay1103
Title: Easily the worst restaurant of Kuching
Review: Great Setting but pathetic quality and food and even worse service. Extremely rude staff . Food order was delivered in 90 minutes and they were OK if we wished to leave due to the delay !!!

Author: jameskenglimSingapore
Title: Shame. Not doing justice to the original Madam Kwan
Review: I ordered the Nasi Lemak Bojari and originally wanted the Banana Fritters with Ice cream which was sold out, so had to settle for Cendol.In the end, it wouldn't have made any difference. Sadly, I have to report that both were uninspiring. Nothing like what it was when the business first started.To make matters worse, the staff weren't very attentive either. You could keep your hand up, and wave them around like a lunatic, but they seem to have this superhuman power not to see a distressed hand in need of some assistance.A real shame indeed.

Author: ditchnapperLuang Prabang, Laos
Title: Poor service
Review: I have visited a couple of times for lunch and drinks. The food is ok, nothing special. The service at the bar is terrible. When I have visited there is a single bar tender on duty, even at happy hour, who cannot possibly keep up. I watched him cutting fruit for sangria - one....slow....slice ...... at .....a..... time while people were waiting to order drinks. It was painful to watch and experience. I gave up trying to order any mixed drinks because of the delays involved. I dont really understand because staff are friendly and there are lots of them walking around and smiling, but they just cant seem to figure out how to make and serve drink efficiently.

Author: Assalovefood
Title: Overrated
Review: Don’t be tricked by the review. The food is overpriced and unseasoned , we had to add salt for some flavour and the worst part is the staff serving us was very inpatient in taking orders and also rushing to clean our tables even before we finish our coffee.

Author: adriadchooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Parking Issue
Review: I wanted to bring my family here for a meal and also to buy wardrobe. Unfortunately parking is closed and we were redirected to MyTown parking, all the way to rooftop. I came back down and told the security I cant park at MyTown because I have some furniture to buy and its not convenient to me. My request got ignored so I decided to leave. I would not want to come to either Ikea Cheras or MyTown anymore.

Author: EcoWarriorSalisbury, United Kingdom
Title: Sorry to say, a little bit overrated
Review: We went here for dinner with our Intrepid group and had high expectations. However although the service was good, the food was slightly mediocre and therefore seemed slightly expensive compared to other food in Malaysia. We also went to the jazz night the next evening, and that was good - talented musician.

Author: MaxManilaManila, Philippines
Title: Good food at Paya Serai
Review: I had late lunch here on one of the days I was billeted in Hilton PJ. This is one of their signature restaurants located at the ground floor.Ordered nasi goreng kampung and a soda. The dish is Malay style fried rice with king prawns, chicken wings and satay. It was served with fish crackers and fried egg. Very good meal indeed. Tasty, cooked just right, especially the prawns. Meal is quite filling due to the size of the dish. Waiters were quite responsive to the requests of our group.Serving lead time though can be improved, as it took a really long time for the meal to be served. Perhaps, it was freshly cooked, but customer shouldn't be made to wait for more than 15 minutes for nasi goreng.Overall, it is worth a revisit.

Author: frankiea124
Title: Average buffet
Review: The view is amazing because you can see Kuala Lumpur city center from up here. The buffet has limited choice but the price is very expensive.

Author: rithlaksi
Title: Standard noodle restaurant
Review: The noodle soup dish is ok. It is not bad and not too good as well. Sweet&sour soup is good. The service is ok.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: Ferbie18
Title: nice ambience
Review: the decor is nice and you get to see the KLCC busy street. dim sum is average taste and it cost more too. i just go here to chill with my girlfriends

Author: R9708YCchriswTorquay, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, wonderful service, delicious food.
Review: We have stayed at The Danna previously but unfortunately did not get the opportunity to dine in Planters Restaurant. On this occasion we booked asking for a table outside, which in itself was just perfect. The location can only be described as stunning, the staff are very attentive but also allow you space to enjoy the experience. The food was cooked to perfection and served with style. As a couple we are used to fine dining and often frequent Michelin star restaurants. We add this only to put into context that dining in Planters Restaurant is as good as it gets. We will book to eat again in this beautiful place before we leave.

Author: KimMengMalaysia
Title: Most Pleasant Surprice
Review: I've lived in KL for years and walked past this place. Finally visited last week - what a find!! Wonderful ambience and service and the food was actually really good. The tapas was outstanding (check out the stuffed peppers) and the air-flown Spanish beef was marvellous. I will definitely visit again.

Author: JimmyY_13Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Live band music and drinks
Review: We visit the barn mainly for the live band music and the ambience. They do have happy hour for drinks. They do serve finger food and goes well with drinks. It is at an uptown and trendy venue so the prices is above average. Live music has always been good and we have visited the place when ever I visit KL. The traffic at Bukit Bintang can be busy so nearby is the monorail and MRT and take about 10mins walk.

Author: WenRenL
Title: Delicious, not so salty food
Review: It's a place good for dinner with families. If you like local Sarawakian food, you can try 'Money Chai with egg' , Midin with Red Wine, Chicken Pansuh(Bamboo Chicken) and others(some dishes are originally from Sarawak, and some others are not from Sarawak).

Author: Sara YThailand
Title: Yummy cheesy naany treat
Review: Lovely little spot. Huge fan of naan bread - try the cheesy naan and sauce if you're after a treat. The staff are friendly. I also tried a curry (on a separate night as everything is very filling!) and that was lovely too. Just don't go in a rush ... they don't have all the food pre made sat in the back with flies landing on it. So it might be a bit of a wait but you'll appreciate it when your food comes! Have an ice te tarik drink too. Traditional drink - can sometimes be too sweet but here they get the balance just right. Enjoy!

Author: stuarts1948Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: This is no 'Rendez Vous' reborne in any way.
Review: We went to try out this place because we had really enjoyed "Rendez Vous" and always had a good experience there. At "Chez Gaston", the experience was much different.The entrance to the premises is dirty and dangerous down some stairs. The ambience inside is lacking. It is very hot and the seating for couples is rather tight. Service was slow and it is quite apparent that the staff did not know what to do. We ordered a starter each but both were served to my wife. I took mine which was escargots but was given a knife and fork to eat them with! The escargots were very bland and obviously not much was done to them after they came out of the can. I had boudin which was just one sausage on a plate with some apple. My wife had a salad and then a fish course. Shared dishes were served with no serving spoons. We finished our mains just wanting to get out of the place. The place is not 'fine dining' but has 'fine d dining' prices. I spent over RM 300 to experience this in a hot and humid location. Not much value!

Author: ivonnaxAsiain, Spain
Title: Chendol was okay.
Review: For cold dessert, go to the counter on the right side and order directly (self-service). A bowl of chendol is 4MYR. Pay directly to gentleman behind the counter.For food, we tried Char Siew rice (roasted pork rice) - taste is forgettableYong Tau Fu noodle - the noodle is very average, the Yong Tau Fu is okay.Bak Chor Mee (Minced meat noodles) - taste forgettableFried dumplings - good, but pricey (5 for 6MYR).Menu is available at the food counter, take the order chit and fill it up with foods that you would like to buy. Hand the order chit to lady behind the counter. Pay when food arrive at your table.Plenty of room in a spacious old colonial house.Maybe will go back again jus for dessert

Author: François S
Title: Kudos for location, cuisine, chef and staff
Review: Superb lunch and dinig experience in this over the water, luxury restaurant.Food is creative e.g. vacuum, low temperature cooking of fish or meat - and delicious. Staff is professional and pleasant. The view on the surrounding bay and islands is simply paridise. As expected, not really cheap but quite an experience.

Author: MyMatahari
Title: Ok for a quick stop
Review: Malaysian delicacies in a mall. That is what it is. Service was ok. Drinks were too sweet and sugary. That overpowered the taste. My friend had the nasi lemak. Curry was tasty and I had the Hokkien noodle dish.

Author: AbdullahAltamimi
Title: Chili's is Chili's
Review: Great as usual. still one of my favorite restaurants. For Great Appetizers always chili's is the place.

Author: Joanna O
Title: Very good!
Review: Tasty and cheap Indian restaurant, we order Chicken cashew with naan, can recommend to anyone in Batu Ferringhi

Author: EdwardTeoMalaysia
Title: My worst experience among all Oriental Group of restaurants!
Review: Went to Han Room for my CNY luncheon, since I'm in Mid Valley. One outcome - TOTAL REGRET!- Waited 40 mins despite booking prior- Table or environment surrounding table smelled musty and mouldy... almost like those half-damp cloth that is not dried properly- Food overly salty (9 pax on my table feedback on the same as well)- CNY set came with Shark fin soup and I asked to replace shark fin with crab meat instead. Ended up with a soup that looks more like sweet corn and crabstick soup. Asked 3 captain/supervisor unsuccessfully to define whether such is Han's Room standard when it comes to that dish. At the end, the senior staff (most likely manager) rudely mentioned that he will go to kitchen to get a bowl of crabmeat for us to mix. Soup is already cold by then. No courtesy to come to table to explain what happened. Picture attached before and after adding crabmeat (picture speaks a thousand words).- Damage... RM1,6xx for sub-par chinese cuisine experience.- Junior staffs serve you better than the senior staffs captains.I wanted to highlight that, I am after a memorable and good experience for my last CNY gathering with family before work next week. I ended up getting a memory of this place for sure. IT SUCKS! I'm ready to pay, but the service and food must must live up to the standard if you are charging your customers such pricing. I seriously wonder how they can still survive??? The Han's Room I've been when it was located at ground floor of Gardens wasn't bad at all. What happened here? Over capacity with lack of trained staffs and quality control of kitchen? Poor management? My personal opinion, I won't visit this place anymore. Spoiled both my and family's CNY experience.

Author: JTabbyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food in chaotic and stressful environment
Review: The food we had was very good, unfortunately, we were made to feel very unwelcome after we requested that both of our breakfast dishes arrive together. Needless to say, one of our dishes with eggs and raw salmon came 20 minutes before the other dish. We asked them if they could bring them both out together. They brought back a reheated poached egg dish with what now was cooked salmon. Of course we explained that we can't be paying top dollar for this! After having to speak to 3 different members of staff, they eventually brought us the right dish, which was dropped onto the table. No eye contact. No apologies. Nothing. It appears the kitchen has no one executing the orders and it looks like other tables were also having similar problems. Given the amount of competition in the area and the high prices of Breakfast Thieves, we won't be going back again. There are simply too many other great choices such as VCR, Lisette's, Antipodean etc.

Author: Chin Y
Title: Famous but below expectations
Review: Food quality not as good as old days, but still with wider selection, not enjoyed their type of services, some may feel these are normal for such old establishment.

Author: N I I N
Title: Better then last time
Review: The restaurant is getting better and better, they have changed the menu again. The only thing that should change is that some waiters push to much, to order what they think is best.

Author: Franck_RozaidaJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Factory made food
Review: I have been here several times a couple of years ago, but stopped visiting them due to poor quality.After Aeon's renovations we more or less accidentally dropped in and had lunch. Place was packed, and surprisingly some of the Nepali staff were nice and friendly.Food however was poor at best. Presentation on menu looks delicious but when served it looks like dog- food!Luckily it (presumably) tastes better though.

Author: jchong
Title: Good food...
Review: Mun Choong is one of the stalwarts in terms of Chinese restaurants in Ipoh. Food is generally quite good, though we prefer the branch in town (which is listed in Tripadvisor under Pusing Public Seafood Restaurant).

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Overrated
Review: Not sure why so many visitor give them a good rating. There is limited parking & poor setvice. Their chicken chop is taste ordinary & priced upper edge

Author: Chirag SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but everything else was just average
Review: Been here about 3 times and the service was not great during all three visits. Takes very long to get a server's attention and on two of the three occasions, they forgot one of our ordered menu items. A small few number of servers could not speak English very well making ordering quite long-winded.In terms of food, although its quite decent overall, it takes very long time to arrive. The restaurant was not full on any of the three visits yet the food still took a long time to arrive. The Malay themed dishes tasted much better than the Indian themed dishes in my opinion. One special thing to point out though is that the dessert has always been superb. Had the dessert buffet during Hari Raya and it was easily the best dessert buffet I have had- great variety with everything tasting authentic and delicious.The atmosphere is quite good- depending on where you are seated, you can get view of the kitchen.

Author: speeg1986
Title: Outstanding Food & Excellent Customer Service
Review: I visited El Iberico for the first time last night with members of my senior management team.Not only was the food first class, the ambiance and customer service was impeccable (this is not easy to kind in Kuala Lumpur).The largest surpise however was our food actually arrived at the same time! After visiting Kuala Lumpur for the past 10 years I can assure you that this is not common place...I can't speak highly enough of the place. My only issue is that I chose to ignore the recommendation to order the ribs. I was fortunate that I was offered a taste of my colleagues. They are sublime! Never mind, it's a great excuse to return again soon :)

Author: Coastal77466Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
Title: Comedy Service
Review: I really can't comment on the food as I never received my order. The alarm bells should have rung when I had to ask for my wine to come more than 20 minutes after my order went in. 40 minutes later no sign of the simple pizza I'd asked for. Awful service, avoid like the plague

Author: Daniel FSingapore, Singapore
