Title: Underwhelming Experience. Rude, Disrespectful, 3rd World Management
Review: Dined at Yellow Brick Road a couple of months ago with some friends after hearing good things about their brunch. However, I was extremely disappointed with the experience--namely predicated around management. I ordered a drink called a babyccino thinking that it was like a mini cappuccino like cortado, macchiato, etc. The waitress didn't correct me and brought me some frothed milk. Surprised, I asked to speak to the manager. The manager was extremely rude and smart not apologizing in the slightest. Mind you, every food item on the menu has about a paragraph below it listing every single ingredient in the dish, yet the drinks menu has no description below it and uses playful drink names that are not commonly known. I think this was intentionally done by management to take advantage of customers, which in my opinion is not an ethical way to run a business. The manager again, refused to apologize was quite arrogant, and asked me if I wanted to replace my drink for FULL PRICE. Had I not been with other people, I would have walked out of this restaurant at that very moment. This is insulting and not the way management should be running a business, especially if attempting to charge western prices for higher quality gourmet food, the customer service should be on par with said price. I felt sorry and bad for the waitress who was kind and sweet and didn't know any better. I felt that the manager intentionally set her up for a difficult situation. I hope she can find a job somewhere else where she is treated more fairly by her superiors. Long story short, at Yellow Brick Road, the customer is always wrong, no matter what. Come here if you want to give your money away, but I for one will not and as such will not be coming back.

Author: angelina1994
Title: Bad hygiene habits (?)
Review: The foods are delicious especially the pork ride and the beef noodles. Until one day when we parked behind the shop, we saw them washing the plates and pans on the road.

Author: TMisnan
Title: Expensive Crabs
Review: Expensive crabs, pricey , prawns cooked not so fresh, Crabs for MYR130/kgms, woww, nice place to sit back and relax, among the expensive places for locals, suitable for USD,BND,SGD,£,EURO Currencies, if want to try, you are welcome, for reservation they will suggest for 1000 MYR per table(10 seats), which is more expensive than 5 star hotels charges. Not worth for money, seek somewhere else, you can enjoy so many varieties of food for 1000MYR budget.

Author: Strider OChinatown, Singapore
Title: Getting more crowded and no longer nice
Review: Although the shop has been extended to 3-4 shop lots as compared to my last visit, I still need to take around 20-30 mins to wait for my seats. It is extremely crowded. But the food is no longed nice.I am kinda disappointed with the soup.... :(

Author: Shal_LalwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Afternoon tea is not what it used to be; one of the worst I've had
Review: I had the afternoon tea at the Majestic a few years ago and it was beautiful. I raved about it to my friends, who eventually tried it and they enjoyed it as well.Fast forward to 2018 and the same friends and I planned another trip to the Majestic for their afternoon tea. The ambiance is still gorgeous but we were shocked to see how much the quality has fallen. I don't understand how or why a 5 star hotel like the Majestic would allow this to happen: 1) There's no menu - this was probably deliberate as it allowed them to serve a random assortment of their choice for each set. As a guest, it would have been nice to know what was being served. (I don't like tuna and I got tuna).2) The "hot items" (1 chicken wing & 2 unidentifiable items) were served cold. When I bit into them, they were oily/soggy and the oil tasted like it was over-used for frying. We asked for the hot items to be served hot. They were taken away and then brought back in exactly the same positions and still cold. 3) Portions were allocated awkwardly. One person was given 2 scones and the other 2 people were required to share 3 scones with 1 portion of jam & cream. When we asked for an extra scone, the first response we got was "that's the way it is". We had to ask someone more senior just for a scone.4) Only one type of tea is available, Darjeeling. Surely 1 or 2 other tea choices is not difficult to do in case someone doesn't like Darjeeling? We were surprised that for the price charged, the hotel uses a tea bag rather than tea leaves.5) The bread used for some of the sandwiches was dry and definitely not fresh. This is quite basic!6) Containers containing jam & cream showed marks (not washed well). We asked for clean ones but the marked ones were brought back to us.The ONLY part of the set that didn't have any issues were the 2 rather small cakes in my set. Tasted OK...nothing memorable. I would once have rated this one of the best afternoon teas in Asia. Now, I would honestly rate this as the worst. I've had better ones in a shopping mall cafe in Singapore.

Author: traveller24by7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great late night eating out at Jalan Alor
Review: This place does not disappoint each time I visit. The food is quite good and the staff efficient. Each dish is delectable. The restaurant is always packed and is a must visit if you are in KL for a great late night out dinner or drinks. There is something for everyone here, foodie or not. Some may find the restaurant a bit pricey. The beggars and random people selling cheap junk can be a nuisance though. Apart from that the food & the lively atmosphere at Jalan Alor will have you coming back for more. Happy eating y'all.

Author: KT785KL
Title: glamour minus the value
Review: This place has a good location and ambiance. Prices, and the menu are comparable to other restaurants in the locality. But the biggest disappointment is that unlike most restaurants of the same size and price range at KLCC, this place doesn't have a restroom within the restaurant, and you need to walk about 75m (each way) to the nearest basic public toilet, which is only moderately clean, and if you are a woman, endure a long wait, due to very heavy usage. If you do not mind the exercise, and a 10-15 minute interruption, this place may be for you. Otherwise, there are many other choices with the same view and ambiance, at better value.

Author: RusnitaUSBeverly, Massachusetts
Title: Worth going just to take in the view
Review: The buffet here is mediocre, ok for the price I paid especially as I got them through Groupon. I wouldn't go there just for the food but it's worth going at least once just for the novelty of dining whilst taking in the views of KL

Author: NGCKKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: French cousins with everything goes well!
Review: Very nice French cousins on the good side ranging from the menu, to the excellence services(they feel bad when you didn't finish the dish), to the ambience and pricing.Nothing will stop me from returning to this restaurant except that you'll need to pre-book as the seats are limited and usually you can't walk in and get a table.

Author: AndrewY123Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Local cuisine made with heart
Review: I've been back here more than a couple of times! The food here honest, authentic and faithful to local tastes.Highly recommend the fried rice here. The nasi lemak is probably one of the best in KL. Come here as a group and order the platter (the fried chicken is delicious) and also order the Nasi Ulam! From time to time there are special drinks on offer like the delicious lemongrass tea. For desserts, definitely try the sago and crepe.Of course this is nothing without the warm hospitality of the proprietor who has worked so hard to build the restaurant. Well done and keep it up!

Author: william q
Title: cheap & cheerful
Review: ben and amy are the owners here , very nice people who get to know most of their customers and often join for a beer or chat . food is lovely and cheap too . nice place to relax and unwind

Author: mandd477York, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful restaurant ruined by sudden change in policy
Review: Our previous experience at Aqua was such a joy - excellent food, service, views, ambience. We went back this week and had a drink before our meal, but had to leave the restaurant because of the loud music during happy hour. Impossible to have a conversation over the disco music. This would be OK later in the evening but not at 6.30pm. They said they had just got a DJ but they have failed to understand their loyal clientele. What a shame.

Author: imegatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A walkcown memory lane....with great gastronomical experience
Review: This is probably one of the oldest restaurant in KL. Some of the staffers are probably still the original ones (white shirt, black pants). Lots of pictures of old KL.Food selection is great (mostly local with some western options). Better make it a walking trip if you want to go there, so that you can experience the whole Jalan TAR experience as well.

Author: ohshafiqaSingapore
Title: underwhelmed
Review: we tried this restaurant due to the good ratings found in tripadvisor - but our visit is far from satisfactory. the decor was kind of outdated and kitschy (I might be biased but I hate fake brick walls), and the atmosphere was not what we expected. we proceeded to other our food, nonetheless. took quite a while for the food to arrive, which wouldn't be such a sore point if it had been worth the wait. spoiler alert: it was not. I ordered the aglio olio with bacon and my partner ordered the lamb rack. my dish had a weird aftertaste, and if not for the bacon which I asked to be added, I wouldn't have been able to eat more than a few spoonfuls. the lamb rack was better - but the meat used was full of fat and the seasoning was not done well. so disappointed with how our food turned out.. but at least their portion was huge (we couldn't finish it, though).service was alright - and we give props to the server for being concerned about how our dinner went. I just don't get why this place is rated highly amongst the steakhouses in melaka. this would definitely be my last visit to this restaurant..

Author: NeetsnewtsSouthend-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Honest review
Review: The value for money was excellent, however the service was quite poor and the food wasn't great. We ordered the mashed potatoes skins which were lovely, the boneless chicken which was late out because it was overlooked according to the staff. Whilst eating I get told my main is ready, I would have liked to finish my starter, although we both didn't like the chicken. When it comes out the chips were cold, I ordered the beef tacos, I told them and they said they would change it and reheated the tacos but had fresh chips. The tacos weren't very nice for my taste and I ate the chips and left the rest. My partner had fish and chips which he enjoyed however, again, it was late out.

Author: abrownyorkJakarta, Indonesia
Title: A very disappointing lunchtime experience
Review: I had noticed the TGI Friday restaurant as we drove by on a tour bus earlier in the week and made a promise to take my girlfriend for lunch later in the week. We arrived full of expectation as I had been to TGIFs in Britain and had enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Unfortunately we were very disappointed as we entered and found a table. The teenage staff were clustered together in two groups one near the entrance and the others at the back of the restaurant. They were more interested in chatting with their backs to the diners while playing with electronic devices. I had to bang the table and raise my voice to get service. We then waited for over 30 minutes before being served with below average chicken & shrimp. We will definitely not go there again.

Author: aniqaali
Title: good service from kowser
Review:
We are visiting here first day in gravybaby.very nice place in kl
This restaurant served lots of international foods, which suited us. The service was very good and the restaurant was very nice. Especially thanks kowser.He is very friendly and thanks for good service.

Author: GreyLephanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good jap fusion, but lacking the omph
Review: i've followed Nobu since 20yrs back, and i must say the diminishing awe factor, as other restaurants catch up on funky experimentation of flavors/textures. In contrast, Nobu has remain conservative relatively speaking.this nobu is a tad underwhelming in decor, though the view from the high floor probably makes up a little. service is excellent, and beer is served ice cold.

Author: CharlesL2887
Title: Food decent, Service SUCKS BIG TIME!!!
Review: I had dinner here at the Westin Hotel Prego, not because I wanted to eat here but I was rushing for time and had a meeting to catch. So I thought a quick dinner and off I go for me meeting.My order for drinks and food was spot on. I got my food in less than 30mins. That was impressive!!! But it seems that they were not keen in billing me for my dinner. After I had finished my dinner, I wanted my bill but there was not waiters to be found. Then I saw a waiter strutting towards a guest who just walked into the restaurant. And he was served with the menu and taking his orders. So I waved at the waiter for my bill and he acknowledged. 10mins passed before the waiter appeared but only to serve him water and laying out the napkin for the guest. Then he disappeared again. This time he came back with the bread for the guest. And all this time, I still did not get my bill. The third time I saw him walking in and still, no bill for me. He brought out the dish for the table next to me... I really cannot understand how this can happen in a 5 star hotel restaurant. And I am still waiting for my bill as I write this review....So my advice is, don’t eat here unless you have loads of time to kill. Besides, the waiting for the bill does not outweigh how good the food maybe...

Author: emmalindss
Title: Got food poisoined
Review: They have great food but I actually got a food poisoning from this place... So I Wont come back sadly

Author: EJTT34B
Title: Reliably good traditional Chinese confectionery
Review: Quality of Heong Peah, Tau Sar Peah always good.   Service is fantastic.  Staff obliging and willing to provide samples.

Author: DawnLeowKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Forget about the rule FCFS
Review: The wait staff couldn't remember what was ordered. Served others that came after with our order and had the audacity to argue on the order given. They kept asking what was ordered. God forbid.. even if the food was ok, the service was mediocre to say the least.

Author: krokodillekeHemiksem, Belgium
Title: Middag lunch
Review: We order a pasta and a dish with chicken we have to wait 45min and there were no people in the restaurant when we had our Food it was Cold the staff is not intressed in there guests the only thing that they do is playing with there phone it's a shame there are other places on the island much cheaper much so much cheaper !!!!!!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Marwan A
Title: 5 star
Review: So far the best burger joint in sarawak!! Love the makio grind!! Must try!! Dont forget to bring your friends and family!!

Author: waelonsyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Excellent is not enough to explain this place
Review: Cba was perfect in every single way, it's a restaurant that everyone dreams to eat in during a vacation. The restaurant is placed right on the beach where you can have a 5star dish with beautiful representation. The ambience is absolutely beautiful especially after enjoying the sunset you get to enjoy the live band. You get a large selection of high quality appetisers and desserts from the buffet. I could honestly say it was one of my favourite parts of the night after a great day at the hotel.

Author: ruthmanullangIndonesia
Title: Revolving execellent view of Kuala Lumpur
Review: Went here with my whole family, we enjoy the food and the 360 itself. It's called 360 because it's revolving view of Kuala Lumpur, serving as an excellent view as we dine 282 metres above the ground, it such a great new experience (i was sitting next to the window and i enjoyed it). My only complaint is that the air-con doesn't work at the time, the restaurant team didn't inform us before, so when we got there, it was kinda warm (caused some people to sweat). However it has excellent views, nice dining areas, and nice service.

Author: HelenMRyan
Title: Nice flasback of home
Review: NOTE: I posted this originally to another Tripadvisor account I didn't know I had. So I am re-posting here to correct account and deleting from the other one.If you're from California, then seeing this chain in a foreign country will bring a smile to your face. And if you've been gone from home for quite a while, the menu will make you happy.They have Malaysian food on the menu as well, but I chose the quesadilla, and it was quite good. Expensive, but worth it.The ambiance was as any Hard Rock would be, which is what you are looking for when you pick a chain. I sat outside even though it was warm and watched people and the monorail go by. It was nice to take a moment and relax and see the (foreign) world go by.Staff was professional and polite (I believe I was greeted by the door both entering and existing, which is always a nice touch). My server was attentive and pleasant. You definitely want to take a few photos of the cafe and the parking signs outside. If you are on the other side of the street it's challenging to get to since you have to cross a very busy road to get there. I snuck across with a large group of business people who obviously were experts and crossing the street.

Author: RinaN285
Title: Not so good for me
Review:
The rice and roasted chicken is tasteless.. Dont think to come again.. I think
 overrated by people..

Author: AgentBroccoliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Attentive Waiter. Ok Food
Review: As we were there for an early dinner with a big group of ladies, we didn't get to take in the entertainment. We were self-entertaining anyway.No surprises here. Which is good, really. Pretty much like the other Hard Rock Cafes worldwide, with a slight change in the menu. Prices are on the steeper side compared to other restaurants in Melaka but no more than you would expect from a Hard Rock.

Author: SEE KIONG TKuching
Title: Business Meeting
Review: Nice exotic place but room temperature was a bit warm. Simple set up and looked tidy. Polite waitress but communication was not good enough. Menu selection was not impressive. Hot coffee O was very very low standard and even I personally reminded the bar tender to make a good hot coffee O for my second order, it was still the same. Truly upset. The "Nasi" served as Nasi Lemak was not cooked with coconut milk or santang. I brought with me my Indonesian business partner to dine at Tribal Stove and he was not impressed with it. Dare not recommend to others and will only consider to go back after they have some improvement.

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Dinner at sunset and seabreeze
Review: This restaurant is wel located for sun set dinners. Eating outside with a seabreeze what more is required for a nice evening out with friends. The seafood was excellent prepared, ikan bakar is was fresh and very much recomendable. The choice of music was wel chosen too. All in all we're very satisfied about this evening out

Author: derekchiangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing experience :(
Review: Bad experience overall - we found hair in our thai soft shell crab salad and requested for a new plate. When speaking to Shirley, the restaurant leader that evening, about our unfortunate incident (especially coming from a restaurant of this status), she wasn't apologetic at all. I was mindful and paying attention how she was trying to do her service recovery - there was not a word of "sorry" or "i apologise". It felt that the restaurant was not wrong to serve dishes with hair at all. To give her some credit, she did try to do some service recovery by offering arabica coffee which she said was something new on the menu (seriously?! And who drinks coffee at night?). My friend and I do not drink coffee and declined her kind offer for coffee, but there wasn't an alternative for us sadly, which i thought was bad customer service. There was no also follow up or byes after we paid. A pity our evening was affected by this unfortunate incident and hope that they can improved.

Author: NoneedTOgo
Title: Lousy food
Review: Curries and tkka masala very salty and no curry taste.  All i could raste is salt and salt.  Food recoomendations are overated!

Author: shankumartKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprise Birthday dinner at Prego Westin for my mom
Review: I decided to celebrate my mom's birthday at Prego today and it was indeed the best choice. Service was excellent and food was top notch..my compliments to the chefs and i would like to take this time to thank Sara, Connie and Kamil for the excellent arrangements and the great service rendered. My family had a wonderful dining experience and i would recommend Prego to anyone who wants to enjoy great food and service.

Author: pickyluxe
Title: The best!!!
Review:
This place has the best western food in Kuala Lumpur and always have dinner here when visiting. The wagyu bolognese is to die for and the roast chicken is unbeatable.

Service is excellent, friendly, and beautiful setting.

Author: Food4godsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: breakfast at Not Tiffany
Review: Buffet spread not impressive. The samosa served was fried in rancid oil and smell terrible. Could do much better with the spread.

Author: Rdwrer
Title: Hype, undeserved and undeserving. Spare yourself the bother
Review: Expectations were high, I had heard so much about this coffee shop and its signature dishes and when we arrived the place was packed. The roti bakar - kaya toast. This looked like a cat had vomited next to a piece of bread...oh the Anchor butter was delicious. The roti babi - pork toast. It's like a French toast if that came with onion and pork stuffed inside a fatty deep fried toast...so it's more like an unsavory aberration...The pork roll - This looked appetizing (at first), 2 slices of pork with crackling on the outside and served with apple sauce. Pity the pork was overdone and looked a little...old and the crackling was chewy.We also ordered the beef rendang, I know, why you ask? I kept giving them another chance to redeem themselves and...they consistently didn't. The beef rendang was 90% fat and came in a curry sauce. In all the food was bad and nothing to drive across town for. If you are in the area already, check out one of the other places around. Don't eat the hype!

Author: worldtraveller081970Rheinfelden, Switzerland
Title: One of the best choices in Changkat Bukit Bintag
Review: Nice place in the middle of the hustle and bustle of Bukit Bintag. Service very friendly and attentive, food good, but nothing to write home about. It is clearly not "authentic asian cuisine" as stated in some of the reviews, but a creative and in most cases tasty modern fusion style between asian and western dishes.

Author: SAPOIDJakarta
Title: This was supposed to be the pasta place.
Review: I asked a friend for a pasta place he did recommend me few places including this, and by the way some taxis often mistaken Neroteca and Nerovivo, careful, fortunately they're not far from each other.Lets start from the booking, as I had several attempts. First attempt thru the online booking failed. The website told me to call. Second booking same thing did not work out, so I went to the restaurants official website and searched for their email.It took them a while to reply to me. Which they did apologize on the email.So once I had the reservations done, on the day of the reservation, I was going to be late, so I called them up to postpone my table a further 45minutes. I did arrive exactly 45 minutes from the original time.As soon as I walked in, this young cocky gentleman greeted me, as soon as I said my name, he looked at his watch, basically giving me this "you are late gesture". Seeing him doing that, I immediately told him, "I did call earlier". SO apparently the guy who picked up the phone had not updated the manager.Buy hey, costumer is King! Don't look at your watch in costumer's face when he walks in late. Even if i did not make the reservation change.After speaking to the manager, I do realize that he is a nice guy, just with a little cockiness issue.As for the food, they were marginally standard. My pasta was the flattest and tasteless I had in my life. Seriously, no kidding. Pizza Hut was better. Again, I am not kidding. The other plates we ordered was ok though. Fortunately.

Author: LoveThaiifoodAndMoreBangkok, Thailand
Title: A money making machine
Review: Have been at the Chili's a few times in the past year. Unfortunately every single time we get rushed and every time there is something wrong with the food. When I point it out they always apologize however, they never change anything to get better. The location is great in KLCC with the great view but I think they use the restaurant mainly as a money making machine and don't really care about the customers experience.

Author: Songjude
Title: Mr Song
Review: Excellent service. Good food and fine ambience. Staffs are friendly and helpful. Very good experience

Author: CITI-ONEKuching, Malaysia
Title: Fairly good but Stingy on soup!
Review: The BKT flavor is just fairly good. Meat is well cooked with BKT flavor and nice aroma..but stingy on the soup. Good that the soup doesn't have the sticky thick soy sauce / oyster sauce fIavour. It is also very crowed especially during weekends. Need to go early for certain good parts (such as yuen kuat and sai kuat) as it usually run out fast. Don't expect good service and business is good. Workers expect you to pay and go away urgently after your meal..as they want to clean up for next customer.Verdict: Not highly recommended....can try if you are fine with crowd and you don't take soup like me. If you like to take BKT for it's soup....then you will be slightly disappointed. Enjoy !
Restaurant: Restoran Seng Huat Bak Kut Teh

Author: Pioneer55532691241London, United Kingdom
Title: Unprofessional
Review: Unable to book (tried to via WhatsApp but told to just walk in). Waited outside with other hopeful customers as told to do by the sign at the door. Empty tables visible. Ignored for 30mins then someone came and said the kitchen was now closed. Unprofessional, appalling customer service. Suggest you go elsewhere and save yourself the time.

Author: DellickSingapore, Singapore
Title: Safe first night option
Review: Given the reviews we thought Knife and Fork would be a good first night option - which it was. It’s location on the third floor of the KFC Building (that’s not about chicken) is a bit unusual and the ambience isn’t much to write home about but the food was good and Liang bustles around both cooking and waiting. We ate a prawn curry and the black vinegar chicken both of which we enjoyed.

Author: JacinthaRyan18
Title: Great food and great value
Review: As a Seafood lover, I can tell you this is the place to be, amazing food and wonderful staff, always ready to assist, amazing value also, the sea bass was cooked to perfection, and really cheap will return for sure!

Author: Claire C
Title: Tasty French breakfast
Review: Directly across from our hotel, friendly staff/owners. French inspired food. We had crepes one day and waffles the next, both delicious! Very good prices. Recommended.

Author: Bounford
Title: Cracking food in a beautiful setting
Review: We ate at this restaurant 3 times during our stay, as we were staying at Casa Del Mar. The food is outstanding, and quite reasonably priced (compared to uk prices, not local prices!) Can't recommend it enough
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: MumtoScruffyYorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyable Food and Good Service
Review: We have eaten here many times over the last 12 months and the food and service has always been consistently good. We have had mushroom soup, chicken liver parfait, garlic pizza bread, pasta and salad and these have always been very tasty and of good quality and quantity. Waiters are always pleasant and ready to top up our glasses with wine. The wine is good and reasonably priced for KL especially if you go before 9pm.We have always sat outside because there is a buzz with the throughput of shoppers and it is a great place to people watch. I am sure that we will return on our next visit to KL.

Author: lsg181Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Generous toppings, meat or meatless choices, especially the super spicy pizza to maximize your taste bud
Review: One of real yummy pizza versus commonly found in fast food pizza chain. Generous spreads of topping and not bread like pizza crust, not too thick and not so thin. Today tried 4 types of pizza selections - classic, cheese, mushroom and Mexican. my preferred choice? It must be the drooling hot Mexican!

Author: 592yiwenn
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Worth for the price... food is nice, staff is friendly! The tomato soup was special n nice. The portion of the food is big..The restaurant need to make a reservation, as there are limited seat n lack of manpower to serve the customer .Overall the food is nice worth to go .

Author: LuxuryhotelfansclubPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excelleng
Review: High quality food , great environment , superb and attentive service, price is reasonable , will visit again

Author: May C
Title: Valentine Dinner
Review: Foods very fresh & tasty, service is good especially manageress Julienne where she takes time to recommend their menu to suit our taste for the day & also explain club Marriot benefits. We frequent this chain of hotels from Kota Kinabalu , Desaru, KL and look forward to our next visit again next week

Author: Levin LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Double the price, double the value? That's debatable.
Review: Six Ringgit for one Cheese Naan, one half the size of a normal Naan.Pay double the usual rate for more/better cheese- which is admittedly expensive.You'll never get the same amount of cheese from other restaurants.That being said- if it's cheese you're after, you're better of buying and toasting your own cheese toast. Or paying slightly more for a small pizza at Domino's.It's worth noting that they also charge for dhal (RM2.10 at time of writing). One serving is enough for 3 persons, unless you drink dhal like water.

Author: DequeenYapA
Title: A resturant you can't miss when you are in KL. Get the Chance to meet Black aka the Talented Bar Tender
Review: they have the best service crew especially Mr Black aka the Bartender. Talented guy with great drinks experience. Not forgetting the others (chefs too) who serve great food. You all made me and my friends super happy on this special day! Thank you for the happy shot! p/s: The food and drinks are damn AWESOME! THe hallibut was perfecto!

Author: IskandarsyahismailAmpang, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rude cashier, forget it!
Review: Visited the outlet last night during our trip to Kuching.We asked for extra table to accommodate our big family but the cashier refused. Only after my brother-in-law argued with her, we were allowed to get another table.She really spoiled our mood after long day attending relative's wedding in Kuching. This is the last time we will be here.

Author: lynWollongong
Title: Great International Buffet
Review: Serena buffet offers an International buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Theer is also the option of ordering individual meals from the menu. The buffet offers a huge variety of international cusines, great quality of western, asian, indian and seafood.

Author: Sept_RainSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food. Service can be improved
Review: Had dim sum and dinner at the hotel and was impressed by the food. Prices are surprisingly reasonable and if you are a hotel guest you are entitled to 15% off. Service can be better - service staff looked tired.

Author: 129mirandak
Title: Marvin got us drunk
Review: I had something that resembles pizza. Tasty though, but nothing extraordinary. My partner had something with softshell crab and black noodleS. Which was tasty. The only thing was the glasses, we had wine and beer and they put it in ceramic vases... Not my thing. Marvin the waiter suggested also some sort of Chinese wine, which we had. really strong and tasty!

Author: ManFriday777Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: In a truly sad state.
Review: For an establishment that claims to be iconic and part of the history of the city I call home, I find it downright sad that the owner takes no pride in the place. It is shabby and run down. Paint is peeling off, you got stickers on the walls, dirt everywhere. A piece of paper taped on the cash register says "No Wi Fi."  I know of coffee shops that are in better shape. For heaven's sake, this is not some canteen. It should be treated with more respect. In the hands of a serious restaurateur, this place would be absolutely outstanding. All it takes is some light restoration. As for the food, if the dinner I last had is anything to go by, the kitchen also needs a re-boot. We had a Sirloin Steak (2/5), Beef Bolgnese (3/5), Hainanese Chicken Chop (1/5), Black Pepper Chicken (4/5) and a Grilled Perch 2/5). RM221 including service/tax. So is there anything good to say here? Yes, the service. The staff were friendly and certainly took pride in their work. It is nice to see people in the hospitality business who understand customer service.

Author: JustRose_CHBasel, Switzerland
Title: Good food, friendly service
Review: We ordered a number of dishes and had no complaints with the food. Pretty standard for Thai food, nothing over the top. The spring rolls were probably the best thing ordered, followed next by the pad thai. The service was friendly. We were there early on a Saturday so the place was pretty empty. Was a nice break after a day exploring KL.

Author: BarryL200Sydney, Australia
Title: Great Malaysian food
Review: Apparently quite well known locally for local food.Enjoyed some great flavours in the dishes we ordered. In particular the Tamarind Prawns and Beef Rendang were great. We ordered a variety of other dishes to share and they were all high quality.It is a busy location, basically full on the Monday evening that we went so a good idea to book.

Author: dizzystar1
Title: Delicious lamb rogan josh
Review: Great menu with lots of options - Indian and western plus a kids menu. Serves alcohol too as it’s linked to the bar outside. Lamb rogan josh is delicious as are the desserts. Highly recommend.

Author: JilnickSingapore, Singapore
Title: Never again ! Over-rated
Review: The place was crowded for Sunday dinner. Too noisy for a decent conversation amongst friends. We arrived promptly for our 7pm reservation, ordered the food & requested the captain to start serving at 7.30pm. Waited until 8pm to be told that a few dishes that we had ordered were unavailable & so we substituted with other dishes. Food started arriving intermittently from 8.15 onwards. Waiting time between dishes were long, we had to constantly remind the waitress. By the time we finished, it was almost 10pm. The best thing about the restaurant is the free corkage & the most enjoyable dish was the single malt whiskey that we had brought along.........supposedly voted #4 best Chinese restaurant in the WORLD ! The voters must have had too much to drink then !!

Author: syafiqeffendiSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: The heaven of Spanish Delights
Review: Came here for the Seafood Paella, absolutely delicious. Taste better than Paella I had when i was Barcelona. The amount of seafood is very generous and flavor is awesome. The restaurant got the most friendly staff, very helpful. Chef Adriano had come to my table asking about the food which is nice and thoughtful. Overall, the restaurant is a great venue for family, couple and friends hangout!

Author: Mona DPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not as expected
Review: Came here for Mother's Day buffet on Saturday night. Initially staff were very pleasant and helpful. They prepared a complimentary photo booth on that day, where staff took our family photo, and gifted it to us upon payment. They even changed our reserved seats which were at the entrance to a better location nearer to the buffet. Food variety is ample- served in Malay, Chinese, Indian, western and Japanese. Definitely too much choice for one person to try everything that is being served. Good that they served detox water instead of fruit juices! My favourite were the prawn tempura, and dim sum. Salads were fresh and the yogurt ice cream was refreshing to the palate but other than that food wasn't as good as I expected it to be for the price which was rm180/Pax. The upside is they have a 40% discount for Maybank credit card holders, otherwise I would not recommend this buffet as I feel it is not really worth its price. Also the staff somehow gotconfused with my reservation. I received a call the next day also asking me to confirm my table when I did not make a double reservation. Hope the management will work on the mishaps.

Author: HarryHank
Title: Good food & service
Review: We eat here about once a month, food is tasty, quantity is large and menu varied. we like the small pork knuckle, plenty for two people.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Chris_Orleans
Title: We wanted to explore where Anthony Bourdain went but closed
Review: How can a restaurant group famous in Kuching being closed on Saturday lunch and dinner !!! A shame. I wanted to experience good time but it s failure place. No notice on doors... Not a reliable place and business. Flew it.

Author: TamC223Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Best in JB
Review: We have been eating in Chez Papa for over 12 years and it has consistently served great French cuisine in a great ambiance. Our previous visit to this was 2 years ago and the staff remembered us and made us most welcome. Whether you want to sit at the bar and have a drink or hold a large celebration party this place this restaurant is perfect. Highly recommended.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: zarahmad70Mecca, Saudi Arabia
Title: Great ambience
Review: The newly-renovated Tarbush on Bukit Bintang has a lovely ambience and gives the vibe of eating in an upmarket souk, with food stations and counters selling all manner of Middle Eastern delicacies. However, that is the best feature of the restaurant, not its food. The starters and salad were good but the mixed grill and tagine we ordered didn’t meet our expectations. The grilled items were on the dry side and the tagine was absolutely bland bordering on tasteless. On top of that, a member of staff there was rather condescending to us, when we asked to change our order. I even spoke to her in her own language but she insisted on speaking in English (the command of which was rather... lacking) that resulted in her not understanding what we were saying. It’s a pricey experience overall, you will be paying for the ambience and not really for the quality of the food.

Author: NicoleBrisbane
Title: Back for the pork knuckle
Review: We visited before and came back for the pork knuckle. There were only 2 of us, but food for at least 3 people. We couldn't finish it all. The knuckle came with 3 sides and bread. Yum! Very good service and food.

Author: pluboyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: RUBBISH
Review: Attention-selective staff who are all over and super friendly towards angmoh yet couldn't be bothered to even acknowledge my presence.I walked in, they saw me. They ignored me. I chose a seat and waited to be served. They saw me. They ignored me. I had to call out to them to bring me the bloody menu. The same thing happens when comes to paying. They saw me yet they didn't bring me the bill. I had to get up and walk myself to the counter. I could've just walked away and out and I bet nobody will notice.

Author: Drewski77Dublin, Ireland
Title: Great Malay cuisine
Review: KL's Kampung Baru is an amazing slice of small town life in the middle of the city centre. Kids stop, stare and say hello in that way you generally only experience in areas that are genuinely unused to tourism. Despite a reasonable amount of promotion from tourism bodies relatively few tourists venture into this unique enclave and yet its only one LRT stop away from KLCC. The food here is predominantly Malay and Indonesian. There is a huge selection of places to eat and all of them are very cheap, particularly in comparison to Jalan Alor. I ate as much as I could, from Satay Padang, Kelantanese nasi campur and a very lovely Nasi Lemak at Mak Wanjor. Stay clear of the "Tom Yam" shacks cooking fast food dishes to order and get in line at the buffet stands to sample some delicious slow cooked delicacies. An order of Ikan Bakar (grilled fish) is also a must. Cheap, delicious food. I have to say, Kampung Baru, Brickfields and some of the less popular lanes off Petaling Street are my favorite spots in KL, this where the cities culture is on display...not in aircon malls that could be anywhere in the world.

Author: Mas_udR687
Title: Banana Leaf rice experience in Malaysia
Review: It was great few years before.. the quality and amount of food started to decrease... even the portion used to be a lot than now.. the vegetable pakoda is still best... recommended for people to try at least once..

Author: JaneC1926
Title: Indian food
Review: Awesome food, ambience, service. As authentic as authentic can be. Came back again and again with friends and family

Author: travelingtaliaStockholm, Sweden
Title: Bad Dinner
Review: My husband ordered the Fisherman as take out and he was very disappointed. The fries and fish were both soggy and we waited quite a long time to get the food. This place is rather expensive so it was a real shame. I would not reccommend this place.

Author: Frank vMedellin, Colombia
Title: Nice for having a beer and some food.
Review: The place is nice, and if you drink cans of beer it's quiet cheap too. The most food is good but the most things come in small portions, if you are a little hungry you have to order 2 portions. They have European meals too. Pepence on what you want to eat, but if you want to eat Azian food better go some where else. Ceaper and same quallety or better.

Author: Tian123
Title: Food Hunt
Review: Environment OK, service slow, food and drinks mostly slightly above average especially those with cheese and bacons.

Author: Statler1Foster, Australia
Title: Fast & Fresh Chinese
Review: I visited Tek Sen twice during my stay in Penang. We enjoyed it so much on the first night after trying the tasty fried bean curd & choy sum & squid. On our return as I'm a duck lover I tried the braised duck with yam. It was luke-warm, over-cooked & dry in an ok, but not brilliant sauce with soggy yams. Looks good for pork lovers. Go at opening time or you will be waiting in the queue in the street.

Author: Lawrence S
Title: Memorable evening
Review: My friend and I came to celebrate. We loved the ambience and the service was excellent. Food and drinks were more than satisfactory.

Author: dbrown101272Echuca, Australia
Title: Classy, Elegant, Comfortable
Review: I have not eaten at this bar, but have had drinks here a number of times. It is not necessarily cheap, but they have really good value happy hour prices.The range of drinks and cigars on offer here is awesome - if spirits, cocktails and cigars are your thing, you would find it very difficult to find a better place.More-so than that, the ambiance and comfort of this bar are first-class. Wonderful atmosphere, lounge chairs, tables and outside areas all available. Plus the staff are attentive and knowledgeable. It is also wonderful to sip a glass of whisky on ice with one of their signature ice balls that almost fill the glass. Simply wonderful!

Author: Juliet CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rats!
Review: We went to Madam Kwan's Mid Valley Megamall for dinner and I felt something round my legs, my pants were moving, and I thought I saw a shadow flickering around...I thought I was imagining things and looked around, until my husband pointed out the rat!! We pointed the rat out and the waiter just casually asked if we would like to sit somewhere else! Just go sit somewhere else in their vermin infested restaurant?! From their attitude it seemed like this happens quite often, and we were so angry, we walked out, after walking for fifty meters, one of their waiters catches up to us and insists that we pay for our drinks which we had already consumed partially. There was absolutely no way we would pay for it at their vermin infested place. There would be a law suit if someone fell ill. They had the cheek to run up to us, make a scene in the mall and insist that we pay for the drinks. Needless to say the managers had a huge telling off from us. In their facebook fanpage they say that they serve unique, good and HYGIENIC and consistent Malaysian cuisine. Hygienic? No way! I won't recommend the restaurant to anyone and we won't go there again.

Author: Iceman808
Title: Getting Bad
Review: Well, this used to be my favorite when I am craving for Vietnamese food. But lately the quality is not as good as before. Really hope the management can overcome this challenges. Otherwise we will have to look for an alternative soon ... 🤪

Author: TN007Brisbane, Australia
Title: Wonderful Food
Review: We were staying in a condominium just around the road and had read many good reports about Vishal's. We went for weekday lunch and were not disappointed. The restaurant was very busy with locals and we appeared to be the only Westerners there. The staff were very helpful and we had a great meal and enjoyed all the dishes we tried. Although our excitement got the best of us and we selected far too many dishes for the size of our stomachs. The chicken biryani was a favorite with the kids, while the dry mutton curry was our favorite dish. Extra large iced teas were also very refreshing.

Author: JanKJN
Title: Pretentious place, classy wannabe
Review: Firstly when we entered the establishment at 11.30am on a Sunday, there was no one there to serve us. We seated our selves and had to peek into the kitchen to request for menus and service. Ordered a couple of pots of tea. Although one pot can be poured into 3 cups as illustrated in their menu, they only provide a maximum of two cups, and were denied when we requested an extra. And were adamant about it! They refused to provide and extra empty cup or two just to keep the customers happy. Wow. On top of that, the cups were not entirely clean, with some tiny cracks and stain in the cracks (refer to picture).

Author: DB33178Miami
Title: Service sinks their tasty Chinese food.
Review: Dragon-I has some potential in terms of location and decoration, their food is good, but the service was the worst we experienced in Kuala Lumpur. The waiter and hostess services, had no clue of what they were doing, they were rude, unprofessional and act more like sellers in a street market, than restaurant oriented people. Both of my kids (6 and 8 years old) ordered a noodle soup and when the soups arrived they were so huge that we mentioned to them that one would be more than enough. The lady that supposedly was "taking care of us", started to scream that we had placed two orders of soup, when in the first place she should have recommended that one soup would be sufficient for two little kids; she even brought the ticket to us to showed us we have ordered two, when we were not claiming that, we were clear on that front the beginning. They demonstrated us not a minimal sign of courtesy, etiquette or customer service. Overall, it was a very stressful and a very bad experience.

Author: JGST2020
Title: Local cusinine
Review: This restaurant served good food and at an reasonable price. Many food varities and local food and fish are well for family dinning. Esy car park and just dine Eat and Go.

Author: Jeff K
Title: Ming Cafe
Review: The cafe serves western meal & sells alcohols as well. Lots of westerners partonise the cafe. Food is good. Not too expensive. Centrally located.

Author: GluhenMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A bad experience
Review: First we waited for 20 minutes for the waiter to take our order. After that, we waited for 1 hour plus and our food is not even served while other customer that came after us already got their order. Enquired their staff about our order and was replied rudely. So we decided to go another place for dinner. Seriously not recommended.

Author: GaryL3380Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad Experience & Waste of Money
Review: The service and atmosphere was very bad. My family was seated in the so called private booth and the sound insulation was so bad that we thought we were having dinner at a typical Chinese restaurant. We were lucky that the booths was near the kitchen or else you would have to go search for the waiters/waitresses. The quality of the temaki does not warrant for that kind of price and wasabi or ginger is not served until you asked for it.

Author: HeartyVBirmingham
Title: Bad service
Review: No star for this review coz my family & I had a very bad customer service experience here at Oriental Cravings, One Utama on 31 May 1014 543pm. There were seven of us (including 3 children) and the waiters not bothered giving us tables sufficient for us. Also, the waiters were not polite at all. I am very disappointed at the quality of customer service. And I haven't even tried the food.. Guess they don't need my business which explain the standard of service.

Author: 29xxixAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Lovely Place
Review: First of all location is very easy and all taxi drives know this place. About the place ; staff friendly, restaurant and bar parts are very big. And they have live music and some competitions sometimes. However , their shop part is very small and only a few things for sale. Anyway I love this place !

Author: KTCathy
Title: First Visit to Halal Dim Sum
Review: Something new worth to try especially when it is halal dim sum. Overall food quality is okay with appropriate choices that mimics normal chinese non halal dimsum.

Author: Sinead NXiamen, China
Title: Average
Review: The food was lovely I have to say. We had the chicken wings to start and then a burger and steak sandwich. We went back a second time and sat inside. Bad mistake. A giant cockroach was on the wall beside us and we had to go and sit outside after getting a shock! The service was friendly enough but I wouldn't go back after the cockroach incident!

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chinese New Year dinner
Review: It was a nice meal for a Chinese New Year dinner. Started with the Lou Sang with the senior waitress explaining the significance of each ingredient. We then had the Peking duck - they made the pancakes for us, so not quite as tasty. Following that, the service deteriorated with the subsequent dishes coming out very slowly. The taufu was tasty, as was the beef on a hot plate. We then had the noodles with duck and the Chinese sausages with rice. After at least 20 minutes later, the fish dish came out, just when we thought we were finished! The restaurant was packed, so that may be the reason why the service was so slow, both with the dishes coming out and with the waiters re-filling tea/changing dirty plates. Overall a good meal, but service could do with improvement.

Author: einmanninch
Title: Avoid seafood
Review: Avoid the tuna salad, it was gross. I couldn't eat the tuna and the salad ingredients used are not fresh. The curry was only okay.

Author: SylvienD10Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Overrated pineapple satay sauce
Review: My family and I had the pork, chicken and intestine satay. Quite small portion per stick. The satays were lacking the charcoal grilled aroma and taste. The highlight supposed to be the special pineapple satay sauce which is unusual for a normal satay dish. Unfortunately, the sauce was lacking the nutty flavour that satay sauce needs. The sour element from the pineapple does not add value to the taste, in my opinion. I still prefer the original taste of satay sauce, sweet and most importantly the nutty flavour from the groundnuts that defines what is satay sauce.

Author: FishYee07Bukit Mertajam, Malaysia
Title: Special noodle
Review: A typical Chinese food stall. Toukeh is nice person and friendly. It's not really a kolomee but it's a special noodle that I ever try before. You can order with ' spare parts ' and soup. But I still find Penang's style is nicer. You can have breakfast in kimjoo then coffee at Black Bean . They are in same row same street.

Author: MelGN
Title: The Best Pork Burger in Town
Review: The pork patty is very succulent. The buns they use for Pork Pillow is very soft and pillowy. Double decker pork burger also come in a big portion.I don't mind for not having chips as a side dish like how other restaurants served the usual menu. It's perfect without the chips. It still represent the mixture of the different cultures in Sarawak. Away from home and missing the traditional Borneo's delicacy like Pansuh; this is the right place to dine in. But you have to wait longer than usual. The design of the place itself was inspired by the workshop. Really worth place to hangout with buddies.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Losing it's shine....
Review: A restaurant that stands for almost 70 years will today is somewhat an achievement. The essence of it is it has maintained its quality over the years.Came back to have lunch with family members. When we came in, the lady boss wants us to sit in the non Air-cond section. After some confusion, they decided to open upstairs sitting, which there is air-conditioner. Service isn't that good.Ordered the very basic dishes like fried rice, stir fry kailan with roast pork, kong lam noodles, and their signature phei pha ngap (duck).The duck came first. The taste is still there, but somewhat it does not look fresh and hot serving. Next came the noodles. Previously the noodles were able to take it up by using chopsticks. This time the noodles were so brittle and breaks even without lifting them. As for the stir fry kailan with roast pork, the roast pork isn't crispy where it was not fried separately before/after stir frying the vegetables. The fried rice were wet and the rice grains sticks together, rather than the grains were dry and not sticking together.It is definitely losing it's shine.

Author: Sittingintrees
Title: Poor to average food
Review: The decor is very hipster/shabby chic trendy and is well done. The food, unfortunately, is quite poor quality, comes in small portions and is overpriced. I had a pasta dish that was supposed to be chicken in a tomato sauce with basil and cheese. The pasta was well cooked but the sauce was a tasteless watery mess with a couple pieces of meagre chicken and the smallest quantity of cheese you can imagine. We also had an affogato which was cheap vanilla ice cream - all air and no cream - and overly bitter coffee. All in all a lot of style over substance. The pasta dish with coffee + tax cost 35RM...! Service was fine, but you're paying of the decor, not for decent food.

Author: admutum
Title: Tasty banana leaf meal
Review: Really tasty Indian banana leaf meal. We were really hungry and have to say ate a bit too much. Lots of different vegetarian dishes. My wife ordered a chicken side dish as well. The drinks were lovely as well. Food was served quite fast and was reasonably priced. My son who has autism was not very happy with the music they played but they turned it down on our request. Will definitely visit again.

Author: Ks PJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: "Nothing To Rave About" Burger
Review: I am a burger lover and I was impressed by the number of people having lunch at the restaurant during weekend lunchtime as I was walking by their KLCC restaurant. There was even a queue of people waiting to be seated. So I returned that evening to try their burger. But I'm afraid I was not impressed. Maybe it's because I travel the world trying burgers whenever I can, but, even within Malaysia, I would not rate their burger as good. OK-lah only....

Author: vapelle19
Title: Poor Service.
Review: The service is poor. We had to wait every time we need device. The food is not so " Hakka like " as we expected.

Author: JohnandBridgetTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Average
Review: Went on a quiet evening so only 1 other table occupied by a guy the waitress seemed to know quite well..We had a lamb curry which was more like a stew and bland and yee me with chicken which had nice flavours..drinks were also nice..unfortunately everything was let down by the service..the waitress was more concerned about making eyes at the guy at another table that we didn’t get any service..we never got offered desert so just left and went elsewhere...

Author: rickyshinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very poor service
Review: Had lunch here 2 days in a row on a business trip. The first day we dined at around 3:30pm for a late lunch. Was told about 20 mins after ordering that one of the dishes was not available. Gee thanks.Second day lunch we had 7 people and the orders took an HOUR to arrive. This is totally unacceptable as people have schedules and meetings to attend.

Author: kokhap90
Title: This restaurant was great with the meals and cakes!
Review: This restaurant was located at a corner of the street and the atmosphere there was fantastic, classical decoration and clean.I had ordered the Chicken croissant & Salad, the taste was excellent!Besides that, we also order a few slices of cakes, it was a great choice of dessert after your meal.Overall, we have a wonderful time here. WIll pay a visit again next time.

Author: koksengy
Title: Cosy, good food, fast service
Review: Had lunch with friends. Service was fast. Taste of food was good but portion a bit small. Clean, cosy ambient with nice décor. Even the toilet was cosy. Maybe, that was why price was a bit on the high side.

Author: jjourjon
Title: Terrible place ….
Review: I am French and my wife is from Melaka and I have been totally shocked by the bad and arrogant attitude.The place is definitely not friendly towards family and kids. We were received with attitude and discouraged to enter by the owner (?) insisting on the waiting time.Initially mentioning 1h waiting time then gradually saying it would be 1h30 mins while telling us not to wait inside but outside in the street near the road … obvious choice and very wise (I am sarcastic) when waiting with 5 kids of less than 9 years old of ageSuch business should not be recommended at all as it seems the philosophy is pure money making …

Author: francoise r
Title: Italian Street Food night
Review:
Absolutely superb. Food fabulous, atmosphere great and a lots of fun. Fantastic night.
Lorenzo and his staff created a wonderful evening.

Author: szetwinnePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Might not consider to go back
Review: My friend really wanted to try out this place as the decor outside was pretty interesting and a new pork place has always been attractive to us. When we got in, we felt the menu was confusing. No doubt the cashier was really friendly and tried to explain to us how the sets works, but somehow me and my friend couldn't really understand the menu. No doubt the ribs were delicious but the fries we received were cold, we didn't bother to request to change as we were not really impress with the food at the place.

Author: shery98
Title: Perfect atmosphere
Review: Good atmosphere! Excellent service by Shawn! Definitely a place to check out if you want to chill and have a good drink.

Author: irisbootlurnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Aesthetic Site and Neat Food
Review: I go to Cubs and Cups with my friends because I don't have a dog, yet I still love them. Lots of people bring their dogs and there are strict rules as to how trained and healthy your dog must be. Clesaning tools available for your dog. The food is a bit pricey, but very delicious and comes looking gorgeous for instagram picture . Wild milkshakes, and very good acai bowls and salads. Would definitely recommend the sweet potato fries.

Author: cossiefamilyWellington, New Zealand
Title: Reflections of the past
Review: If you love things that never change and a dining experience in KL which allows you to step back in time while tasting signature dishes from bygone colonial das this is your place. I appreciated that places like this are still operating and the waiters still politely serving while the modern city races and grows up around them. The old time planter bar , eclectic customer base and the bibs for sizzling steak served at your table add to the charm. Apparently there are rooms upstairs available for accommodation and would love to try these in future. Thank you for never changing !!

Author: may081Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A total rip off
Review: Had my Mother's Day lunch here .. Food really did not taste good ... We ordered mostly vegetarian dishes . It was a total disappointment . The vegetable curry could have been renamed long bean curry ... Tasteless and a total rip off ! Papa dons were soaked in oil ! They have totally compromised their quality for cheap ingredient at a premium price !Better off in any other Indian outlet in kl ...

Author: AESKMelbourne, Australia
Title: Worst oxtail pasta I've ever had
Review: This is by far the worst pasta I've ever had recommended by the waitress. The pasta was just filled with fat! It was disgusting! And they didn't do anything on the bill. Such a disgrace. I even found twigs of thyme which they should remove. I feel sick from eating there !!!

Author: CathyGP2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rustic hygiene
Review: Went to this place after a year when the food was of a higher quality. Ordered the prawn, sotong and chicken curry with banana leaf. The free vegetables with the banana leaf was nothing to shout about. The meat dishes were tasteless. The prawn and sotong was stale which was cooked with an overpowering of spices to blanket its staleness. The place to wash hands is really horrible, dirty with rusting pipes. Situated at the back of the shop, while walking along, one gets an idea of the low level of cleanliness practised by the restaurant. These guys should be able to provide a more hygienic place for washing hands. I will not be going back to this restaurant with the low quality of food and cleanliness. There is no price list of the food which is against government regulations.

Author: thechef494Paris, France
Title: Worst Pizza of my life and this is not a joke
Review: We asked for Calzones : nice price 5€...But It was more a burger rather than a pizza: -bread is ok-beefsteak was not okay (who puts beefsteak in a pizza anyway)-onions ??? (Is this a kebab?)-salami (horrible)-almost no cheese-ham or sausage I can’t tell but it reminds me of plastic-one other unidentified ingredient I think that this could be consider as a crime in Italy, no kidding Italians avoid or you will have an heart attack...This was really not a pizza and certainly not a calzone. I am just a tourist, really surprised by the good review of this so called pizza restaurant....

Author: 933zeldak
Title: Dinner near the river
Review: This place is lovely. Good service. Very nice menu and excellent food. We had a good time. But they need to get their own Toilet facilities.

Author: Mmyen
Title: Good Dining Experience
Review: Nice food and the price is on high side. Overall it's a good place for romantic dinner or close family gathering. I'll be back!

Author: KenWan118
Title: Dinnerin heart of the city
Review: Fantastic service By Mr Martin,aiza and Irene,nice food and good experience ,come to enjoy your wonderful nite with friend or love one

Author: Fatnutzw8Basildon, United Kingdom
Title: Met friends there
Review: If you ever want to sit in a busy kitchen and eat here's the place, basic but tasty as hell, I had tandoori chicken bread and curry sauce on the side with a ice lemon tea in a beaker, wonderful so fresh and tasty please try

Author: Sealed77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Duck= OK, Service = Slow
Review: Stumble across this restaurant while looking for food after a long drive from KL. As my colleague and I came in we saw that there were just two tables occupied, a little skeptical but proceeded to order. Not familiar with this restaurant and with the recommendations from the waiter we stick to the common dishes: rice, mix vege, butter prawn and of course Duck (half a duck as we were hungry). Took them almost 30 mins to cut and serve an already roasted duck to our table and had to wait another 5 mins for the vege and another 10 mins for the butter prawn. I ordered an extra rice but it never arrive to our table. Waiter was apologetic, I guess our hungry and angry faces were too obvious. Below are the ratings base on our experience in the scale of 1 to 5:Duck : 3/5 (Ok, not bad nor great)Mix Vege: 2/5 (Too small portion for 2 person and cost RM12) Butter Prawns: 4/5 (It was fine, just fine)Service: 2/5 (Slow but friendly)Price: 3/5 (Would give a higher rating if the portion matched the price)Chances of going back to this restaurant? Slim to none.

Author: kapireviewKlang, Malaysia
Title: Neat Place to Enjoy the Meal
Review: This is the main restaurant for Chi Liung people to have a homemade breakfast.All the foods served here Halal,as far as i know.U have to go on time to enjoy foods there and most of the time will be occupied.The restaurant a bit small,so not that suitable if you go with family mote than 5 people on peak hours.Personally l,I don't prefer here due to the price a abit expensive compared to other indian restaurant.Drinks will be taste worst sometimes,try order Teh O and try your luck.But i give 4 star for the cleanliness and such a friendly staffs.Forgot to tell,some foods we have to self service.Good job Love Mom.

Author: hsswu
Title: Leisure session after work
Review: Free welcome drink for lodging in Lime Tree Hotel. Nice place to chill out. It was close to Christmas so it has good ambiance every corner of the Hotel and Lounge.

Author: MichaelHenniganKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Healey Mac's outlet in the Publika Shopping Centre in Kuala Lumpur, is an authentic example of an excellent Irish pub.
Review: When I first came to KL in 2003 there were a number of Irish pubs called Finnegans and have been closed since then. We are fortunate that two Irishmen decided to open several outlets in the city and the Publika pub is one of my locals.It has a warm wooden decor, with good food, well-pulled pints of Guinness and importantly, lots of friendly staff.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: CharlieH695Windsor, United Kingdom
Title: A warm welcome, good beer and good food!
Review: We found Healy Mac's on our second night in KL. It's a couple of minutes from or hotel, The Shangri-La and 5 minutes from the Petronas Twin Towers. It's got a really chilled vibe, nice and relaxed with a really great team of people. Everyone we met was so friendly and welcoming and the Managers make a point of personally welcoming as many people as possible (nice touch if you're new in town). It's a typical Irish Bar (no really, it is) in the heart of KL. Good, freshly cooked food. The carbonara pasta is great, the pizzas are really good and the burgers are great too. Everything is freshly cooked and has a lovely home cooked taste.We also tried the bar snack and they were huge! There really is something for everyone. The music is good (80's/90's) and you can watch live sport on the numerous big screens. It's also great just to sit out front and watch the world go by!The service is excellent! Friendly and professional, a real Irish (style) welcome!It's extremely good value for money too!I must mention Paddy. He made us feel super welcome! A really charming guy who looked after his customers like royalty. Look out for him and give him our regards. He's a gem!So no surprises, we visited 4 times during our stay and I would recommend it to anyone!Thanks Healy Mac's and thanks Paddy!
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Docrheena
Title: Surprised
Review: I have seen this place every weekend but always thought it was just a burger joint ( I don't fancy burgers) but most of the other restaurants were full for lunch. We ordered the Vietnamese burger ...I have to say it was delish! I truly enjoyed it, my tastebuds were actually tantalised after that! and the lamb ragout was very good too. Definitely impressed. I would go back to try out something else and service was fine except for a staff who was totally zoned out...her thoughts were elsewhere..oh well we all have our problems! cheers!

Author: BayAhTreecePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bad service but good food !
Review: We made reservation for Fuego but it was raining heavily so we had no choice but to move to Strato. We were waiting for someone to assist us about half an hour but no one was there to help. The food and atmosphere were great! If only the service was better

Author: LJ_CanToronto, Canada
Title: Bad Start
Review: When we got there all the tables were full. Seeing that people just paid and were leaving we waited for the table, which by the time we walked over to was given away to locals. so they set us up a new one at the far end. From here we could not hear the music and were kind of forgotten. Finally we ordered, ten minutes later the waitress comes back and says they don't have what one of us want. We change the order and then receive our meals about ten minutes apart. Either eat alone or let the food get cold waiting for the other. The location is good.

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very Good Meal
Review: At Jake's one can always be assured of a good meal with excellent service to match.I should know because I have always had a good meal at Jake's especially when I am in the mood for a Black Angus Steak.Our recent visit to Jake's confirms this point. We were shown to our table promptly. I opted for a Black Angus Steak and my wife chose a Rack of Lamb. Both dishes turned out to be excellent.I must also commend the staff for their courtesy and attentiveness,Overall, it was another great meal at Jake's.

Author: JuneramadanMalaysia
Title: Terrible service
Review: As me and my partner went there at peak hour on a Sunday, the place was almost full, so we decided to sit at the smoking area. We were ushered by 'Jeraida' or that is how its pronounced, very rude with bad attitude wasn't hospitable at all. Took us ages to get the waiters noticed whenever we needed their assistance as no one even bothered to be in charge of the smoking area.Note that anyone could've walked away easily without paying the bills. Nothing to brag about the dim sum, had better elsewhere. Very dissapointing.

Author: barchart184
Title: Typical local Food Court
Review: Good selection of dishes from the region, so dining out as a group there is something for everyone. Good food in the hustle and bustle of local life

Author: claireyap0913
Title: Excellent food and price reasonable.
Review: Excellent food and price reasonable. Cozy places and good environment with awesome staff here.. high recommend and definitely will come back again

Author: kualalumpur900Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food and service - Top Class in Curate
Review: We had Sunday brunch in Curate restaurant. The food as well the service were outstanding and we will definitely come back. A very attentive crew makes this place an enjoyable and wonderful experience. Special cudos to Mr. Adham who is an excellent host and pays attention to every wish of his guests. Thank you from Austrian Embassy/Commercial Section for this marvelous Sunday Brunch !
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: Vicknoben VSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good lunch deals, but was put off with bad manners
Review: The lady at the counter needs to be more customer centric and not stuck up. Was there for lunch with friends but was treated rudely by this person. I've been patronizing Social's from the day it was open and never had such treatment before. Hope the management will do something about it.

Author: flor-eveStoke-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Best Indian ive ever ate!
Review: The quality of the food is amazing! Freshly made (what we ordered was anyway) and the service is friendly and helpful! It's such good value for money- we shared one of the set meals (we asked for the mildest) We were advised brilliantly. We ordered an extra naan. It was enough for us (if anything too much). The dish came with so many things to try, it was so delicious and enjoyable.

Author: ChrisDevonDXBDubai
Title: Didnt meet expectations
Review: An nice venue with excellent atmosphere and good music, but the restaurant isn't well managed, the waiting staff are not on point and you constantly trying to get their attention. The food is ok but we had high expectations and it didn't live up to its name.

Author: Ozzishane
Title: Great steak, basic setting
Review: Suzi's is all about the steak and beer. All the food we have got was great, but the steak is the beat in KL

Author: ManuelaKiran KSydney, Australia
Title: A must go establishment in Langkawi at the Danna
Review: My wife and I stayed at Danna Property in April(first week onwards)We visited the Planters restaurant for their weekly Friday night BBQ. The food was a mix of both traditional and modern cuisine. We were spoilt for choice and bit more than we could chew :-) We would highly recommend everyone who visit Langkawi to try the Planters restaurant at the Danna.But the main thing that stood out that evening was the amazing service we got. The stafff are so friendly and warm. They make sure that every guest is comfortable. They will even go get the food to your table so you do not even need to get up and walk to the BBQ stations. They are very knowledgeable and can explain each of the very many dishes on the menu. The FnB manager Mr. Yeray is awesome!! He walks around and makes sure each guest is happy and is taken care . He has a great sense of humor and this helps in breaking the ice with the guests. Thanks Yeray!And thank you everyone at Planters for making all our visits (including breakfasts) so memorable during our stay.

Author: dbasha
Title: A total letdown !
Review: We went there for lunch recently but there was no paddy field to see from the restaurant! There was only incomplete construction and a wall which completely obscured the view. And the prices were very high. Simply not worth the trouble.

Author: VK K
Title: Buffet Lunch
Review: Amazing Hospitality Attitude by Vasco's crews Sanjai & Ramlah at Hilton KL. Good ambience! Keep up your good work!

Author: Kuropon
Title: It's terrible
Review:
I decided to have a visit after I read good reviews (and also great number of Facebook likes on the page). I was really looking forward to have a nice dinner there. 
The staff and environment is quite good but the food it's just so...More

Author: Hani SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hi Tea buffet with amazing view of the city
Review: Me and my family got a chance to dine here during their hi tea. Selection of food was not that extensive for the price we paid (and we got ours via a Groupon deal). The menu has both local and international light dishes. The kids however were more excited to enjoy the view rather than have their meal. It is definitely the restaurant that you go to for the winning view and food second.Handy tip : Go to Malaysia Groupon website for deals. You can save quite an amount of money.

Author: Feb F
Title: Charged extra beer when I didnt order
Review: Dr Jackson handed me the check and I was going to pay when my curiosity kicked in and I checked the bill, yup there was it, an extra pint of beer in my account!!!I think this is a trend there to charge foreigners who dont care to check their bills...

Author: haidarove
Title: Ok
Review: Pricey but good place .. Average food taste it would not be amazing but ok .. They serve shisha and the double Apple tastes good .. Lemon mint juice is watery !!

Author: D5311FFgrahambBiggin Hill, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: Recommended by our driver from Shangri la hotel. Andrew the owner is a extremely congenial host greets you cordially as does all the staff but enough of the big words. Food is superb, great value for money and as a lot of people have said have the half meals so you can try more of the menu. Will be back again before we leave next week.

Author: Hugo BIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Very Bad breakfast
Review: I was staying in the hotel that the restaurant is attached too and I can say that the breakfast I had was horrible. I had the breakfast burrito and it was just slopped together. The coffee, juice and breakfast were all served at different times. Bad experience.

Author: Zhenlohas
Title: Nice japanese resto
Review:
Nice tasty n fresh japanese food n beautiful environment
Good service wth smiling faces
Great place for family dining

Author: 278nicholasy
Title: Food quality is below expectation
Review: The choice of din sum is less and taste of food is terrible. Compare to few years ago, quality of food is drop significantly. Not worth to visit if you have other choice.

Author: 794susiehDevon, United Kingdom
Title: So modern that it's weird.
Review: Went with friends and had the strangest meal EVER.Duck confit on toast to start - that was pretty tasty. Main course was a lamb flat bread. I only selected that as I didn't fancy duck confit on a waffle with a fried egg... My meal was a small flat bread with what I can only describe as a British lamb kebab (generally eaten when drunk) with radish slices and peas sprinkled on it, very odd....Pudding (which was a kind gesture of a gift from the chef) was vanilla ice cream and choccy mouse with thyme glaze.... Thyme glaze doesn't work.... Really unusually horrid.Don't think I'll be back.

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ...stale bread,cold coffeee and ants in sugar and coffee
Review: ...i regretted dragging hubby to this joint about 2 years back,seemingly after a reporter wrote about the ambience and old "feel" of this place...so i insisted we shud go for it and try the evening toast and kaya with coffee.....it was horrid a middle aged chinese waiter attended to us,we were the only patrons,table cloth was stained...coffee was cold and had ants in it...white sugar had ants in it and the toast was nothing great,of course for the rest of the evening had to listen to hubby raving about the place altogether,hope things are different now.

Author: MariaPetalingJayaPetaling Jaya
Title: Nothing Special
Review: Nice quiet place away from the hustle and bustle of Bangsar Telawi Area. Good ambience, good service but the food was nothing special. The bread was too soft, the pasta and the risotto swam in oil, impossible to finish and the the risotto's aspargus were basically non-existent. Apart from that the risotto had hardly any taste. Maybe we were just unlucky, because I have eaten there before.

Author: c20travelbugLeicestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Poor service over priced
Review: We attended for a family meal to celebrate a bday on an overnight stay in KL. we were staying the Le Meridian, next door.We had arrived and were seated at8.30pm. There were only 4 other tables of diners. We were rushed to order. The staff were extremely unhelpful when asked for some advice on recommended fish dishes.
