They had sold out of their signature dish of duck. We ordered a 1xpot if tea and were charged for 5xpots (of expensive tea). The food arrived and was good food but extremely over priced for the portion and quality. We were aware the restaurant closed at 10pm, however were were not offered dessert and were given the bill at 9.40, as soon as out plates had been cleared. For the price of the meal and the location of the restaurant, in a central area in an international hotel, I would expect much better hospitality and service. We had been charged for an additional dish on our bill which we had not ordered. Extremely disappointed. Would never recommend.

Author: rr77ukStamford Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and setting at "The Restaurant, The Andaman.
Review: We had 5 breakfasts and 4 evening meals at this restaurant. Food superb, steaks and sea food and the service 100% and the setting overlooking the swimming pool and forest simply great. I could write too much much about this restaurant, come and see / taste the food!!

Author: summerkopiteaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth trying
Review: Service from waiting to serving us was great. We had chicken rice balls, half chicken (mixed white and roasted), assam pedas fish, sambal kangkong, stir-fry kailan & prawn omelettewe didnt enjoy the rice balls maybe coz we are not used to the texture. the fish & stir-fry kailan is must try..

Title: Two Thumbs up!
Review: We enjoyed our authentic Peranakan dinner at Samfu on the 23rd of September, especially their Ayam Pongteh which went well with their home made sambal belacan. The Babi Garam was excellent and so was their fried fish with cili garam. Two thumbs up!

Author: ALONSO10BARCELONA
Title: Good cuisine but very bad service.
Review: The Teppanyaki menu was excellent, very tasty and well cooked in front of us. Both the welcome service and the service were terrible and non-existent.

Author: KLCollings
Title: Nothing available
Review: Ok. I get it. It’s a holiday and it’s been busy but why bother staying open if more than half of the menu isn’t available? However, trying to stay positive, we decided to change our choices and order something that was on the menu - except not the bread of that sandwich. “It is something else”. Ok what kind of bread is it? Have to go check. We pressed on, mistake. We ended up with the Hangover sandwich. Eggs were nice but that was it. It was served on a tiny plate with huge slices of bread that muted any flavor of the inside ingredients. Cheese was barely there. Can’t hardly eat the thing without it falling all over the table due to the big bread and tiny plate. They forgot the bacon and hurriedly served bowl of almost raw fat with a few pieces of beef - on the side. When the server asked if everything was ok and we said not really - we got giggles and stares and he walked away. Whatever! If they don’t care about the quality of food they put out then shame on them. So disappointing. So many people turned away at the host desk due to unavailability of menu items. They were smart. Wish we’d done the same.

Author: f00dhuntKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Loan shark parking in Restoran Hakka
Review: Was there for a decent meal with friends. However, their car parking was suppose to be free for patron restaurants which was run by Indian people who does not allow you to park and charge RM4 flat parking rate.Worst more, upon collecting car, the Indian "car jockey" supposedly refuse to return and charge surcharge RM10 as its their outside "working hours". No point arguing since they dont listen to you but the experience makes me feels its not worthwhile a trip there anymore as it's run by gangster car parker which was suppose to be "free for those who want to have a good decent meal together).

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Alright?
Review: The place is always pack here especially during weekends but seriously do not know why the food is enjoyed so much by the diners. There is a huge selection of food and it is very difficult to decide on what to eat. In the end, we ordered their special sweet potato balls (which I don't find it that amazing to say the least), beef noodles (which was ok) and some seafood & chicken set (portion was too big for me but i found this to the best of what we ordered). And the point was that everything that we ordered was their recommended dishes.For dessert, we had one of those ice snow thing which look huge but the taste wasnt there. it was so difficult to stir as it was like a mountain. and after eating the top, the bottom part was just like eating shaved iced.

Author: Andrew C
Title: Wide Range for Breakfast
Review: Wide selection for breakfast. - Beside the usual section. They actually had a teppanyaki station for breakfast though I never order from it.- Served both English style and Nanyang coffee, Teh Tarik and Milo. - like it that Juice were all freshly squeeze.- The omelette at egg station was excellence.- Staff were friendly.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Tiptop7787Malaysia
Title: Buffet in style
Review: Great experience for a Japanese buffet. Average food presentation however taste was good. Service team was handling it well even though it was quite busy, taking our order and serving it in a timely manner. There is point that all of us would like to recommend this place is to even though there is a menu but at kampachi EQ, they are able to arrange the food samplers for us , in that way we can always reorder if we like it. Great effort form the Chef and service team at Kampachi EQ. Will definitely revisit in near future.

Author: Tracey and Mart... BSydney, Australia
Title: Very expensive for what you get, however good views
Review: We were also very disappointed with the buffet food that was available at this restaurant. We went for lunch and paid extra for the window seat, which was worthwhile however I agree with one of the previous reviewers, we would have been better just going to the observation deck and eating somewhere else. The drinks are ridiculously expensive at over $75.00 AUD for a bottle of Californian wine that wasn't even nice. The restaurant was also extremely noisy with children running around everywhere. Don't go here if you are after a romantic evening.

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya food in modern settings
Review: We were recommended by a friend and we were pleasantly surprised that it was in such comfortable and contemporary setting, which is not usual for a Nyonya restaurant in Melaka. The menu is small, and we chose the chicken wings, chicken limau perut, sambal sotong and laksa. The dishes were not very big in size, but big on flavours! Delicious, spicy dinner.We ended with a bowl of cendol, which was the best cendol we had in Melaka thus far (and we had plenty). Service was only so-so, an Indian chap there was not very friendly and was pretty surly from the moment we entered.

Author: EarlyRetirementAbroaPrinceton, New Jersey
Title: Too expensive
Review: The dining hall is nicely decorated; the menu has just a few vegetarian options.We ordered Season Salad (RM 22!), hummus (soo delicious, but expensive RM19!), baba ghanoush (good, RM 19), and lemon mint drink (RM 17 vs RM15 in other places). All was served with Arabic bread (very good)We did not have a cozy feeling “welcome to our place”, plus the waiter spoke very little English. Thanks to manager, who was near table to ensure that our order will be taken correctly. Additionally, the place is overprices.

Author: Bear00786
Title: Mixed review...
Review:
Went once the food was great.
Went second time  the beef had past  its best before date.
Had  a mouth full and couldn't eat it the meet was bad.

Author: carynjen13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I Don't Like It!
Review: I thought the food will be good seeing how old fashioned is the place, but I was wrong. I ordered a Lemongrass Juice but when it came it was soooo Limey, might as well call it Lime Juice. I told the worker the drink does not taste like Lemongrass at all but he had an attitude (the one where hair cover his forehead, no offense but scruffy looking), he debated with me and said it is Lemongrass juice, so I asked have you had Lemongrass juice before? He grunted and brought my drink back to the counter and said loudly to the guy who did the drink, this is not Lemongrass (sarcastically).He brought it back, I tasted it there was no difference. I left the whole thing untouched. Like I said Lime Juice. The nasi lemak was terrible, the chicken was so dry and tough. The sotong sambal was okay.I like the caramelized chicken (I think it's chicken), this tasted the best among all the dishes. When we paid the bill, a chinese man was nice, he said probably there is too much lime in the drink so I can't taste the lemongrass, and how come we didn't eat the petai, I replied we don't eat petai and he said we can ask for no petai. The food that we had was not great, my drink was a bust, the attitude of that one foreign worker kill my mood. I would not recommend this place.

Author: dwoodwar7KL
Title: A favorite destination in KL
Review: Our family has greatly enjoyed visiting Chakri Palce in KLCC on multiple occasions. The mango chicken is a favorite of our young kids, and the quality of food and the convenient location are big benefits. During a recent visit with friends, we greatly enjoyed some delicious food and, as always, the gracious help from the staff. The friendly greeting and encouragement from the manager/owner was a help in ordering as well as making a memorable meal. It has some good food and is wonderful to get quality Thai food easily.

Author: edyTBD
Title: Great selection of beers from all around the world
Review: Good place to meet with friend during world cup and great selection of beers from around the world, Belgium, Korea, Japan, Sweden, German, England and etc. They have good porky meals to chose as well.

Author: Siti Norazah Z
Title: Cosy Venue, friendly staff, shame about the food
Review: We returned to Las Carretas last Feb after it went off our dining radar for a few years. We had enjoyed quite a number of dinners there with friends and family back then. The service was friendly as always. Alas, we found the food quite disappointing; everything our party of four ordered. Perhaps because it was a Sunday of a long weekend. (We were, in fact, the only diners) I would like to think so.

Author: HappycookiesKl
Title: 5 star ambience 1 star service and food
Review: 1. Called to ask if there is an afternoon tea menu and they told me "mam, only ala carte"2. Do I need to book? "No, mam, you could walk in"3. Upon arrival, we ordered from ala carte. Later on we see another table eating a 2-tier afternoon set. So, i called the waitor/manager and asked who I spoke to on the phone and nevermind, why wasn't I given the menu anyway. They gave me lame excuses.4. Summary- nice ambience (super hot though!) horrible food though. We spent rm300 on samosas, sandwiches and juices that was really bad. (See my photo if bruschetta) 5. Don't spend your money here if you're local- you get better value, service and food in Bali or Krabi.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: FizahRomanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced!
Review: Friendly service, but waiting time its really slow just for yogurt lassy took 10 minutes to arrived while is no customer and only us. Food was great but very small portion from what we paid, this's over -rated price!Unfortunately we had decided not to come back due over price, frankly this's just a restaurant not a 5 star hotel.

Author: JhzhongSingapore
Title: Lovely place and awesome food experience
Review: Its got to be one of the best dining experience I have tried. The food portion is big and really good. As we cannot see the plating the food, we can taste and smell how well the food was prepared. Definitely worth a try.

Author: leesing2kAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: An average bowl of mee (for this price)
Review: At this higher price point, you will be expecting higher quality. But it does not meet the expectation. The quality of the noodle (most important) is not meeting the requirement. It is just an average noodle. The broth is not bad but it is too salty. The chashu (the meat) is very nice. Basically, not worth the price.

Author: banskoboy2013
Title: Overrated
Review: Nothing special, corn on the cov was uncooked-unedible, fries were full with cooking oil, sunday roast was still alive. The mushrooms were great and the service polite.

Author: FransiscaNJakartaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Don't judge the book by its cover!
Review: Traditional food court at the corner of jalan ampang under the fly over. Don't get fooled by the appearance as the food is really good especially the tenderloin steak and chicken satay!Very cheap indeed! RM 32 for the steak!! Ask for medium rare and it's perfect!

Author: tck90823
Title: Restaurant spoiled by the arrogant chef
Review: Nice restaurant with nice ambience but spoiled by the arrogant chef. Food was served quite slow and we found a fly in one of the dishes. We confronted the staff and the chef came and arrogantly told us that is was a bee instead of a fly. He was trying to treat us as a fool with such lies. Even if it is a bee in the food, it is also not acceptable. Would you accept your food being served with a bee in it? Actually, just a simply apology will do but the chef chose to give stupid excuses. His attitude towards us was also very arrogant with no sense of apology. Well, there is not only one peranakan restaurant around. We still have other choice.

Author: najidiMale
Title: The best restaurant bar in Kuching sarawak (Siniawan)
Review: This is my second visit to kuching siniawan and i did not find any better place to go and have a chill drink. Since my first visit i was planning to come back to this beautiful bar in siniawan night market, The Bikalan. The food, bites, and the drinks are really good at bikalan. A huge compliment to the owners Andy & Grace,who trained all the staff so well that they keep treating each and customers so professionally, the smiles of bikalan , the lovely chat with the staff keep us coming back to bikalan every time i visit kuching. One thing i like more about bikalan is the variety of drinks at the bar. I recommend anyone traveling to kuching its a must visit place. I will definitely keepComing back to the bikalan each and every time i visit here.Special thanks to Andy, Grace and all the staffs for giving us an unforgettable memories during this holiday. You guys really brought happiness to many of the visitors come here.Keep up the great work.Looking forward to visit the bikalan again.You are the best in whole sarawak.

Author: lillyjo6363Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing Dinner
Review: My family and I visited the Sunway Velocity branch this evening 19th Jan. for dinner, which would likely be our last! After taken to our seats, none of the Captains even came to take our order or even introduce any dishes for the night, instead were at the back, chatting away, and making it difficult to get their attention. To make matters worse, were the disappointing quality of one of the food which was the Fish maw and Loofa soup, which had a strong oily taste and was not well-cooked. The soup tasted like water with soya sauce, which we made it known to the female supervisor but wasn’t given a satisfactory explanation, and instead seemed as if we were making a fuss! We would assume the quality of both the food and service to be present with the reputable Grand Imperial Group, but we were let down. Thank you.

Author: EA2013
Title: Good ambience
Review: My first time visit this place, been recommended by friend.. they have a good coffee, good food and good ambience. Perfect place for hangout 😊👍👍

Author: Euphorion1World
Title: Wonderful surprise
Review: ￼Euphorion1 (3 reviews)WorldWe came to Kuala Lampur on a birthday trip for my girlfriend. I had been looking for the right time to propose. After eating and wandering around Changkat Bukit Bintang, and finding the party atmosphere not really our thing, we saw Cielo up above and decided to check it out. The restaurant itself is very nice. They have done a great job of separating the space and making it feel pretty intimate even though the city is spread out before you. The view is wonderful. We came there after dark, but I can only imagine it at sunset. We didn't have dinner as we had already eaten but the menu is pretty impressive and the presentation is very well done. I don't drink, but the mocktails were some of the best I've had (flavor and presentation were top notch) and I expect this extends to the cocktails as well. The service was wonderful. Liang and Yating were attentive and obliging without being overbearing. It was the perfect ending to a perfect day, and I proposed. Thanks to Cielo and staff for making everything wonderful. When I came to write this review I wasn't at all surprised to learn that Cielo is rated the best restaurant in the city on trip advisor. It's the perfect place for a special occasion. Looking forward to coming back for dinner. Thanks again.

Author: shakou19
Title: taste is for Japanese.
Review:
I visited around lunch time. Almost seat is full. Turist, business, local, there are many people!
The taste is very good. It seems to be suitable for Japanese who likes soy sauce.

お昼時に行きましたが、ほとんど席は埋まってました。観光客やビジネスマン、地元の人などたくさんいました。
味はとてもおいしく、醤油好きな日本人にはぴったりです。

Author: sitimaryamm2020Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Le méridien Kuala Lumpur
Review: The food is good portion & delicious.Hafizi has give us pleasant services and make us comfortable and cosy.amazing meal

Author: mrscrispy2Perth, Australia
Title: Average
Review: Ok pub food. Nothing to write home about. The place on the river is lovely but the slow services and average food let down what could be a great place. The menu is very small which I could deal with if there was a variety. A simple salad would be great - no vegetarian options. Only really burgers, sandwiches, and fried foods.

Author: Narmitha
Title: Lame restaurant
Review: I think I've ordered a vege kuew tiow but they serve me the kuew tiow with seafood such as shrimp and squid.. But labeled as vege on top of the box.. Is it that difficult to understand a simple order?? Next time please do hear properly and note it down.. Waste of my money because I can't eat it... When I asked whether can be cooked in vege? He said that okay sure no problem but didn't serve the order correctly...

Author: Amar_DanialPetaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Nice Presentation Average Taste
Review: The restaurant serves local delicacies and mostly Malaysian/Asian dishes. The price is a bit above average for the food but considering the rental that they have to fork out for their operating expenses - I guess it would make the price in the reasonable category. Food are serves in good presentation and restaurant is very clean. The waiters and waitresses are very attentive during non-peak period and one of the place to taste the food is you have the extra $$$$$ in your pocket ;)

Author: Matt7722The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: So simple and so complex
Review: To start the Guiness is as good as the Irish bar 50m away. To start I took ravioli with venison and a simple tomatoe sauce, thin pasta made the whole dish very light. After that I had veal with lemon sauce, perfectly cooked with the right amount of zest in sauce. Add this to your list of places to try.

Author: LynnC2551
Title: Food was terrible...
Review:
Had their apple salad and fish & chips. the fish&chips - fries should be the safest but it wasn’t nice at all. 

the ambience was ok nice view but toilet was badly managed.

Author: Shaqallan
Title: Overly loud and just average food
Review: Coming into the the 'fine dining' restaurant with a very loud band is beyond my comprehension. Due to the noise, we had to shout to the waiters to take our order and we could not have a proper conversation. When the food came, the chicken wings were too super spicy hot and the rest of the food was just 'safe'. The most ironic thing is that the kitchen was closed at 9.30 p.m. Made me wonder, what is the proper dining time for the restaurant?

Author: Brightitan
Title: Tasty but hefty & small
Review: Food tasty indeed but portion really small for the price. Was taken aback when served. Escargot is good but soup is so-so. For experience sake yes but rather pricey overall.

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: Yong Peng Fish balls was recommended by my friend in Melaka .However, according to them, their standards has fallen.As I was not very convinced,i went over to have their ikan parang (wolf herring) fish balls. It basically tasted average as in not so fishy but not "bouncy" to the bite. Not really worth the effort to eat there but if you are not too fussy,i guess it's ok

Author: youchengz2019
Title: Great food
Review: Great food and friendly staff, had the braised pork. Was juicy and seasoned very well, and wide selection of seafood

Author: jamhs
Title: Great steak!
Review:
Very enjoyable steak, great atmosphere and good drinks!

Arif was a good waiter with brilliant service.

Thank you

Author: Intan K
Title: The best
Review: I love the Nyonya that i ordered. Love the rice it tastes good. Also love the drinks called sunset was so nice and tasty. The nasi lemak cake is a must try!

Author: Richard  Dcruz W
Title: Casual
Review:
Good service 
Excellent staff - Honey Singh, Tej Singh always with smile
Wonderfully courtesy. Recommended , food is nice
Fried Chicken wing very tasty

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Outlet in Mid Valley and it is nothing compare to Greyhound Bangkok!
Review: Was there recently to try their foods at the Mid Valley outlet. As I'm a loyal fan of Greyhound Bangkok and their foods are always top-notch with great service.What a disappointment! Service was lacklustre and not attentive at all. Maybe there are too busy or what, i still can accept this. However, when the foods came - huge disappointment! Their 1) spaghetti Carbonara serving is so watery seems like a soup base. 2) The deep fried salmon belly was so oily, 2) Friend chicken wing is ok and 4) another pasta dishes (with salted fish) was so salty that I don't even bother to eat it.Please buck up and live it to Greyhound Bangkok reputation!

Author: Van TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but v. crowded
Review: We aimed to avoid the crowd by getting lunch there about 1.45pm. Had to wait about 15 minutes to be seated ... and about 25 minutes before the food came.The chicken rice balls were small ... almost bite size which was good but suggests you need to order more. The chicken was also succulent and tender ... though not outstanding, taking into account the competition. The fried fish was a bit of a ripoff ... the wait staff had recommended it but we didn't find it exceptional -- the price maybe; it was more expensive than the chicken.One note is that they didn't allow/encourage adding to your initial order. I guess something about camping on a seat -- but its a little odd it seemed to not allow ordering more rice balls or chicken.All told its a better bet to eat here than in the Jonker Street Chicken rice ball shops wait wise ... it seems like a tourist trap at teh Jonker Street Chicken rice shops there ...

Author: MommyYoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Japanese French cuisine
Review: Cilantro has been around for a long time in KL and there is good reason for its staying power. The food is definitely one of the best in KL and although it may not be located in one of the newer, hipper buildings or hotels, I would recommend people to go seek out the place and try their food. Definitely world class. Pity they do not have any recognition from Michelin or Zagat.

Author: samchuahlKuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Will be back for more!
Review: We ordered the chef recommended dishes like " wah tan hor " and " yok kong hor" like both of the dishes. A regular customer shared table with us told braised chicken feet and steam octopus were another thumb up snacks that not to be missed.

Author: ErIcT4080Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Very bad experience!!!
Review: Me and my wife went for lunch at Cafe BLD at Renaissance JB Hotel. Flies are all over the food and no one pay attentions to it or shall I say no one cares about it. Food selections are limited. It's not worth the visit for expensive buffet, I won't recommend this restaurant.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: ManarY98
Title: Great night!
Review: I wanted to celebrate with my husband a special event but in a short time without pervious booking so it was hard to find the restaurants I like!I read about Nobu and it had good recommendation and ranking online and luckily I found a table for us on the same night!We were also lucky to get a table with a view beside the window...The ambiance was fine...location and view amazing..They serve Japanese food..the most delicious I ever tasted till now!!!Mouth watering appetizers whether hot or cold..yummy sushi and great juice cocktails!The service was great as well..so quick and efficient with friendly faces :)I'd only comment,that,tables are too close to each others that minimize the privacy!Over all experience is great and we had a very nice evening :)

Author: Sharada_QureshiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mexican at its best in KL!
Review: Fresca Mexican Kitchen and Bar just packs in all the right ingredients for a great time out with your family or friends ! The food is bursting with flavors, the menu not quite the usual tex-mex and refreshingly different, the service is superb, the decor and ambience is stylish, warm and chilled out ! Great bar...one of the best features. Overall, this is one of the few places that has day-time soul...great place for afternoon drinks. The two talented owners ( also sisters) have definitely got the formula right.

Author: Julie CGateshead, United Kingdom
Title: Expensive for what it is
Review: We came here for lunch so that we could sit in the air conditioning and regain a normal temperature after walking in the Perdana Park. Food was nice enough, my partner's was nicer than mine but fairly expensive, service was OK but again not outstanding. It's pretty cool when the hornbills and egrets come and hop about on the balcony but if you're going to visit the Bird Park anyway then it's not worth it just for that.

Author: Stefano-onthego
Title: Bad service
Review: The food is alright. Nothing special but good average Lebanese. What is unacceptable is the service. I asked for a shisha, after half an hour it did not came and I asked for the bill. No excuses no apologies. Not acceptable at all.

Author: alvinzaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rude, rude, rude. Just plain rude.
Review: Upon arrival, we were greeted by a male waiter who randomly pointed at an empty table. He then grabbed a few menus and threw them on the table after we were all seated. At first we thought that he was busy, thus the seemingly unfriendly behaviour. When we were ready to order, a lady (around her thirties) approached us with a REALLY grumpy face, and her attitude while taking our order was EXTREMELY TERRIBLE. It was as if being there in the restaurant was a big inconvenience to her. Being born and raised in Malaysia, my family and I understand that to be working in this particular industry, especially during the peak period is tough. However, the waitress's behaviour was totally inexcusable, she even told us to hurry up and tell her all our orders. She sighed, and clicked her tongue, and even rolled her eyes at us. She was so rude. Before the food even came, we all lost our appetites already. If you are someone who wouldn't care about the service despite paying service tax, this is the place to go. Cuz the food ain't that bad. Just the service.

Author: hidayah77
Title: not many choices ......
Review: bread variety is not a lot while pricing wise, considered reasonably high of course this is at pavi, so can't complain much  ey ....

Author: Sia65Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing special..
Review: My first visit to this restaurant. Felt that the food is not that fantastic. Probably over-rated. Waiters were too enthusiastic. After first waiter took our order, poured our drinks or checked if the Teapot was empty. Another would come within 1 minute to check again. It's quite disruptive for conversations.

Author: Raza-Jones
Title: Hard to knock the rock
Review: After a not so great start to our holiday in KL the night before at Saloma restaurant we needed a safe bet to redeem our faith in the city. Hard rock cafe was the place we chose as it was in walking distance and heard good things from the hotel staff. We didnt book and walked in. We were greeted by friendly Malay staff who in true hard rock style put on their best american accents and looked after us both from the minute we walked in. We ordered 2 main meals a couple of soft drinks and after some hesitation (full from the large portions) a dessert to share. Food was great but the night was made special by our chatty waiter and the live band. The band members were all over 50 and we got a bit worried, then they started to play 60's rock and the place went wild. Brilliant night out!!!

Author: Globe-Girdler2016London, United Kingdom
Title: Couldn't find the restaurant
Review: We hired a Grab car from our hotel - around 9 miles away after receiving the excellent reviews and to our astonishment - there was no such place. Our driver and I both asked the locals and showed them photos with no luck in finding a place. There was no sign outside a house or a restaurant to even minutely know that the place existed. We then had to order another Grab ride to another restaurant after being frustrated. The phone number on the listing doesn't even work so try calling them before you go or don't even bother. If the owners read this review - then I strongly recommend that they come back and say something about their location or own the business on Tripadvisor and change the address, if need be.

Author: BerniechiahumphriesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Authentic Nonya Food in Melaka
Review: Was there 3 days ago for Lunch. Had Chilli Crispy Fish, Udang Nanas, Belachan Kangkong, Aunty Lee Chicken with special sauce and Special Sambal Belachan with their best Chendol for dessert..They are all very Authentic Nonya Food and very delicious. This is a Must Try Authentic Nonya Food Restaurant then you will know the difference. Of Course there are many Nonya Food Restaurant floating in the Market in Melaka but how Authentic is their Nonya Food is another question..Have to Book in advance. Best is to text Jasmine @012-3980669 to make Advance Booking and place Order instead of calling Restaurant Line cos quite difficult to get through. She'll defiinetly call back. I'll always go back there to enjoy my Nonya Food each time I visit Melaka. If they can maintain their Standard, they'll be the Best Authentic Nonya Food Restaurant in Melaka.

Author: dashinsightsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre service and very
Review: Mediocre service and very mediocre food and over priced wines. The fish soup was horrible and so is the mushroom soup so I decided to only order a salad as my mains and left.

Author: cuttie10
Title: 'Rude'
Review: very rude services...without asking for bill they came and give the bill statement to pay....looks like they chasing out from the shop....scolding staffs infront of others.....

Author: ChanMLPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Grossly overrated nyonya restaurant
Review: It was highly recommended for us to have a meal at Amy's. This was a constant reminder from my frens aunt even before we reached Malacca. We were asked to book days' ahead to avoid disappointment.Making a phone call to Amy's already din impress us, a group of 11 frens. We were told she can't take bookings for 11!!!My friend was speechless since she was informed maximum she can accommodate was 10. The phone was passed to me and I finally managed to obtain a booking for lunch on Sunday. All geared to try out this place, we were there sharp at 12noon. We ordered majority of recommended dishes to try, alas to our disappointment more than half of the dishes were below average. Don't order seafood at Amy's, all was not fresh namely fish n prAwns. What we all agreed was good was nyonya fried noodles, chendol and ladies finger. The rest were mediocre and some were not palatable. Don't order the otak otak(steam fish wiv spicy paste). You can get the same thing at Baba Charlie's. It was a real disappointment.

Author: JessDoll
Title: Delicious!
Review: We came here because of the good recommendations that we read about The Steakhouse and our expectations were completely fulfilled. Our rib-eye steaks were delicious and perfectly cooked as we ordered. Kean, who waited our table, was kind and helpful and we felt very comfortable. We will definitely visit again!

Title: Horrible everything
Review: Horrible food and ugly service . Lady boss is especially rude and food prep environment is very disgusting .  Bad experience will never come again .

Author: paifaim
Title: Best meal in SG
Review: It’s a mazing how this meal make us remember for so long . Especially the staffs and their manager were so friendly and polite they helped os a lot to ordering food also for wine pairing, such a good memory!

Author: Happiness57708389985Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid
Review: Went to W twice in the last month. Both occasions went to the Wet Bar. First time just after restrictions on Malaysia allowed. Ordered food - 90 minutes later food not served. No one seemed to know or care what happened. I thought might have been a result of everything being closed for so long, so gave them the benefit of the doubt. Went again last night. Service better but staff really not very welcoming or organised. Used valet service. When we left waited 15 minutes for car to be brought around. Seems service just not their thing.

Author: Springchick1986
Title: Happy Hour specials
Review: There are many Happy Hour specials. Buy one pint get 1 free,  Buy one cocktail get one free,  5 bottles in a bucket special.    Good pizza.

Author: Sprattle
Title: Worst service ever!
Review: We waited for an hour an a half for our food to eventually be told in an aggressive way we never ordered any food!

Author: Christine LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hair found in our food
Review: We visited Chez Gaston again just before CNY and ordered from their set menu. Unfortunately there was hair in the sauce that came with the chicken we ordered. They have offered to change the food but after finding the hair in the food, our palate was gone. There should not be any compromise on hygiene at any eatery at all times!!!!

Author: YingL517
Title: Not bad
Review: Decent food at reasonable price in pavilion, which is not an easy find. Definitely will come back again

Author: SaifulJanisPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Good taste asam pedas
Review: Exact location Jln Laksamana 2, Taman Kota Laksamana. Belongs to Hajjah Mona. Actually a corner lot house. You can order in a set which includes asam pedas (choose your fish), bean sprout & rice. If you are an "asam pedas addict", this may disappoint you bcoz the asam is not that "powerful". For someone who prefers mild asam, this will be the choice.

Author: Petals23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unattended
Review: Waited for a good 15 minutes before anyone came and only to tell us the food will take 30 minutes or more to come. The table was never cleared. Waiter didn't bring the menu, don't think he had the intention to even take any order from us. I think its highly overrated

Author: noisyminor
Title: Friendly detailed service, 5-star quality dishes, comfortable simple settings
Review: My family and close friends frequent this small corner restaurant almost every week. It is that good! No joke! One may find its odd corner location and super simple setting strange. But don't let its down-to-earth appearance change your mind. Just find a place and relax.The menu offers the typical tandoor stuff (chicken n various nann breads and etc), rogan lamb, seafood curries and quite extensive vegetarian choices. It also offers (veg n non-veg) tali sets during weekday lunch time. But its best dishes are the briyani rice. I have to say the fish version is the best. And it us not often to see fish briyani on the menu unless it's a specialist shop. We also love its kerala paratha, which we don't often see in other restaurants too. I have to say this place does it the best among all the versions I have tried, including the ones from a famous Kerala specialty restaurant. (Should I name it here?!) I can confidently say that we have tried just about almost all dishes, perhaps except for the vegetarians. It is very difficult to find one we won't try again. Now, the service is plan amazing! The long time servers know their stuff. They can recommend the right dishes according to your liking and choices. Very rarely anything goes wrong, and if they accidentally do so, they make it up to the customers immediately without a second word. We have become friends with the friendly crew here over the years. By the way, you must try its Masala Tea and Carrot Halwa. Hands down.

Author: PeggieMalaysiaKuala Lumpur
Title: Food - good; hospitality - can be improved
Review: The dim sum at Chynna is of high standard - the fried radish cake and the charcoal lao-sa-pao are standouts in a sea of really great dim sums - BUT - yes, there is a big but... I made phone reservations and the person who took my reservation asked me if I wanted a room as there were 8 of us. I said yes, thinking how excellent Chynna was. However, today, after we had ordered the food, the captain came in to tell us that normally, there is a minimum spend for rooms - RM1,000. He observed that our orders would be significantly less than RM1,000 and urged us to order something else to push the bill higher so we could earn the privilege of being in a room. Management, do advise your guests of your rules before offering a room. If you inadvertently allow guests to use the room, swallow the 'loss' if your guests don't spend as much. Don't coerce your guests to spend more just so you can justify the use of the room. It is very off-putting. So 4 stars for the food but -2 stars for the room fiasco. Luckily, we were a group of friends and I wasn't entertaining business guests. We live, we learn I guess...

Author: nick130470Hat Yai, Thailand
Title: Rock bottom it is!
Review: Went ere with a friend who was visiting KL. We ordered 2 beers and as soon as they arrived we were presented the bill. The next round of beers we had to ask for our change otherwise we would not have seen it. 3rd round and again asked for our change which had not arrived even after we completed those beers. We were then told that we had not paid for those beers. When we questioned them about the bill always arriving as the beers were being served, we were told that we now gad a tab and we would pay at the end. Again, we questioned why the billing system had changed half way through our stay and got no answers. My friend then sees one of the staff making a punching gesture into his palm directed towards me. We refused to pay the bill again and walked out. Be careful and stay aware that you don't receive your change unless you ask for it and they bill you as they see fit for each round you buy. Never, ever again. If only I could rate it zero stars.

Author: interneta
Title: Very bad quality breakfast
Review: Would advice anyone to have food here. The croissant are dry, hard and cold. Choice of food limited. Quality extremly poor. Overpriced. (RM 20,90 per person for breakfast buffet)

Author: h-travels888Manila, Philippines
Title: Dilapidated - needs a major overhaul
Review: Had breakfast here with the Mrs and our toddler - the staff, the selection and quality of food was spot on, no issues there which is the saving grace of the cafe and what redeems it to get a one (terrible) rating, plus I don't think I can go lower than that.The cafe feels tired and old, way past its prime and definitely seen better days - just looking at the wear and tear of the cafe, one can tell its seen its fair share of guests and customers. Saying it needs a renovation would not be doing anybody any justice when what needs to be done it to give it a much needed overhaul. The ceiling is very low and the fixtures (lighting, walls, decorations) was probably installed in the early 90s and have been there ever since. Friendly tip:Prior to ordering your coffee inspect the cups as BOTH (yup not one but two) had lipstick stains on them

Author: Abdulelah A
Title: 360 view restaurant
Review: The restaurant got an amazing view where  you can see KLM city all from the top. The food was good and a lot of varieties and kinds of food. The services was good.

Author: Suryn SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing HOUR LONG WAIT!
Review: This place was highly recommended but turned out to be a far higher disappointment than I ever thought possible. Really sad. We had to brave Melaka's nightmarish traffic to find a park where many cars were double parked, then found ourselves in a queue waiting for tables, for about half an hour before we got a table. It was self-service so we had to queue to provide our order at the counter cum kitchen area- then WAIT for what seemed like hours to have our tables cleared and cleaned, before a RUDE waitress came by to DEMAND that we give her our order for drinks or have our food order further DELAYED- we came all the way from Selangor to sample their so-called famous intestines' satay and when our order finally arrived with people standing all around us waiting to take on our table, they had RAN OUT of the delicacy and told us to just take what they had or leave- others were waiting for our table. Not wanting to waste our table, we took our share and left with a terrible distaste- their famous pineapple sauce was watery and too sweet, and chicken, liver and pork satay nothing to shout about at all. I can't even believe how much it pains me to share this but SUCH A DISAPPOINTMENT!!!

Author: AK_travel_reviewLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Saturday buffet experience
Review: The setting of the restaurant is very appealing on the 13th floor of the DoubleTree hotel with great views of either the pool or the skyline and on to Singapore. The food available on the buffet covered a variety of cold antipasti (no seafood), a freshly made pizza station, a meat station serving chicken with peppercorn sauce, a fresh pasta station and a dissertation section. This was in no way a negative experience but I was not overwhelmed either. I had some bruscetta to start, followed by a slice of pizza, pasta with mushrooms chicken and cream and a chocolate brownie. The quality of the food was good even if the tastes were a bit blunt for my liking (but I may be biased since I am a great lover of Italian cuisine and miss no opportunity to have it locally). As expected, the staff were very friendly and attentive, always eager to assist which is a huge plus. A point of note, there appeared to have been an a la carte menu as well as the table next to me were both having a huge and delicious looking steak but I was not made aware of that going in. I will definitely try that next time.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Grace L
Title: Very disappointing
Review: It's not often a dining experience compels me to write a review, but my experience here at Meet the Porkers did just that.Let's get to it.Siew yoke briyani (RM28)You know what refrigerated leftover meat dishes look like when they're cold from the fridge? That's what we got. The briyani was served hot on the surface but the inside was a stiff, congealed mass I didn't first recognise as pork. Tasted it. It was still cold. Waiter showed no remorse and wordlessly took it back to reheat.Let's assume we got the regular, thoroughly reheated version everyone's supposed to get. It would still be the weirdest tasting briyani I've had, with disproportionately sized chunks of siew yoke and fat. I've had plain briyani in an Indian restaurant for 5 bucks that is far, far more fragrant, and this one has pork in it.It comes with fried pork lard (not crunchy), a raita of some kind (hard to tell, no cucumber in it) and another condiment I couldn't care to ask about.Bacon cheese naan (RM15)It's your standard naan with bits of bacon sprinkled around it. It was okay. Went well with the sauces from other dishes we ordered, but the curry it came with tasted generic. I really didn't think the meagre smattering of bacon bits justified the price tag.Butter Pork (RM30)Best tasting dish today.Palak paneer (RM22)This is what did it for me. Maybe the fusion thing wasn't going so well. At least get the true blue North Indian stuff right, right? Underwhelming. This was the lightest shade of green I've had palak in, as if there was too much cream. It wasn't nearly as aromatic or tasty as I know it to be.Garlic cheese naan (RM8)What cheese? Where? (We probably got a garlic naan instead)-----------Bill came up to $135, including a mango lassi I didn't sample, and 3 iced waters at $1 each. The waiters looked like they didn't know what they were doing, as they moved listlessly with a glazed expression on their faces. There was a point where a waiter left fresh food from the kitchen on a table that had leftover food (with used tissue, cutlery etc) from previous diners for a couple minutes, before figuring out which table to send it to.-----------TL;DR:Meet the Porkers is the place for you if you don't mind sub-par, soulless northern Indian 'fusion' food at unjustified prices with bad service.Food: 4/10Price: 3/10Service: 3/10Ambiance: 6/10

Author: E L
Title: Not worth the money
Review: Way too expensive for crepe. Totally not worth it and regretted it. Plus it's full of flies and no air conditioning. For that sort of cut throat pricing, I'd expect a higher standard.

Author: PabloDiddyAsia
Title: disappointing food and service
Review: popped in for a couple vietnamese iced coffees and a small afternoon nibble. the coffees were fine; everything else... eesh. ordered a little appetizer sampler with a "fresh" spring roll, fried roll, and pork on lemongrass. it took 20 minutes to arrive to the table and it was all truly bad; the rice paper on "fresh" spring roll was all ripped and "fresh" shouldn't be used to describe the taste of the ingredients within. pork tasted old. fried roll was very greasy. the kicker was attempting to order two waters... we ordered them from our server, waited 10 minutes, asked another server, waited another 10 minutes, then finally just said forget it and asked for the bill. had to ask them to remove the two waters we ordered but never received. when i paid at the bar area the (apparently) manager on duty was really snotty and terse with us. certainly won't be back...

Author: Louloubelle979Hedge End, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic setting and Food
Review: We ate here on 3 separate occasions whilst we were in Langkawi. We loved the atmosphere and perfect place to watch the sunset. The drinks menu is good with a good selection of wine, beers, cocktails and mocktails for the kids.The food was consistently of high quality, presented nicely and really tasty. The menu had good variety from appetisers, meat from the grill, fish dishes and pasta. The steak, seabass and King prawns were a particular favourite. A must visit if you are in the area.

Author: jayleenkayyy
Title: Yums！
Review: The pizza & spaghetti was good! Portion was quite big too 😍 The waiter Kumar was really helpful thanks! :)

Author: Karthik SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Melaka trip on 09 & 10 Nov13
Review: The location in google maps is incorrect. It is actually much closer to Melaka River and Discovery cafe on the same road.I don't understand why this restaurant has a great rating on tripadvisor, probably because it is the nearest Indian restaurant to main tourist areas. It is no different from any other south indian restaurants in Singapore and Malaysia.Menu was very limited, just meals and few basic tiffin items.Food quality was good, but cleanliness needs to be improved. We visited on two days, customer service was good during first visit and very poor during second visit. Would recommend this only if you are short on time and can't walk long distance from main tourist areas of Jonker street and Red square. Otherwise there must be better options for Indian food. I didn't have time to explore various dining options in Melaka, so can't suggest a better alternative.

Author: yenhuatan
Title: Love the plum cucumber
Review: Love the plum cucumber juice, so refreshing! Portion for one is big for the soup but for the dried BkT its a bit small for 3. Quick service.

Author: ClarandaYork, United Kingdom
Title: Ordinary
Review: Although the welcome was warm, we found the food to be unexceptional and the location rather depressing, with an outlook onto the police station. Badly presented starters - one on a chipped plate - were succeeded by average mains. We did not return as we found better restaurants without difficulty

Author: 10outof
Title: Very Disappointing
Review:
high expectation on tenderloin steak (medium), came out overcooked, the overall taste, not worth the money
pan seared sea bass fillet is better than steak, but disappointed on the crust, not seasoned well, some part is more salty than the other

Author: jj37795
Title: overrated
Review: Service was quick but we found the food overrated - particularly the char-kuay-teow. Malaysian food is yummy, but we just didnt' enjoy this at all and left most of it.

Author: PebblesJetson
Title: Delicious dishes
Review: Dishes were delicious, very tasty. The appam thali however, is not worth the price. Makes more sense to order individual appoms if you want them.

Author: LucereL
Title: Reliable source of all things Italian
Review: I have visited this place a few times this year. Each time it is with a different friend that is impressed with their food. Whenever I want to taste good Italian food, I would choose to patronize this place. The one that makes the lasting impression on my friends and I is the Mascarpone and that the chef that would check on us.As for the environment, the space feels tight due to the seating arrangements. If you were to sit outdoor, it would be either too hot or too dark. They do have outdoor lighting but this area is a little secluded. If you were to sit indoor, you are bound to listen to other people's conversation in a foreign language. At the seating upstairs, there is also indoor and outdoor seating. The seating indoor comes across a lot of foot traffic while the seating outdoor seems like a confine space due to the height of the concrete wall. Due to this factor, I would only patronize this place when I have a friend with me. I find that it would be a nice experience for patrons to have breakfast at the downstairs - outdoor seating. So far that has not happened because their operational hour is 12pm onwards.

Author: ppbAustraliaaustralia
Title: Worse service
Review: Visited the place at 8.30. Met by indifferent and lethargic staff. Ordered drinks and food with a number of dishes not available. Initially provided with side plates and one staff member then came around with proper plates and cutlery.Rice was not available - first in a Chinese restaurant.Terrible attitude and indifferent food.Avoid this place!

Author: SpiceSpySingapore, Singapore
Title: Needs Improvement
Review: Went for a family lunch. Group of 20 ppl, though I have made a reservation, they did not set the tables for us. After we arrived only they start making arrangements. Ordered few veg and non-veg dishes. The square tables were rather small and it was so inconvenient. The dishes were normal and the portion served quite a standard size. Overall the food was average & the place seriously needs improvement. Suggest some round tables for guest with large groups. Plus point, ample parking space. Staff was friendly and the restaurants are clean.

Author: BrisbaneTraveller2Brisbane, Australia
Title: Delightful
Review: The food was freshly cooked and delicious. We enjoyed listening to the soft live music with a vocalist playing the piano. Pure luxury.

Author: jtrikaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hangry ...
Review: Got off a flight, transiting at KLIA, good airport even a bit lacking in choices, hungry ... looking forward to some local delicacies.We've been here once for dinner ... so let's come back.At 06:30 ... no Roti Channai, no coffee ... hhhmm so what do you sell for breakfast and why are you opened at all?Poorly staff, 1 person, that's the Manager managing the floor, he is either unhappy or rude to all equally. People are waiting to get a table, then he tells customer off for going directly to a table, clearly that they can't speak Bahasa Malayu nor English.Where's the hospitality in this place ... it need more staff and he needs some redirection and re-training, not a sack.Anyway, let's have some breakfast ... 1/10 MYR 24.50 Ipoh Sar Hor Fun ... bland broth, 3 shrimps instead of prawns on the menu ...MYR 11.00 for a fresh young coconut juice, what was served was an old coconut ... hard coconut meat is a pretty good indication.All plus 10% service charge ... what service, I even say please asking for my bill and he replied "pin" ... no please, no thank you, no smile ...I'm happy to be charged 3 x the cost for a meal outside the airport, may I suggest do yourself a favour in representing your business well, then people might want to come back and even give you a good review.What a disappointing place to have at an International Airport representing Malaysians ... my hunger has turned to hAngry. JT-30/04/2018.

Author: GChan156Toronto, Canada
Title: ok food
Review: We had the buffet lunch, There were only the 2 of us at noon. I don't know if it is because we were early or that the restaurant isn't good. the food was decent but the buffet only had 5 items on it. The only thing that stood out was the fried catfish as that was very fresh and delicious. Otherwise, there is other places in town with more tasty Dyak food.

Author: JamesNjimKuching, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Kuching's Malay Dishes
Review: This two-lot corner coffee shop served mainly halal dishes such as rojaks( chicken and noodle), curry noodles, Sarawak Kolo Mee, Mee jawa, beef noodles, bakso and fast food. The rojak ayam is highly popular and it has the semblance of the popular rojak kucei of Batu Lintang.

Author: bobbiejean52Crawley, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible food and service
Review: We visited Outback for a early birthday meal for a member of our family. It was a disaster from the start, The waiter couldn't seem to understand us when we ordered our meal and even got the drinks wrong. The food when it came was not up to the usual standard and there wasn't any bread with the soup and when we asked for some the waiter brought us a pepper mill. The bread when it arrived had been microwaved so as it cooled down it turned in a brick. My chips had been fried earlier and refried so they were very dry. Also the soup was just warm but after waiting for the bread well you can imagine how we felt. My brother had been unwell for a couple of days and we were supposed to be celebrating his birthday before he flies back home to Kazakhstan. This used to be a great plaice but it's not worth a visit and also you're not getting a cheap meal.

Author: ekta p
Title: Portions extremely small!
Review: Food portions are really small, however the taste is good. Sides also well done. Service average!!!!

Author: teikinn
Title: Didn't Enjoy It
Review: I personally found the broth not to my liking. Perhaps it comes from a different region as it is different from what I have normally associated vietnamese noodles to be... Overall pretty nice place with a relatively inexpensive menu.

Author: KLG77
Title: Dinner Time
Review:
Have a similar dinner with my friend. The noodle that we order is no taste and vegetable is too salt. First time, I get this kind of food quality.

It is so busy and noisy today. Can’t even have a chat with my friend.

Author: Troy BPerth, Australia
Title: Good Food but Average Service
Review: Absolutely love this place everytime we stay at the Concorde.Went here with family and as usual the food was excellent. Best burgers i have tasted.However the service was really bad. They were dismantling tables for the buffet and were so loud and acting very immature.Also this stopped the table service as we had to physically walk up to them for assistance. They also forgot our drink order which was very annoying.Was a real shame because the food is excellent.

Author: Krithika21Malaysia
Title: Bday dinner done right!
Review: Being South Indians from two different states, my husband and I wanted to experience a different take on our own cuisine :) we were pleasantly surprised with the dishes! I chose the vegetarian journey and some of the memorable dishes for me were the jackfruit choux, kappa fry, the take on erisherry, the overly rich sodhi and the biriyani.The technique of rasam making blew my mind and the addition of ginger surprised me!On the cocktails side, I first chose to try the moringa gin. While the infused liquor was wonderful, the amount of alcohol was quite less! Then I was asked to choose the rasam vodka which was the highlight of the night for me! The theatre to it helped, but the infused vodka was top notch. The cocktail bartender even gave me a shot and I was ready to take the bottle home Service was very pleasant. While it burns the pocket alright, I will highly recommend Nadodi for a special occasion!

Author: May_and_timSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must write this!
Review: I have been coming here on and of for five years. I met my fiancé here. The beer is good, the food is halal and there is rarely a queue. In the heat of the Melaka day, it is a welcome stop; in the warmth of he Melaka night, it is a lively haunt.But it could be so much more. Try to get served and you'll be told to 'wait', the waiters have no knowledge of what has sold out until 5 minutes after it is ordered and do not know what is in their dishes. When you have waited 30 minutes for a dish, everyone else has finished and you cancel the missing dish, you're shouted at for wanting your food too quickly!If the mgmt read this, I know you make a lot of money, I know you are popular, but you could be so much better and enjoyable...

Author: melbournetourista
Title: A Vegan Delight in Kuching!
Review: When Indah Cafe came up in my tripadvisor search, I thought it was too good to be true! A vegan cafe in Kuching, there couldn't be? I went to have a look none the less and was pleasantly suprised. Probably the only cafe in Sarawak to have a full vegan menu, and what a menu. The curry and pesto noodles were incredible but an absolute must try is the coconut shake. The staff were lovely and I found out they have a homestay! I will certainly be returning next time I am in Kuching.

Author: midhat14
Title: Unbelievable cool place
Review: Amazing place is canopy definitely shisa is better then other place . Shawn is takecare our team and we everybody enjoy like crazy 😜

Author: GattoMelakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Overated and Disappointing.
Review: We were there in December 2015. Here's our verdict:Food : The spread on the menu looks good so we ordered "Jantung Pisang", "Curry Chicken" "Fried Four Angel Beans" "Asam Bak" and "Otak Otak".However, the food turned out to be disappointing -it appeared to have been pre-prepared and microwaved and the taste was mediocre, at best. The jantung pisang was mushy and overcooked. The cook completely destroyed whatever color and texture there was. The restaurant was really busy but I guess the other patrons did not know any better. It comes across to me that the food is mass-produced and the owner of the restaurant does not care about the quality of the food. Ambience: Average decor. No ambience really. Its like "eat and go". Too crowed and cramped. The toilet is quite clean. Service: The ladies accepting the reservations, sadly, do not have a cheerful face or voice. There was no smile or greeting when we went over to enquire about our reservation. It's like a chore to them. Conclusion: Given a choice, I would not return to this restaurant. I have eaten better Nyonya Food in Melaka.

Author: Afflick67Warwickshire, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty food
Review: After a warm walk around the bird park, we had a very nice meal here and enjoyed the food and the ambiance. We ordered Nasi Goreng and Nasi Lemak and two refreshing Tiger beers which came to RM74; which we thought represented good value. Add the free Wi-Fi and we were happy!

Author: Mary BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food and beautiful ambiance restaurant
Review: My family and I were in Melaka for 5 days and we only found Wild Coriander Restaurant on the 2nd last day and we all loved it. The ambiance of the restaurant was beautiful and rustic and it was by the river. The food was excellent and we tried nasi lemak, laksa and rojak and also the dry mee siam. The service personnel was very polite and professional. We went back there for lunch and dinner the last 2 days as it was such a pleasant and nice restaurant. I would highly recommend anyone in Melaka to visit Wild Coriander Restaurant by the river near Jonker area

Author: WilsonN18
Title: Nice
Review:
Nice fd and services, the price is reasonable . We share fd for our family. 
Burger is nice. Beef is quite hard for child eat

Author: JohnsonIVOxon Hill, Maryland
Title: Nice, warm, somewhat hipster-ish spot with wonderful food and drinks
Review: This was a wonderful surprise on a day when I was driven in here by a thunderstorm and somewhat poor timing (missing my intended lunch target by a block when the skies opened). After coming in for a coffee, I couldn't resist trying one of their crepe cakes -- the lemon one -- and both it and the coffee were excellent, so I decided to order the pesto pasta for lunch also (despite the rain having stopped by then), which was excellent as well. If I hadn't been stuffed, I would've continued trying things from their good-sized menu of creative options (that included a "popcorn latte"!).Lavish has a nice, warm, somewhat hipster-ish interior. It's a long, narrow cafe, with light coming from assorted types of bulbs/lamps and a mid-restaurant skylight, the latter which overlooks a section of the dining area that includes two tables with faux gardens under the glass tops. The staff was friendly and efficient. This really seems like great place for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or desserts...or even drinks, with a few beers available in bottles.

Author: JayKaySixSeven
Title: Laksa and More!
Review: Great LAKSA, great POPIAH, great Coffee & Toast ... what more is there to say?  Oh ya, there's great kolomee & porridge too, but whatever you order, be prepared to wait!

Author: BSManiam
Title: Clean ambience, food taste can be improved
Review:
Clean restaurant. Service can be improved by ensuring adequate staff to take orders.

Tried their lamb samosa, chicken briyani and tandoori chicken. Food did not meet my expectations.

Tea was average.

Author: JulietzhuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worst Dimsum and not authentic at all!
Review: This is the worst dim sum place I have ever eaten; the problem is not that it is Halal, the problem is it is Malay-flavoured dimsum, not the Chinese one at all. The sauce to go with the dim sums are malay sauces and they don't have chinese sauces. The food is also not chinese flavour. If you are looking for chinese/cantonese dimsum, please do not go there, there are many good choices in Ipoh.

Author: DewiRatna
Title: 5 Star hotel 3 star service
Review: I have tried their buffet dinner, but the food was just average, nothing extraordinary. The service was so slow, took forever to even get a glass of water.

Author: Adrax_ChewKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: To the management
Review: Disclaimer: this is purely my personal opinions with no ill intentions.What do you do when you are craving for some steaks after drinking with your friends? It's 12am and it's drizzling outside.. Fear not, we have Pampas!I sat indoors as it was still raining outside, but the table settings have been removed from all the tables. No big deal. I sat down and ordered an Iced Lemon Tea and a Rib-eye Medium. As I was waiting for my steak, the staff came to place a fork and steak knife on the table. The steak knife was worn, evident of just how great the steaks are and countless of guests have enjoyed them.I finished my drink as I waited for my steak for almost an hour. I purposely pushed away my empty glass to the other side of the table. The staff approached me, twice, to ask if I would like to have another drink. I said no, as I would like to wait for the steak and order a wine. Sadly, they left without taking the glass with them as soon as they heard my reply.Finally, the steak arrived. On a square plate. Reminded me of a picture frame, nice touch. Reminded me of the various art pieces that decorated the dining area of Pampas. Oddly, one side of the wall is covered with a wallpaper that seemed to give you a headache if you stare at it for too long. Seemed to reflect certain disagreement among the management. Luckily I sat with my back facing it.The steak was heavenly. Grilled to perfection. and the mushroom sauce was just as amazing. I asked for a refill and literally drank them like a soup. Really, really great steak.I guess what I am trying to say is. You have really great steaks and I am guessing not many on the street itself sells steak up to 2am? You should take advantage of this and make sure the floor and the kitchen is ready at all times to deliver. More knowledge for the staff: none of them knew anything about the art pieces on the wall and what is a serviette.Sometimes it's just the small things that separate you from being number 1 on Tripadvisor. Cheers!

Author: WilliamW2183
Title: Attractive
Review: It's awesome with lots of ingredients put in a bowl of nice pork noodles...Should ask for additional egg as the soup will be tempting as well.

Author: sam l
Title: Better than expected, recommended
Review: Foods are quite pleasant, salmon and lamb rack was awesome, however maybe they pay too much attention on the main dishes but miss out some of the side dishes. It would have been a full course of perfection. Will definitely return.
Restaurant: Laman Grill steak n Bar B Que,

Author: Edwin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good seafood, but avoid the rest
Review: This place came highly recommended by friends and locals alike. Perhaps my expectations were unfairly built up, but I don't think it was that fantastic.The seafood was good (& cheap!), but unfortunately the other dishes we ordered fell short. The chicken in plum sauce in particular, was quite inedible. There were other local eateries that served better food.

Author: Michael HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not up to expectations
Review: I went there for the white asperges promotion; the hot asperges are tasty but undercooked (pity). My friends ordered the Spanish rib platter which was tasty but far from tender (there are other places in town to get better ribs). The German spicy sausage is great. Service is great but the (too) frequent "happy birthday" singing (and worse clapping) is a annoyance to have a nice dinner. No reason to go back.

Author: SzivHong Kong, China
Title: Great for guests to Malaysia
Review: We enjoyed a birthday dinner here. The restaurant was quiet enough and dim enough to be romantic on a Monday night but I can imagine it might be full of larger groups at the weekends. It's a good introduction to modern Malay cuisine with mildly-spiced dishes, tender meats, bite-sized samplers and some great desserts. I'd come here again for sure. The area is good for after dinner drinks, too.

Author: Mariza A
Title: Mediocre Food and Service!
Review: I came in thinking this place was going to be fabulous, because it looked very trendy and fun.OhmyGawd! I was wrong...Our food was average at best. The desserts were decent but wasn't enough to save the rather average meals prior. And the service is severely lacking. One even was rude and argumentative. Overall, the rest of the staff were nice and tried to be helpful. But clearly they're not trained and possibly inexperienced in quality service. Won't be going back.

Author: rotatingplanets
Title: WORST SERVICE OF THE CENTURY
Review: My first & second (yes, especially the second) experience at Restoran Peking @ Taman Sentosa was dreadful and honestly, disastrous. We had our first meal on 27/10/19 at approximately 9:45pm. When we arrived, most items we came for (crabs, suckling pig, crispy duck) were sold out. Decided to settle over here for dinner anyway. 1. We ordered mixed mushroom beancurd tofu but what came was just plain beancurd tofu. (The staff did not take the orders down on a paper) We told the staff and they went back into the kitchen and added some mushrooms on it. Well, it taste terrible. WORST dish by far.2. Was finishing up our dinner so we asked the staff, "Is our fish maw soup done cooking yet?" She went to check and came back with a disappointing reply, "The order was not being keyed in." 3. Our supposedly hot tea came at room temperature. We understand that you guys were closing but yup, zero effort.4. Staff are super inattentive. It's quite apparent at this point but hold up! It gets worse. Will get to this later.I guess it's understandable to have occasional cock-ups during service sometimes. Also, since we did not manage to eat what we wanted, we decided to make another reservation for lunch the next day (WORST DECISION EVER). You will be surprised how difficult it is to catch the staff attention when they have at least 6 staff on the floor. 5. Staff walked away in midst of taking our order. (??????????) "We want suckling pig. Crispy duck....." (She walked away at this point without saying anything. No acknowledgement, no nothing). I told my friends maybe she went to the kitchen to check for the food availability. We waited patiently and when she came out from the kitchen, she simply walked to another table. Excuse me????? We were not even done ordering the food. We decided to order our food from another staff since she's so busy. While we were doing that, she came back and said like, "I thought you guys ordered already?" LOLLLLLLL WHAT? YOU TOOK OUR ORDER? Absolutely redonkulous.6. While we were eating, staff were clearing and setting up other tables. This particular staff threw the wet tissue across the table to set for convenience sake. Super unprofessional behaviour noting that there are customers around and considering this is a premium Chinese restaurant.7. We were finishing up our lunch when we asked one of the staff about our fish maw soup (we ordered it again as we did not manage to consume this the night before). "The order is not being keyed in." WOW SERIOUSLY AGAIN? WHAT ARE THE CHANCES? Please have the decency to remove it from the menu if you guys do not have it. Or try jotting it down on a paper next time? Cos it’s clear as day that waitresses here do not have great memory.8. Once we finished our lunch, all of us took turns to the toilet. We were diagnosed with food poisoning and personally, I was in and out of the toilet for at least 8 times that day. Unfortunately for my friend, he had it worse than me and had the runs throughout the night. (TMI -- I'm still having the runs today 1/11/2019)HONESTLY AN ADVANCED HALLOWEEN EXPERIENCE FOR US. HORRENDOUS SERVICE AND RUN-OF-THE-MILL FOOD. For the price point, you can get way better food and service elsewhere. Thinking about it, mamak stalls have wayyyyyyy better service. WILL NOT RECOMMEND THIS RESTAURANT TO ANYONE.

Author: Pouxinette
Title: Excellent, good prices & Friendly
Review: Living room cafe quickly became the best spot in Batu Ferringhi! Great food, excellent service all within a very nice price! Ask for the recommendation or for fresh fish plates which may not be on the card, you won't regret it!! Ingrid & Marjorie

Author: CraftBeerDeanDoncaster, United Kingdom
Title: Nice chicken
Review: I ordered the quarter chicken for Rm 11 and gave them my table number and sat down. one of the wandering drinks waiters came round and asked me if I wanted anything to drink. I ordered a large Guinness for Rm 20 (4 Euros). The price seems to be going up every year. My chicken arrived and was pretty good. Quite juicy. Recommended

Author: skYap
Title: Mixed rice
Review: Outside look special,old style!  Inside deco also special, many old old stuff,  service is very good , but food terrible,  like eat chinese mixed rice, food serve very fast, feel(own feeling)like ready look time!

Author: michaelhH5372IGLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lunchtime Chill
Review: It was nice to get off the hot and busy streets and into the cool, quiet and calm efficiency of this cosy eatery. The mango salad and hummus starters were excellent and biryani prawn, chicken and veg dishes were delicious. The toilet facilities were basic but clean. I would highly recommend but you would do well to book ahead as it doesn’t take much for this small charm to be busy and it is likely to be too hot to wait for any length of time.

Author: coozeecoozaSingapore, Singapore
Title: No frills, Authentic and value for money!
Review: We took a short walk to this corner shophouse for dinner, less than 10 min slow stroll from where we are staying- Hatten Hotel Melaka. It has a stained glass door and air conditioning inside. We ordered 3 simple Peranakan dish- pucuk ubi (fern leaves) stir fried in belacan, ngor hiong (minced meat rolls) and chicken (ayam) buah keluak. These fusion dishes marry the traditional Chinese dishes with the spices and flavours of the Malay cooking style. Google any of these dishes online and you can find explanations of how flavourful they taste and how they look like. Makko Restaurant does these dishes without any pretentious add ons and served without any fancy cutleries to distract. The way it should be done!! We couldn't resist ordering a traditional chendol dessert(shaved ice) even though we've already burst our calorie quota for the day! We paid a total of Rm55 for the dinner, including a small take away container of "heybeehiam". A savoury spiced shrimp topping, perfect for sprinkling over toast for brekkie. Highly recommended!!

Author: FreyjaFireDancerWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Good food but terrible smoke
Review: I ate here with a large group for a business dinner. The atmosphere was good, cool vibe and the food was great - we enjoyed some wonderfully cooked steak. The wine choices were also good. The service was ok, especially considering we were a group of 40. The only reason for the poor rating was the overpowering smoke - whilst people don't smoke in the restaurant part, there is a bar which is thick with cigar and cigarette smoke. The air conditioning seems to pick this up and blow it out on the diners. I literally felt like I was eating ash. It's a real shame as without this it would have been an enjoyable meal so if the smoke doesn't bother you, don't let this review put you off!

Author: TravlinFinn
Title: Bombay feast just ok
Review: We ordered the feast and the food was mostly pretty good, but not good value for the price. The dessert was old freezer burned "home made" (last year?) ice cream which was not enjoyable.

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Not great - would avoid
Review: We visited Vintage Cafe over the Chinese New Year period as all the Chinese restaurants and cafes were shut. We ordered food - two pizzas and a couple of drinks. The pizzas were awful. The base was thin and crispy and I couldn't work out what was used as a base. It crumbled as I ate it. Cheap cheese on top. Would avoid at all costs. Drinks weren't much better. The cafe felt like it could be a really great place to chill out but they really need to improve the food and drink.

Author: sebastienl575
Title: Breakfast
Review: For once I went for breakfast at there restaurant . A must try big breakfast it s succulent. And good price . For big size guy like me was just perfect with a coffee .

Author: 572gemmal
Title: Really tasty
Review: Popped in here because it always seems to be full. Had their Ayam Bakar and it was really very tasty chicken. Well cooked and piping hot. Wasn't particularly expensive. Would definitely return.

Author: OzieOzLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Worst Hard Rock Cafe
Review: I have been fortunate to have been travelled the world and most Hard Rock from Panama, NY, European to Singapore.This has to be the worst one of them in terms of customer service, food very poor and the most ruddiest waiter seeing us to the table. (Faisal)Bought my family of 6 here with high expectations. Took the kids to TGI Friday yesterday and they really enjoyed. I Would never come to this hard rock ever again.Totally avoid this place.

Author: soemr
Title: Good steamboat food
Review: We enjoyed our steamboat meal in this restaurant. They offered 2 types of soup base, chicken and tom yam. Their chicken soup base is delicious and steamboat platter choices are also quite good.

Author: Sofikkkk
Title: Hangout with friends
Review: I have visited to steakhouse for dinner,one of the stuff asking me smoking area or non smoking.After that i decide to go smoking area,then they given me smoking place.i started to look food and i found my favourite porterhouse stek.i order the steak and scollps and a glass of house wine. It all came in perfect time.i really enjoy and i finished everything.i was looking for good cigar the expert Arif choose for me choiba siglo 2 It was so good he did everthing perfectly.

Author: sueanntravelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best comfort food, worth the wait.
Review: I can eat this everyday. The kolok noodles got mild palette to it that you can eat it even if you are feeling unwell. Their Sarawak laksa also top it off the chart including the little dumplings (kiauw). I like the kiauw in soup. Overall their drinks are also very good. My favourite is their iced milk tea and kopi-o-kosong panas. Please be patient and every dish is made to order. Do take note on their facebook or shop notice of off days. Just always check on their FB before going to avoid disappointment.

Author: PinkAddictKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Glad I don't live in Johor as a victim of bad service
Review: As a KL expat, we have been spoilt for choice when it comes to good Italian fare. So when I experienced good Italian pizza but it comes with bad service I would say I would not come back again.I'm glad I don't live here to suffer bad service just to get a decent Italian meal.Latte was mediocre and milky. My Nespresso machine can do much better than that.Four cheese pizza was tasty. Worth it.Carbonara was so so bec it was not pork bacon.The menu of the day fish with risotto was average but good value bec of the menu price with soup and a drink.For the price we paid (3pax) I would say this is KL price and if I paid that in town I'm sure I would have had better service.The two waitress with dyed light brown hair were obnoxious looking and arrogant... Unapproachable in fact.
