I asked for a take away cup for the latte they just answered "don't have" instead of a courteous sorry we don't have it.The very inexperienced chinese boy waiter assigned to us barely understood English and when he took away the pasta plate, my iPhone fell backwards bec my daughter was watching a video... He didnt bother putting it back (as the other waiters usually do when we dine out, they are extremely apologetic then they put it back). Obviously there is no sense of customer service at all.Won't come back. Too many better choices out there for a more enjoyable meal.

Author: lancetaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Lack of taste, quality and service
Review: I visited this outlet according to the recommendation of the food bloggers, but was left with a price tag of RM142.60! I was disappointed with the foods.Vegetables with beancurd were tasteless, bland and it's lack of seasoning, I bearly continue to eat after the first mouth and it cost me RM28. The Hokkaido ramen was the worst noodles I tasted so far. Noodles were not homemade but were written homemade on the menu. The favor that burst in my mouth was the braised pork belly, the hard-boiled egg was overcooked. Xiao long bao is not freshly-made I can taste the hardness of the meat that it had been in the steamer for some time. I had Mango Sago for dessert, there is red bean glutinous rice ball in the dessert which is totally wrong. Both elements don't evenly match.Overall service was not up to standards, the waitress has no experience with food knowledge, Manager had lost his direction instead of running the operation, his role had become the host and cashier. Dragon-i had the most creative name but serves food that was worst than a hawker centre. Definitely will not even intro to any of my friends after this experiences!

Author: Joanne CJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Significant drop in customer service standard
Review: Noted significant drop in the customer service standard of the Pelangi branch compared to their Sutera Utama and Mount Austin branch. My basic expectation is that hot towel and menu should be given when I am seated. Not only did I have to ask for a menu to be given to me, I was not given a hot towel even after ordering, eating and ready to leave. I may be a solo dining customer but I think it speaks volume when there seems to be an obvious element of bias / discrimination towards a solo dining customer. This is such a horrible experience and the reason given when I highlighted this matter was due to new staff on duty. As a solo diner who paid more than RM15 of service charge for a meal (10% service charge), I really expected a better standard of customer service. Do not get complacent just because business is good and assume that customers will make do with mediocre customer service standards.

Author: wessley_220678
Title: Not that nice - beware of pictures
Review:
Hi,
been at Outback on 13th November 2016. The menu found on the cards can be rather for the eyes. I was servered a salad steack with only some pieces and not worth the price. The drinks are very expensive there. beware

Author: zhihongtoh
Title: Lovely
Review: Old school chicken chop served with potato wedges and coleslaw. Chose to deep fry the chicken because it was recommended by the waiter. The chicken chop was really good with the mushroom sauce, remember to complete your meal with a root beer float!

Author: GayathriG30
Title: Service is bad
Review: I visited this cafe on 29th May 2018 with my friends for lunch, we love the food and decided to come back again the next day for dinner on 30th May 2018. After our dinner we were chit chatting and the waiter start visiting our table for almost 3times asking us if he should prepare for the bill even after I told no for the 1st and 2nd time. If the restaurant was pack, we would have leave right after our dinner but there were plenty of tables available yet the waiter keep asking us in the manner of chasing us.But all other time the waiter is always behind the bar except the food serving time.I'm not really happy with the way we are treated as We are sitting here for free.

Author: RONALDODIMATTEO
Title: Kind of disappointed...
Review:
I heard a lot about brazzo, but, as a first timer, i was quite disappointed by the place.
Didn't feel that comfortable.
The food was good, the drinks too.
For the staff, extra smile is free...

Author: jessloylm
Title: Tea time place
Review: We went to Mid Valley branch for tea time. Staffs friendly and coffee latte average ok. Tried their bread, almond croissant too sweet.

Author: wacko123Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Probably the worst Indian food experience
Review: The place is not clean, the wine list is a joke, the food is awful and it is not cheap. Service was barely adequate and disinterested. If this place is to have any future it needs to close-down, refurbish everything from carpet to cutlery and GET A NEW CHEF and give him the right budget. And I'll do the wine list for free.

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good place for spicy seafood
Review: If you love seafood that is spicy, this is the place to go. Their speciality is fried/grilled bawal (pomfret) and grilled sotong (cuttlefish) which is taken with a few types of chili sauces and rice. You may add fresh vegetables to the dish. Besides the above, they also serve rendang chicken, asam stingray, fried prawns, egg omelette & other varieties of fried fish. To soothe the tongue due to the hot spicy food, you can drown yourself in some ice cold drinks. A place worth going & the pricing is reasonable.

Author: Dian3_2Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love turned sour for this place!
Review: I first visited this place for cocktails sometime in October 2017 after a birthday meal in an Italian restaurant nearby. I absolutely loved the cocktails! It not only looked beautiful but tasted as how it looked. <3 While I was there, I was told that they serve fusion Asian-European cuisine which I found enticing and when I saw some dishes across my table -- looked delish! So, I tried the food not long after that and even swung by twice in two weeks to relish the eatery’s tasty eats and sips. However, recently, since the new year, we walked into the eatery as we always do, but we were refused by the waitress because they were fully booked – that’s fair enough. So the next day, I made a booking about 2-3 hours before my actual reservation time, and was again refused by the same waitress. She added, in an unsavoury and domineering manner, that reservations are only accepted 8 hours prior to the reservation time, and again, I saw the tables inside and out vacant. This, I felt was a deliberate refusal, and also spells the end of my patronage to Manja. So for this reason, I am never returning back to this restaurant. It’s a real shame because I truly enjoyed the food and beverage there. I hope the owner gets this message and reassesses his/her staff on the front-line. I often do a ‘walk in’ to a nearby tapas bar called Pinchos and they always make room for myself and friends, no matter how fully booked they are. And this, to me is not only makes good business sense, but keeps customers coming back for more.

Author: Kiwifruit_traveler
Title: Great staff, very welcome!
Review: I had a lovely steak, food was perfict , almost to much to finish, very well cooked. The staff were very friendly, they looked after everything, I want to say thank you to Rajib, Tess and also Amin. Thanks guys. Cheers Colin

Author: Angryharry
Title: Rip off merchants
Review: Just been for a quiet drink at the Brussels Beer cafe due to my love of Leffe.Service was really poor nobody looked in our direction so we went to the bar to order our drinks these where brought to us. Around half an hour later we asked for the bill 3 times finally we where brought the bill which included a 10% service charge which we questioned we where told this was a government tax LIES it's is an unnecessary tax.Reading other reviews about this cafe the food is terrible so it has failed on it's saving grace Belgium beer as the staff are obviously corrupt.Just a warning incase anyone fancies popping in.

Author: Trvlng4funStonington, Connecticut
Title: Okay
Review: Not good, not bad, nothing to write home about. I wasn't even going to review this restaurant, but only decided to in the end to tell you that this restaurant may be a stop on a tour if on a cruise. At least it was for us. If so, it is just perfect for a large group getting off a bus. But if you are a family or couple looking for authentic Malaysian food I would look elsewhere.

Author: Exceeding_Joy
Title: Food is average
Review: This is one of the popular places where visitors to Ipoh go to try the famous bean sprout chicken. Food was ok but nothing to shout about. You can get better tasting bean sprout chicken in Ipoh if you ask the locals.

Author: KatyDaisy
Title: Very breezy and fantastic view!
Review: Very breezy and fantastic view!! The staff were amazing and very attentive! They got our orders wrong but easily forgiven because of their friendliness! Absolutely enjoyed ourselves here and would love to visit again!

Author: dahungrycouplePorto, Portugal
Title: Tasty Thai 'tis not
Review: Everything about this restaurant was just not up to scratch. The menu was difficult to open, service was borderline inattentive, at best, and the food lacked the flavour a proper Thai dish readily contains. Ordered the most basic Thai dishes (Green Papaya Salad and Pad Thai), but neither dish came close to satisfactory. Salad was drenched in sauce and the Pad Thai was so flavourless I chose not to finish it.I had high hopes for this place, as it is the only Asian fusion-type restaurant in the area...but it turned into nothing but a colossal disappointment. If they can't get the basics right, how could they tackle the more complex flavours??? Pass.

Author: Rizal H
Title: Nice local food
Review: Local hawkers stall sell at upscale prices. Fortunately the taste is comparable. Nothing really fancy as you almost have the same at kind of dishes elsewhere.

Author: HappyOgreInverness, United Kingdom
Title: As Irish as Bratwurst!
Review: We were feeling hungry and, apart from the fact that they sell beer, it appeared to be reasonable: lots of people there apparently having a reasonable time is usually a good sign.We read the menu and suddenly weren't hungry any more. Any food on the menu --- and, from what we saw this means everything --- which was remotely European, had cheese on it. Why? Just why?So, while trying to decide what we were going to do next, we sat and had a beer.Wrong!The beer is, even by Malaysian standards, stupidly expensive (probably the most expensive we got in our three weeks in Malaysia!).Hungry? Go elsewhere.Thirsty? Ditto.

Author: tomchurch
Title: Simple, excellent food
Review: Boatman is why you came to Malaysia. Excellent food, cheap prices, good service. The restaurant is simple, not fancy, and it's popular with ex-pats. You'll end up eating here more than once.

Author: Jhens_HeartJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Great service and the foods are amazing
Review: This restaurant offers great food and service. One of the best restaurants in town. Before entering the restaurant, waiters are smiling and greeting you politely. A waiter will ask your preference of sitting, is it smoking or non smoking area. The waiter will assist you to your table and will ask if you are comfortable with the place or not.All the staffs are very attentive throughout the whole night. One of the best service we had experienced in a fine dining dinner.I ordered pan fried salmon. The salmon was cooked in perfection. Definitely a must try when dining in Tosca. Dessert was heavenly amazing too. I ordered chocolate mousse cake. It was so delightful until I finished it within less than 5 minutes. Definitely will come back again to this restaurant.This restaurant is a must try when you are in Johor Bahru town area.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: LindaMazwin
Title: Very bad taste
Review: I've been to various Minang Restaurant but this is my first experience to taste Minang food which is not up to is standard. The price is very expensive.not recommend it.by the way we eat at jalan chow kit restaurant sederhana

Author: JeffreychewthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food not too bad... but very pricey
Review: Went there on the 11th dec with my family. Ate their nasi lemak and their famous nasi bojari otak as well as their satay I must say that the best was the satay. Taste like the satay on the business class on Singapore Airlines! Otherwise it's like peranakan food.Not too bad.A bit salty....otak nothing to shout about. Not their bojari or nasi lemak.And it's really expensive. But guess it's so pricey cos it's in klcc and the heart of town.

Author: WilsonLimPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good price, average food
Review: The chicken rice here is just average, nothing you can't get in Kuala Lumpur except for the rice balls but its taste was just okay.The black bean soup was really good though.The good thing here is its price - RM26 for 3 servings of rice, half a chicken, a bowl of soup, 2 servings of cabbage and 3 drinks(barley and chinese tea). Pretty decent price considering it's located right in the middle of a tourist area.

Author: tadeojoJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Each dish lit up our faces. Excellent Service!
Review: My oh my! Wan Li should be the level all Cantonese restaurants should aspire to. Then again I shouldn't be surprised as Singaporeans had made the journey over The Causeway to dine at this enclave. You know you've made the right choice when the hostess appears right on cue to deliver the next item on the menu or top up the Oolong tea. The food was marvellous. Deep Fried Groupa perfectly dissected by our ever helpful hostess, meant there was no need to worry about bones. I never knew the Chinese made such mouth-watering deserts. The pictures don't do the spread justice. Please visit if only to have a standard to challenge lesser establishments.

Author: sychowlao
Title: Nice sports bar
Review: Service and setting were good. Food was very good. The beer was a little pricey is my only complaint.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: GaryC4449
Title: Best herbal jelly
Review: The best herbal jelly in town, consistence quality across different store. Like both cold n hot Kelly.

Author: T4791OYjuliapKuching, Malaysia
Title: Lousy service & cashier
Review: Went on a Saturday afternoon for lunch with the family. We were not guided to our seats which we reserved & was not shown it was upstairs until we strayed to the back until no tables are around, only the waitress told us we need to go upstairs. When it was time to pay which I use by paywave, (a frequent user though)..the cashier told me to scan my card on the machine & I thought he was telling me other things so I kind of "excuse me, what was it again?" He had the NERVE to show his BLACK CHARCOAL FACE to me. Applause to your service. This will be our FIRST & LAST TIME dining there.Also, the price is so sky high for a fish & chios at RM46?? Even a finer restaurant than this does not charge this much.

Author: jennifergR9664FILondon, United Kingdom
Title: A trip back in time
Review: Have been going to the Coliseum Restaurant on and off for 20 years, love the charm of the place and just thankful that it is still standing seeing as though they are pulling down all the beautiful colonial buildings that the tourists come to see. Great steaks, bountiful bread and butter and just love the atmosphere. Food could perhaps be better at times but still enjoy the visits.

Author: bigboy61455xxx
Title: Best value meal in KL Chinatown
Review: Food is really cheap like $1.5 for rice with duck or roasted pork. At this price, I should not make any complaint and just eat. Beef noodle, mussels with omelet and many other yummy street food all good at Kedai Kopi Lai Foong. Famous nighttime Street food Jalan Alor is a bit overrated and much more expensive- although it looks cheap to tourists from developed countries. Here at Kedai Kopi Lai Foong cafe, we first time saw the structure of cool arrangement of street food all across Malaysia. Cafe itself sells white coffee, tea and cold drinks. Cafe rent spaces around to food carts to sell various snacks to complete meals. Almost as good as in Penang.

Author: SiewKuenYeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We have been to Cilantro a few times and it has always been pleasant. But not this time - disappointing - that is how we felt this time. We have not been back for a while and decided to try it after they have had the renovation. The food was badly presented - obvious that there was not much care in the plating. Food was just placed on the plate and the plate was not cleaned. And the flavour was just ordinary. Definitely not worth the money we are paying. We will not be coming back for sure.

Author: 716katev
Title: Really good place!
Review: This place is just amazing! The food is really tasty, prices are very cheap, staff is so friendly and of course the heart of this place is the owner 😉 Thank you!

Author: megac2014Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: nice ambience to hang out
Review: I definitely love this place though it feels like entering an unfinished building, but the concept is excellent ! You won't believe what you see once you step in to the room, since the front door is quite small, but the place is quite big inside. The meal is quite good, the coffee is great and you can hang out with almost everyone, you name it. Family, friends, spouse, or even going solo! Must try!

Author: Hanh NAdelaide, South Australia, Australia
Title: Fish and prawns were not fresh
Review: Read good reviews on trip advisor so we give it a go. It was bad. Prawns were tasteless. Tried the salted egg crabs and it was so so. Crabs were not sweet. The steamed garoupa fish was a joke. We picked a live one from the tank. However when steamed, it tasted like an already dead fish. We paid good money hence was very disappointed by the meal. Wont be back ever.

Author: ChelseaY46
Title: Good food and hospitality
Review: One of the best Chinese restaurants in town. Frequented this restaurant a few times. Great ambience and nice food. Strategically located in the center of Ipoh with indoor car park. Parking flat rate at RM3 (as at date of writing ) for dining here but must get validation at the reception before leaving. Will come back again.

Author: Johnting86
Title: Nice lamb chop
Review: Must try their lamb chop. Soft and tender. Not everywhere you can find grilled lamb that is still soft inside and juicy.

Author: DaFi11
Title: Could do better
Review: We visited this restaurant in the Pavilion Butik Bintang in the afternoon to catch a small meal. Went with the share platter. Food and service were both ok, but not quite up to the standard that we've experienced at TGIF previously.

Author: JohnTYC07Malaysia
Title: Great food with local inspired dishes
Review: Dewakan location is quite far away from the city, situated near a KDU university. Even though its a hassled to get to it is definitely worth a try !The restaurant is modern and has a nice lounge adjacent to the dining area which makes it great for functionsThe food here is definitely 5 stars and worth every penny especially if you enjoy fine dining cuisine. Dishes such as then herbal vegetable pot soup (cant remember the dish name) and the razor clam dish really stood out to me. The appetizers & desserts were all fantastic but the main dishes lack the wow effect though.The menu also comprises of many local elements in it such as gula melaka and flowers which originated from Malaysia highlights the chef creative versatility.I have been to this restaurant about 4 times already, and yes the menu does change slightly from month to month, i feel that the menu is not different enough for me to want to make a trip there again.The service is good with polite and attentive managers, however the food service is way too slow. This cant be helped much as i noticed the restaurant has a program for the students to work there and train there hence the delays.Overall this is one of the best french restaurant in kl, the chef is fantastic, shame the service does match its level and hope to see a greater range of dishes

Author: NicholasD918Vancouver, Canada
Title: Great waffles
Review: Cool little café that caught our eye because of the sweet and savoury waffles. The banana almond and chocolate waffle was a hit for elder daughter and black forest ham sandwich and double bacon and scrambled egg waffles for the rest. Great coffee and amazing lemon and ginger tea. Great breakfast brunch spot.

Author: ZhongguoKMKunming, China
Title: Had breakfast here 3 days in a row
Review: They need more vegetables. Two days they had none. The third day, they had one vegetable dish (green beans.) Lots of cheap items: potatoes, rice, chicken sausage. They did have an egg station and a noodle station. They did have a selection of fresh fruit and salads. Ipoh white coffee was available. That was a nice touch. Nothing terrible, nothing outstanding. Just one more basic, nondescript hotel breakfast buffet.

Author: Gensi52Telford,England
Title: Ageist Bar
Review: Found this bar on our first night in KL, the 26/02/2015, it is near the Hotel Istana on the way to Jalan Alor. It seemed quite trendy.All the front tables were taken so my wife and I sat at the end of the bar. The band came on shortly after we arrived and played good Cuban style music. The staff were very attentive at first talking to us and being very pleasant, actively encouraging us to try the happy hour drinks. We did notice the clientele were mostly young; we are in our early 60’s but by no means past it!!!! Unfortunately at 9:00 p.m. we were suddenly told the end of the bar was reserved and almost physically manhandled to a table at the back of the bar in the passage way to the toilets. Reserve signs suddenly appeared at the end of the bar although nobody appeared before we finished our drink and left. We were also suddenly ignored by the staff. The owner or manager had appeared shortly before we were moved and he obviously thought our faces did not fit in. Tables can obviously be reserved but the end of a bar, hardly! Needless to say after this very unpleasant episode we paid our bill and left without leaving a tip. We went to a bar a couple of doors down where we were welcomed and had a couple of excellent mojitos. I did check back at the Pisco Bar 15 minutes after we had left, the reserve signs had gone and there was nobody sat at the end of the bar. Disgraceful.It is a pity I have lost the receipt from the other bar with their name as I would give them an excellent review

Author: O5110ZYsarahh
Title: Very peaceful!
Review: Went with family for Mother’s birthday!Delightful experience. Especially because this is a very quiet and calm restaurant within the very busy and noisy Suria Mall. The service is perfect. staff is friendly. Food is good. Would rate it very good.Slightly overpriced.Overall good experience!

Author: Vinhang
Title: Excellent view but lousy service
Review: Magnificent view of klcc while enjoying meal here... However, it's just a bummer for being served terribly by unattentive, insensitive and helpless servants... Cutlery was put on table without serviette underneath... Furthermore, some servants seem impatient while taking orders... There are a lot of room for improvement in the customer service...

Author: Mahes90Moscow, Moscow City, Russia
Title: Mesmerizing
Review: well I had an enjoyable evening visiting sushi oribe on october the 30th for celebrating for my girlfriend's birthday. excellent service ensured easy booking beforehand. Staff was attentive and knowledgeable, gave really good advice for sake choices. chef was amazing and intricate on each dish he served with explainations while showcasing his ability in preparing. every single dish was absolutely stunning! staff did gave a happy birthday treat dessert for my girlfriend. overall experience was amazing. came back twice for lunch! nothing short of good food!

Author: phoebet546
Title: Decent place
Review:
Place was still packed although we went there about 1pm.

Food was tasty, but portions were small. The siu mais were miserably small.

Overall, I personally feel that they must improve in their portions.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Tiq325Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Dissapointing
Review: I came across this café as one of the must-visit hipster café in Shah Alam (in Facebook) . Unfortunately it is not! Staff are busy checking their phones, standing and not "really" responding as I came with my family (3 adults and 3 small kids) . I even waited and have to request for a baby chair. Since the waitress looks like she is dragging herself, I went and took the chair myself. Anyway, ordered their carbonara pasta, Olio pasta and chicken chop. What a disappointment.. To be honest its tasteless! Ordered the so called famous triple chocolate threat, and its more looking like a plain choc ice in a SMALL CUP with a price at least for a medium sized drinks!This café is not so clean either. Dusts and stained sofas all over. No next time for this café.

Author: pearly855Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Disappointment Dim Sum Breakfast
Review: We Went to Ming court Hong Kong dim sum but it was packed to the roof and saw Foh San on the opposite side. We thought they should be as good with the magnificent design. We ordered a pot of tea and a few choices of dim sum but they were all a disappointment. Bland taste. The cashier at the counter should be taught customer to give good service as we are paying for our meal.

Author: azlie m
Title: Unfriendly waitress
Review: Visited on 19/0/19, dinner with friends.....eventhough food is not bad....but the service is terrible....waitress is rude when we want to pay for the foods....questioning the manner we want the bill to be produced & giving us unnecessary sarcastic remarks...it is our right how we want the bill to be provided as long as we are paying the bill. Please respect customer. This incident has spoilt our outing night. Overall not recommended especially if you are looking for a friendly services. One star is the best this restaurant deserves.

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Zen burger-eating mode
Review: Yes, we’ve seen about every permutation of burgers by this point. The Baboon House is an unsung hero in a world of overstuffed and overpriced burgers.Inside is a space that more closely resembles a dense garden than a restaurant. Beaten up wooden tables and chairs punctuate grubby shelves and art-strewn walls in a nice natural lush tropical environment.The basic menu is short, to-the-point and has possibly the best burger readily available to most Malaccans. Baboon special aloha cheeseburger is a delightful assault on the senses. The homemade bun is perfectly soft. The juicy baboon beef patty is thin enough to not be a belly bomb and are accompanied by a profusion of cheddar cheese, grilled cheese, streaky pork bacon and fresh veggies. The Oriental chicken burger was also simple and spot on and the tropical lemongrass drink (lemongrass, lemon and honey) complements the food very well.You will surely be in zen burger-eating mode. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…

Author: dennis757hong kong
Title: True Malaysian taste
Review: We visited the one at Pavilion. It was almost full house but we managed to find a table for two. We had Fried Udon with Chicken and Asam Laksa. Food was tasty and service was up to standard. As I understand it, this restaurant has outlets in other malls as well. Definitely got to blend in this experience if you are visiting KL.

Author: borneo88Miri, Malaysia
Title: Grumpy staff and mediocre food
Review: Used to be one of our favourite restaurants in Miri but during our most recent visit we encountered bored and hostile waitress and mediocre food.I understand the social distancing rules are not easy for restaurants but the female server with a pony tail was positively hostile upon taking our temperature. No greeting, just a grumpy "how many?" before ushering us to a table.The grilled salmon on bean sprouts was not fresh and the ramen was greasy.It is a pity as this restaurant had a great opening crew who provided cheerful service and the food was consistently good.

Author: LuisTangoPOH
Title: Delicious American Cuisine
Review:
👍 Delicious American Cuisine 👍
- Cozy Environment
- Delicious 
- Service Excellent
- Reasonable Price
- Convenient Parking

Author: Charleston C
Title: Buffet dimsum
Review: Sadly dissapointed. Not worth the price. The dim sum is one of the worse dimsum ever eaten b4. Good luck to you all. Highly not recommended.

Author: bruceli_88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Heart warming home cooked food in Ipoh
Review: We never fail to pop by Tuck Kee Restaurant for lunch whenever we stop over in Ipoh. Parking can be an issue as it can get pretty congested during meal times - especially lunch and dinner. They serve a variety of pork stuff - siew yoke, roasted pork, and they also have delicious roasted duck. Try the steamed fish .. just in simple soy sauce .. it's just simply great when the fish meat just melts in your mouth. There are other delightful dishes such as fried cereal prawn, broccoli with mushroom, and others.Essentially a delightful and sumptious Chinese meal in an airconditioned environment.

Author: majugigih
Title: Not special asam pedas.
Review: The taste of asam pedas here not the original asam pedas. No asam and pedas. Means no sour and spicy. Infront of the restaurant have 2 more asam pedas restaurant and highly recommend to eat there, because more delicious then this restaurant.

Author: jefftang91
Title: Food is not up to expectation
Review: Typical hong Kong style restaurant. Busy seating busy business. Dimsum portion is so small . Smaller than the usual. So called best ipoh dimsum ..hhmmmmm
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Jo FSydney, Australia
Title: A Little Gem
Review: We arrived in our hotel and were looking for a place to have a quick bite for lunch. This was recommended by people who were in our hotel foyer and were about to leave. Thoroughly enjoyed our quick bite to eat. The only thing I would say is that the serving sizes were a bit small but the flavours and service were very good. Would go again in a heart beat.

Author: Samantha UCalgary, Canada
Title: Not impressed
Review: High prices, inefficient staff with no knowledge of the menu, manager barked orders at staff around me and the quality of food was poor. I had two bites of my meal and stopped eating it. No one came by to ask how the dish was nor to clean it up until I asked for my bill (10 min later). Do not recommend.

Author: April SUnited Kingdom
Title: TOURIST WARNING! Food is nice but the customer service will give you chronic indigestion...
Review: On Sunday 22nd Jan my friend and I, who were visiting friends in Kuala Lumpur for a few days, had dinner at Tarbush restaurant.Basically to sum it up, this place is more trouble than it's worth - if you're a tourist they are likely to try and scam you out of any money they can - whether it's just 10 ringgit - they don't seem to care about providing any kind of standard customer service... (read on for more info)Our male friend (who lives locally) personally recommended the place, having been once before, however unbeknown to us, the night was due to take a horrendous turn. The decor is lush and the menu looked fabulous so I was very excited, but we seemed to get off to a bad start with our waiter, who rolled his eyes and shrugged when we asked questions (simple) questions about the food. He seemed to want to order on behalf of my female friend and I...he had a very dismissive, condescending nature. But we were only in KL for two days so we ignored it, ordered three canned drinks, a starter each and a large main. Bare in mind this is not a cheap, typically Asian priced meal - this place is expensive.Food was brought out, tasted good, all was going well. When our drinks were brought out, they were delivered by a different waiter and I noticed I was given a fresh juice when I had asked for a 'Miranda' juice from the canned drinks section - my friends all got cans. Now I really don't mean to sound petty here, but this is where the tiniest of mistakes blew up into what resulted in the most terrible of customer service I have experienced in a long while.There was an issue with the drink I was given, a miscommunication that could have been so easily solved by a simple "Sorry, my mistake" but instead escalated into the waiter patronisingly telling me I should know what I mean before I order and then when we tried to pay he was noticeably pissed off we wanted to pay separately. He then took his sweet time doing God know's what with my friends' card...to the point of her being suspicious of him and having to get up and see what was going on. I then gave a 50 ringgit note to pay for my meal (40 something ringgit) and as we had come to an agreement for me to pay for what I originally ordered (which was 3 times cheaper than what he gave me) I was waiting for ,my change. He didn't return. Instead I had to go up to the counter as well, asking for my change. At which time the MANAGER decided to rudely interject, causing me to have to once again explain myself, despite the waiter telling me already it was all sorted. This was frustrating and we just wanted to leave however I was being told I was in the wrong and it was me who had made a mistake. I was refused any change, and the waiter just smugly stood next to me shrugging and saying he had no idea what I was talking about.Just a nightmare. Don't bother there's 2849240482 other nice Lebanese/Arabic restaurants in Bukit Bintang.

Author: adeline998
Title: Doesnt taste as good as before
Review: nothing to shout out with the taste anymore.  Just SIMPLY SALTY! not worth to go anymore.  I found 1 shop opposite Onn Kee bean sprout is better taste than this one

Author: Norana9988
Title: Vasco’s
Review: Vasco’s has got great interior, Great presentation and food serving is big. Sanjai is very helpful and enthusiastic!

Author: Solsab89
Title: An experience to remember
Review: The view is great, the staffs are excellent, the cake was exceptionally good. The dinner was something that my husband and i will surely remember for years to come

Author: VerwerftHove, Belgium
Title: Seafood
Review: Friendly staff. Original food but a limited choice. Glad to be there but just for a one time experience.

Author: DaiBedwas
Title: Very nice large restaurant close to KL city centre
Review: This is a huge restaurant with about 1000 seats. Despite its size and being busy (lunchtime), the service was very quick and good. The Chinese food was very good with a wide selection of dishes. Prices are reasonable.

Author: julianh518Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Brilliant food, and brilliant service.
Review: I visit the Mont Kiara outlet regularly as this has become one of my favorite restaurants in Malaysia. The service is always timely, even at peak hours and all the staff are very friendly and polite. They are knowledgeable about the menu and seem to know what's inside most of the dishes and will happily recommend any food to you if you ask.  The ambience is absolutely great. The 2-storey restaurant is well decorated with plenty of free tables and an upstairs lounge area with a massive display case full of BEAUTIFUL shells. The walls are covered in pictures or posters, some of them dispaying travel, movies, food ect. They also have outdoor seating, some on the upstairs balcony and a couple of tables out in the front of the restaurant.The food here is Italian cuisine, but I noticed a couple of Albanian dishes on the monthly specials menu. There is even a Tapas menu! Every single meal that I have ordered here has been delicious, whether it is meat, fish, salad, or pasta. The pizza here is truly Italian style as well, as the crust is very thin. The chef will even cook a dish that was on the monthly specials, but isn't anymore. My personal recommendation would be the Albanian Lamb Kofta, if you ever spot that on the specials menu. Actually, the only downside of this restaurant is the lack of parking space, as its outside a condo complex and right next to a fast food restaurant. However, this can be avoided if you come early enough.

Author: fearsomepuppyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Interesting experience
Review: Visited as a company activity which was something a bit different. As an experience I found it a bit disorientating as the dining hall is really pitch dark and I found it difficult to have any conversation with anyone further than one seat away. The food was tasty and mainly western in small portions but I wouldn't have rated as highly as most other people on tripadvisor. Also presentation which is a key element of a meal for me was missing for obvious reasons.If you're not afraid of the dark and don't mind the staff sometimes bumping into you I guess it's worth a try.

Author: Renke B
Title: Best Sushi Ever!
Review: Eat here once and you'll keep going back :) Great selection and wonderful staff... Try the 'Golden Age' sushi!!

Author: GerryD366
Title: Gerard Donnelly
Review: Great atmosphere and really friendly staff. Good attention to detail, including the county flag for all of the 32 Counties of Ireland. I went in alone but was quickly made very welcome by all the staff, especially once they realised I was Irish.

Author: ErinN688
Title: Really the best French food in JB
Review: It has always been in my heart to praise about this restaurant... Finally, I am writing this review.. Chez Papa has awesome service and I feel 'French' when I was in there, the spirit in them influence me.. make me wants to always go back and taste the food.... I would like to visit every dinner time!
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: PietroScardigli
Title: Lots of variety but not customer friendly
Review: Souled out is very good for coming and not talking because the music is so loud you can't hear yourself think. The food is spectacular, a great variety, but I recommend not ordering the pizza as it isn't very authentic. The satay and nasi lemak and all the Asian food offered here is great, full of flavour and presented well.

Author: denka83Stockholm, Sweden
Title: Amazing food
Review: We found this place on tripadviser and it didnt let us down. Me and my girlfriend shared a sallad (big and super delicious) and My girlfriend had grilled prawns (big plate with sourcrote under) and I had tenderloin beef in chefs special sauce and it was the most tender and tasty food I have ever had. The dishes is big and served with rice so we didnt need to take the sallad but it was really good so we were glad we took it. We couldnt eat everything up even thou it was so good. The staff was really nice and Islam gave ous tips for what to do in Kuala Lumpur. Islam also gave us a box so we could bring the rest of our food home wich was perfect. The price was 120 MR for both of us and we really recomend to eat there. We will defenetly go there again. / Dennis and Veronika

Author: Sightsee754505
Title: Foodddd
Review: Good ambience and food. Pretty cool place to hang with friends. On the pricey side. The portion is kinda small. Worth trying though.

Author: thebritstralian
Title: If you have to do fast food...
Review: If you have to eat fast food then subway is not an overly bad choice. But if you're visiting KL get out and try something a little more local. There is some great street for a short walk from this Subway, why not go there.

Author: apple-talia
Title: Cashier is sloooooooooowwwwwwww
Review: The food is superb (as usual), better than at MyTown's outlet but they do not serve a side salad as in MyTown's. We had tu queue TWICE, while waiting for the table (this is fine due to high traffic), HOWEVER, the lady at the cashier works at a snail pace, it took her a LONG time to confirm what has already been captured in the system and was distracted with her other colleagues doings. Service and pace could be improved as the queue to the cashier is too long (due to the tardy service) and blocking the entrance to the restaurant.

Author: Jackson621
Title: Good services
Review: The grand getaway food is not good , the food still can have many improvements ,the events are perfects
Restaurant: The Grand Getaway by Grand Hyatt Kuala Lumpur

Author: Jojofamily88
Title: Very rude staff
Review: The food was acceptable, but it became unpalatable due to very rude foreign staff. Extremely rude and arrogant. I would never return to this place.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as I was expecting it to be
Review: In comparison to the pork ribs that were served at the establishment in Bali, the ones here didn't taste just as good. The ribs were sort of missing something. The pork loin was a bit too dry for my liking. The condiments that came with the meats were quite nice, although can be a bit too spicy for some. We had two regular sized meat dishes with plain water between two of us and the bill came up to about RM75++, which was a little steep in my opinion. The place was really busy on a Friday night, but the wait for a table wasn't more than 15 minutes. They don't take reservations for groups lesser than 8 pax (they make an exception if you have a toddler or if there's an expecting mother in the group). The wait staff were very nice and friendly. The place had a good vibe to it.

Author: stefaniecstPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good coffee and nice decor. Food is average
Review: Wanted to give average , but I gave an additional star (4star) for the free makeup of my thrown away Sally Bowles. Came here yesterday 10march for our brunch at 12pm. Decor really nice and even the owner Shaun was there serving customers. Honestly price expect slight few ringgit higher than normal brunch cafe, but maybe due to the rental at TriBeCa, the golden triangle.We ordered the salmon Bowles at rm32. Honestly it’s way not worth order as it’s so small bowl with 8cubes salmon. Salmon tataki is. Ice and fresh though, but at rm32, I rather go Japanese restaurant have my salmon don with more salmon and rice at less price. I just had he salmon tataki and the rest of the rice and Ibsen egg had it to go, however the Malay guy that took my plate throw my dishes away, due to confusion and he heard wrongly. I didn’t blame him as it’s is indeed noisy in the cafe. He order to takeaway a dish for me and I had the eggs royale to go. The egg royale is beautifully done but this dishes wasn’t that wow due to the hollandaise sauce was not great, in taste wise. Brioche bread is like those you can buy from b.i.g supermarket, again taste wise wasn’t impressive. Egg royale was chargeable at @ rm302nd dish we order was the magical shrooms at rm34. It’s tagliatelle in cream sauce with beef bacon, wild mushroom and truffles. No sign of truffle at all though but this dish really flavourful and yummy , even my 3yrs old loves it. Ordered the flat white, and of course coffee great with the balance of dark roast and milk, no doubt from there. Would I come again, maybe if I’m at kl town looking for brunch place, but for brunch dishes, still prefer Shaun first baby yellow brick road , antipodean and birch.

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Not a good place for coffee and food
Review:
Not a good place for coffee and food .
Coffee not good. Food did not taste nice.
Probably franchise eateries are like that.

Go other places nearby.

Author: TraciiO
Title: Evening meal
Review: Great meal, great atmosohere and great service by Prity. Definitely recommend to visitors to Kuala Lumpur

Author: amaran51632015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Ambiance
Review: Went there with my friend. When we ordered the food with a good expectation after reviewing comments from TA, but we were disappointed. The burger meat came out RAW when I asked for Medium well. The fries were cold. The Spicy spaghetti aglio olio their version looks like fried noodle. the drinks were decent.

Author: DivyaLeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the calories intake !
Review: Really must make reservation in advance otherwise waste hours sitting outside for a table.Service was average, took a while before we got our orders taken cos there appears to be only one order taker at that level (we were parked at level 2), I could be wrong... Anyway we ordered a variety of dishes but these are the must orders from my personal opinion - kueh pie tee, babi pongteh, chendol, Nonya dumpling We also had the Ngoh Hiang that was served with this Chili sauce which was so good I had to buy some home. Go down to the ground level and ask Nancy or whoever is at the counter for the Ngoh Hiang Chili sauce !!! Will definitely be back at Nancy's kitchen !

Author: aprilbaby_0420
Title: Best Fine dining restaurant EVER!!!!
Review: Had a nice set dinner with my friends, good wine selection...aircond was a bit cold though but the staff were nice enough to offer us some shawls. The outdoor section was breezy with an amazing view of KL night lights...

Author: 699mauricesPetersfield, United Kingdom
Title: One of the best food options in Changkat
Review: They are known for steak, but have other decent options too. Also an exception whisky list if you're in to that.

Author: Chris_OrleansKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but too expensive
Review: You can choose Spanish or Italian good. We had Spanish as one of my favourite. The portions are very small not the prices. So many restaurants around are trendy Spanish . Better deal elsewhere.

Author: duckmango
Title: Undisputed
Review: Undisputedly the worst ‘Classic New York Pizza’ on the planet. Gave it a try, will never come back. How could anyone botch a classic Margherita so badly. For each his own I guess.

Author: BeeT772Malaysia
Title: Only bottled mineral water
Review: It's my pet peeve when a restaurant refuses to serve water in a restaurant. I've been coming here for years and on this trip I'm informed that the only water you can have to drink is bottled mineral water. I find that utterly unacceptable. Will not have my custom until they change this policy

Author: faisal021187Dhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Dine close to nature
Review: Just outside of KL city, surrounded by green-nature. Beautiful place for a small gathering. Food is excellent with all types of available cuisine. Sitting arrangement is also multi-type with a bar available at the back. Lovely walk-path to the restaurant will make your experience more memorable.

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Still great quality & service
Review: This is my third time here in two years, and I'm glad to see that the quality is still up to par and the service as friendly as ever. As always, do try their banana & salted caramel crepe (add a scoop of homemade coconut ice-cream for an extra punch). We also tried their "pizza" galette this time (with sauce tomat, chicken & cheese) and while tasty, I think I still prefer their mushrooms, cheese & creme fraiche galette. Keep up the great work! I'll definitely check in the next time I'm in Langkawi! ;)

Author: O_GoffinStrasbourg, France
Title: Experience not to be missed
Review: One of the unique place in Kuala Lumpur where you can eat on banana leaves...No plates there, a big section of banana leave will be your plate.The food is rather simple in terms of choice, you will first pick up the type of rice you want, then a selection of fish or meat, and they will provide the sides, various salads and vegetable fritters.The food is very tasty, the experience is quite unique and simply enjoyable.No alcoholic drinks are served, a good selection of fruit juices and lassis are available.

Author: EEuropeanDreamer
Title: Good Food, Good Atmosphere
Review:
Good food for a very reasonable price.  

It offers a more western menu but still delicious.

There was a few locals eating here when we visited which was a good sign the foods good. 

I recommend it to anyone looking for a good cheap meal.

Author: Tr1x1eNg
Title: Slowwwwwwww service
Review: Was there for lunch to celebrate colleague's birthday. The food was nice but i wouldn't say the same for the service though. Another colleague said that service that day was faster than the other time they were there with 5-6 people.

Author: kkhannnn
Title: Rediculas place
Review: The service is so slow and rude costumer service.i will suggest that plz don't go there to disrespect your self.

Author: dahungrycouplePorto, Portugal
Title: 35th Birthday Party RUINED!
Review: 17 person party. 2700RM bill. Trusted person collected all monies from partygoers. Paid the bill, everything sorted. Or is it? While at our second venue, I was called and told that our party was 500RM short. I return (with friends) to settle the issue. Things get heated. Cooler heads prevail and we sort the problem. Or so I think. Following day, I find that my friend's credit card bill has been charged 500RM. She, El Cerdo and the bank are sorting that out. All I know is that I had to pay back 500RM to her, as I was the host of the party.Further, the entire situation 1) caused me to entirely miss my after party, and 2) put me in a predicament with my girl, which caused us to break up. So, on my 35th (a party that was supposed to go off without a hitch), ineptitude and carelessness by the staff of El Cerdo caused my (3-weeks in the making) party to end up stillborn. Thanks, guys! I will NEVER return to El Cerdo again.BTW, the suckling pig IS all fat and skin.That said, the sommelier made excellent wine recommendations that paired nicely with the menu I selected. Many thanks to him.

Author: AsianExpert68
Title: Simply delicious
Review: A regular here. Some of the best Indian food we have tasted. Very reasonably priced, all staff friendly and polite. The boneless chicken Tandoori and butter chicken are highly recommended. Will continue to frequent Sagar.

Author: Clarence SBintulu, Malaysia
Title: bad customer service
Review: all i can say is the customer service is freaking worst than any japanese buffet restaurant that i have visited before , when you kindly ask for refill from staff, they seem like unwilling to lend you a hand and also show you a fking sting face, more like they are customer , i seriously have no idea how those impolite stuff are able to remain their position without being fired

Author: SulynL3
Title: Highly enjoyable Izakaya themed dinner
Review: I went for the special Izakaya promotion, which is an Izakaya themed buffet. It was a delightful experience - we got to choose half-sized portions of Izakaya-style snacks ranging from sashimi, sushi and soup to teppanyaki, grilled dishes, deep-fried and rice/noodles. Each time you can order up to 3 dishes per person, which they will bring to your table. Unlimited number of times to order.The food was great - I especially loved the avocado sashimi (just fresh avocado served with wakame), fish sashimi, beef steak, squid karaage. There was also ice cream as dessert, and a welcome drink at the start. Really good service and great food - going to return at least once more before the promotion ends in Aug!

Author: Road511478
Title: Friday evening dinner
Review: Great evening at The Steakhouse. Deserves a 5 star rating for the quality of the food and the service! Steak was fantastic and my wife received addtional portion because the original steak was a bit smaller than usual. For dessert I definitely recommend the Crepe Suzette!

Author: Anusuya N
Title: Slightly pricey but worthy experience
Review: If you see dining as an experience, the flavour fusion and the ambience here would be just right for you. Enjoyed our date night here yday, definitively we will be coming back again!

Author: U2348NB_Phnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Best bar
Review: We had a great time at Healy Mac's. Onion ring and tomato wedges are great. And the very chill beer tiger and guinness is the best. We had the best beer in my life in healy macs. Special thanks to Alisha she is an asset of the bar. We meet with the manager Anna also . We are so happy to be in healy macs. We will come back again. Healy macs rocks

Author: Yuu M
Title: Cool
Review: Been here with my bae. And we love it. The drinks, the foods, the songs, the atmosphere. Everything are good.

Author: TomRabbit99
Title: Overly expensive for the average food
Review: Wanted to try this new Chinese restaurant for their dim sum because some friends had posted on Instagram. They were booked out for the morning so my friend made a dinner reservation, and mistakenly told the rest that the restaurant was still serving dim sum. Even so we still decided to try the food on the dinner menu, which given the location in the Four Seasons, was expectedly expensive eg RM48 for stir fried vegetables. The manager also kindly brought out some dim sum when she heard our story. So here’s the verdict. The restaurant’s interior is beautiful and the views great. The service is not bad, but they forgot to tell the kitchen about one dish we ordered, which therefore never came. The food, however, was decidedly average for the price. And the dim sum the manager kindly brought out was ridiculously priced. RM43 for 5 barbecued chicken buns (I’m guessing since no pork is served) and RM 60+ for 5 shumai (there were 5 of us at the table). The price shock is partly because the manager brought these out for us as a courtesy without informing us of the prices beforehand. But the bigger complaint was how mediocre the dim sum was given the high expectations and prices we had. This quality of dim sum can be had for a fraction of the price at any good quality Chinese restaurant in the city. Adding little abalones on top of the shumai does not make cover for the average shumai beneath. They appeared sad and unevenly plumped. The taste too was just average. Some might say you’re paying for the setting but having travelled much, most restaurants in hotels are far more innovative and pay better attention to the quality of the food that Yun House. You don’t feel as ripped off as we did at Yun. The rest of the dishes also did not fare well in the value - price equation. They were decently made dishes but given the price that is about 3 x more than a good Chinese restaurant, not worth it. No special ingredients or special cooking preparation nor special arrangements on the plate. I wouldn’t recommend this place until they’ve upgraded their menu.

Author: Boon LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The cook simply does not know to cook!
Review: We went to this new Italian eatery in DC mall. The atmosphere was nice and it felt like a nice bistro. Besides that, that was all that was positive!The 4 of us went for light lunch and had an eggplant starter, a fettucine porcin and a spaghetti vongole.The eggplant flavour was insipid without any flavour, The fettucine was soft and soggy and the clams in the vongole were rubbery and tough and the spaghetti had an overload of pepper with an odd taste. The only decent thing was the prosecco we ordered was decent.They better fire the cook and get someone else who know how to cook Italian. The menu consisted largely of pizzas and pasta. Lack of menu choice is a huge let down for this restaurant.Ond of the worst restaurant experience and worse than any cafeteria I've been to.

Author: raymondp604Metung, Australia
Title: Went once never went back
Review: Not sure about this joint but somethings just not quite right with the atmosphere. Great position over looking the river but just does not have the low key vibe of most of the little bars along the river.

Author: ScipioSydneySydney
Title: medicore
Review: We went with a family to the one in KLCCThe first thing to note is that it is a bar, so its no really muslim friendly, the steaks were well prepared, the coke was watered down, the children's menu was inedible, and we had to feed our children elsewhere later on.The nachos came arranged (6 corn chips) arranged in a circular fashion on the plate. I asked the waiter what the names of each of the 6 corn chips was. He didn't see the absurdity in the meal.If you are in the KLCC and need a burger, go to burger king on the lower ground floor, its unpretentious, and not seedy

Author: ProfZuKedah
Title: Rude staff at the Infusion cafe
Review: Dirty room. Rude staff (at the cafe -the old, rainbow eyeshadowed lady). I am definitely sure -in syaa Allah- i will not ever stay here again. This rude lady treated me as if i am a beggar. Chasing me away from my table while i was eating. I paid for the service, i paid for my 4 nights stay, and just because i am old, wearing baju kurung, headscaft,...thus i have no right to sit at a particular table. Why? Do you choose certain type of people to sit at certain table? There is no sign of booking, nor label. The manager came and appologise, but what's the point? No price can pay for such attitude shown, and ambarassment caused.

Author: Sarah6788Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good!
Review: The meal was pretty forgettable nothing exactly special. Inside the establishment was pretty worn and dirt on seats but aside from that staff were attentive and helpful. Food was good from what I can remember, if you're after a good meal and want a change from the food court, go here. Probably won't visit again as lacks atmosphere and ambience.

Author: SurfingWildBandung, Indonesia
Title: Was better before but still alright
Review: I've eaten here so many times in the past that I would never miss having a lunch or dinner here when visiting KL. I came in the middle of the afternoon and there were plenty of tables available.Actually I ordered my usual which was 5 pieces of salmon sashimi, 2 sets of salmon sushi mentai, a small spicy ramen and a Passion Fruit tea. The sashimi seemed slightly less fresh than normal and the portions also seemed smaller than in the past. The salmon sushi mentai was not blow-torched as much as usual which was a shame too. But the spicy ramen was the same as ever, delicious especially when you add the powdered chili flakes. The drink was also good.I still enjoyed my meal but hope that this was not the "new" standard and that it will increase to excellent as it always was in the past.

Author: AliceH2631
Title: Big Breakfast is THE BEST HERE!
Review: I definitely love the scramble eggs here and especially the sautéed mushroom. It’s so juicy and perfect. Will definitely come back here for the big breakfast.

Author: JLee1982
Title: This is not nyonya food
Review: There was nothing authentic about the food. The normal flavour from the herbs used in nyonya food was not present. Only recommended for tourists, if you are a local forget it.

Author: paulineb0905
Title: Family dinner with a view
Review:
Very very nice dinner.. The food is excellent and fresh.
We tried a bit of all and it definitely worth it.
The view is great with the KLCC towers in my sight...
Good atmosphere and I liked to watch the chefs cooking.

Thank you!!

Author: jaytee15Palmerston North, New Zealand
Title: Nothing to rave about
Review: Our family came here to have dinner a few nights ago. The service was alright except at the beginning when we had to ask for the menus ourselves (it wasn't given to us when we sat down). The food was in very small portions, and expensive as well. I've had better Chinese food for better prices. Not quite worth it, unfortunately.
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: honourtheworkMelbourne, Australia
Title: Appropriate for those with nut allergies
Review: Travelled with son with severe nut allergies. In addition to typical sushi/sashimi options, the gyu don and the curry katsu don were both consumed with no ill-effects/allergic reactions - but still check anyway. The sushi/sashmi is expensive (RM8 for two pieces of nigiri) but the rice bowls and bento represent better value at RM 7-9 for a small bowl and RM 12-14 for a larger serving. Expensive by local standards but reasonable for an Australian. Restaurant clean, service was friendly if a bit slow, food was tasty though the sushi/sashimi was not as fresh as could be.

Author: XeviR9
Title: Great bar
Review: Great time to drink and Nice place for a play and live music !!! In t’he middle of t’he party !! You mast pass Éverton night

Author: bubbles_csKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Came hère for big porc breakfast
Review: Excellent food , breakfast was very nice but they lack good PR customer service and waiter not knowledgeable , ordered English breakfast tea , I had to ask for sugar & milk to go along with it , they just serve tea , without give any sugar .. Common sense stuff that doesn't need to be ask for but overall for food , really good ! Impress hoe good the breakfast was

Author: DenmafiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor service...
Review: Our 1st and last visit for me & family. Went there for takeaways when we see the restaurant full with customers. Assuming restaurant must be popular for their delicious food. Approached the staff at Nasi Kandar stall...staffs not that friendly when informed I'm buying takeaways. Next he's kept asking roughly "some more what else you want?" when I pointed the dishes to be packed. When I asked him to elaborate the type of gravies on the trays, all he replied was "These are chickens (pointing to 3 different trays) mutton...fishes (2 trays)...not keen to say out if that was curry, rendang or whatever they call the dish. When I asked for a squid..he said it cost RM40 per piece!!! RM 40 for small size squid??? Must be a joke rite?? Next I go to the Mi Goreng stall..same treatment from another staff...was informed to just tell the cashier instead of writing on the menu order I gave him from the NasiKandar stall. At the drink stall.. Staff just packed my drinks then get his Friend to do the writing (no other customer onsite). Just my luck to get this kind of service!!

Author: Riche P
Title: 5Star hotel with 2star food
Review: They serve international buffet but the choice is less then 20type of food. Think yourself, if your have to you pay MYR140 per-pax for limited choice of food what will you do? Dessert only in small island table, no coffee no tea, not even syrup or orange juice, they only have plain water. If you want to try there look at the food option before you start seating or eating. Some suggestion to the GM, try to see other hotel buffet to make your idea or food have more variety. Unless you thinks that your competitors only Le Maridien.

Author: YapES1976Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overhyped
Review: Great service and views of the city.The food is overrated by reviewers.It was very well done with a nice twist but revelationary. Wagy Matsuhisa Sliders, Salmon New Style Sashimi Shiromi Usuzukuri, Yellowtail Sashimi Jalapeno had a nice twist but average. The classic black Cod with Miso well done. The only dish that stood out was dessert, Natsu_No Fruits Pearl, with fruit pearls that literally explodes with flavours in your mouth.

Author: jaja136Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Check your change!!
Review: We went there yesterday for drinks after walking about the old town. The banana chocolate cake tasted and looked very similar the one sold at secret recipe. I gave the attendant a 100 ringgit note to pay for the bill which was less than rm40 (because that was the only note i had in my purse). I was shortchaged because the cashier mistook it for a 50 ringgit note. The mistake was rectified but we had to wait for awhile in front of the cashier who was an angry man and shouted "it was a 50ringgit note!!". If you feel you cannot avoid this place, please make sure you have adequate change to pay for your food, or clarify with the attendant CLEARLY that this is the amount you have given. And count your change properly too. It has now entered my list of a no-go for food in Melaka.

Author: JeffreyW864
Title: Slow slow and tasteless
Review: Busy,no problem but ages for the noodles to arrive.... And all of it tasteless... Bland chicken, bland sprouts, octopus ok , and finally the tasteless noodles arrived..... Love the atmosphere, clean street, colourful too but not worth the time

Author: Syme0nAdelaide, Australia
Title: Expensive for a First Bite
Review: Taking into account as to how mediocre the ingredients are in whipping up a sandwich dish, the price can be quite hefty to bear. Though their saving grace would be the amount of portion served alongside an interesting ambiance, the rest were quite typical. A great place though to catch up with friends or romance your beau if food isn't your top priority.

Author: GH803
Title: Attractive from the outside, disappointed inside
Review: Nice staff, good atmosphere but food clearly below average. Tasteless sagas, plain fried rice and overlooked eggs. Pass...

Author: MAKANRANGERSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Childhood memory food
Review: It's not fair to compare the food they serve today than 20 years ago. I still remember every trip to Ipoh, my family would takeaway their ''wah tan hor'', cantonese noodle, moonlight noodle..The sifus probably retired and now passed on to their hired staffs to cook the dishes which explains there is ''something missing''.Price is reasonable for a tourist spot.

Author: Emindxb
Title: Loved the place!
Review:
Nothing less than a magnificent menu! 
I loved the seafood platter & the lychee martinis & the negroni!! 
Great atmosphere & location.

Author: Remco2010Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't go here if it is busy
Review: Quite good food but if it is busy it takes an age to order. Today I ordered food and wine, got the wine, waited for 40 minutes, asked where the food was, only to be told by the waiter that he did not realize I ordered food. Decided to walk away and go somewhere else.

Author: Caroline M
Title: Good place for Chinese food
Review: Tasty food at reasonable price. Tucked away out of main centre of Kuching but only a 5-10 min walk. Full of locals. Cleaner and quieter than Top Spot - as to which is best I guess it depends on what you're looking for!

Author: PetrinaJ_12
Title: Bad service
Review: Arrived at 10:30am for coffee but the staff did not want to serve until 11:00am. Mind you, opening time is written as 7:30am.

Author: ann_ainun
Title: The staffs are rude
Review: Today 15 June 2019, i dine in yr restaurant (Little Nyonya SCM).This is my first time and the foods was really good. Sadly, yr staff is really rude. I dont know how they react like that. They serve us without smile and i feel like yr staff look down on us. Especially, the cashier and the staff beside her. I dont know either it is her real name or not. But the name on receipt is Nurfaizah/Shahira. I hope little nyonya can train their staff to serve customer with bright smile and respect. I give you 2 stars because the food was really amazing

Author: Sophie2309Singapore, Singapore
Title: Blacklisted.
Review: Went for a dinner buffet at this so called 5 star establishment, I would like to comment on the food, hospitality and environment; first off, the salads and the fresh seafood as starters, well not too bad but I have tasted better. Then on to the main course, had tried everything in small portions as to minimize wastage, wow I must say the chefs have a salty palate, as most of the food is salty even the biryani rice, and the western section everything was tasteless accept the lamb. The Chinese soup was salty, the was nothing I liked. The desserts were dry cakes, that were very flaky when I pierce my fork through. Gosh. And there is no coffee/tea served? By the way the choc in the choc fountain was watered down! Gosh! Are you people trying to bring down Hilton's reputation? BUCK up!

Author: eDaLiNeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delighful Dining
Review: My bf and I were dining at this restaurant last Sunday in conjunction with their Sunday lunch buffet promotion of RM88+ per pax from 11:30am – 3pm. We find this is a good chance to try this steamboat since on a regular basis, a pot of their famous broth alone would cost from RM 48 to RM 88 with the truffle one being the most expensive. There are five different broth to choose from (The Original Yezi Broth, Aromatic Taiwanese Beef Spice Broth, Wild Forest Truffle Mushroom Broth, Imperial Canton Broth and Fragrant Shao Xing Wine Seafood Broth).Since the name of the restaurant itself is coconut, we figured we should get the Original Coconut Broth. We were told the broth is real coconut juice without adding water or sugar to it. The more ingredients we add to it, the sweeter the broth was, though it wasn’t strong coconut taste, but you do taste the coconut fragrance. There aren’t too many choices on their buffet menu though. However, we find the ingredients are of quality and good taste. All except, the prawns which we find not fresh. We were also surprised to find the ala carte buffet serving was too big for the two of us. Perhaps they should indicate or notify the patrons the serving size before ordering.Some of the highlights of their dish would be their lobster ball and their coconut ice cream (very similar to sangkaya coconut ice cream). Their other balls such as beef, tung choy, seaweed and mushroom are equally good too. It was also interesting to try their shao xing dumpling and coconut dumpling. Is unique because the dumpling filling was different, my bf likes the shao xing dumpling and though the coconut dumpling was equally tasty, but I find the sweet dumpling weird (not the taste, but just personal expectation because dumpling should be savoury, but the sweetness from the coconut is hard for me to embrace).I would love to go again just to try their other coconut desserts. Would recommend others to grab this opportunity to try because of their promotional offer.

Author: i_am_nate
Title: Very disappointing buffet
Review: Two stars are to acknowledge the sashimi. The rest was incredibly ordinary. Not the worst buffet I have been too but it comes close.

Author: JimmieLim
Title: My best breakfast meal during my 5 day trip to Malaysia
Review: You just have to be here to taste the out-of-this world kopi, kaya-butter toast. Try the RM1 nasi lemak too. Very delicious! Only disappointing was the mee goreng. Worth the detour on my way back from KL to Singapore.

Author: JaniceG1404
Title: Strongly Recommend
Review: Nice food, nice people & nice environment... strongly recommend the char siew rice, ho jiak !!!!! :-)
Restaurant: The Museum New Concept In Tow

Author: JacquelineG2306London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: This was our second attempt to eat out locally and we were really looking forward to it as it was number 1 on the hotels recommended list. The service was very friendly but the food was poor. My black cod was dry and the rice had bits of grisly chicken in it. We would definitely not go back there and don’t think it should have been on the Four Seasons listing

Author: 42jimmy1983
Title: What a great french restaurant?
Review: Surprises food senses with every dishes , and the staff  are very attentive :) Recommended ! Should some to visit .

Author: ThivankaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Casual hang out
Review: The food is nice here, but we came mostly to catch a quick out of office meeting, the snack we had was pretty decent and the service was really good.Portions are good and atmosphere pretty decent, will head by back to try the full meals sometime

Author: Feepak
Title: Zaibadah
Review: Excellent service from zaibadah , we will come again to try more authentic & fresh Japanese cuisines

Author: azriaris
Title: The taste & service are outstanding!
Review: This is my 2nd time having dinner here with my Family. As usual, Adli welcome us with his big smile. We had Tomahawk. Well done. The meat is super juicy. Thank you to the chef : Nathan & Haziq. Also thx to the team at the kitchen Azu & Steaphnnie. Definately will come here again!

Author: 875iainmNethy Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience
Review: We like this place a lot. It's noisy and busy, close to the restaurants and bars on Jalan P Ramlee, but staff are friendly, there's usually a table available and the beers are cold. Soft shell crab and garlic rice are winners, but there's plenty to choose from and the iPad ordering is fun, although it's easy to get carried away if your eyes are bigger than your appetite. Sit outside and watch KL rush by. Relatively expensive for KL food, otherwise it would have been 5 stars. Recommended.

Author: Cindy GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: BOYCOTT, THEY SERVE SHARK FINS plus other unpleasantness
Review: stay away from any dragon-i.our party of 4 adult plus one 2 year old were there on feb 18, 2013. we chose this time to go for the fact that everything might have fallen back into routine, and the restaurant's supplier would've replenished the kitchen ingredients. also, we had some pretty good experience eating there way back in 2009. we wanted fish, however, the smallest they carry is a one-kilo fish (RM10/100g), which translates to RM100. when the fish arrived, it didn't seem that big. we were also disappointed with the soups, and the stew pork. we suspect the pork used might have been the kind that is old and male, hence the strong smell emitting from the meat. very off-putting. none of us could palate the meat in the soups as well as the stew. now, on to the wait staff. not only were we not greeted with smiles, they all had a very hard and cold look about them. and we were charged for service??? every time one dines in malaysia, one is charged service charges regardless of the quality of services rendered. not only is this unfair to the customers, it would also do a disservice for the service & f&b industry in malaysia. so, back to the wait staff. the first thing we ordered once we were done perusing the menu was the lamien. i ordered that as my toddler loves noodles, and i'm sure the lamien is not spicy. my sister repeated the order of the lamien to the wait staff, whom actually nodded whilst writing it down. then we ordered everything else. she didn't even ask which size of lamien i wanted, or which kind of chinese tea i wanted. she seemed in a hurry to leave our table. and as we suspected, the lamien was missed out of our order. we did not realize this initially. the order slip they placed on our table was all in codes and abbreviations which we didnt understand 100%. but after all our orders have arrived, we realized the lamien did not show. and after rectifying that order, it took another 20-25mins for the lamien to arrive at our table, at which point our toddler was already a little restless and only managed 2 spoons full. the damage for 2 kinds of vege, one pork stew, one "1kg" fish, 2 soups, one small fried rice, one small basket of xiao loong bao, and one kiddy basket of bao, plus pur-er tea for 3 came to a whooping RM379.65. that is roughly RM90.00 per person (4adults). oh, forgot to mention they charge RM2/plate for tidbits, and RM1 for wet towels, all which we didn't order, nor needed. They forced 2 small plates (size of large soy sauce plates) of tidbits and 5 wet towels on our table. and that goes toward the calculation for the 10% service charge and 6% gst. that makes total for tidbit RM4.64, and total wet towels RM5.80. will NEVER, EVER EAT THERE AGAIN. Another thing that concerns me is that THEY SERVE SHARK FINS here. that is a no-no in my book. i did not realize it as i skipped the soup section of the menu. had i known that, i would not have eaten there, hence saving us all the unpleasantness dining there. TIPS: NEVER PATRONISE DRAGON-I AND CANTON-I. THERE ARE SO MANY OTHER SHANGHAINESE RESTAURANTS AROUND. SO MANY.

Author: sadaquat k
Title: Doesn't like the food
Review: Really surprised to see people giving 5 stars for the poor and unhygenic quality of food. I think they lost their taste bud or getting money for 5 stars...

Author: k7cqPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Worst wine tasting ever
Review: My wife and I have been to many wine tastings. The event was advertised as 7:30pm to 10:30pm.The tasting started at almost 8pm. By 9:40pm they were out of wine. So instead of a 3 hour tasting it was about 1 ½ hours. The servers stopped coming around by 9:30pm. McGuigan just got stingy and did not bring enough wine and Havana let them get away with it.

Author: ShaneandDonna
Title: Best Afternoon Tea
Review: Great Afternoon Tea and very good staff. Anyone looking for a romantic place to impress this is it! Theirs also a great bar to have a drink after. Very reasonable considering the location.

Author: Tanisha S
Title: Best Sheesha
Review: This is the best place for Sheesha and Drinks. The service is amazing. The hosts are very friendly. Come here to chill with your friends and family

Author: chryavenJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Peranakan cuisine at it's best!
Review: What a wonderful experience Kebaya Restaurant is for all the senses!Located at the UNESCO heritage site boutique hotel Seven Terraces, this restaurant is amazing!The decor is authentic without being overwhelming and kitsch, and the food is really beautiful. A fusion of Peranakan cuisine with Western cooking techniques and presentation, we chose their Set Menu and tried any dishes.One of our favorites was the Pork Bun appetizer dish, a perfect blend of succulent tasty pulled pork with pickles on a steamed bun.I would definitely come back to this restaurant. A perfect fusion of Ambience, Good Food and Great service!

Author: Lina_TanSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over-rated and disappointing food
Review: We visited the restaurant for lunch. The quality of the food was disappointing. We were served cold rice which we rejected and subsequently replaced hot steaming rice. The fish otar just fish cake wrapped with curry coconut paste - one of the worst otar I ever eaten. The chendol is also lacking - dilute coconut and no red beans. All their dishes paled in comparison to the dishes in other Nonya restaurants that we visited in Malacca.

Author: JojopopoAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Quick Visit to Hard Rock
Review: Caught the monorail to the Hard Rock for a drink and bite. I was disapointed my cocktail wasn't served in the Hard Rock cocktail glasses they sell in the shop but instead in a normal glass. Got nachos that were pretty much overpriced corn chips with dry baked beans & salsa. Staff were friendly & very helpful in the shop. Its obviously a wee meeting place for hookers at the bar but gave us entertainment for a few hours

Author: Sandeep SAgra, India
Title: not bad
Review: first thing i wanted to write was its change in location as still before travelling i had seen a different address in TripAdvisor also but luckily i had asked somebody there and they gave me the right address. what i liked was the ambiance the variety of dishes to choose from but the food what we had was just about ok could have been better after reading a lot about this place i expected a little more was a little expensive also. i was there on 31st night so i expected some thing special also but nothing as such The staff and service was good

Author: stefaniecstPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Healthy good food + service prompt
Review: Just finished my dinner after grocery shopping today on thurs night. Arrived at 7.15, a lot tables have occupied already almost 50percent.Food are lovely with tea cook or infused, but it’s not heavy until overpower the dishes.
