I had 1- Homemade bean curd with oolong tea sauce @ RM262- Braised chicken with black fungus in tea sauce @ RM263- Long Jing Green Tea Rice @ RM3.504- Arrowroot and Chrysanthemum with Chicken Tea Soup @RM 9.90Homemade bean curd are strongly recommended. It’s fried and sauce are pour on top of the bean curd. When scoop the bean curd, it’s soft and yummy with the lightly infused tea sauce and top with fried shrimp and some other unidentified topping with a few tea leavesBraised chicken are all skinless so it’s healthy, tasted the sesame oil present while cooking the chicken, it’s okay this dish but not memorableArrowroot soup comes in small teapot and it’s cute and lovely. Concentrated and nice, not oily.Long Jing rice tasted like normal rice. Can’t taste tea at all, because longjing is not a thick flowery tea instead it’s light tea.Strongly recommended this place in the mall. Purple cane restaurant served healthy, yummy Chinese cuisine. Chinese staffs are very good and friendly. Will be back to try their other dishes and lei cha soup. Accept cash and credit card. They served nice nitro cold brew tea next door too or you can’t order when having your meal here

Author: Markdicko12Fuengirola, Spain
Title: Closed!
Review: I guess you have to just go with the flow here in Malaysia and accept that things are well a little chaotic. But having said that its bloody annoying when you turn up at the restaurant of your choice bouyed by the great reviews on trip adviser and lonely planet only to find that they are closed. No explanation ......just don't fancy opening.....come back at the weekend!!

Author: 02Holiday2014
Title: Average
Review: The food is too commercialized & does not have the real taste of Penang. Need to add more sitting place to cater the crowd.

Author: local_critic
Title: Worth several meals
Review: Fresh, authentic cuisine, and reasonably priced. Try a mix of Thai, Malaysian, and Indian dishes. Stay for the Friday BBQ by the pool.

Author: taifun69
Title: Slow service, tasteless food
Review: Waited half an hour for a tasteless lamb dish with some deep frozen peas and pine nuts sprinkled in. Not to be recommended.

Author: JaisyaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Slow service, mediocre food
Review: We were disappointed with the slow service and food standard in Chinoz. The restaurant tries to offer too many variety of fusion food and in the end the delivery is not up to standard. The edamame is hard, the pumpkin gnocchi doesnt look appetising at all and taste bad. Saw the next table complaining about weird melon bruschetta which they didnt even finish. The nachos and prawn tempura were ok. Also tried the fish and chips, it came so late and was just a very small portion not worth the price you paid for. Everything is on a pricey side for that poor standard. Waiters seemed to be rushing and not bothered to ask if you need anythg else.

Author: david0ng
Title: Eating out at Nandos
Review: The pricing is on the high side and also the potion of the dishes has reduced.  The environment is cosy.

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Dim Sum. Perfect Pau
Review: Forget the breakfast included in your hotel price - go down to Low Yong for one of the best local breakfasts that you can find in Melaka. The dim sum are tasty and fresh, and we think the char siu pau are some of the best we have ever had; anywhere.Good strong local coffee, basic local café but good prices and good service.Very very good.

Author: kchinaCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Fusion food - alright but nothing special
Review: We ate here and got some alright Western/fusionfood. Generally cooked nice but it was nothing extraordinary with prices being relatively steep compared to what you get a hawker centres It has a chill vibe and live music from 8pm the saturday night we were there, so rather go there for the atmosphere and a beer rather than the food.

Author: 171steevec
Title: Good but only one dish - Laksa
Review: Friendly service, good dish at a cheap price but only Laksa offered. It's a mono-product restaurant. They tolerate that you bring food from the opposite restaurant if not all of your friends want to have a laksa.

Author: mnag490807
Title: Breakfast at Paya Serai
Review: Good service, clean & friendly staffs (Kalpana, Linda, Mustaffa, Shahrul, Mell, Shaz, Rohini, Azlina & Teja). 👍👍👍

Author: sdlovetotraveldublin
Title: Disappointing
Review: Restaurant has a nice ambiance and quiet. The food was quite tasty. but when we first walked in no one came to serve us, it was not until later that we noticed the waiter was siting around and staring at us!. We ordered 3 dishes and all of them came at a different time. We had eaten our noodles when the second dish arrived and same for the third. It was disappointing that we were not able to enjoy them together. I noticed that the same where happening to another table of 10 but we were only a table of 2. The bad service had unfortunately ruined our dinner for us

Author: BlellumDuns, United Kingdom
Title: French dining in the tropics
Review: We ate here on my last night in KL. I was driven there so cannot comment on location.The decor is the first thing to hit you - huge chandeliers and belle epoque posters set the scene.The menu looked fantastic - but the food was a bit of a let down (for me anyway).My friend had the pasta and it looked great, my grilled prawns were just served on broccoli and I had to shell them myself.Brie starter was nice, as was the soup. I have to say it was very expensive considering the food wasn't even in the league of my local gastropubs here in Scotland.If you go, ask which dish is the biggest...

Author: bridgeways
Title: Chocosphere
Review:
It was my first visit to this restaurant for afternoon tea, and would love to have something sweet! 

Lots of choices and I chose the Chocosphere, and it was served with ice-cream, really delicious!

Author: 1hairleftRockport, Texas
Title: Excellent steak - good service - clean
Review: We have eaten at the Sizzling Stonegrill several times now. Every time has been a pleasant experience. We drive to Johor about every week to two weeks, and we make the Stonegrill a must stop for dinner. The beef is always fresh and tasty. My husband and I like that we can cook our own steaks on the red-hot stone provided. He likes his steak medium, and I want mine very well done. We've tried the sirloin, the boneless ribeye and the tenderloin. Our favorite is the tenderloin. And it is a good sized serving. See pictures below. You can order with two sides consisting of baked potato, french fries and mixed vegetables. I like the french fries so I order two sides of those. Husband likes the mixed vegetables so he gets fries and veggies. We are American, so we like having iced tea with our meal. Their tea is very good, and if you ask, they will serve it plain with the sugar syrup separate. We haven't tried any of the local dishes, but always see lots of Asian folks enjoying the local noodle dishes. They smell good, and look delicious! The cost is mid-range, about $25 for a steak and 2 sides with tea. The service is very good. There is plenty of wait staff and they are very good about coming when motioned for.

Author: flojoe18San Diego, California
Title: Overrated
Review: So I went to Yasmin’s because of the rave reviews on TripAdvisor and this is the first time ever I was steered wrong. First off, the food was mediocre. Not much flavor going on. As far as service, never have I felt so uncomfortable. When I got to the restaurant, I was sat on the foreigners only side. All of the locals were to the right and they sat me on the left. Several locals who were sat after me and ordered after me, got their meals before I did. I had several waiters who barely talked to me, only to take my order. They never checked on me to see if I needed a refill or to see how the food was. Throughout my time there, the male waiters just stared at me as if they didn’t want me there. I have never felt so uncomfortable. I don’t know why anyone would bother going there. Don’t waste your time.

Author: mrsau2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Colonial atmosphere setting
Review: The setting, furniture still the same but the waitors have changed, no more the friendly old chinese men in their old English white uniform. The waitors are mainly foreigners from third world and service not efficient. We ordered 3 different dishes, one sizziling however only 2 came. Guess they have forgotten after an hour. Hainanese coffee was good but the Kaya butter toast was so-so. Food not as good as before and prices a bit high. Understand the Restaurant have changed many owners.

Author: melissasO8016JANew Zealand
Title: Awful just horrible
Review: Awful food, rude, arrogant staff and horrible service. Went into the restaurant and the waiter (a foreigner) shouted at me and demanded if I brought pork into the restaurant. I had some nyonya kueh in a plastic bag which I brought to the restaurant not to eat but to keep it away from the hot sun in my car. I saw everyone was looking at me and I felt humiliated and demanded that the waiter apologise to me. He shouted even louder and tried to justify his behavior. I never felt so publicly humiliated and belittled in my life. The Chinese waitress heard the commotion and simply brushed the incident aside. She let the waiter raved and ranted. I will never go back there. If it weren’t for my guests waiting (they had ordered the food) I would have walked out. The food tasted horrible .

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good noodles
Review: Had their noodles in pork bone soup. Flavourful soup with reasonable amount of meat and vegetables for the dish. Service was quick but it was mid-afternoon. Be aware that they charge you for the appetiser (a garlicky vegetable dish) and the wet towel is not free. Since they don’t give you a standard paper napkin, bring your own or pay for their wet towel!

Author: 841madelineh
Title: Not worth the price
Review:
Went there for dinner last week. The traditional rice dish was not really tasty. 
Furthermore the atmosphere of the cafe is cold and it seems the service is not at all interested in their guests wishes and needs.

Author: FoudinguetteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Extremely disappointing
Review: Being Thai food lovers and after hearing so much about Rama V we couldn't wait to have dinner there. The outside garden is charming and makes you forget you are next to the major (congested) road of kl. However we found the inside restaurant to be tasteless, just like the food - and the service was very poor and tired. All in all, not worth going there, as the Prive is quite high given the quality from A to Z

Author: spyfox808
Title: pork ribs
Review: The ribs are ok. Reasonable price with bottomless drink not bad. Overall, a nice experience for a first time customer.

Author: karla mAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: big serving, affordable price
Review: we were famished as we woke up and decided to go to the putra mall, its just 5 minutes away from the place that we rented, we saw this restaurant and exterior looked home-y so we went it. the food is good and affordable, i was in a food coma after lol.. i recommend the pomelo salad, it was good :)

Author: ahalvdanBaton Rouge, Louisiana
Title: Sunset visit
Review: Came here to enjoy drinks in a nicer setting for the gorgeous Cenang sunset. The sunset didn’t disappoint, and the location is great but this restaurant/bar sure did. A frozen margarita took over 30 minutes to come out, even after multiple inquiries. The LIT was passable. Could taste the liquor for a change. Considering the location and the duty free nature of the island, I think they are gouging a bit unnecessarily on drinks. Food we had was a bit bland and unmemorable. Saw some other people with pizza that was definitely undercooked and soggy looking. Can’t say I was impressed by any of the food I saw. Bottom line, if you want to splurge a bit for ambiance with your drinks and then stay there to eat, you could do worse but I’d suggest elsewhere.

Author: MidaHmdSingapore, Singapore
Title: So-So steak not worth the exorbitant price
Review: It was a nice and romantic gesture from the other half to bring us here but the steaks were disappointing, from the decoration and the ambience, I expected something more but when it arrives, the steak was dry and unlike my expectations. The sauce was nice but the main course itself was not well prepared.

Author: Valerie037
Title: Lovely Lunch
Review: Tiny restaurant along the riverbank with just three tables, but ever so relaxing watching the passing boats and away from the crowds in Dutch Square.  The interior was spotlessly clean, food excellent, freshly cooked and tasty.  Our waiter was friendly, prompt and efficient.

Author: plivingston
Title: Close but not close enough
Review:
There it was,  I was staring at the familiar Chili's sign.  Thoughts of hometown food raced through my head.   But,  Malaysia just hasn't quite matched up
Look and taste.  Not bad, somewhat close.  Good in a pinch, but not the real deal.

Author: carsam c
Title: Penang Food
Review: Variety of Penang Food here. It would be a long drive if you come from KL. The Assam Laksa is good but the rest are just average

Author: lazysundaymorninbSingapore, Singapore
Title: Inattentive waitress ruined a birthday celebration.
Review: Hi this is with regards to my experience at Grand Hyatt thirty 8. I had brought friend for her birthday celebration on the 7th of June 2019. In my reservation I specifically stated that it was for a birthday celebration. I had previously read good reviews on thirty8 being a venue for birthday celebrations, and how they make an effort to be part of the special occasion. Imagine our disappointment when we were given such bad service. The waitress (Tiffany) attending to us was very inattentive, we were waiting for our tables to be cleared and served the desserts for a good 30mins, but it never happened. To make things worse, other tables had their birthday cake served, but we never had one. My friend had her hopes up, only to be crushed by this terrible service. The night that would have been great, was ruined. I am terribly disappointed with thirty8 and I will definitely not come back.

Author: Samiraak
Title: Exceptional view / ambience, tasty and unique food, extraordinarily atrocious service
Review: The restaurant is located along the water and on the beach itself. The understated and elegant decor combined with flames was beautiful against the backdrop. It was good to be able to dig our feet in the sand. We dined with our three children, my mother, and sister. Our three children were served off a uniquely healthy and delicious children's menu. And when our food eventually arrived, it was tasty. However, I've seen NOTHING like this in terms of service:1. After we placed our children's order and said to give us a bit, no one came to check in on us2. When they did, my sister and mom ordered. My mother's food came, and my sister's did not. My husband and I placed our orders as well. We soon found out that the server had entirely forgotten to put in her order - she had been waiting for over 30 min3. We had four cloth napkins and no napkins for the children. We requested more and NEVER got them. 4. I ordered additional white rice for the baby, as she had finished her meal and still seemed fairly hungry. It took over 20 min to bring plain white rice5. When we asked to speak with the manager, multiple people came by to ask us if we need anything, but the restuarant failed to act quickly enough to bring forth someone with whom we could address this. Perhaps, they wanted us to finish our meals,but they should do the one thing for which we were emphatically asking. 6. The assistant manager spoke with us and asked us what she can do to make it right. Not sure what she expected us to say, as little can make up for vacation time ill-spent 7. The man who manages the restaurant's space and also other spaces, also came and heard what my husband had to say, including that we are only on a two-day trip and this was a terrible experience. He offered to get some wine and cheese. We passed. And when he asked us what he could do for us, we left it up to him 8. When the bill came, a token one wine glass' cost had not been charged. Not commensurate with a ruined eve on vacation. Maybe they don't care for reviewsThis is all on the heels of my slipping on fruit left on the floor during breakfast in another restaurant. The manager had come to "do something for us" to make up. Nothing has been done yet. 9. The children's dessert came without spoons at all! When brought, they were huge n silver. Finally, plastic ware was brought. 10. I saw the same "manager" man walking around to mention this and how bad the experience was - including missing dessert spoons after we had spoken to him earlier. I said I didn't assess during dinner so as not to further ruin my experience. I tried to be nice and say that maybe the staff had a comm barrier. He just seemed lost and was not helpful at all - as though this isn't of consequence. Overall, the service was one of the worst I've seen. Staff had no idea how to mitigate any of this and didn't bother trying too hard. Would not recommend jala. Save your money and go to the Malaysian restuarant at the resort. Great food and service there.

Author: Melanie L
Title: Must try Malay food when in KL
Review: This is a great option to try Malaysian food when visiting KL. A twist on the hawker style food, this is more upmarket. Have eaten here many times and mostly good experiences. Favourites the popish and bungkus kukus for starters, include corn crime brûlée,

Author: Philip GLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great relaxed atmosphere
Review: Mangoes enjoys a great reputation amongst the expat community as well as the locals.The setting is very pleasant nestled in the jungle close to the sea.A relaxed dining experience with pleasant, courteous and friendly service.The menu has quite a few selections and the food is great and generous.Sunday brunch starting at around 11:30 is a wondeful experience.

Author: Lienaganu
Title: Farewell Lunch
Review: Food was excellentStaff was excellentEnvironment, equipment, cleanliness everything was perfectHope can dining here againSuperb serviceThank you for making today's event one of the most memorable day

Author: rrituxLondon
Title: Keep coming back!
Review: Love the food here! My favourite- mix veg curry! I don’t know how they make it, but it’s damn good! Also the ginger delight! As for my taste I like strong ginger in my drink and very often it’s hard to find the place that so it up to my taste, so this place is like paradise for my belly! Just read reviews about birryani, so tempted to come back here this evening to try it out!

Author: Qi K
Title: No more chances for you
Review: Have dined here on numerous occasions.Everytime I come here, there's no parking or the jocket is not friendly.Having entered the restaurant, it is always too crowded despite having booked a table for my family.The food is usually only semi fresh served to us.Every time I ordered a Lavender Ice cream, they would always tell me it is out of stock.Me and my family will not be returning here anymore and will go to other places. Eg, Hana Bar in Sunway or Jyu raku in Subang.

Author: Elizabethgammaray
Title: Great service!
Review: Qayyum was an A+ bartender Had a delicious mojito and got to watch the soccer match would recommend visiting!

Author: CasChen
Title: Lunch
Review: Had lunch there and the restaurant is quiet on a friday.   The teochew food is average and nothing to rave about.  Price is expensive as we have rm 650 for a group of 8 persons.  The braised duck is over cooked.  steamed fish is good

Author: markdeacon2Kent, United Kingdom
Title: Insensitive and humiliating experience
Review: We are both vegetarians and ordered two veggie sets from the menu. The chef was cooking other orders involving meat and then started to prepare the vegetables for our meal. He was using the same utensils to cook the meat at the same time as the vegetables which resulted in meat mixing in with our vegetables. As our 'veggie' dish now had meat throughout it, we called a staff member over to explain that we couldn't eat it and asked if they could prepare a fresh meal without any cross contamination of meat.The waitress said we were wrong and that it didn't contain meat, but was garlic granules. She called the chef over and upon hearing her state the substance was garlic, he quickly agreed. We tried explaining in several different ways we saw him contaminate it with meat, but she was adamant we were wrong and very insensitive about the situation. We felt we had no choice but to leave our meal and felt humiliated and lost the 36 Ringit we paid for food we couldn't eat. The staff didn't seem to care at all about our experience and ignored us when we left having not eaten our food and gave no attempt at an apology. Vegetarians avoid completely.

Author: act78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The place is full of flies!
Review: Not for those who goes for healthy lifestyle. Food was below average, everything was instant food. Frozen fish, frozen chicken chop, curry was just bland and overwelmed with just curry powder. The place was invested with flies, we had to keep chasing flies away all throughout our meal. Won’t come back.

Author: manhattan64Hong Kong, China
Title: Every Staffs is just busy occupied with their Mobile Phones!
Review: We have been to a few similar training schools in Hanoi and HoiAn and both was very good. Since Obama also have visited this restaurant so we decided to give it a try. We came around 4:30pm and it’s not busy with 7 customers included us 2. The staffs is non interactive and just playing with the phone. We ordered Lasi Nemak Beef Redang which is average and cold. The mackerel is over done as it’s dry. However the roasted chicken is tender although no taste to it and the gravy was the only good thing. Don’t bother especially if it’s out of your way to come.

Author: FennySetiawanHo
Title: Great place to host semi formal corporate dinner
Review: Lovely food and services. Generous portion n reasonable price. All my overseas guests enjoy the food.

Author: zoe929
Title: Too pricey? It’s worth depends on you
Review: This is the first place using stainless steel straw, that’s good. Yup, too pricey for a crepe. Banana milkshake is absolutely good.

Author: Ken L
Title: Amazing Jap food but too pricey
Review: Big fan of Nobu, first time to Nobu KL, birthday celebration, we ordered Signature Omakase, sake and sashimi, great food and good service, but very pricey.  Besides, most of the view was blocked by other buildings surrounding, a little bit disappointed.

Author: brownsugarrrr18Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Saturday Brunch Buffet
Review: The selection of food was excellent and the team headed by Yow was very professional and excellent in recommending the popular dishes which were fantastic. Our server Chester was very attentive to our requests and the food was delivered without any delay. The quality of the food served was not compromised and would love to come back again for more.

Author: kamal2015
Title: One of the better restoran for Arabic food
Review: Interesting place for small gathering (about 25/30 people) or family dinner on Arabic type food. Have good selection and reasonably priced. Location wise in Bukit Julutong reachable and with plenty car parks.

Author: jefftang91
Title: Place to chill out
Review: Price is not too high given the atmosphere provided. Recommended To go when you need a average speed of Wi-Fi

Author: Damian C
Title: Nice Laksa
Review: had this for coming 20 years, nothing much has changed. their Otak Otak also quite nice, they will place a basket of it and you can eat all you want, of course, you need to pay end of your meal. lol

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Regret coming here
Review: We decided to have some bites and drinks here because the place was swarming with people and it seemed to have a very good vibe. After waiting for about 5 minutes for a table, we were ushered in. The guy who greeted us didn’t really care if we wanted to be there or not. He seemed to be in a rush the entire time. It was as tough some other people could replace us because “everyone seemed to wanna be there”. All their staff seemed to running around like headless chicken with no smiles on their faces, except one guy who was really nice and even had a conversation with us. The food was disappointing. I love Mexican food, but what we had here was sorely lacking in everything. The cocktails appear to be cheap and it really reflects in the quality of the drink they put in front of you. And finally, the toilets. They’re really dirty and disgusting! Suffice to say I wanted to get as far away as possible from this place after visiting the loo.

Author: Albert SMalaysia
Title: Lunch in construction side
Review: We went to Madrin oriental Chinese restaurant for lunch, we regretted we walk in We where hardly able to talk, not only the service has really dropped but to have lunch in construction side restaurant is a bit to much, when we complain to the waiters she said yes we know many people complain, maybe complain to the manager as what we did, finally the answer was oh this will go on till June. So you are saying don't come till June, than the person smiled and kept silent. We ask is you g GM aware about it the manager said he is and know sure he knows.What to do we have to do renovation, you can ask the construction workers to stop on the opening hours of the restaurant, he said by right they should .... Than we told them .... So what is this .... You charge full money you have to give full service without construction side and drillinghamer noise .... But it seems nobody cares even we looked around a lot of people where not happy .... So advise to everybody when you look for a lunch place in peace forget about about Mandrin Oriental as you have lunch with construction side experience with drill hammer supported entertainment .... Think twice .....her is guest service sure not a first priority that's for sure .....we know from personal experience ...???

Author: shivajim0dak
Title: Simply delicious
Review: Went with family, enjoyed the food and the ambience. It was Sunday lunch and the restaurant was almost full. The service was good, the amount of food was sufficient and really tasty.

Author: KangtaoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used To Be Good...
Review: Used to be among the best Chinese / Hainanese Breakfast establishment in KL but am not thinking so now. Went to have a breakfast on Sunday morning at 7.30am and ordered Hainanese Pork Chop, toast and coffee. To my surprise all food were served within 3 minutes, and the pork chop was absolutely cold! Am thinking that they prepared the food much earlier so that able to serve customers fast but the pork chop was way too cold and totally unappetizing. Totally disappointing.

Author: ngcweeKuching, Malaysia
Title: A great place for snacks and local food
Review: Munch is an unusual cafe. They serve a mix of western sandwiches and local fare. Most popular are the bagel or regular sandwiches with ham, egg or smoked salmon. They also make really good kaya toasts. This is the only place you can get bagels in Kuching. On the local food side - they offer dumplings and noodles. Their dumplings are definitely better then the noodles - my favourite are the prawn dumplings - served dry.

Author: Baileys_Travel27Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not as good as before....
Review: Nancy's Kitchen relocated from Jonkers Walk to the current place. It's quite a walk from Casa del Rio hotel. You may choose to take the cab if you want.There were at least 7 other groups on the waiting list ahead of us. Waited for almost half an hour before we get a table on the second floor. Ordered a few dishes, the only ones worth mentioning are perhaps fried rice and cendol. I've tried Nancy's Kitchen years back, food then were tasty!If you really want to enjoy good Peranakan food, I believe you are able to find them within Jonkers Walk rather then travelling all the way to Nancy's Kitchen and still wasting time to queue.

Author: Yen S
Title: Great ambience, overpriced food
Review: It was a birthday dinner for myself with my best friends and the overall experience was pretty average.We were greeted with a beautiful atmosphere and ambience when we've first arrived and I immediately knew that why people would make their way to such a secluded area just for food.Everything was nicely done up and details were intricate.However, that's the best thing out of my whole experience.Food was mediocre though the appetiser was nice but it's just crackers. Service was slow as people were not as attentive as what I've expected for such an expensive restaurant. Took me 3 attempts to get our drinks.Prices of the food were quite ridiculous for the portion that we were getting. Well, I guess that's called paying for the ambience.

Author: arwinzen
Title: Horrible service & poor management.
Review: The music line up they have here is incredible. However in terms of service it's downright horrible. There was a power failure (fuse blew) within the first 20 minutes of a performance here last night, and instead of informing your patrons of the actual situation the staff proceeded to treat the whole thing as a non trivial issue. We asked to speak to the manager during the break, but were prohibited from doing so.Picture this - air-conditioning was out, part of the lighting, and worst of all the sound system too. For the rest of the 2 hours no less! The only saving grace was that the performers continued playing (beautifully) despite the situation and were apologetic about the whole thing. However the guitar could not be heard as clearly seeing as the accompanying instrument was a saxophone. It's a crying shame that no one from the management stood up to apologize to the customers and explain the situation through out the entire 2 hours. And it's an even worse indictment that the staff actually had the cheek to say that no other customer complained about the blackout, and instead tried to appease us with a 10% discount for the drinks. We continued waiting after the show to speak to the manager, but there didn't seem to be anyone willing to stand up to defend the integrity of this place.Kudos to the performers nonetheless for being great sports and continuing to entertain us with their selection of tasteful jazz and contemporary jazz pieces. We had a lovely evening despite everything and will look forward to seeing them play again. We however will not be returning to this venue again. It was truly an embarrassing affair as this was meant to be a birthday outing for a close friend.

Author: Beaz4
Title: Nice food
Review: Dined here last night. Food and atmosphere good with the place being busy.  Although the service was ok it could have been better. Pasta and garlic bread were good.  Would come again.

Author: Kirsty12345678910London, United Kingdom
Title: Been here 3 times and will come back
Review: We stop by here every time we're in KL.Great setting and the main things I'd recommend are the salt and pepper prawns, sechzuan chicken and all the green vegetables they stir fry with garlic. Great Chinese tea and it's beautiful sitting under the Chinese lanterns below all the skyscrapers.

Author: 408CGVancouver
Title: Worst Din Tai Fung of all
Review: Note: This review is for non Muslim because every other DTF serves pork. Having experienced the authentic and original TDF on Xinyi Rd in Taipei almost 21 ago as an expat living there, and subsequently eating similar versions in different locations of DTF in Taiwan, HK, Canada, China and Malaysia, this Din is the worst by a country mile. The owners employ cheap laborers who cannot serve properly nor provide any level of customer service expected of an establishment serving RM45 for a basket of 10 small steam dumplings and RM3 for a glass of warm water ( of unknown source). Total bill for 2 - RM155 for lunch. The funny thing is that I got more gastronomic satisfaction out of our RM5 breakfast of 2 teh tarek (pulled milk tea) and 2 roti canai. I write this to warn fans of good dumplings that this is no Din Tai Fung if you are nostalgic for the real goods because you cannot serve good dumplings without pork and no credible establishment should charge RM3 for a glass of warm water. Be warned. This is non pork dumplings at 3 times the cost of the original restaurant in Taipei.
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Suria KLCC (NO PORK)

Author: BubblyBearyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Smashing Experience
Review: My boyfriend brought me here as a surprise birthday dinner. Have to say that its truly a smashing experience. We were waited on by Jacob, whom was very friendly and kind to give us his recommendations and provide us with the best service possible.Although my boyfriend told them on the spot that it was my birthday, the staffs really put their hearts into celebrating my birthday with singing and clapping.Food-wise, everything I had was yummy and surprisingly very filling. I'd definitely recommend the COCHINILLO AL ESTILO SEGOVIANO, for an interesting but fun spanish experience for couples and family.

Author: RixingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh ingredients but poor execution
Review: Wanted to try omakase in JB but was disappointed. If you have eaten fine omakase, this definitely isn't one.In terms of ambience, I found the restaurant to have a weird odour despite changing seats.The omakase menu ranged from $120/180/200+/300 and 400RM and the difference between the 300 and 400RM is supposedly the portion size.The ingredients are fresh but the chef's execution is poor. Clams were used multiple times, sashimi slices were not equal and generally poor progression of food.The service is genuine and sweet but it feels like the chef is trying too hard. Appreciate the effort but would not be back again

Author: MslindKopavogur, Iceland
Title: Stay away
Review: This restaurant is a classic example of a misunderstood concept.Porkies could be a massive success, but it's not. Owners find a smart concept from Europe and runs is as a local coffee shop, result is total disaster. We ordered steaks and mash as side order and nachos as starter. After 10 minutes we where told that they only had one steak left, so we changed two orders to chicken and beef tortillas. An other 10 minutes later we where told that there was no beef tortillas, that was changed to chicken tortillas. Next think that happens was that we where served the 2 mash side orders, no starter yet ! So we asked for the starter again we now been waiting 30 minutes, few moment later the starter arrived, wet soft and not eatable, then the steak arrived, is was ordered medium and was served very well done/spoiled. The totillad was served, and guess what, is was beef !? Chicken was dry and not possible to get of the bone.Local chef that does not care and know how to cook European food, this place is not worth visiting ! Going there for a drink ? Don't, service, if you call it that is very impolite.You really should not go, there is so many other nice restaurants in Kuching

Author: jessb1989994Stuttgart, Germany
Title: Total waste of money
Review: I got the tickets as a present for my boyfriend as a surprise because he really wanted to go there. So both of us were very excited and the room and service is nice. But that’s it. Watching those short films before having food is nice for like 1 Minute and then it’s boring. We were still hungry afterwards and the food was okay. Compared to the price it’s not worth it, could have gotten way better food for less money at many other places. Especially the dessert was a joke: one scoop vanilla ice cream with some chocolate crumbles. So would not recommend to do it to anybody, at least if you are not in to wasting your money for food that is only average but with high class prices.

Author: Norry_LynKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: All the hype was for nothing.
Review: Honestly, I decided to try this place out with my Singaporean friend as we were staying around Changkat that weekend. I've heard so much hype about this place that my expectations were set quite high. I was ready to eat and get it over with. I tried Barramundi fish while my friend ordered the Butterfish. Quite frankly, I think it is way too pricey for fish and chips. RM30 and above? Really? When it came, the portion was big I must admit. They served an array of sauces alongside as well for some added kick. Cut into the fish, tasted and.... was disappointed. Fish was fairly fresh.. Batter was plain.. But the overall fish and batter was tasteless.. I tried the Butterfish from my friend. Hers was seasoned fortunately. They gave us a hefty amount of big fries... It was just OK as well.. But then, we started to realise that it was not even cooked enough.. It was hard. Tsk.. Tsk.. Did I mention that I had to change my drink..? There was a small piece of grass in it.. LOLI would not recommend this to anyone anymore.

Author: ALCF1996
Title: Expensive and tasteless
Review: The nasi lemak that we had was so bad and it was better to go the next door kopitiam to have a bowl of kolo mee instead. price was so high and customers were only a few, yet the service was so slow.

Author: Giulio C
Title: Decent food, terrible service
Review: My girlfriend and I visited Sushi Zanmai at the mall near KL Sentral.The food was decent but the service was really terrible. The waitress treated us so bad we couldn't believe it. When she was cleaning the table she almost threw the carafe of the refillable tea and made it slid on the table so to almost fall on my girlfriend and then spilled the soy sauce all over the table, just crazy..

Author: sanlauMelbourne
Title: Best Resturant
Review: this is a must when in Penang, the food is to die for. The owner is really lovely and you can not go wrong the prices are great and the curry is to die for. Thankyou Amy for the tips on the spices and showing me the spice book. Sandra in Melb australia !!!

Author: ShuYeeT2Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food, disappointing service
Review: Food was ok, a bit overpriced. However, the servers were very inattentive, it seemed like they were more enthusiastic in getting customers out rather than serving customers (e.g. explaining about the condiments, food served or refilling tea). They hastily stacked our food before we were done with it. When told, the server was not even apologetic about it. Note that it's only 8.45pm, it's far from the shops closing time. Don't think the price justifies the experience

Author: stormlccIpoh
Title: Master the Basics Before Doing Your Own Thing
Review: I love Italian food, I also love Japanese food. However I have my reservations for "fusion" food such what this restaurant has to offer. You see, a lot of fusion restaurants tend to incorporate more than one kind of cooking into their dishes without first mastering the basics of one particular cooking style. This tends to make the taste of their food out of balance and balance is what separate the good from the bad, or in this case, the good from the great.Lets get one thing straight off the bat, some of the dishes (at least the ones that I have tasted so far) in this place is above average compared to other places in Ipoh, and IT SERVES PORK which to me says "the chef has some balls! and integrity" because it is very very difficult to survive (in the F&B industry) in Ipoh if you are not giving 2 hoots to our Malay friends. Many many entrepreneurs who opened restaurants that serves pork in this place closed shop because they were unable to serve the 30% Malay population (at least) thus loosing potentially 1/3 of business revenue. And I love pork. For me, if you are not serving pork in a so called "Japanese" or "Italian" restaurant you DON'T DESERVE to be called that because pork is the soul of the food of these 2 great nations.Now comes the specific (personal) analysis of the dishes that my group ordered. Firstly the appetizers, the Caesar salad with bruschettas and mushroom soup. The dressing of the salad is spot on, very nice and not overly dressed. To me it is the perfect salad. But it comes with 2 bruschettas and one of them is the ota-ota flavoured. Seriously...ota-ota? If you want to do something different just for the sake of doing something different, DON'T. It RUINED the whole salad dish. What did I say about balance of flavours (this sentence will repeat very often in this review)? First you serve me a fresh, well dressed and very refreshing salad and then you expect to tingle my senses by that ota-ota? Don't get me wrong, I don't dislike ota-ota, I like it on it's own, but not with a perfect Caesar salad. On the other hand, the mushroom soup just tasted like any regular mushroom soup that's was in a package from a Tesco.Then I had my "Classic Carbonara" which is quite confusing because there is NOTHING CLASSIC about this dish. When it arrived I found some bonito flakes on top albeit a very tiny amount shaved very thinly, you would hardly notice them if you do not cook any Japanese dishes. I do, so they are very obvious to me. Ok then, it's NOT Classic in any way, they should name it "Fusion Carbonara" instead. This is just nitpicking in the name and I apologize to waste your time. The question is: WHY? Is it to enhance the flavour of the dish? You can't, not with this tiny amount. Is it to enhance the presentation? You also can't, not with this tiny amount shaved this thin you can hardly notice them. So what's the point? Please be reminded that this is a pasta dish that consist of at least 30% cheese in it, so any subtle ingredients in small amount will just be wasted. The fundamental basics of how to make a good carbonara is the balanced mix of good cheese, good eggs and parsley to accentuate the richness of these 3 core ingredients. The cheese is there for the richness. The eggs are there to combine all the elements, to soften the taste of the cheese a bit and also to make the sauce smoother and runnier. The parsley (which a lot of people ignore and is more important than you think) is there to provide balance of flavours between the 3 core ingredients, to lessen the blow of the cheese - egg mixture and to provide colouring to the whole dish. I am disappointing to say that the parsley was not there in this dish. This caused it to look bland, and too rich because they put too much cheese in the mixture and the balance is totally out.There's the 'Pasta with Bacon and Cherry Tomatoes' that my wife ordered. Most of the time this combination of bacon and cherry tomatoes is perfect. You have flavourful smoky bacon and you have slightly stir fried sweet sweet cherry tomatoes, how can you top that? By adding in long beans? NO! Usually long beans are great if they are the main ingredient but in this case, they are just SOME ingredient they chef put in there to be different. If this pasta is called 'Pasta with Long Beans (with bacon & tomatoes)' with long beans as the core of the dish then it will be great. It's also the way they cooked the long beans. They have been very slightly stir fried to make them look fresh and light green. Good if it's on it's own, bad if mixed with other subtle ingredients. This is a grave error in this particular dish because the their smell covers the entire dish. We had a pasta that only taste like under-cooked long beans with a slight hint of bacon and tomatoes. It's like the rookie's error of under cooking bell peppers for a pasta dish, the whole thing will just taste like raw vege.I almost forgot to mention the pasta itself. If you know how to make fresh pasta yourself it wouldn't be anything special but if you don't (not interested, lazy etc.) then it is something worthwhile to try it out in this place.We also ordered the Sakura Pork which tasted quite amazing. It very juicy and tender with good flavour and reminds me of freshly roasted Chinese pork with a pineapple sauce. Speaking of pineapple sauce, this sauce is the highlight of the day. The balance is spot on, the flavour is incredible and it compliments the pork perfectly.Then comes the dessert. I am not THAT into sweet stuff, but some of the options here are quite good. The Chocolate Mousse is GREAT, it's got a hint of bitterness to it which I love and it actually tasted like Belgium Chocolate and the Creme Brulee was not bad (which is high praises from me). But the Semifreddo is not my cup of tea. The Tiramisu is quite acceptable except for the taste of alcohol was too strong, balance of taste is not up to par here but I applaud the chef for using alcohol, at least it's made the correct way and it's really home made. There are just too many shops in this country selling disgusting feces and they dare to name them Tiramisu without a hint of alcohol in them and then charge a fortune to rip people off. This place is NOT one of them.I also want to mention the environment. There's no denying it, it's quite nice and cozy because the place is so small. The decorations are kept at a minimal but everything is clean and very inviting. The only issue we had is the weather of Malaysia and El Nino. On that evening we are experiencing super high heat, and the 3 tiny 1-2hp air-con units in the dining room were unable to keep up with. They should have installed 2 units of 5hp air-con but due to (presumably) their inexperience in running their own business they opt to save cost in buying 3 units of small air-con. I pity them because in the long run, their electricity bills will stack up like mad, since small air-cons uses so much more juice when they are running at full capacity compared to big ones running at low in the same environment.The conclusion is this restaurant can do better and has huge potential if the chef can adjust his style a bit and improve on his basics. I just hope TNB bills will not make them close shop.

Author: Jimconno
Title: Loved it
Review: A must visit.  -   don't be misled by appearances.  a superb restaurant with great atmosphere.   -   and the staff are just superb!

Author: Aleksandra P
Title: disappointing
Review: For 5 RM in Old Cafe Bazaar we eat kuey tiaw with bean sprouts and a sweet toast. It was lunch time and the place looked dead, No buzz coming from the kitchen, no smell of the food. Disappointing.

Author: Firdaustaj
Title: Date night made perfect
Review: Excellent food and service. We had lamb rack and lobster bisque, both were excellent. Chef and staff are very friendly. Mr Burn, the floor manager was extremely friendly and polite. Highly recommended for date night or special occasions

Author: imprettyaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst service. Unprofessional staff.
Review: I went to the restaurant on Monday evening 9:10pm. When I enter the restaurant no body greating us.after I enter the restaurant no one care , everyone was busy with talking each other.the restaurant wasn't busy, 1 table 4 person only. I rise my hand calling them .. 1 Chinese guy came gave us a table.before we seat down he was telling us they serving pizza and pasta only. I am so surprised that not even 10pm.they stop serving food.after that another Chinese guy came and explain me that tomorrow they have 100 over pax ,that's why the preparing for tomorrow. After that a girl came with bread and olive oil. No one asked me for any water or drinks ,but..they served bread already.what bad service.its really made me dispoinment.i really can't take anymore. I asked waiter to call the manager. After 10 minutes manager came. He apologised and saying that is misunderstood.i really don't understand what is mean misunderstood. I would say worst service I seen ever. I will never ever go there again.i would recommend to not go that restaurant. They spoiled my evening.

Author: RGELLAKuala Lumpur
Title: Very Disappointing
Review: Waited until our last night for a reservation at Jala and in all honesty it is very mediocre. The Malaysian restaurant is much better. Menu at Jala is very limited,almost intentionally forcing customers to choose the fresh fish bar which displays the fresh fish caught during the day. The food is cooked well and beautifully presented but the portion size is very small and pretentious. I hate restaurants where you leave as hungry as you arrived. I won't be coming back to this restaurant which is a shame given its fantastic beach side setting. This continues to be a problem for The Andaman given its isolation in the NW corner of the island. The restaurant choices are fairly limited and offer a fairly niche selection of food.

Author: anavarr2Cabo San Lucas, Mexico
Title: Amazing set up, awesome service, food needs to improve alot!
Review: We visited twice during our 3 nights in Lankawi. The first time we only had a drink and we loved the atmosphere and view. The second time we decided to get appetizers and drinks. The staff was supper attentive and friendly but the food does not meet the standards of a place like this. We ordered Nachos(they where chips from 7eleven), bruchetas(very little tomato) and samosas with coriander sauce(there was zero coriander in the sauce)....in general the appetizers were overpriced...the music played both times was cool...we would ONLY recommend for a drink and the ambiance....

Author: AmygeorgereaNottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Awful Service.
Review: Staff were absolutely useless, we had to shout "Hello?" five times to finally have a member of staff come to us. Moved around three different tables in a completely empty restaurant. There was no music in the restaurant and staff clearly had no idea what they were doing, it was the most awkward i have ever felt in a restaurant. Then I ask about what drinks they serve and was told only wine, when I ask if they do anything else (unfortunately i can not drink alcohol to due to recent surgery) I was laughed at!!! The chef responded with "orange juice?" in the most mocking voice. The menu for steaks are all in the range of 300rm, and for that price we expected better service from all members of staff. Completely disrespectful. We were then offered a measly 10% off to try and get us to return, even though we had previously had been offered this for our time before. Will not be returning and will be letting our friends know how awful this was.

Author: ADAM L
Title: Poor service
Review: Very poor service.  Workers serve customers with sour face.  Most of them pretend very busy.  No time to serve customers.  Fish noodle is quite smelling.  What hell are your people doing?
Restaurant: Mount Austin One Two Eat Cafe

Author: olisolo
Title: Nice fried rice
Review: RM5 got a plate of fried rice. Value for money. Taste is good. Just directly opposite Central Market. Add on fried chicken.

Author: HamizahH11
Title: Terrible and Really Really Not Worth It
Review: The chicken is very very small its like shrinking. The portion for a pax is very very little, even for rm5 its not worth it. The portion is like for rm2 only. The chicken is tasteless. I also ordered sambal masin udang petai. The price is rm25 but the portion is very very little eventho with the small udang you can actually count how many udang on the plate. I dont understand whats with the hype of this restaurant but the price is so not worth with the food. The udang sambal taste so-so only. Same goes with omelette cencalok. Rm20 but very small omelette and you only can taste a bit of cencalok only. The restaurant looks like a normal chicken rice restaurant but when you see the price and the portion and also the taste, its better for you to go The Chicken Rice Shop. Save money and save your taste buds! An honest review!

Author: AlbertwcsBrisbane, Australia
Title: Friendly staffs, but the food is terrible
Review: Although the staffs were attentive and helpful, the standard of some of the dishes we tasted was just terrible. The raw tuna sushi was stale and did not taste fresh, the rice of salmon don was filled less than a quarter of the bowl served, and the price did not come cheap. You may be better off spending your money on other nearby Japanese food establishments.

Author: GrahamStephensPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Pavilion Pigs & Wolf
Review: Decided to give it a try after being told it was good by colleague. Went at 9pm and was surprised to find last orders called at 9.45 and staff closing up at 10.00. Ordered leek soup which was very good but took 20 mins to arrive. Main course was chicken parmagiana - probably a bad choice in a pork place because it had no taste. Red wine by glass was an Aussie Shiraz Cabernet I think but it was not fresh so difficult to tell. At least it was cheap at 18++. I'll give this place another try to sample the pork - no other reason.

Author: emmay08London, United Kingdom
Title: BEST RESTAURANT WE HAVE BEEN TO SO FAR IN SOUTH EAST ASIA!
Review: This place is quite unassuming from the outside, but the food is absolutely amazing! Best mock meat I can ever remember having, especially the sweet and sour 'chicken' and the black pepper 'chicken'. The price for the quality of the food is incredible! We are actually planning on stopping over in KL again so we can solely go to this restaurant.The staff are also absolutely lovely!! This is a must go for vegans, vegetarians and meat eaters alike - my boyfriend is a meat eater and still loved the mock meats so much so we just kept going back!

Author: TravellingMike2021
Title: TGI Fridays ... just great
Review: This is a typical TGI's and as usual the food was great. Staff were friendly as expected and we were not let down.

Author: travelbuddy2001
Title: AWFUL Valentines Dinner
Review: Had very high expectations given some good reviews and ridiculously high price (required to pay upfront) but turned out to be one of the worst high end dinners I have ever hadBar - great views of Petronas towers, furniture tacky. Wine selection overpriced (wouldnt mind high price but they were charging 40 RM for a glass of simple Brancott Estate Sauvignon blanc which costs about 50-60 RM a bottle retail)Restaurant Ambiance and Service - furniture fairly good...at par with most other high priced steakhouses..but Music was absolutely terrible...they were playing Air Supply, Backstreet Boys, Barbara Streisand, etc...didnt fit the place at all (save for a few minutes of a live sax player who was pretty good, they were blaring out a mishmash of old, tacky songs most of the evening)... made for an awful dining experience. Servers were attentive but a bit robotic and rushing when introducing the dishes.Food - mediocre. Starter 1 (oysters tempura)...extremely oily and taste was driven by the batter ...could not even taste the oyster inside (which was dry and overcooked) Starter 2 (tuna with avocado)...very sour and overseasoned with Lemon. Soup (cerielac with shaved truffle)...could not taste the truffle and soup was probably two table spoons worth...felt like an amuse bouche instead of a proper soup course. Main course (dry aged wagyu tenderloin)...absolutely bland and very dry...orderd it medium but didnt help...even the side of potato with parmesan was bland and dry. Other main course was supposed to be trout and lobster but they changed the trout to salmon (without informing us)... Salmon was overcooked. I wont get into dessert as the above are probably sufficient in capturing the awful dining experience.Wont be back here and i dont recommend this place..suggest you spend your money elsewhere.

Author: Nomad812421
Title: Nice Japanese dining
Review: Better than the chain restaurants and they have seasonal variety of dishes. Small spaces and cozy like in Japan (tight & noisy). All food is good and fresh

Author: Shenz643Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Terrible
Review: The food is really horrible and the service is rock bottom. We have ordered grilled chicken with gravy sauce and the gravy is tasteless (NO SALT). This was highlighted to the waiter but he showed little or NO understanding of their food served. Furthermore, the manager explained the food is served according to western taste and it may not suit to our asian palate. Then why open a restaurant in MELAKA?! GO AND OPEN in the WESTERN COUNTRY! Further, she pointed out to us the PURPOSE why they put the SALT on the table and expects us to adjust to taste. I was floored when she said she cant do anything about the taste. Only when we further express our frustration, only she agreed to change the dish to another, which was equally bad . I could not believe this is the quality of food and service served at Hard Rock Cafe. I am VERY DISAPPOINTED and I will NEVER got there again. I will not recommend this place to anyone. RIDICULOUS.

Author: graceblessed1singapore
Title: Terrible service
Review: This place does not know the meaning of service, customer satisfaction and reservation. For a $$ restaurant hotel they 1) make you wait while they take 20 mins to set up the place and our table despite reservations being made AND calling the restaurant again right before arrival2) one miserable size 'pool quality table' for 3 pax 3) table with water ponding under our seats/table which we had to point it out to the restaurant manager that we are not attired in bathing suits!! 4) my brother's fish entree came in record time of more than 1.5 hours!! We were there for a special occasion which was to celebrate my mum's birthday. The rain was not the letdown but the attitude of the manager was the real damper! Not even at all apologetic for his blunder and the level of service from him. If you are coming for meals come at your own risk and be prepared for an unforgettable out-of-the-world customer experience. Good luck!

Author: LordOfKendalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over Rated and failed the Brazilian tests - meat was avearage
Review: We celebrated the new year by joining the New Year Brunch. It was an important day to celebrate with the family but the setting failed to capture the festivity. Chairs and tables were still disorganised in the open area with the Twin Tower view. That was a shame. Brunch started quite late at 12 when brunch by definition is breakfast Lunch. The meat was average. We have done brazilian before and Brazilian is about quality meat. If average meat is served then we know that it failed the brazilian tag test.The second test of a good brazilian restaurant is the coffee. Being dissapointed with the ambience we adjourned to the coffee bar at the same Avenue K.

Author: JTCruz69Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fusion Chinese/Asian Food
Review: Came here with overseas colleagues. Decor was nice. Service was very fast and good.. Ordered sampling menu for 5 persons..The portions were a bit small.. Perhaps a ala carte order would have been a better choice.. Food taste was delicious..Cocktail was exotic as it came.. Noise level a bit high for those expecting a quiet dinning..My guests loved the place..

Author: Mio S
Title: Excellent
Review: I'm Australian but have Japanese parents, so naturally I'm fussy with Japanese food. I have also been privileged enough to enjoy A5 rank Japanese wagyu in Japan. I must say the wagyu we had at Tatsu was on par with A5 wagyu we had in Japan. I opted for Lobster and it was the best I ever had. Pricey? Yes, but worth every cent. It's such a lovely meal and service us also amazing. Highly recommend.

Author: dmclean1
Title: Smoking Pub
Review:
Used to be our favourite hang out, great staff & food.

BUT Healy’s why are you not enforcing the government smoking ban as other eateries and bars in Publika are doing?

Byeee....
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: FlyingTineLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A place to escape
Review: Kuala Lumpur is such a busy city that you would not believe to find such a peaceful place just 20 min away from the centre. The ambience is romantic and the service and quality of food sublime. When you leave the car and walk towards the restaurant you start to forget the stress of your day and feel like being on holiday. We had a reservation at the upper restaurant area (Thai cuisine) and have been warmly welcomed by the service team. A nicely placed table at the end of the terrace opened us to a beautiful view of the forest. Our waiter helped us with the food choices to avoid "a death by hot spices" - which I was thankful for. The food was good, well cooked and perfectly served. This was for me one of the best locations that I have been to for dinner. PS. The waiter told us that during the day you can see monkeys in the forest. PSS. One star less due to the price range of the restaurant.

Author: sachajungerWashington Dc, District Of Columbia, Usa
Title: Very bad service
Review: We waited quit a long time before to be seated. Then, nobody came to bring the menu. We had to ask for it. Once we chose we closed off the menus and... absolutely nothing more happened. We have waited almost 10 min, the waiters were chatting together, they went past our table several times. I recommend to do what we did : run away.

Author: SugarCandy63
Title: music too loud
Review: This place is only suitable for young people. very hard to have a proper conversation with friends due to loud music. Food is normal, parking is catastrophic and asked to pay RM10 for an illegal parking spot.

Author: foodhunterxhunterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food so-so and service is terrible
Review: We decided to check out that place because our usual banana leaf place was packed and we're too hungry to wait. It turned out to be a very bad decision. First of all, the food can't compare with Devi's or Nirwana in the same area. The mutton curry we ordered tasted weird, chicken was too dry and deep fried squid was too oily. Second of all, the service is the worst thing they have. When i walked to the counter to pay the bill, the guy first told me the total is RM53 and i gave him RM63 expecting a RM10 change. Then, he gave me short so i told him wrong change, then he said "oh, it's RM57", then I was like "ok,can i have a copy of the receipt?" As he printed out the receipt, he quoted me another price again, this time around RM60+, i was like hold on a sec, from RM53 to RM57 to RM60+, what is this man, so i thought there is a need to check the receipt. Turns out that they double counted certain item in the bill, so i told the cashier to remove the item that we only ordered 1. The cashier got angry and scolded me in their language together with his friend who is also standing at the cashier counter I felt so unfairly treated, i supposed as a customer i have the right to request and check the receipt? Also, it's so utterly rude to scold your customer in the face in your own language over your own mistakes. All in all, it is the worst banana leaf experience i've ever had. A few words of advice, check the bill before you pay, try to learn their language just in case you get scolded by them over their mistake. Best thing to do is, avoid this place.

Author: jessicakG3142AHWorld
Title: Not worth it
Review: Over priced by alot for below average food. There is literally nothing special about this place besides their giant sliding door. The food was bland. Have never in my life tasted bland Indian food but this place managed to do so. Even ordered their recommended eggplant dish but it was just another disappointment. Highly advise not to dine here.

Author: 412brittanyg
Title: Not sure what all the rave is abiut
Review: We recently had dinner at Andrews after it being recommended to us by people and reading reviews on trip advisor. Have to say it didn’t match up with the reviews left.... we ordered the crispy duck with pancakes as the waitress said it was their specialty, the duck was very dry and the pancakes seemed to be tortilla wraps instead of the traditional pancakes usually served with Peking duck. The rest of the dishes were okay but nothing spectacular.

Author: dylanc220
Title: Food was just OK.
Review: Generally nothing sepical. Chicken was over cooked and Bean sprout was a bit too oily. Place was very packed as well.

Author: Robert d
Title: Gteat place in a top location
Review: Like many others of the HRCS this one is a good place to meet fellow travellers and revellers. Food and music are ghe usual fare and the outlet is a bit more slanted towards a local clientele but it's still worth a visit and it sits smack on the river at Jonker's in viewing distance of the Dutch church, old Town Hall and loads of museums.

Author: 437jingjingl
Title: Do not come here.
Review: Don’t get the Yam ring. The Yam was stale then over cooked. Kung Pao chicken was terrible, almost inedible. I am chinese and cook better Kung Pao chicken than this.The basics - steamed rice was terrible. It’s old rice and mushy. Resturabt told us they ran out of ‘small’ size and we had to order large, only after we sat down and got our drinks.Would not come here again. This is one of the worst foods I have had.

Author: 279ericaiVancouver, Washington
Title: Crappy Crappy Crappy
Review: This place is no no no good. It's dressed up like fine dining place, but it couldn't be further. When we went in we were the only ones there. The table clothes are white but they are covered in stains! We ordered two main courses, but my came so much ahead of time that I was literally done with mine before my friend's dish came. Not to mention but a DVD of Rihanna performing was playing the entire time we ate, which was the weirdest fine dining experience of my life. When my friend's salmon dish came, it had lettuce to the side but absolutely no dressing. It seemed very weird!

Author: TeonL2
Title: Nice food nice service :)
Review:
From Johor Bahru to Ipoh for a few days trip. The scenes in are indeed beautiful ! 
Foods here are awesome ~ a must try restaurant in town if you are looking for a delicious dim sum restaurant ! 👍

Author: IpohLight
Title: Overrated
Review: Cold airconditioning coupled with cold unfriendly service gives the background to mediocre food said to be Nyonya

Author: BTkuchingKuching, Malaysia
Title: Great laksa, terrible woman making drinks
Review: The laksa is great but the woman making the drinks and bread is terrible. We are regulars and we lost count of the times she forgot our order, served the wrong drinks, and worst and most consistently, serve our drinks so late we have finished our food. So we brought our own drinks, and she gave us an earful. She even went to the next few tables to point us out and complain about us. I'll suggest you order the food and drinks, finish your laksa, then cancel the drinks. Problem solved. Or better yet, go to choon choon at Green Heights for just as good laksa and less frustrating drinks.

Author: Michael D
Title: Low Cost & Low Quality
Review: Good service and wide range of Malay & Chinese dishes.  But the sweet and sour chicken sauce was way too sweet and the chicken itself tasted like deep fried rubber.  My Wife's Nasi Lemak was no better.  The Borjani (?) rice was good as was...the a char kway teoh.  3 brands of lager on t menu; all unavailable!More

Author: grisa300
Title: Good food!
Review: We tried to come here to eat earlier this week, but they were closed. Recommend to call them and make sure that they are open and maybe book a table. Food was delicious, after one hour of arring we did have foods, so prepare to wait a while. Chickenswarma was delicious!! Really good food, worth trying.

Author: carine3366
Title: Food is average taste
Review: We were here quite early and most of the shops are not open yet. Hence, we decided to try the dim sum. The shop is quite clean. The food is average taste but it's quite reasonable

Author: TifiiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Performance is nice, but not the price
Review: Went there with a friend, the entree fee is RM42. Usually the venue will include a drink but not this one ( quite disappointing, coz the price is a little bit expensive). The second half of performance is not so jazzy, more like R&B. Overall, I enjoyed the atmosphere and the performance. Other than that, it's a little bit pricy.

Author: geromamGeraldton, Australia
Title: Disappointing-go Elsewhere
Review: You are paying for the view over the park. After a poor effort one morning, we decided to try again. There seemed to be a dire staff shortage. Our breakfast (a la carte) arrived cold. Juices were warm. It cost us near 100 ringgit. That was without coffee. I wish my husband hadn't been so insistent on going back here. A total waste. Plenty of other nicer (and cheaper) places inside the shopping centre. Disappointing to the max.

Author: ReubenC1606Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the price for the experience we had.
Review: Lovely ambience and great front of house service generally. But that's about it from our experience. Now to be fair, I can only critique what we ordered. We ordered the lobster pasta and striploin for mains. Presented nicely. Lobster pasta was basic and wasn't worth the price. The striploin was disappointingly bland. Honestly, the marinated lamb from AEON supermarket tasted significantly better than this striploin for a quarter of the price. Seriously, go try it. For desserts we ordered a cheesecake and the cannoli. Cheesecake was fine but nothing significant. But the cannoli... No. Don't order it. It tasted like paper even with the filling. It was over fried too. The tastiest food I ate that night were the fruits. The sweet wine was great too. Too bad none of it was actually made by the restaurant.I really hope they get much better with the above mentioned dishes. For the price we paid, I really expected food that was worth it.

Author: LuvAlice
Title: Not tat great afterall
Review: Was reading past reviews and decided to try . Not easy to find but managed to on the last day. Opened at 12noon only and price wise is not cheap. Ordered few dishes and not great taste afterall
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: CodyYewSingapore, Singapore
Title: Waaaaaay overpriced
Review: just visited this restaurant on 15 March. My table of 6 adults have been on a food trail around malacca restaurants, so we kinda knew the prices.The suckling pig we ordered was RM 188++, which was an acceptable price given that a famous nearby restaurant was selling it around that price albeit tastier.What was truly shocking and unacceptable, was the special prawns. When I ate at this restaurant 9 months ago, I was charged rm30++ per prawn, as it was supposedly the low season. (Price indicated on menu is "market price").This time, I was charged rm199++ for six prawns. Yes they were big prawns, but to charge the same exorbitant price now and 9months ago means it is not truly the market price is it?It was also very disappointing that the restaurant had run out of many items on the menu. The lame excuse was that they had too many patrons the night before and the restaurant didn't have time to replenish even basic items like vegetables!If u wish to try this restaurant, AVOID the special prawns. In my bill of rm650, two-thirds went to the suckling pig and the 6 prawns!

Author: happybaby03Singapore, Singapore
Title: Horrible service!
Review: Read up the review about this restaurant so we decided to give a try. There was no one attending to us when we are at the door. It was the lovely customers whom sitting around told us there were more seats available upstairs since they seen we have big groups. Headed up with the narrow steps and the waitress upstair stop us from going up saying that is full house no place at all. So we went down again and notice one big round table only 2 seats occupied so we wanted to share the table. Just when we are arranging the seats a man came out say sorry you all cannot sit here cos we cannot walk at all. I am so angry and asked my friend loudly have he order anything if not let's go ... is total a waste of time and I will not spend my money here! No point spending money on this lousy service there are plenty of nice yummy food located at Jonker!

Author: Enkidu-backpackerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Creepy staff, good tandoori,bad naan, good price
Review: We visited for tandoori and cheese Nan. Tandoori came first, quite small bit looked really good and great taste. Green sauce was quite watery. Then naan came, plain Nan! When I had asked for cheese Nan. I returned it back and then cheese naan came with just little cheese in center. Staff didn't even bother to take order but when we were going to pay, he was looking inside my shopping bag exploring my stuff with his eyes which was really rude and creepy!

Author: Xavier1328
Title: Perrier jouet champagne brunch graze Hilton Kl
Review: All the team, adli, azu, fajar, Stephanie, fadli.chef Bret, Nathan, Steven, ehsan, haziq, perfect!

Author: RobertChew-MYShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Don't bother...
Review: This is a classic case of social media influence This place used to to give you big la la and cooked well. nowadays is popular because of social media. Went there yesterday (July 1, 2017). Fourteen of us. My sis went there to wait at 5:30pm. we arrived at 7pm. Food arrived at 8pm!!!!We order the so called famous dishes: Xiong Tong La La, Chiu Pai Noodle, Oat Mantis Prawn, Ham Yee Fa Lam Poh, Belacan Kangkung, Tit Pan Tauhu and yau mal.La La are small nowadays but xiong tong is good. Oat are too sweet for the mantis prawn. Noodle tasteless and oily. The rest you can find much better elsewhere.you see 90% are young people and from our of town, obviously come here using waze after r3ading it social media.Price is not that cheap. RM 235 considering the food We ordered or common food.Don't bother to queue.

Author: AdelineLCFKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Celebrate Friend's Birthday
Review: Celebrate my friend's birthday here at the month of March. We having a great time here! The staff was friendly and helpful. The restaurant manager approach us to check on our food and our feedback. The portion was big and the price was reasonable. We are planning to celebrate me and my sisters birthday there again.

Author: Dana CDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Nice setting
Review: Went there last week for dinnerAfter getting lost because the taxi dropped us off at the wrong location, walking for 30min on a dark road, then finally hitch hiking our way there we finally arrived 1hour lateSetting is nice, staff is nice as well except one waiter who was being SO pushy and trying to up sell as well as almost forcing us to take what he wanted us to; the food was ok, not my favorite at all but maybe that's just because I prefer Thai food to Vietnamese As appetizers we had 2 salads and chicken wrapped in a leaf, the salads were so spicy I couldn't eat any, and they were full of onion, For main course we had some kind of prawn as well as another dish that was just okDessert we had the chocolate mousse and another fruit desert with chocolate icecream, the mousse was fine, the other didn't really had any flavor

Author: SailorMumSingapore, Singapore
Title: bad dining experience at Nobu
Review: First time at Nobu KL. Bad experience. Had Omakase. Food so-so. Very very slow service. The time between each course was 20-25 minutes wait. Had to call the waiter ALL the time to refill the green tea and the water. The candle on our table was not lighted. Asked the waiter to light it up as the restaurant light was so dim, a little candlelight would help us see better. The waiter took the candle away saying he would light it up but never returned. We had to ask for candlelight again from another waiter. So she took the candle from the unoccupied table next to ours!! For a meal that cost USD 416.90, think we deserved better service and food. SeaFood was not so fresh. After 2 hours and only at the 4th course, was getting v sleepy and asked the waiter to speed up serving the courses. I heard that Nobu was v good from someone who went to Nobu Beverly Hills.But I guess they don't maintain the quality and provide the same standard of service at Nobu KL. what's the point of asking patrons to dress up nicely - no round neck, no short pants etc. but the level of service and food quality does not befit that of a fine dining restaurant.

Author: abumusaadzhar
Title: Mediocrity at a premium price
Review: Everything was cold, even the service. Waitress unfriendly and service was slow. Highly recommend you look else where for a good meal.

Author: suexplorestheworldZurich, Switzerland
Title: Nice location with average food
Review: The Colonial Café is serving lunch and afternoon tea at the Majestic Hotel. As the hotel, it features a nice heritage style with different seating areas and a wonderful wooden bar. Unfortunately, the food did not meet my expectations. While the Mulligatawny soup was nice the salad was partly rotten and the dressing awful.To sum up: a nice setting but average food, unless they just had a bad day.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: awesome pork noodles!
Review: This stall is located within Money Corner Food Court which has many varieties of local food. Peter serves up only one thing which is the pork noodles. You can choose between 2 sizes and whether u want it with or without egg. Oh yes you can also decide the type of noodle (yellow mee, bee hoon or hor fun). Service is quick & friendly. Prices are okay for the location.I don't usually go for pork noodles as I usually find them rather bland. However Peter's is a whole new level. The broth is full of flavour and literally good to the last drop. Full of ingredients and a must have with egg. Comes to you pipping hot. Sluurrrp! Not to be missed for foodies. Highly recommended.

Author: stuffmattersLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great location and ambiance.
Review: Great location & open air feel given the large wrap round verandah overlooking gardens and the waterfront and a style that I'm sure James Brook would be comfortable in ! Whilst not the best value meal Iv had, it was a fun outing. Service was exemplary.

Author: TheGastronomic
Title: Horrendous Waiters Service!
Review: We're visiting from USA on a 45 days SE Asia Trip. We have visited Tokyo, Bangkok, Jakarta, Bali, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City. Then visited Madam Kwan's at Suria KLCC per recommendation of our good friend.We visited on Nov 3, 2016 around 7:30PM.The food was good but the waiter service just awful. No one waited for us. We had to "plead" to place orders. We read the menu then we closed the menu and usually that's the signal for the waiter to come over and takes our order. Well... noone came after 15 minutes. Then we had to waive our hands left and right just to get someone's attention.Then when we were ready to check out, we asked for a bill. The waiter said yes but then ignore us (to add salt to the wound, the waiter "leisurely" took order from the next table). We had to ask other waiter for the bill... seriously... we had to "beg" to pay them.Tried to complain to the so-called manager and all we got just "rolled-eyes" from the manager. In our SE Asia travel, we never seen so many "lazy" waiters until we visited this restaurant. They charge 10% service fee automatically on the bill so whether the waiters do more or less, they will get the same amount. Good food very unfortunate very poor, awful service... the worst of it, they didn't care!

Author: dekiaiparadoxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food had been compromised to ambiance...
Review: The restaurant is nicely decorated with comfortable ambiance however the food was no up to par. ordered my orange juice and half of it seems to be water. Placed an order for the prawn tapas, chicken burritos and fish grilled rice. Besides the rice, fish was only okay. The chicken burritos however was the worst.
