It had a burnt taste to it thought it wasn't burnt. I'm thinking they could've max the fire in order to cook the rice and chicken together quickly. The prawn tapas was alright however there was only 7 tiny prawns to it...and it's way overpriced. Then again, everything is.I think this place is all about ambiance and just drinks (by drinks i meant only beer). As i recall my orange juice was half water, my friend's special mexican drink tasted salty. Not a place that i'll give a second visit to.

Author: KwaiYinLSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great place to chill and eat
Review: The menu was quite limited but we were glad that the food tasted good.Four of us ordered several items to share: Laksa, Char Koay Teow, fried chicken and the two types of fried rice (salted fish & sambal). Nevertheless, we added one more bowl of laksa after the first one. It simply tasted good... generous serving of the ingredients and the soup was really yummy :) I liked the chicken which was fried with the paste. It's so fragrant and tasty when served piping hot! For the rice, however, there was not much difference between the two. It seemed to me a family business. Quite like the ambience here. Great eating place.

Author: gospidinmilojkoBangkok, Thailand
Title: Would love to eat their food daily..
Review: If you wish excellent food we would recommend you Jawi House. The menu is not big but is gold worth. We prefer restaurants with less dishes as this way they will be excellent in all they offer.Don’t forget their dessert, lemon tartin Can wait until next visit

Author: LKH2812Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Iphone stolen
Review: We were at havana last night and an iphone was picked up from our table when we went to dance. We have asked the manager for a cctv footage of the area and hopefully he will be able to help. But if u ate planning to go there pls be ware..

Author: TheYogaStudioCameron Highlands, Pahang
Title: Poor food
Review: We had a pork chop rice and tomato soup noodle. The taste is not outstanding at all. Same goes to the rice skin wrap. The sauce taste exactly like the Malaysian Chinese 'Chee Cheong Fun' sweet & sour sauce. Fruit juice is so watery. Not an authentic and taste is not near to a Vietnamese food.

Author: moveawayMalaysia
Title: Awful food with hard sell from the restaurant manager who essentially misled us
Review: Ordered their grass fed beef ribs when it was on promotion. It was dry and very sinewy and appeared to have been cooked sometime ago and just warmed up. The rest of our party had mediocre meals with fajitas (lamb) and a pizza-like mistake of a taco or enchilada starter. Cocktails were reasonable (we had margaritas). This is a poor excuse of a restaurant with food that can hardly be called Mexican

Author: arianna0405Ancona, Italy
Title: Not so good
Review: It is good if you want to eat some western food but it more expensive than any other place in Melaka and the service is really slow.By the way when there is live music the tables on the river are really nice you can enjoy your after dinner time there.

Author: AlocalExPatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb albeit a bit pricey
Review: We have eaten here 3-4 times now and have never had a bad meal.Thoroughly recommend the steamed fish (Tiger groper or Silver perch) with signature sauce. The Chilli crab is also excellent as are the various prawn dishes.Absolutely love the place and the attention by staff - Its pricey and yes you can get cheaper if you travel to Klang, Kuala Selangor etc but a great choice if your looking for very good Chinese style fresh seafood in KL

Author: svennovichKo Pha Ngan, Thailand
Title: okay i guess, but nothing to brag about
Review: we came here for dinner and had thai mango salad, calamari and grilled salmon. as for drink my gf had a pina colada. as for the thai mango salad...the mango was lost and not to be found and all the other dishes came with the same "salad" the calamari wasnt as expected to be... basically it was just fried squid and not the expected rings as you would usually get when ordering that dish... the salmon good. the pina colada was a virgin i think... even if we paid for a regular... personally i think there are better places then this one...zinc and granary for example.

Author: raymondp604
Title: Jazz nights monday
Review: Music was ok if a bit bland but pleasant enough. Drinks were cold and snacks hit the spot. Not a bad time in what otherwise would have been a quiet night.

Author: dorathyannes
Title: Terrible place
Review: The waiter did not ask us if we had any allergies to a specific type of food. The fusion cuisine might not be appetising to Malaysians. The table we were seated at was too small for even two people..not so happy with the restaurant

Author: JaxhowKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food ran out
Review: Went for a pre Christmas lunch buffet on Wednesday Dec 20th. Buffet started at 12 noon. By 1pm the lamb had finished and was replaced by sausage. Many of the pots of food were finishing and nothing much to eat. It's a frigging buffet for Gods sake. Very disappointed. The dessert counter was ok but nothing spectacular. I've had better elsewhere. Asked for a piece of Tiramisu and the staff literally shaved a piece if. It was so thin she may have well not bothered. The ice cream was nice though and the service was fine. I don't know whether it was a bad day or what but I won't be going back in a hurry.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Chicken  rice balls?
Review:
The chicken itself is very average. The rice itself is rolled into ball.shaped bit it's just ordinary rice and not the authentic chicken rice.

I am sure there are others which tastes better and is more authentic.

Keep looking and avoid this one if possible

Author: EricP4426
Title: Disappointment
Review: Very long waiting time ... drinks were cold when food is served Nasi kerabu fried chicken taste very bad - the road side stall is easily twice better and half of its priceSeafood linguine - totally tasteless and seafood is not fresh. Not worth RM78.

Author: Victorious_sponge
Title: Good food, service lacking a bit!
Review: We came and ate here twice during a three week stay. The first time I ate a vegetarian curry for dinner which was really tasty! The second time we came and had a sandwich for lunch, which was a bit underwhelming for the price. The service when you get it is friendly, however, they always seemed a bit stretched and were not very attentive. Seemed always to be more tourists than any locals that ate there. I feel they get a lot of customers because of the great location, however, I'm not sure it deserves it as much as some other places.

Author: 1holidayman
Title: Nice
Review:
1st of all Hamed our waiter was a top man very friendly , and very helpful with the choice of food .
Great chicken cooked to perfection , curry and sizzler , 
Great Nan Bread , 
Excellent price .
Recommend it .

Author: ChrisB417Crieff, United Kingdom
Title: Inconsistent
Review: We went for lunch during the week with my wife and mother and father-in-law while visiting KL. When entering the restaurant we were initially very impressed, great decor and atmosphere and the menu was excellent.Unfortunately there were too many issues to overlook from then on, service was terribly slow except when we got 1 of the better dressed waiters; as an example we had to order our second round of drinks 3 times before they came. The food was good but not great and came at different times. This issue seems common place across a number of restaurants we ate in, it's almost like the kitchen makes whatever it can as quickly as it can and then it gets brought out, no thought around timings. The value was good however, big portions of pasta and the toastie was huge, so no complaints there.Go here if you're at KLCC, not in a hurry and are looking for good food and good portions - wouldn't go out of my way though.

Author: 922nizarz
Title: Dinner
Review: The best serviced offered here, and food here is delicious, but i came just to have some pasta, yet delicious, thank you

Author: Ed MNewcastle Upon Tyne
Title: Authentic Mexican in KL
Review: Excellent ambiance and authentic Mexican food. The proportions are perfect not the typical American sizes for anyone thinking this is Tex-Mex!

Author: Dryadra
Title: Our first fine dining in KL
Review: And... It did not disappoint. The rib eye was ooh lala. Meat & fats melting in the mouth. Be warned though the portions are pretty big - more like Greek portions (lesser than American). Hubby and I shared everything. Their signature dessert is a must!!

Author: YieQinT
Title: Good food great ambience
Review: Family friendly environment and a good place to chill. Love the Durian Musang King Cronut Ice cream too!

Author: 777neilBangkok, Thailand
Title: Average. Very average.
Review: A well-known cafe in this World Heritage city, the Geographer is tastefully furnished, well staffed, clean and neat. The service was great, the food, average. In this city you are spoilt for choice for food. What I liked most was the decor. Least, the Lorong soup which had an oily layer and for a vegetarian staple was a touch disappointing.

Author: munishuthayaKajang, Malaysia
Title: Not again!
Review: I went here today with my hubby n children. We ordered dad's curry laksa, lamb steak with pesto n chopped chicken. I am definitely not satisfied with the food! Tasteless! I can get tastier curry mee somewhr else. The lamb steak portion was too small and overpriced RM 138, and even the laksa was 38 ringgit. Oh man! I felt waste of money, seriously!!! Besides that service was good n nice ambient. Thank you Ben's! Won't come again!

Author: Suba I
Title: Not so impressed
Review:
We just went to this restaurant, and the food quality is not meet the range of its price. The service is ok, we ask for chicken fried rice but they give seafood fried rice. We request papadam but never served.

Worst experience.

Author: boltotravellerAdlington, United Kingdom
Title: £5 for a coke
Review: £5 for a cook, outrageous. I first ordered a glass of water and was given a glass of hot water very strange. It’s quite scruffy nothing like the sky bar in Bangkok. It was £20 for a coke and a beer. Staff were not good will not return

Author: General_kohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Below average food
Review: Don't waste your time here. There are better food along the street than this. The variety is very limited and many of the food are cold.

Author: dshri999
Title: Inconsistent food and payment method
Review: I have been visiting this place for about 2 years now. The ambience is nice, the taste of the food is somewhat inconsistent however it would not be too bad to the extend it is not edible. What truly caught my attention was their payment method. The staffs would insist that you can only use the debit card if the amount is more than RM50. However there are times, some staff will allow us to use the card even when the amount is less than RM50. In one recent instance, the staff was insisting that i pay by cash since the amount was less than RM50, after informing the staff that i do not have cash in hand, he would then just proceed to use the card and payment was made cashless. It is really disappointing to see this kind of inconvenience being practised in restaurant like this in Bangsar. I still cannot comprehend the reason they would imply such rules when they can actually allow payment to be made cashless regardless of the amount. Is it a marketing stunt to make their customer spend more or some kind of hidden reason that we are simply just not aware about?

Author: Kapten A
Title: Indian Style
Review: Who want to try to eat like Indian style.. Recommended to eat at this restaurant.. eat white white with banana leaf feel like an Indian style eating. Food also is very good.

Author: drlocbiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Sick of their lies
Review: We have visited this tea shop every year for the last 3 years to try and buy a particular product that cannot be obtained in Australia. Each time they gave just sold out. Last year we were transiting back through KL and the assistant promised to email us advising if the new delivery had arrived - no email. Special trip from the airport- no tea either. So if French Earl Grey is your tea of choice don't waste your time here and don't take any notice if anything the liars tell you.

Author: KGB777Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience
Review: I came here for dinner on one of the nights I was in Ipoh recently. It's a nice little cafe with some great ambience and juices. The food, however, isn't quite as great and I didn't end up finishing all of mine. Probably a better choice just to hang out and have a juice in rather than having the food.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Not cheap but good experience
Review:
They serve dayak food.

It's a good experience to go and taste food from the indigenous dayak tribe of sarawak

Food is good quality albeit a bit expensive for Kuching standard

Author: I3365OY
Title: Good food but very slow
Review: The food tastes good but you have to wait 30 min to have it even with low numbers of customers around.

Author: Leng N
Title: From bad to worse
Review: When they first arrived in KL, food and service was fantastic!Over the years, the breakfast set got worse and so are the service.Their waiter/waitresses were either rude or lack knowledge of the food menu and offering. There's probably only 1 Malay lady wait-staff who knows the menu and it's so frustrating that they get our orders all wrong. The last 4x I'm here I told myself not to order it's Eggs Benedict but did so miserably because the other stuff in the menu doesn't seem appealing.The Eggs Benedict was awful! The bun was hard! A sign that it was taken out from the fridge and not thawed properly before serving and the salmon was icky too, lacking freshness. Even the scones are not as good as it taste. The other desserts looks good but they don't actually taste the way they look. - Need improvement- Time to revamp your menu - Re-train your wait-staff- Be service-oriented. I'm not paying to look at sour faces

Author: BritnieS5
Title: I went on TripAdvisor just to rate them
Review: This place is really great. The staff are friendly, the food is delicious, The atmosphere is relaxing, and the art is well done.

Author: Ng L
Title: Nice services food not satisfied
Review:
We got good welcome when going in the restaurant, server n hostess come fast n in a polite way. 

Food not worth for what I paying, normal.

Author: 426iwansJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Standard, pricey and FAKE review.
Review: I came because I saw it was number 1 @tripadvisor. The fact was, there were not many customers at the restaurant, the food was standard and the price was expensive (colagen soup was pricey, but inside only include few pieces of chicken meat). I went there during dinner time. Then how come it is rated number 1 in tripadvisor? Because there is FREE ICE CREAM for people who gave good review.

Author: erikk2127
Title: Awesome Food
Review:
For Malay Cuisine... this is the place to come and eat.. you wouldnt go wrong
Location is good ...
Service is fantastic...

Author: Gary-L8Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I agree with the rating of "fair"
Review: I had minestrone soup, calamari, and a salmon dish. Wife had escargot tart & crab meat linguini. Was ok, or fair, but no wow factor. The restaurant was reasonably full, and because we didn't reserve, we got a street side table for 2. Service is marginal, but polite. Ambiance does not justify a visit, but the restaurant displays a bunch of best restaurant awards, so maybe I am missing something. I provided a pic from my side of the table, past my wife, with the cars to the right. I also took a pic facing into the restaurant, including the wall with awards. It is ok!!!

Author: elenita o
Title: Set lunch
Review: A quiet place to relax and to  enjoy their set meal. Highly recommended for a big group to be dine in.

Author: junejiun216
Title: Lovely dining experience!
Review: My first experience here at El Cerdo Changkat was not a pleasant one, hence I was offered a second chance to dine in at the restaurant. We were served by the same lady that served us during our first visit there, her name is Cho, she was very helpful and welcoming, service was undeniably good. We had calamari, sautéd brown mushrooms and creamy mushroom soup for appetisers to start the evening. The calamari was delightful as it wasn't heavily battered but the crunch was there, very well-seasoned. Sautéd mushroom and the soup were just mediocre. For mains, we had their signature pork shoulder steaks and half a roasted suckling pig, both to be shared among four of us. The pork chops were so flavoursome and surprisingly succulent, they've totally nailed that dish and I'd say it's the best pork chop I've ever had in KL. However, the potato mash that came with it was a little bit too dry to my liking, it could use some butter/cream to make it slightly moist and richer. The half piglet was delicious! Crispy skin and juicy meats, couldn't ask for a better suckling pig. Ended the wonderful evening with tiramisu and churros.The Tiramisu was amazing but the churros was a little bit disappointing, it was crunchy however the batter was a little bit too densed and not airy as it was supposed to be, so it felt like I was eating deep-fried bread! My overall experience there during my second visit was very pleasurable, will definitely be back for more pork dishes!

Author: Juliet CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Shoved the bill in our face because they closing the till
Review: This is the second and last time we are coming to this restaurant. The ribs that we had were average, they were better the first time we were there, but what really made us upset with this restaurant was that at around 9:30pm, their staff obviously wanted to go home early and started printing out all the bills for the tables and handed them to the guests. The waiter shoved the bill in my husband's face while we were still eating and said "Closing cash machine. Pay now." We were obviously unhappy about this and refused to pay until we had finished eating. The waiter came back another two more times to ask us to pay up, and when his colleague standing at the till saw that my husband was not happy told the waiter to leave us alone. This is really not acceptable. Appalling customer service.

Author: serenar430
Title: Bad experience
Review: Very disappointed. Waited an hour plus for the food. Service is very slow. Serving is small for a long wait.

Author: RoyStormerGuangzhou, China
Title: Average Arabic Food
Review: This place was close to our hotel and we were told to eat here by the concierge. I gave them an extra star because the decor was nice and they have AC (not guaranteed in KL). The bread was not as soft and pillowy as we normally like and the spicy hummus was very bland. I do not know if it's supposed to be bland but I have had delicious hummus before and this was not it. We got the mixed grill with 4 different skewers and only one of the chicken ones was tasty. The other 3 were either on the bland side or the meat (lamb) was very tough. My wife did enjoy the garlic sauce and dipped everything in there to add a little flavor. The biryani rice was fine as well.

Author: AmyWoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simple the best
Review: I was there for dining on my ROM night with my hubby. Their food & service are really good! Tiramisu is a MUST try here

Author: JohnsonIVOxon Hill, Maryland
Title: Beautiful setting, but not what I hoped for the price
Review: I was here for brunch and thought this was good but not what I'd hoped. The brunch spread was a good-size, although I perhaps greedily expected more for the price. There was a table of salads/vegetables/fruits, carved meat (roast beef), and breads; a table with three entrees in chafing dishes; and a dessert table. In addition, the staff brings around small-bite items and bowls of pasta. The food was good, but I didn't come across anything that wowed me and made me go back for more. (Not that that stopped me from going back for more, especially because I'm a sucker for pasta.) You can choose all-you-can-drink options with prosecco, wine...and maybe beer?The brunch is served in a beautiful setting, with elegant, dark shades indoors that highlight the excellent view of KLCC Park and the Petronas Towers through the floor-to-ceiling windows on two sides of the restaurant. The staff is friendly and efficient.

Author: shahirtahir_56Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just Average
Review: The menu is very limited but it's fine for me. Only one appetizer in the menu i.e. cheesy escargot which i found the cheese quite tasty. As for the escargot, just normal, nothing to shout about.Then comes the main course. I ordered Tenderloin and my wife ordered Rib Eye with both of medium doneness. Mine is cooked as per ordered but my wife's steak was overcooked. Taste-wise is good but I have tasted better.Now for the desert, they only have creme brulee, the normal vanilla one and chocolate. We ordered one each. This is what makes my rating to this restaurant only average as the creme brulee is a quite a disappointment. It's more like a pudding already, so dense.Will I return? I don't think so.

Author: MujieKMHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Farewell Dinner
Review: Foods not so variety but still satisfied The best are their grill bar - sirloin, ribeye, lamb and others are fresh and nice. You just choose what you want and chef will grill for you. Once done they will serve it to your table. Staff are friendly The view from restaurant also great - KLCC

Author: Lee SMelaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Price of food
Review: The price of food here is usually quite expensive. I feel the price charge is more expensive when compare to other eateries. This is especially so for fishes. Price for fried vegetable is also costly. I hope the operator can adjust a little bit the price charged so that moreeople will go. They have to remember this if they charge cheaper then more people will go as such the business will be better.

Author: Debbie2380Maleny, Australia
Title: Closed at 12pm
Review: After reading the reviews we wanted to try this place. Arrived at 12pm and discovered it’s closed. So disapointed. I can’t rate this as we didn’t have the opportunity to try it out

Author: mariafdagironFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Average and extremely slow!
Review: The sushis here are just average! The creativity of vegan sushi’s is very low since it is the same ingredients for all the sushis. This place is also in desperately need of an extra server! It gets full very easily (because of its tiny space) so the service is extremely slow! They took 1hour and 30minutes to deliver 4 types of sushi! (We ordered more stuffs but they forgot!) Also extremely expensive for the average sushi flavor. Was worth the try but we would not come back.

Author: JuneT502
Title: Not too fantastic
Review: Set menu think is reasonable, just came back yesterday and had hotpot soup for 2 with wife.I think ingredient portion in pot is not generous but side dishes are ok, can ask for more if need.Hotpot does not come with rice and a small bowl of rice is RM5 which I think is too highly priced.Not a must try Korean restaurant in Melaka, In Johor yes, Bornga in City Square food is much better.But the Nepalese staff are really good.I don't like the stern looking Korean boss pacing here and there at the counter while our table is just to it. Irritating pacing by the Korean boss.

Author: FrenchInAsiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great lunch
Review: We enjoyed very much finding this cafe and getting food served at 4 pm!!We had salad and croque monsieur which were very good! Deserts were excellent unfortunately we ate them before taking photos!!Toilets very cleanStaff lovely

Author: christopherysl
Title: Expensive food
Review: Street food but the prices are super duper expensive, a plate of small 1 pax fried noodles costs about RM11.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great space, great food
Review: The restaurant has a great space ideal for functions and bigger gatherings. We tend to go for dinner, and we always manage to get a table (lunch time can be crowded).We enjoy our meals here, though the naan bread can be inconsistent (some days are bland, some days are delicious with a buttery ghee). We tried everything from the menu, and our must-order is the Dhal Makati, the smokiness of the lentil curry is very appetising with bread or briyani rice.Service is pleasant and obliging. Will be back again and again!

Author: drsfr
Title: Not worth a visit.
Review: We went as per recommendation from a tour guide. We tried the nyonya cakes pineapple tarts chendol and laksa. Really average and nothing memorable. We had better lalsa at calanthe cafe and chendol at the food court in pahlawan mall. Go elsewhere for nyonya food.

Author: peng1946San Francisco, California
Title: Overrated
Review: Expensive and not true peranakan flavours. Very disappointed. We loved Penang food but not this one. Can get better peranakan food in another restaurant.

Author: GwidonF2
Title: Food is dirty
Review: Not coming back to this place again, the food is dirty got one of the iron wash brush inside the food, really had bad feeling about this.

Author: Bev BNew York City, New York
Title: Best Sushi Chef Ever - Better than Nobu in NYC!
Review: I live 3 doors down from Nobu in New York, ostensibly one of the best Japanese restaurants on earth. But after savoring and Omikase of Chef Johnny at Iketeru, I've got news for Nobu Matsuhisa: You have a serious competitor in Kuala Lumpur - and the prices in KL are a fraction of Nobu's tabs in NYC. What's more Chef Johnny makes you feel welcome. It's fun! It's exactly what every traveler wants and needs at the end of a long day: Off-the-charts fabulous food and a sense of being welcome and having a great evening. Hats off to Chef Johnny!

Author: Cammal_BrownBoyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ok lah...
Review: This review is based on Overseas restaurant in Armada Hotel, PJ. This is my second visit for CNY yee sang dinner with friends at the same restaurant. Sorry for the late submission. Generally the service is good however I feel the quality of the food is not as good as before. We took the dinner set for 8 of us. The price has increased as well. If they are gonna continue with this, I probably will not return to this outlet in future. Nowadays there are so many restaurants serving yee sang dinner in PJ area as such finding one within the same price range will not be difficult. I hope they will improve their food quality, portion and perhaps price to attract future customers.

Author: STANTE0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Does not live up to the Pizza Hut name
Review: The mushroom soup is pathetic... but its not this branch only, its the same bland soup wannabe served at other branches too.Pizza is kinda ok, but strange, not as good as how its done in other countries, or the neighboring country. Pop over to Vivo for better pizzas. Service is average.

Author: SpiceSpy
Title: Average South & Indian Food
Review: Buffet lunch at RM 30/person is worth trying.  The buffet is until 3.30pm only.  Varieties of   Briyani also good.  Place is rather small and best to avoid peak hours.

Author: sannenooitgedagtAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Overpriced food, unkind staff
Review: Came here hoping I’d get a delicious smoothie bowl, so I was willing to pay a little bit more for it. The waitress was very unkind and seemed super annoyed, which made me feel unwelcome. My mango smoothie bowl was all right, but really nothing special and didn’t have passion fruit topping as it says on the menu (it had pomegranate instead). Overall the experience was mainly bad because of the staff, the restaurant itself looks nice and the food is ok but not really worth the price in my eyes.

Author: Rdwrer
Title: Nice view, good food but ultimately not worth it
Review: The views over KL are great, the service good (at times we couldn't hear the server's description of food, she was speaking so softly) and generally attentive and the food was at the standard to be expected. However, for a degustation menu the dishes were lame, safe options. I expect more from Nobu, something interesting and sth with a wow factor. This was good Japanese fusion fare, no more, no less. And that is widely available in KL at much more competitive prices. Thus disappointing and not worth the long ascent via 2 elevators and 20 staff pointing the way. Overdone, over it.

Author: Homealonetoday
Title: Nothing special
Review: Not sure why there are so many overrated reviews here, however my visit in September wasn't that good. My girlfriend is Spanish, she ordered ribs and it was tasteless(it isn't Spanish Iberico flavour at all). The prices are quite high, service is good though. I don't think we will return. No, thanks!

Author: E7174Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Underwhelming
Review: Having read decent reviews before visiting Malaysia, we thought we were booking something ‘authentic and traditional’ when we booked our table at Bijan.We visited towards the end of our holiday, so by the time of our visit had experienced a couple of weeks of fantastic Malaysian food from across the spectrum - Hawker Stalls, local family run cafes, smart ‘higher end’ places etc, so we were expecting some great flavours, since every other meal we had prior was so good.Unfortunately the food at Bijan was utterly underwhelming, bland, lacking in seasoning and flavour.If this had been my first experience of Malaysian cuisine I’d have thought I was in for a couple of weeks of ordinary fare at best!The venue is large and neatly decorated, but has a bit of a theme park feel about it and is packed with tourists. It’s also pretty expensive.The staff were friendly though and the dessert (Gula Melaka Cake) was good.

Author: Roadtoholidays
Title: Nice atmosphere, disappointing cappuccino/cocktails and ok food.
Review: Nice setting and atmosphere. Service was above average. Cappuccino and cocktails were of disappointing quality. Food was ok but nothing special. Overall not likely to come back.

Author: JK926Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Aziamendi88
Review: For the reasons of celebrating my wife's birthday and our 15th anniversary we have invited my cousin and his friend who came from HK to join us for the dinner. Been communicating with the Mandarin Grill (MG) for our requirement as my wife is gluten free. Upon arrival we were escort to the bar and wait. We were not sure if we were to order any drinks as no one told us why we needed to wait and for how long to wait until we asked and then they explained that we will be going to "the garden", an area which can accommodating 8 persons at a time before going to our table. The picnic at the garden was good but that could be coordinated better. Having emailed with MG a few times, they still got some of details wrong e.g. two fishes two meats but we got 3 fishes 1 meat; my wife got the non-gluten free bread until 2nd round and etc. However, the servicing staff were very good and helpful.Not going into too much details about the food as you must go and try them, all of them were good especially the amazing foie gras. Not so much the taste but it was the presentation and artistic display that made the visit worthwhile. The bill was just over RM2800 for four of us with wine-paring 8-course dinner, it was very reasonable for a Michelin 3* dining experience. Good experience with Aaziamendi88, very enjoyable but not MG and basically still the same issues with MG as I went last year.

Author: Voyager342453
Title: Chicken chop..
Review: Hi.. oldest cafe in Johor Bahru..the chicken chop w eggs added on top.. lovely..lamb is one my favourite..but must have the coffee..

Author: Debora H
Title: Omg
Review:
Really disappointed why tripadvisor have this for first Italian restaurant in kl!!!! 
Food mediocrity location same!!! 
Pizza same market mall !!!

Author: GrantG792
Title: Best Tapas in KL
Review: A great place to eat if you like tapas. The service and the atmosphere are great. Food is not overy expensive but is all well presented and very tasty

Author: AdrianAdy66
Title: love the food.
Review: love the food...service is ok...atmosphere is nice too..

Author: Desert_BlondeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: We had heard such great things about this little cafe tucked away in Bau Ferringhi that we had to visit while we were on the island. My meal was amazing but my husband and 11 year old daughter were disappointed with their meals. My daughter had the lemon chicken and my husband the Thai fish which just happened to be one of the chef's recommendations on the blackboard. Possibly this was to get rid of the fish because it needed to be thrown out! All 3 of us suffered from food poisoning. As I only had a very small amount of the chicken I was the least affected. My daughter only ate a small amount as well and we ordered her french fries to replace her meal. My husband ate all the fish and half of my daughter's chicken. We dined at the restaurant on Saturday night and my husband is still violently ill and had to visit the doctor this morning to get prescription medication. Not very often that food affects him like this, normally he just has an "off" day. The service and staff were very good and it was a lovely little restaurant. The owner had told us that they had been exceptionally busy for months and the last 2 nights very very quiet. I am guessing they had way too much food that needed to be used an wasn't as fresh as it should have been. I would imagine we just got lucky at the drop in business and they have adjusted their ordering quantities by now. Shame, my meal was delicious!

Author: Capta1n57Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Learn from this man!
Review: My 1st visit to this branch. Nice layout,not always keen on Mall restaurants,but have been to their Great Eastern branch,so familiar with the menu. Edel,was our waiter,and he was head and shoulders above the rest of the staff. Food was great and Edel made the experience more enjoyable. Not expensive either

Author: maxsimkhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Japanese Restaurant in Klang Valley
Review: Finally the SOP for Covid-19 is relaxed and dining in is allowed. Great food as usual, portion of sashimi is thicker than most Japanese restaurant. Very attentive and friendly staff Ms. Sophia. Highly recommend this place if you have craving for Japanese food and do ask for Sophia.

Author: Kailee_TN
Title: Disappointed & over-rated
Review: It's our first time to Melaka and we decided to have lunch at this place due to Tripadvisor's rating. Boy... are we really disappointed. We ordered chicken candlenut, fried meehoon, ngoh hiang, and cendol. Only ngoh hiang was a bit tasty, cendol was good, but the first 2 dishes were completely tasteless. Strongly urge Tripadvisor to review the rating.

Author: renefishKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quaint little place tucked in the basement of central plaza serving great japanese cuisine
Review: I chanced upon this unassuming restaurant some time ago since it is near my office. I have then made it a point to savour their food every now and then. It serves reasonably priced japanese cuisine with the exception of ramen. Try their pastas which are really delicious, creamy and tasty. Fancy having unlimited shashimi... Try their a la carte buffet which just over rm50 per person....you can choose from their menu a good selection of teppanyakis, shashimis including oysters, grills, ice cream and free flow of house drinks and tea. I notice that it is full during evenings as their buffet is quite popular especially on festive ocassions such as valentines day

Author: shctidStockport, United Kingdom
Title: Twice in three days
Review: My wife and I were in the Far East for 3 weeks and were joined in KL for 3 days by our elder daughter and boyfriend.On our second evening we turned up at 7TNine hoping for a half reasonable mealResult!It was so good that on our last night there was no argument. We all wanted to go again.The food is really tasty and our western tastes and fussiness was catered for: chicken tikka massala, which I accept is not a proper Indian dish, was not on the menu, but they produced a super version; another dish should have been prepared with lots of small pieces of chicken chopped up bones and all, but this was replaced with boneless breast meat. Happy days!The waiters were great - so attentive.If I had a gripe it would be the quality of the beer. But then I didn't go to Asia to enhance my love of real ale. And at least the wine was of a standard.All in all, a happy experience which I'd recommend to others.

Author: diyaasree25Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: worst service ever for local comer
Review: i have been to tgs several time with friends. what i can notice is all the staff only entertain and giving the good service for foreigners. (may be they think only the foreigners can review in this trip advisor).we need to call more then 5 times to order the food. the way they serve to the local is very rude. its big disappointed.

Author: 718belindagJurong East, Singapore
Title: Most terrible service and irresponsible owner
Review: Most terrible service from this restaurant EVER!! Waiter spilled hot barley all over me. Instead of apologizing he just got me a box of tissue and walked away. I had to call him back to clean up the floor and table, and get me a new chair because it was wet. Throughout the whole incident, the restaurant owner conveniently busied himself away from our table and I had to ask him over to talk. The owner told me it could be because my kid had distracted the waiter which caused the incident when all the while my child was just seated beside me minding his own business? Honestly that was the worst kind and most irresponsible excuse anyone could find for a mistake they made. Nothing offered to make amends so nothing else to be said. Just my bad luck to be here. There’s nothing fantastic about their food. Please don’t come to this restaurant.

Author: cfoo13
Title: Great food!
Review: Food quality was great and the service was impeccable as always. There’s a seasonal menu that changes frequently and ingredients are flown in from Japan. Would revisit.

Author: Simon6511
Title: Simply Good
Review: This is a great place if you wish to bring your guest to dine and enjoy Malaysian food, though the place is crowded, the food is nice, the waiter and waitress are friendly and the selection for the BUKA Puasa is just great

Author: joshua_Solo
Title: Bad quality crepes
Review: Um first off the service was bad, and second the food didn’t taste good. Only came here because Briezh Up was closed. Very poor food and service, small space too.

Author: K5224MTjennyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Rude staff
Review: Don't bother going if you're a tourist, you won't be made to feel welcome, at least I wasn't. I love to support local businesses while backpacking but my advice is to visit one of the many other local places in the area. A waitress was incredibly rude to me last night. I politely asked her if it was self service or if they plate the food for you as it wasn't obvious to me because of the layout. She laughed in my face then grabbed a couple of the other staff while continuing to laugh at me. Then while I was eating she kept looking over and smirking at me then typing on her phone. I wish I'd have left instead of eating there as it ruined my meal and my mood. Please treat people with a bit of kindness in future, especially if they're on their own - it made me feel very uncomfortable.

Author: YhanS15
Title: Great ambience . Good food . And friendly staff
Review: If your looking for a good and great ambience , well this right for you.. going here for the first time was so excellent for the staff who serving happiness and enjoying .. martinis serve with dance . And dont miss out there happy hour dance

Author: ChillaxGalSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mid valley KL branch
Review: Indoor area is pretty limited so we sat at the outdoor area which has a much bigger capacity. It’s fun to watch the shoppers rushing around in this busy area. Food wise, we enjoyed all 3 food items - Fried salmon belly with 2 different dips, salted fish pasta with a smoky aroma and stew duck bee Hoon soup with a big duck drumstick. The meat on the duck leg is a tad tough but I still like the taste.

Author: phooneyySingapore
Title: Great food worth waiting for!
Review: I am from Singapore. My family of four came here on the second night of Chinese New Year. We were told to wait an hour for the food to arrive, of course we waited, my dad loves chinese food. My Favourite dish here is the Cheese Bee Hoon and Claypot Sliced pork. Two other dishes that we ordered was Tom Yam Soup(the red one) and Kai Lan w roast meat. P. S. This restaurant serves pork !Staff service was great too! She recommended food to us and treat us like family. Ambience, was a little cozy and stuffy because the section where we sat was not air-conditioned. Howevere, there is music playing in the restaurant too and I think is a bonus for me. Price was affordable! We paid RM147.50 in total for 4pax for 4 dishes + a pot of tea. To sum up, you can have a great dinner with your family here if you come to Melaka and this place is highly recommended. This serves as an alternative to Tong Sheng Restoran or Amboi Nyonya which are overcrowded with long queues.

Author: Morkeel
Title: Disappointed
Review: I have been visited this bar few times and this time i bring to my boss here, to get couple of whisky.we Ask the menu but we get the menu after 10 minutes.i was Rising my hand few times but nobody response.Finally one of the lady stuff came and took our Order.i used to come here coz the whisky selection impressive amd i always get good service, but this time it’s completely different.i have seen all the stuff was careless.i am Very disappointed and i will never Come back here.#service is Very bad.

Author: Bryant1109Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: JB FIRST MICKEY MOUSE CAFE !
Review: Just had high tea there with my friends. Everyone loved the chill and relaxing atmosphere. Staff were generally friendly. We had the following items:1. Mushroom soup 4/52. Carbonara 4/53. Tiramisu with ice-cream 4/54. Hot Dark Chocolate 5/5Pretty and cute mickey mouse cup. The star of this cafe. Unfortunately they don't have sell coffee at all, but their staff said coming soon !Will definitely be back.Visited SEP 2015

Author: leonac435Singapore
Title: Nice Surprise
Review: Very thoughtful of the resty to offer me a very yummy pleasant birthday desert! Had the tuna steak which was very delicious cooked to perfection as I didn’t like it raw. The salad was generous in portion and I had a good balanced meal. Service is excellent attentive and environment is lovely. Glad I googled for fine dining in JB and the resty came up on the list! Highly recommend for good quality food and nice environment for any occasion.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: Jacqueline LChandler, Arizona
Title: Most horrible Tony Roma’s I’ve ever been
Review: I would give this TR a negative star if I can but too bad the system doesn’t allow me to. I ordered chicken burger while hubby ordered rib eye. The rib eye came with one piece of dried out meat and mashed potato. Same as my burger, only burger and mashed potato. There were no side dish at all. When approached the waitress, she just told us oh, we ran out of fries. When asked isn’t there 2 side dishes came with the meal. She just passed us the menu and asked us to choose the side dish. The so call free kids meal looks patethic as well. The cheese burger is too dry with extremely thin pattie. All in all, food in TR Pavillion look worse than cafeteria food. Save your money and go somewhere else. Whoever that is running this restaurant it’s better well off shutting this restaurant down.

Author: Sian510
Title: Rude!
Review: This is such an a let down restaurant. Very nice building and ambience but the staff were so unhelpful we generally had to ask 4 different people to order something. The food was average and overpriced. Give it a miss
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: selvarajahjKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible Service for Breakfast
Review: Went for breakfast at this restaurant in Bangsar Jalan Telawi, on 11 Feb, 2018. Ordered a rawa thosa and a roti telur with Nescafe C and Milo kosong Hot. The rawa thosa came after 30 minutes of waiting and after chasing the restaurant waiters for no less than 4 times .... the roti telur never came !! by then it wa 1 hour and 10 mins since we came in and ordered !!!The rawa thosa was tough and stuck to the plate - not edible after 10 mins of it being delivered to the table.Left feeling extremely disgusted with the food and the waiters. Complained to the cashier and he put on a totally dumb face with no words or reaction !!!

Author: Jiu Mu XSingapore, Singapore
Title: Can give it a miss
Review: We were told that this restaurant served good nyonya food. So we decided to give it a try. First time i dined in a restautant that turned on its air con at full blast. Everyone was shivering. The waitresses said they needed to circulate the air. Werent they afraid that the food would turn cold very fast?Anyway, we ordered chicken pongteh, makko fried chicken, ngoh hiang, steamed beancurd with fried shrimps, fried fish with chilli, brinjal with chilli and chinchalok fried egg.The chicken pongteh and egg were tasty. The steamed beancurb, brinjal and ngoh hiang were so so. The fried chicken n fried fish were hard and tough. I think we probably ordered the wrong dishes so we didnt find them fantastic. Price was reasonable but i think i ll try other nonya restaurants next time.

Author: Hope V
Title: Great western food
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant on our first night in kl. It was wonderful- the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The food was fantastic! Felt like eating proper western food- a pleasant surprise to eat a steak as good as it was in Malaysia! However a bit more expensive that expected but well worth it.

Author: Nani A
Title: Pricey but nice al-fresco
Review: The food and beverage are over priced. the only saving grace is that they served perfect Long Black. However it is a perfect location to chill after a good shopping workout.

Author: LL721Kuala Lumpur
Title: Delicious food in nice environment
Review: We tried the Mixed Vege, Shahi Paneer, Saag Gosht, Masala Chole, Kadai Murg bls, Dice Chicken, Garlic Naan, Cheese Naan, Chapatti and Tandoori Roti. All were delicious. Before the main dishes arrived, they served a variety of papadum: the normal ones and the ones with black pepper with 2 different dips.The decoration in the restaurant was really nice too and made our photographs really pretty. We enjoyed our food and service was excellent.Lastly, there was lemon water in little bowls to wash our fingers and Saunf (fennel seeds) which was really unique. Overall it was really an authentic experience.

Author: Mervyn H
Title: Misrepresentation, tasteless, pricey
Review: The Vietnamese salad was NOT vietnamese, but it was certainly a less than mediocre salad without any decent vegetables. Topping the tasteless dish with pavillion prices means it's a place of never again.

Author: anita111222Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worse mexican food i've ever tried in my life !!
Review: I travel alot & tasted in a lot of different mexican foods infact mexican food is one of my favourite food & was really pleased that a mexican restuarant is near by but m very disappointed with this restaurant this is the worst mexican food i have ever tasted.

Author: Akash AMumbai, India
Title: Highly recommended by Tripadvisor .. but I would not re-visit
Review: We went there as my friends were looking for good Vegetarian options and there were good recommendations on Tripadvisor . We ordered Local Vegetarian stuff which none of us could eat. The rice was so coconuty and this was not mentioned anywhere in the menu. The asam pedas was probably the worst we ever had - both the vegetarian as well as the one with fish. The highlight was the pesto pasta which we ordered after being disappointed with the asian dishes. This was no better and even the fast food versions of pasta shops make it better. There were mosquitoes in the indoor area and when we asked for a solution for it, the waiter said that we could sit outside which we didnt as it was about to rain and it did. We asked for a bigger table as our plates could not fit on the table they provided but the waiter didnt seem to understand. So I went to the bar counter and asked them to sort this which they eventually did. Guess, service does not come naturally to them . To my surprise, the place is packed with people ( mostly expats or tourists I guess )... They need some serious re-visiting in the dishes that they send out of the kitchen. I would recommend the quaint little cafes / local joints right across the street for a much more delectable meal.

Author: Aishinqiero
Title: Nice food but poor service
Review: The food was average but the portion was relatively small as commented by others and slightly pricey. There are limited table indoor and may require earlier booking to secure indoor seats. They have many waiters, however with poor management of waiters even though the restaurant was not even full or probably strategically provide full attention to "identified big guests only", we felt neglected: For our dessert, we had to asked 3 different waiters before the final waiter served as the first two waiters just either ignored or disarray. Same went to bill payment, we had to wait and called 2 different waiters before the final really came with the bill to us. This was not acceptable as they are many waiters available and the restaurant was not even full.

Author: ema5344
Title: Best irish bar
Review: Very fresh beer, good food, nice music.. I always come here to enjoy my drink and music.. I will come back.. Highly recommend milon and good manager gurumeet sight

Author: Qing QSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must try herbal chicken
Review: Despite the crazy parking. Despite the dirty like dump toilet. Despite the limited sitting. Despite the small table. You must try the herbal chicken, cook to perfection in the herbs, its nutrition value is high and delicious at the same time!The rest of the dishes is normal and cheap. Low price and huge quantity for the budget traveller.

Author: tina0073
Title: relaxing
Review: nice place,feeling relaxed and excited❤ serious is awesome .0and music is nice make me cannot stop dancing😂

Author: Darren L
Title: Unbeatable taste! Must eat for Ramen lover!
Review: One of the world's best ramen has been landed here! Try their Akamaru Shinaji ramen or karaka-me ramen which is suitable for spicy food lover. Do try out the side dishes here as well.

Author: KiznicolenigelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worst Nyona Food!!! Biggest disappointment!
Review: It was highly recommended by our friend who visited last when it the chef was an elderly lady and the server was an elderly man. This trip was run by 2 fairly muscular men who obviously was really uptight and just not pleasant and somewhat obnoxious. Every single dish was just way below par that it was a waste of calories to eat there. We ordered quite a number of dishes for our big group of 10 pax. The chicken Ponteh was the only decent dish that could be repeated. Every other dish from Assam Fish to soups were ..If I may blatantly comment- awful. But the worst of it was the chendol- no crushed ice and very weak coconut with only the green jelly strips. It made us really so disgusted at how anyone can serve chendol of this standard and in Melaka. Our last trip there...Most certainly!

Author: Varin B
Title: Surprise Party for Hubby's Big 40
Review:
Had a g8 time. Planned a surpise and worked out well. Food as usual as g8....Staff friendly and chef shamini, Raman and Rakitt was awesome.
Sure to be back for more great times...

Author: d-eilatan
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ordered the Asam Laksa and Char Kway Teow. Food was delicious, service was quick and staff were very friendly! Food was reasonably priced. Would recommend to anyone looking to try some authentic Malaysian food.

Author: K1232WPchriss
Title: Outstanding hospitality
Review: Great service, great food and a great setting (if a little difficult to find). A very friendly and warm welcome followed by some exquisite traditional Malaysian food. Worth a visit!

Author: masp488Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Stay away from that place. You will find many much better places around. Had a 4 cheese pizza there, which was mostly one kind of a cheap tasting cheese like product. Only a few small pieces of gorgonzola. No other cheese notes detected at all. My friend had salmon ravioli. For 32 rm you get a lot of sauce and 5 small ravioli. This is not how Italian food is done.

Author: VevienongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible food
Review: Came here for dinner and our char siew rice and Chee Cheong fun was served cold. Yang chow fried rice was hard. Silver fish was hard, pathetically little and cold. Wanton mee came with no char siew as shown in photos. Porridge was bland. BEYOND DISSAPPOINTING. Not sure if it's because we came when it was closing but it's not an excuse.

Author: Juliet CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Kids not allowed
Review: Guess this is not a kid friendly restaurant. We had wanted to try the Kebaya restaurant, and were looking forward to it. We tried to change our dinner booking to 8pm but were told that we can't bring in kids after 8pm because they will be disruptive to guests. We won't be visiting this place and won't recommend it to families or even to stay just in case they disrupt their guests or break any precious things in there.

Author: minna_s_12Kuala Lumpur
Title: Good selection, nice ambience
Review: The selection is quite good, enjoyed especially Sichuan dumplings, yummy . A bit pricey, in 5 we paid RM50 x pax but I have to say we ate to our hears content. I like the ambience there as it is very peaceful even it is in a mall, but location is next to side entrance and facing a less travelled road. Only negative point is it only opens at 11am. We were there on Sunday morning and would have liked to go earlier. It was not full and not noisy, so it was easy to talk. The space is big, so lots of choice for seats.

Author: Pektho L
Title: Indulgence
Review: The food quality and taste has really dropped. Won't visit again. We came here for dessert. Had the grilled mango with ice cream; mango was hard and raw and hardly grilled! Coffee was ok.

Author: L2675WTnicolebHouston, Texas
Title: Total 5 Star
Review: We are expats that were in KL for a short trip. Our sushi standards are pretty high, and some of us had visited the likes of Nobu in NYC, LA, and Dallas. Nobu in KL did not disappoint! The fish was super fresh with a flair, the staff was eager to please and the prices more than fair. The menu was eclectic and full of fabulous combinations, just as Nobu is famous for. Anyone who says this place is "pricey" just doesn't know good quality sushi when they see it. We found our experience here delightful and will make dining at Nobu a regular event each and every time we are in KL.

Author: kuaychapSingapore, Singapore
Title: Local recommendation
Review: Amy's was recommended to us about 2 years ago, and we make it a point to return each time we are back in Malacca. Booking is essential at weekends, and advised at other times. The restaurant is usually full and the acoustics make it a very noisy place. Those looking for a fiery curry experience should go elsewhere. If you are looking for peranakan food in a restaurant as close as possible to homestyle then this is the place to find it. The only minuses are no pork, and no shaved ice for the chendol.

Author: hoaruSouillac
Title: There are better places out there
Review: We went there based on reviews on TRip advisor.Unfortunately the food tasted very commercial and we ate better at some cheaper restaurant in town,And the food is not set, so you basically select which item you want in your plate. As a tourist dealing with someone who coudnt speak much english, it was much of a pain as well to select the dish.

Author: winniejane80Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Absolute Worth It!
Review: I had mine at Absolute Thai @ The Gardens (not sure why they do not have an account here, or maybe I couldn't find it). Of all the Absolute Thai I went to, the quality of the food at The Gardens are better and the ambience is really nice. You can check out their website and they will "bring" you around.Food was good, service was really really fast. Do start with their Starter, I recommend, Mieng Kam - Traditional Thai appertizer of betel leaves with 7 heavenly condiments. It's either you like it or not, you have to take a mouthful of it, at least once. The leaves are seasonal, so sometime they may not have it.For those who are craving for real Thai food, do not hesitate to come over to this one.

Author: lou3Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Very disappointing...
Review: We visited from the neighbouring Andaman Hotel. We'd heard good things about the restaurant and were expecting the meal to be a highlight of the trip. However, we left strongly disappointed.This primarily stemmed from our table location, coupled with a severe problem that the restaurant has with its floor. We'd were seated in the middle of the floor, so the jungle setting wasn't visible to us - we'd had far more atmospheric views from tables at our hotel. We asked whether we could move to a table looking out to the jungle, but were told by the manager that all were booked. This was despite us booking our table two days before, and asking for a good table. To add insult, the next family that arrived, who were sat at a similar table in the centre, asked a different waiter and were moved to a nicely located table.This alone would not have been a huge issue. What did become an issue was the terrible vibration on the floor as waiters passed. Our table, in front of the fish and cooking counter, was passed by every waiter visiting tables and the suspended floor bounced harshly as they walked by. It might seem like a trivial thing but we just didn't relax for the whole meal.The Gulai was by far the highest meal charge of our trip and yet we felt that that the atmosphere was close to the worst. A long way from the intimate 'back to nature' experience that we'd expected.In terms of the food itself, it was ok. We all enjoyed our dishes but they were disproportionately expensive for the quality provided.We also saw another couple walk out after some form of complaint, half way through our meal, but didn't notice why....So, sorry Gulai, not a good experience.

Author: ElizabethKualaLumpur
Title: Keep moving
Review: Food was not good and I will not be back.  Lots of other choices elsewhere!

Author: pauldM4517UVBackworth, United Kingdom
Title: Best bar in Langkawi
Review: A hidden gem of a bar. Access via Main Street through a restaurant not linked to bar or go via beach. Customer service is brilliant with prices really competitive 10rm for a bottle of Chang £2 in an ice bucket. Food is good to but views and ambience is what this place is all about. Check out their fb page. Highly recommended

Author: armenian2013
Title: Noisy and messy place............
Review: We went there for lunch and had to wait for long time to be seated. The place was noisy and messy. Food was average. Overall, the experience was comparable to having food at hawker center.

Author: teearr53Toronto, Canada
Title: Sunday Roast at The Library at Ritz Carlton Kuala Lumpur
Review: Sunday Roast at the Ritz Carlton in Kuala Lumpur has been a cherished experience for us over the years. In keeping with outstanding experiences in the past, we chose it for the Easter Sunday lunch in April earlier this year and found it to be exemplary as usual in The Cobalt Room location. The Sunday Roast was, therefore, an automatic choice to celebrate out 36th wedding anniversary and we were looking forward to the pleasure from the event as usual. This time around the location was The Library (our first chance to attend in this room). The food and service was outstanding as usual but what marred the experience for us was the bizarre arrangement in that guests staying at the hotel walk through The Library to get to the elevators to their rooms. There was a steady stream of hotel guests walking through the middle of The Library with their luggage, strollers, etc throughout the dining experience but things got totally unacceptable close to the check in time for the hotel when large groups of hotel guests started to navigate through The Library with the bellboys carrying their luggage in tow.In my so many years of fine dining experience around the world, I cannot recall anywhere where the only access for hotel guests was routed through the middle of a fine dining restaurant affecting the privacy of the diners. Not sure what the RC KL management had in mind while setting up the arrangement for hotel guests in their state of informality to travel through highly formal fine dining mood in The Library. Under present circumstances, I will limit my participation in the Sunday Roast at RC Kuala Lumpur to the annual Sunday Easter lunch in the hope that the event will get held at The Cobalt Room location.

Author: Mohammmed AJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Difinitely needs a new chef
Review: I send back my lamp mechwi plate, really bad taste and smell,the Shish taouk was dry and hard, they offered me a replacement dish but that taste of the meat turned off my appetite.I am very disappointed to see all the Misleading 5 star rating.Enviroment and Staff were Ok, but they need to invest in a professional Chef.

Author: 423tamarasBerry Springs, Australia
Title: Yummy drinks and food, good haven from the rain
Review: Dropped in here to hide from the rain. Had already had some small dinner so had a salad and small German plate to supplement which was just perfect and fresh. Had a few cocktails and beers and then had a great discussion with the lady owner who was really informative and helped us out Si Ce we had only just arrived on our first trip. Really friendly eclectic atmosphere, enjoyed very much.

Author: TapaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful experience
Review: I went to Tamarind Springs with my fiancé for dinner, he surprised me after work for dinner there. It was both our first times there, and I must say the experience was amazing. I love being around nature and also around exquisite decorative taste in the interior of Mandi Mandi restaurant. We both are from architecture background therefore we appreciate the tropical fusion theme of the restaurant. The restaurant blew me away, and the food was very good too which made it even better experience. The service by our waiter Azam was efficient and helpful for us first timers, even made an initiative to chat with us about the surroundings and the restaurant background. We both appreciate his recommendation for the Red Mix Seafood Tom Yum that was excellent ! We were only served by azam, but i would like to think the staffs there are all very nice, always smiling and greeting you. Even the manager Shyda came to personally thank us for coming for dinner, such a friendly lady. We will definitely come back for the Tom Yum , and to meet our new friend Shyda. Thank you for making our first time experience in Mandi Mandi restaurant, one that we will always remember.I highly recommend to anyone who enjoys a good meal, beautiful atmosphere of nature, serenity and a quiet dinner with your loved ones to give Mandi Mandi at Tamarind Springs a try.

Author: Australian2000Sydney, Australia
Title: Over-rated
Review: Lots of choices but not necessary the best food around town. We walk around for a while and finally decided to stop into one of the many restaurants. The photos shown in the menu looks much better than the actual dish that’s delivered.We ordered the Bak Kut Teh and the rice porridge. The porridge was good, however the Bak Kut Teh was a real disappointment. Eventually we paid and left and walked to Lot 10band found the same food much better and 40% cheaper. Mind you Lot 10 is not the real street food but it’s a good facsimile of the actual street food around KL.In summary, Jalan Alor is meant for tourists and not where the locals go.

Author: Climber83265
Title: Very value for money lunch.
Review: Very value for money lunch. Quite delicious food comprising of signature dish 1. Water cress vegetables fried with meat 2. Signature steam egg 3 sweet and sour pork. Can come if you are with big family. Sumptuous and value for money. Can drink Chinese tea to wash down the oil.

Author: workinglifeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service bad attitude
Review: Your cashier attitude is very very bad!!!I pay her RM62 and i wait her refund me 70 cents more than 10 minutes...I stand out to the corridor I look at her(your staff know I looking at her,but she no take action),I want to see will she return the 70 cents to me anot...however, she didn't then I walk to the cashier that time she only return me, show me a rudely face and put hardly the change on your cashier table...maybe for you...70 cents is just a number...but for me as ur customer...I have pay 10% service charge and 6% gst...but ur staff show me tat kind of face...Actually I have the rights to deduct ur 10% service charge!

Author: IOMSiang
Title: well , they bring all the street food in shopping mall
Review: more like a fast food stall, can go for a brunch if u r really hungry, if i wan to try authentic Malay food i would go to a Malay restaurant

Author: SamYin
Title: Good oysters
Review: Love the Gallagher Special oysters. Very big and fresh. Good to eat on its own even without lemon or tabasco sauce.

Author: Joan_Shori
Title: French Crepes
Review: Excellent service and good crepes. Owned by a delightful French couple who wanted to introduce something French for the island. Bear in mind that the crepes are soft and not crispy .. the French style.

Author: hnyew
Title: Not recommended
Review: Noisy place with senior waitress shouting orders instead of walking to customers table. Same practice at the reception when you mention your reservation. They know that the open kitchen is noisy but don't want to budge expect customers to shout like night market. Awards? Naah

Author: 22charlyfHong Kong, China
Title: AMAZING
Review: What a great experience ! The service was immaculate, very friendly. Unfortunately I didn’t get the chance to get the names of the waiters but the whole team has been doing an outstanding job. They even went to get me cigarettes as they don’t sell any. I went for the beef Redang, that was absolutely amazing ! So colourful with the right amount of spice. Then, as a pandan leaf lover, I tried a new experiment from the kitchen and they served me a beautiful cake looking like a cheesecake (rice instead of cheese) ! I loved it !! The place is very well located and perfect for a romantic dinner with candle by the river. Sadly, I was alone that night lol Prices are also very descent.

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Much improved experience after previous disappointment approx 5 years before
Review: I decided to give the Hard Rock Café a second chance after being seriously disappointed approximately 5 years before. On the previous occasion, soon after the establishment had opened, I said never again due to the non existent service, the inability to serve the food in one go (there were four of us), to get the orders correct and high prices charged. I felt so disappointed I actually called over the manager, and complained bitterly (she did agree that the service was unacceptable and recompensed us appropriately).But enough of the negative. I made a spur of the moment decision to revisit, for drinks only, and was very glad I did. Service was impeccable and friendly, the music and ambience was fantastic (it was a Sunday night) and the outdoor sitting area had been converted into a smoking allowed area (it wasn't before). The location of this balcony area next to the Melaka River was wonderful, especially at night with all the lights.As mentioned I only had drinks, no food, but thoroughly enjoyed myself. Will visit again, and will recommend to others.Now if you could only lower the prices a bit !!!

Author: LLL1973
Title: The food is nice but I saw a cockroach at the wall!
Review: I was twice at Ming Cafe (it is only two blocks from the Imperial Hotel, Miri), the food is very good but during my visit I saw a little cockroach at the wall!

Author: Actuarial_MathSingapore
Title: Did Not Even Taste Like Nyonya Food. Low Quality, Poor Taste, Expensive, Overhyped.
Review: We read good reviews of this restaurant and decided to try it. When we arrived for lunch, there was an empty table just nice for us. After a while, the queue was 1 hour long.We ordered asam prawns, fried chicken, otah, fish maw soup, and a plate of prawn cracker appetiser. For all the dishes, there was no Nyonya taste of cooking at all; they were at best Chinese cooking and at worst disguised Nyonya cooking. The quality of food is not refined and they were not tasty at all. We have eaten better quality and tastier street food and mall food in Melaka. The highly praised prawn crackers were very starchy; no prawn taste at all. The prices were steep. This is the 2nd worst Nyonya restaurant we have ever eaten at in Melaka over our 10+ years of travelling there. Definitely overhyped on the Internet. Do avoid this restaurant and try some other Nyonya restaurants for more authentic and better quality Nyonya food.

Author: Janice K
Title: Delicious
Review:
We are first  time come to here, the  food and view are delicious n nice. 
Imperial canton broth is delicious. #^_^#

Author: JT34998
Title: Food Poisoning
Review: The title says it all.  Food poisoning from a dodgy mussel.  Steer clear.

Author: Navtej88Singapore, Singapore
Title: An Uplifting Experience
Review: The first thing that strikes you, as you step into this restaurant, is the bustling atmosphere. It was packed at dinner time and everyone was engaged in animated banter. The crowd was young and lively. It lifted the spirits! The second thing is the multi-racial crowd - in fact I saw more non Indians than Indians that night, which says a lot about its appeal to a broad cross-section of Malaysians and expats. And third was the reception we received from Chef-owner Yogesh personally as we walked into the restaurant. With a broad smile and warm handshake he greeted us as if we were old friends. He in fact did the same for all guests and I noticed he was walking the floor the whole night, talking to guests and getting feedback on the food. With such active engagement it’s not surprising the experience is bound to make a lasting impression on anyone who visits this restaurant. We ordered starters, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian, which were all very good. What struck me most was the way they were served, neatly carved bite-sized pieces on wooden trays, reminiscent of Spanish Tapas. The main course consisted of dhal, brinjals, ladies fingers and the piece-de-resistance, the lamb briyani. The briyani, prepared in the “dum” style of cooking which originated from Hyderabad, is traditionally cooked in sealed earthen pots to retain its juices and flavour. Hyderabad briyani is renowned in India. So it was not surprising when I later learnt that the briyani at this restaurant is highly popular and could arguably be the best in KL. We rounded up the meal with “kulfi” (Indian style ice cream) which was not sweet enough and didn’t quite make an impression on us. Also the portion, served in a large metal container, was rather large for one person after a big meal. Overall it was a memorable experience. Kudos to Chef Yogesh for giving a refreshing twist to North Indian cuisine. I see good potential for this concept to spread its wings beyond its base in the upscale neighbourhood of Damansara Heights.I would highly recommend a branch in KLCC or Pavillion mall which deserve to have an innovative North Indian restaurant like this, appealing to a wider audience. What is currently available in and around KLCC is the usual tried and tested fare. Nothing else in KL comes anywhere close to the experience of Flour!

Author: 200annette56Sydney, Australia
Title: Yummy Food
Review: For a quick bite or a filling breakfast, the place to go. Of an evening Thursday to Saturday definitely indulge in the Seafood Buffet.

Author: Climber147786Linz, Austria
Title: Nice French Place at Langkawi
Review: We went to the restaurant for crepes and waffles, which all were very delicious. The french owners of the place are very friendly - would definitely visit again!

Author: queen_touristKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Christmas Eve Service
Review: VERY POORLY TRAINED STAFF - We waited 40 MINUTES for dessert. We followed up at least 4 times and were advised that it was on the way. We eventually asked to cancel but the female Indian server insisted we wait another 10 minutes because the dishes were already being made. Emphasis on INSISTED as she was very RUDE and expected us to follow her even though we were already unhappy with the late service. When I asked to cancel, she then said to wait another 5 minutes to see if it was possible. UNBELIEVABLE! I don't believe there was even a manager on site on Christmas Eve to settle such matters. Absolutely terrible.Pros:1. Good ambiance2. Some good pasta dishesCons:1. Digital menu is not easy to navigate2. Portions are quite small for the price you are paying for; if the goal is for fine dining, it still isn't justified3. When we asked for water for a table of 4, they only served 24. Quite rude waiting service, always on the bar area and not proactively checking on tables

Author: shemin61Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unique food & drinks! Nice décor!
Review: Nice artsy café that serves unique burgers and drinks. We had pineapple beer! The burgers were yummy and juicy. It’s a cozy artsy and vintage café décor with loads of plants. Price wise, its mid-range, not too expensive.Strict house rules of no photography. Note that you are not allowed to take photos of the interior and of people. I had asked if we could take photos of the food (it was allowed). But no photos allowed of my partner and I with the food. I’m still wondering why there was such a rule, I guess they don’t want tourist to come into the place to just take photos and not order any thing? Not sure why.

Author: honeys49
Title: It caters for white trash infidels -Its just like home
Review: Staff is good atmosphere is great but you may have to ask rev up the music. Prices are reasonable and food is great. I come Kl every month on business - doctor- and visit every trip ,They have another one but its not the same yet. This place is customer friendly for a change- KL has changed over the years this place hasnt. Go there for good food anytime and enjoy the day or night. plenty taxis to get you to hotel and safe walking at night
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Turn176
Title: Fast efficient service, but
Review: The host, Andrew is entertaining but the ambiance and standard of cuisine doesn't make it a place for a second visit.

Author: TeppanloverKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Teppanyaki Lover
Review: I am a teppanyaki lover. My favorite teppanyaki place was at Iketeru Hilton KL because of the quality of the food and a team of great chef's cooking. But sadly this team of chef has left Iketeru. Since then my family and I felt very dissatisfied over the new chef's cooking although they still maintain the quality of the food. Our visits there became lesser and lesser. I tried to locate the whereabout of this team of previous chef. Luckily a friend of mine found them and the chef are currently at Fong Lye Fusion The Garden Midvalley. It is a very famous Taiwanese restaurant with few outlets in KL. My family and I are so delighted and we decided to go for a try. We were so happy that the head chef, Ben is now handling the teppanyaki section in the restaurant. He is our favorite chef. The taste of the food is so great and the price is far more affordable compare to Iketeru. All the chefs are friendly and the quality of the food is very good. We now dine here every week and also on all occasions and celebrations. There are few course sets to choose from and each set is for 1-2 persons. It includes an appetizer, soup, main course (beef/chicken/pork/seafood), garlic fried rice and dessert. The soup, appetizer and dessert will be changed every two weeks to ensure that guest could try new dishes every time they visit. The price range for the set course is RM108-198 depending on which main course you pick. There are variety of ala carte dishes like chicken, pork, beef, and seafood, noodles, fried rice and vegetables. It's a must try teppanyaki. I can say it's the best one with good price as I'm a teppanyaki lover and I hunt and try every teppanyaki restaurant in Malaysia and overseas. The best thing is you won't smell smokey after the meal as they have very good oil and smoke absorber fan.

Author: and12345audyt
Title: Good Taste!!!
Review: If you visit Melaka, put this place on your list because the foods are so good.Beside bakut teh, they serve vegies, cakwe, and pork leg black soup.This place is suitable for family and friends because you guys can share your foods.Service is not so good because of the restaurant is crowd when lunch time.

Author: 683philipt
Title: Great location
Review: We were advised to go here by our driver and although the service was a bit offhand , we enjoyed a beer and some pizza, while watching the people walking up and down Jonker Street

Author: WynnTLY
Title: Nice Food and Desserts
Review: Pizza burgers and desserts are delicious here! We were hungry thus there's no pictures of the main dishes. Tried the desserts and we ordered another round after tasting how delicous it was. Good place to chill out as well.

Author: MerciAsia
Title: Arnaque
Review:
Bad eating, bad people...baklawa at 30 ringgits on the menu and on the bill: 35 ringgits!... and very difficult to change, i had to be very angry... crazzy!...
Very expensive for KL...and more no flavor, no taste only too much oil...

Author: Yin Ferng H
Title: Nice
Review: Nice environment as well as food and drinks :) Great place to stop by for a break and for place to check in for  instagram lovers.

Author: jennhkpKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chinese New Year gathering
Review: I visited this restaurant on the 24th February 2018 and this is the worst buffet I ever had. I never thought that poor servings in a 4-5 stars hotel.The ambience is good but it doesn't match with the food served. There is not much variety to choose, I think the fewest I ever had in a hotel restaurant. The refill of food is really slow. Crab and sashimi also not fresh. Only tempura vegetable is available until I checked from one of the chef if there's any Tempura prawn or fish available.In the noodles bar, fresh prawn replace by vegetarian prawn. I was shocked too when I saw the white rice tray gone empty. ( What I am trying to say is most of the diners take white rice to fill up, I guessed ).
