Don't you think it is such embarrassing?The hotel's waiter serve wine in this way. ( as in the photo ). I really hope the management will look into this matter seriously. Really a disappointing dinner.

Author: TravellingTony_12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used to be good but now....
Review: I have been to this place twice to entertain my guests. So we decided to go there and this was my third time. I have always love their curry and fish. However this time, I was so disappointed with the food it is really sad. We ordered a curry, vegetable dish, lamb, fish and beef.CurryI have always love their curry. It taste amazing. However this time, it is dry and tasteless and even the meat is dried out. Truly shocking and disappointing.FishThe fish is deep fried with green apples. Once again the food is dried and tasted so weird. Previously, their fish was fresh and just right.VegetableTold the waitress I wanted a stir fried mixed vegetable dish. We had yet another deep fried aubergine, deep fried ferns and a potato of some sort coupled with freshly sliced cucumber (5 slices). The whole dish looks cheap, tasteless,dried (again!), boring and I feel cheated to pay so much money for over fried stuff.

Author: adeline8899
Title: Nice food and environment
Review: The burgers and salads were awesome! Nice place to cheer with friends! Strictly no photo except on food and drinks~ Always full house and kitchen close at 5pm.😊

Author: EdwardN709Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My first and last visit
Review: Went here with friend to have dinner since it has a very good review from many food bloggers. Order their signature dish as many recommended steam rice, fry cabbage, chicken chop, mun yee pie quat(too salty). To me the taste just so so only, I don't why it was rated so high how tasty the food from bloggers! The only thing I like about this restaurant is they give you big portion of dishes and their reasonable pricing.

Author: KittyTrigger77London, United Kingdom
Title: Good lounge
Review: Marini’s on 57 has a great view and 2 sections - a louder club and a more relaxed lounge. We used the lounge and were not disappointed. Good wine selection and good music too. The staff were very polite and friendly without getting in the way.

Author: questar11
Title: Supper club dining
Review:
Taste: 4/5
Portion: 5/5
Ambience: 4/5
Service: 4/5
Price: 3/5
Good food, nice cosy setting in a house restyled into a restaurant.

Author: mjq0175Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Creative menu & excellent quality
Review: Plates are meant for sharing, which adds fun and variety to the meal. Food was excellent and service was friendly and attentive.

Author: M30_MOLLYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: TOTALLY DISGUSTING! PLEASE AVOID!
Review: I've dined here several times before my last visit and the food was good the first few times and not so good after that. During my last visit though i noticed that the chef whom i could see through the kitchen window preparing food, did some despicable things!The chef did not have an apron on, no head cap on and no gloves. Actually none of the other chef / cook had on gloves, cap or aprons. Anyway this particular chef that looked like the head chef, I could see him very clearly, he was touching and scratching his hair (hard) every now and then and then garnish the food with his bare hands! Intermittently he touched his crotch and then went back to handling food. He also touched the dirty chef uniform that he was wearing and did the same.I was so appalled and disgusted by this time ready to throw up! I called one of the guys that was not wearing the regular server uniform, just a blue shirt and voiced out my displeasure and informed him in detail what i had witnessed. He went inside and spoke to the chef. Later the chef came out and apologised to me saying 'he didn't know', he's glad that I pointed out his 'mistakes'. Well these are not regular mistakes and he shouldn't even have been hired in the first place since he does not have basic hygiene knowledge.This place is not cheap, mind you. It is a fine dining restaurant. This should not have happened at all! I am sure after this, to cover up they would close the window so that we could not see them preparing the food! Beware people!
Restaurant: Kayra Authentic Kerala Cuisine, Bangsar Village

Author: wanyadiy
Title: Very good services and delicious food
Review: Thank you for the very good services to my whole family and delicious food that they serve. Especially to Chef Izzat and Mohsin. Will come again.The ambiance is very beautiful. Thanks again.

Author: 1mightymouseFootscray, Australia
Title: authentic home cooked dishes
Review: what a joy to discover and explore sarang cookery serving a mix of nonya, mamak, malay dishes spawned by christina, a foodie herself. i have tried a lot of dishes, will continue to do so and to date it has been a taste sensation.i must also check out the cooking classes and learn how to make magic like this!

Author: dkr28
Title: Malay Restuatant
Review: Doesn't appear appetizing. Cleanliness is a question mark . The atmosphere is conclusive for a decent meal.

Author: Baizuin
Title: Bad management
Review: We book a table for 3 persons at 20.00pm upon arriving there the waiter told us that the restaurant was full!!!! Then I ask for what we book??? Bad management ........

Author: Northerntraveller73Kaarina, Finland
Title: Great variety, attentive staff quality just under 5 stars
Review: Had a couple of breakfast here with my family while staying at the hotel and visiting JB.The variety of food was good there was a lot to choose from (Malaysian, Indian, Japanese, ...) and staff at the restaurant was very polite.I felt that the quality wasn't at the top notch but all in all very good place to have breakfast.Remember to arrive in good time if breakfast is ending at 10:30 it means that they are shutting the place down at that time...
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: KH_LyeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Food, Poor Value for Money
Review: Sought this out due to its good review but hugely disappointing. The quality of the food was not per expectations. We asked the staff (looks junior) for recommendations on their signature dishes but he could not offer any definitively ... so we went on our own. Ayam Buah Keras (Candlenut Chicken) - we ordered a small size, the gravy was good but regrettably the chicken pieces were very small and lots of bones and bits, with a couple of wings, no excuse for giving so little for a small size! Sek Bak (Braised Pork) - quite nice but a tad too much fat. Sambal Udang Petai (Prawn) - this was very disappointing, prawns were not fresh, was frozen and treated - you can taste it! It's no different from what you get in kopi tiam. And the petai - all cut into halves and so very few! Nyonya Chp Chai (mixed vegetables) - what mix?? 90% cabbage only! And tasted very ordinary. Well at least the Kedondong drink was a little saving grace. We felt that this restaurant was overhyped and we can certainly find better Nyonya food at better prices elsewhere.

Author: helloothereeAustralia
Title: Bad
Review: 2 things to point out - bad service and food.A group of customers were waiting for their table to be ready, so the kids were waiting around the counter sitting on the chairs. Kids being kids they are usually rather lethargic and fidgety. This lady staff at the counter rather rudely raised her voice "if you're are waiting please wait outside, don't block the way." I figured the customers were rather pissed because they never come back. The staff may be busy and overwhelmed but I don't see why she should be raising her voice. This is the only incident because I see her being rather rude to her fellow staff.My friends and I had diarrhea and vomited after having the chap chye. The chap chye appears to be reheated because it was rather soggy and too sweet. I am not taking away the credentials of the other dishes, but the chap chye was bad. It wasn't just me alone - but my friends and I all got unwell because of it. Never going back again.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: spica_cs
Title: It's an over-rated restaurant from my personal point of view
Review: I went there in Jan'15 for a gathering dinner based on my friend's recommendation. Seriously, this restaurant is really out-of-the-way. I have to admit i am not a foodies or food fashionista but i'm willing to pay more for a good meal for special occasion. I've ordered the Ploy's Black Fried Rice (which they claimed "once you've tried our black, you won't go back!") which never impressed me at all (although the food presentation is good). The rice wasn't hot enough and it tasted wetter after you pour the raw egg yolk into it, a "wet" fried rice is a big "no" to me but i do not mind if its a paella as its not under fried rice category. Just some recommendation, this problem could be fixed if they increase the portion of the fried rice and served immediately (able to retain more heat in an air-cond environment) or they can change the raw egg yolk into soft boiled egg yolk. On top of this, the fried rice was accompanied with some dried green leafs and 4 bland average sized prawns at a price tag of RM 30.50, I'm speechless at this point.

Author: Sightseer814503
Title: Taste good although crowded
Review: Overall, Food taste good but very crowded during weekends n public holidays. Recommended to try Sang Har Hor Fun & fried mee indo

Author: Hippie P
Title: Extremely poor service
Review: I just had a late lunch at Ben's KLCC. First impression of the wait staff was poor. He crooked his finger to indicate follow him and placed in a crowded area eventhough the place is half empty. Once seated I have to wait 15 minutes before the waiter took my order. Oh, and he took another table's order first eventhough I was seated 5 minutes earlier. The food was okay, I had the macaroni and cheese. When came time for the bill, I have to wait 10 more minutes before someone came and collect the money. Definately would not recommend the place.

Author: Mark JFalmouth, United Kingdom
Title: In transition - awful
Review: Visited Sid’s on a what should have been a busy Friday night but bar was fairly quiet. Seems to be changing management or ownership to the GravyBaby chain of restaurants...? But transition isn’t going well - service was poor, several things on the menu were unavailable, food was very slow arriving, two dishes were not as ordered and two never arrived. We even saw them bringing in our cooked rice from another restaurant nearby! As my wife still hadn’t received her meal by the time everyone else had finished, we decided enough was enough and left. Staff were very apologetic but there were enough of them working to ensure even a minimal level of customer service should have been possible. A regular patron told we should have just had a drink and not ordered food as the place had gone downhill recently. Shame, because the location is good and Sid’s used to be a reliable place for food, drink and a nice riverside atmosphere. Hope they sort things out quickly!

Author: THEVOICE15Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Burger is really Legendary!
Review: One of the best burgers I have ever had - Legendary Burger 10oz. Juicy; tasty and filling! Love the fried onion ring and crispy bacon on the burger. Great service; excellent food and the music! And, the location is excellent - just right outside Jonker Street. Hence, a good place to chill after the shopping!

Author: Isabelle T
Title: Pork restaurant
Review: Great restaurant with service minded staff. If you love pork, this is the perfect restaurant. Otherwise you should find somewhere else to eat. It looks quite nasty when people order a whole piglet and get to beat it with a plate (while it's dead of course) before you eat it, it seems to be some kind of tradition. But apart from that we really enjoyed our food which was very good. The location, on a street with lots of restaurants and bars, is very good.

Author: Thijs d
Title: Bad kitchen
Review: Went here during our stay in the hotel. Half of our table had a starter served. Then 10 minutes they served mozzarella sticks which were still frozen inside. Those were sent back and they came back with the same ones, warmed up in the microwave. The pizza was like a piece of cardboard. Super dry. And served 1 munite after we finished with our starter. So half of the table was done by the time we got our main course. Bad experience, I would not visit again.

Author: carlc764Chinley, United Kingdom
Title: The best food on batu ferrengi
Review: After seeing all of the great reviews, we decided to try it as our hotel is only 500m away.All i need to say is that all of the possitve reviews are spot on, even though they were very busy the sevice and food is first class.The chicken kapitan was amazing and the sweet and sour chicken was possibly the best i have had, also try the pineapple fried rice.We will deffinateley go back here again.

Author: Notcolin21Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ridiculously slow service
Review: Ridiculously slow service for staple dishes that could have been prepared beforehand. Food is decent but experience is marred by inefficient service. Will not return. Ever.

Author: Amacious
Title: One of the best Risotto in town.
Review: Friendly service team! Creative cocktails choice, and I just love their Saffron Seafood Risotto! The risotto is well cooked, not too dry and well seasoned.

Author: chloecG4348TUKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and food is bad
Review: We had show our apps twice, before we enter the restaurant and before we order food, the staff told us it can be use on selected item so we choose from it. Foods turn out very bad, fish is not fresh and duck is over cooked! When we made payment the cashier said apps not available for today and she just push away the problem.

Author: Angie L
Title: Horrendous and Incompetent Service Crew
Review:
Ordered Rojak and 2 Drinks for lunch. Waited for more than 50 mins. Called the waiters which was standing 5 steps from our table but unresponsive, to find out that our order was not computed and hence they did not prepare our order.

OMG!!

Author: Fanazmi
Title: Above average Asam Pedas.
Review: Very busy place in the evenings, so do expect to wait. Had 2 servings of Asam Pedas (2 different types of fish). The gravy was quite tasty and had all the flavours. Fish was fresh and portion was quite ok for the price.

Author: aldwiny
Title: Great brunch and ambience
Review: Had a great brunch having always seen the place. Lovely serene decor with comfortable homely seatings. Had no qualms about the food. Just wish that this beautiful place was open for dinner.

Author: blessedwoman08Singapore, Singapore
Title: Totally not worth the hype
Review: Heard so much about this restaurant and saw the video on social media, finally had a chance to come and try. The place is disorganised and understaffed. You gotta wait for an empty table if you are there at the usual meal times and catch the staff to order your food. I ordered the large lobster nasi lemak set with the intention to share with my hubby. Food took a very long time to come, waited an hour for it. When my set arrived, I was shocked by the size of the large lobster, it looked like a baby lobster which I can finished in 4 mouths. It is definitely too small to be shared. I finished the lobster with lots of rice left, it is not enough to go the rice. That's how pathetic it is. If you have not been here, don't bother, you won't miss out anything. It's totally not worth the time and money.

Author: monk3yseendoMalaysia
Title: Nice Ambiance
Review: A very instagrammable hotel on its own tucked away in the heart of the city. That said, it’s literally perpetually fully booked so it’s not for the spontaneous foodies. Bookings need to be made well in advance. High Tea on Weekends (RM 120 per pax)The food is nothing extra ordinary but substantial. However, if it is the ambiance you are after, this is the place for you. Limited amount of seating hence gives you tons of privacy to satisfy your trigger happy camera fingers. Orchids add a nice splash of colour to the overall look and feel of the experience. It would probably be the place to celebrate a nice occasion or bring a date to. Our full review is on Instagram (@monk3yseendo)

Author: alexchandran84Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food was a let down.
Review: Decided to visit cos of all the great reviews with my partner (who is from jordan) . It's in a 5 star hotel jwmarriot. The food was bland and almost tasteless. The soup was unseasoned. The lamb kebabs were good and so we're the drinks that's about it. compared to a few other places that serve the same food. Salad tasted like it was missing a few ingredients. My drink the lemonada was very good. Prices are very reasonable which makes me wonder how they manage rent in such a nice location and manage to serve such food.

Author: Poh Ming N
Title: Overrated and Seems Stupid to Q
Review:
It's always long Q and it seems stupid to Q for food especially in Malaysia.

There's another restaurant in Taman Daya new shop.  There's better curry fish head at Ulu Tiram.

Author: vivianhammySingapore
Title: One of a kind experience!
Review: I coped surprisingly well dining in the dark, only spilling the first piece of food and caught it midway. The first minute of entering the dining area was frightening but the smell of food from other tables calmed me down a little. The waiter was very friendly and I was coping fine very soon. i ate with a spoon and my other hand. Eating with at least one hand really helps as it could be a messier experience otherwise. Of all the food items, i thoroughly enjoyed my main course and I remember the tastes more vividly than usual. I like it!!

Author: Dhia Aurora Ais... A
Title: Good food but rude staff
Review: I was there with my friend . I called their waiter . And he came and asked us 'ye apedahal tu' . I think its very rude . For all . I loved the food . Thats all

Author: Ly_Yu906
Title: Very bad food quality
Review: Visit this sushi shop first time and this was the last time ever!!! The service is slow and the food quality and quantity are terrible, taste not nice at all. Worst sushi shop ever in Malaysia

Author: puimanchan
Title: Poor arrangement of the seats.
Review: Poor arrangement of the seats.Upstairs they got a much better view of the twins tower. However, it’s only open during weekends, which is a waste of the place during weekdays. Downstairs there’re plants blocking the view. There are bugs and bite the guests! Very itchy!

Author: dm6808
Title: Dinner with Big Group
Review: We were a big group of about 200 persons and the efficiency with which this restaurant handled us is commendable.  Breathtaking view of the KL city at night from 57th floor with superb food and variety of drinks

Author: Chippering
Title: Very Disappointed
Review: Surprised and disappointed by our meal there, given other glowing reports. Waitress uninterested and surly. Duck: bits of scraggy bone with hardly any meat in a glutinous sauce; chicken OK but not special.

Author: DingCKKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quality drop by still super crowded
Review: Went early at 8.30 am but still super crowded. Have to stand at tables to get a table. Quality dropped compared to last time (2 years back) but still so crowded. Will not be coming back here again. Will try other new outlets because still same lousy service. One: they will not bother to look tables for u...u have to wait at tables at stare at the people sitting there. Order some dim sum but they never bother to send to u.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: ptsha7Singapore, Singapore
Title: We made the right choice!
Review: My Friend and I decided to try out GRAZE @ HILTON SENTRAL KL. We definitely made the right choice.Ordered the escargots to start and shared the spring chicken and seafood stew kinda dish. Very tasty and flavourful We had the Chianti. Overall it was a very nice dinner experience. Definitely a place to bring your date!

Author: nikmat07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointingly average ...after all the hype
Review: #1 in Langkawi?? Seriously? It's a fast food crepe n pancake joint that's usually closed. Several fillings are straight out of the Nutella jar or toblerone packet. Every suburban mall has a pretend-creperie place like this tucked away at the back of the food court. It's just NORMAL everyone... You will be disappointed if you are expecting something exceptional

Author: 125marklGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing from start to finish
Review: Went for Sunday brunch but what showed promise was a dig disappointment. We were sat on the terrace outside, which was completely separate from the buffet. The people at the next table took one look and left - wish we had done the same. It felt like we were on a different planet. No music, no service - I cleared our table and poured wine as there were no staff. There was a musician wandering in the restaurant, but he never came outside. The food was nice, but most of the hot food was cold. Manager was understanding and gave a discount but would have preferred good service. To round things off, when we came to leave a taxi was blocking the drive and staff did nothing. Sat there for 5 mins while honking horn but they didn’t care. It summed up the experience perfectly. I am sure if you get a nice table inside, but beware if you book on the terrace.

Author: luludinson
Title: Terrible Food
Review:
Not recommended for pavlova lover ...cakes are too sweet + yucks!
Slow and bad service from the restaurant...the waiters keep chit-chatting

Author: natshane_12Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: I became Fat Girl Instead
Review: Love the idea, perfect decor and environment but the portion was too big for me. I do love the combination that they assembled for the burger, I ordered a stuffed pork bacon burger and it was tasty! I'm going to try building my own burger next.

Author: tham2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average food, service can be better
Review: The restaurant was quite crowded when we visited. Although there were many waiters/waitresses around, service was not prompt. The feeling you get is they are not interested in you unless you order their more pricey items on the menu. Food was average, or may be even slightly above average if the service is better.

Author: MARKW8357
Title: Authentic Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Delicious and tasty food with reasonable pricing. Clean and comfortable environment. The asam pork was to die for, in fact all the dishes we ordered were good & delicious. Service was fast & efficient maybe because we went on a weekday and the place was not really packed with customers. Will definitely return. Highly recommended.

Author: docMalacca
Title: Claypot
Review: Everything is cooked and served in claypot , thus piping hot.Interesting and delicious. Liked the fish dish. Cost is average

Author: spytan
Title: Interesting decor, ok food
Review: Service was reasonable and the food ok though we felt it was on the high side for the type of food offered.

Author: raymondy133Bangkok, Thailand
Title: A unique experience
Review: Had our last supper here with the family before leaving Malaysia for home. Must say we were thoroughly entertained, satisfied and happy. Entertained... From the moment we arrived the service was quick and attentive. Best part was the special *Kung Fu* tea waiter that performed an impressive tai chi like performance while pouring tea! Absolutely amazing. The food was really good. That was surprising as we had vegetarian food only. The salted egg pumpkin was beautiful. Satisfied and happy pretty much sums up the meal. Give them a go.

Author: B2006HCmarkwMelbourne, Australia
Title: Major disappointment
Review: We were recommended to come here by the folks at Kebaya (it might be a sister eatery). We ordered Nasi Lamak Bento and struggled to eat it owing to the poor quality of the chicken cooking. Considering how many cheaper hawker options with amazing quality there are in Georgetown, it was kind of heart breaking to pay good money for this. Wine list terrible. Not recommended. Go instead to Kesum instead.

Author: VancouverNomad7777Vancouver, Canada
Title: Not my cup of tea but great location
Review: Good location in the hussle of bussle of Jonker street and makes for and easy choice to sit and have a drink and people watch. Not impressed by the food but good selection of beers albeit pricy. Gave a two as the service was just brutal - super slow on all aspects (cleaning table, taking orders, bringing drinks and etc) and messed up the order and took no accountability for it; did not correct their mistake and even charged us for the item! We also found the waiter/manager quite rude and argumentative.You get the impression that repeat clientele is not the focus here.

Author: syafiqi111
Title: Give it a try!
Review: It was a memorable experience. totally recommend it. Let the conversation flow while enjoying the food.

Author: ChadSeattleSeattle, Washington
Title: watch your ticket
Review: Great location and a busy place on the weekend. Great Happy hour. We had a couple appetizers and a few beers with a friend, but when the bill came, the ticket had an extra zero added to the end. So a $40 US bill would have cost more than $400 US ( RM134 was RM 1,340)! I'm sure it was a mistake on a dark night, but just beware. I'm lucky my friend caught it.

Author: Peggy0411
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Good service from Sahim for the birthday song. Great service and great food with great ambience. Thank you so much. We enjoyed the dinner.

Author: JaisyaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing spectacular.
Review: Had lunch with my partner. The warn bread served was good. Overall experience is average, very typical fine dining, nothing to shout about. We had the 3 course lunch sets which were satisfying but not impressive in my opinion. Good to try to just tell yourself you've dined there as the Restaurant has been voted as the best Steak Place in KL.

Author: Aussieontherun25Kuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner...
Review: Great food and cold drinks. Good happy hour. Friendly service. Nice western food at an okay price and decent portion...

Author: Dahlia D
Title: Masjid India Hawker Court
Review: you can find a bustling covered hawker court serving all the usual Malay, Indian and Chinese favourites. Good to visit if you can’t make it to the Saturday pasar malam. Happy tummy happy me!

Author: ANNIELOUISE01Lightwater, United Kingdom
Title: Losing it
Review: Have been here before when we went just the 2 of us and it was OK. This time we went with a group of 12. They couldn't get orders right, food was very long time coming out, we had to keep asking for our food.Place was very loud with music playing same songs on repeat.Felt very disappointed in the evening.It will be a long time before we think we about returning.

Author: susannn0612
Title: Fantastic dimsum
Review: I come here for breakfast. Like the usual dimsum restaurant, the waitress will go around and offering the dimsum. They have a lot of dimsum type. The visitors are mostly family. Try the noodles (served at small cup) and hakao.

Author: 2186MandyL
Title: Worst fine dining experience
Review: If you‘re not into paying a hefty price for terrible food, avoid this place at all cost ! Even the pasta was overcooked.

Author: nikmatdin
Title: A let-down at last visit
Review: I would rate a 2 for the last visit as the "medium" steak ordered came dry and almost a "well done". And it was small and definitely not a 90 mg. The raviole chicken was bland and the base of Tarte Tatin was doughy and hard (as though it wasn't fully thawed from the freezer) instead of a tart. Disappointed as we were looking forward to a wonderful morning brunch.

Author: Roy C
Title: Quaint
Review: It has a wide range of dishes, food, etc, But may not be a noticeable place as its at the corner of the underpass and highways.  Food wise is ok and the restaurant have their set of patrons.

Author: Michelle P
Title: Not great
Review: Service was pretty bad, food just ok, location good. Wrong drink was served, mains came before starter, didn't have the first starter I wanted - who runs out of tofu? Service overall was a big problem

Author: Queenferra
Title: Perfect celebration
Review: Really enjoy and satisfied with the food.All the staff friendly too.will come here again.thanks husband

Author: BerickusBaar, Switzerland
Title: Food ok, service less
Review: We went here on a recommendation and we should not have done this. It was pretty disappointing.It seemed to be one of the more expensive places in the food street, with which I do not have a problem but then I also expect something more for the money.This unfortunately did not happen. The spare ribs were good, also was the Kaylan but not that much better than other places.The problem we had was that the watermelon juice was not good anymore, you could smell the rotting water melon. After telling the waiter, he tried, made a weird face and walked away. We did not get a new one and they even charged it on the bill.As I said the food was ok but overall it was not worth the money.

Author: idefixx76Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great food, wonderful service
Review: We came without reservation for dinner with our baby and were told that their policy is that families with kids could only eat in a private room (though the restaurant was almost empty). I am not blaming them for the policy more myself for not doing the research :)So we sat in this room that is more for 10+ pax and felt a bit lonely... but the wonderful and attentive staff did a fantastic job at making us feel comfortable.Food is modern and exactly what you expect for the price you pay.

Author: james l
Title: disappointing
Review: though not exactly of the same nature as lizC85 had, nonetheless a negative experience too. The overall leaves much to be desired and after trying others in the vicinity, much better is available.

Author: MikeWells90Brighton and Hove, United Kingdom
Title: Lively friendly atmosphere. Good food and service.
Review: Great atmosphere created by live music from an enthusiasticband playing jazz with a fusion of musical styles. Food isalso fusion with Western, Oriental and local influences.The food is well prepared and presented at reasonableprices.Sample prices large Tiger beer RM 25, cream of seafoodboulabaselle RM12, seafood Cantonese kuch teow RM16.

Author: Arinna
Title: Soggy fish & chips
Review: Finally tried the fish and chips there after great reviews from friends. But the overpriced fish & chip platter that i received was too soggy for my liking. On the upside, the portion was huge if you are hungry and didnt mind the soggy-ness.

Author: NeoFrancois7Phuket, Thailand
Title: Restaurant JPTeres overall service is totally not as par as the brand
Review: Exoerience on 4 Feb 2017 Dinner HRS1)takes a 5 minutes to get a hostess to welcome and usher my group to be seated to be exact: chinese girl wearing jacket or full attire servuce uniform2) all waiters are not attentive and helpful similarly to road side restaurants3) food ordered a siganture dish of chicken rice took more than 50 minutes to prepare4) not worth service charge with total service provided

Author: Alan K
Title: Terrible Service
Review: Staff never around or when around avoiding customers. Too short staff. The location and ambiance is nice, food was good but staff needs desperate training. Typical bad Malaysian service quality... better for a hawker stall level.

Author: Gary Y
Title: Japanese Food
Review: Ishin japanese restaurant has a perfect dining environment especially for families. The food is well served and the waiters has great manners.

Author: norwan aKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Hi Tea from Above
Review: My family and I went for a hi-tea at the Atmosphere 360 revolving restaurant and the experience was simply superb. It is advisable for guests to make prior reservation to ensure that you get a table in the restaurant. So I booked a table next to the window so that we could get unobstructed view of KL at an extra cost of RM25 per table, which is reasonable. Parking was easy to find, although the cost was a bit high at RM19 for roughly about 2 hours 45 minutes. After checking in at the lobby area and got our ticket, we decided to go to the observation deck first to view the beautiful panorama of KL from the tower since the hi-tea will only start at 3.30pm. I must say that the view from the tower was splendid...after spending about 30 minutes there, we took the stairs to the restaurant since it is just one level above the observation deck. At the restaurant, we were welcomed by friendly restaurant staff and were shown to our table right away. The spread of the food was fair, but what is most important is the taste... we particularly love the roti bom and kuah dalca. Even when eating murtabak and popia also we ate them with kuah dalca. So it was a time well-spent for us at the restaurant enjoying both, the food as well as the majestic ambience of revolving KL....rather, it is the restaurant that revolves.

Author: WallyHollandVoorburg, The Netherlands
Title: Fake
Review: I do like my sushi and do like rolls but not with water infused salmon and rolls that have so much mayonnaise on top that you cannot taste the fish anymore; or was that exactly the idea? I left with several pieces on the plate which I normally never do.

Author: MidlandsArttravelShenton Park, Australia
Title: Nice service but very average food
Review: The cafe/ bar is clean and nicely presented. The staff were friendly and attentive. Unfortunately the night we were there her were no pizzas..no dough apparently..go figure...so half the menu was missing..my wife had a pasta with sauce that tasted like it came for a jar and I had a tasteless piece of chicken. Fine I guess if you have to have European food but generally dissapointing

Author: 391vladislavkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, Terrible service!
Review: Terrible service! Waiters always trying to seat you to the worst table even if there are so many available. Always very slow, not friendly at all. Sometimes it feels like they purposely avoid looking at you when you wave them. Asked for just a bit of extra spicy sauce (as I like to combine honey with spicy sauce) was rejected (seriously, it's just a sauce, why do u have to make such a big problem about it?)Writing this review only because I really like the food and want the restaurant to improve. But so far been there like 4 times and don't see any improvements.Hey managers! Please do ur job!

Author: mytravelliciousKuching, Malaysia
Title: Cheap drinks and place for hangout
Review: This is one of the my fav spot for hangout with my friends every night. Cheap drinks. You can choose to sit inside (which have nice decoration and sofa), at the bar or outside (open space, nice wind and looking at car passing by). You can try the food stall menu. The chicken chop is yummy. Try the fried oyster mushroom. Nice.... Recommended if you want to find cheap drinks. Closed early every night.

Author: bSpearUK
Title: Incredible seafood
Review: Directed here by our homestay owner and Lonely Planet, we were really not sure what to expect. I was expecting the more market end of the fish market it had been described to me as, but it turned out to be much more open-air Cafe/restaurant. Prices were reasonable for excellent fish (800g sea-bass was 32RM/£6 and 7 large prawns 18RM) and tasty veg (fried fern, 8RM?). Would highly, highly recommend for easily the best piece of fish I have, and probably will ever have, had in a restaurant. We chose to keep the fish quite plain - opting just for sambal. Still getting used to the shrimp paste (v fishy) sambal, we were a bit taken aback when the fish came out slathered in enough sambal for 4 people to share. Luckily it wasn't cooked in the sambal and it came off easily enough. Maybe ask for sambal on the side, if you're not sure!Lovely atmosphere with a lot of locals (midweek too). Quite an airy location atop the car park (rid yourself of any dingey, grotty car park roofs you might have in mind - this was very clean with a swanky looking cocktail Bar sharing the roof...) but lacking in a great view.Plus side it's very easy to find - you're looking for 'TopSpot' and when they say look for the lobster sign, I think they mean the bright red neon one on top of the building!
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: Baskie
Title: Nice
Review: Nice place to chill. my favourite here is the vegetarian curry mee. Must try. The cappuccino & cafe latte here is heavenly.

Author: chuckie21Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Seafood stations! and great service
Review: The buffet has more options and widespread where I most enjoyed the seafood stations. The sashimis and fresh oysters are my favorite. Also the ambiance is lively, you can see how busy it is and people enjoying dinner. I also commend Melvin, Dinesh and Sathish for their exemplary service. They are very attentive to our needs and efficient. I would like to have this buffet again.

Author: bernhard281Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rat Race
Review: what started with a nice dinner , ended with 2 rats chasing each other over our dining table towards the back of the restaurant, which spoilt everyone's appetite.

Author: Relic86Adelaide, Australia
Title: Mediocre service topped with appalling food
Review: Been here several times previously for drinks but never had the food. My last visit to this restaurant was for the food and it was terribly disappointing. My friend had ordered a tenderloin steak and I had a stew. My friend had requested for a medium rare steak and upon arrival it was very uncooked as it was only seared on the surface. Subsequently we sent the steak back to be cooked further. To our astonishment, we had sent back the steak 2 more times as it was still under cooked. Service staff were oblivious even though the steak was sent back so many times. Neither the Chef or service staff acknowledged our disappointment and would never go back again.

Author: Ngoc2404
Title: Disappointed - bad service.
Review: I went there with my little daughter. I ordered 2 beef dishes and 1 beef soup. After pick up my daughter from her school so we passed by and had our dinner there. We dressed a little mess that time. The boss and staff treated us like begger while they served other like king and queen. Food is accepted. After finished dinner, we headed to our car, then we came back cause my daughter wanted go toilet. When we came back the lady boss looked at us very uncomfortable and not welcome. She made me feel very embarrassed. She spoke something to her husband in Korean. I did not understand but I can feel what she expressed. I will not come back 2nd time. Such a bad experience.

Author: JC_5382Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Seafood
Review: The seafood was really fresh. The sweetness was just there. Will certainly come back again when I stay at this resort. Why I rated a four is because of the pricing. I would rate a 5 if the pricing was better.

Author: SleepsInCatPajamas
Title: Nice food but not worth the price
Review: The restaurant started humble many years ago. with good asian food and services. as they expand, more menus and drinks appeared and they start branching out too.however, the quality dropped, while the price went up over the years. most of the waiter/waitress are not attentive to customers. for the price that i am paying for the food i get, i could get better / cheaper elsewhere.

Author: jolilies15Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below average..
Review: We had eaten here in the past and remembered it tasted great. Our recent visit was such let down, the mee hoon kueh was soggy and as silly as it may seem with the fact that mee hoon kueh is made of flour, pan mee lovers, you will know what I mean by "flour taste". The anchovies were barely there, fried onions were close to non-existence,and the soup was so bland. Mom was really disappointed that pan mee doesn't even serve sambal belacan to compliment the noodles, only provide cili padi. We have tasted better mee hoon kueh. Coming back? NO.

Author: behalvin2000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad Experience in PRIME Restaurant
Review: We celebrated an early Father's Day with our family today in PRIME restaurant in Le Meridien KL. Everyone ordered steak and I ordered Salmon. To my surprise the fish served was cold and when I cut it open it was still 80% raw inside. Upon checking with the staff, they took the dish away and said will check with the kitchen. 5 mins later they came out with the exact same piece of fish re-cooked. After I insist that I wanted something new, they took back and make me wait for another 15 mins. The fish eventually came out cooked properly, but the crab meat and the potato under it was again cold, I gave up and kept quiet.With my very bad experience above, believe it or not, none of the staff said a word of sorry and they seem to believe that it is all OK.I am very disappointed and initially wanted to write an email directly, but I couldn't find an address at all from the website, so here is my feedback.

Author: Barbara SChelmsford, United Kingdom
Title: Very good
Review: Ate here a couple of times lunch and dinner both exceptional and I can recommend the satay chicken. Staff very attentive, not in your face but just noticing when they are required. The setting of the restaurant is very good and on a Sunday night there is a lot going on along the waterfront.

Author: basilda
Title: Comfy
Review: We had the Grilled Salmon with rice,  Angel hair Aglio olio &  the California rolls,  with coffee and lassie. Food was as good as always. Service was fair. Price reasonable sitting and facing the park.  A good place for brunch....

Author: biancaraubPerth, Australia
Title: Must try in Kuala Lumpur!
Review: Naughty Nuris has the best ribs I have ever had. Well priced and absolutely delicious everything we have had. Lovely atmosphere and service. Will be back again for sure!

Author: themanfromearthSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best ambience in Langkawi
Review: Located a bit out of the way from the hub of Cenang, the ambience of this place just kills it! With a view of the sea and super inviting atmosphere, time spent here was a pleasure. Food is also good and we ordered the vegetarian fare - quite good lasagna and soup. Definitely recommend when in town.

Author: Anunu17Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overhyped: Dry Ribs, Dirty Glasses
Review: Was really excited to try this place out after hearing so much hype about it. Tandoori ribs is satisfying but on the dry side. Siew yok briyani tasted better but portion was small for the price. Bacon cheese naan dry and a tad too chewy. Palak paneer was the best dish for this visit -- but it took 45 minutes to get it and we had finished the rest of our food by then. We were served DIRTY GLASSES OF WATER. Twice.The first glass had dried food imprints all over the glass and pieces of god-knows-what inside. Waiter took it away without bothering to apologize. Second glass also had dirty imprints, really disgusting. Mango lassi malibu was perfect though. If you only have one thing here, have this. At least THIS glass looked clean enough....This place gets very packed and the staff either cannot handle the volume of people or can't be bothered to. Had to ask several times for our delayed food and no explanation was given, no apologies for dirty glasses.

Author: mikexomDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Step ack in time
Review: Historical - close your eyes, you are back in the colonial days, listen to the British Lord Mayor apportion deals. The waiter attending you was there then and still is now. The decor is aged, the building run down, but the sizzling steaks are excellent, the drinks are honest, and the desserts simple and delicious. A cafe in every sort of the word, a good one, and honest in its value. You should be proud you came and ate, it will be a favorite memory of Kuala Lumpur and its wonderful past you shared for your meal!

Author: hizonfireMarikina, Philippines
Title: South Indian diner-style that's a favorite of office workers in the area.
Review: ABC Bistro Cafe despite it's name is an unpretentious diner-style eatery, that is patronized by office workers of different ethnicities. We had their banana leaf biryani meal, which everybody seems to be having and we weren't disappointed. They also have really good fruit juices. Service is fast and attentive, despite us walking in during office lunch time.

Author: JutishaKuching, Sarawak, Malaysia
Title: A seafood place we will not go back to for seafood!
Review: Our first visit to this restaurant was with some friends. The pork dish , I would say was the best we ordered that day. The chicken cooked in bamboo was the worst I've ever had in Sarawak- it had a strong smell & taste of stale chicken meat! The seafood dishes were average. We all got sick after the meal though. We gave it another try a few weeks later, hoping food would be better. The fried fish was okay. The seafood fried rice & the squid cooked with dried chili were disappointing. The squid had a funny smell. We felt unwell again on our 2nd visit so we definitely are not coming back here for a meal.

Author: xAKxRUSxMoscow, Russia
Title: Don't understand the hype
Review: I asked out concierge to give us a selection of good restaurants in KL. He asked if we are willing to try Malay cuisine, and I agreed of course. He recommended Bijan. I then went onto TripAdvisor, and read the many great reviews. Reservations were made, and in the evening we arrived. Many awards and plaques at the door and I thought to myself "Hmm, this place must be really good."First thing that went wrong - we got the menu and the waiter asked us right away what we want. I told him to come back in 5 minutes since we need time to choose what we want. I asked him if there is anything he recommends, but he couldn't...When we were finally ready to order, we couldn't find our waiter... or any waiter for that matter. Finally caught one...We ordered some appetizers, some entrees, some drinks, and a bottle of water.About 20 minutes later the appetizers arrived... I reminded the waiter about our drinks and bottle of water...The appetizers were... meh. Not interesting, sort of bland. The entrees arrived... and still no drinks or water. I reminded them again, and they ran off to find our drinks...For entrees we got traditional Malay beef and lamb. The lamb was old and reeked. It was as if the lamb lived a full life and died of old age, and then served to us...The beef was in no better shape. It was hard and burnt. I am not even sure if it was beef since it was so burnt. When I asked the manager if this is how its supposed to be, he nodded, and inquired if we didn't like it. Clearly they don't understand that old lamb and burnt up beef isn't food that should be considered good and shouldn't be served in a restaurant. Something tells me that after receiving all these awards, the owners cashed out, and the place went downhill. Stay away!

Author: Y7338XTstevenbPerth, Australia
Title: Breakfast feast!
Review: The Living Room restaurant at The Westin Hotel in Kuala Lumpur is spacious and comfortable. The breakfast is a veritable feast with a wide variety of foods catering for Chinese, Japanese, Indian, Western, and local tastes. The buffet food offerings are strategically placed around a large central self-serving counter with separate counters for cereals (also including pancakes, fresh fruit, waffles), eggs (where you can order eggs in your favourite way), Indian (roti canai and curry), pastries, and bread. The breakfast food was tasty and plentiful. There was also a mobile cart where a chef prepared a complementary small dish at your table and this made it feel a bit special. The staff were smiling and helpful and we were impressed by the service we received from Nana a friendly and efficient waitress. We had a good fulfilling breakfast experience at this restaurant.

Author: YunJinChen
Title: Used to be good
Review: It used to be good. My recent trip with my Singaporean friends turned out to be a disaster. The fish was not cooked fully, the dessert - sago gula melaka and santan durian have gone bad and serving is much smaller.

Author: 877shivap
Title: poor quality on price,taste and hygiene.
Review: I went to have lunch at the chakri palace where after I paid the bill a rat was running in the restaurant. I informed the manager and nothing was done assumibg too much people were in the restaurant.

Author: JohnFoster68Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not Impresed at all
Review: I do not understand all the raving reviews about this poor buffet. Certainly some people need to get out more often. First of all, today they changed the name to the Rumanian Buffet. They took out the sashimi and the foie gras and put in place a display of boring salads from Rumania, a country with no culinary tradition and nothing of interest. The buffet was adorned with brochures from some Rumanian product, which I found improper. Evidently someone had paid the Ritz to display whatever they were trying to sell. The seafood was insipid. The oysters were kind of okay. There was a very poor variety. The beef roast was excellent but the lamb leg not really great, although they had a delicious foie gras sauce. There were no drinks included in the buffet. Just ice water. The price was about 50 USD per person all included, which on Malaysia was too much for not too good quality. I was not impressed. Do not recommend it and certainly will not come back.

Author: aikent88Cheras, Malaysia
Title: Our first and last for this restaurant
Review: Hi good day,I'm wondering why so many "Great food and good service" from the feedback?Or am i the only who given by bad service(Because i use voucher?)First of all. I'm not a Starwood Privilege Card holder.On 6th July 2013. I'm staying in Westin KL(Complimentary Night given by my sister) and going to Sheraton Imperial KL to have my buffet dinner(Starwood Complimentary Rm200 cash for dining OR buffer voucher for 2pax from a friend) with my girlfriend at 8pm.1. When i reach Essence, there is no one server you in the counter. I waited for few minutes, a waitress came and server me, so i show her the complimentary voucher and she serve me to a table.When me and girlfriend was look around the food and a so called Manager(He looks Chinese or maybe a part time manager?) came and asked me did i bring my Starwood membership card. and i told him I'm not. This voucher was given by a friend. And he told me this voucher is non-transferable, they have to verified with the Membership card, if not i can't use this voucher in the dining.I called my friend and pass the phone to the Manager, and he looks so impatient to pick it up.After phone called end, i asked whether i stay here wait for my friend come to show the card or can i enjoy the dinner first? He didn't answer me. And there is another Manage(He is Malay, but i guessing he is a Manager level due to he is wearing a coat as the previous Manager) asking for the situation. I've told him the story and he said NO to me too(Well, i like this Manager more than the previous one due to he spoke to me with friendly smile, not like the previous Manager with impatient face)Ok, fine. I'm giving a call to my friend again, and he told me just enjoy the dinner first, he will come along to settle it around 9:30pm,or he will just pay for me(or i will pay it if he doesn't come)8:20pm.Well, I don't care what it was happened. Time to enjoy my dinner with my girlfriend.2.Is this the only Hotel that only serve sky juice in dinner buffet? And there is nobody offering you a coffee or tea or whatever. NOT EVEN GIVE YOU THE MENU TO CHOOSE.3.Sushi bar just sucks. I saw some Tamago eggs so I asked for Tamago sushi and the chef told me only have Tamago skin with the sushi. Speechless.4.It took 20 minutes to clean the table.(Maybe it was Saturday, peak season) Btw, the impatient Manager was opening the red wine for my next table customer, and he does saw my table with empty plate but he did not clean it up.Maybe it not under his job? but i saw he cleaned up for other customers !! This was just hilarious. I've told my girlfriend and she said i was just too sensitive. 9:30pmMy friend is arrived, and he went to spoke and show the membership card to the Malay Manager, and he came to my table told me everything settled. Enjoy my dinner. Well, Thank You!I had an option to choose Sheraton or Westin for the buffet dinner. and i chose(my bad choice) Sheraton due to reading all the positive feedback from TripAdvisor.I don't know what i should tell you to improve, but please train well for those specially the Manager level. My personally think friendly smile and Sensitivity to customers: good relationship skills is most important in a F&B industry. So yeah.Anyways, I will never go to this restaurant anymore.P/s: Sorry for my bad English due to I'm not a blogger or part time review writer.This is my first review @ TripAdvisor. Thanks to Essence@Sheraton Imperial KLThank you again,Kent Low

Author: MayGoEZSouth Hampton
Title: Expensive for average food
Review: Visited Gianni's Restaurant for a special evening out and found the food not so special. We expected to enjoy delicious food for price but the food was at best average in taste. Food didn't measure up in Italian taste and price for steak and lamb entree were on the par of $40+ Singapore dollars-not entree prices of $15-$20 stated on Trip advisor restaurant description.The restaurant decor was nice and wait staff was attentive. Perhaps this is the best Italian in JB but it is far from the authentic taste. Restaurant on this caliber should consider using cloth napkins instead of paper napkins.

Author: Burkett66Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Obviously Chef Wan was out of town!
Review: Obviously Chef Wan was out of town when I attended his restaurant. After reading all the great reviews about this restaurant wand the waiting time to get a table I couldn't wait!!Well the hype certainly outweighed both the restaurant and the service.While the food was ok, I have to say I have had equal at some mamak stalls the service was like a clowns circus.... Both starters and main course served at the same time ??!! In fact the mains were delivered to the table before the starters. It's clear in the menu underlined as Starters!! This hasn't happened before but this is a restaurant with claims of being better !! Once the main nicely decorated restaurant is busy then the concertina doors open up to what must be The Wedding venue this where you lose ambiance due to very austere large open space its like eating in a community center with tables and chairs.Unfortunately due the the reasons above and the high cost I will not visit this place again. Shame Chef Wan was not there as I would have been as honest to his face. While the Cats away !!

Author: CaiyannnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Suitable for Family dinner.
Review: Dragon-I serves is Cantonese restaurant that serves quite exquisite dishes for quite valuable price. My friends and I (3 person) ordered a whole table of food for about $90 SGD inclusive of services charges and taxes, about 5 dishes and a soup.The services were very good. The waiters and waitresses attended to our requests patiently.It is really worth the money if you are holding a family dinner, be it taste or presentation. There were a lot of big family gathering there and hardly any teenagers like us.

Author: fraggleliz
Title: Lovely food but appalling service.
Review: The food here is lovely but the staff just couldn't cope with a large group. They forgot to order meals and brought drinks that we hadn't ordered and tried to charge us for them at the end.

Author: Evelyn S
Title: Boutique restaurant serving family recipes amidst many artistic artifacts
Review: Reservations are recommended as the seating capacity is limited. The food is traditional Johor cuisine, given the owner's family touch. The pisang salai (smoked banana) brownie is a delicious combo of being crumbly, rich and smoky, and the ice cream topping complements it perfectly. The drinks too include Johor specialties like Kluang coffee.

Author: 279gracies
Title: Awful customer service
Review: Such a shame that I'd to stop myself from going to Beast anymore as the service is horrendous! My colleagues and I frequent Beast alot as we work at one of the offices atop the restaurant at the Intermark. It started with a slight miscommunication where the waiter made a mistake on our order (happy hour promo), he was very reluctant to fix the bill and even made a nasty remark afterwards (F word included). I can't believe my ears! Of course, we requested to speak to one of the manager on duty and a Polish/German red haired lady came and told us off right away! that we should be nice to her staffs and will not hesitate to bar us from stepping into the compound, without even bother to understand the situation beforehand. We left the place, happily. there's 15 of us. 15 regulars, not including more from the office . I hope the management will do something about the CS level of your establishment, both wait staffs and managers.

Author: Pat58300
Title: very bad
Review: nasi goreng ayam, maggi goreng ayam.. both terrible and yet expensive.. not worth it at all. dnt mind to pay expensive if the food is satisfying, but price and the taste doesnt sync at all.

Author: yewchuennKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Celebrated buddy's birthday here
Review: Was here on Thursday 26 October 2017 for their dinner buffet to celebrate my buddy's birthday. 1) They don't have a drinks section. Everyone was served plain water and unless and until you ask, you wouldn't know that they actually serve tea and coffee too - but you'd have to ask for this.2) We were so sick of constantly having to ask the waiters to take away our dirty plates we just gave up asking. Instead, we moved over the plates to the (empty) table next to us. Can you imagine having to get rid of your own dirty plates just to make space for the plates of food you've just taken? Once or twice is fine - but this wasn't the case. Why are we even paying service charge for this? And it's not like we're seated in a secluded area. We were seated just a table away from the main entrance. We shouldn't have to pay this much for the subpar service that we received.3) Perhaps the worst service we've received came from a waitress by the name of Rohanna. We asked for tissues - we didn't get it. We asked for refills - we didn't get it. We asked for forks - we didn't get it. If you're wondering why we even bother to ask the same person again knowing that we'd probably wouldn't get what we asked for, it was because she was the only person there. So we basically spent the evening reminding the waiters how to do their job.4) We went for the international dinner buffet and the food was mediocre. We've tasted better food at cheaper places and better buffets at better prices at other hotels. It beats me as to how this restaurant is still getting 4 to 5 stars reviews.Yesterday was my third time dining at Lemon Garden (the last time being about 2 years ago). Things have changed and we were extremely disappointed at the service we received and the type and quality of food that was available. Things would have been different if the service was good - but it wasn't. Everything from A to Z was just horrible. I've heard better things about their seafood buffet but I've not had opportunity to try it yet. But I'm not going to pay another sen to dine here. The Management should:- employ more waiters; - improve on staff planning (felt like there wasn't enough people on the floor);- ensure all employees are well trained (Rohanna looked like she was gonna slit our throats when we reminded her to get us tissues, for example);- ensure employees are properly motivated.My friend and I have never been more eager and happy to leave a buffet - THAT WE WERE PAYING FOR. (Well, I paid for it.) Horrible place to celebrate one's birthday.Also, people who give this restaurant 5 stars for their international dinner buffet should be whacked with a tuna.If you're the Management of the restaurant, don't even bother giving me a template response unless you genuinely want to do a service recovery.

Author: RubyF191
Title: Wonderful ambiance
Review: The desserts were wonderful and the service was great. Ordered the lemon tart cheesecake, salted caramel and Americano. The music and setting made me feel at home.

Author: Grace WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent meal
Review: We ordered stir-fried sweet potato leaves, otak-otak, fishballs & veggie soup, chicken pongteh, egg omelet cincalok and chap chai (mixed veggie). It was just okay for me. Portion was just nice for 5 adults and 3 young teens. The kedondong and lemon tea juices were nice.

Author: 787weip
Title: Set Lunch pasta too salty
Review: Simple meal but not good. Pasta too salty. The best is the latte  l. Service staff present food to table never inform you and place it there and left dessert is pcs of cookies 🍪. Nothing special here.

Author: cyktaiCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Never going back
Review: Had a few decent experiences with Oritsuki. So when i was in KL again over the weekend, i decided to book a seat for myself. The booking was made 4 days in advance, and i confirmed twice that i would be sitting with Orisuki, which Oribe replied black-n-white that i would be seated with Oritsuki. Imagine my surprise when they decided to shift me to sit with another chef, without prior warning, and the further insult when i heard another customer thanking the staff for accomodating them at the last minute, which i presume was at my expense. For a restaurant that doesn't show me any respect, it is difficult for me to rate them any higher. Stick to Sushi Hinata for similar food and price point, or Sushi Saito if you would like to have something better. They are certainly more respectful.

Author: iamjohnnyThailand
Title: One of the best dining experiences!
Review: Love the place. So clean and tidy. Feels more like in Bali than Langkawi. Very beautifully decorated and very calming. Feels like a wedding set-up. Very accommodating when I requested the food altered from what's stated in the menu. Delicious food. Friendly and smiling staff. Great hospitality. Thank you, Jackie!

Author: kailichungKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It was okay
Review: The food was tasty, it’s unique although I’m not sure it would suit everyone’s taste. We were seated at a corner near the door with a lot of human traffic, i.e, it’s a cosy restaurant then can feel crowded. The service was okay, but I felt that staff were not all professionally trained, so don’t expect five star service. Considering the prestige and the prices, we expected a better fine dining experience.

Author: munak991Klang, Malaysia
Title: Good View but bad service
Review: My fiancee booked a table for 2 of us. Price of the buffet is 2x what you are paying to a 5 star hotel. If you are getting a window view sit there is extra charges so be aware. Food is decent as expected, the experience is mainly on view.and then every thing turns sour ,I've seen tourist been prioritize to be taken Photo with the restaurant DSLR so they can push to sell the photo frame. When it comes to our turn,I asked them politely to take a photo of both of us, they turned away and ignored us. BECAUSE I AM A LOCAL?

Author: limwwKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious French crepes & waffles
Review: My French Factory is a boutique shop located along the main street of Cenang Beach. It is next to Cenang Mall. Though not many sittings available, it is worth waiting for. There are a good variety of crepes (sweet or salty, vegetarian or vegan) and waffles. We loved the Nutella & Coconut Crepe and the Butter Salted Caramel waffle we ordered. The plates were totally wiped out!There are coffees, teas and hot chocolate too. We liked the friendly and gentle waitress who served us.

Author: GaryChin68
Title: Ambience before food
Review: The very short .... Horrid!!! Ambience great but the main thing for a restaurant is the food and that is downright tasteless. Portions may be big, bigger than their sister restaurant STG, but food quality is heaven and hell.

Author: travelgirlforyouBengaluru, India
Title: long wait period and limited thalis
Review: we visited this place after looking at such good reviews but did not have a great experiencewe ordered 5 veg thalis each priced at a steep 55 ringgits and only after the thali arrived did they mention that its limited thali and doesn't have any seconds to itamount of rice was a small cup and insufficient for adultssecondly there is a good amount of wait period herethe waiter was asked to get food free from peas specifically and he didnt bother with itthere are better places for food in klnot to waste time and money over this place.

Author: anneC234XIKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food and service
Review: Went for birthday dinner last night and it was wonderful! Loving the food, the view and the service! Particularly by Mr Fadzli B Mohamad. Thank you for the night. Will definitely come again.

Author: BMNSmithKuala lumpur
Title: Don't go!
Review: the steamed rolls for entree were nice - but all 3 main courses and even the rice were tasteless, one even not nice. So disappointing. the Beef salad, a chef special apparently, was full of tough and tasteless beef - I could do better at home - it's not that hard to make a tasty beef salad!! and the seafood noodles was horrible. The stirfried vegetables was fairly tasteless but the veg were nice and crunchy. As disappointing as the sister restaurant in Pavillion. Won't be trying Vietnamese restaurants in KL again - I will wait till I get to Vietnam.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: TheVinesNBranchesSingapore, Singapore
Title: New venue now
Review: Had moved From previous location to current venue, food is still good, is just round the corner in a shop lot which is more conveniently situated with plenty of car park! Still as good as I could remember this place ! Been eating here on and off in the last 14 plus years!
Restaurant: Ipoh Road Yong Tow Foo, Cairnhill Hotel

Author: Leonard S
Title: It should be good for the food, if not for the experience...
Review: Objectively speaking, it is one delicious restaurant to try. Tried the baby octopus, Wat Tan Hor Fun, Hokkien Fried “Yu Kong Hor”. They're all good, delicious baby octopus. The Hor Fun came with a little bit thick layer of sauce, probably not everybody like it. We spent RM 30 for those 3 menus and drinks. Please be mindful that this place is not friendly in space, and no system apply whatsoever. So queue on your own, stand there and stare at those who still eat or wait for their food, by the time they get up, you race with others to get your seat, what a way to have dinner. Not to mention, the wait time is literally more than 30 minutes to get the first meal. It should be good if not for the experience, nuff said.

Title: Delightful
Review: We usually come here for family celebrations as we find the food absolutely delicious. The menu is extensive. The choices of desserts are endless and it is always difficult to make a decision - not just due to the many choices but also because all taste so good!The ambience is delightful. Comfortable seats and non-harsh lighting. The decor is lovely and my favorites are the artwork - chalk? - on the walls. Last, but certainly the most important by far, is the crew. They are warm and friendly and it is always a pleasure chatting with the host who will never fail to mingle with his guests each time he is there. Talking about the food, the restaurant always makes the guests/customers feel at home and part of the 1Serambi family. It is definitely where we will pop by regularly.

Author: Stuart APoole, United Kingdom
Title: Awful food quality
Review: I've eaten in Harrods many times, however this is the first time in Kuala Lumpur Airport and it will certainly be my last.I am currently sat in front of a plate of gristle and bay leaf that my knife and teeth have failed to dissect. Absolutely awful. My rating would have been lower if it had not been for the half decent pot of tea, although after the tea had been served I had to ask for milk as none had been served with it!I have had better quality food from a local chip shop.

Author: richtee2019Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Could Be Better
Review: Came for Christmas Eve Dinner. No reservation allowed and the waiting system was bad. We finally gotten our table and ordered some steaks & ribs. Food were ok except for a rib that was too hard. But the manager was fast and kind enough to change it and ended up giving us a delicious lamb rack. There was a good local band ‘Split Fire’ singing on the night. Overall it was a good night out for our family.

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Spain Meets Melaka
Review: I am uncertain if the dishes served in this restaurant are authentic Spanish recipes for I have not been to Spain. However, their meals are definitely unique and served as an eye opener to the locals. The kind Spanish lady who runs this restaurant was very helpful in recommending signature dishes and seemed to be very welcoming to all of her guests regardless locals or foreigners.Good ambience. Lightings are perfect but it can get really hot and sweaty in this restaurant. I would also suggest selections of Spanish music to be played on air to create that atmosphere. Skillful cooks and I have seen a demonstration of their professionalism as they control the flames while roasting a piglet in front of my friends and I.Prices can be quite stiff hence this is not my daily hang out joint. However, it is worth a try.

Author: hao721Singapore, Singapore
Title: It is really a terrible lunch and service on Father’s day
Review: I really cant imagine how does a 4 star hotel service can be so ridiculous bad! Me and my family had a father’s day lunch visit over this Wan Li restaurant, and we had been told that there is out of stock of lamb chop, cod fish and even long bean after we had ordered the menu for more than 20mins. And the worst moment has come after another 30mins which is no gas at their kitchen! This is unacceptable and how could it be happened? You are a 4-5star hotel restaurant, even mamak stall is better then you!

Author: Mulrobs
Title: Disappointing food and service
Review: Positives:Sushi was delicious. The tiger prawn and salmon the tastiest I've had at any restaurant.The setting is cute, nestled in trees and tables on the terrace are intimate and provide a nice atmosphereNegatives:Overpriced for what is served - surprised to be paying uk prices for food on LankawiService poor - they forgot one of our meals and attempted to clear the table. When we said we had more food to come that we'd been waiting over 15 further minutes for, we were told it was "being prepared". If you forget a dish, just apologise, don't lie. The server checked back the order upon placing, so clear it had been forgotten. Granted though, they did have some trainee servers on this night which might explain things a little.Finally, second dish was overcooked and chewy. Most annoyingly, when asked how our dinner was on paying, we explained our disappointment, only to be met with a smile!Spend your money elsewhere!

Author: meaningremission
Title: Bak kut teh
Review: Bak kut teh is quite popular in JB and most of them tasted differently. This restaurant doesn't only serve bak kut teh, they also serve stream kampung chicken (free-range) and other pork and vegetable dishes too. They have 2 sections open-air and air-condition.

Author: grentoczz
Title: Bad food, bad service.
Review: Food is actually terrible, but thats ok because I wasnt expecting anything else from the Hard Rock cafe. The service was bizarre and uncomfortable. We had about five different servers fussing over us the whole meal. Halfway through our order one of them took all our napkins away before we could protest saying he'd get us new ones?? But then never did. When we were finished another server asked us would we like to see a menu for a sandwich or a burger maybe... we'd just finished our burgers. Then when we were sitting finishing our drinks a waiter sat down at our table with our bill asking us to do "research" by signing in to a website and typing in a code and reviewing the food. Bad enough, but she wanted us to do it immediately!! Very unpleasant experience all round, I'll continue avoiding the Hard Rock cafe.

Author: Lalat79
Title: As cosy an eatery one can dine in
Review: A walk back to the older days with fine dining in cosy environment. Lots of lights and lantern, great food in generous portion and yes the plates are huge too...

Author: Clb1403
Title: Simple but Delicious Sikh Punjabi Food
Review: No frills cafe serving a range of  freshly cooked flat breads and rice with a large variety of vegetarian and meat dishesto accompany, along with typically indian deserts. Very tasty . It's a pity that we're unable to upload photos for a new listing

Author: tatianac4444
Title: Not good...
Review: Here it goes, my first poor review on TripAdvisor. I was in the mood for dim sum and followed the suggestions of previous TripAdvisor visitors. Unfortunately my experience was “poor” and that’s putting it nicely. I walked from the touristy jonker Street area with hopes to enjoy something fresh and off the beaten path but this was short of my experience. Important to note, this is not a vegetarian friendly restaurant and absolutely cannot serve to a vegan. Majority of dimsum was with pork, beef and or chicken leaving me with close to zero vegetarian options so I went with the following; steamed prawns OK, friend Carrot cake OK, fish cakes NOT GOOD, Thai tofu REALLY NOT GOOD (I watched it come out of the microwave which is conveniently located on the main dining floor) and Chinese tea NOT GOOD (only tea option available). The energy was off in this place from my arrival, all staff and owner Were sitting together at a table, the only occupied table upon my arrival. And I was a table for one, the only table throughout my meal there. They began to close the shutters before I got up to leave. That was my “g2g” sign.

Author: MrsFoongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Horrible dinner buffet.
Review: I'm here on 30th April 2017 for 630pm dinner. Which cost rm 148++ p/pax. Everything looks nicely placed n look appetizing. However when I placed the food on my plate I was utterly disappointed with the quality of food Sheraton Hotel serves:1. Sushi: was utterly not fresh n not cold enough as it suppose to be. 2. Indian: Naan was like a rubber n tasteless3. Lambrack: was cooked medium however the meat is so tough like rubber; hard to chew4. Beef steak: same tough n tasteless5 Noodles: this was good6 Satay: Chicken Satay was v delicious!.7 Beef stew: was not bad8 Dessert: the display of dessert are v appealing but was so so only You pay RM148 for this quality of food?! I feel so cheated n mind you with that price they only provide coffee & tea only for drinks!! Seriously?! Who in the right mind would drink caffeinated drinks for dinner??? No way I'm gg to come back n pay big bucks to this quality of trash! :/

Author: alang763Sydney, Australia
Title: mini tiffin no pushover
Review: Could not fault them. We were looking for a light and easy lunch. The mini tiffin has a masala dosai centrepiece that was crisp and light with just the right amount of potatoe filling and an excellent thali plate with a well chosen range of flavours. My salty lassi and her sweet lime drinks were simply taste perfect. Attentive team who made sure we had all we needed. RM40 very well spent.

Author: Girija MKuala Lumpur
Title: Chez Pappa's really exceptional!
Review: Delightfully unexpected, a French restaurant in Johor Baru...and what a relief to have a really good scrumptious meal! My personal favourite is the "foie gras chaud" made to perfection. Congratulations to the chef on this. So many other mouth-watering dishes to choose from at such reasonable cost as when compared what you pay in Singapore! The warm atmosphere and impeccable service of all the staff is definitely worth a mention.Next visit to Johor Baru, I am not going to miss going back to Chez Pappa. :)Girija Menon, French Trade Commission-Ubifrance, Embassy of France in Kuala Lumpur
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: aimacarmelaIloilo City, Philippines
Title: A bite of Penang in Kuala Lumpur
Review: My group and I were planning on going to Penang but that fell through. Not having any experience with Penang cuisine, I would say this cafe have some really good food! The choices are extensive. There's a lot to choose from. I suggest going with a group. Ordering a lot of food choices to share. We eat here for a couple of times, ordering something different every time and we weren't disappointed. Price is not really cheap but it's all good food anyway and most portions are good for sharing. The line was long when we went there so it would help you go early or later than the usual meal time.

Author: RobertChew-MYShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Patient is a must
Review: Well, this a one of the popular place, for tourist and locals as wellOpen at around 6:30pm till midnight but you must wait a least an hour before you can have your food.The queue starts even before they starts to cook. If you are early, look for the guy that gives out numbers. Then you will have your queue number or you will be shown your table. Its Roadside and pathway dining, so wear comfortable and if raining, well... Must order here is the 'Siong Tong La La (Clam in superior soup)'. The Calm is big but beware, its spicy soup!Rest of the food are not too bad. Hokkien Mee is also a worthwhile try.If you are in Klang, and already had your Bah-Kut-Teh, this should be your second stop.

Author: 658LeeR
Title: Nice food
Review: Managed to find this place on our last day in Langkawi. Staff are nice and friendly and food was enjoyable, all at a reasonable price.

Author: JohnI273Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I feel violated!!
Review: I went to Acme Southern BBQ had their RM99 beef ribs and RM 44 beef brisket. It was burnt over cooked and dry!!! The owners must think we are stupid! Portion so small and the sides tiny! Do not go! I feel violated!! I am from BBQ country I know good BBQ!
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: SurfingWildBandung, Indonesia
Title: Lovely food and desserts
Review: I eat here quite from time to time and despite browsing through the menu I always end up ordering the slow roast chicken breast on mashed potato with asparagus and a wild mushroom ragout. The menu is actually very interesting with many delicious looking meals, however, the slow roast chicken breast is always super.

Author: JUDYLEE2003Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Fusion Dining - This Is The Place
Review: We came for dinner and we are not disappointed. The place is beautifully decorated and is such a comfort environment. The place is not big so if you have a big group, please make a reservation. Most of the menu available are western food. I recommend the lamb shank or lamb chop,not sure of the correct name is lamb cubes on top of mashed potatoes.

Author: alvinmfaw
Title: Scrumptious dim sum
Review: This dim sum restaurant served the food hot from kitchen. It has Ipoh dumplings koay throw which is delicious too.

Author: nel93Penang Island, Malaysia
