Title: Mr.Dakgalbi AEON Bandaraya Melaka
Review: Seriously a disappointment for the visit to your AEON Bandaraya Outlet on both the services and food quality. It took me quite sometimes for me the waiters/waitress actually realized that I raised my hand for me to actually request them to fry my rice. One of my main reason is that the girls are actually playing with their handphone. The rice has been by my side for quite some time!Next, speaking of food quality. Your AEON Bandaraya Melaka outlet is giving out great disappointment. The Dakgalbi served is just too oily, your sauce is sweet, and it tastes really bad.Please do something to your staffs. And to my surprise the outlet manager does not seem to be alerted with my comments too (busy eating with his staff).

Author: JoParfitt
Title: Our third trip
Review: I like the Geographer at any time of day for its location, decent food, nice staff and the way you can watch the world go by.

Author: Clay W
Title: Not worth for trying.
Review: We ordered a salted prawn and a charcoaled grilled fish. The prawn is overcooked. The aroma of the fish's sauce is average and the fish is slightly under.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: nami8319
Title: Cool restaurant with great food
Review: Scrumptious meal! Had the chilli cheese fries, nachos, fish and chips, and a few other dishes. Best chilli cheese fries in tow! The wines are not bad too.

Author: Patrick L
Title: Dinner snacks & drinks
Review:
This is a cafe that's perfectly located right in the middle of Jonker Street. 

After walking and eating and shopping in the heat and humidity the Geographer Cafe is the place to take a break for a drink if not more food.

Author: David DParis, France
Title: Pay Out The Nose
Review: I walked in on Halloween afternoon to see if they had something going that night and I had a pint of Carlsberg beer that cost me 38.00 Ringgit! Don't drink there, the prices are not fare. The service is good but you will lose a weeks wages in the process. Carlsberg cost less than 10 cents a pint to make, don't do it.

Author: Traveller8354
Title: A has been
Review: This place is fast becoming deserted except for foreign tourist. Expensive and poor service. Been good before but standards fallen.

Author: JacquelineInstoneHampshire, United Kingdom
Title: My Seductive Parisian Delights!
Review: I had my first Escargot, and mussel Mariniere (Incredible!!!) in this Restaurant and fell in love with this place. Food is good and affordable, ambiance is incredibly comfortable and the Parisian music on the background simply completes our date night in a fine dining french restaurant! It is a shame no one took time to write a review about this beautiful restaurant on TripAdvisor,yet. Crews and the Chefs are friendly and passionate about their tantalizing masterpiece. Definitely a Gastronomic Delight to dine in a place where people remembers your name and took time to please your tummy!

Author: S5949TEdanielh
Title: Disgraceful staff
Review: I feel compelled to write after the experience I had at Ben's Suria KLCC. On 7 January 2018, at around 1pm, my wife and I took our kids to KLCC for lunch. We had driven from JB for a mini holiday in KL and our trip was so far pleasant. We walked into Ben's, and I noted that there was an attendant at the entrance, but she just stood there, very unwelcomingly. I had to walk to her booth to engage her. I tried to make eye contact, but she looked away. I then asked whether I could look at the menu, which was placed in front of her. Her reaction was incredible. She audibly scoffed at me and my family, and even sneered at us, before looking away. For a service staff, this is beyond unacceptable. She looked down upon us, as if we couldn't afford a simple meal in a restaurant! We were disgusted with her attitude and left. I have never met such a rude staff in my life! She was a Malay lady.KLCC is a tourist destination and it is experiences like this that tarnishes a tourist's impression of a country. I wrote to Ben's a day after the incident, but they have ignored me to this day. Such a haughty establishment is a disgrace to the food industry as a whole!

Author: WenWongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated restaurant with average food & high price tag
Review: We went to this restaurant after seeing the review on Tripadvisor but it was a total disappointment! We ordered fish, beancurd with home made sauce, nyonya chap chye, ladies finger with sambal, fried omelette with cincaluk, and otak-otak.Firstly, we noticed that only tourists are eating there when we first stepped into the restaurant. That was probably the first sign that the food may not be good since the local don;t even want to eat there!Secondly, the food cooked were so so only, nothing special but expensive. The chap chye is just average, the beancurd with home made sauce is even worse. It's just normal bean curd taken to deep dry and the so called home made sauce is just some diluted bottled soy bean sauce which you can purchase from supermarket. The omelette with cincaluk is just normal fried egg with probably 1 tablespoon (or less) of cincaluk. We could hardly taste the cincaluk. The steamed fish was ok but pricey. I have eaten a much better one in Penang and it is cheaper as well! The ladies fingers was horrible. It does not taste horrible but it is not what it claimed to be. It's just steamed ladies fingers and the so called special sambal is some diluted canned chillie sauce that you can get from supermarket. And this dish cost about RM10!! Anyone without cooking skill can also make this dish!the otak-otak taste the same as those from factory, nothing fantastic and definitely not worth mentioning. Overall experience: terrible, food are expensive and not worth coming back!this restaurant seems like is catered for Singaporeans. The entire restaurants were full of Singaporeans except us. The food is probably tasty by Singapore standard, but definitely not by Malaysia standard. We tried some nyonya food in Singapore previously and the standard of food serving in this restaurant is rather similar to the one in Singaore. The Singapore restaurant that we tried claims to be one of the best nyonya restaurants in Singapore but food were rather average. Well, the food in Nyonya Suan is cheap if you convert to SGD but I would say: why waste the money to come here if you have better choice out there? For Nyonya food, Penang is still the best!

Author: zimbajamuStavanger, Norway
Title: Overpriced
Review: Not a newbie to Hard Rock KL, food was always decent before. It seems over the years Hard Rock has evolved into a place that people go to for live music and not to eat. Food while average tasting, has declined in quality and value. Too expensive for the quality we get here. Decor is old and tired. It is not a destination for food but if you want drinks or live band or the “been there done that” thingy, then proceed by all means. Better value elsewhere for food.

Author: Lovefood786
Title: Consistently good food
Review: We've the Bar b q tonight buffet a few times now and it has been consistently good, definitely with the rm40 per head price tag (adults) the lamb ribs are particular good and the chicken biryani and nihari dishes. Haven't been disappointed yet

Author: Harrison-F-CarterCologne, Germany
Title: Okay
Review: Our visit was okay. Food and coffee were good. Nice interior too. One thing that should be done better is making sure that as a couple we get our coffees together. A 10-15 minute difference in serving meant I had finished mine before my partner's arrived. It wasn't even that it was busy. And then another 10-15 for the food. A bit out of sync. Might be best to specify this when placing order rather than assuming.

Author: Kiara756Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Never again!
Review: Extremely poor service which is a shame considering they just renovated. We ordered a salad which should have come with dressing but we had to ask at least 4 times before it came. By then, we had eaten half of it - rabbit style. Ordered a cake and it took 25 min to arrive. Overall, food portions are tiny, oily and tasteless. Food and service was much better pre-renovation and even then, the service was bad! We even had to take our own cutlery as it wasn't given to us.Only go if you're ok to pay a lot for mediocre food, poor service and can afford the time to wait.

Author: carolinegourriLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent. Excellent food, excellent service, excellent location. Excellent.
Review: We dined at La Sal twice on our vacation. We had been advised to go by friends and had such a wonderful time that we decided to go a second time to celebrate my husband's birthday. We were not disappointed.. Robert made us feel so welcome. The food was amazing (both times) and the staff fantastic. Robert went to a lot of trouble to make sure my husband's birthday dinner was really memorable. Not only did the staff sing him happy birthday, we were given champagne and the most wonderful deserts! We loved our two visits to La Sal and would 100% recomend that everyone who visits Langkawi eats at this restaurant at least once. Dining on the beautiful beach was amazing. We weren't staying at the hotel but we were made to feel so welcome. Simply wonderful.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: BillyT0313
Title: good place with good food and good services
Review: this is a over 80 years building. I love that very much. You will feel that you are back to 1930's for a dinner. Nonya food is very good with attentive staff Shirley cocktails is very suitable for food too. I have a great night with my friend and enjoy this night very much! that's why this is #1 here!

Author: patber66Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: Came in to this famous, but very sad our meals were left a side until we keep asking the waitress and finely came about an hour later but not to what we order. We decided to cancel the dish and were eventually given the apology by the waitress for their mistake.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: agoh69Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing chicken rice ball
Review: Disappointed with the chicken rice and the meat. I think it is overrated by many. The rice not even fragrant and meat was blend, quite tasteless ! Both fried and steamed chicken. Ordered few other dishes like petai prawn with sambal, fried egg prawn omelette , fried fish with sambal and drinks. The price is not cheap and we spent rm180 for 1 roast Chicken and half boiled chicken, egg omelette, petai prawn and 2 slices of batang fish! Service is so so and luckily we came off leak time, else the queue is not worth to even try. They don’t even offer you free soup for chicken rice.. won’t come back !

Author: Hooksan13
Title: Fantastic
Review: We had escargot, French onion soup, and beef bourguignon. Everything was delicious and well wade. It’s definitely a good change if u have had your fill of curry n fried food.

Author: LLing_L
Title: Penang's food
Review: Used to be my favourite place, but the quality of the food dropped years by years. I wonder how and why? I can even get a better taste with lower price from the foodcourt. Disappointed

Author: richardmB1391SHNorthwich, United Kingdom
Title: Average
Review: Service was not very good, the food was average. My lamb curry was easily 50% bone. It's cheap, which is all I can really say positive. I wouldn't go out of my way to find this place. There are hundreds dotted around kuala lumpur. Just go to your local place. It will probably be better.

Author: JennPenang
Title: Dinner
Review: Great food , Great view ! Excellent ambience . Thanks for your great and attentive service , Mr.  Sayed.

Author: Clare_AliciaSingapore, Singapore
Title: On level 15 of Impiana Hotel
Review: Great view and great food. They have indoor dining and outdoor dining. I would recommend to take the indoor dining as the weather in Malaysia is quite humid. Indoor air conditioned environment would be better. You may go outside to the outdoor area for drinks and smoke and photo taking.

Author: David G
Title: Dangerous
Review:
Everyone in my party fell ill after eating here. They served a raw chicken sandwich, undercooked burger and somehow "sweetened" my cappuccino with SALT.

The beer was nice though.

Author: Kakipii294Tokyo, Japan
Title: Disappointed
Review: Like some other reviews here, I had a feeling I was being ripped off by upselling that took advantage of my lack of knowledge over the process. Despite quite a significant minority of the customers looking like tourists or visiting foreign workers, they do not employ English speaking waiters and they don't explain how the meal will be served. I left feeling a bit disappointed that I didn’t get the classic banana leaf rice on my one and only chance to try it during my trip. Imagine a foreign tourist in the UK going to a pub carvery to sample a traditional roast, and somehow getting persuaded into having the pie of the day and fish and chips from the menu (at twice the price). That's how I felt. You could say I should have done more research and been more confident in saying what I wanted, but nowhere could I find 'how' the meal is served, so this is the process:-There’s no menu on the table. Once you're seated, a banana leaf is placed in front of you. Staff circle the restaurant with various dishes, some of which will come with the price of the meal (i.e. won't appear on your bill). If you're asked if you want something, you probably have to pay for it. Otherwise, they just put it on the leaf. The first bit of upselling came before I'd even sat down (Chicken biryani? Sorry? Chicken biryani? Ah OK...). This led to my not getting a choice of white rice (refined or unrefined) which I felt was a big point of the banana leaf rice meal, but instead getting a (quite nice but unnecessary) filling chicken main to go with all the other quite hearty stuff on the leaf. Oh, and this was of course a quite expensive choice.As others have said, as the waiters come round with other choices of dishes, order just one at a time - they keep coming. From the 'fried' plate, I got the fish (dry) and a croquette (nice) and a piece of chicken (ok). The latter was my poor decision, as the biryani had a large piece of chicken. I therefore didn't need any of the bowls of vegetable curry, as they came round 20 minutes into the meal when I was stuffed and nearly done.The taste? It was OK. I bought a mango lassi after reading about the heat level, but nothing on my leaf (included or sold to me separately) could have been described as hot in any way. I couldn't help looking enviously at customers around me, who all had white rice, a couple of sauces and veggie dish sides. The staff? I was greeted warmly in English by the manager at the till - later, staff came round in pairs occasionally, one guy telling his mate a stream of jokes. It might have been absolutely nothing to do with me, but when one guy is standing in front of you adding up your bill and another is telling him a load of jokey comments in a language you don't understand, you can't help feeling they're taking the piss.All in all, taste OK but not spicy, service unhelpful at best (actively trying to fleece you at worst), and the price is more than you think you'd pay, as you've been sold lots of stuff you didn't really want. I came out feeling full but disappointed; with myself for not having researched a bit more (perhaps I could have brought a picture or a list of things I wanted and insisted on that) and with the staff for not trying to give me what I was there for. I’ve been the hapless foreigner in hundreds of places over Asia, and I remember and go back to the restaurants I was helped to have a good meal in – this is not one of those places.

Author: FoodProfessor2015Singapore
Title: The Real thing
Review: This is a place for who knows real Italian food or want to experience the real thing. Set over the balcony on a fresh evening served with Nero D'Avola and a fantastic steak cooked to perfection sith a side dish of red peppers and veggie could not be better!! Friendly staff and related value for money. GREAT WINE SELECTION ! Good for dates, birthdays, company function. Book earlier or try your luck to have the real thing. Please notice and take pictures with a 1967 600 fiat in collector condition. Have fun!

Author: claud1neJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice place but terrible experience
Review: We wanted to eat there because of the location but after what we been through inside the restaurant we left without actually experience the beautiful night view of Melaka.The waiter who served us, i don't know whether he is making fun of us for not knowing some of the dishes name on the menu as our English is not superb or just trying to be funny. Either way, we felt uncomfortable. The serving period is alright, you don't have to wait hours to eat. The food I ordered is not tasty but my friends food are okay. If this weren't for the scenery, we definitely will not go there and now, even with the view, we will not go back as well.

Author: RowdyMonsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Didn’t get to eat, told to wait as we didn’t make any reservations
Review: I can’t review about the food but I can say that I’m not impressed; four of us took a Grab to this restaurant; and being Malaysians, it didn’t cross our minds that we had to make a reservation first. So imagine our frustration when we were told to wait outside for an hour or more as we didn’t make any reservations. Instead of waiting, we walked around and found New Lagoon restaurant instead.

Author: Karis WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Money worth and food is excellent
Review: We had crab, duck, squid, asam prawn etc the food is really excellent and cheap. We definitely will visit this restaurant. The only disadvantage is hard to find, if you are not familiar there, we drove 4 to 5 rounds finally we found it very worth going for it.

Author: CheddarCharlieSomerset
Title: Busy, nice fresh food, cheap
Review: Bargain food and drink, cooked fresh and very tasty. So cheap too £20 for family of 4 with beers and soft drinks, seafood. Location and restaurant is basic but we liked that as it is so different. Full of locals which is always a good sign.

Author: ritajegaJohor
Title: Great food and place
Review: This place is a must eat place in JB. The food was very nice and the tong yam is super great. Till today can feel the taste.The food was great the prawn and fish too. There is a dish called Manggo salad.. Which i would recommend everyone to try. Really very very nice.

Author: JAMILEYJAAFARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Expensive Price But Average Taste"
Review: It is not worth it if you eat here. The location is very attractive, the restaurant looks very grand but the taste of the food is very simple and not worth it at all with the price to be paid. Most of its employees are Hindus. So for Muslims be a little careful because most of them practice unclean life. This is my personal opinion I have nothing to do with anyone, I comment on my own experience.

Author: AsiatracemKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not our First...
Review: ...time there, but every time there seems to be an "even better" aspect to our visit -- and this time was no different. We went to the Sunday Brunch for my husband's birthday (but ahem, as mine is in but 2 days, in my mind, it was a combo thing). I'd called on that front and when they checked in the night before, they asked me more about it (good follow-up!). The food is truly wonderful: foie gras? Eggs Benedict? Caviar? Oysters? All covered, and divine. The Alaskan king crab legs were not as generous as in times past (size-wise)...and the crab claws were, well, watery! This was not so during previous visits (who knows?). Suffice to say, however, we simply loved this return to The Brasserie and look ever forward to our next time there. We can't end this without acknowledging the wonderful Alvin (!) who oversaw everything with aplomb (and just couldn't have been more engaging), along with the frequent attention of Devi -- making service at The Brasserie top notch!
Restaurant: The Brasserie - The St. Regis Kuala Lumpur

Author: Serimah T
Title: Chicken was bland
Review: The chicken was very bland but he prawn noodles was very good and I highly recommend that if you ever go to project b you should try their prawn noodles 👌🏻👌🏻

Author: georgepburdell97tokyo
Title: They cancelled our order without telling us that they did so
Review: We relayed to the wait-staff that we had to catch an airplane and that we would appreciate their efforts to bring our meal as soon as possible. The waiter confirmed that we didn't have much time and quickly returned to the kitchen with our order. Thirty-five minutes later, we asked where our meal was, and he stated that he had canceled our order and then he offered to give us some more iced-water. So be warned...the waiters may seem to understand what you are communicating, but they obviously did not in our case.

Author: aiswaryaletchumiShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Great Food,Amazing Experience
Review: I took my boyfriend here to celebrate his birthday, As we went in they made us play a game to guess the welcome drink we were having, which was fun. Then we had to lock out things in a locker and here into the dark. We were guided by our very friendly blind waiter. I liked the fact that we locked our watched and phones away, giving more focus to dinner and our companion. We had 4 different appetizers, 2 different soups, 3 mains and 5 desserts all served in average portions. It was an amazing experience trying to eat in the dark, the food tasted great and the portions were filling. As we were finished, the waiter asks us for our opinion of what we were tasting, like a guessing game. Then as we came out, they sang a birthday song for my boyfriend with a tiramisu dessert also done by their chef which was so creamy and just .. PERFECT!! Im so happy that upon my request they helped me celebrate his birthday. Its definitely an experience we'll never forget. While we were having the cake, they gave us a picture menu to see what we had. They told us the chef changes the menu every 3-4 months i think. Excited to try it again. And they can also make a vegetarian menu if requested

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good seafood within walking distance from central hotels
Review: This place offers seafood with, what I would call, reliable quality.If you have fiends staying in different hotels such as Mega, Meritz, Imperial, it is easy to converge there for dinner without having to bother with taking a taxi. After dinner, lots of places to adjourn to for drinks. You can order the normal fare, which won't cost you too much, or you can order expensive stuff, which they do have too.

Author: JazzivKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Customer Service Spoiled My Mood
Review: This morning I purposely woke up earlier in the morning and went to SS2 branch for breakfast. As usual, the staffs there are like zombie without spirit walking around and need to be called for order taking. After 10 mins, nothing was served and he seemed to forget about my order until I looked at him when he walked pass and then he suddenly thought of that and went to prepare the drinks and food slowly. As I can see, many customers that came late than me already had their food. After 15 mins, this guy only started to serve the drinks, and 1 roti telur which I shared with my friend while waiting for another roti kosong. After we finished the roti telur, only the roti (something but not kosong) was served. We looked at him and he was like suddenly awaken but did not say anything and walked away. Then, we just told him to take back that roti and we paid the bill then back to office.Seriously, the customer service is far behind KAYU nasi kandar where the staffs there are aggressive. If you are not serious about your business, please continue with the customer service like this and you will see the business is going down hill.

Author: PatrickChai
Title: Food Delicious
Review:
Food Really Delicious
price reasonable
Chef friendly
Staff helpful

Also available of Western Food but probably need some advance booking

Absolutely come again ..
Very near China town

Author: jadey2701Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Only Go for the View ... Don't expect much more
Review: Having lived in Johor for a long time, I was really excited to see that there was somewhere different to go for a drink and some food. However unfortunately it was a very disappointing experience. The only reason I am even giving one star up from "terrible", is because I would go for a quick glass of wine with friends while watching the sunset, as the view from the balcony is amazing, unfortunately all good things stop there. The service is truly appalling, none of the wait staff seem to know the menu or have any basic training. My friend had to order a beer 3 times before they brought him just a beer and not a shandy. The food takes an extremely long time to arrive and sometimes is doesn't even arrive and after 20 minutes of waiting you are told "it's not available". When the food does arrive, it's extremely low standard and not well executed at all. The cappuccino I ordered came in what I can only describe as a cereal bowl and it was basically just milk and no actual coffee. So As I say, go there are a drink at sunset and then head somewhere else afterwards, going through a meal there REALLY isn't worth it.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: sp3ak_christ
Title: Best Chinese Cuisine in Kuching!
Review:
Limited seats! no reservation = no seat
Waiters may be a little unprofessional but... the food is GOOD!
Price? Reasonable for the quality of food served :D
One won't patronize and leave disappointed ;)

Author: Adiwati ZKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch At Marini's 🙁
Review: First time trying out Marini. We had the pasta prawns aglio olio and Asian Duo Salad. Both were lunch sets. Pasta was done just right. Prawns were fresh. The Asian Duo salad was great and very filling. The house dressing was awesome sweet citrissy. The chicken was still moist and the tuna were seared just right. Sadly though the greens itself were such a dissappointment. It was wilted and brown at the edges. You charge so much and you served wilted browned salad? Such dissapointment for an establishment like Marini's.

Author: Kentcp73
Title: The vegetarian food are so delicious
Review: We are seldom eat vegetarian food but this shop have a well cook. The food are delicious and I ate 2 bowl of brown rice 😄

Author: Sze Mian KKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good food but the price is a disaster!
Review: Been here many times. The first time in 2008 was the best experience I have. The food was so delicious, probably the best out there, and it is competitively priced. You really get a sense of satisfaction. Unfortunately, recent visits to this restaurant have been utterly disappointing. A small dish of vegetable cost RM30++, which is twice as much as the priciest ones in town. Not gonna come back again.

Author: UkMagmag
Title: Great place to get to know Malaysia!
Review: Not to be missed if you are in Kuala Lumpur. The place is very accessible and convenient!

Author: iqtidar91
Title: Rude waiter
Review: I went to samba last night with all my family members, the 19 of us. The waiter was rude and unfriendly and before we were done, he cleared the table, he took our napkins, plates, glass and earlier while eating, my mom asked for ice for her drink and this guy put way too many ice in her glass,so my mom asked for lesser ice and this guy took the ice out and put it back in the bucket where he would serve others later. That's disgusting. Who knows how many times he has done that and from whose glass... The guy who served had black earringsThe quality of food has also deteriorated, this is my third time here and 1st & 2nd trip were much better.

Author: Nick ASingapore, Singapore
Title: not very legendary!
Review: we decided to make the effort take a cab and visit this place as it was outside the city centre map, after long journey and getting lost forever, we finally got there, and I am terribly sorry D Legends bar, there is nothing legendary about you! you got to be realistic! just a pup with below average offerings, we felt we just wasted half of our day looking for 2nd best restaurant in KL and what we found was just a big joke. again as I posed the question before to other restaurants! ALL 6 reviewers have written ONLY ONE review and thats only for this restaurant! is this a coincidence?

Author: AliceDtravels
Title: Opi-yum!
Review: The food was excellent, authentic and interesting. The atmosphere and music also lovely - our server Roy was of the utmost calibre!

Author: azharaida
Title: Nice Restaurant For Family Outing
Review: Serve good food. The Tom Yam is delicious. Fast service. Very convenience venue. New shopping mall. No problems with parking. Easy to find. Look for Plaza Masalam or Plaza Shah Alam.

Author: veronnecaSir Bani Yas Island, United Arab Emirates
Title: Definitely not the best fish & chips in town.
Review: We were told that this place serves the best fish and chips in town and we finally went in for dinner last night.We ordered the fish chowder, fish & chips, mushy and some gin &tonic. Fish chowder was good.Mushy was cold and unappetising. Fish and chips- the fish was not great. The chips came out cold and soggy so we asked the waitress to replace the chips for us. When the new batch of chips came up, they Chef had left the same old soggy chips underneath a layer of fresh new chips.We left with our food almost untouched. Plus points: waitresses were very Friendly and helpful.

Author: Phang H
Title: Best coconut steamboat in kl
Review: Their food is really good. Best coconut steamboat in kl!!! I love their lobster ball. The ambience of the restaurant is also very good.

Author: AakritiAgg
Title: Awesome Place!
Review: Stepped in here for an early lunch. The food was great, the wine chilled! Very friendly staff. Great place to grab a bite & relax :-)

Author: Luxing18
Title: Great food, great location
Review: The best Japanese food I've ever had in a mall. Generous portions and really fresh sashimi. The staff were also friendly and attentive. Will definitely go again!

Author: BibbibooLausanne, Switzerland
Title: SADLY IT’S NO LONGER THE SAME FARE
Review: Went there on Sat 2/10 for an early bak kut the breakfast. Ordered the lean meat (pai quat) in a one-person-portion clay pot with some string mushrooms and fried bean curd. Also had a separate bowl of ‘China Bones’ or commonly known as Yeow Char Kway and onion rice. Ended the meal with a deep feeling of nostalgia……of what it used to be before and what it has become now. The soup was no longer thick, the spare ribs were minuscule portions and the additional soup for the Yeow Char Kway even more diluted. Even the fiery chili padi that they were famous for and which I raved about was a pale shadow of itself. I could have consumed the whole Tupperware of the chili and would have suffered none the worse of a rear end burn. I asked my tongue: is it you misbehaving or is it the chili? It replied: I’m as well as can be; don’t blame me just because you can’t taste the chili….go question the chili please! What an admonishment. What a sad start to a breakfast I was looking forward to. This was my all time favorite bak kut the place. I guess before I leave, I’ll give it one more try….for old times sake.

Author: JessMacBocLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible, overpriced degustation menu
Review: My husband and I had a terrible experience. We were so excited for the degustation menu at 198RM. We understand gastronomical food but this was an utter joke. The portions were literally the size of my tooth, it was all about the esthetics but the food was not tasty, in fact there was hardly any food. We complained and the manager still made us pay for most of the bill. We are not. Coming back and do not recommend his place if you're a food or expect good customer service. This place has none of that.

Author: samuell127Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Chilled place for an after dinner drink
Review: Came here after a meal down Jalan Alor, mainly to find a spot to watch the football. Yet, it ended up being alright with beers priced decently as that whole street of bars do charge quite a bit compared to other places. Still nice atmosphere, if you want to smoke Shisha you can. We just had two beers and left to try another place out.

Author: HappycookiesKl
Title: Double standards service, average steaks
Review: This restaurant attracts lots of foreigners and the waiters have double standards, keep asking the other tables “how was your food? Etc etc” no good service to our table. We went there after reading many good reviews on service.Never mind the service, I wanted a good steak. We ordered a medium rare rib eye that came too raw and sent it back. The steak doesn’t melt in your mouth. It was Rm88 for 250g. For a steakhouse, mehhhhhhWe also had the seafood platter. It’s like calamari frozen rings into the deep fryer served to you for rm78.Definitely not coming back.

Author: wing_winggggHong Kong, China
Title: Great bar and food
Review: This bar has good atmosphere and staff quickly serving up your drinks and food. They have a good food selection and quality was quite good.

Author: tsashi
Title: Nothing special
Review: Went the there last week with son. I was hoping for some good/best quality pastries and breads. But was not impressed by their choice. Perhaps when they initially opened the quality and choices were good, now more like average. Their drinks are good. Service prompt.

Author: samanthas792Singapore, Singapore
Review: Melaka is supposedly famous for chicken rice ball. Its just a gimmick sales & marketing that someone has created & made it famous - is to eat rice rolled into riceballs.The chicken is tough and taste just normal. Stir fried veg is tasteless.Don't bother wasting money & calories on this chicken rice balls. U may go try satay celup, cendol, nyonya food, street food - fried oyster etc

Author: limdarren
Title: Pretty much one of the best char siew in Klang Valley!
Review: The char siew is really great, that it melts in your mouth! The chicken is quite nice as well considering that is not their main attraction. Avoid going during lunch hours as the place usually packed and need to wait for quite some time.

Author: sher b
Title: Tasty but paid the price later
Review: Ordered aloo prontha, biryani, chicken and paneer. It was tasty, but had terrible diarrhoea day after. I strongly recommend for you to avoid this place. Everyone on the table had stomach upset! Seriously need to review their food cleanliness.

Author: ellBem
Title: Meh
Review: this restaurant was highly recommended by our hotel, and others, said to be the best seafood in Langkawi. We were pretty disappointed - the fish fillets were frozen, the noodles looked and tasted like 2 minute noodles, the vegetables tasteless and the prawns floury.

Author: Vincent DKL
Title: Terrible insulting service staff
Review: Called the place on 26.05.2016 for a reservation for 3 pax and specifically mentioned that I want Thai Food, the person at the other end informed me that he will arrange a table for 3 pax at the Thai Food area and informed that the reservation is confirmed, and he also informed me that just mention my name at the greeting counter and we will be seated accordingly. This is my first visit and I arrived at about 8:30 pm and my son was already hungry, at the main greeting counter informed the person that I have a reservation and gave my name.The person after checking took three of us and made us sit at a table which was set for 2 pax. He then gave us just one menu and went off to the next table to promote the food to a couple who just walked in after us!We had to wait for him to get back to us as the other staffs were either missing or busy helping other tables which was 3 or 4 occupied!When the waiter got back to us, I informed him that we wanted to order Thai Food and the menu is just about Vietnamese and Cambodian Food. The waiter got very angry and he was telling me that their food is almost same as Thai and it better than Thai food. Hey come on Thai is Thai, Vietnam is Vietnam, I was just confused and before I could say anything he was asking me why did I sit here as i should be sitting down stairs if I wanted Thai Food and I was lucky as they have not served the drinks yet as they would not allow me to change to Thai section.I told him I made a reservation and when I came in I gave my name and it was him after checking asked me to sit at this table and I told that I just want Thai Food and not any other food.He rudely asked me to get down and not to waste their time and went off, even without escorting us or to guide us the way to downstairs. Since my son was hungry I had to be patient and just walked down. At below there were just one occupied table and other tables were empty. They only had one waiter and he was busy attending to one occupied table and we were unsure where to sit as no was there to greet us.We waited almost 5 minutes and still no one came to us, actually there were no other staff except for that one waiter and some staffs inside the kitchen. We just left feeling disappointed, no point you guys having a place with great ambiance but with rude staffs. It is not easy to get there with KL traffic jam, and with such an attitude I wonder how you guys can showcase so many awards on your wall.

Author: alex-shapo87Berlin, Germany
Title: Fantastic food ! Not expensive and still luxury.
Review: Hidden secret place here on langkawi! For round about 20rm main course, which taste so awesome! If you are here, you should pass by with your partner/family etc! Nice chilly musik and very good atmosphere as well ... 15 min walk from cenang beach, fully worth it. Enjoy!

Author: WeiXiongL4
Title: Lousy Service
Review:
The boss and staff are having bad attitude... the service level is terrible ... not acceptable at all ... 

Environment is horrible ... dirty ...

Author: iloveperthMalaysia
Title: Not so awesome
Review: Visited last Saturday was greatly disappointed. It was overcrowded because they cater to bus load of tourists now. Their dishes are overpriced and mass cooked, has lost its authentic touch. Was told that this restaurant was sold but its name still remains.

Author: sheerinzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Slow
Review: IT took forever to get our meals . The 6 course meal took almost 2 hours And was often cold . And the actual food was a constant hit And Miss . Not Happy . Many customers around us were complaining . They Really need to work on their service .

Author: qiwen21
Title: Thumbs down for the breakfast set
Review: This is my first time trying in O'Galito. The breakfast set that consists of scramble eggs, 2 breads, 2 tiny sausages and a hash brown. All the ingredients cooked looks cheap and in a very small amount for its price. A very disappointed breakfast indeed.

Author: fifi_ceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible, rude, and the worst service in KL
Review: This is the worst customer service I have encountered in Kuala Lumpur or maybe in the WORLD.We went for lunch (group of 7 pax) to Samba restaurant.Ordered our set lunch. The appetizer and drink came immediately. Then, 3 main course we wait for more than 1 hour and asked several times to waiter / waitress.we asked waitress 1: "We have too much order,sir" (note: we are among the first customer arrived and the restaurant is not full, not even half full).Waitress 2: "Sorry, mem". (while friend asked why other customer already received food though they came late than us). The waitress just go and hide. waiter no. 3: "Sorry, we will bring in 5 minutes" (after 30 minutes still not shown).Finally, requested for bill and cancel the remaining order (**still receipt not coming).We just pay on the counter and asked to complain with floor manager.waitress XX(no guilty face or applogize) replied: "he hasn't come yet".Speechless with the attitude, rude, and bad customer service. Please close this restaurant, not worth at all. XXThank you.

Author: snakenovKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Place to Chit Chatting
Review: Nice hangout place for friends to gather and chit-chat. Even though the menu has plenty of food; for me I have difficulty to choose the food because I don't eat beef. There are a number of food with beef. They don't have table menu, you need to see from the giant 'black board' on the wall which I find too hard to see. They will ask you to see from their apps.

Author: Robert BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: nice location but average food
Review: went there during a weekday. The service was slow even if the place was not busy so that was disappointing. The food was just ok, the view was nice but there was a noisy family in the pool area so that took away from the experience

Author: Peter HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The worst owner in history! Avoid!
Review: Bought my tickets online a few days before the Zee Avi gig only to be told on arrival that there had been a mistake and there were no seats available! That was bad enough but the arrogance of the Mexican owner / Manager is beyond belief and suddenly it was all my fault. I had been looking so forward to this evening and it was totally ruined by first the ticketing fiasco and then the arrogance of the man. Best to avoid and go somewhere who knows how to a] sell tickets for seats that are actually available and b] to avoid the most arrogant obnoxious individual who makes it feel like it is your fault.

Author: Nicola W
Title: The best crepes and waffles!
Review: We visited My French Factory 5+ times in January for crepes and waffles!The service is great and food even better!Perfect for a treat after an evening meal! You can dine inside or outside.They also offer great drinks including homemade pink lemonade and Oreo milkshakes!Don't miss this place! My favourite was the banana crepe with Nutella and chocolate ice cream!

Author: Ricky_HK
Title: char kway teow  and laksa
Review: char kway teow  and laksa must try. only RM10 per dish. Very reasonable and tasty. Better than Madam Kwan's.

Author: Anny O
Title: Disappointed
Review: We decided to give it a try after the good recommendation from TripAdvisor.GOOD ambience but the food really out from our expectation.the carbonara really taste bad , the white sauce really plain no taste at all.Maybe we should not order their western food.The pizza just ok . service was slow and pricey.will not come back again .

Author: sKyf1ReSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: This was a good place. *WAS*. Still barely decent.
Review: Haven't been back here in almost 10 years. Place isn't as homely and friendly as before. Servers were snooty. Food was decently fine, not as good as when they first started. For a premium joint, they don't serve free drinking water which makes them look like some kucing kurap joint and that lost them a ⭐️. Mediocre service almost lost them another star. Decent food and generous portions was the only plus point. Will be back here..... probably in another 10 years. Will not recommend.

Author: Renganathan
Title: Not value for money and time at all
Review: Very bad experience.... Just 2 crazy meals cost us RM 265 ;( I don't recommend this restaurant... We wanted to try French but its very poor... Italian and Spanish food is way much better....

Author: Jerry K
Title: Overrated!
Review: The ambience was reminiscence an olden Chinese eating place.But two things marred our experience. The patchy and poor attentiveness of wait staff and the food. The beef rendang was tough, the lobak was cold, the taste of the chap chye was poor.Once is enough.

Author: Ian_CHEONG
Title: Dated cafe run down by rubbish environment
Review: Aging waiters are awaiting retirement. Dark and dingy parking spots behind is a potential pickpocket hazard! Food wise, nothing great unless u love the colonial smoky environment

Author: amandaaV5842YXKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner @ Iketeru
Review: Nice and delicious food!! The Salmon teriyaki was nicely grilled and still juicy inside. The medium well Tenderlion was great, the Salmon salad was amazing and the Dragon Maki was just nice. A bit packed and noisy on Saturday night since a lot of groups gathering during this CNY festive season..

Author: CindytkySingapore, Singapore
Title: 5 star dishes with 5 star price
Review: Went there in the evening of weekday, not crowded at all therefore we got full attention from their lovely waiter. Polite and attentive. Dishes were all delicious especially the roast chicken. A must try dish. However, I find it over priced especially for the rice. A bowl of steam rice at RM5.66 is quite ridiculous although I understand that we're having dinner in Hilton. Suggested order a plate of fried rice that could share among everyone. Ambiance was really good.. we took a lot of photos in the restaurant. I would recommend this restaurant but bear in mind if you don't have any member voucher for discount and you have more than 5 persons you might need to spend more RM400 for a decent meal.

Author: AK2116
Title: Nothing Special
Review: Very overrated restaurant, you can get all the food served here at the next door 'mamak'. Nothing sets them apart. So I don't get all the hype it's not like they trademarked a special sauce.

Author: Timbermad
Title: Great food!
Review: Among my favourite but a bit run down. But still ok & pricewise was ok compared to the ones in shopping complex. We eat with 23pax.

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Just go there for the foods..
Review: Suddenly, feel like trying something new on this midweek .. park the car opposite Underwater Langkawi and walk across the road. We are the only customers on that night, and friendly greeted by the owner (husband & wife) at the entrance. Ordered few dishes recommended. Seafood platter is abit out, beef grilled platter was delicious, Korean pancake was not too bad, chicken/onion soup is tasty, bimbimbap rice is nice, egg omelete is normal. Overall, foods are not bad... but just the foods. The lacking is the atmosphere and ambiance...

Author: jenlimmmmKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Appalling
Review: This review is long over due and to be fair I cannot review the food because I didn't end up having any. So please continue reading this review if you are interested in their monster poor service.1. Inconvenient- would only accept reservations in person and a hefty upfront payment, I had to pay up RM 500 bucks for a reso for 6 pax.2. Unprofessional- They were unprepared and when I made the physical trip to pay up the deposit they told me the receipt machine wasnt working and asked me to come back later. As if I had nothing better to do. Then after arguing with them that its ridic I had to make another trip for a receipt of my deposit they said they'd whatsapp the invoice once their manager got in. No need to say, they did not. As RM 500 bucks was quite a sum (atleast to me) I was not at ease until a receipt was issued, so I made the trip back. They're reacted to my dissatisfaction unkindly and told me they were busy "it's lunch time miss, how to send you?". Sorry but this 'reason' or more like excuse was beyond ridic. They weren't even full.. so I really could not understand the logic.- Needless to say I demanded the deposit back and cancelled the reservation. They ping pong-ed amongst the staffs who to attend to me, with each staff asking me what did I want. With no internal communication. Finally one of them returned my money and IN TENS AND TWENTIES. Safe to say I will NEVER return to such a restaurant with poor staff etiquette nor recommend this place to ANYONE.

Author: KyraTaylorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A concerto in your mouth
Review: Dewakan brings world-class fine dining to a restaurant in the middle of nowhere (in Glenmarie). Some may scoff at its high price, but think of it like paying for a concerto in your mouth. Dewakan takes Malaysian ingredients and local flavours and presents it in spectacular fashion. You will never think of Malaysian cuisine in the same way again after eating here. The service crew are all well-trained and better than a lot of so-called high-class establishments in KL. Well worth the drive deep into Glenmarie and well worth the price. Thanks, Chef Darren!

Author: LeeCheah
Title: 1st time and will sure come again!!
Review: Hoooochiak!! Nice and very good!! Will surely come again and recommend to my frenz and family! Worthy.

Author: notfussy2012
Title: The only difference is the dipping sauce
Review:
we visited the satay shop just few days back in Malacca.
The taste of the satay was ok. The sauce contained more pineapple and thus different from what we have in Singapore.  Overall still prefer Singapore satay and our thick peanut sauce.

Author: John KJamberoo, Australia
Title: A gem of a place for Yum Cha
Review: Do not be put off by lack of menu or signs in English. When the food comes the staff can tell you what they are. The pork dumplings we delicious as were most of the dishes. WE loved it so much we went 2 days running. Hard to better this place for a Yum Cha breakfast and it will not break the bank

Author: AChee74Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Old school
Review: They opening from the morning until late at night.,You can try a lot of local cuisine here. The satay and the fishball soup is famous in the afternoon while in the morning, try the Laksa, Kolo mee and Kueh chap. At night, try the fish soup

Author: kimlkimfdPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Chillax
Review: Food was okay, the waiter was super friendly and atmosphere is chilling :) they have piano for you to play as well ! (And yes they sometimes have performers coming at night !) Ordered their salted egg fried bitter gourd Hainanise Chicken chop Fish and chips Fried beehon All are 3/5

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food not up to expectations
Review: Had looked forward to dining at the restaurant after learning it has a Certificate of Excellence Award from Tripadvisor. The location is on Armenian Street, 2 doors away from Yap Kongsi/Clan House. The decor here is Peranakan Malay. The restaurant is clean and tastefully furnished. We each ordered a different rice and meat dish and shared our food. We also ordered Armenian salad and cucur udang as starters. The cucur udang was really nice. We ordered briyani rice, herbal lemuni rice, tomato rice and pandan rice. The rice cooked in various styles were light and well cooked. The 2 styles of chicken, a vegetarian and the fish dishes were average but their curries/gravy were all rather bland. We also had 4 desserts to share. The pineapple and coconut tart was too sweet and with no fresh pineapple scent, semolina and creme caramel as well as the sago pudding were good. The chef and service staff were all very friendly but we were served by a new staff who got some of our orders wrong. Pricing is on the high side. Food not up to expectations. All in an average rating.

Author: sulochiniPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Ok ok
Review: Firstly, based on the reviews I expected a much better experience and taste:*Ice lemon tea and honey lemon most probably didnt contain lemon or honey.*The mutton biryani: I expected aomething more Pakistani. This was very Malaysian.Should not have been served with fish curry.*The good stuff: the raita, the mutton, the waiters, ambience

Author: Mila_ShahloKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food, cozy environment
Review: Usually one of my fav place if i go to changkat area. Lovely place, music and staff are super friendly. Food is very tasty here, chef really knows how to cook delicious foods. Desert also yummy, lemon pie. Love their crispy spicy prawn and lady have wine promo here. Highly recommend the place.

Author: theexplorer0203
Title: Mill Cafe
Review: Had a great dinner in this restaurant, service from Harris was good. The food was superb! We love how the buffet was set up, some of the food you have to order and will make freshly cook for you. It was an enjoyable night with my friend. Would love to come back again next time. Highly recommended!

Author: Mark M
Title: Food is better quality than the service
Review: Good food with decent pricing. You have to flag down the wait staff whenever you need something, including your main dish in the event that they forget or the kitchen gets backed up.

Author: SeanFarrell1791Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Miri Marriot Malaysia
Review: What a wonderful hotel, we stayed here 3 nights 26th 27th & 28th December 2016, hotel good, ameneties good, pools for us and children good, kids club with crafts and films and games etc is good, room was good, staff were great, nothing too much trouble, we had an issue with a food item which was very quickly rectified by the food and beverage manager, (he was 2 days into his new post, but was quick to act, satisfactorily) He will no doubt be poached by another hotel before long, what a wonderful man, a credit to the hotel.Thank you

Author: danielcY6181JZJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Wide range of choices.
Review: Visited the restaurant for a change of our usual dinner fare. From the many choices on the menu, the four of us ordered different naan with chicken tikka masala and a palak paneer to share. The food was a little cold when served but taste, while not spectacular, was pleasant. The paneer was a little too firm from what I am used to. Waiting staff were polite but was hesitant when asked for recommendations. Service was slow considering that there were only three tables dining there on this occasion. Prices were mid-range.

Author: williamg216
Title: Breakfast in KUL
Review: Great breakfast good coffee and excellent service at  reasonable price.   Small but nice.   Recommended.   We had full 'american' breakfast and enjoyed.

Author: aishwariyah
Title: Terrible Experience
Review: These people ruined our Xmas eve dinner. We were made to wait for 1.5hrs for our food. We did not make a fuss as it was the eve of Christmas and the place was busy but what put us off was that these people were unreasonably rude and arrogant. We were told after 60mins that the chef can only go "table by table" and there were 4 more tables to be served before us. I asked if they could just serve us 3 bowls of plain rice and 1 simple vege dish so the children could start eating first while we wait but was very rudely told off by the lady who runs the place that she cannot "disturb" her chef. We carried on waiting patiently and after 1.5 hrs we realised that the 4 tables before ours were not served yet and we decided to leave. I made my way to the cashier to pay for the soft drinks we had ordered earlier and the man at the counter ,also someone who runs the place, was unhappy that we were leaving. He held on to my 50 ringgit note and refused to give me my change until we gave him an explanation about why we were leaving. We were then told that they only had 1 chef. I then told them that they should downsize and not try to serve more than 25 or 30 tables at a go with just 1 chef in the kitchen. The rude lady then came up to us and simply rolled her eyes and walked away when she learnt that we were cancelling our order.This place deserves no rating or good reviews. A food business that treats their customers so badly should not be supported at all.

Author: jiaxuan_5541
Title: Cockroach spotted and rude chef!
Review: I was dining in Cafe BLD on the 22nd February night for the international buffet dinner. Saw a cockroach crawling around near the Roast duck station. Immediately informed the female chef who was making sushi nearby. The female chef then informed another male chef (the head chef i believed). The male chef then came over but did not take any action and walked away shortly. I am utterly disappointed. This is not the attitude I am expecting from a 5 stars hotel. In addition to that, the food was below average. Grilled salmon was too dry, satay was cold, dessert and juices were too sweet.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: sharifah_ahmadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Charcoal Grilled Chicken !
Review: The chicken was grilled to perfection . The cheese banana was great too . The sambal condiment was spicy and yet surprisingly addictive . The place radiates calm and peaceful ambience. There seems to be 2 rooms separated , the air-conditioning room and the normal fan open air seating arrangement. The service is fast. The server were attentive but somehow lacks good communication. We were given a menu and then, the girl went over after passing us a piece of paper for us to wrote our order. One male server were very attentive and explained what's good and not. Would definitely came here again on the next trip to Kuching. .

Author: Alex C
Title: average spread of food
Review: plenty of buffet diners, mostly of participants from seminars during lunch hour.  nothing spectacular.  but decent place for a reasonable meal within CBD area

Author: reese kSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Food great but.....
Review: My friends and I decided to try this place after the great reviews we had read. We really enjoyed the food. Tasty and plentiful. Do try the midin salad - superb. But..... we were very disappointed with the service. We were made to wait for a substantial amount of time before anyone bothered to give us the menus. Then our orders were taken by an unsmiling waitress and served without a word by an equally moody waitress. Halfway the meal, our polite request for a glass of warm water was met with a waitress who rolled her eyes upwards as if irritated by the request. It's not as if it was free, we were charged RM1 for it. We were neither thanked when we paid the bill nor wished a pleasant evening as we were leaving the place. But other than that, we had an enjoyable dinner.

Author: LuisHdezJ
Title: Flavor explosion!!!!
Review: Great dishes full of flavored perfectly combined to procure the best culinary experience. This very Indian place provides an ambience full of style. Great job guys.

Author: spud1001
Title: great spot to watch the world go by
Review: Good place to hang out and watch the world go by, cold beers and pleasant food. Good music on a couple of occasions we were there

Author: Debbiegoh1984Malaysia
Title: SHOCKING SERVICE ATTITUDE
Review: This is not the first time we visit Carabao, and we were satisfied with their service and food as always previously. Hence, today we went again to celebrate my boyfriend's birthday and this is what had happened...We ordered 3 coconut drinks and the coconut flesh are as hard as stone and I could barely scoop any of the flesh out. We have tried the other 2 and both are the same, so we didn't touch at all on the third one. They agreed to change the last coconut upon our request. However, they refused to change the other two for us because WE HAVE TASTED THE COCONUT. (Can I ask a question, how can you scoop the flesh without drinking the juice?) So, what they mean is if we have not tasted the coconut, they will put back the OLD HARD coconut back to the fridge and sell to the next customer AGAIN!!!! So, be careful when you ordered the coconut, it may be rejected coconuts from the previous customers. They even ask me to go into their kitchen to pick my own YOUNG coconut, so that CUSTOMER NEED TO BEAR THEIR OWN RISK! Meaning if you were to order Coconut in Carabao, you need to be professional in picking coconut to avoid getting a OLD HARD coconut.LAST BUT NOT THE LEAST, they even ask me whether AM I A SINGAPOREAN? I think this should not be a question to be asked. So what if I am a Singaporean and so what if I am not???? They advise us not to visit their shop anymore next time if we were to so persistent on the youth of the COCONUT. Those stated above is fact without personal judgement. Please assess the quality of the restaurant yourself as a reader.

Author: alvintinglh
Title: My ever first time worst buffet
Review: My ever first time worst buffet in my life, all empty even though no crowd, all cheap and value food, complimentary drink is ice water, buffet so short and all repeated. Super poor standard

Author: yumickey
Title: delicious
Review:
Very good cafe.
I visited every night.
Especially I recommend steam boat.
There is a menu in Japanese.

Author: nickc224
Title: Poor
Review: Sadly this didn't live up to what i expected. service was good but the food was average at best, very disappointing

Author: Wander824802
Title: Surprise Birthday Celebration
Review: First of all, this is one of the MUST VISIT place in kuching! Lastweek I contacted the owner to organize a small birthday surprise. She was kind and helpful enough to help me with all of the arrangement. She was patient enough to list down, explaining the menu for me based on the budget given and gave me a very reasonable price as well. Everything went so well and the food was amazing! I requested food for 6 pax and all of us ate till our stomach was almost burst! The portion definitely is worth the price. The tomato crispy noodle, curry chicken with fried mantou, the masak hitam, ginger chicken is a must must must! And also dont forget to try their kuih muih platter! By far the nicest kuih i ever had jn kuching. The food in LimaTujoh is one of the nicest and most authentic nyonya cuisine you can have in kuching. It definetly brings back memories I had in Melaka. A rare gem in kuching indeed! we’ll be coming back for more!Feel free to contact the owner (jessica) if you need any help or question. Don’t worry she is one of the nicest and friendliest person you will ever meet.

Author: Sarah E
Title: Not what I requested
Review: We were excited to visit however were left utterly disappointed. I had requested no meat ONLY Chicken Breast but were served Chicken thigh with skin. I knew instantly this was the case so did my Husband but he tried to convince me other wise. We then continued the experience which was now ruined for me. After dessert was served it appeared the waiting staff had forgotten us and the table next to us were served main course and dessert before our waitress came back to us. Being in the dark it is difficult to contact your server. Maybe a device on the table to call a Waiter would be a good idea. I later spoke with manager who could only offer us a complimentary drink. Not really satisfactory.

Author: ck kSingapore
Title: Monday lunch At Manis
Review: Was leaving Malacca on a Monday so thought we'd try (again) to give the Nonya food in Melaka a chance. Googled and saw this nearest to our location. Went for it. Positives - parking is not difficult along the roadnear to Swiss Garden hotel clean place the ayam bakaluak was a winner, authentic enoughNegatives staff not very personal, cold AC and cold servicefood quality average food quantity per serving is a little lacking

Author: James_60156
Title: Dirty restaurant
Review: The dirtiest restaurant I have ever seen. Flies are everywhere and they don’t clean the table properly.

Author: Nishant2029
Title: Loved their Chicken-Biryani
Review: I had only Chicken Biryani. And i have no doubts saying it was the best Biryani I ever had.  It's a must try for non-vegetarians.

Author: kawaii40San Diego, California
Title: Overpriced!
Review: We were craving for American food so ended up here. The food was eatable- at least. The burgers were a little saggy. The fajita is salty. The price was ridiculous. More expensive than in the U.S.

Author: 475vladimirm
Title: A wonderful restaurant of Malay cuisine!
Review:
Not a flashy, but very cozy design. Good service.
Very tasty dishes of local cuisine.
Not a bad wine list.
Be sure to try at the end of the evening ice cream from durian!

Author: Barry S
Title: Great Atmosphere
Review: Lively and warm welcome always greets us at Souled Out..good varied menu ..a little more expensive than the  average in KL but worth it for the atmosphere.  Spacious  and nice decor.

Author: Federico Z
Title: Not impressed
Review: Not impressed at all, hummus tasted acid, lamb and chicken very boring. Too many similar food concepts on the strip and much better choice. Not going to come again.

Author: Karis SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Waste of time & money
Review: Went to Sutera outlet and really regret it. Ordered both grilled and fried chicken chop and standard is worst than average. Potato is soggy and soaked in oil. Coleslaw is worst than fast food and black pepper sauce is thick gravy only with some coarse peppercorn. So called wild mushroom soup at rm6.90 but it is just canned soup with more chopped button mushroom. Overall great disappointment and will not eat again even if it is free.

Author: Graham_and_Susan414Hua Hin, Thailand
Title: Worth A Visit
Review: Stopped here for a few drinks in Happy hour and decided to sample the fish and chips, the fish and chips were excellent. The staff were great and I would like to mention Najja, who we had a good conversation with she was efficient and made us feel very welcome. We will definitely return on our next visit in January. Based on our experience we can recommend this to anybody.

Author: FWFSIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Appalling Service and Terrible Attitude
Review: In the past, the service has been at least decent but it has gone from average to terrible! During my last visit which was just last week, we were first greeted with a disclaimer that we should choose to go if we could not wait due to the crowd. As far as my eye could see, there were only hardly seven tables and only about four tables that had not been served. So with patience, we waited for about 45 minutes. Then there was a commotion and loud argument exchanged between the kitchen chefs and the waitress. The commotion disrupted our peace and the serenity of the ambiance. A table behind us which had just been seated for a few minutes was being served with drinks and food. The table before us and our crowd were taken aback as to why the patron after us was being served. I stood up and queried the waiter and he just rudely dismissed me and told me that I had the option either to leave or wait. His attitude and treatment towards us as patron was demeaning! I was asking a valid question and would have been pacified if he could just apologize for the mix up etc or at least have the courtesy to inform me how much waiting time is expected. I would take my business elsewhere since I was not welcomed. Such attitude is unacceptable.Not a place to recommend if you expect that the service quality to commensurate with the price of the food and ambiance of the place.

Author: dimsum088Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Overall the food was pretty average. The Caesar salad with foie gras bits was a disappointment. Looks and taste like normal Caesar salad but priced at 4X higher. The Hokkaido scallop was so so. The only decent item was the tomahawk - succulent and nicely done. Lobster pasta was nice but wait till you see the price tag! It was shockingly expensive. Ambiance was good but the interior decor was a little old school and nothing to shout about. One good thing about the restaurant is that they have 2 private rooms so if you want a little privacy, the place is great.

Author: Thomas T
Title: Fishball Noodle
Review: Fresh and delicious home-styled fishball noodles. Thoroughly enjoyed the meal. Owner/chef is a friendly guy. Will go back for more.

Author: femiknitterBangkok, Thailand
Title: Best Indian food on the island!
Review: This is definitely the best Indian food you'll get in Penang. It's a simple an unassuming restaurant with such delicious food. I've eaten there many times when I visit Penang and I'll keep going back, it's that good. It's cheap and consistent so definitely check it out when you're in Batu. They have pizza and other Western options if you're with people who don't like Indian food.

Author: MMJCPACanton, Ohio
Title: Good for Tourists
Review: Thirty8 is in the Grand Hyatt on the 38th floor with an impressive 360 degree view of KL including the Petronas Towers. The restaurant has floor to ceiling windows all the way around the entire level so most tables have a good view. Some tables view the Petronas Towers, others view the KL skyline and the open style kitchen in the center of the restaurant. Being in the Hyatt hotel, the menu has an OK selection of Chinese, Japanese and Western dishes to satisfy tourists. The wine list is good but the menu is fairly basic and not exceptionally creative for the prices. The ambience and service were very nice, and the open style kitchen was fun to watch. It was a fairly easy walk for us from the Sky walk but a little confusing as there are not many signs for the Hyatt at street level and the hotel reception is on the 37 floor, then a separate elevator or stairs up one level to the restaurant. No complaints about our experience, just being in KL for only a few nights, we would have preferred more creative dishes for our dining option. Although the view is unique to KL, we did not travel that far to eat what we can eat in the US. The atmosphere at Thirty8 was good with a nice view, good service and good food, but I would not recommend as a top destination in KL for "great food".

Author: ChinS246
Title: Overpriced!
Review: Overpriced for this restaurant!! foods so so, Lamb Loin was Dry and there is no complimentary cake or dessert for birthday celebration...not about the dessert price but it doesn't feel any warmth and welcoming...Besides, I have called to make reservation at The Big Group HQ and I have asked whether i'm able to make reservation via Big Group and the lady said YES...Then, she said will send me a confirmation via email, I have waited a day and yet to receive any email from Big Group so I decided to called to BEAST, and the person said the system doesn't show any reservation under my name. C'mmon...is RIDICULOUS!

Author: Visha1616
Title: Amazing
Review:
Really nice, cozy joint. Amazing coffee and pastries too! I tried the Caramel cake and it was the best cake I've had. 
Parking was very convenient too.
Will definitely come back :)

Author: 325abadya
Title: Aljubail industrial city
Review:
The trip was very good and the restaurant was clean and organized
Thanks Nabil 
Jeet 
You are very help full and welcoming people

Author: Deslim
Title: Salty and Mediocre
Review:
Food (egg omellete and soup) was very salty. Very disapointed as this a family trip and we had looked forward to good nonya food. What a dampenener.

Other dishes were nomal and not nonya in essence. Not recommended.

Author: MsL431971
Title: So so
Review: First time here. Was invited for a private function. Was not impressed with the in-your-face mural and photographs on the wall to remind you that it is an Italian restaurant.Did not enjoy my starter of pomodoro e mozzarella salad. Of poor quality.Rissotto with a bit of shaved truffles was fairly good.No one came to top up my glass of water at all.Have had better risotto and pasta at another restaurant in Kuala Lumpur. At Sage Gardens Mall. Go try it!

Author: LoveTravel826496Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food but service have to improve alot
Review: One of my favourite place to dien in , only fo rthe food, eventually the service as been provide by team can be improve away to better, food as arrived after few minutes later drink arrived, its quite pricey also, at saem time the service determine the food quailty, 10% service as been charge but there's no any effiecient service as been provide by the team , its will be great if there's any Food & beverage trainer to train this team at least thier knows fundamental basic things about service. Kudas to chef to nailed it the food

Author: AcidHurtsKL
Title: Service, Environment & Food Quality Bad....
Review: Our family have went to The Loaf at Langkawi & was very satisfied.Thus though of visiting The Pavillion branch, disappointed the quality.Waiter attitude, Bread over toast, The Ceiling show obvious leakageIf it is not located at prime area still fine... Prime Entrance Location...

Author: AMPW4London
Title: Incredible food
Review: Beautiful food in a stunning setting....it has a twist as it set by the beach and the floor is sand. You can kick your show off before you go in. Don't worry they have these fab jet air hoses for blowing away the sand on your feet before you put your shoe on.

Author: Marianne C
Title: Decent omakase
Review: Had the omakase with sushi and teppanyaki. Sushi and sashimi were good as they were really fresh, but the teppanyaki was so-so for the price. Told the waitress I didn't want squid but still was served squid and had to request for a change. Oribe, Sushi Azabu and Ginza Sushimasa were much better for omakase.

Author: n_jaswantSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value for money
Review: A basic and pretty straightforward restaurant offering non-veg and veg thali.Spacious and clean restaurant, tasty food and the best part is the restaurant staff always have smile on their face.Do visit this Indian Restaurant when walking around Little India.We enquired and came to know this hotel doesn’t serve ala carte.Dosa was also not available (although few revies have mentioned).Pickle and papad were great add-on

Author: 264dennisz
Title: Try somewhere else
Review: It was not what we expected. We were graving for some 'western food'. But the bread from the panini was terrible. The pizza was very poor and had an instant bottom. Hope they improve their western cooking skills because the atmosphere was pretty ok.

Author: babyeugKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Elegant but affordable restaurant in Kuala Lumpur
Review: It was an unforgettable experience with my fiancee dining in this kind of simple but elegant restaurant.. Food so good with affordable prices, you can imagine like you truly in Spain.. Service is excellent.. I 100% recommend this restaurant to any traveler who may be goes to kuala Lumpur for vacation.. Just try it and you will see for yourself..

Author: Joan WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Buffet Spread
Review: Quite a good buffet spread. Some of the highlights are the oysters, sashimi, very very fresh prawns, grilled prawns. I think seafood lovers will love this place. I, however, enjoyed the chinese and indian cuisine namely biryani, dahl, and roasted chicken. I absolutely loved the bread pudding dessert.

Author: ngtpengSingapore
Title: Over price
Review: I agree with one of the reviewers, forget this joint. Our dinner came up to RM250 for a few pieces of sashimi, cuttlefish, oyaku don and chirashi. After paying the bill, we rushed to Sea Good to complete our dinner.Probably for hygiene reasons, Minoru sushi chef put on a pair of gloves whilst making sushi but I have not seen a Japanese sushi chef wearing gloves.

Author: Big_ChilliThalwil, Switzerland
Title: Great staff
Review: Very good service. Attentive and friendly. The food was very good and served in a timely manner. I can highly recommend this restaurant. Very well visited by the Indian community which gives me the belief that it is very authentic. I can recommend this restaurant if you are in KL and need to satisfy a craving for great Indian cuisine.

Author: sekc2017
Title: Poor quality
Review: Not as delicious as 15 years ago. The stall was mend by workers..not the owner. And even the condiments of cendol finished, they still sell, compromising the quality.

Author: Bill AArlington, Virginia
Title: Nice "Americanized" cafe
Review: You gotta have a love/hate feeling about places like this (and all tourist destinations have them) where the local cuisine has been repackaged just enough to be "easy" and comfortable to Western tourists. These places are always slightly more expensive but feel enough like home that they are subconsciously attractive. Geographer Cafe is no exception. Wonderful American "oldies" are played quite loudly from midday until late a night. Simple menu designed not to really challenge unadventurous, tourist palates but still give the illusion of being overseas. That said, I confess I had a nice latte and chicken sate here, but resisted the urge to keep playing it safe and happily ventured to other places (like Nancy's).

Author: TheChoobsSelangor, Malaysia
Title: The only word for it - Over-rated
Review: There was this hype that was going on about the Jibs, so one fine afternoon I decided to join the cue. I wouldn't say is all that bad.Service - They looked absolutely confused. And even with walkies there seem to be miscommunication. So I would say overall service would be in between "lacking" and "horrible".Food - Ordered their big breakfast and so called ultimate burger. Big breakfast - Sausages and bacon came out alright but i guess who could praise that. Mushroom was tasted average, eggs were soggy, toast were barely toasted. Ultimate Burger - Upon arrival, I thought order came wrongly. Size was phathetic and there is zero elements of it being ultimate.In summary, the food it's in somewhere in between "embarrassing" to "a disgrace" with a hint of "frustrating".However, you'll be able to capture good looking food pics here though.Price - Don't get me started. One of the biggest regret, I could have actually gotten a proper brunch for 1 quarter the price. I felt something in between "being used" and "being ripped off".Environment - Deco and layout was cozy and comfortable. Looks really awesome for everyone else. But I was seated at a corner where my chair has only 2 inches of movement space. I had to shift the table to stand up. Overall, I would highly recommend all to come here. It's not everyday you suffer and feel the pain of making a terrible mistake. PS: The photo looks good because the food was actually very well garnished. And also because I am good food-o-grapher. Do not be confused and think it's actually good.

Author: Hussin S
Title: Good service
Review: The service and foods was quite good however the environment and outlet set up was not impressive.  The roti canai gravy is giid but quite salty, the portion of mee sapi can be eat by 2 pax but taste good.

Author: afiqzambriKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Upscale version of Pappa Rich / Old Town White Coffee
Review: Pros:1. Staff was very helpful and welcoming2. Place is very clean3. Have a private room that can sit 10 pax4. Food arrived quick, within 10 minutes of orderingCons:1. Staff did not suggest anything on the menu, being a first timer here I would like some introduction of the best selling items2. Some of the food items are quite overpriced for me

Author: Steff_kh
Title: Dining Sunday lunch
Review:
Great food with nice ambience
A lovely Sunday spend in a nice ambience cafe while dining with family, what more to ask! Reasonable price with great food and drink!

Author: karienj_12Ibiza, Spain
Title: Not so tasty
Review: The location is okay but there is not much flavor in the food. I shared a salad and the fish and chips. Maybe not the best choice. In the salad there was too much mayonnaise and the battery of the fish was without any taste. Would not come back here.

Author: Cathy A
Title: Fantastic restaurant. Wonderful food and extremely attentive attentive service.
Review: I booked this restaurant after reading reviews on trip advisor. It didn't disappoint. The food was absolutely stunning. Every dish was beautifully presented with amazing flavours. The host was very attentive and interesting to chat to. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting KL.

Author: rekria
Title: Wide variety and value for money
Review:
Located just behind hotel Grand Paragon,  this little gem serves up a good selection of food which are affordable and tasty.
