Recommendations:
Hong Kee BBQ chicken wings 
Sin Kee Ikan bakar
Meng Fang Kway teow kia 
Thai food 
Tampoi satay

Author: Itravel0ne
Title: Hang out place
Review: While in Miri this is a nice place to hang out with friends or family. Tasty food and good price. Nice environment for a good relaxation.

Author: yeoc468Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: Reached the restaurant early and was brought to a waiting lounge and ordered sparkling water. No other service staff came to us to present us with a menu or wine list until I have to ask.Ambience of this place is a good typical steakhouse with good view of twin tower, although not as good as from my suite at Hyatt.For the international prices they are charging food quality falls a little short.Services also fall short of a good steakhouse. The waiter who took our order did not repeat and reconfirmed our order and thus messed up one order. He was so over confident of himself and even attempts to tell us that he was correct. He is more suitable to work in a burger joint. No apologies from anyone for this mistake.Later they messed up our birthday cake too. One staff told us that we cannot use sparkling candles, so we told her that we will have our cake and champagne when we return to our hotel. At the end of our lunch, the cake came out with the sparkling candles lighted up. What a messed up and no apologies from anyone again.I would recommend all of you to skip this place at all cost unless you are entertaining a corporate guest who only goes for the ambience.

Author: Simon Y
Title: Go for the Ribs, not the Environment
Review: As I stepped into the restaurant, I was greeted by a lovely waitress who then brought my friend and I through a rough introduction of their menu.Despite the friendly customer service, I had a hard time placing my order. Instead of taking my order and processing it right away, I had to queue up at the counter to pay.I'm not saying that this is an abnormal practice in modern day cafés nowadays, but seeing as there's already not much space for walking around, I don't think having your customers take up space standing in line to pay is a good idea. I lined up, only to find that that's not the designated queue up line. To make matters worse, I had to wait doubly long since the cashier prioritized other patrons and let them pay before me. Just as I thought it's not going to be a good day, the ribs turned it around. It was awesome as recommended. The meat falls off the bones nicely, and the marinade is really tasty.My friend and I ordered pulled pork with rice, chewbwakka with wholemeal bread and some cheesy fries as well, but unfortunately, I would only return for the ribs.

Author: Bertrand A
Title: Needs to improve on their service
Review: We decided to eat indoors at the Big Apple Restaurant, it has a very nice view, but very slow service.

Author: CarolM157Launceston, Australia
Title: Could find better elsewhere
Review: Wanted something close to our hotel and decided to try this. Menu looked OK. I had spaghetti and meatballs was ok, my husband had snitzel. Couldn't decide if it was cooked on the inside but was very dark on the outside. Could find better places to eat next time.

Author: YudiS397Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Reasonable Dim Sum
Review: It is a good dim sum place for the dim sum foodie. Has a decent range and reasonably well done. Service is prompt and friendly. Parking can be a challenge being in the heart of Kota Kemuning but where there is good food hungry stomachs go. Cannot beat Ipoh dim sum but in case of dim sum emergency, this is the place to go.

Author: Gracie OBatu Ferringhi, Malaysia
Title: breathtaking view
Review: beautiful view and romantic place for dining , one of the stunning view in KLCC , Drinks  and food are expensive but you are paying for the views really. It has undeniably beautiful views that are very hard to beat, but that no doubt is the best part about this place.

Author: tripwithjeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Makes your tummy dance
Review: The food is superb, I’m very very impressed with the flavours and presentation of the food. The cocktails were also very nicely made. As for service, I think it would help if staff were to ask if it’s your first time visiting for them to do recommendations on portions and pairings as soon as they hand over the menu to customers. Overall, good ambience and music. A place that I’ll definitely go again. Though the price is leaning on the expensive side, it’s well worthy for the quality and overall experience.

Author: Ameer S
Title: Good food, great ambience
Review: Good selection of food and tasty.  Friendly and professional staff however the cost was slightly pricey though.

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Avoid Food
Review: The drink Zonin Italian merlot RM120. 3 pints of tiger RM50. Great deal on the street.Food is a big let down. Best bit is the fried chicken. But how can you go wrong. Meatball gravy is good. Meatball is small. Like caviar size. The worst thing is battered calamari. The picture will show you how much we been ripped off. Small calamari with double portion steak of batter. Vile! Tabasco sauce help.We walked pass back door from Ramada hotels. About 10 mouse cage lying around not appetising.

Author: raysonraySingapore, Singapore
Title: Not a fine dining restaurant.
Review: This place is a very simple restaurant. Not the posh one. It jas no a/c. The menu is basically white rice and veg and non veg. Briyani only on fridays and weekends. Tiffin only at specific hours. Service is lousy. Some.dishes are cold. Some are tasty.i won't recommend.

Author: sunsetskr
Title: Overrated
Review: On a recent visit to KL, we decided to try out this restaurant after having read all the positive reviews. Unfortunately, we were very disappointed as it did not live up to its reviews.The pizza we ordered was fairly bland. The base was very thin and crispy (like burnt dough) and you couldn't taste the toppings. The pizza was not genuine Italian.

Author: Jian Chen T
Title: It's just average if you had tried once
Review: Well,it would be a big shock experience for anyone who hasnt try satay celup before. The sauce is awesome, but the selection of sticks are like normal stuff. So you definitely have to try it if you never check it out!

Author: SoonC72
Title: Another better cafe
Review: Cosy environment and creative food to be served...strongly recommend for hanging out especially for couples

Author: SimoneOngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice view and snack is nice
Review: Not a good place for me to chill as is too hot for me. Maybe is not at the high floor, is only at 12th floor. Prefer Vertigo banyan tree KL. The swimming pool is super duper small, if at 1st W make it like infinity pool i think will be better. Is wasted for the twin towers view.Order 4 snack to sharing with friends, all is tasty. We order fries, fried squid, fried prawn and 1 named "WTF", this all is really tasty for us. But the drinks we order taste is so so, as we all don't drink any alcohol drinks, so we just order juice. Mango and orange.As we see all customer pics is very nice but in real is really under my expectation, a little bit disappointed.

Author: Eddie_YeoKuching, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special
Review: It used to be a local budget street fiod but due to years if tourist poured in, have made it the expensive street food. The local doesn't cook but employed foreign workers to do it instead.However, there is one stall, my favourite one who still maintain its traditional taste of Curry Mee which price at only RM7, do check my photos attached
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: samanthas792Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good breakfast
Review: I stayed at the service apartments next door at Somerset Ampang. Breakfast was provided by the hotel at Soul Out. Decent breakfast with a variety of freshly baked bread, salads, cold cuts, 2 asian hots, 2 western hots, freshly brew coffee, tea, juices, milkTried the Sang Har Mien & Singapore fried beehoon from the ala-carte. Taste good too.

Author: gowrin2014
Title: Rude waiters, a definite last visit!
Review: 11th July 2017 was and will be my last visit to this outlet. Food is nothing rave about. Service sucks to the max! 1. When my friend requested for fork & spoon,the waiter ask us to use our hand. 2. When we ask for a certain item that is on the menu available after 3pm on wekend, he said it will be very very late and maybe not available. No proper answer with a gangsta attitude. 3. When we ask to seperate the bill, the waiter ask us to count on our own.Your food pricing just not justify your service and attitude!

Author: Jerry HKuching, Malaysia
Title: So-so. Not worth the price
Review: I had lamb shank, hawaiian pizza and the taste was quite bad for its price. The lamb is not soft enough and the hawaiian pizza (one of their best seller pizza) was not up to standard (quite tasteless and the whole pizza felt really dry).Despite having all these said, the carbonara is considered quite ok but there are better ones out there.

Author: Angelo F
Title: Food not authentic italian
Review:
My wife had spaghetti carbonara and was too creamy I had sea bass and they put too much cream on the top
The good things is that they serve really fast.

Author: MarTravels16Redhill, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, more expensive
Review: This great restaurant is tucked in what I believe to be my favourite street in downtown JB.The food is a very abstract take on Western food with hints of the Asian culture seeping through. Although rather small, the bright and airy atmosphere make the restaurant seem much larger than it actually is.I would definitely recommend visiting.

Author: meikeiyeohKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Taste Good but Slow Service
Review: Ordered Asam Pedas Nyonya Fish, Sambal Sotong Petai, Kangkung Belacan, Telur Dadar Udang and Cendol. Everything was good, especially the Asam Pedas Nyonya Fish and Sambal Sotong Petai. Service was slow (waited 30 mins for table and another 30 mins for dishes to be served), probably because it was peak hour for lunch. Overall, we enjoyed our lunch.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: M30_MOLLYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not Satisfactory
Review: We read the raving reviews before going to this restaurant but was very disappointed with the food. We ordered laksa, normal fried rice, belacan fried rice and popiah. All was a disappointment as the taste was not what we expected. Restaurant was not crowded when we got there around 4pm on a normal weekend.

Author: ElsieTravelsKuala Lumpur
Title: Poor spread, Great Service
Review: We went for a lunch buffet expecting 4 Season's standard but was disappointed. Spread was poor and usually in a limited buffet spread there should be 1 or 2 outstanding dishes that should make up for it but there wasn't. In fact my partner found the prawn dish from the Indian section to be overcooked. Service was great but it didn't make up for the poor food standards, I should mention Sheila who attended to us and was great all around.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: Eric K
Title: Love the surf and turf
Review: The fillet steak is great. House wine are smooth. Good atmosphere, well priced steak for its quality and very good service.

Author: oarydpanama city
Title: Nearly there
Review: Having been relatively disappointed with the offerings of the restaurants of Langkawi this was a pleasant surprise. I ordered the steak and also chose the garlic bread and onion rings to go with it. Well cooked steak, lovely pepper sauce and even the dressing on the salad was bang on.However if you have a good appetite order lots, twelve chips!!!!! . I might look like I need a diet but I am not on one.On saying that its a nice setting, attentive staff and relatively good value for money.In comparison to the restaurants on Cenangs main drag it wins hands over heels.Try.

Author: Itravel0neKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Bursting pork ball and smooth noodlr
Review: Fancy big round pork ball with minced meat inside that's juicy and tasty? Go Noodle perfected this with the smooth noodle to go with it. Find your own choice and add to your dish. We visited the outlet in mid valley. We had to take a number and queued but it is worth the wait.

Author: Matkailija58
Title: Go and enjoy the local food and atmosphere
Review: Try different types of prawns, mixed vegetables also excellent. All in all great food, cheap prices. (There´s no toilet in the restaurant, but one public one on the other side of street, at least for men)

Author: yushisushi
Title: Disappointed
Review:
We went there for brunch and service was really slow and waiters attitude were not good.
Dim Sum overall was a little salty, would definitely go to other dim sum places for the same price. 
A disappointed experience !!!

Author: guanhwangKlang, Malaysia
Title: Nice foods and environment
Review: it is not easy to locate the restaurant as it is hide behind the huge Hokkien Association building. Good bak kut teh in both taste & tenderness but not the best among in Klang. but we do like the dish call "hong ba" and highly recommended to try that.

Author: Anto876Madrid, Spain
Title: Totally disappointed
Review: We came here for lunch, we ordered tandoori chicken and lamb chop. As it often happen in fusion restaurants, they have hundreds of different dishes on the menu and none of them is good and original. The drinks... We ordered two blended juices (the waitress said that the fruit were fresh...) actually they were supermarket juice frozen and blended... The restaurant furnitures were very poor and the menu more expensive than average. I don't recommend this place

Author: Jabero54
Title: Great authentic Malaysian food.
Review:
Very nice Malaysian food in a beautiful setting, adjacent to the Sarawak River.
A good selection of dishes and cold beer, I recommend the Laksa and a jug of Tiger. Follow up with a walk along the Kuching waterfront for a very pleasant outing.

Author: ekta pMalaysia
Title: Very expensive but the owner is a nice chap!
Review: Food is quite expensive for such an isolated place, probably because of the premium property. The smoothie was great, which the owner customized for me. He ensured all the patrons were having a good time and was recommending dishes according to the place. The ambiance was great.

Author: Danny YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Staff should be more attentive.
Review: Food was below par compared to the other HRC that we've been to. We ordered the Salmon and the fish is overcooked. Cheeseburger tasted rather bland and the bun was not toasted.The Pulled chicken sandwich was however quite nice.When all our main course was served we wanted to add on a order of chicken satay. Told one of the staff about it, he nodded, replied 'sure no problem' and went away. After we finished our meal and waited for another 15 minutes more, we check with another staff, she said we already got all our meal (except desserts) and when we asked about the extra order, she went away and checked with the kitchen. Only to come back 10 minutes later to tell us that 'no more chicken satay'. Didn't even say sorry. We were surprised that the staff just now did not come to inform us and we waited there like a fool. Staff could be more attentive instead of joking around with other staff and talking to each other laughing out loud.Felt so turned off by the level of service from the staff, we cancelled our order of desserts, pay for the bills and heads back to hotel.

Author: Silverstone90Singapore, Singapore
Title: Worth a try
Review: Recommend the Indonesia claypot prawn and the steamed fish. Personally feel that the price is quite reasonable, spent about RM160 for 5 dishes for 5 persons. However, please prepare to wait for at least 1 hr especially during dinner hour. It will be good if you could make reservation in advance, however, I think the staff might release your table to others if you didn’t arrived on time or slightly late. Out of 5Food: 4Price: 3.5Environment: 4Service: 3.5Waiting time: 3

Author: Loh999
Title: Very ordinary
Review: I could not understand the hype regarding dimsum in Ipoh. The quality is poor. One can get much better dimsum in KL. not worth the trouble.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: azukibeans
Title: Great Chicken Rice
Review: Excellent chicken rice shop. This place is open for lunch as well as dinner, however I think it closes between 2.30-5.30pm. Highly recommend getting the "3 types of chicken" plate for dinner - has steamed, roasted, and fried chicken and each one is very delicious.

Author: aim-khan
Title: Good Food, pocket friendly.
Review: Affordable & tasty chicken rice. Different types of chicken available. Definitely one of the best chicken rice around. Place is quite crowded at times. Come early, as some dishes would be sold out.

Author: Trisha L
Title: Best experience in KL and all of Asia
Review: Food was amazing. Drinks were delicious. Service was exceptional. We had the ceviche trio and a few orders of empanadas. When you go, be sure to have the tres leche cake. We would have waited hours but it only takes 20 minutes. It was one of the best things we have had in Asia. And the prices and atmosphere can't be beat. We wish we had this in America.

Author: Aguyabroad
Title: Terrible service and discrimination
Review: We had a good time drinking and eating food downstairs (and spent over 230MYR), but when we decided to go up and dance they kicked us out for not paying for drinks, we showed them the receipt but they told us that it doesn’t make a difference and that we should buy another drink. We are 3 male friends and we were the only ones being ushered out despite paying previously. We will not return, and do not recommend this place.

Author: Tuczyński WGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Nice design, average food
Review: Difficult to find, no sign. Nice design place but dissapoint food. I'm always asking myself "can I do something similar at home?" , if the answer is 'yes' means the food is average (and I'm not a chef). I like the sAlso due to 'technical issue' half of the drink menu wasn't available ;( (Apparently Information was on web.)Am I willing come back? Most likely.

Author: Vivien l
Title: Helpful Manager but Poor Food
Review: Ordered the chicken tacos, over salty tacos & it's very bland. Cold & hard rice which sticks together like the scraps from the pan bottom, very bland chili beans.

Author: cookiencoffee
Title: Below expectations
Review: A repeat visit to Overseas Restaurant and we were sad to be disappointed. 1 of 3 dishes we ordered was really substandard, and the fish in tomato stew in claypot was particularly tasteless. The only nice dish was the pork ribs in wine sauce.

Author: 259franciscooSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: A bit disappointed
Review: Great atmosphere and decor, very nice and welcoming staff.The food on the other hand was disappointing. The salted duck egg noodles were a bit too Al dente and were quite sticky. The mozzarella and tomato toast was average, as in the picture.. Just a tomato sauce with mozzarella on top and some pieces of processed bread around to dip in the sauce.Definitely overpriced.

Author: SB261Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Italian in Malaysia... Why am I here??
Review: Had the veal. It was tough - the wine was cheap and the meal felt like it was for tourists - which I guess is what I am. The others I was with for business thought it was okay but it didn't satisfy and I won't be back. The service was fine and the price very reasonable. I just wasn't in the mood for cheap Italian.

Author: SimoneSMC
Title: Fantastic beef pho
Review: We visited this restaurant at 2pm on a Saturday. It was not crowded. Clean and spacious place. Staff are quick and efficient. We ordered both the dry and soup versions of their beef pho. The food was really good, and the portions more than enough. We also tried the duck fetal egg, could be that the egg was too young still as it was mostly watery fluids. I'll recommend this for lunch.

Author: trebordoyl
Title: High standard
Review:
Great food 
Great service
Great atmosphere
Lovely family run restaurant

Author: midzurllMalaysia
Title: Delicious German Food!
Review: We went here for lunch on Sunday afternoon, I have to say that Mr Ahmed is a very friendly host, he's very understanding and helpful. Their food was really delicious especially the Schnitzel with their homemade garlic sauce, yummy! We had fun along with their cat, Lucky. When Mr Ahmed found out it was my wife's birthday, he gave us a piece of their homemade cheesecake which tasted like home, thank you so much!

Author: GudGollyMsMollySydney, Australia
Title: Brilliant street food
Review: Supposedly a locals only secret but now getting well known by tourists we rocked in just before 12 noon & by 12.15 the place was full. Service was really friendly & prompt & while the atmosphere was fairly basic there was a really gr8 vibe of couples, groups, families just enjoying good food. Like most ‘street food type’ places make sure to bring your own wet wipes as serviettes aren’t provided. We had 2 juices, Mapo tofu, deep fried balacan chicken, double roasted pork & rice for ~MYR60.

Author: audreyxjySingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and good price
Review: We visited on a Sun and called for reservation 45mins before dropping by. It was not crowded and there really is no need to reserve in advance. The Ayam Buah Keluak is a must try, the chicken is tender and savory. The cendol is a disappointed especially after we tasted what was offered at Jonker88.

Author: AishahMoorsKuching, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant food & atmosphere
Review: Recommended by a friend. So we tried and it’s pleasant, tasty, even healthy food! Presentation and volume is rather huge for me but we finished our food! The drinks are good too, bigger glass than most cafes! The staff is also nice despite it being her first day at work! Good job. Constructive comment: just please change the bulbs of the lights to a dimmer or frosted bulbs, it’s too bright that we squint our eyes to read the menu on the wall. Overall a pleasant experience

Author: tontotaylor
Title: Great buffet Restaurant
Review: Fixed price buffet is really good value. Each evening has a different theme. There is always avery large choice of dishes to suite all tastes. Food is constantly being replaced and replenished so it's always fresh.

Author: Vern LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth what you're paying for
Review: The video projection is a gimmick. Unfortunately, the gimmick doesn't work well. The projected video on your table is grainy and low res. It's like watching something on your CRT TV from 1985. The sound that accompanies it sounds like 8-bit music from your 1st generation Atari consoles. The food that finally replaces the projection does not look at all like the display of the projection.I expect quite a bit from this 'gimmick' as naturally you're paying for this 'insta-worthy thing'. But frankly, it's a complete let down.The dining hall is unimaginative and a complete letdown. Tables and chairs look aged. The wall on one side is decorated with empty frames. A big green 'keluar' sign is placed in the center of the back wall. It does not give any sense of atmosphere, romance or even warmth.We took the wine pairing and had to pay 400 more. 400 for 6 glasses of wine. I won't complain about the quality of the wine, but I am complaining about the price of it. Too much money for too little wine.The food is alright. Not great but alright. Our first course is a seafood dish. The fish is good but the lala is not fresh and has a strong 'fishy' smell. The rest of the courses are okay but the helping is small and there are too few courses that we ended the meal still hungry.The only good thing about this place is the service. They use foreign workers but they are at least friendly, warm and well trained. The entire experience did not leave me satisfied. It's very average and mundane. The projection is a big let down, the dining hall has no personality and the food has too little courses to be a satisfying meal. I'll sum it up by saying it's like attending a concert that ends only after the band played 5 songs, and didn't come out for the encore.For the 1000+ you're going to pay for this meal (or 2000 if you take the most expensive set), there are many other restaurants in KL which will make you feel a lot more satisfied.NOT WORTH YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY.

Author: Febrose
Title: Not a good choice for spicy food lover!!
Review: I went to their restaurant on 1/7/2015. Overall I'm not satisfied with their service and food. Services is extremely late. Food is below average. Briyani is too oily and not spicy. My parents ordered tea and they said "It's 3 in 1 tea".

Author: ignoramarkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lack of service
Review: Wanted to visit and try their bak kut teh. However we wasn't able to get their staffs' attention as we seem to be quite invisible to them and they just keep walking past us. Not sure if it is because there is just 2 of us and they seem to be friendlier to other tables of big groups. In the end, we have to leave without eating as we are just unable to order

Author: nyavtechKuching, Malaysia
Title: Seafood and more seafood...
Review: A large outdoor food court featuring a number of seafood restaurants. Pick from the vast array of seafood on offer: fish, crabs, shrimp, clams, you name it, decide on the way it should be cooked and place your order. There is a large choice of veggies as well. Choose a table and sit down. Someone will come to your table to take your drinks order. The food is well priced, and is delivered to your table piping hot.The only challenge is finding Hot Spot. Ignore the big sign at the entrance, it points to the parking at the back. Instead follow the small sign into the building and climb numerous flights of stairs to get to the food court on the roof.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: MerelSydneyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First price for worst customer service ever
Review: To think "Let's try our luck" wasn't the best decision we made today. We felt like having some Japanese food with the kids, in a nice restaurant setting. Although the atmosphere isn't too bad in this restaurant (we sat at table S27), the same thing can't be said for the service at The Japan Store. Our order was taken in the most unpleasant and uninterested way; the waiter wasn't even looking at us and couldn't tell us where to find the sake on the menu (turned out he gave us the wrong menu) and after some vague and confusing explanation about bottle sizes, we gave up and simply ordered a beer and green tea.First dish served was the seaweed salad. Not too bad, but it was simply wacked on the table without any plates and the waitress rushed off. We had to try our utmost to drag her back, to ask for plates.The rest of the food was ok (although very tiny portions) came reasonably quick, except for the salmon roll, but we were told "Not too worry" in a dismissive tone. Right.Then drinks came and were served by a trainee. Nice person, but he put all four drinks right in front of hubby, and ran off too! This person needs more training...After a lot of waiting and even calling out, we managed to attract attention to order our dessert... Desserts were nice: tiramisu and cheesecake.When we asked for the bill, we noticed the beer was priced at 35R. After inquiring, it turned out it was two Happy Hour beer for the price of one. Nobody had bothered to tell us this though...By then we had truly enough of the place and we couldn't be bothered to stay for the second beer.I think the waiter in charge realised the mess up they made of our lunch and kindly offered a 10% discount on the total bill of 216 RM, which was the right thing to do.A shame to see that a potentially nice place can be such a disappointment.

Author: Miumiu1982
Title: Suck!
Review: My night mare visiting Havana club, 2 of us having bottle vodka. While I am going to ladies room, n come back to our place in bar counter.... Half bottle vodka gone. My friend doesn't realize who take the bottle, I been complain to manager but there is no respond. Be careful n better to go another place!

Author: Agil NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Standards have gone down, bad service
Review: We had arranged to have lunch at Paya Serai in PJ Hilton to celebrate Mother's Day. I have been going there for lunch or dinner over the years and I have noticed that their standards have deteriorated significantly. The quality and range of foods for the buffet during the Mother's Day luncheon was mediocre, Service was bad! The waiters were not moving around to clear the tables of used plates and crockery. We had to remove the used plates ourselves and hand it to the waiters near the back entrance. After complaining, the duty manager came to apologize. He promised to put right and after that the waiters were regularly visiting our table to clear the used plates. This should not have happened.

Author: ikarrtiniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food,superb service and lovely ambience
Review: My favourite is Soraya's Dutch meat balls with apple sauce.Not too heavy just right for me! My son's favourite is their lamb shanks tender and yummy.Hosts are friendly and caring that we have now become friends. Away from the hustle bustle of Cenang which I like. Decor cosy and stylish

Author: jan59Essex
Title: Smashing buffet
Review: Something for everyone, we were staying here, so obvious choice for our last evening. Wine - they have 3 reds, 3 whites on tap, and you can refill as many times as you like for RM70. Splendid,

Author: AndyLSth
Title: Love this place
Review: Love Kah Ping's mee hoon kueh... tasty and delicious. Generous portion of noodle, vegetables (cai xin), pork slices, prawns and fried anchovies. Egg an option. Long waiting time as packed with locals.

Author: ckwee13Singapore, Singapore
Title: Decent Chinese food
Review: Went on friend's recommendation and because it was right beside where we stayed (Pullman). Huge restaurant and we walked in without a reservation on a Sunday evening. Chose the indoor air-conditioned table. Amongst dishes ordered, the braised pork with bun, and the assam chilli prawns were the better ones (delicious). Rest were decent. Prices were still fairly reasonable- spent abt 15SGD per pax.

Author: HayaRidh
Title: a worse restaurant
Review:
I went to the sammad Restaurant for three times ,however at the last time the food was terrible and The restaurant was  crowded 
This restaurant is the most expensive restaurant in kuala lampur 
and the service was poor

Author: Mizlia
Title: Terrible food service
Review: For the price you pay, it is not recommended at all. I reserve the table at 8:30pm because it mentioned the dine in duration is 1 hour 30 mins. It should be just enough for us. I was wrong! We arrived at 8:35pm, the spread was almost empty! I take what I need the first time coz i thought they will refill, again I was wrong. 9pm.. none of the appertizer was refilled, the deco was removed as well. 9:15pm, some of the kitchen staff was cleaning up and prep for closing. Some of the things are wrapped up! 9:25pm, kitchen staff member dine in dispite not refilling ANY of the buffet dish! I am pissed off. We did not have the chance to eat any scallop..there was none! Nothing to eat for second round at grill section as it was not refill, i remind you again..this is at 9pm! Whats the point of having a booking slot if you are not going to refill the dishes!!!! I seriously think most of the customer there was having their dinner for more than 1.5 hours! If i knew i would just pick the slot at 7! I was told that the last call at 9:45 which is Funny coz most of the dishes was not even being top up at 9!! Please dont come here. Not worth it apart from the view that u can just pay by going to the observation deck!!!

Author: echoleo71
Title: Awesome cafe
Review: Wonderful cafe for the family and friends. Great setup, good food at good price. Friendly staffs. And must try the apple crumble, it's the best i had ever tried. And free Wi-Fi.......

Author: Chriselloy
Title: Dinner
Review: The food was good. I loved the curry crab and the yam dish the best of all that we had. Service was good and the food was quick to come to the table.  It was old style cooking

Author: leopang
Title: Hakka mee Restaurant at Taman Ann
Review:
The sambal (daily preparation)is very tasty.
a)Hakka Mee
b)Yong Tau Foh
c)Pork knuckle vinegar
and other Hakka style dishes

Author: FromKluangMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Good nyoya foods
Review: The restaurant had move from Jonker street to Kota Laksamana ( near opposite Bei Zhan restaurant ). One of the better Nyona foods restaurant in Melaka.Recommend foods : Ponteh pork. They selling nice Nyona kuey.Long queue during weekend better go before 11:30am for lunch.Price is reasonable but serving was little small.

Author: finesses f
Title: Nice food
Review:
Small restaurant.  Nice food. Tried what The uncle recommended - pineapple drinks. It's rather sweet.

Other food are acceptable.  Fair price.

Author: 374kexintVictoria, Canada
Title: Nachos should not be made from Doritos!
Review: Terrible, terrible service. Disappointing food. The restaurant was not even at half capacity, yet the service actually slowed to a stop. To add to the farce that this restaurant has become, the Nachos Libre were actually made with cheese flavored Doritos. The caesar salad was without taste. Don't order the Sangria either. Worst I have ever had. The restaurant itself is nicely appointed, but that's not enough to ever draw us back again. bens used to be good, but has taken a sharp nosedive. Too bad.

Author: Jepa PHelsinki, Finland
Title: Friendly service but food quite tasteless
Review: We went here with big expectations because of the previous reviews. However, in our opinion this was the most bland-tasting vegetarian restaurant we have tried in Kuching. Service is very friendly though but this doesn't make food any tastier. A cheap buffet style vegetarian place and seems popular with locals. We tried nearly every variety they had and only one of them (leaf amarant with ginger) tasted good. Everything else was either tasteless or just very salty.

Author: yll79Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Horrible service
Review: The moment we arrived and it's at 2pm noon. Your board says that you are open from 11.30 to 2.30pm. Immediately your waitress hand me the menu and required me to place order that instant. I wasn't even give at least 1 min to look at the menu since this is my first visit.Then the food arrived and within the same instant my cendol was sent to my table while we are still half way eating out main meal. By the time I get to my cendol it was already diluted.Then at 2.40pm you send your waitress to start sweeping the floor while we are still eating and it's a aircond place.Congrats you won the award of providing the worst service ever. Doesn't matter how good is your food but this kind of service is really bad. My first and very last.

Author: Rodney17Melbourne, Australia
Title: Made the rookie mistake
Review: Reservations are a must at this longstanding Lonely Planet 'top pick' and very popular and good value Malay restaurant.Until a few hours after being home and after what I thought was a fabulous dinner, I would have rated 5 stars. Unfortunately (and I readily recognise it is a grave impugning and am loathe to say so), I was seriously ill with food poisoning. To some extent I blame myself for making the rookie mistake of eating non fried fish and having ice cream with desert.Not good enough Bijan - your otherwise good reputation deserves so much better.

Author: alltimetraveller91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great set lunch! Huge portions
Review: Tried the grilled chicken from their set lunch menu. It was a little salty but really worth it, portions were huge and superb tasty with great beach view. Exceptionally friendly fnb staff too.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Eskay97
Title: Best Salted Chicken
Review: I've tried the other restaurants serving salted chicken and I rate this one as the best. They have a drive-in purchasing system along the busy main road. You will have to wait as usually there is a long queue. Trust me it's worth the wait.

Author: Jane131262Fleet, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner
Review: Tired after a long day getting to KL needed comfort food so headed for the Hard Rock. Service was great and so was the food. I had the featured New York strip with fries that had a smoked paprika taste to them steak cooked perfectly as ordered and fries lovely and crispy. Husband had the fajitas combo of chicken and steak again fab sized portion and tasty. For pudding we shared the brownie omg it’s massive and even between the two of us we couldn’t finish it! All washed down with a lovely frozen margarita and a couple of beers. Excellent value for money and packed by the time we left.

Author: Eddie30Malaysia
Title: 2-Star Food, 5-Star Price
Review: After much hype place by my business associates in Kuching, I finally had a chance to sample the food at this restaurant. Maybe it was me or my taste bud is blend but to me, the food cooked and presented at this restaurant left very much to be desired (I had better seafood cooked by a hawker stall at Pending Seafood Center) . The price however was shocking (even though I was not the one paying). So if you want to eat at a restaurant atmosphere in Kuching, I would suggest you avoid this particular one and try the many others found all over the beautiful city of Kuching.

Author: AhmadKasyidi
Title: Teh Tarik Nice
Review: Yesterday I had a Teh Tarik at Trace Restaurant,Element Kuala Lumpur & it is very delicious.The F&B Manager,Mr Saiful treat me nicely.FYI,he was my boss at Westin Kuala Lumpur.

Author: Simon6511Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice and packed Japanese Food
Review: 4 of us on business ad lunch discussion, the food is OK.. and i think some of the food seem like fast food to me and lost the "identity - Japanese" .. it becoming fast japanese style food instead of japanese food .. hope for changes for better japanese food

Author: memorealIstanbul, Turkey
Title: never ever
Review: I have been there today.we have been seated on the table 9:45 pm. We order our meals.They bring my soup and drinks first and the serve 2 of my friends' meals .And ı was thinking that it takes long to prepare my meal.Then they bring the dessert with the bill.When ı asked about my meal they said that they have forgotten my meal.I said how this can be happen.They apoligize that they had forgotten.I said "Ok then, are you going to prepare it.".The waiter went to the kitchen and said that they can not prepare that meal at that time.I said, you sould be jokking, you will not send me to the hotel hungry, will you?I said," I accept you apoligize but please tell me what you can prepare for me".The waiter went to the kitchen again and come back and told that the kitchen is closed so they will not serve any thing for me.And they bring me the bill.They were charged even the bavarege I have not drink. They said me that they may not charge for the desert (RM6,5).the dessert waiting for the mail dish.Can you imagine? I said I do not want your dessert.How can ı eat it when ı am hungry.I paid their money and exit from that awful place.

Author: BUY S
Title: WORST SERVICE IN MY WHOLELIFE
Review: Was told to go away because I'm alone they only serve half chicken and 1 chicken , how can I finish the chicken?

Author: fitfunfPerth, Australia
Title: Ipoh coffee shop cuisine
Review: Old style coffee house food. Popiah or veggie spring rolls. Sate with peanut sauce. They also have prawn noodles with chicken strips in broth, coconut rice & curry or nasi lemak. There was crystal custard with caramel for dessert. Kopi or coffee was Malaysian style with a bitter burnt caramel after taste. Pay on delivery of food. Next door cafe also available to provide food. Worth a visit & don’t forget your table number for orders. Hide & see table numbers.

Author: mfaridzz
Title: Nothing special than just
Review: Nothing special than just a plain asam pedas and not to mention rude owner/casher, no attitude, treated like we the customers eat the for free. Jokers

Author: SuthashiniSri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: We had great time!
Review: The food was great. I loved especially the Keema Naan and the butter paneer masala. The chicken briyani, chicken tikka masala and prawn masala was nice too. The atmosphere was good, I felt like as though I was in India. With many people, it was noisy, nevertheless, we enjoyed chit-chatting among our family members. We had great time!

Author: tracyyap
Title: It was alright
Review:
Ambience 9/10
Food 4/10 (food cooled down when served - fish soup. Lamb soup too salty for me, good for others)
Service 8/10
Cleanliness 8/10

Author: 110Mckiwi
Title: Tasty Tandoori
Review: We wandered down from KL Sentral - easy stroll and can enjoy the sounds of the street while enjoying most beautiful fresh Tandoori chicken and Naan. Family store and very friendly

Author: Shuj-qad
Title: Mr
Review: Great place with an amazing music and even better atmosphere. The hospitality is the best that you’ll get in KL. if you are visiting, you HAVE you come here!

Author: GieGieTayMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Homecook German Food
Review: The cafe locate behind the RHB Bank Melaka Raya. Must try the pork knuckle if you come here. The taste same like what I eat in Munich. Really yummy..... The sauce for the sausages are taste very good too. According to them, the sauce mixed with 20+ spices and some spices they import from German.If you want to try German food, come here.

Author: lorrainer517Bolton, United Kingdom
Title: Just ok
Review: Menu wasn't anything special. Staff were very overwhelming. You couldn't eat or talk without them wiping the table moving the salt back after I used it. The place was lovely and very clean. Staff just need to chill out. Also a little but pricey for what it is.

Author: Cbrowne23
Title: A world class dining experience.
Review: Congrats to the Kayu Puti team for creating a Michelin style restaurant in Langkawi. It is a total sensory overload...the beautiful smells, spectacular decor and divine food will be impossible to forget.

Author: Ron6978
Title: Christmas Day 2020
Review: Spent Christmas Day at our favourite bar. Traditional Christmas dinner with starter n Christmas pud. V nice. Spent a good 9 hours enjoying the atmosphere, service good food and drink. Thankyou

Author: Roza BSydney
Title: Overrated
Review: Yes, it has the idyllic on-the-beach location, but this place was overpriced.We had the three course + tea/coffee package. It started so well - the crab, and the prawn house specialty were fantastic. Then it steadily went downhill from there. The beef randang was dry and although a big serve (prerfect for the hungry man in your life), it was pastey/dry and needed something more - like more curry sauce. My fish was quite good. The desserts were a real disappointment. The cheesecake was below average.I am not sure if it's just a co-incidence but my boyfriend was violently ill all night after dinner. The only thing we didn't share was the ice-cream and I recall him saying it tasted as if it had melted and had been refrozen, which is never good re bacteria.The service was ok - but with the beach tables far away from the other tables and kitchen, we often struggled to get attention when trying to reorder drinks etc.On the up side, the cocktails are great!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: SFT118
Title: Not crowded
Review:
Friendly owner who served us and recommended few of their signature dishes. 

Loved the spicy squid with petai (sticky beans) of the 6 dishes we ordered.

Author: sherenep86
Title: Underwhelming Food and Drinks
Review: We were a party of 4 ladies whom initially went there just for the drinks as a couple of us had been there for drinks and said that it was great. We decided to have dinner there too as it was our last night at Langkawi and thought to splurge a little. The location and ambience is great however the food had no flavour plus very small portions and not a good value for the money! We had the slow baked salmon (no seasoning), cod (not fresh and tasteless), ikan panggang (not fresh and unauthentic), soft shell crab (not fresh, fried in old reused oil), butternut pumpkin and sweet potato soup (bruschetta was good, but the soup was way too sweet).We all ordered different cocktails and tried each others but were utterly disappointed, especially with their Margarita and Bellinis. When my friend tried to provide feedback to the waiter just before we left of our experience, we were told that they catered for European taste buds. Gee thanks. I for one will not be returning any time soon.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: brocdogSanta Cruz, California
Title: Fantastic setting, great food
Review: Enjoyed the setting sun from a table out on the beach at this waterfront restaurant...recommend trying the Malaysian food pallet (sampler), which featured beef rendang and other spicy curried dishes - delish! Whole sea bass also recommended - all in all, excellent quality food and service - some of the best I've had in Langkawi.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: gnkrltrrsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worse
Review: Your server is so damn stupid. First I ordered whisky neat then he served it on the rocks, second I ordered strawberry margarita but was served regular margarita. I also ordered Gordon's gin and tonic. But when the bill was presented it was Grey goose. the stupid server is even arguing that Grey goose is also a gin. Bloody hell. His breath almost killed me as well.

Author: David WGladstone, Australia
Title: Looked popular enough....
Review: Have been to this restaurant probably at least a dozen times on our five trips to Kuala Lumpur.....have never had a problem before today....we ordered our meal, which was delivered promptly...then the Matriarch who does not speak much English proceeded to instruct me on how to eat my meal.....BIG NO NO.....did not eat one tasty morsel, and I was starving....asked for our bill and walked away....younger staff who speak English were not helpful.....will never go back to this establishment and will tell everyone and anyone not to frequent the establishment......a very, very, very disappointing experience......and I never give bad review, making allowances for many incidents which can and do occur in restaurants. But this experience really did take the cake.

Author: BMF60Bangkok
Title: Not as good as it used to be
Review: I think the chef here hates vegetables. As I was doing a training course at the hotel recently, I ate at Temptations about 7 times, and eat time I was left craving for vegetables. There are lots of oily, sweet local dishes, but no cooked vegetables. I wouldn't eat here if I had to pay for it.

Author: Eat_WindKuching, Malaysia
Title: Food quality has dropped, avoid!
Review: Good meeting place with friends but aside from the beers, the food is not worth ordering. The tapas that we ordered were not warm enough, i suspect most items are pre-prepared and heated upon ordering. Portion is small and the price is on the high side.

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Horrible cafeteria food
Review: I wrote a review for this place about 2 years back and that review was quite positive. I found the place to have a good balance between price and quality. Unfortunately it would appear to have changed since then.I just went there for lunch. We were seated and handed a couple of menus. After browsing through the HUGE menu I decided on a rather nice looking pizza with Salmon, but when I ordered the waiter told me that only one section of the menu was available. Why oh why didn't they tell me that when they gave me the menu, or even better - hand me a lunch menu containing only the items that are actually available.I ended up ordering a Chicken Gordon Bleu and boy was I in for a nasty surprise. That Chicken Gordon Bleu hands down qualifies as the worst I have ever had. It consisted of a cheap chicken sausage (yes you read that right), a layer of chicken so thin that the layers of some chicken ham was actually thicker and then a MASSIVE layer of breading. Excuse me - come again - if you want to sell me a breaded chicken sausage - then at least have the decency to call it that instead of pretending it is something else. At RM 26++ it wasn't cheap either.Cafeteria food with NO soul whatsoever served at restaurant prices - that is the experience I left with. Now, I have visited the original Souled out a number of times and this one once before, but if I had been served this rubbish before I wouldn't have come back.So to conclude - if you are out looking for overpriced cafeteria food, then Souled out might be your kind of place. If you expect quality or soul - please look elsewhere.

Author: MatzhuangSingapore
Title: Fantastic Home-cooked Food at Reasonable Prices
Review: Had a late lunch at Unicorn Cafe recently and I must say that the food was great! The food feels like home and this family run business is so warm and welcoming. Our favorites were the popiah and kueh pie ti. Do leave some space for their durian chendol - the durian is a slab of actual durian from a local organic plantation and chendol has the right amount of Gula Melaka (not overly sweet). Best of all, prices are very reasonable. Serving is on the small side, but that means u can order a greater variety of food.

Author: Liyana S
Title: Slow service
Review: When i was asking for the bill, I had to ask multiple times for about 15 minutes. As one of the waitress was kind enough to come to me and apologize for the slow service, I let it go at first. The bill finally arrived and I paid, then wait for the change. Usually in other Nando's restaurants they will take about 15 minutes tops and this is when it is filled with customers. But I waited for almost half an hour just to get the change. I had to go to the cashier and I see a long queue of people. The young man was operating the cash register and I finally see why it took so long. He was laughing and talking to his friend inside the kitchen. You can laugh and talk while your hand is working but he literally stopped to talk to his friend. I got angry and asked him to hurry. No appologies from the waiter as he just asked which table I sat on. I showed him and he gave me a new bill. I immediately raised my voice saying I have paid and was waiting freaking half and hour just to get my change. He immediately try to find the former bill along with my money that he stacked with other bills (a stack means around 10 bills unattended). He gave me my change and that will be the last time I'm having Nando's at Sogo.

Author: ongjanice1Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Food but service kinda sucked!
Review: Was there for lunch (yesterday) with my family (6 adults & 2 children). The bill came up to approx RM280 for 6 dishes & Chinese tea. Wifi is available & Pavilion shopping mall is located opposite the restaurant. We enjoyed the meal because it is tasty, portions are reasonable but the downside to the whole experience is that there's no service with smile; most of the waitresses are so grumpy and they could not be found when required. Some of them "act" busy and there's this particular waitress sulked when walking to our table. Only 1 waitress who was really friendly but she only came by once & couldn't be found after that.

Author: RusnitaUSBeverly, Massachusetts
Title: Perfect for good coffees and desserts
Review: We went to this delightful restaurant for coffee and desserts. All three types of cakes we had (apple pie ala mode, pavlova and and the carrot cake) were delicious. We will definitely be returning. My only caveat is the air conditioning is very efficient so bring a wrap.

Author: DablooWSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent ambiance, friendly staff, below average food, slow service
Review: Went in Dec 2019 with 4 adults and 2 kids. Orders the grilled fish which was good, but the sushi was below average. The unagi was not fresh, didnt taste good at all.We sat outside which was really beautiful but it was infested by mosquitoes. The service was really slow, food took over 45 mins to arrive, one dish at a time.

Author: 5sanjay
Title: Quality of food reduced
Review: Food quality is getting worse and tasteless. Used to love their briyani. Ambience good. I hope they review the quality of their dishes.

Author: 193TerrySydney, Australia
Title: Very authentic
Review: Great variety of food with an authentic vibe make this place a standout on this strip of restaurants. Huge selection is probably the only struggle, otherwise I can safely say - it’s all pretty great. Perfect for meeting friends on a casual night that’s not too complicated. We’ll be back!

Author: kika03Vienna Region, Austria
Title: Nice place,but a bit overpriced
Review: We had dinner at Shook with our 2 sons in January 2013 after searching around this area for a good meal. The restaurant is a great concept with different cuisines in one place. The location inside the mall is questionable to some ,but not unpleasant to us.The Maitre D was very nice ,but the food was average and they were not quite up to the task as far as service is concerned (my main dish was waiting on a table next to ours while I was finishing my appetizer and was getting cold). None of the other dishes were exceptional in their own right,maybe it is better to choose a specialty restaurant for every cuisine. The prices were "european"- like ,but that itself is a hard sell in Kuala Lumpur...

Author: Petitegem88Melbourne, Australia
Title: Service needs major improvement before reaching real fine dining levels
Review: Our first fine dining experience in Malaysian celebrity chef restaurant was a let down . We had booked a private dining room for our friends 50th birthday for a table of 14 and had flown in from overseas . We decided to go with the top set menu which was to cater for 12 people . We had 2 young kids so we knew it was going to be more than enough . We requested to change the spicy seafood soup as some cannot take spice . The waitress was quite reluctant to do so . Who is the customer ! If you cannot take spice then we would waste it anyway . We didn’t ask to pay less . We just wanted some soup to be another type that they had in the lesser price set menu so we can enjoy ourselves.. The main courses all came at once , sitting there getting cold as you can’t eat them all at the same time . We hadn’t even finished and the waitress started clearing our plates . We are paying fine dining prices and it’s like they wanted us out ASAP . The good quality was inconsistent . Some dishes especially the seafood ones were overcooked . The only good thing was the private room had nice decor . I would not recommend this place for a fine dining experience in KL.

Author: daniib84Sydney, Australia
Title: Okay but be careful during happy hour
Review: We went after dinner one night and ordered two cocktails during happy hour. The waiter said there were only two cocktails not included in the happy hour promotion. The cocktails themselves were great but when we went to pay he charged us for two because he said they had to be the same cocktail to qualify for the happy hour discount. He failed to mention this when we ordered. I said i was not paying for two as we were mislead. He wasnt happy and tried to argue with me about it. After much discussion he went and took one cocktail off the bill. Just beware you may tried to be ripped off during happy hour.

Author: GeorgeLoker
Title: Simple Restoran with good food
Review: This is the place for duck and the duck is exceptionally delicious. Just order some dishes and try it out yourself with your friends and family.

Author: nabilahkhalid
Title: Just so-so
Review: We went there because that is one the must visit stalls in Malacca. A lot of people are queing up for the Mango Float.  The taste is not like what I expected.

Author: MpoloKL
Title: Average halal Chinese Restaurant
Review:
Amber restaurant serves halal chinese menu located in Kerinci/Bangsar South on kuala lumpur.

They serves northern chinese cuisine which is mainly spicy, grilled or fried chicken, lamb, duck, fish and vegetables. This is different from southern chinese cuisine which is common in Malaysia.

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice lunch
Review: Had lunch here with a friend. The two of us ordered the sashimi platter which consisted on uni, fresh prawns, salmon belly, tuna, scallop. I love sashimi but was horrified to bite into a small portion of unfresh uni! This really needs improvement as freshness is absolutely the testament of a good Japanese restaurant.Also ordered my favorite tempura sweet potato. Love it as I love sweet potato. The baked oyster which we had was a disappointment though. Finale is the raindrop cake which is my first try and we both love that.

Author: 436JamesMLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Not just for St Paddy's day
Review: Healy Mac's is basically a chain of pubs across Malaysia. I have been to 3 of them, 2 of them Penang & Mont kiara many times. What I like the most is the consistency about it . Each bar has a friendly Irish landlord /lady who works the bar , saying hi , checking you are on and a chat if you want it, I like this old school touch. The food in each bar is consistently good wholesome Irish pub grub which when living Asia, a taste of back home . Always have a great time in Healy's whether with friends or for a quite pint on my own.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: y35813
Title: Awsome fatoush salad and more
Review: Highly recommended!!! Home cooking, great lamb steak. But we loved the fatoush salad and the Turkish coffee the best. Thank you for the wonderful service.

Author: renee804Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad experience
Review: Ordered paella much earlier and ordered another one subsequently . Both went we checked after more than 45 mins did not arrived as they said it was not keyed in . The worst part was that one of them said that the squid ink ran out of stock !!! We were really disappointed as we came for the paella but due to this there’s no way that we were going to wait for another 45 mins. Hope Martha’s restaurant will improve their service .

Author: ruoxuan
Title: Awesome spread breakfast
Review: They have a super awesome selection of breakfast as well as excellent service provided to us. Missing the cheese omelette already.

Author: C400D
Title: Overpriced, poor service
Review: Food is expensive, but not very delicious. Restaurant looks clean. When we asked them to pack all leftover food, we found only certain food were packed.

Author: Sarita_KL
Title: Go for the Sub of the day
Review: Good simple sandwhich. Value for money. Go for the sub of the day.

Author: rogerstephensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing, Ben's can do SO much better than this
Review: It was a quick lunch break, first visit after a refit. The waiters are clearly still being trained and look nervous. Fish and chips, should be easy but we got raw uncooked soggy batter inside and tasteless fish. I ordered smoked salmon and avacado sandwich - salmon was OK, but pretty uninspiring for it's price. Basically, slow nervous service, aveage to poor food, a cheap cafe look interior (what's with all the plastic palms hanging from the ceiling?) and prices that make no sense other than it's in KLCC where their rent is high.

Author: GerardoD1136
Title: Wire of a sponge made of metal in the shawarma
Review: No matter the food, the atmosphere and the service when you find a wire of a sponge made of metal in the shawarma. People die for something like that

Author: YzTengC
Title: Fast service
Review: I think not necessary to try it because it just normal and not so tasty... oily chicken meat , chicken rice make to be a rice ball and taste just so-so ... price considering high and other chicken rice shops are tasty than this

Author: bigawa
Title: Nice bakuteh
Review: Very cozy place, plenty of bakuteh choices, dry to traditional wet . The dish are fresh, can ask to add soup

Author: maroon2533
Title: The food is AMAZING!
Review: Everyone should try the Belacan fried rice. This place has good staff and although its Malaysia, the staff can speak English. This place is great for families for all 3 meals.

Author: KcHani
Title: Awesome place!
Review: It is a must go place for those who loves North Indian food. As we were vegetarians, we tried their vegetarian kebab and it was tasty. Lovely ambience n good food! Mango Colada ( mocktail) was one of the best drink I have tried!

Author: Killarney_chief117Killarney
Title: Delicious Food and Great Service
Review: Had the beef rendang and it was amazing. Our waiter Marvin was brilliant and made sure we had everything we needed. There was great traditional music and the vibe was really cool. Don't forget to try the dumplings!Give the "elemental cocktails" a go if you like something different from the regular cocktails out there, really tasty and novel.

Author: Rajeev007000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner Experience
Review: Went there for a dinner with family and didn't like a thing. Poor service, waiters do not care much and busy grooming themselves. When I ordered, Waiter did not write the order and behaved as he can remember everything. I had specifically requested to put butter for my daughter Roti (Indian bread) and he did not put that. Secondly can you imagine, he brought all cold rotis, Chef must have made and kept it aside. These are supposed to be direct from oven. when I ate they were like rubber.I had asked for grill vegetable platter which by default supposed to come with mint sauce, but waiter did not bring, I had to ask. Bad experience. I will never recommend it to anyone and will not go there again ever.

Author: 556ngkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner
Review: Went makko for dinner. We reached at 6 and the restaurant was already fully booked. We had to wait 40mins for a table. Best to call in advance or to arrive 30mins before to get a table.Food was ok. But somehow lacking that authentic nonya feel

Author: DaveV775Ubud, Indonesia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went there expecting some good nyonya cooking but were quite disappointed. The service was good but the food was very bland, not at all like other nyonya cuisine we've had. And a bit pricey -- 66 Ringgit for 2 without drinks -- not bad if it'd been good.

Author: Gayathri SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Service
Review: This restaurant serves good indian food. Upstairs you can enjoy banana leaf rice. However during peak hours the service sucks - somehow the waiters group around near the cashier & food counter but do not manage orders well. It can be frustrating when you want a quick bite in an area where parking is impossible to get during peak hours.

Author: Yong T
Title: Average nyonya food
Review: The food are bit sweet for me, the ambient is good .Just not the correct taste for me.maybe u can try if u want.

Author: WSKwan
Title: >5 star. Who can ask for anything more?
Review: Love this place as well as the food and beverage. I bet the coffee latte, hot chocolate it serves are even better than that of famous franchise outlets. >5 star. Thanks.

Author: Philippe DHuy, Belgium
Title: Very disappointing experience
Review: We are not experts in local food but Western cuisine was part of our career in F&B so we had quite high expectations for our lunch at Cuisines. The atmosphere is pleasant and like other reviews said the staff are friendly and efficient. Sadly we were very disappointed by the food. For starter we ordered the humous with pita bread. The bread was industrially made and dry. The humous itself was ok but less tasty as those we enjoy in Arabic restaurants of Bukit Bintang area in KL. I ordered the fillet mignon steak. First of all the fillet mignon quality was changed to ribeye. Clearly the meat had been frozen. I requested medium rare cooking and oit came out very well done, hard and tasteless. The cut was thin like basic local steaks from buffalo meat. The sauce was made from powder and so was the tiny mash portion. My wife ordered the lamb. It was presented exactly the same way with industrially made mash, powder sauce and a few vegetable. We had only mineral water to drink and out total bill was RM 180. Clearly way too expensive for the quality offered. Sadly, not a place to recommend in Ipoh and way over rated here on Tripadvisor.

Author: rzingerGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice Little Place with Good Food and a Nice Beer Selection
Review: Stopped here for dinner and enjoyed the food as well as the nice selection of German beers (good to deviate from the usual menu of Carlsberg and Tiger featured at most restaurants! Fondue with Chili is a great off-menu order. Bratwurst was nice as well. Friendly service. Good food takes time, this is not the best choice if you are in a rush.

Author: Avle_elva
Title: Omakase experience
Review: Chef Yau was serving us, overall experience is pretty good, he is very friendly and explain to us on our questions through the experience. Food taste good with the freshness and special preparation

Author: elliet496Headingley, United Kingdom
Title: Worth it for the service
Review: We enjoyed fantastic food and experienced great service at this restaurant when we visited recently. Service was sharp and attentive, and the food was tasty and cooked to perfection. All of which stood out exceptionally amongst everywhere we've been to during our 5 weeks in Malaysia. When visiting Bukit Bintang, I would definitely recommend paying this place a visit.

Author: Hanif MShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Cozy atmosphere with very average taste and price
Review: living near to this cafe does really help to excite my taste bud as seeing people keeps coming in and out of this place. ordered a carbonara and does not taste bad. very good place to "lepak" especially at night due to lighting and furniture. expect the price to be not far from secret recipe or other growing cafes.

Author: FruitusDoha, Qatar
Title: Much improved over its previous incarnation.
Review: The place is under new management an is all the better for it. I still haven't tried the food, but friends have, with mixed reviews. However the decor is much improved and the atmosphere in the place is much better than before. They serve Asahi on draught! That for me is a winner, though they could improve that by gettin rid of the crappy plastic glasses and using real frozen ones.

Author: Alvin_PheyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just alright...
Review: Heard so much of this fish head curry restaurant so we have decided to give it a try. My partner has eaten there before but I haven’t. The queue when we were there at ard 1215pm on a Friday was decent, only took us 10 mins to get a small table for ourselves. Ordered a medium size curry fish head pot and I must said the taste is just alright, I have definitely tasted much better similar dishes in KL and PG. Staffs are friendly, nevertheless. Floor can be a little slippery so pls walk carefully.

Author: SuperGastSouth Pole
Title: Love the place
Review: Came across an article about the street where this bar is located, so I decided to give it a shot.For me the best way to describe the food is that it's Tapas with some Japanese flavour, but not to much so even people that don't like Japanese food will not dislike this food at all. It's interesting and a must try.Because it's a bit hidden it makes it a great place for a casual dinner and still close to the bars, which is not really needed because they have some good beers on the tap.Like what other reviewers mentioned, it's a hidden gem and worth a try. Remember that they serve pork.

Author: AngieleM
Title: Overall satisfactory
Review: Celebrated Mother's Day here. The buffet lunch served was overall satisfactory. Prawns was fresh, mussels and crayfish okay but the crab is tasteless. All the chicken dishes besides the Indian Cuisine was over tenderised. Limited choices of drinks. Table attention was alright but require improvement, probably because it was fully booked today. Ambience was good. Hope KL Hilton can make improvements.

Author: muazandbeloved
Title: Best Indian food in KL
Review: Went there after hearing astounding recommendations from colleagues. Good food and service. Would definitely come again!

Author: JwpgohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Confused experience and Eminem’s swearing
Review: We chose the ‘fine dining-ish looking’ section instead of the more casual section outside. Interestingly, they had Eminem playing in the background (in fact, Eminem was swearing his head off in the background rap music). Then the wait staff asked if we wanted tap, still or sparkling water? I did mention that the section had a fine-dining feel including the prices. My boys ordered ribeye steaks which was priced SGD$30ish each. The steaks were very average at best, and did not come with anything apart from the meat, some raw salad and bbq sauce. The chicken dish I had was also average. For the price, it was not worth a second visit. My food was already coming out of my mouth at the end of dinner listening to Eminem swearing and grim lyrics.
Restaurant: New Zealand Unlimited Restaurant at Puteri Harbour

Author: NicoleJ1021
Title: Great food, amazing coffee and friendly staff
Review: Great food, amazing coffee and friendly staff. This has become my go to every morning for my coffee, there is also a wide variety of food on the menu from western to Asian - you will not be disappointed

Author: Willinko
Title: Dim Sum palace
Review:
Dim sum buffet ( trolley coming at your table ) is amazing.
Menu is also vast and very good . I recommend the crispy duck and pork belly .
Staff is friendly and professional but most waiter speak only Chinese .

Author: AFAK25Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: The price adds up quickly
Review: Individual items look cheap on the menu. However the portions are unbelievably small and you need to have more than one portion to sate your appetite and the price adds up quickly without you realising.In the end you are paying only slightly less than a higher end Japanese restaurant.For some reprieve come between 3 and 6pm. There's 20% discount for the sushis.

Author: jameskenglimSingapore
Title: More like Jalan AWEFUL than Jalan Alor
Review: I was in transit at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport recently and my eyes sparkled (and my taste buds tingled) when I saw the Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Kitchen. Having worked in KL for a few years, I have fond memories of Jalan Alor and the sumptuous food on offer. And I couldn't wait to lap up all that my appetite could stomach.Ignoring the sticky plastic seats, the torn faux leather booth seats, the overwhelming crowd (there were a grand total of 4 diners), and the less-than-enthusiastic staff, I happily trooped over to the counter and ordered Penang Prawn Mee while my wife hankered for the Curry Mee.The food, when it arrived, looked nothing like the pictures above the counter. Against my better judgement, I chose to tuck in. The prawns looked miserably half cooked. The broth was tasteless, and I am being kind with my comments. I looked over at my wife and she wasn't a happy trooper either. Her soup was blessed with a (un)healthy dose of sambal chilli. Totally devoid of taste, character and visual pleasantries, the noodles swam languidly in the hot oily chilli water.Like the food, the price we paid for what they tried to pass off as food, was disturbing.We had 2 mouthfuls, at best. And left....for good.Shame on you guys.
Restaurant: Jalan Alor Malaysian Street Food Kitchen (KLIA)

Author: ekta pMalaysia
Title: Overcharged me while claiming they have promo!
Review: They show 50% off on happy hours on cake and drinks menu, however did not give any discount. Unfortunately I was busy chatting with my friend to notice the bill till I got home. Their drinks were so disappointing and cake was average. The place feels like an old kopitiam and was a let down from its pictures.

Author: Iggies64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Enough said. You must go
Review: We knew you needed to book, we’d heard there’s always line ups. Now we know why. Food selection is of a wide variety and with interesting combinations. The food is of a high quality in a very clean shop lot environment. Staff are helpful and friendly. Come again they said... and we will.

Author: Francisco DLondon, England, United Kingdom
Title: Typical Indiana and Malay cuisine
Review: One of the best food ever eaten in Malaysia, perfect set up and incredible service. Ever time we went to eat at The Gulai we eat some food as it was delicious ( onion soup, oxtail soup, deep fried fish and tandory meat, also coconut ice cream, fresh garlic naan bread)

Author: CityGal2705
Title: Halal & easy dining
Review:
Halal & easy dining

Classic dish like Nasi Bojari is still there. Always satisfying comfort food and dish is all quite big.
Only ala carte order like rendang is small maybe.

Author: Gillian MBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: Good meat, poor service
Review: This restaurant would get a much lower rating if it wasn't for the head waiter Andy Tee. We were seated in the bar area because the restaurant was full which was fine as we hadn't made a reservation. However the waiters dealt with later arriving clients, ignoring us. The aforementioned Andy Tee who we believe is the head waiter spotted the oversight and quickly took our order himself. We shared a beef carpaccio for starters which had clearly been taken out of the freezer as it was so cold. We had some wine and iced water (no charge) which was served ok. A waiter attempted to deliver our main courses whilst we were still eating our starter but was ushered back into the kitchen by Andy Tee. Whilst the meat dishes (lamb cutlets and short rib beef) were delicious, the accompanying potatoes were cold. We sent back the potatoes and they returned two minutes later exactly the same. We explained our problem to Andy Tee and were promptly delivered fresh hot potato a few minutes later. We ordered an additional glass of wine which failed to materialise and again Andy Tee intervened and delivered it promptly. Then the waitress suddenly appeared with two glasses of wine and Andy chased her. We ordered dessert which we watched being walked round the restaurant and back to the kitchen, and eventually it appeared five minutes later. Overall the food was good but we feel sorry for Andy, his staff need so much more training.

Author: Chockiechic
Title: Lack the “Wow” factor
Review: Hubs brought us there to celebrate our anniversary. Service crew was top notch - they made effort to engage you throughout your meal and are very attentive generally. Just a slight setback in that some of the staff can do with better diction/clearer speech when presenting the dishes, as we needed them to repeat a couple of times trying to catch/understand what they were trying to describe about the dishes presented. We ordered the medium tier tasting menu. DC seem to like his truffles a lot. Honestly of all the dishes on the menu, the ones that had anything to do with truffles turned out pretty decent - especially his signature truffle oil pasta. The other dishes were not impressionable. Did not help that DC liked to have Japanese fusion in his dishes. As we have been spoilt by Chef Ori (from Sushi Ori) on couple of other occasions with his gastronomical presentation of Japanese food flavours, DC’s attempt to recreate Japanese fusion in his offering turned out to be sorely disappointing to us. Although this restaurant has a fantastic selection of cheeses to boot, the serving portions that they give borders on pathetic/miserly.

Author: Pohsze
Title: Overrated. Not worth visiting.
Review: Food was so-so. Overrated price. Small portion. Staff/the owner was a bit rude to us and attitude was quite bad.

Author: Panda ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the queue!
Review: Been to Melaka a couple of times but didn't know about this Putu Piring stall at all. Not until this trip where we met a nice local friend who brought us around to try local delicacies. Taste was just right for us and the owner was generous with the gula melaka filling! We waited around 15 - 20 mins for our order of 30pcs and its definitely worth the wait !

Author: Gracie2307Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great food, authentic taste
Review: What a little gem in a not so expected location.This restaurant together with it's staff is a little gem. Very clean, very professional and very good food.We ate here for lunch on a business meeting. I was expecting good food and what I got was great food. The lamb is so tender, the dips are so smooth, and the bread is to die for. They cook it all fresh, so what you get is really "A grade" quality food.I have been to many middle eastern food outlets and I generally leave with a lingering taste in my mouth, or find that a few hours later I can still taste the meal (not in a nice way).With this place you don't get any of that, and I put it down to their lack of preservatives and freshness in their cooking. You don't have to look hard to see that, and once you taste the food you will agree.The pricing is around 40-75 Ringgit for 2 persons for a very decent meal.I would say this is right on the money, as the food quality, cleanliness and service is excellent for that price.

Author: onghm6950
Title: Expensive
Review: The food is just so-so. The chicken is not served hot. The chicken is so skinny, less meat. The soy sauce is too salty. We were shocked when we were given the bill!

Author: christophery2015
Title: Great food and service
Review: The carbonara spaghetti is something u should seek. Rich in cheese and bacon. Credits to Jeeva from Prego for his recommendation.

Author: izwanhShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food
Review: Went here for early lunch, I don't think they were officially open at the time but the lady there is nice enough to take my order.. Tried their nasi goreng kampung and asam pedas fish? Actually I forgot the actual name of the dish, but both was good and generous portion size.. Price wise is right in the middle between not too expensive, not cheap either.. I don't think this place is halal certified as it serves liquor but they don't serve pork

Author: GeochongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: worth a try
Review: visited on a Sunday night. it wasn't crowded and service was prompt. However as they prepare food enough for the day so some of the dishes were not available at night. better to come for lunch. The prawns and vegetable masak lemak were good. Fried chicken was average. would come back again.

Author: JLee23Friedrichshafen, Germany
Title: Enjoyable food
Review: We went there due to recommendation of a chef. We really enjoyed the Chiccetti, chef's selection of nine dishes. Three different types of croquets, snapper, bruschetta, pancake, grilled vegetables, clams, and prawns. Love the basil panna cotta with berry sauce and the mint soda drinks. I didn't know what panna cotta is and a guy, probably the owner showed us from the kitchen. Food and drinks are great. The staff service could certainly be improved - do not confuse the diners. We only understand the owner and not any of the two serving staff.

Author: gabgabziePuchong
Title: Good way to start your Ipoh Foodie Trail
