Review: My friend took me here to start our Ipoh Foodie Trail. Gotta love the dim sum, fresh prawns. Love their fried Yam with ribs too. We didn't get to try the CCF there but overall it was good. Service was average considering it was quite busy when we went there. The only let down for me is the fact that they don't have the salted egg yolk bun. Would've made it to perfect if they have :)
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: ComdrJeff
Title: Wanted to try the so-called 'best' mee hoon kueh.
Review: The food is ok but be prepared to wait more than 30 mins. The lady boss is a little cocky maybe because the shop is so popular. But we probably won't go back there anymore.

Author: abbieevans11Perth, Australia
Title: Very poor service
Review: My partner and I chose Laypark for lunch as it was close to our hotel and we were very hungry after a long flight. We were invited to choose a table as there were only a few others in the restaurant at the time. We waited for what felt a very long time before having to ask a waiter if we could order. My partner and I both ordered the duck noodles and we were sternly told, there’s no duck. After quickly choosing something else and closing our menus, we waited for fifteen minutes whilst engaging in eye contact with the waiter several times to hint we were ready to order. We decided half an hour was too long to wait just to order, so we left. Considering there were four wait staff wandering around the restaurant, the service was very poor and rude.

Author: Adrian P
Title: In need of good food
Review: Cheap, very friendly and yummy food. Well worth the money and the mango lassi was amazing. Lamb biryani was so tender and they keep bringing condiments .

Author: Bluebutterfl
Title: Mind blowing 🐯👌👍✌🤘❤
Review: This lounge is super underrated for me. this lounge is one of the best lounges easily top 10 in Asia not only Malaysia . I've been going to shisha lounges for over 15 years and the vibe along with the customer services is incredible beautiful.they are smart, they are super friendly ,they are attentive ⏰.Food awesome. Drinks also amazing . ‍Shawn(host) he make your day special  . none here you won't be disappointed  Thankyou canopy

Author: DrTaufiq
Title: Meat Galore
Review: Great place for meat lovers. You get free flow of all sorts of meat brought straight from the grill and skewered off to your plate. Also serves a wide variety of other foods if you ever get sick of the meat

Author: dai77
Title: Great food and dtaff
Review: First night in KL and went here due to Tripadvisor reviews. Great environment, awesome food (dumplings, beef rendang and crab and avocado salad) and brilliant staff. Particular mention for Marvin - lovely, knowledgeable guy who made our night.

Author: winstonlaw
Title: Thumbs up
Review: I've frequent this place since I was little. Until now, the taste is still the same. My favourite. The meat is soft and tender and the gravy is tasty. One dish of rice is never enough for me.

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic meal and atmosphere
Review: Read the reviews on TA and knew this would be a place we would have to visit whilst in George Town. Walking distance to our hotel it seemed a perfect place to celebrate my wife's birthday with our baby daughter. On arrival we were really impressed with the decoration and the greenery outside of the restaurant. You can tell a lot by simple touches, and you could see that the owners have really made an effort. We were greeted by staff to the table outside and they straight away got a highchair for our baby daughter, without us asking. Throughout the whole entire the meal all the staff were so friendly and helpful and catered to our every requirement. They also were extremely playful with our daughter, which mad sour dining experience a whole lot easier.The tasting platter my wife and I chose to share as we liked the concept of trying lots of dishes on the menu, and this did that. Wow! It was incredibly good. Each dish was so flavoursome and authentic. It included sides and a little desert. Our meal was very reasonable we felt for what we paid and we enjoyed an excellent evening. All to the help of the staff and the chef. Keep it up Mews! Thank you for providing such a fantastic meal on a special occasion.

Author: WusserladDerby, United Kingdom
Title: A Fantastic Restaurant!
Review: Popped along due to the reviews, all I can say is WOW!No exaggeration the food served here is some of the best I have ever eaten in 47 years!The flavour of everything is incredible.No alcohol served but not an issue.The service is excellent.Give it a try, it is brilliant!

Author: J9279JTnataliepBucharest, Romania
Title: 1. Love 1. Indifferent
Review: Amazing how two people can come to the same restaurant and have such a different opinion as they leave. Me: had the house cocktail (has Malibu in it which believe me is rare these days). Was very different from anything I’ve had before. Thoroughly enjoyed and would’ve gladly had a 2nd. Also they use metal straws so thumbs up for the environment as well. Then I had a beef noodle dish. Was absolutely delicious. Big portion. Couldn’t finish it. My partner: ordered a negroni. Was not what he is used to. Was there interpretation. Very watery. He then had the Nasi Aram Pontay (hope I’ve spelt that right). Beautifully presented but a bit bland and boring. Service was excellent. Waiter offered to make my partner a new drink. Really nice little place. Not pretentious. Vegetarians can get a good meal here. I would come back, my partner wouldn’t.

Author: Q4750BAchrisl
Title: Pork knuckle was not properly cooked
Review: When I started on my pork knuckle, the meat was tender, but not falling-off-the-bone as I expected. But soon I got closer to the bone and found the meat was still pink. I stopped with 1/2 the dish uneaten. We were always told that pork must be well done - this was not.I ask the staff about the dish, but there was no response from the chef.While paying the bill I asked about the pink pork and was toll "Chef says the meat is cooked." No apology.BTW, I attempted to post a comment onto The Yum List, but my comment never surfaced. Make what you will about that!

Author: zulrubaie
Title: Famous Chicken Chop in Johor Bahru
Review: IT Roo is famous with Chicken Chop claim is the best chicken chop in Johor Bahru beside selling chicken chop the restaurant offer verity of western and chinese food.

Author: Geraldine G
Title: Penang food in KL
Review: Great place to get local penning food in KL within having to travel to Penang. My fav are char kuey teow, acar fish set and rojak buah. Service is prompt.

Author: Fandogh7Frankfurt, Germany
Title: Unprofessional staff and crew
Review: Despite the food is delicious but the management and the staff crew I can give them 20 out of 100! In my recent experience, even though I booked a table, it was given another group whom they booked the same table with same time! and the staff rather than make solve, or apologizing about their mistake, presenting the evidence and some excuses which was not acceptable at all!In another experience, one of the crew made mistake in bringing the additional dish, which was highlighted in order time to cancel. after serving the ordered dishes, once the additional dish was rejected from table due to it was not in order list, the supervisor was punishing the staff by paying the rejected dish by himself in front of us. Even though we accepted to pay the mistaken dish's price but behavior of supervisor in front of customers and punishing his staff was totally unpleasant and unprofessional at all.!!! Also , They do not accept card , have to pay by cash!!! Amazing!

Author: pinkrazeKuala Lumpur
Title: Below average food
Review: I was recommended by my friend to visit this place. Was told that it willl be a unique experience but food is average. I set low expectation but the food was way worse than what I have expected. Dining tables were small and food was below average. Apart from being able to dine in total darkness, there is nothing to shout about.

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: Food here is generally quite good. It's Chinese mixed with some Nyonya influences. The outstanding dishes are the pandan chicken (sold per piece) and yong chow fried rice (which has that traditional yong chow taste and wok hei).On Fridays they have a very nice Nyonya laksa set, which is delicious and value for money.

Author: 888travelKaron, Thailand
Title: Only 4 dishes on the menu!
Review: Ok, so everyone goes here for the laksa - which was very nice, but apart from that, there were only 3 other dishes on offer (char kway teow, and something with rice). So don’t make a special trip if you’re after more to eat than just a bowl of laksa!It was nice but this place probably doesn’t deserve a top 10 rating on the basis of one dish alone.

Author: Gnatti79Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fake italian
Review: The name itself does not promise anything good, it sounds italian but, in a way, it has no meaning...The place is nice, with the exception of the uncomfortable chairs of the outdoor tables. View is limited but ok. Service is good. And, as long as they call it “restaurant”, it is is definitely a bad one. Most supposed-to-be or supposed-to-sound-like italian dishes are just a bad imitation. We tried 4 dishes and none of them was at least decent. The dessert was ok. If you want italian food, you have plenty of choices in KL!! Go somewhere else. If you want the view, there are also much better places! A disaster!

Author: MEAFaroAlgarve, Portugal
Title: Good Malaysian food, nice place
Review: Elegant, modern, very busy, cosmopolitan.Supposedly traditional Malaysian food, but served in an elegant way, we ate a mix of starters, incredible duck legs, plus a dessert of pandan leaves .... It was my favorite dinner in Malaysia. Starter, main, dessert, accompanied by 2 beers ( each) cost 80 euros ( for two). It is not cheap for Malaysia but it is reasonable.I recommend booking a table

Author: Cheryl_BillRedding, Connecticut
Title: My "Go to" Place for entertaining
Review: Recently opened in the heart of KLCC. This bar/restaurant offers spectacular views of the city sky line. I have not eaten in the actual restaurant but have been twice now to the bar restaurant. Food is great compared to other bar options, fresh tasting and not overly fried. Pizzas great for sharing, different options on brushcetta, calamari, etc. And reasonably priced given KLCC location. You need to reserve in advance if you want outdoor seating but indoor offers just as an amazing view with floor to ceiling windows. Very comfortable sofas and chairs and perfect for entertaining a group. Staff are extremely attentive and offer great recommendations. Good place for entertaining clients. Opens at 6pm in the Trillion Building.

Author: ethan m
Title: Only out of convenience
Review: Food doesnt taste good esp the fried items which had a heavy taste of oil.  Noodles taste too floury and dense.  a lot of artificial taste enhancers

Author: deeeeMidlands
Title: Is lovely atmosphere
Review: Great dining restaurant open all day ....great selection on offer . Breakfast was very good with fresh juice station and lovely selection of breads etc on offer.
Restaurant: The Pomelo - The Banjaran Hotsprings Retreat

Author: neildonovan81
Title: Crap Indian
Review: Don't bother ... Who uses a chicken leg in their curries? , dry bland and doesn't resemble any of the classic Punjab dishes with the set thali menu.. Service is ok

Author: ommsamz
Title: COOL PROMOTION
Review: You can get 10% off when you post your experience on Facebook and instagram plus additional 5% when you give review on google review.

Author: Julie OMarmion, Australia
Title: Overpriced, badly cooked, terrible accoustics.
Review: Took my dad as a special treat for him when visiting from the uk and wished we had gone somewhere else. The accoustics in the restaurant are terrible and the noise from other diners was almost unbearable. We ordered our steaks (3 different selections from the list) and when i asked if there was any sauces to accompany the steak I was told no only mustard as it was important to taste the wonderful falvour of the meat... fair enough. So we were absolutely horrified when they came out piled high with roasted garlic cloves... at least 25 of them on each steak.... We told the server that perhaps they needed to tell people that this was the way they served them and at least give people the choice but she appeared disinterested in our views and gave the impression we were being difficult customers. All we could taste was garlic... for the entire night and the next day as well. One steak alone was 180rm so at this price i at least expect to be able to taste the meat. Will never return. Will never recommend to anyone. Overpriced gimmicky restaurant.

Author: Nick DBlandford Forum, United Kingdom
Title: Straight forward good value
Review: The staff were pleasant enough and attentive but not overly so. I had a plain chicken curry which was freshly cooked and a good sized portion but not particularly special in its flavour. My wife had the tandoori chicken and thoroughly enjoyed and remarked on the freshly cooked naan bread.

Author: LordOfKendalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: LACKING IN PASSION
Review: Anak muda, tak kira kerja dimana, KLCC ka, kampung Baru ke, bila masak tu buat lah dengan berahi dan bersemangat. A chef’s work is not that difficult but you need a tremendous amount of passion. It was clear from the Chicken Chop I ordered, the passion was missing

Author: 27Vivien77
Title: Nice chicken rice balls!
Review: If you like something a little different, the chicken rice here has chicken served with rice balls. I liked it! At times, there is a long queue - chicken in soy sauce is tender and the chilli goes well with it. Worth a visit!

Author: Joonghoseoul
Title: The worst Omakase I have ever seen.
Review: I think this restaurant is not real Japnaese restaurant. The loacation is quite good and atmoshpere is also nice.BUT THAT'S IT. THAT'S ALL. Food and ingreidient is never fine dining. You can experience terrible Nobu in your life here. I wondered that NOBU HQ not test quality control in the other country.Comparing Hawaii NOBU, this restaurant is absoultely different. We can`t expect same quality and servce.According to cheif`s recommedation, I orderd special omakase. But the name of the menu was special, real dishes was so terrible.Food and dishes is altered for decoration and atmoshpere. If you expect the taste, please don` go this restaurt. Additonaly, sales manager is very rude. After compaling about the course, she noegotiated me to discount price. If you enjoy real japanese for tradational, you must not go there. Staff and cheif is like learner from school and institution, They are not proffessional. I wonder whether is issue in ML or just Nobu. P.S. When I complaint about the food, staff asked me wheter I am Japnaese. So rude things.

Author: MellowtraxCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Too expensive
Review: We decided to celebrate my birthday here and made booking in advance. To get a table with a good view to the twin towers we were told to spend a minimum of 300 Ringgit per person. Upon arrival we got a table with limited view to the twin towers. We decided to try the Tradition menu (8 courses) which was 580 RM per person (10 % service charge and 6 % GST not included). The food was good, but not even close to other top restaurants around the world. I was quite disappointed given the price (165 USD per person). The service was average, but inconsistent. Sometimes we hadn't finished our course before they wanted to take our plates, other times we waited a long time for service.The restaurant is very dark, and the evening we visited (Tuesday) it was half empty. To get to the restaurant we had to take 3 different lifts.If you consider to eat at a good restaurant in KL I can't recommend Marini's. The price is too high given the standard, and you can find a lot of other places to eat with the same standard for less money.

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Seafood in Buntal
Review: First things first, the boss here is super chatty and some people might find him arrogant if you meet him for the first time (Yes, he always talks about the ministers that dine in his restaurant). This is a family-run business unlike the nearby Lim Hock Ann which has been very commercialised. As it is a small business, sometimes they do not have seafood that you may want to have. The place may look a bit run-down but do not fret, it is always a good option to dine here. Besides the seafood, they are also famous for their kampung chicken (you have to pre-order before coming).

Author: nuriannadSelangor
Title: Terrible service
Review: I was a regular customer since Pasta Zanmai opened in Empire Shopping Gallery. All the while the service was good especially one of the season waiter, I think he is a foreigner with good manners and excellent customer service but today he was not there and there was one of the waitress who was pratically ignoring me. We came earlier than some of the couples and they were served with food before us. We were waiting patiently till i asked the waitress how long does it take, she didn't even bother to stop and inform me just looked at me and passed by. The worst customer service in my life. Will never come there again. VERY DISAPPOINTED

Author: sebastiand496Unterpinswang, Austria
Title: Tourist Trap
Review: This place is a rooftop on the second floor were you can’t see the twin towers. The staff was rude and unfriendly. Now I now why we had to pay for all 40 people in advance.Beside being well treated as a guest I prefer to look down from a rooftop bar rather than looking up.

Author: StephenTheHungry
Title: Lovely
Review: Succulent duck and lovely flavours all around. Gentle live piano music serenaded us and all around a super dinner

Author: keekeat82Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Super nice Churros!
Review: It was our second visit to this quiet yet comfy cafe, we went there on Friday afternoon and it was pretty quiet with very few customers. Glad that we ordered the Churros because it was so delicious, crispy outside and so soft and tender inside, the best Churros that I ever had so far. Will definitely go back again when I visit to Ipoh, thumbs up!

Wow the cakes are tasty and cheap too.The spaghetti and the chicken chop are delicious very generous with the portion we can’t finish and have to share it with our friends.Since I already felt in love with the cakes I make my 2nd trip the next day just to get more cakes so that I can share them with my family and friends. Author: 997sallybKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Didn't wow us
Review: We arrived early because we wanted to see the place before it got crowded. Took some pictures and sat quietly to wait to be shown to the table. We were led to the table about 10 minutes before the kitchen started. We were given a table with a full view of the Petronas Towers, well impressed. The menu was left with us to peruse.A selection of finger bites was brought to our table together with a small bowl of salad. Even the beverages like hot coffee or tea got to be ordered no juices but a glass of cold water.We ordered 4 dishes of hot food, when they arrived there were lukewarm. The portion was tiny, like two bite sides on a side plate. There were 2 pieces of clam swimming in white cream sauce. 2 prawn balls and a plate of fried turnip cakes.We ordered some more hot food but we waited and waited nothing came. In the end we had to dive in on the desserts buffet to fill our hunger. When the desserts were eaten, our second round of hot food still nowhere in sight. Got to reprimand the man in suit as the waitress seemed to be afraid to find out for us!Later on we were told the computer crashed and the kitchen lost our orders. Kitchen melt down....This was a New Year's Day Festive High on Flavours lunch as advertised. It didn't give me the wow experience. The food served was bland, and the portions as wee. It was more like a tasting menu with a hefty price tag.

Author: Maiden0422Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Worst Buffet ever tried
Review: Book for 7..place nicely decorated but the moment started the dinner our appetite drops. Nothing much to grab and most the food is tastless and even the cendol us stale..luckily my kids did not consume it.After 30 minutes we left after paying.

Author: PeepohPandaKota Kinabalu, Malaysia

We had a good meal together, only gripe is the lack of variety and slightly more exotic food, eg sushi/sashimi, dim sum , or something oriental/Japanese. But if you want a good place to dine with family or friends, and reasonably tasty food, and entitled to discount, this is a good place.

Author: helmutdethaas

Review:
Had the fish and chips, restaurant is very slick with nice background music and a lovely atmosphere. 
Waiting staff are very attentive and friendly

Title: Well Worth the Wait
Review: This eating establishment has been around Penang for a while now. My friends took me here for dinner. We got here just a few minutes before 6pm and it was already a full house. After we got seated, I noticed that people started lining waiting to get a table. I understand that the line gets really long and people are willing to wait.My friends who were Penang locals, did the ordering of food and when our food arrived, I see why people are willing to stand in line and wait. It's because the food was off the hook! So tasty and delicious! Perfectly seasoned and even their fried chicken, which was one of the food items that was ordered, was out of this world! One word for all the food we ate...Delish!I highly recommend this place if you're ever in Penang. Make sure you get there before 6pm so you can get a table.

Review: Staff at are very friendly and welcoming and the location is set nicely. My steak was unseasoned and it was not fresh, definitely defrosted! Very disappointed :(

Title: Local style Local service
Review: Food I can said average coz I order teowchew steam fish and come out with mix .Person who take order, dun know she think I cant pay or she help customer save money ,order 2 fish for 2 table , each table can get 1 fish , but they serve half fish for each table. Title: earned experience and good food
Review: it's a lot of fun , totally dine in the dark , i was wondering how's it work until i get there . Very trustful crew and tasty meal. RM200 per pax, it's worth to pay for the delicious food and experience !

Author: CallaBudgieFrankfurt, Germany
Title: New place with potential
Review: This nice little BBQ restaurant is run by the owners that operate fatCUPID. When we ate at fatCUPID they made us aware of their new opening so we decided to give it a try as we were always happy at their first place. We were friendly greeted and quickly got our drinks the so called freezers made from different juices. A little bit to icy to drink but tasty. We ordered food and their different combos are very nice with different homemade dips and spicy marinades. Chicken and beef satay and grilled chicken were of nice quality and perfectly prepared on the fire. Service was attentive but needs some more training to handle guest complaints. The quality of the lamb chops was a desaster though. The so called chops were one 200g piece of meet which you could actually eat only 15% or 4 bites of. The rest was grease and absolutely unedible. We complained with the waiter and he wanted to talk to the chef about the meat. We decided to have some ice cream as dessert which was of nice quality.Only when settling the bill the manager came to explain and apologize that they did not get the quality they wanted for the meat because of Christmas. Hey guys, then take it from the menu if it does not meet your quality standards which are obviously existing. Also it would have been a nice gesture to take the dessert from the bill which you did not. The restaurant has enough potential to be nice. When they improve on the described quality issues which are hopefully only some start up glitches there is clear potential for more than 3,5 stars (which I would have given if possible).

Author: thomasedwardsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A bit pretentious.
Review: Not bad, good pizza, but the Chef seems to be a bit pretentious. Asked for black pepper as the salad needed it as it wasn't seasoned to my preference. Was told that the chef didn't allow black pepper to be served, same thing with chilli flakes and was told they would only serve chilli oil, maybe I don't want to add extra oil...If it was perfect then maybe they could get away with it, but it wasn't. Rather arrogant to assume everybody wants it's the chefs way..in the end it's a decent pizza place, but it's still a pizza place. I've never come across that attitude in some of the best restaurants in the world and to come across it here was a surprise. Pizza was good, toppings wise the carne could of done with less, was nice but soggy in the middle because of too much topping. My wife had the spicy pizza with pumpkin which she enjoyed, but the chilli paste overwhelmed the flavor of the pumpkin.

Author: BrotherDragonSingapore
Title: Highly Recommended But Food Quality Is Unacceptable
Review: Foodie friends of mine in Singapore and Malacca highly recommended this restaurant to me. Being a huge fan of Peranakan food I was in all anticipation. Phone reservation for a table was made a week earlier for I was told the place is always fully booked.For the three of us, I ordered the Kueh Pie Ti, Ayam Buah Keluak, Item Tim, Otak Otak Panggang, Ikan Cilli Garam, Telur Dadar Cinchaluk, Chap Chye and Udang Goreng Asam.The Kueh Pie Tee starter kicked off to a very good start. Flavourful and delicious, the pastry shell was crispy and fresh tasting.But after that, it was downhill all the way.Next to arrive was the Itek Tim (duck with salted vegetables soup). It tasted ducky and it came warm, not hot. And it was served in a chipped bowl.The Ikan Cilli Garam, fried fish slices topped with a spicy sauce. While the sauce was delicious and not too salty, the fish meat was soft and mushy. Certainly not very fresh fish. Quality control failed badly here.The Otak-Otak Panggang was just a slab of fish cake coated with a coconuty rempah (spice paste). Fish cake? Maybe that's their style, but it is the first time I have eaten this version in a Peranakan restaurant. And it came steamed not grilled as advertised. Usually, the fish meat is minced and mixed with the spice paste and then either steamed or grilled.The Udang Goreng Asam tasted right but why so much gravy? Isn't it supposed to be drier? The highlight of a peranakan meal is usually the Ayam Buah Keluak, chicken cooked with keluak nuts in a spicy sauce. Again, the sauce was great but three of the six buay keluak nuts were one step away of being rancid. How could this be allowed in a nyonya kitchen? The cook would have been banished from the kitchen for life!The Telur Dadlar Cincaluk and Chap Chye were okay but nothing to rave about.After this bad experience, we didn't dare order any of the desserts and waste more money.I don't know what happened to this restaurant as I trusted my foodie friends' tastebuds. But never again will I step into it.

Author: John F
Title: Average
Review: Food okay, service slow, below average and non attentive. Took awhile to clear the table.  Had to request for the table to be wiped. Overall an average experience.

Author: formulafrog GCairns, Australia
Title: A major disappointment
Review: This restaurant had rave reviews in our guidebook, and seems to be relying on that legacy. It had queues out the door everytime we went past it (on the weekend). When we did go it was a huge disappointment. The starter was good, but the main course of duck was a bowl of bones. The staff seemed unhappy and disinterested.

Author: 639abbie
Title: Didn't loaf it
Review: Bought the lemon cheese cream oyaki from little Tokyo section of pavilion and really nothing worth raving about. You can g downstairs to get it reheated but it is just airy bread with warm cream cheese filling. Looks better than taste

Author: 496PaulW496Daresbury, United Kingdom
Title: Great street food
Review: We walked past and then went back to try when we saw other options The lady helped us with both size of plates to order and type of food. For me the food was better then some expensive restaurants we had tried in Hong Kong. Great location on the corner and can see the kL tower and twin towers above the buildings in the sky line We will return here to try more

Author: badger w

Review: The view is amazing. However, we were very disappointed by the food. The pasta with coniglio was done badly and the price was ridiculous! Might go there for the bar but not for the food ever again!

Author: KingKong58718London, United Kingdom
Title: Poor substandard food
Review: The food choice was not good especially it is a buffet. Our hotel had more variety of foods to chose from. The dessert slection is poor and the quality of the desserts were poor.They need to provide variety of food like what you would find in a buffet restaurant. There was long queue to use the lift to go up to the restaurant and also to go down. We had to wait 5-10mins. Also the lift was congested with people.We went for lunch at 1.30pm and while we are eating, the waiter interrupts our meal and suggesting that we pay for the meal. Not only us, but to everyone else! This is poor and sub standard for a known establishment. The view is good from the restaurant. Also; water, tea and coffee is included in the buffet, but not soft drinks.My suggestion for atmosphere 360 would be to go and see what other places like Traders hotel, Shangri-LI hotel and other hotels and how they offer buffet service and quality of the food they have. The quality of the food is very very poor and very limited choice!I regretted coming to Atmosphere 360 as the food choices and the quality is absolutely poor! The only thing I enjoyed was the view, apart from that, nothing spectacular.

Review: Tourists who like to be charmed by old authentic restaurant will have enough reason to be delighted here. Specially contrived for such purpose, the restaurant must have seen a regular throng of adventure seekers who arrived in tour buses. Food is fair but the price is rather steep. We like the fried chicken which is a house's specialty and the assam prawn has a rich flavor. The steamed fish we ordered was good but at RM118 I rather give it a miss! I won't return again as this looks like authentic no more!

Author: ReddyR312578Melbourne, Australia
Title: AVOID THIS RESTAURANT FOREVER...
Review: Went for dinner with my brother. Decent food. Over priced coupled with the worst service ever... EVER. The head waiter, Anthony Raj, was arguing with us and would not stop. Unheard of. The hawker stalls have better standards and service. The owner should seriously look in to it and change the staff without further delay. I don't think you need to bring all the way from india to provide such horrendous service. Spoiled our mood and wasted our night.The manager, Suresh, seems to be an ok guy. We did not even get an apology. Of the 28 reviews including mine, 6 reviewers have rated the service terrible. Now, you do the math. Tripadvisor should insist that they should remove the sticker from their door. Avoid this restaurant. There are better choices in KL. Will never go back again.

Review: Location, setting, decor & atmosphere were all OK, Menu was about right; enough selection to please most tastes. Wine list was a little disappointing if you want NZ Sav Blanc or similar (OK it's an Italian restaurant) & very few wines by the glass considering it uses the term Wine-bar...Food was pretty average, our initial server was engaging and pleasant but the remainder were a little unsure of themselves.

Review: I am surprise that this bar allowed smoking drink and eat. Although it might normal in Malaysia, but most hotel bar of my frequent travel destination had ban smoking. For me as single diner, it's perfectly suite me after all day meeting . Beside I had great steak from next door, I personally adore the decor and massive selection of whisky. The extra plus point , i don't need step out from the hotel and friendly bar staff.

Author: Tas193Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
Title: Extremely Disappointed
Review: We visited Atmosphere 360 for afternoon tea. We paid approx £12 per person. The experience left us extremely disappointed to say the least. The restaurant from inside needs some serious refurbishment. It looks dull and dreary from the moment you enter.There is no variety or quality in the items on offer for the afternoon tea. Poor selection, poor quality and poor service to top it off. Waste of money!I wouldn't recommend this place, unless you really want to experience the 'rotating restaurant' for the views. Some nice views from the top.

Author: clementsim
Title: Ok, But Overrated on TripAdvisor
Review: It's very busy. It took 15 for our drinks to be served. Food was ok, nothing bad but nothing fantastic either.

Author: Noren17y
Title: Arrogant business attitude
Review: They have delicious quiches but extremely arrogant staff. And try and figure out this logic. I asked if I could buy a whole quiche. There were 4 in the display window. The boy refuses. He said if they sell it all "there will be angry customers tomorrow". So I said, so you won't sell it to me today even if I get angry? "No". So what if my daughter sat here and ordered 8 slices and there were none left for tomorrow, how will you deal with that? "You're not going to do that." What if 8 of my friends walked in right now and finished your quiche? "we are not a restaurant or bakery." there you've heard it from them. So know that they are saving their quiches for certain customers "tomorrow" they don't want to anger.

Author: juhar1234Tampere, Finland
Title: Not worth visiting
Review: Me and my wife had our last dinner in Penang, saw the good reviews here and decided to go. Sadly we were disappointed. The starters were good and a little spicy, the fish -stake a little odd though. Our main courses were small and bland, the chili crab buns had absolutely no chili (or any flavour whatsoever) and inside was one lettuce, one deep fried shrimp and some mayonnaise, on the side a few curly fries. Also we felt like we weren't welcomed as there were 3 tables with big families and the waiters took pictures of them etc and none bothered to even tell us about the menu. As we finally asked for our check the waiter looked closely next to me as I counted my money. No one thanked or said goodbyes as we left. We felt treated as unwanted customers but with no reason we could think of. Not worth your money, there are many excellent restaurants in Georgetown to go to instead.

Author: AuntyAyuPetaling Jaya, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: Don’t know why this place is full. Our experience was far from satisfactory. One of our orders came 1/2 hr late, after we asked about it. Turned out the Chef wasn’t happy with the dish! Then, my friend found 2 strands of short hair at the bottom of her pasta bowl!! Horrors!! Then, came the ultimate let-down: no compensation as the dish was nearly finished???! Hello!! She found the hairs at the BOTTOM of her bowl - disgusting!! Felt like vomiting coz I had 2 scoops myself We all decided NOT to ever visit this place ever again!

Author: et0212Malaysia
Title: Lunch at Alexis
Review: I ordered a fish and chips, pepperoni pizza and French fries with 2 drinks it came up to 170 ringgit which I am ok with if the food was good. Unfortunately the fish came smaller then a woman’s palm size and the chips were horrible stale dense yet not fried to crisp, for 50 ringgit the lease you could do is serve proper tasting chips. I asked for mayo and ketchup that was a mistake as they use the cheapest source possible. Ketchup is pink and very sweet mayo who knows where it’s from it was all very disappointing. It seems like the price has gone up to recover from the loss during the pandemic and the size of meals have reduced. This is understandable but don’t screw the customers as they will not return again.

Author: LongitudinalShift
Title: What yousee is not what you get
Review: The place has a nice vibe to it. Pretty casual and above the pavement for outside eating. I've been looking for a place that does decent pizza since I arrived in KL a month ago, and unfortunately this one strikes out as well.Simply the pizza you get is not what you see on the menu. Even when the menu statues 'Pizza pictured is Pepperoni & Mushroom' what you get is missing all the good bits from the picture. Blatant false advertising.To boot it tasted like any old typical chain pizza with way too much cheese smothering what there was of the other toppings. Tasted pretty bland.I'll give them another go and try a burger next time but after that...

Review: My friends and I had three types of briyani- chicken, prawn and another (can't remember the name), fish tikka, raita, chicken curry. All of the items were very yummy. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal. The fish tikka was superb and the condiments served together with it was also great.Ambiance was average but clean. Staff were efficient and service was good. Price was appropriate for the area.Would definitely go back again and would recommend to others.

Review:

The waiters/waitress are very friendly and helpful.

However, in the recent years after the renovation the restaurant it become so popular that they doesn't take care of the quality of food. True that they have a lots of crestive dim sum.. But the food doesn't taste good... Doesn't that matter?

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rack of ribs disappointing
Review: Went at a friend's recommendation because she had raved about the ribs. So we ordered it. But when it came, it was very disappointing. The meat was tender and fell off the bone, but was absolutely tasteless. Needed to smoother it with the sauce to make it edible, but then the accompanying sauce was a little too sweet. The pork chops were also tender, and tastier, but drowned in a creamy sauce - overall was OK. The best dish was the satay. Meat was tender and the satay sauce had lots of peanuts.

Author: FayDragonica
Title: Good selection of items
Review: Dine on a Saturday night with 3 other friends. Good menu. Only downside is the lack of butter to coat the meat which makes it sticky to the grill.

Author: Gina2023Canberra, Australia

Review: Stumbled across this tapas bar while wandering the streets of Melaka, a little more expensive than the local dining options but the food, sangria and the service were all brilliant. So good in fact that although I was looking forward to exploring the local food we went back here for a second meal.

Author: Romuluz75Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre and disappointing
Review: Pros :-1. Good and efficient service by the receiption  and waiting staff2. Price is OK if purchased on discount sites3. Easily accessible location4. Ambience is pleasant5. Interesting choice and variety of dessertCons :-1. Food quality is average and not  commensurating with the price paid  (if on full rate)2. Variety of Chinese and western cuisine is  poor3. Fresh Oysters are very small and quantity  lacking. Secondly the oysters were taken off  the display just before 9.00pm !4. No special car parking charges or flat rate for  diners.5. No fresh juices or soft drinks avaiable. Only  iced plain water in various flavours of lemon,  strawberry and cucumber.

Author: FancyFree007Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cockroaches running around
Review: a regular at Devi's .. good roti choices. But Just had breakfast there and sorry to say there were many cockroaches.. did not eat in peace as wondering whether kitchen is infested too. Disappointed as really a favorite family breakfast place. Devi's, please clean up and have a pest management program in place!

Author: Krystyna FFleckney, United Kingdom
Title: Great food at great prices
Review: BBQ Nights looks more like a cheap no frills cafe with plastic chairs, so you could easily pass by it and think nothing of it it, but the food is delicious. My husband and I had 2 different curries and shared them - and they were very tasty. The service was good. I would recommend coming here for good, cheap food.

Author: Maja_VilufushiThaa Atoll
Title: Highly praised and worth it
Review: This Japanese restaurant in Hotel Hilton doesn't come cheap, but the venue, menu and food is worth the price. You better book in advance to get seated, the restaurant is often sold out in the evening. Teppanyaki is very popular and skillfully executed, but hand rolled sushi and a variety of Udon broths are just as delicious. The Sake selection is impressive and the staff helpful. Service is quite quick, even if the place is fully booked. It was a wonderful experience.

Author: cmfchris
Title: Wonderful service and delicious food
Review: We celebrated my son's birthday here and thoroughly enjoyed the food and service. No doubt the food is on the pricey side but we appreciated the quality of what was served. The privacy of a room added to the experience too.

Author: Stefanielow18Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Extremely disappointing. Don't bother.
Review: I call it mass dining not fine dining. We were there for valentine's - 9 pm session (yes even fine dining go two sessions - just like Chinese New Year). I even gave them a benefit of a doubt and asked 'are you normally this busy or it's just because it's valentines' - the waiter proudly announced 'we are always this busy on weekend' - if that's the case then this place is not worth a single cent! The waiters are full of air and ignore you (not one waiter but all of them ignore you)- two of us spend close to rm900 that night - so better spend that money elsewhere right? This is fine dining - I expect my food to be served in the correct order - but guess what - like mass dining - my sashimi was actually served last - by then the tongue cannot taste the freshness of the sashimi. Totally wasted!

Author: sweel980
Title: Nothing change, except the price
Review: Patronising this many years, good food, good service, always enjoyable. Nothing change over the years, except the price, everytime price increase. Getting ex.

Author: k7cqPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: No Excuse.....
Review: What has happened at this bar? The place was empty for a saturday evening because of the holiday coming up. We sat at the bar, which was empty. We sat there for at least 15 minutes without getting any drinks. The persons behind the bar apparently don't service those sitting at the bar. One of the waiters finally stopped by. I ordered a house wine. The glass was a smaller one and had very little wine in it for what I paid. That was the last one I ordered. The waiters and bartenders didn't smile or show any social skills. I have to blame all of this on the expat manager that was there. I believe he is in over his head and doesn't know how to run a bar/restaurant. He also was afraid to make eye contact or smile, etc. He will skip this place in the future.

Author: dachtakaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: worst experience ever!
Review: we were there New Years Eve 2019..... the worst restaurant experience my husband and I have ever had! Yes, it was New Years Eve but sorry - that should NEVER be an excuse!!! Four tables of people who arrived after us, were served before us. When my meal eventually made its way to our table, it looked likes somebody's starter leftovers! I said "what is this?"..... the waiter replied very rudely "you want it or not?" Seriously???? needless to say - after this shabby service and treatment of restaurant staff, my husband and I walked away with no dinner!!! Never, EVER again will we go to or recommend - El Toro. It was appalling!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: oiram2015Malaysia
Title: excellent sandwiches and salads
Review: Great place for lunch if you fancy a sandwich or a salad. Both are jam packed with quality ingredients. The different sandwiches come on a range of different European style breads. I'm sure their other food is just as tasty. It looked great as it passed our table.

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Not up to standard
Review: I was very disappointed with 2 visits to this bar during my stay at the Shangri-la in Kuala Lumpur.On the first evening we ordered chicken wings. They were dry and over cooked. The sauce was also disappointing and required copious amounts of Tabasco sauce to give a remote taste of good wings we have had elsewhere. On the 2nd evening the beer was clearly going off. Probably because it had been stored in warm temperatures.All in all 2 very disappointing experiences when one considers its location within Shangri-la, and the hefty price tag.

Author: Phoopinder K
Title: Unpleasant experience
Review: I visited the restaurant today with some members of my family including my parents aged 79 and 84. We had a horrible experience!! Would not recommend "Flour" to anyone. We made reservations and was not informed that the restaurant was affected by the water disruption. I dread to think how our food was cooked. If we knew, we would have not gone for lunch there today as we were travelling with our elderly parents.Firstly, when we asked for two glasses of hot water for my mom and dad, we were informed by the waiter that because of the water disruption in KL they can't give it to us. Which was fine but when we asked for some hot milk to add to the masala tea (it was too strong for my dad), the waiter came back to us and told us he could not give us hot milk as he only has cold milk and he said he can't heat the milk. I then told him since he can't heat the milk, just add some hot water to it and give it to us so we could dilute the tea. He comes back to me 5 to 10 minutes later with room temperature milk. What was truly disappointing was when my dad needed to go to the toilet and the waiter than informed us that he can't use the toilet because of the water disruption. When I explained to him that my dad is 84 and he needs to use the toilet. This is where the management needs to step-up. The wait staff runs around asking a guy in a grey coat and another man who was sitting on a table across room in the restaurant which clearly was his superior. They shook their heads and sent him back to us to say too bad he couldn't do anything. None of them came up to apologise or were sorry that we had to go through this or provided an alternative for an elderly gentleman. My poor dad who had come from Seremban had be to rushed to our home in KL. In this time of Covid-19, I now wonder how the staff washed their hands or maintained good hygiene when they had no water in their toilets. I am happy to share a picture of how all of them just stood there and ignored the whole thing. Without wasting anytime or even trying to speak to the very rude staff, we rushed to get our cars. Unfortunately it was raining heavily, my dad and mom were standing at the door the waiter actually asked my dad to move further infront so he could close the door. The rain was really heavy. Instead of seating both my parents in the foyer they pushed them further into the rain Not worth your time visiting the restaurant. Lots of better Indian restaurants in KL. Can't recall how the food tasted. The poor experience with the wait staff has to be the worse I've encountered. Throughly unimpressed.

Author: ddfoodlover
Title: Great dining on the sand
Review: Great place to have a romantic dinner on the beach and watch the sunset.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: clementjnlingLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Exceptional
Review: Exceptional food, on par with that I had in Positano, if not better! Excellent service and soothing ambience. Shoutout to Anwar for his dedicated & professional service. Will definitely come back.

Author: TravellingTisyJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Extremely disappointing dining experience.
Review: Overpriced and super bland. Do not waste time or money here especially when there are so many better restaurants within a short walking distance. Even the view isn't worth it because you can get about the same view with genuine 5 star food and without being slaughtered. Mind you, I don't mind paying a premium price for good food but good food isn't found here.

Author: tm007Canberra, Australia
Title: Local restaurant experience
Review: We visited as a family of 4. The place is well populated by local families and smoking is not allowed inside (although is allowed outside).We found the food on the whole was great - although we made some choices which the kids didn't like (although the waitress did give us the heads up on what our western kids would like and not).While not as cheap as the street side food stands we though it was a good cheap eat for lunch.

Author: GanYY2009Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place for dinner
Review: we came here after a mediocre experience in Orkid Ria in Pantai Cenang, and we didn't regret it one bit. Ordered a total of 7 dishes for 5 adults for only RM 140. Most are seafood too, although the portions are all small. Now that's value formoney. Service is speedy if you come early, but risk sitting for a long time if you come later than 6.30 pm. The owner is pleasant and friendly, and the food is delicious.

Author: JamesMichaelNLSt. John's, Canada
Title: Bad coffee and unfriendly/confused service
Review: It is rare for us to leave a bad review (even average reviews!) especially considering this place was recommended so highly by friends but we didn't enjoy our time at delirium cafe. When we sat down to order the server seemed confused as to why we were there...Then when we ordered the ice coffees there was alot of back and forth about what we wanted. When the coffees finally came they didn't taste great and they were in takeaway plastic cups that kept opening up and spilling on us. Wouldn't go back sadly :(

Author: hilltribeimportPhuket
Title: A bit disappointed
Review: Atmosphere was fine, service was excellent but food and pricing were disappointing. I ordered fish and chips, I think it was 18 myr, the portion was big but unfortunately they served the cheapest farmed fish that you can buy. It's mushy and has a slightly muddy taste. It happens often and is a real pet hate of mine, 18 ringits is good money and we're on Langkawi where seafood is plentiful, give me half the serve but make it fresh caught fish please. Then there was the glass of wine, 15 ringits I think and only just okay. Remember Langkawi is a duty free island where they just about give the booze away so for what I got it was just too expensive.

Author: phait_leeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food lacks taste
Review: Decided to dine at Pampas as my friend wanted to try somewhere new. As we weren't hungry, we order 2 appetisers - US scallops and beef carpaccio. My friend reckons the scallops aren't fresh as they were chewy. And the beef carpaccio lacks taste; and the cheese scattered on top didn't help at all.For the main, i had the barramundi which was salty to the max. Service wise is good, attentive and well mannered staff.But won't be returning if the food quality is as such.

Author: ongjanice1Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not where the locals dine
Review: I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to those who are on a budget; restaurant for business and those who are willing to splurge. Btw, this restaurant is halal. Overall, the experience is average and most of the dishes are not that tasty or extraordinary. The sweet & sour crab is disappointing for me because I've tasted better. Service is good because we had a dedicated server to our table (10 of us). Other than that, nothing much to shout about.

Author: Boroboy100Marske-by-the-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food great staff
Review: We decided to have an evening meal at this restaurant after recommendations from other people, it was very nice food and the owner and staff were very nice. But I must say that it is not good value as the same quality food can be got at a third of the price in other food outlets in Batu Ferringhi.

Author: Ts D
Title: Terrible quality of food.
Review: Don't recommend anyone. Terrible food. Meet was frozen, refrozen ( have no idea from how many days it was there. Before they served it ) and tasted really really not fresh, and almost spoiled ( beef fajitas) We asked to change the meal. They Brought enchiladas with chicken ( ordered beef ). I assume beef was from few days before, so they didn't want to serve it again. However chicken didn't look better, when I opened the rolls ( super soggy btw, like it's been prepared and stored for a few days ) chicken inside was old and dry, like it's been left in the open air for a couple of days and then microwaved. My assumptions chef simply doesn't care about the quality of food that goes out of his kitchen. Don't wanna even remember about my lunch there. Terrible experience. For this quality of food I wouldn't pay more then 40RM for 2 people. While after showing to the waiter a dry like a stone old piece of chicken they bringing bill, charging like a 5 star restaurant for unfresh meat and microwaved dishes. If it would be my restaurant I would be ashamed to bring a bill even.

Author: Shawnation
Title: Delicious Classic!
Review: Delicious Chinese Foods, Unique decoration, old style, classic. Great staffs, great service, everything just simply perfect.

Author: Olga T
Title: Be careful when you pay with your bank card
Review: This used to be a very good place for me and my friends to hang out after work. Food - very good, music - very average and too loud, staff - helpful. However their staff is not responsible when making transactions for credit cards users. My card was swiped 2 times for quite a good sum of money. Now i have to go though the headache of asking my bank to solve it for me. So, be carefull with your cards or pay cash, looks like sold out likes to earn extra tips on these who uses cretit cards.

Author: kezenku5
Title: Good for eat-in
Review: Few times I bought the dishes home and often the food turned bad and ended up we couldn't eat the dishes. For eat-in, very wide selections of dishes

Author: Marcy HOsaka, Japan
Title: Not even a semblance of Indian food
Review: Please read the reviews for this place closely and make yourself aware that Kuching has virtually no Indian population. "Cheese naan", as in bread stuffed thickly with oozie cheese, is not Indian food. Neither are most of the dishes locals seems to recommend, they are all typical "mamak" Malay dishes. It's very clearly this place caters to the local Malay population as well as offering sweet and flavourless food for the local Chinese to pretend they eat Indian food - I have even eaten better Indian food in provincial towns in China... We live in London and have travelled in India, so we have had great Indian food. However, I have also eaten Indian food throughout the world, including Malaysia - where in general, Indian food is good and authentic. Still, I have to say that even the worst Indian takeaway in some rural UK town is miles better than what they served as "Indian" food here. There was no Indian staff there during our visit, our "butter paneer curry" had pieces of tofu instead of paneer and otherwise consisted of the local spicy sauce diluted with ketchup. The okra curry was okra in ketchup with cream, cooked without any spices and our "grilled meats" tasted like they were marinated in fizzy drinks. The plain rice we ordered on the side was Chinese broken rice.Service was very efficient and friendly, to be fair, and the lassi was overly sweet, but decent. Prices were absolutely ridiculous for very tiny portions, about three times the usual Kucing price.

Author: Edward NSydney, Australia
Title: Noisy but fun
Review: Enjoyed a business dinner with a group of thirteen. Noisy place with lots of activity happening but food and service was OK. Football or tennis up on the big screen for those interested. Don't expect a quiet conversation it isn't that sort of place but is a fun place to eat.

Author: 25gy
Title: Sajiab Nusantara - in calloboration with Chef Fazley Yaakob at Curate
Review: Made reservations on the 11th May 2019 to break fast and to enjoy the food as Four Seasons was fairly new. Had no knowledge that a celebrity chef specially customise the food menu, so was pretty excited to experience it.The GoodDecoration was very nice with beautiful views around Kuala Lumpur cityStaff was very polite and their service was goodThe BadThe food was rather tasteless and bland! The roasted lamb was like there was not enough spices and rather cold. Nothing to really to shout about. The desserts was nothing special, it was like not fresh and tasteless.The only thing that was good or rather nice was the oysters but had better ones at St Regis KL
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: JOYKITTEN89
Title: GREAT OLD SCHOOL CHINESE CUISINE
Review:
Second time at this resto and I was looking forward as the first time was awesome. 

Not disappointed. I missed out on a few pics as I had to step away halfway.

Do come! Food is so awesome!!

Author: Victor L
Title: Worst service in KL
Review: Thr food is alright and the place is very nice, but the simply have the worst service in KL.. forgot our drinks twice, and took the food ages
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: jxsimonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The staff and the food
Review: The staff was very rude when I requested for more meats from the bbq. When the drink were served I asked the waitress if it's free flow and said she said yes. When the bill presented they charged for the extra 5 cans of coke.Meats are not served as you wish, they come to the table maybe max 2 times but if ask more they will ignore you. The price is high but the service is poor. One staff was even seen showing the middle finger during serve not sure to her own working mate or customer. The attitude and environment was not conducive for a family restaurant.

Author: nurnabila_95Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: new addition to the menu
Review: i have recently visited this cafe again during my semester break with my family and noticed that they have added a new section to their menu, such as beef burger, salmon fillet, striploin steak and lamb steak, all from the grill. my family and i tried their new menu and we loved it! super glad that they added these items because now we have more choices. we came on a wednesday night and turns out they had an open mic session every wednesday! we had a very comfortable dining experience. Foodsbury remains to be my favourite cafe in Shah Alam!

Author: ByngChuBangkok, Thailand
Title: Interesting
Review: A gimmick place but overall is still has a good atmosphere and seems popular too.Beer is served with Chinese Wine Bottle and serve with Chinese bowl (chilled). Very funky.Menu has Chinese cuisine as well as Western including Malaysia's. Spicy Samosa is very good. Lamb satays are not bad. Angus beef Ren Dang is more like stewed beef and come along with Chinese Bun and Chinese sauerkraut. Interesting combination yet Not a bad idea. The Bun is quite authentic.Price is moderate. RM150 for two is reasonable.Also, looks like staffs of this restaurant are Birthday celebration experts. Bring your friend and give him/her a surprise.

Author: JoeCool_KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the price !
Review: Having seen videos of Le Petit chef in Paris, I was really looking forward to our dinner here. There is a lot of marketing about the fact that Le Petit is here in KL.Firstly, the dining area is like a makeshift area. No ambiance and just a square room with tables and chairs.Although the video presentation was cute and interesting, it was really just that. A novelty and quite an expensive novelty to pay for.At RM1000 plus for 2 people, we would have expected some kind of quality for the food. No bread rolls were provided at all. The plates being served was not warm - that is the number 1 rule that any good chef should know ! In fact, the soup was luke warm and the main meal was cold ! And the dessert - supposedly some fancy milk dessert was just really ice cream. Serves were also really small and nothing was served in between meals (no palate cleanser at all). Honestly, how can they even think of charging such prices for such mediocre food. Come for the novelty of the cute little chef video being projected on the table - but not for the food. We have been to so many Michelin star places in Europe and the food, presentation and ambiance was so much better for the same price. This place doesn’t even match up to other good restaurants or hotels in KL.

Author: Erin WChennai (Madras), India
Title: Stay far, far away
Review: We were excited to try this place because the menu had a lot of classic English favourites. The kids were craving breakfast for lunch, so we thought this place would hit the spot. We were greeted and we settled in and ordered fairly quickly. Our drinks came a few minutes later and they were quite good. We had a hot chocolate, the berry lemonade, and hibiscus and mint tea. But that is where the pleasantness stopped. We were fairly entertained by the old movie clips playing, but then we realised our food was not coming. We tried to flag someone down to find out about our food, but that was quite difficult. Finally after about 45 minutes someone checked on our food. The order had not even been submitted yet. The dishes started to slowly come out one by one. First my daughter’s waffles came and they were decent. Then my son’s eggs benedict came and it was not very good. They put way too much lemon in the hollandaise sauce and it overpowered the taste of the entire dish. The sausage was undercooked and the potatoes were burned. Next came my husband’s sandwich, and this is when we started to get really irritated. We had been waiting over an hour at this point, and my husband’s pulled beef sandwich came out with virtually no meat on it. It was like a few stringy pieces of meat stuck to soggy bread. He tried to complain and the waitstaff kept waking away. And my dish still had not come. After my husband started to raise a fuss, the manager came over to see what was wrong. We showed him the sandwich and mentioned that my dish still hadn’t come. One hour and fifteen minutes had elapsed by then. The manager apologised and said they were making a new sandwich. He then told us that they were out of the fish pie I had ordered. At that point I too raised my voice. I said that it would have been nice to have been told that over an hour ago so I could make another selection. We also told him that I hope this meal was free because we are leaving. We got up and left and told people that were seated and had not ordered yet to also leave. The food was not good and the service was even worse. I’d give it a zero if I could, but the one star can go for the drinks, which were tasty.

Author: Ganesh74Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
Title: Great ambience! Great Music
Review: Dont forget to check this out guys if you are staying at the DoubleTree. This place is perfect for the evening wind down with your colleagues and friends. Lovely atmosphere, very good music, the food is ok and this is full value for money! Love it!

Author: Dvicary
Title: Good value
Review: Great menu. Yemeni bread is a must. Reasonable prices and friendly and attentive service. Has become a regular haunt for the family

Author: minggyhsiang
Title: Chic & contemporary
Review:
A nice and simple place with unique coffee, tea, drinks, cakes and simple eats including pasta and paella. 

Food and drinks were good and tasty though a bit pricey, and portions could be a bit bigger. 

Overall a nice place to relax and enjoy. 😊

Author: synicalrulesPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It was okay, I guess..?!
Review: Was here over the Merdeka weekend to celebrate grandmother's birthday with extended family.I would say that the food is alright and the service is not bad (they cleared plates quickly), but then again, I didn't exactly pay for it myself and so why complain about it?

Author: OzTravellerBrisbaneBrisbane
Title: Good food but so noisy spoilt it all
Review: My second visit here as I had a great time the first. But, this time we couldn't get for our party of 7 an individual room and instead a shared walled room that had about 20 people at least.Now I'm not being racist, but, Malaysians are very loud people. Limited understanding of volume control in public spaces or "indoor voice" especially restaurants. You would think after coming here for 25 years I would be used to it!!! After kids that had their games cranked up to the max making a noise, adults shouting so the others can hear them, I left with a headache.So overall, maybe as the food is good, I would only come here if I had a guaranteed room or less enclosed space. Otherwise, I wouldn't come back even if it was free. I would pay the extra money and go to Jagoya.

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: Great view from the top! but go day time
Review: Food nothing great. However the view is impressive. The Pizza was with chunky meat but still small for a medium eater like me.

Author: Elaine TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Singapore Holland Village Quality is BAD
Review: Just looks like clear hot water with lots of pepper instead of their proclaim signature soup The soup is not even piping hot even though it’s served in claypot and taste so BADOverpriced with barely any ingredients and worst than any food court BKT Please do improve the Quality of food especially with the price range

Author: Jesper M
Title: Best seafood we ate in KL
Review:
Nice ambiance and interesting menu. Excellent service.
Tried 2 of the catch of the day, very good.  But alas the fish was slightly overcooked, that's the reason for 4 of 5.

Author: Majed MAbu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Very good food but bad service
Review: I was staying in the berjaya time square hotel, and thought of having early dinner. The food was great, but is the worst service. No organisation in delivering the food to the table (e.g. appetiser with soup with main course all at the same time), very bad attitude, serving a bottle of water was a miracle coming true, not everyone knows English. Over all, I gave them 2 stars just for the food taste, which I really enjoyed. I don't know if they are the same during buffet or not; as usually the buffet you serve yourself and need less services from the waiters

Author: j201920192019
Title: One of the best chawanmushi!
Review: One of the best chawanmushi I've had, including in Japan. Other dishes were lovely too. I find it to be great value as well, and tasty. I can't remember the exact name but there is a sort of a maki with beautiful fillings (lots of it too) which is one of my favourite.

Author: MaroDrDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The dirtiest place ever
Review: It is local style eating. It is so dirty there...I could hardly believe this place . Even the chairs were disgusting. Convenient parking in the yard. I would never go there again. A place for people who are used to street food eating, not for people who are expecting a restaurant.

Author: Pamela C
Title: no to impressed dissapointed
Review: We decided to have a little celebration for my dad's Birthday In June. We wanted a nice place to eat and celebrate his birthday. So decided on Strato thinking this would be a nice experience with the view and being an Italian restaurant. But My dad's feedback was not impressed with the serve and overly priced Italian food!!. Other then the location and ambience of the sky city view, I would just stop at that, the layout impressive and that is about it, there is nothing to shout about with the food being serve here. We were seated at the balcony because we wanted a nice city view, But nothing to shout about. The table setting was average, as it was an outdoor dining we would expect more lights at least more table candles for us to see the faces of person we are sitting next too and also to see what we are eating. I did on numerous times requested for the waiter to bring more table candles out. that fell on deaf ears. Just not attentive enough. This place is overly priced Italian food. I had better Italian dishes else where and even cooking at home taste better. The service provided was more or less average, it could be better with more attention to detail from their wait staff, They could be more equiped with the knowledge of their food menu. To start our dinning experience, we ordered the antipasti platter to share for 4 people, the menu did say 2-3 people serving I understand that. But when it arrived it was such a small serving, I would say this platter should be change on the menu for sharing of 1-2 person not 2-3. It was not generous at all with the items on the platter and it looked average Meh!!!, with small cuts of sourdough bread, we could not even fit the cured meat on top for it having it dropping off the side. We had to ask for more bread. Mind you this platter was RM$70.00 on the menu, it was not justified with the price and the serving. It was a ripped off. Then we had our mains, my dad wanted a nice piece of steak so he ordered the Pan seared rib eye steak, garlic ricotta, salsa verde & arugula at RM$95.00. Again we were disappointed when it arrived. We requested for the steak to be cook rare to medium. And having cutting the outer part of the meat it was okay, but as dad process to eat the steak to the centre of it, it became very tough to cut the steak. It was so dark you can't even see the inside of the meat. We had to use our Phone torchlight to inspect it, don't the kitchen use a Thermometer to check the meat!!!???. We expected a Medium-rare: A more pink colour with a little pink juice flowing. None of that it was RARE!! and still Blue. seriously at RM95.00 we would expect a good quality steak. Again here the price of what they served is not justified. We then complained to our waiter and his solution was to return the steak back on to the grill and recook it again. Seriously.... we were shocked !!! you don't just do that !!! you should serve us a proper cooked steak again as requested!! he stood there taking notes of the error and said to us that he will give this feedback to the chef, then he went on saying about the chef that he was trained in Italy for 1 month to cook and he was an experienced chef in cooking steak. And that was his way of dealing with our complain. Such a Rubbish....Our pasta and pizza arrived. Pasta: seriously bad it was dry with not enough crab meat and was not substantial at all it did not look inviting to eat. we had the Crab meat linguini, chili, rocket & garlic chips RM55.Pizza: we order the Modern margherita with buffalo mozarella & cherry tomatoes on the vine RM40.00. again not impressed at all. not enough ingredients, lack flavour and just not justified with the servings. I don't think the money was well spent here, for such a unsatisfied meal and having spend RM500.00 on a meal that night, we were very disappointed. Not a place I would return even if you are going for the view.

Author: Erik1888Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely steak and onion flower
Review: We had ordered the Ribeye and also the grade 7 wagyu and oh boy the taste was lovely. The price premium you have to pay for this lovely meal reflects the premium status of the meat they are grilling for you. The onion flower dish is unique and just lovely, but it's a bit too much for just 2 especially if u r ordering a steak each.Contrary to some of the gripes in the reviews about service, we are extremely pleased with the good service but that is may be due to the fact that there were few guests in store. The only thing is that it took the staff very long to call us a cab after we settled the bill, but then again I'm not sure if it's the staff or the taxi booking.

Author: linnmansingapore
Title: Standard has dropped over the years
Review: During our trips to KL, we will have lunch at Luk Yu right after check-in. Over the last 10 years, we have observed that the standard of the food there is dropping. The same items on the menu do not taste as good as before unlike Jake's Charbroiled Steaks (also in Starhill Gallery) which has consistently maintained its high standard.While food is not great, the level of service is still good.We were really disappointed this time round.

Author: Cheng O
Title: Hash tag great food behind our house!
Review:
We came here for a quick dinner after moving into the neighbourhood. The ambiance was great, staff are very friendly and welcoming, food were full of flavour...
And we walked to it! Just delightful!

Author: ilo2728
Title: Good choice of breakfast spread, clean and organised
Review: Efficient staff, clean environment, good spread of breakfast/buffee, nice food. Good view out to KL city as well. Friendly staff members.

Author: kafir63Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: best banana leaf rice
Review: if u happen to be there go upstair, totally different food fr downstair. only for lunch.even without the additional side dishes their basic Rm7 banana leave set is very substancial.not very authentic tamil nadu fare but very tasty. the fish curry is more Goa influence n the mutton dalcha is northern.

Author: Grace S
Title: Great setting, great dinner, great service
Review: We visited our first evening in Langkawi and we’re thrilled with this find. Relaxing and pretty atmosphere, super menu and better service.

Author: Ngan H
Title: Expensive & not good
Review: This corner mamak shop is large & located behind Maybank. Convenient, right? But it is downhill from there. The food is bland, the price is on the high side. Rather go to other shop for the nest Indian meal.

Author: sauber182
Title: Live band members have a good voice
Review:
Definitely be coming back for more music if and only if the band was still the same band in future.

One good recommended meal - 10oz burger. Super tasteful.

Author: kongkkPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unworthy Visit
Review: Low grade salmon shashimi. Overprice white rice at RM6 a small bowl. Mentai topping is much much smaller compare to what shown in photo, it's even smaller than half size of 5 cents coin. Staff is not paying attention to customers, they are more attracted to the TV show. It's not worth a visit even with Eatigo 50% discount. Will not be back anymore

Author: Marc F
Title: More expensive than The Cut (MBS-Singapore)
Review: More expensive than "The Cut" at MBS-Singapore, pushy waitress. Steak was just average. Monte's in Bangsar would have been better.

Author: WyvonaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Come only if you want to drink!
Review: This place serves bad food with a very noisy environment. Do not plan to have your gathering or reunion here if you wish to have some catch ups with friends, because you can hardly hear a word as their music is so loud hence everyone in the restaurant have to shout to talk, very annoying..

Author: wallawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Finally tried it after so many years!
Review: Been to Melaka for the past 10 years plus but first time trying this. Always hated the crowd but past by the restaurant and there was some empty tables so decided to try.First the satay sauce took quite a while to heat/boil so can slowly choose what you want to eat. Many variety to choose from so should have something for everyone.Once the sauce is boiling they will constantly come and help you stir it (to prevent it from getting burnt at the bottom). The sauce is just nice, not too hot for children, but need more peanuts.Just remember to watch how many sticks you have taken as the number can add up very fast when you are enjoying the food. You might be surprised at the end of the meal how many sticks you have eaten!Overall food is good (with the satay sauce) but the final amount can really add up fast!

Author: 280audreyl
Title: Decent Food And Bad Service At Premium Price
Review: Visited Kampachi at EQ, and it was a bad experience.Haven't been to a buffet in this whole pandemic situation so unsure what to expect like was the food in the open - do we take it ourselves or do they serve it to us? So went there for the Sunday buffet and the system in place was we had to order from the menu. Food was decent at best. It is fresh but I did notice that the cooked foods all were only warm at best (only the miso soup which i specified to be really hot came...well...steaming hot). Understand perhaps because it is buffet style, they probably had the trays of food somewhere and they only served it when ordered? So don't be mistaken, it's probably not made to order.The dining experience started off fine but when we wanted to add more items. It seemed that the relatively calm restaurant were perhaps understaffed or had a system that just did not work. Ordered 2 miso - only 1 came. Ordered desserts - reminded perhaps 3 different waiter/waitresses in a period of at least 30mins and still did not get anything.Spoke to the manager only to have him being defensive instead of genuinely being apologetic. Then they all decided to overcompensate by immediately bringing out the dessert...and bringing way too much. In no way the waiters/waitresses were rude or anything to be honest. Just super forgetful or not attentive enough. Or the system failed them. Is anything keyed in or recorded down?All in all. Very unpleasant experience with the slow/lack of service. We were unlucky maybe. Food was ok. It wasn't "wow!" It was just ok, not bad, quite fresh. But that's about it. (Tempura, the nabe dishes, teppanyaki dishes were all cold. The dorayaki too hard. And the soba was probably soaking in the sauce for way too long)For RM168 per pax, I think I'm better off else where (like Shangri La Lemon Garden). To be honest even a mid range restaurant provides better service and perhaps have a better system than this.

Author: IanFromSydneyHunters Hill, Australia
Title: Average
Review: This place has great views. That's about it. I visited Marinis for a business trip and was seriously disappointed with the food. The staff made a real show off placing all the food on the table at the same time but perhaps they should have practiced cooking instead. We had a set meal but if you are cooking beef you should ask how the diner prefers it. All came out very rare and all went back uneaten. Risotto undercooked. Desert was ok but didn't save the rest of the meal and the staff weren't very friendly or switched on. Even after notifying them of seafood allergy and having a special card placed in front of me I was still given a prawn dish! Only when I asked twice was I told what it was. Not good.

Author: x96lee26
Title: Delicious autentic Chinese foodies 🥰🥰🥰
Review: Delicious autentic Chinese cuisine with refreshing white chicken, and tomato based fish fillet with stir fried vegetables and their calimari deep fried are amazingly tasty; with mince meats rice and double boiled supreme soup 😋😋😋

Author: arwen_tripMiri, Malaysia
Title: returning customer
Review: This was my 2nd trip there. However it was the first for my hub. and he was impressed with the deco.Base on the memory the portion of the food where slightly smaller compare to previous trip which i have for dinner (2 years back)we have ordered soup of the day, aglio olio and meatloaf. Taste wise they are good.nevertheless i will return for other dishes.

Author: argenkiwi
Title: Vegetarians welcome
