Review: The prices here are no the lowest in Kuah, but are still very good compared to most western countries. The quality of the food is outstanding and we managed to order a fully vegetarian meal for 4 which we really enjoyed. The service and environment are very good as well.

Author: jenniferhpkangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service, lovely food
Review: It's not always easy to find good service in KL so we were delighted with the lovely service provided by all staff of Baan26. Delicious food made it a perfect evening. Som Tham {papaya salad} was dish of the night with delicious dried prawns incorporated. Basil omelette was also lovely. Finished the meal with a fabulous red ruby dessert. Definitely will return!

Author: lyla1lyla1
Title: Great broth but horribly lack of ingredients and service staff
Review: I'll be very honest and not try to sugar coat this reviewThe start, extremely aromatic truffle soup that was so intoxicating with mushrooms. Anticipating yummy food cooked in such intense broth. We went as a family. Some from Singapore and some all the way from Australia. The weekend we booked, they were having a promotion for all-you-can-eat, OR REALLY?We arrived on sunday morning at 11.30am and ordered as usual, beef or seafood, The buffet menu is limited but they did have beef slices and tiger prawns among other vegetable options. That's fine, we were prepared for fine dining, paying premium prices for service, premium food and ambience. It went downhill from here. Each time you're only allowed to order once. So a table of 11, we were only allowed to order one beef slice plate that consist of 5 thinly sliced beef. Oh wait, the waiter even forgot our orders, so we mostly ate rice and vege while waiting for premium stuff.The worst was yet to come, our prawns ran out after 10 pieces. 10 might sound alot but for a table of 10, that wasnt even one each. They ran out for the day. It was only 1pm. Prime hour for lunch on their promotion weekend. I would be fine if I was informed beforehand about the limit on prawns then, we'll spread it out accordingly, it was great big tasty prawns. But no, we just suddenly were told, no more. Ok. So some family members didnt' get it. Imagine paying $88 ++ for mediocre vege and balls steamboat without any premium meat or prawns.It's not that I can't afford, it's better I know what's available. Don't try to sneakily promote what you cannot deliver. Super dissapointed...

Author: aweiss2016
Title: Yum Yum Yum
Review: Delicious!!!  This Asian fusion restaurant has plenty to offer.  The prawn in cashew sauce is...like to die for...and the walk to get to the back of the restaurant over a koi pond  is a mini adventure.

Author: RoulNaser
Title: Little cafe with big flavor!
Review: Love every bit of the cafe. The music was on point. The host was superb. We had Nyonya Laksa, Assam Laksa and Thai Iced Tea. They were flavorful and remind me of my late mum’s cooking. Delish! Will be coming back soon!

Author: AprilflameKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh seafood
Review: The seafood here was very fresh. We tried a selection of fish, crabs and prawns. Price was reasonable. The restaurant is outdoor but didn't feel too warm. The restaurant gets a big crowd but the service is quite fast. We were a party of 9 people and the food was ready within half an hour of ordering. Go early i.e. by 6PM to avoid queueing. There was also a fish crackers seller parked right outside the restaurant that is worth trying. He sells ready to eat packs of crackers which make a good starter while waiting for dinner. If you're after fresh seafood, this place should be on your list.

Author: siewlingt2021
Title: Dining in chynna
Review: Service by leng is superb and friendly, professional . This restaurant dish is delicious and very traditional chinese restaurant

Author: MarTravels16Redhill, United Kingdom
Title: Not a good impression
Review: All of our family of four where hungry hence we decided to try and eat and have a drink at the geographer cafe.Staff where too busy too seat anyone meaning we had to find our own table. All the tables where full so we got stuck next to a sewage drain FULL of mosquitos.We where all bitten alive before we could even get a chance to read the menu.Unfortunately we had to get up and leave as the service appeared overwhelmed by the amount of customers. Not a great start to our short weekend getaway.Be careful before deciding to settle here.

Author: 843mushp
Title: Please fix the Fxxk aircon
Review:
the price is quite high however the food is nice BUT WHAT HAPPEN TO YOUR AIRCON!!!!!
At the price , the boss still want to save the money to fix or install new aircon like crazy

Author: V123I
Title: Disappointed..rude service
Review: Nothing special..the only thing special is their rude service..I asking about why my food order so slow but the staff replied " nanti nanti " especially the female cook..she seem more focus on chit chat among themselves instead of cooking?! Really disappointed on this trip, pls improve your service.

Author: Aikku_01
Title: Ms
Review: Such a wonderful place! So peaceful and relaxing athmophere. Nice river view, good beer, bad jokea and good company!

Author: No_BS_svp
Title: Don't understand the hype
Review: We expected something special based on the TA reviews. We were really disappointed. Hummus was mediocre. Lamb was tough as shoe leather. Fish of the day was mystery fish drowned in a glutinous spicy sauce. Tables too close together. No alcohol served. Won't return. Ever. Avoid.

Author: Kate S
Title: Vegetarians stay at home
Review: Ok so my husband likes a good steak but I am veggie.....according to the staff in Prime, vegetarians should be left at home....!! I have eaten here several times before and the staff seem to go out of their way to remind me I have mistakenly found myself in a steak bar...... The chef can only serve risotto.....what's the point, how easy is it to prepare something appetising for someone who is vegetarian not to mention cheap.... All that's on offer are side dishes an expensive way to plate up potato and veg............The foods ok but nothing special very over rated and expensive..........

Author: Ian S
Title: Dining plus shopping
Review: Bad material used on the item bought for HRC standard. Just a cuople of days wearing and the item plated tarnished very badly. With the price i guess it is just not right to be valued with the material used. But dining experience wise is great with great servers and all..

Author: Jasonpei
Title: It’s the different sushi zanmai from KL
Review:
Terrible services.
Staff really enjoying singing Malay song in the song Ang chit chat very loud.
 I was wondering am I enter to Sushi Zanmai or food court?

Author: Stephen o
Title: Great value duck awakens at Midvalley
Review: We dropped in one late afternoon for our regular roast duck at the MidValley outlet and were pleasantly surprised at the Set Lunch offered with all our favorites at RM16.90++. It was good value roast duck rice with the sugarcane drink plus the normal freebies soup and jelly. Certainly enough for our little boy who is very fussy about the freshness of his food. Some familiar servers there were "promoted" from Bangsar Village and Pavilion outlets. They are always attentive and know our exact requirements for baby chair and utensils. However our favorite outlet is still Bangsar Village for the perfectly roasted and moist duck. We have told them the only room for improvement is the freshness of the prawns and scallops, which still have slight fishy smells - detectable by our 21 month old's pure palate. He only eats his favorite seafood when it is fresh and without smell, otherwise he spits it out!

Author: Sieh FSingapore, Singapore
Title: Grumpy Staff
Review: Well, all and all the experience wasn't fantastic. Grumpy staff unwilling to serve, half-hearted whenever we tried to request or place our order. Not attentive at all, we need to repeat at least 3 times before we get what we wanted as during the placing of order, the staff wasn't even giving you his fullest attention. That basically sums up my whole experience there. In the end, only had a drink and left.

Author: Johary M
Title: A must dining!
Review:
Walking up the stairs was so not 5 star, restaurant itself, looks so normal. But the food was awesome, we loved the spring rolls, kampung fried rice as well as the sambal belacan and butter prawn. 
Really good food and would definitely come again.

Author: dezzlynShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: nice place to chili
Review: last time visited was about 10years ago. still a very nice place to be for dinner. cozy with nice ambient and dinner and wine by the seaside . highlt recommended to go especially if you want to just enjoy a night out from the city. just a note ,price of food is a bit on the high side but all in all, it's still worth going . recommend the nasi lemak and the ikan bakar

Author: geoffheadKuala Lumpur
Title: Average Mexican food
Review: Food was ok, but nothing special. Presentation was nothing to write home about, lacking any sense of occasion. Fajitas for RM50++ was over priced for something that resembled And tasted like I could make it at home. Tried the cactus appetiser, not good. House Margharitas not bad for the money. RM480 in total for 3 people, did not make for good value.

Author: Geoffrey L
Title: very good chinese foods
Review: very hard for you to get a place.. u need to book in advance for this place.. always full.. not bad at all their foods.. serving cantonese-chinese cuisine..

Author: valMLtanKuching, Malaysia
Title: A Dayak cuisine experience
Review: I have been there 3 times now & in the most recent visit, I brought along my friend who is Singapore Malay Muslim. She really want to have the chance to experience Dayak cuisine and so, Lepau is the place for her. We enjoyed the food very much - our menu selection for that night was umai, midin belacan, ayam pansuh & petai belacan, with local rice of course. That night also, a smalls side dish of sambal was given to us (which I find it very delicious) Compliments to the kitchen staff for the food served. The ambiance and decor of Lepau reflects its Dayak roots from the tablet cloth to lighting and wooden decor carvings. Food quality, serving size and price is reasonable. We were fortunate to able to see sape played as have our dinner. To get there, we drove there and location is just right beside Grand Supreme Hotel at Ban Hock Road. It's away from main road so need to drive in and you'll find it. It's my third time to Lepau and I will definitely return again, with friends (and/or recommend to tourists) who are looking for Dayak cuisine to experience.

Author: Mike BJohor, Malaysia
Title: Rip Off Merchants
Review: Had a group dinner last night at Coppola - food quality was reasonable apart from the child-meal size pasta portions. The prices however were sky high (RM 45 for 8 pieces of Ravioli) and the only restaurant in the area to charge both 10% service charge and 6% service tax. I doubt very much that the service charge gets passed onto the staff. Over-priced and definitely NOT value for money.

Author: sreeyogaNegombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Food Quality Dropped
Review: A place I have dined a few times. Surprised to find food standards have dropped. Roghini Naan was starchy. The chef 's speciality palak panner which cost 15.50 before tax came with three small cubes of panner. Jalfrezi was oily . Only the tandoori roti and plain lassi was ok. Made a complain to the manager. He insisted on giving a discount of 20 % although I thought the quality of food is more important than the discount.

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre
Review: Restaurant a bit far from the town center, though the establishment has been around since 1999 or 1997 in the same location.There was not a queue at all, and the restaurant was only quarter full when we entered.Rice and fish was terrible, others mediocre at best. Not worth the long drive from town to this restaurant,

Author: Nicolef494Ipswich, Queensland, Australia
Title: Strange service and a bit pricey
Review: Food was pretty good but have had much better in Malaysia for much cheaper. What we remember most is the service from the waiters. I had barely put the last bit of my meal in my mouth and one of them came to clear my plate, cutlery and both of our napkins. The annoying bit was my husband was still eating! Felt like we were being forced out but then they took ages to ask if we wanted anything else or get us the bill.

Author: EducatedTraveller123
Title: Great service! Great food!
Review: Nice, comfy place with great service to match. Very attentive and pleasant staff especially Erfan, the Manager there. Very courteous, with great service skills. Always obliging and can do attitude. Keep up the good work, guys!

Author: AChee74
Title: Casablanca...
Review:
Middle eastern food in Kuching. The food was great, service was great, but slow. Overall a very interesting expericence. 

The place is very far away from the city and hidden away, so one might need a transport to get there.
Restaurant: Desert Retreat Restaurant And Coffee Shop

Author: PrudanilleSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Bad Service Management
Review: Drinks served really slow and it doesn’t seems there was sequence in place. Witnessed there were several tables came later than us but they got their drinks first. And the drinks that we ordered just juices. Come on, are those fruits only pluck from the trees after we order? It took more than 45 mins with multiple times of reminding. To be honest, it’s not recommended to visit unless the places nearby are really fully crowded and really no more empty spot. The food and drinks is just normal. Nothing fancy nothing really worth to brag about. Outside the restaurant is more instagrammable compared to inside. Seriously first and last time for this.

Author: CarineL544Malaysia
Title: The food was below expectation
Review: My dad was ordered the ox tail soup, it taste so spicy and we do wonder whether the chef has mixed the soup with lots of Indian curry powder.. :-( , one more thing to highlight was the sizzling tenderloin steak found a piece of tissue paper into it, eventually we have informed the waitress on that. The staff was apologized and sent us the complimentary of chocolate lava.. Of course, the staff/ cook need to be alert and cautious in preparing the food to their customer.

Author: reenabenjaminPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great food , great people , feels like home❤️
Review: From the moment we entered, Andy & syamsul welcome and guide us to our table. The food from the high tea was excellent! The staff on duty that day, Akma, rizal, irma , hasmah, syuhada ,fariz & others... really took care of us as if they were taking care of a family. Will recommend this place to others and will come back for sure. Thank you paya serai

Author: cgw99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wish we didn't return
Review: Having raved on trip advisor about the steak we went back and it was like a different restaurant, we ordered exactly the same steak this time it was tough and full of gristle we left as much as we ate (no choice it was so poor). A first rate place wouldn't have served that steak it was obviously a poor cut. I was surprised that no one seemed that bothered. We won't be going back. So my advice would be to look carefully at your steak before you try it and reject it if it looks like it has gristle through it.Disappointing for a 5 star hotel.

Author: lbthomsen
Title: Going Downhill
Review: For years Twenty One have had the best lunch deal in town. Unfortunately the last couple of months, the portions have been getting consistently smaller and smaller to a point where a fish burger now is mostly potatoes, burger bun and a few tiny dry bits of fish. For RM 20 that is no longer a good deal. I told the manager that it wasn't good any longer, but that didn't seem to concern him much. Anyway, I'm sure the owners have ordered cost cutting at the obvious expense of the loyal customers.

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Overrated.
Review: Came here because of all the raved reviews and concidently we were staying at Westin - so easy access. This restaurant is just average and the food is not value for money. We have been to far better Japanese restaurants than this and is cheaper too. I am surprised that this place is packed after dining here.

Author: Goh HJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed.
Review: Came here to try because of good reviews but totally disappointed. The toasted bread got no taste solely depend on kacang pool but kacang pool taste terrible. For those who don't take beef please check whether any beef in kacang pool. For RM6 per set it is not worth it. Try the nasi lemak as well. Could only comment just to fill up the hunger.

Author: a00111
Title: So So
Review: The ribs is not that great but this place is fully booked for a good reason i guess but i don't really enjoy the food

Author: Kimchimann
Title: Review of Restaurant Cheang Kee
Review: The food was really good and delicious, nice environment too, very cozy!!😀😁😁 I would recommend you to come visit!!

Author: bmatnorKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Very dull restaurant
Review: I visited this restaurant twice. But the second one was bad. The restaurant looks clean but empty during lunch time. For both occasions, we were the only customers. We were greeted by err...non local waiter and obviously he is from Indonesia. We have a break of communication there and I found that it was not easy to make my order. I could feel that the business was not that good, the ambience was 'sad', 'dull' etc etc. I was not really confident that I would get the food that at least look the same as in the pamphlet. We asked for lempeng (difficult to make the order due to communication) and hot drinks. The lempeng was served with a sambal (with petai but coudn't see the petai inside the dish). I also asked for 'daging rusa salai'. No explanation by the waiter and was served 'gulai lemak daging rusa' but of course it was not freshly cooked. Well, this place is not recommended by me.

Author: yychang
Title: Very, Very Poor Service
Review:
We waited for 20 mins to get a Menu. There was only one Chinese lady staff working, the rest just pretend not seeing anybody.
When we wanted to order our food but was told have to wait another 45 mins. Finally, we gave up.

Author: jasskoh
Title: Service have to improve
Review:
Environment not bad food still under expectation. But....
Early morning go for breakfast refresh my new day~
See all the workers face like robot, no smiling no talking~
Restaurant: Mount Austin One Two Eat Cafe

Author: Denis DYangon (Rangoon), Myanmar
Title: Great staff, food less interesting
Review: We went for dinner when there was a large group of about 20 tourists. The service was nevertheless very good. We were a bit disappointed by the food, the halibut with egg floss was forgettable, only a local crispy jungle leaf served with a yellow powder (forgot the name) saved the meal. Portions are indeed very large. Only 3 out of the 10 wines listed were available, for both red and white, but credit must be given to our waiter who brought a choice of bottles from outside to suit our taste. The restaurant itself has a nice entrance and is actually very deep. The best part was actually the staff.

Author: justineesun
Title: Nothing much....
Review: With Pavilion gaining all the attention, what is there left for this store except the many restaurants mainly Japanese that offer good value for money sets.... other then that nothing to shouting about...

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Nice Ribs
Review: We had dinner there and had the Ribs and the medallion combo but the ribs really is good - tender, really tasty and juicy - have always like the ribs. The small steak is done medium but only so so. We had a complimentary bread given. A bit pricey but not unlike other western restaurants in KL.

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful quite night out...
Review: It's slightly away from Melaka Town, but worth the drive. The place is nicely set up with wooden furniture and it's an ALL OUTDOOR DINING. Table seating options include right beside the sea which I personally recommend. There are no fans (none required) as it can be very breezy. I do suggest bringing mosquito a repellent with you especially if you're traveling with children. The food is not much to shout about but that's only my opinion (and taste buds!) The nasi lemak is nice but I would not classify it as being the best in Melaka tho... Grilled squid was nice especially the sauce that came with it.Overall I would say its a great place to relax and unwind. Food-wise, I'll give it a 6/10

Author: SteffiRiedl
Title: Delicious indian food
Review:
One of the best indian restaurants during our journey through Malaysia!
Very good menu and delicious meals!
Only a pity that the music is extremely loud, so that it's difficult to have a conversation.

Author: Maxby C
Title: Portions are kid size and pricey.
Review: Portions are kid size and pricey. Food is not great either Had a very disappointing evening at this place.

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced
Review: I have dined in this restaurant many times. The interior is very slick for any business or special occasion and this is its unique selling point. Otherwise the food / steak is just above average and is certainly overpriced even if you take advantage of presenting your SPG Membership Number to enjoy a 20% discount, its still overpriced compared with other steak houses in KL. In short, if you are in KL Sentral or staying in Hilton or Le Meridien or its a business or special occasion and you want to impress your guests and dont mind paying over the odds then this is the place to dine.

Author: Cocoapple69
Title: Disappointing
Review: Only 3 of the beers available from a whole list of their craft beers. Asked for a Mojito and the waiter informs that there isn't any rum available. Food was so so and the cherry beer is exorbitantly priced. Definitely better to head elsewhere for a better meal and drinks.

Author: JessieKTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Very pleasant
Review: A lovely spot for dining in with an outlook across the water.The atmosphere was very charming and inviting.The food choices were very good and the food delicious and portions were large. Prices are very acceptable.Staff were friendly and pleasant and service good.I can’t understand how previous reviewers could be soo negative. Perhaps they were having a bad day.This is Malaysia, not a downtown big worldly city.

Author: kevinKoid5288Nilai, Malaysia
Title: Underwhelming experience
Review: Underwhelming experience I was expecting phenomenal Service and food quality but it failed to live up to standards and expectations. Yes, the view is magnificent but after all this is a restaurant and it should have weighed on that aspect. The interior design of the restaurant could have been thought out better. Let us just say it was no Tokyo Chic. Servers needed to be more attentive and know the fundamentals of serving right to the tee.

Author: titans123Studley, United Kingdom
Title: Awful from start to finish
Review: It is hard to say something positive about our experience at The Planters - the only positive comment I have to make is that the pianist was good. Approximately 10 tables were occupied - both inside and outside - and the restaurant had no atmosphere. The menu is quite varied including Thai, Malaysian and Italian cuisine, however when the food arrived it was cold and my partner didn't receive his food until 5 minutes after mine - I wouldn't mind but I went out to eat as a couple. No one came to check on us during the meal and when we finished we waited for 40 minutes for someone to come clear our plates, a delay in clearing the plates I might understand if the restaurant was understaffed but there were about 8 servers on duty, all of whom walked past our table as it was located near to the kitchen!! Only when we stood up to leave did one of the team come over to us. On leaving the restaurant we spoke to one of the team about our experience however they weren't interested. By nature we are not the type of people to complain for no reason and quite often accept service we perhaps shouldn't, however in our opinion this was unacceptable - especially for a 5 star luxury hotel.

Author: ProtrSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ipoh Food Tour
Review: Took a self drive from Singapore to Ipoh on a food tour. We heard about the famous salted chicken in Ipoh and managed to locate the shop. It was so tasty that we decided to come back again on another day after visiting Penang. For food lovers, you may want to try the salty chicken where lots locals drive there to pick up a few packets along the way home.

Author: avinashchandraaBengaluru, India
Title: Mouthwatering sweet chinese dish Muah Chee
Review: MADAM Tang, as she prefers to be known as, sells this signature sweet dish Muah Chee which is rice flour rooled ground nut. There are 10 to 12 flavors but only two on any say. We got lychee flavour which had the unique taste and aroma. She has been selling for over 50 years and it seems she has perfected the receipe.

Author: Nale N
Title: One of good arabic restaurant (Shah Alam, Selangor)
Review: good food and good service. The owner is not Yemeni but the food yes. Might want to try new Hadramawt restaurant next door (shared with Concorde Hotel)

Author: SuzanneM2683
Title: Not A Restaurant Owner I'll Support
Review: The biryani here is enjoyed by people and I used to enjoy it as well. I was so frequent as my office is around the corner that I was close to the owner. I've now stopped dining in this restaurant as one morning the owner was complaining to me about the patrons 'on how they just can't wait when there's no seating' and move on to the restaurants around. This to me was absurd as he seeks loyalty without earning as his restaurant has an extended room inside (atleast 40 seating) which they don't open for breakfast and so I pointed that to him (nicely like it's just a thought) and he just quit talking to me since that day and that's the end of my visit. I don't think I would dine in a place where the owner doesn't know the value of the customer. Their staffs are friendly tho.

Author: PieGuts101Perth, Australia
Title: Great Lunch
Review: We had a great Lunch today with great service. I had a cold coffee with tonic . It blew my mind. I also had the chefs salad , which turned out nothing like I thought. But was still very tasty . The wife had a peanut butter chicken burger and the kids a beef burger, we had a serve of sweet potato chips and the kids had chilled berry tea. Funky fit out. We loved it

Author: Happiness265558
Title: Poor service
Review: Went for dinner.... The waiters was busy doing nothing just walking around and taking not event care of guess wanna order. Very disappointed of one of the waiters coz she just like don't know how to communicate or she don't understand english...... Overall the service is a bit slow....

Author: LipSengYap
Title: Ok for a quick meal..
Review: Nothing fancy, but good for a quick meal, conveniently located in heart of KL, briyani could be better.

Author: alanlebrasMonce-en-belin, France
Title: OK Kopitiam near Sentral Market
Review: The place is OK. But it is not cheap as one would expect of a kopitiam. The advertisements outside for set breakfast are no longer true. So, they practice fake advertising to get customers in. Then they tell you you can order a la carte, which is not cheap anymore.

Author: Billy L
Title: One of the best hotpot
Review: Yezi is consider one of the best hotpot in kl. I like their coconut soup base and truffle soup. Plenty of varieties for add on dishes. For Dessert I will go for coconut avocado.

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Weighing in
Review: Ok, I've been holed up around the corner from Jonker Street for almost two weeks. I'm not a big eater here but I've been here six or seven times. Certainly we all understand the value of being at a well kept, up to date open air venue on the best corner in town, don't we? Good, let's move on... The beer is cold and on tap. Same price pretty much everywhere. It's not cheap, it's Malaysia. The chairs are a nice touch. Remember, we're in SE Asia and plastic chairs and stools abound. The staff is friendly and not overbearing. They remember me whenever I pass. The food is good and what I haven't tried looked good too. Even tried the pizza. It's good. Is it Cross Bay Boulevard in Howard Beach good? Let's all just calm down. This isn't Little Italy. The food is fine, the weather is hot, you're on the best corner on Jonker Street, and it's a good thing!

Author: AnthonyMoussKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Really delicious italian cuisine
Review: I went to Ciao for a birthday dinner with my wife I can really say the place is really make you feel like travel to Italy.Service was great and efficient , the special message for the Bday cake was great.For the food , it was delicious really , we were only disappointed with the Tiramisu

Author: martinmH7414BHBelfast, United Kingdom
Title: Hit and Miss
Review: Depending on chef and staff on , its hit and miss place , I spent sometime in here as its a sports bar also . Just be careful getting double charged for drinks .

Author: DonMacLeanKamala, Thailand
Title: Was Hoping for Better Food
Review: Since I live in Thailand, it has been a long time since I saw an Outback Steakhouse, and I was excited to get a good quality lunch. I ordered a good'ol bacon cheeseburger and fries, but was presented with something closer to a BigMac. Shredded lettuce, diced onion, small tomato...nothing special at all. Fries were nothing special either, and not many of them. I also saw somebody else get a steak dinner, and it looked like a thin and unimpressive piece of meat. Certainly not the Outback Steakhouse experience I was hoping for.

Author: rohit3212019
Title: great service experience
Review: Before some days ago i visit to westin for breakfast in living room with my indian group and one of your staff Anshu Rana serve us..It was a very great experience in westin...

Author: markL312TYGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: SAME OLD BREAKFAST DAILY WITH NO NEW ITEMS
Review: We stayed for 5 nights and on a daily basis we saw the same breakfast. As for us it was even worse as there was only very few items for vegetarians and the same old items repeated daily. The Fruit juices were all cordial and sugary drinks - no fresh juices. The breads were the same choices daily. When we requested for the Teh Tarikh we were told it would cost us RM50/- per glass!!! The Hotel seriously needs to look into this and improve its spread for breakfast and also to have polite staff positioned there.

Author: Summer WMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hit and miss Korean BBQ
Review: We ordered the Seaweed Rice Balls, the BBQ set with pork slices, belly and octopus and a Seafood Pancake. The service was slow which was expected with lots of customers still waiting for a table. The pork slices are frozen and wasn't marinated/ flavourful. The dishes that are worth trying is the octopus, the seafood pancake and the seaweed riceballs. The waiters didn't speak much of the local conversational languages and brought a wrong order (kimchi pancake instead of seafood pancake). We managed to get it changed at the and luckily we checked our bill before paying as they included both of the pancakes in the bill.

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Terrible Service!
Review: Used the Dome as an RV while waiting for friends to arrive and ordered drinks with intention of eating later. Place was empty which is not surprising. Managed to get cold drinks after a lot of cajoling and once our friends arrived indicated that we wanted to eat. Inexplicably the waiter chose to ignore us and appeared to be on another planet. Watched another couple have the same problem and they got up and walked - we followed suit and went to the adjacent bier keller where we did get served with some very good food. Avoid!

Author: ACDC29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Chicken Chop
Review: The design, decor and ambiance of the place was very nice. The feel was nostalgic, bringing to mind colonial style hainanese cafes of yesteryear.Unfortunately the chicken chop came with a horrible clear starchy sauce! My dining companion's mee mamak looked alright and the fish and chips was so-so but for a place popular for the Hainanese Chicken Chop this was a let down in the biggest proportions!

Author: Riazkaram
Title: Excellente food
Review: Excellent food and service, breakfast was awesome, breakfast everyday changing it feels you everday new, and tkanks for staff name Rasel he gave us good service, we will surly come back

Author: siewshentanHong Kong, China
Title: Dinner - 30 May 2018
Review: I am sitting in my grand hyatt room waiting for my tv to be fixed... Thus, this review begins.Arrived around 10pm yesternight, was hungry and decided to go thirty8. First impression, a bit off. The waiting staff was waiting for her colleague to bring me to my table. Did not turn up, so she brought me to my table. Bad start.Got the menu... And man, talk about limited choice... I am not sure what the person who designed this menu was thinking, but it was boring zero excitement. Fine, i wanted comfort food anyways, light but homely. Btw, each type of cuisine had like a few choices only... Quite steep.Decided on a fried prawn dish and hk style kailan plus steam rice. Was nit sure what fried prawn was because it had tempura sauce... Thought I'd double confirm... Asked the waiter who took my order, he did know if it was tempura... Had to check... I asked for room temperature still water as well. He came back with thec water, icey cold, pls change and he did. Then totally forgotten about my tempura question... 10 minutes later i asked again, he said yes.. I asked why did you not inform me? He walked away with a smile... Hmmm.Food came - tempura prawns.. No good, not very "tempura", and the kailan dish, 15 years living on hk never had hk kailan like this... The sauce was like the chef just poured oyster sauce... The steam rice was fine. Manager came and asked, all good? I said ok with a hint of this is bad. He did not care, just walked off... Courtesy call i suppose.Ok... If this is one of the best restaurants in KL, man, this is bad. I assume most (not all) reviewers who said how awesome must have been incentivised somehow... As we know tripadvisor does that. Thought I'd add my review to give an objective view.Avoid, unless you want to write another awful review from personal experience.

Author: mahzark
Title: Lunch time visit
Review: Serbis lembabs, Lotsa of tables waiting for food. The masala tea wasn't up to normal standards. First time here.. So don't know whether this is the norm during lunch hour or whether they are shortstaffed.

Author: gsatimessquare
Title: About of Roti.
Review: roti is so good and testy. but another foods is average, i think that if the kabbab quality will be like arabian then we will be happy

Author: ColKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Dining Experience In KL
Review: I've eaten a lot of Italian food in KL and the meal at Prego ranks as the worst. Had dinner with a party of 12 friends. Time from the first main plate delivery to the last was nearly 30 mins which meant 4 of our party had finished their dinner before the last 4 received theirs. Food quality for the price was poor - overly dry chicken, tasteless lamb - nobody was satisfied with their food. Restaurant manager failed to appear to address any of our concerns. Given the competitive KL restaurant market I see no reason for another visit to Prego and would not recommend it to anyone.

Author: LqsoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Could have been better
Review: Restaurant is warm and cozy, At first service was good then when it comes to the final bill payment, it sucks. Waiter literally throw the pen on the table for me to sign off my bill. After signing, took almost 2 minutes for them to come get it. Can see that very busy chatting with each other.Food wise apps and soup was good, loved the salad, mushroom soup was very good, hardly any independent restaurants or cafe can make that good mushroom soup. Told waiter that me and my wife are sharing for soup and apps....well the couldn't be bothered to give us a sharing plate or bowl.Main course was a disaster, we shared the Ocean & Earth. Beef ask for medium came out almost well done, prawn and fish is cook to perfectly dry like hell. Sauce is salty.Well, if the food and service were to be improved, i might just give another chance to come back.

Author: 228tinajAdelaide, Australia
Title: Love the food
Review: We ate here a number of times during our last and previous visits to KL. The food is very fresh and reasonably priced. And all though there was a queue most nights, it didn't take look for us to be shown to a table. Service is very swift. There are a range of soft drinks and beers on the menu but no wine! Have recommended this place to other people.

Author: Cassandra ZKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent food with poor staff
Review: We walked in to the restaurant. And the man who took orders just left us at the corner, asking us wait without any other words. However, when the next group of visitors arrived (who didn't make reservations in advance as well), the man suddenly became another person - warm, friendly, helping them register.As a result, even we were there earlier, our sequence was behind the next group. We wasted a lot of time there.But I must be fair to their food. They have the best black bean in town.I sincerely they have better staff in the future.

Author: Sjors983
Title: Disappointing
Review: Food was ok, not special. They threw a glass of beer over me, but did nothing about it. I had to went back to the hotel to change. When I came back, the beer was still all over the floor. Didn’t do anything to compensate.

Author: Idah196Singapore
Title: Good Beriyani
Review: We skipped the buffet and ordered ala carte. The naan came piping hot and the butter chicken was good. Tha palak paneer however was bland. The chicken beriyani was really good- very spicy. Ambience was ok but place was very convenient. Parking literally at doorstep, so good if you have elderly.

Author: Hanif K
Title: Go for the atmosphere
Review: Read a lot about this area and were excited to try the street food. The dishes we ordered were average. Portions were small. Atmosphere overall was great but definitely not satisfied with actual food. Good to have experienced but wouldn't visit the area again.

Author: Jenny W
Title: Left wanting
Review: We try and visit whenever we are back in the country.The set lunch menu has changed from a 3 course to a 4 course menu with a price increase.While food remains wonderful we were left wanting as the portions were much smaller than before.Suggest you revert back to your previous portion size as not a good sign when your patrons are having to look for more makan when they leave your establishment!

Author: cavassssinVicenza, Italy
Title: Weak service and poor food quality
Review: I do not know why I ended up in this chinese vegetarian restaurant. I was not satisfied at all: food is prepared without passion and love, the menu is costly compared to the presentation and the quality offered on the dish. I am sorry I have no photos to share: the noodles dish my friend ordered was really umpresentable. I had a sad set lunch and it came with a glass of soy milk.

Author: SydneyGazzaRozelle, Australia
Title: CHEF SMOKING IN THE KITCHEN !
Review: This is the first time I have ever seen a chef openly smoking in the kitchen of what is supposed to be an upmarket restaurant. When seen he then tried to hide under a counter and just continued to smoke. He didn't seem to care that he was doing the wrong thing and his workmates thought it was quite funny. We were quite appalled. No one seemed to care. Also when paying the bill, as I was about to enter the pin number I noticed that the amount was DOUBLE the actual bill. For a restaurant that is supposed to have a good reputation and frequented by many foreigners, just be aware. The worst eating experience we had in 3 weeks in Kuching.

Author: JeffBaselBasel, Switzerland
Title: Traditional banana leaf Indian cuisine
Review: Another favorite local restaurant of mine. The banana leaf set rice comes with steamed white rice, cucumber salad, fried butter gourd and another salad. A choice of chicken, fish or vegetarian curry to go with the rice. All served in banana leaf. Order extra the delicious fried chicken, fish or squid. A real unique way to enjoy Indian cuisine.

Author: Eddy_LeongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great View with Overrated Food Experience
Review: I have to admit that Marini's on 57 has a great view from the high ground however as for the food I'm not to excited about it. Seating next the to windows with dazzling light of the city it is romantic to bring your wife or girlfriend for a fancy dinner however the

Author: jeff1955malaysiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Indian Muslim Resto
Review: it is located at the junction of Central market (CM). It has a bright yellow sign board. they serve both indian and malay food. You get tosai, chapati and nasi lemak. during lunch you have the buffet lunch where you pick and choose the food and they bill you accordingly. For items like prawns and fish it is better to ask the price before taking. they also have mamak noodles and fried rice, roti naan. ample food and sitting. Place always packed because of the busy area. food is of average quality. Service is also average.

Author: Shall_Lina
Title: Good location
Review: We had a dinner there 1 time for traveling .they had western food and local food .the staff are friendly .

Author: Ylimeylime
Title: Average
Review: It is a nice place to have meals here but is not advisable for ppl who bring along kids

Author: WawanieRffan
Title: Average lunch buffet
Review: Having lunch with a group of collegue...the environment is ok...food varieties is just so so...the taste quite ok...acceptable...!

Author: Helena GBrussels, Belgium
Title: Nice fusion menu. But beware: Check for mistakes when passing your card.
Review: Visited the restaurant earlier this month with friends and family. The menu presented a nice variety of fusion cuisine, which realization was good enough. The starters/apèros are generous, thus ordering for everyone was an excess, as we ordered main courses too. Overall the experience was good, but it was overshadowed by the fact that they did not ask us which currency to charge to our Eurocard -which is fraud not to advise systematically the customer. However, we did not oversee the overcharge of 35% before signing the bill. Upsetting as it was, we asked them to correct the mistake. They did, but we were left with the bad aftertaste of a dinner that was assumed to be a nice get together with friends in our trip to Malaysia.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Herodotus888Sydney, Australia
Title: KLIA2 Branch - A Bit Odd
Review: This review is for the KLIA2 airport branch of this restaurant.We found it pretty odd. They don't seem to cater very well for foreigners which is a bit strange for a restaurant based in an international airport! No-one spoke English (fair enough) but there was very little attempt to assist us in choosing the food. As it happened, the food was cold. It looked hot but turned out to be barely warm.The ordering system was incomprehensible but you soon end up with a plate of food that, having said all that, was ok and cheap.I suspect that this place is geared up for locals only and that foreign travellers are an inconvenience. Again, it was ok and, believe it or not, I might go back!

Author: InashaAleeMale
Title: Delicious food and amazing atmosphere
Review: Cozy little place with different atmosphere compared to the other restaurants. It is quiet and lovely.with delicious food; tried the waffles and breakfast. They were truly amazing.The owners are friendly and warmDefinitely would visit the place again!

Author: GourmandVKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing food
Review: This restaurant is located on a relatively quiet neighborhood in Bangsar, so parking was convenient. The first floor dining area was dimly lit (somewhat romantic for dinner) and while the place was empty, we were placed right next to another couple's table, where a woman was talking very loudly.The waiter was friendly and was knowledgeable enough to provide recommendations on the food. We tried the bacon lollipops which were delicious. The seafood pasta and lamb rack were edible (not outstanding) but the portions overall were small, considering the price we paid. We decided not to stay for dessert even though the menu was tempting.

Author: Doreenang_ssaa
Title: Disappointing
Review: Service is ok only but food is disappointing. The ambience and cleanliness is sub-standard. Really not worth for a try. I was so badly bitten by mosquitoes. Given a choice, I will never revisit them again especially there are too many choices to choose. Desserts...More

Author: Richard_HengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent Japanese Meal
Review: I was at the AEON outlet at Tebrau, joining 2 Japanese customers for a quick lunch. We ordered set meal and some side dishes to go with it. The amount didn't look a lot, but at the end, to finish our own portion, it was very filling. Food being served are fresh and accompanied by decent portion of veg. Personally, I like the beverage, I ordered a Kiwi (cant remember the name), it is very refreshing, especially on a hot dayOverall experience is very good, staffs are very attentive.

Author: Ed-HenryIndonesia
Title: What a culinary educational experience!
Review: Make sure you make a reservation. The place is a favourite amongst visitors especially on weekends. When we arrived, we were served a mystery mocktail and we had to guess the ingredients. Also we put on a blindfold to pick up paperclips from a bucket of rices and beans. This was a practice round for what came up next in the dining area.The dinner was a 4-course meal, with appetisers (4 kinds), soups (2), main courses (3) and desserts (5). They didn't tell you what you ate, until you finished your meal. You can see the menu when you paid the bill outside the dining area, in the reception area. If you opt for wine pairing, you will also have to guess the wine.The place is absolutely pitch dark, You have to leave your mobile phone and watch in a locker. It was a fantastic experience. The waiters are mostly visually impaired. Our waiter, Darius was very kind, patient and funny! We thoroughly enjoyed the dinner and the conversation with him afterwards. The host, Monique, was very kind and friendly too.The food tasted good. There were some that were too salty for me. And it's pricey. But the experience is worth it.

Author: Mitchell_Lim
Title: Least Favourite Outlet
Review: Pretty much the same menu across all outlets. However, quality of hot food here ain't as good as that of Menara Tan&Tan, MidValley Megamall...Had kebab with couscous..sent it back cos meat was extremely tough; as though meat was cut along the grains but had to chew against. Salad greens quite wilted and cakes ain't fresh.No worth the money..

Author: Kiing239Miri,Sarawak
Title: BAD FRONT LINE SERVICE
Review: I work in the service industry and I've had my share of bad experiences with people , at such, I made it a point to be courteous to any front-liners. But this branch of McDonald really need to improve thier staff training, especially the order queque. Sometimes we need to pack our car and wait for our orders to be delivered, which can be a long wait for a fast food chain. I agreed with KongJing26 & ShawnWong. The few times that I've been there, floor space were a bit dirty and the toilet, well .. wet and smelly & the crew just lack the efforts and its so obvious since its an open-kitchen. The management should really do something since McD is practically an icon to keep up with the service and expectations ! Come on, motivate your staff!

Author: 786Chris82
Title: View
Review:
Lovely chilled rooftop bar in the centre of Kuala Lumpur, drinks were great and the satay mortar platter was out of this world. Service was impeccable. 
Very reasonable priced. Will come again when back in KL.

Author: Prakash76Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disspointing Experience
Review: Celebrated our anniversary here. My partner had to wait until I had almost finished by appetizer before he got his and there wasn't even an apology. We ordered a bottle of wine but it was not available and the Manager suggested we had a completely different bottle - and of course a more expensive wine. The wine list was not extensive at all, so there should not be an excuse to not have all the wines available. My steak was quite nice, but by then, we were not really in the mood. It was too noisy for a romantic dinner. We really couldn't wait to get out of the place. The staff were not friendly either and the owner never came out to see us. Wouldn't be celebrating our next anniversary there, that's for sure.

Author: Iruka_82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Experience Ever
Review: Understand it was the pandemic and buffet was changed to menu set style of order type. However the menu was confusing and staff told guest that customer are only allowed to order a set each. There is no further explanation. We were serve like mamak style, have to ask for it kind. I'm beyond shocked by the worst dining experience in a hotel. I end up walking out hungry and upset. Portioning is buffet size but customer can only order once. Ridiculous, rigid & utterly rubbish. Shame on you. Suppose to be no star, I'll leave the food and menu for you guys to judge

Author: Wei Y
Title: Deposit taken & NO REFUND
Review: Upon reservation for New Year Eve dinner in the apartment, KLCC, RM250 deposit was demanded. At the end of the day it was not deducted from our bills and neither returning it back to us. After making FEW TRIPS to the apartment for inquiries, they decided to give us VOUCHER instead of giving us the money back. It seems like we are forced to purchase the voucher with no intention at all!!! Is this the right approach when dealing with customer, taking their deposit and in return with voucher?? Where is their customer service standard?Quite disappointing with the service - slow response and no responsibility. We had a package of wine and we were promised to have 2 bottles of wines but it turned out only 1 bottle was given. Reason given by them was out from 2 bottles we can only choose 1, totally contradict to what they have promised!Definitely, no 2nd visit for me and NOT recommend for others too. Food was just so so, nothing fantastic except the ambience. Im sure can get better restaurant from the neighbouring one.

Author: joey_7687
Title: So so
Review:
Very sad to say that the taste was so so
Don't think will return again 
However,not all were lost,the service was quick good

Author: JJGraf
Title: Fantastic food
Review: went there for Dinner with my wife. We had the ricotta gnocchi on blue cheese sauce and the tortellini,  both home made and truly delicious.

Author: gunasegeranp
Title: Dinner with family friends from Sydney
Review: Worst service ever by supervisor. Served us like we cannot afford. Will not recommend to anyone. Total bill came to 456.00.
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: Karin10Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: cheap and always busy Indian
Review: because an Indian friend of us was staying in Kuala Lumpur, we decided to visit Devi's Corner. Voted as one of the best Indian restaurants by Time Out Magazine.The restaurant is also one of the cheapest we ever ate in Kuala Lumpur, which is nice for a change. The food is very tastefull, but don't come here for having a chique or romantic evening out. It's like having a quick bite at a fast food, but than much more tastefull.

Author: shagee2019
Title: Poor service and arrogant customer service.
Review: Went with friends and two different waiter took order and waited for 30 min for food and went to ask.. And told briyani was ready but those who came 10 min ago got their order..Finally food arrived 43 mins after order.The couple who came after we arrived ate and left.Briyani was half the portion and went asked they said it was by mistake and didn't even have the courtesy to add back the missing portion.Charged full price for the meal.What a rip off.Decided not to go again.

Author: khqwerty
Title: Best European restaurant
Review: Beautiful restaurant, perfect ambience. We had steak and lamb cutlets- cooked to perfection. Love the fries- fresh, crispy on the oustide, soft on the inside, well and lightly salted. Heads up to Mr Adli and Ms Regina for their impeccable service.

Author: AnthonyMoussKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Way below expectation
Review: As we were staying at the Hilton , we decided to eat at Vasco for our anniversary dinner . What a mistake . We didn’t mind that the buffet was served at the table , but the ordering system is wrong , keep have to wait for the waiter to notice you even though there is a QR code on the table to order but it isn’t working . We wanted to laugh when the dishes were serve , how small it was , you must keep on ordering to make it worth the price , hence you keep on waiting . The biggest problem was the food quality , It was so below average, I don’t know how those chef manage to get their job there . Seriously . We tried almost every dishes on the menu and only the pizza were surprisingly good . I reached to the point that I’d actually rather cook dinner myself than eating here . We were given a complimentary chocolate cake for our anniversary, but it tasted bad too , like just out of freezer .Breakfast was included with our room so we were back here in the morning, sadly the choice was very limited and not so worth it . Conclusion: won’t go back

Author: elisewong0Kuala Selangor, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: If I could rate a negative, I would
Review: When we got there, my aunt and cousin were already sitting at the table with an additional person with her back facing us. I didn't know who it was and when we saw who it was, it was the waitress sitting on the table and did not move a budge when we sat down, not even a smile to us. Even after ordering, she's still talking about what-- even I dunno. We just wanted her to get out orders to the kitchen. We were hungry from walking around jonker Street. If that was bad enough, we had to wait an hour for our food to arrive and there was nobody in the room! When the food finally arrived. The rice came at a very tortoise pace. All that time waiting, they could at least prepare the rice and forks and spoons so we can eat readily but noooooo... Now for the food. It is not authentic at all. The pom tay was diluted. In actuality,the stew was suppose to boil with the potatoes for a while to the point the stew is thick and the potatoes super soft but this was far from it. Their prawn fritters, I think.. Even the local store by the road that sells 'cucur udang' actually tastes better. The otak otak was alright. The Tom yam was alright but they use very cheap cuts of meat for every dish. For the pom tay, they use chicken breast (with skills, you can make the breast soft but the meat was incredibly tough and dry) as for the Tom yam, there was very few fish meat and a lot more of fish cakes. Really? The kangkung was alright. The omelet was meh... We came out of the place very disappointed and VERY angry.

Author: AliAzzamShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Good food ,lack presentation
Review: I will say that the food here is delicious. However , I am a bit frustrated that I have to eat my dinner from boxes. Yup,it feel awkward though. Unless if you have intention to take it away. Point to note...you are not allowed to make reservation ( sometimes it can be really crowded and they don't have credit card facilities.) If I may advise the owner , please apply this facility. But another good point is that ,their serving is quite fast.

Author: jarodl977
Title: Early bah kut teh
Review:
Individual serve meat, need abit hear on the bah kut teh...
Tea pot abit small for me...
Still a very good food is serve!
Restaurant: Restoran Seng Huat Bak Kut Teh

Author: 619sidharthb
Title: Horrible!!!!
Review: Hair in my food, potato undercooked awaited for ages for the food... slow service. Avoid at all costs

Author: travealddictedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced
Review: I was really disappointed with brunch here. Service was incredibly slow and many items off the menu were “out of stock”. The food was tasty, but portions were not huge. But I did find that the prices were way too high. Their prices are similar to brunch prices in Singapore or London... but you are in JB!! I felt ripped off and will not return again.

Author: AsiaMorganSingapore, Singapore
Title: Spacious Indian restaurant with authentic offerings
Review: Overall, a very good choice for restaurant quality Indian food. Standards that come out quickly but don’t taste pre cooked. Relaxing atmosphere, too. My only tiff was that we, a party of six, asked for a refill of our table water and they refused? Was it worth the savings my friends. An odd thing to do in a stylish restaurant. Otherwise, highly recommended.

Author: RoyT1577
Title: Nice seafood restaurant
Review: We came for dinner with our family and enjoyed the dishes that we ordered. The midin belacan (wild fern leaf) was not tasty enough. The salted prawn is a bit sweet. The grouper fish is nice though. The crab in Hainanese style is ok but the buns is good eaten with the sauce. Sea cucumber soup is ok too.The last time we went here the food was great, now maybe the quality decrease. Overall it was affordable and there's ample parking space if you come early.

Author: skatemusicianer
Title: Great thin crust pizza, friendly atmosphere
Review: Dropped in after work, not expecting much - but was blown away by the balance and flavours - the crust is light, allowing you to experience the toppings in their full flavour. Interesting local Sarawakian combinations are available. We will be back for sure!

Author: RonA_Plymouth
Title: Not all that
Review: We did not enjoy the food, the service was unfriendly and for what they offered well over priced. Better everything at other places in the area.

Author: Braveheart2013Whitby, Ontario
Title: 4 mini BBQ Bao for a table of 7 people
Review: The" bao" is nice but the way they do business is not customer friendly. Was here last year and it seems that there is always a shortage of BBQ buns. They are good but very small and it seems that they place limits on each table. Here's a suggestion: IF BBQ buns are popular , why not make more of them? I won't be going back there again given the choice. I find it utterly ridiculous that most places that has been on the blog and receives favorable reviews, the owners become arrogant and rude. My mum asked the owner the simple questions of how much the Big Buns were and instead a simple answer from one of the lady owner, she gave her a rude reply.. look at the pricing menu on the wall. What goes around comes around. By the way their dim sum like siow mai, etc is so so only.

Author: Ivan SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Too pricey for the local food
Review: www.Atmosphere360.com.my where one can make a booking for lunch or dinner which has increased in its prices from a couple of years back. Just to look around from the open deck, one will have to pay close to RM100. Parking from the evening goes up to RM5 per entry.

Author: naneanMelbourne, Australia
Title: Flavourful and fresh
Review: To escape the heat, I highly recommend sitting inside, instead of on the street. It is not only cooler but quieter. I wanted to order the kangkong Sotong, however was told it wasn't available. When asking which part was not available, was told we could order them seperately, just not together. I found this quite odd, and the waitress seemed to dislike the fact that I asked. She did however drop her attitude later in the evening. We had the Sambal kangkong (well executed), the hot and spicy clams (which were really tasty), and the char Kway teow (nothing wow, but certainly was acceptable). We had a satisfying meal here (if you can get passed the crowds seated outside on jalan alor!).

Author: O9951SXpauljLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food
Review: Stopped for dinner as the restaurant was packed, so you'd guess the food was good- it was.Good portions, good service.Compared to other local restaurants and hawker stall the food was expensive for Penang, but for a western budget, it was still cheap.Would eat here again.

Author: AnnieTranMelbourne, Australia
Title: WORSE ALL YOU CAN EAT
Review: I pre book voucher for this restaurant for 6 days for a buffet breakfast for two. The buffet starts at 7am-11am but just to let everyone know that they don't have food after 9:30am. Sounds ridiculous well that is exactly what happened to me. I went down one morning and the waitress very rudely told me that there is no food (9:30am). I said to her so what do I do? She look at me and said nothing. Five minutes later the chef said go to hotel get refund. So I did. Told the hotel staff what had happened and he walk me back to the restaurant and he said just wait here and he'll order me a omelette which I don't really mind. Sat down waited Waited and waited nothing. 5 minute later I ask the girl for my food and she just went to the serving table and pick up two pizza with just cheese and drop it on my table. I was fuming. I throw the pizza back on the table and walk off. This shouldn't happened. And also they have the same food ever breakfast. Which are bread hot dogs,small meat pastry, boil eggs, harsh brown and some chocolate muffin. And they also have freshly cook omelette but you really have to make a big deal to get one. Disgusting

Author: cclyeGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Indian food in heart of KL
Review: Last time I visited Passage Thru India was during CNY in 2016. We had vegetarian food during that visit. This time round, my parents came along with my wife and I.For starters, we had chicken pakora, aloo jeera (potato cubes stir fried with herbs and spices), papadum, rasam and tomato soup.For mains, we had tandoori chicken, chicken murgh shahjahani, lamb rogan josh, palak paneer to go with kashmiri pulao rice, butter and garlic naans.The tandoori chicken stood out as the thigh meat came out tender and juicy unlike other Indian food outlets.Excellent meal. Service was very attentive too.

Author: Keelung SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No More Magical
Review: We have our dinner here. The service is efficient. Order was brief and crew were attentive. The chicken portion has scaled down, compared to we came 3 years ago. The chicken is sweet now, which is funny. It really disappointed us. I wonder why they have changed the recipe.

Author: Krasen18Sydney, Australia
Title: Great place with views
Review: Visited this place with my cousin for drinks. The expansive view of KL and PJ provides a great lounge experience whilst you sip your glass of wine. However there are few things to improve that could really enhance this place :1) The service could be much faster2) Serving expensive wines and champagnes in plastic flutes and glasses seem odd. Depending on the order, i would suggest using real glasses especially if people are there just to enjoy the view and not to use the pool.Overall a good place.

Author: Amy_smk
Title: Fresh sashimi
Review: The sashimi served is super fresh. The sets are value for money considering the quality of the ingredients. As a plus, real grated wasabi is given too! Would definitely visit again :)

Author: suntanKualaLumpurkuala lumpur
Title: Unleashing the Secret of Louisiana
Review: A surprise detour to this charming restaurant overlooking the lake was a pretty amazing find..most of the time newee restaurants were crestfallen dreams.Never having had a meal out in Malaysia for the past decade due to allergies I resigned myself for that cup of tea to' watch while the family eat 'routine.But to my amazement the Chef was actually out there to liase with.I did not have feel apologetic and defensive in ordering a meal devoid of additives and preservatives..believe me that being so simple is a rarity here.The fear that the meal one takes could be that last supper..is horrendous..tedious really!So here we were in this warm and delightful ambience and i indulged in this beautiful meal walking away with confidence in the chef.Priceless!Thank you Chef Elvin for your expertise. By the way I did notice they have a lovely bar n lounge area too.So for those of us who miss those quiet evenings lounging over quiet drinks and warm meals and desserts ..this would be the place to go

Author: skidkid666kuala lumpur
Title: didnt detect the soul
Review: went with a group of expats for a reunion night. About 18 of us all told, with kids and a wide range of ages.Football was showing on lots of big screen, big positive for us as we were all keen on watching the match.Beers etc reasonably priced for the area,not massively impressed by the repeated attempts by staff to sell me cocktails I had made it clear I didnt want!Very large menu, which always worries me. Very small portions for the price. Good quick service though.What could have been a reasonablyfun evening came very unstuck at payment time. When we asked if we could split the bill the answer came back a resounding no! Ok, can you help us divvy up as it will be a bit tricky to work out who owes what after adding tax, as prices on the menu are without? er, no. Ok, I will do it. After much fussing, bills sorted, I went to the till with our server to pay, only to find he had no idea how to work the computerized till, (which would have made the bill separation easy if they could have been bothered to use it).Now, I am a pretty relaxed guy, but after 10 minutes of fumbling around, the guy told me it was all my fault,at which point I had to calm down and move away, letting someone else deal with the mess. End result? God knows.Shame. A bit of training and some less aggressive pricing and it would have been agood night, as it was, it wasnt!

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just okay...
Review: Maybe we got in on an early part of lunch time. So, there is not that many people. Ordered and the owner is upselling their black bean soup, assam fish, apart from the chicken which can be either poached, roasted or a combination of both. We decided to go for both for variety. For the upselling we only ordered the black bean soup.The food came in a jiffy with a plate of chicken rice rolled into balls.There is no difference between a normal bowl of rice and being rolled into balls.The chilli is really spicy enough. Black bean soup is just okay together with the rest of the food ordered.A bit pricey

Author: Incoherent1Keflavik, Iceland
Title: Not very good
Review: I was looking for a quick bite to eat, and didn't have super high expectations, but I'd give this a "pass" in the future. The tabouleh (Lebanese salad) was... pretty bad. While this is usually a favorite dish of mine, their iteration was basically just some wilted parsley chopped and tossed into a bowl. It was tasteless and they left way too many stems in the mix (the best tabouleh leaves these out entirely), so the texture was unpleasant as well. My lamb wrap was okay (even though I ordered the beef wrap), but very chewy and without a lot of seasoning or flavor. I'd look elsewhere for better food!

Author: Helen BMelbourne, Australia
Title: Experience sky high dining
Review: Amazing views of KL particularly the Petronas Towers. The food was typical buffet - plenty of variety and styles to suit all tastes. Save room for the selection of petite cakes - I generally dont go for desert but these were perfectly sized and delicious. Note alcohol and soft drinks are not included - we paid 33 Ringet for a glass of beer (ouch!) And they dont advise you the price upfront. There is a dress code - men must have long pants (the provide a long wrap if you turn up in shorts - hairy legs are a hygiene problem! ) ladies you can wear anything.

Author: Max LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overated
Review: Got attracted by Casablanca eggs on food blogs. Well, end up its just eggs with sausages and napolitana. The drinks are fine. Mum had a piece of cake which is so dry that she left almost half untouched. It was suppose to be her birthday cake.

Author: David PPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Terrible Malay food, acceptable Indian
Review: My wife ordered from the lunch menu was there was nothing she liked on the main menu (vege).The nasi gorang tasted like it was reheated (from lunchtime) as it was dry and tasteless.My chicken biryani was ok and was served in an innovative fashiion (bamboo).The tiger beer and service were good.

Author: cyrildasonKuching, Malaysia
Title: Needs a new look
Review: Hong Kong Noodle House has been around for quite sometime, and the place is a bit run down, needing a newer fresher look.Food however is not bad, but not also excellent.The Pork Fried in Nestum and the Sweet Sour Pork is worth to try and mention.Service is fast and price is okay.

Author: travelingdimensionsSingapore, Singapore
Title: It used to be good
Review: The magnificent fish and chips bar used to be quite good and one of the primary reasons for this was the staff. It seems that a lot of the old staff that I used to see have left and I don't know if this includes the cooks but the food definitely fluctuates in quality so much so that I no longer know if I'd be getting a passable meal or a bad one. Given the abundance of great food available in the area I'd rather go somewhere where I know I'll be getting a good meal. Its unfortunate because I used to really enjoy coming here.

Author: PeiXin712
Title: Birthday Celebration
Review: Service is good, food is awesome, atmosphere is nice. A must-go restaurant to celebrate birthday or anniversary.

Author: HappycatHappycatWoodford Green, United Kingdom
Title: No soft drinks?...
Review: I m a little confused... We went here for food & drinks (soft drinks only as I m pregnant and my husband had a dodgy belly - normally we are big time party people :-( ) When we asked for water we were told they don't sell soft drinks! Errrrr so why does it have soft drinks on the menu board outside? Also another post mentioned a soft drink being served in a jam or pickle jar. No water?! Seriously? Very peculiar.... Although My other half was up for a few beers tomorrow night we won't be going back if I can't have a soft drink! Confused.com

Author: CareFreeBluesN London
Title: well worth a visit
Review: great food and service .good for vegetarians . Good choice on menu

Author: CarolAsiaBali
Title: Has nothing to do with Indian food
Review: We have been very disappointed with this place. Its not a good quality food for the price you need to pay. The food did not taste good, there was too much sugar being added to every dish. I have order mutton and had to send it to the kitchen back as it was to chewy to eat and there was not good quality meat used in it. Would not come back and do not recommend it.

Author: yapw_13Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing .....
Review: Beats me why this steakhouse is ranking no. 2 in KL. it shouldn't be at all. I've had better steaks than this joint in other parts of KL and from JB. First of all Onion soup is too salty & has two beef meatballs in it. Totally turns me off as if I was asking for testies soup. Then came the pan seared scallops. I dunno why they use this veggies to blend with the scallops. It does not blend well. And the steak is the overall loser. Ordered medium cooked and saw the blood redness in the meat. But what I don't understand, is their steaks do not retain the juiciness . It's probably cheap though & that is why for that price, many good ratings by patrons with bad taste

Author: Stacey R
Title: Some of the best food I've ever eaten!
Review: This place rocks - without a doubt some of the best food I have ever eaten! Marlon was our waiter and he was so knowledgable, friendly and no request was too much for him. We had the half pig (can't remember what the proper name was for it) had to be ordered in advance when we booked but totally worth it. And you don't just get the meal, there's also a bit of a show to go with it as well. So much fun - if you are in KL you must try here at least once!

Author: 112sureshkMount Waverley, Australia
Title: Utterly disappointed with their attitude
Review: Extremely disappointing after never being disappointed at Naughty Nuri's before... We decided to go by for an early dinner last nite with our son. In the past, turning up at 6pm on a weekend for a bite and a drink and staying for as long as we wanted has never benn a problem. Knowing full well that you only take reservations for 6 pax or more, we turned up yesterday at about 6.15pm and were informed that if we wanted to dine, we had to be done by 7.30pm, as ALL tables had been booked and there was nothing available for a small party of 3. So not only do you not allow small groups to make a booking, you don't keep any small tables spare for us. And while, we probably wouldn't have stayed past 8.30pm, the whole experience of 'nothing for you if you're not a party of 6 and haven't made a reservation' but you can rush through a meal if you can be out of here by 7.30pm, otherwise thanks but no thanks we don't want you..." was infuriating to say the least.Furious with the attitude, we left immediately and went down the road to Naughty Babe Dirty Duck where not only did they have a table with no time limitations (even though they had reserved tables as well for any number of people), they was absolutely no time restrictions when the table had to be vacated. Best part, dinner was served 5 mins after we ordered and the food was FABULOUS, not to mention the service which was impeccable.Walking back to our car after dinner at about 8.30pm, we walked through Naughty Nuri's and surprise, surprise, tables of 3 & 4 not just reserved tables of 6. Shame on you Naughty Nuri's when it's simple enough to:1. either have 2 seating sessions - 6pm and 8.30pm for anyone with any number of people to make a reservation, or2. to just set aside a bunch of smaller tables for groups of 4 or less who just want to have a quick and early bite with a drink.I'll most definitely be heading back to Naughty Babe Dirty Duck and be sharing this post out to as many people as I can because you have really disappointed with your high and mighty attitude Naughty Nuri's. Extremely disappointed with a place I always enjoyed frequenting before.

Author: Alex_JaneRuMoscow, Russia
Title: fake impression
Review: The only interesting thing in this place is marketing - such a "hidden ancient chinese cafe". Thus it attracts mostly Westerners, rather than locals or Chinese. That means that food quality leaves much to be desired. Indeed food is very basic, definetely not interesting and not delicious. It is also very far from quality Chinese cooking. My result of visiting this place was food poisoning. Think twice.

Author: FeliciaCMarieSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not recommended
Review: Just went last night with a friend. Ordered Tom Yum, Pandan Chicken, Mix Vage & Fried fish with sauce.Pandan chicken was so-so in flavour. Tom Yum was above average.Mix vage with oyster sauce taste decent, nothing outstanding.Fried grouper In some thai sauce (can’t remember exactly the name) it was meh.My heartache writing this review because I love Thai food so much. I read the review & all the hype about this restaurant. Price is not on the lower range that makes my heart aches even more. Pandan chicken, Tom yum & mix vage arrived around 8-10mins gap from each item. Food was Luke warm. Even my warm water is warmer. I think they forgotten my fried fish. My friend & I were almost finish eating. My other dishes are 90% finished but my fish is yet to arrived. Me n my friend kinda stop eating so we can wait for the fish. We waited for about 10 minutes after stop eating. The fish is the only thing that’s hot in all the meal. Even my rice was not even warm. Paid rm177++ including tax. Was it worth it? No. Will I revisit? No. Will I recommend? Big NO. Even the family next to my table was scolding the staff (their food didn’t serve fully even after almost hour of eating).Please improve & do something about it. Such a nice ambiance & exclusive. But the food was not up to what we expected. But we finish almost everything except Pandan chicken & the fish we ate half (but that’s the most expansive item on the table for us!) because we are hungry. I’m just so disappointed.

Author: samhus
Title: A beatiful break to escape the heat
Review:
It is a unique place full of Artistic gestures. Clean and organized with free wifi and good service.
The coffee and the ice cream  were delicious and the atmosphere is nice but it is a bit small.

Author: petrinajoanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Horrible Experience!! Again!
Review: Well... an update on my previous review.. Mr Navee from the restaurant had called me after seeing this review and even spoke to me when I went there for my friend's function. He seemed to be really kind and apologetic. Claimed that he has spoken with the management and they really wanted to provide a free lunch/dinner for my family. I said I accepted his apology, but he insisted that they had to give me the free meal to compensate for our treatment there. So I promised to take them up on the offer once I could get my family together.Fast forward to the end of July. And I messaged the mobile number given by Mr Navee if it was convenient to bring my family for dinner there that weekend. A lady called me back from that number and said that we can come and that she was aware of the arrangement. That Mr Navee was on leave (I did offer to reschedule to when Mr Navee comes back). She seemed in a rush to complete the call so I messaged to reconfirmed that it'll be a complementary meal.She said she'll speak to the directors.She then called back and said that they can only offer free buffet lunch if we wanted a free meal. As if we were begging for a free meal!I immediately cancelled the reservation!The most horrible experience with a fine dining establishment I've ever had!

Author: danny jSingapore, Singapore
Title: OVER-RATED, BLAND AND DILUTED
Review: My partner and I were looking forward to dining at Nancy's after reading the reviews and based on recommendations in some websites.We appreciated and respected the reviews. However, we felt the restaurant is over-rated!And the long queuing was not worth it at all.It is no doubt the restaurant is very popular amongst the tourists but a few chats with the locals, we were told that the standard has dropped very much.And we could not agree more. The management did not maintain the quality of the food. I suspect they may have chosen quantity over quality. We ordered 4 dishes to savour. Each dish may have its own distinctive taste and seasoning. However, the two words to describe it is 'Diluted and bland'. Peranakan food is known to be rich and savoury. It is not supposed to be palatably light. So, my partner and I could not reconcile with that the fact that this restaurant is voted no.1 for its Nonya food. We have expected better.Perhaps, it was the tourists who have voted for it and not the locals.
