Or maybe this is the only Peranankan restaurant in Jonker Street that serves pork dishes so it attracted the crowd.I would personally not recommend this restaurant. You may have a different opinion and other expectations because everyone has a differing taste bud. You may want to consider Kocik Kitchen which is just a stone's throw away from Nancy. Why not go for both if you are staying for two nights and draw your own conclusions?Enjoy!

Author: bob bAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Steak Night
Review: Great place - attentive, friendly staff, quick service and very, very nice food, just what it says on the label. I live in KL and will be back there weekly.

Author: WhatdoyouwanPlentong, Malaysia
Title: Delicious TomYam and Thai dishes
Review: 2 adults and a baby went to Absolute Thai on a non public holiday weekday. We had an early dinner, which the restaurant served only 3 tables of customer.We order TomYam seafood, onion beef, sweet sour chicken and vegetables. All were delicious, we like especially the clear soup TomYam, very spicy and rich.We will go visit them again, but we will order more dishes, as the food portion is small.

Author: frolicker_leonSingapore, Singapore
Title: cendol
Review: had only their cendol as my hostel was next to this place. from the various slips of complimentary notes pinned on the walls, their nonya laksa seems really popular. i only had their cendol, which is excellent too. but to be fair, you can't go wrong with cendol. anyway, this place is very clean, and food is always freshly prepared.

Author: LimlennaGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Expected to be better
Review: It was my first time to Murni and I have heard a lot of good things about this place. It turned out to be a disappointment. I order teh o limau and got teh o instead. The triple H was very bad. The bread was too compact and mayo was limited, making the whole appetizer rather dry. The ice blended like Soda Herb was the only fix to our visit.

Author: kkhannnn
Title: Rediculas place
Review: so slow service and disrespect costumer . i am not going  there and i will suggest that other that plz don't disrespect your self to go there.

Author: 589hannahnAdelaide, Australia
Title: amazing food with amazing service
Review: have been to this restaurant many times before and have always rated it 10/10. This trip to KL was my first trip since changing to a vegan lifestyle, when we got to the restaurant we were greeted by Martin and before we took a seat I asked if they would be able to make a vegan meal because I knew they didn't have anything on the menu. Martin told me they could do a pasta full of veggies either olive oil based or tomato based, I went with the tomato based one and definitely didn't regret it. He also made sure the bruschetta was vegan and the cocktail I ordered. Not only was the food probably one of the best meals I have ever had but his service was outstanding, he was understanding of my dietary requirements and was more than happy to help. I will continue to go back to this restaurant time and time again

Author: Joll_es49
Title: No thanks
Review: I went here to eat authentic Malay food. It was a ‘dump’ filthy dirty. We love street food but this was NOT for us. 🤮

Author: Michael Bshanghai
Title: Dreadful - don't bother
Review: The owners were talking loudly at a table in the "restaurant" whilst the new waitress game fully tried to sort out issues - very little of the menu was available - we eventually ordered, waited almost an hour and left, paying only for the couple of drinks. Just awful and annoying - go somewhere where the owners and staff actually care!

Author: pianocello
Title: In KLCC
Review: We ordered beef noodles, spaghetti, cendol. The decor is very tasteful and this restaurant is seldom crowded. Service was satisfactory. Food was decent but not a must - go. The main problem is that this is just too expensive for what is on offer.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Rosielim7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice enviroment with excellent food & service
Review: The service and food is really good. Ordered shrimp dumplings, char siew bao, Sichuan style chicken feet, fried carrot cake (fired with bean sprouts, eggs) - do not like it find the taste a little weird ..., love the steamed cod fish with garlic/ginger the best! Take note on their business hours. They open only from 12noon unless it's during public holiday they will open early around 11am or 11.30am til night. Was there at 10am so I went back again around 12nn.Located on the 5th level at Hilton Hotel (Opposite KL Sentral Station)

Author: loiseloiseUlan Bator
Title: Would be overpriced but okay if internet worked, but it doesn't
Review: Coffee was okay but very overpriced, which would only be slightly annoying if the extra services wrapped up in the those prices, like fast and reliable wifi, and strong AC, were good. Unfortunately, after we'd been there a very short time, the internet went out completely, and staff seemed totally uninterested in getting it to work again. AC was not quite as strong as should be.

Author: stevenpN5318FNSingapore
Title: Great flavours
Review: Surroundings non aircon...so it was uncomfortable.Alcohol and drinks average.Flavours of food was fantastic! So very hard to decide if you'd go back. If you're looking for a fun afternoon by the pool side with good food, then this could be it with a group you bring yourself.Quite empty when we went on on Saturday lunch.Food Flavours the only attraction!

Author: jetlagwooferSydney
Title: I was expecting great things.
Review: Meh. The food wasn't bad, but it wasn't 'wow' either. I was led to believe this was 'the place' for Malaysian cuisine.The decor is interesting. It's an outdoor open air hut style restaurant - between the Andaman and Datai resorts.The food all tasted similar, which was disappointing. We were practically ignored mist of the evening. We served our own wine - I don't have a problem with this if the restaurant is busy, but there were only 5 tables occupied (our of 50!).The Thai restaurant at Datai is better.

Author: Iceman808Las Vegas, Nevada
Title: Quality Drop
Review: Well, after 6 months I came back to this restaurant again and found the food quality is dropping. Don’t know weather my taste bud is improving or the food is getting worst. Everyone has their own judgement and if you ask my personal opinion, I will not go back. I should try another place just across the street call Lot 10 on 4th or 5th floor which I was told is more pricy but quality is much better or at the lower ground floor where you can choose more casual Japanese food at Isetan. The choice is yours...

Author: bijoy k
Title: Avoid mutton dishes
Review: Had ordered a virundhu non veg sappadu. A very unattractive thaali with an equally chewy mutton curry. My friend ordered a mutton biriyani. Was one of the worst with low quality rice and inferior mutton pieces which were rubbery too. Don't know how they manage to grow internationally

Author: Sarah FOslo, Norway
Title: lovely
Review: the best food around if u prefer western style, great service, cozy hotel. great location....very close to any activity u would like. i like that its a small hotel, only 35 rooms.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KhairilrawaBali
Title: Just not good!
Review: This was my second visit to prime, the first was a bit more than a year ago. The first time was for a friends party and we did not get to order ourselves it was all pre ordered for us.It was an acceptable meal, but do not remember what we had.I recently visited prime again for my Birthday with 8 more of my mates. I have to say that service was so so, definitely not the level I would have expected at this sort of establishment. We were given the private room with the view of the kitchen, but did not have a waiter posted with us at all times that made it difficult to order anything. I am a serious steak man! It's hard for me to say, but the truth is no one does steak better than the Americans. Charred on the outside and still bloody rare to the center! At prime like most steak restaurants in Malaysia, I find that their cuts are usually to thin therefore not allowing long enough cooking time at high heat to achieve this black and blue effect so sort after by true steak lovers. With a table of 9 I got to sample multiple cuts and beef varieties. Almost all were served luke warm and though it was mostly very good quality meat, it was just not cooked the way a steak should be. mostly grey with a few grill lines and minimal charring, thus produced mostly limp steaks. Please visit Peter Lugers website or Ruths Chris to get an Idea of the steak i'm looking for. All in all was not a good culinary experience in my book and for the amount we paid(RM6000), I would have been happier buying 200 people a steak at suzi's and everyone could have brought their own wine!ShameJ

Author: akku_pKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Something Different!!!
Review: Do you really wanna eat something different today? Then how about Roasted Deer or Rabbit Varuval or Deer Biryani? Seems really different right?Then Anjappar is the destination where you will get something extra ordinary to eat cooked in real South Indian style. However, it's bit costly.

Author: mychngPenang
Title: Great waffles - no photography
Review: To be honest, what compelled me try the food there was the fact that no photography is allowed. It made me curious about the decoration. Additionally, the hot and humid weather also acted as a 'push' for me to walk in to enjoy some dessert and the air-conditioning. I didn't order the burger since I just wanted something light, so I settled for the summerific waffles. Yes, the waffles were fantastic. But still, I wish my friends could've seen the product.

Author: vtST13Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Worst service n food quality not like before
Review: My last visit was one of the worst, ordered a fish maw soup, half way through found a human hair in it, called the supervisor.. Instead of apologize for it, first reaction from her, was if we want to change another new serving?? What kind of mentality n service attitude was that?? Dong Po pork was one of the poor one I ever have in my life, Peking duck serving was awful, instead of skin, it was served with the meat attached to it, slices are junky in size for the pancake, was rated the top Chinese Restaurant in town, please train your staffs, not a casual labour to served the Peking duck. Till we settle the bill, not even apologize for the hair found in the soup..

Author: Carmen-c122594
Title: Food
Review: Excellent food especially the chicken shawarma! Will come again to try other dishes. Friendly host as well.

Author: pirdmnParis, France
Title: Great tandoori and naan !
Review: We went there around 23h00, had a great tandoori chicken + cheese naan + orange juice ! Was only 16.5MYR each !Tandoori was yummy and not dry at all, with the right amount of spices !Maybe this restaurant isn't that good looking, but the food is good!

Author: sunnybatuKuching, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Nyonya Food
Review: When to eat dinner with my colleague after work. This restaurant was close to Renaissance Hotel JB with walking distance. We order Asam curry fish(spicy and sour), Pangium edule fruit chicken (slightly spicy and fruit taste) and spicy sambal lady finger. All the dishes were amazing. The Asam curry fish is spicy an sour enough until you can eat up few bowls of rice. The chicken sauce taste was unique until you would none stop trying it. The boiled lady finger was cooked just nice and the sambal sauce enhance the freshness of lady finger. We do order desert too. I order Cendul and I order cendul with durian for my colleague as he haven't try Malaysian durian. He is so impress by the durian. They using freezed fresh during and put on top of the cendul. We do order tea tarik and lemon juice too. The portion was big enough for both of us eat until very full as we only order one bowl of rice. This is not a fancy restaurant that come with great decorate but the food was really impress us. I am sure we could go back and try it again in future.

Author: karinaemmaCanberra, Australia
Title: Delicious, classy & quality food
Review: Amazing food, well balanced flavours & cooked to perfection. Interesting, theatrical desserts & lovely atmosphere. Service was top class & we received a few little extra complementary tastings. Very reasonably priced considering the quality of meat & dining experience (I would pay nearly double the price for a meal like this in Australia!) Well worth a visit, particularly if you're after a modern European/Australian type meal.

Author: 713shirleyl
Title: Nice food and good service
Review: Nice food with reasonable price and good service. As the restaurant is relatively small as run by family it is advisable to make your reservation earlier.

Author: BellaNic
Title: take away
Review: Takeaway from Sushi King.  Yee Sang and chicken karaagan. Taste: yee san 4/5. Chicken kaaragan don 3/5(Improvement is needed)

Author: flhl82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: hygiene is a BIG issue !!!
Review: We visit here with a group of friend at 5pm to avoid the crowd as we went there on Sunday. There is actually 2 similar shop next to each other but we pick this one. There are variety of food for u to choose and u also can add on the slice cucumber & bread in order to indulge with the satay sauce. The satay celup look like the normal steamboat ....here comes the problem ie. the hygiene !!! It doesn't bother us very much as we are friend BUT how about the others ? they don't change the gravy instead they add on and stir it all over again !!! Imagine from 5pm until the shop closed the same sauce is repeatedly used ....from the moment we start eating that issue floundering within my mind !!! The quality & value of the food was fine for me BUT i will not going back again simply because the hygiene is a BIG issue for me. It is the enthusiasm of my friend brought me here and there to try out Melaka local delicacy that render me not giving a terrible rating !!!

Author: Jemypink
Title: A Delight meal
Review: Having lunch with a friend, food was presentable and deliciously good. Warm lights makes the food looks even tastier.

Author: Mcatno3Wickford, United Kingdom
Title: Must have caught them on a bad day !
Review: We got the mono rail specifically to go to the HRC as we have dined in a few around the world, but we were so disappointed, the atmosphere was non existent, they music videos were of people I'd never heard of, not that it matters if it was good but it wasn't. The memorabilia wasn't fantastic but didn't really expect to much. The food was ok my partners pasta was cold and they were very mean with the shell fish only one mussel, my fish and chips was nice and I enjoyed it and he had some of mine? But the real disappointment was the service, there were only 4 other tables dining as we were there early, our body clocks still adjusting, and there were 3 waiting staff and when my partner wanted another beer there was no one to be seen another table also waited an age to pay the bill so when he got his beer we asked for the bill at the same time just in case. Nobody came to check if we were happy with the food and we generally felt neglected. Having read some of the other reviews ..... let's hope they were just having a bad day and others don't have the same experience...... and if not please raise your game most people expect more from HRC.

Author: Eng.Abdulaziz A
Title: Very dirty.
Review: I found hair in my meal !!! Thank of god I don't ate. I don't recommend to visit this branch in mid villa mega there many restaurants .

Author: paradisicalmostlyKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Reservations
Review: We tried to go here tonight but was denied access cause we didn't have a reservation even though only one table was occupied…….

Author: May_75_30
Title: Arrogant service, will never enter the shop again!!
Review: I've make a booking for a table at 7pm but we happen to reach the restaurant at 6:45pm.So when enter the shop no one approach us and i went to the front desk to ask. The staff pointed at the clock say now only 6:45pm and continue doing her work. What a arrogant and rude attitude!! Never even say can we just wait a while or offer us to come back at 7pm! Completely don't have customer service and i found this is unacceptable.

Author: tyler297Xiamen, China
Title: Pushy and rude staff
Review: First, we sat down at a table with no other patrons in the bar and were told we need to sit in the corner. Second, the temperature was 34 degrees so I had a bottle of water in hand with a few sips left and the staff had me physically hand it to him to throw away and said we could buy mineral water from the bar. Third, my friend had her foot casually up on the outdoor seat she was on and the staff promptly came over and ask she put her foot on the floor. At that point, we stood up and said we’re leaving. The staff did not apologize or offer any gesture that there was a misunderstanding, instead smugly smiling and laughing as we got in the elevator to leave. We’re greatly disappointed with the place, especially after seeing the 5 star reviews here. We will not be going back.

Author: Mikhail G
Title: Bad service
Review: Food was ok. Waited for roll and sashimi for over an hour, remainded two times, but didn't get it. Very disappointed.

Author: laquacha
Title: alcohol waterdown
Review: it would have been better if they serve alcohol that tastes "right."

Author: TracyannethiagaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Waste of money
Review: It was my first wedding anniversary and I decided to bring my husband for a nice Nyonya style dinner so I walked into Nyonya Suan. My first impression was not so good as I saw nobody dinning in but I decided not to judge the food so we ordered the sambal fried fish..ayam masak Merah and sambal bendi but the only satisfying dish was the sambal fried fish which was expensive to me.. the ayam masak Merah and sambal bendi was loaded with sugar and under cooked sambal paste. When I ordered I asked the waiter if my food will be sweet and he said no it won’t be. So I happily went on. It was so disappointing and I had spent so much for these type of food. Not going here anymore

Author: tobesloSingapore, Singapore
Title: New twist in Old Town
Review: This is a happy place.Situated centrally around Kong Heng, and opposite Concubine Lane, this is a place to chill and rest from walking around Old Town especially in the humid afternoon. The place is air conditioned, has an open plan concept, floor-ceiling window maximising the sunlight; it brings in a sense of energy.Food is the modern twist of some local and Asian cruises, which is refreshing. It also brought in the Western cafe style food (various choices of fries) that is quite popular. This place also serves coffee and alcohol. The idea was there and the service was adequate; just needed some refinement on the execution of the dishes, which somehow were a bit plain and lacking the flavours.Adjacent to the restaurant is the market which sells various of artwork and merchandises. This place reminds us of a mini Paddington in Sydney Australia.

Author: alistair15
Title: Village style
Review:
Good variety of local food. Tasty and delicious. Enjoy your time 
here as time pass slowly. This is a old school place. Refresh your old memory of kampung.

Author: Terry W
Title: Gem of Melaka
Review: Hidden in a dark corner near the the beach, well known by the local, couple of famous dishes, always packed with tourists and local

Author: iamwienKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food here
Review: So honestly i work in royal selangor visitor centre and found out the food here is like really good, I've tried the lasagna, honey mustard chicken etc. THEY WERE AWESOME and set lunch comes with a soft drink and haegen das ice cream. Like really good. Not to mention about the cakes, oreo cheese, lemon raspberry, oh and also the chocolate mousse. They're like pegect! A place that worth you coming all the way just for a meal.
Restaurant: The Cafe at the Royal Selangor Visitor Centre

Author: nadja53South Australia, Australia
Title: Great Food.
Review: A good choice of international and Asian cuisine. Something on the menu for everyone, even people with allergies. The staff are happy to accommodate you and will advise what dishes are not conducive to certain allergies.

Author: TokyoMuncherMarbella, Spain
Title: Steer Away...Steer Clear Away
Review: Food was unseasoned, unsophisticated and, if not bland. then simply flavourless. The broccoli soup was abysmal - think, tasteless and so full of culinary mistakes. The main meat course was initial described as strip loin, but turned out to be a sous vide loin of lamb...that was tough, chewy and lacked any depth of flavour. The glazes used throughout were watery thin and lacked any depth. It was as if there was no quality control, no tasting, no attention to detail in the kitchen. The serving was flustered - on two occasions wines were not poured with the new plates being served, cutlery was forgotten and when asked for wine to be replenished (on one occasion) we were told that we would have new wine served for the next course! What????Two major faux pas I cannot help but mention: (1) At a degustation menu one expects to have a new set of cutlery served with new plate servings. Orinea appears to simply keep your cutlery and takes the plates away. A word of advice - this is not a buffet! (2) At such a 'fine ding' experience (which it is NOT) diners should not expect to see boxes stored under the stairs in the dining room (see picture)! Oh...and let's not even talk about the state of the restrooms...certainly no better than many hawker stall food courses dotted around the town - this is not a fine dining restaurant...but it has prices to match...this was by far the most expensive dinner we had at over USD 320 per couple (and we stayed and dined at the Eastern & Oriental!).

Author: M9C8
Title: Satay celup
Review:
There are two satay celup shops beside each other and my friend who is a local recommended this one. 
The selection is quite big, there are mushrooms, meat, veggie and seafood. 
The peanut sauce was delicious and service was decent

Author: SK_JauneKuching, Malaysia
Title: A blend of East and West
Review: If you are thinking of a place to entertain your clients for a nice Japanese food with a cosy ambient or just want to relax with your colleagues or business associates after a hard day work with a few mug of cold beers and simple Japanese dinner ; Izakaya is just the right place. A mixture of Japanese restaurant with a bar that serve cold beers and warm sake is just perfect after the dinner.

Author: wspindloeMetro Manila, Philippines
Title: Getting served may be an issue
Review: The last time I visited I have praise to the manageress who served myself and colleagues. It would appear however that if there is a lack of managerial presence your chance of getting served is cut dramatically. They saw me. They even motioned to each other and then decided to have a chat with one another instead. I left. The problem is if you are staying at the Somerset as I am. This is their restaurant, and I had prepaid for breakfast, but now will refuse to eat there.... I guess now won't be also staying at the hotel anymore

Author: BenT988Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The worst beef bulgogi EVER
Review: Visited the starling mall’s branch and ordered a small portion of beef bulgogi. Had a shock when it arrived because it look anything but. The beef was not fresh and they sticked together/stacked up almost like a ball, which makes it extremely thick, tough, chewy and tasteless. Eonoki mushroom was served raw as garnish and I simply had no confidence to try it as I spotted some brown substance near the root. The dish is also laden with cheap cabbage, carrot and glass noodle. Oh and please don’t get me start on the sauce. It is soooo starchy, pale and soupy that you might as well call the dish sup tulang. It is so sloppy and disgusting. Please do not dishonour beef bulgogi this way. I left after first few bites and am glad I cut loss early. Will never ever return even if my mother ask me to

Author: KR_EDINBURGHEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Below average western food
Review: I really wanted to like this place. Actually, i do like the setting, sitting underneath the mature trees and listening to ambient music. Nice chilled environment. Unfortunately my dinner experience was not on the same level. T-bone steak was ordered. It arrived around 20 mins after my partners dish (had to ask where it had gone) and when it did, my partner was all but finished. Ok service in a coffee shop but do expect better coordination from a restaurant. As for the steak itself, once I cut past the gristle and fat, there was some tasty meat, but not very much at all. No doubt it was T-bone, the bone was the dominant piece of the dish. Just way too little meat on it.We also wanted to have draft heineken and a can too. They had neither available. Same applied to Tiger. Pretty poor therefore to not have any lager on draft, just the more expensive Guinness, Hoegaarden and Kilkenny. Ordered large tiger bottles instead, which were reasonably priced. Staff were pleasant enough, but food should have really arrived at the same time - the delay was too much.Overall, its a pleasant setting. Liking the ambience however it does feel a little impersonal. When I compare to Jambu its not in the same league for atmosphere, or food quality for that matter. Maybe a little cheaper here, but i guess you get what you pay for.Would probably return, but not for the T-bone!

Author: AiNSTAiN83Kota Bharu, Malaysia
Title: Slow Service
Review: After spending some time under the scorching sun trying to find all the street arts we went into Jawi House to have a drink and snack. The ambiance was quite cosy and we loved the simple and old time decor of the cafe. The drinks were good but their food was quite bland. Maybe it is because we have Asian palettes. The staffs, whom I believe were foreigners based on their accents, seemed bored and uninterested. I think they could have done much better if they step up their service.

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good place for a drink with friends
Review: Well this is a good place for friends and business discussions. They have a wide array of liquor from beers to wine, whisky and brandy.For the food, not all is good. They pizza is good but the pork knuckle was dry. So choice of food is important.A good place to hang out.

Author: TheItalianTravelistBarcelona, Spain
Title: What's the big fuss about this place?!
Review: I've been here a few times since they opened (I think a couple of years ago) then stopped to come after seeing how both quality of food and service badly lowered. The only 2 things that didn't diminished are prices and pretentiousness, cause this place have plenty of it, starting from the crowd. Mediocre food and quite boring if you're a habituée here, design tired and not-so-innovative in my opinion, and a place that in a simple sentence, didn't survive itself. I simply don't find exciting going there, there're more exciting options in the same trojka building than here. I wish they do some changes to refresh the whole atmosphere and making this place cool again. I do appreciate their use of Aesop products in the bathroom, but you don't judge a restaurant solely on his bathroom, do you?
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: HSeeingtheworldWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Pleasant enough but nothing special
Review: We stopped to look at the menu as we walked by. The seating was comfortable enough and there was room to sit downWe had the cashew nut chicken which was very bland and the Thai Mango Chicken, which was the better of the two dishes.Service was pleasant and promptIncluding drinks the bill came to less than £20, so I should not be expecting too much, but over here I have had better food for the same or lessWe would not rush back

Author: rlsh07
Title: Not good ayam pongteh
Review:
We ordered the following items 

- pie tee , each order comes with 4 . MYR 6, average. 
- ayam pongteh- MYR 25. The chicken is quite dry. Gravy not much flavor. 

We don't enjoyed the food here.

Author: sunilmu
Title: Average, not very impressive
Review: We had dinner there, Indian food varieties are not much and the Dal Tadka which we got doesnt seem to be authentic. The ambience is good, however need a buggy to reach there and it is slightly overpriced.

Author: NURY888
Title: Delicious
Review: The food are delicious, especially the curry menu. But one thing that need improvement - no netting installed to cover the buffet line & we can see flies are everywhere, very unhygenic. Please improve on the cleanliness.

Author: kevin777davidKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food and good ambience
Review: Took the family to celebrate a birthday lunch. Place is inside a golf club. Food is North Indian. Restaurant is very quiet because very less people. Like most restaurants in India, the food will take a long time (average of 30 minutes) because it is prepared only when you order and all dishes are brought out at the same time.Briyani portions are big (can be shared by two). We tried a few dishes and all were delicious. Waiter asked if we wanted some 'sparkling' water when infact it was the common Spritzer mineral water (no issues there).Restaurant is beautiful and decorated in Moroccan lights and beautiful silverware.Menu is expensive. Be prepared to spend about RM50 for Briyani and about RM100 per person.Overall, everyone loved the food so much that they wanted to come back for dinner. Definitely worth a try if ypu have money to spend.

Author: AChee74
Title: It was just ok
Review:
That night, the tables there was the least among all the other stalls. Somehow the food that night was not as good as it was.

All the food is halal. and there are many choices, mostly seafood.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: 95janicel
Title: Reasonably priced with nice food
Review: This restaurant is very near our apartment and we have a good time there at Christmas Eve, continues bread providing to us, food is delicious and service is super ...waiters Kabirc and Jafan are so nice.

Author: julesf379Hong Kong, China
Title: good vibe, poor food
Review: The place has a hip and pleasant decor and atmosphere, with cool vibes in the background and attentive staff. They also had some modern art on display for sale, all nice and good,.....but the food was a letdown!It calls itself a tapas bar, but the food is more Italian than Spanish. But that's not the issue for me, Italians make lots of yummy food which I would be happy to enjoy in a "tapas setting",....it's the quality of the produce, the preparation and presentation that matters. I had 4 "tapas"; meat balls in sauce, fried sea-bass with eggplant, prawns with garlic, chicken wings wrapped in ham. The meat balls were dry (the sauce helped the dryness, but not the flavor), the fried sea-bass served with an orange colored salsa was bland with no flavor at all, it could have been anything you are chewing on, the chicken wings on the other hand were really salty, but the worst was the prawns were not fresh! Despite rather strong garlic "support" you could smell the prawns were off (not just fishy, but stinking!, i had to spit it out)! Does the chef (at least) not have a nose?  Sadly the bread sticks and the focaccia bread slices, that were served as a condiment, were the best part of the food.I actually wanted this to work because the place felt good, again ambiente, yes, attendance by the staff, yes, background vibe/music, yes, wine served, yes, but the food, definitely a no no. I mentioned about the prawns being off to the staff, this however didn't lead to any actions in any form,.,...needless to say I left disappointed.

Author: lanpanjang
Title: Dinner at Tepian Tebrau
Review: For dinner, I opted for Tepian Tebrau due to many recommendations from FB friends. We arrived around 8pm and parking was quite limited, so I dropped off my family and found a spot 50 meters away. Food choices and prices were basically the same throughout this food court. If you sit in front of a certain stall, they will insist that all food and drinks are only ordered from that stall. Seafood is generally the best option, and most are quite fresh. You can basically ask them to stir-fried with sambal, soy sauce or oyster sauce, deep-fry, steamed or boil your orders and most stalls have very able cooks manning them. We ordered Siakap Masak Tiga Rasa or 3 Flavours Seabass which was lovely. Stir-fried Mussels or Kepah Goreng was delicious. Tomyam Campur or Mixed Tomyam Soup was delicious but you can ask them not to make it too spicy. Vegetables we opted for Kangkung Goreng Belacan or Water Spinach stifried with Prawn Paste. For drinks we ordered fruit juices that came in giant tall glasses, and you can ask lychee with watermelon or Air Tembikai Laici which was refreshing. For 4 people, the price charged was reasonable. A visit to JB won't be complete if you don't have a meal here.

Author: Cynz87
Title: Be patient slow service is waiting around 1,5 hour
Review: The food is totally plain, doesn't have taste, under my expectation since I need to wait around 1,5 hour until food coming...

Author: Nurna
Title: Awesome!
Review: Definitely a good spot for Arabic cuisine enthusiast. Originally from Johore (southern part of Malaysia) but whenever I went to KL, Wadi Hadramawt is one of the must go restaurant for my family.Mandy Chicken absolutely one of the best food I've ever eat so far in the restaurant. Thumbs up!

Author: schezara
Title: I will definitely come back here for the Sarawak Laksa
Review: The title speaks for itself. I'm quite a fussy eater, and laksa is not one of my favourite foods, but the Sarawak laksa here is so good, I ended up with 2 bowls of it. So good....

Author: Christine G
Title: Meal on a budget...value for money
Review: Service here is great. The members of the staff are very attentive...they speak good english, too! It's a must try when you're within the BUKIT BINTANG area.

Author: 69tiger888Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: European fare
Review: This is very nice restaurant in the hotel offering western food with an Eurpoean flare. The chef is European and his presence was felt . Decor is modern , spacious with good service and The menu offers French quail , foie gras ,escargots , , veal Oslo Bucholz , squid ink pasta , Vienna schnitzel . Wine list I’d good and food preparation and quality is top notch.

Author: Soon Seng P
Title: U will regret
Review: Poor services + poor foods with high price! So regret and definitely won't visit for 2nd time . we will never recommend  this lousy restaurant to any of our friends too. First and also the last! Holly poop

Author: lucyang99
Title: Gone
Review: Don't look for it. This eatery failed to make its mark. It has changed hands within a year, two different operators. It's a story of open-close-open-close.
Restaurant: Desert Retreat Restaurant And Coffee Shop

Author: CC991244BSKnaresborough, United Kingdom
Title: School dinner
Review: Sorry but ordered new york strip and wasnt impressed at all.Was rare how i asked but seemed tough and difficult to cut?Very few fries..7 or 8.Awful veg that was soggy boiled school dinner type stuff.Loads of fat on steak too.Way over priced and as other reviewer said..all show on boards and menus but just did not deliver.So disapointed.Female waitress was friendly though.Wouldnt go back.

Author: MVADIVALE
Title: Kerala food in Petaling Jaya, Selangor , Malaysia
Review: Overall clean and nice. Tali is good and tasty. Separate dishes a generally a bit on the costly side. Mutton and fish was great.

Author: KhanOfLifestyleHong Kong, China
Title: Where are the managers and the value for money?
Review: One of the waiters definitely saved the evening. My first night in KL and GOBO came recommended. No immediate welcome, confused waiters and flavorless starters. Atmosphere is nice, but no communication between waiters. A manager is surely missing to direct the team. A well dressed local came in every thirty minutes, looking stressed and busy, but this didn't help us at all with getting our bill sorted (with four additional dishes we didn't have). Wine was served after dish was served, so were the condiments.It was difficult to get the attention of a waiter. Anyway the polite waiter that suddenly appeared to be ours, apologized for the mistake with the wrong billing. Overall hectic, unorganized and not great value for money.

Author: PhineasF0ggLondon
Title: Great food - Poor Cleanliness
Review: Visited the place for some good punjabi food and they didn't disappoint. The Kari, Cholle and Daal were all on point. Very traditional and authentic just the way you'd expect it if you were in Punjab. It's a very basic setting and being a popular restaurant amongst locals, the waiters are often rushing around. Don't wait to be attended to - make yourself be heard and seen. They need to fix up their cleanliness & hygiene game. Evidence of grime around sinks and generally a little dirty around the restaurant. If you can see past that then you're in for a decent meal. I would go again (my wife who is a clean freak, won't).

Author: elmadaloToronto, Canada
Title: Fascinating experience
Review: I enjoyed this more than I thought I would. For a few moments at the beginning, the darkness felt scary and suffocating, but that quickly dissipated. My boyfriend and I had lots of fun trying to figure out what we were tasting. It was interesting that there were a couple dishes I thought I recognized for sure but I was totally off. Definitely recommend for a unique dining experience.

Author: greenberry520
Title: Lousy food
Review: Stayed at Royale Chulan KL and they provide breakfast at Warisan Cafe. The food selection is very less, only Malaysian food. The taste is very bad too. Couldn't believe this is 5 star standard. i will only give 1 star.

Author: sheeqhistina
Title: Best place to chill and hangout
Review: good place to hang out with friends and need to make a reservation. their service is superb too.. 🥂🥂

Author: muratd247Istanbul, Turkey
Title: Getting old and loosing ambition
Review: I loved eating at Hard Rock. Big plates, happy hosts and delicious food all packed in "loving all serving everyone". This time I felt like the restaurant was getting old, lost its ambition to make cuatomers eat more and pay more. Hamburger was not juicy looked as small as and less fancier than MD ones. Nachoes still big but as if manufactured in an industial plant rather than a kitchen. Overall still a good and safe alternative if you ever want to eat at an international chain.

Author: Stephanie W
Title: good services and comfortable ambience
Review: Food is good affordable and comfortable quiet environment .set lunch with 18+ it is very value price.

Author: ntlchinmalaysia
Title: Totally awful experience with failed recovery by management
Review: Went to curate for the much hyped Sunday buffet brunch. Made a booking requesting for a view and was promised a table with a view. Arrived late due to the famous kl traffic. Management called after one hour checking if the booking was still required. After arrival we were shown to our seats n was being offered the drinks menu. The server asked us if we wanted still or sparkling water. Buffets usually comes with drinking water but this was not offered. I ignored the request but was asked another two occasion if we wanted still or sparkling.... felt like little choice was left we ordered still. I found out later that other tables was served drinking water.... so not a good start. I ordered the wine accompaniment and without being asked what I wanted , I was presented with a white wine glass. I requested for the red wine and was presented with a red wine glass. No red wine came. So I requested for my red wine. In the mean time my neighbouring tables which were mainly white ppl were topped up over and over again whilst mine was yet to be filled. This was like this until I started to get fed up and made complaints . The server started to make excuses and said she will now be taking care of us and will provide us with the best service. And if we were ever here again she will look after us well... but shouldn’t all the waiters be offering the highest level of service to all equal paying customers? We were not invited to help ourselves to the buffet let alone being introduced to the food. The most helpful staff was mustafa sous chef coming out to explain his food etc . No attempt was made for service recovery throughout even after paying the bill and leaving we were just asked how was everything？ despite numerous times of saying it was terrible absolutely no attempt was made for service recovery. Left the place not impressed . Bilal restaurants director called me soon after requested for another opportunity for service recovery. I agreed to the next day lunch. No structure as to what the attempt will be or what drinks will be offered. Mustafa again came out saving the day will multiple offerings made especially from the kitchen. Again no attempt was made to invite us to the buffet , so thinking that it will be what mustafa will cook for us. Mustafa made us a salmon salad prawn pancake wrap, a chicken soup and fried flat noodles. Drinks top up remained upon request . Being cheeky I requested for champagne but staff upon checking with bilal said no. Bilal sat down for a chit chat after the meal after a long pause so I assumed that’s all we will be served , I requested to talk to bilal before making a quick exit . Nothing very special came out of it except what the feed back I have already mentioned above. Bilal left quickly after with nasriq his restaurant manger. Overall it was a disastrous brunch and at best a half hearted recovery the next day.... but mustafa is a hero throughout. My thank you to mustafa.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: PhiloDCruz
Title: Food
Review: Offering regular Indian food for various budgets moods and time.. With Chapatis and rice or various curries for any palette

Author: Gaye J
Title: Great little gem.
Review: convenient for us we stayed in the somerset apartments next door after a long journey to KL we were hungry. quick service , friendly staff ,we ate here more than once as food was great. decor clean and tidy. thank you for wonderful experience.

Author: VuvieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not fresh. Upset stomach
Review: Meal: Food is really bad, not fresh. Servings are huge. Don't order too much. It's totally not Japanese at all, the serving size!Atmosphere: The place is really nice and relaxing. Very fancy. Also too dark to see the food clearly. Service: Not bad. Not great.Before anyone gets upset as I see a lot of "fans" here, I go to Japan quite often (almost annually) so I really do mean it when I say, it's terrible and overpriced food trying to pass of as Japanese. Shame on you, Equatorial!

Author: Lindyloo1UK
Title: Great for breakfast
Review: We went to Shook the first morning and were amazed at the variety of food as it seemed to cater for every nationality imaginable.My husband always eats a large breakfast and he had fresh fruit, cereal, omelette, sausages etc along with toast, fruit juice and coffee. I had fruit juice, fresh fruit, cereal, toast and tea. All were very good and it was nice to help yourself to everything for the set amount whilst having continuous coffee and tea brought to you.The setting is in amongst the busy food hall and is quite nice watching all the hustle and bustle.Whilst we were there they had events in Shook each evening and it looked very nice indeed.

Author: JoCeLynMikaMalaysia
Title: Set Lunch RM17.90++
Review: They have different set lunch menu for selected day. Set lunch included a main course, softdrink, free flow of soup of the day and salad. I have a grilled salmon, milestone soup, salad, fruits and coke. Taste is OK. But if the salmon more thicker will be good as too thin make it overcooked not juicy and its a bit oilly. But is cheap to have the set lunch.

Author: peopleredKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Of average quality, but really overpriced food
Review: When we first sat down, little servings of truffle butter was placed on the table, with bread (not homemade), the butter wasnt slated and the truffles were overpowering. Obviously used too much truffle oil. after a while, i literally got a headache cos it was too strong. I chose the 4 course menu - 2 appetisers, 1 entree, and 1 dessert. One og the starters was a lobster souffle - not very flavorful, the other one was a risotto with tarabagani(some type of crab) - decent but not excellent. For mains was a poussin with truffles. when it arrived, all was on the plate was a slice of breast, and a little confit leg, and some truffle foam ( the menu stated truffle, not truffle foam, so i was disappointed), it was quite nice. dessert was a trio of valrhona chocolate - ice cream, some small cake, and another thing(didnt know wat it was, but it had almonds on it), it was quite nice as well, but again not superb. Overall, the portions they gave were quite small , asu'd expect in a fine dining restaurant. But for the price they charge - something like almost rm300 or something per person, u would expect a great meal, but i guess it wasnt to be. It was by no means bad, but merely average. Our waiter was v helpful, explaining everything we asked. when we asked to see the chef while having our dessert, the waiter said he had gone home already ( doesnt really say much abt his dedication to the job, does it?) All in all, if u have money to spend, i'm not discouraging u from visiting. but if u're looking for an amazing meal, i wouldnt suggest it. really not a value for money.

Author: Galeno CPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: Fast crap
Review: This is supposed to be a take-off of Maccas and KFC etc but with local foods. Sure it comes out fast but it's disgusting and over-priced. The fruit juice I ordered came out 80% syrup and cordial 10% fruit juice and 10% froth and bits. The chicken rice which is supposed to be it's signature dish is seriously not worth having. It's like KFC getting their chicken wrong. Don't go there!

Author: MaradardiLa Foye de Vinax, France
Title: Not as good as it was...
Review: On our first visit to Langkawi in 2005 we had at least 5 or 6 meals at La Sal and loved every one. So it was high on our "things to do" list to go back and have another memorable experience. What an anti climax!! The service was slow and indifferent, the food was very poor, I had eaten far superior food in the local food markets! The prices were incredibly steep even for a 4* hotel/restaurant. The setting is lovely, but as outside visitors, we were not allowed to sit at a table overlooking the sea, which are reserved for residents only, I understand and appreciate this. I am only thankful we went for lunch, which we incorporated on a day trip of the island. If we had made a special trip for dinner I would have been extremely disappointed!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: yhpets
Title: not too bad
Review: the chairs are comfy but the price of drinks is what weights the place down. its a bit expensive. the staff were friendly.

Author: takemeasiamMalaysia
Title: Good food worth a try
Review: Had dinner with a group of friends. Nice cosy environment, servers were attentive and polite, suggested we share a few pasta and their suggestions were good, not pushy or rushed us in any ways..we shared 3 types of pasta among the 4 of us and had a bottle of wine..a bit pricey but no complaints as the food served were good. Wouldn’t mind coming again. Satisfied with everything.

Author: Lasse B
Title: Great steak
Review: It's the best place in Kuching to eat a good steak and drink good wine - especially the Wagyu steak is recommendable. The cook was sadly replaced between the times I was there. The garniture and sauce was absolute better with the old cook. The staff were good but could be better and more observant. It's a good idea to book a table and a steak if you are coming as a group and want to be sure to get a steak. We went as a group and had to order different than expected as they did not have enough Wagyu or Sirloins.

Author: Karis P
Title: Good food and alot of veggie options
Review:
Good atmosphere, lovely food on the main bar strip in KL.

Very cheap prices, even for the cocktails. Have a good variety of vegetarian options too.

Author: chinhuihuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing but a strategic location for birdeyes view of KL coty
Review: Ambience: Almost perfect! Separated into parts: dining area, bar chilling area with live band on the Saturday night I visit, outdoor where smoking is allowed. You won’t be able to see the KLCC in twin, one tower is overlapped the other. Food and wine (Menu): Pasta are salty, please remind to request for less salty one. Terderloin cooked medium rare with blue cheese is a bit too dry, suggest try other sauces. Cut rib eye is a little too thin to treat it as a steak. Very limited choices of wines. They served wine in 18°C and expecting the ice bucket is not needed. You can request one anyway. Coz as an Asian, I enjoy my red wine in chill ~10°C With the prices of RM128 for tenderloin, RM150 a bottle of shiraz, etc, you’ll expecting the service is standardly good as other restaurant. Some of the waiters at the bar area are not showing good manner with the way they speak.

Author: Ron FCanberra, Australia
Title: Little piece of France in Langkawi
Review: Many of our fellow customers were French - a good sign. The coffee is excellent and the crepes were superb. The service is very en-francais and helpful. Highly recommended.

Author: shajipapa
Title: Check it out for spice lovers..........
Review: It's the best seafood experience I had so far but yet sooo near!!!!

Author: Christeene818Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to write home about....
Review: Had lunch with friends at Loaf AVENUE K and have to say the prices were on the high side for the quality and serving size of the food. The laksa was below average in taste, steak sandwich very average and chicken wrap nice but very small. I guess the food is more 'fast' food style but lacking flavor. They do offer pastry which looked nice. Have a feeling it is a cafe more for coffee and pastry. With so many cafes offering more interesting food at a more reasonable price it is hard to justify dining here. The staff were friendly and food was served quite quickly with them updating us on wait time for our last dish. For me, I think it is time for cafes to drop serving chips & sauce with everything. I am instantly put off as I know it is just a quick and easy accompaniment. The pricing level of the food gives an expectation for some more interesting well presented food.

Author: Akrep81London, United Kingdom
Title: Good luck if you can talk to someone
Review: I haven't been to this restaurant because I haven't been able to. They don't have a telephone number, email address or booking form. The only way to reach them is through the hotel reception. Then someone transfers your call and you end up speaking to someone who can't understand English yet they want to know your name, address, telephone number, email, etc. I called this restaurant twice and both times they were unable to help me on the phone. They took my details and promised to get back to me. Well it has been two weeks, noone has emailed or called me yet. I am not calling them third them, I rather not eat there.

Author: Hanifrxz
Title: Hilton
Review: Good hospitality and staffing, thank you guys love it so much ! Cc: Sanjai, Fatiha, Shidi, Ramesh, Fauzi

Author: Joe N
Title: Place is over rated
Review: The coffee is very bad ordered a cappuccino it was more like a bad latte an the espresso tasted bad too its not even made with beans or a proper coffee machine just a cheap nespresso machine and as for the food it is over priced plus small portions

Author: hey0rangesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: still good
Review: was my first time going back to flour ever since they closed down their branch at damansara. food was still good and all. but i thought the ambience was a bit tacky. service from staff was good, very attentive. overall, my dining experience over there was good.

Author: mariapI2560DXKoege, Denmark
Title: Delicious pancakes
Review: We ordered two different kinds of crepes and a coffee. The coffee was also good. We got a crepes with salted caramel and on with Nutella, banana and coconutIt tasted really good and looked fantastic. So if u have a sweet tooth u should go there.

Author: 173s_bastienm
Title: Wonderful !
Review:
Very good experience in this restaurant. People are very nice and took care of us and our kids.
Service very efficient.
The crepes and waffles are amazing. We loved it.

Author: AriesJY
Title: Average
Review: Hear a lot of recommendation to try this but not as good as what we had hear. The rice balls is average & fishballs soup although quite tasty but too oily. Chicken not fully cooked...too raw

Author: Leechipoi
Title: Business lunch
Review:
Very good. Suman is a good waiter service
Good foods. Will recommend friends family to try. Sure will come next time

Author: ManishaPasricha
Title: Master of Fusion
Review: Knowhere Bangsar stands at the top of my list whenever I wish to have a chilled out sesh with my friends. The food so scrumptious, the service best in class, the ambience so welcoming and the cocktails unique in taste!

Author: Seng88Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan
Title: Feel cheated!
Review: Last time this restaurant used to be very good. Now, both the qualities of service and food are really sub par to their price! Their food was exorbitant because prices inside menu exclude GST and service charge, mean you need to pay extra 16%. Unfortunately, the quality of service was really really poor. My friend wanna asked for water, but received constant ignorant. The one who came only asked if we wanna ask for bill. We said not yet and he just ignored us after that. After we paid the bill, the waiter swiftly took away our changes and disappeared. This service was really terrible because we paid 10% service charge, how could they take away our change without permission! In terms of food quality, their famous pandan chicken was not fresh and taste was poor. Their seafood tomyam was full of mushroom instead of seafood. The only satisfying dish was their crispy butter vege. Overall, the perception was negative!

Author: Yin168Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Thanks again Chef Yau for the warm and friendly service to us. More, the foods are fresh and tasty. Especially the sashimi. Worth the price.

Author: sylvietsh
Title: Instagrammable restaurant - most likely for a group of friends if you're looking for something different
Review: A very colourful and inviting restaurant that's tucked away on Jalan Kamunting. It's best if you book in advance due to MCO restrictions so it can be hard to get a table if you just walk in. It's not very big as well but there is good air flow if ventilation is a concern during these pandemic times. The flavours of the food were great. We had the pork carinatas and guava glazed prawns tostadas for starters, I especially loved the prawns. The jerk chicken with mango relish was delicious, the sauce can be quite spicy so be wary! The food was a little towards the warm side rather than hot, which I'd personally prefer. In terms of pricing, it can be on the less budget friendly side if this is your concern. Staff are friendly and provide helpful recommendations on what to order. Overall, a very "instagramable" place that I'd probably only visit for special occasions.

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Nice setting, unspectacular food!
Review: Staying at the hotel, we fancied a quick bite one night and found the food poor at both the Cba and the hotel itself. My advice, go next door to either the Casa del Mar, which was excellent, or walk further along the beach to a place called D-Grill, which was ok and another place which i think was called the Brasserie which was good.

Author: dreamiconKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: over price & un-friendly staffs
Review: I cant believe why this restaurants has high reputation on TripAdvisor. Well,, I can tell this place is for mainly western people & they served over priced food which taste is just average. Also the staff (lady staff) is well-trained but not friendly. I dont recommend. Nothing special in here.

Author: Duif_family
Title: Great burgers and nice vibe
Review: One of the best burgers we had in KL: Good quality meat, buns were not too sweet and too soft. Went well with some Japanese beers. Service was excellent and there was nice vibe; band just started to play. Highly recommended!

Author: hundgene
Title: Nice food
Review:
Nice food. Fast service.
Reasonable price.
Kids will definitely enjoy this place.
Thumb up & good job

Author: TristanM_11Kerobokan, Indonesia
Title: Average food less then average service
Review: Just finished breakfast here. What a mistake.I ordered sausages and scrambled eggs and a coffee, served with no cutlery, 3 more minutes to get cutlery. Cold sausages.Friend ordered eggs hollandaise, by the time it came out I had finished my meal. Stale burnt muffin, overcooked eggs. We complained and got another muffin when she was half way through.Told the waiter the meal wasn’t great and got a half smile.Only saving grace was the coffee and side hash browns. Won’t be back

Author: risshik
Title: Best service, Best food
Review: This place is perfect for groups or a casual date night.great food with wonderful ambiance.please try the Calzona pizza

Author: Lancelot25St. Asaph, United Kingdom
Title: Comfort food
Review: We visited for breakfast and for dinner during our trip and both meals were delicious and super comforting. We've been travelling Thailand and Malaysia for 6 weeks +, so this was such a nice break from rice and noodles! The desserts are absolutely to die for and my boyfriend said his burger was the best he's had on our trip! "Proper beef" as he calls it! The staff are all so friendly and attentive aswell. And you get unlimited free filtered water which is something we haven't experienced much. Can't fault it!

Author: KLG77
Title: Group Dinner
Review:
It is a great group dinner as everyone enjoy it.

Whoever can't take spicy food and highlight it to them when making order.

Give it a try and you won't regret it.

Author: nuruldeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Buffet Breakfast
Review: very little varieties for a hotel that claimed a five stars hotel. please improve for your business future.

Author: Listsurfer
Title: Can it compete with the other Japanese food court in the basement?
Review: Recently opened, J's Gate (why the name?) seems to offer slightly cheaper almost as authentic fare as the premium operation downstairs at Isetan. Easy entry via a lift right on the street next to the MRT exit. Most of the main area of the race track layout is non-pork. The more secluded area in back makes no claims to be halal. ShinanaSoba has many inexpensive choices of hot and cold soba but the curried ones are a bit lacking in flavour compared to their neighbour's, Kohaku Tendon Curry Udon which was sweet enough. Featured at Kagura was Champon, but the chicken soup base could not match the pork bone flavour of the real thing.The Tonkatsu Set at Kushiage Kimme was a tummy filling good value as it comes with salmon, kimchee, miso soup, sesame slaw, 6 pork nuggets. Unfortunately when I asked whether tea was included, they tacked on Rm4 for it. Tsujiri's matcha-mochi ice cream matched the best in Japan. September 2018 if you fill in Choya's marketing survey form in the corridor, you get a Rm5 voucher for any outlet, so you can have a treat for less than Rm10 ! Hope they can keep up standards after the Japanese trainers move on.

Author: Veronica L
Title: Mano Ice Blended is all syrup!
Review: Ordered Mango Ice blended and it tasted like whole lump of sugar! Can’t even take a sip. Swapped with Americano instead. The owner should really look into the formula and have a taste himself, it was all mango syrup without the taste of mango and the drinks costs RM11. You must be kidding me??!!!

Author: yeelaml2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Penang Street Food in a pleasant setting
Review: There are a few restaurants in various malls in this city by this small chain. The food is fairly authentic Penang Street food. For those who want to have a taste of street food in a pleasant air-conditioned setting and the quality is good, this is the place.

Author: Sue CSydney, Australia
Title: A true dining experience
Review: This restaurant is a true dining delight, and despite the fact that I don't eat seafood, this did not stop me from enjoying the service and experience of dining at Jala Restaurant.Eating at Jala is not just about the food, but the overall dining experience.To begin with, service was unbelievably attentive. The staff make you feel like you're the only customer around! When I initially made the booking I enquired as to whether there were food options for people who did not eat seafood. At that point in time I thought Jala exclusively served seafood. The staff member who took the booking said that there were things on the menu for me, so I went ahead with the booking. When we turned up the next day, we handed our thongs over as the restaurant floor is sand. The restaurant is undercover but open right on the beach! It was such a care free and lovely feeling. The view of the beach is splendid but don't forget your mosquito repellant! As we were seated, one of the waitstaff actually handed me an ala carte menu and said 'I believe there is someone at the table that doesn't eat seafood?' When I mentioned that it was me, he kindly pointed out the non sea food options before letting us decide.Jala restaurant actually has an uncooked seafood buffet display at the front, where the seafood lovers can choose their fish/lobster/prawns etc, before discussing how they would like it cooked and served with the sous chef who is manning the area. My husband choose this option whilst I ordered off the menu. When you choose your seafood, you also get to choose a number of accompaniments. The chef was more than pleased to make recommendations. The food was fantastic and the seafood fresh. At some point during the evening the duty manager introduced himself to welcome us to the restaurant, as well as to invite us to provide any feed back.The Andaman should take pride in their staff who made such a wonderful impression. At one point in the evening a restaurant staff member grabbed another light/candle to bring it over as it was getting dark so we could see better.Reception and concierge were friendly and most helpful in directing us to the restaurant when we first arrived, and then helping us to organise a cab upon leaving. The hotel driver who drove us home was pleasant, polite and friendly. I believe his name was Ahman/Ahmed.The restaurant even has an area for you to wash the sand from your feet as you leave.The only drawbacks is that the Andaman is quite remote and the cabs will charge about 70RM from Cenang Beach - although I think its remoteness only adds to the wonderfully secluded atmosphere - no traffic, no hawkers, no buzzing from water sports or crowds!The other 'draw back' is obviously the fact that this is a fine dining restaurant and they charge accordingly. I would recommend the Jala experience to anyone!

Author: witheldnoNo
Title: amazing views
Review: Pay the small extra charge and have a table by the window it`s well worth it. We had lunch which is buffet style with a very good variety of Asian & European food, All good, the only real problem is the hot food is not hot so it takes the edge off of what would otherwise be a very enjoyable experience

Author: Julie ACoolangatta, Australia
Title: Reviews are True - but beware if you are tall!
Review: We ate here on our last night as it had so many great reviews onTtrip Adviser. We were greeted by Amy and once seated, we asked her which curries we should order. She recommended the Beef Rendang and the Chicken Kapitan, and we were not disappointed with her recommendation. The curries were SENSATIONAL. The staff are very attentive and the overall feel of the place is inviting. The only downside - which was not a reflection of the service or the quality of the food, was the cleverly converted old sewing machine benches into tables. Because of the frames, they leave very little leg room for tall people, so choose your table carefully. There are plenty of other tables to sit at that will be far more comfortable if you are tall. Will definitely come back here next time!

Author: TheFoodEater90
Title: The Akak Is So Hot
Review: The owner is the akak yg hot gila and i enjoy the food and the view of her butt so much! So worth it!

Author: David WMumbai, India
Title: Pretty good Vietnamese Pho
Review: I was in the mood for some pho, the national dish of Vietnam, so I decided to try this restaurant. Pho is a noodle soup/stew prepared with different meats or with only vegetables. I tried the beef pho, which was good. The meat was a bit chewy, and percentage of variety meats (offal), such as tripe, was a bit on the high side. Service was average. Prices were average. So, my recommendation is to stop in for some Vietnamese food if you're at the mall, but probably don't go out of your way for it.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: JannChia
Review: We ordered one oasta and kne panna cotta. They were both not good and below my expectation. The meatball pasta was one of the worst i had thus far. I was disappointed.  I will not come back.

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Melaka bulldog spirit
Review: We were meeting one of my wife's old friends from Suzhou who'd relocated to Melaka for work so ut was an ideal place for catch up, having spotted it in trip advisor Clean and inviting with the minimalist black and white decor and wood surfaces separated with some red lamps by the bar. So good so far, service I think was thought about with the waitress recommending dishes and sizes depending on what we were eating. So this is keeping alive baba nyonya cuisine with a selection of We had pai tee as a small starter and then given one of us each didn't eat pork, seafood or beef we danced around it ordering a fish crispy fried fish with sambal, chicken-limau perut and some veggie options of okra and fried water spinach. Food was served briskly and accompanied by some steamed rice. We ended up having a couple more dishes, onion omelette and chicken sausage with onions and chilli. However that left no room for cendol. So that's a return visit on the cards. I've read people complain about background music but I didn't notice it possibly as we were enjoying good conversation and good food. With many hotels think residents may pop in, but if not I'd say give it a go.

Author: Ah Long T
Title: Food not nice, slow service
Review:
The valentine set is no good
The chicken is very hard
Please serf the customer smartly
Customer spend so much money on your restorant but waiter don't know how to serf customer perfectly

Author: AJPKKKota Kinabalu, Sabah
Title: Was a Popular Bar
Review: This bar was very popular but no longer as the bar has introduced some rather strange rules which has resulted in the regulars opting to drink elsewhere. Restaurant still popular with local wanting to eat American style chain meals, To me its an up scale McDonalds and the menu needs to be changed regularly as it does get rather boring.

Author: Nick Lee W
Title: Iketeru
Review: Nice food . Nice environment . The server were so polite and friendly (shafiq) . Highly recommended.

Author: Cat A
Title: Worth the queue
Review: We had to queue for about 10 minutes, even though we went at around 8.30pm.  But the fantastic food is well worth the wait.  Some of the best Chinese food we've had.

Author: Wai Ling TSentosa Island, Singapore
Title: good try but not a MUST try
Review: good chicken rice i must say. The rice is fragrance and is not oily at all. This is the first time trying the chicken hence i cannot compare whether which generation is better? The chicken is tender but due to the soya sauce and the sesame oil, it is not what i expected ! the horfun soup is pretty normal.

Author: SimonB19622
Title: Hit or Miss
Review: Heard about this place from my friends. Took my family here last weekend. Tried a couple of pizzas. Some were good, others meh.

Author: Caryl CWoking, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, service hit and miss
Review: Walking around getting menu after menu shoved in our faces. We decided on this place. Lots of rows of plastic tables and chairs set in the street. We ordered satay chicken to start. Mains were drunken chicken and sizzling beef and rice. The mains arrived before the starter. Staff a bit stroppy about taking mains away until we had eaten our starter!!All good flavoured food. Along with 2 large beers it was reasonable value at 120 Ringgits.Staff too rushed to smile.We paid and got up from the table 4 staff moved in and cleared the table into buckets.By the time we got to the open road they had sat 2 more people at the table. Very rushed.

Author: MarcuslctMalaysia
Title: Taste Of A Fridays
Review: I had been to this restaurant quite often but i have not written any comment of it. Let's get started.Food: 4/5Service: 4/5 getting improved by saving customer costPeople are friendly but not all : 3/5Cost: Definitely not the Super saving but yet reasonable price. 3/5Overall: 3.5/5

Author: Mynameisrick
Title: Not a fresh prawn
Review: Im.choosing this restaurant cause their selection of menu quite interesting and clean ..I choose Mee Bandung Johor because from the.menu the picture.look.tempting..BUT  the meal.taste terrible plus they using not realy fresh prawn..i can taste the prawn.almost spoil...I hope.the page manager read this and check.back.ur SOP....

Author: WilliamLow8
Title: 1st Try
Review:
Quite special concept restaurant. 
All the food ingredients will be using tea.
Food is good and special.

Author: Connector36897899830
Title: Holiday
Review: Lousy food if you compare with other restaurant. Need to share table as well. Go and try Baba Charlie for their lunch but not their spring rolls and pohpiah.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: 599evib
Title: Great indian experience in Kuching
Review: We came here because of the good reviews and were not dissapointed. The ‘chef special naan’ is very good ! You should also try the tikki masala. Prices are good and nice atmosphere. Would reccomand if you’re looking for a quick indian style bite !

Author: Noren17y
Title: Have the staff eaten their food? They should, to know what bad food they're serving
Review: The place is noisy, busy, the service is poor and the food is appalling. It's no wonder you don't need to reserve a place even though it's breaking fast time during the Ramadan month, the only restaurant with tables available at 7pm. The waiters enjoy their strut and swag but they get their orders wrong. They're all crowding around the computer so they don't notice when customers are trying to get their attention. It took them half an hour to make a coffee, not a cappuccino or a frappe mocha or anything fancy like that, just a coffee. And it only came after we asked the supervisor what was taking so long. The mushroom swiss burger is dry, unlike the juicy ones at Chilli's. The mozzarella sticks are hard like fish sticks. There's a "buffet spread" of soup and salad for an additional RM10 which is an array of limp lettuce, keropok, an empty plate of what was slices of bread, soup, and dates. The empty platters were not refilled till we were about to leave.Realy not worth what you pay for.

Author: BasM954The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Overrated and overpriced
Review: As everyone knows Hard Rock Cafes may differ in ambiance and quality. Prices though are everywhere high for what one gets. That on itself is not a problem if it comes with good music, good food/beverage and a nice atmosphere. But I experienced the KL department of Hard Rock Cafe on all levels as average to say the least with a bit of an arrogant staff. So the verdict overall is not favourable.

Author: beatrizo981
Title: worst restaurant
Review: The staff is not nice, the food is horrible, I order a tuna sandwich and it doesnt have any tuna inside, just a bit, lettuce, and ketchup, DONT GO THERE!

Author: Hotel-Motel91
Title: Decent coffee...
Review: The coffee was decent and the surrounding and nice, clean and bright however, it was a little overpriced for something that was just average. Although...I did get to color in a coffee cup for their wall which kept me amused and distracted from the overpriced yet average coffee....

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good selection for buffet
Review: The Hilton PJ has been around for a long time and serves a good selection for its buffets. Cuisine is Malay and local Malaysian style cooking. While taste has always been consistently average, it does offer reasonable pricing and convenience for folks living around the area. Service can be improved.

Author: Shashee_Sean
Title: Amazing view!
Review: This is the best spot in chenang to enjoy the evening with a glass of beer or wine. Lovely view with great choice of food. Not to forget their Carlsberg 1 pint promo at only RM9(Kindly refer for happy hour time). Restaurant manager Murthy was very friendly and professional. Im surely visiting here when im at Langkawi again.

Author: TerminatorSarawakSarawak
Title: Super Duper Yummy
Review: I am a food lover..I craze and dare to try any kind of food especially when its about meat! Well, can't deny that everyone has a different opinion and taste buds when it comes to this topic..but in my personal opinion - I certainly believe that (from the bottom of my heart) Howdy has the best choice of meals @ meat @ ribs ever compare to the others in town. I have been loyally and happily eating at this restaurant - and for your kind infor, sometimes it can be up to 3-4 times in a week. Well, although in certain occasions the service can be a bit slow but hey, there is always ups and downs in everything ya? =)The food is nice + the people are friendly too...well done Howdy =)Pssst..miss out Howdy for the past 2 months as was travelling and once reach home..sick..cough cough..be back soon =)

Author: Sixto S
Title: Bad place. Dismal. Horrible. Will never come back. Will never recommend. Not tourist friendly.
Review: This restaurant. Has absolutely the poorest customer service I've ever seen in my travels.First of all, the place is packed but the poorly trained waiters don't keep wait list and seat customers according to their bias. Second, they appear to have a preference for locals when it comes to choosing their customers. We felt extremely discriminated while waiting.Third, their staff are rude and insensitive to customers waiting. It's either that or they don't know how to communicate properly. In our experience, they are just plain disrectful.Lastly, I think this place is poorly managed if it has any management at all. There was a very unruly group of customers who were bothering other customers from the other half of the hall but management didnt seem to care. They even requested to switch the lights of which the restaurant did without regard for other disgruntled customers who were eating. Other customers were just playing spin the bottle. Very poor coordination among staff and management.

Author: Christopher O
Title: bad service
Review: Yesterday was my second visit to that restaurant. The first time when i went there for dinner was good. service & food were good. they will served you sparkling wine as a welcome drink, but i seldom drink alcoholic drinks especially with my family so the waiter offered me their fruit juice which i was so impress that time. However, yesterday dinner was terrible. i seldom comment especially in social media but yesterday the service really piss me off!!! Waiting for bread nearly 20 minutes. Inform the waitress to get me the bread first so that i can feed my baby. call for second , third time still not coming. only arrived nearly 20 minutes. I only order 2 main course which the food serve quite fast. No napkin for us, I had to ask for napkins. I spoke to the waitress that you do served welcome drinks when guest arrive but i did not get it. the waitress apologize to me that they are busy. ( i assume will get the same service like my first visit which she will offer me) However, she just walk off. After finished my meal i went to counter to settle the bill & inform the senior person that i was not really happy about the service experience today. The gentleman say sorry & inform me the service will be better next time for mine next visit. i wrote this comment so that their boss will be alert because he always busy in the kitchen.

Author: JohnnyRD123
Title: Lively pub
Review: We enjoyed a pleasant evening here. Food was pretty good, staff were friendly and beer was cold and reasonably priced for Malaysia. All in all, a busy place with an enjoyable atmosphere.

Author: LshooiKajang, Malaysia
Title: Truly, the best fish and chips in kl
Review: I ordered a plate of butterfish fish and chips and to my surprise the fish was very fresh and there was not a hint of soda bicarbonate which is very prevalent in our local fish and chips. The chips were chunky and crispy. I would definitely return for more

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not impressive pork noodles. KL's Pork Noodles are way better. Expensive too.
Review: Very poor pork noodles. Soup one is very tasteless, dry one is nicer than the soup but still lousy. The pork is coated with starch which made it so softlike powdery texture. The soup itself has really poor pork flavours. Pork lard is very different from the usual where it's supposed to be crispy? This is not crispoy at all.If this is Sabah's best pork noodles, this seriously needs help. It's really very NORMAL actually. However if you insist to try, go for their dry noodle because the soup noodle is absolutely tasteless.Also, those meat balls they are charging are extremely overpriced. Jiang Bao meatballs are those meatballs with minced meat stuffed inside. Not particularly impressed as this is also available in so many other shops, especially steamboat shops.and RM6.90 for 4, how ridiculously expensive is that?p/s: only tried this place because there is a groupon voucher for it, otherwise it is not worth the money really. also, their conditions on groupon isn't specifically clear on what is for 2 and what is for 4. service, however was OK overall. they accommodated to our requests but a little too slow.

Author: Jorge ABrooklyn, New York
Title: Excellent!!!
Review: Great place for breakfast. Wonderful coffee, atmosphere, and food. One of the best places to enjoy authentic malay-chinese food at amazing prices and far away from tourist and mall-going crowds. Service is good and you will be amazed reading the many articles posted on wall about this landmark restaurant.

Author: IskandarTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not sold on Souled Out
Review: We decided to have a quiet dinner the night before New Year's Eve, and found this restaurant to have only a few diners and sat upstairs where there were only 3 other tables who were finishing their meals.
