There was a wide menu selection but several of the items we chose from the menu were not available but in the end we managed to order some items. However, the service was very indifferent and we often had to call for attention even though there were very few diners and there were 4 waiters on that floor. We certainly will not visit that restaurant again !

Author: peopleschoice85
Title: Awesome ny 18inch pies
Review: This is the best pizza in kuala lumpur hands down and free delivery love this place would recommend 100%

Author: StanTVLSingapore, Singapore
Title: " Daylight Robbery "
Review: We had a small year-end gathering upon my recommendation at this hotel of which I used to patronize regularly. Everything started fine/beautifully and we were enjoying the well-spread & generous buffet. We arranged for a lucky draw & each of us was given a number and was excited looking forward to get a prize !Although we had requested from the hotel for a lucky draw 'bowl' and were promised one just a day before the gathering, we ended up picking the lucky draw winners from a small disposable plastic bag as they could not find an available bowl in the hotel. What a shame !When it was time to settle the bill, we had a rude shock as the " not so friendly cum arrogant " outlet manager (nicholas) insists we had 78 pax dining and not 72 pax > as according to our attendees' list and lucky draw numbers. We argued with him in front of other guests and had even requested to view the CCTV but he was adamant and further "humiliate" us by saying he did not count 2 more pax which were inside the toilet. If that is the case, why didn't this manager charged 80 pax as we have yet to settle the bill then ?If you look at the number 80 compared to 72, that is a huge 10% difference ! How did he arrive at this figure ? We pay what we ought to pay, nothing more nothing less ! It is just a matter of principle.But to avoid further embarrassment, we decided to pay under 'protest'. To us, this is like "daylight robbery" and imagine, it happened right inside a so-called 5-star hotel !Perhaps, a more service-oriented manager with good PR would have settled this matter amicably and in a professional manner, instead of being "high-handed", bossy & humiliate hotel guests openly ?As such, we have decided against holding anymore event in the future at this hotel.

Author: joanadventure
Title: Get variety @ Tony Roma
Review: It's a good place to dine for dinner especially if you want a mix of drink and food. You can get variety of drinks from fruit juices to alcoholic. I particularly like the beef here. :)

Author: AngieTaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food with nice service
Review: Restaurant is small with only a few tables. Food is super delicious, many signature dishes are a must order. Assam fish, the otak, Kang kong are must order.Waitress is friendly and try their best to serve as fast as they can. A nice restaurant to visit if you are looking for home cooked peranakan food
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: iAngelicSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average...
Review: Have been there many times as a child.. when business was bustling with life. However this time when we went back recently, we were served cold solid custard lava buns (when it’s supposed to be flow-y and bursting with flavors when bitten into it), and the restaurant wasn’t even busy, only 3-4 tables were occupied. Items weren’t steaming hot, only mildly warm when served to our tables. We had to had the staff steam our food items more than once. Hopefully it’ll be better when we’re back next time!

Author: roseline mKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Free cash voucher anyone?
Review: Probably we should not blame Bankara for keeping the very original taste from its origin. Most Japanese food, in Japan, are salty and in strong favor. Bankara, with its white broth, taste extremely porky (even stronger than Ippudo) Char siew is okay. Tonkotsu is way too salty that our taste buds nearly got numbed.I was given a RM 10 cash voucher, valid till 30 Mar, but don't think I'll use it.So, free cash voucher anyone?

Author: Kerry MSunbury, Australia
Title: Arthur's Bar and Grill let's down the SL team ... so badly!
Review: Arrived from London this morning fresh from an outstanding experience in the JW Steakhouse within Grosvenor House on Park Lane.After work and a relaxing, delicious, pu-ehr tea in the Shangri-La lobby lounge, a juicy steak, with french fries and fresh green vegetables beckoned. So to Arthur's Bar and Grill for one more try following a less-than-blue ribbon experience on a previous visit.Welcomed by attentive and friendly wait staff and seated efficiently in a prime window table, the prospect of a medium-rare tenderloin steak with sides of fries and fresh green beans had me fairly salivating. To my delight, my waitress even confirmed that the kitchen would accommodate my wish for a mushroom sauce (off the menu).While the steak only just exceeded the medium-rare requested, it was still tender, juicy, and flavoursome, and the mushroom sauce a reasonable accompaniment.It is here that the tale of woe begins, the french fries absolutely reeked from cooking in what could best be described as rancid oil, and the fresh green beans were only fresh from the freezer, short cut, soggy, limp and tasteless. Consequently, The sour, rancid odour and visibly lifeless texture prevented any of the vegetables or fries from passing my lips.Staff: Very good. Attentive & friendly Trying hardest. 8/10Ambience: Agree with other reviewers. Smoky, uninviting. 3/10Decor: Hideously dated, 1980's feel. 3/10.Food: Well below standard of Zipangu, Shang Palace, ££. 1/10Drinks: Good selection, £££. 6/10Service: Good standard. 7/10Overall: Arthur's Bar & Grill has gone the way of restaurants at Bangsar Village, and now is a complete let down for the World-Class Shangri-La hotel and all it's other dining establishments. Well overdue for a major renovation of venue and F&B. 4/10.

Author: 275GilliB
Title: Awful
Review: Greasy noodles, filthy toilets leaking out to the area where the pot washing is done. That said, my husband and kids liked it!

Author: Soh YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Seafood Buffet Dinner
Review: We were there on 10-Aug for buffet dinner. 4 out of 5 took the fresh seafood (oyster) & having food poisoning now!! My wife didn't take it so she is OK. The prawn served also not fresh. Should ask for refund & will never go there again !!!

Author: Kl YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Shucked @ The Garden Mall, Kuala Lumpur - A great disappointment
Review: Yesterday, me and my business associate decided to dine at the Shucked Oyster located at the Garden Mall. Our experience turnout to be one of the worst that I ever had.1.) Food  - Oyster - we ordered a dozen of oysters, but unfortunately the oyster turnout to be not fresh; - Bread - Presentation and quality is really bad. I must said that its looks worst than those I had at the tradition coffee shop; and - Overcooked Spaghetti that looked like spaghetti porridge. That makes us left the restaurant and continue our dinner at the Alexis downstairs.Well, the only consolation was the wine we had ... not too bad. Last but not least ... Service as good as zero. Quality of food - Very bad. (Imagine an oyster bar that not able to serve good quality oyster....).

Author: aileenkohailingMiri, Malaysia
Title: the food is not tasty
Review: I found the food here is not tasty. I tried the mee mamak and it had a terrible smell which made me couldnt take any spoon of it. The fried vegetables is so so and the fried pork ribs is too salty. I also ordered a bowl of soup and it was tasteless even though it was full of anchovis, vege and chicken. I hope Ming Cafe can improve themselves.

Author: kashs884
Title: Cold food arrived in three different times
Review: We ordered food in our visit on Sunday and waiter brought food after 20 minutes but then we had to wait another 15 minutes for steak which eventually came but was cold , waiter called manager who was very defensive and didn't want to help in the beginning but then took the steak away and after 12 minutes brought it back which was burning hot and when I asked him y he took so long and got me the same steak back then he replied that he was warming up the steak. This steak became chewy and disgusting. We just had to pay and leave and I willRecommend anyone coming from Europe to think twice before visiting this place .

Author: PurpletravelsSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bole-ler
Review: Easy to park during the night. Not sure about day time. They have a wide selection of menu. Prep time a bit too long for me by the time all our food arrived I felt too tired to eat. Presentation was good but taste was just average. Like it wasn't memorable. You know how you want food to remember food and come again? Lol. Not here. Ambience was just ok. They had a dining for 2 package setup and romantic dinner etc. But yeah, I would have preferred yummeh food rather than all the right ambience etc. The Chef was around, maybe can try to mingle with the visitors or try to improve turn around time. Because seriously who wants to come and wait for almost an hour for their food But kudos on the idea for bday packages etc.. Just improve the taste.
Restaurant: Laman Grill steak n Bar B Que,

Author: charleneleong3001
Title: Charlene’s Eye Opener Japanese Fine Dining
Review: That was my first time experienced Japanase fine dining.I already addicted to this. Thanks Chef Sam.

Author: eleanor kKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best hainanese coffeshop in the heart of Kuala Lumpur
Review: One of the hidden gem in the heart of Kuala Lumpur. If you are craving for local breakfast and coffee this is the place to go. The half boiled eggs were made to perfection. Their service is fast and efficient. Mr Ho the owner is ever smiling and friendly.

Author: intorox61Perth, Australia
Title: Great location for a drink but the food is foul.
Review: Fantastic watering hole for people watching and perhaps listening to jazz. We had a meal there as well but it was horrible. The vegetable curry and naan bread entree had a bowl of watery tasteless curry. The rice curry arrived cold and as a result was pretty much inedible. The ramen soup was passable, some interesting ingredients including nice noodles but hardly any taste. With so many better food options in town, I'd have a pre-dinner drink here and find a decent restaurant.

Author: Belinda L
Title: Had to beg for bowls, refill teapot ourselves and pay 10% service charge
Review: V v poor service yet charge 10% service charge. Table of 9 lunch and we had to justify ourselves to request for small bowls, which is standard utensil in all Chinese restaurants. Only after we explained that we have ordered the very premium dishes ie suckling pig rm168 and Peking duck rm60 did they give us a stack of bowls which we distribute ourselves. We had to go and refill teapot with hot water ourselves throughout. Very rude too. Tea was expensive too. Rm4++/pax.They charged extra 20.8 to chop up the Peking duck too. Ive never heard of that.. couldnt believe my ears. Chinese restaurants always chop up the duck free. The premium is only when they stir fry with noodles. And this wasn't stated in menu. There's no dim sum menu too. They just come to your table and give you what dim sum is available, and you have no idea about the price.Prawn cheong fun was bad. Prawn fried beancurd roll was stuffed with lots of corn/veg too. Other dishes were ok. Rm500 for 9pax.

Author: limwc78
Title: Excellent Food
Review: All the spicy food is tasty, beside equatorial we finally got other option to eat already. The price is reasonable.

Author: felicitytraveller
Title: Pretty average food.
Review: Pretty average food. We both had curry and it was basically just chicken etc in oil. There was no curry sauce. Bit disappointed seeing how highly rated it is

Author: oiradanilHannover, Germany
Title: Simply wired
Review: We went there expecting the normal Hard Rock Cafe we know all over the world. We were shocked by the great difference. First they had reservation system, and we had hardly found a table to eat.. coming from along distance it was disappointing...then we noticed the unfriendly staff which is not unusual for the international hard rock cafe like we know it.. they are usually making small talk and are smiling.. the cafe was full with biker gang members and it made us feel uncomfortable .. food is standard like expected.. but i would not recommend it and i would definitely not be going there again :o

Author: DFH-Manager
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review:
Went there twice due to a good offer and pleasant staff.
Food was presented very nicely and taste was good.
However, the drinks were not as expected and could improve.

Author: 914swagg
Title: good food & worth for money 👍 excellent service 👏 kipidap dongibab mantap cuy😍
Review: ps// im having braised short rib .. very recommended ❤ so, fr the traveller out thre, please come to the Ken's Kitchen located at saradise bdc & do make a vsit 😉

Author: Shirley H
Title: Good food and good environment
Review: A bit pricey for Malaysian ... may be ok for foreigner.. but yummy food, good service and very nice environment. Good place for business lunch meeting, quiet comfortable place. Hope can be back in future.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fantabulous Fine Dining Lunch
Review: Simple lovely 3 course fine dining lunch with lovely wine to chill about in celebrating friends’s birthday. Had the simple lovely cold Somen with refreshing Hokkaido Scallops as their appetiser, with Poached Japanese Tai Fish with Shirao & Ginger Jus as the main course blend with Selection of Chef Cheese Platter as the desert or Green Tea Bavarois With Azuki Ice Cream, Chilling lovely friends with a. Bunch of lovely ladies

Author: chiachiangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Really average and a let down for me
Review: We went on a Friday evening dinner and was the only table when we arrive at 6pm. Could have been a sign as we seen other eateries filled up with many patrons already.Anyway we had the recommended pasta and also pizza and fries. Quality and taste is really average and expensive for the bill. Service is acceptable.

Author: Alexandra GLuxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Returning to the Bombay Palace
Review: So, we arrived back in Malaysia after sixteen years and just in time for dinner. I had a craving for curry. We decided on the Bombay Palace, our favourite Indian restaurant from the 1990s, and wondered if it would still be there. Google said yes, and the concierge at our hotel agreed, and booked us a table. The taxi driver seemed a little confused by our directions, but ‘maybe I am forgetting?’ he said apologetically. The fact that the Bombay Palace appeared to have been air lifted across about eight lanes of heavy traffic and a substantial medium strip to land on the far side of Tun Razak threw us into confusion, and we started to feel a little silly, apologizing profusely to the driver for our senility.Yet it turns out we were all right. The restaurant actually had moved across the road some years before, into a very similar, spacious old house on a large lot. Now it’s moving again, to Sultan Ismail, as yet another elegant but rather faded colonial building makes way for yet another suave high rise.We were ushered upstairs to a large formal dining room, surprisingly empty of all but a group of silent army hot shots in full uniform. But it was soon humming upstairs as loudly as it was downstairs.Our waiters were charming, advising us cautiously not to order too much. Well, who doesn’t when confronted with a ten page menu? You don’t want to miss anything significant! One young waiter was so friendly, I thought he was going to pull up a chair and join us. The Bombay Palace has a great wine list according to one fellow blogger, but we chose Kingfisher beers to accompany our meal, having long felt that beer goes much better than wine with Indian food. Of course we did order far too much, but the only dish that was faintly disappointing was the Malai Kofta, an old and honoured favourite of mine that sadly did not live up to my expectations. The rest, mostly spicy vegetarian dishes apart from one prawn vindaloo, were as tasty as we remembered and we eventually waddled out, filled to the gunwales.

Author: heatherrjollyEdzell, United Kingdom
Title: a great place to get out of the heat
Review: We saw the Hard Rock Cafe whilst on the boat tr and decided to visit. We really wanted to get out of the intense heat and we were not disappointed. We had happy hour drinks in fabulous surroundings and the atmosphere was great. We will certainly go back for some food.

Author: b0gdanpBucharest, Romania
Title: Great thai food
Review: During our 4 night stay in KL, we had lunch/dinner 3 times at Malai. Surprisingly, the restaurant was quite empty each time we went there (albeit we usually went at unusual hours, somewhere around 5-6 pm). However, the food was, every time, flawless.The tom yum is exactly like in Thailand, while the dishes were perfect. We had 6 different dishes and, to tell the truth, I couldn't tell which one I enjoyed most.The prices are nothing compared to the quality of the food served there.100% recommend this place!

Author: mimamaike2019
Title: Payed a lot, got less, items missing, unprofessional handling
Review: We ordered two similar haloumi-avocado salads, cost per salad 32 ringgit (expensive) plus taxes and service charge. ON THE PICTURE: 2 big slices haloumi, half a avocado, steemed vegetables with seeds. One leaf of rucola for decoration. ON OUR PLATES: a full plate of rucola, 3 small slices of haloumi, NO avocado, a vew pieces of veggies, seeds.Basically they reduced the expensive main ingredients to decoration or just didn't put it on the plate at all and made the cheap decoration the main ingedient.After asking I was told, avocado was to hard, I could choose a substitute. Well... I took an egg. Suggestions or just a cheaper price would have been nice.When we asked for the bill, I asked if an egg salad was the same price as an avocado salad. Bartender got a little pissed then and told me he had told us there was no avocado, what was a straight lie (who would order a green salad for 32ringit???). Also they didn't offer a substitute for me friend.So we paid 70ringit for two green salads with a little haloumi in a mall. Plus partly unprofessional and unfriendly staff (as soon as you criticize, otherwise friendly).Drinks were nice.

Author: Paul OKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sai Woo, say NICE...
Review: Cheap, local, tasty and good. When you are sick of the hotel food and top end restaurants, treat yourself to something special at the right price. Range of food is good and the quality is great value. Will suit most tastes and the quantity of serve is very good. Service is fast when you just need some quality eats on track to a big night out. Nice atmosphere, friendly staff and feels local. I had a chicken dish that was exceptional with my taste buds jumping from my mouth for more. Mouth watering, with amazing aroma, the perfect dish. Treat yourself without costing a fortune. Good for all types of travellers. Ask for the specials, very nice.

Author: JadeGC
Title: Halal Outlet of Din Tai Fung
Review: Din Tai Fung as always been one of the good choice for the hand-made noodles and Xiao Long Bao. DIN is the HALAL outlet of DTF, the taste is different but it is an experience close enough for the Halal foodies out there.DIN is in KLCC, convenient for lunch hour. Otherwise, original DTF would be the choice to go for the non-halal version of the food.
Restaurant: DIN by Din Tai Fung at Suria KLCC (NO PORK)

Author: Natalie BMadrid, Spain
Title: Great food but beer was very expensive
Review: Came this evening for a delicious meal. The food was great and we were really happy until we came to pay. My husband was offered a Tiger beer which wasn't on the menu. But when we paid we noticed on the receipt that he was charged 45 RM for a small can - this is about twice the price we have paid anywhere else in KL - including in our hotel and bars. This was upsetting as we feel that were taken advantage of.

Author: nik_menJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Decent vegetarian south indian food
Review: This is a big chain and i have been to their outlets in New Delhi and Chennai. The food served in kuala lampur branch can not be compared to the ones back in india as it does not taste as good as that. Sambar tastes watery and lacks flavour and even the gravies and desserts are not as good. Dont keep your expectations high. Having said that, atleast this place gives you the option to satisfy your craving for south indian food, it offers you a really wide variety of dishes that taste decent enough.

Author: Aizul Johann Z
Title: Slow kitchen process.
Review: Kitchen should have an adequate or efficient practice. If for one you are aware that your customers are waiting for just a plate of 8 pieces or more, I'm sure there will be a long line of customers waiting for the same thing. This will take about 25 mins avg. I think for one the kitchen should prepare the average batch of materials before hand reduce waiting for about 30 to 40%. Hence I believe the reason for long waits outside the restaurant too which also could be the factor. I've also noticed that some chicken are just out from the fridge and that will take time to tore. So consider to take frozen food out of the chiller/fridge an hour and a half before proceeding to cook. My two cents.

Author: AileenChua
Title: Family lunch
Review: Great tasting dim sum at affordable prices. Queue was long so make sure to be there before 10.30 am or risk being turned away as the dim sum could be sold out by 11.30 am.

Author: Jon J
Title: So so...
Review:
Foods average, tad expensive for what you get. Disappointed with the chicken where we feel they cut corners and serving tough chicken meat. 

Salted egg crab was poor and tasteless. Vegetables as basic staple can be done better. 

Not something I'd go back again..

Author: TravellerJeffLeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience for gathering
Review: I was here alone for business trip and did a thorough research to source for the best food in mid valley mall. Saw good reviews about Chilis and took awhile to find this restaurant. Realise it is beside another popular store, antipodean. What surprise me is antipodean was quiet that day that it was so crowded at chilis.it was full house that evening. My expectation grew and guess im not wrong. People here tend to come in big group. I just here for short 20minutes and there are 2 group celebrate birthday as they sang birthday song. Nice ambience for gathering.I order beef burger. but just a little disappointed as I don't like the beef patty which maybe need some seasoning. Overall I enjoy the ambience and took some photos

Author: G4974FJsunilk
Title: Good place for South Indian food
Review: Sarvana Bhavan is part of their global chain and popular for their south indian foods. I have also visited their New Delhi, India outlet which is much better then the Kuala Lumpur one and food taste also have some difference specially in sambhar.

Author: sboob
Title: Day off
Review: Everything is good and Mj is very friendly she take care me good I recommend this place i come back again

Author: aandlkchKuching, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing meal
Review: Went to Tribal Stove some while back, but were very disappointed with the buffet lunch there yesterday.The ? spinach soup was quite good, but cold. The 2 green vegetables were cooked in the same way, and, alongside the soup, didn't really offer much variety. The ayam pansoh (chicken) was very bony, not much meat. In all it was very uninspiring.

Author: kennethtjlim1509
Title: Expected better.
Review: Was there yesterday 15/7/2019 with my partner for dinner. Decided to go with the set course menu for rm250 per pax and a bottle of red wine ConFirstly my appetizer was ths smoked salmon bruchetta and immediately I saw a small piece of blue colour glove was on the salmon, luckily they did replace it with the Pan Seared Scallop dish wish I was thinking of paying for it.Thru out the courses food was serve even before we could finish our current plate, which I felt like being rushed to finish my food?? Rainbow fish tasted frozen and tasted like dory fillets, and mushy.Veal tasted a lot of demi glaze powder for their sauce as I expected a restaurant like favola to be like home made their sauces,instead of using from a packet.Pro'sThe CDP that was in charge last night was actually taking responsibility coming out and explaining and listening and apologising on behalf of the team for something that I thought was a job for the Chef de cuisine or Sous chef to handle...Well, I do hope it can be improved, but I would say their better Italian restaurants for now, should have just went for Prime instead. Bread & dipping was good.Wine was good

Author: 629kinsJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: zero service and arrogant
Review: Went with a vip and business partners (investors) for a lunch approximately at 12noon.When i tried to enter the coffee house the hostess stopped us by sating we are not allowed to enter as lunch will only start at 12.30noon. So we thought since it was only half an hour before the buffet is open, we could wait at the coffee house or maybe doing while having coffee and discussion.But to our horror, we were not allowed to even wait at the coffee house!Excuse given by the hostess: the staff is mopping the floor to get ready for lunch.We didnt feel welcomed at all. Really?What kind of excuse is this???Ive been to so many hotels in and out of the country,normally when lunch starts at 12.30 there will be no more mopping as it is done during clearing after breakfast time- 11.00-11.30am and the staff will be in the midst of taking out arranging food and buffet line instead at 12!It is such a disgrace to the hotel international brand which is well known locally and internationally with its excell in services and courtesy regardless of guests class or ethnicity!Beside a cliche reply to the feedbacks by guests,you should really look into upgrading your service!Though it is not my first, it could be my last. There are always better hotels in johor bahru every day. And double tree will not be in my list of recommendation.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: AzliaDeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Mother's Day Lunch
Review: Food variety was really good. Great choices of Malay, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Western cuisine. We enjoyed the lunch.Coincidentally there was a Mother's Day celebration and the restaurant organized a cake decoration competition for the kids & mothers. Good effort to cheer up the occasion of Mother's Day and lucky draw session also was held. If you wish to have a table by the window, please make a reservation earlier. We did not manage to grab any even though reservation was made 2 weeks earlier. It was a quite disappointed to see empty tables by the window when people did not turn up at last. Restaurant should give cut-off time and release the table for others.The crews were polite & friendly. But less efficient as we need to call them for the plain water at first.The parking charge is quite pricey. Stayed there for 2 1/2 hours and been charged RM10. Would like to suggest for the hotel to give fix rate for the hotel / restaurant guests just like other hotels did.

Author: pschreiber123Singapore, Singapore
Title: Thank you for ruining my family's New Years Eve
Review: My family traveled to Malaysia to spend New Years Eve in KL. My parents-in-law traveled from Germany for the celebration. We went in person to make a reservation for New Year's Eve dinner and we were faced with an extremely defensive and rude bespectacled reservations girl. She was unfriendly, off-putting and, overall, she had no concept on how to speak to potential customers. We reserved a table for the second seating which was scheduled for 9:30pm. After reaching the restaurant lobby in the rain and going through several security checks and 2 elevators rides, we arrived a few minutes after 9:30pm. As other guests were seated, we were told to wait and to sit on some sofas. After several minutes we were given the menus to look at. As we waited and waited, my husband went to asked the rude, bespectacled reservations girl what the hold up was. She curtly told him to go sit down and to wait and that we would have to wait another 25 to 30 minutes for the table. It was now already 10pm and we were then ushered upstairs to an extremely loud lounge. My parents in law are elderly folk, so sitting in a lounge with music blaring, where you cannot hear yourself speak is not ideal, to say the least. We were kept waiting then were offered some champagne (I do not drink) and some pizza (which was much too spicy for me and my son). We were kept waiting and waiting. It was now past 10:30 and we were no closer to getting our table. I was so incensed that I left. I was in no way shape or form going to spend a cent in this place. They clearly oversold the table and had no intention of honoring our reservation. Instead they thought they could bide their time and try to appease us by sending some booze and pizza to tide us over until we gave up. Which we eventually did because we were so offended about being deceived and relegated to some corner of a loud lounge. As a born and bred New Yorker and a person who has lived in London, Paris, Munich, Hong Kong and Singapore, I have never been treated with such disrespect. I have eaten in top restaurants around the world and this experience was truly disgraceful. The Marini Group should fire this rude, defensive, bespectacled reservations girl who has zero concept on how to speak to customers and they should be ashamed of themselves for treating guests in such a deceitful manner. At the end of the day, I am glad that I did not spend a cent in this dump.

Author: TraceJase
Title: Yum
Review:
Fresh food cooked in front of you
Very reasonable prices, generous servings
Fabulous food.
Go there.

Author: chociq
Title: Tiny oysters
Review: We read good reviews about this place. Were let down by the tiny oysters. The batter texture were yummy though. Now if only the oysters are way bigger, I would rate this very good.

Author: 839sabinap
Title: Really decent Japanese food
Review: Great Japanese food at decent affordability. The place is always packed, a testament to the great restaurant! A wide variety of Japanese cruising, from sushi and sashimi to noodles and garlic fries rice, you're sure to satisfy your Japanese palette here :)

Author: Quakermin
Title: Worst. service. ever.
Review: Food tasted great except that it wasn't what I ordered. Not many of us who ordered food got what we ordered. We were also asked to leave before receiving all the food we ordered because they "needed the table for other customers." Even though the second floor was empty. Would not recommend to anyone unless you speak a language other than English.

Author: JustinlyhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No choice
Review: We stumble at this restaurant when there were no other restaurant available during lunch hour.. everywhere full and crowded. We entered the restaurant, waited for more than five minutes, no one come to service, after ordered simple two individual plate chicken rice, took more than five minutes waiting. The food portion was so little, tiny and pathetic !So..come to this restaurant when you have no other choice.

Author: Jay T
Title: unprofessional services
Review: Time of entry: 9.30pm......This restaurant is not professional at all as 5 stars dining, as per tele-conversation said allowed dining until 11.30pm but waitress informed us at 10.15pm last call, 10.30pm mention that buffet area close. 10.30pm no more replenish and whole session close....waitress and waiter not observant enough, if you not request they serve plain water, they will not serve you water at all...

Author: gemini99australia
Title: Delicious food - friendly service
Review: The food here is magnificent - we had hummus, fattoush, shawarma and everything was so fresh and full of flavour! I would recommend this restaurant for people looking for something different in Kuah! We will ba back and we wish you every success!

Author: Shabarna M
Title: Was a lovely experience
Review: Was a lovely experience had had a great time with family and the food was excellent the restaurant manager was very was warm and polite and stopped at our table every time to inquire about how we are enjoying our meal

Author: fsenadaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Pan Pizza is good...
Review: Been here more than a dozen times, yet I still find my way back here. Why? Cos some of the dishes, is something you cannot get elsewhere, not that they don't make just because weren't as yummy as in here. I always love their pizza. Place is okay not that fantastic but they do serve good dishes.

Author: Sooria R
Title: Awesome Japanese Food
Review: My favorite Japanese restaurant. The whole family lives this place. We normally go to the one at Oasis boulevard.The restaurant itself is kinda welcoming and the staff are attentive. The food portions are decent compared to some places that I've been. Maybe it's because the price here is on the higher side but it's definitely worth it.Love the atmosphere and love the food. When I think of Japanese ala carte with the family, we always head there.

Author: IGibbonsUK
Title: The food was cold, have a drink but eat elsewhere
Review: On first impression it looks OK, it's busy and that gave me the false impression that it was the place to be. It sells a good selection of beers, inc my favorite San Miguel Light so that was a good enough reason for me to stay. The bar staff are mainly Filipino's and very friendly, and being Filipino's they all speak fluent English allbeit with an American accent.The biggest disappointment was the food, my travelling partner and I ordered several hot dishes, all of which were either cold or slightly warm when they arrived.It's not cheap there, and I found better and cheaper places to eat.If you're in the area and want a drink it's fine, but you're better off going somewhere else to eat

Author: OliviaWeatherstoneLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Appaling
Review: The view is great, but the restaurant can't claim any credit for that. What it should get credit for is the food, if it's any good. And it isn't. There are no two ways about it, the afternoon tea selection is appalling. They have hi-tea on weekends so that may be better, who knows, but I went for the afternoon tea on a weekday hoping for a decent selection of delectable cakes, pastries, scones, sliced fruit, sandwiches and mini-pies. I was completely shocked to see the spread after making payment (they insist on payment as soon as you enter). All the food was laid out on one table (a little bigger than a dining table) and the afternoon tea consisted of (and I am NOT exaggerating) 1. 2 types of English cakes (cut into small squares) and 2 types of local cakes (I have had Malaysian cakes before and they are delicious when made well, these were horrible and not representative of the typical local fare you can find elsewhere in Malaysia) 2. Fried springrolls (the only thing we could stomach) 3. Cold and terribly made sweet porridge 4. Hard buns 5. Low-quality bread 6. Tea and coffee. I did read all the reviews before going, but I wanted the experience for the kids and just could not imagine that it could be that bad. I was wrong. Even with lowered expectations, I was aghast. This is supposed to be a major attraction and it is beyond me that you can allow a restaurant of this calibre to operate here. Paying almost 60 ringit and getting about 5 ringit worth of food is inexcusable. Sure, it's not much in pounds (I feel sorry for the Malaysians who go there), but you can't measure the value for money based on currency which is stronger. At that price, I could get fantastic tea at many 5-star establishments, and I could eat a feast at the cheaper food stalls, many of which serve excellent local and Western delicacies. The management should really do something about this, the experience could have been so wonderful had the restaurant just met basic expectations. I could go on and on but I think I've said enough and I want to enjoy the rest of the holidays so I'll put this horrible experience behind me and move on. P.S If you must see KL from somewhere high up, visit the KLCC skybridge instead, it's free and you can enjoy the experience without anger getting in the way.

Author: cttclaire
Title: Commercialize Nyonya food
Review: Commercialize Nyonya food. Nothing special, food tastes normal & costly.

Author: isoderaKuala Lumpur
Title: Feel cheated
Review: We ordered Debil Chicken and Kai Lan with garlic (recommended by owner since I cannot take shrimp paste).The chicken meat didn't taste absolutely fresh. But my grievance was that we were served a different vegetable (Malaysian grown brussels sprouts, not kai lan) with garlic and mini dried shrimp (which I'm allergic to and wasn't aware it contained until the end of the meal). The vegetable was also mostly old leaves with black blemishes (normally thrown out in Malaysian cooking)

Author: rslovestravelselangor
Title: Used to be good, not recently
Review: We are used to eating here at their various branches in KL. Food choices and the taste were amazing, well not until recently.Packing for take aways during fasting month because was craving for their kway teow. Little did I expect, during dinner I was eating such a bland dish that I paid so much for it. Regret.In times like this, I'll avoid the place altogether. Don't want to be disappointed again.

Author: JUnniMorgan
Title: Great culinary experience
Review: Pricey (RM100+ for two people) but for us having authentic Korean food for the first time it was a great culinary experience. The ambience is homely. Service staff is very attentive, the cook was happy to explain dishes and reduce the spiciness for us.

Author: bundaoli
Title: cozy place!
Review: we were on the walking toward chew jetty, was extremely hot so finding this place was a bless!Cozy place, a nice staff informing that they were selling pork.i ask wether we can still be sitting for a drink, and was welcomed warmthly.very nice place, love the decoration.would also order for dessert to go with our drink but they only have western dessert while we explore more for penang’d specialty.it was a fresh drink served, eventhough a bit overpricing.but we did enjoy the place and coziness

Author: Nacho BKL
Title: Never Again. The worst service in Kuala Lumpur by far
Review: I have been to many Nobu restaurants but this one only has the same Name, nothing to share with others I visited. Went there yesterday with a group of friends for a B-day celebration, 12 of us. Will never go again.Staff has not clue about a thing, they came with all orders late and wrong, they showed a terrible bad customer service with an attitude after complaining for a while they acknowledged they wee completely overwhelmed, not trained and understaffed. Food was good but took us 3 hours from mains to dessert. We paid RM 800 per couple, the manager came late to offer us all sort of freebies and extra dishes, too late in my opinion, we wanted to remove service charge but couldn't.avoid at all cost until they completely change their staff. Views and access to the place also sucks,Marinis 57 is much better, for same price you get service, access and views that Nobu lacks.

Author: NurulhusnaZul
Title: Good place, good food.
Review: Amazing place, decoration, atmosphere, food, ambience, and most importantly live band music. Just that the live band should reduce overwhelming noise.Recommend to everyone!

Author: Michie SKlang, Malaysia
Title: Long queue good food
Review: Food portion (S or L) is based on the dough weight. Price is reasonable for the portion but often lesser than other food stalls as this place strictly weighs the dough. Dough kneaded and cook in thin smooth slices where its easily chew, I love it that way. Soup were tasteful where not too salty nor tasteless. Sides (anchovies, pork lard, fried onions etc) were tasty too but sadly, there's an additional charges occur for extra (which is not reasonable to me). Service is definately slow, estimated at least 30 mins of waiting on normal crowd. If there are standing crowd before you, estimate to sit and dine within 45 mins to an hour. Place order with only a person, as they often ignore further request if you order with another (though they have so many staff around to help). Often crowded no matter what time you come. Hardly able to find parking so carpool is recommendable. By far, I don't see nor get any baby highchairs for my kids to seat. Mostly I stacked chairs for my kids.

Author: la030902
Title: Lmch
Review: The food here was good, especially the dim sum. It has standard, Service is good. during weekends however, is best to book as its crowded.

Author: Jay LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Go for atmosphere, NOT the food
Review: The title says it all. The food is terrible. My steak was very poor quality, tough and inedible (I can't prove it but I think it was deep fried, not grilled). Have a drink but don't eat.

Author: thevein_nambiarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Doubtful Quality
Review: I used to be their patron till I heard rumors that they buy their cooking oil from cooking oil recycling merchants. I thought I should check it out and so several months back I went to their outlet in Bangsar and asked one of the counter staff the kind of cooking oil they use. He replied that they use Sunflower Oil. Doubting his words, I asked him to show me proof by producing the bottle from the kitchen. He got aggressive and replied me in a rude voice that they cook elsewhere and bring the food to the restaurant and therefore don't have any bottles to show me. That was clearly a lie. The recycling merchants source their used cooking oil from anyone including restaurants and roadside stalls that deep fry chicken and other meat items. Therefore, the recycled oil can never be a vegetarian oil. If any vegetarian restaurant uses it then it is simply unacceptable. Furthermore, before the used oil is sold to the recycling merchant, the oil has already used several times. Only when the oil is considered not usable at all do these restaurants or roadside stalls sell it to the recycling merchants. Such oil has already been chemically changed and the recycling process does not reverse chemical structure. Therefore it is extremely unhealthy to consume such oil.

Author: aklcarolKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: This time could have been better
Review: Have eaten here several times in past couple of years but this time 2 dishes were disappointing. Steamed ginger tilapia fish...fish was too meaty and thick. Deep fried pig knuckle was too lean and dry.Restaurant was almost full when we arrived before 7pm so had to sit upstairs. Soon filled up eventho was a weekday, maybe cos was school holidays in Msia and Spore. Otherwise prices still very competitive and service good.

Author: Tamara APark City, Utah
Title: Best Chinese in KL
Review: We just returned from a wonderful evening with friends who have been residing in KL for generations. They told us they were bringing us to the best Chinese in KL and they were right. The char siew was the best I've tasted and even the tofu was exceptional, soft on the inside and crunchy on the outside. I say, "even the tofu" since I'm not normally a tofu fan but now I am a tofu-convert.If you are looking for fancy fusion this is not the place but if you are looking for fantastic home style Malaysian Chinese then this is the place to go.

Author: AbdullahAltamimi
Title: Decent Arabic Restaurant
Review: It is a very decent Arabic restaurant with nice food and atmosphere, but I didn't like that they allow customers to smoke shisha inside it. And their hummus is not that good.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Waiting staff is friendly and fast, but the kitchen is very slow
Review: Good food, but the price is a little on the high side.Nice ambience and furniture setting. Pity the ventilation is lacking which makes it uncomfortable when the evening is hot and humid.The waiting staff is friendly and helpful. But the food just took forever.

Author: Jeffery W
Title: Wonderful food
Review: Friendly staff with good fresh seafood. Reasonable price. Worth paying. Comfortable environment. Recommend for travellers.

Author: 204muhda
Title: Bad service
Review: Bad service the waiters had smells on their uniform......not so friendly ....not worth it.......please upgrade

Author: hsswuBatu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: Stink seafood pasta
Review: Seafood pasta only have squid, should be squid pasta instead. Squid is stink, request for change but they just heat it and adding more chili flakes try to cover the stink. Latte is watery. Waitress did not greet nor say thank you when I make payment. Uploaded the stink squid pasta to their Facebook and was taken down by the boss. Terrible dining experience I have ever had. If you are good in dessert, don't serve proper meal. So disappointed that 8TV Quickie introduce this terrible cafe. Regret for coming and will never go again.

Author: elizabethl0we
Title: Indah House Kuching
Review:
Great little cafe in the quiet side streets.
Friendly service and delicious food. We really enjoyed the tropical fruit drinks .
Had a beautiful lunch there.

Author: danelle637San Francisco, California
Title: Beware - Additional Fee for tourists/visitors
Review: This restaurant is inside the Fort Cornwallis, which has an entrance fee of 20MYR. I informed the ticket agent I was there just for the restaurant. I paid the fee and she gave me a voucher for the restaurant of 20MYR, which stated that the minimum spend is 20 MYR. However, when I went to pay my bill which was 35MYR, the employee informed me that they only discount 10MYR for tourist. I felt a bit misled since the ticket agent gave me different information. I tried to get a better understanding of why the voucher was different, but I was informed they could subtract 10 from my bill.I had black coffee and the Nyonya, which was quite delicious. The presentation and overall taste was good. The location is air conditioned which is perfect for the hot afternoon and many other guests had cold drinks. They have free wifi, which wasn't working at the time. Unfortunately, working out the bill at the end left me feeling a bit annoyed & slighted. For what I ate, it wasn't fully worth an extra fee.

Author: spockrockerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very average tarts.
Review: I'm a huge fan of Malaysian food and pastries but these tarts were a huge disappointment.Pineapple part was dry. Pastry (got the butter covered ones) was drier and had zero butter taste. Now i understand why the owner said "no sample" when we asked for some to try.

Author: dcpoon40Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad. Can try.
Review: Not bad. Quite cheap. Rm71 for the food in the photos. But i prefer the opp blue signboard ong kee. This chicken is normal. The opp ong kee at the corner is more Q like kampung chicken. But lou Wang has the intestine which is very nice. Their chilli also not bad la.

Author: OmidMohajeraniTehran, Iran
Title: Normal Choice
Review: If you are near Pavilion or you are visiting Jalan Alor it will be normal choice to go there . The food quality is good . It doesn't have a lot of choices . I can say it is normal and it is not wow . The price is cheap in comparison to other restaurants in that area

Author: Sean L
Title: Cheap and fast, but normal
Review: The seafood is much cheaper than one of the famous seafood restaurants in Cenang Beach. The food portion is bigger too. The food is average to me - may be I have too high expectation after reading all the good comments and recommendations?The clams are not very fresh and not clean thoroughly. The clam that fulled of sand had spoilt my clam soup.

Author: otyewSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice satay celup but....
Review: Well this restaurant is growing since yrs ago. It wasnt the best either but wasnt bad too. The problem is that the sauce was not replaced all the time, so hygenic wise....if you dont mind, it is still ok. As compare with Capitol, the sauce is a bit spicier but not as thich as Capitol. For some, me especially...I think Ban Lee Hiang is more worth it compare to Capitol.

Author: tommychewslKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Have the hotel actually done any check on dinner service?
Review: Summary of dinner service - disasterService was very by waiters who are rude.Seated ...7 mins no one attends to any request water or orders. Wave at waiter, they just walk away.Immediately requested to speak with hardy (manager) who is trying his best to accomodate all guest.Later plating was just practically thrown on the table by waiters. Even the next table raised his voice on why the waiters where so rude and if anyone knows about service.Signature was chicken ball rice and chicken chop....has the sous chef really even tasted the food? Tasteless, cold, and felt totally frozen meat.Environment was old school, but really spoilt by hospitality.Even the basic question ask, can the chef recommend something special...was replied by...sorry sir...we only have chicken rice ....and all is on menu...Omg... comparing to nobu, fuego, marinis and all similar spots..... colonial is really so far away.... If you are planning to bring someone special or for a special occasion... please dont bother.....Lastly....tks hardy....but the overall was a sinking ship.....

Author: LadyPoGKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Way too oily for my liking
Review: This restaurant serves chinese halal food from mainland China. While I understand most of the dishes are made kinda oily for some reason, I find it too oily to point I cannot eat it. Most of the dishes my family tried is either oily hot or oily tasteless. So no, would not recommend this place at all.

Author: John DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sub standard
Review: Had lunch there on Saturday, service was poor and we had to actively chase the poorly trained waiters at every turn. I asked for a glass of Sauvignon Blanc, the waiter asked would I like red or white!I went up to the main counter to order dessert as the waiters had all but disappeared. I made my order and waited… and waited. After 30 mins I asked for the bill. When I asked about the missing dessert the waiter smiled and said I would not be charged!There is no avenue to complain as all staff seemed to be foreign workers. Several other would be diners had left without eating.I will need a great deal of convincing to venture into this place again.

Author: Anna H
Title: Decent traditional cuisine
Review: Situated on what feels like the edge of town in a building based on a longhouse design. Staff were very attentive and friendly. Food was not really to our taste, buttermilk squid was very sweet and for me, slightly sickly. Chicken stew was nice. Overall not blown away but a reasonable traditional alternative.

Author: NataschaR
Title: Nice place
Review: Malaysian foot but western entourage. Very nice to enjoy your evening.

Author: tulipanmoradoPolaris, Montana
Title: Food is good but pity that the service was below expectation..Go to Pavillion outlet instead..
Review: Been a regular customer to this outlet in KLCC but usually I didn't go in a group, due to the good food , I choose to held a very important event here.. To start on the wrong for food, the reservation was a mess with lack of information, over promised but under deliver.. As invitation has been sent, hence it was rather too late to make changes all I was hoping was it will turn out to be right after speaking to the customer service..Unfortunately, it did not, service was slow, waiter doesn't seems to know their task, rude and it was overall a terrible experience..So my suggestion is if you want to try it's good food, try the outlet at Pavilion instead, service is better, food is just the same..

Author: thesimpletravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Standard has dropped
Review: Standard of food has dropped, what a shame. Desserts were mediocre, beef was tasteless, simple dish of mac cheese was bland. See attached photo - how could they serve such bad cake! This buffet was saved by the very good teh tarik and excellent table service by Kamrul. YTL, you can do better than this please.

Author: AliaAMRKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Low Quality
Review: Been a frequent patron but I noticed that the quality has been dropped. TR need to buckle up or you gonna be left behind as too many restaurant offers tasty food and better service.We ordered the set lunch1. Mushroom soup - tasteless. A bit cold should served it warm.2. Bread - too hard. 3. BBQ chicken - too dry.4. Lamb Cavapi - worst ever. The lamb taste lingers for a while.

Author: Jacki S
Title: Quality Food & Service
Review: Fusion menu. Friendly staff. Quality food. In the heart of colonial downtown Ipoh. Highly recommend.

Author: AllyC09Singapore, Singapore
Title: Sucks big time - will not return
Review: I was here with a friend for lunch. Impressively the menu provide more options and to my expected impression? Still sucks big time.Partner and I order the clay pot spicy pork and seafood with borsch, and cream soup each with ice coffee and Ying Yong. Soup arrived ok. Problem rose from Our drink. Coffee is alright but Ying Yong? Is a milk tea and this pink shirt so call captain insisted is Ying Yong. So, we were upset. Come to our main meal? 1 set arrived, pork set but mine? Waited for 20 mins. Everyone of the server waking around pretended to be busy and were looking at our table but say nothing till my partner asked? This so call captain? Swing like as if he is doing a cheap fashion show and later return with our order receipt which he throw it on our table mumbling something and walk away.10 mins later? My food arrived, we ate and while eating? I know this will be a last visit as we were upset with the attitude by the staffs despite we have to pay service charge with no sense of customer orientation, and I was hungry. No way to return and not recommended!!
Restaurant: City Square Hong Kong Kim Gary Restaurant

Author: pianocello
Title: Visit
Review: Service was friendly and fast. Food was delicious. I would give the highest rating if not for the fact that prices are too high and this is in a neighbourhood with difficulty finding parking.

Author: Emily BChicago, Illinois
Title: Complete opposite experience from all the other reviews.
Review: Such a strange evening....by far the most rude staff I have encountered in Malaysia, she seemed a bit more friendly to the Chinese customers, but the attitude definitely didn't match the environment. We weren't asked if we wanted a drink and then when we asked for one she was very short and dismissive of us. Then, the food. We ordered the first and fourth set and a bowl of the "soup of the day". The seasonings (or lack thereof) and textures were sooooo off. Cold, strange dishes, old (or overcooked) rice, and soup with absolutely no seasoning only water as the base.

Author: Li Sa B
Title: Perfect
Review: Thank you for the amazing evening. Perfect food, perfekt service. We feeling like at home and very welcome. We will come back.

Author: iantF7178IWSturminster Marshall, United Kingdom
Title: Evening Out
Review: We only visited this place once and we really enjoyed it. I'm not sure why people rate it badly as for me it not provided excellent value for money (food and drinks) but there was also live music (which was actually very good - especially the female singer). Both our meals were well cooked and tasted as they should - and they were pretty cheap. The beers were also very reasonably priced. The staff were very friendly and efficient and the place a nice vibe about it. You can't really ask for any more in my book. Would definitely have visited again if we had stayed in KL for longer than our 4 nights

Author: pixie-alex
Title: It is a very relaxing place
Review: I love this place. The food is nice and the beer is cool and cheap and it is in the middle of the town. Easy breeeezy

Author: Tom WKuala Lumpur
Title: Poor service and poor wine selection
Review: Beast has gone down hill since previous visits. On a recent visit in May we were advised that the first few wines we ordered were out of stock (having to wait each time whilst the waiter went to check). In the end we had to ask what was available on the menu to save time.The waiter messed up the order and missed one starter (we were a party of 7) despite having confirmed the order with us. The other six had finished their starters before the seventh came. The main courses were served over a period of 20 mins so again some of the party had finished before others were even served. Not conducive to a business meeting meal.The steaks were average - none of our party were impressed.I won't be going back.

Author: OpahAspa
Title: Good Seafood
Review: Well, I'm not really a fan of seafood. But the food here are yummy and the service is quite fast too.

Author: yinteng88Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Overly-priced food with bad service
Review: Server recommended medium-sized portion dishes for a group of 7, There was not enough food to go around and the bill total came up to more than RM200. There was not a breakdown of food prices on the final bill. When we asked for another plate of the same dish, we were given a different one. While the food is good, I would think twice about going back due to bad experience.

Author: BobBobGolden
Title: Truely Swiss, must try for locals
Review:
Although the shop is standard size, the decoration is so classical and comfortable that you think you are in the Swiss. 

For the locals, it is a must try so that you have a taste of swiss.

Author: mamalelizeekySingapore, Singapore
Title: Not the best in JB
Review: Food is slightly below average n staff is not the most friendly. Definitely can improve the standard of culinary skills n service. It's the first time I ever had potato salad that tasted like it had wasabi inside n doesn't hv the pleasant taste to it. Different but not refreshing.

Author: nemuaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quite disappointed
Review: Read a good review of the restaurant, so we went for a try in the evening. Unfortunately, they didn’t serve much cooked food to sample in the evening. Bbq cockles was not available though and disappointed with the food that we ordered on a la carte. Tom yam was not much seafood in it despite of the price. The rojak sotong taste so so. Probably shouldn’t go in the evening. Parking was ample and next to a mosque. I was being mindful of cat litter scattered and the smells was overwhelming. Eweeee.

Author: Gregory WMankato, Minnesota
Title: Affordable Food, Below Average Service
Review: I had the $10.90 rinngit special-- Thai tea, tom yam soup, friend rice, ice cream. The soup was cold, but I was fine with that b/c it was too spicey for my tongue. The main course was okay and served with watered down tea. The best part of the meal was the ice cream. The service was mediocre at best, may be they don't care b/c an automatic 10% is added to your bill for service with the total coming to $12.70. I would rate them higher if the waiter showed some interest and also came to check-in with me. Sadly, this was not the case. The place is clean.

Author: 434grahamiMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Average
Review: Took a fancy for a steak after a busy day and no lunch. Chicken wings starter (actually drumsticks) not spicy at all but ok. T bone for main, medium rare but was very fatty and slightly tough probably worst steak I've had. Service was swift but they did that annoying thing of serving the main when you are half way through starter. Wouldn't recommend it to be honest and won't be going back.

Author: VicchuahPoint Cook, Australia
Title: Poor quality food, price different from that shown on the menu.
Review: Poor quality food and the price on our bill for our lunch sets was more than that which is shown on the menu although supposed to be 0% gst. The Hainanese chicken chop and nasi lemak was worse than the one I had before at a open air food court. You can get a better chicken chop at any road side food court in KL or Melaka.I expected Tappers food to be of much better quality. And something to take note of is that the price on our final bill is different and much higher from that on the menu (we ordered lunch sets inclusive of drinks). This is price before their 10% service charge and 0% gst.

Author: vikneshbmwPort Dickson, Malaysia
Title: The worse chicken rice ball in melaka . Don't go.
Review: This shop previously is the famous chicken rice ball shop. . But nowdays the worse . The chicken is tasteless, rice ball not hot at all ,its chill . And the price like eating gold. . Very small portion. Terrible shop. Not even have place to sit relax and eat becouz ppl are q to come thia shop. Im sure all of them are new to this shop. . Please avoid this shop. You giys can fine more better rice ball shops in melaka city and jonker.

Author: Catherinelai27
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: Foods taste yummy & delicious , environment in good view and specially their service staff (Jacob)...👍🏼👍🏼

Author: ThermoprofessorJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Kacang pool Haji – Much ado about something
Review: Living in Johor Bahru for more than 10 years, I had no idea about the supposedly JB signature dish until I heard friends/visitors hyped about the dish. My husband insisted that it’s the Egyptians’ poor people staple food – he has stayed there for 1 year. I finally tried it last week – at RM6, it’s not exactly a poor man’s kind of breakfast! A bowl of mushy pool beans dish (probably grinded not boiled till soft, like the Egyptian’s dish) with a fried egg on top – now, that’s a Malaysian addition. Eaten with a thick slice of bread, it is quite filling to last me through lunch actually. Good to try once but not for me to return.

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A refreshed view
Review: Been here many years ago. It was a CNY family reunion dinner and it was horrible. However, we were suppose to have a family lunch here and my uncle who is also a fussy eater suggested here. With hesitation ... I agree and even asked my Aunty who had that same horrible dinner with me. I guess things changed ... Was surprised at the food served. The pork with the bun was lovely. The best was the fish head curry ! A must try. Impressed with it and look forward to coming back. Sorry no picture.

Author: kevin777davidKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and even poorer quality of food
Review: Came here with my family for dinner. Waited at the entrance to be seated but nobody approached us. Waiters were no where to be seen until we approached the staff at the bar/counter area. Staff was unpleasant and seemed like we were inconveniencing them with our presence. Even after being seated and given the menu, nobody came to take our order. After a full five minutes of waiting, we went to the bar again and someone called for a waiter. We noticed another family next to us having a difficult time getting the waiter's attention. The waiter was not friendly and didn't bother explaining the dishes on the menu. He was just waiting to take the order and disappear into the kitchen againWhen the food finally arrived, it was a bigger disappoinment. The soup was bland and the dishes didn't taste good. Being someone who frequents Italian food, I can tell you, this was below the average standard. Nobody in my family enjoyed their food and I even tasted their dishes to be sure. The cooks either have no idea how Italian food is supposed to taste or are not bothered.I'm surprised why they even bothered charging Service Tax when there was hardly any service. Seems like they are aware that they are cheating their customers but don't seem to mind.My honest advise is spend another 3 minutes driving to 'DV'. It's another Italian restaurant in the middle of Bukit Damansara with excellent service, amazing, authentic Italian food and parking shouldn't be a problem. The price is around the same and you will leave satisfied. Your family deserves the best and your money's worth.

Author: 590Sandra
Title: Worth a try
Review: Cheap ie RM40 for 2. Spartan atmosphere. Basic service. Wide range of dishes. Mixed vegetable curry recommended.

Author: sussexrowmarkRye, United Kingdom
Title: a characterful place for a meal
Review: We walked here from our hotel just outside Chinatown and wished we had not - the car is king in KL and roads are difficult to cross. The ambience of the restaurant did not disappoint, plenty of atmosphere. Do not expect great comfort or particularly great food, but our meal was certainly tasty and we would return if back in the city again. House wine was off, as it usually seems to be in Malaysia, but cheaper and more expensive options were available.

Author: Vishnu R
Title: perfect place for a date
Review: Called in to reserve a table and mentioned private table for 2. They totally understood and gave me the perfect corner seat table. Food was excellent, wine list was better. Thumbs up. Highly recommended. Cheers guys!

Author: DavitowalkerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great atmosphere
Review: Nice change and touch to the 'heritage' environment. The decor still boast a heritage sense but in a simple, chic and modern way. They focused more on the food, drinks and service which is the right thing to do and they did it great! Have a quick drink there to break away from the monotony of styles throughout Georgetown.

Author: Sharlene X
Title: Stir fry Assam Laksa is special
Review: Onde-onde serves local Malaysian Food. One thing in the menu that attracts locals like me is the stir-fry assam laksa. Give it a try!

Author: MisterM_TA
Title: A last resort destination
Review:
The buffet is extremely expensive for a choice of foods clearly not aligned with the price...
Avoid if you can.
Plus the breakfast served is far from great even though it remains acceptable.

Author: lavanian2014
Title: Overrated
Review:
Food is tasteless, service is below average.

Waiters were annoyed whenever we ask for our curry or drinks. Not many choices of curry for a banana leaf and they are not happy to serve us when we ask for a top up.

Author: Shaima D
Title: the worst service ever experienced
Review: expected so much from this place bt unfortunately we felt like we were doing them a favour by eating there. firstly stood at the entrance with the manager/cashier not even greeting us altho we had a reservation. only after 15min we wer even attended to because he seemed too busy cashing bills. just a simple hello welcome and i will attend to u shortly wud have sufficed. after that th food ws js dumped onto th table. the waiter didnt suggest anythin t order. th food ws very good- i will giv credit where its due i enjoyd the food. there was just no personal touch or friendly service. th desert menu was asked for 4 times before handed t us. the desert thn came 40mins later- that too ws js kulfi icecream. it was also the best kulfi id eaten. i would sum up this place to say th food ws definately worth it- just not worth the way u r made to feel there.

Author: gumtree10London, United Kingdom
Title: Very Nice
Review: I have been back to Il Bacaro, and again I was very impressed, Penang is starved of GOOD places to eat food that is not Asian; Il Bacaro is filling the gap, my pasta was good and innovative, representing Italian food of Today rather than Italian food of 20 years ago.The pizza was very good and my Italian friends loved it.I will be back again

Author: hognerakSingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor service and food
Review: Three of us were squeezed at a table meant for two. Ordered 2 sets of the afternoon tea and the server had problems placing the tea sets and asked us for the solution. He then proposed to serve one set later due to the lack of space. We ended up having to shuffle the cutlery and tea pots for him to place the food items. Sandwiches and muffins were ice cold when served, most likely due to the strong air-con. Muffins were really dry, and sandwiches were substandard. Hot water was not refillable for the tea.Even payment was slow, we waited for 15 mins before the bill was given, and it was given to the wrong table! With this kind of service and food quality, we will not be going back again.

Author: MalaysiaMinkyMalaysia
Title: poor service , over price
Review: one gets pretty attracted by its design but disappointment sets in as soon as you ask for a table. Service personnel offer very poor service with foreign workers speaking with strong accent , hard to understandtea is without tea leaves thus one cannot control the strength of the tea you wish to have. Do these guys understand tea culture?

Author: Teo Y
Title: Poor coffee quality. A tourist trap
Review: The initial excitement to try out its coffee and other drinks turned out to be the worst decision of my life. Lousy coffee taste and the coconut I ordered could not have tasted worse. This cafe can only scam the western tourist,but not me. I would rather spend my money visiting the zoo than this cafe. My first and last visit. I urge travellers to try out other cafes in the vicinity rather than this cafe.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Dim Sum
Review: The dim sum are taste ordinary at reasonable price. Always crowded with tourists after 8am & required a wait for seat

Author: Storyteller610046
Title: My last time!
Review: Was there to celebrate my friend's birthday... wanted to order the set but was told by the rude male waiter that I have to take the set as it is.. even if I am allergic to one of the ingredient in it .. cannot be substituted...Food was quite good but service is deplorable for a 5 star restaurant... was told to go into kitchen to key in my PIN number when making payment!!! Was stared at by the few kitchen staff... That said male waiter won't even suggest an alternative way for me to pay...even though I need walking aid, I was told to go inside kitchen .. (with steps!)...to key in pin..The ladies waiting on us were friendly but this male waiter takes the cake for being unfriendly and rude!

Author: louisteo9Sarawak, Malaysia
Title: Lukewarm Services but great food
Review: Roast duck, seafood fried rice and Yong Chow fried rice were amazing. However, I find the soup of the day to be very disappointing: portion- and taste-wise, it wasn't worth RM32. I also wish the hotel manager had been less lukewarm in receiving us at the door. I would come back again for the food, definitely.

Author: Lulubelle75Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Will no longer be a regular customer. Highly disappointing!
Review: My family and I have been regular customers of Jyu Raku for several years and we have always found the food to be delicious and value for money. Even many Japanese themselves were regulars, attesting to the quality of food.However, our most recent visit (after a hiatus of half a year) proved highly disappointing. Last year we found their yee sang, served only during Chinese New Year, one of the best in town with an abundance of fresh ingredients. This year? A paltry few pieces of salmon served with a mixture of wakame, salad, and 80% of the dish comprising what I would refer to as uncooked vermicelli!The soft shell crab temaki was bland, the unagi roll was mushy, the chicken katsu curry was much much worse than what chain outlet Yoshinoya serves up, and the beef teppanyaki came medium rare and soaked in sauce that was too salty.Unfortunately for them, they have just lost a regular customer.

Author: Rach456_13Singapore, null, Singapore
Title: Long waiting time even wih earlier reservation and ordered.
Review: Heard very good comment of the delicious food. My friends was there around 7.30pm and waited till 8.38pm yet the food still not yet serve. I was very disappointed with such lousy service. I've helped my friends to call for reservation and even ordered the food we wanted to eat for dinner. Ended up the restaurant gave them stupid reason of order mixed up? This is unacceptable for F&B line. No matter how nice the delicious the food they can prepare but I would real,y banned this restaurant for such lousy service.

Author: Mary T
Title: Awesome food and ambiance
Review: Farm Bistro exceeded my expectations when it delivered great food in a comfortable and welcoming setting which my guests of over 40 pax thoroughly enjoyed. Friends and family from New York, Australia, Singapore, KL, Seremban and Penang truly appreciated the good service provided by the friendly staff. Credit must be given to the manager, Anthony who was instrumental in ensuring that all went well with lots of good wholesome and delicious food which was enjoyed by all. Looking forward to future visits the next time I am in Kuching.

Author: nuruldean
Title: Okay
Review: Char Kuey Teow were not really kicking but it was acceptable to my tastebud. But I would love to come again to try other menu.

Author: brunonityaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Cosy
Review: This place has a really cosy atmosphere. The prices on the menu is a little bit more on the higher end. I came here once hearing that this place was really good for a datenight. It lived up to its standards. Definetely worth it if you are looking for something exclusive. Price wise its somewhere you go only REALLY IMPORTANT occasions. Food was average. Cant say i have tried all though.

Author: matthewjordisonGateshead, United Kingdom
Title: What a gem!
Review: Wow, what a gem this place is! Nestled in an active area but one certainly lacking in drinking options, you find this place! Greeted by both the host & the hostess with the mostess!A casual community hub for a good laugh in any language, with drinks that tbh didn't even dent the pocket.Really great time, and next time I will try the food and the see more of that River view!Great place

Author: Replacart
Title: Bit expensive
Review: Anything not street food in Penang is pretty expensive. But relative to western it's cheap. Smoothies are a lovely change

Author: V-NithishZ L
Title: Farquhar Mansion High Tea
Review: Delicious menu.. Love the Fruity White Tea.. Well treated and friendly staffs.. Peaceful environment with good music..

Author: satanbugAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Breakfast only.....
Review: We stopped in just for breakfast based on all the positive reviews. The Hotel itself is sat on the beach with a really nice outdoor area, pool, bar and dining facilities. The breakfast buffet was a little short of inspiration but the a la carte choice was good and my food was excellent. Enjoy.......
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: tripreview777Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Variety for Breakfast
Review: The Breakfast was amazing because of it's variety. The range is the widest i have seen! Coffee is too strong but there are always variety of drinks served, even fresh fruit juices. The Chinese section is not up to standard e.g. dim sum was not good at all. The porridge was good but not the range of chinese dishes. The best range is still the Malay and Indian cuisines, except no local drinks like teh halia or teh tarik. But the nice thing about it was when we requested for it, the waiter was quick to get the chef to make them specially of us! That's great service!! i wished there was a toaster that customers could toast the croissants rather than make us eat them cold. They should know they taste better toasted or warmed. But only breads are allowed to be toasted.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: AZLeeMalaysia
Title: Discriminatory service
Review: Did someone say he found the service / quality vastly different between a la carte and buffet? Well, I had similar experience too.First time I went was a business lunch with clients. The wait staff were attentive, even the captain himself came to serve us. When our individual plates were empty, the captain himself came to replenish our individual plates, from the noodles on the main plate (we were more occupied with our business discussions). But what a difference when I went with family for Sunday brunch! The captain did not bother to come near any of the tables, we waited at the entrance for a long time expecting to be shown to a table but no one approached us. Finally I had to approach the cashier to enquire if we could just walk in and sit at any table we liked (which is of course not what a 'fine-dining' restaurant should be!). When we needed to order or request for anything, we had to wave our hands many times before any of the wait staff would look our way, After patrons left, tables were left uncleared for some time. Did they call themselves a fine-dining restaurant?? Probably for the business clientele they are, but not to others!

Author: Chern Wei T
Title: Christmas Dinner Encounter
Review: been here 4 - 5 times, mostly for friends' gathering annually during Christmas when they serve special dinner set (4 course I think). there wasn't any wow-factor thru out the night.12 of us, a kid broke a small sorbet cup (accidentally of course) since they left them on some chairs beside our table after we have had the sorbet.felt apologetic and suggested to pay for their loss since the person in charge told us that it's very hard to get hold of such kind of cup nowadays.total bill was RM3,900 or so, RM50 for the cup before adding in 6% tax & 10% service charge.

Author: 50LouiseCLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best experience of our KL trip
Review: This was a brilliant experience and great value for money (about a fifth of the price that it is in London - and with very good quality food in KL - unlike London!). We enjoyed the whole experience from beginning to end due to the fantastic staff and thought that has gone into every step and dish. We were there for two hours. We guessed about 30% of what we were eating - our minds were tricked by many of the textures! Our waiter (Radha) was brilliant (all of the waiting staff are visually impaired - this was just a small insight into what that means every day). Food was excellent quality which I didn't expect and I was very full at the end. It's four courses and each course is split into up to five dishes.If you book online (just google dining in the dark KL) there is a discount so I would recommend doing this.Don't miss this experience if you are in KL - you won't get it at the price or quality anywhere else in the world P.s. I thought I might be scared of the dark - but this wasn't an issue at all! Relaxing music and your own personal waiter makes you feel very comfortable!

Author: CL L
Title: Good service and quite good variety
Review: Very accessible at old klang road with good ambience.  Service is OK with some variety of food not seen in others restaurant.  Price is slightly pricey and taste is not exceptional. Worth to try for once

Author: SaudiArabia1002Saudi Arabia
Title: Noisy, busy, popular, don't miss it
Review: This is were the locals and their familites eat, its noisy, busy and crowded but fantastic. Metal tables and chairs don't be shy order lots don't think you will be disappointed, try new things or look, point and order what fun. Cannot imagine anything is not good, have fun.

Author: heyjudes123
Title: Flavorful Korean food
Review: Very nice decor and seating, and the food itself was excellent (: Serve staff were very prompt and enthusiastic, though the waiting time for food is slightly long.
