Author: Stellina_and_SoleGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Read the reviews, experienced the place, will not be back!
Review: Read great reviews on the place.Had the Dover Sole and barracuda. The Dover sole was delicious but the other choice was only average.Service wasn't that great - even with restaurant only 30% full.Utterly disappointing was the wine. Has the muscadet, tasted watered down. Poured at table to taste but served were pre-poured glasses.Very steep prices for the experience. Will not be back.

Author: meaningremission
Title: Reasonably Japanese cuisine in Subang
Review: Subang Jaya is a haven for Japanese restaurant and this is one of the few decent and reasonably priced restaurant. The kitchen in manned by Nakajima san and there are plenty of choice, from set bento to normal ala carte menu.

Author: Andy C
Title: Great ambiance
Review: Good environment for all kinds of functions. Tried their mushroom in the jungle and it's surprisingly flavorful with a hinge of truffle oil though a little bit more oil would be preferred.

Author: allele_12Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Al Tanoor by Tarbush, Pavilion KL
Review: My first time, and last time. Sadly, this is becoming the standard in KL: Restaurant 80% empty, with no more than 2-3 tables occupied. We ordered some simple food and basic ice teas. For the next 20 minutes: Nothing. Not even the drinks coming. Our irritation and regret kept growing. Also, the Arab manager who too our order was the strong, silent type - silent treatment, no eye contact, our questions answered with one-word whispers. No "good afternoon", no "see you next time", nothing. (To be fair, this is the treatment he gave to all guests - Asian, Western, Middle Eastern - so at least he's not racist, I guess.) The bill for what was really just a quick mid-afternoon snack for two came to almost 100 ringgit. My verdict: Overpriced; remarkably unfriendly; and VERY slow.

Author: mymahe
Title: Great ambience, great location and awesome food
Review: Every time we have been there our signature order is hummus beiruti and pita bread along with french fries

Author: greenberry520
Title: getting poor
Review:
the food standard is getting poor. 
pasta was bland. pork chop was hard.
really a big difference compared to first visit
the restaurant was only opened not long ago but the standard drop so fast

Author: SarahClarke1702
Title: Awesome
Review: We had an awesome dinner in here! The chicken was excellent the same was dessert! We really enjoyed it!

Author: Leonj59Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good enough
Review: Easy to recommend. This is good malay food. Lots of 'lemak' (coconut) dishes and the majority are tasty. The chicken chili padi and potato cutlet deserve special mention. Good number of veg dishes too. Saturdays only see alacarte so that's a shame. The prices are on the high side when compared to similar shops. But it is good food.

Author: kochi188
Title: Overrated chicken
Review: What a disappointment! It's not even delicious... Just salty and mild herbal taste. Won't buy again.

Author: JutishaKuching, Sarawak, Malaysia
Title: Had upset stomach on our last 2 visits here
Review: This place used to be good for their seafood & pork dishes. But the last two visits were disappointing - I & my husband had stomach upset. Both the squid in dried chilly & chicken in bamboo had funny smell. Their seafood fried rice, which was once a favorite had tasted different from what we used to order. I hope the management can look into improving their food.

Author: Eric TKuala Lumpur
Title: Sometimes OK, sometimes bad
Review: I eat here every now and then - and I found out that the quality of the food is mixed.I think i all started with the increased use of the Myanmar refugees as the chefs and servers. Since then, I have seen less local chefs and till recently - no local chefs at all, but Myanmar refugees preparing and cooking all food.The quality is average at best, if not then it is really bad. I am very disappointed to see the entire restaurant chain go down the drain to save themselves a few dollars.

Author: VananKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonder if this is really a thai restaurant
Review: The place looks promising from the photos published in the websites and it was rated good. I planned to celebrate my wife birthday with a private dining at this restaurant. They have a room called 'the chalet' for private dining. I made reservation thru table app and sent an email to confirm on the reservation. I was told the chalet will cost additional RM150 and i confirmed the reservation and taken note by the staff. When i was at the restaurant, they only reserve a table for 5 person not the chalet. I showed them the confirmation email and requested the chalet. Again they remind me additional cost of RM150 for the chalet. I insist them for the chalet and it took 15 minutes for them to get the chalet ready yet the curtain was missing.The best part of the restaurant are the environment, location and the settings. The food is below the average. I've tried thai food at many restaurants and this is the worst one. I just wonder if they really serve thai cuisine here. The food are served in small portion and not worth the price charged. They promise to me a complimentary dessert for birthday celebration but did not serve it. Well, this is not a place for thai cuisine indeed!

Author: channil2017
Title: Great!
Review: Even though it might seem unsanitary for Western standards food is very good and more than priceworthy. I mean 3 Euros for a meal? And you can drink out of a coconut!😍

Author: lucasis
Title: Stupid waiter
Review: Please don't use Clorox to wipe your table & chair. I just throw away one of my short pants because I sit there waiting for my tapao 😡 I throw away my tapao too, too angry.

Author: haidanur7Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Tasteless Food
Review: Hi,my housemates and I went here to have a dinner.We ordered maggi goreng, rojak, roti tisu and sup kambing. Sorry to say this but the tastes of the food are not up to our expectation especially the maggi goreng and rojak (the gravy is tasteless) but the sup kambing and roti tisu are acceptable.Hope Nasi Kandar Pelita can improve the quality of the food,Thank you.

Author: Jlmtd
Title: Typical of every Hard Rock
Review:
Hard Rock is abig worldwide brand. You get the same here as everywhere else in the world.
Service friendly, food is standard western.

Author: Chris3669London, United Kingdom
Title: Very small portion :( and taste average
Review: The food taste was average, the portion is really small. We ordered 5 dishes and 2 bowl of rice with total bill RM170++, sharing with 3 person. But we were not full, I will suggest to go somewhere else.

Author: Shawn O
Title: Aunthentic jap  food?
Review: Very fresh food served but unfortunately food is very localize. If you are looking for somethIng halal but don't mind a Malaysian like cooking while paying prices equivalent to real jap food go ahead.

Author: Hermionehy
Title: Too dark
Review: Inside shop is dark and when they service my ayam bakar also over cook. So the chicken is dark too 🤣🤣. I only know I'm eating ayam bakar (BBQ chicken) haha.

Author: Livenow88
Title: Nice atmosphere but the outside is...
Review: Nice atmosphere but the outside is terrible! Prices are steep. Still don't want to go to a restaurant where I feel like I'm about to be mugged.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: Malim27Swindon, United Kingdom
Title: If you want to play at pretentious...make sure you do it right!
Review: This place tries hard to provide high-end cuisine in a sophisticated atmosphere. This also includes eye watering prices for average fayre. Steak was OK…poor if you account for the price. Cutting the meat at the table and then returning to the kitchen to plate it up…on cold plates resulted in guess what…cold food!! All that fancy play acting and carving, only to eventually delivering a poor result. Service again is lacking and patchy. Sometimes it was overbearing, other times non existent. Note to restaurant…if you are going to be fancy…do it right! Atmosphere does not mean just dimming the lights. I cannot for the life of me understand the previous glowing reports. Maybe we ate during an off-night…although I don’t think so.

Author: ShirlzB52Surfers Paradise, Australia
Title: Happy Hour
Review: Happy Hour from 4pm-9pm is the best value. Excellent margaritas, yummy chicken wings with chilli sauce really satisfies the afternoon munchies. Great service from staff, very friendly, good spot on the verandah to people watch. Even saw antics from a family of monkeys that live in the trees across the road. Good mix of music as to be expected from Hard Rock.

Author: EricLogaKlang, Malaysia
Title: Visit if u don mine the shocking humiliation....
Review: Im giving the worst service award to Garam Masala Klang Restaurant of 2014. Humiliation what a best service a customer can have and a justification by the manager. The way the handle the customer with unprofessional attitude, asking the customer to shift table once seated and given menu card. Just because somebody called for reservation. Totally idiotic.

Author: Westiekhoo
Title: Great food!
Review: Been around for a long time. This restaurant presents a surprisingly varied menu each time you go. The roast pork is a must! Do book before you go if you want to miss the long lines of waiting.

Author: SteDfPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It should be called Betty's Sugarhouse
Review: Apart from the rudness shown to my friend, who was waiting for me, the food was terrible, everything tasted the same, and to be more precise, everything tasted of sugar. If that is not enough, my "Pulled Burger" came with the "pulled" but the "burger" part was missing. As a note, I also found a bit strange that on top the open view kitchen there was a sign saying that taking photos of the kitchen was not allowed. Mhmm weird ... I don't plan to return.

Author: LoveF179
Title: Poor Pizza quality!!
Review: Been invited by friend to eat pizza there. It was a busy night and so was terrible to place our order since all waitress were walking around and no one noticed us. We got to order with a guy (BTW very good waiter) and we received our pizzas, sadly it was not as good as we thought. Toppings were good, but pizza it self (and I mean the dough) was awful, just like a bread, not crunchy, not crispy and not thin like a good Italian pizza should be. If you like bread looking like a pizza go ahead, if you look for italian pizza I won't recommend this place.

Author: DaveThompson16Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Nice decor, decent service, below par food
Review: I wasn’t too impressed with the quality of the food, although I went as part of an event so it was a set menu that I wouldn’t ordinarily have chosen myself. General comments... the som tam was tasteless, soft shelled crab had a raw crunchy vegetable that didn’t quite work, the tom yum was generic, the fried fish was a mass of bones, the meat in the duck curry was desperately over cooked. Oh yes, to be fair, the mango sticky rice was good. However, the premises are very nice and relaxing, and the staff were friendly and attentive. I had the impression that the kitchen was a bit stressed. Not really my sort of thing, but each to his own.

Author: dazarina83
Title: Birthday Lunch
Review: Everything here is awesome..the food, the ambience was lovely, good service by Kyle..will definitely come again

Author: MattVonOelhafenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A steady decline....needs a wake-up call....
Review: We've been regular patrons since about 4 years. The quality and taste of the dishes has been unfortunately not very good as of late.The starters were presented on a thick bed of lettuce which is a waste and also distracts the presentation of the dishes.The main dishes were a big disappointment - the pork fillet was pan fried without any sauce and 4-5 fried slices of Zucchini. No sauce. Dry meat. Sad to eat and to behold.The Aglio & Olio spaghetti were NOT al dente they were still half raw.The Scaloppa alla Romana consisted of three wafer thin slices -literally less than 10mm thick- and of course were bone dry. Rather serve one scaloppa but make it meaningful rather than three quick cooked slices of meat. The spinach was bland - no salt and pepper. The presentation of all dishes was primitive and it looked rather a quick serve restaurant than an Italian dining restaurant.Very disappointing when one realises HOW GOOD this restaurant once was.The food quality is one big disappointment.The one star I'm giving is only because at least the waitress tried to save a lost cause namely the kitchen.

Author: Sumartok
Title: Taste the original malaysian food
Review: Food is awesome.  It give you real taste of malaysian food with affordable price.  The service is also good, waiters and food come timely.  I come here twice during my visit to Kuala Lumpur last time.

Author: ApeepCork, Ireland
Title: Sloppy.
Review: Had my breakfast there, the food was good. However, the quality went down further from time to time. I'm not sure why, but 24th Dec morning wasn't a great morning to have breakfast there.

Author: FutureproofDormansland, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to eat
Review: This cafe was fairly pricey by Malaysian standards but if you are looking for a break in eating Malaysian food this place is for you.Staff were friendly and were happy to make recommendations. Not that well catered for vegetarians, but I was talked into trying the veggie curry which I did not regret.

Author: petite_rainbowMelbourne, Australia
Title: Just an average lunch
Review: Service is slow, maybe due to lunch hour. I came to the restaurant at 11.30 am (not lunch hour yet) and it was a full 15 minutes before the service staff came to my table and that because she was giving menus to another customer that she saw me. Another service staff came to take my order and he was friendly and repeated our order to get it right. When it was time to go, we couldn't get the attention of the service staff, so we walked to the cashier to pay her.

Author: YNL127
Title: Over rated with poor service
Review: Went there with relatives. Food was just average and the staff were so arrogant.  Tasted better food on the road side. Not a place I would go again if I had the choice.

Author: The_Miri_EpicureMiri, Malaysia
Title: Ridiculously overpriced
Review: A group of us visited with a business partner treating.Live seafood is selected from holding tanks and then cooked to your requirements (e.g. steamed, ginger, curry etc)The decor is good. Service ok.Food was average but the bill was astronomical.This place lives on its "showboat" reputation in my opinion and that is how they justify their ridiculous prices.

Author: Neil912Singapore, Singapore
Title: CNY Menu Over Pricing
Review: Chinese New Year menu extremely over pricing. Food quality no longer as good as last time we had at old shop. Overall restaurant outlook is good but the quality of food does not match the price and not really worth to dine in here compare to other restaurants in Melaka Raya. My guests were not very happy with the dining experiences at all. Hope they could improve the quality of food.

Author: Benjamin K
Title: Very disappointed
Review: Been here many times before, my last visit was almost a year back with my family. We came here for a good dim sum brunch knowing they serve excellent dim sum only to go back disappointed. They don’t taste as good, in fact they don’t taste good at all and the dim sums have gotten smaller. The siew mai used to have an abalone on it but now there is only mushroom. It’s totally not worth it to come here and pay full price or even with discounts( I got a 40% discount because of CIMB’s credit card). Seems like they are on a cost cutting path. I posted a picture of the receipt as proof I came here. Also cappuccino was hopeless. It’s much better to get an artisanal cuppa from outside at half the price. At the end when I complained, the staff just brushed it off with pleasentries.Sorry for not taking pictures of the food (they don’t deserve to be posted anyways)

Author: ta816Asia
Title: Lack of quality
Review: Read so much about the buffet dinner unfortunately just doesn’t hold up to the hype. Was there for Wednesday buffet dinner and couldn’t even find any quality seafood apart from mussels and mussels and more mussels! The only dish with passable shrimps was the coconut shrimps. Not even cold shrimps!The grill sections only has Turkey understandable since it is festive season after all. But what about roast duck or lamb? Grill fish? Not in sight.Usually even at lower category buffet dinner you will find few soups choices. There were none. Only one we found in front of the noodle section that wasn’t labelled and it was way too salty. Guess maybe it wasn’t for guests but soup base for the noodle?We were there for breakfast too and let’s just say it didn’t fare better than the dinner. Just wasn’t sure if this the standard of buffets in KL maybe?

Author: wkh0409Singapore, Singapore
Title: Business Dinner
Review: I must said this place really impressed me a lots. Food is delicious and the service is good. One can enjoy the KL building lighting while enjoying your dinner. We were here for business dinner and we noticed lots if foreigners coming here for dinner which mean this place must be very popular. I strongly recommend to give this restaurant a try when in KL. Fried bee hoon with crab is awesome.

Author: izzatizakiMalaysia
Title: An awesome experience!
Review: We went for my sister's birthday lunch today. Initially was a bit disappointed when they release our table after we did not arrive within 15 minutes from the booking time. However, things started to get better when they promised to give us a bigger table after the group lunch finish. Yup, they really did fulfill their promises. We moved to a bigger table and they help us to bring over our food. Ms. Noramiza was very helpful in taking our order and explain very well. Not to forget Mr. Zamzuri (I hope I got his name correct) and Mr. Sulaiman were very cheerful and made our whole time there feel like home. I should also give Ms. Najla'a a compliment by ensuring that the birthday surprise works like how I want it to be in the email. Thank you so much for these awesome experience we had today. Thanks for the signature cake from Thirty8, the birthday gift for my sister and everything! Definitely will come again.

Author: hannajomeansMalaysia
Title: Outstanding service from start to finish
Review: The food was good (not the best I've ever had), but definitely good!! The service was outstanding. The atmosphere is laid back and open air. There are many good choices on the menu. It's hidden off a back alley behind the main street, but worth it.

Author: Justin FLas Vegas, Nevada
Title: One word - Soccer
Review: This is our first time here. It was raining so we thought we check this place out. Ordered our dinner with a pint of beer and guiness. All was well until the staff started playing football aka soccer on TV that's really loud. I want to eat and have a conversation NOT have a hundred ringgit TV dinner. Disappointed with this "award winning" restaurant. You don't see Gordon Ramsay play English Premier League in his restaurant.

Author: bentong66Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Oh, how they have fallen.
Review: We've been going to La Risata in Medan Damansara, KL on and off for years, and it has been consistently good, though it was truly excellent when it used to be just a little single shoplot. But even after it expanded it remained pretty good, until now.Four of us had dinner there two Fridays ago. The place was packed, which we thought a good sign and service was ever-present. We were quickly seated, despite not having a reservation, and drinks came quickly. Our dinner companions who had already arrived warned us not to order the draft beers as "they taste really awful" so we went with the house wine instead, which was okay. We ordered a pizza to share as a starter, along with the aubergine starter. The pizza was excellent; the aubergine not.But the main courses were the main disasters. I ordered the lamb shank, which was truly bad. The sauce had obviously been made separately from the meat; the meat had been boiled in what must have been plain water and then plated up with the sauce. The meat was watery, tasteless and hardly fell off the bone, the way a true lamb shank would. The sauce was plain brown sauce with water added, and with four (yes, exactly four) tiny slivers of carrot. Absolutely nothing else. It couldn't be eaten at all, and I had to order a serving of plain bread to stave off hunger pangs.My dinner companions order a rib eye (pale, rubbery and tasteless) and the house special pasta, which tasted okay but was hardly anything to shout about. The sad thing was despite the ever-present service staff who came quickly enough to clear our plates, not one asked us how come we had so much food left on our plates. Which tells me that no one in La Risata really cares.And that's a real shame, considering how highly this restaurant used to be regarded.

Author: LorenP247
Title: Must try!
Review: Crispy, delicious and really inexpensive! I would have ordered but we also ordered few other dishes so we had more than enough food for 2 adults and 1 kid. :)

Author: SabrinBediKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Crab Resam !!!!
Review: Firstly not every indian restaurant has crab resam (soup with spices).. and when you find a place that serves it and it's darn good.. u should share...I highly recommend this.. and the other food on the menu is pretty standard. It caters both veg and non veg food. Services at this outlet can be a bit slow, so be ready to wait.. The tea is average and the kesri (sweet sticky pudding) is really nice..

Author: chickabigpond
Title: not for me
Review: sorry not for me middle eastern food is not the type of food i like and i thought the service was poor food seemed costly as compared to other good restaurants

Author: sarnavinaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Hospitality
Review: Having lived in Germany, I forgot what hospitality feels like.Le Meridian hotel staff and the Latest Recipe staff are just amazing.Special shout out to Giri, Poobhil and the entire Latest Recipe restaurant team for looking after me and my mum You'll see us again very soon.

Author: anisibrahim
Title: halal or pork free?
Review: is this restaurant really certified halal by jakim or pork free.. pls anyone answer.. i would like to go . we like chinese food..

Author: Belinda H
Title: Best Burgers and we are Aussie. We know our burgers!
Review:
To our surprise,  best cheese burgers we've ever had!
And, like all the food in Malaysia it was cheap!

Author: grevichMalaysia
Title: another sorry attempt at first world food by third word muppets
Review: price is high, coffee takes forever for them to make and then arrives barely warm in tiny little cups for starbucks prices. need 3 of them to equal 1 normal serving. hash brown is frozen patty they buy from outside that they heat up like one you get at mcdonalds. eggs were good but that doesnt take a college degree to get right. lots of service staff standing around but all useless as usual in malaysia.

Author: puspanathanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good lunch great Hainanese food
Review: I walked in for lunch. Ordering was easy. The drinks arrived very quickly. We orders mainly hainanese food. I had Hainanese Chicken Chop which was great. The sauce was unique not the usual brown HP based sauce.My daughter had Salted egg chicken rice. A first for us. It was very tasty. My wife had Honey Chili Chicken rice also a great tasting dish. The portions were big the price reasonable. The wait staff were very helpful. Certainly would come again.

Author: rloganathankuala lumpur
Title: Tasty and good service
Review: I went to this restaurant for dinner last night with my wife and in laws. The service was good I like the approach of getting the drinks first and then the food order. The chapathis here are fluffy and the gravies are good. The arrays of curries are many. Will surely go for makan at this place often. Only setback is the gravies are a bit pricey but tasty.

Author: NorniaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Capsul coffee for RM 20+
Review: I only had a cup of coffee at this place, but my cappuccino smelled and tasted like a capsule coffee and so did the latte my friend was having. I'd expect nothing less, but a freshly brewed coffee at such place.The view from the restaurant is indeed lovely and the staff were friendly (that's why I added one more star), but I didn't finish my cup of coffee...

Author: adriancckJurien Bay, Australia
Title: 1st Jan 2016 dinner
Review: The restaurant atmosphere has a good ambience and lighting in restaurant is adequate. There was accompanying pianist on the day we had dinner.Service was excellent ,however it was not clear of the menu how the charges per head include starters ,main course and dessert including coffee and starter drink are included. The food was a bit pricey for the food on what we ordered.The dishes we order was Otak Otak,spring roll of some kind, (crispy moo hoo char) with prawn , confit duck(Lok ark) veggie (Kerang) and sambal goreng n 2 dessert .Overall taste of all the food is not to local palette and the dishes we order had a sweet after taste on all the dishes.

Author: j wCalifornia City, California
Title: Has potential, but needs work
Review: The good - the interesting fusion decor, the court house facade, the generous portions, the location.The bad - service (amongst other things, we weren't told in advance that the credit card machines were out of order and we barely managed to throw together enough local currency to pay), no dessert on the menu.

Author: Tunching218Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just Mediocre
Review: What's the use of paying extra ( compared to lunch) for the ala carte dinner buffet if more than 20 dishes are not available? This place used to be our favorite Japanese buffet but our last visit was so disappointing. The salmon sashimi was also not fresh as though it had been put on ice for too long. I hope the owners or management will look into this.

Author: JoyLeeBooksKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don’t be the 1st few guests in the morning
Review: Yut Kee is my Sunday breakie place since childhood. Till now I frequented it and Yut Kee is always my top recommended place to my friends.But this morning as the first few guests of Yut Kee at 7.30am, my favourite Chicken Chop was probably the left over of yesterday. The gravy drenched over it was probably left over too and diluted by adding in water I think. It was tasteless. My friends told me many times that Yut Kee standard has dropped and now I do believe it. Maybe if I had come later like before it would be a different experience!

Author: samdesirous
Title: Too high expectation on it
Review: Cheap food in KL (not so cheap as well) but do not expect on the quality. Service is real bad due to their well known brand, you do not shout at the customer just because its crowded or whatsoever. Courtesy need to be improved. Environment is packed with people.

Author: Thomas A
Title: Reservation not honored.
Review: My colleagues and I had made reservation for an evening of dining. When we reached there unfortunately the indicated that their kitchen was under maintenance. Only serving pizzas, we were told. Duh!Could have just called us back to inform so that we did need to travel all the way there to find out.Disappointed to say the least.

Author: Patricktay73Singapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner
Review: Have a dinner at 4fingers chicken at berjaya times square on 8.12.19. Disappointed with the service as well as the management. As a well estabalish fast food outlets, I was disappointed when I wanted to order some items from their menu like French fries and Kim chi and they tell me they out of stock. And it is only 5 plus. The manager say oh the supplier got issues so no Kim chi and fries. So, I tell them you are lucky the chicken supplier got no issue if not 4fingers chicken also got no chicken to sell.

Author: Lloydness
Title: Delicious and cheap
Review: Delicious mexican feast! Honey was a great addition, always greeting us with a lil smile. We went multple times, wish we had one at home.

Author: Vallina31
Title: just fantastic
Review: you have to wait quite a lot.. but the dinner worths the waiting!! Suggestion: the summer rolls are just tasty and fabulous!!

Author: tomaaaaaatoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bad service attitude and not that cheap
Review: Settled for this because the other one was packed. Food was average, but the lead/boss attitude sucked.Ordered their "special" cheese prawn Mee Hoon. Taste was ok, but gelat (Malay for full because of a certain richness from oil/cheese/butter), prawns were 5 halves, not full prawns, so ingredients abit lacking. A green vegetables which was ok, and pork deep fried with fermented beans. Taste for pork was decent, but half the plate of pork was PURE FATS. Not even a shred of meat. When I brought this up, the lead/owner had the cheek to say, oh we serve the dish like this...(see picture of proof of the dish). If the service had been a tad better maybe they would wrangle a 3 out of me. There's a reason why there isn't a queue for this so called "restaurant" and I now understand why. Damage was 75rm.

Author: MartynC_HKHong Kong, China
Title: I thought it was OK. My wife didn't...
Review: The MEw's cafe is very close to the Muntri Grove hotel where we stayed and we had dinner here the first night of our recent stay in Georgetown. I think this restaurant has the same owner as the Muntri. We ordered the spring rolls, the steamed sea bass with blue rice, chicken satayThis was a weird experience. My wife is Asian and a foodie. I am British and generally see food as something that stops me being hungry. Most of our arguments are food based. While this was not one of the best meals I have had I did enjoy the food and ate most of it myself. My wife went back to the hotel and had instant noodles....The saving grace for my wife was the singer who we both thought was very good.

Author: Jenny NSibu, Malaysia
Title: Not recommended at all
Review: Going for a business daytrip, seeing the cafe served roti canai, thinking this would be a good breakfast. Unfortunately, the waitress said no roti canai since no one is making it while I saw next table taking canai comfortably and I saw 3 trays of roti canai doh untouched yet one of the worker is making canai! Unsatisfied, I asked the canai worker whether he's available to make canai yet he said he's not doing it because too many requests n no staffs. This is absurd! 5 staffs walking here n there standing with nothing to do. Unfriendly staffs, bad services n forgetting orders so many times. Roti canai is one of the profitable morning breakfast, yet u are reluctant selling it, might as well you don't open in the morning anymore!

Author: BeachesAreBest123
Title: Ok, could be better
Review: Not like the Korean bar-b-q in NYC.  there were side dishes but not that many and the quality was not good. The beef was not well-marbled. Server was friendly. They should pick it up a notch.

Author: adamfazli
Title: Overall is fine
Review: Came here to celebrate friend birthday, and it was crowded.. food just fine. overall is good. its cozy place for me..

Author: ameyakamatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Interesting cocktails, Chinese menu and super ambience makes this a must ry
Review: very different experience from the usual pub grub beer experience. Opium has really spent tie constructing very interesting cocktails and food to go with it. While we sampled a lot of their cocktails. The kitchen closed by the time we got in so food choices were limited, maybe next time. The ambience has a different old world Chinese charm which adds to the experience.

Author: 980magnustWillesden, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food
Review: We were looking for a place with a good atmosphere and good food. Tek Sen delivered both. The restaurant was full, and we waited a couple minutes when we arrived for a late lunch. However, the staff was very polite and in a good mood.Restaurant feels clean. It has a great vibe, but you can still feel relaxed by your table. The food was really great, and service was excellent. A small minus for the toilet facilities. Overall: our best eating experience in George Town.

Author: MariaPetalingJayaPetaling Jaya
Title: Nice Ambiance Good Food
Review: A small resturant with French, western cuisine. The service is excellent, the bread out of this world, the food sometimes very good, sometimes not. The steak I had was good, the tartare I tried unfortunately a disaster, I had to sent it back. The soups are always very good, the salad disappointing. I will go there again despite some disappointment. Have been there a few times in the last few month, because friends like it very much. Maybe it was just my luck.

Author: jfjlawai
Title: Just excellent
Review: Great food. I would call it a fusion of Asian cuisines and a potpourri of western and creole variances. Very cozy and warm tropical decor. Like Balinese garden. Staff very knowledgeable and listen to their advice. Portions are huge but the food is just a big WOW. Drinks are great. No pricey at all if you consider the satisfying experience.

Author: Quilfaitbeau1601Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: horrible choice of music
Review: Service and food was good, but once the music starts, it's simply awful! I miss the good old HRC where rock was actually played. Only current popular music are played. I have given it many chances. Tonight is my last night ever. I have sworn off that damn place!

Author: shokolim
Title: never failed me
Review: each time i come back to kl its a must to visit either one of the shop.....after long tiring day of travelling a bowl of authentic hot soup noodle will ease all with friendly waitress n waiter....

Author: Traveltheworld99999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated, bad food quality & bad service
Review: Stay for a night and try out their buffet turned out a bad experience. Food selection is okay. Nothing wow us. Food quality seem very bad. Butter cream mussel overcooked, roast beef is tough, salad lettuce turn brown, dessert was okay. The only thing we like is cook to request pasta and the special request roti pisang.Service: was seated by the white jacket guy but nothing offer even water or beverage list. Waited 15 min and no water serve still, and we have to walk to a waiter and ask him serve us water. Ice cream counter lady seem rude: she said “just tell me what you like okay, easy for me”. I told her I want 2 chocolate ice cream in a cup and 1 green tea ice cream in another cup. She don’t really bother my request and put all in one bowl. Simple request and I don’t expect that from a well known hotel. Kitchen Staff playing handphone while on duty. Oh ya, only 3 waiters serving the entire restaurant. Poor management. Ambience: spacious seat and table. But overall is weird, I only heard noise from kitchen and no other background music. Price wasn’t bad, 115 per person. But experience and quality wasn’t impress us.

Author: firahkhirana
Title: Glad I came.
Review: Being in Malaysia is the best to have Chinese food, for me. I took a lot of the 'steamed' portion of the menu and I'm very impressed; how tiny sized dumplings could be so delicious. I would have ordered more honestly but let's save that for another day. I personally like eateries with quaint and chic interior, like this one. Makes the experience warm and memorable. Try to go off peak period, very serene.

Author: Sinag
Title: Bon adresse!!!
Review: I’ve had dinner here twice this year. I love the cosy, neighbourhood feel. Kitchen serves common french fare like foie gras, escargots, duck confit among other things. Servers are very helpful to suggest wine pairings.

Author: Philip I
Title: Traditional malaysian food
Review: Went here for dinner on recommendation by hotal.  worth the cab fare, long but nice menu and good service. Ladies toilet not pleasant though.

Author: Kecee28
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: Best shisha I have been tried in Malaysia, love the place, friendly staff good food, will come back again

Author: sorenbsdhaka
Title: Hide and seek
Review: If you have children aged less than six who like to play hide and seek while screaming loudly and playing with the food. If polite but annoying waiters is your thing. If you love Korean love music. If you think being told shorts is not appropriate and then arriving to a tourist trap where everyone is doing just that constitutes a good time. Then this place is for you.

Author: Joey L
Title: Cozy Place
Review: Nice place to hang out for cuppa of coffee and tea. Entire place fit about 60 pax at a time. Cozy environment for reading and some "me" time. Shall be back to try signature coffee.

Author: Doug KHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Lovely setting, lovely staff
Review: A little off the beaten track (about 70 meters to be precise) and definitely worth a visit. The atmosphere was fantastic, and the staff were very friendly and accommodating, offering advice on the menu and genuinely interested in what we had to say about the restaurant and our time in Malaysia. The food was amazing, and offered a chance to try some traditional Malaysian food for my vegetarian girlfriend which she was delighted about. Special mention should definitely go to the cocktails, which were only 18 ringgits, and were the best we had in our entire journey around Malaysia.

Author: gayathridevi1983Klang, Malaysia
Title: Indian Cuisine
Review: Hi, this is Gayathri, yesterday i went to the restaurant called garam masala north indian, some of my friends recommended me, i visited there and what i felt was like they had no water, oh god.!U running a restron without proper water, just for some money, am i right mr. owner..Second thing they have no proper staff as i easily realized, owner took my order, strange thing is when he came for order he was drunk, crazy man. My mom was with me, she angry on me that time, why gayathri u bring me here, no water no proper staff, owner drunk alrdy and taking orders, oh my god, pity on ppl.Hope sm1 take any action.

Author: Puven91
Title: Good service
Review: Excellent service and friendly staff. The food is excellent. I liked the environment too.Staff : I think I was attended by a foreign staff (can't recall her name). She was very welcoming and had good customer service skills. She had a big smile throughout her conversation with me.Food : I'm not a big fan of Asian food but I liked their food here. Their viatnamese Pho gai and pad Thai is a must try because it taste very similar to the actual dish when I had them back in Vietnam and Thailand respectively. Their butter chicken was a little sweeter than usual but I still liked it.Environment : perfect place to hang out after long working hours. It's quiet and the background music is soothing.

Author: castiel21Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Zero Quality
Review: It was one of our fav restaurants for our monthly family gathering but today it was over. We arranged a birthday party at the restaurant today. And make a proper reservation with one of the Indian staff there. The guy said all were in order and the restaurant would provide free small cake and balloons. We were really excited.We arrived around 12.30pm. the waiter (an indian/bangla) at the main entrance look confused when we informed him about our birthday party reservation. But he allowed us to enter.We ordered our food and asked again about the cakes and balloons. Another Bangla/indian waiter replied, they will prepared them shortly. But then the same waiter told us they can't arranged the balloons cause our seating area not suitable to put balloons? (was he joking?). He also without any expression told us infront of our birthday boy that no cake was available.They would replace it with a coconut jelly. Really a big joke. My son who was expecting a decent birthday party was really sad. No birthday cake. We had previously called them twice to confirm about the birthday cake and balloons, they promised all would be provided. Really an empty promises. Spoilt our birthday party.At 1.05pm, whilst we were having our food in sombre mood, we had received a call from the restaurant. It was the indian/bangla waiter at the main entrance. He asked us why we still not arrive or were we cancelling our birthday party lunch.Omg it's was really a bad joke. My wife simply responded that we were already having our lunch now and we complained about the poor arrangements.a nice female malay waiter tried to help us but still no birthday cake or balloons. A really bad customer service.Previously the restaurant was ok but now with a.bangla maintaining the maintenance entrance. It became really chaotic. None of the waiter said sorry.Worst experience. And this restaurant charged a "service charge" but Worst customer service.The gravy was too oily. We have decided the restaurant is no longer our one of our fav hang out place.The food was pricey but the services were a total disaster (low standard)Highly not recommended.

Author: Yanzer79
Title: Bad service
Review: Run by a bunch of ladies with bad services. They are no eye candy either... food is so so actually. Don’t really understand the big fuss. Lol.

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Complete disappointment and appalling service
Review: Complete disappointment and appalling service. Thats all how I can summarise this so called 5 star Italian restaurant. If you arrive early, they sit you on a couch thats more fit for a dentist's waiting room. We proceeded to the bar. You then get your table. We waited more than 35 minutes before they brought some appetiser, that we didnt order, which was tiny, limp, luke warm, and simply a waste of time. We then complained where were our starters and eventually, they came. Then, when I made it clear to one of the suit wearing waiters that we did not want to be kept waiting for the main course, his reply was "I heard you the first time". This restaurant is arrogant, completely over priced and full of pompous, self righteous waiters who need learn how to be professional. Never again will I bother with this disappointment of a restaurant.

Author: macbeathEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Perfectly good place to eat
Review: This restaurant is located next to the Bird Park and can be accessed from both inside the park and from the car park.It's perfectly clean, if a little crowded, inside, and the menu is a mix of local and western dishes, so there should be something for everyone. Price wise, it's a little more expensive than the similar food would cost you in a Mall foodcourt, but it's still cheap by UK standards. The service is also very fast and friendly and the food (char kwey teow and satay) was perfectly acceptable. It's also one of the few places to eat within the Lake Gardens unless you wander down to the more formal restaurant in the Islamic Art Museum or grab a taxi back into town.

Author: Frances M
Title: Small Living Room
Review: This restaurant was raved about by friends but we found it disappointing. Quite a small menu and curry so hot we had to choose and pay for something else.

Author: PinviaggiTreviso, Italy
Title: Bed quality
Review: Yesterday we went for the first time to have dinner in this restaurant.We are Italian so we though it was a nice place where to eat pizza but we made a big mistake.the pizza was very bad,unfortunatly you cannot open a restaurant if you don't have any idea how to make it!!We ordered also a plate of fried squid but the quality and the flavour was orrible!If you don't have any idea how to cook Italian food and if you don't know what's mozzarella cheese. Is,please change job....

Author: MALAYSIANWANNABEKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The band rocks! But everything else sucks
Review: Don't waste your time at this place if you are interested in good food or service. If you are a true Hard Rock fanatic, it might be worth your time. The food is crazy expensive and mediocre and everyone was frustrated with the lackluster service. Hubby's salmon was overcooked and my salad came without the promsed pecans. The staff is friendly but undertrained and people were constantly raising their hands to get their attention. The band was fun and we enjoyed the live music, but I would never go back again. Chili's is a much better value for money if you want to go to an American chain in Malaysia (unless you really want to see Aerosmiths guitar).

Author: KLOysterManMalaysia
Title: Will not return
Review: I read an article (which I think was about them), that they go cheap on decor in favour of putting more money into quality ingredients. Apparently this extends to having no aircon.Was very average in my opinion. I can take plenty hot food, but when you kick off with chicken wings that blow your head off and ruin the taste of everything else to come, you are off to a bad start. Burger was average...the Classic I think it was called. Pattie was very average, ditto the chicken one my wife had. As mentioned, maybe our taste buds were ruined due to the complete over powering of the unnecessarily red hot chili chicken wings.The "milkshake" was more like frozen ice cream, so couldnt make any progress on that with a normal straw so had to resort to whipping it up myself with the steel spoon provided.Won't be going back - sorry.

Author: GG3MY
Title: Highly Anticipated First Time Visit !
Review: Had dinner at this restaurant last night. 3/01/22. It was a birthday celebration and one of my friends had done a lot of reading up about the Food Innovator Navin Karu, so we were quite excited to go there.Helas, the restaurant did not live up to its hyped up reputation.We ordered the calamari and the crab cake to start with. Calamari lacked seasoning, bland and soggy. The crab cake was nothing to shout about either.For mains, our order was 2 barramundi and one prawn pasta. Once again big disappointment, the dishes lacked flavour and seasoning. A major hiccup was that on the menu there was no mention of fresh cream being in the barramundi dish, but there was and since I am allergic to fresh cream the dish had to be sent back. I then ordered a lamb pizza which was ok. Long story short, i sat and watched while my other two guests ate their tasteless meal. The pizza arrived after everyone was done eating, except me. Not a very pleasant situation.All I can say is that this visit was sheer disappointment, more so for my friend who was really looking forward to sampling the food. The food is overrated and overpriced. We won't be going back there in a hurry.

Author: Katu_8123
Title: What a good restaurant!!
Review: So nice !! Staff is very kind, food is tasty!!Especially, Racheal is best one for serve us.Best for fun !!!

Author: Elvin C
Title: Variety of food
Review: Like the breakfast which present variety and quality of foods. The kitchen and service staffs are friendly and attentive
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Diana A
Title: Dinner
Review: Nice food..  good place... friendly staff ,especially waiter zee his recomended good lamb pasta with cooktail,how an awesome tested!!really love it!!will come back here ..very soon 😄😄😄

Author: Nrafyna99
Title: Good places to go
Review: Best places to go in Malacca after a long hot morning taking the history of this World Heritage city to rest in the guaranteed quality environment. The foods also delicious and affordable 👍🏻

Author: tgwwgtTravelHermanus, South Africa
Title: Great ambiance - island style
Review: This cosy eatery is tucked away close enough to the beach to see the sun go down framed by palm trees.. We went with island friends and were warmly greeted by Michele (the owner). Service was friendly and efficient.The menu offered a good selection of dishes. I opted for the spinach lasagne which was excellent, The liver and onion served with mashed potato was also good according to my partner Desserts were quite stunning and I would recommend the mango crepe The restaurant also had a small but well patronised bar, where locals and tourists alike were enjoying drinks and good conversation.

Title: Delicious Malaysian food
Review: I've lived in KL for six years and eaten at Bijan many times. It's more expensive than your average restaurant, but worth the price I'd say . Tangy, fresh, spicy flavours, decent service and a lovely relaxed atmosphere. Great pace to take out of rotten visitors.

Author: azlanshahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing breakfast
Review: First time here and breakfast was generally disappointing.- Roti telur goyang: toast was soft- Chee cheong fun: tasted bland and chicken was sparse- Cakoi: the kaya was just sweet and didn't taste of real kayaMaybe its popular because the food was good once upon a time?

Author: Alexklmy
Title: Birthday Party
Review:
Delicious variety of Spanish food , nice ambiance and fast service.
We were in a big group and really enjoyed the appetizers ,main course and of course our Red and White Wines .
Thumbs up 👍

Author: yan85kwanIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Food is nice, but BAD services!
Review: Offers a nice tradition Nonya foods, especially the pandan chicken (must try) But the services is terrible... i reached at 8:30pm in a monday night. The restaurant is not full since it's the 1day of the week..so, there is still empty tables but so far the waiters ask me to wait (I'm the only walk in customers after it all, so I'm sure these tables wasn't reserved!!!) ..gosh, i have to wait 10min++ for a couple to clear their bill and another 5min for the waiters to clean the table (somohow the table is not clean). At the end of the dinner, I then noticed that this restaurant love to hurry their customers out just the time you finish your foods @.@ HHmmm....while the food is good, I would think twice about going back.

Author: joanadventure
Title: Pelita Restaurant
Review: It's a place for mama food with local the tarik etc. The price is on a high side too. You can find them around Klang Valley.

Author: nurhashmiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely amazing
Review: Tried the restaurant for lunch with a couple of friend. I must say the food was amazing! And the portions! We could hardly finish. This is as authentic as it gets taste wise as well. I loved it so much that I ended up bringing back another friend and my daughter, the same day. Tried their pizzas too. They were divine. Exactly the way I like it. For desert we shared the lava stack. I can’t recommend it enough! The owner is a great guy with such an inspiring story. This one is for you, Imran! Looking forward to watching you grow. I’ll be back soon :)

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Fantabulous Thai Foodies 😋😋😋
Review: Lunch at this delicious awesome Thai restaurant that served very good spicy for grab Tomyam Clear chicken soup with sea bass that is so fresh and tender in Thai style, with tender soft pandas chicken, with tofu salted eggs sotong and of course their mango salad is simply fantabulous. Their famous signature dish is the cockle curry is one of the best dishes, just nice big and juicy that melts in the mouth.

Author: Sage2724Australia
Title: Homely welcoming and great food
Review: What a surprise greets you as you enter Mangoes. It is situated in a back street, very understated entrance...then you walk into a setting of a veranda in tropical bush, open air, sea views with lots of efficient fans and you are immediately heartily greeted by Michelle and feel totally relaxed and at home. The menu is simple and has lots of variety of western dishes. The meal was generous and really delicious, especially the mango crepe for dessert! Everyone there seemed to be relaxed and having a great time. The service was excellent and prices very reasonable. It is a great restaurant and we will definitely be back!!

Author: KennethLimBW
Title: Nice environment but average food
Review: This is halal Chinese restaurant. Nice environment and good service. But Chinese food without lard is like lack of some taste. You know what I meant.

Author: giup972Milan, Italy
Title: overprized and overestimated
Review: I got a beef (empal) lelapasi. The price went up in 2 years from 8 ringit to 13 ringit for this simple meal. it was ok, but nothing really special and poor quantity. Maybe because I am not malesian/asian, they didn't bring me the free soup to go with rice; only when I asked for it, because I knew they usually bring, they did. Not a good choice in my opinion.

Author: GonnyB33
Title: Awesome Indian restaurant
Review:
Recommended by Jai after a trip to Cameron Highlands we came here for diner since we love Indian food. 
Great price/quality! We had chicken tikka massala, massala biryani but to be honest all the food looked great. 
 
Clean and spacious too!

Author: lifeoffoodUnited Kingdom
Title: Good First Experience of Nasi Kandar
Review: Was taken here by my mother-in-law, who wanted me to try the Nasi Kandar. We had ordered several rice, seafood, meat and vegetable dishes, one of which is Fried Chicken with spicy rice. The tastes are very authentic and the portions are reasonable. Very good for Lunch and for a hungry appetite. Service is quick and in an orderly manner.

Author: grentoczz
Title: Bad food, worse service
Review: Went here because of all the good reviews, which I now don’t understand. I ordered a cake and a coffee, while my partner ordered nachos. My cake came out first and my coffee took an extra fifteen minutes after that. We waited still longer for the other coffee, and then longer again for the nachos. The waiters didn’t smile once, just threw the food in front of us.The cake was horrible, it tasted cold, stale and salty. The nachos were laughable. Would not recommend this place at all.

Author: VeryTheJoSinop, Turkey
Title: Ugh, really?
Review: Had the salted caramel cake and caffe mocha. The cake was beautiful and the overall presentation was very classy. But it was ridiculously-dry, not unlike an old dishwashing sponge. And to think one of the hosts who greeted me actually had the gall to proclaim that their desserts are excellent when I made it known that that was what I came for - the nerve, I tell you!The caffe mocha not only required close to 15 minutes to be served (I timed them), but when it came, it was one of the saddest, most-uninspired concoction I've ever come across (and I've eaten at several very shady, very questionable establishments). The liquid was tepid (I'm being generous - try plonk a thermometer in there and watch as nothing happens, I guarantee you). Serving coffee this terrible should be against the UN Convention Against Torture! For around RM15 per cup, you might as well cross the thoroughfare to Coffee Beans, harrumph.My goodness! All these glowing reviews are making me question my sanity, honestly. A friend highly recommended this place, which was why I stopped by; she's getting a horrid present this Christmas!Nice ambience, though, if a tad noisy (i.e. don't expect to be able to have a quiet conversation here). I enjoy the music selection well enough. Tables are quite packed; the back of my chair was flush against the edge of another patrons' table. Also, there's a constant gust of warm air from the counter - don't know what that's about.The staff were friendly and charming, but always in a hurry to get away from you. The first fellow ran off before I could finish my order; thankfully another guy saw me try to catch his attention as he was dashing off and this second one came to 'rescue' me. Same thing when I was trying to pay. Dropped the bill and off he went before I could even blink (I already had my purse out in preparation because it was a little hard getting their attention). The whole thing was slightly annoying, though not a deal-breaker.Maybe the entrees and mains are okay? I'll probably give this another go if it's someone else's treat.

Author: jerryw166Brisbane, Australia
Title: Long on style, short on value and shorter on taste
Review: Went with a large group which did stress test the staff which where ok but not great, one person main got lost and bills got a little confused. The food looks absolutely fantastic but the taste was bland and rather tasteless. The group of 6 around me taste shared our meals, only one was ok, the rest where just bad. Re the value, I ordered the soft shell chilli crab, RM25, I got I small clean which was greasy, a few curly fries which where Luke warm and a bit of shaved cucumber. Not valve for money IMHO. Needless to say, will not be back, which was the general concensus.

Author: GEEWONGKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant
Review: I love banana leaf rice so i was pleasantly surprised to find myself enjoying a good meal here and have been a repeat patron. The servings are adequate and have a good choice of my favorite veges.The restaurant is clean , spacious and serving staff are pleasant and attentive.Will come back!

Author: LPMTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very bad service
Review: I always liked B-Lab but recently was a turning point.The pasta I ordered wasn't fresh and very sweet... I told the staff that this I can't eat this and returned it.When I got the bill I had to pay full price.Later that evening/night I didn't feel .B-Lab you lost one customer.

Author: bekinge
Title: No way to eat.
Review:
We visited for dinner and ordered T-bone. 
However, none of them is correctly cooked and all meals are cold. Since, the kichten is not in same place I guess.

Author: Paul S KSydney, Australia
Title: Rude Service
Review: Having just come from one week in Osaka the food was passable imitations of the real things but the service carried out was atrocious. We had to ask two or more times for tea or ginger to be refilled and once this waitress simply ignored our request and proceeded to take away empty dishes. My napkin fell to the floor and this waiter simply picked it up and throw it onto my lap. It was not just one person. All of the service staff except one petite middle aged waitress had this funny snooty attitude. For the coup de resistance we were told to move our body and arms so this BIG waitress could clean the table while we waited for the check. The restaurant was nearly empty but we eventually had to hang around the cashier counter and wait for the privelege to pay to pay our bill and leave the place. Our bill came out at 690MR for 4 people so we were not time wasters.The cooking staff looked like Japanese but the management is certainly not.

Author: zhu2000KL, malaysia
Title: A hypersonic experience
Review: Just as the name implied... dine in a plane... with super speed. Don’t even bother to pay for any additional birthday cake or such... right after they sang the song and serve the cake... the Q came.. “would you like to pack it to be taken away?”

Author: andi_wilsonWhitehaven, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic & Energetic!
Review: Wow what a fantastic place! The food is sensational but it’s the wonderful lady chef/owner who really stands out! She’s sooooo friendly and hyper! Totally love her! I recommend the sizzling noodles. The quality of beef locally can be a bit hit and miss but here it is exceptional. I dare you not to fall in love with Knife & Fork!!The sister restaurant is Tam San Guan Seafood across the road, also amazing.

Author: Fong J
Title: Not great
Review: Restaurant was almost empty yet it took a long time for my order to arrive at my tableStaff can be more attentive,water glass was empty for a long time, all of them where standing there doing nothing.Bun was spread with correct amount of butter and toasted to my likingBeef patty was overcooked and very tough chewy and full of sinus Price was overprice for the quality they offer

Author: yss97
Title: Good Japanese food
Review: The sashimi and sushi was fresh and tasted good. The food overall was of good quality. Service was attentive. Prices on the higher end.

Author: jenlauwlKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food but bad service
Review: Recommended by friend to try out this restaurant and booked a table. You need to book in advance or else it’s hard to get a table. The nyonya food here is nice. We ordered few dishes and one of the dishes served was not what we wanted. We told the boss that is sitting in the counter but he refused to change and even showed us one kind of face.

Author: ryan_leeuwenRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Terrible service, not fresh
Review: I went here with high expectations. There is not a lot of sushi restaurants in KL. So I ordered chicken. Meat was not fresh. Looks old and bit rotten. I asked for a other. Then I get a other rotten chicken. Also waiter was very grumpy. The sushi was not bad, but not high quality. When I want to pay the lady waiter added 5 more pink plates. I didn't ordered that at all. I think that was a trick to pay for the chicken I complained about. I was very mad. For this reason I give 2 stars. Service is bad, food not fresh!!

Author: meeyuleeLos Angeles
Title: Disappointing
Review: Makko Nyonya Restaurant in Melaka was recommended by a Kuala Lumpar friend. Twelve of us arrived at exactly 6 p.m., when they had just opened up. A queue was already being turned away; I overheard that reservation was necessary at least a day ahead--hearing that, imagine my expectation. Inside, historic photos on the wall added charm to the otherwise dowdy dining room. The menu explained the history of Nyonya cuisine, hinting at the restaurant's authentic roots. On-time diners quickly filled the tables. My group ordered a variety of dishes ending with desserts. Native ladies casually took orders and began bringing out food almost instantly. (Here I must admit that the only prior Nyonya restaurant I had enjoyed very much was one in Pasadena, California.) We were excited at the arrival of every dish and ate with gusto. By the end, my friends silently chalked it up as a unique experience. Honestly for me the meal was disappointing. The rice was cold, rough, and tough--if that was the Nyonya way, nevertheless it was awful. Veggie meat and fish dishes were topped with different mush but none has much savory taste. Later a friend said he had peeked inside the kitchen and saw very little active cooking, just pots of sauces ready to be dished. If Makko serves “real” and “best” Nyonya food, then I shall never miss it again.

Author: Louis Y
Title: Decent dim sum
Review: Decent dim sum, good service and averagely priced right beside Foh Shan .. not amazed, though! Much hype about their neighbours but decided against it after a local's advice
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: McSuanMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Great dim sum & delicious durian pan cake
Review: If you are looking at having a great dim sum for lunch, you should drop by to this restaurant.The food are very fresh & they have the fastest service. The team is also very attentive.You must not also forget to try their signature dessert "Durian Pan Cake" .... trust me, you will not get as good as this else where.

Author: MademoiselleMidJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: So-so
Review: Went in at around 11am on a Friday noon and was practically empty but did took some time for my 3 sets to be ready. Ordered the balls with chicken and some fishball soup. Each plate of 10 rice balls (adult portion) with some slices of chicken at RM9 was slightly too expensive in my opinion. Rice was slightly bland (probably prefer normal chicken rice) and so was the roasted chicken. My taste bud seemed to prefer the steamed chicken option though. Ee Ji Ban should consider increasing flavor of the rice and probably more spices for the roasted chicken. I would say it was an ok experience.

Author: Manuel S
Title: Expensive, not the real McCoy
Review: This is not the real McCoy, a few very expensive Spanish products, the Real McCoy is PISCO, not very far from there, that offers decent Spanish food, and that is were young affluent French and Spaniards meet in KL.

Author: MeiLeong
Title: Good choices of food with food like home cooked food.
Review: This restaurant have variety of home cooked food. It's difficult to find duck dishes but teik seng offers few types. However they are not serving theses dishes everyday. The price of the duck dish is RM20 with is reasonable for me.

Author: Rinchen_purpleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly & Cozy Ambience
Review: We drove around trying to find a place for quick dinner that's near our hotel, and we found Sun Cafe that's about 3 minutes drive away~ had Indian food the previous night so something different would be nice~We approached the friendly personnel if they serve dishes that are suitable for vegetarian and he immediately recommended some pizza and pasta that meat/seafood are able to be removed. We ordered Pizza Supreme sans turkey ham, Vegetable Curry serves with Rice, and Pumpkin soup~ the staffs are all so friendly and smiley, YES I mean ALL of them! Some are owners I'm sure :) The food presentation of the Vegetable Curry & Rice is so unique (look at the picture ^^) and it's delicious, could be slightly spicy to some but we are ok with that. Pizza is good too and I like my pumpkin soup~ The interior is tastefully decorated and children friendly too~ Price is considered a little on the high side for local, but overall it's a place we would go back again the next time we visit Langkawi ~

Author: Zanzibarian
Title: First class food
Review:
We ate at The Planters the first night we stayed at The Danna. The food was amazing and the service matched it. 

The waiters were very attentive and the food was well cooked and excellently presented. 

It's upmarket, but worth the treat!

Author: Teh_AisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Review: I am from KL and tried this place after checking out the reviews. I was not impressed in terms of food standard, service and value vs. reviews given. Now, food preference is a very subjective manner - however having dined in many Italian restaurants both fine and casual, I'd just rate the food on a scale of 3.5/5. Service could have been better in terms of serving time and staff standard. Value is definitely at the lowest end of the scale. I only have two explanations for my experience with Coppola:1. Might have been an unlucky day for me. Things may go wrong.2. Other reviewers may have not the opportunity to experience something better.However, I do have to refute their statement of best Tiramisu in JB. It actually deserves the best Tiramisu in Malaysia (Having finally hunted the best Tiramisu that is closest to Italia in this country)

Author: Kiran RIpoh, Malaysia
Title: The most authentic North Indian cuisine you can ever find in IPOH!!
Review: The restaurant offers a one-of-a-kind fine dining experience of North Indian cuisines. Started of with Pani Puri, which was delicious and mouth-watering. We proceeded to have Mutton Kebab, Kadhai Chicken, Methi Fish, as well as Mutton Briyani. All of these dishes tasted amazing, and were excellent. Ended the meal with their Mango Kulfi and Gulab Jamun for dessert, and it was superb!The service by the staff was excellent, and the prices of the dishes are reasonable. The restaurant has a good ambience and a serene setting. Had an incredible night, with good food. We'll definitely be coming here back again!

Author: SimoRoma14
Title: Very poor experience
Review: The restaurant is in a great location and has a fantastic view, however unless you know the city very well you will not be able to find it easily. Food is ok, portions are very small and is very expensive...

Author: TravellingTTs
Title: Good food and great value
Review:
The place is no frills but has great food with generous servings so it is perfect if on a budget.
Located near jalan alor so gives a good alternative if you are getting tired of Chinese food

Author: Viajero1199Singapore, Singapore
Title: Don't expect any service
Review: The menu looks extensive although the open kitchen looks like some backstreet joint with random cook. Stood and sat for a good amount of time, without much service orientation from the staffs, with the manager standing at the bar checking his phone. Probably better to check out La Bodega down the alley

Author: UKJohn88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: Dined here recently with some foreign guests. Was rather disappointed with the service. We asked for the dishes to be served to us individually. What we did not expect was that all the dishes came out at the same time; these were then served to each guest on small plates and bowls. The results was that each guest had several small plates and bowls all around us at the same time! Does Chynna Restaurant not realise that the proper way to serve is for each dish to come out one at a time, and each guest to be served one dish at a time on his or her plate? It was really embarrassing to my foreign guest.I also ordered steamed Soon Hock fish. This was full of bones when served to us. The waiters clearly had no idea how to debone the fish prior to serving us!The whole dinner felt rather rushed, like the waiters were rushing us through the dinner. The price of RM1,800 for 7 people was rather expensive too and for the food and service we received, was not worth it. I will never entertain my foreign guests or indeed other guests here again.

Author: baxtermurphExmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyed it so much we went twice
Review: Recommended by our agent, we were not disappointed. Some delicious and original dishes, but beware the portions are huge, and we have good appetites, better for 3 or 4 people! Photos are of soft shell crab ( fabulous), Midin ( local fern, a must try crispy, green and delicious), crispy lamb (yummy), Bee Hoon (fried noodles, lovely but enough for 3!), Salt squid with loads of crispy salad, again very delicious.Good range of drinks, lovely helpful staff, and reasonable prices, cheap if you consider the portion sizes.There was a big party on the first time we went so it was pretty noisy, but good atmosphere, and popular with the locals.Our waitress both times was Raine who was absolutely lovely

Author: griffin139Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Seafood and eat it
Review: By the airport on business, taken here for lunch. The large red crab hoarding is difficult to miss. Our host took us around the enormous fish tanks full of seafood, some of which I don't think I'd heard of before let alone had to eat and I'm old enough to have tried a few. I'm squeamish about picking exactly which ones I'm going to eat!so after viewing the catch we came to a compromise on what to try, several different types of prawn cooked various ways, mantis shrimps fried in a chilli coating, an entire 'local' fish, crab and steamed vegetables, and juice and coconut milk. The service was good but I reckon our host was well known to the management. I was pleasantly surprised when the food arrived, well cooked and obviously fresh out of the tank! Lunch went on a long time as we sampled the numerous dishes. The mantis shrimp and the prawns were my favourites. I gather it is on the expensive side for the area but was the best of several local fish restaurants we were taken to; both for the food and the setting. I was told it was quiet as it was a public holiday and everybody would come later after the rain had stopped. As others have commented the fish eye view in the gents toilet is totally bizarre.

Author: Caswy
Title: Top notch service
Review: I made a reservation for my wedding anniversary. We are just there for dinner, however the restaurant took the hassle to specially set up a table with us. Their food is good and the service is excellent. My wife was very happy and satisfied with the arrangement. The effort by the restaurant made my wife smile the whole night. We will return again.

Author: csfKuching_SarawakKuching, Sarawak
Title: Dissapointed
Review: My son took me to this restaurant sometime back where he celebrated Mother's Day for me when my husband were in overseas. We promised we would go back again, when the time is right with his father around. We thought what a better place to sit, enjoy a great meal with perfect view for our this year Chinese New Year Eve reunion dinner. We even paid more to be seated near the "window", we expected the charges for the buffet to be more pricey since its a festive occasion. How dissapointed we were when we saw the display and the variety of food served, it's was nothing compared to what was five years ago. In my opinion, the Kuala Lumpur Tower was a building of Malaysian Pride, but the current operators of this restaurant made an impression that this place is a huge tourist trap. We left earlier than expected, we did highlight our dissapointment with the cashier when we paid RM673.70 for three pax meal. We told them their management should have done better knowing that this venue is not only patronize by just the tourist, it caters for the local as well. Anyway, nobody would like the feeling of getting cheated, I sincerely hope someone in authority would come across this comment and make that improvement. Sad.

Author: brunasJ5940XIMalaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: We came all the way to try their amazing pancakes and we arrive at 11.20 and they only serve pancakes after 12. Kind of disappointing that the meals that they advertise in their menus have timing to be served. Unfortunately we left without trying their meals.

Author: KatyDaisy
Title: Place is certainly cute.
Review: Place is certainly cute but food was really average. Maybe I dislike the cilantro in the cheese and egg and mushroom croissant. Ambience is certainly enjoyable and staffs are nice. Also not super expensive.

Author: BangsarBritKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful!
Review: Having eaten in their London branch some years ago I had high expectations - that were not met in a spectacular fashion:Indifferent serving staff (if you exclude an OCD-like desire to shuffle things around on the tableLukewarm mineral waterFlavourless appetiser that arrived after the main;Pork and green beans. What can I say? The beans were apparently cooked over a naked flame until their ends were charred to death. Insipid pork with burnt skin. Entire dish tasted like an ashtray. Rice had a nasty chemical taste to it, like it had been steamed over water that had been used to clean the floor. Needless to say that I shall not be going back!

Author: FoodLover554Bangsar
Title: Extremely Satisfied
Review: I have never written a review before, I have always been the person who reads it and would venture but this amazing place have actually made me to write a review for the very first time. After reading the reviews, me and my partner decided to try out Vin's. I was not disappointed at all. From the food to the service to the ambience..everything was simply great. I had the brandy prawn bruschetta and the Maksimo while my partner had the pumkin soup and the lamb cutlets. The food was delicious (my mouth is watering while i'm typing). I could still feel the juicy beef burger. Its been ages since we had good food in Malaysia. Me and my partner were satisfied. And guess what we came back 2 days later and still everything was amazing. This time, we had the herb grilled salmon and the spicy tuna pizza and to end it, we ordered the creme brulee (was lovely). We are definitely coming back here again (I'm coming back tomorrow with few of my colleagues).

Author: philosophymajor
Title: So-so
Review: Asked if I could have the seafood platter for one, but they weren't flexible on that. Ordered the seafood pasta which was meh. Had a whiskey sour- I've had much better whiskey sours!

Author: jctok
Title: Good food,good atmosphere
Review: A must visit dining place in Kuching, within walking distance to water front, carpenter street and shopping area.

Author: Carla v
Title: Horrible
Review:
Horrible food and drinks. They add sugar in the food and even in orange juice
Worst food I ever had in Miri
Really not eatable. Fat, sweet and expensive as well

Author: GurukohliNew Delhi, India
Title: My Credit card got robbed for 9400 Euros
Review: I visited Whisky bar and the Steakhouse on the back of very good reviews on TripAdvisor. The food and ambience were very good.However I had a shock in the morning when I realized somebody had used my credit card for 9400 Euros after visiting SteakhouseI did not visit another place after this restuarant so the only eplanation is that my card was skimmed in this restuarant

Author: benandblondieDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Disappointing - could be amazing
Review: What a shame that a piece of history is not being embraced and well kept. This beautiful heriage colonial buiding is not loved and cared for. Opened in 1921it served the British who worked and lived in then 'Malaya'. It was patronised by government officers, tin miners, planters, traders and military personnel together with their families who swung by for tea, cocktails and dinner. Over time, the Western Colonial cuisine evolved into its own unique style as the Hainanese chefs, immigrants from China, concocted their own interpretation of many a western dish. It now specialises in steaks which were very average cuts of meat. The sauces were what you may expect in a canteen - consistancy like packet gravy. The hakka noodles you could buy in the street stalls and get a lot more flavor and quality. Overall very disappointing. It is such a shame as the building is beautiful but they are not maintaining it. The bathrooms smelt. Just hope they take this feedback as constructive to improve as it would be such a shame for this history to be lost.

Author: Gorm L
Title: Great food, good selection - when one craves for Japanese
Review: Dinner, great selection, fresh shashimi, and in general a good selection on offer. Relatively good service, but had to ask for my beer twice.

Author: Waelfallatah
Title: Not clean as it should
Review: The view and the place is showing 5 stars service, however experience insect in juice make my experience in this restaurant so bad.

Author: Singyew19
Title: Disappointing briyani
Review: Ordered this because it sounded very special as it was made with a traditional twist of how an Indian grandma will mix all the leftover curry with generous portions of mutton. Unfortunately it only looks beautiful yet I wonder how with this array of spices in it, it was still tasteless!! Such a waste! The raita was also too watery and not sour enough. Plus it was quite expensive!! Rm21! Maybe it should've been a shared portion as i struggled to finish it

Author: acsmate93
Title: Nope
Review: Asked the waiter for a vegan food and got a handful of chicken with it.. Asked him if the food is spicy because i dont like it and got it so spicy i couldnt eat it. Garbage place. Thanks for the possible diarrhoea

Author: 888bushy1
Title: Good food
Review: Had a lovely   meal here. Good choice of food and reasonable .Remember all restaurants charge gov tax and service charge.The staff were very pleasant and polite apologised for us having to wait for our meal which in all fairness didn't take long.

Author: thzoe
Title: Foods and environment just so so...
Review:
To our family trip, the foods are just so so. 
Environment is under our expectation. Nothing is special about this restaurant.

Author: VaniessaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Egg Waffles - Not Impressed
Review: Tried this place as they are famous for their egg waffles, I have to admit that I am not impressed at all. The waffles are pretty simple and the fillings are very simple and not worth the visit there.
