The service is slow, and the waitress look like they have no experience at all and we had to keep requesting plates & cutleries etc.

Author: Wittynam3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gem in the forest
Review: A good news to have another good quality cafe in the neighborhood! Not too bad menu, however need more choices!! And the plates... hmmm.... it'd be better if change to a better quality serving plate, the place or ambience feels cheapen by the plate used. And won't mind to pay for the service charge if its table service, queueing up to order and pay also makes it like a fast food.

Author: ktindeMumbai, India
Title: Excellent as always
Review: This is the second time round we have been taken to this restaurant. Its a Chinese favourite and best to visit it with a Chinese family. But everyone there speaks English so I see no problem going with your own group. ...but preferably not alone. Purely because the dishes are huge and if you are alone you would not be able to savour more than a dish or two. The Chinese love eating and always in family groups, so be prepared for a noisy , children filled meal. But I think it adds to the fun. Enjoy food the Asian way! It was the Chinese new year so after getting a table with some difficulty, we started the tradition way by being served a mixed dish of noodles....not sure of its name...where everyone stands up, takes a pair of chopsticks and mixes all the food on the platter. Its a bonding thing and I personally make a wish as I take part. Am not sure if we ate the stuff then or just sent it back. Then the platters of food arrived. This time we did not stick to just sea food. Hardly any wait time and one dish followed the other in quick time. We started with some pork dish and each one got a few chopsticks worth of food. Felt too little at first. But then came the meats , followed by fish. Each was served a few chopsticks at a time and before long our plates were overflowing .Steamed rice and steamed veggies were always at hand. And finally came a large fish on a huge platter. No room left in our stomachs but yet we dug in. Wow, how to the Chinese stay so slim in spite of such large dinners!! Having desserts was out of question.. The lights failed at some point of our meal, overload I guess, but that did not fazzle anyone. We all kept eating and enjoying. The Bill when presented was so low for 8 or us that we thought we should just continue eating.

Author: mezaddinJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Unsure what the hype all abiut but dissapointment
Review: Was there to know what the hype all about. I stay nearby this area. Came and ordered the nslemak lobster and sotong. They hv the lobster but no sotong. oredered both the same. Place is a normal shoplot eatery, a lot people waiting for the dishes being served. Waiting time is around 20-30 mins. And we got our order within that time too. Staffs are slow and seemed busy but tables still not served. Suddenly the power off, only emergency light was on. And upon checking there was a power trip at the switchboard and they took time forever to revive the situation. As we were inside the shop, was so hot and disrupted our meal. Overall i feel dissapointed on the visit and wasnt get the expected service and good food

Author: cherexc
Title: very best feeling here
Review: I will bring more friends and family for the next visit good environment nice food nice drink cold air cond love it so much

Author: Daniel LMelbourne, Australia
Title: Nice food, quick service, nothing extraordinary
Review: Executive summary: Good for a quick bite, inexpensive, fast service but not a mustI went there after a long day and decided to go to Fish and Co. Service was good and fast and the food was alright. I can't remember what I the items I had were called but they were good but it was nothing special.

Author: OldDalbyitePocklington, United Kingdom
Title: Italian food
Review: We didn’t research prior to visiting so were disappointed with the Italian menu with no local food on offer- our fault but not clear from the outside that this was the case.The restaurant is much larger than it looks from the outside and is filled with curiosities (or junk depending on your view)I had the fisherman ‘s basket which was big enough for two. The waiter nor the menu suggested what the main courses came with so we ended up over ordering sides when fries and salad came with the mains.Ok but better options available

Author: Aseema7
Title: I would have liked more variety in the menu.
Review: We went to Thirty8 to celebrate our daughters birthday. After getting a "spot with a great view" we looked at the menu. It had limited options. Price was not too high considering the place & view. We ordered Chinese food. We felt it was ok. I've eaten far better food for that price. The staff was polite & gave us suggestions as to what to order & how much to order. The quantity of the Chinese food was a lot. The house special cake too was nothing to boast about. If you want great views & if you are not much of a food fan I would suggest this restaurant.

Author: Anne BPreston, United Kingdom
Title: Worth getting wet
Review: We visited this restaurant on an evening when the rain was bucketing down but it was worth braving the elements. It was busy, despite the rain, with attractive decor and a comfortable vibe. Everything we had - chicken pandan, pineapple rice and midin was delicious and came in enormous portions, which, being greedy, we more or less polished off before waddling back to our hotel. Well worth a visit.

Author: GDarrenPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Not bothered
Review: Visited Pelita Sunway for morning breakfast but nobody bothered to take our order as we sat there for a good 3 minutes until we saw a new customer came in but failed to see us or even take our order, if the morning staff is not interested in working then close your shop. Have been a regular here at sunway pelita for evening tea but ever since this incident there will be no more. Improve the service.

Author: jokl78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super cheap but not nice
Review: We came in 3 for dinner at 5pm. Ordered alot.Popia - not niceMeat ball - not badKang kung belacan - not niceSambal petai prawn - not badBak pongteh - niceOtak otal - tastelessCurry chicken - so soCendol - not badSo much food and only cost us rm100

Author: RosemaryT415
Title: Yummy food
Review: My friends and I were supposed to head towards a Japanese restaurant but it was closed for lunch so we wondered along and chanced upon Sun Cafe. No regrets as we tucked into a delicious and sumptuous meal . The waiter was surprised at our ferocious appetite !#

Author: MaaikeB86Nijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: Yummy food
Review: We went here twice during our visit in Kuching. Food is really good and the restaurant really cosy and nice decorated.Enough choice between chicken, duck, deer, prawn and fish dishes. Portions are big so consider sharing the dishes. Choose a vegatable, a meat/fish and rice/noodle/side and share with two, that would be enough. Really good food and friendly staff!

Author: Sarah_Shafari
Title: Bad service and rude staff
Review: Very bad service, overrated and overpriced for a place placed in the outskirts of Langkawi. I was shouted by the owner for giving a feedback about the rude staff.  Don’t open a restaurant if you can’t accept constructive criticism especially from the customer.

Author: Dubaibob23Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Really average food
Review: Although the service we received was very enthusiastic, it was not very knowledgeable. We ordered a chicken dish and a lamb dish as entrees, they were really awful. Chewy meats, if that was lamb I’m still 20 years old! The starters were bland and oily.Shame as the place has a nice ambience and probably was good in a previous life.We got the impression they are now catering for a mainly Western expat audience who maybe don’t know better. My friend is Malaysian and she couldn’t believe how bad this was. It’s a tourist trap as it’s not authentic Malay food.Prices are reasonable by Western standards but on expensive side in Kuala Lumpur. The wine list was ok with some reasonable wines included.Overall I recommend giving this place a miss.

Author: quadimod
Title: Amateur service, so-so average Italian fare
Review: Our dinner for 7 persons came to RM4,800 with 1 bottle of an average NZ wine. This is London prices at a top notch fine fining restaurant and this is far far away from top notch in terms of service and food quality. The only plus here are the views. Otherwise, don't come here.

Author: 401Ne-d
Title: Soup is good
Review: This place is new place in the place of old, by the sea. Waiter was rude and too interrupting. Soup good.

Author: Salgainz
Title: I don’t think I’ll taste something similar !!
Review: The best place to try the authentic French Crepe !!I tried a lot of places before, nothing I can compare to this one, the staff were so lovely and welcoming, specially Kelvin, such a great funny guy.If I come back again to langkawi, this place will be the reason

Author: JoeCool_KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Won’t be coming here again
Review: We have been coming to Dancing fish since it opened doors and have recommended this place to friends and colleagues and even brought foreign visitors. We noticed that this place has deteriorated over the past year. The food is no longer as good as what it used to be. There used to be a local manager who managed this place and the service used to be excellent. Again this has gone downhill as it’s all hired foreign help.We came here again for dinner and after ordering our food, we waited only to have a waiter coming to our table 10 minutes later to say one dish is not available and if we could choose something else. After choosing an alternative dish, he came back a few minutes later to tell us another dish was no longer available. When the manager came with our drinks we were again told a 3rd dish was no longer available.I can understand that things run out but all 3 dishes and only being told in piece meal after 10-15 minutes of ordering is totally unacceptable. The waiter wasn’t even apologetic. Suffice to say - we won’t be coming back here anymore. Many more restaurants in KL that have better service and better food and more reasonable prices !

Author: leecam156
Title: Disappointing Hi Tea Buffet!
Review: I just attended the Hi Tea Buffet today and I am very very disappointed. Firstly, for a high ‘tea’ buffet, there wasn’t even any tea served! No option of any drinks besides water! Even a simple bed and breakfast would have at least orange juice as standard. This is appalling! Secondly, there was very limited options. I have been to many other hi tea buffets and this is perhaps one of the most limited options I have experienced! If mco and less crowd is the reason then perhaps the price should also be reduced accordingly. But instead, the price is exorbitant for such a spread. And my guest had to wait 20 mins for a satay to be served! The roast lamb on display was almost left with only bones at only 1pm! My other guest who is a vegetarian had very limited options. Even dessert was limited and Malaysian food selection was non-existent! Not even a roti canai/kueh/Mee goreng!To add to this, the staff were not even aware of my cake order until I insisted there was one pre-ordered and they had to search for the order. That wasn’t even ready until I asked when in fact someone should have come to ask when I wanted the cake!Thoroughly disappointed as I expected much more from a well-established 5 star hotel.

Author: Md Zulhelmi B
Title: Ok food, clealiness can improve more
Review: Good food. I love the cheese naan. The fried dhall and mint chutney is great as condiment. Try their biryani also. Go for lamb.

Author: LiniHarun29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Use to be great but now they just want to make more money
Review: So I have been coming here for years. Many times for dinner and some evenings for coffee and cake. I love the food but lately the prices been creeping up slowly yet surely. Though the taste has remained the same so I still go and have my meals there. Today was the last straw. They have stopped serving tap water. Why ... I guess it’s another way to ensure profitability. Tap water or warm water is just a Malaysian thing. I don’t want to have my Italian water warmed up in the microwave thank you. I guess Alexis probably won’t missed me as a customer but I still refuse to pay for my water so today is my last time in Alexis Garden.

Author: lightsammIbiza, Spain
Title: The worst Burger on the planet!!!!!
Review: The twinkling lights and the setting is soooooo romantic that everyone gets caught on the first night!!!! .... and believe me this is soooo true!!! The burger that was served to us was full of nerves, ligaments and stomach tubes .... This is your worst nightmare on a plate!!!! One mouthful and it was impossible to swallow ..... This was made with the lowest quality meat possible ... Not fit for human consumption!!! I do not recommend to eat here but a glass of water or a watermelon shake for the twinkling lights , no problem!!!!

Author: Jennytly0601Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service ever
Review: For social this is a great spot. Good food with great service. The staff was always there, but not overbearing or pushy. So you can relax and take your time. Most every table celebrating birthday occasion, the staff trying so hard to accommodate guest need even the place was very busy.Special attention to Pui Teng, Marina, Sam for great service provided and showing care.

Author: Jess PEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible experience that everyone should try!
Review: From the moment we walked in we were amazed by the venue, beautiful bar area, scented and low lighting. We were given a welcome drink and had an ‘icebreaker’ to get us started in the dark experience. We were handed over to a guide who was extremely friendly and warming. Radha was very attentive and we quickly had full faith in him and trusted him to guide us through it. The selection of dishes were each exquisite in their own right and provided a challenge to guessing what ingredients made them up. We found our senses heightened in the experience and would recommend that everyone give this a go!

Author: stcyaudryKuching, Malaysia
Title: An okay
Review: I went twice and I really enjoyed the calamari rings. I've not tried anything else but I think I would come again in the long future. The service is fine and the setting is also nice because it's somewhat different from other cafes with all those photo frames of tv shows, celebrities and what not. I am liking the idea that there's no WiFi available.

Author: ShaggiesueSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: One word ......AWESOME !
Review: After reading good reviews I made attempts for reservations, I was over the moon when Raymond and Cheryl helped me with the reservation for dinner. We were on an adventure trip, the first cave we went was GUA Tempurung in the morning (Grand Tour) my teenagers were already filled with Oohs....the rest of the 3 temple caves bored them a little. But once they stepped foot into the Retreat....Bang! They asked to stay at the villas (next visit)! For the start, the management arranged for a butler to show us around the villas, pods, spas, crystal cave etc. The introduction was good and detailed, except that there were mozzies that tagged along for some free blood (please bring insect repellents!)Cave no.5 of the day ...inside Jeff Cellar ...the ambiance was so Awesome! My 15 year old called it ATAS! You can see the amazement in those eyes when they compared to the 4 other caves they conquered earlier. We were led into The Cellar to view the Chairman's private collection....mind blowing!The food that we pre-ordered from the menu was fantastic, we had to order a second round of soup (Ala cart Special Thanks to the chef for accommodating my 3 hungry teens) to satisfy ourselves with the freshly baked bread, both whole meal and plain bread were warm and soft. The mains were well done and the portion was just right! The desserts were just unforgettable. Everything was perfect just that the promotional Champagne was not available and we settled for a bottle of sparkling wine.The staff Ms. Apple was bright and cherry, in fact all the staffs were polite and accommodating. We were going round and round taking photographs at every corner, too beautiful to miss anything.I have recommended Jeff's cellar to a colleague who will be visiting Ipoh in December. Hope she will enjoy as much as I did.My family and I will definitely plan for at least a one night stay in 2 of the villas. To those who have not visited, this is really a unique, romantic and peaceful get away from the stress. You can rest you mind, your soul, close to the nature and yet in comfort.My sincere thanks to Raymond, Cheryl, Apple and all who made it memorable for us.

Author: AndyChanKLHong Kong, China
Title: good food, average dining experience
Review: Food was actually refreshing for KL - though deep fried fois gras ( unagi fois gras ) will get some use to. Cold angel hair pasta / sea urchin was excellent. Ambience was good, simple but elegant - great area downstairs for after dinner drinks / aperitifService - started off good, but went downhill. The sommelier didnt seem to care - when you order a good bottle of wine, you expect it to be be decanted, reviewed in front of you - sommelier poured it blind, didnt offer cork inspection and just walked away. Very unprofessional. At the end of the botttle, he cleared the decanter as if he need to use it - feels rushed. As we ended the night, we walked straight out after paying bill - there was not a single person who asked us how the meal went.Good food, mediocre dining experience

Author: ElleLaJollaLa Jolla, California
Title: What a Delightful Cafe
Review: It may not look like much from the outside--tucked in a side street--but once you're inside you realize you are in a special little cafe. There is much local art on the walls (for sale), and the owner Trudy's enthusiasm is contageous. She wants all her guests to be happy and made sure to provide a couple of vegan dishes to the menu which we absolutely loved. We loved it so much in fact, that we returned a few days later for a cooking class. If you have a day to spare, I highly recommend the cooking class. Trudy and her chef will take you to the farmers market to find fresh produce, then take you to their kitchen (a few houses away from the restaurant) where you learn to cook the dishes. We had three glorious hours together with much laughter. I highly recommend Indah Cafe!

Author: hanimyahya
Title: Will come back for MORE
Review: My second visit to the place. Serving are satisfying. Love the Cheese RIng. Waiters are very friendly. Offered us a fan as it can get pretty hot having it cook right in front of us. They also recommended the must try from the menu.

Author: Jude BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice but pricy. :))
Review: Heard of its good reviews but wanted to manage expectation so here it goes; love that it's cozy and visible from the front of Empire Mall. Smoking area available so that's good. Menu wise it has a very good spread especially if you're hunting for breakfast / brunch. The coffee is good too. The only setback maybe the price cause I can opt for cheaper options nearby. Nevertheless, if you enjoy this sort of lifestyle then no problem to pay a bit for that.Friendly and helpful staff so that's convenient.

Author: Victor TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Roti canai kayu arang.. Long wait
Review: Came here on school holiday and the places are jammed pack with lots of people, can imagine the for food to arrive at your table. Food taste is just average, the only unique part is how they prepare the food with wooden coal. If you have the patience to wait, then is worth visit the place.

Author: Belinda WKuala Lumpur
Title: Poor food quality
Review: This is my first time visiting this cafe in Starhill (I've been to the other one at Tong Shin).We were there around 10ish and only breakfast is served with 3 limited choices which we had all ordered the same Smoked Salmon Toast, 3 Flat White and 1 slice of Lemon Sponge Cake.Our Flat White Coffee took more than 20 minutes to serve when they're no other customers around apart from 3 of us & when they served it, it's totally cold!!! Lemon Sponge Cake from their original cafe is always my favourite but this one is not fresh & very hard like it has been there for days???Our Smoked Salmon Toast serving is quite big but taste definitely need some improvement!When we asked for the bill, the waiter told us their machine is not working so they can't print the bill out and shouldn't they show us the details of each item billed instead of telling us the total instead? It's not RM10 but it's RM129 that we're paying!I was so disappointed as I always want to visit this branch but your customer service and food quality definitely needs a whole lot of improvement!

Author: popeye64
Title: great food
Review: Had a wonderful meal on last night in Kuching. Good menu selection and friendly staff, prices very reasonable.

Author: WongYeeWah
Title: Disappointed
Review: Food was so dissappointed and not nice like last time. Service is poor and expensive!! Service and food need to be improved alot

Author: Vicki T
Title: Part of  Pelangi beach resort
Review: Great location really friendly staff great for drinks and watching the sunset however the night we had dinner with friends they had sold out of most of the seafood and Malay dishes so a bit dissapointing and what I then ordered was a bit average

Author: iamirashahSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Chill
Review: My friend works nearby the restaurant so whenever I visit her, this would be our number one choice for lunch. It came in big portion and the taste is delicious. Various type of food are offered in the menu. Its next to the road with open concept, which I like. A really good place for those who likes to chill and eat at the same time.

Author: NGUYETD
Title: Ok only
Review: We came as this restaurant is ranked in the top 5 penarakan restaurant in Melacca. However the food is just so-so. Not impressed! Can get better food at Singapore Keppel Club.

Author: 243georginam
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We had a really nice dinner here. We had some bread with tomato and a plate of iberian ham and cheese to start with. We felt like in Spain. After that we tried the garlic prawns, the coca catalana and the secreto iberico. Absolutely everything was delicious. We recommend this for the ones who miss home while traveling a long time (like us) and for the ones who want to try authentic Spanish food without having to fly there. And to make it even more perfect we had an AMAZING cheesecake! Don't miss it! Thanks Maria for your recommendations and for being so attentive with us!

Author: Belinda HLancashire
Title: Yummy Fish & Chips and Sunday Roast
Review: My husband and I had our Sunday lunch here the other week, he had Roast Lamb with all the trimmings (apart from the mint sauce??) which he said was very good, I had fish & chips which I have to say was delicious, it was so meaty and tasty, very very fresh.This place is certainly worth a visit..

Author: residentwphnom penh
Title: Great locaation & building
Review: Not sure if this is a fair revue as some of the drunken & noisy self centered English preppy kid customers made it a bit of a nightmare! The location is fab for people watching & atmospheer, food was good but is not explained very well on the menu. Staff were not doing a great job & then we actually had to ask for our change...they EXPECTED to keep it a as tip..not impressed I am in the Service Industry myself...tips are earned!

Author: InvalidPassw0rdSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average okay
Review: I feel it is over rated for this. Was looking forward to it. But when we were there, it was abit disappointing. Rice is plain white rice that is not cooked with chicken oil or margarine or pandan leaves or lemongrass. The chicken itself is so so. I like the crunchy beansprouts. Not bad. Meatball abit too tough and soup is abit over flavorful that we requested for 1 cup of hot water to add in to lessen the taste. Overall is a good try but not exactly something die die must travel there and eat.

Author: Michael Halkjær JHorsens, Denmark
Title: Had high hopes!
Review: I may be ruined by some excellent cuisine in Thailand, but I don't feel this place lived up to the high ranking on TA.Prices are fair and the restaurant looks really cool - but the food was only average in my mind.It is close to Chinatown though, so its a great a place to start a fun evening!

Author: Alice FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A French haute dining spot
Review: What a nice surprise to find a spacious French house tucked away in this secluded corner of KL. We love the chef's home smoked salmon and the exquisite duck breast. Evidently everything is cooked with much love and passion - you can detect these in every dish that comes out from the kitchen. Dessert lovers must succumb to the sublime dessert sampler. Service is impeccable yet warmly cordial.

Author: Rachael J
Title: Best Naan Cheese
Review: If you want to find that one naan fulls with cheese....this is the place! Like they put a lot of cheese inside it! Just that you have to wait quite long for the food to come especially when that place full with people.

Author: SuMinS14
Title: Overrated! Money wasted!!
Review: Celebrated my birthday dinner here but my mood was ruined completely!First of all, bad customer service - we stood at the entrance for 5mins and was not given a single attention.Secondly, the food was mediocre especially the fisherman basket, too much of coating we can barely taste the real food!Thirdly, Since we are only a couple of 2 person and first time here, I was surprised the waitress didn't stop us from ordering the salmon steak after fisherman basket as the portion is so huge! The dishonesty made me mad.The only pros: good ambience and interesting settings.Note: table reservation must be made for Friday and weekend or else you will be given a bad seating downstairs.

Author: segaryputrajaya
Title: The food is average..
Review: Excellent setting and a lovely place to hang out with friends. The staffs were very friendly. We ordered the mushroom croquetas, Coca Catalana, Paella (squid ink). Both 3 dishes were below average. I'm a big fan of Spanish food so I personally feel the food didn't taste good. Disappointed. I might consider to go again to try other dishes.

Author: ISOBEL s
Title: Good service and the food is nice
Review: This is I'm order the food Chicken cheese teriyaki .look so good and yammi. The survive very good. The price is nice not too high can be accepted. I'll come again.

Author: Kieran11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ate here a few days ago
Review: Steamed crab was outstanding ....... very fresh and tasty. Food is good and pricing excellent - there are two stalls with this name --- owned by the same people I am sure, the first one is crowded and does a roaring trade the second one is further in to the food court so not as busy - try this one
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: Milan011Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't bother
Review: Unless you are one of the Hard Rock Cafe item collectors, and need to buy t-shirt, there is really no point going through effort to get there. Very smoky place with old food menu and irritating hits from 70s and 80s.There is absolutely no vibe in there.Just some confused tourists, several expats enjoying burgers and beers. Definitely not on my list to see again any time soon. Avoid

Author: Rasoul K
Title: Very bad
Review: One days before we tried orkid ria , for 2nd night we decide to try some where near to our hotel ', so we went to this restaurant , 1: service is very bad and not clean really 2: good not taste specially prawn 3 : price , we really got shock even price is higher than orkid ria

Author: EmilyS8712
Title: Friendly staff, nice food
Review: Our 1st time visit and once we entered the staff immediately welcome us.  The outlet is clean and variety kind of foods can be found here with reasonable price.  No regrets!

Author: elsiekLondon
Title: Average
Review: Despite the reviews our experience was not the best. The food was moderate. Started with spring rolls and satays which were ordinary - have easily had better elsewhere. The sizzling chicken was fresh and tasty but the spare ribs were almost inedible. The fried ice cream dessert kinda worked. But what was most irritating was the speed at which everything was served. Seemed we no sooner had we finished one course then the next plate was arriving. Have never been pushed to eat a meal so fast but perhaps this was caused by the line of customers waiting for our table. Oh - and this was the first restaurant in Batu Ferringhi to charge us corkage

Author: Steven_Lim193-
Title: Unable to locate the area
Review: I used waze to locate the area but to unavailable... i guess this place is either shutdown or move someone else.

Author: Silent88
Title: My Dining Experience In Pizza Hut, Aeon Tebrau City, Johor Bahru
Review: Favorite restaurant for pizza by local and office staff. Offer variety of pizzas. Mid range of price. Suitable for family and friend. Restaurant cleanliness and customer service can be improved further.

Author: Nomad814140
Title: Really terrible service
Review: Been sitting for half and hour still nobody serve for food just let you sit with a pot of Chinese tea ....... no next time
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Pink_jules22Berkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Long wait and ran out of glasses to serve our drinks in!
Review: After reading lots of reviews, I expected a lovely meal experience. We had a 15 minute to be asked out drinks order. We ordered food and two soft drinks. When our drinks eventually arrived we were told that they had run out of glasses and we'd have to drink out of the bottles. Not acceptable for a mid-priced restaurant in Kuching. We left and went to the granary instead.

Author: my_dgrt
Title: Onion Soup is the Best
Review: The onion soup is impressive and the best in Penang, the service is top of the range too. They explained every dish very details.

Author: Rosalie1992Naples, Italy
Title: Odd restaurant
Review: I ordered the beef ribs, and I must say, was rather disappointed. The ribs were very fatty and actually didn't even taste good. However, since it took near 45 min to get the food, I didn't bother to send it back. The next day I tried the cheese burger and it was so overdone it was near burnt. It was also incredibly greasy. I'm not sure if they use cheap cuts of beef or what, but both beef dishes were really unappetizing. Shame because it is a bit over priced

Author: Seah_hazel
Title: Aunty lee food...
Review:
Ordered the otah , chup chai, sotong, beef redang , shrimp egg..

Food is not as what I have expected.. 

Sg beef redang taste better

Sotong sourish taste.. Not fantastic

Egg well liked by my kids..

Author: Ishak4788
Title: Too expensive and service too slow
Review: I’ll be there with my friend to eat good food and drink. But there are food quality is too bad no teast. Service was so bad. We wait for our food 30 minute. It really bad experience for us.

Author: JaisyaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A place for scrumptious mexican meals with the family
Review: This is my family's usual hang out place for mexican meals, very good selection of menus, cosy ambiance and very friendly staff. We normally ordered the same thing fajitas, mussels in habanero sauce and beef ribs. My boy loves their chicken nuggets and my girl will always go for their carlos skin. Overall, very satisfying meal everytime and always feel welcome here. Have tried their other menus mushroom soup, nachos, steak etc and these were good too.

Author: sKyf1ReSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Balinese food at its closest.
Review: Very decent place. Very good service. Food is quite authentic Balinese the way the Balinese people would like it. Tastes the way it should be. Sells pork dishes too, the way the Balinese would want it. Too bad some traditional balinese dishes like babi guling, pepesan ikan and tipat tjantok has been omitted due to time and ingredient constraints. However prices are well worth for local dining standards with large portions, and the larger 4-pax package is worth it too. Located in a quiet area thus convenient for parking. Worth a visit, and worth a return visit too.

Author: Sihwee
Title: Closed at 10.20pm
Review: Opening hours stated prominently that the food court is opened till 11pm but every shop is closed at 10.20pm!

Author: Jimmy SKuching, Malaysia
Title: Slow and steady
Review: Been few times here having dinner with client. If u a kind of rushing on something else, think twice before having meals here. Service is fine but too slow and steady. Food portion not that big except for the plate and spoon. Price wise as a local were slighlty high..can't blame the price because u need to pay the view as well. Overall good location..nice view...nice setting and environment and nice staffs.

Author: palanivelan
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Used to be my favourite food joint but it’s not as good as before but it’s still worth visit for the rumali roti , very soft and made to order , Punjabi tadka dhal also good

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent Nyonya restaurant in a convenient location
Review: We dropped by for lunch at Nyonya Suan on a quiet Thursday afternoon. It is conveniently located beside the Mahkota Parade shopping center. Our favourite dish was the steamed fish cooked in nyonya style. The garoupa was fresh and the spices hit the mark. It was a satisfying meal that warmed our stomach.

Author: aliaszaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: tom yam and green curry chicken
Review: This is a place i come for lunch with my cousin, a hen night dinner for my gf and normal dinner days with bf. Tom yam and green curry chicken, try the siakap steamed with lime and chilli as well. Aside from that, it transforms into a nice hang out place for a Friday night drink session with your friends

Author: Nanthy1349Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very bad experience
Review: To be frankly speaking, this restaurant is very expensive and adapt double standard food charge for takeaway food during mco period. To illustrate this, i went to this restaurant drng lunch for takeaway food. I ordered crab curry (only curry), cabbage fry and mango chutney which cost rm 3 each but wat surprise me was that their chicken masala which cost rm 30... What the crap....before packing the chicken masala the waiter inform me that its rm12 per plate so i agreed to buy it but then when i saw the bil, it was written as rm30 per packet....and their reason was because its chicken masala so that why its expensive....hello dear devi's corner owner.....i can buy two whole chicken n cook briyani with rm 30....wat a scam kind of business you are handling....whn the customer is new you charge them differently compare to old customer...should complain them to higher authority....

Author: Adline11Bratislava, Slovakia
Title: Disappointinh
Review: We came for dinner there following the Trip Advisor reviews. There was a queue but we got a table pretty fast. After ordering, we waited forever to get the food. My bf ordered the double roasted pork with chili padi (which is supposed to be the greatest thing they have..) but turned out to be something like pork belly with cotton candy taste. I ordered some stir fried chicken with garlic & rice wine but again the taste was not great - I still wonder if I got what I ordered! So very big disappointment.

Author: Melissa zKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent tasty meals
Review: The meals serve here is generally tasty, if you do not compare to the absolutely authentic Balinese food from Bali. The portion of a plate, consist of meat, rice, crackers and salad is big enough to be shared between two light eaters or a very hungry one person. The drinks, a favourite of mine is Pulut Hitam, is very rich with enough amount of sugar included. Kids meal however is possibly over priced considering their portion is smaller and of little variety. Service however, I found a bit lacking. It is slow, and the waiters would wait around the counter, and not aware folks are trying to hail them for bills. It can be frustrating to get their attention unless you walk up to them. So, be patient and sooner or later, they can see a table with two or three people waving their hands.

Author: miyumi83Nara, Japan
Title: Bad service, Bad tea
Review: We think that the water has a bad smell. Maybe not many people has been noticed because everybody there was drinking happyly. But we could notice something was wrong in it. Only lady waitress was nice and considerate.We were SO excited about going to Harrods but it was disapointing.

Author: PrintArtIKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner for 2
Review: Compared to 2-3yrs ago food varieties was better more of western food. The menu is more of local.If I want local dish I can have it at norm eateries outside. Where are the smoked salmon, cold Cutts and etc...Sad to say I may think twice before coming back here again, unless there is a change in the buffet menu.Hilton menu is all western not local. All is not lost as for the service from the staff was excellent thanks to Dinesh, Ramesh and Awie who accommodate us on last minute requests. Last but not least food quality has to improve. I only enjoy the roasted lamb and oyster. Curry laksa was oky very few vegetables the soup was missing. Please buck up to your Hilton standards in food excellence.

Author: hkustrgHong Kong, China
Title: Good food at a good price
Review: was a recommendation from our taxi driver. It was 3PM and we needed lunch. Went there and was quite surprised at the range of items on their menu. he food was quite good even though a little greasy. The biriyani was very good. Food very very reasonable. Can be quite spicy depending on what you pick. Need to have some idea on what to order.

Author: shinee5
Title: Good atmosphere, but food isn't that nice
Review: It is really a good place for gathering, drinks and food isn't that nice. Quite expensive.

Author: Yvonne LKL
Title: breakfast throughout the day
Review: This time I ordered avocado bacon on toast. It was light and just what I needed. I added lemon cake and it was soft and fluffy. My friend ordered the carbonara mushroom spinach and she said it tasted good with plenty of mushrooms and spinach since she is vegetarian.we had a lovely time coz the ambience with the water feature is really good. We can chat and enjoy the atmosphere.

Author: CryptorefAloha, Oregon
Title: Ok
Review: It's right outside the Hilton and so a good choice for a quick meal. Open air with great views of the river and sunset. Service was ok, they were busy but a couple of gaps when we needed some attention. Loved the food. I had the butter chicken, it was fried with a light sauce under it. Very crispy batter but not super thick. Price was fantastic. May just visit again before the business trip is over.

Author: Wangahyi
Title: Wide variety
Review: Wide variety of food but food quality was average. All the staff were attentive and polite. The restaurant is so spacious that you will not feel cramped at the buffet area.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Nicuma
Title: Amazing place to unwind
Review: I've heard of this place many times from friends and it's one of the popular places to chill and drink. Having been there myself, it's not just a place for drinks but the food there is actually not bad. I can understand why people come here. Besides the choices of beers, cocktails and shooters,the the food menu is diverse and for the price is very reasonable. From Indian, Asian to Western dishes made available, one can have a proper meal or simple fingerfood to share amongst friends and family. Yes it does seem to be a place where families go to if you don't mind the music (which is at an appropriate volume) or people smoking. I had the nachos and wedges which was quite ok whilst a colleague had the chicken chop. Match that with a drink of your choice, be it alcoholic or not, it is indeed a great eatery if you are in Miri. The price is reasonable, a meal you can get for less than RM10 or if you go a bit western and heavy 30ish ringgit. The beers are reasonably priced as well so it won't break the bank at all. The ambiance is good and it's fine to have a conversation as the noise isn't deafening. A good place to go if you don't really know what you want to eat as the choices are aplenty. Recommended for sure.

Author: SkyMoria
Title: RACIST.BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE.EXPENSIVE
Review: The owner of this restaurant flip one of non malay stall own by old woman at baazar ramadhan miri. Throw boxes, everything into the drain.all Miri people know about this incident. Went to this restaurant before too, bad customer service.very slow service and food ain't cheap either..expensive yet no taste at all..racisttt!rude!!

Author: Jane9394Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Food
Review: I have eaten at The Uma a few times and it has never failed to give me excellant taste of food. I especially love the alpokat (avocado juice). There is a variety of main course. It comes in a set with meat, vegetables, sambal and some other stuff too.I truely recommend this restaurant if you are around Kota Damansara area.

Author: dandelion1684Baden
Title: zero star given
Review: Difficult to find parking. Overcrowded. Overpriced junk food. Poor customer services! Staff ignored calls to deliver drinks which were already paid at the counter and answered in a very ultimate impolite way that he will not attend to us if we ordered drinks at cashier counter. When confronted he claims we should order and pay to him, what a disgrace, why didn't he tell his cashier colleague/boss to stop taking drinks order at the counter then?? Never come back again - to all pelita's branches!

Author: toniandlewistravelsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Unbelievable vegan sushi!
Review: Amazing vegan sushi, edamame, wakame and miso soup! The service was great throughout our meal helping us to decide on which dish’s to order and the restaurant is really clean and very atmospheric! We were only in Kuala Lumpur a couple of days but would have definitely gone back if we were there for longer!

Author: Princess_Ace
Title: Must Try - LaLa Soup and Beef Noodle
Review: This is a coffee shop with free seating. Love the LaLa soup and beef noodle there. Need to go there early to avoid disappointment especially during weekend.

Author: GreenWorldPeopleMalaysia
Title: Getting worse!
Review: This is our third time to dine in. It’s ok to be located at the very end of the shop lot for its quietness. But the mosquito condition is still not controlled. We paid a 5 star hotel price to expect a five star grade of food. However, the taste of the food is getting blunt and poor quality comparing to the previous experience. Beside buy one get one free beer, we are not satisfied with the environment and the food this time. We don’t find any improvement but poorly condition, even though we have told the waiter/waitress every time after our experience. Sorry to say that, but this probable our last chance for this restaurant.

Author: Lizzie EKo Samui, Thailand
Title: Weird tableware
Review: Walked past many times and finally decided to try as we were interested in trying Malay food. Menu is very Chinese but a few Malaysian dishes. Beef rendang was good and Chinese dumplings good. Placeis quite pretty but what I found very strange was if you order draft beer it comes in a Chinese pot and you drink from a bowl! Having lived in Hong Kong for 5 years I've never seen this and told them to bring me a glass. Don't have glasses only metal containers. I'm sorry I don't get it. Probably wouldn't go again.

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Satay Celup
Review: Restaurant normally quite pack with diners yearning for satay celup. Surprising, its quite pricy to dine here.....also they have GST charges. Per stick of average size and all at same prices. The service OK as they have many staff. Not many of this sort of restaurant servicing this cuisine in Melaka. Another shop is downtown but that area is small.

Author: IkmalB11
Title: Box..wait what?
Review: I dont really like the idea to serve in box. The pasta was overcooked and watery. I wont come here again.

Author: SouthamptonStarlight
Title: Good views
Review: Buffet style. Lots of choices and plenty of food. Food warm but not hot due to having to go and collect. Service for drinks slow but great views over KL at night at 282m. Difficult to take photos because of light,reflections and rotations

Author: globalroadguy
Title: Cheating bar staff - check receipts and change
Review: This bar has good live music, pool tables and a nice atmosphere but some of the bar staff are blatantly trying to scam people out of money. When you order a drink they give you a receipt and then come back for the money later. The first receipt I got was for a different more expensive drink to what I ordered. When I pointed this out they claimed honest mistake. I gave them benefit of doubt. The person next to me at bar said "you have to chase them for your change otherwise they won't bring it". Sure enough next drink I paid for the bill was 18 ringitt. I accidentally handed over two twenties because I was jetlagged but realized my mistake as the barman walked off. I summoned him back and said "I just gave you two twenties can I have my change please". He immediately became aggressive and said I was lying and had only given him two tens (he still hadn't brought me change) and questioned why I would give two twenties for an 18 ringitt bill. I explained it was a mistake. I had just withdrawn cash from an ATM and had only had two drinks so I knew exactly how much money I had handed over. I stood my ground because after the earlier attempt to charge me for the wrong drink I was sure he was cheating me and going straight to aggressive is usually the sign of a cheat who has been caught. He then started to clench his first and make a punching action at me as if to warn me he would get violent. As I had no back up I opted to leave. It ruined an otherwise decent evening. The band were good. The atmosphere was nice. But I will be warning people that some of the staff there are not nice and are out to try and cheat people. The establishment should really not employ such types. Very disappointed.I was planning on becoming a regular as I've just moved to KL but I guess I'll find another place where I can trust the staff.

Author: CraigLaronta
Title: Coffee break
Review: Stop by Tang bistro for a coffee after having lunch at restaurant nearby Little India. Good heritage ambience and coffee is ok. Seems like they serve Many local food and will come back to try next round.

Author: misssk
Title: Authentic, good value, delicious.
Review: Very popular among locals, the food is fantastic. The flavours are explosive, with the combination of different spices used. Some dishes can be spicy but i'm sure can be adjusted for different tastes. Don't forget dessert! Definitely worth a visit!

Author: sheronlee
Title: Not Bad
Review: The restaurant is rather new and comfortable. The satay (chicken and pork) are tasty and succulent. However, the sauce is not to my liking.

Author: BJBudimanJaafar
Title: Change owner & change menu
Review: Already change ownership. Now offering pakistani brayani , tandoori etc. No more Malaysian and western cuisine. We are disappointed because we look forward to dine here and try some western and malaysian food with the good rating.

Author: muratd247
Title: Tasty
Review: Small restaurant in an elegant mall. Good place to stop by and have a quick  but elegant food.  Tender beef over risotto was exeptionally tasty. Loved it.

Author: SLL36
Title: Old Gold
Review:
Old Gold
Yes though much longer but still as good.
The meat may not be competitive with new kids on the block but it’s sauce still better.
Love the pineapples in the satay sauce

Author: vincybieHong Kong, China
Title: Cheated on the Park
Review: We went for a late lunch at Chinoz on the park as we were staying at Mandarin Oriental. We dined at Chinoz before quite several times, the last time was maybe 3, 4 years ago even on one of the special Valentine's Day and it was somewhat special dating place for us whenever we're in Kuala Lumpur. However this time was a very disappointing encounter from the very beginning. We have noticed that the interior hasn't been changed much to be humble, AT ALL to be honest, and their sofa cushion cover were filthy and unacceptably stained to an extend that It gave me goosebumps sitting on it even with my long skirt and the table that the host seated us was not even properly wiped! When we tried to tell the staffs that the table vicinity area smelled like someone vomited, they just simply spoke in Malay "bring them to the dining side" without apologising. At that time there were 3 or 4 staff members standing around us, they might as well be invisible as they were acting in that way. To start with, we ordered edamame and spider roll. For the main we chose quarter roasted chicken with capsicum vinaigrette sauce and seafood spaghetti aglio olio. The food was served to our table in a timely manner. The taste wise was not spectacular but reasonably good. Menu was tired and worn out, tearing apart just like the furniture. We can see plenty of man power in Chinoz but even some places with half of the staff provides better service with less and able to be more attentive to customers. I particularly did not appreciate server collecting plates etc from behind our back which I think it's somewhat unacceptable and rude. One of the Chinese lady server even took away the chilli flakes shaker and my OWN carried cayenne pepper powder while we're still enjoying our main course. With this last experience, coming back is very unlikely unless the management does something to upgrade the restaurant focus to service and the decor....especially the sofas!!! For the Prices of the menu items and the below average experience on everything from the hardware to the software of the restaurant. This is truly a tremendous disappointment on the park.

Author: JeretangwkSingapore
Title: Overrated Chicken Chop
Review: First of all....the restaurant doesn't open on time..(not at 11am, sometimes at 12 noon).The chicken chop is decent in size in taste, but definitely not the best. It is definitely not worth the hassle/trip to go down there for it other than it's cheaper compared to Singapore.However, the tze char bee hoon deserve a mention. It is one of the best ones i've tasted, can even put most restaurants (Malaysia and Singapore) to shame. It has sufficient 'wok hei' with succulent prawns and fish slices. The gravy is very savory and has sweetness from the seafood. Be warned the portion is huge, takes 2 to finish it.

Author: andeeyeoKuching, Malaysia
Title: Fine Food Falls Short
Review: The music was loud. The bar should have been sectioned off.Then there was the food. We ordered the All Day Big breakfast which comprised of very tough bacon, oversalted baked beans, runny fried eggs and get this, a slice of hard french bread!(Sigh... Wrong bread)And,The Mixed Grill platter comprising of a thinly sliced lamb chop, overdone heavily salted pork chop, an overboiled piece of rib, and a dollop of unrecognizable pumpkin. Yes, the pork chop had potential, and the pumpkin was flavourful but, everything else was a letdown.(Double Sigh...)Also, being an open concept restaurant, kitchen should keep their talking to a minimum. On the plus side, the wait staff were really, really good. So kudos to them. Oh, the beer was well chilled. 10 points... For the beer. Well done, Heineken.

Author: KoGu_14Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Not recommended to go if you want to dine
Review: The beer was nice. Excellent sea view and can relaxing mind and boost mood. The worst part what happen was when order the food. First we ordered chicken poppers, ok nice with BBQ sauce... then next we ordered another food and after 15 minutes, the waiter came and told us, the kitchen is closed! We like.. damn... It was just 19:30MYT evening... how come can close that soon. With suspicious, we asked another waiter, she explained that the kitchen is closed for 1 hour due to lot of people order foods which the cook need to prepare and will takes time. Ohh come on.. What a poor arrangement.... Break the mood...

Author: Cherylshin1021
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Excellent service, great food! We really enjoy our night here! Thanks to Adli,azu,fajar, chef brett and chef nathan.

Author: Summon_2828
Title: Tasty !!
Review: Great and tasty pizza with unique pizza flavour to choose. The service there was great too!! Definitely must try out once!!

Author: perseuskualalumpur
Title: Not as good as before
Review: Always busy, generally fast paced service. Some good dishes, gulai tumis  disappointing,  fried roast pork  too sweet.

Author: Ebyae
Title: Food
Review: Good food. Enjoyed the environment and vibes the most. Love the Nangka pizza. Dine in is the best experience

Author: maeltoshio
Title: Just Ok
Review: Nice place to hang out with friends while listening to the live music performance..the menu is most of vegetarian and healthy dishes..for taste wise just ok...No harm to try

Author: tpLong
Title: Coffee & Lunch
Review: Nice place for coffee & relax.  The waffles served are delicious.  Just one comment, Coffee is not hot enough.
Restaurant: New Chapter by The Owls Cafe

Author: rajamanusingapore
Title: needs a wake up call
Review: located next to Mahkota parade mall this restaurant has thrived on group travellers, particularly the organised tours and the business is so good that they ignore your bookings or reservations made prior to the visit.the person at the cash counter ( he could be the owner ) definitely needs a lesson or two in public relations. courtesy calls you to make a simple apology if you fail to have the table ready for reservations. here it is the opposite - so what if you have made the reservations. we are not ready for you and you just wait until a table is ready. why in the first place accept reservations then.this attitude may be acceptable to the uninitiated. let me tell you there are countless other nonya food options in malacca, cheaper and with better cuisine. you do not have to depend on nonya suan.food is nothing special. they do not have the sambal belachan which many diners of nonya food also enjoy.suggest you do not waste your money and time trying to dine at nonya suan.

Author: whistleblower42Lakes Entrance Victoria
Title: Nice surroundings, food average
Review: Nice surrounding give you a feel for places history.I visited because this restaurant was rated top 10 restaurants in chinatown KL , but left disappointed with the food, the beef rendang was tough and not overly flavousome, the rice ,chcken and entree dishes were just ok,look maybe i am used good qaulity beef we get in Austalia but i love chinese food and have eaten in two better restaurants, one in Malacca and one in KL suburbs that had better food, service was good but they were not overly busy on the Monday night we visited.

Author: idie Z
Title: Giftshop and cafe
Review: Shop that offer merchandises of Mamee product (famous Malaysian junk food). Taking photo are allowed in the premises, they event have place like a photo booth. Further inside the is a cafe with very nice ambience.

Author: Ali_HawkinsWellington, New Zealand
Title: Show is good, food is okay ...
Review: The cabaret show her is really fun - dances and costumes from each of the cultural groups and states of Malaysia are showcased here and it's great. I particularly enjoyed the items from Sabah and Sarawak ... indigenous people with particular dances and elaborate costumes. It's good. There's an opportunity for you to get up and dance with the performers, which I did - that was great fun and they are really gentle - they don't do it just to embarrass you, like performers in other shows would. The buffet here is extensive - there is a lot to choose from, the hot dishes I tried had beautiful flavours. The soup was good and the salads fresh and nice. Lots of desserts to choose from too, including fresh fruit, which was appreciated. You can get photos of yourself here too, that's another plus.

Author: jeannietung81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst peranakan food
Review: After reading the good review in tripadvisor do we decide to give it a try. And the taste of the food is very normal and nothing special about it. My husband said I cook better than them. The fried chicken( forgot the dish name)The cendol is worst than a Indian stall who selling it. And the boss face is stuck up type. I would not recommend it to anyone.

Author: DariusL109
Title: Delightful meal
Review: When I came for the first time the service was excellent, I suppose as a foreigner I was attended by the manager who spoke good English. They asked whether I'm familiar with banana leaf food, did I enjoy the food, etc.I've went here a few more times. The food is really good (9 out of 10). The banana leaf meal is to die for. the time I tried naan it was so so. once papadum was already softened so I mentioned it at the counter and since then it's always fresh and crispy. The manager is always improving the situation if something isn't done well. The staff is cool and friendly. It's so nice to see the guys improve every time you come.

Author: AllysonChia
Title: A memorable night:)
Review: Let's talk about the food which deemed to be the main focus of this whole review, food portion is slightly small compareably to the slightly high in the price. Not recommended if you are a big eater. "Godfather" & "squid ink fried rice" are the BOMBS OF THE NIGHT:) Beautiful ambience. (It would be better if the other group were having some sort of celebration could control the voice volume, but it's not easy I know) < tolerate that Decent service from the service crew. Friendly indeed:)

Author: AzrinaA25
Title: To Management- Upgrade your service!
Review: I come in and I know what to order but it takes forever to get the waiters attention. 20 minutes before I managed to flag someone down to take down my order AFTER I've actively been calling and signalling several waiters who kept telling me to wait. After that, AN HOUR before I got my food. I came in BEFORE 7PM and got my food at 8:20PM!!! This was absolutely unacceptable. DON'T COME HERE IF YOU HAVE PLANS AFTER! People who have came in around the same time have gotten food but waiters were not aware that my table did not get food. They are not vigilant!Turns out, my order did not go through, and I had to ask where is my food before they went and checked. We had to go and ask the waiter what the problem is in which the waiter gave A SLEW OF EXCUSES and said that he placed the order but it didn't get printed, we are understaffed, please understand etc. Excuse me, I want to be served food not excuses! At the very least COME TO OUR TABLE AND EXPLAIN WHAT HAPPEN INSTEAD OF MAKING US WAIT AN HOUR! TERRIBLE SERVICE! WAITERS ARE NOT VIGILANT! In the end, I couldn't even enjoy the food because I was so angry. My dinner was ruined.TO MANAGEMENT - I use to like Ben's, upgrade your service before you lose more customer. After sharing my experience tonight, I actually found out a lot of people I know had the same experience. You have a reputation now.

Author: Michael5425081955Johor, Malaysia
Title: Absolutely average!
Review: Well after staying several times at the Copthorne Waterfront in Singapore, this sister hotel Grand Millenium is well sjort of being Grand. Free breakfast at the Mill Cafe, but every morning there is a queue for staff to take yiu name and room number then print a bill. IT IS FREE SO WHY BILL???Food is at best average, and considering the Malay ability to conjure up tasty food, this is not inspiring or worth getting out of bed for!

Author: 321juliustShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Lala bee hoon.
Review: Never expect to be here after visited sin sze ye and si sze ye temple. Looking around many ordered the lala bee hooñ. Had a try and the soup was nice. Glad to had a chance to try it. Suggest to be at the shop before 11.30 am. After 12.30pm, it packed during lunch break especially during mco whereby the seat is limited.

Author: Yasmine BGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Nice enough but nothing special
Review: Based on the reviews I was expecting something special, but it is not - a bare room with a few tables, local food prepared adequately, but I have had much better in Penang. Quite a long wait for the food, options on the menu that weren't available, that sort of thing. Not somewhere I would go out of my way for.

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Nice setting..
Review: I walked in looking at the setup but found it a little overpriced compared to the quite average quality of fare that they serve.But the choice of items is quite huge.

Author: esthercyt93Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It wasn't worth it..
Review: My husband and I had Kampachi's Sunday lunch buffer spread. I was very excited but it was a let down. The grilled seafood (crab legs, flower crabs, river prawn) was so dry and mushy which tells us it's not fresh and frozen to a point I thought I was watching Frozen 3. RM6 for a cup of green tea? That's a rip off. The overall buffet spread wasn't up to par as choices of food are limited. The place that we sat was warm and could hardly feel the air-conditioner. The only thing that salvaged the dining experience was the young teppanyaki chef who cooked our beef perfectly, fresh sashimi platter and that friendly chef who served us a bowl of teriyaki beef bowl (stationed next to the seafood grill). We didn't even bother to ask for the complimentary Birthday dessert and decided to leave. The price that we pay, was not worth it at all. I'd rather head down to Mitasu @ Central Plaza - affordable, standards and quality are consistent despite me revisiting that place several times.

Author: nickjboothCambridge, England
Title: Food okay; poor service & lousy management
Review: I was visiting HRC KL for the second time. I had enjoyed a very pleasant evening during my holiday in 2009, but tonight's meal was a fiasco. Very bad service from beginning to end. The waiter was unable to take our order without needing constant checking and correction on our part. Despite having confirmed that we didn't want cheese on the burger that my Dad ordered, it turned up 15 minutes later with cheese on it (actually it was completely the wrong burger).They took the burger back and prepared a fresh one, which turned-up just as the others in our party were finishing their food. When my Dad asked for mustard, the waiter disappeared for another 10 minutes! Eventually the mustard was found and brought by one of the waitresses. The straw that broke the camel's back was when the candle on our table was snatched away to give to another table who couldn't read their menus!I complained to the manager (Zane) who was barely able to understand or speak English. He took no ownership of the problem and left it to the waiter to deduct a paltry 10% from the bill. I was having none of this and went up several times to the tills to complain to the manager again & again. Eventually I got a 20% discount.I was very disappointed by Hard Rock Cafe Kuala Lumpur. Its standards of service appear to have slipped badly and is a very poor reflection on what is a wonderful city. I certainly shall not be visiting there again and would recommend very strongly that you search out other less expensive and more attentive options for dining in this city which is rich in superb dining options.

Author: gnurkOdense, Denmark
Title: Very overrated
Review: Design 9/10, food looks 8/10, food taste: 6/10, location 4/10 service. Service outside categorie. Ate twice (don't ask why we came back, probably the easy location). On both occassions we had to wait one hour before being brought our food.

Author: MargPilgerToronto, Canada
Title: Great food, great price
Review: Every day we looked forward to breakfast here. The people were always friendly and the food always wonderful. We became "regulars" here. The roti here are great - try roti with bananas and honey or roti with egg and cheese. Also the nasi lemak with mango lassi. Whether you are a vegetarian or carnivore, you will love this place, day or night. Stay to watch soccer with the locals. Tgs is a gem.

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner spoilt by terribly long wait
Review: We had dinner here on a Sunday night. Placed our orders and waited and waited and waited. Some food came out first, some ate first, and even when finished, the steak and chicken had still not been served. This is quite unacceptable for a dining establishment like this. On another note, food was good. The chicken was really delicious and we enjoyed our carbonara pasta which was swirled and mixed in the cheese wheel. But can someone please do something about waiting too long for the food, or at least warn the customers upon taking orders so that expectations are met.

Author: Yang2011
Title: Insufficient food & overly long queue
Review: Do timely supplement the food and do balance out the items. There were numerous incident where the stall was left with chicken rice but already run out of chicken.

Author: DMKL01
Title: Great food, service & ambiance
Review: Great design and the rooftop location really makes it feel unlike a mall-based restaurant. Delicious food - the burrata starter is wonderfully creamy and the home made pasta dishes are excellent. The service (from all staff members) is what makes Nero Nero stand out. But a big shout out to Rasel who was friendly, knowledgeable and made our evening truly enjoyable. We will definitely be back......

Author: MegzTravelPenang, Malaysia
Title: Did not live up to its reputation
Review: The Gulai House Restaurant is linked to the Datai Hotel in Langkawi. It specializes in Malaysian and Indian cuisine. It is approximately 45mins drive from the Cenang Beach area and is located in the middle of the rain forest. You definitely need a car to get there and also have to be prepared to drive through a winding hilly dark road. It's most suitable for people who are living at the Datai Hotel and are picked up and dropped off by the hotel buggy. The restaurant is beautiful with a rustic ambience and the service is very good but not exceptional.The food is very expensive and below average. The presentation of the food is a big part of the culinary experience especially in an expensive fancy restaurant and they completely failed on that. The vegetable wok was a combination of different crunchy vegetables with little sauce and no flavour. The garlic naan was crispy with no garlic flavour and was hard to chew. The fish in curry sauce was insipid with a very strong flavour of coconut milk. The only good dishes were the grilled meat platter and the prawn in coconut curry. To top it all we ordered their signature dessert called Crepe Suzette which was a complete let down. The preparation was interested and the F&B Director Ms. Noorani has tried to give it an Asian touch by using ingredients like lemongrass, cinnamon and star anise. However, the Grand Marnier and Liquer completely overpowered any other flavours. When it was presented it looked like 4 pieces of squished crepes floating in some brown sauce so once again the presentation wasn't appealing and so was the taste. Our bill was RM650 for 4 items, 1 dessert and 2 non alcoholic beverages. Even if I paid half that price I wouldn't recommend this place for the culinary experience.

Author: nicky456458Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Lunch with my friends
Review: Visit again in restaurant for dimsum, seem like never provide good service.. several issue was faced: 1. Mod the floor during we eat somemore near to our table, the smell also very strong.. 2. Return dim sum but didn't talk anything and never revert us what is going on. We don't want sorry, really up sad on it, never come back again to here...

Author: koshpatPenang, Malaysia
Title: One time visit
Review: This restaurant is located inside the historical landmark of Penang, Fort Cornwallis.Good for a one time visit. Food is okay but oily and very small portion. Ratio is like a big bowl of rice and 1 piece of chicken and 1 teaspoon of vegetables (referring to "Nyonya" on the menu). If you intend to only serve 1 piece of chicken (like a "fine local dining"..), please just give us 2 tablespoon of rice instead. What am I gonna do with the remaining rice after the first two mouthful of rice and chicken/vege? Overpriced. Staff can't wait to take away your food, even if you have not finished. Noisy patrons during lunch. Quiets down after 2.30pm if you want to have a peaceful lunch.Park your vehicle at the Fort Cornwallis car park opposite the police station.Entrance fee to the fort is RM10 for locals and RM20 for foreigners. The entrance fee will be deducted from your bill if you dine above RM30.Look for Fort Cornwallis on Waze to reach this place. Happy dining.

Author: derekang1980Singapore
Title: Excellent set of crew
Review: Food was mediocre, a particular kitchen staff weren't so nice and patient (Malay guy but was wearing short chef cap not the tall one, manning the porridge station on 17th Aug), but the rest of the chef staff were fantastic! What impressed me the most was the team work displayed amongst the team members. They don't remain static at their pre-assigned stations, but were seen assisting one another wherever help is needed or whenever a guest is waiting. But the creme ala creme, is of course their service staff. Prompt and warm greetings at the start, immediately ushered swiftly to your preferred table. Coffee or tea appears like magic after you've indicated your preference. And for coffee it's not your normal brewed in large quantities type, individually freshly brewed using French press and fresh powder. Staff are efficient and hardworking! And trust me they work with challenging work loads, as I've see. Guests pile their tables with food one second and ask them to be cleared the next cause their kids don't like them! And yet they do this with a smile, although I would have dumped them on their heads for wasting this much food. But these gracious hosts even bothered to lower themselves down to even ask the kids what they'd like instead. Worthy of mention is Salim, who remembered our last visit and preference. Offering us our usual double espresso and latte despite our coffees, this shows he truly knows what we like. But we decline since the coffee was already prepared. His attention to details such as clearing of tables, refill of coffee shows his ability and manage his team well! Truly deserving of a management position as his qualities as well as personality exuded one of great potential!

Author: ChoojxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One time is enough, and if you have a group of 8.
Review: Oh dear. So much hype over this restaurant. First - the service. We went in a group of 6 (walked in, as we were told over the phone that they only accept reservations for a group of 8; and will only hold the table for 10 minutes). Arrived at about 7:30pm, managed to get a table but was told that we can only have the table for... 1 hour. We ended up switching tables after our 1 hour was up (to another table of the same size at the end of the restaurant - what's the diff, NN?) Second - the food. Though the ribs looked yummy, it was actually dry and tasteless. We ordered two platters but ended up only eating 1. Babi guling was OK. But the RM18 maggi goreng & fried rice... I've tasted better at a mamak nearby for a fraction of the price. I'll have to say that the only thing I liked was the environment and cocktails (mojto & margarita) were good. Nope, never returning again. Food's not that cheap. Overrated. Wasn't a good experience dining here. But that's just me. Or maybe it wasn't my lucky day. P/S: Valet parking available so you don't have to go ard hartamas hunting for a parking space.

Author: LaTravellingAmbivertLondon, United Kingdom
Title: I wish I could recommend
Review: Unfortunately, this is the worst Nandos I’ve experienced in three countries. It’s found in the basement of the Pavilion shopping mall- which also adds to the level of disappointment, as the mall is an immaculate, visual space. The service and food were equally poor with a lacklustre attitude from the staff, dirty menus and poorly flavoured food. I wouldn’t recommend eating here, as there are many other food options in and around the area.

Author: ScrumBumJakartaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Demise of an Ikon
Review: I remember in the day, the green man having a reputation for the finest hangover breakfast in KL. A true British fry up with tea. Hmmm with the original owner moving on, whats left is not quite there. The food was okay, the service in okay and the atmosphere is..... okay ish. Sadly nothing to get out of bed for. The legend is sadly dead.

Author: StefvgiTurnhout, Belgium
Title: Great atmosphere and tasty food!
Review: We visited this restaurant for brunch. The welcoming by the personnel was really friendly and made us feel at home immediately. The decoration of the interior makes you wonder if you are eating in a cosy museum rather than in a real restaurant.I had the sandwich with salmon, with crunchy French bread, a little bit of olive oil and some fresh vegetables. Very tasty for a reasonable price!

Author: SaurabhBajCanton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: Best Indian food - probably in whole of Malaysia
Review: Well, I have lived for more than 25 years in India and i don't think you will find such great Indian food easily even in India. We ate here numerous times during our stay and every time trying something new from the menu - and each and everything was a delicious surprise. We observed many customers complimenting the staff - and the staff taking it straight faced. Probably they are used to it :). The restaurant is located in Pantai Tengah area right next to the Frangipani resort.

Author: eddie s
Title: great chicken tikka
Review: If you want a cheap lunch visit NZ curry.  The location at GTower gets crowded but is a terrific spot.  Line up at the counter or sit down and order the chicken tikka and naan.  For 4 dollars, you get a great meal

Author: amir829Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood in the City
Review: If you are looking for good seafood place in town with reasonable pricing and fast service this is the place.My favourite dish here is Chili Crab to go together with Mantao. I must say this is the best Mantao I ever tasted. Crispy outside and very very soft inside. Best to consume while its hot. You have a choice to site outside with no air-condition or inside with air-condition. The only drawback to sit inside is the echoes of the room and it can be a little bit annoying when its full and hard to communicate with each other.Facilities wise is ok. Expect a typical chinese restaurant set up nothing fancy nor bling-bling. Service is fast with very helpful staff to accommodate your needs.Beside seafood the restaurant also serve Steamboat.

Author: Bboy2017
Title: hygiene problem
Review: While seated at the counter and watching the cook preparing food, I came to the realization that Jyu Raku has serious hygiene problem.What I saw really put me off. The guy, after frying the chicken teppan, he placed it on the same, unwashed cutting board (which he and another guy used earlier, to prepare raw meat and seafood) and cut it in pieces. Everyone knows that is a BIG NO NO! That is cross-contamination!Throughout the whole time I was there, they didn't wash the board at all. When it got too wet, they just wiped it with a white cloth (or shall I say red) stained with the blood of raw meat and seafood.We voiced our concern, and hopefully, something will be done about it.

Author: Newfie013
Title: Closed...still?
Review: We were in Kuching at the end of December for 4 days and it was never open.  There was no sign to say why or if it was going to reopen.

Author: 677sylviawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fine dining with good ambience... high end dining place
Review: The cafe offers fusion local Penang food with an enhancement. Though the price is a bit pricey in Malaysia context, it’s worth a visit for the overall experience. The modification to the local food gives u a totally upgraded version of local food to a brand new experience. Well, only Malaysian know what’s the difference. There are many variety of food and the place is also good for photo taking. Enjoy the local food with a slightly modified version.

Author: caricarimakan
Title: bad experience
Review: food is cold and left there from morning to night. place is unhygenic, staff is not presentable, food is cheap and it draw a certain sort of crowd. only recently I was sat next to taxi driver who spad on the floor a couple of time before he got into his taxi which park next to shop. not a place to dine with yr girlfrient or in good company

Author: jade128
Title: Beef noodles
Review: Thet serve up really tasty beef noodles (dry). A bowl of beed noodles came with a small beef broth/soup with bean sprouts. Both were really good! Serving was on the smaller side. Good enough for me to order my second bowl

Author: Lynn & Mark P
Title: Rubbish
Review: Unable to get any service,waited for half an hour or more to try and get a drink, so we left and found another bar.

Author: FLKS8
Title: Early dinner
Review: Nice view and relaxing ambience but the food is average and pricy for the quality. The servers are very nice and polite.

Author: Hatt17Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Staff are fantastic!
Review: Called in here to shelter from the KL rain and was glad I did, all the staff were friendly and helpful, food was delicious. The Indian waitress in particular was the most helpful and loveliest person I’ve met whilst in Malaysia!

Author: Travelqueen7177Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service nice ambience but over priced indian food
Review: Paid 400+ we had 2 alcoholic drinks. I found the food to be way too over the top and can;t understand the raves and rants-am a foodie at all the kl hot spots but i will not be returning. Very good fish sodhi but this kid of food you can get at some amama or parti ama's hse without this kind of price.

Author: abby y
Title: Yummy juicy sizzling beef
Review: A bi-weekly visit restaurant, it's a good choice for friend's gathering / celebration restaurant. However, it listed in my dinner place's option. Do make a reservation, and specific on the smoking/non-smoking area.

Author: JanieBS1Bristol
Title: Don’t eat here unless you speak Tamil
Review: Specifically asked for a dish with chicken breast. Double checked with the waiter that the chicken was breast and no bones. He confirmed it was breast only. Guess what? I got chicken with all bones. When I complained they went off to have a laugh together. Also the food that you order comes from a curry counter where it has been sat all day. Don’t eat here.

Author: 4SUM
Title: /// Terrible Food & Worst Services ///
