Review: Ordered Beef Rendang & Nasi Lemak.Before complainting about terrible food, I have to comment about the waiter's attitude first.  In a word, they (especially the Asian guy) were so rude.  They don't even know what the service is.  I guess these rude behavior of the employees were caused by the owner's ignorance and lack of interest in the employee's service education.  I am not going to mention how rude they were, because seems like many people already knew about it. For Beef Rendang, I have never eaten such cold, tough Rendang in particular. I was so shocked when they brought Rendang dish to my table, because I couldn't tell what kind of food that was. I even asked the waiter "Is this Beef Rendang?"  The waiter replied to me that, "Yes, It is Beef Rendang".  I wondered if these people knew about "Rendang".  If they thought it was Rendang, the restaurant don't know nothing about how to cook.In addition to terrible food & worst service, I am obligated to pay "10% Service Charge" no matter what.  Although I didn't receive any kind of service but sarcasm.  Please be used in cooking development and employee training.  Until then, I strongly against to recommend this restaurant to the public.

Author: Alan Y
Title: Not as good as before
Review: I used to come here every week when the restaurant first started. Back then, it has good variety of food ranging from sashimi to yakitori to don to many more and all taste very nice. However for the past few visits this year, I find the food quality and service has declined tremendously. My last visit, the sashimi is not fresh and my grilled squid was served stale. There was not much attention after my complaint though. No acknowledgement, no apology and it takes a while for the server to come back to us. My favourites Japanese restaurant in Publika is still Edo Ichi.

Author: ceberus07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average service and low in hygiene.
Review: I was having lunch with my friends there. I noticed a few things happened there and one of them are a chinese barista guy wasn't friendly at all. Before we entered, he raised his voice on us telling us no outside drink allowed well at least tell us nicely. We wanted to go other place to eat but he came and told us to enter but only drink finish before enter but we threw our drinks instead. We sat near the counter area and I noticed that guy plays phone at times without alert. Instead of him doing the job but he ordered the staffs to do the job but he just stood there and does his phone stuffs. Overall, the floor staffs were nice and friendly so credits for them. Food was good too and I would give 5 but due to one guy's service on us I had to give 2. Please refer to him and do something pls thanks

Author: KayaToastedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Only nonya chang was great
Review: Went there mid-afternoon so absolutely no crowd. The shop keepers were very friendly. Was there on a Friday so no popiah but had the laksa, rojak and nonya chang. The laksa was not too bad, more like noodles in a light, salty curry sauce but could be I am used to more lemak laksa. The rojak was ok but nothing to write home about. What I really enjoyed (and will go back for when I return to Malacca) is the Nonya chang. It was very tasty - had that great balance of sweet and salty and it was stuff full of meat. I preferred it to the one from East & West Rendezvous

Author: PyaeSoneOo
Title: Great Asian Delights
Review: Not ideal if you're looking for excellent continental flavours, but if you want local flavour, this is the place.

Author: JoshChuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh ingredients but taste not well balanced
Review: Ordered Ayam Buah Keluak, sweet potato leaves, tamarind prawns, lime juice and Chendol. The ingredients were very fresh but the dishes were either too salty or too sweet or sour. Lacking in balanced of favour. It is really home cooked food. Much better than the mass produced food in the other Melaka Raya restaurants.

Author: guillermom351Milwaukee, Wisconsin
Title: Not five stars for food
Review: After a week of conference food, I was excited to try this restaurant after reading the Trip Advisor reviews. Service was courteous and prompt. I ordered the shrimp balls as an appetizer and shrimp pad Thai. Both were good, but certainly didn't merit five stars. The shrimp balls were fried and it was difficult to taste any shrimp. There was shrimp in the pad thai, but they were rubbery. My experience was more like a three star restaurant.

Author: Sharon W
Title: Horrible Food and Service
Review: The food was tasteless and horrible.  Really expensive for the quality of food served.  The waiters were rude and unattentive.  Had to remind them over and over again on our orders

Author: JaneWongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food is good but not the chendol
Review: This is located at the adjoining row of shops at the far end of Mahkota Parade shopping mall. Just opposite Macdonald.The food is nice especially the crackers which is free to sample. However we were disappointed with the Chendol which is made from soy milk instead of coconut milk. Fortunately the Ice-kacang saved the day as it was very nice. There was lots of ingredients with free-pour of gula melacca sauce. Very yummy.

Author: Christina G
Title: Not so good!
Review:
We ordered Chilli crab, kangkung belacan, butter chicken and baked fish. 

The food is tasteless and not worth. We did not enjoy the food. Not recommended. 

A  for garnishing  and F for the taste. Very disappointing.  

Price is reasonable.

Author: wilbers49
Title: Awesome place!!
Review: Be sure to visit and ask for Azlan with his special mix - Blue sky heaven. Azlan and his drink is in the picture ;)

Author: klthunderstormsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: great night out
Review: i went with some friends. tried the roasted pumpkin salad, a couple of pastas, some snacks. the bread and dips were lovely. the staff were very attentive and friendly, the food was fresh, well-cooked and presented beautifully. nice selection of wines and craft beer. the only complaint i would have is that the place is pretty packed (even on weeknights) and you may have to wait for a while before being seated.

Author: Shaun Y
Title: Meh
Review: It was meh was all I could describe it. Overpriced and overrated, it is a haven for hipsters. Basically, if you want poached eggs that taste sour and overcooked scrambled eggs; you've arrived at the correct place.

Author: shahrukhqz
Title: Food was good in taste and presentation was also good
Review: Went there with my family and the food turned out to be pretty good compared with other restaurants offering same cuisine.

Author: FA29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hit and Miss
Review: Some said Hit and Miss. Others said price could be too expensive. True enough.Chicken feet and corgee are worth the price. So these are a hit.I also ordered Braised seafood yee mee at the price of RM26! The taste was terrible. Prawns overcooked. Snapper had a weird taste like it has expired. Took too long to prepare the meal that I almost cancelled it. Overpriced but tasteless.If you asked me, that kind of quality worth only RM5. You can get better yee mee at any hawker stall. Waiters are lackadaisical. No follow-up on the order. Restaurant decoration is nice though. My suggestion: Skip this restaurant. Not worth the price.

Author: 2019hanuman
Title: Great nasi bojari
Review: Always my favourite place to go in klcc as the other dining options are really quite poor in my opinion. Their nasi bojari is my favourite and the quality has always maintained throughout.

Author: Daniel_DTKYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Worst FOOD EVER Tasted
Review: My plan was to bring my girlfriend to a romantic candle light Surprise birthday dinner. We ordered a 9 course meal (vege), 7 course meal dinner and a pre-ordered birthday chocolate crystal ball thingy dessert (which is the only good stuff) for a bill of about RM1.2k (USD 270). If you're here for fine dining then it's HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED, because the food are way too salty. we have tasted the worst risotto in our whole life, it's SO SALTY!! Basically there is not even 1 dish which taste ok. But apart for all terrible taste, they do give free flow of bread to fill our stomach, the environment, ambience and the service is good. Even so, it's not worth the price we are paying.

Author: SimPKSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonable priced meal
Review: We had lunch at this coffee shop. A typical eating place located in a suburban like environment. The server advised us to have the small portion serving each of chicken congee, hokien noodle, wat tan hor (flat noodle fried with won ton meat in gravy). The small portion when served was really large and sufficient for one person. The hokien noodle was fried with dark sauce and the noodle appeared black and simmering in hot gravy. All the main entrees were delicious. The Malaysian coffee went well with the meal. To find such a location serving such nice food was really a treasure.

Author: Steve A
Title: the new Tapas in town.
Review: Just like the other tapas restaurant across town, this one surely easy to find. strategic location near Jonker street. And it serve PORK?? A must visit and meet the Spanish Chef Traba. Kudos.

Author: HuanWL
Title: Grossly overpriced and mediocre taste
Review: My first impression when I stepped in, was how snobbish the staff was, and how certain people get the VVIP treatment while other customers ( myself included ) are just shoved to one corner of the restaurant. Service was prompt...but after only after strenuous efforts to capture the attention of the waiters. ( Once again proving that I was among the "unwanted" in the restaurant. ) Now we shall proceed to their one saving grace, the food. First of all, food prices are atrocious...overpriced for the kind of food being served. Ordered the butter chicken but the order was mixed up with tandoori chicken. After letting them know about the mistake, they were quick to change the dish. But I wasn't pleased that all they did was just add the butter "sauce" over the previous tandoori chicken. So, I'm going to give them the benefit of the doubt that their butter chicken is cooked in a tandoor. The taste of the food was definitely nothing to shout about. I would say that they're doing a grave injustice if, in fact that was really the taste of authentic Pakistani food. Apart from that, the portions were reasonable and the overall ambience is cozy. Ordered the ginger tea, and once again, wasn't impressed by it. All in all, a disappointing experience from a well-reviewed restaurant.

Author: Thi79Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: good food, horrible service - non professional at all
Review: We wanted to try their food cos of friend's recommendation. We order 6 dishes and 5 drinks but only 4 dishes came evethough we remind them twice and 4 drinks ( 1 wrong order).We came to the restaurant for lunch, we wait for 5 mins to reach 1 server attention and arrange 1 table for 6. they used tablet to take order then drinks came by 1 , by 2, by 1 and 1 missing - never show. after that our food come 1 by 1 for every 5 mins. After 5 dishes were on the table, we remind server that we still had another dish with a "yes" from the server we have to wait for 10mins more and remind him again for and 10 mins after "ok". we decided forget that dish and left. ( they never sorry for our dish and drink.they had good nasi lemak and soup ( yellow noodle with stuff mice pork), other dishes are ok. the restaurant had a modern look but service is horrible and unacceptable, the management has no idea of restaurant but the price.

Author: Davidlye70Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated food
Review: This cafe was rated number two in Tripadvisor so it was with much anticipation that I booked a family dinner over the lunar new year long weekend.The "kueh pie tee" and Vietnamese spring rolls were average.The coconut milk laksa was average. My mother complained of fish balls that were not fresh.I had fried rice with chicken satay. The rice was not spicy. The peanut sauce for the satay was bland.The only good bits were the carrot cake and the chocolate walnut cake.Will I come back? Only for desserts.Not worth the reservation. When it comes to food, it is a real disappointment.

Author: AlexjoeyBaar, Switzerland
Title: Excellent steak celebrating my wife’s birthday dinner!
Review: Booked for my wife’s birthday, excellent wet dried steak (marble 7) at medium rare - succulent and tender. Also had the food gras which was very good with the ice cream. They also surprised us with a nice desert (apple cake) for my wife’s birthday. This is one of the best steak place in KL, a little pricey but very worth it for the food, ambience and service. Will come back!

Author: PatienceginKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ben's Kitchen BSC shocking
Review: We were a group of 10, 6 adults and 4 kids. Firstly I am a little upset as to why this bad service and terrible food is taking place at BSC when Publika and KLCC is up to par. We placed our orders from Burgers, to soft shell crab pasta, nachos, Caesar salads, pies, fries and etc, it all came out bland and no initiative taken. My ice lemon tea was diluted. We had to wave our hands many times just to get service. I had to call one particular waiter closed by to our table to clear the plates away and he gave me stare that really burst my bubbles! Seriously! It was a stressful meal. Never again.

Author: turnbulliansChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Traditional Highland cusine, Very good
Review: The food was very different and extremely tasty. We ate salads made from ginger flowers, a pineapple curry, pounded rice, and a vegetable dish made out of Taro. it was unlike anything else we ate in Borneo. Price was particularly good, and we ate a set menu for 16 RM each which included soup and a cold drink.

Author: ClairbeartanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Charming interior for chilling
Review: The food is pretty average, nothing to die for. We would think that ordering the standard tapas wouldn't go wrong - nothing went wrong, just food. Price range is reasonable. Sangria was so-so.The decor thought deserves the credit with a very comfortable alfresco dining.

Author: Kuropon
Title: It's terrible
Review: I decided to have a visit after I read good reviews (and also great number of Facebook likes on the page). I was really looking forward to have a nice dinner there. The staff and environment is quite good but the food it's just so terrible. I spend like RM170 to get a microwave-liked unagi set, salmon sashimi with fish skin still left on it and also a sukiyaki beef set which the broth does not even taste like sukiyaki ones(although the beef is quite fresh). The tempuras for the sets are very bad and the seafoods are not fresh at all.Another point is the iPad ordering system. It's very frustrating and I really do prefer a paper booke menu.This is my first and last time visit to Ishin.

Author: Vishal Anand G
Title: Amazing Irish Bar
Review: Had a great experience. A little bit on the expensive side but it more than makes up with service. James and Simul took care of us very well. That's them in the pic. Check it out!

Author: AmyChewSingapore, Singapore
Title: WORST
Review: Mislead by other blogger review. Traveled all the way from Sg to this 5 Star service hotel for their buffet dinner.1) Understaff - waited at the entrance with other customers. I walked in and ask for the staff to bring me to my table instead. 2) Communication - most of the counter staff had poor understanding of the universal language-English. Ultimate shock! They reply malay to me????? Huh????3) Training - staff dont listen / understand cudtomers' order. Order dish 'A', served dish 'B'? Wrong serving and end up staff asking which one you want? Reason from Manager was because these staffs are rather new. My advice - get them out of your 5 star hotel! 4) Initiative - people, you are in service industry - pls train or at least hire ppl with good attitude or willing to put in extra initiative with their work. Staff there got no common sense. Asked for cake to be serve (we purchased the cake). Our table was in a mess - was expecting the staff to clear the table and ask if we would like to cut the cake. Omg, she just hand in the cake to us - like that. . Just like that... so we ask her to clear the table and I casually asked her is this a 5 star hotel?? She said yes. I BURST out laughter. If all these logical stuff need to be tell, might as well the hotel hire robot to work if that make sense!By the way, is my mom's birthday celebration. . So can you guys imagine how ultimate embarrassing it is to bring someone that you loved to such dining experience. ..manager is trying to do the service recovery by offering us free buffet dinner but do you guys think it matters? .....SPEECHLESS.....

Author: Neil0akesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not at its best
Review: We were all pretty disappointed this time the quality here seems to go up and down a lot but it is definitely not best fish and chips in Asia and not even KL. nearly 50 ringgit for average fish and a few slightly soggy chips hmm Marks and Spencer's frozen haddock supper is better! 14 ringgits for mushy peas? Fish and chips is cheap comfort food ! Choice of fish for frying maybe is part of the issue but we all agreed had better here and elsewhere. We ordered calamari as an appetiser when it didn't show after 15 minutes we enquirer where was it there was some confusion followed by a hurried cooking now statement. Place was not full slow service should not have happened.

Author: 628Michelle
Title: You Will Never Say No To Rice !!!
Review: if you think you do not like rice , then you will have to think twice when you are at Hoe Kee Chicken Rice Ball !

Author: JackofAllPlaceSeminyak, Indonesia
Title: Overpriced and overrated
Review: Was really looking forward for some good juicy ribs at this place. Didn't live up to expectations. Even those fancy ribs they have like salted egg, and with sambal were also disappointing. Words of advice to restaurant: - "don't try to get fancy. Do one thing well, and make it really good." For what we got in terms of taste, I want my money back because one shouldn't be spending over RM100 (for 2) and walk out of there feeling deflated.We didn't even finish the meal as it felt more like a chore to eat than enjoyment. My recommendation is, if you're ever in Bali - try ribs at Hog Wild in Seminyak. You're see the stark difference between a satisfied great meal versus utter disappointment. Humbug.

Author: Mark672Napa
Title: Average food
Review: We ate here for lunch. My wife had a vegetarian noodle soup and I had the spicy pork noodle dish. The broth for the soup was very good, and was a generous portion. Mine was neither spicy, nor noteworthy. The sauce seemed to be primarily soy sauce, and the pork had little flavor. The service was good, and the price very cheap.

Author: Hongty
Title: Bad service and rude staff.
Review: The staffs and especially the lady manager doesn't like the customer to add dish. During the meal we feel like the portion of the food is not enough and we like to add 1 more dish even we already had 6 on the table. She yell from the counter that we add only 1 dish. I even heard that she say "PAY BY CREDIT CARD VERY ACTION". That night when we are In the cafe(petaling street branch) there is no customer accept 6 of us. I really feel angry n disappointed that type of service you provide and still charge us service fee. Really feel sad and ashame for the OLD CHINA CAFE Owner to employ this type of lady manager. Malaysian citizen dont ever think of going there.

Author: 909pat
Title: Very good chinese food with outdoor seating
Review: Very good chinese restaurant, with a lot of people, friendly staff and a wide variety of meals. Prices are not the cheapest in town but it worths the expense

Author: Oei P
Title: disappointed
Review: I was here on school holiday (long holiday), i went there twice, restaurant closed. Really dissapointed. I asked people near the restaurant and they don't know it will open or not.

Author: AssssssfIpoh
Title: Terrible Experience
Review: As per my expectation, the foods are not up to standadrd during Chinese New Year season. The service is terribly BAD! The cashier and "captain" upstair are very rude and ignorant. I think they forgot the fundamental of their jod is to provide service to customer. When we try to request for something, the captain just walk away when we are talking half way. The cashier is even worst, when we are asking for her help to get us the sos, she just show a "BLACK FACE". I will never visit this kind of restaurant again.

Author: Becca1979_5Southampton, United Kingdom
Title: And, RELAX!
Review: If you want to somewhere to go and pretty much do nothing then this is perfect. Lovely pool, nice burgers (chips a bit on the greasy side) and looking out onto the beautiful South China sea, my friend and I spent several peaceful hours here reading and swimming before we were due to fly out (its really close to the airport). The beach was lovley but we had no idea if there were currents or other hazards and had been advised against swimming due to a recent spate of croc attacks so just paddled.

Author: watercrownKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Utter Disappointment
Review: I've heard good things about Social from close friends but my first time there last night was disappointing.Went there with a couple of friends for drinks after dinner and we were left standing around for a good 10 minutes just trying to get the attention of a waiter to get a table! And when one of us asked, we were completely ignored and all the waiters just walked right by us. I understand that they were pretty busy because the place was packed but this is not the kind of standards of service one would expect from a popular place like this!When we finally managed to get a table in the outdoor seating, it took another 15 minutes for us to be served. After we ordered, we were left waiting for our drinks for more than 20 minutes. My cocktail took an extra 10 minutes after that for them to bring it. My friend found her Guinness tasting watered down like filtered water.We were all ready to just get up and leave but unfortunately it had began pouring outside and we weren't eager to make a wet run in the rain.We also couldn't help but feel that there were double standards in the service because the Western customers before us were able to get a table and were served immediately.This kind of service is completely unacceptable. The ambience may be good (although music was too loud and it's difficult to have a good chat) but it certainly isn't worth spending my money and time. Will not be going there again.

Author: YvonneTeh
Title: Family birthday celebration
Review: Out first visit to this restaurant and surprised that they only serve fish/seafood pot. Eight soup based and we ordered the mala, sour & spicy and tomato. Consider so-so nothing really special and a bit pricey.

Author: Mal S
Title: Gee....is it worth of money ?
Review: Had a Beef steak and a bit gammy taste further it is't not even tender. Too much sweetness in Potato salad (is it added with sugar?), however your customer service and ambiance considered as GOOD. Guys, please improve on your quality of food.

Author: Tee_MalaccaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Fresh and Delicious Japanese Cuisine that I can Found in Melaka Raya
Review: We tried Grilled Oyster Bento dinner set (RM30), Tempura and Raw Fish dinner set (RM32) and Chicken Nanbam Bento dinner set (RM26). I purposely ordered oyster because want to try whether freshness of the seafood can be satisfied. The result is I love it so much! They grilled the oyster with their homemade white sauce, and the taste is so good! Besides, the dinner sets that they offered all in large size! I got too full at the end! Now this is the Japanese restaurant that I love most among the Japanese restaurants in Melaka Raya, already planning back again in coming week. During weekend night, it is better to make reservation.

Author: Zulkarnain23
Title: Lack of selection
Review: Went there a few times during my visit in Malacca. I was there for three time just because I stayed at Casa Del Rio. Foods portion is pretty small... not so tasty and not many choices.

Author: hennes bBerlin, Berlin, Germany
Title: Close to Platinum Tower - cosy place
Review: We just came by for a snack and were well surprised - good quality food and service. Brickstone beer bar Ambiente in old small building with a beautiful terrace in a small quiet side street. Everything higly recommended, thanks for a good time and a relaxed Restobar !!!

Author: Maurice89Malaysia
Title: Above the average but steep pricing!
Review: Just visited this place during the late morning on a Thrusday, there was no queue. The nasi lemak was not bad, I would say above the average. Taste is there, everything was very tasty, but beef rendang was not tender... rice ok la. I order the nasi lemak with parut (since its popular there), beef rendang and sotong with one limau ice. The total was RM15! I was really surprised because the portion was average, i'm still trying to calculate how could it be so expensive for an environment like this. Maybe I was ripped off? There is a better nasi lemak at a much more reasonable pricing behind Fahrenheit88, same thing as I ordered above is less than RM10, it opens early morning till 10am during weekdays only. Sold by an elderly malay couple, their nasi is truly the best and I would say it beats this Wanjor! Will I ever come back if you ask? I'm not sure, maybe once in 6 months when im in the mood again.

Author: Robert BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good once in awhile
Review: Went there once last week with my son. Food is very tasty and plentiful. My choice was good, his was not as good. Service was OK, they didn't seem to pay much attention to us. I asked for a glass of ice water and was given something that was a little bigger than a shot glass. I asked for a bigger glass (the ones they serve coke in) and was told they only give small glasses for ice water!!! I went there before about 4 months ago and found the food to be oily. Would I go back.............. probably not for another 6 months

Author: darrenmok10
Title: Chynna’s lovely service
Review: The servers are excellent in serving us and especially with their honest recommendations of food. Particularly, the server named Leng

Author: Judy H
Title: Yum yum!!
Review: We went there for lunch today and had a wonderful Nyonya Laksa. So flavourism. Service was friendly and efficient. It is definitely a place to visit for excellent Nyonya food.

Author: Saraabey05
Title: A pleasant surprise
Review: My husband and I stopped here for dinner and had an excellent meal. For our starter we calamari which was served with a delicious mayonnaise. For our mains, my husband had the piccante pizza which was quite big and delicious and I had the lamb rack which was cooked perfectly. The passionfruit iced tea was refreshing. The staff were attentive, not pushy at all and the restaurant has a great atmosphere. Definitely recommend a visit to Quivo.

Author: MsL431971
Title: Stop expanding till you get it right
Review: This review is for the BV branch. Have reviewed the KLCC outlet before. Came in once to order a quick coffee and was already seated and ordered and 5 min later only to be informed by waiter their coffee machine went kaput. Ordered tea instead and suddenly a big cockroach crawled by my tea cup. Mentioned to the waiter but he barely understood my English so I paid the bill and left in a huff. Please review the menu. Your fusion combo does not work!!

Author: debbiechoa
Title: Fly in My Red Wine and Not an Apology
Review: Just had dinner at J&R. Am a regular. Service at Jln Bangkung is in decline. Prefer the Plaza Damansara outlet. Was served a glass of house red tonight. Almost drank it to the end, then noticed there was a fly in my drink. Glass was replaced with a smaller glass partly filled, it was as if the waitress figured I had already drunk most of the wine, thus she did not want to unduly enrich me. No offer of an explanation or apology. Just a shrug. And yes, I still paid for the full glass.

Author: Alex LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Everything was not up to expectation
Review: It was noisy in the restaurant. No reservation being made, luckily we got a table.Only 1 menu on the table, that we have to share among three of us, until we grab the menu next table. By looking the menu all the price being change and increase tremendously. I'm fine if the service is up to what we pay for it. But is not. Servers did the order never ask for any beverage.Food were 10 -15 minutes after we place our order. However one of the item which is not in the menu take us more that 40 minutes to deliver. Which all of us finished our set meals. Yes apologize being extended by the servers, but the waiting is still unacceptable. Noisy and lack of service. Taste of the food still good, but I think there are some better out there.

Author: R9245AWrobl
Title: Delicious vegetarian Laksa
Review: Went for lunch at laksalicious and arrived to a menu that didn't include a vegetarian laksa. Not to worry though, the friendly waiter (owner I think) explained that if we could wait 20 minutes they could prepare a vegetarian nonya style laksa. The wait was worth it - one of the most flavoursome laksas that I have ever had. We also had freshly made spring rolls and a yam and sticky rice roll that was also delicious. We highly recommend laksalicious for both veg and non veg laksa enthusiasts when visiting Penang.

Author: 589hamzah
Title: Awesome place to dine inn...
Review: Had an dinner few days...awesome ambience staff...Bartender was quite professional named Mohsin...served me a camomile dream..loved that will come back soon..:))

Author: ZyungkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Grade F
Review: Had new year lunch here just now. Food especially the steamed SH meat dumplings were good. The rest also tasted above average. However, was disappointed with the shui-shen Chinese tea. It supposed to be grade A but I think grade F. After waited for 10minutes for the flavour to come out, it still taste likes water. Told one of the waitress to add more tea leaves but were ignored. Instead asked us to wait for another 10minutes. Good food but lousy tea and certainly not worth the $10/per head for the tea. What a start to 2018.

Author: semu2018Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Where is the chef hiding?
Review: On the 30th Dec our family of 4 adults and 3 children along with a guest from KL came to the restaurant for a year-end meal together. Two of the children have difficult food allergies - one child cannot eat wheat and the other egg. I had contacted the restaurant beforehand telling them about this. However, on our arrival we were told that they only had fish and chips for the children with the allergies. The child with the wheat allergy does not like fish so we asked if the kitchen could cook a portion of egg and rice for him (a very normal Asian food). The answer was a flat no, cannot!! We had brought with us a packet of gluten-free pasta (for cases such as this) and asked if the kitchen could cook the pasta. Normally, in fact always restaurants will oblige as they can see and empathise with the problem. But NOT Spice Grill! Again the answer was NO. We then asked if we could speak directly with the chef but apparently he had just left the premises?? The waiter said he would try to call the chef which he did, the end result of which was still a flat refusal to even cook the pasta for us. This to us was the limit and we voted with our feet and left the restaurant to a more friendly and understanding one. My advise to anyone with food allergies is to stay well away from this restaurant!!! Selma Oksanen

Author: LynnShaneKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Must Order: Pasta ala Pollo
Review: I visited the One City Mall outlet back in May as we bought online dining vouchers. As the title above says, Pasta ala Pollo is a must order. Price wise and portion, this is a 10/10 dish for me (such value for money!). In summary, this is pesto pasta topped with HUGE chunks of mexican-rubbed chicken breast. The name and summary that I've mentioned does not do it justice. But you can view more details and photos at:http://lynnshane.blogspot.com/2014/05/mexican-food-shepherdoo-restaurant-and.htmlAn item on the menu to skip is Taco-Taco. Priced at MYR23.50 (as at May 2014), the portion was shockingly small and too skimpy for a dinner meal.Service was not very pleasant but the Pasta ala Pollo will definitely keep me coming back for more. Also, if you are a fan of snapping food photos, please bring a spotlight as the eatery is very dimly litted. Else, your smartphone's torchlight would do. :D

Author: MJABATH
Title: Great Food - Great Price
Review: A great chinese restaurant offering decent food at reasonable prices.  Staff not too smily but very efficient.  It reminded me of a huge chinese cafeteria. Lots of atmosphere and once again, good food.

Author: seekjusticeChina
Title: Best meal in years (sugarcane Chicken) but charge for water?
Review: So this is supposed to be a high end place. The food I had was the best I've had in recent memory. The SugarCane Chicken was absolutely amazing. It was so amazing that we decided not to go back, because we didn't want our memory ruined if they didn't meet our expectations.ok, so this place is the most expensive place we ate in Malaysia. 40 RM for my chicken dish. the environment was super nice as well. However, they charged 1 RM for a glass of water. It just seemed tacky that at a place that nice would charge for water. Why even bother charging 1 RM...However, if you only had once place to eat, make it this place.

Author: carolinewH35FF
Title: Would not go again
Review: This is some sort of healthy eating place I think. We tried something called sempeh and it wasn't very nice. Service was slow and the toilet disgusting. Would not go again

Author: sidhudavinder1313
Title: BEST VEGETARION FOOD
Review: I had visit with family to this restaurant had aloo prantha .paneer prantha .with curd . Sweet lassi masala tea and many more . It's best north Indian food in jb town .
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food

Author: worldadventurer19Bali, Indonesia
Title: Terrible service and staff who cannot be bothered
Review: We waited 45 minutes for our food to arrive on a normal lunch time. Despite asking the waitress/ waiter how long our order will take, they failed to get back to us to reassure us they were looking into it at all.After an hour of waiting we had to call the manager to check our food for us, only then did they try a bit of "customer service". Do not go here - not worth your time.

Author: GurmeetS253
Title: Mediocre Place, Poor Service & Average Food
Review: 1. Rude staff who just don't care about customers/diners. In fact, they don't take pride in their own work. They argue between themselves as orders often ended up at wrong table numbers. 2. Service is awful. Waited between 45 minutes to an hour before we got our first of many orders. That too after we politely prompted a staff that we had a toddler who was hungry.3. Beware of bugs/ants/mosquitos. A bug of sort ended up on one of our dishes as tables are placed under the tree. 4. There's nothing really scenic. Overated would be an understatement.5. Food is average, not fresh and unnecessarily greasy. Saw fish (fish & chips) which were fried in advance and kept. Ironically, even the pre-cooked food took forever to be served. 6. Only consolation is the live band. A couple who belted out lovely numbers to stop the (frustrated/agitated) crowd from leaving.Will strongly discourage people from visiting this overated eatery.

Author: Popopo1976Lawas, Malaysia
Title: Decent and Average Halal DimSum place
Review: Located in Pelita Centre, this place can be found quite easily. Have been to many dimsum paces and this one is ok. Nothing to shout about, decently ok. Average. Muslim friends will be happy to know it is Halal, ie no pork in the dimsum. Chicken used instead of pork, and IMHO that kinda makes dimsum taste different. Not necessarily bad but some may not like it.Have a go, check it out.

Author: Pokhran
Title: Keema
Review: ..bro...how to makan now ...not sure if it is mutton keema or kangaroo keema...dont the aussies have some kind of laws against this. No choice..have to go back to shark fins soup..

Author: yusfw
Title: Bad to worse
Review: Been here first time in 2010. Those days opening hours was only to 5pm. Service was efficient (ordering to getting the foods), clean place with good atmosphere overall. Today’s visit: dusty, service was slow, even missed my friends order- when we checked at the cashier, there order was in but the food never came after waited for an hour! The manager should really look into this- opening long hours (early morning to late night) might be the reason for this overall decline.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Local Cuisine
Review: The most famous ipoh salt chicken. They are no more serve in house but offer taking away. Quality still maintain, juicy & drlicious. Must eat

Author: Stephen NJonzac, France
Title: No atmosphere, food indifferent
Review: The night I ate there I was the only customer in the restaurant, the atmosphere was non-existent.I ordered rack of lamb. Given I was the only customer, service can best be described as slow. The lamb was cooked as ordered, but it had not been cut into individual chops and the knife provided was blunt making it very difficult to eat. Impossible to ask for a sharp knife as the waitress had disappeared until it became time to pay.It was not possible to order any wine to go with the food as the hotel does not serve alcohol of any description, being halal, something I was unaware of at the time. Otherwise, I would probably gone to one of the restaurants nearby or another non-halal hotel.

Author: juliaJ5358ZB
Title: Delicious food!
Review: Would recommend the Habanero Chicken and Margherita Pizza! The staff was very friendly and brought us these delicious appetizers!

Author: breathe-thetravelMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Average touristy bar
Review: I was taken here in a group tour for dinner (but we each paid for our meals). Food choices for vegetarians lacked sorely in protein so I chose nasi lemak (vege option) - could hardly tell it was coconut rice and the “tempeh” was crisp like little chips. I have never come across that before. I was surprised being a restaurant with nice tables, aircon here and there (but with fans on and the doors open, such a waste of energy) that the toilets were all squat for females, the ground was all wet inside, and there was no toilet paper provided. I guess they have a few options for Western plates and that’s why it’s popular, but really, I would not go if it was my choice. So many other real Malay food around, why would you pay double the amount for food that tastes half as good?

Author: cha mBali, Indonesia
Title: Waiting more than 1 hr for table, another 40 minutes for tea, another 10 minutes for food
Review: Worst birthday dinner ever. Waiting more than 1 hr for table, another 40 minutes for tea, another 10 mins for soup, another 10 mins for pasta and pizza . When I complained to the waiter (with mustache) he said: I made your soup from scratch! (Duh, it's a RM28 soup, damn sure you have to make it from scratch and not instant soup!!) He did not even said sorry for making us wait. Not to mentioned the worst girls group on the next table sounded like screaming draculas. Conclusion: Last visit to Vin's!

Author: bdg100Sydney, Australia
Title: Pathetic experience -Waste of time
Review: This not a hard Rock Cafe but a pick up cafe. There were over 20 hookers surrounding the bar. I visited the Hard rock to have a drink and listen to some good music.Waste of time. The band does not come on until 11pm. Then at 11.30 they take a half an hour break....really !!!If you were at the HRC for a call girl you would be in the right place. Not one local I spoke to had anything good about this place.

Author: Foodie190091Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced tripe
Review: The Grand Straits Garden Seafood restaurant is a disservice to those out for a good seafood meal, especially if your expectations have been set by the likes of Singapore's Long Beach, Jumbo seafood, or Johor's Telok restaurant. For one, crabs, a firm favorite among seafood diners in Malaysia and Singapore, are set at a so called 'market price'. You would like to think this would be the Johor market price. When we went, this price was RM120 per kilo of crab, which would be the "market" price you'd wonder which market? Tokyo? New York? Singapore? London?Secondly, where possible, the restaurant uses cheap tricks. Scallops: In our case, frozen ones were used in the braised scallop (RM40 per serving). The sweet-corn crabmeat soup: Ours used crabstick instead of crabmeat. When we challenged the hostess she gave us the explanation that this was after all only a RM12 soup (and most customers don't know the difference anyway). The szechaun chilli chicken? The chicken tough, over-fried, over-glazed in an odd way. The only parts of the order that did justice was the pepper beef - the beef was succulent and well prepared; and the prawns fried in cereal. In all a disappointing experience.

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Still one of the best
Review: This restaurant has been open since I was a kid. At least > 30 years I think. Had a family lunch today and it was good. Nothing to complain. Nice Chinese food. Love the veg and pork we had today. Tofu did not look nice but tastes well. Fish in nonya style was fairly ok. Enjoy and refer to the pics.

Author: GlobalTraveller1985
Title: Angry bird
Review: angry unpleasant unwelcoming waitress/bar woman - luckily stumbled across the place while exploring the old town. I say luckily so i know where to avoid in future

Author: sharon h
Title: Great experience and highly recommended
Review: The food is really good especially their mushroom soup as well as their calamari which personally is my favourite and my friends and family too. The owner Neville is very friendly and kind. He even open the shop before the opening time when we gave him a call telling him we are near his restaurant. The pastas as well as the fish and chips is my daughter's all time favourite.The owner once gave me a complimentary desert when my friend told him she was celebrating my birthday

Author: RashmisateeshSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food and Good Location
Review: We had been to this place during weekend.. Great service! Good food for reasonable price.If your staying in Traders Hotel good place to try Indian food. Beautiful location and ambience.This is perfect place for happy hours with good options. Must try Peanut Masala goes very well with beer... we loved it!

Author: YapFCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent place for meat lovers
Review: Great deli-restaurant to purchase various meats/cuts to be cooked in-house or take away. Good quality food at reasonable prices. However, the place gets really busy on weekends and reservation is highly recommended. Also the tables are placed a little too close together sacrificing dining comfort. I have visited multiple times for the scrumptious food and will continue to do so.

Author: Navin R
Title: Tasty & reasonably priced food with pathetic ambience & hygiene
Review: The food is tasty and very reasonably priced. It was  short walk from out hotel, Vistana. It would be great if some thoughts are given to improve ambience and hygiene of the restaurant. Do not mind paying little more for the same!

Author: luluchanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible customer service and deteriorating food
Review: It's written "Authentic Malaysian Food" on the signboard. Is it really authentic?I doubt it. I'm a foreigner but been in Malaysia almost all of my life. Last visit to Madam Kwan's in KLCC was more than 4yrs ago. It is always crowded during the lunch hours. But I went on Sunday with my BF to have early dinner. The crowd wasn't that bad...the captain came to order but didn't even bother to greet us and he was in a rush. We waited glasses of water for over 10min. We even requested to 3 different waiters including one female captain who didn't apologize. Finally the food came (took so long) and the water. The customer service is terrible and taste has been going down. I cannot imagine how they can operate effectively during the lunch hrs. I wouldn't recommend to tourists and I will never bring my guests to this restaurant.

Author: adeline_potterCanberra, Australia
Title: Excellent birthday dinner
Review: We visited as a family group of eight (5 adults and 3 children) on Sunday evening for my sister’s birthday dinner and we had a very pleasant experience! We only booked that afternoon and we were pleased that they could fit us in. Upon arrival, Richard (one of the staff) very kindly agreed to my mum’s request to place a candle on one of the desserts that we ordered as a surprise for my sister’s birthday. Richard also advised that with more notice the kitchen can also do special writing on desserts, such as happy birthday, etc..We were also very happy with the food, which was delicious and fresh. However, note that the barramundi dish is only one piece of fish, not the whole fish. The style is a mix of nyonya with Western presentation, and it was also well-priced. A main course varies from RM25-28. We decided to share dishes which allowed for a variety of food. There is also dishes for children and vegetarian options. The kitchen was very accommodating for our kids and made a non-spicy version of the Kapitan chicken burger. The highlight was the dessert, which was a trio of mini Creme Brulee, with local flavours, such as pandan and Gula Melaka. The other desserts also looked interesting (e.g nasi lemak cake and tiramisu with pandan) which we will try next time! FYI - as the restaurant is in Fort Cornwallis, customers will have to buy an entry ticket (which is RM10 for Malaysians upon presentation of MyKad, and RM20 for foreigners) but this is redeemable at the Kota restaurant. However I would advise potential customers to call the restaurant to find out exactly the terms of redemption as it was unclear to me, but we managed to redeem the cost of the adult tickets (child tickets (RM5) are not redeemable).

Author: 811liciac
Title: Service level not impressive
Review: How could they make my parents who are old (in their 60s) wait outside when those who came later (and probably better dressed) wait on the inside? :( That's just so mean. Also, because my parents did not order much, those who came later received their orders first. My parents waited for almost an hour and no food came.

Author: Sid5515Bangi, Malaysia
Title: Hangout Place with Delighful View
Review: Came here with my colleagues by invitation after event in KL Convention Centre. You have to get several elevators (maybe 3 if I not mistaken) before reach here. They even have dedicated personnel accompanied you to the elevator dedicated to this level. Great place for business occasion. As it is one of the highest point of buildings in KL, you can enjoy great view without much obstacles. Foods is just okay but quite expensive, suits to where it is located.

Author: HuatSiangSri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: Not so good
Review: Having a day trip to melaka, drop by and try to enjoy the food here. Maybe we not order the correct food. the portion was small for 10 people. one of the vege we cant even finish it, because the taste cannot be accepted. I tried nyonya food before, it not like this. Bad.

Author: Joma71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive for KL
Review: Generally I prefer to eat local, however tired and this was around the corner from my hotel. popped in for a burger and a beer. Pint of beer was RM35 which is very expensive. Burger was RM46 and huge, however i went for a local flavour burger - the PERCIK burger The problem with this burger was that the sauce/friend shallots seemed to be full of MSG as this additive causes blisters/ulcers in my mouth. Unfortunately they are not appear immediately so was unaware at the time I was eating the burger. I guess it serves me right for being lazy...

Author: EncikJ6
Title: best thai food
Review: yesterday i have visit tiger lily resturant i have try the pad thai the food very good n the staff very friendly

Author: lawrencewoon888
Title: Nothing to shout about !
Review: Nothing to shout about . The vegetable we ordered was too salty and the food were all below expectation.

Author: 513anantk
Title: Great dining experience
Review: We went here for dinner and it was a lovely experience Food was delicious,  service was fabulous and so is the place

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Average food and overpriced!
Review:
The owner and staff was very unfriendly. 
Food was average and owner had bad attitude. 
It also took a long time for our food to be served.

Author: Jluv7
Title: 4-course Dinner
Review: Excellent service by Ben with really good food! Definitely recommended :) We love all the food!!! Thank you :)
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good Western food tastefully done
Review: We had a banquet which was carried out by Cafe BLD Renaissance Johor Bahru. It was a 4 course Western Dinner. The appetizer was salad with fried prawns (Katafi prawns). This was followed by clear mushroom soup. The main course was chicken with vegetables followed by dessert. The food was tasty and elegantly tabled. I also liked the bun and the butter mixed that was prepared. The service was good and as was expected in a 5 star establishment.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: aiemenrazieqKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: They changed their recipe!
Review: I dine here infrequently over the past 5 years and they used to serve steaks with incredible sauces to accompany. The service was prompt as usual and our food arrives in time, every time.Their mushroom sauce was great until my last visit where it seems that they've changed the recipe for the worse. And now, the sizzling plates are tiny compared up to my second last visit in the first half of 2018. It was a struggle to keep my dinner on the plate and off the table. Is the new management to blame? Hmm, this KL institution is decaying.Will only come back if management rectifies these issues, and only if positively reviewed by friends because this restaurant ain't cheap only to have an underwhelming meal.

Author: iqbalh285
Title: Good food
Review: Everything is good cafe bld best in jb I love food and service is best ever ....  all staff are best from gate to bld
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: MistressorchidPerth, Australia
Title: Great view, food not so much
Review: Went for the afternoon tea with my husband. Before going into the restaurant they take you up to the viewing deck, they only let you go up 15 min before your restaurant booking and there isn't anything much worth doing here while you wait. The view is amazing though.Afternoon tea, the food was not so great, have had better in a food court. The view is amazing though and afternoon tea is the cheapest way to experience this revolving restaurant. I would say that it is worth doing once.

Author: jas0nikeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: International buffet lunch
Review: Food was just so so. Very bad service. Ordered coffee several times but did not serve even we reminded them. Some of the staff are not friendly. Called for service and asked for bill no one attended.Feedback to restaurant manager during my last visit but it seems no improvement.

Author: Robert J
Title: Not bad, but maybe too authentic?
Review: The space is lovely. The outdoor terrace was very nice and the restaurant looks very good too. Now, im not Mexican but have been to Mexico and eaten at a lot of "Mexican" restaurants around the world. But i have never had Mexican food like this. Im not saying is the real deal or not but maybe its not what a lot of people would expect. The guacamole was decent. Lacked seasoning and that freshness taste you would expect but maybe the avocados were not ripe fully. The fish taco was the most disappointing. ("Crispy fish taco with cabbage salad" - it was a battered finger of fish with a cheap coleslaw glob).The prawn taco had a very strange flavour to it and we couldn't eat all if it. Maybe it was the bean puree or the taco shell itself or maybe it was too authentic for us. The chicken enchilada with salsa verde was very strange tasting too. The salsa was very sour and of the 3 pieces we could only eat two. Again, maybe too authentic for us???Overall a nice place with nice ambiance but perhaps it too "real" for a lot of people who are use to Tex Mex?Im not saying its bad but not what I was hoping for.

Author: gizmo118
Title: More Shopping
Review:
This place is like a Toys r Us for adults.
Most important things there is that you have to keep an opened mind.

Author: ThogaivignavaniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner with family and friends
Review: The menu here is very similar to that of STG but only select variety is available here.That said, the food here seemed a whole lot bettet, tastier, the wait staff friendlier and overall ambience cozier!We were treated to some really good food and excellent company for adults and children!Toilets are interesting looking and super-clean!Tip for traveller : Parking is ample right beside the restaurantWill surely return

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dim sum
Review: Decided to have dim sum with the family at Shang Palace. There were plenty of dim sum choices available and also some vegetarian choices on the main menu as hubby is vegetarian. As usual, we ordered a lot to share and I must say that considering it is a 5 star hotel, the price is reasonable. We enjoyed the food. Service though is unremarkable and can be improved. We had to remind the staff twice for everything we needed.

Author: ExplorernationsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bad service & cramped seatings
Review: It only deserves one-star based on my experience. As for a bar in a 5-star hotel, this is really not up to the standard, especially it’s compared to the one in Bangkok. The first thing you’ll notice are the cramped seatings. There are barely any space to spare in case of rain/emergencies. Also, the music was unbearably loud to the point I thought I walked into a nightclub. However, the bright side of this bar is the stunning view of KLCC & surroundings. My biggest critic for this bar was the service and the quality of the drinks served. We waited for more than 15 minutes for someone to serve us but to no avail, we had to approach a staff at the bar counter for a menu and return to order the drinks at the counter. I had to clarify that during our visit, the bar wasn’t overly crowded for staffs to handle. As most of the customers were already settled in, thus, it’s really not that hard for the staffs to pay attention to new walk in customers. We came in a group of 3 and we had a table at the side along the glass panel. As my friends were away to order the drinks, a staff came and asked whether a couple could sit with us. I responded that our table were occupied and there was a free table with two seats in front of us, but the staff insisted to pull two chairs to the walkway next to us without a table for the couple, which I find that really odd. But we didn’t bother too much as the couple found the situation quite awkward as well. The couple then changed their seats somewhere else afterwards. To add on, our drinks weren’t served as how it should be. When we alerted the server about our drinks, he told us we should speak to the bartender and so we did. We were shocked that he simply just said it’s how we prepared it. So, we asked if we can speak to the manager. To our odd surprise, the manager came with an attire worst than the server and was being defensive when we confronted the error of how the drinks should be served. He was being really defensive and wasn’t apologetic at all. Not a single word ‘Sorry’ was said during the entire conversation. He came back with another drink for us but it’s just not how it should be. We left quickly afterwards. We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel but the bar really threw us off. We canceled our bar reservation after the awful experience we had. It would be nice if the staffs here are as good as the one in Bangkok. We would love to visit this bar again in future if the problems are rectified.

Author: Shoekeeper
Title: Mr
Review: I just visited this Restaurant. It has almost 100 menu items. Their food is simply delicious. We had a few varieties of beers, and they are all fresh at tip top servings. We really had a great time sitted right beside of the beautiful water fountain.This place is clean and spacious. Lastly, we love its super clean and comfort bathroom.A good call to chill, relax and get things done.

Author: swim_jessKuching, Malaysia
Title: Not so German
Review: We were a bit disappointed with the food here - it is not so German after all except for the sausages on the menu. We asked what was recommended and he mentioned the spaghetti (not so German after all). We also ordered the gyros with tzatziki which was pretty good but this is also not German but more like Greek food!

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Haven from the Monsoon!
Review: I was visiting friends who happen to live nearby to Mangoes and having been caught in a very heavy storm options were limited as to where to dine alfresco. Problem solved as the dining area is enclosed within a courtyard area and we were able to concentrate on our food and wine without fear of getting drenched. Food is first class and beats handsdown what is offered in some of the swankier hotels on the Island.. along with that you get the personal attention of the owners Michelle and Lutz. Added to which a big thank you to Michelle for the must be sampled Crepe for desert, which was adorned with candle and rendering of Happy Birthday as it was delivered to the table. Cheers!

Author: megaz2017
Title: not as seen on tv
Review: stepped inside this because of their big advertisement infront of the resto. they were on tv. it should be nice. i was wrong. the rice and chickens were tasteless. the omelette ok. the homemade barley was the only 1 become the nicest thing among those.

Author: RS946
Title: Don't waste your time and money
Review: Service was terrible, over 2 hours to get our food and when we got it, it was cold!  There are much better places in to eat in Kuching, try Bla, Bla, Bla or Top Spot both are excellent.

Author: YeohYong
Title: Great Xiao Long Bao!
Review: Great Xiao Long Bao!
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: chai77Adelaide, Australia
Title: I shall return !!!
Review: Well that says it all doesn't it. Wanted noodles and dim sum for brunch , and this was literally behind our hotel. Though quoted as Fahrenheit 88 building ,it's actually the back lower floor of building - hence back entrance on other side of bintang roadLovely noodles and dim sum

Author: 217masumis
Title: Takes way too much time
Review: A simple bowl of needles took more than 40 minutes to be served. The atmosphere and food is good, but not worth that much wait. Probable won’t go back. Maybe just takeout.

Author: Ian G
Title: Lovely Cakes
Review: The cakes were great here but the coffee was weak , wishy washy and overpriced. Art gallery had some nice works, but the jewellery maker was not at work when we visited.

Author: pipped_up
Title: Meh..
Review: Overpriced like most places on the street. If you are keen to go here try the breakfast or the sunday roast, amazing. But for dinner be prepared to pay for average grub and pricey booze. Not what is was... :(

Author: TravelOver55British Columbia, Canada
Title: Fabulous
Review: Not many restaurants have an owner who really cares about customers. Lorenzo, the owner and chef, is spectacular. This small, intimate restaurant delivers on quality, service and atmosphere. His staff are very well trained and attentive. In fact, the experience was so delightful, we are returning, in six weeks from traveling, just to eat here again.Thank you, amd continued success!

Author: christi1203
Title: Disappointing
Review:
Ordered Uokatsu Don (RM30.74). Despite of the small portion, it's not even nice. 
The waitress is responsive yet not sure what happened to the cashier aunty, why is she so grumpy.

Author: MrChilliVanilliTrier, Germany
Title: Bad stomach after visit!!!
Review: Yesterday I went with my girlfriend here for dinner. Both of us have a bad stomach now and we're feeling sick. She had the lemon chicken and I had some chicken curry soup. We both had a fresh lime juice with dinner. The strange think, my curry was served about 2 minutes after I ordered. The food wasn't very good as well.

Author: meichingl2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Not recommended for local people, this is for tourists.
Review: They charges for the prawn cracker that usually served free, they also charges for the plain water which is unexcetable. The service was excellent, but the food was under the expectation. Not recommand for local people who always having Nyonya food since little. This is for tourist people only.

Author: Hullgirl77Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Terrible loud music, expensive drinks
Review: We came here to watch the EPL game, the live music was terrible and really loud. We had made an effort to get there so decided to have one drink. They didn't have draft cider and the bottles were very expensive, no apologies or deals offered so we left. Morganfields just one minute away had EPL on a large screen and the drinks are half the price, go there instead.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: MariekeK973
Title: Good food
Review: It's a nice location and homely atmosphere. Nicely decorated. The food is not cheap/cheap but very nice.

Author: 698bryanl
Title: Dining
Review: The Food is very fresh. serving Portion is quite big.  Wagyu is quite expensive now maybe bcoz of our RM is depreciated but the taste is very very delicious.

Author: tenukKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: I went to Il Bacaro for a hope of real authentic flavorful Italian dish, but ends up disappointed and i cant even finish my main course. It's bland, not enough flavor and a total rip off.The Minestrone i had is also pretty basic and i'm sure i can do better at home.The only positive part i could say is it's a nice place, good service and they packed my unfinished main course (some lamb risotto) well.So i said goodbye to that place and swear i will never return again.As for the lamb risotto, we brought it at home, re-cook it with added spice and herbs..and it became so so good. See better cook at home than go to this place.

Author: Jilly92Bristol
Title: Food ok
Review: As we were staying at the Shangri La Hotel ,thought we would try the restaurant. Service was ok nothing special. Food only average, thought I would try the nasi goring not very good and not one of the best I have had. My friend had nasi leak, again only average. Would we eat in this restaurant again, probably not. Considering this restaurant is in a 5 star hotel, food was no more than 3 star.

Author: Dexter L
Title: Do NOT dine here!!!
Review: I'm now @ Beast, Intermark. 4 Feb 2017. 7:16pm. Valentine's Dinner. HORRIBLE - reasons:1. Smokers allowed inside air-cond restaurant. We are non-smokers seated next to smoking table. I told waiter that indoor smoking is prohibited by law. Ignored!2. Waited 10 minutes after seated. No menu was given by waiter.3. Waiter couldn't speak proper English. Hardly understood his explanation on menu!4. Bread very salty!5. Very expensive menu but 3rd class service by waiters!!!!WORST DINING EVER!

Author: Zenheart
Title: Average Peranakan Fare
Review: Each visit to Malacca for our family must include a stop at a Peranakan eatery. We were recommended Nancy's Kitchen. Having been spoilt by great and genuine homecooked Peranakan food by close Peanakan family friends, we tend to measure the standard of food at Peranakan restaurants with what genuine homecooked Peranakan food should be! We were not impressed by what was served. It was at best Average. We were looking for the extra x-factor in the taste and preparation.It did not have the 'wow' factor to bring our taste buds up a notch or two, that we would want to reorder the dishes! Service was also average! Value for money - not really! Worth a revisit the next time we hit town? Will try other Peranakan eateries first to compare!!

Author: jonw96Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Amazing!
Review: I love this place. The steaks are fabulous and the selection is whisky is excellent. It's very beautifully displayed and these guys do it better than the scots! It's good a nice vibe about it and a great ambience. The staff are lovely, I had a guy called Ariff looked after me and he's a real asset. Very knowledgeable of different types of whiskys and very professional.Certainly worth a visit. You won't be disappointed in this place.

Author: alikar984
Title: I am so sorry
Review: Dear all, I am so sorry to say this, but Tatsu is not a place I would recommend. The food is not bad and the ambience is also good. However, the service is absolutely ridiculous and the restaurant was almost empty. First of all, the waiters behave as if we are not there. I waved to to the waiter, she looked at me and went away to the kitchen for approximately 20 minutes. Then, we requested forks and knives (because I am still a learner), but to my luck by the time the brought the cutlery, I was already fluent in eating with chop sticks! We asked them to bring the cutlery before the food arrived, but it arrived after we finished eating! We ordered 2 same main courses for 2 different people, one arrived. Then the other one arrived 30 minutes later. We also ordered some grilled stingray and of course we waited an hour for it to arrive. Then, we complained to a different waiter because our wasn’t around and she brought it in 10 minutes. But as we were leaving, our old waiter comes and brings us the stingray! Lastly, they don’t even look at your table between meals and as they are bringing the food, they just try to fit all the dirty plates at the same time they are putting the new food on table. (See photo)

Author: IshDewynKL, Malaysia
Title: Great coffee, hugely disappointing food
Review: After all the hype over the Frisky Goat, we finally got around to checking it out over the weekend for brunch - and found the food depressingly lacking. Disregarding what the dishes are called on the menu, our table ordered (several orders of) the full breakfast, the eggs benedict on waffles, the salmon & eggs benedict on waffles and waffles. A lot of waffles, but the reviews had them to be the most promising feature of the FG. Disappointing. Listed as "Belgian waffles", the only thing Belgian about the waffles was the shape. The waffles were airy and barely substantial, and fell to pieces at the slightest introduction of moisture. Nothing at all like the robust & hearty real Belgian waffles, and I'm not referring to the Liege waffles either. The actual Belgian in our group thought it was a cute attempt at his nation's pride and joy. The poached eggs were a joke. It looked like they were "poached" in one of those microwaveable devices. The consistency of the whites were slightly rubbery on the outside and the yolks had... almost disappeared somewhere. The wilted spinach was stringy and bland, and the moisture turned the waffles into a tasteless mess over the course of the meal. The sauce hollandaise was scant. Being a huge eggs benedict afficionado, this was a waste of what I had to pay for it, especially since I felt it was no longer edible halfway through the dish. The full breakfast was decent. The eggs sunny side up were well cooked, as were everything else. The coffee at FG is quite good though, as were the offerings from the bakery. The fruit danish were moreish.If I ever end up at the FG again for brunch, I'd happily do coffee + pastries. The cooked brunch offerings aren't worth the rather hefty price tag. Our table ended up paying an average of RM45/person (taxes incl.) for what was, at best, only an average brunch.

Author: JounallerMalaysia
Title: Quirky and Hungry
Review: Guests could sit barefoot on the sand covered floor. Novelty No.1 Waiters look mostly imported from Bali or some Indonesian islands. Novelty No. 2Bread and dips with a generous serving of olives covered cheese tub is the best part of the meal.Appetizer of 'laksa' with snapper and prawn was gone and Ringgit $50/- lighter in two mouthfuls despite the outdated show of pouring the sauce (really a thin broth) at the table. Novelty No. 3Appetizer of Calamari, three thumbsize stuffed pieces deep filed and sitting on a bed of deep purple eggplant cream with some sticks of thin asparagus and all these gone in 3 small nibbles and another Rinngit $50/- gone Novelty No. 4. Seems like the money disappearing act here is faster than some airplane, pardon the mention as it happened exactly on the same day on this visit for dinner.However, the taste is recognizably fresh and the Caucasian couple with their children at another table were pleased and even commented THEIR portions were generous. Thanks Chef for making us pay for you and your friends stay in Asia.

Author: GlobeTrotting272483
Title: Teadate with BFFs
Review: Some fancy afternoon tea with a view, insta-worthy but the taste was okay. Reasonable for the price. Esther was our waitress, she was polite and helpful.

Author: Mawar A
Title: Not coming again
Review: Saw some reviews earlier but when arrived, was shocked that the place doesn't look as nice and service is pretty bad. So I left before even ordering.

Author: travelskSingapore
Title: Dissapointing Service at Alexis Bangsar Baru
Review: I have heard a lot about this place from friends, who rave about the food. I must say that the food is good, as I've tried selections of the pizza, pasta and asian menu. The only annoying thing is that the service at Bangsar Baru is consistently poor. For example, we enter the restaurant, and are left standing at the entrance for 5-10 minutes without any acknowledgement before being shown to our seats, even though there are many empty seats and the staff have already seen us the moment we enter. I ask for water, and repeated myself 3 times during the dinner, before the water finally arrived. I try to get the attention of the staff, and we don't get any attention at all. Also, which restaurant only stocks 1 baby chair for the entire restaurant?? I noticed that other diners were getting impatient with the bad service and the lack of attentiveness. The staff just look busy, but really not productive which I cannot fathom why.

Author: Simon6511
Title: OK lah
Review: This is simple restaurant .. they have music to (live band) so .. go there and have few beers and listen to the music.. but food is so so..

Author: natyow
Title: Nice food but poor service
Review: I don't usually write review and I contribute my 1st review in TripAdvisor as the service that I received from Cielo was ruined for my celebration mood. I choose this restaurant to celebrate my birthday as Cielo is the popular spot for special occasion dining. The food is pricey, but I have to admit the food was great and I dont mind to pay in this price as our food was really good especially the monkfish and the lobster.However, this price is definitely not worth for the service we received there. The lady who took our order was in black face and she looks like she not in good mood to serve. No smiling, just a cold respond yes or just nod her head to your order. When I got the dessert served with happy birthday writing on the plate as requested from my fiance, I thought to showing my appreciation to the waitress and said to her :"it's lovely, thank you for the amazing dessert." I didn't get any response from her, she just dropped the dessert for me and my fiance and left. Throughout the whole dining session, there's only one or two male waiter who is giving good service and we purposely call one of them for bill, as we want to tipping him for his good work, and my fiance mentioned to him that the tips is only for you, you were doing an amazing job, you totally deserved the tips by just yourself and no one else should share with you. Our final bill was Rm1200+, to this price I dont think it worth for the celebration experience. Staff attitude and hospitality is important in the service line, let alone Cielo is categorised as higher class dining restaurant. Even though the food was good however poor service will killed everything and ruined your celebration mood. At the end you walk out from the restaurant, you feel nothing special for your birthday.

Author: soonYuan
Title: Attitude, price, food -- all good
Review: The staff was very truthful in their talking, service was very attentive, pricing was reasonable and food was tasty, will go back again.

Author: Overland-Transfer
Title: Foods & meals are very good
Review:
"Pulled tea.nasi lemak & flying bread with great curry."
crowded of peoples during late evening & night time.

Author: petay1
Title: No system
Review: The waiting time is too long. In our case, we have a baby with us. The waiting time is so long that the baby become so cranky. And the crab that we waited for took more than 2 hrs to come. Very disappointed.

Author: SK1183
Title: Nice View
Review:
Good view but that's about it. 

Food was average, service below average and not particularly cheap. 

Unfortunately if you visit KL, for the view alone, it is something which you should experience.

Author: 671vivianw
Title: Full of Mickey Mouse
Review: Is a well Mickey Mouse themed cafe. Not a big range of food but good variety in menu. Price is reasonable for a themed cafe.

Author: saigonsoniaHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: I gave them another chance...still disappointed in their music selection!
Review: I have been to the Melaka Hard Rock Cafe twice, once with a friend, once with my family. We were all disappointed, both times. The main issue we had both times was the music. We are all hard rock fans and we live for rock music, live concerts, electric guitars and so on. In Hard Rock Cafes all around the world (I've been to many), we are always delighted to listen to fantastic music during the entire meal. In Melaka however, the first time I went, we were forced to listen to Justin Bieber the whole time! I complained and the waiters said it was a special 'Bieber' day. Second time around, it was during Ramadan and the music was local Malay pop music the entire evening. They said it's because it's Ramadan. I respect the culture and religion, but this is still a Hard Rock Cafe and should feature some of the things that make the franchise so popular, such as a great rock playlist, no matter what the day or occasion is.Food is good, service is fine, decoration is great as in all Hard Rock cafes, but between Bieber day and loud Malay pop, I simply will not take the chance again. It's a pity...

Author: JKJYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre local food
Review: Service was really fantastic here, and the restaurant was very quiet with 0 waiting time on a Tuesday evening. However, I find that the food is very mediocre and on the pricey side. Wouldn't come here again.

Author: reynold2016Singapore, Singapore
Title: Somewhat overrated
Review: (Note: By default Tripadvisor's ratings jump from 'average' to 'VERY good'. There is no "Good" rating which is what I would have chosen in this case for the Heritage). One would think for a mature site like TA, this lapse would have been corrected ages ago.Heritage : Visited on 20 Mar 2019For what is (relatively) Kuching's more expensive Chinese neighbourhood restaurant, the food is ranges from average to good. Certain perennials like the sharks-fin, roasted chicken etc were very good. The blachan sayor paku was excellent.The steamed prawns with garlic were a let-down. They were few in number and completely tasteless. I suspect they were of the cheap, fresh water variety (and I don't mean udang gala which I always avoid). It is hard to go wrong with steamed prawns, but they did.During the rest of my seafood dinners in Kuching I had superb seafood elsewhere - at a fraction of the price that Heritage charged.

Author: aliya_zKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Offensive team, lots of training required.
Review: Staff came and said "this dish takes 20minutes to be cooked." Sent a private message to the restaurant for them to improve and received the same respond, that it takes 20-25 minutes to prepare the chicken. But they're sorry that there was a delay in sending in this order to the kitchen (by 10 minutes).Well okay, first of all, I cook and I cater. Second of all, I waited over 45 minutes not 25, and 35. There was a lot of delay... and they did not seem apologetic about this. It was really sad for me to see everyone else around us receiving their orders except for our table.I feel that the whole experience was very offensive and their responses were condencending. Full stop. There are other places in town that serve better food and with staff with better manners and kind, and better service. I will not return.

Author: LoftusroadW12Doha, Qatar
Title: Very good and very well done!
Review: We dined there one night and promptly emailed them to book another night! The setting helps and the CdM is not overcrowded and did not seem to have kids marauding out of control. Get there early and have a cocktail as the sun goes down. The use the beach as the dining area and it was done well and not cheesy and neither were you hassled for being on the beach.The food was excellent and no complaints at all in this regard. Staff we found to be very good and based on our two visits, I could not recommend the place highly enough,
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: KellyLandrey01Harare, Zimbabwe
Title: The Junk restaurant. Kuching . Sarawak
Review: We stopped here by chance and were utterly enchanted with the decor , uniqueness of the interior , filled with Asian oddities and cultural clashes with modern junk , rooms within rooms , the menu was not large but was excellent and beautifully prepared. Atmosphere outstanding , service excellent , really enjoyed our dinner . Classy !

Author: starbelleeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing service and food
Review: Went on a Tuesday evening - excited for the food/ambience/service, given the great reviews I read on Tripadvisor.Was sorely disappointed by the service and food- the waitress was very curt when we asked for food/dessert recommendations, forgot our dish of chicken satay, and it was also very hard to get her attention (eg to order dessert) as she was talking to her colleague half of the time. We were also told that the live music was only on Saturday night.What we ate:- beef rendang (6/10, rice was really aromatic but the beef was very dry)- Laksa (7/10, mix of Assam Laksa and Singapore’s Katong Laksa, but quite an acquired sour taste — either love it or hate it!
