I personally liked it but my mum ate a spoonful and would not eat any more)- Gula Melaka sago dessert (6/10, interesting at first but it was too filling after about 3 spoonfuls)- Banana fritters (8/10, the bananas were deep fried and delicious- the vanilla ice cream 3/10 as it tasted really artificial)Overall: good ambience, average food, and poor service. Would not come here again even if I had the chance to.

Author: tham2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: food quality drops, small servings, slow service
Review: This restaurant used to be our favourite place for Thai food, but not anymore. Their clear tom yam soup used to be very spicy and fragrant but the spiciness has dropped. In fact, the quality of most of the dishes is not what they used to be. The serving size has also shrunk. The only thing that is still nice is the fried crispy kangkong. The service is also very slow. Despite having prior booking, we still have to wait for almost one hour for the food to be served. Won't be coming back for a long time...

Author: Zwinky1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Huge disappointment - horrible experience with the staff
Review: I made a reservation for the Sunday brunch at 11 for a group of friends. I have been there bevore around 8 month back, and really liked the place. This time, however:When we showed up at 11, as they advertise the start of the brunch at 11, the waiter didn't really know where to seat us down. When I showed him the only table that would fit our group he agreed. The buffet wasn't ready yet. No one attended to us. The staff was lingering around drinking coffe behind the counter. When I asked for the brunch that should have started at 11 they replied, their Manager is not around. That's a confusing answer.So, I asked if they would serve us coffee in the meantime. Answer: We don't know if we can serve you coffee...the Manager is not around. I said, but we are paying guests and we would like to order some coffee.The buffet still, wasn't even in the build up.No one attended for another 5 minutes for our coffees.Once one of the waiters came, he said, the Manager is not around, we cannot serve you coffee. There were at leas 3 male waiters and 1 femal waiter. All of them involved.After half an hour we announced to the team that we would leave now. They didn't seam to care and said good bye.It was a very disappointing experience especially because at the last brunch everything was seamless. Food so delicious. We had dinner there several times before which was always fine too.

Author: redwingblackbirdAlberta
Title: A second visit.
Review: The chicken porridge is just average. Usually some of the condiments make the porridge great, like salted duck eggs, Yu Char Kueh, Preserved mustard Cabbage, Tau Ju (preserved red Soya Bean cake paste), Ikan pusuk or salty fish, sesame oil, etc. All that these but all it serves are a little itty bitty bit of chicken and fewer still of the Yu Char Kueh.

Author: Jet4worknplaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent roasts but crowded for lunch
Review: I vaguely recall reading about this place on TripAdvisor whilst researching my ipoh trip. So when we passed this place enroute to Kek Lek Tong temple, I asked our driver to bring us back here for our lunch. It was lunch time and place was packed. We were 2nd in Q but still took a while to get in and also long wait for food to be served. Not sure why only one person chopping ducks n meats when these were the main food people would order. Take away Q was also very long. We order 3roasts(1/2 duck/char siew/roast pork) and Otah and archar on recommendation of waitress. The roasts were excellent and one of the yummiest char siew ever eaten, sticky sweet maltese coated meat was delicious. Overall bill came up to RM120 for 5Adults+1child. I will definitely come back again for the roasts but the Otah was too ‘moussey’ with a little fish meat for my liking.

Author: chequer25Hong Kong, China
Title: Surprisingly good Peking duck!
Review: We arrived at around dinner time and were lucky to get a table. It's a nice Chinese restaurant, with tables well-spaced so diners are allowed private conversation. We ordered a Ma Po Tau Fu, which was to my taste as it was not too spicy, a beef dish and half a Peking duck. I was not expecting too much of the Peking duck in this part of the world, but the half duck turned out a big enough serving, with really crispy skin and was surprisingly good!Service was relatively fast and waiters attentive. It was good quality Chinese food in a nice setting, at very reasonable prices.
Restaurant: Dragon-i Peking Duck Restaurant @ Pavilion KL

Author: J-Bap-V
Title: Lunch buffet is somptuous and inexpensive.
Review: Currently under renovation so looking forward to discover the new Lemon Garden Café once it re-opens.

Author: yantong26
Title: very expensive
Review:
no aircorn
Food is greasy
bad service
food is expensive
taste worst
no drink mineral water is freaky disgusting

Author: emeraldxxPerth, Australia
Title: Great views and Ambience
Review: I went here on my first night in KL and managed to get a table outside right next to the petronas towers so the view was spectacular. Then service was great and the ambience was lovely so a great start to my holiday. The drink prices are high (what you would expect for a place like this) so keep an eye on your tab.

Author: ChrisBarefordPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: First night in KL
Review: Great food and service from Nouman. He recommended the platter and he was right very tasty and enough for 2 including rice

Author: ahmedeA4934GDDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Worth the hype
Review: I was a bit cautious after reading some bad reviews regarding the service. Then, when I was making the booking the guy answering the phone seemed a bit rude, so I went expecting the worst. I was proved wrong. First of all, Amy is a legend! She cooks all the food herself (she is a descendent of peranakans) and is a very warm and lovely lady. She welcomed us and took the order herself.The other guy serving at the tables (I think same guy who answers the phone) was polite and nice enough as well.The food was just so good! No fuss, just home-made-style delicious Nyonya food. We wanted to order the whole menu.Prices are quite affordable.Be sure to reserve a table at least a day in advance if not more.

Author: MickYoongMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Authentic Italian Restaurant in Melaka (211213)
Review: It was a Saturday evening, five of us dined in and ordered salads which was fresh and seared tuna appetizer which was good to last bite. The delectable seafood soup was infused and the shrimps, scallops and mussels were fresh, juicy and nicely cooked. Mushroom soup was just thick enough to my taste.Those breads were awesome! Grilled beef tournedos and rib eye were fresh and succulent, cooked to my desired taste. Chicken piccata was tender and toothsome. Lasagna well presented and with minced chicken fillings to her liking. Finally the array of sea food platter was really out of this world came in hot and cold plates, squids, scallops shrimps,clamps and mussels well cooked fresh and juicy. Limed oysters and smoke salmon in cold. Freshness of oysters were recommendable. Desserts, Choc Lava and Aromatic cappuccino Tiramisu sponge cake, Trio Gelato were mouth watering. Good ambiance, authentic and worth the money!

Author: SLLooi123
Title: Birthday
Review: Sashimi served is always fresh. Good value and very friendly staff. Very relaxing environment. Free car valet service👏👍

Author: kmquek
Title: Lovely tze char food
Review: Lovely tze char food. Really good. I really like the been sprouts with salted fish. The salted fish aroma (not salty just flavour) was like truffle exploding in my mouth. It was great! Also liked the belly pork and I actually like all the dishes.

Author: walidsibrahim
Title: Meh much?
Review:
Breakfast spread was completely not up to the 5-star as the hotel claims to be.
Food was average and even again, the window. 

My god! Can someone please clean the windows!! What can the guest see from the cafe with dirty window like that?

Author: May C
Title: Farewell Dinner
Review: The restaurant is located along the road which has private parking lot with limited space. Environment is nice and cozy for normal hangout.

Author: TanWS_OM
Title: Terrible service
Review: Tried to get a seat but was told to go upstairs. No one heeded us so we left. Really poor service.

Author: maisaramajid
Title: Bazaar Malam
Review: We really enjoyed the foods. Have a variety of delicious foods and seafood section is awesome. The team that served us was so friendly especially Hanis and Ben. Definitely will come again.

Author: boon248
Title: Friendly pub cumulative restaurant
Review: First time here with my family members.Their food surprisingly exceeded my expectations.They serve western food with a twist of Indian spices.Pricing is on the high side but it's ok if you wish to pamper yourself and family members.Their beer is worth ordering during happy hours!

Author: DrLincoln
Title: Great deep fried ice cream!
Review: Nice chill out place! Interesting decor all from recycled material. Local homestyle cooking is pretty good. Highlight was the deep fried ice cream - one of the best i have ever had!

Author: VernonC_13
Title: Great Breakfast Place
Review: Great coffee, great breakfast menu and great pastry. Great place to hangout with friends and have great coffee with pastries...

Author: NicklauslooPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast at 7 Spices
Review: This place looks suprisingly posh for an Indian breakfast place. I had the breakfast set at RM15 with chicken 65 (RM14). When the breakfast set was served, i can see variety of different mini prata, tosai, roti and a few indian dishes served with few different kind of sauces. It looked WOW! But when the chicken came, i was surprised to see few little mini fried chicken chunks. Overall everything was fine. I like the sauces very much the prawn curry.

Author: CCBK
Title: Lousy Service at Citta Mall
Review: Decided to meet my husband for lunch as the Citta Mall outlet is near his work place. Will avoid this place in future.Food quality was just average but the poor service was most annoying. There was a delay in seating us not because there were no unoccupied tables - there were several but they were not bussed. They placed us right inside, last table just by the door that faces the inside of the mall (door does not access the mall). We had to walk past several empty but dirty tables (plates and cups not cleared, napkins strewn all over etc). Then he promptly forgot about us. No one came to take our order, no one came to clean the tables around us either for a good 15 min. I had to walk all the way to the front of the restaurant to get the attention of the staff who were simply standing around chatting amongst themselves. Then they got our order wrong - when we pointed that to the server (who was not the same person who took our orders), he merely mumbled he "will check" and walked away but no one came by to follow up for at least 10 minutes. Add the time of all these sc*@w ups plus time we spent waiting for food to arrive...and this is lunch where we did not have the luxury of time...we just ate whatever was brought, paid and left. Did not bother to try and complain as it was obvious the staff just could not be bothered.

Author: SubbaraoKBengaluru, India
Title: Selvam Vegetarian restaurant, Melaka, Malaysia - avoid if you can
Review: If you ask any one in Melaka to suggest a vegetarian restaurant, invariably, it would be SELVAM. But according to me, it is not a clean restaurant. We ordered Lunch. We could not see the way the items were served. Nothing was tasty. If ones criteria is only vegetraian and cheap, then you may go over there. In Holiday Inn, we got an excellent vegetarian curry. The whole sight at Selvam was disgusting

Author: Jorge D
Title: Good place for a beer
Review: Good bar to have a beer solo or with friends, lounge music (not too loud). Happy hour every day from 12 to 9pm just 18 MYR for a pint( quite cheap in KL). Food not bad. Recommended for watching European football.

Author: maiaradh2293Wichita, Kansas
Title: Good but will not come back again
Review: Well after taking notice that Malabar Palace was rated 3rd best indian restaurant in KL right after Betel Leaf which is btw one of my fav indian restaurants, i had to try it out for dinner. Hm. I did come here convincing my family that the food will be worth it especially after we were seated in such an odd placement. The restaurant is in a mall but the tables are not IN the restaurant but at the entrance of the restaurant. So its kinda outdoor but not outdoor which makes it weird because there are shoppers walking by. Very very compact. Now the food:-Lentil soup: Not enough salt. Could use more spice in it. Quite bland for an indian soup. Good consistency though! Chicken tikka wrap: A little too much onion and less chicken. And it was a little too "wet" for the wrap. Taste was alright. The chicken was tender. Malabar prawn briyani: Really good! One of the best briyanis i have had in a while! I liked how they added in a little twist by adding orange slices in there and it made the flavours amazing! Well spiced, well cooked rice & prawns were fresh! Mixture of naan breads & paratta: This was also okay taste wise but i found it a little too chewy n tough for me. Very filling for the tummy though so avoid eating this too much. Panner Butter Masala: Again too much onion. A little bit on the sweet side but could use a bit more gravy.Pistachio Kulfi: Kulfi is an indian ice cream for those of u who dont know. Now this was a little disappointing as well because it pretty much felt like a pistachio milkshake frozen n cut into cubes rather than a good icy kulfi. Maybe some would like it but i didnt. Staff were excellent btw. The bill came to RM98. It was overall good, edible good. But i wouldnt come here again if i had the choice.

Author: 4fhjg
Title: Very dissapointinhg
Review:
The macadamia cake was dry n stale-like. Complimentary water was murky n tasted bad (like rotten food in it). The only good thing was the flat white which was smooth.
I certainly didn't appreciate the stomach ache after.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Laura W
Title: Awful
Review: Awful place. Went after seeing reviews on trip advisor. Very dirty and staff very unfriendly. If your not used to Indian food you won't know what it is you're ordering. We both left and had to go lie down due to stomach aches. Also all the staff and most of the customers are men who all stare a lot which makes it very uncomfortable for female customers.

Author: allerta2016Leiden, The Netherlands
Title: Aside from the popiahs, not impressed
Review: We had dinner at Nancy's on our first evening in Melaka, encouraged by TA reviews praising the good local fare and reasonable prices. Unfortunately, we can not give a great review. On a positive note, the popiah that we started off with was delicious! However, we were somewhat disappointed by the main courses: we had a fish dish (garlic and soy sauce, I believe), which was admittedly tasty, but it was a tiny portion (like 6 very small pieces of fish and some sauce) which we felt was way overpriced at 18 ringgit. We didn't enjoy the vegetable dish (called something like angled beans with fish flavour) and left the plate half-full - definitely the first time that has happened in Malaysia! Furthermore, when we returned a few days later (a Tuesday) to pick up some popiahs for lunch the place was strangely closed, although it had been open for lunch the previous day. There was no signage to explain the closure.

Author: kyoon33
Title: Nice food but service need improvement
Review: very authentic italian food in Johor Bahru with nice dining setting. However, service staff is not so helpful.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: oneredpantherKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mostly Good
Review: Nice peaceful location with attentive staff and good atmosphere. Started with cream of mushroom soup, which was excellent. Finished with the cannoli which was similarly well-made, with fresh mint leaves. Main course of duck confit, where the duck was juicy and perfectly cooked. Dish overall was let down however by the potatoes (both mashed and baked) that were dry as a bone and lacked any kind of flavour- as if they were reheated from yesterday. Some butter, garlic and salt should be added - with additional sauce or broth, since the potatoes are overly dry otherwise. All in, a good experience and would return.

Author: SherborneCeltSherborne
Title: Worst meal in a while! Sad!
Review: Having loved eating here in the past, we’ve just had the worst experience at this restaurant. So many things were not up to expectations. Chosen wine not available. Final wine selection - broken cork... wine brought back to table in original bottle having been strained and poured back in. Food, well below expected standards- prawns over-cooked and tough. A very large and noisy party just behind our table added to the misery of the evening. Expensive and very disappointingly!

Author: Mayapotz
Title: Peri-Peri Rocks!
Review:
I can't ever get tired of Nando' chicken! So glad I get my yearly fix in KL!  

Their chicken is the best! Add potato wedges and Mediterranean rice for your side dishes and you're all set!

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: A fun place
Review: Wanna meet two people who truly love what they do? Go to this place and Samantha & Jason will take great care of you. It's long, narrow & cozy and can get a little too busy on weekends...but the food, beverage, music and friendly atmoshpere are outstanding

Author: Sarah41KLMalaysia
Title: Ambience is superb
Review: Dined here for birthday dinner. This restaurant is nestled within the rainforest, yet just 10 minutes away from the crowded KL city centre. I was really impressed with the very natural settings - a wooden built restaurant surrounded with trees and with the echoing sounds from birds, monkeys, & crickets. But that's it, superb ambience only but expensive. Foods basically are indochina mainly Thai, Vietnamese, & Laotian cuisines - nothing great with the tastes but comparing to 5 star hotels, their prices are very much higher. So i guess the diner is paying more for the ambience than for the foods and service. So if one is looking for nice, natural, relaxing, & romantic place, without minding the pocket, i would recommend this place, but if one is looking for nice Asian cuisines tastes, there are lot of places out there can give you the same rating for foods but 2x or even 3x cheaper than this place. Ambience = 10/10Foods = 6/10Service = 5/10Value = 6/10

Author: NicholasalloverSan Francisco, California
Title: Fantastic food!
Review: Loved this little restaurant! The food was great and the service was perfect. I didn’t have cash because they only take cash, so they let me borrow their car so I could run to the ATM. I just wish they were open on Monday and Tuesday so we could go everyday!

Author: mcyumiPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Left dumb-founded during my birthday dinner.
Review: I was celebrating my birthday dinner at the social bangsar on the the 6th of april 2013, which was yesterday. I was seated at the long table near the kitchen beside the fish tank. The waiter that served us gave me a impression that he was blur or he was intoxicated with certain substance. We asked for our menu and there were 4 of us in the table he only presented one menu to us. We had to shared the menu which was rather awkward for that to happened. Later when we ordered our food the waiter again repeated our orders 3 times and he still got it wrong, but nevertheless we corrected him. When the food arrived, the food that i ordered was served to my friend and the sequence was in a mess again, how could that happened when the same person ordered the food for us and then in ten minutes time he got the sequence wrong again. Being embarrassed was an understatement but the mood and environment created for me and my friends was very uneasy to say the least. While eating i was waiting for two of my other friends who were coming and the cutleries were set wrongly which one was set at the side and another cutleries was set at the end which was three seats away. I then asked for the manager on duty named John, and he seems to talked to the waiter and after that the waiter came back in and i could heard him loudly telling his co-workers that i was fussy and because he only gave me one menu. I think this attitude is totally unacceptable, upon tell the manger about the wrong table cutleries setting he did not rectify the problem and also his facial expression was not attentive and apologetic instead he just listened and left. It was my first experience dining in The social Bangsar, and the food was in my opinion really below par and i was fine with it. What really happened and made my birthday a really forgettable one was the whole dining and service experience in your restaurant. Again, we are paying customers and i am paying for the full price i don't expect anything less anything more. I am just really disappointed with the service in your establishment but what is more disappointing was the manager who was on duty did not rectify the problem or being attentive. I will NOT patronize any of your establishment again, as i feel ashamed and dumb-founded.

Author: LL721Kuala Lumpur
Title: Absolutely the worst Tom Yam Fish soup!!
Review: This place serves the absolute worst Tom Yam Fish Soup. The soup is tasteless.... only tasted spicy, spicy and spicy, thanks to the huge amount of bird eye chillis in the soup!!! We left the soup behind and tried to eat the spicy pieces of fish only.Tried the Ngor Heong. Thought the serving was rather small, and not as tasty as the ones in Penang.Will give this place a miss next time. Only left me with a hot stomach and dissatisfied feeling.

Author: OnePintShortMelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed after reading so many positive reviews
Review: We were here to celebrate my parents' wedding anniversary. It was very thoughtful of them to give my mom a bouquet of flowers and even a cake for the occasion. But let's talk about the reason we chose this restaurant, the food. The chef recommended that we leave it to him to get an assortment of meats. So the first dish was the minestrone soup with freshly baked buns. The soup was really tasty and the bun was light and fluffy. Then we had a salad with shishamo (japanese pregnant fish). The shishamo was grilled perfectly but the salad could have a better dressing other than a few drops of balsamic vinegar. Then it was aglio olio spaghetti with truffles, tasted as it's supposed to be. Then there is the suckling pig. The skin was very crispy but we felt the herbs/marinade was a tad too strong. Then we had the iberico collar and secreto, the meat was pretty good but the pineapple and passion fruit sauce was a bit too sweet. Then the ribeye steak. Judging by the appearance, it was cooked perfectly medium rare. Unfortunately, it was extremely chewy. We were later told that they had accidentally cut the meat parallel to the grain instead of against it. BIG MISTAKE. To compensate, the owner gave us a plate of wagyu beef. It thought it was so-so. We ended the meal with grilled lamb which was pretty good. We paid RM1,008 for the meal for 6 people with 3 bottles of red wine. Plenty of room for improvement. But in the meantime, I think we'll head to Maria's for a good piece of steak.

Author: Beledees
Title: Good food and friendly staffs
Review:
Definitely a great place for couples to dine in. Cozy and comfortable. 
They've fresh imported sashimi and seafood and also nice wine. 
The staffs here give good services and are very friendly. 
Love every dishes they made!

Author: Sharon K
Title: By Far My Favourite Japanese Restaurant
Review: Food and service are just top notch. From the time you call to make a reservation, to arriving at the restaurant, to having your food, and leaving the place - just great service through and through. This place serves the best sashimi I've had. And the unagi is cooked to perfection and just melts in your mouth. The price is a little steep, but it's totally worth it.

Author: Fong J
Title: So many thing to talk about
Review: I dine in this restaurant for lunch weekend buffet and this is my thoughts 1) steamed chinese fish, tasteless fish2) sushi, ratio of rice to meat is not proportion 3) satay, overly oily, i know it requires oil but this a too much. However good tasting marinade 4) beef curry, ridiculously tough and chewy could benefit from longer braise.5) beef stew, all tail cut. I expected brisket or some good meat that have good amount of gelatin.6) lamp leg stew, tough a d chewy, can benifit from longer braising time7) oyster, not the best but good enough 8) malay salads, refreshing, fragrant and good taste balance9) roasted lamb, was expecting it to be tough and dry but it was not. Juicy and tender. Best dish of all.10) smocked duck, love the seeetness amd smoky flavor.11) other dish are quite averageLove to smile of the front of house team. Very good serviceFor a 5star price buffet its not worth the price ( based on my opinion)

Author: 205shanecYamba, Australia
Title: Terrible
Review: Looks amazing but tastes terrible. All the seafood tasted like it had been frozen. Everything was warm. Nothing was hot. After 5 plates of food could not find anything that I liked

Author: stuarts1948Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Restaurant with fine view but kampong atmosphere.
Review: The setting is interesting. The food is very plain and definitely not 'fine dining' nor 'cordon bleu'. Prices are high. The noise from the floor above can be quite overcoming. The management of the restaurant is certainly disappointing. A less than 10 years kid was running round the tables screaming and yelling at 9 pm. We asked the staff if they could put a stop to it. It still persisted and after another ten minutes, we complained again. The manager of the restaurant came and started asking if the kid disturbed us at the table, indicating that he condoned the behaviour. The management attitude was very disappointing. The HSE issue is another matter also.

Author: Puven123
Title: Food exposure
Review:
Excellent food and service best and food traveler recomended
Never fail for their excelent services.

Author: ShamimR59
Title: Great Food Worth The wait
Review: Food was amazing, they had really long line up to get a table. Michael, the owner had warned us that it will take long to get the food since the restaurant was packed and wait list for tables. It was the best food we have had in Mslaysia

Author: carsam ckuala lumpur
Title: Claypot Chicken Rice
Review: Right at the corner of Jalan Yew in Pudu Market, there is this Claypot Chicken Rice. In fact , there are 2 Claypot Chicken Rice Restaurants within a stone throw from each other but this one is more popular. We ordered a Sausage & Chicken Claypot rice with a slice of salted fish & Sweet Potatoes vegetables Taste was above average & if we had enough room for our stomach, we would have ordered more dishes.

Author: bartk275
Title: Great food & atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is somewhat hidden, but definately serves the very best food I've had (up to now) during this holiday!! Even the pizza that we ordered for our kids was delicious!

Author: Truth000Sydney
Title: Abysmal
Review: Ordered the Paella for one. It came out so dry it was encrusted throughout. Took a fork to scrape it but it still didn't come away from the pan.Came with one prawn, one clam and one mussel on top. All dried out and shrivelled.Brought it to the attention of the waiter because that's what they want right? Clearly not.The waiter couldn't back away quick enough. He did tell some guy standing around in a suit, possibly the manager but since I got no acknowledgement it could well have been some dude who just finished work.No approach, no explanation, no offer of a replacement or something else and still charged full price.Food zero. Customer service -1

Author: smalls19862018Cheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: Worst evening ever!
Review: Given that I got engaged that night, it should have been fantastic. The food and restaurant were an absolute shambles. Hot food was only just warm and cold food was equally warm.2 hours later back in our hotel after just getting engaged throwing up alllll night. It would appear that everyone else in KL knew this, we were the only people there.... the view was good though ;)My first and only trip adviser review ** mic drop***

Author: Vlad_AnastassiaMoscow, Russia
Title: Poor service....
Review: Same as a near by Marble 8 - good view, but no care about you.Forgot your orders.Sitting without wine till glasses are dry.You never know who is serving you. There are 5 waters come and go.Sorry, this is not Nobu. I was in Nobu in other cities and it is different - really high class.

Author: LydiaShobha
Title: Best restaurant in KL
Review: Everything is nice here - the food, the friendly and attentive service, the ambience, and the price. I had the 300g black angus steak and it was marvellous!

Author: kon1czGermany
Title: If you want to leave quite a lot of cash on the table and leave with an empty stomach then fatCUPID will be your No. 1
Review: Yesterday we visited fatCUPID because it is rated No. 1 on TA. We hoped for excellent food at a moderate price level since TA suggests you could have apparently the best food even for $5 or somewhat more. Here are our observations:+ Quiet location+ Very friendly waitress+ The taste of the food is not bad (but for sure not good enough to be ranked as the No. 1 on Tripadvisor)Unfortunately these were the only positive facts about fatCUPID. The weaknesses are as follows:- True, the location is quiet, however the fatCUPID belongs to small resort and as such many guests pass regularly through the restaurant area greeting the staff and having small talk which disturbs the atmosphere after a while- Right next to the restaurant area is the hotel’s pool area, so do not be surprised if a hotel guests jumps into the pool while you are having your first bites of food- On first sight the restaurant area seems inviting, but if you take a closer look you realize that the service area is poorly organized. For instance, the restaurant uses glass tables which look truly elegant, however the staff does not use coasters for drinks and plates, especially if you order cold drinks the table quickly turns into a swimming pool when the cold drinks get warmer. Furthermore, it might be beneficial for the restaurant to decorate the tables with some accessories- By now you might think that we are quite picky, but please note that you pay a relatively high price (the normal avg. price for a dinner including an appetizer including one beer will cost at least $10-15) for a dinner which you could get somewhere else $2-5. For this amount of money you would expect everywhere else really good food in a very charming atmosphere, unfortunately the fatCUPID fails in both aspects- The amount of food is really small, smaller than in an ordinary kitchen stall right at the next street corner, you will get a big plate with a small portion of rice and a fairly small cup of your main course. If they did not decorate the plate with cabbage (or whatever it was) the plate would look actually empty- We took the recommended fatCUPID starter for two (~ $9) expecting a wide variety of their best appetizers. Unfortunately there was no variety at all. Not only the outer look of all meals looks very similar, but also the taste of each dish is similar. For instance, at least two out of three meals are based on tough, while the remaining meal involves a deep fried coating. If you aim for any sorts of vegetables, do not expect it in the fatCUPID starter for two.We paid approx. $36 for a starter (for two), two main courses, a smoothie as well as a beer. Unfortunately we left hungry and quite disappointed. After all we would not return to this restaurant anymore, at some point we felt even ripped off. We still do not understand how this restaurant made it at the top of TA. This review sounds really harsh and we are aware of that, but this only a mere reflection of our huge disappointment. Do expect decent food for $5 for this money you will only get some drinks.

Author: mileysYork, United Kingdom
Title: Don't spoil your time in KL by eating here!
Review: Service exceptionally poor, had to ask three times to order, despite the table after me ordering and receiving their meal before I even ordered. Food was greasy, had better from the local takeaway. The waiter came to take it away and left clearing half way through to answer his phone....asked twice for the bill and when it came 8 ringits for nuts I thought were complimentary and 1.80 for the hand towel....speaks volumes. A nice day in KL spoilt by less than mediocre food and service!

Author: royl619Singapore, Singapore
Title: This is not the Sushi Zanmai you are looking for
Review: Ate there with my family when we visited KomtarThere is no conveyor belt at this branch, if that matters to you.Sushi took forever to come. The rice fell apart too easily and was a bit warm and mushy. Fish was fresh enough but again, seemed a little overhandled. Having eaten in Japan quite a bit, I have to say it was not what I expect of a sushi restaurant and i was disappointed. The main branch in KL was quite a few notches better than this place.The gyu udon and oyako were ok.It nevertheless gets pretty crowded at meal times so going outside normal meal times is better.

Author: 91purple
Title: Spicy Lalapan
Review: Its a must try if you are "ayam lalapan" lovers! The sambal is delicious and spicy. The portion is normal.

Author: SsuTianC
Title: Roti Surai and Malayan Seasonal Salad!
Review: Tasted a few stuff at this restaurant, but there was consensus among all the people I took to eat there that the Roti Surai (which is like Roti Jala) is the most delicious. Recently also tasted the Malayan Seasonal Salad and it was excellent too (with avocado tasting better than the ones I bought outside myself - maybe due to the pomegranate juice on it with papaya slices among the greens). May need to call ahead to ask whether stuff like the Roti Surai is available and book table because sometimes might be fully booked. Love the décor and staff is quite polite and service quite good too.

Author: BakesieLas Vegas, Nevada
Title: Eat the durian puff in ONE BITE
Review: We were excited to try the famous one bite durian puff. It is important that you put the whole thing in your mouth and chew. The center is liquid and it will be messy if you don't. This also gives you no choice but to get the full taste of the durian inside. The durian flavor was on par with an onion. I wasn't a fan of the durian taste but the pastry was amazing! A MUST TRY if your interested in tasting durian. It was a fun experience at 2.20RM a puff (.51 cents/USD).

Author: HaffizF2
Title: Great for lunch but..
Review: Been here for around 2 to 3 times already for lunch and I would say that the reason this place is famous and has it's own regulars was only caused by its variety of choices for the side-dishes. Tasted average but the choices will make you go blind!! In terms of service and location-wise, the drinks won't be coming your way in less than 10 minutes, that's for sure. There's so many people and you just kinda have to hope that your favorite dish is still there by the time you arrived. The downside, it is definitely hard to find a parking, especially during lunch and weekends. Dinner time. Been there 2 times and what I can say is that it is a complete 180 degrees from lunch. The food was bad and overpriced. So yeah. In conclusion, Go for lunch, avoid the dinner.

Author: hiiong888Singapore, Singapore
Title: All about noodle and mamee
Review: This place located at jonker street, melaka. An interesting place for young children especially age 5 and ups. We did some activities as follows:1. Mamee noodle workshop at monster kitchenThis activity located at 2nd floor, however, we need to pay at 1st floor. It cost RM 22 per pax. This is good edutainment for children as they can make the mamee monster noodle from the scratch. I feel that this activity quite safe for children as the instructor quite hands in and some activities like steaming and frying are done inside separate room and children only can watch from outside.2. Decorate cups noodle at noodle doodle.This activity located at 2nd floor. However we need to purchase the cup noodles at 1st floor. We need to purchase minimum 4 cups cost RM 5.5 each cups. There are 3 flavour that we can choose. After we finish decorate, the attendance will fill the noodle and wrap it nicely for us.3. Visit mamee museumThis activity located at level 1. Ticket price is RM 5 per person. It is just a small room with all achievement of mamee company and not too interesting for the children.4. Shopping mamee monsterWe bought quite a lot mamee monster and mamee biscuits for souvenir.

Author: g0_f0r_itSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth it at all
Review: Totally disagree with the other 2 reviews. We are not fussy about food but the dishes tasted like any other Chinese dishes cooked by an amateur. We had nyonya chap chai (no different from Chinese chap chai), beef rendang (worse than those cooked by the average hawker or caterer), deep fried fish with chilli (that was not at all cripsy), ayam / chicken ponteh (tasted like most ordinary stir fried chicken with sauce), Ngoh Hiang (like any other you can find in hawker centres/ food courts), Cincaloh eggs (we failed to taste the Cincaloh). Even my kids, who loves eggs, did not finish up the eggs like they usually do. The meal with drinks costs us 137RM. There was no atmosphere or decor in the restaurant to make up for the very ordinary food.We would not recommend it, but if you have to go, the restaurant is along Jalan Merdeka, on the opposite side of Ole Sayang and Fenix Inn. It is within walking distance from the east entrance of Dataran Pahlawan Melaka Megamall. It is opened at 11.30-2.45 for lunch, and 6-9.30 for dinner. It is closed on Tuesdays while Ole Sayang is closed on Wednesdays.

Author: Donnakatrina
Title: Food was nice and cheap!
Review: My hotel was near to this restaurant. And I always bought food here as I travelled alone. I tried almost in the menu and it was all nice and very cheap.

Author: DoreeseWKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is good, but, not ambiance
Review: In terms of the food & service, I would say this is an awesome one!But... the place looked a little run down… Also, I went there in February where they had all these Chinese New Year decoration, which I feel is inappropriate. It was making me felt like I was eating in a Chinese Restaurant, & not a Hard Rock Café !As we, customers go to HRC to enjoy the ambiance & I did not get them on my visit.

Author: mrdeleo
Title: Good recommendation and excellent staff...
Review: I'm going to have dinner with my friends and when I arrived at the front door, I was greeted warmly by a staff person there that looks neat smart and friendly. Shafiq very good about food selection and he suggest to us the food was very good quality and in accordance with user preferences and he was not nervous in conversation whenever new food came to our table Shafiq will make sure used clean plate and he knows how to treat us. I enjoy the food serve to us and we give it all to his full confident and I really enjoy. Shafiq provide the best service on par with 5 star Hotel, I would definitely come here again and find him to treat us. GOOD JOB.

Author: stansngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced n Underrated lobster nasi lemak in septia tropica , Jb
Review: We j had our late lunch at the above resturant ..When we ordered the lobster nasi lemak.. we were told by the waiter that only the “extra large lobsters”were available, at rm 55 per serving.. the smaller lobsters listed at rm 35 were not available for the day.As we had come in thru the 2nd link and from gelang patah, it alrey took us 1hr to reach tis resturant .. we tot let’s go for the large lobster.When it was serve, I couldn’t believe it.. the “extra large” sized lobster was actually a baby one..I know what an “extra large” lobster looks like.To add insult to injury, the whole plate was pathetic..the sambal was not enough for the whole plate, the Ikan bilis I counted was like 10 small fishes.. n the baby lobster can be finished in 3-4 bites n not enough to compliment the rice.We heard other ppl coming in being told the same message tat only the large sized lobsters were available.The table next to us had 9aunties n were obviously Sporeans by their accent.. we could also hear the same comments n complaints tat we felt cheated.So kindly be forewarned- Sporeans..1. The journey is so far away to drive to reach tis place to eat..don’t waste time n petrol.. massive disappointment- not worth the drive n trip.2. The whole place is so dirty.. if you need to go to the toilet, pl do so b4 you eat.. you hav b warned.There were so many flies(the big black type tat luv faeces) flying around, the toilet floor is soiled n wet also..3. The food is all hyped up n not justified to pay this type of good money for mediocre food, n the reputation of tis vendors questionable in terms of honesty.In short, this will be my only and last time to frequent tis pathetic eatery .

Author: Harks91Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It should be shut down.
Review: Sunway Piramid TGI Fridays really sucks, to the core.The service was bad and they even tried to tell me what to do and what to order when i did not ask for their advice. Food was terrible and the portion was minuscule. The food came late and the drinks tasted like detergent (I ordered a Mojito and my girlfriend ordered a Bloody Marry).And here's where the restaurant really sucked, I was charged a whooping RM200++ for 2 drinks and 2 tiny portions of what they called steak.The whole place even smelled like a antique furniture shop and really there is nothing good to say about this place.Go out and walk to Tony Romas for a better experience.let this stupid place shut down,

Author: tcwayfun
Title: Review
Review: Good japanese food. Reliable as ever. Customer service amazing. Consistent food and service quality!

Author: junteng1123
Title: The food is awful
Review: The food is really awful with the price it’s unreasonable. The sushi is not cool and the fish has a unpleasant taste.

Author: dvdsinmk071161Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Buffet Spread at Latest Recipe, Le Meridien KL
Review: Firstly i had a bad experience in finding a parking space at the hotel. After going round and round for 30 minutes, I still could not find a vacant space. The sign which showed 40 vacant spaces was very misleading. Eventually we had to pay to get out and parked at KL Sentral car park. Secondly, we were given a table that was very close to the Japanese food counter. I was sitting hardly a foot away from the crowd. Thirdly the food quality was poor. The prawns at the Chinese food counter were not fresh, the curry laksa taste horrible, waffle was not perfectly cooked and the dim sum tasted poor. However briyani rice with the curry chicken, oyster, fresh prawn and dessert were okay. The hotel needs to improve the overall food quality in terms of taste and freshness if it wants to keep up to its 5-star image.

Author: Ameera O
Title: Tasty Asam Laksa
Review: Me and my bf was craving for asam laksa in penang. Searched on TripAdvisor and brought us here. We did not regret it. I had 2 large bowl for myself. With combination of all the ingredients that need to be in it. The level of spiciness just right. Is a must to try!

Author: PennyPenangDarwin, Australia
Title: Disappointing
Review: After reading the great reviews in Trip Advisor and having friends staying with us we decided to go along and try it out. Whilst the food was ok, we must have been there on a bad day as the service was not up to standard, it was noisy with the music too loud and the ice machine grinding constantly in the background. Sadly it just did not live up to our expectations

Author: World_Traveller_838Melbourne, Australia
Title: Restaurant located at Fahrenheit 88
Review: My wife and I had dinner here in March 2016. The food was tasty, service was okay, prices were reasonable.This chinese restaurant is located in Fahrenheit 88 shopping complex in the Bukit Bintang shopping area. There is another restaurant with the same name, located at Mid Valley Mega Mall shopping complex (probably a different outlet belonging to the same Group of companies). Check the address stated at the top of the page on TripAdvisor.Some reviewers have made this error in their published reviews on this thread.

Author: Jaisya
Title: Good food selections
Review: Enjoyed the variety of food on the large buffet especially the desserts. Great coffee/hot drinks selections and very attentive service. Overall, a good dining experience and will definitely come again.

Author: Lynn83Qi83Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: We reach restaurant for grab a quick brunch by 11am and the restaurant was not yet ready. Customer have to queue to waiting enter the restaurant. Order taking is slow and same as the serving speed. Our drink order was ready and no one serve. When we got the drinks all the ice had melt. One of the friend order the famous nasi lemak which needs more than 30min to ready and another 3 of us had almost finish our meal. Reason giving by the waiter is chef are making the hard boil egg and is in the progress peeling the shell. So you are telling us that chef need to peel all the eggs to serve 1 order of nasi lemak?

Author: TravelmemoirsofswatiKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Alfresco dining on beach
Review: Cba, the beachfront 80-seater restaurant of Meritus Pelangi Beach Resort and Spa provides alfresco dining. It specializes in Asian fusion dishes for lunch and dinner and breakfast is Continental. Dinner is semi- buffet and there are a wide variety of Continental desserts. I enjoyed having dinner on the sea beach with cool breeze blowing from the Straits of Malacca and live musical band. The interiors crafted from recycked wooden doors.

Author: sbak85Nilai, Malaysia
Title: Nasi Daun Pisang
Review: i love this place. whenever i feel like eating Nasi Daun Pisang (plain rice with a variety of choices of Indian cuisine) I'll come here.I also love their Baryani Rice, Mango Lassi and Naan (love their Cheese Naan) but for Naan its only available for dinner.Their food is good and their price is cheaper than other authentic indian restaurant cuisine in Ipoh.And for Muslim, dont worry, this restaurant is HALAL certified by Jakim.

Author: Magg6368
Title: Not worth it
Review: The whole street a bit difficult to find parking,  a bit rundown restaurant. Honestly food price is quite costly.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: jaschintazSingapore
Title: Worst dining experience ever
Review: We've had the worse dining experience ever tonight, and that's saying a lot given the number of restaurants I've frequented around the world. Requested for a table with a view, but got a lousy table in the middle. Waitress serving us couldn't even get our wine order right. Our food took 1 hour to reach us despite us asking 3 times, and when it finally reached us, was cold. Other tables who arrived after us received our food before us. There was a ruckus in the kitchen with shouting and smashing of plates. Waitress spilled our wine when pouring. When we provided feedback, the "head" waitress looked extremely hard pressed to accept it and last but not least, we were charged, not a single cent was waived for all the inconvenience we had to go through. Suffice to say, this will be the last time we will be patronising this place. Great view, but too bad the service is worse than what you get at a Malaccan McDonald's.

Author: imthejessicatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delish!
Review: This is our second time visiting this outlet. Delicious food no doubt and the taste was as authentic as it can get. Superbly clean place as well. Good service given by the young boy waiting tables.The only downside is probably that the mango lassi, despite being fresh mangoes, wasn’t as good as many others that I’ve tried. Tasted a lil syrupy/artificial? Can’t quite put my finger on it.

Author: 688alexanderiStockholm, Sweden
Title: Poor service, great food!
Review: We had a confirmed reservation för 21:00. We started off waiting for 30 minutes in the door. Every time we asked how long it would going to take we got the answer "only 10 minutes". After 25 minutes we asked if we could get complimentary drinks in the bar while we were waiting, we got the answer "we do not give complimentary drinks and the bar is full." After a total of 30 minutes waiting, we told the staff that we are leaving to another restaurant, and they replied that they needed only five more minutes and that we should follow them inside to get a drink. We got a private "waiting room" and complimentary drinks and snacks and were told the table is only 10 minutes away every time we asked. After waiting another 30 minutes in the room, at around 22:00 we finally got our table. The staff gave us no information at all and did not do anything for us meanwhile we were waiting on their own initiative. We had to ask for drinks and snacks during our 1 hour wait.After ordering we all received the food one dish at a time over a period of about an hour. Luckily we were able to share the food and we got a nice tapas experience. The food was very nice and for that price, it was really good value, a luxurious touch on the food.Unfortunately, the service really made us disappointed at the end of the night. It could have been a great experience if they were honest in the beginning. I recommend going here on any other day than a weekend or a holiday.

Author: oedipus98Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Surprise, surprise, surprise
Review: Located in a dinghy building, we climbed up the stairs as we cannot find any lifts. 2nd floor means it is located on the 3rd floor of the building as there is a ground floor, first floor and then second floor. Clear direction on the location of the restaurant. Services is friendly and the food varies from local and western. I like the fact that they have half portion and one portion selection. For lunch, it is a limited choice of menu. Found the lift which is located inside the building right at the corner. Closed on tuesday but other than that open daily from 11am to 10pm. We loved the fried rice and even my fussy mother commended that the food is quite nice even though we did a take away which can reduced the taste dramatically. Will go back there and recommend to others.

Author: Paradise45674440826
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: Ms Azura service is marvelous outstanding superb including Mr Ben, Mr Alam & Ms Aishah. They are very friendly & helpful

Author: Naina3378
Title: Not happy
Review: i did not like the ambience there..not nice at all

Author: Su-tourKl
Title: No taste n less quantity
Review: I went to d tandoori house after reading the reviews but unfortunately our experience os not so gud. We ordered basic veggy dishes which are like no one can willing cant make tasteless as green peas with cheese means matter paneer with dal tadka also tandoori roti n plain rice. We were 2 and the quantity the served after long time was not at all sufficient for one person with no taste at all. All the items are overpriced and having no taste. Even the person who seemed to be manager or owner or served us( same person) is very rude.

Author: chowtrip
Title: Great tea-time offer
Review: It currently runs a great tea-time offer of RM15 for a slice of cake and coffee/tea. Location is great being in the middle of Atria Mall. The staff there is friendly and the food is not bad either.

Author: Cindy W
Title: Good Food and Good Service
Review: The Suckling Pig is really good!! The skip is so crispy!! Service is really good because they give us brief explanation 😊😊

Author: Bluebunny2046
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Every weekend this cafe full of people, some time very difficult to get a seat. Normally after walk at Jonker, will grab a drink at here.

Author: AzmiD_12
Title: good food
Review: good food..the deepfried fish salad are to die for... very delicious. The thai green curry chicken eventhough a little too spicy it was good. Thick and creamy and good chunks of chicken and lots of eggplants.

Author: Rabindra1972Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No longer the place to visit
Review: I was very disappointed with out visit to Manhattan fish. The changes made to the menu was not great. Things are actually more expensive. Ordered fish and chips, they made us eat on a piece is paper, no plate. There were four of us yet they put us on a table meant for 2, no common sense.You would have received 0 stars, but your server was good at accomodating us by giving us plates. I don't know why you think removing plates and using paper would be better culinary experience?? Definitely not for us.

Author: Beijingfolks
Title: relatively inexpensive for that mall and food was fine
Review: The food was tasty and plentiful but the service let this mall eatery down - rather slow, drinks very late and not great English level. Will come though as the bill was 68rm for 2 mains and 2 starters and 3 drinks (NA).

Author: aYish9796
Title: Staff need to SMILE
Review: Smile is everything. Food is nice. Environment is nice. The staff. The staff really need to SMILE. Don’t ever show your stress to the customer directly tru your face.

Author: Kl YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: From Good to Bad ....
Review: I have been to this place for many times. Its was not too bad but recently I had encounter a very bad experience during my visit at the Graze. I ordered a lamb chop and requested for Medium-rare. But the lamb chop was served in medium and I requested for a change. I expected my lamb chop is serve according to my request but guess what, I get a dirty look from the asst manager - Liz saying that the serving earlier was medium rare and throw the food on my table and walked away. And this round I got my lamb chop rare. I am too lazy yo complaint and forced to have my lamb chop rare. And the service quality is worst than Mcdonald. The whole night, no one bother to serve our table not even to refill our drinking water. I don't believe that I am dining at KL Hilton. Dirty Look, Bad service and horrible food....

Author: 284rubenl
Title: Excellent naan and tikka masala
Review: We visited this restaurant based on the previous reviews and it didn’t fail our expectations. The Indian food is very good with tasty garlic naans. The staff is very friendly! Certainly worth a visit when in Kuching.

Author: MgHgLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Somehow Standard Has Dropped
Review: J&R used to serve excellent sausages and such; I'd bring some home after dining there. Was there recently and found that the standard of some if their meats have dropped, although their set lunch was value for money. There was an occasion where we ordered set lunch and they forgot to bring the dessert, which was ice cream. Reminded again and eventually we left without having our frozen confectionery. A word of cvaution: if you think bread and butter are complimentary, think again. They charge RM5 for two measly slices of bread! Service was just average at best.

Author: Hui yi LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: nice servise experience at Wan Li
Review: I went there few days ago with friends to enjoy my breakfast- Dim Sum. Food presentation was nice and strongly recommend Salted Egg Custard Bun the best seller ever. The staffs there are very friendly, polite, attentive in details and had a nice ambiance.

Author: GattoMelakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointing
Review: I have been to this restaurant numerous times. All were during lunch except the last occasion, it was dinner. The Xiao long pau skin was dry and there was little broth in the dumpling. Which is unusual as i had eaten better ones from this restaurant. The noodles were salty. The waitress lacked knowledge and failed to advise us that the 2 vege dishes we chose had the same gravy base. So we ended up the same tasting vege. When we called for help, none of the waiters/waitress were looking at the direction of customers. All were looking at the front door , waiting for new customers. On the last occasion to this restaurant, my experience has been disappointing.

Author: Chia W
Title: Worth trying!
Review: Nice cafe with nice environment.. Food tastes good and in reasonable price. Worth to give it a try :)

Author: DongNLos Angeles, California
Title: Should skip
Review: My girlfriend and I visited kebaya based on tripadvisors reviews. You guys wronged us! The food was uneventful; however, the decor was memorable. For a four course meal per one person, it's around $120 rm. I can definitely say I have had better. I can honestly say that I actually enjoyed local/stall food compared to kebaya. The restaurant was full of tourists. Take that how you want it but I would definitely recommend that you would skip kebaya, save your money and spend it at gurney drive where your money will go a lot farther.

Author: Rob HCoto de Caza, California
Title: Very disappointing
Review: The view is spectacular from the bar and the table seats by the window but that is as far as it goes. There was 4 of us and we started with a Vodka Martini and explained exactly how we wanted it with "NO VERMOUTH". The drinks came out with Vermouth and where exactly 1oz. We sent them back and got a major attitude from the waiter and bar tender. One of our guys went to the bar and showed them how to make our drinks. The restaurant refused to turn on the air conditioning for over 1 hour and if you have traveled to Malaysia you know you need air! We then ordered dinner and a bottle of wine. The waitress brought out the wine and showed us the label and then poured us the taste and it was sour. The bottle had gone bad as the wine was rust tint in our glass. We then told her to take it back and she refused and said she was going to have to pay for it if we didn't. After much arguing with all the staff, they finally took if off our bill. The food was cheap but just OK and that is why I am giving this place 2 stars. For this to be called a steakhouse is confusing to me as they were out of the best steak and was 6:00PM. Follow the reviews and stay away or just go to the bar and have beer, they cant mess that up.

Author: Ativ ATrondheim, Norway
Title: Not so amazing as it is advertised everywhere.
Review: This place is widely advertised as a tourist attraction and I believe if tourists have extra money they can visit this place once.But food is not that much outstanding, you can try better one in some 5* hotels in the city center for a more reasonable price. Panoramic view is beautiful during a day time, but at night you can hardly see the city.And this place is freezing!!!Don't forget to take a shawl or sweater!

Author: Petar TParis, France
Title: To avoid
Review: We went for a dinner and we had to wait for 35 minutes for a table for 2 although there was an available one for the last 15 minutes. Secondly, we ordered some appetizers that came after the main course meal, which on the top of that wasn't that good. We had the impression that we had to leave the table so that others can come. In a conclusion I propose to avoid this restaurant.

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Mr. Adrian Lee
Review: Hidden gem of ipoh famous white chicken with fresh Ben sprouts and meats balls soup which is simply filling to the stomach and having a fulfilling meal. The white chicken is “Kampung Chicken” with its char siew is solely marinated by the owner itself which makes it delicious crunchy and tasty

Author: EvaP1270
Title: Cafe
Review: Neat cafe with just the right kind of menu for people on the mid range. Taste okay and coffee was alrite.The atmosphere was nice in the evening

Author: Chris_OrleansKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Faboulous ribs, great friendly staff
Review: Love that place mostly for the ribs ... tender and melting in the mouth high in tasteThe staff is really nice and friendly many of them are Philippinos.It s a bit hot there for me as I m a a/c lover but it s ok

Author: alexchandran84
Title: Must go!
Review: Filet mignon! Done to perfection! And an awesome manager! Great service and imported beer!  Gotta return to try their other cuts of meat!

Author: kajambeCanberra, Australia
Title: Skip it and look elsewhere
Review: I had high hopes for a Saturday night seafood buffet, but was disappointed all round. There was no issue with the range - crab, yabbies, prawns, mantis shrimp, baby crayfish, oysters, sushi and sashimi....Sounds great? Ah, no. All frozen and thawed, which is easy to tell by the soft mushy flesh and complete lack of seafood flavour. The lone exception were the great really freshly shucked oysters. Sadly even the sashimi suffered from sitting prepared too long. If you aren't interested in seafood, there were roasts and curries, pastas etc which looked like standard buffet fare. If you still end up here, one tip is that they currently offer a cheap bottle of white or red wine at around RM85 which is on their website, but not on their menu. We asked and it appeared and was fine - less than half the price of any other bottle on the menu. It was also very noisy and not an enjoyable relaxing dinner - lots of huge tables with kids running about the place, staff trying but just not able to keep up with the clearing of plates. I will note that despite the general chaos, when we asked staff for help they were very pleasant and polite, and really were trying their best.

Author: Wolf D K
Title: Delicious Surprise
Review: Laksa is what you should get and enjoy, blue rice is ok and chicken good. No alcohol and very nice family service, price moderate. Beware: Closing early.

Author: stoko42Taunggyi, Myanmar
Title: Great food, attentive staff
Review: This is a great little cafe hidden away by the river. Due to rain the outside seating by the river was closed. Even though the cafe itself doesn't very special it is worth staying for the food. The staff are super friendly and attentive they serve great pork meatballs with mash potato and my wife had a very interesting slow cooked pork belly stew. And the ice cream mud pie desert was delectable. Definitley worth a visit if you are in Malaka. As a bonus they also play funky 1950's tunes

Author: Yennlynn-1
Title: Disappointing
Review: Food was reasonable but the waiter who is called mr Yan was superb. However, I ordered 3 pastas for my children n that have cost me a whopping rm 362. Plain scallop pasta, nothing to shout about. I’m very disappointed with the exorbitant price for simple pasta which I feel is cut throat. Will not return to this horrible venue

Author: coley vBangkok, Thailand
Title: Fun
Review: This is a nice spot! Family friendly and affordable. The steaks are inexpensive and just ok. Do not, I repeat, do not order the oxtail soup. It seems that they add way to much flour. We didn't even finish it. I will definetly go back because I love the atmosphere and fun vibe. The staff was nice and attentive. I also noticed several people bringing in their own wine and wine glasses which I what I'll do next time!

Author: jennycP7700JEKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not So Tickled Dinner
Review: Food served here is just average. Based on the quality of food served here, the prices are quite high. Though the service staff has been trained well to up-sell their products,but whatever they recommended ended not very tasty or satisfactory.The lighting in the restaurant is too dim and furniture not comfortable. The biggest damper to me was finding a fly in my coke that they served to our table.Though the service staff was quick to replace my drink but we decided never to return..

Author: arminhazariMumbai, India
Title: A taste of India in KL
Review: The ambience is lovely. it is not too overpowering- as it is in most indian restaurants abroad. a large tree in the centre of the retaurant welcomes you and is hung with cheerful lights. The space is large and airy and feels lovely. The food is to die for. absolutely delicious. Try the South Indian Chillies soaked in curd and deep fried - a must for every visiting Indian, and don't miss the Sea food. The service is quick and smiling, leaving you feeling happy!

Author: jacquim883
Title: Very average dim sum
Review: One of the older dim sum restaurants in KL, this place is clearly popular with locals and was mobbed when we visited. Due to renovations at the front porch, it was a trek to get to their parking lot. At 12 noon, they had sold out of the hot favourites like egg tarts and roasted 'char sue bao'. However, service was efficient and we had a reasonable lunch of average dim sum. Beware those with a nut allergy - even innocent dishes like 'char sue' (barbecued pork) are marinaded in peanut oil!

Author: CarmenC5516
Title: Energetic Vibes with Good Service Crew
Review: The atmosphere was impeccable - it only gets better with the service crew here. The manager was unbelievably attentive to what we need and made good sure that we were comfortable.We had nachos, pizza and fries - safe to say that we enjoyed them a lot, albeit on the pricey side.I would definitely come back for another good night of food.

Author: HKinseyParaparaumu, New Zealand
Title: Definitely not Spanish!
Review: The staff seemed to be in a hurry to get rid of us. The tapas didn't arrive together, then they served a main while we still were eating the tapas.The staff are nice, but not enough to compensate for the rest of the experience.

Author: IsaactanjsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner Special & Socials at Chili’s Malaysia
Review: When was the last time you dined at Chili's Malaysia, any of their outlet for that matter? It's been a while since I tried their fares hence it was nice to find out they have launched their latest Dinner Special & Socials at Chili’s promotion which is real value for money. How much do you save? Well, from only RM35.95, you get a choice of either salad or soup to start you off, one hearty main course and a scoop of vanilla ice cream for dessert. Now that's what I call value for money!Chili's SocialBefore we get into the heavy mains and what nots, we kicked off our meal with Chili's new Socials menu which is basically yummy starters available for order throughout the day. Do note they are currently available for a limited time only from 27th May till 22nd July 2017. Creamy Jalapeño Wings & Chili Garlic WingsWings, they can literally fly if you want them too. Who doesn't love themselves some scrumptious chicken wings. We tried two vastly different flavours, the Creamy Jalapeño Wings which is on the spicy side, and the Chili Garlic Wings which I truly like! Why? It's just so flavourful with chile-garlic sauce, resting on creamy avocado crema, sprinkled crumbled feta cheese and fresh cilantro. Must try if you're craving for some delicious chicken wings as starters. Dinner SpecialThe Dinner Special at Chili’s consists of soup or salad, a delectable main course and a scoop of vanilla ice cream to end it all. There's three sets of pricing to choose from, either the RM35.95, RM40.95 or the RM43.95 one. Do note that the Dinner Specials are only available after 6pm from 27th May till 22nd July 2017. Let's have a look at the choices of soup, salad and ice cream first below, before we head on to the heavy stuff, the MAINS! The MAINS! RM35.95 Dinner Special ComboFor RM35.95, on top of the soup, salad and ice cream, you get a combo of the delectable and crispy Country Fried Chicken, or the Boneless Buffalo Chicken Salad. How did it taste? For one, I love how the crispy chicken breast tasted, hand battered and deep fried to a crisp on the outside. This dish comes with mashed potatoes and sweet corn on the side. This combo comes with the Boneless Buffalo Chicken Salad, so you could actually share these! For the same price of RM35.95 combo, you could go for the Firecracker Fish Fillet dish. Beautiful. We had a whole slab of grilled white dory ﬁllet brushed with sweet & spicy glaze and garnished with red chile tapenade & sesame seeds. Served with rice and seasonal veggies, you got yourself a complete, healthy meal over there. Why is it named Firecracker? Must be the red chile tapenade on top of the fish. RM40.95 Dinner Special Combo MainsTortillas lovers would do good to go for their signature Southwestern Quesadillas Combo. Inside these tortillas, we have a yummy combination of marinated chicken and beef with grilled onions and Jack cheese. Dip it into the sour cream and house-made pico de gallo, and you're good to go! Burgers! Get me one, or more of these sinful delights. The Sweet & Smokey Burger came looking absolutely drool-worrhy, where we had these hand-seasoned beef patty topped with Pepper Jack cheese, beef bacon, onion rings, leaf lettuce, tomato, mango-infused BBQ sauce & Chili’s Signature sauce. Even the bread looks good albeit, it was a bit on the hard side when bitten into. Served with house-made garlic dill pickles, homestyle fries and a side of mango-infused BBQ sauce, this makes a good meal by itself. But don't forget that with a price of RM40.95 you're getting those extra soup, salad and ice cream! What a deal! RM43.95 Dinner Special ComboChipotle Prawn Fresh Mex BowlPrawns, lots of it in a bowl. The Chipotle Prawn Fresh Mex Bowl consists of marinated grilled prawns, corn & black bean salsa, rice & chipotle pesto. It is then topped with cheddar cheese, house-made pico de gallo, fresh ﬁeld greens, chopped cilantro, crispy tortilla strips, fresh sliced avocado & a drizzle of cumin-lime sour cream. What a blast of flavours in one bowl of noms. Southwestern Grilled LambLooks good doesn't it? Although I would have preferred my beef steak, the Southwestern Grilled Lamb did good as well. Grilled lamb with Chili’s special marinade, served with mashed potatoes with black pepper gravy and seasonal veggies, one of my favourite mains that evening.

Author: Ljssss
Title: Bad experience
Review: Terrible experience,the dishes are not nice and the prices are unreasonable.The service of the staff is bad and didn't let us know the price of each dish.

Author: gabriel78346
Title: Extremely rude manager offers bad customer service reflected in his aggressive manner.
Review: The very high volume of music ruins the atmosphere for many people. I have never written a review before but this incident compelled me to do so. I am worried that my ears may be damaged as a result of the volume.The rude customer service was the most perturbing and ruined the experience. I recommend avoiding this restaurant.The manager was extr

Author: szenth25Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over rated dim sum restaurant
Review: It is overrated and quite expensive. Not to mention the food are cooked with lots of MSG. It is always packed over the weekend and their services sucks. The staff are not 'really' that friendly to serve. I strongly believed that there are plenty of good dim sum restaurants in Klang Valley to look out for!
Restaurant: Restoran Jin Xuan Hong Kong "Kuchai Lama"

Author: SuzieMMNew York City, New York
Title: Fantastic afternoon tea service!
Review: Had a lovely afternoon tea with my parents. I made reservations and requested a window seat overlooking the park. They are currently partnering with Chopard on a Christmas-themed afternoon tea, everything was delicious! For RM 148++ per person, we got 2 scones, 6 sweets and 4 mini sandwiches. Also unlimited hot beverages for 2 hours, including coffee, teh tarik and hot chocolate (in addition to more traditional teas).Service was impeccable, we were never without a hot beverage. Nadia especially was wonderful. Thanks Nadia for taking care of me and my parents.Highly recommend for anyone looking to have an indulgent tea experience!

Author: Quinie O
Title: Ambience
Review: Nice & cosy ambience accompanied with sentimental music and friendly service. Suitable for families, friends and lovers too.  Do pay a visit to enjoy the delicious food.  There is a variety of food to choose from.

Author: feltroneuGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Unreasonable pricing
Review: Having dinner there with some of the visitors from China. We are 5 together and order 6 dishes. The portion is relatively small which did not match to the price they charged. The most unreasonable price is the Asam prawn where 6 average size of prawn costing RM47.70 including GST. My visitors complaint they have never ate so expensive prawn before. I really felt shame. The other dish is taufu where they only serve 3 pieces of small taufu and charged us for RM19+. Taufu is a very cheap dish. Taste is so so and service is not up to our expectation as the waitress was a bit rude. I think I am not the only one complaining the food is pricy. With same price I think I can order even crab at another restaurant. So be aware.

Author: erfani83Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great grilled fish
Review: Whilst walking in Jalan Alor I came across this place and ordered their chilli grilled fish ( stingray) which is cooked in a banana leaf and a bowl of coconut rice.Prices are moderate ( not too high) I generally don’t eat a lots of sea food but really liked this dish. If you happened to come to this area I would recommend this dish to try.

Author: 690chewl
Title: Birthday Dinner with family
Review: Amazing food. Must try the mushroom soup. The pastry dish with mushroom fillings is my favorite. This is such a cosy and nice place. Not noisy enough for decent conversation between two people. Such a nice ambience. And the food is superb.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: HYun19
Title: Local Gem
Review: Most websites recommend tourists to visit Orkid Ria for good seafood so we planned to go there initially. But, a local guide that we met during our snorkeling tour recommended Wonderland Food Store. He said that the food tastes delicious and the price was comparatively cheaper. According to him, it's a place where locals go to get good seafood. Indeed, as the local guide had said, the food there was really good and the price was affordable, even for budget travelers. We ordered butter prawn, fried squid in salted egg yolk, greens, chicken, white rice and Chinese tea for four. It costs only RM17++ per pax. The place is always packed with locals and it only opens for dinner. (Tip: Go there slightly earlier to secure a table, or else, you will need to stand by the side to wait for an empty one.)

Author: arsenalrulz18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Horrid Service and average food
Review: Was there last weekend and will never return again- we had 3 tables ( came as a big group)- our table was mainly children -least no. of adults.I had to ask the wait staff at least 3 -4 times for the dishes to be served- our counterparts at the other 2 tables already had all of their food served and were almost finishing their food when our table had our first dish.When we feedback to the wait staff, no apologies- just the comment that : " if you want good food, you'll have to wait' .Come on- their food isn't that great to begin with and there is totally 0 customer service.BAD BAD BAD please avoid

Author: Torzas
Title: Disappointed
Review: I dont think the food is that great. Food is basically sweet, had 4 dishes and 3 tasted sweet. No salty no peppery but sweet. Only vege tasted ok. Points up for their service.

Author: 99denistDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Good HRC standards
Review: As usual with hard rock you get great service and food. The band was good but again as with hard rock a bit loud for us “older” ones . Always worth a visit.

Author: HotKhongPenang
Title: Great place but busy as heck
Review: Decent food, but the food service was a bit slow on the holiday weekend when I visited. This place gets really busy on weekend mornings.

Author: ali18242016London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: Came here after reading all the reviews, service is great the guys working at front line really do a good job but the food really lacked flavour, i had the chicken shawarma but it tasted very dry. So i ordered the Fish which was overpriced for a fish in Langkawi!! My Bill came to 200 ringgit which is quite pricey when i didnt have starters dessert...

Author: OziemuncherBrisbane, Australia
Title: Visit , take a photo and go some where else
Review: It is hard to pick the worst feature of this " Bistro ". Service 0/10 - Menu 0/10 - Food 0/10.On a positive note the beer was cold but only two brands - no wine - no spirits.Half way through my entrée / soup my main was delivered. The staff are completely and comprehensively hopeless. Well appointed and the best view in Kuching.Must be Government owned??And to add insult to injury they do not take credit cards.

Author: Eddie T
Title: Typical restautant in Malaysia with Excellent Food
Review: It was quite easy to find this restaurant which was sited along the main street of Berkeley Garden in Klang. Typical Chinese restaurant setup. Surprisely it was relatively cleaner than most of the typical Chinese restaurants in town. It was so crowded most of the time. We ordered the food 1st before we had place to sit down. No long we were standing there before there was table available for us to sit. So the shop would guarantee you will have table and the food at the same time. Waiting time for the food was relatively longer than expected. The food was served after 25minutes waiting. However, the foos was delicious. Overall they cannot score full as there is room foe improvement for the environment of the restaurant. They may need to think of expansion to accomodate more people. Food wise we have no regret with it and we definitely will come again.

Author: chanshuikay
Title: Overrated
Review: Totally overrated, all the food is so so yet everything is expensive. However their service and atmosphere are good. The food isn't bad, just its not great enough to justify the price, you can get better food at cheaper prices elsewhere.

Author: ngchnchongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent birthday celebration
Review: Food, services, environment - all well done! The dinner course was really huge in portion including the sashimi. It was really fresh and taste superb! One of the best Japanese restaurant I will revisit again. The staff there were playing guitar and singing birthday song to me - thank you very much, indeed it is really nothing else can be complained.

Author: jaygirl2019
Title: Limited menu
Review: a beautiful cafe with garden theme. But the list menu was very limited. Less food varieties. But food really delicious. I really love the chocolate lava cake. I've tried in most places but, this lava cake really delicious. The presentation also interesting. Mostly this place famous for events like birthday party and so on. No cocktails and moctails. If they serve more food varieties means, can attract more customers.

Author: RubiYAYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wrong order, no service recovery
Review: Having read good reviews, we went to YamYam on empty stomachs expecting good food..Partner ordered a burger. Good solid beef burger but nothing to rave about. He did comment that the bun was a bit thick though. No complaints here overall. I ordered the Dutch Bitterballs, a starter of 6 breaded meatballs.
