Instead, they confused my order with Dutch Meatballs. So I received a large plate with 5 (boiled?) meatballs, a mound of greasy potatoes, some salad and applesauce. Almost double the price (RM31 vs RM18), so much unwanted food, and sadly, SO BLAND. I had to ask multiple staff before they acknowledged the mistake. To be fair, the Lady boss came over and offered to redo the original order but said it would take half an hour. We were hungry n didn't want to make a fuss, so we said never mind, but only realised our error once we started eating because really, everything was SO BLAND!We peppered and peppered, but couldn't save the bland balls, bland potatoes and overly sweet applesauce. Lady Boss came midway to check on us and could see we weren't pleased (and the food was unfinished) but there weren't any further attempts at service recovery. And when the bill came... yep they charged RM31 for the wrong order, instead of RM18 for what we had wanted. I can see this both ways, but as a customer, this is the least I'd have expected them to do to make up for a mistake they acknowledged. can't help but feel a little upset as I tried to be accommodating by not making them redo the order which I can only assume would have resulted in a further loss for them, so really disappointed that this wasn't corrected in the bill of their own initiative. It was actually our wedding anniversary and we didn't want to make a fuss, so just paid and left ... never to return again...

Author: VRJL
Title: Nice restaurant.
Review: A good restaurant for a business dinner.   Food was very good.  Good wine selection.   Service was good as well.

Author: DummiessmurfJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: - late updating for food that out of stock. No synchronised in taking order between the cashier and the kitchen staff. Seems like no communication among the staffs. - meal takes an excessively to be served which the stomach full by drinking water while waiting for food.- Paying the 10% taxes for nothing when the customer itself come to cashier for order and payment. - not providing the pictures of meals on menu quite hard for customers to know what it is.- such an disappointment for the ambience of the cafe, plain with dull decorations, the big glass windows without any curtains to cover the brightness and also the chair like silent killer are harmful to sit on. Pity to old people. - didn't follow the SOP; no distancing and some of the staff didn't wear the mask properly when serve the food.

Author: Alanimei
Title: Don't get fool by its title. Not the best :/
Review: Overpriced chicken chop. (RM 16) Almost forget what I'm here for. The' root beer' they used is probably some low quality root beer (taste like it's already mix with water) cost Rm 6.5. Poorly trained staff- bad communication and service skill. I suggest you go for chicken chop selling in the mall. Any of it would taste better than this. Dissapointed.

Author: kcpacPerth, Australia
Title: We really do eat with our eyes...
Review: Fantastic experience! Definitely made me better understand how much we rely on visual cues when eating. The food was a good mix of familiar and a bit unusual. Well worth a try.

Author: chesperjoghnepang
Title: Could Have Been A Gem
Review: At a friend's recommendation (who happened to be a friend of the owner, Chef Raymond Tham), I decided to treat my love to dinner at S@163 to celebrate his passing his Year 2 IATAS exams. Rave reviews had Louis and I really excited, but by the time the third main came and went, the promised fushion culinary experience was far from divine.Service was personal, no question about it. 6 different staff members greeted us, sat us down, served our drinks and food, and settled our near RM 400 bill. It was a heavily rained-out but humid KL evening. Other than Louis and I, there were only 2 others quietly drinking at the open patio area.Good food (as we were told) was what Louis and I came for, and we were quick to explore S@163's adequate menu geared toward carnivores sipping what would probably be one of the most delicious, well-chilled Mojitos on the planet. (8.5/10)PRE-COURSE 1. CANAPES.So, these little beautiful stacked-up baby canapes arrived. A tiny, crunchy piece of deep-fried salmon (think that was what the waitress said) sat on top of a dollop of pureed guacamole, topped with what I can only gather was salsa, all nicely crowned over a piece of crispy tortilla or papadum. Freshness was really lacking in this little beauty during the munch. If it was salsa, the usual battle of rawness of onions, freshness of tomatoes and the tang of citrus bound by a virgin olive oil emulsion were evidently hovering in Jupiter and not Earth. Similarly, the guacamole was a boring buttery mush without bite.Never mind, it is only a freebie from S@163. (3/10)PRE-COURSE 2. BREAD."Freshly-baked straight from the oven", said the gayly waitress as she laid them browned dough between Louis and my Mojitos. I thought, not too bad for S@163 to serve these hot little chewy Japanese-like Pans straight from the oven. Later, as we left the restaurant and walked by the open kitchen, these little "freshly-baked straight from the oven" buggers were happily tucked nicely in a big tupperware wrapped in clingfilm! Still, they were quite good. (7.5/10)APPETISER 1. SCOTCH EGGS ON ASIAN LEAVES.Traditionally, spiced-up ground pork (sausage meat?) wrapped around an egg, this version used minced chicken instead. To qualify for Halal certification I suppose. Instantly, from the first bite, the texture and taste of these so-called Scotch Eggs felt like frozen chicken patties from the local supermarket! Not a Scotch Egg, surely--the restaurant should rename this dish, and quickly!A more coursely-ground chicken meat with a stronger hint of All Spice would have made this exceptional.Asian leaves? Chicory? Rocket? Carrot julienne? Hardly. Just a few slivers of ginger flower with a generous sprinkling of sesame seeds do not make this salad medley Asian. Sigh... I would have left the salad out entirely this great idea. A nice, delicate Asian pickle or chutney would be a better accompaniment.(3/10)APPETISER 2. PAN-SEARED HOKKAIDO SALADS.When I saw the Chicory lettuce that came with S@163 Scotch Eggs earlier, my heart sunk to the deepest depths of the Pacific Ocean. No chef should ever acquaint scallops with lettuce! Scallops' sides were fibrous--hmm... Then, came the greatest dismal: slivers of Japanese-pickled ginger sat under the medallions... Jeez... Saving grace could have been the undercooked scallops as they should be, but their fibrous sides sort of killed the thrill... Chef, I would have just gone for a Yuzu-infused virgin olive oil and balsamic drizzle, with bits of local crunchy fruits. Simple and sharp.(3/10)MAINS 1. SIGNATURE ASIAN AGLIO OLIO.By the time the first main course came, disappointment has become mainstay at dinner. I just felt so sorry for Louis. Signature Asian Alio Oglio. Aglio Olio. Whatever. It doesn't matter anymore, because that's what this main course was. Confusion. Huge tiger prawns were dry from being superbly overcooked--yes, I was being sarcastic. Again, questions over the freshness of this restaurant's main raw ingredients. Did S@163 killed the fresh tiger prawns on purpose by over-deepfrying them? Or simply, a lack of skill? One minute of 190C oil would have crisped the head-shell and tail to an edible crunch, and kept the flesh fresh to the bite.Al dente spaghetti seemed fine, but when the olive oil-absent, overpowering dried shrimp taste started flooding the palette, I left the rest untouched. Subtlety was lacking. Chef, if I wanted fried prawn noodles, I would have gone to the local hawker stall.Curry leaves were a waste of space. They did not contribute nor complement. (3/10)MAINS 2. SOUS-VIDE BARRAMUNDI.I believe this was my first ever sous-vide experience... Mmm... I shall have to ponder at this assertion a bit because I did visit a seafood restaurant in Singapore that served a selection of marine life and Chorizo in a plastic bag... In spite of earlier repeated disappointments, I was extremely excited. My BP should have shot up in anxiety. And, I even gargled my mouth with Mojito to rid the crustacean-assault of the earlier dish to prepare myself for the sous-vide experience. When the Barramundi arrived, the culinary creation was lopsided on the plate's real estate. An eye-sore. I felt so sorry for the Barramundi. Some flavourness chipped, crumbly stuff sat on top of the slab of Barramundi. The fish was tasteless and well, overcooked. The lemon-sauce was bland and uninspiring. The poached and dead-looking sticks of scallion missed the mark.Saving grace: the potatoe puree.I left the fish alone after 2 bites.(2/10)MAINS 3. BRAISED AUSTRALIAN BEEF BRISKET.The final taste assault for the night.Where the culinary fushion showed in this dish I don't know, but this and our last main course for this evening was an odd taste and quality swivel. The cocoa-infused beef and its not so subtle jus left the dry-ish red meat sitting overwhelmingly underwhelming. Sometimes, less is more, Chef... and a bit of tang would help the palette along, eh?Not quite the melt-in-your-mouth brisket I was hoping for. Bad selection of the brisket at the market I say.  (5/10)One disappointment after another, Louis and I opted off dessert. We would be in better shape with another round of Mojitos to close the evening.My review here may be scathing, but I hope Chef Raymond Tham and his team will take my criticism with some level of construction. Not everyone can be pleased easily--certainly not me, the nitpicky. I just wish S@163 will do well.(Oh, one last thing. I hope the staff understands that BO is never part of any restaurant's menu...)Good luck!

Author: Henk MVlaardingen, The Netherlands
Title: It is difficult to shine in Batu Ferringhi
Review: Yes, with so many good eating spots in Batu Ferringhi to choose from, it is busy at the top and I am afraid that Helena's Café is not the top in Batu Ferringhi. Granted, Helena's Café fits in the expectation of a casual sit down, the service of the staff is polite and dedicated, but in my experience the food is a bit bland and mediocre at best, not to be compared with the Long Beach Hawkers center or Andrew's Kampung, to name a couple of shining stars in Batu Ferringhi. A positive point of Helena's is the flexible opening hours.

Author: saifjan
Title: Take way, tom yam
Review: Last night we had a tom yam soup, its very worst food for my life, my friends also having and today morning onwards me and my friends to much  stomach problems we feel, we will never eat this soup.

Author: izzatdaraniBatu Caves, Malaysia
Title: For tummy and eye treat
Review: Not only the food is tasty, the environment around the restaurant also is distinctively lovely and exquisite. A little bit old town plus the beautiful paintings on the wall give a little art adventure for the customers while enjoying the meals. On the other hand, I felt quite uneasy to walk around due to the narrow structure of the restaurant. Overall, thumbs up for B&G!

Author: jackie f f
Title: good food if a little expensive
Review: very busy so would recommend booking, the food was really good but as to be expected rather expensive

Author: DarrencheonghyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very poor bbq buffet dinner experience
Review: There are few things right at this restaurant, but many wrongs as well.The good: -waiters and waitresses are very friendly.-food is quickly replenished.-drinking water is also replenished very quickly.Now on to the bad:-the selection is horribly limited. -quality of most food is subpar to say the least (especially the oysters tasted not fresh and beef was too overdone)-although the bbq buffet was greatly advertised, only the lamb was good, while the duck and beef were very overdone.-choices of dessert were very limited.-pastry was OK but still not justified given the price.To conclude, at a price of 125 nett, you are definitely better off going to more popular buffets such as contango(which is the same price) and other popular ones such as Shangri-la and le Meridien.

Author: Ian CWithington, United Kingdom
Title: Pay for the view, not the meal!
Review: Unfortunately I didn't listen to the fellow reviewers who described the food as average.....The food here is average at absolute best. It's your classic 'Eat as much as you can' style buffet place, where they count on customers appreciating quantity over quality.If the food was good, the bill of RM550 would have been absolutely fine, but it didn't measure up to the food on offer elsewhere in KL available at 1/3 of the price.A few other things to be aware... When they say your serving closes at 11, they mean it. We were still finishing up when they turned on all the lights and STOPPED THE RESTAURANT REVOLVING!They then got the bill wrong twice, initially undercharging by RM400! I should have put the cash on the table and left, but hey ho!My advice, pay the fee to go up to the look out point, then go anywhere else in KL for food and drink!You have been warned again, please take heed!

Author: GaffarM4Khartoum, Sudan
Title: Lunch
Review: Its my 3rd time here , and its the same taste of the place and food , always crowded and had the Trio Fajitas (Lamb, chicken and Grilled Prawns ) Rm 55.95 around 14 USD .. for 2 people as we were not hungry..I founded responsibly good .. great service attitude as usual..

Author: dampenedgimbals
Title: Cafe Cafe so bad they named it twice
Review: Damned shame the food was as poor as it was because the restaurant itself was full of charm. Duck confit was as bad as I have had - you would have been better off playing the drums with that drum stick. Starter of 'Camembert' should have been the warning sign - did not taste of cheese. Wine list was OK, but for a 'French' restaurant - just having one french white wine to pick from was very disappointing. Overall, with the pricing they charge it was a remarkably disappointing experience

Author: Jase8213Shoreham-by-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Last night after staying here and trying all the other restaurants in the area
Review: Poor. Service super slow! Food average. Arrived and waited 20 minutes before even being acknowledged and given a menu. Another 15 mins until asked for drinks! Asked for a selection of breads to dip whilst waiting on main a la carte main course, we got sliced white bread!! Steak was good, Lamb was poor, over-cooked chewy strips. Really slow to get another drink or even acknowledged!

Author: Imah_MY
Title: Soaring prices!
Review:
This is my second trip here. The food & service has not improved.  Really expensive prices for very average food.  

Very bad service - you have to wait for hours for your order to arrive.

Author: Keinth123
Title: Service
Review: Good service by shalu. Good recommendation for you to drop by for dinner and beer of course. Nice ambient too.

Author: hazinheiraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Flavourful food, but only remotely portuguese-inspired
Review: The cooking style is not Portuguese, but we nevertheless enjoyed the food. We had the water spinach, fried rice and clams. We found that the spices overpowered the flavour of the clams and that we should have ordered them less spicy. We sat in the courtyard outside – the setting is simple but clean, and prices are very affordable.The staff speaks English.

Author: eatrepeat
Title: Delicious Pork Dish
Review: Lovely place. Was recommended the fried noodles but I found it too oily and overly salted. The Dayak Char Siew was flavourful though some pieces were chewy. The Sunny Bowl granola was absolutely delicious and the best we had here in Kuching! Came back for it the next day but the mango was not as sweet but still all good. Do sit outside if you get the chance. Can get a lil stuffy.

Author: SinagQuezon City, Philippines
Title: Had potential but service is poor
Review: We have visited The Barn a few times since we arrived in KL. It was easy to access as it is the first restaurant you see when you enter the 1 Mont' Kiara mall.Dishes are non-halal. Alcoholic drinks are available. We thought this would have been a neighborhood favorite for us. They serve all sorts of pork dishes from crisped roast pork, sausages, breaded pork chops. A variety of 'western' dishes like steak, salmon, fish and chips and pasta. Quality is decent/above average.What is consistent on every visit however is the lack of good service. There are servers milling around but on some occasion, we have to follow up orders, servers coming back because they can't remember our orders, delivery of bill takes too long and the last straw was when servers distract our kids to the point that - even if it is with good intentions - they clandestinely ask my youngest child to enter the kitchen to give her a sweet. No management of an establishment should allow their staff to have that kind of behaviour anytime. During the same visit, we have made the payment and the waiting staff took away my credit card (inadvertently of course), started chatting with a fellow server - completely forgetting that we do need to go home but could not because she still had my credit card. Ironically, we could not even make eye contact with a server to get the card back.Honestly, the servers do not deserve the service charge that is automatically placed on the bill. Well, they got it but lost our custom in the end.

Author: Leesa DJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Amazing!
Review: Having lived in Malaysia for 2 and a half years we are huge dim sum fans and often seek out small family run places in KL. I'd read about this place and couldn't wait to try it. We arrived around 9:45am Saturday morning and were warmly greeted and offered Chinese Tea and pork buns....yes please! We also had a couple of other dim sum items. The pork buns were full of meat and bursting with flavour, almost like a meal in itself. RM12 for our dim sum, pork buns and tea. Bargain compared to KL prices. We were the only westerners there but we are used to that. Thank you and keep doing what you're doing!

Author: mazzami97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place for dining!
Review: They serve one of the best hotel buffet in kuala lumpur! The food is really good and tasty. The hospitality of the staff is very warm and friendly!!

Author: FBJ1805Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fish & Dishes that Dance with Flavour
Review: Had dinner with the family last night. Enjoyed the food - familiar, flavorful and consistent. Service was a little slow last night - they had a large group in the restaurant. Must have are dishes like the signature dancing fish, towering tofu, BBQ duck, and their sambal were divine.

Author: RahmatAsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: I was ready to like this place cos of the reviews only to leave with my friends feeling bloated & getting indigestion last night. We came at 8.45 pm thinking we should still be able to get a decent dinner since it was listed 10 pm as closing time on Facebook. We were immediately told they were closing at 9.30 instead and 9.15 would be the last order. We enquired then whether it would be ok still to order and a staff member said it was fine. Immediately we were pressured to place orders. While we were trying to finish our meal at 9.10 we were already given the bill clearly hurrying us out the door. We gobbled our food feeling rushed while air-con was getting switched off and some lights turned off. We left at 9.15 without a thank you or come again. I guess we won't be bothering with such uncaring abrupt service for the meal experience.

Author: Alina V
Title: Awesome place!! Recommend!!!!!
Review: Very good place, will highly recommend for everyone who wants to try some good Arabic cosine. Shisha and dishes are godlike. Bahlawa is must try! You absolutely won't be disappointed with this place.

Author: makaul_movesToronto, Canada
Title: Staff made for an excellent experience
Review: It goes without saying that the food and the cocktails (especially) are amazing here. What almost made for a poor experience is that our waiter forgot one of the two main orders. Once brought to their attention, they reopened the kitchen and brought it out with haste. At the end of the meal, one of the staff (perhaps a manager) came up to us to offer an explanation and apologies for the oversight. Instead of covering up the mistake, they were honest about the error and reasoning behind it. They also did not charge us for either meals or appetizers to make up for it. The sincerity was appreciated and really superseded expectations in customer service.

Author: prutbcMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: 1st visit
Review: The relaunched was on 10 Dec 2019 and we went there for chilled out on 14 Dec, Saturday while they were having a pair of singer performing through the night. It wasn't a good and smooth performance thou as we assumed they were gaining experience for performing live. To be honest, the food taste was average but the environment is good for family dining and company meetings/events.

Author: jasonhoics
Title: Happy customer
Review: Great place for authentic Japanese food. Good environment. Staff is helpful and good service. Well separated between diners to reduce spread of covid-19

Author: LovelynlaiKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good Vietnamese food
Review: This restaurant's chef is a Vietnamese. That's why they serve the most authentic Vietnam food in kuching. I love their special pho the most. It come with soft thin noodle, tender beef slices, beef tendon, beef stomach and beef ball soak in a tasty clear broth. Top with that is a separate Vietnamese basil leaf, lemon, tauge and lots of onion. When you mix all together, what can I say more, it's heavenly! I also like their special chili sambal which has a lemongrass smell. As for drink, I always order their special milk tea, only available in Sarawak. If you want to be slim like all the Vietnamese, this is the place to be. None of their food is oily, but all yummy...

Author: cooldoc1971Kuala Lumpur
Title: Twice I was turned away
Review: I went here twice :Once at 9 pm weekday , and was told it was closed, despite having customers still being served.Another at 8 pm weekday, was told they cannot accept any more customers as they short on supplies and they are pretty full.Very awkward indeed

Author: maymaymieMalacca
Title: Beware of Food Hygiene in Latest Recipe Restaurant
Review: I visited the Latest Recipe Restaurant for the Buffet dinner on 16th May 2010 with my fiance's family. It was our 1st time here as we wanted to try someplace new than our usual haunt at Lemon Garden Cafe Shangrila. Lets just say we were extremely dissapointed with the quality of food and variety at Latest Recipe. 3 out of the 5 of us vomitted and suffered diarrhoea after the dinner and the next 2 days after that. I suspect it might be due to the raw oysters which were not very fresh (definitely tasted different from the ones at shangrila) and also because the other 2 people who didn't touch the oysters were fine. The oysters looked dirty too, with specks of dirt on it. This is definitely the 1st and last time we'll be dining here.Also on another matter, the toilets on the same floor of Latest Recipe restaurant has downright disgusting. It was not well maintained and also had those ancient squatting type of toilets. Definitely not something I would expect to see at a Le Meridian Hotel. My advice: Skip this hotel and head straight to Lemon Garden Cafe, Shangrila KL for the best food in KL.

Author: mrsau2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst buffet dinner ever
Review: Our family celebrated birthday on last weekend thinking a 5 star hotel(Le Meridien) buffet dinner will be good after experiencing previous company ballroom dinner in Le Meridien. But we were totally disappointed. The food were mostly hawker's food and not good compare to any hawker's food. Dessert and pastry were also bad, fruit juices were so diluted that it tastes like plain water. No ice-cream but yogurt and ABC (terrible ABC). A small tray of tuna and small shrimp Sitting normal, crowd rowdy with service initially good but later plates were piling on our table with no one to collect (need to search for someone to collect). Tea/coffee/sugar sachet on table but no creamer. Need to order hot water and milk to make own drinks. We did not eat much (appetite) after browsing around. Long queue at the hotplate meat counter. Not worth queing for some small prawn.Even buffet lunch at 3 stars hotel is so much better.

Author: ktshuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great for breakfast
Review: Tried the other dimsum restaurant right across Foh San the last time but it was closed so we chose Foh San.Great variety of dimsum. Self service whereby you take the card and head to the counter to choose your food. Love the har kow, each packed w lots of prawns. Very fresh as well. They serve one of the best egg tarts.Prices were quite affordable as well. Service staff were friendly and polite.

Author: nataliea705Wellington, Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Just OK -
Review: Came here because of all the rave reviews we were seeing on Trip Advisor. Had walked past many times and seen it was pretty empty but thought why not give it a try...The service was average and a bit slow, waiter didn't note down our order and we figured he would get something wrong and he did, forgot our drinks and entree shrimp cocktail which came out half and hour after our other entree. We again had to wait quite a while for our steaks, which were quite tasty...but found them very hard to eat off a hot grill plate.Was also expensive, our most expensive meal to date in KL so far.

Author: eszumeenjCheras, Malaysia
Title: We will never come back!
Review: Came to Pampas last night(25 march) to celebrate my birthday and was attracted to come there due to the location in a refurbished colonial building but was utterly disappointed with the food and service. I ordered the tenderloin steak(one of the expensive ones on the menu) and my friends ordered the linguini, seabass, soup, salad, burger, etc. We were all disappointed with the food and the service. The waiter and waitress were rude and made faces and were NOT helpful/reluctant when we requested for their help to take our photos, and even to get anything for us when the restaurant was not even full! However if you can put up for bad service and mediocre food but want a good ambiance, then pampas is right for you. But we will never be coming back.

Author: Ann D
Title: Lovely Views, Terrible Afternoon Tea
Review: Undoubtedly stunning views of the twin towers from this location. But the "High on Sugar" afternoon tea was terrible and quite honestly the worst selection of bakes I have ever had, and that includes from simple cafes. Firstly its a buffet, so all the food with the exception of a number of local savoury items were already laid out. It looked amazing but this is a case of style over substance. All the sponge cakes were dry and dense, scones were dry and cold (although jam was lovely and freshly made). Chocolate tasted of poor quality. Macaroons were just crunchy/hard and very sugary, and did not have the classic chewy texture which you expect from them. The hazelnut choux bun was just soft and tasted completely wrong. Sandwiches were made from an impressive looking very long baguette, cut into thin slices, which made it hard to eat as a sandwich and fillings were average at best. I was told the cheesecake and chocolate ganache tasted alright by my husband but by then I had had enough.The best dish was the local savoury dish which was really good, but that was totally out of place during an afternoon tea and not exactly what I had come for. The only other plus was the jasmine tea I had was lovely and the sweets that they didn't make (of the pick and mix variety) were nice.I really don't recommend going here for afternoon, and was very upset to have wasted my 5 year anniversary going here.

Author: yikes247Perth, Australia
Title: Local Fare
Review: Variety of food. Eat like the locals, but stuffy within the food court. Best to sit under the electric fans. Buzzing with people. Good to go early. Closes at 1pm. The kuehs are average, but the limited baked bbq pork buns are the favourite, mouth watering that sells fast. Some of the other food like popiah are a must to try. Local authentic food. Good to give it a visit.

Author: World_Traveller_838Melbourne, Australia
Title: The main restaurant of Times Square Hotel
Review: My wife and I have stayed in Berjaya Times Square Hotel many times over the years and have always had our included buffet breakfast here. The quality of the food is mediocre. Quality of beverages also mediocre. Quality of service also mediocre. Gets very crowded by 8 am with people waiting in line for a table, so we usually eat at 6:30 am.

Author: ShiouSingaporeSingapore
Title: Enjoyable dining, reservation recommended
Review: We were there on a weekend for lunch with our friends who made reservations the day before. Some walk ins had to be turned away unless you arrived nicely when some people leave. The host's recommendation were good and the dining experience not rushed and enjoyable. We had Kuey pitee (they seem to run out so prior order may help), Otah, hee peow soup etc. My only disappointment was they do not have my favorite ngoh Xiang.

Author: realryanwatts
Title: The food is very terrible
Review: The food is very terrible , no taste , food is very cold , Do not recommended this restaurant 0/10 .

Author: kwtum
Title: Fresh delicious Japanese food with bargain price
Review: I have tried sushi king,sakae sushi, etc almost all the chain sushi stores. This is the best, freshest sushi plus ramen. Best of all not too expensive. Almost similar price to sushi king. But beware, the queue to get inside is quite long. Be prepared to wait!

Author: WeiHsiuHsiu
Title: Must come !
Review:
Nice foods and kindly services :p
Really enjoy and have a wonderful experience here 
Especially thanks for  Kuman 🎉

Author: MaisyBNewtown, Australia
Title: Authentic Mexican - great flavours
Review: I see myself as a bit of a Mexican aficionado and La Mexicana didn't disappoint.The flavours of the food were amazing, ingredients freash and margaritas good!The gardens and music added to the great ambience (my 5 year old loved the fact that we could dance, something that is rare at home)We will definitely return on our annual trips the KL

Author: MmeRobillard
Title: Not very good noodle
Review: We ate there for diner. We were very disappointed. The noodle did not taste good. The portion were so small. The sauce not good. We should of eat on the street where all the locals go. Next time..

Author: Adventurer815766
Title: Great hospitality
Review: Miss Azura Team Leader provides great service and very happy with the assistance and support. I gave my support for her 5 star rating.

Author: SempreOnTheGoMelbourne, Australia
Title: It needs to be improved big time!
Review: Quite disappointing really... From the careless staff more focused in doing silly dances and having fun than providing good service... And the food? Well... Nothing special at all! Very close to fast food level, presentation zero, excessively greasy and very boring. A tip to the management: promotions on booze work until certain extend... It is time to review the really boring, below standard menu and review all areas of it (desserts, no comment!). Good luck! Until then, NOT recommended, sorry.

Author: Leelaw000Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst recommendation from a friend
Review: When a friend recommends you a restaurant, you go without hesitation - because, well, your friend has dined there and liked it. So I went straight into The Junk (just behind my hotel) without checking the prices. To be honest, I don't think I even noticed if there was a menu stand outside the restaurant. Anyway, on my way in, the cheese cake counter caught my attention (as they always do), and I saw this: RM12.20 for a piece of cheese cake. Fine, maybe it's homemade cheese cake, not some mass produced stuff. Fine.When I sat down and checked out the menu, I was shocked at literally all the prices - from drinks to steak to pasta. You don't expect to pay RM35++ for pasta at a place like this - no scenic view, no elegantly dressed waiters, no romantic lights. I did actually debate as to whether I should head out of the restaurant, but you know, mild pride issues prevailed.So I ordered the cheapest food on the menu - fish and chips (RM20), and free water. Then the fish arrived and I realised soon after that I couldn't cut into the sides of the fish. I mean, the plate was gigantic, the chips were abundant - but the fish! The fish fillet's sides were so hard / stale / over-fried that I had to cut it with the strength utilised when cutting into a medium steak. I would not recommend it to ANYONE at all for two simple reasons:1) Food overpriced for its mediocre quality2) James Brooke Bistro & Cafe, a cosy, well-menued eatery with scenic view of the river, is less than 5 minutes walk away of The Junk

Author: 553melvink
Title: Nice place but food... Not that great
Review: Honestly the place is nice to chill.. But disappointed with the nasi Lemak spaghetti.. Too sweet and spicy not like a typical nasi lemak should be... Not salty at all... Avoid that... The rest is ok but not worth the price... They request guest to give a good review at trip advisor to get 20% discount.. Seems like buying likes for me...They have a cute dog though... Go there to chill but don't expect much on the food.

Author: ShivaniU14Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor Form ,Terrible Customer Service
Review: I've been to this Rum Bar called Jungle Bird several times now, but after last night's experience I truly understand why foreigners say Malaysia's level of customer service is poor at best.So this bar uses pineapple leaves as a decorative cocktail garnish. Very pretty and all but those leafs can be quite sharp & prickly from the thorns. I was with a friend yesterday and we were drinking one such cocktail when the leaf actually pricked /scratched his skin. I spoke to the bartender in front of me who saw this happen and said this isn't right, at least snip the thorns off for safety reasons. Pat came his response " we have been doing this for 3 years and you are the first to complain" I wondered if he was going to congratulate my friend next for being the first to have a painful and unpleasant experience.So I walked up to the big Brit who usually takes our orders (Cant recall his name right now) to express my concern.Previously I though he might be the bar manager if not owner because he seemed to have it together. His response was shocking, obnoxious and most ridiculous. He said and I quote '...I bet you wouldn't be complaining if I'd given you roses even if they were thorny" ??!!! Proceeds to say surely you cant expect us to get the thorns off before we use each leaf. I was QUITE dumbfounded and irked that he saw it fit to smirk with that callous a tone. Anyways after he had his moment of "genius" , I decided that talking to him was a waste of time, and since he completely killed our nightcap for us, we left.Not going back there again. If you are reading this and are the indeed the owner, my customer experience was horrible, and you've trained your staff to be flippant and rude. Well done you!But really, that two extra seconds you take in making sure anything that can potentially hurt a customer (one or ten hurt customers should be treated the same -we are all paying customers) won't cost you money and will make all the difference. But we are all human and make mistakes, so perhaps and apology and a rethink of how you could serve better would have been appreciated. Being so rude isn't ever , ever acceptable and wont ever work in your favour in the long run.

Author: ChillaxGalSingapore, Singapore
Title: Warm service, great decor
Review: We received very warm service from the aunties who chatted with us, reminded us to put parking coupon (we rented a car), and let us walk around to take pics. They have 2 nice courtyards if you like privacy but we sat in the main dining which was aircon. Pig trotters set is good value, we also liked the soft boil egg on toast. Again the aunties were v patient in explaining the menu items. It feels v homely! I would go there again. Price is reasonable and menu has a lot of items, plus the warm service, what’s there not to like?

Author: dianal963Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: A pleasent surprise...
Review: Sunday lunch at the Hadramawt restaurant turned out to be a pleasant surprise. Never been here before but after our Sunday lunch we’ll most certainly visit again.Had some of the traditional starters: hummus, feta cheese, babaganouch - all very good and very reasonably prices - as well as the arabic bread (the mullaeah bread was delicious, freshly baked and hot right out of the owen - where as the “arabic” bread could have done with a minute or two in the owen (was served cold)The main dish - Lamb mandy - was delicious too - very tender and tasty.Main dishes - geberally generous portions served. Good value for money. As we could not finish all our food the waiter kindly packed our left-overs in a container for us to take home

Author: CruzinAlongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chef extraordinaire Mano
Review: I loved his culinary creations when I visited Finnegan's and Bulldog over the years. At Finnegan's, his Irish Stew was great and he came up with an awesome Guinness-inspired for Arthur's Day at Bulldog. Even Chef-in-Black Emmanuel Stroobant was impressed by the taste and graphic design. Must catch him at Vin's. Cheers.

Author: Helmut J
Title: Best avoided
Review: I rarely write reviews, and normally reserve my opinion for places that deserve recognition. However, this is an exception.I wanted a light meal, and ended up ordering a Waldorf salad and glass of red wine. The salad was fine, if pricey, but the wine was terrible. I could live with both, and put it down to a bad experience, but the service was terrible. The staff seemed keen to close half an hour before the closing time, and the person who took my payment (Faudi) looked like he was only interested in going home. I could understand, but there were several other people still eating, and some had barely started their main course.I will not be going back.

Author: derrickawcwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Why settle for third grade when there are other options in this building?
Review: Did not use Japanese rice - unforgivable. I mean, for heavens sake, even the Japanese stalk in a food court uses Japanese rice! Chawanmushi is atrocious. Service (except the two managers) was appalling - I was brought to a seat without menus; served food without uttering a single word or a smile.

Author: Steve WNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Sunday dinner
Review: We were staying at the hotel opposite, Saturday night was full, so we went there on a Sunday night. We ordered beer and prawn curry, Pad Thai, Chicken stay and butter chicken. The waiter put the prawn curry on the table two minutes after we ordered, before we got our drinks, and it looks like a bowl of soup more than curry, we were worried but it turned out really tasty and there were quite a lot of prawns. The chicken satay was really good! butter chicken is not what we expected but also taste very good, our daughter loves it! Pad Thai was amazing! Very big portion and it's one of the best Pad Thai we have ever had, we didn't expect too much but turned out really good and enjoyable, price was reasonable, only RM 180 for the 3 of us. Will definitely go again! Atmosphere and service was good too.

Author: 889pantearVancouver, Canada
Title: Worse Japanese food ever
Review: I had a long day i wanted to end it happy by treating myself with a nice Japanese pleasure. But turned out to be the worst Japanese food i ever tasted.The sushi bar sushis are looking so old and unappetizing . I always take one plate of everything but by looking at them i had absolutely lost my appetite. Had ordered Chukalidako"seasoned baby octopus " it was not fresh at all and worse it was tasteless. I had looked at menu again n thought for last try as i was super hungry i shall try something simple i have ordered Sukiyaki Don. And with first spoon i know i shall leave and this is insult to Japanese cuisine.Service was fast but not welcoming at all.Im food lover n generally enjoy everything but this was so bad that i was not able to control myself for not putting up a review.Don't even try it ....

Author: claudiabsyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Dining Experience
Review: We heard about Sentul Park & decided to visit this place on a weekend hence went to Samira for lunch on a Saturday. I was looking forward to a nice authentic Thai meal but was a little disappointed with all that we ordered. We ordered one vege, pandan chicken, Tomyam seafood soup, sweet & sour fried fish, Thai green curry. Vege was decent, Tomyam was pretty good, but the other dishes were below expectation. Thai green curry was a big disappointment. Sweet & sour fish taste ok (the sauce) but fish was not very fresh. Service was acceptable. Prices are on the high side, the meal cost us about RM280 (fish was expensive). I noticed that there were only 3 tables (including us) throughout our lunch there. Kids enjoy their lunch as they were thrilled with the ambience (dining by the lake).We probably will come back to try other dishes but the only thing that i would re order is the Tomyam soup. Hopefully there will be more interesting dishes / new menu available in the future.

Author: jamesh9246
Title: Good food sometimes.
Review: My last three visits to this restaurant have been quite disappointing. One visit a month ago; restaurant was half full, I ordered a simple dish of stir fried chicken pieces with basil and chilli. It took forever to come. Around me other eaters were complaining of slow service too. Polite serving staff were looking helpless and very apologetic. Two weeks ago; I went at 12pm just as the almost empty restaurant started lunch service, ordered my favourite dish there, a house special, Thai Red Curry with duck. After a considerable wait an apologetic waiter returned to my table to say, sorry duck already finished. I left. One week ago; returned again at 12.00pm. Take a seat please, no I said first tell me do you have duck today? After some consultation amongst the staff, sorry no. Why, duck is a common and popular dish in Malaysia, other restaurants on the same floor in this building have it, but not you, why? Apologies and no straight answer form an embarrassed waiter. So good food, when they actually have it. Slow service. And I would say, polite staff and thoroughly incompetent management.

Author: E DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great decor. Contemporary and stylish! Great place to eat.
Review: A very welcoming restaurant. Well priced for stylish dining. We had the chicken Milanese Pasta, Octopus on skewers and chicken lasagna. All great and we really enjoyed it. We had a side of burnt cauliflower - delicious. We wanted to try the sizzling brownie but we were just too full........must visit again.The service is excellent and attentive.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: yoi14Singapore
Title: Oldtown white coffee at Puteri Harbor
Review: Me and my family were there for breakfast. The counter and eating area got many flies, terrible and disgusting.We had nasi lemak, dry pan mee and steam minced rice. The fried chicken that came with nasi lemak does not taste nice, the size also pathetic, the rice not much fragrant and sticky due to too much water. The pan mee is just another version of instant noodle, faint. I don't bother to try steam rice. We did not even want to complete the meal, disgusting food and environment.

Author: 628eugenekPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good selection but slow refills
Review: Had a mid-size group for lunch and a conference at the hotel. It was midweek with a fair number of patrons so some dishes were emptying quick but I notice the refills were slow. Otherwise, the selection is good and varied. Not as wide as some bigger hotels but quality was good overall. Staff were reasonably attentive given the crowd.
Restaurant: Link Restaurant , Lower Ground , Hotel Pullman Bangsar

Author: interpol4
Title: Lou Wong gone too arrogant!
Review: Was there with girl friend around 7.15pm on 29 January 2020. Restaurant was quite full. We managed to find an empty table behind the stall though there was spilled drink on the floor, very dirty. We didn't mind. I asked a plump waiter whether I could sit there. He said yes. Then, I repeatedly trying to order food but nobody entertained us. An uncle saw me but told us that we were not supposed to sit there. We moved to an table next to us when it was empty. We repeatedly asked waiters and waitress to take our order but failed. Then, one skinny matured waiter with glasses came and shouted at us to find another table as there were only 2 of us. His manner was rude and unexpected for a restaurant known to host many tourist. Though he might be uneducated, I am sure he knew basic manner on how to treat customer. Few customers are not important? Where is the sign reminding customer where to sit? Is this the manner adopted by the boss too? Not only has this shop gone too arrogant, it shows negative image on IPOH and Malaysia.

Author: Middle_East_ExplorerSan Francisco, California
Title: Korean cuisine totally lacking in flavor
Review: I went there with two friends on the basis of the many positive reviews. Frankly, we couldn't understand the positive reviews after our experience. We ordered several dishes -- yuk gae jang (the spicy beef soup with green onion and egg), the Korean seafood pancake, and two types of beef for BBQ. With the exception of the beef, every other item, including the array of cold side dishes that usually accompanies the meal, was completely lacking in flavor. None of the dishes contained enough garlic -- in fact, the usual raw garlic accompaniment for the BBQ beef was not offered. The service was friendly, and the restaurant was attractive with big tables widely spaced, but Kuala Lumpur residents and tourists would be better off sampling the much better restaurants in the Solaris neighborhood, rather than being disappointed with this place.

Author: khaidir77
Title: The Worst Banana Leaf Restaurant ever
Review: slow services..waiters can't understand simple english or malay..food tasteless..promises myself i would never go there again...

Author: kykykykyk
Title: Lots of Flies and mosquitoes! Bad service, average food and completely overrated!
Review: I've been there around 5 times since I moved to The Troika. Everytime I was there I got bitten by mosquitoes, I'm never the type that attract mosquitoes but Acme nurtures really fierce insects! I'm sure you have seen flies and mosquitoes flying around your food and drinks or YOU if you've been to this "high class" cafe! I went there for a coffee bcoz the lifts in my condo was out of service and I needed a place to rest and wait. After I had left and got home, as always, I found that I got bitten again but this time was very serious! My husband saw my legs and said that I was bitten by bugs or insects and I should never go back to Acme again! In addition to this, the reception ladies are very cocky and rude. Everytime they see a customer coming in you can tell from their faces that they're very annoyed. And the food isn't enough good!!!
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: KiatYeenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unique and Different Dining Experience
Review: Bought my husband a birthday dinner at Dining in the Dark and it was an amazing experience.It was totally dark and can't even see your own fingers at all. We have to touch our plate to find the food as well as to find out whether we have finished our food. The food were really awesome and we have to test our taste bud as well see whether we know what we are eating. I would say I was having an experience of how a blind person eat.The service was excellent as well. I will definately go back again with other friends. One setback is when there is a large group in the dining hall and probably they are fear of dark, they tend to speak out loud until I can't hear what the waiter is telling me. And they will speak out loud the answer of the food which is not fun for other guests anymore.

Author: peterarthurh
Title: Awesomeeeeee
Review: Everything great. Good steak. Good wine. Good ambience. Its really recommended steakhouse in Kuala Lumpur. Lots of Bar you can pick after that in that street.

Author: sarahwenbornBrisbane, Australia
Title: Apparently the customer is not always right
Review: Good food, however my husband sent back some fahitas that had a hair on top of the toppings/ sour cream. We are not the kind of people who send back food, in fact I don't think I've ever seen my husband do it. The waiter took the dish, then shortly returned with the same one and tried to explain it was a fibre from the leaf the sour cream was on. I stated "ummm it's black!" (The leaf was light green) when the waiter picked up the leaf from the plate with his fingers and took it back to the kitchen before returning with a new plate. No apology, no nothing. Not sure if they've heard of it here, but there's a saying in Australia "the customer is always right". We cannot believe they tried to tell us we were mistaken. Unfortunately, this is only one of many poor customer service experiences we've had in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: itsmypointKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: delicious food
Review: Food was excellent ! Aglio olio was nicely done with fresh seafood. The only disappointing was we come at 9.40pm and ask for nice table and even point it out on empty table but the waitress told us it reserved. While your last order is 10.30 pm and we was there to witness that no body occupied it until we left. May be she hesitate as we have baby sleeping in stroller. Our table did not set with candle and centerpiece like the table beside and was really beside door.Make us felt that they choose guest base on appearance. We can see many empty table to choose for but then left in dark room beside door.

Author: TaylorKlasMelbourne, Australia
Title: Idyllic Peaceful dinner
Review: On the main road but you would never know as it feels like you’re on your own special beach. Beautiful restaurant, excellent service. we are vegetarian, and there were plenty of options mainly for entrees, Had the fresh tomato and red pepper soup which was delicious, the avocado and mango salad had too much creamy salty mayo dressing for our tastes, but otherwise good. The main was braised vegetables, with condiments and was also very good, huge portion and well presented.This restaurant is well worth it!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: LeLeviathanParis, France
Title: Let's go somewhere else!
Review: One little advise, there are so many other bar in this street, let's give your money to nicer people!!They will con you with the bill and you will have to argue with the manager who is as rude as they get! "That's the way" she said! Alright then... you've been warned!

Author: lhspenang
Title: Nice environment but lousy food.
Review: Inexperience staff but friendly, food cold, badly organised, bloody meat but staff insist is medium. over priced.

Author: SanjayRaphaelKajang, Malaysia
Title: Not Great
Review: Was there for a wedding reception of a friend. Food was nothing to shout about. Honestly Mamak food the next block taste better. Customer service is a big NO here! The waiters were young boys whom were busy playing with their mobile and not bothered to even get us water. Overall, Location, Parking and Hall Ambiance was a 5 star. Food and Service is a NO star.

Author: aleeshiab2017
Title: Best vegetarian food and amazing Punjabi sweets  in JB town!!
Review: The atmosphere here is buzzing with high spirits... food is so delicious and the sweets are to die for!! Oh my god so yummy.... do come and have a taste and you will not regret it...
Restaurant: JH Lovely Sweets Indian Vegetarian Food

Author: Malyk777
Title: So expensive but tasty 4/10
Review:
Not need that much expensive 
Food are very expensive about one portion briyani around RM30 plus drink about RM15.99 RM 9,99
Or 8.99, I don’t think so so special about the drinks . Plus service tax and service charges 10%. Not worthy to spend

Author: RizanA_13
Title: Not fresh item
Review: All the seafood not really fresh. The fish a bit bad smelly. But love the gravy of steam thai. Butter prawn a bit sweet. The vege only better cook & fresh.
Restaurant: Restoran Hj Sharin Low (Seksyen 7 Shah Alam)

Author: Wayne D
Title: Service is absolutely terrible
Review: Brought my frens from kl on a friday night just to chill and have a few Pints. The staffs are foreigners for all i know, they speak very rude towards us, almost start a fight. What terrible service they have. Beers are watered down, cant even get a good taste of the malt, definitely wouldnt recommend anyone here

Author: Jern92Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Slow
Review: Slow service. Took a while for them to take orders, and orders take forever to come. Ordered a bowl of wedges but somehow that took longer to come than all the others that had chicken PLUS sides, some of which were wedges. Also, they were out of Veggie Burgers, which is pretty bad news especially as they had so few items available for vegetarians to begin with. Food was rather meh overall.

Author: Veron CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible car jockey service
Review: My friend and I were in Impiana Hotel recently for dinner. Due to an on-going event, the car park was full and we had to leave our car with the jockey. After dinner, I queued for twenty minutes before I got my car. During the first 15 minutes, I queued patiently until the jockeys allowed one customer who came later than me to receive their car first. I wasn't happy with this unfair treatment and highlighted to them than I was in queue earlier than the guy. Their excuse was my car was being blocked by two cars.Then, a lady who queued later that that guy, received her car. This time I kicked up a fuss and requested them to give me a discount. However, they refused. I was very unhappy with Impiana Hotel's jockey service. The queue should work on a first-in-first-out basis and not based on the convenience of getting customers out of the car park.Honestly, I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anybody who drives or plans to hold their weddings/parties in this hotel.

Author: 478sallyb
Title: Horrible!  Don’t go here!
Review: We went to the chain at My Town mall. Always a line here. Don’t know why. Horrible service. Unbelievably slow. Food not worth it. TERRIBLE. TERRIBLE.

Author: Jason O
Title: Super duper small portion
Review: The food serve is darm small portion...don't qualify to call it main course... service also react very slow...totally not worth for the price!!

Author: ShellsO
Title: Tasty
Review: Great location. Food was very good but perhaps not quite as good as some other restaurants we visited. The standard in Langkawi was quite high. So all up, an enjoyable experience. Service was great. Food good.

Author: MeenaAliMalaysia
Title: Wonderful Dinner, AGAIN!
Review: This was our second time coming here and there’s a lot of changes that have been made in terms of the food varieties and taste. Met Chef Matt and Mr. Adham, the heads of the restaurant and they mentioned that they’ve been changing the menu from time to time to keep the excitement going on and that’s good for repeating customers like us to enjoy the different types of dishes on every visit. Service by the team was amazing as usual. Can’t wait to try out their festive dinner next month!
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: imshirleythong
Title: Not impressed with the food
Review: Ordered chicken with fermented Soy which is Chef recommended and cincalok egg omelette. Both were too salty. Prive also on the high side. Chendol also not very good.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Kiarash-R
Title: Magnificent Breakfast Buffet
Review: Since entering, you'll face smiling and helpful staff which are ready to assist you to enjoy your breakfast. There are different compartments. From freshly cooked egg dishes, to fresh juices. This is one of the places which kept its quality during last 3 years.

Author: Matt D
Title: Run of the mill chain Japanese
Review: I can´t say that Umai Ya was terrible, it just wasn´t very good. Nothing tasted particular notable, the flavours were pretty much indistinguishable. The ramen dish I had really was pretty poor, with a broth that tasted like they had just made it with a stock cube. In such a fancy shopping centre next to the Petronas Twin Towers I am sure you can do much better than this - even on a modest budget.

Author: CharissaAreingtonSingapore
Title: Breakfast
Review: Being a fully raw foodie, I must say I do enjoy coming here for brunch. We have been here a few times and we've not been disappointed.As I enjoy raw living food it is great to take friends and family to Ashleys, who are not necessarily raw as they can select their selection of breakfast from poached eggs,scrambled with smoked salmon etc. my husband absolutely loves the morning breakfast there where he tends to have his smoked salmon, poached eggs, sprouted baked beans (and I MUST say it might sound strange but boy it tastes 100 times better than that nasty canned stuff) and a light toasted bread. Plus it is also not drenched in oil when you order a fried egg or scrambled eggs, it tastes clean on the pallet.There is also healthy granola to choose from, although it's not fully raw as it contains oats, it's very tasty.I tend to have the raw food dishes they have on the menu and all of them are superb, although I would have liked to have seen more Raw living options on the menu to select from. But other than that I can go there anytime! Perhaps a rawfood pizza! All the juices and smoothies are also made from scratch and there is also no preservatives or sugars added, this is the way fresh juices And smoothies should be served! You can also have your selection of milks, for example almond milk, soy milk or just the normal cow's milkAll the sauces on the raw food dishes are also living raw sauces, made only from soaked nuts then blended to create a "raw living cheese sauce", there is also a natural raw salsa! They also serve this water that has health properties and has a perfect ph balance that enhances the bodies natural healing properties and promotes good health.The only down side to my times visited there is the fact that some of the waiters don't seem to mention these things to you.The water was just put down on our table, so upon receiving it I saw the sticker on the bottle and then googled it, then only I learnt what the water is about.I also found when my husband ordered his version of an English breakfast I asked instead of giving my husband cheese could he rather have the raw nut cheese, the waiter seemed a bit confused and in then end when my husband got his dish there was no raw living cheese, only the normal Parmesan cheese. So that was a bit disappointing as I feel this is a unique selling point of having some raw food options on the menu and also educating and making the customers excited about the experience in eating the healthy food at Ashely's, as I think this is what the whole concept is behind Ashley's living food.

Author: rtw99Shanghai Region, China
Title: Average
Review: Ambience is good- a busy and fun place. The food - average. We all had the steak - nothing special. Service was ok but a little confused.

Author: julian l
Title: Okay-lah
Review: Dinner on the first floor of Noble House was an average experience. A vast room with little ambience and atmosphere. Lacklustre service. Passable food. Nothing special. Also, shark’s fin is highlighted on the menu which is not a good thing.

Author: Simon B
Title: Don't upset the staff
Review: This evening we went to the TGI Fridays across from our Hotel in KL - the Shangri-La - well I don't know what I did to upset the staff but they set out to make our evening a nightmare - and succeeded!

Author: rt4laiSingapore
Title: Magnifique dinner
Review: Was there to celebrate the birthdays of our family members. The food and experience was wonderful. Love the foccacia served as starter. Had the mussels and prawns as tapas and they were lovely. The prawns were fresh and crunchy and the mussels were plump and flavourful. For the mains, we had the confit duck, salmon, Cote de beuff, lamb loin, seafood buccatini, seafood risotto, French pizza. The salmon was a little dry but everything else was perfect. I particularly love the buccatini. It is a type of pasta similar to spaghetti except it is hollow inside. I love the chewy texture and it goes so well with the seafood. The risotto was very good as well. Between the two it was hard to decide which was my favourite. If you love cheese and cream, the risotto probably suits you better. I have to give special mention to the french pizza. Unlike the Italian version, which has a thin crust, these have a more bread or doughy feel to it. We have the truffle pizza and it was fabulous. The service was impeccable as well. Credit has to be given to Faruk, Nora and Norman who not only had to serve us and our many questions, they had to provide that evening's entertainment as well. Kudos to the management for such well trained staff.I will be back....

Author: Sukan28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One two questions to the owner and the chef of this restaurant
Review: - Would you eat this dish that you cooked? And- Would you play RM69 (15euro) for it?I ordered their special of the century "Santo Tamales"It took 20mins to arrive and it looked like the left over from the previous week and reheated for the weekend.Please do not be put off by what we experienced. Your experience might be different than ours. We would never return....

Author: Chris M
Title: Terrible food and beverage
Review: I was visited this cafe last night , I ordered a coconut juice but found the coconut juice is spoilt. I had feedback to the staff, they exchange another coconut to me. unfortunately, I was diarrhea for whole midnight, guess the coconuts all in the fridge are not fresh.Banned this restaurant!!! Although their atmosphere feel good, but the FOOD TASTE NO GOOD and NOT FRESH

Author: breepayne
Title: Yummy laksa and great rendang!
Review: A great menu with plenty of options, clean restaurant and lovely service! We had the laksa, rendang and fried banana spring rolls! Would recommend ☺️

Author: vorm2019Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice dining experience
Review: Just Wanna say it was a good dining experience in here. Overall everything is okay. Not too great not too..

Author: TressyLimPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not too bad
Review: My friend was looking for a nice big breakfast in town and so we decided to give S.Wine a try. I was wondering our order English Fry Up don't serve serve with ham but it do mentioned in the menu. Such a sad case because we looking for nice bacon and ham. Mexicana Pulled Pork is a great dish but the baked bean is just too much. I would suggest to put some tomato inside so can filled up the bowl. Haha. If you looking for nice coffee, then S.Wine definitely is not your taste. But they serve good pork. In overall the pork sausage and the Pulled Pork is nice !

Author: MimiTHengKlang
Title: PITIFULLY POOR service in addition to BAD FOOD
Review: Went there today for lunch with colleagues to the Bangsar South outlet. I ordered Curry Laksa but the taste was bad and I was given a half-cooked chicken drumstick! When I alerted the workers about it, THREE of them came over to look at the chicken and one of them finally said "I will inform the kitchen".. And then guess what, not a single apology, no replacement and worst of all I still had to pay for the 10% service charge although I would rate the service as PITIFULLY POOR in addition to BAD FOOD. I had an utterly bad experience dining in your premise... booohh...

Author: rogerstephensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Take your sense of humour with you, you will need it.
Review: Arrived on a Monday, about 1.30 lunchtime. Only two other people in the restaurant, just drinking I think. The waiter just waved me in so I chose a table and sat down. He came over, gave me a closed winelist and hovered. I was celebrating with a friend (who was arriving half an hour later) so I ordered a bottle of Veuve Clicquot with two glasses. The waiter was insistent I ordered food but I also insisted I waited for my friend. He arrived, we ordered Caesar Salad and soup for him, Crab Cake for me. Waiter returned. No Caesar salad (honestly, it's a basic requirement surely). He ordered a garden salad I think which turned out to be a soup bowl stuffed with lettuce leaves. My crab cake was luke warm and smelled very fishy but OK. It was all going fairly well (the restaurant was now empty at 2pm save us two) despite asking for a bigger bowl to put the salad plus dressing in, eventually got a massive dish. At 2.45 the waiter was hovering to take the unfinished food away and kept on topping up the glasses. Eventually he came to take the food at 2.55pm and said "You have to leave now, we are closing" As a less than subtle hint, they started to shut the lights off and closed the main door. we were still halfway through out meal and champagne. We gave up and left to find somewhere else at 3.10pm It was like Fawlty Towers - we just ended up laughing, the place is so ridiculous, empty, dreadful food and service like I have never ever experienced. You had to see the funny side otherwise you would just get very cross. This place is part of the BIG group and shame on them for running a disaster like this. Close it down.

Author: zailymddin
Title: this place is full of peace
Review: Its 100% pure taste from India kitchen . Place is good to bring family or friend . Portion also is good enough .

Author: Road33323781978
Title: Wonderful visit as always
Review: When ever we visit KL we always make sure we visit Gravybaby. Prity our waitress was amazing and very attentive. The food choices are plentiful and the food was very good. Thank you Prity

Author: NicoleSheHuik
Title: Pricey and not worth
Review: Pricey because the foods not as tasty as shown in website or promoted by blogger. The drink also very simple but costy

Author: dimitryo_12Rotterdam
Title: To the person in the kitchen: shame on you!
Review: I tried a summer salad and a steak. The salad was just romaine salad leaves with some dressing and a bit of seafood in it. The steak was 1/3 of fat and some half-ready vegtables thrown on a plate and some fried potatoes. Clearly that whoever works in the kitches couldn’t care less about cooking something decent. Quite a disgrace and would advise you to skip this one!

Author: AnnaTeh6
Title: Fav Mexican's in town
Review: My go-to whenever I need to either fix my taco Tuesday or Friday night out, people-watching. :) Closest-real Mexican's I can get. Also, Thanks to Iqbal for looking after us at our most recent visit. That night was on point, food was quick.

Author: 598jessicaoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing meal swimming in oil
Review: We ate the chicken brioche burger and the beef croissant burger. The taste of the meat was quite nice, and if you are looking for a high calorie oily meal it fits the bill. However, we were quite disappointed by the meal - the chips were dripping in oil, the cheese was orange and gloopy, and it was all over priced.We regret not trying the salads on the menu but won't be going back.

Author: MichelleH4369
Title: Website Update
Review: I enjoy this restaurant for its beautiful thoughtful restoration of an older building . This is a definite must do if you are in the area and you will appreciate the cool and calm together with the good food they serve. Gorgeous refreshing brewed drinks and hot teas that pick you up and get you ready for the next KL adventure . DONT try to use google maps to navigate though it’s gets all confused in this area but take a note of the address and self guide it’s easy and well worth it It was disappointing to plan a trip yesterday for lunch and then find it was locked right ......shut ! nothing we found on the website indicated this and there is nothing on the entrance to show this is a normal occurrence . It is normal for business’s to have a closed day but it does need to be clearly communicated. I’m going back today though it’s too good to miss

Author: SportheadSydney, Australia
Title: Average restaurant
Review: a bit disappointed that even after specifying for the children's meals to come out first it didn't. As a matter of fact we all got our mains at different times which was a bit odd. I'm not sure if there's cultural differences and I don't want to impose mine on others but if I am dining with another adult (my wife in this instance) I'm used to dining at the same time. When my dish arrives ten minutes before hers, I either have to wait (and the food goes cold), or start without her (which is rude).Maybe the restaurant can address that for future.

Author: Avril K
Title: Nice
Review: Nice dinner on the beach last night. The beef rendang was the best one I had during my trip to Malaysia. Just had ice cream for dessert and it was half melted by the time it arrived.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: JepThrillSingapore, Singapore
Title: Celebrate daughter’s birthday.
Review: Like any S’poreans, once heard of a new eatery, surely we want to try it (out of curiosity), be it locally or in M’sia. Well, last Sat. my family went there to celebrate one of my daughter’s birthday. The deco was simple and the staffs were friendly. Unfortunately, some dishes that we wanted to order were not available. Anyway, we ordered the Alaskan crab and some other dishes. We were disappointed because all the seafood were frozen! The meat tasted chewy and rubbery. We didn’t really enjoy and it was a disappointment. I rate 4 out of 10! The only one that we like most is the SAMBAL if the Nasi Lemak! It tasted really good!

Author: stylesetter17
Title: Very friendly restaurant with good food
Review:
Bit of a hidden gem. Cosy and comfortable setting, friendly and inviting staff. 

Mid-priced, varied menu. Excellent pizzas made fresh with a wood-burning oven. Very accommodating, they stay open as long as you are there.  

Always a pleasant dining experience, definitely worth a visit.

Author: AzliaDeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It's all about chicken
Review: The restaurant was full of crowd during lunch especially on weekend. Do not expect fast food in this restaurant as they serve fresh food for the diners. You need to give them at least 15 - 20 minutes to serve your food. If you love spicy food, you may order spicy series as the hot level is 5/5. Friendly treatment by the waiters / waitress. However the table is quite small if you order more than 4 dishes.

Author: bertrand c
Title: Good place to enjoy pork ribs
Review: Typical American restaurant where you can order portions way to big for one person. Recommend the jack daniels pork ribs there to be enjoy with a beer and onion rings

Author: ChubbythePandaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dishonest Staffs + Terrible Service
Review: Request for a plain water but been told that no plain water to be served. But yet the plain water were served to other tables. Clarify with the waitress (who can't tell me her name) and she claimed that the water is not safe to drink, smell fishy, dirty..... (My concern is how can you serve it to other customers?) Request to meet up with the manager, and been told that the manager is in a meeting.. After 15minutes, a lady show up (Did not introduce herself) apologies to us for the water issue.... She offer to waived off the still water charges & a dessert.....However the 2 items were charged in the final bill....... (P/S: I felt been cheated)Such a lousy and terrible service. Even the food is nice.. I will never never come back again.The management should look into this issue seriously and make sure your staff did not simply committed to your guest.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: Sheena BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for Those Romantic Dinners
Review: Love the ambiance and the slow pace of the world around us when we were there. The service, however, was thoroughly prompt and the smiles were generous. It's one of those eats where you don't have plans afterwards. Just take your time and enjoy the experience. Ps: Food was great especially their burgers.

Author: CityFolks777Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Great sea view but an average place to dine.
Review: Seem to be serving a wide selection of food on the menu. But overall food is just average. Portioning is generous and cooking ability is just average. We happened to have the fried noodles with fresh big prawns, it was just average. Pricing wise on the items on the menu is reasonable considering the quality of food and standard of cooking. Be prepare to wait for your meal to be served.

Author: Clare_AliciaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Doesn’t do Penang food justice
Review: Don’t recommend, char kueh tiao and Assam laksa taste awful. We order both and plus a side dish. Half way we decided to cancel the side dish coz we didnt think it is worth to try it. If wanna eat char kueh tiao or Assam laksa, try the food court a level 4, at least they are cheaper and taste ok.

Author: JPSWashington_DCWashington, DC
Title: Stuffy service and average food
Review: The Kebaya is located in a beautifully renovated historic heritage house. While the interior is lovely, the service in the restaurant is somewhat stuffy and I think the appeal of the restaurant is that it is a fixed price menu, that some tourists appreciate more for its price and quantity of food, than for its quality. The starters and entrees were average (we had the much touted lamb and prawn curry), but the desserts were very good. All in all, the restaurant for dinner is overrated.

Author: Kebuh
Title: Nice Indian Cuisine
Review: Located to the right of the Hilton Doubletree as you exit the hotel, the restaurant is spacious and clean. I had a Rawa Tosai which was good. Found the prices quite reasonable as well.

Author: 185matthewrMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simply brilliant
Review: An unassuming location on the second floor of a small shopping however you are welcomed enthusiastically by Andrew and then treated to arguably the best Malaysian cuisine in the local area. The house specials all have a little asterisk on the menu, stick with these and you can't go wrong. The table next to us had people who were eating there for the 5th night in a row because they felt they would just be disappointed if they went elsewhere.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Popular kopitiam
Review: A popular breakfast and lunch venue for the working crowds in the area. There are a number of stall here selling a wide selection of hawker style food like fried kway teow and noodle soup. Service is fast but seating can be a problem during peak hours.

Author: mings86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Another Hype
Review: Went to this cafe over the weekend with a few girlfriends and queued for almost 40 minutes to get in. When the crowd is huge i expected the food to be good if not marvelous. However, i was rather disappointed .Firstly the helping is pretty small for the price that we pay. Secondly, and most importantly, food doesn't taste good at all. I must say they're pretty bland despite looking very fancy on the menu. Thirdly, the food items that we ordered seems to be DRY. Yes, dry. We had a seafood spaghetti that seems to be dehydrated and went through a drought or something. I can't complain much about fish and chips.What disappointed me the most was desert. We had a slice of their best seller, almond chocolate cake with salted caramel and it crumbled the minute we dig in. The cake lacks moisture and the cream in between the layers toughen so it felt like we were having a cookie instead. Despite being unsatisfied with food, the interior of the cafe is a work of art. If you're into soaking up the aura of a cool restaurant and taking tons of selfies instead of concentrating on food, this is a photo worthy place to go to.

Author: olekurGran Canaria, Spain
Title: Great fusion of Japanese and Spanish cuisine
Review: The place is great for hangout with friends or dinner for couples. Interior is great for evening atmosphere and it feels cosy inside. Service is good and attentive. The food is great combination of spanish and japanese tapas. So far it is our favorite place in KL for patatas bravas, it is not served traditionally but it is great and it has the best patatas bravas sauce in KL. I wish Pinchos (a sister restaurant) would have that sauce too :) Our favorites is Iberico pork belly and Chorizo. All in all I would surely recommend to visit.

Author: Lina EKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasteless fries!
Review: This review is for Mikey's NY pizza in mid valley mega mall.We ordered the pizza burger and the empire burger with fries. The pizza burger was good but the empire one was disappointing. The fries were clearly reheated and didn't taste good. Ambience is nice and service is fast. Prices are reasonable.

Author: Casey SWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: BE ADVISED - Our credit card info was stolen at this restaurant!
Review: BEWARE: My husband visited this restaurant with his co-workers earlier this week, and our credit card information was stolen there. We are CERTAIN is was stolen there because this was the only place he used the card the entire time he was in Kuala Lumpur, and it was the first time he'd used the card in nearly two months. Within 48 hours, there were four fraudulent charges on our card...one was for nearly $10,000!! Be advised, you would be wise to pay in cash if you insist on eating there.

Author: ECKLKualaLumpurKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less is More Part 248 - Utterly Underwhelming & Unprofessional
Review: Now where do I start? OH YES! Never believe what [so-called] professional food reviewers write. Just so happen that I came across a recent review in a local [highly reputable] lifestyle magazine [name begins with "O"] and is a regular insert in a business paper [starting with "E"]. Should have double checked TA but just went ahead to make a reservation for a birthday dinner.If first impressions are anything to go by, it failed quite miserably. Along a row of restaurants all bright and smartly decked out to attract diners, S&L is comparatively tired and sloppy. There is no ID. One of the servers was unprofessionally dressed in t-shirt, shorts and rubber flip-flops. The menu is old and dog-earred. Nonetheless given the 'rave' reviews, we went ahead to order several of the premium sets including the Burger of Kings (RM188), GF Ribeye & Half Lobster (RM145), Signature Grilled Chipotle Steak (RM68) and 300gm GF Ribeye (RM59). We also ordered the Caesar salad and Potato Skins. Our order was taken by the most dour personality.The Burger of Kings is definitely NOT good enough for any royalty. Sadly the foie gras and beef patty in it were dry. The liver was actually rock hard! While they highlighted that their lobsters were flown fresh every week, ours was fishy-smeliing and most likely defrosted. The chipotle steak arrived bloody [request for medium rare] and had to be re-cooked. The salad sides were limp and tired, the sauces thick and cloying and the fries tasted stale and old.
