Would have overlooked these details if not for the prices charged. There are probably countless other steak houses in this medium-high price range within a 5km radii thats better, more satisfying and customer-focused. Spend your money elsewhere.

Author: Shikin_GiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: 1) the staff was nice and helpful. 2) there were 7 of us that night and the place was comfortable to dine in, just the environment gets quite hot and sweaty once more people came in to dine inside the restaurant. It became quite uncomfortable when the air cond doesnt seem to function. 3) minimal food variety. However all the food was delicious and freshly prepared. Very nice arabic food. we just felt that the price was overrated and not worth it, luckily the food was good. 4) no need to worry about parking as there were plenty of it.

Author: Angeline CAustralia
Title: Disappointing Hainanese food
Review: Good ambience reflecting traditional Hainanese settings. However, the dishes we ordered were disappointing. Inche Kabin chicken was over fried & tough, kerabu mango too sour, sweet & sour fish had more onions & capsicums than fish, stir fried vegetables were average. Prices were above average.Table service was inattentive - only 4 of us were served water whilst 2 others had to repeated request before they were served to wards the end of the meal.

Author: copycalebKlang, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated
Review: I don't understand why people queue for this. I have had way better chicken rice balls outside of Melaka. You can try heading to the Klang Valley and you'll be surprised how bad this one is compared to the ones found over there. I used to frequent Chung Wah and thought it was the best in Melaka but even that has dropped in standards, and is currently closed without notice. Hoe Kee's chicken was bland, the rice was very normal. You can get authentic Hainanese chicken rice (not in ball form though) that is so fragrant and flavorful you can eat it plates of it without the chicken. Try Kedai Nasi Dan Ayam along Petaling Street and then you will know what real Hainan chicken rice tastes like. This will be my last visit to Hoe Kee.

Author: Sue Ik L
Title: Noodle Char-sao
Review: Not worth it...tasteless for the soup..while the noodle just like normal.. think Maggie noodle better than this. Anyway,I won't come again.. very bad

Author: h_liae2018Leamington Spa, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing
Review: La Sal is a fabulous restaurant on the beach, which serves fresh, fabulous food and drink on a daily basis. It is romantic and peaceful, and service is great. We stayed at CDM which included 4 meals at La Sal, and we expected some sort of buffet. However it comprised of a 3 meal a la carte menu, and tea and coffee. What more can you wish for? Highly recommended.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 0Jools0Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Little gem!
Review: Well worth heading out of the main resorts to find this lovely place in a pretty, peaceful garden setting.Steve & Coco are great hosts, the staff are friendly and welcoming, the service excellent and the food so tasty.We dined here 3 times and all the meals were impressive, we cleared our plates every time. The steak was cooked to perfection, bangers and mash yummy and best of all the delicious Irish stew, all washed down with ice cold beers. Sadly we missed the Sunday roast which we hear is very popular but we will definitely be back.Thanks Steve & Coco, glad we found you.

Author: pjayacobJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Sutera mall branch - Food just average
Review: We ordered two sets which is seafood ramen and fried rice. The food is just average and don't have many choices. The staff was good and great service. However, there is no smoke suction and it make my clothes with smoke smell for the entire day.

Author: CraftBeerDeanDoncaster, United Kingdom
Title: be wary of the 10% service charge in the small print. I really hate these sneaky stealth charges
Review: Nice looking place with friendly service. I ordered chicken noodles for Rm 8.90. The food took some time to arrive but it was pretty good. No wifi though. When I asked for the bill it was 10% higher, then I noticed at the bottom of the menu in small print 10% service charge. I really hate these sneaky stealth charges. I liked this place but I won't come back

Author: michelemorgant
Title: Great fun!
Review: Very special place.   Good and fashion.  I will certainly come back! I like the place and the food. There is a beautiful garden for our pets

Author: lewiskoh
Title: Celebrating my girlfriend's birthday
Review: A really wonderful place to dine in. I went to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday and I was warmly greeted by the servers, a special shoutout to Sujan for being so attentive to our needs. The food were delicious and they even prepared a homemade cake specially for the celebration. Overall it was a wonderful experience for me and my girlfriend. We will definitely return to this place again soon.

Author: NaaveMalaysia
Title: Weird and Eye Opening Experience
Review: An OK place to hang out. Drinks are good but quite pricey. The furnitures are old and worn out. Staffs are not really friendly and have some attitude while taking orders. Just want to highlight a bizarre experience that took place here. The waiters asked if we could rate them on Tripadvisor and we agreed. They literally stood beside us to see if we are actually reviewing them. The waiter even took my friend's phone to review when he said he didn't know what to write in the review. After he wrote the review and posted, we read "our" reviews that was wrote by the waiters. It was very funny and over exaggerated. The waiter literally wrote "this is the best shisha in my life. my waiter Shawn is a genius and etc etc". It seems like a very desperate act. I wouldn't blame the waiters because I'm guessing the management are the ones that ask them to do that. It is such a pathetic thing to do. Customers should be willingly to review if they are satisfied and happy with your place or service. Don't force them to give a review. Worst even, reviews and ratings wrote by the waiters (that explains my one star rating). If you're visiting this place, don't trust the reviews or the ratings. Review the place by yourself only. Don’t allow the waiters to do it on your behalf.

Author: yekoms eTokyo, Japan
Title: Very expensive
Review: Am surprised after reading the comments here. Other discussion boards have said things like this restaurant is very expensive, just so-so quality for KL standards, constantly sold out of dishes, and wait staff is arrogant. I have to agree in disappointment from my visit last month. But I'm sure this place was at one time great. Amazing pics, though!

Author: AcidHurts
Title: Different Branch... Different Quality Standard...
Review: Viva Cheras Branch... Staff Quality Bad... Sing Song Loudly...

Author: elsaooi
Title: Jingga Anggun Sdn Bhd
Review: 5⭐️ star lily , very good service and environment ,having successfully dinner ,love it . At Hilton hotel

Author: Andrew MLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Too salty.....
Review: This is a beautiful old traditional colonial building set back from the river front in lovely gardens. You can sit on the verandah while the kids play on the grass area in front. The menu is good, with a wide range of local foods, especially the famous curry laksa (of which several versions are offered). We had four different dishes and they were ALL way too salty, which was a shame, as otherwise the presentation and freshness was very good. It's a little pricey by Kuching standards (not much) and note that you can only pay by cash.

Author: dariusdaniel
Title: Delicious
Review: They have the wet and dry type of bah kut teh. The food was good. The whole family enjoyed it. Parking was ok.

Author: Bryan C
Title: Decent bak kut teh but...
Review: The food was decent and the prices were average. We liked the herbal taste of the soup that wasn't too overpowering. Other dishes such as sweet and sour chicken were not bad as well. However when we requested for a soup topup, the amount was less than a bowlful and they told us that we were only allowed one refill :( they should definitely allow us to top up the soup more!

Author: miraclenTorremolinos, Spain
Title: Slow service and tasteless food
Review: This restaurant should seriously consider firing the chef and change the whole kitchen staff. It took half an hour to deliver the hot platter and everything in the platter basically tasted plain - the calamari, the weird ham and beans, the potatoes, very hard meatball and the weird hard croquettes. The drinks and service from the waiters are ok though. If you have read my reviews, I have been to many different restaurants in different parts of Spain. This tastes nothing like Spain. The management staff should come to the restaurant and try the food themselves instead of asking the reviews to contact them and find out what happened. Such a shame that the decorations of the restaurant is quite nice. We are lucky that we decided to have just snacks after reading the menu.

Author: rakugosan
Title: Old School but delicious food.
Review: Tantalizing food and the environment reminds me of the old nostalgic days as you stepped into the cafe! I like the dessert served and tried all of it and super yummy!

Author: MKrwg
Title: Chicken Bryani...1/2 portion boiled egg!!
Review: Been to many north/south indian restaurant...was soooo surprised to get half egg!! They charge rm25 for 1 chicken bryani. Omg!!

Author: GroupBA
Title: HAROO, I LOVE YOU 😂
Review: Well my title is pretty cheesy but One restaurant that I would definitely recommend to those who are in langkawi would be Haroo.. The waiters were extremely friendly and attentive. They greeted me and my friends with so much warmth as soon as we walked into the restaurant and I don’t recall feeling such hospitality at a restaurant. One of the waiters went through the menu, giving a thorough explaination on specific dishes which I definitely found very helpful as it was my first time trying Korean food. We had a Korean barbecue and the food was simply amazing..we also got free ice cream and I really appreciated that as it was quiet a hot day.. Me and my friends spent hours talking to one of the waiters who was exceptionally kind and he even gave us a complementary cool drink.. I would like to thank every one of the staff at Haroo for the wonderful experience I had..I will definitely be back soon

Author: KristenDariaSingapore
Title: Million dollar view, 5/10 food, wait staff with attitude problems
Review: Lounging on the hammock watching the sun go down was certainly a million dollar experience, but I would rate the dishes (I ordered the degustation menu with wine pairing) only between 5/10 to 7/10.The wait staff were either novice or had attitude problems (unteachable & defensive to the rut)- I’m unimpressed by that.Best advise- have cocktails while watching the sun go down on the hammock... but your money is much better spent at other restaurants.

Author: StefanieLee
Title: Just average for me
Review: It was just an average place for me. The deco was nice. However food was just average. Can take a miss.

Author: Vinny v
Title: Very nice food and excellent services. Very friendly and helpful staff. I recomend this restaurant. And specially jewel.
Review: Highest rating. Very nice food and excellent services. Very friendly and helpful staff. I recomend this restaurant. And specially jewel.

Author: U715ZRmichaelh
Title: Not worth going, way too long waiting
Review: We waited more than an hour to get our appetizer and and another 40+ minutes for the main dish. I went and told them three times and was always told „only a few more minutes...“. There’s other good steakhouses in KL.

Author: KrisD_plWarsaw, Poland
Title: Worst meal in Malaysia
Review: Either we were simply unlucky or the chef was out of work. Mee goreng chicken and nasi goreng rendang were almost cold when finally arrived at our table. Not tasty at all. Costed us MYR 20 including 2 drinks. The place looks more like a bar, full of rich youths showing off their smartphones.

Author: 205bentleybShannon, Ireland
Title: Special family holiday dinner.
Review: It was after a long day by the beach, that we wanted a special place for a relaxing dinner. By chance we heard of Fat Cupid, with a little apprehension we went for it. What a delight. A small, quaint and relaxed great dining spot. The service, very good from the time we entered to when we had to leave. The menu was varied with sea food dominant, the food was fabulous and well presented, the wine list good and reasonable (for Malaysia) the dessert was just what the doctor ordered. All in all a great meal, lovely staff and hope to be able to make it back again.

Author: Wing Hong C
Title: Bak Kut Teh
Review:
Good service. Food are reasonably price. Food are tasty.  fast service and no queue.
amber of parking.

Author: Kiran CLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Be aware - the food is tailored for tourists - not local and authentic.
Review: Unfortunately, very disappointing. It is important to be aware that the food here has been completely tailored to Western tourists, it is not very authentic at all.The dish we had tasted only of salt. We sent this back and the returning second version of the same dish tasted entirely of pepper. I suppose they deserve some credit for going from one extreme to the other!The restaurant is obviously doing well and is serving a lot of tourists but if you want local Kuching food don't make the same mistake as us and just visit one of the much cheaper food stalls around the corner.

Author: Jos3phin3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice staff and food!
Review: Came across a very friendly staff name Azura. Highly recommended food and ambience.Perfect dining place.

Author: hanibol53Miri, Malaysia
Title: An embarrassment
Review: Really this place is an embarrassment to any reputable chef. Not only is the food substandard but the prices are ridiculous. I could see paying those prices at a restaurant that was actually good but this place is bad. The beetroot salad is so sweet that it could be on the desert menu. I mean come on, beetroot paired with sweet dried cranberries and honey. Are you kidding me. It's a salad I would serve to a three year old. The crab cake and prawn was a disgrace. The prawn was so over cooked it was literally fused to the shell. The crab cake or maybe the sauce can't tell, doesn't matter, was so salty that even now I can't stop drinking water. The only reason This got two stars is the service was ok and the live music was nice. Chef, you either need to show up a bit more at your restaurant to provide some quality control or if this is how you want it, resign yourself to a life in KL.

Author: Michmy
Title: Best Authentic Nyonya cuisine
Review: It's a dinner that's so yummy from 1st dish till the most delicious Cendol in this restaurant. The customer service is excellent with dishes recommendations. This is the best Nyonya restaurant & fully recommended to all. Thank you, Uncle Jimmy of Manis J.

Author: KiruDharshini
Title: Great banana leaf food
Review: The atmosphere was nice. Fish curry was amazing. Ate to my heart's content. Took mutton varuval. the fries and drinks were also good. service was fast and friendly.

Author: luwism2016Manila, Philippines
Title: Nice place to hangout with friends
Review: It was my second time to be around this area, it's like a 'Club Street' in the city area... nice bars with live bands & sport bars. It was my first time here at Ceylon, it's a nice place to chill out... have some drinks and hangout with friends, friendly staff...

Author: loi_joel
Title: Frisk-free Food
Review:
Good coffee spot with great atmosphere. A good mix of families and young people in the crowd. The 'big breakfast' was full of flavor and the coffee was good. For me the winning point were the pastries! 

Overall a good experience!

Author: AngSiongHuatMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Factoring all in, 3star seem too high
Review: First off, this is to review tuck kee, and not the sun tuck kee next door.I used to have fantastic experience dining here, foods good, environment is rustic.But with the bane of popularity, this place is spiraling on a downward trend.The food while is good on average, have significantly dropped in standard.I used to had better noodle and services.And the fact that food are prepared is such a slow manner requiring a wait of over an hour 30mins just doesn't cut it anymore.My advice, still a must try place, but come as early as you could, eat and leave!

Author: Greatholidays4allMelbourne, Australia
Title: Mixed feelings
Review: On our first visit to this restaurant i loved my lamb shanks with mash so we went back another day. The second visit was no so good. I offered a beef and mushroom pie with mash. I only received a pie i asked about the mash and they looked at me like i was an alien. The pie was less than great with a few bits of meat more like beacon bites than beef with some tiny pieces of mushroom and some creamy sauce total only half filled the crust. I double checked the menu to make sure i was not mistaken and no where was there a pie listed without mash.i can only presume you can buy then from the take away counter as the bill listed my order as a large pie. I would hate to have ordered a small one.

Author: Natasha D
Title: My French Factory
Review: Can’t deny the waffles are delicious. However, place is very cramp and the boss appeared unfriendly. Well, don’t know about you but for me being customer oriented goes a long way. Kudos to the floor staff who made the experience amazing!

Author: Kian FTehran, Iran
Title: Left with tears in my eyes
Review: Visited 4 times. The friendly personnel make you feel like you own the place, they all smile and they're full of positive energy. Even the band crews, the security and the DJ personally greeted us and made us feel welcome which I was impressed the most. Spent the last night in KL at this place, rock songs, cold beer, good people all over the place, smiling and having a good time.I was so attached to this place that leaving it was heart breaking for me.Will definitely visit again on my next trip to KL.

Author: soonsinmy
Title: Reasonable price
Review: The price is reasonable and the service is quite friendly. Personally found the food is just good but not great.

Author: Meng Yang N
Title: Crazy crowds but good food
Review: If you don't mind the crazy crowds and cramp quarters, the food is actually pretty decent. Order the 月光河粉 which is flat noodles with a raw egg on top, and baby octopus with soy sauce.

Author: Angie K
Title: Review of Vivo American Pizza
Review: Vivo is a young American brand that serves a range of pizzas, pastas, baked dishes, seafood/ meats, and desserts. Like the case with Tea Garden, we were in a dilemma whether to include Vivo in our reviews, since it is quite common in Malaysia, and we’ve visited it so many times. We usually frequent the outlets at Setia Tropika and Tebrau JUSCO in Johor Bahru, and hang around to do some work/reading while enjoying a nice meal.Overall, if you are looking for western food, want a clean, comfortable and modern setting with consistent food and service quality, this is good place to go. The only downside is their relatively higher prices by Malaysian standards.A meal there (2 mains and a drink and/or side) typically sets 2 of us back around RM50. They usually have ongoing lunch and tea-time/ dessert promotions (which are updated regularly).Generally, this is a “safe” outlet to visit because of the consistent quality across its wide range of menu items. While we haven’t found any outstanding items on the menu, we love the clean, bright and comfortable setup, and the reliable service.For reviews and pictures of the food items that we have tried, refer to our blog: https://angiekayexplorer.wordpress.com/2015/02/27/review-of-vivo-american-pizza-panini-johor-bahru/

Author: ivanlzhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place
Review: The place offers a nice relaxed ambiance in the bustling city with a nice view of the kl tower which changes colors at night. (Ask to be seated outdoors for the view of kl tower). Food are served at an unexpectedly good quality at a reasonable price with friendly staff.

Author: Poonster1978
Title: Excellent Chinese Food
Review: Very nice ambience and conveniently located within citysquare JB. Avoid during lunch time as it will be crowded.

Author: josephinec42
Title: Overrated and overpriced food
Review: Our family decided to have lunch at this restaurant due to its good reviews. It is stated in it's website that the last order would be at 240pm. Although we arrived at 220pm, much to our dismay, we were told it was already closed. Upon further enquire, no explanation was given other than it was closing time.But because of it's good reviews on TripAdvisor, we returned the next day for lunch. However, it was a disappointment lunch as the food was clearly overrated and overpriced. The Adam Pedas fish was not balanced and for a medium portion, it was highly overpriced. There was hardly any prawns in Tauhu Udang Tauchu. From all the dishes ordered, the kangkung belacan was one of the better dishes.Due to these disappointments, it is likely that we will not return.

Author: Iggies64Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cozy place of a side street with great big, good meals!
Review: Down a lane way we made our way to the restaurant. Tried the fried wontons for starters which were nice. Our host was friendly, informative of the island, the accommodation available, the history of the restaurant as well as attending to meals and cocktail types. It made for a relax full, friendly evening.The mains we bought were the Laksa (which was a huge bowl) as well as beef rendang and a chicken dish I can’t recall the name of, but all got the thumbs up.Might just go back for the gin varieties!

Author: mraandylim
Title: Flies flies flies
Review:
You are paying RM29-35 average for a meal. Coffee is separate. 

You will have flies at your table for company. Right next to your cutleries. Hygiene is a Big Zero! 

When we mentioned this to the staff. They were indifferent.

Not coming back

Author: drdeepySeri Manjung, Malaysia
Title: Awesome night
Review: Decided to have something special this anniversary & opted to come to jeff's cellar for dinner. I was unsure how things worked during the cmco hence I contacted the restaurant directly and spoke to Christine. She's an amazing person and helped place booking and discussed the menu for the night. We don't take beef so the menu was altered a little to accommodate our request. The cellar is amazing. The restaurant is built into this natural limestone cave and the decor gives it a very unique and interesting field. We opted to have the chairman's favorite menu which I think is sort of a degustation menu that the chairman favours. Christine explained each menu and to be honest the evening was simply perfect. The food was tasty and it did give me a wow factor that I was looking for. Hats off to our chef for the night, chef benedict certainly pulled off an amazing meal which certainly has made us decide to plan our next trip again here in future. To all the staff, thank you for the amazing night and experience. We also had the opportunity to see Tan Sri personal wine cellar which is awesome. We understand the most expensive bottle is worth 26k USD, crazy huh. Anyway, to all staff here, u people rock

Author: agj0hnnyKuching, Malaysia
Title: Staff very rude
Review: One of the stuff very rude to us " the bald one and using spec at night . Not a kind of service that we expect from a great and well known place such as Hard Rock.

Author: Steven N
Title: Oily and Average Taste !
Review: I see Tripadvisor reviews usually before I go to restaurant to eat . I see pictures of food very attractive for Kaki Lang Homes Kitchen . So I go with friends and order . The food are very oily with lard not good for health especially rendang chicken. I enjoyed the sambal petai seafood. Also we liked the marinated duck . The atmosphere is very noisy. Cannot really enjoy talk . First time I do not want to go as location of restaurant not good . My friends ask me many times . So I agree . I was surprised all the reviews were done by first timer unlike most reviews for other restaurants . Each one had one review only . It made me suspicious of the reviews and reviewers  Overall the food are average. In Malaysia we say "So So " and pricey not that fantastic. Will i go there again ... not likely !
Restaurant: Kaki Lang Homes Kitchen 自家人私家菜

Author: Ju L
Title: cheap and good
Review: nice market, not a  tourist market! Actually there are  more food stalls than a market   (good and cheap coffee, tea, food), good place to get a feeling for locals, go there early most of the stalls close already at lunch time

Author: ChineseTeaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pok pok pok
Review: Signature dish is the bbq ribs. Excellent. The menu is very flexible. You can choose you add on. Cheese, onions etc. your bread and your side dish. The place is very crowded though it opened 6 months ago only so I am not the only one to enjoy the ribs and sandwiches, the special decoration and the smiles of the staff.

Author: sandral346Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very bad attitute from restaurant manager and mostbof the dishes in the catalogue were not available
Review: I went there for company lunch last month and we were treated bad by the restaurant manager-Gordon . His behavior was rude as he pretended doesn't see us when we were weaving for order and he took the menu from our table without asking whether we have finished reading it. In addition, his tone was impolite when answering our questions about the food. We surprised that there is one trainee who named Alif is much professional than the manager as he treat customer more friendly and promptly. Besides this manager's attitude , the food choice also very limited as there are many dishes are not available during lunch due to run out of some ingredients.

Author: Sethtyler76
Title: Below standard food
Review: Just had the CNY set menu for three of us and it was pretty poor. There was a fried duck dish which seemed to have been refried to such an extent that one could no longer discern what type of meet it was. The fried noodles lacked flavour. The texture was mushy. The Kaplan was too salty and the steamed fish could easily have been missed. Overall, given the reputation that Samadhi would like to promote, the Tamarind Spring was a real disappointment this evening.

Author: 983edwarde
Title: Baba Nyonya style food
Review: The restaurant itself from outside look interesting, and once you step inside the restaurant, it brings you back to old days of Malaysia 1970-80's (I guess). It is a nicely decorated restaurant. Choices of menu was variety which can relate to Baba-Nyonya style of dishes in Malaysia, the price is reasonable (don't compare with street food) considering having inside a beautiful decorated restaurant with food quality. The serving was surprisingly fast apparently although me and my friend visited during lunch peak hour. I would recommend trying their Tamarind Chicken, taste great and not spicy, but if you are spicy liking individual, I believe there are better option.

Author: 862leenkAdelaide, Australia
Title: Poor Service, disappointing Black Cod
Review: Beautiful views of KL skyline. Cold dishes ordered were very good, to the usual standard of Nobu elsewhere. The signature Nobu Black Cod served here was very disappointing - the flesh was not firm and creamy & it was relatively tasteless- I've had the same dish served at other Nobu restaurants in other countries, and they were excellent. I wonder if the fish used here in the KL branch is different from other Nobu restaurants?? Service by front of house staff were not up to par. Inattentive and occasionally obstructive to patrons. I was interrupted a whilst trying to serve myself from a dish - with a waitress barging in attempting to "clear an empty dish" from our table. The polite and sensible thing for her to do would have been to wait a couple of seconds whilst I finish serving myself, instead of stopping me midway, reaching over me, and interrupting our conversation. This happened a couple of times! I would suggest that Nobu spend some time training their front of house staff on some basic etiquette on serving their patrons! Will not be returning till things improve.

Author: jchongIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good dimsum in Ipoh
Review: Of the 3 popular dim sum restaurants on Jalan Leong Sin Nam, Ming Court is probably the most preferred one among the Ipoh locals. The servings are a little more dainty compared to Foh San or Yoke Fook Moon and taste good.On weekends expect a large crowd and you probably need to be patient in finding a table.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Roshane IKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: international service
Review: been a few times and food always good, what is impressive is the international service, attention to detail and caring staff which is rare in kuala lumpur. i have traveled extensive globally and regionally and i can say its v good.for those whom have been; keep going. for those whom have not; what are you waiting for?

Author: 16GinnyTPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Superb food
Review: From the moment we stepped inside we loved this restaurant. While we sat at the bar before going to our table one of the waiters showed us a couple of folders outlining the renovations. It really enhanced our appreciation of the building, the owners are truly innovative. This was the best meal we had during our 7 night trip to Penang. Loved it. We had 2 different curries and shared them. Starters superb and the mango panna cotta perfect to finish. After our meal we were invited to look round the hotel, we can't wait to return and intend staying here next time.

Author: Rayner0411Singapore
Title: It's a Meaty Affair
Review: I happened to chanced upon this place while doing some research on Johor Bahru. Was planning to come in with some of my friends for a meal. The herbal duck was so good, ordered roast pork and char siew as well, Could not resist the temptation for roasted meat. The beverage we ordered tasted average as based on my friends well if could be subjective for individuals. Overall me and my friends love it and will come back for more of the meatFinding this place was pretty easy, about 15 minutes walk from JB City Square. You will see a giant roast duck right above the restaurant.

Author: CarolineC5375
Title: Worst Choice...Never to go back again!
Review: I picked Tiffin for dinner buffet to celebrate gathering with my besties & to my utter shock it was such a bad choice of place. We paid RM70 and were served with choices like what we could typically get at any street stalls. Taste was average. The dressings for salad ran out several times n was not replenished until we had to call and alert the staffs. BBQ option was worst still...they served ikan kembung and it was not cooked well that when we teared off the foil all we got was the raw smell of the fish! There was a pasta corner and no staff, again had to call and wait. Deserts - among the common few deserts served thay had marble cake....seriously??? I can get that at pasar malam! Literally i only enjoyed the soup which tasted good n helped myself with 2 servings.I am a frequent traveller and this is my first ever worst experience with food at a good rated hotel. It a blacklisted buffet choice in my list & definitely would not recommend this place to anyone!!

Author: 587hedik
Title: Chilli's lost quality dramatically
Review: Chili's restaurant which I used to enjoy for many years (this branch in KLCC) lost quality a lot. Don't order lamb steak and burger here. I don't know what was the taste but I couldn't continue eating. Chicken nachos is not bad.

Author: Pureborneo
Title: Slow sordid service
Review: No seated me, noone came to my table when I sat myself, my Rump Steak came in record time of 30min, my request for the bill was never entertained until I had to walk to the cashier to receive a 2 seconds glare by 2 staffs who were busy fiddling a calculator and literally ignored until someone else came out of the kitchen. Or maybe being Malaysian means not to be served upon.Don't bother visiting...

Author: hayashimori
Title: THE FOOD PORTION IS VERY SMALL
Review: the price is not value for the portion. that night me and my wife was still hungry after the meal. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE

Author: DhennverNgPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dog food is a must
Review: The dog food is a must. The honey bbq ribs wasnt as good as expected. I would stick to pork chop. They are very crowded during peak hours and I think they don't take reservations. So be sure to come early to avoid the long queue.

Author: ChrisHiewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below expectation -very disappointed!!
Review: I was in Lafite for an event recently and was really shock that the food standard has dropped so much since I last visited the restaurant.The entree was just a plate of smoke salmon with a few pieces of scallops, not much of cooking skills at all, way too much smoke salmon and I have left half a plate untouched!The soup, was a mushroom soup with a piece of foie gras on top, the foie gras was way too big and chunky, it just takes the essence out of the foie gras, I also noticed almost all on the table of 10 pax left half of their foie gras not eaten.The main course was a seabass fillet, not much skills in this either, seabass was pan fried, the plating was sloppy and not much of anything spectacular in the taste either. The dessert was a real shocker!! Not sure what it is , a strawberry soup with a small cake in the middle, poorly presented, it just taste like strawberry milkshake with a piece a cake, that is so unacceptable as a french dessert especially in a restaurant as such!!Overall experience was poor!!

Author: corsivaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dropping Standard - matter of timing?
Review: Arrivee at restaurant ard 850pm. Was told that we will have to make our order as the restaurant is closing soon. The (small) Unagi don is different from the menu - you only get half a bowl full of unagi. The sushi was barely in shape. Unlike what was shown in the picture there is only a thin film of tobiko (fish eggs) on the sushi we ordered. Overall the standard seemed to have dropped compared to our last visit 2 years back. Not sure if the timing if visit might have contribute - but I would think a professional restaurant should not compromise their standard over conviniences. The bill ended up ard RM100 for 2 person. With the same price Sushi Tei might be a better option if this standard continue.

Author: karenkokliyingKuala Kubu Baharu, Malaysia
Title: Love food and family service
Review: The food is delicately made and deliciously consumed. Fantastic service from Jane and Rucel, very attentive.

Author: melkeetIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Average Restaurant
Review: This restaurant is situated on Jalan Suppiah Pillay, below the Viva Residency in the Kasipillay area of Kuala Lumpur. The staffs are courteous and friendly. However the restaurant is a bit noisy, not so much due to the customers, but due to some noise coming from an exhaust/ventilator, especially towards the entrance. Again, I am not sure, if this was a one off incident or if it is the norm.The food took some time to come, but it was also the peak hour then. However you need to choose wisely what you want to eat, as some of the dishes are large and can’t be finished even by two, especially if you ordered more than one dish. I ordered two different chicken dishes, but both tasted almost the same to me. The Nans were good. The prices were on the higher side. As I found in most Indian restaurants, you have to keep asking for drinking water as they don’t leave a jug of water for you on the table. Waited for the bill, for more than half an hour, as the cashier’s machine was offline.

Author: 217geraldines
Title: Tropical Island atmosphere with Western food.
Review: There are very few places on Langkawi with a thatched roof and tropical isle atmosphere. Mangoes have it. Small friendly bar, sitting surrounded by a  tropical garden.Michelle, is the hostess,while Lutz oversees the kitchen. Perfect for the visitor wishing for the  famiilar  flavousr of home.

Author: linamn1579Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Birthday Dinner at Yun House Four Seasons KL
Review: My girlfriends and I had a lovely Birthday Dinner at Yun House Four Seasons KL recently. The food that we ordered and some recommended by their waitress was I have to say very good. Basics we enjoyed the dinner and it was a lovely Birthday celebration. But before the Birthday Dinner, we were skeptical due to something that they required from us during the dinner reservation.Yun House requested for us to pre order our dinner and make full payment. This situation really puts me off because usually we will pay after we received the service and of course we want to know what’s recommended. I had to write a long and lengthy email to them for some explanation. Anyway, I received a simple explanation from them to be fair and a courtesy call telling me that I do not have to pre order and make the full payment. What a troublesome situation for just a Birthday Dinner. To be fair, Dinner was good and we love the interior of Yun House, Four Seasons KL.

Author: Aliwoodley
Title: Fantastic food and service....
Review:
Popped in for a beer and ended up with nachos, amazing guacamole. Fries with the most delicious spicy mayo and the best jalapeño poppers we’ve ever eaten...all served with a smile from Nadim!

Sensational!!

Author: survivord
Title: Roast Pork Ain't The Same No More.... What a shame
Review: What a shame... the roast pork they don't do it the same way anymore... it is now done in a manner that leaves too much oil in the skin, not much depth to the taste and needing to pour the sauce over it. It just tastes salty. The chicken is wee bit better than last time i was here, not as hard. The soup is still as tasty. Minimum wait time 30mins. If you cant or dont want to wait, dont come... if you want to come then dont complaint about the wait. 5 strips of roast pork, a plate of char siew and a plate of roast chicken with 2 rice and 4 drinks costs rm134 for 4 person. U decide if it is worth it...
Restaurant: Wong Kee Hai Lam Chicken Rice & Roast Pork

Author: x96lee26Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Splendid Evening 😋😋😋
Review: Light dinner at this restaurant Labodega, with Happy Friday Sangria Glass, blends well with Prawns Olive Oil Garlic Tapas, With Deep Fried Calimari so fresh and delicious. Accompany with Paella Seafoods muscle; tasty and awesome and not forgetting Seafood Aglio Olio finger licking goodness. Wonderful evening well spend time.

Author: Arichana
Title: Good
Review: Great experience. Excellent service by Jeeva and his team.. Food was lovely 5/5... A place worth a next visit

Author: LovisaL944Jonkoping, Sweden
Title: Good food, no rock n roll.
Review: The food is good, so are the drinks. Really expensive though, compared to other restaurants in KL. The music and atmosphere is definitely not rock n roll, the place is crowded of rich Malaysians listening to pop music. If you're looking for rock n roll - don't go there. If looking for a good burger - go!

Author: garylim88Greater Perth, Australia
Title: Right idea but wrong place
Review: Beautifully decorated hanging out by rich people that love to splash money. Unfortunately this venue located at the worst complex in KL that do not have proper management services.After closing hours, patron have to walk virtual around the building in the dark to look your car at the basement. When u reach there u will need to walk all the way up the other side of the building to pay parking fee. U got the idea but u placed in wrong building. Sorry for ur lost, not going there any more...

Author: huiyeeg2015Kuala Lumpur
Title: Good food with not so good service
Review: I came here many times for food and very satisfied with the food quality and taste.However, the last time I went was last week and had a very bad experience with the waitress. There were total 6 of us and they gave us a small table that can only accommodate 4 pax. We then requested to join another table. Since 2 of our friends has not arrived, the waitress by the name Joyce, told us she will join the table after our friends arrived. So we order our food while waiting for our friends. However, even there were only 4 of us, the table is not even big enough to place the food for 4 pax. We then requested to join another table but again they said they will check with the manager. Again, no one came back to us.After our friends arrived, we again requested to join the table, but again they ignore our request without even apologize or comfort us! This was very disappointing and caused poor experience to us dining here.

Author: jolynn408
Title: Your KL trip will not be complete
Review: If you miss out dining at Opium ! Must tries : salt and chilli fried squid, red Ang and noodles. Cocktails and mocktails is good !

Author: susantN8524LZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dim Sum Breakfast at Foh San
Review: We had wanted to have breakfast at Ming Court but it was closed that day (Thur) - so we ate at the restaurant across the street. Foh San has a great ambience and we managed to get a table for the 14 of us upstairs. The porridge was good as it was cooked only when you order them. The other Dim Sum dishes were just average.

Author: Phyllis PSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Humble looking but high quality dimsum
Review: Restaurant is oldish, no-frills. Food served was of high quality despite the humble looks. We especially loved the melt-in-your-mouth chee cheong fun and rich-flavoured charsiew buns! Siew mai was good too. Carrot was sold by the time we reach, but I reckon it's worth a try.Fyi: shop is closed on Thursdays.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: anav493Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing setting but disappointing service
Review: Food and atmosphere could not get better. Although we were quite disappointed with the staff. What you expect from such a good restaurant is some sort of guidance through the menu. We did not get any advice or recommendation from the waiters or the owner. The feeling was more of a money making business than of a culinary experience...

Author: 800joewKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, shame about the service
Review: I have visited El Meson a few times and always had good food and again this trip did not disappoint. What was a shame was the service. We were put on a table out the back near the kitchen which was fine but they forgot about us. The order was taken and when the food arrived, there was a panic on as they realised they had not given us complimentary bread or our drinks. The lady dropped the plate of breads down and another man rushed over with the drinks without an apology. The food was really nice. When we came to pay, the waitress didn't acknowledge us when giving us the bill, and thrusted the card machine in our face and then printed the receipt, handed it to us and walked off without a single word spoken . Shame as I've been here before when it's been busy but never had this style of service...

Author: Hanerman
Title: Decent food while shopping
Review: Not an awesome restaurant, but definitely a good option when shopping in any of the better malls in Kuala Lumpur. Moderately priced with good service.

Author: John MPerth and Kinross, United Kingdom
Title: Evening Gathering
Review: Tucked away off Jalan Ampang opposite Oakwood Kuala Lumpur, parking available, offers food as well as drinks. Not sure what the concept is, pub or restaurant with a pool table? Food was not good, pizza was made with cheap cheese, no mozzarella, chicken sausage. Chicken wings were very small, overall the food didn’t offer value for money.Not really any atmosphere here, no customers to help create the atmosphere, therefore no positives from the concept ( what concept?) or food to encourage a return visit.

Author: jentmyKajang, Malaysia
Title: Awesome experience in the dark
Review: The food is excellent!!! Too bad we couldn't see the beautiful food.Had fun dining in the dark with family. We were stealing food from each other's plate and touching each other's legs and hand, trying to scare them! LOL.Your sense of taste definitely improved a lot in the dark, even a tiny bit of mango was tasted.It made you appreciate your sight after the experience.

Author: claudesuppiah
Title: Poor despite the hype
Review: Searched this place out because of all the good reviews that were posted.However, it was a typical Chinese restaurant with tables over the drain and obviously living off a past glory.....Oh... How I was looking forward to that silky smooth hainese chicken..... The subtlety of the taste the lingering of the soy sauce, the bite of the chili sauce....The reality was meh!!I have had more satisfaction scratching a mosquito bite then I had eating at this place....Find another.... There are many more better places!!!

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Tender crepe
Review: Be frankly, seating capacity of my french factory was quite low. I think they could only comfortably accommodate around 12-14 persons, or 20 person with some messes. Their bosses were very friendly and asked for our opinions for their crepes. Be frankly, RM20 for a dark chocolate crepe is quite expensive even in a tourist attraction. Since I am not a crepe-lover, I didn't see much value from their offering.It is worth noting that their crepe was much tender than those Malaysian would usually have, priced at around RM 4-8. It is a nice experience for first-time eater, but i won't visit there second time.

Author: Chandrashekhar T
Title: good
Review:
good food.  Ok for Indians, but not ok for vegies.  Be careful while selecting non veg menu.
Good ambience

Author: FoodyNumberOneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Just Wonderful
Review: Without a doubt an extremely good steakhouse. I had a tenderloin 200g which was clearly more than 200g. It was too the point medium rare and of finest quality. The side dishes were excellent and the 2 unexpected calamari were a nice mini surf-and-turf add on. 5 different salts and 3 different mustards demonstrated attention to detail. The salts weren't too different though and together with the meat I couldn't make out a difference anymore. Last but not least the service was very good. Sometimes a little clumsy as you often have it when restaurants are trying too hard to copy European service - but very very friendly and attentative.

Author: BorneoViewKuching, Malaysia
Title: Lovely decor, wish the food was as good ...
Review: Had a family lunch here and was a tad disappointed that the food quality did not live up to the well-decorated restaurant. A lot of thought went into the design of the restaurant and it has a nice ambience. The dishes etc are much nicer than at many other Japanese restaurants in Kuching. Sadly the sushi rolls were not well made. Something is not quite right with the texture of the sushi rice. The salmon yaki was not evenly cooked.Portions are very small for the price.Service is above average for Kuching. It was not a bad experience but definitely below expectations.

Author: Kokomu
Title: Best pizza in Kuching
Review: The only place to go for the best pizza in town. Service is efficient.

Author: Adrian YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and average food
Review: We had to wait more than 30 minutes for our food and half our orders never turned up. It was difficult to flag the waiters and tea had to be self service. Their price is ok but the food is quite average. Not only that, the portions are very small.

Author: Eric LLabuan Island, Malaysia
Title: Great for a quick bite
Review: If you are around this area (Malim, Lor Pandan, Pokok Mangga), this is a great place for lunch. Local food served is tasty, in adequate portions and extremely reasonable. Service is prompt and friendly. They also blend fresh fruit juices. Quite busy at lunch time and tends to close earlier than its stated 4 pm closing time. Worth a visit.

Author: BramDocLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Dinner at Madam Kwan's
Review: A dinner for four adults and a child.A good selection of local dishes and some Western Dishes. Portions are adequate but noticed no children's portions. Food is well prepared. Local delicacies are worth trying. The cost was reasonable but slightly high in terms of the local currency

Author: kibzy82
Title: terrible service , rude lady at the counter
Review: the lady in charge has a rude manner , refuses to talk or listen to the customer. needs an attitude adjustment , perhaps some training in customer relations.

Author: PaulIanLyonsRoyal Tunbridge Wells, United Kingdom
Title: Very Poor Value
Review: Congratulations on selling the most expensive beer I have come across in three months travel in SE Asia. Bearing in mind that this isn’t a particularly smart establishment or in an expensive area, the price of 15.90 ringgit for what turned out to be a small bottle of beer was pretty extortionate but when I went up to the register to pay, they add 6% tax and 10% service, with a grand total of 18.45.I may be a little old fashioned but I think that if you want to charge for service, it would be nice to do something like:- open the bottle- provide a glass- provide some nuts (I tried to buy some but they didn’t have any anyway- bring the bill and change to the table

Author: E7291MJpatricksDoha, Qatar
Title: Nice food. Shame we were rushed out of restaurant
Review: Headed to this restaurant on the recommendation of TripAdvisor. The food was good, we enjoyed it thoroughly, however, the staff were not interactive despite efforts from us. We tried to learn about our dishes . We felt rushed out of the restaurant at 9:15. Despite the owner being present there was no intersection. Sad. Also, Deserts brought to the table before the dirty plates cleared and no one asked if we enjoyed our meal. They lost out on a generous tip.

Author: sineadschavLondon, United Kingdom
Title: AWFUL FOOD!!!
Review: My husband and I are very fortunate to travel lots (especially around South East Asia) and while travelling get to experience some amazing food - mostly from little local gems that are off of the beaten track. We asked our hotel for a similar recommendation and they spoke very highly of Fat Cupid. We read lots of great comments on Trip Advisor (so we knew it wasn't going to be a local gem but just good Malay food) so were excited to go. What a mistake. The menu sounded lovely with 'recipes handed down through generations' etc. My husband ordered the Thai beef salad (which we have both eaten lots) and when it came to the table, it was a bowl of lettuce with some beef in and no dressing or flavour. I ordered the 'famous' wontons that were so over cooked, I needed the spicy sauce that came with it to take the burnt flavour away. At this point we were both a little unsure about eating our main and noticed that nearly everyone around us were eating paninis (they obviously knew something we didn't). We stuck it out and when our mains arrived I wish we hadn't. We both ordered the waitresses favourite dishes off the menu - chicken curry and a laksa. My husbands curry was edible but not tasty or delicious and my laksa was like eating a bowl of spicy hot water. There was no real flavour, no depth to the dish and even the prawn that I tried was bland. I did not eat this dish. As mentioned, we have tried these dishes in other parts of Malaysia as well as other countries and it has never tasted like this. We asked the waiter for a roti or something similar and he said our roti is square which we'd never heard of but ordered it - we had to laugh when he brought to the table two slices of brown bread!!! The only one good thing the restaurant has going for it, is the staff were very sweet but that is not enough when providing food for paying customers.

Author: Eleen00Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used to be very good
Review: Delicious used to be my favourite restaurant. It serves great food with fresh ingredients. Recently however, the quality has gone down the drain. Food is ok (usually with too much dressing), service is bad and the decor of the place is dirty and unkept. In almost all the delicious now, there are black stains all over the wall and furniture (they are white and the stains are pretty stark against them). Makes me question the hygiene of their food as well.

Author: suesM5412QO
Title: Good value beers, lovely staff.
Review: We enjoyed splash, had some beers at a very inexpensive rate, and enjoyed the pool, highly recommend this for any time of day.

Author: PilotTraveler1977
Title: A very pleasant stay at the Aloft/Nook
Review: A very pleasant stay at the Aloft Hotel was accompanied by the nice Nook restaurant and the Splash poolbar. In both places especially the service by Nurul and Sarah was outstanding!We really felt welcome and warmly hosted.

Author: catherinemac24Singapore, Singapore
Title: Change it up
Review: Nice to try a different cuisine after a few days in Ipoh. It was a short walk away from our accommodation and was quite well frequented. The deconstructed salad bowls were very tasty, although I did also need to order some fresh rice paper rolls to actually fill me up. Very clean place and reasonably priced.

Author: Eveline90Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner buffet lacks variety
Review: It is Rasa Malaysia month and the mutton was delicious. They have the basics buffet must haves (salmon, oyster, sushi) although there was not much variety. Desserts were mediocre. The fondue chocolate was way too sweet for my liking. Service was slow when the crowd started pouring in. Not was good as I expected as Renaissance is a 5 star hotel.

Author: Marc FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Above average with a friendly touch
Review: Went there with my wife and mum. The food was good and prices were of the typical tourist belt. Nonetheless the personal touch was there. They also did a special curry vegetable for my mom as she was vegan. Next to another top rated wine bar.

Author: simonka28
Title: There's better.
Review: It was nice, nothing special. Prices ok but small servings. Service was good and staff friendly. Preferred next door at the living room.

Author: Skaramoosh
Title: Cheap and Good
Review: This establishment is located in the Continental Hotel at Upper Penang Road. The buffet is a good spread and a reasonable price. Ala Carte is just as good and not that pricey.

Author: f_ain90Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: A pleasant dinner.
Review: My family and I went there for our father's birthday and it was a pleasant memory. The steak was delicious. The sauce was good but I think the meat taste better by itself (with a dash of black pepper). I would strongly recommend ordering appetizers because it does take quite a while before your main dish is served. But we were very satisfied when we got our orders. We also ordered the stick fries and what makes it different is that it is sprinkled with seasoning which is somewhat sweet but still savoury. It reminds me of something similar to BBQ seasoning, but I might be wrong. The service was prompt and they were all smiles all the time we were there. It was my father's birthday and they did prepare a dessert (I believe it is a pudding not a cake) and sang for him Everything was pleasant and I would recommend this place if you love your meat and would like somewhere on the quiet side to spend the evening (or noon) with someone special.

Author: KatieA3Mumbai, India
Title: Best laksa at fatCUPID
Review: fatCUPID is a lovely little restaurant in Langkawi, based at La Pari Pari hotel. It is definitely worth a visit for their Laksa alone, I had it two nights in a row. Generous meals with both western and Malaysian style dishes. Lovely setting overlooking the pool and garden, friendly helpful staff.

Author: babla75Singapore, Singapore
Title: Though big spread but bad vegetarian food
Review: We stayed at Shangrila KL for 2 nights and the buffet spread though big was low on quality for vegetarian food and the Indian vegetarian counter was horrible. The food at the Indian section was oily and the breads bad. Not impressed at all. If you have to pay for your breakfast my suggestion is to go out and eat at the various options in and around the area.

Author: rosamundwoKuala Lumpur
Title: Bad experience in Annalakshimi Restaurant Brickfields Malaysia
Review: Well, here’s the incredible bad experience me and my husband had while we went into Annalakshimi Restaurant in Brickfields this afternoon.As usual, we walked into this fine dining vegetarian restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, at Brickfields, the waiter an elderly man told us to sit at two seater table at the corner (dim light corner by the way).Since i would like to put my bag on a chair, i informed this waiter i would prefer 4 seater table (politely).Then he pointed us to the back of the area and told us to sit there at number 24th table, without leading the way. (Wow, does he need to control which table number we have to be seated)It was too far away from the food counter and there were several empty seats in the middle (i saw a 4 seater table with 2 person seated just now), so i would much prefer to sit in the middle. He then said, he expected crowd and he need to optimize their seatings. (FYI, there were lots of empty seats at that hour). And so my husband told him, it was already after lunch time. He’s replied back this way: “Just now i told you to sit at the 2 table seat and you don’t want, so i told you to sit at the back 4 seater seat and then now you said you want to sit in the middle..Does that mean, we can’t choose where to sit when we paid for our food? It wasn’t cheap after all. With such customer service treatment?? Wow!.Even in cinema, you can select your seats, because you paid for it. The cashier never even once reply in such way (above).Such a “FINE Dining experience at Annalakshimi Restaurant Malaysia”..Would you spend your money for such attitude?In the end, we don’t bother to argue with him for his rude behaviour, we left and had our lunch elsewhere with better treatment where our money are worth spending to.http://rosamundwo.com/2014/bad-experience-in-annalakshimi-restaurant-malaysia/

Author: meinnit
Title: Perfect Location, Under-Used
Review: This place has such potential, yet somehow it sits alone and sad, with few locals visiting. For tourists it's good of only the good location but food is nothing special and staff's English can be hit or miss

Author: Departure112256
Title: Birch Restaurant DC Mall Bukit Damansara
Review: Good food - service could have been better. Smoking section should be relegated to the back and near the outside of the restaustant

Author: shilpinitisha
Title: Good indian food
Review:
Food was really nice though it was served after 45mins waiting. 
There is a room of improvement in hospitality.

Author: kajalpattani
Title: Love love
Review:
Since I study in China, my holiday getaway to KL was food paradise. Straight up heaven feels with the vada pav at WTF 💕
Stars for service and great food 🌝

Author: AE G
Title: Nice Coffee n breads
Review: Nice coffee, have many variety of breads with reasonable price，the speaking unicorn drink have perfect and unique taste

Author: GerardWW
Title: Great Chinese food in Mid-Valley Mega Mall
Review: Along with Canton-i in the basement of the Gardens Mall next door, Dragon-i serves delicious Chinese food. One of the better options in the Mid Valley Mega Mall.

Author: Tharshini T
Title: Review
Review: The taste of the food was too bad.... It wasn't worth it at all. Should never try to eat here.....  Having dinner over here was a great disappointment!

Author: david n
Title: Terrible service with average dim sum
Review: Went to this restaurant for Sunday morning dim sum with family. Service is just non-existent. Notice most of the employees are senior citizens and they are too old to push the carts around. The push cart is literally left parked at a corner and you're expected to go over and collect your own food. For the price they are charging, it does not warrant self-service. Dim sum is also average with little selection. Would not return.

Author: John MDallas, Texas
Title: There is a Hard Rock in Melaka
Review: I have been coming to Melaka on business for several years and was happy and surprised to see the Hard Rock here. They have a really great location in the city and it's always fun to visit a Hard Rock wherever I go. I do enjoy the local food but sometimes you just want something to remind you of home. The Hard Rock does that with great service and some good food selections. Go - you'll enjoy the food, the people, and the atmosphere.

Author: Travis T
Title: Nice but might not be that GREATEST.
Review: Been thinking a nice place to pick for Friday lunch. Recommended by a friend to Uokatsu. Checked some Tripadvisor reviews and decided to pay a visit.Definitely, I would say the main purpose make me came Uokatsu is "Mentai Rice", averagely commented MUST EAT. Mentai rice, presentation as what you see from those posted on social media or tripadvisor. I with an extremely high expectation to this "worth to die for"- Mentai Rice, taste wise it is a nice mentai tamago topping the sushi rice (with some seaweed slices). The rice is well cooked and texture at standard. Unfortunately, I would say the Mentai Rice is below my expectation, as the tamago is thin as those tamago sushi (about 0.5cm). You barely can taste the tamago as the mentai part could have overpower and definitely over shine the tamago. Honestly speaking at MYR 19 this price for this rice bowl, I would think the tamago should have much thicker than 0.5cm. Overall, if the today mentai rice bowl priced at RM15 would be decent, but at RM19 then it is obviously pricely for this bowl. I would not said, mentai rice is a must die for kind, BUT if you are visiting Uokatsu, then this Mentai Rice is still on the recommended side. Just for me, I would probably NOT purposely come back just for Mentai Rice. it would probably worth for a TRY, but might not be super missing it.Salt grilled saba (RM 6.7) is good quality, fair portion which you can still taste the juicy part of saba, it is not too salty and not fishy at all to me. Very important it is not overcooked. Recommended to those like saba. If you are ordering their weekday lunch set which just a bowl of white rice, miso soup + green tea, then suggest add-on order this salted grill saba. Grilled full squid is above average, it is not overcooked, so you wont be feeling like having chewing gum. The squidink sauce was good, i highly recommend to have a dip before you eat it. The original sauce on the squid just nothing to shout about.I order the wasabi ice cream to wrap up my lunch dining. I would said, Uokatsu wasabi ice cream even more impress me, as you can feel the "kick" (spicy), of course it wont make you tear, but just a seconds or two a kick on your tounge. A very interesting combination ice cream which come with wasabi kick,texture is smooth and not over milky, it is not too sweet I think it is just nice sweetness level. It is on my recommended list.My friend said, she found that today Mentai rice the tamago part is slightly below standard to her previous visit. Summary, Uokatsu is a place that price slightly towards higher spending, however worth to go for IF you are foodie super craving for fish and mentai tamago. If Uokatsu could have ensure consistent at their tamago part (pls pls pls make it at least thicker than 0.5cm), then I would probably consider Uokatsu in my list for restaurant to return for.Side note: The order taker (a young lady) seems to be grumpy when i placed order or add on order. Well, this slightly marks minus part.

Author: S_H4868Siem Reap, Cambodia
Title: Appalling!!
Review: I want to Bla Bla Bla because of the previous reviews. I now wonder where these people usually eat.Last week I went there but just before going I had a short river Sarawak cruise. I told the ticket man where I was planning to have dinner and he advised me not to go. I should have followed his advice.The initial entry to the small restaurant is both interesting and inviting. I orgered one of their 'signature' dishes which, in my case, was salmon. In view of the large portions mentioned in previous reviews I asked the waitress if I needed to order anything else to accompany the salmon. She assured me, no, as it came with baked potato and vegetables.The food arrived and three quarters of the plate was covered with this dark colored leaf vegetable covered in butter. There was a side very large dish sitting on the plate containing a thick hollandaise type sauce. The tiny piece of salmon was sitting on, literally, eight pieces of diced, boiled potato. Thankfully, having read a previous review, I had asked for the sauce on the 'side' otherwise the salmon mini piece would have even smothered in this 'stuff'. 40 Ringgitt for this appalling destruction of good food and the salmon was well under-cooked. Quoth the Raven....Nevermore!!

Author: Joke L
Title: Great place to chilled out all day
Review: Nice cafe with loft design. You can stay here and enjoy your food and drink all day. Let try this mocktails "special slush". If you are the mango lovers, it's worth to try.

Author: LL721
Title: Good, although portions were small
Review: We had the bowls of ramen and pork buns. Food was delicious, although portions were really small. And, for the small portions, it was expensive.

Author: TheruthiVancouver, Canada
Title: Nice authentic Indian banana leaf meal
Review: Made me feel like I was back in south inda. However I ordered a lassi that had ice in it and they couldn't assure me that it was made from safe water (to their credit, they gave me another ice less one for no charge). Their chai is a lot more expensive than other nearby places (the best and cheapest chai I had was at the madras cafe).

Author: mfletcher09Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food - Highly recommend!
Review: An awesome find during our time in Kuah. Everything was delicious and very reasonably priced. We enjoyed the hummus, fattoush salad, shish kebab and shwarma. Servings were huge and the owners were very friendly, they even talked us out of buying two of something as they thought it would be too much!

Author: Janneke020
Title: Great food!
Review: Loved the food. We had fried anchovies, Rendang and lemon chicken with fried rice. The fresh fruit juices are also great.

Author: jaclynteohKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Flies!
Review: This place is getting bad to worse. I have not been there for quite a while and decided to pay try it again. Reached there slightly before 7 pm, crowd have yet to pour in. We requested to sit by the bar so we can see the food preparation. As I was browsing through the menu, I noticed flies!! Not one but a couple of flies. The sushi chef and even waiter all saw it but they were just being ignorant. I voiced out my dissatisfaction on the flies as this is a Japanese restaurant and there were raw seafood lying openly on the bar. It is simply unacceptable! The waiter then asked the chef to take a cling wrap and cover the exposed raw sashimi This place has really deteriorated tremendously. With the price they are charging customer, they simply don't care about cleanliness. It's just a matter of time before someone get a very serious food poisoning and they will be asked to shut downOn top of that, staff were not friendly. Rather rude especially the sushi chef. Maybe he wasn't happy with me complaining about the flies. Zero service and cleanliness coupled with exorbitant price as well as mediocre food, it's not even worth a try anymore. Just stay away from this place

Author: HY_SG
Title: Can be better
Review: Tried a few dishes. Duck wasn't as good as it claims, so was the roasted pork. However, the char siew was charred and tasty. The best of all trio. Oat prawn was delicious too.

Author: b0bnw8London, United Kingdom
Title: Another visit, alas in vain - DC should indeed try harder
Review: We've visited DC Restaurant a while ago and much as we have enjoyed the meal, and very much appreciated the service, we were certainly not impressed and did not feel that what were good intentions and result of high ambition and aspiration materialised and turned into a memorable meal and an incredible experience.The patron owner, Chef Darren Chin himself, kindly replied to our comment, but we had no way to comment on what he said. We have sent him an email, to the restaurant address, sent for his attention, but received no reply.While we are happy to hear that our asparagus, white asparagus from Landes no less, was not from a jar, we certainly did not find that right cuisson for such an asparagus is "mushy" and mushy it was.As for great intentions of Chef Darren Chin to respect terroir, a glimpse at our menu made us feel a bit confused:So, it starts with alaskan king crab, moving on with Perigord black truffle, further Irish premium oysters and Oscietra caviar, mackerel which, unless you are talking about kembung, is certainly not indigenous, Hokkaido scallops, irish mussels the aforementioned Loire white asparagus, sea urchin and stripped jack that certainly do not come from local waters, alaskan king crab which features again, Roguie foie gras which I understand is preferred by chefs for a good reason, some more black perform truffle, and an amarena cherry no less than from Bologna (I was a student there and know well the place is called La Grassa for its perfect food), some Australian lamb for good measure, Brittany blue lobster, or Hidayu A5 Wagyu (that awaited us placed as a display on the table) and it all ends with Japanese mandarin, and Korean strawberry. No amount of ""European variety" vegetables grown for (DC), to order, by organic farmers in the Cameron Highlands" helps out with this, as we did not see them on the menu. Further, while we appreciate DC were the first restaurant in KL to do so because they believe in serving the best and freshest produce to their customers, and because they believe in reducing food miles and supporting local producers we still see that main ingredients are flown from far far far away.Anyway, we yet again had a nice meal, we appreciated the exceptional service, but feel that hype is not well deserved. We know that Chef Darren Chin spent time at Le Cordon Bleu, and during this period got an award for his sandwich creation - Délifrance Sandwich World. We also know the he was for a short period an intern at one of Pierre Sang Boyer restaurants, all of them are high class establishments with outstanding food, but certainly not Michelin star material, we feel that food, now for the second time, fails to be exceptional and make you feel that you've been taken into another dimension as really good and really memorable food should. The tastes of course differ, but Chef Darrin Chen should be humble enough to take less than affirmative comments with as much appreciation as he does take the praises, and understand that aspiring to do something and being very passionate and honest about it does not always translate in the actual accomplishment.We shall be back to DC Restaurant, there are lots of good things about it, not least probably the best table service in KL, but feel that Wow factor is missing, and at this price level and with this high ambition, we do not feel it is unreasonable to expect it.PS. It is strange that Chef Darren often mentons " My experiences working in Paris in Michelin starred-kitchens" so we are interested in which Michelin starred kitchen did he work as Pierre Sang Signature has L'Assiette MICHELIN, not a Michelin star and so does Pierre Sang in Oberkampf.

Author: brittany b
Title: great breakfast
Review: came here for breakfast nearly every day I stayed in penang. they do a very nice fruit salad, great bagels, and a generous serving of pancakes. nice decor, music, atmosphere as well.

Author: HunyBunySuny
Title: Poor.
Review:
Poor was terrible and not to mention, it was expensive (much more expensive than normal cafes out there)! It was no wonder the whole cafe was empty throughout 10-12pm. 

Don't waste your money here.

Author: Alice FKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent food, bad service
Review: Wrote in to make advance reservations for dinner. Manager called, promising to speak with chef about a special menu. Never materialized in the end. Worst of all, when my dining party showed up, the staff have no idea about my reservations. Very annoyed when they asked when I made the booking...they behaved as if I was lying!! I have the sms from the so-called manager as proof. Luckily food was okay. The restaurant was busy but I felt so disappointed as my plans to surprise my two friends celebrating their birthdays were ruined. There was a guy in black jacket on duty that night but obviously he either wasn't in charge or couldn't be bothered to make amends. Not returning ever again!

Author: KJ5622
Title: DISAPPOINTED!
Review: Initially the food was delicious and well served but unfortunately currently the food are unappetizing. To add more in disappointment, the staffs are not welcoming at all. Serving the dishes as if they are paying for our foods. Not even a SMILE! Why work in a customer service line when you can't even treat your customer well? The portion are so little yet charging high price for it. I understand if it is delicious. It's teribble! The mutton is as you're chewing a gum.

Author: SGS1960Melbourne, Australia
Title: Why wouldn't you ?
Review: We were in KL for 4 days and I like to have places researched to go in case we don't find anything else while there.Our daughter always wanted to visit a revolving restaurant, so it was a bit of a no-brainer for us.Once you take a look though and compare the price of the buffet meal to just a visit to the floor below to take a look, why wouldn't you do it ?The buffet was quite good, with the desserts a standout. Take your time, no-one's in a hurry and the dishes are refilled regularly.It was pretty quiet while we were there, but the service was excellent. Our waiter really looked after us and even took lots of photos. It's just lovely combining a nice meal with a birds eye view of the whole city just wandering past your table.

Author: MalRosEaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: If you would like to try a halal chicken rice ball, you may wish to try Ee Ji Ban. The roasted chicken tastes nice. You have a choice to order either chicken rice balls at RM0.30 per ball or a plate of chicken rice (if you wish to have normal rice). Not to worry about the heat as place is equipped with fans. Price wise is ok, not too expensive.

Author: YhteohMalaysia
Title: Great pork rib
Review: No doubt, its a very delicious pork rib 7 other side dishes like curry mutton, asam fish, meatball & some others Hakka foodie. A friendly boss that always come nearby to eater chit chat & feel proudly to tell you that their pork rib rice are the cheaper in town, yes it is cheaper in town with just Rm3.80+ you can have a single potion, but when you saw that single potion, there is the rice with standard size (a small bowl size) and the pork rib or meaty just few small pieces, after you ask for add-on or extra meaty to your meal, the price will increase to the same with others or maybe it will become over-priced.for those go for 1-2 person, you can order the meal with small size potion, up to 3-4 you better ask for large size. Always ordered the pork ribs with large potion, you might not enough for the ribs, it is great.

Author: RUIWEN78Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great combination of malaysian ingredients & western techniques
Review: Really great nice ambience. You can choose from an ala carte menu or select your own fish to be cooked the way you want it to. The fish on display were really fresh. We ordered the golden pomfret which we thought combined malaysian ingredients and flavours really well. Fillets of fried pomfrets sit atop a bed of ulam, panko fried quail's eggs and rice cakes. Really interesting.

Author: imJoviKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Indian Cuisine
Review: Pros:+ Valet parking, or if you don't want to valet there's a spacious parking lot.+ Great service. Never have to worry about waiters not attending to your needs.+ Wide selection. I spent way too long reading the menu, longer than I care to admit.+ DELICIOUS FOOD. I recommend trying out their many signature dishes, and the chicken tikka masala, and butter chicken. Even on my 4th visit I was discovering new menu items that I could not get enough of.+ Good atmosphere and interiors. Appropriate in setting the scene for the meal you're about to enjoy.Verdict:No doubt I will be making return visits to Delhi Royale. The easily accessible location, wide selection and great taste is not to be missed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for legit, tasty Indian food.

Author: OzTrottingGlobe
Title: Dinner for two at this tiny Cafe/Bar
Review: Found this Cafe by accident while looking for a place to eat. It has a little garden and outdoor area in the front facing the street. Very simple menu and very friendly staff. Another inexpensive place for a meal in the Ferringhi Beach area.

Author: suichabo
Title: Lunch of 5 people
Review: Ordered fried rice, fish maul soup, curry chicken, etc. Not authentic n not nice at all. Very disappointed

Author: Bobby MByron Shire, Australia
Title: great location an oasis from the heat
Review: James Brooke bistro is a good place for lunch after walking the streets of Kuching. The décor is lovely, the staff are competent, but what makes it is the food and the location. The Sarawak laksa is the go, tasty and delicious. The rest of the menu falls into the same vein, clean and tasty. I have recommended this bistro heaps of times and will continue to do so.

Author: jyyyy_1994
Title: Worth to visit when you are eating alone
Review: Concept similar to the small sushi shop that I have tried in my home town. Food served fresh and waiters are polite.

Author: helmiyoung93
Title: ALA CARTE BREAKFAST
Review: Great service for Ala Carte breakfast at Latest Recipe with their staff named Hafizi 👍🏻 Will come again soon for my next holiday!

Author: VRPG
Title: Nice to chill
Review: Lovely place to chill for hi-tea, hangout but food is nothing to boast, very average. Desserts are to go for, it's good!

Author: Yoga2014Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: You've not tasted sushi if you think this is good
Review: The sushi is just normal, not worth the long queue. Service is slow. Your expectation and apprehension of sushi are pretty low if you think the sushi here is anywhere near decent.Shockingly, I once saw a big rat jumping down to customer's table from the ceiling at Gardens outlet, and the staff did not do much but just rush the rat out of the premise. No compensation or apologies. This is terrible.

Author: LJB610San Diego, California
Title: Overpriced and pretentious
Review: So I have to admit, the only reason I was attracted to this place was the promise of craft beers. However, after we had settled in and placed our food order, I enquired about the 'selection' of craft beers, only to be told they had exactly none ! As we had already placed our food order we were kinda obliged to remain. The food was mediocre at best and tries to be gourmet but really doesn't quite make it.
