The waitress seamed to be more concerned with updating her social media than attending to her patrons, of whom we were the only two. Not surprising the place was empty. Not recommended.

Author: J6343YZamyb
Title: Small portions, disinterested service, dishonest staff
Review: Just left Spice and Grill, Puteri Harbour, with one of the most disappointing 'fine' dining experiences.The portions are extremely small and the restaurant failed to offer basic entries like bread and butter. The service staff appears disinterested in serving as we stood at the door for several minutes without anyone bothering to entertain us. Finally, there was a promise of 15% Discount that was retracted after the meal because the email that was sent has 'bounced'. Such dishonestly and poor service made this one of the worst 'fine' dining that I have experienced in years. Best to avoid this restaurant.

Author: tingjin
Title: Comfortable Dining
Review: Their pasta prices are a bit expensive, the taste is so so but it is a comfortable dining area. Their menu will change from time to time.

Author: AdvSiddharthVerma
Title: Okay buffet dinner
Review: Visited in Dec, 2009. Buffet dinner was alright. Nothing extraordinary to mention about. Food was fresh.

Author: Filippo A
Title: “Simple the Best Rooftop Bar/Restaurant in KL”
Review:
Located at the Banyan Tree hotel in KLCC, Verigo is a great place to get some fantastic views of the city, exquisite food and unique cocktails. 

Glad to have experienced it. Hope to return soon.

Author: cheah99Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Over-priced!
Review: This supposedly fine-dining restaurant now serves average food. We had several dishes including a set of degustation menu. The only thing worth mentioning in the degustation menu is the wahyu beef. A lobster dish was over-cooked. But what takes the cake in restaurant 'speak' is a starter they called "duck foie gras". This dish is nothing more than duck pate(and not even a good one, in our opinion!) dressed up as foie gras. Our trip to Lafite was rather disappointing this time round, with average food at fine-dining prices.

Author: LovetotravelpjPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very poor quality food
Review: I never expect restaurant in a Hilton hotel serve such poor quality food. The crab and prawn are all not fresh. The slices of sirloin steak looked dry and unappetising. Even the pineapple at the fruit tray appeared with black spots. The only thing that is edible is the satay. The drink is also very expensive.

Author: Luana0079
Title: Lovely place
Review:
Amazing night is Friday night ... full of fun with friends. Shisha and  food is good too .. 
if you thinking u wanna go canopy book a table for you first ..  
service is standard also.. from me 100 out of 100

Author: Domchong
Title: Breakfast at Jonker
Review: Went there for breakfast. Nice place. Not much people. Kaya breakfast was not bad. But the pancake we ordered came cold. Not nice at all. Prefer it hot.

Author: sylveskeAntwerp, Belgium
Title: Great food and service!
Review: On recommendation of our travel guide, we ended up here...It's a small restaurant, not fancy or cosy, but... very friendly staff, very yummy (and surely enough) food!!!, very low prices...Here you can eat the real indian food... a lot of locals here too, which is a good sign ;-)We really loved it here!

Author: stanya91Penang, Malaysia
Title: Not impress
Review: We went to have brunch over the weekend.When we are there, there is only few people then we head to the counter and would like to order our food and drinks. There was a girl que in front of us buying a cake, the cashier was so busy looking for a box to put the cake, another guy was busy at the coffee machine, so no one attend to us even three of us are standing in front of the counter for about 10 minutes.We ordered Iced Caramel Macchiato, Iced Chocolate, Iced Toffee Nut Latte and Banana Smoothies. The Banana smoothies is very good but the rest are very disappointed. Coffee taste very diluted, not worth the price.Food wise, we ordered Applewood & Bacon Bagel, Big Breakfast, Mushroom omelette & mushroom bruschetta. The portion is ok but it is tasteless. Like just cooked and served, thats all. Not recommended as we are not the satisfied customers.However, the environment are chill and nice.

Author: GoPlaces816478
Title: Nice presentation but tasteless
Review: I've ordered nasi goreng.i love their presentation but it was tasteless.their spageti aglio olio was okay..i did gv feedback to the cashier and thr cashier gave me a slice of cake as token of apology.even the chef also apology to me..good service recovery..the restaurant is clean and nicely deco

Author: frdins
Title: Best Restaurant
Review: Nice ambiance, great views with outstanding service yet the quality of food could be enhanced. I believe they do one of the best seafood in the city, highly recommended and not to be missed. Keep it up

Author: MBJ400Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Not as good as it used to be, cheap ingredients and not much service
Review: whent ey started they were great, they had Filippino staff that really knew how to serve, they smiled and served, now its sadthe train food is just dreadful, very little variety, and quality averageservice is really non existentfood is OK, but there is better, try somewhere else

Author: huey ling gKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrendous service
Review: A family who came later than us and without reservation, got a table before us - because they knew one of the captains. Bad start. After all, there was a queue system and everyone waited for his or her turn . we waited 10mins for our table. our table was in a small room, away from the main section, which meant that we and the other diners in the room would be overlooked. True enough. The trolley with the Dim sum only came 10-15 mins later. We waited for another trolley with fried radish cake but it came too late. We had already asked for the bill. We waited 15 mins to get the card back. The captain said it will be back . Five minutes later, she said the same when we asked about it again. The credit card only came back when she chased the waiter for it. Terrible.Food was mediocre. Also, There was only one trolley with steamed stuff , serving the entire restaurant and another trolley with the fried stuff. Needless to say, food is extremely slow in coming.

Author: AV_madridMadrid, Spain
Title: Too quiet for a pub
Review: I went there twice during mu stay. Service is fine and cocktails are good but there is no atmosphere.

Author: MsApexKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food
Review: This is the restaurant that my friend suggested when I went to Kuching. Well, they have a variety of food at a very reasonable price. The food was good and delicious. I get to try some of Sarawak's local food in this restaurant and don't need to go to other places since they have all Sarawak's most popular food. So, why not step ur food and try the food here.

Author: kimlkimfd
Title: Decent indian food
Review:
One of the very good indian food that i could find in this area
Comfy environment
Staffs are pretty efficient and friendly
Prices are slightly expensive
Try their briyani and masala prawns !
Naan is just nah :p
Fried vege is god damn oily

Author: NickWhite_12
Title: Excellent service and beef rendang
Review: A small restaurant with probably only 5 tables. Excellent service and outstanding beef rendang at very good prices.

Author: Traveller5970
Title: Disappointing
Review: Visited this restaurant after reading the reviews. Food was disappointing, sushi and sashimi were served at room temperature and definitely not cut fresh obviously pre prepared. Chicken teriyaki, bbq chicken and steak were okay but rather tasteless. Visit certainly was what we were expecting following previous reviews... disappointing

Author: Wahidah F
Title: Best steak in KL
Review: This café is our favorite family eating outlet as their nasi goring and their menus, services very satisfying. Here you can see their staff age more than 50yrs still working and they enjoy it.

Author: Christian SHobart, Australia
Title: A place to hang out while in Town.
Review: This is a place to hang out while in Town. This Café offers everything that you are looking for. Great atmosphere, good music, excelent Staff and owner Belinda is a true professional. A variety of drinks including Beers and Wine, fruit juices and excelent coffeé.The food is fresh and delicious and made on the premises. Bread and Pasta ere made fresh on a daly basis by her two chefs, June the more western style and Avi more Asian home style cook. Tasty and generous seems to be theyr moto and it hits the mark. Food available all day and every day. Breakfast-Lunch-Dinner and all times in between. Or pop in for sweets and Tea or coffeé. If this Cafeé would not excist it would have to be invented. The place has been tastfully decorated by Belinda and her Builder Husband in a very short period.It is a place to go when ever you are in Town and tired from running arround.Go and relax at the ARTS CAFEÉ.

Author: Chong LSibu, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I went to this place a long time ago and it was a nice place. The food was nice the service was good and the environment was nice too. But my last visit really disappoints me. It's a buffet style steamboat. And you can eat all you can and the price is quite reasonable . But The food was not so fresh. There was not much choice. And the table clothes was damp when we sit at our table. The place was not so well organized . Hope the owner will try lo clean the place up .

Author: L PJohor
Title: Expected - Unexpected from indian shop !
Review: Hi all,I read the reviews and seems very highly rated, but i did see a pattern, all those who rated highly were non-indians and 1 indian rated poorly but that was backed by another indian rated good too. So i decided to try the palce.I went there with 4 adults and 3 kids.We ordered the following, i have included the remarks too.1. Fish head curry ( RM 45 )- very sweet and fish is not fresh. 2. Cucumber raita- it was way too salty, when we feedback they mentioned they will do it right in the next round and came with sugar added to the raita. We were like ??? The waiter was kind enough to take it back and remove from our list of food.3. Fish cutlets.- ohh gosh i only taste flour instead of fish, it doesnt get anywhere to fish.4. They charge us for papadam, hahah first indian shop to char papadam at first serving.5. fried chicken - only thing we find was ok ok.6. egg omelete- no comments, taste normalOverall the food is good but i wouldnt call it indian food, pls take note those who are reading. this is fusion indian i feel. Those indians who want to eat good indain food, this is not the place , dont waste ur money.Check the bills when you are paying, as i get extra items in my bill which i didnt order for.All the best.

Author: TraesaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Some Alexis Restaurants better than others ....
Review: There are a number of Alexis restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. The best is at Bangsar Shopping Centre and the worst is Alexis Ampang. On New Years Eve our family had brunch in Alexis Ampang situated in the Great Eastern Mall. The menu was similar to other branches but the quality of food was very different. The rocket was limp, the prawns were dried out and over cooked and the chicken sandwiches were made from thin pieces of bread with a little salad, tasteless chicken and a few greasy curly fries. The Vietnamese soup was the best of a very disappointing meal.I would suggest that the manager from BSC go overhaul their Alexis Ampang branch as they are falling short of the usual excellent standard of Alexis.

Author: jdelucchi8Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reliably consistent
Review: I had last visited this place 2 years ago, when I was living/working in Tanjong Bungah. Always friendly, always good quality, always helpful. The same owners and the same good feeling about the place. I never did a review, before, so I need to put that right. Try it, I'm sure you'll like it. Real BACON in the breakfasts, good coffees and a varied main meal menu.

Author: Chieh777
Title: Good choice for dining
Review: The food here is wonderful, and the service is also quite nice, especially our waiter Jacob, he is thoughtful and professional.If you are looking a place for celebrations, it’s definitely the best choice.

Author: PatrickT3357
Title: Fraser Place Thai
Review: Nice 👍🏼 much better than the most commercial Thai restos not the cheapos outside. Good for the offices nearby and valet parking is easy.

Author: chrisyap19Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Moderate only
Review: Four of us opted for different dishes ranging from ribeye to pasta alia olio and all tasted moderate only, nothing to shout about. My pasta was a tad too oily. Limited menu and the place looks more like for drinking rather than foods. Service was ok. Prices a bit on the high side.

Author: Fiey15_R
Title: just a plain mee soup
Review: It is just mee soup in a large bowl. Nothing special. The drinks all too fancy type, not much variety to choose.

Author: Chan0383
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Had a wonderful time at Graze. The escargot, gnocchi and salmon were perfectly seasoned and tasted good. Xinyih and Stanley were attentive and made sure we had a lovely evening.

Author: Jaskel_33Singapore
Title: Mediocre High Tea and Pathetic Welcome Drinks Selection
Review: Stayed in Banyan Tree KL for 6 days (5 nights) as an Accor Plus Platinum member and was appalled by its poor standard.A) Drinks limitation using complimentary vouchers for Accor Plus Platinum member at Altitude- I was given 4 drinks vouchers but I was unable to use any since the Altitude Bar restricted the drinks to only a handful of options.- I only consume beer and there is only Carlsberg available and there is no other option.- I do not take Carlsberg at all because I will develop headache even after consuming 1 glass of Carlsberg beer (bad experience in the past) and no other international beers such as Hoegaarden, Kronenbourg 1664, Heinken etc are available.- we ended up leaving the Attitude (I mean Altitude) Bar in disappointment as I could not believe that a top 5 stars hotel is so cheap as to not provide other international beers- if the hotel is not sincere in offering any welcome drinks, then please refrain from doing so instead of insulting us by only limiting us to some non-alcoholic beverages, 1 beer and some house pour.- the cheapest room rate cost around MYR 1,000 per night and yet other beer that costs a couple of dollars is not an option (disgraceful and cheapskate) B) High Tea not up to standard- our stay package includes a set of complimentary high tea for 2 persons but the food quality is poor compared to the usual high tea we have from other hotels.- we ended up eating only 30-40% of the food and asked the service staff to remove the majority of the food.

Author: GTti_72Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: For young children who know Mamee
Review: If you're not familiar with the products, give this place a miss. The activities and displays are targeted at a very young audience. Despite loving the snack, both my 13 & 9 year olds were not attracted by the limited displays.The top floor is catered for activities. Whilst we were there a large group of children (I assume from a school/kindie) were busy in one section while the other section where actual creation of the snack is being carried out had a few kids (and their parents) participating. The staff didn't seem too motivated and didn't make it more enjoyable. Nobody came up to us and offered advice or asked questions.Some of the products on sale could only be bought in sets so you spend more than you planned for.So overall, skip this place unless you're a HUGE fan of Mamee...

Author: C3451ZUmichaelt
Title: This Restaurant is permanently closed
Review: We were trying to find this restaurant but not able find it. Ask around nobody knows about this Chef Anthony. Finally found that they closed the restaurant for the past 3 years. Should remove the reviews.

Author: Q8902IMpauldAdelaide Hills, Australia
Title: Never Again!
Review: This was the first dinner we had on arriving in Kuching and it would be fair to say we were mortified with the quality of the food. Our duck was cold and the ribs were so overcooked we struggled to chew them. Given the lack of cleanliness of the place and the obscure tastes of our food we were just thankful we didn't end up with food poisoning.

Author: kmn232Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Service on point.
Review: Had to write this before I even left the place. Have been to KL 4 times this year and have been to La Boca every time. Menu is awesome and service is probably the most attentive (talking about fast waiters that really pay attention) I've had in my years in SE Asia. Will be coming back for years to come.

Author: Vlad A
Title: Tasty traditional malaysian food
Review: It has plenty of tasty dishes of Malaysian cuisine. For europeans, do not take red/orange soups - they are extremly HOT)))

Author: coconutboy_9San Francisco
Title: Mediocre food - over priced
Review: Ate here twice, just to give it a second chance - but still not convinced.The food was edible, but lack lustre. I ordered the cordon bleu - and that's all that was on the plate - just this sad lump of bread-crumbed meat that smelled and tasted or old reheated cooking oil. Where were the vegetables? Ah - well if I wanted vegetables I should have ordered them! I recheck the menu and see that the price of the meal almost doubles if you want veg and potatoes with your meat. This place caters to the local expatriate community - over 60's only please - not that I'm ageist, but there was a certain retirement home atmosphere both times I went. Visitors who are not regulars can wait to be seated or served until the regulars get served. The service was friendly, but drunk (admittedly original for Malaysia) and got steadily drunker as the evening went on.

Author: ikram_mdKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Getting Expensive with Quality Degrading
Review: I had been to this place for few time in the past so I really can compare with my latest visit. The price had gone up considerably but the quality was degrading. Ordered grilled chicken which cost me around RM45 (if I can remember correctly) and what I got was a small piece of cold chicken with lots of smashed potates stuff in it, so it looks like a large portion. I flet like just paying the high price for the so-called ambience (which was rather cramped and noisy at times). I don't think I would be coming in near future.

Author: adelinetan2Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Family Dinner at Samira Asian Terrace 11 July 2020 @ 6.30pm
Review: Ambience was nice but Foodies, red wine by glass,cocktail totally lousy. If you want to visit this Samira Asian Terrace, just come here for a beer, take some nice pictures but please don't waste your money on their Foodies. Pineapple Fried rice RM24 is like butter fried rice without pineapple and put on a white plate not inside a pineapple. Seafood Tomyum clear soup was not hot, Squid with chilli & lime just OK, Green curry with duck was lousy. They missed out our order Papaya salad with soft shell crab and captain only found out when we pay our bill. Totally atrocious Thai fine dining experience at Samira Asian Terrace...I think these dishes were cooked by amateur chef... 11 July 2020 Our total bill for 3 person cost us RM212. 00

Author: 727yingc
Title: Good laksa
Review: The second time we have tried Assam laksa in Georgetown and it was pretty good. I really like the prawn cracker, it adds an extra layer of flavour to the laksa.

Author: andreay341
Title: cut throat price
Review: food was okay but super expensive for area in klang. ordered crab, lamb. lamb was small piece only good for 2 bites claimed from Australia

Author: ZRFI
Title: Amazing Chinese cuisine!
Review: Best Chinese food that I can think of, competitively priced as well. Jacquelyn and team are fantastic too, they remembered out little dining requirements. After MCO ended this is where I went to get my fix for Chinese food. Keep doing what you're doing Yue and Sheraton PJ, we will return.

Author: uncle_sim123
Title: One of the Best Dim Sum in Malacca
Review: Nearby Jonker Street. Dim Sum in small portion (2 pcs). So can try more dishes. Waiter will bring Dim Sum to your table for you to choose. Most Dim Sum are nice. Price for 4 person around rm$50.

Author: Emilia D
Title: Good food and lovely Cafe.
Review: The cafe itself is very pretty and much larger than it looks from the outside! Our food came very quickly and was brilliant. The staff weren't as friendly as in some other places but all round very happy with the service.

Author: Anne384Shanghai, China
Title: Fantastic experience !
Review: We went here because of the good reviews on TA. We are so glad we did, because this was a really fun experience. We did not book a table, but went quite early one afternoon and got in right away. The staff was very welcoming, and we got some complimentary drinks to start with in the bar, outside the dark restaurant. When we first entered the dark restaurant area, it was a bit scary, but mostly funny. The food tasted delightful ! When we were finished we had a beer in the bar, and the chef stopped by and asked if we enjoyed the dinner, that was really cool. This is a must-do in KL !

Author: GabriellemariaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Underwhelming
Review: We thought we’d try this place out as it’s got amazing reviews on here... we were very disappointed. There were only 4 tables with customers but food still took ages to come out. The drinks also took a long time. The people on the table next to us got told half an hour later that what they ordered wasn’t available. You’d think they would’ve been told straight away but the customers actually had to ask why it was taking so long.Our food was average and drinks also average. There was no ‘amazing view’ as the roof was closed. There was no music until another customer asked for music to be played and then they played terrible music. The wifi didn’t work. The waiter kept going on his phone and there was only one person working at the bar. Definitely not worth it. It was a waste of time going here.

Author: foodmonstrAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Not upto the mark..very dissapointed
Review: Well, me and my wife, we both are a huge fan of mexican food. We tried mexican in almost all the international cities but this is our first time in KL. Mexican food when we say, it should be spicy. So spicy that your eyes, nose, tongue should be burning. And the taste should b still on that u wont feel like stop eating. This is where la mexicana has barriers. Food is not at all spicy and tacos must be improved.Will I go there for a second time? Well i will think thrice and still will think about it.

Author: michaelgB4441DXSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not so good recommendations
Review: Visited the restaurant for lunch and was greeted very well. Once seated I asked the manager for his recommendation and that was the wagu beef checks which I ordered together with mushroom soup. Soup was good and tasty. The presentation of the beef checks was great, but the taste was not there and more than half was fat...not very nice. When addressed to the manager he said he would tell the cook - that was it. Full price no complementary offer for a coffee, I won't be back. Also they did have a lunch special, but did not tell me.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: lim906
Title: Waited more than 40 minutes and they serve tables after us first
Review: Food is nice and price is reasonable but the wait is just way too long. Worse, tables of 8 that come after me got their food first even though I order the same thing.

Author: Y5411DFpaulk
Title: Very Average
Review: Mains were served 10 minutes apart. Heated in microwave. Tasteless lasagne. Cocktail arrived after wine. Ambience okay but not REAL italian

Author: FruitusDoha, Qatar
Title: Average
Review: Been here a couple of times now and probably won't return. The first time I had a tasty but very small portion of BBQ ribs, the second time I went I ordered minced pork and rice ( a fave of mine) and what I got was a plate of gristly fatty pork cubes. Some people's likin I'm sure but not mine.The staff are very nice and there's a relaxed family atmosphere, but the hit and miss food and not cold enough beers will prevent my return. To balance that out some of my local friends tell me they really like the food there, especially the roast pork. All a matter of taste I suppose, if fatty pork is your thing, this place is perfect, go for it.

Author: KhinChongKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere and location.
Review: It's located nearby Petronas Twin Tower, very classy business hub with secure underground parkings. Good for a date or meeting friends to chill. I went there after dinner, the lightings was nicely dimmed and desert was great. Friendly staffs. We sat outdoor area which was very cozy and tidy, everyone was enjoying the chilly night. I must say, will revisit again soon.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: RangoMa55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very disappointed
Review: That was the greasiest wagyu ribeye I have ever had in my life. It was literally dripping with grease because it wasn't thick enough to be sitting in its own juices. The onion rings were so soaked in oil they were inedible. I was really expecting much better quality food for the prices involved.

Author: Ro_FishersFishers, Indiana
Title: Good food, Bad Service.
Review: I had lunch here on a saturday. The place was seemed relatively busy from outside. In reality, they cramped everybody into the front 1/4 of the restaurant. I only saw two servers who couldn't care less out the customers.. if you can stomach the bad service, food is pretty decent

Author: Jiahui CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Don't bother coming
Review: Requested for a 4-seater even though there were only 2 of us because we planned to order alot but was rejected by the waitress. (There were quite a bit of empty tables.)Server stacked the dim sum baskets up because there was not enough space on the table to place all the baskets on. Throughout our meal, we had to use our bare hands to lift up the piping hot dim sum baskets in order to eat our food.The prawns used in the har kow were small(not a full prawn) and the skin was too thick. The prawn in fried beancurd roll had almost no prawn inside. Some parts only contained beancurd skin. Teacups were dirty.Cashier charged me for the wet towels even though I returned the wet towels to her before she printed my receipt. She also tried to charge me for the peanuts appetizer even though I rejected the dish at the start of my meal.Overall, not worth my money at all. Subpar food. If you decide to come here, check through your bill thoroughly before payment.

Author: mpmilestogo
Title: Nice dinner along the river
Review: Stopped for the lamb kebab roti. Very mice place to sit outside for awhile and eat. They have a few vendors for food and the river is right there!
